verses.sanskrit: अनादिमध्यान्तमनन्तवीर्यं ज्योतिःस्वरूपं ज्वलनं पुराणम् | ब्रह्मा च विष्णुश्च न वेदतुस्तं स्तम्भं महालिङ्गमभूत् तदा हि ||
verses.transliteration: anādimadhyāntamanantavīryaṃ jyotiḥsvarūpaṃ jvalanaṃ purāṇam | brahmā ca viṣṇuśca na vedatustaṃ stambhaṃ mahāliṅgamabhūt tadā hi ||
verses.translation: Without beginning, middle, or end — of infinite power, of the nature of light, blazing, the ancient one — that pillar neither Brahma nor Vishnu could know. That was the Maha-Linga.
verses.hindi: जिसका न आदि है, न मध्य है, न अन्त है — अनन्त शक्तिमान, ज्योतिस्वरूप, प्रज्वलित, पुरातन — उस स्तम्भ को न ब्रह्मा जान सके, न विष्णु। वही महालिङ्ग है।
verses.commentary: The Linga Purana's most profound teaching arrives in its first episode. Brahma and Vishnu — the principles of creation and sustenance — are in conflict over supremacy when the Linga appears. Neither can find its beginning (brahma flies upward as a swan for a thousand years) nor its end (Vishnu digs downward as a boar for a thousand years). The Linga is the anadi-madhya-anta (without beginning, middle, or end) — not a thing within the universe but the ground from which the universe itself arises. The column of fire is the oldest symbol in the Vedic tradition for the axis mundi — the unmoving centre around which all movement occurs.

verses.sanskrit: लिङ्गं हि परमं ब्रह्म लिङ्गं ज्ञानमयं परम् | लिङ्गं ध्यानप्रदं नित्यं लिङ्गं मुक्तिप्रदं परम् ||
verses.transliteration: liṅgaṃ hi paramaṃ brahma liṅgaṃ jñānamayaṃ param | liṅgaṃ dhyānapradaṃ nityaṃ liṅgaṃ muktipradaṃ param ||
verses.translation: The Linga is indeed supreme Brahman. The Linga is the highest wisdom. The Linga bestows meditation eternally. The Linga bestows the highest liberation.
verses.hindi: लिङ्ग ही परम ब्रह्म है। लिङ्ग ज्ञानमय परम है। लिङ्ग नित्य ध्यान प्रदान करता है। लिङ्ग परम मुक्ति प्रदान करता है।
verses.commentary: The Linga Purana demystifies the Linga: it is not a physical symbol to be worshipped as a body part (as critics have misread it) but the supreme Brahman in symbolic form — ज्ञानमय (made of knowledge/consciousness), ध्यानप्रद (that which gives meditation), मुक्तिप्रद (that which gives liberation). The three vertical dimensions of the Linga — the base (Brahma), the octagonal section (Vishnu), and the cylindrical top (Shiva) — represent the three aspects of the cosmos: creation, sustenance, dissolution. Together they are Brahman.

verses.sanskrit: लिङ्गं देवं महाप्रज्ञं सर्वज्ञं सर्वगं शिवम् | यो वेद स लिङ्गविद्यां स याति परमां गतिम् ||
verses.transliteration: liṅgaṃ devaṃ mahāprajñaṃ sarvajñaṃ sarvagaṃ śivam | yo veda sa liṅgavidyāṃ sa yāti paramāṃ gatim ||
verses.translation: The Linga is the God of great wisdom, the all-knowing, all-pervading Shiva. He who knows this Linga-vidya attains the supreme goal.
verses.hindi: लिंग महाप्रज्ञ देव, सर्वज्ञ, सर्वव्यापी शिव हैं। जो इस लिंग-विद्या को जानता है, वह परम गति को प्राप्त होता है।
verses.commentary: The Linga Purana's central teaching: the Linga is not a stone but the symbol of Shiva's all-pervading nature. "Linga-vidyā" — the knowledge of the Linga — is the recognition that Shiva is not located in any particular place but pervades all space. The Linga as a pillar without beginning or end is the perfect symbol for the infinite. To "know" the Linga is to recognise the infinite in the finite form.

verses.sanskrit: पशुः पाशो महेशश्च पतिः पाशविमोचकः | तत्त्वत्रयमिदं ज्ञातव्यं मोक्षार्थिभिर्नरैः ||
verses.transliteration: paśuḥ pāśo maheśaśca patiḥ pāśavimocakaḥ | tattvatrayamidaṃ jñātavyaṃ mokṣārthibhirnaraiḥ ||
verses.translation: The individual soul (pashu), the bondage (pasha), and Maheshvara as the Lord (Pati) who liberates from bondage — these three principles should be known by those who seek liberation.
verses.hindi: पशु (जीव), पाश (बन्धन), और महेश्वर — पाश से मुक्त करने वाले पति — ये तीन तत्त्व मोक्षार्थी मनुष्यों को जानने चाहिए।
verses.commentary: The Shaiva Siddhanta's fundamental metaphysics in one verse: Pati (the Lord — Shiva), Pashu (the individual soul — literally "animal," bound by instinct and ignorance), and Pasha (the bondage — the cords of karma, maya, and ego). Liberation is not the annihilation of the soul but the cutting of its bonds by the grace of Pati. The soul does not merge with Shiva and disappear; it realises it was never truly bound. The Pasha was real in experience but not real in essence — like a rope mistaken for a snake.

verses.sanskrit: यो वेद निहितं गुहायां परमे व्योमन् | स एव शिवः स एव ब्रह्म स एव परमात्मा ||
verses.transliteration: yo veda nihitaṃ guhāyāṃ parame vyoman | sa eva śivaḥ sa eva brahma sa eva paramātmā ||
verses.translation: That one who knows what is hidden in the cave, in the highest sky — that one alone is Shiva, that one alone is Brahman, that one alone is the supreme Self.
verses.hindi: जो परम आकाश में गुफा में स्थित (आत्मा) को जानता है — वही शिव है, वही ब्रह्म है, वही परमात्मा है।
verses.commentary: The Linga Purana's final identity statement: the one who discovers the Self hidden in the "cave of the heart" (guha — a term from the Katha Upanishad) does not merely find something called Shiva. They ARE Shiva. There is no distance between the knower and the known at this level. The "cave" is the innermost space of awareness where the Linga — the pillar of consciousness — is perpetually present, waiting to be recognised. Knowledge here is not about the Self; it is the Self knowing itself.

verses.sanskrit: शिवः शान्तः शिवाकारः शिवालयनिवासकः | विभुः सर्वत्रगः सर्वो विश्वस्य परमेश्वरः ||
verses.transliteration: śivaḥ śāntaḥ śivākāraḥ śivālayanivasākaḥ | vibhuḥ sarvatragaḥ sarvo viśvasya parameśvaraḥ ||
verses.translation: Shiva (the auspicious), Shanta (the peaceful), Shivakarah (whose form is auspiciousness), he who dwells in Shivalaya; Vibhu (all-pervading), Sarvatraga (present everywhere), Sarva (everything), Parameshvara (the supreme lord of the universe).
verses.hindi: शिव (मंगल), शान्त (शान्तिस्वरूप), शिवाकार (शुभस्वरूप), शिवालय में निवास करने वाले; विभु (सर्वव्यापी), सर्वत्रग (सर्वत्र गमन करने वाले), सर्व (सब कुछ), विश्व के परमेश्वर।
verses.commentary: The Sahasranama is not a list of titles — it is a systematic meditation on the nature of ultimate reality through 1,000 lenses. The first four names establish the tonality: Shiva (auspicious), Shanta (peaceful), Shivakarah (whose very form is auspiciousness), Shivalayanivasaka (who dwells in the house of Shiva — i.e., the heart). The teaching: the thousand names are a thousand angles of approach to the same reality. Repeating them is not supplication but recognition — each name is a way of seeing the divine in one more face of experience.

verses.hindi: लिङ्ग ही परम ब्रह्म है। लिङ्ग ज्ञानमय परम है। लिङ्ग नित्य ध्यान प्रदान करता है। लिङ्ग परम मुक्ति प्रदान करता है।
verses.commentary: The Linga Purana demystifies the Linga: it is not a physical symbol to be worshipped as a body part (as critics have misread it) but the supreme Brahman in symbolic form — ज्ञानमय (made of knowledge/consciousness), ध्यानप्रद (that which gives meditation), मुक्तिप्रद (that which gives liberation). The three vertical dimensions of the Linga — the base (Brahma), the octagonal section (Vishnu), and the cylindrical top (Shiva) — represent the three aspects of the cosmos: creation, sustenance, dissolution. Together they are Brahman.
verses.wordMeaning: The Linga Purana demystifies the Linga: it is not a physical symbol to be worshipped as a body part (as critics have misread it) but the supreme Brahman in symbolic form — ज्ञानमय (made of knowledge/consciousness), ध्यानप्रद (that which gives meditation), मुक्तिप्रद (that which gives liberation). The three vertical dimensions of the Linga — the base (Brahma), the octagonal section (Vishnu), and the cylindrical top (Shiva) — represent the three aspects of the cosmos: creation, sustenance, dissolution. Together they are Brahman.

verses.sanskrit: अथ प्राथमिकस्येह यः कालस्तदहः स्मृतम् सर्गस्य तादृशी रात्रिः प्राकृतस्य समासतः
verses.transliteration: atha prāthamikasyeha yaḥ kālastadahaḥ smṛtam sargasya tādṛśī rātriḥ prākṛtasya samāsataḥ
verses.translation: The period of the duration of the Prakrita creation is said to be a day of Brahma. There is a similar period constitut- ing the night. The lord effects creation during day time and dissolution during the night. He has neither a day nor a night (as we understand the terms). The time-duration by day and night is used in a secondary sense.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्माजीको आयुका परिमाण, कालका स्वरूप, कल्प, मन्वन्तर एवं युगादिका मान तथा ब्रह्माजीद्वारा विभिन्न लोकोंकी संरचना अथ प्राथमिकस्येह य: कालस्तदहः स्मृतम्।
verses.wordMeaning: The period of the duration of the Prakrita creation is said to be a day of Brahma. There is a similar period constitut- ing the night. The lord effects creation during day time and dissolution during the night. He has neither a day nor a night (as we understand the terms).…
verses.commentary: Sense: The period of the duration of the Prakrita creation is said to be a day of Brahma. There is a similar period constitut- ing the night. The lord effects creation during day time and dissolution during the night. He has neither a day nor a night (as we understand the terms).…

verses.sanskrit: दिवा सृष्टिं विकुरुते रजन्यां प्रलयं विभुः औपचारिकमस्यैतद् अहोरात्रं न विद्यते
verses.transliteration: divā sṛṣṭiṃ vikurute rajanyāṃ pralayaṃ vibhuḥ aupacārikamasyaitad ahorātraṃ na vidyate
verses.translation: During the (so-called) day all the Vikrtis — the Vi- vedevas, the Prajapatis and the sages stay by. During the night all of them are dissolved. They are produced (again) at the end of the night. A day of His constitutes our kalpa, His night too similarly another kalpa. There are fourteen Manus by the time a thousand sets of four yugas come to a close. O brahmins, the Krta yuga consists of four thousand years. Four hundred, three hundred, two hundred and hundred years respectively constitute the period of transition both at the beginning and end of a yuga.®
verses.hindi: सूतजी बोले- ब्रह्मकी प्राकृत सृष्टिका जो समय है, वही उनका दिन है तथा उतने ही परिमाणको उनकी रात्रि है वे ब्रह्मा दिनमें सृष्टि करते हैं तथा रातमें प्रलय करते हैं। ब्रह्माका अहोरात्र उत्पत्ति-प्रलयरूपात्मक है, मनुष्योंके दिन-रातके समान सूर्योदयास्तवाला नहीं
verses.wordMeaning: During the (so-called) day all the Vikrtis — the Vi- vedevas, the Prajapatis and the sages stay by. During the night all of them are dissolved. They are produced (again) at the end of the night. A day of His constitutes our kalpa, His night too similarly another kalpa.…
verses.commentary: Sense: During the (so-called) day all the Vikrtis — the Vi- vedevas, the Prajapatis and the sages stay by. During the night all of them are dissolved. They are produced (again) at the end of the night. A day of His constitutes our kalpa, His night too similarly another kalpa.…

verses.sanskrit: दिवा विकृतयः सर्वे विकारा विश्वदेवताः प्रजानां पतयः सर्वे तिष्ठन्त्यन्ये महर्षयः
verses.transliteration: divā vikṛtayaḥ sarve vikārā viśvadevatāḥ prajānāṃ patayaḥ sarve tiṣṭhantyanye maharṣayaḥ
verses.translation: The amsaka, therefore, is one-sixth of the duration of each yuga. The period of duration ofTreta, Dvapara and Kali is respectively three thousand, two thousand and one thousand years without their arhsaka parts. That of Krta has been men- tioned above. O men of holy rites, fifteen winks in the eyes of a man of normal health in normal condition constitute a kastha. Thirty such kashas make one kala. Thirty such kalas make one muhurta.
verses.hindi: अध्याय ४ ब्रह्माजीकी आयुका परिमाण “विभिन्न लोकोंकी संरचना २३ फफफफफफफफफफफफफफफफफफफीफफफफफफफाफफफफफफीफफफीफफफमी फक मी क क क की” दिवा विकृतयः सर्वे विकारा विश्वदेवता:। प्रजानां पतयः सर्वे तिष्ठन्त्यन्ये महर्षयः
verses.wordMeaning: The amsaka, therefore, is one-sixth of the duration of each yuga. The period of duration ofTreta, Dvapara and Kali is respectively three thousand, two thousand and one thousand years without their arhsaka parts. That of Krta has been men- tioned above. O men of holy rites,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The amsaka, therefore, is one-sixth of the duration of each yuga. The period of duration ofTreta, Dvapara and Kali is respectively three thousand, two thousand and one thousand years without their arhsaka parts. That of Krta has been men- tioned above. O men of holy rites,…

verses.sanskrit: रात्रौ सर्वे प्रलीयन्ते निशान्ते सम्भवन्ति च अहस्तु तस्य वैकल्पो रात्रिस्तादृग्विधा स्मृता
verses.transliteration: rātrau sarve pralīyante niśānte sambhavanti ca ahastu tasya vaikalpo rātristādṛgvidhā smṛtā
verses.translation: The night contains fifteen such muhurtas and the day another fifteen muhurtas, A (lunar) month according to human
verses.hindi: दिनमें सभी प्रकारकी वैकारिक सृष्टि, समस्त विद्यमान रहते हैं तथा रातमें ये सभी विलीन हो जाते हैं। रातकी समाप्तिपर वे सभी पुनः उत्पन्न हो जाते हैं। ब्रह्माका एक दिन ही एक कल्प कहा जाता है तथा उसी प्रकार उनकी रात भी एक कल्पके मानके तुल्य कही
verses.wordMeaning: The night contains fifteen such muhurtas and the day another fifteen muhurtas, A (lunar) month according to human
verses.commentary: Sense: The night contains fifteen such muhurtas and the day another fifteen muhurtas, A (lunar) month according to human

verses.sanskrit: चतुर्युगसहस्रान्ते मनवस्तु चतुर्दश चत्वारि तु सहस्राणि वत्सराणां कृतं द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: caturyugasahasrānte manavastu caturdaśa catvāri tu sahasrāṇi vatsarāṇāṃ kṛtaṃ dvijāḥ
verses.translation: Each yuga is prefixed and suffixed by a sandhya which specifies the advent and culmination of a yuga. The two sandhya s of a yuga are of equal length though their period of duration differs from yuga to yuga. Thus Krtayuga lasts for four thousand divine years and its sandhyas for eight hundred such years; Trcta lasts for three thousand divine years and its sandhySs for six hundred such years; Dvapara lasts for two thousand and its sandhyas for four hundred; Kali lasts for one thousand audits sandhyas for two hundred such years. The total period of duration for the four yugas is ten thousand divine years and that for their sandhyas is two thousand divine years.
verses.hindi: एक हजार चतुर्युगीकी अवधिमें चौदह मनु उत्पन्न होते हैं। है विप्रो! सत्ययुगका काल चार हजार दिव्य वर्षाका है और उस सत्ययुगके चार सौ वर्षोंकी सन्ध्या तथा सन्ध्यांश होते हैं । उसी प्रकार क्रमसे त्रेतायुगको सन्ध्या तीन सौ वर्षकी, द्वापरकी सन्ध्या दो सौ वर्षको तथा कलियुगकी सन्ध्या एक सौ वर्षकी होती है
verses.wordMeaning: Each yuga is prefixed and suffixed by a sandhya which specifies the advent and culmination of a yuga. The two sandhya s of a yuga are of equal length though their period of duration differs from yuga to yuga.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Each yuga is prefixed and suffixed by a sandhya which specifies the advent and culmination of a yuga. The two sandhya s of a yuga are of equal length though their period of duration differs from yuga to yuga.…

verses.sanskrit: तावच्छती च वै संध्या संध्यांशश् च कृतस्य तु त्रिशती द्विशती संध्या तथा चैकशती क्रमात्
verses.transliteration: tāvacchatī ca vai saṃdhyā saṃdhyāṃśaś ca kṛtasya tu triśatī dviśatī saṃdhyā tathā caikaśatī kramāt
verses.translation: A hundred years calculated according to human reckoning make three years of the Pitrs.
verses.hindi: इस प्रकार सत्ययुगके सन्ध्यांशकको छोड़कर अन्य तीन युगोंके कुल सन्ध्यांशक छः सौ वर्षके होते हैं तथा इन त्रेता, द्वापर और कलिके सन्ध्या-सन्ध्यांशकको छोड़कर इनका नियत समय क्रमशः तीन हजार, दो हजार तथा एक हजार वर्षाका होता है
verses.wordMeaning: A hundred years calculated according to human reckoning make three years of the Pitrs.
verses.commentary: Sense: A hundred years calculated according to human reckoning make three years of the Pitrs.

verses.sanskrit: अंशकः षट्शतं तस्मात् कृतसंध्यांशकं विना त्रिद्व्येकसाहस्रमितो विना संध्यांशकेन तु
verses.transliteration: aṃśakaḥ ṣaṭśataṃ tasmāt kṛtasaṃdhyāṃśakaṃ vinā tridvyekasāhasramito vinā saṃdhyāṃśakena tu
verses.translation: Twelve months according to human calculation make one year ( of the mortals); twelve months of the manes (accor- ding to their own calculation) constitute their one year.
verses.hindi: हे सुव्रत ऋषियो! अब मैं आप लोगोंको त्रेता, द्वापर, कलियुग तथा सत्ययुगके कालमान बताता हूँ। स्वस्थ मनुष्यके नेत्रके पन्द्रह निमेषके समयको एक काष्ठा कहते हैं और तीस काष्ठाकी एक कला होती है। है विप्रो! तीस कलाको मिलाकर एक मुहूर्त कहा जाता है
verses.wordMeaning: Twelve months according to human calculation make one year ( of the mortals); twelve months of the manes (accor- ding to their own calculation) constitute their one year.
verses.commentary: Sense: Twelve months according to human calculation make one year ( of the mortals); twelve months of the manes (accor- ding to their own calculation) constitute their one year.

verses.sanskrit: त्रेताद्वापरतिष्याणां कृतस्य कथयामि वः निमेषपञ्चदशका काष्ठा स्वस्थस्य सुव्रताः
verses.transliteration: tretādvāparatiṣyāṇāṃ kṛtasya kathayāmi vaḥ nimeṣapañcadaśakā kāṣṭhā svasthasya suvratāḥ
verses.translation: According to Lihgapurana one human year constitutes the period of day and night for the manes. Their days, nights and years and their further divisions are as follows:
verses.hindi: पन्द्रह मुहूर्तकी एक रात होती है तथा उसी प्रकार पन्द्रह मुहूर्तका एक दिन होता है। मनुष्योंका एक कृष्णपक्ष पितरोंके एक दिनके बराबर होता है तथा शुक्लपक्ष उनकी स्वप्नसम्बन्धी रातके समान होता है। मनुष्योंके तीस महीनेका समय पितरोंके एक मासके बराबर माना गया है
verses.wordMeaning: According to Lihgapurana one human year constitutes the period of day and night for the manes. Their days, nights and years and their further divisions are as follows:
verses.commentary: Sense: According to Lihgapurana one human year constitutes the period of day and night for the manes. Their days, nights and years and their further divisions are as follows:

verses.sanskrit: मर्त्यस्य चाक्ष्णोस्तस्याश् च ततस् त्रिंशतिका कला कलात्रिंशतिको विप्रा मुहूर्त इति कल्पितः
verses.transliteration: martyasya cākṣṇostasyāś ca tatas triṃśatikā kalā kalātriṃśatiko viprā muhūrta iti kalpitaḥ
verses.translation: The period of Uttarayana (northern transit of the sun) is the day for the manes; the period of Daksinay ana (south- ern transit of the sun) constitutes their night. These days and nights arc calculated in accordance with the reckoning of the devas.
verses.hindi: मनुष्योंके तीन सौ साठ महीनोंका समय पितरोंका एक संवत्सर (वर्ष) माना जाता है मानवीय मानसे सन्ध्या-सन्ध्यांशसहित जो १०० वर्ष होते हैं, यहाँ वे ही पितरोंके तीन वर्ष कहे गये हैं। जैसे लौकिक मानसे बारह मासका एक मानववर्ष होता है,
verses.wordMeaning: The period of Uttarayana (northern transit of the sun) is the day for the manes; the period of Daksinay ana (south- ern transit of the sun) constitutes their night. These days and nights arc calculated in accordance with the reckoning of the devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: The period of Uttarayana (northern transit of the sun) is the day for the manes; the period of Daksinay ana (south- ern transit of the sun) constitutes their night. These days and nights arc calculated in accordance with the reckoning of the devas.

verses.sanskrit: मुहूर्तपञ्चदशिका रजनी तादृशं त्वहः पित्र्ये रात्र्यहनी मासः प्रविभागस्तयोः पुनः
verses.transliteration: muhūrtapañcadaśikā rajanī tādṛśaṃ tvahaḥ pitrye rātryahanī māsaḥ pravibhāgastayoḥ punaḥ
verses.translation: Thirty human years constitute a divine month. O brahmins, a hundred human years constitute three divine months and ten days. Three hundred and sixty human years constitute a divine year. Three thousand and thirty human years constitute a year of the seven sages. Nine thousand and ninety years, according to human calculation make a year of Dhruva. Thirty six thousand human years make a century of divine years. The people who know arithmetic say that the three hundred and sixty thousand human years constitute the period of a thousand divine years.
verses.hindi: त्रिहयेकसाहस्त्रमितौ विना सन्ध्यांशके न तु निमेषपञ्चदशका काष्ठा स्वस्थस्य सुव्रताः
verses.wordMeaning: Thirty human years constitute a divine month. O brahmins, a hundred human years constitute three divine months and ten days. Three hundred and sixty human years constitute a divine year. Three thousand and thirty human years constitute a year of the seven sages.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Thirty human years constitute a divine month. O brahmins, a hundred human years constitute three divine months and ten days. Three hundred and sixty human years constitute a divine year. Three thousand and thirty human years constitute a year of the seven sages.…

verses.sanskrit: कृष्णपक्षस्त्वहस्तेषां शुक्लः स्वप्नाय शर्वरी त्रिंशद्ये मानुषा मासाः पित्र्यो मासस्तु स स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: kṛṣṇapakṣastvahasteṣāṃ śuklaḥ svapnāya śarvarī triṃśadye mānuṣā māsāḥ pitryo māsastu sa smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: The duration of a yuga is calculated according to the divine reckoning. The first yuga is named Krta; thereafter comes Treta and then Dvapara and Kali. O men of holy rites, these are the (names of the four) yugas. Hence- forth the number of years of each yuga which have been mentioned earlier in divine reckoning arc now being counted according to human reckoning. The Krta consists of one million four hundred and forty thousand human years; Treta of one million eight hundred thousand years; Dvapara of seven hundred twenty thousand years and Kali of three hundred and
verses.hindi: मर्त्यस्य चाक्ष्णोस्तस्याश्च ततस्त्रिंशतिका कला। कला त्रिंशतिको विप्रा मुहूर्त इति कल्पितः मुहूर्तपञ्चदशिका रजनी तादूशं त्वहः। पित्र्ये रात्र्यहनी मासः प्रविभागस्तयोः पुन:
verses.wordMeaning: The duration of a yuga is calculated according to the divine reckoning. The first yuga is named Krta; thereafter comes Treta and then Dvapara and Kali. O men of holy rites, these are the (names of the four) yugas.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The duration of a yuga is calculated according to the divine reckoning. The first yuga is named Krta; thereafter comes Treta and then Dvapara and Kali. O men of holy rites, these are the (names of the four) yugas.…

verses.sanskrit: शतानि त्रीणि मासानां षष्ट्या चाप्यधिकानि वै पित्र्यः संवत्सरो ह्येष मानुषेण विभाव्यते
verses.transliteration: śatāni trīṇi māsānāṃ ṣaṣṭyā cāpyadhikāni vai pitryaḥ saṃvatsaro hyeṣa mānuṣeṇa vibhāvyate
verses.translation: Uurhig Brahma's night the creatures perish; at the end O'* the nigut diey are created again. J here are twenty-eight cror<f a of gods who move in aerial chariots.
verses.hindi: कृष्णपक्षस्त्वहस्तेषां शुक्लः स्वप्नाय शर्वरी। त्रिंशद्ये मानुषा मासाः पित्र्यो मासस्तु स स्मृतः शतानि त्रीणि मासानां षष्ट्या चाप्यधिकानि वै। पित्र्यः सम्वत्सरो ह्येष मानुषेण विभाव्यते
verses.wordMeaning: Uurhig Brahma's night the creatures perish; at the end O'* the nigut diey are created again. J here are twenty-eight cror<f a of gods who move in aerial chariots.
verses.commentary: Sense: Uurhig Brahma's night the creatures perish; at the end O'* the nigut diey are created again. J here are twenty-eight cror<f a of gods who move in aerial chariots.

verses.sanskrit: मानुषेणैव मानेन वर्षाणां यच्छतं भवेत् पितॄणां त्रीणि वर्षाणि संख्यातानीह तानि वै
verses.transliteration: mānuṣeṇaiva mānena varṣāṇāṃ yacchataṃ bhavet pitṝṇāṃ trīṇi varṣāṇi saṃkhyātānīha tāni vai

verses.hindi: दश वै ह्यधिका मासाः पितृसंख्येह संस्मृता लौकिकेनैव मानेन अब्दो यो मानुषः स्मृतः श्रीलिड्रमहापुराण  पूर्वभाग
verses.wordMeaning: O hraiimms, during the last kaJpa their number tarar to.s<*v\-ijlv-cight thousand. In all kalpas this is the position in onr* When the dis'chuiori i. imminent pecjple abandon the persons sur-ivng the last day of the kalpa and go to Janaloka from the world Mahar.
verses.commentary: Sense: O hraiimms, during the last kaJpa their number tarar to.s<*v\-ijlv-cight thousand. In all kalpas this is the position in onr* When the dis'chuiori i. imminent pecjple abandon the persons sur-ivng the last day of the kalpa and go to Janaloka from the world Mahar.

verses.sanskrit: दश वै द्व्यधिका मासाः पितृसंख्येह संस्मृता लौकिकेनैव मानेन अब्दो यो मानुषः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: daśa vai dvyadhikā māsāḥ pitṛsaṃkhyeha saṃsmṛtā laukikenaiva mānena abdo yo mānuṣaḥ smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: Kigiit thousaud years of Brahma make his yuga. A ihout-and yugas of Brahma constitute a savana.
verses.hindi: मत न १. ह इस प्रकार दिव्य अहोरात्र तथा दिव्य दिव्ये राव्यहनी वर्ष कर ल है वर्षका विभागपूर्वक वर्णन किया गया है॥ १३--१५॥ अहस्तत्रोदगयनं रात्रिः Re वत ॥ ३६ सूर्यका उत्तकी ओर संक्रमण उत्तरायण-- एते रात्र्यहनी दिव्ये प्रसंख्या » सूर्यका मकरराशिसे मिथुनराशितक ही देवताओंका त्रिंशद्यानि तु वर्षाणि दिव्यो मासस्तु स स्मृतः । दिवस तथा सूर्यका दक्षिणकी ओर संक्रमण दक्षिणायन मानुषं तु शतं विप्रा दिव्यमासास्त्रयस्तु ते॥ १७ कर्कराशिसे धनुराशितक ही देवोंकी रात्रि होती है। दश चैव तथाहानि दिव्यो ह्येष विधि स्मृतः। विशेषतया ये दिव्य अहोरात्र कहे गये हैं
verses.wordMeaning: Kigiit thousaud years of Brahma make his yuga. A ihout-and yugas of Brahma constitute a savana.
verses.commentary: Sense: Kigiit thousaud years of Brahma make his yuga. A ihout-and yugas of Brahma constitute a savana.

verses.sanskrit: एतद्दिव्यमहोरात्रम् इति लैङ्गे ऽत्र पठ्यते दिव्ये रात्र्यहनी वर्षं प्रविभागस्तयोः पुनः
verses.transliteration: etaddivyamahorātram iti laiṅge 'tra paṭhyate divye rātryahanī varṣaṃ pravibhāgastayoḥ punaḥ
verses.translation: Nine thousand such savanas constitute a day of Rud»a.
verses.hindi: त्रीणि वर्षशतान्येव षष्टिवर्षाणि यानि तु॥ १८ मनुष्योंके तीस वर्षोका काल देवताओंके एक दिव्यः सम्वत्सरो ह्येष मानुषेण प्रकीर्तितः । महीनेके समयके बराबर होता है। है विप्रो! मनुष्योंका त्रीणि वर्षसहस्राणि मानुषाणि प्रमाणतः॥ १९ एक सौ वर्ष देवताओंके तीन माह तथा दस दिनके बराबर माना गया है॥ १७/२ ॥
verses.wordMeaning: Nine thousand such savanas constitute a day of Rud»a.
verses.commentary: Sense: Nine thousand such savanas constitute a day of Rud»a.

verses.sanskrit: अहस्तत्रोदगयनं रात्रिः स्याद्दक्षिणायनम् एते रात्र्यहनी दिव्ये प्रसंख्याते विशेषतः
verses.transliteration: ahastatrodagayanaṃ rātriḥ syāddakṣiṇāyanam ete rātryahanī divye prasaṃkhyāte viśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: A manvantara comprises about seventyone mahayugas which are equal to 12,000 years ol the gods. The PurSnas mention fourteen manvantaras. These derive their names from fourteen successive mythical progenitors and sovereigns of the earth.
verses.hindi: नव यानि सहस्राणि वर्षाणां मानुषाणि तु॥ २० मनुष्योंके तीन सौ साठ वर्षाका कालमान देवताओंके अन्यानि नवतीश्चैव ध्रौवः संवत्सरस्तु सः। एक वर्षके समयके तुल्य कहा गया है॥ १८९५, ॥ वर्षाणां तच्छतं ज्ञेय क स वर्ष सप्त एक वर्षके बराबर
verses.wordMeaning: A manvantara comprises about seventyone mahayugas which are equal to 12,000 years ol the gods. The PurSnas mention fourteen manvantaras. These derive their names from fourteen successive mythical progenitors and sovereigns of the earth.
verses.commentary: Sense: A manvantara comprises about seventyone mahayugas which are equal to 12,000 years ol the gods. The PurSnas mention fourteen manvantaras. These derive their names from fourteen successive mythical progenitors and sovereigns of the earth.

verses.sanskrit: त्रिंशद्यानि तु वर्षाणि दिव्यो मासस्तु स स्मृतः मानुषं तु शतं विप्रा दिव्यमासास्त्रयस्तु ते
verses.transliteration: triṃśadyāni tu varṣāṇi divyo māsastu sa smṛtaḥ mānuṣaṃ tu śataṃ viprā divyamāsāstrayastu te
verses.translation: At the dissolution of a kalpa, whatever remains of creation produced during day and night is destroyed.
verses.hindi: ए क उ १ तु मनुष्योंके नौ हजार नब्बे वर्षोको मिलाकर वह षष्टिश्चैव सहस्राणि तानि तु संख्यया। एक श्रौव्य वर्ष (ध्रुव वर्ष) होता है दिव्यं वर्षसहस्रं तु प्राहुः संख्याविदो क 123 मनुष्योंका जो छत्तीस हजार वर्षोका समय है, दिव्येनैव प्रमाणेन सुगसख्याप्रकल्पनम्। वही देवताओंका सौ वर्ष कहा जाता है॥ २१/२ ॥ पूर्व कृतयुगं नाम ततस्त्रेता विधीयते॥ २४ कालगणनाके विद्वान् मनुष्योके तीन लाख साठ
verses.wordMeaning: At the dissolution of a kalpa, whatever remains of creation produced during day and night is destroyed.
verses.commentary: Sense: At the dissolution of a kalpa, whatever remains of creation produced during day and night is destroyed.

verses.sanskrit: दश चैव तथाहानि दिव्यो ह्येष विधिः स्मृतः त्रीणि वर्षशतान्येव षष्टिवर्षाणि यानि तु
verses.transliteration: daśa caiva tathāhāni divyo hyeṣa vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ trīṇi varṣaśatānyeva ṣaṣṭivarṣāṇi yāni tu
verses.translation: The destruction is subject to the behest of lord Siva. When the creation is annihilated and the Pradhana is stationed in itself, both Pradhana and Piirusa come to a standstill or remain inactive. O brahmins, it is only when the three gunas are not in equilibrium that creation takes place. When they are in equilibrium the creation is dissolved. The great lord is the cause of both. The creation is effected by him sportively in this manner.
verses.hindi: हजार वर्षोके समयको देवताओंके एक हजार वर्षोके बराबर कहते हैं कृतस्याद्यस्य विप्रेन्द्रा दिव्यमानेन कीर्तितम्। देवताओंके ही कालप्रमाणसे युगोंकी संख्या
verses.wordMeaning: The destruction is subject to the behest of lord Siva. When the creation is annihilated and the Pradhana is stationed in itself, both Pradhana and Piirusa come to a standstill or remain inactive. O brahmins,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The destruction is subject to the behest of lord Siva. When the creation is annihilated and the Pradhana is stationed in itself, both Pradhana and Piirusa come to a standstill or remain inactive. O brahmins,…

verses.sanskrit: दिव्यः संवत्सरो ह्येष मानुषेण प्रकीर्तितः त्रीणि वर्षसहस्राणि मानुषाणि प्रमाणतः
verses.transliteration: divyaḥ saṃvatsaro hyeṣa mānuṣeṇa prakīrtitaḥ trīṇi varṣasahasrāṇi mānuṣāṇi pramāṇataḥ
verses.translation: Such creations, effected through the agency of Pradhana arc innumerable. The kalpas together with their Brahmas and Vi§nus are innumerable. But lord Siva is only one The activities of Prakrti emerging from Pradhana are due to His sport. The activities as characterized by the gunas are threefold and destructible but the (uncreated) atman has neither a beginning nor a middle nor an cnd.*
verses.hindi: सहस्राणां शतान्यासंश्चतुर्दश च संख्यया॥ २६  कल्पित की गयी है। है सुव्रत ऋषियो! सर्वप्रथम सत्ययुग, इसके बाद त्रेता, फिर द्वापर और अन्तमें कलियुग-ये चार युग कहे गये हैं। अब मानुषीवर्ष- प्रमाणसे इनका काल बताया जाता है
verses.wordMeaning: Such creations, effected through the agency of Pradhana arc innumerable. The kalpas together with their Brahmas and Vi§nus are innumerable. But lord Siva is only one The activities of Prakrti emerging from Pradhana are due to His sport.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Such creations, effected through the agency of Pradhana arc innumerable. The kalpas together with their Brahmas and Vi§nus are innumerable. But lord Siva is only one The activities of Prakrti emerging from Pradhana are due to His sport.…

verses.sanskrit: त्रिंशदन्यानि वर्षाणि मतः सप्तर्षिवत्सरः नव यानि सहस्राणि वर्षाणां मानुषाणि तु
verses.transliteration: triṃśadanyāni varṣāṇi mataḥ saptarṣivatsaraḥ nava yāni sahasrāṇi varṣāṇāṃ mānuṣāṇi tu
verses.translation: The worlds bhur, bhuvah, svar and mahar perish; only the worlds above remain intact. At night, when the mobile and immobile perish and a vast sheet of water® spreads like a single ocean, Brahma goes to sleep in the water. He is there-
verses.hindi: अशीतिश्च सहस्त्राणि कालस्त्रेतायुगस्य च। हे विप्रवरो! कृतयुगका ओके सप्तैव नियुतान्याहुर्वर्षाणां मानुषाणि तु॥ २८ ठता Ci कालमान आ विंशतिश्च सहस्त्राणि कालस्तु द्वापरस्य च। ह कृतयुग मानुषी व
verses.wordMeaning: The worlds bhur, bhuvah, svar and mahar perish; only the worlds above remain intact. At night, when the mobile and immobile perish and a vast sheet of water® spreads like a single ocean, Brahma goes to sleep in the water. He is there-
verses.commentary: Sense: The worlds bhur, bhuvah, svar and mahar perish; only the worlds above remain intact. At night, when the mobile and immobile perish and a vast sheet of water® spreads like a single ocean, Brahma goes to sleep in the water. He is there-

verses.sanskrit: अन्यानि नवतीश्चैव ध्रौवः संवत्सरस्तु सः षट्त्रिंशत्तु सहस्राणि वर्षाणां मानुषाणि तु
verses.transliteration: anyāni navatīścaiva dhrauvaḥ saṃvatsarastu saḥ ṣaṭtriṃśattu sahasrāṇi varṣāṇāṃ mānuṣāṇi tu
verses.translation: Creation is the result of stimulation (ksobha) of the guas* When there is no stimulation, creation docs not exist; consequently, the time- units-— kalpas, manvantaras, yugas, sarhvatsaras and other relatively bigger and smaller units disappear as a matter of course.
verses.hindi: चौदह लाख चालीस हजार वर्षाका है तथा तरेतायुगका कालप्रमाण दस लाख अस्सी हजार वर्षोका, द्वापरयुगका कालमान सात लाख बीस हजार वर्षाका तथा कलियुगका समय तीन लाख साठ हजार वर्षाका कहा गया है। इस षष्टिश्चैव सहस्त्राणि कालः कलियुगस्य तु। एवं चतुर्युगः काल ऋते सन्ध्यांशकात्स्मृतः
verses.wordMeaning: Creation is the result of stimulation (ksobha) of the guas* When there is no stimulation, creation docs not exist; consequently, the time- units-— kalpas, manvantaras, yugas, sarhvatsaras and other relatively bigger and smaller units disappear as a matter of course.
verses.commentary: Sense: Creation is the result of stimulation (ksobha) of the guas* When there is no stimulation, creation docs not exist; consequently, the time- units-— kalpas, manvantaras, yugas, sarhvatsaras and other relatively bigger and smaller units disappear as a matter of course.

verses.sanskrit: वर्षाणां तच्छतं ज्ञेयं दिव्यो ह्येष विधिः स्मृतः त्रीण्येव नियुतान्याहुर् वर्षाणां मानुषाणि तु
verses.transliteration: varṣāṇāṃ tacchataṃ jñeyaṃ divyo hyeṣa vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ trīṇyeva niyutānyāhur varṣāṇāṃ mānuṣāṇi tu
verses.translation: A kalpa (a period of four thousand cycles of four yugas) consti- tutes a day of BrahmS. It is divided into two halves; 2 parardhas. A half kalpa covers a cycle of two thousand caturyugas. At the end of a full kalpa a great fire consumes the world.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्मजीकी आयुका परिमाण“विभिन्न लोकोंकी संरचना एवं चतुर्युगाख्यानां साधिका ह्योकसप्ततिः
verses.wordMeaning: A kalpa (a period of four thousand cycles of four yugas) consti- tutes a day of BrahmS. It is divided into two halves; 2 parardhas. A half kalpa covers a cycle of two thousand caturyugas. At the end of a full kalpa a great fire consumes the world.
verses.commentary: Sense: A kalpa (a period of four thousand cycles of four yugas) consti- tutes a day of BrahmS. It is divided into two halves; 2 parardhas. A half kalpa covers a cycle of two thousand caturyugas. At the end of a full kalpa a great fire consumes the world.

verses.sanskrit: षष्टिश्चैव सहस्राणि संख्यातानि तु संख्यया दिव्यं वर्षसहस्रं तु प्राहुः संख्याविदो जनाः
verses.transliteration: ṣaṣṭiścaiva sahasrāṇi saṃkhyātāni tu saṃkhyayā divyaṃ varṣasahasraṃ tu prāhuḥ saṃkhyāvido janāḥ
verses.translation: Ekarnava symbolises the state of the universe during the period of dissolution when the divided units are drawn together forming a single watery mass. For detail sec MP — A Study, P -10.
verses.hindi: मन्वन्तरस्य संख्या च वर्षाग्रेण प्रकीर्तिता त्रिंशत्कोट्यस्तु वर्षाणां मानुषेण द्विजोत्तमाः। सप्तषष्टिस्तथान्यानि नियुतान्यधिकानि तु
verses.wordMeaning: Ekarnava symbolises the state of the universe during the period of dissolution when the divided units are drawn together forming a single watery mass. For detail sec MP — A Study, P -10.
verses.commentary: Sense: Ekarnava symbolises the state of the universe during the period of dissolution when the divided units are drawn together forming a single watery mass. For detail sec MP — A Study, P -10.

verses.sanskrit: दिव्येनैव प्रमाणेन युगसंख्याप्रकल्पनम् पूर्वं कृतयुगं नाम ततस्त्रेता विधीयते
verses.transliteration: divyenaiva pramāṇena yugasaṃkhyāprakalpanam pūrvaṃ kṛtayugaṃ nāma tatastretā vidhīyate
verses.translation: With great effort he makes the earth even. He gathers together all the mountains burned by fire on the earth. He establishes the four worlds, bhuh, etc. as before. He, the lord creator, then decides to create everything afresh.
verses.hindi: विंशतिश्च सहस्त्राणि कालोऽयमधिकं विना। मन्वन्तरस्य संख्यैषा लैङ्गेऽस्मिन् कीर्तिता द्विजाः चतुर्युगस्य च तथा वर्षसंख्या प्रकीर्तिता। चतुर्युगसहस्त्रं वै कल्पश्चैको द्विजोत्तमाः
verses.wordMeaning: With great effort he makes the earth even. He gathers together all the mountains burned by fire on the earth. He establishes the four worlds, bhuh, etc. as before. He, the lord creator, then decides to create everything afresh.
verses.commentary: Sense: With great effort he makes the earth even. He gathers together all the mountains burned by fire on the earth. He establishes the four worlds, bhuh, etc. as before. He, the lord creator, then decides to create everything afresh.

verses.sanskrit: द्वापरश्च कलिश्चैव युगान्येतानि सुव्रताः अथ संवत्सरा दृष्टा मानुषेण प्रमाणतः
verses.transliteration: dvāparaśca kaliścaiva yugānyetāni suvratāḥ atha saṃvatsarā dṛṣṭā mānuṣeṇa pramāṇataḥ
verses.translation: With great effort he makes the earth even. He gathers together all the mountains burned by fire on the earth. He establishes the four worlds, bhuh, etc. as before. He, the lord creator, then decides to create everything afresh.
verses.hindi: निशान्ते सृजते लोकान् नश्यन्ते निशि जन्तवः। तत्र वैमानिकानां तु अष्टाविंशतिकोटयः त्रीणि कोटिशतान्यासन् कोट्यो द्विनवतिस्तथा
verses.wordMeaning: With great effort he makes the earth even. He gathers together all the mountains burned by fire on the earth. He establishes the four worlds, bhuh, etc. as before. He, the lord creator, then decides to create everything afresh.
verses.commentary: Sense: With great effort he makes the earth even. He gathers together all the mountains burned by fire on the earth. He establishes the four worlds, bhuh, etc. as before. He, the lord creator, then decides to create everything afresh.

verses.sanskrit: कृतस्याद्यस्य विप्रेन्द्रा दिव्यमानेन कीर्तितम् सहस्राणां शतान्यासंश् चतुर्दश च संख्यया
verses.transliteration: kṛtasyādyasya viprendrā divyamānena kīrtitam sahasrāṇāṃ śatānyāsaṃś caturdaśa ca saṃkhyayā
verses.translation: With great effort he makes the earth even. He gathers together all the mountains burned by fire on the earth. He establishes the four worlds, bhuh, etc. as before. He, the lord creator, then decides to create everything afresh.
verses.hindi: कल्पावसानिकांस्त्यक्त्वा प्रलये समुपस्थिते। महरलोकात्प्रयान्त्येते जनलोकं जनास्ततः कोटीनां द्वे सहस्रे तु अष्टौ कोटिशतानि तु। द्विषष्टिशच तथा कोट्यो नियुतानि च सप्ततिः
verses.wordMeaning: With great effort he makes the earth even. He gathers together all the mountains burned by fire on the earth. He establishes the four worlds, bhuh, etc. as before. He, the lord creator, then decides to create everything afresh.
verses.commentary: Sense: With great effort he makes the earth even. He gathers together all the mountains burned by fire on the earth. He establishes the four worlds, bhuh, etc. as before. He, the lord creator, then decides to create everything afresh.

verses.sanskrit: चत्वारिंशत्सहस्राणि तथान्यानि कृतं युगम् तथा दशसहस्राणां वर्षाणां शतसंख्यया
verses.transliteration: catvāriṃśatsahasrāṇi tathānyāni kṛtaṃ yugam tathā daśasahasrāṇāṃ varṣāṇāṃ śatasaṃkhyayā

verses.transliteration: pitāmahasyātha paraḥ parārdhadvayasaṃmitaḥ divā sṛṣṭaṃ tu yatsarvaṃ niśi naśyati cāsya tat
verses.translation: With great effort he makes the earth even. He gathers together all the mountains burned by fire on the earth. He establishes the four worlds, bhuh, etc. as before. He, the lord creator, then decides to create everything afresh.
verses.hindi: पुरस्तादसृजद्देवः सनन्दं सनकं तथा। सनातनं मुनिश्रेष्ठा नैष्क्रम्येण गताः परम् नवैते ब्रह्मणः पुत्रा ब्रह्मज्ञा ब्राह्मणोत्तमाः । ब्रह्मवादिन एवैते ब्रह्मणः सदृशाः स्मृताः

verses.sanskrit: भूर्भुवःस्वर्महस्तत्र नश्यते चोर्ध्वतो न च रात्रौ चैकार्णवे ब्रह्मा नष्टे स्थावरजङ्गमे
verses.transliteration: bhūrbhuvaḥsvarmahastatra naśyate cordhvato na ca rātrau caikārṇave brahmā naṣṭe sthāvarajaṅgame
verses.translation: With great effort he makes the earth even. He gathers together all the mountains burned by fire on the earth. He establishes the four worlds, bhuh, etc. as before. He, the lord creator, then decides to create everything afresh.
verses.hindi: सङ्कल्पश्चैव धर्मश्च ह्यधर्मो धर्मसन्निधिः। द्वादशैव प्रजास्त्वेता ब्रह्मणोऽव्यक्तजन्मनः तावूर्ध्वरेतसौ दिव्यौ चाग्रजौ ब्रह्मवादिनौ

verses.sanskrit: सुष्वापाम्भसि यस्तस्मान् नारायण इति स्मृतः शर्वर्यन्ते प्रबुद्धो वै दृष्ट्वा शून्यं चराचरम्
verses.transliteration: suṣvāpāmbhasi yastasmān nārāyaṇa iti smṛtaḥ śarvaryante prabuddho vai dṛṣṭvā śūnyaṃ carācaram
verses.translation: With great effort he makes the earth even. He gathers together all the mountains burned by fire on the earth. He establishes the four worlds, bhuh, etc. as before. He, the lord creator, then decides to create everything afresh.
verses.hindi: सर्गको सृष्टि-विस्तारका असाधक मानकर वृक्षादिरूप (वृक्ष, गुल्म, लता, वीरुध्, तृणरूप--पाँच प्रकारका सर्ग) मुख्यसर्गका सृजन किया, तदनन्तर ध्यानपूर्वक मनन करते हुए उन ब्रह्माजीका कण्ठ (चिन्तन) त्रिगुणात्मक (सत्त्व, रज तथा तमोगुणसे युक्त) हो गया
verses.wordMeaning: With great effort he makes the earth even. He gathers together all the mountains burned by fire on the earth. He establishes the four worlds, bhuh, etc. as before. He, the lord creator, then decides to create everything afresh.
verses.commentary: Sense: With great effort he makes the earth even. He gathers together all the mountains burned by fire on the earth. He establishes the four worlds, bhuh, etc. as before. He, the lord creator, then decides to create everything afresh.

verses.sanskrit: स्रष्टुं तदा मतिं चक्रे ब्रह्मा ब्रह्मविदां वरः उदकैराप्लुतां क्ष्मां तां समादाय सनातनः
verses.transliteration: sraṣṭuṃ tadā matiṃ cakre brahmā brahmavidāṃ varaḥ udakairāplutāṃ kṣmāṃ tāṃ samādāya sanātanaḥ
verses.translation: With great effort he makes the earth even. He gathers together all the mountains burned by fire on the earth. He establishes the four worlds, bhuh, etc. as before. He, the lord creator, then decides to create everything afresh.
verses.hindi: पहले उन महात्मा ब्रह्माने तिर्यक्र्नोत पशु आदि उत्पन्न किये, तत्पश्चात् उन्होंने ऊर्ध्वस्रोतको रचना की, जो सात्तिविकरूप कहा गया। इसके अनन्तर अर्वाक्स्रोत तदुपरान्त भूतादिकोंका सर्ग रचा गया॥ ५/२ ॥
verses.wordMeaning: With great effort he makes the earth even. He gathers together all the mountains burned by fire on the earth. He establishes the four worlds, bhuh, etc. as before. He, the lord creator, then decides to create everything afresh.
verses.commentary: Sense: With great effort he makes the earth even. He gathers together all the mountains burned by fire on the earth. He establishes the four worlds, bhuh, etc. as before. He, the lord creator, then decides to create everything afresh.

verses.sanskrit: पूर्ववत्स्थापयामास वाराहं रूपमास्थितः नदीनदसमुद्रांश् च पूर्ववच्चाकरोत्प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: pūrvavatsthāpayāmāsa vārāhaṃ rūpamāsthitaḥ nadīnadasamudrāṃś ca pūrvavaccākarotprabhuḥ
verses.translation: With great effort he makes the earth even. He gathers together all the mountains burned by fire on the earth. He establishes the four worlds, bhuh, etc. as before. He, the lord creator, then decides to create everything afresh.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्माजीद्वारा रचित पहला सर्ग महत्तत्त्वादिका है, दूसरा भौतिक सर्ग है, जो भूततन्मात्राओंका है, तीसरा ऐन्द्रियसर्ग है ये बुद्धिपूर्वक उत्पन्न हुए तीन सर्ग प्राकृत सर्ग हैं और चौथा मुख्य सर्ग वृक्ष आदिका कहा जाता है। तिर्यक् योनिवाले पशु-पक्षियोंवाला सर्ग पाँचवाँ सर्ग है तथा छठा देवताओंकी सृष्टिवाला ऊर्ध्व्रोताओंका देवसर्ग कहा जाता है
verses.wordMeaning: With great effort he makes the earth even. He gathers together all the mountains burned by fire on the earth. He establishes the four worlds, bhuh, etc. as before. He, the lord creator, then decides to create everything afresh.
verses.commentary: Sense: With great effort he makes the earth even. He gathers together all the mountains burned by fire on the earth. He establishes the four worlds, bhuh, etc. as before. He, the lord creator, then decides to create everything afresh.

verses.sanskrit: कृत्वा धरां प्रयत्नेन निम्नोन्नतिविवर्जिताम् धरायां सो ऽचिनोत्सर्वान् गिरीन् दग्धान् पुराग्निना
verses.transliteration: kṛtvā dharāṃ prayatnena nimnonnativivarjitām dharāyāṃ so 'cinotsarvān girīn dagdhān purāgninā
verses.translation: With great effort he makes the earth even. He gathers together all the mountains burned by fire on the earth. He establishes the four worlds, bhuh, etc. as before. He, the lord creator, then decides to create everything afresh.
verses.hindi: सातवाँ  अर्वाक्स्रोताओंका सर्ग मनुष्योंका, आठवां अनुग्रहसर्ग है, ये पाँच वैकृतसर्ग हैं नौवाँ कौमार सर्ग कहा जाता है। है विप्रो! प्राकृत तथा वैकृत ये ही नौ सर्ग हैं; जिनमें प्रारम्भके तीन सर्ग प्राकृत हैं तथा पाँच सर्ग वैकृत हैं तथा नौवाँ कौमारसर्ग प्राकृत तथा वैकृत दोनों है
verses.wordMeaning: With great effort he makes the earth even. He gathers together all the mountains burned by fire on the earth. He establishes the four worlds, bhuh, etc. as before. He, the lord creator, then decides to create everything afresh.
verses.commentary: Sense: With great effort he makes the earth even. He gathers together all the mountains burned by fire on the earth. He establishes the four worlds, bhuh, etc. as before. He, the lord creator, then decides to create everything afresh.

verses.sanskrit: भूराद्यांश् चतुरो लोकान् कल्पयामास पूर्ववत् स्रष्टुं च भगवांश्चक्रे तदा स्रष्टा पुनर्मतिम्
verses.transliteration: bhūrādyāṃś caturo lokān kalpayāmāsa pūrvavat sraṣṭuṃ ca bhagavāṃścakre tadā sraṣṭā punarmatim
verses.translation: With great effort he makes the earth even. He gathers together all the mountains burned by fire on the earth. He establishes the four worlds, bhuh, etc. as before. He, the lord creator, then decides to create everything afresh.
verses.hindi: तडुपरान्त भगवान् ब्रह्माने सनक, सनन्दन तथा सनातन एवं सनत्कुमार मुनि उत्पन्न किये। ये श्रेष्ठ इन ऋषियोंको उत्पन्न किया । है = नको उत्पन्न किया है श्रेष्ठ ब्राहमणो । ब्रह्माजीके ये नौ मानस पुत्र ब्रह्मको जाननेवाले 9 अ ब्रह्मको जाननेवाले थे । ये ब्रह्मवादी ऋषि ब्रह्माके ही तुल्य कहे गये हैं। संकल्प, धर्म तथा अधर्म भी उत्पन्न हुर। इस प्रकार उन अव्यक्तजन्मा
verses.wordMeaning: With great effort he makes the earth even. He gathers together all the mountains burned by fire on the earth. He establishes the four worlds, bhuh, etc. as before. He, the lord creator, then decides to create everything afresh.
verses.commentary: Sense: With great effort he makes the earth even. He gathers together all the mountains burned by fire on the earth. He establishes the four worlds, bhuh, etc. as before. He, the lord creator, then decides to create everything afresh.

verses.sanskrit: यदा स्रष्टुं मतिं चक्रे मोहश्चासीन्महात्मनः द्विजाश् च बुद्धिपूर्वं तु ब्रह्मणो ऽव्यक्तजन्मनः
verses.transliteration: yadā sraṣṭuṃ matiṃ cakre mohaścāsīnmahātmanaḥ dvijāś ca buddhipūrvaṃ tu brahmaṇo 'vyaktajanmanaḥ
verses.translation: Ignorance originated from the self-born Brahma in five®* forms: — darkness (tamas), infatuation (moha), the great infatuation (mahamoha), gloominess (tamisra), and blinding gloominess (andhatamisra).
verses.hindi: ब्रह्माकी ये बारह सन्तानें कहलायीं॥ १०--१२॥ उन सनातन ब्रह्माने आदिमें ऋभु तथा सनत्कुमारको
verses.wordMeaning: Ignorance originated from the self-born Brahma in five®* forms: — darkness (tamas), infatuation (moha), the great infatuation (mahamoha), gloominess (tamisra), and blinding gloominess (andhatamisra).
verses.commentary: Sense: Ignorance originated from the self-born Brahma in five®* forms: — darkness (tamas), infatuation (moha), the great infatuation (mahamoha), gloominess (tamisra), and blinding gloominess (andhatamisra).

verses.sanskrit: तमो मोहो महामोहस् तामिस्रश्चान्धसंज्ञितः अविद्या पञ्चधा ह्येषा प्रादुर्भूता स्वयम्भुवः
verses.transliteration: tamo moho mahāmohas tāmisraścāndhasaṃjñitaḥ avidyā pañcadhā hyeṣā prādurbhūtā svayambhuvaḥ
verses.translation: This creation of Brahma which is enveloped by igno- rance is declared to be primary. From this creation emerged the immovables (plants, mountains etc.). He considered this creation incapable of causation. He thought of creating yet. While he thus meditated, his neck turned horizontally.
verses.hindi: अध्याय ५ ब्रह्माजीद्वारा पंचपर्वा अविद्याकी सृष्टि “दक्षप्रजापतिकी कन्याओंका वंशवर्णन २९ कुमारौ ब्रह्मणस्तुल्यौ सर्वज्ञौ सर्वभाविनौ। किया था। अग्रजन्मा वे दोनों दिव्य पुत्र नैष्ठिक वक्ष्ये भार्याकुलं तेषां मुनीनामग्रजन्मनाम्॥ १४  ब्रह्मचारी, ब्रह्मवादी, सर्वज्ञ, सर्वत्र व्याप्त रहनेवाले तथा ब्रह्माके ही समान थे॥ १३ /२॥ हे श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! अब मैं उन अग्रजन्मा मुनियोंको
verses.wordMeaning: This creation of Brahma which is enveloped by igno- rance is declared to be primary. From this creation emerged the immovables (plants, mountains etc.). He considered this creation incapable of causation. He thought of creating yet. While he thus meditated,…
verses.commentary: Sense: This creation of Brahma which is enveloped by igno- rance is declared to be primary. From this creation emerged the immovables (plants, mountains etc.). He considered this creation incapable of causation. He thought of creating yet. While he thus meditated,…

verses.sanskrit: अविद्यया मुनेर्ग्रस्तः सर्गो मुख्य इति स्मृतः असाधक इति स्मृत्वा सर्गो मुख्यः प्रजापतिः
verses.transliteration: avidyayā munergrastaḥ sargo mukhya iti smṛtaḥ asādhaka iti smṛtvā sargo mukhyaḥ prajāpatiḥ
verses.translation: At first the horizontal creation named tiryaksrotas emerged from him; the next was urdhvasrotas chiefly characte-
verses.hindi: भार्याओंका कुल तथा प्रजाओंकी उत्पत्तिका संक्षेपमें वर्णन करूँगा॥ १४/२॥ भगवान् ब्रह्माने स्वायम्भुव मनु तथा रानी शतरूपाका सृजन किया। उस अयोनिजा तथा पुण्यशालिनी रानी शतरूपाने स्वायम्भुव मनुसे दो पुत्र एवं दो कन्याएँ उत्पन्न कों
verses.wordMeaning: At first the horizontal creation named tiryaksrotas emerged from him; the next was urdhvasrotas chiefly characte-
verses.commentary: Sense: At first the horizontal creation named tiryaksrotas emerged from him; the next was urdhvasrotas chiefly characte-

verses.sanskrit: अभ्यमन्यत सो ऽन्यं वै नगा मुख्योद्भवाः स्मृताः त्रिधा कण्ठो मुनेस्तस्य ध्यायतो वै ह्यवर्तत
verses.transliteration: abhyamanyata so 'nyaṃ vai nagā mukhyodbhavāḥ smṛtāḥ tridhā kaṇṭho munestasya dhyāyato vai hyavartata
verses.translation: The Pur&iias often mention Varaha (Boar incarnation of Vifiu) lilting the earth from the depth of the Ek&noava ocean.
verses.hindi: उनमें बुद्धिसम्पन्न प्रियव्रत ज्येष्ठ तथा उत्तानपाद रुचि नामक प्रजापतिने आकूतिको तथा दक्षप्रजापतिने जगद्धात्री योगमयी प्रसूतिको भार्याके रूपमें ग्रहण किया
verses.wordMeaning: The Pur&iias often mention Varaha (Boar incarnation of Vifiu) lilting the earth from the depth of the Ek&noava ocean.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Pur&iias often mention Varaha (Boar incarnation of Vifiu) lilting the earth from the depth of the Ek&noava ocean.

verses.sanskrit: प्रथमं तस्य वै जज्ञे तिर्यक्स्रोतो महात्मनः ऊर्ध्वस्रोतः परस्तस्य सात्त्विकः स इति स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: prathamaṃ tasya vai jajñe tiryaksroto mahātmanaḥ ūrdhvasrotaḥ parastasya sāttvikaḥ sa iti smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: Avidya, also designated as viparyaya is fivefold. Gf. II.9.30. Its five kinds are defined in the Devi Bhdga, These are subdivided into sixty- two kinds. Gf. II, 9. 34-35.
verses.hindi: आकूतिने दक्षिणासहित यज्ञ नामक पुत्रको जन्म दिया और दक्षिणाने दिव्य बारह कन्याओंको उत्पन्न किया प्रसूतिने दक्षप्रजापतिसे श्रद्धा, लक्ष्मी, धृति, पुष्टि,
verses.wordMeaning: Avidya, also designated as viparyaya is fivefold. Gf. II.9.30. Its five kinds are defined in the Devi Bhdga, These are subdivided into sixty- two kinds. Gf. II, 9. 34-35.
verses.commentary: Sense: Avidya, also designated as viparyaya is fivefold. Gf. II.9.30. Its five kinds are defined in the Devi Bhdga, These are subdivided into sixty- two kinds. Gf. II, 9. 34-35.

verses.sanskrit: अर्वाक्स्रोतो ऽनुग्रहश् च तथा भूतादिकः पुनः ब्रह्मणो महतस्त्वाद्यो द्वितीयो भौतिकस् तथा
verses.transliteration: arvāksroto 'nugrahaś ca tathā bhūtādikaḥ punaḥ brahmaṇo mahatastvādyo dvitīyo bhautikas tathā
verses.translation: Formerly, O excellent sages, Brahma created Sananda, Sanaka and Sanatana. By refraining from worldly activities they attained the Supreme Being. By his yogic accomplishment he created Marici, Bhrgu, Angiras, Pulastya, Pulaha, Kratu, Daksa, Atri and Vasistha. These nine sons of Brahma were the knowers of Brahman and excellent brahmins. They are known as expounders of brahman and were equal to Brahma himself*
verses.hindi: कीर्ति, ख्याति, शान्ति, सम्भूति, स्मृति, प्रीति, क्षमा, सन्नति, अनसूया, ऊर्जा, देवताओंके लिये अरणिरूपा स्वाहा तथा स्वधा-इन तपोमयी चौबीस कन्याओंको उत्पन्न किया तथा इन महाभाग्यवती कन्याओंको आगे बताये गये क्रमके अनुसार महात्माजनोंको समर्पित कर दिया
verses.wordMeaning: Formerly, O excellent sages, Brahma created Sananda, Sanaka and Sanatana. By refraining from worldly activities they attained the Supreme Being. By his yogic accomplishment he created Marici, Bhrgu, Angiras, Pulastya, Pulaha, Kratu, Daksa, Atri and Vasistha.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Formerly, O excellent sages, Brahma created Sananda, Sanaka and Sanatana. By refraining from worldly activities they attained the Supreme Being. By his yogic accomplishment he created Marici, Bhrgu, Angiras, Pulastya, Pulaha, Kratu, Daksa, Atri and Vasistha.…

verses.sanskrit: सर्गस्तृतीयश्चैन्द्रियस् तुरीयो मुख्य उच्यते तिर्यग्योन्यः पञ्चमस्तु षष्ठो दैविक उच्यते
verses.transliteration: sargastṛtīyaścaindriyas turīyo mukhya ucyate tiryagyonyaḥ pañcamastu ṣaṣṭho daivika ucyate
verses.translation: [He had three more sons] Saiikalpa, Dharma and Adharma. Adharma is always present near Dharma. Thus there were twelve progenies of Brahma of unknown origin.
verses.hindi: श्रद्धासे लेकर कीर्तिपर्यन्त तेरह परम दुर्लभ सुन्दर कन्याओंने प्रजापति धर्मको पतिरूपमें प्राप्त किया। बुद्धिसम्पन्न भृगुने ख्यातिको, भार्गव शुक्राचार्यने अरणि शान्ति-को, मरीचिने सम्भूतिको तथा मुनि अंगिराने स्मृतिको पत्नीरूपमें ग्रहण किया
verses.wordMeaning: [He had three more sons] Saiikalpa, Dharma and Adharma. Adharma is always present near Dharma. Thus there were twelve progenies of Brahma of unknown origin.
verses.commentary: Sense: [He had three more sons] Saiikalpa, Dharma and Adharma. Adharma is always present near Dharma. Thus there were twelve progenies of Brahma of unknown origin.

verses.sanskrit: सप्तमो मानुषो विप्रा अष्टमो ऽनुग्रहः स्मृतः नवमश्चैव कौमारः प्राकृता वैकृतास्त्विमे
verses.transliteration: saptamo mānuṣo viprā aṣṭamo 'nugrahaḥ smṛtaḥ navamaścaiva kaumāraḥ prākṛtā vaikṛtāstvime
verses.translation: The eternal lord had at the outset created jbhu and Sanatkumara. These two eldest sons became the divine expounders of Brahman. Being free from sexual desire they remained bachelors and rose equal in wisdom to Brahma. They were omniscient and possessed of all merits. I shall now state succinctly the names of the wives of the brahmanical sages and the birth of their progenies, O excellent sages.
verses.hindi: पुण्यात्मा पुलस्त्यने प्रीतिको, मुनि पुलहने क्षमाको, ऊर्जा वसिष्ठो भगवान् वरिष्ठो वारिजेक्षणाम्। बुद्धिसम्मन्न क्रतुने सन्नतिको, अत्रिने उस अनसूयाको, विभावसुस्तथा स्वाहा स्वधां वै पितरस्तथा॥ २६  श्रेष्ठ वसिष्ठे कमलके समान नेत्रोवाली कर्जाको,  यहाँ मनुकी दो पुत्रियाँ कही हैं, जबकि भागवत आदिमें "तिस्र: कन्याश्च जज्ञिरे' मनुकी तीन पुत्रिया प्रसिद्ध हैं। लिङ्गपुराणका वर्णन ईशानकल्पका आख्यान है और भागवतका बर्णन शवेतवाराहकल्पका है । पुराणपठित (पुराणोक्त) सभी आख्यान सत्य हैं, कल्पभैदसे ही भिन्नताकी प्रतीति है।
verses.wordMeaning: The eternal lord had at the outset created jbhu and Sanatkumara. These two eldest sons became the divine expounders of Brahman. Being free from sexual desire they remained bachelors and rose equal in wisdom to Brahma. They were omniscient and possessed of all merits.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The eternal lord had at the outset created jbhu and Sanatkumara. These two eldest sons became the divine expounders of Brahman. Being free from sexual desire they remained bachelors and rose equal in wisdom to Brahma. They were omniscient and possessed of all merits.…

verses.sanskrit: पुरस्तादसृजद्देवः सनन्दं सनकं तथा सनातनं मुनिश्रेष्ठा नैष्कर्म्येण गताः परम्
verses.transliteration: purastādasṛjaddevaḥ sanandaṃ sanakaṃ tathā sanātanaṃ muniśreṣṭhā naiṣkarmyeṇa gatāḥ param
verses.translation: The lord created Viraja (Manu) and Vairajfli Satarupa who was not born of womb. She bore two sons and two daughters to Manu. The elder was the intelligent Priyavrata and the younger Uttanapada. The elder daughter was Akuti and the younger was Prasuti.
verses.hindi: समासतो मुनिश्रेष्ठाः प्रजासम्भूतिमेव च। शतरूपां तु वै राज्ञीं विराजमसृजत् प्रभु: प्रसूतिं भगवान् दक्षो लोकधात्रीं च योगिनीम्
verses.wordMeaning: The lord created Viraja (Manu) and Vairajfli Satarupa who was not born of womb. She bore two sons and two daughters to Manu. The elder was the intelligent Priyavrata and the younger Uttanapada. The elder daughter was Akuti and the younger was Prasuti.
verses.commentary: Sense: The lord created Viraja (Manu) and Vairajfli Satarupa who was not born of womb. She bore two sons and two daughters to Manu. The elder was the intelligent Priyavrata and the younger Uttanapada. The elder daughter was Akuti and the younger was Prasuti.

verses.sanskrit: मरीचिभृग्वङ्गिरसः पुलस्त्यं पुलहं क्रतुम् दक्षमत्रिं वसिष्ठं च सो ऽसृजद्योगविद्यया
verses.transliteration: marīcibhṛgvaṅgirasaḥ pulastyaṃ pulahaṃ kratum dakṣamatriṃ vasiṣṭhaṃ ca so 'sṛjadyogavidyayā
verses.translation: Prajapati Ruci married Akuti and lord Dak$a mar- ried Prasuti the mother of the worlds and a great Yogini. Akuti gave birth to a son Yajfla and a daughter Daksi. Dak§i gave birth to twelve illustrious sons. Prasuti of great penance bore twentyfour daughters to Dak viz., — SraddhE (faith),
verses.hindi: दक्षिणासहितं यज्ञमाकूतिः सुषुवे तथा। दक्षिणा जनयामास दिव्या द्वादशपुत्रिकाः प्रसूतिः सुषुवे दक्षाच्चतुर्विशति कन्यकाः। श्रद्धां लक्ष्मी धृतिं पुष्टिं तुष्टिं मेधां क्रियां तथा
verses.wordMeaning: Prajapati Ruci married Akuti and lord Dak$a mar- ried Prasuti the mother of the worlds and a great Yogini. Akuti gave birth to a son Yajfla and a daughter Daksi. Dak§i gave birth to twelve illustrious sons. Prasuti of great penance bore twentyfour daughters to Dak viz.,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Prajapati Ruci married Akuti and lord Dak$a mar- ried Prasuti the mother of the worlds and a great Yogini. Akuti gave birth to a son Yajfla and a daughter Daksi. Dak§i gave birth to twelve illustrious sons. Prasuti of great penance bore twentyfour daughters to Dak viz.,…

verses.sanskrit: नवैते ब्रह्मणः पुत्रा ब्रह्मज्ञा ब्राह्मणोत्तमाः ब्रह्मवादिन एवैते ब्रह्मणः सदृशाः स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: navaite brahmaṇaḥ putrā brahmajñā brāhmaṇottamāḥ brahmavādina evaite brahmaṇaḥ sadṛśāḥ smṛtāḥ
verses.translation: Ninefold creation: The Puraic cosmology divides the cosmic creation into nine classes. For detail, see SP, (English trans. note 214).
verses.hindi: बुद्धिं लजां वपुः शान्तिं सिद्धिं कीर्ति महातपाः । ख्यातिं शान्तिं च सम्भूतिं स्मृति प्रीतिं क्षमां तथा श्रद्धाद्याश्चैव कीर्त्यन्तास्त्रयोदश सुदारिकाः।
verses.wordMeaning: Ninefold creation: The Puraic cosmology divides the cosmic creation into nine classes. For detail, see SP, (English trans. note 214).
verses.commentary: Sense: Ninefold creation: The Puraic cosmology divides the cosmic creation into nine classes. For detail, see SP, (English trans. note 214).

verses.sanskrit: संकल्पश्चैव धर्मश् च ह्य् अधर्मो धर्मसंनिधिः द्वादशैव प्रजास्त्वेता ब्रह्मणो ऽव्यक्तजन्मनः
verses.transliteration: saṃkalpaścaiva dharmaś ca hy adharmo dharmasaṃnidhiḥ dvādaśaiva prajāstvetā brahmaṇo 'vyaktajanmanaḥ
verses.translation: Sati the mental creation of the lord was adopted as his daughter by Daksa. She the mother of the worlds attained Rudra as her husband. At the beginning of the creation Brahma had created a Being (Rudra) possessed of a body half man's and half women and then the Creator said, "Divide thyself." And he being accosted thus, divided himself into (wo. It was then that she was born.
verses.hindi: धर्म प्रजापतिं जग्मुः पतिं परमदुर्लभाः सम्भूतिञ्च मरीचिस्तु स्मृतिं चैवाङ्गिरा मुनिः
verses.wordMeaning: Sati the mental creation of the lord was adopted as his daughter by Daksa. She the mother of the worlds attained Rudra as her husband. At the beginning of the creation Brahma had created a Being (Rudra) possessed of a body half man's and half women and then the Creator said,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Sati the mental creation of the lord was adopted as his daughter by Daksa. She the mother of the worlds attained Rudra as her husband. At the beginning of the creation Brahma had created a Being (Rudra) possessed of a body half man's and half women and then the Creator said,…

verses.sanskrit: ऋभुं सनत्कुमारं च ससर्जादौ सनातनः तावूर्ध्वरेतसौ दिव्यौ चाग्रजौ ब्रह्मवादिनौ
verses.transliteration: ṛbhuṃ sanatkumāraṃ ca sasarjādau sanātanaḥ tāvūrdhvaretasau divyau cāgrajau brahmavādinau
verses.translation: All the women in three worlds are born of the female part. Similarly, all the eleven Rudras* originated from his male part.
verses.hindi: प्रतिं पुलस्त्यः पुण्यात्मा क्षमां तां पुलहो मुनिः। क्रतुश्च सन्नतिं धीमान् अत्रिस्ताञ्चानुसूयकाम् श्रीलिडुमहापुराण
verses.wordMeaning: All the women in three worlds are born of the female part. Similarly, all the eleven Rudras* originated from his male part.
verses.commentary: Sense: All the women in three worlds are born of the female part. Similarly, all the eleven Rudras* originated from his male part.

verses.sanskrit: कुमारौ ब्रह्मणस् तुल्यौ सर्वज्ञौ सर्वभाविनौ वक्ष्ये भार्याकुलं तेषां मुनीनामग्रजन्मनाम्
verses.transliteration: kumārau brahmaṇas tulyau sarvajñau sarvabhāvinau vakṣye bhāryākulaṃ teṣāṃ munīnāmagrajanmanām
verses.translation: Everything feminine in gender is she herself and everything masculine is Rudra himself. Keeping Rudra in view, lord Brahma looked at Daksa and said, "Worship her, she is of good holv rites, th(i mother of all the worlds, of mine as well as yours, lithe word putri (daughter) is interpreted as 'one who
verses.hindi: पुत्रीकृता सती या सा मानसी शिवसम्भवा। दक्षेण जगतां धात्री रुद्रमेवास्थिता पतिम् अर्धनारीश्वरं दृष्ट्वा सर्गादौ कनकाण्डजः। विभजस्वेति चाहादौ यदा जाता तदाभवत्
verses.wordMeaning: Everything feminine in gender is she herself and everything masculine is Rudra himself. Keeping Rudra in view, lord Brahma looked at Daksa and said, "Worship her, she is of good holv rites, th(i mother of all the worlds, of mine as well as yours,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Everything feminine in gender is she herself and everything masculine is Rudra himself. Keeping Rudra in view, lord Brahma looked at Daksa and said, "Worship her, she is of good holv rites, th(i mother of all the worlds, of mine as well as yours,…

verses.sanskrit: समासतो मुनिश्रेष्ठाः प्रजासम्भूतिमेव च शतरूपां तु वै राज्ञीं विराजमसृजत्प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: samāsato muniśreṣṭhāḥ prajāsambhūtimeva ca śatarūpāṃ tu vai rājñīṃ virājamasṛjatprabhuḥ
verses.translation: Eleven Rudras. For the names of eleven Rudras, sec 1. 82. 40-41. Their names arc variously mentioned in the PurSnas. For instance, Matsya has two lists (5. 29-30; 153. 19) which differ from each other. Vayu agrees with Matsya only in three names. Bhavifya (125.7) gives a different list. For the interpretation of these names and other detail, sec AfP. A Study P 67.
verses.hindi: एकादशविधा रुद्रास्तस्य चांशोद्भवास्तथा स्त्रीलिङ्गमखिलं सा वै पुंलिङ्गं नीललोहितः। तं दृष्ट्वा भगवान् ब्रह्मा दक्षमालोक्य सुव्रताम्
verses.wordMeaning: Eleven Rudras. For the names of eleven Rudras, sec 1. 82. 40-41. Their names arc variously mentioned in the PurSnas. For instance, Matsya has two lists (5. 29-30; 153. 19) which differ from each other. Vayu agrees with Matsya only in three names.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Eleven Rudras. For the names of eleven Rudras, sec 1. 82. 40-41. Their names arc variously mentioned in the PurSnas. For instance, Matsya has two lists (5. 29-30; 153. 19) which differ from each other. Vayu agrees with Matsya only in three names.…

verses.sanskrit: स्वायम्भुवात्तु वै राज्ञी शतरूपा त्वयोनिजा लेभे पुत्रद्वयं पुण्या तथा कन्याद्वयं च सा
verses.transliteration: svāyambhuvāttu vai rājñī śatarūpā tvayonijā lebhe putradvayaṃ puṇyā tathā kanyādvayaṃ ca sā
verses.translation: The thirteen wives of Dharma, Sraddha and others have already been mentioned. I shall now mention the progniy of Dharma from those wives, in due order.
verses.hindi: पुन्नाम्नो नरकात्त्राति इति पुत्री त्विहोक्तितः प्रशस्ता तव कान्तेयं स्यात्पुत्री विश्वमातृका । तस्मात्पुत्री सती नाम्ना तवैषा च भविष्यति
verses.wordMeaning: The thirteen wives of Dharma, Sraddha and others have already been mentioned. I shall now mention the progniy of Dharma from those wives, in due order.
verses.commentary: Sense: The thirteen wives of Dharma, Sraddha and others have already been mentioned. I shall now mention the progniy of Dharma from those wives, in due order.

verses.sanskrit: उत्तानपादो ह्यवरो धीमाञ्ज्येष्ठः प्रियव्रतः ज्येष्ठा वरिष्ठा त्वाकूतिः प्रसूतिश्चानुजा स्मृता
verses.transliteration: uttānapādo hyavaro dhīmāñjyeṣṭhaḥ priyavrataḥ jyeṣṭhā variṣṭhā tvākūtiḥ prasūtiścānujā smṛtā
verses.translation: They are Kama (love), Darpa (pride), Niyama (restraint), Santo§a (contentment), Lobha (covetousness), Sruta (learning), Danda (punishment), Samaya (agreement), Bodha (wisdom), Apramada (non-erring), Vinaya (humility), Vyavasaya (industry), Kma (welfare), Sukha (happiness) and Yaas (fame). These are the offspring of Dharma.
verses.hindi: एवमुक्तस्तदा दक्षो नियोगाद् ब्रह्मणो मुनिः। लब्ध्वा पुत्रीं ददौ साक्षात् सतीं रुद्राय सादरम् धर्मस्य पत्यः श्रद्धाद्याः कीर्तिताः वै त्रयोदश। तासु धर्मप्रजां वक्ष्ये यथाक्रममनुत्तमम्
verses.wordMeaning: They are Kama (love), Darpa (pride), Niyama (restraint), Santo§a (contentment), Lobha (covetousness), Sruta (learning), Danda (punishment), Samaya (agreement), Bodha (wisdom), Apramada (non-erring), Vinaya (humility), Vyavasaya (industry), Kma (welfare),…
verses.commentary: Sense: They are Kama (love), Darpa (pride), Niyama (restraint), Santo§a (contentment), Lobha (covetousness), Sruta (learning), Danda (punishment), Samaya (agreement), Bodha (wisdom), Apramada (non-erring), Vinaya (humility), Vyavasaya (industry), Kma (welfare),…

verses.sanskrit: उपयेमे तदाकूतिं रुचिर्नाम प्रजापतिः प्रसूतिं भगवान्दक्षो लोकधात्रीं च योगिनीम्
verses.transliteration: upayeme tadākūtiṃ rucirnāma prajāpatiḥ prasūtiṃ bhagavāndakṣo lokadhātrīṃ ca yoginīm
verses.translation: Dharma begot of Kriya (activity) and Buddhi (in- telligence) two sons each viz., — Danda (punishment) and Samaya (agreement) of the former, Apramada (non-erring) and Bodha (wisdom) of the latter. Hence the sons of Dharma and Adharnia are fifteen in all. Bhrgu's wife Khyati gave birth to Sn, (who became) the wife of Visnu and to two sons Dhatr and Vidhatrwho later became the sons-in-law ofMeru. Prabhuti, wife of Marici, gave birth to two sons: Purnamasa and Marlca and four daughters: Tusp, Drsi, Krsi and Apaciti.
verses.hindi: कामो दर्पोऽथ नियमः सन्तोषो लोभ एव च। क्षेमं सुखं यशश्चैव धर्मपुत्राशच तासु वै
verses.wordMeaning: Dharma begot of Kriya (activity) and Buddhi (in- telligence) two sons each viz., — Danda (punishment) and Samaya (agreement) of the former, Apramada (non-erring) and Bodha (wisdom) of the latter. Hence the sons of Dharma and Adharnia are fifteen in all.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Dharma begot of Kriya (activity) and Buddhi (in- telligence) two sons each viz., — Danda (punishment) and Samaya (agreement) of the former, Apramada (non-erring) and Bodha (wisdom) of the latter. Hence the sons of Dharma and Adharnia are fifteen in all.…

verses.sanskrit: दक्षिणासहितं यज्ञम् आकूतिः सुषुवे तथा दक्षिणा जनयामास दिव्या द्वादश पुत्रिकाः
verses.transliteration: dakṣiṇāsahitaṃ yajñam ākūtiḥ suṣuve tathā dakṣiṇā janayāmāsa divyā dvādaśa putrikāḥ
verses.translation: O great sages, Ksama bore to Pulaha three sons: Kardama, Variyas and Sahisnu and one daughter Pivari, golden in colour and stout as the earth. Pulastya begot of Priti two sonsDattorna and Vedabahu and a daughter Drdvatl. Sannati, wife of Kratu gave birth to sixty thousand sons who are known as Balakhilyas. Smrti, wife of sage Angiras, gave birth to four daughters: Sinivall, Kuhu, Raka and Anumati after obtaining three sons: Anubhava, Agni and Kirtiman, O sages of holy rites.
verses.hindi: धर्मस्य वै क्रियायां तु दण्डः समय एव च। अप्रमादस्तथा बोधो बुद्धेर्धर्मस्य तौ सुतौ तस्मात् पञ्चदशैवैते तासु धर्मात्मजास्त्विह। भृगुपली च सुषुवे ख्यातिर्विष्णो: प्रियां श्रियम्
verses.wordMeaning: O great sages, Ksama bore to Pulaha three sons: Kardama, Variyas and Sahisnu and one daughter Pivari, golden in colour and stout as the earth. Pulastya begot of Priti two sonsDattorna and Vedabahu and a daughter Drdvatl. Sannati,…
verses.commentary: Sense: O great sages, Ksama bore to Pulaha three sons: Kardama, Variyas and Sahisnu and one daughter Pivari, golden in colour and stout as the earth. Pulastya begot of Priti two sonsDattorna and Vedabahu and a daughter Drdvatl. Sannati,…

verses.sanskrit: प्रसूतिः सुषुवे दक्षाच् चतुर्विंशतिकन्यकाः श्रद्धां लक्ष्मीं धृतिं पुष्टिं तुष्टिं मेधां क्रियां तथा
verses.transliteration: prasūtiḥ suṣuve dakṣāc caturviṃśatikanyakāḥ śraddhāṃ lakṣmīṃ dhṛtiṃ puṣṭiṃ tuṣṭiṃ medhāṃ kriyāṃ tathā
verses.translation: Anasuya, the wife of Atri, gave birth to six children, a daughter Sruti and five sons: Satyanetra, Bhavyamurti, Apa, Sanaiscara and Soma; the sixth was Sruti (mentioned above). The affectionate mother Orja bore to Vasistha seven handsome sons: Rajas, Suhotra, Bahu, Savana, Anagha, Sutapas and Sukra. verses.transliteration: kratostu bhāryā sarve te vālakhilyā iti śrutāḥ sinīvālīṃ kuhūṃ caiva rākāṃ cānumatiṃ tathā

To the god of fire who identifies himself with Rudra and is the eldest son of Brahma and also the very life of the
verses.hindi: स्वधाने उन अग्निष्वात्त पितरोंसे मेना नामक मानसी कन्या उत्पन्न की। अग्निष्वात्त पितरोंको वह मानसौ पुत्री मेना लोकमें अतीव प्रसिद्ध हुई मेनाने मैनाक, क्रौञ्च, उसकी अनुजा उमा तथा शिवजीके अंग-श्लेषके कारण (मस्तकपर विराजमान रहनेके कारण) जगत्को पवित्र करनेका गुण रखनेवाली हैमवती गंगाको उत्पन्न किया

verses.transliteration: smṛtiś ca suṣuve patnī muneścāṅgirasas tathā labdhānubhāvamagniṃ ca kīrtimantaṃ ca suvratā

To the god of fire who identifies himself with Rudra and is the eldest son of Brahma and also the very life of the
verses.hindi: कमलके समान मुखवाली मेरुराजपत्नी स्वधाने यज्ञानुष्ठानमें प्रवृत्त रहनेवाली धरणी नामक मानसी पुत्रीको जन्म दिया। यहाँ अमृतपान करनेवाले पितरों तथा ऋषियोंके कुलका विस्तार दिया जा रहा है; आप लोग उसे विस्तारपूर्वक सुनिये

verses.sanskrit: अत्रेर्भार्यानसूया वै सुषुवे षट्प्रजास्तु याः तास्वेका कन्यका नाम्ना श्रुतिः सा सूनुपञ्चकम्
verses.transliteration: atrerbhāryānasūyā vai suṣuve ṣaṭprajāstu yāḥ tāsvekā kanyakā nāmnā śrutiḥ sā sūnupañcakam

To the god of fire who identifies himself with Rudra and is the eldest son of Brahma and also the very life of the
verses.hindi: अब मैं आप सबसे पूर्वनिरूपित विषयका पुनः पृथक् अध्यायमें वर्णन करता हूँ । दक्षकन्या सतीका विवाह ुद्रके साथ हुआ और वे उनके साथ चली गयीं । फिर इन्हीं सतीने दक्षके यज्ञका विध्वंस करके अपना देहत्याग कर दिया। इसके बाद पार्वतीरूपमें पुनः शिवजीको पतिके
verses.wordMeaning: Anasuya, the wife of Atri, gave birth to six children, a daughter Sruti and five sons: Satyanetra, Bhavyamurti, Apa, Sanaiscara and Soma; the sixth was Sruti (mentioned above). The affectionate mother Orja bore to Vasistha seven handsome sons: Rajas, Suhotra, Bahu, Savana,…

verses.sanskrit: सत्यनेत्रो मुनिर्भव्यो मूर्तिरापः शनैश्चरः सोमश् च वै श्रुतिः षष्ठी पञ्चात्रेयास्तु सूनवः
verses.transliteration: satyanetro munirbhavyo mūrtirāpaḥ śanaiścaraḥ somaś ca vai śrutiḥ ṣaṣṭhī pañcātreyāstu sūnavaḥ

verses.sanskrit: ऊर्जा वसिष्ठाद्वै लेभे सुतांश् च सुतवत्सला ज्यायसी पुण्डरीकाक्षान् वासिष्ठान् वरलोचना
verses.transliteration: ūrjā vasiṣṭhādvai lebhe sutāṃś ca sutavatsalā jyāyasī puṇḍarīkākṣān vāsiṣṭhān varalocanā

verses.wordMeaning: Anasuya, the wife of Atri, gave birth to six children, a daughter Sruti and five sons: Satyanetra, Bhavyamurti, Apa, Sanaiscara and Soma; the sixth was Sruti (mentioned above). The affectionate mother Orja bore to Vasistha seven handsome sons: Rajas, Suhotra, Bahu, Savana,…

verses.sanskrit: रजः सुहोत्रो बाहुश् च सवनश्चानघस् तथा सुतपाः शुक्र इत्येते मुनेर्वै सप्त सूनवः
verses.transliteration: rajaḥ suhotro bāhuś ca savanaścānaghas tathā sutapāḥ śukra ityete munervai sapta sūnavaḥ

To the god of fire who identifies himself with Rudra and is the eldest son of Brahma and also the very life of the
verses.hindi: ब्रह्माजीके मानसपुत्र सनक, सनन्दन, सनातन तथा सनत्कुमार दिव्य कैलासधाममें परिकरोंसहित विराजमान भगवान् उमा-महेश्वर

verses.sanskrit: यश्चाभिमानी भगवान् भवात्मा पैतामहो वह्निरसुः प्रजानाम् स्वाहा च तस्मात्सुषुवे सुतानां त्रयं त्रयाणां जगतां हिताय
verses.transliteration: yaścābhimānī bhagavān bhavātmā paitāmaho vahnirasuḥ prajānām svāhā ca tasmātsuṣuve sutānāṃ trayaṃ trayāṇāṃ jagatāṃ hitāya

To the god of fire who identifies himself with Rudra and is the eldest son of Brahma and also the very life of the
