verses.sanskrit: पवमानः पावकश् च शुचिरग्निश् च ते स्मृताः निर्मथ्यः पवमानस्तु वैद्युतः पावकः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: pavamānaḥ pāvakaś ca śuciragniś ca te smṛtāḥ nirmathyaḥ pavamānastu vaidyutaḥ pāvakaḥ smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: The three sons of Agni are Pavamana, Pavaka and Suci. The fire produced by attrition is called Pavamana; that from lightning is named Pavaka; that from the sun is known as Suci. The three were the sons of Svaha. Together with their sons and grandsons their number goes upto fortyninc (*-7x7). The fires are produced in sacrifices.
verses.hindi: आत्मनस्तु समान् सर्वान् सर्वलोकनमस्कृतान्। है मुनिशार्दूलो ! उन (पार्वती)-का ध्यान करके याचितो मुनिशादूला ब्रह्मणा प्रहसन् क्षणात्॥ १२ प्रार्थनापर नीललोहित महादेवजीने क्षण- भरमें लीलापूर्वक अपने ही तुल्य तथा समस्त लोकोंके वन्दनीय अनेक रुद्र उत्पन्न कर दिये। उन रुद्रोने सभी चौदह भुवनोंको पूर्णरूपेण व्याप्त कर
verses.wordMeaning: The three sons of Agni are Pavamana, Pavaka and Suci. The fire produced by attrition is called Pavamana; that from lightning is named Pavaka; that from the sun is known as Suci. The three were the sons of Svaha.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The three sons of Agni are Pavamana, Pavaka and Suci. The fire produced by attrition is called Pavamana; that from lightning is named Pavaka; that from the sun is known as Suci. The three were the sons of Svaha.…

verses.sanskrit: शुचिः सौरस्तु विज्ञेयः स्वाहापुत्रास्त्रयस्तु ते पुत्रैः पौत्रैस्त्विहैतेषां संख्या संक्षेपतः स्मृता
verses.transliteration: śuciḥ saurastu vijñeyaḥ svāhāputrāstrayastu te putraiḥ pautraistvihaiteṣāṃ saṃkhyā saṃkṣepataḥ smṛtā
verses.translation: All these are ascetics and observers of holy rites. All of them arc praj&patis identical with Rudra.
verses.hindi: जरा-मरणसे मुक्त तथा निर्मल आत्मावाले उन विविध नीललोहित रुद्रोंको देखकर पितामह ब्रह्माजीने उनसे कहा॥ १३ /२॥ हे त्रिनेत्रधारी नीललोहित महादेवो! आप सभीको नमस्कार है। आप सभी सर्वज्ञ हैं, सर्वव्यापी हैं, दीर्घ- हस्व-वामन (बौना)-रूप धारण करनेवाले हैं, शुभ हैं, हिरण्यकेश हैं, दूष्टिघ्न हैं, नित्य हैं, चेतनायुक्त हैं,
verses.wordMeaning: All these are ascetics and observers of holy rites. All of them arc praj&patis identical with Rudra.
verses.commentary: Sense: All these are ascetics and observers of holy rites. All of them arc praj&patis identical with Rudra.

verses.sanskrit: विसृज्य सप्तकं चादौ चत्वारिंशन्नवैव च इत्येते वह्नयः प्रोक्ताः प्रणीयन्ते ऽध्वरेषु च
verses.transliteration: visṛjya saptakaṃ cādau catvāriṃśannavaiva ca ityete vahnayaḥ proktāḥ praṇīyante 'dhvareṣu ca
verses.translation: The Pitfs are of two categories: yajvans and non-yajvans. Yajvans arc also called Agnisvattas, the non-yajvans as Barhi- das.
verses.hindi: निर्मल आत्मावाले हैं, हन्हृरहित हैं, वीतराग हैं, विश्वको आत्मा हैं तथा शिवजीके आत्मज हैं। इस प्रकार उन रुद्रोंकी अनेकविध स्तुति करके कनकाण्डज (हिरण्यगर्भ) भगवान् ब्रह्माने शिवजीको प्रदक्षिणाकर उन भवरूप हे महादेव! आपको नमस्कार है। है प्रभो! हे शंकर! आपने तो अमर प्रजाओंको उत्पन्न कर दिया; ऐसी मृत्युहीन प्रजाकी सृष्टि उचित नहीं है। अतएव हे विभो! अब आप मरणधर्मा प्रजाओंका सूजन
verses.wordMeaning: The Pitfs are of two categories: yajvans and non-yajvans. Yajvans arc also called Agnisvattas, the non-yajvans as Barhi- das.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Pitfs are of two categories: yajvans and non-yajvans. Yajvans arc also called Agnisvattas, the non-yajvans as Barhi- das.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वे तपस्विनस्त्वेते सर्वे व्रतभृतः स्मृताः प्रजानां पतयः सर्वे सर्वे रुद्रात्मकाः स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: sarve tapasvinastvete sarve vratabhṛtaḥ smṛtāḥ prajānāṃ patayaḥ sarve sarve rudrātmakāḥ smṛtāḥ
verses.translation: Sraddh& gave birth to the mental daughter Mena. This mental daughter is well known in the world.
verses.hindi: करनेकी कृपा करें तब भगवान् शंकरने ब्रह्मासे कहा-हे प्रभो! उस प्रकारकी (मरणधर्मा) सृष्टि करनेकी मेरी स्थिति नहीं है। अतएव आप ही मृत्युसे युक्त रहनेवाली प्रजाका अपने इच्छानुसार सृजन कोजिये
verses.wordMeaning: Sraddh& gave birth to the mental daughter Mena. This mental daughter is well known in the world.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sraddh& gave birth to the mental daughter Mena. This mental daughter is well known in the world.

verses.sanskrit: अयज्वानश् च यज्वानः पितरः प्रीतिमानसाः अग्निष्वात्ताश् च यज्वानः शेषा बर्हिषदः स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: ayajvānaś ca yajvānaḥ pitaraḥ prītimānasāḥ agniṣvāttāś ca yajvānaḥ śeṣā barhiṣadaḥ smṛtāḥ
verses.translation: Mena gave birth to Mainaka Kraufica, his (Mainaka's) younger sisters Uma and Gahga. The latter became the holiest by virtue of her contact with the body of lord Siva. Svadha gave birth to a mental daughter Dharani (earth) who became the support of sacrifices. That lady (Dharaii) of lotus-face became the wife of Meru, the king of mountains.
verses.hindi: भगवान् शंकरको ऐसी आज्ञा प्राप्तकर चतुरानन ब्रह्माने जरा-मरणसे युक्त इस सम्पूर्ण स्थावर-जंगम जगतूकी रचना को भगवान् शंकर भी उस समय रुद्रों (रुद्रात्मक सृष्टिके सूजन) -से निवृत्त आत्मावाले होकर अधिष्ठित हो गये। है विप्रो! निष्कल आत्मावाले तथा अपनी इच्छासे शरीर धारण करनेवाले उन महात्मा शंकरका
verses.wordMeaning: Mena gave birth to Mainaka Kraufica, his (Mainaka's) younger sisters Uma and Gahga. The latter became the holiest by virtue of her contact with the body of lord Siva. Svadha gave birth to a mental daughter Dharani (earth) who became the support of sacrifices.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Mena gave birth to Mainaka Kraufica, his (Mainaka's) younger sisters Uma and Gahga. The latter became the holiest by virtue of her contact with the body of lord Siva. Svadha gave birth to a mental daughter Dharani (earth) who became the support of sacrifices.…

verses.sanskrit: मेनां तु मानसीं तेषां जनयामास वै स्वधा अग्निष्वात्तात्मजा मेना मानसी लोकविश्रुता
verses.transliteration: menāṃ tu mānasīṃ teṣāṃ janayāmāsa vai svadhā agniṣvāttātmajā menā mānasī lokaviśrutā
verses.translation: The Pitrs are anirtapas (imbibers of nectar). Their account in detail, together with that of the sages and their fami- lies I shall narrate in a separate chapter, later on.
verses.hindi: तान्दृष्ट्वा विविधान् रुद्रान्निर्मलान्नीललोहितान् जरामरणानिर्मुक्तान् प्राह रुद्रान् पितामहः। नमोऽस्तु वो महादेवास्त्रिनेत्रा नीललोहिताः
verses.wordMeaning: The Pitrs are anirtapas (imbibers of nectar). Their account in detail, together with that of the sages and their fami- lies I shall narrate in a separate chapter, later on.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Pitrs are anirtapas (imbibers of nectar). Their account in detail, together with that of the sages and their fami- lies I shall narrate in a separate chapter, later on.

verses.sanskrit: असूत मेना मैनाकं क्रौञ्चं तस्यानुजामुमाम् गङ्गां हैमवतीं जज्ञे भवाङ्गाश्लेषपावनीम्
verses.transliteration: asūta menā mainākaṃ krauñcaṃ tasyānujāmumām gaṅgāṃ haimavatīṃ jajñe bhavāṅgāśleṣapāvanīm
verses.translation: For agnivazha see Vdyu I. 29; Brahmia I. i.io; Mirkaoda 52, 20-21, I.IO. 14-17. According to Likga (ii*i2.33) agni is the
verses.hindi: सर्वज्ञाः सर्वगा दीर्घा हृस्वा वामनकाः शुभाः। हिरण्यकेशा दृष्टिघ्ना नित्या बुद्धाश्च निर्मला: एवं स्तुत्वा तदा रुद्रान् रुद्रं चाह भवं शिवम्। प्रदक्षिणीकृत्य तदा भगवान् कनकाण्डजः
verses.wordMeaning: For agnivazha see Vdyu I. 29; Brahmia I. i.io; Mirkaoda 52, 20-21, I.IO. 14-17. According to Likga (ii*i2.33) agni is the
verses.commentary: Sense: For agnivazha see Vdyu I. 29; Brahmia I. i.io; Mirkaoda 52, 20-21, I.IO. 14-17. According to Likga (ii*i2.33) agni is the

verses.sanskrit: धरणीं जनयामास मानसीं यज्ञयाजिनीम् स्वधा सा मेरुराजस्य पत्नी पद्मसमानना
verses.transliteration: dharaṇīṃ janayāmāsa mānasīṃ yajñayājinīm svadhā sā merurājasya patnī padmasamānanā
verses.translation: Later, she cursed her father Dak$a [and immolated her- self] Rudra who thought on her created many Rudras.
verses.hindi: नमोऽस्तु ते महादेव प्रजा नारहसि शङ्कर। ततस्तमाह भगवान् नहि मे तादूशी स्थितिः। स त्वं सृज यथाकामं मृत्युयुक्ताः प्रजाः प्रभो
verses.wordMeaning: Later, she cursed her father Dak$a [and immolated her- self] Rudra who thought on her created many Rudras.
verses.commentary: Sense: Later, she cursed her father Dak$a [and immolated her- self] Rudra who thought on her created many Rudras.

verses.sanskrit: पितरो ऽमृतपाः प्रोक्तास् तेषां चैवेह विस्तरः ऋषीणां च कुलं सर्वं शृणुध्वं तत्सुविस्तरम्
verses.transliteration: pitaro 'mṛtapāḥ proktās teṣāṃ caiveha vistaraḥ ṛṣīṇāṃ ca kulaṃ sarvaṃ śṛṇudhvaṃ tatsuvistaram
verses.translation: He created them in the form of his own person and they were honoured by all the worlds. O leading sages, it was at the behest of Brahma that lord Rudra created them. The lord had laughed and they were created immediately.
verses.hindi: शङ्करोऽपि तदा रुद्रैर्निवृत्तात्मा ह्यधिष्ठितः। स्थाणुत्वं तस्य वै विप्राः शङ्करस्य महात्मनः शं रूद्रः सर्वभूतानां करोति घृणया यतः
verses.wordMeaning: He created them in the form of his own person and they were honoured by all the worlds. O leading sages, it was at the behest of Brahma that lord Rudra created them. The lord had laughed and they were created immediately.
verses.commentary: Sense: He created them in the form of his own person and they were honoured by all the worlds. O leading sages, it was at the behest of Brahma that lord Rudra created them. The lord had laughed and they were created immediately.

verses.sanskrit: वदामि पृथगध्यायसंस्थितं वस्तदूर्ध्वतः दाक्षायणी सती याता पार्श्वं रुद्रस्य पार्वती
verses.transliteration: vadāmi pṛthagadhyāyasaṃsthitaṃ vastadūrdhvataḥ dākṣāyaṇī satī yātā pārśvaṃ rudrasya pārvatī
verses.translation: The fourteen worlds** were completely covered by them. They were of different sort, devoid of impurities, death- less and ageless. On seeing these Rudras in front Brahma spoke to them:
verses.hindi: श्रीलिड्रमहापुराण ति क ० २ ० जा गा +, फ ककर का फी फ ममी मी मी कमा फकिकफाफझमाफामझफफफफफकफ फ़
verses.wordMeaning: The fourteen worlds** were completely covered by them. They were of different sort, devoid of impurities, death- less and ageless. On seeing these Rudras in front Brahma spoke to them:
verses.commentary: Sense: The fourteen worlds** were completely covered by them. They were of different sort, devoid of impurities, death- less and ageless. On seeing these Rudras in front Brahma spoke to them:

verses.sanskrit: पश्चाद्दक्षं विनिन्द्यैषा पतिं लेभे भवं तथा तां ध्यात्वा व्यसृजद्रुद्रान् अनेकान्नीललोहितः
verses.transliteration: paścāddakṣaṃ vinindyaiṣā patiṃ lebhe bhavaṃ tathā tāṃ dhyātvā vyasṛjadrudrān anekānnīlalohitaḥ
verses.translation: "O lord, obeisance be to you; O great Rudra, it does not behove you to create subjects devoid of death. O lord, you should create mortal subjects."
verses.hindi: शङ्करश्चाप्रयलेन तदात्मा योगविद्यया। वैराग्यस्थं विरक्तस्य विमुक्तिर्यच्छमुच्यते धर्मो ज्ञानञ्च वैराग्यमैश्वर्यं शङ्करादिह। स एव शङ्करः साक्षात् पिनाको नीललोहितः
verses.wordMeaning: "O lord, obeisance be to you; O great Rudra, it does not behove you to create subjects devoid of death. O lord, you should create mortal subjects."
verses.commentary: Sense: "O lord, obeisance be to you; O great Rudra, it does not behove you to create subjects devoid of death. O lord, you should create mortal subjects."

verses.sanskrit: आत्मनस्तु समान्सर्वान् सर्वलोकनमस्कृतान् याचितो मुनिशार्दूला ब्रह्मणा प्रहसन् क्षणात्
verses.transliteration: ātmanastu samānsarvān sarvalokanamaskṛtān yācito muniśārdūlā brahmaṇā prahasan kṣaṇāt
verses.translation: Then the great lord Rudra replied thus, ''My position is not of such a nature. O Brahma, you should create such sub* jects endowed with death."
verses.hindi: ये शङ्कराश्रिताः सर्वे मुच्यन्ते ते न संशयः। न गच्छन्त्येव नरकं पापिष्ठा अपि दारुणम् आश्रिताः शङ्कर तस्मात्प्राप्नुवन्ति शाश्वतम्।
verses.wordMeaning: Then the great lord Rudra replied thus, ''My position is not of such a nature. O Brahma, you should create such sub* jects endowed with death."
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the great lord Rudra replied thus, ''My position is not of such a nature. O Brahma, you should create such sub* jects endowed with death."

verses.sanskrit: तैस्तु संछादितं सर्वं चतुर्दशविधं जगत् तान्दृष्ट्वा विविधान् रुद्रान् निर्मलान्नीललोहितान्
verses.transliteration: taistu saṃchāditaṃ sarvaṃ caturdaśavidhaṃ jagat tāndṛṣṭvā vividhān rudrān nirmalānnīlalohitān
verses.translation: Thus, at the will of Rudra, the four-faced Brahma created the Universe, of the mobile and immobile beings, en- dowed with death and old age.
verses.hindi: कोटयो नरकाणान्तु पच्यन्ते तासु पापिनः। अनाश्रिताः शिवं रुद्रं शङ्करं नीललोहितम् स्थाणुत्व हो गया। इसीलिये वे भगवान् रुद्र दयार्द् होकर सभी प्राणियोंका कल्याण करते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: Thus, at the will of Rudra, the four-faced Brahma created the Universe, of the mobile and immobile beings, en- dowed with death and old age.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus, at the will of Rudra, the four-faced Brahma created the Universe, of the mobile and immobile beings, en- dowed with death and old age.

verses.sanskrit: जरामरणनिर्मुक्तान् प्राह रुद्रान्पितामहः नमो ऽस्तु वो महादेवास् त्रिनेत्रा नीललोहिताः
verses.transliteration: jarāmaraṇanirmuktān prāha rudrānpitāmahaḥ namo 'stu vo mahādevās trinetrā nīlalohitāḥ
verses.translation: Thus, as Rudra desisted from creating mortal sub- jects he obtained the title 'sthanu'. O Brahmins, Rudra alone is capable of that. He is the supreme and unsullied soul who can assume physical bodies when he wills. The lord bestows happi- ness on all living beings mercifully and without strain. He has, therefore, acquired the title Sankara. He is the all-pervading
verses.hindi: भगवान् शंकरकी आत्मा बिना प्रयत्नके ही कल्याण करनेवाली है। वे योगविद्याके द्वारा वैराग्यमे स्थित रहते हैं। विरक्त विरक्त पुरुषकी मुक्तिको ही कल्याण कहा जाता है स्वल्प विषयोंका त्याग करके प्राणी सांसारिक भयसे मुक्त होकर क्रमसे वैराग्यको प्राप्त होता है और उस वैराग्यसे उस विरागी पुरुषको अन्तमें शिवजीका साक्षात् दर्शन प्राप्त होता है
verses.wordMeaning: Thus, as Rudra desisted from creating mortal sub- jects he obtained the title 'sthanu'. O Brahmins, Rudra alone is capable of that. He is the supreme and unsullied soul who can assume physical bodies when he wills.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus, as Rudra desisted from creating mortal sub- jects he obtained the title 'sthanu'. O Brahmins, Rudra alone is capable of that. He is the supreme and unsullied soul who can assume physical bodies when he wills.…

verses.sanskrit: सर्वज्ञाः सर्वगा दीर्घा ह्रस्वा वामनकाः शुभाः हिरण्यकेशा दृष्टिघ्ना नित्या बुद्धाश् च निर्मलाः
verses.transliteration: sarvajñāḥ sarvagā dīrghā hrasvā vāmanakāḥ śubhāḥ hiraṇyakeśā dṛṣṭighnā nityā buddhāś ca nirmalāḥ
verses.translation: The universe is comprised of fourteen worlds, seven rising above the earth and seven lying below. The seven upper regions are (i) bhCir, (ii) bhsHah, (iii) svar, (iv) mahar, (v) janah (vi) tapas, (vii) satyam and the seven lower are (i) atala,. (ii) vitala, (iii) sutala, (iv) rasfttala, (v) tala, (vi) tal&tala, (vii) ptala.
verses.hindi: 7 संसारनिवर्तक आत्मानात्मविवेकरूप विशिष्ट ज्ञानका विचार किये बिना जो ना जो क्षणिक विषयत्याग हैँ वह जानरहित होनेसे अस्थायी है, अतएव विम्य अप्रशंस्य है। उस सत्, असत् वस्तु-विवेकरूप विचार तथा इस (सांसारिक) विषयोंके त्यागका एक साथ होना परमेष्ठी सदाशिवके कृपाप्रसादसे ही सम्भव है
verses.wordMeaning: The universe is comprised of fourteen worlds, seven rising above the earth and seven lying below. The seven upper regions are (i) bhCir, (ii) bhsHah, (iii) svar, (iv) mahar, (v) janah (vi) tapas, (vii) satyam and the seven lower are (i) atala,. (ii) vitala, (iii) sutala,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The universe is comprised of fourteen worlds, seven rising above the earth and seven lying below. The seven upper regions are (i) bhCir, (ii) bhsHah, (iii) svar, (iv) mahar, (v) janah (vi) tapas, (vii) satyam and the seven lower are (i) atala,. (ii) vitala, (iii) sutala,…

verses.sanskrit: निर्द्वंद्वा वीतरागाश् च विश्वात्मानो भवात्मजाः एवं स्तुत्वा तदा रुद्रान् रुद्रं चाह भवं शिवम् प्रदक्षिणीकृत्य तदा भगवान्कनकाण्डजः
verses.transliteration: nirdvaṃdvā vītarāgāś ca viśvātmāno bhavātmajāḥ evaṃ stutvā tadā rudrān rudraṃ cāha bhavaṃ śivam pradakṣiṇīkṛtya tadā bhagavānkanakāṇḍajaḥ
verses.translation: Virtue, knowledge, detachment and prosperity are the result of his blessing. By taking recourse to him one can be easily liberated. Even if he is engrossed in sin he does not fall into hell.
verses.hindi: इस लोकमें धर्म, ज्ञान, वैराग्य तथा ऐश्वर्य शिवजीकी कृपासे प्राप्त होते हैं। वे कल्याण करनेके कारण शंकर हैं, पिनाक नामक धनुष धारण करनेके कारण पिनाकी हैं तथा उनका कण्ठ नीला एवं देह लाल होनेके कारण नीललोहित हैं
verses.wordMeaning: Virtue, knowledge, detachment and prosperity are the result of his blessing. By taking recourse to him one can be easily liberated. Even if he is engrossed in sin he does not fall into hell.
verses.commentary: Sense: Virtue, knowledge, detachment and prosperity are the result of his blessing. By taking recourse to him one can be easily liberated. Even if he is engrossed in sin he does not fall into hell.

verses.sanskrit: नमो ऽस्तु ते महादेव प्रजा नार्हसि शंकर मृत्युहीना विभो स्रष्टुं मृत्युयुक्ताः सृज प्रभो
verses.transliteration: namo 'stu te mahādeva prajā nārhasi śaṃkara mṛtyuhīnā vibho sraṣṭuṃ mṛtyuyuktāḥ sṛja prabho
verses.translation: Hence, by resorting to him, people can attain eternal release from worldly existence.
verses.hindi: जो प्राणी शंकरजीका आश्रय ग्रहण करते हैं अर्थात् उनके शरणागत होते हैं, वे सभी मुक्ति प्राप्त करते हैं। भगवान् शंकरके आश्रित महान् पापी भी अत्यन्त भयावह नरकको नहीं प्राप्त होते हैं। वे शिवजीके शाश्वत पदको पा जाते हैं। इस विषयमें कोई भी संदेह नहीं है॥ २६१, ॥
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, by resorting to him, people can attain eternal release from worldly existence.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, by resorting to him, people can attain eternal release from worldly existence.

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तमाह भगवान् न हि मे तादृशी स्थितिः स त्वं सृज यथाकामं मृत्युयुक्ताः प्रजाः प्रभो
verses.transliteration: tatastamāha bhagavān na hi me tādṛśī sthitiḥ sa tvaṃ sṛja yathākāmaṃ mṛtyuyuktāḥ prajāḥ prabho
verses.translation: Hence, by resorting to him, people can attain eternal release from worldly existence.
verses.hindi: ऋषिगण बोले--अहंकार (घोर)-से लेकर मायापर्यन्त विभिन्न प्रकारके कुल अट्टाईस करोड नरक हैं; उनमें जाकर पापी प्राणी अपने द्वारा किये गये कर्मोके फल भोगते हैं। ये वही प्राणी होते हैं, जो शिव, रुद्र, शंकर, नीललोहित, सभी प्राणियोंके आश्रय,
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, by resorting to him, people can attain eternal release from worldly existence.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, by resorting to him, people can attain eternal release from worldly existence.

verses.sanskrit: लब्ध्वा ससर्ज सकलं शंकराच्चतुराननः जरामरणसंयुक्तं जगदेतच्चराचरम्
verses.transliteration: labdhvā sasarja sakalaṃ śaṃkarāccaturānanaḥ jarāmaraṇasaṃyuktaṃ jagadetaccarācaram
verses.translation: Hence, by resorting to him, people can attain eternal release from worldly existence.
verses.hindi: अध्याय ७1 माहेश्वरयोगका प्रतिपादन “माहेश्‍्वरयोगावतारोंका वर्णन तमसा कालरुद्राख्यं रजसा कनकाण्डजम्। सत्त्वेन सर्वगं विष्णुं निर्गुणत्वे महेश्वरम्
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, by resorting to him, people can attain eternal release from worldly existence.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, by resorting to him, people can attain eternal release from worldly existence.

verses.sanskrit: शंकरो ऽपि तदा रुद्रैर् निवृत्तात्मा ह्यधिष्ठितः स्थाणुत्वं तस्य वै विप्राः शंकरस्य महात्मनः
verses.transliteration: śaṃkaro 'pi tadā rudrair nivṛttātmā hyadhiṣṭhitaḥ sthāṇutvaṃ tasya vai viprāḥ śaṃkarasya mahātmanaḥ
verses.translation: Hence, by resorting to him, people can attain eternal release from worldly existence.
verses.hindi: पुरुष्टुत, तमोगुणको प्रधानता होनेपर कालरुद्ररूप, रजो- गुणकी प्रधानता होनेपर ब्रह्मारूप, सत्त्वगुणको प्रधानता होनेपर सर्वव्यापी विष्णुरूप तथा गुणरहित होनेपर महेश्वर-रूप भगवान् महादेवजीका आश्रय ग्रहण नहीं किये होते हैं॥ २७--३० ॥
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, by resorting to him, people can attain eternal release from worldly existence.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, by resorting to him, people can attain eternal release from worldly existence.

verses.sanskrit: निष्कलस्यात्मनः शम्भोः स्वेच्छाधृतशरीरिणः शं रुद्रः सर्वभूतानां करोति घृणया यतः
verses.transliteration: niṣkalasyātmanaḥ śambhoḥ svecchādhṛtaśarīriṇaḥ śaṃ rudraḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ karoti ghṛṇayā yataḥ
verses.translation: Hence, by resorting to him, people can attain eternal release from worldly existence.
verses.hindi: है महामते! अब हम लोगोंको यह सुननेकी केन गच्छन्ति नरकं नराः केन महामते। उत्कट अभिलाषा है कि किन-किन कर्मोके करने कर्मणाकर्मणा वापि श्रोतुं कौतूहलं हि नः॥ ३९  अथवा न करनेसे मनुष्य नरकको प्राप्त होते हैं माहेश्वरयोगका प्रतिपादन, अट्टाईस व्यासों तथा चौदह मनुओंकी नामावली, विभिन्न युगोंमें हुए माहेशवरयोगावतारोंका वर्णन सूत उवाच सूतजी बोले--हे मुनीश्वरो! अब मैं संक्षेपमें रहस्यं वः प्रवक्ष्यामि भवस्यामिततेजसः । तेजवाले, सर्वतत्त्वदर्शी भगवान् शंकरके रहस्य
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, by resorting to him, people can attain eternal release from worldly existence.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, by resorting to him, people can attain eternal release from worldly existence.

verses.sanskrit: शंकरश्चाप्रयत्नेन तदात्मा योगविद्यया वैराग्यस्थं विरक्तस्य विमुक्तिर्यच्छमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: śaṃkaraścāprayatnena tadātmā yogavidyayā vairāgyasthaṃ viraktasya vimuktiryacchamucyate
verses.translation: Hence, by resorting to him, people can attain eternal release from worldly existence.
verses.hindi: प्रभावं शङ्करस्याद्यं सङ्क्षेपात् सर्वदर्शिनः ॥ १  तथा श्रेष्ठ प्रभावका वर्णन करूँगा प्राणायाम आदि योगके आठ साधनोंसे युक्त तथा केर ना साधनोंसे युक्त तथा करुणा आदि गुणोंसे सम्पन्न बड़े-बड़े योगिजन नानाविध कर्म करके भी अपने कर्मानुसार नरक तथा स्वर्ग जाते है स्वर्गमें जाते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, by resorting to him, people can attain eternal release from worldly existence.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, by resorting to him, people can attain eternal release from worldly existence.

verses.sanskrit: अणोस्तु विषयत्यागः संसारभयतः क्रमात् वैराग्याज्जायते पुंसो विरागो दर्शनान्तरे
verses.transliteration: aṇostu viṣayatyāgaḥ saṃsārabhayataḥ kramāt vairāgyājjāyate puṃso virāgo darśanāntare
verses.translation: Hence, by resorting to him, people can attain eternal release from worldly existence.
verses.hindi: भगवान् शंकरकी अनुकम्पासे ज्ञान उत्पन्न होता है, ज्ञानसे योगमें प्रवृत्ति होती है और योगसे मुक्तिको प्राप्ति होती है। इस प्रकार उन्हीं शिवजीकी कृपासे सब कुछ सिद्ध होता है ऋषिगण बोले--हे योगवेत्ताओंमें श्रेष्ठ सूतजी ! शिवजीकी कृपासे ही यदि विशिष्ट ज्ञान तथा योग होता है, तो उस ज्ञानस्वरूप दिव्य माहेश्वरयोगका आप वर्णन कीजिये
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, by resorting to him, people can attain eternal release from worldly existence.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, by resorting to him, people can attain eternal release from worldly existence.

verses.sanskrit: विमुख्यो विगुणत्यागो विज्ञानस्याविचारतः तस्य चास्य च संधानं प्रसादात्परमेष्ठिनः
verses.transliteration: vimukhyo viguṇatyāgo vijñānasyāvicārataḥ tasya cāsya ca saṃdhānaṃ prasādātparameṣṭhinaḥ
verses.translation: Hence, by resorting to him, people can attain eternal release from worldly existence.
verses.hindi: विभुतासम्पन्न तथा चिन्तारहित भगवान् शिव योगमार्गके द्वारा किस प्रकार तथा किस कालमें प्राणियोंक ऊपर अनुग्रह करते हैं ? सूतजी बोले-- प्राचीनकालमें देवताओं, ऋषियों तथा पितरोंकी सन्निधिमें शिलादपुत्र नन्दीके द्वारा ब्रह्मा- पुत्र सनत्कुमारसे जिस योगके विषयमें कहा गया था, उसे आपलोग सुनें
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, by resorting to him, people can attain eternal release from worldly existence.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, by resorting to him, people can attain eternal release from worldly existence.

verses.sanskrit: धर्मो ज्ञानं च वैराग्यम् ऐश्वर्यं शंकरादिह स एव शंकरः साक्षात् पिनाकी नीललोहितः
verses.transliteration: dharmo jñānaṃ ca vairāgyam aiśvaryaṃ śaṃkarādiha sa eva śaṃkaraḥ sākṣāt pinākī nīlalohitaḥ
verses.translation: Hence, by resorting to him, people can attain eternal release from worldly existence.
verses.hindi: करुणादिगुणोपेताः कृत्वापि विविधानि ते। कर्माणि नरकं स्वर्ग गच्छन्त्येव स्वकर्मणा कथं करोति भगवान् चिन्तया रहितः शिवः। प्रसादं योगमार्गेण कस्मिन् काले नृणां विभुः
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, by resorting to him, people can attain eternal release from worldly existence.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, by resorting to him, people can attain eternal release from worldly existence.

verses.sanskrit: ये शंकराश्रिताः सर्वे मुच्यन्ते ते न संशयः न गच्छन्त्येव नरकं पापिष्ठा अपि दारुणम्
verses.transliteration: ye śaṃkarāśritāḥ sarve mucyante te na saṃśayaḥ na gacchantyeva narakaṃ pāpiṣṭhā api dāruṇam
verses.translation: Hence, by resorting to him, people can attain eternal release from worldly existence.
verses.hindi: देवानाञ्च ऋषीणाञ्च पितृणां सन्निधौ पुरा। शैलादिना तु कथितं शृण्वन्तु ब्रह्मसूनवे फफफ फफक फफफफ फफफाफीफफ फफ फफफ फक फफ फफफ मज्जमे तामाका माका” यः
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, by resorting to him, people can attain eternal release from worldly existence.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, by resorting to him, people can attain eternal release from worldly existence.

verses.sanskrit: आश्रिताः शंकरं तस्मात् प्राप्नुवन्ति च शाश्वतम् मायान्ताश्चैव घोराद्या ह्य् अष्टविंशतिरेव च
verses.transliteration: āśritāḥ śaṃkaraṃ tasmāt prāpnuvanti ca śāśvatam māyāntāścaiva ghorādyā hy aṣṭaviṃśatireva ca
verses.translation: Hence, by resorting to him, people can attain eternal release from worldly existence.
verses.hindi: फक्क कक कफ कक फफ काक फ फक काक फक काका क की कम कम मजा आ हे सुव्रत ऋषियो ! द्वापरके अन्तमें व्यासके अवतार RE ल ड र लि  । योगाचार्योके अवतार तथा कलियुगमें शिवजीके अवतार योचा या तताराणा तथा 5 : प्रभुके पवित्र अन्तःकरणवाले चार शिष्य और बहुतसे प्रशिष्य
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, by resorting to him, people can attain eternal release from worldly existence.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, by resorting to him, people can attain eternal release from worldly existence.

verses.sanskrit: कोटयो नरकाणां तु पच्यन्ते तासु पापिनः अनाश्रिताः शिवं रुद्रं शंकरं नीललोहितम्
verses.transliteration: koṭayo narakāṇāṃ tu pacyante tāsu pāpinaḥ anāśritāḥ śivaṃ rudraṃ śaṃkaraṃ nīlalohitam
verses.translation: Hence, by resorting to him, people can attain eternal release from worldly existence.
verses.hindi: क्रमागतं ज्ञानं मुखादेव नृणां विभोः। हुए तयात उ इस प्रकार वह ज्ञान क्रमशः शिष्य-परम्पराक्रे वैश्यान्तं ब्राह्मणाद्यं हि घृणया चानुरूपतः॥ १० माध्यमसे ब्राह्मण, क्षत्रिय तथा वैश्योंको भगवान् शिवकी ह कृपासे उनके मुखसे प्राप्त हुआ
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, by resorting to him, people can attain eternal release from worldly existence.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, by resorting to him, people can attain eternal release from worldly existence.

verses.sanskrit: आश्रयं सर्वभूतानाम् अव्ययं जगतां पतिम् पुरुषं परमात्मानं पुरुहूतं पुरुष्टुतम्
verses.transliteration: āśrayaṃ sarvabhūtānām avyayaṃ jagatāṃ patim puruṣaṃ paramātmānaṃ puruhūtaṃ puruṣṭutam
verses.translation: Hence, by resorting to him, people can attain eternal release from worldly existence.
verses.hindi: द्वापरे द्वापरे व्यासाः के वै कुत्रान्तरेषु वै। क अंगणे 8 द्वापरमे, किन-किन कल्पेषु कस्मिन् कल्पे नो वक्तुमहसि चात्र तान्॥ ११  ल्मे तथा किन मन्वन्तरोंमें कौन-कौन व्यास हुए अ हैं? आप उनके विषयमें हमलोगोंको बताइये व्यासांश्च साम्प्रतं रुद्रांस्तथा सर्वान्तरेषु वै॥ १२  तथा वैवस्वत मन्वन्तरमें एवं अन्य मन्वन्तरोंमें भी जो वेदानाञ्च पुराणानां तथा ज्ञानप्रदर्शकान् । व्यास तथा रुद्र हुए त्त उन सभी ज्ञानप्रदर्शक महात्माओके यथाक्रमं प्रवक्ष्यामि सर्वावर्तेषु साम्प्रतम्॥ १३  विषयमें वेदों तथा पुराणोंके अनुसार मैं यथाक्रम कहता
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, by resorting to him, people can attain eternal release from worldly existence.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, by resorting to him, people can attain eternal release from worldly existence.

verses.sanskrit: तमसा कालरुद्राख्यं रजसा कनकाण्डजम् सत्त्वेन सर्वगं विष्णुं निर्गुणत्वे महेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: tamasā kālarudrākhyaṃ rajasā kanakāṇḍajam sattvena sarvagaṃ viṣṇuṃ nirguṇatve maheśvaram
verses.translation: Hence, by resorting to him, people can attain eternal release from worldly existence.
verses.hindi: मृत्युः शतक्रतुर्धीमान् वसिष्ठो मुनिपुङ्गवः॥ १४ है द्विजो! क्रतु, सत्य, भार्गव, अंगिरा, सविता, सारस्वतस्त्रिधामा च त्रिवृतो मुनिपुङ्गवः। मृत्यु, बुद्धिसम्पन्न शतक्रतु, मुनिश्रेष्ठ वसिष्ठ, सारस्वत, शततेजाः स्वयं धर्मो नारायण इति श्रुतः॥ १५  त्रिधामा, मुनिवर त्रिवृत, शततेजा, साक्षात् धर्मस्वरूप तरक्षुश्चारुणिरधीमांस्तथा देवः कृतञ्जयः। नारायण, तरक्षु, बुद्धियुक्त अरुणि, देव, कृतंजय, ऋतंजय, ऋतञ्जयो भरद्वाजो गौतमः कविसत्तमः ॥ १६  भरद्वाज, कविश्रेष्ठ गौतम, साक्षात् मुनिस्वरूप वाचः श्रवा, वाचःश्रवाः मुनिः साक्षात्तथा शुष्मायणिः शुचिः।  परम पावन शुष्मायणि, मुनि तृणबिन्दु, रक्ष, शक्ति, तृणबिन्दर्मुनी रुक्षः शक्तिः शाक्तेय उत्तरः ॥ १७  शक्तिपुत्र पराशर, जातूकर्ण्य तथा साक्षात् विष्णुस्वरूप जातूकण्यों हरिः साक्षात् कृष्णद्वैपायनो मुनिः। मुनि कृष्णद्वैपायन--ये अट्ठाईस व्यास हुए। इसी प्रकार
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, by resorting to him, people can attain eternal release from worldly existence.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, by resorting to him, people can attain eternal release from worldly existence.

verses.sanskrit: केन गच्छन्ति नरकं नराः केन महामते कर्मणाकर्मणा वापि श्रोतुं कौतूहलं हि नः
verses.transliteration: kena gacchanti narakaṃ narāḥ kena mahāmate karmaṇākarmaṇā vāpi śrotuṃ kautūhalaṃ hi naḥ
verses.translation: Hence, by resorting to him, people can attain eternal release from worldly existence.
verses.hindi: व्यासास्त्वेते शृण्वन्तु कलौ योगेश्वरान् क्रमात्॥ १८  लियुगमें क्रमसे जो योगेश्वर हुए, कल्योंमें तथा सभी असंख्याता हि कल्पेषु विभोः सर्वान्तरेषु च। मन्वन्तरोमें महेश्वरके जो असंख्य अवतार हुए, कलिमें कलौ रुद्रावताराणां व्यासानां किल गौरवात् ॥ १९ विशेष महिमाके कारण रुद्रों तथा व्यासोंके जो अवतार हुए एवं श्वेतवाराह कल्पके वैवस्वत मन्वन्तरमें तथा
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, by resorting to him, people can attain eternal release from worldly existence.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, by resorting to him, people can attain eternal release from worldly existence.

verses.sanskrit: रहस्यं वः प्रवक्ष्यामि भवस्यामिततेजसः प्रभावं शंकरस्याद्यं संक्षेपात्सर्वदर्शिनः
verses.transliteration: rahasyaṃ vaḥ pravakṣyāmi bhavasyāmitatejasaḥ prabhāvaṃ śaṃkarasyādyaṃ saṃkṣepātsarvadarśinaḥ
verses.translation: I shall recount to you, at the outset, the esoteric secret, in brief, of the all-knowing Siva of unmeasured splendo. The yogins who are conversant with the tenera, who have adopted great detachment, who are constantly associated
verses.hindi: अवतारान् प्रवक्ष्यामि तथा सर्वान्तरेषु वै॥ २० अन्य मन्वन्तरोंमें जो अवतार हुए--उन सभीके विषयमें ऋषय ऊचुः में आप लोगोंको बताऊँगा; आप सब सुनें ॥ १४--२० ॥ ऋषिगण बोले--हे सूतजी! सर्वप्रथम आप वाराह कल्प तथा अन्य कल्पोंके मन्वन्तरोंका वर्णन कोजिये । तत्पश्चात् वैवस्वत मन्वन्तरमें हो चुके सिद्धोंके विषयमें बताइये
verses.wordMeaning: I shall recount to you, at the outset, the esoteric secret, in brief, of the all-knowing Siva of unmeasured splendo. The yogins who are conversant with the tenera, who have adopted great detachment, who are constantly associated
verses.commentary: Sense: I shall recount to you, at the outset, the esoteric secret, in brief, of the all-knowing Siva of unmeasured splendo. The yogins who are conversant with the tenera, who have adopted great detachment, who are constantly associated

verses.sanskrit: योगिनः सर्वतत्त्वज्ञाः परं वैराग्यमास्थिताः
verses.transliteration: yoginaḥ sarvatattvajñāḥ paraṃ vairāgyamāsthitāḥ
verses.translation: By virtue of his grace, knowledge arises and yoga func- tions through knowledge. By dint of yoga, liberation is effected, and everything is achieved through his grace. O best ofyogins, if perfect knowledge comes through grace, you shall tell us about the form and feature as well as the divine yoga of lord iSiva (through which that grace is attained).
verses.hindi: मनु हैं, उनके बाद स्वारोचिष मनु हुए। इसी प्रकार अध्याय ७ माहेश्वरयोगका प्रतिपादन”“माहेश्वरयोगावतारोंका वर्णन ३७
verses.wordMeaning: By virtue of his grace, knowledge arises and yoga func- tions through knowledge. By dint of yoga, liberation is effected, and everything is achieved through his grace. O best ofyogins, if perfect knowledge comes through grace,…
verses.commentary: Sense: By virtue of his grace, knowledge arises and yoga func- tions through knowledge. By dint of yoga, liberation is effected, and everything is achieved through his grace. O best ofyogins, if perfect knowledge comes through grace,…

verses.translation: O sages of good holy rites, listen to the incarnations of Vyasas, at the end of Dvapara and the incarnations of lord Siva as Yogacaryas in the kali age. In different areas, the four disciples of the lord, fully endowed with mental control spread the doctrines of Siva. There grew up many disciples of disciples and the lord was pleased at this.

verses.translation: The perfect knowledge of the lord had been tradition- ally and gradually transmitted orally to men of the first three castes from brahmins to vaisyas in the manner befitting them. It was done so out of mercy. It behoves you to tell us who those Vyasas were who
verses.hindi: धर्म, सावर्णिक, पिशंग, अपिशंगाभ, शबल तथा वर्णक— ये अकारसे लेकर औकारपर्यन्त चौदह स्वरोंके रूपवाले चौदह मनु कहे गये हैं। है उत्तम ब्राह्मणो! श्वेत, पाण्डु, रक्त, ताम्र, पीत, कापिल, कृष्ण, श्याम, धूम्र, सुसू, अपिशंग, पिशंग, त्रिवर्ण शबल तथा कालन्धुर—ये चौदह वर्ण (रंग) उन पवित्र मनुओंके कहे गये हैं । इस प्रकार वे चौदह मनु स्वायम्भुव आदि नामोंसे, अकार आदि वर्णोसे तथा श्वेत आदि वर्णो (रंगों)-से अभिहित

Now listen to the yogic incarnations of the lord and their line of disciples in due order, in all the kalpas and manvantaras. verses.translation: The portion covered by a vitasti beneath the throat and above the umbilicus is the excellent zone of yoga; so also the curling lock of hair below the umbilicus and middle portion between the eye-brows. The knowledge of all topics that arises in the soul is called yoga.* The concentration of the mind is possible only through his grace.

verses.sanskrit: वेदानां च पुराणानां तथा ज्ञानप्रदर्शकान् यथाक्रमं प्रवक्ष्यामि सर्वावर्तेषु साम्प्रतम्
verses.transliteration: vedānāṃ ca purāṇānāṃ tathā jñānapradarśakān yathākramaṃ pravakṣyāmi sarvāvarteṣu sāmpratam
verses.translation: One should abstain from sensual activities and burn sins by means of perfect knowledge. The achievement of yoga shall be possible only to one who has restrained the activities of his soise-organs. O excellent brahmins, yoga is restraining the function- ing of the mind.*® Eight means have been mentioned for the achievement of yoga.

verses.sanskrit: तरक्षुश्चारुणिर्धीमांस् तथा देवः कृतंजयः ऋतंजयो भरद्वाजो गौतमः कविसत्तमः
verses.transliteration: tarakṣuścāruṇirdhīmāṃs tathā devaḥ kṛtaṃjayaḥ ṛtaṃjayo bharadvājo gautamaḥ kavisattamaḥ
verses.translation: Considering all living beings as one's own self and working for the welfare of all living beings is called non-viol- ence. It helps in achieving the knowledge of self. Retelling precisely what has been seen, heard, inferred or experienced is called truthfulness (satya). It is devoid of in- jury or infliction of pain on others.
verses.hindi: सुधामा काश्यपश्चैव वासिष्ठो विरजास्तथा। अत्रिर्देवसदश्चैव श्रवणोऽथ श्रविष्ठकः। उतथ्यो वामदेवश्च महायोगो महाबल:
verses.wordMeaning: Considering all living beings as one's own self and working for the welfare of all living beings is called non-viol- ence. It helps in achieving the knowledge of self. Retelling precisely what has been seen, heard, inferred or experienced is called truthfulness (satya).…

verses.sanskrit: वाचश्रवा मुनिः साक्षात् तथा शुष्मायणिः शुचिः तृणबिन्दुर् मुनी रूक्षः शक्तिः शाक्तेय उत्तरः
verses.transliteration: vācaśravā muniḥ sākṣāt tathā śuṣmāyaṇiḥ śuciḥ tṛṇabindur munī rūkṣaḥ śaktiḥ śākteya uttaraḥ
verses.translation: The Vedas declare. **One should not utter what is obscene in the presence of the brahmins". *'Even after knowing the defects of others one should not proclaim them to others" — this is another passage in the ruti. Not stealing the possessions of others purposefully, even in emergency, mentally, physically and verbally is non-stealing in brief.

verses.sanskrit: जातूकर्ण्यो हरिः साक्षात् कृष्णद्वैपायनो मुनिः व्यासास्त्वेते च शृण्वन्तु कलौ योगेश्वरान् क्रमात्
verses.transliteration: jātūkarṇyo hariḥ sākṣāt kṛṣṇadvaipāyano muniḥ vyāsāstvete ca śṛṇvantu kalau yogeśvarān kramāt
verses.translation: Not indulging is sexual intercouse,® mentally, verbally or physically is the vow of celibacy, with reference to the asce- tics and the religious students. This holds good in regard to the anchorites, forest- dwellers and widowers. I shall now tell yon about the vow of celibacy of the householders who live with their wives.
verses.hindi: छगलः कुण्डकर्णश्च कुम्भश्चैव प्रवाहकः . उलूको विद्युतश्चैव मण्डूको ह्याश्वलायनः । अक्षपादः कुमारश्च उलूको वत्स एंव च
verses.wordMeaning: Not indulging is sexual intercouse,® mentally, verbally or physically is the vow of celibacy, with reference to the asce- tics and the religious students. This holds good in regard to the anchorites, forest- dwellers and widowers.…

verses.sanskrit: असंख्याता हि कल्पेषु विभोः सर्वान्तरेषु च कलौ रुद्रावताराणां व्यासानां किल गौरवात्
verses.transliteration: asaṃkhyātā hi kalpeṣu vibhoḥ sarvāntareṣu ca kalau rudrāvatārāṇāṃ vyāsānāṃ kila gauravāt
verses.translation: In their case, as prescribed, indulgence in sexual inter- course with their own wives and abstention from it with other women mentally, physically and verbally should be understood as brahmacarya. The householder shall take ablution after indulging in sexual intercourse with his own wife. If he is in yogic commu- nion with his self be is undoubtedly a celibate.
verses.hindi: विमला ब्रह्मभूयिष्ठा ज्ञानयोगयरायणाः। देवादयः पिशाचान्ता: पशवः परिकीर्तिताः ।
verses.wordMeaning: In their case, as prescribed, indulgence in sexual inter- course with their own wives and abstention from it with other women mentally, physically and verbally should be understood as brahmacarya.…
verses.commentary: Sense: In their case, as prescribed, indulgence in sexual inter- course with their own wives and abstention from it with other women mentally, physically and verbally should be understood as brahmacarya.…

verses.translation: In the case of non-violence (ahiihsa) too, the same rule is applicable. Violence sanctioned by §ruti, in regard to the brahmanas, preceptors and sacrifice comes under ahiihsa. Women are always to be avoided. One should stay

verses.sanskrit: मन्वन्तराणि वाराहे वक्तुमर्हसि साम्प्रतम् तथैव चोर्ध्वकल्पेषु सिद्धान्वैवस्वतान्तरे
verses.transliteration: manvantarāṇi vārāhe vaktumarhasi sāmpratam tathaiva cordhvakalpeṣu siddhānvaivasvatāntare
verses.translation: For eight kinds of maithuna, cf. ST. He should have the same attitude in the sexual inter- course with his own wife, as when discharging the faeces and urine on the ground. There should be no attitude other than this.
verses.hindi: शंखपा, ट्वैरज, मेघ, सारस्वत, मुनिवर सुवाहन, मेघवाह, कपिल, आसुरि, मुनि पंचशिख तथा महायोगी वाल्कल-ये सभी धर्मात्मा तथा महान् ओजस्वी हुए । इसी क्रममें पुनः पराशर, गर्ग, भार्गव, अंगिरा, बलबु निरामित्र, केतुथृंग, तपोधन, लम्बोदर, लम्ब, लग्बाक्ष लम्बकेशक, सर्वज्ञ, समबुद्धि, साध्य, सर्व, सुधामा, काश्यप वासिष्ठ, विरजा, अत्रि, देवसद, श्रवण, श्रविष्ठक, कुणि,
verses.wordMeaning: For eight kinds of maithuna, cf. ST. He should have the same attitude in the sexual inter- course with his own wife, as when discharging the faeces and urine on the ground. There should be no attitude other than this.
verses.commentary: Sense: For eight kinds of maithuna, cf. ST. He should have the same attitude in the sexual inter- course with his own wife, as when discharging the faeces and urine on the ground. There should be no attitude other than this.

verses.sanskrit: मनुः स्वायम्भुवस्त्वाद्यस् ततः स्वारोचिषो द्विजाः उत्तमस्तामसश्चैव रैवताश्चाक्षुषस् तथा
verses.transliteration: manuḥ svāyambhuvastvādyas tataḥ svārociṣo dvijāḥ uttamastāmasaścaiva raivatāścākṣuṣas tathā
verses.translation: Woman is like a burning coal; man is like a vessel of ghee. He should always avoid contact with women therefore. If we ponder over this, we shall know that there is no satiety in sexual pleasures. Hence, one should practise detached attitude mentally, physically and verbally.
verses.hindi: बृहस्पति, उतथ्य, वामदेव, महायोग, महाबल, वाच: श्रवा, दाल्भ्यायणि, केतुमान्, गोपन, भल्लावी, मधुपिंग, श्वेतकेतु, तपोनिधि, उशिक, बृहदश्व, देवल, कवि, शालिहोत्र, अग्निवेश, युवनाश्व, शरद्वसु, छगल, कुण्डकर्ण, कुम्भ,

verses.sanskrit: वैवस्वतश् च सावर्णिर् धर्मः सावर्णिकः पुनः पिशङ्गश्चापिशङ्गाभः शबलो वर्णकस् तथा
verses.transliteration: vaivasvataś ca sāvarṇir dharmaḥ sāvarṇikaḥ punaḥ piśaṅgaścāpiśaṅgābhaḥ śabalo varṇakas tathā
verses.translation: Lust is never suppressed by indulging in sexual plea- sures. Just as fire burns vigorously if ghee is poured in, so also lust is increased by means of indulgence.** Hence the yogin should always practise renunciation for achieving immortality, since he who is not detached is born and re-born in different wombs.
verses.hindi: शिष्य भी हुए। सभी युगावर्तोमें योगाचार्योके ये महात्मा शिष्य कहे गये हैं। ये सब विमल आत्मावाले, सिद्ध, ब्रह्मनिष्ठ, ज्ञान तथा योगमें निरत रहनेवाले भस्म-विभूषित शरीरवाले तथा शैवी दीक्षासे सम्पन्न हें ॥ ३७--५२॥ इनके भी सैकड़ों-हजारों शिष्य तथा प्रशिष्य पाशुपत योग प्राप्तकर शिवलोकके अधिकारी हुए
verses.wordMeaning: Lust is never suppressed by indulging in sexual plea- sures. Just as fire burns vigorously if ghee is poured in, so also lust is increased by means of indulgence.** Hence the yogin should always practise renunciation for achieving immortality,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Lust is never suppressed by indulging in sexual plea- sures. Just as fire burns vigorously if ghee is poured in, so also lust is increased by means of indulgence.** Hence the yogin should always practise renunciation for achieving immortality,…

verses.sanskrit: औकारान्ता अकाराद्या मनवः परिकीर्तिताः श्वेतः पाण्डुस् तथा रक्तस् ताम्रः पीतश्च कापिलः
verses.transliteration: aukārāntā akārādyā manavaḥ parikīrtitāḥ śvetaḥ pāṇḍus tathā raktas tāmraḥ pītaśca kāpilaḥ
verses.translation: Hence one should practise detachment, mentally, ver- bally and physically. Abstention from sexual intercourse, except during the prescribed period, after menstruation is stated as celibacy in the case of householders. Thus the restraints (yamas) arc succinctly men- tioned. I shall now tdl you the observances (niyamas). They are ten in number: (1) cleanliness (auca), (2) sacrifice (ijya), (3) penance (upas), (4) chariuble gift (dana), (5) study of the Vedas (svadhyaya) (6) restraint on the organs of gener- ation (upasthanigraha), (7) holy rites (vrau), (8) fast (upavasa), silence (mauna), amd holy bath (snana). Accor- ding to some, observances (niyamai) mean (1) absence of craving (anlha), (2) cleanliness (sauca), (3) satisfaction (tu$ti), (4) penance (tapas), (5) muttering of Siva's mantra
verses.hindi: गये हैं, उनका पति अर्थात् स्वामी होनेके कारण सर्वेश्वर शिवको पशुपति कहा जाता है है द्विजो! सभीको परम ऐश्वर्यकी प्राप्ति करानेहेतु छ पशुपति रुद्रके द्वारा प्रवर्तित योग “पाशुपतयोग' के नामसे जाना जाता है
verses.wordMeaning: Hence one should practise detachment, mentally, ver- bally and physically. Abstention from sexual intercourse, except during the prescribed period, after menstruation is stated as celibacy in the case of householders. Thus the restraints (yamas) arc succinctly men- tioned.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence one should practise detachment, mentally, ver- bally and physically. Abstention from sexual intercourse, except during the prescribed period, after menstruation is stated as celibacy in the case of householders. Thus the restraints (yamas) arc succinctly men- tioned.…

verses.sanskrit: कृष्णः श्यामस् तथा धूम्रः सुधूम्रश् च द्विजोत्तमाः अपिशङ्गः पिशङ्गश् च त्रिवर्णः शबलस् तथा

verses.translation: Na karmai aa pnyayX dliaaeoa, 7!4. 10.3; Mahin. tl, 10.5 He who practises yoga never suffers calamity. When the pra is properly trained it turns the defects of the mind, speech or body, preserving the body of the practiser. Thus, if the devotee perfects himself by taking recourse to the pranayama his defects perish; the very breath is conquered by him, and the divine quiescence etc. are achieved.

verses.sanskrit: कालंधुरस्तु कथिता वर्णतो मनवः शुभाः नामतो वर्णतश्चैव वर्णतः पुनरेव च
verses.transliteration: kālaṃdhurastu kathitā varṇato manavaḥ śubhāḥ nāmato varṇataścaiva varṇataḥ punareva ca
verses.translation: The attributes of the pranayama are four, viz, santi, prasanti, dipti and prasada. They are explained in order: O brahmins, the first of these four is santi. It means the suppres- sion of sins congenital or adventitious, Prasanti is a perfect restraint in speech." All round, all time brilliance, O brahmins, is called dipti. Prasada is the clarity of the mind which is of four types. It is the clarity of the sense-organs, of the intellect and the organic winds. The organic winds— prana, apana, samana, udana and vyana have their functional names: Naga, Kurma, Krkala, Devadatta and Dhanahjaya respectively. The clarity of these winds is called prasada. According to ST. sagarbha is a variety of Kumbhaka that includes par (mhalii) and recaka (exhaling) varieties of pr&fiy&ma.

verses.sanskrit: स्वरात्मानः समाख्याताश् चान्तरेशाः समासतः वैवस्वत ऋकारस्तु मनुः कृष्णः सुरेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: svarātmānaḥ samākhyātāś cāntareśāḥ samāsataḥ vaivasvata ṛkārastu manuḥ kṛṣṇaḥ sureśvaraḥ
verses.translation: The wind which traverses through the body is called prsLigA; that which brings down food and drink is called apana; that which enables the limbs of the body to bend is called vyana which incites the ailments too; that which excites and afSicts the vulnerable points (in the body) is called udana. That which normalizes the functions of the organs is called samana. Thus the first set of five winds has been explained to you. The wind Niga functions in the act of belching; theKfirma in the opening of eyes; Krkala in sneezing; Devadatta in yawning and Dhanaft- jaya in making a loud report. It is present even in the dead body. By restraining these winds, one can attain prasada. O brahmins, in the fourfold set of attributes, prasada figures as the fourth. O brahmins, the intellect has these synonyms — viz., visvara, mahat, prajfta, manas, brahma, citi, smrti, khyati, samvit, lvara and mati. It is through pranayama that the clarity of intellect is achieved.
verses.hindi: सूतजी बोले- है द्विजो! अब मैं भगवान् शंकरके जगतूके हितार्थ कल्पित किये गये योगस्थानोंका संक्षेपमें वर्णन करूँगा गलेसे नीचे तथा नाभिसे ऊपरका वितस्ति

verses.transliteration: saptamastasya vakṣyāmi yugāvarteṣu yoginaḥ samatīteṣu kalpeṣu tathā cānāgateṣu vai
verses.translation: O excellent sages, Visvara is so called because it com- promises between two conflicting opposites. Since it is the first and the greatest of all the tattvas arising out of Prakrti it is called mahat. It is called prajfia because it is the repository of all means of knowledge. It is manas because it thinks. It is Brahma because it is big and swells up. O most excellent among the knowers of Brahman, it is called citi because it gathers together all activities for the sake of enjoyment. It is called smrti because it enables one to remember things. Since it obtains everything it is called Sarhvit. Because it is known everywhere by means of knowledge it is called khyati.*® It is called Ivara because it is the overlord of all elements and comprehends everything. O sages, most excellent among the intelligent, it is called Mati because it is the instrument of thought subjectively and objectively. It is called Buddhi because it enlightens things and is itself the instrument of enlightenment. khy&ti--a category of intellect (M 17). It if so caUed be- cause it is the source of the perceived creation or the cosmos which becomes visible or the object of pcrcq>tion by the mind and the senses.

verses.sanskrit: वाराहः साम्प्रतं ज्ञेयः सप्तमान्तरतः क्रमात् योगावतारांश् च विभोः शिष्याणां संततिस् तथा
verses.transliteration: vārāhaḥ sāmprataṃ jñeyaḥ saptamāntarataḥ kramāt yogāvatārāṃś ca vibhoḥ śiṣyāṇāṃ saṃtatis tathā
verses.translation: By means of pratyahara (withdrawal of sense-organs) and Dharaas (retentions) one shall destroy sins. By medi- tating on the mundane objects as if they were poisonous one destroys all ungodly qualities. O excellent ascetics, one should increase the power of intellect by means of samadhi. The eight ancillaries of yoga should be practised only after securing the proper place for yogic practice.
verses.hindi: हे श्रेष्ठ द्विजो! उस अनुग्रहका स्वरूप स्वसंवेद्य है अर्थात् स्वानुभूतिका विषय है। ब्रह्मा आदि भी उस स्वरूपका वर्णन नहीं कर सकते। मनुष्य धीरे-धीरे उस स्वरूपको योगके माध्यमसे जान लेता है योगसाधनासे प्राप्त निर्वाण माहेश्वर पद कहा जाता है। उस निर्वाणका हेतु रुद्रका ज्ञान हो जाना ही है और वह ज्ञान उन्हींकी कृपासे होता है

verses.sanskrit: सम्प्रेक्ष्य सर्वकालेषु तथावर्तेषु योगिनाम् आद्ये श्वेतः कलौ रुद्रः सुतारो मदनस् तथा
verses.transliteration: samprekṣya sarvakāleṣu tathāvarteṣu yoginām ādye śvetaḥ kalau rudraḥ sutāro madanas tathā
verses.translation: The knower of the Atman shall then duly secure Asanas (correct postures) for achieving yogic results. If the place and time are not suitable he cannot have even a glimpse of yoga. The yogic exercises should not be practised in the the following places or circumstances — near the fire, within water, on a heap of dry leaves, in a place infested with crea- tures, in the cremation ground, in a dilapidated cowpen, in the four crossroads, in a place full of noises, in a place generating fear, in a monastery, or the anthill, in an in- auspicious place, in a place inhabited by wicked men and in a place infested with mosquitoes. One should not practise yogic exercises when there is some ailment in the body or when the mind is in dejection.
verses.hindi: जो सभी इन्द्रियोंको नियन्त्रित करके उस ज्ञानसे पापोंको जला डालता है, इन्द्रियोंकी वृत्तियोंपर नियन्त्रण नियन्त्रण रखनेवाले उस प्राणीको योगकी सिद्धि अवश्य होती है हे श्रेष्ठ ब्राह्मणों! चित्तकी वृत्तियोंपर नियन्त्रण करना ही योग है। सिद्धिप्राप्तिके लिये इस योगके आठ प्रकारके साधन यहाँ बताये गये हें

verses.sanskrit: महाकायमुनिः शूली दण्डी मुण्डीश्वरः स्वयम् सहिष्णुः सोमशर्मा च नकुलीशो जगद्गुरुः
verses.transliteration: mahākāyamuniḥ śūlī daṇḍī muṇḍīśvaraḥ svayam sahiṣṇuḥ somaśarmā ca nakulīśo jagadguruḥ
verses.translation: He should meditate on Him in a spot as lustrous as gold or as splendid as burning coal or very white or as reful- gent as twelve suns or as brilliant as the disc of the moon or as flashing as millions of lightning streaks or as lustrous as fire or as glittering as a circle of lightning or as refulgent as a crore of diamond pieces or as brilliant as a ruby. He should practise meditation on the image of blue and red coloured lord (Siva). He shall meditate on Siva on his forehead; on Mahadeva ( the great lord) in his lotus-like heart and in the mind. The great lord is of the following description: He is devoid of impurities. He is unsullied. He is the quiescent Brahman in the form of knowledge. He has no specific charac- teristics. He cannot be particularly pointed out. He is minuter than the atom. He is splendid and supportless. He cannot be reflected upon. He is devoid of death and birth. He is liberation itself. He is ambrosial, imperishable and unborn. He is mira- culous, the greatest and the largest bliss. He is devoid of defects and qualities. He is subtler than the subtlest, auspicious, self-cognizable, incomprehensible. He is the greatest lord identical with perfect knowledge. He is beyond the scope of sense-organs. He has no semblance. He is the greatest prin- ciple, greater than the greatest, devoid of conditioning adjuncts, comprehensible through meditation, non-dualistic, beyond all darkness and the greatest Being. The devotee should meditate in the umbilicus on Sadi$iva, the lord identical with devas.

verses.translation: Ailments originate from the imbalance of' the consti- tuent elements. They are the outcome of the defective previous schemes as well as of bad habits. Negligence constitutes omission to secure the means of yoga. Doubt is a double perception — "this or that". Un- steadiness is the instability to stabilize the mind. The mind remains unsteady due to its engrossment in mundane affairs even when the ground is achieved. Lack of faith is the un- emotional attitude towards the means of yoga.
verses.hindi: विधिना तादृशी हिंसा सा त्वहिंसा इति स्मृता स्त्रियः सदा परित्याज्याः सङ्गं नैव च कारयेत् । कुणपेषु यथा चित्तं तथा कुर्याद्विचक्षणः

verses.transliteration: viśokaśca vikeśaś ca vipāśaḥ pāpanāśanaḥ sumukho durmukhaścaiva durdamo duratikramaḥ
verses.translation: When the mind is affected by tamasor rajas it is afflicted. The state of the mind at that time is called dejection. Dejection should be eschewed by strict detachment from the material objects. When one can discriminate between what is worthy and what is not worthy but still stubbornly clings to the unworthy, engrossed in diverse mundane affairs his mind becomes fickle then. These are the impediments in the reali- zation of yoga for a yogin. To the devotee who practises yoga excessively en- dowed with zeal the obstacles subside but other impediments in the form of siddhis begin to appear. The siddhis arc six:

verses.translation: The yogic siddhi apya (pertaining to the water) is sbcteen: (1) He can stay under water as long as he wills; (2) he can come out of water whenever he wills; (3) he can drink up even the ocean and be none the worse for it; (4) he can let the water spring up wherever he wills; (5) whatever he wishes to eat he can transform it into tasty substance; (6) he can hold body with only three elements, viz. fire, air and ether; (7) He can hold a mass of water by the bare hands without any con- tainer; (8) he can have a body free from cuts and wounds. These eight powers together with the eight qualities of the earth constitute aivarya pertaining to the water. verses.hindi: हे मुनियो! मैंने संक्षेपमें यमोंके विषयमें बता दिया और अब आपलोगोंसे नियमोंका वर्णन करता हूँ। शौच, यज्ञ, तप, दान, स्वाध्याय, इन्द्रियनिग्रह, व्रत, उपवास, मौन तथा स्नान--ये दस प्रकारके नियम आकांक्षाराहित्य, शुचिता, सन्तुष्टि, तप, जप एवं भगवान् शिवसे सम्बन्ध स्थापित करना तथा पद्यासन आदि-ये नियम हैं ॥३० /२॥
verses.wordMeaning: — sifari|rl%<n*.Thesixtylburatt (siddhayab)

verses.sanskrit: विमला ब्रह्मभूयिष्ठा ज्ञानयोगपरायणाः एते पाशुपताः सिद्धा भस्मोद्धूलितविग्रहाः
verses.transliteration: vimalā brahmabhūyiṣṭhā jñānayogaparāyaṇāḥ ete pāśupatāḥ siddhā bhasmoddhūlitavigrahāḥ
verses.translation: In all the worlds, upto the world of' Brahma, one should avoid obstacles. Checking up all desires one should totally abandon them. The great lord is delighted thereby. When the lord is delighted liberation becomes easy to attain, by virtue of complete detachment. In some cases, a sage (after getting His grace) may roam about without eschewing the Siddhis for the sake of blessing others or for mere sport. Then also he can be happy.

verses.sanskrit: शिष्याः प्रशिष्याश्चैतेषां शतशो ऽथ सहस्रशः प्राप्य पाशुपतं योगं रुद्रलोकाय संस्थिताः
verses.transliteration: śiṣyāḥ praśiṣyāścaiteṣāṃ śataśo 'tha sahasraśaḥ prāpya pāśupataṃ yogaṃ rudralokāya saṃsthitāḥ
verses.translation: The knower of the yoga can perceive thousands of images of devas and their splendid aerial chariots. Everything can come within the lange of his kcii.
verses.hindi: शैवला झषका मत्स्याः सत्त्वा मत्स्योपजीविनः तस्मादाभ्यन्तरं शौचं सदा कार्यं विधानतः
verses.wordMeaning: The knower of the yoga can perceive thousands of images of devas and their splendid aerial chariots. Everything can come within the lange of his kcii.
verses.commentary: Sense: The knower of the yoga can perceive thousands of images of devas and their splendid aerial chariots. Everything can come within the lange of his kcii.

verses.sanskrit: देवादयः पिशाचान्ताः पशवः परिकीर्तिताः तेषां पतित्वात्सर्वेशो भवः पशुपतिः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: devādayaḥ piśācāntāḥ paśavaḥ parikīrtitāḥ teṣāṃ patitvātsarveśo bhavaḥ paśupatiḥ smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: He can see Brahma, Visnu, India, Yania, Agni, Varuna and other deities. He can see thousands of planets, stars and luminaries as well as their regions. Entering the state of ecstatic trance he can sec the dwellers of nether regions. He can dispel daikuess ( == igno- rance) by the steady influx of his inmost spiritual light— glowing with divine grace and characterized by goodness— -which he can sec within himself.
verses.hindi: सुवैराग्यमृदा शुद्धः शौचमेवं प्रकीर्तितम् तथा शिवप्रणीधानं मनोवाक्कायकर्मणा
verses.wordMeaning: He can see Brahma, Visnu, India, Yania, Agni, Varuna and other deities. He can see thousands of planets, stars and luminaries as well as their regions. Entering the state of ecstatic trance he can sec the dwellers of nether regions.…
verses.commentary: Sense: He can see Brahma, Visnu, India, Yania, Agni, Varuna and other deities. He can see thousands of planets, stars and luminaries as well as their regions. Entering the state of ecstatic trance he can sec the dwellers of nether regions.…

verses.sanskrit: तेन प्रणीतो रुद्रेण पशूनां पतिना द्विजाः योगः पाशुपतो ज्ञेयः परावरविभूतये
verses.transliteration: tena praṇīto rudreṇa paśūnāṃ patinā dvijāḥ yogaḥ pāśupato jñeyaḥ parāvaravibhūtaye
verses.translation: No doubt need be entertained that by virtue of His grace, one can attain Dharma, riches, knowledge, detach- ment and salvation* The details of his grace, one cannot descril>c even in ten thousands of years. O leading sages, one should steadily adhere to the yoga piertaining to lord Siva.
verses.hindi: शिवज्ञानं गुरोर्भक्तिरचला सुप्रतिष्ठिता निग्रहो ह्यपहत्याशु प्रसक्तानीन्द्रियाणि च . विषयेषु समासेन प्रत्याहारः प्रकीर्तितः। चित्तस्य धारणा प्रोक्ता स्थानबन्धः समासतः
verses.wordMeaning: No doubt need be entertained that by virtue of His grace, one can attain Dharma, riches, knowledge, detach- ment and salvation* The details of his grace, one cannot descril>c even in ten thousands of years. O leading sages,…
verses.commentary: Sense: No doubt need be entertained that by virtue of His grace, one can attain Dharma, riches, knowledge, detach- ment and salvation* The details of his grace, one cannot descril>c even in ten thousands of years. O leading sages,…

verses.sanskrit: संक्षेपतः प्रवक्ष्यामि योगस्थानानि साम्प्रतम् कल्पितानि शिवेनैव हिताय जगतां द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: saṃkṣepataḥ pravakṣyāmi yogasthānāni sāmpratam kalpitāni śivenaiva hitāya jagatāṃ dvijāḥ
verses.translation: The portion covered by a vilasti beneath the throat and above the umbilicus is the excellent zone of yoga; so also the curling lock of hair below the umbilicus and middle portion between the eyc-brows.
verses.hindi: शुचिता बाह्य तथा आभ्यन्तर-भेदसे दो कही गयी है, उसमें भी आन्तरिक शुचिता साधकको बाह्य पवित्रतासे युक्त होकर पवित्रताके लिये प्रयास करना चाहिए॥ ३१ र्वष शिवपूजकोंको चाहिए कि वे विधिपूर्वक भस्मस्नान जलस्नान तथा मन्त्रस्तान सम्पन्न करनेके पश्चात् आभ्यन्तर शुचिताका सम्पादन करें; क्योंकि सम्पूर्ण शरीरमें पवित्र मृत्तिकाका लेपन करके सर्वदा पवित्र
verses.wordMeaning: The portion covered by a vilasti beneath the throat and above the umbilicus is the excellent zone of yoga; so also the curling lock of hair below the umbilicus and middle portion between the eyc-brows.
verses.commentary: Sense: The portion covered by a vilasti beneath the throat and above the umbilicus is the excellent zone of yoga; so also the curling lock of hair below the umbilicus and middle portion between the eyc-brows.

verses.sanskrit: गलादधो वितस्त्या यन् नाभेरुपरि चोत्तमम् योगस्थानमधो नाभेर् आवर्तं मध्यमं भ्रुवोः
verses.transliteration: galādadho vitastyā yan nābherupari cottamam yogasthānamadho nābher āvartaṃ madhyamaṃ bhruvoḥ
verses.translation: The knowledge of all topics that arises in the soul is called yoga. The concentration of the mind is possible only through his grace.
verses.hindi: तीर्थके जलमें अवगाहन करनेवाला भी अन्त:शोचके बिना मलिन ही रहता है॥ ३२-३३//२॥ हे द्विजोत्तमो ! सदा जलमें रहनेपर भी शैवाल, झषक
verses.wordMeaning: The knowledge of all topics that arises in the soul is called yoga. The concentration of the mind is possible only through his grace.
verses.commentary: Sense: The knowledge of all topics that arises in the soul is called yoga. The concentration of the mind is possible only through his grace.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वार्थज्ञाननिष्पत्तिर् आत्मनो योग उच्यते एकाग्रता भवेच्चैव सर्वदा तत्प्रसादतः
verses.transliteration: sarvārthajñānaniṣpattir ātmano yoga ucyate ekāgratā bhaveccaiva sarvadā tatprasādataḥ
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, the form of his grace can be realized by the individual alone. It cannot be imported by Br 2 hi:i v>r any other. It arises itself in the individual gradually.
verses.hindi: कभी पवित्र हुए हैं ? इसीलिये सदा विधिपूर्वक आन्तरिक पवित्रताका सम्पादन करना चाहिए शरीरपर एक बार श्रद्धापूर्वक वैराग्यरूपी मृत्तिकाका लेपन करके आत्म-ज्ञानरूपी जलमें स्नान करके शुद्ध हो जानेको अन्तःशौच कहा गया है। शुद्ध पुरुषको ही सिद्धियाँ मिलती हैं, अशुद्ध पुरुषको कभी नहीं
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent brahmins, the form of his grace can be realized by the individual alone. It cannot be imported by Br 2 hi:i v>r any other. It arises itself in the individual gradually.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent brahmins, the form of his grace can be realized by the individual alone. It cannot be imported by Br 2 hi:i v>r any other. It arises itself in the individual gradually.

verses.sanskrit: प्रसादस्य स्वरूपं यत् स्वसंवेद्यं द्विजोत्तमाः वक्तुं न शक्यं ब्रह्माद्यैः क्रमशो जायते नृणाम्
verses.transliteration: prasādasya svarūpaṃ yat svasaṃvedyaṃ dvijottamāḥ vaktuṃ na śakyaṃ brahmādyaiḥ kramaśo jāyate nṛṇām
verses.translation: Yoga indicates the region where the Supreme Lord dwells.'* For the attainment of that region, knowledge is the cause, and this knowledge comes through his grace alone.
verses.hindi: जो ब्रती पुरुष न्यायपूर्वक अर्जित किये गये धनसे संतुष्ट रहता है और गये धनके विषयमें चिन्तन नहीँ करता, वह सन्तोषी कहा जाता है। चान्द्रायण आदि ब्रतोंका निपुणतापूर्वक आचरण करना शुभ तप कहा श्रणवका जप स्वाध्याय कहा जाता है और वह जप तीन प्रकारका कहा गया है। वाचिक जप अधम,
verses.wordMeaning: Yoga indicates the region where the Supreme Lord dwells.'* For the attainment of that region, knowledge is the cause, and this knowledge comes through his grace alone.
verses.commentary: Sense: Yoga indicates the region where the Supreme Lord dwells.'* For the attainment of that region, knowledge is the cause, and this knowledge comes through his grace alone.

verses.sanskrit: योगशब्देन निर्वाणं माहेशं पदमुच्यते तस्य हेतुरृषेर्ज्ञानं ज्ञानं तस्य प्रसादतः
verses.transliteration: yogaśabdena nirvāṇaṃ māheśaṃ padamucyate tasya heturṛṣerjñānaṃ jñānaṃ tasya prasādataḥ
verses.translation: One should abstain from sensual activities and burn sins by means of perfect knowledge. The achievement of yoga shall be possible only to one who has restrained the activities of his sense-organs.
verses.hindi: मानस जप उत्तमोत्तम है, जो पंचाक्षर कल्पमें विस्तारसे बताये गये हैं। इस प्रकार मन, वचन तथा शारीरिक क्रियाओंसे शिवका प्रणीधान और गुरुके प्रति निश्चल 0 00 उनका, गया है। इन्द्रियोपर नियन्त्रण करनेको संक्षेपमें प्रत्याहार कहा गया
verses.wordMeaning: One should abstain from sensual activities and burn sins by means of perfect knowledge. The achievement of yoga shall be possible only to one who has restrained the activities of his sense-organs.
verses.commentary: Sense: One should abstain from sensual activities and burn sins by means of perfect knowledge. The achievement of yoga shall be possible only to one who has restrained the activities of his sense-organs.

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञानेन निर्दहेत्पापं निरुध्य विषयान् सदा निरुद्धेन्द्रियवृत्तेस्तु योगसिद्धिर्भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: jñānena nirdahetpāpaṃ nirudhya viṣayān sadā niruddhendriyavṛttestu yogasiddhirbhaviṣyati
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, yoga is restraining the function- ing of the mind. Eight means have been mentioned for the achievement of yoga.
verses.hindi: है और हृदय आदि स्थानोंमें चित्तको रोकनेकी क्रिया संक्षेपमें धारणा कही गयी है॥ ३९--४२॥ शरीरमें स्थित योगस्थानों ( चक्रों )-का वर्णन""सदाशिवके ध्यानका स्वरूप
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent brahmins, yoga is restraining the function- ing of the mind. Eight means have been mentioned for the achievement of yoga.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent brahmins, yoga is restraining the function- ing of the mind. Eight means have been mentioned for the achievement of yoga.

verses.sanskrit: यमस्तु प्रथमः प्रोक्तो द्वितीयो नियमस् तथा तृतीयमासनं प्रोक्तं प्राणायामस्ततः परम्
verses.transliteration: yamastu prathamaḥ prokto dvitīyo niyamas tathā tṛtīyamāsanaṃ proktaṃ prāṇāyāmastataḥ param
verses.translation: Abstention by way of austerity is C'llled restraint (yama); O foremost among those who have restraint, the first
