verses.translation: He shall meditate on lord Siva identical with
verses.hindi: विद्यते तत्परं शैवं विष्णुना नावगम्यते। असंख्येयगुणं शुद्धं को जानीयाच्छिवात्मकम् "० ०॥---.--... ज्य फफफ परापापापाफाफाफफ फ़ फुफफफफफफफफफाफाफाफफाफीफपीफीकीकी फफफ फाफफपाप सा पापी फफफफ

verses.transliteration: svayaṃvedyamavedyaṃ tac chivaṃ jñānamayaṃ param atīndriyam anābhāsaṃ paraṃ tattvaṃ parātparam
verses.translation: He shall meditate on lord Siva identical with
verses.hindi: फकफफफ्फफफफफकफमका व्युत्थाने सिद्धयश्चैता ह्युपसर्गाश्च कीर्तिताः। भी नहीं जानते हैं। असंख्य ह शुद्ध शिवात्मक निरोद्धव्या: प्रयत्नेन वैराग्येण परेण तु॥ तत्वको कौन जान सकता है अर्थात् कोई नहीं जान
verses.wordMeaning: He shall meditate on lord Siva identical with
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall meditate on lord Siva identical with

verses.sanskrit: सर्वोपाधिविनिर्मुक्तं ध्यानगम्यं विचारतः अद्वयं तमसश्चैव परस्तात्संस्थितं परम्
verses.transliteration: sarvopādhivinirmuktaṃ dhyānagamyaṃ vicārataḥ advayaṃ tamasaścaiva parastātsaṃsthitaṃ param
verses.translation: He shall meditate on lord Siva identical with
verses.hindi: चौंसठ गुणात्मक ये ऐश्वर्य व्यवहारकालमें सिद्धि कहे जाते हैं, किंतु समाधिकालमें ये ही उपसर्ग अ विघ्न कहे गये हैं। इन्हें प्रयत्नपूर्वक परम बेराग्यसे रोकना चाहिए भय उत्पन्न करनेवाले विषय-भोगोंकी अवश्यम्भावी नश्वरता जानकर सबका अश्रद्धासे त्याग कर देना चाहिए। ऐसा करनेवाला विरक्त कहा जाता है
verses.wordMeaning: He shall meditate on lord Siva identical with
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall meditate on lord Siva identical with

verses.sanskrit: मनस्येवं महादेवं हृत्पद्मे वापि चिन्तयेत् नाभौ सदाशिवं चापि सर्वदेवात्मकं विभुम्
verses.transliteration: manasyevaṃ mahādevaṃ hṛtpadme vāpi cintayet nābhau sadāśivaṃ cāpi sarvadevātmakaṃ vibhum
verses.translation: He shall meditate on lord Siva identical with
verses.hindi: पुरुषमें वितृष्णा नामसे प्रसिद्ध भावको ही गुणवैतृष्ण्य कहा जाता है। औपसर्गिक अर्थात् विघ्नरूप सिद्धियोंका वैराग्यके द्वारा परित्याग कर देना चाहिए चित्तको विषयभोगोंसे हटाकर भुवनोंमें समस्त विघ्नरूप ब्राह्म ऐश्वर्योका परित्याग करनेसे महेश्वर प्रसन्न होते हैं और इस प्रकार साधकके परम वैराग्यसे शिवके प्रसन्न होनेपर उसे विमल मुक्ति प्राप्त होती है
verses.wordMeaning: He shall meditate on lord Siva identical with
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall meditate on lord Siva identical with

verses.sanskrit: देहमध्ये शिवं देवं शुद्धज्ञानमयं विभुम् कन्यसेनैव मार्गेण चोद्घातेनापि शंकरम्
verses.transliteration: dehamadhye śivaṃ devaṃ śuddhajñānamayaṃ vibhum kanyasenaiva mārgeṇa codghātenāpi śaṃkaram
verses.translation: He shall meditate on lord Siva identical with
verses.hindi: अथवा जो योगी सांसारिक प्राणियोंके कल्याणार्थ या लीलाके निमित्त इन सिद्धियोंका त्याग नहीं करता, वह भी सुखी ही रहता है कभी भूमि छोड़कर अपनी प्रबल शक्तिसे आकाशमें क्रोडा करता है और कभी सूक्ष्म अर्थात् सामान्य लोगोंके लिये अबोधगम्य वेदार्थोको संक्षेपमें उच्चारित करता है॥५७४/. ॥
verses.wordMeaning: He shall meditate on lord Siva identical with
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall meditate on lord Siva identical with

verses.sanskrit: क्रमशः कन्यसेनैव मध्यमेनापि सुव्रतः उत्तमेनापि वै विद्वान् कुम्भकेन समभ्यसेत्
verses.transliteration: kramaśaḥ kanyasenaiva madhyamenāpi suvrataḥ uttamenāpi vai vidvān kumbhakena samabhyaset
verses.translation: He shall meditate on lord Siva identical with
verses.hindi: वह कभी कोई प्रसंग सुनकर उसके अर्थसे श्लोक-रचना कर डालता है। कभी दण्डक छन्दमें और इसी प्रकार हजारों प्रकारके छन्दोंमें काव्यरचना करता उसे मृग तथा पक्षिवर्गकी ध्वनियोंका ज्ञान हो जाता है। यहाँतक कि ब्रह्मासे लेकर स्थावरपर्यन्त समग्र संसार उस योगीके लिये हस्तामलकतुल्य हो जाता
verses.wordMeaning: He shall meditate on lord Siva identical with
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall meditate on lord Siva identical with

verses.sanskrit: द्वात्रिंशद् रेचयेद्धीमान् हृदि नाभौ समाहितः रेचकं पूरकं त्यक्त्वा कुम्भकं च द्विजोत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: dvātriṃśad recayeddhīmān hṛdi nābhau samāhitaḥ recakaṃ pūrakaṃ tyaktvā kumbhakaṃ ca dvijottamāḥ
verses.translation: He shall meditate on lord Siva identical with
verses.hindi: है श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! अधिक क्या कहा जाय; उस महात्मा योगीमें हजारों प्रकारके विज्ञान उत्पन्न हो जाते अश्रद्धया त्यजेत्सर्वं विरक्त इति कीर्तितः
verses.wordMeaning: He shall meditate on lord Siva identical with
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall meditate on lord Siva identical with

verses.sanskrit: साक्षात्समरसेनैव देहमध्ये स्मरेच्छिवम् एकीभावं समेत्यैवं तत्र यद्रससम्भवम्
verses.transliteration: sākṣātsamarasenaiva dehamadhye smarecchivam ekībhāvaṃ sametyaivaṃ tatra yadrasasambhavam
verses.translation: He shall meditate on lord Siva identical with
verses.hindi: वैराग्येणैव सन्त्याज्याः सिद्धयश्चौपसर्गिकाः औपसर्गिकमाब्रह्मभुवनेषु परित्यजेत्। निरुद्धयैव त्यजेत्सर्वं प्रसीदति महेश्वर:
verses.wordMeaning: He shall meditate on lord Siva identical with
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall meditate on lord Siva identical with

verses.sanskrit: आनन्दं ब्रह्मणो विद्वान् साक्षात्समरसे स्थितः धारणा द्वादशायामा ध्यानं द्वादश धारणम्
verses.transliteration: ānandaṃ brahmaṇo vidvān sākṣātsamarase sthitaḥ dhāraṇā dvādaśāyāmā dhyānaṃ dvādaśa dhāraṇam
verses.translation: He shall meditate on lord Siva identical with
verses.hindi: अथवानुग्रहार्थं च लीलार्थं वा तदा मुनिः क्वचिद्भूमिं परित्यज्य ह्याकाशे क्रीडते श्रिया
verses.wordMeaning: He shall meditate on lord Siva identical with
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall meditate on lord Siva identical with

verses.sanskrit: ध्यानं द्वादशकं यावत् समाधिर् अभिधीयते अथवा ज्ञानिनां विप्राः सम्पर्कादेव जायते
verses.transliteration: dhyānaṃ dvādaśakaṃ yāvat samādhir abhidhīyate athavā jñānināṃ viprāḥ samparkādeva jāyate
verses.translation: He shall meditate on lord Siva identical with
verses.hindi: क्वचिच्छुते तदर्थेन श्लोकबन्धं करोति सः ब्रह्माद्यं स्थावरान्तं च हस्तामलकवद्भवेत्। अहुनात्र किमुक्तेन विज्ञानानि सहस्रश:
verses.wordMeaning: He shall meditate on lord Siva identical with
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall meditate on lord Siva identical with

verses.sanskrit: प्रयत्नाद्वा तयोस्तुल्यं चिराद्वा ह्यचिराद्द्विजाः योगान्तरायास् तस्याथ जायन्ते युञ्जतः पुनः
verses.transliteration: prayatnādvā tayostulyaṃ cirādvā hyacirāddvijāḥ yogāntarāyās tasyātha jāyante yuñjataḥ punaḥ
verses.translation: He shall meditate on lord Siva identical with
verses.hindi: उत्पद्यन्ते . मुनिश्रेष्ठा मुनेस्तस्य महात्मन: । अभ्यासेनैव विज्ञानं विशुद्धं च स्थिरं भवेत् देवबिम्बान्यनेकानि विमानानि सहस्त्रश:
verses.wordMeaning: He shall meditate on lord Siva identical with
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall meditate on lord Siva identical with

verses.sanskrit: नश्यन्त्य् अभ्यासतस् ते ऽपि प्रणिधानेन वै गुरोः
verses.transliteration: naśyanty abhyāsatas te 'pi praṇidhānena vai guroḥ
verses.translation: He shall meditate on lord Siva identical with
verses.hindi: पश्यति ब्रह्मविष्ण्वीन्द्रयमाग्निवरुणादिकान्। ग्रहनक्षत्रताराशच भुवनानि सहस्त्रशः तस्य प्रसादाद्धर्मश्च ऐश्वर्य ज्ञानमेव च। वैराग्यमपवर्गश्च नात्र कार्या विचारणा
verses.wordMeaning: He shall meditate on lord Siva identical with
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall meditate on lord Siva identical with

verses.sanskrit: आलस्यं प्रथमं पश्चाद् व्याधिपीडा प्रजायते प्रमादः संशयस्थाने चित्तस्येहानवस्थितिः
verses.transliteration: ālasyaṃ prathamaṃ paścād vyādhipīḍā prajāyate pramādaḥ saṃśayasthāne cittasyehānavasthitiḥ
verses.translation: Obstacles to yogic practice take shape in ten different ways. They are (1) lethargy, (2) ailment, (3) negligence, (4) doubt, (5) unsteady mind, (6) lack of faith, (7) illusion, (8) misery, (9) dejection and (10) indulgence in sensual
verses.hindi: योगसिद्धिप्राप्त पुरुषोके लक्षण-“भक्तिभावमें श्रद्धाकी महत्ता । सतत अभ्यासके द्वारा ही यह विशुद्ध विज्ञान सदा स्थिर रहता है
verses.wordMeaning: Obstacles to yogic practice take shape in ten different ways. They are (1) lethargy, (2) ailment, (3) negligence, (4) doubt, (5) unsteady mind, (6) lack of faith, (7) illusion, (8) misery, (9) dejection and (10) indulgence in sensual
verses.commentary: Sense: Obstacles to yogic practice take shape in ten different ways. They are (1) lethargy, (2) ailment, (3) negligence, (4) doubt, (5) unsteady mind, (6) lack of faith, (7) illusion, (8) misery, (9) dejection and (10) indulgence in sensual

verses.sanskrit: अश्रद्धादर्शनं भ्रान्तिर् दुःखं च त्रिविधं ततः दौर्मनस्यमयोग्येषु विषयेषु च योग्यता
verses.transliteration: aśraddhādarśanaṃ bhrāntir duḥkhaṃ ca trividhaṃ tataḥ daurmanasyamayogyeṣu viṣayeṣu ca yogyatā
verses.translation: wnf: I Gf. Sivagita as quoted in
verses.hindi: योगी सभी तेजसम्पन्न देवताओंके बिम्ब तथा हजारों प्रकारके विमानोंको देखनेकी सामर्थ्य प्राप्त कर लेता है वह ब्रह्मा, विष्णु, इन्द्र, यम, अग्नि, वरुण आदि
verses.wordMeaning: wnf: I Gf. Sivagita as quoted in
verses.commentary: Sense: wnf: I Gf. Sivagita as quoted in

verses.sanskrit: दशधाभिप्रजायन्ते मुनेर्योगान्तरायकाः आलस्यं चाप्रवृत्तिश् च गुरुत्वात्कायचित्तयोः
verses.transliteration: daśadhābhiprajāyante muneryogāntarāyakāḥ ālasyaṃ cāpravṛttiś ca gurutvātkāyacittayoḥ
verses.translation: recakam purakaih tyaktva. Kumbhaka alone is recommended for the attainment of spiritual goal; recaka and puraka are excluded. Gf. Hafhqyogapradipikd
verses.hindi: वह पातालके तलमें स्थित पदार्थांको भी आत्मविद्यारूप स्वस्थ तथा अचल दीपकसे समाधिस्थ होकर देखता है वह साधक प्रसादरूप अमृतसे पूर्ण सत्त्वपात्रमें स्थित उस आत्मविद्यारूप प्रदीपसे अज्ञानान्धकारको नष्ट करके अपने भीतर साक्षात् ईश्वरका दर्शन करता हे
verses.wordMeaning: recakam purakaih tyaktva. Kumbhaka alone is recommended for the attainment of spiritual goal; recaka and puraka are excluded. Gf. Hafhqyogapradipikd
verses.commentary: Sense: recakam purakaih tyaktva. Kumbhaka alone is recommended for the attainment of spiritual goal; recaka and puraka are excluded. Gf. Hafhqyogapradipikd

verses.sanskrit: व्याधयो धातुवैषम्यात् कर्मजा दोषजास् तथा प्रमादस्तु समाधेस्तु साधनानाम् अभावनम्
verses.transliteration: vyādhayo dhātuvaiṣamyāt karmajā doṣajās tathā pramādastu samādhestu sādhanānām abhāvanam
verses.translation: Ailments originate from the imbalance of the consti- tuent elements. They are the outcome of the defective previous schemes as well as of bad habits. Negligence constitutes omission to secure the means of yoga.
verses.hindi: उसी परमेश्वरकी कृपासे धर्म, ऐश्वर्य, ज्ञान, वैराग्य तथा मोक्ष सुलभ हो जाते हैं; इसमें किसी प्रकारका संदेह नहीं करना चाहिए हे मुनीश्वरो! शिवकी महिमाका विस्तृत वर्णन हजारों वर्षोमे भी नहीं किया जा सकता है। अतएव पाशुपतयोगमें निष्ठापूर्वक रहना चाहिए तथा उसीमें सदा
verses.wordMeaning: Ailments originate from the imbalance of the consti- tuent elements. They are the outcome of the defective previous schemes as well as of bad habits. Negligence constitutes omission to secure the means of yoga.
verses.commentary: Sense: Ailments originate from the imbalance of the consti- tuent elements. They are the outcome of the defective previous schemes as well as of bad habits. Negligence constitutes omission to secure the means of yoga.

verses.sanskrit: इदं वेत्युभयस्पृक्तं विज्ञानं स्थानसंशयः अनवस्थितचित्तत्वम् अप्रतिष्ठा हि योगिनः
verses.transliteration: idaṃ vetyubhayaspṛktaṃ vijñānaṃ sthānasaṃśayaḥ anavasthitacittatvam apratiṣṭhā hi yoginaḥ
verses.translation: Doubt is a double perception — "this or that". Un- steadiness is the instability to stabilize the mind. I'he mind remains unsteady due to its engrossment in mundane affairs even when the ground is achieved. Lack of faith is the un- emotional attitude towards the means of yoga.
verses.hindi: योगे पाशुपते निष्ठा स्थातव्यं च मुनीश्वराः ॥ ६७ मनको स्थिर रखना चाहिए योगसिद्धिप्राप्त पुरुषोंके लक्षण, साधुधर्मका स्वरूप, भगवान् शिवके साक्षात्कारके उपायोंका वर्णन तथा भक्तिभावमें श्रद्धाको महत्ता
verses.wordMeaning: Doubt is a double perception — "this or that". Un- steadiness is the instability to stabilize the mind. I'he mind remains unsteady due to its engrossment in mundane affairs even when the ground is achieved. Lack of faith is the un- emotional attitude towards the means of yoga.
verses.commentary: Sense: Doubt is a double perception — "this or that". Un- steadiness is the instability to stabilize the mind. I'he mind remains unsteady due to its engrossment in mundane affairs even when the ground is achieved. Lack of faith is the un- emotional attitude towards the means of yoga.

verses.sanskrit: लब्धायामपि भूमौ च चित्तस्य भवबन्धनात् अश्रद्धाभावरहिता वृत्तिर्वै साधनेषु च
verses.transliteration: labdhāyāmapi bhūmau ca cittasya bhavabandhanāt aśraddhābhāvarahitā vṛttirvai sādhaneṣu ca
verses.translation: Illusion is misconception of the mind as regards one's aim, the preceptor, right knowledge, good conduct and lord Siva as also in the apprehension of self in non-self even when it is nearby. Misery is threefold: spiritual material®** and divine®. There is also a natural misery due to the agitation of the mind through the frustration of desires.
verses.hindi: धर्मज्ञानां च साधूनामाचार्याणां शिवात्मनाम् साक्षात् द्विजाति (ब्राह्मण, क्षत्रिय, वैश्य), धर्मज्ञ, साधु,
verses.wordMeaning: Illusion is misconception of the mind as regards one's aim, the preceptor, right knowledge, good conduct and lord Siva as also in the apprehension of self in non-self even when it is nearby. Misery is threefold: spiritual material®** and divine®.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Illusion is misconception of the mind as regards one's aim, the preceptor, right knowledge, good conduct and lord Siva as also in the apprehension of self in non-self even when it is nearby. Misery is threefold: spiritual material®** and divine®.…

verses.sanskrit: साध्ये चित्तस्य हि गुरौ ज्ञानाचारशिवादिषु विपर्ययज्ञानमिति भ्रान्तिदर्शनम् उच्यते
verses.transliteration: sādhye cittasya hi gurau jñānācāraśivādiṣu viparyayajñānamiti bhrāntidarśanam ucyate
verses.translation: When the mind is affected by tamasor rajas it is afflicted. The state of the mind at that time is called dejection. Dejection should be eschewed by strict detachment from the material objects. When one can discriminate between what is worthy and what is not worthy but still stubbornly clings to the unworthy, engrossed in diverse mundane affairs his mind becomes fickle then. These arc the impediments in the reali- zation of yoga for a yogin.
verses.hindi: आचार्य, शिवात्मा, दयावान्, तपस्वी, संन्यासी, दानी, उदार, मनसा-वाचा-कर्मणा सत्यवादी, अलुब्ध,
verses.wordMeaning: When the mind is affected by tamasor rajas it is afflicted. The state of the mind at that time is called dejection. Dejection should be eschewed by strict detachment from the material objects.…
verses.commentary: Sense: When the mind is affected by tamasor rajas it is afflicted. The state of the mind at that time is called dejection. Dejection should be eschewed by strict detachment from the material objects.…

verses.sanskrit: अनात्मन्यात्मविज्ञानम् अज्ञानात्तस्य संनिधौ दुःखमाध्यात्मिकं प्रोक्तं तथा चैवाधिभौतिकम्
verses.transliteration: anātmanyātmavijñānam ajñānāttasya saṃnidhau duḥkhamādhyātmikaṃ proktaṃ tathā caivādhibhautikam
verses.translation: To the devotee who practises yoga excessively en- dowed with zeal the obstacles subside but other impediments in the form of siddhis begin to appear.- The siddhis arc six:
verses.hindi: सदिति ब्रह्मणः शब्दस्तदन्ते ये लभन्त्युत सायुज्यं ब्रह्मणो यान्ति तेन सन्तः प्रचक्षते। दशात्मके ये विषये साधने चाष्टलक्षणे
verses.wordMeaning: To the devotee who practises yoga excessively en- dowed with zeal the obstacles subside but other impediments in the form of siddhis begin to appear.- The siddhis arc six:
verses.commentary: Sense: To the devotee who practises yoga excessively en- dowed with zeal the obstacles subside but other impediments in the form of siddhis begin to appear.- The siddhis arc six:

verses.sanskrit: आधिदैविकमित्युक्तं त्रिविधं सहजं पुनः इच्छाविघातात्संक्षोभश् चेतसस्तदुदाहृतम्
verses.transliteration: ādhidaivikamityuktaṃ trividhaṃ sahajaṃ punaḥ icchāvighātātsaṃkṣobhaś cetasastadudāhṛtam
verses.translation: These siddhis if avoided initially when their pot- ency is very little, lead to better results. Pratibha (keen intel- lect j is the disposition (of the mind), resting on one's power of understanding.
verses.hindi: सामान्येषु च द्रव्येषु तथा वैशेषिकेषु च ब्रह्मक्षत्रविशो यस्माद्युक्तास्तस्माद् द्विजातयः। वर्णाश्रमेषु युक्तस्य स्वर्गादिसुखकारिणः
verses.wordMeaning: These siddhis if avoided initially when their pot- ency is very little, lead to better results. Pratibha (keen intel- lect j is the disposition (of the mind), resting on one's power of understanding.
verses.commentary: Sense: These siddhis if avoided initially when their pot- ency is very little, lead to better results. Pratibha (keen intel- lect j is the disposition (of the mind), resting on one's power of understanding.

verses.sanskrit: दौर्मनस्यं निरोद्धव्यं वैराग्येण परेण तु तमसा रजसा चैव संस्पृष्टं दुर्मनः स्मृतम्
verses.transliteration: daurmanasyaṃ niroddhavyaṃ vairāgyeṇa pareṇa tu tamasā rajasā caiva saṃspṛṣṭaṃ durmanaḥ smṛtam
verses.translation: Varta is the intellectual perception of divine smells and subtle elements. O brahmins, through yoga, the yogins attain the knowledge of everything about the embodied beings.
verses.hindi: श्रौतस्मार्तस्य धर्मस्य ज्ञानाद्धर्मज्ञ उच्यते। विद्यायाः साधनात्साधुरब्रह्चारी गुरोर्हितः एवमाश्रमधर्माणां साधनात्साधवः स्मृताः
verses.wordMeaning: Varta is the intellectual perception of divine smells and subtle elements. O brahmins, through yoga, the yogins attain the knowledge of everything about the embodied beings.
verses.commentary: Sense: Varta is the intellectual perception of divine smells and subtle elements. O brahmins, through yoga, the yogins attain the knowledge of everything about the embodied beings.

verses.sanskrit: तदा मनसि संजातं दौर्मनस्यमिति स्मृतम् हठात्स्वीकरणं कृत्वा योग्यायोग्यविवेकतः
verses.transliteration: tadā manasi saṃjātaṃ daurmanasyamiti smṛtam haṭhātsvīkaraṇaṃ kṛtvā yogyāyogyavivekataḥ
verses.translation: In this world there are sixty four qi:alities present in the body. O brahmins, among these, the aupasargika quali- ties should be eschewed. In the region of pisacas, () brahmins, the cpialities of earth (should be eschewed); in the region of raksasas the qualities of water; in the region of Yaksa the qualities of fire; in the region of Gandharvas the qualities of breath; in the region of Indra the qualities o' ether; in the region of Soma the qualities of the mind; in the region of prajapati the qualities of ego; in the regioe of brahman the qualities of intellect should be eschewed.
verses.hindi: गृहस्थो ब्रह्मचारी च वानप्रस्थो यतिस्तथा। धर्माधर्माविह प्रोक्तौ शब्दावेतौ क्रियात्मकौ कुशलाकुशलं कर्म धर्माधर्माविति स्मृतौ। धारणार्थे महान् ह्येष धर्मशब्दः प्रकीर्तित:
verses.wordMeaning: In this world there are sixty four qi:alities present in the body. O brahmins, among these, the aupasargika quali- ties should be eschewed. In the region of pisacas, () brahmins, the cpialities of earth (should be eschewed); in the region of raksasas the qualities of water;…
verses.commentary: Sense: In this world there are sixty four qi:alities present in the body. O brahmins, among these, the aupasargika quali- ties should be eschewed. In the region of pisacas, () brahmins, the cpialities of earth (should be eschewed); in the region of raksasas the qualities of water;…

verses.sanskrit: विषयेषु विचित्रेषु जन्तोर्विषयलोलता अन्तराया इति ख्याता योगस्यैते हि योगिनाम्
verses.transliteration: viṣayeṣu vicitreṣu jantorviṣayalolatā antarāyā iti khyātā yogasyaite hi yoginām
verses.translation: In the first region (earth) there arc eight qualities; in the second (water) sixteen; in the third (fire) twenty four; in the fourth (gandharva) twentytwo; in the fifth (Indra) forty. Each of the five subtle elements — smell, taste, colour, touch and sound is evolved eightfold. O excellent brahmins, there are fortycight qualities in the region of the moon, fifty- six in the region of Prajapati, d sixtyfour in the region of Brahman. In all the regions ending with that of Brahman, the
verses.hindi: अधारणे महत्त्वे च अधर्म इति चोच्यते। अत्रेष्टप्रापको धर्म आचार्यरुपदिश्यते अधर्मश्चानिष्टफलो ह्याचायैरुपदिश्यते। वृद्धाश्चालोलुपाश्चैब आत्मवन्तो हादाम्भिका:
verses.wordMeaning: In the first region (earth) there arc eight qualities; in the second (water) sixteen; in the third (fire) twenty four; in the fourth (gandharva) twentytwo; in the fifth (Indra) forty. Each of the five subtle elements — smell, taste, colour, touch and sound is evolved eightfold.…
verses.commentary: Sense: In the first region (earth) there arc eight qualities; in the second (water) sixteen; in the third (fire) twenty four; in the fourth (gandharva) twentytwo; in the fifth (Indra) forty. Each of the five subtle elements — smell, taste, colour, touch and sound is evolved eightfold.…

verses.sanskrit: अत्यन्तोत्साहयुक्तस्य नश्यन्ति न च संशयः प्रनष्टेष्वन्तरायेषु द्विजाः पश्चाद्धि योगिनः
verses.transliteration: atyantotsāhayuktasya naśyanti na ca saṃśayaḥ pranaṣṭeṣvantarāyeṣu dvijāḥ paścāddhi yoginaḥ
verses.translation: The yogic siddhi parthiva (pertaining to the earth) is eight: (1) bulkiness, (2) lelnness, (3) infancy (4) youthful- ness, (5) old age, (6) ability to assume different shapes, (7) ability to hold body by means of (only) four elements without the part of the earth and (8) having perpetual sweet scent.
verses.hindi: लोगोंपर महेश्वर प्रसन्न रहते हैं॥ १--३१५२॥ सत् शब्दका अर्थ ब्रह्म होता है। जो अन्तमें उस ब्रह्मको पा लेते हैं, वे ब्रह्मसायुज्यको प्राप्त होते हैं इसीलिये ऐसे महात्मा संत कहे जाते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: The yogic siddhi parthiva (pertaining to the earth) is eight: (1) bulkiness, (2) lelnness, (3) infancy (4) youthful- ness, (5) old age, (6) ability to assume different shapes,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The yogic siddhi parthiva (pertaining to the earth) is eight: (1) bulkiness, (2) lelnness, (3) infancy (4) youthful- ness, (5) old age, (6) ability to assume different shapes,…

verses.sanskrit: उपसर्गाः प्रवर्तन्ते सर्वे ते ऽसिद्धिसूचकाः प्रतिभा प्रथमा सिद्धिर् द्वितीया श्रवणा स्मृता
verses.transliteration: upasargāḥ pravartante sarve te 'siddhisūcakāḥ pratibhā prathamā siddhir dvitīyā śravaṇā smṛtā
verses.translation: The yogic siddhi apya (pertaining to the water) is sixteen: (1) He can stay under water as long as he wills; (2) he can come out of water whenever he wills; (3) he can drink up even the ocean and be none the worse for it; (4) he can let the water spring up wherever he wills; (5) whatever he wishes to eat he can transform it into tasty substance; (6) he can hold body with only three elements, viz. fire, air and ether; (7) He can hold a mass of water by the bare hands without any con- tainer; (8) he can have a body free from cuts and wounds. These eight powers together with the eight qualities of the earth constitute aivarya pertaining to the water.
verses.hindi: दस इन्द्रियोंक विषयभोगोंमें तथा पूर्ववर्णित आइ प्रकारके ऐश्वर्यरूप साधनोंकी अप्राप्तिसे जो न तो क्रोध करते हैं और न उनकी प्राप्तिसे हर्षका अनुभव करते हैं, वे जितात्मा कहे गये हैं ॥ ५९/२ ॥ सामान्य तथा विशेष पदार्थोके साथ ब्राह्मण, क्षत्रिय, वैश्योंका सम्बन्धविशेष होनेसे ही ये द्विजाति कहे गये हैं ॥ ६ /२॥
verses.wordMeaning: The yogic siddhi apya (pertaining to the water) is sixteen: (1) He can stay under water as long as he wills; (2) he can come out of water whenever he wills; (3) he can drink up even the ocean and be none the worse for it; (4) he can let the water spring up wherever he wills;…
verses.commentary: Sense: The yogic siddhi apya (pertaining to the water) is sixteen: (1) He can stay under water as long as he wills; (2) he can come out of water whenever he wills; (3) he can drink up even the ocean and be none the worse for it; (4) he can let the water spring up wherever he wills;…

verses.sanskrit: वार्त्ता तृतीया विप्रेन्द्रास् तुरीया चेह दर्शना आस्वादा पञ्चमी प्रोक्ता वेदना षष्ठिका स्मृता
verses.transliteration: vārttā tṛtīyā viprendrās turīyā ceha darśanā āsvādā pañcamī proktā vedanā ṣaṣṭhikā smṛtā
verses.translation: The yogic siddhi taijasa ( pertaining to the fire) is twentyfour: (1) ability to create fire from the body; (2) absence of fear from being scorched by it; (3) ability to arrange something unburnt even when the whole world is burnt; (4) ability to keep fire in the water or (5) hold it in palms, (6) ability to create fire by merely remembering it; (7) ability to re-create at will what is reduced to ashes; and ( 8) ability to have the body with two elements — air and ether, to the exclu- sion of the other three.
verses.hindi: स्वर्ग आदिका सुख प्रदान करनेवाले श्रुति-स्मृति- प्रतिपादित वर्णाश्रम-धर्मका ज्ञान रखनेसे व्यक्ति धर्मज्ञ कहा जाता है॥ ७/२ ॥ विद्याको साधना करनेके कारण गुरुका हित करनेवाला ब्रह्मचारी साधु तथा विहित कर्मोकी साधना करनेवाला गृहस्थ साधु कहा जाता है। बनमें तपस्याकी साधना करनेसे वैखानस साधु एवं योगकी साधना करने
verses.wordMeaning: The yogic siddhi taijasa ( pertaining to the fire) is twentyfour: (1) ability to create fire from the body; (2) absence of fear from being scorched by it; (3) ability to arrange something unburnt even when the whole world is burnt;…
verses.commentary: Sense: The yogic siddhi taijasa ( pertaining to the fire) is twentyfour: (1) ability to create fire from the body; (2) absence of fear from being scorched by it; (3) ability to arrange something unburnt even when the whole world is burnt;…

verses.sanskrit: स्वल्पषट्सिद्धिसंत्यागात् सिद्धिदाः सिद्धयो मुनेः प्रतिभा प्रतिभावृतिः प्रतिभाव इति स्थितिः
verses.transliteration: svalpaṣaṭsiddhisaṃtyāgāt siddhidāḥ siddhayo muneḥ pratibhā pratibhāvṛtiḥ pratibhāva iti sthitiḥ
verses.translation: The yogic siddhis pertaining to the air are: (1) ability to move as fast as the mind; (2) ability to enter the bodies of living beings; (3 ) ability to hold weighty things like mountains on shoulders; (4) lightness, (5) weightiness, (6) holding the air with palms; (7) ability to shake the earth with the tip of the finger and ( 8) to create bodies with the air.
verses.hindi: तथा यतिधर्ममें परायण होनेसे व्यक्ति यति साधु कहा जाता है। इस प्रकार अपने-अपने आश्रमोंके धर्मोका साधन करनेसे गृहस्थ, ब्रह्मचारी, वानप्रस्थ तथा यति-- ये सभी साधु कहे गये हैं॥ ८१०१/२ ॥ धर्म तथा अधर्म-ये दोनों शब्द क्रियाके वाचक कहे गये हैं। कुशल कर्मको धर्म तथा अकुशल कर्मको अधर्म कहा गया है॥ ११ .॥
verses.wordMeaning: The yogic siddhis pertaining to the air are: (1) ability to move as fast as the mind; (2) ability to enter the bodies of living beings; (3 ) ability to hold weighty things like mountains on shoulders; (4) lightness, (5) weightiness, (6) holding the air with palms;…
verses.commentary: Sense: The yogic siddhis pertaining to the air are: (1) ability to move as fast as the mind; (2) ability to enter the bodies of living beings; (3 ) ability to hold weighty things like mountains on shoulders; (4) lightness, (5) weightiness, (6) holding the air with palms;…

verses.sanskrit: बुद्धिर्विवेचना वेद्यं बुध्यते बुद्धिरुच्यते सूक्ष्मे व्यवहिते ऽतीते विप्रकृष्टे त्वनागते
verses.transliteration: buddhirvivecanā vedyaṃ budhyate buddhirucyate sūkṣme vyavahite 'tīte viprakṛṣṭe tvanāgate
verses.translation: Ability (1) to have no shadow of oneself; (2) to see the subtle elements; (3) to walk over the ether; (4) to have the objects of desire at will; (5) to hear sound from a distance, (6) to comprehend all types of sounds; (7) to have a body composed only of subtle elements and (8) to see all li\'ing
verses.hindi: मह्तायुक्त यह धर्म शब्द धारणके अर्थमें कहा गया है तथा अधारण (धारण न करने)-को उद्देश्य करके कृत कर्म अधर्म कहा जाता है॥ १२/२॥ विनम्र, सरल स्वभाववाले लोगोंको आचार्य कहा जाता है
verses.wordMeaning: Ability (1) to have no shadow of oneself; (2) to see the subtle elements; (3) to walk over the ether; (4) to have the objects of desire at will; (5) to hear sound from a distance, (6) to comprehend all types of sounds;…
verses.commentary: Sense: Ability (1) to have no shadow of oneself; (2) to see the subtle elements; (3) to walk over the ether; (4) to have the objects of desire at will; (5) to hear sound from a distance, (6) to comprehend all types of sounds;…

verses.sanskrit: सर्वत्र सर्वदा ज्ञानं प्रतिभानुक्रमेण तु श्रवणात्सर्वशब्दानाम् अप्रयत्नेन योगिनः
verses.transliteration: sarvatra sarvadā jñānaṃ pratibhānukrameṇa tu śravaṇātsarvaśabdānām aprayatnena yoginaḥ
verses.translation: Ability (to acquire whatever he desires), (2) to wander wherever he pleases, (3) to overpower all. '4) to perceive all secret things, ( 5) to create according to desire, (6) to bring others under control, (7) to see things at will, (8) to perceive the whole world — these arc the powers pertaining to the mind in the region of the moon.
verses.hindi: जो स्वयं आचरण करता है तथा सभीको आचारमें योगसिद्धिप्राप्त पुरुषोंके लक्षण ”“भक्तिभावमें श्रद्धाकी महत्ता
verses.wordMeaning: Ability (to acquire whatever he desires), (2) to wander wherever he pleases, (3) to overpower all. '4) to perceive all secret things, ( 5) to create according to desire, (6) to bring others under control, (7) to see things at will,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Ability (to acquire whatever he desires), (2) to wander wherever he pleases, (3) to overpower all. '4) to perceive all secret things, ( 5) to create according to desire, (6) to bring others under control, (7) to see things at will,…

verses.sanskrit: ह्रस्वदीर्घप्लुतादीनां गुह्यानां श्रवणादपि स्पर्शस्याधिगमो यस् तु वेदना तूपपादिता
verses.transliteration: hrasvadīrghaplutādīnāṃ guhyānāṃ śravaṇādapi sparśasyādhigamo yas tu vedanā tūpapāditā
verses.translation: Ability to cut, (2) strike, (3) bind, (4) create and (5) destroy, (6) bless, (7) conquer time and (8) death — these are the qualities pertaining to the ego in these regions of Prajapati.
verses.hindi: विज्ञेयं श्रवणाच्छौतं स्मरणात्स्मार्तमुच्यते ब्रह्मचर्य तथा मौनं निराहारत्वमेव च
verses.wordMeaning: Ability to cut, (2) strike, (3) bind, (4) create and (5) destroy, (6) bless, (7) conquer time and (8) death — these are the qualities pertaining to the ego in these regions of Prajapati.
verses.commentary: Sense: Ability to cut, (2) strike, (3) bind, (4) create and (5) destroy, (6) bless, (7) conquer time and (8) death — these are the qualities pertaining to the ego in these regions of Prajapati.

verses.sanskrit: दर्शनाद्दिव्यरूपाणां दर्शनं चाप्रयत्नतः संविद्दिव्यरसे तस्मिन्न् आस्वादो ह्यप्रयत्नतः
verses.transliteration: darśanāddivyarūpāṇāṃ darśanaṃ cāprayatnataḥ saṃviddivyarase tasminn āsvādo hyaprayatnataḥ
verses.translation: The following powers pertain to Brahma — ( 1 ) creation of the world by mere conception, (2) protection, (3) dissolution, (4) exercise of authority, (5; functioning the world at will, (6) dissimilarity with all, (7) creating separately aP things and (8) the creatorship of the universe.
verses.hindi: कारुण्यात्सर्वभूतेभ्यः संविभागस्तु मध्यमः। ्रुतिस्मृतिभ्यां विहितो धर्मो वर्णाश्रमात्मकः शिष्टाचाराविरुद्धशच स धर्मः साधुरुच्यते। मायाकर्मफलत्यागी शिवात्मा परिकीर्तितः
verses.wordMeaning: The following powers pertain to Brahma — ( 1 ) creation of the world by mere conception, (2) protection, (3) dissolution, (4) exercise of authority, (5; functioning the world at will, (6) dissimilarity with all,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The following powers pertain to Brahma — ( 1 ) creation of the world by mere conception, (2) protection, (3) dissolution, (4) exercise of authority, (5; functioning the world at will, (6) dissimilarity with all,…

verses.sanskrit: वार्त्ता च दिव्यगन्धानां तन्मात्रा बुद्धिसंविदा विन्दन्ते योगिनस्तस्माद् आब्रह्मभुवनं द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: vārttā ca divyagandhānāṃ tanmātrā buddhisaṃvidā vindante yoginastasmād ābrahmabhuvanaṃ dvijāḥ
verses.translation: The power greater than and beyond this is the one pertaining to Visnu. It is the source of the power of Brahma. It can be understood by Brahma alone and not by others.
verses.hindi: निवृत्तः सर्वसङ्गेभ्यो युक्तो योगी प्रकीर्तित:। असक्तो भयतो यस्तु विषयेषु विचार्यं च नियोजित करता है एवं शास्त्रोंके अर्थाका परिशीलन करता है; वह आचार्य कहा जाता है॥ १५/२ ॥
verses.wordMeaning: The power greater than and beyond this is the one pertaining to Visnu. It is the source of the power of Brahma. It can be understood by Brahma alone and not by others.
verses.commentary: Sense: The power greater than and beyond this is the one pertaining to Visnu. It is the source of the power of Brahma. It can be understood by Brahma alone and not by others.

verses.sanskrit: जगत्यस्मिन् हि देहस्थं चतुःषष्टिगुणं समम् औपसर्गिकम् एतेषु गुणेषु गुणितं द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: jagatyasmin hi dehasthaṃ catuḥṣaṣṭiguṇaṃ samam aupasargikam eteṣu guṇeṣu guṇitaṃ dvijāḥ
verses.translation: There is another greater power pertaining to Siva. It is not understood even by Visnu. Who else can know lord Siva — the pure entity possessed of many qualities.®®
verses.hindi: वेदोंका श्रवण करनेसे श्रौत तथा शास्त्रोंके अर्थांका स्मरण करनेसे स्मार्त कहा जाता है। वेदविहित यज्ञ आदि करनेवाला श्रौत तथा वर्णाश्रमसम्बन्धी नियमोंका पालन करनेवाला स्मार्त कहा जाता है॥ १६ /२॥ किसीके द्वारा पूछनेपर देखे गये अनुरूप (कथनयोग्य) तथा अननुरूप (कथनके अयोग्य) विषयको बिना छिपाये अभिव्यक्त करनेको लिङ्गपुराणके अनुसार सत्य कहा गया है॥ १७/२॥
verses.wordMeaning: There is another greater power pertaining to Siva. It is not understood even by Visnu. Who else can know lord Siva — the pure entity possessed of many qualities.®®
verses.commentary: Sense: There is another greater power pertaining to Siva. It is not understood even by Visnu. Who else can know lord Siva — the pure entity possessed of many qualities.®®

verses.sanskrit: संत्याज्यं सर्वथा सर्वम् औपसर्गिकमात्मनः पैशाचे पार्थिवं चाप्यं राक्षसानां पुरे द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: saṃtyājyaṃ sarvathā sarvam aupasargikamātmanaḥ paiśāce pārthivaṃ cāpyaṃ rākṣasānāṃ pure dvijāḥ
verses.translation: In the course of practising yogic exercises® these impe- diments in the form of attainments do often take place. The impediments should be checked assiduously by complete detachment.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्मचर्य, मौन, निराहार, अहिंसा तथा सर्वविध शान्तिको तप कहा गया है॥ १८/२ ॥ जो पुरुष सदा अपने ही हित तथा अहितकी भाँति सभी प्राणियोंके हिताहितका ध्यान रखता है; उसको यह
verses.wordMeaning: In the course of practising yogic exercises® these impe- diments in the form of attainments do often take place. The impediments should be checked assiduously by complete detachment.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the course of practising yogic exercises® these impe- diments in the form of attainments do often take place. The impediments should be checked assiduously by complete detachment.

verses.sanskrit: याक्षे तु तैजसं प्रोक्तं गान्धर्वे श्वसनात्मकम् ऐन्द्रे व्योमात्मकं सर्वं सौम्ये चैव तु मानसम्
verses.transliteration: yākṣe tu taijasaṃ proktaṃ gāndharve śvasanātmakam aindre vyomātmakaṃ sarvaṃ saumye caiva tu mānasam
verses.translation: Knowing that worldly pleasures are highly ruinous, the detached yogin should eschew everything without the least sense of fear.
verses.hindi: क्रमसे न्यायपूर्वक अर्जित अभीष्टतम द्रव्य गुणीको ही दिया जाना चाहिए। दाताके द्वारा प्रदत्त दानका यही लक्षण है। बह दान भी कनिष्ठ, मध्यम तथा श्रेष्ठ-तीन प्रकारका होता है। करुणापूर्वक सभी प्राणियोंके निमित्त धनका विभाग करना मध्यम दान है॥ २०-२१/२॥
verses.wordMeaning: Knowing that worldly pleasures are highly ruinous, the detached yogin should eschew everything without the least sense of fear.
verses.commentary: Sense: Knowing that worldly pleasures are highly ruinous, the detached yogin should eschew everything without the least sense of fear.

verses.sanskrit: प्राजापत्ये त्वहङ्कारं ब्राह्मे बोधमनुत्तमम् आद्ये चाष्टौ द्वितीये च तथा षोडशरूपकम्
verses.transliteration: prājāpatye tvahaṅkāraṃ brāhme bodhamanuttamam ādye cāṣṭau dvitīye ca tathā ṣoḍaśarūpakam
verses.translation: Absence of desire is, indeed, commendable. It is through the absence of yearning for the attainment of powers
verses.hindi: श्रुतियों तथा स्मृतियोंसे विहित वर्णाश्रमसम्बन्धी तथा शिष्टाचारके अनुकूल जो धर्म है, वह साधुधर्म कहा जाता है॥ २२ /२॥ मायायुक्त कर्मफलका त्याग करनेवाला शिवात्मा कहा जाता है तथा सभी आसक्तियोंसे निवृत्त प्राणी युक्त-योगी कहा जाता है॥ २३/२॥
verses.wordMeaning: Absence of desire is, indeed, commendable. It is through the absence of yearning for the attainment of powers
verses.commentary: Sense: Absence of desire is, indeed, commendable. It is through the absence of yearning for the attainment of powers

verses.sanskrit: चतुर्विंशत्तृतीये तु द्वात्रिंशच्च चतुर्थके चत्वारिंशत् पञ्चमे तु भूतमात्रात्मकं स्मृतम्
verses.transliteration: caturviṃśattṛtīye tu dvātriṃśacca caturthake catvāriṃśat pañcame tu bhūtamātrātmakaṃ smṛtam
verses.translation: It refers to the eternal transcendent spirit placed in the twenty- seventh category beyond the influence of sattva, rajas and tamas, and re- garded as higher than the highest. Gf.
verses.hindi: अनासक्त तथा पुनः-पुनः जन्म-मृत्युके भयसे भीत होकर विषयभोगोंकी नश्वरतापर विचार करके सभी ओरसे प्रलोभन दिये जानेपर भी जो अलुब्ध बना रहता है, वह संयमी कहा जाता है॥ २४/२॥ अपने लिये अथवा दूसरेके लिये जिस व्यक्तिको इन्द्रियाँ मिथ्या प्रवृत्त नहीं होतीं, वह शमके लक्षणोंवाला कहा जाता है॥ २५ /२॥
verses.wordMeaning: It refers to the eternal transcendent spirit placed in the twenty- seventh category beyond the influence of sattva, rajas and tamas, and re- garded as higher than the highest. Gf.
verses.commentary: Sense: It refers to the eternal transcendent spirit placed in the twenty- seventh category beyond the influence of sattva, rajas and tamas, and re- garded as higher than the highest. Gf.

verses.sanskrit: गन्धो रसस् तथा रूपं शब्दः स्पर्शस्तथैव च प्रत्येकमष्टधा सिद्धं पञ्चमे तच्छतक्रतोः
verses.transliteration: gandho rasas tathā rūpaṃ śabdaḥ sparśastathaiva ca pratyekamaṣṭadhā siddhaṃ pañcame tacchatakratoḥ
verses.translation: ST. The sixtyfour attainments (siddhaya) are useful from the materialistic point of view but they are obstacles (upa- sargas) to yoga.
verses.hindi: जो अनिष्ट अर्थात् प्रतिकूल विषयोंपर उद्विग्न प्रीतितापविषादेभ्यो प्रोतितापविषादेभ्यो वितिवत्तिर्विरक्तता।  नहीं होता तथा अनुकूल विषयोंकी प्राप्तिपर हृ ००९ । संन्यासः कर्मणां न्यासः कृतानामकृतैः सह
verses.wordMeaning: ST. The sixtyfour attainments (siddhaya) are useful from the materialistic point of view but they are obstacles (upa- sargas) to yoga.
verses.commentary: Sense: ST. The sixtyfour attainments (siddhaya) are useful from the materialistic point of view but they are obstacles (upa- sargas) to yoga.

verses.sanskrit: तथाष्टचत्वारिंशच् च षट्पञ्चाशत्तथैव च चतुःषष्टिगुणं ब्राह्मं लभते द्विजसत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: tathāṣṭacatvāriṃśac ca ṣaṭpañcāśattathaiva ca catuḥṣaṣṭiguṇaṃ brāhmaṃ labhate dvijasattamāḥ
verses.translation: In all the worlds, upto the world ol Brahma, one should avoid obstacles. (Ihecking up all desires one should totally abandon them. The great lord is delighted thereby.
verses.hindi: अव्यक्ताद्यविशेषान्ते विकारेऽस्मिन्नचेतने एवं तु ज्ञानयुक्तस्य श्रद्धायुक्तस्य शङ्करः
verses.wordMeaning: In all the worlds, upto the world ol Brahma, one should avoid obstacles. (Ihecking up all desires one should totally abandon them. The great lord is delighted thereby.
verses.commentary: Sense: In all the worlds, upto the world ol Brahma, one should avoid obstacles. (Ihecking up all desires one should totally abandon them. The great lord is delighted thereby.

verses.sanskrit: औपसर्गिकम् आ ब्रह्म भुवनेषु परित्यजेत् लोकेष्वालोक्य योगेन योगवित्परमं सुखम्
verses.transliteration: aupasargikam ā brahma bhuvaneṣu parityajet lokeṣvālokya yogena yogavitparamaṃ sukham
verses.translation: When the lord is delighted liberation becomes easy to attain, by virtue of complete detachment. In some cases, a sage (after getting His grace) may roam about without eschewing the Siddhis for the sake of blessing others or for mere sport. I'hen also he can be happy.
verses.hindi: प्रसीदति न सन्देहो धर्मश्चायं द्विजोत्तमाः। किं तु गुह्यतमं वक्ष्ये सर्वत्र परमेश्वरे अयोग्यस्यापि भगवान् भक्तस्य परमेश्वरः
verses.wordMeaning: When the lord is delighted liberation becomes easy to attain, by virtue of complete detachment. In some cases, a sage (after getting His grace) may roam about without eschewing the Siddhis for the sake of blessing others or for mere sport. I'hen also he can be happy.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the lord is delighted liberation becomes easy to attain, by virtue of complete detachment. In some cases, a sage (after getting His grace) may roam about without eschewing the Siddhis for the sake of blessing others or for mere sport. I'hen also he can be happy.

verses.sanskrit: स्थूलता ह्रस्वता बाल्यं वार्धक्यं यौवनं तथा नानाजातिस्वरूपं च चतुर्भिर् देहधारणम्
verses.transliteration: sthūlatā hrasvatā bālyaṃ vārdhakyaṃ yauvanaṃ tathā nānājātisvarūpaṃ ca caturbhir dehadhāraṇam
verses.translation: The knower of the yoga can perceive thousands of images of devas and their splendid aerial chariots. Everything can conic within the range of his ken.
verses.hindi: ज्ञानमध्यापनं होमो ध्यानं यज्ञस्तपः श्रुतम् चान्द्रायणसहस्रैशच प्राजापत्यशतेस्तथा
verses.wordMeaning: The knower of the yoga can perceive thousands of images of devas and their splendid aerial chariots. Everything can conic within the range of his ken.
verses.commentary: Sense: The knower of the yoga can perceive thousands of images of devas and their splendid aerial chariots. Everything can conic within the range of his ken.

verses.sanskrit: पार्थिवांशं विना नित्यं सुरभिर् गन्धसंयुतः एतदष्टगुणं प्रोक्तम् ऐश्वर्यं पार्थिवं महत्
verses.transliteration: pārthivāṃśaṃ vinā nityaṃ surabhir gandhasaṃyutaḥ etadaṣṭaguṇaṃ proktam aiśvaryaṃ pārthivaṃ mahat
verses.translation: He can sec Brahma, Vi.snU; India, Yanui, Agni, Vaiunaand other deities. He can see thollan(ls of planets, siai and luminaries as well as their regions.
verses.hindi: मासोपवासैश्चान्यैर्वा भक्तिर्मुनिवरोत्तमाः। अभक्ता भगवत्यस्मिंल्लोके गिरिगुहाशये भक्तानां दर्शनादेव नृणां स्वर्गादयो द्विजाः
verses.wordMeaning: He can sec Brahma, Vi.snU; India, Yanui, Agni, Vaiunaand other deities. He can see thollan(ls of planets, siai and luminaries as well as their regions.
verses.commentary: Sense: He can sec Brahma, Vi.snU; India, Yanui, Agni, Vaiunaand other deities. He can see thollan(ls of planets, siai and luminaries as well as their regions.

verses.sanskrit: जले निवसनं यद्वद् भूम्यामिव विनिर्गमः इच्छेच्छक्तः स्वयं पातुं समुद्रमपि नातुरः
verses.transliteration: jale nivasanaṃ yadvad bhūmyāmiva vinirgamaḥ icchecchaktaḥ svayaṃ pātuṃ samudramapi nāturaḥ
verses.translation: Entering the slate of ecstatic tiaucc he can st'c the dwellers of nether regions. He can dispe l darkness ( -igno- rance) by the steady influx of liis inmost spiiitnal light glowing with divine grace and characterized by goodi.ess — which he can sec within himself.
verses.hindi: नहीं होता तथा अनुकूल विषयोंकी प्राप्तिपर हर्षित न होता; वह प्रीति, संताप तथा विषादसे रहित हो है। उसकी यह विनिवृत्ति ही विरक्तता (विराग) कह जाती है॥ २६ /२॥ निषिद्ध कर्मोसहित विहित कर्मोमें दोष-गुण न्यास (त्याग) ही संन्यास है और इष्ट और कर्मोका भलीभाँति छोड़ना ही न्यास है॥ २७१,
verses.wordMeaning: Entering the slate of ecstatic tiaucc he can st'c the dwellers of nether regions. He can dispe l darkness ( -igno- rance) by the steady influx of liis inmost spiiitnal light glowing with divine grace and characterized by goodi.ess — which he can sec within himself.
verses.commentary: Sense: Entering the slate of ecstatic tiaucc he can st'c the dwellers of nether regions. He can dispe l darkness ( -igno- rance) by the steady influx of liis inmost spiiitnal light glowing with divine grace and characterized by goodi.ess — which he can sec within himself.

verses.sanskrit: यत्रेच्छति जगत्यस्मिंस् तत्रास्य जलदर्शनम् यद्यद्वस्तु समादाय भोक्तुमिच्छति कामतः
verses.transliteration: yatrecchati jagatyasmiṃs tatrāsya jaladarśanam yadyadvastu samādāya bhoktumicchati kāmataḥ
verses.translation: No doubt need be entertained that by virluc of His grace, one can attain Dharma, riches, knowledge, dctach- mtiil and salvation. The details of his grace, one cannot describe even in ten thou.sands of years. O leading sages, one should steadily adhere to the yoga pertaining to lord Siva.

verses.sanskrit: श्रौतस्मार्ताविरुद्धानां प्रसीदति महेश्वरः सदिति ब्रह्मणः शब्दस् तदन्ते ये लभन्त्युत
verses.transliteration: śrautasmārtāviruddhānāṃ prasīdati maheśvaraḥ saditi brahmaṇaḥ śabdas tadante ye labhantyuta
verses.translation: Adharma, as taught by the preceptors, is one that has as its fruit what is not desired. They call those persons Acyas (preceptors) who are elderly, not greedy and self-possessed; devoid of arrogance, well disciplined, and straight forward. He who practises (Dharma) himself who establishes others in dharma and who gathers together the meanings of the scrip- tural texts is called acarya. What should be known or what is worthy of knowledge is irauta if it is heard and smarta if it is remembered.
verses.hindi: ध्यायता पुत्रकामेन यस्मात्तेऽहं पितामह॥ दृष्टः परमया भक्त्या स्तुतश्च ब्रह्मपूर्वकम्।

verses.transliteration: sāyujyaṃ brahmaṇo yāti tena santaḥ pracakṣate daśātmake ye viṣaye sādhane cāṣṭalakṣaṇe
verses.translation: A sacrifice when it pertains to Vedas is called srauta, and when it pertains to the varna4ramas is called smarta. One who has found truth and does not hide it when asked for, is called an acarya. Truth, as defined in this purana, is the statement of facts exactly in the manner seen. Tapas (penance) constitutes celibacy, silence, observance of fast, abstention from injury of all sorts and quiescence. When a person behaves towards all living beings like unto himself®® both for welfare or otherwise that attitude is called kindness. Whatever one has obtained by justifiable means, whatever one likes the most, should be given to a meritorious person. This is the characteristic feature of the charitable gift of the donor. Charitable gift is of three types viz. — the lowliest, the highest and the middling.
verses.hindi: वेत्स्यसे मां प्रसंख्यातं लोकधातारमीश्वरम्। ततस्तस्य महात्मानश्चत्वारस्ते कुमारकाः ॥

The rites laid down by Srutis and Smrtis in regard to persons of different stages in life and castes constitute dharma. Dharma that does not come into clash with the conduct of the persons of disciplined life is held to be righteous.

verses.transliteration: brahmakṣatraviśo yasmād yuktāstasmāddvijātayaḥ varṇāśrameṣu yuktasya svargādisukhakāriṇaḥ
verses.translation: The eschewal of both joy and misery is called Nyasa. All created things from the unmanifcst to the manifest gross elements are insentient. Perfect Knowledge is the discrimination between the sentient and the insentient. Lord Siva, no doubt, bestows his grace on him who is endowed with such perfect knowledge. So also dharma bestows grace. Yet I shall tell you a great secret. One who is endowed with devotion lo the lord is undoubtedly liberated. It is certain that lord Siva checks the different sorts of delusion of the devotee and is delighted with him even if he (the devotee) lacks full accomplishments for yoga.
verses.hindi: ततो वर्षसहस्रान्ते ब्रह्मत्वेःध्यवसायिन: सूतजी बोले--तीसवाँ कल्प रक्तकल्पके नम प्रसिद्ध है। महान् तेजस्वी ब्रह्मने उस कल्पमें रक्तका धारण किया था
verses.wordMeaning: The eschewal of both joy and misery is called Nyasa. All created things from the unmanifcst to the manifest gross elements are insentient. Perfect Knowledge is the discrimination between the sentient and the insentient. Lord Siva, no doubt,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The eschewal of both joy and misery is called Nyasa. All created things from the unmanifcst to the manifest gross elements are insentient. Perfect Knowledge is the discrimination between the sentient and the insentient. Lord Siva, no doubt,…

verses.sanskrit: श्रौतस्मार्तस्य धर्मस्य ज्ञानाद्धर्मज्ञ उच्यते विद्यायाः साधनात्साधुब्रह्मचारी गुरोर्हितः
verses.transliteration: śrautasmārtasya dharmasya jñānāddharmajña ucyate vidyāyāḥ sādhanātsādhubrahmacārī gurorhitaḥ
verses.translation: Perfect knowledge, teaching of the Vedas, offerings to the gods, meditation, sacrifices, penance, charitable gifts, study of the Vedas, all these undoubtedly contribute to the devotion of Lord Siva. O excellent sages, devotion results from thousands of Gandrayanas,* hundreds of Pr5japatyas, monthly fasts and other holy rites. Those who lack in devotion to the lord fall into a mountain cave and undergo the results
verses.hindi: पुत्रको कामनासे ध्यानरत परमेष्ठी ब्रह्माजीके समक्ष एक महातेजस्वी तथा प्रतापी कुमार प्रकट हुआ। वह रक्तवर्णके भूषण, रक्तवर्णकी माला तथा रक्तवर्णके वस्त्र धारण किये हुए था तथा उसके नेत्र भी रक्तवर्णके लाल वस्त्र धारण किये उस महात्मा कुमारको देखकर ब्रह्माजीने परम ध्यानयोगसे यह जान लिया कि यह कुमार तो साक्षात् देवेश्वर है॥ ३१/२ ॥
verses.wordMeaning: Perfect knowledge, teaching of the Vedas, offerings to the gods, meditation, sacrifices, penance, charitable gifts, study of the Vedas, all these undoubtedly contribute to the devotion of Lord Siva. O excellent sages,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Perfect knowledge, teaching of the Vedas, offerings to the gods, meditation, sacrifices, penance, charitable gifts, study of the Vedas, all these undoubtedly contribute to the devotion of Lord Siva. O excellent sages,…

verses.sanskrit: क्रियाणां साधनाच्चैव गृहस्थः साधुरुच्यते साधनात्तपसो ऽरण्ये साधुर्वैखानसः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: kriyāṇāṃ sādhanāccaiva gṛhasthaḥ sādhurucyate sādhanāttapaso 'raṇye sādhurvaikhānasaḥ smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: CandrSyaiia: Of. Y&jiiavaikya 3. 324 ct ssq; Manu 11.217, It is a religious observance or expiatory penance regulated by the period of the moon's waxing and waning. Herein the daily quantity of fo oonsistiiig of fifteen mouthfuls at the full moon is diminished by one mouthful every day during the dark fortnight tilt It is increased an like manner during the bright fortnight.
verses.hindi: उन्हें प्रणाम करके आत्मजित् भगवान् ब्रह्मो वामदेवसंज्ञक उन परमेश्वरको साक्षात् ब्रह्मस्वरूप कल्पित तत्पश्चात् ब्रह्माजीके द्वारा अनेकविध स्तुति किये जानेपर प्रसन्नहृदय परमेश्वर महादेवने उन पितामहसे यह कहा॥ ५९/. ॥
verses.wordMeaning: CandrSyaiia: Of. Y&jiiavaikya 3. 324 ct ssq; Manu 11.217, It is a religious observance or expiatory penance regulated by the period of the moon's waxing and waning.…
verses.commentary: Sense: CandrSyaiia: Of. Y&jiiavaikya 3. 324 ct ssq; Manu 11.217, It is a religious observance or expiatory penance regulated by the period of the moon's waxing and waning.…

verses.sanskrit: यतमानो यतिः साधुः स्मृतो योगस्य साधनात् एवमाश्रमधर्माणां साधनात्साधवः स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: yatamāno yatiḥ sādhuḥ smṛto yogasya sādhanāt evamāśramadharmāṇāṃ sādhanātsādhavaḥ smṛtāḥ
verses.translation: Prkjkpatya: It is a religious fiut or penance. Herein one shall Uke food for three days in the momiog, for three days in the evening, and thereafter shall abstain from food for three days.
verses.hindi: हे पितामह! पुत्रकी कामनासे ध्यानपरायण आपने मेरा दर्शन प्राप्त किया और परम भक्तिसे ब्रह्म अर्थात् वामदेवाय” मन्त्र पूर्वमे लगाकर अनेक स्तुतियोंसे मेरा स्तवन किया। अतएव आप प्रयत्नपूर्वक ध्यानबलका आश्रय लेकर कल्प-कल्पमें मुझ सर्वश्रेष्ठ तथा लोकके आधारस्वरूप परमेश्वरको भलीभाँति जानेंगे ॥ ६-७१/२॥
verses.wordMeaning: Prkjkpatya: It is a religious fiut or penance. Herein one shall Uke food for three days in the momiog, for three days in the evening, and thereafter shall abstain from food for three days.
verses.commentary: Sense: Prkjkpatya: It is a religious fiut or penance. Herein one shall Uke food for three days in the momiog, for three days in the evening, and thereafter shall abstain from food for three days.

verses.sanskrit: गृहस्थो ब्रह्मचारी च वानप्रस्थो यतिस् तथा धर्माधर्माविह प्रोक्तौ शब्दावेतौ क्रियात्मकौ
verses.transliteration: gṛhastho brahmacārī ca vānaprastho yatis tathā dharmādharmāviha proktau śabdāvetau kriyātmakau
verses.translation: (.) brahmins, thetic words were spoken by ihe lord to
verses.hindi: इसके अनन्तर ब्रह्माजीके विरजा, विबाहु, विशोक तथा विश्वभावन नामवाले चार और कुमार उत्पन्न हुए। वे सभी कुमार महान्, विशुद्ध आत्मावाले तथा ब्रहातेजसे सम्पन्न थे वे सभी कुमार ब्रह्मनिष्ठ, ब्रह्मातुल्य, वीर तथा अध्यवसायी थे। वे रक्तवर्णके वस्त्र तथा रक्तवर्णकी मालासे विभूषित थे। उनके शरीरमें लाल कुमकुम तथा लाल भस्म लगा हुआ था॥ १० २ ॥
verses.wordMeaning: (.) brahmins, thetic words were spoken by ihe lord to
verses.commentary: Sense: (.) brahmins, thetic words were spoken by ihe lord to

verses.sanskrit: कुशलाकुशलं कर्म धर्माधर्माविति स्मृतौ धारणार्थे महान् ह्य् एष धर्मशब्दः प्रकीर्तितः
verses.transliteration: kuśalākuśalaṃ karma dharmādharmāviti smṛtau dhāraṇārthe mahān hy eṣa dharmaśabdaḥ prakīrtitaḥ
verses.translation: (.) brahmins, thetic words were spoken by ihe lord to
verses.hindi: तत्पश्चात् एक हजार वर्षके अनन्तर ब्रह्मभावमें अध्याय १३ पीतवासाकल्पमें शिवस्वरूप भगवान् तत्पुरुषका प्रादुर्भाव तथा उनका माहात्म्य
verses.wordMeaning: (.) brahmins, thetic words were spoken by ihe lord to
verses.commentary: Sense: (.) brahmins, thetic words were spoken by ihe lord to

verses.sanskrit: अधारणे महत्त्वे च अधर्म इति चोच्यते अत्रेष्टप्रापको धर्म आचार्यैरुपदिश्यते
verses.transliteration: adhāraṇe mahattve ca adharma iti cocyate atreṣṭaprāpako dharma ācāryairupadiśyate

verses.hindi: फ्फकफफफफ क कफ पफ फा का फा फा फ फ क फ फ फ फ क फ फ़ फ फ़ फ फक फक फक फ फ फ क फ फफ फफफ गृणन्तश्च महात्मानो ब्रह्म तद्वामहैविकम्। अनुग्रहार्थ लोकानां शिष्याणां हितकाम्यया
verses.wordMeaning: (.) brahmins, thetic words were spoken by ihe lord to
verses.commentary: Sense: (.) brahmins, thetic words were spoken by ihe lord to

verses.sanskrit: अधर्मश्चानिष्टफलो ह्य् आचार्यैरुपदिश्यते वृद्धाश्चालोलुपाश्चैव आत्मवन्तो ह्यदाम्भिकाः
verses.transliteration: adharmaścāniṣṭaphalo hy ācāryairupadiśyate vṛddhāścālolupāścaiva ātmavanto hyadāmbhikāḥ
verses.translation: (.) brahmins, thetic words were spoken by ihe lord to
verses.hindi: धर्मोपदेशमखिलं कृत्वा ते ब्रह्मणः प्रियाः। पुनरेव महादेवं प्रविष्टा रुद्रमव्ययम् प्रपश्यन्ति महादेवं तद्भक्तास्तत्परायणाः
verses.wordMeaning: (.) brahmins, thetic words were spoken by ihe lord to
verses.commentary: Sense: (.) brahmins, thetic words were spoken by ihe lord to

verses.sanskrit: सम्यग्विनीता ऋजवस् तानाचार्यान् प्रचक्षते स्वयमाचरते यस्माद् आचारे स्थापयत्यपि
verses.transliteration: samyagvinītā ṛjavas tānācāryān pracakṣate svayamācarate yasmād ācāre sthāpayatyapi
verses.translation: (.) brahmins, thetic words were spoken by ihe lord to
verses.hindi: ते सर्वे पापनिर्मुक्ता विमला ब्रह्मचारिणः। लीन वे सभी ब्रह्मप्रिय महात्मा कुमार उस वामदेवरूप ब्रह्मका चिन्तन करते हुए लोकके अनुग्रह तथा शिष्योंके कल्याणकी कामनासे सम्पूर्ण धर्मांका उपदेश करके पुनः शाश्वत महादेव रुद्रमें समाविष्ट हो गये
verses.wordMeaning: (.) brahmins, thetic words were spoken by ihe lord to
verses.commentary: Sense: (.) brahmins, thetic words were spoken by ihe lord to

verses.sanskrit: आचिनोति च शास्त्रार्थान् आचार्यस्तेन चोच्यते विज्ञेयं श्रवणाच्छ्रौतं स्मरणात्स्मार्तमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: ācinoti ca śāstrārthān ācāryastena cocyate vijñeyaṃ śravaṇācchrautaṃ smaraṇātsmārtamucyate
verses.translation: (.) brahmins, thetic words were spoken by ihe lord to
verses.hindi: हे श्रेष्ठ द्विजो! इसी प्रकार परमेश्वरपरायण अन्य जो भी भक्त समाधिसे ध्यान करके ब्रह्मरूप परमेश्वर वामदेवका दर्शन करेंगे; विमल आत्मावाले ब्रह्मनिष्ठ वे सभी भक्त पापसे छूटकर उस रुद्रलोकको प्राप्त होंगे, जहाँसे जीवका पुनः संसारमें आगमन नहीं
verses.wordMeaning: (.) brahmins, thetic words were spoken by ihe lord to
verses.commentary: Sense: (.) brahmins, thetic words were spoken by ihe lord to

verses.sanskrit: इज्या वेदात्मकं श्रौतं स्मार्तं वर्णाश्रमात्मकम् दृष्ट्वानुरूपमर्थं यः पृष्टो नैवापि गूहति
verses.transliteration: ijyā vedātmakaṃ śrautaṃ smārtaṃ varṇāśramātmakam dṛṣṭvānurūpamarthaṃ yaḥ pṛṣṭo naivāpi gūhati
verses.translation: (.) brahmins, thetic words were spoken by ihe lord to
verses.hindi: रुद्रलोकं गमिष्यन्ति पुनरावृत्तिदुर्लभम्॥ १५  होता पीतवासाकल्पमें शिवस्वरूप भगवान् तत्पुरुषका प्रादुर्भाव तथा उनका माहात्म्य
verses.wordMeaning: (.) brahmins, thetic words were spoken by ihe lord to
verses.commentary: Sense: (.) brahmins, thetic words were spoken by ihe lord to

verses.sanskrit: यथादृष्टप्रवादस्तु सत्यं लैङ्गे ऽत्र पठ्यते ब्रह्मचर्यं तथा मौनं निराहारत्वमेव च
verses.transliteration: yathādṛṣṭapravādastu satyaṃ laiṅge 'tra paṭhyate brahmacaryaṃ tathā maunaṃ nirāhāratvameva ca
verses.translation: (.) brahmins, thetic words were spoken by ihe lord to
verses.hindi: ब्रह्मा यत्र महाभागः पीतवासा बभूव ह ध्यायतः पुत्रकामस्य ब्रह्मणः परमेष्ठिनः।
verses.wordMeaning: (.) brahmins, thetic words were spoken by ihe lord to
verses.commentary: Sense: (.) brahmins, thetic words were spoken by ihe lord to

verses.sanskrit: अहिंसा सर्वतः शान्तिस् तप इत्यभिधीयते आत्मवत् सर्वभूतेषु यो हितायाहिताय च
verses.transliteration: ahiṃsā sarvataḥ śāntis tapa ityabhidhīyate ātmavat sarvabhūteṣu yo hitāyāhitāya ca
verses.translation: (.) brahmins, thetic words were spoken by ihe lord to
verses.hindi: हेमयज्ञोपवीतश्च पीतोष्णीषो महाभुजः तं दृष्ट्वा ध्यानसंयुक्तो ब्रह्मा लोकमहेश्वरम्। मनसा लोकधातारं प्रपेदे शरणं विभुम्
verses.wordMeaning: (.) brahmins, thetic words were spoken by ihe lord to
verses.commentary: Sense: (.) brahmins, thetic words were spoken by ihe lord to

verses.sanskrit: वर्तते त्वसकृद्वृत्तिः कृत्स्ना ह्येषा दया स्मृता यद्यदिष्टतमं द्रव्यं न्यायेनैवागतं क्रमात्
verses.transliteration: vartate tvasakṛdvṛttiḥ kṛtsnā hyeṣā dayā smṛtā yadyadiṣṭatamaṃ dravyaṃ nyāyenaivāgataṃ kramāt
verses.translation: (.) brahmins, thetic words were spoken by ihe lord to
verses.hindi: ततो ध्यानगतस्तत्र ब्रह्मा माहेश्वरीं वराम्। गां विश्वरूपां ददूशे महेश्वरमुखाच्च्युताम् स तां दृष्ट्वा महातेजा महादेवीं महेश्वरीम् ७
verses.wordMeaning: (.) brahmins, thetic words were spoken by ihe lord to
verses.commentary: Sense: (.) brahmins, thetic words were spoken by ihe lord to

verses.sanskrit: तत्तद्गुणवते देयं दातुस्तद्दानलक्षणम् दानं त्रिविधमित्येतत् कनिष्ठज्येष्ठमध्यमम्
verses.transliteration: tattadguṇavate deyaṃ dātustaddānalakṣaṇam dānaṃ trividhamityetat kaniṣṭhajyeṣṭhamadhyamam
verses.translation: (.) brahmins, thetic words were spoken by ihe lord to
verses.hindi: कल्प नामवाला कहा गया है, जिसमें महाभाग ब्रह्माने पीला वस्त्र धारण किया था पुत्रप्राप्तिकी कामनासे परमेश्वरके ध्यानमें रत परमेष्ठी ब्रह्माजीके समक्ष पीतवस्त्रधारी एक महातेजस्वी कुमार प्रकट हुआ। वह कुमार पीतवर्णको माला तथा पीत परिधान धारण किये हुए था। उस महान् भुजाओंवाले
verses.wordMeaning: (.) brahmins, thetic words were spoken by ihe lord to
verses.commentary: Sense: (.) brahmins, thetic words were spoken by ihe lord to

verses.sanskrit: कारुण्यात्सर्वभूतेभ्यः संविभागस्तु मध्यमः श्रुतिस्मृतिभ्यां विहितो धर्मो वर्णाश्रमात्मकः
verses.transliteration: kāruṇyātsarvabhūtebhyaḥ saṃvibhāgastu madhyamaḥ śrutismṛtibhyāṃ vihito dharmo varṇāśramātmakaḥ
verses.translation: (.) brahmins, thetic words were spoken by ihe lord to
verses.hindi: कुमारके अंगोंमें पीत वर्णका गन्ध लिप्त था तथा वह पीले वर्णकी पगड़ी और हेमवर्णके यज्ञोपवीतसे सुशोभित था ध्यानयुक्त होकर ब्रह्माजीने जब यह जान लिया कि ये जगत्के परमेश्वर हैं, तब वे हृदयसे लोकके आधाररूप प्रभु महेश्वरके शरणागत हो गये
verses.wordMeaning: (.) brahmins, thetic words were spoken by ihe lord to
verses.commentary: Sense: (.) brahmins, thetic words were spoken by ihe lord to

verses.sanskrit: शिष्टाचाराविरुद्धश् च स धर्मः साधुरुच्यते मायाकर्मफलत्यागी शिवात्मा परिकीर्तितः
verses.transliteration: śiṣṭācārāviruddhaś ca sa dharmaḥ sādhurucyate māyākarmaphalatyāgī śivātmā parikīrtitaḥ
verses.translation: (.) brahmins, thetic words were spoken by ihe lord to
verses.hindi: उसी समय ध्यानगत ब्रह्माजीने महेश्वरके मुखसे चार दाढ़ोंवाली, चार मुखोंवाली, बत्तीस गुणोंसे युक्त, सभी दिशाओंमें मुखवाली, ईश्वररूपिणी विश्वरूपा
verses.wordMeaning: (.) brahmins, thetic words were spoken by ihe lord to
verses.commentary: Sense: (.) brahmins, thetic words were spoken by ihe lord to

verses.sanskrit: निवृत्तः सर्वसङ्गेभ्यो युक्तो योगी प्रकीर्तितः असक्तो भयतो यस्तु विषयेषु विचार्य च

verses.hindi: इसी बीच महातेजस्वी ब्रह्माने कृष्णवर्णवाले, महान् वीर्यसम्मन्न, अपने तेजसे देदीप्यमान, कृष्णवर्णका वस्त्र- पगड़ी तथा यज्ञोपवीत धारण किये हुए, कृष्णमुकुटसे सुशोभित, कृष्णमाला धारण किये हुए तथा कृष्ण अंगरागसे अनुलिप्त अंगोंबाले एक कुमारको वहाँ प्रकट हुआ देखा
verses.wordMeaning: (.) brahmins, thetic words were spoken by ihe lord to
verses.commentary: Sense: (.) brahmins, thetic words were spoken by ihe lord to

verses.sanskrit: यथा त्वयाद्य वै पृष्टो द्रष्टुं ब्रह्मात्मकं त्वहम् श्वेते श्वेतेन वर्णेन दृष्ट्वा कल्पे तु मां शुभे
verses.transliteration: yathā tvayādya vai pṛṣṭo draṣṭuṃ brahmātmakaṃ tvaham śvete śvetena varṇena dṛṣṭvā kalpe tu māṃ śubhe
verses.translation: (.) brahmins, thetic words were spoken by ihe lord to
verses.hindi: उन घोर पराक्रमवाले महात्माको अधघोरसंज्ञक महादेव जानकर ब्रह्माजीने अद्भुत कृष्ण-पिंगल वर्णको आभासे युक्त उन देवदेवेशको प्रणाम किया तत्पश्चात् ध्यानयुक्त मनसे प्राणायामपरायण होकर तथा महेश्वरको हृदयमें धारणकर श्रीमान् ब्रह्माजी उन अघोररूप परमेश्वरके शरणागत हो गये और उन अघोरको ब्रह्मस्वरूप मानकर उनका ध्यान करने लगे।
verses.wordMeaning: (.) brahmins, thetic words were spoken by ihe lord to
verses.commentary: Sense: (.) brahmins, thetic words were spoken by ihe lord to

verses.sanskrit: सद्योजातं तथा रक्ते रक्तं वामं पितामहः पीते तत्पुरुषं पीतम् अघोरे कृष्णमीश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: sadyojātaṃ tathā rakte raktaṃ vāmaṃ pitāmahaḥ pīte tatpuruṣaṃ pītam aghore kṛṣṇamīśvaram
verses.translation: (.) brahmins, thetic words were spoken by ihe lord to
verses.hindi: तदनन्तर घोर पराक्रमवाले अघोर महादेवने उन ध्यानपरायण परमेष्ठी ब्रह्माको साक्षात् दर्शन दिया ॥७-८ /२॥ तदनन्तर उन अघोरके समीप कृष्ण, कृष्णशिख,
verses.wordMeaning: (.) brahmins, thetic words were spoken by ihe lord to
verses.commentary: Sense: (.) brahmins, thetic words were spoken by ihe lord to

verses.sanskrit: ईशानं विश्वरूपाख्यो विश्वरूपं तदाह माम्
verses.transliteration: īśānaṃ viśvarūpākhyo viśvarūpaṃ tadāha mām
verses.translation: (.) brahmins, thetic words were spoken by ihe lord to
verses.hindi: कफफकफफफफफफफफफफककफफफफफफफफफफफफफझफफफफफफफ फक फक फक कक वी री फफफफफफफफाफफफ पापमा £ फ़ फफफफ्फ्फफफ्रफफफफफ्रफ्फफफ्फ्फफ्फक्रफक्फक्््फफ्फ्फ्फफफफफ चत्वारस्तु महात्मानः सम्बभूवुः कुमारकाः।
verses.wordMeaning: (.) brahmins, thetic words were spoken by ihe lord to
verses.commentary: Sense: (.) brahmins, thetic words were spoken by ihe lord to

verses.sanskrit: वाम तत्पुरुषाघोर सद्योजात महेश्वर दृष्टो मया त्वं गायत्र्या देवदेव महेश्वर केन वश्यो महादेव ध्येयः कुत्र घृणानिधे
verses.transliteration: vāma tatpuruṣāghora sadyojāta maheśvara dṛṣṭo mayā tvaṃ gāyatryā devadeva maheśvara kena vaśyo mahādeva dhyeyaḥ kutra ghṛṇānidhe
verses.translation: (.) brahmins, thetic words were spoken by ihe lord to
verses.hindi: कृष्णः कृष्णशिखश्चैव कृष्णास्यः कृष्णवस्त्रधृक् ॥ १०  कुमार प्रादुर्भूत हुए, जो कृष्णवर्णके थे, कृष्णमालासे योगेन योगसम्पन्नाः प्रविश्य मनसा शिवम्। अमलं निर्गुणं स्थानं प्रविष्टा विश्वमीश्वरम्
verses.wordMeaning: (.) brahmins, thetic words were spoken by ihe lord to
verses.commentary: Sense: (.) brahmins, thetic words were spoken by ihe lord to

verses.sanskrit: दृश्यः पूज्यस् तथा देव्या वक्तुमर्हसि शङ्कर अवोचं श्रद्धयैवेति वश्यो वारिजसंभव
verses.transliteration: dṛśyaḥ pūjyas tathā devyā vaktumarhasi śaṅkara avocaṃ śraddhayaiveti vaśyo vārijasaṃbhava
verses.translation: (.) brahmins, thetic words were spoken by ihe lord to
verses.hindi: विभूषित थे और कृष्ण अंगरागसे अनुलिप्त थे एक हजार वर्षोतक योगपरायण होकर उन अघोर परमेशवरकी उपासना करके उन कुमारोंने पुनः अपने शिष्योंको महायोगका उपदेश प्रदान किया
verses.wordMeaning: (.) brahmins, thetic words were spoken by ihe lord to
verses.commentary: Sense: (.) brahmins, thetic words were spoken by ihe lord to

verses.sanskrit: ध्येयो लिङ्गे त्वया दृष्टे विष्णुना पयसां निधौ पूज्यः पञ्चास्यरूपेण पवित्रैः पञ्चभिर्द्विजैः
verses.transliteration: dhyeyo liṅge tvayā dṛṣṭe viṣṇunā payasāṃ nidhau pūjyaḥ pañcāsyarūpeṇa pavitraiḥ pañcabhirdvijaiḥ
verses.translation: (.) brahmins, thetic words were spoken by ihe lord to
verses.hindi: योगसम्पन्न वे सभी महात्मा मनसे शिवका ध्यानयोग करके महेशवरके निर्विकार, निर्गुण, विश्वरूप तथा ऐश्वर्यमय स्थानमें प्रविष्ट हुए इसी प्रकार और भी अन्य जो मनीषी इस योगके द्वारा महादेवका ध्यान करते हैं, वे अविनाशी भगवान्
verses.wordMeaning: (.) brahmins, thetic words were spoken by ihe lord to
verses.commentary: Sense: (.) brahmins, thetic words were spoken by ihe lord to

verses.sanskrit: भव भक्त्याद्य दृष्टो ऽहं त्वयाण्डज जगद्गुरो सो ऽपि मामाह भावार्थं दत्तं तस्मै मया पुरा
verses.transliteration: bhava bhaktyādya dṛṣṭo 'haṃ tvayāṇḍaja jagadguro so 'pi māmāha bhāvārthaṃ dattaṃ tasmai mayā purā
verses.translation: (.) brahmins, thetic words were spoken by ihe lord to
verses.hindi: चिन्तयन्ति महादेवं गन्तारो रुद्रमव्ययम्॥ १३  रुद्रके दिव्य लोकको प्राप्त होते हैं अघोरेशमाहात्म्य तथा अघोरमन्त्रके जपसे विविध पातकोंका विनाश
verses.wordMeaning: (.) brahmins, thetic words were spoken by ihe lord to
verses.commentary: Sense: (.) brahmins, thetic words were spoken by ihe lord to

verses.sanskrit: भावं भावेन देवेशि दृष्टवान्मां हृदीश्वरम् तस्मात्तु श्रद्धया वश्यो दृश्यः श्रेष्ठगिरेः सुते
verses.transliteration: bhāvaṃ bhāvena deveśi dṛṣṭavānmāṃ hṛdīśvaram tasmāttu śraddhayā vaśyo dṛśyaḥ śreṣṭhagireḥ sute
verses.translation: (.) brahmins, thetic words were spoken by ihe lord to
verses.hindi: ततस्तस्मिन् गते कल्पे कृष्णवर्णे भयानके। तुष्टाव देवदेवेशं ब्रह्मा तं ब्रह्मरूपिणम् अनुगृह्म ततस्तुष्टो ब्रह्माणमवदद्धरः । अनेनैव तु रूपेण संहरामि न संशयः
verses.wordMeaning: (.) brahmins, thetic words were spoken by ihe lord to
verses.commentary: Sense: (.) brahmins, thetic words were spoken by ihe lord to

verses.sanskrit: पूज्यो लिङ्गे न संदेहः सर्वदा श्रद्धया द्विजैः श्रद्धा धर्मः परः सूक्ष्मः श्रद्धा ज्ञानं हुतं तपः
verses.transliteration: pūjyo liṅge na saṃdehaḥ sarvadā śraddhayā dvijaiḥ śraddhā dharmaḥ paraḥ sūkṣmaḥ śraddhā jñānaṃ hutaṃ tapaḥ
verses.translation: (.) brahmins, thetic words were spoken by ihe lord to
verses.hindi: ब्रह्महत्यादिकान् घोरांस्तथान्यानपि पातकान्। हीनांश्चैव महाभाग तथैव विविधान्यपि उपपातकमप्येवं तथा पापानि सुव्रत। मानसानि सुतीक्ष्णानि वाचिकानि पितामह
verses.wordMeaning: (.) brahmins, thetic words were spoken by ihe lord to
verses.commentary: Sense: (.) brahmins, thetic words were spoken by ihe lord to

verses.sanskrit: श्रद्धा स्वर्गश् च मोक्षश् च दृश्यो ऽहं श्रद्धया सदा
verses.transliteration: śraddhā svargaś ca mokṣaś ca dṛśyo 'haṃ śraddhayā sadā
verses.translation: (.) brahmins, thetic words were spoken by ihe lord to
verses.hindi: कायिकानि सुमिश्राणि तथा प्रासङ्गिकानि च। बुद्धिपूर्वं कृतान्येव सहजागन्तुकानि च लक्षं जप्त्वा ह्यघोरेभ्यो ब्रह्महा मुच्यते प्रभो। तदर्धं वाचिके वत्स तदर्धं मानसे पुनः
verses.wordMeaning: (.) brahmins, thetic words were spoken by ihe lord to
verses.commentary: Sense: (.) brahmins, thetic words were spoken by ihe lord to

verses.sanskrit: कथं वै दृष्टवान्ब्रह्मा सद्योजातं महेश्वरम् वामदेवं महात्मानं पुराणपुरुषोत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: kathaṃ vai dṛṣṭavānbrahmā sadyojātaṃ maheśvaram vāmadevaṃ mahātmānaṃ purāṇapuruṣottamam
verses.translation: In that (kalpa) when Brahma was pursuing intense meditation a son with tuft was born unto him. He was called Svetalohita
verses.hindi: सूतजी बोले--हे मुनियो! उस भयावह कृष्ण कल्पके बीत जानेपर ब्रह्माजी उन ब्रह्मस्वरूप देवदेवेश अघोरकी स्तुति करने लगे उस स्तुतिसे प्रसन्न होकर महादेवने अनुग्रह करके ब्रह्मासे कहा-हे महाभाग! ब्रह्महत्या आदि महापातकों, अन्य पातकों तथा अनेकविध पापोंको मैं अपने इसी अघोर रूपसे दूर करता हूँ; इसमें कोई संदेह नहीं
verses.wordMeaning: In that (kalpa) when Brahma was pursuing intense meditation a son with tuft was born unto him. He was called Svetalohita
verses.commentary: Sense: In that (kalpa) when Brahma was pursuing intense meditation a son with tuft was born unto him. He was called Svetalohita

verses.sanskrit: अघोरं च तथेशानं यथावद्वक्तुमर्हसि एकोनत्रिंशकः कल्पो विज्ञेयः श्वेतलोहितः
verses.transliteration: aghoraṃ ca tatheśānaṃ yathāvadvaktumarhasi ekonatriṃśakaḥ kalpo vijñeyaḥ śvetalohitaḥ
verses.translation: On seeing that Purusa, the glorious lord Brahma with faces all round, thought of the noble-souled lord in the form of Brahman. Brahma retained Sadyojata in the heart and became engaged in meditation. After realising die greatest being through meditation Brahma, the lord of Dcvas, saluted him.
verses.hindi: हे सुब्रत! है पितामह! इसी प्रकार सभी उपपातकों, मानसिक पापों, सुतीक्ष्ण वाचिक पापों, कायिक पापों, मिश्रित पापों, प्रासंगिक पापों, जानबूझकर किये गये पापों, सहज रूपमें आगन्तुक पापों तथा पितृ-मातृदेहजन्य पापोंको दूर कर देता हूँ और है विभो! समस्त प्रकारके पातकजनित दुःखोंका नाश कर देता हूँ; इसमें लेशमात्र भौ संशय नहीं है॥ ४--६॥
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing that Purusa, the glorious lord Brahma with faces all round, thought of the noble-souled lord in the form of Brahman. Brahma retained Sadyojata in the heart and became engaged in meditation. After realising die greatest being through meditation Brahma,…
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing that Purusa, the glorious lord Brahma with faces all round, thought of the noble-souled lord in the form of Brahman. Brahma retained Sadyojata in the heart and became engaged in meditation. After realising die greatest being through meditation Brahma,…

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिंस्तत्परमं ध्यानं ध्यायतो ब्रह्मणस्तदा उत्पन्नस्तु शिखायुक्तः कुमारः श्वेतलोहितः
verses.transliteration: tasmiṃstatparamaṃ dhyānaṃ dhyāyato brahmaṇastadā utpannastu śikhāyuktaḥ kumāraḥ śvetalohitaḥ
verses.translation: Brahma contemplated again over Sadyojata. There- upon from his sides were born Svetas (white ones) of great fame, viz. Sunanda, Nandana, Vivananda and Upanandana; these nobie-souled ones were thedisciples of Brahma by whom he was always surrounded.
verses.hindi: घोरेभ्यः० ) जपकर ब्रह्महत्यारा भी मुक्त हो जाता है। वीरहा लक्षमात्रेण भ्रूणहा कोटिमभ्यसेत्
verses.wordMeaning: Brahma contemplated again over Sadyojata. There- upon from his sides were born Svetas (white ones) of great fame, viz. Sunanda, Nandana, Vivananda and Upanandana; these nobie-souled ones were thedisciples of Brahma by whom he was always surrounded.
verses.commentary: Sense: Brahma contemplated again over Sadyojata. There- upon from his sides were born Svetas (white ones) of great fame, viz. Sunanda, Nandana, Vivananda and Upanandana; these nobie-souled ones were thedisciples of Brahma by whom he was always surrounded.

verses.sanskrit: तं दृष्ट्वा पुरुषं श्रीमान् ब्रह्मा वै विश्वतोमुखः हृदि कृत्वा महात्मानं ब्रह्मरूपिणमीश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: taṃ dṛṣṭvā puruṣaṃ śrīmān brahmā vai viśvatomukhaḥ hṛdi kṛtvā mahātmānaṃ brahmarūpiṇamīśvaram
verses.translation: In front of him the sage Sveta, glittering in his white colour, was born. Then there was born Hara of great splendour.
verses.hindi: गोघ्नश्चैव कृतघ्नश्च स्त्रीघ्नः पापयुतो नरः ब्रह्मघ्नश्च जपेदेवं मानसं वै पितामह। सम्पर्कात्पापिनां पापं तत्समं परिभाषितम्
verses.wordMeaning: In front of him the sage Sveta, glittering in his white colour, was born. Then there was born Hara of great splendour.
verses.commentary: Sense: In front of him the sage Sveta, glittering in his white colour, was born. Then there was born Hara of great splendour.

verses.sanskrit: सद्योजातं ततो ब्रह्मा ध्यानयोगपरो ऽभवत् ध्यानयोगात्परं ज्ञात्वा ववन्दे देवमीश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: sadyojātaṃ tato brahmā dhyānayogaparo 'bhavat dhyānayogātparaṃ jñātvā vavande devamīśvaram
verses.translation: There all the sages resorted to the great lord Sadyojata with perfect devotion. They praised the eternal Brahman. Hence all those persons O brahmins, who resort to lord Vive: - vara after being engrossed in breath-control and mentally devoted to Brahman, become liberated from sins. They will have the splendour of brahman and be free from impulses. They will go beyond Visnu's abode and enter Rudra's world.
verses.hindi: तथाप्ययुतमात्रेण पातकाद्वै प्रमुच्यते संसर्गात्पातकी लक्षं जपेद्वै मानसं धिया पातकादर्धमेव स्यादुपपातकिनां स्मृतम्॥
verses.wordMeaning: There all the sages resorted to the great lord Sadyojata with perfect devotion. They praised the eternal Brahman. Hence all those persons O brahmins, who resort to lord Vive: - vara after being engrossed in breath-control and mentally devoted to Brahman,…
verses.commentary: Sense: There all the sages resorted to the great lord Sadyojata with perfect devotion. They praised the eternal Brahman. Hence all those persons O brahmins, who resort to lord Vive: - vara after being engrossed in breath-control and mentally devoted to Brahman,…

verses.sanskrit: सद्योजातं ततो ब्रह्म ब्रह्म वै समचिन्तयत् ततो ऽस्य पार्श्वतः श्वेताः प्रादुर्भूता महायशाः
verses.transliteration: sadyojātaṃ tato brahma brahma vai samacintayat tato 'sya pārśvataḥ śvetāḥ prādurbhūtā mahāyaśāḥ
verses.translation: There all the sages resorted to the great lord Sadyojata with perfect devotion. They praised the eternal Brahman. Hence all those persons O brahmins, who resort to lord Vive: - vara after being engrossed in breath-control and mentally devoted to Brahman, become liberated from sins. They will have the splendour of brahman and be free from impulses. They will go beyond Visnu's abode and enter Rudra's world.
verses.hindi: अघोरेशमाहात्म्य तथा अघोरमन्त्रके जपसे विविध पातकोंका विनाश फफफफफाफ फपीफीकीफीफीकीफीफीफाफफफफफफफफफफफ
verses.wordMeaning: There all the sages resorted to the great lord Sadyojata with perfect devotion. They praised the eternal Brahman. Hence all those persons O brahmins, who resort to lord Vive: - vara after being engrossed in breath-control and mentally devoted to Brahman,…
verses.commentary: Sense: There all the sages resorted to the great lord Sadyojata with perfect devotion. They praised the eternal Brahman. Hence all those persons O brahmins, who resort to lord Vive: - vara after being engrossed in breath-control and mentally devoted to Brahman,…

verses.sanskrit: सुनन्दो नन्दनश्चैव विश्वनन्दोपनन्दनौ शिष्यास्ते वै महात्मानो यैस्तद्ब्रह्म सदावृतम्
verses.transliteration: sunando nandanaścaiva viśvanandopanandanau śiṣyāste vai mahātmāno yaistadbrahma sadāvṛtam
verses.translation: There all the sages resorted to the great lord Sadyojata with perfect devotion. They praised the eternal Brahman. Hence all those persons O brahmins, who resort to lord Vive: - vara after being engrossed in breath-control and mentally devoted to Brahman, become liberated from sins. They will have the splendour of brahman and be free from impulses. They will go beyond Visnu's abode and enter Rudra's world.
verses.hindi: हे वत्स! उससे आधा जप करनेसे वाचिक पाप तथा उससे भी आधे जपसे मानसिक पाप, चार गुना जप करनेसे बुद्धिपूर्वक अर्थात् जानबूझकर किये गये पाप तथा आठ गुना जप करनेसे क्रोधपूर्वक किये गये पाप दूर होते हैं ॥ ७/२॥
verses.wordMeaning: There all the sages resorted to the great lord Sadyojata with perfect devotion. They praised the eternal Brahman. Hence all those persons O brahmins, who resort to lord Vive: - vara after being engrossed in breath-control and mentally devoted to Brahman,…

verses.sanskrit: तस्याग्रे श्वेतवर्णाभः श्वेतो नाम महामुनिः विजज्ञे ऽथ महातेजास् तस्माज्जज्ञे हरस्त्वसौ
verses.transliteration: tasyāgre śvetavarṇābhaḥ śveto nāma mahāmuniḥ vijajñe 'tha mahātejās tasmājjajñe harastvasau
verses.translation: There all the sages resorted to the great lord Sadyojata with perfect devotion. They praised the eternal Brahman. Hence all those persons O brahmins, who resort to lord Vive: - vara after being engrossed in breath-control and mentally devoted to Brahman, become liberated from sins. They will have the splendour of brahman and be free from impulses. They will go beyond Visnu's abode and enter Rudra's world.
verses.hindi: वीरोंकी हत्या करनेवालेको एक लाख जप तथा भ्रूण-हत्या करनेवालेको एक करोड़ जप करना चाहिए । माताका हत्यारा दस लाख जप करनेसे शुद्ध होता है; इसमें संशय नहीं है॥ ८ /२॥ गायकी हत्या करनेवाला, कृतघ्न तथा स्त्रीका हत्यारा-ऐसा पापी मनुष्य दस हजार बार अघोरमन्त्र जपकर पापमुक्त हो जाता है; इसमें लेशमात्र भी संदेह नहीं है॥ ९/२॥
verses.wordMeaning: There all the sages resorted to the great lord Sadyojata with perfect devotion. They praised the eternal Brahman. Hence all those persons O brahmins, who resort to lord Vive: - vara after being engrossed in breath-control and mentally devoted to Brahman,…
