verses.sanskrit: तत्र ते मुनयः सर्वे सद्योजातं महेश्वरम् प्रपन्नाः परया भक्त्या गृणन्तो ब्रह्म शाश्वतम्
verses.transliteration: tatra te munayaḥ sarve sadyojātaṃ maheśvaram prapannāḥ parayā bhaktyā gṛṇanto brahma śāśvatam
verses.translation: There all the sages resorted to the great lord Sadyojata with perfect devotion. They praised the eternal Brahman. Hence all those persons O brahmins, who resort to lord Vive: - vara after being engrossed in breath-control and mentally devoted to Brahman, become liberated from sins. They will have the splendour of brahman and be free from impulses. They will go beyond Visnu's abode and enter Rudra's world.
verses.hindi: हे प्रभो! जानकर अथवा बिना जाने सुरापान करनेवाला एक लाख जपसे तथा वारुणी (मद्य) पीनेवाला उसके आधे अर्थात् पचास हजार जपसे पापमुक्त हो जाता है; इसमें किसी प्रकारका संशय नहीं बिना स्नान किये भोजन करनेवाला, गायत्री-जप तथा अग्निहोत्र किये बिना और देवताओं एवं अतिथियों आदिको भोजन कराये बिना भोजन करनेवाला द्विज एक हजार जप करनेसे शुद्ध होता है॥ ११/२॥
verses.wordMeaning: There all the sages resorted to the great lord Sadyojata with perfect devotion. They praised the eternal Brahman. Hence all those persons O brahmins, who resort to lord Vive: - vara after being engrossed in breath-control and mentally devoted to Brahman,…
verses.commentary: Sense: There all the sages resorted to the great lord Sadyojata with perfect devotion. They praised the eternal Brahman. Hence all those persons O brahmins, who resort to lord Vive: - vara after being engrossed in breath-control and mentally devoted to Brahman,…

verses.sanskrit: तस्माद्विश्वेश्वरं देवं ये प्रपद्यन्ति वै द्विजाः प्राणायामपरा भूत्वा ब्रह्मतत्परमानसाः
verses.transliteration: tasmādviśveśvaraṃ devaṃ ye prapadyanti vai dvijāḥ prāṇāyāmaparā bhūtvā brahmatatparamānasāḥ
verses.translation: There all the sages resorted to the great lord Sadyojata with perfect devotion. They praised the eternal Brahman. Hence all those persons O brahmins, who resort to lord Vive: - vara after being engrossed in breath-control and mentally devoted to Brahman, become liberated from sins. They will have the splendour of brahman and be free from impulses. They will go beyond Visnu's abode and enter Rudra's world.
verses.hindi: ब्राह्मगका धन हरण करनेवाला तथा स्वर्णको चोरी करनेवाला अधम व्यक्ति दस लाख अघोर मन्त्र जपकर पापसे मुक्त होता है, इसमें संदेह नहीं है। इसी प्रकार हे पितामह! गुरुपत्नीमें आसक्ति रखनेवाले, माताका वध करनेवाले तथा ब्रह्महत्यारे नराधमको भी पापमुक्तिहेतु दस लाख मानस जप करना चाहिए॥ १२-१३/२॥
verses.wordMeaning: There all the sages resorted to the great lord Sadyojata with perfect devotion. They praised the eternal Brahman. Hence all those persons O brahmins, who resort to lord Vive: - vara after being engrossed in breath-control and mentally devoted to Brahman,…
verses.commentary: Sense: There all the sages resorted to the great lord Sadyojata with perfect devotion. They praised the eternal Brahman. Hence all those persons O brahmins, who resort to lord Vive: - vara after being engrossed in breath-control and mentally devoted to Brahman,…

verses.sanskrit: ते सर्वे पापनिर्मुक्ता विमला ब्रह्मवर्चसः विष्णुलोकमतिक्रम्य रुद्रलोकं व्रजन्ति ते
verses.transliteration: te sarve pāpanirmuktā vimalā brahmavarcasaḥ viṣṇulokamatikramya rudralokaṃ vrajanti te
verses.translation: There all the sages resorted to the great lord Sadyojata with perfect devotion. They praised the eternal Brahman. Hence all those persons O brahmins, who resort to lord Vive: - vara after being engrossed in breath-control and mentally devoted to Brahman, become liberated from sins. They will have the splendour of brahman and be free from impulses. They will go beyond Visnu's abode and enter Rudra's world.
verses.hindi: पापियोंके सम्पर्कमात्रसे लगनेवाला पाप उन पापियोंके पापके ही समान कहा गया है, फिर भी मात्र दस हजार जपसे ही सम्पर्कमें रहनेवाला प्राणी उस पापसे मुक्त हो जाता है॥ १४/२॥ संसर्गसे होनेवाले पाप-शमनके लिये पातकीको एक लाख मानस जप अथवा उसका चार गुना उपांशु जप अथवा आठ गुना वाचिक जप बुद्धिपूर्वक करना
verses.wordMeaning: There all the sages resorted to the great lord Sadyojata with perfect devotion. They praised the eternal Brahman. Hence all those persons O brahmins, who resort to lord Vive: - vara after being engrossed in breath-control and mentally devoted to Brahman,…
verses.commentary: Sense: There all the sages resorted to the great lord Sadyojata with perfect devotion. They praised the eternal Brahman. Hence all those persons O brahmins, who resort to lord Vive: - vara after being engrossed in breath-control and mentally devoted to Brahman,…

verses.sanskrit: ततस्त्रिंशत्तमः कल्पो रक्तो नाम प्रकीर्तितः ब्रह्मा यत्र महातेजा रक्तवर्णमधारयत्
verses.transliteration: tatastriṃśattamaḥ kalpo rakto nāma prakīrtitaḥ brahmā yatra mahātejā raktavarṇamadhārayat
verses.translation: Even as Brahma desirous of a son was meditating, a boy of great splendour mcnifcsted himself: He was adorned In red ornaments. He wore red garlands and clothes. His eyes
verses.hindi: तदर्ध केवले पापे नात्र कार्या विचारणा। चाहिए। उपपातकीजनोंके लिये पापीजनोंके लिये निर्धारित ब्रह्महत्या सुरापानं सुवर्णस्तेयमेव च॥ १ जपका आधा जप करना बताया गया है तथा सामान्य पापोंसे मुक्तिहेतु उससे भी आधे जपका विधान है; इसमें

verses.sanskrit: ध्यायतः पुत्रकामस्य ब्रह्मणः परमेष्ठिनः प्रादुर्भूतो महातेजाः कुमारो रक्तभूषणः
verses.transliteration: dhyāyataḥ putrakāmasya brahmaṇaḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ prādurbhūto mahātejāḥ kumāro raktabhūṣaṇaḥ
verses.translation: "Since, O Brahma, I have been seen by you medita- ting on me with the desire for a son, with great devotion, and since 1 was eulogized with the mantra beginning with "brahmane VSmadevaya" you will attain the strength of meditation and will realize me as Hvara, the assiduous creator of the worlds, in every kalpa. Thereafter four sons were born to him who were as pure and splendid as brahman. They were named as Virajas, Vibahu, Vioka and Visvabhavana.
verses.hindi: कोई संदेह नहीं करना चाहिए॥ १५-१६ /२॥ हे द्विजो! ब्रह्महत्या, सुरापान, स्वर्णकी चोरी, गुरुपत्नीगमन आदि महापातक करनेवाले ब्राह्मणको चाहिए कि वह रुद्रगायत्री' मन्त्रके द्वारा कपिला (किंचित् पीतवर्ण) गायका मूत्र, ' गन्धद्वारा०'२ इस
verses.wordMeaning: "Since, O Brahma, I have been seen by you medita- ting on me with the desire for a son, with great devotion, and since 1 was eulogized with the mantra beginning with "brahmane VSmadevaya" you will attain the strength of meditation and will realize me as Hvara,…
verses.commentary: Sense: "Since, O Brahma, I have been seen by you medita- ting on me with the desire for a son, with great devotion, and since 1 was eulogized with the mantra beginning with "brahmane VSmadevaya" you will attain the strength of meditation and will realize me as Hvara,…

verses.sanskrit: रक्तमाल्याम्बरधरो रक्तनेत्रः प्रतापवान् स तं दृष्ट्वा महात्मानं कुमारं रक्तवाससम्
verses.transliteration: raktamālyāmbaradharo raktanetraḥ pratāpavān sa taṃ dṛṣṭvā mahātmānaṃ kumāraṃ raktavāsasam
verses.translation: They were pious and on a par with Brahma. They were heroic and enterprising. They wore red garments and red gar- lands and applied red unguents.
verses.hindi: 'तेजोऽसि शुक्रं इस मन्त्रसे कपिला गायका घी, “आप्यायस्व” इस मन्त्रसे दूध, “दधिक्राव्ण इस पितामह! “देवस्य त्वा इस मन्त्रसे कुशाका जल इकट्टा करे। तत्पश्चात् इन सबको स्वर्ण, चाँदी या ताँबेके पात्रमें अथवा कमल या पलाशपत्रमें एकत्र करके अघोरमन्त्रःसे अभिमन्त्रित करना चाहिए। पुनः उसमें
verses.wordMeaning: They were pious and on a par with Brahma. They were heroic and enterprising. They wore red garments and red gar- lands and applied red unguents.
verses.commentary: Sense: They were pious and on a par with Brahma. They were heroic and enterprising. They wore red garments and red gar- lands and applied red unguents.

verses.sanskrit: परं ध्यानं समाश्रित्य बुबुधे देवमीश्वरम् स तं प्रणम्य भगवान् ब्रह्मा परमयन्त्रितः
verses.transliteration: paraṃ dhyānaṃ samāśritya bubudhe devamīśvaram sa taṃ praṇamya bhagavān brahmā paramayantritaḥ
verses.translation: Their bodies were smeared with red saffron; they had applied red ashes over their bodies. At the end of a thousand years they re-entered the great eternal lord. In the mean- time they attempted to realize brahman. For blessing the worlds and with a desire for the welfare of their disciples they imparted instructions in dharma and became favourites of Brahma. Ultimately, at the end of a thousand years, they re-entered the great lord.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्मकूर्चं तथा सभी रत्नोंसहित सोना डाल देना चाहिए तत्पश्चात् अघोर मन्त्रका जप करके घी आदिसे हवन करना चाहिए। घी, चरु, समिध, तिल, यव, धान्यसे अलग-अलग आहुति देनी चाहिए। प्रत्येककी सात-सात बार आहुति देनेका विधान है। इन द्रव्योंके
verses.wordMeaning: Their bodies were smeared with red saffron; they had applied red ashes over their bodies. At the end of a thousand years they re-entered the great eternal lord. In the mean- time they attempted to realize brahman.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Their bodies were smeared with red saffron; they had applied red ashes over their bodies. At the end of a thousand years they re-entered the great eternal lord. In the mean- time they attempted to realize brahman.…

verses.sanskrit: वामदेवं ततो ब्रह्मा ब्रह्म वै समचिन्तयत् तथा स्तुतो महादेवो ब्रह्मणा परमेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: vāmadevaṃ tato brahmā brahma vai samacintayat tathā stuto mahādevo brahmaṇā parameśvaraḥ
verses.translation: Another brahmins who practise yoga and repeat the sacred formula 'namobrahmaie Vamadcvaya***and who are devoted to him as their greatest resort are liberated from sins. They become devoid of impurities and they attain the strength of Brahman. They achieve the blessed region (rudraloka) whence there is no return to this (mortal) world.
verses.hindi: अभावमें अघोरमन्त्रसे केवल घीसे ही हवन किया जा सकता है। है द्विजो! इसके बाद अघोर मन्त्रका जप करते हुए आठ द्रोण घीसे देवेश शिवको स्नान कराकर बादमें शुद्धोदक स्नान कराना चाहिए॥ २३--२५॥ पुनः दिन-रात उपवास करके दूसरे दिन प्रातः काल स्नानकर ब्रह्मकूर्चविधिसे बनाये गये पंचगव्यका पान करना चाहिए। तत्पश्चात् आचमन करके शिवके
verses.wordMeaning: Another brahmins who practise yoga and repeat the sacred formula 'namobrahmaie Vamadcvaya***and who are devoted to him as their greatest resort are liberated from sins. They become devoid of impurities and they attain the strength of Brahman.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Another brahmins who practise yoga and repeat the sacred formula 'namobrahmaie Vamadcvaya***and who are devoted to him as their greatest resort are liberated from sins. They become devoid of impurities and they attain the strength of Brahman.…

verses.translation: The thirty first kalpa is known as Pitavasas. Therein, the blessed Brahma was clad in yellow garbs.
verses.hindi: ब्राह्मणका धन हरण करनेवाला, गोहत्यारा, माता- पिताकी हत्या करनेवाला, देवताओंको मूर्ति खण्डित करनेवाला, शिवलिङ्ग ध्वस्त करनेवाला तथा हजारों प्रकारके अन्य मानसिक-वाचिक-शारीरिक पाप करनेवाला द्विज शीघ्र ही पापमुक्त हो जाता है। इतना ही नहीं, इस विधिके करनेसे सैकड़ों जन्म-जन्मान्तरके पापोंसे मुक्ति मिल जाती है। मैंने अघोरेशवर भगवान् शिवके प्रसंगसे इस रहस्यका वर्णन किया है। अतएव द्विज अर्थात्
verses.wordMeaning: The thirty first kalpa is known as Pitavasas. Therein, the blessed Brahma was clad in yellow garbs.
verses.commentary: Sense: The thirty first kalpa is known as Pitavasas. Therein, the blessed Brahma was clad in yellow garbs.

verses.sanskrit: ध्यायतः पुत्रकामस्य ब्रह्मणः परमेष्ठिनः प्रादुर्भूतो महातेजाः कुमारः पीतवस्त्रधृक्
verses.transliteration: dhyāyataḥ putrakāmasya brahmaṇaḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ prādurbhūto mahātejāḥ kumāraḥ pītavastradhṛk
verses.translation: Even as Brahma desirous of a son was meditating, a boy of great splendour, wearing yellow robes, appeared before.
verses.hindi: ब्राह्मण, क्षत्रिय तथा वैश्यको सभी पापोंसे मुक्तिहेतु इस तस्माज्पेद् द्विजो नित्यं सर्वपापविशुद्धये॥ ३२  अघोर मन्त्रका जप नित्य करना चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: Even as Brahma desirous of a son was meditating, a boy of great splendour, wearing yellow robes, appeared before.
verses.commentary: Sense: Even as Brahma desirous of a son was meditating, a boy of great splendour, wearing yellow robes, appeared before.

verses.sanskrit: पीतगन्धानुलिप्ताङ्गः पीतमाल्यांबरो युवा हेमयज्ञोपवीतश् च पीतोष्णीषो महाभुजः
verses.transliteration: pītagandhānuliptāṅgaḥ pītamālyāṃbaro yuvā hemayajñopavītaś ca pītoṣṇīṣo mahābhujaḥ
verses.translation: He was a youth with the body smeared with yellow scents. He wore yellow garlands and dress. He had long arms, a golden sacred thread and yellow turban.
verses.hindi: विश्वरूप नामक कल्पमें शिवस्वरूप भगवान् ईशानका प्रादुर्भाव, ब्रह्माजीद्वारा ईशानकी स्तुति  सूत उवाच सूतजी बोले--हे मुनिश्रेष्ठो असित कल्पके अथान्यो ब्रह्मणः कल्पो वर्तते मुनिपुङ्गवाः।  अनन्तर “विश्वरूप' नामसे विख्यात ब्रह्माजीका दूसरा ब्रह्मणः पुत्रकामस्य ध्यायतः परमेष्ठिनः
verses.wordMeaning: He was a youth with the body smeared with yellow scents. He wore yellow garlands and dress. He had long arms, a golden sacred thread and yellow turban.
verses.commentary: Sense: He was a youth with the body smeared with yellow scents. He wore yellow garlands and dress. He had long arms, a golden sacred thread and yellow turban.

verses.sanskrit: तं दृष्ट्वा ध्यानसंयुक्तो ब्रह्मा लोकमहेश्वरम् मनसा लोकधातारं प्रपेदे शरणं विभुम्

verses.translation: On seeing him, Brahma, endowed with meditation men- tally resorted to and sought refuge in the overlord, the creator of the worlds.
verses.hindi: विश्वमाल्याम्बरधरा विश्वयज्ञोपवीतिनी विशवोष्णीषा विशवगन्धा विश्वमाता महोष्ठिका। तथाविधं स भगवानीशानं परमेश्वरम्
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing him, Brahma, endowed with meditation men- tally resorted to and sought refuge in the overlord, the creator of the worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing him, Brahma, endowed with meditation men- tally resorted to and sought refuge in the overlord, the creator of the worlds.

verses.sanskrit: ततो ध्यानगतस्तत्र ब्रह्मा माहेश्वरीं वराम् गां विश्वरूपां ददृशे महेश्वरमुखाच्च्युताम्
verses.transliteration: tato dhyānagatastatra brahmā māheśvarīṃ varām gāṃ viśvarūpāṃ dadṛśe maheśvaramukhāccyutām
verses.translation: Thereafter Brahma went on meditation. He saw the excellent cow of the great lord. In her universal form it had come out of his mouth,
verses.hindi: शुद्धस्फटिकसङ्काशं सर्वाभरणभूषितम् अथ तं मनसा ध्यात्वा युक्तात्मा वै पितामहः अत्यन्त अद्भुत कल्प आरम्भ हुआ
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter Brahma went on meditation. He saw the excellent cow of the great lord. In her universal form it had come out of his mouth,
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter Brahma went on meditation. He saw the excellent cow of the great lord. In her universal form it had come out of his mouth,

verses.sanskrit: चतुष्पदां चतुर्वक्त्रां चतुर्हस्तां चतुःस्तनीम् चतुर्नेत्रां चतुःशृङ्गीं चतुर्दंष्ट्रां चतुर्मुखीम्
verses.transliteration: catuṣpadāṃ caturvaktrāṃ caturhastāṃ catuḥstanīm caturnetrāṃ catuḥśṛṅgīṃ caturdaṃṣṭrāṃ caturmukhīm
verses.translation: It had four feet, four faces, four hands, four udders, four eyes, four horns, four teeth and four mouths.
verses.hindi: समस्त जगत्के संहारके अनन्तर चराचर संसारको पुनः सृष्टिके निमित्त पुत्र-कामनासे ध्यानरत परमेष्ठी ब्रह्माजीके समक्ष महान् नाद करती हुई विश्वरूपा सरस्वती गौ प्रकट हुई। वह विश्वरूप माला, वस्त्र, यज्ञोपवीत तथा शिरोभूषण (पगड़ी) धारण को हुई थी। उन महोष्ठिका विशवमाताके सभी अंग विश्वगन्धसे
verses.wordMeaning: It had four feet, four faces, four hands, four udders, four eyes, four horns, four teeth and four mouths.
verses.commentary: Sense: It had four feet, four faces, four hands, four udders, four eyes, four horns, four teeth and four mouths.

verses.sanskrit: द्वात्रिंशद्गुणसंयुक्ताम् ईश्वरीं सर्वतोमुखीम् स तां दृष्ट्वा महातेजा महादेवीं महेश्वरीम्
verses.transliteration: dvātriṃśadguṇasaṃyuktām īśvarīṃ sarvatomukhīm sa tāṃ dṛṣṭvā mahātejā mahādevīṃ maheśvarīm
verses.translation: The cow was goddess herself who had faces all round and who possessed thirtytwo qualities. On seeing the great goddess in the form of the cow, the great lord who is wor- shipped by all devas said again repeating the words: 'O great goddess, symbol of intellect and memory, come on, come on.* [I'lius addressed] she joined her palms in reverence to the lord and stood there. Then the lord of devas spoke to her. [O goddess,] enveloping the universe by your yogic power you should keep it under your control. You will be Uma for the welfare of the brahmins and for the attainment of their goal { of liberation).
verses.hindi: तदनन्तर वे युक्तात्मा भगवान् ब्रह्मा उसी प्रकारके विश्वरूपवाले, शुद्ध स्फटिकमणिके तुल्य आभायुक्त फफ फ़ का फ क फ फा फ फा भा भी मी मी मी फी की की मी क फ की फी फे फ फ फ़ फ फ़ फ फू
verses.wordMeaning: The cow was goddess herself who had faces all round and who possessed thirtytwo qualities. On seeing the great goddess in the form of the cow, the great lord who is wor- shipped by all devas said again repeating the words: 'O great goddess, symbol of intellect and memory,…

On seeing the great goddess in the form of the cow, the great lord who is wor- shipped by all devas said again repeating the words: 'O great goddess, symbol of intellect and memory,…

verses.sanskrit: पुनराह महादेवः सर्वदेवनमस्कृतः मतिः स्मृतिर्बुद्धिरिति गायमानः पुनः पुनः
verses.transliteration: punarāha mahādevaḥ sarvadevanamaskṛtaḥ matiḥ smṛtirbuddhiriti gāyamānaḥ punaḥ punaḥ
verses.translation: By practising meditation Brahma realized that she was the great goddess and he accepted her from the preceptor of the worlds.
verses.hindi: अककफ फक कफ फफक फफक कफ ककाकाकीमाकीकीकीकीकेकिकि क ववन्दे देवमीशानं सर्वेशं सर्वगं प्रभुम्। तथा सभी आभूषणोंसे शोभायमान, सर्वेश्वर, सर्वव्यापी,
verses.wordMeaning: By practising meditation Brahma realized that she was the great goddess and he accepted her from the preceptor of the worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: By practising meditation Brahma realized that she was the great goddess and he accepted her from the preceptor of the worlds.

verses.sanskrit: एह्येहीति महादेवि सातिष्ठत्प्राञ्जलिर्विभुम् विश्वमावृत्य योगेन जगत्सर्वं वशीकुरु
verses.transliteration: ehyehīti mahādevi sātiṣṭhatprāñjalirvibhum viśvamāvṛtya yogena jagatsarvaṃ vaśīkuru
verses.translation: After meditating on Gayatri pertaining to Rudra, Brahma became self-controlled- By performing the Japa of Rudra-Gayatri as instructed by the lord and rjealizing that it
verses.hindi: ओमीशान नमस्तेऽस्तु महादेव नमोऽस्तु ते॥ सर्वसमर्थ परमात्मा ईशानदेवका मनसे ध्यान करके उनकी वन्दना करने लगे॥ ४-५ /२॥ हे ओमूस्वरूप ईशान! आपको नमस्कार है। हे महादेव! आपको नमस्कार है। है समस्त विद्याओंके ईशान (स्वामी) परमेश्वर! आपको नमस्कार है। हे सभी प्राणियोंके अधिपति वृषवाहन! आपको नमस्कार
verses.wordMeaning: After meditating on Gayatri pertaining to Rudra, Brahma became self-controlled- By performing the Japa of Rudra-Gayatri as instructed by the lord and rjealizing that it
verses.commentary: Sense: After meditating on Gayatri pertaining to Rudra, Brahma became self-controlled- By performing the Japa of Rudra-Gayatri as instructed by the lord and rjealizing that it

verses.sanskrit: अथ तामाह देवेशो रुद्राणी त्वं भविष्यसि ब्राह्मणानां हितार्थाय परमार्था भविष्यसि
verses.transliteration: atha tāmāha deveśo rudrāṇī tvaṃ bhaviṣyasi brāhmaṇānāṃ hitārthāya paramārthā bhaviṣyasi
verses.translation: The lord then granted him a divine yoga, great learning, riches and glory, wealth of knowledge and detach- ment.
verses.hindi: है। है ब्रह्माधिपते! आप ब्रह्मरूप तथा साक्षात् ब्रह्मो नमस्कार है। आप ब्रह्माधिपतिको नमस्कार है। हे सदाशिव! मेरा कल्याण हो॥ ६--८ ॥ हे ओंकारमूर्ते! है देवेश! है सद्योजात! आपको बार-बार नमस्कार है। मैं कष्टसे पीडित होकर आपके शरणागत हूँ। सद्योजातको नमस्कार है। अजन्मा होनेपर भी आप लोकाभ्युदयार्थ ही जन्मादिको स्वीकार करनेवाले
verses.wordMeaning: The lord then granted him a divine yoga, great learning, riches and glory, wealth of knowledge and detach- ment.
verses.commentary: Sense: The lord then granted him a divine yoga, great learning, riches and glory, wealth of knowledge and detach- ment.

verses.sanskrit: तथैनां पुत्रकामस्य ध्यायतः परमेष्ठिनः प्रददौ देवदेवेशः चतुष्पादां जगद्गुरुः
verses.transliteration: tathaināṃ putrakāmasya dhyāyataḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ pradadau devadeveśaḥ catuṣpādāṃ jagadguruḥ
verses.translation: Thereafter from his sides there emerged divine sons who wore yellow garlands, yellow garbs, yellow necklaces. They had yellow unguents on their bodies and yellow turbans on their heads. Their faces and hair were all yellow. For a period of thousand years, these persons of great power and splendour who were devoid of impurities spent their time for the welfare of brahmins. They were yogic souls delighting in penan- ces. They were endowed with virtue and power of yoga. They instructed the sages engaged in long sacrifices in the system of great yoga and (finally) entered the body of the lord. Thus others loo who seek refuge in him in this manner, who have restrained their Souls, who have conquered the sense organs and who are engaged in meditation will become sinless. They will have the splendour of Brahman and be free from impurities. They will enter Rudra the great lord and be relea- sed from rc-birth.
verses.hindi: हैं, है शिव! आपको नमस्कार है। है विश्वोत्पादक ! हे विश्वके ईशान (विश्वेश)! है महाद्युते! मेरी रक्षा करो हे वामदेव! आपको नमस्कार है। ज्येष्ठको नमस्कार है। वरदको नमस्कार है। रुद्रको, कालको तथा कलन (संख्यारूप)-को बार-बार नमस्कार है। वर्णी, कालवर्ण, विकरणको नित्य नमस्कार है। बलियोंके
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter from his sides there emerged divine sons who wore yellow garlands, yellow garbs, yellow necklaces. They had yellow unguents on their bodies and yellow turbans on their heads. Their faces and hair were all yellow. For a period of thousand years,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter from his sides there emerged divine sons who wore yellow garlands, yellow garbs, yellow necklaces. They had yellow unguents on their bodies and yellow turbans on their heads. Their faces and hair were all yellow. For a period of thousand years,…

verses.transliteration: tatastāṃ dhyānayogena viditvā parameśvarīm brahmā lokaguroḥ so 'tha pratipede maheśvarīm

verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter from his sides there emerged divine sons who wore yellow garlands, yellow garbs, yellow necklaces. They had yellow unguents on their bodies and yellow turbans on their heads. Their faces and hair were all yellow. For a period of thousand years,…

They had yellow unguents on their bodies and yellow turbans on their heads. Their faces and hair were all yellow. verses.sanskrit: जपित्वा तु महादेवीं ब्रह्मा लोकनमस्कृताम् प्रपन्नस्तु महादेवं ध्यानयुक्तेन चेतसा

verses.sanskrit: योगात्मानस्तपोह्लादाः ब्राह्मणानां हितैषिणः धर्मयोगबलोपेता मुनीनां दीर्घसत्त्रिणाम्
verses.transliteration: yogātmānastapohlādāḥ brāhmaṇānāṃ hitaiṣiṇaḥ dharmayogabalopetā munīnāṃ dīrghasattriṇām
verses.translation: Thereafter from his sides there emerged divine sons who wore yellow garlands, yellow garbs, yellow necklaces. They had yellow unguents on their bodies and yellow turbans on their heads. Their faces and hair were all yellow. For a period of thousand years, these persons of great power and splendour who were devoid of impurities spent their time for the welfare of brahmins. They were yogic souls delighting in penan- ces. They were endowed with virtue and power of yoga. They instructed the sages engaged in long sacrifices in the system of great yoga and (finally) entered the body of the lord. Thus others loo who seek refuge in him in this manner, who have restrained their Souls, who have conquered the sense organs and who are engaged in meditation will become sinless. They will have the splendour of Brahman and be free from impurities. They will enter Rudra the great lord and be relea- sed from rc-birth.
verses.hindi: इति स्तवेन देवेशं ननाम वृषभध्वजम्। यः पठेत्सकृदेवेह ब्रह्मलोकं गमिष्यति विश्वरूप नामक कल्पमें शिवस्वरूप भगवान् ईशानका प्रादुर्भाव

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तस्मिन्गते कल्पे पीतवर्णे स्वयंभुवः पुनरन्यः प्रवृत्तस्तु कल्पो नाम्नासितस्तु सः
verses.transliteration: tatastasmingate kalpe pītavarṇe svayaṃbhuvaḥ punaranyaḥ pravṛttastu kalpo nāmnāsitastu saḥ
verses.translation: When the kalpa of yellow colour passed by and an- other of the self-born lord was ushered in by the name of Asita and when the universe became a vast sheet of water®® and a thousand years by the divine reckoning passed by, Brahma be- came desirous of creating the subjects. He was dejected and began to ponder.
verses.hindi: पुरस्तात्तव देवेश तच्छृणुष्व महामते अथवा जो श्राद्धमें ब्राह्मणोंको सुनाता है, वह परमगतिको प्राप्त होता है ॥ १६ /२॥

verses.transliteration: ekārṇave tadā vṛtte divye varṣasahasrake sraṣṭukāmaḥ prajā brahmā cintayāmāsa duḥkhitaḥ

verses.hindi: इस प्रकार ध्यानमग्न होकर वन्दना करते हुए पितामह ब्रह्मासे भगवान् ईशान बोले--मैं तुमपर प्रसन्न तत्पश्चात् ब्रह्माजीने अत्यन्त निवेदनपूर्वक विशुद्ध वाणीवाले तथा प्रसन्नताको प्राप्त महेश्वरसे प्रसन्न मनसे कहा--हे परमेश्वर! यह आपका जो विश्वरूप है तथा परम कल्याणी यह जो विश्वरूपा गौ है--इसके

verses.transliteration: tasya cintayamānasya putrakāmasya vai prabhoḥ kṛṣṇaḥ samabhavadvarṇo dhyāyataḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ
verses.translation: Thcroipon he, the lord of great splendour, saw a boy in front of him. He had black colour but he was refulgent with his brilliance. He had great prowess. He wore black gar- ments, black turban, black sacred thread, black crown and black garlands. He bad black unguents on his body. On seeing this noble-souled Aghora of terrible exploits, Brahma saluted the miraculous lord who had the black and tawny colour.
verses.hindi: हाथों तथा चार नेत्रोंबाली ये भगवती कौन हैं तथा इन देवीको विश्वरूपा क्‍यों कहा गया है? इनका नाम तथा गोत्र क्या है? ये किसकी भार्या हैं तथा इनके कर्मका प्रभाव एवं सामर्थ्य क्या है ?॥ २०-२१/२॥ उन ब्रह्माका वह वचन सुनकर ब्रह्मरूप देवदेव वृषध्वज शिवने देवताओंमें श्रेष्ठ अपने पुत्र ब्रह्मासे कहा--॥ २२'/२॥

verses.translation: Then the glorious lord Brahma became engaged in Praayama. He thought of the supreme lord Siva within his heart. With hb mind engaged in meditation he resorted to lord Aghora. He contemplated on him in the form of Brahman. When Brahma was meditating thus, lord Aghora of terrible exploits granted him vbion. Thereupon four noble sons appeared from his sides. They were black in colour and they wore black garlands and unguents. They were Krsna, Krasikha, Kr$nasya, and Kfifavastradhrk.
verses.hindi: अब आदिसर्गमें जैसा था, वही पुष्टिकी वृद्धि करनेवाला, पवित्र तथा सभी मन्त्रोंका परम गुह्य रहस्य सुनो। है प्रभो! यह जो वर्तमान कल्प है, वह विश्व- रूप कल्प नामवाला कहा गया है। जिसमें आपने यह ब्रह्मपद प्राप्त किया है और मेरे वाम अंगसे उत्पन्न विष्णुके द्वारा विशुद्ध वैकुण्ठलोक प्राप्त किया गया । हे देव! विष्णुद्वारा प्राप्त वह शुभ पद तुम्हारे ब्रह्मपदसे भी श्रेष्ठ है ॥ २३-- २५ /२॥

verses.sanskrit: कृष्णांबरधरोष्णीषं कृष्णयज्ञोपवीतिनम् कृष्णेन मौलिना युक्तं कृष्णस्रगनुलेपनम्
verses.transliteration: kṛṣṇāṃbaradharoṣṇīṣaṃ kṛṣṇayajñopavītinam kṛṣṇena maulinā yuktaṃ kṛṣṇasraganulepanam
verses.translation: By resorting to yoga they adored the great lord for a thousand years. They imparted instruction in supreme yoga to their disciples. By resorting to yoga these persons, endowed with yogic powers, thought on Siva. They entered the region of lord Siva, the region devoid of impurities and free from attributes. Those others too, who contemplate on him by resorting to yoga can go unto the region of that eternal lord.
verses.hindi: हे देवेश! है महामते! उस समयसे अब यह तैंतीसवाँ कल्प है और इससे पूर्व लाखों कल्प बीत चुके हैं तथा आपसे पहले लाखों ब्रह्मा भी हो चुके हैं, उनके विषयमें सुनो आपका माण्डव्य गोत्र है और तपस्यासे मुझे पुत्र- रूपमें प्राप्त हुए हैं, अतएव आपको आनन्दरूप तत्त्वमें व्यवस्थित वह ब्रह्मरूप आनन्द जानना चाहिए

verses.transliteration: pradadau darśanaṃ devo hy aghoro ghoravikramaḥ athāsya pārśvataḥ kṛṣṇāḥ kṛṣṇasraganulepanāḥ
verses.translation: By resorting to yoga they adored the great lord for a thousand years. They imparted instruction in supreme yoga to their disciples. By resorting to yoga these persons, endowed with yogic powers, thought on Siva. They entered the region of lord Siva, the region devoid of impurities and free from attributes. Those others too, who contemplate on him by resorting to yoga can go unto the region of that eternal lord.
verses.hindi: इस विश्वरूपा गायको अपने बुद्धि-विचारसे साक्षात् तदनन्तर ब्रह्माजीसे ऐसा कहकर परमेश्वर महादेवने कई कुमार सृजित किये और इस प्रकार देवीके समीपसे अनेक रूपोंवाले कुमार प्रकट हुए, जिनमें कोई जटाधारी था, कोई मुण्डितसिर था, कोई सिरपर शिखा धारण किये
verses.wordMeaning: By resorting to yoga they adored the great lord for a thousand years. They imparted instruction in supreme yoga to their disciples. By resorting to yoga these persons, endowed with yogic powers, thought on Siva. They entered the region of lord Siva,…
verses.commentary: Sense: By resorting to yoga they adored the great lord for a thousand years. They imparted instruction in supreme yoga to their disciples. By resorting to yoga these persons, endowed with yogic powers, thought on Siva. They entered the region of lord Siva,…

verses.sanskrit: चत्वारस्तु महात्मानः संबभूवुः कुमारकाः कृष्णः कृष्णशिखश्चैव कृष्णास्यः कृष्णवस्त्रधृक्
verses.transliteration: catvārastu mahātmānaḥ saṃbabhūvuḥ kumārakāḥ kṛṣṇaḥ kṛṣṇaśikhaścaiva kṛṣṇāsyaḥ kṛṣṇavastradhṛk
verses.translation: By resorting to yoga they adored the great lord for a thousand years. They imparted instruction in supreme yoga to their disciples. By resorting to yoga these persons, endowed with yogic powers, thought on Siva. They entered the region of lord Siva, the region devoid of impurities and free from attributes. Those others too, who contemplate on him by resorting to yoga can go unto the region of that eternal lord.
verses.hindi: था तथा कोई अर्धमुण्डित सिरवाला था । तदनन्तर सदाचारी, नियत आत्मावाले तथा महान् ओजसे सम्पन्न वे कुमार यथोक्त योगाभ्यास करते हुए देवताओंके एक हजार वर्षतक महेश्वरकी आराधना करके दृढ़ योगयुक्त सम्पूर्ण धर्मोका उपदेश अपने शिष्यों-प्रशिष्योंको देकर अन्तमें परमेश्वर शिष्टाशच नियतात्मानः प्रविष्टा रुद्रमीएवरम्॥ ३९  रुद्रमें प्रवेश कर गये॥ ३६--३९
verses.wordMeaning: By resorting to yoga they adored the great lord for a thousand years. They imparted instruction in supreme yoga to their disciples. By resorting to yoga these persons, endowed with yogic powers, thought on Siva. They entered the region of lord Siva,…
verses.commentary: Sense: By resorting to yoga they adored the great lord for a thousand years. They imparted instruction in supreme yoga to their disciples. By resorting to yoga these persons, endowed with yogic powers, thought on Siva. They entered the region of lord Siva,…

verses.sanskrit: ततो वर्षसहस्रं तु योगतः परमेश्वरम् उपासित्वा महायोगं शिष्येभ्यः प्रददुः पुनः
verses.transliteration: tato varṣasahasraṃ tu yogataḥ parameśvaram upāsitvā mahāyogaṃ śiṣyebhyaḥ pradaduḥ punaḥ
verses.translation: By resorting to yoga they adored the great lord for a thousand years. They imparted instruction in supreme yoga to their disciples. By resorting to yoga these persons, endowed with yogic powers, thought on Siva. They entered the region of lord Siva, the region devoid of impurities and free from attributes. Those others too, who contemplate on him by resorting to yoga can go unto the region of that eternal lord.
verses.hindi: कान्तिनीतिः प्रथा मेधा लज्जा दृष्टि: सरस्वती सैषा भगवती देवी मत्प्रसूतिः प्रतिष्ठिता।
verses.wordMeaning: By resorting to yoga they adored the great lord for a thousand years. They imparted instruction in supreme yoga to their disciples. By resorting to yoga these persons, endowed with yogic powers, thought on Siva. They entered the region of lord Siva,…
verses.commentary: Sense: By resorting to yoga they adored the great lord for a thousand years. They imparted instruction in supreme yoga to their disciples. By resorting to yoga these persons, endowed with yogic powers, thought on Siva. They entered the region of lord Siva,…

verses.sanskrit: योगेन योगसम्पन्नाः प्रविश्य मनसा शिवम् अमलं निर्गुणं स्थानं प्रविष्टा विश्वमीश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: yogena yogasampannāḥ praviśya manasā śivam amalaṃ nirguṇaṃ sthānaṃ praviṣṭā viśvamīśvaram
verses.translation: By resorting to yoga they adored the great lord for a thousand years. They imparted instruction in supreme yoga to their disciples. By resorting to yoga these persons, endowed with yogic powers, thought on Siva. They entered the region of lord Siva, the region devoid of impurities and free from attributes. Those others too, who contemplate on him by resorting to yoga can go unto the region of that eternal lord.
verses.hindi: गौरी माया च विद्या च कृष्णा हैमवतीति च। प्रधानं प्रकृतिश्चैव यामाहुस्तत्त्वचिन्तकाः अजामेकां लोहितां शुक्लकृष्णां
verses.wordMeaning: By resorting to yoga they adored the great lord for a thousand years. They imparted instruction in supreme yoga to their disciples. By resorting to yoga these persons, endowed with yogic powers, thought on Siva. They entered the region of lord Siva,…
verses.commentary: Sense: By resorting to yoga they adored the great lord for a thousand years. They imparted instruction in supreme yoga to their disciples. By resorting to yoga these persons, endowed with yogic powers, thought on Siva. They entered the region of lord Siva,…

verses.sanskrit: एवमेतेन योगेन ये ऽपि चान्ये मनीषिणः चिन्तयन्ति महादेवं गन्तारो रुद्रमव्ययम्
verses.transliteration: evametena yogena ye 'pi cānye manīṣiṇaḥ cintayanti mahādevaṃ gantāro rudramavyayam
verses.translation: By resorting to yoga they adored the great lord for a thousand years. They imparted instruction in supreme yoga to their disciples. By resorting to yoga these persons, endowed with yogic powers, thought on Siva. They entered the region of lord Siva, the region devoid of impurities and free from attributes. Those others too, who contemplate on him by resorting to yoga can go unto the region of that eternal lord.
verses.hindi: एवमुक्त्वा महादेवः ससर्ज परमेश्वर; । ततश्च पार्श्वगा देव्याः सर्वरूपकुमारकाः धर्मोपदेशमखिलं कृत्वा योगमयं दृढम्
verses.wordMeaning: By resorting to yoga they adored the great lord for a thousand years. They imparted instruction in supreme yoga to their disciples. By resorting to yoga these persons, endowed with yogic powers, thought on Siva. They entered the region of lord Siva,…
verses.commentary: Sense: By resorting to yoga they adored the great lord for a thousand years. They imparted instruction in supreme yoga to their disciples. By resorting to yoga these persons, endowed with yogic powers, thought on Siva. They entered the region of lord Siva,…

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तस्मिन् गते कल्पे कृष्णवर्णे भयानके तुष्टाव देवदेवेशं ब्रह्मा तं ब्रह्मरूपिणम्
verses.transliteration: tatastasmin gate kalpe kṛṣṇavarṇe bhayānake tuṣṭāva devadeveśaṃ brahmā taṃ brahmarūpiṇam
verses.translation: When the terrible kalpa of black colour passed by, Brahma eulogised the supreme lord in the form of Aghora.
verses.hindi: अध्याय १७ ब्रह्मा तथा विष्णुके समक्ष ज्योतिर्मय महालिङ्गका प्राकट्य“शिवरूपोंकी उत्पत्ति ब्रह्मा तथा विष्णुके समक्ष ज्योतिर्मय महालिङ्गका प्राकट्य, ब्रह्मा और विष्णुद्वारा हंस एवं वाराहरूप धारणकर लिङ्गके मूलस्थानका अन्वेषण, लिङ्गमध्यसे शब्दमय उमा- महेश्वरका प्रादुर्भाव और ईशानादि पाँच शिवरूपोंकी उत्पत्ति
verses.wordMeaning: When the terrible kalpa of black colour passed by, Brahma eulogised the supreme lord in the form of Aghora.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the terrible kalpa of black colour passed by, Brahma eulogised the supreme lord in the form of Aghora.

verses.sanskrit: अनुगृह्य ततस्तुष्टो ब्रह्माणमवदद्धरः अनेनैव तु रूपेण संहरामि न संशयः
verses.transliteration: anugṛhya tatastuṣṭo brahmāṇamavadaddharaḥ anenaiva tu rūpeṇa saṃharāmi na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: Thereafter the delighted lord Aghora blessed Brahmfi and said to him: Do not doubt that I, assiuning this form, destroy all kinds of sin, including the terrible sin of brahmin slaughter. O blessed one, O deity of virtuous sacred rites, I destroy ail minor and miyor sins of small or great power and
verses.hindi: स याति ब्रह्मसायुज्यं प्रसादात्परमेष्ठिनः। कथं लिङ्गमभूल्लिङ्गे समभ्यर्च्यः स शङ्करः
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter the delighted lord Aghora blessed Brahmfi and said to him: Do not doubt that I, assiuning this form, destroy all kinds of sin, including the terrible sin of brahmin slaughter. O blessed one, O deity of virtuous sacred rites,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter the delighted lord Aghora blessed Brahmfi and said to him: Do not doubt that I, assiuning this form, destroy all kinds of sin, including the terrible sin of brahmin slaughter. O blessed one, O deity of virtuous sacred rites,…

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्महत्यादिकान् घोरांस् तथान्यानपि पातकान् हीनांश्चैव महाभाग तथैव विविधान्यपि
verses.transliteration: brahmahatyādikān ghorāṃs tathānyānapi pātakān hīnāṃścaiva mahābhāga tathaiva vividhānyapi
verses.translation: O lord, by repeating one hundred thousand times the mantras of Aghora, even a brahmin-slayer is liberated from sins. O dear, for verbal sins half of this number is recom- mended. For mental sins, ludf of the previous number. If the sin is committed consciously the japa shall be four times that number. If the sin is committed out of fury, eight times that number. A slayer of a hero shall repeat the mantra a hundred thousand times; the destroyer of a child in the womb a crore times; a matricide a hundred thousand times; a destroyer of cows and women or an ungrateful wretch by repeat- ing ten thousand times; a willing or unwilling drinker of liquor by repeating a hundred thousand times or half that number and the partaker of meals before taking bath a thou- sand times. The brahmin who abstains from japa or who takes meals before performing the daily sacrifice or abstains from giving charity should repeat this mantra a thousand times. The base man who steals the property of a brahmin or who steals gold is released from sin by repeating this mantra mentally a hundred thousand times. A person defiling the preceptor's bed or slaying his own mother or a brahmin shall repeat this mantra mentally the same number of times, O Brahma.
verses.hindi: किं लिङ्गं कस्तथा लिङ्गी सूत वक्तुमिहार्हसि। एवं देवाश्च ऋषयः प्रणिपत्य पितामहम्
verses.wordMeaning: O lord, by repeating one hundred thousand times the mantras of Aghora, even a brahmin-slayer is liberated from sins. O dear, for verbal sins half of this number is recom- mended. For mental sins, ludf of the previous number.…
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord, by repeating one hundred thousand times the mantras of Aghora, even a brahmin-slayer is liberated from sins. O dear, for verbal sins half of this number is recom- mended. For mental sins, ludf of the previous number.…

verses.sanskrit: उपपातकमप्येवं तथा पापानि सुव्रत मानसानि सुतीक्ष्णानि वाचिकानि पितामह
verses.transliteration: upapātakamapyevaṃ tathā pāpāni suvrata mānasāni sutīkṣṇāni vācikāni pitāmaha
verses.translation: The sin resulting from contact with the sinner is equal to the sin of the original sinner. Still by repeating the mantra ten thousand times he is liberated from sin. The person imbibing sin by the contact with the sinner shall repeat the mantra a hundred thousand times if done mentally; if done in low tones four times that number; if in high tones eight times that number. It is enjoined that persons guilty of subsidiary sins need repeat the mantra only half the number enjoined for the main sinner; half that number if the sin is committed unconsciously. O brahmins, if a brahmin sinner commits the sin of brahmin slaughter, liquor drinking, theft of gold or defiling the preceptor's bed he ould do as fellows:
verses.hindi: अपृच्छन् भगवँल्लिङ्गं कथमासीदिति स्वयम्। लिङ्गे महेश्वरो रूद्रः समभ्यर्च्यः कथं त्विति ४ किं लिङ्ग कस्तथा लिङ्गी सोऽप्याह च पितामहः।
verses.wordMeaning: The sin resulting from contact with the sinner is equal to the sin of the original sinner. Still by repeating the mantra ten thousand times he is liberated from sin.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The sin resulting from contact with the sinner is equal to the sin of the original sinner. Still by repeating the mantra ten thousand times he is liberated from sin.…

verses.sanskrit: कायिकानि सुमिश्राणि तथा प्रासंगिकानि च बुद्धिपूर्वं कृतान्येव सहजागन्तुकानि च
verses.transliteration: kāyikāni sumiśrāṇi tathā prāsaṃgikāni ca buddhipūrvaṃ kṛtānyeva sahajāgantukāni ca
verses.translation: He should gather together (i) urine of a tawny coloured cow repeating Rudra-Gayatri,* (ii) freshly laid dung of the same or similar cow repeating the mantra Gandhadvara,** (iii ) ghee made from a similar cow repeating the mantra Tejosi ukram,®* (iv) milk from the same or similar cow repeat ing the mantra Apyayasva''® and (5) fresh curds made from the milk of the same or similar cow repeating the mantra Dadhikrana. To this mixture water taken with a tuft of kua grass should be added by repeating the mantra Devasya tva, and the mixture should be well stirred in a vessel made of gold, silver or copper, or in a cup made of lotus or palasa leaf, repeating the aghora mantra. In this vessel he should place (different) gems and a piece of gold along with a tuft of kusa grass.
verses.hindi: प्रधानं लिङ्गमाख्यातं लिङ्गी च परमेश्वर: वैमानिके गते सर्गे जनलोकं सहर्षिभिः ६
verses.wordMeaning: He should gather together (i) urine of a tawny coloured cow repeating Rudra-Gayatri,* (ii) freshly laid dung of the same or similar cow repeating the mantra Gandhadvara,** (iii ) ghee made from a similar cow repeating the mantra Tejosi ukram,®* (iv) milk from the same or similar…
verses.commentary: Sense: He should gather together (i) urine of a tawny coloured cow repeating Rudra-Gayatri,* (ii) freshly laid dung of the same or similar cow repeating the mantra Gandhadvara,** (iii ) ghee made from a similar cow repeating the mantra Tejosi ukram,®* (iv) milk from the same or similar…

verses.sanskrit: मातृदेहोत्थितान्येवं पितृदेहे च पातकम् संहरामि न संदेहः सर्वं पातकजं विभो
verses.transliteration: mātṛdehotthitānyevaṃ pitṛdehe ca pātakam saṃharāmi na saṃdehaḥ sarvaṃ pātakajaṃ vibho
verses.translation: He should repeat the mantra of Aghora a hundred thousand times and perform homa with ghee, cooked rice, sacrificial twigs, gingelly seeds, barley grains and unhusked grains. He should perform homa, seven times separately with each one of these materials. If the materials are not available he should perform homa with ghee alone. O brahmins, he should perform homas as well as ablution for the lord with ghee while repeating the Aghora Mantra. He should bathe the lord with eight drona'® measures of ghee and wipe it off. He should then observe fast for a whole day and night, take holy bath and drink kurca before the image of Siva. After performing the rite of acamana he should repeat Gayatrl.
verses.hindi: स्थितिकाले तदा पूर्णे ततः प्रत्याहते तथा। चतुर्युगसहस्त्रान्ते सत्यलोकं गते सुराः विनाधिपत्यं समतां गतेऽन्ते ब्रह्मणो मम। शुष्के च स्थावरे सर्वे त्वनावृष्ट्या च सर्वशः ८
verses.wordMeaning: He should repeat the mantra of Aghora a hundred thousand times and perform homa with ghee, cooked rice, sacrificial twigs, gingelly seeds, barley grains and unhusked grains. He should perform homa, seven times separately with each one of these materials.…
verses.commentary: Sense: He should repeat the mantra of Aghora a hundred thousand times and perform homa with ghee, cooked rice, sacrificial twigs, gingelly seeds, barley grains and unhusked grains. He should perform homa, seven times separately with each one of these materials.…

verses.sanskrit: लक्षं जप्त्वा ह्यघोरेभ्यो ब्रह्महा मुच्यते प्रभो तदर्धं वाचिके वत्स तदर्धं मानसे पुनः
verses.transliteration: lakṣaṃ japtvā hyaghorebhyo brahmahā mucyate prabho tadardhaṃ vācike vatsa tadardhaṃ mānase punaḥ
verses.translation: By performing this the following sinners become libe- rated form sins: — an ungrateful person, a slayer of brahmin, a destroyer of a child in the womb, a murderer of a warrior, a slayer of preceptor, a betrayer of faith, a thief, a gold-stealer, a defiler of the preceptor's bed, a liquor-addict, a paramour, a low-caste woman, a ravisher of other men's wives, a destroyer of brahmin's property, a cow-killer, a matricide, a patricide, an idol-breaker
verses.hindi: एकार्णवे महाघोरे तमोभूते समन्ततः। सुष्वापाम्भसि योगात्मा निर्मलो निरुपप्लवः सूतजी बोले- है मुनियो! इस प्रकार मैंने शिवजीके सद्योजात आदि अवतारोंका वर्णन संक्षेपमें कर दिया। जो इसे पढ़ता है, सुनता है अथवा श्रेष्ठ द्विजों (ब्राह्मण, क्षत्रिय, वैश्य)-को सुनाता है, वह शिवजीके अनुग्रहसे
verses.wordMeaning: By performing this the following sinners become libe- rated form sins: — an ungrateful person, a slayer of brahmin, a destroyer of a child in the womb, a murderer of a warrior, a slayer of preceptor, a betrayer of faith, a thief, a gold-stealer,…
verses.commentary: Sense: By performing this the following sinners become libe- rated form sins: — an ungrateful person, a slayer of brahmin, a destroyer of a child in the womb, a murderer of a warrior, a slayer of preceptor, a betrayer of faith, a thief, a gold-stealer,…

verses.sanskrit: चतुर्गुणं बुद्धिपूर्वे क्रोधादष्टगुणं स्मृतम् वीरहा लक्षमात्रेण भ्रूणहा कोटिमभ्यसेत्
verses.transliteration: caturguṇaṃ buddhipūrve krodhādaṣṭaguṇaṃ smṛtam vīrahā lakṣamātreṇa bhrūṇahā koṭimabhyaset
verses.translation: TA. lo.i.io; MahSn. U. 4.8.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्मसायुज्यको प्राप्त होता है॥ १ /२॥ ऋषिगण बोले-हे सूतजी! लिङ्गको उत्पत्ति किस प्रकार हुई तथा उस लिङ्गमें शंकरजीकी उपासना कैसे की जानी चाहिए? लिङ्ग क्या है तथा लिङ्गी कौन है? यह आप हमें बताइये ॥ २ /२॥
verses.wordMeaning: TA. lo.i.io; MahSn. U. 4.8.
verses.commentary: Sense: TA. lo.i.io; MahSn. U. 4.8.

verses.sanskrit: मातृहा नियुतं जप्त्वा शुध्यते नात्र संशयः गोघ्नश्चैव कृतघ्नश् च स्त्रीघ्नः पापयुतो नरः
verses.transliteration: mātṛhā niyutaṃ japtvā śudhyate nātra saṃśayaḥ goghnaścaiva kṛtaghnaś ca strīghnaḥ pāpayuto naraḥ
verses.hindi: रोमहर्षण  सूतजी  बोले-हे ऋषियो! इसी प्रकार अत्यन्त निवेदनपूर्वक देवताओंने भी पितामह ब्रह्मासे पूछा था कि है भगवन्! यह लिङ्ग कैसे उत्पन्न हुआ तथा लिङ्गमें महेश्वर रुद्रका किस प्रकार पूजन होना चाहिए? लिङ्ग क्या है तथा लिङ्गी कौन है? इसपर वे ब्रह्मा बोले॥ ३-४ /२॥

verses.sanskrit: स्तेयी सुवर्णस्तेयी च गुरुतल्परतः सदा मद्यपो वृषलीसक्तः परदारविधर्षकः
verses.transliteration: steyī suvarṇasteyī ca gurutalparataḥ sadā madyapo vṛṣalīsaktaḥ paradāravidharṣakaḥ
verses.translation: It is a measure of four Xhakas equal to X024 muffis.
verses.hindi: कारण शीघ्र बताओ॥ २०-२१/२॥ इसपर उन्होंने भी मुझसे कहा-सम्पूर्ण जगतका सृष्टिकर्ता, पालनकर्ता तथा संहारकर्ता मैं (विष्णु) ही हूँ, ऐसा जानो और तुमने भी मुझ शाश्वत परमेश्वरके अंगसे ही अवतार ग्रहण किया है। फिर भी तुम मुझ
verses.wordMeaning: It is a measure of four Xhakas equal to X024 muffis.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is a measure of four Xhakas equal to X024 muffis.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मस्वहा तथा गोघ्नो मातृहा पितृहा तथा देवप्रच्यावकश्चैव लिङ्गप्रध्वंसकस् तथा
verses.transliteration: brahmasvahā tathā goghno mātṛhā pitṛhā tathā devapracyāvakaścaiva liṅgapradhvaṃsakas tathā
verses.translation: It is a measure of four Xhakas equal to X024 muffis.
verses.hindi: जगत्पति, नारायण, रोग-विकाररहित, परम पुरुष, परमात्मा, सभीसे आवाहित होनेवाले, पुरुष्टुत, अच्युत, ऐश्वर्यसम्पन्न तथा विश्वकी उत्पत्तिके कारणस्वरूप मुझ विष्णुको भूल गये हो, किंतु इसमें तुम्हारा कोई अपराध नहीं है। यह सब तो मेरी मायाद्वारा रचा गया है॥ २२-२४ /२॥
verses.wordMeaning: It is a measure of four Xhakas equal to X024 muffis.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is a measure of four Xhakas equal to X024 muffis.

verses.sanskrit: तथान्यानि च पापानि मानसानि द्विजो यदि वाचिकानि तथान्यानि कायिकानि सहस्रशः
verses.transliteration: tathānyāni ca pāpāni mānasāni dvijo yadi vācikāni tathānyāni kāyikāni sahasraśaḥ
verses.translation: It is a measure of four Xhakas equal to X024 muffis.
verses.hindi: हे चार मुखवाले ब्रह्मन्! तुम यह सत्य जानो कि सृष्टिका कर्ता, पालक, संहारक तथा सभी देवताओंका स्वामी मैं ही हूँ। मेरे सदृश ऐश्वर्यवाला और कोई नहीं हे पितामह! मैं ही परम ब्रह्म हूँ, में ही परम तत्त्व
verses.wordMeaning: It is a measure of four Xhakas equal to X024 muffis.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is a measure of four Xhakas equal to X024 muffis.

verses.sanskrit: कृत्वा विमुच्यते सद्यो जन्मान्तरशतैरपि एतद्रहस्यं कथितम् अघोरेशप्रसंगतः
verses.transliteration: kṛtvā vimucyate sadyo janmāntaraśatairapi etadrahasyaṃ kathitam aghoreśaprasaṃgataḥ
verses.translation: It is a measure of four Xhakas equal to X024 muffis.
verses.hindi: हे चतुर्मुख! इस जगतूमें जो भी समस्त स्थावर- जंगम वस्तुएँ दिखायी पड़ रही हैं अथवा जिनके बारेमें सुना जाता है; उन सबको मुझसे व्याप्त किया हुआ प्राचीन कालमें मैंने ही स्वयं चौबीस तत्त्वमय व्यक्त सृष्टि रची है। नित्य अन्तको प्राप्त होनेवाले सूक्ष्मातिसूक्ष्म बद्धजीव, क्रोधसे उत्पन्न अन्यान्य तामसी सृष्टि तथा आप (ब्रह्मा)-सहित अनेक ब्रह्माण्ड मेरी
verses.wordMeaning: It is a measure of four Xhakas equal to X024 muffis.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is a measure of four Xhakas equal to X024 muffis.

verses.sanskrit: तस्माज्जपेद्द्विजो नित्यं सर्वपापविशुद्धये
verses.transliteration: tasmājjapeddvijo nityaṃ sarvapāpaviśuddhaye
verses.translation: It is a measure of four Xhakas equal to X024 muffis.
verses.hindi: मायाके प्रभावसे ही विरचित हें मैंने बुद्धिकी रचना की है तथा उसमें तीन प्रकारके अहंकारों (सात्त्विक, राजस, तामस)-का निर्माण किया है। इसी प्रकार अपनी मायासे पाँच तन्मात्राएँ एवं मन, इन्द्रिया, आकाश आदि पाँच
verses.wordMeaning: It is a measure of four Xhakas equal to X024 muffis.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is a measure of four Xhakas equal to X024 muffis.

verses.sanskrit: अथान्यो ब्रह्मणः कल्पो वर्तते मुनिपुङ्गवाः विश्वरूप इति ख्यातो नामतः परमाद्भुतः
verses.transliteration: athānyo brahmaṇaḥ kalpo vartate munipuṅgavāḥ viśvarūpa iti khyāto nāmataḥ paramādbhutaḥ
verses.translation: When the period of dissolution passed by, when again the universe of mobile and immobile beings came into existence Brahma began to meditate with a desire for sons. Then Sarasvati of universal form and loud sound manifested herself. The universe constituted her garlands, garments, sacred thread and turban. The mother of the universe with all universal scents and long lips manifested herself, Brahma meditated on lord Tirana resembling pure crystal and bedecked in all orna- ments. With concentrated mind, Brahmi paid homage to Isma, the omnipresent lord of all— Om O Ii$ana, O Mahadeva, obeisance be to you. O lord of all learning, obeisance be to you. O lord, with the bull as your conveyance, obeisance be to you. O lord of living beings, obeisance be to you.
verses.hindi: महाभूतोंकी सृष्टि मैंने ही की है॥ ३० /२॥ यह वचन कहनेके अनन्तर रजोगुणकी वृद्धिसे परस्पर शत्रुता-भावको प्राप्त हम दोनोंमें उस प्रलय-सागरके मध्य भीषण रोमांचकारी संग्राम होने लगा
verses.wordMeaning: When the period of dissolution passed by, when again the universe of mobile and immobile beings came into existence Brahma began to meditate with a desire for sons. Then Sarasvati of universal form and loud sound manifested herself. The universe constituted her garlands,…
verses.commentary: Sense: When the period of dissolution passed by, when again the universe of mobile and immobile beings came into existence Brahma began to meditate with a desire for sons. Then Sarasvati of universal form and loud sound manifested herself. The universe constituted her garlands,…

verses.sanskrit: विनिवृत्ते तु संहारे पुनः सृष्टे चराचरे ब्रह्मणः पुत्रकामस्य ध्यायतः परमेष्ठिनः
verses.transliteration: vinivṛtte tu saṃhāre punaḥ sṛṣṭe carācare brahmaṇaḥ putrakāmasya dhyāyataḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ
verses.translation: O overlord of Brahma, obeisance be to you. Obeisance to Brahman in the form of Brahma. Obeisance to the overlord of Brahma. O Sadaiva, may auspiciousness befall me.
verses.hindi: इसी बीच हम दोनोंके कलहको दूर करने तथा पापापापापाधातरालापाधापापापापापाफाफफफफ फफ
verses.wordMeaning: O overlord of Brahma, obeisance be to you. Obeisance to Brahman in the form of Brahma. Obeisance to the overlord of Brahma. O Sadaiva, may auspiciousness befall me.
verses.commentary: Sense: O overlord of Brahma, obeisance be to you. Obeisance to Brahman in the form of Brahma. Obeisance to the overlord of Brahma. O Sadaiva, may auspiciousness befall me.

verses.sanskrit: प्रादुर्भूता महानादा विश्वरूपा सरस्वती विश्वमाल्यांबरधरा विश्वयज्ञोपवीतिनी
verses.transliteration: prādurbhūtā mahānādā viśvarūpā sarasvatī viśvamālyāṃbaradharā viśvayajñopavītinī
verses.translation: O lord representing oxhktrain a physical form, O lord of devas, O Sadyojata, obeisance be to you, I resort to you. I have resorted to SadyojSta. Obeisance to Sadyojata.
verses.hindi: ज्वालामालासहस्त्राढ्यं कालानलशतोपमम्। तस्य ज्वालासहस्रेण मोहितो भगवान् हरिः
verses.wordMeaning: O lord representing oxhktrain a physical form, O lord of devas, O Sadyojata, obeisance be to you, I resort to you. I have resorted to SadyojSta. Obeisance to Sadyojata.
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord representing oxhktrain a physical form, O lord of devas, O Sadyojata, obeisance be to you, I resort to you. I have resorted to SadyojSta. Obeisance to Sadyojata.

verses.sanskrit: विश्वोष्णीषा विश्वगन्धा विश्वमाता महोष्ठिका तथाविधं स भगवान् ईशानं परमेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: viśvoṣṇīṣā viśvagandhā viśvamātā mahoṣṭhikā tathāvidhaṃ sa bhagavān īśānaṃ parameśvaram
verses.translation: Obeisance to you, the unborn, the source of birth and who are not beyond the worldly existence. O Bhava, O IIna, O source of the worlds, O deity of great lustre, bless me.
verses.hindi: एवं व्याहृत्य विश्वात्मा स्वरूपमकरोत्तदा हंस हंसेति यो ब्रूयान्मां हंसः स भविष्यति। सुश्वेतो ह्यनलाक्षश्च विश्वतः पक्षसंयुतः
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to you, the unborn, the source of birth and who are not beyond the worldly existence. O Bhava, O IIna, O source of the worlds, O deity of great lustre, bless me.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to you, the unborn, the source of birth and who are not beyond the worldly existence. O Bhava, O IIna, O source of the worlds, O deity of great lustre, bless me.

verses.sanskrit: शुद्धस्फटिकसंकाशं सर्वाभरणभूषितम् अथ तं मनसा ध्यात्वा युक्तात्मा वै पितामहः
verses.transliteration: śuddhasphaṭikasaṃkāśaṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitam atha taṃ manasā dhyātvā yuktātmā vai pitāmahaḥ
verses.translation: O V&madeva, obeisance to you, the eldest being, the granter of boons. Obeisance to Rudra, Kala the reckoner of time*
verses.hindi: कालादित्यसमाभासं दीर्घघोणं महास्वनम्। हृस्वपादं विचित्राङ्गं जैत्र दृढमनौपमम् एवं वर्षसहस्त्रं तु त्वरन् विष्णुरधोगतः
verses.wordMeaning: O V&madeva, obeisance to you, the eldest being, the granter of boons. Obeisance to Rudra, Kala the reckoner of time*
verses.commentary: Sense: O V&madeva, obeisance to you, the eldest being, the granter of boons. Obeisance to Rudra, Kala the reckoner of time*

verses.sanskrit: ववन्दे देवमीशानं सर्वेशं सर्वगं प्रभुम् ओमीशान नमस्ते ऽस्तु महादेव नमो ऽस्तु ते
verses.transliteration: vavande devamīśānaṃ sarveśaṃ sarvagaṃ prabhum omīśāna namaste 'stu mahādeva namo 'stu te
verses.translation: Obeisance to the lord as the mind, to the lord black in colour, to the lord as a religious student, to the lord as the strength of the strong and to the lord devoid of organs and their function.
verses.hindi: नापश्यदल्पमप्यस्य मूलं लिङ्गस्य सूकरः। तावत्कालं गतो : श्रान्तो ह्यदृष्ट्वा तस्यान्तमहङ्कारादधोगतः
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to the lord as the mind, to the lord black in colour, to the lord as a religious student, to the lord as the strength of the strong and to the lord devoid of organs and their function.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to the lord as the mind, to the lord black in colour, to the lord as a religious student, to the lord as the strength of the strong and to the lord devoid of organs and their function.

verses.sanskrit: नमो ऽस्तु सर्वविद्यानाम् ईशान परमेश्वर नमो ऽस्तु सर्वभूतानाम् ईशान वृषवाहन
verses.transliteration: namo 'stu sarvavidyānām īśāna parameśvara namo 'stu sarvabhūtānām īśāna vṛṣavāhana
verses.translation: Obeisance to the suppressor of Bala, to the strong, of the form of Brahman. Obeisance to the overlord, the suppressor of living beings.
verses.hindi: ज्ञान प्रदान करनेके निमित्त एक दीप्तिमान् लिङ्ग हमलोगोंके समक्ष प्रकट हुआ। वह लिङ्ग हजारों अग्नि-ज्चालाओंसे व्याप्त, सैकड़ों कालाग्निके सदृश, क्षय तथा वृद्धे रहित, आदि-मध्य-अन्तसे हीन, अतुलनीय, अवर्णनीय, अव्यक्त तथा विश्वका उत्पत्तिकर्तारूप था॥ ३३-३४/२॥
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to the suppressor of Bala, to the strong, of the form of Brahman. Obeisance to the overlord, the suppressor of living beings.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to the suppressor of Bala, to the strong, of the form of Brahman. Obeisance to the overlord, the suppressor of living beings.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मणो ऽधिपते तुभ्यं ब्रह्मणे ब्रह्मरूपिणे नमो ब्रह्माधिपतये शिवं मे ऽस्तु सदाशिव
verses.transliteration: brahmaṇo 'dhipate tubhyaṃ brahmaṇe brahmarūpiṇe namo brahmādhipataye śivaṃ me 'stu sadāśiva
verses.translation: Obeisance to the lord the impeller of the mind, obeisance to the lord of great lustre, obeisance to the refulgent Vamadeva and to the supreme soul.
verses.hindi: उस लिङ्गकी हजारों ज्चालाओंसे भगवान् विष्णु तथा मैं-दोनों लोग मोहित हो गये। फिर विष्णुने मुझसे कहा कि हमें अग्नि-उद्धत इस लिङ्गका पता लगाना चाहिए। एतदर्थ मैं इस अनृपम अग्नि-स्तम्भके नीचे जाता हूँ और आप प्रयत्नपूर्वक शीघ्र इसके ऊपर
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to the lord the impeller of the mind, obeisance to the lord of great lustre, obeisance to the refulgent Vamadeva and to the supreme soul.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to the lord the impeller of the mind, obeisance to the lord of great lustre, obeisance to the refulgent Vamadeva and to the supreme soul.

verses.sanskrit: ओङ्कारमूर्ते देवेश सद्योजात नमोनमः प्रपद्ये त्वां प्रपन्नो ऽस्मि सद्योजाताय वै नमः
verses.transliteration: oṅkāramūrte deveśa sadyojāta namonamaḥ prapadye tvāṃ prapanno 'smi sadyojātāya vai namaḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to the eldest and the greatest; obeisance to Rudra the bestower of boons. Obeisance to you the slayer of Kala. Obeisance to you possessed of the noble soul.
verses.hindi: हे देवताओ! ऐसा कहकर विश्वात्मा भगवान् विष्णुने वाराहका रूप धारण कर लिया और मैं भी शीघ्र हंसके रूपको प्राप्त हो गया। उसी समयसे मुझ ब्रह्माकों विराट् रूपवाले भगवान् विष्णु 'हंस' कहने लगे। जो प्राणी 'हंस-हंस' नामसे मेरा कीर्तन करता है, वह हंसत्वको प्राप्त हो जाता है ॥ ३७-३८ /२॥
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to the eldest and the greatest; obeisance to Rudra the bestower of boons. Obeisance to you the slayer of Kala. Obeisance to you possessed of the noble soul.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to the eldest and the greatest; obeisance to Rudra the bestower of boons. Obeisance to you the slayer of Kala. Obeisance to you possessed of the noble soul.

verses.sanskrit: अभवे च भवे तुभ्यं तथा नातिभवे नमः भवोद्भव भवेशान मां भजस्व महाद्युते
verses.transliteration: abhave ca bhave tubhyaṃ tathā nātibhave namaḥ bhavodbhava bhaveśāna māṃ bhajasva mahādyute
verses.translation: With this prayer he bowed to the lord of Devas, to the God with the Bull as his emblem. He who reads this narrative even once becomes entitled to the world of Brahma.
verses.hindi: हे देवताओ! उस समय मैं अत्यन्त श्वेत वर्णका था, मेरे नेत्र अग्निके समान थे और मैं सभी ओरसे पंखोंसे युक्त था--इस प्रकार हंसरूपमें मैं मनरूपी वायुके वेगसे उड़कर ऊपरकी ओर गया॥ ३९ १/॥ उधर विश्वात्मा नारायण विष्णु भी दस योजन चौड़े तथा शत योजन लम्बे और नीले अंजनके
verses.wordMeaning: With this prayer he bowed to the lord of Devas, to the God with the Bull as his emblem. He who reads this narrative even once becomes entitled to the world of Brahma.
verses.commentary: Sense: With this prayer he bowed to the lord of Devas, to the God with the Bull as his emblem. He who reads this narrative even once becomes entitled to the world of Brahma.

verses.sanskrit: वामदेव नमस्तुभ्यं ज्येष्ठाय वरदाय च नमो रुद्राय कालाय कलनाय नमो नमः
verses.transliteration: vāmadeva namastubhyaṃ jyeṣṭhāya varadāya ca namo rudrāya kālāya kalanāya namo namaḥ
verses.translation: Listen to a great secret. As in the first creation, the Jkalpa that is current now is known as Vivariipa. O lord (Brahmfi) there Is the region of Brahma which you have attained. O lord! beyond that region there is an auspicious region occupied by Vifnu bom of my left limb. Since that time, this the thirtythird kalpa has begun.
verses.hindi: विचित्र अंगोंवाले, प्रलयकालीन सूर्यके समान प्रकाशमान, कृष्णवाराहका रूप धारण करके उस अग्नि-स्तम्भ (लिङ्ग)-के नीचेकी ओर गये॥ ४०--४२१/, ॥
verses.wordMeaning: Listen to a great secret. As in the first creation, the Jkalpa that is current now is known as Vivariipa. O lord (Brahmfi) there Is the region of Brahma which you have attained. O lord! beyond that region there is an auspicious region occupied by Vifnu bom of my left limb.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Listen to a great secret. As in the first creation, the Jkalpa that is current now is known as Vivariipa. O lord (Brahmfi) there Is the region of Brahma which you have attained. O lord! beyond that region there is an auspicious region occupied by Vifnu bom of my left limb.…

verses.sanskrit: नमो विकरणायैव कालवर्णाय वर्णिने बलाय बलिनां नित्यं सदा विकरणाय ते
verses.transliteration: namo vikaraṇāyaiva kālavarṇāya varṇine balāya balināṃ nityaṃ sadā vikaraṇāya te
verses.translation: O lord of Devas possessed of great intellect, before you, hundreds and hundred thousands of Brahmis have passed away. Now listen.
verses.hindi: इस प्रकार विष्णुभगवान् एक हजार वर्षतक वेगपूर्वक नीचेको ओर जाते रहे, किंतु बाराहरूप विष्णु इस लिङ्गके मूलका अल्पांश भी नहीं देख सके शत्रुओंका दमन करनेवाला मैं ब्रह्मा भी उस लिङ्गका अन्त जाननेकी इच्छासे पूरे प्रयासके साथ शीघ्रतापूर्वक ऊपरकी ओर जाता रहा॥ ४४/२ ॥
verses.wordMeaning: O lord of Devas possessed of great intellect, before you, hundreds and hundred thousands of Brahmis have passed away. Now listen.
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord of Devas possessed of great intellect, before you, hundreds and hundred thousands of Brahmis have passed away. Now listen.

verses.sanskrit: बलप्रमथनायैव बलिने ब्रह्मरूपिणे सर्वभूतेश्वरेशाय भूतानां दमनाय च
verses.transliteration: balapramathanāyaiva baline brahmarūpiṇe sarvabhūteśvareśāya bhūtānāṃ damanāya ca
verses.translation: You who are a devotee of the spiritual lineage of Mandavya have attained the state of my son by practising penance. Stabilised in bliss you can realize the supreme bliss,
verses.hindi: १७ ब्रह्मा तथा विष्णुके समक्ष ज्योतिर्मय महालिङ्गका प्राकट्यशिवरूपोंकी उत्पत्ति तथैव भगवान् विष्णुः श्रान्तः सन्त्रस्तलोचन: । सर्वदेवभवस्तूर्णमुत्थिः स महावपु:
verses.wordMeaning: You who are a devotee of the spiritual lineage of Mandavya have attained the state of my son by practising penance. Stabilised in bliss you can realize the supreme bliss,
verses.commentary: Sense: You who are a devotee of the spiritual lineage of Mandavya have attained the state of my son by practising penance. Stabilised in bliss you can realize the supreme bliss,

verses.sanskrit: मनोन्मनाय देवाय नमस्तुभ्यं महाद्युते वामदेवाय वामाय नमस्तुभ्यं महात्मने
verses.transliteration: manonmanāya devāya namastubhyaṃ mahādyute vāmadevāya vāmāya namastubhyaṃ mahātmane
verses.translation: O lord, you are characterized by the following qualities: (1) Yoga, (2) Sankhya, (3) penance, (4) learning (5) Sastric injunctions, (6) holy rites (7) pleasant speech, (8) truth, (9) mercifulness, (10) Vcdic knowledge, (11) non- violence, (12) wisdom, (13) forbearance, (14) meditation, (15) proximity with the lord, (16)control of the senses, (17) quiescence, (18) intelligence, (19) illusion, (20) intellect, (21) fortitude, (22) splendour, (23) ethics, (24) fame, (25) intelli- gence, (26) modesty, (27) vision, (28) auspicious speech, (29) satisfaction, (30) skill in the exercise of sense-organs, (31) performance of Vedic rites, and (32) pleasure. While she, the goddess, has these thirtytwo qualities recognizable in her appellation of thirtytwo syllables.
verses.hindi: लिङ्गस्य दक्षिणे भागे तदापश्यत्सनातनम् आद्यवर्णमकारं तु उकारं चोत्तरे ततः। मकारं मध्यतश्चैव नादान्तं तस्य चोमिति
verses.wordMeaning: O lord, you are characterized by the following qualities: (1) Yoga, (2) Sankhya, (3) penance, (4) learning (5) Sastric injunctions, (6) holy rites (7) pleasant speech, (8) truth, (9) mercifulness, (10) Vcdic knowledge, (11) non- violence, (12) wisdom, (13) forbearance,…
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord, you are characterized by the following qualities: (1) Yoga, (2) Sankhya, (3) penance, (4) learning (5) Sastric injunctions, (6) holy rites (7) pleasant speech, (8) truth, (9) mercifulness, (10) Vcdic knowledge, (11) non- violence, (12) wisdom, (13) forbearance,…

verses.sanskrit: ज्येष्ठाय चैव श्रेष्ठाय रुद्राय वरदाय च कालहन्त्रे नमस्तुभ्यं नमस्तुभ्यं महात्मने
verses.transliteration: jyeṣṭhāya caiva śreṣṭhāya rudrāya varadāya ca kālahantre namastubhyaṃ namastubhyaṃ mahātmane
verses.translation: O Brahma, the goddess Prakfti, the source of your origin has been created by me. She is the overlord of Vi§nu and other gods. She is my progeny. Philosophers call her by various names, the four-faced deity, the origin of the universe, primordial nature, cow or speech, Gauri, Maya, Vidya, Krsna, Haimavati, Pradhana or Prakrti.
verses.hindi: उत्तरे पावकप्रख्यमुकारं पुरुषर्षभः शीतांशुमण्डलप्रख्यं मकारं मध्यमं तथा। तस्योपरि तदापश्यच्छुद्धस्फटिकवत्प्रभुम्
verses.wordMeaning: O Brahma, the goddess Prakfti, the source of your origin has been created by me. She is the overlord of Vi§nu and other gods. She is my progeny. Philosophers call her by various names, the four-faced deity, the origin of the universe, primordial nature, cow or speech, Gauri,…
verses.commentary: Sense: O Brahma, the goddess Prakfti, the source of your origin has been created by me. She is the overlord of Vi§nu and other gods. She is my progeny. Philosophers call her by various names, the four-faced deity, the origin of the universe, primordial nature, cow or speech, Gauri,…

verses.sanskrit: इति स्तवेन देवेशं ननाम वृषभध्वजम् यः पठेत् सकृदेवेह ब्रह्मलोकं गमिष्यति
verses.transliteration: iti stavena deveśaṃ nanāma vṛṣabhadhvajam yaḥ paṭhet sakṛdeveha brahmalokaṃ gamiṣyati
verses.translation: She alone is unborn.'® She is red, white and black in colour; She creates subjects in the universe that arc of the form as she herself. I am unborn, know me to be omnipresent and know her to be Gayatri of universal form.
verses.hindi: निर्हनद्रं केवलं शून्यं बाह्याभ्यन्तरवजितम् आदिमध्यान्तरहितमानन्दस्यापि कारणम्
verses.wordMeaning: She alone is unborn.'® She is red, white and black in colour; She creates subjects in the universe that arc of the form as she herself. I am unborn, know me to be omnipresent and know her to be Gayatri of universal form.
verses.commentary: Sense: She alone is unborn.'® She is red, white and black in colour; She creates subjects in the universe that arc of the form as she herself. I am unborn, know me to be omnipresent and know her to be Gayatri of universal form.

verses.sanskrit: श्रावयेद्वा द्विजान् श्राद्धे स याति परमां गतिम् एवं ध्यानगतं तत्र प्रणमन्तं पितामहम्
verses.transliteration: śrāvayedvā dvijān śrāddhe sa yāti paramāṃ gatim evaṃ dhyānagataṃ tatra praṇamantaṃ pitāmaham
verses.translation: TA.io.i; Mah&n. U. 9.2, Svet. U 4.5,
verses.hindi: मात्रास्तिस्त्रस्त्वर्धमात्रं नादाख्यं ब्रह्मसंज्ञितम्। TO कक का प का फ फ काका क आक का फफ काका का फ काका कफ कफ फ कफ कक पापाफाफफफफफफफफफफफ फफफफफफ फफ फफ फ फ फ फ फ फ़ फ फ फ़ फ़ फ फ़ फ़ फ फ फ़ फ फ़ फ़ फ फ फ़ फा फ़ फ फ फ फा छ
verses.wordMeaning: TA.io.i; Mah&n. U. 9.2, Svet. U 4.5,
verses.commentary: Sense: TA.io.i; Mah&n. U. 9.2, Svet. U 4.5,

verses.sanskrit: उवाच भगवानीशः प्रीतो ऽहं ते किमिच्छसि ततस्तु प्रणतो भूत्वा वाग्विशुद्धं महेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: uvāca bhagavānīśaḥ prīto 'haṃ te kimicchasi tatastu praṇato bhūtvā vāgviśuddhaṃ maheśvaram
verses.translation: TA.io.i; Mah&n. U. 9.2, Svet. U 4.5,
verses.hindi: तत्पश्चात् अहंकारपूर्वक ऊपर गया हुआ मैं उस लिङ्गका अन्त न देखकर अत्यन्त थका हुआ नीचे लौट आया और उसी प्रकार सभी देवताओंके उद्धवकर्ता तथा महान् शरीरवाले वे भगवान् विष्णु भी थकान एवं सन्त्रासभरे नेत्रोंक साथ लिङ्गका मूल न पाकर नीचेसे ऊपर आ गये
verses.wordMeaning: TA.io.i; Mah&n. U. 9.2, Svet. U 4.5,
verses.commentary: Sense: TA.io.i; Mah&n. U. 9.2, Svet. U 4.5,

verses.sanskrit: उवाच भगवान् रुद्रं प्रीतं प्रीतेन चेतसा यदिदं विश्वरूपं ते विश्वगौः श्रेयसीश्वरी
verses.transliteration: uvāca bhagavān rudraṃ prītaṃ prītena cetasā yadidaṃ viśvarūpaṃ te viśvagauḥ śreyasīśvarī
verses.translation: TA.io.i; Mah&n. U. 9.2, Svet. U 4.5,
verses.hindi: शंकरकी मायासे मोहको प्राप्त वे महामना विष्णु मेरे साथ आकर परमेश्वरको प्रणाम करके व्याकुल मनसे खड़े हो गये। इसके बाद मेरे साथ पुनः परमेश्वरको पीछेसे, बगलसे तथा आगेसे प्रणाम करके वे विचार करने लगे कि आदि-अन्तहीन यह क्या है ?
verses.wordMeaning: TA.io.i; Mah&n. U. 9.2, Svet. U 4.5,
verses.commentary: Sense: TA.io.i; Mah&n. U. 9.2, Svet. U 4.5,

verses.sanskrit: एतद्वेदितुमिच्छामि यथेयं परमेश्वर कैषा भगवती देवी चतुष्पादा चतुर्मुखी
verses.transliteration: etadveditumicchāmi yatheyaṃ parameśvara kaiṣā bhagavatī devī catuṣpādā caturmukhī
verses.translation: TA.io.i; Mah&n. U. 9.2, Svet. U 4.5,
verses.hindi: हे श्रेष्ठ देवताओ! उसी समय वहाँ प्लुत स्वरसे यह तीव्र शब्द क्या है-- ऐसा मेरे साथ विचार करते हुए वे विष्णु खडे रहे। तभी उन्होंने उस ' ओम्' नादके अन्तमें लिङ्गके दक्षिण भागमें सनातन आदि वर्ण अकार, उसके उत्तर भागमें उकार तथा उसके मध्यमें
verses.wordMeaning: TA.io.i; Mah&n. U. 9.2, Svet. U 4.5,
verses.commentary: Sense: TA.io.i; Mah&n. U. 9.2, Svet. U 4.5,

verses.sanskrit: चतुःशृङ्गी चतुर्वक्त्रा चतुर्दंष्ट्रा चतुःस्तनी चतुर्हस्ता चतुर्नेत्रा विश्वरूपा कथं स्मृता
verses.transliteration: catuḥśṛṅgī caturvaktrā caturdaṃṣṭrā catuḥstanī caturhastā caturnetrā viśvarūpā kathaṃ smṛtā
verses.translation: TA.io.i; Mah&n. U. 9.2, Svet. U 4.5,
verses.hindi: इस प्रकार सूर्यमण्डलके समान आदि वर्ण अकारको लिङ्गके दक्षिणमें, अग्निके सदृश प्रतीत होनेवाले उकारको उत्तरमें तथा चन्द्रमण्डलके तुल्य मकारको मध्यमें देखनेके बाद उन पुरुषश्रेष्ठ विष्णुने उसके ऊपर तुरीयातीत, अमृतरूप, कलारहित, विकारशून्य, नि्ठन्, अद्वितीय, शून्यस्वरूप, बाह्य तथा आभ्यन्तरसे रहित, बाह्य तथा आभ्यन्तरसे युक्त, बाह्य तथा आभ्यन्तर दोनों रूपोंमें स्थित, आदि-मध्य-अन्तसे रहित तथा आनन्दके
verses.wordMeaning: TA.io.i; Mah&n. U. 9.2, Svet. U 4.5,
verses.commentary: Sense: TA.io.i; Mah&n. U. 9.2, Svet. U 4.5,

verses.sanskrit: किंनामगोत्रा कस्येयं किंवीर्या चापि कर्मतः तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा देवदेवो वृषध्वजः
verses.transliteration: kiṃnāmagotrā kasyeyaṃ kiṃvīryā cāpi karmataḥ tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā devadevo vṛṣadhvajaḥ
verses.translation: TA.io.i; Mah&n. U. 9.2, Svet. U 4.5,
verses.hindi: भी कारणस्वरूप शुद्ध स्फटिकके सदृश प्रकाशमान प्रभुको देखा अकार, उकार और मकाररूप तीन मात्राएँ तथा
verses.wordMeaning: TA.io.i; Mah&n. U. 9.2, Svet. U 4.5,
verses.commentary: Sense: TA.io.i; Mah&n. U. 9.2, Svet. U 4.5,

verses.sanskrit: प्राह देववृषं ब्रह्मा ब्रह्माणं चात्मसंभवम् रहस्यं सर्वमन्त्राणां पावनं पुष्टिवर्धनम्
verses.transliteration: prāha devavṛṣaṃ brahmā brahmāṇaṃ cātmasaṃbhavam rahasyaṃ sarvamantrāṇāṃ pāvanaṃ puṣṭivardhanam
verses.translation: TA.io.i; Mah&n. U. 9.2, Svet. U 4.5,
verses.hindi: है और वही ब्रह्मसंज्ञावाला है। ऋकू-यजुः तथा सामवेद उन तीनों मात्राओंके रूपमें विष्णु ही हैं उसी वेदरूप शब्दके द्वारा विष्णुने विश्वात्मा
verses.wordMeaning: TA.io.i; Mah&n. U. 9.2, Svet. U 4.5,
verses.commentary: Sense: TA.io.i; Mah&n. U. 9.2, Svet. U 4.5,

verses.sanskrit: शृणुष्वैतत्परं गुह्यम् आदिसर्गे यथा तथा एवं यो वर्तते कल्पो विश्वरूपस्त्वसौ मतः
verses.transliteration: śṛṇuṣvaitatparaṃ guhyam ādisarge yathā tathā evaṃ yo vartate kalpo viśvarūpastvasau mataḥ
verses.translation: TA.io.i; Mah&n. U. 9.2, Svet. U 4.5,
verses.hindi: क श्रीलिड्रमहापुराण  पूर्वभाग फफफफकफ़फाफफफफफफफफफाफाफफाफपाफाफफाफफाफफाफपाफापापापाथापापारपीाफचीचीफीचीफीकी फणी णस पीसापापापा फफफ फफ फफफ फ फ फ फ फ फ फ़ फ फ़ फ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ फ फ़ फ फ़ फ फ फ़ फ फ़ फ फ फ़ फ फ फ का फ फ फ फा फी फी फ्रफाफफ्रफफफ्रफफ्फ्फ्््कफ्रफ्रक्क्फक्रफकफ्रफक्फ्फ्फफफ फ़
verses.wordMeaning: TA.io.i; Mah&n. U. 9.2, Svet. U 4.5,
verses.commentary: Sense: TA.io.i; Mah&n. U. 9.2, Svet. U 4.5,

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मस्थानमिदं चापि यत्र प्राप्तं त्वया प्रभो त्वत्तः परतरं देव विष्णुना तत्पदं शुभम्
verses.transliteration: brahmasthānamidaṃ cāpi yatra prāptaṃ tvayā prabho tvattaḥ parataraṃ deva viṣṇunā tatpadaṃ śubham
verses.translation: TA.io.i; Mah&n. U. 9.2, Svet. U 4.5,
verses.hindi: किया । उसी समयसे अतीन्द्रिय- ऋषिणा विष्णुर्ज़ातवान् परमेश्वरम्। ईश्वर शिवका चिन्तन Ee Si दर्शक, परम-तत्त्वरूप कल्याणकारी वेद हुआ और उसी ऋषि (वेद)-से विष्णुने परमेश्वर शिवको
verses.wordMeaning: TA.io.i; Mah&n. U. 9.2, Svet. U 4.5,
verses.commentary: Sense: TA.io.i; Mah&n. U. 9.2, Svet. U 4.5,

verses.sanskrit: वैकुण्ठेन विशुद्धेन मम वामाङ्गजेन वा तदाप्रभृति कल्पश् च त्रयस्त्रिंशत्तमो ह्ययम्
verses.transliteration: vaikuṇṭhena viśuddhena mama vāmāṅgajena vā tadāprabhṛti kalpaś ca trayastriṃśattamo hyayam
verses.translation: TA.io.i; Mah&n. U. 9.2, Svet. U 4.5,
verses.hindi: देव (ब्रह्मा) बोले--वाणी भी मनके साथ जिन्हें प्राप्त न करके लौट आती है, उन चिन्तारहित भगवान् रुद्रका वाचक एकाक्षर प्रणव ही है और यही एकाक्षर प्रणव उस सृष्टिके परम कारणरूप, सत्य- आनन्द तथा अमृतरूप परात्पर परम ब्रह्मका भी वाचक है॥ ५८-५९१/२॥
verses.wordMeaning: TA.io.i; Mah&n. U. 9.2, Svet. U 4.5,
verses.commentary: Sense: TA.io.i; Mah&n. U. 9.2, Svet. U 4.5,

verses.sanskrit: शतं शतसहस्राणाम् अतीता ये स्वयंभुवः पुरस्तात्तव देवेश तच्छृणुष्व महामते
verses.transliteration: śataṃ śatasahasrāṇām atītā ye svayaṃbhuvaḥ purastāttava deveśa tacchṛṇuṣva mahāmate
verses.translation: TA.io.i; Mah&n. U. 9.2, Svet. U 4.5,
verses.hindi: उसी एकाक्षर प्रणवसे अकारसंज्ञक भगवान् ब्रह्मा, उकारसंज्ञक परमकारणस्वरूप विष्णु तथा मकारसंज्ञक परमेश्वर नीललोहितका प्रादुर्भाव हुआ है अकारसंज्ञक ब्रह्मा सृष्टिके निर्माता, उकारसंज्ञक विष्णु मोह करनेवाले तथा मकारसंज्ञक शिव उन दोनों तथा विष्णुपर सदा अनुग्रह करनेवाले हैं
verses.wordMeaning: TA.io.i; Mah&n. U. 9.2, Svet. U 4.5,
verses.commentary: Sense: TA.io.i; Mah&n. U. 9.2, Svet. U 4.5,

verses.sanskrit: आनन्दस्तु स विज्ञेय आनन्दत्वे व्यवस्थितः माण्डव्यगोत्रस्तपसा मम पुत्रत्वमागतः
verses.transliteration: ānandastu sa vijñeya ānandatve vyavasthitaḥ māṇḍavyagotrastapasā mama putratvamāgataḥ
verses.translation: TA.io.i; Mah&n. U. 9.2, Svet. U 4.5,
verses.hindi: मकाररूप भगवान् शिव बीजवान्, अकाररूप ब्रह्मा बीज तथा उकाररूप प्रधानपुरुषेश्वर विष्णु योनि कहे जाते हैं नादरूप महेश्वर शिव ही स्वयं बीजी, बीज तथा योनि-तीनों हैं । वे बीजीरूप महेश्वर स्वेच्छासे अपनेको विभाजित करके प्रतिष्ठित हैं
verses.wordMeaning: TA.io.i; Mah&n. U. 9.2, Svet. U 4.5,
verses.commentary: Sense: TA.io.i; Mah&n. U. 9.2, Svet. U 4.5,

verses.sanskrit: त्वयि योगं च सांख्यं च तपोविद्याविधिक्रियाः ऋतं सत्यं दया ब्रह्म अहिंसा सन्मतिः क्षमा
verses.transliteration: tvayi yogaṃ ca sāṃkhyaṃ ca tapovidyāvidhikriyāḥ ṛtaṃ satyaṃ dayā brahma ahiṃsā sanmatiḥ kṣamā
verses.translation: TA.io.i; Mah&n. U. 9.2, Svet. U 4.5,
verses.hindi: इन बौजीरूप परमेश्वर शिवके लिङ्गसे अकाररूप बीज (ब्रह्मा), उकाररूप योनि (विष्णु) -में गिरकर चारों ओर वृद्धिको प्राप्त होने लगा और वह फिर स्वर्णका अण्ड हो गया। इसके बाद एकाक्षर प्रणबको आदि-अन्तसे आवेष्टित करके वह दिव्य अण्ड बहुत वर्षांतक जलमें स्थित रहा
verses.wordMeaning: TA.io.i; Mah&n. U. 9.2, Svet. U 4.5,
verses.commentary: Sense: TA.io.i; Mah&n. U. 9.2, Svet. U 4.5,

verses.sanskrit: ध्यानं ध्येयं दमः शान्तिर् विद्याविद्या मतिर्धृतिः कान्तिर्नीतिः प्रथा मेधा लज्जा दृष्टिः सरस्वती
verses.transliteration: dhyānaṃ dhyeyaṃ damaḥ śāntir vidyāvidyā matirdhṛtiḥ kāntirnītiḥ prathā medhā lajjā dṛṣṭiḥ sarasvatī
verses.translation: TA.io.i; Mah&n. U. 9.2, Svet. U 4.5,
verses.hindi: तदनन्तर हजार वर्षोके बाद साक्षात् आदिरूप परमेश्वरने जलमें स्थित उस अजोद्धूत अण्डको दो भागोंमें कर दिया उस अण्डके ऊर्ध्वस्थित हेममय पवित्र कपालसे
verses.wordMeaning: TA.io.i; Mah&n. U. 9.2, Svet. U 4.5,
verses.commentary: Sense: TA.io.i; Mah&n. U. 9.2, Svet. U 4.5,

verses.sanskrit: तुष्टिः पुष्टिः क्रिया चैव प्रसादश् च प्रतिष्ठिताः द्वात्रिंशत्सुगुणा ह्येषा द्वात्रिंशाक्षरसंज्ञया
verses.transliteration: tuṣṭiḥ puṣṭiḥ kriyā caiva prasādaś ca pratiṣṭhitāḥ dvātriṃśatsuguṇā hyeṣā dvātriṃśākṣarasaṃjñayā
verses.translation: TA.io.i; Mah&n. U. 9.2, Svet. U 4.5,
verses.hindi: चिन्तया रहितो रुद्रो वाचो यन्मनसा सह अप्राप्य तं निवर्तन्ते वाच्यस्त्वेकाक्षरेण सः। एकाक्षरेण तद्वाच्यमृतं परमकारणम्
verses.wordMeaning: TA.io.i; Mah&n. U. 9.2, Svet. U 4.5,
verses.commentary: Sense: TA.io.i; Mah&n. U. 9.2, Svet. U 4.5,

verses.sanskrit: प्रकृतिर्विहिता ब्रह्मंस् त्वत्प्रसूतिर्महेश्वरी विष्णोर्भगवतश्चापि तथान्येषामपि प्रभो
verses.transliteration: prakṛtirvihitā brahmaṃs tvatprasūtirmaheśvarī viṣṇorbhagavataścāpi tathānyeṣāmapi prabho
verses.translation: TA.io.i; Mah&n. U. 9.2, Svet. U 4.5,
verses.hindi: सत्यमानन्दममृतं परं ब्रह्म परात्परम्। एकाक्षरादकाराख्यो भगवान् कनकाण्डजः एकाक्षरादुकाराख्यो हरिः परमकारणम्। एकाक्षरान्मकाराख्यो भगवान्नीललोहितः
verses.wordMeaning: TA.io.i; Mah&n. U. 9.2, Svet. U 4.5,
verses.commentary: Sense: TA.io.i; Mah&n. U. 9.2, Svet. U 4.5,

verses.sanskrit: सैषा भगवती देवी मत्प्रसूतिः प्रतिष्ठिता चतुर्मुखी जगद्योनिः प्रकृतिर् गौः प्रतिष्ठिता
verses.transliteration: saiṣā bhagavatī devī matprasūtiḥ pratiṣṭhitā caturmukhī jagadyoniḥ prakṛtir gauḥ pratiṣṭhitā
verses.translation: TA.io.i; Mah&n. U. 9.2, Svet. U 4.5,
verses.hindi: सर्गकर्ता त्वकाराख्यो ह्युकाराख्यस्तु मोहकः। मकाराख्यस्तयोर्नित्यमनुग्रहकरोऽभवत् मकाराख्यो विभुरबीजी ह्यकारो बीजमुच्यते। उकाराख्यो हरियाँनिः प्रधानपुरुषेश्वरः
verses.wordMeaning: TA.io.i; Mah&n. U. 9.2, Svet. U 4.5,
verses.commentary: Sense: TA.io.i; Mah&n. U. 9.2, Svet. U 4.5,

verses.sanskrit: गौरी माया च विद्या च कृष्णा हैमवतीति च प्रधानं प्रकृतिश्चैव यामाहुस्तत्त्वचिन्तकाः
verses.transliteration: gaurī māyā ca vidyā ca kṛṣṇā haimavatīti ca pradhānaṃ prakṛtiścaiva yāmāhustattvacintakāḥ
verses.translation: TA.io.i; Mah&n. U. 9.2, Svet. U 4.5,
verses.hindi: अस्य लिङ्गादभूद्बीजमकारो बीजिनः प्रभोः। उकारयोनौ निक्षिप्तमवर्धत समन्ततः अनेकाब्दं तथा चाप्सु दिव्यमण्डं व्यवस्थितम्
verses.wordMeaning: TA.io.i; Mah&n. U. 9.2, Svet. U 4.5,
verses.commentary: Sense: TA.io.i; Mah&n. U. 9.2, Svet. U 4.5,

verses.sanskrit: अजामेकां लोहितां शुक्लकृष्णां विश्वप्रजां सृजमानां सरूपाम् अजो ऽहं मां विद्धि तां विश्वरूपं गायत्रीं गां विश्वरूपां हि बुद्ध्या
verses.transliteration: ajāmekāṃ lohitāṃ śuklakṛṣṇāṃ viśvaprajāṃ sṛjamānāṃ sarūpām ajo 'haṃ māṃ viddhi tāṃ viśvarūpaṃ gāyatrīṃ gāṃ viśvarūpāṃ hi buddhyā
verses.translation: TA.io.i; Mah&n. U. 9.2, Svet. U 4.5,
verses.hindi: तस्याण्डस्य शुभं हैमं कपालं चोर्ध्वसंस्थितम्। आकाश तथा नीचेके भागसे पाँच लक्षणोंसे सम्पन्न जज्ञे यद् द्यौस्तदपरं पृथिवी पञ्चलक्षणा॥ ६८ = 3 ६८  पथ्तीकीहातिहुई॥।६८।॥॥) ७००५ 8 उत्पत्ति हुई  यतो वाचो निवर्तन्ते। अप्राप्य मनसा सह। आनन्द ब्रह्मणो विद्वान्। (तैत्तिश २।४। १)
verses.wordMeaning: TA.io.i; Mah&n. U. 9.2, Svet. U 4.5,
verses.commentary: Sense: TA.io.i; Mah&n. U. 9.2, Svet. U 4.5,

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्त्वा महादेवः ससर्ज परमेश्वरः ततश् च पार्श्वगा देव्याः सर्वरूपकुमारकाः
verses.transliteration: evamuktvā mahādevaḥ sasarja parameśvaraḥ tataś ca pārśvagā devyāḥ sarvarūpakumārakāḥ
verses.translation: TA.io.i; Mah&n. U. 9.2, Svet. U 4.5,
verses.hindi: अध्याय १७ ब्रह्मा तथा विष्णुके समक्ष स स्त्रष्टा सर्वलोकानां स एव त्रिविध: प्रभुः
verses.wordMeaning: TA.io.i; Mah&n. U. 9.2, Svet. U 4.5,
verses.commentary: Sense: TA.io.i; Mah&n. U. 9.2, Svet. U 4.5,

verses.sanskrit: जटी मुण्डी शिखण्डी च अर्धमुण्डश् च जज्ञिरे ततस्तेन यथोक्तेन योगेन सुमहौजसः
verses.transliteration: jaṭī muṇḍī śikhaṇḍī ca ardhamuṇḍaś ca jajñire tatastena yathoktena yogena sumahaujasaḥ
verses.translation: TA.io.i; Mah&n. U. 9.2, Svet. U 4.5,
verses.hindi: ततो विज्ञाय देवेशं यथावच्छतिसम्भवैः मनतरर्महेश्वरं देवं तुष्टाव सुमहोदयम्। आवयोः स्तुतिसन्तुष्टो लिङ्गे तस्मिन्निरञ्जनः
verses.wordMeaning: TA.io.i; Mah&n. U. 9.2, Svet. U 4.5,
verses.commentary: Sense: TA.io.i; Mah&n. U. 9.2, Svet. U 4.5,

verses.sanskrit: दिव्यवर्षसहस्रान्ते उपासित्वा महेश्वरम् धर्मोपदेशमखिलं कृत्वा योगमयं दृढम्
verses.transliteration: divyavarṣasahasrānte upāsitvā maheśvaram dharmopadeśamakhilaṃ kṛtvā yogamayaṃ dṛḍham
verses.translation: TA.io.i; Mah&n. U. 9.2, Svet. U 4.5,
verses.hindi: अकारस्तस्य मूर्द्धा तु ललाटं दीर्घमुच्यते इकारो दक्षिणं नेत्रमीकारो वामलोचनम्। उकारो दक्षिणं श्रोत्रमूकारो वाममुच्यते
verses.wordMeaning: TA.io.i; Mah&n. U. 9.2, Svet. U 4.5,
verses.commentary: Sense: TA.io.i; Mah&n. U. 9.2, Svet. U 4.5,

verses.sanskrit: शिष्टाश् च नियतात्मानः प्रविष्टा रुद्रमीश्वरम्
