verses.hindi: कमलके साथ क्रीडारत उन देवश्रेष्ठ विष्णुके पास आकर हिरण्यगर्भ, अण्डज, सोनेके वर्णवाले, अतीन्द्रिय, चार मुखवाले तथा विशाल नेत्रोंवाले ब्रह्माने शोभासम्पन्न, दिव्य, सुन्दर तथा सुगन्धित कमलके साथ सुन्दर नयनोंवाले विष्णुको खेलते हुए देखा। तत्पश्चात् उनके सन्निकट पहुँचकर ब्रह्माजीने विस्मयपूर्ण भावसे विनप्रतायुक्त वाणीमें उनसे पूछा-आप कौन हैं और इस समुद्रके मध्य आश्रय लेकर क्यों सो रहे हैं?॥ ९-११ /२॥
verses.wordMeaning: Gf. note 37. on p.
verses.commentary: Sense: Gf. note 37. on p.

verses.sanskrit: एकाक्षराय रुद्राय अकारायात्मरूपिणे उकारायादिदेवाय विद्यादेहाय वै नमः
verses.transliteration: ekākṣarāya rudrāya akārāyātmarūpiṇe ukārāyādidevāya vidyādehāya vai namaḥ
verses.translation: If love has been generated in you, if boon has to be granted to us, may our devotion to you remain perpetual and unswerving.
verses.hindi: उन ब्रह्माका यह सुखद वचन सुनकर विष्णुजी पर्यकसे उठकर बैठ गये और नेत्रोंमें प्रसन्नता भरकर उनके उत्तरमें कहने लगे कि मैं प्रत्येक कल्पमें इसी स्थानका आश्रय लेकर शयन करता हूँ जो कुछ भी किया जाना है, किया गया है और किया जा रहा है तथा स्वर्गलोक, आकाश, पृथ्वी एवं भुवर्लोक-इन सबका परम पद मैं ही हूँ.
verses.wordMeaning: If love has been generated in you, if boon has to be granted to us, may our devotion to you remain perpetual and unswerving.
verses.commentary: Sense: If love has been generated in you, if boon has to be granted to us, may our devotion to you remain perpetual and unswerving.

verses.sanskrit: तृतीयाय मकाराय शिवाय परमात्मने सूर्याग्निसोमवर्णाय यजमानाय वै नमः
verses.transliteration: tṛtīyāya makārāya śivāya paramātmane sūryāgnisomavarṇāya yajamānāya vai namaḥ
verses.translation: O Devas. the moon-crested lord accordingly granted them an unswerving devotidn and faith.
verses.hindi: उनसे इस प्रकार कहकर भगवान् विष्णुने पुनः उनसे पूछा-ऐश्वर्यसम्पन्न आप कौन हैं तथा मेरे पास कहाँसे आये हैं? आप पुनः कहाँ जायेगे तथा आपका निवासस्थान कहाँ है? विश्‍्वमूर्तिस्वरूप आप कौन हैं तथा मैं आपके लिये क्या करूँ ?
verses.wordMeaning: O Devas. the moon-crested lord accordingly granted them an unswerving devotidn and faith.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Devas. the moon-crested lord accordingly granted them an unswerving devotidn and faith.

verses.sanskrit: अग्नये रुद्ररूपाय रुद्राणां पतये नमः शिवाय शिवमन्त्राय सद्योजाताय वेधसे
verses.transliteration: agnaye rudrarūpāya rudrāṇāṃ pataye namaḥ śivāya śivamantrāya sadyojātāya vedhase
verses.translation: Then Visnu knelt on the ground and bowed to the lord. With perfect control over himself he spoke to the lord in low tones.
verses.hindi: विष्णुके ऐसा कहनेपर महात्मा शिवको मायासे मोहित होनेके कारण भगवान् जनार्दनको पहचाने बिना पितामह ब्रह्मा उन्हीं शिवकी मायासे मोहको प्राप्त अविज्ञात विष्णुदेवसे कहने लगे, जिस प्रकार आप इस जगत्के आदिकर्ता तथा प्रजापति हैं, वैसे ही मैं भी हूँ
verses.wordMeaning: Then Visnu knelt on the ground and bowed to the lord. With perfect control over himself he spoke to the lord in low tones.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then Visnu knelt on the ground and bowed to the lord. With perfect control over himself he spoke to the lord in low tones.

verses.sanskrit: वामाय वामदेवाय वरदायामृताय ते अघोरायातिघोराय सद्योजाताय रंहसे
verses.transliteration: vāmāya vāmadevāya varadāyāmṛtāya te aghorāyātighorāya sadyojātāya raṃhase
verses.translation: O lord of the Devas, our controversy has borne splendid fruits, since you yourself have come over here to remove the same.
verses.hindi: जगत्के रचयिता ब्रह्माजीका यह विस्मयकारी वचन सुनकर और उनकी आज्ञा लेकरं विश्वको उत्पत्ति करनेवाले योगी महायोगी विष्णुभगवान् कौतूहलवश ब्रह्माके मुखमें प्रविष्ट हो गये॥ १९/२ ॥ ब्रह्माजीके उदरमें प्रवेश करके वहाँपर अठारह
verses.wordMeaning: O lord of the Devas, our controversy has borne splendid fruits, since you yourself have come over here to remove the same.
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord of the Devas, our controversy has borne splendid fruits, since you yourself have come over here to remove the same.

verses.sanskrit: ईशानाय श्मशानाय अतिवेगाय वेगिने नमो ऽस्तु श्रुतिपादाय ऊर्ध्वलिङ्गाय लिङ्गिने
verses.transliteration: īśānāya śmaśānāya ativegāya vegine namo 'stu śrutipādāya ūrdhvaliṅgāya liṅgine
verses.translation: On hearing this, Lord Siva again spoke smiling to Visriu who bowed to him with his head bent down and who stood with palms joined in reverence.
verses.hindi: वर्णोके जनसमूहों, सनातन सात लोकों तथा ब्रह्मासे ८८ श्रीलिड्रमहापुराण  पूर्वभाग
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing this, Lord Siva again spoke smiling to Visriu who bowed to him with his head bent down and who stood with palms joined in reverence.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing this, Lord Siva again spoke smiling to Visriu who bowed to him with his head bent down and who stood with palms joined in reverence.

verses.sanskrit: हेमलिङ्गाय हेमाय वारिलिङ्गाय चांभसे शिवाय शिवलिङ्गाय व्यापिने व्योमव्यापिने
verses.transliteration: hemaliṅgāya hemāya vāriliṅgāya cāṃbhase śivāya śivaliṅgāya vyāpine vyomavyāpine
verses.translation: O Vi?pu, I am lord Siva, the unsullied, I divided my-
verses.hindi: बहनलदर दृष्ट्वा सर्वान् विष्णुर्महाभुजः। लेकर तृणपर्यन्त सभी स्थावर-जंगम पदार्थ देखकर अहोऽस्य तपसो वीर्यमित्युक्त्वा च पुनः पुनः ॥ महाभुज महातेजस्वी विष्णुभगवान् अत्यन्त विस्मित अटित्वा विविधाँल्लोकान् विष्णुर्नानाविधाश्रयान्। हुए।' अहो! इनकी तपस्याका ऐसा प्रभाव'--ऐसा बार. नारायणो जगद्धाता पितामहमथाब्रवीत्॥ २४  लोकों तथा अनेक स्थानोंपर हजार वर्षोंतक भ्रमण करते रहे, किंतु जब उसका अन्त नहीं पा सके, तब वे
verses.wordMeaning: O Vi?pu, I am lord Siva, the unsullied, I divided my-
verses.commentary: Sense: O Vi?pu, I am lord Siva, the unsullied, I divided my-

verses.sanskrit: वायवे वायुवेगाय नमस्ते वायुव्यापिने तेजसे तेजसां भर्त्रे नमस्तेजो ऽधिव्यापिने
verses.transliteration: vāyave vāyuvegāya namaste vāyuvyāpine tejase tejasāṃ bhartre namastejo 'dhivyāpine
verses.translation: O Vi?9u, abandon your delusion. Protect this Brahma, who in the Padmakalpa, will become your son.
verses.hindi: भगवानादिरन्तशच मध्यं कालो दिशो नभः। नाहमन्तं प्रपश्यामि उदरस्य तवानघ॥ २५  शेषशायी जगदाधार नारायण उन ब्रह्माके मुखमार्गसे बाहर निकलकर उनसे कहने ' लगे हे अनघ! आप भगवान् हैं। आप आदि, अन्त,
verses.wordMeaning: O Vi?9u, abandon your delusion. Protect this Brahma, who in the Padmakalpa, will become your son.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Vi?9u, abandon your delusion. Protect this Brahma, who in the Padmakalpa, will become your son.

verses.sanskrit: जलाय जलभूताय नमस्ते जलव्यापिने पृथिव्यै चान्तरिक्षाय पृथिवीव्यापिने नमः
verses.transliteration: jalāya jalabhūtāya namaste jalavyāpine pṛthivyai cāntarikṣāya pṛthivīvyāpine namaḥ
verses.translation: Then you will see me thus, so will the lotus-born Brahmi too. Thus saying the lord vanished there itself.
verses.hindi: भगवानेवमेवाहं शाश्वतं हि ममोदरम् प्रविश्य लोकान् पश्यैताननौपम्यान् सुरोत्तम। क?
verses.wordMeaning: Then you will see me thus, so will the lotus-born Brahmi too. Thus saying the lord vanished there itself.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then you will see me thus, so will the lotus-born Brahmi too. Thus saying the lord vanished there itself.

verses.sanskrit: शब्दस्पर्शस्वरूपाय रसगन्धाय गन्धिने गणाधिपतये तुभ्यं गुह्याद्गुह्यतमाय ते
verses.transliteration: śabdasparśasvarūpāya rasagandhāya gandhine gaṇādhipataye tubhyaṃ guhyādguhyatamāya te
verses.translation: Ever since then the worship of the Lihga was well established in the world. The great goddess is the altar for the Lihga. The Lihga is the great lord himself.
verses.hindi: टी च मध्य, काल, दिशा, आकाश आदिसे युक्त हें । मैं आपके उदरका अन्त नहीं देख पाया ऐसा कहकर भगवान् विष्णुने ब्रह्मासे पुन: यह
verses.wordMeaning: Ever since then the worship of the Lihga was well established in the world. The great goddess is the altar for the Lihga. The Lihga is the great lord himself.
verses.commentary: Sense: Ever since then the worship of the Lihga was well established in the world. The great goddess is the altar for the Lihga. The Lihga is the great lord himself.

verses.sanskrit: अनन्ताय विरूपाय अनन्तानामयाय च शाश्वताय वरिष्ठाय वारिगर्भाय योगिने
verses.transliteration: anantāya virūpāya anantānāmayāya ca śāśvatāya variṣṭhāya vārigarbhāya yogine
verses.translation: Lihga is so called because, O gods, everything gets dissolved in it. The brahmin who reads this narrative of Lihga, in the presence of the Lihga image attains Siva-hood. No doubt need be entertained in this respect.
verses.hindi: तानेव लोकान् गर्भस्थानपश्यत्सत्यविक्रमः। कहा-हे सुरश्रेष्ठ! मैं भी इसी तरह भगवान् हूँ। अब आप भी मेरे शाश्वत उदरमें प्रवेश करके इन्हीं अनृपम
verses.wordMeaning: Lihga is so called because, O gods, everything gets dissolved in it. The brahmin who reads this narrative of Lihga, in the presence of the Lihga image attains Siva-hood. No doubt need be entertained in this respect.
verses.commentary: Sense: Lihga is so called because, O gods, everything gets dissolved in it. The brahmin who reads this narrative of Lihga, in the presence of the Lihga image attains Siva-hood. No doubt need be entertained in this respect.

verses.sanskrit: संस्थितायाम्भसां मध्ये आवयोर्मध्यवर्चसे गोप्त्रे हर्त्रे सदा कर्त्रे निधनायेश्वराय च
verses.transliteration: saṃsthitāyāmbhasāṃ madhye āvayormadhyavarcase goptre hartre sadā kartre nidhanāyeśvarāya ca
verses.translation: How did Hrahma become the lotus-born (deity), hrmerly, in the Padmakalpa? How did \'i.snu and Biahma.sec loid Siva? Pleast' recount all this pailiculaily now.
verses.hindi: पर्यटित्वा तु देवस्य ददूशेऽन्तं न वै हरेः लोकोंका दर्शन करें॥ २६/२ ॥
verses.wordMeaning: How did Hrahma become the lotus-born (deity), hrmerly, in the Padmakalpa? How did \'i.snu and Biahma.sec loid Siva? Pleast' recount all this pailiculaily now.
verses.commentary: Sense: How did Hrahma become the lotus-born (deity), hrmerly, in the Padmakalpa? How did \'i.snu and Biahma.sec loid Siva? Pleast' recount all this pailiculaily now.

verses.sanskrit: अचेतनाय चिन्त्याय चेतनायासहारिणे अरूपाय सुरूपाय अनङ्गायाङ्गहारिणे
verses.transliteration: acetanāya cintyāya cetanāyāsahāriṇe arūpāya surūpāya anaṅgāyāṅgahāriṇe
verses.translation: The supreme loicl in liis qualified (sakala) state is characterized by three functions: viz. creation, sustenance and destruction. The idea is often repeated in the Puranas.
verses.hindi: द्वाराणि सर्वाणि पिधाय विष्णुः । विभुर्मनः कर्तुमियेष चाशु लक्ष्मीकान्त विष्णुकी यह आह्वादकारिणी वाणी सुनकर उन्हें प्रसन्न करते हुए ब्रह्माजी उनके उदरमें प्रविष्ट हुए॥ २७/२ ॥
verses.wordMeaning: The supreme loicl in liis qualified (sakala) state is characterized by three functions: viz. creation, sustenance and destruction. The idea is often repeated in the Puranas.
verses.commentary: Sense: The supreme loicl in liis qualified (sakala) state is characterized by three functions: viz. creation, sustenance and destruction. The idea is often repeated in the Puranas.

verses.sanskrit: भस्मदिग्धशरीराय भानुसोमाग्निहेतवे श्वेताय श्वेतवर्णाय तुहिनाद्रिचराय च
verses.transliteration: bhasmadigdhaśarīrāya bhānusomāgnihetave śvetāya śvetavarṇāya tuhinādricarāya ca
verses.translation: A tall and lofty lotus was sportively created in his umbilicus as he lay there all-powerful self-contented but un- wearif'cl in activities. It was hundred Yojanas long. It resem- bled the mid-day sun. It had adamantine stalk.
verses.hindi: सत्य पराक्रमवाले ब्रह्माजीने विष्णुके उदरमें स्थित उन्हीं सब लोकोंको देखा और उसमें बहुत भ्रमण करनेके उपरान्त भी विष्णुदेवके उदरका अन्त नहीं पा सके
verses.wordMeaning: A tall and lofty lotus was sportively created in his umbilicus as he lay there all-powerful self-contented but un- wearif'cl in activities. It was hundred Yojanas long. It resem- bled the mid-day sun. It had adamantine stalk.
verses.commentary: Sense: A tall and lofty lotus was sportively created in his umbilicus as he lay there all-powerful self-contented but un- wearif'cl in activities. It was hundred Yojanas long. It resem- bled the mid-day sun. It had adamantine stalk.

verses.sanskrit: सुश्वेताय सुवक्त्राय नमः श्वेतशिखाय च श्वेतास्याय महास्याय नमस्ते श्वेतलोहित
verses.transliteration: suśvetāya suvaktrāya namaḥ śvetaśikhāya ca śvetāsyāya mahāsyāya namaste śvetalohita
verses.translation: Even as the bountiful lord was playing (with the lotus), Brahma, who was born of the cosmic Egg of golden womb, who had golden colour, who was beyond the pale of the sense-organs, who had four faces and large eyes came near the lord casually. On seeing Visnu of splendid eyes sporting with the lotus that was glorious, divine, splendid and fragrant, Brahma was surpiiscd and asked in a tone filled with gentle- ness —
verses.hindi: उज्हारात्मनो रूपं पुष्कराच्चतुराननः सभौ इन्द्रियद्वारोको निरुद्ध करके मैं सुखपूर्वक
verses.wordMeaning: Even as the bountiful lord was playing (with the lotus), Brahma, who was born of the cosmic Egg of golden womb, who had golden colour, who was beyond the pale of the sense-organs, who had four faces and large eyes came near the lord casually.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Even as the bountiful lord was playing (with the lotus), Brahma, who was born of the cosmic Egg of golden womb, who had golden colour, who was beyond the pale of the sense-organs, who had four faces and large eyes came near the lord casually.…

verses.sanskrit: सुताराय विशिष्टाय नमो दुन्दुभिने हर शतरूपविरूपाय नमः केतुमते सदा
verses.transliteration: sutārāya viśiṣṭāya namo dundubhine hara śatarūpavirūpāya namaḥ ketumate sadā
verses.translation: On hearing the splendid words of Brahma, Visnu got up from his couch and with his eyes beaming with surprise replied: —
verses.hindi: सो लिया-ऐसा सोचकर और ब्रह्माजीकी गतिको जानकर सर्वव्यापक विष्णुजीने शीघ्र ही उनकी अभिलाषा पूर्ण करनेकी इच्छा की तत्पश्चात् सभी द्वारोंको बन्द देखकर पितामहने अत्यन्त सूक्ष्म रूप धारण करके नाभिमें मार्ग पाया तथा पद्मसूत्र (कमलनाल)-के सहारे पुष्कर (कमल) -से स्वयंको बाहर निकाला, तदनन्तर पद्मगर्भके समान
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing the splendid words of Brahma, Visnu got up from his couch and with his eyes beaming with surprise replied: —
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the splendid words of Brahma, Visnu got up from his couch and with his eyes beaming with surprise replied: —

verses.sanskrit: ऋद्धिशोकविशोकाय पिनाकाय कपर्दिने विपाशाय सुपाशाय नमस्ते पाशनाशिने
verses.transliteration: ṛddhiśokaviśokāya pinākāya kapardine vipāśāya supāśāya namaste pāśanāśine
verses.translation: Thereupon Brahma icplicd to Visnu. Being deluded by the Maya of lord Siva, he could not fully comprehend Visnu who himself was deluded by the Maya of Siva and hence unknowable.
verses.hindi: कान्तिवाले जगद्योनि स्वयम्भू पितामह भगवान् ब्रह्मा कमलके ऊपर शोभित हुए॥ ३०--३२॥ विरराजारविन्दस्थः पदागर्भसमद्युतिः । ब्रह्मा स्वयम्भूर्भगवाञ्जगद्योनिः पितामहः
verses.wordMeaning: Thereupon Brahma icplicd to Visnu. Being deluded by the Maya of lord Siva, he could not fully comprehend Visnu who himself was deluded by the Maya of Siva and hence unknowable.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereupon Brahma icplicd to Visnu. Being deluded by the Maya of lord Siva, he could not fully comprehend Visnu who himself was deluded by the Maya of Siva and hence unknowable.

verses.sanskrit: सुहोत्राय हविष्याय सुब्रह्मण्याय सूरिणे सुमुखाय सुवक्त्राय दुर्दमाय दमाय च
verses.transliteration: suhotrāya haviṣyāya subrahmaṇyāya sūriṇe sumukhāya suvaktrāya durdamāya damāya ca
verses.translation: The Self-born Brahma, the source of the origin of the universe sat in the lotus, resembling in lustre the interior of the lotus itself.
verses.hindi: अध्याय २० शेषशय्यापर आसीन भगवान् न् विष्णुके नाभिकमलसे ब्रह्माजीका प्रादुर्भाव
verses.wordMeaning: The Self-born Brahma, the source of the origin of the universe sat in the lotus, resembling in lustre the interior of the lotus itself.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Self-born Brahma, the source of the origin of the universe sat in the lotus, resembling in lustre the interior of the lotus itself.

verses.sanskrit: कङ्काय कङ्करूपाय कङ्कणीकृतपन्नग सनकाय नमस्तुभ्यं सनातन सनन्दन
verses.transliteration: kaṅkāya kaṅkarūpāya kaṅkaṇīkṛtapannaga sanakāya namastubhyaṃ sanātana sanandana
verses.translation: In the meantime, even as either of them was wholly engaged in a struggle with the other in the middle of the ocean, lord Siva of immeasurable soul, the lord of living beings appealed theie itself. Holding a trident in hand and clad in garmrnls of pure gold he came to the place where Visnu was lying on Sesa — the lord of serpents. As he waded through the waters quickly, big drops of water rose up in the sky, kicked up by his feet. The wind that blew was very hot and cold. On perceiving this wonderful phenomenon, Brahma spoke to Visnu ''See how hot and cold waters make the lotus shake.
verses.hindi: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे ताभ्यामेकैकस्य - मेक य की फफफफफफू फफफफफफाफफफफफफाफाफफफफफफफफ फा पापा मपी फफफफफ्फ्फफ्फ शूलपाणिर्महादेवो हेमवीराम्बरच्छदः
verses.wordMeaning: In the meantime, even as either of them was wholly engaged in a struggle with the other in the middle of the ocean, lord Siva of immeasurable soul, the lord of living beings appealed theie itself.…
verses.commentary: Sense: In the meantime, even as either of them was wholly engaged in a struggle with the other in the middle of the ocean, lord Siva of immeasurable soul, the lord of living beings appealed theie itself.…

verses.sanskrit: सनत्कुमारसारङ्गम् आरणाय महात्मने लोकाक्षिणे त्रिधामाय नमो विरजसे सदा
verses.transliteration: sanatkumārasāraṅgam āraṇāya mahātmane lokākṣiṇe tridhāmāya namo virajase sadā
verses.translation: Clear this doubt of mine and tell me what else you wish to do now."
verses.hindi: उद्भूतास्तूर्णमाकाशे पृथुलास्तोयबिन्दवः। अत्युष्णश्चातिशीतश्च वायुस्तत्र ववौ पुनः तददूष्ट्वा महदाश्चर्यं ब्रह्मा विष्णुमभाषत। अब्बिन्दवश्च शीतोष्णाः कम्पयन्त्यम्बुजं भृशम्
verses.wordMeaning: Clear this doubt of mine and tell me what else you wish to do now."
verses.commentary: Sense: Clear this doubt of mine and tell me what else you wish to do now."

verses.sanskrit: शङ्खपालाय शङ्खाय रजसे तमसे नमः सारस्वताय मेघाय मेघवाहन ते नमः
verses.transliteration: śaṅkhapālāya śaṅkhāya rajase tamase namaḥ sārasvatāya meghāya meghavāhana te namaḥ
verses.translation: "O Sir, are you in a perplexed state inside the lotus? O lord, what is it that 1 have done wlieicfore O excellent one among men, you speak to me thus: What is it for? Tell me factually." Lord Brahma, the storehouse of the Vedas, replied to the lotus-eyed lord of Devas who spoke thus in accordance with the activities of the world: — "It was I who formerly entered your belly in accordance with your wish. Just as all the worlds within my belly were seen by you O lord, so also all the worlds in your belly are seen by me. O sinless one after a thousand years I returned. With a spirit of rivalry and a desire to subject me to control, all the openings were closed suddenly by you. O blessed one, 1.pondered over it. By dint of my ow'n splendour I gained exit through the umbilicus by the lotus stalk. Let there be no dejection in your mind: O Visnu, this is the sequence of events in their gradual advancement. What should be done by me hereafter, kindly tell me: What shall I do?"
verses.hindi: एतन्मे संशयं ब्रूहि किं वा त्वन्यच्चिकीर्षसि। एतदेवंविधं वाक्यं पितामहमुखोद्गतम् ्रुत्वाप्रतिमकर्मा हि भगवानसुरान्तकृत्। किं नु खल्वत्र मे नाभ्यां भूतमन्यत्कृतालयम्
verses.wordMeaning: "O Sir, are you in a perplexed state inside the lotus? O lord, what is it that 1 have done wlieicfore O excellent one among men, you speak to me thus: What is it for? Tell me factually." Lord Brahma, the storehouse of the Vedas,…
verses.commentary: Sense: "O Sir, are you in a perplexed state inside the lotus? O lord, what is it that 1 have done wlieicfore O excellent one among men, you speak to me thus: What is it for? Tell me factually." Lord Brahma, the storehouse of the Vedas,…

verses.sanskrit: सुवाहाय विवाहाय विवादवरदाय च नमः शिवाय रुद्राय प्रधानाय नमोनमः
verses.transliteration: suvāhāya vivāhāya vivādavaradāya ca namaḥ śivāya rudrāya pradhānāya namonamaḥ
verses.translation: On hearing these loving, pleasing auspicious and irreproachable words of Brahma, Vifnii the destroyer of Hiranya- kasipu and of immeasurable soul, spoke sincere and simple words. This type of adverse action was not envisaged by me.
verses.hindi: किमत्र भगवानद्य पुष्करे जातसम्भ्रमः। किं मया च कृतं देव यन्मां प्रियमनुत्तमम् भाषसे पुरुषश्रेष्ठ किमर्थ ब्रूहि तत्त्वतः। एवं ब्रुवाणं देवेशं लोकयात्रानुगं ततः ॥
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing these loving, pleasing auspicious and irreproachable words of Brahma, Vifnii the destroyer of Hiranya- kasipu and of immeasurable soul, spoke sincere and simple words. This type of adverse action was not envisaged by me.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing these loving, pleasing auspicious and irreproachable words of Brahma, Vifnii the destroyer of Hiranya- kasipu and of immeasurable soul, spoke sincere and simple words. This type of adverse action was not envisaged by me.

verses.sanskrit: त्रिगुणाय नमस्तुभ्यं चतुर्व्यूहात्मने नमः संसाराय नमस्तुभ्यं नमः संसारहेतवे
verses.transliteration: triguṇāya namastubhyaṃ caturvyūhātmane namaḥ saṃsārāya namastubhyaṃ namaḥ saṃsārahetave
verses.translation: You should not mis-understand me. You deserve my respect and worship. O auspicious one, foigive if at all I have committed any offence against you.
verses.hindi: प्रत्युवाचाम्बुजाभाक्षं ब्रह्मा वेदनिधिः प्रभुः। योऽसौ तवोदर पूर्व प्रविष्टोऽहं त्वदिच्छया यथा ममोदरे लोकाः सर्वे दृष्टास्त्वया प्रभो। तथैव दृष्टाः कार्त्स्न्येन मया लोकास्तवोदरे
verses.wordMeaning: You should not mis-understand me. You deserve my respect and worship. O auspicious one, foigive if at all I have committed any offence against you.
verses.commentary: Sense: You should not mis-understand me. You deserve my respect and worship. O auspicious one, foigive if at all I have committed any offence against you.

verses.sanskrit: मोक्षाय मोक्षरूपाय मोक्षकर्त्रे नमोनमः आत्मने ऋषये तुभ्यं स्वामिने विष्णवे नमः
verses.transliteration: mokṣāya mokṣarūpāya mokṣakartre namonamaḥ ātmane ṛṣaye tubhyaṃ svāmine viṣṇave namaḥ
verses.translation: You are borne by me, O lord, descend from this lotus. I cannot bear you. You are refulgent and weighty. Thereupon Brahma said once again: 'Tel' me, what boon you desire to have. O lord, take me down from the lotus*. Then Visnu said: 'O slayer of enemies, you should be my son. You wii: cttain splendid pleasure. Speak agreeable and loving words.
verses.hindi: उस समुद्रके मध्य ब्रह्मा और विष्णुमें अनेक प्रकारसे संघर्ष चल रहा था, उसी समय श्रेष्ठ स्वर्णके समान सस्त्रको धारण करनेवाले, अमेय आत्मावाले, जीवोंके स्वामी शूलपाणि महादेव कहींसे वहाँपर पहुँच गये, जहाँ वे शेषशायी अनन्त विष्णुभगवान्
verses.wordMeaning: You are borne by me, O lord, descend from this lotus. I cannot bear you. You are refulgent and weighty. Thereupon Brahma said once again: 'Tel' me, what boon you desire to have. O lord, take me down from the lotus*. Then Visnu said: 'O slayer of enemies, you should be my son.…
verses.commentary: Sense: You are borne by me, O lord, descend from this lotus. I cannot bear you. You are refulgent and weighty. Thereupon Brahma said once again: 'Tel' me, what boon you desire to have. O lord, take me down from the lotus*. Then Visnu said: 'O slayer of enemies, you should be my son.…

verses.sanskrit: नमो भगवते तुभ्यं नागानां पतये नमः ओङ्काराय नमस्तुभ्यं सर्वज्ञाय नमो नमः
verses.transliteration: namo bhagavate tubhyaṃ nāgānāṃ pataye namaḥ oṅkārāya namastubhyaṃ sarvajñāya namo namaḥ
verses.translation: "He is wading through the ocean with great speed. When his feet press the surface of water, as he wades through the ocean with great speed, masses of water rise up even to the sky. O lotUs-bom one, you are being sprinkled from all sides with a heap of water. By the wind coming out of his nostrils, this great lotus emerged out of my navel is being shaken. It is lord Siva who has no origin and who destroys the world that has come. Let us eulogise the bull-bannered lord with hymns of prayer."
verses.hindi: उनके शीश्रतापूर्वक चलनेसे चरणोंके प्रहारसे संपीडित होकर समुद्र-जलकी बड़ी-बड़ी बूँहै आकाशतक पहुँचने लगीं और वहाँ कभी अत्यन्त गर्म तथा कभी अत्यन्त शीतल वायु बहने लगी उस महान् आश्चर्यको देखकर ब्रह्माने विष्णुसे कहा कि ये शीतल एवं उष्ण जलकी बूँदें इस कमलको अत्यधिक कम्पायमान कर रही हैं। इस विषयमे मेरी शंकाका समाधान कीजिये अथवा आप कुछ और
verses.wordMeaning: "He is wading through the ocean with great speed. When his feet press the surface of water, as he wades through the ocean with great speed, masses of water rise up even to the sky. O lotUs-bom one, you are being sprinkled from all sides with a heap of water.…
verses.commentary: Sense: "He is wading through the ocean with great speed. When his feet press the surface of water, as he wades through the ocean with great speed, masses of water rise up even to the sky. O lotUs-bom one, you are being sprinkled from all sides with a heap of water.…

verses.sanskrit: सर्वाय च नमस्तुभ्यं नमो नारायणाय च नमो हिरण्यगर्भाय आदिदेवाय ते नमः
verses.transliteration: sarvāya ca namastubhyaṃ namo nārāyaṇāya ca namo hiraṇyagarbhāya ādidevāya te namaḥ
verses.translation: Then Brahma who was infuriated spoke to Visnu whose eyes resembled the lotus: — ''Indeed you do not know yourself as the lord of all the worlds. You do not know me also as Brahma, the eternal creator of the worlds. Who is this Siva apart from us both?"
verses.hindi: करना तो नहीं चाहते ?॥ ३७/३ ॥ ब्रह्माके मुखसे निर्गत इस प्रकारको बात सुनकर अप्रतिम कर्मवाले असुरसंहारक भगवान् विष्णु सोचने लगे कि मेरी नाभिमें इस कौन-से जीवने अपना स्थान बना लिया है, जो इस तरह प्रेमपूर्वक मधुर-मधुर
verses.wordMeaning: Then Brahma who was infuriated spoke to Visnu whose eyes resembled the lotus: — ''Indeed you do not know yourself as the lord of all the worlds. You do not know me also as Brahma, the eternal creator of the worlds. Who is this Siva apart from us both?"
verses.commentary: Sense: Then Brahma who was infuriated spoke to Visnu whose eyes resembled the lotus: — ''Indeed you do not know yourself as the lord of all the worlds. You do not know me also as Brahma, the eternal creator of the worlds. Who is this Siva apart from us both?"

verses.sanskrit: नमो ऽस्त्वजाय पतये प्रजानां व्यूहहेतवे महादेवाय देवानाम् ईश्वराय नमो नमः
verses.transliteration: namo 'stvajāya pataye prajānāṃ vyūhahetave mahādevāya devānām īśvarāya namo namaḥ
verses.translation: Then Brahma who was infuriated spoke to Visnu whose eyes resembled the lotus: — ''Indeed you do not know yourself as the lord of all the worlds. You do not know me also as Brahma, the eternal creator of the worlds. Who is this Siva apart from us both?"
verses.hindi: बोल रहा है; तथा मैंने इसके प्रति कहीं क्रोध किया है--ऐसा मनमें ध्यान करके विष्णुभगवान् यह उत्तर देने आप भगवान् हैं और आपको यहाँ कमलके

verses.sanskrit: शर्वाय च नमस्तुभ्यं सत्याय शमनाय च ब्रह्मणे चैव भूतानां सर्वज्ञाय नमो नमः
verses.transliteration: śarvāya ca namastubhyaṃ satyāya śamanāya ca brahmaṇe caiva bhūtānāṃ sarvajñāya namo namaḥ
verses.translation: Then Brahma who was infuriated spoke to Visnu whose eyes resembled the lotus: — ''Indeed you do not know yourself as the lord of all the worlds. You do not know me also as Brahma, the eternal creator of the worlds. Who is this Siva apart from us both?"
verses.hindi: सा श्रेष्ठ कार्य किया है, जो आप मुझसे प्रेमपूर्वक बोल रहे हैं? है पुरुषश्रेष्ठ। इसका कारण मुझे यथार्थ रूपसे लोकयात्राका अनुवर्तन करनेवाले तथा कमलको आभाके समान नेत्रवाले देवेश्वर विष्णुके इस प्रकार बोलनेपर वेदनिधि प्रभु ब्रह्माने उनसे कहा॥ ४२ /२॥
verses.wordMeaning: Then Brahma who was infuriated spoke to Visnu whose eyes resembled the lotus: — ''Indeed you do not know yourself as the lord of all the worlds. You do not know me also as Brahma, the eternal creator of the worlds. Who is this Siva apart from us both?"
verses.commentary: Sense: Then Brahma who was infuriated spoke to Visnu whose eyes resembled the lotus: — ''Indeed you do not know yourself as the lord of all the worlds. You do not know me also as Brahma, the eternal creator of the worlds. Who is this Siva apart from us both?"

verses.sanskrit: महात्मने नमस्तुभ्यं प्रज्ञारूपाय वै नमः चितये चितिरूपाय स्मृतिरूपाय वै नमः
verses.transliteration: mahātmane namastubhyaṃ prajñārūpāya vai namaḥ citaye citirūpāya smṛtirūpāya vai namaḥ
verses.translation: Then Brahma who was infuriated spoke to Visnu whose eyes resembled the lotus: — ''Indeed you do not know yourself as the lord of all the worlds. You do not know me also as Brahma, the eternal creator of the worlds. Who is this Siva apart from us both?"
verses.hindi: यह मैं आपकी ही इच्छासे पूर्वकालमें आपके उदरमें प्रविष्ट हुआ था। है प्रभो! जिस प्रकार प्रथम मेरे उद्रमें प्रवेश करके आपने सभी लोकोंको देखा था, उसी प्रकार मैंने भी आपके उदरमें उन सम्पूर्ण लोकोंका द श्रीलिड्रमहापुराण  पूर्वभाग अक्क कक फफफफफफफकफफफफफझफफफझफफफफफफफफाफफफफफफफफफफफफ म क कमी मी फ माफ कफ कफ कफ फक कक कक कमका कम काफिकफाफाफ छा क ततो वर्षसहस्रात्तु उपावृत्तस्य मेऽनघ। है अनघ! वहाँ मैं हजार वर्षोतक चक्कर लगाता
verses.wordMeaning: Then Brahma who was infuriated spoke to Visnu whose eyes resembled the lotus: — ''Indeed you do not know yourself as the lord of all the worlds. You do not know me also as Brahma, the eternal creator of the worlds. Who is this Siva apart from us both?"

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञानाय ज्ञानगम्याय नमस्ते संविदे सदा शिखराय नमस्तुभ्यं नीलकण्ठाय वै नमः
verses.transliteration: jñānāya jñānagamyāya namaste saṃvide sadā śikharāya namastubhyaṃ nīlakaṇṭhāya vai namaḥ
verses.translation: Then Brahma who was infuriated spoke to Visnu whose eyes resembled the lotus: — ''Indeed you do not know yourself as the lord of all the worlds. You do not know me also as Brahma, the eternal creator of the worlds. Who is this Siva apart from us both?"
verses.hindi: ईर्ष्याभावसे युक्त होकर आपने मुझे मत्सरभावेन मां वशीकर्तुमिच्छता॥ रहा। इसके बाद ईष्य ५. र  वशमें करनेकी इच्छासे चारों ओरसे सभी इन्द्रियद्वार शीघ्रतापूर्वक बन्द कर लिये॥ ४५ /२॥
verses.wordMeaning: Then Brahma who was infuriated spoke to Visnu whose eyes resembled the lotus: — ''Indeed you do not know yourself as the lord of all the worlds. You do not know me also as Brahma, the eternal creator of the worlds. Who is this Siva apart from us both?"
verses.commentary: Sense: Then Brahma who was infuriated spoke to Visnu whose eyes resembled the lotus: — ''Indeed you do not know yourself as the lord of all the worlds. You do not know me also as Brahma, the eternal creator of the worlds. Who is this Siva apart from us both?"

verses.sanskrit: अर्धनारीशरीराय अव्यक्ताय नमोनमः एकादशविभेदाय स्थाणवे ते नमः सदा
verses.transliteration: ardhanārīśarīrāya avyaktāya namonamaḥ ekādaśavibhedāya sthāṇave te namaḥ sadā
verses.translation: Then Brahma who was infuriated spoke to Visnu whose eyes resembled the lotus: — ''Indeed you do not know yourself as the lord of all the worlds. You do not know me also as Brahma, the eternal creator of the worlds. Who is this Siva apart from us both?"
verses.hindi: तदनन्तर है महाभाग! मैं अपने तेजके प्रभावे विवेकपूर्वक अतिसूक्ष्मरूप धारणकर आपके नाभि- स्थलसे कमलनालके सहारे बाहर निकल आया। इसके लिये आपके मनमें थोड़ा भी विषाद नहीं होना हे विष्णो! जो यह मेरा बाहर निकलना हुआ है, वह किसी विशेष कार्यके लिये है। अब आप मुझे यह बताइये कि मैं क्या करूँ ?
verses.wordMeaning: Then Brahma who was infuriated spoke to Visnu whose eyes resembled the lotus: — ''Indeed you do not know yourself as the lord of all the worlds. You do not know me also as Brahma, the eternal creator of the worlds. Who is this Siva apart from us both?"
verses.commentary: Sense: Then Brahma who was infuriated spoke to Visnu whose eyes resembled the lotus: — ''Indeed you do not know yourself as the lord of all the worlds. You do not know me also as Brahma, the eternal creator of the worlds. Who is this Siva apart from us both?"

verses.sanskrit: नमः सोमाय सूर्याय भवाय भवहारिणे यशस्कराय देवाय शङ्करायेश्वराय च
verses.transliteration: namaḥ somāya sūryāya bhavāya bhavahāriṇe yaśaskarāya devāya śaṅkarāyeśvarāya ca
verses.translation: Then Brahma who was infuriated spoke to Visnu whose eyes resembled the lotus: — ''Indeed you do not know yourself as the lord of all the worlds. You do not know me also as Brahma, the eternal creator of the worlds. Who is this Siva apart from us both?"
verses.hindi: तदनन्तर पितामह ब्रह्माको प्रिय, मधुर, पवित्र तथा कल्याणमयी वाणी सुनकर हिरण्यकशिपुके शत्रु अप्रमेयात्मा भगवान् विष्णुने इर्ष्यारहित होकर उनसे यह वचन कहा कि आपके नाभिकमलोद्भवरूप इस कार्यके लिये मैंने कोई प्रयास नहीं किया है
verses.wordMeaning: Then Brahma who was infuriated spoke to Visnu whose eyes resembled the lotus: — ''Indeed you do not know yourself as the lord of all the worlds. You do not know me also as Brahma, the eternal creator of the worlds. Who is this Siva apart from us both?"
verses.commentary: Sense: Then Brahma who was infuriated spoke to Visnu whose eyes resembled the lotus: — ''Indeed you do not know yourself as the lord of all the worlds. You do not know me also as Brahma, the eternal creator of the worlds. Who is this Siva apart from us both?"

verses.sanskrit: नमो ऽंबिकाधिपतये उमायाः पतये नमः हिरण्यबाहवे तुभ्यं नमस्ते हेमरेतसे
verses.transliteration: namo 'ṃbikādhipataye umāyāḥ pataye namaḥ hiraṇyabāhave tubhyaṃ namaste hemaretase
verses.translation: Then Brahma who was infuriated spoke to Visnu whose eyes resembled the lotus: — ''Indeed you do not know yourself as the lord of all the worlds. You do not know me also as Brahma, the eternal creator of the worlds. Who is this Siva apart from us both?"
verses.hindi: आपको बोध करानेकी इच्छासे मैंने तो क्रीड़ापूर्वक हैवयोगसे यों ही अपने सभी दरवाजे शीघ्र बन्द कर लिये थे। इसे आप कुछ भी अन्यथा न समझें। हे कल्याणकारक! आप मेरे मान्य तथा पूज्य हैं, अतएव मैंने आपका जो भी अपकार किया है, वह सब आप क्षमा करें
verses.wordMeaning: Then Brahma who was infuriated spoke to Visnu whose eyes resembled the lotus: — ''Indeed you do not know yourself as the lord of all the worlds. You do not know me also as Brahma, the eternal creator of the worlds. Who is this Siva apart from us both?"
verses.commentary: Sense: Then Brahma who was infuriated spoke to Visnu whose eyes resembled the lotus: — ''Indeed you do not know yourself as the lord of all the worlds. You do not know me also as Brahma, the eternal creator of the worlds. Who is this Siva apart from us both?"

verses.sanskrit: नीलकेशाय वित्ताय शितिकण्ठाय वै नमः कपर्दिने नमस्तुभ्यं नागाङ्गाभरणाय च
verses.transliteration: nīlakeśāya vittāya śitikaṇṭhāya vai namaḥ kapardine namastubhyaṃ nāgāṅgābharaṇāya ca
verses.translation: Then Brahma who was infuriated spoke to Visnu whose eyes resembled the lotus: — ''Indeed you do not know yourself as the lord of all the worlds. You do not know me also as Brahma, the eternal creator of the worlds. Who is this Siva apart from us both?"
verses.hindi: हे प्रभो! मेरे द्वार वहन किये जाते हुए आप अब कमलसे उतर आइये; क्योंकि आपके अत्यन्त गुरुतर तथा तेजसम्पन्न होनेके कारण मैं आपका भार सहन करनेमें समर्थ नहीं हूँ तब ब्रह्माने कहा कि आप मुझसे वरदान माँगिये। इसपर विष्णु कहने लगे- है प्रभो! आप कमलसे नीचे उतर आइये और यही वर दीजिये कि आप मेरे पुत्र बनेंगे। है शत्रुदलन! इससे आपको भी अपार हर्ष प्राप्त
verses.wordMeaning: Then Brahma who was infuriated spoke to Visnu whose eyes resembled the lotus: — ''Indeed you do not know yourself as the lord of all the worlds. You do not know me also as Brahma, the eternal creator of the worlds. Who is this Siva apart from us both?"
verses.commentary: Sense: Then Brahma who was infuriated spoke to Visnu whose eyes resembled the lotus: — ''Indeed you do not know yourself as the lord of all the worlds. You do not know me also as Brahma, the eternal creator of the worlds. Who is this Siva apart from us both?"

verses.sanskrit: वृषारूढाय सर्वस्य हर्त्रे कर्त्रे नमोनमः वीररामातिरामाय रामनाथाय ते विभो
verses.transliteration: vṛṣārūḍhāya sarvasya hartre kartre namonamaḥ vīrarāmātirāmāya rāmanāthāya te vibho
verses.translation: Then Brahma who was infuriated spoke to Visnu whose eyes resembled the lotus: — ''Indeed you do not know yourself as the lord of all the worlds. You do not know me also as Brahma, the eternal creator of the worlds. Who is this Siva apart from us both?"
verses.hindi: कमलसे नीचे उतर आइये। आप महायोगी तथा प्रणवरूप हैं। आप हमारे पूज्य हैं। आजसे आप सबके इत्येषानुगतिर्विष्णो कार्याणामौपसर्पिणी। यन्मयानन्तरं कार्य ब्रूहि किं करवाण्यहम्
verses.wordMeaning: Then Brahma who was infuriated spoke to Visnu whose eyes resembled the lotus: — ''Indeed you do not know yourself as the lord of all the worlds. You do not know me also as Brahma, the eternal creator of the worlds. Who is this Siva apart from us both?"

verses.sanskrit: नमो राजाधिराजाय राज्ञामधिगताय ते नमः पालाधिपतये पालाशाकृन्तते नमः
verses.transliteration: namo rājādhirājāya rājñāmadhigatāya te namaḥ pālādhipataye pālāśākṛntate namaḥ
verses.translation: Then Brahma who was infuriated spoke to Visnu whose eyes resembled the lotus: — ''Indeed you do not know yourself as the lord of all the worlds. You do not know me also as Brahma, the eternal creator of the worlds. Who is this Siva apart from us both?"
verses.hindi: अनवद्यां प्रियामिष्टां शिवां वाणीं पितामहात् न ह्येवमीदूशं कार्य मयाध्यवसितं तव
verses.wordMeaning: Then Brahma who was infuriated spoke to Visnu whose eyes resembled the lotus: — ''Indeed you do not know yourself as the lord of all the worlds. You do not know me also as Brahma, the eternal creator of the worlds. Who is this Siva apart from us both?"

verses.sanskrit: नमः केयूरभूषाय गोपते ते नमोनमः नमः श्रीकण्ठनाथाय नमो लिकुचपाणये
verses.transliteration: namaḥ keyūrabhūṣāya gopate te namonamaḥ namaḥ śrīkaṇṭhanāthāya namo likucapāṇaye
verses.translation: Then Brahma who was infuriated spoke to Visnu whose eyes resembled the lotus: — ''Indeed you do not know yourself as the lord of all the worlds. You do not know me also as Brahma, the eternal creator of the worlds. Who is this Siva apart from us both?"
verses.hindi: त्वां बोधयितुकामेन क्रीडापूर्वं यदूच्छया। आशु द्वाराणि सर्वाणि घटितानि मयात्मन: फरफफफफीफफफफफफफफफफ प्या विष्णुके नाभिकमलसे ब्रह्माजीका प्रादुर्भाव

verses.sanskrit: भुवनेशाय देवाय वेदशास्त्र नमो ऽस्तु ते सारङ्गाय नमस्तुभ्यं राजहंसाय ते नमः
verses.transliteration: bhuvaneśāya devāya vedaśāstra namo 'stu te sāraṅgāya namastubhyaṃ rājahaṃsāya te namaḥ

verses.hindi: Ea कभ अक क अक का कककफ फफफ बाआफकफकककककक भफ फक फक भाकामा फफफफफफ पुत्रो मे त्वं भव ब्रह्मन् सप्तलोकाधिपः प्रभो । ततः स भगवान् देवो वरं दत्त्वा किरीटिने

verses.sanskrit: कनकाङ्गदहाराय नमः सर्पोपवीतिने सर्पकुण्डलमालाय कटिसूत्रीकृताहिने
verses.transliteration: kanakāṅgadahārāya namaḥ sarpopavītine sarpakuṇḍalamālāya kaṭisūtrīkṛtāhine

verses.hindi: प्रत्यासन्नमथायान्तं बालार्काभं महाननम् दशबाहुस्त्रिशूलाङ्को नयनैर्विश्वतः स्थितः। लोकप्रभुः स्वयं साक्षाद्विकृतो मुञ्जमेखली

verses.sanskrit: वेदगर्भाय गर्भाय विश्वगर्भाय ते शिव विररामेति संस्तुत्वा ब्रह्मणा सहितो हरिः
verses.transliteration: vedagarbhāya garbhāya viśvagarbhāya te śiva virarāmeti saṃstutvā brahmaṇā sahito hariḥ

verses.hindi: तेनैवमुक्तो भगवान् विष्णुर्ब्रह्माणमब्रवीत् वेगेन महताकाशेऽप्युत्थिताश्च जलाशयाः
