verses.sanskrit: एतत्स्तोत्रवरं पुण्यं सर्वपापप्रणाशनम् यः पठेच्छ्रावयेद्वापि ब्राह्मणान् वेदपारगान्
verses.transliteration: etatstotravaraṃ puṇyaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam yaḥ paṭhecchrāvayedvāpi brāhmaṇān vedapāragān
verses.translation: Then Brahma who was infuriated spoke to Visnu whose eyes resembled the lotus: — ''Indeed you do not know yourself as the lord of all the worlds. You do not know me also as Brahma, the eternal creator of the worlds. Who is this Siva apart from us both?"
verses.hindi: स्थूलाद्द्रिविश्वतोऽत्यर्थं सिच्यसे पद्मसम्भव। घ्राणजेन च वातेन कम्प्यमानं त्वया सह ततः क्रद्धोऽम्बुजाभाश्षं ब्रह्म प्रोवाच केशवम्
verses.wordMeaning: Then Brahma who was infuriated spoke to Visnu whose eyes resembled the lotus: — ''Indeed you do not know yourself as the lord of all the worlds. You do not know me also as Brahma, the eternal creator of the worlds. Who is this Siva apart from us both?"
verses.commentary: Sense: Then Brahma who was infuriated spoke to Visnu whose eyes resembled the lotus: — ''Indeed you do not know yourself as the lord of all the worlds. You do not know me also as Brahma, the eternal creator of the worlds. Who is this Siva apart from us both?"

verses.sanskrit: स याति ब्रह्मणो लोके पापकर्मरतो ऽपि वै तस्माज्जपेत्पठेन्नित्यं श्रावयेद्ब्राह्मणाञ्छुभान्
verses.transliteration: sa yāti brahmaṇo loke pāpakarmarato 'pi vai tasmājjapetpaṭhennityaṃ śrāvayedbrāhmaṇāñchubhān
verses.translation: Then Brahma who was infuriated spoke to Visnu whose eyes resembled the lotus: — ''Indeed you do not know yourself as the lord of all the worlds. You do not know me also as Brahma, the eternal creator of the worlds. Who is this Siva apart from us both?"
verses.hindi: भवान्न नूनमात्मानं वेत्ति लोक प्रभुं विभुम् ब्रह्माणं लोककर्तारं मां न वेत्सि सनातनम् को ह्यसौ शङ्करो नाम आवयोर््यतिरिच्यते।
verses.wordMeaning: Then Brahma who was infuriated spoke to Visnu whose eyes resembled the lotus: — ''Indeed you do not know yourself as the lord of all the worlds. You do not know me also as Brahma, the eternal creator of the worlds. Who is this Siva apart from us both?"
verses.commentary: Sense: Then Brahma who was infuriated spoke to Visnu whose eyes resembled the lotus: — ''Indeed you do not know yourself as the lord of all the worlds. You do not know me also as Brahma, the eternal creator of the worlds. Who is this Siva apart from us both?"

verses.sanskrit: सर्वपापविशुद्ध्यर्थं विष्णुना परिभाषितम्
verses.transliteration: sarvapāpaviśuddhyarthaṃ viṣṇunā paribhāṣitam
verses.translation: Then Brahma who was infuriated spoke to Visnu whose eyes resembled the lotus: — ''Indeed you do not know yourself as the lord of all the worlds. You do not know me also as Brahma, the eternal creator of the worlds. Who is this Siva apart from us both?"
verses.hindi: महायोगेन्धनो धर्मो दुराधषो वरप्रदः ॥ स्वामी हैं तथा श्वेत पगड़ीसे सदा शोभायमान रहेंगे और इस प्रकार “पद्मययोनि' नामसे लोकमें प्रसिद्ध होंगे। हे ब्रह्मन्! है प्रभो! आप मेरे पुत्र तथा सात लोकोंके स्वामी
verses.wordMeaning: Then Brahma who was infuriated spoke to Visnu whose eyes resembled the lotus: — ''Indeed you do not know yourself as the lord of all the worlds. You do not know me also as Brahma, the eternal creator of the worlds. Who is this Siva apart from us both?"
verses.commentary: Sense: Then Brahma who was infuriated spoke to Visnu whose eyes resembled the lotus: — ''Indeed you do not know yourself as the lord of all the worlds. You do not know me also as Brahma, the eternal creator of the worlds. Who is this Siva apart from us both?"

verses.sanskrit: अथोवाच महादेवः प्रीतो ऽहं सुरसत्तमौ पश्यतां मां महादेवं भयं सर्वं विमुच्यताम्
verses.transliteration: athovāca mahādevaḥ prīto 'haṃ surasattamau paśyatāṃ māṃ mahādevaṃ bhayaṃ sarvaṃ vimucyatām
verses.translation: Both of you very powerful were born of me formerly. Brahma, the grandfather of the universe was born from my right side; Vi§nu, the soul of the universe, sprang from my left side. I am extremely pleased with both of you. I shall grant you the boon of your choice.
verses.hindi: तत्पश्चात् किरीटधारी विष्णुसे ऐसा ही होगा' कहकर अर्थात् वर देकर ब्रह्माजी प्रसन्नतायुक्त तथा द्वेषषहित हो गये। इसके बाद पितामहने उदीयमान सूर्यकी आभाके समान विशाल मुखवाले तथा अत्यन्त अद्भुत रूपवाले शिवको अति समीप आते हुए देखकर भगवान् विष्णुसे कहा- ॥ ५७-५८ /२॥
verses.wordMeaning: Both of you very powerful were born of me formerly. Brahma, the grandfather of the universe was born from my right side; Vi§nu, the soul of the universe, sprang from my left side. I am extremely pleased with both of you. I shall grant you the boon of your choice.
verses.commentary: Sense: Both of you very powerful were born of me formerly. Brahma, the grandfather of the universe was born from my right side; Vi§nu, the soul of the universe, sprang from my left side. I am extremely pleased with both of you. I shall grant you the boon of your choice.

verses.sanskrit: युवां प्रसूतौ गात्राभ्यां मम पूर्वं महाबलौ अयं मे दक्षिणे पार्श्वे ब्रह्मा लोकपितामहः
verses.transliteration: yuvāṃ prasūtau gātrābhyāṃ mama pūrvaṃ mahābalau ayaṃ me dakṣiṇe pārśve brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ
verses.translation: After saying this, the lord, the storehouse of mercy patted Visnu with his gentle and smooth hands out of compassion.
verses.hindi: हे विष्णो ! अप्रमेय, विशाल वक्त्रसम्मन्न, वाराहके समान दाढ़ोंवाला, फैले हुए केशोंवाला, दश भुजाओंवाला, त्रिशूलधारी, नेत्रोंसे हर जगह स्थित अर्थात् सर्वदर्शी, मुंजकी मेखला धारण किये, विकृत रूपवाला, उन्नत तथा विशाल मेढ़वाला, अत्यन्त भयंकर ध्वनि करता हुआ साक्षात् लोक-प्रभुतुल्य, महान् कान्तिसम्मन्न तथा तेजपुंज- सा यह कोन प्राणी सभी दिशाओं तथा आकाशको व्याप्त करके इधर ही चला आ रहा है?॥ ५९-६१/२॥
verses.wordMeaning: After saying this, the lord, the storehouse of mercy patted Visnu with his gentle and smooth hands out of compassion.
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying this, the lord, the storehouse of mercy patted Visnu with his gentle and smooth hands out of compassion.

verses.sanskrit: वामे पार्श्वे च मे विष्णुर् विश्वात्मा हृदयोद्भवः प्रीतो ऽहं युवयोः सम्यग् वरं दद्मि यथेप्सितम्
verses.transliteration: vāme pārśve ca me viṣṇur viśvātmā hṛdayodbhavaḥ prīto 'haṃ yuvayoḥ samyag varaṃ dadmi yathepsitam
verses.translation: Then with a delightful mind, Visnu bowed and spoke to the great lord who though devoid of Lihga was stationed in the Lihga.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्माीके इस प्रकार कहनेपर भगवान् विष्णुने उनसे कहा-इस सागरमें चलनेके कारण जिनके दोनों पैरोंके आघातसे आकाशमें महान् वेगसे जलाशय उठ रहे हैं, सभी ओर उठी हुई विशाल जल-बूँदोंसे आप सिक्त हो चुके हैं, जिनकी नासिकासे निकली वायुसे आपके साथ कम्पायमान यह महापद्म-जो मेरी नाभिसे उत्पन्न है, स्वच्छन्दतापूर्वक दोलायमान हो रहा है, वे ही आदि-अन्तरहित पार्वतीनाथ प्रभु शिव आ रहे हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Then with a delightful mind, Visnu bowed and spoke to the great lord who though devoid of Lihga was stationed in the Lihga.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then with a delightful mind, Visnu bowed and spoke to the great lord who though devoid of Lihga was stationed in the Lihga.

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्त्वा तु तं विष्णुं कराभ्यां परमेश्वरः पस्पर्श सुभगाभ्यां तु कृपया तु कृपानिधिः
verses.transliteration: evamuktvā tu taṃ viṣṇuṃ karābhyāṃ parameśvaraḥ pasparśa subhagābhyāṃ tu kṛpayā tu kṛpānidhiḥ
verses.translation: If love has been generated in you, if boon has to be granted to us, may our devotion to you remain perpetual and unswerving.
verses.hindi: अब हम दोनों मिलकर स्तोत्रके द्वारा इन वृषध्वज महादेवकी प्रार्थना करें॥ ६२--६५ /२॥ तत्पश्चात् कमलको आभाके समान नेत्रोंवाले भगवान् विष्णुसे ब्रह्माजीने कुपित होकर कहा कि लोकोंके स्वामी तथा सर्वव्यापी स्वयं अपनेको एवं जगतूके कर्ता मुझ सनातन ब्रह्माको आप नहीं जानते। हम दोनोंसे बढ़कर यह
verses.wordMeaning: If love has been generated in you, if boon has to be granted to us, may our devotion to you remain perpetual and unswerving.
verses.commentary: Sense: If love has been generated in you, if boon has to be granted to us, may our devotion to you remain perpetual and unswerving.

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रहृष्टमनसा प्रणिपत्य महेश्वरम् प्राह नारायणो नाथं लिङ्गस्थं लिङ्गवर्जितम्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prahṛṣṭamanasā praṇipatya maheśvaram prāha nārāyaṇo nāthaṃ liṅgasthaṃ liṅgavarjitam
verses.translation: O Devas. the moon-crested lord accordingly granted them an unswerving devotidn and faith.
verses.hindi: शंकर नामवाला कौन है ?॥ ६६-६७ /२॥ उन ब्रह्माका वह क्रोधयुक्त वचन सुनकर भगवान् विष्णु बोले-हे कल्याणकारक! महात्मा शिवके लिये
verses.wordMeaning: O Devas. the moon-crested lord accordingly granted them an unswerving devotidn and faith.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Devas. the moon-crested lord accordingly granted them an unswerving devotidn and faith.

verses.sanskrit: यदि प्रीतिः समुत्पन्ना यदि देयो वरश् च नौ भक्तिर्भवतु नौ नित्यं त्वयि चाव्यभिचारिणी
verses.transliteration: yadi prītiḥ samutpannā yadi deyo varaś ca nau bhaktirbhavatu nau nityaṃ tvayi cāvyabhicāriṇī
verses.translation: Then Visnu knelt on the ground and bowed to the lord. With perfect control over himself he spoke to the lord in low tones.
verses.hindi: हेतुरस्याथ जगतः पुराणपुरुषोऽव्ययः। ऐसा निन्दित वचन मत बोलिये। ये महादेव सा बीजी खल्वेष बीजानां ज्योतिरेकः प्रकाशते॥ धर्मस्वरूप हैं, अत्यन्त प्रचण्ड हैं, महायोग प्रदीप्त करनेवाले तथा वर प्रदान करनेवाले हैं
verses.wordMeaning: Then Visnu knelt on the ground and bowed to the lord. With perfect control over himself he spoke to the lord in low tones.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then Visnu knelt on the ground and bowed to the lord. With perfect control over himself he spoke to the lord in low tones.

verses.sanskrit: देवः प्रदत्तवान् देवाः स्वात्मन्यव्यभिचारिणीम् ब्रह्मणे विष्णवे चैव श्रद्धां शीतांशुभूषणः
verses.transliteration: devaḥ pradattavān devāḥ svātmanyavyabhicāriṇīm brahmaṇe viṣṇave caiva śraddhāṃ śītāṃśubhūṣaṇaḥ
verses.translation: O lord of the Devas, our controversy has borne splendid fruits, since you yourself have come over here to remove the same.
verses.hindi: ये शिव ही इस जगतूके कारण हैं। ये प्राचीन पुरुष हैं, समस्त बीजों अर्थात् कारणोंके मूल बीज अर्थात् परम कारण हैं, निर्विकार हैं एवं एकमात्र ज्योतिके रूपमें जगत्को प्रकाशित कर रहे हैं। जिस प्रकार बच्चे खिलौनोंसे खेलते हैं, उसी प्रकार ये महादेव स्वयं जगतूके साथ खेलते रहते हैं अर्थात् नानाविध लीलाएँ रचते रहते हैं ॥ ७०/२ ॥
verses.wordMeaning: O lord of the Devas, our controversy has borne splendid fruits, since you yourself have come over here to remove the same.
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord of the Devas, our controversy has borne splendid fruits, since you yourself have come over here to remove the same.

verses.sanskrit: जानुभ्यामवनीं गत्वा पुनर्नारायणः स्वयम् प्रणिपत्य च विश्वेशं प्राह मन्दतरं वशी
verses.transliteration: jānubhyāmavanīṃ gatvā punarnārāyaṇaḥ svayam praṇipatya ca viśveśaṃ prāha mandataraṃ vaśī
verses.translation: On hearing this, Lord Siva again spoke smiling to Visriu who bowed to him with his head bent down and who stood with palms joined in reverence.
verses.hindi: नित्य आदि ये नाम मुझ प्रसवधर्मीके हैं और जिनके मरण आदि दुःखोंका भलीभाँति अनुभव करके वैराग्यको प्राप्त यतियोंद्वारा दृष्टिगत किये जाते हैं। ये शिव बीजवान् हैं, आप (ब्रह्मा) बीज हैं तथा सनातनरूप मैं (विष्णु) योनि हूँ॥ ७१-७२/.॥
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing this, Lord Siva again spoke smiling to Visriu who bowed to him with his head bent down and who stood with palms joined in reverence.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing this, Lord Siva again spoke smiling to Visriu who bowed to him with his head bent down and who stood with palms joined in reverence.

verses.sanskrit: आवयोर्देवदेवेश विवादमतिशोभनम् इहागतो भवान् यस्माद् विवादशमनाय नौ
verses.transliteration: āvayordevadeveśa vivādamatiśobhanam ihāgato bhavān yasmād vivādaśamanāya nau
verses.translation: O Vi?pu, I am lord Siva, the unsullied, I divided my-
verses.hindi: विष्णुके इस प्रकार कहनेपर विश्वात्मा ब्रह्माने उनसे पूछा-आप योनि, मैं बीज तथा महेश्वर शिव बीजी (बीजवान्) किस प्रकार हैं? आप मेरे इस सूक्ष्म तथा अव्यक्त संदेहका निवारण करनेकी कृपा अनेक प्रकारसे लोकतन्त्र ब्रह्माकी उत्पत्ति जानकर भगवान् विष्णुने उनके इस परम निगूढ़ प्रश्नका उत्तर दिया। इन महादेवसे बढ़कर अन्य कोई भी गूढ़ तत्त्व नहीं है । महत्तत्त्वका सर्वोत्कृष्ट स्थान अध्यात्मज्ञानियोंका
verses.wordMeaning: O Vi?pu, I am lord Siva, the unsullied, I divided my-
verses.commentary: Sense: O Vi?pu, I am lord Siva, the unsullied, I divided my-

verses.sanskrit: तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा पुनः प्राह हरो हरिम् प्रणिपत्य स्थितं मूर्ध्ना कृताञ्जलिपुटं स्मयन्
verses.transliteration: tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā punaḥ prāha haro harim praṇipatya sthitaṃ mūrdhnā kṛtāñjalipuṭaṃ smayan
verses.translation: O Vi?9u, abandon your delusion. Protect this Brahma, who in the Padmakalpa, will become your son.
verses.hindi: उन्होंने अपनेको सगुण तथा निर्गुण--इन दो रूपॉमें विभाजित किया। उनमें जो निर्गुण हैं, वे अव्यक्तरूपमें तथा जो सगुण हैं, वे महेश्वररूपमें प्रतिष्ठित हैं प्राचीनकालमें सृष्टिके आदिमें मायाकी विधिको भी जाननेवाले, अगम्य तथा दुर्बोध उन्हीं महादेवके लिङ्गसे प्रादुर्भूत बीज सर्वप्रथम मेरी योनिमें गिरा। पुनः कालान्तरमें उस सागररूप योनिमें वह बीज स्वर्णके
verses.wordMeaning: O Vi?9u, abandon your delusion. Protect this Brahma, who in the Padmakalpa, will become your son.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Vi?9u, abandon your delusion. Protect this Brahma, who in the Padmakalpa, will become your son.

verses.sanskrit: प्रलयस्थितिसर्गाणां कर्ता त्वं धरणीपते वत्स वत्स हरे विष्णो पालयैतच्चराचरम्
verses.transliteration: pralayasthitisargāṇāṃ kartā tvaṃ dharaṇīpate vatsa vatsa hare viṣṇo pālayaitaccarācaram
verses.translation: Then you will see me thus, so will the lotus-born Brahmi too. Thus saying the lord vanished there itself.
verses.hindi: बालक्रोडनकैर्देवः क्रीडते शङ्करः स्वयम् । प्रधानमव्ययो योनिरव्यक्तं प्रकृतिस्तमः मम चैतानि नामानि नित्यं प्रसवधर्मिणः। यः कः स इति दुःखार्तैदुश्यते यतिभिः शिव:
verses.wordMeaning: Then you will see me thus, so will the lotus-born Brahmi too. Thus saying the lord vanished there itself.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then you will see me thus, so will the lotus-born Brahmi too. Thus saying the lord vanished there itself.

verses.sanskrit: त्रिधा भिन्नो ह्यहं विष्णो ब्रह्मविष्णुभवाख्यया सर्गरक्षालयगुणैर् निष्कलः परमेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: tridhā bhinno hyahaṃ viṣṇo brahmaviṣṇubhavākhyayā sargarakṣālayaguṇair niṣkalaḥ parameśvaraḥ
verses.translation: Ever since then the worship of the Lihga was well established in the world. The great goddess is the altar for the Lihga. The Lihga is the great lord himself.
verses.hindi: स एवमुक्तो विश्वात्मा ब्रह्मा विष्णुमपृच्छत ज्ञात्वा च विविधोत्पत्तिं ब्रह्मणो लोकतन्त्रिणः । इमं परमसादृश्यं प्रशनमभ्यवदद्धरिः
verses.wordMeaning: Ever since then the worship of the Lihga was well established in the world. The great goddess is the altar for the Lihga. The Lihga is the great lord himself.
verses.commentary: Sense: Ever since then the worship of the Lihga was well established in the world. The great goddess is the altar for the Lihga. The Lihga is the great lord himself.

verses.sanskrit: संमोहं त्यज भो विष्णो पालयैनं पितामहम् पाद्मे भविष्यति सुतः कल्पे तव पितामहः
verses.transliteration: saṃmohaṃ tyaja bho viṣṇo pālayainaṃ pitāmaham pādme bhaviṣyati sutaḥ kalpe tava pitāmahaḥ
verses.translation: Lihga is so called because, O gods, everything gets dissolved in it. The brahmin who reads this narrative of Lihga, in the presence of the Lihga image attains Siva-hood. No doubt need be entertained in this respect.
verses.hindi: महतः परमं धाम शिवमध्यात्मिनां पदम् पुरा लिङ्गोद्भवं बीजं प्रथमं त्वादिसर्गिकम्
verses.wordMeaning: Lihga is so called because, O gods, everything gets dissolved in it. The brahmin who reads this narrative of Lihga, in the presence of the Lihga image attains Siva-hood. No doubt need be entertained in this respect.
verses.commentary: Sense: Lihga is so called because, O gods, everything gets dissolved in it. The brahmin who reads this narrative of Lihga, in the presence of the Lihga image attains Siva-hood. No doubt need be entertained in this respect.

verses.sanskrit: तदा द्रक्ष्यसि मां चैवं सो ऽपि द्रक्ष्यति पद्मजः एवमुक्त्वा स भगवांस् तत्रैवान्तरधीयत
verses.transliteration: tadā drakṣyasi māṃ caivaṃ so 'pi drakṣyati padmajaḥ evamuktvā sa bhagavāṃs tatraivāntaradhīyata
verses.translation: Lihga is so called because, O gods, everything gets dissolved in it. The brahmin who reads this narrative of Lihga, in the presence of the Lihga image attains Siva-hood. No doubt need be entertained in this respect.
verses.hindi: मम योनौ समायुक्तं तद् बीजं कालपर्ययात्। हिरण्मयमकूपारे योन्यामण्डमजायत उल्बं तस्य महोत्सेधो योऽसौ कनकपर्वतः
verses.wordMeaning: Lihga is so called because, O gods, everything gets dissolved in it. The brahmin who reads this narrative of Lihga, in the presence of the Lihga image attains Siva-hood. No doubt need be entertained in this respect.
verses.commentary: Sense: Lihga is so called because, O gods, everything gets dissolved in it. The brahmin who reads this narrative of Lihga, in the presence of the Lihga image attains Siva-hood. No doubt need be entertained in this respect.

verses.sanskrit: तदाप्रभृति लोकेषु लिङ्गार्चा सुप्रतिष्ठिता लिङ्गवेदी महादेवी लिङ्गं साक्षान्महेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: tadāprabhṛti lokeṣu liṅgārcā supratiṣṭhitā liṅgavedī mahādevī liṅgaṃ sākṣānmaheśvaraḥ
verses.translation: Lihga is so called because, O gods, everything gets dissolved in it. The brahmin who reads this narrative of Lihga, in the presence of the Lihga image attains Siva-hood. No doubt need be entertained in this respect.
verses.hindi: ततश्च प्रतिसन्ध्यात्मा देवदेवो वर: प्रभुः। हिरण्यगर्भो भगवांस्त्वभिजज्ञे चतुर्मुखः आतारार्केन्दुनक्षत्रं शून्यं लोकमवेक्ष्य च। कोऽहमित्यपि च ध्याते कुमारास्तेऽभवंस्तदा
verses.wordMeaning: Lihga is so called because, O gods, everything gets dissolved in it. The brahmin who reads this narrative of Lihga, in the presence of the Lihga image attains Siva-hood. No doubt need be entertained in this respect.
verses.commentary: Sense: Lihga is so called because, O gods, everything gets dissolved in it. The brahmin who reads this narrative of Lihga, in the presence of the Lihga image attains Siva-hood. No doubt need be entertained in this respect.

verses.sanskrit: लयनाल्लिङ्गमित्युक्तं तत्रैव निखिलं सुराः यस्तु लैङ्गं पठेन्नित्यम् आख्यानं लिङ्गसन्निधौ
verses.transliteration: layanālliṅgamityuktaṃ tatraiva nikhilaṃ surāḥ yastu laiṅgaṃ paṭhennityam ākhyānaṃ liṅgasannidhau
verses.translation: Lihga is so called because, O gods, everything gets dissolved in it. The brahmin who reads this narrative of Lihga, in the presence of the Lihga image attains Siva-hood. No doubt need be entertained in this respect.
verses.hindi: भुवनानलसङ्काशाः पद्यपत्रायतेक्षणाः। श्रीमान् सनत्कुमारश्च ऋभुश्चैवोर्ध्वरेतसौ उत्पन्नाः समकालं ते बुद्धयातीन्द्रियदर्शनाः
verses.wordMeaning: Lihga is so called because, O gods, everything gets dissolved in it. The brahmin who reads this narrative of Lihga, in the presence of the Lihga image attains Siva-hood. No doubt need be entertained in this respect.
verses.commentary: Sense: Lihga is so called because, O gods, everything gets dissolved in it. The brahmin who reads this narrative of Lihga, in the presence of the Lihga image attains Siva-hood. No doubt need be entertained in this respect.

verses.sanskrit: स याति शिवतां विप्रो नात्र कार्या विचारणा
verses.transliteration: sa yāti śivatāṃ vipro nātra kāryā vicāraṇā
verses.translation: Lihga is so called because, O gods, everything gets dissolved in it. The brahmin who reads this narrative of Lihga, in the presence of the Lihga image attains Siva-hood. No doubt need be entertained in this respect.
verses.hindi: नारप्स्यन्ते च कर्माणि तापत्रयविवर्जिताः अल्पभूतं सुखं स्वर्गे दुःखानि नरके तथा।
verses.wordMeaning: Lihga is so called because, O gods, everything gets dissolved in it. The brahmin who reads this narrative of Lihga, in the presence of the Lihga image attains Siva-hood. No doubt need be entertained in this respect.
verses.commentary: Sense: Lihga is so called because, O gods, everything gets dissolved in it. The brahmin who reads this narrative of Lihga, in the presence of the Lihga image attains Siva-hood. No doubt need be entertained in this respect.

verses.sanskrit: कथं पाद्मे पुरा कल्पे ब्रह्मा पद्मोद्भवो ऽभवत् भवं च दृष्टवांस्तेन ब्रह्मणा पुरुषोत्तमः
verses.transliteration: kathaṃ pādme purā kalpe brahmā padmodbhavo 'bhavat bhavaṃ ca dṛṣṭavāṃstena brahmaṇā puruṣottamaḥ
verses.translation: How did Hrahma become the lotus-born (deity), hrmerly, in the Padmakalpa? How did \'i.snu and Biahma.sec loid Siva? Pleast' recount all this pailiculaily now.
verses.hindi: त्रयस्तु त्रीन् गुणान् हित्वा चात्मजाः सनकादयः ततस्तेषु प्रवृत्तेषु सनकादिषु वै त्रिषु
verses.wordMeaning: How did Hrahma become the lotus-born (deity), hrmerly, in the Padmakalpa? How did \'i.snu and Biahma.sec loid Siva? Pleast' recount all this pailiculaily now.
verses.commentary: Sense: How did Hrahma become the lotus-born (deity), hrmerly, in the Padmakalpa? How did \'i.snu and Biahma.sec loid Siva? Pleast' recount all this pailiculaily now.

verses.sanskrit: एतत्सर्वं विशेषेण सांप्रतं वक्तुमर्हसि आसीदेकार्णवं घोरम् अविभागं तमोमयम्
verses.transliteration: etatsarvaṃ viśeṣeṇa sāṃprataṃ vaktumarhasi āsīdekārṇavaṃ ghoram avibhāgaṃ tamomayam
verses.translation: The supreme loicl in liis qualified (sakala) state is characterized by three functions: viz. creation, sustenance and destruction. The idea is often repeated in the Puranas.
verses.hindi: भविष्यसि विमूढस्त्वं मायया शङ्करस्य तु। एवं कल्पे तु वै वृत्ते संज्ञा नश्यति तेडनघ शेषशय्यापर आसीन भगवान् विष्णुके नाभिकमलसे ब्रह्माजीका प्रादुर्भाव
verses.wordMeaning: The supreme loicl in liis qualified (sakala) state is characterized by three functions: viz. creation, sustenance and destruction. The idea is often repeated in the Puranas.
verses.commentary: Sense: The supreme loicl in liis qualified (sakala) state is characterized by three functions: viz. creation, sustenance and destruction. The idea is often repeated in the Puranas.

verses.sanskrit: मध्ये चैकार्णवे तस्मिन् शङ्खचक्रगदाधरः जीमूताभो ऽम्बुजाक्षश् च किरीटी श्रीपतिर्हरिः
verses.transliteration: madhye caikārṇave tasmin śaṅkhacakragadādharaḥ jīmūtābho 'mbujākṣaś ca kirīṭī śrīpatirhariḥ
verses.translation: A tall and lofty lotus was sportively created in his umbilicus as he lay there all-powerful self-contented but un- wearif'cl in activities. It was hundred Yojanas long. It resem- bled the mid-day sun. It had adamantine stalk.
verses.hindi: फ़फापापापापापापापापाफाफाफाफफफफफफफ फ OO कलक कफ का कक कफ फफफ फक आफ फफक फक आफ कफ कळक फफफ फफ फफफ फ फ फफ फ़ फा फ फ फ फ फ अण्डमें परिवर्तित हो गया
verses.wordMeaning: A tall and lofty lotus was sportively created in his umbilicus as he lay there all-powerful self-contented but un- wearif'cl in activities. It was hundred Yojanas long. It resem- bled the mid-day sun. It had adamantine stalk.
verses.commentary: Sense: A tall and lofty lotus was sportively created in his umbilicus as he lay there all-powerful self-contented but un- wearif'cl in activities. It was hundred Yojanas long. It resem- bled the mid-day sun. It had adamantine stalk.

verses.sanskrit: नारायणमुखोद्गीर्णसर्वात्मा पुरुषोत्तमः अष्टबाहुर्महावक्षा लोकानां योनिरुच्यते
verses.transliteration: nārāyaṇamukhodgīrṇasarvātmā puruṣottamaḥ aṣṭabāhurmahāvakṣā lokānāṃ yonirucyate
verses.translation: Even as the bountiful lord was playing (with the lotus), Brahma, who was born of the cosmic Egg of golden womb, who had golden colour, who was beyond the pale of the sense-organs, who had four faces and large eyes came near the lord casually. On seeing Visnu of splendid eyes sporting with the lotus that was glorious, divine, splendid and fragrant, Brahma was surpiiscd and asked in a tone filled with gentle- ness —
verses.hindi: एक हजार वर्षांतक वह अण्ड जलमें ही स्थित इस अवधिके अन्तमें वायुके द्वारा यह दो भागोंमें विभक्त हो गया। एक खण्डसे आकाश तथा दूसरे खण्डसे पृथ्वीका प्रादुर्भाव हुआ। यह अति उन्नत जो स्वर्णपर्वत मेरु है, वह उस अण्डके गर्भावरणसे निर्मित हुआ
verses.wordMeaning: Even as the bountiful lord was playing (with the lotus), Brahma, who was born of the cosmic Egg of golden womb, who had golden colour, who was beyond the pale of the sense-organs, who had four faces and large eyes came near the lord casually.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Even as the bountiful lord was playing (with the lotus), Brahma, who was born of the cosmic Egg of golden womb, who had golden colour, who was beyond the pale of the sense-organs, who had four faces and large eyes came near the lord casually.…

verses.sanskrit: किमप्यचिन्त्यं योगात्मा योगमास्थाय योगवित् फणासहस्रकलितं तमप्रतिमवर्चसम्
verses.transliteration: kimapyacintyaṃ yogātmā yogamāsthāya yogavit phaṇāsahasrakalitaṃ tamapratimavarcasam
verses.translation: On hearing the splendid words of Brahma, Visnu got up from his couch and with his eyes beaming with surprise replied: —
verses.hindi: तत्पश्चात् प्रतिसन्थ्यात्मा देवाधिदेव हिरण्यगर्भ चतुर्मुख महाप्रभु भगवान् ब्रह्मा आविर्भूत हुए तारा, सूर्य, चन्द्र तथा नक्षत्रपर्यन्त समस्त लोकोंको शून्य देखकर “मैं कौन हूँ'-एऐसा आपके विचार करनेपर पुनः एक हजार वर्षके अनन्तर यतियोंके पूर्वज, यत्नशील, प्रिय दर्शनवाले, समस्त भुवनोंको अपने
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing the splendid words of Brahma, Visnu got up from his couch and with his eyes beaming with surprise replied: —
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the splendid words of Brahma, Visnu got up from his couch and with his eyes beaming with surprise replied: —

verses.sanskrit: महाभोगपतेर्भोगं साध्वास्तीर्य महोच्छ्रयम् तस्मिन्महति पर्यङ्के शेते चैकार्णवे प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: mahābhogapaterbhogaṃ sādhvāstīrya mahocchrayam tasminmahati paryaṅke śete caikārṇave prabhuḥ
verses.translation: Thereupon Brahma icplicd to Visnu. Being deluded by the Maya of lord Siva, he could not fully comprehend Visnu who himself was deluded by the Maya of Siva and hence unknowable.
verses.hindi: तेजसे व्याप्त करनेवाले, कमलपत्रके समान विशाल सनन्दन नामक वे कुमार आपके पुत्ररूपमें आविर्भूत हुए, जिनमें सनत्कुमार तथा ऋभु ऊर्ध्वरेता थे। बुद्धि तथा इन्द्रियोंसे अगोचर, विशिष्ट ज्ञानसम्पन्न, जगतूको स्थितिके कारणरूप तथा तीन प्रकारके तापोंसे रहित वे
verses.wordMeaning: Thereupon Brahma icplicd to Visnu. Being deluded by the Maya of lord Siva, he could not fully comprehend Visnu who himself was deluded by the Maya of Siva and hence unknowable.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereupon Brahma icplicd to Visnu. Being deluded by the Maya of lord Siva, he could not fully comprehend Visnu who himself was deluded by the Maya of Siva and hence unknowable.

verses.sanskrit: एवं तत्र शयानेन विष्णुना प्रभविष्णुना आत्मारामेण क्रीडार्थं लीलयाक्लिष्टकर्मणा
verses.transliteration: evaṃ tatra śayānena viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā ātmārāmeṇa krīḍārthaṃ līlayākliṣṭakarmaṇā
verses.translation: The Self-born Brahma, the source of the origin of the universe sat in the lotus, resembling in lustre the interior of the lotus itself.
verses.hindi: कुमार एक साथ उत्पन्न हुए थे, जिनकी कर्ममार्गमें प्रवृत्ति नहीं थी जीवनमें सुख कम तथा दुःख अधिक है, जीवन जरा तथा शोकसे युक्त है, जीवनमें जन्म तथा मरण बार-बार होते रहते हैं, स्वर्गमें अत्यल्प सुख तथा नरकमें दुःख-ही-दुःख है और भावी अटल है-ये सब
verses.wordMeaning: The Self-born Brahma, the source of the origin of the universe sat in the lotus, resembling in lustre the interior of the lotus itself.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Self-born Brahma, the source of the origin of the universe sat in the lotus, resembling in lustre the interior of the lotus itself.

verses.sanskrit: शतयोजनविस्तीर्णं तरुणादित्यसन्निभम् वज्रदण्डं महोत्सेधं नाभ्यां सृष्टं तु पुष्करम्
verses.transliteration: śatayojanavistīrṇaṃ taruṇādityasannibham vajradaṇḍaṃ mahotsedhaṃ nābhyāṃ sṛṣṭaṃ tu puṣkaram
verses.translation: In the meantime, even as either of them was wholly engaged in a struggle with the other in the middle of the ocean, lord Siva of immeasurable soul, the lord of living beings appealed theie itself. Holding a trident in hand and clad in garmrnls of pure gold he came to the place where Visnu was lying on Sesa — the lord of serpents. As he waded through the waters quickly, big drops of water rose up in the sky, kicked up by his feet. The wind that blew was very hot and cold. On perceiving this wonderful phenomenon, Brahma spoke to Visnu ''See how hot and cold waters make the lotus shake.
verses.hindi: बातें अवश्यम्भावी हैं, ऐसा जानकर ऋभु तथा सनत्कुमारको आपके वशमें स्थित देखकर त्रिगुणातीत सनक-सनातन- सनन्दन--ये आपके तीनों महातेजस्वी पुत्र अध्यात्मसम्बन्धी ब्रह्मज्ञानको ओर प्रवृत्त हो गये॥ ८८--९० /२॥ तत्पश्चात् उन सनक आदि तीनों कुमारोंके ज्ञानमार्गमें प्रवृत्त हो जानेपर आप महादेवको मायासे विमूढ (मोहित) हो गये। है अनघ! इस प्रकार कल्पके प्रवृत्त होनेपर आपका ज्ञान नष्ट हो जाया करता है
verses.wordMeaning: In the meantime, even as either of them was wholly engaged in a struggle with the other in the middle of the ocean, lord Siva of immeasurable soul, the lord of living beings appealed theie itself.…
verses.commentary: Sense: In the meantime, even as either of them was wholly engaged in a struggle with the other in the middle of the ocean, lord Siva of immeasurable soul, the lord of living beings appealed theie itself.…

verses.sanskrit: तस्यैवं क्रीडमानस्य समीपं देवमीढुषः हेमगर्भाण्डजो ब्रह्मा रुक्मवर्णो ह्यतीन्द्रियः
verses.transliteration: tasyaivaṃ krīḍamānasya samīpaṃ devamīḍhuṣaḥ hemagarbhāṇḍajo brahmā rukmavarṇo hyatīndriyaḥ
verses.translation: Clear this doubt of mine and tell me what else you wish to do now."
verses.hindi: कल्पमें जो सूक्ष्म जीव तथा पार्थिव पदार्थ अवशिष्ट रह जाते हैं। उन सबको जाग्रत् करनेवाली यथैष पर्वतो मेरुर्देवलोको ह्युदाहतः। शक्ति ही ऐश्वरी माया कही गयी है
verses.wordMeaning: Clear this doubt of mine and tell me what else you wish to do now."
verses.commentary: Sense: Clear this doubt of mine and tell me what else you wish to do now."

verses.sanskrit: चतुर्वक्त्रो विशालाक्षः समागम्य यदृच्छया श्रिया युक्तेन दिव्येन सुशुभेन सुगन्धिना
verses.transliteration: caturvaktro viśālākṣaḥ samāgamya yadṛcchayā śriyā yuktena divyena suśubhena sugandhinā
verses.translation: "O Sir, are you in a perplexed state inside the lotus? O lord, what is it that 1 have done wlieicfore O excellent one among men, you speak to me thus: What is it for? Tell me factually." Lord Brahma, the storehouse of the Vedas, replied to the lotus-eyed lord of Devas who spoke thus in accordance with the activities of the world: — "It was I who formerly entered your belly in accordance with your wish. Just as all the worlds within my belly were seen by you O lord, so also all the worlds in your belly are seen by me. O sinless one after a thousand years I returned. With a spirit of rivalry and a desire to subject me to control, all the openings were closed suddenly by you. O blessed one, 1.pondered over it. By dint of my ow'n splendour I gained exit through the umbilicus by the lotus stalk. Let there be no dejection in your mind: O Visnu, this is the sequence of events in their gradual advancement. What should be done by me hereafter, kindly tell me: What shall I do?"
verses.hindi: तस्य चेदं हि माहात्म्यं विद्धि देववरस्य ह॥ ९४ जिस प्रकार यह मेरुपर्वत देवलोकके रूपमे प्रसिद्ध है, उसी प्रकार उन देवश्रेष्ठ महादेवके इस माहात्म्यको भी प्रसिद्ध समझिये
verses.wordMeaning: "O Sir, are you in a perplexed state inside the lotus? O lord, what is it that 1 have done wlieicfore O excellent one among men, you speak to me thus: What is it for? Tell me factually." Lord Brahma, the storehouse of the Vedas,…
verses.commentary: Sense: "O Sir, are you in a perplexed state inside the lotus? O lord, what is it that 1 have done wlieicfore O excellent one among men, you speak to me thus: What is it for? Tell me factually." Lord Brahma, the storehouse of the Vedas,…

verses.sanskrit: क्रीडमानं च पद्मेन दृष्ट्वा ब्रह्मा शुभेक्षणम् सविस्मयमथागम्य सौम्यसम्पन्नया गिरा
verses.transliteration: krīḍamānaṃ ca padmena dṛṣṭvā brahmā śubhekṣaṇam savismayamathāgamya saumyasampannayā girā
verses.translation: On hearing these loving, pleasing auspicious and irreproachable words of Brahma, Vifnii the destroyer of Hiranya- kasipu and of immeasurable soul, spoke sincere and simple words. This type of adverse action was not envisaged by me.
verses.hindi: ज्ञात्वा चेश्वरसद्भावं ज्ञात्वा मामम्बुजेक्षणम्। परमेश्वर महादेवका सद्भाव जानकर तथा मुझ महादेवं महाभूतं भूतानां वरतं प्रभुम्॥ ९५  कमलनयनको जानकर प्रणवयुक्त साममन्त्रोके द्वारा भूतोंके भी महाभूत वरदाता जगद्गुरु प्रभु महादेवको नमस्कार करके उठिये, अन्यथा ये क्रोधित होकर आ 5 त की केला न, अपने निःश्वाससे मुझे तथा आपको दग्ध कर
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing these loving, pleasing auspicious and irreproachable words of Brahma, Vifnii the destroyer of Hiranya- kasipu and of immeasurable soul, spoke sincere and simple words. This type of adverse action was not envisaged by me.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing these loving, pleasing auspicious and irreproachable words of Brahma, Vifnii the destroyer of Hiranya- kasipu and of immeasurable soul, spoke sincere and simple words. This type of adverse action was not envisaged by me.

verses.sanskrit: प्रोवाच को भवाञ्छेते ह्य् आश्रितो मध्यमम्भसाम् अथ तस्याच्युतः श्रुत्वा ब्रह्मणस्तु शुभं वचः
verses.transliteration: provāca ko bhavāñchete hy āśrito madhyamambhasām atha tasyācyutaḥ śrutvā brahmaṇastu śubhaṃ vacaḥ
verses.translation: You should not mis-understand me. You deserve my respect and worship. O auspicious one, foigive if at all I have committed any offence against you.
verses.hindi: इस प्रकार उनके महान् योग तथा अमित बलको एवं ज्ञात्वा महायोगमभ्युत्तिष्ठन्महाबलम्। जानकर आपको आगे करके अग्निसदृश प्रभावाले अहं त्वामग्रतः कृत्वा स्तोष्याम्यनलसप्रभम्॥ ९७  महादेवके निकट खड़ा होकर मैं उनकी स्तुति करूंगा
verses.wordMeaning: You should not mis-understand me. You deserve my respect and worship. O auspicious one, foigive if at all I have committed any offence against you.
verses.commentary: Sense: You should not mis-understand me. You deserve my respect and worship. O auspicious one, foigive if at all I have committed any offence against you.

verses.sanskrit: उदतिष्ठत पर्यङ्काद् विस्मयोत्फुल्ललोचनः प्रत्युवाचोत्तरं चैव कल्पे कल्पे प्रतिश्रयः
verses.transliteration: udatiṣṭhata paryaṅkād vismayotphullalocanaḥ pratyuvācottaraṃ caiva kalpe kalpe pratiśrayaḥ
verses.translation: You are borne by me, O lord, descend from this lotus. I cannot bear you. You are refulgent and weighty. Thereupon Brahma said once again: 'Tel' me, what boon you desire to have. O lord, take me down from the lotus*. Then Visnu said: 'O slayer of enemies, you should be my son. You wii: cttain splendid pleasure. Speak agreeable and loving words.
verses.hindi: इक्कीसवाँ अध्याय ब्रह्मा तथा विष्णुद्वारा की गयी भगवान् महेश्वरकी स्तुति एवं उसका माहात्म्य सूत उवाच सूतजी बोले--तदनन्तर ब्रह्माको आगे करके वे ब्रह्माणमग्रतः कृत्वा ततः स गरुडध्वजः।  गरुडध्वज भगवान् विष्णु अतीत, भविष्य तथा वर्तमान अतीतैश्च भविष्यैश्च वर्तमानैस्तथैव च॥ १  कल्पोंसे सम्बन्धित महादेवजीके वेदप्रतिपादित नामोंसे  इस स्तोत्रका वाचन करने लगे॥ ११/, ॥
verses.wordMeaning: You are borne by me, O lord, descend from this lotus. I cannot bear you. You are refulgent and weighty. Thereupon Brahma said once again: 'Tel' me, what boon you desire to have. O lord, take me down from the lotus*. Then Visnu said: 'O slayer of enemies, you should be my son.…
verses.commentary: Sense: You are borne by me, O lord, descend from this lotus. I cannot bear you. You are refulgent and weighty. Thereupon Brahma said once again: 'Tel' me, what boon you desire to have. O lord, take me down from the lotus*. Then Visnu said: 'O slayer of enemies, you should be my son.…

verses.sanskrit: कर्तव्यं च कृतं चैव क्रियते यच्च किंचन द्यौरन्तरिक्षं भूश्चैव परं पदमहं भुवः
verses.transliteration: kartavyaṃ ca kṛtaṃ caiva kriyate yacca kiṃcana dyaurantarikṣaṃ bhūścaiva paraṃ padamahaṃ bhuvaḥ
verses.translation: "He is wading through the ocean with great speed. When his feet press the surface of water, as he wades through the ocean with great speed, masses of water rise up even to the sky. O lotUs-bom one, you are being sprinkled from all sides with a heap of water. By the wind coming out of his nostrils, this great lotus emerged out of my navel is being shaken. It is lord Siva who has no origin and who destroys the world that has come. Let us eulogise the bull-bannered lord with hymns of prayer."
verses.hindi: रन इट स्तोत्रमुदीरयेत्। विष्णुजी बोले- है सुव्रत! आप तन तेजसम्पन्न विष्णुरुवाच भगवानूको नमस्कार है। क्षेत्राधिपति, बीजी तथा नमस्तुभ्यं भगवते सुत्रतानन्ततेजसे ॥ २ त्रिशूलधारीको नमस्कार है । सुमेंढ़ (सुन्दर लिङ्गवाले), तमः क्षेत्राथिपतये बीजिने शूलिने नमः।  ऽय (पूजनीय लिङ्गवाले), दण्डी तथा रकेत सुमेढ्वायार्च्यमेढ्राय दण्डिने रूक्षरेतसे॥ ३  कक्ष वीर्यवाले)-को नमस्कार है
verses.wordMeaning: "He is wading through the ocean with great speed. When his feet press the surface of water, as he wades through the ocean with great speed, masses of water rise up even to the sky. O lotUs-bom one, you are being sprinkled from all sides with a heap of water.…
verses.commentary: Sense: "He is wading through the ocean with great speed. When his feet press the surface of water, as he wades through the ocean with great speed, masses of water rise up even to the sky. O lotUs-bom one, you are being sprinkled from all sides with a heap of water.…

verses.sanskrit: तमेवमुक्त्वा भगवान् विष्णुः पुनरथाब्रवीत् कस्त्वं खलु समायातः समीपं भगवान्कुतः
verses.transliteration: tamevamuktvā bhagavān viṣṇuḥ punarathābravīt kastvaṃ khalu samāyātaḥ samīpaṃ bhagavānkutaḥ
verses.translation: Then Brahma who was infuriated spoke to Visnu whose eyes resembled the lotus: — ''Indeed you do not know yourself as the lord of all the worlds. You do not know me also as Brahma, the eternal creator of the worlds. Who is this Siva apart from us both?"
verses.hindi: रो ज्येष्ठको, श्रेष्ठको, पूर्वको तथा प्रथमको नमस्कार नमो ज्येष्ठाय श्रेष्ठाय पूर्वाय प्रथमाय च।  है। मान्यको, पूज्यको तथा सद्योजातको नमस्कार है। नमो मान्याय पूज्याय सद्योजाताय वै नम:॥ ४  गहर (अगम्य) -को, घटेश (चेष्टमान जीवोंके स्वामी) - गह्वराय घटेशाय व्योमचीराम्बराय च। को तथा आकाश एव वृक्षको छालको अम्बर (वस्त्र)- नमस्ते ह्यस्मदादीनां भूतानां प्रभवे नम. ii के रूपमें धारण करनेवाले तथा हम-जैसे प्राणियोंके वेदीं तीनां स्वामीको नमस्कार है
verses.wordMeaning: Then Brahma who was infuriated spoke to Visnu whose eyes resembled the lotus: — ''Indeed you do not know yourself as the lord of all the worlds. You do not know me also as Brahma, the eternal creator of the worlds. Who is this Siva apart from us both?"
verses.commentary: Sense: Then Brahma who was infuriated spoke to Visnu whose eyes resembled the lotus: — ''Indeed you do not know yourself as the lord of all the worlds. You do not know me also as Brahma, the eternal creator of the worlds. Who is this Siva apart from us both?"

verses.sanskrit: क्व वा भूयश् च गन्तव्यं कश् च वा ते प्रतिश्रयः को भवान् विश्वमूर्तिर्वै कर्तव्यं किं च ते मया
verses.transliteration: kva vā bhūyaś ca gantavyaṃ kaś ca vā te pratiśrayaḥ ko bhavān viśvamūrtirvai kartavyaṃ kiṃ ca te mayā
verses.translation: On hearing these words of Brahma uttered in rage Visnu spoke: "O auspicious one, bestower of welfare, do not speak ill of the great soul. Here is he who has the lustre of the splendid yoga, who is the invincible bestower of boons, who is the unchanging ancient Purusa, the cause of this universe. He is the sower of seeds and the refulgence of seeds, shining by him- self. He, the lord, plays with toys as do the childein. Piaclhana, the eternal womb, the unmanifest Prakrti and the quality tamas — darkness — these arc my names, ince I perpetually give- birth to 'creation. The person of your query is lord Siva who is the goal of the ascetics who, being afraid of the pangs of biith and death resort to him He is the sower of the sc(-d; you are the seed itself and I am the. tcrnal womb.''®- On being addicsscd thus, Brahma, the soul of the universe asked again:
verses.hindi: वेदानां प्रभवे चैव स्मृतीनां प्रभवे नमः। वेदोंके स्वामी तथा स्मृतियोंके स्वामीको नमस्कार प्रभवे कर्मदानानां द्रव्याणां प्रभवे नमः॥ ६  है। कमो तथा दान आदिके स्वामी और द्रव्योके अध्याय २१ ब्रह्मा तथा विष्णुद्वारा की गयी भगवान् महेश्वरकी स्तुति एवं उसका माहात्म्य
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing these words of Brahma uttered in rage Visnu spoke: "O auspicious one, bestower of welfare, do not speak ill of the great soul. Here is he who has the lustre of the splendid yoga, who is the invincible bestower of boons, who is the unchanging ancient Purusa,…
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing these words of Brahma uttered in rage Visnu spoke: "O auspicious one, bestower of welfare, do not speak ill of the great soul. Here is he who has the lustre of the splendid yoga, who is the invincible bestower of boons, who is the unchanging ancient Purusa,…

verses.sanskrit: एवं ब्रुवन्तं वैकुण्ठं प्रत्युवाच पितामहः मायया मोहितः शंभोर् अविज्ञाय जनार्दनम्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ bruvantaṃ vaikuṇṭhaṃ pratyuvāca pitāmahaḥ māyayā mohitaḥ śaṃbhor avijñāya janārdanam
verses.translation: "How is it that you aic the womb. I am the seed and hr
verses.hindi: धर्मवृक्षाय धर्माय स्थितीनां प्रभवे नमः। प्रभवे च परार्धस्य परस्य प्रभवे नमः नमः पुराणप्रभवे सर्गाणां प्रभवे नमः
verses.wordMeaning: "How is it that you aic the womb. I am the seed and hr
verses.commentary: Sense: "How is it that you aic the womb. I am the seed and hr

verses.sanskrit: मायया मोहितं देवम् अविज्ञातं महात्मनः यथा भवांस्तथैवाहम् आदिकर्ता प्रजापतिः
verses.transliteration: māyayā mohitaṃ devam avijñātaṃ mahātmanaḥ yathā bhavāṃstathaivāham ādikartā prajāpatiḥ
verses.translation: According to the Puranic account of creation (sarga), in the begin- ning, the Cosmic Egg which arose out of the waters was insentient. It remained in this state for thousands of years until it was activated by the sentient principle which entering divided it into two parts. One of the two halves b 'f ame the celestial and the other the terrestrial sphere.
verses.hindi: नमो विश्वस्य प्रभवे ब्रह्माधिपतये नमः स्वामीको नमस्कार है
verses.wordMeaning: According to the Puranic account of creation (sarga), in the begin- ning, the Cosmic Egg which arose out of the waters was insentient. It remained in this state for thousands of years until it was activated by the sentient principle which entering divided it into two parts.…
verses.commentary: Sense: According to the Puranic account of creation (sarga), in the begin- ning, the Cosmic Egg which arose out of the waters was insentient. It remained in this state for thousands of years until it was activated by the sentient principle which entering divided it into two parts.…

verses.sanskrit: सविस्मयं वचः श्रुत्वा ब्रह्मणो लोकतन्त्रिणः अनुज्ञातश् च ते नाथ वैकुण्ठो विश्वसंभवः
verses.transliteration: savismayaṃ vacaḥ śrutvā brahmaṇo lokatantriṇaḥ anujñātaś ca te nātha vaikuṇṭho viśvasaṃbhavaḥ
verses.translation: After thinking about the multiformed creation, Visnu spoke in answer to this specific query of Brahma, the creator of the worlds.
verses.hindi: योगके प्रभुको नमस्कार है और सांख्यके प्रभुको नमस्कार है। ध्रुवसे सम्बन्धित ऋषियों अर्थात् सप्तर्षियोंके प्रभुको नमस्कार है नक्षत्रोके स्वामीको नमस्कार है, ग्रहोंके स्वामीको नमस्कार है, आपको नमस्कार है। विद्युताग्निसे युक्त मेघोंकी गर्जनाके स्वामीको नमस्कार है
verses.wordMeaning: After thinking about the multiformed creation, Visnu spoke in answer to this specific query of Brahma, the creator of the worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: After thinking about the multiformed creation, Visnu spoke in answer to this specific query of Brahma, the creator of the worlds.

verses.sanskrit: कौतूहलान्महायोगी प्रविष्टो ब्रह्मणो मुखम् इमानष्टादश द्वीपान् ससमुद्रान् सपर्वतान्
verses.transliteration: kautūhalānmahāyogī praviṣṭo brahmaṇo mukham imānaṣṭādaśa dvīpān sasamudrān saparvatān
verses.translation: For a thousand years the Egg lay in the waters. There- it was split into two by the force of the wind.
verses.hindi: महासागरोंके स्वामी तथा द्वीपोंके स्वामीको नमस्कार है। पर्वतों तथा भारत आदि नौ वर्षाके स्वामीको नमस्कार है। नदियों तथा नदोंके स्वामीको नमस्कार है । महौषधियों तथा वृक्षोंके स्वामीको नमस्कार अनेकविध धर्मोके कारणरूप धर्मवृक्षको नमस्कार है, धर्मको नमस्कार है तथा स्थितियोंके स्वामीको नमस्कार है। परार्धके स्वामी तथा परके स्वामीको नमस्कार है
verses.wordMeaning: For a thousand years the Egg lay in the waters. There- it was split into two by the force of the wind.
verses.commentary: Sense: For a thousand years the Egg lay in the waters. There- it was split into two by the force of the wind.

verses.sanskrit: प्रविश्य सुमहातेजाश् चातुर्वर्ण्यसमाकुलान् ब्रह्मणस्तम्भपर्यन्तं सप्तलोकान् सनातनान्
verses.transliteration: praviśya sumahātejāś cāturvarṇyasamākulān brahmaṇastambhaparyantaṃ saptalokān sanātanān
verses.translation: The upper lid of the Egg became the heaven and the lower lid became the earth. The foetus became the lofty golden mountain Meru.
verses.hindi: सभी रसोंके स्वामी तथा रत्नोंके स्वामीको नमस्कार है। क्षणोंके स्वामी तथा लबों (क्षणांश)-के स्वामीको नमस्कार है। दिन, रात, अर्धमास (पक्ष) तथा मासोंके स्वामीको नमस्कार है । ऋतुओंके स्वामी तथा संख्याओंके स्वामी आप शिवको नमस्कार है
verses.wordMeaning: The upper lid of the Egg became the heaven and the lower lid became the earth. The foetus became the lofty golden mountain Meru.
verses.commentary: Sense: The upper lid of the Egg became the heaven and the lower lid became the earth. The foetus became the lofty golden mountain Meru.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मणस्तूदरे दृष्ट्वा सर्वान्विष्णुर्महाभुजः अहो ऽस्य तपसो वीर्यम् इत्युक्त्वा च पुनः पुनः
verses.transliteration: brahmaṇastūdare dṛṣṭvā sarvānviṣṇurmahābhujaḥ aho 'sya tapaso vīryam ityuktvā ca punaḥ punaḥ
verses.translation: I'hen with the soul entering the womb, you, the lord, Hiranyagarbha the most excellent of the lords ofDevas, and of four faces were born.
verses.hindi: अपरार्ध तथा परार्धके स्वामीको नमस्कार है। पुराणोंके स्वामीको नमस्कार है। सर्गोके स्वामीको नमस्कार है। मन्वन्तरोंके स्वामी तथा योगके स्वामीको नमस्कार है। (जरायुज, अण्डज, स्वेदज तथा उद्धिज्जरूप) चार प्रकारको सृष्टिके स्वामीको नमस्कार है। अनन्त ज्योतिको नमस्कार है
verses.wordMeaning: I'hen with the soul entering the womb, you, the lord, Hiranyagarbha the most excellent of the lords ofDevas, and of four faces were born.
verses.commentary: Sense: I'hen with the soul entering the womb, you, the lord, Hiranyagarbha the most excellent of the lords ofDevas, and of four faces were born.

verses.sanskrit: अटित्वा विविधांल्लोकान् विष्णुर्नानाविधाश्रयान् ततो वर्षसहस्रान्ते नान्तं हि ददृशे यदा

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्त्वाब्रवीद्भूयः पितामहमिदं हरिः भगवानेवमेवाहं शाश्वतं हि ममोदरम्
verses.transliteration: evamuktvābravīdbhūyaḥ pitāmahamidaṃ hariḥ bhagavānevamevāhaṃ śāśvataṃ hi mamodaram
verses.translation: Thus in the functioning of the kalpa, when the three sons — Sanaka and others took to detachment you will become confused and deluded through the illusory power of lord Siva. Then O sinless one, your consciousness will perish. In the present kalpa, the elements both gross and subtle will be affected by his maya who, in fact, is the activizer of these elements. This great and glorious account of the most excellent of all Devas is as famous as the golden Meru— the mountain- ous abode of Devas.
verses.hindi: सभी गुप्त पिशाचोंके गुह्याधिपतिको नमस्कार है । गोकर्ण, गोप्ता तथा शंकुकर्णको नमस्कार है । वाराहको, अप्रमेयको, ऋक्षको तथा विरजको नमस्कार है । देवताओंके पति तथा गणोंके पतिको नमस्कार है जलोंके पति तथा ओजोंके पतिको नमस्कार है । लक्ष्मीपति, लक्ष्मीके रक्षक तथा पृथ्वीके पालन- कर्ताको नमस्कार है। शक्तिमान् तथा शक्तिहीन प्राणियोंके समुच्चयरूप शिवको नमस्कार है। अक्षोभ्यक्षोभणको
verses.wordMeaning: Thus in the functioning of the kalpa, when the three sons — Sanaka and others took to detachment you will become confused and deluded through the illusory power of lord Siva. Then O sinless one, your consciousness will perish. In the present kalpa,…

verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to the lord of the Vyantaras, of yoga, and of fourfold creation. Obeisance to one of infinite vision; to the lord of all occupations that have sprung up from the beginning of kalpa (that is creation itself).…

verses.sanskrit: एतन्मे संशयं ब्रूहि किं वा त्वन्यच्चिकीर्षसि एतदेवंविधं वाक्यं पितामहमुखोद्गतम्
verses.transliteration: etanme saṃśayaṃ brūhi kiṃ vā tvanyaccikīrṣasi etadevaṃvidhaṃ vākyaṃ pitāmahamukhodgatam
verses.translation: Obeisance to the source of origin and the overlord of mantras, pitrs and the individual souls. Obeisance to you,
verses.hindi: करनेवाले, विश्व, विश्वरूप तथा सभी ओरसे सिरवाले शिवको नमस्कार है। सभी दिशाओंमें हाथों तथा पैरोंवाले, अप्रतिम, हव्य, कव्य तथा हव्यवाहरूप रुद्रको नमस्कार है सिद्ध, पवित्रात्मा, यज्ञरूप, यज्ञपरायण, सुवीर, सुघोर, अक्षोभ्यका भी क्षोभण करनेवाले, सुन्दर प्रजाओंवाले, तीव्र मेधावाले, दीप्त, भास्कर, बुद्ध, शुद्ध, प्रतिष्ठित तथा विस्तृत शिवको नमस्कार है
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to the source of origin and the overlord of mantras, pitrs and the individual souls. Obeisance to you,
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to the source of origin and the overlord of mantras, pitrs and the individual souls. Obeisance to you,

verses.sanskrit: श्रुत्वाप्रतिमकर्मा हि भगवानसुरान्तकृत् किं नु खल्वत्र मे नाभ्यां भूतमन्यत्कृतालयम्
verses.transliteration: śrutvāpratimakarmā hi bhagavānasurāntakṛt kiṃ nu khalvatra me nābhyāṃ bhūtamanyatkṛtālayam
verses.translation: Obeisance to the lord of Prajapatis, to the lord of the Siddhas, to the lord of daityas, danavas and raksasas.
verses.hindi: तथा शिशिर (ठंड)-रूप शिवको नमस्कार है। वक्रकेश शिवको नमस्कार है। सुन्दर वर्णवाले तथा तप्त स्वर्णके तुल्य आभावाले शिवको बार-बार नमस्कार है
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to the lord of Prajapatis, to the lord of the Siddhas, to the lord of daityas, danavas and raksasas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to the lord of Prajapatis, to the lord of the Siddhas, to the lord of daityas, danavas and raksasas.

verses.sanskrit: वदति प्रियमत्यर्थं मन्युश्चास्य मया कृतः इत्येवं मनसा ध्यात्वा प्रत्युवाचेदमुत्तरम्
verses.transliteration: vadati priyamatyarthaṃ manyuścāsya mayā kṛtaḥ ityevaṃ manasā dhyātvā pratyuvācedamuttaram
verses.translation: Obeisance to the lord of gandharvas, yak, garuda, snakes, serpents and birds.
verses.hindi: विरूपाक्ष, लिङ्गरूप, पिंगल, महान् ओजसे सम्पन्न, वृष्टिका अवरोध करनेवाले तथा सौम्य दृष्टिवाले शिवको नमस्कार है, नमस्कार है पीतरूप धनुर्धर शिवको नमस्कार है। विशेषतायुक्त तथा
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to the lord of gandharvas, yak, garuda, snakes, serpents and birds.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to the lord of gandharvas, yak, garuda, snakes, serpents and birds.

verses.sanskrit: किमत्र भगवानद्य पुष्करे जातसंभ्रमः किं मया च कृतं देव यन्मां प्रियमनुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: kimatra bhagavānadya puṣkare jātasaṃbhramaḥ kiṃ mayā ca kṛtaṃ deva yanmāṃ priyamanuttamam
verses.translation: Obeisance to the overlord of the guhyas and piacas, to Gokarna, to the protector, to Sahkukarna (one whose ears resemble the pike).
verses.hindi: सुवर्चसे च वीर्याय शूराय ह्यजिताय च जरासिद्ध नमस्तुभ्यमयसे वरदाय च। अधरे महते चैव नमः सस्तुपताय च
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to the overlord of the guhyas and piacas, to Gokarna, to the protector, to Sahkukarna (one whose ears resemble the pike).
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to the overlord of the guhyas and piacas, to Gokarna, to the protector, to Sahkukarna (one whose ears resemble the pike).

verses.sanskrit: भाषसे पुरुषश्रेष्ठ किमर्थं ब्रूहि तत्त्वतः एवं ब्रुवाणं देवेशं लोकयात्रानुगं ततः
verses.transliteration: bhāṣase puruṣaśreṣṭha kimarthaṃ brūhi tattvataḥ evaṃ bruvāṇaṃ deveśaṃ lokayātrānugaṃ tataḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to the incomprehensible varaha (boar); to the star bear, devoid of rajaS, the lord of Devas and asuras and ganas.
verses.hindi: विश्वाय विश्वरूपाय विश्वतः शिरसे नमः सर्वतः पाणिपादाय रुद्रायाप्रतिमाय च। नमो हव्याय कव्याय हव्यवाहाय वै नमः
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to the incomprehensible varaha (boar); to the star bear, devoid of rajaS, the lord of Devas and asuras and ganas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to the incomprehensible varaha (boar); to the star bear, devoid of rajaS, the lord of Devas and asuras and ganas.

verses.sanskrit: प्रत्युवाचाम्बुजाभाक्षं ब्रह्मा वेदनिधिः प्रभुः यो ऽसौ तवोदरं पूर्वं प्रविष्टो ऽहं त्वदिच्छया
verses.transliteration: pratyuvācāmbujābhākṣaṃ brahmā vedanidhiḥ prabhuḥ yo 'sau tavodaraṃ pūrvaṃ praviṣṭo 'haṃ tvadicchayā
verses.translation: Obeisance to the lord of the waters; the lord of reful- gence; the lord of Laksmi ( glory and splendour) and the lord of the earth.
verses.hindi: सुप्रजाय सुमेधाय दीप्ताय भास्कराय च। नमो बुद्धाय शुद्धाय विस्तृताय मताय च नमस्ते वक्रकेशाय ऊरुवक्षःशिखाय च। नमो नमः सुवर्णाय तपनीयनिभाय च
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to the lord of the waters; the lord of reful- gence; the lord of Laksmi ( glory and splendour) and the lord of the earth.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to the lord of the waters; the lord of reful- gence; the lord of Laksmi ( glory and splendour) and the lord of the earth.

verses.sanskrit: यथा ममोदरे लोकाः सर्वे दृष्टास्त्वया प्रभो तथैव दृष्टाः कार्त्स्न्येन मया लोकास्तवोदरे
verses.transliteration: yathā mamodare lokāḥ sarve dṛṣṭāstvayā prabho tathaiva dṛṣṭāḥ kārtsnyena mayā lokāstavodare
verses.translation: Obeisance to one who unifies the strong and the weak; to the agitator who cannot be excited; to the bull (Nandi) who has a single illuminated horn; and a huge hump.
verses.hindi: विरूपाक्षाय लिङ्गाय पिङ्गलाय महौजसे। वृष्टिघ्नाय नमश्चैव नमः सौम्येक्षणाय च पिशिताय पिशङ्काय पीताय च निषड्धिणे
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to one who unifies the strong and the weak; to the agitator who cannot be excited; to the bull (Nandi) who has a single illuminated horn; and a huge hump.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to one who unifies the strong and the weak; to the agitator who cannot be excited; to the bull (Nandi) who has a single illuminated horn; and a huge hump.

verses.sanskrit: ततो वर्षसहस्रात्तु उपावृत्तस्य मे ऽनघ त्वया मत्सरभावेन मां वशीकर्तुमिच्छता
verses.transliteration: tato varṣasahasrāttu upāvṛttasya me 'nagha tvayā matsarabhāvena māṃ vaśīkartumicchatā
verses.translation: Obeisance to one who is stable in the body; to one enveloped in halo; to one who represents the past, future and present.
verses.hindi: फफफफफाफाफपीफीपापा पीप फफफफफफफफफफफफफफ फ फ़ फ़ फ फ फ़ फ़ क़ फ फफक फ फ फ़ फ फ फ़ फ फ फ क फ़ फ फ फ फ फ फा फा फा म मी फी की मी म नमस्ते सविशेषाय निर्विशेषाय वै नमः। विशेषतारहित शिवको नमस्कार है। ईज्य, पूज्य तथा
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to one who is stable in the body; to one enveloped in halo; to one who represents the past, future and present.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to one who is stable in the body; to one enveloped in halo; to one who represents the past, future and present.

verses.sanskrit: आशु द्वाराणि सर्वाणि पिहितानि समन्ततः ततो मया महाभाग संचिन्त्य स्वेन तेजसा
verses.transliteration: āśu dvārāṇi sarvāṇi pihitāni samantataḥ tato mayā mahābhāga saṃcintya svena tejasā
verses.translation: ' Obeisance to the brilliant and virile, to the heroic and the unconquered, to the bestower of boons, to the best of persons of great soul.
verses.hindi: नम ईज्याय पूज्याय उपजीव्याय वै नमः॥ उपजीव्यको नमस्कार है क्षेम्य, वृद्ध, वत्सलको बार-बार नमस्कार है।
verses.wordMeaning: ' Obeisance to the brilliant and virile, to the heroic and the unconquered, to the bestower of boons, to the best of persons of great soul.
verses.commentary: Sense: ' Obeisance to the brilliant and virile, to the heroic and the unconquered, to the bestower of boons, to the best of persons of great soul.

verses.sanskrit: लब्धो नाभिप्रदेशेन पद्मसूत्राद्विनिर्गमः मा भूत्ते मनसो ऽल्पो ऽपि व्याघातो ऽयं कथंचन
verses.transliteration: labdho nābhipradeśena padmasūtrādvinirgamaḥ mā bhūtte manaso 'lpo 'pi vyāghāto 'yaṃ kathaṃcana
verses.translation: Obeisance to mahat ( the first evolute of Prakrti) in all its 3 stages, past, present and future;** obeisance to you repre- senting the people; to penance, to the bestower of boons.
verses.hindi: भूत, सत्य तथा सत्य-असत्यरूप शिवको नमस्कार है। पद्मवर्ण, मृत्युके विनाशक तथा मृत्युरूप शिवको नमस्कार है। गौर, श्याम, कद्रू (भूरावर्ण) तथा लोहितवर्ण शिवको नमस्कार है महासन्ध्याकालीन बादलोंके समान वर्णवाले, सुन्दर दीप्तिवाले, दीक्षा प्रदान करनेवाले, हाथमें कमल धारण करनेवाले, दिग्वास (दिशाओंमें वास करनेवाले अथवा दिगम्बर) तथा जटाजूटधारी शिवको नमस्कार है।
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to mahat ( the first evolute of Prakrti) in all its 3 stages, past, present and future;** obeisance to you repre- senting the people; to penance, to the bestower of boons.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to mahat ( the first evolute of Prakrti) in all its 3 stages, past, present and future;** obeisance to you repre- senting the people; to penance, to the bestower of boons.

verses.sanskrit: इत्येषानुगतिर्विष्णो कार्याणाम् औपसर्पिणी यन्मयानन्तरं कार्यं ब्रूहि किं करवाण्यहम्
verses.transliteration: ityeṣānugatirviṣṇo kāryāṇām aupasarpiṇī yanmayānantaraṃ kāryaṃ brūhi kiṃ karavāṇyaham
verses.translation: Obeisance to the minute as well as the great; to the all-pervading lord. Obeisance to bondage and liberation; to heaven and hell.
verses.hindi: रूप, गन्ध, नित्य तथा अविनाशी शिवको नमस्कार है उपस्थित होकर पालन-पोषण करनेवाले, अस्थिर, कर्मरूप, दुर्गम, महेश, क्रोधरूप, कपिल, तर्क-अतर्कसे परे विग्रहवाले, बलवान्, वेगरूप, बालुकामें विराजमान, प्रवाहरूप, स्थित, व्यापक, उत्तम मेधासम्पन्न, पृथिवीका
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to the minute as well as the great; to the all-pervading lord. Obeisance to bondage and liberation; to heaven and hell.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to the minute as well as the great; to the all-pervading lord. Obeisance to bondage and liberation; to heaven and hell.

verses.sanskrit: ततः परममेयात्मा हिरण्यकशिपो रिपुः अनवद्यां प्रियामिष्टां शिवां वाणीं पितामहात्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ paramameyātmā hiraṇyakaśipo ripuḥ anavadyāṃ priyāmiṣṭāṃ śivāṃ vāṇīṃ pitāmahāt
verses.translation: Obeisance to lord Siva, who is worthy of worship. Obeisance to the sacrifice, and to the deity of effulgent brilliance. Obeisance to the principle beyond all attributes.
verses.hindi: लालन-पालन करनेवाले, चन्द्रकला धारण करनेवाले, चित्ररूप, विचित्र वेष धारण करनेवाले, विचित्र वर्णवाले तथा यज्ञरूप शिव आपको नमस्कार है॥ ५०--५२॥ निहित (अत्यन्त हितकारक) आपको नमस्कार है । क्षमाशील, इन्द्रियजित् तथा वज्रके समान आघात करनेवाले शिवको नमस्कार है
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to lord Siva, who is worthy of worship. Obeisance to the sacrifice, and to the deity of effulgent brilliance. Obeisance to the principle beyond all attributes.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to lord Siva, who is worthy of worship. Obeisance to the sacrifice, and to the deity of effulgent brilliance. Obeisance to the principle beyond all attributes.

verses.sanskrit: श्रुत्वा विगतमात्सर्यं वाक्यमस्मै ददौ हरिः न ह्येवमीदृशं कार्यं मयाध्यवसितं तव
verses.transliteration: śrutvā vigatamātsaryaṃ vākyamasmai dadau hariḥ na hyevamīdṛśaṃ kāryaṃ mayādhyavasitaṃ tava
verses.translation: Obeisance to the noose, to the weapon, to one equipped with missiles as ornaments; to one who is the material for sacrifice; to one invoke<|; to one who partakes of what is offered in the sacrifice; to one who does desirable acts; to one who does acts of charity, such as digging wells; to the
verses.hindi: राक्षसोंका विनाश करनेवाले, विषका शमन करनेवाले, शुभ्र ग्रीवावाले, क्रुद्ध प्रतीत होते हुए भी सौम्य रूपवाले, सर्परूप, यमराजस्वरूप, तीक्ष्ण शस्त्र धारण करनेवाले, आनन्दस्वरूप, मोदसदृश, संन्यासियोके द्वारा ज्ञेय आप शिवको नमस्कार है। रोगविकारसे रहित, सर्वरूप महाकालको नमस्कार है
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to the noose, to the weapon, to one equipped with missiles as ornaments; to one who is the material for sacrifice; to one invoke<|; to one who partakes of what is offered in the sacrifice; to one who does desirable acts; to one who does acts of charity,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to the noose, to the weapon, to one equipped with missiles as ornaments; to one who is the material for sacrifice; to one invoke<|; to one who partakes of what is offered in the sacrifice; to one who does desirable acts; to one who does acts of charity,…

verses.sanskrit: त्वां बोधयितुकामेन क्रीडापूर्वं यदृच्छया आशु द्वाराणि सर्वाणि घाटितानि मयात्मनः
verses.transliteration: tvāṃ bodhayitukāmena krīḍāpūrvaṃ yadṛcchayā āśu dvārāṇi sarvāṇi ghāṭitāni mayātmanaḥ
verses.translation: The 26b, 27 and 28a are repeated in 34 and 35 of this Gh.
verses.hindi: ओंकार, ओंकारेश्वर, भग नामक देवताके नेत्रका नाश करनेवाले, मृगव्याधरूप, दक्षरूप, दक्षप्रजापतिके यज्ञका विध्वंस करनेवाले, सभी प्राणियोंके आत्मस्वरूप, सर्वेश्वर, अतिशयस्वरूप, त्रिपुरके संहर्ता, सुन्दर शस्त्र सुमेधसे कुलालाय नमस्ते शशिखण्डिने। चित्राय चित्रवेषाय चित्रवर्णाय मेधसे
verses.wordMeaning: The 26b, 27 and 28a are repeated in 34 and 35 of this Gh.
verses.commentary: Sense: The 26b, 27 and 28a are repeated in 34 and 35 of this Gh.

verses.sanskrit: न ते ऽन्यथावगन्तव्यं मान्यः पूज्यश् च मे भवान् सर्वं मर्षय कल्याण यन्मयापकृतं तव
verses.transliteration: na te 'nyathāvagantavyaṃ mānyaḥ pūjyaś ca me bhavān sarvaṃ marṣaya kalyāṇa yanmayāpakṛtaṃ tava
verses.translation: Obeisance to one refraining from violence, to one devoid of temptations, to one who is a redeemer of souls (Jivas), to one who bestows nourishment, to one who habitually re- presents and practises good conduct.
verses.hindi: अनामयाय सर्वाय महाकालाय वै नम: प्रणवप्रणवेशाय भगनेत्रान्तकाय च । मृगव्याधाय दक्षाय दक्षयज्ञान्तकाय च
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to one refraining from violence, to one devoid of temptations, to one who is a redeemer of souls (Jivas), to one who bestows nourishment, to one who habitually re- presents and practises good conduct.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to one refraining from violence, to one devoid of temptations, to one who is a redeemer of souls (Jivas), to one who bestows nourishment, to one who habitually re- presents and practises good conduct.

verses.sanskrit: अस्मान् मयोह्यमानस्त्वं पद्मादवतर प्रभो नाहं भवन्तं शक्नोमि सोढुं तेजोमयं गुरुम्
verses.transliteration: asmān mayohyamānastvaṃ padmādavatara prabho nāhaṃ bhavantaṃ śaknomi soḍhuṃ tejomayaṃ gurum
verses.translation: Obeisance to one who represents the past, future and present. Obeisance to the brilliant and virile, to the heroic and the unconquered, to the bestower of boons and to the best of persons of great soul. Obeisance to 'mahat* the first evolute ofPrakrti in all its three stag's: past, present and future. Obeisance to one without a fear.
verses.hindi: अध्याय २१ ब्रह्मा तथा विष्णुद्वारा की गयी भगवान् महेश्वरकी स्तुति एवं उसका माहात्म्य ९९ क क म फ फा फ फ फ फ फ फ का फ फ फ फ फ़ फ फ़ फ़ फफ फ फ फ क फ फ फ फफ फ फ फ फ फफ फ फ फ फ फक क फ फ़ फफ फ फा फा म फ फ मी की फी कीली सी लमक की कफी फ क कक फफफ फफफफ फफ फफफ फफफ फफफफफफफफफफफफफफफफफफक फफफ फफफ फफ फ फफ र्फरक ळक पूषदन्तविनाशाय भगनेत्रान्तकाय च। कामदाय वरिष्ठाय कामाङ्गदहनाय च
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to one who represents the past, future and present. Obeisance to the brilliant and virile, to the heroic and the unconquered, to the bestower of boons and to the best of persons of great soul.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to one who represents the past, future and present. Obeisance to the brilliant and virile, to the heroic and the unconquered, to the bestower of boons and to the best of persons of great soul.…

verses.sanskrit: स होवाच वरं ब्रूहि पद्मादवतर प्रभो पुत्रो भव ममारिघ्न मुदं प्राप्स्यसि शोभनाम्
verses.transliteration: sa hovāca varaṃ brūhi padmādavatara prabho putro bhava mamārighna mudaṃ prāpsyasi śobhanām
verses.translation: Obeisance to the ever young, of golden form, the bcsiowor <)i boons, the lowei, the upper and the lord of the sleepers-on.
verses.hindi: करनेवाले, धनुर्धर, कुठार धारण करनेवाले, दक्षके यज्ञमें पूषानामक देवताका दाँत तोड्नेवाले तथा भग नामक देवताको नेत्रविहीन करनेवाले, मनोरथ पूर्ण करनेवाले, वरिष्ठ, कामदेवका शरीर दग्ध करनेवाले, रणभूमिमें विकराल वक्त्रवाले, गजाननरूप, हैत्योंके संहारक हम ब्रह्मा, विष्णु आदि देवताओंके भी स्वामी, हैत्योंको क्रन्दित करनेवाले, शीतका निवारण करनेवाले, तीक्ष्ण रूपवाले, मृदुचर्म धारण करनेवाले, नित्य श्मशानसे
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to the ever young, of golden form, the bcsiowor <)i boons, the lowei, the upper and the lord of the sleepers-on.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to the ever young, of golden form, the bcsiowor <)i boons, the lowei, the upper and the lord of the sleepers-on.

verses.sanskrit: सद्भाववचनं ब्रूहि पद्मादवतर प्रभो स त्वं च नो महायोगी त्वमीड्यः प्रणवात्मकः
verses.transliteration: sadbhāvavacanaṃ brūhi padmādavatara prabho sa tvaṃ ca no mahāyogī tvamīḍyaḥ praṇavātmakaḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to the wearer of garlands, to the enjoyer of objects through the vehicle of sense-organs. Obeisance to one representing the universe, to one who is universe-formed and to one with heads, hands and feet all round. Obeisance toRudra the unsurpassed. Obeisance to one who receives offerings poured into the fire. Obeisance to one who represents fire that carries oblations to the gods.
verses.hindi: अनुराग रखनेवाले तथा हाथमें प्रज्वलित काष्ठ धारण करनेवाले भगवान् शिवको नमस्कार है प्रिय भक्तोंका पालन करनेवाले, मुण्डको माला धारण करनेवाले, शोकरहित, अनेकविध भूतोंसे घिरे रहनेवाले शिवको नमस्कार है। नर-नारीका विग्रह धारण करनेवाले (अर्धनारीश्वर), देवी पार्वतीका सदा
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to the wearer of garlands, to the enjoyer of objects through the vehicle of sense-organs. Obeisance to one representing the universe, to one who is universe-formed and to one with heads, hands and feet all round. Obeisance toRudra the unsurpassed.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to the wearer of garlands, to the enjoyer of objects through the vehicle of sense-organs. Obeisance to one representing the universe, to one who is universe-formed and to one with heads, hands and feet all round. Obeisance toRudra the unsurpassed.…

verses.sanskrit: अद्यप्रभृति सर्वेशः श्वेतोष्णीषविभूषितः पद्मयोनिरिति ह्येवं ख्यातो नाम्ना भविष्यसि
verses.transliteration: adyaprabhṛti sarveśaḥ śvetoṣṇīṣavibhūṣitaḥ padmayoniriti hyevaṃ khyāto nāmnā bhaviṣyasi
verses.translation: Obeisance to the holy one has all attainments.
verses.hindi: प्रिय करनेवाले, जटाधारी, मुण्डी, सर्पोका यज्ञोपवीत धारण करनेवाले, नृत्यमें अभिरुचि रखनेवाले, नृत्यशालाके प्रति प्रीति रखनेवाले, क्रोधरूप, गीतप्रिय तथा मुनियोंके द्वारा स्तुत्य शिवको नमस्कार है हाथीका मस्तक काटनेवाले अर्थात् सिंहरूप, तीक्ष्ण, अप्रिय, प्रिय, अति भयानक, प्रचण्ड, भगका प्रमथन करनेवाले, सिद्धसमुदायद्वारा नित्य अनुगीत महाभागको नमस्कार है । मुक्तरूपसे अट्टहास करनेवाले,
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to the holy one has all attainments.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to the holy one has all attainments.

verses.sanskrit: पुत्रो मे त्वं भव ब्रह्मन् सप्तलोकाधिपः प्रभो ततः स भगवान्देवो वरं दत्त्वा किरीटिने
verses.transliteration: putro me tvaṃ bhava brahman saptalokādhipaḥ prabho tataḥ sa bhagavāndevo varaṃ dattvā kirīṭine
verses.translation: Obeisance to one of good progeny, to one of good intellect and to one who is the brilliant sun. Obeisance to the enlightened, pure and all-pervasive and to one who is contem- plated on by all.
verses.hindi: क्रोधावस्थामें सिंहगर्जना करके प्रकम्पित शरीरवाले शिवको नमस्कार है तीव्र नाद करनेवाले, कूदने-फाँदनेवाले तथा प्रमुदित आत्मावाले शिवको नमस्कार है। श्वास लेनेवाले, दौड्नेवाले, अधिष्ठाता तथा आनन्दरूप शिवको नमस्कार है। ध्यान करनेवाले, जम्भाई लेनेवाले, रुदन करनेवाले
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to one of good progeny, to one of good intellect and to one who is the brilliant sun. Obeisance to the enlightened, pure and all-pervasive and to one who is contem- plated on by all.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to one of good progeny, to one of good intellect and to one who is the brilliant sun. Obeisance to the enlightened, pure and all-pervasive and to one who is contem- plated on by all.

verses.sanskrit: एवं भवतु चेत्युक्त्वा प्रीतात्मा गतमत्सरः प्रत्यासन्नम् अथायान्तं बालार्काभं महाननम्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ bhavatu cetyuktvā prītātmā gatamatsaraḥ pratyāsannam athāyāntaṃ bālārkābhaṃ mahānanam
verses.translation: Obeisance to yoi of curly hairs, ot great chest and tuft, of goiden colour, or resembling gold.
verses.hindi: तथा द्रवित होनेवाले शिवको नमस्कार है। छलाँग लगानेवाले, क्रीड़ा करनेवाले तथा लम्बे उदरयुक्त शरीरवाले शिवको नमस्कार है विकटरूप शिवको नमस्कार है। उन्मत्त देहवाले तथा किंकिणीसे शोभायमान शरीरवाले शिवको नमस्कार है। विकृत वेष धारण करनेवाले, क्रूर, कोपाविष्ट, अप्रमेय,
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to yoi of curly hairs, ot great chest and tuft, of goiden colour, or resembling gold.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to yoi of curly hairs, ot great chest and tuft, of goiden colour, or resembling gold.

verses.sanskrit: भवमत्यद्भुतं दृष्ट्वा नारायणमथाब्रवीत् अप्रमेयो महावक्त्रो दंष्ट्री ध्वस्तशिरोरुहः
verses.transliteration: bhavamatyadbhutaṃ dṛṣṭvā nārāyaṇamathābravīt aprameyo mahāvaktro daṃṣṭrī dhvastaśiroruhaḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to one who has odd eyes, to one assuming the form of Lihga, to one of tawny colour, to one of great prowess and to the destroyer of rain, to one of gentle eyes.
verses.hindi: रङ्गे करालवक्त्राय नागेन्द्रवदनाय च। हैत्यानामन्तकेशाय हैत्याक्रन्दकराय च नरनारीशरीराय देव्या: प्रियकराय च। जटिने मुण्डिने चैव व्यालयज्ञोपवीतिने
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to one who has odd eyes, to one assuming the form of Lihga, to one of tawny colour, to one of great prowess and to the destroyer of rain, to one of gentle eyes.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to one who has odd eyes, to one assuming the form of Lihga, to one of tawny colour, to one of great prowess and to the destroyer of rain, to one of gentle eyes.

verses.sanskrit: दशबाहुस्त्रिशूलाङ्को नयनैर्विश्वतः स्थितः लोकप्रभुः स्वयं साक्षाद् विकृतो मुञ्जमेखली
verses.transliteration: daśabāhustriśūlāṅko nayanairviśvataḥ sthitaḥ lokaprabhuḥ svayaṃ sākṣād vikṛto muñjamekhalī
verses.translation: Obeisance to one of brown, white, black, red, tawny and yellow colours. Obeisance to one who is possessed of a quiver.
verses.hindi: मन्यवे गीतशीलाय मुनिभिर्गायते नमः सिद्धसङ्कानुगीताय महाभागाय वै नमः। नमो मुक्ताट्टहासाय क्ष्वेडितास्फोटिताय च
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to one of brown, white, black, red, tawny and yellow colours. Obeisance to one who is possessed of a quiver.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to one of brown, white, black, red, tawny and yellow colours. Obeisance to one who is possessed of a quiver.

verses.sanskrit: मेण्ढ्रेणोर्ध्वेन महता नर्दमानो ऽतिभैरवम् कः खल्वेष पुमान् विष्णो तेजोराशिर् महाद्युतिः
verses.transliteration: meṇḍhreṇordhvena mahatā nardamāno 'tibhairavam kaḥ khalveṣa pumān viṣṇo tejorāśir mahādyutiḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to you, marked and not marked by special traits; Obeisance to one worthy of worship and adornment. Obeisance to one who is a suitable patron.
verses.hindi: नम उन्मत्तदेहाय किङ्किणीकाय वै नमः हे फफफफफफफफफफफफफाफफफफफफफफफाफफीफफफफफफफफक्रफाफीफीकककफफकीककीककीफफफफाफफफफफ अकळ कफ फक क्क कफ क फाकडमाडकफ कमफ मक कक कल फक कक कक्ष फ
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to you, marked and not marked by special traits; Obeisance to one worthy of worship and adornment. Obeisance to one who is a suitable patron.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to you, marked and not marked by special traits; Obeisance to one worthy of worship and adornment. Obeisance to one who is a suitable patron.

verses.sanskrit: व्याप्य सर्वा दिशो द्यां च इत एवाभिवर्तते तेनैवमुक्तो भगवान् विष्णुर्ब्रह्माणमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: vyāpya sarvā diśo dyāṃ ca ita evābhivartate tenaivamukto bhagavān viṣṇurbrahmāṇamabravīt
verses.translation: Obeisance to one befitting welfare. Obeisance to the elderly one. Obeisance to one favourably disposed. Obeisance to one representing the past, to the truthful one. Obeisance to one who is both true and untrue.
verses.hindi: वामप्रियाय वामाय चूडामणिधराय च। रक्षा करनेवाले, दीप्त तथा सगुणरूप शिवको नमस्कार है नमस्तोकाय तनवे गुणैरप्रमिताय च॥ वामभागमे अपनी प्रिया गौरीसे विभूषित, सुद चूडामणि धारण करनेवाले, बालरूप विग्रहवाले तथा अप्रमेय गुणोंसे सम्पन्न शिवको नमस्कार है
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to one befitting welfare. Obeisance to the elderly one. Obeisance to one favourably disposed. Obeisance to one representing the past, to the truthful one. Obeisance to one who is both true and untrue.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to one befitting welfare. Obeisance to the elderly one. Obeisance to one favourably disposed. Obeisance to one representing the past, to the truthful one. Obeisance to one who is both true and untrue.

verses.sanskrit: पद्भ्यां तलनिपातेन यस्य विक्रमतो ऽर्णवे वेगेन महताकाशे ऽप्युत्थिताश् च जलशयाः
verses.transliteration: padbhyāṃ talanipātena yasya vikramato 'rṇave vegena mahatākāśe 'pyutthitāś ca jalaśayāḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to one of lotus colour, to the destroyer of death, the lord of death, to one of white, dark, tawny and red colours and to one having the colour of a charmingly brilliant cloud at dusk, to one initiated, to one having lotus- like hands; to one without garments and to one with matted hair.
verses.hindi: सद्गुणोँसे युक्त, निगूढ़ तथा अगम्य गतिवाले शिवको नमस्कार है। सदाचारीजनोंद्वारा सेवित आपके दोनों चरण लोकधात्री इस पृथ्वीके तुल्य हैं। सभी सिद्धियो तथा योगोंका अधिष्ठानस्वरूप मध्यस्थित आपका उदर तारासमूहोंसे विभूषित विस्तृत अन्तरिक्षके समान है। आपके वक्षःस्थलपर शोभायमान श्रीयुक्त हार तारापुंजोंके मार्गको भाँति प्रतीत होता है। केयूर तथा अंगदसे विभूषित आपके दस हाथ दसों दिशाओंके
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to one of lotus colour, to the destroyer of death, the lord of death, to one of white, dark, tawny and red colours and to one having the colour of a charmingly brilliant cloud at dusk, to one initiated, to one having lotus- like hands;…
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to one of lotus colour, to the destroyer of death, the lord of death, to one of white, dark, tawny and red colours and to one having the colour of a charmingly brilliant cloud at dusk, to one initiated, to one having lotus- like hands;…

verses.sanskrit: स्थूलाद्भिर् विश्वतो ऽत्यर्थं सिच्यसे पद्मसंभव घ्राणजेन च वातेन कम्प्यमानं त्वया सह
verses.transliteration: sthūlādbhir viśvato 'tyarthaṃ sicyase padmasaṃbhava ghrāṇajena ca vātena kampyamānaṃ tvayā saha
verses.translation: Obeisance to one without magnitude; to one iden- tical with ail; to the unchanging and immortal one; to one who represents colour and smell; to the eternal and to the uninjured one; to the huge one in front; to one without illusions; to one full and satisfied; to one difficult of access; to one re- presenting anger and to the tawny coloured one.
verses.hindi: नीले अंजनके समूहके तुल्य विस्तृत परिधिवाला आपका श्रीयुक्त कण्ठ स्वर्णसूत्रसे सुशोभित है । विकराल दांतोंवाला आपका मुख अत्यन्त भयावह तथा अनृपमेय है। पद्ममाला तथा पगड़ीसे शोभायमान आपका सिर आकाशको भाँति अत्यधिक शोभाको प्राप्त हो रहा है
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to one without magnitude; to one iden- tical with ail; to the unchanging and immortal one; to one who represents colour and smell; to the eternal and to the uninjured one; to the huge one in front; to one without illusions; to one full and satisfied;…
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to one without magnitude; to one iden- tical with ail; to the unchanging and immortal one; to one who represents colour and smell; to the eternal and to the uninjured one; to the huge one in front; to one without illusions; to one full and satisfied;…

verses.sanskrit: दोधूयते महापद्मं स्वच्छन्दं मम नाभिजम् समागतो भवानीशो ह्य् अनादिश्चान्तकृत्प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: dodhūyate mahāpadmaṃ svacchandaṃ mama nābhijam samāgato bhavānīśo hy anādiścāntakṛtprabhuḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to one whose physical body is capable of being known and (at the same time) not known; obeisance to the powetful, to the brave; and the speedy one; obeisance to the deity behind sandy soil and behind current of water; to one stationed, extended and stretched.
verses.hindi: सूर्यमें प्रकाश, चन्द्रमामें कान्ति, पर्वतमें स्थिरता, वायुमें शक्ति, अग्निमें उष्णता, जलमें शीतलता तथा आकाशमें शब्दरूप विद्यमान-ये गुण अविनाशी शिवके निष्पन्द अर्थात् अल्पांशसे उत्पन्न हुए हैं-ऐसा मनीषी लोग मानते हैं। जप, जप्य, महादेव, महायोग, महेश्वर, पुरेशय, गुहावासी (गुफामें निवास करनेवाले), खेचर (आकाशमें विचरणशील), रजनीचर (रात्रिमें भ्रमण करनेवाले), तपोनिधि, कार्तिकेयके गुरु, आनन्दरूप,
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to one whose physical body is capable of being known and (at the same time) not known; obeisance to the powetful, to the brave; and the speedy one; obeisance to the deity behind sandy soil and behind current of water; to one stationed, extended and stretched.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to one whose physical body is capable of being known and (at the same time) not known; obeisance to the powetful, to the brave; and the speedy one; obeisance to the deity behind sandy soil and behind current of water; to one stationed, extended and stretched.

verses.sanskrit: भवानहं च स्तोत्रेण उपतिष्ठाव गोध्वजम् ततः क्रुद्धो ऽम्बुजाभाक्षं ब्रह्मा प्रोवाच केशवम्
verses.transliteration: bhavānahaṃ ca stotreṇa upatiṣṭhāva godhvajam tataḥ kruddho 'mbujābhākṣaṃ brahmā provāca keśavam
verses.translation: Obeisance to you the intelligent potter; obeisance to you, with the crescent Moon on the forehead. Obeisance t(» the wonderful one of variegated dress and colours and of the form of intellect.
verses.hindi: आनन्दको वृद्धि करनेवाले, हयशीर्ष (घोड़ेके सिरवाले विष्णुरूप), पयोधाता (जल धारण करनेवाले इ्द्ररूप), विधाता (ब्रह्मारूप), भूतभावन, बोद्धव्य (बोध करनेयोग्य), बोधिता (बोध करानेवाले), नेता, दुर्धर्ष भीमकर्मा (भयंकर कर्मवाले), बृहत्कोति (महान्
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to you the intelligent potter; obeisance to you, with the crescent Moon on the forehead. Obeisance t(» the wonderful one of variegated dress and colours and of the form of intellect.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to you the intelligent potter; obeisance to you, with the crescent Moon on the forehead. Obeisance t(» the wonderful one of variegated dress and colours and of the form of intellect.

verses.sanskrit: भवान्न नूनमात्मानं वेत्ति लोकप्रभुं विभुम् ब्रह्माणं लोककर्तारं मां न वेत्सि सनातनम्
verses.transliteration: bhavānna nūnamātmānaṃ vetti lokaprabhuṃ vibhum brahmāṇaṃ lokakartāraṃ māṃ na vetsi sanātanam
verses.translation: Obeisance to one, of great consciousness and alertness; obeisance to you, the most satisfied one and the best bestower of favours; obeisance to the forbearing one, to one having self- control; and to one of adamantine body.
verses.hindi: लोकधात्री त्वियं भूमिः पादौ सञ्जनसेवितौ दिशो दशभुजास्तुभ्यं केयूराङ्गदभूषिताः
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to one, of great consciousness and alertness; obeisance to you, the most satisfied one and the best bestower of favours; obeisance to the forbearing one, to one having self- control; and to one of adamantine body.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to one, of great consciousness and alertness; obeisance to you, the most satisfied one and the best bestower of favours; obeisance to the forbearing one, to one having self- control; and to one of adamantine body.

verses.sanskrit: को ह्यसौ शङ्करो नाम आवयोर्व्यतिरिच्यते तस्य तत्क्रोधजं वाक्यं श्रुत्वा हरिरभाषत
verses.transliteration: ko hyasau śaṅkaro nāma āvayorvyatiricyate tasya tatkrodhajaṃ vākyaṃ śrutvā harirabhāṣata
verses.translation: Obeisance to the destroyer of the R$asas, to the dispeller of poisons, to the bright-necked one and to one who is above anger. Obeisance to the all consuming God of Death; and to one holding sharp weapons, to one endowed with great joy, to one with great gaiety, to one comprehensible only to the
verses.hindi: दंष्ट्रा करालं दुर्धर्षमनौपम्यं मुखं तथा । पद्ममालाकृतोष्णीषं शिरो द्यौः शोभतेऽधिकम् जपो जप्यो महादेवो महायोगो महेश्वर:
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to the destroyer of the R$asas, to the dispeller of poisons, to the bright-necked one and to one who is above anger. Obeisance to the all consuming God of Death; and to one holding sharp weapons, to one endowed with great joy, to one with great gaiety,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to the destroyer of the R$asas, to the dispeller of poisons, to the bright-necked one and to one who is above anger. Obeisance to the all consuming God of Death; and to one holding sharp weapons, to one endowed with great joy, to one with great gaiety,…
