verses.sanskrit: मा मैवं वद कल्याण परिवादं महात्मनः महायोगेन्धनो धर्मो दुराधर्षो वरप्रदः
verses.transliteration: mā maivaṃ vada kalyāṇa parivādaṃ mahātmanaḥ mahāyogendhano dharmo durādharṣo varapradaḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to Pranava; to the lord of Pranava; to the destroyer of Bhaganetra; to the hunter of deer; to the diligent one and to the destroyer of Daksa's sacrifice.
verses.hindi: बृहद्रथो भीमकर्मा बुहत्कीर्तिर्धनञ्जयः। घण्टाप्रियो ध्वजी छत्री पिनाकी ध्वजिनीपतिः अध्याय २१ ब्रह्मा तथा विष्णुद्दार की गयी भगवान् महेश्वरकी स्तुति एवं उसका माहात्म्य
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to Pranava; to the lord of Pranava; to the destroyer of Bhaganetra; to the hunter of deer; to the diligent one and to the destroyer of Daksa's sacrifice.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to Pranava; to the lord of Pranava; to the destroyer of Bhaganetra; to the hunter of deer; to the diligent one and to the destroyer of Daksa's sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit: हेतुरस्याथ जगतः पुराणपुरुषो ऽव्ययः बीजी खल्वेष बीजानां ज्योतिरेकः प्रकाशते
verses.transliteration: heturasyātha jagataḥ purāṇapuruṣo 'vyayaḥ bījī khalveṣa bījānāṃ jyotirekaḥ prakāśate
verses.translation: Obeisance to one, the soul of all creatures, to one who excels all lords, to the destroyer of the Puras, to one having good weapons and to one having bow and axe.
verses.hindi: फफफफफफफफफफफ sii पापापाफपाफफपाफफाफफफफफफफफपाफफफफफफफफफफफफापाफाफापाफापापापालापासाचााचानासासानालाना फफ्फफफफ फफ फफ फफ फफफ फफफ फफफ फफफ फ फ फ फ़ फ फफ फ फ फ फ फ फ फा फ फ फ फा फा फ फी मी अघस्मरोऽनघः शूरो देवराजोऽरिमर्दनः
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to one, the soul of all creatures, to one who excels all lords, to the destroyer of the Puras, to one having good weapons and to one having bow and axe.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to one, the soul of all creatures, to one who excels all lords, to the destroyer of the Puras, to one having good weapons and to one having bow and axe.

verses.sanskrit: बालक्रीडनकैर्देवः क्रीडते शङ्करः स्वयम् प्रधानमव्ययो योनिर् अव्यक्तं प्रकृतिस्तमः
verses.transliteration: bālakrīḍanakairdevaḥ krīḍate śaṅkaraḥ svayam pradhānamavyayo yonir avyaktaṃ prakṛtistamaḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to one who destroyed Pusadanta and Bhaganetra; to the bestower of desires; to the excellent one; to one who burnt the body of Kama.
verses.hindi: अग्निः सदार्णवाम्भस्त्वं पिबन्नपि न तृप्यसे क्रोधाकारः प्रसन्नात्मा कामदः कामगः प्रियः ।
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to one who destroyed Pusadanta and Bhaganetra; to the bestower of desires; to the excellent one; to one who burnt the body of Kama.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to one who destroyed Pusadanta and Bhaganetra; to the bestower of desires; to the excellent one; to one who burnt the body of Kama.

verses.sanskrit: मम चैतानि नामानि नित्यं प्रसवधर्मिणः यः कः स इति दुःखार्तैर् दृश्यते यतिभिः शिवः
verses.transliteration: mama caitāni nāmāni nityaṃ prasavadharmiṇaḥ yaḥ kaḥ sa iti duḥkhārtair dṛśyate yatibhiḥ śivaḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to one of terrible face in the battlefield; to one having face of a great elephant; ob''isance to the lord who destroyed the Daityas and to one who caused distress to the Dailyas.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्मचारी चागाधश्च ब्रह्मण्यः शिष्टपूजितः देवानामक्षयः कोशस्त्वया यज्ञः प्रकल्पितः।
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to one of terrible face in the battlefield; to one having face of a great elephant; ob''isance to the lord who destroyed the Daityas and to one who caused distress to the Dailyas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to one of terrible face in the battlefield; to one having face of a great elephant; ob''isance to the lord who destroyed the Daityas and to one who caused distress to the Dailyas.

verses.sanskrit: एष बीजी भवान्बीजम् अहं योनिः सनातनः स एवमुक्तो विश्वात्मा ब्रह्मा विष्णुमपृच्छत
verses.transliteration: eṣa bījī bhavānbījam ahaṃ yoniḥ sanātanaḥ sa evamukto viśvātmā brahmā viṣṇumapṛcchata
verses.translation: Obeisance to you the protector of lives; to the wearer of skulls and to one surrounded by care-free goblins of different classes.
verses.hindi: प्रीते त्वयि महादेव वयं प्रीता भवामहे लोकानां त्वं ब्रह्मकर्तादिसर्गः।
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to you the protector of lives; to the wearer of skulls and to one surrounded by care-free goblins of different classes.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to you the protector of lives; to the wearer of skulls and to one surrounded by care-free goblins of different classes.

verses.sanskrit: भवान् योनिरहं बीजं कथं बीजी महेश्वरः एतन्मे सूक्ष्ममव्यक्तं संशयं छेत्तुमर्हसि
verses.transliteration: bhavān yonirahaṃ bījaṃ kathaṃ bījī maheśvaraḥ etanme sūkṣmamavyaktaṃ saṃśayaṃ chettumarhasi
verses.translation: Obeisance to one having male-rum-fcmalc body; to one who pleases the Goddess; to one having matted hair; to one having tonsured head and to one having the serpent for sacred thread.
verses.hindi: स्वकर्मभिस्ते दिव्यभोगा भवन्ति कीर्तितं तव माहात्म्यमपारस्य महात्मनः ॥
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to one having male-rum-fcmalc body; to one who pleases the Goddess; to one having matted hair; to one having tonsured head and to one having the serpent for sacred thread.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to one having male-rum-fcmalc body; to one who pleases the Goddess; to one having matted hair; to one having tonsured head and to one having the serpent for sacred thread.

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञात्वा च विविधोत्पत्तिं ब्रह्मणो लोकतन्त्रिणः इमं परमसादृश्यं प्रश्नम् अभ्यवदद्धरिः
verses.transliteration: jñātvā ca vividhotpattiṃ brahmaṇo lokatantriṇaḥ imaṃ paramasādṛśyaṃ praśnam abhyavadaddhariḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to one the habitual dancer, to one fond of dance and music, to the lord of anger, to one practising music and to one who is sung about by the sages.
verses.hindi: शिवो नो भव सर्वत्र योऽसि सोऽसि नमोऽस्तु ते। य इदं कीर्तयेद्धक्त्या ब्रह्मनारायणस्तवम्
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to one the habitual dancer, to one fond of dance and music, to the lord of anger, to one practising music and to one who is sung about by the sages.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to one the habitual dancer, to one fond of dance and music, to the lord of anger, to one practising music and to one who is sung about by the sages.

verses.sanskrit: अस्मान्महत्तरं भूतं गुह्यमन्यन्न विद्यते महतः परमं धाम शिवम् अध्यात्मिनां पदम्
verses.transliteration: asmānmahattaraṃ bhūtaṃ guhyamanyanna vidyate mahataḥ paramaṃ dhāma śivam adhyātmināṃ padam
verses.translation: Obeisance to one in the form of a lion, to one of sharp nature, to one both pleasing and not pleasing, to the horrifying and the terrible one, to the suppressor cf Bhaga demon.
verses.hindi: करनेवाले), छत्री (छत्र धारण करनेवाले), पिनाको (धनुर्धर), ध्वजिनीपति (सेनापति), कवची (कवच धारण करनेवाले), पट्टिशी (एक प्रकारका तीक्ष्ण लौह- दण्डरूप शस्त्र धारण करनेवाले), खड्गी (तलवार धारण करनेवाले), भनुर्हस्त (हाथमें धनुष धारण करनेवाले), परश्वधी (परशु धारण करनेवाले), अघस्मर (सबके पापकर्मोको स्मृतिमें रखनेवाले), निष्पाप, पराक्रमी,
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to one in the form of a lion, to one of sharp nature, to one both pleasing and not pleasing, to the horrifying and the terrible one, to the suppressor cf Bhaga demon.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to one in the form of a lion, to one of sharp nature, to one both pleasing and not pleasing, to the horrifying and the terrible one, to the suppressor cf Bhaga demon.

verses.sanskrit: द्विविधं चैवमात्मानं प्रविभज्य व्यवस्थितः निष्कलस्तत्र यो ऽव्यक्तः सकलश् च महेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: dvividhaṃ caivamātmānaṃ pravibhajya vyavasthitaḥ niṣkalastatra yo 'vyaktaḥ sakalaś ca maheśvaraḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to one praised and sung about by the en- lightened souls. Obeisance to the highly blessed, to one who laughs boisterously, who roars like a lion and who flaps and blows.
verses.hindi: पूर्वकालमें आपको प्रसन्न करके हम देवताओंने अपने शत्रुओंका युद्धमें संहार किया था। अग्निरूप आप सदा महासागरका जल पीते हुए भी कभी तृप्त नहीं होते हैं मनोरथोंको पूर्ण करनेवाले, अपनी इच्छासे विचरण करनेवाले, प्रिय, ब्रह्मचारी, दुस्तर, ब्रह्मण्य, शिष्टजनोंद्वारा पूजित तथा देवताओंकी अक्षय निधि हैं। आपने ही यज्ञोंका विधान किया है। अग्निदेव आपके ही वेदोक्त
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to one praised and sung about by the en- lightened souls. Obeisance to the highly blessed, to one who laughs boisterously, who roars like a lion and who flaps and blows.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to one praised and sung about by the en- lightened souls. Obeisance to the highly blessed, to one who laughs boisterously, who roars like a lion and who flaps and blows.

verses.sanskrit: यस्य मायाविधिज्ञस्य अगम्यगहनस्य च पुरा लिङ्गोद्भवं बीजं प्रथमं त्वादिसर्गिकम्
verses.transliteration: yasya māyāvidhijñasya agamyagahanasya ca purā liṅgodbhavaṃ bījaṃ prathamaṃ tvādisargikam
verses.translation: Obeisance to one who roars and jumps; obeisance to the joyous soul, to the benevolent, to one who breathes, runs and controls all.
verses.hindi: हव्यका वहन करते हैं। है महादेव! आपके प्रसन्न होनेपर हम देवतालोग प्रसन्न हो जाते हैं आप भवानीके ईश हैं तथा आदिसे रहित हैं। सभी लोकोंके ब्रह्मरूप कर्ता आप ही हैं। आप ही आदि सृष्टि हैं । क्षीण ध्यानवाले सांख्यशास्त्री आपको प्रकृतिसे परे जानकर अमृत्युरूप आपको ही प्राप्त होते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to one who roars and jumps; obeisance to the joyous soul, to the benevolent, to one who breathes, runs and controls all.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to one who roars and jumps; obeisance to the joyous soul, to the benevolent, to one who breathes, runs and controls all.

verses.sanskrit: मम योनौ समायुक्तं तद्बीजं कालपर्ययात् हिरण्मयमकूपारे योन्यामण्डमजायत
verses.transliteration: mama yonau samāyuktaṃ tadbījaṃ kālaparyayāt hiraṇmayamakūpāre yonyāmaṇḍamajāyata
verses.translation: Obeisance to one who meditates, yawns, cries, runs, gallops and sports about; to one who has a protruding belly.
verses.hindi: ध्यानपरायण योगी अपने योगबलसे नित्य-सिद्ध आपको जानकर पुनः उन योगोंका परित्याग कर देते हैं। और भी अन्य जो प्रसन्नचित्त तथा विशुद्ध मनवाले लोग हैं, वे अपने उत्तम कर्मोके द्वार आपको जानकर दिव्य भोगोंकी प्राप्ति करते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to one who meditates, yawns, cries, runs, gallops and sports about; to one who has a protruding belly.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to one who meditates, yawns, cries, runs, gallops and sports about; to one who has a protruding belly.

verses.sanskrit: शतानि दश वर्षाणाम् अण्डम् अप्सु प्रतिष्ठितम् अन्ते वर्षसहस्रस्य वायुना तद्द्विधा कृतम्
verses.transliteration: śatāni daśa varṣāṇām aṇḍam apsu pratiṣṭhitam ante varṣasahasrasya vāyunā taddvidhā kṛtam
verses.translation: Obeisance to one who has functions and no functions to perform, to one who has a thousand heads, to one who is poor or miserly, to one who has an impassioned body, to one who has small anklet-bells.
verses.hindi: गणनातीत तत्त्वोंवाले तथा सीमारहित आप महात्माका जैसा माहात्म्य हम जानते हैं, वैसा अपनी सामर्थ्यके कल्याणकारी हों। आप जो कुछ भी हैं, आपको नमस्कार है॥ ८७/२॥
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to one who has functions and no functions to perform, to one who has a thousand heads, to one who is poor or miserly, to one who has an impassioned body, to one who has small anklet-bells.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to one who has functions and no functions to perform, to one who has a thousand heads, to one who is poor or miserly, to one who has an impassioned body, to one who has small anklet-bells.

verses.sanskrit: कपालमेकं द्यौर्जज्ञे कपालमपरं क्षितिः उल्बं तस्य महोत्सेधो यो ऽसौ कनकपर्वतः
verses.transliteration: kapālamekaṃ dyaurjajñe kapālamaparaṃ kṣitiḥ ulbaṃ tasya mahotsedho yo 'sau kanakaparvataḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to one of deformed dress; to the ruthless and unforgiving; to one who cannot be measured; to the pro- tector; to the illuminated and devoid of attributes.
verses.hindi: सूतजी बोले-हे ऋषियो! जो प्राणी एकाग्र श्रीलिड्रमहापुराण  पूर्वभाग
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to one of deformed dress; to the ruthless and unforgiving; to one who cannot be measured; to the pro- tector; to the illuminated and devoid of attributes.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to one of deformed dress; to the ruthless and unforgiving; to one who cannot be measured; to the pro- tector; to the illuminated and devoid of attributes.

verses.sanskrit: ततश् च प्रतिसंध्यात्मा देवदेवो वरः प्रभुः हिरण्यगर्भो भगवांस् त्व् अभिजज्ञे चतुर्मुखः
verses.transliteration: tataś ca pratisaṃdhyātmā devadevo varaḥ prabhuḥ hiraṇyagarbho bhagavāṃs tv abhijajñe caturmukhaḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to one fond of the elegant, to the beautiful, to one adorned with a crest-jewel, to the minutest of the minute and to one who cannot be measured or known by qualities.
verses.hindi: अअम ककड डीडीमीऔममीमजी करीन नक फ फ़ फ़ फ फ़ फ़ फ़ क़ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ फ़ फ क़ फ़ फ फ़ फ र फ़ फ फ रजक पापाचारोऽपि यो मर्त्यः शृणुयाच्छिवसन्निधौ। जपेद्वापि विनिर्मुक्तो ब्रह्मलोकं स गच्छति
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to one fond of the elegant, to the beautiful, to one adorned with a crest-jewel, to the minutest of the minute and to one who cannot be measured or known by qualities.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to one fond of the elegant, to the beautiful, to one adorned with a crest-jewel, to the minutest of the minute and to one who cannot be measured or known by qualities.

verses.sanskrit: आ तारार्केन्दुनक्षत्रं शून्यं लोकमवेक्ष्य च को ऽहमित्यपि च ध्याते कुमारास्ते ऽभवंस्तदा
verses.transliteration: ā tārārkendunakṣatraṃ śūnyaṃ lokamavekṣya ca ko 'hamityapi ca dhyāte kumārāste 'bhavaṃstadā
verses.translation: Obeisance to one possessed of good qualities; to the secret one, to one who goes to impassable places. This earth is the mother of worlds. Your feet are resorted to by good men. Your belly, the support of all Siddhis, contains the wide firmament be- decked in clusters of stars. Just like the galaxy of stars the glori- ous necklace shines on your chest. To you, the ten quarters are the ten arms bedecked in shoulderlets and bracelets. Your neck has great girth and extent; it is comparable to the blue collyrium; it is adorned with golden threads.
verses.hindi: श्राद्धे वा हैविके कार्ये यज्ञे वावभृथान्तिके। होकर भक्तिपूर्वक ब्रह्मा तथा विष्णुके द्वारा की गयी इस शिवस्तुतिको कहता है, सुनता है अथवा ह्विजो तथा विद्वानोंको सुनाता है; वह दस हजार अश्वमेध यज्ञ करके जो फल मिलता है, उस फलको प्राप्त कर लेता
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to one possessed of good qualities; to the secret one, to one who goes to impassable places. This earth is the mother of worlds. Your feet are resorted to by good men. Your belly, the support of all Siddhis, contains the wide firmament be- decked in clusters of stars.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to one possessed of good qualities; to the secret one, to one who goes to impassable places. This earth is the mother of worlds. Your feet are resorted to by good men. Your belly, the support of all Siddhis, contains the wide firmament be- decked in clusters of stars.…

verses.sanskrit: प्रियदर्शनास्तु यतयो यतीनां पूर्वजास् तव भूयो वर्षसहस्रान्ते तत एवात्मजास्तव
verses.transliteration: priyadarśanāstu yatayo yatīnāṃ pūrvajās tava bhūyo varṣasahasrānte tata evātmajāstava
verses.translation: Your face is irrepressible; it is terrible due to the cur- ved fangs; it is incomparable. Your head which is heaven it- self shines all the more with its turban of lotus garlands.
verses.hindi: घोर पापकर्म करनेवाला जो कोई भी प्राणी शिवके समीप इस स्तुतिका पाठ करता है अथवा इसे सुनता है, वह सभी पापोंसे मुक्त होकर ब्रह्मलोकको जाता है जो सञ्जनोंके बीचमें, श्राद्धकर्ममें, देवकर्ममे, यज्ञधर्मादि अनुष्ठानोंके बाद किये जानेवाले स्नानके अनन्तर इस स्तोत्रका पाठ करता है, वह ब्रह्मलोकको
verses.wordMeaning: Your face is irrepressible; it is terrible due to the cur- ved fangs; it is incomparable. Your head which is heaven it- self shines all the more with its turban of lotus garlands.
verses.commentary: Sense: Your face is irrepressible; it is terrible due to the cur- ved fangs; it is incomparable. Your head which is heaven it- self shines all the more with its turban of lotus garlands.

verses.sanskrit: भुवनानलसंकाशाः पद्मपत्रायतेक्षणाः श्रीमान्सनत्कुमारश् च ऋभुश्चैवोर्ध्वरेतसौ
verses.transliteration: bhuvanānalasaṃkāśāḥ padmapatrāyatekṣaṇāḥ śrīmānsanatkumāraś ca ṛbhuścaivordhvaretasau
verses.translation: Refulgence in the sun, brilliance in the moon, firm- ness in the mountains, strength in the wind, heat in the fire, chilliness in the waters and sound in the firmament — the wise know these qualities to be due to the internal throbbing of the imperishable lord.
verses.hindi: कीर्तयेद्वा सतां मध्ये स याति ब्रह्मणोऽन्तिकम्॥ ९१  प्राप्त होता है महादेवजीद्वारा विष्णु और ब्रह्माको वरदान, सृष्टिके लिये ब्रह्माजीद्वारा तप करना तथा सर्पो एवं रूद्रोंकी सृष्टि सूत उवाच सूतजी बोले--हे मुनियो! उन ब्रह्मा तथा अत्यन्तावनतौ दृष्ट्या मधुपिङ्गायतेक्षणः।  विष्णुको अत्यन्त विनीत भावसे सत्य स्तुति करते
verses.wordMeaning: Refulgence in the sun, brilliance in the moon, firm- ness in the mountains, strength in the wind, heat in the fire, chilliness in the waters and sound in the firmament — the wise know these qualities to be due to the internal throbbing of the imperishable lord.
verses.commentary: Sense: Refulgence in the sun, brilliance in the moon, firm- ness in the mountains, strength in the wind, heat in the fire, chilliness in the waters and sound in the firmament — the wise know these qualities to be due to the internal throbbing of the imperishable lord.

verses.sanskrit: सनकः सनातनश्चैव तथैव च सनन्दनः उत्पन्नाः समकालं ते बुद्ध्यातीन्द्रियदर्शनाः
verses.transliteration: sanakaḥ sanātanaścaiva tathaiva ca sanandanaḥ utpannāḥ samakālaṃ te buddhyātīndriyadarśanāḥ
verses.translation: Formerly, after propitiating you ihe enemies were slain by us in the battle. You are a submarine fire. Not satiated by drinking all the waters of the ocean, you are infuriated in i'oriij, but delighted within. You are the bestower of desires; you can go as you wish; you aic fond (of u.s); you arc the celibate religious student. You are unfathomable and favourably disposed towards the Brahmins; you are adored by the society.
verses.hindi: प्रहष्टवदनोऽत्यर्थमभवत्सत्यकीर्तनात् ॥ १  देखकर सुन्दर, लालिमायुक्त तथा विशाल नेत्रोंवाले उमापतिर्विरूपाक्षो दक्षयज्ञविनाशनः । पिनाकी खण्डपरशुः सुप्रीतस्तु त्रिलोचनः
verses.wordMeaning: Formerly, after propitiating you ihe enemies were slain by us in the battle. You are a submarine fire. Not satiated by drinking all the waters of the ocean, you are infuriated in i'oriij, but delighted within. You are the bestower of desires; you can go as you wish;…
verses.commentary: Sense: Formerly, after propitiating you ihe enemies were slain by us in the battle. You are a submarine fire. Not satiated by drinking all the waters of the ocean, you are infuriated in i'oriij, but delighted within. You are the bestower of desires; you can go as you wish;…

verses.sanskrit: उत्पन्नाः प्रतिभात्मानो जगतां स्थितिहेतवः नारप्स्यन्ते च कर्माणि तापत्रयविवर्जिताः
verses.transliteration: utpannāḥ pratibhātmāno jagatāṃ sthitihetavaḥ nārapsyante ca karmāṇi tāpatrayavivarjitāḥ
verses.translation: You have made sacrifice the everlasting treasure of the Devas. The firc-god bears to you the offering, as mentioned in the Vedas O supreme lord, if you are pleased wc too become pleased.
verses.hindi: ततः स भगवान् देवः श्रुत्वा वागमृतं तयोः। जानन्नपि महादेवः क्रीडापूर्वमथाब्रवीत् विभो रुद्र महामाय इच्छया वां कृतौ त्वया। तयोस्तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा अभिनन्द्याभिमान्य च
verses.wordMeaning: You have made sacrifice the everlasting treasure of the Devas. The firc-god bears to you the offering, as mentioned in the Vedas O supreme lord, if you are pleased wc too become pleased.
verses.commentary: Sense: You have made sacrifice the everlasting treasure of the Devas. The firc-god bears to you the offering, as mentioned in the Vedas O supreme lord, if you are pleased wc too become pleased.

verses.sanskrit: अल्पसौख्यं बहुक्लेशं जराशोकसमन्वितम् जीवनं मरणं चैव संभवश् च पुनः पुनः
verses.transliteration: alpasaukhyaṃ bahukleśaṃ jarāśokasamanvitam jīvanaṃ maraṇaṃ caiva saṃbhavaś ca punaḥ punaḥ
verses.translation: You are the lord of Parvati, >t)i» arc beginningless. At the time of first creation you are Brahma, the maker of worlds. I'he followers of the Sarhkhya system realise you as one beyond prakrti and at the close of meditation they enter you, devoid of death.
verses.hindi: उमापति, विरूपाक्ष, दक्षयज्ञके विध्वंसक, पिनाकी, खण्डपरशु धारण करनेवाले, त्रिनेत्र शिवजीका मुख प्रसन्नतासे प्रफुल्लित हो उठा और उनके मनमें उन दोनोंके प्रति अत्यधिक प्रीति उत्पन्न हुई तत्पश्चात् उन दोनोंको अमृतमयी वाणी सुनकर उन्हें जानते हुए भी भगवान् महादेवने क्रीड़ाके निमित्त उनसे पूछा- है महात्माद्वय ! एक-दूसरेका हित चाहनेवाले, कमलको आभाके तुल्य नेत्रोंवाले आप दोनों लोग कौन
verses.wordMeaning: You are the lord of Parvati, >t)i» arc beginningless. At the time of first creation you are Brahma, the maker of worlds. I'he followers of the Sarhkhya system realise you as one beyond prakrti and at the close of meditation they enter you, devoid of death.
verses.commentary: Sense: You are the lord of Parvati, >t)i» arc beginningless. At the time of first creation you are Brahma, the maker of worlds. I'he followers of the Sarhkhya system realise you as one beyond prakrti and at the close of meditation they enter you, devoid of death.

verses.sanskrit: अल्पभूतं सुखं स्वर्गे दुःखानि नरके तथा विदित्वा चागमं सर्वम् अवश्यं भवितव्यताम्
verses.transliteration: alpabhūtaṃ sukhaṃ svarge duḥkhāni narake tathā viditvā cāgamaṃ sarvam avaśyaṃ bhavitavyatām
verses.translation: Those who meditate on you, understand you as perpetual siddha through yoga and then eschew those yogas. Those rnlighlcned persons who resort to you through their actions enjoy divine bliss.
verses.hindi: हैं तथा इस घोर महासागरमें क्यों स्थित हैं ? महादेवके ऐसा पूछनेपर एक-दूसरेकी ओर देखकर महात्मा ब्रह्मा तथा विष्णु बोले-हे भगवन्! है विभो! है रुद्र! हे महामाय! क्या आज आपको विदित नहीं है कि आपने ही अपनी इच्छासे हम दोनोंको उत्पन्न किया है ?॥ ५/२ ॥
verses.wordMeaning: Those who meditate on you, understand you as perpetual siddha through yoga and then eschew those yogas. Those rnlighlcned persons who resort to you through their actions enjoy divine bliss.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who meditate on you, understand you as perpetual siddha through yoga and then eschew those yogas. Those rnlighlcned persons who resort to you through their actions enjoy divine bliss.

verses.sanskrit: ऋभुं सनत्कुमारं च दृष्ट्वा तव वशे स्थितौ त्रयस्तु त्रीन् गुणान् हित्वा चात्मजाः सनकादयः
verses.transliteration: ṛbhuṃ sanatkumāraṃ ca dṛṣṭvā tava vaśe sthitau trayastu trīn guṇān hitvā cātmajāḥ sanakādayaḥ
verses.translation: The greatncjss of yours has been glorified in accor- dance with what we know according to our capacity. Your reality and principles cannot be enumerated; you are the supreme soul who cannot be easily crossed.
verses.hindi: फ़फफपापापाफाफफापाफफाफमफफफपफफफपफफफ महादेवजीद्वारा विष्णु और ब्रह्माको वरदान रुद्रोंकी सृष्टि
verses.wordMeaning: The greatncjss of yours has been glorified in accor- dance with what we know according to our capacity. Your reality and principles cannot be enumerated; you are the supreme soul who cannot be easily crossed.
verses.commentary: Sense: The greatncjss of yours has been glorified in accor- dance with what we know according to our capacity. Your reality and principles cannot be enumerated; you are the supreme soul who cannot be easily crossed.

verses.sanskrit: ववर्तेन तु ज्ञानेन प्रवृत्तास्ते महौजसः ततस्तेषु प्रवृत्तेषु सनकादिषु वै त्रिषु
verses.transliteration: vavartena tu jñānena pravṛttāste mahaujasaḥ tatasteṣu pravṛtteṣu sanakādiṣu vai triṣu
verses.translation: Be auspicious towards u.s everywhere. As you arc so you arc; obeisance be to you.
verses.hindi: फ फ पा फ फ फ फा फ फ फ फ फ फ फा क फ फा फ फ फा फ फ़ फ फक फ फ फफ क फा फ फा फक ममा फ फी फीकी की मी उवाच भगवान् देवो मधुरं श्लक्ष्णया गिरा। भो भो हिरण्यगर्भ त्वां त्वां च कृष्ण ब्रवीम्यहम्॥
verses.wordMeaning: Be auspicious towards u.s everywhere. As you arc so you arc; obeisance be to you.
verses.commentary: Sense: Be auspicious towards u.s everywhere. As you arc so you arc; obeisance be to you.

verses.sanskrit: भविष्यसि विमूढस्त्वं मायया शङ्करस्य तु एवं कल्पे तु वैवृत्ते संज्ञा नश्यति ते ऽनघ
verses.transliteration: bhaviṣyasi vimūḍhastvaṃ māyayā śaṅkarasya tu evaṃ kalpe tu vaivṛtte saṃjñā naśyati te 'nagha
verses.translation: Be auspicious towards u.s everywhere. As you arc so you arc; obeisance be to you.
verses.hindi: अथोवाच महाभागो विष्णुर्भवमिदं वचः सर्व मम कृतं देव परितुष्टोऽसि मे यदि।
verses.wordMeaning: Be auspicious towards u.s everywhere. As you arc so you arc; obeisance be to you.
verses.commentary: Sense: Be auspicious towards u.s everywhere. As you arc so you arc; obeisance be to you.

verses.sanskrit: कल्पे शेषाणि भूतानि सूक्ष्माणि पार्थिवानि च सर्वेषां ह्यैश्वरी माया जागृतिः समुदाहृता
verses.transliteration: kalpe śeṣāṇi bhūtāni sūkṣmāṇi pārthivāni ca sarveṣāṃ hyaiśvarī māyā jāgṛtiḥ samudāhṛtā
verses.translation: Be auspicious towards u.s everywhere. As you arc so you arc; obeisance be to you.
verses.hindi: त्वयि मे सुप्रतिष्ठा तु भक्तिर्भवतु शङ्कर १० एवमुक्तस्तु विज्ञाय सम्भावयत केशवम्। प्रददौ च महादेवो भक्तिं निजपदाम्बुजे
verses.wordMeaning: Be auspicious towards u.s everywhere. As you arc so you arc; obeisance be to you.
verses.commentary: Sense: Be auspicious towards u.s everywhere. As you arc so you arc; obeisance be to you.

verses.sanskrit: यथैष पर्वतो मेरुर् देवलोको ह्युदाहृतः तस्य चेदं हि माहात्म्यं विद्धि देववरस्य ह
verses.transliteration: yathaiṣa parvato merur devaloko hyudāhṛtaḥ tasya cedaṃ hi māhātmyaṃ viddhi devavarasya ha
verses.translation: Be auspicious towards u.s everywhere. As you arc so you arc; obeisance be to you.
verses.hindi: भवान् सर्वस्य लोकस्य कर्ता त्वमधिहैवतम्। तदेवं स्वस्ति ते वत्स गमिष्याम्यम्बुजेक्षण एवमुक्त्वा तु भगवान् ब्रह्माणं चापि शङ्करः । अनुगृह्यास्पृशद्देवो ब्रह्माणं परमेश्वरः
verses.wordMeaning: Be auspicious towards u.s everywhere. As you arc so you arc; obeisance be to you.
verses.commentary: Sense: Be auspicious towards u.s everywhere. As you arc so you arc; obeisance be to you.

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञात्वा चेश्वरसद्भावं ज्ञात्वा मामंबुजेक्षणम् महादेवं महाभूतं भूतानां वरदं प्रभुम्
verses.transliteration: jñātvā ceśvarasadbhāvaṃ jñātvā māmaṃbujekṣaṇam mahādevaṃ mahābhūtaṃ bhūtānāṃ varadaṃ prabhum
verses.translation: Be auspicious towards u.s everywhere. As you arc so you arc; obeisance be to you.
verses.hindi: कराभ्यां सुशुभाभ्यां च प्राह हृष्टतरः स्वयम्। मत्समस्त्वं न सन्देहो वत्स भक्तश्च मे भवान् गतवान् गणपो देवः सर्वदेवनमस्कृतः ।
verses.wordMeaning: Be auspicious towards u.s everywhere. As you arc so you arc; obeisance be to you.
verses.commentary: Sense: Be auspicious towards u.s everywhere. As you arc so you arc; obeisance be to you.

verses.sanskrit: प्रणवेनाथ साम्ना तु नमस्कृत्य जगद्गुरुम् त्वां च मां चैव संक्रुद्धो निःश्वासान्निर्दहेदयम्
verses.transliteration: praṇavenātha sāmnā tu namaskṛtya jagadgurum tvāṃ ca māṃ caiva saṃkruddho niḥśvāsānnirdahedayam
verses.translation: Be auspicious towards u.s everywhere. As you arc so you arc; obeisance be to you.
verses.hindi: ततो दीर्घेण कालेन दुःखात्क्रोधो ह्यजायत। क्रोधाविष्टस्य नेत्राभ्यां प्रापतन्नश्रुबिन्दवः उन दोनोंकी वह बात सुनकर भगवान् शंकर प्रसन्न होकर सम्मानपूर्वक कोमल वाणीमें धीरेसे बोले-हे हिरण्यगर्भ! है कृष्ण! मैं आप दोनोंको बता रहा हूँ कि मैं आपकी इस शाश्वत तथा दृढ भक्तिसे
verses.wordMeaning: Be auspicious towards u.s everywhere. As you arc so you arc; obeisance be to you.
verses.commentary: Sense: Be auspicious towards u.s everywhere. As you arc so you arc; obeisance be to you.

verses.sanskrit: एवं ज्ञात्वा महायोगम् अभ्युत्तिष्ठन्महाबलम् अहं त्वामग्रतः कृत्वा स्तोष्याम्यनलसप्रभम्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ jñātvā mahāyogam abhyuttiṣṭhanmahābalam ahaṃ tvāmagrataḥ kṛtvā stoṣyāmyanalasaprabham
verses.translation: Be auspicious towards u.s everywhere. As you arc so you arc; obeisance be to you.
verses.hindi: आप दोनों लोगोंके प्रति मेरे हृदयमें अपार प्रेम है। मैं आज आपलोगोंको श्रेष्ठ तथा मनोवांछित कौन-सा वर प्रदान करूँ ?॥ ८ /२॥ तदनन्तर महाभाग विष्णुने रुद्रसे यह वचन कहा-हे देव! मेरा यही सर्व अभीष्ट है कि यदि आप मुझपर प्रसन्न हैं, तो है शंकर! मुझे अपने प्रति अचल भक्ति प्रदान कीजिये
verses.wordMeaning: Be auspicious towards u.s everywhere. As you arc so you arc; obeisance be to you.
verses.commentary: Sense: Be auspicious towards u.s everywhere. As you arc so you arc; obeisance be to you.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्माणमग्रतः कृत्वा ततः स गरुडध्वजः अतीतैश् च भविष्यैश् च वर्तमानैस्तथैव च
verses.transliteration: brahmāṇamagrataḥ kṛtvā tataḥ sa garuḍadhvajaḥ atītaiś ca bhaviṣyaiś ca vartamānaistathaiva ca
verses.translation: Obeisance tg the eldest, the excellent the foremost and the first; Obeisance to one who is worthy of honour and worship. Obeisance to Sadyojata.
verses.hindi: विष्णुके ऐसा कहनेपर महादेवने विष्णुभगवान्को स्नेहपूर्वक अपने चरणकमलोंमें स्थिर भक्ति प्रदान को तत्पश्चात् भगवान् शंकरने ब्रह्माजीसे कहा- हे कमलनयन! आप समस्त लोकके कर्ता हैं तथा आप ही अधिष्ठातृ देवता हैं। अतः है वत्स! आपका कल्याण हो। मैं तो अब प्रस्थान करूँगा। ब्रह्माजीसे इस
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance tg the eldest, the excellent the foremost and the first; Obeisance to one who is worthy of honour and worship. Obeisance to Sadyojata.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance tg the eldest, the excellent the foremost and the first; Obeisance to one who is worthy of honour and worship. Obeisance to Sadyojata.

verses.sanskrit: नामभिश्छान्दसैश्चैव इदं स्तोत्रमुदीरयत् नमस्तुभ्यं भगवते सुव्रतानन्ततेजसे
verses.transliteration: nāmabhiśchāndasaiścaiva idaṃ stotramudīrayat namastubhyaṃ bhagavate suvratānantatejase
verses.translation: Obeisance to the unfathomable and the lord of jlvas (personal souls). Obeisance to the naked and the lord of all created beings.
verses.hindi: प्रकार कहकर भगवान् शंकरने अपने दोनों पवित्र हाथोंसे अनुग्रहपूर्वक ब्रह्माजीका स्पर्श किया। पुनः उन परमेश्वर शंकरने प्रसन्न मनसे ब्रह्मासे स्वयं कहा-- आप भी मेरे ही तुल्य हैं; इसमें सन्देह नहीं है। है वत्स! आप मेरे भक्त हैं। आपका कल्याण हो और आपको यथार्थ ज्ञानकी प्राप्ति हो। है सुव्रत! अब मैं प्रस्थान कर
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to the unfathomable and the lord of jlvas (personal souls). Obeisance to the naked and the lord of all created beings.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to the unfathomable and the lord of jlvas (personal souls). Obeisance to the naked and the lord of all created beings.

verses.sanskrit: नमः क्षेत्राधिपतये बीजिने शूलिने नमः सुमेढ्रायार्च्यमेढ्राय दण्डिने रूक्षरेतसे
verses.transliteration: namaḥ kṣetrādhipataye bījine śūline namaḥ sumeḍhrāyārcyameḍhrāya daṇḍine rūkṣaretase
verses.translation: Obeisance to the lord of the Vedas, the Smrtis and the lord of activities, charities and substances.
verses.hindi: इस प्रकार कहकर समस्त देवताओंके वन्दनीय, गणोंके रक्षक, परमेश्वर भगवान् महादेव अन्तर्धान हो भगवान् गोविन्दसे ज्ञान प्राप्त करके पितामह ब्रह्माने प्रजाओंकी सृष्टिको कामनासे भीषण तप करना आरम्भ कर दिया॥ १६/२॥ इस प्रकार दीर्घ कालतक तपस्या करते हुए उनका
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to the lord of the Vedas, the Smrtis and the lord of activities, charities and substances.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to the lord of the Vedas, the Smrtis and the lord of activities, charities and substances.

verses.sanskrit: नमो ज्येष्ठाय श्रेष्ठाय पूर्वाय प्रथमाय च नमो मान्याय पूज्याय सद्योजाताय वै नमः
verses.transliteration: namo jyeṣṭhāya śreṣṭhāya pūrvāya prathamāya ca namo mānyāya pūjyāya sadyojātāya vai namaḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to the lord of Yoga and Saiikhya. Obeisance to the lord of the sages who are bound together by the Polar Star.
verses.hindi: जब कुछ भी सिद्ध नहीं हुआ, तब उन्हें बहुत दुःख हुआ और उस दु:खसे वे बहुत क्रोधित हो उठे। कोपसे 11311 11111 11 ,// 7 ss फफफफफाफफाफफाफफफफफ फी फाफफाफाफीफफी फक फफफफफफफफफफफ कफ फा फफा फा पी पापी पीसमी फफफफफफाफफफाफ पीप पीपापीपीपाफीपाीपफापफाफपफाफफफाफफ फफफ फफ फ
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to the lord of Yoga and Saiikhya. Obeisance to the lord of the sages who are bound together by the Polar Star.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to the lord of Yoga and Saiikhya. Obeisance to the lord of the sages who are bound together by the Polar Star.

verses.sanskrit: गह्वराय घटेशाय व्योमचीरांबराय च नमस्ते ह्यस्मदादीनां भूतानां प्रभवे नमः
verses.transliteration: gahvarāya ghaṭeśāya vyomacīrāṃbarāya ca namaste hyasmadādīnāṃ bhūtānāṃ prabhave namaḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to you, the lord of stars and planets; obeisance to the lord of thundering sound of lightning, thun- derbolt and clouds.
verses.hindi: ततस्तेभ्योऽश्रुबिन्दुभ्यो वातपित्तकफात्मकाः। युक्त उन ब्रह्माके दोनों नेत्रोंसे आँसुओंकी बूँदें गिरने तत्पश्चात् उन अश्रुबिन्दुओंसे वात-पित्त-कफयुक्त
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to you, the lord of stars and planets; obeisance to the lord of thundering sound of lightning, thun- derbolt and clouds.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to you, the lord of stars and planets; obeisance to the lord of thundering sound of lightning, thun- derbolt and clouds.

verses.sanskrit: वेदानां प्रभवे चैव स्मृतीनां प्रभवे नमः प्रभवे कर्मदानानां द्रव्याणां प्रभवे नमः
verses.transliteration: vedānāṃ prabhave caiva smṛtīnāṃ prabhave namaḥ prabhave karmadānānāṃ dravyāṇāṃ prabhave namaḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to the lord of great oceans and their islands. Obeisance to the lord of mountains and continents.
verses.hindi: महान् सत्त्वसे सम्पन्न, महाभाग्यशाली तथा महाविषधर सर्प उत्पन्न हुए। वे स्वस्तिक चिहसे विभूषित थे तथा उनके केश फैले हुए थे॥ १९/२॥ उन सर्पोको पहले उत्पन्न हुआ देखकर ब्रह्माजीको बड़ी आत्मग्लानि हुई। वे अपनी भर्त्सना करते हुए कहने लगे-- अहो, मुझे धिक्कार है। मेरी तपस्याका मुझे यही फल प्राप्त .हुआ कि आरम्भमें हो मेरी
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to the lord of great oceans and their islands. Obeisance to the lord of mountains and continents.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to the lord of great oceans and their islands. Obeisance to the lord of mountains and continents.

verses.sanskrit: नमो योगस्य प्रभवे सांख्यस्य प्रभवे नमः नमो ध्रुवनिबद्धानाम् ऋषीणां प्रभवे नमः
verses.transliteration: namo yogasya prabhave sāṃkhyasya prabhave namaḥ namo dhruvanibaddhānām ṛṣīṇāṃ prabhave namaḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to the lord of the rivers and rivulfcts, to the lord of medicinal herbs and plantations.
verses.hindi: लोकविनाशक सर्परूप प्रजा उत्पन्न हुई' अत्यधिक क्रोध तथा अधीरतासे युक्त होनेके कारण ब्रह्माजीको तीव्र मूर्च्छा उत्पन्न हुई और उस मूर्च्छासे आक्रान्त पितामहने अपने प्राण त्याग दिये
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to the lord of the rivers and rivulfcts, to the lord of medicinal herbs and plantations.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to the lord of the rivers and rivulfcts, to the lord of medicinal herbs and plantations.

verses.sanskrit: ऋक्षाणां प्रभवे तुभ्यं ग्रहाणां प्रभवे नमः वैद्युताशनिमेघानां गर्जितप्रभवे नमः
verses.transliteration: ṛkṣāṇāṃ prabhave tubhyaṃ grahāṇāṃ prabhave namaḥ vaidyutāśanimeghānāṃ garjitaprabhave namaḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to the lord of 'rasas', jewels, and the units of time.
verses.hindi: इसके पश्चात् अप्रतिम वीर्यवाले उन ब्रह्माके देहसे दीनभावसे कारुण्यपूर्वक ग्यारह रुद्र रोते हुए निकले। रुदन करनेके कारण ही उनका नाम रुद्र जो रुद्र हैं, वे ही प्राणरूप हैं तथा जो प्राण हैं, वे उन्हीं रुद्रके आत्मारूप हैं। सभी प्राणियोंमें स्थित उन रुद्रोंकी ही जीवोंके प्राणरूपमें जानना चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to the lord of 'rasas', jewels, and the units of time.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to the lord of 'rasas', jewels, and the units of time.

verses.sanskrit: महोदधीनां प्रभवे द्वीपानां प्रभवे नमः अद्रीणां प्रभवे चैव वर्षाणां प्रभवे नमः
verses.transliteration: mahodadhīnāṃ prabhave dvīpānāṃ prabhave namaḥ adrīṇāṃ prabhave caiva varṣāṇāṃ prabhave namaḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to the lord of day, night, fortnights and months; Obeisance to you, the lord of seasons and the lord of number.
verses.hindi: नीललोहित त्रिशूलधारी शिवजीने अत्यन्त उग्र ब्रह्माको पुनः उनके प्राण प्रदान कर दिये ॥ २५१/२॥
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to the lord of day, night, fortnights and months; Obeisance to you, the lord of seasons and the lord of number.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to the lord of day, night, fortnights and months; Obeisance to you, the lord of seasons and the lord of number.

verses.sanskrit: नमो नदीनां प्रभवे नदानां प्रभवे नमः महौषधीनां प्रभवे वृक्षाणां प्रभवे नमः
verses.transliteration: namo nadīnāṃ prabhave nadānāṃ prabhave namaḥ mahauṣadhīnāṃ prabhave vṛkṣāṇāṃ prabhave namaḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to the lord of the Vyantaras, of yoga, and of fourfold creation. Obeisance to one of infinite vision; to the lord of all occupations that have sprung up from the beginning of kalpa (that is creation itself). Obeisance to the lord of the universe and to the overlord of Brahma. Obeisance to the source of origin of sacred lores and to the overlord of holy rites.
verses.hindi: तत्पश्चात् प्राण प्राप्तकर भगवान् ब्रह्माने खडे होकर देवाधिदेव उमापतिको प्रणामकर गायत्रीके ध्यानसे विश्वरूप परमात्मा शिवको वहाँ देखा समस्त लोकोंमें व्याप्त रहनेवाले महादेवको देखकर त्रह्ाजीने उनकी स्तुति की । तत्पश्चात् उन्होंने आश्चर्यचकित होकर शिवजीको बार-बार प्रणामकर उनसे पूछा- हे ततो विस्मयमापन्नः प्रणिपत्य मुहुर्मुहु।  विभो! 'सद्योजात' आदि रूपमे आपका प्रादुर्भाव क्यों
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to the lord of the Vyantaras, of yoga, and of fourfold creation. Obeisance to one of infinite vision; to the lord of all occupations that have sprung up from the beginning of kalpa (that is creation itself).…
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to the lord of the Vyantaras, of yoga, and of fourfold creation. Obeisance to one of infinite vision; to the lord of all occupations that have sprung up from the beginning of kalpa (that is creation itself).…

verses.sanskrit: धर्मवृक्षाय धर्माय स्थितीनां प्रभवे नमः प्रभवे च परार्धस्य परस्य प्रभवे नमः
verses.transliteration: dharmavṛkṣāya dharmāya sthitīnāṃ prabhave namaḥ prabhave ca parārdhasya parasya prabhave namaḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to the lord of Prajapatis, to the lord of the Siddhas, to the lord of daityas, danavas and rak$asas.
verses.hindi: उवाच वचनं शर्व सद्यादित्वं कथं विभो॥ २८ हुआ ? प्रकीर्णकेशाः सर्पास्ते प्रादुर्भूता महाविषाः। सर्पांस्तानग्रजान् दृष्ट्वा ब्रह्मात्मानमनिन्दयत्
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to the lord of Prajapatis, to the lord of the Siddhas, to the lord of daityas, danavas and rak$asas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to the lord of Prajapatis, to the lord of the Siddhas, to the lord of daityas, danavas and rak$asas.

verses.sanskrit: नमो रसानां प्रभवे रत्नानां प्रभवे नमः क्षणानां प्रभवे चैव लवानां प्रभवे नमः
verses.transliteration: namo rasānāṃ prabhave ratnānāṃ prabhave namaḥ kṣaṇānāṃ prabhave caiva lavānāṃ prabhave namaḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to the lord of gandharvas, yak, garua, snakes, serpents and birds.
verses.hindi: लोकवैनाशिकी जज्ञे आदावेव प्रजा मम तस्याप्रतिमवीर्यस्य देहात्कारुण्यपूर्वकम्। अथैकादश ते रुद्रा रुदन्तोऽभ्यक्रमंस्तथा
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to the lord of gandharvas, yak, garua, snakes, serpents and birds.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to the lord of gandharvas, yak, garua, snakes, serpents and birds.

verses.sanskrit: अहोरात्रार्धमासानां मासानां प्रभवे नमः ऋतूनां प्रभवे तुभ्यं संख्यायाः प्रभवे नमः
verses.transliteration: ahorātrārdhamāsānāṃ māsānāṃ prabhave namaḥ ṛtūnāṃ prabhave tubhyaṃ saṃkhyāyāḥ prabhave namaḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to the overlord of the guhyas and piacas, to Gokar, to the protector, to Sahkukarna (one whose ears resemble the pike).
verses.hindi: रोदनात्खलु रुद्रत्वं तेषु वै समजायत। ये रुद्रास्ते खलु प्राणा: ये प्राणास्ते तदात्मकाः लब्ध्वासून् भगवान् ब्रह्मा देवदेवमुमापतिम्
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to the overlord of the guhyas and piacas, to Gokar, to the protector, to Sahkukarna (one whose ears resemble the pike).
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to the overlord of the guhyas and piacas, to Gokar, to the protector, to Sahkukarna (one whose ears resemble the pike).

verses.sanskrit: प्रभवे चापरार्धस्य परार्धप्रभवे नमः नमः पुराणप्रभवे सर्गाणां प्रभवे नमः
verses.transliteration: prabhave cāparārdhasya parārdhaprabhave namaḥ namaḥ purāṇaprabhave sargāṇāṃ prabhave namaḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to the incomprehensible varaha(boar); to the star bear, devoid of rajas, the lord of Devas and asuras and gai.
verses.hindi: सर्वलोकमयं देवं दृष्ट्वा स्तुत्वा पितामहः विभिन्न कल्पोमें होनेवाले सद्योजातादि शिवावतारोंका वर्णन
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to the incomprehensible varaha(boar); to the star bear, devoid of rajas, the lord of Devas and asuras and gai.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to the incomprehensible varaha(boar); to the star bear, devoid of rajas, the lord of Devas and asuras and gai.

verses.sanskrit: मन्वन्तराणां प्रभवे योगस्य प्रभवे नमः चतुर्विधस्य सर्गस्य प्रभवे ऽनन्तचक्षुषे
verses.transliteration: manvantarāṇāṃ prabhave yogasya prabhave namaḥ caturvidhasya sargasya prabhave 'nantacakṣuṣe
verses.translation: Obeisance to the lord of the waters; the lord of reful- gence; the lord of LaksmI (glory and splendour) and the lord of the earth.
verses.hindi: फपफाफफफफफफफफफफफफफफ रप ह टी ली ाचापाफाफपाधापापाफफफपाफफपाफाफफाफफफापाफापायाफाफाफपाचापायापाकालपीलीलील णा फ फ फ़ फ फ़ फ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ फ फ़ फ़ फ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ फ फ फ क की फ्रम विभिन्न कल्पोंमें होनेवाले सद्योजातादि शिवावतारोंका वर्णन, विभिन्न लोकोंकी स्थिति तथा महारुद्रका विश्वरूपत्व
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to the lord of the waters; the lord of reful- gence; the lord of LaksmI (glory and splendour) and the lord of the earth.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to the lord of the waters; the lord of reful- gence; the lord of LaksmI (glory and splendour) and the lord of the earth.

verses.sanskrit: कल्पोदयनिबन्धानां वातानां प्रभवे नमः नमो विश्वस्य प्रभवे ब्रह्माधिपतये नमः
verses.transliteration: kalpodayanibandhānāṃ vātānāṃ prabhave namaḥ namo viśvasya prabhave brahmādhipataye namaḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to one who unifies the strong and the weak; to the agitator who cannot be cited; to the bull (Nandi) who has a single illuminated horn; and a huge hump.
verses.hindi: तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा ब्रह्मणो भगवान् भवः। ब्रह्मरूपी प्रबोधार्थं ब्रह्माणं प्राह सस्मितम् मत्प्रसूता च देवेशी श्वेताङ्गा शवेतलोहिता। श्वेतवर्णा तदा ह्यासीद् गायत्री ब्रह्मसंज्ञिता
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to one who unifies the strong and the weak; to the agitator who cannot be cited; to the bull (Nandi) who has a single illuminated horn; and a huge hump.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to one who unifies the strong and the weak; to the agitator who cannot be cited; to the bull (Nandi) who has a single illuminated horn; and a huge hump.

verses.sanskrit: विद्यानां प्रभवे चैव विद्याधिपतये नमः नमो व्रताधिपतये व्रतानां प्रभवे नमः
verses.transliteration: vidyānāṃ prabhave caiva vidyādhipataye namaḥ namo vratādhipataye vratānāṃ prabhave namaḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to one who is stable in the body; to one enveloped in halo; to one who represents the past, future and present.
verses.hindi: तस्मादहं च देवेश त्वया गुह्येन वै पुनः। विज्ञातः स्वेन तपसा सद्योजातत्वमागतः सद्योजातेति ब्रह्मैतद् गुह्यं चैतत्प्रकीर्तितम्। तस्माद् गुह्यत्वमापन्नं ये वेत्स्यन्ति द्विजातयः
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to one who is stable in the body; to one enveloped in halo; to one who represents the past, future and present.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to one who is stable in the body; to one enveloped in halo; to one who represents the past, future and present.

verses.sanskrit: मन्त्राणां प्रभवे तुभ्यं मन्त्राधिपतये नमः पितॄणां पतये चैव पशूनां पतये नमः
verses.transliteration: mantrāṇāṃ prabhave tubhyaṃ mantrādhipataye namaḥ pitṝṇāṃ pataye caiva paśūnāṃ pataye namaḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to the brilliant and virile to the heroic and the unconquered, to the bestower of boons, to the best of persons of great soul.
verses.hindi: लोहिताक्षी स्तनवती गायत्री गौः प्रकीर्तिता। वामत्वाच्चैव देवस्य वामदेवत्वमागतः। तत्रापि च महासत्त्व त्वयाहं नियतात्मना
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to the brilliant and virile to the heroic and the unconquered, to the bestower of boons, to the best of persons of great soul.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to the brilliant and virile to the heroic and the unconquered, to the bestower of boons, to the best of persons of great soul.

verses.sanskrit: वाग्वृषाय नमस्तुभ्यं पुराणवृषभाय च नमः पशूनां पतये गोवृषेन्द्रध्वजाय च
verses.transliteration: vāgvṛṣāya namastubhyaṃ purāṇavṛṣabhāya ca namaḥ paśūnāṃ pataye govṛṣendradhvajāya ca
verses.translation: Obeisance to mahat ( the first evolute of Prakrfi) in all its 3 stages, past, present and future;** obeisance to you repre- senting the people; to penance, to the bestower of boons.
verses.hindi: ततश्च वामदेवेति ख्यातिं यातोऽस्मि भूतले सूतजी बोले--ब्रह्माजीका वह वचन सुनकर उनके प्रबोधनके लिये ब्रह्मरूप भगवान् शिवने मुसकराकर उनसे कहा-
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to mahat ( the first evolute of Prakrfi) in all its 3 stages, past, present and future;** obeisance to you repre- senting the people; to penance, to the bestower of boons.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to mahat ( the first evolute of Prakrfi) in all its 3 stages, past, present and future;** obeisance to you repre- senting the people; to penance, to the bestower of boons.

verses.sanskrit: प्रजापतीनां पतये सिद्धीनां पतये नमः दैत्यदानवसंघानां रक्षसां पतये नमः
verses.transliteration: prajāpatīnāṃ pataye siddhīnāṃ pataye namaḥ daityadānavasaṃghānāṃ rakṣasāṃ pataye namaḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to the minute as well as the great; to the all-pervading lord. Obeisance to bondage and liberation; to heaven and hell.
verses.hindi: जब श्वेतकल्प था, उस समय मैं श्वेत वर्णका था। इसी कारणसे वह कल्प 'श्वेतकल्प' नाम से विख्यात हुआ
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to the minute as well as the great; to the all-pervading lord. Obeisance to bondage and liberation; to heaven and hell.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to the minute as well as the great; to the all-pervading lord. Obeisance to bondage and liberation; to heaven and hell.

verses.sanskrit: गन्धर्वाणां च पतये यक्षाणां पतये नमः गरुडोरगसर्पाणां पक्षिणां पतये नमः
verses.transliteration: gandharvāṇāṃ ca pataye yakṣāṇāṃ pataye namaḥ garuḍoragasarpāṇāṃ pakṣiṇāṃ pataye namaḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to lord 8iva, who is worthy of worship. Obeisance to the sacrifice, and to the deity of effulgent brilliance. Obeisance to the principle beyond all attributes.
verses.hindi: उस कल्पमें मुझसे उत्पन्न ब्रह्म नामसे जानी जानेवाली देवेश्वरी गायत्री भी श्वेत अंगोंवाली, श्वेत रक्तवाली तथा श्वेत वर्णवाली थीं तदनन्तर है देवेश! आपने अपने उग्र तपसे सद्योजातत्वको प्राप्त मुझ शिवको जाना
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to lord 8iva, who is worthy of worship. Obeisance to the sacrifice, and to the deity of effulgent brilliance. Obeisance to the principle beyond all attributes.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to lord 8iva, who is worthy of worship. Obeisance to the sacrifice, and to the deity of effulgent brilliance. Obeisance to the principle beyond all attributes.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वगुह्यपिशाचानां गुह्याधिपतये नमः गोकर्णाय च गोप्त्रे च शङ्कुकर्णाय वै नमः
verses.transliteration: sarvaguhyapiśācānāṃ guhyādhipataye namaḥ gokarṇāya ca goptre ca śaṅkukarṇāya vai namaḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to the noose, to the weapon, to one equipped with missiles as ornaments; to one who is the material for sacrifice; to one invoke; to one who partakes of what is offered in the sacrifice; to one who docs desiiable acts; to one ¥fbo docs acts of charity, such as digging wells; to the
verses.hindi: मेरा यह सद्योजातरूप गुह्य ब्रह्मके रूपमें जाना जाता है । अतएव गुह्यत्वको प्राप्त मुझ सद्योजात शिवको जो द्विजातिगण जानेंगे, वे मेरे सान्निध्यको प्राप्त होंगे, जहाँसे उनका पुनरागमन नहीं होता अर्थात् वे जन्म- मरणके बन्धनसे मुक्त हो जाते हैं ॥ ६ /२॥
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to the noose, to the weapon, to one equipped with missiles as ornaments; to one who is the material for sacrifice; to one invoke; to one who partakes of what is offered in the sacrifice; to one who docs desiiable acts; to one ¥fbo docs acts of charity,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to the noose, to the weapon, to one equipped with missiles as ornaments; to one who is the material for sacrifice; to one invoke; to one who partakes of what is offered in the sacrifice; to one who docs desiiable acts; to one ¥fbo docs acts of charity,…

verses.sanskrit: वराहायाप्रमेयाय ऋक्षाय विरजाय च नमः सुराणां पतये गणानां पतये नमः
verses.transliteration: varāhāyāprameyāya ṛkṣāya virajāya ca namaḥ surāṇāṃ pataye gaṇānāṃ pataye namaḥ
verses.translation: The 96b, 97 and 28a aie repeated in 34 and 35 of this Gh.
verses.hindi: धारित लोहित वर्णके कारण वह कल्प लोहितकल्प नामसे कहा गया॥ ७/२॥ उस कल्पमें रक्तवर्णके मांस तथा हडियोंवाली, रक्त- वर्णका दूध प्रदान करनेवाली, लाल आँखोंवाली तथा लाल स्तनवाली धेनुरूपमें गायत्री अधिष्ठित हुई ॥ ८ /२॥
verses.wordMeaning: The 96b, 97 and 28a aie repeated in 34 and 35 of this Gh.
verses.commentary: Sense: The 96b, 97 and 28a aie repeated in 34 and 35 of this Gh.

verses.sanskrit: अंभसां पतये चैव ओजसां पतये नमः नमो ऽस्तु लक्ष्मीपतये श्रीपाय क्षितिपाय च
verses.transliteration: aṃbhasāṃ pataye caiva ojasāṃ pataye namaḥ namo 'stu lakṣmīpataye śrīpāya kṣitipāya ca
verses.translation: Obeisance to one refraining from violence, to one devoid of temptations, to one who is a redeemer of soiils (Jivas), to one who bestows nourishment, to one who habitually re- presents and practises good conduct.
verses.hindi: तदनन्तर उस धेनुके लोहितत्व, उस कल्पमें वर्णके बदल जाने तथा योगकी वामताके कारण मैं वामदेवत्वको प्राप्त हुआ अर्थात् मेरा नाम वामदेव पड़ हे महासत्त्व! उस कल्पमें भी नियत आत्मावाले आपने अपने योगबलसे लोहितवर्ण-स्थित मुझ परमेश्वरको जाना और तभीसे में पृथ्वीलोकमें वामदेव नामसे प्रसिद्धिको प्राप्त हो गया
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to one refraining from violence, to one devoid of temptations, to one who is a redeemer of soiils (Jivas), to one who bestows nourishment, to one who habitually re- presents and practises good conduct.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to one refraining from violence, to one devoid of temptations, to one who is a redeemer of soiils (Jivas), to one who bestows nourishment, to one who habitually re- presents and practises good conduct.

verses.sanskrit: बलाबलसमूहाय अक्षोभ्यक्षोभणाय च दीप्तशृङ्गैकशृङ्गाय वृषभाय ककुद्मिने
verses.transliteration: balābalasamūhāya akṣobhyakṣobhaṇāya ca dīptaśṛṅgaikaśṛṅgāya vṛṣabhāya kakudmine
verses.translation: Obeisance to one who represents the past, future and present. Obeisance to the brilliant and virile, to the heroic and the unconquered, to the bestower of boons and to the best of persons of great soul. Obeisance to *mahat* the first evolute ofPrakrti in all its three stages: past, present and future. Obeisance to one without a fear.
verses.hindi: पक्क क र काका भाका फ फ फ फ़ क काका माका फफ फफक कक कक क कक फक्क फ फफफ फफफ फफ फफफ ७ फ फफ यी त मम सप 0 ाकामाकमाण जाई वे जन्म-मरणके बन्धनसे मुक्ति प्राप्त करानेवाले मेरै रुद्रलोकमें निवास करेंगे जब मैं युगक्रमसे पीतवर्णवाला हुआ, तब मेरे वर्णनामपर उस कल्पका नाम पीतकल्प हुआ
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to one who represents the past, future and present. Obeisance to the brilliant and virile, to the heroic and the unconquered, to the bestower of boons and to the best of persons of great soul.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to one who represents the past, future and present. Obeisance to the brilliant and virile, to the heroic and the unconquered, to the bestower of boons and to the best of persons of great soul.…

verses.sanskrit: नमः स्थैर्याय वपुषे तेजसानुव्रताय च अतीताय भविष्याय वर्तमानाय वै नमः
verses.transliteration: namaḥ sthairyāya vapuṣe tejasānuvratāya ca atītāya bhaviṣyāya vartamānāya vai namaḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to the ever young, of golden form, the bestower of boons, the lower, the upper and the lord of the sleepers-on.
verses.hindi: मेरे द्वारा उत्पन्न तथा ब्रह्म नामसे जानी जानेवाली देवेश्वरी गायत्रीका भी अंग पीला, रक्त पीला तथा वर्ण आदि सब पीला था हे महासत्त्व! उस कल्पमें भी योगपरायण मनवाले उन द्विजातियोंने योगयुक्त चित्तसे मुझे जाना। है कनकाण्डज  उस कल्पमें तुमने भी मुझे पुनः तत्पुरुषरूपमें जाना; उसी कारणसे मेरा यह तत्पुरुष नाम हुआ
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to the ever young, of golden form, the bestower of boons, the lower, the upper and the lord of the sleepers-on.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to the ever young, of golden form, the bestower of boons, the lower, the upper and the lord of the sleepers-on.

verses.sanskrit: सुवर्चसे च वीर्याय शूराय ह्यजिताय च वरदाय वरेण्याय पुरुषाय महात्मने
verses.transliteration: suvarcase ca vīryāya śūrāya hyajitāya ca varadāya vareṇyāya puruṣāya mahātmane
verses.translation: Obeisance to the wearer of garlands, to the enjoyer of objects through the vehicle of sense-organs. Obeisance to one representing the Universe, to one who is universe-formed and to one with heads, hands and feet all round. Obeisance toRudra the unsurpassed. Obeisance to one who receives offerings poured into the fire. Obeisance to one who represents fire that carries oblations to the gods.
verses.hindi: तपस्यासे युक्त, विशुद्ध मनवाले तथा ब्रह्मपरायण जो लोग मुझ रुद्र तथा वेदमाता रुद्राणी गायत्रीकी आराधना करेंगे, वे पुनर्जन्मसे मुक्ति दिलानेवाले रुद्रलोकको मेरे वर्णके नामसे वह कल्प कृष्णकल्प कहा
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to the wearer of garlands, to the enjoyer of objects through the vehicle of sense-organs. Obeisance to one representing the Universe, to one who is universe-formed and to one with heads, hands and feet all round. Obeisance toRudra the unsurpassed.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to the wearer of garlands, to the enjoyer of objects through the vehicle of sense-organs. Obeisance to one representing the Universe, to one who is universe-formed and to one with heads, hands and feet all round. Obeisance toRudra the unsurpassed.…

verses.sanskrit: नमो भूताय भव्याय महते प्रभवाय च जनाय च नमस्तुभ्यं तपसे वरदाय च
verses.transliteration: namo bhūtāya bhavyāya mahate prabhavāya ca janāya ca namastubhyaṃ tapase varadāya ca
verses.translation: Obeisance to the holy one who has all aUainments. Obeisance to the sacrifice and to one devoted to the sacrifice, to one who is a good warrior, to one of terrible aspect and to one who agitates persons who cannot be easily excited.
verses.hindi: हे ब्रह्मन्! उस कल्पमें भी तुमने कालसदृश, कालरूप, लोकोंके लिये महाकाल तथा घोर पराक्रमवाले मुझ घोरको जाना॥ १९/२ ॥ हे देवेश! उस कल्पमें मुझसे उत्पन्न ब्रह्मसंज्ञावाली
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to the holy one who has all aUainments. Obeisance to the sacrifice and to one devoted to the sacrifice, to one who is a good warrior, to one of terrible aspect and to one who agitates persons who cannot be easily excited.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to the holy one who has all aUainments. Obeisance to the sacrifice and to one devoted to the sacrifice, to one who is a good warrior, to one of terrible aspect and to one who agitates persons who cannot be easily excited.

verses.sanskrit: अणवे महते चैव नमः सर्वगताय च नमो बन्धाय मोक्षाय स्वर्गाय नरकाय च
verses.transliteration: aṇave mahate caiva namaḥ sarvagatāya ca namo bandhāya mokṣāya svargāya narakāya ca
verses.translation: Obeisance to one of good progeny, to one of good intellect and to one who is the brilliant sun. Obeisance to the enlightened, pure and all-pervasive and to one who is contem- plated on by all.
verses.hindi: अतएव इस भूतलपर जो लोग घोरत्वको प्राप्त मुझ शिवको जान लेंगे, शाश्वत रूपवाला मैं उनके लिये हे ब्रह्मन्! पुनः जब मैं विश्वरूपत्वको प्राप्त हुआ, उस समय भी आपने परम समाधिसे मुझे जाना था। उस समय समस्त लोकोंको धारण करनेवाली गायत्री भी विश्वरूपा अर्थात् अनेक वर्णोबाली थीं
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to one of good progeny, to one of good intellect and to one who is the brilliant sun. Obeisance to the enlightened, pure and all-pervasive and to one who is contem- plated on by all.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to one of good progeny, to one of good intellect and to one who is the brilliant sun. Obeisance to the enlightened, pure and all-pervasive and to one who is contem- plated on by all.

verses.sanskrit: नमो भवाय देवाय इज्याय याजकाय च प्रत्युदीर्णाय दीप्ताय तत्त्वायातिगुणाय च
verses.transliteration: namo bhavāya devāya ijyāya yājakāya ca pratyudīrṇāya dīptāya tattvāyātiguṇāya ca
verses.translation: Obeisance to you, of curly hairs, of great chest and tuft, of golden colour, or resembling gold.
verses.hindi: इस भूतलपर जो लोग विश्वत्वको प्राप्त मुझ परमात्माको जान लेंगे, उनके प्रति मैं सदाके लिये सौम्य तथा शान्त हो जाऊँगा ये चापि वामदेवत्वं ज्ञास्यन्तीह द्विजातयः। रुद्रलोकं गमिष्यन्ति पुनरावृत्तिदुर्लभम्
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to you, of curly hairs, of great chest and tuft, of golden colour, or resembling gold.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to you, of curly hairs, of great chest and tuft, of golden colour, or resembling gold.

verses.sanskrit: नमः पाशाय शस्त्राय नमस्त्वाभरणाय च हुताय उपहूताय प्रहुतप्राशिताय च
verses.transliteration: namaḥ pāśāya śastrāya namastvābharaṇāya ca hutāya upahūtāya prahutaprāśitāya ca
verses.translation: Obeisance to one who has odd eyes, to one assuming the form of Lihga, to one of tawny colour, to one of great prowess and to the destroyer of rain, to one of gentle eyes.
verses.hindi: मत्प्रसूता च देवेशी पीताड़ी पीतलोहिता। पीतवर्णा तदा ह्यासीद् गायत्री ब्रह्मसंज्ञिता तस्मात्तत्पुरुषत्वं वै ममैतत्कनकाण्डज
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to one who has odd eyes, to one assuming the form of Lihga, to one of tawny colour, to one of great prowess and to the destroyer of rain, to one of gentle eyes.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to one who has odd eyes, to one assuming the form of Lihga, to one of tawny colour, to one of great prowess and to the destroyer of rain, to one of gentle eyes.

verses.sanskrit: नमो ऽस्त्विष्टाय पूर्ताय अग्निष्टोमद्विजाय च सदस्याय नमश्चैव दक्षिणावभृथाय च
verses.transliteration: namo 'stviṣṭāya pūrtāya agniṣṭomadvijāya ca sadasyāya namaścaiva dakṣiṇāvabhṛthāya ca
verses.translation: Obeisance to one of brown, white, black, red, tawny and yellow colours. Obeisance to one who is possessed of a quiver.
verses.hindi: ये मां रुद्रं च रुद्राणीं गायत्रीं वेदमातरम्। वेत्स्यन्ति तपसा युक्ता विमला ब्रह्मसड़ता: रुद्रलोकं गमिष्यन्ति पुनरावृत्तिदुर्लभम्। यदाहं पुनरेवासं कृष्णवर्णो भयानकः
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to one of brown, white, black, red, tawny and yellow colours. Obeisance to one who is possessed of a quiver.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to one of brown, white, black, red, tawny and yellow colours. Obeisance to one who is possessed of a quiver.

verses.sanskrit: अहिंसायाप्रलोभाय पशुमन्त्रौषधाय च नमः पुष्टिप्रदानाय सुशीलाय सुशीलिने
verses.transliteration: ahiṃsāyāpralobhāya paśumantrauṣadhāya ca namaḥ puṣṭipradānāya suśīlāya suśīline
verses.translation: Obeisance to you, marked and not marked by special traits; Obeisance to one worthy of worship and adornment. Obeisance to one who is a suitable patron.
verses.hindi: तत्राहं कालसङ्काशः कालो लोकप्रकालकः विज्ञातोऽहं त्वया ब्रह्मन् घोरो घोरपराक्रमः। मत्प्रसूता च गायत्री कृष्णाङ्गी कृष्णलोहिता
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to you, marked and not marked by special traits; Obeisance to one worthy of worship and adornment. Obeisance to one who is a suitable patron.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to you, marked and not marked by special traits; Obeisance to one worthy of worship and adornment. Obeisance to one who is a suitable patron.

verses.sanskrit: अतीताय भविष्याय वर्तमानाय ते नमः सुवर्चसे च वीर्याय शूराय ह्यजिताय च
verses.transliteration: atītāya bhaviṣyāya vartamānāya te namaḥ suvarcase ca vīryāya śūrāya hyajitāya ca
verses.translation: Obeisance to one befitting welfare. Obeisance to the elderly one. Obeisance to one favourably disposed. Obeisance to one representing the past, to the truthful one. Obeisance to one who is both true and untrue.
verses.hindi: कृष्णरूपा च देवेश तदासीद् ब्रह्मसंज्ञिता। तस्माद् घोरत्वमापनं ये मां वेत्स्यन्ति भूतले तेषामघोरः शान्तश्च भविष्याम्यहमव्ययः। पुनश्च विश्वरूपत्वं यदा ब्रह्मन् ममाभवत्
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to one befitting welfare. Obeisance to the elderly one. Obeisance to one favourably disposed. Obeisance to one representing the past, to the truthful one. Obeisance to one who is both true and untrue.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to one befitting welfare. Obeisance to the elderly one. Obeisance to one favourably disposed. Obeisance to one representing the past, to the truthful one. Obeisance to one who is both true and untrue.

verses.sanskrit: वरदाय वरेण्याय पुरुषाय महात्मने नमो भूताय भव्याय महते चाभयाय च
verses.transliteration: varadāya vareṇyāya puruṣāya mahātmane namo bhūtāya bhavyāya mahate cābhayāya ca
verses.translation: Obeisance to one of lotus colour, to the destroyer of death, the lord of death, to one of white, dark, tawny and red colours and to one having the colour of a charmingly brilliant cloud at dusk, to one initiated, to one having lotus- like hands; to one without garments and to one with matted hair.
verses.hindi: तदाप्यहं त्वया ज्ञातः परमेण समाधिना । विश्वरूपा च संवृत्ता गायत्री लोकधारिणी ॥ २ ३ तेषां शिवश्च सौम्यश्च भविष्यामि सहैव हि
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to one of lotus colour, to the destroyer of death, the lord of death, to one of white, dark, tawny and red colours and to one having the colour of a charmingly brilliant cloud at dusk, to one initiated, to one having lotus- like hands;…
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to one of lotus colour, to the destroyer of death, the lord of death, to one of white, dark, tawny and red colours and to one having the colour of a charmingly brilliant cloud at dusk, to one initiated, to one having lotus- like hands;…

verses.sanskrit: जरासिद्ध नमस्तुभ्यम् अयसे वरदाय च अधरे महते चैव नमः सस्तुपताय च
verses.transliteration: jarāsiddha namastubhyam ayase varadāya ca adhare mahate caiva namaḥ sastupatāya ca
verses.translation: Obeisance to one without magnitude; to one iden- tical with all; to the unchanging and immortal one; to one who represents colour and smell; to the eternal and to the uninjured one; to the huge one in front; to one without illusions; to one full and satisfied; to one difficult of access; to one re- presenting anger and to the tawny coloured one.
verses.hindi: अध्याय २३ विभिन्न कल्पोंमें होनेवाले सद्योजातादि शिवावतारोंका वर्णन १०७ न म म फ फी फ फ फ फ फ फ फा फ फ फ फ फ़ फ फ फ फ फ क फा क फ फ़ फा का आ फ फा क फ फ फ़ फ फा फ फा भा फ फा मा क फ म फ फा म मी मी मी
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to one without magnitude; to one iden- tical with all; to the unchanging and immortal one; to one who represents colour and smell; to the eternal and to the uninjured one; to the huge one in front; to one without illusions; to one full and satisfied;…
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to one without magnitude; to one iden- tical with all; to the unchanging and immortal one; to one who represents colour and smell; to the eternal and to the uninjured one; to the huge one in front; to one without illusions; to one full and satisfied;…

verses.sanskrit: नमश्चेन्द्रियपत्राणां लेलिहानाय स्रग्विणे विश्वाय विश्वरूपाय विश्वतः शिरसे नमः
verses.transliteration: namaścendriyapatrāṇāṃ lelihānāya sragviṇe viśvāya viśvarūpāya viśvataḥ śirase namaḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to one whose physical body is capable of being known and (at the same time) not known; obeisance to the powerful, to the brave; and the speedy one; obeisance to the deity behind sandy soil and behind current of water; to one stationed, extended and stretched.
verses.hindi: इसी कारण यह कल्प विश्वरूपकल्प नामसे गया और ये गायत्री विश्वरूपा नामसे कही गयीं। पत्ररूपमें प्रकट हुए, जिनकी लोकमें विशेष प्रसिद्धि हुई
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to one whose physical body is capable of being known and (at the same time) not known; obeisance to the powerful, to the brave; and the speedy one; obeisance to the deity behind sandy soil and behind current of water; to one stationed, extended and stretched.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to one whose physical body is capable of being known and (at the same time) not known; obeisance to the powerful, to the brave; and the speedy one; obeisance to the deity behind sandy soil and behind current of water; to one stationed, extended and stretched.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वतः पाणिपादाय रुद्रायाप्रतिमाय च नमो हव्याय कव्याय हव्यवाहाय वै नमः
verses.transliteration: sarvataḥ pāṇipādāya rudrāyāpratimāya ca namo havyāya kavyāya havyavāhāya vai namaḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to you the intelligent potter; obeisance to you, with the crescent Moon on the forehead. Obeisance to the wonderful one of variegated dress and colours and of the form of intellect.
verses.hindi: ये गायत्री शब्द और अर्थरूपसे मेध्या अर्थात् यज्ञयोग्या होंगी, सर्वभक्षा अर्थात् पातकादिविनाशिका होंगी । गायत्रीके सावित्रीके सर्ववर्णा (सर्वशब्दात्मिका) होनेसे ही चातुर्वरण्य-व्यवस्था प्रजामें व्यवस्थित होगी इसीलिये धर्म, अर्थ, काम तथा मोक्ष-चार प्रकारके ये पुरुषार्थ हैं और वेद भी चार हैं। जीव- समुदायोंके भी जरायुज, अण्डज, स्वेदज, उद्धिज्ज-र्‍ये चार प्रकारके रूप हैं तथा आश्रम भी चार हैं । दया, दान,
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to you the intelligent potter; obeisance to you, with the crescent Moon on the forehead. Obeisance to the wonderful one of variegated dress and colours and of the form of intellect.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to you the intelligent potter; obeisance to you, with the crescent Moon on the forehead. Obeisance to the wonderful one of variegated dress and colours and of the form of intellect.

verses.sanskrit: नमः सिद्धाय मेध्याय इष्टायेज्यापराय च सुवीराय सुघोराय अक्षोभ्यक्षोभणाय च
verses.transliteration: namaḥ siddhāya medhyāya iṣṭāyejyāparāya ca suvīrāya sughorāya akṣobhyakṣobhaṇāya ca
verses.translation: Obeisance to one, of great consciousness and alertness; obeisance to you, the most satisfied one and the best bestower of favours; obeisance to the forbearing one, to one having self- control; and to one of adamantine body.
verses.hindi: तप, सत्य-ये धर्मके चार पाद हैं एवं मेरे पुत्र भी चार हैं इसीलिये यह चराचर जगत् युगरूप चार अवस्थाओंवाला है और यह चतुष्पादात्मक लोक भी भेदानुसार चार रूपोंमें अवस्थित है
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to one, of great consciousness and alertness; obeisance to you, the most satisfied one and the best bestower of favours; obeisance to the forbearing one, to one having self- control; and to one of adamantine body.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to one, of great consciousness and alertness; obeisance to you, the most satisfied one and the best bestower of favours; obeisance to the forbearing one, to one having self- control; and to one of adamantine body.

verses.sanskrit: सुप्रजाय सुमेधाय दीप्ताय भास्कराय च नमो बुद्धाय शुद्धाय विस्तृताय मताय च
verses.transliteration: suprajāya sumedhāya dīptāya bhāskarāya ca namo buddhāya śuddhāya vistṛtāya matāya ca
verses.translation: Obeisance to the destroyer of the R§asas, to the dispeller of poisons, to the bright-necked one and to one who is above anger. Obeisance to the all consuming God of Death; and to one holding sharp weapons, to one endowed with great joy, to one with great gaiety, to one comprehensible only to the
verses.hindi: भूर्लोक, भुवलोंक, स्वर्लोक, महलोंक, जनलोक, तपलोक तथा सत्यलोक-इन सबके परे विष्णुलोक स्थित है अष्टाक्षररूप लोक अपने-अपने स्थानपर अक्षरात्मकरूपमें विद्यमान हैं । भूर्लोक, भुवर्लोक, स्वर्लोक तथा महलोक ही चार पादके रूपमें अवस्थित हैं । इनमें भूर्लोक पहला पाद है, भुवर्लोक दूसरा पाद है, स्वर्लोक
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to the destroyer of the R§asas, to the dispeller of poisons, to the bright-necked one and to one who is above anger. Obeisance to the all consuming God of Death; and to one holding sharp weapons, to one endowed with great joy, to one with great gaiety,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to the destroyer of the R§asas, to the dispeller of poisons, to the bright-necked one and to one who is above anger. Obeisance to the all consuming God of Death; and to one holding sharp weapons, to one endowed with great joy, to one with great gaiety,…

verses.sanskrit: नमः स्थूलाय सूक्ष्माय दृश्यादृश्याय सर्वशः वर्षते ज्वलते चैव वायवे शिशिराय च
verses.transliteration: namaḥ sthūlāya sūkṣmāya dṛśyādṛśyāya sarvaśaḥ varṣate jvalate caiva vāyave śiśirāya ca
verses.translation: Obeisance to Pranava; to the lord of Prariava; to the destroyer of Bhaganetra; to the hunter of deer; to the diligent one and to the destroyer of Daksa's sacrifice.
verses.hindi: तीसरा तथा महर्लोक चौथा पाद है पाँचवाँ जनलोक, छठा तपलोक तथा पुनर्जन्मको प्राप्ति न करनेवाले लोगोंका सत्यलोक सातवाँ लोक कहा गया है
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to Pranava; to the lord of Prariava; to the destroyer of Bhaganetra; to the hunter of deer; to the diligent one and to the destroyer of Daksa's sacrifice.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to Pranava; to the lord of Prariava; to the destroyer of Bhaganetra; to the hunter of deer; to the diligent one and to the destroyer of Daksa's sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit: नमस्ते वक्रकेशाय ऊरुवक्षःशिखाय च नमो नमः सुवर्णाय तपनीयनिभाय च
verses.transliteration: namaste vakrakeśāya ūruvakṣaḥśikhāya ca namo namaḥ suvarṇāya tapanīyanibhāya ca
verses.translation: Obeisance to one, the soul of all creatures, to one who excels all lords, to the destroyer of the Puras, to one having good weapons and to one having bow and axe.
verses.hindi: विष्णुलोक वह पद है, जहाँ पहुँचकर जीवका पुनः आगमन नहीं होता है। उससे भी आगे स्कन्दलोक तथा उससे भी परे पार्वतीलोक है, जो सर्वविध सिद्धियोंसे युक्त माना गया है रुद्रलोक उससे परे विद्यमान है। वह पद योगियोंके लिये अत्यन्त शुभकर कहा गया है। ममतारहित, अहंकार-
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to one, the soul of all creatures, to one who excels all lords, to the destroyer of the Puras, to one having good weapons and to one having bow and axe.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to one, the soul of all creatures, to one who excels all lords, to the destroyer of the Puras, to one having good weapons and to one having bow and axe.

verses.sanskrit: विरूपाक्षाय लिङ्गाय पिङ्गलाय महौजसे वृष्टिघ्नाय नमश्चैव नमः सौम्येक्षणाय च
verses.transliteration: virūpākṣāya liṅgāya piṅgalāya mahaujase vṛṣṭighnāya namaścaiva namaḥ saumyekṣaṇāya ca
verses.translation: Obeisance to one who destroyed Pudanta and Bhaganetra; to the bestower of desires; to the excellent one; to one who burnt the body of Kama.
verses.hindi: सर्वरूपा तथा चेमे संवृत्ता मम पुत्रकाः। चत्वारस्ते मया ख्याताः पुत्रा वै लोकसम्मताः मोक्षो धर्मस्तथार्थश्च कामश्चेति चतुष्टयम्। यस्माद्वेदाश्च वेद्यं च चतुर्धा वै भविष्यति
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to one who destroyed Pudanta and Bhaganetra; to the bestower of desires; to the excellent one; to one who burnt the body of Kama.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to one who destroyed Pudanta and Bhaganetra; to the bestower of desires; to the excellent one; to one who burnt the body of Kama.

verses.sanskrit: नमो धूम्राय श्वेताय कृष्णाय लोहिताय च पिशिताय पिशङ्गाय पीताय च निषङ्गिणे
verses.transliteration: namo dhūmrāya śvetāya kṛṣṇāya lohitāya ca piśitāya piśaṅgāya pītāya ca niṣaṅgiṇe
verses.translation: Obeisance to one of terrible face in the battlefield; to one having face of a great elephant; obeisance to the lord who destroyed the Daityas and to one who caused distress to the Dailyas.
verses.hindi: धर्मस्य पादाश्चत्वारश्चत्वारो मम पुत्रकाः भूर्लोकोऽथ भुवलोंकः स्वलोकश्च महस्तथा। जनस्तपश्च सत्यं च विष्णुलोकस्ततः परम्
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to one of terrible face in the battlefield; to one having face of a great elephant; obeisance to the lord who destroyed the Daityas and to one who caused distress to the Dailyas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to one of terrible face in the battlefield; to one having face of a great elephant; obeisance to the lord who destroyed the Daityas and to one who caused distress to the Dailyas.

verses.sanskrit: नमस्ते सविशेषाय निर्विशेषाय वै नमः नम ईज्याय पूज्याय उपजीव्याय वै नमः
verses.transliteration: namaste saviśeṣāya nirviśeṣāya vai namaḥ nama ījyāya pūjyāya upajīvyāya vai namaḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to the destroyer of snow; to the severe one; to one wearing wet hide; to one having perpetual interest in the cremation ground; to one holding the fire-brand.
verses.hindi: अष्टाक्षरस्थितो लोकः स्थाने स्थाने तदक्षरम्। भूर्भुवः स्वर्महश्चैव पादाश्चत्वार एव च भूर्लोकः प्रथमः पादो भुवर्लोकस्ततः परम् स्वर्लोको वै तृतीयश्च चतुर्थस्तु महस्तथा
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to the destroyer of snow; to the severe one; to one wearing wet hide; to one having perpetual interest in the cremation ground; to one holding the fire-brand.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to the destroyer of snow; to the severe one; to one wearing wet hide; to one having perpetual interest in the cremation ground; to one holding the fire-brand.

verses.sanskrit: नमः क्षेम्याय वृद्धाय वत्सलाय नमोनमः नमो भूताय सत्याय सत्यासत्याय वै नमः
verses.transliteration: namaḥ kṣemyāya vṛddhāya vatsalāya namonamaḥ namo bhūtāya satyāya satyāsatyāya vai namaḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to you the protector of lives; to the wearer of skulls and to one surrounded by care-free goblins of different classes.
verses.hindi: सत्यं तु सप्तमो लोको ह्यपुनर्भ॑वगामिनाम् विष्णुलोकः स्मृतं स्थानं पुनरावृत्तिदुरलभम्। स्कान्दमौमं तथा स्थानं सर्वसिद्धिसमन्वितम्
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to you the protector of lives; to the wearer of skulls and to one surrounded by care-free goblins of different classes.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to you the protector of lives; to the wearer of skulls and to one surrounded by care-free goblins of different classes.

verses.sanskrit: नमो वै पद्मवर्णाय मृत्युघ्नाय च मृत्यवे नमो गौराय श्यामाय कद्रवे लोहिताय च
verses.transliteration: namo vai padmavarṇāya mṛtyughnāya ca mṛtyave namo gaurāya śyāmāya kadrave lohitāya ca
verses.translation: Obeisance to one having male-cum-female body; to one who pleases the Goddess; to one having matted hair; to one having tonsured head and to one having the serpent for sacred thread.
verses.hindi: रूद्र्लोकः स्मृतस्तस्मात्पदं तद्योगिनां शुभम्। निर्ममा निरहङ्काराः कामक्रोधविवर्जिता: अअझभभझभकमकरकरभभभअकककमझकरमझभभकभझरकझरमरमभमक अझ झमक अझ झमक झमक भक जक न कवी कमभमक काण
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to one having male-cum-female body; to one who pleases the Goddess; to one having matted hair; to one having tonsured head and to one having the serpent for sacred thread.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to one having male-cum-female body; to one who pleases the Goddess; to one having matted hair; to one having tonsured head and to one having the serpent for sacred thread.

verses.sanskrit: महासंध्याभ्रवर्णाय चारुदीप्ताय दीक्षिणे नमः कमलहस्ताय दिग्वासाय कपर्दिने
verses.transliteration: mahāsaṃdhyābhravarṇāya cārudīptāya dīkṣiṇe namaḥ kamalahastāya digvāsāya kapardine
verses.translation: Obeisance to one the habitual dancer, to one fond of dance and music, to the lord of anger, to one practising music and to one who is sung about by the sages.
verses.hindi: शून्य, काम-क्रोधसे विवर्जित तथा ध्यानपरायण चित्तवाले योगीजन ही उस लोकका दर्शन करेंगे ॥ ३६/२॥ और जो आपने चार पादोंवाली इस गायत्री (सरस्वती)-को देखा है, उसीके चार चरणोंके रूपमें चरम पदवाला विष्णुलोक, शान्त तथा उत्तम स्कन्दलोक, पार्वतीलोक एवं रुद्रलोक अवस्थित हँ । ऐसी माहात्मययुक्त
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to one the habitual dancer, to one fond of dance and music, to the lord of anger, to one practising music and to one who is sung about by the sages.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to one the habitual dancer, to one fond of dance and music, to the lord of anger, to one practising music and to one who is sung about by the sages.

verses.sanskrit: अप्रमाणाय सर्वाय अव्ययायामराय च नमो रूपाय गन्धाय शाश्वतायाक्षताय च
verses.transliteration: apramāṇāya sarvāya avyayāyāmarāya ca namo rūpāya gandhāya śāśvatāyākṣatāya ca
verses.translation: Obeisance to one in the form of a lion, to one of sharp nature, to one both pleasing and not pleasing, to the horrifying and the terrible one, to the suppressor of Bhaga demon.
verses.hindi: सरस्वतीका आपने दर्शन किया है इससे सभी पशु भी चार पैरोंवाले होंगे और इसीसे इनके चार स्तन भी होंगे। है ब्रह्मन्! मेरे मुखसे गिरा हुआ मन्त्रयुक्त सोमरूप अमृत प्राणधारियोंका जीवन बनकर उनके स्तनमें निवास करेगा। इसलिये वे स्तन
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to one in the form of a lion, to one of sharp nature, to one both pleasing and not pleasing, to the horrifying and the terrible one, to the suppressor of Bhaga demon.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to one in the form of a lion, to one of sharp nature, to one both pleasing and not pleasing, to the horrifying and the terrible one, to the suppressor of Bhaga demon.

verses.sanskrit: पुरस्ताद्बृंहते चैव विभ्रान्ताय कृताय च दुर्गमाय महेशाय क्रोधाय कपिलाय च
verses.transliteration: purastādbṛṃhate caiva vibhrāntāya kṛtāya ca durgamāya maheśāya krodhāya kapilāya ca
verses.translation: Obeisance to one praised and sung about by the en- lightened souls. Obeisance to the highly blessed, to one who laughs boisterously, who roars like a lion and who flaps and blows.
verses.hindi: उसीके कारण सोममय अमृत जीवनसंज्ञावाला होगा और उनके दुग्धका श्वेतत्व उसी सोमरूपत्वके कारण होगा-ऐसे गुणोंवाले वे चतुष्पाद होंगे आपके द्वारा देखी गयी यह लोकभाविनी सावित्री महेश्वरी पुनः दो पादोंवाली होकर क्रियारूप धारण करेगी; जिससे सभी शुभ नर-नारी दो पादों तथा दो
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to one praised and sung about by the en- lightened souls. Obeisance to the highly blessed, to one who laughs boisterously, who roars like a lion and who flaps and blows.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to one praised and sung about by the en- lightened souls. Obeisance to the highly blessed, to one who laughs boisterously, who roars like a lion and who flaps and blows.

verses.sanskrit: तर्क्यातर्क्यशरीराय बलिने रंहसाय च सिकत्याय प्रवाह्याय स्थिताय प्रसृताय च
verses.transliteration: tarkyātarkyaśarīrāya baline raṃhasāya ca sikatyāya pravāhyāya sthitāya prasṛtāya ca
verses.translation: Obeisance to one who roars and jumps; obeisance to the joyous soul, to the benevolent, to one who breathes, runs and controls all.
verses.hindi: सभी प्राणियोंको धारण करनेवाली तथा महान् शक्तिसे सम्पन्न जिस देवीका आपने दर्शन किया है; वह महेश्वरी अजा होकर जब सर्ववर्णमय विश्वरूप धारण करेगी, तब उसीसे सभी प्रजाएँ भी अनेक धारण करेंगे और इनके मुखमें सर्वत्र अग्नि विराजमान होगी; उसी कारण सर्वव्यापी पशुरूपी अग्नि पवित्र
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to one who roars and jumps; obeisance to the joyous soul, to the benevolent, to one who breathes, runs and controls all.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to one who roars and jumps; obeisance to the joyous soul, to the benevolent, to one who breathes, runs and controls all.

verses.sanskrit: सुमेधसे कुलालाय नमस्ते शशिखण्डिने चित्राय चित्रवेषाय चित्रवर्णाय मेधसे
verses.transliteration: sumedhase kulālāya namaste śaśikhaṇḍine citrāya citraveṣāya citravarṇāya medhase
verses.translation: Obeisance to one who mediutes, yawns, cries, runs, gallops and sports about; to one who has a protruding belly.
verses.hindi: विशुद्ध आत्मावाले जो द्विजगण अपनी तपस्यासे इंशित्व (ईश्वरत्व) तथा वशित्व (योगसिद्धि) -में सभी जगह मुझे भी सर्वव्यापी रूपमें विराजमान देखेंगे; वे रजोगुण तथा तमोगुणसे रहित होकर मानवशरीरका त्याग करके मेरा सानिध्य प्राप्त करेंगे और उनका पुनर्जन्म नहीं होगा॥ ४६-४७१५. ॥
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to one who mediutes, yawns, cries, runs, gallops and sports about; to one who has a protruding belly.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to one who mediutes, yawns, cries, runs, gallops and sports about; to one who has a protruding belly.

verses.sanskrit: चेकितानाय तुष्टाय नमस्ते निहिताय च नमः क्षान्ताय दान्ताय वज्रसंहननाय च
verses.transliteration: cekitānāya tuṣṭāya namaste nihitāya ca namaḥ kṣāntāya dāntāya vajrasaṃhananāya ca
verses.translation: Obeisance to one who has functions and no functions to peribrm, to one who has a thousand heads, to one who is poor or miserly, to one who has an impassioned body, to one who has small anklet-bells.
verses.hindi: सूतजी कहते हैं कि है द्विजो! शिवजीके इस पादान्तं विष्णुलोकं वै कौमारं शान्तमुत्तमम्। औमं माहेश्वरं चैव तस्माद् दृष्टा चतुष्पदा
