verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to one who has functions and no functions to peribrm, to one who has a thousand heads, to one who is poor or miserly, to one who has an impassioned body, to one who has small anklet-bells.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to one who has functions and no functions to peribrm, to one who has a thousand heads, to one who is poor or miserly, to one who has an impassioned body, to one who has small anklet-bells.

verses.sanskrit: रक्षोघ्नाय विषघ्नाय शितिकण्ठोर्ध्वमन्यवे
verses.transliteration: rakṣoghnāya viṣaghnāya śitikaṇṭhordhvamanyave
verses.translation: Obeisance to one of deformed dress; to the ruthless and unforgiving; to one who cannot be measured; to the pro- tector; to the illuminated and devoid of attributes.
verses.hindi: जीवः प्राणभृतां ब्रह्मन् पुनः पीतस्तनाः स्मृताः दृष्टा पुनस्तथैवैषा सावित्री लोकभाविनी
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to one of deformed dress; to the ruthless and unforgiving; to one who cannot be measured; to the pro- tector; to the illuminated and devoid of attributes.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to one of deformed dress; to the ruthless and unforgiving; to one who cannot be measured; to the pro- tector; to the illuminated and devoid of attributes.

verses.sanskrit: लेलिहाय कृतान्ताय तिग्मायुधधराय च
verses.transliteration: lelihāya kṛtāntāya tigmāyudhadharāya ca
verses.translation: Obeisance to one fond of the elegant, to the beautiful, to one adorned with a crest-jewel, to the minutest of the minute and to one who cannot be measured or known by qualities.
verses.hindi: इत्येवमुक्तो भगवान् ब्रह्मा रुद्रेण वै द्विजा: श्वेतवाराहकल्पके अट्टाईस द्वापरोंके अन्तमें प्रकट होनेवाले व्यासोंका वर्णन
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to one fond of the elegant, to the beautiful, to one adorned with a crest-jewel, to the minutest of the minute and to one who cannot be measured or known by qualities.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to one fond of the elegant, to the beautiful, to one adorned with a crest-jewel, to the minutest of the minute and to one who cannot be measured or known by qualities.

verses.sanskrit: प्रमोदाय संमोदाय यतिवेद्याय ते नमः अनामयाय सर्वाय महाकालाय वै नमः
verses.transliteration: pramodāya saṃmodāya yativedyāya te namaḥ anāmayāya sarvāya mahākālāya vai namaḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to one possessed of good qualities; to the secret one, to one who goes to impassable places. This earth is the mother of worlds. Your feet are resorted to by good men. Your belly, the support of all Siddhis, contains the wide firmament be- decked in clusters of stars. Just like the galaxy of stars the glori- ous necklace shines on your chest. To you, the ten quarters arc the ten arms bedecked in shoulderlets and bracelets. Your neck has great girth and extent; it is comparable to the blue collyrium; it is adorned with golden threads.
verses.hindi: य एवं भगवान् विद्वान् गायत्र्या वै महेश्वरम् प्रकार कहनेपर भगवान् ब्रह्मने प्रणाम करके विनम्रतापूर्वक रुद्रसे पुनः कहा--हे भगवन्! जो विद्वान् सर्वव्यापी विश्वात्मा आप महेश्वरको गायत्रीसहित सर्वत्र स्थित देखे तथा है ईश्वर! आपकी एवं गायत्रीको आराधना
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to one possessed of good qualities; to the secret one, to one who goes to impassable places. This earth is the mother of worlds. Your feet are resorted to by good men. Your belly, the support of all Siddhis, contains the wide firmament be- decked in clusters of stars.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to one possessed of good qualities; to the secret one, to one who goes to impassable places. This earth is the mother of worlds. Your feet are resorted to by good men. Your belly, the support of all Siddhis, contains the wide firmament be- decked in clusters of stars.…

verses.sanskrit: प्रणवप्रणवेशाय भगनेत्रान्तकाय च मृगव्याधाय दक्षाय दक्षयज्ञान्तकाय च
verses.transliteration: praṇavapraṇaveśāya bhaganetrāntakāya ca mṛgavyādhāya dakṣāya dakṣayajñāntakāya ca
verses.translation: Your face is irrepressible; it is terrible due to the cur- ved fangs; it is incomparable. Your head which is heaven it- self shines all the more with its turban of lotus garlands.
verses.hindi: करे, उसे आप परमपद दें। इसपर उन शिवजीने कहा-- वैसा ही होगा इसलिये प्रभु शिवद्वारा ब्रह्माजीके प्रति कहे गये वचनके अनुसार जो विद्वान् गायत्री तथा महात्मा रुद्रका विश्वरूपत्व जान लेता है, वह ब्रह्मसायुज्यको प्राप्त होता है अर्थात् ब्रह्मे साथ उसका तादात्म्य स्थापित हो जाता
verses.wordMeaning: Your face is irrepressible; it is terrible due to the cur- ved fangs; it is incomparable. Your head which is heaven it- self shines all the more with its turban of lotus garlands.
verses.commentary: Sense: Your face is irrepressible; it is terrible due to the cur- ved fangs; it is incomparable. Your head which is heaven it- self shines all the more with its turban of lotus garlands.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वभूतात्मभूताय सर्वेशातिशयाय च पुरघ्नाय सुशस्त्राय धन्विने ऽथ परश्वधे
verses.transliteration: sarvabhūtātmabhūtāya sarveśātiśayāya ca puraghnāya suśastrāya dhanvine 'tha paraśvadhe
verses.translation: Refulgence in the sun, brilliance in the moon, firm- ness in the mountains, strength in the wind, heat in the fire, chilliness in the waters and sound in the firmament — the wise know these qualities to be due to the internal throbbing of the imperishable lord.
verses.hindi: स याति ब्रह्मसायुज्यं वचनाद् ब्रह्मणः प्रभोः॥ ५९  है शवेतवाराहकल्पके अट्टाईस द्वापरोंके अन्तमें प्रकट होनेवाले अट्टाईस व्यासों, अट्टाईंस शिवावतारों तथा विविध शिवयोगियोंका वर्णन
verses.wordMeaning: Refulgence in the sun, brilliance in the moon, firm- ness in the mountains, strength in the wind, heat in the fire, chilliness in the waters and sound in the firmament — the wise know these qualities to be due to the internal throbbing of the imperishable lord.
verses.commentary: Sense: Refulgence in the sun, brilliance in the moon, firm- ness in the mountains, strength in the wind, heat in the fire, chilliness in the waters and sound in the firmament — the wise know these qualities to be due to the internal throbbing of the imperishable lord.

verses.sanskrit: पूषदन्तविनाशाय भगनेत्रान्तकाय च कामदाय वरिष्ठाय कामाङ्गदहनाय च
verses.transliteration: pūṣadantavināśāya bhaganetrāntakāya ca kāmadāya variṣṭhāya kāmāṅgadahanāya ca
verses.translation: Formerly, after propitiating you the enemies were slain by us in the battle. You are a submarine fire. Not satiated by drinking all the waters of the ocean, you are infuriated in form, but delighted within. You are the bestower of desires; you can go as you wish; you are fond (of us); you arc the celibate religious student. You are unfathomable and favourably disposed towards the Brahmins; you arc adored by the society,
verses.hindi: श्रुत्वैवमखिलं ब्रह्मा रुद्रेण परिभाषितम्। पुनः प्रणम्य देवेशं रुद्रमाह प्रजापति: भगवन् देवदेवेश विश्वरूप महेश्वर। उमाधव महादेव नमो लोकाभिवन्दित
verses.wordMeaning: Formerly, after propitiating you the enemies were slain by us in the battle. You are a submarine fire. Not satiated by drinking all the waters of the ocean, you are infuriated in form, but delighted within. You are the bestower of desires; you can go as you wish;…
verses.commentary: Sense: Formerly, after propitiating you the enemies were slain by us in the battle. You are a submarine fire. Not satiated by drinking all the waters of the ocean, you are infuriated in form, but delighted within. You are the bestower of desires; you can go as you wish;…

verses.sanskrit: रङ्गे करालवक्त्राय नागेन्द्रवदनाय च दैत्यानामन्तकेशाय दैत्याक्रन्दकराय च
verses.transliteration: raṅge karālavaktrāya nāgendravadanāya ca daityānāmantakeśāya daityākrandakarāya ca
verses.translation: You have made sacrifice the everlasting treasure of the Devas. The fire-god bears to you the offering, as mentioned in the Vedas O supreme lord, if you are pleased we too become pleased.
verses.hindi: विश्वरूप महाभाग कस्मिन् काले महेश्वर। या इमास्ते महादेव तनवो लोकवन्दिताः केन वा तपसा देव ध्यानयोगेन केन वा
verses.wordMeaning: You have made sacrifice the everlasting treasure of the Devas. The fire-god bears to you the offering, as mentioned in the Vedas O supreme lord, if you are pleased we too become pleased.
verses.commentary: Sense: You have made sacrifice the everlasting treasure of the Devas. The fire-god bears to you the offering, as mentioned in the Vedas O supreme lord, if you are pleased we too become pleased.

verses.sanskrit: हिमघ्नाय च तीक्ष्णाय आर्द्रचर्मधराय च श्मशानरतिनित्याय नमो ऽस्तूल्मुकधारिणे
verses.transliteration: himaghnāya ca tīkṣṇāya ārdracarmadharāya ca śmaśānaratinityāya namo 'stūlmukadhāriṇe
verses.translation: You are the lord of Parvati, you are beginningless. At the time of first creation you are Brahma, the maker of worlds. The followers of the Skhya system realise you as one beyond prakrti and at the close of meditation they enter you, devoid of death.
verses.hindi: नमस्ते वै महादेव शक्यो द्रष्टु द्विजातिभिः। तस्य तद्ठचनं श्रुत्वा शर्वः सम्प्रेक्ष्य तं पुरः स्मयन् प्राह महादेवो ऋग्यजुःसामसम्भवः ।
verses.wordMeaning: You are the lord of Parvati, you are beginningless. At the time of first creation you are Brahma, the maker of worlds. The followers of the Skhya system realise you as one beyond prakrti and at the close of meditation they enter you, devoid of death.
verses.commentary: Sense: You are the lord of Parvati, you are beginningless. At the time of first creation you are Brahma, the maker of worlds. The followers of the Skhya system realise you as one beyond prakrti and at the close of meditation they enter you, devoid of death.

verses.sanskrit: नमस्ते प्राणपालाय मुण्डमालाधराय च प्रहीणशोकैर्विविधैर् भूतैः परिवृताय च
verses.transliteration: namaste prāṇapālāya muṇḍamālādharāya ca prahīṇaśokairvividhair bhūtaiḥ parivṛtāya ca
verses.translation: Those who meditate on you, understand you as perpetual siddha through yoga and then eschew those yogas. Those enlightened persons who resort to you through their actions enjoy divine bliss.
verses.hindi: श्रीभगवानुवाच तपसा नैव वृत्तेन दानधर्मफलेन च सूतजी बोले है मुनियो! शिवके द्वारा कथित सम्पूर्ण वचनोंको सुनकर प्रजापति ब्रह्माने उन देवाधिदेव शिवको प्रणाम करके पुनः उनसे कहा-
verses.wordMeaning: Those who meditate on you, understand you as perpetual siddha through yoga and then eschew those yogas. Those enlightened persons who resort to you through their actions enjoy divine bliss.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who meditate on you, understand you as perpetual siddha through yoga and then eschew those yogas. Those enlightened persons who resort to you through their actions enjoy divine bliss.

verses.sanskrit: नरनारीशरीराय देव्याः प्रियकराय च जटिने मुण्डिने चैव व्यालयज्ञोपवीतिने
verses.transliteration: naranārīśarīrāya devyāḥ priyakarāya ca jaṭine muṇḍine caiva vyālayajñopavītine
verses.translation: The greatness of yours has been glorified in accor- dance with what we know according to our capacity. Your reality and principles cannot be enumerated; you are the supreme soul who cannot be easily crossed.
verses.hindi: हे भगवन्! है देवदेवेश! है विश्वरूप! हे महेश्वर! है उमापते! है महादेव! है लोकवन्द्य! आपको नमस्कार है हे विश्वरूप! है महाभाग! है महेश्वर! हे महादेव! आपके ये जो लोकवन्द्य अवतार हैं, वे किस कालमें तथा किस युगमें द्विजातियोंके द्वारा इस लोकमें देखे जा सकेंगे?॥ ३/२॥
verses.wordMeaning: The greatness of yours has been glorified in accor- dance with what we know according to our capacity. Your reality and principles cannot be enumerated; you are the supreme soul who cannot be easily crossed.
verses.commentary: Sense: The greatness of yours has been glorified in accor- dance with what we know according to our capacity. Your reality and principles cannot be enumerated; you are the supreme soul who cannot be easily crossed.

verses.sanskrit: नमो ऽस्तु नृत्यशीलाय उपनृत्यप्रियाय च मन्यवे गीतशीलाय मुनिभिर् गायते नमः
verses.transliteration: namo 'stu nṛtyaśīlāya upanṛtyapriyāya ca manyave gītaśīlāya munibhir gāyate namaḥ
verses.translation: The greatness of yours has been glorified in accor- dance with what we know according to our capacity. Your reality and principles cannot be enumerated; you are the supreme soul who cannot be easily crossed.
verses.hindi: हे देव! है महादेव! आपको नमस्कार है। द्विजातिगण किस तप या ध्यानयोगके द्वारा आपका दर्शन कर पानेमें समर्थ हो सकते हैं ?॥ ४ /२॥ ब्रह्माजीका यह वचन सुनकर ऋग्वेद, यजुर्वेद तथा सामवेदसे प्रादुर्भूत महादेव रुद्र अपने सम्मुख- स्थित उन पितामहको देखकर मुसकराते हुए उनसे
verses.wordMeaning: The greatness of yours has been glorified in accor- dance with what we know according to our capacity. Your reality and principles cannot be enumerated; you are the supreme soul who cannot be easily crossed.
verses.commentary: Sense: The greatness of yours has been glorified in accor- dance with what we know according to our capacity. Your reality and principles cannot be enumerated; you are the supreme soul who cannot be easily crossed.

verses.sanskrit: कटकटाय तिग्माय अप्रियाय प्रियाय च विभीषणाय भीष्माय भगप्रमथनाय च
verses.transliteration: kaṭakaṭāya tigmāya apriyāya priyāya ca vibhīṣaṇāya bhīṣmāya bhagapramathanāya ca
verses.translation: The greatness of yours has been glorified in accor- dance with what we know according to our capacity. Your reality and principles cannot be enumerated; you are the supreme soul who cannot be easily crossed.
verses.hindi: भगवान् शिव बोले--मानव मुझे न तो केवल फुफफफफफफफफफफफफाफफफी पापा फक पीपीपी कमी फ्रफक्रफ्फ्फरफ्रफफ फ़

verses.sanskrit: सिद्धसंघानुगीताय महाभागाय वै नमः नमो मुक्ताट्टहासाय क्ष्वेडितास्फोटिताय च
verses.transliteration: siddhasaṃghānugītāya mahābhāgāya vai namaḥ namo muktāṭṭahāsāya kṣveḍitāsphoṭitāya ca

verses.hindi: फ्रोफफाफफाफफाफाफाफक पापा फी फक न योगसे , न पुष्कल बेदोंके
verses.wordMeaning: The greatness of yours has been glorified in accor- dance with what we know according to our capacity. Your reality and principles cannot be enumerated; you are the supreme soul who cannot be easily crossed.

verses.sanskrit: नर्दते कूर्दते चैव नमः प्रमुदितात्मने नमो मृडाय श्वसते धावते ऽधिष्ठिते नमः
verses.transliteration: nardate kūrdate caiva namaḥ pramuditātmane namo mṛḍāya śvasate dhāvate 'dhiṣṭhite namaḥ
verses.translation: The greatness of yours has been glorified in accor- dance with what we know according to our capacity. Your reality and principles cannot be enumerated; you are the supreme soul who cannot be easily crossed.
verses.hindi: दमत घ्यानादह त्विह! ही देख सकनेमें समर्थ हैं, मेरा दर्शन ध्यानरहित सप्तमे चैव वाराहे ततस्तस्मिन् पितामह॥ ८  साधनाके द्वारा नहीं किया जा सकता है कल्पेश्वरोऽथ भगवान् सर्वलोकप्रकाशनः। है पितामह! वाराहकल्पके सातवें मन्वन्तरमें सभी मनुर्वैवस्वतश्चैव तव पौत्रो भविष्यति॥ ९  लोकोंको त ह ता मेरा तदा चतुर्युगावस्थे तस्मिन् कल्पे युगान्तिके । अवताररूप नेवस्वत मनु आपके त्रिक रूपम अवतरित
verses.wordMeaning: The greatness of yours has been glorified in accor- dance with what we know according to our capacity. Your reality and principles cannot be enumerated; you are the supreme soul who cannot be easily crossed.
verses.commentary: Sense: The greatness of yours has been glorified in accor- dance with what we know according to our capacity. Your reality and principles cannot be enumerated; you are the supreme soul who cannot be easily crossed.

verses.sanskrit: ध्यायते जृम्भते चैव रुदते द्रवते नमः वल्गते क्रीडते चैव लम्बोदरशरीरिणे
verses.transliteration: dhyāyate jṛmbhate caiva rudate dravate namaḥ valgate krīḍate caiva lambodaraśarīriṇe

verses.hindi: अनुग्रहार्थ लोकानां ब्राह्मणानां हिताय च॥ १० उसी कल्पके द्वापरयुगके अन्तमं लोकोपर अनुग्रह उत्पत्स्यामि तदा ब्रह्मन् पुनरस्मिन् युगान्तिके।  तथा ब्राह्मणोंके हितके लिये मैं अवतार ग्रहण करूँगा।
verses.wordMeaning: The greatness of yours has been glorified in accor- dance with what we know according to our capacity. Your reality and principles cannot be enumerated; you are the supreme soul who cannot be easily crossed.

verses.transliteration: namo 'kṛtyāya kṛtyāya muṇḍāya kīkaṭāya ca nama unmattadehāya kiṅkiṇīkāya vai namaḥ
verses.translation: The greatness of yours has been glorified in accor- dance with what we know according to our capacity. Your reality and principles cannot be enumerated; you are the supreme soul who cannot be easily crossed.

verses.commentary: Sense: The greatness of yours has been glorified in accor- dance with what we know according to our capacity. Your reality and principles cannot be enumerated; you are the supreme soul who cannot be easily crossed.

verses.transliteration: namo vikṛtaveṣāya krūrāyāmarṣaṇāya ca aprameyāya goptre ca dīptāyānirguṇāya ca
verses.translation: The greatness of yours has been glorified in accor- dance with what we know according to our capacity. Your reality and principles cannot be enumerated; you are the supreme soul who cannot be easily crossed.

verses.translation: The greatness of yours has been glorified in accor- dance with what we know according to our capacity. Your reality and principles cannot be enumerated; you are the supreme soul who cannot be easily crossed.

verses.wordMeaning: The greatness of yours has been glorified in accor- dance with what we know according to our capacity. Your reality and principles cannot be enumerated; you are the supreme soul who cannot be easily crossed.

verses.translation: The greatness of yours has been glorified in accor- dance with what we know according to our capacity. Your reality and principles cannot be enumerated; you are the supreme soul who cannot be easily crossed.
verses.hindi: पुन: आठवें द्वापरके अन्तमें जब ' वसिष्ठ' नामक व्यास होंगे, तब दधिवाहन नामसे मैं अवतरित होऊंगा  उस समय भी कपिल, आसुरि, पंचशिखमुनि तथा चार पुत्र होंगे, जिनके सदृश महान् योगी भूतलपर कोई नहीं होगा। वे धर्मात्मा तथा महान् ओजस्वी पुत्र भी माहेश्वर योगमें सिद्ध होकर ज्ञानसम्पन्न और पापमुक्त हो मेरे सान्निध्यको प्राप्त होंगे, जहाँसे जीवका पुन:
verses.wordMeaning: The greatness of yours has been glorified in accor- dance with what we know according to our capacity. Your reality and principles cannot be enumerated; you are the supreme soul who cannot be easily crossed.
verses.commentary: Sense: The greatness of yours has been glorified in accor- dance with what we know according to our capacity. Your reality and principles cannot be enumerated; you are the supreme soul who cannot be easily crossed.

verses.sanskrit: अत्यन्तावनतौ दृष्ट्वा मधुपिङ्गायतेक्षणः प्रहृष्टवदनो ऽत्यर्थम् अभवत्सत्यकीर्तनात्
verses.transliteration: atyantāvanatau dṛṣṭvā madhupiṅgāyatekṣaṇaḥ prahṛṣṭavadano 'tyartham abhavatsatyakīrtanāt
verses.translation: On seeing both of them extremely humble, the lord of Uma with eyes tawny as honey, was much delighted, thanks to the exposition of truth. The threc-eyed, the pinaka-bearing, and the trident-holder lord Siva, the destroyer ofDaksa's sacri- fice became very glad.
verses.hindi: आगमन (जन्म) नहीं होता है॥ ३९-४२/२॥ नौवें द्वापरके अन्तमें जब 'सारस्वत' नामके व्यास होंगे, तब मैं भी ऋषभनामसे अवतीर्ण होऊँगा। उस
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing both of them extremely humble, the lord of Uma with eyes tawny as honey, was much delighted, thanks to the exposition of truth. The threc-eyed, the pinaka-bearing, and the trident-holder lord Siva, the destroyer ofDaksa's sacri- fice became very glad.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing both of them extremely humble, the lord of Uma with eyes tawny as honey, was much delighted, thanks to the exposition of truth. The threc-eyed, the pinaka-bearing, and the trident-holder lord Siva, the destroyer ofDaksa's sacri- fice became very glad.

verses.sanskrit: उमापतिर्विरूपाक्षो दक्षयज्ञविनाशनः पिनाकी खण्डपरशुः सुप्रीतस्तु त्रिलोचनः
verses.transliteration: umāpatirvirūpākṣo dakṣayajñavināśanaḥ pinākī khaṇḍaparaśuḥ suprītastu trilocanaḥ
verses.translation: On hearing their nectar like words lord Siva sportingly asked them though he knew their intentions.
verses.hindi: चार पुत्र होंगे, जो महान् ओजस्वी, ब्रह्मनिष्ठ, वेदोंके प्रकार ध्यानमार्गको प्राप्त होकर इस लोकसे प्रस्थान करेंगे। तपोबलमें उत्कृष्ट, शाप-अनुग्रहके पूर्ण विद्वान् एवं तपोत्रती वे सभी पुत्र भी पूर्वोक्त उसी योगमार्गका आश्रय लेकर रुद्रलोकको प्राप्त होंगे, जहाँसे पुनः
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing their nectar like words lord Siva sportingly asked them though he knew their intentions.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing their nectar like words lord Siva sportingly asked them though he knew their intentions.

verses.sanskrit: ततः स भगवान्देवः श्रुत्वा वागमृतं तयोः जानन्नपि महादेवः क्रीडापूर्वमथाब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sa bhagavāndevaḥ śrutvā vāgamṛtaṃ tayoḥ jānannapi mahādevaḥ krīḍāpūrvamathābravīt
verses.translation: "Who are you noble souls eagerly yearning for each other's welfare? You lotus-eyed ones have somehow met together in this terribly extensive flood."
verses.hindi: आगमन नहीं होता है॥ ४३--४७॥ दसवें द्वापरके अन्तमें जब त्रिपाद् नामक विप्ररूप व्यास होंगे, तब मैं भृगुमुनिके रूपमें पर्वतोंमें उत्तम हिमालयके रमणीक भृगुतुंग नामक श्रेष्ठ पर्वत-शिखरपर अवतीर्ण होऊँगा। वह शिखर मेरे ही नामपर
verses.wordMeaning: "Who are you noble souls eagerly yearning for each other's welfare? You lotus-eyed ones have somehow met together in this terribly extensive flood."
verses.commentary: Sense: "Who are you noble souls eagerly yearning for each other's welfare? You lotus-eyed ones have somehow met together in this terribly extensive flood."

verses.sanskrit: कौ भवन्तौ महात्मानौ परस्परहितैषिणौ समेतावंबुजाभक्षाव् अस्मिन् घोरे महाप्लवे
verses.transliteration: kau bhavantau mahātmānau parasparahitaiṣiṇau sametāvaṃbujābhakṣāv asmin ghore mahāplave
verses.translation: I am delighted by your devotion couched in words of perpetual value. Both of you are endearing to my heart.
verses.hindi: “भृगुतुंग' नामसे प्रसिद्ध होगा तथा देवताओंद्वारा पूजित होगा उस समय भी बलबन्धु, निरामित्र, केतुश्रंग तथा
verses.wordMeaning: I am delighted by your devotion couched in words of perpetual value. Both of you are endearing to my heart.
verses.commentary: Sense: I am delighted by your devotion couched in words of perpetual value. Both of you are endearing to my heart.

verses.sanskrit: तावूचतुर्महात्मानौ संनिरीक्ष्य परस्परम् भगवान् किं तु यत्ते ऽद्य न विज्ञानं त्वया विभो
verses.transliteration: tāvūcaturmahātmānau saṃnirīkṣya parasparam bhagavān kiṃ tu yatte 'dya na vijñānaṃ tvayā vibho
verses.translation: What shall 1 give you now? Which is sweeter boon you desire?** Then the blessed lord Vi§nu spoke to lord Siva:

verses.translation: O lofd! everything has been granted by you. If you are so pleased with me, O lord! grant that my devotion for you remains stable.

verses.commentary: Sense: O lofd! everything has been granted by you. If you are so pleased with me, O lord! grant that my devotion for you remains stable.

verses.sanskrit: उवाच भगवान्देवो मधुरं श्लक्ष्णया गिरा भो भो हिरण्यगर्भ त्वां त्वां च कृष्ण ब्रवीम्यहम्
verses.transliteration: uvāca bhagavāndevo madhuraṃ ślakṣṇayā girā bho bho hiraṇyagarbha tvāṃ tvāṃ ca kṛṣṇa bravīmyaham
verses.translation: On being requested thus lord Siva realised it. He honoured Visnu and granted him devotion to his lotus-feet.
verses.hindi: उग्रो नाम महातेजाः सर्वलोकेषु विश्रुतः। तत्रापि मम ते पुत्रा भविष्यन्ति महौजसः लम्बोदरश्च लम्बाक्षो लम्बकेशः प्रलम्बकः। प्राप्य माहेश्वरं योगं रुद्रलोकं गता हि ते
verses.wordMeaning: On being requested thus lord Siva realised it. He honoured Visnu and granted him devotion to his lotus-feet.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being requested thus lord Siva realised it. He honoured Visnu and granted him devotion to his lotus-feet.

verses.sanskrit: प्रीतो ऽहमनया भक्त्या शाश्वताक्षरयुक्तया भवन्तौ हृदयस्यास्य मम हृद्यतरावुभौ
verses.transliteration: prīto 'hamanayā bhaktyā śāśvatākṣarayuktayā bhavantau hṛdayasyāsya mama hṛdyatarāvubhau
verses.translation: "You are the creator of this world. You are its presi- ding deity. Hail unto you, O dear, O lotus-eyed lord, 1 shall go (now)
verses.hindi: द्वादशे परिवर्ते तु शततेजा यदा मुनिः। भविष्यति महातेजा व्यासस्तु कविसत्तमः तदाप्यहं भविष्यामि कलाविह युगान्तिके । हैतुकं वनमासाद्य अत्रिर्नाम्ना परिश्रुतः
verses.wordMeaning: "You are the creator of this world. You are its presi- ding deity. Hail unto you, O dear, O lotus-eyed lord, 1 shall go (now)

verses.sanskrit: युवाभ्यां किं ददाम्यद्य वराणां वरमीप्सितम् अथोवाच महाभागो विष्णुर्भवमिदं वचः
verses.transliteration: yuvābhyāṃ kiṃ dadāmyadya varāṇāṃ varamīpsitam athovāca mahābhāgo viṣṇurbhavamidaṃ vacaḥ
verses.translation: After saying this the great lord blessed Brahma too. Greatly delighted he patted Brahma with his auspicious hands and said:--"0 dear, surely you are equal to me. You are my devotee too. Hail unto you. I shall leave now, O deity of good rites, may there be perfect awareness in you.*'
verses.hindi: भविष्यन्ति महायोगा रुद्रलोकपरायणा: प्राप्य माहेश्वरं योगं रुद्रलोकं गता हि ते

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्तस्तु विज्ञाय संभावयत केशवम् प्रददौ च महादेवो भक्तिं निजपदांबुजे
verses.transliteration: evamuktastu vijñāya saṃbhāvayata keśavam pradadau ca mahādevo bhaktiṃ nijapadāṃbuje
verses.translation: After a great deal of linic his misery turned into anger. From the eyes overwhelmed with anger drops of tears fell down. From those drops of tears, huge poisonous snakes appeared. They had all the three humours, the wind, bile and phlegm. They were highly blessed; they were adorned with Svastika marks. I'heir hairs were dishevelled and scattered. On seeing the snakes born at the outset Brahma censured himself.
verses.hindi: सुधामा काश्यपश्चैव वासिष्ठो विरजास्तथा प्राप्य माहेश्वरं योगं रुद्रलोकं गता हि ते
verses.wordMeaning: After a great deal of linic his misery turned into anger. From the eyes overwhelmed with anger drops of tears fell down. From those drops of tears, huge poisonous snakes appeared. They had all the three humours, the wind, bile and phlegm. They were highly blessed;…
verses.commentary: Sense: After a great deal of linic his misery turned into anger. From the eyes overwhelmed with anger drops of tears fell down. From those drops of tears, huge poisonous snakes appeared. They had all the three humours, the wind, bile and phlegm. They were highly blessed;…

verses.sanskrit: भवान्सर्वस्य लोकस्य कर्ता त्वमधिदैवतम् तदेवं स्वस्ति ते वत्स गमिष्याम्यंबुजेक्षण
verses.transliteration: bhavānsarvasya lokasya kartā tvamadhidaivatam tadevaṃ svasti te vatsa gamiṣyāmyaṃbujekṣaṇa
verses.translation: O fie upon the fruit of my penance of this sort, if it were to be like this. Even in the beginning, my progeny has become the destroyer of the world.
verses.hindi: तत्रापि पुनरेवाहं भविष्यामि युगान्तिके अत्रिर्देबसदश्चैव श्रवणोऽथ श्रविष्ठकः॥
verses.wordMeaning: O fie upon the fruit of my penance of this sort, if it were to be like this. Even in the beginning, my progeny has become the destroyer of the world.
verses.commentary: Sense: O fie upon the fruit of my penance of this sort, if it were to be like this. Even in the beginning, my progeny has become the destroyer of the world.

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्त्वा तु भगवान् ब्रह्माणं चापि शङ्करः अनुगृह्यास्पृशद्देवो ब्रह्माणं परमेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: evamuktvā tu bhagavān brahmāṇaṃ cāpi śaṅkaraḥ anugṛhyāspṛśaddevo brahmāṇaṃ parameśvaraḥ
verses.translation: Originating from anger and fury a severe loss of sense overwhelmed him. Out of the distress resulting from his loss of sense, he lost his life. From the body of Brahma of unequalled valour, the eleven Rudras® sprang up crying, out of sympathy and mercy.
verses.hindi: प्राप्य माहेश्वरं योगं रुद्रलोकाय ते गताः तदाप्यहं भविष्यामि नाम्ता वेदशिरा द्विजः। तत्र वेदशिरो नाम अस्त्रं तत्पारमेश्वरम्
verses.wordMeaning: Originating from anger and fury a severe loss of sense overwhelmed him. Out of the distress resulting from his loss of sense, he lost his life. From the body of Brahma of unequalled valour, the eleven Rudras® sprang up crying, out of sympathy and mercy.
verses.commentary: Sense: Originating from anger and fury a severe loss of sense overwhelmed him. Out of the distress resulting from his loss of sense, he lost his life. From the body of Brahma of unequalled valour, the eleven Rudras® sprang up crying, out of sympathy and mercy.

verses.transliteration: svastyastu te gamiṣyāmi saṃjñā bhavatu suvrata evamuktvā tu bhagavāṃs tato 'ntardhānamīśvaraḥ

verses.sanskrit: गतवान् गणपो देवः सर्वदेवनमस्कृतः अवाप्य संज्ञां गोविन्दात् पद्मयोनिः पितामहः
verses.transliteration: gatavān gaṇapo devaḥ sarvadevanamaskṛtaḥ avāpya saṃjñāṃ govindāt padmayoniḥ pitāmahaḥ
verses.translation: The pranas are stationed in all living beings. The trident- bearing lord Siva who enforces strict discipline granted him life again. After obtaining life> lord Brahma saluted lord Siva, the lord of Devas. By means of Gayatri he perceived him as identical with the universe. On seeing and eulogizing him as such, Brahma was struck with wonder. Bowing to him again and again, he proclaimed: "O lord! how is it that you have assumed such forms as Sadyojata and others."
verses.hindi: पुनः क्रमसे तेरहवें द्वापरयुगका अन्त आनेपर जब धर्मरूप 'नारायण' नामक व्यास होंगे, उस समय भी मैं गन्धमादन पर्वतपर पवित्र बालखिल्य आश्रममें महामुनि “बालि' नामसे अवतरित होऊँगा उस समय भी सुधामा, काश्यप, वासिष्ठ तथा
verses.wordMeaning: The pranas are stationed in all living beings. The trident- bearing lord Siva who enforces strict discipline granted him life again. After obtaining life> lord Brahma saluted lord Siva, the lord of Devas. By means of Gayatri he perceived him as identical with the universe.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The pranas are stationed in all living beings. The trident- bearing lord Siva who enforces strict discipline granted him life again. After obtaining life> lord Brahma saluted lord Siva, the lord of Devas. By means of Gayatri he perceived him as identical with the universe.…

verses.sanskrit: प्रजाः स्रष्टुमनाश्चक्रे तप उग्रं पितामहः तस्यैवं तप्यमानस्य न किंचित् समवर्तत
verses.transliteration: prajāḥ sraṣṭumanāścakre tapa ugraṃ pitāmahaḥ tasyaivaṃ tapyamānasya na kiṃcit samavartata
verses.translation: When the Sveta kalpa was current, it was I who existed then. I had white turban, white garlands and white garments. I was white myself with white bones, white hairs, white blood and white complexion So the kalpa too was known as Svetakalpa. Gayatri, the goddess of Devas, born of me, had white limbs, white colour, white blood. She was known as Brahmanl.
verses.hindi: महायोगसे सम्पन्न, विशुद्धात्मा एवं नैष्ठिक ब्रह्मचारी होंगे और माहेश्वरयोगको प्राप्त होकर रुद्रलोक जायेगे चौदहवें द्वापरके अन्तमें जब ' तरक्षु' नामक व्यास होंगे, उस समय भी मैं अंगिरामुनिके उत्तम वंशमें गौतम नामसे अवतार ग्रहण करूँगा और वह स्थान परम पवित्र 'गौतमवन' नामसे प्रसिद्ध होगा
verses.wordMeaning: When the Sveta kalpa was current, it was I who existed then. I had white turban, white garlands and white garments. I was white myself with white bones, white hairs, white blood and white complexion So the kalpa too was known as Svetakalpa. Gayatri, the goddess of Devas,…
verses.commentary: Sense: When the Sveta kalpa was current, it was I who existed then. I had white turban, white garlands and white garments. I was white myself with white bones, white hairs, white blood and white complexion So the kalpa too was known as Svetakalpa. Gayatri, the goddess of Devas,…

verses.sanskrit: ततो दीर्घेण कालेन दुःखात्क्रोधो ह्यजायत क्रोधाविष्टस्य नेत्राभ्यां प्रापतन्नश्रुबिन्दवः
verses.transliteration: tato dīrgheṇa kālena duḥkhātkrodho hyajāyata krodhāviṣṭasya netrābhyāṃ prāpatannaśrubindavaḥ
verses.translation: O lord of Devas, that was why 1 had been understood by you as the secret deity. By my penance 1 had assumed the form of Sadyojata.
verses.hindi: उस कलिमें भी अत्रि, देवसद, श्रवण तथा महान् आत्मावाले और योगयुक्त पुत्र माहेश्‍वरयोगमें सिद्ध होकर रुद्रलोकको प्राप्त होंगे
verses.wordMeaning: O lord of Devas, that was why 1 had been understood by you as the secret deity. By my penance 1 had assumed the form of Sadyojata.
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord of Devas, that was why 1 had been understood by you as the secret deity. By my penance 1 had assumed the form of Sadyojata.

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तेभ्यो ऽश्रुबिन्दुभ्यो वातपित्तकफात्मकाः महाभागा महासत्त्वाः स्वस्तिकैरप्यलंकृताः
verses.transliteration: tatastebhyo 'śrubindubhyo vātapittakaphātmakāḥ mahābhāgā mahāsattvāḥ svastikairapyalaṃkṛtāḥ
verses.translation: When the yuga gradually changed and I became yellow in colour, the kalpa was known as Pita — the name assigned by me. Gayatri, the goddess of Devas born of me was named Brahmani. She was yellow in body, yellow in blood and yellow in colour.
verses.hindi: पुनः क्रमसे पन्द्रहवें द्वापका अन्त होनेपर द्विजरूप “वेदशिरा' नामसे मैं अवतार ग्रहण करूँगा।
verses.wordMeaning: When the yuga gradually changed and I became yellow in colour, the kalpa was known as Pita — the name assigned by me. Gayatri, the goddess of Devas born of me was named Brahmani. She was yellow in body, yellow in blood and yellow in colour.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the yuga gradually changed and I became yellow in colour, the kalpa was known as Pita — the name assigned by me. Gayatri, the goddess of Devas born of me was named Brahmani. She was yellow in body, yellow in blood and yellow in colour.

verses.sanskrit: प्रकीर्णकेशाः सर्पास्ते प्रादुर्भूता महाविषाः सर्पांस्तानग्रजान्दृष्ट्वा ब्रह्मात्मानम् अनिन्दयत्
verses.transliteration: prakīrṇakeśāḥ sarpāste prādurbhūtā mahāviṣāḥ sarpāṃstānagrajāndṛṣṭvā brahmātmānam anindayat
verses.translation: O deity of great strength, there too, I was realized by yogins devoted to the practice of yoga, through your yogic mind. I was realized by you in the form ofTatpu- rusa. Hence, it was, O deity born of the golden egg, I got the Tatpurusa form. Persons endowed with penance, devoid of impurities, who are in contact with Brahman and who know me as Rudra, and Rudrani as Gayatri — the mother of the Vedas go to Rudra's world whence there is no return.
verses.hindi: श्रीलिड्ठुमहापुराण  पूर्वभाग १ ९ है. फ्रफ्रफ्रफ्रफ््रफ्फफ्रफ््फफ्फफ्रफक्रक्रफ्रफक्रफाक््फ्क्रफफफफफफफ फफ ७७७ 1111111 षष फ

verses.sanskrit: अहो धिक् तपसो मह्यं फलमीदृशकं यदि लोकवैनाशिकी जज्ञे आदावेव प्रजा मम
verses.transliteration: aho dhik tapaso mahyaṃ phalamīdṛśakaṃ yadi lokavaināśikī jajñe ādāveva prajā mama
verses.translation: When I became terrible and black in colour the kalpa was known as Krsna after the colour assumed by me. There I resemble Kala (god of death). I amKala (Time), the reckoner of the worlds. O Brahma, I was then known by you as Ghora (the terrible) with terrible exploits. O lord of Devas, Gayatri, born of me, was black in body, black in blood, black in form and was named Brahmani. Hence to those who know me that I have assumed the ghora form, I, the changeless one, shall be Aghora (non-terrible) and Santa (quiescent). O Brahma, when I assumed the universal form I was realized by you by means of the yogic trance. Gayatri, the
verses.hindi: हिमवत्पृष्ठमासाद्य सरस्वत्यां नगोत्तमे॥ ६९  प्रकट करूंगा और पर्वतोंमें श्रेष्ठ हिमालयके पृष्ठदेशमे सरस्वतीके तटपर वेदशीर्ष नामक पर्वत मेरा आश्रयस्थल प्राप्य माहेश्वरं योगं रुद्रलोकाय ते गताः॥ ७१  महात्मा एवं नैष्ठिक ब्रह्मचर्यव्रतका पालन करनेवाले वे व्यासो युगे षोडशे तु यदा देवो भविष्यति। सभी पुत्र माहेश्‍वरयोगकी सिद्धि करके शिवलोकको
verses.wordMeaning: When I became terrible and black in colour the kalpa was known as Krsna after the colour assumed by me. There I resemble Kala (god of death). I amKala (Time), the reckoner of the worlds. O Brahma, I was then known by you as Ghora (the terrible) with terrible exploits.…
verses.commentary: Sense: When I became terrible and black in colour the kalpa was known as Krsna after the colour assumed by me. There I resemble Kala (god of death). I amKala (Time), the reckoner of the worlds. O Brahma, I was then known by you as Ghora (the terrible) with terrible exploits.…

verses.sanskrit: तस्य तीव्राभवन्मूर्च्छा क्रोधामर्षसमुद्भवा मूर्च्छाभिपरितापेन जहौ प्राणान्प्रजापतिः
verses.transliteration: tasya tīvrābhavanmūrcchā krodhāmarṣasamudbhavā mūrcchābhiparitāpena jahau prāṇānprajāpatiḥ
verses.translation: These four who are of all kinds of forms will be- come popular as my sons. Since they are of different colours, their subjects too will be of different colours or castes ( Varnas), and allowed the use of Gayatri. Man's aim of life will be four- fold: virtue, wealth, desire and liberation. All living beings will come under four groups®*, four stages of life. The feet of Dharma will be four®® since my sons are four in number.
verses.hindi: सोलहवें द्वापरके अन्तमें जब देव नामक व्यास तदाप्यहं भविष्यामि गोकर्णो नाम नामतः। ता गोकर्ण होंगे, तब भक्तों तथा संयत आत्मावाले जनोंको योग पण्य च गोकण नाम तदगम॥ ७३ प्रदान करनेके निमित्त मैं गोकर्ण नामसे अवतार लूँगा
verses.wordMeaning: These four who are of all kinds of forms will be- come popular as my sons. Since they are of different colours, their subjects too will be of different colours or castes ( Varnas), and allowed the use of Gayatri. Man's aim of life will be four- fold: virtue, wealth,…
verses.commentary: Sense: These four who are of all kinds of forms will be- come popular as my sons. Since they are of different colours, their subjects too will be of different colours or castes ( Varnas), and allowed the use of Gayatri. Man's aim of life will be four- fold: virtue, wealth,…

verses.sanskrit: तस्याप्रतिमवीर्यस्य देहात्कारुण्यपूर्वकम् अथैकादश ते रुद्रा रुदन्तो ऽभ्यक्रमंस् तथा
verses.transliteration: tasyāpratimavīryasya dehātkāruṇyapūrvakam athaikādaśa te rudrā rudanto 'bhyakramaṃs tathā
verses.translation: Hence the universe consisting of the mobile and im- mobile beings is stationed in the four yugas. Since it is stationed in the.four yugas it shall have four feet. There are eight worlds: Bhuh, Bhuvah, Svar, Mahar, Janar, Tapas, Satya and Visnu. These are established in the eight substratums each of which is imperishable. Bhuh, Bhuvah, Svar and Mahah constitute the four substratums.
verses.hindi: और वह स्थान परम पवित्र गोकर्णवनके नामसे प्रसिद्ध काश्यपो ह्युशनाश्चैव च्यवनोऽथ बृहस्पति: उस समय भी काश्यप, उशना, च्यवन तथा प्राप्य माहेश्वरं योगं गन्तारो रुद्रमेव हि॥ ७५  बृहस्पति नामक मेरे चार महायोगी पुत्र होंगे। वे भी
verses.wordMeaning: Hence the universe consisting of the mobile and im- mobile beings is stationed in the four yugas. Since it is stationed in the.four yugas it shall have four feet. There are eight worlds: Bhuh, Bhuvah, Svar, Mahar, Janar, Tapas, Satya and Visnu.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence the universe consisting of the mobile and im- mobile beings is stationed in the four yugas. Since it is stationed in the.four yugas it shall have four feet. There are eight worlds: Bhuh, Bhuvah, Svar, Mahar, Janar, Tapas, Satya and Visnu.…

verses.sanskrit: रोदनात्खलु रुद्रत्वं तेषु वै समजायत ये रुद्रास्ते खलु प्राणा ये प्राणास्ते तदात्मकाः
verses.transliteration: rodanātkhalu rudratvaṃ teṣu vai samajāyata ye rudrāste khalu prāṇā ye prāṇāste tadātmakāḥ
verses.translation: The first is Bhuh, the second Biiuvoi *c third ovar and Mahar is the fourth.
verses.hindi: उसी मार्गसे ध्यानयोगसे युक्त होकर माहेश्वरयोग प्राप्त यदा भविष्यति व्यासो नाम्ना देवकृतञ्जयः करके रुद्रलोक जायेगे
verses.wordMeaning: The first is Bhuh, the second Biiuvoi *c third ovar and Mahar is the fourth.
verses.commentary: Sense: The first is Bhuh, the second Biiuvoi *c third ovar and Mahar is the fourth.

verses.transliteration: prāṇāḥ prāṇavatāṃ jñeyāḥ sarvabhūteṣvavasthitāḥ atyugrasya mahattvasya sādhurācaritasya ca
verses.translation: The fifth is Janah, the sixth Tapa ■ seventh Satya whence people do not return to this world. The world of Visnu is the eighth. It is also the spot whence a retun to this world is difficult. Beyond that is the world of Skandha an i Uma endow- ed with all attainments. Beyond that is the world of Rudra — the splendid region of yogins. The twice-born who are dt v i of ego, who have neither lust nor anger and whosf j.iuuls are devoted to yoga alone can enter it. verses.sanskrit: प्राणांस्तस्य ददौ भूयस् त्रिशूली नीललोहितः लब्ध्वासून् भगवान्ब्रह्म देवदेवमुमापतिम्
verses.transliteration: prāṇāṃstasya dadau bhūyas triśūlī nīlalohitaḥ labdhvāsūn bhagavānbrahma devadevamumāpatim
verses.translation: The four feet of righteousness, according to ST. comprise daya (compassion), dSnam (charity), tapah (penance), satyam (truth).
verses.hindi: अवतीर्ण होऊँगा । वह महालयस्थल परम पवित्र तथा सिद्धक्षेत्र माना जायगा। वहाँपर भी उतथ्य, वामदेव, उतथ्यो वामदेवश्च महायोगो महाबलः
verses.wordMeaning: The four feet of righteousness, according to ST. comprise daya (compassion), dSnam (charity), tapah (penance), satyam (truth).
verses.commentary: Sense: The four feet of righteousness, according to ST. comprise daya (compassion), dSnam (charity), tapah (penance), satyam (truth).

verses.sanskrit: प्रणम्य संस्थितो ऽपश्यद् गायत्र्या विश्वमीश्वरम् सर्वलोकमयं देवं दृष्ट्वा स्तुत्वा पितामहः
verses.transliteration: praṇamya saṃsthito 'paśyad gāyatryā viśvamīśvaram sarvalokamayaṃ devaṃ dṛṣṭvā stutvā pitāmahaḥ
verses.translation: Since the Soma-juice, which is the life of living beings, accompanied by Vedic chants, fell off from my mouth, the cows came to be known as those whose udders are sucked. Hence the nectar in the form of the Soma-juice is known as the life of living beings. Hence too, the animals became quadru- peds; the whiteness of their milk is also due to that. Since the great Goddess was seen as biped in the course of the rites, Gayatri the creator of the worlds is also of the same nature. Hence all human beings are bipeds, endowed with two breasts. Since the great godde.ss, the unborn deity of great strength, was seen by you as supporting all living beings, therefore, the subjects will have all kinds of form.
verses.hindi: योगवेत्ता, ब्रह्मवादी, महात्मा, मोहरहित तथा अहंकारशून्य कलियुगमें उन पुत्रोंके ध्यानयोग करनेवाले हजारों शिष्य होंगे। ध्यान करनेवाले तथा योगाभ्यासपरायण वे सभी शिष्य महेश्वरको हृदयमें धारण करके महालय- क्षेत्रमे मेरे चरणोंका दर्शन करके शिवपदको प्राप्त
verses.wordMeaning: Since the Soma-juice, which is the life of living beings, accompanied by Vedic chants, fell off from my mouth, the cows came to be known as those whose udders are sucked. Hence the nectar in the form of the Soma-juice is known as the life of living beings. Hence too,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Since the Soma-juice, which is the life of living beings, accompanied by Vedic chants, fell off from my mouth, the cows came to be known as those whose udders are sucked. Hence the nectar in the form of the Soma-juice is known as the life of living beings. Hence too,…

verses.sanskrit: ततो विस्मयमापन्नः प्रणिपत्य मुहुर्मुहुः उवाच वचनं शर्वं सद्यादित्वं कथं विभो
verses.transliteration: tato vismayamāpannaḥ praṇipatya muhurmuhuḥ uvāca vacanaṃ śarvaṃ sadyāditvaṃ kathaṃ vibho
verses.translation: The unborn deity shall have great splendour and universal form and from his face there will come out the fire*God whose energy will be unfailing. Hence, the pure and all-pervading fire-god has the form of living body. The pure- souled men of two births who see me as endowed with the faculties of overlordship, sense-control and omnipresence become liberated from rajas and tamas. Eschewing physical bdy they attain my vicinity and never return to this earth.
verses.hindi: इनके अतिरिक्त अन्य जो भी महात्मा उस द्वापरके अन्तमें कलिमें अपना मन ध्यानमें लगाकर निर्मल आत्मा तथा शुद्ध बुद्धिवाले हो जायँगे, वे शोकरहितं होकर मेरे अनुग्रहसे रुद्रलोकको प्राप्त होंगे। पुण्यप्रद भविष्यन्ति तदा काले सर्वे ते ध्यानयुञ्जका:
verses.wordMeaning: The unborn deity shall have great splendour and universal form and from his face there will come out the fire*God whose energy will be unfailing. Hence, the pure and all-pervading fire-god has the form of living body.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The unborn deity shall have great splendour and universal form and from his face there will come out the fire*God whose energy will be unfailing. Hence, the pure and all-pervading fire-god has the form of living body.…

verses.sanskrit: तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा ब्रह्मणो भगवान् भवः ब्रह्मरूपी प्रबोधार्थं ब्रह्माणं प्राह सस्मितम्
verses.transliteration: tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā brahmaṇo bhagavān bhavaḥ brahmarūpī prabodhārthaṃ brahmāṇaṃ prāha sasmitam
verses.translation: When the Sveta kalpa was current, it was 1 who existed 'then. I had white turban, white garlands and white garments. I was white myself with white bones, white hairs, white blood and white complexion So the kalpa too was known as Svetakalpa.
verses.hindi: महालये पदं न्यस्तं दृष्ट्वा यान्ति शिवं पदम् ये चान्येऽपि महात्मान: कलौ तस्मिन् युगान्तिके।
verses.wordMeaning: When the Sveta kalpa was current, it was 1 who existed 'then. I had white turban, white garlands and white garments. I was white myself with white bones, white hairs, white blood and white complexion So the kalpa too was known as Svetakalpa.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the Sveta kalpa was current, it was 1 who existed 'then. I had white turban, white garlands and white garments. I was white myself with white bones, white hairs, white blood and white complexion So the kalpa too was known as Svetakalpa.

verses.sanskrit: श्वेतकल्पो यदा ह्यासीद् अहमेव तदाभवम् श्वेतोष्णीषः श्वेतमाल्यः श्वेतांबरधरः सितः
verses.transliteration: śvetakalpo yadā hyāsīd ahameva tadābhavam śvetoṣṇīṣaḥ śvetamālyaḥ śvetāṃbaradharaḥ sitaḥ
verses.translation: Gayatri, the goddess ol Devas, born of me, had white limbs, white colour, white blood. She was known as Brahmani.
verses.hindi: मम प्रसादाद्यास्यन्ति रुद्रलोकं गतज्चराः। गत्वा महालयं पुण्यं दृष्ट्वा माहेश्वरं पदम् श्वेतवाराहकल्पके अट्टाईस द्वापरोंके अन्तमें प्रकट होनेवाले व्यासोंका वर्णन
verses.wordMeaning: Gayatri, the goddess ol Devas, born of me, had white limbs, white colour, white blood. She was known as Brahmani.
verses.commentary: Sense: Gayatri, the goddess ol Devas, born of me, had white limbs, white colour, white blood. She was known as Brahmani.

verses.sanskrit: श्वेतास्थिः श्वेतरोमा च श्वेतासृक् श्वेतलोहितः तेन नाम्ना च विख्यातः श्वेतकल्पस्तदा ह्यसौ
verses.transliteration: śvetāsthiḥ śvetaromā ca śvetāsṛk śvetalohitaḥ tena nāmnā ca vikhyātaḥ śvetakalpastadā hyasau
verses.translation: O lord of Devas, that was why I liad been understood by you as the secret deity. By my penance 1 had assumed the form of Sadyojata.
verses.hindi: फफफफफफ So पफ पा फ फा क क फा का फा का फ फा फ फ़ फ फा कक जका फ फफ फा फ फा फा कका क जफमफकफफफफफफफफफफफफकफफ फफफ फफफ फफफ फफ फक्क फ फफ फफफ फ फ क्क मम प्रसादाद्यास्यन्ति रुद्रलोकं गतज्चराः। ततोऽष्टादशमे चैव परिवतें यदा विभो
verses.wordMeaning: O lord of Devas, that was why I liad been understood by you as the secret deity. By my penance 1 had assumed the form of Sadyojata.
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord of Devas, that was why I liad been understood by you as the secret deity. By my penance 1 had assumed the form of Sadyojata.

verses.sanskrit: मत्प्रसूता च देवेशी श्वेताङ्गा श्वेतलोहिता श्वेतवर्णा तदा ह्यासीद् गायत्री ब्रह्मसंज्ञिता
verses.transliteration: matprasūtā ca deveśī śvetāṅgā śvetalohitā śvetavarṇā tadā hyāsīd gāyatrī brahmasaṃjñitā
verses.translation: The title Sadyojaia is a secret Brahma; the twice- born who know me, who have assumed secret nature, shall attain nearness to me whence there is no return.
verses.hindi: तदा ऋतञ्जयो नाम व्यासस्तु भविता मुनिः। तदाप्यहं भविष्यामि शिखण्डी नाम नामतः सिद्धक्षेत्रे महापुण्ये देवदानवपूजिते। हिमवच्छिखरे रम्ये शिखण्डी नाम पर्वत:
verses.wordMeaning: The title Sadyojaia is a secret Brahma; the twice- born who know me, who have assumed secret nature, shall attain nearness to me whence there is no return.
verses.commentary: Sense: The title Sadyojaia is a secret Brahma; the twice- born who know me, who have assumed secret nature, shall attain nearness to me whence there is no return.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मादहं च देवेश त्वया गुह्येन वै पुनः विज्ञातः स्वेन तपसा सद्योजातत्वमागतः
verses.transliteration: tasmādahaṃ ca deveśa tvayā guhyena vai punaḥ vijñātaḥ svena tapasā sadyojātatvamāgataḥ
verses.translation: When the next kalpa known as lohita, as a result of my colour, came, Gayatri glorified as a cow, born with red flesh, red bone, red blood, red milk, red eyes and red udders was known as Brahman!. Since the colour was changed into red and since the lord was Varna, 1 was known as Vamadeva. O deity of great strength, then also 1, who was in a different colour, was recognised by you who had practised sell-control by resorting to yoga. I was then known as Vamadeva. The twice-born who realise my Vamadeva form shall go to Rudra's world whence there is no return.
verses.hindi: प्राप्य माहेश्वरं योगं रुद्रलोकाय संवृताः। अथ एकोनविंशे तु परिवर्ते क्रमागते व्यासस्तु भविता नाम्ना भरद्वाजो महामुनिः। तदाप्यहं भविष्यामि जटामाली च नामतः
verses.wordMeaning: When the next kalpa known as lohita, as a result of my colour, came, Gayatri glorified as a cow, born with red flesh, red bone, red blood, red milk, red eyes and red udders was known as Brahman!. Since the colour was changed into red and since the lord was Varna,…
verses.commentary: Sense: When the next kalpa known as lohita, as a result of my colour, came, Gayatri glorified as a cow, born with red flesh, red bone, red blood, red milk, red eyes and red udders was known as Brahman!. Since the colour was changed into red and since the lord was Varna,…

verses.sanskrit: सद्योजातेति ब्रह्मैतद् गुह्यं चैतत्प्रकीर्तितम् तस्माद्गुह्यत्वमापन्नं ये वेत्स्यन्ति द्विजातयः
verses.transliteration: sadyojāteti brahmaitad guhyaṃ caitatprakīrtitam tasmādguhyatvamāpannaṃ ye vetsyanti dvijātayaḥ
verses.translation: When the yuga gradually changed and 1 became yellow in colour, the kalpa was known as Pita — the name * N>*gncd by me.
verses.hindi: हिरण्यनाभः कौशल्यो लोकाक्षी कुथुमिस्तथा। ईश्वरा योगधर्माणः सर्वे ते ह्यूर्ध्वरेतस: प्राप्य माहेश्वरं योगं रुद्रलोकाय संस्थिताः । ततो विंशतिमश्चैव परिवर्तो यदा तदा
verses.wordMeaning: When the yuga gradually changed and 1 became yellow in colour, the kalpa was known as Pita — the name * N>*gncd by me.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the yuga gradually changed and 1 became yellow in colour, the kalpa was known as Pita — the name * N>*gncd by me.

verses.sanskrit: मत्समीपं गमिष्यन्ति पुनरावृत्तिदुर्लभम् यदा चैव पुनस्त्वासील् लोहितो नाम नामतः
verses.transliteration: matsamīpaṃ gamiṣyanti punarāvṛttidurlabham yadā caiva punastvāsīl lohito nāma nāmataḥ
verses.translation: Gayatri, the goddess of Devas born of me was named Brahman!. She was yellow in body, yellow in blood and yellow in colour.
verses.hindi: गौतमस्तु तदा व्यासो भविष्यति महामुनिः। तदाप्यहं भविष्यामि अद्टहासस्तु नामतः देबदानवयक्षेन्द्रसिद्धचारणसेवितः तत्रापि मम ते पुत्रा भविष्यन्ति महौजसः
verses.wordMeaning: Gayatri, the goddess of Devas born of me was named Brahman!. She was yellow in body, yellow in blood and yellow in colour.
verses.commentary: Sense: Gayatri, the goddess of Devas born of me was named Brahman!. She was yellow in body, yellow in blood and yellow in colour.

verses.sanskrit: मत्कृतेन च वर्णेन कल्पो वै लोहितः स्मृतः तदा लोहितमांसास्थिलोहितक्षीरसंभवा
verses.transliteration: matkṛtena ca varṇena kalpo vai lohitaḥ smṛtaḥ tadā lohitamāṃsāsthilohitakṣīrasaṃbhavā
verses.translation: O deity of great strength, there too. I was realized by yogins devoted to the practic e' of yoga, through your yogic mind, I was realized by you in the form ofTatpu- rusa. Ilcnce, it was, (> deil> born of the golden egg, 1 got the Tat purusa form Persons endowed with penan((', devoid of impurities, who are in contact with Bnd,nu\n and who know rnc as Rudra, and Riidrani as (jayatri to • mother of the Vedas go to Rudra's world whence there is no icturn.
verses.hindi: महालयक्षेत्रमें जाकर माहेश्वरपदका दर्शन करके प्राणी अपनी दस पूर्वकी तथा दस बादकी और अपनी स्वयं--इस प्रकार इक्कीस पीढ़ियोंका उद्धार कर देता है। इस प्रकार महालयक्षेत्रमें पहुँचकर लोग अपने वंशका उद्धार करके मेरी कृपासे कष्टसे रहित होकर रुद्रलोकको प्राप्त करेंगे॥ ८२--८४ /२॥
verses.wordMeaning: O deity of great strength, there too. I was realized by yogins devoted to the practic e' of yoga, through your yogic mind, I was realized by you in the form ofTatpu- rusa. Ilcnce, it was, (> deil> born of the golden egg, 1 got the Tat purusa form Persons endowed with penan((',…
verses.commentary: Sense: O deity of great strength, there too. I was realized by yogins devoted to the practic e' of yoga, through your yogic mind, I was realized by you in the form ofTatpu- rusa. Ilcnce, it was, (> deil> born of the golden egg, 1 got the Tat purusa form Persons endowed with penan((',…

verses.sanskrit: लोहिताक्षी स्तनवती गायत्री गौः प्रकीर्तिता ततो ऽस्या लोहितत्वेन वर्णस्य च विपर्ययात्
verses.transliteration: lohitākṣī stanavatī gāyatrī gauḥ prakīrtitā tato 'syā lohitatvena varṇasya ca viparyayāt
verses.translation: These four who are of all kinds of forms will be- come popular as my sons. Since they are of different colours, their subjects too will be of different colours or castes ( Varnas), and allowed the use of Gayatri. Man's aim of life will be four- fold: virtue, wealth, desire and liberation. All living beings will come under four groups®*, four stages of life. The feet of Dharma will be four®® since my sons arc four in number.
verses.hindi: हे विभो! पुनः अठारहवें द्वापरके अन्तमें जब ऋतंजयमुनि नामक व्यास होंगे, तब मैं सिद्धिप्रदायक, पुण्यप्रद तथा देव-दानवोंसे पूजित रमणीक हिमालय- शिखरपर शिखण्डी नामसे अवतार ग्रहण करूँगा और वह शिखर मेरे नामसे शिखण्डी पर्वत तथा वह क्षेत्र शिखण्डीका वन कहा जायगा, जहाँ सिद्ध महात्मा निवास करेंगे॥ ८५--८७ /२॥
verses.wordMeaning: These four who are of all kinds of forms will be- come popular as my sons. Since they are of different colours, their subjects too will be of different colours or castes ( Varnas), and allowed the use of Gayatri. Man's aim of life will be four- fold: virtue, wealth,…
verses.commentary: Sense: These four who are of all kinds of forms will be- come popular as my sons. Since they are of different colours, their subjects too will be of different colours or castes ( Varnas), and allowed the use of Gayatri. Man's aim of life will be four- fold: virtue, wealth,…

verses.sanskrit: वामत्वाच्चैव देवस्य वामदेवत्वमागतः तत्रापि च महासत्त्व त्वयाहं नियतात्मना
verses.transliteration: vāmatvāccaiva devasya vāmadevatvamāgataḥ tatrāpi ca mahāsattva tvayāhaṃ niyatātmanā
verses.translation: Hence the universe consisting of the mobile and im- mobile beings is stationed in the four yugas. Since it is stationed in the.four yugas it shall have four feet.
verses.hindi: वहाँपर भी वाचश्रवा, ऋचीक, श्यावाश्व तथा योगात्मा, महात्मा तथा वेदोंके पारगामी विद्वान् होंगे, जो माहेश्वर योगमें सिद्ध होकर रुद्रलोकको प्राप्त
verses.wordMeaning: Hence the universe consisting of the mobile and im- mobile beings is stationed in the four yugas. Since it is stationed in the.four yugas it shall have four feet.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence the universe consisting of the mobile and im- mobile beings is stationed in the four yugas. Since it is stationed in the.four yugas it shall have four feet.

verses.sanskrit: विज्ञातः स्वेन योगेन तस्मिन्वर्णान्तरे स्थितः ततश् च वामदेवेति ख्यातिं यातो ऽस्मि भूतले
verses.transliteration: vijñātaḥ svena yogena tasminvarṇāntare sthitaḥ tataś ca vāmadeveti khyātiṃ yāto 'smi bhūtale
verses.translation: There are eight worlds: Bhuh, Bhuvah, Svar, Mahar, Janar, Tapas, Satya and Visnu. These are established in the eight substratums each of which is imperishable. Bhuh, Bhuvah, Svar and Mahah constitute the four substratums.
verses.hindi: तदनन्तर क्रमसे उन्नीसवें द्वापरके अन्तमें महामुनि भरद्वाज तो व्यास होंगे और उस समय मैं हिमालयके नामसे अवतीर्ण होऊँगा। उस समय भी हिरण्यनाभ, कौशल्य, लोकाक्षी तथा कुथुमि नामक मेरे चार पुत्र
verses.wordMeaning: There are eight worlds: Bhuh, Bhuvah, Svar, Mahar, Janar, Tapas, Satya and Visnu. These are established in the eight substratums each of which is imperishable. Bhuh, Bhuvah, Svar and Mahah constitute the four substratums.
verses.commentary: Sense: There are eight worlds: Bhuh, Bhuvah, Svar, Mahar, Janar, Tapas, Satya and Visnu. These are established in the eight substratums each of which is imperishable. Bhuh, Bhuvah, Svar and Mahah constitute the four substratums.

verses.sanskrit: ये चापि वामदेव त्वां ज्ञास्यन्तीह द्विजातयः रुद्रलोकं गमिष्यन्ति पुनरावृत्तिदुर्लभम्
verses.transliteration: ye cāpi vāmadeva tvāṃ jñāsyantīha dvijātayaḥ rudralokaṃ gamiṣyanti punarāvṛttidurlabham
verses.translation: The first is Bhuh, the second Bhuvah. Uic ihiid >var and Mahar is the fourth.
verses.hindi: नैष्ठिक ब्रह्मचारी होंगे। वे सब माहेश्वरयोगको प्राप्त होकर रुद्रलोकको प्रस्थान करेंगे॥ ९०-९३/२॥ पुनः जब बीसवें द्वापरका अन्त होगा, तब उस समय महामुनि गौतम तो व्यास होंगे और मैं भी उसी समय हिमालय-क्षेत्रमें अट्टहास नामसे अवतरित होऊँगा। तभीसे लोगोंकी अट्टहासके प्रति महान् प्रीति हो जायगी।
verses.wordMeaning: The first is Bhuh, the second Bhuvah. Uic ihiid >var and Mahar is the fourth.
verses.commentary: Sense: The first is Bhuh, the second Bhuvah. Uic ihiid >var and Mahar is the fourth.

verses.sanskrit: यदाहं पुनरेवेह पीतवर्णो युगक्रमात् मत्कृतेन च नाम्ना वै पीतकल्पो ऽभवत्तदा
verses.transliteration: yadāhaṃ punareveha pītavarṇo yugakramāt matkṛtena ca nāmnā vai pītakalpo 'bhavattadā
verses.translation: The fifth is Janah, the sixth '1 apas, the seventh Satya whence people do not return to this world. The world ol Visnu is the eighth. It is also the spot whence a return to this world is difficult. Beyond that is the world of Skandha and Uina endow- ed with all attainments.
verses.hindi: वह क्षेत्र महागिरि अद्टहासके नामसे विख्यात होगा और सदा निवास करेंगे॥ ९४-९६ /२॥
verses.wordMeaning: The fifth is Janah, the sixth '1 apas, the seventh Satya whence people do not return to this world. The world ol Visnu is the eighth. It is also the spot whence a return to this world is difficult. Beyond that is the world of Skandha and Uina endow- ed with all attainments.
verses.commentary: Sense: The fifth is Janah, the sixth '1 apas, the seventh Satya whence people do not return to this world. The world ol Visnu is the eighth. It is also the spot whence a return to this world is difficult. Beyond that is the world of Skandha and Uina endow- ed with all attainments.

verses.sanskrit: तत्रापि च महासत्त्व योगयुक्तेन चेतसा यस्मादहं तैर्विज्ञातो योगतत्परमानसैः
verses.transliteration: tatrāpi ca mahāsattva yogayuktena cetasā yasmādahaṃ tairvijñāto yogatatparamānasaiḥ
verses.translation: The four feet of righteousness, according to ST, comprise daya (compassion), danam (charity), tapah (penance), satyam (truth).
verses.hindi: ल माहेश्वरं योगं रुद्रलोकाय ते गताः। योगात्मा, महात्मा, ध्यानपरायण एवं दृढ़  एकविंशे पुनः प्राप्ते परिवर्ते क्रमागते॥ ९  जो माहेश्वरयोगमें सिद्ध होकर रुद्रलोकको प्राण
verses.wordMeaning: The four feet of righteousness, according to ST, comprise daya (compassion), danam (charity), tapah (penance), satyam (truth).
verses.commentary: Sense: The four feet of righteousness, according to ST, comprise daya (compassion), danam (charity), tapah (penance), satyam (truth).

The other noble souls who engage their rnind.s m meditation at the end of Hvapara age and tlie advent of Kali will become sinless and pure in intellect. Devoid cf distress they will go to Rudra- loka, by my grace By visiting the sacred Mahalaya, the region of the gieal loiei, a devotee will cross the ocean of worldly existence and redeem his **n previous and ten future gcueiations. Thus, including himself, he will redeem twenty one generations in Mahalaya. These being free from level will go to Rudraloka, by my grace.
verses.hindi: छगलः कुण्डकर्णश्च कुभाण्डश्च प्रवाहकः तदाप्यहं भविष्यामि सहिष्णुर्नाम नामतः। पुरं भद्रवटं प्राप्य कलौ तस्मिन् युगान्तिके
verses.wordMeaning: When the seventeenth cycle sets in duly, O Lord Brahma, Krtahjaya will be the Vyasa, and I shall be born, under the name Guhavasa on the lofty and beautiful peak of the Himalayas, Mahalaya'". I shall be known as Guhavasin.…
verses.commentary: Sense: When the seventeenth cycle sets in duly, O Lord Brahma, Krtahjaya will be the Vyasa, and I shall be born, under the name Guhavasa on the lofty and beautiful peak of the Himalayas, Mahalaya'". I shall be known as Guhavasin.…

verses.sanskrit: तस्माच्चतुर्युगावस्थं जगद्वै सचराचरम् चतुर्धावस्थितश्चैव चतुष्पादो भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: tasmāccaturyugāvasthaṃ jagadvai sacarācaram caturdhāvasthitaścaiva catuṣpādo bhaviṣyati
verses.translation: This peak of the Himalayas has not been identified so far.
verses.hindi: तत्रापि मम ते पुत्रा भविष्यन्ति सुधार्मिकाः । उलूको विद्युतश्चैव शम्बूको ह्याश्वलायनः प्राप्य माहेश्वरं योगं रुद्रलोकाय ते गताः। सप्तविंशे पुनः प्राप्ते परिवर्ते क्रमागते
verses.wordMeaning: This peak of the Himalayas has not been identified so far.
verses.commentary: Sense: This peak of the Himalayas has not been identified so far.

verses.sanskrit: भूर्लोको ऽथ भुवर्लोकः स्वर्लोकश् च महस् तथा जनस्तपश् च सत्यं च विष्णुलोकस्ततः परम्
verses.transliteration: bhūrloko 'tha bhuvarlokaḥ svarlokaś ca mahas tathā janastapaś ca satyaṃ ca viṣṇulokastataḥ param
verses.translation: When the nineteenth cycle sets in duly, the great sage Bharadvaja will become the Vyasa. I'hen I will be born by the name Jatamalin on the beautiful peak of the Himala- yas where the mountain Jatayu' exists. There too four sons of great prowess will be born to me. They will be known as Hira- nyanabha, Kausalya, Laugaksi and Kuthumi. Characterized by yogic virtues they will remain celibate. After attaining the yoga of Mahesvara they will go to Rudraloka.
verses.hindi: जातूकर्ण्यो यदा व्यासो भविष्यति तपोधन: । तदाप्यहं भविष्यामि सोमशर्मा द्विजोत्तमः अक्षपादः कुमारश्च उलूको वत्स एव च। योगात्मानो महात्मानो विमलाः शुद्धबुद्धयः
verses.wordMeaning: When the nineteenth cycle sets in duly, the great sage Bharadvaja will become the Vyasa. I'hen I will be born by the name Jatamalin on the beautiful peak of the Himala- yas where the mountain Jatayu' exists. There too four sons of great prowess will be born to me.…
verses.commentary: Sense: When the nineteenth cycle sets in duly, the great sage Bharadvaja will become the Vyasa. I'hen I will be born by the name Jatamalin on the beautiful peak of the Himala- yas where the mountain Jatayu' exists. There too four sons of great prowess will be born to me.…

verses.sanskrit: अष्टाक्षरस्थितो लोकः स्थाने स्थाने तदक्षरम् भूर्भुवः स्वर्महश्चैव पादाश्चत्वार एव च
verses.transliteration: aṣṭākṣarasthito lokaḥ sthāne sthāne tadakṣaram bhūrbhuvaḥ svarmahaścaiva pādāścatvāra eva ca
verses.translation: When the twentieth cycle of yugas sets in, the sage Gautama becomes a Vyasa. Then I shall be born by the name Attahasa, most liked by the people. There itself on the ridge of the Himavat a great mountain Attaha.sa' is the abode of Devas, Danavas, Yaksas, Siddhas and Caranas. There too, powerful sons will be born to me. They will be yogic and noble souls, habitually meditating and performing the holy rites. They will be known as Sumantu, Barbari, Kabandha and Kusikandhara. After attaining the Yoga of Mahevra they will go to Rudraloka.
verses.hindi: प्राप्य माहेश्वरं योगं रुद्रलोकं ततो गताः। अष्टाविंशे पुनः प्राप्ते परिवर्ते क्रमागते पराशरसुतः श्रीमान् विष्णुलोंकपितामहः।
verses.wordMeaning: When the twentieth cycle of yugas sets in, the sage Gautama becomes a Vyasa. Then I shall be born by the name Attahasa, most liked by the people. There itself on the ridge of the Himavat a great mountain Attaha.sa' is the abode of Devas, Danavas, Yaksas, Siddhas and Caranas.…
verses.commentary: Sense: When the twentieth cycle of yugas sets in, the sage Gautama becomes a Vyasa. Then I shall be born by the name Attahasa, most liked by the people. There itself on the ridge of the Himavat a great mountain Attaha.sa' is the abode of Devas, Danavas, Yaksas, Siddhas and Caranas.…

verses.sanskrit: भूर्लोकः प्रथमः पादो भुवर्लोकस्ततः परम् स्वर्लोको वै तृतीयश् च चतुर्थस्तु महस् तथा
verses.transliteration: bhūrlokaḥ prathamaḥ pādo bhuvarlokastataḥ param svarloko vai tṛtīyaś ca caturthastu mahas tathā
verses.translation: When the twenty-firbt cycle sets in duly, the ex- cellent sage Vacasravas becomes a Vyasa. Then I shall be born by the name Daruka. Hence there will be a splendid and sacred forest of Deodars. There too my sons will be very powerful. They will be known as Plaksa, Darbhfiyani, Keiu- man and Gautama. They will be yogic and great souls, well con- trolled and celibate. After practising the perpetual holy riles they will go to Rudra's region.
verses.hindi: बसुदेवाद्यदुश्रेष्ठो वासुदेवो भविष्यति तदाप्यहं भविष्यामि योगात्मा योगमायया। लोकविस्मयनार्थाय ब्रह्मचारिंशरीरकः
verses.wordMeaning: When the twenty-firbt cycle sets in duly, the ex- cellent sage Vacasravas becomes a Vyasa. Then I shall be born by the name Daruka. Hence there will be a splendid and sacred forest of Deodars. There too my sons will be very powerful. They will be known as Plaksa, Darbhfiyani,…
verses.commentary: Sense: When the twenty-firbt cycle sets in duly, the ex- cellent sage Vacasravas becomes a Vyasa. Then I shall be born by the name Daruka. Hence there will be a splendid and sacred forest of Deodars. There too my sons will be very powerful. They will be known as Plaksa, Darbhfiyani,…

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चमस्तु जनस्तत्र षष्ठश् च तप उच्यते सत्यं तु सप्तमो लोको ह्य् अपुनर्भवगामिनाम्
verses.transliteration: pañcamastu janastatra ṣaṣṭhaś ca tapa ucyate satyaṃ tu saptamo loko hy apunarbhavagāminām
verses.translation: In the twenty-second cycle when Iusmayana becomes a Vyasa, I shall be born as a great sage by the name
verses.hindi: श्मशाने मृतमुत्सृष्टं दृष्ट्वा कायमनाथकम्। ब्राह्मणानां हितार्थाय प्रविष्टो योगमायया दिव्यां मेरुगुहां पुण्यां त्वया सार्धं च विष्णुना। भविष्यामि तदा ब्रह्मन् लकुली नाम नामतः॥ १ २९ कायावतार इत्येवं सिद्धक्षेत्रं च वै तदा। भविष्यति सुविख्यातं यावद्भमिर्धरिष्यति
verses.wordMeaning: In the twenty-second cycle when Iusmayana becomes a Vyasa, I shall be born as a great sage by the name
verses.commentary: Sense: In the twenty-second cycle when Iusmayana becomes a Vyasa, I shall be born as a great sage by the name

verses.sanskrit: विष्णुलोकः स्मृतं स्थानं पुनरावृत्तिदुर्लभम् स्कान्दमौमं तथा स्थानं सर्वसिद्धिसमन्वितम्
verses.transliteration: viṣṇulokaḥ smṛtaṃ sthānaṃ punarāvṛttidurlabham skāndamaumaṃ tathā sthānaṃ sarvasiddhisamanvitam
verses.translation: KaLihjara; I'he (III. 8j, 56) associates Kalanjara with Citrakuta. According to this reference, it lies in the Madhya Bharata terri- tory formerly known as Bundelkhanda. Cunningham (A.G. see map at the end) places it to the cast of Mahoba, below Citrakuta.
verses.hindi: पुनः क्रमिक रूपसे पचीसवें द्वापरके अन्तमें जब वसिष्ठजीके पुत्र शक्तिमुनि व्यास होंगे, उस समय जगत्प्रभु मैं दण्ड धारण किये हुए मुण्डीश्वर नामसे अवतार ग्रहण करूँगा। उस समय भी छगल, कुण्डकर्ण, होंगे। माहेश्‍वरयोगमें सिद्ध होकर वे अमरत्वको प्राप्त
verses.wordMeaning: KaLihjara; I'he (III. 8j, 56) associates Kalanjara with Citrakuta. According to this reference, it lies in the Madhya Bharata terri- tory formerly known as Bundelkhanda. Cunningham (A.G. see map at the end) places it to the cast of Mahoba, below Citrakuta.
verses.commentary: Sense: KaLihjara; I'he (III. 8j, 56) associates Kalanjara with Citrakuta. According to this reference, it lies in the Madhya Bharata terri- tory formerly known as Bundelkhanda. Cunningham (A.G. see map at the end) places it to the cast of Mahoba, below Citrakuta.

verses.sanskrit: रुद्रलोकः स्मृतस्तस्मात् पदं तद्योगिनां शुभम् निर्ममा निरहङ्काराः कामक्रोधविवर्जिताः
verses.transliteration: rudralokaḥ smṛtastasmāt padaṃ tadyogināṃ śubham nirmamā nirahaṅkārāḥ kāmakrodhavivarjitāḥ
verses.translation: See p. I. note 4.
verses.hindi: छब्बीसवें द्वापरके अन्तमें जब पराशर नामक व्यास होंगे, उस समय भी उस युगान्तमें मैं कलिके प्रारम्भमें भद्र-वरकषेत्रमें सहिष्णु नामसे अवतीर्ण होऊँगा। वहाँ भी उलूक, विद्युत, शम्बूक तथा आश्वलायन नामक अत्यन्त धर्मपरायण मेरे चार पुत्र होंगे। वे माहेश्वरयोगको प्राप्त होकर रुद्रलोकको प्रस्थान करेंगे॥ ११७-११९/२॥
verses.wordMeaning: See p. I. note 4.
verses.commentary: Sense: See p. I. note 4.

verses.sanskrit: द्रक्ष्यन्ति तद्द्विजा युक्ता ध्यानतत्परमानसाः यस्माच्चतुष्पदा ह्येषा त्वया दृष्टा सरस्वती
verses.transliteration: drakṣyanti taddvijā yuktā dhyānatatparamānasāḥ yasmāccatuṣpadā hyeṣā tvayā dṛṣṭā sarasvatī
verses.translation: Bhadravata: Gf. SP. SRS. 5. 39. This town has not been identi- fied so far.
verses.hindi: पुनः क्रमिक रूपसे सत्ताईसवें ट्वापरके अन्तमें जब तपस्वी जातूकर्ण्य व्यास होंगे, तब मैं योगविश्रुत तथा योगात्मा द्विजश्रेष्ठ सोमशर्माके रूपमें प्रभासक्षेत्रमें अवतरित निर्विकारहृदय तथा शुद्ध बुद्धिवाले वे शिष्य माहेश्‍वरयोग प्राप्त करके अन्तमें रुद्रलोक जायँगे ॥ १२०-१२३१/२॥
verses.wordMeaning: Bhadravata: Gf. SP. SRS. 5. 39. This town has not been identi- fied so far.
verses.commentary: Sense: Bhadravata: Gf. SP. SRS. 5. 39. This town has not been identi- fied so far.

verses.sanskrit: पादान्तं विष्णुलोकं वै कौमारं शान्तमुत्तमम् औमं माहेश्वरं चैव तस्माद्दृष्टा चतुष्पदा
verses.transliteration: pādāntaṃ viṣṇulokaṃ vai kaumāraṃ śāntamuttamam aumaṃ māheśvaraṃ caiva tasmāddṛṣṭā catuṣpadā
verses.translation: It is a celebrated place of pilgrimage in Saurastra, the southern part of Kathiawar.
verses.hindi: पुनः क्रमसे अट्टाईसवें द्वापपके आनेपर जब श्रीमान् लोकपितामह विष्णु अपने छठे अंशसे पराशरपुत्र वासुदेव कृष्ण वसुदेवसे उत्पन्न होंगे) उस समय योगात्मा मैं लोकोंको विस्मित करनेके उद्देश्यसे योगमायासे एक ब्रह्मचारीका शरीर धारणकर प्रकट होऊँगा और योगमायाके प्रभावसे ब्राह्मणोंके कल्याणार्थ श्मशानमें मृत
verses.wordMeaning: It is a celebrated place of pilgrimage in Saurastra, the southern part of Kathiawar.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is a celebrated place of pilgrimage in Saurastra, the southern part of Kathiawar.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात्तु पशवः सर्वे भविष्यन्ति चतुष्पदाः ततश्चैषां भविष्यन्ति चत्वारस्ते पयोधराः
verses.transliteration: tasmāttu paśavaḥ sarve bhaviṣyanti catuṣpadāḥ tataścaiṣāṃ bhaviṣyanti catvāraste payodharāḥ
verses.translation: Dvaipayana Vyasa: See note 6.
verses.hindi: पड़े एक अनाथ ब्राह्मणका शरीर देखकर उसमें प्रवेश करूँगा। दिव्य तथा पुण्य प्रदान करनेवाली मेरुगुहामें आपके एवं विष्णुके साथ मैं निवास करूँगा। है ब्रह्मन! उस समय मैं लकुली नामसे विख्यात होऊँगा और मेरा अवतार-स्थल जबतक भूमिको सत्ता रहेगी, तबतक एक सिद्भक्षेत्रके रूपमें कायावतार--इस नामसे विख्यात रहेगा
verses.wordMeaning: Dvaipayana Vyasa: See note 6.
verses.commentary: Sense: Dvaipayana Vyasa: See note 6.

verses.sanskrit: सोमश् च मन्त्रसंयुक्तो यस्मान्मम मुखाच्च्युतः जीवः प्राणभृतां ब्रह्मन् पुनः पीतस्तनाः स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: somaś ca mantrasaṃyukto yasmānmama mukhāccyutaḥ jīvaḥ prāṇabhṛtāṃ brahman punaḥ pītastanāḥ smṛtāḥ
verses.translation: tvaya sardham ca Visnuna. ST. construes tvaya with Visnuna (tvaya Visnuna sardham) and thus excludes Brahma.
verses.hindi: श्रीलिड्रमहापुराण  पूर्वभाग मम ते पुत्रा भविष्यन्ति तपस्विनः। वहाँपर भी कुशिक, ह मित्र तथा कौरुष्य कुशिकश्चैव गर्गश्च मित्रः कौरुष्य एव च॥ १ १  नामक मेरे चार तपस्वी, गात्मा, ब्रह्मज्ञानी और वेदोके
verses.wordMeaning: tvaya sardham ca Visnuna. ST. construes tvaya with Visnuna (tvaya Visnuna sardham) and thus excludes Brahma.
verses.commentary: Sense: tvaya sardham ca Visnuna. ST. construes tvaya with Visnuna (tvaya Visnuna sardham) and thus excludes Brahma.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात्सोममयं चैव अमृतं जीवसंज्ञितम् चतुष्पादा भविष्यन्ति श्वेतत्वं चास्य तेन तत्
verses.transliteration: tasmātsomamayaṃ caiva amṛtaṃ jīvasaṃjñitam catuṣpādā bhaviṣyanti śvetatvaṃ cāsya tena tat
verses.translation: Mcru: It is situated in the centre of the earth. It is described in the Puranas as the four-armed svastika, evolving in four directions, each* with seven constituent members. It can be identified with the highland of Tartary, north of the Himalayas. It is variously called Su-meru, Hemadri (the golden mountain), Ratnasanu (jewel-peaked), Karnikacala (lotus mountain), Amaradri, Deva-parvata, 'mountain of the Gods*. On its extent and identification with the Great Pamir knot of Asia, sec The Geography of the Puranas: — S. M. ALL Ch. III. p -52.
verses.hindi: योगात्मानो महात्मानो ब्राह्मणा वेदपारगा: । ष्क बरहाचयत्रत धारण करनेवाले वे पुत्र माहेश्‍वर योग प्राप्य माहेश्वरं योगं विमला द्युर्ध्वरेतसः ॥ १३२ सिद्ध होकर पुनरागमनसे मुक्ति दिलानेवाले रुद्रलोकको वरय रुद्रलोकं गमिष्यन्ति पुनरावृत्तिदुर्लभम्। प्राप्त होंगे एते पाशुपताः सिद्धा भस्मोद्धूलितविग्रहाः॥ १३३ ये पाशुपतयोगमें सिद्ध, भस्मसे विभूषित शरीरवाले, लिङ्गार्चनरता नित्यं बाह्याभ्यन्तरतः स्थिताः। नित्य शिवलिङ्गके अर्चनमें तत्पर रहनेवाले, बाहर एवं भक्त्या मयि च योगेन ध्याननिष्ठा जितेन्द्रियाः ॥ १३४  भीतरसे भक्तिपूर्वक योगके द्वारा मुझमें स्थित रहनेवाले,
verses.wordMeaning: Mcru: It is situated in the centre of the earth. It is described in the Puranas as the four-armed svastika, evolving in four directions, each* with seven constituent members. It can be identified with the highland of Tartary, north of the Himalayas.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Mcru: It is situated in the centre of the earth. It is described in the Puranas as the four-armed svastika, evolving in four directions, each* with seven constituent members. It can be identified with the highland of Tartary, north of the Himalayas.…

verses.sanskrit: यस्माच्चैव क्रिया भूत्वा द्विपदा च महेश्वरी दृष्टा पुनस्तथैवैषा सावित्री लोकभाविनी
verses.transliteration: yasmāccaiva kriyā bhūtvā dvipadā ca maheśvarī dṛṣṭā punastathaivaiṣā sāvitrī lokabhāvinī
verses.translation: On hearing the words of Brahma lord Siva was delighted on account of the weighty relevancy of the question. He looked at him as if he would drink him through his eyes. Facing him, he then described the method of worship of the Lihga.
