verses.wordMeaning: O multiformed, O highly blessed god, when and in which age (yuga) will these bodies honoured by all be seen by the brahmins and by what penance or meditation of yoga? Obeisance to you, O lord Mahadeva".
verses.commentary: Sense: O multiformed, O highly blessed god, when and in which age (yuga) will these bodies honoured by all be seen by the brahmins and by what penance or meditation of yoga? Obeisance to you, O lord Mahadeva".

verses.sanskrit: कस्यां वा युगसंभूत्यां द्रक्ष्यन्तीह द्विजातयः केन वा तपसा देव ध्यानयोगेन केन वा
verses.transliteration: kasyāṃ vā yugasaṃbhūtyāṃ drakṣyantīha dvijātayaḥ kena vā tapasā deva dhyānayogena kena vā
verses.translation: On hearing his words and seeing him in front, the great lord Rudra revealed by Rk, Yajus and Saman smiled and said: —
verses.hindi: लिङ्गके अर्चनके बिना निष्ठाकी प्राप्ति नहीं हो सकती, इसलिये जगत्पति भगवान् विष्णु श्रद्धापूर्वक मेरे लिङ्गका पूजन करते हैं देवेश ब्रह्माजीसे ऐसा कहकर तथा पुनः उनके ऊपर कृपादृष्टि डालकर महेश्वर वहींपर अन्तर्धान हो गये
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing his words and seeing him in front, the great lord Rudra revealed by Rk, Yajus and Saman smiled and said: —
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing his words and seeing him in front, the great lord Rudra revealed by Rk, Yajus and Saman smiled and said: —

verses.sanskrit: नमस्ते वै महादेव शक्यो द्रष्टुं द्विजातिभिः तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा शर्वः सम्प्रेक्ष्य तं पुरः
verses.transliteration: namaste vai mahādeva śakyo draṣṭuṃ dvijātibhiḥ tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā śarvaḥ samprekṣya taṃ puraḥ
verses.translation: Except through meditation, neither through penance nor by conduct nor through gifts and holy rites nor by visits to pilgrim centres nor through sacrifices with ample monetary gifts nor through the study of the Vedas'®* nor through wealth nor through knowledge of various kinds is it possible for men to sec me.
verses.hindi: तत्पश्चात् उन शिवको हाथ जोड़कर प्रणाम करके और उनसे आज्ञा प्राप्त करके वे भगवान् ब्रह्मा सृष्टिकी रचना करनेमें प्रवृत्त हो गये लिङ्गार्चनविधिके अन्तर्गत शरीर एवं मनकी शुद्धिके लिये अन्तः एवं बाह्य स्नानकी प्रक्रिया और विविध मन्त्रोसे आत्माभिषेचन
verses.wordMeaning: Except through meditation, neither through penance nor by conduct nor through gifts and holy rites nor by visits to pilgrim centres nor through sacrifices with ample monetary gifts nor through the study of the Vedas'®* nor through wealth nor through knowledge of various kinds is…
verses.commentary: Sense: Except through meditation, neither through penance nor by conduct nor through gifts and holy rites nor by visits to pilgrim centres nor through sacrifices with ample monetary gifts nor through the study of the Vedas'®* nor through wealth nor through knowledge of various kinds is…

verses.sanskrit: स्मयन्प्राह महादेव ऋग्यजुःसामसंभवः तपसा नैव वृत्तेन दानधर्मफलेन च
verses.transliteration: smayanprāha mahādeva ṛgyajuḥsāmasaṃbhavaḥ tapasā naiva vṛttena dānadharmaphalena ca
verses.translation: In the course of that kalpa containing the four yugas, towards the end of Kali, I will be born to bless the worlds and for the welfare of the brahmins, O Brahma. As the yuga proceeds further, when the great lord himself becomes Vyasa, during the first Dvapara age I will be born at the end of Dva- para® as sage Sveta. 1 will be endowed with a tuft and will stay on the excellent mountain Ghagala®* a beautiful peak of the Himalaya mountain.
verses.hindi: कथं पूज्यो महादेवो लिङ्गमूर्ति्महेश्वरः। वक्तुमर्हसि चास्माकं रोमहर्षण साम्प्रतम् देव्या पृष्टो महादेवः केलासे तां नगात्मजाम्। अङ्कस्थामाह देवेशो लिङ्गार्चनविधिं क्रमात्
verses.wordMeaning: In the course of that kalpa containing the four yugas, towards the end of Kali, I will be born to bless the worlds and for the welfare of the brahmins, O Brahma. As the yuga proceeds further, when the great lord himself becomes Vyasa,…
verses.commentary: Sense: In the course of that kalpa containing the four yugas, towards the end of Kali, I will be born to bless the worlds and for the welfare of the brahmins, O Brahma. As the yuga proceeds further, when the great lord himself becomes Vyasa,…

verses.sanskrit: न तीर्थफलयोगेन क्रतुभिर् वाप्तदक्षिणैः न वेदाध्ययनैर्वापि न वित्तेन न वेदनैः
verses.transliteration: na tīrthaphalayogena kratubhir vāptadakṣiṇaiḥ na vedādhyayanairvāpi na vittena na vedanaiḥ
verses.translation: Ghagala: This peak of the Himalayas has not been identified so
verses.hindi: तदा पार्श्वे स्थितो नन्दी शालङ्कायनकात्मजः। श्रुत्वाखिलं पुरा प्राह ब्रह्मपुत्राय सुब्रताः ऋषिगण बोले--हे सूतजी ! लिङ्गस्वरूप महेश्वर महादेवकी पूजा किस प्रकार की जानी चाहिए? अब आप हमलोगोंको यह बतानेकी कृपा करें
verses.wordMeaning: Ghagala: This peak of the Himalayas has not been identified so
verses.commentary: Sense: Ghagala: This peak of the Himalayas has not been identified so

verses.sanskrit: न शक्यं मानवैर्द्रष्टुम् ऋते ध्यानादहं त्विह सप्तमे चैव वाराहे ततस्तस्मिन्पितामह
verses.transliteration: na śakyaṃ mānavairdraṣṭum ṛte dhyānādahaṃ tviha saptame caiva vārāhe tatastasminpitāmaha
verses.translation: Then my disciples will be four noble brahmins, the masters of the V edas and having tufts. I'hcy will be Sveta, Svctasikha, Svetasyaand Svela-lohita. After attaining Brahman's goal, they will approach me and will be devoted to the path of meditation and yoga. O Brahma, in the second Dvapara age lord Prajapati will become Vyasa, known as Sadya. Then, in the Kali age, 1 will be born by the name Sutara for the wel- fare of the world, with a desire for blessing the disciples. My disciples then will be known by these names:
verses.hindi: सूतजी बोले-हे ऋषियो! इसी विषयमें कैलास पर्वतपर देवी पार्वतीके द्वारा पूछे जानेपर देवाधिदेव महादेवने अपने अंकमें विराजमान गिरिराजकिशोरी पार्वतीसे लिङ्गार्चन विधिका क्रमसे वर्णन किया था हे सुव्रतो! उस समय समीपमें ही स्थित शालंकायनके पुत्र नन्दीने उस विधिका श्रवण करके पहले ब्रह्मापुत्र
verses.wordMeaning: Then my disciples will be four noble brahmins, the masters of the V edas and having tufts. I'hcy will be Sveta, Svctasikha, Svetasyaand Svela-lohita. After attaining Brahman's goal, they will approach me and will be devoted to the path of meditation and yoga. O Brahma,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Then my disciples will be four noble brahmins, the masters of the V edas and having tufts. I'hcy will be Sveta, Svctasikha, Svetasyaand Svela-lohita. After attaining Brahman's goal, they will approach me and will be devoted to the path of meditation and yoga. O Brahma,…

verses.sanskrit: कल्पेश्वरो ऽथ भगवान् सर्वलोकप्रकाशनः मनुर्वैवस्वतश्चैव तव पौत्रो भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: kalpeśvaro 'tha bhagavān sarvalokaprakāśanaḥ manurvaivasvataścaiva tava pautro bhaviṣyati
verses.translation: Dundhubhi, Satarupa, Rcika and Ketuman. After attaining yoga and meditation and after establishing the Brah- ma® on the earth they will attain the region and companion- ship ofRudra. In the third age, Dvapara, Bhargava will be the Vyasa. Then, at the end of Dvapara I will be born as Damana. There too four boys will be born to me, namely, Vikesa, Vikosa, Vipasa and Sapanasana. These four of great prowess will go to the world of Rudra through the same yogic path and will never return. In the fourth Dvapara yuga, Ahgiras will become Vyasa. At that time I shall be born by the name Suhotra. There too, four ascetics will be born as my sons.
verses.hindi: सनत्कुमाराय शुभं लिङ्गार्चनविधिं परम्।  सनत्कुमारको वह परम पवित्र लिङ्गार्चनविधि अतत शुभं लिङ्गार्चनविधिं परम्। उह h परम i त बतायी शैलादि (नन्दी)-के मुखसे स्नान तथा लिङ्ग पूजानुष्ठानकी जो विधि कही गयी है एवं जो मैंने भी सुनी है, उस स्नान तथा अर्चनविधिका आपलोगोंसे वर्णन करूँगा
verses.wordMeaning: Dundhubhi, Satarupa, Rcika and Ketuman. After attaining yoga and meditation and after establishing the Brah- ma® on the earth they will attain the region and companion- ship ofRudra. In the third age, Dvapara, Bhargava will be the Vyasa. Then,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Dundhubhi, Satarupa, Rcika and Ketuman. After attaining yoga and meditation and after establishing the Brah- ma® on the earth they will attain the region and companion- ship ofRudra. In the third age, Dvapara, Bhargava will be the Vyasa. Then,…

verses.sanskrit: तदा चतुर्युगावस्थे तस्मिन्कल्पे युगान्तिके अनुग्रहार्थं लोकानां ब्राह्मणानां हिताय च
verses.transliteration: tadā caturyugāvasthe tasminkalpe yugāntike anugrahārthaṃ lokānāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ hitāya ca
verses.translation: They will be excellent brahmins of steadfast rites and yogic souls. They will be known as Sumukha, Durmukha, Dardura and Dhrtikrama.
verses.hindi: शैलादि ( नन्दिकेश्वर) बोले--ब्राह्मणोंके कल्याणके निमित्त अब मैं स्नान-विधिके विषयमें कहूँगा। यह विधिपूर्वक किया गया स्नान सभी पापोंको दूर करनेवाला है । पूर्वकालमें स्वयं भगवान् शंकरने इसके महत्त्वका वर्णन किया है
verses.wordMeaning: They will be excellent brahmins of steadfast rites and yogic souls. They will be known as Sumukha, Durmukha, Dardura and Dhrtikrama.
verses.commentary: Sense: They will be excellent brahmins of steadfast rites and yogic souls. They will be known as Sumukha, Durmukha, Dardura and Dhrtikrama.

verses.sanskrit: उत्पत्स्यामि तदा ब्रह्मन् पुनर् अस्मिन् युगान्तिके युगप्रवृत्त्या च तदा तस्मिंश् च प्रथमे युगे
verses.transliteration: utpatsyāmi tadā brahman punar asmin yugāntike yugapravṛttyā ca tadā tasmiṃś ca prathame yuge
verses.translation: By performing subtle yogic practices they will be- come pure and shall wash off their sins by taking recourse to the subtle yogic practice. Endowed with yoga and through the same path (as described above) these courageous souls will go to the world of Rudra and never return. In the fifth Dva- para age Savitr will be the Vyasa. At that lime, I shall be born as a person of great penance with the name Kafika for blessing the worlds and propagating yoga among the people.
verses.hindi: इस विधिसे स्नान करनेके बाद भक्तिपूर्वक एक बार शंकरजीको पूजा करके विधिपूर्वक निर्मित ब्रह्मकूर्च (पंचगव्य)-का पानकर मनुष्य सभी पापोंसे मुक्त हो जाता है हे ब्रह्माजीके उत्तम पुत्र! ब्राह्मण आदिके हितके लिये देवाधिदेव शंकरने तीन प्रकारके स्नानोंका वर्णन किया है
verses.wordMeaning: By performing subtle yogic practices they will be- come pure and shall wash off their sins by taking recourse to the subtle yogic practice. Endowed with yoga and through the same path (as described above) these courageous souls will go to the world of Rudra and never return.…
verses.commentary: Sense: By performing subtle yogic practices they will be- come pure and shall wash off their sins by taking recourse to the subtle yogic practice. Endowed with yoga and through the same path (as described above) these courageous souls will go to the world of Rudra and never return.…

verses.sanskrit: द्वापरे प्रथमे ब्रह्मन् यदा व्यासः स्वयं प्रभुः तदाहं ब्राह्मणार्थाय कलौ तस्मिन् युगान्तिके
verses.transliteration: dvāpare prathame brahman yadā vyāsaḥ svayaṃ prabhuḥ tadāhaṃ brāhmaṇārthāya kalau tasmin yugāntike
verses.translation: Four blessed persons of pure origin shall be my disci- ples. They will be yogic souls with steadfast rites. They will be known as Sanaka, Sanandana Sanatana and Sanat. They will be devoid of ego, altogether.
verses.hindi: सर्वप्रथम जलस्नान करनेके बाद श्रेष्ठ अग्निस्नान (भस्मस्नान)-और फिर मार्जनरूप मन्त्रस्तान करके परमेश्वरको पूजा करनी चाहिए भावदुष्ट अर्थात् श्रद्धारहित प्राणी जलमें स्नान करके तथा भस्म लगा लेनेसे शुद्ध नहीं हो जाता है। भावनासे शुद्ध होकर ही मनुष्यको शुद्धि करनी चाहिए, अन्यथा नहीं
verses.wordMeaning: Four blessed persons of pure origin shall be my disci- ples. They will be yogic souls with steadfast rites. They will be known as Sanaka, Sanandana Sanatana and Sanat. They will be devoid of ego, altogether.
verses.commentary: Sense: Four blessed persons of pure origin shall be my disci- ples. They will be yogic souls with steadfast rites. They will be known as Sanaka, Sanandana Sanatana and Sanat. They will be devoid of ego, altogether.

verses.sanskrit: भविष्यामि शिखायुक्तः श्वेतो नाम महामुनिः हिमवच्छिखरे रम्ये छागले पर्वतोत्तमे
verses.transliteration: bhaviṣyāmi śikhāyuktaḥ śveto nāma mahāmuniḥ himavacchikhare ramye chāgale parvatottame
verses.translation: In the end they will come to my abode and never return. In the sixth yuga, Mrtyu will be the Vyasa and 1 shall
verses.hindi: प्रलयपर्यन्त सभी नदियों, सरोबरों तथा तड़ागोंमें स्नान करके भी भावनासे दूषित मनवाला व्यक्ति शुद्ध नहीं हो सकता है; इसमें सन्देह नहीं है तमोगुणके प्रभावसे मनुष्यका प्रसुप्त चित्तकमल जब ज्ञानरूपी सूर्यके प्रकाशसे चेतनायुक्त हो जाता है, तभी शुद्धि हो पाती है
verses.wordMeaning: In the end they will come to my abode and never return. In the sixth yuga, Mrtyu will be the Vyasa and 1 shall
verses.commentary: Sense: In the end they will come to my abode and never return. In the sixth yuga, Mrtyu will be the Vyasa and 1 shall

verses.sanskrit: तत्र शिष्याः शिखायुक्ता भविष्यन्ति तदा मम श्वेतः श्वेतशिखश्चैव श्वेतास्यः श्वेतलोहितः
verses.transliteration: tatra śiṣyāḥ śikhāyuktā bhaviṣyanti tadā mama śvetaḥ śvetaśikhaścaiva śvetāsyaḥ śvetalohitaḥ
verses.translation: In the eighth cycle, Vasisha will become the Vyasa, I will be born by the name Dadhivahana. There too my sons will be yogic souls of steadfast rites and great yogic prac- tice. There will be none equal to them. They will be known as Kapila, Asuri, Paftcasikha*® and Bakala. I'hesc will be righteous souls of great prowess. After attaining the yoga of the lord they will burn their sins and come near me, never to return.
verses.hindi: मिट्टी, गोमय, तिल, पुष्प तथा भस्म आदि लेकर स्नानके लिये स्नानतीर्थ जाकर वहाँ तटपर कुश बिछा लेना चाहिए। तदनन्तर दोनों पैर धोकर पुनः आचमन सर्वपापहरं साक्षाच्छिवेन कथितं पुरा
verses.wordMeaning: In the eighth cycle, Vasisha will become the Vyasa, I will be born by the name Dadhivahana. There too my sons will be yogic souls of steadfast rites and great yogic prac- tice. There will be none equal to them. They will be known as Kapila, Asuri, Paftcasikha*® and Bakala.…
verses.commentary: Sense: In the eighth cycle, Vasisha will become the Vyasa, I will be born by the name Dadhivahana. There too my sons will be yogic souls of steadfast rites and great yogic prac- tice. There will be none equal to them. They will be known as Kapila, Asuri, Paftcasikha*® and Bakala.…

verses.sanskrit: चत्वारस्तु महात्मानो ब्राह्मणा वेदपारगाः ततस्ते ब्रह्मभूयिष्ठा दृष्ट्वा ब्रह्मगतिं पराम्
verses.transliteration: catvārastu mahātmāno brāhmaṇā vedapāragāḥ tataste brahmabhūyiṣṭhā dṛṣṭvā brahmagatiṃ parām
verses.translation: In the ninth cyelc when Sarasvata will be the Vyasa I will be born by the name Rsabha. There too, iny sons will be persons of great prowess. They will be Parasara, Garga, Bhargava and Angiras — all brahmins well versed in the Vedas, exalted with the strength of their penance, and capable of cursing and blessing. Attaining the path of meditation in the the manner prescribed in the yogic system those ascetics will go to Rudraloka never to return.
verses.hindi: अनेन विधिना स्नात्वा सकृत्पूज्य च शङ्करम्। ब्रह्मकूर्चं च पीत्वा तु सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते त्रिविधं स्नानमाख्यातं देवदेवेन शम्भुना।
verses.wordMeaning: In the ninth cyelc when Sarasvata will be the Vyasa I will be born by the name Rsabha. There too, iny sons will be persons of great prowess. They will be Parasara, Garga, Bhargava and Angiras — all brahmins well versed in the Vedas, exalted with the strength of their penance,…
verses.commentary: Sense: In the ninth cyelc when Sarasvata will be the Vyasa I will be born by the name Rsabha. There too, iny sons will be persons of great prowess. They will be Parasara, Garga, Bhargava and Angiras — all brahmins well versed in the Vedas, exalted with the strength of their penance,…

verses.sanskrit: मत्समीपं गमिष्यन्ति ध्यानयोगपरायणाः ततः पुनर्यदा ब्रह्मन् द्वितीये द्वापरे प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: matsamīpaṃ gamiṣyanti dhyānayogaparāyaṇāḥ tataḥ punaryadā brahman dvitīye dvāpare prabhuḥ
verses.translation: In the twelfth cycle the sage Satatejas of great splen- dour, the best among the wise, will become Vyasa. At that time, when Dvapara ends, and Kaliyuga starts, I shall be known by the name Atri in the forest Haituka®**. There too will be born my sons who will have ashes for ablution and unguent, who will be such yogins, and who will be devoted to Rudra's world. They will be known as Sarvajfta Samabuddhi, Sadhya and Sarva, After attaining the yoga of Mahe vara they will go to Rudraloka.
verses.hindi: लिङ्गार्चनविधिके अन्तर्गत शरीर एवं मनकी शुद्धिकी प्रक्रिया फझफफफफफफफ पण कपका फा फफफ फा फफफ फफफ फा क फफक फा म फ फफफ फफ फफफ फफक
verses.wordMeaning: In the twelfth cycle the sage Satatejas of great splen- dour, the best among the wise, will become Vyasa. At that time, when Dvapara ends, and Kaliyuga starts, I shall be known by the name Atri in the forest Haituka®**.…
verses.commentary: Sense: In the twelfth cycle the sage Satatejas of great splen- dour, the best among the wise, will become Vyasa. At that time, when Dvapara ends, and Kaliyuga starts, I shall be known by the name Atri in the forest Haituka®**.…

verses.sanskrit: प्रजापतिर्यदा व्यासः सद्यो नाम भविष्यति तदा लोकहितार्थाय सुतारो नाम नामतः
verses.transliteration: prajāpatiryadā vyāsaḥ sadyo nāma bhaviṣyati tadā lokahitārthāya sutāro nāma nāmataḥ
verses.translation: When the thirteenth cycle sets in due order, Dharma under the name Narayana will be the Vyasa. At that time, I will be born as the sage Vali in the holy penance grove of Vala-
verses.hindi: करके तीरदेशमें स्थित द्र्व्योंसे शरीरके मलका शोधन मृदादाय ततश्चान्यद्वस्त्रै स्नात्वा ह्यनुल्बणम् १५  करनेके उपरान्त स्नान करना चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: When the thirteenth cycle sets in due order, Dharma under the name Narayana will be the Vyasa. At that time, I will be born as the sage Vali in the holy penance grove of Vala-
verses.commentary: Sense: When the thirteenth cycle sets in due order, Dharma under the name Narayana will be the Vyasa. At that time, I will be born as the sage Vali in the holy penance grove of Vala-

verses.sanskrit: भविष्यामि कलौ तस्मिन् शिष्यानुग्रहकाम्यया तत्रापि मम ते शिष्या नामतः परिकीर्तिताः
verses.transliteration: bhaviṣyāmi kalau tasmin śiṣyānugrahakāmyayā tatrāpi mama te śiṣyā nāmataḥ parikīrtitāḥ
verses.translation: Gangadvara represents modem Haradvara. It is also known by other names like Haridvara, Mokadvara, Mayadv&ra. Gf. SK iv.
verses.hindi: सर्वपापविशुद््यर्थमावाह्य वरुणं तथा। सम्पूज्य मनसा देवं ध्यानयज्ञेन वै भवम् शान्तिधर्मेण चैकेन पञ्चब्रह्मपवित्रकैः।
verses.wordMeaning: Gangadvara represents modem Haradvara. It is also known by other names like Haridvara, Mokadvara, Mayadv&ra. Gf. SK iv.
verses.commentary: Sense: Gangadvara represents modem Haradvara. It is also known by other names like Haridvara, Mokadvara, Mayadv&ra. Gf. SK iv.

verses.sanskrit: दुन्दुभिः शतरूपश् च ऋचीकः केतुमांस्तदा प्राप्य योगं तथा ध्यानं स्थाप्य ब्रह्म च भूतले
verses.transliteration: dundubhiḥ śatarūpaś ca ṛcīkaḥ ketumāṃstadā prāpya yogaṃ tathā dhyānaṃ sthāpya brahma ca bhūtale
verses.translation: When the seventeenth cycle sets in duly, O Lord Brahma, Krtahjaya' will be the Vyasa, and I shall be born, under the name Guhavasa on the lofty and beautiful peak of the Himalayas, Mahalaya. I shall be known as Guhavasin. This Mahalaya will become a Siddhaksetra the place of sanctity. There too my sons will be conversant with yoga and expounders of Brahman. They will be noble sons and devoid of ego. They will be known as — Utathya, Vamadeva, Maha- yoga and Mahibala. At that time, in the practice of yogic meditation, they will have hundreds and thousands of disciples. Engaged in the practice of yoga, and meditating upon the great lord within their hearts, they after observing the foot- prints in the Mahalaya will attain the region of the lord. The other noble souls who engage their minds in meditation at the end of Dvapara age and the advent of Kali will become sinless and pure in intellect. Devoid of distress they will go to Rudra- loka, by my grace. By visiting the sacred Mahalaya, the region of the great lord, a devotee will cross the ocean of worldly existence and redeem his ten previous and ten future generations. Thus, including himself, he will redeem twenty one generations in Mahalaya. These being free from fever will go to Rudraloka, by my grac:c.
verses.hindi: तत्पश्चात् “उद्धृतासि वराहेण ' यह मन्त्र पढ़कर मिट्टी लेकर उससे शरीरकी शुद्धि करनी चाहिए। इसके अनन्तर स्नान करके दूसरा पवित्र वस्त्र धारण करना चाहिए पुनः मन्त्रवित् पुरुषको चाहिए कि वह ' गन्धद्वारां दुराधर्षाम्'' इस मन्त्रको पढ़कर कपिला गायके भूस्पर्शरहित गोमयका शरीरपर लेपन करे। इसके बाद स्नान करके उस मलिन वस्त्रको छोड़कर पुनः श्वेत
verses.wordMeaning: When the seventeenth cycle sets in duly, O Lord Brahma, Krtahjaya' will be the Vyasa, and I shall be born, under the name Guhavasa on the lofty and beautiful peak of the Himalayas, Mahalaya. I shall be known as Guhavasin.…
verses.commentary: Sense: When the seventeenth cycle sets in duly, O Lord Brahma, Krtahjaya' will be the Vyasa, and I shall be born, under the name Guhavasa on the lofty and beautiful peak of the Himalayas, Mahalaya. I shall be known as Guhavasin.…

verses.sanskrit: रुद्रलोकं गमिष्यन्ति सहचारित्वमेव च तृतीये द्वापरे चैव यदा व्यासस्तु भार्गवः
verses.transliteration: rudralokaṃ gamiṣyanti sahacāritvameva ca tṛtīye dvāpare caiva yadā vyāsastu bhārgavaḥ
verses.translation: O lord, in the eighteenth cycle the sage Rtaftjaya will become a Vyasa. Then 1 shall be born in the name of Sikhandin in the most sacred region of the Siddhas which is adored by Devas as well as Danavas. On the beautiful peak of the Himalayas there is a hill named Sikhandin,"® wheiein is situated the penance grove of the sage likhantin, resorted to by the Siddhas. There too four ascetics will be born
verses.hindi: वस्त्र धारण करके स्नान करना चाहिए समस्त पापोंसे विमुक्तिके लिये वरुणदेवका आवाहन करके तथा मानसिक उपचारोंसे भगवान् शंकरको विधिवत् पूजा करके तीन बार आचमनकर जलको अभिमन्त्रित करके शिवका स्मरण करते हुए तीर्थजलमें
verses.wordMeaning: O lord, in the eighteenth cycle the sage Rtaftjaya will become a Vyasa. Then 1 shall be born in the name of Sikhandin in the most sacred region of the Siddhas which is adored by Devas as well as Danavas.…
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord, in the eighteenth cycle the sage Rtaftjaya will become a Vyasa. Then 1 shall be born in the name of Sikhandin in the most sacred region of the Siddhas which is adored by Devas as well as Danavas.…

verses.sanskrit: तदाप्यहं भविष्यामि दमनस्तु युगान्तिके तत्रापि च भविष्यन्ति चत्वारो मम पुत्रकाः
verses.transliteration: tadāpyahaṃ bhaviṣyāmi damanastu yugāntike tatrāpi ca bhaviṣyanti catvāro mama putrakāḥ
verses.translation: This peak of the Him&layas has not been identified so far.
verses.hindi: प्रवेश करे। इसके बाद गोता लगाकर "ऋतञ्च सत्यञ्च ' इस अघमर्षण मन्त्रका जप करते हुए उस जलमें सूर्य, चन्द्र तथा अग्नि-इन तीनोंके मण्डलोंका उस संयमी व्यक्तिको ध्यान करना चाहिए फिर आचमन करके उस जलसे निकलकर पुण्यकी वृद्धिहेतु उस मन्त्रवितृको पुनः जलमध्यमें प्रवेश करना चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: This peak of the Him&layas has not been identified so far.
verses.commentary: Sense: This peak of the Him&layas has not been identified so far.

verses.sanskrit: विकोशश् च विकेशश् च विपाशः शापनाशनः ते ऽपि तेनैव मार्गेण योगोक्तेन महौजसः
verses.transliteration: vikośaś ca vikeśaś ca vipāśaḥ śāpanāśanaḥ te 'pi tenaiva mārgeṇa yogoktena mahaujasaḥ
verses.translation: When the nineteenth cycle sets in duly, the great sage Bharadvaja will become the VySsa. Then I will be born by the name Jatamalin on the beautiful peak of the Himala- yas where the mountain Jatayu' exists. There too four sons of great prowess will be born to me. They will be known as Hira- nyanabha, Kausalya, Laugaksi and Kuthumi. Characterized by yogic virtues they will remain celibate. After attaining the yoga of Mahesvara they will go to Rudraloka.
verses.hindi: गृहीत जलसे रुद्र-सूक्त (शु०यजुर्वेद अ० १९ के नमस्ते रुद्र० इत्यादि ६६ मन्त्र), पवमानसूक्त (ऋग्वेदकी पावमानी ऋचाएँ), यो रुद्र० इत्यादि त्वरितसंज्ञक मन्त्र, तरत्समन्दी मित्र० आदि दो मन्त्रों (यजु० ३६। ९-१०), शान्तिधर्मक शं नो देवी० (शुभ्यजु० ३६।१२) एक मन्त्र,
verses.wordMeaning: When the nineteenth cycle sets in duly, the great sage Bharadvaja will become the VySsa. Then I will be born by the name Jatamalin on the beautiful peak of the Himala- yas where the mountain Jatayu' exists. There too four sons of great prowess will be born to me.…
verses.commentary: Sense: When the nineteenth cycle sets in duly, the great sage Bharadvaja will become the VySsa. Then I will be born by the name Jatamalin on the beautiful peak of the Himala- yas where the mountain Jatayu' exists. There too four sons of great prowess will be born to me.…

verses.sanskrit: रुद्रलोकं गमिष्यन्ति पुनरावृत्तिदुर्लभम् चतुर्थे द्वापरे चैव यदा व्यासो ऽङ्गिराः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: rudralokaṃ gamiṣyanti punarāvṛttidurlabham caturthe dvāpare caiva yadā vyāso 'ṅgirāḥ smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: When the twentieth cycle of yugas sets in, the sage Gautama becomes a Vyasa. Then I shall be born by the name Attahasa, most liked by the people. There itself on the ridge of the Himavat a great mountain Attahisa'** is the abode of Devas, Danavas, Yaksas, Siddhas and Caranas. There too, powerful sons will be born to me. They will be yogic and noble souls, habitually meditating and performing the holy rites. They will be known as Sumantu, Barbari, Kabandha and Kuikandhara. After attaining the Yoga of Maheivara they will go to Rudraloka.
verses.hindi: तत्तन्मन्त्राधिदेवानां स्वरूपं च ऋषीन् स्मरन्॥ २४  पंचब्रह्मपवित्रक सद्योजातादि मन्त्र-पंचककाऽ पाठ करते १. उद्धृतासि वराहेण कृष्णेन शतबाहुना। मृत्तिके त्वां च गृह्णामि प्रजया च धनेन च॥ २. गन्धद्वारां दुराधर्षा नित्यपुष्टां करीषिणीम्। ईश्वरीं सर्वभूतानां तामिहोप ह्ये श्रियम्॥
verses.wordMeaning: When the twentieth cycle of yugas sets in, the sage Gautama becomes a Vyasa. Then I shall be born by the name Attahasa, most liked by the people. There itself on the ridge of the Himavat a great mountain Attahisa'** is the abode of Devas, Danavas, Yaksas, Siddhas and Caranas.…
verses.commentary: Sense: When the twentieth cycle of yugas sets in, the sage Gautama becomes a Vyasa. Then I shall be born by the name Attahasa, most liked by the people. There itself on the ridge of the Himavat a great mountain Attahisa'** is the abode of Devas, Danavas, Yaksas, Siddhas and Caranas.…

verses.sanskrit: तदाप्यहं भविष्यामि सुहोत्रो नाम नामतः तत्रापि मम ते पुत्राश् चत्वारो ऽपि तपोधनाः
verses.transliteration: tadāpyahaṃ bhaviṣyāmi suhotro nāma nāmataḥ tatrāpi mama te putrāś catvāro 'pi tapodhanāḥ
verses.translation: When the twenty-first cycle sets in duly, the ex- cellent sage Vacasravas becomes a Vya. Then I shall be born by the name Daruka. Hence there will be a splendid and sacred forest of Deodars*. There too my sons will be very powerful. They will be known as Plaksa, Darbhfiyani, Ketu- man and Gautama. They will be yogic and great souls, well con- trolled and celibate. After practising the perpetual holy rites they will go to Rudra's region.
verses.hindi: ४. (क) सद्योजातं प्रपद्यामि सद्योजाताय वै नमो नमः । भवे भवे नातिभवे भवस्व मां भवोद्धवाय नम: ॥ (ख) वामदेवाय नमो ज्येष्ठाय ध्यायेच्च त्र्यम्बकं देवं हृदि पञ्चास्यमीश्वरम्
verses.wordMeaning: When the twenty-first cycle sets in duly, the ex- cellent sage Vacasravas becomes a Vya. Then I shall be born by the name Daruka. Hence there will be a splendid and sacred forest of Deodars*. There too my sons will be very powerful. They will be known as Plaksa, Darbhfiyani,…
verses.commentary: Sense: When the twenty-first cycle sets in duly, the ex- cellent sage Vacasravas becomes a Vya. Then I shall be born by the name Daruka. Hence there will be a splendid and sacred forest of Deodars*. There too my sons will be very powerful. They will be known as Plaksa, Darbhfiyani,…

verses.sanskrit: द्विजश्रेष्ठा भविष्यन्ति योगात्मानो दृढव्रताः सुमुखो दुर्मुखश्चैव दुर्दरो दुरतिक्रमः
verses.transliteration: dvijaśreṣṭhā bhaviṣyanti yogātmāno dṛḍhavratāḥ sumukho durmukhaścaiva durdaro duratikramaḥ
verses.translation: In the twenty-second cycle when Susmayana becomes a Vyasa, I shall be born as a great sage by the name
verses.hindi: अभ्युक्ष्य सकुशं चापि दक्षिणेन करेण तु। पिबेत्प्रक्षिप्य त्रिस्तोयं चक्री भूत्वा ह्यतन्द्रितः प्रदक्षिणं ततः कुर्याद्धिंसापापप्रशान्तये। एवं सङ्क्षेपतः प्रोक्तं स्नानाचमनमुत्तमम्
verses.wordMeaning: In the twenty-second cycle when Susmayana becomes a Vyasa, I shall be born as a great sage by the name
verses.commentary: Sense: In the twenty-second cycle when Susmayana becomes a Vyasa, I shall be born as a great sage by the name

verses.sanskrit: प्राप्य योगगतिं सूक्ष्मां विमला दग्धकिल्बिषाः ते ऽपि तेनैव मार्गेण योगयुक्ता महौजसः
verses.transliteration: prāpya yogagatiṃ sūkṣmāṃ vimalā dagdhakilbiṣāḥ te 'pi tenaiva mārgeṇa yogayuktā mahaujasaḥ
verses.translation: Devadiinivana. It is identical with Darn or Daruka vana and is placed close to the western ocean (SP, KRS 29. 4). Another vana of the same name also stands in theHim&layas near Badrinath (Mbh. XIII, 25. 27).
verses.hindi: य मधय य न्न क क ९ ० अकअक् फ़ फ़ फ़ फ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ फ़ फ क फ फ फ़ क्ष फ फ फ कमी फ की फी जीती मी जन व ओके स्वरूप एवं ऋषियोंका स्मरण करते हुए आत्माभिषेचन करे॥ २२--२४॥
verses.wordMeaning: Devadiinivana. It is identical with Darn or Daruka vana and is placed close to the western ocean (SP, KRS 29. 4). Another vana of the same name also stands in theHim&layas near Badrinath (Mbh. XIII, 25. 27).

verses.sanskrit: रुद्रलोकं गमिष्यन्ति पुनरावृत्तिदुर्लभम् पञ्चमे द्वापरे चैव व्यासस्तु सविता यदा
verses.transliteration: rudralokaṃ gamiṣyanti punarāvṛttidurlabham pañcame dvāpare caiva vyāsastu savitā yadā
verses.translation: Kalanjara: The.WM. (III. 85, 56) associates Kalafljara with Gitrakilta. According to this reference, it lies in the Madhya Bh&rata terri- tory formerly known as Bundelkharta. Cunningham (A.G. sec map at the end) places it to the east of Mahoba, below GitrakQta.
verses.hindi: हे द्विजो! इस प्रकार जलसे अपने मस्तकपर अभिषेक करके त्रिनेत्र तथा पंचमुख परमेश्वर महादेवका हृदयमें ध्यान करना चाहिए और अपने गृह्मसूत्रकी रीतिके अनुसार आचमन करना चाहिए। तदनन्तर पवित्र स्थानमें सुन्दर आसनपर बैठकर हाथमें पवित्रक लेकर उस कुशके द्वारा दाहिने हाथसे अपने ऊपर जल छिड्के। पुनः जल लेकर तीन बार आचमन करके सभी हिंसा तथा पापोंके शमनके लिये आलस्यरहित
verses.wordMeaning: Kalanjara: The.WM. (III. 85, 56) associates Kalafljara with Gitrakilta. According to this reference, it lies in the Madhya Bh&rata terri- tory formerly known as Bundelkharta. Cunningham (A.G. sec map at the end) places it to the east of Mahoba, below GitrakQta.
verses.commentary: Sense: Kalanjara: The.WM. (III. 85, 56) associates Kalafljara with Gitrakilta. According to this reference, it lies in the Madhya Bh&rata terri- tory formerly known as Bundelkharta. Cunningham (A.G. sec map at the end) places it to the east of Mahoba, below GitrakQta.

verses.sanskrit: तदा चापि भविष्यामि कङ्को नाम महातपाः अनुग्रहार्थं लोकानां योगात्मैककलागतिः
verses.transliteration: tadā cāpi bhaviṣyāmi kaṅko nāma mahātapāḥ anugrahārthaṃ lokānāṃ yogātmaikakalāgatiḥ
verses.translation: See p. X. note 4.
verses.hindi: होकर अपने स्थानपर घूमते हुए प्रदक्षिणा करनी चाहिए । है श्रेष्ठ द्विजो! इस प्रकार मैंने सभी ब्राह्मणोंके कल्याणके लिये संक्षेपमें स्नान तथा आचमनके अत्युत्तम सर्वेषां ब्राह्मणानां तु हितार्थे द्विजसत्तमाः॥ २९  विधानका वर्णन कर दिया॥ २५--२९॥
verses.wordMeaning: See p. X. note 4.
verses.commentary: Sense: See p. X. note 4.

verses.sanskrit: चत्वारस्तु महाभागा विमलाः शुद्धयोनयः शिष्या मम भविष्यन्ति योगात्मानो दृढव्रताः
verses.transliteration: catvārastu mahābhāgā vimalāḥ śuddhayonayaḥ śiṣyā mama bhaviṣyanti yogātmāno dṛḍhavratāḥ
verses.translation: Bhadravata: Cf. SP. SRS. 5. 39. This town has not been identi- fied so far.
verses.hindi: भगवती गायत्रीका आवाहन तथा जप, सूर्यकी प्रार्थना, सूर्यसूक्तोंका पाठ, देव-ऋषि- पितृतर्पण, पंचमहायज्ञोंका अनुष्ठान, भस्मस्नान एवं मन्त्रस्नान आवाहयेत्ततो देवीं गायत्रीं वेदमातरम्। आयातु वरदा देवीत्यनेनैव महेश्वरीम्
verses.wordMeaning: Bhadravata: Cf. SP. SRS. 5. 39. This town has not been identi- fied so far.
verses.commentary: Sense: Bhadravata: Cf. SP. SRS. 5. 39. This town has not been identi- fied so far.

verses.sanskrit: सनकः सनन्दनश् चैव प्रभुर्यश् च सनातनः विभुः सनत्कुमारश् च निर्ममा निरहंकृताः
verses.transliteration: sanakaḥ sanandanaś caiva prabhuryaś ca sanātanaḥ vibhuḥ sanatkumāraś ca nirmamā nirahaṃkṛtāḥ
verses.translation: It is a celebrated place of pilgrimage in Sauratra, the southern part of Kathiawar.
verses.hindi: नन्दिकेश्वर बोले है सनत्कुमार! इस विधिसे स्नान करनेके पश्चात् 'आयातु वरदा देवी' इस चाहिए और पुन: पाद्य, आचमन, अर्घ्य आदि अर्पित करना चाहिए। पुन: तीन बार प्राणायाम करके बैठे- बैठे अथवा खड़े होकर एक हजार अथवा पाँच सौ अथवा एक सौ आठ बार गायत्रीजप प्रणवके साथ नियमपूर्वक
verses.wordMeaning: It is a celebrated place of pilgrimage in Sauratra, the southern part of Kathiawar.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is a celebrated place of pilgrimage in Sauratra, the southern part of Kathiawar.

verses.sanskrit: मत्समीपमुपेष्यन्ति पुनरावृत्तिदुर्लभम् परीवर्ते पुनः षष्ठे मृत्युर्व्यासो यदा विभुः
verses.transliteration: matsamīpamupeṣyanti punarāvṛttidurlabham parīvarte punaḥ ṣaṣṭhe mṛtyurvyāso yadā vibhuḥ
verses.translation: Dvaip&yana Vyasa: Sec note 6.
verses.hindi: करना चाहिए। इन तीनोंमें किसी एक विधिसे ही जप करना चाहिए॥ १--३॥ उत्तमे शिखरे देवीत्युक्त्वोद्वास्य च मातरम् ॥ ४ हिप सूर्यको अर्ध्य देकर उनका पूजनकर सिर झुकाकर अर्घ्य देकर उनका पूजनकर सिर झुकाकर
verses.wordMeaning: Dvaip&yana Vyasa: Sec note 6.
verses.commentary: Sense: Dvaip&yana Vyasa: Sec note 6.

verses.sanskrit: तदाप्यहं भविष्यामि लोगाक्षीर् नाम नामतः तत्रापि मम ते शिष्या योगात्मानो दृढव्रताः
verses.transliteration: tadāpyahaṃ bhaviṣyāmi logākṣīr nāma nāmataḥ tatrāpi mama te śiṣyā yogātmāno dṛḍhavratāḥ
verses.translation: tvaya sardham ca Visnuna. ST. construes tvaya with Visnuna (tvaya Visnuna sSrdham) and thus excludes Brahma.
verses.hindi: मो रुद्राय नम: कालाय नम: कलविकरणाय नमो भ्यः सर्वेभ्यः सर्वशर्वेभ्यो नमस्तेऽस्तु रुद्ररूपेभ्यः ॥ (घ) तत्पुरुषाय
verses.wordMeaning: tvaya sardham ca Visnuna. ST. construes tvaya with Visnuna (tvaya Visnuna sSrdham) and thus excludes Brahma.
verses.commentary: Sense: tvaya sardham ca Visnuna. ST. construes tvaya with Visnuna (tvaya Visnuna sSrdham) and thus excludes Brahma.

verses.sanskrit: भविष्यन्ति महाभागाश् चत्वारो लोकसंमताः सुधामा विरजाश्चैव शङ्खपाद्रज एव च
verses.transliteration: bhaviṣyanti mahābhāgāś catvāro lokasaṃmatāḥ sudhāmā virajāścaiva śaṅkhapādraja eva ca
verses.translation: Meru: It is situated in the centre of the earth. It is described in the Puratias as the four-armed svastika, evolving in four directions, each with seven constituent members. It can be identified with the highland of Tartary, north of the Himalayas. It is variously called Su-meru, HemUdri (the golden mountain), RatnasSnu (jewel-peaked), Karnikacala (lotus mountain), Amaradri, Deva-parvata, 'mountain of the Gods'. On its extent and identification with the Great Pamir knot of Asia, see The Geography of the Puranas: — S. M. ALI. Ch. III. p -5S.
verses.hindi: विद्महे महादेवाय धीमहि। तन्नो रुद्र: प्रचोदयात्॥ (ङ) ईशान: सर्वविद्यानामीश्वरः सर्वभूतानां ब्रह्माधिपतिर््ह्मणोऽधिपतिर््ह्म शिवो मे अस्तु सदाशिवोम् ॥
verses.wordMeaning: Meru: It is situated in the centre of the earth. It is described in the Puratias as the four-armed svastika, evolving in four directions, each with seven constituent members. It can be identified with the highland of Tartary, north of the Himalayas.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Meru: It is situated in the centre of the earth. It is described in the Puratias as the four-armed svastika, evolving in four directions, each with seven constituent members. It can be identified with the highland of Tartary, north of the Himalayas.…

verses.sanskrit: योगात्मानो महात्मानः सर्वे वै दग्धकिल्बिषाः ते ऽपि तेनैव मार्गेण ध्यानयोगसमन्विताः
verses.transliteration: yogātmāno mahātmānaḥ sarve vai dagdhakilbiṣāḥ te 'pi tenaiva mārgeṇa dhyānayogasamanvitāḥ
verses.translation: All these enlightened souls will be the devotees of Siva and will have their bodies smeared with ashes. They will be perpetually engaged in worshipping Lihga. They will be steadfast and firm in body and the mind. With devotion towards me and by means of yoga they will be established in meditation and acquire self-control. The great Paiupata yoga can snap worldly ties and illuminate the path of knowledge. It is also conducive to Real knowledge. There are several paths of yoga and several paths of knowledge. But without taking recourse to the five-syllabled Mantra® one cannot attain eternal bliss. When a person performs penance eschew- ing Dvandvas (mutually clashing opposites) he can be- come a liberated soul, as one who has attained the ripe fruit. Even if a man performs Paupata rite for a single day he can obtain fruits, the like of which he cannot have either by Panca- rat ra Qj. Saiikhya.
verses.hindi: भगवती गायत्रीका आवाहन तथा जप-“भस्मस्नान एवं मन्त्रस्तान फफफफफफफफफफ प पा फफ फ फा पाक फा का फा फ क फा फ फ फा फ फ फा फ फ फ फ फ क फ फ फा फ फ फ
verses.wordMeaning: All these enlightened souls will be the devotees of Siva and will have their bodies smeared with ashes. They will be perpetually engaged in worshipping Lihga. They will be steadfast and firm in body and the mind.…
verses.commentary: Sense: All these enlightened souls will be the devotees of Siva and will have their bodies smeared with ashes. They will be perpetually engaged in worshipping Lihga. They will be steadfast and firm in body and the mind.…

verses.sanskrit: मत्समीपं गमिष्यन्ति पुनरावृत्तिदुर्लभम् सप्तमे परिवर्ते तु यदा व्यासः शतक्रतुः
verses.transliteration: matsamīpaṃ gamiṣyanti punarāvṛttidurlabham saptame parivarte tu yadā vyāsaḥ śatakratuḥ
verses.translation: On hearing about the incarnations of Rudra described thus by the supreme lord, Lord Brahma, of great splendour bowed to him and eulogised him with pleasing words. Then he spoke to lord Siva.
verses.hindi: प्राच्यालोक्याभिवन्दयेशां गायत्रीं वेदमातरम्। कृताञ्जलिपुटो भूत्वा प्रार्थयेद्भास्करं तथा अभिवन्द्य पुनः सूर्य ब्रह्माणं च विधानतः
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing about the incarnations of Rudra described thus by the supreme lord, Lord Brahma, of great splendour bowed to him and eulogised him with pleasing words. Then he spoke to lord Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing about the incarnations of Rudra described thus by the supreme lord, Lord Brahma, of great splendour bowed to him and eulogised him with pleasing words. Then he spoke to lord Siva.

verses.sanskrit: विभुनामा महातेजाः प्रथितः पूर्वजन्मनि तदाप्यहं भविष्यामि कलौ तस्मिन् युगान्तिके
verses.transliteration: vibhunāmā mahātejāḥ prathitaḥ pūrvajanmani tadāpyahaṃ bhaviṣyāmi kalau tasmin yugāntike
verses.translation: The five-syllabled mantra of Siva: namal Siv&ya.
verses.hindi: अभिवन्द्य पुनः सूर्य ब्रह्माणं च विभावसुम् ८ सर्वानावाहयामीति देवानावाह्य सर्वतः
verses.wordMeaning: The five-syllabled mantra of Siva: namal Siv&ya.
verses.commentary: Sense: The five-syllabled mantra of Siva: namal Siv&ya.

verses.sanskrit: जैगीषव्यो विभुः ख्यातः सर्वेषां योगिनां वरः तत्रापि मम ते पुत्रा भविष्यन्ति युगे तथा
verses.transliteration: jaigīṣavyo vibhuḥ khyātaḥ sarveṣāṃ yogināṃ varaḥ tatrāpi mama te putrā bhaviṣyanti yuge tathā
verses.translation: Paiicar&tra — a name of the sacred books of the various Vainava
verses.hindi: देवानां पुष्पतोयेन ऋषीणां तु कुशाम्भसा। पितृणां तिलतोयेन गन्धयुक्तेन सर्वतः यज्ञोपवीती देवानां निवीती ऋषितर्पणम्।
verses.wordMeaning: Paiicar&tra — a name of the sacred books of the various Vainava
verses.commentary: Sense: Paiicar&tra — a name of the sacred books of the various Vainava

verses.sanskrit: सारस्वतश् च मेघश् च मेघवाहः सुवाहनः ते ऽपि तेनैव मार्गेण ध्यानयोगपरायणाः
verses.transliteration: sārasvataś ca meghaś ca meghavāhaḥ suvāhanaḥ te 'pi tenaiva mārgeṇa dhyānayogaparāyaṇāḥ
verses.translation: On hearing the words of Brahma lord Siva was delighted on account of the weighty relevancy of the question. He looked at him as if he would drink him through his eyes. Facing him, he then described the method of worship of the Lihga. It was after worshipping the Lihga in accordance with the instructions that you (Brahma), Visnu and Indra, the best of Devas and the sages, had attained their respective status. O lord, hence they continue to worship me further. There cannot be steadiness®® m piety without the worship of the Lihga; hence lord Visnu worships me perpetually with due devotion and faith.
verses.hindi: प्रणाम करके 'उत्तमे शिखरे देवी'' ऐसा कहकर माताका विसर्जन करके पूर्व दिशामें देखते हुए वेदमाता महेश्वरी गायत्रीका अभिवन्दन करके दोनों हाथ जोड़कर सूर्यकी प्रार्थना करनी चाहिए। “उदुत्यं जातवेदसम्” तथा 'चित्रं देवानाम्'२--इन मन्त्रोंसे सूर्य तथा ब्रह्माको नमस्कार करके ऋग्वेद, यजुर्वेद तथा सामवेदके सूर्यसम्बन्धी सूक्तोंका विधानपूर्वक पाठ करके तीन बार सूर्यदेवकी प्रदक्षिणा करनी चाहिए ॥ ४--७॥
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing the words of Brahma lord Siva was delighted on account of the weighty relevancy of the question. He looked at him as if he would drink him through his eyes. Facing him, he then described the method of worship of the Lihga.…
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the words of Brahma lord Siva was delighted on account of the weighty relevancy of the question. He looked at him as if he would drink him through his eyes. Facing him, he then described the method of worship of the Lihga.…

verses.hindi: इसके बाद आत्मा, अन्तरात्मा तथा परमात्माका ध्यान करके सूर्य, ब्रह्मा एबं अग्निको प्रणाम करना चाहिए। पुनः मुनियों, पितरों तथा देवताओं-सभीका उनका अपने नामसे आवाहन करे। सबको आवाहित करके पूर्वमुख अथवा उत्तरमुख होकर उनके तत्त्वों तथा स्वरूपोंका ध्यान करके विधिपूर्वक क्रमसे तीर्थके जलसे तर्पण करना चाहिए और अन्तमें प्रणाम करना चाहिए॥ ८--१० ॥
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing the words of Brahma lord Siva was delighted on account of the weighty relevancy of the question. He looked at him as if he would drink him through his eyes. Facing him, he then described the method of worship of the Lihga.…

verses.hindi: पुष्पयुक्त जलसे देवताओंका, कुशयुक्त जलसे ऋषियोंका तथा तिल और गन्धयुक्त जलसे पितरोंका तर्पण करना चाहिए हे विप्रेन्द्र ! यज्ञोपवीती अर्थात् सव्य होकर देवतर्पण, निवीती अर्थात् कण्ठमें यज्ञोपवीत धारण करके ऋषितर्पण

verses.sanskrit: बाष्कलश् च महायोगी धर्मात्मानो महौजसः प्राप्य माहेश्वरं योगं ज्ञानिनो दग्धकिल्बिषाः
verses.transliteration: bāṣkalaś ca mahāyogī dharmātmāno mahaujasaḥ prāpya māheśvaraṃ yogaṃ jñānino dagdhakilbiṣāḥ

verses.hindi: १. ३७ उत्तमे शिखरे देवी भूम्या पर्वतमूर्धनि । ब्राह्मणेभ्यो5 भ्यनुज्ञाता गच्छ देवि यथासुखम्॥ २. ३ॐ उदु त्यं जातवेदसं देवं वहन्ति केतवः॥ दृशे विश्वाय सूर्यम्॥ (यजु० ७। ४१) ३. ३ चित्रं देवानामुदगादनीकं चक्षुमित्रस्य वरुणस्याग्नेः  आप्रा द्यावापृथिवी अन्तरिक्ष सूर्य आत्मा जगतस्तस्थुषश्च ॥ (यजु० ७। ४२) ह हक वै धीमांस्तर्पयेह्देवतर्पणम्। कनिष्ठाङ्गलिना श्रोत्रियः सर्वसिद्धये

It was after worshipping the Lihga in accordance with the instructions that you (Brahma), Visnu and Indra, the best of Devas and the sages, had attained their respective status. O lord, hence they continue to worship me further. There cannot be steadiness®® m piety without the worship of the Lihga; hence lord Visnu worships me perpetually with due devotion and faith.
verses.hindi: सूतजी बोले--  है क्रषिगण! उन सनत्कुमारका यह वचन सुनकर श्रुतिसारविदोंमें वरिष्ठ शिलादपुत्र भगवान् नन्दिकेश्वर कुछ-कुछ हँसते हुए उनसे कहने लगे शैलादि बोले--एक बार घने देवदारुवनमें देवाधिदेव रुद्रकी प्रसन्नताके लिये अपने स्त्री-पुत्रादिसहित पंचाग्निका
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing the words of Brahma lord Siva was delighted on account of the weighty relevancy of the question. He looked at him as if he would drink him through his eyes. Facing him, he then described the method of worship of the Lihga.…
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the words of Brahma lord Siva was delighted on account of the weighty relevancy of the question. He looked at him as if he would drink him through his eyes. Facing him, he then described the method of worship of the Lihga.…

verses.sanskrit: कथं पूज्यो महादेवो लिङ्गमूर्तिर्महेश्वरः वक्तुमर्हसि चास्माकं रोमहर्षण सांप्रतम्
verses.transliteration: kathaṃ pūjyo mahādevo liṅgamūrtirmaheśvaraḥ vaktumarhasi cāsmākaṃ romaharṣaṇa sāṃpratam
verses.translation: O Romaharsana,'®® how is the great lord to be wor- shipped in his Lihga-form? Please explain this to us now. Suta said:
verses.hindi: सेवन करते हुए मुनिगण कठोर तप कर रहे थे करते हुए मुनिगण कठोर तप कर रहे थे देवदारुवनका वृत्तान्तसंन्यासधर्मका वर्णन
verses.wordMeaning: O Romaharsana,'®® how is the great lord to be wor- shipped in his Lihga-form? Please explain this to us now. Suta said:
verses.commentary: Sense: O Romaharsana,'®® how is the great lord to be wor- shipped in his Lihga-form? Please explain this to us now. Suta said:

verses.sanskrit: देव्या पृष्टो महादेवः कैलासे तां नगात्मजाम् अङ्कस्थामाह देवेशो लिङ्गार्चनविधिं क्रमात्
verses.transliteration: devyā pṛṣṭo mahādevaḥ kailāse tāṃ nagātmajām aṅkasthāmāha deveśo liṅgārcanavidhiṃ kramāt
verses.translation: At Kailaa®® the great lord was asked the same by the Goddess Parvati, the daughter of the lord of the Himalaya, who was seated on his lap. The lord, then, described to her the procedure of worshipping the Lihga.
verses.hindi: फफफफफफफफफफफफफफफफफफफफफफफ ऑर्शार्शर्शर्शरधशााार्शर्शाोरशरिशाोणिणिण्णा्ाा सा न सीसीाचापाताधापापापापापापापाफापापापापापाफफफफफफफफापाफापाफापापापायाचाथाचालााचालाचाचीची सा तत फ़फफफफफफपाफफफफफफफफफफफफफफफफफपापाफपाफफफपापापाफाफाफाफफफफ तुष्टो रुद्रो जगन्नाथश्चेकितानो वृषध्वज:।
verses.wordMeaning: At Kailaa®® the great lord was asked the same by the Goddess Parvati, the daughter of the lord of the Himalaya, who was seated on his lap. The lord, then, described to her the procedure of worshipping the Lihga.
verses.commentary: Sense: At Kailaa®® the great lord was asked the same by the Goddess Parvati, the daughter of the lord of the Himalaya, who was seated on his lap. The lord, then, described to her the procedure of worshipping the Lihga.

verses.sanskrit: तदा पार्श्वे स्थितो नन्दी शालङ्कायनकात्मजः श्रुत्वाखिलं पुरा प्राह ब्रह्मपुत्राय सुव्रताः
verses.transliteration: tadā pārśve sthito nandī śālaṅkāyanakātmajaḥ śrutvākhilaṃ purā prāha brahmaputrāya suvratāḥ
verses.translation: m$tha — niscala-sth&nam ST, a permanent abode.
verses.hindi: उनके तपसे प्रसन्न जगन्नाथ, चेकितान, वृषध्वज, धूर्जटिः परमेशानो भगवान्नीललोहित: ॥ ६  धूर्जटि, परमेशान, नीललोहित भगवान् रुद्र दारुवनमें
verses.wordMeaning: m$tha — niscala-sth&nam ST, a permanent abode.
verses.commentary: Sense: m$tha — niscala-sth&nam ST, a permanent abode.

verses.sanskrit: सनत्कुमाराय शुभं लिङ्गार्चनविधिं परम् तस्माद्व्यासो महातेजाः श्रुतवाञ्छ्रुतिसंमितम्
verses.transliteration: sanatkumārāya śubhaṃ liṅgārcanavidhiṃ param tasmādvyāso mahātejāḥ śrutavāñchrutisaṃmitam
verses.translation: See p, 2 note 7.
verses.hindi: निवृत्तिलक्षणज्ञानप्रतिष्ठार्थ च शङ्करः। देवदारुवनस्थानां प्रवृत्तिज्ञानचेतसाम् मन्दस्मितं च भगवान् स्त्रीणां मनसिजोद्भवम्। भ्रूविलासं च गानं च चकारातीव सुन्दरः
verses.wordMeaning: See p, 2 note 7.
verses.commentary: Sense: See p, 2 note 7.

verses.sanskrit: स्नानयोगोपचारं च यथा शैलादिनो मुखात् श्रुतवान् तत्प्रवक्ष्यामि स्नानाद्यं चार्चनाविधिम्
verses.transliteration: snānayogopacāraṃ ca yathā śailādino mukhāt śrutavān tatpravakṣyāmi snānādyaṃ cārcanāvidhim
verses.translation: Mount Kailasa is a part of the Himalayan range lying to the north of M&nasa-sarovara, not far off from the source of Ghogra (Sarayu) river. The detailed description of the mount is found in the Matsya P, Gh. 121.
verses.hindi: अनङ्गवृद्धिमकरोदतीव मधुराकृतिः दृष्ट्वा काश्चिद्भवं नार्यो मदधघूर्णितलोचना: । विलासबाह्यास्ताश्चापि भ्रूविलासं प्रचक्रिरे
verses.wordMeaning: Mount Kailasa is a part of the Himalayan range lying to the north of M&nasa-sarovara, not far off from the source of Ghogra (Sarayu) river. The detailed description of the mount is found in the Matsya P, Gh. 121.
verses.commentary: Sense: Mount Kailasa is a part of the Himalayan range lying to the north of M&nasa-sarovara, not far off from the source of Ghogra (Sarayu) river. The detailed description of the mount is found in the Matsya P, Gh. 121.

verses.sanskrit: अथ स्नानविधिं वक्ष्ये ब्राह्मणानां हिताय च सर्वपापहरं साक्षाच् छिवेन कथितं पुरा
verses.transliteration: atha snānavidhiṃ vakṣye brāhmaṇānāṃ hitāya ca sarvapāpaharaṃ sākṣāc chivena kathitaṃ purā
verses.translation: At that time, Nandin the son of Salahkayana was standing nearby. O sages of good rites, he heard everything and mentioned it to Brahma's son Sanat. From him Vyasa of great refulgence received the great discourse on the worship of the Lihga, as also the bathing and other rites, as declared in the Vedas. I shall recount the same in the manner he heard it orally from Nandin.
verses.hindi: किञ्चिद्विसतरस्तवसनाः स्त्रस्तकाञ्चीगुणा जगुः काश्चित्तदा तं विपिने तु दृष्ट्या
verses.wordMeaning: At that time, Nandin the son of Salahkayana was standing nearby. O sages of good rites, he heard everything and mentioned it to Brahma's son Sanat. From him Vyasa of great refulgence received the great discourse on the worship of the Lihga, as also the bathing and other rites,…
verses.commentary: Sense: At that time, Nandin the son of Salahkayana was standing nearby. O sages of good rites, he heard everything and mentioned it to Brahma's son Sanat. From him Vyasa of great refulgence received the great discourse on the worship of the Lihga, as also the bathing and other rites,…

verses.sanskrit: अनेन विधिना स्नात्वा सकृत्पूज्य च शङ्करम् ब्रह्मकूर्चं च पीत्वा तु सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: anena vidhinā snātvā sakṛtpūjya ca śaṅkaram brahmakūrcaṃ ca pītvā tu sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate
verses.translation: Henceforth, for the welfare of the brahmins, 1 shall recount the rules of procedure for the sacred ablution, which is destructive of all sins. Formerly it was declared by lord Siva himself.
verses.hindi: काचित्तदा तं न विवेद दृष्ट्वा विवासना स्रस्तमहांशुका च। निवास करनेवाले उन मुनियोंके प्रवृत्ति-लक्षण तथा ज्ञानकी जानकारी करनेके लिये एवं उनमें श्रद्धाभावकी परीक्षा करनेके लिये और साथ ही प्रवृत्तिज्ञानसे युक्त चित्तवाले उन देवदारुवनवासी मुनियोंमें निवृत्ति-लक्षण
verses.wordMeaning: Henceforth, for the welfare of the brahmins, 1 shall recount the rules of procedure for the sacred ablution, which is destructive of all sins. Formerly it was declared by lord Siva himself.
verses.commentary: Sense: Henceforth, for the welfare of the brahmins, 1 shall recount the rules of procedure for the sacred ablution, which is destructive of all sins. Formerly it was declared by lord Siva himself.

verses.sanskrit: त्रिविधं स्नानमाख्यातं देवदेवेन शंभुना हिताय ब्राह्मणाद्यानां चतुर्मुखसुतोत्तम
verses.transliteration: trividhaṃ snānamākhyātaṃ devadevena śaṃbhunā hitāya brāhmaṇādyānāṃ caturmukhasutottama
verses.translation: By taking holy bath in accordance with this procedure, by worshipping lord!§iva and by observing Brahmakurca at a time, one is liberated from sins.
verses.hindi: तथा ज्ञान स्थापित करनेके निमित्त लीलापूर्वक विकृत रूप धारण करके अलौकिक दारुवनमें पहुँचे। उस समय शंकरजी कृष्ण वर्णवाले, दो भुजाओंवाले, तीन आँखोंवाले, अत्यन्त सुन्दर रूपवाले भगवान् शिव मन्द मुसकान तथा भ्रूविलास करते हुए गीत गाकर स््त्रयोंमें कामभावना उत्पन्न कर रहे थे
verses.wordMeaning: By taking holy bath in accordance with this procedure, by worshipping lord!§iva and by observing Brahmakurca at a time, one is liberated from sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: By taking holy bath in accordance with this procedure, by worshipping lord!§iva and by observing Brahmakurca at a time, one is liberated from sins.

verses.sanskrit: वारुणं पुरतः कृत्वा ततश्चाग्नेयमुत्तमम् मन्त्रस्नानं ततः कृत्वा पूजयेत्परमेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: vāruṇaṃ purataḥ kṛtvā tataścāgneyamuttamam mantrasnānaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā pūjayetparameśvaram
verses.translation: O most excellent among the sons of Brahma, three types of ablution are enjoined by Siva, the lord of Devas, for the wel- fare of the brahmins and others.
verses.hindi: कामदेवका संहार करनेवाले तथा अत्यन्त मोहक आकृतिवाले भगवान् शिव वहाँ नारीसमूहको बार-बार देखकर उनके भीतर कामभावनाको बढ़ा रहे थे बनमें उस विकृत तथा नीललोहित वर्णवाले पुरुषको देखकर पतिव्रता स्त्रियाँ भी प्रेमपूर्वक उनके पीछे-पीछे चलने लगीं
verses.wordMeaning: O most excellent among the sons of Brahma, three types of ablution are enjoined by Siva, the lord of Devas, for the wel- fare of the brahmins and others.
verses.commentary: Sense: O most excellent among the sons of Brahma, three types of ablution are enjoined by Siva, the lord of Devas, for the wel- fare of the brahmins and others.

verses.sanskrit: भावदुष्टो ऽम्भसि स्नात्वा भस्मना च न शुध्यति भावशुद्धश्चरेच्छौचम् अन्यथा न समाचरेत्
verses.transliteration: bhāvaduṣṭo 'mbhasi snātvā bhasmanā ca na śudhyati bhāvaśuddhaścarecchaucam anyathā na samācaret
verses.translation: One shall at the outset perform the watery bath and then the sacred ash-bath® and thereafter the Mantra ablution and then the worship of the lord. One who is defiled in emotions and feelings is not purified even after taking bath in water or after applying ashes. Only one who is emotionally pure will proceed with purificatory rites and not otherwise.
verses.hindi: आरण्यक कुटीरोंके द्वारतक आयी हुई स्त्रियोंके वस्त्र एवं अलंकार शिथिल हो गये। वे मूच्छित-सी हो गयीं, उन लीलामय शिवके मुखारविन्दको मोहक मुसकानको पाकर वृक्षोंके आश्रयमें रहनेवाली वे नारियाँ उनके पीछे-पीछे चल दीं
verses.wordMeaning: One shall at the outset perform the watery bath and then the sacred ash-bath® and thereafter the Mantra ablution and then the worship of the lord. One who is defiled in emotions and feelings is not purified even after taking bath in water or after applying ashes.…
verses.commentary: Sense: One shall at the outset perform the watery bath and then the sacred ash-bath® and thereafter the Mantra ablution and then the worship of the lord. One who is defiled in emotions and feelings is not purified even after taking bath in water or after applying ashes.…

verses.sanskrit: सरित्सरस्तडागेषु सर्वेष्व् आ प्रलयं नरः स्नात्वापि भावदुष्टश्चेन् न शुध्यति न संशयः
verses.transliteration: saritsarastaḍāgeṣu sarveṣv ā pralayaṃ naraḥ snātvāpi bhāvaduṣṭaścen na śudhyati na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: The lotus-like mind of man is asleep due to Tamas. When it is wakened up by the refulgence of knowledge, man becomes pure®*.
verses.hindi: शिवजीको देखकर प्रौढावस्थावाली होनेपर भी कुछ स्त्रियाँ मदमत्त होकर आँखें घुमाने लगीं तथा भौंहोंका संचालन करने लगीं तदनन्तर शिवको देखकर दूसरी स्त्रियाँ मुसकानयुक्त मुखवाली हो गयीं, उनके वस्त्र कुछ शिथिल-से हो गये, कांचीबन्धन भी ढीले हो गये; वे मिलकर गाने लगीं
verses.wordMeaning: The lotus-like mind of man is asleep due to Tamas. When it is wakened up by the refulgence of knowledge, man becomes pure®*.
verses.commentary: Sense: The lotus-like mind of man is asleep due to Tamas. When it is wakened up by the refulgence of knowledge, man becomes pure®*.

verses.sanskrit: नृणां हि चित्तकमलं प्रबुद्धमभवद्यदा प्रसुप्तं तमसा ज्ञानभानोर्भासा तदा शुचिः
verses.transliteration: nṛṇāṃ hi cittakamalaṃ prabuddhamabhavadyadā prasuptaṃ tamasā jñānabhānorbhāsā tadā śuciḥ
verses.translation: The devotee shall take clay, cowdung®', gingelly
verses.hindi: उस समय शिवको विपिनमें देखकर कुछ ऋषिपत्नियाँ तो शिथिल नूतन वस्त्रों तथा अपने-अपने विचित्र वलयोंको फॅंककर मदान्वित हो स्वजनोंके पास पहुँचीं उस समय शिथिल वस्त्रवाली कोई तो शिवको
verses.wordMeaning: The devotee shall take clay, cowdung®', gingelly
verses.commentary: Sense: The devotee shall take clay, cowdung®', gingelly

verses.sanskrit: मृच्छकृत्तिलपुष्पं च स्नानार्थं भसितं तथा आदाय तीरे निःक्षिप्य स्नानतीर्थे कुशानि च
verses.transliteration: mṛcchakṛttilapuṣpaṃ ca snānārthaṃ bhasitaṃ tathā ādāya tīre niḥkṣipya snānatīrthe kuśāni ca
verses.translation: It is a kind of penance in the observance of which the five products of the cow (paheagavya) arc eaten.
verses.hindi: श्रीलिड्रमहापुराण  पूर्वभाग काश्‍चिज्जगुस्तं ननृतुर्निपेतुश्च धरातले। निषेदुर्गजवच्चान्या प्रोवाच द्विजपुङ्गवाः
verses.wordMeaning: It is a kind of penance in the observance of which the five products of the cow (paheagavya) arc eaten.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is a kind of penance in the observance of which the five products of the cow (paheagavya) arc eaten.

verses.sanskrit: प्रक्षाल्याचम्य पादौ च मलं देहाद्विशोध्य च द्रव्यैस्तु तीरदेशस्थैस् ततः स्नानं समाचरेत्
verses.transliteration: prakṣālyācamya pādau ca malaṃ dehādviśodhya ca dravyaistu tīradeśasthais tataḥ snānaṃ samācaret
verses.translation: This verse is a fine piece of poetical composition involving metaphor.
verses.hindi: अन्योन्यं सस्मितं परेक्ष्य चालिलिङ्गः समन्ततः। निरुध्य मार्ग रुद्रस्य नैपुणानि प्रचक्रिरे को भवानिति चाहुस्तं आस्यतामिति चापराः। कुत्रेत्यथ प्रसीदेति जजल्पुः प्रीतमानसाः
verses.wordMeaning: This verse is a fine piece of poetical composition involving metaphor.
verses.commentary: Sense: This verse is a fine piece of poetical composition involving metaphor.

verses.sanskrit: उद्धृतासीतिमन्त्रेण पुनर्देहं विशोधयेत् मृदादाय ततश्चान्यद् वस्त्रं स्नात्वा ह्यनुल्बणम्
verses.transliteration: uddhṛtāsītimantreṇa punardehaṃ viśodhayet mṛdādāya tataścānyad vastraṃ snātvā hyanulbaṇam
verses.translation: Repeating the Mantra "Uddhrtasi"® he shall clean the body again with a small quantity of clay and wearing another cloth he shall bathe. Repeating the Mantra "Gandha- dvaram Duradharsam"® he shall smear himself with the cowdung of the tawny cow gathered even before it touches the ground.
verses.hindi: दृष्ट्वा नारीकुलं विप्रास्तथाभूतं च शङ्करम्। अतीव परुषं वाक्यं जजल्पुस्ते मुनीश्वराः तपांसि तेषां सर्वेषां प्रत्याहन्यन्त शङ्करे। यथादित्यप्रकाशेन तारका नभसि स्थिताः
verses.wordMeaning: Repeating the Mantra "Uddhrtasi"® he shall clean the body again with a small quantity of clay and wearing another cloth he shall bathe.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Repeating the Mantra "Uddhrtasi"® he shall clean the body again with a small quantity of clay and wearing another cloth he shall bathe.…

verses.sanskrit: गन्धद्वारां दुराधर्षाम् इति मन्त्रेण मन्त्रवित् कपिलागोमयेनैव खस्थेनैव तु लेपयेत्
verses.transliteration: gandhadvārāṃ durādharṣām iti mantreṇa mantravit kapilāgomayenaiva khasthenaiva tu lepayet
verses.translation: Taking bath again he shall discard the dirty cloth; wear (fresh) white one and perform ablution again. For dis- pelling sins he shall invoke Varuna. He shall then worship the lord by meditation. He shall perform acamana thrice, and then plunge into the holy waters (all the while) thinking about Siva. Again doing acamana he shall inspire the holy water with Mantras. Plunging again into the water he shall repeat the Aghamarsana® Mantra. With great self- control the devotee shall remember the discs of the sun, moon and fire in that water.
verses.hindi: श्रूयते ऋषिशापेन ब्रह्मणस्तु महात्मनः। समृद्धश्रेयसां योनिर्यज्ञो वै नाशमाप्तवान् शापेन विष्णु: परमवीर्यवान्

verses.transliteration: punaḥ snātvā parityajya tadvastraṃ malinaṃ tataḥ śuklavastraparīdhāno bhūtvā snānaṃ samācaret
verses.translation: O brahmins, while pouring water over his head, he shall repeat these mantras remembering the forms of the respective deities (invoked therein) and the sages concerned for increase of his holiness. The mantras include Rudra,® Pava- mana what is called Tvarita, two Santimantras*® and the man- tra 'an no devi, and the five holy mantras* of Sadyojata.
verses.hindi: इन्द्रस्यापि च धर्मज्ञ छिन्नं सवृषणं पुरा। ऋषिणा गौतमेनोर्व्यां क्रुद्धेन विनिपातितम्

verses.translation: Udhrtsi Varahena TA- 10. 1.8; Mahan u. 4.5.
verses.hindi: देखकर विशिष्ट वासनायुक्त हो गयी तथा अन्य स्त्रि मतवाली-सी होकर विचित्र शाखावाले प्रसिद्ध वृक्षोको एवं घनिष्ठ बन्धुजनोंतकको नहीं पहचानती थीं हे द्विजश्रेष्ठो! कुछ स्त्रियाँ उनके पास जाकर

verses.sanskrit: आचम्य त्रिस्तदा तीर्थे ह्य् अवगाह्य भवं स्मरन् पुनराचम्य विधिवद् अभिमन्त्र्य महाजलम्

verses.translation: gandhadvaraxh durharam TA, 10. 1; Mahan u. 4. 8.
verses.hindi: हाथीकी भाँति बैठ गयीं। कोई दूसरी स्त्री कुछ बोलने लगी मुसकराते हुए एक-दूसरेको देखकर वे परस्पर आलिंगन करने लगीं। वे सभी ओरसे शिवजीका मार्ग रोककर अनेक प्रकारके हाव-भाव दर्शने लगीं
verses.wordMeaning: gandhadvaraxh durharam TA, 10. 1; Mahan u. 4. 8.
verses.commentary: Sense: gandhadvaraxh durharam TA, 10. 1; Mahan u. 4. 8.

verses.sanskrit: अवगाह्य पुनस्तस्मिन् जपेद्वै चाघमर्षणम् तत्तोये भानुसोमाग्निमण्डलं च स्मरेद्वशी
verses.transliteration: avagāhya punastasmin japedvai cāghamarṣaṇam tattoye bhānusomāgnimaṇḍalaṃ ca smaredvaśī
verses.translation: agliamarana: rtaiii ca satyam TA xo. i. 13; Mahan u. 3.5.
verses.hindi: कुछ स्त्रियाँ उनसे कहने लगीं कि 'आप कौन हैं ? बैठिये। अन्य स्त्रियाँ भी प्रसन्नचित्त होकर कहने लगीं-आप कहाँ जा रहे हैं? आप हम सबपर प्रसन्न होइये' भगवान् शंकरको मायाके प्रभावसे अपने पतियोंके सम्मुख ही पतिव्रता स्त्रियोंके वस्त्रपरिधान, केश आदि अस्त-व्यस्त हो गये और वे कामुक स््त्रियोंकी भाँति स्वेच्छाचारितापूर्ण व्यवहार प्रदर्शित करने लगीं
verses.wordMeaning: agliamarana: rtaiii ca satyam TA xo. i. 13; Mahan u. 3.5.
verses.commentary: Sense: agliamarana: rtaiii ca satyam TA xo. i. 13; Mahan u. 3.5.

verses.sanskrit: आचम्य च पुनस्तस्माज् जलादुत्तीर्य मन्त्रवित् प्रविश्य तीर्थमध्ये तु पुनः पुण्यविवृद्धये
verses.transliteration: ācamya ca punastasmāj jalāduttīrya mantravit praviśya tīrthamadhye tu punaḥ puṇyavivṛddhaye
verses.translation: After rinsing his mouth and doing acamana as prescribed in his own Sutra and wearing pavitra in the hand, he shall sit comfortably in a clean spot, sprinkle kua water on his body with his right hand and perform acamana again. Then artfully he shall wheel water round him and perform circumambulation. This will wipe off his sins of violence. O virtuous brahmins, this excellent procedure of ablution and acamana has been succinctly mentioned for your welfare.

Then artfully he shall wheel water round him and perform circumambulation. This will wipe off his sins of violence. O virtuous brahmins, this excellent procedure of ablution and acamana has been succinctly mentioned for your welfare.
verses.hindi: जनार्दन भगवान् विष्णुने वाराणसीपुरीमें पहुँचकर अविमुक्तेश्वर देवाधिदेव त्र्यम्बकेश्वरका दूधसे अभिषेक करके परम श्रद्धासे युक्त होकर देहसंस्मर्शजन्य अमूतस्वरूप क्षीरद्वारा स्वयं उन मधुसूदने ब्रह्माजी एवं मुनियोंके साथ भगवान् शिवको अभिषिक्त करके पूर्ववत् क्षीरसागरको अपना निवासस्थान बनाया
verses.wordMeaning: After rinsing his mouth and doing acamana as prescribed in his own Sutra and wearing pavitra in the hand, he shall sit comfortably in a clean spot, sprinkle kua water on his body with his right hand and perform acamana again.…
verses.commentary: Sense: After rinsing his mouth and doing acamana as prescribed in his own Sutra and wearing pavitra in the hand, he shall sit comfortably in a clean spot, sprinkle kua water on his body with his right hand and perform acamana again.…

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीलिङ्गमहापुराणे पूर्वभागे स्नानविधिर्नाम पञ्चविंशो ऽध्यायः आवाहयेत्ततो देवीं गायत्रीं वेदमातरम् आयातु वरदा देवीत्य् अनेनैव महेश्वरीम्
verses.transliteration: iti śrīliṅgamahāpurāṇe pūrvabhāge snānavidhirnāma pañcaviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ āvāhayettato devīṃ gāyatrīṃ vedamātaram āyātu varadā devīty anenaiva maheśvarīm
verses.translation: Thereafter he should invoke the glorious and great goddess Gayatri the mother of the Vedas, with the mantra; "ayatu varada devi".®
verses.hindi: महात्मा माण्डव्यने धर्मको शापित किया तथा श्रीकृष्णकी प्रेरणासे दुर्वासा आदि महात्माओंके द्वारा वृष्णिवंशी शापित हुए थे महान् आत्मावाले दुर्वासामुनिने लक्ष्मणसहित श्रीरामको शाप दे दिया और श्रीवत्स (श्रीयुक्त वक्षःस्थलवाले) विष्णुको भृगुमुनिका चरण- प्रहार सहना पड़ा
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter he should invoke the glorious and great goddess Gayatri the mother of the Vedas, with the mantra; "ayatu varada devi".®
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter he should invoke the glorious and great goddess Gayatri the mother of the Vedas, with the mantra; "ayatu varada devi".®

verses.sanskrit: पाद्यमाचमनीयं च तस्याश्चार्घ्यं प्रदापयेत् प्राणायामत्रयं कृत्वा समासीनः स्थितो ऽपि वा
verses.transliteration: pādyamācamanīyaṃ ca tasyāścārghyaṃ pradāpayet prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā samāsīnaḥ sthito 'pi vā
verses.translation: He shall offer padya, acamaniya, and arghya. He shall then perform three pranayamas. Thereafter, either sitting or standing he shall repeat the Gayatri along with Pranava Om adopting one of the three modes, viz., repeating it a thousand or five hundred or hundred and eight times.
verses.hindi: देवाधिदेव विरूपाक्ष उमापति शिवको छोड़कर ये तथा अन्य बहुत-से लोग भी विप्रों (ब्राह्मणों)-के वशवर्ती हुए हैं उन्हीं शिवकी मायासे मोहित होनेके कारण वे मुनिगण शंकरको नहीं जान पाये और अत्यन्त कठोर वचन बोलने लगे, फिर भगवान् शिव भी अन्तर्धान हो गये
verses.wordMeaning: He shall offer padya, acamaniya, and arghya. He shall then perform three pranayamas. Thereafter, either sitting or standing he shall repeat the Gayatri along with Pranava Om adopting one of the three modes, viz., repeating it a thousand or five hundred or hundred and eight times.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall offer padya, acamaniya, and arghya. He shall then perform three pranayamas. Thereafter, either sitting or standing he shall repeat the Gayatri along with Pranava Om adopting one of the three modes, viz., repeating it a thousand or five hundred or hundred and eight times.

verses.sanskrit: सहस्रं वा तदर्धं वा शतमष्टोत्तरं तु वा गायत्रीं प्रणवेनैव त्रिविधेष्वेकमाचरेत्
verses.transliteration: sahasraṃ vā tadardhaṃ vā śatamaṣṭottaraṃ tu vā gāyatrīṃ praṇavenaiva trividheṣvekamācaret
verses.translation: He shall offer the arghya again and worship the mother Goddess. He shall bow to her and then ritualistically dismiss her by repeating the mantra "uttame ikhare devi,'*** etc. Looking towards the east and saluting the goddess Gayatri, mother of the Vedas, he shall with the palms joined in reverence, pray to the Sun God repeating the Mantras "Udutyarii Jatavedasam", "Citram" and others. He shall then salute the sun and Brahma in accordance with the injunctions.
verses.hindi: तत्पश्चात् व्याकुल चित्तवाले वे मुनिगण प्रातःकाल होते ही उस दारुवनसे ब्रह्माजीके पास पहुँचे। वहां श्रेष्ठ आसनपर विराजमान महात्मा ब्रह्मासे उस सुन्दर दारुवनमें रहनेवाले क्षीण चेतनावाले मुनियोंने शंकरका सारा फफ फफ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ फ़ फ फ़ फ फ़ फ़ फ फ़ फ फ फ फ़ फ फ क़ पा फ़ फ फ फ़ की फा फा पा फा मा फी फी की फी जी किकाफाफाफ   फफफ फ़
verses.wordMeaning: He shall offer the arghya again and worship the mother Goddess. He shall bow to her and then ritualistically dismiss her by repeating the mantra "uttame ikhare devi,'*** etc. Looking towards the east and saluting the goddess Gayatri, mother of the Vedas,…
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall offer the arghya again and worship the mother Goddess. He shall bow to her and then ritualistically dismiss her by repeating the mantra "uttame ikhare devi,'*** etc. Looking towards the east and saluting the goddess Gayatri, mother of the Vedas,…

verses.sanskrit: अर्घ्यं दत्त्वा समभ्यर्च्य प्रणम्य शिरसा स्वयम् उत्तमे शिखरे देवीत्य् उक्त्वोद्वास्य च मातरम्
verses.transliteration: arghyaṃ dattvā samabhyarcya praṇamya śirasā svayam uttame śikhare devīty uktvodvāsya ca mātaram
verses.translation: ayatu varada devi TA» 10.126.1.
verses.hindi: उन ब्रह्माजीने भी क्षणभरमें ही मनमें सोचकर पवित्र दारुवनमें उनका पूर्वघटित सम्पूर्ण वृत्तान्त जा अपने आसनसे तत्काल उठकर और दोनों हाथ
verses.wordMeaning: ayatu varada devi TA» 10.126.1.
verses.commentary: Sense: ayatu varada devi TA» 10.126.1.

verses.sanskrit: प्राच्यालोक्याभिवन्द्येशां गायत्रीं वेदमातरम् कृताञ्जलिपुटो भूत्वा प्रार्थयेद्भास्करं तथा
verses.transliteration: prācyālokyābhivandyeśāṃ gāyatrīṃ vedamātaram kṛtāñjalipuṭo bhūtvā prārthayedbhāskaraṃ tathā
verses.translation: uttamc iikhare devi ITd. 10. 3.1.
verses.hindi: जोड़कर ब्रह्माजीने मन-ही-मन शिवजीको प्रणाम करके दारुवनमें रहनेवाले उन मुनियोंसे कहा-हे विप्रो! विनाशको प्राप्त तुम सभीको धिक्कार है; क्योंकि सर्वोत्तम निधि प्राप्त करके भी तुम अभागोंने उसे गँवा तुम अलिंगियोंने उस दारुवनमें जिस विकृत आकारवाले पुरुषको देखा था; वे साक्षात् परमेश्वर शिव ही थे
verses.wordMeaning: uttamc iikhare devi ITd. 10. 3.1.
verses.commentary: Sense: uttamc iikhare devi ITd. 10. 3.1.

verses.sanskrit: उदुत्यं च तथा चित्रं जातवेदसमेव च अभिवन्द्य पुनः सूर्यं ब्रह्माणं च विधानतः
verses.transliteration: udutyaṃ ca tathā citraṃ jātavedasameva ca abhivandya punaḥ sūryaṃ brahmāṇaṃ ca vidhānataḥ
verses.translation: He shall repeat the hymns to Surya, from RJk, Yajus and Saman. He shall thereafter circumambulate the sun thrice. He shall then bow to Atman, Antaratman and Paramatman the sun, Brahma and fire.® Thereafter he shall invoke the sage the Pitrs and Devas with their respective names by saying "I am invoking alP*. Then he shall duly perform the tarpana rite facing either east or north after meditating on their actual principal forms and saluting them in due order.
verses.hindi: हे विप्रो! गृहस्थोंको अतिथियोंकी निन्दा कभी नहीं करनी चाहिए; वे अतिथि विकृत रूपवाले, सुन्दर रूपवाले, मलिन तथा मूर्ख--चाहे जैसे भी हों पूर्वकालमें पृथ्वीपर द्विजोंमें अग्रणी सुदर्शनमुनिने अतिथिपूजाके प्रभावसे साक्षात् कालमृत्युको भी जीत लिया था
verses.wordMeaning: He shall repeat the hymns to Surya, from RJk, Yajus and Saman. He shall thereafter circumambulate the sun thrice. He shall then bow to Atman, Antaratman and Paramatman the sun,…
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall repeat the hymns to Surya, from RJk, Yajus and Saman. He shall thereafter circumambulate the sun thrice. He shall then bow to Atman, Antaratman and Paramatman the sun,…

verses.sanskrit: तथा सौराणि सूक्तानि ऋग्यजुःसामजानि च जप्त्वा प्रदक्षिणं पश्चात् त्रिः कृत्वा च विभावसोः
verses.transliteration: tathā saurāṇi sūktāni ṛgyajuḥsāmajāni ca japtvā pradakṣiṇaṃ paścāt triḥ kṛtvā ca vibhāvasoḥ
verses.translation: The tarpana to Devas shall be performed with the water inlaid with flowers, the rites to the sages with the water mixed with Ku4a grass and the rites to the Pitrs with water mixed with gingelly seeds. Scents should be mixed in the water in all cases.
verses.hindi: भवसागरसे पार होने तथा आत्मशुद्धिके लिये त छोड़कर गृहस्थों एवं श्रेष्ठ द्विजोंके लिये लोकमें अन्य कोई भी उपाय नहीं है पूर्वकालमें सुदर्शन नामसे विख्यात गृहस्थ मुनिने मृत्युपर विजय प्राप्त करनेकी प्रतिज्ञा की और अपनी संतानयुक्त पतिव्रता पत्नीसे कहा--हे सुव्रते! हे सुन्दर भौहोंवाली ! है सौभाग्यवति ! सुनो, तुम पूर्ण प्रयलके
verses.wordMeaning: The tarpana to Devas shall be performed with the water inlaid with flowers, the rites to the sages with the water mixed with Ku4a grass and the rites to the Pitrs with water mixed with gingelly seeds. Scents should be mixed in the water in all cases.
verses.commentary: Sense: The tarpana to Devas shall be performed with the water inlaid with flowers, the rites to the sages with the water mixed with Ku4a grass and the rites to the Pitrs with water mixed with gingelly seeds. Scents should be mixed in the water in all cases.

verses.sanskrit: आत्मानं चान्तरात्मानं परमात्मानमेव च अभिवन्द्य पुनः सूर्यं ब्रह्माणं च विभावसुम्
verses.transliteration: ātmānaṃ cāntarātmānaṃ paramātmānameva ca abhivandya punaḥ sūryaṃ brahmāṇaṃ ca vibhāvasum
verses.translation: O leading brahmins, the sacred thread is worn in the usual manner (i.e. over the left shoulder) when the rites to Devas are performed; it is worn like a garland when the tarpana to the sages is performed; it is worn from right shoulder leftward when the tarpana to Pitrs is performed.
verses.hindi: साथ अतिथियोंका सदा सत्कार करना और कभी भी उनका निरादर न करना अतिथि साक्षात् पिनाकधारी शिवका ही स्वरूप होता है, अतएव सब कुछ अर्पित करके भी अतिथिकी पूजा करो  सुदर्शनने पुन: कहा--हे आयें  अतिथि साक्षात् शिव होता है; शिवस्वरूप अतिथिको सब कुछ प्रदान
verses.wordMeaning: O leading brahmins, the sacred thread is worn in the usual manner (i.e. over the left shoulder) when the rites to Devas are performed; it is worn like a garland when the tarpana to the sages is performed;…
verses.commentary: Sense: O leading brahmins, the sacred thread is worn in the usual manner (i.e. over the left shoulder) when the rites to Devas are performed; it is worn like a garland when the tarpana to the sages is performed;…

verses.sanskrit: मुनीन् पितॄन् यथान्यायं स्वनाम्नावाहयेत्ततः सर्वानावाहयामीति देवानावाह्य सर्वतः
verses.transliteration: munīn pitṝn yathānyāyaṃ svanāmnāvāhayettataḥ sarvānāvāhayāmīti devānāvāhya sarvataḥ
verses.translation: For procuring ail achievements the wise devotee who is well versed in the Vedas shall perform tarpana to Devas with waters flowing down the tips of all fingers. He shall per- form tarpana to the sages with waters flowing down the tip of the little finger. He shall perform tarpana to the pitrs with waters flowing down the thumb of the right hand.
verses.hindi: करना चाहिए । अत: सभी अतिथियोंकी सदा पूजा करनी चाहिए ॥ ४८--५० १/ ॥ पतिके ऐसा कहनेपर वह पातिव्रतपरायण मुनिभार्या पतिकी आज्ञाको देवप्रतिमाके समक्ष अर्पित किये गये
verses.wordMeaning: For procuring ail achievements the wise devotee who is well versed in the Vedas shall perform tarpana to Devas with waters flowing down the tips of all fingers. He shall per- form tarpana to the sages with waters flowing down the tip of the little finger.…
verses.commentary: Sense: For procuring ail achievements the wise devotee who is well versed in the Vedas shall perform tarpana to Devas with waters flowing down the tips of all fingers. He shall per- form tarpana to the sages with waters flowing down the tip of the little finger.…

verses.sanskrit: तर्पयेद्विधिना पश्चात् प्राङ्मुखो वा ह्युदङ्मुखः ध्यात्वा स्वरूपं तत्तत्त्वम् अभिवन्द्य यथाक्रमम्
verses.transliteration: tarpayedvidhinā paścāt prāṅmukho vā hyudaṅmukhaḥ dhyātvā svarūpaṃ tattattvam abhivandya yathākramam
verses.translation: O brahmins, the study of the Vedic texts of one's own branch is Brahmayajfia;® the oflfering of cooked rice into the sacred fire is Devayajfta; the offering of oblations to Bhutas (living beings) as prescribed in the ritual is Bhutayajna; it bestows prosperity on all living beings. The devotee shall bow to brahmins well-versed in the Vedic rituals as well as
verses.hindi: सोऽपि सञ्चिन्त्य मनसा क्षणादेव पितामह: । तेषां प्रवृत्तमखिलं पुण्ये दारुवने पुरा उवाच सत्वरं ब्रह्मा मुनीन् दारुवनालयान्
verses.wordMeaning: O brahmins, the study of the Vedic texts of one's own branch is Brahmayajfia;® the oflfering of cooked rice into the sacred fire is Devayajfta; the offering of oblations to Bhutas (living beings) as prescribed in the ritual is Bhutayajna;…
verses.commentary: Sense: O brahmins, the study of the Vedic texts of one's own branch is Brahmayajfia;® the oflfering of cooked rice into the sacred fire is Devayajfta; the offering of oblations to Bhutas (living beings) as prescribed in the ritual is Bhutayajna;…

verses.sanskrit: देवानां पुष्पतोयेन ऋषीणां तु कुशांभसा पितॄणां तिलतोयेन गन्धयुक्तेन सर्वतः
verses.transliteration: devānāṃ puṣpatoyena ṛṣīṇāṃ tu kuśāṃbhasā pitṝṇāṃ tilatoyena gandhayuktena sarvataḥ
verses.translation: Listen O Brahmins! Brahmayajfia is the greatest of these Yajfias. A man engaged in Brahmayajfia is honoured in the world of Brahma.
verses.hindi: यस्तु दारुवने तस्मिल्लिङ्गी दृष्टोऽप्यलिङ्गिभिः। युष्माभिर्विकृताकारः स एव परमेश्वरः सुदर्शनेन मुनिना कालमृत्युरपि स्वयम्। पुरा भूमौ द्विजाग्रथेण जितो ह्यतिथिपूजया
verses.wordMeaning: Listen O Brahmins! Brahmayajfia is the greatest of these Yajfias. A man engaged in Brahmayajfia is honoured in the world of Brahma.
verses.commentary: Sense: Listen O Brahmins! Brahmayajfia is the greatest of these Yajfias. A man engaged in Brahmayajfia is honoured in the world of Brahma.

verses.sanskrit: यज्ञोपवीती देवानां निवीती ऋषितर्पणम् प्राचीनावीती विप्रेन्द्र पितॄणां तर्पयेत् क्रमात्
verses.transliteration: yajñopavītī devānāṃ nivītī ṛṣitarpaṇam prācīnāvītī viprendra pitṝṇāṃ tarpayet kramāt
verses.translation: By Brahmayajfia all the Devas including Indra, Lords Brahma, Visnu and Siva, all the Vedas and Pitrs are pleased. No doubt need be entertained in this respect. The brahmin who is adept in Brahmayajfia when he goes out of his village out of sight of hundreds of huts, shall turn towards the east, north or north-east®* and then perform the sacred rite of Acamana for the sake of Brahmayajfia. For propitiating the ]s, O brahmins, he shall fill the cup of his palm and drink water thrice.
verses.hindi: प्रतिज्ञामकरोज्जायां भार्यामाह पतिब्रताम् देयं सर्वं शिवायार्ये शिव एवातिथिः स्वयम्
verses.wordMeaning: By Brahmayajfia all the Devas including Indra, Lords Brahma, Visnu and Siva, all the Vedas and Pitrs are pleased. No doubt need be entertained in this respect. The brahmin who is adept in Brahmayajfia when he goes out of his village out of sight of hundreds of huts,…
verses.commentary: Sense: By Brahmayajfia all the Devas including Indra, Lords Brahma, Visnu and Siva, all the Vedas and Pitrs are pleased. No doubt need be entertained in this respect. The brahmin who is adept in Brahmayajfia when he goes out of his village out of sight of hundreds of huts,…

verses.sanskrit: अङ्गुल्यग्रेण वै धीमांस् तर्पयेद्देवतर्पणम् ऋषीन् कनिष्ठाङ्गुलिना श्रोत्रियः सर्वसिद्धये
verses.transliteration: aṅgulyagreṇa vai dhīmāṃs tarpayeddevatarpaṇam ṛṣīn kaniṣṭhāṅgulinā śrotriyaḥ sarvasiddhaye
verses.translation: For propitiating the Yajus he shall wash his hands, and wipe off his face twice with water. For the propitiation of Samaveda he shall touch the head.
verses.hindi: अध्याय २९ देवदारुवनका वृत्तान्त “संन्यासधर्मका वर्णन १३९ धर्मो द्विजोत्तमो भूत्वा जगामाथ मुनेर्गृहम्। आदिकी भाँति शिरोधार्य करके अतिथि-सत्कारमें
verses.wordMeaning: For propitiating the Yajus he shall wash his hands, and wipe off his face twice with water. For the propitiation of Samaveda he shall touch the head.
verses.commentary: Sense: For propitiating the Yajus he shall wash his hands, and wipe off his face twice with water. For the propitiation of Samaveda he shall touch the head.

verses.sanskrit: पितॄंस्तु तर्पयेद् विद्वान् दक्षिणाङ्गुष्ठकेन तु तथैवं मुनिशार्दूल ब्रह्मयज्ञं यजेद् द्विजः
verses.transliteration: pitṝṃstu tarpayed vidvān dakṣiṇāṅguṣṭhakena tu tathaivaṃ muniśārdūla brahmayajñaṃ yajed dvijaḥ
verses.translation: The brahmin shall wash the eyes, nostrils and other limbs for the propitiation of the Atharvan and Angiras texts.
verses.hindi: सम्मूजितस्तया तां तु प्राह धमो द्विजः स्वयम्। है श्रेष्ठ द्विजो! उन दोनोंकी श्रद्धाको परीक्षा भद्रे कुतः पतिर्धीमांस्तव भर्ता सुदर्शनः ॥ ५४ करनेके लिये एक सुन्दर ब्राह्मणका रूप धारण करके ब्राह्मणका पूजन किया
verses.wordMeaning: The brahmin shall wash the eyes, nostrils and other limbs for the propitiation of the Atharvan and Angiras texts.

verses.sanskrit: देवयज्ञं च मानुष्यं भूतयज्ञं तथैव च पितृयज्ञं च पूतात्मा यज्ञकर्मपरायणः
verses.transliteration: devayajñaṃ ca mānuṣyaṃ bhūtayajñaṃ tathaiva ca pitṛyajñaṃ ca pūtātmā yajñakarmaparāyaṇaḥ
verses.translation: After Brahmayajha he shall perform Ablution for the self, collect the holy water duly and enter the camp with per- fect self-control.
verses.hindi: भा न्यमीलयन्नेत्रे चचाल च पतिव्रता। उस स्त्रीके द्वारा भलीभाँति पूजित होकर ब्राह्मण- किं चैत्याह पुनस्तं वै धर्मे चक्रे च सा मतिम् वेषधारी साक्षात् धर्मने उससे कहा-हे कल्याणि ! तुम्हारे निवेदितुं किलात्मानं तस्मै पत्युरिहाज्ञया। बुद्धिसम्मन्न पति सुदर्शन कहाँ हैं ? तत्पश्चात् अपने पतिद्वारा
verses.wordMeaning: After Brahmayajha he shall perform Ablution for the self, collect the holy water duly and enter the camp with per- fect self-control.
