verses.sanskrit: स्वशाखाध्ययनं विप्र ब्रह्मयज्ञ इति स्मृतः अग्नौ जुहोति यच्चान्नं देवयज्ञ इति स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: svaśākhādhyayanaṃ vipra brahmayajña iti smṛtaḥ agnau juhoti yaccānnaṃ devayajña iti smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: Outside the house he shall wash his hands and feet with water. Thereafter, for purity's sake he shall perform the sacred bath with ashes duly.
verses.hindi: कही गयी बातका स्मरण करती हुई उस स्त्रीने पतिकी आज्ञाको गृहद्वारं गतो धीमांस्तामुवाच महामुनिः। ध्यानमें रखकर धर्मरूप उस ब्राह्मणके लिये आतिथ्य- एह्येहि वब गता भद्रे तमुवाचातिथिः स्वयम्॥ ५८  सैवा करोका मनमै निश्‍चय ति कि से च इसी बीच उस स्त्रीके पति प्रज्ञासम्मन्न सुदर्शन भार्यया त्वनया सार्धं मैथुनस्थोऽहमद्य वे। घरके द्वापर आ गये। मुनिवर सुदर्शने अपनी भार्याको
verses.wordMeaning: Outside the house he shall wash his hands and feet with water. Thereafter, for purity's sake he shall perform the sacred bath with ashes duly.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वेषामेव भूतानां बलिदानं विधानतः भूतयज्ञ इति प्रोक्तो भूतिदः सर्वदेहिनाम्
verses.transliteration: sarveṣāmeva bhūtānāṃ balidānaṃ vidhānataḥ bhūtayajña iti prokto bhūtidaḥ sarvadehinām
verses.translation: The ashes should be perfectly cleaned by means of Pranava. It must be taken from what remains after perform- ing Agnihotra. When the sun has risen in the morning the Agnihotra should be performed with the Mantra "Jyotih suryab "*" In the evening the same should be performed with the Mantra *'Jyotir Agnih".®® If the sun has not risen fully, the performance of Agnihotra is rendered ineffective. The ashes of the sacrifice performed after the sun has risen is alone sacred and splendid.
verses.hindi: सुदर्शन महाभाग किंकर्तव्यमिहोच्यताम्॥ ५९  आवाज दी-हे भद्रे! तुम कहाँ चली गयी हो? तब सुरतान्तस्तु विप्रेन्द्र सन्तुष्टोऽहं द्विजोत्तम। साक्षात् धर्मरूप अतिथि उनसे बोले-हे महाभाग सुदर्शनस्ततः प्राह सुप्रहृष्टो द्विजोत्तमः ॥ ६०  सुदर्शन! में इस समय तुम्हारी इस भार्याके आतिथ्यसे भुङ्क्ष्व चैनां यथाकामं गमिष्येऽहं द्विजोत्तम। परम सन्तुष्ट हूँ॥ ५७--६० /२॥ इष्टोऽथ दर्शयामास स्वात्मानं धर्मराट् स्वयम्॥ ६१ तदनन्तर धर्मराजने अपना वास्तविक रूप उन्हें
verses.wordMeaning: The ashes should be perfectly cleaned by means of Pranava. It must be taken from what remains after perform- ing Agnihotra.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The ashes should be perfectly cleaned by means of Pranava. It must be taken from what remains after perform- ing Agnihotra.…

verses.sanskrit: सदारान् सर्वतत्त्वज्ञान् ब्राह्मणान् वेदपारगान् प्रणम्य तेभ्यो यद्दत्तम् अन्नं मानुष उच्यते
verses.transliteration: sadārān sarvatattvajñān brāhmaṇān vedapāragān praṇamya tebhyo yaddattam annaṃ mānuṣa ucyate
verses.translation: Thepe is nothing holy like truth and nothing sinful like untruth. Repeating the Mantra of Iana he shall smear ashes on the head; repeating the Mantra of Tatpurusa, he shall smear ashes on his face; repeating the Mantra of Aghora he shall do so over his chest; O men of holy rites! he shall apply ashes over the secret parts by repeating the Mantra of Vama- deva and similarly on the feet by repeating the Mantra of Sadya. By repeating the Pranava he shall smear ashes all over the body. Thereafter he shall wash hands and feet. After wasing them off he shall take ashes with his mind set on the lord of Devas and perform Ablution repeating the Mantras viz., "Apo hi §tha®* and other sacred formulas taken from Rk, Yajus and Saman texts. Thus for your welfare O brahmins, the mode of procedure for holy bath has been described to you succinctly. He who performs thus even for once shall attain the highest abode of God.
verses.hindi: दिखाया और मनोवांछित वर देकर महान् कान्तिवाले धर्मने उनसे कहा-हे विप्रेन्द्र! मैं यहाँ केवल तुम्हारी श्रद्धाकी परीक्षा करनेके निमित्त आया हूँ । है सुव्रत! तुमने अपने एकमात्र अतिथिपूजारूप धर्मसे मृत्युतकको जीत लिया है॥ ६१--६३॥

Repeating the Mantra of Iana he shall smear ashes on the head; repeating the Mantra of Tatpurusa, he shall smear ashes on his face; repeating the Mantra of Aghora he shall do so over his chest; O men of holy rites! he shall apply ashes over the secret parts by repeating the Mantra of Vama- deva and similarly on the feet by repeating the Mantra of Sadya. By repeating the Pranava he shall smear ashes all over the body. Thereafter he shall wash hands and feet. After wasing them off he shall take ashes with his mind set on the lord of Devas and perform Ablution repeating the Mantras viz., "Apo hi §tha®* and other sacred formulas taken from Rk, Yajus and Saman texts. Thus for your welfare O brahmins, the mode of procedure for holy bath has been described to you succinctly. He who performs thus even for once shall attain the highest abode of God.

verses.translation: Listen, I shall briefly mention the rules of procedure for the worship of Lihga. It is not possible to recount them in detail even in a hundred years.

verses.translation: He shall resort to the form of the deity as follows. He has five faces and ten arms. He shines like pure crystal. He is bedecked in all ornaments and clothes of variegated colours. By means of certain Tan trie practices such as dahana, plavana etc,, he shall transform himself into the body of lord Siva and begin to worship him.

verses.translation: After purifying the body he shall perform the rite of Nyasa of the mula mantras. Everywhere the five Brahmans (Sadyojata etc. ) shall be fixed with the Pranava in order.
verses.hindi: अथवा जगदीश्वर रुद्र-इनमें भला कौन मेरे द्वारा ग्रास बनाये गये जीवको बचा सकनेमें समर्थ है? है विप्र! यह रुद्रपूजा मुझ शक्तिमानूका क्या कर सकती है? जिस किसीको भी ले जानेके लिये मैं उठ खड़ा होता हूँ, उसे क्षणभरमें यमलोक पहुँचा देता हूँ। है मुने! क्योंकि तुम समाप्त आयुवाले हो चुके हो, अत: तुम्हें ले जानेहेतु मैं यहाँ आया हँ ॥ ६--९॥

verses.sanskrit: देहशुद्धिं च कृत्वैव मूलमन्त्रं न्यसेत् क्रमात् सर्वत्र प्रणवेनैव ब्रह्माणि च यथाक्रमम्
verses.transliteration: dehaśuddhiṃ ca kṛtvaiva mūlamantraṃ nyaset kramāt sarvatra praṇavenaiva brahmāṇi ca yathākramam
verses.translation: In the highly splendid aphorism viz., "Namah Sivaya** the Vedas are present in subtle form. Just as the holy fig tree is present in the subtle seed of the Nyagrodha so also the great Brahman is present in the great and splendid aphorism, all by Himself in a subtle form.
verses.hindi: उस कालका वह धर्ममिश्रित भयावह वचन सुनकर मुनिवर श्वेत “हा रुद्र! हा रुद्र! हा रुद्र!' कहकर विलाप करने लगे और अश्रुपूरित तथा व्याकुल नेत्रोंसे एवं कातर दृष्टिसे शिवलिङ्गको निहारते हुए अत्यन्त व्यग्रचित्त होकर उस कालसे कहने लगे-
verses.wordMeaning: In the highly splendid aphorism viz., "Namah Sivaya** the Vedas are present in subtle form. Just as the holy fig tree is present in the subtle seed of the Nyagrodha so also the great Brahman is present in the great and splendid aphorism, all by Himself in a subtle form.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the highly splendid aphorism viz., "Namah Sivaya** the Vedas are present in subtle form. Just as the holy fig tree is present in the subtle seed of the Nyagrodha so also the great Brahman is present in the great and splendid aphorism, all by Himself in a subtle form.

verses.sanskrit: सूत्रे नमः शिवायेति छन्दांसि परमे शुभे मन्त्राणि सूक्ष्मरूपेण संस्थितानि यतस्ततः
verses.transliteration: sūtre namaḥ śivāyeti chandāṃsi parame śubhe mantrāṇi sūkṣmarūpeṇa saṃsthitāni yatastataḥ
verses.translation: The washing and sprinkling is performed by repeat- ing the Prava. The intelligent devotee shall duly cover the vessels with a cloth; these are the Proksani {vessel containing holy water), Arghya, Padya and Acamaniya vessels.
verses.hindi: श्वेतमुनि बोले--हे काल! तुम मेरा क्या बिगाड़ सकते हो; क्योंकि सभी देवताओंको उत्पन्न करनेवाले हमारे स्वामी वृषध्वज शंकर रुद्र इस लिङ्गमें विराजमान हैं विधिका विधान शिवजीके प्रति अतिशय भक्ति रखनेवाले मुझसदूश महात्माओंका क्या कर सकता है? अतएव है महाबाहो! आप जिस प्रकार आये थे, उसी प्रकार चले जाइये
verses.wordMeaning: The washing and sprinkling is performed by repeat- ing the Prava. The intelligent devotee shall duly cover the vessels with a cloth; these are the Proksani {vessel containing holy water), Arghya, Padya and Acamaniya vessels.
verses.commentary: Sense: The washing and sprinkling is performed by repeat- ing the Prava. The intelligent devotee shall duly cover the vessels with a cloth; these are the Proksani {vessel containing holy water), Arghya, Padya and Acamaniya vessels.

verses.sanskrit: न्यग्रोधबीजे न्यग्रोधस् तथा सूत्रे तु शोभने महत्यपि महद्ब्रह्म संस्थितं सूक्ष्मवत्स्वयम्
verses.transliteration: nyagrodhabīje nyagrodhas tathā sūtre tu śobhane mahatyapi mahadbrahma saṃsthitaṃ sūkṣmavatsvayam
verses.translation: The intelligent devotee shall pour water in them after observing the materials. He shall place Uira and sandal in the Padya.
verses.hindi: तदनन्तर श्वेतमुनिका वैसा वचन सुनकर हाथमें पाश धारण किये, तीक्ष्ण दाढ़ोंवाले भयंकर कालगे कुपित होकर सिंहके सदृश घोर गर्जना करते हुए तथा किं करिष्यति मे मृत्यर्मृत्योर्मृत्युरहं यतः। तं दृष्ट्वा सस्मितं प्राह श्वेतं लोकभयङ्करः
verses.wordMeaning: The intelligent devotee shall pour water in them after observing the materials. He shall place Uira and sandal in the Padya.
verses.commentary: Sense: The intelligent devotee shall pour water in them after observing the materials. He shall place Uira and sandal in the Padya.

verses.sanskrit: सेचयेदर्चनस्थानं गन्धचन्दनवारिणा द्रव्याणि शोधयेत्पश्चात् क्षालनप्रोक्षणादिभिः
verses.transliteration: secayedarcanasthānaṃ gandhacandanavāriṇā dravyāṇi śodhayetpaścāt kṣālanaprokṣaṇādibhiḥ
verses.translation: He shall duly powder nutmeg (Jali), momordica mixta (Kankola seed), the root of Bahumula (a herb), Xanthocymus epictorius (Tamala seed) and camphor and put the same in the Acamaniya vessel.
verses.hindi: रुद्रो वा भगवान् विष्णुर्ब्रह्मा वा जगदीश्वरः॥ नेतुं यस्योत्थितश्चाहं यमलोकं क्षणेन वै।
verses.wordMeaning: He shall duly powder nutmeg (Jali), momordica mixta (Kankola seed), the root of Bahumula (a herb), Xanthocymus epictorius (Tamala seed) and camphor and put the same in the Acamaniya vessel.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall duly powder nutmeg (Jali), momordica mixta (Kankola seed), the root of Bahumula (a herb), Xanthocymus epictorius (Tamala seed) and camphor and put the same in the Acamaniya vessel.

verses.sanskrit: क्षालनं प्रोक्षणं चैव प्रणवेन विधीयते प्रोक्षणी चार्घ्यपात्रं च पाद्यपात्रम् अनुक्रमात्
verses.transliteration: kṣālanaṃ prokṣaṇaṃ caiva praṇavena vidhīyate prokṣaṇī cārghyapātraṃ ca pādyapātram anukramāt
verses.translation: Similarly he shall put camphor, sandal and different kinds of flowers in all the vessels.
verses.hindi: तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा भैरवं धर्ममिश्रितम्। हा रुद्र रुद्र रुद्रेति ललाप मुनिपुङ्गवः तं प्राह च महादेवं कालं सम्प्रेक्ष्य वै दृशा। नेत्रेण बाष्पमिश्रेण सम्भ्रान्तेन समाकुलः
verses.wordMeaning: Similarly he shall put camphor, sandal and different kinds of flowers in all the vessels.
verses.commentary: Sense: Similarly he shall put camphor, sandal and different kinds of flowers in all the vessels.

verses.sanskrit: तथा ह्याचमनीयार्थं कल्पितं पात्रमेव च स्थापयेद् विधिना धीमान् अवगुण्ठ्य यथाविधि
verses.transliteration: tathā hyācamanīyārthaṃ kalpitaṃ pātrameva ca sthāpayed vidhinā dhīmān avaguṇṭhya yathāvidhi
verses.translation: He shall put tips of Kusa grass, unbroken rice grains, barley grains, cereals, gingelly seeds, ghee, white mustard, flowers and ashes in the Arghya vessel.
verses.hindi: त्वया किं काल नो नाथश्चास्ति चेद्धि वृषध्वजः । लिङ्गेऽस्मिन् शङ्करो रुद्रः सर्वदेवभवोद्भवः
verses.wordMeaning: He shall put tips of Kusa grass, unbroken rice grains, barley grains, cereals, gingelly seeds, ghee, white mustard, flowers and ashes in the Arghya vessel.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall put tips of Kusa grass, unbroken rice grains, barley grains, cereals, gingelly seeds, ghee, white mustard, flowers and ashes in the Arghya vessel.

verses.sanskrit: दर्भैर् आच्छादयेच्चैव प्रोक्षयेच्छुद्धवारिणा तेषु तेष्वथ सर्वेषु क्षिपेत्तोयं सुशीतलम्
verses.transliteration: darbhair ācchādayeccaiva prokṣayecchuddhavāriṇā teṣu teṣvatha sarveṣu kṣipettoyaṃ suśītalam
verses.translation: Repeating the Pranava he shall put Kusa grass, flowers, barley grains, bits of Bahumula herb and Tamala root as well as ashes into the Prok§anI vessel.
verses.hindi: ततो निशम्य कुपितस्तीक्ष्णदंष्ट्र भयङ्करः। श्रुत्वा शवेतस्य तद्वाक्यं पाशहस्तो . भयावहः बबन्ध च मुनिं कालः कालप्राप्तं तमाह च
verses.wordMeaning: Repeating the Pranava he shall put Kusa grass, flowers, barley grains, bits of Bahumula herb and Tamala root as well as ashes into the Prok§anI vessel.
verses.commentary: Sense: Repeating the Pranava he shall put Kusa grass, flowers, barley grains, bits of Bahumula herb and Tamala root as well as ashes into the Prok§anI vessel.

verses.sanskrit: प्रणवेन क्षिपेत्तेषु द्रव्याण्यालोक्य बुद्धिमान् उशीरं चन्दनं चैव पाद्ये तु परिकल्पयेत्
verses.transliteration: praṇavena kṣipetteṣu dravyāṇyālokya buddhimān uśīraṃ candanaṃ caiva pādye tu parikalpayet
verses.translation: He shall perform the rite of Nyasa of the flve-syllabled Mantra, and of Rudra Gayatri or only of Pranava — the exc- ellent essence of the Vedas.
verses.hindi: अध्याय ३० शिवाराधनाके माहात्म्यमें श्वेतमुनिका आख्यान १४३ फफफाफीफफफफफफफफफफफफफफ फफ फफ फफ फफ फफ फफ फ फ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ फ़ फ फ़ फ फ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ फ़ फ फ़ क फ फ़ फ़ फ फ का फ फा फ फ
verses.wordMeaning: He shall perform the rite of Nyasa of the flve-syllabled Mantra, and of Rudra Gayatri or only of Pranava — the exc- ellent essence of the Vedas.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall perform the rite of Nyasa of the flve-syllabled Mantra, and of Rudra Gayatri or only of Pranava — the exc- ellent essence of the Vedas.

verses.sanskrit: जातिकङ्कोलकर्पूरबहुमूलतमालकम् चूर्णयित्वा यथान्यायं क्षिपेदाचमनीयके
verses.transliteration: jātikaṅkolakarpūrabahumūlatamālakam cūrṇayitvā yathānyāyaṃ kṣipedācamanīyake
verses.translation: Thereafter he shall sprinkle the materials of worship with water from the Proksanl vessel, repeating Pranava as well as the five Yajus beginning with Isana.
verses.hindi: अद्य वै देवदेवेन तव रुद्रेण किं कृतम्  बार-बार फटकारते हुए काल-प्राप्त मुनिको बाँध दिया और पुनः उनसे कहा--
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter he shall sprinkle the materials of worship with water from the Proksanl vessel, repeating Pranava as well as the five Yajus beginning with Isana.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter he shall sprinkle the materials of worship with water from the Proksanl vessel, repeating Pranava as well as the five Yajus beginning with Isana.

verses.sanskrit: एवं सर्वेषु पात्रेषु दापयेच्चन्दनं तथा कर्पूरं च यथान्यायं पुष्पाणि विविधानि च
verses.transliteration: evaṃ sarveṣu pātreṣu dāpayeccandanaṃ tathā karpūraṃ ca yathānyāyaṃ puṣpāṇi vividhāni ca
verses.translation: By the (right) side* the loid of Devas, Naridin, i.e. myself, shall be worshipped. 1 sha have the lustre of ten thousand blazing fires, three eyes, the face of a monkey, four arms, the crescent moon as coronet, wearing flower garlands, gentle, and bedecked in all ornaments. My wife Suyaa the auspicious and holy daughter of the Maruts shall be worshipped to the north of Nandin i.e. myself.* She who performs holy rites shall be engaged in embellishing the feet of Amba (Goddess Parvati).
verses.hindi: हे विप्रर्ष! तुम श्वेतको यमलोक ले जानेके निमित्त मैंने बाँध दिया है; किंतु तुम्हारे देवाधिदेव रुद्रने इस समय तुम्हारी क्या सहायता की ? कहाँ शिव, कहाँ तुम्हारी भक्ति तथा पूजा, कहाँ पूजाका फल और कहाँ मैं एवं मेरा भय! है श्वेत! अब तुम मेरे द्वारा बाँध दिये गये हो। है श्वेत! तुम्हारा महेश्वर रुद्र जो इस लिङ्गमें स्थित है, वह महादेव तो निश्चेष्ट है; तो फिर तुम उस महेश्वरकी पूजा क्यों करते हो ?
verses.wordMeaning: By the (right) side* the loid of Devas, Naridin, i.e. myself, shall be worshipped. 1 sha have the lustre of ten thousand blazing fires, three eyes, the face of a monkey, four arms, the crescent moon as coronet, wearing flower garlands, gentle, and bedecked in all ornaments.…
verses.commentary: Sense: By the (right) side* the loid of Devas, Naridin, i.e. myself, shall be worshipped. 1 sha have the lustre of ten thousand blazing fires, three eyes, the face of a monkey, four arms, the crescent moon as coronet, wearing flower garlands, gentle, and bedecked in all ornaments.…

verses.sanskrit: कुशाग्रमक्षतांश्चैव यवव्रीहितिलानि च आज्यसिद्धार्थपुष्पाणि भसितं चार्घ्यपात्रके
verses.transliteration: kuśāgramakṣatāṃścaiva yavavrīhitilāni ca ājyasiddhārthapuṣpāṇi bhasitaṃ cārghyapātrake
verses.translation: After worshipping thus he shall enter the sanctum sanctorum of lord Siva. He shall then offer handfuls of flowers on the five heads of the Lord repeating the five Mantras. With different kinds of incense and scented flowers he shall worship Siva, Skanda, Ganea and the goddess, and then consecrate the Linga.
verses.hindi: तत्पश्चात् मुनिका प्राण हरनेके निमित्त आये हुए कालका संहार करनेके लिये कामदेवके शत्रु, दक्ष- यज्ञके विध्वंसक तथा त्रिनेत्र सदाशिव महादेव शंकर अपने नन्दी, गणेश्वरों और पार्वतीसहित मुसकराते हुए शीघ्रतापूर्वक शिवलिङ्गसे साक्षात् प्रकट हुए
verses.wordMeaning: After worshipping thus he shall enter the sanctum sanctorum of lord Siva. He shall then offer handfuls of flowers on the five heads of the Lord repeating the five Mantras. With different kinds of incense and scented flowers he shall worship Siva, Skanda, Ganea and the goddess,…
verses.commentary: Sense: After worshipping thus he shall enter the sanctum sanctorum of lord Siva. He shall then offer handfuls of flowers on the five heads of the Lord repeating the five Mantras. With different kinds of incense and scented flowers he shall worship Siva, Skanda, Ganea and the goddess,…

verses.sanskrit: कुशपुष्पयवव्रीहिबहुमूलतमालकम् दापयेत्प्रोक्षणीपात्रे भसितं प्रणवेन च
verses.transliteration: kuśapuṣpayavavrīhibahumūlatamālakam dāpayetprokṣaṇīpātre bhasitaṃ praṇavena ca
verses.translation: After repeating the Mantras b( ginning with Pranava®
verses.hindi: हे द्विजो! शिवजीको देखते ही उसी क्षण भयके कारण वह बलवान् काल श्वेतमुनिके पास शीघ्र ही गिर पड़ा और कालका भी अन्त करनेवाले शिवजीको देखकर जोरसे चिल्लाया। है उत्तम विप्रो! मृतप्राय उस कालको शिवजीने अपने कृपावलोकनसे जीवन प्रदान कर दिया
verses.wordMeaning: After repeating the Mantras b( ginning with Pranava®
verses.commentary: Sense: After repeating the Mantras b( ginning with Pranava®

verses.sanskrit: न्यसेत्पञ्चाक्षरं चैव गायत्रीं रुद्रदेवताम् केवलं प्रणवं वापि वेदसारमनुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: nyasetpañcākṣaraṃ caiva gāyatrīṃ rudradevatām kevalaṃ praṇavaṃ vāpi vedasāramanuttamam
verses.translation: Its imperishable petal in the East shall be Anima; Laghima shall be the petal in the South; Mahima the Western petal; Prapti the Northern, Pramyam the South-eastern, Isitva the South-western, Vasitva the North-western, Omniscience the North-eastern petal. The moon will be the pericarp. Beneath the moon is the sun and beneath the sun the fire-god. Dharma®® and others shall be installed in the subsidiary quarters. He shall then instal Ananta. He shall instal Avyakta etc. in the four quarters®® in order and the three Gunas at the extremity of Soma.
verses.hindi: सभी महान् देवतागण तथा मुनिवुन्द महेश्वर एवं माता पार्वतीको प्रणाम करने लगे और हर्षित होकर उच्च स्वरमें “जय हो-जय हो' ऐसा बोलने लगे। नभोमण्डलमें स्थित देवसमुदाय इन श्वेतमुनि तथा शंकरजीके सिरपर आकाशसे अत्यन्त सुन्दर, शीतल तथा सुगन्धित पुष्पोंको वर्षा करने लगे
verses.wordMeaning: Its imperishable petal in the East shall be Anima; Laghima shall be the petal in the South; Mahima the Western petal; Prapti the Northern, Pramyam the South-eastern, Isitva the South-western, Vasitva the North-western, Omniscience the North-eastern petal.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Its imperishable petal in the East shall be Anima; Laghima shall be the petal in the South; Mahima the Western petal; Prapti the Northern, Pramyam the South-eastern, Isitva the South-western, Vasitva the North-western, Omniscience the North-eastern petal.…

verses.sanskrit: अथ संप्रोक्षयेत्पश्चाद् द्रव्याणि प्रणवेन तु प्रोक्षणीपात्रसंस्थेन ईशानाद्यैश् च पञ्चभिः
verses.transliteration: atha saṃprokṣayetpaścād dravyāṇi praṇavena tu prokṣaṇīpātrasaṃsthena īśānādyaiś ca pañcabhiḥ
verses.translation: Above it he shall instal the three Atmans® and in the end Siva's pedestal. Repeating the Mantra "1 resort to Sadyojata"®® he shall invoke ' the supreme lord. With the Mantra of Vamadeva he shall instal Him over the seat. With Rudragayatri he shall establish His presense and with Aghora Mantra he shall stabilise the presence of deity. He shall then worship with the Mantra "Ianah Sarvavidyanam.®® He shall then offer Padya, Acamaniya and Arghya to the lord. In accordance with the injunctions he shall be the Rudra with scented sandal paste water. After gathering Paftca Gavya in a vessel and after inspiring it with Pranava he shall bathe the deity with Paficagavya. Repeating the Pranava he shall perform the rite of ablution to the deity (successively) with ghee, honey, sugar-cane juice and other holy materials of worship. With holy' Mantras, using pure vessels he shall pour water over the deity.
verses.hindi: तत्पश्चात् शिलादके पुत्र तथा शिवजीके अनुचर गणेश्वर नन्दीजी कालको मरा हुआ देखकर अत्यन्त विस्मित हुए और उन्होंने अविनाशी महेश्वर शिवको प्रणामकर उनसे कहा कि यह अल्पबुद्धि काल मर चुका है; अब आप इस काल और मुनि-दोनोंपर अनुग्रह कोजिये
verses.wordMeaning: Above it he shall instal the three Atmans® and in the end Siva's pedestal. Repeating the Mantra "1 resort to Sadyojata"®® he shall invoke ' the supreme lord. With the Mantra of Vamadeva he shall instal Him over the seat.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Above it he shall instal the three Atmans® and in the end Siva's pedestal. Repeating the Mantra "1 resort to Sadyojata"®® he shall invoke ' the supreme lord. With the Mantra of Vamadeva he shall instal Him over the seat.…

verses.sanskrit: पार्श्वतो देवदेवस्य नन्दिनं मांसमर्चयेत् दीप्तानलायुतप्रख्यं त्रिनेत्रं त्रिदशेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: pārśvato devadevasya nandinaṃ māṃsamarcayet dīptānalāyutaprakhyaṃ trinetraṃ tridaśeśvaram
verses.translation: The aspirant shall wipe it off with a white cloth.
verses.hindi: तत्पश्चात् क्षणभरमें ही मृत होकर पृथ्वीपर गिरे कालको देखकर उसके तथा द्विजश्रेष्ठ श्‍वेत--दोनोंके लिङ्गेऽस्मिन् संस्थितः श्वेत तव रुद्रो महेश्वरः। निश्चेष्टोऽसौ महादेवः कथं पूज्यो महेश्वरः
verses.wordMeaning: The aspirant shall wipe it off with a white cloth.
verses.commentary: Sense: The aspirant shall wipe it off with a white cloth.

verses.sanskrit: बालेन्दुमुकुटं चैव हरिवक्त्रं चतुर्भुजम् पुष्पमालाधरं सौम्यं सर्वाभरणभूषितम्
verses.transliteration: bālendumukuṭaṃ caiva harivaktraṃ caturbhujam puṣpamālādharaṃ saumyaṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitam
verses.translation: padmasana: sec note 47,
verses.hindi: ततः सदाशिवः स्वयं द्विजं निहन्तुमागतम्। निहन्तुमन्तकं स्मयन् स्मरारि यज्ञहा हरः त्वरन् विनिर्गतः परः शिवः स्वयं त्रिलोचनः। त्रियम्बकोऽम्बया समं सनन्दिना गणेश्वरैः
verses.wordMeaning: padmasana: sec note 47,
verses.commentary: Sense: padmasana: sec note 47,

verses.sanskrit: उत्तरे चात्मनः पुण्यां भार्यां च मरुतां शुभाम् सुयशां सुव्रतां चाम्बां पादमण्डनतत्पराम्
verses.transliteration: uttare cātmanaḥ puṇyāṃ bhāryāṃ ca marutāṃ śubhām suyaśāṃ suvratāṃ cāmbāṃ pādamaṇḍanatatparām
verses.translation: iiSnab sarvavidy&n&m Tif. io.47«
verses.hindi: ननाद चोर्ध्वमुच्चधीनिरीक्ष्य चान्तकान्तकम्। निरीक्षणेन वै मृतं भवस्य विप्रपुङ्गवाः प्रणेमुरम्बिकामुमां मुनीश्वरास्तु हर्षिताः
verses.wordMeaning: iiSnab sarvavidy&n&m Tif. io.47«
verses.commentary: Sense: iiSnab sarvavidy&n&m Tif. io.47«

verses.sanskrit: एवं पूज्य प्रविश्यान्तर् भवनं परमेष्ठिनः दत्त्वा पुष्पाञ्जलिं भक्त्या पञ्चमूर्धसु पञ्चभिः
verses.transliteration: evaṃ pūjya praviśyāntar bhavanaṃ parameṣṭhinaḥ dattvā puṣpāñjaliṃ bhaktyā pañcamūrdhasu pañcabhiḥ
verses.translation: A man who worships the Lihga even once with the following Mantras will be liberated. Those who are conver- sant with the Mantra Stra use the following Mantras for the rite of Ablution: Pavamana, Vama,'* Rudra,'® Nila'* Rudra, Srisukta, Ratrisukta,'* Camaka Hotara, Atharva- iiras, Santi, Bharunda, Aruna, Varuna, Jyestha, Vedavrata, Rathantara, Purusa, Tvarita, Rudra," Kapi, Kapardi, the Saman A vo rajanam,® Brhaccandra, Vi§nu, Virupaksa Mantra, Skanda, a group of hundred hymns, the hymns of Paflca Brahmans, Pailcksara Mantra or Pranava alone.
verses.hindi: शिलाशनात्मजोऽव्ययं शिवं प्रणम्य शङ्करम् ततो विवेश भगवाननुगृह्य द्विजोत्तमम्। क्षणाद् गूढशरीरं हि ध्वस्तं दृष्ट्वान्तकं क्षणात्
verses.wordMeaning: A man who worships the Lihga even once with the following Mantras will be liberated. Those who are conver- sant with the Mantra Stra use the following Mantras for the rite of Ablution: Pavamana, Vama,'* Rudra,'® Nila'* Rudra, Srisukta, Ratrisukta,'* Camaka Hotara,…
verses.commentary: Sense: A man who worships the Lihga even once with the following Mantras will be liberated. Those who are conver- sant with the Mantra Stra use the following Mantras for the rite of Ablution: Pavamana, Vama,'* Rudra,'® Nila'* Rudra, Srisukta, Ratrisukta,'* Camaka Hotara,…

verses.sanskrit: गन्धपुष्पैस् तथा धूपैर् विविधैः पूज्य शङ्करम् स्कन्दं विनायकं देवीं लिङ्गशुद्धिं च कारयेत्
verses.transliteration: gandhapuṣpais tathā dhūpair vividhaiḥ pūjya śaṅkaram skandaṃ vināyakaṃ devīṃ liṅgaśuddhiṃ ca kārayet
verses.translation: The devotee shall bathe the lord of the chiefs of Devas for the suppression of all sins. He shall then offer the following to the deity: Clothes, the sacred thread, Acamanlya, scents and flowers, incense, light, cooked rice, scented water and Acamaniya once again. Thereafter he shall offer a crown.
verses.hindi: मुक्तिदं भुक्तिदं शाङ्करम्॥ शरीरमें समाविष्ट हो गये 8 १ सा शक अतएव है द्विजो! सभौको मोक्ष तथा भोग प्रदान
verses.wordMeaning: The devotee shall bathe the lord of the chiefs of Devas for the suppression of all sins. He shall then offer the following to the deity: Clothes, the sacred thread, Acamanlya, scents and flowers, incense, light, cooked rice, scented water and Acamaniya once again.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The devotee shall bathe the lord of the chiefs of Devas for the suppression of all sins. He shall then offer the following to the deity: Clothes, the sacred thread, Acamanlya, scents and flowers, incense, light, cooked rice, scented water and Acamaniya once again.…

verses.sanskrit: जप्त्वा सर्वाणि मन्त्राणि प्रणवादिनमो ऽन्तकम् कल्पयेदासनं पश्चात् पद्माख्यं प्रणवेन तत्
verses.transliteration: japtvā sarvāṇi mantrāṇi praṇavādinamo 'ntakam kalpayedāsanaṃ paścāt padmākhyaṃ praṇavena tat
verses.translation: V&miyaka — Vama sukta beginning with 'asya vamasya*.
verses.hindi: करनेवाले मृत्युंजय महादेवको भक्तिपूर्वक पूजा करनी चाहिए हे मुनियो! अधिक क्या कहूँ; संन्यासधर्मका पालन करते हुए परम श्रद्धाके साथ उन महादेवकी आराधना करनेसे तुम सब सन्तापरहित हो जाओगे
verses.wordMeaning: V&miyaka — Vama sukta beginning with 'asya vamasya*.
verses.commentary: Sense: V&miyaka — Vama sukta beginning with 'asya vamasya*.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य पूर्वदलं साक्षाद् अणिमामयम् अक्षरम् लघिमा दक्षिणं चैव महिमा पश्चिमं तथा
verses.transliteration: tasya pūrvadalaṃ sākṣād aṇimāmayam akṣaram laghimā dakṣiṇaṃ caiva mahimā paścimaṃ tathā
verses.translation: Ratri sClkta RY.
verses.hindi: नन्दीश्वर बोले-- है सनत्कुमारजी ! तत्पश्चात् उन ब्रह्मके इस प्रकार कहनेपर ब्रह्मवेत्ता मुनिगण बोले--हे देव! आप प्रसन्न हों और हमें बतायें कि किस तपस्या, किस यज्ञ अथवा किन ब्रतोंसे पिनाकधारी देवेश्वर रुद्रके प्रति हमलोगोंमें भक्ति उत्पन्न होगी तथा हम द्विजगण शिवभक्त हो सकेंगे 2
verses.wordMeaning: Ratri sClkta RY.
verses.commentary: Sense: Ratri sClkta RY.

verses.sanskrit: प्राप्तिस्तथोत्तरं पत्रं प्राकाम्यं पावकस्य तु ईशित्वं नैरृतं पत्रं वशित्वं वायुगोचरे
verses.transliteration: prāptistathottaraṃ patraṃ prākāmyaṃ pāvakasya tu īśitvaṃ nairṛtaṃ patraṃ vaśitvaṃ vāyugocare
verses.translation: tvarita, sec note. 142
verses.hindi: ऊपर अनुग्रह करके भगवान् शंकर तत्काल गुण भक्त्या चापरया तस्मिन् विशोका वै भविष्यथ
verses.wordMeaning: tvarita, sec note. 142
verses.commentary: Sense: tvarita, sec note. 142

verses.sanskrit: सर्वज्ञत्वं तथैशान्यं कर्णिका सोम उच्यते सोमस्याधस् तथा सूर्यस् तस्याधः पावकः स्वयम्
verses.transliteration: sarvajñatvaṃ tathaiśānyaṃ karṇikā soma ucyate somasyādhas tathā sūryas tasyādhaḥ pāvakaḥ svayam
verses.translation: a VO r&jknam TS 1.3.12.1.
verses.hindi: एवमुक्तास्तदा तेन ब्रह्मणा ब्रह्मवादिनः। प्रसीद भक्तिर्देवेशे भवेद्रुद्रे पिनाकिनि केन वा तपसा देव यज्ञेनाप्यथ केन वा। व्रतैर्वा भगवद्भक्ता भविष्यन्ति द्विजातयः
verses.wordMeaning: a VO r&jknam TS 1.3.12.1.
verses.commentary: Sense: a VO r&jknam TS 1.3.12.1.

verses.sanskrit: धर्मादयो विदिक्ष्वेते त्व् अनन्तं कल्पयेत्क्रमात् अव्यक्तादिचतुर्दिक्षु सोमस्यान्ते गुणत्रयम्
verses.transliteration: dharmādayo vidikṣvete tv anantaṃ kalpayetkramāt avyaktādicaturdikṣu somasyānte guṇatrayam
verses.translation: On the top of the Lihga he shall worship the unsullied, imperishable Lord, shining like a crystal glass, the cause of all Devas, identical with the universe, imperceptible to the sages, Devas, Brahma, Indra, Visnu, Rudra and others. The Sruti says "He is imperceptible through even VedSntas, to the knowers of the Vedas too". He is devoid of beginning, middle and end. He is a medicine unto those who are afflicted by the sickness of worldliness.'® He is known as Sivatattva (Principle of iSiva) and is stationed in the Siva Linga. He shall duly repeat the prayers and make obeisance. He shall circumambulate, offer Arghya, scatter flowers at the feet, bow to the lord of Devas and superimpose Siva on the Atman. This, in brief, is the procedure of worshipping Siva in Lihga. Now I shall describe the internal worship of Lihga to you.
verses.hindi: पितामह उवाच ब्रह्माजी बोले--हे मुनिवरो! दान, तप, विद्या, विद्या, न दानेन मुनिश्रेष्ठास्तपसा च न विद्यया। यज्ञ, होम, व्रत, वेदाध्ययन, शास्त्रपारायण, योगसाधन यज्नैहोंमैर््रतेर्वेहैर्योगशास्त्रर्निरो धनैः ॥ ३२  तथा इन्द्रिय-नियन्त्रण आदि उपायोंसे शिव-भक्ति सम्भव
verses.wordMeaning: On the top of the Lihga he shall worship the unsullied, imperishable Lord, shining like a crystal glass, the cause of all Devas, identical with the universe, imperceptible to the sages, Devas, Brahma, Indra, Visnu, Rudra and others.…
verses.commentary: Sense: On the top of the Lihga he shall worship the unsullied, imperishable Lord, shining like a crystal glass, the cause of all Devas, identical with the universe, imperceptible to the sages, Devas, Brahma, Indra, Visnu, Rudra and others.…

verses.sanskrit: आत्मत्रयं ततश्चोर्ध्वं तस्यान्ते शिवपीठिका सद्योजातं प्रपद्यामीत्य् आवाह्य परमेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: ātmatrayaṃ tataścordhvaṃ tasyānte śivapīṭhikā sadyojātaṃ prapadyāmīty āvāhya parameśvaram
verses.translation: On the top of the Lihga he shall worship the unsullied, imperishable Lord, shining like a crystal glass, the cause of all Devas, identical with the universe, imperceptible to the sages, Devas, Brahma, Indra, Visnu, Rudra and others. verses.hindi: नहीं है। केवल उनको कृपासे ही जगतूके परम कारण है। केवल उनकी कृपासे ही परम कारण महादेवके प्रति वह भक्ति उत्पन्न होती है॥ ३२'/२॥ इसके बाद उन ब्रह्माका वचन सुनकर परिश्रान्त हुए उन सभी श्रेष्ठ ऋषियोंने स्त्री तथा पुत्रोसहित ब्रह्माजीको प्रणाम किया॥ ३३/२ ॥

verses.sanskrit: वामदेवेन मन्त्रेण स्थापयेदासनोपरि सान्निध्यं रुद्रगायत्र्या अघोरेण निरुध्य च
verses.transliteration: vāmadevena mantreṇa sthāpayedāsanopari sānnidhyaṃ rudragāyatryā aghoreṇa nirudhya ca
verses.translation: On the top of the Lihga he shall worship the unsullied, imperishable Lord, shining like a crystal glass, the cause of all Devas, identical with the universe, imperceptible to the sages, Devas, Brahma, Indra, Visnu, Rudra and others. verses.hindi: अतएव है सनत्कुमार! यह शैवी भक्ति धर्म, काम, अर्थ तथा सभी सिद्धियाँ प्रदान करनेवाली है और सभौ प्रकारकी मृत्युसे विजय दिलानेवाली है । यह शिव- भक्ति मुनि दधीचके लिये विजयदायिनी सिद्ध हुई थी। पूर्व कालमें दधीचमुनिने शिवकी भक्तिसे ही देवताओंसहित सर्वशक्तिमान् विष्णुको जीतकर अपने चरणसे राजा क्षुपपर प्रहार किया और अपनी हड्डियोंमें वज्रत्व प्राप्त कर लिया था। महादेवको आराधनासे मैंने भी मृत्युपर विजय प्राप्त
verses.wordMeaning: On the top of the Lihga he shall worship the unsullied, imperishable Lord, shining like a crystal glass, the cause of all Devas, identical with the universe, imperceptible to the sages, Devas, Brahma, Indra, Visnu, Rudra and others.…

verses.sanskrit: ईशानः सर्वविद्यानाम् इति मन्त्रेण पूजयेत् पाद्यमाचमनीयं च विभोश्चार्घ्यं प्रदापयेत्
verses.transliteration: īśānaḥ sarvavidyānām iti mantreṇa pūjayet pādyamācamanīyaṃ ca vibhoścārghyaṃ pradāpayet
verses.translation: On the top of the Lihga he shall worship the unsullied, imperishable Lord, shining like a crystal glass, the cause of all Devas, identical with the universe, imperceptible to the sages, Devas, Brahma, Indra, Visnu, Rudra and others. verses.hindi: न कर ली है और जिस प्रकार मैंने मृत्युको जीता है, उसी श्वेतेनापि गतेनास्यं मृत्योर्मुनिवरेण तु। प्रकार मृत्युके मुखमें गये हुए मुनिवर श्वेतने भी शिवजीकी महादेवप्रसादेन जितो मृत्युर्यथा मया॥ ३७  कृपासे मृत्युको जीत लिया था॥ ३४--३७॥ प्रसादेनैव सा भक्तिः शिवे परमकारणे। अथ तस्य वचः श्रुत्वा सर्वे ते परमर्घयः
verses.wordMeaning: On the top of the Lihga he shall worship the unsullied, imperishable Lord, shining like a crystal glass, the cause of all Devas, identical with the universe, imperceptible to the sages, Devas, Brahma, Indra, Visnu, Rudra and others.…

verses.sanskrit: स्नापयेद्विधिना रुद्रं गन्धचन्दनवारिणा पञ्चगव्यविधानेन गृह्य पात्रे ऽभिमन्त्र्य च
verses.transliteration: snāpayedvidhinā rudraṃ gandhacandanavāriṇā pañcagavyavidhānena gṛhya pātre 'bhimantrya ca

verses.translation: On the top of the Lihga he shall worship the unsullied, imperishable Lord, shining like a crystal glass, the cause of all Devas, identical with the universe, imperceptible to the sages, Devas, Brahma, Indra, Visnu, Rudra and others. The Sruti says "He is imperceptible through even VedSntas, to the knowers of the Vedas too". He is devoid of beginning, middle and end. He is a medicine unto those who are afflicted by the sickness of worldliness.'® He is known as Sivatattva (Principle of iSiva) and is stationed in the Siva Linga. He shall duly repeat the prayers and make obeisance. He shall circumambulate, offer Arghya, scatter flowers at the feet, bow to the lord of Devas and superimpose Siva on the Atman. This, in brief, is the procedure of worshipping Siva in Lihga. Now I shall describe the internal worship of Lihga to you.

verses.transliteration: tasmāddhyeyaṃ tathā dhyānaṃ yajamānaḥ prayojanam smarettannānyathā jātu budhyate puruṣasya ha
verses.translation: The word Purusa is derived thus; puri ictc (he who lies in the body). He who worships the deity, the object of worship by means of meditation, is known as yajamana. Dhyeya (the object of meditation) is the lord himself. Dhyana is the act of thinking. Nirukti (bliss) the fruit of dhyana. One who knows about this attains the ultimate reality which is the sub- stratum of Pradhana and Puru?a.

verses.sanskrit: पुरे शेते पुरं देहं तस्मात्पुरुष उच्यते याज्यं यज्ञेन यजते यजमानस्तु स स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: pure śete puraṃ dehaṃ tasmātpuruṣa ucyate yājyaṃ yajñena yajate yajamānastu sa smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: Here the supreme lord, the object of meditation, is the twenty-sixth principle, — the meditator (jiva) is the twenty- fifth, the avyakta or pradhana is the twenty-fourth. The seven principles constitute mahat, ahaihkara, and five tanmatras. The organs of action are five, as also the organs of sense; then there is the mind and the five elements. Thus Siva is the twenty-sixth principle. He alone is the creator and sustainer. He is greater than Brahma. He has created Brahma. He is one who is above and greater than the universe, and is the universe itself.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्मादीनां च देवानां दुर्विज्ञेयानि ते हर। अगतिं ते न जानीमो गतिं नैव च नैव च पैरके अँगूठेके अग्रभागपर स्थित होकर, कोई दाँतोंको ही उलूखल बनाकर उनसे पिसे अन्नको खाकर, कुछ पाषाणपर पिसे अन्नको ही खाकर, कुछ वीरासनमें बैठकर, कुछ मृगचर्यापरायण होकर-इस प्रकार तपस्या

verses.sanskrit: ध्येयो महेश्वरो ध्यानं चिन्तनं निर्वृतिः फलम् प्रधानपुरुषेशानं याथातथ्यं प्रपद्यते
verses.transliteration: dhyeyo maheśvaro dhyānaṃ cintanaṃ nirvṛtiḥ phalam pradhānapuruṣeśānaṃ yāthātathyaṃ prapadyate
verses.translation: Just as children are not born without their parents, so also the three worlds arc not born without Siva and his consort.
verses.hindi: तथा पूजनके द्वारा उन महाबुद्धिमान् मुनियोंने समय इस प्रकार उन मुनियोंको तप करते हुए एक वर्ष पूर्ण होनेपर वसन्त ऋतु आनेपर परमेश्वर शिव अपनी दयासे उन भक्तोंपर अनुग्रह करनेके निमित्त कृतयुगमें हिमालयके उस पर्वतपर स्थित देवदारुवनमें प्रसन्नतापूर्वक
verses.wordMeaning: Just as children are not born without their parents, so also the three worlds arc not born without Siva and his consort.
verses.commentary: Sense: Just as children are not born without their parents, so also the three worlds arc not born without Siva and his consort.

verses.transliteration: iha ṣaḍviṃśako dhyeyo dhyātā vai pañcaviṃśakaḥ caturviṃśakam avyaktaṃ mahadādyāstu sapta ca
verses.translation: If the great lord who is the supreme power and the supreme soul is himself the doer how can he be an agent who causes activity of the individual souls? But the supreme lord has been mentioned by you as eternal, enlightened and un- qualitative.®* How can he then bestow liberation? If he is without attributes how can he function?

verses.transliteration: manaś ca pañca bhūtāni śivaḥ ṣaḍviṃśakastataḥ sa eva bhartā kartā ca vidherapi maheśvaraḥ
verses.translation: jivatma, the individual soul, the enjoyer of the fruits of the world-tree (cf. cbhih sampaditam bhunkte puruah pancavixhSakah. Matsya 3.27), constitutes the twenty- fifth category. He is also called *bhokta puru$ab'> 'bhokta suparnab* and he is controlled by the will of Ivara (cf. Lvareccha- vaiai so'pi jivktma kathyate budhaih). The latter is called advixhSaka Siva — the twenty-sixth category who though transcendent is not competent to bestow grace. (Cf. adviihiakamanUvaram 1.71.109}.

verses.transliteration: vinā yathā hi pitaraṃ mātaraṃ tanayāstviha na jāyante tathā somaṃ vinā nāsti jagattrayam
verses.translation: The universe appears to be existent by his very activity. The eight®® forms of the lord represent the empirical universe. Without the five elements — ether, earth, wind, fire and water and without the priest, the sun and the moon, the world has no existence. On consideration, it is evident that the gross world consisting of the mobile and immobile beings is the gross body of Rudra. These eight are the cosmic forms of the lord.
verses.hindi: विश्वेश्वर महादेव योऽसि सोऽसि नमोऽस्तु ते।  विश्वेश्वर! है महादेव! आप जो कोई भी , 1 देवदेवं आपको है मुनिगण आप महात्मानो देवदेवं महेश्वरम्॥ आपको नमस्कार है। ह्म मु हि ह महेश्वरकी स्तुति करते हें

verses.transliteration: kartā yadi mahādevaḥ paramātmā maheśvaraḥ tathā kārayitā caiva kurvato 'lpātmanas tathā
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins the sages declare that the subtle body of the lord is inexpressible. (The Vedas declare) "From him the words recede after failing to reach him along with the mind. He who realizes the bliss of the Brahman eschews fear from any quarter".®® Hence, after realizing the bliss of the pinaka-bearing lord, no one need be afraid.

verses.sanskrit: नित्यो विशुद्धो बुद्धश् च निष्कलः परमेश्वरः त्वयोक्तो मुक्तिदः किं वा निष्कलश्चेत्करोति किम्

verses.translation: After perceiving through their imagination that the elegances®® of Rudra are present everywhere, the images who perceive the truth say, "Everything is Rudra.*
verses.hindi: करनेवाले, कन्दर्पस्वरूप तथा अग्निरूप परमात्मा शिवको नमस्कार है हाथमें दण्ड तथा पाश धारण करनेवाले, कालरूप, गणोंके पति एवं वृषभध्वज शंकरको नमस्कार है
verses.wordMeaning: After perceiving through their imagination that the elegances®® of Rudra are present everywhere, the images who perceive the truth say, "Everything is Rudra.*
verses.commentary: Sense: After perceiving through their imagination that the elegances®® of Rudra are present everywhere, the images who perceive the truth say, "Everything is Rudra.*

verses.sanskrit: कालः करोति सकलं कालं कलयते सदा निष्कलं च मनः सर्वं मन्यते सो ऽपि निष्कलः
verses.transliteration: kālaḥ karoti sakalaṃ kālaṃ kalayate sadā niṣkalaṃ ca manaḥ sarvaṃ manyate so 'pi niṣkalaḥ
verses.translation: By making incessant obeisance to Brahma one's prestige is increased. All this is Brahman; everything is lord Rudra. Purusa is the great lord; Siva is the supreme lord*. Thus the lord has been specified. Meditation is the sole thought about him.
verses.hindi: वेदमन्त्रोमें प्रधान रूपसे निरूपित तथा शत जिह्नावाले आप शिवको नमस्कार है। है देव! भूत, भविष्य तथा वर्तमान जो कुछ भी है एवं स्थावर-जंगममय यह सम्पूर्ण जगत् आपकी ही देहसे उत्पन्न हुआ है। आप ही जगतका पालन तथा संहार करते हैं। अतएव हे भगवन्! आपका मंगल हो और आप हमपर प्रसन्न हों। सान अथवा आज्ञानमें मनुष्य जो कुछ भी करता है, वह सब स्वयं आप परमेश्वर ही अपनी योगमायासे सम्पन
verses.wordMeaning: By making incessant obeisance to Brahma one's prestige is increased. All this is Brahman; everything is lord Rudra. Purusa is the great lord; Siva is the supreme lord*. Thus the lord has been specified. Meditation is the sole thought about him.
verses.commentary: Sense: By making incessant obeisance to Brahma one's prestige is increased. All this is Brahman; everything is lord Rudra. Purusa is the great lord; Siva is the supreme lord*. Thus the lord has been specified. Meditation is the sole thought about him.

verses.sanskrit: कर्मणा तस्य चैवेह जगत्सर्वं प्रतिष्ठितम् किमत्र देवदेवस्य मूर्त्यष्टकमिदं जगत्
verses.transliteration: karmaṇā tasya caiveha jagatsarvaṃ pratiṣṭhitam kimatra devadevasya mūrtyaṣṭakamidaṃ jagat
verses.translation: The mind too when stabilized by concentration becomes inactive (niskriya) as this helps in the emancipation of jiva. Gf. ST,:
verses.hindi: इस प्रकार तपस्यासे युक्त वे मुनिगण पुलकित अन्तरात्मासे शिवजीका स्तवन करके उनसे याचना करने लगे कि है भगवन्! हम लोगोंने आपको पहले जिस रूपमें देखा था, उसी रूपमें आपका दर्शन करना चाहते तब उनको स्तुतिसे प्रसन्न मनवाले प्रभु शिवने अपना त्रिनेत्र-रूप दिखानेके लिये उन्हें दिव्य-दृष्टि प्रदान की
verses.wordMeaning: The mind too when stabilized by concentration becomes inactive (niskriya) as this helps in the emancipation of jiva. Gf. ST,:
verses.commentary: Sense: The mind too when stabilized by concentration becomes inactive (niskriya) as this helps in the emancipation of jiva. Gf. ST,:

verses.sanskrit: विनाकाशं जगन्नैव विना क्ष्मां वायुना विना तेजसा वारिणा चैव यजमानं तथा विना
verses.transliteration: vinākāśaṃ jagannaiva vinā kṣmāṃ vāyunā vinā tejasā vāriṇā caiva yajamānaṃ tathā vinā
verses.translation: The eight forms of lord Shra constitute the five gross material elements, the soul, the sun and the moon. Each stands in relation to its constituent as follows:
verses.hindi: देवदारुवनमें निवास करनेवाले उन मुनियोंने उस लब्धदृष्ट्या तया दृष्ट्वा देवदेवं त्रियम्बकम्। प्राप्त दिव्य दृष्टिसे तीन नेत्रवाले देवाधिदेव शिवका पुनस्तष्टुवुरीशानं देवदारुवनौकसः ॥ ४६  दरशन करके पुनः उनकी स्तुति की त्र्यम्बकाय त्रिनेत्राय त्रिशूलवरधारिणे। कन्दर्पाय हुताशाय नमोऽस्तु परमात्मने
verses.wordMeaning: The eight forms of lord Shra constitute the five gross material elements, the soul, the sun and the moon. Each stands in relation to its constituent as follows:
verses.commentary: Sense: The eight forms of lord Shra constitute the five gross material elements, the soul, the sun and the moon. Each stands in relation to its constituent as follows:

verses.sanskrit: भानुना शशिना लोकस् तस्यैतास्तनवः प्रभोः विचारतस्तु रुद्रस्य स्थूलमेतच्चराचरम्
verses.transliteration: bhānunā śaśinā lokas tasyaitāstanavaḥ prabhoḥ vicāratastu rudrasya sthūlametaccarācaram
verses.translation: Gf. TA. 8.4.1. TU 2.41, 9.1. Brahman is here identical with Siva.
verses.hindi: शङ्कराय वृषाङ्काय गणानां पतये नमः। दण्डहस्ताय कालाय पाशहस्ताय वै नम: तव देहात्समुत्पन्नं देव सर्वमिदं जगत्। पासि हंसि च भद्रं ते प्रसीद भगवंस्ततः
verses.wordMeaning: Gf. TA. 8.4.1. TU 2.41, 9.1. Brahman is here identical with Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: Gf. TA. 8.4.1. TU 2.41, 9.1. Brahman is here identical with Siva.

verses.sanskrit: सूक्ष्मं वदन्ति ऋषयो यन्न वाच्यं द्विजोत्तमाः यतो वाचो निवर्तन्ते अप्राप्य मनसा सह
verses.transliteration: sūkṣmaṃ vadanti ṛṣayo yanna vācyaṃ dvijottamāḥ yato vāco nivartante aprāpya manasā saha
verses.translation: Rudrasya vibhutayah* The vibhuties of Rudra comprise rta, satya etc. Gf. ftaxh satyam param brahma, quoted in ST,
verses.hindi: तत्सर्वं भगवानेव कुरुते योगमायया ततो देवः प्रसन्नात्मा स्वमेवास्थाय शङ्करः। रूपं त्र्यक्षं च सन्द्रष्टुं दिव्यं चक्षुरदात्प्रभुः
verses.wordMeaning: Rudrasya vibhutayah* The vibhuties of Rudra comprise rta, satya etc. Gf. ftaxh satyam param brahma, quoted in ST,
verses.commentary: Sense: Rudrasya vibhutayah* The vibhuties of Rudra comprise rta, satya etc. Gf. ftaxh satyam param brahma, quoted in ST,

verses.sanskrit: आनन्दं ब्रह्मणो विद्वान् न बिभेति कुतश्चन न भेतव्यं तथा तस्माज् ज्ञात्वानन्दं पिनाकिनः
verses.transliteration: ānandaṃ brahmaṇo vidvān na bibheti kutaścana na bhetavyaṃ tathā tasmāj jñātvānandaṃ pinākinaḥ
verses.translation: O sage of good, holy rites, he should be thought upon in fourfold® manner and perceived. He, the cause of worldly existence, is the world itself. He is the cause of liberation. He is the greatest ecstasy.
verses.hindi: मुनियोंद्वारा की गयी शिवस्तुति मुनियोंद्वारा शिवस्तुति मुनियोंद्वारा की गयी शिवस्तु
verses.wordMeaning: O sage of good, holy rites, he should be thought upon in fourfold® manner and perceived. He, the cause of worldly existence, is the world itself. He is the cause of liberation. He is the greatest ecstasy.
verses.commentary: Sense: O sage of good, holy rites, he should be thought upon in fourfold® manner and perceived. He, the cause of worldly existence, is the world itself. He is the cause of liberation. He is the greatest ecstasy.

verses.sanskrit: विभूतयश् च रुद्रस्य मत्वा सर्वत्र भावतः सर्वं रुद्र इति प्राहुर् मुनयस्तत्त्वदर्शिनः
verses.transliteration: vibhūtayaś ca rudrasya matvā sarvatra bhāvataḥ sarvaṃ rudra iti prāhur munayastattvadarśinaḥ
verses.translation: The four-arrayed path is prescribed for a practis- ing yogin. Thought is counted as manifold. If it is centred in one place it is called Sunistha;®® if centred inRudra it is called Raudri; if centred in Indra Aindri; if in Soma Saumya; if in Narayana or in the sun or in the fire it is called after those names. If the devotee fixes in his mind in both ways that he is I and I am he that thought is called Brahmi. O brahmins, thus should a devotee think of this universe — both mobile and immobile — as identical with Brahman.
verses.hindi: नमो दिग्वाससे नित्यं कृतान्ताय त्रिशूलिने। विकटाय करालाय करालवदनाय च कटङ्कटाय रूद्राय स्वाहाकाराय वै नम:॥
verses.wordMeaning: The four-arrayed path is prescribed for a practis- ing yogin. Thought is counted as manifold. If it is centred in one place it is called Sunistha;®® if centred inRudra it is called Raudri; if centred in Indra Aindri; if in Soma Saumya;…
verses.commentary: Sense: The four-arrayed path is prescribed for a practis- ing yogin. Thought is counted as manifold. If it is centred in one place it is called Sunistha;®® if centred inRudra it is called Raudri; if centred in Indra Aindri; if in Soma Saumya;…

verses.sanskrit: नमस्कारेण सततं गौरवात्परमेष्ठिनः सर्वं तु खल्विदं ब्रह्म सर्वो वै रुद्र ईश्वरः
verses.transliteration: namaskāreṇa satataṃ gauravātparameṣṭhinaḥ sarvaṃ tu khalvidaṃ brahma sarvo vai rudra īśvaraḥ
verses.translation: Keeping the goal in his mind, the devotee shall eschew the thought of division between the mobile and imo- bile,®® as also between what should be eschewed and what should not be eschewed, as also between what is possible and what is not possible of achievement and what should be done and what should not be done. He shall also remain satiated and contented. Such a man's contemplation is the real one, pertaining to Brahman and not otherwise. Thus in due order the mental worship of the lord has been recounted.
verses.hindi: नीलकण्ठाय देवाय चिताभस्माङ्गधारिणे। त्वं ब्रह्मा सर्वदेवानां रूद्राणां नीललोहितः ऋषीणां च वसिष्ठस्त्वं देवानां वासवस्तथा। कार: सर्ववेदानां श्रेष्ठं साम च सामसु
verses.wordMeaning: Keeping the goal in his mind, the devotee shall eschew the thought of division between the mobile and imo- bile,®® as also between what should be eschewed and what should not be eschewed,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Keeping the goal in his mind, the devotee shall eschew the thought of division between the mobile and imo- bile,®® as also between what should be eschewed and what should not be eschewed,…

verses.sanskrit: पुरुषो वै महादेवो महेशानः परः शिवः एवं विभुर्विनिर्दिष्टो ध्यानं तत्रैव चिन्तनम्
verses.transliteration: puruṣo vai mahādevo maheśānaḥ paraḥ śivaḥ evaṃ vibhurvinirdiṣṭo dhyānaṃ tatraiva cintanam
verses.translation: Those who carry out this sort of mental worship should also be adored by means of obeisance, etc. Even if they are hideous and deformed, these expounders of Brahman should not be censured. They should not be subjected to scrutiny by a discerning person. Those who censure them are narrow- minded persons who will become miserably unhappy as those sages of old who censured the lord in the Daruka forest. The
verses.hindi: ग्राम्याणामूषभश्चासि भगवान् लोकपूजितः त्वामेव तत्र पश्यामो ब्रह्मणा कथितं तथा
verses.wordMeaning: Those who carry out this sort of mental worship should also be adored by means of obeisance, etc. Even if they are hideous and deformed, these expounders of Brahman should not be censured. They should not be subjected to scrutiny by a discerning person.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who carry out this sort of mental worship should also be adored by means of obeisance, etc. Even if they are hideous and deformed, these expounders of Brahman should not be censured. They should not be subjected to scrutiny by a discerning person.…

verses.sanskrit: चतुर्व्यूहेण मार्गेण विचार्यालोक्य सुव्रत संसारहेतुः संसारो मोक्षहेतुश् च निर्वृतिः
verses.transliteration: caturvyūheṇa mārgeṇa vicāryālokya suvrata saṃsārahetuḥ saṃsāro mokṣahetuś ca nirvṛtiḥ
verses.translation: caturvyuha: Four vyuhas constitute praigia, manas, vijiiana and luianda and exclude the gross annamaya koia. ST, offers an alternative explanation: yad va dhyeya-dhyana-yajamana-prayojanarupaih catur- vyuhait. But according to Lihga purai?a, the caturvyuha consists of(i)cxis- tence (sariiskra), cause of existence (saihsarahetu), cause of emancipation (mokidictu) and emancipation (nirvrti).
verses.hindi: कामः क्रोधश्च लोभश्च विषादो मद एव च। महासंहरणे प्राप्ते त्वया देव कृतात्मना। करं ललाटे संविध्य वह्निरुत्पादितस्त्वया
verses.wordMeaning: caturvyuha: Four vyuhas constitute praigia, manas, vijiiana and luianda and exclude the gross annamaya koia. ST, offers an alternative explanation: yad va dhyeya-dhyana-yajamana-prayojanarupaih catur- vyuhait. But according to Lihga purai?a,…
verses.commentary: Sense: caturvyuha: Four vyuhas constitute praigia, manas, vijiiana and luianda and exclude the gross annamaya koia. ST, offers an alternative explanation: yad va dhyeya-dhyana-yajamana-prayojanarupaih catur- vyuhait. But according to Lihga purai?a,…

verses.sanskrit: चतुर्व्यूहः समाख्यातश् चिन्तकस्येह योगिनः चिन्ता बहुविधा ख्याता सैकत्र परमेष्ठिना
verses.transliteration: caturvyūhaḥ samākhyātaś cintakasyeha yoginaḥ cintā bahuvidhā khyātā saikatra parameṣṭhinā
verses.translation: esu'acara-vibhagam— Jagadbrahmarupam ST, — distinction bet- ween Brahma and the mundane orldw.
verses.hindi: तेनाग्निना तदा लोका अर्चिभिः सर्वतो वृताः। तस्मादग्निसमा होते बहवो विकृताग्नयः ऋषिगण बोले-दिशाओंको वस्त्ररूपमें धारण करनेवाले, शाश्वत, प्रलयके कारण, त्रिशूलधारी, विकट रूपवाले, कराल (संसाररूपी वृक्षके लिये कुठार स्वरूप) तथा भीषण वदनवाले शिवको नमस्कार है
verses.wordMeaning: esu'acara-vibhagam— Jagadbrahmarupam ST, — distinction bet- ween Brahma and the mundane orldw.
verses.commentary: Sense: esu'acara-vibhagam— Jagadbrahmarupam ST, — distinction bet- ween Brahma and the mundane orldw.

verses.sanskrit: सुनिष्ठेत्यत्र कथिता रुद्रं रौद्री न संशयः ऐन्द्री चेन्द्रे तथा सौम्या सोमे नारायणे तथा
verses.transliteration: suniṣṭhetyatra kathitā rudraṃ raudrī na saṃśayaḥ aindrī cendre tathā saumyā some nārāyaṇe tathā
verses.translation: esu'acara-vibhagam— Jagadbrahmarupam ST, — distinction bet- ween Brahma and the mundane orldw.
verses.hindi: बिना रूपवाले, सुन्दर रूपवाले, विश्वरूप आपको नमस्कार है। गजाननरूप, स्वाहा करनेवाले यजमानरूप रुद्रको नमस्कार है सभी लोगोंसे नमस्कृत देहवाले, स्वयं विनीत आत्मावाले, निरन्तर नील जटाजूट धारण करनेवाले, अपने शरीरमें चिताकी भस्मको धारण करनेवाले, श्रीकण्ठ, नीलकण्ठ शिवको बार-बार नमस्कार है। हे
verses.wordMeaning: esu'acara-vibhagam— Jagadbrahmarupam ST, — distinction bet- ween Brahma and the mundane orldw.
verses.commentary: Sense: esu'acara-vibhagam— Jagadbrahmarupam ST, — distinction bet- ween Brahma and the mundane orldw.

verses.sanskrit: सूर्ये वह्नौ च सर्वेषां सर्वत्रैवं विचारतः सैवाहं सो ऽहमित्येवं द्विधा संस्थाप्य भावतः
verses.transliteration: sūrye vahnau ca sarveṣāṃ sarvatraivaṃ vicārataḥ saivāhaṃ so 'hamityevaṃ dvidhā saṃsthāpya bhāvataḥ
verses.translation: esu'acara-vibhagam— Jagadbrahmarupam ST, — distinction bet- ween Brahma and the mundane orldw.
verses.hindi: प्रभो! आप सभी देवताओंमें ब्रह्मा हैं तथा रुद्रोंमें नीललोहित हैं आप समस्त भूतोंको आत्मा हैं सांख्यविद् आपको पुरुष कहते हैं। आप पर्वतोंमें विशाल मेरु पर्वत तथा नक्षत्रोमें चन्द्रमा हैं
verses.wordMeaning: esu'acara-vibhagam— Jagadbrahmarupam ST, — distinction bet- ween Brahma and the mundane orldw.
verses.commentary: Sense: esu'acara-vibhagam— Jagadbrahmarupam ST, — distinction bet- ween Brahma and the mundane orldw.

verses.sanskrit: भक्तो ऽसौ नास्ति यस्तस्माच् चिन्ता ब्राह्मी न संशयः एवं ब्रह्ममयं ध्यायेत् पूर्वं विप्र चराचरम्
verses.transliteration: bhakto 'sau nāsti yastasmāc cintā brāhmī na saṃśayaḥ evaṃ brahmamayaṃ dhyāyet pūrvaṃ vipra carācaram
verses.translation: esu'acara-vibhagam— Jagadbrahmarupam ST, — distinction bet- ween Brahma and the mundane orldw.
verses.hindi: ऋषियोमें आप वसिष्ठ हैं तथा देवताओंमें देवराज इन्द्र हैं, सभी वेदोंमें साररूपसे आप ओंकार हैं एवं सभी गेयस्वरोंमें आप सामगान हैं आप परमेश्वर वन्य पशुओंमें सिंह हैं और ग्राम्य पशुओंमें आप ऐश्वर्यसम्पन्न तथा लोकपूज्य वृषभ हैं
verses.wordMeaning: esu'acara-vibhagam— Jagadbrahmarupam ST, — distinction bet- ween Brahma and the mundane orldw.
verses.commentary: Sense: esu'acara-vibhagam— Jagadbrahmarupam ST, — distinction bet- ween Brahma and the mundane orldw.

verses.sanskrit: चराचरविभागं च त्यजेदभिमतं स्मरन् त्याज्यं ग्राह्यम् अलभ्यं च कृत्यं चाकृत्यमेव च
verses.transliteration: carācaravibhāgaṃ ca tyajedabhimataṃ smaran tyājyaṃ grāhyam alabhyaṃ ca kṛtyaṃ cākṛtyameva ca
verses.translation: esu'acara-vibhagam— Jagadbrahmarupam ST, — distinction bet- ween Brahma and the mundane orldw.
verses.hindi: हे प्रभो! आप वैसा कीजिये कि आपका जो भी विद्यमान स्वरूप हो, उसमें हम ब्रह्माद्वारा कथित आपके सर्वस्वरूपका दर्शन कर सकें हे परमेश्वर! आप प्रसन्न होइये। हम यह जानना चाहते हैं कि काम, क्रोध, लोभ, विषाद तथा मद-ये पाँचों विकार सभीको दग्ध क्यों करते हैं ?
verses.wordMeaning: esu'acara-vibhagam— Jagadbrahmarupam ST, — distinction bet- ween Brahma and the mundane orldw.
verses.commentary: Sense: esu'acara-vibhagam— Jagadbrahmarupam ST, — distinction bet- ween Brahma and the mundane orldw.

verses.sanskrit: यस्य नास्ति सुतृप्तस्य तस्य ब्राह्मी न चान्यथा आभ्यन्तरं समाख्यातम् एवमभ्यर्चनं क्रमात्

verses.translation: esu'acara-vibhagam— Jagadbrahmarupam ST, — distinction bet- ween Brahma and the mundane orldw.
verses.hindi: हे देव! महासंहार उपस्थित होनेपर शुद्ध चित्तवाले आप परमेश्‍्वरने ललाटपर हाथ घर्षितकर अग्नि उत्पन्न को थी तब उसी अग्निको ज्वालाओंसे समस्त लोक

verses.commentary: Sense: esu'acara-vibhagam— Jagadbrahmarupam ST, — distinction bet- ween Brahma and the mundane orldw.

verses.translation: esu'acara-vibhagam— Jagadbrahmarupam ST, — distinction bet- ween Brahma and the mundane orldw.
verses.hindi: कामः क्रोधश्च लोभश्च मोहो दम्भ उपद्रव: । यानि चान्यानि भूतानि स्थावराणि चराणि च दह्यन्ते प्राणिनस्ते तु त्वत्समुत्थेन वह्निना। अस्माकं दह्यमानानां त्राता भव सुरेशवर

verses.translation: esu'acara-vibhagam— Jagadbrahmarupam ST, — distinction bet- ween Brahma and the mundane orldw.

verses.commentary: Sense: esu'acara-vibhagam— Jagadbrahmarupam ST, — distinction bet- ween Brahma and the mundane orldw.

verses.sanskrit: वर्णाश्रमविनिर्मुक्ता वर्णाश्रमपरायणैः
verses.transliteration: varṇāśramavinirmuktā varṇāśramaparāyaṇaiḥ
verses.translation: esu'acara-vibhagam— Jagadbrahmarupam ST, — distinction bet- ween Brahma and the mundane orldw.
verses.hindi: सभी ओरसे आच्छादित हो गये। इसीलिये ये काग अग्नियाँ अग्नितुल्य ही हैं। इस जगत्में जो भी स्थावर-जंगम जीव एवं पदार्थ हैं, वे सब उत्पादित अग्निसे दग्ध हो रहे हैं। अतएव है सुरेश्वर  उस अग्निसे दग्ध हो रहे हम सभीकी आप रक्ष
verses.wordMeaning: esu'acara-vibhagam— Jagadbrahmarupam ST, — distinction bet- ween Brahma and the mundane orldw.
verses.commentary: Sense: esu'acara-vibhagam— Jagadbrahmarupam ST, — distinction bet- ween Brahma and the mundane orldw.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीलिङ्गमहापुराणे पूर्वभागे शिवार्चनतत्त्वसंख्यादिवर्णनं नामाष्टाविंशो ऽध्यायः इदानीं श्रोतुमिच्छामि पुरा दारुवने विभो प्रवृत्तं तद्वनस्थानां तपसा भावितात्मनाम्
verses.transliteration: iti śrīliṅgamahāpurāṇe pūrvabhāge śivārcanatattvasaṃkhyādivarṇanaṃ nāmāṣṭāviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ idānīṃ śrotumicchāmi purā dāruvane vibho pravṛttaṃ tadvanasthānāṃ tapasā bhāvitātmanām
verses.translation: O holy lord, now I wish to know what was committed by the dwellers of the Daruvana, those persons who had puri- fied their souls by means of penance. How did Rudra the naked lord of sublimated sexuality assume a hideous form and go to Daru forest? What did that great soul do there Please recount factually the activities of that lord of Devas.
verses.hindi: हे महेश्वर! है महाभाग! है प्रभो! है शुभ निरीक्षक! आप लोक-कल्याणके लिये जीवोंको अमृतरूपी जलसे सौंचते हैं। है नाथ! आज्ञा दीजिये; हमलोग आपके वचनोंका पालन करनेके लिये तत्पर हैं । अनन्त पदार्थों एवं उनके नाम-रूपोंके मध्य आप व्याप्त ह आपका पार हम पा नहीं सके हैं। है देवाधिदेव!
verses.wordMeaning: O holy lord, now I wish to know what was committed by the dwellers of the Daruvana, those persons who had puri- fied their souls by means of penance.…
verses.commentary: Sense: O holy lord, now I wish to know what was committed by the dwellers of the Daruvana, those persons who had puri- fied their souls by means of penance.…

verses.sanskrit: कथं दारुवनं प्राप्तो भगवान्नीललोहितः विकृतं रूपमास्थाय चोर्ध्वरेता दिगम्बरः
verses.transliteration: kathaṃ dāruvanaṃ prāpto bhagavānnīlalohitaḥ vikṛtaṃ rūpamāsthāya cordhvaretā digambaraḥ
verses.translation: On hearing his words Nandin, the most excellent among the knowers of the Vedas, said after remembering Siva and smiling a little.
verses.hindi: अन्तं गन्तुं न शक्ताः स्म देवदेव नमोऽस्तु ते॥ १६  आपको नमस्कार है॥ १४--१६॥ मुनियोंको शिवभक्तिका उपदेश नन्हुवाच नन्दीश्वर बोले--उन मुनियोंके द्वारा संस्तुत ततस्तुतोष भगवाननुगृह्य महेश्वर: । भगवान् महेश्वर उनकी स्तुति सुनकर उनके प्रति
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing his words Nandin, the most excellent among the knowers of the Vedas, said after remembering Siva and smiling a little.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing his words Nandin, the most excellent among the knowers of the Vedas, said after remembering Siva and smiling a little.

verses.sanskrit: किं प्रवृत्तं वने तस्मिन् रुद्रस्य परमात्मनः वक्तुमर्हसि तत्त्वेन देवदेवस्य चेष्टितम्
verses.transliteration: kiṃ pravṛttaṃ vane tasmin rudrasya paramātmanaḥ vaktumarhasi tattvena devadevasya ceṣṭitam
verses.translation: In order to propitiate the lord of Devas, the sages per- formed a terrible penance in the D«iru forest.®® They were accompanied by their wives, sons and sacrificial fires.
verses.hindi: यः पठेच्छृणुयाद्वापि युष्माभिः कीर्तितं स्तवम्। श्रावयेद्वा द्विजान् विप्रो गाणपत्यमवाण्नुयात् वक्ष्यामि वो हितं पुण्यं भक्तानां मुनिपुङ्गवाः ।
verses.wordMeaning: In order to propitiate the lord of Devas, the sages per- formed a terrible penance in the D«iru forest.®® They were accompanied by their wives, sons and sacrificial fires.
verses.commentary: Sense: In order to propitiate the lord of Devas, the sages per- formed a terrible penance in the D«iru forest.®® They were accompanied by their wives, sons and sacrificial fires.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा श्रुतिसारविदां वरः शिलादसूनुर्भगवान् प्राह किंचिद्भवं हसन्
verses.transliteration: tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā śrutisāravidāṃ varaḥ śilādasūnurbhagavān prāha kiṃcidbhavaṃ hasan
verses.translation: Rudra, the lord of the univeise, the bull-emblemed omniscient deity known as Nilalohita, Dhurjati and P.irame- sana was delighted.
verses.hindi: स्त्रीलिङ्गमखिलं देवी प्रकृतिर्मम देहजा पुंल्लिङ्गं पुरुषो विप्रा मम देहसमुद्भवः। उभाभ्यामेव वै सृष्टिर्मम विप्रा न संशय:
verses.wordMeaning: Rudra, the lord of the univeise, the bull-emblemed omniscient deity known as Nilalohita, Dhurjati and P.irame- sana was delighted.
verses.commentary: Sense: Rudra, the lord of the univeise, the bull-emblemed omniscient deity known as Nilalohita, Dhurjati and P.irame- sana was delighted.

verses.sanskrit: <दारुवन> मुनयो दारुगहने तपस्तेपुः सुदारुणम् तुष्ट्यर्थं देवदेवस्य सदारतनयाग्नयः

verses.translation: The lord of the universe, Rudra, wanted to test the sincerity of the dwellers of the Daru forest in respect of their sacrificial rites. He wanted to turn their minds from the observance of sacrificial rites to the path of renunciation. Thus in order to test their faith, and sportively too, he assumed a

verses.sanskrit: तुष्टो रुद्रो जगन्नाथश् चेकितानो वृषध्वजः धूर्जटिः परमेशानो भगवान्नीललोहितः
verses.transliteration: tuṣṭo rudro jagannāthaś cekitāno vṛṣadhvajaḥ dhūrjaṭiḥ parameśāno bhagavānnīlalohitaḥ
verses.translation: Even in this form he was extremely handsome. He was smiling and singing, with seductive play of his eyebrows, thereby creating feelings of love in the hearts of women.
verses.hindi: जो विप्र आप लोगोंद्वारा की गयी स्तुतिको पढेगा अथवा सुनेगा अथवा द्विजोंको सुनायेगा, वह मेरे गणोंमें मुख्य स्थान प्राप्त करेगा हे मुनिश्रेष्ठो! आप भक्तोंके हितार्थ अब मैं शुभ उपदेश करता हूँ। इस जगत्में समस्त स्त्रीलिङ्ग-समुदाय मेरे शरीरसे उत्पन्न प्रकृतिदेवीका ही रूप है और हे विप्रो! सभी पुंल्लिंग-समुदाय मेरी देहसे उत्पन्न पुरुषका
verses.wordMeaning: Even in this form he was extremely handsome. He was smiling and singing, with seductive play of his eyebrows, thereby creating feelings of love in the hearts of women.
verses.commentary: Sense: Even in this form he was extremely handsome. He was smiling and singing, with seductive play of his eyebrows, thereby creating feelings of love in the hearts of women.

verses.sanskrit: प्रवृत्तिलक्षणं ज्ञानं ज्ञातुं दारुवनौकसाम् परीक्षार्थं जगन्नाथः श्रद्धया क्रीडया च सः
verses.transliteration: pravṛttilakṣaṇaṃ jñānaṃ jñātuṃ dāruvanaukasām parīkṣārthaṃ jagannāthaḥ śraddhayā krīḍayā ca saḥ
verses.translation: He the destroyer of cupid, the lord of extremely hand- some features increased their sexual feelings.

verses.commentary: Sense: He the destroyer of cupid, the lord of extremely hand- some features increased their sexual feelings.

verses.translation: On seeing a man of deformed features, black-red (in colour), even the chaste women followed him with great enthusiasm.

verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing a man of deformed features, black-red (in colour), even the chaste women followed him with great enthusiasm.

verses.sanskrit: विकृतं रूपमास्थाय दिग्वासा विषमेक्षणः मुग्धो द्विहस्तः कृष्णाङ्गो दिव्यं दारुवनं ययौ
verses.transliteration: vikṛtaṃ rūpamāsthāya digvāsā viṣamekṣaṇaḥ mugdho dvihastaḥ kṛṣṇāṅgo divyaṃ dāruvanaṃ yayau
verses.translation: On recxjving the gesture of a smile from his lotus- like face the women who had gathered at the threshold of huts in the forest or who stayed on the huts above trees, stopped all other activities and followed him not caring for thcii loosened garments and ornaments.
verses.hindi: यथोक्तकारिणो दान्ता विप्रा ध्यानपरायणा: ॥ महादेवपरा नित्यं चरन्तो ह्यू्ध्वरेतसः।
verses.wordMeaning: On recxjving the gesture of a smile from his lotus- like face the women who had gathered at the threshold of huts in the forest or who stayed on the huts above trees, stopped all other activities and followed him not caring for thcii loosened garments and ornaments.
verses.commentary: Sense: On recxjving the gesture of a smile from his lotus- like face the women who had gathered at the threshold of huts in the forest or who stayed on the huts above trees, stopped all other activities and followed him not caring for thcii loosened garments and ornaments.

verses.sanskrit: मन्दस्मितं च भगवान् स्त्रीणां मनसिजोद्भवम् भ्रूविलासं च गानं च चकारातीव सुंदरः
verses.transliteration: mandasmitaṃ ca bhagavān strīṇāṃ manasijodbhavam bhrūvilāsaṃ ca gānaṃ ca cakārātīva suṃdaraḥ
verses.translation: Some of these women, on seeing him felt their eyes reel- ing due to excitement. Even tlie old women who were beyond the age of seductive charms ot the eye-brow began to display their amorous gestures.
verses.hindi: अर्चयन्ति महादेवं वाङ्मनःकायसंयताः रुद्रलोकमनृप्राप्य न निवर्तन्ति ते पुनः। तस्मादेतद् व्रतं दिव्यमव्यक्तं व्यक्तलिङ्गिनः
verses.wordMeaning: Some of these women, on seeing him felt their eyes reel- ing due to excitement. Even tlie old women who were beyond the age of seductive charms ot the eye-brow began to display their amorous gestures.
verses.commentary: Sense: Some of these women, on seeing him felt their eyes reel- ing due to excitement. Even tlie old women who were beyond the age of seductive charms ot the eye-brow began to display their amorous gestures.

verses.sanskrit: संप्रोक्ष्य नारीवृन्दं वै मुहुर्मुहुरनङ्गहा अनङ्गवृद्धिम् अकरोद् अतीव मधुराकृतिः
verses.transliteration: saṃprokṣya nārīvṛndaṃ vai muhurmuhuranaṅgahā anaṅgavṛddhim akarod atīva madhurākṛtiḥ
verses.translation: On seeing him some women woie smiling faces. With their garments loosened a little, and with their waist bands dislodged they began to sing.
verses.hindi: न हसेन्नाप्रियं ब्रूयादमुत्रेह हितार्थवान्। यस्तान्निन्दति मूढात्मा महादेवं स निन्दति यस्त्वेतान् पूजयेन्नित्यं स पूजयति शङ्करम्। एवमेष महादेवो लोकानां हितकाम्यया
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing him some women woie smiling faces. With their garments loosened a little, and with their waist bands dislodged they began to sing.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing him some women woie smiling faces. With their garments loosened a little, and with their waist bands dislodged they began to sing.

verses.sanskrit: वने तं पुरुषं दृष्ट्वा विकृतं नीललोहितम् स्त्रियः पतिव्रताश्चापि तमेवान्वयुरादरात्
verses.transliteration: vane taṃ puruṣaṃ dṛṣṭvā vikṛtaṃ nīlalohitam striyaḥ pativratāścāpi tamevānvayurādarāt
verses.translation: Some brahmin ladies on seeing him in the forest found that their own fresh silken garments had got loosened. They cast off their bangles of diverse colours and went to thcii kinsmen.
verses.hindi: शिवकथितं परमं पदं विदित्वा। गायन्ति विविधे्ुहोुङ्कारेश्चापि सुस्वरः
verses.wordMeaning: Some brahmin ladies on seeing him in the forest found that their own fresh silken garments had got loosened. They cast off their bangles of diverse colours and went to thcii kinsmen.
verses.commentary: Sense: Some brahmin ladies on seeing him in the forest found that their own fresh silken garments had got loosened. They cast off their bangles of diverse colours and went to thcii kinsmen.

verses.sanskrit: वनोटजद्वारगताश् च नार्यो विस्रस्तवस्त्राभरणा विचेष्टाः लब्ध्वा स्मितं तस्य मुखारविन्दाद् द्रुमालयस्थास् तम् अथान्वयुस्ताः
verses.transliteration: vanoṭajadvāragatāś ca nāryo visrastavastrābharaṇā viceṣṭāḥ labdhvā smitaṃ tasya mukhāravindād drumālayasthās tam athānvayustāḥ
verses.translation: One of them, on seeing him did not know tliat her upper and lower garments had stripped off. Others in ihcir excitement could not distinguish between their kinsmen and the multi-branched trees though they were familiar.
verses.hindi: नमो देवाधिदेवाय महादेवाय वै नमः । अर्धनारीशरीराय सांख्ययोगप्रवर्तिने करें। विशेष रूपसे मेरी भक्तिमें तत्पर उत्तम, दिगम्बर, ब्रह्मवादी, बालस्वभाववाले, उन्मत्त तथा चेष्टारहित यतिको तो कभी भी निन्दा नहीं करनी चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: One of them, on seeing him did not know tliat her upper and lower garments had stripped off. Others in ihcir excitement could not distinguish between their kinsmen and the multi-branched trees though they were familiar.
verses.commentary: Sense: One of them, on seeing him did not know tliat her upper and lower garments had stripped off. Others in ihcir excitement could not distinguish between their kinsmen and the multi-branched trees though they were familiar.

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा काश्चिद्भवं नार्यो मदघूर्णितलोचनाः विलासबाह्यास्ताश्चापि भ्रूविलासं प्रचक्रिरे
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvā kāścidbhavaṃ nāryo madaghūrṇitalocanāḥ vilāsabāhyāstāścāpi bhrūvilāsaṃ pracakrire
verses.translation: Some sang; some danced; some fell and idled down on the ground. O leading brahmin, another lady sat on the ground like an elephant and began to talk aloud. Look- ing smilingly they began to embrace one another all round. After stopping Rudra on his way they began to show all shrewd gestures.
verses.hindi: भस्मसे विभूषित होकर दग्ध पापोंवाले, इन्द्रियजित्, ध्यानपरायण, नित्य नैष्ठिक ब्रह्मचर्यका पालन करनेवाले तथा महादेवकी भक्तिमें तत्पर जो विप्र मन-वाणी एवं शरीरसे संयत होकर मुझ महादेवकी यथोक्त रीतिसे पूजा-आराधना करते हैं, वे रुद्रलोकको प्राप्त होते हैं और उनका पुनर्जन्म नहीं होता है। अतएव व्यक्त लिङ्गवाले शिवका यह पाशुपत व्रत परम दिव्य तथा अव्यक्त है
verses.wordMeaning: Some sang; some danced; some fell and idled down on the ground. O leading brahmin, another lady sat on the ground like an elephant and began to talk aloud. Look- ing smilingly they began to embrace one another all round.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Some sang; some danced; some fell and idled down on the ground. O leading brahmin, another lady sat on the ground like an elephant and began to talk aloud. Look- ing smilingly they began to embrace one another all round.…

verses.sanskrit: अथ दृष्ट्वापरा नार्यः किंचित् प्रहसिताननाः किंचिद् विस्रस्तवसनाः स्रस्तकाञ्चीगुणा जगुः
verses.transliteration: atha dṛṣṭvāparā nāryaḥ kiṃcit prahasitānanāḥ kiṃcid visrastavasanāḥ srastakāñcīguṇā jaguḥ
verses.translation: They asked, "who ai'C you?'*
verses.hindi: विद्वान् मनुष्यको चाहिए कि भस्म धारण किये तथा मुण्डित सिर जो शिवरूप ब्रती हैं, उनकी न तो निन्दा करे तथा न तो उनकी बातोंका उल्लंघन करे। लोक एवं परलोकमें अपना हित चाहनेवालेको ऐसे महात्माओंपर न तो हँसना चाहिए और न तो उनके प्रति अप्रिय वचन बोलना चाहिए॥ ९९/२ ॥
verses.wordMeaning: They asked, "who ai'C you?'*
verses.commentary: Sense: They asked, "who ai'C you?'*

verses.sanskrit: काश्चित्तदा तं विपिने तु दृष्ट्वा विप्राङ्गनाः स्रस्तनवांशुकं वा स्वान्स्वान्विचित्रान् वलयान्प्रविध्य मदान्विता बन्धुजनांश् च जग्मुः
verses.transliteration: kāścittadā taṃ vipine tu dṛṣṭvā viprāṅganāḥ srastanavāṃśukaṃ vā svānsvānvicitrān valayānpravidhya madānvitā bandhujanāṃś ca jagmuḥ
verses.translation: Due to the Maya of Rudra even the chaste ladies fell down in an awkward posture with their clothes loosened and their tresses dishevelled, in the very presence ol llieir husbands.
verses.hindi: जो मनुष्य इनकी निन्दा करता है, वह मन्दबुद्धि साक्षात् महादेवको निन्दा करता है तथा जो इनकी नित्य पूजा करता है, वह महादेवजीकी पूजा करता है ॥ १० /२॥ इस प्रकार ये महायोगी शिवजी भस्म-भूषित होकर लोक-कल्याणको कामनासे युग-युगमें नानाविध क्रोड़ाएँ करते हैं। आपलोग भी ऐसा ही आचरण कीजिये; उससे आपलोगोंका कल्याण होगा तथा आपलोग
verses.wordMeaning: Due to the Maya of Rudra even the chaste ladies fell down in an awkward posture with their clothes loosened and their tresses dishevelled, in the very presence ol llieir husbands.
verses.commentary: Sense: Due to the Maya of Rudra even the chaste ladies fell down in an awkward posture with their clothes loosened and their tresses dishevelled, in the very presence ol llieir husbands.

verses.sanskrit: काचित्तदा तं न विवेद दृष्ट्वा विवासना स्रस्तमहांशुका च शाखाविचित्रान् विटपान्प्रसिद्धान् मदान्विता बन्धुजनांस्तथान्याः
verses.transliteration: kācittadā taṃ na viveda dṛṣṭvā vivāsanā srastamahāṃśukā ca śākhāvicitrān viṭapānprasiddhān madānvitā bandhujanāṃstathānyāḥ
verses.translation: Even after h( iring their words and seeing their diverse activities, the unchanging lord Rudra did not utter anything, good or bad.
verses.hindi: सिद्धि प्राप्त करेंगे महाभयका नाश करनेवाले शिव-कथित अतुलनीय तथा परमपदको जानकर उन मुनियोंका चित्त सांसारिक लोभ एवं मोहसे रहित हो गया और उन्होंने शंकरजीके चरणोंपर सिर रखकर प्रणाम किया
verses.wordMeaning: Even after h( iring their words and seeing their diverse activities, the unchanging lord Rudra did not utter anything, good or bad.
verses.commentary: Sense: Even after h( iring their words and seeing their diverse activities, the unchanging lord Rudra did not utter anything, good or bad.

verses.sanskrit: काश्चिज्जगुस्तं ननृतुर् निपेतुश् च धरातले निषेदुर्गजवच्चान्या प्रोवाच द्विजपुङ्गवाः
verses.transliteration: kāścijjagustaṃ nanṛtur nipetuś ca dharātale niṣedurgajavaccānyā provāca dvijapuṅgavāḥ
verses.translation: On seeing the fiowd ol women and Rudia in this situation the brahmins, the leading sages began to say harsh words.
verses.hindi: इस प्रकार शिवको बातें सुनकर प्रसन्न मनवाले उन मुनियोंने गन्ध, पुष्प तथा कुशसे मिश्रित शुद्ध जलसे परिपूर्ण विशाल घड़ोंसे महेश्वरको स्नान कराया और पुनः वे गूढ़ तथा हुंकारयुक्त सुन्दर स्वरोंसे महादेवजीका स्तुति-गान करने लगे
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing the fiowd ol women and Rudia in this situation the brahmins, the leading sages began to say harsh words.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing the fiowd ol women and Rudia in this situation the brahmins, the leading sages began to say harsh words.

verses.translation: Their powers of austerity were incft'ective against Rudra in the same manner as the lustre of the stars in the sky igainst the refulgence of the sun.

verses.wordMeaning: Their powers of austerity were incft'ective against Rudra in the same manner as the lustre of the stars in the sky igainst the refulgence of the sun.
verses.commentary: Sense: Their powers of austerity were incft'ective against Rudra in the same manner as the lustre of the stars in the sky igainst the refulgence of the sun.
