verses.sanskrit: तपांसि तेषां सर्वेषां प्रत्याहन्यन्त शङ्करे यथादित्यप्रकाशेन तारका नभसि स्थिताः
verses.transliteration: tapāṃsi teṣāṃ sarveṣāṃ pratyāhanyanta śaṅkare yathādityaprakāśena tārakā nabhasi sthitāḥ
verses.translation: Dharma had been cursed by the noble sage Mandavya. The Vrsnis along with Krsna had been cursed by Durvasas and other noble sages.
verses.hindi: तत्पश्चात् उस स्तुतिसे अत्यन्त प्रसन्नताको प्राप्त उन महादेवने उन मुनियोंसे पुनः कहा--हे सुव्रती मुनीश्वरो ! मैं तुमलोगोंकी तपस्यासे अति प्रसन्न हूँ। तुम सब वर माँगो इसपर भृगु, अंगिरा, वसिष्ठ, विश्वामित्र, गौतम, अत्रि, सुकेश, पुलस्त्य, पुलह, क्रतु, मरीचि, कश्यप, कण्व, संवर्त आदि उन सभी महान् तपस्वी मुनियोंने शिवजीको प्रणामकर उनसे यह वचन कहा-भस्म-
verses.wordMeaning: Dharma had been cursed by the noble sage Mandavya. The Vrsnis along with Krsna had been cursed by Durvasas and other noble sages.
verses.commentary: Sense: Dharma had been cursed by the noble sage Mandavya. The Vrsnis along with Krsna had been cursed by Durvasas and other noble sages.

verses.sanskrit: श्रूयते ऋषिशापेन ब्रह्मणस्तु महात्मनः समृद्धश्रेयसां योनिर् यज्ञा वै नाशमाप्तवान्
verses.transliteration: śrūyate ṛṣiśāpena brahmaṇastu mahātmanaḥ samṛddhaśreyasāṃ yonir yajñā vai nāśamāptavān
verses.translation: Rama and his younger brother Laksmana had been c\irsed by the noble sage Durvasas. Lord Visnu was even kicked by the sage Bhrgu.
verses.hindi: स्नान, नग्नता, वामता, प्रतिलोमता (काम्य कर्ममार्गमें प्रवृत्ति), सेव्य तथा असेव्य-इनके विषयमें हम जानना चाहते हैं॥ २०--२२ /२॥ इसपर उनको बात सुनकर परमेश्वर भगवान् शिवने मुसकराकर सभी मुनिवरोंकी ओर देखकर उनसे
verses.wordMeaning: Rama and his younger brother Laksmana had been c\irsed by the noble sage Durvasas. Lord Visnu was even kicked by the sage Bhrgu.
verses.commentary: Sense: Rama and his younger brother Laksmana had been c\irsed by the noble sage Durvasas. Lord Visnu was even kicked by the sage Bhrgu.

verses.sanskrit: भृगोर् अपि च शापेन विष्णुः परमवीर्यवान् प्रादुर्भावान्दश प्राप्तो दुःखितश् च सदा कृतः
verses.transliteration: bhṛgor api ca śāpena viṣṇuḥ paramavīryavān prādurbhāvāndaśa prāpto duḥkhitaś ca sadā kṛtaḥ
verses.translation: These and many others, except the odd-eyed lord of Uma, the overlord of Devas had been made subservient by the brahmins.
verses.hindi: सस्मितं प्राह सम्प्रेक्ष्य सर्वान् मुनिवरांस्तदा॥ २४  कहा भगवान् शिवद्वारा भस्म, भस्मस्नान एवं शिवयोगियोंकी महिमाका प्रतिपादन
verses.wordMeaning: These and many others, except the odd-eyed lord of Uma, the overlord of Devas had been made subservient by the brahmins.
verses.commentary: Sense: These and many others, except the odd-eyed lord of Uma, the overlord of Devas had been made subservient by the brahmins.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रस्यापि च धर्मज्ञ छिन्नं सवृषणं पुरा ऋषिणा गौतमेनोर्व्यां क्रुद्धेन विनिपातितम्
verses.transliteration: indrasyāpi ca dharmajña chinnaṃ savṛṣaṇaṃ purā ṛṣiṇā gautamenorvyāṃ kruddhena vinipātitam
verses.translation: Thus deluded the sages of Daruvana did not under- stand Rudra®*. They spoke harsh words to Rudra who thereupon disappeared.
verses.hindi: भगवान् शिव बोले--हे मुनीश्वर! इन सबके माहात्म्यसे युक्त कथाके सारभागका वर्णन मैं आपलोगोंसे अगिनर्ह्हं सोमकर्ता सोमश्चाग्निमुपाञ्चितः ॥ १  करुँगा। सोमका कारणस्वरूप अग्नि मैं हूँ तथा अग्निसंयुक्त
verses.wordMeaning: Thus deluded the sages of Daruvana did not under- stand Rudra®*. They spoke harsh words to Rudra who thereupon disappeared.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus deluded the sages of Daruvana did not under- stand Rudra®*. They spoke harsh words to Rudra who thereupon disappeared.

verses.sanskrit: गर्भवासो वसूनां च शापेन विहितस् तथा ऋषीणां चैव शापेन नहुषः सर्पतां गतः
verses.transliteration: garbhavāso vasūnāṃ ca śāpena vihitas tathā ṛṣīṇāṃ caiva śāpena nahuṣaḥ sarpatāṃ gataḥ
verses.translation: In the morning all those sages with perplexed minds and blurred thinking went from Daruvana to Brahma of noble soul who was seated in the highest seat. They infor- med him about what had happened in that holy Daru forest.
verses.hindi: कृतमेतद्हत्यग्नर्भूयो लोकसमाश्रयात्। इस लोक (भारतवर्ष) -में रहनेके कारण सबके कर्मोका फल अग्निके द्वारा ही धारण किया जाता हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: In the morning all those sages with perplexed minds and blurred thinking went from Daruvana to Brahma of noble soul who was seated in the highest seat. They infor- med him about what had happened in that holy Daru forest.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the morning all those sages with perplexed minds and blurred thinking went from Daruvana to Brahma of noble soul who was seated in the highest seat. They infor- med him about what had happened in that holy Daru forest.

verses.sanskrit: क्षीरोदश् च समुद्रो ऽसौ निवासः सर्वदा हरेः द्वितीयश्चामृताधारो ह्य् अपेयो ब्राह्मणैः कृतः
verses.transliteration: kṣīrodaś ca samudro 'sau nivāsaḥ sarvadā hareḥ dvitīyaścāmṛtādhāro hy apeyo brāhmaṇaiḥ kṛtaḥ
verses.translation: Pondering over everything in his mind Brahma understood what they did in the holy Daru forest. He stood up with palms joined in reverence and bowed to Rudra. He then spoke* hurriedly to the sages who had their abodes in Daru forest.
verses.hindi: दग्धं जगत्स्थावरजङ्गमम्॥ २  अग्निने इस स्थावर-जंगम जगतको अनेक बार दा भगवान् शिवद्वारा भस्म, भस्मस्नान एवं शिवयोगियोंकी महिमाका प्रतिपादन
verses.wordMeaning: Pondering over everything in his mind Brahma understood what they did in the holy Daru forest. He stood up with palms joined in reverence and bowed to Rudra. He then spoke* hurriedly to the sages who had their abodes in Daru forest.
verses.commentary: Sense: Pondering over everything in his mind Brahma understood what they did in the holy Daru forest. He stood up with palms joined in reverence and bowed to Rudra. He then spoke* hurriedly to the sages who had their abodes in Daru forest.

verses.sanskrit: अविमुक्तेश्वरं प्राप्य वाराणस्यां जनार्दनः क्षीरेण चाभिषिच्येशं देवदेवं त्रियंबकम्
verses.transliteration: avimukteśvaraṃ prāpya vārāṇasyāṃ janārdanaḥ kṣīreṇa cābhiṣicyeśaṃ devadevaṃ triyaṃbakam
verses.translation: The man with a Lihga who had been seen by you all without Lihgas, the person of deformed features was the supreme lord himself.
verses.hindi: पम क प फ फ पफ भक क कफ क फ क फ फ फ फफफ काका भाक मम कक कफ की काका का अग्निकार्यं च यः कृत्वा करिष्यति त्रियायुषम्। भस्मना मम वीर्येण मुच्यते सर्वकिल्बिषैः
verses.wordMeaning: The man with a Lihga who had been seen by you all without Lihgas, the person of deformed features was the supreme lord himself.
verses.commentary: Sense: The man with a Lihga who had been seen by you all without Lihgas, the person of deformed features was the supreme lord himself.

verses.sanskrit: श्रद्धया परया युक्तो देहाश्लेषामृतेन वै निषिक्तेन स्वयं देवः क्षीरेण मधुसूदनः
verses.transliteration: śraddhayā parayā yukto dehāśleṣāmṛtena vai niṣiktena svayaṃ devaḥ kṣīreṇa madhusūdanaḥ
verses.translation: O brahmins, never should the guests be dishonoured by the householder even if they happen to be deformed, dirty or illiterate.
verses.hindi: भ्रक्षणात्सर्वपापानां भस्मेति परिकीर्तितम् ऊष्मपाः पितरो ज्ञेया देवा वै सोमसम्भवाः। अग्नीषोमात्मकं सर्व॑ जगत्स्थावरजङ्गमम्
verses.wordMeaning: O brahmins, never should the guests be dishonoured by the householder even if they happen to be deformed, dirty or illiterate.
verses.commentary: Sense: O brahmins, never should the guests be dishonoured by the householder even if they happen to be deformed, dirty or illiterate.

verses.sanskrit: सेचयित्वाथ भगवान् ब्रह्मणा मुनिभिः समम् क्षीरोदं पूर्ववच्चक्रे निवासं चात्मनः प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: secayitvātha bhagavān brahmaṇā munibhiḥ samam kṣīrodaṃ pūrvavaccakre nivāsaṃ cātmanaḥ prabhuḥ
verses.translation: Formerly, on this very same earth even Kala the God of death was defeated by the excellent brahmin sage SudarSana through the adoration of a guest.
verses.hindi: अहमग्निर्महातेजाः सोमश्चैषा महाम्बिका। अहमर्निश्च सोमश्च प्रकृत्या पुरुषः स्वयम् तदाप्रभृति लोकेषु रक्षार्थमशुभेषु च। भस्मना क्रियते रक्षा सूतिकानां गृहेषु च
verses.wordMeaning: Formerly, on this very same earth even Kala the God of death was defeated by the excellent brahmin sage SudarSana through the adoration of a guest.
verses.commentary: Sense: Formerly, on this very same earth even Kala the God of death was defeated by the excellent brahmin sage SudarSana through the adoration of a guest.

verses.sanskrit: धर्मश्चैव तथा शप्तो माण्डव्येन महात्मना वृष्णयश्चैव कृष्णेन दुर्वासाद्यैर्महात्मभिः
verses.transliteration: dharmaścaiva tathā śapto māṇḍavyena mahātmanā vṛṣṇayaścaiva kṛṣṇena durvāsādyairmahātmabhiḥ
verses.translation: Excepting the adoration of the guests there is no
verses.hindi: व्रतं पाशुपतं योगं कापिलं चैव निर्मितम्। पूर्व पाशुपतं ह्येतन्निर्मितं तदनुत्तमम् सृष्टिरेषा मया सृष्टा लज्ञामोहभयात्मिका
verses.wordMeaning: Excepting the adoration of the guests there is no
verses.commentary: Sense: Excepting the adoration of the guests there is no

verses.sanskrit: राघवः सानुजश् चापि दुर्वासेन महात्मना श्रीवत्सश् च मुनेः पाद पतनात्तस्य धीमतः
verses.transliteration: rāghavaḥ sānujaś cāpi durvāsena mahātmanā śrīvatsaś ca muneḥ pāda patanāttasya dhīmataḥ
verses.translation: praptanidhanan i.e. though you have obtained a rich treasure in the visit of Siva to your hermitage.
verses.hindi: नग्ना एव हि जायन्ते देवता मुनयस्तथा। ये चान्ये मानवा लोके सर्वे जायन्त्यवाससः तैरेव संवृतैर्गुप्तो न वस्त्रं कारणं स्मृतम्
verses.wordMeaning: praptanidhanan i.e. though you have obtained a rich treasure in the visit of Siva to your hermitage.
verses.commentary: Sense: praptanidhanan i.e. though you have obtained a rich treasure in the visit of Siva to your hermitage.

verses.sanskrit: एते चान्ये च बहवो विप्राणां वशमागताः वर्जयित्वा विरूपाक्षं देवदेवमुमापतिम्
verses.transliteration: ete cānye ca bahavo viprāṇāṃ vaśamāgatāḥ varjayitvā virūpākṣaṃ devadevamumāpatim
verses.translation: Formerly, a householder known as Sudarsana, vowed to conquer the God of Death. He said to his chaste wife.
verses.hindi: किया है। अग्निसे भस्मीभूत हो जानेसे यह सम्पूर्ण जगत् पवित्र तथा उत्तम हो जाता है  उसी भस्मसे ओज प्राप्त करके यह सोम प्राणियोंको जीवित करता है जो मनुष्य अग्निहोत्र- कार्य सम्पन्न करके भस्मसे त्र्यायुष करता है, वह मेरे ओजसे समस्त पापोंसे मुक्त हो जाता है
verses.wordMeaning: Formerly, a householder known as Sudarsana, vowed to conquer the God of Death. He said to his chaste wife.
verses.commentary: Sense: Formerly, a householder known as Sudarsana, vowed to conquer the God of Death. He said to his chaste wife.

verses.sanskrit: एवं हि मोहितास्तेन नावबुध्यन्त शङ्करम् अत्युग्रवचनं प्रोचुश् चोग्रो ऽप्यन्तरधीयत
verses.transliteration: evaṃ hi mohitāstena nāvabudhyanta śaṅkaram atyugravacanaṃ procuś cogro 'pyantaradhīyata
verses.translation: "O lady of good holy rites, fine eye-brows and good fortune, listen to whai I say, assiduously. Never should you dishonour the guests who visit your house.
verses.hindi: यह भस्म प्रकाशित करता है, कल्याण सम्पादित करता है तथा समस्त पापोंका नाश करता है, अतएव इसे भस्म कहा जाता है ऊष्मपसंज्ञक पितर तथा देवतागण चन्द्रमासे उत्पन्न कहे गये हैं। स्थावर-जंगममय यह समस्त जगत् अग्नि-सोमात्मक है
verses.wordMeaning: "O lady of good holy rites, fine eye-brows and good fortune, listen to whai I say, assiduously. Never should you dishonour the guests who visit your house.
verses.commentary: Sense: "O lady of good holy rites, fine eye-brows and good fortune, listen to whai I say, assiduously. Never should you dishonour the guests who visit your house.

verses.sanskrit: ते ऽपि दारुवनात्तस्मात् प्रातः संविग्नमानसाः पितामहं महात्मानम् आसीनं परमासने
verses.transliteration: te 'pi dāruvanāttasmāt prātaḥ saṃvignamānasāḥ pitāmahaṃ mahātmānam āsīnaṃ paramāsane
verses.translation: Since everyone of the guests is the Pinaka-bearing lord, you should dedicate even your self to the guest and adore him.
verses.hindi: मैं महान् तेजसे युक्त अग्नि हूँ तथा ये महिमामयी अम्बा पार्वती सोमस्वरूपा हैं। प्रकृतिके साथ पुरुषरूप मैं अग्नि सोम दोनों ही हूँ अतएव है महाभाग मुनियो! यह भस्म मेरा वीर्य है-एऐसा कहा जाता है। मैं अपने शरीरमें अपने वीर्य (भस्म)-को धारण करके अधिष्ठित हूँ और उसी समयसे यह भस्म सभी अमंगलोंसे लोकोंको रक्षा करता
verses.wordMeaning: Since everyone of the guests is the Pinaka-bearing lord, you should dedicate even your self to the guest and adore him.
verses.commentary: Sense: Since everyone of the guests is the Pinaka-bearing lord, you should dedicate even your self to the guest and adore him.

verses.sanskrit: गत्वा विज्ञापयामासुः प्रवृत्तमखिलं विभोः शुभे दारुवने तस्मिन् मुनयः क्षीणचेतसः
verses.transliteration: gatvā vijñāpayāmāsuḥ pravṛttamakhilaṃ vibhoḥ śubhe dāruvane tasmin munayaḥ kṣīṇacetasaḥ
verses.translation: That chaste lady, on being urged thus, became ex- tremely dejected. Helpless that she was, she wept and said to her husband — "O lord! please explain what you have just said.''
verses.hindi: है तथा इसी भस्मसे सूतिकागृहोंको भी रक्षा को जाती है जो मनुष्य क्रोध तथा इन्द्रियोंको जीतकर भस्मस्नान करके पवित्र अन्तःकरणवाला हो जाता है, वह मेरा सानिध्य प्राप्त कर लेता है एवं पुनर्जन्मसे मुक्त हो जाता है
verses.wordMeaning: That chaste lady, on being urged thus, became ex- tremely dejected. Helpless that she was, she wept and said to her husband — "O lord! please explain what you have just said.''
verses.commentary: Sense: That chaste lady, on being urged thus, became ex- tremely dejected. Helpless that she was, she wept and said to her husband — "O lord! please explain what you have just said.''

verses.sanskrit: सो ऽपि संचिन्त्य मनसा क्षणादेव पितामहः तेषां प्रवृत्तमखिलं पुण्ये दारुवने पुरा
verses.transliteration: so 'pi saṃcintya manasā kṣaṇādeva pitāmahaḥ teṣāṃ pravṛttamakhilaṃ puṇye dāruvane purā
verses.translation: O noble lady, enough ol this cooked rice and other eatables! 1 say, you should dedicate yourscH (to me)"
verses.hindi: पाशुपतत्रत, योगशास्त्र तथा कापिल (सांख्यशास्त्र) - की रचना मैंने ही को। इनमें पाशुपतयोगको रचना पहले हुई है, इसलिये यह उत्तम है आश्रम-सम्बन्धी शेष सभी शास्त्र स्वयंभू ब्रह्माजीके द्वारा बादमें रचे गये और लज्जा, मोह तथा भयसे युक्त इस सृष्टिकी रचना मैंने ही की है
verses.wordMeaning: O noble lady, enough ol this cooked rice and other eatables! 1 say, you should dedicate yourscH (to me)"
verses.commentary: Sense: O noble lady, enough ol this cooked rice and other eatables! 1 say, you should dedicate yourscH (to me)"

verses.sanskrit: उत्थाय प्राञ्जलिर्भूत्वा प्रणिपत्य भवाय च उवाच सत्वरं ब्रह्मा मुनीन्दारुवनालयान्
verses.transliteration: utthāya prāñjalirbhūtvā praṇipatya bhavāya ca uvāca satvaraṃ brahmā munīndāruvanālayān
verses.translation: jelum (inrtyum iti sesah) i.c. to conquer death.
verses.hindi: लोकमें अन्य जो मनुष्य हैं, वे भी वस्त्रविहीन- अवस्थामें उत्पन्न होते हैं। इन्द्रियोंपर विजय प्राप्त न किये हुए लोग सुन्दर वस्त्र धारण करके भी नग्न हैं और फापापापापापापाफाफाफाफ प्या फ्रफ्फफफफ्फफफ्फफफफ्फफफफफफफफफफफककफऊ फफफफफफ फफ फफफफफ फो पापी फीफफफीफाफीफफीफीफाकीकी CEE फफफफफफ फफफ फ
verses.wordMeaning: jelum (inrtyum iti sesah) i.c. to conquer death.
verses.commentary: Sense: jelum (inrtyum iti sesah) i.c. to conquer death.

verses.sanskrit: धिग् युष्मान् प्राप्तनिधनान् महानिधिम् अनुत्तमम् वृथाकृतं यतो विप्रा युष्माभिर् भाग्यवर्जितैः
verses.transliteration: dhig yuṣmān prāptanidhanān mahānidhim anuttamam vṛthākṛtaṃ yato viprā yuṣmābhir bhāgyavarjitaiḥ
verses.translation: "O Sudarsana, O highly blessed one, I am now engaged in sexual intercourse with this wife of yours. What should be done here may kindly be mentioned. O leading brahmin, the sexual intercourse is concluded. O excellent brahmin, I am satisfied."
verses.hindi: इन्द्रियजित् लोग नग्न रहते हुए भी सस्त्रसे ढँके हुए है तुल्यौ मानावमानौ च तदावरणमुत्तमम्॥ १ इसमें वस्त्र हेतु नहीं माना गया है
verses.wordMeaning: "O Sudarsana, O highly blessed one, I am now engaged in sexual intercourse with this wife of yours. What should be done here may kindly be mentioned. O leading brahmin, the sexual intercourse is concluded. O excellent brahmin, I am satisfied."
verses.commentary: Sense: "O Sudarsana, O highly blessed one, I am now engaged in sexual intercourse with this wife of yours. What should be done here may kindly be mentioned. O leading brahmin, the sexual intercourse is concluded. O excellent brahmin, I am satisfied."

verses.sanskrit: यस्तु दारुवने तस्मिंल् लिङ्गी दृष्टो ऽप्यलिङ्गिभिः युष्माभिर् विकृताकारः स एव परमेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: yastu dāruvane tasmiṃl liṅgī dṛṣṭo 'pyaliṅgibhiḥ yuṣmābhir vikṛtākāraḥ sa eva parameśvaraḥ
verses.translation: O unfortunate noble brahmins, of what avail is much talk. All of you should seek refuge in the very same Rudra immediately.
verses.hindi: यद्यकार्यसहस्त्राणि कृत्वा यः स्नाति भस्मना तस्माद्यत्नपरो भूत्वा त्रिकालमपि यः सदा
verses.wordMeaning: O unfortunate noble brahmins, of what avail is much talk. All of you should seek refuge in the very same Rudra immediately.
verses.commentary: Sense: O unfortunate noble brahmins, of what avail is much talk. All of you should seek refuge in the very same Rudra immediately.

verses.sanskrit: गृहस्थैश् च न निन्द्यास्तु सदा ह्यतिथयो द्विजाः विरूपाश् च सुरूपाश् च मलिनाश्चाप्यपण्डिताः
verses.transliteration: gṛhasthaiś ca na nindyāstu sadā hyatithayo dvijāḥ virūpāś ca surūpāś ca malināścāpyapaṇḍitāḥ

verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, the devotee shall, at first, learn the Vedas with great devotion from his preceptor. He shall always ponder over their meanings and understand Dharma. He shall remain a disciple till he completes all learn- ing or upto twelve yea/s.
verses.hindi: इन्द्रादयस्तथा देवा: कामिकव्रतमास्थिताः। ऐश्वर्य परमं प्राप्य सर्वे प्रथिततेजसः पशुपतियोगपरो भवेत्सहैव

verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent brahmins, the devotee shall, at first, learn the Vedas with great devotion from his preceptor. He shall always ponder over their meanings and understand Dharma. He shall remain a disciple till he completes all learn- ing or upto twelve yea/s.

verses.sanskrit: अन्यथा नास्ति संतर्तुं गृहस्थैश् च द्विजोत्तमैः त्यक्त्वा चातिथिपूजां ताम् आत्मनो भुवि शोधनम्

He shall consign all the earthen and wooden vessels to the w aters and the metallii oik s to his pre- ceptor. He shall distribute all his belongings to the brahmins without hesitation. He shall prostrate on the ground and make obeisance to the preceptor. Becoming detached he shall then renounce everything and become an ascetic.

verses.sanskrit: भार्यया त्वनया सार्धं मैथुनस्थो ऽहमद्य वै सुदर्शन महाभाग किं कर्तव्यमिहोच्यताम्

verses.sanskrit: सुरतान्तस्तु विप्रेन्द्र संतुष्टो ऽहं द्विजोत्तम सुदर्शनस्ततः प्राह सुप्रहृष्टो द्विजोत्तमः
verses.transliteration: suratāntastu viprendra saṃtuṣṭo 'haṃ dvijottama sudarśanastataḥ prāha suprahṛṣṭo dvijottamaḥ
verses.translation: Over the heads of the sage and Rudra, the sky-roving gods showered cool and splendid flowers from the firmament.
verses.hindi: प्राप्त किया और है नन्दीश्वर! जिस प्रकार आपने मृत्युपर विजय प्राप्त की, वह भी आप कृपा करके बताइये नन्दी कहते हैं--ब्रह्माजीके पुत्र महान् तेजवाले क्षुप नामक एक राजा हुए हैं। उन लोकपति क्षुपकी मुनीश्वर दधीचसे मित्रता थी
verses.wordMeaning: Over the heads of the sage and Rudra, the sky-roving gods showered cool and splendid flowers from the firmament.
verses.commentary: Sense: Over the heads of the sage and Rudra, the sky-roving gods showered cool and splendid flowers from the firmament.

verses.sanskrit: प्रददौ चेप्सितं सर्वं तमाह च महाद्युतिः एषा न भुक्ता विप्रेन्द्र मनसापि सुशोभना
verses.transliteration: pradadau cepsitaṃ sarvaṃ tamāha ca mahādyutiḥ eṣā na bhuktā viprendra manasāpi suśobhanā
verses.translation: On seeing Yama destroyed in a trice, the lord blessed the excellent brahmin and disappeared.***
verses.hindi: अष्टानां लोकपालानां वपुर्धारयते नृपः। तस्मादिन्द्रो ह्यहं वह्निर्यमश्च निर्क्रतिस्तथा महती देवता या सा महतश्चापि सुव्रत। तस्मात्त्वया महाभाग च्यावनेय सदा ह्यहम्
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing Yama destroyed in a trice, the lord blessed the excellent brahmin and disappeared.***
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing Yama destroyed in a trice, the lord blessed the excellent brahmin and disappeared.***

verses.sanskrit: मया चैषा न संदेहः श्रद्धां ज्ञातुमिहागतः जितो वै यस्त्वया मृत्युर् धर्मेणैकेन सुव्रत
verses.transliteration: mayā caiṣā na saṃdehaḥ śraddhāṃ jñātumihāgataḥ jito vai yastvayā mṛtyur dharmeṇaikena suvrata
verses.translation: Hence, O brahmins. One should devoutly worship the lord, the conqueror of the god of Death. He is the bestower of liberation as well as of worldly pleasures. He is the benefactor of all.
verses.hindi: शरुत्वा तथा मतं तस्य क्षुपस्य मुनिसत्तमः ब्रह्मलोके पुरासौ हि ब्रह्मणः क्षुतसम्भवः। लब्धं वज्रं च कार्यार्थ वज्रिणा चोदितः प्रभुः
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, O brahmins. One should devoutly worship the lord, the conqueror of the god of Death. He is the bestower of liberation as well as of worldly pleasures. He is the benefactor of all.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, O brahmins. One should devoutly worship the lord, the conqueror of the god of Death. He is the bestower of liberation as well as of worldly pleasures. He is the benefactor of all.

verses.sanskrit: अहो ऽस्य तपसो वीर्यम् इत्युक्त्वा प्रययौ च सः तस्मात्तथा पूजनीयाः सर्वे ह्यतिथयः सदा
verses.transliteration: aho 'sya tapaso vīryam ityuktvā prayayau ca saḥ tasmāttathā pūjanīyāḥ sarve hyatithayaḥ sadā
verses.translation: Of what avail is much talk? After renouncing and wor- shipping Rudra with great devotion you will all become free from grief.
verses.hindi: तस्माद्राजा स विप्रेन्द्रमजयद्वै महाबलः सस्मार च तदा तत्र दुःखाद्है भार्गवं मुनिम्। शुक्रोऽपि सन्धयामास ताडितं कुलिशेन तम्
verses.wordMeaning: Of what avail is much talk? After renouncing and wor- shipping Rudra with great devotion you will all become free from grief.
verses.commentary: Sense: Of what avail is much talk? After renouncing and wor- shipping Rudra with great devotion you will all become free from grief.

verses.sanskrit: बहुनात्र किमुक्तेन भाग्यहीना द्विजोत्तमाः तमेव शरणं तूर्णं गन्तुमर्हथ शङ्करम्
verses.transliteration: bahunātra kimuktena bhāgyahīnā dvijottamāḥ tameva śaraṇaṃ tūrṇaṃ gantumarhatha śaṅkaram
verses.translation: On being addressed thus by Brahma, the sages, the expounders of Brahman said once again: — O lord, be pleased. By what penance or sacrifice or holy rites can devotion to Rudra, the Pinaka-bearing lord, be acquired? How will the twicebom become the devotee of Rudra?
verses.hindi: भो दधीच महाभाग देवदेवमुमापतिम्। सम्पूज्य पूज्यं ब्रह्माद्मैर्देददेव॑ निरञ्जनम् कालान्तरमें उन क्षुप तथा दधीचके मध्य बातके सन्दर्भमें विवाद हो गया। क्षुपका कथन था कि. क्षत्रिय श्रेष्ठ होता है और दधीचका कथन था कि ब्राह्मण ही श्रेष्ठ होता है
verses.wordMeaning: On being addressed thus by Brahma, the sages, the expounders of Brahman said once again: — O lord, be pleased. By what penance or sacrifice or holy rites can devotion to Rudra, the Pinaka-bearing lord, be acquired? How will the twicebom become the devotee of Rudra?
verses.commentary: Sense: On being addressed thus by Brahma, the sages, the expounders of Brahman said once again: — O lord, be pleased. By what penance or sacrifice or holy rites can devotion to Rudra, the Pinaka-bearing lord, be acquired? How will the twicebom become the devotee of Rudra?

verses.sanskrit: तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा ब्रह्मणो ब्राह्मणर्षभाः ब्रह्माणमभिवन्द्यार्ताः प्रोचुराकुलितेक्षणाः
verses.transliteration: tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā brahmaṇo brāhmaṇarṣabhāḥ brahmāṇamabhivandyārtāḥ procurākulitekṣaṇāḥ

verses.sanskrit: नापेक्षितं महाभाग जीवितं विकृताः स्त्रियः दृष्टो ऽस्माभिर् महादेवो निन्दितो यस्त्वनिन्दितः
verses.transliteration: nāpekṣitaṃ mahābhāga jīvitaṃ vikṛtāḥ striyaḥ dṛṣṭo 'smābhir mahādevo nindito yastvaninditaḥ
verses.translation: Formerly, by means of devotion, Dadhica conquer- ed lord Viu and his associate Devas. He killed K$upa with the tip of his foot. He acquired adamantine bones. By glori- fying the lord, I too conquered death. Even by the great sage Sveta who had fallen into the jaws of death, death was con- quered by the grace of the lord, in the manner it was conque- red by me.
verses.hindi: हे सुव्रत! वह राजा महान् देवता होता है । अत: हे च्यवनपुत्र है महाभाग ! तुम्हें मेरा अपमान कभी नहीं करना चाहिए, अपितु सर्वथा मेरी पूजा करनी चाहिए ॥ ७ i उन क्षुपका वह वचन सुनकर च्यवनपुत्र मुनिश्रेष्ठ द्विज दधीचने आत्मगौरवसे प्रेरित होकर अपने बाँयें हाथसे ्षुपके सिरपर तेज मुष्टिका-प्रहार किया॥ ८१/,॥ .

By glori- fying the lord, I too conquered death. Even by the great sage Sveta who had fallen into the jaws of death,…

verses.sanskrit: शप्तश् च सर्वगः शूली पिनाकी नीललोहितः अज्ञानाच्छापजा शक्तिः कुण्ठितास्यनिरीक्षणात्

verses.sanskrit: आदौ वेदानधीत्यैव श्रद्धया च गुरोः सदा विचार्यार्थं मुनेर्धर्मान् प्रतिज्ञाय द्विजोत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: ādau vedānadhītyaiva śraddhayā ca guroḥ sadā vicāryārthaṃ munerdharmān pratijñāya dvijottamāḥ

By glori- fying the lord, I too conquered death. Even by the great sage Sveta who had fallen into the jaws of death, death was con- quered by the grace of the lord, in the manner it was conque- red by me.
verses.hindi: दधीचके शरीरको पूर्वकी भाँति ठीककर भार्गव शुकराचार्यने कहा-हे महाभाग दधीच! है विप्रवर ! ब्रह्मा आदि देवताओंसे पूजित निरंजन देवाधिदेव उमापति शिवको सम्यक् पूजा करके उन त्र्यम्बक महादेवके अनुग्रहसे अवध्य हो जाओ॥ १४-१५१/ ॥

verses.sanskrit: ग्रहणान्तं हि वा विद्वान् अथ द्वादशवार्षिकम् स्नात्वाहृत्य च दारान्वै पुत्रानुत्पाद्य सुव्रतान्
verses.transliteration: grahaṇāntaṃ hi vā vidvān atha dvādaśavārṣikam snātvāhṛtya ca dārānvai putrānutpādya suvratān
verses.translation: Formerly, by means of devotion, Dadhica conquer- ed lord Viu and his associate Devas. He killed K$upa with the tip of his foot. He acquired adamantine bones. By glori- fying the lord, I too conquered death. By glori- fying the lord, I too conquered death. Even by the great sage Sveta who had fallen into the jaws of death, death was con- quered by the grace of the lord, in the manner it was conque- red by me.
verses.hindi: किंतु भगवान् शिवके अनुग्रहसे वत्र-तुल्य शरीरबाले महात्मा दधीचको वह वज्र विनष्ट करनेमें समर्थ नहीं हो सका दधीचका अवध्यत्व, उनकी अदीनता तथा उनके तपोबलका प्रभाव देखकर राजा क्षुप कमलके सदृश. नेत्रवाले उपेन्द्र मुकुन्द श्रीविष्णुकी आराधना करने
verses.wordMeaning: Formerly, by means of devotion, Dadhica conquer- ed lord Viu and his associate Devas. He killed K$upa with the tip of his foot. He acquired adamantine bones. By glori- fying the lord, I too conquered death. Even by the great sage Sveta who had fallen into the jaws of death,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Formerly, by means of devotion, Dadhica conquer- ed lord Viu and his associate Devas. He killed K$upa with the tip of his foot. He acquired adamantine bones. By glori- fying the lord, I too conquered death. Even by the great sage Sveta who had fallen into the jaws of death,…

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीलिङ्गमहापुराणे पूर्वभागे एकोनत्रिंशो ऽध्यायः एवमुक्तास्तदा तेन ब्रह्मणा ब्राह्मणर्षभाः श्वेतस्य च कथां पुण्याम् अपृच्छन् परमर्षयः
verses.transliteration: iti śrīliṅgamahāpurāṇe pūrvabhāge ekonatriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ evamuktāstadā tena brahmaṇā brāhmaṇarṣabhāḥ śvetasya ca kathāṃ puṇyām apṛcchan paramarṣayaḥ
verses.translation: On being thus uiged by Brahma, the leading brahmins, the great sages asked him about the sacred story of Sveta.
verses.hindi: राजा क्षुपद्वारा विष्णुको आराधना, विष्णुद्वारा शिवभक्तोंकी महिमाका कथन पूजया तस्य सन्तुष्टो भगवान् पुरुषोत्तमः। श्रीभूमिसहितः श्रीमान् शङ्खचक्रगदाधरः
verses.wordMeaning: On being thus uiged by Brahma, the leading brahmins, the great sages asked him about the sacred story of Sveta.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being thus uiged by Brahma, the leading brahmins, the great sages asked him about the sacred story of Sveta.

verses.sanskrit: श्वेतो नाम मुनिः श्रीमान् गतायुर्गिरिगह्वरे सक्तो ह्यभ्यर्च्य यद्भक्त्या तुष्टाव च महेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: śveto nāma muniḥ śrīmān gatāyurgirigahvare sakto hyabhyarcya yadbhaktyā tuṣṭāva ca maheśvaram
verses.translation: O brahmins, there was a certain sage named Sveta in the cave of a mountain. His span of life was nearing its end. Hence he worshipped and eulogised the great lord with devo- tion. He repeated the Mantras of the holy hymn Rudradhyaya beginning with "Namaste*' (Obeisance so Th( Then the
verses.hindi: पीताम्बरश्च भगवान् देवै्हैत्यैश्च संवृतः दिव्येन दर्शनेनैव दृष्ट्वा देवं जनार्दनम्
verses.wordMeaning: O brahmins, there was a certain sage named Sveta in the cave of a mountain. His span of life was nearing its end. Hence he worshipped and eulogised the great lord with devo- tion.…
verses.commentary: Sense: O brahmins, there was a certain sage named Sveta in the cave of a mountain. His span of life was nearing its end. Hence he worshipped and eulogised the great lord with devo- tion.…

verses.sanskrit: रुद्राध्यायेन पुण्येन नमस्तेत्यादिना द्विजाः ततः कालो महातेजाः कालप्राप्तं द्विजोत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: rudrādhyāyena puṇyena namastetyādinā dvijāḥ tataḥ kālo mahātejāḥ kālaprāptaṃ dvijottamam
verses.translation: Namastc rudra manyave. TS, 4.5,!.!.
verses.hindi: पुरुषस्त्वं जगन्नाथो विष्णुर्विश्वेशवरो भवान्। योऽयं ब्रह्मासि पुरुषो विश्वमूर्तिः पितामहः नन्दीश्वर बोले है सनत्कुमारजी! उन राजा क्षुपको आराधनासे प्रसन्न होकर देवताओं तथा हैत्योंसे पूजित, हाथोंमें शंख-चक्र-गदा-पद्म धारण किये हुए, पीत वस्त्र पहने हुए, सभी आभूषणोंसे सुशोभित एवं
verses.wordMeaning: Namastc rudra manyave. TS, 4.5,!.!.
verses.commentary: Sense: Namastc rudra manyave. TS, 4.5,!.!.

verses.sanskrit: नेतुं संचिन्त्य विप्रेन्द्राः सान्निध्यमकरोन्मुनेः श्वेतो ऽपि दृष्ट्वा तं कालं कालप्राप्तो ऽपि शङ्करम्
verses.transliteration: netuṃ saṃcintya viprendrāḥ sānnidhyamakaronmuneḥ śveto 'pi dṛṣṭvā taṃ kālaṃ kālaprāpto 'pi śaṅkaram
verses.translation: Kalapriptam~-gat&y\isam i«e. dead.
verses.hindi: मुकुट धारण किये हुए लक्ष्मी तथा भूमिसहित गरुड्ध्वर्ज श्रीमान् भगवान् पुरुषोत्तमने उन क्षुपको दिव्य दर्शत दिव्य दर्शनके अनन्तर उन गरुडध्वज भगवान् विष्णु देवको प्रणाम करके राजा क्षुप अत्यन्त प्रिय वाणीमें उनकी स्तुति करने लगे॥ ३ भा
verses.wordMeaning: Kalapriptam~-gat&y\isam i«e. dead.
verses.commentary: Sense: Kalapriptam~-gat&y\isam i«e. dead.

verses.sanskrit: पूजयामास पुण्यात्मा त्रियंबकमनुस्मरन् त्रियंबकं यजेदेवं सुगन्धिं पुष्टिवर्धनम्
verses.transliteration: pūjayāmāsa puṇyātmā triyaṃbakamanusmaran triyaṃbakaṃ yajedevaṃ sugandhiṃ puṣṭivardhanam
verses.translation: Gf, tryambakaih yaj&malic sugandhim puHivardhanam. TS, I.8.6.2.
verses.hindi: आप आदि हें तथा आप आदिरहित भी हैं । आप हो प्रकृति हैं, आप ही जनार्दन हैं, आप ही पुरुष हँ, आप ही जगन्नाथ, आप ही विष्णु तथा आप ही राजा क्षुपद्वारा विष्णुकी आराधना, विष्णुद्वारा शिवभक्तोंकी महिमाका कथन
verses.wordMeaning: Gf, tryambakaih yaj&malic sugandhim puHivardhanam. TS, I.8.6.2.
verses.commentary: Sense: Gf, tryambakaih yaj&malic sugandhim puHivardhanam. TS, I.8.6.2.

verses.sanskrit: किं करिष्यति मे मृत्युर् मृत्योर्मृत्युरहं यतः तं दृष्ट्वा सस्मितं प्राह श्वेतं लोकभयंकरः
verses.transliteration: kiṃ kariṣyati me mṛtyur mṛtyormṛtyurahaṃ yataḥ taṃ dṛṣṭvā sasmitaṃ prāha śvetaṃ lokabhayaṃkaraḥ
verses.translation: "Come, O Sveta. What fruit do you gain by this means? O excellent brahmin, who can save one caught in my clutches even if he be Rudra, or Viu or Brahma the lord of the uni- verse? O brahmin, how does this procedure pertaining to Rudra affect me. 1 am bent upon taking you to my world
verses.hindi: फ झा फ़ फ़ फ फा फ पी फी फा की मी फी की की फी की ज फी फ फ फ फ फ़ फ फ फ़ फ फ़ फ फ फ़ फ़ फ फ़ फ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ फ फ फ़ फ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ फ़ फ फ़ फ़ फ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ फ फ़ फ़ फ फफ फ़ फ़ फफ फ़ फ फ फ़ फफफ फ फ फ फ फ त्वत्क्रोधसम्भवो रुद्रस्तमसा च समावृतः। त्वत्प्रसादाज्जगद्धाता रजसा च पितामहः
verses.wordMeaning: "Come, O Sveta. What fruit do you gain by this means? O excellent brahmin, who can save one caught in my clutches even if he be Rudra, or Viu or Brahma the lord of the uni- verse? O brahmin, how does this procedure pertaining to Rudra affect me.…
verses.commentary: Sense: "Come, O Sveta. What fruit do you gain by this means? O excellent brahmin, who can save one caught in my clutches even if he be Rudra, or Viu or Brahma the lord of the uni- verse? O brahmin, how does this procedure pertaining to Rudra affect me.…

verses.sanskrit: एह्येहि श्वेत चानेन विधिना किं फलं तव रुद्रो वा भगवान् विष्णुर् ब्रह्मा वा जगदीश्वरः
verses.transliteration: ehyehi śveta cānena vidhinā kiṃ phalaṃ tava rudro vā bhagavān viṣṇur brahmā vā jagadīśvaraḥ
verses.translation: O KLala, what can be done by you if our bull-emble- med lord, Rudra, the source of origin of all Devas, is present in this Lihga?
verses.hindi: त्वत्प्रसादात्स्वयं विष्णुः सत्त्वेन पुरुषोत्तमः । कालमूर्ते हरे विष्णो नारायण जगन्मय महादेव जगन्नाथ पितामह जगद्गुरो। प्रसीद देवदेवेश प्रसीद परमेश्वर
verses.wordMeaning: O KLala, what can be done by you if our bull-emble- med lord, Rudra, the source of origin of all Devas, is present in this Lihga?
verses.commentary: Sense: O KLala, what can be done by you if our bull-emble- med lord, Rudra, the source of origin of all Devas, is present in this Lihga?

verses.sanskrit: कः समर्थः परित्रातुं मया ग्रस्तं द्विजोत्तम अनेन मम किं विप्र रौद्रेण विधिना प्रभोः
verses.transliteration: kaḥ samarthaḥ paritrātuṃ mayā grastaṃ dvijottama anena mama kiṃ vipra raudreṇa vidhinā prabhoḥ
verses.translation: O lord of great arms, of what avail is this behest (of yours) to persons like me who are extremely devoted to Rudra?
verses.hindi: वैकुण्ठ शौरे सर्वज्ञ वासुदेव महाभुज सङ्कर्षण महाभाग प्रद्युम्न पुरुषोत्तम। अनिरुद्ध महाविष्णो सदा विष्णो नमोऽस्तु ते
verses.wordMeaning: O lord of great arms, of what avail is this behest (of yours) to persons like me who are extremely devoted to Rudra?
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord of great arms, of what avail is this behest (of yours) to persons like me who are extremely devoted to Rudra?

verses.sanskrit: नेतुं यस्योत्थितश्चाहं यमलोकं क्षणेन वै यस्माद्गतायुस्त्वं तस्मान् मुने नेतुमिहोद्यतः
verses.transliteration: netuṃ yasyotthitaścāhaṃ yamalokaṃ kṣaṇena vai yasmādgatāyustvaṃ tasmān mune netumihodyataḥ
verses.translation: On hearing this Kala of sharp fangs and terrible to look at, became infuriated. The terrible god with the noose in his hands roared like a lion and clapped his hands again and again. He then bound the sage whose time of death had arrived and addressed him thus:
verses.hindi: अधश्च धर्मो देवेश ज्ञानं वैराग्यमेव च। द्यौर्मूर्धा ते विभो नाभिः खं वायुर्नासिकां गतः। नेत्रे सोमश्च सूर्यश्च केशा वै पुष्करादयः
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing this Kala of sharp fangs and terrible to look at, became infuriated. The terrible god with the noose in his hands roared like a lion and clapped his hands again and again. He then bound the sage whose time of death had arrived and addressed him thus:
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing this Kala of sharp fangs and terrible to look at, became infuriated. The terrible god with the noose in his hands roared like a lion and clapped his hands again and again. He then bound the sage whose time of death had arrived and addressed him thus:

verses.sanskrit: तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा भैरवं धर्ममिश्रितम् हा रुद्र रुद्र रुद्रेति ललाप मुनिपुङ्गवः
verses.transliteration: tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā bhairavaṃ dharmamiśritam hā rudra rudra rudreti lalāpa munipuṅgavaḥ
verses.translation: "O brahmin sage, O Sveta, you have been bound by me for being taken to my abode. What has been done now by your Rudra the lord of Devas?
verses.hindi: नक्षत्रतारका द्यौश्च ग्रैवेयकविभूषणम्। कथं स्तोष्यामि देवेशं पूज्यश्च पुरुषोत्तमः विश्वेश्वर हैं। जो ये पुरुषरूप विश्वमूर्ति पितामह हैं वे भी आप ही हैं
verses.wordMeaning: "O brahmin sage, O Sveta, you have been bound by me for being taken to my abode. What has been done now by your Rudra the lord of Devas?
verses.commentary: Sense: "O brahmin sage, O Sveta, you have been bound by me for being taken to my abode. What has been done now by your Rudra the lord of Devas?

verses.sanskrit: तं प्राह च महादेवं कालं सम्प्रेक्ष्य वै दृशा नेत्रेण बाष्पमिश्रेण संभ्रान्तेन समाकुलः
verses.transliteration: taṃ prāha ca mahādevaṃ kālaṃ samprekṣya vai dṛśā netreṇa bāṣpamiśreṇa saṃbhrāntena samākulaḥ
verses.translation: Where is Rudra and where your devotion? Where is your worship and where the fruit thereof? Where am I and whence have I to fear? O Sveta, you have been bound by me.
verses.hindi: हे जनार्दन! जो आदि ज्योति है, वह आप ही हैं। हे लक्ष्मीकान्त! है भूपते! आप ही परमात्मा तथा आप ही परमधाम हैं तमोगुणसे संलिप्त भगवान् रुद्र आपके क्रोधसे आविर्भूत हैं तथा आपके ही अनुग्रहसे रजोगुणसे सम्पन्न जगत्के सृजनकर्ता पितामह ब्रह्माकी उत्पत्ति हुई है। हे कालमूर्ते  है हरे! है विष्णो! है नारायण! है जगन्मय!
verses.wordMeaning: Where is Rudra and where your devotion? Where is your worship and where the fruit thereof? Where am I and whence have I to fear? O Sveta, you have been bound by me.
verses.commentary: Sense: Where is Rudra and where your devotion? Where is your worship and where the fruit thereof? Where am I and whence have I to fear? O Sveta, you have been bound by me.

verses.sanskrit: त्वया किं काल नो नाथश् चास्ति चेद्धि वृषध्वजः लिङ्गे ऽस्मिन् शङ्करो रुद्रः सर्वदेवभवोद्भवः
verses.transliteration: tvayā kiṃ kāla no nāthaś cāsti ceddhi vṛṣadhvajaḥ liṅge 'smin śaṅkaro rudraḥ sarvadevabhavodbhavaḥ
verses.translation: O Sveta, is your Rudra stationed in this Lihga? If so, he is utterly inactive. How can he be worshipped?**
verses.hindi: सत्त्वगुणयुक्त साक्षात् पुरुषोत्तम विष्णु भी आपके ही अनुग्रहसे अधिष्ठित हैं हे विश्वमूर्ते! है महेश्वर! महत्, पंचमहाभूतादि, पाँच तन्मात्राएँ, पाँच कर्मेन्द्रियाँ तथा पाँच ज्ञानेन्द्रियाँ एवं मन-ये सब आपके ही द्वारा अधिष्ठित हैं
verses.wordMeaning: O Sveta, is your Rudra stationed in this Lihga? If so, he is utterly inactive. How can he be worshipped?**
verses.commentary: Sense: O Sveta, is your Rudra stationed in this Lihga? If so, he is utterly inactive. How can he be worshipped?**

verses.sanskrit: अतीव भवभक्तानां मद्विधानां महात्मनाम् विधिना किं महाबाहो गच्छ गच्छ यथागतम्
verses.transliteration: atīva bhavabhaktānāṃ madvidhānāṃ mahātmanām vidhinā kiṃ mahābāho gaccha gaccha yathāgatam
verses.translation: Then Rudra, the destroyer of Kama and sacrifice, the three-eyed lord came hurriedly with a laugh, accom- panied by Uma, Nandin and the leading ganas in order to slay Yama who had come to kill the brahmin.
verses.hindi: हे महादेव! है जगन्नाथ! है पितामह! है जगद्गुरो! हे देवदेवेश! है परमेश्वर! आप प्रसन्न होइये, प्रसन्न होइये हे शरणागतको शरण प्रदान करनेवाले जगन्नाथ! हे वैकुण्ठ! है शौरे! है सर्वज्ञ! है वासुदेव! है महाभुज! आप प्रसन्न होइये
verses.wordMeaning: Then Rudra, the destroyer of Kama and sacrifice, the three-eyed lord came hurriedly with a laugh, accom- panied by Uma, Nandin and the leading ganas in order to slay Yama who had come to kill the brahmin.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then Rudra, the destroyer of Kama and sacrifice, the three-eyed lord came hurriedly with a laugh, accom- panied by Uma, Nandin and the leading ganas in order to slay Yama who had come to kill the brahmin.

verses.sanskrit: ततो निशम्य कुपितस् तीक्ष्णदंष्ट्रो भयङ्करः श्रुत्वा श्वेतस्य तद्वाक्यं पाशहस्तो भयावहः
verses.transliteration: tato niśamya kupitas tīkṣṇadaṃṣṭro bhayaṅkaraḥ śrutvā śvetasya tadvākyaṃ pāśahasto bhayāvahaḥ
verses.translation: O brahmins, then on seeing Rudfa, the mighty Yama*
verses.hindi: हे संकर्षण! है महाभाग! है प्रद्युम्न! है पुरुषोत्तम! हे अनिरुद्ध! है महाविष्णो! है विष्णो! आपको सदा नमस्कार है हे विष्णो! हजार फणोंसे युक्त, तमोमूर्तिस्वरूप, पृथ्वीको धारण करनेवाले, ऐश्वर्यसम्पन्न शेषनाग आपके दिव्य तथा अव्यक्त आसनके रूपमें अधिष्ठित हैं
verses.wordMeaning: O brahmins, then on seeing Rudfa, the mighty Yama*
verses.commentary: Sense: O brahmins, then on seeing Rudfa, the mighty Yama*

verses.sanskrit: सिंहनादं महत्कृत्वा चास्फाट्य च मुहुर्मुहुः बबन्ध च मुनिं कालः कालप्राप्तं तमाह च
verses.transliteration: siṃhanādaṃ mahatkṛtvā cāsphāṭya ca muhurmuhuḥ babandha ca muniṃ kālaḥ kālaprāptaṃ tamāha ca
verses.translation: Over the heads of the sage and Rudra, the sky-roving gods showered cool and splendid flowers from the firmament.
verses.hindi: हे देवेश! है सुव्रत! इस आसनके नीचे पादके रूपमें साक्षात् धर्म, ज्ञान, वैराग्य तथा ऐश्वर्य विराजमान हैं हे विभो! सातो पाताल आपके चरणरूपमें, पृथ्वी जाँघके रूपमें, सातौं समुद्र चस्त्रके रूपमें, दिशाएँ विशाल भुजाओंके रूपमें, अन्तरिक्ष मस्तकके रूपमें, आकाश नाभिके रूपमें, वायु नासिकाके रूपमें, दोनों नेत्र
verses.wordMeaning: Over the heads of the sage and Rudra, the sky-roving gods showered cool and splendid flowers from the firmament.
verses.commentary: Sense: Over the heads of the sage and Rudra, the sky-roving gods showered cool and splendid flowers from the firmament.

verses.sanskrit: मया बद्धो ऽसि विप्रर्षे श्वेतं नेतुं यमालयम् अद्य वै देवदेवेन तव रुद्रेण किं कृतम्
verses.transliteration: mayā baddho 'si viprarṣe śvetaṃ netuṃ yamālayam adya vai devadevena tava rudreṇa kiṃ kṛtam
verses.translation: On seeing Yama dead, Nandin bowed to lord Rudra. He the leader of the gaas and the follower of lord Rudra, spoke to the lord in great astonishment. "This Yama of puerile intelli- gence* is dead. Now, be favourable to the sage.**
verses.hindi: सूर्य-चन्द्रके रूपमे, बाल मेघोंके रूपमें तथा नक्षत्र-तारे और सम्पूर्ण गगनमण्डल आपके गलेके आभूषणके श्रद्धया च कृतं दिव्यं यच्छतं यच्च कीर्तितम्। धया च कृतं दिव्यं यच्छतं यच्च कीर्तितम्।  रूपमे अधिष्ठित हैं। आप पुरुषोत्तम हैं और प 2 पुरुषोत्तम हैं और पप यदिष्टं तत्क्षमस्वेश नारायण नमोऽस्तु ते॥ १ हैं। आप देवेश्वरकी स्तुति मैं किस प्रकार करूं?
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing Yama dead, Nandin bowed to lord Rudra. He the leader of the gaas and the follower of lord Rudra, spoke to the lord in great astonishment. "This Yama of puerile intelli- gence* is dead. Now, be favourable to the sage.**
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing Yama dead, Nandin bowed to lord Rudra. He the leader of the gaas and the follower of lord Rudra, spoke to the lord in great astonishment. "This Yama of puerile intelli- gence* is dead. Now, be favourable to the sage.**

verses.sanskrit: क्व शर्वस्तव भक्तिश् च क्व पूजा पूजया फलम् क्व चाहं क्व च मे भीतिः श्वेत बद्धो ऽसि वै मया
verses.transliteration: kva śarvastava bhaktiś ca kva pūjā pūjayā phalam kva cāhaṃ kva ca me bhītiḥ śveta baddho 'si vai mayā
verses.translation: On seeing Yama destroyed in a trice, the lord blessed the excellent brahmin and disappeared.*
verses.hindi: भावको मैंने श्रद्धापूर्वक स्तुतिरूपमें कह दिया। है ईशा हे नारायण! मेरी अभिलाषाके लिये मुझे क्षमा कीजिये आपको नमस्कार है नन्दीश्वर बोले--जो मनुष्य क्षुपके द्वारा की गयी सर्वपापनाशिनी इस विष्णु-स्तुतिको भक्तिपूर्वक पढ़ता है या सुनता है अथवा ब्राह्मणोंको सुनाता है, वह विष्णु- लोकको प्राप्त होता है
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing Yama destroyed in a trice, the lord blessed the excellent brahmin and disappeared.*
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing Yama destroyed in a trice, the lord blessed the excellent brahmin and disappeared.*

verses.sanskrit: लिङ्गे ऽस्मिन् संस्थितः श्वेत तव रुद्रो महेश्वरः निश्चेष्टो ऽसौ महादेवः कथं पूज्यो महेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: liṅge 'smin saṃsthitaḥ śveta tava rudro maheśvaraḥ niśceṣṭo 'sau mahādevaḥ kathaṃ pūjyo maheśvaraḥ
verses.translation: Hence, O brahmins, One should devoutly worship the lord, the conqueror of the god of Death. He is the bestower of liberation as well as of worldly pleasures. He is the benefactor of all.
verses.hindi: इस प्रकार इन्द्र आदिके द्वारा स्तुत किये जानेवाले अपराजेय परमेश्वर विष्णुकी भक्तिपूर्वक स्तुति करके उनके चरणोंमें मस्तक झुकाकर प्रणाम करके उनकी ओर कातर दृष्टिसे देखते हुए क्षुपने कहा राजा बोले--हे भगवन्! दधीच नामसै लोकप्रसिद्ध एक धर्मज्ञ तथा विनीत आत्मावाले ब्राह्मण हैं, जो पहले मेरे मित्र थे। शिवजीकी आराधनामें सदा तत्पर रहनेके कारण उनकी कृपासे वे सभीसे
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, O brahmins, One should devoutly worship the lord, the conqueror of the god of Death. He is the bestower of liberation as well as of worldly pleasures. He is the benefactor of all.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, O brahmins, One should devoutly worship the lord, the conqueror of the god of Death. He is the bestower of liberation as well as of worldly pleasures. He is the benefactor of all.

verses.sanskrit: ततः सदाशिवः स्वयं द्विजं निहन्तुमागतम् निहन्तुमन्तकं स्मयन् स्मरारियज्ञहा हरः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sadāśivaḥ svayaṃ dvijaṃ nihantumāgatam nihantumantakaṃ smayan smarāriyajñahā haraḥ
verses.translation: Of what avail is much talk? After renouncing and wor- shipping Rudra with great devotion you will all become free from grief.
verses.hindi: अवध्य हैं। है देवेश! है विष्णो! है जगत्पते ! उन्होंने सभामें मेरा तिरस्कार करते हुए अपने बायें पैरसे मेरे सिरपर प्रहार कर दिया और उन मदोन्मत्तने कहा कि मैं किसीसे भी नहीं डरता हूँ॥ २२--२४॥ हे जगदीश्वर! मैं उन विप्र दधीचको जीतना चाहता हूँ। है जनार्दन! मैं उन्हें जिस भी तरहसे जीत सकूँ; आप वैसा उपाय कीजिये
verses.wordMeaning: Of what avail is much talk? After renouncing and wor- shipping Rudra with great devotion you will all become free from grief.
verses.commentary: Sense: Of what avail is much talk? After renouncing and wor- shipping Rudra with great devotion you will all become free from grief.

verses.sanskrit: त्वरन् विनिर्गतः परः शिवः स्वयं त्रिलोचनः त्रियंबको ऽम्बया समं सनन्दिना गणेश्वरैः
verses.transliteration: tvaran vinirgataḥ paraḥ śivaḥ svayaṃ trilocanaḥ triyaṃbako 'mbayā samaṃ sanandinā gaṇeśvaraiḥ
verses.translation: On being addressed thus by Brahma, the sages, the expounders of Brahman said once again: — O lord, be pleased. By what penance or sacrifice or holy rites can devotion to Rudra, the Pinaka-bearing lord, be acquired? How will the twicebom become the devotee of Rudra?
verses.hindi: नन्दीश्वर बोले--इस प्रकार उन विष्णुने भी महात्मा दधीचके अवध्यत्वको जानकर तथा भगवान् शिवके अतुलित प्रभावका स्मरण करके ब्रह्ाकी छींकसे उत्पन्न क्षुपसे कहा-हे राजेन्द्र! महेश्वरकी भक्तिको प्राप्त विप्रोंको किसी प्रकारका भय नहीं रहता। है राजन्! विशेषरूपसे रुद्रके भक्त सर्वदा भयसे मुक्त रहते हैं, चाहे वे परम नीच ही क्यों न हों; फिर इन दधीचमुनिकी तो बात ही क्या? ॥ २६--२८॥
verses.wordMeaning: On being addressed thus by Brahma, the sages, the expounders of Brahman said once again: — O lord, be pleased. By what penance or sacrifice or holy rites can devotion to Rudra, the Pinaka-bearing lord, be acquired? How will the twicebom become the devotee of Rudra?
verses.commentary: Sense: On being addressed thus by Brahma, the sages, the expounders of Brahman said once again: — O lord, be pleased. By what penance or sacrifice or holy rites can devotion to Rudra, the Pinaka-bearing lord, be acquired? How will the twicebom become the devotee of Rudra?

verses.sanskrit: ससर्ज जीवितं क्षणाद् भवं निरीक्ष्य वै भयात् पपात चाशु वै बली मुनेस्तु संनिधौ द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: sasarja jīvitaṃ kṣaṇād bhavaṃ nirīkṣya vai bhayāt papāta cāśu vai balī munestu saṃnidhau dvijāḥ
verses.translation: Neither by charitable gifts, nor by learning, can, O excellent sages devotion to Siva, the great cause (of the universe) be acquired. It cannot be acquired by long or sessional
verses.hindi: हे महाभाग! है भूपते! अत: अब आपके विजयकी आशा नहीं है। देवताओंसहित अपनेको शापित होनेके इदं तु वैष्णवं स्तोत्रं सर्वपापप्रणाशनम्। यः पठेच्छणुयाद्वापि क्षुपेण परिकीर्तितम्
verses.wordMeaning: Neither by charitable gifts, nor by learning, can, O excellent sages devotion to Siva, the great cause (of the universe) be acquired. It cannot be acquired by long or sessional
verses.commentary: Sense: Neither by charitable gifts, nor by learning, can, O excellent sages devotion to Siva, the great cause (of the universe) be acquired. It cannot be acquired by long or sessional

verses.sanskrit: ननाद चोर्ध्वमुच्चधीर् निरीक्ष्य चान्तकान्तकम् निरीक्षणेन वै मृतं भवस्य विप्रपुङ्गवाः
verses.transliteration: nanāda cordhvamuccadhīr nirīkṣya cāntakāntakam nirīkṣaṇena vai mṛtaṃ bhavasya viprapuṅgavāḥ
verses.translation: Formerly, by means of devotion, Dadhica conquer- ed lord Vinu and his associate Devas. He killed Kupa with the tip of his foot. He acquired adamantine bones. By glori- fying the lord, I too conquered death. Even by the great sage Sveta who had fallen into the ja%vs of death, death was con- quered by the grace of the lord, in the manner it was conque- red by me.
verses.hindi: श्रावयेद्वा द्विजान् भक्त्या विष्णुलोकं स गच्छति स्तुत्वा स्तुतं देवमजेयमीशम्।
verses.wordMeaning: Formerly, by means of devotion, Dadhica conquer- ed lord Vinu and his associate Devas. He killed Kupa with the tip of his foot. He acquired adamantine bones. By glori- fying the lord, I too conquered death. Even by the great sage Sveta who had fallen into the ja%vs of death,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Formerly, by means of devotion, Dadhica conquer- ed lord Vinu and his associate Devas. He killed Kupa with the tip of his foot. He acquired adamantine bones. By glori- fying the lord, I too conquered death. Even by the great sage Sveta who had fallen into the ja%vs of death,…

verses.sanskrit: विनेदुरुच्चमीश्वराः सुरेश्वरा महेश्वरम् प्रणेमुरंबिकामुमां मुनीश्वरास्तु हर्षिताः
verses.transliteration: vineduruccamīśvarāḥ sureśvarā maheśvaram praṇemuraṃbikāmumāṃ munīśvarāstu harṣitāḥ
verses.translation: Formerly, by means of devotion, Dadhica conquer- ed lord Vinu and his associate Devas. He killed Kupa with the tip of his foot. He acquired adamantine bones. By glori- fying the lord, I too conquered death. Even by the great sage Sveta who had fallen into the ja%vs of death, death was con- quered by the grace of the lord, in the manner it was conque- red by me.
verses.hindi: धर्मवेत्ता विनीतात्मा सखा मम पुराभवत् अवध्यः सर्वदा सर्वैः शङ्करार्चनतत्परः। सावज्ञं वामपादेन स मां मूर्धनि सदस्यथ
verses.wordMeaning: Formerly, by means of devotion, Dadhica conquer- ed lord Vinu and his associate Devas. He killed Kupa with the tip of his foot. He acquired adamantine bones. By glori- fying the lord, I too conquered death. Even by the great sage Sveta who had fallen into the ja%vs of death,…

By glori- fying the lord, I too conquered death. Even by the great sage Sveta who had fallen into the ja%vs of death,…

verses.sanskrit: ससर्जुर् अस्य मूर्ध्नि वै मुनेर्भवस्य खेचराः सुशोभनं सुशीतलं सुपुष्पवर्षमंबरात्
verses.transliteration: sasarjur asya mūrdhni vai munerbhavasya khecarāḥ suśobhanaṃ suśītalaṃ supuṣpavarṣamaṃbarāt
verses.translation: Formerly, by means of devotion, Dadhica conquer- ed lord Vinu and his associate Devas. He killed Kupa with the tip of his foot. He acquired adamantine bones. By glori- fying the lord, I too conquered death. Even by the great sage Sveta who had fallen into the ja%vs of death, death was con- quered by the grace of the lord, in the manner it was conque- red by me.
verses.hindi: ताडयामास देवेश विष्णो विश्‍वजगत्पते। उवाच च मदाविष्टो न बिभेमीति सर्वतः यथा हि तं तथा कर्तुं त्वमर्हसि जनार्दन
verses.wordMeaning: Formerly, by means of devotion, Dadhica conquer- ed lord Vinu and his associate Devas. He killed Kupa with the tip of his foot. He acquired adamantine bones. By glori- fying the lord, I too conquered death. Even by the great sage Sveta who had fallen into the ja%vs of death,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Formerly, by means of devotion, Dadhica conquer- ed lord Vinu and his associate Devas. He killed Kupa with the tip of his foot. He acquired adamantine bones. By glori- fying the lord, I too conquered death. Even by the great sage Sveta who had fallen into the ja%vs of death,…

verses.sanskrit: अहो निरीक्ष्य चान्तकं मृतं तदा सुविस्मितः शिलाशनात्मजो ऽव्ययं शिवं प्रणम्य शङ्करम्
verses.transliteration: aho nirīkṣya cāntakaṃ mṛtaṃ tadā suvismitaḥ śilāśanātmajo 'vyayaṃ śivaṃ praṇamya śaṅkaram
verses.translation: Formerly, by means of devotion, Dadhica conquer- ed lord Vinu and his associate Devas. He killed Kupa with the tip of his foot. He acquired adamantine bones. By glori- fying the lord, I too conquered death. Even by the great sage Sveta who had fallen into the ja%vs of death, death was con- quered by the grace of the lord, in the manner it was conque- red by me.
verses.hindi: एवं स्मृत्वा हरिः प्राह ब्रह्मणः क्षुतसम्भवम्। विप्राणां नास्ति राजेन्द्र भयमेत्य महेश्वरम् दुःखं करोमि विप्रस्य शापार्थं ससुरस्य मे
verses.wordMeaning: Formerly, by means of devotion, Dadhica conquer- ed lord Vinu and his associate Devas. He killed Kupa with the tip of his foot. He acquired adamantine bones. By glori- fying the lord, I too conquered death. Even by the great sage Sveta who had fallen into the ja%vs of death,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Formerly, by means of devotion, Dadhica conquer- ed lord Vinu and his associate Devas. He killed Kupa with the tip of his foot. He acquired adamantine bones. By glori- fying the lord, I too conquered death. Even by the great sage Sveta who had fallen into the ja%vs of death,…

verses.sanskrit: उवाच बालधीर्मृतः प्रसीद चेति वै मुनेः महेश्वरं महेश्वर-स्य चानुगो गणेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: uvāca bāladhīrmṛtaḥ prasīda ceti vai muneḥ maheśvaraṃ maheśvara-sya cānugo gaṇeśvaraḥ
verses.translation: Formerly, by means of devotion, Dadhica conquer- ed lord Vinu and his associate Devas. He killed Kupa with the tip of his foot. He acquired adamantine bones. By glori- fying the lord, I too conquered death. Even by the great sage Sveta who had fallen into the ja%vs of death, death was con- quered by the grace of the lord, in the manner it was conque- red by me.
verses.hindi: अध्याय ३६ राजा क्षुपद्वारा विष्णुकी आराधना, विष्णुद्वारा शिवभक्तोंकी महिमाका कथन १६९ भविता तस्य शापेन दक्षयज्ञे सुरैः समम्। मैं अब विप्र दधीचको क्रोधित करूँगा
verses.wordMeaning: Formerly, by means of devotion, Dadhica conquer- ed lord Vinu and his associate Devas. He killed Kupa with the tip of his foot. He acquired adamantine bones. By glori- fying the lord, I too conquered death. Even by the great sage Sveta who had fallen into the ja%vs of death,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Formerly, by means of devotion, Dadhica conquer- ed lord Vinu and his associate Devas. He killed Kupa with the tip of his foot. He acquired adamantine bones. By glori- fying the lord, I too conquered death. Even by the great sage Sveta who had fallen into the ja%vs of death,…

verses.sanskrit: ततो विवेश भगवान् अनुगृह्य द्विजोत्तमम् क्षणाद्गूढशरीरं हि ध्वस्तं दृष्ट्वान्तकं क्षणात्
verses.transliteration: tato viveśa bhagavān anugṛhya dvijottamam kṣaṇādgūḍhaśarīraṃ hi dhvastaṃ dṛṣṭvāntakaṃ kṣaṇāt
verses.translation: Formerly, by means of devotion, Dadhica conquer- ed lord Vinu and his associate Devas. He killed Kupa with the tip of his foot. He acquired adamantine bones. By glori- fying the lord, I too conquered death. Even by the great sage Sveta who had fallen into the ja%vs of death, death was con- quered by the grace of the lord, in the manner it was conque- red by me.
verses.hindi: विनाशो मम राजेन्द्र पुनरुत्थानमेव च॥ ३० है राजेन्द्र! उनके शापसे दक्षके यज्ञमें सभी हे भूपते! है राजेन्द्र! समस्त देवताओंसहित मैं विप्रेद्र दधीचमुनिसे आपकी विजयके लिये पूरे मनसे प्रयास करूँगा
verses.wordMeaning: Formerly, by means of devotion, Dadhica conquer- ed lord Vinu and his associate Devas. He killed Kupa with the tip of his foot. He acquired adamantine bones. By glori- fying the lord, I too conquered death. Even by the great sage Sveta who had fallen into the ja%vs of death,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Formerly, by means of devotion, Dadhica conquer- ed lord Vinu and his associate Devas. He killed Kupa with the tip of his foot. He acquired adamantine bones. By glori- fying the lord, I too conquered death. Even by the great sage Sveta who had fallen into the ja%vs of death,…

verses.sanskrit: तस्मान्मृत्युञ्जयं चैव भक्त्या सम्पूजये द्विजाः मुक्तिदं भुक्तिदं चैव सर्वेषामपि शङ्करम्
verses.transliteration: tasmānmṛtyuñjayaṃ caiva bhaktyā sampūjaye dvijāḥ muktidaṃ bhuktidaṃ caiva sarveṣāmapi śaṅkaram
verses.translation: Formerly, by means of devotion, Dadhica conquer- ed lord Vinu and his associate Devas. He killed Kupa with the tip of his foot. He acquired adamantine bones. By glori- fying the lord, I too conquered death. verses.sanskrit: एष देवो महादेवो विज्ञेयस्तु महेश्वरः न तस्मात्परमं किंचित् पदं समधिगम्यते
verses.transliteration: eṣa devo mahādevo vijñeyastu maheśvaraḥ na tasmātparamaṃ kiṃcit padaṃ samadhigamyate
verses.translation: The period of dissolution is equal to a kalpa, or a night of Brahm, equal to a period of four hundred thirty two million years of mortals.
verses.hindi: द्विजेनैकेन योद्धुं हि प्रवृत्तस्य महाबलाः वचन सुनकर उसी क्षण ब्राह्मणरूप छोड़कर विष्णु अपना रूप धारण कर लिया और हँसकर दधीचसे कहा

verses.sanskrit: देवानां च ऋषीनां च पितॄणां चैव स प्रभुः सहस्रयुगपर्यन्ते प्रलये सर्वदेहिनः
verses.transliteration: devānāṃ ca ṛṣīnāṃ ca pitṝṇāṃ caiva sa prabhuḥ sahasrayugaparyante pralaye sarvadehinaḥ
verses.translation: He is the thunder bol inarmed (Indra) and the discu'- bcaring Vinu marked by Srivatsa. He is called Yogin in the Kfta age, Kratu in the Treta, Kalagni in the Dvapara and Dharmaketu in the Kali age. These four are the forms of Rudra which the learned men meditate upon.
verses.hindi: श्रीभगवान् बोले- है सुव्रत! है दधीच! क्योंकि आप सर्वज्ञ हैं तथा शिवार्चनमें रत रहनेवाले हैं, इसलिये आपको सभी स्थानोंपर किसी भी प्रकारका भय व्याज नहीं कर सकता हे विप्रवर! आपको नमस्कार है। मेरा आग्रह है कि आप एक बार सभामें क्षुपसे बोल दीजिये कि 'मैं आपसे डरता हूँ'

verses.commentary: Sense: He is the thunder bol inarmed (Indra) and the discu'- bcaring Vinu marked by Srivatsa. He is called Yogin in the Kfta age, Kratu in the Treta, Kalagni in the Dvapara and Dharmaketu in the Kali age. These four are the forms of Rudra which the learned men meditate upon.

verses.sanskrit: संहरत्येष भगवान् कालो भूत्वा महेश्वरः एष चैव प्रजाः सर्वाः सृजत्येकः स्वतेजसा
verses.transliteration: saṃharatyeṣa bhagavān kālo bhūtvā maheśvaraḥ eṣa caiva prajāḥ sarvāḥ sṛjatyekaḥ svatejasā
verses.translation: The Lihga should be symmetrical within and without; at the place of support of the swollen knob it should be octangu- lar. In other places it should be cylindrical and of attractive appearance. One should worship only such a fine Linga.
verses.hindi: इस प्रकार विष्णुभगवान्का वह विनय तथा प्रीतियुक्त वचन सुनकर महामुनि दधीचने देवोंमें श्रेष्ठ उन विष्णुसे कहा-मैं साक्षात् पिनाकधारी सर्वज्ञ शर्व देवदेव महादेव शिवके अनुग्रहसे किसीसे भी नहीं तत्पश्चात् उन मुनि दधीचका वचन सुनकर भगवान् विष्णु क्रोधित हो उठे और उन्होंने मुनिश्रेष्ठ दधीचको दग्ध करनेको इच्छासे अपना चक्र उठाया
verses.wordMeaning: The Lihga should be symmetrical within and without; at the place of support of the swollen knob it should be octangu- lar. In other places it should be cylindrical and of attractive appearance. One should worship only such a fine Linga.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Lihga should be symmetrical within and without; at the place of support of the swollen knob it should be octangu- lar. In other places it should be cylindrical and of attractive appearance. One should worship only such a fine Linga.

verses.sanskrit: एष चक्री च वज्री च श्रीवत्सकृतलक्षणः योगी कृतयुगे चैव त्रेतायां क्रतुर् उच्यते
verses.transliteration: eṣa cakrī ca vajrī ca śrīvatsakṛtalakṣaṇaḥ yogī kṛtayuge caiva tretāyāṃ kratur ucyate
verses.translation: Tamas is the fire god; Rajas is Brahma and Sattva is Viinu. Although there is a single deity at the base these are glorified as its forms.®
verses.hindi: क्षुपके सामने ही मुनि दधीचके प्रभावसे विष्णुका सुदर्शन चक्र कुण्ठित हो गया कुण्ठित अग्रभागवाले सुदर्शन चक्रको देखकर वे दधीच मुसकराकर सत-असत्के अवभासक चक्रधारी विष्णु -से कहने लगे
verses.wordMeaning: Tamas is the fire god; Rajas is Brahma and Sattva is Viinu. Although there is a single deity at the base these are glorified as its forms.®
verses.commentary: Sense: Tamas is the fire god; Rajas is Brahma and Sattva is Viinu. Although there is a single deity at the base these are glorified as its forms.®

verses.sanskrit: द्वापरे चैव कालाग्निर् धर्मकेतुः कलौ स्मृतः रुद्रस्य मूर्तयस्त्वेता ये ऽभिध्यायन्ति पण्डिताः
verses.transliteration: dvāpare caiva kālāgnir dharmaketuḥ kalau smṛtaḥ rudrasya mūrtayastvetā ye 'bhidhyāyanti paṇḍitāḥ
verses.translation: The leading brahmins who have conquered their anger and sense-organs, make the Linga endowed with all these traits. It is there that the Brahman stays along with all his yogic powers. Hence they worship (in the lihga) lord Iana the lord of the chiefs of Devas, the unchanging deity.
verses.hindi: हे भगवन्! है विष्णो ! पूर्वकालमें आपको भी अत्यन्त प्रयत्नपूर्वक शिवकृपासे ही यह अति भयाबह सुदर्शन नामक शुभ चक्र प्राप्त हुआ है। अत: यह चक्र मुह शिवभक्तको नहीं मार सकता। अब आप ब्रह्मास्त्र आदि अन्य अस्त्रोसे मुझे मारनेका प्रयास कीजिये
verses.wordMeaning: The leading brahmins who have conquered their anger and sense-organs, make the Linga endowed with all these traits. It is there that the Brahman stays along with all his yogic powers. Hence they worship (in the lihga) lord Iana the lord of the chiefs of Devas,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The leading brahmins who have conquered their anger and sense-organs, make the Linga endowed with all these traits. It is there that the Brahman stays along with all his yogic powers. Hence they worship (in the lihga) lord Iana the lord of the chiefs of Devas,…

verses.sanskrit: चतुरस्रं बहिश्चान्तर् अष्टास्रं पिण्डिकाश्रये वृत्तं सुदर्शनं योग्यम् एवं लिङ्गं प्रपूजयेत्
verses.transliteration: caturasraṃ bahiścāntar aṣṭāsraṃ piṇḍikāśraye vṛttaṃ sudarśanaṃ yogyam evaṃ liṅgaṃ prapūjayet
verses.translation: The Lihga should be cylindrical, splendid, of the size of a thumb, appealing to all and level in the umbilical region. It may have eight or sixteen equal angles. Its zone must be well built so that it should yield all desires. The supporting altar is twice its size or equal in size, and approved by all. The cow's hole shall have all the characteristics of the altar and shall be a third of its size. O excellent brahmins, the border all round shall be at least one yava in breadth. The Lihga shall be made of gold, silver or copper. The altar shall extend up to thrice its size all round. It (the altar) shall be circular, triangular, quadrangular or hexagonal in shape. It shall be free from cracks, and with all characteristics clearly defined. After installing it duly in accordance with the rules governing worship, O brahmins, the Kalaa (water-pot) shall be placed in the middle of the altar.
verses.hindi: नन्दीश्वर बोले-हे सनत्कुमार! दधीचका वह वचन सुनकर तथा अपने अस्त्रको निस्तेज देखकर विष्णुजीने समस्त प्रकारके अस्त्र उत्पन्न किये और वै चारों ओरसे उनके ऊपर प्रहार करने लगे महान् बलशाली शाश्वत देवता लोग भौ उस एकमात्र ब्राह्मणसे युद्ध करनेमें प्रवृत्त उन विष्णुकी सहायता करनेमें तत्पर हो गये
verses.wordMeaning: The Lihga should be cylindrical, splendid, of the size of a thumb, appealing to all and level in the umbilical region. It may have eight or sixteen equal angles. Its zone must be well built so that it should yield all desires.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The Lihga should be cylindrical, splendid, of the size of a thumb, appealing to all and level in the umbilical region. It may have eight or sixteen equal angles. Its zone must be well built so that it should yield all desires.…

verses.sanskrit: तमो ह्यग्नी रजो ब्रह्मा सत्त्वं विष्णुः प्रकाशकम् मूर्तिरेका स्थिता चास्य मूर्तयः परिकीर्तिताः
verses.transliteration: tamo hyagnī rajo brahmā sattvaṃ viṣṇuḥ prakāśakam mūrtirekā sthitā cāsya mūrtayaḥ parikīrtitāḥ
verses.translation: A piece of gold and cereals' shall be placed within it. The holy water shall then be inspired with the Mantras of
verses.hindi: अध्याय ३६1 राजा क्षुपद्वारा विष्णुकी आराधना, विष्णुद्वारा शिवभक्तोंकी महिमाका कथन १६३ ससर्ज सर्वदेवेभ्यो वज्रास्थिः सर्वतो बशी ॥ ५३ मुट्ठी कुश लेकर भगवान् शिवका स्मरण करते हुए सभी देवताओंके ऊपर फेंक दिया
verses.wordMeaning: A piece of gold and cereals' shall be placed within it. The holy water shall then be inspired with the Mantras of
verses.commentary: Sense: A piece of gold and cereals' shall be placed within it. The holy water shall then be inspired with the Mantras of

verses.sanskrit: यत्र तिष्ठति तद्ब्रह्म योगेन तु समन्वितम् तस्माद्धि देवदेवेशम् ईशानं प्रभुमव्ययम्
verses.transliteration: yatra tiṣṭhati tadbrahma yogena tu samanvitam tasmāddhi devadeveśam īśānaṃ prabhumavyayam
verses.translation: Of. Devi Bhaga. 1*8.4; BrakmSnday prakriyd, 4.6; Mar, 40.18; SP VSyaviya 10.27; LiAga, 1.1.22.
verses.hindi: वह कुश कालाग्निके तेजके समान दिव्य त्रिशूल बन गया। उस समय दूसरी प्रलयाग्निके तुल्य प्रतीत होनेवाले दधीचने सभी देवताओंको भस्म कर देनेका निश्चय कर लिया हे मुने! इन्द्र तथा विष्णु आदि देवताओंने जो-जो अस्त्र दधीचके ऊपर छोड़े थे, वे सब उस त्रिशूलको प्रणाम करने लगे
verses.wordMeaning: Of. Devi Bhaga. 1*8.4; BrakmSnday prakriyd, 4.6; Mar, 40.18; SP VSyaviya 10.27; LiAga, 1.1.22.
verses.commentary: Sense: Of. Devi Bhaga. 1*8.4; BrakmSnday prakriyd, 4.6; Mar, 40.18; SP VSyaviya 10.27; LiAga, 1.1.22.

verses.sanskrit: आराधयन्ति विप्रेन्द्रा जितक्रोधा जितेन्द्रियाः लिङ्गं कृत्वा यथान्यायं सर्वलक्षणसंयुतम्
verses.transliteration: ārādhayanti viprendrā jitakrodhā jitendriyāḥ liṅgaṃ kṛtvā yathānyāyaṃ sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutam
verses.translation: If you worship with such materials as are available you will attain Siddhi. All of you joined by your sons and kins* men shall worship him with concentration and mental purity.
verses.hindi: हे द्विजश्रेष्ठ! यह देखकर सभी देवता पराक्रमशून्य हो गये तथा व्याकुल होकर पलायन करने लगे। तब पुरुषोत्तम भगवान् विष्णुने अपने शरीरसे अपने ही तुल्य करोड़ों दिव्य गण उत्पन्न किये। मुनिवर दधीचने क्षण- भरमें उन सभीको भस्मसात् कर दिया
verses.wordMeaning: If you worship with such materials as are available you will attain Siddhi. All of you joined by your sons and kins* men shall worship him with concentration and mental purity.
verses.commentary: Sense: If you worship with such materials as are available you will attain Siddhi. All of you joined by your sons and kins* men shall worship him with concentration and mental purity.

verses.sanskrit: अङ्गुष्ठमात्रं सुशुभं सुवृत्तं सर्वसंमतम् समनाभं तथाष्टास्रं षोडशास्रम् अथापि वा
verses.transliteration: aṅguṣṭhamātraṃ suśubhaṃ suvṛttaṃ sarvasaṃmatam samanābhaṃ tathāṣṭāsraṃ ṣoḍaśāsram athāpi vā
verses.translation: On seeing him your ignorance and sins will perish.
verses.hindi: तदनन्तर दधीचको विस्मित करनेके निमित्त भगवान् विष्णुने विश्वरूप धारण किया। विप्रेन्द्र दधीचने उन विष्णुके शरीरमें साक्षात् देवताओंके पृथक्-पृथक् गणोंको देखा। उस समय विश्वमूर्ति विष्णुके शरीरमें करोड़ों रुद्र, करोड़ों रुद्रगण तथा करोड़ों ब्रह्माण्ड विद्यमान
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing him your ignorance and sins will perish.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing him your ignorance and sins will perish.

verses.sanskrit: सुवृत्तं मण्डलं दिव्यं सर्वकामफलप्रदम् वेदिका द्विगुणा तस्य समा वा सर्वसंमता
verses.transliteration: suvṛttaṃ maṇḍalaṃ divyaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam vedikā dviguṇā tasya samā vā sarvasaṃmatā
verses.translation: In the different dry tracts of land, or in the caves of the mountains or in the auspicious but isolated banks of the rivers they performed penances. Some stayed in water, looking splendid with moss clinging to them, some were exposed to the rain in the course of penance and some stood on the tips of their toes. Others lived on grains crushed by teeth. Others on grains crushed with pieces of rocks. Some adopted Vfrasana postures and others were engaged in the activities of deer. Thus these wise devotees spent time in penance and worship. When a year was completed and Spring arrived, in that Krta age, the lord wanted to bless them with his grace. With sym- pathy towards his devotees, the delighted lord came to Daru forest on the splendid mountain Himalaya.®
verses.hindi: तब च्यवन-पुत्र महामुनि दधीच वह सब कुछ देखकर विस्मित हो गये और वे विश्वरूप धारण किये हुए उन जगत्पति, लोकव्याप्त, ऐश्वर्यसम्पन्न विष्णुके ऊपर जलका छींटा मारकर उनसे कहने लगे-- हे महाबाहो! मायाका परित्याग कीजिये। हे माधव! पदार्थोकी भ्रमात्मक सत्तापर विचार करनेसे प्रतीत होता है कि इस मायाके हजारों प्रकारके दुर्विज्ञेय क्रिया-कलाप हुआ करते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: In the different dry tracts of land, or in the caves of the mountains or in the auspicious but isolated banks of the rivers they performed penances. Some stayed in water, looking splendid with moss clinging to them,…
verses.commentary: Sense: In the different dry tracts of land, or in the caves of the mountains or in the auspicious but isolated banks of the rivers they performed penances. Some stayed in water, looking splendid with moss clinging to them,…

verses.sanskrit: गोमुखी च त्रिभागैका वेद्या लक्षणसंयुता पट्टिका च समन्ताद्वै यवमात्रा द्विजोत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: gomukhī ca tribhāgaikā vedyā lakṣaṇasaṃyutā paṭṭikā ca samantādvai yavamātrā dvijottamāḥ
verses.translation: The lord had vulgar traits. He was stark nude. He had smeared his limbs with ashes. His hands were engaged in whirling a firebrand. His eyes were red and tawny. Sometimes he laughed biosteriously, sometimes he sang surprisingly. Sometimes he danced amorously and sometimes he cried repeatedly. He roamed round the hermitages and begged for alms. He assumed forms of his choice by his mayil. When the lord thus came to the forest the sages eulogised him with devotion. By their pleasant countenance and in the con xny
verses.hindi: हे अनिन्द्य! अब आप अपने सहित ब्रह्मा, रुद्र तथा सम्पूर्ण जगत्को मुझमें देखिये। इसके लिये मैं आपको दिव्य दृष्टि प्रदान करता हूँ ऐसा कहकर मुनि दधीचने अपने शरीसमें उन्हे सम्पूर्ण जगत् दिखा दिया और फिर सभी देवताओं तथा विश्वके रचयिता भगवान् विष्णुसे उन्होंने कहा
verses.wordMeaning: The lord had vulgar traits. He was stark nude. He had smeared his limbs with ashes. His hands were engaged in whirling a firebrand. His eyes were red and tawny. Sometimes he laughed biosteriously, sometimes he sang surprisingly.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The lord had vulgar traits. He was stark nude. He had smeared his limbs with ashes. His hands were engaged in whirling a firebrand. His eyes were red and tawny. Sometimes he laughed biosteriously, sometimes he sang surprisingly.…

verses.sanskrit: सौवर्णं राजतं शैलं कृत्वा ताम्रमयं तथा वेदिकायाश् च विस्तारं त्रिगुणं वै समन्ततः
verses.transliteration: sauvarṇaṃ rājataṃ śailaṃ kṛtvā tāmramayaṃ tathā vedikāyāś ca vistāraṃ triguṇaṃ vai samantataḥ
verses.translation: See note xii.
verses.hindi: दिव्यं त्रिशूलमभवत्कालाग्निसदूशप्रभम्। दग्धुं देवान् मतिं चक्रे युगान्ताग्निरिवापरः इन्द्रनारायणाद्यैश्च देवैस्त्यक्तानि यानि तु। आयुधानि समस्तानि प्रणेमुस्त्रिशिखं मुने
verses.wordMeaning: See note xii.
verses.commentary: Sense: See note xii.

verses.sanskrit: वर्तुलं चतुरस्रं वा षडस्रं वा त्रिरस्रकम् समन्तान्निर्व्रणं शुभ्रं लक्षणैस्तत् सुलक्षितम्
verses.transliteration: vartulaṃ caturasraṃ vā ṣaḍasraṃ vā trirasrakam samantānnirvraṇaṃ śubhraṃ lakṣaṇaistat sulakṣitam
verses.translation: O lord of the universe, O supreme lord, you are as you are. Obeisance be to you. The sages of noble soul eulogise you as the lord of Dcvas, the supreme lord.
verses.hindi: देवाश्च दुद्रुवुः सर्वे ध्वस्तवीर्या द्विजोत्तम। ससर्ज भगवान् विष्णुः स्वदेहात्पुरुषोत्तमः तानि सर्वाणि सहसा ददाह मुनिसत्तमः
verses.wordMeaning: O lord of the universe, O supreme lord, you are as you are. Obeisance be to you. The sages of noble soul eulogise you as the lord of Dcvas, the supreme lord.
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord of the universe, O supreme lord, you are as you are. Obeisance be to you. The sages of noble soul eulogise you as the lord of Dcvas, the supreme lord.

verses.sanskrit: प्रतिष्ठाप्य यथान्यायं पूजालक्षणसंयुतम् कलशं स्थापयेत्तस्य वेदिमध्ये तथा द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: pratiṣṭhāpya yathānyāyaṃ pūjālakṣaṇasaṃyutam kalaśaṃ sthāpayettasya vedimadhye tathā dvijāḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to Bhava, to the splendid one, to the coiiceiver of all objects, to the source of their origin, to one of infinite strength and prowess and to the lord of all living beings.
verses.hindi: दधीचो भगवान् विप्रः देवतानां गणान् पृथक् । रूद्राणां कोटयश्चैव गणानां कोटयस्तदा ५९ अण्डानां कोटयश्चैव विश्वमूर्तेस्तनौ तदा। दृष्टरैतदखिलं तत्र च्यावनिर्विस्मितं तदा
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to Bhava, to the splendid one, to the coiiceiver of all objects, to the source of their origin, to one of infinite strength and prowess and to the lord of all living beings.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to Bhava, to the splendid one, to the coiiceiver of all objects, to the source of their origin, to one of infinite strength and prowess and to the lord of all living beings.

verses.sanskrit: सहिरण्यं सबीजं च ब्रह्मभिश् चाभिमन्त्रितम् सेचयेच्च ततो लिङ्गं पवित्रैः पञ्चभिः शुभैः
verses.transliteration: sahiraṇyaṃ sabījaṃ ca brahmabhiś cābhimantritam secayecca tato liṅgaṃ pavitraiḥ pañcabhiḥ śubhaiḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to the destroyer, to the tawny-coloured one, to the changing and the unchanging one, to one who bore the flow of the Gangetic waters and to the support of all. Obeisance to one who manifests in all the three Gunas.
verses.hindi: विष्णुमाह जगन्नाथं जगन्मयमजं विभुम्। अम्भसाभ्युक्ष्य तं विष्णुं विश्वरूपं महामुनिः बरह्माणं च तथा रुद्रं दिव्यां दृष्टिं ददामि ते
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to the destroyer, to the tawny-coloured one, to the changing and the unchanging one, to one who bore the flow of the Gangetic waters and to the support of all. Obeisance to one who manifests in all the three Gunas.

verses.transliteration: labdhadṛṣṭyā tayā dṛṣṭvā devadevaṃ triyaṃbakam punastuṣṭuvurīśānaṃ devadāruvanaukasaḥ
verses.translation: After eulogising the lord with delighted inner soul, the sages endowed with austerities requested*** him — ''Let us see you in your real form.** Then the delighted lord assumed his real form of three eyes. To sec that form the lord granted them divine eyes. Looking at the three-eyed lord of Devas by the vision they had acquired, the dwellers of Daruvana again eulogised the lord.
verses.hindi: कही गयी है। प्रथम परार्धमें हजारों करोड़ कल्प भौ ब्रह्मके दिनके रूपमें व्यतीत हो चुके हैं और द्वितीय परार्धमें उतने ही कल्प शेष हैं अतएव है विप्रेनद्र! अयोनिज तथा मृत्युहीन पुत्रकी आशा प्रयत्नपूर्वक छोड़ दीजिये और अपने तुल्य पुत्र ग्रहण कीजिये
verses.wordMeaning: After eulogising the lord with delighted inner soul, the sages endowed with austerities requested*** him — ''Let us see you in your real form.** Then the delighted lord assumed his real form of three eyes. To sec that form the lord granted them divine eyes.…
