verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीलिङ्गमहापुराणे पूर्वभागे एकत्रिंशो ऽध्यायः नमो दिग्वाससे नित्यं कृतान्ताय त्रिशूलिने विकटाय करालाय करालवदनाय च
verses.transliteration: iti śrīliṅgamahāpurāṇe pūrvabhāge ekatriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ namo digvāsase nityaṃ kṛtāntāya triśūline vikaṭāya karālāya karālavadanāya ca
verses.translation: Obeisance to the lord who is naked,*** who bears the trident, who dissolves the universe,*** who is handsome,*** who is an axe to the tree of the universe,*** to one with terrifying face.**' Obeisance to formless one; to one of handome form; to one of the form of the universe. Obeisance to one who em- braces the elephantine face of his son Ganesa;*** obeisance to Rudra; obeisance to one in the form of yajamana.*** Obeisance to one bowed by all; obeisance to one who bows to his own Atman; obeisance to one with blue tuft;*** obei- sance to one with poison in his neck.
verses.hindi: नन्दीश्वर बोले उनका वह वचन सुनकर शिलाद नामसे लोक-विख्यात मेरे पुण्यात्मा पिताने शचीपति इन्द्रसे पुनः कहा शिलाद बोले-हे भगवन्! है महेन्द्र! मैंने पूर्वकालमें इन ब्रह्माके पूर्वोत्पन्न नारद नामक पुत्रद्वारा ऐसा कहते हुए सुन रखा है कि ये ब्रह्मा अण्ड, कमल और शिवजीके अंगसे उत्पन्न हैं; तो है महाबाहो! मुझे आप
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to the lord who is naked,*** who bears the trident, who dissolves the universe,*** who is handsome,*** who is an axe to the tree of the universe,*** to one with terrifying face.**' Obeisance to formless one; to one of handome form; to one of the form of the universe.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to the lord who is naked,*** who bears the trident, who dissolves the universe,*** who is handsome,*** who is an axe to the tree of the universe,*** to one with terrifying face.**' Obeisance to formless one; to one of handome form; to one of the form of the universe.…

verses.sanskrit: अरूपाय सुरूपाय विश्वरूपाय ते नमः कटङ्कटाय रुद्राय स्वाहाकाराय वै नमः
verses.transliteration: arūpāya surūpāya viśvarūpāya te namaḥ kaṭaṅkaṭāya rudrāya svāhākārāya vai namaḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to one who is blue-necked, to one who applies the ash from the cremation ground all over the body. You are Brahma among all Devas. You are Nilalohita among all Rudras. sv&hkar&ya — one who has a form of yajam&na. You are the soul of all living beings. You are known as Purusa in the Sahkhya system. You are Meru among moun- tains; moon among planets; Vasitba among sages; Indra among Devas; Om among Vedas and the excellent Saman among Saman verses.
verses.hindi: शीघ्र बताइये कि ऐसा कैसे है ? दक्षप्रजापति तो पद्मयोनि ब्रह्माजीके पुत्र हैं। इस प्रकार दक्षकी पुत्री हिरण्यगर्भ ब्रह्माकी पौत्री हुई; तो फिर वे प्रभु ब्रह्मा उन दाक्षायणीके पुत्र कैसे हुए ?॥ १३--१५॥ इन्द्र बोले है विप्र! इस स्थितिमें आपका संदेह करना युक्तिपूर्ण है; किंतु मैं आपको इसका कारण बता रहा हूँ। तत्पुरुष नामक कल्पमें परमेष्ठी शिवकी सृष्टि करनेकी इच्छा हुई और उन परमेश्वरने ध्यान करके
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to one who is blue-necked, to one who applies the ash from the cremation ground all over the body. You are Brahma among all Devas. You are Nilalohita among all Rudras. sv&hkar&ya — one who has a form of yajam&na. You are the soul of all living beings.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to one who is blue-necked, to one who applies the ash from the cremation ground all over the body. You are Brahma among all Devas. You are Nilalohita among all Rudras. sv&hkar&ya — one who has a form of yajam&na. You are the soul of all living beings.…

verses.sanskrit: सर्वप्रणतदेहाय स्वयं च प्रणतात्मने नित्यं नीलशिखण्डाय श्रीकण्ठाय नमोनमः
verses.transliteration: sarvapraṇatadehāya svayaṃ ca praṇatātmane nityaṃ nīlaśikhaṇḍāya śrīkaṇṭhāya namonamaḥ
verses.translation: You are lion among beasts; bull among animals and lord of all men. In whatever form you are, whatever form you may assume, may we be able to see you there in the manner mention- ed by Brahma.** Lust, anger, covetousness, despondency and arrogance — we wish to know all these; be pleased, O supreme lord.
verses.hindi: कलायुक्त ब्रह्माजीको उत्पन्न किया। जनार्दन जगत्पति नारायण विष्णुभगवान् मेघवाहन कल्पमें हजार दि वर्षोतक मेघ बनकर अत्यन्त सम्मान तथा आदरके साथ महादेव शिवके वाहन बने रहे॥ १६--१८॥ महादेव शिवने अपनेमें भगवान् विष्णुकी भक्ति देखकर उन्हें ब्रह्माजीसहित सम्पूर्ण जगत् रचनेकी आज्ञा दी
verses.wordMeaning: You are lion among beasts; bull among animals and lord of all men. In whatever form you are, whatever form you may assume, may we be able to see you there in the manner mention- ed by Brahma.** Lust, anger, covetousness, despondency and arrogance — we wish to know all these;…
verses.commentary: Sense: You are lion among beasts; bull among animals and lord of all men. In whatever form you are, whatever form you may assume, may we be able to see you there in the manner mention- ed by Brahma.** Lust, anger, covetousness, despondency and arrogance — we wish to know all these;…

verses.sanskrit: नीलकण्ठाय देवाय चिताभस्माङ्गधारिणे त्वं ब्रह्मा सर्वदेवानां रुद्राणां नीललोहितः
verses.transliteration: nīlakaṇṭhāya devāya citābhasmāṅgadhāriṇe tvaṃ brahmā sarvadevānāṃ rudrāṇāṃ nīlalohitaḥ
verses.translation: When the time of great Dissolution arrived, O lord, the hand was rubbed against the forehead and fire was generated by you the self-possessed soul. Then the whole world was enveloped by that fire. Hence these (lust, anger etc. ) are distorted fires equal to the fire of dissolution. Lust, fury, greediness, delusion, arrogance and harass- ment and all living beings mobile and immobile are burn- ed by the fire originating from you. O lord of Devas, be our protector even as we are being burned. O highly blessed one, O supreme lord, for the welferc of the world you sprinkle the living beings. O auspicious observer, O lord, command us: we shall carry out your behest, in thousands and crores of living beings, in hundreds and crores of forms, we are unable to reach the extremities. O lord of Devas, obeisance be to you.
verses.hindi: अध्याय ३७ नन्दीके जन्मका वृत्तान्त शिवद्वारा ब्रह्मा एवं विष्णुपर अनुग्रह करना १६७ जनार्दनसुतः प्राह तपसा प्राप्य शङ्करम्। तव वामाङ्गजो विष्णुर्दक्षिणाङ्गभवो ह्यहम्
verses.wordMeaning: When the time of great Dissolution arrived, O lord, the hand was rubbed against the forehead and fire was generated by you the self-possessed soul. Then the whole world was enveloped by that fire. Hence these (lust, anger etc.…
verses.commentary: Sense: When the time of great Dissolution arrived, O lord, the hand was rubbed against the forehead and fire was generated by you the self-possessed soul. Then the whole world was enveloped by that fire. Hence these (lust, anger etc.…

verses.sanskrit: आत्मा च सर्वभूतानां सांख्यैः पुरुष उच्यते पर्वतानां महामेरुर् नक्षत्राणां च चन्द्रमाः
verses.transliteration: ātmā ca sarvabhūtānāṃ sāṃkhyaiḥ puruṣa ucyate parvatānāṃ mahāmerur nakṣatrāṇāṃ ca candramāḥ
verses.translation: The brahmin who reads or listens to the hymn glorified by you all or narrates this to the brahmins shall attain leader- ship among my attendants. O leading sages, I shall mention what is conducive to your welfare and sacred to the devotees. Everything feminine is goddess Prakrti born of my body. O brahmins, everything masculine is Purusa born of my body. O brahmins, undoubt- edly my creation is through both of these. Hence no one shall censure the naked ascetic who is devoted to me, who expounds Brahman but who behaves like children and mad people. Those devotees of Mahadeva who are interested in applying ashes; who burn their sins through ashes; who are engaged in meditation and carry out what has been laid down in the scriptures; who have perfect control over the sense- organs; who have sublimated their sexuality; who worship the great lord with perfect verbal, mental and physical control; reach Rudra's world and do not return therefrom. Hence this secret, sacred ar' divine rite of the deity of manifest Lihga.
verses.hindi: जगन्मयोऽवहद्यस्मान्मेघो भूत्वा दिवानिशम् भवन्तमवह्विष्णुर्देवदेवं जगद्गुरुम्। नारायणादपि विभो भक्तोऽहं तव शङ्कर
verses.wordMeaning: The brahmin who reads or listens to the hymn glorified by you all or narrates this to the brahmins shall attain leader- ship among my attendants. O leading sages, I shall mention what is conducive to your welfare and sacred to the devotees.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The brahmin who reads or listens to the hymn glorified by you all or narrates this to the brahmins shall attain leader- ship among my attendants. O leading sages, I shall mention what is conducive to your welfare and sacred to the devotees.…

verses.sanskrit: ऋषीणां च वसिष्ठस् त्वं देवानां वासवस् तथा ओङ्कारः सर्ववेदानां श्रेष्ठं साम च सामसु
verses.transliteration: ṛṣīṇāṃ ca vasiṣṭhas tvaṃ devānāṃ vāsavas tathā oṅkāraḥ sarvavedānāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ sāma ca sāmasu
verses.translation: The observers of the above holy rite have all t3 pes of forms; they shave off their heads and they observe the rite of ashes. No learned man shall revile at them nor should they be transgressed. No one shall laugh derisively at them nor shall he speak words displeasing to them if he desires for welfare here and hereafter. The stupid man who censures them, censures the lord himself. He who worships them worships Siva. Thus, with a desire for the welfare of the worlds, the great lord sports about as a great yogin in every yuga, with ashes smeared all over his body.®
verses.hindi: तदाथ लब्ध्वा भगवान् भवात्सर्वात्मतां क्षणात् एकार्णवालये शुभ्रे त्वन्धकारे सुदारुणे
verses.wordMeaning: The observers of the above holy rite have all t3 pes of forms; they shave off their heads and they observe the rite of ashes. No learned man shall revile at them nor should they be transgressed.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The observers of the above holy rite have all t3 pes of forms; they shave off their heads and they observe the rite of ashes. No learned man shall revile at them nor should they be transgressed.…

verses.sanskrit: आरण्यानां पशूनां च सिंहस्त्वं परमेश्वरः ग्राम्याणामृषभश्चासि भगवांल्लोकपूजितः
verses.transliteration: āraṇyānāṃ paśūnāṃ ca siṃhastvaṃ parameśvaraḥ grāmyāṇāmṛṣabhaścāsi bhagavāṃllokapūjitaḥ
verses.translation: The half man and half woman form of Siva known as *ardha- Cf. Bhagvadgaiti: d (\ vpff: | Grasping the great knowledge impasted by Siva» which being incomparable is the destroyer of the sages bent their heads and made obeisance to Siva with their minds clear- ed of fear, greed and delusion immediately. On hearing what was recounted thus, the delighted brahmins, began the ablution of lord Siva with pure scented waters with Kua grass and flowers scattered therein. They poured water out of water jars. They sang various songs of esoteric meaning and produced huihkaras with sweet tones.
verses.hindi: दुष्प्राप्पे दुर्जनैः पुण्यैः सनकाद्यैरगोचरे तभीसे उस कल्पको 'मेघवाहन' नामसे कहा है। उन विष्णुको देखकर उन्हींके देहसे उत्पन्न जनार्दनपुत्र हिरण्यगर्भ ब्रह्माने अपनी तपस्यासे शंकरजीको प्राप्तकर उनसे कहा--॥ २०/२॥
verses.wordMeaning: The half man and half woman form of Siva known as *ardha- Cf. Bhagvadgaiti: d (\ vpff: | Grasping the great knowledge impasted by Siva» which being incomparable is the destroyer of the sages bent their heads and made obeisance to Siva with their minds clear- ed of fear,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The half man and half woman form of Siva known as *ardha- Cf. Bhagvadgaiti: d (\ vpff: | Grasping the great knowledge impasted by Siva» which being incomparable is the destroyer of the sages bent their heads and made obeisance to Siva with their minds clear- ed of fear,…

verses.sanskrit: सर्वथा वर्तमानो ऽपि यो यो भावो भविष्यति त्वामेव तत्र पश्यामो ब्रह्मणा कथितं तथा
verses.transliteration: sarvathā vartamāno 'pi yo yo bhāvo bhaviṣyati tvāmeva tatra paśyāmo brahmaṇā kathitaṃ tathā
verses.translation: Obeisance to the overlord of Devas; obeisance to the great lord, obebance to one who shares half of body with hb consort;* obeisance to the initiator of Skhya and Yoga. Obeisance to one who is black as a cluster of clouds. Obeisance to one wearing elephant's hide. Obeisance to one having deerskin for the upper garment; obeisance to one hav- ing serpent for the sacred thread. Obeisance to Siva with wonderful well-arranged car-rings; with well knit garlands and ornaments; to one with the fine lion skin as garb; obeisance to one of extensive reputation.
verses.hindi: बिष्णु आपके वाम अंगसे उत्पन्न हैं तथा मैं आपके दायें अंगसे उत्पन्न हूँ; फिर भी उन विष्णुने मेरे साथ सम्पूर्ण जगतूकी रचना की॥ २१ /२॥ यद्यपि जगन्मय विष्णुने मेघ बनकर आप देवदेव जगद्गुरु महेश्वरका दिन-रात वहन किया है; फिर भी हे विभो! है शंकर! मैं उन नारायणसे भी बढ़कर आपका भक्त हूँ। अतएव है प्रभो! मेरे ऊपर प्रसन्न होइये और
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to the overlord of Devas; obeisance to the great lord, obebance to one who shares half of body with hb consort;* obeisance to the initiator of Skhya and Yoga. Obeisance to one who is black as a cluster of clouds. Obeisance to one wearing elephant's hide.…

verses.sanskrit: कामः क्रोधश् च लोभश् च विषादो मद एव च एतद् इच्छामहे बोद्धुं प्रसीद परमेश्वर
verses.transliteration: kāmaḥ krodhaś ca lobhaś ca viṣādo mada eva ca etad icchāmahe boddhuṃ prasīda parameśvara
verses.translation: Then the delighted lord spoke to the sages — '*0 ye of good rites, I am delighted with your penance. Choose your boons." All those sages bowed to the lord. TTicn Bhrgu Angiras, Vasitha, Vivamitra, Gautama, Atri, SukcfiSa, Pula- stya, Pulaha, Kratu, Maiici, Kayapa, Kanva and Samvarta of great penance, spoke to the lord after paying due homage: ''We wish to know the mystic secret behind the smearing of ashes, nudity, indirectness (in worship) contrariety in the natural order,*®® the propriety of service or otherwise." On hearing their words the great lord looked at the excellent sages and said smilingly. See note 27. VSmMvam'---»avyimS ST. the left-hand ritual
verses.hindi: मुझे अपना सर्वात्मत्व प्रदान कीजिये ॥ २२-२३ /२॥ तत्पश्चात् महादेवजीसे सर्वात्मत्वकी प्राप्ति करके ब्रह्माजीने शीघ्रतापूर्वक क्षीरसागर पहुँचकर वहाँ एकार्णवमें पुरुषोत्तम विष्णुको भीषण अन्धकारमें

verses.sanskrit: महासंहरणे प्राप्ते त्वया देव कृतात्मना करं ललाटे संविध्य वह्निरुत्पादितस्त्वया
verses.transliteration: mahāsaṃharaṇe prāpte tvayā deva kṛtātmanā karaṃ lalāṭe saṃvidhya vahnirutpāditastvayā
verses.translation: I shall recount to you the whole story in a nutshell. I am Agni (Fire god) the creator of Soma and I am Soma that resorts to Agni. Agni carries what is consigned to it by way of Homa. Since it rests in the world, the universe consisting of the mobile and immobile beings is often burned by it. Everything reduced to ashes becomes excellent and sacred. With ashes Soma attains power and rejuvenates living beings.
verses.hindi: भवनमें देखा॥ २४--२६॥ ब्रह्माजीने जगतको अपने हृदयमें धारण करनेवाले, चारों भुजाओंमें शंख-चक्र-गदा-पद़म धारण करनेवाले, सभी आभूषणोंसे युक्त, चन्द्र-मण्डलतुल्य आभावाले, अपने वक्ष:स्थलपर ' श्री' चिह्न धारण करनेवाले, तमोगुणसे
verses.wordMeaning: I shall recount to you the whole story in a nutshell. I am Agni (Fire god) the creator of Soma and I am Soma that resorts to Agni. Agni carries what is consigned to it by way of Homa. Since it rests in the world,…
verses.commentary: Sense: I shall recount to you the whole story in a nutshell. I am Agni (Fire god) the creator of Soma and I am Soma that resorts to Agni. Agni carries what is consigned to it by way of Homa. Since it rests in the world,…

verses.sanskrit: तेनाग्निना तदा लोका अर्चिर्भिः सर्वतो वृताः तस्मादग्निसमा ह्येते बहवो विकृताग्नयः
verses.transliteration: tenāgninā tadā lokā arcirbhiḥ sarvato vṛtāḥ tasmādagnisamā hyete bahavo vikṛtāgnayaḥ
verses.translation: He who performs the rite of oblation into the firc** as also the rite of 'Tryayusa'*®' is liberated from sins due to the virtue of ashes which constitute power. The word Bhasman is derived from *bhas' to shine, The Pitrs drink fire; Devas drink Soma. The entire universe of the mobile and immobile beings is of the nature of Agni and Soma. I am Agni of great splendour. This great Uma is Soma. I am Agni and Soma together. I am Purusa as well as Prakrti.
verses.hindi: युक्त होनेपर कालरूप, रजोगुणसे युक्त होनेपर सभी लोकोंकी सृजन-लीलाके प्रवर्तक, सत्त्वगुणसे युक्त होनेपर सभी प्राणियोंके स्थापक, कमलनयन, प्रसन्नमुख, जनार्दन, परमपुरुष, परमात्मा, ईशान, सर्वात्मा, महात्मा, देवरूप ईश्वर विष्णुको उस अमृतमय क्षीरसागरमें अनन्त शेषनागकी शय्यापर योगनिद्रामें सोये हुए देखा; उस समय उनके रक्त-कमल-सदूश चरणोंको लक्ष्मीजी अपने अरविन्द- तुल्य कोमल हाथोंसे दबा रही थीं ॥ २७-३१ /२॥
verses.wordMeaning: He who performs the rite of oblation into the firc** as also the rite of 'Tryayusa'*®' is liberated from sins due to the virtue of ashes which constitute power. The word Bhasman is derived from *bhas' to shine, The Pitrs drink fire; Devas drink Soma.…
verses.commentary: Sense: He who performs the rite of oblation into the firc** as also the rite of 'Tryayusa'*®' is liberated from sins due to the virtue of ashes which constitute power. The word Bhasman is derived from *bhas' to shine, The Pitrs drink fire; Devas drink Soma.…

verses.sanskrit: कामः क्रोधश् च लोभश् च मोहो दम्भ उपद्रवः यानि चान्यानि भूतानि स्थावराणि चराणि च
verses.transliteration: kāmaḥ krodhaś ca lobhaś ca moho dambha upadravaḥ yāni cānyāni bhūtāni sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca
verses.translation: Hence, O blessed ones! the ashes constitute my virility. I hold my virility by my physical body. This is the fact, Ever since then, protection is afforded by the ashes. At times of inauspicious events and even in lying-in chambers it is resorted to for securing protection. One whose soul is purified by applying ashes over the body, one who has conquered anger and the sense-organs, never returns after coming near me.
verses.hindi: भगवान् जनार्दनको देखकर ब्रह्माजीने उनसे कहा कि जिस प्रकार पहले आपने मुझे ग्रस लिया था, उसी प्रकार शिवजीकी कृपासे अब मैं आपको ग्रसूँगा॥ ३२ /२॥ भगवान् विष्णुने उठकर विस्मयपूर्ण भावसे ऊपर दृष्टि करके ब्रह्माजीको देखा और उन महाबाहुने थोड़ा
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, O blessed ones! the ashes constitute my virility. I hold my virility by my physical body. This is the fact, Ever since then, protection is afforded by the ashes. At times of inauspicious events and even in lying-in chambers it is resorted to for securing protection.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, O blessed ones! the ashes constitute my virility. I hold my virility by my physical body. This is the fact, Ever since then, protection is afforded by the ashes. At times of inauspicious events and even in lying-in chambers it is resorted to for securing protection.…

verses.sanskrit: दह्यन्ते प्राणिनस्ते तु त्वत्समुत्थेन वह्निना अस्माकं दह्यमानानां त्राता भव सुरेश्वर
verses.transliteration: dahyante prāṇinaste tu tvatsamutthena vahninā asmākaṃ dahyamānānāṃ trātā bhava sureśvara
verses.translation: Persons occupying different stages of life have been created by Brahma afterwards. This creation involving bash- fulness, delusion and fear has been evolved by me. Devas and sages are verily born nude. The other human beings are also born nude. A man may be clad in silken garments. But if his sense-organs are not in control he is naked. But if his sense- organs are subdued he himself is well covered ( even if he does not put on clothes). The cloth is not regarded as the specific cause in these cases.*** Forgiveness, fortitude, non-violence, detachment, equal reaction in regard to honour and dishonour — all these consti- tute excellent covering for the body.
verses.hindi: श्रीवत्सलक्षणं देवं प्रसन्नास्यं जनार्दनम्। रमामृदुकराम्भोजस्पर्शरक्तपदाम्बुजम्
verses.wordMeaning: Persons occupying different stages of life have been created by Brahma afterwards. This creation involving bash- fulness, delusion and fear has been evolved by me. Devas and sages are verily born nude. The other human beings are also born nude.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Persons occupying different stages of life have been created by Brahma afterwards. This creation involving bash- fulness, delusion and fear has been evolved by me. Devas and sages are verily born nude. The other human beings are also born nude.…

verses.sanskrit: त्वं च लोकहितार्थाय भूतानि परिषिञ्चसि महेश्वर महाभाग प्रभो शुभनिरीक्षक
verses.transliteration: tvaṃ ca lokahitārthāya bhūtāni pariṣiñcasi maheśvara mahābhāga prabho śubhanirīkṣaka
verses.translation: One who has taken holy bath of ashes, one who after smearing ashes over the body, mentally meditates on Siva, even if he has committed thousands of faults gets all his sins washed by the ash-bath in the manner as the fire burns the forest. He who strenuously takes holy bath of ashes thrice a day would attain the status of the lord of Ganas. Those who perform sacrifices,**® observe holy rites and meditate on the great lord with devout feelings about the divine sports of the lord, attain immortality by passing through the noble northern path. Those who resort to the cremation ground, by means of the southern path, attain the eight perfections: Aima: Garima, Laghima, Prapti, Kfimavasayita, Prakamya, liSitva Vaiitva and also immortality (in the end).** Mark the contribution of ethics to the Saivite cult*
verses.hindi: परमात्मानमीशानं तमसा कालरूपिणम्। रजसा सर्वलोकानां सर्गलीलाप्रवर्तकम्
verses.wordMeaning: One who has taken holy bath of ashes, one who after smearing ashes over the body, mentally meditates on Siva, even if he has committed thousands of faults gets all his sins washed by the ash-bath in the manner as the fire burns the forest.…
verses.commentary: Sense: One who has taken holy bath of ashes, one who after smearing ashes over the body, mentally meditates on Siva, even if he has committed thousands of faults gets all his sins washed by the ash-bath in the manner as the fire burns the forest.…

verses.sanskrit: आज्ञापय वयं नाथ कर्तारो वचनं तव भूतकोटिसहस्रेषु रूपकोटिशतेषु च
verses.transliteration: ājñāpaya vayaṃ nātha kartāro vacanaṃ tava bhūtakoṭisahasreṣu rūpakoṭiśateṣu ca
verses.translation: The eight siddhis (attainments of supernatural power) comprise (i)apim& (the power of becoming as small as an atom), (ii) laghimfi (the faculty of assuming excessive lightness at will), (iii) prapti (the power of obtaining everything), (iv) priUdlmya (irresistible will) (v) mahimfi (the power of increasing one's size as will), \yi) liitva (supremacy), (vii) vaitva (the power of subduing all to one's own will) and (viii) kfimftvas&yitft (th Indra and other Devas who had adopted the holy rite conducive to the realisation of all desires attained the greatest power and prosperity; ail of them are well known for their splendour and refulgence. One shall be devoid of delusion, arrogance, passion and the defects of tamas and rajas in his character. Under- standing that things of the world arc subject to decay and dest- ruction one shall always be devoted to the yoga of Paupati.*** He should meditate on the vrata of Paupati (Siva) that is destructive of all sins.
verses.hindi: तं दृष्ट्वा प्राह वै ब्रह्मा भगवन्तं जनार्दनम् स्मयमानस्तु भगवान् प्रतिबुध्य पितामहम्
verses.wordMeaning: The eight siddhis (attainments of supernatural power) comprise (i)apim& (the power of becoming as small as an atom), (ii) laghimfi (the faculty of assuming excessive lightness at will), (iii) prapti (the power of obtaining everything),…
verses.commentary: Sense: The eight siddhis (attainments of supernatural power) comprise (i)apim& (the power of becoming as small as an atom), (ii) laghimfi (the faculty of assuming excessive lightness at will), (iii) prapti (the power of obtaining everything),…

verses.sanskrit: अन्तं गन्तुं न शक्ताः स्म देवदेव नमो ऽस्तु ते
verses.transliteration: antaṃ gantuṃ na śaktāḥ sma devadeva namo 'stu te
verses.translation: Hence even the deformed and dirty persons are worthy of worship and should not be censured. Leading brahmins whether handsome or dirty should also be worshipped. They may be leading yogins. Of what avail is much talk? Excellent brahmin devo- tees of Siva should be worshipped by all means like Siva himself. Even dirty leading brahmins may be devotees of Siva and steady in their rites. By devotion to Siva much can be achieved in the world in the manner of Dadhica who could conquer even Visnu the lord of Devas. Hence by all means, those devotees with matted hair or tonsured head, or naked anchori-

verses.wordMeaning: Hence even the deformed and dirty persons are worthy of worship and should not be censured. Leading brahmins whether handsome or dirty should also be worshipped. They may be leading yogins.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence even the deformed and dirty persons are worthy of worship and should not be censured. Leading brahmins whether handsome or dirty should also be worshipped. They may be leading yogins.…

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीलिङ्गमहापुराणे पूर्वभागे द्वात्रिंशो ऽध्यायः ततस्तुतोष भगवान् अनुगृह्य महेश्वरः स्तुतिं श्रुत्वा स्तुतस्तेषाम् इदं वचनमब्रवीत्

verses.translation: Thereafter the lord was delighted and he blessed them. On listening to their eulogy he spoke thus: The brahmin who reads or listens to the hymn gloriticd by you all or narrates this to the brahmins shall attain leader- ship among my attendants,
verses.hindi: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे रुद्रः सर्वदेवभवोद्भवः । विकृतं रूपमास्थाय पुरा दत्तवरस्तयोः आगच्छद्यत्र वै विष्णुर्विश्वात्मा परमेश्वर: । प्रसादमतुलं कर्तु ब्रह्मणश्च हरेः प्रभुः

verses.sanskrit: पुंल्लिङ्गं पुरुषो विप्रा मम देहसमुद्भवः उभाभ्यामेव वै सृष्टिर् मम विप्रा न संशयः
verses.transliteration: puṃlliṅgaṃ puruṣo viprā mama dehasamudbhavaḥ ubhābhyāmeva vai sṛṣṭir mama viprā na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: O brahmins, the masculine principle is Purusha, born from my body. From these two alone proceeds my creation, O brahmins; of this there is no doubt.
verses.hindi: तत्पश्चात् ब्रह्माजीने अपने भ्रूमध्यसे उन विष्णुजीको पुनः उत्पन्न कर दिया और इस प्रकार उनके द्वारा सुजित भगवान् विष्णु उन्हें देखकर उनके पास खड़े हो गये इसी बीच पूर्वकालमें उन दोनों  ब्रह्मा, विष्णु. को वर देनेवाले सभी देवताओं तथा जगतूकी उत्पत्ति करनेवाले विश्वात्मा प्रभु परमेश्वर शिव विकृत रूप धारण करके ब्रह्मा एवं विष्णुपर महान् अनुग्रह करनेकै
verses.wordMeaning: O brahmins, the masculine principle is Purusha, born from my body. From these two alone proceeds my creation, O brahmins; of this there is no doubt.
verses.commentary: Sense: O brahmins, the masculine principle is Purusha, born from my body. From these two alone proceeds my creation, O brahmins; of this there is no doubt.

verses.sanskrit: न निन्देद्यतिनं तस्माद् दिग्वाससमनुत्तमम् बालोन्मत्तविचेष्टं तु मत्परं ब्रह्मवादिनम्
verses.transliteration: na nindedyatinaṃ tasmād digvāsasamanuttamam bālonmattaviceṣṭaṃ tu matparaṃ brahmavādinam
verses.translation: On hearing what was recounted thus, die delighted brahmins, began the ablution of lord Siva with pure scented waters with Kuia grass and flowers scattered therein. They poured water out of water jars. They sang various songs of esoteric meaning and produced huihkflras with sweet tones. Obeisance to the overlord of Devas; obeisance to the great lord, obeisance to one who shares half of body with his consort;•** obeisance to the initiator of Saiikhya and Yoga.
verses.hindi: लिये जहाँ विष्णुजी थे, वहींपर आ गये इसके बाद उन दोनों देवोंने शिवजीके पास पहुँचकर कालाग्नितुल्य उन सभी देवताओं तथा जगतूकी उत्पत्ति करनेवाले महादेवका दर्शन किया
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing what was recounted thus, die delighted brahmins, began the ablution of lord Siva with pure scented waters with Kuia grass and flowers scattered therein. They poured water out of water jars.…
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing what was recounted thus, die delighted brahmins, began the ablution of lord Siva with pure scented waters with Kuia grass and flowers scattered therein. They poured water out of water jars.…

verses.sanskrit: ये हि मां भस्मनिरता भस्मना दग्धकिल्बिषाः यथोक्तकारिणो दान्ता विप्रा ध्यानपरायणाः
verses.transliteration: ye hi māṃ bhasmaniratā bhasmanā dagdhakilbiṣāḥ yathoktakāriṇo dāntā viprā dhyānaparāyaṇāḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to one who is black as a cluster of clouds. Obeisance to one wearing elephant's hide. Obeisance to one having deerskin for the upper garment; obeisance to one hav- ing serpent for the sacred thread. Obeisance to Siva with wonderful weH-arranged ear-rings; with well knit garlands and ornaments; to one with the fine lion skin as garb; obeisance to one of extensive reputation.
verses.hindi: उन दोनों (ब्रह्मा, विष्णु)-ने दूरसे ही सम्मानपूर्वक उन शर्व (भक्तोंके पापोंका नाश करनेवाले), कपदी (जटाजूटधारी), उग्र तथा वर देनेवाले शिवजीको प्रणाम किया और पुन: वे उनकी स्तुति करने लगे जगतूके स्वामी भगवान् शिव पितामह ब्रह्मदेव तथा जनार्दन विष्णुपर अनुग्रह करके वहींपर अन्तर्धान
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to one who is black as a cluster of clouds. Obeisance to one wearing elephant's hide. Obeisance to one having deerskin for the upper garment; obeisance to one hav- ing serpent for the sacred thread. Obeisance to Siva with wonderful weH-arranged ear-rings;…
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to one who is black as a cluster of clouds. Obeisance to one wearing elephant's hide. Obeisance to one having deerskin for the upper garment; obeisance to one hav- ing serpent for the sacred thread. Obeisance to Siva with wonderful weH-arranged ear-rings;…

verses.sanskrit: महादेवपरा नित्यं चरन्तो ह्यूर्ध्वरेतसः अर्चयन्ति महादेवं वाङ्मनःकायसंयताः
verses.transliteration: mahādevaparā nityaṃ caranto hyūrdhvaretasaḥ arcayanti mahādevaṃ vāṅmanaḥkāyasaṃyatāḥ
verses.translation: Then the delighted lord spoke to the sages — "O ye of good rites, I am delighted with your penance. Choose your boons." All those sages bowed to the lord. Then Bhrgu, Ahgiras, Vasistha, Vidvamitra, Gautama, Atri, Sukefa, Pula- stya, Pulaha, Kratu, Marici, Kayapa, Kanva and Saihvarta of great penance, spoke to the lord after paying due homage: "We wish to know the mystic secret behind the smearin g of ashes, nudity, indirectness (in worship) contrariety in the natural order,*®® the propriety of service or otherwise." On hearing their words the great lord looked at the excellent sages and said smilingly.
verses.hindi: विष्णुद्वारा महेश्वरके माहात्म्यका कथन तथा नारायणद्वारा सृष्टिका वर्णन गते महेश्वरे देवे तमुद्दिश्य जनार्दनः। प्रणम्य भगवान् प्राह पद्मयोनिमजोद्भवः
verses.wordMeaning: Then the delighted lord spoke to the sages — "O ye of good rites, I am delighted with your penance. Choose your boons." All those sages bowed to the lord. Then Bhrgu, Ahgiras, Vasistha, Vidvamitra, Gautama, Atri, Sukefa, Pula- stya, Pulaha, Kratu, Marici, Kayapa,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the delighted lord spoke to the sages — "O ye of good rites, I am delighted with your penance. Choose your boons." All those sages bowed to the lord. Then Bhrgu, Ahgiras, Vasistha, Vidvamitra, Gautama, Atri, Sukefa, Pula- stya, Pulaha, Kratu, Marici, Kayapa,…

verses.sanskrit: रुद्रलोकमनुप्राप्य न निवर्तन्ति ते पुनः तस्मादेतद्व्रतं दिव्यम् अव्यक्तं व्यक्तलिङ्गिनः
verses.transliteration: rudralokamanuprāpya na nivartanti te punaḥ tasmādetadvrataṃ divyam avyaktaṃ vyaktaliṅginaḥ
verses.translation: See note 27. I shall recouit to you the whole story in a nutshell. I am Agni (Fire god) the creator of Soma and I am Soma that resorts to Agni.
verses.hindi: श्रीविष्णुरुवाच परमेशो जगन्नाथः शङ्करस्त्वेष सर्वगः। अहं वामाङ्गजो ब्रह्मन् शङ्करस्य महात्मनः । भवान् भवस्य देवस्य दक्षिणाङ्गभवः स्वयम्
verses.wordMeaning: See note 27. I shall recouit to you the whole story in a nutshell. I am Agni (Fire god) the creator of Soma and I am Soma that resorts to Agni.

verses.sanskrit: भस्मव्रताश् च मुण्डाश् च व्रतिनो विश्वरूपिणः न तान्परिवदेद्विद्वान् न चैतान्नाभिलङ्घयेत्
verses.transliteration: bhasmavratāś ca muṇḍāś ca vratino viśvarūpiṇaḥ na tānparivadedvidvān na caitānnābhilaṅghayet
verses.translation: Agni carries what is consigned to it by way of Homa. Since it rests in the world, the universe consisting of the mobile and immobile beings is often burned by it. Everything reduced to ashes becomes excellent and sacred. With ashes Soma attains power and rejuvenates living beings.
verses.hindi: नन्दीश्वर बोले--तदनन्तर महेश्वर महादेवके चले जानेपर ब्रह्माजीसे उत्पन्न भगवान् विष्णु पद्मयोनि पितामहको उद्देश्य करके प्रणामकर उनसे कहने लगे श्रीविष्णु बोले सर्वत्र गमनका सामर्थ्य रखनेवाले ये परमेश्वर ईश्वर जगन्नाथ महेश्वर शिव सम्पूर्ण जगतूके तथा हमदोनोंके शरण हैं
verses.wordMeaning: Agni carries what is consigned to it by way of Homa. Since it rests in the world, the universe consisting of the mobile and immobile beings is often burned by it. Everything reduced to ashes becomes excellent and sacred.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Agni carries what is consigned to it by way of Homa. Since it rests in the world, the universe consisting of the mobile and immobile beings is often burned by it. Everything reduced to ashes becomes excellent and sacred.…

verses.sanskrit: न हसेन्नाप्रियं ब्रूयाद् अमुत्रेह हितार्थवान् यस्तान्निन्दति मूढात्मा महादेवं स निन्दति
verses.transliteration: na hasennāpriyaṃ brūyād amutreha hitārthavān yastānnindati mūḍhātmā mahādevaṃ sa nindati
verses.translation: He who performs the rite of oblation into the fire'**®* as also the rite of 'Tryayusa'®®' is liberated from sins due to the virtue of ashes which constitute power. The word Bhasman is derived from 'bhas' to shine, bhasate-shines or from causal of 'bhu' to cause to reach, mpitor from *bhaks' to eat, «Trf?r; since it devours all sins it is called Bhasman.

verses.wordMeaning: He who performs the rite of oblation into the fire'**®* as also the rite of 'Tryayusa'®®' is liberated from sins due to the virtue of ashes which constitute power. The word Bhasman is derived from 'bhas' to shine, bhasate-shines or from causal of 'bhu' to cause to reach,…

verses.sanskrit: युगे युगे महायोगी क्रीडते भस्मगुण्ठितः एवं चरत भद्रं वस् ततः सिद्धिमवाप्स्यथ
verses.transliteration: yuge yuge mahāyogī krīḍate bhasmaguṇṭhitaḥ evaṃ carata bhadraṃ vas tataḥ siddhimavāpsyatha
verses.translation: Hence, O blessed ones! the ashes constitute my virility. I hold my virility by my physical body. This is the fact. Ever since then, protection is afforded by the ashes. At times of inauspicious events and even in lying-in chambers it is resorted to for securing protection.
verses.hindi: एवमाहुर्महादेवमावयोरपि कारणम्। ईशं सर्वस्य जगतः प्रभुमव्ययमीश्वरम् इस प्रकार अविनाशी ईश्वर महादेवको हम  भी कारण तथा सम्पूर्ण जगतूका स्वामी कहा गया है

verses.sanskrit: अतुलमिह महाभयप्रणाशहेतुं शिवकथितं परमं पदं विदित्वा व्यपगतभवलोभमोहचित्ताः प्रणिपतिताः सहसा शिरोभिर् उग्रम्
verses.transliteration: atulamiha mahābhayapraṇāśahetuṃ śivakathitaṃ paramaṃ padaṃ viditvā vyapagatabhavalobhamohacittāḥ praṇipatitāḥ sahasā śirobhir ugram
verses.translation: One whose soul is purified by apph <ng ashes over the body, one who has conquered anger and the sense-organs, never returns after coming near me. Persons occupying different stages of life have been created by Brahma afterwards. This creation involving bash- fulness, delusion and fear has been evolved by me.
verses.hindi: उन देवेश विष्णुका वचन सुनकर उन पद्ययोनि ब्रह्माने भी वर प्रदान करनेवाले पूज्य महादेवको बार- बार प्रणाम किया तथा उनकी स्तुति की इसके अनन्तर वाराहरूप धारणकर जनार्दन विष्णुने जलसे व्याप्त भूमिको लाकर पुन: पूर्वकी भाँति स्थापित किया
verses.wordMeaning: One whose soul is purified by apph <ng ashes over the body, one who has conquered anger and the sense-organs, never returns after coming near me. Persons occupying different stages of life have been created by Brahma afterwards. This creation involving bash- fulness,…

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रमुदिता विप्राः श्रुत्वैवं कथितं तदा गन्धोदकैः सुशुद्धैश् च कुशपुष्पविमिश्रितैः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ pramuditā viprāḥ śrutvaivaṃ kathitaṃ tadā gandhodakaiḥ suśuddhaiś ca kuśapuṣpavimiśritaiḥ
verses.translation: Devas and sages are verily born nude. The other human beings are also born nude. A man may be clad in silken garments. But if his sense-organs are not in control he is naked. But if his sense- organs arc subdued he himself is well covered ( even if he does not put on clothes). The cloth is not regarded as the specific cause in these cases.***
verses.hindi: तत्पश्चात् भगवान् विष्णुने नदियों, नदों तथा समुद्रोंको पहलेकी भाँति कर दिया। पुनः पृथ्वीको ऊँचाई एवं निचाईसे रहितकर भूधरकी आकृतिवाले उन भगवानूने उस समतल धरापर समस्त पर्वत स्थापित किये, भूलोक आदि चार लोक पूर्वकी भाँति रचे
verses.wordMeaning: Devas and sages are verily born nude. The other human beings are also born nude. A man may be clad in silken garments. But if his sense-organs are not in control he is naked. But if his sense- organs arc subdued he himself is well covered ( even if he does not put on clothes).…

But if his sense-organs are not in control he is naked. But if his sense- organs arc subdued he himself is well covered ( even if he does not put on clothes).…

verses.sanskrit: स्नापयन्ति महाकुम्भैर् अद्भिर् एव महेश्वरम् गायन्ति विविधैर्गुह्यैर् हुंकारैश्चापि सुस्वरैः
verses.transliteration: snāpayanti mahākumbhair adbhir eva maheśvaram gāyanti vividhairguhyair huṃkāraiścāpi susvaraiḥ
verses.translation: Forgiveness, fortitude, non-violence, detachment, equal reaction in regard to honour and dishonour — all these consti- tute excellent covering for the body. One who has laken holy bath of ashes, one who after smearing ashes over the body, mentally meditates on Siva, even if he has committed thousands of faults gets ail his sins washed by the ash-bath in the manner as the fire burns the forest. He who strenuously takes holy bath of ashes thrice a day would attain the status of the lord of Ganas.
verses.hindi: पुनः बुद्धिमानोंमें श्रेष्ठ, प्रखर प्रतिभावाले तथा ऐश्वर्यसम्पन्न भगवान् विष्णुने मुख्य सर्ग, तिर्यक् सर्ग (पशुसर्ग), देवसर्ग, मनुष्यसर्ग, अनुग्रहसर्ग एवं कौमारसर्ग रचनेका विचार किया॥ १० /२॥ उन विष्णुने आरम्भमें सनन्द, सनक तथा महात्माओंमें श्रेष्ठ सनातनका सृजन किया, जो निष्काम ज्ञानयोगमें प्रवृत्त होकर ब्रह्मस्वरूपको प्राप्त हुए॥ १९ /२॥ इसके बाद सबके स्वामी भगवान् विष्णुने मरीचि,
verses.wordMeaning: Forgiveness, fortitude, non-violence, detachment, equal reaction in regard to honour and dishonour — all these consti- tute excellent covering for the body. One who has laken holy bath of ashes, one who after smearing ashes over the body, mentally meditates on Siva,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Forgiveness, fortitude, non-violence, detachment, equal reaction in regard to honour and dishonour — all these consti- tute excellent covering for the body. One who has laken holy bath of ashes, one who after smearing ashes over the body, mentally meditates on Siva,…

verses.sanskrit: नमो देवाधिदेवाय महादेवाय वै नमः अर्धनारीशरीराय सांख्ययोगप्रवर्तिने
verses.transliteration: namo devādhidevāya mahādevāya vai namaḥ ardhanārīśarīrāya sāṃkhyayogapravartine
verses.translation: Those who perform sacrifices,**® observe holy rites and meditate on the great lord with devout feelings about the divine sports of the lord, attain immortality by passing through the noble northern path. Those who resort to the cremation ground, by means of the southern path, attain the eight perfections: Anima: Garima, Laghima, Prapti, Kamavasayita, Prakamya, Hitva Varitva and also immortality (in the end).** Mark the contribution of ethics to the *aivite cult«
verses.hindi: संकल्प, धर्म तथा अधर्मको योगविद्यासे रचा । अव्यक्तजन्मा ब्रह्माकी ये ही बारह संतानें हैं॥ १२-१३/२॥ शाश्वत विष्णुने आरम्भमें ऋभु तथा सनत्कुमारका सृजन किया। पूर्वमें उत्पन्न वे दोनों कुमार ऊध्वरेता, दिव्य, ब्रह्मवादी, सर्वज्ञ, सभी प्रकारके भावोंसे सम्पन्न तथा ब्रह्माजीके ही सदूश थे
verses.wordMeaning: Those who perform sacrifices,**® observe holy rites and meditate on the great lord with devout feelings about the divine sports of the lord, attain immortality by passing through the noble northern path. Those who resort to the cremation ground, by means of the southern path,…

Those who resort to the cremation ground, by means of the southern path,…

verses.sanskrit: मेघवाहनकृष्णाय गजचर्मनिवासिने कृष्णाजिनोत्तरीयाय व्यालयज्ञोपवीतिने

verses.sanskrit: सुरचितसुविचित्रकुण्डलाय सुरचितमाल्यविभूषणाय तुभ्यम् मृगपतिवरचर्मवाससे च प्रथितयशसे नमो ऽस्तु शङ्कराय
verses.transliteration: suracitasuvicitrakuṇḍalāya suracitamālyavibhūṣaṇāya tubhyam mṛgapativaracarmavāsase ca prathitayaśase namo 'stu śaṅkarāya
verses.translation: O sage of holy rites, how did Dadhica strike king Ksupa with his foot after conquering Vi;9u, the lord of Devas in battle? How did that sage of great penance attain adaman- tine bones firom lord Siva? O Nandin, please recount how Death was conquered by you. There was a king of great splendour known as K$upa. He ytras the son of Brahma. He, the lord of the people, was the friend of Dadhica, a leading sage.
verses.hindi: नदीनदसमुद्रांश्च पूर्ववच्चाकरोत्प्रभुः । कृत्वा चोर्वी प्रयत्नेन निम्नोन्नतविवर्जिताम् भूराद्यांश्चतुरो लोकान् कल्पयामास पूर्ववत्

verses.sanskrit: ततस् तान् स मुनीन् प्रीतः प्रत्युवाच महेश्वरः प्रीतो ऽस्मि तपसा युष्मान् वरं वृणुत सुव्रताः
verses.transliteration: tatas tān sa munīn prītaḥ pratyuvāca maheśvaraḥ prīto 'smi tapasā yuṣmān varaṃ vṛṇuta suvratāḥ
verses.translation: In course of time, incidentally a dispute arose between Ksupa and 'Dadhica as to who was the better — a K$atriya or a Brahmin. (K$upa said) The king holds the physical body of the eight guardians of the quarters.**' Hence I am Indra, Agni, Yama, Nirrti, Varuna, Vayu, Soma (Moon), and Dhanada (Kubera, the lord of wealth). I am livara (overlord). I should not be dishonoured.
verses.hindi: स्रष्टुं च भगवान् चक्रे मतिं मतिमतां वरः। मुख्यं च तैर्यग्योन्यं च हैविकं मानुषं तथा सनातनं सतां श्रेष्ठं नैष्कर्म्येण गताः परम् मरीचिभूग्वद्गिरसं पुलस्त्यं पुलहं क्रतुम्
verses.wordMeaning: In course of time, incidentally a dispute arose between Ksupa and 'Dadhica as to who was the better — a K$atriya or a Brahmin. (K$upa said) The king holds the physical body of the eight guardians of the quarters.**' Hence I am Indra, Agni, Yama, Nirrti, Varuna, Vayu,…
verses.commentary: Sense: In course of time, incidentally a dispute arose between Ksupa and 'Dadhica as to who was the better — a K$atriya or a Brahmin. (K$upa said) The king holds the physical body of the eight guardians of the quarters.**' Hence I am Indra, Agni, Yama, Nirrti, Varuna, Vayu,…

verses.sanskrit: ततस्ते मुनयः सर्वे प्रणिपत्य महेश्वरम् भृग्वङ्गिरा वसिष्ठश् च विश्वामित्रस्तथैव च
verses.transliteration: tataste munayaḥ sarve praṇipatya maheśvaram bhṛgvaṅgirā vasiṣṭhaś ca viśvāmitrastathaiva ca
verses.translation: O sage of holy rites, that deity (i. e. the king) is The king embodies the essence of eight lokapSlas — the guardian deities presiding over the quarters, viz. (1) Indra, east; (s) Agni, south- east; (3) Yama, south; (4) Sdryii — south-west; (5) Varuoa, west; (6) "Vayu, north-west; (7) Kuvem, north; (8) Soma, north-east. As such, he is a divine being. He is authorized to maintain the system of four varnas and Airamas. But none of thesacred texts — irutis and smrtis— empowers him to rule over the Br&hmana varna. Cf. G. Dh. S. raja sarvasyesfe brah- mana-varjam.
verses.hindi: सङ्कल्पं चैव धर्म च ह्यधर्मं भगवान् प्रभुः द्वादशैव प्रजास्त्वेता ब्रह्मणोऽव्यक्तजन्मनः। ऋभुं सनत्कुमारं च ससर्जादौ सनातनः
verses.wordMeaning: O sage of holy rites, that deity (i. e. the king) is The king embodies the essence of eight lokapSlas — the guardian deities presiding over the quarters, viz. (1) Indra, east; (s) Agni, south- east; (3) Yama, south; (4) Sdryii — south-west; (5) Varuoa, west; (6) "Vayu,…

verses.sanskrit: गौतमो ऽत्रिः सुकेशश् च पुलस्त्यः पुलहः क्रतुः मरीचिः कश्यपः कण्वः संवर्तश् च महातपाः
verses.transliteration: gautamo 'triḥ sukeśaś ca pulastyaḥ pulahaḥ kratuḥ marīciḥ kaśyapaḥ kaṇvaḥ saṃvartaś ca mahātapāḥ
verses.translation: Formerly, he was born in the world of Brahma when Brahma sneezed. He was urged by the thunderbolt- wielding Indra to perform a task. He obtained the thunderbolt as a reward for his task. Out of his own will, he became a human, being and afterwards a king. The powerful king then conquered the leading brahmin like the powerful Indra himself, full of tamas qualities. When struck by the thunderbolt me leading brahmin fell on the ground. Out of sorrow he remembered sage Bhargava. Bhargava, the best among the embodied beings, came there and by his yogic power he stitched the body of Dadhica who had been struck by the thunderbolt. After stitching the severed body Bhargava said:
verses.hindi: तौ चोर्ध्वरेतसौ दिव्यौ चाग्रजौ ब्रह्मवादिनौ। कुमारौ ब्रह्मणस्तुल्यौ सर्वज्ञौ सर्वभाविनौ सत्ययुग, त्रेतायुग तथा द्वापरयुगका वर्णन, द्वापरमें वेदसंहिताके विभाजनका एवं कल्पभेदसे विविध पुराणोंके अनुक्रमका वर्णन
verses.wordMeaning: Formerly, he was born in the world of Brahma when Brahma sneezed. He was urged by the thunderbolt- wielding Indra to perform a task. He obtained the thunderbolt as a reward for his task. Out of his own will, he became a human, being and afterwards a king.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Formerly, he was born in the world of Brahma when Brahma sneezed. He was urged by the thunderbolt- wielding Indra to perform a task. He obtained the thunderbolt as a reward for his task. Out of his own will, he became a human, being and afterwards a king.…

verses.sanskrit: ते प्रणम्य महादेवम् इदं वचनमब्रुवन् भस्मस्नानं च नग्नत्वं वामत्वं प्रतिलोमता
verses.transliteration: te praṇamya mahādevam idaṃ vacanamabruvan bhasmasnānaṃ ca nagnatvaṃ vāmatvaṃ pratilomatā
verses.translation: O highly blessed Dadhica, worship Siva, the un- sullied lord of Devas, worthy of worship by Brahma and others* O brahmin sage! by the grace of the three-eyed lord, you become immortal. O brahmin, this pow'r of resuscitating one to life has been obtained from him by n# i There is no fear, anywhere, from death for the devo- tees of Siva. I shall now tell you Siva's Mantra that revives one to life.
verses.hindi: श्रुत्वा शक्रेण कथितं पिता मम महामुनिः । पुनः पप्रच्छ देवेशं प्रणम्य रचिताञ्जलिः ॥ भगवन् शक्र सर्वज्ञ देवदेवनमस्कृत।
verses.wordMeaning: O highly blessed Dadhica, worship Siva, the un- sullied lord of Devas, worthy of worship by Brahma and others* O brahmin sage! by the grace of the three-eyed lord, you become immortal. O brahmin,…
verses.commentary: Sense: O highly blessed Dadhica, worship Siva, the un- sullied lord of Devas, worthy of worship by Brahma and others* O brahmin sage! by the grace of the three-eyed lord, you become immortal. O brahmin,…

verses.sanskrit: सेव्यासेव्यत्वमेवं च ह्य् एतदिच्छाम वेदितुम् ततस्तेषां वचः श्रुत्वा भगवान्परमेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: sevyāsevyatvamevaṃ ca hy etadicchāma veditum tatasteṣāṃ vacaḥ śrutvā bhagavānparameśvaraḥ
verses.translation: Cf. Manu: I 7 *®* After hearing his words Dadhica propitiated Siva by means of penance and attained adamantine bones, indestructi- bility and absence of affliction.
verses.hindi: युगधर्मान् कथं चक्रे भगवान् पदासम्भवः। व्याजहार यथादृष्टं युगधर्म सुविस्तरम्॥
verses.wordMeaning: Cf. Manu: I 7 *®* After hearing his words Dadhica propitiated Siva by means of penance and attained adamantine bones, indestructi- bility and absence of affliction.
verses.commentary: Sense: Cf. Manu: I 7 *®* After hearing his words Dadhica propitiated Siva by means of penance and attained adamantine bones, indestructi- bility and absence of affliction.

verses.transliteration: sasmitaṃ prāha samprekṣya sarvānmunivarāṃstadā

verses.hindi: ध्यानं परं कृतयुगे त्रेतायां यज्ञ उच्यते। पादावशिष्टो भवति युगधर्मस्तु सर्वतः

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीलिङ्गमहापुराणे पूर्वभागे ऋषिवाक्यं नाम त्रयस्त्रिंशो ऽध्यायः एतद्वः सम्प्रवक्ष्यामि कथा सर्वस्वमद्य वै अग्निर्ह्यहं सोमकर्ता सोमश्चाग्निमुपाश्रितः
verses.transliteration: iti śrīliṅgamahāpurāṇe pūrvabhāge ṛṣivākyaṃ nāma trayastriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ etadvaḥ sampravakṣyāmi kathā sarvasvamadya vai agnirhyahaṃ somakartā somaścāgnimupāśritaḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to the overlord of Devas; obeisance to the great lord, obebance to one who shares half of body with hb consort;* obeisance to the initiator of Skhya and Yoga.
verses.hindi: नन्दीश्वर बोले-- है सनत्कुमार ! इन्द्रका कथन सुनकर मेरे पिता महामुनि शिलादने दोनों हाथ जोड़कर देवेश इन्द्रको प्रणाम करके उनसे पुन: पूछा शिलाद बोले--हे भगवन्! है शक्र! है सर्वज्ञ हे सर्वदेवनमस्कृत! है शचीपते! है जगन्नाथ! हे सहस्राक्ष! है महेश्वर ! भगवान् पद्मयोनिने युगधर्म किस प्रकार कल्पित किये ? आप इस विषयमें सब कुछ मुझ्
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to the overlord of Devas; obeisance to the great lord, obebance to one who shares half of body with hb consort;* obeisance to the initiator of Skhya and Yoga.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to the overlord of Devas; obeisance to the great lord, obebance to one who shares half of body with hb consort;* obeisance to the initiator of Skhya and Yoga.

verses.sanskrit: कृतमेतद्वहत्यग्निर् भूयो लोकसमाश्रयात् असकृत्त्वग्निना दग्धं जगत् स्थावरजङ्गमम्
verses.transliteration: kṛtametadvahatyagnir bhūyo lokasamāśrayāt asakṛttvagninā dagdhaṃ jagat sthāvarajaṅgamam
verses.translation: Obeisance to one who is black as a cluster of clouds. Obeisance to one wearing elephant's hide. Obeisance to one having deerskin for the upper garment; obeisance to one hav- ing serpent for the sacred thread.
verses.hindi: शरणागतको बतानेको कृपा करें शिलादका वह वचन सुनकर इन्द्रने जैसा देखा था, उन युगधमाँका विस्तारसे वर्णन करना प्रारम्भ किया
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to one who is black as a cluster of clouds. Obeisance to one wearing elephant's hide. Obeisance to one having deerskin for the upper garment; obeisance to one hav- ing serpent for the sacred thread.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to one who is black as a cluster of clouds. Obeisance to one wearing elephant's hide. Obeisance to one having deerskin for the upper garment; obeisance to one hav- ing serpent for the sacred thread.

verses.sanskrit: भस्मसाद्विहितं सर्वं पवित्रमिदमुत्तमम् भस्मना वीर्यमास्थाय भूतानि परिषिञ्चति
verses.transliteration: bhasmasādvihitaṃ sarvaṃ pavitramidamuttamam bhasmanā vīryamāsthāya bhūtāni pariṣiñcati
verses.translation: Obeisance to Siva with wonderful well-arranged car-rings; with well knit garlands and ornaments; to one with the fine lion skin as garb; obeisance to one of extensive reputation.
verses.hindi: इन्द्र बोले-हे मुने! आदिमें सत्ययुग, फिर त्रेतायुग, द्वापर तथा कलियुग-ये ही चार युग होते हैं; ऐसा आप संक्षेपमें जान लीजिये सत्ययुगको सत्त्वगुणरूप, त्रेतायुगको रजोगुणरूप, द्वापरयुगको रज-तमगुणरूप और कलियुगको तमोगुणरूप जानना चाहिए। इस प्रकार विभिन्न युगोंमें अलग- अलग युग-वृत्ति होती है
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to Siva with wonderful well-arranged car-rings; with well knit garlands and ornaments; to one with the fine lion skin as garb; obeisance to one of extensive reputation.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to Siva with wonderful well-arranged car-rings; with well knit garlands and ornaments; to one with the fine lion skin as garb; obeisance to one of extensive reputation.

verses.sanskrit: अग्निकार्यं च यः कृत्वा करिष्यति त्रियायुषम् भस्मना मम वीर्येण मुच्यते सर्वकिल्बिषैः
verses.transliteration: agnikāryaṃ ca yaḥ kṛtvā kariṣyati triyāyuṣam bhasmanā mama vīryeṇa mucyate sarvakilbiṣaiḥ
verses.translation: Then the delighted lord spoke to the sages — '*0 ye of good rites, I am delighted with your penance. Choose your boons."
verses.hindi: सत्ययुगमें ध्यान, त्रेतायुगमें यज्ञ, द्वापरमें भजन कलियुगमें विशुद्ध दानको श्रेष्ठ कहा गया है वह सत्ययुग चार हजार दिव्य वर्षोके प्रमाणवाला है। उसकी सन्ध्या चार सौ दिव्य वर्षोकी होती है तथा उसका सन्थ्यांश भी उसी प्रकार चार सौ दिव्य वर्षोंका होता है
verses.wordMeaning: Then the delighted lord spoke to the sages — '*0 ye of good rites, I am delighted with your penance. Choose your boons."
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the delighted lord spoke to the sages — '*0 ye of good rites, I am delighted with your penance. Choose your boons."

verses.sanskrit: भासत इत्येव यद्भस्म शुभं भावयते च यत् भक्षणात् सर्वपापानां भस्मेति परिकीर्तितम्
verses.transliteration: bhāsata ityeva yadbhasma śubhaṃ bhāvayate ca yat bhakṣaṇāt sarvapāpānāṃ bhasmeti parikīrtitam
verses.translation: All those sages bowed to the lord. TTicn Bhrgu Angiras, Vasitha, Vivamitra, Gautama, Atri, SukcfiSa, Pula- stya, Pulaha, Kratu, Maiici, Kayapa, Kanva and Samvarta of great penance, spoke to the lord after paying due homage: ''We wish to know the mystic secret behind the smearing of ashes, nudity, indirectness (in worship) contrariety in the natural order,*®® the propriety of service or otherwise." On hearing their words the great lord looked at the excellent sages and said smilingly.
verses.hindi: हे शिलाद! है सुव्रत! इस सत्ययुगमें प्रजाओंकी आयु चार हजार मनुष्य वर्षके बराबर जानिये सत्ययुग तथा इसके सन्ध्यांश बीत जानेपर समग्र युग-धर्मका एक चरण घट जाता है। पुनः उत्तम त्रेतायुग प्रवृत्त होता है, जो तीन हजार दिव्य वर्षोका होता है। सत्ययुगके आधे प्रमाणके बराबर द्वापरको जानिये तथा
verses.wordMeaning: All those sages bowed to the lord. TTicn Bhrgu Angiras, Vasitha, Vivamitra, Gautama, Atri, SukcfiSa, Pula- stya, Pulaha, Kratu, Maiici, Kayapa, Kanva and Samvarta of great penance,…
verses.commentary: Sense: All those sages bowed to the lord. TTicn Bhrgu Angiras, Vasitha, Vivamitra, Gautama, Atri, SukcfiSa, Pula- stya, Pulaha, Kratu, Maiici, Kayapa, Kanva and Samvarta of great penance,…

verses.sanskrit: ऊष्मपाः पितरो ज्ञेया देवा वै सोमसंभवाः अग्नीषोमात्मकं सर्वं जगत्स्थावरजङ्गमम्
verses.transliteration: ūṣmapāḥ pitaro jñeyā devā vai somasaṃbhavāḥ agnīṣomātmakaṃ sarvaṃ jagatsthāvarajaṅgamam
verses.translation: See note 27.
verses.hindi: उसके (द्वापरके) आधेके बराबर कलियुगका प्रमाण अध्याय ३९ सत्ययुग, त्रेतायुग तथा द्वापरयुगका वर्णन""व्रिविध पुराणोंके अनुक्रमका वर्णन
verses.wordMeaning: See note 27.
verses.commentary: Sense: See note 27.
