verses.translation: They call the supreme lord the cause of us both, as lord of the universe. He is the unchanging lord livara.
verses.hindi: तब उनका स्वप्नभूत मनोगत वचन सुनकर पितामह प्रसन्नचित्त हो गये  तदनन्तर लब्धप्राण ब्रह्माजीने अपने खिले हुए कमलके समान नेत्रोंसे महेश्वरको देखा। बहुत समयतक उन्हें देखते रहनेके पश्चात् भगवान् ब्रह्माने उठ करके दोनों हाथ जोड़कर स्नेहयुक्त गम्भीर वाणीमें उनसे कहा-हे महाभाग! आप मेरे मनको आनन्दित कर रहे हैं; एकादश रूपोंमें प्रतिष्ठित अष्टमूर्ति आप कौन हैं ?॥ ५२५४/२ ॥
verses.wordMeaning: They call the supreme lord the cause of us both, as lord of the universe. He is the unchanging lord livara.
verses.commentary: Sense: They call the supreme lord the cause of us both, as lord of the universe. He is the unchanging lord livara.

verses.sanskrit: एवमाहुर्महादेवम् आवयोरपि कारणम् ईशं सर्वस्य जगतः प्रभुमव्ययमीश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: evamāhurmahādevam āvayorapi kāraṇam īśaṃ sarvasya jagataḥ prabhumavyayamīśvaram
verses.translation: At the instance of the lord of the immortals, the lotus- born deity eulogised and bowed to Rudra the most excellent one and the bestower of boons.
verses.hindi: इन्द्र बोले--उनका वचन सुनकर देवशत्रुओंका संहार करनेवाले महेश्वर अपने सुखप्रद हाथोंसे ब्रह्माजीका स्पर्श करते हुए उनसे कहने लगे॥ ५५/२॥ श्रीशंकर बोले--मुझे परमात्मा तथा इन्हें अजन्मा माया समझिये और सामने खड़े ये रुद्र आपको रक्षा करनेके लिये यहाँ आये हैं॥ ५६/२॥
verses.wordMeaning: At the instance of the lord of the immortals, the lotus- born deity eulogised and bowed to Rudra the most excellent one and the bestower of boons.
verses.commentary: Sense: At the instance of the lord of the immortals, the lotus- born deity eulogised and bowed to Rudra the most excellent one and the bestower of boons.

verses.sanskrit: सो ऽपि तस्यामरेशस्य वचनाद्वारिजोद्भवः वरेण्यं वरदं रुद्रम् अस्तुवत्प्रणनाम च
verses.transliteration: so 'pi tasyāmareśasya vacanādvārijodbhavaḥ vareṇyaṃ varadaṃ rudram astuvatpraṇanāma ca
verses.translation: Then assumed the form of a Boar and lifted up
verses.hindi: तदनन्तर उन देवाधिदेवको प्रणाम करके ब्रह्माने हाथ जोड़कर हर्षपूर्ण गदगद वाणीमें कहा-हे भगवन्! हे देवदेवेश! मैं दुःखोंसे अत्यन्त व्याकुल हूँ । है ईशान! हे शंकर! मुझे इस संसारसे मुक्त करनेमें आप समर्थ तत्पश्चात् पितामह ब्रह्माकी इस बातपर हँसकर सर्व- व्यापी तथा जगतूके स्वामी उमापति भगवान् शिव रुद्रों एवं उन भगवती उमाके साथ अन्तर्धान हो गये ॥ ५९/२ ॥
verses.wordMeaning: Then assumed the form of a Boar and lifted up
verses.commentary: Sense: Then assumed the form of a Boar and lifted up

verses.sanskrit: अथाम्भसा प्लुतां भूमीं समाधाय जनार्दनः पूर्ववत्स्थापयामास वाराहं रूपमास्थितः
verses.transliteration: athāmbhasā plutāṃ bhūmīṃ samādhāya janārdanaḥ pūrvavatsthāpayāmāsa vārāhaṃ rūpamāsthitaḥ
verses.translation: With great effort he made the earth even, without ups and downs. The lord created the rivulets, rivers and the oceans as before.
verses.hindi: इन्द्र बोले-हे शिलाद! अतः समस्त लोकोंमें अयोनिज तथा मृत्युरहित पुरुष सर्वथा दुर्लभ है। यहाँतक कि वे पद्मयोनि ब्रह्मा भी मृत्युयुक्त हैं--ऐसा जानिये। किंतु यदि देवेश्वर भगवान् रुद्र प्रसन्न हो जाये, तो आपके लिये मृत्युरहित तथा अयोनिज पुत्र दुर्लभ नहीं है। मैं, विष्णु एवं महात्मा ब्रह्मा भी मृत्युहीन तथा अयोनिज पुत्र देनेमें असमर्थ हैं॥ ६०-६२/२॥
verses.wordMeaning: With great effort he made the earth even, without ups and downs. The lord created the rivulets, rivers and the oceans as before.
verses.commentary: Sense: With great effort he made the earth even, without ups and downs. The lord created the rivulets, rivers and the oceans as before.

verses.sanskrit: नदीनदसमुद्रांश् च पूर्ववच्चाकरोत्प्रभुः कृत्वा चोर्वीं प्रयत्नेन निम्नोन्नतविवर्जिताम्
verses.transliteration: nadīnadasamudrāṃś ca pūrvavaccākarotprabhuḥ kṛtvā corvīṃ prayatnena nimnonnatavivarjitām
verses.translation: The lord having the form of a boar*** the uplifter of the earth, gathered all the mountains together. As before he created the four worlds beginning with Bhuh.
verses.hindi: शैलादि बोले--इस प्रकार विप्रेनद्रसे कहकर तथा उनपर अनुग्रह करके वे दयालु इन्द्र देवताओंके एवं व्याहृत्य विप्रेनद्रमनुगृह्य च तं घृणी॥ ६३  साथ श्वेतवर्णवाले ऐरावतपर आरूढ होकर चले देवैर्वृतो ययौ देवः सितेनेभेन वै प्रभुः॥ ६४  गये ऑतिङयहाउपा फफफ भं
verses.wordMeaning: The lord having the form of a boar*** the uplifter of the earth, gathered all the mountains together. As before he created the four worlds beginning with Bhuh.
verses.commentary: Sense: The lord having the form of a boar*** the uplifter of the earth, gathered all the mountains together. As before he created the four worlds beginning with Bhuh.

verses.sanskrit: धरायां सो ऽचिनोत्सर्वान् भूधरान् भूधराकृतिः भूराद्यांश्चतुरो लोकान् कल्पयामास पूर्ववत्
verses.transliteration: dharāyāṃ so 'cinotsarvān bhūdharān bhūdharākṛtiḥ bhūrādyāṃścaturo lokān kalpayāmāsa pūrvavat
verses.translation: The lord who was the most excellent of all intelligent persons became inclined to create the chief creation, the animal creation, and then the divine and human creations.
verses.hindi: शिलादद्वारा तप करनेसे भगवान् महेश्वरका नन्दी नामसे उनके पुत्रके रूपमें प्रकट होना और शिलादद्वारा नन्दिकेश्वर शिवकी स्तुति सूतजी बोले--वर प्रदान करनेवाले सहस्रनेत्र इन्द्रके चले जानेपर वे शिलाद महादेव शिव आराधना करते हुए तपके द्वारा उन्हें सन्तुष्ट करने लगे  १॥
verses.wordMeaning: The lord who was the most excellent of all intelligent persons became inclined to create the chief creation, the animal creation, and then the divine and human creations.
verses.commentary: Sense: The lord who was the most excellent of all intelligent persons became inclined to create the chief creation, the animal creation, and then the divine and human creations.

verses.sanskrit: स्रष्टुं च भगवांश्चक्रे मतिं मतिमतां वरः मुख्यं च तैर्यग्योन्यं च दैविकं मानुषं तथा
verses.transliteration: sraṣṭuṃ ca bhagavāṃścakre matiṃ matimatāṃ varaḥ mukhyaṃ ca tairyagyonyaṃ ca daivikaṃ mānuṣaṃ tathā
verses.translation: With the intellect free from wretchedness the lord at the outset created Sananda, Sanaka and Sanatana the most excellent among the good. All these practised Naiskarmya and attained the greatest being. By his yogic learning he created Marici, Bhrgu, Ahgiras, Pulastya, Pulaha, Kratu, Dak$a, Atri, VaSi§tha, Sahkalpa, Dharma and Adharma. Thus there are twelve sons to Brahma born of the unmanifest.
verses.hindi: इस प्रकार निरन्तर तपस्यामें संलग्न उन द्विज शिलादके एक हजार दिव्य वर्ष एक क्षणकी भाँति अद्भुतरूपसे व्यतीत हो गये उनका शरीर वल्मीक (बाँबी)-से ढँक गया, बे मुनि वञ्रसूची (वज्र तथा सूईके समान) मुखवाले तथा अन्य रक्तभोजी कीटोंसे लिपटे शरीरवाले परिलक्षित हो रहे थे, वे मांस-रुधिर-त्वचासे विहीन होकर अस्थिमात्र
verses.wordMeaning: With the intellect free from wretchedness the lord at the outset created Sananda, Sanaka and Sanatana the most excellent among the good. All these practised Naiskarmya and attained the greatest being. By his yogic learning he created Marici, Bhrgu, Ahgiras, Pulastya, Pulaha,…
verses.commentary: Sense: With the intellect free from wretchedness the lord at the outset created Sananda, Sanaka and Sanatana the most excellent among the good. All these practised Naiskarmya and attained the greatest being. By his yogic learning he created Marici, Bhrgu, Ahgiras, Pulastya, Pulaha,…

verses.sanskrit: विभुश्चानुग्रहं तत्र कौमारकम् अदीनधीः पुरस्तादसृजद्देवः सनन्दं सनकं तथा
verses.transliteration: vibhuścānugrahaṃ tatra kaumārakam adīnadhīḥ purastādasṛjaddevaḥ sanandaṃ sanakaṃ tathā
verses.translation: With the intellect free from wretchedness the lord at the outset created Sananda, Sanaka and Sanatana the most excellent among the good. All these practised Naiskarmya and attained the greatest being. By his yogic learning he created Marici, Bhrgu, Ahgiras, Pulastya, Pulaha, Kratu, Dak$a, Atri, VaSi§tha, Sahkalpa, Dharma and Adharma. Thus there are twelve sons to Brahma born of the unmanifest.
verses.hindi: शरीरवाले हो गये थे; फिर भी वे निर्लिप्त भावसे भित्तिकी भाँति निश्चल खड़े थे। तब उन्हें इस रूपमे तप करते हुए भगवान् शंकरने जान लिया। वहाँ प्रकट होकर कामरिपु शिवने ज्यों ही अपने हाथसे मुनिका स्पर्श किया, त्यों ही मुनिश्रेष्ठ द्विज शिलादका
verses.wordMeaning: With the intellect free from wretchedness the lord at the outset created Sananda, Sanaka and Sanatana the most excellent among the good. All these practised Naiskarmya and attained the greatest being. By his yogic learning he created Marici, Bhrgu, Ahgiras, Pulastya, Pulaha,…
verses.commentary: Sense: With the intellect free from wretchedness the lord at the outset created Sananda, Sanaka and Sanatana the most excellent among the good. All these practised Naiskarmya and attained the greatest being. By his yogic learning he created Marici, Bhrgu, Ahgiras, Pulastya, Pulaha,…

verses.sanskrit: सनातनं सतां श्रेष्ठं नैष्कर्म्येण गताः परम् मरीचिभृग्वङ्गिरसं पुलस्त्यं पुलहं क्रतुम्
verses.transliteration: sanātanaṃ satāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ naiṣkarmyeṇa gatāḥ param marīcibhṛgvaṅgirasaṃ pulastyaṃ pulahaṃ kratum
verses.translation: With the intellect free from wretchedness the lord at the outset created Sananda, Sanaka and Sanatana the most excellent among the good. All these practised Naiskarmya and attained the greatest being. By his yogic learning he created Marici, Bhrgu, Ahgiras, Pulastya, Pulaha, Kratu, Dak$a, Atri, VaSi§tha, Sahkalpa, Dharma and Adharma. Thus there are twelve sons to Brahma born of the unmanifest.
verses.hindi: तदनन्तर तपस्यारत उन मुनिके तपसे सन्तुष्ट होकर भगवान् शंकरने उनसे कहा--मैं अपने गणों तथा आपपर प्रसन्न हूँ। है महामते! इस तपस्यासे आपका क्या प्रयोजन! मैं आपको सर्वज्ञ तथा समस्त शास्त्रोके रहस्योंका पारगामी विद्वान् पुत्र प्रदान करता हूँ
verses.wordMeaning: With the intellect free from wretchedness the lord at the outset created Sananda, Sanaka and Sanatana the most excellent among the good. All these practised Naiskarmya and attained the greatest being. By his yogic learning he created Marici, Bhrgu, Ahgiras, Pulastya, Pulaha,…
verses.commentary: Sense: With the intellect free from wretchedness the lord at the outset created Sananda, Sanaka and Sanatana the most excellent among the good. All these practised Naiskarmya and attained the greatest being. By his yogic learning he created Marici, Bhrgu, Ahgiras, Pulastya, Pulaha,…

verses.sanskrit: दक्षमत्रिं वसिष्ठं च सो ऽसृजद् योगविद्यया संकल्पं चैव धर्मं च ह्य् अधर्मं भगवान्प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: dakṣamatriṃ vasiṣṭhaṃ ca so 'sṛjad yogavidyayā saṃkalpaṃ caiva dharmaṃ ca hy adharmaṃ bhagavānprabhuḥ
verses.translation: With the intellect free from wretchedness the lord at the outset created Sananda, Sanaka and Sanatana the most excellent among the good. All these practised Naiskarmya and attained the greatest being. By his yogic learning he created Marici, Bhrgu, Ahgiras, Pulastya, Pulaha, Kratu, Dak$a, Atri, VaSi§tha, Sahkalpa, Dharma and Adharma. Thus there are twelve sons to Brahma born of the unmanifest.
verses.hindi: तब देवेश शिवको प्रणाम करके और उनकी स्तुति करके शिलादमुनि हर्षपूर्ण गद्गद वाणीमें चन्द्रभूषण शिवसे कहने लगे शिलाद बोले-हे भगवन्! है देवदेवेश! है त्रिपुरार्दन! है शंकर! है सत्तम! मैं अयोनिज तथा मृत्युहीन पुत्र चाहता हूँ
verses.wordMeaning: With the intellect free from wretchedness the lord at the outset created Sananda, Sanaka and Sanatana the most excellent among the good. All these practised Naiskarmya and attained the greatest being. By his yogic learning he created Marici, Bhrgu, Ahgiras, Pulastya, Pulaha,…
verses.commentary: Sense: With the intellect free from wretchedness the lord at the outset created Sananda, Sanaka and Sanatana the most excellent among the good. All these practised Naiskarmya and attained the greatest being. By his yogic learning he created Marici, Bhrgu, Ahgiras, Pulastya, Pulaha,…

verses.sanskrit: द्वादशैव प्रजास्त्वेता ब्रह्मणो ऽव्यक्तजन्मनः ऋभुं सनत्कुमारं च ससर्जादौ सनातनः
verses.transliteration: dvādaśaiva prajāstvetā brahmaṇo 'vyaktajanmanaḥ ṛbhuṃ sanatkumāraṃ ca sasarjādau sanātanaḥ
verses.translation: With the intellect free from wretchedness the lord at the outset created Sananda, Sanaka and Sanatana the most excellent among the good. All these practised Naiskarmya and attained the greatest being. By his yogic learning he created Marici, Bhrgu, Ahgiras, Pulastya, Pulaha, Kratu, Dak$a, Atri, VaSi§tha, Sahkalpa, Dharma and Adharma. Thus there are twelve sons to Brahma born of the unmanifest.
verses.hindi: सूतजी बोले पूर्वमें ब्रह्माजीके द्वारा तपस्या आराधित परमेश्वर रुद्रने परम प्रसन्नताके साथ झु शिलादसे कहा आराधयन् महादेवं तपसातोषयद्भवम्
verses.wordMeaning: With the intellect free from wretchedness the lord at the outset created Sananda, Sanaka and Sanatana the most excellent among the good. All these practised Naiskarmya and attained the greatest being. By his yogic learning he created Marici, Bhrgu, Ahgiras, Pulastya, Pulaha,…
verses.commentary: Sense: With the intellect free from wretchedness the lord at the outset created Sananda, Sanaka and Sanatana the most excellent among the good. All these practised Naiskarmya and attained the greatest being. By his yogic learning he created Marici, Bhrgu, Ahgiras, Pulastya, Pulaha,…

verses.sanskrit: तौ चोर्ध्वरेतसौ दिव्यौ चाग्रजौ ब्रह्मवादिनौ कुमारौ ब्रह्मणस्तुल्यौ सर्वज्ञौ सर्वभाविनौ
verses.transliteration: tau cordhvaretasau divyau cāgrajau brahmavādinau kumārau brahmaṇastulyau sarvajñau sarvabhāvinau
verses.translation: With the intellect free from wretchedness the lord at the outset created Sananda, Sanaka and Sanatana the most excellent among the good. All these practised Naiskarmya and attained the greatest being. By his yogic learning he created Marici, Bhrgu, Ahgiras, Pulastya, Pulaha, Kratu, Dak$a, Atri, VaSi§tha, Sahkalpa, Dharma and Adharma. Thus there are twelve sons to Brahma born of the unmanifest.
verses.hindi: बल्मीकेनावृताङ्गश्च लक्ष्यः कीटगणैर्मुनिः । वज्रसूचीमुखैश्चान्ये रक्तकीटैशच सर्वतः अस्थिशेषोऽभवत्पश्चात्तममन्यत शङ्करः
verses.wordMeaning: With the intellect free from wretchedness the lord at the outset created Sananda, Sanaka and Sanatana the most excellent among the good. All these practised Naiskarmya and attained the greatest being. By his yogic learning he created Marici, Bhrgu, Ahgiras, Pulastya, Pulaha,…
verses.commentary: Sense: With the intellect free from wretchedness the lord at the outset created Sananda, Sanaka and Sanatana the most excellent among the good. All these practised Naiskarmya and attained the greatest being. By his yogic learning he created Marici, Bhrgu, Ahgiras, Pulastya, Pulaha,…

verses.sanskrit: एवं मुख्यादिकान् सृष्ट्वा पद्मयोनिः शिलाशन युगधर्मानशेषांश् च कल्पयामास विश्वसृक्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ mukhyādikān sṛṣṭvā padmayoniḥ śilāśana yugadharmānaśeṣāṃś ca kalpayāmāsa viśvasṛk
verses.translation: With the intellect free from wretchedness the lord at the outset created Sananda, Sanaka and Sanatana the most excellent among the good. All these practised Naiskarmya and attained the greatest being. By his yogic learning he created Marici, Bhrgu, Ahgiras, Pulastya, Pulaha, Kratu, Dak$a, Atri, VaSi§tha, Sahkalpa, Dharma and Adharma. Thus there are twelve sons to Brahma born of the unmanifest.
verses.hindi: यदा स्पृष्टो मुनिस्तेन करेण च स्मरारिणा। तहैव मुनिशार्दूलश्चोत्ससर्ज क्लमं द्विजः तपतस्तस्य तपसा प्रभुस्तुष्टोऽथ शङ्करः। तुष्टस्तवेत्यथोवाच सगणश्चोमया सह
verses.wordMeaning: With the intellect free from wretchedness the lord at the outset created Sananda, Sanaka and Sanatana the most excellent among the good. All these practised Naiskarmya and attained the greatest being. By his yogic learning he created Marici, Bhrgu, Ahgiras, Pulastya, Pulaha,…
verses.commentary: Sense: With the intellect free from wretchedness the lord at the outset created Sananda, Sanaka and Sanatana the most excellent among the good. All these practised Naiskarmya and attained the greatest being. By his yogic learning he created Marici, Bhrgu, Ahgiras, Pulastya, Pulaha,…

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीलिङ्गमहापुराणे पूर्वभागे वैष्णवकथनं नामाष्टत्रिंशो ऽध्यायः श्रुत्वा शक्रेण कथितं पिता मम महामुनिः पुनः पप्रच्छ देवेशं प्रणम्य रचिताञ्जलिः
verses.transliteration: iti śrīliṅgamahāpurāṇe pūrvabhāge vaiṣṇavakathanaṃ nāmāṣṭatriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ śrutvā śakreṇa kathitaṃ pitā mama mahāmuniḥ punaḥ papraccha deveśaṃ praṇamya racitāñjaliḥ
verses.translation: On hearing the narration of Indra» my father, the great sage, bowed to the lord of Dcvas, and with the palms joined in reverence he asked him again.
verses.hindi: तपसानेन किं कार्य भवतस्ते महामते। ददामि पुत्रं सर्वज्ञं सर्वशास्त्रार्थपारगम् ततः प्रणम्य देवेशं स्तुत्वोवाच शिलाशनः।
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing the narration of Indra» my father, the great sage, bowed to the lord of Dcvas, and with the palms joined in reverence he asked him again.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the narration of Indra» my father, the great sage, bowed to the lord of Dcvas, and with the palms joined in reverence he asked him again.

verses.sanskrit: भगवन् शक्र सर्वज्ञ देवदेवनमस्कृत शचीपते जगन्नाथ सहस्राक्ष महेश्वर
verses.transliteration: bhagavan śakra sarvajña devadevanamaskṛta śacīpate jagannātha sahasrākṣa maheśvara
verses.translation: On hearing the words of SillUia, the noble-souled Indra recounted the dharmas of the yugas in detail in the manner seen by him.
verses.hindi: भगवन् देवदेवेश त्रिपुरार्दन शङ्कर। अयोनिजं मृत्युहीनं पुत्रमिच्छामि सत्तम शिलादं ब्रह्मणा रुद्रः प्रीत्या परमया पुनः
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing the words of SillUia, the noble-souled Indra recounted the dharmas of the yugas in detail in the manner seen by him.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the words of SillUia, the noble-souled Indra recounted the dharmas of the yugas in detail in the manner seen by him.

verses.sanskrit: युगधर्मान्कथं चक्रे भगवान्पद्मसंभवः वक्तुमर्हसि मे सर्वं सांप्रतं प्रणताय मे
verses.transliteration: yugadharmānkathaṃ cakre bhagavānpadmasaṃbhavaḥ vaktumarhasi me sarvaṃ sāṃprataṃ praṇatāya me
verses.translation: Knov/ that first comes Kftayuga. O sage, TreUL comes next. Thereafter Dvfipara and Ti§ya (Kali) yugas. These arc the four yugas in brief.
verses.hindi: अध्याय ४२ भगवान् महेश्वरका नन्दी नामसे शिलादपुत्रके रूपमें प्रकट होना १९९ फझफफफफफफफफफफफफ क क फ फ फ फ फ का फ फ फ फ फ फ फ़ फ फ फ छ फ फ फ फ फ़ फ़ फ़ फा फ फ़ फ फ क क फा छ फा भा फा का फ मी फ मीमी मी मी
verses.wordMeaning: Knov/ that first comes Kftayuga. O sage, TreUL comes next. Thereafter Dvfipara and Ti§ya (Kali) yugas. These arc the four yugas in brief.
verses.commentary: Sense: Knov/ that first comes Kftayuga. O sage, TreUL comes next. Thereafter Dvfipara and Ti§ya (Kali) yugas. These arc the four yugas in brief.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा शिलादस्य महात्मनः व्याजहार यथादृष्टं युगधर्मं सुविस्तरम्
verses.transliteration: tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā śilādasya mahātmanaḥ vyājahāra yathādṛṣṭaṃ yugadharmaṃ suvistaram
verses.translation: Sattvagua signifies Kfta yuga; rajas signifies Treta; rajas-cum-tamas signifies DvEpara. Tamas signifies Kali. These should be known as the special characterisdcs in each of the different yugas.
verses.hindi: श्रीदेवदेव उवाच ह श्रीदेवदेव शिव बोले- है विप्र! है तपोधन! पूर्वमाराधितो विप्र ब्रह्मणाहं पूर्वम हाणाह तपोधन।  तथा श्रेष्ठ देवताओंसहित ब्रह्माजीने अवतार ठल" जावुता सिति सुरोत्तमैः ॥ ११ ग्रहण करनेके लिये पूर्वकालमें तपस्याके द्वारा मेरी
verses.wordMeaning: Sattvagua signifies Kfta yuga; rajas signifies Treta; rajas-cum-tamas signifies DvEpara. Tamas signifies Kali. These should be known as the special characterisdcs in each of the different yugas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sattvagua signifies Kfta yuga; rajas signifies Treta; rajas-cum-tamas signifies DvEpara. Tamas signifies Kali. These should be known as the special characterisdcs in each of the different yugas.

verses.sanskrit: <चतुर्युग> आद्यं कृतयुगं विद्धि ततस्त्रेतायुगं मुने द्वापरं तिष्यमित्येते चत्वारस्तु समासतः
verses.transliteration: <caturyuga> ādyaṃ kṛtayugaṃ viddhi tatastretāyugaṃ mune dvāparaṃ tiṣyamityete catvārastu samāsataḥ
verses.translation: Meditation is the greatest activity in Ktta yuga; yajfla (sacrifice) in Treta; worship is the main activity in Dvfipara and pure charitable gift in the Kali age.
verses.hindi: आराधना की थी। अतः मैं नन्दी नामसे तुम्हारे अयोनिज पुत्रके रूपमें जन्म लूँगा। है मुने! आप मुझ जगत्पिताके भी पिता होंगे ऐसा कहकर सम्मुख स्थित मुनिकी ओर प्रेमपूर्वक देखकर उन्हें प्रणाम करके अमृततुल्य भगवान् शिव उमासहित वहीं अन्तर्धान हो गये
verses.wordMeaning: Meditation is the greatest activity in Ktta yuga; yajfla (sacrifice) in Treta; worship is the main activity in Dvfipara and pure charitable gift in the Kali age.
verses.commentary: Sense: Meditation is the greatest activity in Ktta yuga; yajfla (sacrifice) in Treta; worship is the main activity in Dvfipara and pure charitable gift in the Kali age.

verses.sanskrit: सत्त्वं कृतं रजस्त्रेता द्वापरं च रजस्तमः कलिस्तमश् च विज्ञेयं युगवृत्तिर्युगेषु च
verses.transliteration: sattvaṃ kṛtaṃ rajastretā dvāparaṃ ca rajastamaḥ kalistamaś ca vijñeyaṃ yugavṛttiryugeṣu ca
verses.translation: Four thousand divine years constitute Kfta yuga. So many hundred years (i.e four hundred) constitute the preceding transition period (sandhya). The following transition period (sandhyama) is also of the same duration.
verses.hindi: हे महामुने! भगवान् रुद्रसे पुत्रप्राप्तिका वरदान पाकर यज्ञविदोंमें श्रेष्ठ मेरे पिताजी यज्ञ करनेके लिये प्रसन्नतापूर्वक विशाल यज्ञशालामें पहुँचे; तब मैं पूर्व ही भगवान् रुद्रकी आज्ञासे उनके पुत्रके रूपमें उस अंगणमें प्रादुर्भूत हो गया, उस समय मैं प्रलयाग्निके समान प्रभासे समन्वित था
verses.wordMeaning: Four thousand divine years constitute Kfta yuga. So many hundred years (i.e four hundred) constitute the preceding transition period (sandhya). The following transition period (sandhyama) is also of the same duration.
verses.commentary: Sense: Four thousand divine years constitute Kfta yuga. So many hundred years (i.e four hundred) constitute the preceding transition period (sandhya). The following transition period (sandhyama) is also of the same duration.

verses.sanskrit: ध्यानं परं कृतयुगे त्रेतायां यज्ञ उच्यते भजनं द्वापरे शुद्धं दानमेव कलौ युगे
verses.transliteration: dhyānaṃ paraṃ kṛtayuge tretāyāṃ yajña ucyate bhajanaṃ dvāpare śuddhaṃ dānameva kalau yuge
verses.translation: O Silfiana, O man of good holy rites, know that the longevity of the subjects in Krta is foiur thousand human years
verses.hindi: उस समय शिलादमुनिके पुत्ररूपमें मेरे आविर्भूत होनेपर पुष्कर, आवर्तक आदि मेघ बरसने लगे; किन्नर, सिद्ध, साध्य आदि गगनचारी देवतागण गान करने लगे और इन्द्र पुष्पराशिमिश्रित वृष्टि करने लगे उस समय कालसूर्यके समान आभावाले, जटा- मुकुट धारण किये, तीन नेत्रोसे युक्त, चार भुजाओंवाले, हाथोंमें शूल-टंक-गदा धारण करनेवाले, वज्र लिये हुए, हीरेके सदृश उज्ज्वल दाँतोंवाले, इन्द्रके द्वारा
verses.wordMeaning: O Silfiana, O man of good holy rites, know that the longevity of the subjects in Krta is foiur thousand human years
verses.commentary: Sense: O Silfiana, O man of good holy rites, know that the longevity of the subjects in Krta is foiur thousand human years

verses.sanskrit: चत्वारि च सहस्राणि वर्षाणां तत्कृतं युगम् तस्य तावच्छती संध्या संध्यांशश् च तथाविधः
verses.transliteration: catvāri ca sahasrāṇi varṣāṇāṃ tatkṛtaṃ yugam tasya tāvacchatī saṃdhyā saṃdhyāṃśaś ca tathāvidhaḥ
verses.translation: When the Krtayuga together with its sandhyama passes off, the yuga dhzuma becomes reduced by a quarter all round.
verses.hindi: आराधित, कानोंमें हीरेका कुण्डल धारण किये हुए, घोर विग्रहवाले तथा मेघसदूश गम्भीर ध्वनिसे सम्पन्न मुझ बाल-शिशुको देखकर ब्रह्मा आदि, इन्द्र तथा सभी मुनीश्वर स्तुति करने लगे और सभी अप्सराएँ चारों ओरसे वाद्ययन्त्र बजाने लगीं तथा नृत्य करने
verses.wordMeaning: When the Krtayuga together with its sandhyama passes off, the yuga dhzuma becomes reduced by a quarter all round.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the Krtayuga together with its sandhyama passes off, the yuga dhzuma becomes reduced by a quarter all round.

verses.sanskrit: चत्वारि च सहस्राणि मानुषाणि शिलाशन आयुः कृतयुगे विद्धि प्रजानामिह सुव्रत
verses.transliteration: catvāri ca sahasrāṇi mānuṣāṇi śilāśana āyuḥ kṛtayuge viddhi prajānāmiha suvrata
verses.translation: O sage, the Sandhya periods are respectively three hundred, two hundred and one hundred years. The sandhyaiha periods are also the same. The same thing holds good in all the kalpas, and yugas.
verses.hindi: हे मुनिश्रेष्ठ! ऋग्वेद, यजुर्वेद तथा सामवेदके माहेश्वर मन्त्रोंके द्वार आनन्दपूर्वक मेरी स्तुति करके ऋषियोंने मुझे प्रणाम किया ब्रह्मा, विष्णु, रुद्र, इन्द्र, साक्षात् अम्बिका शिवा, देवगुरु बृहस्पति, चन्द्रमा, महातेजस्वी सूर्य, वायु, अग्नि, ईशान, निर्क्रति, यक्ष, यम, वरुण, विश्वेदेव,
verses.wordMeaning: O sage, the Sandhya periods are respectively three hundred, two hundred and one hundred years. The sandhyaiha periods are also the same. The same thing holds good in all the kalpas, and yugas.
verses.commentary: Sense: O sage, the Sandhya periods are respectively three hundred, two hundred and one hundred years. The sandhyaiha periods are also the same. The same thing holds good in all the kalpas, and yugas.

verses.sanskrit: ततः कृतयुगे तस्मिन् संध्यांशे च गते तु वै पादावशिष्टो भवति युगधर्मस्तु सर्वतः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ kṛtayuge tasmin saṃdhyāṃśe ca gate tu vai pādāvaśiṣṭo bhavati yugadharmastu sarvataḥ
verses.translation: In Krta, the eternal dharma has all the four feet; in Treta it has three feet; it stays on two feet in Dvapara; in Kali, it is devoid of three feet and is stationed by its mere exis- tence. In Krta, the subjects are born in twins; their avocation abounds in taste and happiness.
verses.hindi: एवमुक्त्वा मुनिं प्रेक्ष्य प्रणिपत्य स्थितं घृणी। लब्धपुत्रः पिता रुद्रात्प्रीतो मम महामुने। ज्ञाङ्गणं महत्प्राप्य सज्ञार्थंयज्ञवित्तमः
verses.wordMeaning: In Krta, the eternal dharma has all the four feet; in Treta it has three feet; it stays on two feet in Dvapara; in Kali, it is devoid of three feet and is stationed by its mere exis- tence. In Krta, the subjects are born in twins; their avocation abounds in taste and happiness.
verses.commentary: Sense: In Krta, the eternal dharma has all the four feet; in Treta it has three feet; it stays on two feet in Dvapara; in Kali, it is devoid of three feet and is stationed by its mere exis- tence. In Krta, the subjects are born in twins; their avocation abounds in taste and happiness.

verses.sanskrit: चतुर्भागैकहीनं तु त्रेतायुगमनुत्तमम् कृतार्धं द्वापरं विद्धि तदर्धं तिष्यमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: caturbhāgaikahīnaṃ tu tretāyugamanuttamam kṛtārdhaṃ dvāparaṃ viddhi tadardhaṃ tiṣyamucyate
verses.translation: They are always satisfied. They enjoy all pleasures and bliss. There is no inferiority or superiority among them; there are no special characteristics among subjects; they are all auspicious.
verses.hindi: ववर्घुस्तदा पुष्करावर्तकाद्या मां दृष्ट्वा कालसूर्याभं जटामुकुटधारिणम्। त्र्यक्षं चतुर्भुजं बालं शूलटङ्कगदाधरम्
verses.wordMeaning: They are always satisfied. They enjoy all pleasures and bliss. There is no inferiority or superiority among them; there are no special characteristics among subjects; they are all auspicious.
verses.commentary: Sense: They are always satisfied. They enjoy all pleasures and bliss. There is no inferiority or superiority among them; there are no special characteristics among subjects; they are all auspicious.

verses.sanskrit: त्रिशती द्विशती संध्या तथा चैकशती मुने संध्यांशकं तथाप्येवं कल्पेष्वेवं युगे युगे
verses.transliteration: triśatī dviśatī saṃdhyā tathā caikaśatī mune saṃdhyāṃśakaṃ tathāpyevaṃ kalpeṣvevaṃ yuge yuge
verses.translation: Longevity, happiness and features among the people in Krta are the same for all; they have no special liking; they have no Dvandvas (mutually opposing pairs), no hatred, no fatigue.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्माद्यास्तुष्टुवुः सर्वे सुरेन्द्रश्च मुनीश्वराः। ऋषयो मुनिशादूंल ऋग्यजुःसामसम्भवैः । मन्त्रैमहिश्वरैः स्तुत्वा सम्प्रणेमुर्मुदान्विताः
verses.wordMeaning: Longevity, happiness and features among the people in Krta are the same for all; they have no special liking; they have no Dvandvas (mutually opposing pairs), no hatred, no fatigue.
verses.commentary: Sense: Longevity, happiness and features among the people in Krta are the same for all; they have no special liking; they have no Dvandvas (mutually opposing pairs), no hatred, no fatigue.

verses.sanskrit: आद्ये कृतयुगे धर्मश् चतुष्पादः सनातनः त्रेतायुगे त्रिपादस्तु द्विपादो द्वापरे स्थितः
verses.transliteration: ādye kṛtayuge dharmaś catuṣpādaḥ sanātanaḥ tretāyuge tripādastu dvipādo dvāpare sthitaḥ
verses.translation: Those who have no abodes live on mountains and in the oceans. Even then they are devoid of misery. They have mostly sattva gunas and are mostly isolated. They move about without specific desires; they are perpetually delighted in their minds. They refrain from virtuous and sinful activities.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्म हरिश्च रुद्रशच शक्रः साक्षाच्छिवाम्बिका। जीवशचेन्दर्महातेजा भास्करः पवनोऽनलः विश्वेदेवास्तथा रुद्रा वसवश्च महाबलाः
verses.wordMeaning: Those who have no abodes live on mountains and in the oceans. Even then they are devoid of misery. They have mostly sattva gunas and are mostly isolated. They move about without specific desires; they are perpetually delighted in their minds.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who have no abodes live on mountains and in the oceans. Even then they are devoid of misery. They have mostly sattva gunas and are mostly isolated. They move about without specific desires; they are perpetually delighted in their minds.…

verses.sanskrit: त्रिपादहीनस्तिष्ये तु सत्तामात्रेण धिष्ठितः कृते तु मिथुनोत्पत्तिर् वृत्तिः साक्षाद्रसोल्लसा
verses.transliteration: tripādahīnastiṣye tu sattāmātreṇa dhiṣṭhitaḥ kṛte tu mithunotpattir vṛttiḥ sākṣādrasollasā
verses.translation: When that Siddhi has perished another is generated. When water attains subtlety it gets transformed into clouds. From the thundering clouds rainfall proceeds. As soon as the surface of the earth comes into contact with rain, trees appear. These trees form their abodes. The subjects have their susten- ance and pleasures out of these trees.
verses.hindi: १ चा त न? तिला फफफफफफफफफफफफफफाफफफफ फफफफफफाफ फा फी फा फाफीपीफपीफापी पापी फीपीफीपफापाीपाफफपफाफ फा फफफ फफ फ ड : ज्येष्ठा देवी चैव सरस्वती । सभी रुद्र, महाब , इराण लक्ष्मीः साक्षाच्छची देवी ज्येष्ठा, सरस्वती, अदिति, दिति, श्रद्धा,
verses.wordMeaning: When that Siddhi has perished another is generated. When water attains subtlety it gets transformed into clouds. From the thundering clouds rainfall proceeds. As soon as the surface of the earth comes into contact with rain, trees appear. These trees form their abodes.…
verses.commentary: Sense: When that Siddhi has perished another is generated. When water attains subtlety it gets transformed into clouds. From the thundering clouds rainfall proceeds. As soon as the surface of the earth comes into contact with rain, trees appear. These trees form their abodes.…

verses.sanskrit: प्रजास्तृप्ताः सदा सर्वाः सर्वानन्दाश् च भोगिनः अधमोत्तमता तासां न विशेषाः प्रजाः शुभाः
verses.transliteration: prajāstṛptāḥ sadā sarvāḥ sarvānandāś ca bhoginaḥ adhamottamatā tāsāṃ na viśeṣāḥ prajāḥ śubhāḥ
verses.translation: In the beginning of Treta the subjects sustained themselves through them. Then after the lapse of a great deal
verses.hindi: महातेजस्वी धर्म तथा धर्मपुत्र मुझे घेरकर मेरा आलिङ्ग करके मेरी स्तुति करने लगे। है मुनिश्रेष्ठ। उस समय पुण्य आत्मावाले मेरै पिता मुनि शिलाद पै उस प्रकारके रूपवाले इष्टप्रद पुत्रको देखकर प्रेमपूर्वक प्रणाम करके मेरी स्तुति करने लगे॥ २ १--२५४
verses.wordMeaning: In the beginning of Treta the subjects sustained themselves through them. Then after the lapse of a great deal
verses.commentary: Sense: In the beginning of Treta the subjects sustained themselves through them. Then after the lapse of a great deal

verses.sanskrit: तुल्यमायुः सुखं रूपं तासां तस्मिन्कृते युगे तासां प्रीतिर्न च द्वन्द्वं न द्वेषो नास्ति च क्लमः
verses.transliteration: tulyamāyuḥ sukhaṃ rūpaṃ tāsāṃ tasminkṛte yuge tāsāṃ prītirna ca dvandvaṃ na dveṣo nāsti ca klamaḥ
verses.translation: They used to produce clothes, fruits and ornaments. On the very same trees honey of great potency but not genera- ted by bees, got evolved in every leafy cup. This honey had great fragrance, good colour and sweet taste The subjects always sustained themselves thereby and passed their days comfortably at all times.
verses.hindi: शिलाद बोले--हे भगवन्! है देवदेवेश! हे त्रियम्बक! है अव्यय! आप मेरे पुत्र हैं और रक्षक हैं, अत: अब मुझे दु:ख किस बातका! है पुत्र हे सर्वग (सर्वव्यापी) ! आप जगत्के रक्षक हैं, अत: मेरे भी पिता हैं । है अयोनिज! आपको नमस्कार है। है जगद्योने हे पितामह! है पुत्र! है महेशान! है जगद्गुरो! आप जगत्के पिता हैं। है वत्स! है वत्स! है महाभाग! हे परमेश्वर! मेरी रक्षा कीजिये। है सुरेश्वर! आपने मुझे
verses.wordMeaning: They used to produce clothes, fruits and ornaments. On the very same trees honey of great potency but not genera- ted by bees, got evolved in every leafy cup. This honey had great fragrance,…
verses.commentary: Sense: They used to produce clothes, fruits and ornaments. On the very same trees honey of great potency but not genera- ted by bees, got evolved in every leafy cup. This honey had great fragrance,…

verses.sanskrit: पर्वतोदधिवासिन्यो ह्य् अनिकेताश्रयास्तु ताः विशोकाः सत्त्वबहुला एकान्तबहुलास् तथा
verses.transliteration: parvatodadhivāsinyo hy aniketāśrayāstu tāḥ viśokāḥ sattvabahulā ekāntabahulās tathā
verses.translation: They were delighted and well-nourished. Through this achievement they were free from ailments. Then after the lapse of some time, they became greedy.
verses.hindi: आनन्दित किया है, अत: आप 'नन्दी' नामसे विख्यात होंगे; है नन्दिन्! मुझे आनन्द प्रदान कीजिये, मैं आप जगदीश्वरको प्रणाम करता हूँ ॥ २६-२९१/२॥ हे विभो! आप प्रसन्न होइये। है नन्दिन्! आप महेश्वरके मेरे यहाँ अवतीर्ण होनेपर आज मेरे माता- पिता रुद्रलोक चले गये; पितामह, प्रपितामह आदि भी रुद्रलोक चले गये। है जगत्प्रभो! मेरे रक्षार्थ पुत्र
verses.wordMeaning: They were delighted and well-nourished. Through this achievement they were free from ailments. Then after the lapse of some time, they became greedy.
verses.commentary: Sense: They were delighted and well-nourished. Through this achievement they were free from ailments. Then after the lapse of some time, they became greedy.

verses.sanskrit: ता वै निष्कामचारिण्यो नित्यं मुदितमानसाः अप्रवृत्तिः कृतयुगे कर्मणोः शुभपापयोः
verses.transliteration: tā vai niṣkāmacāriṇyo nityaṃ muditamānasāḥ apravṛttiḥ kṛtayuge karmaṇoḥ śubhapāpayoḥ
verses.translation: They began to chop off the trees and take the honey forcibly. Due to their misdemeanour as well as their greed the kalpa trees perished in certain places along with honey. As time rolled on only a little of this perfection surviv- ed. As Trcta was repeated in every cycle the Dvandvas (mutually conflicting pairs) cropped up. Then the subjects became very miserable due to the chilly rain and scorching sun.
verses.hindi: रूपमे आपके अवतार लेनेपर आज संसारमें मेरा जन्म सफल हो गया। है सुरेशान! आपको नमस्कार है। हैं नन्दीश्वर! आपको नमस्कार है। है पुत्र! है महाबाहो! हे देवदेव! है जगद्गुरो ! मेरी रक्षा कीजिये। है नन्दीश! हे वत्स! आपके प्रति पुत्रभाव समझकर मैंने जो भी कहा है, उसे आप क्षमा करें। है पुत्र! जो मेरैद्वारा कहें गये इस स्तवनका भक्तिपूर्वक पाठ या श्रवण करता है अथवा द्विजोंको इसे सुनाता है, वह मेरै साथ आन
verses.wordMeaning: They began to chop off the trees and take the honey forcibly. Due to their misdemeanour as well as their greed the kalpa trees perished in certain places along with honey. As time rolled on only a little of this perfection surviv- ed.…
verses.commentary: Sense: They began to chop off the trees and take the honey forcibly. Due to their misdemeanour as well as their greed the kalpa trees perished in certain places along with honey. As time rolled on only a little of this perfection surviv- ed.…

verses.sanskrit: वर्णाश्रमव्यवस्था च तदासीन्न च संकरः रसोल्लासः कालयोगात् त्रेताख्ये नश्यते द्विज
verses.transliteration: varṇāśramavyavasthā ca tadāsīnna ca saṃkaraḥ rasollāsaḥ kālayogāt tretākhye naśyate dvija
verses.translation: When they were harassed by Dvandvas they began to make clothes and garments for covering themselves. They made abodes on the mountains in order to ward off Dvandvas.
verses.hindi: प्राप्त करता है॥ ३०३४/२ ॥ इस प्रकार बालरूप पुत्र नन्दीकी स्तुति करके अत्यन्त आदरपूर्वक उन्हें प्रणामकर उत्तम व्रत धारा
verses.wordMeaning: When they were harassed by Dvandvas they began to make clothes and garments for covering themselves. They made abodes on the mountains in order to ward off Dvandvas.
verses.commentary: Sense: When they were harassed by Dvandvas they began to make clothes and garments for covering themselves. They made abodes on the mountains in order to ward off Dvandvas.

verses.sanskrit: तस्यां सिद्धौ प्रनष्टायाम् अन्या सिद्धिः प्रजायते अपां सौक्ष्म्ये प्रतिगते तदा मेघात्मना तु वै
verses.transliteration: tasyāṃ siddhau pranaṣṭāyām anyā siddhiḥ prajāyate apāṃ saukṣmye pratigate tadā meghātmanā tu vai
verses.translation: Formerly they roamed about as they pleased. They had no fixed abodes. Now they began to stay in bouses in accordance with their availability and pleasure.
verses.hindi: वृषेन्द्रश्च महातेजा धर्मो धर्मात्मजस्तथा आवृत्य मां तथालिङ्ग्य तुष्टुवुर्मुनिसत्तम। शिलादोऽपि मुनिर्दृष्ट्वा पिता मे तादूशं तदा
verses.wordMeaning: Formerly they roamed about as they pleased. They had no fixed abodes. Now they began to stay in bouses in accordance with their availability and pleasure.
verses.commentary: Sense: Formerly they roamed about as they pleased. They had no fixed abodes. Now they began to stay in bouses in accordance with their availability and pleasure.

verses.sanskrit: मेघेभ्यस्तनयित्नुभ्यः प्रवृत्तं वृष्टिसर्जनम् सकृद् एव तथा वृष्ट्या संयुक्ते पृथिवीतले
verses.transliteration: meghebhyastanayitnubhyaḥ pravṛttaṃ vṛṣṭisarjanam sakṛd eva tathā vṛṣṭyā saṃyukte pṛthivītale
verses.translation: They had more rains than they desired or needed for production. Heavy downpour of waters flowed down the slopes.
verses.hindi: भगवन् देवदेवेश त्रियम्बक ममाव्यय रक्षको जगतां यस्मात्पिता मे पुत्र सर्वग
verses.wordMeaning: They had more rains than they desired or needed for production. Heavy downpour of waters flowed down the slopes.
verses.commentary: Sense: They had more rains than they desired or needed for production. Heavy downpour of waters flowed down the slopes.

verses.sanskrit: प्रादुरासंस्तदा तासां वृक्षास्ते गृहसंज्ञिताः सर्ववृत्त्युपभोगस्तु तासां तेभ्यः प्रजायते
verses.transliteration: prādurāsaṃstadā tāsāṃ vṛkṣāste gṛhasaṃjñitāḥ sarvavṛttyupabhogastu tāsāṃ tebhyaḥ prajāyate
verses.translation: Due to continuous rain sources of water currents arose. Thus in the course of second creation of rains, streams and rivers began to function.
verses.hindi: प्रसीद पितरौ मेऽद्य रुद्रलोकं गतौ विभो ममैव सफलं लोके जन्म वै जगतां प्रभो
verses.wordMeaning: Due to continuous rain sources of water currents arose. Thus in the course of second creation of rains, streams and rivers began to function.
verses.commentary: Sense: Due to continuous rain sources of water currents arose. Thus in the course of second creation of rains, streams and rivers began to function.

verses.sanskrit: वर्तयन्ति स्म तेभ्यस्तास् त्रेतायुगमुखे प्रजाः ततः कालेन महता तासामेव विपर्ययात्
verses.transliteration: vartayanti sma tebhyastās tretāyugamukhe prajāḥ tataḥ kālena mahatā tāsāmeva viparyayāt
verses.translation: Small collection of those waters fell on the earth. Due to the mingling of waters and the earth, plants and herbs came into being.
verses.hindi: पुत्र पाहि महाबाहो देवदेव जगद्गुरो। ुत्रत्वमेव नन्दीश मत्वा यत्कीर्तितं मया शिलादद्वारा पुत्र नन्दिकेश्वरको वेदादिकी शिक्षा प्रदान करना
verses.wordMeaning: Small collection of those waters fell on the earth. Due to the mingling of waters and the earth, plants and herbs came into being.
verses.commentary: Sense: Small collection of those waters fell on the earth. Due to the mingling of waters and the earth, plants and herbs came into being.

verses.sanskrit: रागलोभात्मको भावस् तदा ह्याकस्मिको ऽभवत् विपर्ययेण तासां तु तेन तत्कालभाविना
verses.transliteration: rāgalobhātmako bhāvas tadā hyākasmiko 'bhavat viparyayeṇa tāsāṃ tu tena tatkālabhāvinā
verses.translation: Then trees and hedges grew up. Very few of them were cultivated. They were not sown. Fourteen*® types of trees and grasses grew up in the rural and forest areas. They put forth flowers and fruits in accordance with the season. Diflferent types of trees and medicinal herbs also appeared. The subjects sustained themselves with these at that time of Treta.
verses.hindi: अफफफ का फ का फा का क फ फा क फ फा फ फ फा फा क फ फ फाम कका मी क मा फ ममी मी मी नन्दी यज्ञाङ्गणे देवश्चावतीणों यतः प्रभुः ।
verses.wordMeaning: Then trees and hedges grew up. Very few of them were cultivated. They were not sown. Fourteen*® types of trees and grasses grew up in the rural and forest areas. They put forth flowers and fruits in accordance with the season.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Then trees and hedges grew up. Very few of them were cultivated. They were not sown. Fourteen*® types of trees and grasses grew up in the rural and forest areas. They put forth flowers and fruits in accordance with the season.…

verses.sanskrit: प्रणश्यन्ति ततः सर्वे वृक्षास्ते गृहसंज्ञिताः ततस्तेषु प्रनष्टेषु विभ्रान्ता मैथुनोद्भवाः
verses.transliteration: praṇaśyanti tataḥ sarve vṛkṣāste gṛhasaṃjñitāḥ tatasteṣu pranaṣṭeṣu vibhrāntā maithunodbhavāḥ
verses.translation: Thereafter the subjects became lustful and greedy in every respect on account of what is destined to happen inevitably in Treta age.
verses.hindi: मत्समः कः पुमाँल्लोके देवो वा दानवोऽपि वा करनेवाले मुनि शिलाद मुनीश्वरोंकी ओर देखकर बोले-हे मुनिगण! आप सभी लोग मेरे महान् अक्षुण्ण भाग्यको देख लें, जो कि मेरे यज्ञांगणमें अविनाशी भगवान् महेश्वर मेरे पुत्र होकर नन्दीके रूपमें
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter the subjects became lustful and greedy in every respect on account of what is destined to happen inevitably in Treta age.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter the subjects became lustful and greedy in every respect on account of what is destined to happen inevitably in Treta age.

verses.sanskrit: अपि ध्यायन्ति तां सिद्धिं सत्याभिध्यायिनस्तदा प्रादुर्बभूवुस्तासां तु वृक्षास्ते गृहसंज्ञिताः
verses.transliteration: api dhyāyanti tāṃ siddhiṃ satyābhidhyāyinastadā prādurbabhūvustāsāṃ tu vṛkṣāste gṛhasaṃjñitāḥ
verses.translation: Then the subjects forcibly occupied the fields near the rivers and on the mountains. They seized the trees, hedges and herbs as much as they could.
verses.hindi: अवतरित हुए हैं। सम्पूर्ण जगत्में कौन मनुष्य, देवता अथवा दानव मेरे समान है; क्योंकि मेरे हितार्थ ये नन्दी एष नन्दी यतो जातो यज्ञभूमौ हिताय मे॥ ३८  मेरी यज्ञभूमिमें प्रादुर्भूत हुए हैं॥ ३५--३८॥
verses.wordMeaning: Then the subjects forcibly occupied the fields near the rivers and on the mountains. They seized the trees, hedges and herbs as much as they could.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the subjects forcibly occupied the fields near the rivers and on the mountains. They seized the trees, hedges and herbs as much as they could.

verses.sanskrit: वस्त्राणि ते प्रसूयन्ते फलान्याभरणानि च तेष्वेव जायते तासां गन्धवर्णरसान्वितम्
verses.transliteration: vastrāṇi te prasūyante phalānyābharaṇāni ca teṣveva jāyate tāsāṃ gandhavarṇarasānvitam
verses.translation: On account of this perversity the fourteen types of medicinal herbs perished. Thinking that these plants and herbs have entered the earth, Brahma milked the earth assidu- ously for the welfare of living beings. Ever since, the plants are ploughed by ploughshares here and there.
verses.hindi: शिलादद्वारा पुत्र नन्दिकेशवरको वेदादिकी शिक्षा प्रदान करना, ऋषियोंद्वारा नन्दिकेश्वरकी आयु अल्प बतानेपर शिलादका दुःखी होना तथा नन्दिकेश्वरद्वारा त्र्यम्बकमन्त्रका जप एवं महेश्वर-पार्वतीद्वारा उन्हें अपने पुत्ररूपमें अमर होनेका वरदान देना नन्दिकेश्वर उवाच
verses.wordMeaning: On account of this perversity the fourteen types of medicinal herbs perished. Thinking that these plants and herbs have entered the earth, Brahma milked the earth assidu- ously for the welfare of living beings. Ever since, the plants are ploughed by ploughshares here and there.
verses.commentary: Sense: On account of this perversity the fourteen types of medicinal herbs perished. Thinking that these plants and herbs have entered the earth, Brahma milked the earth assidu- ously for the welfare of living beings. Ever since, the plants are ploughed by ploughshares here and there.

verses.sanskrit: अमाक्षिकं महीवीर्यं पुटके पुटके मधु तेन ता वर्तयन्ति स्म सुखमायुः सदैव हि
verses.transliteration: amākṣikaṃ mahīvīryaṃ puṭake puṭake madhu tena tā vartayanti sma sukhamāyuḥ sadaiva hi
verses.translation: Those who were desirous of sustaining themselves assiduously took to agriculture. The word Varta means avocation and the avocation in this context is the endeavour and desire for agriculture.
verses.hindi: तदा वै हैविकं रूपं त्यक्त्वा मानुष्यमास्थितः नष्टा चैव स्मृतिर्दिव्या येन केनापि कारणात्। मानुष्यमास्थितं दृष्ट्वा पिता मे लोकपूजितः
verses.wordMeaning: Those who were desirous of sustaining themselves assiduously took to agriculture. The word Varta means avocation and the avocation in this context is the endeavour and desire for agriculture.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who were desirous of sustaining themselves assiduously took to agriculture. The word Varta means avocation and the avocation in this context is the endeavour and desire for agriculture.

verses.sanskrit: हृष्टपुष्टास्तया सिद्ध्या प्रजा वै विगतज्वराः ततः कालान्तरेणैव पुनर्लोभावृतास्तु ताः
verses.transliteration: hṛṣṭapuṣṭāstayā siddhyā prajā vai vigatajvarāḥ tataḥ kālāntareṇaiva punarlobhāvṛtāstu tāḥ
verses.translation: Otherwise, towards the close of Treta, the subjects have no means of livelihood. Then water has to be lifted by hand in general.
verses.hindi: जातकर्मादिकाशचैव चकार मम सर्ववित् शालङ्कायनपुत्रो वै शिलादः पुत्रवत्सलः । उपदिष्टा हि तेनैव ऋकूशाखा यजुषस्तथा
verses.wordMeaning: Otherwise, towards the close of Treta, the subjects have no means of livelihood. Then water has to be lifted by hand in general.
verses.commentary: Sense: Otherwise, towards the close of Treta, the subjects have no means of livelihood. Then water has to be lifted by hand in general.

verses.sanskrit: वृक्षांस्तान्पर्यगृह्णन्ति मधु वा माक्षिकं बलात् तासां तेनोपचारेण पुनर्लोभकृतेन वै
verses.transliteration: vṛkṣāṃstānparyagṛhṇanti madhu vā mākṣikaṃ balāt tāsāṃ tenopacāreṇa punarlobhakṛtena vai
verses.translation: In that Treta the subjects in their fury seized one another, even their sons, wives, riches etc., forcibly. Such was the characteristic of that yuga.
verses.hindi: नन्दिकेश्वर बोले--महेश्वरको प्रणाम करके पिताजी मुझको साथ लेकर प्रसन्नतापूर्वक अपनी कुटीमें लौट गये, जैसे निर्धन व्यक्ति निधि पाकर हर्षित हो जाता है, वैसे ही वे उस समय हर्षयुक्त थे हे महामुने! जब मैं शिलादकी कुटीमें गया, तब अपना हैविक (दिव्य) रूप छोड़कर मैं मनुष्यरूपमें हो गया
verses.wordMeaning: In that Treta the subjects in their fury seized one another, even their sons, wives, riches etc., forcibly. Such was the characteristic of that yuga.
verses.commentary: Sense: In that Treta the subjects in their fury seized one another, even their sons, wives, riches etc., forcibly. Such was the characteristic of that yuga.

verses.sanskrit: प्रनष्टा मधुना सार्धं कल्पवृक्षाः क्वचित्क्वचित् तस्यामेवाल्पशिष्टायां सिद्ध्यां कालवशात्तदा
verses.transliteration: pranaṣṭā madhunā sārdhaṃ kalpavṛkṣāḥ kvacitkvacit tasyāmevālpaśiṣṭāyāṃ siddhyāṃ kālavaśāttadā
verses.translation: Knowing aU this, the lotus-bom lord created K$atri- yas, to protect people from wounds and injuries and also for establishing the rules of conduct.
verses.hindi: उस समय किसी अज्ञात कारणवश मेरी दिव्य स्मृति नष्ट हो गयी। लोकपूजित मेरे पिताजीने मुझे मानवरूपमें देखकर अपने बन्धुओंसहित दुःखसे व्याकुल होकर अत्यधिक विलाप किया। पुत्रवत्सल तथा सर्वज्ञ शालंकायनपुत्र शिलादने मेरे जातकर्म आदि संस्कार
verses.wordMeaning: Knowing aU this, the lotus-bom lord created K$atri- yas, to protect people from wounds and injuries and also for establishing the rules of conduct.
verses.commentary: Sense: Knowing aU this, the lotus-bom lord created K$atri- yas, to protect people from wounds and injuries and also for establishing the rules of conduct.

verses.sanskrit: आवर्तनात्तु त्रेतायां द्वन्द्वान्यभ्युत्थितानि वै शीतवर्षातपैस्तीव्रैस् ततस्ता दुःखिता भृशम्
verses.transliteration: āvartanāttu tretāyāṃ dvandvānyabhyutthitāni vai śītavarṣātapaistīvrais tatastā duḥkhitā bhṛśam
verses.translation: Characterised by his own splendour the lord establish- ed castes and stages of life. The lord of the universe then created avocation and conduct of life for respective castes of people.
verses.hindi: हे महामुने! उन्होंने ही मुझको ऋग्वेद तथा यजुर्वेदकी शाखाओं और सामवेदकी हजार शाखाओंका धनुर्वेद, गान्धर्वविद्या, अश्वलक्षण, हाथियोंके लक्षण, मनुष्योंके लक्षण आदिको शिक्षा प्रदान को ॥ ५-६/२॥
verses.wordMeaning: Characterised by his own splendour the lord establish- ed castes and stages of life. The lord of the universe then created avocation and conduct of life for respective castes of people.
verses.commentary: Sense: Characterised by his own splendour the lord establish- ed castes and stages of life. The lord of the universe then created avocation and conduct of life for respective castes of people.

verses.sanskrit: द्वन्द्वैः सम्पीड्यमानाश् च चक्रुर् आवरणानि तु कृतद्वन्द्वप्रतीघाताः केतनानि गिरौ ततः
verses.transliteration: dvandvaiḥ sampīḍyamānāś ca cakrur āvaraṇāni tu kṛtadvandvapratīghātāḥ ketanāni girau tataḥ
verses.translation: The avocation of sacrifices was evolved in Treta gradu- ally. But persons of good holy rites did not resort to animal sacrifice even then.
verses.hindi: मेरा सातवाँ वर्ष पूर्ण होनेपर परमेश्वरकी आज्ञासे मुझे देखनेके लिये तप तथा योगशक्तिसे सम्पन्न मित्र- १९४ श्रीलिड्रमहापुराण  न नाकामा तताकाहारू” ऊचतुश्च महात्मानौ मां निरीक्ष्य मुहुर्मुहु:।  वरुण नामक दो दिव्य मुनिश्रेष्ठ उनके (मेरे पिता)
verses.wordMeaning: The avocation of sacrifices was evolved in Treta gradu- ally. But persons of good holy rites did not resort to animal sacrifice even then.
verses.commentary: Sense: The avocation of sacrifices was evolved in Treta gradu- ally. But persons of good holy rites did not resort to animal sacrifice even then.

verses.sanskrit: पूर्वं निकामचारास्ता ह्य् अनिकेता अथावसन् यथायोगं यथाप्रीति निकेतेष्ववसन्पुनः
verses.transliteration: pūrvaṃ nikāmacārāstā hy aniketā athāvasan yathāyogaṃ yathāprīti niketeṣvavasanpunaḥ
verses.translation: It was then that the seer Vi$nu performed sacrifices forcefully. That is why the brahmins praise a non-violent sacrifice.
verses.hindi: तात नन्द्ययमल्पायुः सर्वशास्त्रार्थपारगः॥ आश्रममें गये मुझको बार-बार देखकर उन दोनों महात्माओ
verses.wordMeaning: It was then that the seer Vi$nu performed sacrifices forcefully. That is why the brahmins praise a non-violent sacrifice.
verses.commentary: Sense: It was then that the seer Vi$nu performed sacrifices forcefully. That is why the brahmins praise a non-violent sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit: कृत्वा द्वन्द्वोपघातांस्तान् वृत्त्युपायमचिन्तयन् नष्टेषु मधुना सार्धं कल्पवृक्षेषु वै तदा
verses.transliteration: kṛtvā dvandvopaghātāṃstān vṛttyupāyamacintayan naṣṭeṣu madhunā sārdhaṃ kalpavṛkṣeṣu vai tadā
verses.translation: In the Dvapara too, men have different inclinations mentally, verbally and physically. It is with great difficulty that agriculture proceeds in that age.
verses.hindi: कहा-हे तात! यह नन्दी सभी शास्त्रोंके ज्ञानमें पारंगत होगा, किंतु यह अल्प आयुवाला है। ऐसा आश्चर्य ते कभी नहीं देखा गया है, इसको आयु आजसे मात्र एक वर्षकी है॥९४/२॥ उनके ऐसा कहनेपर पुत्रसे स्नेह रखनेवाले विप्रवर शिलाद मेरा आलिंगन करके दु:खसे व्याकुल होकर करुण स्वरमें अत्यधिक रुदन करने लगे-हा पुत्र! हा पुत्र! हा पुत्र! अहो, हैवविधि तथा विधाताका
verses.wordMeaning: In the Dvapara too, men have different inclinations mentally, verbally and physically. It is with great difficulty that agriculture proceeds in that age.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the Dvapara too, men have different inclinations mentally, verbally and physically. It is with great difficulty that agriculture proceeds in that age.

verses.sanskrit: विवादव्याकुलास्ता वै प्रजास्तृष्णाक्षुधार्दिताः ततः प्रादुर्बभौ तासां सिद्धिस्त्रेतायुगे पुनः
verses.transliteration: vivādavyākulāstā vai prajāstṛṣṇākṣudhārditāḥ tataḥ prādurbabhau tāsāṃ siddhistretāyuge punaḥ
verses.translation: Then all living beings exert gradually and strain their bodies. Covetousness, service on wage basis, business, fighting, indecision about principles, division of Vedas, confusion of dharmas, destruction of discipline among the four castes and stages of life, lust and hatred — these are the specifics pertain- ing to that age.
verses.hindi: ऐसा बल! यह कहकर वे दुःखित होकर भूमिप तब उनको दुःखभरी वाणी सुनकर आश्रमवासी इकट्रे हो गये। वे इस अशुभके लिये विह्वल होकर मंगल रक्षाकृत्य करने लगे। उन्होंने अन्य सभी सामग्रियोंसहित मधुलिप्त दस हजार दूर्वाकी त्रियम्बक
verses.wordMeaning: Then all living beings exert gradually and strain their bodies. Covetousness, service on wage basis, business, fighting, indecision about principles, division of Vedas, confusion of dharmas, destruction of discipline among the four castes and stages of life,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Then all living beings exert gradually and strain their bodies. Covetousness, service on wage basis, business, fighting, indecision about principles, division of Vedas, confusion of dharmas, destruction of discipline among the four castes and stages of life,…

verses.sanskrit: वार्तायाः साधिकाप्यन्या वृष्टिस्तासां निकामतः तासां वृष्ट्युदकादीनि ह्य् अभवन्निम्नगानि तु
verses.transliteration: vārtāyāḥ sādhikāpyanyā vṛṣṭistāsāṃ nikāmataḥ tāsāṃ vṛṣṭyudakādīni hy abhavannimnagāni tu
verses.translation: It is in this Dvapara that the following begin to function, viz — passion, covetousness, arrogance, etc. In the beginnings of Dvapara the Vedas are classified into four by Vyasa.
verses.hindi: बहुत विलाप किया, वे भी चेतनारहित हो मृतकी भाँति पड़े रहे मैं मृत्युसे भयभीत हो गया और साक्षात् मृतकको भाँति भूमिपर पड़े हुए अपने पिता तथा पितामहकी शीघ्रतापूर्वक सिर झुकाकर प्रणाम करके एवं उनकी प्रदक्षिणा करके रुद्रजपमें संलग्न हो गया। त्रिनेत्र, दस
verses.wordMeaning: It is in this Dvapara that the following begin to function, viz — passion, covetousness, arrogance, etc. In the beginnings of Dvapara the Vedas are classified into four by Vyasa.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is in this Dvapara that the following begin to function, viz — passion, covetousness, arrogance, etc. In the beginnings of Dvapara the Vedas are classified into four by Vyasa.

verses.sanskrit: अभवन्वृष्टिसंतत्या स्रोतस्थानानि निम्नगाः एवं नद्यः प्रवृत्तास्तु द्वितीये वृष्टिसर्जने
verses.transliteration: abhavanvṛṣṭisaṃtatyā srotasthānāni nimnagāḥ evaṃ nadyaḥ pravṛttāstu dvitīye vṛṣṭisarjane
verses.translation: It is laid down that during Treta the Vedas constituted one single whole with four sections. Since the span of life be- comes less and less the Vedas are classified in Dvfipara.
verses.hindi: भुजाओंवाले, शान्त, पाँच मुखोंवाले, सदाशिव भगवान त्रियम्बकका अपने हृदयकमलमें ध्यान करके मैं जप कर रहा था; तब मैंने देखा कि नदीके पुण्यतटपर म स्थित हूँ और अर्धचन्द्रमाको आभूषणके रूपमें धारण करनेवाले महादेव उमासहित प्रसन्न होकर प्रकट हु” और मुझसे कहने लगे--॥ १६-१८/२॥
verses.wordMeaning: It is laid down that during Treta the Vedas constituted one single whole with four sections. Since the span of life be- comes less and less the Vedas are classified in Dvfipara.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is laid down that during Treta the Vedas constituted one single whole with four sections. Since the span of life be- comes less and less the Vedas are classified in Dvfipara.

verses.sanskrit: ये पुनस्तदपां स्तोकाः पतिताः पृथिवीतले अपां भूमेश् च संयोगाद् ओषध्यस्तास्तदाभवन्
verses.transliteration: ye punastadapāṃ stokāḥ patitāḥ pṛthivītale apāṃ bhūmeś ca saṃyogād oṣadhyastāstadābhavan
verses.translation: They are further differentiated through the whims of the sons of sages, when the order of Mantra and Brahmana texts is altered and the accents and letters are changed. The compendiums of Rk Yajus and Samans are compiled by the learned men. Although the texts are common, they are differ* entiated due to different view-points.
verses.hindi: हे वत्स! है नन्दिन्! है महाबाहो! तुमी भला मृत्युसे भय कहाँ, मैंने ही उन दोनों विप्रोंको भरा अहो बलं हैवविधेर्विधातुश्चेति दुःखितः। तस्य चार्तस्वरं श्रुत्वा तदाश्रमनिवासिनः
verses.wordMeaning: They are further differentiated through the whims of the sons of sages, when the order of Mantra and Brahmana texts is altered and the accents and letters are changed. The compendiums of Rk Yajus and Samans are compiled by the learned men. Although the texts are common,…
verses.commentary: Sense: They are further differentiated through the whims of the sons of sages, when the order of Mantra and Brahmana texts is altered and the accents and letters are changed. The compendiums of Rk Yajus and Samans are compiled by the learned men. Although the texts are common,…

verses.sanskrit: अथाल्पकृष्टाश्चानुप्ता ग्राम्यारण्याश्चतुर्दश ऋतुपुष्पफलाश्चैव वृक्षगुल्माश् च जज्ञिरे
verses.transliteration: athālpakṛṣṭāścānuptā grāmyāraṇyāścaturdaśa ṛtupuṣpaphalāścaiva vṛkṣagulmāś ca jajñire
verses.translation: The different sections to the Vedas are evolved, viz.,—*
verses.hindi: तुष्टुवुश्च महादेवं त्रियम्बकमुमापतिम् हुत्वा त्रियम्बकेनैव मधुनैव च सम्प्लुताम्। दूर्वामयुतसंख्यातां सर्वद्रव्यसमन्विताम्
verses.wordMeaning: The different sections to the Vedas are evolved, viz.,—*
verses.commentary: Sense: The different sections to the Vedas are evolved, viz.,—*

verses.sanskrit: प्रादुर्भूतानि चैतानि वृक्षजात्यौषधानि च तेनौषधेन वर्तन्ते प्रजास्त्रेतायुगे तदा
verses.transliteration: prādurbhūtāni caitāni vṛkṣajātyauṣadhāni ca tenauṣadhena vartante prajāstretāyuge tadā
verses.translation: The Itihas and Puranas**® differ from time to time. They are Brahma, Padma, Vainava, Saiva, Bhagavata, Bhavi$ya, Nluadiya, Markan(jeya, Agneya, Brahmavaivarta, Laihga, Varaha, Vamana, Kurma, Matsya, Gca, Skda and Brahm&n<jUi — these are the eighteen Puraas.
verses.hindi: प्रदक्षिणीकृत्य च तं रुद्रजाप्यरतोऽभवम्। हत्पुण्डरीके सुषिरे ध्यात्वा देवं त्रियम्बकम् त्यक्षं दशभुजं शान्तं पञ्चवक्त्रं सदाशिवम्। सरितश्चान्तरे पुण्ये स्थितं मां परमेश्वरः
verses.wordMeaning: The Itihas and Puranas**® differ from time to time. They are Brahma, Padma, Vainava, Saiva, Bhagavata, Bhavi$ya, Nluadiya, Markan(jeya, Agneya, Brahmavaivarta, Laihga, Varaha, Vamana, Kurma, Matsya, Gca, Skda and Brahm&n<jUi — these are the eighteen Puraas.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Itihas and Puranas**® differ from time to time. They are Brahma, Padma, Vainava, Saiva, Bhagavata, Bhavi$ya, Nluadiya, Markan(jeya, Agneya, Brahmavaivarta, Laihga, Varaha, Vamana, Kurma, Matsya, Gca, Skda and Brahm&n<jUi — these are the eighteen Puraas.

verses.sanskrit: ततः पुनरभूत्तासां रागो लोभश् च सर्वशः अवश्यं भाविनार्थेन त्रेतायुगवशेन च
verses.transliteration: tataḥ punarabhūttāsāṃ rāgo lobhaś ca sarvaśaḥ avaśyaṃ bhāvinārthena tretāyugavaśena ca
verses.translation: The eleventh Lihga Puraxta was classified in Dvapara. The following sages, thousands in number, wrote Smrtis etc. — Manu, Atri,Vi$nu, Hwta, Yajfiavalkya, Uanas, Ahgiras, Yama, Apastamba, Samvarta, Katyayana Brhaspati,. Paraara, Vyasa, Sahkha, Likhita, Dak?a, Gautama, Satatapa, Vasitha and others.
verses.hindi: तष्टोऽब्रवीन्महादेवः सोमः सोमार्धभूषणः । वत्स नन्दिन् महाबाहो मृत्योभीतिः कुतस्तव अध्याय ४३ शिलादद्वारा पुत्र नन्दिकेश्वरको वेदादिकी शिक्षा प्रदान करना १९५
verses.wordMeaning: The eleventh Lihga Puraxta was classified in Dvapara. The following sages, thousands in number, wrote Smrtis etc. — Manu, Atri,Vi$nu, Hwta, Yajfiavalkya, Uanas, Ahgiras, Yama, Apastamba, Samvarta, Katyayana Brhaspati,. Paraara, Vyasa, Sahkha, Likhita, Dak?a, Gautama, Satatapa,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The eleventh Lihga Puraxta was classified in Dvapara. The following sages, thousands in number, wrote Smrtis etc. — Manu, Atri,Vi$nu, Hwta, Yajfiavalkya, Uanas, Ahgiras, Yama, Apastamba, Samvarta, Katyayana Brhaspati,. Paraara, Vyasa, Sahkha, Likhita, Dak?a, Gautama, Satatapa,…

verses.sanskrit: ततस्ताः पर्यगृह्णन्त नदीक्षेत्राणि पर्वतान् वृक्षगुल्मौषधीश्चैव प्रसह्य तु यथाबलम्
verses.transliteration: tatastāḥ paryagṛhṇanta nadīkṣetrāṇi parvatān vṛkṣagulmauṣadhīścaiva prasahya tu yathābalam
verses.translation: Absence of rain, death, the harassments of pestilence etc. occur. Indifference to worldly affairs results from various miseries, mental, verbal and physical. From this indifference they begin to think about their liberation from pain and misery. This process of thinking leads to detachment and from deUchment they begin to realize the deformities and defects in the world. Thanks to this perception, perfect know- ledge becomes possible in Dvapara. This is due to the behavi- our of mixed rajas and tamas. In the first yuga viz. Krta yuga dharma originates. In Treta it begins to function. In Dvapara it becomes distracted gradually and in Kali it perishes altogether.
verses.hindi: हैविकं १ प हिलिभििजिजम मकज झमभभभकभभभभककमककककझभझझफझझझभभझककझझभझभ फक जकमी नास्त्येव हैविकं दृष्टं हक
verses.wordMeaning: Absence of rain, death, the harassments of pestilence etc. occur. Indifference to worldly affairs results from various miseries, mental, verbal and physical. From this indifference they begin to think about their liberation from pain and misery.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Absence of rain, death, the harassments of pestilence etc. occur. Indifference to worldly affairs results from various miseries, mental, verbal and physical. From this indifference they begin to think about their liberation from pain and misery.…

verses.sanskrit: विपर्ययेण चौषध्यः प्रनष्टास्ताश्चतुर्दश मत्वा धरां प्रविष्टास्ता इत्यौषध्यः पितामहः
verses.transliteration: viparyayeṇa cauṣadhyaḥ pranaṣṭāstāścaturdaśa matvā dharāṃ praviṣṭāstā ityauṣadhyaḥ pitāmahaḥ

verses.sanskrit: दुदोह गां प्रयत्नेन सर्वभूतहिताय वै तदाप्रभृति चौषध्यः फालकृष्टास्त्वितस्ततः
verses.transliteration: dudoha gāṃ prayatnena sarvabhūtahitāya vai tadāprabhṛti cauṣadhyaḥ phālakṛṣṭāstvitastataḥ
verses.translation: On the authenticity, extent tuid number of the Purftas, see In- troduction.
verses.hindi: था। है नन्दिकेश्वर! संसारका यह स्वभाव है कि सुख- कराभ्यां सुशुभाभ्यां च उभाभ्यां परमेश्वर: ।
