verses.commentary: Sense: On the authenticity, extent tuid number of the Purftas, see In- troduction.

verses.sanskrit: वार्तां कृषिं समायाता वर्तुकामाः प्रयत्नतः वार्ता वृत्तिः समाख्याता कृषिकामप्रयत्नतः
verses.transliteration: vārtāṃ kṛṣiṃ samāyātā vartukāmāḥ prayatnataḥ vārtā vṛttiḥ samākhyātā kṛṣikāmaprayatnataḥ
verses.translation: On the authenticity, extent tuid number of the Purftas, see In- troduction.
verses.hindi: पस्पर्श भगवान् रुद्रः परमार्तिहरो हरः॥ २४  दुःख बार-बार आते रहते हैं । मनुष्योंके लिये स्त्रीभोगका उवाच च महादेवस्तुष्टात्मा वृषभध्वज:। परित्याग ही सर्वथा उचित है--ऐसा विवेकी पुरुष कहते हैं ॥ १९-२२/२॥ निरीक्ष्य गणपांश्चैव देवीं हिमवतः सुताम्
verses.wordMeaning: On the authenticity, extent tuid number of the Purftas, see In- troduction.
verses.commentary: Sense: On the authenticity, extent tuid number of the Purftas, see In- troduction.

verses.sanskrit: अन्यथा जीवितं तासां नास्ति त्रेतायुगात्यये हस्तोद्भवा ह्यपश्चैव भवन्ति बहुशस्तदा
verses.transliteration: anyathā jīvitaṃ tāsāṃ nāsti tretāyugātyaye hastodbhavā hyapaścaiva bhavanti bahuśastadā
verses.translation: On the authenticity, extent tuid number of the Purftas, see In- troduction.
verses.hindi: समालोक्य च तुष्टात्मा महादेवः सुरेश्वरः। काकी नित्यं ऐसा कहकर महान् कष्टोंको दूर करनेवाले, अक्षयश्चाव्ययश्चैव सपिता ससुहज्जनः। सभी देवताओंके महेश्वर, भगवान् रुद्र, हर, वृषभध्वज तथा परमेश्वर महादेवने अपने दोनों अत्यन्त शुभ हाथोंसे मुझे स्पर्श किया और उनका मन प्रसन्न हो
verses.wordMeaning: On the authenticity, extent tuid number of the Purftas, see In- troduction.
verses.commentary: Sense: On the authenticity, extent tuid number of the Purftas, see In- troduction.

verses.sanskrit: तत्रापि जगृहुः सर्वे चान्योन्यं क्रोधमूर्छिताः सुतदारधनाद्यांस्तु बलाद्युगबलेन तु
verses.transliteration: tatrāpi jagṛhuḥ sarve cānyonyaṃ krodhamūrchitāḥ sutadāradhanādyāṃstu balādyugabalena tu
verses.translation: On the authenticity, extent tuid number of the Purftas, see In- troduction.
verses.hindi: गया। तदनन्तर गणेश्वरोंको एवं हिमालयपुत्री पार्वतीको भलीभाँति देखकर वे सुरेश्वर महादेव प्रसन्नचित्त होकर मेरी ओर देखकर कहने लगे-॥ २३-२५/२॥
verses.wordMeaning: On the authenticity, extent tuid number of the Purftas, see In- troduction.
verses.commentary: Sense: On the authenticity, extent tuid number of the Purftas, see In- troduction.

verses.sanskrit: मर्यादायाः प्रतिष्ठार्थं ज्ञात्वा तदखिलं विभुः ससर्ज क्षत्रियांस्त्रातुं क्षतात्कमलसंभवः
verses.transliteration: maryādāyāḥ pratiṣṭhārthaṃ jñātvā tadakhilaṃ vibhuḥ sasarja kṣatriyāṃstrātuṃ kṣatātkamalasaṃbhavaḥ
verses.translation: On the authenticity, extent tuid number of the Purftas, see In- troduction.
verses.hindi: एवमुक्त्वा च मां देवो भगवान् सगणस्तदा। कुशेशयमयीं मालां समुन्मुच्यात्मनस्तदा अमर, बुढ़ापारहित, दुःखसे हीन, क्षयरहित एवं अव्यय
verses.wordMeaning: On the authenticity, extent tuid number of the Purftas, see In- troduction.
verses.commentary: Sense: On the authenticity, extent tuid number of the Purftas, see In- troduction.

verses.sanskrit: वर्णाश्रमप्रतिष्ठां च चकार स्वेन तेजसा वृत्तेन वृत्तिना वृत्तं विश्वात्मा निर्ममे स्वयम्
verses.transliteration: varṇāśramapratiṣṭhāṃ ca cakāra svena tejasā vṛttena vṛttinā vṛttaṃ viśvātmā nirmame svayam
verses.translation: On the authenticity, extent tuid number of the Purftas, see In- troduction.
verses.hindi: आबबन्ध महातेजा मम देवो वृषध्वजः। तयाहं मालया जातः शुभया कण्ठसक्तया बनकर सदा मेरे समीप विराजमान रहोगे। तुम मेरे सदृश बलशाली एवं महान् योगबलसे सम्पन्न होओगे
verses.wordMeaning: On the authenticity, extent tuid number of the Purftas, see In- troduction.
verses.commentary: Sense: On the authenticity, extent tuid number of the Purftas, see In- troduction.

verses.sanskrit: यज्ञप्रवर्तनं चैव त्रेतायामभवत्क्रमात् पशुयज्ञं न सेवन्ते केचित्तत्रापि सुव्रताः
verses.transliteration: yajñapravartanaṃ caiva tretāyāmabhavatkramāt paśuyajñaṃ na sevante kecittatrāpi suvratāḥ
verses.translation: On the authenticity, extent tuid number of the Purftas, see In- troduction.
verses.hindi: मुझसे ऐसा कहकर गणोंसहित महातेजस्वी बृषध्वज भगवान् महादेवने कुशेशयमयी अर्थात् शतदलकमलसे निर्मित अपनी माला उतारकर मेरे कण्ठमें बाँध दी। कण्ठमें बँधी हुई उस सुन्दर मालासे मैं तीन नेत्रोंवाले तथा दस भुजाओंवाले दूसरे शंकरके
verses.wordMeaning: On the authenticity, extent tuid number of the Purftas, see In- troduction.
verses.commentary: Sense: On the authenticity, extent tuid number of the Purftas, see In- troduction.

verses.sanskrit: बलाद्विष्णुस्तदा यज्ञम् अकरोत्सर्वदृक् क्रमात् द्विजास्तदा प्रशंसन्ति ततस्त्वाहिंसकं मुने
verses.transliteration: balādviṣṇustadā yajñam akarotsarvadṛk kramāt dvijāstadā praśaṃsanti tatastvāhiṃsakaṃ mune
verses.translation: On the authenticity, extent tuid number of the Purftas, see In- troduction.
verses.hindi: तत्पश्चात् परमेश्वरने मुझको हाथसे पकड़कर कहा-बोलो, मैं तुम्हें कौन-सा उत्तम वर प्रदान करूँ ? तब उन वृषध्वजने अपनी जटामें समाहित अति निर्मल त्र्यक्षो दशभुजश्चैव द्वितीय इव शङ्करः । तत एव समादाय हस्तेन परमेश्वरः
verses.wordMeaning: On the authenticity, extent tuid number of the Purftas, see In- troduction.
verses.commentary: Sense: On the authenticity, extent tuid number of the Purftas, see In- troduction.

verses.sanskrit: द्वापरेष्वपि वर्तन्ते मतिभेदास्तदा नृणाम् मनसा कर्मणा वाचा कृच्छ्राद्वार्ता प्रसिध्यति
verses.transliteration: dvāpareṣvapi vartante matibhedāstadā nṛṇām manasā karmaṇā vācā kṛcchrādvārtā prasidhyati
verses.translation: On the authenticity, extent tuid number of the Purftas, see In- troduction.
verses.hindi: का मम फफफफफफ फा फाफा फा फाफफ फो फ्रक फफफफफफफफफाफफफीफाफ फी पापी फफफफफ फा फा फा फफ फी फी फी फीफीफफ फक माफमफफफफफफफफफफफफ फफ कक तामाह च महादेवो नदीं परमशोभनाम्
verses.wordMeaning: On the authenticity, extent tuid number of the Purftas, see In- troduction.
verses.commentary: Sense: On the authenticity, extent tuid number of the Purftas, see In- troduction.

verses.sanskrit: तदा तु सर्वभूतानां कायक्लेशवशात्क्रमात् लोभो भृतिर्वणिग्युद्धं तत्त्वानामविनिश्चयः
verses.transliteration: tadā tu sarvabhūtānāṃ kāyakleśavaśātkramāt lobho bhṛtirvaṇigyuddhaṃ tattvānāmaviniścayaḥ
verses.translation: On the authenticity, extent tuid number of the Purftas, see In- troduction.
verses.hindi: यस्माजटोदकादेव प्रवृत्ता त्वं महानदी। तस्माजटोदका पुण्या भविष्यसि सरिद्वरा जलको हाथमें लेकर कहा--नदी हो जाओ--ऐस कहकर उन्होंने जलको छोड़ दिया। तब दिव्य जलवाली
verses.wordMeaning: On the authenticity, extent tuid number of the Purftas, see In- troduction.
verses.commentary: Sense: On the authenticity, extent tuid number of the Purftas, see In- troduction.

verses.sanskrit: वेदशाखाप्रणयनं धर्माणां संकरस् तथा वर्णाश्रमपरिध्वंसः कामद्वेषौ तथैव च
verses.transliteration: vedaśākhāpraṇayanaṃ dharmāṇāṃ saṃkaras tathā varṇāśramaparidhvaṃsaḥ kāmadveṣau tathaiva ca
verses.translation: On the authenticity, extent tuid number of the Purftas, see In- troduction.
verses.hindi: श्याम जलसे परिपूर्ण, कमल तथा उत्पलके वनोंसे तदनन्तर महादेवने उस परम सुन्दर नदीसे कहा चूँकि तुम जटाके जलसे महानदीके रूपमें निकली हे अतः तुम्हारा नाम जटोदका होगा । तुम पवित्र तथा नदिय श्रेष्ठ होओगी । कोई भी मनुष्य तुम्हारे जलमें स्नान करके
verses.wordMeaning: On the authenticity, extent tuid number of the Purftas, see In- troduction.
verses.commentary: Sense: On the authenticity, extent tuid number of the Purftas, see In- troduction.

verses.sanskrit: द्वापरे तु प्रवर्तन्ते रागो लोभो मदस् तथा वेदो व्यासैश्चतुर्धा तु व्यस्यते द्वापरादिषु
verses.transliteration: dvāpare tu pravartante rāgo lobho madas tathā vedo vyāsaiścaturdhā tu vyasyate dvāparādiṣu
verses.translation: On the authenticity, extent tuid number of the Purftas, see In- troduction.
verses.hindi: सभी पापोंसे मुक्त हो जायगा॥ ३४-३५ /२॥ तत्पश्चात् प्रभु महादेवने “यह तुम्हारा पुत्र है! ऐसा कहकर मुझ शिलादतनयको देवी पार्वतीके चरणमै डाल दिया। तब उन्होंने मेरा सिर सूँघकर दोनों हाथोसे मुझे स्नेहपूर्वक सहलाते हुए पुन: देवदेव शंकरकी
verses.wordMeaning: On the authenticity, extent tuid number of the Purftas, see In- troduction.
verses.commentary: Sense: On the authenticity, extent tuid number of the Purftas, see In- troduction.

verses.sanskrit: एको वेदश्चतुष्पादस् त्रेतास्विह विधीयते संक्षयादायुषश्चैव व्यस्यते द्वापरेषु सः
verses.transliteration: eko vedaścatuṣpādas tretāsviha vidhīyate saṃkṣayādāyuṣaścaiva vyasyate dvāpareṣu saḥ
verses.translation: On the authenticity, extent tuid number of the Purftas, see In- troduction.
verses.hindi: ओर देखकर पुत्रप्रेममें तीन पुत्ररूप स्रोतोंके द्वारा शंखके समान श्वेतवर्णाले जलरूप अश्रुबिन्दुओसे मुझे अभिसिंचित कर दिया। इनके वे ही तीनों स्रोत तीन नदियाँ बन गयीं। भगवान् भव महादेवने इसे त्रित्रोतस् (तीन धाराओंवाली) नदीकी संज्ञा प्रदान कौ
verses.wordMeaning: On the authenticity, extent tuid number of the Purftas, see In- troduction.
verses.commentary: Sense: On the authenticity, extent tuid number of the Purftas, see In- troduction.

verses.sanskrit: ऋषिपुत्रैः पुनर्भेदा भिद्यन्ते दृष्टिविभ्रमैः मन्त्रब्राह्मणविन्यासैः स्वरवर्णविपर्ययैः
verses.transliteration: ṛṣiputraiḥ punarbhedā bhidyante dṛṣṭivibhramaiḥ mantrabrāhmaṇavinyāsaiḥ svaravarṇaviparyayaiḥ
verses.translation: On the authenticity, extent tuid number of the Purftas, see In- troduction.
verses.hindi: उस त्रिख्रोतस् नदीको देखकर वृषने अत्यन्त प्रसन्न होकर नाद किया, तब उस ध्वनिसे एक दूसरी नदी आविर्भूत हो गयी। देवदेव शंकरने उस नदीका नाम इसके बाद भगवान् वृषध्वजने विश्वकमकि द्वारा निर्मित, स्वर्णमय, सभी रत्नोंसे जटित, अलौकिक, शुभ, अद्भुत तथा दिव्य अपने मुकुटको मेरे सिरपर बाँध दिया। उन महेश्वर महादेवने हीरे तथा वैदूर्यमणिसे
verses.wordMeaning: On the authenticity, extent tuid number of the Purftas, see In- troduction.
verses.commentary: Sense: On the authenticity, extent tuid number of the Purftas, see In- troduction.

verses.sanskrit: संहिता ऋग्यजुःसाम्नां संहन्यन्ते मनीषिभिः सामान्या वैकृताश्चैव द्रष्टृभिस्तैः पृथक्पृथक्
verses.transliteration: saṃhitā ṛgyajuḥsāmnāṃ saṃhanyante manīṣibhiḥ sāmānyā vaikṛtāścaiva draṣṭṛbhistaiḥ pṛthakpṛthak
verses.translation: On the authenticity, extent tuid number of the Purftas, see In- troduction.
verses.hindi: मण्डित दो शुभ तथा दिव्य कुण्डल मेरे कानोंमें स्वय हे मुने! मुझको इस प्रकार पूजित देखकर सूर्यने आकाशमें मेघोंके जलसे मुझ नन्दीका अभिसेचन किया। तब उस अभिषेकके जलसे सोनेकी नदी बत गयी। उस स्वर्णजलसे निकलकर यह नदी
verses.wordMeaning: On the authenticity, extent tuid number of the Purftas, see In- troduction.
verses.commentary: Sense: On the authenticity, extent tuid number of the Purftas, see In- troduction.

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणं कल्पसूत्राणि मन्त्रप्रवचनानि च अन्ये तु प्रस्थितास्तान्वै केचित्तान्प्रत्यवस्थिताः
verses.transliteration: brāhmaṇaṃ kalpasūtrāṇi mantrapravacanāni ca anye tu prasthitāstānvai kecittānpratyavasthitāḥ
verses.translation: On the authenticity, extent tuid number of the Purftas, see In- troduction.
verses.hindi: इसलिये देवोंके देव त्रियम्बक शिवने उसे स्व्णोदका (स्वर्ण जलवाली) कहा। उसी प्रकार सौनेके मुकुटसे त्वयि स्नात्वा नरः कश्चित्सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते। ततो देव्या महादेवः शिलादतनयं प्रभुः
verses.wordMeaning: On the authenticity, extent tuid number of the Purftas, see In- troduction.
verses.commentary: Sense: On the authenticity, extent tuid number of the Purftas, see In- troduction.

verses.sanskrit: इतिहासपुराणानि भिद्यन्ते कालगौरवात् ब्राह्मं पाद्मं वैष्णवं च शैवं भागवतं तथा
verses.transliteration: itihāsapurāṇāni bhidyante kālagauravāt brāhmaṃ pādmaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ ca śaivaṃ bhāgavataṃ tathā
verses.translation: On the authenticity, extent tuid number of the Purftas, see In- troduction.
verses.hindi: पयसा शङ्खगौरेण देवदेवं निरीक्ष्य सा नदीं त्रिस्त्रोतसं देवो भगवानवदद्भवः
verses.wordMeaning: On the authenticity, extent tuid number of the Purftas, see In- troduction.
verses.commentary: Sense: On the authenticity, extent tuid number of the Purftas, see In- troduction.

verses.sanskrit: भविष्यं नारदीयं च मार्कण्डेयमतः परम् आग्नेयं ब्रह्मवैवर्तं लैङ्गं वाराहमेव च
verses.transliteration: bhaviṣyaṃ nāradīyaṃ ca mārkaṇḍeyamataḥ param āgneyaṃ brahmavaivartaṃ laiṅgaṃ vārāhameva ca
verses.translation: On the authenticity, extent tuid number of the Purftas, see In- troduction.
verses.hindi: वृषध्वनिरिति ख्याता देवदेवेन सा नदी। जाम्बूनदमयं चित्रं सर्वरलमयं शुभम् स्वं देवश्चाद्भुतं दिव्यं निर्मितं विश्वकर्मणा। मुकुटं चाबबन्धेशो मम मूर्ध्नि वृषध्वजः
verses.wordMeaning: On the authenticity, extent tuid number of the Purftas, see In- troduction.
verses.commentary: Sense: On the authenticity, extent tuid number of the Purftas, see In- troduction.

verses.sanskrit: वामनाख्यं ततः कूर्मं मात्स्यं गारुडमेव च स्कान्दं तथा च ब्रह्माण्डं तेषां भेदः प्रकथ्यते
verses.transliteration: vāmanākhyaṃ tataḥ kūrmaṃ mātsyaṃ gāruḍameva ca skāndaṃ tathā ca brahmāṇḍaṃ teṣāṃ bhedaḥ prakathyate
verses.translation: On the authenticity, extent tuid number of the Purftas, see In- troduction.
verses.hindi: आबबन्ध महादेवः स्वयमेव महेश्वर: मां तथाभ्यचितं व्योम्नि दृष्ट्वा मेधैः प्रभाकरः । मेघाम्भसा चाभ्यषिञ्चच्छिलादनमथो मुने
verses.wordMeaning: On the authenticity, extent tuid number of the Purftas, see In- troduction.
verses.commentary: Sense: On the authenticity, extent tuid number of the Purftas, see In- troduction.

verses.sanskrit: लैङ्गम् एकादशविधं प्रभिन्नं द्वापरे शुभम् मन्वत्रिविष्णुहारीतयाज्ञवल्क्योशनो ऽङ्गिराः
verses.transliteration: laiṅgam ekādaśavidhaṃ prabhinnaṃ dvāpare śubham manvatriviṣṇuhārītayājñavalkyośano 'ṅgirāḥ
verses.translation: On the authenticity, extent tuid number of the Purftas, see In- troduction.
verses.hindi: स्वणोंदकेति तामाह देवदेवस्त्रियम्बक: । जाम्बूनदमयाद्यस्माद् द्वितीया मुकुटाच्छुभा भगवान् शिवद्वारा नन्दिकेश्वरको गणोंके अधिपतिके रूपमें प्रतिष्ठित करना
verses.wordMeaning: On the authenticity, extent tuid number of the Purftas, see In- troduction.
verses.commentary: Sense: On the authenticity, extent tuid number of the Purftas, see In- troduction.

verses.sanskrit: यमापस्तम्बसंवर्ताः कात्यायनबृहस्पती पराशरव्यासशङ्खलिखिता दक्षगौतमौ
verses.transliteration: yamāpastambasaṃvartāḥ kātyāyanabṛhaspatī parāśaravyāsaśaṅkhalikhitā dakṣagautamau
verses.translation: On the authenticity, extent tuid number of the Purftas, see In- troduction.
verses.hindi: अथ देवो महादेवः सर्वभूतपतिर्भवः। देवीमुवाच शर्वाणीमुमां गिरिसुतामजाम् देवि नन्दीश्वरं देवमभिषिञ्चामि भूतपम्। गणेन्द्रं व्याहरिष्यामि किं वा त्वं मन्यसेऽव्यये
verses.wordMeaning: On the authenticity, extent tuid number of the Purftas, see In- troduction.
verses.commentary: Sense: On the authenticity, extent tuid number of the Purftas, see In- troduction.

verses.sanskrit: शातातपो वसिष्ठश् च एवमाद्यैः सहस्रशः अवृष्टिर्मरणं चैव तथा व्याध्याद्युपद्रवाः
verses.transliteration: śātātapo vasiṣṭhaś ca evamādyaiḥ sahasraśaḥ avṛṣṭirmaraṇaṃ caiva tathā vyādhyādyupadravāḥ
verses.translation: On the authenticity, extent tuid number of the Purftas, see In- troduction.
verses.hindi: सर्वलोकाधिपत्यं च गणेशत्वं तथैव च। दातुमर्हसि देवेश शैलादिस्तनयो मम ततः स भगवान् शर्वः सर्वलोकेश्वरेश्वरः। सस्मार गणपान् दिव्यान् देवदेवो वृषध्वजः
verses.wordMeaning: On the authenticity, extent tuid number of the Purftas, see In- troduction.
verses.commentary: Sense: On the authenticity, extent tuid number of the Purftas, see In- troduction.

verses.sanskrit: वाङ्मनःकर्मजैर् दुःखैर् निर्वेदो जायते ततः निर्वेदाज्जायते तेषां दुःखमोक्षविचारणा
verses.transliteration: vāṅmanaḥkarmajair duḥkhair nirvedo jāyate tataḥ nirvedājjāyate teṣāṃ duḥkhamokṣavicāraṇā
verses.translation: On the authenticity, extent tuid number of the Purftas, see In- troduction.
verses.hindi: दूसरी पवित्र तथा शुभ नदी उत्पन्न हुई, अतः उसे जाम्बूनदी कहा जाता है। इस प्रकार ये पाँच नदियाँ भगवान् जप्येशवरके समीप जानेवाली हैं । जो पंचनदपर पहुँचकर इसमें स्नान करके भगवान् जप्येश्वरेश्वरकी पूजा करता है, वह शिवसायुज्य प्राप्त करता है; इसमें सन्देह नहीं है ॥ ४४--४८॥
verses.wordMeaning: On the authenticity, extent tuid number of the Purftas, see In- troduction.
verses.commentary: Sense: On the authenticity, extent tuid number of the Purftas, see In- troduction.

verses.sanskrit: विचारणाच्च वैराग्यं वैराग्याद्दोषदर्शनम् दोषाणां दर्शनाच्चैव द्वापरे ज्ञानसंभवः
verses.transliteration: vicāraṇācca vairāgyaṃ vairāgyāddoṣadarśanam doṣāṇāṃ darśanāccaiva dvāpare jñānasaṃbhavaḥ
verses.translation: On the authenticity, extent tuid number of the Purftas, see In- troduction.
verses.hindi: इसके बाद सभी भूतोंके स्वामी भगवान् महादेवने हिमालयपुत्री, अजन्मा, शर्वाणी, उमा देवीसे कहा-हे देवि! मैं भूतोंके स्वामी देव नन्दीश्वरका अभिषेचन करता हूँ और उन्हें गणेन्द्र नामवाला कहूँगा, है अव्यये! इस विषयमें तुम क्या सोचती हो ?
verses.wordMeaning: On the authenticity, extent tuid number of the Purftas, see In- troduction.
verses.commentary: Sense: On the authenticity, extent tuid number of the Purftas, see In- troduction.

verses.sanskrit: एषा रजस्तमोयुक्ता वृत्तिर् वै द्वापरे स्मृता आद्ये कृते तु धर्मो ऽस्ति स त्रेतायां प्रवर्तते
verses.transliteration: eṣā rajastamoyuktā vṛttir vai dvāpare smṛtā ādye kṛte tu dharmo 'sti sa tretāyāṃ pravartate
verses.translation: On the authenticity, extent tuid number of the Purftas, see In- troduction.
verses.hindi: उनका यह वचन सुनकर हर्षयुक्त मुखवाली भवानीने वर प्रदान करनेवाले तथा भूतोंके स्वामी अपने पति शिवसे मुसकराते हुए इस प्रकार कहा- है देवेश! शैलादि मेरा पुत्र है, अतः आप इसे सभी लोकोंका स्वामित्व और गणेशत्व प्रदान करनेकी कृपा कीजिये
verses.wordMeaning: On the authenticity, extent tuid number of the Purftas, see In- troduction.
verses.commentary: Sense: On the authenticity, extent tuid number of the Purftas, see In- troduction.

verses.sanskrit: द्वापरे व्याकुलीभूत्वा प्रणश्यति कलौ युगे
verses.transliteration: dvāpare vyākulībhūtvā praṇaśyati kalau yuge
verses.translation: On the authenticity, extent tuid number of the Purftas, see In- troduction.
verses.hindi: तत्पश्चात् सभी लोकेश्वरोंके भी ईश्वर, देवोंके देव, शर्व, भगवान् वृषध्वजने अपने दिव्य गणेश्वरोंका स्मरण किया नामक तैंतालीसवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ
verses.wordMeaning: On the authenticity, extent tuid number of the Purftas, see In- troduction.
verses.commentary: Sense: On the authenticity, extent tuid number of the Purftas, see In- troduction.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीलिङ्गमहापुराणे पूर्वभागे एकोनचत्वारिंशो ऽध्यायः तिष्ये मायामसूयां च वधं चैव तपस्विनाम् साधयन्ति नरास्तत्र तमसा व्याकुलेन्द्रियाः
verses.transliteration: iti śrīliṅgamahāpurāṇe pūrvabhāge ekonacatvāriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ tiṣye māyāmasūyāṃ ca vadhaṃ caiva tapasvinām sādhayanti narāstatra tamasā vyākulendriyāḥ
verses.translation: In Kali age there is always carelessness illness, hunger, fear, and terrible suffering from drought. There is also opposi- tion from and among the different parts of the country.
verses.hindi: भगवान् शिवद्वारा नन्दिकेशवरको गणोंके अधिपतिके रूपमें प्रतिष्ठित करना एवं सभी देवोंके द्वारा नन्दिकेश्वरका अभिषेक तथा शिवनाममन्त्रको महिमा स्मरणादेव रुद्रस्य सम्प्राप्ताशच गणेश्वरा:।
verses.wordMeaning: In Kali age there is always carelessness illness, hunger, fear, and terrible suffering from drought. There is also opposi- tion from and among the different parts of the country.
verses.commentary: Sense: In Kali age there is always carelessness illness, hunger, fear, and terrible suffering from drought. There is also opposi- tion from and among the different parts of the country.

verses.sanskrit: कलौ प्रमादको रोगः सततं क्षुद्भयानि च अनावृष्टिभयं घोरं देशानां च विपर्ययः
verses.transliteration: kalau pramādako rogaḥ satataṃ kṣudbhayāni ca anāvṛṣṭibhayaṃ ghoraṃ deśānāṃ ca viparyayaḥ
verses.translation: Sruti (i. c. Vedas) is not considered an authority. Men resort to sinful activity. People are sinful, irritable and narrow- minded. They misbehave.
verses.hindi: कोटिकालाग्निसङ्काशा जटामुकुटधारिणः दंष्ट्राकरालवदना नित्या बुद्धाश्च निर्मलाः। कोटिकोटिगणैसतुल्यैरात्मना च गणेश्वराः । असंख्याता महात्मानस्तत्राजमपुर्मुदा सुताः
verses.wordMeaning: Sruti (i. c. Vedas) is not considered an authority. Men resort to sinful activity. People are sinful, irritable and narrow- minded. They misbehave.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sruti (i. c. Vedas) is not considered an authority. Men resort to sinful activity. People are sinful, irritable and narrow- minded. They misbehave.

verses.sanskrit: न प्रामाण्यं श्रुतेरस्ति नृणां चाधर्मसेवनम् अधार्मिकास्त्वनाचारा महाकोपाल्पचेतसः
verses.transliteration: na prāmāṇyaṃ śruterasti nṛṇāṃ cādharmasevanam adhārmikāstvanācārā mahākopālpacetasaḥ
verses.translation: Greedy and wicked subjects, born in Kali utter false- hood. They are engaged in evil desires, evil study, misbehaviour and misleading scriptural texts.
verses.hindi: शैलादि बोले--रुद्रके स्मरण करते ही गणेश्वर लोग उपस्थित हो गये। उन सभीको हजार-हजार भुजाएँ थीं, उन्होंने हाथोंमें हजार अस्त्र धारण कर रखे थे, उनके तीन नेत्र थे, वे महान् गण देवताओंसे वन्दित हो रहे थे, वे करोड़ों कालाग्निके समान थे, वे जटामुकुट धारण किये हुए थे, दाढ़ोंके कारण वे विकराल मुखवाले थे, वे शाश्वत, शुद्ध तथा प्रबुद्ध थे, वे अपने ही समान करोड़ों-करोड़ों अनुचरे युक्त थे-ऐसे असंख्य महात्मा गणेश्वर प्रसन्नताके
verses.wordMeaning: Greedy and wicked subjects, born in Kali utter false- hood. They are engaged in evil desires, evil study, misbehaviour and misleading scriptural texts.
verses.commentary: Sense: Greedy and wicked subjects, born in Kali utter false- hood. They are engaged in evil desires, evil study, misbehaviour and misleading scriptural texts.

verses.sanskrit: अनृतं ब्रुवते लुब्धास् तिष्ये जाताश् च दुष्प्रजाः दुरिष्टैर्दुरधीतैश् च दुराचारैर्दुरागमैः
verses.transliteration: anṛtaṃ bruvate lubdhās tiṣye jātāś ca duṣprajāḥ duriṣṭairduradhītaiś ca durācārairdurāgamaiḥ
verses.translation: Due to defects in the activities of the brahmins fear arises in the subjects. The twice-bom neglect the study of Vedas and do not sacrifice as prescribed.
verses.hindi: भेरीमृदङ्गकाद्यैशच पणवानकगोमुखैः। वदित्रैर्विविधैश्चान्यैः पटहैरेकपुष्करैः भेरीमुरजसंनाहैराडम्बरकडिण्डिमैः  मर्दलैर्वेणुवीणाभिर्विविधैस्तालनिःस्वनैः
verses.wordMeaning: Due to defects in the activities of the brahmins fear arises in the subjects. The twice-bom neglect the study of Vedas and do not sacrifice as prescribed.
verses.commentary: Sense: Due to defects in the activities of the brahmins fear arises in the subjects. The twice-bom neglect the study of Vedas and do not sacrifice as prescribed.

verses.sanskrit: विप्राणां कर्म दोषेण प्रजानां जायते भयम् नाधीयन्ते तदा वेदान् न यजन्ति द्विजातयः
verses.transliteration: viprāṇāṃ karma doṣeṇa prajānāṃ jāyate bhayam nādhīyante tadā vedān na yajanti dvijātayaḥ
verses.translation: Men perish. Ksatriyas and Vaisyas decline gradually. In Kali Sudras claim kinship with brahmins through their learning through interdining and sharing scats and beds. Kings become mostly. Sudras and they harass brahmins.
verses.hindi: वाह्यमानैर्महायोगा आजम्मुर्देवसंसदम् ते गणेशा महासत्त्वाः सर्वदेवेश्वरेश्वराः। प्रणम्य देवं देवीं च इदं वचनमब्रुवन्॥ भगवन् देवदेवेश त्रियम्बक वृषध्वज। किमर्थ च स्मृता देव आज्ञापय महाद्युते
verses.wordMeaning: Men perish. Ksatriyas and Vaisyas decline gradually. In Kali Sudras claim kinship with brahmins through their learning through interdining and sharing scats and beds. Kings become mostly. Sudras and they harass brahmins.
verses.commentary: Sense: Men perish. Ksatriyas and Vaisyas decline gradually. In Kali Sudras claim kinship with brahmins through their learning through interdining and sharing scats and beds. Kings become mostly. Sudras and they harass brahmins.

verses.sanskrit: उत्सीदन्ति नराश्चैव क्षत्रियाश् च विशः क्रमात् शूद्राणां मन्त्रयोगेन संबन्धो ब्राह्मणैः सह
verses.transliteration: utsīdanti narāścaiva kṣatriyāś ca viśaḥ kramāt śūdrāṇāṃ mantrayogena saṃbandho brāhmaṇaiḥ saha
verses.translation: Killing of foetus and murder of heroes become preva- lent. Iudras adopt the conduct of life prescribed for the brahmins and the brahmins adopt the ways of Sddras. *
verses.hindi: किं सागरान् शोषयामो यमं वा सह किङ्करैः । हन्मो मृत्युसुतां मृत्युं पशुवद्धन्म पद्मजम् बदध्वेन्द्र सह देवैश्च सह विष्णुं च वायुना। आनयामः सुसङ्क्रुद्धा हैत्यान् वा सह दानवैः
verses.wordMeaning: Killing of foetus and murder of heroes become preva- lent. Iudras adopt the conduct of life prescribed for the brahmins and the brahmins adopt the ways of Sddras. *
verses.commentary: Sense: Killing of foetus and murder of heroes become preva- lent. Iudras adopt the conduct of life prescribed for the brahmins and the brahmins adopt the ways of Sddras. *

verses.sanskrit: भवतीह कलौ तस्मिञ् शयनासनभोजनैः राजानः शूद्रभूयिष्ठा ब्राह्मणान् बाधयन्ति ते
verses.transliteration: bhavatīha kalau tasmiñ śayanāsanabhojanaiḥ rājānaḥ śūdrabhūyiṣṭhā brāhmaṇān bādhayanti te
verses.translation: Thieves function as kings and kings function as thieves. The chaste ladies cease to exist and wanton sluts increase in number.
verses.hindi: कस्याद्य व्यसनं घोरं करिष्यामस्तवाज्ञया। कस्य वाद्योत्सवो देव सर्वकामसमृद्धये उवाच देवः सम्पूज्य कोटिकोटिशतान् प्रभुः
verses.wordMeaning: Thieves function as kings and kings function as thieves. The chaste ladies cease to exist and wanton sluts increase in number.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thieves function as kings and kings function as thieves. The chaste ladies cease to exist and wanton sluts increase in number.

verses.sanskrit: भ्रूणहत्या वीरहत्या प्रजायन्ते प्रजासु वै शूद्राश् च ब्राह्मणाचाराः शूद्राचाराश् च ब्राह्मणाः
verses.transliteration: bhrūṇahatyā vīrahatyā prajāyante prajāsu vai śūdrāś ca brāhmaṇācārāḥ śūdrācārāś ca brāhmaṇāḥ
verses.translation: Stability and discipline of four castes and stages of life disappear from all places. At that time the earth yields very little fruit in one place and great fruits in another.
verses.hindi: विप्रोऽयं नायकश्चैव सेनानीर्वः समृद्धिमान् सेनान्यमभिषिञ्चध्वं महायोगपतिं पतिम्
verses.wordMeaning: Stability and discipline of four castes and stages of life disappear from all places. At that time the earth yields very little fruit in one place and great fruits in another.
verses.commentary: Sense: Stability and discipline of four castes and stages of life disappear from all places. At that time the earth yields very little fruit in one place and great fruits in another.

verses.sanskrit: राजवृत्तिस्थिताश् चौराश् चौराचाराश् च पार्थिवाः एकपत्न्यो न शिष्यन्ति वर्धिष्यन्त्यभिसारिकाः
verses.transliteration: rājavṛttisthitāś caurāś caurācārāś ca pārthivāḥ ekapatnyo na śiṣyanti vardhiṣyantyabhisārikāḥ
verses.translation: O Silasana, the kings confiscate and misappropriate public property. They cease to be protectors. Sodras acquire knowledge and are honoured by the brahmins.
verses.hindi: NEES SSNS NE = 1 भजबम फफफफफफफफफफफफफफफफपापफाफफफफाफाफाफफीफ मी फीफी कमी फफफफफफफफफफफफपफीफफफीपीफीफीफीफीपीपपीफीफीपीफीफफीपफाफफफाफाफफ फफफ फक वे महान् बलसे सम्पन्न गण गाते, दौड़ते, नाचते तथा अनेक मुखवाद्योंको बजाते हुए आये  बे
verses.wordMeaning: O Silasana, the kings confiscate and misappropriate public property. They cease to be protectors. Sodras acquire knowledge and are honoured by the brahmins.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Silasana, the kings confiscate and misappropriate public property. They cease to be protectors. Sodras acquire knowledge and are honoured by the brahmins.

verses.sanskrit: वर्णाश्रमप्रतिष्ठानो जायते नृषु सर्वतः तदा स्वल्पफला भूमिः क्वचिच्चापि महाफला
verses.transliteration: varṇāśramapratiṣṭhāno jāyate nṛṣu sarvataḥ tadā svalpaphalā bhūmiḥ kvaciccāpi mahāphalā
verses.translation: In Kali there will be many ascetics. As the yuga draws to a close, men become reduced in number while women increase in proportion. In Kali even the brahmins censure V'edic learning and holy rites. In Kali lord Mahadeva, Sankara, Nilalohita reveals himself as one of deformed features, for the establishment of righteousness. The brahmins who resort to him by any means conquer the evils of Kali and attain the highest abode.
verses.hindi: महायोगसे सम्पन्न वे गणेश्वर भेरी, मृदंग, पणव आनक, गोमुख, पटह, एकपुष्कर, मुरज, आडम्बर पणव एवं अन्य प्रकारके वाद्योंको बजाते हुए तथा विविध तालध्वनियाँ करते हुए भगवान् शिवकी सभन
verses.wordMeaning: In Kali there will be many ascetics. As the yuga draws to a close, men become reduced in number while women increase in proportion. In Kali even the brahmins censure V'edic learning and holy rites. In Kali lord Mahadeva, Sankara,…
verses.commentary: Sense: In Kali there will be many ascetics. As the yuga draws to a close, men become reduced in number while women increase in proportion. In Kali even the brahmins censure V'edic learning and holy rites. In Kali lord Mahadeva, Sankara,…

verses.sanskrit: अरक्षितारो हर्तारः पार्थिवाश् च शिलाशन शूद्रा वै ज्ञानिनः सर्वे ब्राह्मणैरभिवन्दिताः
verses.transliteration: arakṣitāro hartāraḥ pārthivāś ca śilāśana śūdrā vai jñāninaḥ sarve brāhmaṇairabhivanditāḥ
verses.translation: attafllai>-~attam kanySdravyam iulo ST. — those who
verses.hindi: महान् शक्तिसे युक्त तथा सभी देवेश्वरोंके इश्क उन गणेश्वरोंने महादेव एवं पार्वतीको प्रणाम करके यह वचन कहा--हे भगवन्! है देवदेवेश! है त्रियम्बक! हे वृषध्वज! आपने हमलोगोंका स्मरण किसलिये किया है? है देव! है महाद्युते! आदेश दीजिये
verses.wordMeaning: attafllai>-~attam kanySdravyam iulo ST. — those who
verses.commentary: Sense: attafllai>-~attam kanySdravyam iulo ST. — those who

verses.sanskrit: अक्षत्रियाश् च राजानो विप्राः शूद्रोपजीविनः आसनस्था द्विजान्दृष्ट्वा न चलन्त्यल्पबुद्धयः
verses.transliteration: akṣatriyāś ca rājāno viprāḥ śūdropajīvinaḥ āsanasthā dvijāndṛṣṭvā na calantyalpabuddhayaḥ
verses.translation: Men will rob others of their wealth and violate the chastity of other men's wives. They will be lustful, wicked at heart, base and foolhardy. They will lose proper perspective of things. Suffering from colic they will have their hairs disheve- lled. Towards the close of the yuga people will be born whose age will be only sixteen years.
verses.hindi: क्या हमलोग समुद्रोंको सोख लें? क्या यमको उनके सेवकोंसहित मार डालें अथवा मृत्युपुत्री (जरा) तथा मृत्युको मार डालें अथवा पद्मयोनि ब्रह्माका पशुकी भाँति वध कर दें। क्या अत्यन्त कुपित होकर हमलोग दानवोंसहित हैत्योंको बाँधकर यहाँ ले आयें? हमलोग आपकी आज्ञासे आज किसका घोर अनर्थ कर डालें? हे देव! सभी कामनाओंकी समृद्धिके लिये आज किसका उत्सव है ?॥ ११--१३॥
verses.wordMeaning: Men will rob others of their wealth and violate the chastity of other men's wives. They will be lustful, wicked at heart, base and foolhardy. They will lose proper perspective of things. Suffering from colic they will have their hairs disheve- lled.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Men will rob others of their wealth and violate the chastity of other men's wives. They will be lustful, wicked at heart, base and foolhardy. They will lose proper perspective of things. Suffering from colic they will have their hairs disheve- lled.…

verses.sanskrit: ताडयन्ति द्विजेन्द्रांश् च शूद्रा वै स्वल्पबुद्धयः आस्ये निधाय वै हस्तं कर्णं शूद्रस्य वै द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: tāḍayanti dvijendrāṃś ca śūdrā vai svalpabuddhayaḥ āsye nidhāya vai hastaṃ karṇaṃ śūdrasya vai dvijāḥ
verses.translation: When the end of the yuga is imminent Sudras will begin the practice of dharma with white teeth, deerskin and Rudraksa beads, with shaven heads and ochre-coloured robes.
verses.hindi: भगवान् शंकरने वैसा कहनेवाले उन करोड़ों" करोड़ों सभी सर्वपूज्य गणेश्वरोंका सम्मान करके उनसे कहा-हे जगतूके हितकारको! सुनिये, जिसलिये मैंने तुमलोगोंको यहाँ बुलाया है, उसे सुन करके हैं शुद्धात्माओ गणेश्वरो! निःशंक होकर कीजिये। यह नन्दी हमारा पुत्र है। यह सभीका ईश्वर है। यह समृद्धिशाली विप्र तुमलोगोंका नायक तथा सेनानी है। अतः मेरे आदेशसे तुम सभी लोग अपना स्वामी
verses.wordMeaning: When the end of the yuga is imminent Sudras will begin the practice of dharma with white teeth, deerskin and Rudraksa beads, with shaven heads and ochre-coloured robes.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the end of the yuga is imminent Sudras will begin the practice of dharma with white teeth, deerskin and Rudraksa beads, with shaven heads and ochre-coloured robes.

verses.sanskrit: नीचस्येव तदा वाक्यं वदन्ति विनयेन तम् उच्चासनस्थान् शूद्रांश् च द्विजमध्ये द्विजर्षभ
verses.transliteration: nīcasyeva tadā vākyaṃ vadanti vinayena tam uccāsanasthān śūdrāṃś ca dvijamadhye dvijarṣabha
verses.translation: Men will steal plants and grains. They will covet the clothes they see; thieves will rob other thieves of their wealth; one robber will rob another.
verses.hindi: एवं सेनानी मानकर इस महायोगपतिका अभिषेक करो॥ १४--१७॥ भगवान् शिवके इस प्रकार कहनेपर वै सभी
verses.wordMeaning: Men will steal plants and grains. They will covet the clothes they see; thieves will rob other thieves of their wealth; one robber will rob another.
verses.commentary: Sense: Men will steal plants and grains. They will covet the clothes they see; thieves will rob other thieves of their wealth; one robber will rob another.

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञात्वा न हिंसते राजा कलौ कालवशेन तु पुष्पैश् च वासितैश्चैव तथान्यैर् मङ्गलैः शुभैः
verses.transliteration: jñātvā na hiṃsate rājā kalau kālavaśena tu puṣpaiś ca vāsitaiścaiva tathānyair maṅgalaiḥ śubhaiḥ
verses.translation: When noble and befitting holy rites are no longer performed; when all the people become inactive and lethargic, germs, mice and serpents will torment men. Prosperity, welfare, health and efficiency will be difficult to attain. People afflicted by hunger and fear will resort to the lands near the KauiSiki®® river.
verses.hindi: अध्याय ४४ भगवान् शिवद्वारा नन्दिकेश्वरको गणोंके अधिपतिके रूपमें प्रतिष्ठित करना १९९ न जा फ फ फ फ कफ फफ फ फफ फ फ काक फ फ फा फ फ फ फ फ फ फ फ फ फ फफ फफ फ फ फ फा पाका का म की कक
verses.wordMeaning: When noble and befitting holy rites are no longer performed; when all the people become inactive and lethargic, germs, mice and serpents will torment men. Prosperity, welfare, health and efficiency will be difficult to attain.…
verses.commentary: Sense: When noble and befitting holy rites are no longer performed; when all the people become inactive and lethargic, germs, mice and serpents will torment men. Prosperity, welfare, health and efficiency will be difficult to attain.…

verses.sanskrit: शूद्रानभ्यर्चयन्त्यल्पश्रुतभाग्यबलान्विताः न प्रेक्षन्ते गर्विताश् च शूद्रा द्विजवरान् द्विज
verses.transliteration: śūdrānabhyarcayantyalpaśrutabhāgyabalānvitāḥ na prekṣante garvitāś ca śūdrā dvijavarān dvija
verses.translation: Kau&ikl. It is the modem Kosi that issues from the Him&layas, flows through Nepal and Tirhut and joins the Ganges below Patna. But originally the river passed through North Bengal and fell into the Brahma- putra. See Sircar, GAMI
verses.hindi: आसनं मेरुसङ्काशं मनोहरमुपाहरन् नैकस्तम्भमयं चापि चामीकरवरप्रभम्। मुक्तादामावलम्बं च मणिरत्नावभासितम्
verses.wordMeaning: Kau&ikl. It is the modem Kosi that issues from the Him&layas, flows through Nepal and Tirhut and joins the Ganges below Patna. But originally the river passed through North Bengal and fell into the Brahma- putra. See Sircar, GAMI
verses.commentary: Sense: Kau&ikl. It is the modem Kosi that issues from the Him&layas, flows through Nepal and Tirhut and joins the Ganges below Patna. But originally the river passed through North Bengal and fell into the Brahma- putra. See Sircar, GAMI

verses.sanskrit: सेवावसरम् आलोक्य द्वारे तिष्ठन्ति वै द्विजाः वाहनस्थान् समावृत्य शूद्राञ्शूद्रोपजीविनः
verses.transliteration: sevāvasaram ālokya dvāre tiṣṭhanti vai dvijāḥ vāhanasthān samāvṛtya śūdrāñśūdropajīvinaḥ
verses.translation: People overwhelmed by misery will never see the maximum span of life of hundred years. In Kali all the Vedas will not be available. Yajfias perish afflicted by people of no virtue. Ochre-robed and naked anchorites will be wandering and many Kapalikas (ascetics holding skulls as their begging bowls) will infest the territories.
verses.hindi: केयूरे कुण्डले चैव मुकुटं हारमेव च दत्तं महात्मना तेन ब्रह्मणा परमेष्ठिना
verses.wordMeaning: People overwhelmed by misery will never see the maximum span of life of hundred years. In Kali all the Vedas will not be available. Yajfias perish afflicted by people of no virtue.…
verses.commentary: Sense: People overwhelmed by misery will never see the maximum span of life of hundred years. In Kali all the Vedas will not be available. Yajfias perish afflicted by people of no virtue.…

verses.sanskrit: सेवन्ते ब्राह्मणास्तत्र स्तुवन्ति स्तुतिभिः कलौ तपोयज्ञफलानां च विक्रेतारो द्विजोत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: sevante brāhmaṇāstatra stuvanti stutibhiḥ kalau tapoyajñaphalānāṃ ca vikretāro dvijottamāḥ
verses.translation: Some sell Vedas and others sell Tirthas (holy waters) i.e. make illegal gain out of these. When Kali yuga begins heretics will be born who will be opposed to the system of four castes and stages of life. Sudras will learn the Vedas and will become experts in the meaning of dharma.
verses.hindi: “ऐसा ही होगा'--यह कहकर आपसमें परामर्श करके सामग्रियाँ एकत्र करने लगे उत्तम स्वर्णकी प्रभासे युक्त, लटकती हुई मोतियोंकी झालरोंसे सुशोभित, मणियों एवं रत्नोंसे जटित, वैदूर्यमणिके स्तम्भोंवाले, किंकिणियोंसे सुशोभित, सुन्दर रत्नोंसे समन्वित तथा सभी ओर मुखवाले एक मण्डपका
verses.wordMeaning: Some sell Vedas and others sell Tirthas (holy waters) i.e. make illegal gain out of these. When Kali yuga begins heretics will be born who will be opposed to the system of four castes and stages of life.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Some sell Vedas and others sell Tirthas (holy waters) i.e. make illegal gain out of these. When Kali yuga begins heretics will be born who will be opposed to the system of four castes and stages of life.…

verses.sanskrit: यतयश् च भविष्यन्ति बहवो ऽस्मिन्कलौ युगे पुरुषाल्पं बहुस्त्रीकं युगान्ते समुपस्थिते
verses.transliteration: yatayaś ca bhaviṣyanti bahavo 'sminkalau yuge puruṣālpaṃ bahustrīkaṃ yugānte samupasthite
verses.translation: Kings born of Sudra wombs will perform horse- sacrifice. People begin to harass one another by killing women, children, cows and one another.
verses.hindi: निर्माण करके उसके मध्यमें उस सुन्दर आसनको स्थापितकर पादप्रतिष्ठाके लिये उसके आगे नीलवज़से जटित एक पादपीठ रखा। उसके दोनों ओर उन्होंने दो कलश रखे, जो सुगन्धित जलसे भरे हुए थे तथा उनके मुख कमलपुष्पोंसे ढँके हुए थे। सोने, चाँदी, ताँबे और मिट्टीके हजारों कलश वहाँ रखे थे, जो सभी तीर्थोके जलसे परिपूर्ण थे
verses.wordMeaning: Kings born of Sudra wombs will perform horse- sacrifice. People begin to harass one another by killing women, children, cows and one another.
verses.commentary: Sense: Kings born of Sudra wombs will perform horse- sacrifice. People begin to harass one another by killing women, children, cows and one another.

verses.sanskrit: निन्दन्ति वेदविद्यां च द्विजाः कर्माणि वै कलौ कलौ देवो महादेवः शङ्करो नीललोहितः
verses.transliteration: nindanti vedavidyāṃ ca dvijāḥ karmāṇi vai kalau kalau devo mahādevaḥ śaṅkaro nīlalohitaḥ
verses.translation: Hence during Kali, longevity strength and features become less and less. Men attain perfection within a short while.
verses.hindi: महात्मा परमेष्ठी ब्रह्माने दिव्य वस्त्रयुगल, दिव्य गन्ध, केयूर, कुण्डल, मुकुट, हार, सौ शलाकाओं शंख तथा मोतियोंकी मालाके समान गौरवर्णवाले दण्डसे सुशोभित और चन्द्रमाके समान शुभ्र व्यजन, स्वर्णका दण्ड (मूठ) लगा हुआ चामर, भलीभाँति पूजित ऐरावत तथा सुप्रतीक-ये दो हाथी, विश्‍वकर्माके
verses.wordMeaning: Hence during Kali, longevity strength and features become less and less. Men attain perfection within a short while.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence during Kali, longevity strength and features become less and less. Men attain perfection within a short while.

verses.sanskrit: प्रकाशते प्रतिष्ठार्थं धर्मस्य विकृताकृतिः ये तं विप्रा निषेवन्ते येन केनापि शङ्करम्
verses.transliteration: prakāśate pratiṣṭhārthaṃ dharmasya vikṛtākṛtiḥ ye taṃ viprā niṣevante yena kenāpi śaṅkaram
verses.translation: Excellent brahmins of blessed nature will still practise dharma without malice towards the end of yuga as laid down in the Srutis and Smrtis. What is gained by the practice of dharma for a year in Treta is attained by the prac- tice of it for a month in Dvapara. In Kali an intelligent devotee attains the same in a day by practising Dharma strenuously.**
verses.hindi: द्वारा बनाया हुआ एक सोनेका मुकुट, दो स्वच्छ तथा दिव्य कुण्डल, श्रेष्ठ आयुध वज्र, सोनेका सूत्र तथा दो केयूर वहाँ रखे गये। देवताओंके द्वारा पूजित उन गणेश्वरोंने चारों ओर अनेक प्रकारको अन्य आवश्यक सामग्रियोंको सावधान होकर वहाँ उपस्थित कर दिया
verses.wordMeaning: Excellent brahmins of blessed nature will still practise dharma without malice towards the end of yuga as laid down in the Srutis and Smrtis. What is gained by the practice of dharma for a year in Treta is attained by the prac- tice of it for a month in Dvapara.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Excellent brahmins of blessed nature will still practise dharma without malice towards the end of yuga as laid down in the Srutis and Smrtis. What is gained by the practice of dharma for a year in Treta is attained by the prac- tice of it for a month in Dvapara.…

verses.sanskrit: कलिदोषान् विनिर्जित्य प्रयान्ति परमं पदम् श्वापदप्रबलत्वं च गवां चैव परिक्षयः
verses.transliteration: kalidoṣān vinirjitya prayānti paramaṃ padam śvāpadaprabalatvaṃ ca gavāṃ caiva parikṣayaḥ
verses.translation: This is the state of affairs in the Kali yuga. Under- stand the situation in the period of ending junction (sandh- yaiha) from me. In every yuga the Siddhis are reduced to three-fourths of what they were in the beginning.
verses.hindi: तदनन्तर इन्द्रसहित विष्णु आदि देवता, मुनिगण, भगवान् ब्रह्मा, नवब्रह्माण, देवताओंसहित सभी लोकपाल प्रसन्नतापूर्वक वहाँ गये। उन सभीके वहाँ आ जानेपर भगवान् परमेश्वरने समस्त संस्कारविधि सम्पन्न करानेके ऐरावत: सुप्रतीको गजावेतौ सुपूजितौ। मुकुटं काञ्चनं चैव निर्मितं विश्वकर्मणा
verses.wordMeaning: This is the state of affairs in the Kali yuga. Under- stand the situation in the period of ending junction (sandh- yaiha) from me. In every yuga the Siddhis are reduced to three-fourths of what they were in the beginning.
verses.commentary: Sense: This is the state of affairs in the Kali yuga. Under- stand the situation in the period of ending junction (sandh- yaiha) from me. In every yuga the Siddhis are reduced to three-fourths of what they were in the beginning.

verses.sanskrit: साधूनां विनिवृत्तिश् च वेद्या तस्मिन्युगक्षये तदा सूक्ष्मो महोदर्को दुर्लभो दानमूलवान्
verses.transliteration: sādhūnāṃ vinivṛttiś ca vedyā tasminyugakṣaye tadā sūkṣmo mahodarko durlabho dānamūlavān
verses.translation: Only a quarter of the features of the yugas remains in their sandhyas (preceding transition periods). Similarly only a quarter of the features of the sandhyas abides in the san- dhyamsas (succeeding transition periods) (i.e. during the sandhyama period only l/6th of the yuga Dharma will prevail).
verses.hindi: जाम्बूनदमयं सूत्रं केयूरद्वयमेव च समन्तान्निन्युरव्यग्रा गणपा देवसम्मताः

verses.sanskrit: चातुराश्रमशैथिल्ये धर्मः प्रतिचलिष्यति अरक्षितारो हर्तारो बलिभागस्य पार्थिवाः
verses.transliteration: cāturāśramaśaithilye dharmaḥ praticaliṣyati arakṣitāro hartāro balibhāgasya pārthivāḥ
verses.translation: Of. Visou as cited in ST. 1
verses.hindi: ततो देवाश्च सेन्द्राशच नारायणमुखास्तथा । मुनयो भगवान् ब्रह्मा नवब्रह्मण एव च देवैश्च लोकाः सर्वे ते ततो जग्मुर्मुदा युताः । खातक सवव भगवान! पसेर तर पन परमेश्वरः
verses.wordMeaning: Of. Visou as cited in ST. 1
verses.commentary: Sense: Of. Visou as cited in ST. 1

verses.sanskrit: युगान्तेषु भविष्यन्ति स्वरक्षणपरायणाः अट्टशूला जनपदाः शिवशूलाश्चतुष्पथाः
verses.transliteration: yugānteṣu bhaviṣyanti svarakṣaṇaparāyaṇāḥ aṭṭaśūlā janapadāḥ śivaśūlāścatuṣpathāḥ
verses.translation: In the previous birth he was born in the family of Manu who himself was a part incarnation of Vispu. When the Kali yuga is complete (i.e. coming to an end) he will be born in the line of the Moon as the powerful Pramiti.® will start his campaign in his thirty second year and continue it for twenty years.
verses.hindi: मरीचि, भृगु, अंगिरा, पुलस्त्य, पुल क्रतु, दक्ष, अत्रि तथा वसिष्ठ- ये नौ ऋषि ब्रह्माजीके मनसे उत्पन्न होनेके कारण तथा ब्रह्मवादी और ब्रह्मात्मक होनेसे 'नवब्रह्मण' कहलाते हैं। (लिङ्गपु० पू० ७०। १८१--१८३) सर्वकार्यविधिं कर्तुमादिदेश पितामहम्। लिये पितामह ब्रह्माको आदेश दिया॥ ३१-३२ १, पितामहोऽपि भगवान् नियोगादेव तस्य तु॥ ३ तब उनका आदेश पाते ही भगवान् ब्रह्माने भ

verses.sanskrit: प्रमदाः केशशूलिन्यो भविष्यन्ति कलौ युगे चित्रवर्षी तदा देवो यदा प्राहुर्युगक्षयम्
verses.transliteration: pramadāḥ keśaśūlinyo bhaviṣyanti kalau yuge citravarṣī tadā devo yadā prāhuryugakṣayam
verses.translation: Getting infuriated mutually (the people will attack one another). Pramiti will defeat all those alien outcastes and all unrighteous persons and ultimately rest in the middle land between the Gahga and Yamuna along with his ministers and followers, after killing all the kings and alien outcastes in thousands. When the sandhyaihsa period sets in at the end of the yuga there will be groups of people among the subjects left behind here and there. Getting unrestrained and covetous they will be attacking and killing one another. When anarchy
verses.hindi: ध्यानपूर्वक सम्पूर्ण अभिषेक-कर्म सम्पन्न कराया चकार सर्व भगवानभिषेकं समाहितः।  तत्पश्चात् भगवान् ब्रह्माने पूजन करके स्वयं उनका अर्चयित्वा ततो ब्रह्मा स्वयमेवाभ्यषेचयत्॥ ३४  अभिषेक किया। इसके बाद शिवके आदेशसे विष्णु
verses.wordMeaning: Getting infuriated mutually (the people will attack one another). Pramiti will defeat all those alien outcastes and all unrighteous persons and ultimately rest in the middle land between the Gahga and Yamuna along with his ministers and followers,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Getting infuriated mutually (the people will attack one another). Pramiti will defeat all those alien outcastes and all unrighteous persons and ultimately rest in the middle land between the Gahga and Yamuna along with his ministers and followers,…

verses.sanskrit: सर्वे वणिग्जनाश्चापि भविष्यन्त्यधमे युगे कुशीलचर्याः पाषण्डैर् वृथारूपैः समावृताः
verses.transliteration: sarve vaṇigjanāścāpi bhaviṣyantyadhame yuge kuśīlacaryāḥ pāṣaṇḍair vṛthārūpaiḥ samāvṛtāḥ
verses.translation: In their misery they will sustain themselves on wine, meat, roofs and fruits. They will wear barks of trees, leaves or deer skin. They will not perform holy rites or accept monetary gifts.
verses.hindi: फिर इन्द्रने और लोकपालोंने गणेन्द्रका विधिपूर्वक तदनन्तर ऋषियों तथा पितामह आदिने उनकी स्तुति की। तब उन सभीके स्तुति कर लेनेपर समस्त जगतूके स्वामी विष्णुने सिरपर अंजलि बाँधकर एकाग्र- चित्त होकर उनकी स्तुति को और हाथ जोड़े हुए
verses.wordMeaning: In their misery they will sustain themselves on wine, meat, roofs and fruits. They will wear barks of trees, leaves or deer skin. They will not perform holy rites or accept monetary gifts.
verses.commentary: Sense: In their misery they will sustain themselves on wine, meat, roofs and fruits. They will wear barks of trees, leaves or deer skin. They will not perform holy rites or accept monetary gifts.

verses.sanskrit: बहुयाजनको लोको भविष्यति परस्परम् नाव्याहृतक्रूरवाक्यो नार्जवी नानसूयकः
verses.transliteration: bahuyājanako loko bhaviṣyati parasparam nāvyāhṛtakrūravākyo nārjavī nānasūyakaḥ
verses.translation: They will fall off from the rigid discipline of four castes and stages of life. They will be involved in a terrible calamity. Thus the few remaining subjects at the end of Kali- yuga will be in miserable circumstances.
verses.hindi: झुककर जय-जयकार किया। तत्पश्चात् सभी गणेश्वरों इस प्रकार ब्रह्मासहित सभी देवताओंके द्वारा उनका अभिषेक तथा स्तवन हो जानेके बाद परमेष्ठीकी आज्ञासे उन्होंने विवाह किया। सुयशा नामक जो मरुतोंको पुत्री थी, वह उनकी भार्या हुई । उस सुयशाको
verses.wordMeaning: They will fall off from the rigid discipline of four castes and stages of life. They will be involved in a terrible calamity. Thus the few remaining subjects at the end of Kali- yuga will be in miserable circumstances.
verses.commentary: Sense: They will fall off from the rigid discipline of four castes and stages of life. They will be involved in a terrible calamity. Thus the few remaining subjects at the end of Kali- yuga will be in miserable circumstances.

verses.sanskrit: न कृते प्रतिकर्ता च युगक्षीणे भविष्यति निन्दकाश्चैव पतिता युगान्तस्य च लक्षणम्
verses.transliteration: na kṛte pratikartā ca yugakṣīṇe bhaviṣyati nindakāścaiva patitā yugāntasya ca lakṣaṇam
verses.translation: They will be afflicted by old age, sickness and hunger. Due to sorrow their minds will become dejected. Through dejec- tion thinking sets in. An even attitude of the mind is wnat is called vicarana (thinking). This attitude leads to knowledge. Through true knowledge arises pious nature. The subjects who survive the concluding years of Kaliyuga will be devoid of physical features and mental peace.
verses.hindi: चन्द्रमाके समान प्रभायुक्त और विशेष शोभासम्पन्न एक छत्र भेंट किया गया। हाथोंमें चामर लिये हुए स्त्रियोसे युक्त उस सुयशाको दो चामर भी प्रदान किये गये। मेरे किया। भगवती महालक्ष्मीने मुकुट आदि सुन्दर आभूषणोंसे उसे अलंकृत किया॥ ३८--४१॥
verses.wordMeaning: They will be afflicted by old age, sickness and hunger. Due to sorrow their minds will become dejected. Through dejec- tion thinking sets in. An even attitude of the mind is wnat is called vicarana (thinking). This attitude leads to knowledge.…
verses.commentary: Sense: They will be afflicted by old age, sickness and hunger. Due to sorrow their minds will become dejected. Through dejec- tion thinking sets in. An even attitude of the mind is wnat is called vicarana (thinking). This attitude leads to knowledge.…

verses.sanskrit: नृपशून्या वसुमती न च धान्यधनावृता मण्डलानि भविष्यन्ति देशेषु नगरेषु च
verses.transliteration: nṛpaśūnyā vasumatī na ca dhānyadhanāvṛtā maṇḍalāni bhaviṣyanti deśeṣu nagareṣu ca
verses.translation: At that time, the yuga changes for them overnight, after creating illusion in their minds as in the case of a sleeping or mad man. Thanks to the inevitability and force of future events Krtayuga will set in. When thus the Krtayuga is ushered in, the subjects surviving from the Kaliyuga, become those
verses.hindi: उसे देवीके गलेका अति सुन्दर हार भी प्राप्त हुआ। वृषेन्द्र, श्वेत हाथी, सिंह, सिंहध्वज, रथ और चन्द्रमण्डलके समान कहीं भी कोई प्रभु नहीं था
verses.wordMeaning: At that time, the yuga changes for them overnight, after creating illusion in their minds as in the case of a sleeping or mad man. Thanks to the inevitability and force of future events Krtayuga will set in. When thus the Krtayuga is ushered in,…
verses.commentary: Sense: At that time, the yuga changes for them overnight, after creating illusion in their minds as in the case of a sleeping or mad man. Thanks to the inevitability and force of future events Krtayuga will set in. When thus the Krtayuga is ushered in,…

verses.sanskrit: अल्पोदका चाल्पफला भविष्यति वसुंधरा गोप्तारश्चाप्यगोप्तारः सम्भविष्यन्त्यशासनाः
verses.transliteration: alpodakā cālpaphalā bhaviṣyati vasuṃdharā goptāraścāpyagoptāraḥ sambhaviṣyantyaśāsanāḥ
verses.translation: pancavixhSakab i.c. with their span of life extending only to twentyfive years or whose gross and subtle bodies constitute twentyfive tattvas.
verses.hindi: मुझको परिवारसहित लेकर सम्बन्धियों तथा बान्धवोंको भी साथ लेकर देवीके साथ भगवान् महेश्वर वृषभपर आरूढ़ हो चल पड़े तब मेरे तथा गणोंके साथ शिव एवं पार्वतीको देखकर मुनियों, देवर्षियों, सिद्धों और द्विजोंने शिवकी आज्ञाहेतु प्रार्थना की
verses.wordMeaning: pancavixhSakab i.c. with their span of life extending only to twentyfive years or whose gross and subtle bodies constitute twentyfive tattvas.
verses.commentary: Sense: pancavixhSakab i.c. with their span of life extending only to twentyfive years or whose gross and subtle bodies constitute twentyfive tattvas.

verses.sanskrit: हर्तारः परवित्तानां परदारप्रधर्षकाः कामात्मानो दुरात्मानो ह्य् अधमाः साहसप्रियाः
verses.transliteration: hartāraḥ paravittānāṃ paradārapradharṣakāḥ kāmātmāno durātmāno hy adhamāḥ sāhasapriyāḥ
verses.translation: They will teach them the two-fold Dharma of the Sruti and Smrti*®® alongwith the conduct of life peculiar to the four castes and stages of life.
verses.hindi: तत्पश्चात् हिमालयकी पुत्रीके पति प्रभु शिवकी ततो विष्णुस्ततः शक्रो लोकपालास्तथैव च। अभ्यषिञ्चन्त विधिवद् गणेन्द्रं शिवशासनात्
verses.wordMeaning: They will teach them the two-fold Dharma of the Sruti and Smrti*®® alongwith the conduct of life peculiar to the four castes and stages of life.
verses.commentary: Sense: They will teach them the two-fold Dharma of the Sruti and Smrti*®® alongwith the conduct of life peculiar to the four castes and stages of life.

verses.sanskrit: प्रनष्टचेष्टनाः पुंसो मुक्तकेशाश् च शूलिनः जनाः षोडशवर्षाश् च प्रजायन्ते युगक्षये
verses.transliteration: pranaṣṭaceṣṭanāḥ puṃso muktakeśāś ca śūlinaḥ janāḥ ṣoḍaśavarṣāś ca prajāyante yugakṣaye
verses.translation: When the Dharmas have been propounded by the seven sages, other sages promulgate them (among the people) by differentiating them between those pertaining to Sruti and Smrti. Some of these sages stay even at the time of dissolution for the purpose of establishing Dharma. The sages indeed stay in office throughout the manvantara, just as trees remain (unaffected) when the forest fire consumes the grass. But when rain falls this grows up again. In the same manner, after the people of Kali die the people of Krta yuga come up. The continuity from one yuga to another goes on without break in this manner till the manvantara comes to a close.
verses.hindi: स्तुतवत्सु ततस्तेषु विष्णुः सर्वजगत्पतिः प्राञ्जलिः प्रणतो भूत्वा जयशब्दं चकार च
verses.wordMeaning: When the Dharmas have been propounded by the seven sages, other sages promulgate them (among the people) by differentiating them between those pertaining to Sruti and Smrti. Some of these sages stay even at the time of dissolution for the purpose of establishing Dharma.…
verses.commentary: Sense: When the Dharmas have been propounded by the seven sages, other sages promulgate them (among the people) by differentiating them between those pertaining to Sruti and Smrti. Some of these sages stay even at the time of dissolution for the purpose of establishing Dharma.…

verses.sanskrit: शुक्लदन्ताजिनाक्षाश् च मुण्डाः काषायवाससः शूद्रा धर्मं चरिष्यन्ति युगान्ते समुपस्थिते
verses.transliteration: śukladantājinākṣāś ca muṇḍāḥ kāṣāyavāsasaḥ śūdrā dharmaṃ cariṣyanti yugānte samupasthite
verses.translation: Happiness, longevity, strength, beauty (or physical features), virtue, wealth and love become reduced to three- fourths from yuga to yuga gradually.
verses.hindi: ततो गणाधिपाः सर्वे ततो देवास्ततोऽसुराः। एवं स्तुतश्चाभिषिक्तो देवैः सब्रह्मकैस्तदा मरुतां च सुता देवी सुयशाख्या बभूव या
verses.wordMeaning: Happiness, longevity, strength, beauty (or physical features), virtue, wealth and love become reduced to three- fourths from yuga to yuga gradually.
verses.commentary: Sense: Happiness, longevity, strength, beauty (or physical features), virtue, wealth and love become reduced to three- fourths from yuga to yuga gradually.

verses.sanskrit: सस्यचौरा भविष्यन्ति दृढचैलाभिलाषिणः चौराश्चोरस्वहर्तारो हर्तुर्हर्ता तथापरः
verses.transliteration: sasyacaurā bhaviṣyanti dṛḍhacailābhilāṣiṇaḥ caurāścorasvahartāro harturhartā tathāparaḥ
verses.translation: The Siddhis of Dharma become (proportionately)
verses.hindi: लब्धो हारश्च परमो देव्याः कण्ठगतस्तथा। आरुह्य वृषमीशानो मया देव्या गत: शिव:
verses.wordMeaning: The Siddhis of Dharma become (proportionately)
verses.commentary: Sense: The Siddhis of Dharma become (proportionately)

verses.sanskrit: योग्यकर्मण्युपरते लोके निष्क्रियतां गते कीटमूषकसर्पाश् च धर्षयिष्यन्ति मानवान्
verses.transliteration: yogyakarmaṇyuparate loke niṣkriyatāṃ gate kīṭamūṣakasarpāś ca dharṣayiṣyanti mānavān
verses.translation: seven sages, viz, Marici, Atri, Ahgiras, Pulastya, Pulaha, Kratu and Vasistha. They are represented by a group of seven stars called Ursa Major. ST. cites a verse with a few variations in names: Kasyapo' trir bharadvajo VUvamitro' tha Gautama Vasitho JamadagniS ca saptaraya ud&hrtab
verses.hindi: तदा देवीं भवं दृष्ट्वा मया च प्रार्थयन् गणैः। मुनिदेवर्षयः सिद्धा आज्ञां पाशुपतीं द्विजाः नन्दिको नगजाभर्तुस्तेषां पाशुपतीं शुभाम्
verses.wordMeaning: seven sages, viz, Marici, Atri, Ahgiras, Pulastya, Pulaha, Kratu and Vasistha. They are represented by a group of seven stars called Ursa Major. ST.…
verses.commentary: Sense: seven sages, viz, Marici, Atri, Ahgiras, Pulastya, Pulaha, Kratu and Vasistha. They are represented by a group of seven stars called Ursa Major. ST.…

verses.sanskrit: सुभिक्षं क्षेममारोग्यं सामर्थ्यं दुर्लभं तदा कौशिकीं प्रतिपत्स्यन्ते देशान्क्षुद्भयपीडिताः
verses.transliteration: subhikṣaṃ kṣemamārogyaṃ sāmarthyaṃ durlabhaṃ tadā kauśikīṃ pratipatsyante deśānkṣudbhayapīḍitāḥ
verses.translation: In the same manner all the four yugas must be understood. A thousand such cycles of four yugas are said to constitute one day of Brahma. The night too consists of as many yugas. By the time the yuga comes to a close the living beings lose their straightforward and sentient feelings. This is the characteristic feature of all the yugas. Seventyone cycles of four yugas constitute a manvantara. What happens in one set of four yugas is repeated in the other cycles of four yugas in the same manner and at the same time as well as in the same order. The differences that occur from creation to creation are limited to twentyfive, neither more nor less. The kalpas too have the same characteristics as the yugas. The same characteristics mark all the manvantaras also.
verses.hindi: वान् रुद्रके विराट् स्वरूप तथा सात पाताललोकोंका वर्णन अकरम मकमजकओओडडऊककक फक्क फ पक प्मप्फफफफ फफ् कफ फफ कफ फ फ फफ्फ पक्ष कफ फ कक फ फ फ्फ क कफ फ फक फक भक फ फ्रफफक्रफफफ फी फफ फफफफफफफफफफफफ फे क फ फ फा फ फा फ़ फ फ फ फ फ फ फ फ फ फ फ फ फ फ फ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ फ़ फ़ फ फ़ फ फ फा फ फफ फ फा फक फ फ फफ फक फाम फफ मामी की

verses.commentary: Sense: In the same manner all the four yugas must be understood. A thousand such cycles of four yugas are said to constitute one day of Brahma. The night too consists of as many yugas.…

verses.sanskrit: दुःखेनाभिप्लुतानां च परमायुः शतं तदा दृश्यन्ते न च दृश्यन्ते वेदाः कलियुगे ऽखिलाः
verses.transliteration: duḥkhenābhiplutānāṃ ca paramāyuḥ śataṃ tadā dṛśyante na ca dṛśyante vedāḥ kaliyuge 'khilāḥ
verses.translation: Just as the changes and alterations in the yugas have happened from early days (and have continued for a long time) in view of the nature of the yugas, so also the world of living beings goes round and round alternating between death and birth.
verses.hindi: तस्माद्द्ि मुनयो लब्ध्वा तदाज्ञां मुनिपुङ्गवात्। भ्रवभक्तास्तदा चासंस्तस्मादेवं समर्चयेत् नमस्कारविहीनस्तु नाम उद्गिरयेद्भवे। ब्रह्मघ्नदशसंतुल्यं तस्य पापं गरीयसम्
verses.wordMeaning: Just as the changes and alterations in the yugas have happened from early days (and have continued for a long time) in view of the nature of the yugas, so also the world of living beings goes round and round alternating between death and birth.
verses.commentary: Sense: Just as the changes and alterations in the yugas have happened from early days (and have continued for a long time) in view of the nature of the yugas, so also the world of living beings goes round and round alternating between death and birth.

verses.sanskrit: उत्सीदन्ति तदा यज्ञाः केवलाधर्मपीडिताः काषायिणो ऽप्यनिर्ग्रन्थाः कापालीबहुलास्त्विह
verses.transliteration: utsīdanti tadā yajñāḥ kevalādharmapīḍitāḥ kāṣāyiṇo 'pyanirgranthāḥ kāpālībahulāstviha
verses.translation: Thus the characteristic feature of the yugas of the past and future in all the manvantaras has been recorded in brief.
verses.hindi: तस्मात्सर्वप्रकारेण नमस्कारादिमुच्चरेत्। आज्ञासे नन्दीने उन पूजनीय लोगोंके लिये शुभ पाशुपत आज्ञा प्रदान को
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the characteristic feature of the yugas of the past and future in all the manvantaras has been recorded in brief.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the characteristic feature of the yugas of the past and future in all the manvantaras has been recorded in brief.

verses.sanskrit: वेदविक्रयिणश्चान्ये तीर्थविक्रयिणः परे वर्णाश्रमाणां ये चान्ये पाषण्डाः परिपन्थिनः
verses.transliteration: vedavikrayiṇaścānye tīrthavikrayiṇaḥ pare varṇāśramāṇāṃ ye cānye pāṣaṇḍāḥ paripanthinaḥ
verses.translation: With the explanation of one manvantara all the man- vantaras have been undoubtedly explained; similarly with one kalpa and other kalpas too.
verses.hindi: तब मुनिश्रेष्ठ (नन्दी)-से उन शिवको आज्ञा (दीक्षा) पाकर वे मुनिलोग शिवभक्त हो गये। अतः सभीको शिवकी पूजा करनी चाहिए यदि कोई मनुष्य बिना नमस्कारके ही शिवके नामका उच्चारण करता है, तो उसे दस ब्रह्महत्याके समान घोर पाप लगता है। अतः सब प्रकारसे नामके आदिमें नमस्कार (नमः) -का उच्चारण करना चाहिए। आदिमें
verses.wordMeaning: With the explanation of one manvantara all the man- vantaras have been undoubtedly explained; similarly with one kalpa and other kalpas too.
verses.commentary: Sense: With the explanation of one manvantara all the man- vantaras have been undoubtedly explained; similarly with one kalpa and other kalpas too.

verses.sanskrit: उत्पद्यन्ते तदा ते वै सम्प्राप्ते तु कलौ युगे अधीयन्ते तदा वेदाञ् शूद्रा धर्मार्थकोविदाः
verses.transliteration: utpadyante tadā te vai samprāpte tu kalau yuge adhīyante tadā vedāñ śūdrā dharmārthakovidāḥ
verses.translation: In regard to the future kalpas the same argument should be continued by one who knows. In all the manvantaras past and future, the eight®' classes of Devas, the ruling lords of manvantaras, Manus and sages will have the same status through their names and forms, as also the same purpose and intention. The same is the case with the division of castes and stages of life in every yuga. It is the lord who lays down the nature and characteristics of the yugas, the divisions of castes and stages of life, the yugas and the Siddhis of the yugas. Inci- dentally, the magnitude of the yugas was mentioned to you. I shall now recount to you how the lotus-born deity became Brahma the son of the goddess.
verses.hindi: नमः अवश्य लगाना चाहिए, ऐसा करनेवाला शिवत्वको आदौ कुर्यान्नमस्कारं तदन्ते शिवतां ब्रजेत्॥ ४९  प्राप्त होता है
verses.wordMeaning: In regard to the future kalpas the same argument should be continued by one who knows. In all the manvantaras past and future, the eight®' classes of Devas, the ruling lords of manvantaras, Manus and sages will have the same status through their names and forms,…
verses.commentary: Sense: In regard to the future kalpas the same argument should be continued by one who knows. In all the manvantaras past and future, the eight®' classes of Devas, the ruling lords of manvantaras, Manus and sages will have the same status through their names and forms,…

verses.sanskrit: यजन्ते चाश्वमेधेन राजानः शूद्रयोनयः स्त्रीबालगोवधं कृत्वा हत्वा चैव परस्परम्
verses.transliteration: yajante cāśvamedhena rājānaḥ śūdrayonayaḥ strībālagovadhaṃ kṛtvā hatvā caiva parasparam
verses.translation: Eight classes of Devas: Gf. Aditya-viiva-vasavas-tu$ita>bh&B- varanil maharakika-sadhyas ca rudris ca ganadevat — dted in ST,
verses.hindi: भगवान् रुद्रके विराट् स्वरूप तथा सात पाताललोकोंका वर्णन सूत सुव्यक्तमखिलं कथितं शङ्करस्य तु। सर्वात्मभावं रुद्रस्य स्वरूपं वक्तुमहसि
verses.wordMeaning: Eight classes of Devas: Gf. Aditya-viiva-vasavas-tu$ita>bh&B- varanil maharakika-sadhyas ca rudris ca ganadevat — dted in ST,
verses.commentary: Sense: Eight classes of Devas: Gf. Aditya-viiva-vasavas-tu$ita>bh&B- varanil maharakika-sadhyas ca rudris ca ganadevat — dted in ST,

verses.sanskrit: उपद्रवांस्तथान्योन्यं साधयन्ति तदा प्रजाः दुःखप्रभूतमल्पायुर् देहोत्सादः सरोगता
verses.transliteration: upadravāṃstathānyonyaṃ sādhayanti tadā prajāḥ duḥkhaprabhūtamalpāyur dehotsādaḥ sarogatā
verses.translation: Eight classes of Devas: Gf. Aditya-viiva-vasavas-tu$ita>bh&B- varanil maharakika-sadhyas ca rudris ca ganadevat — dted in ST,
verses.hindi: सत्यलोकश्च पातालं नरकार्णवकोटयः तारकाग्रहसोमार्का क्षुवः सप्तर्षयस्तथा। वैमानिकास्तथान्ये च तिष्ठन्त्यस्य प्रसादतः
verses.wordMeaning: Eight classes of Devas: Gf. Aditya-viiva-vasavas-tu$ita>bh&B- varanil maharakika-sadhyas ca rudris ca ganadevat — dted in ST,
verses.commentary: Sense: Eight classes of Devas: Gf. Aditya-viiva-vasavas-tu$ita>bh&B- varanil maharakika-sadhyas ca rudris ca ganadevat — dted in ST,

verses.sanskrit: अधर्माभिनिवेशित्वात् तमोवृत्तं कलौ स्मृतम् प्रजासु ब्रह्महत्यादि तदा वै सम्प्रवर्तते
verses.transliteration: adharmābhiniveśitvāt tamovṛttaṃ kalau smṛtam prajāsu brahmahatyādi tadā vai sampravartate
verses.translation: Eight classes of Devas: Gf. Aditya-viiva-vasavas-tu$ita>bh&B- varanil maharakika-sadhyas ca rudris ca ganadevat — dted in ST,
verses.hindi: समष्टिरूपः सर्वात्मा संस्थितः सर्वदा शिवः सर्वात्मानं महात्मानं महादेवं महेश्वरम्। न विजानन्ति सम्मूढा मायया तस्य मोहिताः
verses.wordMeaning: Eight classes of Devas: Gf. Aditya-viiva-vasavas-tu$ita>bh&B- varanil maharakika-sadhyas ca rudris ca ganadevat — dted in ST,
verses.commentary: Sense: Eight classes of Devas: Gf. Aditya-viiva-vasavas-tu$ita>bh&B- varanil maharakika-sadhyas ca rudris ca ganadevat — dted in ST,

verses.sanskrit: तस्मादायुर्बलं रूपं कलिं प्राप्य प्रहीयते तदा त्वल्पेन कालेन सिद्धिं गच्छन्ति मानवाः
verses.transliteration: tasmādāyurbalaṃ rūpaṃ kaliṃ prāpya prahīyate tadā tvalpena kālena siddhiṃ gacchanti mānavāḥ
verses.translation: Eight classes of Devas: Gf. Aditya-viiva-vasavas-tu$ita>bh&B- varanil maharakika-sadhyas ca rudris ca ganadevat — dted in ST,
verses.hindi: तस्य देवस्य रुद्रस्य शरीरं वै जगत्रयम्। ऋषिगण बोले-हे सूतजी! आपने शंकरजीके
verses.wordMeaning: Eight classes of Devas: Gf. Aditya-viiva-vasavas-tu$ita>bh&B- varanil maharakika-sadhyas ca rudris ca ganadevat — dted in ST,
verses.commentary: Sense: Eight classes of Devas: Gf. Aditya-viiva-vasavas-tu$ita>bh&B- varanil maharakika-sadhyas ca rudris ca ganadevat — dted in ST,

verses.sanskrit: धन्या धर्मं चरिष्यन्ति युगान्ते द्विजसत्तमाः श्रुतिस्मृत्युदितं धर्मं ये चरन्त्यनसूयकाः
verses.transliteration: dhanyā dharmaṃ cariṣyanti yugānte dvijasattamāḥ śrutismṛtyuditaṃ dharmaṃ ye carantyanasūyakāḥ
verses.translation: Eight classes of Devas: Gf. Aditya-viiva-vasavas-tu$ita>bh&B- varanil maharakika-sadhyas ca rudris ca ganadevat — dted in ST,
verses.hindi: सर्वात्मभाव तथा स्वरूपको बतानेकी कृपा कोजिये सूतजी बोले-- है ऋषियो! भूः, भुवः, स्वः, महः, जनः, तपः, सत्य-ये लोक, पाताल, करोड़ों
verses.wordMeaning: Eight classes of Devas: Gf. Aditya-viiva-vasavas-tu$ita>bh&B- varanil maharakika-sadhyas ca rudris ca ganadevat — dted in ST,
verses.commentary: Sense: Eight classes of Devas: Gf. Aditya-viiva-vasavas-tu$ita>bh&B- varanil maharakika-sadhyas ca rudris ca ganadevat — dted in ST,

verses.sanskrit: त्रेतायां वार्षिको धर्मो द्वापरे मासिकः स्मृतः यथाक्लेशं चरन्प्राज्ञस् तदह्ना प्राप्नुते कलौ
verses.transliteration: tretāyāṃ vārṣiko dharmo dvāpare māsikaḥ smṛtaḥ yathākleśaṃ caranprājñas tadahnā prāpnute kalau
verses.translation: Eight classes of Devas: Gf. Aditya-viiva-vasavas-tu$ita>bh&B- varanil maharakika-sadhyas ca rudris ca ganadevat — dted in ST,
verses.hindi: वैमानिक देवतागण तथा अन्य सभी उन्हीं शिवको कृपासे प्रतिष्ठित हैं इन्हींके द्वारा ये सब बनाये गये हैं। है श्रेष्ठ द्विजो! ये सब उन्हींके आत्मस्वरूप हैं। वे सर्वात्मा शिव सभीमें सर्वदा समष्टिरूपसे स्थित हैं
verses.wordMeaning: Eight classes of Devas: Gf. Aditya-viiva-vasavas-tu$ita>bh&B- varanil maharakika-sadhyas ca rudris ca ganadevat — dted in ST,
verses.commentary: Sense: Eight classes of Devas: Gf. Aditya-viiva-vasavas-tu$ita>bh&B- varanil maharakika-sadhyas ca rudris ca ganadevat — dted in ST,

verses.sanskrit: एषा कलियुगावस्था संध्यांशं तु निबोध मे युगे युगे च हीयन्ते त्रींस्त्रीन्पादांस्तु सिद्धयः
verses.transliteration: eṣā kaliyugāvasthā saṃdhyāṃśaṃ tu nibodha me yuge yuge ca hīyante trīṃstrīnpādāṃstu siddhayaḥ
verses.translation: Eight classes of Devas: Gf. Aditya-viiva-vasavas-tu$ita>bh&B- varanil maharakika-sadhyas ca rudris ca ganadevat — dted in ST,
verses.hindi: उन्हींकी मायासे मोहित होकर अज्ञानी लोग सर्वात्मरूप, महात्मा, महादेव तथा महेश्वरको नहीं जानते हैं। उन भगवान् रुद्रका शरीर ही तीनों लोक है, अतः उन्हें प्रणाम करके मैं जगतूके शुभ विस्तारका तार्य तं चक्षे जिणे शस स्स्स तं वक्ष्ये जगतां निर्णयं शुभम् ६ वर्णन करूँगा
verses.wordMeaning: Eight classes of Devas: Gf. Aditya-viiva-vasavas-tu$ita>bh&B- varanil maharakika-sadhyas ca rudris ca ganadevat — dted in ST,
verses.commentary: Sense: Eight classes of Devas: Gf. Aditya-viiva-vasavas-tu$ita>bh&B- varanil maharakika-sadhyas ca rudris ca ganadevat — dted in ST,

verses.sanskrit: युगस्वभावाः संध्यास्तु तिष्ठन्तीह तु पादशः संध्यास्वभावाः स्वांशेषु पादशस्ते प्रतिष्ठिताः
verses.transliteration: yugasvabhāvāḥ saṃdhyāstu tiṣṭhantīha tu pādaśaḥ saṃdhyāsvabhāvāḥ svāṃśeṣu pādaśaste pratiṣṭhitāḥ
verses.translation: Eight classes of Devas: Gf. Aditya-viiva-vasavas-tu$ita>bh&B- varanil maharakika-sadhyas ca rudris ca ganadevat — dted in ST,
verses.hindi: शिवमन्त्रकी दीक्षा प्राप्तकर विधिपूर्वक जप करनेके लिये यह वचन है । नामजपकी महिमाके अनुसार श्रद्धापूर्वक नामजप भी किया पुरा व: कथितं सर्व मयाण्डस्य यथा कृति: । पहले जैसा मैंने आपलोगोंसे कहा है अण्ड भुवनानां स्वरूपं च ब्रह्माण्डे कथयाम्यहम्॥ आकार और ब्रह्माण्ड तथा भुवनोंके स्वरूपको बता रह
verses.wordMeaning: Eight classes of Devas: Gf. Aditya-viiva-vasavas-tu$ita>bh&B- varanil maharakika-sadhyas ca rudris ca ganadevat — dted in ST,
verses.commentary: Sense: Eight classes of Devas: Gf. Aditya-viiva-vasavas-tu$ita>bh&B- varanil maharakika-sadhyas ca rudris ca ganadevat — dted in ST,

verses.sanskrit: एवं संध्यांशके काले सम्प्राप्ते तु युगान्तिके तेषां शास्ता ह्यसाधूनां भूतानां निधनोत्थितः
verses.transliteration: evaṃ saṃdhyāṃśake kāle samprāpte tu yugāntike teṣāṃ śāstā hyasādhūnāṃ bhūtānāṃ nidhanotthitaḥ
verses.translation: Eight classes of Devas: Gf. Aditya-viiva-vasavas-tu$ita>bh&B- varanil maharakika-sadhyas ca rudris ca ganadevat — dted in ST,
verses.hindi: तपः सत्यं च सप्तैते लोकास्त्वण्डोद्धवाः शुभा: ८  ये सात शुभ लोक अण्डसे प्रादुर्भूत हुए हैं। है ब्राह्मणे! चैतेषां उनके नीचे महातल आदि सात तल हैं। उनके भी नीचे
verses.wordMeaning: Eight classes of Devas: Gf. Aditya-viiva-vasavas-tu$ita>bh&B- varanil maharakika-sadhyas ca rudris ca ganadevat — dted in ST,
verses.commentary: Sense: Eight classes of Devas: Gf. Aditya-viiva-vasavas-tu$ita>bh&B- varanil maharakika-sadhyas ca rudris ca ganadevat — dted in ST,

verses.sanskrit: गोत्रे ऽस्मिन्वै चन्द्रमसो नाम्ना प्रमितिरुच्यते मानवस्य तु सो ऽंशेन पूर्वं स्वायंभुवे ऽन्तरे
verses.transliteration: gotre 'sminvai candramaso nāmnā pramitirucyate mānavasya tu so 'ṃśena pūrvaṃ svāyaṃbhuve 'ntare
verses.translation: Eight classes of Devas: Gf. Aditya-viiva-vasavas-tu$ita>bh&B- varanil maharakika-sadhyas ca rudris ca ganadevat — dted in ST,
verses.hindi: महातलादयस्तेषां क्रमसे नरक स्थित हैँ॥७--९॥ महातलादयस्तेषां अधस्तान्नरकाः क्रमात् हि महातल स्वर्णका बना हुआ है और यह सभी महातलं हेमतलं सर्वरलोपशोभितम्। रत्नोंसे सुशोभित है । यह अद्भुत प्रासादों तथा शिवके प्रासादेश्च॒विचित्रेश्च॒ भवस्यायतनैस्तथा
verses.wordMeaning: Eight classes of Devas: Gf. Aditya-viiva-vasavas-tu$ita>bh&B- varanil maharakika-sadhyas ca rudris ca ganadevat — dted in ST,
verses.commentary: Sense: Eight classes of Devas: Gf. Aditya-viiva-vasavas-tu$ita>bh&B- varanil maharakika-sadhyas ca rudris ca ganadevat — dted in ST,

verses.sanskrit: समाः स विंशतिः पूर्णाः पर्यटन्वै वसुंधराम् अनुकर्षन् स वै सेनां सवाजिरथकुञ्जराम्
verses.transliteration: samāḥ sa viṃśatiḥ pūrṇāḥ paryaṭanvai vasuṃdharām anukarṣan sa vai senāṃ savājirathakuñjarām
verses.translation: Eight classes of Devas: Gf. Aditya-viiva-vasavas-tu$ita>bh&B- varanil maharakika-sadhyas ca rudris ca ganadevat — dted in ST,
verses.hindi: मन्दिरोंसे युक्त है। यह अनन्त (शेषनाग), बुद्धिमान् अनन्तेन च संयुक्तं मुचुकुन्देन धीमता। मुचुकुन्द और पाताल तथा स्वर्गवासी राजा बलिसे युक्त नृपेण बलिना चैव पातालस्वर्गवासिना शैलं रसातलं विप्राः शार्करं हि तलातलम्। है विप्रो! रसातल चट्टानोंसे युक्त है, तलातल पीतं सुतलमित्युक्तं वितलं विङ्रुमप्रभम्॥ १२  बालुकामय है, सुतल पीले वर्णका कहा गया है और

verses.hindi: ग्यारह हजार योजनके विस्तारवाले हैं। सभी तलोंके (तिता मेघाच्छादित अन्तरिक्षभागको तीस हजार योजनवाला व्योम्नः प्रमाणं मूलं तु त्रिशत्साहस्रकेण तु॥ १५ माना गया है तथा इन सभी तलोंका भौगोलिक विस्तार सुवर्णेन मुनिश्रेष्ठास्तथा वासुकिना शुभम्। एक लाख सात हजार योजन है॥ १२--१५॥ रसातलमिति ख्यातं तथान्यैश्च निषेवितम्॥ १६ है मुनिश्रेष्ठो! शुभ रसातल सुवर्ण, वासुकि तथा विरोचनहिरण्याक्षनरकाद्यैश्च सेवितम्। तलातलमिति ख्यातं सर्वशोभासमन्वितम्
