verses.translation: Eight classes of Devas: Gf. Aditya-viiva-vasavas-tu$ita>bh&B- varanil maharakika-sadhyas ca rudris ca ganadevat — dted in ST,
verses.hindi: मेधातिथिके प्लक्षद्वीपनिवासी उन पुत्रोंद्वारा वर्णाश्रम- धर्मसे सम्पन्न प्रजाएँ वहाँ बसायी गयीं। प्लक्षद्वीप तथा शाकद्वीप आदि पाँचौं द्वीपोंमें वर्ण एवं आश्रमके धर्मोका सम्यक् पालन होता था। है श्रेष्ठ द्विजो! इन पाँचों द्वीपोंमें सुख, आयु, स्वरूप, बल तथा धर्म सबके लिये समान बताया गया है। सभी लोग सदा रुद्रके अर्चनमें लीन रहते हैं तथा महेश्वरमें भक्ति रखते हैं । पुष्कर-द्वीपमें अन्य जो प्रजाएँ एवं राजा हैं, वे सब प्रजापालक रुद्रके श्रद्धारूपी
verses.wordMeaning: Eight classes of Devas: Gf. Aditya-viiva-vasavas-tu$ita>bh&B- varanil maharakika-sadhyas ca rudris ca ganadevat — dted in ST,
verses.commentary: Sense: Eight classes of Devas: Gf. Aditya-viiva-vasavas-tu$ita>bh&B- varanil maharakika-sadhyas ca rudris ca ganadevat — dted in ST,

verses.sanskrit: तुल्याभिमानिनः सर्वे नामरूपैर्भवन्त्युत देवा ह्यष्टविधा ये च ये च मन्वन्तरेश्वराः
verses.transliteration: tulyābhimāninaḥ sarve nāmarūpairbhavantyuta devā hyaṣṭavidhā ye ca ye ca manvantareśvarāḥ
verses.translation: Eight classes of Devas: Gf. Aditya-viiva-vasavas-tu$ita>bh&B- varanil maharakika-sadhyas ca rudris ca ganadevat — dted in ST,
verses.hindi: अमृतपानके सुखको प्रबल इच्छा रखते हैं ॥ ४५--४९॥ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ
verses.wordMeaning: Eight classes of Devas: Gf. Aditya-viiva-vasavas-tu$ita>bh&B- varanil maharakika-sadhyas ca rudris ca ganadevat — dted in ST,
verses.commentary: Sense: Eight classes of Devas: Gf. Aditya-viiva-vasavas-tu$ita>bh&B- varanil maharakika-sadhyas ca rudris ca ganadevat — dted in ST,

verses.sanskrit: ऋषयो मनवश्चैव सर्वे तुल्यप्रयोजनाः एवं वर्णाश्रमाणां तु प्रविभागो युगे युगे
verses.transliteration: ṛṣayo manavaścaiva sarve tulyaprayojanāḥ evaṃ varṇāśramāṇāṃ tu pravibhāgo yuge yuge
verses.translation: Eight classes of Devas: Gf. Aditya-viiva-vasavas-tu$ita>bh&B- varanil maharakika-sadhyas ca rudris ca ganadevat — dted in ST,
verses.hindi: जम्बूद्वीपके अधिपति प्रियव्रतके पुत्र महाराज आग्नीध्वका वंशवर्णन तथा आग्नीध्के शिवभक्त नौ पुत्रोंका अजनाभवर्ष ( भारतवर्ष ), किम्पुरुषवर्ष आदि नौ वर्षो ( देशों )-का स्वामी बनना आरनीध्चं ज्येष्ठदायादं काम्यपुत्र महाबलम्। प्रियव्रतोऽभ्यषिञ्चद्वै जम्बूद्वीपेश्‍वरं नृपः
verses.wordMeaning: Eight classes of Devas: Gf. Aditya-viiva-vasavas-tu$ita>bh&B- varanil maharakika-sadhyas ca rudris ca ganadevat — dted in ST,
verses.commentary: Sense: Eight classes of Devas: Gf. Aditya-viiva-vasavas-tu$ita>bh&B- varanil maharakika-sadhyas ca rudris ca ganadevat — dted in ST,

verses.sanskrit: युगस्वभावश् च तथा विधत्ते वै तदा प्रभुः वर्णाश्रमविभागाश् च युगानि युगसिद्धयः
verses.transliteration: yugasvabhāvaś ca tathā vidhatte vai tadā prabhuḥ varṇāśramavibhāgāś ca yugāni yugasiddhayaḥ
verses.translation: Eight classes of Devas: Gf. Aditya-viiva-vasavas-tu$ita>bh&B- varanil maharakika-sadhyas ca rudris ca ganadevat — dted in ST,
verses.hindi: भवार्चनरतः श्रीमान् गोमान् धीमान् द्विजर्षभाः ॥ २ तरुण, सदा शिवपूजनमें सूतजी बोले- राजा प्रियव्रतने अपने ज्येष्ट उत्तराधिकारी महाबली प्रिय पुत्र आग्नीध्रको जम्बूढीपके राजाके रूपमें अभिषिक्त किया
verses.wordMeaning: Eight classes of Devas: Gf. Aditya-viiva-vasavas-tu$ita>bh&B- varanil maharakika-sadhyas ca rudris ca ganadevat — dted in ST,
verses.commentary: Sense: Eight classes of Devas: Gf. Aditya-viiva-vasavas-tu$ita>bh&B- varanil maharakika-sadhyas ca rudris ca ganadevat — dted in ST,

verses.sanskrit: युगानां परिमाणं ते कथितं हि प्रसङ्गतः वदामि देवीपुत्रत्वं पद्मयोनेः समासतः
verses.transliteration: yugānāṃ parimāṇaṃ te kathitaṃ hi prasaṅgataḥ vadāmi devīputratvaṃ padmayoneḥ samāsataḥ
verses.translation: Eight classes of Devas: Gf. Aditya-viiva-vasavas-tu$ita>bh&B- varanil maharakika-sadhyas ca rudris ca ganadevat — dted in ST,
verses.hindi: हे श्रेष्ठ ब्राह्मणो! वह महान् शिवभक्त, तपस्वी, अध्याय ४७ जम्बूद्दीपके अधिपति प्रियव्रतके पुत्र महाराज आग्नीधका वंशवर्णन २०७
verses.wordMeaning: Eight classes of Devas: Gf. Aditya-viiva-vasavas-tu$ita>bh&B- varanil maharakika-sadhyas ca rudris ca ganadevat — dted in ST,
verses.commentary: Sense: Eight classes of Devas: Gf. Aditya-viiva-vasavas-tu$ita>bh&B- varanil maharakika-sadhyas ca rudris ca ganadevat — dted in ST,

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीलिङ्गमहापुराणे पूर्वभागे चतुर्युगपरिमाणं नाम चत्वारिंशो ऽध्यायः पुनः ससर्ज भगवान् प्रभ्रष्टाः पूर्ववत्प्रजाः सहस्रयुगपर्यन्ते प्रभाते तु पितामहः
verses.transliteration: iti śrīliṅgamahāpurāṇe pūrvabhāge caturyugaparimāṇaṃ nāma catvāriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ punaḥ sasarja bhagavān prabhraṣṭāḥ pūrvavatprajāḥ sahasrayugaparyante prabhāte tu pitāmahaḥ
verses.translation: When the period of a thousand yugas lapsed and it was morning for him, lord Brahma created once again the subjects who had fallen off, in the same manner as they were before.
verses.hindi: फफफफफीफ फरक्का फक फफक फफ फफफ सर्वे माहेश्वराश्चैव महादेवपरायणाः॥
verses.wordMeaning: When the period of a thousand yugas lapsed and it was morning for him, lord Brahma created once again the subjects who had fallen off, in the same manner as they were before.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the period of a thousand yugas lapsed and it was morning for him, lord Brahma created once again the subjects who had fallen off, in the same manner as they were before.

verses.sanskrit: एवं परार्धे विप्रेन्द्र द्विगुणे तु तथा गते तदा धराम्भसि व्याप्ता ह्य् आपो वह्नौ समीरणे
verses.transliteration: evaṃ parārdhe viprendra dviguṇe tu tathā gate tadā dharāmbhasi vyāptā hy āpo vahnau samīraṇe
verses.translation: O leading brahmin, when thus the period of twice Parardha lapsed, the earth merged into the water, the water into the fire, the fire into the wind, the wind into the ether along with the tanmatras. O excellent brahmin, eleven sense-organs and the tanmatras merged into the ego lo! in a trice. Ego merged into intellect (mahat) in a moment. O brahmin, the intellect also attained the unmanifest (avyakta) and merged into it. The unmanifest became merged into the lord along with its Gunas. Thereafter creation took place as before from Purusa §iva.268 Then the mental sons were created by him by mere thinking.
verses.hindi: नवमः केतुमालस्तु तेषां देशान्निबोधत। नाभेस्तु दक्षिणं वर्ष हेमाख्यं तु पिता ददौ गन्धमादनवर्ष तु केतुमालाय दत्तवान्
verses.wordMeaning: O leading brahmin, when thus the period of twice Parardha lapsed, the earth merged into the water, the water into the fire, the fire into the wind, the wind into the ether along with the tanmatras. O excellent brahmin,…
verses.commentary: Sense: O leading brahmin, when thus the period of twice Parardha lapsed, the earth merged into the water, the water into the fire, the fire into the wind, the wind into the ether along with the tanmatras. O excellent brahmin,…

verses.sanskrit: वह्निः समीरणश्चैव व्योम्नि तन्मात्रसंयुतः इन्द्रियाणि दशैकं च तन्मात्राणि द्विजोत्तम
verses.transliteration: vahniḥ samīraṇaścaiva vyomni tanmātrasaṃyutaḥ indriyāṇi daśaikaṃ ca tanmātrāṇi dvijottama
verses.translation: The subjects thus created by the lotus-born deity did not flourish in this world. For the purpose of increase, lord Brahma performed a penance with the supreme lord in view, in the company of his mental sons. The great lord was pleased by their penance. Realising Brahma's desire, the lord pierced through the middle of Brahma's forehead. Saying 'T am your son" he then became male-cum- female in his form.
verses.hindi: अनेक गायोंका स्वामी तथा बुद्धिमान् था उसके प्रजापतिके समान नौ पुत्र हुए। वे सभी शिवभक्त तथा शिवपरायण थे
verses.wordMeaning: The subjects thus created by the lotus-born deity did not flourish in this world. For the purpose of increase, lord Brahma performed a penance with the supreme lord in view, in the company of his mental sons. The great lord was pleased by their penance.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The subjects thus created by the lotus-born deity did not flourish in this world. For the purpose of increase, lord Brahma performed a penance with the supreme lord in view, in the company of his mental sons. The great lord was pleased by their penance.…

verses.sanskrit: अहङ्कारमनुप्राप्य प्रलीनास्तत्क्षणादहो अभिमानस्तदा तत्र महान्तं व्याप्य वै क्षणात्
verses.transliteration: ahaṅkāramanuprāpya pralīnāstatkṣaṇādaho abhimānastadā tatra mahāntaṃ vyāpya vai kṣaṇāt
verses.translation: The lord with half-female body became his son. Then the lord burnt Brahma, the preceptor of the universe. Thereafter for the purpose of the flourishing increase of the worlds the lord adopted the yogic path and enjoyed his own prosperous semi- Matra, ParameSvari. He created Visnu and Brahma in her. The lord of the universe, the soul of the universe, created the Pasupata missile too. Hence Vi§nu and Brahma were born of the part of Mahadevl. Thus Brahma who was the Egg-born, and the lotus- born was born also of the body of the lord.®® Thus, in brief, the
verses.hindi: उनमें ज्येष्ठ पुत्र नाभि नामसे प्रसिद्ध था। उसके छोटे भाईका नाम किम्पुरुष था। तीसरा पुत्र हरिवर्ष तथा छठा पुत्र कहा जाता है। कुरु उनमें सातवाँ था और भद्राश्व आठवाँ पुत्र कहा गया है। नौवाँ केतुमाल था। अब उनके देशोंके विषयमें सुनिये ॥ ४-५/३ ॥
verses.wordMeaning: The lord with half-female body became his son. Then the lord burnt Brahma, the preceptor of the universe. Thereafter for the purpose of the flourishing increase of the worlds the lord adopted the yogic path and enjoyed his own prosperous semi- Matra, ParameSvari.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The lord with half-female body became his son. Then the lord burnt Brahma, the preceptor of the universe. Thereafter for the purpose of the flourishing increase of the worlds the lord adopted the yogic path and enjoyed his own prosperous semi- Matra, ParameSvari.…

verses.sanskrit: महानपि तथा व्यक्तं प्राप्य लीनो ऽभवद्द्विज अव्यक्तं स्वगुणैः सार्धं प्रलीनमभवद्भवे
verses.transliteration: mahānapi tathā vyaktaṃ prāpya līno 'bhavaddvija avyaktaṃ svaguṇaiḥ sārdhaṃ pralīnamabhavadbhave
verses.translation: At first there was nothing except Prakrti and Puru$a (i.e. Siva and Maya). Then Siva created twcntyfive tattvas out of hknself. Gf,
verses.hindi: पिताने ज्येष्ठ पुत्र नाभिको दक्षिणमें स्थित हेम जो वर्ष था, उसे किम्मुरुषको दिया। नैषध नामक जो वर्ष कहा गया है, उसे पिताने हरिको दे दिया
verses.wordMeaning: At first there was nothing except Prakrti and Puru$a (i.e. Siva and Maya). Then Siva created twcntyfive tattvas out of hknself. Gf,
verses.commentary: Sense: At first there was nothing except Prakrti and Puru$a (i.e. Siva and Maya). Then Siva created twcntyfive tattvas out of hknself. Gf,

verses.sanskrit: ततः सृष्टिरभूत्तस्मात् पूर्ववत्पुरुषाच्छिवात् अथ सृष्टास्तदा तस्य मनसा तेन मानसाः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sṛṣṭirabhūttasmāt pūrvavatpuruṣācchivāt atha sṛṣṭāstadā tasya manasā tena mānasāḥ
verses.translation: Brahma is bom of (i) the Cosmic Egg, (ii) the lotus, as well as (iii) the body of Siva.
verses.hindi: पिताने मेरु पर्वतसे आवृत मध्य देश इलावृतको दिया और नीलाचल नामक वर्ष रम्यको दिया। पिताने हिरण्मानूको उत्तरमें स्थित श्वेत नामक वर्ष दिया और उत्तरमें जो श्रृंगवर्ष है, उसे उन्होंने कुरु नामक पुत्रको दिया। इसी प्रकार उन्होंने भद्राश्‍वको माल्यवानूवर्ष दिया और केतुमालको गन्धमादनवर्ष दिया
verses.wordMeaning: Brahma is bom of (i) the Cosmic Egg, (ii) the lotus, as well as (iii) the body of Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: Brahma is bom of (i) the Cosmic Egg, (ii) the lotus, as well as (iii) the body of Siva.

verses.sanskrit: न व्यवर्धन्त लोके ऽस्मिन् प्रजाः कमलयोनिना वृद्ध्यर्थं भगवान्ब्रह्मा पुत्रैर्वै मानसैः सह
verses.transliteration: na vyavardhanta loke 'smin prajāḥ kamalayoninā vṛddhyarthaṃ bhagavānbrahmā putrairvai mānasaiḥ saha
verses.translation: In the middle of its pericarp he installed the lord. Then Brahma, the self-controlled who had purified his soul by perfect restraint of his senses installed the great lord Siva in his heart. The lord was situated there in a space as small as the hundred part of the thread of the lotus stalk**® by repeating *om' in a series of half measures of time. He who was worthy of wor- ship himself, then propitiated the unchanging lord(i.e. Siva) by means of flowers of restraint etc.*'* Then at the behest of the Ivara situated in the heart-lotus (of Brahma) the all- pervading lord bom of the body of Bhava came out of Brahma by piercing through his forehead.
verses.hindi: विभागके अनुसार ये नौ महान् वर्ष हैं। धर्मात्मा राजा आग्नीध्र उन वर्षोमें अपने उन पुत्रोंको राजपदपर क्रमानुसार अभिषिक्त करके तपस्यामें रत हो गये। तपसे अपनेको शुद्ध करनेके अनन्तर वे स्वाध्यायमें संलग्न हो गये और स्वाध्यायमें रत रहनेवाले वे बादमें शिवके ध्यानमें निमग्न हो गये॥ ११-१२/२॥
verses.wordMeaning: In the middle of its pericarp he installed the lord. Then Brahma, the self-controlled who had purified his soul by perfect restraint of his senses installed the great lord Siva in his heart.…
verses.commentary: Sense: In the middle of its pericarp he installed the lord. Then Brahma, the self-controlled who had purified his soul by perfect restraint of his senses installed the great lord Siva in his heart.…

verses.sanskrit: दुश्चरं विचचारेशं समुद्दिश्य तपः स्वयम् तुष्टस्तु तपसा तस्य भवो ज्ञात्वा स वाञ्छितम्
verses.transliteration: duścaraṃ vicacāreśaṃ samuddiśya tapaḥ svayam tuṣṭastu tapasā tasya bhavo jñātvā sa vāñchitam
verses.translation: O great sage, Brahma, the soul of the universe eulogised the lord who was delighted in his mind and who had the uni- verse as his form by means of the Ntka — the set of eight names.
verses.hindi: किम्पुरुष आदि जो आठ शुभ वर्ष थे, उनमें स्वभावतः बिना प्रयत्नके ही सुखमय सिद्धि थी। उनमें किसी प्रकारका विपरीत भाव नहीं था और  प्रजाओंमें  बुढ़ापे तथा मृत्युका भय नहीं था। उनमें न धर्म था न अधर्म और उत्तम, मध्यम तथा अधम--ये भाव नहीं थे। उन आठौं क्षेत्रोंमें हर प्रकारसे युगकी अवस्था नहीं थी॥ १३--१५॥
verses.wordMeaning: O great sage, Brahma, the soul of the universe eulogised the lord who was delighted in his mind and who had the uni- verse as his form by means of the Ntka — the set of eight names.
verses.commentary: Sense: O great sage, Brahma, the soul of the universe eulogised the lord who was delighted in his mind and who had the uni- verse as his form by means of the Ntka — the set of eight names.

verses.sanskrit: ललाटमध्यं निर्भिद्य ब्रह्मणः पुरुषस्य तु पुत्रस्नेहमिति प्रोच्य स्त्रीपुंरूपो ऽभवत्तदा
verses.transliteration: lalāṭamadhyaṃ nirbhidya brahmaṇaḥ puruṣasya tu putrasnehamiti procya strīpuṃrūpo 'bhavattadā
verses.translation: O lord Rudray obeisance to you of unmeasured splendour like the sun. Obeisance to you lord Bhava identical with water and taste. Perpetual obeisance to &afva who has the form of earth and smell. Obeisance to you, Uky identical with air and the quality of touch. Obeisance to Paiupati the lord of individual souls, identical with fire of excessive splendour. Obeisance to you, Bhimay identical with ether having the quality of sound. Obeisance to Mahadevay identical with the moon — the abode of nectar. Obeisance to you, Ugray theYajamana (one who performs sacrifice) who is the agent for all actions.**
verses.hindi: रुद्रक्षेत्रमें जो भी स्थावर, जंगम, भक्त अथवा अस्थायी आगन्तुक प्राणी मृत होते हैं, वे उन्हीं क्षेत्रोमें जाते हैं रुद्रने उनके कल्याणके लिये ही आठौं क्षेत्रोंका निर्माण किया है। बहाँपर महादेव सदा उनका सान्निध्य यथाक्रमं स धर्मात्मा ततस्तु तपसि स्थितः।
verses.wordMeaning: O lord Rudray obeisance to you of unmeasured splendour like the sun. Obeisance to you lord Bhava identical with water and taste. Perpetual obeisance to &afva who has the form of earth and smell. Obeisance to you, Uky identical with air and the quality of touch.…
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord Rudray obeisance to you of unmeasured splendour like the sun. Obeisance to you lord Bhava identical with water and taste. Perpetual obeisance to &afva who has the form of earth and smell. Obeisance to you, Uky identical with air and the quality of touch.…

verses.sanskrit: तस्य पुत्रो महादेवो ह्य् अर्धनारीश्वरो ऽभवत् ददाह भगवान्सर्वं ब्रह्माणं च जगद्गुरुम्
verses.transliteration: tasya putro mahādevo hy ardhanārīśvaro 'bhavat dadāha bhagavānsarvaṃ brahmāṇaṃ ca jagadgurum
verses.translation: He who reads this hymn sung by Brahma unto Rudra, he who listens to this or he who narrates this to brahmins with great concentration will attain identity with the lord of eight cosmic bodies, within a year. After eulogising thus, Brahma looked at the great lord.
verses.hindi: धर्माधर्मौ न तेष्वास्तां नोत्तमाधममध्यमाः । न तेष्वस्ति युगावस्था क्षेत्रेष्वष्टसु सर्वतः रुद्रक्षेत्रे मृताश्चैव जङ्गमाः स्थावरास्तथा । भक्ताः प्रासङ्गिकाश्चापि तेषु क्षेत्रेषु यान्ति ते
verses.wordMeaning: He who reads this hymn sung by Brahma unto Rudra, he who listens to this or he who narrates this to brahmins with great concentration will attain identity with the lord of eight cosmic bodies, within a year. After eulogising thus, Brahma looked at the great lord.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who reads this hymn sung by Brahma unto Rudra, he who listens to this or he who narrates this to brahmins with great concentration will attain identity with the lord of eight cosmic bodies, within a year. After eulogising thus, Brahma looked at the great lord.

verses.sanskrit: अथार्धमात्रां कल्याणीम् आत्मनः परमेश्वरीम् बुभुजे योगमार्गेण वृद्ध्यर्थं जगतां शिवः
verses.transliteration: athārdhamātrāṃ kalyāṇīm ātmanaḥ parameśvarīm bubhuje yogamārgeṇa vṛddhyarthaṃ jagatāṃ śivaḥ
verses.translation: The great lord stood with the eight forms spread all round. The sun shone. So also the fire and the moon. There were earth, wind, water, ether and yajamana — the sacrificcr. Ever since that time they call Isvara, Astamurti.
verses.hindi: तेषां हिताय रुद्रेण चाष्टक्षेत्रं विनिर्मितम्। तत्र तेषां महादेवः सान्निध्यं कुरुते सदा दृष्ट्वा हृदि महादेवमष्टक्षेत्रनिवासिनः । सुखिनः सर्वदा तेषां स एवेह परा गति:
verses.wordMeaning: The great lord stood with the eight forms spread all round. The sun shone. So also the fire and the moon. There were earth, wind, water, ether and yajamana — the sacrificcr. Ever since that time they call Isvara, Astamurti.
verses.commentary: Sense: The great lord stood with the eight forms spread all round. The sun shone. So also the fire and the moon. There were earth, wind, water, ether and yajamana — the sacrificcr. Ever since that time they call Isvara, Astamurti.

verses.sanskrit: तस्यां हरिं च ब्रह्माणं ससर्ज परमेश्वरः विश्वेश्वरस्तु विश्वात्मा चास्त्रं पाशुपतं तथा
verses.transliteration: tasyāṃ hariṃ ca brahmāṇaṃ sasarja parameśvaraḥ viśveśvarastu viśvātmā cāstraṃ pāśupataṃ tathā
verses.translation: Eight names of Siva. SP. Vi<fy$ivara-samhitd (Gh. 20. 47} mentions eight names as Hara, Maheivara, Sambhu, iSulapHii, Pin&kadhrk, Siva, Paiupati and Mah&deva. But Lihga has a different list, represented by the the eight forms of $iva.
verses.hindi: नाभेर्निसर्ग वक्ष्यामि हिमाङ्केऽस्मिन्निबोधत। नाभिस्त्वजनयत्पुत्रं मेरुदेव्यां महामतिः आठों क्षेत्रोके निवासी  अपने हृदयमें देखकर सदा सुखी रहते हैं। वे महादेव ही उनकी परम गति हैं
verses.wordMeaning: Eight names of Siva. SP. Vi<fy$ivara-samhitd (Gh. 20. 47} mentions eight names as Hara, Maheivara, Sambhu, iSulapHii, Pin&kadhrk, Siva, Paiupati and Mah&deva. But Lihga has a different list, represented by the the eight forms of $iva.
verses.commentary: Sense: Eight names of Siva. SP. Vi<fy$ivara-samhitd (Gh. 20. 47} mentions eight names as Hara, Maheivara, Sambhu, iSulapHii, Pin&kadhrk, Siva, Paiupati and Mah&deva. But Lihga has a different list, represented by the the eight forms of $iva.

verses.sanskrit: तस्माद्ब्रह्मा महादेव्याश् चांशजश् च हरिस् तथा अण्डजः पद्मजश्चैव भवाङ्गभव एव च
verses.transliteration: tasmādbrahmā mahādevyāś cāṃśajaś ca haris tathā aṇḍajaḥ padmajaścaiva bhavāṅgabhava eva ca
verses.translation: Even when he performed the penance thus, nothing happened. After a great deal of time he became miserable and his sorrow turned into anger.
verses.hindi: अब मैं हिमसे चिहित इस हिमालय-में विद्यमान नाभिके वंशका वर्णन करूँगा, आपलोग सुनें। महाबुद्धि नाभिने मेरुदेवीसे राजाओंमें श्रेष्ठ तथा सभी राजाओसे पूजित ऋषभ नामक पुत्रको उत्पन्न किया । ऋषभे पराक्रमी भरत उत्पन्न हुए, जो उनके सौ पुत्रोंमें सबसे बडे थे
verses.wordMeaning: Even when he performed the penance thus, nothing happened. After a great deal of time he became miserable and his sorrow turned into anger.
verses.commentary: Sense: Even when he performed the penance thus, nothing happened. After a great deal of time he became miserable and his sorrow turned into anger.

verses.sanskrit: एतत्ते कथितं सर्वम् इतिहासं पुरातनम् परार्धं ब्रह्मणो यावत् तावद्भूतिः समासतः
verses.transliteration: etatte kathitaṃ sarvam itihāsaṃ purātanam parārdhaṃ brahmaṇo yāvat tāvadbhūtiḥ samāsataḥ
verses.translation: When he was overwhelmed with anger, drops of tears fell from his eyes. From those drops of tears goblins and ghosts originated.
verses.hindi: उन पुत्रवत्सल क्रषभने भरतका राज्याभिषेक करके ज्ञान-वैराग्यका आश्रय लेकर सर्परूप इन्द्रियोंपर विजय प्राप्त करके परमात्मा ईश्वरको पूर्णरूपसे अपनेमें स्थापितकर होकर वनमें प्रवेश किया । उन्होंने समस्त आशाओंसे रहित तथा सन्देहमुक्त होकर शिवका परम पद प्राप्त
verses.wordMeaning: When he was overwhelmed with anger, drops of tears fell from his eyes. From those drops of tears goblins and ghosts originated.
verses.commentary: Sense: When he was overwhelmed with anger, drops of tears fell from his eyes. From those drops of tears goblins and ghosts originated.

verses.sanskrit: वैराग्यं ब्रह्मणो वक्ष्ये तमोद्भूतं समासतः नारायणो ऽपि भगवान् द्विधा कृत्वात्मनस्तनुम्
verses.transliteration: vairāgyaṃ brahmaṇo vakṣye tamodbhūtaṃ samāsataḥ nārāyaṇo 'pi bhagavān dvidhā kṛtvātmanastanum
verses.translation: Thereupon, the infuriated lord Brahma, abandoned his life. Thereafter, Rudra in the form of Prana ( vital breath) appeared through the mouth of lord Brahma.
verses.hindi: उन्होंने हिमालय पर्वतके दक्षिणमें स्थित वर्ष भरतको प्रदान किया था, इसीलिये विठ्ठान् लोग उनके नामसे उसे भारतवर्ष कहते हैं ॥ २३ /२॥ भरतके सुमति नामक विद्वान् तथा धार्मिक पुत्र हुए। भरतने वह राज्य उन्हें सौंप दिया । पुत्रको राज्य प्रदान
verses.wordMeaning: Thereupon, the infuriated lord Brahma, abandoned his life. Thereafter, Rudra in the form of Prana ( vital breath) appeared through the mouth of lord Brahma.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereupon, the infuriated lord Brahma, abandoned his life. Thereafter, Rudra in the form of Prana ( vital breath) appeared through the mouth of lord Brahma.

verses.sanskrit: ससर्ज सकलं तस्मात् स्वाङ्गादेव चराचरम् ततो ब्रह्माणमसृजद् ब्रह्मा रुद्रं पितामहः
verses.transliteration: sasarja sakalaṃ tasmāt svāṅgādeva carācaram tato brahmāṇamasṛjad brahmā rudraṃ pitāmahaḥ
verses.translation: The lord, having a lustre resembling that of the rising sun became Ardhanarisvara ( male-cum-female form).. He divided himself into eleven' parts and settled down there.
verses.hindi: पुत्रसङ्क्रामितश्रीको वनं राजा विवेश स: ॥ २५  करके वे राजा  भरत वनमें प्रविष्ट हुए भूमध्यमें स्थित मेरु ( सुमेरु ) पर्वत और इन्द्र आदि लोकपालोंकी पुरियोंका वर्णन
verses.wordMeaning: The lord, having a lustre resembling that of the rising sun became Ardhanarisvara ( male-cum-female form).. He divided himself into eleven' parts and settled down there.
verses.commentary: Sense: The lord, having a lustre resembling that of the rising sun became Ardhanarisvara ( male-cum-female form).. He divided himself into eleven' parts and settled down there.

verses.sanskrit: मुने कल्पान्तरे रुद्रो हरिं ब्रह्माणम् ईश्वरम् ततो ब्रह्माणमसृजन् मुने कल्पान्तरे हरिः
verses.transliteration: mune kalpāntare rudro hariṃ brahmāṇam īśvaram tato brahmāṇamasṛjan mune kalpāntare hariḥ
verses.translation: With half a portion of himself Ardhanarisvara, the soul of all, created Uma. She created Laksmi, Durga and Saras- vati.
verses.hindi: चतुराशीतिसाहस्रमुत्सेधेन प्रकीर्तितः । सूतजी बोले-इस ट्वीपके मध्यमें मेरु नामक महान् पर्वत है। पर्वतोंमें श्रेष्ठ यह अनेक प्रकारे रलोसे पूर्ण शिखरोंसे युक्त होकर स्थित है
verses.wordMeaning: With half a portion of himself Ardhanarisvara, the soul of all, created Uma. She created Laksmi, Durga and Saras- vati.
verses.commentary: Sense: With half a portion of himself Ardhanarisvara, the soul of all, created Uma. She created Laksmi, Durga and Saras- vati.

verses.sanskrit: नारायणं पुनर्ब्रह्मा ब्रह्माणं च पुनर्भवः तदा विचार्य वै ब्रह्मा दुःखं संसार इत्यजः
verses.transliteration: nārāyaṇaṃ punarbrahmā brahmāṇaṃ ca punarbhavaḥ tadā vicārya vai brahmā duḥkhaṃ saṃsāra ityajaḥ
verses.translation: (She further created) Varna, Raudri, Mahamaya, Vaisnavi the lotus-eyed goddess, Kalavikarim, Kali residing in the lotu.s, goddess Balavikarini, Balapramathinf, Sarvabhuatada- man!, (the suppressor of all living beings) and Manonmani. Similarly thousands of other women were created by her. Accom- panied by those ladies and the Rudras, Mahadeva,ParameSvara the lord of the three worlds stood in front of lord Brahma Paramesthin who was the soul of all but was now lying dead.
verses.hindi: यह चौरासी हजार योजन ऊँचाईवाला कही गया है। यह सोलह हजार योजन पृथ्वीके प्रविष्ट है और सोलह हजार योजन ही फैला हुआ है! अध्याय ४८  भूमध्यमें स्थित मेरु ( सुमेरु ) पर्वत और इन्द्र आदि लोकपालोंकी पुरियोंका वर्णन
verses.wordMeaning: (She further created) Varna, Raudri, Mahamaya, Vaisnavi the lotus-eyed goddess, Kalavikarim, Kali residing in the lotu.s, goddess Balavikarini, Balapramathinf, Sarvabhuatada- man!, (the suppressor of all living beings) and Manonmani.…
verses.commentary: Sense: (She further created) Varna, Raudri, Mahamaya, Vaisnavi the lotus-eyed goddess, Kalavikarim, Kali residing in the lotu.s, goddess Balavikarini, Balapramathinf, Sarvabhuatada- man!, (the suppressor of all living beings) and Manonmani.…

verses.sanskrit: सर्गं विसृज्य चात्मानम् आत्मन्येव नियोज्य च संहृत्य प्राणसञ्चारं पाषाण इव निश्चलः
verses.transliteration: sargaṃ visṛjya cātmānam ātmanyeva niyojya ca saṃhṛtya prāṇasañcāraṃ pāṣāṇa iva niścalaḥ
verses.translation: Lord MaheSvara, the sympathetic son of Brahma, granted him vital airs.
verses.hindi: फ़ की फ फ फ फ का फ क क फ फ फ फ फा फ फ फ फ फ फ फ फ फ फा र फ फ फ फ फक फफ फ़ फफफ फ फ फफ फफ फफ फ फ फा माका माका फफक हैमीकृतो महेशस्य शुभाङ्गस्पर्शनेन च। धत्तूरपुष्पसङ्काशः
verses.wordMeaning: Lord MaheSvara, the sympathetic son of Brahma, granted him vital airs.
verses.commentary: Sense: Lord MaheSvara, the sympathetic son of Brahma, granted him vital airs.

verses.sanskrit: दशवर्षसहस्राणि समाधिस्थो ऽभवत्प्रभुः अधोमुखं तु यत्पद्मं हृदि संस्थं सुशोभनम्
verses.transliteration: daśavarṣasahasrāṇi samādhistho 'bhavatprabhuḥ adhomukhaṃ tu yatpadmaṃ hṛdi saṃsthaṃ suśobhanam
verses.translation: Then Rudra the lord of Devas was delighted and he spoke these pleasant words to Brahma who regained his life a little.
verses.hindi: क्रीडाभूमिश्च देवानामनेकाश्चर्यसंयुतः । पश्चिमे नीलसङ्काश उत्तरे विद्रुमप्रभः
verses.wordMeaning: Then Rudra the lord of Devas was delighted and he spoke these pleasant words to Brahma who regained his life a little.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then Rudra the lord of Devas was delighted and he spoke these pleasant words to Brahma who regained his life a little.

verses.sanskrit: पूरितं पूरकेणैव प्रबुद्धं चाभवत्तदा तदूर्ध्ववक्त्रम् अभवत् कुम्भकेन निरोधितम्
verses.transliteration: pūritaṃ pūrakeṇaiva prabuddhaṃ cābhavattadā tadūrdhvavaktram abhavat kumbhakena nirodhitam
verses.translation: O highly blessed lord Brahma, O preceptor of the worlds do not be afraid; the vital airs have been established here in your heart. Hence, O lord get up.
verses.hindi: नानादेवगणैः कीर्णा मणिजालसमावृता गोपुरैरविविधाकारहैमरत्नविभूषितैः । तोरणैहेमचित्रैस्तु मणिक्लुप्तैः पथि स्थितैः
verses.wordMeaning: O highly blessed lord Brahma, O preceptor of the worlds do not be afraid; the vital airs have been established here in your heart. Hence, O lord get up.
verses.commentary: Sense: O highly blessed lord Brahma, O preceptor of the worlds do not be afraid; the vital airs have been established here in your heart. Hence, O lord get up.

verses.sanskrit: तत्पद्मकर्णिकामध्ये स्थापयामास चेश्वरम् तदोमिति शिवं देवम् अर्धमात्रापरं परम्
verses.transliteration: tatpadmakarṇikāmadhye sthāpayāmāsa ceśvaram tadomiti śivaṃ devam ardhamātrāparaṃ param
verses.translation: ek&(iaiadh&: in eleven forms, as stated in Vifnu (dted in ST). They are named Aja-ekapad, Ahirbudhnya, Tvatr* Rudra, Hara, Tryam- baka, Aparijita, Vrakapi, Sambhu, Kapardin and Raivata. Other PuraijAa give different lists. For detail, see Matpurdioa — A study, p -67*
verses.hindi: स्त्रीसहरूैः समाकीर्णा चाप्सरोभिः समन्ततः । दीर्धिकाभिर्विचित्राभिः फुल्लाम्भोरुहसङ्कलैः नीलोत्पलैशचोत्पलैशच हैमैश्चापि सुगन्धिभिः
verses.wordMeaning: ek&(iaiadh&: in eleven forms, as stated in Vifnu (dted in ST). They are named Aja-ekapad, Ahirbudhnya, Tvatr* Rudra, Hara, Tryam- baka, Aparijita, Vrakapi, Sambhu, Kapardin and Raivata. Other PuraijAa give different lists. For detail, see Matpurdioa — A study, p -67*
verses.commentary: Sense: ek&(iaiadh&: in eleven forms, as stated in Vifnu (dted in ST). They are named Aja-ekapad, Ahirbudhnya, Tvatr* Rudra, Hara, Tryam- baka, Aparijita, Vrakapi, Sambhu, Kapardin and Raivata. Other PuraijAa give different lists. For detail, see Matpurdioa — A study, p -67*

verses.sanskrit: मृणालतन्तुभागैकशतभागे व्यवस्थितम् यमी यमविशुद्धात्मा नियम्यैवं हृदीश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: mṛṇālatantubhāgaikaśatabhāge vyavasthitam yamī yamaviśuddhātmā niyamyaivaṃ hṛdīśvaram
verses.translation: On hearing his words as though in dreams passing through his mind Brahma bc;:ame delighted in his heart. With the vital airs coming back to him, he looked at Mahevara with his eyes that had the lustre of full blown lotus. After glancing up at him for a long time, lord Brahma got up and said with palms joined in reverence in a tone affectionate and majestic.
verses.hindi: एवंविधैस्तटाकैशच नदीभिश्च नहैर्युता। यह एक चौडे शराव (कसोरा)-के समान स्थित है और बत्तीस हजार योजन चोटीपर फैला हुआ है । इसका घेरा इसके विस्तारसे तीन गुना है
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing his words as though in dreams passing through his mind Brahma bc;:ame delighted in his heart. With the vital airs coming back to him, he looked at Mahevara with his eyes that had the lustre of full blown lotus. After glancing up at him for a long time,…
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing his words as though in dreams passing through his mind Brahma bc;:ame delighted in his heart. With the vital airs coming back to him, he looked at Mahevara with his eyes that had the lustre of full blown lotus. After glancing up at him for a long time,…

verses.sanskrit: यमपुष्पादिभिः पूज्यं याज्यो ह्ययजदव्ययम् तस्य हृत्कमलस्थस्य नियोगाच्चांशजो विभुः
verses.transliteration: yamapuṣpādibhiḥ pūjyaṃ yājyo hyayajadavyayam tasya hṛtkamalasthasya niyogāccāṃśajo vibhuḥ
verses.translation: On hearing his words, Mahevara the slayer of the enemies of Devas spoke through all his mouths.
verses.hindi: यह महेशवरके शुभ शरीरके स्पर्शसे सुवर्णका हो गया है। यह धतूरके पुष्पके समान आभावाला, सभी देबताओंका निवासस्थान तथा देवताओंकी क्रीड़ाभूमि है और अनेक आश्चर्योंसे भरा हुआ है॥ ४ /२॥ इस महान् पर्वतका आयाम एक लाख योजन है। पृथ्वीके नीचे यह सोलह हजार योजनतक है और हे विप्रेन्द्रो! उस पर्वतका शेष भाग पृथ्वीके ऊपर है। इस पर्वतके मूलके आयाम (हैर्घ्य) -का प्रमाण विस्तारमें
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing his words, Mahevara the slayer of the enemies of Devas spoke through all his mouths.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing his words, Mahevara the slayer of the enemies of Devas spoke through all his mouths.

verses.sanskrit: ललाटमस्य निर्भिद्य प्रादुरासीत्पितामहात् लोहितो ऽभूत् स्वयं नीलः शिवस्य हृदयोद्भवः
verses.transliteration: lalāṭamasya nirbhidya prādurāsītpitāmahāt lohito 'bhūt svayaṃ nīlaḥ śivasya hṛdayodbhavaḥ
verses.translation: Hence O Sil&da, understand that in all the worlds it is difficult to get a person who is not born of a womb and who is deathless. Even the lotus-born deity has death. But if Rudra the lord of Devas is pleased, a son not born of a womb and devoid of death is not difficult for you to get. It is not possible for me, for Vi§9u and for Brahma to offer you a son not born of a womb and devoid of death.
verses.hindi: है; उसके विस्तारको पर्वतके मूलसे दुगुना कहा गया है यह पूर्वमें पद्दरागकी आभाके समान, दक्षिणमें स्वर्णे समान, पश्चिममें नीलमणिके समान और उत्तरमें मुँगेके समान है
verses.wordMeaning: Hence O Sil&da, understand that in all the worlds it is difficult to get a person who is not born of a womb and who is deathless. Even the lotus-born deity has death. But if Rudra the lord of Devas is pleased,…

verses.sanskrit: वह्नेश्चैव तु संयोगात् प्रकृत्य पुरुषः प्रभुः नीलश् च लोहितश्चैव यतः कालाकृतिः पुमान्
verses.transliteration: vahneścaiva tu saṃyogāt prakṛtya puruṣaḥ prabhuḥ nīlaś ca lohitaścaiva yataḥ kālākṛtiḥ pumān

verses.hindi: इसके पूर्वभागमें अमरावती (इन्द्रपुरी) है, जो अनेक प्रकारके महलोंसे युक्त, अनेक देवताओंसे भरी हुई और मणिमय जालोंसे घिरी हुई है। यह विविध आकारवाले तथा स्वर्ण एवं रत्नोंसे विभूषित गोपुरों, सोने तथा मणियोंके बने हुए अद्भुत तोरणों, राजमार्गपर स्थित-वार्तालापमें प्रवीण-सभी आभूषणोंसे अलंकृत- स्तनके भारसे झुकी हुई एवं मदके कारण घूर्णित नेत्रोंबाली हजारों स्त्रियोंसे भरी और चारों ओरसे
verses.wordMeaning: Hence O Sil&da, understand that in all the worlds it is difficult to get a person who is not born of a womb and who is deathless. Even the lotus-born deity has death. But if Rudra the lord of Devas is pleased,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence O Sil&da, understand that in all the worlds it is difficult to get a person who is not born of a womb and who is deathless. Even the lotus-born deity has death. But if Rudra the lord of Devas is pleased,…

verses.sanskrit: नीललोहित इत्युक्तस् तेन देवेन वै प्रभुः ब्रह्मणा भगवान्कालः प्रीतात्मा चाभवद्विभुः
verses.transliteration: nīlalohita ityuktas tena devena vai prabhuḥ brahmaṇā bhagavānkālaḥ prītātmā cābhavadvibhuḥ
verses.translation: Hence O Sil&da, understand that in all the worlds it is difficult to get a person who is not born of a womb and who is deathless. Even the lotus-born deity has death. verses.hindi: अप्सराओंसे घिरी हुई है। यह विचित्र बावलियोंसे युक्त है। यह खिले हुए कमलोंसे सुशोभित, स्वर्णको बनी हुई अन्य प्रकारके कमलोंसे शोभायमान, सुगन्धित नील कमलों एवं स्वर्णकमलोंवाले इस प्रकारके सरोवरोंसे तथा नदियों और नदोंसे युक्त यह सुन्दर पुरी अत्यन्त शोभित है। उस पुरीसे यह सुन्दर पर्वत भी सुशोभित
verses.wordMeaning: Hence O Sil&da, understand that in all the worlds it is difficult to get a person who is not born of a womb and who is deathless. Even the lotus-born deity has death. But if Rudra the lord of Devas is pleased,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence O Sil&da, understand that in all the worlds it is difficult to get a person who is not born of a womb and who is deathless. Even the lotus-born deity has death. But if Rudra the lord of Devas is pleased,…

verses.sanskrit: सुप्रीतमनसं देवं तुष्टाव च पितामहः नामाष्टकेन विश्वात्मा विश्वात्मानं महामुने
verses.transliteration: suprītamanasaṃ devaṃ tuṣṭāva ca pitāmahaḥ nāmāṣṭakena viśvātmā viśvātmānaṃ mahāmune

verses.hindi: इस पर्वतके आग्नेय (दक्षिण-पूर्व) भागमें अग्निदेवकी तेजस्विनी नामक पुरी है। यह अमरावतीतुल्य, दिव्य तथा समस्त भोगोंसे परिपूर्ण है वैवस्वती दक्षिणे तु यमस्य यमिनां वराः। है व्रतियोंमें शरेष्ठ मुनिगण! इसके दक्षिणमे
verses.wordMeaning: Hence O Sil&da, understand that in all the worlds it is difficult to get a person who is not born of a womb and who is deathless. Even the lotus-born deity has death. But if Rudra the lord of Devas is pleased,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence O Sil&da, understand that in all the worlds it is difficult to get a person who is not born of a womb and who is deathless. Even the lotus-born deity has death. But if Rudra the lord of Devas is pleased,…

verses.sanskrit: शर्वाय क्षितिरूपाय सदा सुरभिणे नमः ईशाय वायवे तुभ्यं संस्पर्शाय नमो नमः

verses.hindi: इसके नैऋत्य (दक्षिण-पश्चिम) -में कृष्णवर्ण सुन्दर शुद्धवतीपुरी है और वायव्य (पश्चिम-उत्तर) दिशामें उसी प्रकारकी सुन्दर पुरी गन्धवती है। इसके उत्तरमें महोदया तथा ईशान (उत्तर-पूर्व) -में यशोवती नामक पुरी है। इस प्रकार मेरु पर्वतकी सभी दिशाओंमें द्युलोकमें पुरियाँ सर्वदा सुशोभित रहती हैं

verses.hindi: यह पर्वत ब्रह्मा, विष्णु, महेश तथा अन्य देवताओका निवासस्थान है। यह समस्त सुख-साधनोंसे सम्पन्न, पुण्यमय, अनेक झीलों और उत्तम वृक्षोंसे युक्त है। यह सिद्धो, यक्षों, गन्धर्वो, श्रेष्ठ मुनियों एवं विविध आकारवाले चारों प्रकारके प्राणियोंसे परिपूर्ण है
verses.wordMeaning: Hence O Sil&da, understand that in all the worlds it is difficult to get a person who is not born of a womb and who is deathless. Even the lotus-born deity has death. But if Rudra the lord of Devas is pleased,…

verses.transliteration: mahādevāya somāya amṛtāya namo 'stu te ugrāya yajamānāya namaste karmayogine

verses.wordMeaning: Hence O Sil&da, understand that in all the worlds it is difficult to get a person who is not born of a womb and who is deathless. Even the lotus-born deity has death. But if Rudra the lord of Devas is pleased,…

verses.hindi: वहाँ विष्णुका भी विमान है, जो उन शिवके विमानके आधे विस्तारवाला है और दक्षिणमें पद्मयोनि ब्रह्माका पद्मरागमय दिव्य विमान है उस मेरुपर शिवके भवनके चारों ओर इन्द्र, यम, चन्द्रमा, वरुण, निरति, पावक, वायु और रुद्रका विशाल तथा सुन्दर पुर है। विविध दिव्य विमानोंमें अन्य लोगोंका निवास है। उस ईश्वरक्षेत्र (शिवविमान)-में

verses.transliteration: aṣṭamūrtestu sāyujyaṃ varṣādekādavāpnuyāt evaṃ stutvā mahādevam avaikṣata pitāmahaḥ

verses.hindi: ईशानदिशामें नित्य पूजा होती रहती है। वहाँ भगवा नन्दी सिद्धेशवरोंके साथ रहते हैं और शिष्योंसहित रहते हैं। इसी प्रकार सनक, सनन्द और उन्हींके समान अन्य हजारों लोग विराजमान रहते हैं॥ २४--२७॥ ह

verses.hindi: अन्त समुद्रके भीतर होता है। निषध तथा पारियात्र ये दोनों श्रेष्ठ पर्वत पश्चिमसे पूर्व तथा दक्षिणमें स्थित हैं। त्रिथृंग एवं जारुचि-ये दोनों महापर्वत उत्तरमें हैं तथा पूर्वकी ओर फैले हैं और समुद्रके भीतर व्यवस्थित हैं। विद्वान् लोग इन आठौं पर्वतोंको मर्यादापर्वत कहते हैं॥ २१-२४/२॥
verses.wordMeaning: Hence O Sil&da, understand that in all the worlds it is difficult to get a person who is not born of a womb and who is deathless. Even the lotus-born deity has death. But if Rudra the lord of Devas is pleased,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence O Sil&da, understand that in all the worlds it is difficult to get a person who is not born of a womb and who is deathless. Even the lotus-born deity has death. But if Rudra the lord of Devas is pleased,…

verses.sanskrit: न दुर्लभो मृत्युहीनस् तव पुत्रो ह्ययोनिजः मया च विष्णुना चैव ब्रह्मणा च महात्मना
verses.transliteration: na durlabho mṛtyuhīnas tava putro hyayonijaḥ mayā ca viṣṇunā caiva brahmaṇā ca mahātmanā
verses.translation: Hence O Sil&da, understand that in all the worlds it is difficult to get a person who is not born of a womb and who is deathless. Even the lotus-born deity has death. But if Rudra the lord of Devas is pleased, a son not born of a womb and devoid of death is not difficult for you to get. It is not possible for me, for Vi§9u and for Brahma to offer you a son not born of a womb and devoid of death.
verses.hindi: हे श्रेष्ठ द्विजो! मेरु नामक जो पर्वत है, वह ऊँचा स्वर्णमय पर्वत है। उसके चार चरणोंके रूपमें उसके चारों दिशाओंमें बड़े-बड़े चार उत्तम पर्वत हैं, जिनसे सहारा प्राप्त की हुई सात द्वीपवाली पृथ्वी हिलती नहीं है। उनका आयाम दस हजार योजन कहा गया है ॥ २५-२६ /२॥
verses.wordMeaning: Hence O Sil&da, understand that in all the worlds it is difficult to get a person who is not born of a womb and who is deathless. Even the lotus-born deity has death. But if Rudra the lord of Devas is pleased,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence O Sil&da, understand that in all the worlds it is difficult to get a person who is not born of a womb and who is deathless. Even the lotus-born deity has death. But if Rudra the lord of Devas is pleased,…

verses.sanskrit: अयोनिजं मृत्युहीनम् असमर्थं निवेदितुम् एवं व्याहृत्य विप्रेन्द्रम् अनुगृह्य च तं घृणी
verses.transliteration: ayonijaṃ mṛtyuhīnam asamarthaṃ niveditum evaṃ vyāhṛtya viprendram anugṛhya ca taṃ ghṛṇī
verses.translation: Hence O Sil&da, understand that in all the worlds it is difficult to get a person who is not born of a womb and who is deathless. Even the lotus-born deity has death. But if Rudra the lord of Devas is pleased, a son not born of a womb and devoid of death is not difficult for you to get. It is not possible for me, for Vi§9u and for Brahma to offer you a son not born of a womb and devoid of death.
verses.hindi: पूर्वमें मन्दर, दक्षिणमें गन्धमादन, पश्चिम भागमें विपुल और उत्तरमें सुपार्श्व नामक पर्वत कहा गया है। इनपर चार विशाल वृक्ष उगे हुए हैं, जो द्वीपके पताकातुल्य प्रतीत होते हैं। मन्दर पर्वतकी चोटीपर कदम्बका विशाल वृक्ष है। वह पताकाओंका राजा है और वह लम्बी लटकती हुई शाखाओंवाला है। यह कदम्बवृक्ष चैत्यपादप (पवित्र स्थानमें लगे वृक्ष)-के रूपमें प्रतिष्ठित है॥ २७--२९॥
verses.wordMeaning: Hence O Sil&da, understand that in all the worlds it is difficult to get a person who is not born of a womb and who is deathless. Even the lotus-born deity has death. But if Rudra the lord of Devas is pleased,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence O Sil&da, understand that in all the worlds it is difficult to get a person who is not born of a womb and who is deathless. Even the lotus-born deity has death. But if Rudra the lord of Devas is pleased,…

verses.sanskrit: देवैर्वृतो ययौ देवः सितेनेभेन वै प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: devairvṛto yayau devaḥ sitenebhena vai prabhuḥ
verses.translation: Hence O Sil&da, understand that in all the worlds it is difficult to get a person who is not born of a womb and who is deathless. Even the lotus-born deity has death. But if Rudra the lord of Devas is pleased, a son not born of a womb and devoid of death is not difficult for you to get. It is not possible for me, for Vi§9u and for Brahma to offer you a son not born of a womb and devoid of death.
verses.hindi: दक्षिणमें स्थित गन्धमादन पर्वतके शिखरपर सदा जम्बूवृक्ष है यह जम्बूवृक्ष दक्षिण ट्वीपमें पताकाके रूपमें है और सभी लोकोंमें प्रसिद्ध है॥ ३० /२॥
verses.wordMeaning: Hence O Sil&da, understand that in all the worlds it is difficult to get a person who is not born of a womb and who is deathless. Even the lotus-born deity has death. But if Rudra the lord of Devas is pleased,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence O Sil&da, understand that in all the worlds it is difficult to get a person who is not born of a womb and who is deathless. Even the lotus-born deity has death. But if Rudra the lord of Devas is pleased,…

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीलिङ्गमहापुराणे पूर्वभागे इन्द्रवाक्यं नामैकचत्वारिंशो ऽध्यायः गते पुण्ये च वरदे सहस्राक्षे शिलाशनः आराधयन्महादेवं तपसातोषयद्भवम्
verses.transliteration: iti śrīliṅgamahāpurāṇe pūrvabhāge indravākyaṃ nāmaikacatvāriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ gate puṇye ca varade sahasrākṣe śilāśanaḥ ārādhayanmahādevaṃ tapasātoṣayadbhavam
verses.translation: Even as the brahmin ptursued the penance eagerly and perpetually, a thousand divine years surprisingly passed off like a moment.
verses.hindi: श्रीलिड्रमहापुराण  सञ्जातः शिखरे5श्वत्थः स महान् चैत्यपादप: । पश्चिममें महात्मा विपुल पर्वतकी चोटीपर र सुपार्श्वस्योत्तरस्यापि शृङ्गे जातो महाद्रुमः ॥ महान् वृक्ष उगा हुआ है, वह भी चैत्यपादप (पक्कि न्यग्रोधो विपुलस्कन्धोऽनेकयोजनमण्डलः।  र) A i है। उत्तरमें सुपार्श्व पर्व तेषां चतुर्णा वक्ष्यामि शैलेन्द्राणां यथाक्रमम्॥ ३३ Pe SA ह हुआ है, जे
verses.wordMeaning: Even as the brahmin ptursued the penance eagerly and perpetually, a thousand divine years surprisingly passed off like a moment.
verses.commentary: Sense: Even as the brahmin ptursued the penance eagerly and perpetually, a thousand divine years surprisingly passed off like a moment.

verses.sanskrit: अथ तस्यैवमनिशं तत्परस्य द्विजस्य तु दिव्यं वर्षसहस्रं तु गतं क्षणमिवाद्भुतम्
verses.transliteration: atha tasyaivamaniśaṃ tatparasya dvijasya tu divyaṃ varṣasahasraṃ tu gataṃ kṣaṇamivādbhutam
verses.translation: The sage was completely enveloped by an anthill. He became the victim of torture by groups of worms and blood-sucking insects with their mouths pointed like diamond needles.
verses.hindi: अमानुष्याणि रम्याणि सर्वकालर्तुकानि च। ह न परिधिबाला मनोहराणि चत्वारि देवक्रीडनकानि च॥ ३४ अब मैं चारों महापर्वतोंके चार देवक्रोडा- वनानि वै Fe नामतस्तु निबोधत। स्थानौंका वर्णन करूँगा; जो मनुष्ये रहित, रम्य सभ 80. ए दक्षिणे रर्‍ःथमादनम्॥ ३५ काल तथा ऋतुओंमें रहनेवाले एवं मनोहर हैं। वहाँ चारो ही तिदतर सनितुतनम्। दिशाओंमें वन हैं। उनके नाम सुनिये। पूर्वमें चैत्ररथ मित्रेशवरं तु पूर्वे तु षष्ठेश्वरमतः परम्॥ ३६  नामक वन, दक्षिणमें गन्धमादन, पश्चिममें वैभ्राज और वर्येशवरं पश्चिमे तु उत्तरे चाम्रकेश्वरम्। उत्तरमें सविता (शिव)-के नन्दन नामक वनको महासरांसि च तथा चत्वारि मुनिपुङ्गवाः॥ ३७  जानना चाहिए। पूर्वमे मित्रेश्वर, उसके बाद  दक्षिणमें
verses.wordMeaning: The sage was completely enveloped by an anthill. He became the victim of torture by groups of worms and blood-sucking insects with their mouths pointed like diamond needles.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sage was completely enveloped by an anthill. He became the victim of torture by groups of worms and blood-sucking insects with their mouths pointed like diamond needles.

verses.sanskrit: वल्मीकेनावृताङ्गश् च लक्ष्यः कीटगणैर्मुनिः वज्रसूचीमुखैश्चान्यै रक्तकीटैश् च सर्वतः
verses.transliteration: valmīkenāvṛtāṅgaś ca lakṣyaḥ kīṭagaṇairmuniḥ vajrasūcīmukhaiścānyai raktakīṭaiś ca sarvataḥ
verses.translation: With skin alone, devoid of flesh and blood he stood there like a wall unaffected. He was a mere skeleton then. The auspicious lord thought of him then.
verses.hindi: यत्र क्रीडन्ति मुनयः पर्वतेषु वनेषु च। षष्ठेश्वर, पश्चिममें वर्येश्वर और उत्तरमें आम्रकेशवर अरुणोदं सरः पूर्व दक्षिणं मानसं स्मृतम्॥ ३८  शिवक्षेत्र हैं॥ ३३--३६'५२॥ सितोदं पश्चिमसरो महाभद्रं तथोत्तरम्। है मुनिवरो! वहाँ चार बड़े सरोवर हैं, जहाँ पर्वतो शाखस्य दक्षिणे क्षेत्रं विशाखस्य च पश्चिमे ॥ ३९  तथा वनोंमें मुनिगण क्रीड़ा करते हैं पूर्वमें अरुणोदसर, उत्तरे नैगमेयस्य कुमारस्य च पूर्वतः। दक्षिणमें मानससर, पश्चिममें सितोदसर और उत्तरे अरुणोदस्य पूर्वेण शैलेन्द्रा नामतः स्मृताः॥ ४०  महाभद्रसर बताया गया है। दक्षिणमें शाखका क्षेत्र,
verses.wordMeaning: With skin alone, devoid of flesh and blood he stood there like a wall unaffected. He was a mere skeleton then. The auspicious lord thought of him then.
verses.commentary: Sense: With skin alone, devoid of flesh and blood he stood there like a wall unaffected. He was a mere skeleton then. The auspicious lord thought of him then.

verses.sanskrit: निर्मांसरुधिरत्वग् वै निर्लेपः कुड्यवत् स्थितः अस्थिशेषो ऽभवत्पश्चात् तममन्यत शङ्करः
verses.transliteration: nirmāṃsarudhiratvag vai nirlepaḥ kuḍyavat sthitaḥ asthiśeṣo 'bhavatpaścāt tamamanyata śaṅkaraḥ
verses.translation: When the sage was touched with hand by the lord, the enemy of the Cupid, the leading Brahmin sage eschewed all his fatigue and strain.
verses.hindi: तांस्तु सङ्क्षेपतो वक्ष्ये न शक्यं विस्तरेण तु। पश्चिममें विशाखका क्षेत्र, उत्तरमें नैगमेयका क्षेत्र और सितान्तश्च कुरण्डश्च कुररश्चाचलोत्तमः ॥ ४१  पूर्वमें कुमारका क्षेत्र है ॥ ३७-३९/२॥ विकरो मणिशैलश्च वृक्षवांश्चाचलोत्तमः। अरुणोदसरके पूर्वमें महापर्वत बताये गये हैं। मै महानीलोऽथ रुचकः सबिन्दुर्ददुरस्तथा॥ ४२ संक्षेपमें नामोंसे उनका वर्णन करूँगा; विस्तारपूर्वक वेणुमांश्च समेघश्च निषधो देवपर्वतः । उनका वर्णन नहीं किया जा सकता। सितान्त, कुरण्ड, इत्येते पर्वतवरा ह्यान्ये च वस्ता ॥ ४३ पर्वतश्रेष्ठ कुरर, विकर, मणिशैल, पर्वतश्रेष्ठ वृक्षवान्,
verses.wordMeaning: When the sage was touched with hand by the lord, the enemy of the Cupid, the leading Brahmin sage eschewed all his fatigue and strain.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the sage was touched with hand by the lord, the enemy of the Cupid, the leading Brahmin sage eschewed all his fatigue and strain.

verses.sanskrit: यदा स्पृष्टो मुनिस्तेन करेण च स्मरारिणा तदैव मुनिशार्दूलश् चोत्ससर्ज क्लमं द्विजः
verses.transliteration: yadā spṛṣṭo munistena kareṇa ca smarāriṇā tadaiva muniśārdūlaś cotsasarja klamaṃ dvijaḥ
verses.translation: Lord Siva was delighted at the penance of the sage. (Approaching him) along mth his Ga and Uma he said to him, "I am delighted with your penance**.
verses.hindi: के सिद्धावासा उदाहता:। देवपर्वत--ये महापर्वत हैं; इसी प्रकार अन्य भी पर्वत हु तश पर्ष गुहासु च वनेषु च।। रक पूर्वमें ये पर्वत सिद्धोके निवासस्थान कहें रुद्रक्षेत्राणि दिव्यानि विष्णोर्नारायणस्य च। गये हैं। उन-उन पर्वतोंपर, गुफाओंमें तथा वनोंमें रह सरसो मानसस्येह दक्षिणेन महाचलाः ॥ ४५ एवं नारायण विष्णुके दिव्य क्षेत्र हैं ॥ ४०--४४/२॥ ये कोर्त्यमानास्तान् सर्वान् सङ्क्षिप्य प्रवदाम्यहम्। यहाँ मानससरके दक्षिणमें जो महान् पर्वत कहें शैलश्च विशिराश्चैव शिखरश्चाचलोत्तमः ॥ ४६  जाते हैं, अब मैं संक्षेपमें उन सबका वर्णन करता हँ।
verses.wordMeaning: Lord Siva was delighted at the penance of the sage. (Approaching him) along mth his Ga and Uma he said to him, "I am delighted with your penance**.
verses.commentary: Sense: Lord Siva was delighted at the penance of the sage. (Approaching him) along mth his Ga and Uma he said to him, "I am delighted with your penance**.

verses.sanskrit: तपतस्तस्य तपसा प्रभुस्तुष्टाथ शङ्करः तुष्टस्तवेत्यथोवाच सगणश्चोमया सह
verses.transliteration: tapatastasya tapasā prabhustuṣṭātha śaṅkaraḥ tuṣṭastavetyathovāca sagaṇaścomayā saha
verses.translation: highly intelligent one, what with this penance? I shall give you an omniscient son who has mastered all the Scriptural topics**.
verses.hindi: 7 सन शैल, विशिर, पर्वतोंमें उत्तम शिखर, एकश्रृंग, मही अध्याय ४९  जम्बूद्वीपका विस्तृत वर्णन “वहा रहनेवाले लोगोंका वर्णन २१५

verses.sanskrit: तपसानेन किं कार्यं भवतस्ते महामते ददामि पुत्रं सर्वज्ञं सर्वशास्त्रार्थपारगम्

verses.translation: Thereafter bowing down to the lord of Devas and eulogising him Silada spoke to the moon-bedecked lord, accom- panied by Uml, widi words choked with great pleasure.
