verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter bowing down to the lord of Devas and eulogising him Silada spoke to the moon-bedecked lord, accom- panied by Uml, widi words choked with great pleasure.

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रणम्य देवेशं स्तुत्वोवाच शिलाशनः हर्षगद्गदया वाचा सोमं सोमविभूषणम्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ praṇamya deveśaṃ stutvovāca śilāśanaḥ harṣagadgadayā vācā somaṃ somavibhūṣaṇam
verses.translation: lord, O Sankara the most excellent among the good»
verses.hindi: रुद्रक्षेत्राणि दिव्यानि स्थापितानि सुरोत्तमैः । दिग्भागे दक्षिणे प्रोक्ताः पश्चिमे च वदामि व: इत्येते देवचरिता उत्कटा: पर्वतोत्तमाः । सर्वे पश्चिमदिग्भागे रुद्रक्षेत्रसमन्विता:
verses.wordMeaning: lord, O Sankara the most excellent among the good»
verses.commentary: Sense: lord, O Sankara the most excellent among the good»

verses.sanskrit: भगवन्देवदेवेश त्रिपुरार्दन शङ्कर अयोनिजं मृत्युहीनं पुत्रमिच्छामि सत्तम
verses.transliteration: bhagavandevadeveśa tripurārdana śaṅkara ayonijaṃ mṛtyuhīnaṃ putramicchāmi sattama
verses.translation: Rudra, Paramevara who had already been propitiated by his penance by Brahma spoke thus again to Silada with very great pleasure.
verses.hindi: ये स्थिताः कीर्त्यमानांस्तान् सङ्क्षिप्येह निबोधत पुष्पकोशः प्रशैलश्च विरजश्चाचलोत्तमः
verses.wordMeaning: Rudra, Paramevara who had already been propitiated by his penance by Brahma spoke thus again to Silada with very great pleasure.
verses.commentary: Sense: Rudra, Paramevara who had already been propitiated by his penance by Brahma spoke thus again to Silada with very great pleasure.

verses.sanskrit: पूर्वमाराधितः प्राह तपसा परमेश्वरः शिलादं ब्रह्मणा रुद्रः प्रीत्या परमया पुनः
verses.transliteration: pūrvamārādhitaḥ prāha tapasā parameśvaraḥ śilādaṃ brahmaṇā rudraḥ prītyā paramayā punaḥ
verses.translation: O brahmin, O ascetic, formerly I had been propitiated by Brahma, sages and Devas by penance, for the sake of my incarnation.
verses.hindi: तेषु शैलेषु दिव्येषु देवदेवस्य शूलिनः। असंख्यातानि दिव्यानि विमानानि सहस्त्रशः वसन्ति देवा मुनयः सिद्धाश्च शिवभाविताः। कृतवासाः सपत्नीकाः प्रसादात्परमेष्ठिनः
verses.wordMeaning: O brahmin, O ascetic, formerly I had been propitiated by Brahma, sages and Devas by penance, for the sake of my incarnation.
verses.commentary: Sense: O brahmin, O ascetic, formerly I had been propitiated by Brahma, sages and Devas by penance, for the sake of my incarnation.

verses.sanskrit: पूर्वमाराधितो विप्र ब्रह्मणाहं तपोधन तपसा चावतारार्थं मुनिभिश् च सुरोत्तमैः
verses.transliteration: pūrvamārādhito vipra brahmaṇāhaṃ tapodhana tapasā cāvatārārthaṃ munibhiś ca surottamaiḥ
verses.translation: I shall become your son, not born of a womb, by the name Nandin. O sage, I am the father of worlds and you will become my father.
verses.hindi: उदुम्बरे कर्दमस्य तथान्येषां महात्मनाम्। विद्याधराणां सिद्धानां पुण्ये त्वाम्रवने शुभे सूर्यस्य किंशुकवने तथा रुद्रगणस्य च
verses.wordMeaning: I shall become your son, not born of a womb, by the name Nandin. O sage, I am the father of worlds and you will become my father.
verses.commentary: Sense: I shall become your son, not born of a womb, by the name Nandin. O sage, I am the father of worlds and you will become my father.

verses.sanskrit: तव पुत्रो भविष्यामि नन्दिनाम्ना त्वयोनिजः पिता भविष्यसि मम पितुर्वै जगतां मुने
verses.transliteration: tava putro bhaviṣyāmi nandināmnā tvayonijaḥ pitā bhaviṣyasi mama piturvai jagatāṃ mune
verses.translation: After saying thus to the sage who was standing there after bowing to him and looking up to him, the delighted merciful lord who was accompanied by Uma and who was comparable to the Moon vanished there itself.
verses.hindi: बीजपूरवने पुण्ये देवाचायो व्यवस्थितः । कौमुदे तु वने विष्णुप्रमुखानां महात्मनाम् ये सब देवताओंके द्वारा सेवित, उत्कट तथा उत्तम पर्वत हैं। उन-उन सभी पर्वतोंपर और वनोंमें श्रेष्ठ
verses.wordMeaning: After saying thus to the sage who was standing there after bowing to him and looking up to him, the delighted merciful lord who was accompanied by Uma and who was comparable to the Moon vanished there itself.
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying thus to the sage who was standing there after bowing to him and looking up to him, the delighted merciful lord who was accompanied by Uma and who was comparable to the Moon vanished there itself.

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्त्वा मुनिं प्रेक्ष्य प्रणिपत्य स्थितं घृणी सोमः सोमोपमः प्रीतस् तत्रैवान्तरधीयत
verses.transliteration: evamuktvā muniṃ prekṣya praṇipatya sthitaṃ ghṛṇī somaḥ somopamaḥ prītas tatraivāntaradhīyata
verses.translation: O great sage, having obtained the assurance of a son from Rudra, my father was delighted. He was the most excellent among the knowers of sacrifice. For the purpose of sacrifice he came to the courtyard of a great sacrificial cham- ber. Formerly I was born in that courtyard as his son, at the behest of lord Siva. I had the lustre of fire at the closing of a yuga.
verses.hindi: इस प्रकार दक्षिण दिशामें स्थित पर्वतोंको बता दिया गया, अब मैं आपलोगोंको पश्चिममें विद्यमान पर्वतोंको सितोदके पश्चिममें सुरप, महाबल, कुमुद, मधुमान्,
verses.wordMeaning: O great sage, having obtained the assurance of a son from Rudra, my father was delighted. He was the most excellent among the knowers of sacrifice. For the purpose of sacrifice he came to the courtyard of a great sacrificial cham- ber.…
verses.commentary: Sense: O great sage, having obtained the assurance of a son from Rudra, my father was delighted. He was the most excellent among the knowers of sacrifice. For the purpose of sacrifice he came to the courtyard of a great sacrificial cham- ber.…

verses.sanskrit: लब्धपुत्रः पिता रुद्रात् प्रीतो मम महामुने यज्ञाङ्गणं महत्प्राप्य यज्ञार्थं यज्ञवित्तमः
verses.transliteration: labdhaputraḥ pitā rudrāt prīto mama mahāmune yajñāṅgaṇaṃ mahatprāpya yajñārthaṃ yajñavittamaḥ
verses.translation: When I was born as the son of Silada, the clouds Puara, Avartaka and others showered rain. The heaven- walkers — Kinnaras, Sadhyas and Siddhas sang songs. Viu showered fragrant flowers.
verses.hindi: पारिजात और पर्वतोंमें उत्तम श्रीश्ृंग हें ॥ ये सभी उत्कट तथा उत्तम पर्वत पश्चिम दिशामें हैं, जो देवताओंके द्वारा सेवित हैं और रुद्रक्षेत्रोंसे युक्त हें ॥ ५०--५२॥ महाभद्रसरके उत्तरमें जो शक्तिशाली पर्वत स्थित हैं, मैं उनका संक्षेपमें वर्णन करता हूँ, आपलोग सुनिये।
verses.wordMeaning: When I was born as the son of Silada, the clouds Puara, Avartaka and others showered rain. The heaven- walkers — Kinnaras, Sadhyas and Siddhas sang songs. Viu showered fragrant flowers.
verses.commentary: Sense: When I was born as the son of Silada, the clouds Puara, Avartaka and others showered rain. The heaven- walkers — Kinnaras, Sadhyas and Siddhas sang songs. Viu showered fragrant flowers.

verses.sanskrit: तदङ्गणादहं शंभोस् तनुजस्तस्य चाज्ञया संजातः पूर्वमेवाहं युगान्ताग्निसमप्रभः
verses.transliteration: tadaṅgaṇādahaṃ śaṃbhos tanujastasya cājñayā saṃjātaḥ pūrvamevāhaṃ yugāntāgnisamaprabhaḥ
verses.translation: I had then the lustre of Kalasurya (sun at the time of pralaya or dissolution). I was having matted hair and coronet. In the form of an infant I had three eyes, four arms holding the trident, axe, iron club and thunderbolt. My curved fangs were adamantine. I was the infant adored by the thunder- bolt-wielding Indra. I was terrible in appearance with diamond ear-rin. My voice was comparable to the thundering sound of
verses.hindi: पुष्पकोश, प्रशैल, पर्वतश्रेष्ठ विरज, वराहपर्वत, पर्वतश्रेष्ठ मयूर तथा शैलराज जारुधि--ये सब उत्तरमें स्थित हैं । उन दिव्य पर्वतोंपर देवदेव शिवके असंख्य दिव्य विमान हैं इन प्रमुख पर्वतोंके भीतर झरने, सरोवर तथा उपवन यथाक्रम स्थित हैं। यहाँ परमेष्ठी शिवकी कृपासे देवता, मुनि एवं सिद्ध शिवभक्तिसे युक्त होकर अपने निवासस्थान बनाकर पत्नियोंके साथ रहते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: I had then the lustre of Kalasurya (sun at the time of pralaya or dissolution). I was having matted hair and coronet. In the form of an infant I had three eyes, four arms holding the trident, axe, iron club and thunderbolt. My curved fangs were adamantine.…
verses.commentary: Sense: I had then the lustre of Kalasurya (sun at the time of pralaya or dissolution). I was having matted hair and coronet. In the form of an infant I had three eyes, four arms holding the trident, axe, iron club and thunderbolt. My curved fangs were adamantine.…

verses.sanskrit: ववर्षुस्तदा पुष्करावर्तकाद्या जगुः खेचराः किन्नराः सिद्धसाध्याः शिलादात्मजत्वं गते मय्युपेन्द्रः ससर्जाथ वृष्टिं सुपुष्पौघमिश्राम्
verses.transliteration: vavarṣustadā puṣkarāvartakādyā jaguḥ khecarāḥ kinnarāḥ siddhasādhyāḥ śilādātmajatvaṃ gate mayyupendraḥ sasarjātha vṛṣṭiṃ supuṣpaughamiśrām
verses.translation: O leading sage, with mantras pertaining to MaheiSvara as well as those taken from 5, Yajus and San, the over- joyed sages eulogised and bowed down to me.
verses.hindi: लक्ष्मी आदिका निवास बिल्ववनमें है। कश्यप आदि ककुभ वनमें रहते हैं। इन्द्र, उपेन्द्र तथा श्रेष्ठ सर्पोका निवास तालवनमें कहा गया है। कर्दम और अन्य महात्माओंका निवास उदुम्बरवनमें, विद्याधरौं तथा सिद्धोंका निवास पवित्र एवं सुन्दर आम्रवनमें और नागों तथा सिद्धगणोंका निवास निम्बवनमें है। सूर्य तथा रुद्रगणोंका निवास किंशुकवनमें है। देवताओंके आचार्य पुण्यमय बीजपूरवन (बिजौरा नीबूका वन)-में निवास करते
verses.wordMeaning: O leading sage, with mantras pertaining to MaheiSvara as well as those taken from 5, Yajus and San, the over- joyed sages eulogised and bowed down to me.
verses.commentary: Sense: O leading sage, with mantras pertaining to MaheiSvara as well as those taken from 5, Yajus and San, the over- joyed sages eulogised and bowed down to me.

verses.sanskrit: मां दृष्ट्वा कालसूर्याभं जटामुकुटधारिणम् त्र्यक्षं चतुर्भुजं बालं शूलटङ्कगदाधरम्
verses.transliteration: māṃ dṛṣṭvā kālasūryābhaṃ jaṭāmukuṭadhāriṇam tryakṣaṃ caturbhujaṃ bālaṃ śūlaṭaṅkagadādharam
verses.translation: The following stood all around me: — Brahma, Vi§nu, Rudra, Indra, Siva, Ambika herself, Jupiter, the moon, the sun of great splendour, wind god, fire god, Isana, Nirrti, Yaksa, Yama, Varuna, Visve Devas, Rudras, Vasus of great strength, Lak$nu herself, Saci, Jye9tha, goddess Sarasvati, Aditi, Diti, Sraddha, Lajja, Dhrti, Nanda, Bhadra, Surabhi, SuiSila, Sumanas, the lord of bulls, Dharma of great splendour and the sons of Dharma. They surrounded me, embraced me and eulogised me. O excellent sage, even Silada my father, the sage, on seeing me like that bowed to me with love. The meritorious soul eulogised his son who gave him what he liked.
verses.hindi: हैं। विष्णु आदि महात्माओंका वास कौमुद वनमें है ॥ ५८--६३ ॥ सर्पगण स्थलपद्मवनके अन्दर स्थित न्यग्नोधवनमें रहते हैं और जो सम्पूर्ण जगतूके पति गर्वित शेषनाग हैं, अमानुष्याणि रम्याणि सर्वकालतुंकानि च। मनोहराणि चत्वारि देवक्रीडनकानि च
verses.wordMeaning: The following stood all around me: — Brahma, Vi§nu, Rudra, Indra, Siva, Ambika herself, Jupiter, the moon, the sun of great splendour, wind god, fire god, Isana, Nirrti, Yaksa, Yama, Varuna, Visve Devas, Rudras, Vasus of great strength, Lak$nu herself, Saci, Jye9tha,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The following stood all around me: — Brahma, Vi§nu, Rudra, Indra, Siva, Ambika herself, Jupiter, the moon, the sun of great splendour, wind god, fire god, Isana, Nirrti, Yaksa, Yama, Varuna, Visve Devas, Rudras, Vasus of great strength, Lak$nu herself, Saci, Jye9tha,…

verses.sanskrit: वज्रिणं वज्रदंष्ट्रं च वज्रिणाराधितं शिशुम् वज्रकुण्डलिनं घोरं नीरदोपमनिःस्वनम्
verses.transliteration: vajriṇaṃ vajradaṃṣṭraṃ ca vajriṇārādhitaṃ śiśum vajrakuṇḍalinaṃ ghoraṃ nīradopamaniḥsvanam
verses.translation: O lord, O lord of the chief of Devas, O thrcc-eycd one, O unchanging one, you arc my son since you are my protector and the protector of worlds from misery. Since you arc the protector of worlds, O son, you arc my father. You are omnipresent. O son, not bom of a womb, obeisance to you, O source of origin of the universe, O grand father, O father, O son, O MaheiSana, O preceptor of the universe, O dear one, O highly blessed one, O Paramevara protect me. O lord of Devas, since I am delighted by you, you are to be known by the name Nandin. Hence O Nandin, delight me. I bow down to you, the lord of the universe, O lord, delight my parents who have gone to Rudra's world. O lord, my grandfather too has gone to the world of Rudra. O Nandin, when Maheivara has incarnated my birth in the world is fruitful. O lord, the birth of the worlds too is fruitful.
verses.hindi: वर्येश्वरं पश्चिमे तु उत्तरे चाम्रकेश्वरम्। महासरांसि च तथा चत्वारि मुनिपुङ्गवाः विकरो मणिशैलश्च वृक्षवांश्चाचलोत्तमः। महानीलोऽथ रुचकः सबिन्दुर्दर्दुरस्तथा
verses.wordMeaning: O lord, O lord of the chief of Devas, O thrcc-eycd one, O unchanging one, you arc my son since you are my protector and the protector of worlds from misery. Since you arc the protector of worlds, O son, you arc my father. You are omnipresent. O son, not bom of a womb,…
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord, O lord of the chief of Devas, O thrcc-eycd one, O unchanging one, you arc my son since you are my protector and the protector of worlds from misery. Since you arc the protector of worlds, O son, you arc my father. You are omnipresent. O son, not bom of a womb,…

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्माद्यास्तुष्टुवुः सर्वे सुरेन्द्रश् च मुनीश्वराः नेदुः समन्ततः सर्वे ननृतुश्चाप्सरोगणाः
verses.transliteration: brahmādyāstuṣṭuvuḥ sarve surendraś ca munīśvarāḥ neduḥ samantataḥ sarve nanṛtuścāpsarogaṇāḥ
verses.translation: When you have incarnated as my son for my protection O IiSvara, O Nandin, O lord of Devas, obeisance to you. O NandHvara, obeisance to you.
verses.hindi: वेणुमांश्च समेघश्च निषधो देवपर्वतः । इत्येते पर्वतवरा ह्यन्ये च गिरयस्तथा रुद्रक्षेत्राणि दिव्यानि विष्णोर्नारायणस्य च । सरसो मानसस्येह दक्षिणेन महाचला:
verses.wordMeaning: When you have incarnated as my son for my protection O IiSvara, O Nandin, O lord of Devas, obeisance to you. O NandHvara, obeisance to you.
verses.commentary: Sense: When you have incarnated as my son for my protection O IiSvara, O Nandin, O lord of Devas, obeisance to you. O NandHvara, obeisance to you.

verses.sanskrit: ऋषयो मुनिशार्दूल ऋग्यजुःसामसंभवैः मन्त्रैर्माहेश्वरैः स्तुत्वा सम्प्रणेमुर्मुदान्विताः
verses.transliteration: ṛṣayo muniśārdūla ṛgyajuḥsāmasaṃbhavaiḥ mantrairmāheśvaraiḥ stutvā sampraṇemurmudānvitāḥ
verses.translation: O son of mighty arms, protect me. O lord of Devas,
verses.hindi: ये कीर्त्यमानास्तान् सर्वान् सङ्क्षिप्य प्रवदाम्यहम्। शैलश्च विशिराश्चैव : महान् वृक्ष उगा हुआ है, वह भी चैत्यपादप वृक्ष)-के रूपमें प्रतिष्ठित है । उत्तरमें सुपार्श्व शिखरपर विशाल बरगदका वृक्ष उगा हुआ है, जो
verses.wordMeaning: O son of mighty arms, protect me. O lord of Devas,
verses.commentary: Sense: O son of mighty arms, protect me. O lord of Devas,

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मा हरिश् च रुद्रश् च शक्रः साक्षाच्छिवांबिका जीवश्चेन्दुर्महातेजा भास्करः पवनो ऽनलः
verses.transliteration: brahmā hariś ca rudraś ca śakraḥ sākṣācchivāṃbikā jīvaścendurmahātejā bhāskaraḥ pavano 'nalaḥ
verses.translation: O son of mighty arms, protect me. O lord of Devas,
verses.hindi: पश्चिममें महात्मा विपुल पर्वतकी चोटीपर पीपलका अब मैं चारों महापर्वतोंके चार देवक्रीडा-
verses.wordMeaning: O son of mighty arms, protect me. O lord of Devas,
verses.commentary: Sense: O son of mighty arms, protect me. O lord of Devas,

verses.sanskrit: ईशानो निरृतिर्यक्षो यमो वरुण एव च विश्वेदेवास् तथा रुद्रा वसवश् च महाबलाः
verses.transliteration: īśāno nirṛtiryakṣo yamo varuṇa eva ca viśvedevās tathā rudrā vasavaś ca mahābalāḥ
verses.translation: O son of mighty arms, protect me. O lord of Devas,
verses.hindi: स्थानोंका वर्णन करूँगा; जो मनुष्योंसे रहित, रम्य, सभी काल तथा ऋतुओंमें रहनेवाले एवं मनोहर हैं। वहाँ चारों दिशाओंमें वन हैं। उनके नाम सुनिये। पूर्वमें चैत्ररथ नामक वन, दक्षिणमें गन्धमादन, पश्चिममें वैभ्राज और उत्तरमें सविता (शिव)-के नन्दन नामक वनको जानना चाहिए । पूर्वमें मित्रेश्‍वर, उसके बाद  दक्षिणमे  षष्ठेश्‍्वर, पश्चिममें वर्येश्वर और उत्तरमें आम्रकेश्वर शिवक्षेत्र हैं॥ ३३-३६१. ॥
verses.wordMeaning: O son of mighty arms, protect me. O lord of Devas,
verses.commentary: Sense: O son of mighty arms, protect me. O lord of Devas,

verses.sanskrit: लक्ष्मीः साक्षाच्छची ज्येष्ठा देवी चैव सरस्वती अदितिश् च दितिश्चैव श्रद्धा लज्जा धृतिस् तथा
verses.transliteration: lakṣmīḥ sākṣācchacī jyeṣṭhā devī caiva sarasvatī aditiś ca ditiścaiva śraddhā lajjā dhṛtis tathā
verses.translation: O son of mighty arms, protect me. O lord of Devas,
verses.hindi: हे मुनिवरो! वहाँ चार बड़े सरोवर हैं जहाँ पर्वतों तथा वनोंमें मुनिगण क्रीड़ा करते हैं। पूर्वमे अरुणोदसर, दक्षिणमें मानससर, पश्चिममें सितोदसर और उत्तरमें महाभद्रसर बताया गया है। दक्षिणमें शाखका क्षेत्र पश्चिममें विशाखका क्षेत्र, उत्तरमें नैगमेयका क्षेत्र और
verses.wordMeaning: O son of mighty arms, protect me. O lord of Devas,
verses.commentary: Sense: O son of mighty arms, protect me. O lord of Devas,

verses.sanskrit: नन्दा भद्रा च सुरभी सुशीला सुमनास् तथा वृषेन्द्रश् च महातेजा धर्मो धर्मात्मजस् तथा
verses.transliteration: nandā bhadrā ca surabhī suśīlā sumanās tathā vṛṣendraś ca mahātejā dharmo dharmātmajas tathā
verses.translation: O son of mighty arms, protect me. O lord of Devas,
verses.hindi: पूर्वमें कुमारका क्षेत्र है॥ ३७--३९ /२ ॥ अरुणोदसरके पूर्वमें महापर्वत बताये गये हैं। मैं संक्षेपमें नामोंसे उनका वर्णन करूँगा; विस्तारपूर्वक उनका वर्णन नहीं किया जा सकता। सितान्त, कुरण्ड, पर्वतश्रेष्ठ कुरर, विकर, मणिशैल, पर्वतश्रेष्ठ वृक्षवान्,
verses.wordMeaning: O son of mighty arms, protect me. O lord of Devas,
verses.commentary: Sense: O son of mighty arms, protect me. O lord of Devas,

verses.sanskrit: आवृत्य मां तथालिङ्ग्य तुष्टुवुर्मुनिसत्तम शिलादो ऽपि मुनिर्दृष्ट्वा पिता मे तादृशं तदा
verses.transliteration: āvṛtya māṃ tathāliṅgya tuṣṭuvurmunisattama śilādo 'pi munirdṛṣṭvā pitā me tādṛśaṃ tadā
verses.translation: O son of mighty arms, protect me. O lord of Devas,
verses.hindi: देवपर्वत--ये महापर्वत हैं; इसी प्रकार अन्य भी पर्वत हैं। मन्दरे पूर्वमे ये पर्वत सिद्धोंके निवासस्थान कहे गे हैं। उन-उन पर्वतोपर, गुफाओंमें तथा बनोंमें रुद्र एवे नारायण विष्णुके दिव्य क्षेत्र हैं॥ ४०-४४ /२॥ यहाँ मानससरके दक्षिणमें जो महान् पर्वत कहे जाते हैं, अब मैं संक्षेपमें उन सबका वर्णन करता हूँ।
verses.wordMeaning: O son of mighty arms, protect me. O lord of Devas,
verses.commentary: Sense: O son of mighty arms, protect me. O lord of Devas,

verses.sanskrit: प्रीत्या प्रणम्य पुण्यात्मा तुष्टावेष्टप्रदं सुतम् भगवन्देवदेवेश त्रियंबक ममाव्यय
verses.transliteration: prītyā praṇamya puṇyātmā tuṣṭāveṣṭapradaṃ sutam bhagavandevadeveśa triyaṃbaka mamāvyaya
verses.translation: O son of mighty arms, protect me. O lord of Devas,
verses.hindi: जम्बूद्वीपका विस्तृत वर्णन”“वहाँ रहनेवाले लोगोंका वर्णन अक ककाममअभम अमे भमकभमभमभभझभकमझरमझझ्कभकझकअभकझ्कभककमझ अक अझ अक भक अक झा झअकफ 5 क झक 9 9 भ 5 फफफफफफफफफफफफफफफफफ
verses.wordMeaning: O son of mighty arms, protect me. O lord of Devas,
verses.commentary: Sense: O son of mighty arms, protect me. O lord of Devas,

verses.sanskrit: पुत्रो ऽसि जगतां यस्मात् त्राता दुःखाद्धि किं पुनः रक्षको जगतां यस्मात् पिता मे पुत्र सर्वग
verses.transliteration: putro 'si jagatāṃ yasmāt trātā duḥkhāddhi kiṃ punaḥ rakṣako jagatāṃ yasmāt pitā me putra sarvaga
verses.translation: O son of mighty arms, protect me. O lord of Devas,
verses.hindi: इत्येते देवचरिता उत्कटाः पर्वतोत्तमाः। रुद्रक्षेत्राणि दिव्यानि स्थापितानि सुरोत्तमैः ।
verses.wordMeaning: O son of mighty arms, protect me. O lord of Devas,
verses.commentary: Sense: O son of mighty arms, protect me. O lord of Devas,

verses.sanskrit: अयोनिज नमस्तुभ्यं जगद्योने पितामह पिता पुत्र महेशान जगतां च जगद्गुरो
verses.transliteration: ayonija namastubhyaṃ jagadyone pitāmaha pitā putra maheśāna jagatāṃ ca jagadguro
verses.translation: O son of mighty arms, protect me. O lord of Devas,
verses.hindi: इत्येते देवचरिता उत्कटाः पर्वतोत्तमाः । सर्वे पश्चिमदिग्भागे रुद्रक्षेत्रसमन्विताः ये स्थिताः कीर्त्यमानांस्तान् सङ्क्षिप्येह निबोधत
verses.wordMeaning: O son of mighty arms, protect me. O lord of Devas,
verses.commentary: Sense: O son of mighty arms, protect me. O lord of Devas,

verses.sanskrit: वत्स वत्स महाभाग पाहि मां परमेश्वर त्वयाहं नन्दितो यस्मान् नन्दी नाम्ना सुरेश्वर
verses.transliteration: vatsa vatsa mahābhāga pāhi māṃ parameśvara tvayāhaṃ nandito yasmān nandī nāmnā sureśvara
verses.translation: O son of mighty arms, protect me. O lord of Devas,
verses.hindi: पुष्पकोशः प्रशैलश्च विरजश्चाचलोत्तमः तेषु शैलेषु दिव्येषु देवदेवस्य शूलिनः।
verses.wordMeaning: O son of mighty arms, protect me. O lord of Devas,
verses.commentary: Sense: O son of mighty arms, protect me. O lord of Devas,

verses.sanskrit: तस्मान्नन्दय मां नन्दिन् नमामि जगदीश्वरम् प्रसीद पितरौ मे ऽद्य रुद्रलोकं गतौ विभो
verses.transliteration: tasmānnandaya māṃ nandin namāmi jagadīśvaram prasīda pitarau me 'dya rudralokaṃ gatau vibho
verses.translation: O son of mighty arms, protect me. O lord of Devas,
verses.hindi: वसन्ति देवा मुनयः सिद्धाश्च शिवभाविताः। कृतवासाः सपत्नीकाः प्रसादात्परमेष्ठिनः उदुम्बरे कर्दमस्य तथान्येषां महात्मनाम्। विद्याधराणां सिद्धानां पुण्ये त्वाम्रवने शुभे
verses.wordMeaning: O son of mighty arms, protect me. O lord of Devas,
verses.commentary: Sense: O son of mighty arms, protect me. O lord of Devas,

verses.sanskrit: पितामहश् च भो नन्दिन् नवतीर्णे महेश्वरे ममैव सफलं लोके जन्म वै जगतां प्रभो
verses.transliteration: pitāmahaś ca bho nandin navatīrṇe maheśvare mamaiva saphalaṃ loke janma vai jagatāṃ prabho
verses.translation: O son of mighty arms, protect me. O lord of Devas,
verses.hindi: नागानां सिद्धसङ्कानां तथा निम्बवने स्थितिः। सूर्यस्य किंशुकवने तथा रुद्रगणस्य च बीजपूरवने पुण्ये देवाचायों व्यवस्थितः। कौमुदे तु वने विष्णुप्रमुखानां महात्मनाम्
verses.wordMeaning: O son of mighty arms, protect me. O lord of Devas,
verses.commentary: Sense: O son of mighty arms, protect me. O lord of Devas,

verses.sanskrit: अवतीर्णे सुते नन्दिन् रक्षार्थं मह्यमीश्वर तुभ्यं नमः सुरेशान नन्दीश्वर नमो ऽस्तु ते
verses.transliteration: avatīrṇe sute nandin rakṣārthaṃ mahyamīśvara tubhyaṃ namaḥ sureśāna nandīśvara namo 'stu te
verses.translation: O son of mighty arms, protect me. O lord of Devas,
verses.hindi: ये सब देवताओंके द्वारा सेवित, उत्कट तथा उत्तम पर्वत हैं। उन-उन सभी पर्वतोंपर और वनोंमें श्रेष्ठ इस प्रकार दक्षिण दिशामें स्थित पर्वतोंको बता दिया गया, अब मैं आपलोगोंको पश्चिममें विद्यमान पर्वतोंको
verses.wordMeaning: O son of mighty arms, protect me. O lord of Devas,
verses.commentary: Sense: O son of mighty arms, protect me. O lord of Devas,

verses.sanskrit: पुत्र पाहि महाबाहो देवदेव जगद्गुरो पुत्रत्वमेव नन्दीश मत्वा यत्कीर्तितं मया
verses.transliteration: putra pāhi mahābāho devadeva jagadguro putratvameva nandīśa matvā yatkīrtitaṃ mayā
verses.translation: O son of mighty arms, protect me. O lord of Devas,
verses.hindi: सितोदके पश्‍्चिममें सुरप, महाबल, कुमुद, मधुमान्, पारिजात और पर्वतोंमें उत्तम श्रीशृंग हैं। ये सभी उत्कट तथा उत्तम पर्वत पश्चिम दिशामें हैं, जो देवताओंके द्वारा सेवित हैं और रुद्रक्षेत्रोंसे युक्त हैं॥ ५०--५२॥
verses.wordMeaning: O son of mighty arms, protect me. O lord of Devas,
verses.commentary: Sense: O son of mighty arms, protect me. O lord of Devas,

verses.sanskrit: त्वया तत्क्षम्यतां वत्स स्तवस्तव्य सुरासुरैः यः पठेच्छृणुयाद्वापि मम पुत्रप्रभाषितम्
verses.transliteration: tvayā tatkṣamyatāṃ vatsa stavastavya surāsuraiḥ yaḥ paṭhecchṛṇuyādvāpi mama putraprabhāṣitam
verses.translation: O son of mighty arms, protect me. O lord of Devas,
verses.hindi: महाभद्रसरके उत्तरमें जो शक्तिशाली पर्वत स्थित हैं, मैं उनका संक्षेपमें वर्णन करता हूँ, आपलोग सुनिये। पुष्पकोश, प्रशैल, पर्वतश्रेष्ठ विरज, वराहपर्वत, पर्वतश्रेष्ठ मयूर तथा शैलराज जारुधि-ये सब उत्तरमें स्थित हैं । उन दिव्य पर्वतोंपर देवदेव शिवके असंख्य दिव्य विमान हैं ॥ ५३--५७॥
verses.wordMeaning: O son of mighty arms, protect me. O lord of Devas,
verses.commentary: Sense: O son of mighty arms, protect me. O lord of Devas,

verses.sanskrit: श्रावयेद्वा द्विजान् भक्त्या मया सार्धं स मोदते एवं स्तुत्वा सुतं बालं प्रणम्य बहुमानतः
verses.transliteration: śrāvayedvā dvijān bhaktyā mayā sārdhaṃ sa modate evaṃ stutvā sutaṃ bālaṃ praṇamya bahumānataḥ
verses.translation: O son of mighty arms, protect me. O lord of Devas,
verses.hindi: इन प्रमुख पर्वतोंके भीतर झरने, सरोवर तथा उपवन यथाक्रम स्थित हैं। यहाँ परमेष्ठी शिवको कृपासे देवता, मुनि एवं सिद्ध शिवभक्तिसे युक्त होकर अपने निवासस्थान बनाकर पत्तियोंके साथ रहते हैं। लक्ष्मी आदिका निवास बिल्ववनमें है। कश्यप आदि ककुभ वनमें रहते हैं। इन्द्र, उपेन्द्र तथा श्रेष्ठ सर्पका निवास तालवनमें कहा गया है। कर्दम और अन्य महात्माओंका निवास उदुम्बरवनमें, विद्याधरों तथा सिद्धोंका
verses.wordMeaning: O son of mighty arms, protect me. O lord of Devas,
verses.commentary: Sense: O son of mighty arms, protect me. O lord of Devas,

verses.sanskrit: मुनीश्वरांश् च सम्प्रेक्ष्य शिलाद उवाच सुव्रतः पश्यध्वं मुनयः सर्वे महाभाग्यं ममाव्ययः
verses.transliteration: munīśvarāṃś ca samprekṣya śilāda uvāca suvrataḥ paśyadhvaṃ munayaḥ sarve mahābhāgyaṃ mamāvyayaḥ
verses.translation: O son of mighty arms, protect me. O lord of Devas,
verses.hindi: निवास पवित्र एवं सुन्दर आम्रबनमें और नागों तथा सिद्धगणोंका निवास निम्बवनमें है । सूर्य तथा रुद्र्गणोंका निवास किंशुकवनमें है। देवताओंके आचार्य पुण्यमय बीजपूरवन (बिजौरा नीबूका वन)-में निवास करते हैं। विष्णु आदि महात्माओंका वास कौमुद वनमें है
verses.wordMeaning: O son of mighty arms, protect me. O lord of Devas,
verses.commentary: Sense: O son of mighty arms, protect me. O lord of Devas,

verses.sanskrit: नन्दी यज्ञाङ्गणे देवश् चावतीर्णो यतः प्रभुः मत्समः कः पुमांल्लोके देवो वा दानवो ऽपि वा
verses.transliteration: nandī yajñāṅgaṇe devaś cāvatīrṇo yataḥ prabhuḥ matsamaḥ kaḥ pumāṃlloke devo vā dānavo 'pi vā
verses.translation: O son of mighty arms, protect me. O lord of Devas,
verses.hindi: सर्पगण स्थलपद्मवनके अन्दर स्थित न्यग्रोधवनमें रहते हैं और जो सम्पूर्ण जगत्के पति गर्वित शेषनाग हैं, श्रीलिड्रमहापुराण
verses.wordMeaning: O son of mighty arms, protect me. O lord of Devas,
verses.commentary: Sense: O son of mighty arms, protect me. O lord of Devas,

verses.sanskrit: एष नन्दी यतो जातो यज्ञभूमौ हिताय मे
verses.transliteration: eṣa nandī yato jāto yajñabhūmau hitāya me
verses.translation: O son of mighty arms, protect me. O lord of Devas,
verses.hindi: स एव जगतां कालः पाताले च व्यवस्थित: । विष्णोरविश्वगुरोरमू्तिर्दिव्यः साक्षाद्धलायुधः शयनं देवदेवस्य स हरेः कङ्कणं विभोः। वने पनसवृक्षाणां सशुक्रा दानवादयः
verses.wordMeaning: O son of mighty arms, protect me. O lord of Devas,
verses.commentary: Sense: O son of mighty arms, protect me. O lord of Devas,

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीलिङ्गमहापुराणे पूर्वभागे नन्दिकेश्वरोत्पत्तिर् नाम द्विचत्वारिंशो ऽध्यायः मया सह पिता हृष्टः प्रणम्य च महेश्वरम् उटजं स्वं जगामाशु निधिं लब्ध्वेव निर्धनः
verses.transliteration: iti śrīliṅgamahāpurāṇe pūrvabhāge nandikeśvarotpattir nāma dvicatvāriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ mayā saha pitā hṛṣṭaḥ praṇamya ca maheśvaram uṭajaṃ svaṃ jagāmāśu nidhiṃ labdhveva nirdhanaḥ
verses.translation: O great sage, when I went to the hut of Silada I esche- wed my divine form and assumed a human shape.
verses.hindi: मनोहरवने वृक्षाः सर्वकोटिसमन्विताः सन्तानकस्थलीमध्ये साक्षाद्देवी सरस्वती
verses.wordMeaning: O great sage, when I went to the hut of Silada I esche- wed my divine form and assumed a human shape.
verses.commentary: Sense: O great sage, when I went to the hut of Silada I esche- wed my divine form and assumed a human shape.

verses.sanskrit: यदागतो ऽहमुटजं शिलादस्य महामुने तदा वै दैविकं रूपं त्यक्त्वा मानुष्यम् आस्थितः
verses.transliteration: yadāgato 'hamuṭajaṃ śilādasya mahāmune tadā vai daivikaṃ rūpaṃ tyaktvā mānuṣyam āsthitaḥ
verses.translation: My divine memory was obliterated for some unknown reason. On seeing that I had assumed human form, my father, worshipped by all the worlds, became extremely miserable and he lamented. Surrounded by his kinsmen, he, the knower of everything, performed my postnatal and other holy rites.
verses.hindi: वे पातालमें रहते हैं; वे ही समस्त लोकोंके काल है  वे विश्वगुरु विष्णुकी दिव्य मूर्ति हैं, साक्षात् हलायुध हैं, देवदेव विष्णुकी शय्या हैं और प्रभु शिवके कंकण (कंगन)-स्वरूप हैं॥ ६४-६५ /२॥ दानव आदि शुक्राचार्यके साथ कटहलके वृक्षोंके वनमें और सभी उरग किन्नरोंके साथ विशाखवन (नारिकेलवन) -में रहते हैं। विविध प्रकारकी जातियोंबाले वृक्ष उस मनोहरवनमें हैं। नन्दीश्वर भी श्रेष्ठ गणोंके
verses.wordMeaning: My divine memory was obliterated for some unknown reason. On seeing that I had assumed human form, my father, worshipped by all the worlds, became extremely miserable and he lamented. Surrounded by his kinsmen, he, the knower of everything,…
verses.commentary: Sense: My divine memory was obliterated for some unknown reason. On seeing that I had assumed human form, my father, worshipped by all the worlds, became extremely miserable and he lamented. Surrounded by his kinsmen, he, the knower of everything,…

verses.sanskrit: नष्टा चैव स्मृतिर्दिव्या येन केनापि कारणात् मानुष्यमास्थितं दृष्ट्वा पिता मे लोकपूजितः
verses.transliteration: naṣṭā caiva smṛtirdivyā yena kenāpi kāraṇāt mānuṣyamāsthitaṃ dṛṣṭvā pitā me lokapūjitaḥ
verses.translation: Silada son of Salankayana was highly fond of me his son. It was he who taught me all these: — viz, the recensions ofRgveda, Yajurveda and the thousand branches of Samaveda with their ancillaries and subdivisions. He taught me Ayurveda (science of medicine), Dhanurveda (science of archery), Gandharva (musicology), Avalak§a:gia (characteris- tics of horses), the details of elephants and also the characteri-
verses.hindi: द्वारा स्तुत होते हुए वहाँ विराजमान हैं। सन्तानक (कल्पवृक्ष) क्षेत्रके मध्यमें साक्षात् सरस्वती देवी रहती हैं ॥ ६६--६८ ॥ हे विप्रो! इस प्रकार मैंने इन वनोंमें निवास करनेवाले लोगोंका संक्षेपमें वर्णन किया; ये असंख्य हैं, विस्तारपूर्वक इनका वर्णन करनेमें मैं समर्थ नहीं
verses.wordMeaning: Silada son of Salankayana was highly fond of me his son. It was he who taught me all these: — viz, the recensions ofRgveda, Yajurveda and the thousand branches of Samaveda with their ancillaries and subdivisions. He taught me Ayurveda (science of medicine),…
verses.commentary: Sense: Silada son of Salankayana was highly fond of me his son. It was he who taught me all these: — viz, the recensions ofRgveda, Yajurveda and the thousand branches of Samaveda with their ancillaries and subdivisions. He taught me Ayurveda (science of medicine),…

verses.sanskrit: विललापातिदुःखार्तः स्वजनैश् च समावृतः जातकर्मादिकाश्चैव चकार मम सर्ववित्
verses.transliteration: vilalāpātiduḥkhārtaḥ svajanaiś ca samāvṛtaḥ jātakarmādikāścaiva cakāra mama sarvavit
verses.translation: On seeing me repeatedly the two noble sages said:
verses.hindi: भुवनविन्यासमें विभिन्न कुलाचल पर्वतोंपर रहनेवाली देवयोनियों आदिका वर्णन अष्टौ पुराण्युदीर्णानि दानवानां द्विजोत्तमाः । सुवर्णकोटरे पुण्ये राक्षसानां महात्मनाम्
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing me repeatedly the two noble sages said:
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing me repeatedly the two noble sages said:

verses.sanskrit: शालङ्कायनपुत्रो वै शिलादः पुत्रवत्सलः उपदिष्टा हि तेनैव ऋक्शाखा यजुषस् तथा
verses.transliteration: śālaṅkāyanaputro vai śilādaḥ putravatsalaḥ upadiṣṭā hi tenaiva ṛkśākhā yajuṣas tathā
verses.translation: He was sad and he said — Alas! the power of the adverse fate and of the creator I" On hearing his lamentation the residents of the hermitage gathered there in great bewil- derment. They evolved amulets and observed auspicious rites to ward off the evil. They eulogised Mah&deva, the three-eyed lord of Uma.
verses.hindi: महानीलेऽपि शैलेन्द्रे पुराणि दश पञ्च च वैकुण्ठे गरुड: श्रीमान् करञ्जे नीललोहितः। वसुधारे वसूनां तु निवासः परिकीर्तितः
verses.wordMeaning: He was sad and he said — Alas! the power of the adverse fate and of the creator I" On hearing his lamentation the residents of the hermitage gathered there in great bewil- derment. They evolved amulets and observed auspicious rites to ward off the evil. They eulogised Mah&deva,…
verses.commentary: Sense: He was sad and he said — Alas! the power of the adverse fate and of the creator I" On hearing his lamentation the residents of the hermitage gathered there in great bewil- derment. They evolved amulets and observed auspicious rites to ward off the evil. They eulogised Mah&deva,…

verses.sanskrit: सामशाखासहस्रं च साङ्गोपाङ्गं महामुने आयुर्वेदं धनुर्वेदं गान्धर्वं चाश्वलक्षणम्
verses.transliteration: sāmaśākhāsahasraṃ ca sāṅgopāṅgaṃ mahāmune āyurvedaṃ dhanurvedaṃ gāndharvaṃ cāśvalakṣaṇam
verses.translation: They performed homa repeating the mantra of Tri- yambaka, offering ten thousand times DQrva (Darbha grass) soaked in honey, and accompanied by other materials of worship.
verses.hindi: सूतजी बोले - इन्द्र शितान्तके शिखरपर विद्यमान सुन्दर पारिजातवनमें रहते हैं। उसके पूर्वमें कुमुदपर्वतकी चोटी है, वह बहुत विस्तृत है । है श्रेष्ठ द्विजो ! वहाँ दानवोंके आठ पुर कहे गये हैं । है श्रेष्ठ द्विजो ! पवित्र सुवर्णकोटरमें नीलक नामक महान् राक्षसोंके अड्सठ
verses.wordMeaning: They performed homa repeating the mantra of Tri- yambaka, offering ten thousand times DQrva (Darbha grass) soaked in honey, and accompanied by other materials of worship.
verses.commentary: Sense: They performed homa repeating the mantra of Tri- yambaka, offering ten thousand times DQrva (Darbha grass) soaked in honey, and accompanied by other materials of worship.

verses.sanskrit: हस्तिनां चरितं चैव नराणां चैव लक्षणम् सम्पूर्णे सप्तमे वर्षे ततो ऽथ मुनिसत्तमौ
verses.transliteration: hastināṃ caritaṃ caiva narāṇāṃ caiva lakṣaṇam sampūrṇe saptame varṣe tato 'tha munisattamau
verses.translation: My father and grandfather lost consciousness. With all their activities ceased, they lamented, fell down as though dead.
verses.hindi: हे सुव्रतो! पर्वतश्रेष्ठ महानीलपर भी घोड़ेके  समान मुखवाले प्रधान किन्नरोंके पन्द्रह पुर हैं और
verses.wordMeaning: My father and grandfather lost consciousness. With all their activities ceased, they lamented, fell down as though dead.
verses.commentary: Sense: My father and grandfather lost consciousness. With all their activities ceased, they lamented, fell down as though dead.

verses.sanskrit: मित्रावरुणनामानौ तपोयोगबलान्वितौ तस्याश्रमं गतौ दिव्यौ द्रष्टुं मां चाज्ञया विभोः
verses.transliteration: mitrāvaruṇanāmānau tapoyogabalānvitau tasyāśramaṃ gatau divyau draṣṭuṃ māṃ cājñayā vibhoḥ
verses.translation: I was affaid of death. Ere long I bowed down to my father and grandfather who were lying down as though they were dead. 1 circumambulated them. I was then engaged in the repetition of Rudra mantra. I meditated on the three-eyed lord in the lotus cavity of my heart, the quiescent lord Sad&tiva with ten arms and five faces. Even as I was standing in the middle of the holy river the delighted lord Mahideva accomp- anied by Uma, and adorned by the crescent moon appear and said — O dear Nandin of great arms, whence is fear from death for you?
verses.hindi: महान् पर्वत वेणुसौधपर विद्याधरोंके तीन पुर हैं श्रीमान् गरुड वैकुण्ठ पर्वतपर और नीललोहित रुद्र
verses.wordMeaning: I was affaid of death. Ere long I bowed down to my father and grandfather who were lying down as though they were dead. 1 circumambulated them. I was then engaged in the repetition of Rudra mantra. I meditated on the three-eyed lord in the lotus cavity of my heart,…
verses.commentary: Sense: I was affaid of death. Ere long I bowed down to my father and grandfather who were lying down as though they were dead. 1 circumambulated them. I was then engaged in the repetition of Rudra mantra. I meditated on the three-eyed lord in the lotus cavity of my heart,…

verses.sanskrit: ऊचतुश् च महात्मानौ मां निरीक्ष्य मुहुर्मुहुः तात नन्द्ययमल्पायुः सर्वशास्त्रार्थपारगः
verses.transliteration: ūcatuś ca mahātmānau māṃ nirīkṣya muhurmuhuḥ tāta nandyayamalpāyuḥ sarvaśāstrārthapāragaḥ
verses.translation: Those two brahmins had been sent by me akme* There is no doubt that you are like myself. O dear, this body of yours is factually worldly. It is not divine. O dear, what was formerly seen and worshipped by Sil&da, Devas, sages,, Sid- dhas, Gandharvas and Dinavas was divine. O Nandivara.
verses.hindi: करंज पर्वतपर निवास करते हैं वसुओंका निवास वसुधारमें बताया गया है । गिरिश्रेष्ठ रत्नधारपर महात्मा सप्तर्षियोंके सात पवित्र स्थान हैं, जो सिद्धोंके वाससे युक्त हैं पर्वतोंमें उत्तम एकश्रृंग पर्वतपर प्रजापतिका महान् आवास है। गजशैलपर दुर्गा आदि तथा सुमेधपर वसुगण
verses.wordMeaning: Those two brahmins had been sent by me akme* There is no doubt that you are like myself. O dear, this body of yours is factually worldly. It is not divine. O dear, what was formerly seen and worshipped by Sil&da, Devas, sages,, Sid- dhas, Gandharvas and Dinavas was divine.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Those two brahmins had been sent by me akme* There is no doubt that you are like myself. O dear, this body of yours is factually worldly. It is not divine. O dear, what was formerly seen and worshipped by Sil&da, Devas, sages,, Sid- dhas, Gandharvas and Dinavas was divine.…

verses.sanskrit: न दृष्टमेवमाश्चर्यम् आयुर्वर्षादतः परम् इत्युक्तवति विप्रेन्द्रः शिलादः पुत्रवत्सलः
verses.transliteration: na dṛṣṭamevamāścaryam āyurvarṣādataḥ param ityuktavati viprendraḥ śilādaḥ putravatsalaḥ
verses.translation: After glancing at the goddess, Uma the daughter of the Himavat, and at the chieftains of the Ganas, the bull-emblemed Mahadeva, Lord of Devas, said with satisfaction in his heart, *'Along with your father and friends you will be unageing and deathless. You will be devoid of pain and misery. You will be imperishable and unchanging. You will have my virility and exploit. You will be my favourite chief of Ganas. I will be al- ways fond of you. You will be at my side for ever. You will have my strength. You will be endowed with great yogic power.*'
verses.hindi: अध्याय ५०1 भुवनविन्यासमें विभिन्न कुलाचल पर्वतोंपर रहनेवाली देवयोनियों आदिका वर्णन २१७ आदित्याश्च तथा रुद्राः कृतावासास्तथाश्विनौ। हैं। पर्वतोंमें उत्तम हेमकक्ष पर्वतपर अस्सी अशीतिर्देवपुर्यस्तु हेमकक्षे नगोत्तमे
verses.wordMeaning: After glancing at the goddess, Uma the daughter of the Himavat, and at the chieftains of the Ganas, the bull-emblemed Mahadeva, Lord of Devas, said with satisfaction in his heart, *'Along with your father and friends you will be unageing and deathless.…
verses.commentary: Sense: After glancing at the goddess, Uma the daughter of the Himavat, and at the chieftains of the Ganas, the bull-emblemed Mahadeva, Lord of Devas, said with satisfaction in his heart, *'Along with your father and friends you will be unageing and deathless.…

verses.sanskrit: समालिङ्ग्य च दुःखार्तो रुरोदातीव विस्वरम् हा पुत्र पुत्र पुत्रेति पपात च समन्ततः
verses.transliteration: samāliṅgya ca duḥkhārto rurodātīva visvaram hā putra putra putreti papāta ca samantataḥ
verses.translation: After saying this to me the lord accompanied by his attendants, took off his lotus garland. The bull-emblemed lord of great splendour tied it on me. With that splendid gar- land clinging to my neck I became as though a second Sankara with three eyes and ten arms. Then Paramesvara took me by the hand and said — ''Tell me. What excellent boon shall I give you now?"
verses.hindi: देवपुरियाँ हैं, वहाँ आदित्यगण, रुद्रगण तथा दोनों सुनीले रक्षसां वासाः पञ्चकोटिशतानि च। अश्विनीकुमार निवास करते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: After saying this to me the lord accompanied by his attendants, took off his lotus garland. The bull-emblemed lord of great splendour tied it on me. With that splendid gar- land clinging to my neck I became as though a second Sankara with three eyes and ten arms.…
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying this to me the lord accompanied by his attendants, took off his lotus garland. The bull-emblemed lord of great splendour tied it on me. With that splendid gar- land clinging to my neck I became as though a second Sankara with three eyes and ten arms.…

verses.sanskrit: अहो बलं दैवविधेर् विधातुश्चेति दुःखितः तस्य चार्तस्वरं श्रुत्वा तदाश्रमनिवासिनः
verses.transliteration: aho balaṃ daivavidher vidhātuśceti duḥkhitaḥ tasya cārtasvaraṃ śrutvā tadāśramanivāsinaḥ
verses.translation: The bull-emblemed lord then took the pure water embedded in his matted hairs. Saying ''Be a river" he cast it down. Then it began to flow as a great river full of splendid, divine, white (shining) water with lots of lotuses and lilies in it. Mahadeva said to that extremely splendid river — "Since you began to flow as a great river from the waters of my matted hairs you will be an excellent holy river named Jatodaka."
verses.hindi: पञ्चकूटे पुराण्यासन् पञ्चकोटिप्रमाणतः॥ ९ सुनील पर्वतपर राक्षसोंके पाँच सौ करोड़ निवासस्थान न हैं। पंचकूटपर पाँच करोड़ पुर हैं। शतश्रृंगपर अमित
verses.wordMeaning: The bull-emblemed lord then took the pure water embedded in his matted hairs. Saying ''Be a river" he cast it down. Then it began to flow as a great river full of splendid, divine, white (shining) water with lots of lotuses and lilies in it.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The bull-emblemed lord then took the pure water embedded in his matted hairs. Saying ''Be a river" he cast it down. Then it began to flow as a great river full of splendid, divine, white (shining) water with lots of lotuses and lilies in it.…

verses.sanskrit: निपेतुर्विह्वलात्यर्थं रक्षाश्चक्रुश् च मङ्गलम् तुष्टुवुश् च महादेवं त्रियंबकमुमापतिम्
verses.transliteration: nipeturvihvalātyarthaṃ rakṣāścakruś ca maṅgalam tuṣṭuvuś ca mahādevaṃ triyaṃbakamumāpatim
verses.translation: "Any man will be liberated from all sins by tak- ing bath in you." Then lord Mahadeva said to the goddess "This is your son" and made me the son of Silada, fall at her feet. She kissed me on the head and stroked me with her hands. With three pourings of water as white as the conch, with three sons she bathed me with the affection due to a son all the while glancing at the lord of Devas. These three pour-
verses.hindi: शतशृङ्गे पुरशतं यक्षाणाममितौजसाम् शोके सौ पर हैं। जली ee त. ८७ तेजस्वी यक्षोंके सौ पुर हैं । ताम्राभ पर्वतपर काद्रवेयोंका ताम्र तु गुहस्य व॥ १०  और विशाख पर्वतपर गुहका निवासस्थान है
verses.wordMeaning: "Any man will be liberated from all sins by tak- ing bath in you." Then lord Mahadeva said to the goddess "This is your son" and made me the son of Silada, fall at her feet. She kissed me on the head and stroked me with her hands.…

verses.sanskrit: हुत्वा त्रियंबकेनैव मधुनैव च संप्लुताम् दूर्वामयुतसंख्यातां सर्वद्रव्यसमन्विताम्
verses.transliteration: hutvā triyaṃbakenaiva madhunaiva ca saṃplutām dūrvāmayutasaṃkhyātāṃ sarvadravyasamanvitām
verses.translation: NrQ&xh yoniparityagah: release from the bondage of Birth and Death, which it the goal of man's life. According to ST, yoni-parity&gah» ftrl-sam&gama-tyagih* ST, cites Bhgavata in support of this meaning.
verses.hindi: श्वेतोदरे मुनिश्रेष्ठाः सुपर्णस्य महात्मनः। है श्रेष्ठ मुनियो ! श्वेतोदर पर्वतपर महात्मा सुपर्णका, पिशाचके कुबेरस्य हरिकूटे हरेर्गृहम्॥ १९  पिशाचकपर कुबेरका और हरिकूटपर विष्णुका आवास कुमुद पर्वतपर किन्नरोंका आवास है। अंजन पर्वतपर चारणोंका निवासस्थान है । कृष्णपर्वतपर गन्धर्वोका सहस्रशिखरे शैले हैत्यानामुग्रकर्मणाम्
verses.wordMeaning: NrQ&xh yoniparityagah: release from the bondage of Birth and Death, which it the goal of man's life. According to ST, yoni-parity&gah» ftrl-sam&gama-tyagih* ST, cites Bhgavata in support of this meaning.
verses.commentary: Sense: NrQ&xh yoniparityagah: release from the bondage of Birth and Death, which it the goal of man's life. According to ST, yoni-parity&gah» ftrl-sam&gama-tyagih* ST, cites Bhgavata in support of this meaning.

verses.sanskrit: पिता विगतसंज्ञश् च तथा चैव पितामहः विचेष्टश् च ललापासौ मृतवन्निपपात च
verses.transliteration: pitā vigatasaṃjñaś ca tathā caiva pitāmahaḥ viceṣṭaś ca lalāpāsau mṛtavannipapāta ca
verses.translation: On seeing the river Trisrotas the bull (vehicle of Siva) was extremely delighted. It bellowed. From that bellowing sound another river originated. That river was called *'Vj*§adh- vani'' by the lord of Dcvas. The bull-emblemed lord placed on my head his divine golden crown that was made by ViiSvakar- man, studded with all jewels, and that was variegated au- spicious and wonderful. MahiUleva, MaheSara himself fitted in my ears his splendid divine ear-rings bedecked with diamonds and Lapis Lazuli.
verses.hindi: पुराणां तु सहस्त्राणि सप्तशक्रारिणां द्विजाः। निवासस्थान है । है श्रेष्ठ विप्रो! पाण्डुर पर्वतपर विद्याधरोंके सात पुर हैं, जो सभी प्रकारके भोगोंसे युक्त हैं । है द्विजो!
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing the river Trisrotas the bull (vehicle of Siva) was extremely delighted. It bellowed. From that bellowing sound another river originated. That river was called *'Vj*§adh- vani'' by the lord of Dcvas.…
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing the river Trisrotas the bull (vehicle of Siva) was extremely delighted. It bellowed. From that bellowing sound another river originated. That river was called *'Vj*§adh- vani'' by the lord of Dcvas.…

verses.sanskrit: मृत्योर् भीतो ऽहम् अचिराच् छिरसा चाभिवन्द्य तम् मृतवत्पतितं साक्षात् पितरं च पितामहम्
verses.transliteration: mṛtyor bhīto 'ham acirāc chirasā cābhivandya tam mṛtavatpatitaṃ sākṣāt pitaraṃ ca pitāmaham
verses.translation: O sage, on seeing me honoured thus, the sun in the sky showered Siladana with waters from the clouds. When he was thus showered, those waters flowed as a stream. Since this river originated from gold, the three-eyed lord of Devas called her SvatTLodaka. Since another splendid river originated from the crown made of gold they call that river Jambunadl. Thus the set of five rivers flowed near the lord Japyevara.
verses.hindi: मुकुटे पन्नगावासः पुष्पकेतौ मुनीश्वराः सहस्रशिखर पर्वतपर भयानक कर्मवाले इन्द्रशत्रु हैत्योंके सात हजार पुर हैं। है मुनीश्वरो ! पुष्पकेतु मुकुट पर्वतपर पन्नगोंका आवास है। वैवस्वत, सोम, वायु और तक्षके चैव शैलेन्द्रे चत्वार्यायतनानि च॥ १५ नागाधिपतिके चार निवासस्थान शैलराज तक्षकपर
verses.wordMeaning: O sage, on seeing me honoured thus, the sun in the sky showered Siladana with waters from the clouds. When he was thus showered, those waters flowed as a stream. Since this river originated from gold, the three-eyed lord of Devas called her SvatTLodaka.…
verses.commentary: Sense: O sage, on seeing me honoured thus, the sun in the sky showered Siladana with waters from the clouds. When he was thus showered, those waters flowed as a stream. Since this river originated from gold, the three-eyed lord of Devas called her SvatTLodaka.…

verses.sanskrit: प्रदक्षिणीकृत्य च तं रुद्रजाप्यरतो ऽभवम् हृत्पुण्डरीके सुषिरे ध्यात्वा देवं त्रियंबकम्
verses.transliteration: pradakṣiṇīkṛtya ca taṃ rudrajāpyarato 'bhavam hṛtpuṇḍarīke suṣire dhyātvā devaṃ triyaṃbakam
verses.translation: He who visits Paflcanada,*'® takes the holy dip there and worships Lord JapyeSvara shall undoubtedly attain identity with Siva.
verses.hindi: ब्रहोन्द्रविष्णुरुद्राणां गुहस्य च महात्मनः। gies ब्रह्मा, विष्णु, रुद्र, इन्द्र, महात्मा गुह, कुबेर, सोम कुबेरस्य च सोमस्य तथान्येषां महात्मनाम्॥ १६  तथा अन्य महात्माओके मुख्य निवासस्थान मर्यादाः श्रीकण्ठस्याधिपत्यं वै सर्वदेवेश्वरस्य च। अण्डस्यास्य प्रवृत्तिस्तु श्रीकण्ठेन न संशय:
verses.wordMeaning: He who visits Paflcanada,*'® takes the holy dip there and worships Lord JapyeSvara shall undoubtedly attain identity with Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who visits Paflcanada,*'® takes the holy dip there and worships Lord JapyeSvara shall undoubtedly attain identity with Siva.

verses.sanskrit: त्र्यक्षं दशभुजं शान्तं पञ्चवक्त्रं सदाशिवम् सरितश्चान्तरे पुण्ये स्थितं मां परमेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: tryakṣaṃ daśabhujaṃ śāntaṃ pañcavaktraṃ sadāśivam saritaścāntare puṇye sthitaṃ māṃ parameśvaraḥ
verses.translation: Then lord Mahadeva, Bhava, the lord of all living beings said to goddess Sarvau, Uma, the unborn, and daughter of the mountain.
verses.hindi: पर्वतोंपर हैं। सर्वव्यापी शिव भगवती उमाके साथ श्रीकण्ठपर्वतकी गुफामें निवास करते हैं। सभी देवताओंके अनन्तेशादयस्त्वेवं प्रत्येकं चाण्डपालकाः। चक्रवर्तिन इत्युक्तास्ततो विद्येश्वरास्त्विह ईश्वर शिवका आधिपत्य श्रीकण्ठ पर्वतपर है। इस ब्रह्माण्डकी उत्पत्ति श्रीकण्ठसे ही हुई है; इसमें सन्देह नहीं है
verses.wordMeaning: Then lord Mahadeva, Bhava, the lord of all living beings said to goddess Sarvau, Uma, the unborn, and daughter of the mountain.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then lord Mahadeva, Bhava, the lord of all living beings said to goddess Sarvau, Uma, the unborn, and daughter of the mountain.

verses.sanskrit: तुष्टो ऽब्रवीन्महादेवः सोमः सोमार्धभूषणः वत्स नन्दिन्महाबाहो मृत्योर्भीतिः कुतस्तव
verses.transliteration: tuṣṭo 'bravīnmahādevaḥ somaḥ somārdhabhūṣaṇaḥ vatsa nandinmahābāho mṛtyorbhītiḥ kutastava
verses.translation: O goddess, I am going to crown lord Nandiiivara as the lord of goblins. I shtiU call him the leader of the Ganas. O unchanging goddess, what do you think?
verses.hindi: मर्यादापर्वतेष्वद्य शृण्वन्तु प्रवदाम्यहम्॥ २०  संक्षेपं वर्णन करता हूँ, आपलोग सुनिये। मैं श्रीकण्ठसे श्रीकण्ठाश्चिष्ठितं विश्वं चराचरमिदं जगत्। अधिष्ठित कालाग्निशिवपर्यन्त इस सम्पूर्ण चराचर जगतका पचासवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ अनन्त, ईश आदि इनमेंसे प्रत्येक देवता ब्रह्माण्ड रक्षक हैं, अत: वे चक्रवर्ती तथा विद्येश्वर कहे गये हैं। अब मैं मर्यादापर्वतोंपर श्रीकण्ठसे अधिष्ठित स्थानोंका कालाग्निशिवपर्यन्तं कथं वक्ष्ये सविस्तरम्॥ २१ विस्तारपूर्वक वर्णन कैसे कर सकता हूँ?
verses.wordMeaning: O goddess, I am going to crown lord Nandiiivara as the lord of goblins. I shtiU call him the leader of the Ganas. O unchanging goddess, what do you think?
verses.commentary: Sense: O goddess, I am going to crown lord Nandiiivara as the lord of goblins. I shtiU call him the leader of the Ganas. O unchanging goddess, what do you think?

verses.sanskrit: मयैव प्रेषितौ विप्रौ मत्समस्त्वं न संशयः वत्सैनत्तव देहं च लौकिकं परमार्थतः
verses.transliteration: mayaiva preṣitau viprau matsamastvaṃ na saṃśayaḥ vatsainattava dehaṃ ca laukikaṃ paramārthataḥ
verses.translation: On hearing his words the delight of Bhavani was evident in her face. Smilingly she said to Bhava her lord, the lotd of goblins, and the bestower of boons, lord of Devas, it behoves you to grant him the overlordship of the worlds as also the leadership of the Garias, Sailadi is my own son."
verses.hindi: दिव्य भूतवनमें महादेवके निवासस्थानका वर्णन, कैलास तथा वहाँकी पवित्र नदियोंका वर्णन बहुमूल्य मणियोंसे निर्मित, स्वच्छ, पवित्र, सौ हजार शाखाओंसे युक्त, सभी प्रकारके वृक्षोंसे मण्डित, चम्पक- अशोक-पुन्नाग-बकुल तथा असनसे विभूषित, पारिजातसे परिपूर्ण, अनेक प्रकारके पक्षियोंसे भरे हुए, सैकड़ों
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing his words the delight of Bhavani was evident in her face. Smilingly she said to Bhava her lord, the lotd of goblins, and the bestower of boons, lord of Devas, it behoves you to grant him the overlordship of the worlds as also the leadership of the Garias,…
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing his words the delight of Bhavani was evident in her face. Smilingly she said to Bhava her lord, the lotd of goblins, and the bestower of boons, lord of Devas, it behoves you to grant him the overlordship of the worlds as also the leadership of the Garias,…

verses.sanskrit: नास्त्येव दैविकं दृष्टं शिलादेन पुरा तव देवैश् च मुनिभिः सिद्धैर् गन्धर्वैर्दानवोत्तमैः
verses.transliteration: nāstyeva daivikaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ śilādena purā tava devaiś ca munibhiḥ siddhair gandharvairdānavottamaiḥ
verses.translation: paftcanadam: a confluence of five rivers, viz. Jafodaki, Tri« srotas, Vrsadhvani, SvarvodakS, and JfimbOaadl.
verses.hindi: प्रकारके धातुओंसे चित्रित, अद्भुत पुष्पोंसे युक्त, नीचेतक लटकती हुई पुष्प-शाखाओंसे युक्त नितम्बवाले, नानाविध पशु-समूहोंसे भरे हुए, अनेक धाराओंसे युक्त, स्वच्छ तथा स्वादिष्ट जलवाले, अनेकविध पुष्पोंसे भरे हुए निझरोंसे विभूषित और बहती हुई धाराओं तथा उनमें तैरते हुए पुष्पगुच्छोंसे सुशोभित देवकूट पर्वतपर उसके मध्यमें मनोहर वर्णवाला, गहरी जडों तथा अनेक स्कन्धोंसे युक्त वृक्षोंवाला, मनोहर, घनी छायावाला,
verses.wordMeaning: paftcanadam: a confluence of five rivers, viz. Jafodaki, Tri« srotas, Vrsadhvani, SvarvodakS, and JfimbOaadl.
verses.commentary: Sense: paftcanadam: a confluence of five rivers, viz. Jafodaki, Tri« srotas, Vrsadhvani, SvarvodakS, and JfimbOaadl.

verses.sanskrit: पूजितं यत्पुरा वत्स दैविकं नन्दिकेश्वर संसारस्य स्वभावो ऽयं सुखं दुःखं पुनः पुनः
verses.transliteration: pūjitaṃ yatpurā vatsa daivikaṃ nandikeśvara saṃsārasya svabhāvo 'yaṃ sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ punaḥ punaḥ
verses.translation: As soon as Rudra remembered them, the leaders of Gaas came there. All of them had a thousand arms with weapons in all their thousand hands.
verses.hindi: भूतगणोंके निवासस्थानोंसे समन्वित भूतवन नामक वन वहाँ महादेव महात्मा भगवान् शंकरका कान्तिमान् निवासस्थान है। वह महामणियोंसे विभूषित; स्वर्णकी चहारदीवारीसे युक्त; मणिमय तोरणोंसे मण्डित; स्फटिकके बने हुए विचित्र गोपुरोंसे युक्त; भूमिपर इधर-उधर शुभ
verses.wordMeaning: As soon as Rudra remembered them, the leaders of Gaas came there. All of them had a thousand arms with weapons in all their thousand hands.
verses.commentary: Sense: As soon as Rudra remembered them, the leaders of Gaas came there. All of them had a thousand arms with weapons in all their thousand hands.

verses.sanskrit: नृणां योनिपरित्यागः सर्वथैव विवेकिनः एवमुक्त्वा तु मां साक्षात् सर्वदेवमहेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: nṛṇāṃ yoniparityāgaḥ sarvathaiva vivekinaḥ evamuktvā tu māṃ sākṣāt sarvadevamaheśvaraḥ
verses.translation: They had three eyes. These noble gaas were saluted even by Devas. They resembled crorcs of fires that bum at the time of dissolution. They had matted hairs and crowns.
verses.hindi: आस्तरणोंसे ढके हुए, शिवजीके द्वारा अधिष्ठित, सुन्दर तथा मणिमय सिंहासनोंसे युक्त; कभी न मुरझानेवाले अनेक रंगके फूलोंसे विभूषित उत्तम भवनोंसे युक्त; स्फटिकके स्तम्भोंवाले अत्यन्त विचित्र मण्डपोंसे समन्वित; ब्रह्मा, इन्द्र तथा उपेनद्रके द्वारा पूजित सभी भूतगणोंसे संयुक्त; वराह-गज-सिंह-ऋक्ष-शार्दूल, करभ, गीध, उल्य-गग-उष्ट्र तथा अजके समान मुखवाले, पर्वतके शिखरके समान स्थूल, सुन्दर, भयानक सिंहके समान
verses.wordMeaning: They had three eyes. These noble gaas were saluted even by Devas. They resembled crorcs of fires that bum at the time of dissolution. They had matted hairs and crowns.
verses.commentary: Sense: They had three eyes. These noble gaas were saluted even by Devas. They resembled crorcs of fires that bum at the time of dissolution. They had matted hairs and crowns.

verses.sanskrit: कराभ्यां सुशुभाभ्यां च उभाभ्यां परमेश्वरः पस्पर्श भगवान् रुद्रः परमार्तिहरो हरः
verses.transliteration: karābhyāṃ suśubhābhyāṃ ca ubhābhyāṃ parameśvaraḥ pasparśa bhagavān rudraḥ paramārtiharo haraḥ
verses.translation: Innumerable lords of Gaas of noble souls came there with jubilation. They were accompanied by crores and crores of Gaas all equal in exploits to the chief. Their faces were terri- ble due to the curved fangs. They were eternal, enlightened and devoid of impurities.
verses.hindi: केशों तथा रोमॉंबाले, बड़ी भुजाओंवाले, अनेक वर्ण देवकूटे गिरौ मध्ये महाकूटे सुशोभने। हेमवैडूर्यमाणिक्यनीलगोमेदकान्तिभिः
verses.wordMeaning: Innumerable lords of Gaas of noble souls came there with jubilation. They were accompanied by crores and crores of Gaas all equal in exploits to the chief. Their faces were terri- ble due to the curved fangs. They were eternal, enlightened and devoid of impurities.
verses.commentary: Sense: Innumerable lords of Gaas of noble souls came there with jubilation. They were accompanied by crores and crores of Gaas all equal in exploits to the chief. Their faces were terri- ble due to the curved fangs. They were eternal, enlightened and devoid of impurities.

verses.sanskrit: उवाच च महादेवस् तुष्टात्मा वृषभध्वजः निरीक्ष्य गणपांश्चैव देवीं हिमवतः सुताम्
verses.transliteration: uvāca ca mahādevas tuṣṭātmā vṛṣabhadhvajaḥ nirīkṣya gaṇapāṃścaiva devīṃ himavataḥ sutām
verses.translation: Those strong ones were singing, running, dancing and playing on various instruments with facial gestures.
verses.hindi: चम्पकाशोकपुन्नागबकुलासनमण्डिते । पारिजातकसम्पूर्णे नानापक्षिगणान्विते निझरेः कुसुमाकौर्णेरनेकेश्च विभूषिते
verses.wordMeaning: Those strong ones were singing, running, dancing and playing on various instruments with facial gestures.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those strong ones were singing, running, dancing and playing on various instruments with facial gestures.

verses.sanskrit: समालोक्य च तुष्टात्मा महादेवः सुरेश्वरः अजरो जरया त्यक्तो नित्यं दुःखविवर्जितः
verses.transliteration: samālokya ca tuṣṭātmā mahādevaḥ sureśvaraḥ ajaro jarayā tyakto nityaṃ duḥkhavivarjitaḥ
verses.translation: These Gaas rode in chariots, on elephants, horses, lions and monkeys. They were seated in aerial chariots decorated in gold.
verses.hindi: पुष्पोडुपवहाभिश्च स्रवन्तीभिरलङ्कृते। स्निग्धवर्ण महामूलमनेकस्कन्धपादपम् महादेवस्य देवस्य शङ्करस्य महात्मनः । दीप्तमायतनं तत्र महामणिविभूषितम्
verses.wordMeaning: These Gaas rode in chariots, on elephants, horses, lions and monkeys. They were seated in aerial chariots decorated in gold.
verses.commentary: Sense: These Gaas rode in chariots, on elephants, horses, lions and monkeys. They were seated in aerial chariots decorated in gold.

verses.sanskrit: अक्षयश्चाव्ययश्चैव सपिता ससुहृज्जनः ममेष्टो गणपश्चैव मद्वीर्यो मत्पराक्रमः
verses.transliteration: akṣayaścāvyayaścaiva sapitā sasuhṛjjanaḥ mameṣṭo gaṇapaścaiva madvīryo matparākramaḥ
verses.translation: The Gaas of great yogic power came to the assembly of the lord, playing on drums and other musical instruments such as Bheri, Mdangaka, Paava, Anaka, Gomukha, Pataha, Ekapukara, Adambaraka, Muraja, Piduna, Mardala, Veipiu (flute), (lute), different kinds of cymbals, Dardura, TalaghUta, Kacchapa and Paava.
verses.hindi: हेमप्राकारसंयुक्तं मणितोरणमण्डितम्। स्फाटिकैश्च विचित्रैश्च गोपुरेशच समन्वितम् वराहगजसिंहक्षशार्दूलकरभाननै
verses.wordMeaning: The Gaas of great yogic power came to the assembly of the lord, playing on drums and other musical instruments such as Bheri, Mdangaka, Paava, Anaka, Gomukha, Pataha, Ekapukara, Adambaraka, Muraja, Piduna, Mardala, Veipiu (flute), (lute), different kinds of cymbals, Dardura,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The Gaas of great yogic power came to the assembly of the lord, playing on drums and other musical instruments such as Bheri, Mdangaka, Paava, Anaka, Gomukha, Pataha, Ekapukara, Adambaraka, Muraja, Piduna, Mardala, Veipiu (flute), (lute), different kinds of cymbals, Dardura,…

verses.sanskrit: इष्टो मम सदा चैव मम पार्श्वगतः सदा मद्बलश्चैव भविता महायोगबलान्वितः
verses.transliteration: iṣṭo mama sadā caiva mama pārśvagataḥ sadā madbalaścaiva bhavitā mahāyogabalānvitaḥ
verses.translation: Those lords of Gaas of great strength and stamina, the lords of the chiefi of Devas bowed down to the lord and the goddess and spoke these words:
verses.hindi: करालैर्हरिकेशैश्च रोमशैश्च महाभुजैः। नानावर्णाकृतिधरैर्नानासंस्थानसंस्थितैः अध्याय ५१  दिव्य भूतवनमें महादेवके निवासस्थानका वर्णन २१९
verses.wordMeaning: Those lords of Gaas of great strength and stamina, the lords of the chiefi of Devas bowed down to the lord and the goddess and spoke these words:
verses.commentary: Sense: Those lords of Gaas of great strength and stamina, the lords of the chiefi of Devas bowed down to the lord and the goddess and spoke these words:

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्त्वा च मां देवो भगवान् सगणस्तदा कुशेशयमयीं मालां समुन्मुच्यात्मनस्तदा
verses.transliteration: evamuktvā ca māṃ devo bhagavān sagaṇastadā kuśeśayamayīṃ mālāṃ samunmucyātmanastadā
verses.translation: O blessed lord, O lord of the clue& of Devas, O three-eyed lord, O bull*emblemed lord, why are we summon- ed? O lord of great qdendour, command us.
verses.hindi: दीप्तास्थैदीप्तचरितर्नन्दीश्वरमुखै: शुभैः। आकारवाले, विभिन्न आसनोंसे बैठे हुए प्रभामय ्रहोन्रविष्णुसङ्काशैरणिमादिगुणान्वितैः ॥ १५  मुखवाले, भव्य चरितवाले, ब्रह्मा-इन्द्र-विष्णुके तुल्य अशून्यममंरैर्नित्यं महापरिषहैस्तथा। oe wes ke तत्र भूतपतेर्देवाः पूजां नित्यं प्रयुञ्जते॥ नन्दीश्वर आ ध प्रमथोसे सुशोभित; दवता; 3 १६  तथा महापरिषदोंसे नित्य परिपूर्ण रहता है । वहाँ देवतालोग शङ्कपटहैर्भेरीडिण्डिमगोमुखैः ।
verses.wordMeaning: O blessed lord, O lord of the clue& of Devas, O three-eyed lord, O bull*emblemed lord, why are we summon- ed? O lord of great qdendour, command us.
verses.commentary: Sense: O blessed lord, O lord of the clue& of Devas, O three-eyed lord, O bull*emblemed lord, why are we summon- ed? O lord of great qdendour, command us.

verses.sanskrit: आबबन्ध महातेजा मम देवो वृषध्वजः तयाहं मालया जातः शुभया कण्ठसक्तया
verses.transliteration: ābabandha mahātejā mama devo vṛṣadhvajaḥ tayāhaṃ mālayā jātaḥ śubhayā kaṇṭhasaktayā
verses.translation: Infuriated that we are, shall we bind up Indra along with Devas or Viu along vnik VUyu or Daityas along with Dfinavas and bring them here?
verses.hindi: : भूतपति शिवकी नित्य पूजा करते हें ॥८--१६॥ गोमुख (वाद्ययन्त्रों)- था मधुरगानोंके
verses.wordMeaning: Infuriated that we are, shall we bind up Indra along with Devas or Viu along vnik VUyu or Daityas along with Dfinavas and bring them here?
verses.commentary: Sense: Infuriated that we are, shall we bind up Indra along with Devas or Viu along vnik VUyu or Daityas along with Dfinavas and bring them here?

verses.sanskrit: त्र्यक्षो दशभुजश्चैव द्वितीय इव शङ्करः तत एव समादाय हस्तेन परमेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: tryakṣo daśabhujaścaiva dvitīya iva śaṅkaraḥ tata eva samādāya hastena parameśvaraḥ
verses.translation: Olord, at your behit, to whom shall we bring about destruction and distress today? Who has great festivities today for the prosperity and increase of his desires?'*
verses.hindi: सिद्धर्षिदेवगन्ध्वैर्ब्रह्मणा च महात्मना द्वारा, नाचने-कूदने तथा गर्जन-ध्वनिके द्वारा प्रमथपति महादेवकी पूजा करते हैं। वहाँ सिद्ध, ऋषि, देवता,
verses.wordMeaning: Olord, at your behit, to whom shall we bring about destruction and distress today? Who has great festivities today for the prosperity and increase of his desires?'*
verses.commentary: Sense: Olord, at your behit, to whom shall we bring about destruction and distress today? Who has great festivities today for the prosperity and increase of his desires?'*

verses.sanskrit: उवाच ब्रूहि किं ते ऽद्य ददामि वरमुत्तमम् ततो जटाश्रितं वारि गृहीत्वा चातिनिर्मलम्
verses.transliteration: uvāca brūhi kiṃ te 'dya dadāmi varamuttamam tato jaṭāśritaṃ vāri gṛhītvā cātinirmalam
verses.translation: The lord honoured crores and hundred crores of those chieftains of Gaas. Even as they earnestly spoke to him thus, he replied as follows:
verses.hindi: उपेन््रप्रमुखैश्चान्यैः पूजितस्तत्र शङ्करः। गन्धर्व, महात्मा ब्रह्मा, उपेन्द्र आदि तथा अन्य लोग शंकरकी पूजा करते हैं। जहाँ शंकरकी पूजा होती है, वह सुन्दर शिखर दो भागोंमें बॅटा हुआ तथा शंखके समान कान्तिमान् प्रतीत होता है ॥ १७--१९ ॥
verses.wordMeaning: The lord honoured crores and hundred crores of those chieftains of Gaas. Even as they earnestly spoke to him thus, he replied as follows:
verses.commentary: Sense: The lord honoured crores and hundred crores of those chieftains of Gaas. Even as they earnestly spoke to him thus, he replied as follows:

verses.sanskrit: उक्ता नदी भवस्वेति उत्ससर्ज वृषध्वजः ततः सा दिव्यतोया च पूर्णासितजला शुभा
verses.transliteration: uktā nadī bhavasveti utsasarja vṛṣadhvajaḥ tataḥ sā divyatoyā ca pūrṇāsitajalā śubhā
verses.translation: *You are all persons striving for the welfare of the uni* verse. Listen why you have been called. O noble ones of pure souls, on hearing it do accordingly without hesitation.
verses.hindi: कैलास यक्षोंके राजा महात्मा कुबेरका, करोड़ों यक्षोंका तथा अन्य महात्माओंका निवासस्थान है। वहाँ देवाधिदेव शिवका विशाल भवन है। शिवजी उस भवनमें उमा तथा अपने गणोंके साथ सदा विराजमान रहते हैं । वहाँ कुबेरके सुन्दर शिखरपर बहुत जलसे भरी हुई सोने तथा मणियोंसे निर्मित सीढ़ियोंवाली और कुमुदपुष्पोंसे युक्त मन्दाकिनी नामक नदी है। वह पुण्यदायिनी तथा पवित्र मन्दाकिनी नदी गन्ध-स्पर्शगुणोंसे
verses.wordMeaning: *You are all persons striving for the welfare of the uni* verse. Listen why you have been called. O noble ones of pure souls, on hearing it do accordingly without hesitation.
verses.commentary: Sense: *You are all persons striving for the welfare of the uni* verse. Listen why you have been called. O noble ones of pure souls, on hearing it do accordingly without hesitation.

verses.sanskrit: पद्मोत्पलवनोपेता प्रावर्तत महानदी तामाह च महादेवो नदीं परमशोभनाम्
verses.transliteration: padmotpalavanopetā prāvartata mahānadī tāmāha ca mahādevo nadīṃ paramaśobhanām
verses.translation: This Nandfvara is our son. He is the lord of all chiefs. He is a prosperous brahmin, your leader and coxnmander-in* chief.
verses.hindi: युक्त सुवर्णमय कमलों, नील वैदूर्यके पत्तों, गन्धयुक्त विशाल उत्पलों और कुमुदों तथा महापद्मोंसे अलंकृत; यक्षों तथा गन्धर्वोकी स्त्रियों और अप्सराओंसे सेवित एवं देवता-दानव-गन्धर्व-यक्ष-राक्षस-किन्नरोंके द्वारा उपस्मृष्ट (स्नान-पानके लिये उपयुक्त) जलवाली है
verses.wordMeaning: This Nandfvara is our son. He is the lord of all chiefs. He is a prosperous brahmin, your leader and coxnmander-in* chief.
verses.commentary: Sense: This Nandfvara is our son. He is the lord of all chiefs. He is a prosperous brahmin, your leader and coxnmander-in* chief.

verses.sanskrit: यस्माज्जटोदकादेव प्रवृत्ता त्वं महानदी तस्माज्जटोदका पुण्या भविष्यसि सरिद्वरा
verses.transliteration: yasmājjaṭodakādeva pravṛttā tvaṃ mahānadī tasmājjaṭodakā puṇyā bhaviṣyasi saridvarā
verses.translation: Hence at my bidding, you all, highly respected ones, crown him as your lord and commander-in*chief, as the great lord of yogas"
verses.hindi: उसके उत्तरभागमें शिवजीका वैदूर्यमणिनिर्मित सुन्दर भवन है, वहाँ अविनाशी शंकर निवास करते हैं। हे द्विजो! उसके पूर्व-दक्षिणमें कनकनन्दाके तटपर हजारों द्विजोंसे सेवित और पशुओं तथा पक्षियोसे भरा हुआ एक वन है। वहाँ भी कैलासतुल्य भवनमें शिवजी उमा तथा गणोंके साथ क्रीड़ा करते हैं॥ २६-२७ /२॥
verses.wordMeaning: Hence at my bidding, you all, highly respected ones, crown him as your lord and commander-in*chief, as the great lord of yogas"
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence at my bidding, you all, highly respected ones, crown him as your lord and commander-in*chief, as the great lord of yogas"

verses.sanskrit: त्वयि स्नात्वा नरः कश्चित् सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते ततो देव्या महादेवः शिलादतनयं प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: tvayi snātvā naraḥ kaścit sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate tato devyā mahādevaḥ śilādatanayaṃ prabhuḥ
verses.translation: Thus directed by the lord, the chieftains of the Gaas agreed to the same, by saying "so be it" and thereafter began to gather all the requisites.
verses.hindi: नन्दाके पश्चिमी तटपर थोड़ी दूर दक्षिणमें अनेक निवासः कोटियक्षाणां तथान्येषां महात्मनाम्
verses.wordMeaning: Thus directed by the lord, the chieftains of the Gaas agreed to the same, by saying "so be it" and thereafter began to gather all the requisites.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus directed by the lord, the chieftains of the Gaas agreed to the same, by saying "so be it" and thereafter began to gather all the requisites.

verses.sanskrit: पुत्रस्ते ऽयमिति प्रोच्य पादयोः संन्यपातयत् सा मामाघ्राय शिरसि पाणिभ्यां परिमार्जती
verses.transliteration: putraste 'yamiti procya pādayoḥ saṃnyapātayat sā māmāghrāya śirasi pāṇibhyāṃ parimārjatī
verses.translation: They brought the usual divine seat of Sarva, the splendid seat made of gold, the beautiful one resembling Meru to be offered as seat for him (Nandin). They made a Ma- dapa with many pillars shining with golden lustre. Pearl pen* dants were suspended and they were studded with gems and jewels. There were columns of Lapis Lazuli covered with small tinkling bells. The Madpa had doors on all sides bedecked in beautiful gems and jewels. After making the MaigidApa they placed a splendid seat in the middle. In front of it was the foot-stool shining with blue stones. Fot the installation of the pedestal they kept two water jars nearby. They were filled with sweet waters and covered with lotus flowers.
verses.hindi: तत्रापि देवदेवस्य भवस्यायतनं महत्। तस्मिन्नायतने सोमः सदास्ते सगणो हरः यत्र मन्दाकिनी नाम नलिनी विपुलोदका। सुवर्णमणिसोपाना कुबेरशिखरे शुभे
verses.wordMeaning: They brought the usual divine seat of Sarva, the splendid seat made of gold, the beautiful one resembling Meru to be offered as seat for him (Nandin). They made a Ma- dapa with many pillars shining with golden lustre.…
verses.commentary: Sense: They brought the usual divine seat of Sarva, the splendid seat made of gold, the beautiful one resembling Meru to be offered as seat for him (Nandin). They made a Ma- dapa with many pillars shining with golden lustre.…

verses.sanskrit: पुत्रप्रेम्णाभ्यषिञ्चच्च स्रोतोभिस्तनयैस्त्रिभिः पयसा शङ्खगौरेण देवदेवं निरीक्ष्य सा
verses.transliteration: putrapremṇābhyaṣiñcacca srotobhistanayaistribhiḥ payasā śaṅkhagaureṇa devadevaṃ nirīkṣya sā
verses.translation: There were thousand Jars of gold, silver, copper and clay. They were filled with waters from ail Urthas.
verses.hindi: यक्षगन्धर्वनारीभिरप्सरोभिश्च सेविता देवदानवगन्धवर्यक्षराक्षसकिननरैः ।
verses.wordMeaning: There were thousand Jars of gold, silver, copper and clay. They were filled with waters from ail Urthas.
verses.commentary: Sense: There were thousand Jars of gold, silver, copper and clay. They were filled with waters from ail Urthas.

verses.sanskrit: तानि स्रोतांसि त्रीण्यस्याः स्रोतस्विन्यो ऽभवंस्तदा नदीं त्रिस्रोतसं देवो भगवानवदद्भवः
verses.transliteration: tāni srotāṃsi trīṇyasyāḥ srotasvinyo 'bhavaṃstadā nadīṃ trisrotasaṃ devo bhagavānavadadbhavaḥ
verses.translation: There was a fine Camara (bushy tail of deer used as a flyflap or fan) with gold shaft. The &n was as pure as the moon. It shone with its back as white as conch or pearl necklace.
verses.hindi: बेडूर्यमणिसम्पन्नं तत्रास्ते शङ्करोऽव्ययः पुर॑रुद्रपुरी नाम नानाप्रासादसङ्कलम्। महलोंसे युक्त रुद्रपुरी नामक नगर है। वहाँ भी शिवजी तत्रापि शतधा कृत्वा ह्यात्मानं चाम्बया सह॥ २९  सैकड़ों रूप धारण करके उमा तथा गणोंके साथ क्रीडा क्रीडते सगणः साम्बस्तच्छिवालयमुच्यते। करते हैं, उसे शिवालय न जाता है प इस प्रकार ह एवं शतसहस्राणि शर्वस्यायतनानि तु॥ ३०  मुनिश्रेष्ठो ! प्रत्येक ८ पर्वतोपर, , नदी-नद
verses.wordMeaning: There was a fine Camara (bushy tail of deer used as a flyflap or fan) with gold shaft. The &n was as pure as the moon. It shone with its back as white as conch or pearl necklace.
verses.commentary: Sense: There was a fine Camara (bushy tail of deer used as a flyflap or fan) with gold shaft. The &n was as pure as the moon. It shone with its back as white as conch or pearl necklace.

verses.sanskrit: त्रिस्रोतसं नदीं दृष्ट्वा वृषः परमहर्षितः ननाद नादात्तस्माच्च सरिदन्या ततो ऽभवत्
verses.transliteration: trisrotasaṃ nadīṃ dṛṣṭvā vṛṣaḥ paramaharṣitaḥ nanāda nādāttasmācca saridanyā tato 'bhavat
verses.translation: The divine elephants Airavata and Supratlka were fully caparisoned. A gold crown was made by Visvakarman.
verses.hindi: प्रतिद्वीपे मुनिश्रेष्ठाः पर्वतेषु वनेषु च।  सरोवरोंके तटोंपर और समुद्रोके संगमोपर भगवान नदीनदतटाकानां तीरेष्वर्णवसन्धिषु ॥ ३१  शिवके सैकड़ों-हजारों निवासस्थान हैं ॥ २८--३१  विभिन्न द्वीपोंकी नदियोंका वर्णन, केतुमाल, कुरुवर्ष, भारतवर्ष, किम्पुरुष आदि वर्षामे रहनेवाले लोगों तथा उनकी लोकवृत्तिका वर्णन
verses.wordMeaning: The divine elephants Airavata and Supratlka were fully caparisoned. A gold crown was made by Visvakarman.
verses.commentary: Sense: The divine elephants Airavata and Supratlka were fully caparisoned. A gold crown was made by Visvakarman.

verses.sanskrit: वृषध्वनिरिति ख्याता देवदेवेन सा नदी जांबूनदमयं चित्रं सर्वरत्नमयं शुभम्
verses.transliteration: vṛṣadhvaniriti khyātā devadevena sā nadī jāṃbūnadamayaṃ citraṃ sarvaratnamayaṃ śubham
verses.translation: There were two pure and divine ear-rings. The ex- cellent weapon thunderbolt was kept there. There was a golden thread and two bracelets. The unexcited leaders of Ganas highly honoured by Devas brought many requisite materials from all round.
verses.hindi: पश्चिमाग्राः पवित्राश्च प्रतिवर्ष प्रकीर्तिताः आकाशाम्भोनिधिर्योऽसौ सोम इत्यभिधीयते। आधारः सर्वभूतानां देवानाममृताकरः
verses.wordMeaning: There were two pure and divine ear-rings. The ex- cellent weapon thunderbolt was kept there. There was a golden thread and two bracelets. The unexcited leaders of Ganas highly honoured by Devas brought many requisite materials from all round.
verses.commentary: Sense: There were two pure and divine ear-rings. The ex- cellent weapon thunderbolt was kept there. There was a golden thread and two bracelets. The unexcited leaders of Ganas highly honoured by Devas brought many requisite materials from all round.

verses.sanskrit: स्वं देवश्चाद्भुतं दिव्यं निर्मितं विश्वकर्मणा मुकुटं चाबबन्धेशो मम मूर्ध्नि वृषध्वजः
verses.transliteration: svaṃ devaścādbhutaṃ divyaṃ nirmitaṃ viśvakarmaṇā mukuṭaṃ cābabandheśo mama mūrdhni vṛṣadhvajaḥ
verses.translation: Then all these assembled there joyously: ~ Devas along with Indra, Viu and others, the sages, Brahma and nine Brahmas*®. When all of them had come, lord Parame- vara directed Brahma to perform the rite. At the behest of the lord, Brahma performed the rite of ablution with great attention. After worshipping him Brahma himself poured the water.
verses.hindi: अस्मात्प्रवृत्ता पुण्योदा नदी त्वाकाशगामिनी। सप्तमेनानिलपथा प्रवृत्ता चामृतोदका ताराकोटिसहस्त्राणां नभसश्च समायुता
verses.wordMeaning: Then all these assembled there joyously: ~ Devas along with Indra, Viu and others, the sages, Brahma and nine Brahmas*®. When all of them had come, lord Parame- vara directed Brahma to perform the rite. At the behest of the lord,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Then all these assembled there joyously: ~ Devas along with Indra, Viu and others, the sages, Brahma and nine Brahmas*®. When all of them had come, lord Parame- vara directed Brahma to perform the rite. At the behest of the lord,…

verses.sanskrit: कुण्डले च शुभे दिव्ये वज्रवैडूर्यभूषिते आबबन्ध महादेवः स्वयमेव महेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: kuṇḍale ca śubhe divye vajravaiḍūryabhūṣite ābabandha mahādevaḥ svayameva maheśvaraḥ
verses.translation: At the behest of Siva, Vi§nu, Indra and the guardians of quarters bathed the leaders of Ganas in succession.
verses.hindi: परिवर्तत्यहरहो यथा सोमस्तथैव सा। चत्वार्यशीतिश्च तथा सहस्त्राणां समुच्छितः योजनानां महामेरुः श्रीकण्ठाक्रीडकोमलः।
verses.wordMeaning: At the behest of Siva, Vi§nu, Indra and the guardians of quarters bathed the leaders of Ganas in succession.
verses.commentary: Sense: At the behest of Siva, Vi§nu, Indra and the guardians of quarters bathed the leaders of Ganas in succession.

verses.sanskrit: मां तथाभ्यर्चितं व्योम्नि दृष्ट्वा मेघैः प्रभाकरः मेघांभसा चाभ्यषिञ्चच् छिलादनम् अथो मुने
verses.transliteration: māṃ tathābhyarcitaṃ vyomni dṛṣṭvā meghaiḥ prabhākaraḥ meghāṃbhasā cābhyaṣiñcac chilādanam atho mune
verses.translation: Then the commandants of Ganas, Devas and Asuras one after the other, eulogised and bathed him. Thus after being eulogised and bathed by Devas along with Brahma, his marriage too was performed at the behest of Paramethin. His wife was the gentle lady named Suyaa, the daughter of the Maruts.
verses.hindi: क्रीडते सुचिरं कालं तस्मात्पुण्यजला शिवा। गिरिं मेरुं नदी पुण्या सा प्रयाति प्रदक्षिणम् सूतजी बोले- है श्रेष्ठ ब्राह्मणो! प्रत्येक वर्षमे सदा विपुल जलसे भरी हुई बहुत-सी असंख्य पवित्र नदियाँ बतायी गयी हैं, वे सरोबरोंसे निकली हुई हैं। वे पवित्र नदियाँ पूर्वकी ओर, दक्षिणकी ओर, उत्तरकी ओर
verses.wordMeaning: Then the commandants of Ganas, Devas and Asuras one after the other, eulogised and bathed him. Thus after being eulogised and bathed by Devas along with Brahma, his marriage too was performed at the behest of Paramethin. His wife was the gentle lady named Suyaa,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the commandants of Ganas, Devas and Asuras one after the other, eulogised and bathed him. Thus after being eulogised and bathed by Devas along with Brahma, his marriage too was performed at the behest of Paramethin. His wife was the gentle lady named Suyaa,…

verses.sanskrit: तस्याभिषिक्तस्य तदा प्रवृत्ता स्रोतसा भृशम् यस्मात् सुवर्णान्निःसृत्य नद्येषा सम्प्रवर्तते
verses.transliteration: tasyābhiṣiktasya tadā pravṛttā srotasā bhṛśam yasmāt suvarṇānniḥsṛtya nadyeṣā sampravartate
verses.translation: A well-decorated umbrella having the lustre of the moon was offered to her. She had Camaras also and she was accompanied by groups of women holding Camara in their hands. Along with me, "tlie most excellent throne was occupied by her. She was adorned by Mahalaksmi with coronet and other ornaments.
verses.hindi: तथा पश्चिमको ओर प्रवाहित होनेवाली कही गयी हैं आकाशमें जो जलसागर है, उसे सोम कहा जाता है। वह सभी प्राणियोंका आधार तथा देवताओंके लिये अमृतका भण्डार है; इससे निकली हुई पुण्य जलवाली नदी आकाशमें बहती है। सातवें वायुमार्गसे प्रवृत्त यह
verses.wordMeaning: A well-decorated umbrella having the lustre of the moon was offered to her. She had Camaras also and she was accompanied by groups of women holding Camara in their hands. Along with me, "tlie most excellent throne was occupied by her.…
verses.commentary: Sense: A well-decorated umbrella having the lustre of the moon was offered to her. She had Camaras also and she was accompanied by groups of women holding Camara in their hands. Along with me, "tlie most excellent throne was occupied by her.…

verses.sanskrit: स्वर्णोदकेति तामाह देवदेवस्त्रियंबकः जाम्बूनदमयाद्यस्माद् द्वितीया मुकुटाच्छुभा
verses.transliteration: svarṇodaketi tāmāha devadevastriyaṃbakaḥ jāmbūnadamayādyasmād dvitīyā mukuṭācchubhā
verses.translation: The excellent necklace from the neck of the goddess was gifted to her. The leading bull, the white elephant the lion, the lion-emblem, the chariot, the golden umbrella with
verses.hindi: अमृतमय जलवालौ नदी ज्योतिरूप गणोंके बीच प्रवाहित होती है। यह आकाशके हजारों-करोड़ों ताराओंसे घिरी हुई है। यह चन्द्रमाकी भाँति प्रतिदिन चारों ओर प्रवाहित होती रहती है॥ ३-५ /२॥ महामेरु चौरासी हजार योजन ऊँचा है, वह भगवान् श्रीकण्ठका कोमल क्रीड़ास्थल है। वहाँ शिवजी उमा तथा गरणेश्वरोंके साथ विराजमान रहते हैं और वीर्घकालतक क्रीडा करते हे, अत: वह पवित्र जलवाली
verses.wordMeaning: The excellent necklace from the neck of the goddess was gifted to her. The leading bull, the white elephant the lion, the lion-emblem, the chariot, the golden umbrella with
verses.commentary: Sense: The excellent necklace from the neck of the goddess was gifted to her. The leading bull, the white elephant the lion, the lion-emblem, the chariot, the golden umbrella with

verses.sanskrit: प्रावर्तत नदी पुण्या ऊचुर् जम्बूनदीति ताम् एतत्पञ्चनदं नाम जप्येश्वरसमीपगम्
verses.transliteration: prāvartata nadī puṇyā ūcur jambūnadīti tām etatpañcanadaṃ nāma japyeśvarasamīpagam
verses.translation: The great lord moimted the bull after taking me on, along with all the members of my family, kinsmen and relatives. He set off with the goddess. On seeing the goddess and the lord along with me, the sages, Devas, Siddhas and brahmins requested for the lord's order.
verses.hindi: तथा कल्याणकारिणी है। वह पुण्यदायिनी नदी मेरु पर्वतकी प्रदक्षिणा करती है॥६--८॥ वायुके वेगके कारण विभाजित होते हुए जलवाली वह नदी मेरुकै अन्तर्गत चारों कूटोंमें प्रवाहित होती है। सभी पर्वतोंको विभागपूर्वक सभी ओरसे लाँघकर वह
verses.wordMeaning: The great lord moimted the bull after taking me on, along with all the members of my family, kinsmen and relatives. He set off with the goddess. On seeing the goddess and the lord along with me, the sages, Devas, Siddhas and brahmins requested for the lord's order.
verses.commentary: Sense: The great lord moimted the bull after taking me on, along with all the members of my family, kinsmen and relatives. He set off with the goddess. On seeing the goddess and the lord along with me, the sages, Devas, Siddhas and brahmins requested for the lord's order.

verses.sanskrit: यः पञ्चनदमासाद्य स्नात्वा जप्येश्वरेश्वरम् पूजयेच्छिवसायुज्यं प्रयात्येव न संशयः
verses.transliteration: yaḥ pañcanadamāsādya snātvā japyeśvareśvaram pūjayecchivasāyujyaṃ prayātyeva na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: At the behest of the lord, the husband of the daugh- ter of the mountain, Nandi granted those who deserved the splendid behest of the lord. On receiving the order from the leading sage they became great devotees of Siva. Hence one should worship the lord.
verses.hindi: विभिन्न द्वीपोंकी नदियोंका वर्णन पपरी Es ऊ फा की फी फ फा फ फ फा क फ फ फ फ फ़ क फ फ फ फ़ फ फ फ फ फ फ फ़ फ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ फ़ फ़ फ फ़ फ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ फ फ फ फ़ फ फ क फ़ फ़ फ कफ
verses.wordMeaning: At the behest of the lord, the husband of the daugh- ter of the mountain, Nandi granted those who deserved the splendid behest of the lord. On receiving the order from the leading sage they became great devotees of Siva. Hence one should worship the lord.
