verses.commentary: Sense: At the behest of the lord, the husband of the daugh- ter of the mountain, Nandi granted those who deserved the splendid behest of the lord. On receiving the order from the leading sage they became great devotees of Siva. Hence one should worship the lord.

verses.sanskrit: अथ देवो महादेवः सर्वभूतपतिर्भवः देवीमुवाच शर्वाणीम् उमां गिरिसुतामजाम्
verses.transliteration: atha devo mahādevaḥ sarvabhūtapatirbhavaḥ devīmuvāca śarvāṇīm umāṃ girisutāmajām
verses.translation: At the behest of the lord, the husband of the daugh- ter of the mountain, Nandi granted those who deserved the splendid behest of the lord. On receiving the order from the leading sage they became great devotees of Siva. Hence one should worship the lord.
verses.hindi: नियोगाद्देवदेवस्य प्रविष्टा सा महार्णवम् केतुमाले नराः कालाः सर्वे पनसभोजनाः
verses.wordMeaning: At the behest of the lord, the husband of the daugh- ter of the mountain, Nandi granted those who deserved the splendid behest of the lord. On receiving the order from the leading sage they became great devotees of Siva. Hence one should worship the lord.
verses.commentary: Sense: At the behest of the lord, the husband of the daugh- ter of the mountain, Nandi granted those who deserved the splendid behest of the lord. On receiving the order from the leading sage they became great devotees of Siva. Hence one should worship the lord.

verses.sanskrit: देवी नन्दीश्वरं देवम् अभिषिञ्चामि भूतपम् गणेन्द्रं व्याहरिष्यामि किं वा त्वं मन्यसे ऽव्यये
verses.transliteration: devī nandīśvaraṃ devam abhiṣiñcāmi bhūtapam gaṇendraṃ vyāhariṣyāmi kiṃ vā tvaṃ manyase 'vyaye
verses.translation: At the behest of the lord, the husband of the daugh- ter of the mountain, Nandi granted those who deserved the splendid behest of the lord. On receiving the order from the leading sage they became great devotees of Siva. Hence one should worship the lord.
verses.hindi: कालाम्रभोजनाः सर्वे निरातङ्का रतिप्रियाः। दशवर्षसहस्त्राणि जीवन्ति शिवभाविताः
verses.wordMeaning: At the behest of the lord, the husband of the daugh- ter of the mountain, Nandi granted those who deserved the splendid behest of the lord. On receiving the order from the leading sage they became great devotees of Siva. Hence one should worship the lord.
verses.commentary: Sense: At the behest of the lord, the husband of the daugh- ter of the mountain, Nandi granted those who deserved the splendid behest of the lord. On receiving the order from the leading sage they became great devotees of Siva. Hence one should worship the lord.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा भवानी हर्षितानना स्मयन्ती वरदं प्राह भवं भूतपतिं पतिम्
verses.transliteration: tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā bhavānī harṣitānanā smayantī varadaṃ prāha bhavaṃ bhūtapatiṃ patim
verses.translation: At the behest of the lord, the husband of the daugh- ter of the mountain, Nandi granted those who deserved the splendid behest of the lord. On receiving the order from the leading sage they became great devotees of Siva. Hence one should worship the lord.
verses.hindi: तथा रमणके जीवा न्यग्रोधफलभोजनाः जीवन्ति शुक्लास्ते सर्वे शिवध्यानपरायणाः
verses.wordMeaning: At the behest of the lord, the husband of the daugh- ter of the mountain, Nandi granted those who deserved the splendid behest of the lord. On receiving the order from the leading sage they became great devotees of Siva. Hence one should worship the lord.
verses.commentary: Sense: At the behest of the lord, the husband of the daugh- ter of the mountain, Nandi granted those who deserved the splendid behest of the lord. On receiving the order from the leading sage they became great devotees of Siva. Hence one should worship the lord.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वलोकाधिपत्यं च गणेशत्वं तथैव च दातुमर्हसि देवेश शैलादिस्तनयो मम
verses.transliteration: sarvalokādhipatyaṃ ca gaṇeśatvaṃ tathaiva ca dātumarhasi deveśa śailādistanayo mama
verses.translation: At the behest of the lord, the husband of the daugh- ter of the mountain, Nandi granted those who deserved the splendid behest of the lord. On receiving the order from the leading sage they became great devotees of Siva. Hence one should worship the lord.
verses.hindi: हैरण्मया महाभागा हिरण्मयवनाश्रयाः । एकादशसहस्त्राणि शतानि दशपञ्च च
verses.wordMeaning: At the behest of the lord, the husband of the daugh- ter of the mountain, Nandi granted those who deserved the splendid behest of the lord. On receiving the order from the leading sage they became great devotees of Siva. Hence one should worship the lord.
verses.commentary: Sense: At the behest of the lord, the husband of the daugh- ter of the mountain, Nandi granted those who deserved the splendid behest of the lord. On receiving the order from the leading sage they became great devotees of Siva. Hence one should worship the lord.

verses.sanskrit: ततः स भगवाञ्शर्वः सर्वलोकेश्वरेश्वरः सस्मार गणपान् दिव्यान् देवदेवो वृषध्वजः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sa bhagavāñśarvaḥ sarvalokeśvareśvaraḥ sasmāra gaṇapān divyān devadevo vṛṣadhvajaḥ
verses.translation: At the behest of the lord, the husband of the daugh- ter of the mountain, Nandi granted those who deserved the splendid behest of the lord. On receiving the order from the leading sage they became great devotees of Siva. Hence one should worship the lord.
verses.hindi: कुरुवर्षे तु कुरवः स्वर्गलोकात्परिच्युताः। सर्वे मैथुनजाताश्च क्षीरिणः क्षीरभोजनाः अन्योन्यमनुरक्ताश्च चक्रवाकसधर्मिणः । अनामया ह्यशोकाश्च नित्यं सुखनिषेविणः
verses.wordMeaning: At the behest of the lord, the husband of the daugh- ter of the mountain, Nandi granted those who deserved the splendid behest of the lord. On receiving the order from the leading sage they became great devotees of Siva. Hence one should worship the lord.
verses.commentary: Sense: At the behest of the lord, the husband of the daugh- ter of the mountain, Nandi granted those who deserved the splendid behest of the lord. On receiving the order from the leading sage they became great devotees of Siva. Hence one should worship the lord.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीलिङ्गमहापुराणे पूर्वभागे नन्दिकेश्वरप्रादुर्भावनन्दिकेश्वराभिषेकमन्त्रो नाम त्रिचत्वारिंशो ऽध्यायः स्मरणादेव रुद्रस्य सम्प्राप्ताश् च गणेश्वराः सर्वे सहस्रहस्ताश् च सहस्रायुधपाणयः
verses.transliteration: iti śrīliṅgamahāpurāṇe pūrvabhāge nandikeśvaraprādurbhāvanandikeśvarābhiṣekamantro nāma tricatvāriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ smaraṇādeva rudrasya samprāptāś ca gaṇeśvarāḥ sarve sahasrahastāś ca sahasrāyudhapāṇayaḥ
verses.translation: lord, O Sankara the most excellent among the good»
verses.hindi: सदा तु चन्द्रकान्तानां सदा यौवनशालिनाम्। श्यामाङ्कानां सदा देवदेव शिवके आदेशसे महासागरमें प्रवेश करती है। इससे निकली हुई सैकड़ों-हजारों अनेक नदियाँ कही गयी हैं, जो सभी ट्वीपों, पर्वतों तथा देशोंमें हैं। छोटी नदियाँ तो असंख्य हैं; गंगा आकाशसे पृथ्वीपर आयी
verses.wordMeaning: lord, O Sankara the most excellent among the good»
verses.commentary: Sense: lord, O Sankara the most excellent among the good»

verses.sanskrit: त्रिनेत्राश् च महात्मानस् त्रिदशैरपि वन्दिताः कोटिकालाग्निसंकाशा जटामुकुटधारिणः
verses.transliteration: trinetrāś ca mahātmānas tridaśairapi vanditāḥ koṭikālāgnisaṃkāśā jaṭāmukuṭadhāriṇaḥ
verses.translation: Rudra, Paramevara who had already been propitiated by his penance by Brahma spoke thus again to Silada with very great pleasure.
verses.hindi: हुई हैं, इसलिये वे गंगा कहलाती हैं ॥९--११ /२॥ केतुमालवर्षमें मनुष्य कृष्णवर्णवाले हैं, वे सब कटहलका आहार ग्रहण करते हैं। वहाँकी स्त्रियाँ उत्पलके वर्णवाली हैं । वहाँके लोगोंकी आयु दस हजार वर्ष कही गयी है। भद्राश्ववर्षमें स्त्रियाँ चन्द्रमाकी
verses.wordMeaning: Rudra, Paramevara who had already been propitiated by his penance by Brahma spoke thus again to Silada with very great pleasure.
verses.commentary: Sense: Rudra, Paramevara who had already been propitiated by his penance by Brahma spoke thus again to Silada with very great pleasure.

verses.sanskrit: दंष्ट्राकरालवदना नित्या बुद्धाश् च निर्मलाः कोटिकोटिगणैस्तुल्यैर् आत्मना च गणेश्वराः असंख्याता महात्मानस् तत्राजग्मुर्मुदा युताः
verses.transliteration: daṃṣṭrākarālavadanā nityā buddhāś ca nirmalāḥ koṭikoṭigaṇaistulyair ātmanā ca gaṇeśvarāḥ asaṃkhyātā mahātmānas tatrājagmurmudā yutāḥ
verses.translation: O brahmin, O ascetic, formerly I had been propitiated by Brahma, sages and Devas by penance, for the sake of my incarnation.
verses.hindi: किरणोंके समान शुक्ल वर्णकी हैं। वहाँके सभी लोग कालाम्रका भोजन करनेवाले, भयरहित तथा रतिप्रिय हैं। शिवका ध्यान करनेवाले वे लोग दस हजार वर्षतक जीवित रहते हैं। हिरण्मयवर्षके लोगोंके समान वे भी मनको ईश्वरमें लगाये रखते हैं ॥ १२-१४ /२॥
verses.wordMeaning: O brahmin, O ascetic, formerly I had been propitiated by Brahma, sages and Devas by penance, for the sake of my incarnation.
verses.commentary: Sense: O brahmin, O ascetic, formerly I had been propitiated by Brahma, sages and Devas by penance, for the sake of my incarnation.

verses.sanskrit: गायन्तश् च द्रवन्तश् च नृत्यन्तश् च महाबलाः मुखाडम्बरवाद्यानि वादयन्तस्तथैव च
verses.transliteration: gāyantaś ca dravantaś ca nṛtyantaś ca mahābalāḥ mukhāḍambaravādyāni vādayantastathaiva ca
verses.translation: I shall become your son, not born of a womb, by the name Nandin. O sage, I am the father of worlds and you will become my father.
verses.hindi: रमणकवर्षमें लोग बरगदका फल ग्रहण करते हैं। वे ग्यारह हजार पाँच सौ वर्ष जीवित रहते हैं। वे सब शुक्लवर्णके होते हैं और शिवके ध्यानमें लगे रहते हैं। हिरण्मयवनका आश्रय लेकर महाभाग्यशाली हिरण्मय लोग रहते हैं। वे वहाँपर बारह हजार पाँच सौ वर्ष जीते हैं और अश्वत्थ (पीपल)-के आहारपर जीवित रहते हैं। हिरण्मयवर्षक लोग अपने मनको शिवमें लगाये रखते हैं॥ १५--१८ ॥
verses.wordMeaning: I shall become your son, not born of a womb, by the name Nandin. O sage, I am the father of worlds and you will become my father.
verses.commentary: Sense: I shall become your son, not born of a womb, by the name Nandin. O sage, I am the father of worlds and you will become my father.

verses.sanskrit: रथैर्नागैर्हयैश्चैव सिंहमर्कटवाहनाः विमानेषु तथारूढा हेमचित्रेषु वै गणाः
verses.transliteration: rathairnāgairhayaiścaiva siṃhamarkaṭavāhanāḥ vimāneṣu tathārūḍhā hemacitreṣu vai gaṇāḥ
verses.translation: After saying thus to the sage who was standing there after bowing to him and looking up to him, the delighted merciful lord who was accompanied by Uma and who was comparable to the Moon vanished there itself.
verses.hindi: कुरुवर्षमें कुरुलोग स्वर्गसे गिरे हुए हैं। वे सभी मैथुनक्रियासे उत्पन्न हुए हैं। वे दुग्धका पान तथा भोजन करते हैं। वे एक-दूसरेसे प्रेम करनेवाले, चक्रवाक पक्षीके समान गुण-धर्मवाले, रोगरहित, शोकमुक्त एवं सदा सुखोंका भोग करनेवाले हैं। वे चौदह हजार पाँच सौ वर्षतक जीते हैं । वे महातेजस्वी हैं और अन्य स्त्रीका सेवन नहीं करते हैं। हृष्ट-पुष्ट, अत्यन्त प्रबुद्ध, सभी प्रकारके अन्न तथा अमृतके आहारवाले, सदा चन्द्रमाके
verses.wordMeaning: After saying thus to the sage who was standing there after bowing to him and looking up to him, the delighted merciful lord who was accompanied by Uma and who was comparable to the Moon vanished there itself.
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying thus to the sage who was standing there after bowing to him and looking up to him, the delighted merciful lord who was accompanied by Uma and who was comparable to the Moon vanished there itself.

verses.sanskrit: भेरीमृदङ्गकाद्यैश् च पणवानकगोमुखैः वादित्रैर्विविधैश्चान्यैः पटहैरेकपुष्करैः
verses.transliteration: bherīmṛdaṅgakādyaiś ca paṇavānakagomukhaiḥ vāditrairvividhaiścānyaiḥ paṭahairekapuṣkaraiḥ
verses.translation: O great sage, having obtained the assurance of a son from Rudra, my father was delighted. He was the most excellent among the knowers of sacrifice. For the purpose of sacrifice he came to the courtyard of a great sacrificial cham- ber. Formerly I was born in that courtyard as his son, at the behest of lord Siva. I had the lustre of fire at the closing of a yuga.
verses.hindi: समान कान्तिमान, सदा यौवनशाली, श्याम वर्णके शरीरवाले एवं सर्वदा सभी प्रकारके आभूषणोंसे विभूषित शरीरवाले उन स्वर्गवासी कुरुओंका मरण साथ-साथ होता है। वहाँ जम्बूढीपमें भी अत्यन्त सुन्दर कुरुवर्ष है । चन्द्रशेखर शिवका चन्द्रमाकी प्रभाके समान एक विमान वहाँपर विद्यमान है॥ १९--२४॥
verses.wordMeaning: O great sage, having obtained the assurance of a son from Rudra, my father was delighted. He was the most excellent among the knowers of sacrifice. For the purpose of sacrifice he came to the courtyard of a great sacrificial cham- ber.…
verses.commentary: Sense: O great sage, having obtained the assurance of a son from Rudra, my father was delighted. He was the most excellent among the knowers of sacrifice. For the purpose of sacrifice he came to the courtyard of a great sacrificial cham- ber.…

verses.sanskrit: भेरीमुरजसंनादैर् आडम्बरकडिण्डिमैः मर्दलैर्वेणुवीणाभिर् विविधैस्तालनिःस्वनैः
verses.transliteration: bherīmurajasaṃnādair āḍambarakaḍiṇḍimaiḥ mardalairveṇuvīṇābhir vividhaistālaniḥsvanaiḥ
verses.translation: When I was born as the son of Silada, the clouds Puara, Avartaka and others showered rain. The heaven- walkers — Kinnaras, Sadhyas and Siddhas sang songs. Viu showered fragrant flowers.
verses.hindi: २२२ श्रीलिड्रमहापुराण  वर्षे तु भारते मर्त्याः पुण्याः कर्मवशायुषः। भारतवर्षमें मनु , कर्मके अधीन
verses.wordMeaning: When I was born as the son of Silada, the clouds Puara, Avartaka and others showered rain. The heaven- walkers — Kinnaras, Sadhyas and Siddhas sang songs. Viu showered fragrant flowers.
verses.commentary: Sense: When I was born as the son of Silada, the clouds Puara, Avartaka and others showered rain. The heaven- walkers — Kinnaras, Sadhyas and Siddhas sang songs. Viu showered fragrant flowers.

verses.sanskrit: दर्दुरैस्तलघातैश् च कच्छपैः पणवैरपि वाद्यमानैर्महायोगा आजग्मुर्देवसंसदम्
verses.transliteration: darduraistalaghātaiś ca kacchapaiḥ paṇavairapi vādyamānairmahāyogā ājagmurdevasaṃsadam
verses.translation: I had then the lustre of Kalasurya (sun at the time of pralaya or dissolution). I was having matted hair and coronet. In the form of an infant I had three eyes, four arms holding the trident, axe, iron club and thunderbolt. My curved fangs were adamantine. I was the infant adored by the thunder- bolt-wielding Indra. I was terrible in appearance with diamond ear-rin. My voice was comparable to the thundering sound of
verses.hindi: आयुवाले, प्रायः सौ वर्षकी आयुवाले, अनेक रंगवाले शतायुषः स छोटे शरीरवाले, अनेक देवता पूजामें परायण
verses.wordMeaning: I had then the lustre of Kalasurya (sun at the time of pralaya or dissolution). I was having matted hair and coronet. In the form of an infant I had three eyes, four arms holding the trident, axe, iron club and thunderbolt. My curved fangs were adamantine.…
verses.commentary: Sense: I had then the lustre of Kalasurya (sun at the time of pralaya or dissolution). I was having matted hair and coronet. In the form of an infant I had three eyes, four arms holding the trident, axe, iron club and thunderbolt. My curved fangs were adamantine.…

verses.sanskrit: ते गणेशा महासत्त्वाः सर्वदेवेश्वरेश्वराः प्रणम्य देवं देवीं च इदं वचनम् अब्रुवन्
verses.transliteration: te gaṇeśā mahāsattvāḥ sarvadeveśvareśvarāḥ praṇamya devaṃ devīṃ ca idaṃ vacanam abruvan
verses.translation: O leading sage, with mantras pertaining to MaheiSvara as well as those taken from 5, Yajus and San, the over- joyed sages eulogised and bowed down to me.
verses.hindi: नानाविध कमाँका फल भोगनेवाले, अनेक ज्ञानके अरो सम्पन्न, दुर्बल तथा अल्प सुखको भोगनेवाले कहे गये हैं उनमेंसे कुछ इनद्रद्वीपमें, कुछ कसेरुकद्रीपमे, कुछ ताम्रद्वीपमें और कुछ गभस्तिमान् देशमें चले गये  कुछ नागद्वीपमें, कुछ सोमद्ठीपमें, कुछ गन्धर्वद्वीपमें तथा कुछ वरुणद्वीपमें चले गये । कुछ लोग विविध जातियोंसे उत्पन्न
verses.wordMeaning: O leading sage, with mantras pertaining to MaheiSvara as well as those taken from 5, Yajus and San, the over- joyed sages eulogised and bowed down to me.
verses.commentary: Sense: O leading sage, with mantras pertaining to MaheiSvara as well as those taken from 5, Yajus and San, the over- joyed sages eulogised and bowed down to me.

verses.sanskrit: भगवन्देवदेवेश त्रियंबक वृषध्वज किमर्थं च स्मृता देव आज्ञापय महाद्युते
verses.transliteration: bhagavandevadeveśa triyaṃbaka vṛṣadhvaja kimarthaṃ ca smṛtā deva ājñāpaya mahādyute
verses.translation: The following stood all around me: — Brahma, Vi§nu, Rudra, Indra, Siva, Ambika herself, Jupiter, the moon, the sun of great splendour, wind god, fire god, Isana, Nirrti, Yaksa, Yama, Varuna, Visve Devas, Rudras, Vasus of great strength, Lak$nu herself, Saci, Jye9tha, goddess Sarasvati, Aditi, Diti, Sraddha, Lajja, Dhrti, Nanda, Bhadra, Surabhi, SuiSila, Sumanas, the lord of bulls, Dharma of great splendour and the sons of Dharma. They surrounded me, embraced me and eulogised me. O excellent sage, even Silada my father, the sage, on seeing me like that bowed to me with love. The meritorious soul eulogised his son who gave him what he liked.
verses.hindi: म्लेच्छ और पुलिन्द हैं। उस द्वीपके पूर्वी भागमें किरात तथा पश्चिमी भागमें यवन बताये गये हैं । उसके मध्यभागमें सर्वत्र ब्राह्मण, क्षत्रिय, वैश्य तथा शूद्र हैं। वे पूजन, युद्ध, वाणिज्य आदिके द्वारा जीविका चलाते हुए वहाँ व्यवस्थित हैं। उन वर्णोका अपने-अपने कर्मोमें परस्पर यह व्यवहार धर्म, अर्थ तथा कामसे सम्बन्धित है। उनमें संकल्प एवं अभिमान ब्रह्मचर्यं आदि आश्रमोंमें उचित रूपमें विद्यमान है। वहाँपर स्वर्ग तथा मोक्षके लिये मनुष्योंकी जो प्रवृत्ति
verses.wordMeaning: The following stood all around me: — Brahma, Vi§nu, Rudra, Indra, Siva, Ambika herself, Jupiter, the moon, the sun of great splendour, wind god, fire god, Isana, Nirrti, Yaksa, Yama, Varuna, Visve Devas, Rudras, Vasus of great strength, Lak$nu herself, Saci, Jye9tha,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The following stood all around me: — Brahma, Vi§nu, Rudra, Indra, Siva, Ambika herself, Jupiter, the moon, the sun of great splendour, wind god, fire god, Isana, Nirrti, Yaksa, Yama, Varuna, Visve Devas, Rudras, Vasus of great strength, Lak$nu herself, Saci, Jye9tha,…

verses.sanskrit: किं सागराञ्शोषयामो यमं वा सह किङ्करैः हन्मो मृत्युसुतां मृत्युं पशुवद्धन्म पद्मजम्
verses.transliteration: kiṃ sāgarāñśoṣayāmo yamaṃ vā saha kiṅkaraiḥ hanmo mṛtyusutāṃ mṛtyuṃ paśuvaddhanma padmajam
verses.translation: O lord, O lord of the chief of Devas, O thrcc-eycd one, O unchanging one, you arc my son since you are my protector and the protector of worlds from misery. Since you arc the protector of worlds, O son, you arc my father. You are omnipresent. O son, not bom of a womb, obeisance to you, O source of origin of the universe, O grand father, O father, O son, O MaheiSana, O preceptor of the universe, O dear one, O highly blessed one, O Paramevara protect me. O lord of Devas, since I am delighted by you, you are to be known by the name Nandin. Hence O Nandin, delight me. I bow down to you, the lord of the universe, O lord, delight my parents who have gone to Rudra's world. O lord, my grandfather too has gone to the world of Rudra. O Nandin, when Maheivara has incarnated my birth in the world is fruitful. O lord, the birth of the worlds too is fruitful.
verses.hindi: है और उनके जो युगकर्म हैं, है मुनिश्रेष्ठो ! वैसा अन्यत्र नहीं है किम्पुरुषवर्षमें मनुष्योंकी स्थिति दस हजार वर्षतक रहती है। बहाँके पुरुष सुवर्णके रंगवाले होते हैं और स्त्रियाँ अप्सराओंके समान होती हैं। वे सब रोगरहित, शोकरहित, शिवभक्तिसे युक्त, विशुद्ध सत्त्वगुणसे सम्पन्न,
verses.wordMeaning: O lord, O lord of the chief of Devas, O thrcc-eycd one, O unchanging one, you arc my son since you are my protector and the protector of worlds from misery. Since you arc the protector of worlds, O son, you arc my father. You are omnipresent. O son, not bom of a womb,…
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord, O lord of the chief of Devas, O thrcc-eycd one, O unchanging one, you arc my son since you are my protector and the protector of worlds from misery. Since you arc the protector of worlds, O son, you arc my father. You are omnipresent. O son, not bom of a womb,…

verses.sanskrit: बद्ध्वेन्द्रं सह देवैश् च सह विष्णुं च वायुना आनयामः सुसंक्रुद्धा दैत्यान्वा सह दानवैः
verses.transliteration: baddhvendraṃ saha devaiś ca saha viṣṇuṃ ca vāyunā ānayāmaḥ susaṃkruddhā daityānvā saha dānavaiḥ
verses.translation: When you have incarnated as my son for my protection O IiSvara, O Nandin, O lord of Devas, obeisance to you. O NandHvara, obeisance to you.
verses.hindi: स्वर्णके समान आभावाले, अपनी पत्नियोंके साथ रहनेवाले तथा गूलरका भोजन करनेवाले होते हैं हरिवर्षमें भी मनुष्य महारजतके समान वर्णवाले होते हैं। वे सब देवलोकसे च्युत हुए हैं और हर प्रकारसे
verses.wordMeaning: When you have incarnated as my son for my protection O IiSvara, O Nandin, O lord of Devas, obeisance to you. O NandHvara, obeisance to you.
verses.commentary: Sense: When you have incarnated as my son for my protection O IiSvara, O Nandin, O lord of Devas, obeisance to you. O NandHvara, obeisance to you.

verses.sanskrit: कस्याद्य व्यसनं घोरं करिष्यामस्तवाज्ञया कस्य वाद्योत्सवो देव सर्वकामसमृद्धये
verses.transliteration: kasyādya vyasanaṃ ghoraṃ kariṣyāmastavājñayā kasya vādyotsavo deva sarvakāmasamṛddhaye
verses.translation: O son of mighty arms, protect me. O lord of Devas,
verses.hindi: करते हैं और पवित्र इशुरसका पान करते हैं, अत: उन्हें बुढ़ापा बाधित नहीं करता और वे लोग वृद्ध नहीं होते। वहाँ मनुष्य दस हजार वर्ष जीवित रहते हैं ॥ ३७-३६ Bi  भव्यम स्थित जो इलावृत नामक वर्ष कहा गया pe सूर्य i तपता है और वहाँ मनुष्य बूढ़े नहीं
verses.wordMeaning: O son of mighty arms, protect me. O lord of Devas,
verses.commentary: Sense: O son of mighty arms, protect me. O lord of Devas,

verses.sanskrit: तांस्तथावादिनः सर्वान् गणेशान् सर्वसंमतान् उवाच देवः सम्पूज्य कोटिकोटिशतान्प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: tāṃstathāvādinaḥ sarvān gaṇeśān sarvasaṃmatān uvāca devaḥ sampūjya koṭikoṭiśatānprabhuḥ
verses.translation: O great sage, when I went to the hut of Silada I esche- wed my divine form and assumed a human shape.
verses.hindi: ' इलावृतवर्षमें न सूर्य-चन्द्रमा हैं, न तारे हैं और नानादेवार्चने युक्ता नानाकर्मफलाशिनः। नानाज्ञानार्थसम्पन्ना दुर्बलाश्चाल्पभोगिनः
verses.wordMeaning: O great sage, when I went to the hut of Silada I esche- wed my divine form and assumed a human shape.
verses.commentary: Sense: O great sage, when I went to the hut of Silada I esche- wed my divine form and assumed a human shape.

verses.sanskrit: शृणुध्वं यत्कृते यूयम् इहाहूता जगद्धिताः श्रुत्वा च प्रयतात्मानः कुरुध्वं तदशङ्किताः
verses.transliteration: śṛṇudhvaṃ yatkṛte yūyam ihāhūtā jagaddhitāḥ śrutvā ca prayatātmānaḥ kurudhvaṃ tadaśaṅkitāḥ
verses.translation: My divine memory was obliterated for some unknown reason. On seeing that I had assumed human form, my father, worshipped by all the worlds, became extremely miserable and he lamented. Surrounded by his kinsmen, he, the knower of everything, performed my postnatal and other holy rites.
verses.hindi: इन्द्रद्वीप तथा केचित्तथैव च कसेरुके। ताम्रद्वीपं गताः केचित्केचिद्देशं गभस्तिमत् केचिन्लेच्छाः पुलिन्दाश्च नानाजातिसमुद्भवाः
verses.wordMeaning: My divine memory was obliterated for some unknown reason. On seeing that I had assumed human form, my father, worshipped by all the worlds, became extremely miserable and he lamented. Surrounded by his kinsmen, he, the knower of everything,…
verses.commentary: Sense: My divine memory was obliterated for some unknown reason. On seeing that I had assumed human form, my father, worshipped by all the worlds, became extremely miserable and he lamented. Surrounded by his kinsmen, he, the knower of everything,…

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वरो ऽयं पुत्रो नः सर्वेषामीश्वरेश्वरः विप्रो ऽयं नायकश्चैव सेनानीर् वः समृद्धिमान्
verses.transliteration: nandīśvaro 'yaṃ putro naḥ sarveṣāmīśvareśvaraḥ vipro 'yaṃ nāyakaścaiva senānīr vaḥ samṛddhimān
verses.translation: Silada son of Salankayana was highly fond of me his son. It was he who taught me all these: — viz, the recensions ofRgveda, Yajurveda and the thousand branches of Samaveda with their ancillaries and subdivisions. He taught me Ayurveda (science of medicine), Dhanurveda (science of archery), Gandharva (musicology), Avalak§a:gia (characteris- tics of horses), the details of elephants and also the characteri-
verses.hindi: तेषां संव्यवहारोऽयं वर्ततेऽत्र परस्परम् धर्मार्थकामसंयुक्तो वर्णानां तु स्वकर्मसु। सङ्कल्पश्चाभिमानश्च आश्रमाणां यथाविधि
verses.wordMeaning: Silada son of Salankayana was highly fond of me his son. It was he who taught me all these: — viz, the recensions ofRgveda, Yajurveda and the thousand branches of Samaveda with their ancillaries and subdivisions. He taught me Ayurveda (science of medicine),…
verses.commentary: Sense: Silada son of Salankayana was highly fond of me his son. It was he who taught me all these: — viz, the recensions ofRgveda, Yajurveda and the thousand branches of Samaveda with their ancillaries and subdivisions. He taught me Ayurveda (science of medicine),…

verses.sanskrit: तमिमं मम संदेशाद् यूयं सर्वे ऽपि संमताः सेनान्यम् अभिषिञ्चध्वं महायोगपतिं पतिम्
verses.transliteration: tamimaṃ mama saṃdeśād yūyaṃ sarve 'pi saṃmatāḥ senānyam abhiṣiñcadhvaṃ mahāyogapatiṃ patim
verses.translation: On seeing me repeatedly the two noble sages said:
verses.hindi: तेषां च युगकर्माणि नान्यत्र मुनिपुङ्गवाः अनामया ह्यशोकाश्च सर्वे ते शिवभाविताः।
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing me repeatedly the two noble sages said:
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing me repeatedly the two noble sages said:

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्ता भगवता गणपाः सर्व एव ते एवमस्त्विति संमन्त्र्य संभारानाहरंस्ततः
verses.transliteration: evamuktā bhagavatā gaṇapāḥ sarva eva te evamastviti saṃmantrya saṃbhārānāharaṃstataḥ
verses.translation: He was sad and he said — Alas! the power of the adverse fate and of the creator I" On hearing his lamentation the residents of the hermitage gathered there in great bewil- derment. They evolved amulets and observed auspicious rites to ward off the evil. They eulogised Mah&deva, the three-eyed lord of Uma.
verses.hindi: महारजतसङ्काशा हरिवर्षेऽपि मानवा: । देवलोकाच्च्युताः सर्वे देवाकाराश्च सर्वशः चन्द्रसूर्यौ न नक्षत्रं न प्रकाशमिलावृते
verses.wordMeaning: He was sad and he said — Alas! the power of the adverse fate and of the creator I" On hearing his lamentation the residents of the hermitage gathered there in great bewil- derment. They evolved amulets and observed auspicious rites to ward off the evil. They eulogised Mah&deva,…
verses.commentary: Sense: He was sad and he said — Alas! the power of the adverse fate and of the creator I" On hearing his lamentation the residents of the hermitage gathered there in great bewil- derment. They evolved amulets and observed auspicious rites to ward off the evil. They eulogised Mah&deva,…

verses.sanskrit: तस्य सर्वाश्रयं दिव्यं जांबूनदमयं शुभम् आसनं मेरुसंकाशं मनोहरम् उपाहरन्
verses.transliteration: tasya sarvāśrayaṃ divyaṃ jāṃbūnadamayaṃ śubham āsanaṃ merusaṃkāśaṃ manoharam upāharan
verses.translation: They performed homa repeating the mantra of Tri- yambaka, offering ten thousand times DQrva (Darbha grass) soaked in honey, and accompanied by other materials of worship.
verses.hindi: अध्याय ५२ विभिन्न ट्वीपोंकी नदियोंका वर्णन जअजअ जअआजजअअकळअअजओमअओजजा कीज फफफ की Es
verses.wordMeaning: They performed homa repeating the mantra of Tri- yambaka, offering ten thousand times DQrva (Darbha grass) soaked in honey, and accompanied by other materials of worship.
verses.commentary: Sense: They performed homa repeating the mantra of Tri- yambaka, offering ten thousand times DQrva (Darbha grass) soaked in honey, and accompanied by other materials of worship.

verses.sanskrit: नैकस्तंभमयं चापि चामीकरवरप्रभम् मुक्तादामावलम्बं च मणिरत्नावभासितम्
verses.transliteration: naikastaṃbhamayaṃ cāpi cāmīkaravaraprabham muktādāmāvalambaṃ ca maṇiratnāvabhāsitam
verses.translation: My father and grandfather lost consciousness. With all their activities ceased, they lamented, fell down as though dead.
verses.hindi: फ़ फ़ फ़ फर फ़ फ़ का फ फ फ फ फा फी फी फो फी फो फा भा फ फ फी फ फ फ फ फ फ फ़ फ फ फ फ़ फ फ फ़ फ फ फ़ फ़ फ फ़ फ़ फ फ फ़ फ फ फ़ फ फ फ़ फ़ फ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ फ़ फ़ फ फफक फ फ फ पदाप्रभाः पदामुखाः पद्मपत्रनिभेक्षणाः। प्रकाश ही है । बहाँके लोग कमलके समान प्रभावाले, चदापत्रसुगन्धाश्च जायन्ते भवभाविताः॥ ३९  कमलके समान मुखवाले, कमलके पत्रके समान नेत्रोंवाले जम्बूफलरसाहारा अनिष्पन्दाः सुगन्धिनः । और कमलपत्रकी सुगन्धिसे युक्त होते हैं। वे शिवमें देबलोकागतास्तत्र जायन्ते ह्याजरामराः॥ ४० ध्यानपरायण रहते हैं। बे जामुनके फलके रसका आहार
verses.wordMeaning: My father and grandfather lost consciousness. With all their activities ceased, they lamented, fell down as though dead.
verses.commentary: Sense: My father and grandfather lost consciousness. With all their activities ceased, they lamented, fell down as though dead.

verses.sanskrit: स्तंभैश् च वैडूर्यमयैः किङ्किणीजालसंवृतम् चारुरत्नकसंयुक्तं मण्डपं विश्वतोमुखम्
verses.transliteration: staṃbhaiś ca vaiḍūryamayaiḥ kiṅkiṇījālasaṃvṛtam cāruratnakasaṃyuktaṃ maṇḍapaṃ viśvatomukham
verses.translation: I was affaid of death. Ere long I bowed down to my father and grandfather who were lying down as though they were dead. 1 circumambulated them. I was then engaged in the repetition of Rudra mantra. I meditated on the three-eyed lord in the lotus cavity of my heart, the quiescent lord Sad&tiva with ten arms and five faces. Even as I was standing in the middle of the holy river the delighted lord Mahideva accomp- anied by Uma, and adorned by the crescent moon appear and said — O dear Nandin of great arms, whence is fear from death for you?
verses.hindi: नीर करनेवाले, धूपके प्रभावसे रहित तथा सुगन्धमय होते हैं। देवलोकसे आये हुए वे लोग अजर-अमर होते हैं । उस आयुःप्रमाणं जीवन्ति वर्षे दिव्ये त्विलावृते ॥ ४१  दिव्य इलावृतवर्षमें वे श्रेष्ठ मनुष्य तेरह हजार वर्षतक
verses.wordMeaning: I was affaid of death. Ere long I bowed down to my father and grandfather who were lying down as though they were dead. 1 circumambulated them. I was then engaged in the repetition of Rudra mantra. I meditated on the three-eyed lord in the lotus cavity of my heart,…
verses.commentary: Sense: I was affaid of death. Ere long I bowed down to my father and grandfather who were lying down as though they were dead. 1 circumambulated them. I was then engaged in the repetition of Rudra mantra. I meditated on the three-eyed lord in the lotus cavity of my heart,…

verses.sanskrit: कृत्वा विन्यस्य तन्मध्ये तदासनवरं शुभम् तस्याग्रतः पादपीठं नीलवज्रावभासितम्
verses.transliteration: kṛtvā vinyasya tanmadhye tadāsanavaraṃ śubham tasyāgrataḥ pādapīṭhaṃ nīlavajrāvabhāsitam
verses.translation: Those two brahmins had been sent by me akme* There is no doubt that you are like myself. O dear, this body of yours is factually worldly. It is not divine. O dear, what was formerly seen and worshipped by Sil&da, Devas, sages,, Sid- dhas, Gandharvas and Dinavas was divine. O Nandivara.
verses.hindi: अपनी पूरी आयुभर जीवित रहते हैं। जामुनके फलका रस पीनेसे इन्हें न बुढापा बाधित करता है, न भूख लगती है और न थकावट होती है। वहाँके लोग समयसे पूर्व मरते नहीं हैं। बहाँ जाम्बूनद नामक स्वर्ण होता हैं; वह समान प्रकाशमान रहता है ॥ २७--४३॥
verses.wordMeaning: Those two brahmins had been sent by me akme* There is no doubt that you are like myself. O dear, this body of yours is factually worldly. It is not divine. O dear, what was formerly seen and worshipped by Sil&da, Devas, sages,, Sid- dhas, Gandharvas and Dinavas was divine.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Those two brahmins had been sent by me akme* There is no doubt that you are like myself. O dear, this body of yours is factually worldly. It is not divine. O dear, what was formerly seen and worshipped by Sil&da, Devas, sages,, Sid- dhas, Gandharvas and Dinavas was divine.…

verses.sanskrit: चक्रुः पादप्रतिष्ठार्थं कलशौ चास्य पार्श्वगौ सम्पूर्णौ परमाम्भोभिर् अरविन्दावृताननौ
verses.transliteration: cakruḥ pādapratiṣṭhārthaṃ kalaśau cāsya pārśvagau sampūrṇau paramāmbhobhir aravindāvṛtānanau
verses.translation: After glancing at the goddess, Uma the daughter of the Himavat, and at the chieftains of the Ganas, the bull-emblemed Mahadeva, Lord of Devas, said with satisfaction in his heart, *'Along with your father and friends you will be unageing and deathless. You will be devoid of pain and misery. You will be imperishable and unchanging. You will have my virility and exploit. You will be my favourite chief of Ganas. I will be al- ways fond of you. You will be at my side for ever. You will have my strength. You will be endowed with great yogic power.*'
verses.hindi: इस प्रकार मैंने नौ वर्षोके निवासियोंका वर्णन कर दिया। मैंने उनके वर्ण, आयु, भोजन आदिके विषयमें विस्तारसे नहीं बल्कि संक्षेपमें कहा है हेमकूटपर्वतपर गन्धर्वो तथा अप्सराओंको रहनेवाला जानना चाहिए। शेष, वासुकि, तक्षक और सभी नाग निषधपर रहते हैं। तैंतीस महाबली याज्ञिक देवता, सिद्धाण तथा विशुद्धात्मा ब्रह्मर्षि वैदूर्यं मणिवाले
verses.wordMeaning: After glancing at the goddess, Uma the daughter of the Himavat, and at the chieftains of the Ganas, the bull-emblemed Mahadeva, Lord of Devas, said with satisfaction in his heart, *'Along with your father and friends you will be unageing and deathless.…
verses.commentary: Sense: After glancing at the goddess, Uma the daughter of the Himavat, and at the chieftains of the Ganas, the bull-emblemed Mahadeva, Lord of Devas, said with satisfaction in his heart, *'Along with your father and friends you will be unageing and deathless.…

verses.sanskrit: कलशानां सहस्रं तु सौवर्णं राजतं तथा ताम्रजं मृन्मयं चैव सर्वतीर्थाम्बुपूरितम्
verses.transliteration: kalaśānāṃ sahasraṃ tu sauvarṇaṃ rājataṃ tathā tāmrajaṃ mṛnmayaṃ caiva sarvatīrthāmbupūritam
verses.translation: After saying this to me the lord accompanied by his attendants, took off his lotus garland. The bull-emblemed lord of great splendour tied it on me. With that splendid gar- land clinging to my neck I became as though a second Sankara with three eyes and ten arms. Then Paramesvara took me by the hand and said — ''Tell me. What excellent boon shall I give you now?"
verses.hindi: नीलपर्वतपर रहते हैं हैत्यों एवं दानवोंका निवासस्थान श्वेतपर्वत कहा जाता है। शृंगवानपर्वत सभी पितरोंका निवासस्थान है। हिमवान् सभी यक्षों, भूतों तथा शिवका निवास हैं। महादेवजी श्रीविष्णु, ब्रह्मा, उमा, नन्दी और अपने
verses.wordMeaning: After saying this to me the lord accompanied by his attendants, took off his lotus garland. The bull-emblemed lord of great splendour tied it on me. With that splendid gar- land clinging to my neck I became as though a second Sankara with three eyes and ten arms.…
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying this to me the lord accompanied by his attendants, took off his lotus garland. The bull-emblemed lord of great splendour tied it on me. With that splendid gar- land clinging to my neck I became as though a second Sankara with three eyes and ten arms.…

verses.sanskrit: वासोयुगं तथा दिव्यं गन्धं दिव्यं तथैव च केयूरे कुण्डले चैव मुकुटं हारमेव च
verses.transliteration: vāsoyugaṃ tathā divyaṃ gandhaṃ divyaṃ tathaiva ca keyūre kuṇḍale caiva mukuṭaṃ hārameva ca
verses.translation: The bull-emblemed lord then took the pure water embedded in his matted hairs. Saying ''Be a river" he cast it down. Then it began to flow as a great river full of splendid, divine, white (shining) water with lots of lotuses and lilies in it. Mahadeva said to that extremely splendid river — "Since you began to flow as a great river from the waters of my matted hairs you will be an excellent holy river named Jatodaka."
verses.hindi: गणोंके साथ सभी पर्वतों, वर्षों तथा बनोंमें निवास करते हैं। भगवान् नीललोहित नील, श्वेत एवं त्रिशृंग पर्वतोंपर विशेष रूपसे सिद्धो, देवताओं तथा पितरोंके साथ सदा दिखायी पडते हैं। नीलपर्वत वैदूर्यमय, श्वेतपर्वत शुक्लवर्णवाला, हिरण्यमयपर्वत मोरपंखके वर्णका और श्रृंगवानूपर्वत सुनहरे वर्णका है। ये सभी पर्वतराज जम्बूह्वीपमें स्थित हैं
verses.wordMeaning: The bull-emblemed lord then took the pure water embedded in his matted hairs. Saying ''Be a river" he cast it down. Then it began to flow as a great river full of splendid, divine, white (shining) water with lots of lotuses and lilies in it.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The bull-emblemed lord then took the pure water embedded in his matted hairs. Saying ''Be a river" he cast it down. Then it began to flow as a great river full of splendid, divine, white (shining) water with lots of lotuses and lilies in it.…

verses.sanskrit: छत्रं शतशलाकं च वालव्यजनमेव च दत्तं महात्मना तेन ब्रह्मणा परमेष्ठिना
verses.transliteration: chatraṃ śataśalākaṃ ca vālavyajanameva ca dattaṃ mahātmanā tena brahmaṇā parameṣṭhinā
verses.translation: "Any man will be liberated from all sins by tak- ing bath in you." Then lord Mahadeva said to the goddess "This is your son" and made me the son of Silada, fall at her feet. She kissed me on the head and stroked me with her hands. With three pourings of water as white as the conch, with three sons she bathed me with the affection due to a son all the while glancing at the lord of Devas. These three pour-
verses.hindi: नामक बावतवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ तत्र जाम्बूनदं नाम कनकं देवभूषणम्। इन्द्र्गोपप्रतीकाशं जायते भास्वरं तु तत्
verses.wordMeaning: "Any man will be liberated from all sins by tak- ing bath in you." Then lord Mahadeva said to the goddess "This is your son" and made me the son of Silada, fall at her feet. She kissed me on the head and stroked me with her hands.…
verses.commentary: Sense: "Any man will be liberated from all sins by tak- ing bath in you." Then lord Mahadeva said to the goddess "This is your son" and made me the son of Silada, fall at her feet. She kissed me on the head and stroked me with her hands.…

verses.sanskrit: शङ्खहाराङ्गगौरेण पृष्ठेनापि विराजितम् व्यजनं चन्द्रशुभ्रं च हेमदण्डं सुचामरम्
verses.transliteration: śaṅkhahārāṅgagaureṇa pṛṣṭhenāpi virājitam vyajanaṃ candraśubhraṃ ca hemadaṇḍaṃ sucāmaram
verses.translation: NrQ&xh yoniparityagah: release from the bondage of Birth and Death, which it the goal of man's life. According to ST, yoni-parity&gah» ftrl-sam&gama-tyagih* ST, cites Bhgavata in support of this meaning.
verses.hindi: सर्वे नागाश्च निषधे शेषवासुकितक्षकाः महाबलास्त्रयस्त्रंशद्रमन्ते याज्ञिकाः सुराः। नीले तु वैडूर्यमये सिद्धा ब्रह्मर्घयोऽमलाः
verses.wordMeaning: NrQ&xh yoniparityagah: release from the bondage of Birth and Death, which it the goal of man's life. According to ST, yoni-parity&gah» ftrl-sam&gama-tyagih* ST, cites Bhgavata in support of this meaning.
verses.commentary: Sense: NrQ&xh yoniparityagah: release from the bondage of Birth and Death, which it the goal of man's life. According to ST, yoni-parity&gah» ftrl-sam&gama-tyagih* ST, cites Bhgavata in support of this meaning.

verses.sanskrit: ऐरावतः सुप्रतीको गजावेतौ सुपूजितौ मुकुटं काञ्चनं चैव निर्मितं विश्वकर्मणा
verses.transliteration: airāvataḥ supratīko gajāvetau supūjitau mukuṭaṃ kāñcanaṃ caiva nirmitaṃ viśvakarmaṇā
verses.translation: On seeing the river Trisrotas the bull (vehicle of Siva) was extremely delighted. It bellowed. From that bellowing sound another river originated. That river was called *'Vj*§adh- vani'' by the lord of Dcvas. The bull-emblemed lord placed on my head his divine golden crown that was made by ViiSvakar- man, studded with all jewels, and that was variegated au- spicious and wonderful. MahiUleva, MaheSara himself fitted in my ears his splendid divine ear-rings bedecked with diamonds and Lapis Lazuli.
verses.hindi: हैत्यानां दानवानां च श्वेतः पर्वत उच्यते। शृङ्गवान् पर्वतश्चैव पितृणां निलयः सदा सर्वाद्रिषु महादेवो हरिणा ब्रह्मणाम्बया
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing the river Trisrotas the bull (vehicle of Siva) was extremely delighted. It bellowed. From that bellowing sound another river originated. That river was called *'Vj*§adh- vani'' by the lord of Dcvas.…
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing the river Trisrotas the bull (vehicle of Siva) was extremely delighted. It bellowed. From that bellowing sound another river originated. That river was called *'Vj*§adh- vani'' by the lord of Dcvas.…

verses.sanskrit: कुण्डले चामले दिव्ये वज्रं चैव वरायुधम् जांबूनदमयं सूत्रं केयूरद्वयमेव च
verses.transliteration: kuṇḍale cāmale divye vajraṃ caiva varāyudham jāṃbūnadamayaṃ sūtraṃ keyūradvayameva ca
verses.translation: O sage, on seeing me honoured thus, the sun in the sky showered Siladana with waters from the clouds. When he was thus showered, those waters flowed as a stream. Since this river originated from gold, the three-eyed lord of Devas called her SvatTLodaka. Since another splendid river originated from the crown made of gold they call that river Jambunadl. Thus the set of five rivers flowed near the lord Japyevara.
verses.hindi: नीलशवेतत्रिशृङ्गे च भगवान्नीललोहितः सिद्धैदेवैश्च पितृभिर्दृष्टो नित्यं विशेषतः।
verses.wordMeaning: O sage, on seeing me honoured thus, the sun in the sky showered Siladana with waters from the clouds. When he was thus showered, those waters flowed as a stream. Since this river originated from gold, the three-eyed lord of Devas called her SvatTLodaka.…
verses.commentary: Sense: O sage, on seeing me honoured thus, the sun in the sky showered Siladana with waters from the clouds. When he was thus showered, those waters flowed as a stream. Since this river originated from gold, the three-eyed lord of Devas called her SvatTLodaka.…

verses.sanskrit: सम्भाराणि तथान्यानि विविधानि बहून्यपि समन्तान् निन्युर् अव्यग्रा गणपा देवसंमताः
verses.transliteration: sambhārāṇi tathānyāni vividhāni bahūnyapi samantān ninyur avyagrā gaṇapā devasaṃmatāḥ
verses.translation: He who visits Paflcanada,*'® takes the holy dip there and worships Lord JapyeSvara shall undoubtedly attain identity with Siva.
verses.hindi: भुवनकोशवर्णनमें प्लक्ष, शाल्मलि, क्रौंचद्वीपोंके महापर्वतों, ऊर्ध्वलोकों तथा नरकोंका वर्णन, सर्वत्र सदाशिवकी व्यापकता एवं यक्षरूप शिव और भगवती उमाका माहात्य गोमेदकोऽत्र प्रथमो द्वितीयश्चान्द्र उच्चते
verses.wordMeaning: He who visits Paflcanada,*'® takes the holy dip there and worships Lord JapyeSvara shall undoubtedly attain identity with Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who visits Paflcanada,*'® takes the holy dip there and worships Lord JapyeSvara shall undoubtedly attain identity with Siva.

verses.sanskrit: ततो देवाश् च सेन्द्राश् च नारायणमुखास् तथा मुनयो भगवान्ब्रह्मा नवब्रह्माण एव च
verses.transliteration: tato devāś ca sendrāś ca nārāyaṇamukhās tathā munayo bhagavānbrahmā navabrahmāṇa eva ca
verses.translation: He who visits Paflcanada,*'® takes the holy dip there and worships Lord JapyeSvara shall undoubtedly attain identity with Siva.
verses.hindi: पञ्चमः सोमको नाम सुमनाः षष्ठ उच्यते सप्तमो मन्दरः श्रीमान् महादेवनिकेतनम्। मन्दा इति ह्यपां नाम मन्दरो धारणादपाम्
verses.wordMeaning: He who visits Paflcanada,*'® takes the holy dip there and worships Lord JapyeSvara shall undoubtedly attain identity with Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who visits Paflcanada,*'® takes the holy dip there and worships Lord JapyeSvara shall undoubtedly attain identity with Siva.

verses.sanskrit: देवैश् च लोकाः सर्वे ते ततो जग्मुर्मुदा युताः तेष्वागतेषु सर्वेषु भगवान्परमेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: devaiś ca lokāḥ sarve te tato jagmurmudā yutāḥ teṣvāgateṣu sarveṣu bhagavānparameśvaraḥ
verses.translation: He who visits Paflcanada,*'® takes the holy dip there and worships Lord JapyeSvara shall undoubtedly attain identity with Siva.

verses.hindi: और सातवाँ ककुद्यान् कहा गया है। कुशद्दीपमें भी सात उपद्वीप और कुलपर्वत हैं  मैं केवल नामसे ही संक्षेपमें उन्हें बताऊँगा। पहला विद्रुम तथा दूसरा हेमपर्वत कहा गया है। तीसरा द्युतिमान् एवं चौथा पुष्पित नामवाला बताया गया है। पाँचवाँ कुशेशय तथा छठा हरिगिरि नामवाला कहा गया है। सातवाँ पर्वत शोभासम्पन्न मन्दर है, यह महादेवजीका निवासस्थान है। जलोंका नाम मन्दा है; इसीलिये जलोंको धारण करनेसे इसका

verses.hindi: उद्यो रैवतश्चापि श्यामको मुनिसत्तमाः राजतश्च गिरिः श्रीमानाम्बिकेयः सुशोभनः । आम्बिकेयात्परो रम्यः सर्वौषधिसमन्वितः

verses.transliteration: siṃhāsanaṃ ca paramaṃ tayā cādhiṣṭhitaṃ mayā alaṃkṛtā mahālakṣmyā mukuṭādyaiḥ subhūṣaṇaiḥ
