verses.hindi: क्रौंचद्वीपमें भी क्रौंच आदि सात कुलपर्वत हैं। क्रौंच, दूसरा वामन तथा तीसरा अन्धकारक पर्वत है। अन्धकारकके बाद दिवावृत् नामक पर्वत है। दिवावृत्के बाद विविन्द पर्वत कहा जाता है। विविन्दके बाद पुण्डरीक नामक महान् पर्वत है और पुण्डरीके बाद दुन्दुभिस्वन पर्वत कहा जाता है। क्रौंचद्वीपके ये सातों पर्वत रत्नमय हैं
verses.wordMeaning: He who visits Paflcanada,*'® takes the holy dip there and worships Lord JapyeSvara shall undoubtedly attain identity with Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who visits Paflcanada,*'® takes the holy dip there and worships Lord JapyeSvara shall undoubtedly attain identity with Siva.

verses.sanskrit: लब्धो हारश् च परमो देव्याः कण्ठगतस् तथा वृषेन्द्रश् च सितो नागः सिंहः सिंहध्वजस् तथा
verses.transliteration: labdho hāraś ca paramo devyāḥ kaṇṭhagatas tathā vṛṣendraś ca sito nāgaḥ siṃhaḥ siṃhadhvajas tathā
verses.translation: He who visits Paflcanada,*'® takes the holy dip there and worships Lord JapyeSvara shall undoubtedly attain identity with Siva.
verses.hindi: शाकट्वीपमें भी सात पर्वत हैं, उन्हें जानिये। हे श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! उदय, रैवत, श्यामक, शोभासम्पन्न राजतपर्वत तथा अत्यन्त सुन्दर आम्बिकेय पर्वत हैं। आम्बिकेयके बाद सभी प्रकारकी औषधियोंसे युक्त रम्य नामक पर्वत है। उसके बाद केसरीपर्वत कहा गया है, जहाँसे वायु उत्पन्न होती है॥ ९७-१८ /२॥
verses.wordMeaning: He who visits Paflcanada,*'® takes the holy dip there and worships Lord JapyeSvara shall undoubtedly attain identity with Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who visits Paflcanada,*'® takes the holy dip there and worships Lord JapyeSvara shall undoubtedly attain identity with Siva.

verses.sanskrit: रथश् च हेमच्छत्रं च चन्द्रबिंबसमप्रभम् अद्यापि सदृशः कश्चिन् मया नास्ति विभुः क्वचित्
verses.transliteration: rathaś ca hemacchatraṃ ca candrabiṃbasamaprabham adyāpi sadṛśaḥ kaścin mayā nāsti vibhuḥ kvacit
verses.translation: He who visits Paflcanada,*'® takes the holy dip there and worships Lord JapyeSvara shall undoubtedly attain identity with Siva.
verses.hindi: पुष्करट्वीपमें महाशिल नामक एक ही शोभासम्मन्न पर्वत है; यह अद्भुत मणियोंवाले शिखरोंसे तथा शिलासमूहोंसे युक्त है । यह महान् पर्वत उस द्वीपके आधे पूर्वी भागमें अनेक रंगोंके किनारोंके साथ पचास हजार योजन ऊँचा उठा हुआ है। यह महान् पर्वत  भूतलसे  -चौंतीस हजार योजन नीचेतक गया है । यह पर्वत द्वीपके आधे भागमें उत्तरकी ओर मानसश्रृंखलाके ऊपर फैला हुआ है। समुद्रके समीप स्थित यह पर्वत उगे हुए नवीन
verses.wordMeaning: He who visits Paflcanada,*'® takes the holy dip there and worships Lord JapyeSvara shall undoubtedly attain identity with Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who visits Paflcanada,*'® takes the holy dip there and worships Lord JapyeSvara shall undoubtedly attain identity with Siva.

verses.sanskrit: सान्वयं च गृहीत्वेशस् तथा संबन्धिबान्धवैः आरुह्य वृषमीशानो मया देव्या गतः शिवः
verses.transliteration: sānvayaṃ ca gṛhītveśas tathā saṃbandhibāndhavaiḥ āruhya vṛṣamīśāno mayā devyā gataḥ śivaḥ
verses.translation: He who visits Paflcanada,*'® takes the holy dip there and worships Lord JapyeSvara shall undoubtedly attain identity with Siva.
verses.hindi: चन्द्रमाके समान प्रतीत होता है ॥ १९--२२॥ यह पचास हजार योजन ऊपरकी ओर उठा हुआ है। इसकी चौड़ाई तथा चारों ओरका घेरा भी उतना ही विस्तृत है  द्वीपके पश्चिमी आधे भागमें यही पर्वत मानस नामसे प्रतिष्ठित है । यह महापर्वत एक होता हुआ भी सन्निवेशके
verses.wordMeaning: He who visits Paflcanada,*'® takes the holy dip there and worships Lord JapyeSvara shall undoubtedly attain identity with Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who visits Paflcanada,*'® takes the holy dip there and worships Lord JapyeSvara shall undoubtedly attain identity with Siva.

verses.sanskrit: तदा देवीं भवं दृष्ट्वा मया च प्रार्थयन् गणैः मुनिदेवर्षयः सिद्धा आज्ञां पाशुपतीं द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: tadā devīṃ bhavaṃ dṛṣṭvā mayā ca prārthayan gaṇaiḥ munidevarṣayaḥ siddhā ājñāṃ pāśupatīṃ dvijāḥ
verses.translation: He who visits Paflcanada,*'® takes the holy dip there and worships Lord JapyeSvara shall undoubtedly attain identity with Siva.
verses.hindi: कारण दो भागोंमें विभक्त हो गया है उस ट्वीपमें चाँदीके समान प्रभावाले दो पुण्यमय तथा शुभ जनपद बताये गये हैं, जो इस मानस पर्वतको घेरे हुए हैं मानसके बाहर जो महावीत नामक वर्ष है, उसके भीतर जो जनपद है, उसे धातकीखण्ड कहा जाता है
verses.wordMeaning: He who visits Paflcanada,*'® takes the holy dip there and worships Lord JapyeSvara shall undoubtedly attain identity with Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who visits Paflcanada,*'® takes the holy dip there and worships Lord JapyeSvara shall undoubtedly attain identity with Siva.

verses.sanskrit: अथाज्ञां प्रददौ तेषाम् अर्हाणाम् आज्ञया विभोः नन्दिको नगजाभर्तुस् तेषां पाशुपतीं शुभाम्
verses.transliteration: athājñāṃ pradadau teṣām arhāṇām ājñayā vibhoḥ nandiko nagajābhartus teṣāṃ pāśupatīṃ śubhām
verses.translation: He who visits Paflcanada,*'® takes the holy dip there and worships Lord JapyeSvara shall undoubtedly attain identity with Siva.
verses.hindi: पुष्करद्वीप स्वादिष्ट जलवाले सागरसे घिरा हुआ है। यह सागर सभी ओर पुष्करद्वीपके विस्तारके बराबर विस्तीर्ण है । यह विस्तारमें तथा घेरेमें पुष्कर ट्वीपके ही समान है । इस प्रकार सातौं द्वीप सात समुद्रोंसे घिरे हुए तथैव केसरीत्युक्तो यतो वायुः प्रजायते। पुष्करे पर्वतः श्रीमान्नेक एव महाशिलः
verses.wordMeaning: He who visits Paflcanada,*'® takes the holy dip there and worships Lord JapyeSvara shall undoubtedly attain identity with Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who visits Paflcanada,*'® takes the holy dip there and worships Lord JapyeSvara shall undoubtedly attain identity with Siva.

verses.sanskrit: तस्माद्धि मुनयो लब्ध्वा तदाज्ञां मुनिपुङ्गवात् भवभक्तास्तदा चासंस् तस्मादेवं समर्चयेत्
verses.transliteration: tasmāddhi munayo labdhvā tadājñāṃ munipuṅgavāt bhavabhaktāstadā cāsaṃs tasmādevaṃ samarcayet
verses.translation: He who visits Paflcanada,*'® takes the holy dip there and worships Lord JapyeSvara shall undoubtedly attain identity with Siva.
verses.hindi: तावदेव तु विस्तीर्णः पार्श्वतः परिमण्डलः तस्यैवाभ्यन्तरो यस्तु धातकीखण्ड उच्यते
verses.wordMeaning: He who visits Paflcanada,*'® takes the holy dip there and worships Lord JapyeSvara shall undoubtedly attain identity with Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who visits Paflcanada,*'® takes the holy dip there and worships Lord JapyeSvara shall undoubtedly attain identity with Siva.

verses.sanskrit: नमस्कारविहीनस्तु नाम उद्गिरयेद्भवे ब्रह्मघ्नदशसंतुल्यं तस्य पापं गरीयसम्
verses.transliteration: namaskāravihīnastu nāma udgirayedbhave brahmaghnadaśasaṃtulyaṃ tasya pāpaṃ garīyasam
verses.translation: He who visits Paflcanada,*'® takes the holy dip there and worships Lord JapyeSvara shall undoubtedly attain identity with Siva.
verses.hindi: स्वादूदकेनोदधिना पुष्करः परिवारितः पुष्करट्वीपविस्तारविस्तीणोंऽसौ समन्ततः विस्तारान्मण्डलाच्चैव पुष्करस्य समेन तु। एवं द्वीपाः समुद्रैस्तु सप्तसप्तभिरावृताः
verses.wordMeaning: He who visits Paflcanada,*'® takes the holy dip there and worships Lord JapyeSvara shall undoubtedly attain identity with Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who visits Paflcanada,*'® takes the holy dip there and worships Lord JapyeSvara shall undoubtedly attain identity with Siva.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात्सर्वप्रकारेण नमस्कारादिमुच्चरेत् आदौ कुर्यान्नमस्कारं तदन्ते शिवतां व्रजेत्
verses.transliteration: tasmātsarvaprakāreṇa namaskārādimuccaret ādau kuryānnamaskāraṃ tadante śivatāṃ vrajet
verses.translation: He who visits Paflcanada,*'® takes the holy dip there and worships Lord JapyeSvara shall undoubtedly attain identity with Siva.
verses.hindi: श्रीलिड्रमहापुराण  परेण पुष्करस्याथ अनुवृत्य स्थितो महान्। स्वादूदकसमुद्रस्तु समन्तात्परिवेष्ट्य च
verses.wordMeaning: He who visits Paflcanada,*'® takes the holy dip there and worships Lord JapyeSvara shall undoubtedly attain identity with Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who visits Paflcanada,*'® takes the holy dip there and worships Lord JapyeSvara shall undoubtedly attain identity with Siva.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीलिङ्गमहापुराणे पूर्वभागे नन्दिकेश्वराभिषेको नाम चतुश्चत्वारिंशो ऽध्यायः सूत सुव्यक्तमखिलं कथितं शङ्करस्य तु सर्वात्मभावं रुद्रस्य स्वरूपं वक्तुमर्हसि
verses.transliteration: iti śrīliṅgamahāpurāṇe pūrvabhāge nandikeśvarābhiṣeko nāma catuścatvāriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ sūta suvyaktamakhilaṃ kathitaṃ śaṅkarasya tu sarvātmabhāvaṃ rudrasya svarūpaṃ vaktumarhasi
verses.translation: Bhuh, Bhuvah, Svah, Mahah, Jana, Tapas, Satya, Paiala, the crores of hellish seas, stars, jilancts, the sun, the moon, the polar star, the seven sages (Great Bear and those going al:)out in aerial chariots -all these abide by his grace. All these are created by him. O excellent brahmins, 280. It refers to the five-syllabled mantra of Siva — ''namalni sivaya."
verses.hindi: परेण तस्य महती दूश्यते लोकसंस्थितिः । काञ्चनी द्विगुणा भूमिः सर्वा चैकशिलोपमा प्रकाशश्चाप्रकाशश्च लोकालोकः स उच्यते
verses.wordMeaning: Bhuh, Bhuvah, Svah, Mahah, Jana, Tapas, Satya, Paiala, the crores of hellish seas, stars, jilancts, the sun, the moon, the polar star, the seven sages (Great Bear and those going al:)out in aerial chariots -all these abide by his grace. All these are created by him.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Bhuh, Bhuvah, Svah, Mahah, Jana, Tapas, Satya, Paiala, the crores of hellish seas, stars, jilancts, the sun, the moon, the polar star, the seven sages (Great Bear and those going al:)out in aerial chariots -all these abide by his grace. All these are created by him.…

verses.sanskrit: भूर्भुवः स्वर्महश्चैव जनः साक्षात्तपस् तथा सत्यलोकश् च पातालं नरकार्णवकोटयः
verses.transliteration: bhūrbhuvaḥ svarmahaścaiva janaḥ sākṣāttapas tathā satyalokaś ca pātālaṃ narakārṇavakoṭayaḥ
verses.translation: Those who are confounded, those who arc deluded by his Maya do not know the great lord Mahevara the noble soul, the Atman of all. Indeed the three worlds constitute his body. Hence after bowing to him I shall recount the splendid detail of the worlds.
verses.hindi: तावांश्च विस्तरस्तस्य लोकालोकमहागिरेः । अर्वाचीने तु तस्यार्धे चरन्ति रविरश्मयः परार्धे तु तमो नित्यं लोकालोकस्ततः स्मृतः । एवं सङ्क्षेपतः प्रोक्तो भूलोंकस्य च विस्तरः
verses.wordMeaning: Those who are confounded, those who arc deluded by his Maya do not know the great lord Mahevara the noble soul, the Atman of all. Indeed the three worlds constitute his body. Hence after bowing to him I shall recount the splendid detail of the worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who are confounded, those who arc deluded by his Maya do not know the great lord Mahevara the noble soul, the Atman of all. Indeed the three worlds constitute his body. Hence after bowing to him I shall recount the splendid detail of the worlds.

verses.sanskrit: तारकाग्रहसोमार्का ध्रुवः सप्तर्षयस् तथा वैमानिकास्तथान्ये च तिष्ठन्त्यस्य प्रसादतः
verses.transliteration: tārakāgrahasomārkā dhruvaḥ saptarṣayas tathā vaimānikāstathānye ca tiṣṭhantyasya prasādataḥ
verses.translation: Formerly, I had mentioned to you about the shape and features of the Cosmic Egg. I shall now describe the features of the worlds in the cosmic Egg. The Earth, the firmament, Svah, Mahab, Jana, Tapas and Satya — these seven are the splendid worlds originating from the Cosmic Egg.
verses.hindi: आभानो्ै भुवः स्वस्तु आध्चुवान्मुनिसत्तमाः। आवहाद्या निविष्टास्तु वायोवै सप्त नेमयः आवहः प्रवहश्चैव ततश्चानुवहस्तथा।
verses.wordMeaning: Formerly, I had mentioned to you about the shape and features of the Cosmic Egg. I shall now describe the features of the worlds in the cosmic Egg. The Earth, the firmament, Svah, Mahab, Jana, Tapas and Satya — these seven are the splendid worlds originating from the Cosmic Egg.
verses.commentary: Sense: Formerly, I had mentioned to you about the shape and features of the Cosmic Egg. I shall now describe the features of the worlds in the cosmic Egg. The Earth, the firmament, Svah, Mahab, Jana, Tapas and Satya — these seven are the splendid worlds originating from the Cosmic Egg.

verses.sanskrit: अनेन निर्मितास्त्वेवं तदात्मानो द्विजर्षभाः समष्टिरूपः सर्वात्मा संस्थितः सर्वदा शिवः
verses.transliteration: anena nirmitāstvevaṃ tadātmāno dvijarṣabhāḥ samaṣṭirūpaḥ sarvātmā saṃsthitaḥ sarvadā śivaḥ
verses.translation: O brahmins, beneath these are the seven worlds begin* ning with Mahatala. Beneath them are the hells one by one. Mahatala has the golden ground surface, which is ren* dered splendid by jewels, mansions and shrines dedicated to Icrd Siva.
verses.hindi: संवहो विवहश्चाथ ततश्चोर्ध्वं परावहः द्विजाः परिवहश्चेति वायोर्वै सप्त नेमयः। बलाहकास्तथा भानुश्चन्द्रो नक्षत्रराशयः
verses.wordMeaning: O brahmins, beneath these are the seven worlds begin* ning with Mahatala. Beneath them are the hells one by one. Mahatala has the golden ground surface, which is ren* dered splendid by jewels, mansions and shrines dedicated to Icrd Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O brahmins, beneath these are the seven worlds begin* ning with Mahatala. Beneath them are the hells one by one. Mahatala has the golden ground surface, which is ren* dered splendid by jewels, mansions and shrines dedicated to Icrd Siva.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वात्मानं महात्मानं महादेवं महेश्वरम् न विजानन्ति संमूढा मायया तस्य मोहिताः
verses.transliteration: sarvātmānaṃ mahātmānaṃ mahādevaṃ maheśvaram na vijānanti saṃmūḍhā māyayā tasya mohitāḥ
verses.translation: It is occupied by Ananta, Mucukunda and king Bali who is the resident of Patala and Svarga. O brahmins, Rasatala is rocky, Talatala is full of gravels, Sutala is yellow and Vitala has the lustre of coral.
verses.hindi: रथः षोडशसाहस्त्रो भास्करस्य तथोपरि कोटियोजनमाक्रम्य महलोंको थुवाद् ध्रुव:
verses.wordMeaning: It is occupied by Ananta, Mucukunda and king Bali who is the resident of Patala and Svarga. O brahmins, Rasatala is rocky, Talatala is full of gravels, Sutala is yellow and Vitala has the lustre of coral.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is occupied by Ananta, Mucukunda and king Bali who is the resident of Patala and Svarga. O brahmins, Rasatala is rocky, Talatala is full of gravels, Sutala is yellow and Vitala has the lustre of coral.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य देवस्य रुद्रस्य शरीरं वै जगत्त्रयम् तस्मात्प्रणम्य तं वक्ष्ये जगतां निर्णयं शुभम्
verses.transliteration: tasya devasya rudrasya śarīraṃ vai jagattrayam tasmātpraṇamya taṃ vakṣye jagatāṃ nirṇayaṃ śubham
verses.translation: Atala is white. Tala is black. O men of good holy rites, the extent of all the Talas below is as much as that of the earth, viz., 1000 yojanas each. The sky above each Tala extends to ten thousand yojanas. The magnitude of all the seven along with the clouds is seven thousand lakhs of yojanas. The root (i.e. the space below the last world Patala) is thirty thousand yojanas. O excellent sages, the splendid Rasatala is frequented by Suvarna, Vasuki and by others as well.
verses.hindi: जनलोको महलोंकात्तथा कोटिद्वयं द्विजा:। जनलोकात्तपोलोकश्चतस्त्रः कोटयो मत: प्राजापत्याद् ब्रह्मलोकः कोटिषट्कं विसृज्य तु। पुण्यलोकास्तु सप्तैते ह्यण्डेऽस्मिन् कथिता द्विजा:
verses.wordMeaning: Atala is white. Tala is black. O men of good holy rites, the extent of all the Talas below is as much as that of the earth, viz., 1000 yojanas each. The sky above each Tala extends to ten thousand yojanas.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Atala is white. Tala is black. O men of good holy rites, the extent of all the Talas below is as much as that of the earth, viz., 1000 yojanas each. The sky above each Tala extends to ten thousand yojanas.…

verses.sanskrit: पुरा वः कथितं सर्वं मयाण्डस्य यथा कृतिः भुवनानां स्वरूपं च ब्रह्माण्डे कथयाम्यहम्
verses.transliteration: purā vaḥ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ mayāṇḍasya yathā kṛtiḥ bhuvanānāṃ svarūpaṃ ca brahmāṇḍe kathayāmyaham
verses.translation: Sutala is occupied by Vainayaka and others, by Purvadevas (demons) with ICalanemi at the head and by others too. Vitala is occupied by Danavas and others beginning
verses.hindi: अधः सप्ततलानां तु नरकाणां हि कोटयः  पापिनस्तेषु पच्यन्ते स्वस्वकर्मानुरूपतः। अवीच्यन्तानि सर्वाणि रौरवाद्यानि तेषु च
verses.wordMeaning: Sutala is occupied by Vainayaka and others, by Purvadevas (demons) with ICalanemi at the head and by others too. Vitala is occupied by Danavas and others beginning
verses.commentary: Sense: Sutala is occupied by Vainayaka and others, by Purvadevas (demons) with ICalanemi at the head and by others too. Vitala is occupied by Danavas and others beginning

verses.sanskrit: पृथिवी चान्तरिक्षं च स्वर्महर्जन एव च तपः सत्यं च सप्तैते लोकास्त्वण्डोद्भवाः शुभाः
verses.transliteration: pṛthivī cāntarikṣaṃ ca svarmaharjana eva ca tapaḥ satyaṃ ca saptaite lokāstvaṇḍodbhavāḥ śubhāḥ
verses.translation: Atala is occupied by Kambalava, Tala (i.e. Mahatala) is rendered splendid and occu- pied by Sankukarna and other heroes beginning with Namuci.
verses.hindi: हैं  द्वीपके अनन्तर जो समुद्र है, वह सातवाँ समुद्र है झा प्रकार द्वीपो तथा समुद्रोंको परस्पर वृद्धिको चाहिए॥ २७--२९॥
verses.wordMeaning: Atala is occupied by Kambalava, Tala (i.e. Mahatala) is rendered splendid and occu- pied by Sankukarna and other heroes beginning with Namuci.
verses.commentary: Sense: Atala is occupied by Kambalava, Tala (i.e. Mahatala) is rendered splendid and occu- pied by Sankukarna and other heroes beginning with Namuci.

verses.sanskrit: अधस्तादत्र चैतेषां द्विजाः सप्त तलानि तु महातलादयस्तेषां अधस्तान्नरकाः क्रमात्
verses.transliteration: adhastādatra caiteṣāṃ dvijāḥ sapta talāni tu mahātalādayasteṣāṃ adhastānnarakāḥ kramāt
verses.translation: In all these nether worlds the great lord is present along with Uma, Skanda, Nandin and all the chieftains of Ganas. O excellent ones, above all these seven Talas are the earth and other worlds. The earth too is of seven divisions about which I shall tell you now. The Earth consists of seven continents. It is full of rivers and mountains. It is surrounded by seven oceans® all round and embellished by them.
verses.hindi: पुष्करके बाहर उसे चारों ओरसे घेरकर स्वादिष्ट जलसे युक्त महान् समुद्र स्थित है। उसके बाहर महती लोकस्थिति दिखायी देती है, वहाँकी भूमि स्वर्णमयी है और विस्तारमें दुगुनी है । सम्पूर्ण भूमि एक शिलाके तुल्य है। उसके परे मर्यादामण्डलस्वरूप एक पर्वत है । इसका कुछ भाग प्रकाशमय तथा कुछ भाग अन्धकारमय रहता है, इसे लोकालोक पर्वत कहा जाता है । है द्विजो ! जितना यह दृश्य-अदृश्य पर्वत है, उतनी ही यह धरा है। उसकी
verses.wordMeaning: In all these nether worlds the great lord is present along with Uma, Skanda, Nandin and all the chieftains of Ganas. O excellent ones, above all these seven Talas are the earth and other worlds. The earth too is of seven divisions about which I shall tell you now.…
verses.commentary: Sense: In all these nether worlds the great lord is present along with Uma, Skanda, Nandin and all the chieftains of Ganas. O excellent ones, above all these seven Talas are the earth and other worlds. The earth too is of seven divisions about which I shall tell you now.…

verses.sanskrit: महातलं हेमतलं सर्वरत्नोपशोभितम् प्रासादैश् च विचित्रैश् च भवस्यायतनैस् तथा
verses.transliteration: mahātalaṃ hematalaṃ sarvaratnopaśobhitam prāsādaiś ca vicitraiś ca bhavasyāyatanais tathā
verses.translation: The seven continents beginning with the inner one are Jambu, Plaksa,!§almali, Kusa, Krauhea, Saka and Puskara. Lord Siva is present in all the seven continents, accom- panied by Uma (his consort), surrounded by the Ganas, and assuming different guises.
verses.hindi: (पर्वतकी) ऊँचाई दस हजार योजन कही गयी है। उस लोकालोक नामक महापर्वतका विस्तार भी उतना ही है। उसके आधे भागमें सूर्यकी किरणें पहुँचती हैं और दूसरे आधे भागमें सदा अन्धकार रहता है, इसलिये इसे लोकालोक कहा गया है। है द्विजो ! इस प्रकार मैंने संक्षेपमें भूलोकके विस्तारका वर्णन किया ॥ ३०--३५ ॥
verses.wordMeaning: The seven continents beginning with the inner one are Jambu, Plaksa,!§almali, Kusa, Krauhea, Saka and Puskara. Lord Siva is present in all the seven continents, accom- panied by Uma (his consort), surrounded by the Ganas, and assuming different guises.
verses.commentary: Sense: The seven continents beginning with the inner one are Jambu, Plaksa,!§almali, Kusa, Krauhea, Saka and Puskara. Lord Siva is present in all the seven continents, accom- panied by Uma (his consort), surrounded by the Ganas, and assuming different guises.

verses.sanskrit: अनन्तेन च संयुक्तं मुचुकुन्देन धीमता नृपेण बलिना चैव पातालस्वर्गवासिना
verses.transliteration: anantena ca saṃyuktaṃ mucukundena dhīmatā nṛpeṇa balinā caiva pātālasvargavāsinā
verses.translation: The seven oceans in order are those having, (1) briny water, (2) sugercane juice, (3) wine, (4) ghee, (5) curds, (6) milk and (7) sweet water. In all these oceans the glorious lord Siva assumes the form of water and sports with the waves along with the Ganas. samudraib saptabhib — by seven seas. According to S. M. Ali, 'samudra does not necessarily mean *a watery sea'. The Puranic sea can be a large expanse of sand as well as water. The sea of sand and that of water as barriers to human settlement and movement are synonymous when con- sidering the geography of the inhabited world."
verses.hindi: हे श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! भुवर्लोक सूर्यतक है और स्वलोक धुवतक है। आवह आदि वायुकी सात नेमियाँ कही गयी है । है द्विजो! आवह, प्रबह, अनुवह, संवह, विवह, परावह और परिवह-ये वायुकी सात नेमियाँ हैं है विप्रो! मेघ, ये क्रमसे व्यवस्थित हैं ॥ ३६--३८
verses.wordMeaning: The seven oceans in order are those having, (1) briny water, (2) sugercane juice, (3) wine, (4) ghee, (5) curds, (6) milk and (7) sweet water. In all these oceans the glorious lord Siva assumes the form of water and sports with the waves along with the Ganas.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The seven oceans in order are those having, (1) briny water, (2) sugercane juice, (3) wine, (4) ghee, (5) curds, (6) milk and (7) sweet water. In all these oceans the glorious lord Siva assumes the form of water and sports with the waves along with the Ganas.…

verses.sanskrit: शैलं रसातलं विप्राः शार्करं हि तलातलम् पीतं सुतलमित्युक्तं वितलं विद्रुमप्रभम्
verses.transliteration: śailaṃ rasātalaṃ viprāḥ śārkaraṃ hi talātalam pītaṃ sutalamityuktaṃ vitalaṃ vidrumaprabham
verses.translation: Lord Vi;nu always sleeps in yogic slumber in the milky ocean as though he were the nectar from that, with his intellect concentrated on the knowledge of l§iva. When the lord wakes up, the entire universe wakes up; when he is asleep it is also asleep; the mobile and immobile beings are identical with him.
verses.hindi: पृथ्वीतलसे ऊपर ध्रुवलोकपर्यन्त पन्द्रह नियुत योजनकी दूरी है। भूपृष्ठसे भानुमण्डल एक नियुत योजन दूर है। उसके ऊपर सूर्यका रथ सोलह हजार योजन है । मेरु पर्वत पृथ्वीतलसे चौरासी हजार योजनपर है । धरुवसे एक करोड़ योजनके बाद महर्लोक है है द्विजो ! महर्लोकसे दो करोड़ योजनको दूरीपर जनलोक है। जनलोकसे चार करोड़ योजनको दूरीपर तपोलोक कहा गया है । प्राजापत्यलोक (तपोलोक)-से छ: करोड़ योजनकी दूरी छोड़कर ब्रह्मलोक
verses.wordMeaning: Lord Vi;nu always sleeps in yogic slumber in the milky ocean as though he were the nectar from that, with his intellect concentrated on the knowledge of l§iva. When the lord wakes up, the entire universe wakes up; when he is asleep it is also asleep;…
verses.commentary: Sense: Lord Vi;nu always sleeps in yogic slumber in the milky ocean as though he were the nectar from that, with his intellect concentrated on the knowledge of l§iva. When the lord wakes up, the entire universe wakes up; when he is asleep it is also asleep;…

verses.sanskrit: सितं हि अतलं तच्च तलं यच्च सितेतरम् क्ष्मायास्तु यावद्विस्तारो ह्य् अधस्तेषां च सुव्रताः
verses.transliteration: sitaṃ hi atalaṃ tacca talaṃ yacca sitetaram kṣmāyāstu yāvadvistāro hy adhasteṣāṃ ca suvratāḥ
verses.translation: With the favour of Paramesthin lord of Devas, every- thing was created, held, protected and annihilated by him alone.
verses.hindi: स्थित है। है ब्राह्मणो! इस प्रकार इस ब्रह्माण्डमें इन सात पुण्यलोकोंको मैंने बता दिया॥ ३९--४३॥ सात तलोंके नीचे घोरसे लेकर मायातक अट्टाईस कोटिके नरक हैं; पापीलोग उनमें अपने-अपने कर्मोके आमुरूप दु:ख भोगते हैं। उनमेंसे प्रत्येकमें रौरवसे लेकर
verses.wordMeaning: With the favour of Paramesthin lord of Devas, every- thing was created, held, protected and annihilated by him alone.
verses.commentary: Sense: With the favour of Paramesthin lord of Devas, every- thing was created, held, protected and annihilated by him alone.

verses.sanskrit: तलानां चैव सर्वेषां तावत्संख्या समाहिता सहस्रयोजनं व्योम दशसाहस्रमेव च
verses.transliteration: talānāṃ caiva sarveṣāṃ tāvatsaṃkhyā samāhitā sahasrayojanaṃ vyoma daśasāhasrameva ca
verses.translation: O excellent sages, those who are well known as susenas worship Aniruddha the leading Puru$a holding conch, discus and iron club. O sages, most excellent among the knowers of Atman! those who meditate on Aniruddha Purusa are all similar to Vi$nu and become endowed with all riches. Sanandana, Sanaka, Sanatana, Valakhilyas, Siddhas, Mitra and Varuna these all worship Visu who is the origin of the universe. In all the seven continents there are lofty mountains, some rising to great heights, some extending as far as the oceans, others having many peaks and caves. There were many kings in these continents who were overlords and who ruled with efficiency according to the demands of the period.* They were powerful, thanks to the lord (Siva), the father of the enemy of Kraunca®®® ( i. e. Karttikeya).
verses.hindi: अध्याय ५३ 1 भुवनकोशवर्णनमें प्लक्ष, शाल्मलि, क्रौंचद्वीपोंके महापर्वतोंका वर्णन २२७ प कजा कनक अाकका म कफ कक न न न न्न आरी फ फ फ फ फ फ क फफ फ फ फ फ फ फ फ फ फ फ फ़ फ फ़ फ फ़ फ फ फ फ फ़ फ फ फ फ़ फ़ फक फ़ फ़ फ फ़ फ फ क फा फ क क फा फ फा फी फम मीमी
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent sages, those who are well known as susenas worship Aniruddha the leading Puru$a holding conch, discus and iron club. O sages,…
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent sages, those who are well known as susenas worship Aniruddha the leading Puru$a holding conch, discus and iron club. O sages,…

verses.sanskrit: लक्षं सप्तसहस्रं हि तलानां सघनस्य तु व्योम्नः प्रमाणं मूलं तु त्रिंशत्साहस्रकेण तु
verses.transliteration: lakṣaṃ saptasahasraṃ hi talānāṃ saghanasya tu vyomnaḥ pramāṇaṃ mūlaṃ tu triṃśatsāhasrakeṇa tu
verses.translation: I shall mention the kings in all the manvantaras past and future, beginning with those in the Svayambhuva manvantara. The grandsons of Svayambhuva Manu were all very strong, with similar status, honour and identical pur- poses. They were the heroic sons of Priyavrata®** and they are reputed to be ten,*®* viz., Agnidhra, Agnibahu, Medha, Medhatithi, Vasu, Jyotiman, Dyutimw, Havya, Savana and Putra. Priyavrala crowned seven of them as kings over the seven continents.
verses.hindi: प्रत्येकं पञ्चकान्याहुर्नरकाणि विशेषतः।  सभी विशेष रूपसे पाँच नरक कहे गये हैं। अण्डमादौ मया प्रोक्तमण्डस्यावरणानि च॥ ४६  मैंने आदिमें अण्डका वर्णन किया और अण्डके आवरणोंका भी वर्णन किया एवं प्रसंगवश ब्रह्माकी हिरण्यगर्भसर्गश्च प्रसङ्चाद्वहुविस्तरात्।
verses.wordMeaning: I shall mention the kings in all the manvantaras past and future, beginning with those in the Svayambhuva manvantara. The grandsons of Svayambhuva Manu were all very strong, with similar status, honour and identical pur- poses.…
verses.commentary: Sense: I shall mention the kings in all the manvantaras past and future, beginning with those in the Svayambhuva manvantara. The grandsons of Svayambhuva Manu were all very strong, with similar status, honour and identical pur- poses.…

verses.sanskrit: सुवर्णेन मुनिश्रेष्ठास् तथा वासुकिना शुभम् रसातलमिति ख्यातं तथान्यैश् च निषेवितम्
verses.transliteration: suvarṇena muniśreṣṭhās tathā vāsukinā śubham rasātalamiti khyātaṃ tathānyaiś ca niṣevitam
verses.translation: Krairiic&rih: the enemy of Krauiica, i.e. Karttikeya, so called because he split the Himalaya range Krauiica, situated in the eastern part of the chain on the north of Assam. Priyavrata, son of Svayambhuva Manu and Satarupk.
verses.hindi: ज सृष्टिका भी विस्तारसे वर्णन किया। इस प्रकारके अण्डानामीदृशानां तु कोट्यो ज्ञेयाः सहस्त्रशः॥ ४७  हजारों-करोड़ों ब्रह्माण्डोंको जानना चाहिए प्रधानके सर्वगामी होनेके कारण इन अण्डोंमें तिर्यक्, ऊपर तथा नीचे सभी ओर चौदह भुवन हैं। है श्रेष्ठ द्विजो! उनमें प्रत्येक अण्डके हेतु महेश्वर हैं । अष्टमूर्ति शिव अण्डोंमें, अण्डोंके बाहर, अण्डोंके आवरणोंमें,
verses.wordMeaning: Krairiic&rih: the enemy of Krauiica, i.e. Karttikeya, so called because he split the Himalaya range Krauiica, situated in the eastern part of the chain on the north of Assam. Priyavrata, son of Svayambhuva Manu and Satarupk.
verses.commentary: Sense: Krairiic&rih: the enemy of Krauiica, i.e. Karttikeya, so called because he split the Himalaya range Krauiica, situated in the eastern part of the chain on the north of Assam. Priyavrata, son of Svayambhuva Manu and Satarupk.

verses.sanskrit: विरोचनहिरण्याक्षनरकाद्यैश् च सेवितम् तलातलमिति ख्यातं सर्वशोभासमन्वितम्
verses.transliteration: virocanahiraṇyākṣanarakādyaiś ca sevitam talātalamiti khyātaṃ sarvaśobhāsamanvitam
verses.translation: Though the number is the same, their names differ in the PurSnas.
verses.hindi: अन्धकारके भीतर तथा अन्धकारके परे भी विद्यमान हैं। सम्पूर्ण जगत् इन महेश्वर, महादेव, धीमान्, देहरहित परमात्माका शरीर है । गृहस्थरूप इन अष्टमूर्ति शर्व शिवकी गृहिणी दिव्य प्रकृति है, महत् आदि इनकी सन्ताने हैं और सभी देहाभिमानी पशु इनके सेवक हैं ॥ ४८--५२॥
verses.wordMeaning: Though the number is the same, their names differ in the PurSnas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Though the number is the same, their names differ in the PurSnas.

verses.sanskrit: वैनायकादिभिश्चैव कालनेमिपुरोगमैः पूर्वदेवैः समाकीर्णं सुतलं च तथापरैः
verses.transliteration: vaināyakādibhiścaiva kālanemipurogamaiḥ pūrvadevaiḥ samākīrṇaṃ sutalaṃ ca tathāparaiḥ
verses.translation: He made Agnidhra the lord of Jambudvipa and Medhatithi the king of Plaksadvipa. He crowned Vapusman the king of 8almali, Jyotisman theking of Kusadvipa, Dyutiman the king of Krauhcadvipa, Havya the lord of iSakadvipa. O sages of good holy rites, he made Savana the overlord of Puskara. Savana had two sons Mahavira and Dhatakl. They were most excellent that men could have. The kingdom of Mahavira is known as Mahavira Varsa after the name of that noble soul. The kingdom of Dhatakl is called Dhataklkhanda.* Havya the lord of Sakadvipa procreated seven sons. They were Jalada, Kumara, Sukumara, Manicaka, Kusumottara, Modaki and Mahadruma.
verses.hindi: वे शिव ही आदि-अन्तसे रहित, भगवान् अनन्त, पुरुष, प्रधान आदि (बुद्धि, अहंकार आदि) दस इन्द्रिया, मन), अष्टमूर्ति तथा महेश्वर हैं। उन्हींकी आज्ञाके प्रभावसे पृथ्वी, पर्वत, मेघ, समुद्र, तारागण, इन्द्र आदि देवता, वैमानिक तथा स्थावर-जंगम सभी प्राणी स्थित हैं
verses.wordMeaning: He made Agnidhra the lord of Jambudvipa and Medhatithi the king of Plaksadvipa. He crowned Vapusman the king of 8almali, Jyotisman theking of Kusadvipa, Dyutiman the king of Krauhcadvipa, Havya the lord of iSakadvipa. O sages of good holy rites,…
verses.commentary: Sense: He made Agnidhra the lord of Jambudvipa and Medhatithi the king of Plaksadvipa. He crowned Vapusman the king of 8almali, Jyotisman theking of Kusadvipa, Dyutiman the king of Krauhcadvipa, Havya the lord of iSakadvipa. O sages of good holy rites,…

verses.sanskrit: वितलं दानवाद्यैश् च तारकाग्निमुखैस् तथा महान्तकाद्यैर् नागैश् च प्रह्लादेनासुरेण च
verses.transliteration: vitalaṃ dānavādyaiś ca tārakāgnimukhais tathā mahāntakādyair nāgaiś ca prahlādenāsureṇa ca
verses.translation: The Varsa continent of Talada is called ( 1 ) Tala- da; the Varsa of Kumara is called (2) Kaumara; that of Suku- mara is glorified as (3) Sukumara; the Varsa of Manicaka is called (4) Manicaka; the Varsa of Kusumottara is (5) Kusu- mottara, the Varsa of Modaki is glorified as (6) Modaka; after the name of Mahadruma, the next Varsa is (7) Maha- druma; all the seven Varsas are thus named after their rulers.
verses.hindi: अस्यात्मनो महेशस्य महादेवस्य धीमतः अदेहिनस्त्वहो देहमखिलं परमात्मनः। अस्याष्टमूर्तेः शर्वस्य शिवस्य गृहमेधिनः
verses.wordMeaning: The Varsa continent of Talada is called ( 1 ) Tala- da; the Varsa of Kumara is called (2) Kaumara; that of Suku- mara is glorified as (3) Sukumara; the Varsa of Manicaka is called (4) Manicaka; the Varsa of Kusumottara is (5) Kusu- mottara,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The Varsa continent of Talada is called ( 1 ) Tala- da; the Varsa of Kumara is called (2) Kaumara; that of Suku- mara is glorified as (3) Sukumara; the Varsa of Manicaka is called (4) Manicaka; the Varsa of Kusumottara is (5) Kusu- mottara,…

verses.sanskrit: वितलं चात्र विख्यातं कम्बलाश्वनिषेवितम् महाकुम्भेन वीरेण हयग्रीवेण धीमता
verses.transliteration: vitalaṃ cātra vikhyātaṃ kambalāśvaniṣevitam mahākumbhena vīreṇa hayagrīveṇa dhīmatā
verses.translation: Dyutiman, the lord of Kraufica Dvipa had seven sons named Kuala, Manuga, Usna, Pivara, Andhakaraka, Muni and Dundubhi who had splendid sub-continents named after them, in the Kraufica Dvipa. The sub-continent of Kusala isKusala; that of Manuga is Manonuga; that of Usna is Usna; that of Pivara is Pivara; the land of Andhakara is Andhakaraka; the land of Muni is called Muni and that of Dundubhi is Dundubhi. These seven shining countries are in Kraufica Dvipa. They were Udbhida, VetJiuman, Dvmratha, Lavaca, Dhrti, Prabhakara and Kapila.
verses.hindi: पशवः किङ्करास्तस्य सर्वे देहाभिमानिनः आद्यान्तहीनो भगवाननन्तः लक्षणोंसे रहित यक्षरूपी शिवको देखकर इन्द्रसहित
verses.wordMeaning: Dyutiman, the lord of Kraufica Dvipa had seven sons named Kuala, Manuga, Usna, Pivara, Andhakaraka, Muni and Dundubhi who had splendid sub-continents named after them, in the Kraufica Dvipa. The sub-continent of Kusala isKusala; that of Manuga is Manonuga; that of Usna is Usna;…
verses.commentary: Sense: Dyutiman, the lord of Kraufica Dvipa had seven sons named Kuala, Manuga, Usna, Pivara, Andhakaraka, Muni and Dundubhi who had splendid sub-continents named after them, in the Kraufica Dvipa. The sub-continent of Kusala isKusala; that of Manuga is Manonuga; that of Usna is Usna;…

verses.sanskrit: शङ्कुकर्णेन संभिन्नं तथा नमुचिपूर्वकैः तथान्यैर् विविधैर् वीरैस् तलं चैव सुशोभितम्
verses.transliteration: śaṅkukarṇena saṃbhinnaṃ tathā namucipūrvakaiḥ tathānyair vividhair vīrais talaṃ caiva suśobhitam
verses.translation: The first Var|a is Udbhida; the second is Veu- madl* the third is Dvairatha; the fourth is Lavai;. the fifth isDhrtimat; the sixth is Prabhakara, and the seventh is Kapila.
verses.hindi: 'प्रधानमूर्तिस्त्वथ षोडशाङ्को वैमानिकाः स्थावरजङ्गमाश्च
verses.wordMeaning: The first Var|a is Udbhida; the second is Veu- madl* the third is Dvairatha; the fourth is Lavai;. the fifth isDhrtimat; the sixth is Prabhakara, and the seventh is Kapila.
verses.commentary: Sense: The first Var|a is Udbhida; the second is Veu- madl* the third is Dvairatha; the fourth is Lavai;. the fifth isDhrtimat; the sixth is Prabhakara, and the seventh is Kapila.

verses.sanskrit: तलेषु तेषु सर्वेषु चाम्बया परमेश्वरः स्कन्देन नन्दिना सार्धं गणपैः सर्वतो वृतः
verses.transliteration: taleṣu teṣu sarveṣu cāmbayā parameśvaraḥ skandena nandinā sārdhaṃ gaṇapaiḥ sarvato vṛtaḥ
verses.translation: Medhatithi had seven sons; they were the kings of Plaksa Dvipa which consists of seven Varsas. The eldest among the sons was Santabhaya. After him were Sisira; Sukhodaya, Ananda; Siva, Kemaka and Dhruva. The conti- nent was divided into seven Varsas and named after these sons. Formerly in the Svayambhuva manvantara these Varsas were colonised by them. Subjects endowed with the discipline of four castes and four stages of life were colonised in the Vars by those sons of Medhatithi, the residents of Plaksadvipa. In the five continents beginning with Plakdvipa and ending with Sadvipa, the Dharma, was promulgated in accordance with the division of four castes and four stages of life. O excellent brahmins, in these five Dvipas, happiness, span of life, handsome features, strength and Dharma were their individual characteristics respectively.
verses.hindi: दृष्ट्वा सेन्दरास्ते किमेतत्त्विहेति। यक्षं गत्वा निश्चयात्पावकाद्याः शक्तिक्षीणाश्चाभवन्यत्ततोऽपि अग्नि आदि वे देवता “यहाँ यह क्या है?'- ऐसा
verses.wordMeaning: Medhatithi had seven sons; they were the kings of Plaksa Dvipa which consists of seven Varsas. The eldest among the sons was Santabhaya. After him were Sisira; Sukhodaya, Ananda; Siva, Kemaka and Dhruva. The conti- nent was divided into seven Varsas and named after these sons.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Medhatithi had seven sons; they were the kings of Plaksa Dvipa which consists of seven Varsas. The eldest among the sons was Santabhaya. After him were Sisira; Sukhodaya, Ananda; Siva, Kemaka and Dhruva. The conti- nent was divided into seven Varsas and named after these sons.…

verses.sanskrit: तलानां चैव सर्वेषाम् ऊर्ध्वतः सप्तसप्तमाः क्ष्मातलानि धरा चापि सप्तधा कथयामि वः
verses.transliteration: talānāṃ caiva sarveṣām ūrdhvataḥ saptasaptamāḥ kṣmātalāni dharā cāpi saptadhā kathayāmi vaḥ
verses.translation: The characteristic common to all the five continents was that the subjects there were all perpetually engaged in the worship of Rudra and devoted to Mahesvara. The kings born in the Puskaradvipa enjoy the nectar of their devout feelings towards Prajapati and Rudra.
verses.hindi: यक्षस्य वह्निर्न शशाक विप्राः। सुरेश्वरं यक्षमुवाच को वा
verses.wordMeaning: The characteristic common to all the five continents was that the subjects there were all perpetually engaged in the worship of Rudra and devoted to Mahesvara. The kings born in the Puskaradvipa enjoy the nectar of their devout feelings towards Prajapati and Rudra.
verses.commentary: Sense: The characteristic common to all the five continents was that the subjects there were all perpetually engaged in the worship of Rudra and devoted to Mahesvara. The kings born in the Puskaradvipa enjoy the nectar of their devout feelings towards Prajapati and Rudra.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीलिङ्गमहापुराणे पूर्वभागे पातालवर्णनं नाम पञ्चचत्वारिंशो ऽध्यायः सप्तद्वीपा तथा पृथ्वी नदीपर्वतसंकुला समुद्रैः सप्तभिश्चैव सर्वतः समलंकृता
verses.transliteration: iti śrīliṅgamahāpurāṇe pūrvabhāge pātālavarṇanaṃ nāma pañcacatvāriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ saptadvīpā tathā pṛthvī nadīparvatasaṃkulā samudraiḥ saptabhiścaiva sarvataḥ samalaṃkṛtā
verses.translation: The seven continents beginning with the inner one are Jambu, Plaksa, Salmali, Kua, Kraufica, Saka and Pukara.
verses.hindi: स्तदाम्बिका हैमवती शुभास्या। मुमामजां हैमवतीमपृच्छन्।
verses.wordMeaning: The seven continents beginning with the inner one are Jambu, Plaksa, Salmali, Kua, Kraufica, Saka and Pukara.
verses.commentary: Sense: The seven continents beginning with the inner one are Jambu, Plaksa, Salmali, Kua, Kraufica, Saka and Pukara.

verses.sanskrit: जम्बूः प्लक्षः शाल्मलिश् च कुशः क्रौञ्चस्तथैव च शाकः पुष्करनामा च द्वीपास्त्वभ्यन्तरे क्रमात्
verses.transliteration: jambūḥ plakṣaḥ śālmaliś ca kuśaḥ krauñcastathaiva ca śākaḥ puṣkaranāmā ca dvīpāstvabhyantare kramāt
verses.translation: Lord Siva is present in all the seven continents, accom- panied by Uma (his consort), surrounded by the Ganas, and assuming different guises.
verses.hindi: को वाम्बिके यक्षवपुश्चकास्ति निशम्य तद्यक्षमुमाम्बिकाह
verses.wordMeaning: Lord Siva is present in all the seven continents, accom- panied by Uma (his consort), surrounded by the Ganas, and assuming different guises.
verses.commentary: Sense: Lord Siva is present in all the seven continents, accom- panied by Uma (his consort), surrounded by the Ganas, and assuming different guises.

verses.sanskrit: सप्तद्वीपेषु सर्वेषु साम्बः सर्वगणैर्वृतः नानावेषधरो भूत्वा सान्निध्यं कुरुते हरः
verses.transliteration: saptadvīpeṣu sarveṣu sāmbaḥ sarvagaṇairvṛtaḥ nānāveṣadharo bhūtvā sānnidhyaṃ kurute haraḥ
verses.translation: The seven oceans in order are those having, (1) briny water, (2) sugercane juice, (3) wine, (4) ghee, (5) curds, (6) milk and (7) sweet water. In all these oceans the glorious lord Siva assumes the form of water and sports with the waves along with the Gax>as.
verses.hindi: सोचकर अनिश्चयकी दशामें यक्षके समीप जाकर वे शक्तिहीन हो गये हे विप्रो! अग्निदेव उस यक्षके सामने तिनका भी नहीं जला सके, पवन उस तृणको उड़ानेमें समर्थ नहीं हुए, उसी प्रकार अन्य समस्त श्रेष्ठ देवता भी अपने-अपने प्रभाव प्रदर्शित करनेमें समर्थ नहीं हुए।
verses.wordMeaning: The seven oceans in order are those having, (1) briny water, (2) sugercane juice, (3) wine, (4) ghee, (5) curds, (6) milk and (7) sweet water. In all these oceans the glorious lord Siva assumes the form of water and sports with the waves along with the Gax>as.
verses.commentary: Sense: The seven oceans in order are those having, (1) briny water, (2) sugercane juice, (3) wine, (4) ghee, (5) curds, (6) milk and (7) sweet water. In all these oceans the glorious lord Siva assumes the form of water and sports with the waves along with the Gax>as.

verses.sanskrit: क्षारोदेक्षुरसोदश् च सुरोदश् च घृतोदधिः दध्यर्णवश् च क्षीरोदः स्वादूदश्चाप्यनुक्रमात्
verses.transliteration: kṣārodekṣurasodaś ca surodaś ca ghṛtodadhiḥ dadhyarṇavaś ca kṣīrodaḥ svādūdaścāpyanukramāt
verses.translation: samndratlL saptabhib—by seven seas. According to S. M. Ali, samudta does not necessaxily mean *a watery sea*. The Pur&ic sea can be a large expanse of sand as well as water. The sea of sand and that of water as barriers to human settlement and movement are synonymous when con- sidering the geography of the inhabited world.*'
verses.hindi: तब सभी श्रेष्ठ देवताओंके साथ समस्त समृद्धियोंके कारणभूत वृत्रशत्रु उन देवेनद्रने कुतूहलचित्त होकर यक्षरूप सुरेश्‍वरसे इस प्रकार कहा-आप कौन हैं ? मुखवाली तथा अनेक शुभ आभरणोंसे अत्यन्त शोभित होती हुई हैमवती अम्बिका उमा प्रकट हो गयीं
verses.wordMeaning: samndratlL saptabhib—by seven seas. According to S. M. Ali, samudta does not necessaxily mean *a watery sea*. The Pur&ic sea can be a large expanse of sand as well as water.…
verses.commentary: Sense: samndratlL saptabhib—by seven seas. According to S. M. Ali, samudta does not necessaxily mean *a watery sea*. The Pur&ic sea can be a large expanse of sand as well as water.…

verses.sanskrit: समुद्रेष्विह सर्वेषु सर्वदा सगणः शिवः जलरूपी भवः श्रीमान् क्रीडते चोर्मिबाहुभिः
verses.transliteration: samudreṣviha sarveṣu sarvadā sagaṇaḥ śivaḥ jalarūpī bhavaḥ śrīmān krīḍate cormibāhubhiḥ
verses.translation: Lord Vi$nu always sleeps in yogic slumber in the milky ocean as though he were the nectar from that, with his intellect concentrated on the knowledge of Siva.
verses.hindi: इन्द्र आदिने सुशोभित होती हुई उन हैमवती अजा उमासे पूछा-हे ईशे! है परम शोभायमान अम्बिके! यह यक्षदेहधारी कौन है ? यह सुनकर उमा अम्बिकाने कहा-यह अगोचर है; तब इन्द्रसहित सभी देवताओंने उस यक्षको तथा
verses.wordMeaning: Lord Vi$nu always sleeps in yogic slumber in the milky ocean as though he were the nectar from that, with his intellect concentrated on the knowledge of Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: Lord Vi$nu always sleeps in yogic slumber in the milky ocean as though he were the nectar from that, with his intellect concentrated on the knowledge of Siva.

verses.sanskrit: क्षीरार्णवामृतमिव सदा क्षीरार्णवे हरिः शेते शिवज्ञानधिया साक्षाद्वै योगनिद्रया
verses.transliteration: kṣīrārṇavāmṛtamiva sadā kṣīrārṇave hariḥ śete śivajñānadhiyā sākṣādvai yoganidrayā
verses.translation: When the lord wakes up, the entire universe wakes up; when he is asleep it is also asleep; the mobile and immobile beings are identical with him.
verses.hindi: उमाको प्रणाम किया सभी श्रेष्ठ देवताओंसे सत्कृत होकर देवताओं तथा दानवोंकी समस्त प्रवृत्तिरूपा उन देवीने कहा--मैं ूर्वकालमें इस यक्षरूप परम पुरुषकी आज्ञाके अधीन रहनेवाली प्रकृति थी
verses.wordMeaning: When the lord wakes up, the entire universe wakes up; when he is asleep it is also asleep; the mobile and immobile beings are identical with him.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the lord wakes up, the entire universe wakes up; when he is asleep it is also asleep; the mobile and immobile beings are identical with him.

verses.sanskrit: यदा प्रबुद्धो भगवान् प्रबुद्धमखिलं जगत् यदा सुप्तस्तदा सुप्तं तन्मयं च चराचरम्
verses.transliteration: yadā prabuddho bhagavān prabuddhamakhilaṃ jagat yadā suptastadā suptaṃ tanmayaṃ ca carācaram
verses.translation: With the favour of Paramesthin lord of Devas, every- thing was created, held, protected and annihilated by him alone.
verses.hindi: अतः है द्विजो! उन्हीं अज (शिव)-के नियोगसे ब्रह्मा उत्पन्न हुए, उन ब्रह्मासे अण्ड उत्पन्न हुआ और अण्डसे ज्योतिर्गणोसहित समग्र विश्व उत्पन्न हुआ; इस तत्॥ ६२  प्रकार सब कुछ शिवात्मक है
verses.wordMeaning: With the favour of Paramesthin lord of Devas, every- thing was created, held, protected and annihilated by him alone.
verses.commentary: Sense: With the favour of Paramesthin lord of Devas, every- thing was created, held, protected and annihilated by him alone.

verses.sanskrit: तेनैव सृष्टमखिलं धृतं रक्षितमेव च संहृतं देवदेवस्य प्रसादात्परमेष्ठिनः
verses.transliteration: tenaiva sṛṣṭamakhilaṃ dhṛtaṃ rakṣitameva ca saṃhṛtaṃ devadevasya prasādātparameṣṭhinaḥ
verses.translation: O excellent sages, those who are well known as suenas worship Aniruddha the leading Puru$a holding conch, discus and iron club.
verses.hindi: नामक तिरपनवोँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ   परम पुरुषकी सरवोत्कृष्टताको बतानेवाला यह हैमी. आख्यान पख उ परम पुरुषको सर्वोत्कृष्टताको बतानेवाला यह ' हैमवती-आख्यान' मूलरूपसे सामवेदके तलवकारब्राह्मणके अन्तर्गत प्राप्त होनेवाले
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent sages, those who are well known as suenas worship Aniruddha the leading Puru$a holding conch, discus and iron club.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent sages, those who are well known as suenas worship Aniruddha the leading Puru$a holding conch, discus and iron club.

verses.sanskrit: सुषेणा इति विख्याता यजन्ते पुरुषर्षभम् अनिरुद्धं मुनिश्रेष्ठाः शङ्खचक्रगदाधरम्
verses.transliteration: suṣeṇā iti vikhyātā yajante puruṣarṣabham aniruddhaṃ muniśreṣṭhāḥ śaṅkhacakragadādharam
verses.translation: O sages, most excellent among the knowers of Atman! those who meditate on Aniruddha Purusa are all similar to Vi$nu and become endowed with all riches. Sanandana, Sanaka, Sanatana, Valakhilyas, Siddhas, Mitra and Varuna these all worship Visnu who is the origin of the universe. In all the seven continents there are lofty mountains, some rising to great heights, some extending as far as the oceans, others having many peaks and caves. There were many kings in these continents who were overlords and who ruled with efficiency according to the demands of the period.* They were powerful, thanks to the lord (Siva), the father of the enemy of Kraufica®®* (i. e. Kttikeya).
verses.hindi: केनोपनिषदूमें उपलब्ध होता है। अध्याय ५४ 1 ज्योतिःसन्निवेशवर्णनमें लोकपालोंकी जा त FS
verses.wordMeaning: O sages, most excellent among the knowers of Atman! those who meditate on Aniruddha Purusa are all similar to Vi$nu and become endowed with all riches. Sanandana, Sanaka, Sanatana, Valakhilyas, Siddhas, Mitra and Varuna these all worship Visnu who is the origin of the universe.…
verses.commentary: Sense: O sages, most excellent among the knowers of Atman! those who meditate on Aniruddha Purusa are all similar to Vi$nu and become endowed with all riches. Sanandana, Sanaka, Sanatana, Valakhilyas, Siddhas, Mitra and Varuna these all worship Visnu who is the origin of the universe.…

verses.sanskrit: ये चानिरुद्धं पुरुषं ध्यायन्त्यात्मविदां वराः नारायणसमाः सर्वे सर्वसंपत्समन्विताः
verses.transliteration: ye cāniruddhaṃ puruṣaṃ dhyāyantyātmavidāṃ varāḥ nārāyaṇasamāḥ sarve sarvasaṃpatsamanvitāḥ
verses.translation: I shall mention the kings in all the manvantaras past and future, beginning with those in the Svayambhuva rnanvantara. The grandsons of Svayambhuva Manu were all very strong, with similar status, honour and identical pur- poses. They were the heroic sons of Priyavrata*®® and they are reputed to be ten,*®® viz., Agnidhra, Agnibahu, Medha, Medh&tithi, Vasu, Jyotisman, Dyutiman, Havya, Savana and Putra. Priyavrata crowned seven of them as kings over the seven continents.
verses.hindi: ज्योतिःसन्निवेशवर्णनमें लोकपालोंकी पुरियोंका वर्णन, सूर्यकी स्थिति तथा उसकी गतिसे होनेवाले अयन एवं ऋतुओंकी स्थिति, श्लुवस्थान तथा मेघोंका स्वरूप और वृष्टिका प्रादुर्भाव ज्योतिर्गणप्रचारं वै सङ्क्षिप्याण्डे ब्रवीम्यहम्। देवक्षेत्राणि चालोक्य ग्रहचारप्रसिद्धये
verses.wordMeaning: I shall mention the kings in all the manvantaras past and future, beginning with those in the Svayambhuva rnanvantara. The grandsons of Svayambhuva Manu were all very strong, with similar status, honour and identical pur- poses.…
verses.commentary: Sense: I shall mention the kings in all the manvantaras past and future, beginning with those in the Svayambhuva rnanvantara. The grandsons of Svayambhuva Manu were all very strong, with similar status, honour and identical pur- poses.…

verses.sanskrit: सनन्दनश् च भगवान् सनकश् च सनातनः वालखिल्याश् च सिद्धाश् च मित्रावरुणकौ तथा
verses.transliteration: sanandanaś ca bhagavān sanakaś ca sanātanaḥ vālakhilyāś ca siddhāś ca mitrāvaruṇakau tathā
verses.translation: He made Agnidhra the lord of Jambudvipa and Medhatithi the king of Plaksadvipa. He crowned Vapusman the king of 8&lmali, Jyoti§man the king of Kuadvipa, Dyutiman the king of Krauficadvipa Havya the lord of Sakadvfpa. O sages of good holy rites, he made Savana the overlord of Pu$kara. Savana had two sons Mahavira and Dhatakl. They were most excellent that men could have. The kingdom of Mahavira is known as Mahavira Var§a after the name of that noble soul. The kingdom ofDhataki is called Dhatakikhanda.® Havya the lord of Sakadvipa procreated seven sons,
verses.hindi: सूतजी बोले- है क्रषियो! देवक्षेत्रोंको देखकर ग्रहोंकी गतिके ज्ञानके लिये अण्डमें ज्योतिर्गणों (ग्रहों)-की गतिका संक्षेपमे वर्णन करता हूँ मेरुके पूर्वमें मानस पर्वतपर महेन्द्रकी पुरी स्थित है । दक्षिणमें सूर्यपुत्र यमकी, पश्चिममें वरुणकी और उत्तरमें सोमकी विशाल पुरी है । उनमें दिग्पाल रहते हैं । वे पुरियाँ क्रमसे अमरावती, संयमनी, सुखा तथा विभा
verses.wordMeaning: He made Agnidhra the lord of Jambudvipa and Medhatithi the king of Plaksadvipa. He crowned Vapusman the king of 8&lmali, Jyoti§man the king of Kuadvipa, Dyutiman the king of Krauficadvipa Havya the lord of Sakadvfpa. O sages of good holy rites,…
verses.commentary: Sense: He made Agnidhra the lord of Jambudvipa and Medhatithi the king of Plaksadvipa. He crowned Vapusman the king of 8&lmali, Jyoti§man the king of Kuadvipa, Dyutiman the king of Krauficadvipa Havya the lord of Sakadvfpa. O sages of good holy rites,…

verses.sanskrit: यजन्ति सततं तत्र विश्वस्य प्रभवं हरिम् सप्तद्वीपेषु तिष्ठन्ति नानाशृङ्गा महोदयाः
verses.transliteration: yajanti satataṃ tatra viśvasya prabhavaṃ harim saptadvīpeṣu tiṣṭhanti nānāśṛṅgā mahodayāḥ
verses.translation: They were Jalada, Kumara, Sukumara, Manicaka Kusumottara, Modaki and Mahadruma.
verses.hindi: लोकपालोंकी पुरियोंके ऊपर सभी ओर दक्षिणायनमें बाणके समान गतिवाले सूर्यकी जो गति है, उसे आपलोग जानिये। दक्षिणायनमें सूर्य बाणकी तरह गमन करते हैं, वे नक्षत्रचक्रको साथ लेकर निरन्तर परिभ्रमण करते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: They were Jalada, Kumara, Sukumara, Manicaka Kusumottara, Modaki and Mahadruma.
verses.commentary: Sense: They were Jalada, Kumara, Sukumara, Manicaka Kusumottara, Modaki and Mahadruma.

verses.sanskrit: आसमुद्रायताः केचिद् गिरयो गह्वरैस् तथा धरायाः पतयश्चासन् बहवः कालगौरवात्
verses.transliteration: āsamudrāyatāḥ kecid girayo gahvarais tathā dharāyāḥ patayaścāsan bahavaḥ kālagauravāt
verses.translation: The Var§a continent of Talada is called ( 1 ) Tala- da; the Varsa of Kumara is called (2) Kauma; that of Suku- mara is glorified as (3) Sukumara; the Vari of Maicaka is called (4) Manicaka; the Var of Kusumottara is (5) Kusu- mottara, the Varsa of Modaki is glorified as (6) Modaka; after the name of Mahadruma, the next Varsa is (7) Maha- druma; all the seven Var$as are thus named after their rulers.
verses.hindi: हे द्विजो! जब प्रभु सूर्य इन्द्रकी पुरीमें प्रवेश करते हैं, तब संयमनीपुरीके सभी लोग सूर्यका उदय देखते हैं; जब वे सूर्य संयमनीपुरीमें होते हैं, तब पश्चिममें सुखावतीपुरीमें प्रातःकाल होता है। उस समय विश्वके ेत्रतुल्य भगवान् सूर्य विभापुरीमें अस्त होते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: The Var§a continent of Talada is called ( 1 ) Tala- da; the Varsa of Kumara is called (2) Kauma; that of Suku- mara is glorified as (3) Sukumara; the Vari of Maicaka is called (4) Manicaka; the Var of Kusumottara is (5) Kusu- mottara,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The Var§a continent of Talada is called ( 1 ) Tala- da; the Varsa of Kumara is called (2) Kauma; that of Suku- mara is glorified as (3) Sukumara; the Vari of Maicaka is called (4) Manicaka; the Var of Kusumottara is (5) Kusu- mottara,…

verses.sanskrit: सामर्थ्यात्परमेशानाः क्रौञ्चारेर्जनकात्प्रभोः मन्वन्तरेषु सर्वेषु अतीतानागतेष्विह
verses.transliteration: sāmarthyātparameśānāḥ krauñcārerjanakātprabhoḥ manvantareṣu sarveṣu atītānāgateṣviha
verses.translation: Dyutiman, the lord of Krauilca Dvipa had seven sons named KuiSala, Manuga, U$na, Pivara, Andhakaraka, Muni and Dundubhi who had splendid sub-continents named after them, in the Kraufica Dvipa. The sub-continent of Kusala isKuala; that of Manuga is Manonuga; that of U$na is Usna; that of Pivara is Pivara; the land of Andhakara is Andhakaraka; the land of Muni is called Muni auid that of Dundubhi is Dundubhi. These seven shining countries are in Kraufica Dvipa.
verses.hindi: जिस प्रकार मैंने अमरावतीमें सूर्यकी गतिको कहा है, उसी प्रकार ये सूर्य संयमनीको पाकर 'सुखा' तथा “विभा'को भी प्राप्त करते हैं हे द्विजो! जब आग्नेय (दक्षिण-पूर्व) भागमें अपराह्न होता है, तब नैत (दक्षिण-पश्चिम) भागमें पर्वाह, उस समय वायव्य (उत्तर-पश्चिम) भागमें भयानक रात्रिका उत्तरार्ध और उत्तर-पूर्व भागमें रात्रिका
verses.wordMeaning: Dyutiman, the lord of Krauilca Dvipa had seven sons named KuiSala, Manuga, U$na, Pivara, Andhakaraka, Muni and Dundubhi who had splendid sub-continents named after them, in the Kraufica Dvipa. The sub-continent of Kusala isKuala; that of Manuga is Manonuga;…
verses.commentary: Sense: Dyutiman, the lord of Krauilca Dvipa had seven sons named KuiSala, Manuga, U$na, Pivara, Andhakaraka, Muni and Dundubhi who had splendid sub-continents named after them, in the Kraufica Dvipa. The sub-continent of Kusala isKuala; that of Manuga is Manonuga;…

verses.sanskrit: प्रवक्ष्यामि धरेशान् वो वक्ष्ये स्वायंभुवे ऽन्तरे मन्वन्तरेषु सर्वेषु अतीतानागतेषु च
verses.transliteration: pravakṣyāmi dhareśān vo vakṣye svāyaṃbhuve 'ntare manvantareṣu sarveṣu atītānāgateṣu ca
verses.translation: They were Udbhida, Veuman, Dvairatha, Lavaiia, Dhrti, Prabhakara and Kapila.
verses.hindi: प्रथम काल होता है। सब प्रकारसे यही गति होती है। इसी प्रकार जब जलको सोखनेवाले सूर्य आकाशके मध्यमें संचरण करते हैं, तब वे एक मुहूर्तमें पृथ्वीपर तीस अंश चलते हैं। एक मुहूर्तमें सूर्यके द्वारा पार की गयी दूरीको योजनपरिमाणमें सुनिये
verses.wordMeaning: They were Udbhida, Veuman, Dvairatha, Lavaiia, Dhrti, Prabhakara and Kapila.
verses.commentary: Sense: They were Udbhida, Veuman, Dvairatha, Lavaiia, Dhrti, Prabhakara and Kapila.

verses.sanskrit: तुल्याभिमानिनश्चैव सर्वे तुल्यप्रयोजनाः स्वायंभुवस्य च मनोः पौत्रास्त्वासन्महाबलाः
verses.transliteration: tulyābhimāninaścaiva sarve tulyaprayojanāḥ svāyaṃbhuvasya ca manoḥ pautrāstvāsanmahābalāḥ
verses.translation: The first Varsa is Udbhida; the second is Venu- mandatla; the third is Dvairatha; the fourth is Lavana; the fifth isDhrtimat; the sixth is Prabhakara, and the seventh is Kapila.
verses.hindi: 'सौम्ये सोमस्य विपुला तासु दिग्देवताः स्थिताः। अमरावती संयमनी सुखा चैव विभा क्रमात् लोकपालोपरिष्टात्तु सर्वतो दक्षिणायने। काष्ठां गतस्य सूर्यस्य गतिर्या तां निबोधत ४
verses.wordMeaning: The first Varsa is Udbhida; the second is Venu- mandatla; the third is Dvairatha; the fourth is Lavana; the fifth isDhrtimat; the sixth is Prabhakara, and the seventh is Kapila.
verses.commentary: Sense: The first Varsa is Udbhida; the second is Venu- mandatla; the third is Dvairatha; the fourth is Lavana; the fifth isDhrtimat; the sixth is Prabhakara, and the seventh is Kapila.

verses.sanskrit: प्रियव्रतात्मजा वीरास् ते दशेह प्रकीर्तिताः आग्नीध्रश्चाग्निबाहुश् च मेधा मेधातिथिर्वसुः
verses.transliteration: priyavratātmajā vīrās te daśeha prakīrtitāḥ āgnīdhraścāgnibāhuś ca medhā medhātithirvasuḥ
verses.translation: Medfa&tithi had seven sons; they were the kings of Plaksa Dvipa which consists of seven Var§as. The eldest among the sons was Santabhaya. After him were Sirira; Sukhodaya, Ananda; Siva, Kemaka and Dhruva. The conti- nent was divided into seven Var§as and named after these sons. Formerly in the Svayambhuva manvantara these Var?as were colonised by them. Subjects endowed with the discipline of four castes and four stages of life were colonised in the Varsas by those sons of Medhatithi, the residents of Plaksadvipa.
verses.hindi: मया प्रोक्तोऽमरावत्यां यथासौ वारितस्करः। तथा संयमनीं प्राप्य सुखां चैव विभां खगः एवं पुष्करमध्ये तु यदा सर्पति वारिपः
verses.wordMeaning: Medfa&tithi had seven sons; they were the kings of Plaksa Dvipa which consists of seven Var§as. The eldest among the sons was Santabhaya. After him were Sirira; Sukhodaya, Ananda; Siva, Kemaka and Dhruva. The conti- nent was divided into seven Var§as and named after these sons.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Medfa&tithi had seven sons; they were the kings of Plaksa Dvipa which consists of seven Var§as. The eldest among the sons was Santabhaya. After him were Sirira; Sukhodaya, Ananda; Siva, Kemaka and Dhruva. The conti- nent was divided into seven Var§as and named after these sons.…

verses.sanskrit: ज्योतिष्मान्द्युतिमान् हव्यः सवनः पुत्र एव च प्रियव्रतो ऽभ्यषिञ्चत्तान् सप्त सप्तसु पार्थिवान्
verses.transliteration: jyotiṣmāndyutimān havyaḥ savanaḥ putra eva ca priyavrato 'bhyaṣiñcattān sapta saptasu pārthivān
verses.translation: In the five continents begirming with Plaksadvipa and ending with Sakadvipa, the Dharma, was promulgated in accordance with the divirion of four castes and four stages of life. O excellent brahmins;, in these five Dvipras, happiness, span of life, handsome features, strength and Dharma were their individual characteristics respectively.
verses.hindi: नककी कक कक क ककक सभज चषक चास (जा हः कही गयी है। यह महात्मा भास्करकी एक मुहूर्तकी गति है। जब सूर्य इस गतिसे दक्षिण दिशाकी ओर जाते हैं, तब वहाँ छः माह भ्रमण करनेके बाद पुनः उत्तरायणकालमें उत्तर दिशाको ओर लौटते हैं दक्षिणायनके समय महातेजस्वी सूर्य मानसोत्तर पर्वतपर पुष्करके मध्य भ्रमण करते हैं। वे सूर्य एक सौ अस्सी मण्डलसे गुजरते हैं। उत्तरायण तथा दक्षिणायनको बाह्य
verses.wordMeaning: In the five continents begirming with Plaksadvipa and ending with Sakadvipa, the Dharma, was promulgated in accordance with the divirion of four castes and four stages of life. O excellent brahmins;, in these five Dvipras, happiness, span of life, handsome features,…
verses.commentary: Sense: In the five continents begirming with Plaksadvipa and ending with Sakadvipa, the Dharma, was promulgated in accordance with the divirion of four castes and four stages of life. O excellent brahmins;, in these five Dvipras, happiness, span of life, handsome features,…

verses.sanskrit: जम्बूद्वीपेश्वरं चक्रे आग्नीध्रं सुमहाबलम् प्लक्षद्वीपेश्वरश्चापि तेन मेधातिथिः कृतः
verses.transliteration: jambūdvīpeśvaraṃ cakre āgnīdhraṃ sumahābalam plakṣadvīpeśvaraścāpi tena medhātithiḥ kṛtaḥ
verses.translation: The characteristic common to all the five continents was that the subjects there were all perpetually engaged in the worship of Rudra and devoted to Mahesvara. The kings born in the Puskaradvipa enjoy the nectar of their devout feelings towards Prajapati and Rudra.
verses.hindi: एवं आभ्यन्तर कहा गया है। सूर्य प्रतिदिन उन्हीं मण्डलोंपर भ्रमण करते हैं। जैसे कुम्हारके चाकका बाहरी भाग शीप्रतापूर्वक चारों ओर घूमता है, वैसे ही सूर्यदेव दक्षिणायनमें तेजीसे भ्रमण करते हैं। इसलिये वे थोड़े समयमें ही अपेक्षाकृत अधिक भूमिपर पहुँचते हैं। दक्षिणायनमें सूर्य मात्र बारह मुहूर्तोमे शीघ्रतापूर्वक दिनमें साढ़े तेरह नक्षत्र चलते हैं, जबकि ात्रिमें अठारह मुहूतोमें उतनी ही नक्षत्रकी दूरीको तय
verses.wordMeaning: The characteristic common to all the five continents was that the subjects there were all perpetually engaged in the worship of Rudra and devoted to Mahesvara. The kings born in the Puskaradvipa enjoy the nectar of their devout feelings towards Prajapati and Rudra.
verses.commentary: Sense: The characteristic common to all the five continents was that the subjects there were all perpetually engaged in the worship of Rudra and devoted to Mahesvara. The kings born in the Puskaradvipa enjoy the nectar of their devout feelings towards Prajapati and Rudra.

verses.sanskrit: शाल्मलेश् च वपुष्मन्तं राजानमभिषिक्तवान् ज्योतिष्मन्तं कुशद्वीपे राजानं कृतवान्नृपः
verses.transliteration: śālmaleś ca vapuṣmantaṃ rājānamabhiṣiktavān jyotiṣmantaṃ kuśadvīpe rājānaṃ kṛtavānnṛpaḥ
verses.translation: The characteristic common to all the five continents was that the subjects there were all perpetually engaged in the worship of Rudra and devoted to Mahesvara. The kings born in the Puskaradvipa enjoy the nectar of their devout feelings towards Prajapati and Rudra.
verses.hindi: जैसे कुम्हारके चाकका मध्यभाग मन्द गतिसे चलता है, उसी प्रकार सूर्य उत्तरायणमें मन्दगतिसे भ्रमण करते हैं। इसलिये वे अधिक समयमें थोड़ी भूमिपर पहुँचते हैं। सूर्यका वह रथ आदित्यों, मुनियों, गन्धर्वो, अप्सराओं, ग्रामणियों, सर्पो तथा राक्षसोंसे अधिष्ठित है। हजार किरणोंवाले वे सूर्य आगेसे, पीछेसे, नीचेसे तथा ऊपरसे किरण छोड़कर ब्रह्माकी अत्युत्तम सभाको प्रकाशित करते हुए सन्ध्या-वन्दनके समय
verses.wordMeaning: The characteristic common to all the five continents was that the subjects there were all perpetually engaged in the worship of Rudra and devoted to Mahesvara. The kings born in the Puskaradvipa enjoy the nectar of their devout feelings towards Prajapati and Rudra.
verses.commentary: Sense: The characteristic common to all the five continents was that the subjects there were all perpetually engaged in the worship of Rudra and devoted to Mahesvara. The kings born in the Puskaradvipa enjoy the nectar of their devout feelings towards Prajapati and Rudra.

verses.sanskrit: द्युतिमन्तं च राजानं क्रौञ्चद्वीपे समादिशत् शाकद्वीपेश्वरं चापि हव्यं चक्रे प्रियव्रतः
verses.transliteration: dyutimantaṃ ca rājānaṃ krauñcadvīpe samādiśat śākadvīpeśvaraṃ cāpi havyaṃ cakre priyavrataḥ
verses.translation: The characteristic common to all the five continents was that the subjects there were all perpetually engaged in the worship of Rudra and devoted to Mahesvara. The kings born in the Puskaradvipa enjoy the nectar of their devout feelings towards Prajapati and Rudra.
verses.hindi: मुनियो तथा ब्राह्मणोंके द्वारा अर्घ्यहेतु छोडे गये जलसे पास आनेवाले राक्षसोंको मार-मारकर आगे बढ़ते रहते हैं॥ २०--२३/२॥ उत्तरायणके पश्चिम भागमें दिन अठारह मुहूर्तका होता है, उस समय सूर्य मन्दगतिवाले होकर चलते हैं। सूर्य रातमें बारह मुहूर्तमें साढ़े तेरह नक्षत्रदूरीको त्य करते हैं और दिनमें चलते हुए वे उतनी ही नक्षत्रकी
verses.wordMeaning: The characteristic common to all the five continents was that the subjects there were all perpetually engaged in the worship of Rudra and devoted to Mahesvara. The kings born in the Puskaradvipa enjoy the nectar of their devout feelings towards Prajapati and Rudra.
verses.commentary: Sense: The characteristic common to all the five continents was that the subjects there were all perpetually engaged in the worship of Rudra and devoted to Mahesvara. The kings born in the Puskaradvipa enjoy the nectar of their devout feelings towards Prajapati and Rudra.

verses.sanskrit: पुष्कराधिपतिं चक्रे सवनं चापि सुव्रताः पुष्करे सवनस्यापि महावीतः सुतो ऽभवत्
verses.transliteration: puṣkarādhipatiṃ cakre savanaṃ cāpi suvratāḥ puṣkare savanasyāpi mahāvītaḥ suto 'bhavat
verses.translation: The characteristic common to all the five continents was that the subjects there were all perpetually engaged in the worship of Rudra and devoted to Mahesvara. The kings born in the Puskaradvipa enjoy the nectar of their devout feelings towards Prajapati and Rudra.
verses.hindi: दूरी अठारह मुहूर्तोमे तय करते हें जिस प्रकार नाभिमें चक्र अधिक मन्द गतिंसे घूमता है, उसी प्रकार चक्रके मध्यस्थित मिट्टीके
verses.wordMeaning: The characteristic common to all the five continents was that the subjects there were all perpetually engaged in the worship of Rudra and devoted to Mahesvara. The kings born in the Puskaradvipa enjoy the nectar of their devout feelings towards Prajapati and Rudra.
verses.commentary: Sense: The characteristic common to all the five continents was that the subjects there were all perpetually engaged in the worship of Rudra and devoted to Mahesvara. The kings born in the Puskaradvipa enjoy the nectar of their devout feelings towards Prajapati and Rudra.

verses.sanskrit: धातकी चैव द्वावेतौ पुत्रौ पुत्रवतां वरौ महावीतं स्मृतं वर्षं तस्य नाम्ना महात्मनः
verses.transliteration: dhātakī caiva dvāvetau putrau putravatāṃ varau mahāvītaṃ smṛtaṃ varṣaṃ tasya nāmnā mahātmanaḥ
verses.translation: The characteristic common to all the five continents was that the subjects there were all perpetually engaged in the worship of Rudra and devoted to Mahesvara. The kings born in the Puskaradvipa enjoy the nectar of their devout feelings towards Prajapati and Rudra.
verses.hindi: पञ्चाशच्च तथान्यानि सहस्त्राण्यधिकानि तु मौहूर्तिकी गतिह्णाषा भास्करस्य महात्मनः । एतेन गतियोगेन यदा काष्ठां तु दक्षिणाम्
verses.wordMeaning: The characteristic common to all the five continents was that the subjects there were all perpetually engaged in the worship of Rudra and devoted to Mahesvara. The kings born in the Puskaradvipa enjoy the nectar of their devout feelings towards Prajapati and Rudra.
verses.commentary: Sense: The characteristic common to all the five continents was that the subjects there were all perpetually engaged in the worship of Rudra and devoted to Mahesvara. The kings born in the Puskaradvipa enjoy the nectar of their devout feelings towards Prajapati and Rudra.

verses.sanskrit: नाम्ना तु धातकेश्चैव धातकीखण्डमुच्यते हव्यो ऽप्यजनयत् पुत्राञ् छाकद्वीपेश्वरः प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: nāmnā tu dhātakeścaiva dhātakīkhaṇḍamucyate havyo 'pyajanayat putrāñ chākadvīpeśvaraḥ prabhuḥ
verses.translation: The characteristic common to all the five continents was that the subjects there were all perpetually engaged in the worship of Rudra and devoted to Mahesvara. The kings born in the Puskaradvipa enjoy the nectar of their devout feelings towards Prajapati and Rudra.
verses.hindi: मध्ये तु पुष्करस्याथ भ्रमते दक्षिणायने
verses.wordMeaning: The characteristic common to all the five continents was that the subjects there were all perpetually engaged in the worship of Rudra and devoted to Mahesvara. The kings born in the Puskaradvipa enjoy the nectar of their devout feelings towards Prajapati and Rudra.
verses.commentary: Sense: The characteristic common to all the five continents was that the subjects there were all perpetually engaged in the worship of Rudra and devoted to Mahesvara. The kings born in the Puskaradvipa enjoy the nectar of their devout feelings towards Prajapati and Rudra.

verses.sanskrit: जलदं च कुमारं च सुकुमारं मणीचकम् कुसुमोत्तरमोदाकी सप्तमस्तु महाद्रुमः
verses.transliteration: jaladaṃ ca kumāraṃ ca sukumāraṃ maṇīcakam kusumottaramodākī saptamastu mahādrumaḥ
verses.translation: The characteristic common to all the five continents was that the subjects there were all perpetually engaged in the worship of Rudra and devoted to Mahesvara. The kings born in the Puskaradvipa enjoy the nectar of their devout feelings towards Prajapati and Rudra.
verses.hindi: प्रत्यहं चरते तानि सूर्यो वै मण्डलानि तु दक्षिणप्रक्रमे देवस्तथा शीघ्रं प्रवर्तते
verses.wordMeaning: The characteristic common to all the five continents was that the subjects there were all perpetually engaged in the worship of Rudra and devoted to Mahesvara. The kings born in the Puskaradvipa enjoy the nectar of their devout feelings towards Prajapati and Rudra.
verses.commentary: Sense: The characteristic common to all the five continents was that the subjects there were all perpetually engaged in the worship of Rudra and devoted to Mahesvara. The kings born in the Puskaradvipa enjoy the nectar of their devout feelings towards Prajapati and Rudra.

verses.sanskrit: अलदं जलदस्याथ वर्षं प्रथममुच्यते कुमारस्य तु कौमारं द्वितीयं परिकीर्तितम्
verses.transliteration: aladaṃ jaladasyātha varṣaṃ prathamamucyate kumārasya tu kaumāraṃ dvitīyaṃ parikīrtitam
verses.translation: The characteristic common to all the five continents was that the subjects there were all perpetually engaged in the worship of Rudra and devoted to Mahesvara. The kings born in the Puskaradvipa enjoy the nectar of their devout feelings towards Prajapati and Rudra.
verses.hindi: तस्मात्प्रकृष्टां भूमिं तु कालेनाल्पेन गच्छति। सूर्या द्वादशभिः शीघ्रं मुहूर्तैदक्षिणायने
verses.wordMeaning: The characteristic common to all the five continents was that the subjects there were all perpetually engaged in the worship of Rudra and devoted to Mahesvara. The kings born in the Puskaradvipa enjoy the nectar of their devout feelings towards Prajapati and Rudra.
verses.commentary: Sense: The characteristic common to all the five continents was that the subjects there were all perpetually engaged in the worship of Rudra and devoted to Mahesvara. The kings born in the Puskaradvipa enjoy the nectar of their devout feelings towards Prajapati and Rudra.

verses.sanskrit: सुकुमारं तृतीयं तु सुकुमारस्य कीर्त्यते मणीचकं चतुर्थं तु माणीचकमिहोच्यते
verses.transliteration: sukumāraṃ tṛtīyaṃ tu sukumārasya kīrtyate maṇīcakaṃ caturthaṃ tu māṇīcakamihocyate
verses.translation: The characteristic common to all the five continents was that the subjects there were all perpetually engaged in the worship of Rudra and devoted to Mahesvara. The kings born in the Puskaradvipa enjoy the nectar of their devout feelings towards Prajapati and Rudra.
verses.hindi: तस्माद्दीर्घेण कालेन भूमिमल्पां तु गच्छति। स रथोऽधिष्ठितो भानोराित्वैर्मुनिभिस्तथा ऊर्ध्वतश्च करं त्यक्त्वा सभां ब्राह्मीमनुत्तमाम्। अम्भोभिर्मुनिभिस्त्यक्ते: सन्ध्यायां तु निशाचरान्
verses.wordMeaning: The characteristic common to all the five continents was that the subjects there were all perpetually engaged in the worship of Rudra and devoted to Mahesvara. The kings born in the Puskaradvipa enjoy the nectar of their devout feelings towards Prajapati and Rudra.
verses.commentary: Sense: The characteristic common to all the five continents was that the subjects there were all perpetually engaged in the worship of Rudra and devoted to Mahesvara. The kings born in the Puskaradvipa enjoy the nectar of their devout feelings towards Prajapati and Rudra.

verses.sanskrit: कुसुमोत्तरस्य वै वर्षं पञ्चमं कुसुमोत्तरम् मोदकं चापि मोदाकेर् वर्षं षष्ठं प्रकीर्तितम्
verses.transliteration: kusumottarasya vai varṣaṃ pañcamaṃ kusumottaram modakaṃ cāpi modāker varṣaṃ ṣaṣṭhaṃ prakīrtitam
verses.translation: The characteristic common to all the five continents was that the subjects there were all perpetually engaged in the worship of Rudra and devoted to Mahesvara. The kings born in the Puskaradvipa enjoy the nectar of their devout feelings towards Prajapati and Rudra.
verses.hindi: अध्याय ५४ ज्योतिःसन्निवेशवर्णनमें लोकपालोंकी पुरियोंका वर्णन
verses.wordMeaning: The characteristic common to all the five continents was that the subjects there were all perpetually engaged in the worship of Rudra and devoted to Mahesvara. The kings born in the Puskaradvipa enjoy the nectar of their devout feelings towards Prajapati and Rudra.

verses.sanskrit: महाद्रुमस्य नाम्ना तु सप्तमं तन्महाद्रुमम् तेषां तु नामभिस्तानि सप्त वर्षाणि तत्र वै

verses.hindi: उभयोः काष्ठयोर्मध्ये भ्रमतो मण्डलानि तु भाँति मध्यमें स्थित ध्रुव घूमता है। प्राचीन विद्याके वेत्ता कहते हैं कि दिन और रात मिलकर तीस मुहूर्तके बराबर होते हैं। दोनों दिशाओंके बीचमें मण्डलोंमें सूर्य घूमता है। जैसे कुलालचक्रकी नाभि

verses.sanskrit: क्रौञ्चद्वीपेश्वरस्यापि पुत्रा द्युतिमतस्तु वै कुशलो मनुगश्चोष्णः पीवरश्चान्धकारकः

verses.hindi: उसी स्थानपर रहती है और घूमती है, उसी प्रकार ग्रहोंमें श्रेष्ठ ध्रुव भी ग्रहोंके साथ घूमते हैं। मुनियों तथा नक्षत्रोंका समूह उसीके मनके अनुसार चलता है। उसी  ध्रुव-के द्वारा अधिष्ठित सूर्यदेव वायुके साथ सभी

verses.sanskrit: मुनिश्च दुन्दुभिश्चैव सुता द्युतिमतस्तु वै तेषां स्वनामभिर् देशाः क्रौञ्चद्वीपाश्रयाः शुभाः
verses.transliteration: muniśca dundubhiścaiva sutā dyutimatastu vai teṣāṃ svanāmabhir deśāḥ krauñcadvīpāśrayāḥ śubhāḥ
verses.translation: The characteristic common to all the five continents was that the subjects there were all perpetually engaged in the worship of Rudra and devoted to Mahesvara. The kings born in the Puskaradvipa enjoy the nectar of their devout feelings towards Prajapati and Rudra.
verses.hindi: ओरसे अपनी किरणोंके द्वारा जल ग्रहण करते हैं। उत्तानपादके पुत्रको ध्रुवपद भगवान् विष्णुकी कृपासे सुलभ हुआ और धुवने इसे अपने पिताके कारण प्राप्त सूर्यके द्वारा ग्रहण किया गया वह जल क्रमसे चन्द्रमाको प्राप्त होता है और पुनः वह जल चन्द्रमासे मेघोंको प्राप्त होता है। इसके बाद वायुद्वारा आघात करनेपर मेघोंका समूह पृथ्वीपर वृष्टि करता है। सूर्य

verses.sanskrit: कुशलदेशः कुशले मनुगस्य मनोनुगः उष्णस्योष्णः स्मृतो देशः पीवरः पीवरस्य च
verses.transliteration: kuśaladeśaḥ kuśale manugasya manonugaḥ uṣṇasyoṣṇaḥ smṛto deśaḥ pīvaraḥ pīvarasya ca
verses.translation: The characteristic common to all the five continents was that the subjects there were all perpetually engaged in the worship of Rudra and devoted to Mahesvara. The kings born in the Puskaradvipa enjoy the nectar of their devout feelings towards Prajapati and Rudra.
verses.hindi: सबको भासित करते हैं, इसलिये वे भास्कर नामवाले हैं। जलका कभी नाश नहीं होता, वही जल पुनः परिवर्तित हो जाता है। भगवान् शिवने सभी प्राणियोंके कल्याणके लिये जलकी इस गतिका निर्माण किया है।
verses.wordMeaning: The characteristic common to all the five continents was that the subjects there were all perpetually engaged in the worship of Rudra and devoted to Mahesvara. The kings born in the Puskaradvipa enjoy the nectar of their devout feelings towards Prajapati and Rudra.

verses.sanskrit: अन्धकारस्य कथितो देशो नाम्नान्धकारकः मुनेर्देशो मुनिः प्रोक्तो दुन्दुभेर् दुन्दुभिः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: andhakārasya kathito deśo nāmnāndhakārakaḥ munerdeśo muniḥ prokto dundubher dundubhiḥ smṛtaḥ

verses.sanskrit: उद्भिदो वेणुमांश्चैव द्वैरथो लवणो धृतिः षष्ठः प्रभाकरश्चापि सप्तमः कपिलः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: udbhido veṇumāṃścaiva dvairatho lavaṇo dhṛtiḥ ṣaṣṭhaḥ prabhākaraścāpi saptamaḥ kapilaḥ smṛtaḥ
