verses.hindi: यज्ञधूमोद्धव॑ र द्विजानां हितकृत्सदा। यज्ञके धुएँसे उत्पन्न अभ्र (मेघ) सदा द्विजोंका र बनहितं स्मृतम्॥ हित करनेवाला होता है और दावानलके धूमसे उत्पन्न अभ्र वनके लिये हितकर कहा गया है। मृत प्राणियोंके जलानेपर उठे हुए धूमसे उत्पन्न अभ्र अशुभके लिये
verses.wordMeaning: The characteristic common to all the five continents was that the subjects there were all perpetually engaged in the worship of Rudra and devoted to Mahesvara. The kings born in the Puskaradvipa enjoy the nectar of their devout feelings towards Prajapati and Rudra.
verses.commentary: Sense: The characteristic common to all the five continents was that the subjects there were all perpetually engaged in the worship of Rudra and devoted to Mahesvara. The kings born in the Puskaradvipa enjoy the nectar of their devout feelings towards Prajapati and Rudra.

verses.sanskrit: तस्माच्छान्तभयाच्चैव शिशिरस्तु सुखोदयः आनन्दश् च शिवश्चैव क्षेमकश् च ध्रुवस् तथा
verses.transliteration: tasmācchāntabhayāccaiva śiśirastu sukhodayaḥ ānandaś ca śivaścaiva kṣemakaś ca dhruvas tathā
verses.translation: The characteristic common to all the five continents was that the subjects there were all perpetually engaged in the worship of Rudra and devoted to Mahesvara. The kings born in the Puskaradvipa enjoy the nectar of their devout feelings towards Prajapati and Rudra.
verses.hindi: होता है और है द्विजो! अभिचाराग्निके धूमसे उत्पन्न अभ्र प्राणियोके नाशके लिये होता है। इस प्रकार अलग-अलग धूमोंसे संसारका हित तथा अहित होता है। अतः मनुष्यको चाहिए कि अभिचारकर्मसे उत्पन्न धूमको ढँक दे। यदि कोई द्विज धूमको ढँके बिना अभिचारकर्म करता है, तो यह संसारके विनाशका कारण हो जाता है
verses.wordMeaning: The characteristic common to all the five continents was that the subjects there were all perpetually engaged in the worship of Rudra and devoted to Mahesvara. The kings born in the Puskaradvipa enjoy the nectar of their devout feelings towards Prajapati and Rudra.
verses.commentary: Sense: The characteristic common to all the five continents was that the subjects there were all perpetually engaged in the worship of Rudra and devoted to Mahesvara. The kings born in the Puskaradvipa enjoy the nectar of their devout feelings towards Prajapati and Rudra.

verses.sanskrit: तानि तेषां तु नामानि सप्तवर्षाणि भागशः निवेशितानि तैस्तानि पूर्वं स्वायंभुवे ऽन्तरे
verses.transliteration: tāni teṣāṃ tu nāmāni saptavarṣāṇi bhāgaśaḥ niveśitāni taistāni pūrvaṃ svāyaṃbhuve 'ntare
verses.translation: The characteristic common to all the five continents was that the subjects there were all perpetually engaged in the worship of Rudra and devoted to Mahesvara. The kings born in the Puskaradvipa enjoy the nectar of their devout feelings towards Prajapati and Rudra.
verses.hindi: हे सुव्रतो! जलके भण्डारस्वरूप मेघ वायुकी आज्ञासे जगत्के हितके लिये इस लोकमें छ: महीने वृष्टि करते हैं। मेघका गर्जन वायुके द्वारा, विद्युत्के द्वारा तथा अग्निके द्वारा होता है। है मुनिश्रेष्ठो! उन मेघोंकी
verses.wordMeaning: The characteristic common to all the five continents was that the subjects there were all perpetually engaged in the worship of Rudra and devoted to Mahesvara. The kings born in the Puskaradvipa enjoy the nectar of their devout feelings towards Prajapati and Rudra.
verses.commentary: Sense: The characteristic common to all the five continents was that the subjects there were all perpetually engaged in the worship of Rudra and devoted to Mahesvara. The kings born in the Puskaradvipa enjoy the nectar of their devout feelings towards Prajapati and Rudra.

verses.sanskrit: मेधातिथेस्तु पुत्रैस्तैः प्लक्षद्वीपनिवासिभिः वर्णाश्रमाचारयुताः प्रजास्तत्र निवेशिताः
verses.transliteration: medhātithestu putraistaiḥ plakṣadvīpanivāsibhiḥ varṇāśramācārayutāḥ prajāstatra niveśitāḥ
verses.translation: The characteristic common to all the five continents was that the subjects there were all perpetually engaged in the worship of Rudra and devoted to Mahesvara. The kings born in the Puskaradvipa enjoy the nectar of their devout feelings towards Prajapati and Rudra.
verses.hindi: उत्पत्ति तीन प्रकारसे होती है। 'अभ्र' शब्दका अर्थ है “जो नष्ट नहीं होता है।' 'मेहन' शब्दसे “मेघ' व्युत्पन्न कहा गया है। काष्ठ, वाहन, वैरिंच्य तथा पक्ष--ये विभिन्न प्रकारके मेघ होते हैं। घृतका काष्ठसे संयोग होनेपर अग्निसे जो धूम निकलता है, उससे प्रथम प्रकारका मेघ बनता है। दूसरे प्रकारके मेघकी उत्पत्ति ब्रह्माको श्वासवायुसे होती है। इन्द्रके द्वारा पर्वतोंके काटे गये पक्षोंसे तीसरे प्रकारके मेघ उत्पन्न होते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: The characteristic common to all the five continents was that the subjects there were all perpetually engaged in the worship of Rudra and devoted to Mahesvara. The kings born in the Puskaradvipa enjoy the nectar of their devout feelings towards Prajapati and Rudra.
verses.commentary: Sense: The characteristic common to all the five continents was that the subjects there were all perpetually engaged in the worship of Rudra and devoted to Mahesvara. The kings born in the Puskaradvipa enjoy the nectar of their devout feelings towards Prajapati and Rudra.

verses.sanskrit: प्लक्षद्वीपादिवर्षेषु शाकद्वीपान्तिकेषु वै ज्ञेयः पञ्चसु धर्मो वै वर्णाश्रमविभागशः
verses.transliteration: plakṣadvīpādivarṣeṣu śākadvīpāntikeṣu vai jñeyaḥ pañcasu dharmo vai varṇāśramavibhāgaśaḥ
verses.translation: The characteristic common to all the five continents was that the subjects there were all perpetually engaged in the worship of Rudra and devoted to Mahesvara. The kings born in the Puskaradvipa enjoy the nectar of their devout feelings towards Prajapati and Rudra.
verses.hindi: अग्निसे उत्पन्न मेघ शुभ होते हैं और वे आवह नामक वायुके स्थानमें जाते हैं। ब्रह्माके श्वाससे उत्पन्न सभी मेघ प्रवह नामक वायुके स्कन्धपर रहते हैं। पुष्कर आदि मेघ पक्षसे उत्पन्न होते हैं। ये जब बरसते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: The characteristic common to all the five continents was that the subjects there were all perpetually engaged in the worship of Rudra and devoted to Mahesvara. The kings born in the Puskaradvipa enjoy the nectar of their devout feelings towards Prajapati and Rudra.
verses.commentary: Sense: The characteristic common to all the five continents was that the subjects there were all perpetually engaged in the worship of Rudra and devoted to Mahesvara. The kings born in the Puskaradvipa enjoy the nectar of their devout feelings towards Prajapati and Rudra.

verses.sanskrit: सुखमायुः स्वरूपं च बलं धर्मो द्विजोत्तमाः पञ्चस्वेतेषु द्वीपेषु सर्वसाधारणं स्मृतम्
verses.transliteration: sukhamāyuḥ svarūpaṃ ca balaṃ dharmo dvijottamāḥ pañcasveteṣu dvīpeṣu sarvasādhāraṇaṃ smṛtam
verses.translation: The characteristic common to all the five continents was that the subjects there were all perpetually engaged in the worship of Rudra and devoted to Mahesvara. The kings born in the Puskaradvipa enjoy the nectar of their devout feelings towards Prajapati and Rudra.
verses.hindi: तब क्रमसे शान्त, ध्वनि करनेवाले तथा विनाशकारी होते हैं; इनके द्वारा यथाक्रम यह कृत्य होता है। कुछ मेघ अल्प वृष्टि करनेवाले होते हैं और कुछ मेघ दीर्घ कालतक शीतल वायुवाले होते हैं। कुछ मेघ जीवक होते हैं। कुछ मेघ क्षीण होते हैं और वे विद्युत् तथा ध्वनिसे रहित होते हैं। कुछ मेघ पृथ्वीतलसे एक कोसके भीतर आकाशमें इधर-उधर रहते हैं। पर्वतपर रहनेवाले सभी मेघ आधे कोसकी दूरीमें होते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: The characteristic common to all the five continents was that the subjects there were all perpetually engaged in the worship of Rudra and devoted to Mahesvara. The kings born in the Puskaradvipa enjoy the nectar of their devout feelings towards Prajapati and Rudra.
verses.commentary: Sense: The characteristic common to all the five continents was that the subjects there were all perpetually engaged in the worship of Rudra and devoted to Mahesvara. The kings born in the Puskaradvipa enjoy the nectar of their devout feelings towards Prajapati and Rudra.

verses.sanskrit: रुद्रार्चनरता नित्यं महेश्वरपरायणाः अन्ये च पुष्करद्वीपे प्रजाताश् च प्रजेश्वराः
verses.transliteration: rudrārcanaratā nityaṃ maheśvaraparāyaṇāḥ anye ca puṣkaradvīpe prajātāś ca prajeśvarāḥ
verses.translation: The characteristic common to all the five continents was that the subjects there were all perpetually engaged in the worship of Rudra and devoted to Mahesvara. The kings born in the Puskaradvipa enjoy the nectar of their devout feelings towards Prajapati and Rudra.
verses.hindi: एवमुद्दिश्य लोकस्य क्षयकृच्च भविष्यति
verses.wordMeaning: The characteristic common to all the five continents was that the subjects there were all perpetually engaged in the worship of Rudra and devoted to Mahesvara. The kings born in the Puskaradvipa enjoy the nectar of their devout feelings towards Prajapati and Rudra.
verses.commentary: Sense: The characteristic common to all the five continents was that the subjects there were all perpetually engaged in the worship of Rudra and devoted to Mahesvara. The kings born in the Puskaradvipa enjoy the nectar of their devout feelings towards Prajapati and Rudra.

verses.sanskrit: प्रजापतेश् च रुद्रस्य भावामृतसुखोत्कटाः
verses.transliteration: prajāpateś ca rudrasya bhāvāmṛtasukhotkaṭāḥ
verses.translation: The characteristic common to all the five continents was that the subjects there were all perpetually engaged in the worship of Rudra and devoted to Mahesvara. The kings born in the Puskaradvipa enjoy the nectar of their devout feelings towards Prajapati and Rudra.
verses.hindi: स्तनितं चेह वायव्यं वैद्युतं पावकोद्भवम्। त्रिधा तेषामिहोत्पत्तिरभ्राणां मुनिपुङ्गवाः काष्ठा वाह्वाशच वैरिंच्याः पक्षाशचैव पृथरिवधाः
verses.wordMeaning: The characteristic common to all the five continents was that the subjects there were all perpetually engaged in the worship of Rudra and devoted to Mahesvara. The kings born in the Puskaradvipa enjoy the nectar of their devout feelings towards Prajapati and Rudra.
verses.commentary: Sense: The characteristic common to all the five continents was that the subjects there were all perpetually engaged in the worship of Rudra and devoted to Mahesvara. The kings born in the Puskaradvipa enjoy the nectar of their devout feelings towards Prajapati and Rudra.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीलिङ्गमहापुराणे पूर्वभागे भुवनकोशे द्वीपद्वीपेश्वरकथनं नाम षट्चत्वारिंशो ऽध्यायः आग्नीध्रं ज्येष्ठदायादं काम्यपुत्रं महाबलम् प्रियव्रतो ऽभ्यषिञ्चद्वै जंबूद्वीपेश्वरं नृपः
verses.transliteration: iti śrīliṅgamahāpurāṇe pūrvabhāge bhuvanakośe dvīpadvīpeśvarakathanaṃ nāma ṣaṭcatvāriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ āgnīdhraṃ jyeṣṭhadāyādaṃ kāmyaputraṃ mahābalam priyavrato 'bhyaṣiñcadvai jaṃbūdvīpeśvaraṃ nṛpaḥ
verses.translation: King Priyavrata crowned his eldest son Agnidhra who was the eldest inheritor and who was a loveable son of great strength, as the king of Jambild\npa.*'
verses.hindi: आज्यानां काष्ठसंयोगादग्नेर्धूमः प्रवर्तितः । द्वितीयानां च सम्भूतिर्विरिञ्चोच्छ्ास वायुना
verses.wordMeaning: King Priyavrata crowned his eldest son Agnidhra who was the eldest inheritor and who was a loveable son of great strength, as the king of Jambild\npa.*'
verses.commentary: Sense: King Priyavrata crowned his eldest son Agnidhra who was the eldest inheritor and who was a loveable son of great strength, as the king of Jambild\npa.*'

verses.sanskrit: सो ऽतीव भवभक्तश् च तपस्वी तरुणः सदा भवार्चनरतः श्रीमान् गोमान्धीमान्द्विजर्षभाः
verses.transliteration: so 'tīva bhavabhaktaś ca tapasvī taruṇaḥ sadā bhavārcanarataḥ śrīmān gomāndhīmāndvijarṣabhāḥ
verses.translation: For detail, Ibid» Si.
verses.hindi: वाह्वयास्त्वथ जीमूतास्त्वावहस्थानगाः शुभाः विरिञ्चोच्छ्ठासजाः सर्वे प्रवहस्कन्धजास्ततः। पक्षजाः पुष्कराद्याश्च वर्षन्ति च यदा जलम्
verses.wordMeaning: For detail, Ibid» Si.
verses.commentary: Sense: For detail, Ibid» Si.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य पुत्रा बभूवुस्ते प्रजापतिसमा नव सर्वे माहेश्वराश्चैव महादेवपरायणाः
verses.transliteration: tasya putrā babhūvuste prajāpatisamā nava sarve māheśvarāścaiva mahādevaparāyaṇāḥ
verses.translation: O leading brahmins, he was an ascetic and a great devotee of Siva. He was a young man engaged in the worship of Siva. He was prosperous and intelligent and he possessed many cows.
verses.hindi: मूकाः सशब्ददुष्टाशास्त्वेतैः कृत्यं यथाक्रमम्॥ क्षामवृष्टिप्रदा दीर्घकालं शीतसमीरिणः
verses.wordMeaning: O leading brahmins, he was an ascetic and a great devotee of Siva. He was a young man engaged in the worship of Siva. He was prosperous and intelligent and he possessed many cows.
verses.commentary: Sense: O leading brahmins, he was an ascetic and a great devotee of Siva. He was a young man engaged in the worship of Siva. He was prosperous and intelligent and he possessed many cows.

verses.sanskrit: ज्येष्ठो नाभिर् इति ख्यातस् तस्य किंपुरुषो ऽनुजः हरिवर्षस्तृतीयस्तु चतुर्थो वै त्विलावृतः
verses.transliteration: jyeṣṭho nābhir iti khyātas tasya kiṃpuruṣo 'nujaḥ harivarṣastṛtīyastu caturtho vai tvilāvṛtaḥ
verses.translation: He had nine sons at par with Prajapatis. All of them were followers of Mahevara and devoted to Mahadeva.
verses.hindi: जीवकाश्च तथा क्षीणा विद्युदध्वनिविवर्जिता: । तिष्ठन्त्याक्रोशमात्रै तु धरापृष्ठादितस्ततः मेघा योजनमात्रं तु साध्यत्वाद्वहुतोयदाः
verses.wordMeaning: He had nine sons at par with Prajapatis. All of them were followers of Mahevara and devoted to Mahadeva.
verses.commentary: Sense: He had nine sons at par with Prajapatis. All of them were followers of Mahevara and devoted to Mahadeva.

verses.sanskrit: रम्यस्तु पञ्चमस् तत्र हिरण्मान् षष्ठ उच्यते कुरुस्तु सप्तमस्तेषां भद्राश्वस्त्वष्टमः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: ramyastu pañcamas tatra hiraṇmān ṣaṣṭha ucyate kurustu saptamasteṣāṃ bhadrāśvastvaṣṭamaḥ smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: His eldest son was known as Nabhi. Kimpurusa was his (Nabhi's) younger brother. The third son was Harivar?a. The fourth son was Ilavrta.
verses.hindi: अध्याय ७४ ज्योतिःसन्निवेशवर्णनमें लोकपालोंकी पुरियोंका वर्णन २३३
verses.wordMeaning: His eldest son was known as Nabhi. Kimpurusa was his (Nabhi's) younger brother. The third son was Harivar?a. The fourth son was Ilavrta.
verses.commentary: Sense: His eldest son was known as Nabhi. Kimpurusa was his (Nabhi's) younger brother. The third son was Harivar?a. The fourth son was Ilavrta.

verses.sanskrit: नवमः केतुमालस्तु तेषां देशान्निबोधत नाभेस्तु दक्षिणं वर्षं हेमाख्यं तु पिता ददौ
verses.transliteration: navamaḥ ketumālastu teṣāṃ deśānnibodhata nābhestu dakṣiṇaṃ varṣaṃ hemākhyaṃ tu pitā dadau
verses.translation: Ramya was the fifth; the sixth was Hiramnan. Kuru was the seventh. Bhadrava was the eighth.
verses.hindi: धरापृष्ठाद् द्विजाः क्ष्मायां विद्युदगुणसमन्विता: । द्विजो! पृथ्वीतलसे योजन-मात्रकी दूरीवाले विद्युत् तेषां तेषां वृष्टिसर्ग त्रेधा कथितमत्र तु॥ ५३  युक्त मेघ साध्य होनेके कारण पृथ्वीपर अधिक जल- वृष्टि करनेवाले होते हैं। उन मेघोंका तीन प्रकारका पर्वतोंके कटे हुए पक्षोंसे उत्पन्न मेघ कल्पज होते हैं और वे अति महान् होते हैं। वे कल्पके अन्तमें विनाशके लिये रात्रिमें बरसते हैं। पुष्कर आदि पक्षजनित मेघ जब बरसते हैं, तब सम्पूर्ण जगत् सागरमय हो जाता
verses.wordMeaning: Ramya was the fifth; the sixth was Hiramnan. Kuru was the seventh. Bhadrava was the eighth.
verses.commentary: Sense: Ramya was the fifth; the sixth was Hiramnan. Kuru was the seventh. Bhadrava was the eighth.

verses.sanskrit: हेमकूटं तु यद्वर्षं ददौ किंपुरुषाय सः नैषधं यत्स्मृतं वर्षं हरये तत्पिता ददौ
verses.transliteration: hemakūṭaṃ tu yadvarṣaṃ dadau kiṃpuruṣāya saḥ naiṣadhaṃ yatsmṛtaṃ varṣaṃ haraye tatpitā dadau
verses.translation: The ninth was Ketumala. Understand their lands now. The subcontinent of Nabhi inherited from his father is called Hema which lies in the south.
verses.hindi: है और उसमें भगवान् रातमें शयन करते हैं। है श्रेष्ठ ब्राह्मणो! अग्निसे उत्पन्न, ब्रह्माके श्वाससे उत्पन्न तथा कटे हुए पर्वतोंके पक्षसे उत्पन्न मेघोंका धूम सदा आप्यायन कहा गया है ॥ ५४--५६॥
verses.wordMeaning: The ninth was Ketumala. Understand their lands now. The subcontinent of Nabhi inherited from his father is called Hema which lies in the south.
verses.commentary: Sense: The ninth was Ketumala. Understand their lands now. The subcontinent of Nabhi inherited from his father is called Hema which lies in the south.

verses.sanskrit: इलावृताय प्रददौ मेरुर्यत्र तु मध्यमः नीलाचलाश्रितं वर्षं रम्याय प्रददौ पिता
verses.transliteration: ilāvṛtāya pradadau meruryatra tu madhyamaḥ nīlācalāśritaṃ varṣaṃ ramyāya pradadau pitā
verses.translation: He gave Kimpurusa the subcontinent Hemakuta. He gave the subcontinent called Naisadha to Hari.
verses.hindi: समस्त पौण्ड़ (पुण्ड् देशमें होनेवाली) वृष्टि विद्युन्मय, शीतल तथा अन्न प्रदान करनेवाली होती है । पुण्डू देशके मेघ बर्फके समान शीतल होते हैं और वे हाथीके सूँड्से गिरते हुए जलके छिड़कावकी भाँति प्रतीत होते हैं। गांग नामक मेघ गंगाके जलसे उत्पन्न होते हैं। ये परावहसंज्ञक वायुद्वारा पर्वतों, नदियों और दिग्गजोंको व्याकुल कर देते हैं । मेघोंसे अलग हुआ जल एक पर्वतसे दूसरे पर्वतपर पहुँचता है। परावह नामक जो वायु है,
verses.wordMeaning: He gave Kimpurusa the subcontinent Hemakuta. He gave the subcontinent called Naisadha to Hari.
verses.commentary: Sense: He gave Kimpurusa the subcontinent Hemakuta. He gave the subcontinent called Naisadha to Hari.

verses.sanskrit: श्वेतं यदुत्तरं तस्मात् पित्रा दत्तं हिरण्मते यदुत्तरं शृङ्गवर्षं पिता तत्कुरवे ददौ
verses.transliteration: śvetaṃ yaduttaraṃ tasmāt pitrā dattaṃ hiraṇmate yaduttaraṃ śṛṅgavarṣaṃ pitā tatkurave dadau
verses.translation: To Ilavrta he gave the midlands encircling the moun- tain Meru. He gave Ramya the subcontinent around Nllacala.
verses.hindi: वह मेघोंको हिमालय (अम्बिकागुरु) पर्वतकी ओर ले जाती है । है द्विजो ! पुनः मेनापति हिमालयसे आगे बढ़कर ये मेघ समुद्रके मध्य देशोंकी वृद्धिके लिये भारतवर्षमें भारी वर्षा करते हैं ॥ ५७--६०॥
verses.wordMeaning: To Ilavrta he gave the midlands encircling the moun- tain Meru. He gave Ramya the subcontinent around Nllacala.
verses.commentary: Sense: To Ilavrta he gave the midlands encircling the moun- tain Meru. He gave Ramya the subcontinent around Nllacala.

verses.sanskrit: वर्षं माल्यवतं चापि भद्राश्वस्य न्यवेदयत् गन्धमादनवर्षं तु केतुमालाय दत्तवान्
verses.transliteration: varṣaṃ mālyavataṃ cāpi bhadrāśvasya nyavedayat gandhamādanavarṣaṃ tu ketumālāya dattavān
verses.translation: The subcontinent Sveta to the north of it was given to Hiranman. He gave Kuru the subcontinent Smga Var?a which is to the north of it.
verses.hindi: वस्तुओंकी वृद्धिके लिये होनेवाली वृष्टियाँ दो प्रकारकी कही गयी हैं। मैं बुद्धिके अनुसार उन दोनोंका संक्षेपमें वर्णन करता हूँ। संसारके नेत्रस्वरूप महातेजस्वी भगवान् सूर्य वृष्टियोंका सृजन करनेवाले हैं। हे द्विजश्रेष्ठो! वे भी साक्षात् ईशान परमेश्वर शिव ही लि
verses.wordMeaning: The subcontinent Sveta to the north of it was given to Hiranman. He gave Kuru the subcontinent Smga Var?a which is to the north of it.
verses.commentary: Sense: The subcontinent Sveta to the north of it was given to Hiranman. He gave Kuru the subcontinent Smga Var?a which is to the north of it.

verses.sanskrit: इत्येतानि महान्तीह नव वर्षाणि भागशः आग्नीध्रस्तेषु वर्षेषु पुत्रांस्तानभिषिच्य वै
verses.transliteration: ityetāni mahāntīha nava varṣāṇi bhāgaśaḥ āgnīdhrasteṣu varṣeṣu putrāṃstānabhiṣicya vai
verses.translation: He gave the subcontinent round about Malyavan to Bhadrava. He gave Gandhamadana to Ketumala.
verses.hindi: मृत्यु, आत्मा, मन्यु (क्रोध), दिशाएँ और विदिशाएँ हैं । वे ही सत्य, ऋत, वायु, आकाश, ग्रह, लोकपाल, विष्णु, ब्रह्मा, रुद्र तथा साक्षात् महेश्वर हैं । वे हजार किरणोंवाले, श्रीमान, आठ भुजाओंवाले, परम कल्याणकारी, अर्धनारीश्वर,
verses.wordMeaning: He gave the subcontinent round about Malyavan to Bhadrava. He gave Gandhamadana to Ketumala.
verses.commentary: Sense: He gave the subcontinent round about Malyavan to Bhadrava. He gave Gandhamadana to Ketumala.

verses.sanskrit: यथाक्रमं स धर्मात्मा ततस्तु तपसि स्थितः तपसा भावितश्चैव स्वाध्यायनिरतस्त्वभूत्
verses.transliteration: yathākramaṃ sa dharmātmā tatastu tapasi sthitaḥ tapasā bhāvitaścaiva svādhyāyaniratastvabhūt
verses.translation: These are the nine great subcontinents in brief. After crowning his sons as the kings in those subcontinents, Agmdhra*®® the virtuous became engaged in penance. After purifying himself by penance he became engaged in the study of the Vedas.
verses.hindi: तीन नेत्रोंवाले तथा देवताओंके अधिपति हैं पक्षजाः पुष्कराद्याश्च वर्षन्ति च यदा जलम्।
verses.wordMeaning: These are the nine great subcontinents in brief. After crowning his sons as the kings in those subcontinents, Agmdhra*®® the virtuous became engaged in penance. After purifying himself by penance he became engaged in the study of the Vedas.
verses.commentary: Sense: These are the nine great subcontinents in brief. After crowning his sons as the kings in those subcontinents, Agmdhra*®® the virtuous became engaged in penance. After purifying himself by penance he became engaged in the study of the Vedas.

verses.sanskrit: स्वाध्यायनिरतः पश्चाच् छिवध्यानरतस् त्वभूत् यानि किंपुरुषाद्यानि वर्षाण्यष्टौ शुभानि च
verses.transliteration: svādhyāyanirataḥ paścāc chivadhyānaratas tvabhūt yāni kiṃpuruṣādyāni varṣāṇyaṣṭau śubhāni ca
verses.translation: After being engaged in the study of the Vedas he became engaged in meditation on Siva. There is natural per- fection in all the eight excellent subcontinents beginning with Kimpurusa. Without any strain the subjects are always happy. The opposite of joy is not seen in them. They have no fear from death or old age. They have neither Dharma nor Adharma. There is no distinction such as the excellent, the middling and the base. In all these eight subcontinents there are no subdivi- sions of yugas.
verses.hindi: पुण्डूदेशेषु पतिता नागानां शीकरा हिमाः
verses.wordMeaning: After being engaged in the study of the Vedas he became engaged in meditation on Siva. There is natural per- fection in all the eight excellent subcontinents beginning with Kimpurusa. Without any strain the subjects are always happy. The opposite of joy is not seen in them.…
verses.commentary: Sense: After being engaged in the study of the Vedas he became engaged in meditation on Siva. There is natural per- fection in all the eight excellent subcontinents beginning with Kimpurusa. Without any strain the subjects are always happy. The opposite of joy is not seen in them.…

verses.sanskrit: तेषां स्वभावतः सिद्धिः सुखप्राया ह्ययत्नतः विपर्ययो न तेष्वस्ति जरामृत्युभयं न च
verses.transliteration: teṣāṃ svabhāvataḥ siddhiḥ sukhaprāyā hyayatnataḥ viparyayo na teṣvasti jarāmṛtyubhayaṃ na ca
verses.translation: According to Agnldhra was the eldest ion of Priyavrata. But according to a Viyu venion he was the son of Priyavrata*! daughter.
verses.hindi: गाङ्गा गङ्गाम्बुसम्भूता पर्जन्येन परावहैः । नगानां च नदीनां च दिग्गजानां समाकुलम् परावहो यः श्वसनश्चानयत्यम्बिकागुरुम्
verses.wordMeaning: According to Agnldhra was the eldest ion of Priyavrata. But according to a Viyu venion he was the son of Priyavrata*! daughter.
verses.commentary: Sense: According to Agnldhra was the eldest ion of Priyavrata. But according to a Viyu venion he was the son of Priyavrata*! daughter.

verses.sanskrit: धर्माधर्मौ न तेष्वास्तां नोत्तमाधममध्यमाः न तेष्वस्ति युगावस्था क्षेत्रेष्वष्टसु सर्वतः
verses.transliteration: dharmādharmau na teṣvāstāṃ nottamādhamamadhyamāḥ na teṣvasti yugāvasthā kṣetreṣvaṣṭasu sarvataḥ
verses.translation: Those who die in a holy centre of Rudra whether mobile or immobile whether devotees or casual visitors are reborn there.
verses.hindi: सोऽपि साक्षाद् द्विजश्रेष्ठाश्चेशान: परमः शिव:
verses.wordMeaning: Those who die in a holy centre of Rudra whether mobile or immobile whether devotees or casual visitors are reborn there.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who die in a holy centre of Rudra whether mobile or immobile whether devotees or casual visitors are reborn there.

verses.sanskrit: रुद्रक्षेत्रे मृताश्चैव जङ्गमाः स्थावरास् तथा भक्ताः प्रासंगिकाश्चापि तेषु क्षेत्रेषु यान्ति ते
verses.transliteration: rudrakṣetre mṛtāścaiva jaṅgamāḥ sthāvarās tathā bhaktāḥ prāsaṃgikāścāpi teṣu kṣetreṣu yānti te
verses.translation: For their benefit eight holy centres were created by Rudra. In all those places Mahadeva was always present.
verses.hindi: लोकपालो हरिब्रह्मा रुद्रः साक्षान्महेश्वरः अस्यैवेह प्रसादात्तु वृष्टिनानाभवद् द्विजाः।  है द्विजो! इन्हींकी कृपासे नाना प्रकार ॐ प्रसादात्तु वृष्टिर्नानाभवद् द्विजाः । है द्विजो! इन्हींको कृपासे नाना प्रकारकी वृष्टि होत सहस्त्रगुणमुत्स्रष्टुमादत्ते किरणैर्जलम्॥ ६६  है। ये हजार गुना जल देनेके लिये अपनी किरणो
verses.wordMeaning: For their benefit eight holy centres were created by Rudra. In all those places Mahadeva was always present.
verses.commentary: Sense: For their benefit eight holy centres were created by Rudra. In all those places Mahadeva was always present.

verses.sanskrit: तेषां हिताय रुद्रेण चाष्टक्षेत्रं विनिर्मितम् तत्र तेषां महादेवः सान्निध्यं कुरुते सदा
verses.transliteration: teṣāṃ hitāya rudreṇa cāṣṭakṣetraṃ vinirmitam tatra teṣāṃ mahādevaḥ sānnidhyaṃ kurute sadā
verses.translation: By seeing Mahadeva in their hearts the residents of the eight holy centres were always happy. He alone was the greatest goal unto them all.
verses.hindi: जल ग्रहण करते हैं। विचारपूर्वक देखा जाय तो
verses.wordMeaning: By seeing Mahadeva in their hearts the residents of the eight holy centres were always happy. He alone was the greatest goal unto them all.
verses.commentary: Sense: By seeing Mahadeva in their hearts the residents of the eight holy centres were always happy. He alone was the greatest goal unto them all.

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा हृदि महादेवम् अष्टक्षेत्रनिवासिनः सुखिनः सर्वदा तेषां स एवेह परा गतिः
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvā hṛdi mahādevam aṣṭakṣetranivāsinaḥ sukhinaḥ sarvadā teṣāṃ sa eveha parā gatiḥ
verses.translation: I shall now recount tiic country of Nabhi marked by *hima' (snow; i.c. Bharatavarsa as mentioned below). The intelligent Nabhi begot a son of Merude\d, Rabha by name who was a great king adored by all ksatriyas. A heroic son Bharata was born to Rsabha. He was the eldest among his hundred sons.
verses.hindi: जलस्य नाशो वृद्धिर्वा नास्त्येवास्य विचारत: । जलका नाश अथवा वृद्धि होती ही नहीं। धुवके हार ध्रुवेणाधिष्ठितो वायुर्वृष्टिं संहरते पुन: । ६७  अधिष्ठित वायु वृष्टिका पुन: हरण कर लेती ह तदनन्तर यह सूर्यग्रहसे निकलकर सम्पूर्ण नक्षत्रमण्डलमे ग्रहान्निःसृत्य सूर्यात्तु कृत्स्ने नक्षत्रमण्डले। फैलती है। उसके बाद ध्रुवके द्वारा अधिष्ठित यह चारस्यान्ते विशत्यर्के ध्रुवेण समधिष्ठिता॥ ६८  वृद्धि पुनः सूर्यमें प्रवेश करती है॥६६--६८ ॥
verses.wordMeaning: I shall now recount tiic country of Nabhi marked by *hima' (snow; i.c. Bharatavarsa as mentioned below). The intelligent Nabhi begot a son of Merude\d, Rabha by name who was a great king adored by all ksatriyas. A heroic son Bharata was born to Rsabha.…
verses.commentary: Sense: I shall now recount tiic country of Nabhi marked by *hima' (snow; i.c. Bharatavarsa as mentioned below). The intelligent Nabhi begot a son of Merude\d, Rabha by name who was a great king adored by all ksatriyas. A heroic son Bharata was born to Rsabha.…

verses.sanskrit: नाभेर्निसर्गं वक्ष्यामि हिमाङ्के ऽस्मिन्निबोधत नाभिस्त्वजनयत्पुत्रं मेरुदेव्यां महामतिः
verses.transliteration: nābhernisargaṃ vakṣyāmi himāṅke 'sminnibodhata nābhistvajanayatputraṃ merudevyāṃ mahāmatiḥ
verses.translation: $abha who was fond of his son Bharata crowned him as king. By adopting the path of knowledge and detach- ment he conquered the serpents of his sense-organs; by all means he stabilised Is vara, the supreme Atman, within his own heart; he was immersed in devout feelings; he observed fasts; he wore bark garments and matted hair. He retired into dark- ness (i.e. solitary place). Devoid of all desires and his doubts all cleared, (in the end) he attained the great region of Siva. He gave the subcontinent to the south of the mountain Himavat to Bharata. Hence learned men call that subcontinent as Bharata Vara*®® after his name. Bharata's son was the virtuous Sumati. Bharata entrusted the kingdom to his care. After transferring the royal glory to his son the king entered the forest for penance.
verses.hindi: चौवनवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ
verses.wordMeaning: $abha who was fond of his son Bharata crowned him as king. By adopting the path of knowledge and detach- ment he conquered the serpents of his sense-organs; by all means he stabilised Is vara, the supreme Atman, within his own heart; he was immersed in devout feelings;…
verses.commentary: Sense: $abha who was fond of his son Bharata crowned him as king. By adopting the path of knowledge and detach- ment he conquered the serpents of his sense-organs; by all means he stabilised Is vara, the supreme Atman, within his own heart; he was immersed in devout feelings;…

verses.sanskrit: ऋषभं पार्थिवश्रेष्ठं सर्वक्षत्रस्य पूजितम् ऋषभाद्भरतो जज्ञे वीरः पुत्रशताग्रजः
verses.transliteration: ṛṣabhaṃ pārthivaśreṣṭhaṃ sarvakṣatrasya pūjitam ṛṣabhādbharato jajñe vīraḥ putraśatāgrajaḥ
verses.translation: Bh&rata. LiAga ascribes the origin of the name to King Bharata, the eldest of the hundred sons of B>$abha and grandson of Nftbhi. Of. Vftyu 33. 51-52; Marka 53. 39-40. For detail see Bhaga 11.2. 15- 17 andSk I. ii. 37. 55-57. But according to Matsya 114-5-6, Bharata is the name of Manu himself who creates smd supports the people here. For further detail, see Avasthi: StudUs in SkandapurS, pp, 17-23. Formerly Bh&rata was known as Hima-vars& or Haimavata Varfa.
verses.hindi: शिवस्वरूप भगवान् सूर्यके रथ तथा चेत्रादि बारह मासोंमें रथके साथ भ्रमण करनेवाले देवता, मुनि, नाग, गन्धर्व आदिका वर्णन सूत उवाच सूतजी बोले-हे ऋषियो! मैं संक्षेपमे सूर्यके सौरं सङ्क्षेपतो वक्ष्ये रथं शशिन एव च। रथ और चन्द्रमा तथा अन्य ग्रहोंके विषयमें बताऊँगा ग्रहाणामितरेषां च यथा गच्छति ल पकार जलका शोषण करनेवाले सूर्य गति करते हैं, उसका भी वर्णन करूँगा

verses.sanskrit: सो ऽभिषिच्याथ ऋषभो भरतं पुत्रवत्सलः ज्ञानवैराग्यमाश्रित्य जित्वेन्द्रियमहोरगान्
verses.transliteration: so 'bhiṣicyātha ṛṣabho bharataṃ putravatsalaḥ jñānavairāgyamāśritya jitvendriyamahoragān
verses.translation: Bh&rata. LiAga ascribes the origin of the name to King Bharata, the eldest of the hundred sons of B>$abha and grandson of Nftbhi. Of. Vftyu 33. 51-52; Marka 53. 39-40. For detail see Bhaga 11.2. 15- 17 andSk I. ii. 37. 55-57. But according to Matsya 114-5-6, Bharata is the name of Manu himself who creates smd supports the people here. For further detail, see Avasthi: StudUs in SkandapurS, pp, 17-23. Formerly Bh&rata was known as Hima-vars& or Haimavata Varfa.
verses.hindi: हे श्रेष्ठ द्विजो! ब्रह्माके द्वारा विशेष प्रयोजनके लिये निर्मित वह सूर्यरथ संवत्सरके अवयवोंसे कल्पित किया गया है। तीन नाभि तथा पाँच अरोंवाले चक्रसे

verses.transliteration: sarvātmanātmani sthāpya paramātmānamīśvaram nagno jaṭī nirāhāraś cīrī dhvāntagato hi saḥ
verses.translation: Bh&rata. LiAga ascribes the origin of the name to King Bharata, the eldest of the hundred sons of B>$abha and grandson of Nftbhi. Of. Vftyu 33. 51-52; Marka 53. 39-40. For detail see Bhaga 11.2. 15- 17 andSk I. ii. 37. 55-57. But according to Matsya 114-5-6, Bharata is the name of Manu himself who creates smd supports the people here. For further detail, see Avasthi: StudUs in SkandapurS, pp, 17-23. Formerly Bh&rata was known as Hima-vars& or Haimavata Varfa.
verses.hindi: त्रिणाभिना तु चक्रेण पञ्चारेण समन्वित: । युक्त यह सूर्यरथ सुवर्णमय है और सभी देवताओंका सौवर्णः सर्वदेवानामावासो भास्करस्य तु॥ ३  निवासस्थान है। यह लम्बाई तथा चौड़ाईमें नौ हजार कहा गया है। इसका ईषादण्ड प्रमाण नवयोजनसाहस्त्रो विस्तारायामतः स्मृतः। (माष)-में रथोपस्थसे दुगुना है। जहाँ चक्र है, वहाँ द्विगुणोऽपि रथोपस्थादीषादण्डः प्रमाणतः ॥ ४ स्थित अन्तरिक्षगामी घोड़ोंसे वह युक्त (जुता हुआ) है। उसके सातौं घोड़े वेदके सात छन्दो गायत्री, बृहती,

verses.transliteration: nirāśastyaktasaṃdehaḥ śaivamāpa paraṃ padam himādrerdakṣiṇaṃ varṣaṃ bharatāya nyavedayat

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात्तु भारतं वर्षं तस्य नाम्ना विदुर्बुधाः भरतस्यात्मजो विद्वान् सुमतिर्नाम धार्मिकः
verses.transliteration: tasmāttu bhārataṃ varṣaṃ tasya nāmnā vidurbudhāḥ bharatasyātmajo vidvān sumatirnāma dhārmikaḥ

verses.hindi: सौरस्तु ब्रह्मणा सृष्टो रथस्त्वर्थवशेन सः। चक्रपक्षे निबद्धास्तु ध्रुवे चाक्षः समर्षितः।  चक्रसहित घूमता है और ध्रुव अक्षके साथ सहाश्वचक्रो भ्रमते सहाक्षो भ्रमते श्रुवः ॥ ६  घूमता है॥ २--६॥

verses.transliteration: babhūva tasmiṃstadrājyaṃ bharataḥ saṃnyaveśayat putrasaṃkrāmitaśrīko vanaṃ rājā viveśa saḥ

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीलिङ्गमहापुराणे पूर्वभागे भरतवर्षकथनं नाम सप्तचत्वारिंशो ऽध्यायः अस्य द्वीपस्य मध्ये तु मेरुर् नाम महागिरिः नानारत्नमयैः शृङ्गैः स्थितः स्थितिमतां वरः
verses.transliteration: iti śrīliṅgamahāpurāṇe pūrvabhāge bharatavarṣakathanaṃ nāma saptacatvāriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ asya dvīpasya madhye tu merur nāma mahāgiriḥ nānāratnamayaiḥ śṛṅgaiḥ sthitaḥ sthitimatāṃ varaḥ
verses.translation: In the middle of this Jambu Dvipa is the great moun- tain Meru*®®- It is the most excellent among the mountains, having many peaks full of jewels.
verses.hindi: अक्षः सहैकचक्रेण भ्रमतेऽसौ श्रुवेरितः। वह अक्ष धुवसे प्रेरित होकर एक ही चक्रके साथ प्रेरको ज्योतिषां धीमान् ध्रुवो वै वातरश्मिभिः॥ ७ है। बुद्धिमान् ध्रुव वायुकिरणोंके द्वारा ज्योतिर्गणों युगाक्षकोटिसम्बद्धौ वौ रश्मी स्यन्दनस्य तु। (ग्रह, कषतर आदि)-को प्रेरित करता है। दो रश्मियाँ रवेण भ्रमते रश्मिनिबद्धः स युगाक्षयोः॥ ८ (किरणें) रथके जुए तथा अक्षके अग्रभागमें बँधी हुई हैं और उन जुए तथा अक्षमें रश्मियोंसे निबद्ध वह सूर्यरथ ध्रुवके द्वारा भ्रमण करता है
verses.wordMeaning: In the middle of this Jambu Dvipa is the great moun- tain Meru*®®- It is the most excellent among the mountains, having many peaks full of jewels.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the middle of this Jambu Dvipa is the great moun- tain Meru*®®- It is the most excellent among the mountains, having many peaks full of jewels.

verses.sanskrit: चतुरशीतिसाहस्रम् उत्सेधेन प्रकीर्तितः प्रविष्टः षोडशाधस्ताद् विस्तृतः षोडशैव तु
verses.transliteration: caturaśītisāhasram utsedhena prakīrtitaḥ praviṣṭaḥ ṣoḍaśādhastād vistṛtaḥ ṣoḍaśaiva tu
verses.translation: It is reputed to be eightyfour thousand yojanas in height. It has entered sixteen thousand yojanas beneath the ground and it extends to sixteen thousand yojanas.
verses.hindi: इस प्रकार भ्रमण करते हुए आकाशमें विचरण करनेवाले रथके अनेक मण्डल होते हैं । वे  रश्मिनिबद्ध  जुए तथा अक्षकी कोटियाँ उस रथके दाहिनी ओर होती हैं । रज्जुओंके द्वारा ध्रुवसे प्रगृहीत अरुण, चक्र तथा घोड़े
verses.wordMeaning: It is reputed to be eightyfour thousand yojanas in height. It has entered sixteen thousand yojanas beneath the ground and it extends to sixteen thousand yojanas.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is reputed to be eightyfour thousand yojanas in height. It has entered sixteen thousand yojanas beneath the ground and it extends to sixteen thousand yojanas.

verses.sanskrit: शराववत् संस्थितत्वाद् द्वात्रिंशन्मूर्ध्नि विस्तृतः विस्तारात् त्रिगुणश् चास्य परिणाहो ऽनुमण्डलः
verses.transliteration: śarāvavat saṃsthitatvād dvātriṃśanmūrdhni vistṛtaḥ vistārāt triguṇaś cāsya pariṇāho 'numaṇḍalaḥ
verses.translation: Since it is stationed like a shallow plate the extent on the top is thirty-two thousand yojanas. Three times its width is its girth at the ridges.
verses.hindi: और वे दोनों रश्मियाँ घूमते हुए ध्रुवका अनुगमन करते हैं इस रथकी वायुलहरीरूपा युगाक्षकोटि (जुए तथा अक्षकी कोटि) कीलमें बँधी हुई रस्सीकी भाँति सभी दिशाओंमें घूमती है । उत्तरायणमें मण्डलोंमें घूमते हुए उस सूर्यकी दोनों रश्मियाँ बढ़ जाती हैं और दक्षिणायनमें
verses.wordMeaning: Since it is stationed like a shallow plate the extent on the top is thirty-two thousand yojanas. Three times its width is its girth at the ridges.
verses.commentary: Sense: Since it is stationed like a shallow plate the extent on the top is thirty-two thousand yojanas. Three times its width is its girth at the ridges.

verses.sanskrit: हैमीकृतो महेशस्य शुभाङ्गस्पर्शनेन च धत्तूरपुष्पसंकाशः सर्वदेवनिकेतनः
verses.transliteration: haimīkṛto maheśasya śubhāṅgasparśanena ca dhattūrapuṣpasaṃkāśaḥ sarvadevaniketanaḥ
verses.translation: It is rendered golden due to the auspicious contact with the body of Mahesa. It resembles the flower of the Dhattura plant (thorn apple). It is the abode of all Devas.
verses.hindi: मण्डलोंमें घूमते हुए सूर्यके द्वारा वे रश्मियाँ खिंच जाती हैं  जब वे रश्मियाँ ध्रुवके द्वारा प्रेरित की जाती हैं, तब रथके भीतर स्थित सूर्य मण्डलोंमें घूमता है। उस समय सूर्य दोनों दिशाओंके एक सौ अस्सी मण्डलोंका चक्कर
verses.wordMeaning: It is rendered golden due to the auspicious contact with the body of Mahesa. It resembles the flower of the Dhattura plant (thorn apple). It is the abode of all Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is rendered golden due to the auspicious contact with the body of Mahesa. It resembles the flower of the Dhattura plant (thorn apple). It is the abode of all Devas.

verses.sanskrit: क्रीडाभूमिश् च देवानाम् अनेकाश्चर्यसंयुतः लक्षयोजन आयामस् तस्यैवं तु महागिरेः
verses.transliteration: krīḍābhūmiś ca devānām anekāścaryasaṃyutaḥ lakṣayojana āyāmas tasyaivaṃ tu mahāgireḥ
verses.translation: It is the sporting ground for Devas. It is full of miracles. The toCal width and extent of this mountain is a hundred thousand yojanas.
verses.hindi: लगाता है॥ ११--१३ /२॥ पुनः ध्रुवके द्वारा किरणोंके छोडे जानेपर उसी भाँति सूर्य मण्डलोंके बाहर भ्रमण करता है; वह मण्डलोंको घेरते हुए वेगपूर्वक चलता है
verses.wordMeaning: It is the sporting ground for Devas. It is full of miracles. The toCal width and extent of this mountain is a hundred thousand yojanas.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is the sporting ground for Devas. It is full of miracles. The toCal width and extent of this mountain is a hundred thousand yojanas.

verses.sanskrit: ततः षोडशसाहस्रं योजनानि क्षितेरधः शेषं चोपरि विप्रेन्द्रा धरायास्तस्य शृङ्गिणः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ ṣoḍaśasāhasraṃ yojanāni kṣiteradhaḥ śeṣaṃ copari viprendrā dharāyāstasya śṛṅgiṇaḥ
verses.translation: O leading brahmins, beneath the earth its extent is sixteen thousand yojanas. The remaining part of that moun- tain is above the earth. The extent at the root is thus sixteen thousand yojanas and the extent above, they say, is twice the extent at the root.
verses.hindi: ईश्वर सूर्यदेवका निरन्तर पूजन करते हैं। वह रथ
verses.wordMeaning: O leading brahmins, beneath the earth its extent is sixteen thousand yojanas. The remaining part of that moun- tain is above the earth. The extent at the root is thus sixteen thousand yojanas and the extent above, they say, is twice the extent at the root.
verses.commentary: Sense: O leading brahmins, beneath the earth its extent is sixteen thousand yojanas. The remaining part of that moun- tain is above the earth. The extent at the root is thus sixteen thousand yojanas and the extent above, they say, is twice the extent at the root.

verses.sanskrit: मूलायामप्रमाणं तु विस्तारान् मूलतो गिरेः ऊचुर्विस्तारमस्यैव द्विगुणं मूलतो गिरेः
verses.transliteration: mūlāyāmapramāṇaṃ tu vistārān mūlato gireḥ ūcurvistāramasyaiva dviguṇaṃ mūlato gireḥ
verses.translation: In the cast it has the lustre of the ruby; in the south it resembles gold; in the west it shines like the blue stone and in the north it has the coral lustre.
verses.hindi: ग्रामणियों, सर्पो तथा राक्षसोंके द्वारा अधिष्ठित है। ये लोग सूर्यमें दो-दो महीने क्रमसे निवास करते हैं और कल्याणकारी आदित्य भास्करको अपने तेजोंसे तृप्त करते हैं मुनिगण अपने वचनोंसे ग्रथित स्तुतियोंके द्वारा सूर्यका स्तवन करते हैं; गन्धर्व तथा अप्सराएँ गान एवं नृत्यके द्वारा उनकी उपासना करते हैं; ग्रामणी, यक्ष तथा भूतगण किरणोंका संग्रह करते हैं; सर्पगण सूर्यका वहन
verses.wordMeaning: In the cast it has the lustre of the ruby; in the south it resembles gold; in the west it shines like the blue stone and in the north it has the coral lustre.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the cast it has the lustre of the ruby; in the south it resembles gold; in the west it shines like the blue stone and in the north it has the coral lustre.

verses.sanskrit: पूर्वतः पद्मरागाभो दक्षिणे हेमसन्निभः पश्चिमे नीलसंकाश उत्तरे विद्रुमप्रभः
verses.transliteration: pūrvataḥ padmarāgābho dakṣiṇe hemasannibhaḥ paścime nīlasaṃkāśa uttare vidrumaprabhaḥ
verses.translation: In the eastern side of this mountain is Amaravati (the city of Indra). It is full of mansions of different kinds. It is thronged by different groups of Devas. It is surrounded by clusters of jewels.
verses.hindi: युगाक्षकोटी ते तस्य दक्षिणे स्यन्दनस्य हि
verses.wordMeaning: In the eastern side of this mountain is Amaravati (the city of Indra). It is full of mansions of different kinds. It is thronged by different groups of Devas. It is surrounded by clusters of jewels.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the eastern side of this mountain is Amaravati (the city of Indra). It is full of mansions of different kinds. It is thronged by different groups of Devas. It is surrounded by clusters of jewels.

verses.sanskrit: अमरावती पूर्वभागे नानाप्रासादसंकुला नानादेवगणैः कीर्णा मणिजालसमावृता
verses.transliteration: amarāvatī pūrvabhāge nānāprāsādasaṃkulā nānādevagaṇaiḥ kīrṇā maṇijālasamāvṛtā
verses.translation: It has many ornamental gateways of different shapes bedecked in gold and jewels. The arches at the gateways are rendered wonderful with gol'd, with jewels set in. Thousands of women throng the roadways. They aie clever in conversation and elocution. They are bedecked in all ornaments. They stoop down due to the weight of their heavy breasts and their eyes
verses.hindi: युगाक्षकोटिस्त्वेतस्य वातोर्मिस्यन्दनस्य तु। कीले सक्ता यथा रज्जुर्श्रमते सर्वतोदिशम् अशीतिमण्डलशतं काष्ठयोरन्तरं द्वयोः। ध्रुवेण मुच्यमानाभ्यां रश्मिभ्यां पुनरेव तु
verses.wordMeaning: It has many ornamental gateways of different shapes bedecked in gold and jewels. The arches at the gateways are rendered wonderful with gol'd, with jewels set in. Thousands of women throng the roadways. They aie clever in conversation and elocution.…
verses.commentary: Sense: It has many ornamental gateways of different shapes bedecked in gold and jewels. The arches at the gateways are rendered wonderful with gol'd, with jewels set in. Thousands of women throng the roadways. They aie clever in conversation and elocution.…

verses.sanskrit: गोपुरैर्विविधाकारैर् हेमरत्नविभूषितैः तोरणैर् हेमचित्रैस्तु मणिकॢप्तैः पथि स्थितैः
verses.transliteration: gopurairvividhākārair hemaratnavibhūṣitaiḥ toraṇair hemacitraistu maṇikḷptaiḥ pathi sthitaiḥ
verses.hindi: देवाश्चैव तथा नित्यं मुनयश्च दिवानिशम्। यजन्ति सततं देवं भास्करं भवमीश्वरम्

verses.sanskrit: संलापालापकुशलैः सर्वाभरणभूषितैः स्तनभारविनम्रैश् च मदघूर्णितलोचनैः
verses.transliteration: saṃlāpālāpakuśalaiḥ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitaiḥ stanabhāravinamraiś ca madaghūrṇitalocanaiḥ
verses.translation: In the south-eastern side of the mountain is Tejasv- ini the city of the fire god. It is divine and similar to Amara- vati. It is endowed with all means of pleasures.
verses.hindi: स रथोऽधिष्ठितो देवैरादित्यैर्मुनिभिस्तथा। गन्धर्वैरप्सरोभिश्च ग्रामणीसर्पराक्षसैः आप्याययन्ति चादित्यं तेजोभिर्भास्करं शिवम्
verses.wordMeaning: In the south-eastern side of the mountain is Tejasv- ini the city of the fire god. It is divine and similar to Amara- vati. It is endowed with all means of pleasures.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the south-eastern side of the mountain is Tejasv- ini the city of the fire god. It is divine and similar to Amara- vati. It is endowed with all means of pleasures.

verses.sanskrit: स्त्रीसहस्रैः समाकीर्णा चाप्सरोभिः समन्ततः दीर्घिकाभिर्विचित्राभिः फुल्लाम्भोरुहसंकुलैः
verses.transliteration: strīsahasraiḥ samākīrṇā cāpsarobhiḥ samantataḥ dīrghikābhirvicitrābhiḥ phullāmbhoruhasaṃkulaiḥ
verses.translation: O sages, most excellent among those who have self- control, in the southern side of the mountain is the city of Yama Vaivasvata. It is full of many divine abodes built in gold and very splendid.
verses.hindi: सर्पा वहन्ति वै सूर्य यातुधानानुयान्ति च
verses.wordMeaning: O sages, most excellent among those who have self- control, in the southern side of the mountain is the city of Yama Vaivasvata. It is full of many divine abodes built in gold and very splendid.
verses.commentary: Sense: O sages, most excellent among those who have self- control, in the southern side of the mountain is the city of Yama Vaivasvata. It is full of many divine abodes built in gold and very splendid.

verses.sanskrit: हेमसोपानसंयुक्तैर् हेमसैकतराशिभिः नीलोत्पलैश्चोत्पलैश् च हैमैश्चापि सुगन्धिभिः
verses.transliteration: hemasopānasaṃyuktair hemasaikatarāśibhiḥ nīlotpalaiścotpalaiś ca haimaiścāpi sugandhibhiḥ
verses.translation: In the south-west is the splendid dark-colourcd city Suddhavati.2® Similarly in the north-west is the splendid cuy Gandhavati. The city in the north is Mahodaya and that in the north-east is Yasovati. Thus cities in all the quarters always shine.
verses.hindi: इत्येते वै वसन्तीह द्वौ द्वौ मासौ दिवाकरे त्वष्टा विष्णु: पुलस्त्यश्च पुलहश्चात्रिरेव च। वसिष्ठश्चाङ्गिराश्चैव भृगुर्बुद्धिमतां वरः
verses.wordMeaning: In the south-west is the splendid dark-colourcd city Suddhavati.2® Similarly in the north-west is the splendid cuy Gandhavati. The city in the north is Mahodaya and that in the north-east is Yasovati. Thus cities in all the quarters always shine.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the south-west is the splendid dark-colourcd city Suddhavati.2® Similarly in the north-west is the splendid cuy Gandhavati. The city in the north is Mahodaya and that in the north-east is Yasovati. Thus cities in all the quarters always shine.

verses.sanskrit: एवंविधैस्तटाकैश् च नदीभिश् च नदैर्युता विराजते पुरी शुभ्रा तयासौ पर्वतः शुभः
verses.transliteration: evaṃvidhaistaṭākaiś ca nadībhiś ca nadairyutā virājate purī śubhrā tayāsau parvataḥ śubhaḥ
verses.translation: There are the abodes of Brahma, Visnu and Maheia as well as of others on it. Thus the mountain endowed with all means of pleasures and containing many lakes, is the most excellent among the mountains.
verses.hindi: जमदग्निः कौशिकश्च वासुकिः कङ्कणीकरः
verses.wordMeaning: There are the abodes of Brahma, Visnu and Maheia as well as of others on it. Thus the mountain endowed with all means of pleasures and containing many lakes, is the most excellent among the mountains.
verses.commentary: Sense: There are the abodes of Brahma, Visnu and Maheia as well as of others on it. Thus the mountain endowed with all means of pleasures and containing many lakes, is the most excellent among the mountains.

verses.sanskrit: तेजस्विनी नाम पुरी आग्नेय्यां पावकस्य तु अमरावतीसमा दिव्या सर्वभोगसमन्विता
verses.transliteration: tejasvinī nāma purī āgneyyāṃ pāvakasya tu amarāvatīsamā divyā sarvabhogasamanvitā
verses.translation: It is full of Siddhas, Yaksas, Gandharvas, sages and the four kinds of living beings.
verses.hindi: धनञ्जयो महापद्मस्तथा ककोंटकः स्मृतः। कम्बलोऽश्वतरश्चैव तुम्बुरुर्नारदस्तथा हाहा हूहू्मुनिश्रेष्ठा विश्वावसुरनुत्तम: । उग्रसेनोऽथ सुरुचिरन्यश्चैव परावसुः
verses.wordMeaning: It is full of Siddhas, Yaksas, Gandharvas, sages and the four kinds of living beings.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is full of Siddhas, Yaksas, Gandharvas, sages and the four kinds of living beings.

verses.sanskrit: वैवस्वती दक्षिणे तु यमस्य यमिनां वराः भवनैरावृता दिव्यैर् जांबूनदमयैः शुभैः
verses.transliteration: vaivasvatī dakṣiṇe tu yamasya yamināṃ varāḥ bhavanairāvṛtā divyair jāṃbūnadamayaiḥ śubhaiḥ
verses.translation: O leading brahmins, on the mountain towaids the left, stands a palace of seven storeys that is as clear as pure crystal. It is as extensive as though it has a thousand landing grounds. There stays lord Siva of great arms, whose eyes are the sun, moon and fire. He is seated in a gemset throne along with the goddess and the six-faced deity Karltikeya.
verses.hindi: चित्रसेनो महातेजाश्चोर्णायुश्चैव सुत्रता: । धृतराष्ट्र: सूर्यवर्चा देवी साक्षात्कृतस्थला
verses.wordMeaning: O leading brahmins, on the mountain towaids the left, stands a palace of seven storeys that is as clear as pure crystal. It is as extensive as though it has a thousand landing grounds. There stays lord Siva of great arms, whose eyes are the sun, moon and fire.…
verses.commentary: Sense: O leading brahmins, on the mountain towaids the left, stands a palace of seven storeys that is as clear as pure crystal. It is as extensive as though it has a thousand landing grounds. There stays lord Siva of great arms, whose eyes are the sun, moon and fire.…

verses.sanskrit: नैरृते कृष्णवर्णा च तथा शुद्धवती शुभा तादृशी गन्धवन्ती च वायव्यां दिशि शोभना
verses.transliteration: nairṛte kṛṣṇavarṇā ca tathā śuddhavatī śubhā tādṛśī gandhavantī ca vāyavyāṃ diśi śobhanā
verses.translation: The palace of Visnu is also there. It extends to half of that of lord Siva and he (Visnu) stays there. In the south is the divine palace of the lotus-born deity Brahma. It is full of rubies. There is the city of Indra which is very large. There is the beautiful city of Yama. There are the cities of
verses.hindi: मेनका सहजन्या च प्रम्लोचाथ शुचिस्मिता पूर्वचित्तिरिति ख्याता देवी साक्षात्तिलोत्तमा
verses.wordMeaning: The palace of Visnu is also there. It extends to half of that of lord Siva and he (Visnu) stays there. In the south is the divine palace of the lotus-born deity Brahma. It is full of rubies. There is the city of Indra which is very large. There is the beautiful city of Yama.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The palace of Visnu is also there. It extends to half of that of lord Siva and he (Visnu) stays there. In the south is the divine palace of the lotus-born deity Brahma. It is full of rubies. There is the city of Indra which is very large. There is the beautiful city of Yama.…

verses.sanskrit: महोदया चोत्तरे च ऐशान्यां तु यशोवती पर्वतस्य दिगन्तेषु शोभते दिवि सर्वदा
verses.transliteration: mahodayā cottare ca aiśānyāṃ tu yaśovatī parvatasya diganteṣu śobhate divi sarvadā
verses.translation: Since no city in the west is mentioned, Kj-snavarna and Sud- dhavati in the first half of V-17 may also mean two cities, i.e. Krsnavarna in the south-east and Suddhavati in the west.
verses.hindi: वरुणश्च तथैवान्यः सुषेणः सेनजिच्छुभः। ताक्ष्यश्चारिष्टनेमिश्च क्षतजित्सत्यजित्तथा
verses.wordMeaning: Since no city in the west is mentioned, Kj-snavarna and Sud- dhavati in the first half of V-17 may also mean two cities, i.e. Krsnavarna in the south-east and Suddhavati in the west.
verses.commentary: Sense: Since no city in the west is mentioned, Kj-snavarna and Sud- dhavati in the first half of V-17 may also mean two cities, i.e. Krsnavarna in the south-east and Suddhavati in the west.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मविष्णुमहेशानां तथान्येषां निकेतनम् सर्वभोगयुतं पुण्यं दीर्घिकाभिर्नगोत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: brahmaviṣṇumaheśānāṃ tathānyeṣāṃ niketanam sarvabhogayutaṃ puṇyaṃ dīrghikābhirnagottamam
verses.translation: Some part of it, is the ground for the practice of yoga. In some places are the grounds for enjoyment of plea- sures. There is a splendid palace with seven storeys resem- bling the rising sun.
verses.hindi: सपों व्याघ्रः पुनश्चापो वातो विद्युद्विवाकरः ब्रह्मोपेतश्च रक्षेनद्रो यज्ञोपेतस्तथैव च। एते देवादयः सर्वे वसन्त्यर्के क्रमेण तु
verses.wordMeaning: Some part of it, is the ground for the practice of yoga. In some places are the grounds for enjoyment of plea- sures. There is a splendid palace with seven storeys resem- bling the rising sun.
verses.commentary: Sense: Some part of it, is the ground for the practice of yoga. In some places are the grounds for enjoyment of plea- sures. There is a splendid palace with seven storeys resem- bling the rising sun.

verses.sanskrit: सिद्धैर्यक्षैस्तु सम्पूर्णं गन्धर्वैर्मुनिपुङ्गवैः तथान्यैर्विविधाकारैर् भूतसंघैश् चतुर्विधैः
verses.transliteration: siddhairyakṣaistu sampūrṇaṃ gandharvairmunipuṅgavaiḥ tathānyairvividhākārair bhūtasaṃghaiś caturvidhaiḥ
verses.translation: It is the splendid palace of Nandi and the chieftain of the Ganas is seated there in the midst of six-faced deity, Ganea, thousands of Ganas, Suyasa of beautiful eyes, the mothers and Madana. The river Jambu**® flows round the base of this mountain.
verses.hindi: स्थानाभिमानिनो ह्येते गणा द्वादश सप्तकाः। धात्रादिविष्णुपर्यन्ता देवा द्वादश कीर्तिताः
verses.wordMeaning: It is the splendid palace of Nandi and the chieftain of the Ganas is seated there in the midst of six-faced deity, Ganea, thousands of Ganas, Suyasa of beautiful eyes, the mothers and Madana. The river Jambu**® flows round the base of this mountain.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is the splendid palace of Nandi and the chieftain of the Ganas is seated there in the midst of six-faced deity, Ganea, thousands of Ganas, Suyasa of beautiful eyes, the mothers and Madana. The river Jambu**® flows round the base of this mountain.

verses.sanskrit: गिरेरुपरि विप्रेन्द्राः शुद्धस्फटिकसन्निभम् सहस्रभौमं विस्तीर्णं विमानं वामतः स्थितम्
verses.transliteration: girerupari viprendrāḥ śuddhasphaṭikasannibham sahasrabhaumaṃ vistīrṇaṃ vimānaṃ vāmataḥ sthitam
verses.translation: Jambu: According to Marka, (55. 28-30) this river springs from the juice of the fruits which the Jambu tree produces on the Gandhamadana. The river passes around Meru and then enters Jambamala.
verses.hindi: करते हैं; यातुधान (राक्षसगण) उनका अनुगमन हैं और बालखिल्य नामक ऋषिगण उदयकालसे प्रारम्भ करके चारों ओरसे घेरकर सूर्यको ओर ले जाते हैं। ये सब दो-दो महीने सूर्यमें निवास (भाद्रपद), इष (आश्विन), ऊर्ज (कार्तिक), सह
verses.wordMeaning: Jambu: According to Marka, (55. 28-30) this river springs from the juice of the fruits which the Jambu tree produces on the Gandhamadana. The river passes around Meru and then enters Jambamala.
verses.commentary: Sense: Jambu: According to Marka, (55. 28-30) this river springs from the juice of the fruits which the Jambu tree produces on the Gandhamadana. The river passes around Meru and then enters Jambamala.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिन्महाभुजः शर्वः सोमसूर्याग्निलोचनः सिंहासने मणिमये देव्यास्ते षण्मुखेन च
verses.transliteration: tasminmahābhujaḥ śarvaḥ somasūryāgnilocanaḥ siṃhāsane maṇimaye devyāste ṣaṇmukhena ca
verses.translation: Jambu: According to Marka, (55. 28-30) this river springs from the juice of the fruits which the Jambu tree produces on the Gandhamadana. The river passes around Meru and then enters Jambamala.
verses.hindi: (फाल्गुन)--ये बारह महीने मानव वर्षमें होते हैं। हे
verses.wordMeaning: Jambu: According to Marka, (55. 28-30) this river springs from the juice of the fruits which the Jambu tree produces on the Gandhamadana. The river passes around Meru and then enters Jambamala.
verses.commentary: Sense: Jambu: According to Marka, (55. 28-30) this river springs from the juice of the fruits which the Jambu tree produces on the Gandhamadana. The river passes around Meru and then enters Jambamala.

verses.sanskrit: हरेस्तदर्धं विस्तीर्णं विमानं तत्र सो ऽपि च पद्मरागमयं दिव्यं पद्मजस्य च दक्षिणे
verses.transliteration: harestadardhaṃ vistīrṇaṃ vimānaṃ tatra so 'pi ca padmarāgamayaṃ divyaṃ padmajasya ca dakṣiṇe
verses.translation: Jambu: According to Marka, (55. 28-30) this river springs from the juice of the fruits which the Jambu tree produces on the Gandhamadana. The river passes around Meru and then enters Jambamala.
verses.hindi: तथा शिशिर-ये ऋतुएँ कही गयी हैं॥ २२--२४॥ पर्जन्य, अंशु, भग, त्वष्टा, विष्णु-ये बारह आदित्य हैं; पुलस्त्य, पुलह, अत्रि, वसिष्ठ, अंगिरा, बुद्धिमानोंमें
verses.wordMeaning: Jambu: According to Marka, (55. 28-30) this river springs from the juice of the fruits which the Jambu tree produces on the Gandhamadana. The river passes around Meru and then enters Jambamala.
verses.commentary: Sense: Jambu: According to Marka, (55. 28-30) this river springs from the juice of the fruits which the Jambu tree produces on the Gandhamadana. The river passes around Meru and then enters Jambamala.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिन् शक्रस्य विपुलं पुरं रम्यं यमस्य च सोमस्य वरुणस्याथ निरृतेः पावकस्य च
verses.transliteration: tasmin śakrasya vipulaṃ puraṃ ramyaṃ yamasya ca somasya varuṇasyātha nirṛteḥ pāvakasya ca
verses.translation: Jambu: According to Marka, (55. 28-30) this river springs from the juice of the fruits which the Jambu tree produces on the Gandhamadana. The river passes around Meru and then enters Jambamala.
verses.hindi: कौशिक--ये बारह ऋषि हैं; है द्विजो! वासुकि, कंकणीकर,
verses.wordMeaning: Jambu: According to Marka, (55. 28-30) this river springs from the juice of the fruits which the Jambu tree produces on the Gandhamadana. The river passes around Meru and then enters Jambamala.
verses.commentary: Sense: Jambu: According to Marka, (55. 28-30) this river springs from the juice of the fruits which the Jambu tree produces on the Gandhamadana. The river passes around Meru and then enters Jambamala.

verses.sanskrit: वायोश्चैव तु रुद्रस्य शर्वालयसमन्ततः तेषां तेषां विमानेषु दिव्येषु विविधेषु च
verses.transliteration: vāyoścaiva tu rudrasya śarvālayasamantataḥ teṣāṃ teṣāṃ vimāneṣu divyeṣu vividheṣu ca
verses.translation: Jambu: According to Marka, (55. 28-30) this river springs from the juice of the fruits which the Jambu tree produces on the Gandhamadana. The river passes around Meru and then enters Jambamala.
verses.hindi: महापद्य, कर्काटक, कम्बल तथा अश्वतर--ये बारह सर्प कहे गये हैं; है मुनिश्रेष्ठो तुम्बुरु, नारद, हाहा, हूहू, श्रेष्ठ विश्वावसु, उग्रसेन, सुरुचि, परावसु, चित्रसेन; गन्धर्व हैं; है सुत्रतो! साक्षात् देवी कृतस्थला, सुन्दर मुखवाली-उत्तम श्रोणिवाली दिव्य पुंजिकस्थला, मेनका, सहजन्या, पवित्र मुसकानवाली प्रम्लोचा, अनुम्लोचा, घृताची, विश्‍वाची, उर्वशी, पूर्वचित्ति, साक्षात् देवी
verses.wordMeaning: Jambu: According to Marka, (55. 28-30) this river springs from the juice of the fruits which the Jambu tree produces on the Gandhamadana. The river passes around Meru and then enters Jambamala.
verses.commentary: Sense: Jambu: According to Marka, (55. 28-30) this river springs from the juice of the fruits which the Jambu tree produces on the Gandhamadana. The river passes around Meru and then enters Jambamala.

verses.sanskrit: ईशान्यामीश्वरक्षेत्रे नित्यार्चा च व्यवस्थिता सिद्धेश्वरैश् च भगवाञ् छैलादिः शिष्यसंमतः
verses.transliteration: īśānyāmīśvarakṣetre nityārcā ca vyavasthitā siddheśvaraiś ca bhagavāñ chailādiḥ śiṣyasaṃmataḥ

verses.translation: The first Dvipa, it is said, extends to a thousand yojanas. The other Dvipas successively extend to twice the previous one.
verses.hindi: इसी प्रकार ग्रीष्म ऋतुके दो महीनोमें भी ये लोग निवास करते हैं। दो आदित्य मित्र तथा बरुण, ऋषि अत्रि एवं वसिष्ठ, सर्प तक्षक तथा नाग, दो अप्सराएँ मेनका और सहजन्या, दो गन्धर्व

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चाशत्कोटिविस्तीर्णा ससमुद्रा धरा स्मृता द्वीपैश् च सप्तभिर् युक्ता लोकालोकावृता शुभा
verses.transliteration: pañcāśatkoṭivistīrṇā sasamudrā dharā smṛtā dvīpaiś ca saptabhir yuktā lokālokāvṛtā śubhā
verses.translation: The earth along with all the oceans is stated as ex- tending to fifty crores of yojanas. It consists of seven Dvipas. It is splendid and is surrounded by the Lokaloka mountain.®® The mountain Nila is to the north of the Meru. The Sveta is to the north of this and the Srngi is still further north of Sveta. O brahmins, these three are the mountains of the sub-con- tinents in the north.
verses.hindi: सब शुक्र (ज्येष्ठ) तथा शुचि ( आषाढ) महीनोंमें सूर्यमें निवास करते हैं ॥ ४९--५१॥ इसके बाद अन्य देवता सूर्यमें निवास करते हैं। आदित्य इन्द्र तथा विवस्वान्, ऋषि अंगिरा तथा
