verses.wordMeaning: Niadha: Sp. places it to Che south of the Meru, along with the Himavat and Hemakilta. It represents Hindukush Kunlun chain.
verses.commentary: Sense: Niadha: Sp. places it to Che south of the Meru, along with the Himavat and Hemakilta. It represents Hindukush Kunlun chain.

verses.sanskrit: इदं हैमवतं वर्षं भारतं नाम विश्रुतम् हेमकूटं परं तस्मान् नाम्ना किंपुरुषं स्मृतम्
verses.transliteration: idaṃ haimavataṃ varṣaṃ bhārataṃ nāma viśrutam hemakūṭaṃ paraṃ tasmān nāmnā kiṃpuruṣaṃ smṛtam
verses.translation: Hemakfita: a sacred hill situated to the north of M&nasacovara It represents Ladakh-Kailash-Trans-Himalayan chain.
verses.hindi: नभोनभस्ययोरेष गणो वसति भास्करे। पर्जन्यश्चैव पूषा च भरद्वाजोऽथ गौतमः
verses.wordMeaning: Hemakfita: a sacred hill situated to the north of M&nasacovara It represents Ladakh-Kailash-Trans-Himalayan chain.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hemakfita: a sacred hill situated to the north of M&nasacovara It represents Ladakh-Kailash-Trans-Himalayan chain.

verses.sanskrit: नैषधं हेमकूटात्तु हरिवर्षं तदुच्यते हरिवर्षात्परं चैव मेरोः शुभमिलावृतम्
verses.transliteration: naiṣadhaṃ hemakūṭāttu harivarṣaṃ taducyate harivarṣātparaṃ caiva meroḥ śubhamilāvṛtam
verses.translation: All these leading mountains are frequented by the Siddhas and Caranas. The inter>space between two mountains is nine thousand yojanas in each case.
verses.hindi: सेनजिच्च सुषेणश्च सेनानीर्ग्रामणीश्च तौ। आपो वातश्च तावेतौ यातुधानावुभौ स्मृतौ हैमन्तिकौ तु द्वौ मासौ वसन्ति च दिवाकरे
verses.wordMeaning: All these leading mountains are frequented by the Siddhas and Caranas. The inter>space between two mountains is nine thousand yojanas in each case.
verses.commentary: Sense: All these leading mountains are frequented by the Siddhas and Caranas. The inter>space between two mountains is nine thousand yojanas in each case.

verses.sanskrit: इलावृतात्परं नीलं रम्यकं नाम विश्रुतम् रम्यात्परतरं श्वेतं विख्यातं तद्धिरण्मयम्
verses.transliteration: ilāvṛtātparaṃ nīlaṃ ramyakaṃ nāma viśrutam ramyātparataraṃ śvetaṃ vikhyātaṃ taddhiraṇmayam
verses.translation: This sub-continent south of the Himavat is known as Bharata. Hemakuta is beyond that, llie sub-continent within it is Kimpuru§a. Ni$adha is beyond HemakQti. Its sub-conti- nent is called Harivar§a. Beyond Harivar§a and Meru is the splendid Ilavrta. Beyond Ilavrta is Nila and the sub-continent Ramyaka. Beyond Ramyaka is Sveta and the sub-continent known as Hiraaya. The mountain beyond Hiramaya is known as Srhgi and sub-continent beyond it is JCuru. The two Var§as one in the south and one in the north (i.e. Himavarsa and Ramyaka) are stationed like an arch.
verses.hindi: भुजङ्गश्च महापद्मः सर्पः कर्कोटकस्तथा
verses.wordMeaning: This sub-continent south of the Himavat is known as Bharata. Hemakuta is beyond that, llie sub-continent within it is Kimpuru§a. Ni$adha is beyond HemakQti. Its sub-conti- nent is called Harivar§a. Beyond Harivar§a and Meru is the splendid Ilavrta.…
verses.commentary: Sense: This sub-continent south of the Himavat is known as Bharata. Hemakuta is beyond that, llie sub-continent within it is Kimpuru§a. Ni$adha is beyond HemakQti. Its sub-conti- nent is called Harivar§a. Beyond Harivar§a and Meru is the splendid Ilavrta.…

verses.sanskrit: हिरण्मयात्परं चापि शृङ्गी चैव कुरुः स्मृतः धनुःसंस्थे तु विज्ञेये द्वे वर्षे दक्षिणोत्तरे
verses.transliteration: hiraṇmayātparaṃ cāpi śṛṅgī caiva kuruḥ smṛtaḥ dhanuḥsaṃsthe tu vijñeye dve varṣe dakṣiṇottare
verses.translation: The other four are horizontal in shape. Ilavrta is in the middle; to the west and east of the Meru there are two sub- continents and they are smaller ( than the four mentioned before).
verses.hindi: चित्रसेनश्च गन्धर्व ऊर्णायुश्चैव तावुभौ। उर्वशी पूर्वचित्तिश्च तथैवाप्सरसावुभे ताक्ष्यश्चारिष्टनेमिश्च सेनानीग्रामणीएच तौ। विद्युद्दिवाकरश्चोभौ यातुधानावुदाहृतौ
verses.wordMeaning: The other four are horizontal in shape. Ilavrta is in the middle; to the west and east of the Meru there are two sub- continents and they are smaller ( than the four mentioned before).
verses.commentary: Sense: The other four are horizontal in shape. Ilavrta is in the middle; to the west and east of the Meru there are two sub- continents and they are smaller ( than the four mentioned before).

verses.sanskrit: दीर्घाणि तत्र चत्वारि मध्यतस्तदिलावृतम् मेरोः पश्चिमपूर्वेण द्वे तु दीर्घेतरे स्मृते
verses.transliteration: dīrghāṇi tatra catvāri madhyatastadilāvṛtam meroḥ paścimapūrveṇa dve tu dīrghetare smṛte
verses.translation: The area above Nisadha is known as the northern Vedyardha (half of the whole Dvipa which is conceived as a sacrificial altar). Thus there are three Var§as in the southern half and three Varsas in the northern half.
verses.hindi: सहे चैव सहस्ये च वसन्त्येते दिवाकरे। ततः शैशिरयोश्चापि मासयोर्निवसन्ति वै
verses.wordMeaning: The area above Nisadha is known as the northern Vedyardha (half of the whole Dvipa which is conceived as a sacrificial altar). Thus there are three Var§as in the southern half and three Varsas in the northern half.
verses.commentary: Sense: The area above Nisadha is known as the northern Vedyardha (half of the whole Dvipa which is conceived as a sacrificial altar). Thus there are three Var§as in the southern half and three Varsas in the northern half.

verses.sanskrit: अर्वाक्तु निषधस्याथ वेद्यर्धं चोत्तरं स्मृतम् वेद्यर्धे दक्षिणे त्रीणि वर्षाणि त्रीणि चोत्तरे
verses.transliteration: arvāktu niṣadhasyātha vedyardhaṃ cottaraṃ smṛtam vedyardhe dakṣiṇe trīṇi varṣāṇi trīṇi cottare
verses.translation: Ilavirta with the Meru in the middle is in the midst of the two halves.
verses.hindi: त्वष्टा विष्णुर्जमदग्निर्विश्वामित्रस्तथैव च। काद्रवेयौ तथा नागौ कम्बलाश्वतरावुभौ
verses.wordMeaning: Ilavirta with the Meru in the middle is in the midst of the two halves.
verses.commentary: Sense: Ilavirta with the Meru in the middle is in the midst of the two halves.

verses.sanskrit: तयोर्मध्ये च विज्ञेयं मेरुमध्यमिलावृतम् दक्षिणेन तु नीलस्य निषधस्योत्तरेण तु
verses.transliteration: tayormadhye ca vijñeyaṃ merumadhyamilāvṛtam dakṣiṇena tu nīlasya niṣadhasyottareṇa tu
verses.translation: Its length and width is similar to that of Malyavan. These six Var§a mountains of good ridges extend to the east and are bounded on both sides by the Eastern and Western seas.
verses.hindi: तिलोत्तमाप्सराशचैव देवी रम्भा मनोहरा
verses.wordMeaning: Its length and width is similar to that of Malyavan. These six Var§a mountains of good ridges extend to the east and are bounded on both sides by the Eastern and Western seas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Its length and width is similar to that of Malyavan. These six Var§a mountains of good ridges extend to the east and are bounded on both sides by the Eastern and Western seas.

verses.sanskrit: उदगायतो महाशैलो माल्यवान्नाम पर्वतः योजनानां सहस्रे द्वे उपरिष्टात्तु विस्तृतः
verses.transliteration: udagāyato mahāśailo mālyavānnāma parvataḥ yojanānāṃ sahasre dve upariṣṭāttu vistṛtaḥ
verses.translation: Himavat is full of snow. The Hemakilta contains gold. The Nisadha is also golden resembling the morning sun.
verses.hindi: रथजित्सत्यजिच्चैव ग्रामण्यौ लोकविश्रुतौ । ब्रह्मोपेतस्तथा रक्षो यज्ञोपेतश्च यः स्मृतः
verses.wordMeaning: Himavat is full of snow. The Hemakilta contains gold. The Nisadha is also golden resembling the morning sun.
verses.commentary: Sense: Himavat is full of snow. The Hemakilta contains gold. The Nisadha is also golden resembling the morning sun.

verses.sanskrit: आयामतश्चतुस्त्रिंशत् सहस्राणि प्रकीर्तितः तस्य प्रतीच्यां विज्ञेयः पर्वतो गन्धमादनः
verses.transliteration: āyāmataścatustriṃśat sahasrāṇi prakīrtitaḥ tasya pratīcyāṃ vijñeyaḥ parvato gandhamādanaḥ
verses.translation: The golden Meru which extends upwards has four colours. Its girth is symmetrical and cylindrical. It rises high.
verses.hindi: एते देवा वसन्त्यकें द्वौ द्वौ मासौ क्रमेण तु।
verses.wordMeaning: The golden Meru which extends upwards has four colours. Its girth is symmetrical and cylindrical. It rises high.
verses.commentary: Sense: The golden Meru which extends upwards has four colours. Its girth is symmetrical and cylindrical. It rises high.

verses.sanskrit: आयामतः स विज्ञेयो माल्यवानिव विस्तृतः जम्बूद्वीपस्य विस्तारात् समेन तु समन्ततः
verses.transliteration: āyāmataḥ sa vijñeyo mālyavāniva vistṛtaḥ jambūdvīpasya vistārāt samena tu samantataḥ
verses.translation: The mountain Nila is full of Lapis Lazuli stones. The «§veta is white in colour and full of gold. The three-peaked mountain Srngi has the colour of the feathers of the peacock and contains gold.
verses.hindi: स्थानाभिमानिनो होते गणा द्वादश सप्तका: सर्पा वहन्ति वै सूर्य यातुधानानुयान्ति वै।
verses.wordMeaning: The mountain Nila is full of Lapis Lazuli stones. The «§veta is white in colour and full of gold. The three-peaked mountain Srngi has the colour of the feathers of the peacock and contains gold.
verses.commentary: Sense: The mountain Nila is full of Lapis Lazuli stones. The «§veta is white in colour and full of gold. The three-peaked mountain Srngi has the colour of the feathers of the peacock and contains gold.

verses.sanskrit: प्रागायताः सुपर्वाणः षडेते वर्षपर्वताः अवगाढाश्चोभयतः समुद्रौ पूर्वपश्चिमौ
verses.transliteration: prāgāyatāḥ suparvāṇaḥ ṣaḍete varṣaparvatāḥ avagāḍhāścobhayataḥ samudrau pūrvapaścimau
verses.translation: Four lofty trees grow on these as though they are the flagstaffs of the Dvipas. The great tree on the peak of the moun- tain Mandara is the Kadamba, the king of flagstaffs. It has long hanging branches. It acts as a caityapadapa (holy big tree in a sacred temple).
verses.hindi: विश्वावसु तथा उग्रसेन, ग्रामणी वरुण एवं रथस्वन,
verses.wordMeaning: Four lofty trees grow on these as though they are the flagstaffs of the Dvipas. The great tree on the peak of the moun- tain Mandara is the Kadamba, the king of flagstaffs. It has long hanging branches. It acts as a caityapadapa (holy big tree in a sacred temple).
verses.commentary: Sense: Four lofty trees grow on these as though they are the flagstaffs of the Dvipas. The great tree on the peak of the moun- tain Mandara is the Kadamba, the king of flagstaffs. It has long hanging branches. It acts as a caityapadapa (holy big tree in a sacred temple).

verses.sanskrit: हिमप्रायस्तु हिमवान् हेमकूटस्तु हेमवान् तरुणादित्यसंकाशो हैरण्यो निषधः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: himaprāyastu himavān hemakūṭastu hemavān taruṇādityasaṃkāśo hairaṇyo niṣadhaḥ smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: There are groves in the four directions. Understand them by their names. The forest grove in the east is Caitraratha; in the south it is Gandhamadana; it is Vaibhraja in the west; in the north it is the garden of Savitr (sun).
verses.hindi: और वे दोनों यातुधान सर्प तथा व्याप्र--यह समुदाय सूर्यमें निवास करता है॥ ५२-५४९/२॥
verses.wordMeaning: There are groves in the four directions. Understand them by their names. The forest grove in the east is Caitraratha; in the south it is Gandhamadana; it is Vaibhraja in the west; in the north it is the garden of Savitr (sun).
verses.commentary: Sense: There are groves in the four directions. Understand them by their names. The forest grove in the east is Caitraratha; in the south it is Gandhamadana; it is Vaibhraja in the west; in the north it is the garden of Savitr (sun).

verses.sanskrit: चतुर्वर्णः ससौवर्णो मेरुश्चोर्ध्वायतः स्मृतः वृत्ताकृतिपरीणाहश् चतुरस्रः समुत्थितः
verses.transliteration: caturvarṇaḥ sasauvarṇo meruścordhvāyataḥ smṛtaḥ vṛttākṛtiparīṇāhaś caturasraḥ samutthitaḥ
verses.translation: The sages sport about there on the mountains and in the gardens.
verses.hindi: आदित्य पर्जन्य तथा पूषा, ऋषि भरद्वाज एवं
verses.wordMeaning: The sages sport about there on the mountains and in the gardens.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sages sport about there on the mountains and in the gardens.

verses.sanskrit: नीलश् च वैडूर्यमयः श्वेतः शुक्लो हिरण्मयः मयूरबर्हवर्णस्तु शातकुंभस् त्रिशृङ्गवान्
verses.transliteration: nīlaś ca vaiḍūryamayaḥ śvetaḥ śuklo hiraṇmayaḥ mayūrabarhavarṇastu śātakuṃbhas triśṛṅgavān
verses.translation: To the west of the lake Sitoda there stand Surapa, Mahabala, Kumuda, Madhuman, Aiijana, Mukuta. Krsa, Pandura, Sahasraikhara, the leading hills Parijata andSrirhga. These are the prominent excellent mountains frequented by Devas in the western quarter and they contain shrines of Rudra.
verses.hindi: सुरुचि तथा परावसु, अप्सराओंमें श्रेष्ठ घृताची तथा परम सुन्दर विश्वाची, वे दोनों ग्रामणी-सेनानी सेनजित् तथा ये सब इष ( आश्विन ) तथा ऊर्ज ( कार्तिक ) महीनोंमें सूर्यमें निवास करते हैं ॥ ५५-५७», ॥
verses.wordMeaning: To the west of the lake Sitoda there stand Surapa, Mahabala, Kumuda, Madhuman, Aiijana, Mukuta. Krsa, Pandura, Sahasraikhara, the leading hills Parijata andSrirhga.…
verses.commentary: Sense: To the west of the lake Sitoda there stand Surapa, Mahabala, Kumuda, Madhuman, Aiijana, Mukuta. Krsa, Pandura, Sahasraikhara, the leading hills Parijata andSrirhga.…

verses.sanskrit: एवं संक्षेपतः प्रोक्ताः पुनः शृणु गिरीश्वरान् मन्दरो देवकूटश् च पूर्वस्यां दिशि पर्वतौ
verses.transliteration: evaṃ saṃkṣepataḥ proktāḥ punaḥ śṛṇu girīśvarān mandaro devakūṭaś ca pūrvasyāṃ diśi parvatau
verses.translation: The extremely powerful mountains to the north of the lake Mahabhadra are being stated now succinctly.
verses.hindi: इसी प्रकार हेमन्त ऋतुके दो महीनोंमें भी ये लोग सूर्यमें निवास करते हैं। ये दोनों आदित्य अंशु तथा भग, ऋषि कश्यप तथा क्रतु, भुजंग महापद्म तथा सर्प कर्कोटक, वे दोनों गन्धर्व चित्रसेन तथा ऊर्णायु, दोनों
verses.wordMeaning: The extremely powerful mountains to the north of the lake Mahabhadra are being stated now succinctly.
verses.commentary: Sense: The extremely powerful mountains to the north of the lake Mahabhadra are being stated now succinctly.

verses.sanskrit: कैलासो गन्धमादश् च हेमवांश्चैव पर्वतौ पूर्वतश् चायतावेताव् अर्णवान्तर्व्यवस्थितौ
verses.transliteration: kailāso gandhamādaś ca hemavāṃścaiva parvatau pūrvataś cāyatāvetāv arṇavāntarvyavasthitau
verses.translation: They are: — Sahkhakuta, Mahaaila, Vrabha, Haihsaparvata, Naga, Kapila, Indrasaila, Sanuman, Nila, Kantakafhga, Sataihga, Pufpakoa, Praaila, Virajas, Varahaparvata, Mayura and Jarudhi.® All these are stationed in the north.
verses.hindi: अप्सराएँ उर्वशी तथा पूर्वचित्ति, ग्रामणी-सेनानी ताक्ष्य दिवाकर-ये सब सह ( मार्गशीर्ष ) तथा सहस्य ( पौष ) महीनोंमें सूर्यमे निवास करते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: They are: — Sahkhakuta, Mahaaila, Vrabha, Haihsaparvata, Naga, Kapila, Indrasaila, Sanuman, Nila, Kantakafhga, Sataihga, Pufpakoa, Praaila, Virajas, Varahaparvata, Mayura and Jarudhi.® All these are stationed in the north.
verses.commentary: Sense: They are: — Sahkhakuta, Mahaaila, Vrabha, Haihsaparvata, Naga, Kapila, Indrasaila, Sanuman, Nila, Kantakafhga, Sataihga, Pufpakoa, Praaila, Virajas, Varahaparvata, Mayura and Jarudhi.® All these are stationed in the north.

verses.sanskrit: निषधः पारियात्रश् च द्वावेतौ वरपर्वतौ यथा पूर्वौ तथा याम्याव् एतौ पश्चिमतः श्रितौ
verses.transliteration: niṣadhaḥ pāriyātraś ca dvāvetau varaparvatau yathā pūrvau tathā yāmyāv etau paścimataḥ śritau
verses.translation: There are thousands of divine palaces of the trident- bearing lord on those divine hills.
verses.hindi: इसके बाद  आदित्य त्वष्टा तथा विष्णु, ऋषि जमदग्नि तथा विश्वामित्र, कद्रूके पुत्र दोनों नाग कम्बल
verses.wordMeaning: There are thousands of divine palaces of the trident- bearing lord on those divine hills.
verses.commentary: Sense: There are thousands of divine palaces of the trident- bearing lord on those divine hills.

verses.sanskrit: त्रिशृङ्गो जारुचिश्चैव उत्तरौ वरपर्वतौ पूर्वतश् चायतावेताव् अर्णवान्तर्व्यवस्थितौ
verses.transliteration: triśṛṅgo jāruciścaiva uttarau varaparvatau pūrvataś cāyatāvetāv arṇavāntarvyavasthitau
verses.translation: In the interstices of these leading hills there arc many internal water reservoirs, lakes and parks.
verses.hindi: देवी रम्भा तथा तिलोत्तमा, लोकमें प्रसिद्ध ग्रामणी रथजित् तथा सत्यजित् और ब्रह्मोपेत तथा यज्ञोपेत-जो यातुधान कहे गये हैं-ये सब शिशिर ऋतुके दो महीनों ( माघ और फाल्गुन )-में सूर्यमें निवास करते हैं॥ ६२--६५॥  ये देवतागण क्रमसे दो-दो महीने सूर्यमें निवास
verses.wordMeaning: In the interstices of these leading hills there arc many internal water reservoirs, lakes and parks.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the interstices of these leading hills there arc many internal water reservoirs, lakes and parks.

verses.sanskrit: मर्यादापर्वतान् एतान् अष्टावाहुर्मनीषिणः यो ऽसौ मेरुर्द्विजश्रेष्ठाः प्रांशुः कनकपर्वतः
verses.transliteration: maryādāparvatān etān aṣṭāvāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ yo 'sau merurdvijaśreṣṭhāḥ prāṃśuḥ kanakaparvataḥ
verses.translation: Thanks to the favour of Paramesthin, Devas, sages, Siddhas purified by their devotional thoughts of Siva reside here along with their families in their respective abodes.
verses.hindi: करते हैं । बारहकी संख्यामें ये सात समूह अपने स्थानका अभिमान करनेवाले हैं। ये सब तेजके द्वारा उत्तम तेजवाले सूर्यको सन्तृप्त करते हैं। मुनिगण अपने द्वारा विरचित स्तुतियोंसे सूर्यका स्तवन करते हैं, गन्धर्व तथा अप्सराएँ
verses.wordMeaning: Thanks to the favour of Paramesthin, Devas, sages, Siddhas purified by their devotional thoughts of Siva reside here along with their families in their respective abodes.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thanks to the favour of Paramesthin, Devas, sages, Siddhas purified by their devotional thoughts of Siva reside here along with their families in their respective abodes.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य पादास्तु चत्वारश् चतुर्दिक्षु नगोत्तमाः यैर्विष्टब्धा न चलति सप्तद्वीपवती मही
verses.transliteration: tasya pādāstu catvāraś caturdikṣu nagottamāḥ yairviṣṭabdhā na calati saptadvīpavatī mahī
verses.translation: The different deities reside in the various forests as follows: —
verses.hindi: नृत्य-गानोंसे उनकी उपासना करते हैं, ग्रामणी-यक्ष-भूत रथरश्मियोंको पकड़े रहते हैं, सर्पगण सूर्यका वहन करते हैं, यातुधान पीछे-पीछे चलते हैं और बालखिल्य व) शिवस्वरूप भगवान् सूर्यके रथ आदिका वर्णन २३९
verses.wordMeaning: The different deities reside in the various forests as follows: —
verses.commentary: Sense: The different deities reside in the various forests as follows: —

verses.sanskrit: दशयोजनसाहस्रम् आयामस् तेषु पठ्यते पूर्वे तु मन्दरो नाम दक्षिणे गन्धमादनः
verses.transliteration: daśayojanasāhasram āyāmas teṣu paṭhyate pūrve tu mandaro nāma dakṣiṇe gandhamādanaḥ
verses.translation: J&nidhi: This range is identified with the Kirghiz-ZaUai Al-Tau, Ketmen chain. GF.
verses.hindi: त काला? फफफपफीफीफीफीफपीफीफीफीफीफीफपीफीफ कफी sy प फी फ फा फ फ फ फ फ फ फ फ़ फ़ फ फ फ फ फ फ़ फ़ फ फ फ़ फ फ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ फ फ़ फ फ़ फ फ़ फ फा फफ फ क मा फ फी की
verses.wordMeaning: J&nidhi: This range is identified with the Kirghiz-ZaUai Al-Tau, Ketmen chain. GF.
verses.commentary: Sense: J&nidhi: This range is identified with the Kirghiz-ZaUai Al-Tau, Ketmen chain. GF.

verses.sanskrit: विपुलः पश्चिमे पार्श्वे सुपार्श्वश्चोत्तरे स्मृतः महावृक्षाः समुत्पन्नाश् चत्वारो द्वीपकेतवः
verses.transliteration: vipulaḥ paścime pārśve supārśvaścottare smṛtaḥ mahāvṛkṣāḥ samutpannāś catvāro dvīpaketavaḥ
verses.translation: The glorious Garuda stays in Vaikuntha. The prosperous Nilalohita stays in Karaftja.®®® The Vasus live in Vasudhara.
verses.hindi: एतेषामेव देवानां यथा तेजो यथा तपः।  चारों ओरसे घेरकर सूर्यको उदयसे अस्तको यथायोगं यथामन्त्र यथाधर्म यथाबलम्॥ ७०  प्राप्ति कराते हैं ॥ ६६--६९॥ इत्येते वौ मासौ दिवाकरे॥ ७९  समृद्ध होकर वे सूर्य तेजयुक्त होकर तपते हैं । ये सभी
verses.wordMeaning: The glorious Garuda stays in Vaikuntha. The prosperous Nilalohita stays in Karaftja.®®® The Vasus live in Vasudhara.
verses.commentary: Sense: The glorious Garuda stays in Vaikuntha. The prosperous Nilalohita stays in Karaftja.®®® The Vasus live in Vasudhara.

verses.sanskrit: मन्दरस्य गिरेः शृङ्गे महावृक्षः सकेतुराट् प्रलम्बशाखाशिखरः कदम्बश् चैत्यपादपः
verses.transliteration: mandarasya gireḥ śṛṅge mahāvṛkṣaḥ saketurāṭ pralambaśākhāśikharaḥ kadambaś caityapādapaḥ
verses.translation: Sitanta: It means *end of cold', i.e. ''a range which marks the dividing line between the cold and hot regions. If the river Kizil-Su repre- sents the head waters of the Puraic river Sita, Sitanta is obviously the Kashghar range, i.e. the last longitudinal range of the Pamir region facing the Tarim basin, on the east. It is a range which, to a traveller coming from the east across the hot and sandy Tarim Basin, stands athwart the route to- wards the west and promises a cool climate beyond. It is an effective climatic barrier which separates a hot and dry desert on the east from the cold pla- teau on the west. Coming from the west it literally marks the *end of cold* and is thereCore rightly qualified for its name, Sitanta". GP. p -101.
verses.hindi: ऋषयो देवगन्धर्वपन्नगाप्सरसां गणाः।
verses.wordMeaning: Sitanta: It means *end of cold', i.e. ''a range which marks the dividing line between the cold and hot regions. If the river Kizil-Su repre- sents the head waters of the Puraic river Sita, Sitanta is obviously the Kashghar range, i.e.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Sitanta: It means *end of cold', i.e. ''a range which marks the dividing line between the cold and hot regions. If the river Kizil-Su repre- sents the head waters of the Puraic river Sita, Sitanta is obviously the Kashghar range, i.e.…

verses.sanskrit: दक्षिणस्यापि शैलस्य शिखरे देवसेविता जम्बूः सदा पुण्यफला सदा माल्योपशोभिता
verses.transliteration: dakṣiṇasyāpi śailasya śikhare devasevitā jambūḥ sadā puṇyaphalā sadā mālyopaśobhitā
verses.translation: Kumuda: Peak Barzengi (16,456 feet) beyond the Pakshif Pass.
verses.hindi: सूर्यमें दो-दो महीने निवास करते हैं । ऋषिगण, देवता, ग्रामण्यश्च तथा यक्षा यातुधानाश्च मुख्यतः गन्धर्व, सर्प, अप्सराओंके समूह, ग्रामणी, यक्ष तथा यातुधान (राक्षस) ये ही मुख्यरूपसे तपते हैं, रसते हैं,
verses.wordMeaning: Kumuda: Peak Barzengi (16,456 feet) beyond the Pakshif Pass.
verses.commentary: Sense: Kumuda: Peak Barzengi (16,456 feet) beyond the Pakshif Pass.

verses.sanskrit: सकेतुर् दक्षिणे द्वीपे जम्बूर्लोकेषु विश्रुता विपुलस्यापि शैलस्य पश्चिमे च महात्मनः
verses.transliteration: saketur dakṣiṇe dvīpe jambūrlokeṣu viśrutā vipulasyāpi śailasya paścime ca mahātmanaḥ
verses.translation: Most of the mountains mentioned in this chapter are not Identifiable.
verses.hindi: भूतानामशुभं कर्म व्यपोहन्तीह कीर्तिताः
verses.wordMeaning: Most of the mountains mentioned in this chapter are not Identifiable.
verses.commentary: Sense: Most of the mountains mentioned in this chapter are not Identifiable.

verses.sanskrit: संजातः शिखरे ऽश्वत्थः स महान् चैत्यपादपः सुपार्श्वस्योत्तरस्यापि शृङ्गे जातो महाद्रुमः
verses.transliteration: saṃjātaḥ śikhare 'śvatthaḥ sa mahān caityapādapaḥ supārśvasyottarasyāpi śṛṅge jāto mahādrumaḥ
verses.translation: There are seven holy spots on the mountain Ratnadhara belonging to the noble seven sages. They contain the abodes of the Siddhas as well.
verses.hindi: प्रकाश करते हैं, सृजन करते हैं और आराधित होकर प्राणियोंके अशुभ कर्मका नाश करते हैं। ये लोग दुरात्मा मनुष्योंके शुभका नाश करते हैं और कहीं-कहीं सञ्जनोंके पापका हरण करते हैं ॥७०--७४॥ ये इच्छानुसार चलनेवाले तथा वायुवेगसे गमन करनेवाले दिव्य विमानमें स्थित होकर सूर्यके साथ पूरे दिन भ्रमण करते हैं। है द्विजो! ये वर्षा करते हुए, तपते हुए और सबको आह्लादित करते हुए सभी प्राणियोंको
verses.wordMeaning: There are seven holy spots on the mountain Ratnadhara belonging to the noble seven sages. They contain the abodes of the Siddhas as well.
verses.commentary: Sense: There are seven holy spots on the mountain Ratnadhara belonging to the noble seven sages. They contain the abodes of the Siddhas as well.

verses.sanskrit: न्यग्रोधो विपुलस्कन्धो ऽनेकयोजनमण्डलः तेषां चतुर्णां वक्ष्यामि शैलेन्द्राणां यथाक्रमम्
verses.transliteration: nyagrodho vipulaskandho 'nekayojanamaṇḍalaḥ teṣāṃ caturṇāṃ vakṣyāmi śailendrāṇāṃ yathākramam
verses.translation: The great abode of Prajapati is on the mountain ekarhga. Durga and others stay on the Gajaiiaila and the Vasus on the Sumedha.
verses.hindi: एक मन्वन्तरपर्यन्त विनाशसे बचाते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: The great abode of Prajapati is on the mountain ekarhga. Durga and others stay on the Gajaiiaila and the Vasus on the Sumedha.
verses.commentary: Sense: The great abode of Prajapati is on the mountain ekarhga. Durga and others stay on the Gajaiiaila and the Vasus on the Sumedha.

verses.sanskrit: अमानुष्याणि रम्याणि सर्वकालर्तुकानि च मनोहराणि चत्वारि देवक्रीडनकानि च
verses.transliteration: amānuṣyāṇi ramyāṇi sarvakālartukāni ca manoharāṇi catvāri devakrīḍanakāni ca
verses.translation: The Adityas, Rudras and Asvins have their abodes in eighty divine cities on the mountain Hemakaka.
verses.hindi: अतीत तथा अनागत (भविष्यमें होनेवाले) स्थानाभिमानियोंका तथा इस समय जो विद्यमान हैं, उन सभीका यह स्थान सभी मन्वन्तरोंमें हुआ करता है। ये चौदह गण सात-सातके समूहमें सभी चौदह मन्वन्तरोंमें सूर्यमें निवास करते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: The Adityas, Rudras and Asvins have their abodes in eighty divine cities on the mountain Hemakaka.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Adityas, Rudras and Asvins have their abodes in eighty divine cities on the mountain Hemakaka.

verses.sanskrit: वनानि वै चतुर्दिक्षु नामतस्तु निबोधत पूर्वे चैत्ररथं नाम दक्षिणे गन्धमादनम्
verses.transliteration: vanāni vai caturdikṣu nāmatastu nibodhata pūrve caitrarathaṃ nāma dakṣiṇe gandhamādanam
verses.translation: There are five hundred crores of abodes of the Rakiasas on the Sunila mountain which has five peaks with five crores of cities in each.
verses.hindi: हे श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! मैंने बुद्धिमान् देवदेवके क्रिया- कलापका संक्षेपमें तथा विस्तारसे वर्णन कर दिया, जैसा घटित हुआ था और जैसा मैंने सुना था। ये
verses.wordMeaning: There are five hundred crores of abodes of the Rakiasas on the Sunila mountain which has five peaks with five crores of cities in each.
verses.commentary: Sense: There are five hundred crores of abodes of the Rakiasas on the Sunila mountain which has five peaks with five crores of cities in each.

verses.sanskrit: वैभ्राजं पश्चिमे विद्याद् उत्तरे सवितुर्वनम् मित्रेश्वरं तु पूर्वे तु षष्ठेश्वरम् अतः परम्
verses.transliteration: vaibhrājaṃ paścime vidyād uttare saviturvanam mitreśvaraṃ tu pūrve tu ṣaṣṭheśvaram ataḥ param
verses.translation: The hundred cities of the Yakas of unmeasured pro- wess are on the Satarnga; the cities of Kadraveyas are on the mountain Tamrabha; the city of Guha is on the Viha hill.
verses.hindi: बारह-बारह देवताओंके ये सात समूह अपने स्थान (पद)-का अभिमान करनेवाले हैं इस प्रकार ये दिवाकर सूर्य हरितवर्णके सात अविनाशी अश्वोंद्वारा खींचे जाते हुए एक चक्रवाले 9 रथसे वेगपूर्वक चलते हैं। ये सूर्य एक चक्रवाले रथसे हरितिरक्षररश्वैः स्पंतेऽसौ दिवाकरः ८९ उक्त सात समूहोंके साथ आकाशमें दिन-रात भ्रमण
verses.wordMeaning: The hundred cities of the Yakas of unmeasured pro- wess are on the Satarnga; the cities of Kadraveyas are on the mountain Tamrabha; the city of Guha is on the Viha hill.
verses.commentary: Sense: The hundred cities of the Yakas of unmeasured pro- wess are on the Satarnga; the cities of Kadraveyas are on the mountain Tamrabha; the city of Guha is on the Viha hill.

verses.sanskrit: वर्येश्वरं पश्चिमे तु उत्तरे चाम्रकेश्वरम् महासरांसि च तथा चत्वारि मुनिपुङ्गवाः
verses.transliteration: varyeśvaraṃ paścime tu uttare cāmrakeśvaram mahāsarāṃsi ca tathā catvāri munipuṅgavāḥ
verses.translation: O excellent sages, the abode of Suparna is on the Svetodara; the abode of Kubera is on the Pisacaka and that of Vi§nu is on the Harikuta.
verses.hindi: अहोरात्रं रथेनासावेकचक्रेण तु भ्रमन्। करते हुए सात द्वीपों तथा समुद्रोंवाली पृथ्वीकै ऊपर सप्तद्वीपसमुद्रां गां सप्तभिः सर्पते दिवि॥ ८२  भ्रमण करते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent sages, the abode of Suparna is on the Svetodara; the abode of Kubera is on the Pisacaka and that of Vi§nu is on the Harikuta.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent sages, the abode of Suparna is on the Svetodara; the abode of Kubera is on the Pisacaka and that of Vi§nu is on the Harikuta.

verses.sanskrit: यत्र क्रीडन्ति मुनयः पर्वतेषु वनेषु च अरुणोदं सरः पूर्वं दक्षिणं मानसं स्मृतम्
verses.transliteration: yatra krīḍanti munayaḥ parvateṣu vaneṣu ca aruṇodaṃ saraḥ pūrvaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ mānasaṃ smṛtam
verses.translation: The residence of lord Siva*®* along with Uma is in the cave of mountain Srikaiatha. Srikatha is the overlord of all the chiefs of Devas* Undoubtedly the Cosmic Egg functions by the grace of Srikaitla. Ananta, 1'a and others are severally the protectors of the Cosmic Egg. They are called Vidycvaras as well as Cakravartins (Emperors).
verses.hindi: मानवानां शुभं होते हरन्ति च दुरात्मनाम्। दुरितं सुप्रचाराणां व्यपोहन्ति क्वचित्ववचित् विमाने च स्थिता दिव्ये कामगे वातरंहसि। एते सहैव सूर्येण भ्रमन्ति दिवसानुगाः
verses.wordMeaning: The residence of lord Siva*®* along with Uma is in the cave of mountain Srikaiatha. Srikatha is the overlord of all the chiefs of Devas* Undoubtedly the Cosmic Egg functions by the grace of Srikaitla. Ananta, 1'a and others are severally the protectors of the Cosmic Egg.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The residence of lord Siva*®* along with Uma is in the cave of mountain Srikaiatha. Srikatha is the overlord of all the chiefs of Devas* Undoubtedly the Cosmic Egg functions by the grace of Srikaitla. Ananta, 1'a and others are severally the protectors of the Cosmic Egg.…

verses.sanskrit: सितोदं पश्चिमसरो महाभद्रं तथोत्तरम् शाखस्य दक्षिणे क्षेत्रं विशाखस्य च पश्चिमे
verses.transliteration: sitodaṃ paścimasaro mahābhadraṃ tathottaram śākhasya dakṣiṇe kṣetraṃ viśākhasya ca paścime
verses.translation: Now, I shall briefly describe all the abodes presided over by Srikantha on the border mountains. The universe con- sisting of the mobile and immobile beings is presided over by 5rikantha. How can I recount all in detail upto Kalni — Siva?
verses.hindi: एते वसन्ति वै सूर्ये सप्तकास्ते चतुर्दश। चतुर्दशसु सर्वेषु गणा मन्वन्तरेष्विह
verses.wordMeaning: Now, I shall briefly describe all the abodes presided over by Srikantha on the border mountains. The universe con- sisting of the mobile and immobile beings is presided over by 5rikantha. How can I recount all in detail upto Kalni — Siva?
verses.commentary: Sense: Now, I shall briefly describe all the abodes presided over by Srikantha on the border mountains. The universe con- sisting of the mobile and immobile beings is presided over by 5rikantha. How can I recount all in detail upto Kalni — Siva?

verses.sanskrit: उत्तरे नैगमेयस्य कुमारस्य च पूर्वतः अरुणोदस्य पूर्वेण शैलेन्द्रा नामतः स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: uttare naigameyasya kumārasya ca pūrvataḥ aruṇodasya pūrveṇa śailendrā nāmataḥ smṛtāḥ
verses.translation: Now, I shall briefly describe all the abodes presided over by Srikantha on the border mountains. The universe con- sisting of the mobile and immobile beings is presided over by 5rikantha. How can I recount all in detail upto Kalni — Siva?
verses.hindi: कथितं मुनिशार्दूला देवदेवस्य धीमतः एते देवा वसन्त्यके द्वौ द्वौ मासौ क्रमेण तु। स्थानाभिमानिनो होते गणा द्वादश सप्तकाः ८०
verses.wordMeaning: Now, I shall briefly describe all the abodes presided over by Srikantha on the border mountains. The universe con- sisting of the mobile and immobile beings is presided over by 5rikantha. How can I recount all in detail upto Kalni — Siva?
verses.commentary: Sense: Now, I shall briefly describe all the abodes presided over by Srikantha on the border mountains. The universe con- sisting of the mobile and immobile beings is presided over by 5rikantha. How can I recount all in detail upto Kalni — Siva?

verses.sanskrit: तांस्तु संक्षेपतो वक्ष्ये न शक्यं विस्तरेण तु सितान्तश् च कुरण्डश् च कुररश्चाचलोत्तमः

verses.sanskrit: तेषु शैलेषु दिव्येषु देवदेवस्य शूलिनः असंख्यातानि दिव्यानि विमानानि सहस्रशः

verses.hindi: हैं। अन्तिम कलाके रूपमें पन्द्रहवें भागके शेष रहनेपर अपराहनमें पितृगण चन्द्रमाके पास आ जाते हैं और उसकी जो कला बची रहती है, उसका पान दो कलावाले समय (दो घड़ी)-तक करते हैं। अमावास्या

verses.sanskrit: एतेषां शैलमुख्यानाम् अन्तरेषु यथाक्रमम् सन्ति चैवान्तरद्रोण्यः सरांस्युपवनानि च
verses.transliteration: eteṣāṃ śailamukhyānām antareṣu yathākramam santi caivāntaradroṇyaḥ sarāṃsyupavanāni ca

verses.hindi: तिथिको किरणोंसे निकले हुए स्वधामृतको पीते हैं। इस प्रकार अमृत पीकर महीनेभरको तृप्ति प्राप्त करके वे चले जाते हैं। प्रत्येक पक्षे आरम्भमें सोलहवें दिन चन्द्रमाकी वृद्धि तथा क्षयका होना बताया गया है। इस प्रकार पक्षमें चन्द्रमामें होनेवाली यह वृद्धि सूर्यके कारण

verses.sanskrit: वसन्ति देवा मुनयः सिद्धाश् च शिवभाविताः कृतवासाः सपत्नीकाः प्रसादात्परमेष्ठिनः
verses.transliteration: vasanti devā munayaḥ siddhāś ca śivabhāvitāḥ kṛtavāsāḥ sapatnīkāḥ prasādātparameṣṭhinaḥ

verses.hindi: पक्षवृद्धिर्निशाकरे॥ ९८  होती है

verses.sanskrit: लक्ष्म्याद्यानां बिल्ववने ककुभे कश्यपादयः तथा तालवने प्रोक्तम् इन्द्रोपेन्द्रोरगात्मनाम्
verses.transliteration: lakṣmyādyānāṃ bilvavane kakubhe kaśyapādayaḥ tathā tālavane proktam indropendroragātmanām

verses.hindi: बुध आदि ग्रहोंके रथोंका स्वरूप, ग्रह-नक्षत्रों एवं तारागणोंद्वारा श्रुवका परिभ्रमण, ग्रहोंका स्वरूप-विस्तार तथा उनकी गतिका निरूपण शुक्रस्य क्ष्मामयैर्युक्तो हैत्याचार्यस्य धीमतः

verses.transliteration: uduṃbare kardamasya tathānyeṣāṃ mahātmanām vidyādharāṇāṃ siddhānāṃ puṇye tvāmravane śubhe

verses.hindi: अष्टाएवशचाथ भौमस्य रथो हैमः सुशोभनः। जीवस्य हैमश्चाष्टाश्वो मन्दस्यायसनिर्मितः

verses.sanskrit: नागानां सिद्धसंघानां तथा निंबवने स्थितिः सूर्यस्य किंशुकवने तथा रुद्रगणस्य च
verses.transliteration: nāgānāṃ siddhasaṃghānāṃ tathā niṃbavane sthitiḥ sūryasya kiṃśukavane tathā rudragaṇasya ca

verses.hindi: स्वर्भानोर्भासकरारेशच तथा चाष्टहयः स्मृतः सूतजी बोले-हे ऋषियो! चन्द्रमाके पुत्र बुध-का रथ जल-अग्निमय और पिशंगवर्णवाले सुन्दर आठ घोडोंसे युक्त है । हैत्योंके आचार्य बुद्धिमान् शुक्रका रथ पुष्ट, विभिन्न वर्णोवाले तथा पृथ्वीमय दस
verses.wordMeaning: Now, I shall briefly describe all the abodes presided over by Srikantha on the border mountains. The universe con- sisting of the mobile and immobile beings is presided over by 5rikantha. How can I recount all in detail upto Kalni — Siva?
verses.commentary: Sense: Now, I shall briefly describe all the abodes presided over by Srikantha on the border mountains. The universe con- sisting of the mobile and immobile beings is presided over by 5rikantha. How can I recount all in detail upto Kalni — Siva?

verses.sanskrit: बीजपूरवने पुण्ये देवाचार्यो व्यवस्थितः कौमुदे तु वने विष्णुप्रमुखानां महात्मनाम्
verses.transliteration: bījapūravane puṇye devācāryo vyavasthitaḥ kaumude tu vane viṣṇupramukhānāṃ mahātmanām
verses.translation: Now, I shall briefly describe all the abodes presided over by Srikantha on the border mountains. The universe con- sisting of the mobile and immobile beings is presided over by 5rikantha. How can I recount all in detail upto Kalni — Siva?
verses.hindi: घोडोंसे युक्त कहा गया है । मंगलका रथ सुवर्णमय, परम सुन्दर एवं आठ घोड़ोंवाला है। बृहस्पतिका रथ सुवर्णमय है तथा आठ घोडोंसे युक्त है । शनैश्चरका रथ लोहेका बना हुआ है और वह काले वर्णवाले जलमय दस

verses.sanskrit: स्थलपद्मवनान्तस्थन्यग्रोधे ऽशेषभोगिनः शेषस्त्वशेषजगतां पतिरास्ते ऽतिगर्वितः
verses.transliteration: sthalapadmavanāntasthanyagrodhe 'śeṣabhoginaḥ śeṣastvaśeṣajagatāṃ patirāste 'tigarvitaḥ

verses.hindi: घोडोंसे युक्त है । राहु-केतुका रथ आठ घोड़ोंवाला कहा गया है॥ १--४॥ वे सभी ग्रह वायुरश्मियोंके द्वारा धुवसे बँधे हुए हैं। इसके द्वारा घुमाये जाते हुए वे यथायोग चलते हैं। जितने तारे हैं, उतनी ही वात रश्मियाँ हैं। वे सब धुवसे बँधे हुए हैं और स्वयं घूमते हुए उस धुवको
verses.wordMeaning: Now, I shall briefly describe all the abodes presided over by Srikantha on the border mountains. The universe con- sisting of the mobile and immobile beings is presided over by 5rikantha. How can I recount all in detail upto Kalni — Siva?

verses.sanskrit: शयनं देवदेवस्य स हरेः कङ्कणं विभोः वने पनसवृक्षाणां सशुक्रा दानवादयः
verses.transliteration: śayanaṃ devadevasya sa hareḥ kaṅkaṇaṃ vibhoḥ vane panasavṛkṣāṇāṃ saśukrā dānavādayaḥ

verses.hindi: अलातचक्रवद्यान्ति वातचक्रेरितानि तु। घुमाते हैं। वातचक्रसे प्रेरित तारागण अंगारचक्रके समान यस्माद्वहति ज्योतींषि प्रवहस्तेन स स्मृतः ॥ घूमते हैं। चूँकि इन ग्रह-नक्षत्रोंका वहन वायु करता है नक्षत्रसूर्याश्च ग्रहतारागणैः सह। इसलिये उसे प्रवह कहा गया है॥ ५--७॥ उन्मुखाभिमुखाः करभा श्रिता दिवि॥ ८ ग्रहों तथा तारागणोंके साथ नक्षत्र तथा सूर्य सब- के-सब चक्ररूपमें उन्मुख एवं अभिमुख होकर आकाशमे GU ष्टितारचेत वमिव उल् र स्थित हैं। धुवके द्वारा नियन्त्रित वे सब धुवको प्रदक्षिणा
verses.wordMeaning: Now, I shall briefly describe all the abodes presided over by Srikantha on the border mountains. The universe con- sisting of the mobile and immobile beings is presided over by 5rikantha. How can I recount all in detail upto Kalni — Siva?

verses.sanskrit: किन्नरैरुरगाश्चैव विशाखकवने स्थिताः मनोहरवने वृक्षाः सर्वकोटिसमन्विताः
verses.transliteration: kinnarairuragāścaiva viśākhakavane sthitāḥ manoharavane vṛkṣāḥ sarvakoṭisamanvitāḥ

verses.hindi: ह द मेटीमूत धुं दिवि॥ ९ करते हैं। वे धुरीरूप ईश्वर ध्रुवको देखनेके लिये नवयोजनसाहस्रो विष्कम्भः सवितुः स्मृतः। आकाशमें भ्रमण करते हैं

verses.sanskrit: नन्दीश्वरो गणवरैः स्तूयमानो व्यवस्थितः संतानकस्थलीमध्ये साक्षाद्देवी सरस्वती
verses.transliteration: nandīśvaro gaṇavaraiḥ stūyamāno vyavasthitaḥ saṃtānakasthalīmadhye sākṣāddevī sarasvatī
verses.translation: Now, I shall briefly describe all the abodes presided over by Srikantha on the border mountains. The universe con- sisting of the mobile and immobile beings is presided over by 5rikantha. How can I recount all in detail upto Kalni — Siva?
verses.hindi: त्रिगुणस्तस्य विस्तारो मण्डलस्य प्रमाणतः ॥ १० सूर्यका व्यास नौ हजार योजन कहा गया और इस द्विगुणः सूर्यविस्ताराद्विस्तारः शशिनः स्मृतः । प्रमाणके अनुसार उनके मण्डलका विस्तार तीन गुना है। तुल्यस्तयोस्तु स्सर्भानुर्भूत्वाधस्तात्प्रसर्पति॥ ११  चन्द्रमाका विस्तार सूर्यके विस्तारसे दुगुना बताया गया उद्धृत्य पृथिवीछायां निर्मितां मण्डलाकृतिम्। है। उन दोनोंके बराबर होकर राहु नीचेसे चलता है। स्वर्भानोस्तु बृहत्स्थानं तृतीयं यत्तमोमयम्॥ १२  मण्डलाकार बनी हुई पृथ्वीछायाको लेकर राहुका तीसरा चन्द्रस्य षोडशो भागो भार्गवस्य विधीयते। बड़ा स्थान है, जो अन्धकारमय है॥ १०--१२॥ विष्कम्भान्मण्डलाच्चैव योजनाच्च प्रमाणत:
verses.wordMeaning: Now, I shall briefly describe all the abodes presided over by Srikantha on the border mountains. The universe con- sisting of the mobile and immobile beings is presided over by 5rikantha. How can I recount all in detail upto Kalni — Siva?

verses.sanskrit: एवं संक्षेपतः प्रोक्ता वनेषु वनवासिनः असंख्याता मयाप्यत्र वक्तुं नो विस्तरेण तु

verses.translation: Now, I shall briefly describe all the abodes presided over by Srikantha on the border mountains. The universe con- sisting of the mobile and immobile beings is presided over by 5rikantha. How can I recount all in detail upto Kalni — Siva?
verses.hindi: योजनके प्रमाणसे शुक्रका व्यास तथा मण्डल चन्द्रमाके व्यास एवं मण्डलका सोलहवाँ भाग कहा गया
verses.wordMeaning: Now, I shall briefly describe all the abodes presided over by Srikantha on the border mountains. The universe con- sisting of the mobile and immobile beings is presided over by 5rikantha. How can I recount all in detail upto Kalni — Siva?
verses.commentary: Sense: Now, I shall briefly describe all the abodes presided over by Srikantha on the border mountains. The universe con- sisting of the mobile and immobile beings is presided over by 5rikantha. How can I recount all in detail upto Kalni — Siva?

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीलिङ्गमहापुराणे पूर्वभागे एकोनपञ्चाशत्तमो ऽध्यायः शितान्तशिखरे शक्रः पारिजातवने शुभे तस्य प्राच्यां कुमुदाद्रिकूटो ऽसौ बहुविस्तरः
verses.transliteration: iti śrīliṅgamahāpurāṇe pūrvabhāge ekonapañcāśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ śitāntaśikhare śakraḥ pārijātavane śubhe tasya prācyāṃ kumudādrikūṭo 'sau bahuvistaraḥ
verses.translation: The glorious Garuda stays in Vaikuntha. The prosperous Nilalohita stays in Karanja.®® The Vasus live in Vasudhara.
verses.hindi: है। आकारमें बृहस्पतिको शुक्रसे एक चौथाई कम कहा गया है। विस्तारके प्रमाणसे मंगल तथा शनि sr ot  बृहस्पतिसे एक चौथाई कम हैं। अर्थात् मंगल एवं हरा छ सतह या ॥ ९५  शनि विस्तारमें बृहस्पतिके तीन चौथाई हैं  बुध विस्तार बुधेन तानि तुल्यानि विस्तारान्मण्डलादपि। तथा मण्डलमें उन दोनोंका तीन चौथाई है। तारा- प्रायशश्चन्रयोगीनि विद्यादृक्षाणि तत्त्ववित्॥ १६  नक्षत्ररूप जो पिण्ड हैं, वे विस्तार तथा मण्डलमें बुधके तारानक्षत्ररूपाणि हीनानि तु परस्परम्। तुल्य हैं, तत्त्ववेत्ताको चन््रमासे युक्त उन नक्षत्रोंको शतानि पञ्च चत्वारि त्रीणि द्वे चैव योजने॥ १७  “ऋक्ष' नामसे जानना चाहिए॥ १३--१६ ॥
verses.wordMeaning: The glorious Garuda stays in Vaikuntha. The prosperous Nilalohita stays in Karanja.®® The Vasus live in Vasudhara.
verses.commentary: Sense: The glorious Garuda stays in Vaikuntha. The prosperous Nilalohita stays in Karanja.®® The Vasus live in Vasudhara.

verses.sanskrit: अष्टौ पुराण्युदीर्णानि दानवानां द्विजोत्तमाः सुवर्णकोटरे पुण्ये राक्षसानां महात्मनाम्
verses.transliteration: aṣṭau purāṇyudīrṇāni dānavānāṃ dvijottamāḥ suvarṇakoṭare puṇye rākṣasānāṃ mahātmanām
verses.translation: Sitanta: It means 'end of cold', i.e. "a range which marks the dividing line between the cold and hot regions. If the river Kizil-Su repre- sents the head waters of the Puranic river Sita, Sitanta is obviously the Kashghar range, i.e. the last longitudinal range of the Pamir region facing the Tarim basin, on the east. It is a range which, to a traveller coming from the east across the hot and sandy Tarim Basin, stands athwart the route to- wards the west and promises a cool climate beyond. It is an effective climatic barrier which separates a hot and dry desert on the east from the cold pla- teau on the west. Coming from the west it literally marks the 'end of cold* and is therefore rightly qualified for its name, Sitanta". GP. pp. loo-ioi.
verses.hindi: सर्वोपरि निकृष्टानि तारकामण्डलानि तु। छोटे-छोटे असंख्य तारे तथा नक्षत्र परस्पर पाँच, योजनद्वयमात्राणि तेभ्यो हृस्वं न विद्यते॥ १८  चार, तीन एवं दो योजनकी दूरीपर हैं। सबसे ऊपर उपरिष्टात्रयस्तेषां ग्रहा ये दूरसर्षिण:।  ऽस्त छोटे तारामण्डल हैं, जो केवल दो योजन सौरोऽङ्गिराश्च वक्रश्च ज्ञेया मन्दविचारिण:
verses.wordMeaning: Sitanta: It means 'end of cold', i.e. "a range which marks the dividing line between the cold and hot regions. If the river Kizil-Su repre- sents the head waters of the Puranic river Sita, Sitanta is obviously the Kashghar range, i.e.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Sitanta: It means 'end of cold', i.e. "a range which marks the dividing line between the cold and hot regions. If the river Kizil-Su repre- sents the head waters of the Puranic river Sita, Sitanta is obviously the Kashghar range, i.e.…

verses.sanskrit: नीलकानां पुराण्याहुर् अष्टषष्टिर्द्विजोत्तमाः महानीले ऽपि शैलेन्द्रे पुराणि दश पञ्च च
verses.transliteration: nīlakānāṃ purāṇyāhur aṣṭaṣaṣṭirdvijottamāḥ mahānīle 'pi śailendre purāṇi daśa pañca ca
verses.translation: Kumuda: Peak Barzengi (16,436 feet) beyond the Pakshif
verses.hindi: तावन्त्यस्तारकाः कोट्यो यावत्त्यृक्षाणि सर्वशः। ्रुवात्तु नियमाच्चैषामृक्षमार्गे व्यवस्थितिः तीन ग्रह शनि, बृहस्पति तथा मंगल; जो दूरकी यात्रा करनेवाले हैं, उन्हें मन्दगतिवाला जानना चाहिए। उनके नीचे चार अन्य बड़े ग्रह सूर्य, चन्द्रमा, बुध तथा शुक्र हैं, जो तेजीसे चलनेवाले हैं ॥ १७--२०॥
verses.wordMeaning: Kumuda: Peak Barzengi (16,436 feet) beyond the Pakshif
verses.commentary: Sense: Kumuda: Peak Barzengi (16,436 feet) beyond the Pakshif

verses.sanskrit: हयाननानां मुख्यानां किन्नराणां च सुव्रताः वेणुसौधे महाशैले विद्याधरपुरत्रयम्
verses.transliteration: hayānanānāṃ mukhyānāṃ kinnarāṇāṃ ca suvratāḥ veṇusaudhe mahāśaile vidyādharapuratrayam
verses.translation: Most of the mountains mentioned in this chapter are not iden tillable.
verses.hindi: तारागण उतने ही करोड़ हैं, जितने सभी ऋक्ष (नक्षत्र) हैं। ऋक्षमार्ममें उनकी भी स्थिति ध्रुवके नियन्त्रणसे ही है। सात घोड़ोंवाले सूर्यका अनुक्रमसे
verses.wordMeaning: Most of the mountains mentioned in this chapter are not iden tillable.
verses.commentary: Sense: Most of the mountains mentioned in this chapter are not iden tillable.

verses.sanskrit: वैकुण्ठे गरुडः श्रीमान् करञ्जे नीललोहितः वसुधारे वसूनां तु निवासः परिकीर्तितः
verses.transliteration: vaikuṇṭhe garuḍaḥ śrīmān karañje nīlalohitaḥ vasudhāre vasūnāṃ tu nivāsaḥ parikīrtitaḥ
verses.translation: There are seven holy spots on the mountain Ratnadhara, belonging to the noble seven sages. They contain the abodes of the Siddhas as well.
verses.hindi: विस्तारवाले हैं, उनसे छोटे तारे नहीं हैं। उनके ऊपर  याब ५७ बुध आदि ग्रहोंके रथोंका स्वरूप तथा उनकी गतिका निरूपण २४३
verses.wordMeaning: There are seven holy spots on the mountain Ratnadhara, belonging to the noble seven sages. They contain the abodes of the Siddhas as well.
verses.commentary: Sense: There are seven holy spots on the mountain Ratnadhara, belonging to the noble seven sages. They contain the abodes of the Siddhas as well.

verses.sanskrit: रत्नधारे गिरिवरे सप्तर्षीणां महात्मनाम् सप्तस्थानानि पुण्यानि सिद्धावासयुतानि च
verses.transliteration: ratnadhāre girivare saptarṣīṇāṃ mahātmanām saptasthānāni puṇyāni siddhāvāsayutāni ca
verses.translation: The great abode of Prajapati is on the mountain ekaSrhga. Durga and others stay on the Gajaaila and the Vasus on the Sumedha.
verses.hindi: क्यास  = PTT अकी फा फ फा फ फा फ फा फ फा फ फ फ फ़ फ फ फा फ फ़ फ फ़ फ़ फ फ फफ फ फ फ़ फफ फ फ फ फ फ फ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ फ का फ फा जी नी
verses.wordMeaning: The great abode of Prajapati is on the mountain ekaSrhga. Durga and others stay on the Gajaaila and the Vasus on the Sumedha.
verses.commentary: Sense: The great abode of Prajapati is on the mountain ekaSrhga. Durga and others stay on the Gajaaila and the Vasus on the Sumedha.

verses.sanskrit: महत्प्रजापतेः स्थानम् एकशृङ्गे नगोत्तमे गजशैले तु दुर्गाद्याः सुमेधे वसवस् तथा
verses.transliteration: mahatprajāpateḥ sthānam ekaśṛṅge nagottame gajaśaile tu durgādyāḥ sumedhe vasavas tathā
verses.translation: The Adityas, Rudras and Asvins have their abodes in eighty divine cities on the mountain Hemakaksa.
verses.hindi: दूश्यते शीघ्र नातिव्यक्तैर्गभस्तिभिः  (नीचा तथा ऊँचा होना) होता रहता है । तदा दक्षिणमार्गस्थो नीचां वीथीमुपाश्जितः॥ २३  जब सूर्य उत्तरायणमार्गमें स्थित होते हैं और चन्द्रमा पूर्ण मण्डलमें होते हैं, तब सूर्य कुछ अस्पष्ट किरणोंके साथ उच्चत्वके कारण शीघ्र दिखायी पड़ते हैं। जब सूर्य दक्षिणायनमार्गमें स्थित होते हँ, तब वे नीचेवाली
verses.wordMeaning: The Adityas, Rudras and Asvins have their abodes in eighty divine cities on the mountain Hemakaksa.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Adityas, Rudras and Asvins have their abodes in eighty divine cities on the mountain Hemakaksa.

verses.sanskrit: आदित्याश् च तथा रुद्राः कृतावासास्तथाश्विनौ अशीतिर्देवपुर्यस्तु हेमकक्षे नगोत्तमे
verses.transliteration: ādityāś ca tathā rudrāḥ kṛtāvāsāstathāśvinau aśītirdevapuryastu hemakakṣe nagottame
verses.translation: There are five hundred crorcs of abodes of the Raksasas on the Sunlla mountain which has five peaks with five croies of cities in each.
verses.hindi: वीथिमें रहते हैं। पृथ्वीकी रेखाद्वारा ढँका हुआ सूर्य उससे नीचे होता है। पूर्णिमा तथा अमावास्याके दिनोंमें यथासमय दिखायी देता है; क्योंकि यह शीघ्र अस्त हो जाता है। अतः नये चन्द्रमाकी तिथि अमावास्या-
verses.wordMeaning: There are five hundred crorcs of abodes of the Raksasas on the Sunlla mountain which has five peaks with five croies of cities in each.
verses.commentary: Sense: There are five hundred crorcs of abodes of the Raksasas on the Sunlla mountain which has five peaks with five croies of cities in each.

verses.sanskrit: सुनीले रक्षसां वासाः पञ्चकोटिशतानि च पञ्चकूटे पुराण्यासन् पञ्चकोटिप्रमाणतः
verses.transliteration: sunīle rakṣasāṃ vāsāḥ pañcakoṭiśatāni ca pañcakūṭe purāṇyāsan pañcakoṭipramāṇataḥ
verses.translation: The hundred cities of the Yaksas of unmeasured pio- wess are on the Satasrnga; the cities of Kadraveyas are on the mountain Tamrabha; the city of Guha is on the Visakha hill.
verses.hindi: पर चन्द्रमा उत्तरायणमें होता हैं। यह दक्षिण मार्गमें दिखायी नहीं पड़ता; क्योंकि नक्षत्रोके गतियोगके कारण यह चन्द्रमा सूर्यके अन्धकारसे ढँका हुआ होता है॥ २१--२५ /२॥ सूर्य तथा चन्द्रमा विषुवत् स्थानोंपर समान कालमें अस्त एवं उदय होते हैं। उत्तरायणमें पूर्णिमा तथा अमावास्या तिथियोंपर ज्योतिश्चक्रका अनुसरण करनेवाले इन दोनोंको बिना किसी अन्तरके उदय तथा अस्त
verses.wordMeaning: The hundred cities of the Yaksas of unmeasured pio- wess are on the Satasrnga; the cities of Kadraveyas are on the mountain Tamrabha; the city of Guha is on the Visakha hill.
verses.commentary: Sense: The hundred cities of the Yaksas of unmeasured pio- wess are on the Satasrnga; the cities of Kadraveyas are on the mountain Tamrabha; the city of Guha is on the Visakha hill.

verses.sanskrit: शतशृङ्गे पुरशतं यक्षाणाममितौजसाम् ताम्राभे काद्रवेयाणां विशाखे तु गुहस्य वै
verses.transliteration: śataśṛṅge puraśataṃ yakṣāṇāmamitaujasām tāmrābhe kādraveyāṇāṃ viśākhe tu guhasya vai
verses.translation: O excellent sages, the abode of Suparna is on the Svetodara; the abode of Kubera is on the Pisacaka and that of Visnu is on the Harikuta.
verses.hindi: होनेवाला जानना चाहिए। जब सूर्य दक्षिणायनमार्गमें स्थित होकर चलता है, तब वह सभी ग्रहोंके नीचेसे गुजरता है, उस समय चन्द्रमा अपने मण्डलको विस्तृत करके उस सूर्य-के ऊपर चलते हैं और सम्पूर्ण
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent sages, the abode of Suparna is on the Svetodara; the abode of Kubera is on the Pisacaka and that of Visnu is on the Harikuta.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent sages, the abode of Suparna is on the Svetodara; the abode of Kubera is on the Pisacaka and that of Visnu is on the Harikuta.

verses.sanskrit: श्वेतोदरे मुनिश्रेष्ठाः सुपर्णस्य महात्मनः पिशाचके कुबेरस्य हरिकूटे हरेर्गृहम्
verses.transliteration: śvetodare muniśreṣṭhāḥ suparṇasya mahātmanaḥ piśācake kuberasya harikūṭe harergṛham
verses.translation: The residence of loid Siva®®* along with Uma is in the cave of mountain Srikanha. Srikantha is the overlord of all the chiefs of Devas. Undoubtedly the Cosmic Egg functions by the grace of Srikantha. Ananta, la and others are severally the protectors of the Cosmic Egg. They are called Vidyevaras as well as Cakravartins (Emperors).
verses.hindi: नक्षत्रमण्डल चन्द्रमासे ऊपर भ्रमण करता है। नक्षत्रोंसे ऊपर बुध, बुधसे ऊपर शुक्र, शुक्रसे ऊपर मंगल, मंगलसे ऊपर बृहस्पति, उस बृहस्पतिसे ऊपर शनि और उससे ऊपर सप्तर्षिमण्डल विद्यमान है । सात ऋषियोंके ऊपर धुवकी स्थिति है। उस परम विष्णुलोकको जानकर मनुष्य पापसे मुक्त हो जाता है
verses.wordMeaning: The residence of loid Siva®®* along with Uma is in the cave of mountain Srikanha. Srikantha is the overlord of all the chiefs of Devas. Undoubtedly the Cosmic Egg functions by the grace of Srikantha. Ananta, la and others are severally the protectors of the Cosmic Egg.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The residence of loid Siva®®* along with Uma is in the cave of mountain Srikanha. Srikantha is the overlord of all the chiefs of Devas. Undoubtedly the Cosmic Egg functions by the grace of Srikantha. Ananta, la and others are severally the protectors of the Cosmic Egg.…

verses.sanskrit: कुमुदे किंनरावासस् त्व् अञ्जने चारणालयः कृष्णे गन्धर्वनिलयः पाण्डुरे पुरसप्तकम्
verses.transliteration: kumude kiṃnarāvāsas tv añjane cāraṇālayaḥ kṛṣṇe gandharvanilayaḥ pāṇḍure purasaptakam
verses.translation: Sarv&vaiiab — i.e. Siva, sarvaih viivam av&so yasya sal. ST.
verses.hindi: दो सौ हजार योजन दूरीपर ग्रह-नक्षत्र-तारोंसे ऊपर यथाक्रम सभी ग्रह और दिव्य तेजसे युक्त चन्द्रमा- सूर्य दिन-रात भ्रमण करते हुए सदा नक्षत्रोंसे जुड़े रहते हैं। वे ग्रह, नक्षत्र तथा सूर्य कभी नीचे, कभी ऊँचे एवं
verses.wordMeaning: Sarv&vaiiab — i.e. Siva, sarvaih viivam av&so yasya sal. ST.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sarv&vaiiab — i.e. Siva, sarvaih viivam av&so yasya sal. ST.

verses.sanskrit: विद्याधराणां विप्रेन्द्रा विश्वभोगसमन्वितम् सहस्रशिखरे शैले दैत्यानामुग्रकर्मणाम्
verses.transliteration: vidyādharāṇāṃ viprendrā viśvabhogasamanvitam sahasraśikhare śaile daityānāmugrakarmaṇām
verses.translation: Now, I shall briefly describe all the abodes presided over by Srikantha on the border mountains. The universe con- sisting of the mobile and immobile beings is presided over by.*§r!kantha. How can I recount all in detail upto Kalagni — Siva?
verses.hindi: कभी सीधी रेखामें स्थित रहते हैं। समागम तथा भेद दोनों स्थितियोंमें वे प्रजाओको एक साथ देखते हैं। ऋतुएँ छः कही गयी हैं, वे सब पाँच प्रकारसे आती हैं। एक-दूसरेपर आश्रित होनेके कारण ये परस्पर जुड़ी ददुशे च यथाकालं शीघ्रमस्तमुपैति च

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीलिङ्गमहापुराणे पूर्वभागे भुवनविन्यासोद्देशस्थानवर्णनं नाम पञ्चाशत्तमो ऽध्यायः देवकूटे गिरौ मध्ये महाकूटे सुशोभने हेमवैडूर्यमाणिक्यनीलगोमेदकान्तिभिः
verses.transliteration: iti śrīliṅgamahāpurāṇe pūrvabhāge bhuvanavinyāsoddeśasthānavarṇanaṃ nāma pañcāśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ devakūṭe girau madhye mahākūṭe suśobhane hemavaiḍūryamāṇikyanīlagomedakāntibhiḥ
verses.translation: The beautiful forest Bhutavana, the residence of the different groups of Bhutas (goblins), is on the highly splendid mountain Devakuta. This mountain has great peaks. It is splendid and devoid of impurities. It is made up by gold, Lapis Lazuli, rubies, emeralds, lustrous Gomeda (onyx) and other precious stones. It ranges in a number of branches on all sides. It is adorned with all kinds of trees such as Campaka, Aoka, Punnaga, Bakula, Asana and Parijata. It contains many flocks of birds and herds of elephants. It is variegated in colour with hundreds of minerals. It abounds in wonderful specimens of flowers. Its ridges are covered with bunches of flowers hanging down. Various kinds of animals live therein. It contains many springs and fountains with pure and sweet water. It is adorned with many waterfalls and cascades strewn with flowers. It is beautified by running streams with rafts of flowers floating on them. This Bhutavana®®' has pleasing colours. It contains many trees with great roots and stems. The thick shade of these trees spreads to ten yojanas all-round.
verses.hindi: नामक सत्तावनवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ
verses.wordMeaning: The beautiful forest Bhutavana, the residence of the different groups of Bhutas (goblins), is on the highly splendid mountain Devakuta. This mountain has great peaks. It is splendid and devoid of impurities. It is made up by gold, Lapis Lazuli, rubies, emeralds,…

verses.sanskrit: चम्पकाशोकपुंनागवकुलासनमण्डिते पारिजातकसम्पूर्णे नानापक्षिगणान्विते

verses.translation: Bhutavana: BhUta is a name of Siva; BhUta-vana— Siva's forest.
verses.hindi: चन्द्रमा, वरुण आदिकी प्रतिष्ठाका निरूपण

verses.sanskrit: नैकधातुशतैश्चित्रे विचित्रकुसुमाकुले नितम्बपुष्पसालम्बेन्-ऐकसत्त्वगणान्विते
verses.transliteration: naikadhātuśataiścitre vicitrakusumākule nitambapuṣpasālamben-aikasattvagaṇānvite
verses.translation: In that mansion of Siva there are many apart- ments decorated with garlands of never-fading flowers of dif- ferent colours. There are many raised platforms (Mantjapas) of different shapes and sizes with crystal columns. The leading goblins (Bhutas) adored by Brahma, Indra and Upendra stay there. There are many Pramathas with their faces resembling those of boars, elephants, lions, bears, tigers, camels, vultures, owls, deer, humped bulls and goats. They are stout and huge like great mountain peaks. They are terrible with having huge arms. Some have green hairs on their heads. They are of dif- ferent shapes and sizes. They are seated in all possible pos- tures and positions. There arc splendid Ganas such as Nan- diivara, with bright beaming faces and spotless character. They possess supernatural qualities and they resemble Brahma, Indra and Visnu. The place is never devoid of crowds of im- mortal beings, (i.e. Devas) who worship the lord of Bhutas (i.e. Siva) there, always.
verses.hindi: अभ्यषिञ्चत्कथं ब्रह्मा चाधिपत्ये प्रजापतिः । देवहैत्यमुखान् सर्वान् सर्वात्मा वद साम्प्रतम् ग्रहाधिपत्ये भगवानभ्यषिञ्चहिवाकरम्। ऋक्षाणामोषधीनां च सोमं ब्रह्मा प्रजापतिः
verses.wordMeaning: In that mansion of Siva there are many apart- ments decorated with garlands of never-fading flowers of dif- ferent colours. There are many raised platforms (Mantjapas) of different shapes and sizes with crystal columns. The leading goblins (Bhutas) adored by Brahma,…

verses.sanskrit: विमलस्वादुपानीयेन्-ऐकप्रस्रवणैर्युते निर्झरैः कुसुमाकीर्णैर् अनेकैश् च विभूषिते
verses.transliteration: vimalasvādupānīyen-aikaprasravaṇairyute nirjharaiḥ kusumākīrṇair anekaiś ca vibhūṣite
verses.translation: Sankara, Mahadeva, the lord of Pramhathas is worshipped by the Siddhas, Devas, Gandharvas, Brahma, and others such as Upendra. They use these musical instruments (drums, etc.) in the course of their worship— Jharj haras (cym- bals) conches, Patahas, Bhcris, Diidimas, Gomukhasw During their worship they sing in low, middle and high pitches; they also jump, dance and shout in joy. Sankara when being worshipped thus appears as though he has divided into two the beautiful peak (Kailasa) having the lustre of the conch.
verses.hindi: अपां च वरुणं देवं धनानां यक्षपुङ्गवम्। आदित्यानां तथा विष्णुं वसूनां पावकं तथा

verses.sanskrit: पुष्पोडुपवहाभिश् च स्रवन्तीभिर् अलंकृते स्निग्धवर्णं महामूलम् अनेकस्कन्धपादपम्
verses.transliteration: puṣpoḍupavahābhiś ca sravantībhir alaṃkṛte snigdhavarṇaṃ mahāmūlam anekaskandhapādapam
verses.translation: Kailasa®® is the abode of Kubera, the king of Yaksas as well as other noble beings.
verses.hindi: हैत्यानां दानवानां च प्रह्नादं हैत्यपुङ्गवम् धर्म पितृणामधिपं निऋतिं पिशिताशिनाम्। रुद्रं पशूनां भूतानां नन्दिनां गणनायकम्
verses.wordMeaning: Kailasa®® is the abode of Kubera, the king of Yaksas as well as other noble beings.
verses.commentary: Sense: Kailasa®® is the abode of Kubera, the king of Yaksas as well as other noble beings.

verses.sanskrit: रम्यं ह्यविरलच्छायं दशयोजनमण्डलम् तत्र भूतवनं नाम नानाभूतगणालयम्
verses.transliteration: ramyaṃ hyaviralacchāyaṃ daśayojanamaṇḍalam tatra bhūtavanaṃ nāma nānābhūtagaṇālayam
verses.translation: There too, Siva the lord of Devas has a great abode. He stays there always accompanied by Uma and the chiefs of Ganas.
verses.hindi: वीराणां वीरभद्रं च पिशाचानां भयङ्करम्। मातृणां चैव चामुण्डां सर्वदेवनमस्कृताम्
verses.wordMeaning: There too, Siva the lord of Devas has a great abode. He stays there always accompanied by Uma and the chiefs of Ganas.

verses.transliteration: mahādevasya devasya śaṅkarasya mahātmanaḥ dīptamāyatanaṃ tatra mahāmaṇivibhūṣitam
verses.translation: The holy river Mandakini with plenty of water and abounding in lotuses flows over the splendid peak Kubera Sikhara; the steps leading to its waters are built of gold and set
verses.hindi: ऋषिगण बोले--हे सूतजी! सर्वात्मा प्रजापतिः ्रह्माजीने सभी प्रमुख देवताओं तथा हैत्योंको अधिपतिके रूपमें किस प्रकार अभिषिक्त किया, इस समय हमलोगोंको बताइये
verses.wordMeaning: The holy river Mandakini with plenty of water and abounding in lotuses flows over the splendid peak Kubera Sikhara; the steps leading to its waters are built of gold and set

verses.sanskrit: हेमप्राकारसंयुक्तं मणितोरणमण्डितम् स्फाटिकैश् च विचित्रैश् च गोपुरैश् च समन्वितम्
verses.transliteration: hemaprākārasaṃyuktaṃ maṇitoraṇamaṇḍitam sphāṭikaiś ca vicitraiś ca gopuraiś ca samanvitam
verses.translation: Kail&sa: note 133
verses.hindi: सूतजी बोले-हे ऋषियो! भगवान् ब्रह्मने ग्रहोंके अधिपतिके रूपमें सूर्यका और नक्षत्रों तथा औषधियोंके अधिपतिके रूपमें चन्द्रमाका अभिषेक किया
verses.wordMeaning: Kail&sa: note 133
verses.commentary: Sense: Kail&sa: note 133

verses.sanskrit: सिंहासनैर्मणिमयैः शुभास्तरणसंयुतैः क्षितावितस्ततः सम्यक् शर्वेणाधिष्ठितैः शुभैः
verses.transliteration: siṃhāsanairmaṇimayaiḥ śubhāstaraṇasaṃyutaiḥ kṣitāvitastataḥ samyak śarveṇādhiṣṭhitaiḥ śubhaiḥ
verses.translation: On its northern bank is the splendid abode of Lord Siva, finished with lapis lazuli and other gems. He, the unchang- ing lord, stays there.
verses.hindi: उन पितामहने वरुणदेवको जलोंका अधिपतिं, यक्षोमें श्रेष्ठ कुबेरको धनोंका अधिपति, विष्णुको आदित्योंका अधिपति, अग्निको वसुओंका अधिपति, दक्षको प्रजापतियोंका अधिपति, इन्द्रको मरुतोंका अधिपति, हैत्यश्रेष्ठ प्रह्णादको हैत्यों तथा दानवोंका अधिपति, धर्मको पितरोंका अधिपति, निर्क्रतिको राक्षसोंका अधिपति, रुद्रको पशुओंका अधिपति, गणोंके नायक नन्दीको भूतोंका अधिपति, भयंकर वीरभद्रको वीर
verses.wordMeaning: On its northern bank is the splendid abode of Lord Siva, finished with lapis lazuli and other gems. He, the unchang- ing lord, stays there.
verses.commentary: Sense: On its northern bank is the splendid abode of Lord Siva, finished with lapis lazuli and other gems. He, the unchang- ing lord, stays there.

verses.sanskrit: अम्लानमालानिचितैर् नानावर्णैर् गृहोत्तमैः मण्डपैः सुविचित्रैस् तु स्फाटिकस्तम्भसंयुतैः
verses.transliteration: amlānamālānicitair nānāvarṇair gṛhottamaiḥ maṇḍapaiḥ suvicitrais tu sphāṭikastambhasaṃyutaiḥ
verses.translation: O brahmins, on the eastern and southern banks of the river Kanakananda there is a forest with thousands of Brah- mins,animals and birds.
verses.hindi: पिशाचोंका अधिपति, सभी देवताओंद्वार नमस्कृत चामुण्डाको
verses.wordMeaning: O brahmins, on the eastern and southern banks of the river Kanakananda there is a forest with thousands of Brah- mins,animals and birds.
verses.commentary: Sense: O brahmins, on the eastern and southern banks of the river Kanakananda there is a forest with thousands of Brah- mins,animals and birds.

verses.sanskrit: संयुतं सर्वभूतेन्द्रैर् ब्रह्मेन्द्रोपेन्द्रपूजितैः वराहगजसिंहर्क्षशार्दूलकरभाननैः
verses.transliteration: saṃyutaṃ sarvabhūtendrair brahmendropendrapūjitaiḥ varāhagajasiṃharkṣaśārdūlakarabhānanaiḥ
verses.translation: There- also the lord sports in a mansion similar to the one on the mountain (Kailasa ) along with Uma and chief Ganas. On the western bank of the Nanda®, a little towards the South there is the city Rudrapuri. It is full of many man- sions. In these also Lord Siva assuming hundreds of forms sports about along with Uma and the Ganas It is called Sivalaya (abode of Siva). Thus there are hundreds and thousands of shrines of Siva in every Dvipa, O excellent sages, on the moun- tains, in the forests, on the banks of rivers, lakes and on the junctions of waters.
verses.hindi: अध्याये ५८ 1 ब्रह्माद्वारा शिवके आदेशसे ग्रहों आदिकी प्रतिष्ठाका निरूपण २४५ रुद्राणां व नीललोहितमीश्वरम्।  अधिपति, देवदेवेश ईश्वर नीललोहितको विध्नानां व्योमजं देवं गजास्यं तु विनायकम् ७  रुद्रोका अधिपति, व्योमसे उत्पन्न तथा हाथीके समान
verses.wordMeaning: There- also the lord sports in a mansion similar to the one on the mountain (Kailasa ) along with Uma and chief Ganas. On the western bank of the Nanda®, a little towards the South there is the city Rudrapuri. It is full of many man- sions.…
verses.commentary: Sense: There- also the lord sports in a mansion similar to the one on the mountain (Kailasa ) along with Uma and chief Ganas. On the western bank of the Nanda®, a little towards the South there is the city Rudrapuri. It is full of many man- sions.…

verses.transliteration: gṛdhrolūkamukhaiścānyair mṛgoṣṭrājamukhairapi pramathairvividhaiḥ sthūlair girikūṭopamaiḥ śubhaiḥ
verses.translation: Nandi: Nand&, Alakanandi and Bhiglrath! are three &mous branches of Gahgi in the upper course in the Pauri-Garhwal region. Accor- ding to Pargiter (Mark. ), the nrivers andi and Apara-oanda are often mentioned as situated in the north between the Ganges and KauiikI or Kosi, and near the river B&hudi and mount Hemakilbt.
verses.hindi: जीणा देवीमुमादेवीं वचसां च सरस्वतीम्। मुखवाले विनायकको विघ्नोंका अधिपति, देवी उमाको हनी मायाविनां चैव स्वात्मानं जगतां तथा॥ ८ स्त्रियोंका अधिपति, देवी सरस्वतीको वाणीका अधिपति, विष्णुको मायावियोंका अधिपति, स्वयं अपनेको सम्पूर्ण जगतूका अधिपति, हिमालयको पर्वतोंका अधिपति,

verses.translation: O best of Brahmins, on every sub-continent there are many holy rivers always full of water and originating from great lakes. They flow in all four directions: east, south, north and west.
verses.hindi: अव्यक्तसे उत्पन्न होनेवाले ब्रह्माकी रात्रि बीत जानेपर यह दृश्य जगत् अस्पष्ट था और घोर अन्धकारसे आच्छन्न था। इस लोकके विशेष रूपसे नष्ट हो जानेपर तथा इसका चौथाई भाग अवशिष्ट रहनेपर संसारका कार्य सिद्ध करनेवाले वे भगवान् ब्रह्मा सृष्टिकी कामनासे खद्योतको भाँति वहाँ विचरण करने लगे

verses.sanskrit: प्राङ्मुखा दक्षिणास्यास्तु चोत्तरप्रभवाः शुभाः पश्चिमाग्राः पवित्राश् च प्रतिवर्षं प्रकीर्तिताः
verses.transliteration: prāṅmukhā dakṣiṇāsyāstu cottaraprabhavāḥ śubhāḥ paścimāgrāḥ pavitrāś ca prativarṣaṃ prakīrtitāḥ
verses.translation: The storehouse of water in the sky which is called Soma (moon) is the support of all living beings. To Devas, it is the receptacle of nectar.
verses.hindi: तदनन्तर पृथ्वी तथा जलमें संश्रित उन जगदीश्वरने लोकके आदिमें अग्निका सृजन करके पृथ्वीकै जलका संहरणकर उसके प्रकाशके लिये अग्निको तीन भागोंमें विभक्त किया। इस लोकमें जो पवन है, वह पार्थिव
verses.wordMeaning: The storehouse of water in the sky which is called Soma (moon) is the support of all living beings. To Devas, it is the receptacle of nectar.
