verses.sanskrit: आकाशांभोनिधिर् यो ऽसौ सोम इत्यभिधीयते आधारः सर्वभूतानां देवानाममृताकरः
verses.transliteration: ākāśāṃbhonidhir yo 'sau soma ityabhidhīyate ādhāraḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ devānāmamṛtākaraḥ
verses.translation: From this has originated the river of auspicious waters and it flows in the firmament. With nectarine waters it functions through the seventh path of the wind. This river follows the path of the luminaries. It is frequented by groups of luminaries, and by thousands and crores of stars of the sky.®® Just like the moon it also goes round and round every day.
verses.hindi: अग्नि कहा जाता है और जो अग्नि सूर्यमें तपती है, उसे शुचि आग्नि कहा गया है। विद्युत्से उत्पन्न आग्निकी अब्ज जानना चाहिए। इस प्रकार जलके गर्भसे उत्पन्न वैद्युत, जाठर तथा सौर--ये तीन अग्नियाँ हैं। अब मैं उनके लक्षणोंको बताऊँगा॥ ९--११॥
verses.wordMeaning: From this has originated the river of auspicious waters and it flows in the firmament. With nectarine waters it functions through the seventh path of the wind. This river follows the path of the luminaries. It is frequented by groups of luminaries,…
verses.commentary: Sense: From this has originated the river of auspicious waters and it flows in the firmament. With nectarine waters it functions through the seventh path of the wind. This river follows the path of the luminaries. It is frequented by groups of luminaries,…

verses.sanskrit: अस्मात्प्रवृत्ता पुण्योदा नदी त्वाकाशगामिनी सप्तमेनानिलपथा प्रवृत्ता चामृतोदका
verses.transliteration: asmātpravṛttā puṇyodā nadī tvākāśagāminī saptamenānilapathā pravṛttā cāmṛtodakā
verses.translation: After going beyond all the mountains partially it enters the great sea at the behest of lord Siva.
verses.hindi: कया ५९ पार्थिव, शुचि तथा वैद्युत नामसे अग्निके तीन रूपोंका वर्णन ट्ट
verses.wordMeaning: After going beyond all the mountains partially it enters the great sea at the behest of lord Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: After going beyond all the mountains partially it enters the great sea at the behest of lord Siva.

verses.sanskrit: सा ज्योतींष्यनुवर्तन्ती ज्योतिर्गणनिषेविता ताराकोटिसहस्राणां नभसश् च समायुता
verses.transliteration: sā jyotīṃṣyanuvartantī jyotirgaṇaniṣevitā tārākoṭisahasrāṇāṃ nabhasaś ca samāyutā
verses.translation: The Kurus in Kuruvar?a are those who have fallen down there from the heavenly world. All of them are bom by copulation. They are fond of milk®® and live on milk diet.
verses.hindi: तस्मादपः पिबन् सूर्यो गोभिदीप्यत्यसौ विभु:। विभु सूर्य अपनी किरणोंसे जलको पीते हुए जले चाब्जः समाविष्टो नाद्भिरग्निः प्रशाम्यति॥ १२ हैं। जलसे उत्पन्न अग्नि जलमें समाविष्ट रहती है और वह जलसे नहीं बुझती है। मनुष्योंके उदरे रहनेवाली अग्नि प्रशान्त नहीं होती। वह पवन अग्निज्चालायुक्त होती है, किंतु निष्प्रभ होती है, उसे जाठर अग्नि कहा गया है। यह जो अग्नि है, वह एक मण्डलके रूपमें, शुक्ल वर्णवाली तथा ऊष्मारहित होती है। सूर्यके अस्त हो जानेपर उनकी सम्पूर्ण प्रभा एक
verses.wordMeaning: The Kurus in Kuruvar?a are those who have fallen down there from the heavenly world. All of them are bom by copulation. They are fond of milk®® and live on milk diet.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Kurus in Kuruvar?a are those who have fallen down there from the heavenly world. All of them are bom by copulation. They are fond of milk®® and live on milk diet.

verses.sanskrit: परिवर्तत्यहरहो यथा सोमस्तथैव सा चत्वार्यशीतिश् च तथा सहस्राणां समुच्छ्रितः
verses.transliteration: parivartatyaharaho yathā somastathaiva sā catvāryaśītiś ca tathā sahasrāṇāṃ samucchritaḥ
verses.translation: They love one another and have qualities simillar to those of the Cakravaka birds. They are devoid of ailments and sorrow and perpetually seek happiness.
verses.hindi: पाद (चौथाई) रह जाती है। वह प्रभा रात्रिके समय अग्निमें प्रविष्ट हो जाती है, इसलिये वह दूरसे प्रकाश दिया करती है। जब सूर्य पुनः उगता है, तब पार्थिव अग्निकी उष्णता एक चरणसे सूर्यमें प्रवेश कर जाती
verses.wordMeaning: They love one another and have qualities simillar to those of the Cakravaka birds. They are devoid of ailments and sorrow and perpetually seek happiness.
verses.commentary: Sense: They love one another and have qualities simillar to those of the Cakravaka birds. They are devoid of ailments and sorrow and perpetually seek happiness.

verses.sanskrit: योजनानां महामेरुः श्रीकण्ठाक्रीडकोमलः तत्रासीनो यतः शर्वः साम्बः सह गणेश्वरैः
verses.transliteration: yojanānāṃ mahāmeruḥ śrīkaṇṭhākrīḍakomalaḥ tatrāsīno yataḥ śarvaḥ sāmbaḥ saha gaṇeśvaraiḥ
verses.translation: They live up to fourteen thousand five hundred years. They have great virility, but do not associate with other women.
verses.hindi: है, इसलिये अग्नि तपती है॥ १२-१५/२॥ सूर्य तथा अग्निके तेज प्रकाश एवं उष्ण गुण- स्वरूपवाले हैं, ये दोनों परस्पर अनृप्रवेशके कारण एक- दूसरेको आप्यायित करते हैं। मेरुके दक्षिणी तथा उत्तरी भूम्यर्धमे, जब सूर्य उदित होता हैं, तब रात्रि जलमें
verses.wordMeaning: They live up to fourteen thousand five hundred years. They have great virility, but do not associate with other women.
verses.commentary: Sense: They live up to fourteen thousand five hundred years. They have great virility, but do not associate with other women.

verses.sanskrit: क्रीडते सुचिरं कालं तस्मात्पुण्यजला शिवा गिरिं मेरुं नदी पुण्या सा प्रयाति प्रदक्षिणम्
verses.transliteration: krīḍate suciraṃ kālaṃ tasmātpuṇyajalā śivā giriṃ meruṃ nadī puṇyā sā prayāti pradakṣiṇam
verses.translation: ST. of dark complexion.
verses.hindi: प्रवेश कर जाती है, इसलिये दिनके समय रात्रिके जलमें प्रवेश करनेके कारण जल ताम्रवर्ण हो जाता है। जब सूर्य अस्त होता है, तब दिन जलमें प्रवेश कर जाता है, इसलिये रातमें जल पुनः शुक्ल वर्णवाला तथा
verses.wordMeaning: ST. of dark complexion.
verses.commentary: Sense: ST. of dark complexion.

verses.sanskrit: विभज्यमानसलिला सा जवेनानिलेन च मेरोरन्तरकूटेषु निपपात चतुर्ष्वपि
verses.transliteration: vibhajyamānasalilā sā javenānilena ca merorantarakūṭeṣu nipapāta caturṣvapi
verses.translation: Kairamay&b— retideiits of Htrmomaya Varfa.
verses.hindi: चमकीला दिखायी पड़ता है। इसी क्रमयोगसे उदय एवं अस्त दोनों समयोंमें दिन और रात दक्षिणोत्तर भूम्यर्धमें जलमें प्रवेश किया करते हैं॥ १६--२०॥ जो यह सूर्य अपनी किरणोंसे जलको पीता हुआ तपता रहता है, उसे पार्थिवाग्निमिश्रित दिव्य शुचि (अग्नि) कहा गया है । हजार पाद (किरण)-वाली यह अग्नि वृत्तकुम्भके तुल्य कही गयी है । वह अपनी हजार
verses.wordMeaning: Kairamay&b— retideiits of Htrmomaya Varfa.
verses.commentary: Sense: Kairamay&b— retideiits of Htrmomaya Varfa.

verses.sanskrit: समन्तात्समतिक्रम्य सर्वाद्रीन्प्रविभागशः नियोगाद्देवदेवस्य प्रविष्टा सा महार्णवम्
verses.transliteration: samantātsamatikramya sarvādrīnpravibhāgaśaḥ niyogāddevadevasya praviṣṭā sā mahārṇavam
verses.translation: K|lri9a|}t*--<>fiiiflk-white complexion. Contrast with KAl&h V. 12.
verses.hindi: नाडियों (किरणों)-से चारों ओरसे नदियों, समुद्रं, कूपो, बावलियों, नालों आदि स्थावर-जंगमसे जलोंको ग्रहण करती है । उसकी एक हजार नाड्या हैं; जो शीत, उष्ण और वर्षासे युक्त हैं। उनमेंसे विचित्र रूपोंवाली
verses.wordMeaning: K|lri9a|}t*--<>fiiiflk-white complexion. Contrast with KAl&h V. 12.
verses.commentary: Sense: K|lri9a|}t*--<>fiiiflk-white complexion. Contrast with KAl&h V. 12.

verses.sanskrit: अस्या विनिर्गता नद्यः शतशो ऽथ सहस्रशः सर्वद्वीपाद्रिवर्षेषु बहवः परिकीर्तिताः
verses.transliteration: asyā vinirgatā nadyaḥ śataśo 'tha sahasraśaḥ sarvadvīpādrivarṣeṣu bahavaḥ parikīrtitāḥ
verses.translation: All the residents of the Kunivarsa like the heaven- dwellers die simultaneously. They are delighted and flouri* shing. They take in all kinds of cooked rice and nectar.
verses.hindi: चार सौ नाडियाँ वर्षा करती हैं। वे भजना, माल्या, केतना तथा पतना हैं; अमृता नामवाली ये सभी रश्मियाँ वृष्टि करनेवाली हैं ॥ २९--२५॥ प्रभा सौरी तु पादेन ह्यस्तं याते दिवाकरे
verses.wordMeaning: All the residents of the Kunivarsa like the heaven- dwellers die simultaneously. They are delighted and flouri* shing. They take in all kinds of cooked rice and nectar.
verses.commentary: Sense: All the residents of the Kunivarsa like the heaven- dwellers die simultaneously. They are delighted and flouri* shing. They take in all kinds of cooked rice and nectar.

verses.sanskrit: क्षुद्रनद्यस्त्वसंख्याता गङ्गा यद्गाङ्गताम्बरात् केतुमाले नराः कालाः सर्वे पनसभोजनाः
verses.transliteration: kṣudranadyastvasaṃkhyātā gaṅgā yadgāṅgatāmbarāt ketumāle narāḥ kālāḥ sarve panasabhojanāḥ
verses.translation: They shine always like the moon; they have perpetual youth; they are dark in colour in their bodies and always wear ornaments.
verses.hindi: अग्निमाविशते रात्रौ तस्माहूरात्प्रकाशते ।
verses.wordMeaning: They shine always like the moon; they have perpetual youth; they are dark in colour in their bodies and always wear ornaments.
verses.commentary: Sense: They shine always like the moon; they have perpetual youth; they are dark in colour in their bodies and always wear ornaments.

verses.sanskrit: स्त्रियश्चोत्पलवर्णाभा जीवितं चायुतं स्मृतम् भद्राश्वे शुक्लवर्णाश् च स्त्रियश्चन्द्रांशुसंनिभाः
verses.transliteration: striyaścotpalavarṇābhā jīvitaṃ cāyutaṃ smṛtam bhadrāśve śuklavarṇāś ca striyaścandrāṃśusaṃnibhāḥ
verses.translation: Among all the sub-continents in the Jambudvipa the sub-continent of Kuruvarsa is extremely splendid. There is a magnificent palace of the moon-crested lord liva. It has the lustre of the moon.
verses.hindi: प्रकाशोष्णस्वरूपे च सौराग्नेये तु तेजसी स्थावरा जङ्गमाश्चैव वापीकुल्यादिका अपः
verses.wordMeaning: Among all the sub-continents in the Jambudvipa the sub-continent of Kuruvarsa is extremely splendid. There is a magnificent palace of the moon-crested lord liva. It has the lustre of the moon.
verses.commentary: Sense: Among all the sub-continents in the Jambudvipa the sub-continent of Kuruvarsa is extremely splendid. There is a magnificent palace of the moon-crested lord liva. It has the lustre of the moon.

verses.sanskrit: कालाम्रभोजनाः सर्वे निरातङ्का रतिप्रियाः दशवर्षसहस्राणि जीवन्ति शिवभाविताः
verses.transliteration: kālāmrabhojanāḥ sarve nirātaṅkā ratipriyāḥ daśavarṣasahasrāṇi jīvanti śivabhāvitāḥ
verses.translation: In the sub-continent Bharatavarsa* men are auspi- cious and their longevity depends on their Karmans. They are said to live for a hundred years. They are of different colours and their bodies are small.
verses.hindi: भजनाश्चैव माल्याश्च केतनाः पतनास्तथा ।
verses.wordMeaning: In the sub-continent Bharatavarsa* men are auspi- cious and their longevity depends on their Karmans. They are said to live for a hundred years. They are of different colours and their bodies are small.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the sub-continent Bharatavarsa* men are auspi- cious and their longevity depends on their Karmans. They are said to live for a hundred years. They are of different colours and their bodies are small.

verses.sanskrit: हिरण्मया इवात्यर्थम् ईश्वरार्पितचेतसः तथा रमणके जीवा न्यग्रोधफलभोजनाः
verses.transliteration: hiraṇmayā ivātyartham īśvarārpitacetasaḥ tathā ramaṇake jīvā nyagrodhaphalabhojanāḥ
verses.translation: They are engaged in the worship of different Devas; they experience the fruits of different kinds of Karmans; they are richly endowed with knowledge and with different mate- rials. They are weak and have ver.' little pleasures.
verses.hindi: हिमोद्वहाश्च ता नाड्यो रश्मयस्त्रिशताः पुनः । रेशा मेघाश्च वात्स्याश्च ह्लादिन्यो हिमसर्जनाः सोमो बिभर्ति ताभिस्तु मनुष्यपितृदेवताः
verses.wordMeaning: They are engaged in the worship of different Devas; they experience the fruits of different kinds of Karmans; they are richly endowed with knowledge and with different mate- rials. They are weak and have ver.' little pleasures.
verses.commentary: Sense: They are engaged in the worship of different Devas; they experience the fruits of different kinds of Karmans; they are richly endowed with knowledge and with different mate- rials. They are weak and have ver.' little pleasures.

verses.sanskrit: दशवर्षसहस्राणि शतानि दशपञ्च च जीवन्ति शुक्लास्ते सर्वे शिवध्यानपरायणाः
verses.transliteration: daśavarṣasahasrāṇi śatāni daśapañca ca jīvanti śuklāste sarve śivadhyānaparāyaṇāḥ
verses.translation: Some of them have gone to Indradvipa®* and some to Kaseruka. Others have gone to Tamradvipa and some to the country Gabhastimat. Some have gone to Naga- dvlpa, some to Saumyadvipa, and others to the Dvipa of Gandharvas as well as of Varuna. Some of them are Mlecchas and Pulindas born of different castes.
verses.hindi: अंशुर्विवस्वांस्त्वष्टा च पर्जन्यो विष्णुरेव च। वरुणो माघमासे तु सूर्य एव तु फाल्गुने
verses.wordMeaning: Some of them have gone to Indradvipa®* and some to Kaseruka. Others have gone to Tamradvipa and some to the country Gabhastimat. Some have gone to Naga- dvlpa, some to Saumyadvipa, and others to the Dvipa of Gandharvas as well as of Varuna.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Some of them have gone to Indradvipa®* and some to Kaseruka. Others have gone to Tamradvipa and some to the country Gabhastimat. Some have gone to Naga- dvlpa, some to Saumyadvipa, and others to the Dvipa of Gandharvas as well as of Varuna.…

verses.sanskrit: हैरण्मया महाभागा हिरण्मयवनाश्रयाः एकादश सहस्राणि शतानि दशपञ्च च
verses.transliteration: hairaṇmayā mahābhāgā hiraṇmayavanāśrayāḥ ekādaśa sahasrāṇi śatāni daśapañca ca
verses.translation: In the Eastern parts of the Dvipa are the Kiratas; in the western extremities the Yavanas; in the middle the Brahmins Ksatriyas and Vaiiyas. The Sudras are everywhere.®®
verses.hindi: पर्जन्योऽश्वयुजे मासि त्वष्टा वै कार्तिके रवि: मार्गशीर्षे भवेन्मित्रः पौषे विष्णुः सनातन: । पञ्चरश्मिसहस््राणि वरुणस्यार्ककर्मणि
verses.wordMeaning: In the Eastern parts of the Dvipa are the Kiratas; in the western extremities the Yavanas; in the middle the Brahmins Ksatriyas and Vaiiyas. The Sudras are everywhere.®®
verses.commentary: Sense: In the Eastern parts of the Dvipa are the Kiratas; in the western extremities the Yavanas; in the middle the Brahmins Ksatriyas and Vaiiyas. The Sudras are everywhere.®®

verses.sanskrit: वर्षाणां तत्र जीवन्ति अश्वत्थाशनजीवनाः हैरण्मया इवात्यर्थम् ईश्वरार्पितमानसाः
verses.transliteration: varṣāṇāṃ tatra jīvanti aśvatthāśanajīvanāḥ hairaṇmayā ivātyartham īśvarārpitamānasāḥ
verses.translation: The glorification of Bhrata is one of the common topics in the PurSas.
verses.hindi: षड्भिः सहस्रैः पूषा तु देवोंऽशुः सप्तभिस्तथा।
verses.wordMeaning: The glorification of Bhrata is one of the common topics in the PurSas.
verses.commentary: Sense: The glorification of Bhrata is one of the common topics in the PurSas.

verses.sanskrit: कुरुवर्षे तु कुरवः स्वर्गलोकात् परिच्युताः सर्वे मैथुनजाताश् च क्षीरिणः क्षीरभोजनाः
verses.transliteration: kuruvarṣe tu kuravaḥ svargalokāt paricyutāḥ sarve maithunajātāś ca kṣīriṇaḥ kṣīrabhojanāḥ
verses.translation: Bh&rata is one of the nine khanas of Jambudvipa; the other eight being Indradvlpa, Kaserumim, Tamra-varna, Gabhastiman, Naga, Saumya, Gandharva, and Varuna.
verses.hindi: विवस्वान् दशभिर्याति यात्येकादशभिर्भग: । सप्तभिस्तपते मित्रस्त्वष्टा चैवाष्टभिः स्मृतः षड्भी रश्मिसहस्रैस्तु विष्णुस्तपति मेदिनीम्
verses.wordMeaning: Bh&rata is one of the nine khanas of Jambudvipa; the other eight being Indradvlpa, Kaserumim, Tamra-varna, Gabhastiman, Naga, Saumya, Gandharva, and Varuna.
verses.commentary: Sense: Bh&rata is one of the nine khanas of Jambudvipa; the other eight being Indradvlpa, Kaserumim, Tamra-varna, Gabhastiman, Naga, Saumya, Gandharva, and Varuna.

verses.sanskrit: अन्योन्यमनुरक्ताश् च चक्रवाकसधर्मिणः अनामया ह्यशोकाश् च नित्यं सुखनिषेविणः
verses.transliteration: anyonyamanuraktāś ca cakravākasadharmiṇaḥ anāmayā hyaśokāś ca nityaṃ sukhaniṣeviṇaḥ
verses.translation: The Puranas are conscious of the foreign tribes that surrounded Bharata (cf. Mata, 50. 75-76; Mark, 57,8.). The Kiratas mentioned along the eastern limits are probably the uncivilized tribes of the forests and mountains with the Burmese type of features. The Yavanas in the virest are Greeks originally and afterwards the Mohammedans.
verses.hindi: वसन्ते कपिलः सूर्यो ग्रीष्मे काञ्चनसप्रभः। श्वेतो वर्षासु वर्णेन पाण्डुः शरदि भास्करः
verses.wordMeaning: The Puranas are conscious of the foreign tribes that surrounded Bharata (cf. Mata, 50. 75-76; Mark, 57,8.). The Kiratas mentioned along the eastern limits are probably the uncivilized tribes of the forests and mountains with the Burmese type of features.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The Puranas are conscious of the foreign tribes that surrounded Bharata (cf. Mata, 50. 75-76; Mark, 57,8.). The Kiratas mentioned along the eastern limits are probably the uncivilized tribes of the forests and mountains with the Burmese type of features.…

verses.sanskrit: त्रयोदशसहस्राणि शतानि दशपञ्च च जीवन्ति ते महावीर्या न चान्यस्त्रीनिषेविणः
verses.transliteration: trayodaśasahasrāṇi śatāni daśapañca ca jīvanti te mahāvīryā na cānyastrīniṣeviṇaḥ
verses.translation: They are established there maintaining themselves by worship, warfare and business dealings (respectively). Mutual dealings in connection with the activities of the dif- ferent castes are related only to virtue, wealth and love. They are interested in their own duties. The conception and pride in performing the duties of the various stages of life are maintained properly.
verses.hindi: तीन सौ हिमवाहिनी नाड़ियाँ हैं। वे रेशा, न वात्स्या तथा ह्लादिनी हैं; चन्द्रभा नामवाली बे सभी रश्मियाँ हिमका सर्जन करनेवाली हैं और पीत आभाबाली हैं। शुक्ला, ककुभा, गौ तथा विश्वभूत्--ये रश्मियाँ शुक्ला नामवाली हैं; वे सब तीन सौ रश्मियाँ ऊषा उत्पन्न करनेवाली हैं। चन्द्रमा उन तीनों किरणोंके हारा  मनुष्य, पितृगणों तथा देवताओंका भरण करता है। वह  मनुष्योंको औषधिसे, पितरोंको स्वधासे और सभी
verses.wordMeaning: They are established there maintaining themselves by worship, warfare and business dealings (respectively). Mutual dealings in connection with the activities of the dif- ferent castes are related only to virtue, wealth and love. They are interested in their own duties.…
verses.commentary: Sense: They are established there maintaining themselves by worship, warfare and business dealings (respectively). Mutual dealings in connection with the activities of the dif- ferent castes are related only to virtue, wealth and love. They are interested in their own duties.…

verses.sanskrit: सहैव मरणं तेषां कुरूणां स्वर्गवासिनाम् हृष्टानां सुप्रवृद्धानां सर्वान्नामृतभोजिनाम्
verses.transliteration: sahaiva maraṇaṃ teṣāṃ kurūṇāṃ svargavāsinām hṛṣṭānāṃ supravṛddhānāṃ sarvānnāmṛtabhojinām
verses.translation: It is only here that human beings endeavour for hea- venly pleasures and salvation. O leading sages, only here they pursue the duties specified for each yuga,®*® not elsewhere.
verses.hindi: वह सूर्य वसन्त तथा ग्रीष्ममें तीन सौ किरणोंसे तपता है, वर्षा तथा शरद्में चार सौ किरणोंसे वर्षा करता है और हेमन्त तथा शिशिरमें तीन सौ किरणोंसे हिम छोड़ता है। इन्द्र, धाता, भग, पूषा, मित्र, वरुण, अर्यमा,
verses.wordMeaning: It is only here that human beings endeavour for hea- venly pleasures and salvation. O leading sages, only here they pursue the duties specified for each yuga,®*® not elsewhere.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is only here that human beings endeavour for hea- venly pleasures and salvation. O leading sages, only here they pursue the duties specified for each yuga,®*® not elsewhere.

verses.sanskrit: सदा तु चन्द्रकान्तानां सदा यौवनशालिनाम् श्यामाङ्गानां सदा सर्वभूषणास्पददेहिनाम्
verses.transliteration: sadā tu candrakāntānāṃ sadā yauvanaśālinām śyāmāṅgānāṃ sadā sarvabhūṣaṇāspadadehinām
verses.translation: In the sub-continent Kimpurusa men live up to ten thousand years. Men are golden-complexioned and women resemble the celestial damsels.
verses.hindi: अंशु, विवस्वान्, त्वष्टा, पर्जन्य और विष्णु--ये बारह सूर्य हैं। वरुण माघमासमें सूर्य है एवं पूषा फाल्गुनमासमें सूर्य है। अंशु चैत्रमासमें सूर्य होता है और धाता वैशाखमासमें सूर्य होता है । इन्द्र ज्येष्ठमासमें सूर्य होता है और अर्यमा आषाढ्मासमें सूर्य होता है । विवस्वान् श्रावणमासमें और भग भाद्रपदमासमें सूर्य कहा गया है । पर्जन्य आश्विन मासमें सूर्य होता है और त्वष्टा कार्तिकमासमें सूर्य होता है । मित्र मार्गशीर्षमासमें सूर्य
verses.wordMeaning: In the sub-continent Kimpurusa men live up to ten thousand years. Men are golden-complexioned and women resemble the celestial damsels.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the sub-continent Kimpurusa men live up to ten thousand years. Men are golden-complexioned and women resemble the celestial damsels.

verses.sanskrit: जंबूद्वीपे तु तत्रापि कुरुवर्षं सुशोभनम् तत्र चन्द्रप्रभं शम्भोर् विमानं चन्द्रमौलिनः
verses.transliteration: jaṃbūdvīpe tu tatrāpi kuruvarṣaṃ suśobhanam tatra candraprabhaṃ śambhor vimānaṃ candramaulinaḥ
verses.translation: They are devoid of ailments and sorrow. They are all purified by meditations on Siva. They have Sattva qualities and the lustre of gold. They live on Plaksa fruits along with their wives,
verses.hindi: होता है और सनातन विष्णु पौषमासमें सूर्य होता है॥ ३०-३४१/२ ॥
verses.wordMeaning: They are devoid of ailments and sorrow. They are all purified by meditations on Siva. They have Sattva qualities and the lustre of gold. They live on Plaksa fruits along with their wives,
verses.commentary: Sense: They are devoid of ailments and sorrow. They are all purified by meditations on Siva. They have Sattva qualities and the lustre of gold. They live on Plaksa fruits along with their wives,

verses.sanskrit: वर्षे तु भारते मर्त्याः पुण्याः कर्मवशायुषः शतायुषः समाख्याता नानावर्णाल्पदेहिनः
verses.transliteration: varṣe tu bhārate martyāḥ puṇyāḥ karmavaśāyuṣaḥ śatāyuṣaḥ samākhyātā nānāvarṇālpadehinaḥ
verses.translation: The people there have the lustre of lotuses. Their faces resemble the lotus. Their eyes are like the petals of the lotus. They have the fragrance of the petals of the lotus. They are purified by their meditation on Siva.
verses.hindi: सूर्यसम्बन्धी कर्में वरुणकी पाँच हजार रश्मियाँ होती हैं। पूषा छः हजार किरणोंसे, अंशुदेव सात हजार किरणोंसे, धाता आठ हजार किरणोंसे और इन्द्र नौ हजार किरणोंसे सूर्यकर्म करते हैं। विवस्वान् दस हजार किरणोंसे गमन करता है और भग ग्यारह हजार किरणोंसे गमन करता है। मित्र सात हजार रश्मियोंसे तपता है  त्वष्टा आठ हजार किरणोंसे युक्त कहा गया है। अर्यमा दस हजार किरणोंसे तथा पर्जन्य नौ हजार
verses.wordMeaning: The people there have the lustre of lotuses. Their faces resemble the lotus. Their eyes are like the petals of the lotus. They have the fragrance of the petals of the lotus. They are purified by their meditation on Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: The people there have the lustre of lotuses. Their faces resemble the lotus. Their eyes are like the petals of the lotus. They have the fragrance of the petals of the lotus. They are purified by their meditation on Siva.

verses.sanskrit: नानादेवार्चने युक्ता नानाकर्मफलाशिनः नानाज्ञानार्थसम्पन्ना दुर्बलाश्चाल्पभोगिनः
verses.transliteration: nānādevārcane yuktā nānākarmaphalāśinaḥ nānājñānārthasampannā durbalāścālpabhoginaḥ
verses.translation: The juice of the Jambu fruits constitutes their diet. They are sweet-scented. They have no duties to perform.®® They have come there from the world of Devas and have neither death nor old age.
verses.hindi: किरणोंसे गमन करता है। विष्णु नामक सूर्य छः हजार रश्मियोंसे पृथ्चीपर तपता है
verses.wordMeaning: The juice of the Jambu fruits constitutes their diet. They are sweet-scented. They have no duties to perform.®® They have come there from the world of Devas and have neither death nor old age.
verses.commentary: Sense: The juice of the Jambu fruits constitutes their diet. They are sweet-scented. They have no duties to perform.®® They have come there from the world of Devas and have neither death nor old age.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रद्वीपे तथा केचित् तथैव च कसेरुके ताम्रद्वीपं गताः केचित् केचिद्देशं गभस्तिमत्
verses.transliteration: indradvīpe tathā kecit tathaiva ca kaseruke tāmradvīpaṃ gatāḥ kecit keciddeśaṃ gabhastimat
verses.translation: Since Bharata alone it Karma-Bhumi (land for performing action) » the yuga-dharmas (duties pertaining to yugas) prevail only here. Of. Vifiju cited in ST,
verses.hindi: Fs बलन्त-ऋतुमें कपिल वर्णके और ग्रीष्म- ऋतुमें स्वर्णकी प्रभावाले होते हैं। वे सूर्य वर्षाऋतुमें मंगल, बुध, बृहस्पति, शनि आदि ग्रहों एवं सूर्यके माहात्म्यका वर्णन
verses.wordMeaning: Since Bharata alone it Karma-Bhumi (land for performing action) » the yuga-dharmas (duties pertaining to yugas) prevail only here. Of. Vifiju cited in ST,
verses.commentary: Sense: Since Bharata alone it Karma-Bhumi (land for performing action) » the yuga-dharmas (duties pertaining to yugas) prevail only here. Of. Vifiju cited in ST,

verses.sanskrit: नागद्वीपं तथा सौम्यं गान्धर्वं वारुणं गताः केचिन्म्लेच्छाः पुलिन्दाश् च नानाजातिसमुद्भवाः
verses.transliteration: nāgadvīpaṃ tathā saumyaṃ gāndharvaṃ vāruṇaṃ gatāḥ kecinmlecchāḥ pulindāś ca nānājātisamudbhavāḥ
verses.translation: In the divine sub-continent Ilavrta, the excellent men live their full span of life which is thirteen thousand years.
verses.hindi: ऊ फी जी फा फ फा फा फ फ फ फ फ़ फ फ फ फ फ फ फ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ फ फ फ फ फ फ़ क फ़ फ फ़ फ़ फ फ फा फ़ म क की
verses.wordMeaning: In the divine sub-continent Ilavrta, the excellent men live their full span of life which is thirteen thousand years.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the divine sub-continent Ilavrta, the excellent men live their full span of life which is thirteen thousand years.

verses.sanskrit: पूर्वे किरातास्तस्यान्ते पश्चिमे यवनाः स्मृताः ब्राह्मणाः क्षत्रिया वैश्या मध्ये शूद्राश् च सर्वशः
verses.transliteration: pūrve kirātāstasyānte paścime yavanāḥ smṛtāḥ brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyā madhye śūdrāś ca sarvaśaḥ
verses.translation: By drinking the juice of the Jambu fruits they are not afflicted by old age. They have neither hunger nor fatigue. They do not die a premature death.
verses.hindi: एवं रश्मिसहस्त्रं तत्सौरं लोकार्थसाधकम्। भिद्यते लोकमासाद्य जलशीतोष्णनिःस्रवम् इत्येतन्मण्डलं शुक्लं भास्करं सूर्यसंज्ञितम्। नक्षत्रग्रहसोमानां प्रतिष्ठायोनिरिव च
verses.wordMeaning: By drinking the juice of the Jambu fruits they are not afflicted by old age. They have neither hunger nor fatigue. They do not die a premature death.
verses.commentary: Sense: By drinking the juice of the Jambu fruits they are not afflicted by old age. They have neither hunger nor fatigue. They do not die a premature death.

verses.sanskrit: इज्यायुद्धवणिज्याभिर् वर्तयन्तो व्यवस्थिताः तेषां संव्यवहारो ऽयं वर्तते ऽत्र परस्परम्
verses.transliteration: ijyāyuddhavaṇijyābhir vartayanto vyavasthitāḥ teṣāṃ saṃvyavahāro 'yaṃ vartate 'tra parasparam
verses.translation: The gold found there is called Jambunada. It is the divine metal. It shines and resembles a glow-worm,
verses.hindi: नयनं चैवमीशस्य दक्षिणं भास्करः स्वयम्।
verses.wordMeaning: The gold found there is called Jambunada. It is the divine metal. It shines and resembles a glow-worm,
verses.commentary: Sense: The gold found there is called Jambunada. It is the divine metal. It shines and resembles a glow-worm,

verses.sanskrit: धर्मार्थकामसंयुक्तो वर्णानां तु स्वकर्मसु संकल्पश्चाभिमानश् च आश्रमाणां यथाविधि
verses.transliteration: dharmārthakāmasaṃyukto varṇānāṃ tu svakarmasu saṃkalpaścābhimānaś ca āśramāṇāṃ yathāvidhi
verses.translation: Thus the persons occupying the nine sub-continents have been recounted by me. Their colour, span of life, diet and other things have been succinctly mentioned and not in detail.
verses.hindi: और शरद्-ऋतुमें पाण्डुवर्णके होते हैं। रवि हेमन्त-ऋतुमें ताम्र वर्णवाले और शिशिर-ऋतुमें लोहित वर्णवाले होते हैं। इस प्रकार मैंने सूर्यमें होनेवाले रंगोंका वर्णन किया सूर्य औषधियोंको बल देते हैं, स्वधासे पितरोंको तृप्त करते हैं और देवताओंको अमृत प्रदान करते हैं, इस प्रकार वे उन तीनोंको तीन वस्तुएँ. देते हैं। इस प्रकार सूर्यकी वे हजारों किरणें लोककल्याण करती हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the persons occupying the nine sub-continents have been recounted by me. Their colour, span of life, diet and other things have been succinctly mentioned and not in detail.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the persons occupying the nine sub-continents have been recounted by me. Their colour, span of life, diet and other things have been succinctly mentioned and not in detail.

verses.sanskrit: इह स्वर्गापवर्गार्थं प्रवृत्तिर्यत्र मानुषी तेषां च युगकर्माणि नान्यत्र मुनिपुङ्गवाः
verses.transliteration: iha svargāpavargārthaṃ pravṛttiryatra mānuṣī teṣāṃ ca yugakarmāṇi nānyatra munipuṅgavāḥ
verses.translation: It should be known that the Gandharvas, and celestial nymphs reside in Hemakuta. Sesa, Vasuki, Taksaka and all others live in Nisadha. The very strong Brahmanas called Yajftikas live on sacrifices. They number thirty three thousands and they live happily on the mountain Nila, full of lapis lazuli, the Siddhas and Brahmarsis devoid of impurities.
verses.hindi: शीत, उष्ण तथा वर्षा करनेवाली ये किरणें 'लोकमें पहुँचकर भिन्न-भिन्न रूप धारण करती हैं
verses.wordMeaning: It should be known that the Gandharvas, and celestial nymphs reside in Hemakuta. Sesa, Vasuki, Taksaka and all others live in Nisadha. The very strong Brahmanas called Yajftikas live on sacrifices. They number thirty three thousands and they live happily on the mountain Nila,…
verses.commentary: Sense: It should be known that the Gandharvas, and celestial nymphs reside in Hemakuta. Sesa, Vasuki, Taksaka and all others live in Nisadha. The very strong Brahmanas called Yajftikas live on sacrifices. They number thirty three thousands and they live happily on the mountain Nila,…

verses.sanskrit: दशवर्षसहस्राणि स्थितिः किंपुरुषे नृणाम् सुवर्णवर्णाश् च नराः स्त्रियश्चाप्सरसोपमाः
verses.transliteration: daśavarṣasahasrāṇi sthitiḥ kiṃpuruṣe nṛṇām suvarṇavarṇāś ca narāḥ striyaścāpsarasopamāḥ
verses.translation: It should be known that the Gandharvas, and celestial nymphs reside in Hemakuta. Sesa, Vasuki, Taksaka and all others live in Nisadha. The very strong Brahmanas called Yajftikas live on sacrifices. They number thirty three thousands and they live happily on the mountain Nila, full of lapis lazuli, the Siddhas and Brahmarsis devoid of impurities.
verses.hindi: शुक्ल वर्णवाला तथा देदीप्यमान यह मण्डल सूर्य नामवाला है । यह नक्षत्रों, ग्रहों एवं चन्द्रमाको प्रतिष्ठाका कारण है। चन्द्रमा, नक्षत्र तथा ग्रह-इन सभीको सूर्यसे उत्पन्न जानना चाहिए। चन्द्रमा नक्षत्रका अधिपति है और शिवजीका बायाँ नेत्र है। स्वयं सूर्य शिवजीके दाहिने नेत्र हैं। वे इस लोकमें लोगोंको ले जाते हैं,
verses.wordMeaning: It should be known that the Gandharvas, and celestial nymphs reside in Hemakuta. Sesa, Vasuki, Taksaka and all others live in Nisadha. The very strong Brahmanas called Yajftikas live on sacrifices. They number thirty three thousands and they live happily on the mountain Nila,…
verses.commentary: Sense: It should be known that the Gandharvas, and celestial nymphs reside in Hemakuta. Sesa, Vasuki, Taksaka and all others live in Nisadha. The very strong Brahmanas called Yajftikas live on sacrifices. They number thirty three thousands and they live happily on the mountain Nila,…

verses.sanskrit: अनामया ह्यशोकाश् च सर्वे ते शिवभाविताः शुद्धसत्त्वाश् च हेमाभाः सदाराः प्लक्षभोजनाः
verses.transliteration: anāmayā hyaśokāś ca sarve te śivabhāvitāḥ śuddhasattvāś ca hemābhāḥ sadārāḥ plakṣabhojanāḥ
verses.translation: It should be known that the Gandharvas, and celestial nymphs reside in Hemakuta. Sesa, Vasuki, Taksaka and all others live in Nisadha. The very strong Brahmanas called Yajftikas live on sacrifices. They number thirty three thousands and they live happily on the mountain Nila, full of lapis lazuli, the Siddhas and Brahmarsis devoid of impurities.
verses.hindi: तेषां जनानां लोकेस्मिन्नयनं नयते यतः ॥ ४५  इसीलिये ये नयन कहे जाते हैं ॥ ४३--४५॥
verses.wordMeaning: It should be known that the Gandharvas, and celestial nymphs reside in Hemakuta. Sesa, Vasuki, Taksaka and all others live in Nisadha. The very strong Brahmanas called Yajftikas live on sacrifices. They number thirty three thousands and they live happily on the mountain Nila,…

The very strong Brahmanas called Yajftikas live on sacrifices. verses.hindi: उपेन्द्र, चन्द्रमा, श्रेष्ठ ब्राह्मणों, अग्नि एवं देवताओं... इन सब द्युतिसम्पन्न देवोंकी झुति हैं। उनका जो  सम्पूर्ण तेज है, वह सार्वलौकिक है। वे सबकी  आत्मा, सभी लोकोंके ईश्वर, महादेव और प्रजापति हैं। सूर्य ही तीनों लोकोंके ईश, सबके कारणस्वरूप  एवं परम देवता हैं। उन्हींसे सब कुछ उत्पन्न होता है और उन्हींमें विलीन हो जाता है॥ ६--८ ॥
verses.wordMeaning: It should be known that the Gandharvas, and celestial nymphs reside in Hemakuta. Sesa, Vasuki, Taksaka and all others live in Nisadha. The very strong Brahmanas called Yajftikas live on sacrifices. They number thirty three thousands and they live happily on the mountain Nila,…
verses.commentary: Sense: It should be known that the Gandharvas, and celestial nymphs reside in Hemakuta. Sesa, Vasuki, Taksaka and all others live in Nisadha. The very strong Brahmanas called Yajftikas live on sacrifices. They number thirty three thousands and they live happily on the mountain Nila,…

verses.sanskrit: सिद्धैर्देवैश् च पितृभिर् दृष्टो नित्यं विशेषतः नीलश् च वैडूर्यमयः श्वेतः शुक्लो हिरण्मयः
verses.transliteration: siddhairdevaiś ca pitṛbhir dṛṣṭo nityaṃ viśeṣataḥ nīlaś ca vaiḍūryamayaḥ śvetaḥ śuklo hiraṇmayaḥ
verses.translation: It should be known that the Gandharvas, and celestial nymphs reside in Hemakuta. Sesa, Vasuki, Taksaka and all others live in Nisadha. The very strong Brahmanas called Yajftikas live on sacrifices. They number thirty three thousands and they live happily on the mountain Nila, full of lapis lazuli, the Siddhas and Brahmarsis devoid of impurities.
verses.hindi: लोकोंके भाव तथा अभाव पूर्वकालमें आदित्यसे ही निकले थे। है विप्रो! उत्तम प्रभावाला दीप्तिमान् सूर्य नामक ग्रह अविज्ञेय है
verses.wordMeaning: It should be known that the Gandharvas, and celestial nymphs reside in Hemakuta. Sesa, Vasuki, Taksaka and all others live in Nisadha. The very strong Brahmanas called Yajftikas live on sacrifices. They number thirty three thousands and they live happily on the mountain Nila,…
verses.commentary: Sense: It should be known that the Gandharvas, and celestial nymphs reside in Hemakuta. Sesa, Vasuki, Taksaka and all others live in Nisadha. The very strong Brahmanas called Yajftikas live on sacrifices. They number thirty three thousands and they live happily on the mountain Nila,…

verses.sanskrit: मयूरबर्हवर्णस्तु शातकुंभस् त्रिशृङ्गवान् एते पर्वतराजानो जंबूद्वीपे व्यवस्थिताः
verses.transliteration: mayūrabarhavarṇastu śātakuṃbhas triśṛṅgavān ete parvatarājāno jaṃbūdvīpe vyavasthitāḥ
verses.translation: It should be known that the Gandharvas, and celestial nymphs reside in Hemakuta. Sesa, Vasuki, Taksaka and all others live in Nisadha. The very strong Brahmanas called Yajftikas live on sacrifices. They number thirty three thousands and they live happily on the mountain Nila, full of lapis lazuli, the Siddhas and Brahmarsis devoid of impurities.
verses.hindi: (वर्ष), ऋतु तथा युग इन्हीं सूर्यसे बार-बार उत्पन्न होते हैं और इन्हींमें समाप्त होते हैं। इसलिये सूर्यके बिना यह कालगणना नहीं होती है। कालके बिना न नियम हो सकता है, न दीक्षा हो सकती है और न हैनिक कृत्य ही हो सकता है। इनके बिना ऋतुओंका विभाजन, पुष्प मूल तथा फल कैसे हो सकते हैं? धान्यकी उत्पत्ति कैसे सम्भव है और तृण तथा औषधियाँ भी कैसे हो सकती हैं? जगतको तपानेवाले रुद्ररूप
verses.wordMeaning: It should be known that the Gandharvas, and celestial nymphs reside in Hemakuta. Sesa, Vasuki, Taksaka and all others live in Nisadha. The very strong Brahmanas called Yajftikas live on sacrifices. They number thirty three thousands and they live happily on the mountain Nila,…
verses.commentary: Sense: It should be known that the Gandharvas, and celestial nymphs reside in Hemakuta. Sesa, Vasuki, Taksaka and all others live in Nisadha. The very strong Brahmanas called Yajftikas live on sacrifices. They number thirty three thousands and they live happily on the mountain Nila,…

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीलिङ्गमहापुराणे पूर्वभागे भुवनकोशस्वभाववर्णनं नाम द्विपञ्चाशत्तमो ऽध्यायः प्लक्षद्वीपादिद्वीपेषु सप्त सप्तसु पर्वताः ऋज्वायताः प्रतिदिशं निविष्टा वर्षपर्वताः
verses.transliteration: iti śrīliṅgamahāpurāṇe pūrvabhāge bhuvanakośasvabhāvavarṇanaṃ nāma dvipañcāśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ plakṣadvīpādidvīpeṣu sapta saptasu parvatāḥ ṛjvāyatāḥ pratidiśaṃ niviṣṭā varṣaparvatāḥ
verses.translation: There are seven important mountains in each of the seven Dvipas beginning with Plaksa. They extend straight in all directions and form the boundaries of the great continents,
verses.hindi: भास्करके बिना इस लोकमें तथा स्वर्गमें प्राणियोंके व्यवहारका अभाव हो जायगा। वे ही काल, अग्नि, द्वादश आत्मा तथा प्रजापति हैं ॥ १०--१४॥
verses.wordMeaning: There are seven important mountains in each of the seven Dvipas beginning with Plaksa. They extend straight in all directions and form the boundaries of the great continents,
verses.commentary: Sense: There are seven important mountains in each of the seven Dvipas beginning with Plaksa. They extend straight in all directions and form the boundaries of the great continents,

verses.sanskrit: प्लक्षद्वीपे तु वक्ष्यामि सप्त दिव्यान् महाचलान् गोमेदको ऽत्र प्रथमो द्वितीयश्चान्द्र उच्यते
verses.transliteration: plakṣadvīpe tu vakṣyāmi sapta divyān mahācalān gomedako 'tra prathamo dvitīyaścāndra ucyate
verses.translation: I shall mention the seven great mountains in the Plaksadvipa. The first mountain is Gomedaka; the second is Candra; the third is Narada; the fourth is Dundubhi; the fifth is Somaka; the sixth Sumanas, the same is called Vaibhava; the seventh is Vaibhraja. These are the seven important moun-- tains in the Plaksa Dvipa.
verses.hindi: त्रैलोक्यको प्रकाश देते हैं। ये ही तेजोंकी राशि, सम्पूर्ण स्वरूपवाले तथा सार्वलौकिक हैं। उत्तम मार्गका आश्रय लेकर ये सूर्य ही इस जगत्को पार्श्वभागसे, ऊपरसे, नीचेसे, सभी ओरसे दिन-रात ताप प्रदान करते हैं। जिस प्रकार घरमें रखा हुआ प्रभा करनेवाला दीपक पार्श्वभागमें, ऊपर तथा नीचे समान रूपसे अन्धकारका नाश करता है, उसी तरह हजार किरणोंवाले ग्रहोंके राजा एवं जगतूके स्वामी सूर्य अपनी किरणोंसे सारे
verses.wordMeaning: I shall mention the seven great mountains in the Plaksadvipa. The first mountain is Gomedaka; the second is Candra; the third is Narada; the fourth is Dundubhi; the fifth is Somaka; the sixth Sumanas, the same is called Vaibhava; the seventh is Vaibhraja.…
verses.commentary: Sense: I shall mention the seven great mountains in the Plaksadvipa. The first mountain is Gomedaka; the second is Candra; the third is Narada; the fourth is Dundubhi; the fifth is Somaka; the sixth Sumanas, the same is called Vaibhava; the seventh is Vaibhraja.…

verses.sanskrit: तृतीयो नारदो नाम चतुर्थो दुन्दुभिः स्मृतः पञ्चमः सोमको नाम सुमनाः षष्ठ उच्यते
verses.transliteration: tṛtīyo nārado nāma caturtho dundubhiḥ smṛtaḥ pañcamaḥ somako nāma sumanāḥ ṣaṣṭha ucyate
verses.translation: There are only seven important mountains in the Salmalidvipa. I shall mention them in order. They arc Kumuda, Uttama, Balahaka Drona, Kanka, Mahisa and Kakudman.
verses.hindi: जगत्को सभी ओरसे प्रकाशित करते हैं॥ १५--१८॥
verses.wordMeaning: There are only seven important mountains in the Salmalidvipa. I shall mention them in order. They arc Kumuda, Uttama, Balahaka Drona, Kanka, Mahisa and Kakudman.
verses.commentary: Sense: There are only seven important mountains in the Salmalidvipa. I shall mention them in order. They arc Kumuda, Uttama, Balahaka Drona, Kanka, Mahisa and Kakudman.

verses.sanskrit: स एव वैभवः प्रोक्तो वैभ्राजः सप्तमः स्मृतः सप्तैते गिरयः प्रोक्ताः प्लक्षद्वीपे विशेषतः
verses.transliteration: sa eva vaibhavaḥ prokto vaibhrājaḥ saptamaḥ smṛtaḥ saptaite girayaḥ proktāḥ plakṣadvīpe viśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: The bull-emblemed lord of the universe Siva, the deity without impurities, stays there in person in an excellent golden palace accompanied by Uma and Nandin.
verses.hindi: ज्योतिःसन्निवेशमें ग्रहोंके स्वरूपका वर्णन हरिकेशश्च विश्वकर्मा तथेव च।
verses.wordMeaning: The bull-emblemed lord of the universe Siva, the deity without impurities, stays there in person in an excellent golden palace accompanied by Uma and Nandin.
verses.commentary: Sense: The bull-emblemed lord of the universe Siva, the deity without impurities, stays there in person in an excellent golden palace accompanied by Uma and Nandin.

verses.sanskrit: सप्त वै शाल्मलिद्वीपे तांस्तु वक्ष्याम्यनुक्रमात् कुमुदश्चोत्तमश्चैव पर्वतश् च बलाहकः
verses.transliteration: sapta vai śālmalidvīpe tāṃstu vakṣyāmyanukramāt kumudaścottamaścaiva parvataś ca balāhakaḥ
verses.translation: There are two meritorious and splendid Janapadas on either side of the Manasa mountain, and shining like silver. The sub-continent Mahavita*® is on the exterior of the Manasa. The Janapada in the interior is called Dhatakikhanda.*
verses.hindi: सर्वावसुः पुनश्चान्यः स्वराडन्यः प्रकीर्तितः । सुषुम्नः सूर्यरश्मिस्तु दक्षिणां राशिमैधयत्
verses.wordMeaning: There are two meritorious and splendid Janapadas on either side of the Manasa mountain, and shining like silver. The sub-continent Mahavita*® is on the exterior of the Manasa. The Janapada in the interior is called Dhatakikhanda.*
verses.commentary: Sense: There are two meritorious and splendid Janapadas on either side of the Manasa mountain, and shining like silver. The sub-continent Mahavita*® is on the exterior of the Manasa. The Janapada in the interior is called Dhatakikhanda.*

verses.sanskrit: द्रोणः कङ्कश् च महिषः ककुद्मान् सप्तमः स्मृतः कुशद्वीपे तु सप्तैव द्वीपाश् च कुलपर्वताः
verses.transliteration: droṇaḥ kaṅkaś ca mahiṣaḥ kakudmān saptamaḥ smṛtaḥ kuśadvīpe tu saptaiva dvīpāś ca kulaparvatāḥ
verses.translation: The Puskara Dvipa is surrounded by the ocean of sweet water. All round this ocean extends to as much area as the Puskara Dvipa. In girth and extent it is equal to Puskara.
verses.hindi: न्यगूर्ध्वाध: प्रचारोऽस्य सुषुम्नः परिकीर्तित: । हरिकेशः पुरस्ताद्यो ऋक्षयोनिः प्रकीर्त्यते दक्षिणे विश्वकर्मा च रश्मिर्वर्धयते बुधम्।
verses.wordMeaning: The Puskara Dvipa is surrounded by the ocean of sweet water. All round this ocean extends to as much area as the Puskara Dvipa. In girth and extent it is equal to Puskara.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Puskara Dvipa is surrounded by the ocean of sweet water. All round this ocean extends to as much area as the Puskara Dvipa. In girth and extent it is equal to Puskara.

verses.sanskrit: तांस्तु संक्षेपतो वक्ष्ये नाममात्रेण वै क्रमात् विद्रुमः प्रथमः प्रोक्तो द्वितीयो हेमपर्वतः
verses.transliteration: tāṃstu saṃkṣepato vakṣye nāmamātreṇa vai kramāt vidrumaḥ prathamaḥ prokto dvitīyo hemaparvataḥ
verses.translation: The seventh ocean is beyond all Dvipas. Thus the comparative sizes of dvipas and oceans are stated.
verses.hindi: एवं सूर्यप्रभावेन नक्षत्रग्रहतारकाः॥
verses.wordMeaning: The seventh ocean is beyond all Dvipas. Thus the comparative sizes of dvipas and oceans are stated.
verses.commentary: Sense: The seventh ocean is beyond all Dvipas. Thus the comparative sizes of dvipas and oceans are stated.

verses.sanskrit: तृतीयो द्युतिमान्नाम चतुर्थः पुष्पितः स्मृतः कुशेशयः पञ्चमस्तु षष्ठो हरिगिरिः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: tṛtīyo dyutimānnāma caturthaḥ puṣpitaḥ smṛtaḥ kuśeśayaḥ pañcamastu ṣaṣṭho harigiriḥ smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: The great ocean of sweet waters is stationed envelop- ing the Puskara.
verses.hindi: मैं सूर्यकी जिन हजार किरणोंको पहले बता चुका हूँ, उनमें सात श्रेष्ठ किरणें ग्रहोंको उत्पन्न करनेवाली हैं। वे सुषुम्ना, हरिकेश, विश्वकर्मा, विश्वव्यचा, सन्नद्ध, सर्वावसु और स्वराट् नामवाली कही गयी हैं। सूर्यकी सुषुम्ना नामक रश्मि दक्षिण राशिकी वृद्धि करती है। इस सुषुम्नाका गमन पार्श्व, ऊपर तथा नीचे सभी ओर कहा गया है। सामनेकी ओर जो हरिकेश रश्मि है, उसे नक्षत्रोंकी योनि कहा जाता है।
verses.wordMeaning: The great ocean of sweet waters is stationed envelop- ing the Puskara.
verses.commentary: Sense: The great ocean of sweet waters is stationed envelop- ing the Puskara.

verses.sanskrit: सप्तमो मन्दरः श्रीमान् महादेवनिकेतनम् मन्दा इति ह्यपां नाम मन्दरो धारणाद् अपाम्
verses.transliteration: saptamo mandaraḥ śrīmān mahādevaniketanam mandā iti hyapāṃ nāma mandaro dhāraṇād apām
verses.translation: Beyond that is the situation of the world. The earth is golden and twice in extent. The entire thing is comparable to a single rock.
verses.hindi: विश्वकर्मा नामक रश्मि दक्षिणमें बुधको विकसित करती है। पीछेकी ओर जो विश्वव्यचा नामक रश्मि है, उसे विद्वानोंने शुक्रकी योनि कहा है। जो सन्नद्ध नामक रश्मि है, वह मंगलकी योनि है। छठी जो
verses.wordMeaning: Beyond that is the situation of the world. The earth is golden and twice in extent. The entire thing is comparable to a single rock.
verses.commentary: Sense: Beyond that is the situation of the world. The earth is golden and twice in extent. The entire thing is comparable to a single rock.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र साक्षाद्वृषाङ्कस्तु विश्वेशो विमलः शिवः सोमः सनन्दी भगवान् आस्ते हेमगृहोत्तमे
verses.transliteration: tatra sākṣādvṛṣāṅkastu viśveśo vimalaḥ śivaḥ somaḥ sanandī bhagavān āste hemagṛhottame
verses.translation: Beyond it is the globular mountain of delimitation.
verses.hindi: सर्वावसु रश्मि है, वह बृहस्पतिकी योनि है। इसके बाद स्वराट् रश्मि शनैश्चरको पोषित करती है। इस प्रकार सूर्यके ही प्रभावसे सभी नक्षत्र, ग्रह और तारे अन्तरिक्षमें दिखायी देते हैं और यह सम्पूर्ण जगत् दिखायी देता है। चूँकि वे नष्ट नहीं होते, इसलिये उन्हें नक्षत्र कहा गया है ॥ १९--२६॥
verses.wordMeaning: Beyond it is the globular mountain of delimitation.
verses.commentary: Sense: Beyond it is the globular mountain of delimitation.

verses.sanskrit: तपसा तोषितः पूर्वं मन्दरेण महेश्वरः अविमुक्ते महाक्षेत्रे लेभे स परमं वरम्
verses.transliteration: tapasā toṣitaḥ pūrvaṃ mandareṇa maheśvaraḥ avimukte mahākṣetre lebhe sa paramaṃ varam
verses.translation: Mah&vlta and Dbatakikha]?. These are the two provinces of Pufksura-dvipa (identified with Japan, Manchuria and SB Siberia). The mountain M&nasa runs in a circle like a full moon and divides the two provinces. The exterior province is Mahavita and the interior is Dhktakl.
verses.hindi: ज्योतिःसन्निवेशमें ग्रहोंके स्वरूप तथा नक्षत्रों और ग्रहोंकी पारस्परिक स्थितिका वर्णन
verses.wordMeaning: Mah&vlta and Dbatakikha]?. These are the two provinces of Pufksura-dvipa (identified with Japan, Manchuria and SB Siberia). The mountain M&nasa runs in a circle like a full moon and divides the two provinces. The exterior province is Mahavita and the interior is Dhktakl.
verses.commentary: Sense: Mah&vlta and Dbatakikha]?. These are the two provinces of Pufksura-dvipa (identified with Japan, Manchuria and SB Siberia). The mountain M&nasa runs in a circle like a full moon and divides the two provinces. The exterior province is Mahavita and the interior is Dhktakl.

verses.sanskrit: प्रार्थितश् च महादेवो निवासार्थं सहांबया अविमुक्तादुपागम्य चक्रे वासं स मन्दरे
verses.transliteration: prārthitaś ca mahādevo nivāsārthaṃ sahāṃbayā avimuktādupāgamya cakre vāsaṃ sa mandare
verses.translation: O brahmins, this earth abides, as long as this visible- cum-invisible mountain exists. Its height is stated to be ten thousand yojanas.
verses.hindi: तेषां क्षेत्राण्यथादत्ते सूर्यो नक्षत्रतारकाः तारणात्तारका ह्येताः शुक्लत्वाच्चैव तारकाः
verses.wordMeaning: O brahmins, this earth abides, as long as this visible- cum-invisible mountain exists. Its height is stated to be ten thousand yojanas.
verses.commentary: Sense: O brahmins, this earth abides, as long as this visible- cum-invisible mountain exists. Its height is stated to be ten thousand yojanas.

verses.sanskrit: सनन्दी सगणः सोमस् तेनासौ तन्न मुञ्चति क्रौञ्चद्वीपे तु सप्तेह क्रौञ्चाद्याः कुलपर्वताः
verses.transliteration: sanandī sagaṇaḥ somas tenāsau tanna muñcati krauñcadvīpe tu sapteha krauñcādyāḥ kulaparvatāḥ
verses.translation: The extent of the great mountain Lokaloka is also that much. The rays of the sun pass over its inner and nether half,
verses.hindi: सूतजी बोले- है ऋषियो ! रात्रिमें सूर्यकिरणोंसे प्रकाशित होनेवाले ये सभी क्षेत्र भारतवर्षमें अनुष्ठित पुण्योंद्वारा पुण्यात्माओंके होते हैं, तदनन्तर सूर्य सुकृतोंके पूर्ण होनेपर ग्रहोंके आश्रयमें रहनेवाले  ग्रहाश्रित
verses.wordMeaning: The extent of the great mountain Lokaloka is also that much. The rays of the sun pass over its inner and nether half,
verses.commentary: Sense: The extent of the great mountain Lokaloka is also that much. The rays of the sun pass over its inner and nether half,

verses.sanskrit: क्रौञ्चो वामनकः पश्चात् तृतीयश्चान्धकारकः अन्धकारात्परश्चापि दिवावृन्नाम पर्वतः
verses.transliteration: krauñco vāmanakaḥ paścāt tṛtīyaścāndhakārakaḥ andhakārātparaścāpi divāvṛnnāma parvataḥ
verses.translation: In its other half there is perpetual darkness. Hence it is called Lokaloka. Thus, the world Bhur is explained succin- ctly.
verses.hindi: नक्षत्र-तारोंको  अपने प्रभामण्डलमें ले लेते हैं । शुक्ल होनेसे तथा तारक होनेसे ये तारे कहलाते हैं दिव्य, पार्थिव तथा रात्रिमें होनेवाले अन्धकारोंको अपने तेजसे ग्रहण कर लेनेके कारण वह आदित्य नामवाला है। फैलाने तथा बहाने अर्थमें यह सु धातु पढ़ी जाती है। अतः तेजको फैलाने तथा जलको
verses.wordMeaning: In its other half there is perpetual darkness. Hence it is called Lokaloka. Thus, the world Bhur is explained succin- ctly.
verses.commentary: Sense: In its other half there is perpetual darkness. Hence it is called Lokaloka. Thus, the world Bhur is explained succin- ctly.

verses.sanskrit: दिवावृतः परश्चापि विविन्दो गिरिरुच्यते विविन्दात्परतश्चापि पुण्डरीको महागिरिः
verses.transliteration: divāvṛtaḥ paraścāpi vivindo girirucyate vivindātparataścāpi puṇḍarīko mahāgiriḥ
verses.translation: The Bhuvarloka is upto the sun. O excellent sages, the Svarloka is upto Dhruva (pole star). There are seven wheels of the wind, viz., Avaha, Pravaha, Anuvaha, Sam- vaha, Vivaha, Paravaha and Parivaha, O brahmins, these arc the seven wheels of the wind.
verses.hindi: बहानेके कारण इसे ' सविता' कहा गया है। यह चदि धातु आह्लाद करनेके अर्थमें कही जाती है, आह्वाद
verses.wordMeaning: The Bhuvarloka is upto the sun. O excellent sages, the Svarloka is upto Dhruva (pole star). There are seven wheels of the wind, viz., Avaha, Pravaha, Anuvaha, Sam- vaha, Vivaha, Paravaha and Parivaha, O brahmins, these arc the seven wheels of the wind.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Bhuvarloka is upto the sun. O excellent sages, the Svarloka is upto Dhruva (pole star). There are seven wheels of the wind, viz., Avaha, Pravaha, Anuvaha, Sam- vaha, Vivaha, Paravaha and Parivaha, O brahmins, these arc the seven wheels of the wind.

verses.sanskrit: पुण्डरीकात्परश्चापि प्रोच्यते दुन्दुभिस्वनः एते रत्नमयाः सप्त क्रौञ्चद्वीपस्य पर्वताः
verses.transliteration: puṇḍarīkātparaścāpi procyate dundubhisvanaḥ ete ratnamayāḥ sapta krauñcadvīpasya parvatāḥ
verses.translation: The solar sphere is one hundred thousand yojanas above the surface of the earth. Above it the chariot of the sun is sixteen thousand yojanas. The Meru is eighty-four thousand yojanas above the surface of the earth. The Maharloka extends to a crore of yojanas above Dhruva. O brahmins, the Janaloka extends to two crores of yojanas beyond Maharloka. Tapo- loka extends to four crores of yojanas beyond Jamaloka. Beyond that the Brahmaloka extends to six crores of yojanas. O brahmins, the holy worlds in this Cosmic Egg are thus seven.
verses.hindi: घनतेजोमयं शुक्लं मण्डलं भास्करस्य तु वसन्ति सर्वदेवाश्च स्थानान्येतानि सर्वशः। मन्वन्तरेषु सर्वेषु ऋक्षसूर्यग्रहाश्रयाः
verses.wordMeaning: The solar sphere is one hundred thousand yojanas above the surface of the earth. Above it the chariot of the sun is sixteen thousand yojanas. The Meru is eighty-four thousand yojanas above the surface of the earth. The Maharloka extends to a crore of yojanas above Dhruva.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The solar sphere is one hundred thousand yojanas above the surface of the earth. Above it the chariot of the sun is sixteen thousand yojanas. The Meru is eighty-four thousand yojanas above the surface of the earth. The Maharloka extends to a crore of yojanas above Dhruva.…

verses.sanskrit: शाकद्वीपे च गिरयः सप्त तांस्तु निबोधत उदयो रैवतश्चापि श्यामको मुनिसत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: śākadvīpe ca girayaḥ sapta tāṃstu nibodhata udayo raivataścāpi śyāmako munisattamāḥ
verses.translation: Beneath the seven nether worlds are the crores of hells. They are twentyeight in number beginning with Ghora and ending with Maya.
verses.hindi: शनैश्चरं तथा स्थानं देवश्चापि शनैश्चरः। बौधं बुधस्तु स्वर्भानुः स्वर्भानुस्थानमाश्रित:
verses.wordMeaning: Beneath the seven nether worlds are the crores of hells. They are twentyeight in number beginning with Ghora and ending with Maya.
verses.commentary: Sense: Beneath the seven nether worlds are the crores of hells. They are twentyeight in number beginning with Ghora and ending with Maya.

verses.sanskrit: राजतश्च गिरिः श्रीमान् आंबिकेयः सुशोभनः आंबिकेयात्परो रम्यः सर्वौषधिसमन्वितः
verses.transliteration: rājataśca giriḥ śrīmān āṃbikeyaḥ suśobhanaḥ āṃbikeyātparo ramyaḥ sarvauṣadhisamanvitaḥ
verses.translation: All the Pur&as mentioa seven divisions of the strato -sphere.
verses.hindi: मन्वन्तरेषु सर्वेषु देवस्थानानि तानि वै। अभिमानिनोऽवतिष्ठन्ते देवाः स्थानं पुनः पुनः अतीतैस्तु सहैतानि भाव्याभाव्यैः सुरैः सह।
verses.wordMeaning: All the Pur&as mentioa seven divisions of the strato -sphere.
verses.commentary: Sense: All the Pur&as mentioa seven divisions of the strato -sphere.

verses.sanskrit: तथैव केसरीत्युक्तो यतो वायुः प्रजायते पुष्करे पर्वतः श्रीमान् एक एव महाशिलः
verses.transliteration: tathaiva kesarītyukto yato vāyuḥ prajāyate puṣkare parvataḥ śrīmān eka eva mahāśilaḥ
verses.translation: Since Pradhana is present everywhere within each of these Cosmic Eggs there are fourteen worlds in all sides as well as above and below. O leading brahmins, the cause of their creation is lord Siva himself. The eight-bodied Siva is present in all the Eggs, in the exterior of the Eggs, in the coverings of the Eggs, in the extremities of the darkness and beyond dark- ness. Wonderful it is, every thing in the universe is the body of the unembodied great Atman, of Mahesa, of the intelligent Mahadeva.
verses.hindi: अस्मिन् मन्वन्तरे चैव ग्रहा वैमानिकाः स्मृताः ।
verses.wordMeaning: Since Pradhana is present everywhere within each of these Cosmic Eggs there are fourteen worlds in all sides as well as above and below. O leading brahmins, the cause of their creation is lord Siva himself. The eight-bodied Siva is present in all the Eggs,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Since Pradhana is present everywhere within each of these Cosmic Eggs there are fourteen worlds in all sides as well as above and below. O leading brahmins, the cause of their creation is lord Siva himself. The eight-bodied Siva is present in all the Eggs,…

verses.sanskrit: चित्रैर्मणिमयैः कूटैः शिलाजालैः समुच्छ्रितैः द्वीपस्य तस्य पूर्वार्धे चित्रसानुस्थितो महान्
verses.transliteration: citrairmaṇimayaiḥ kūṭaiḥ śilājālaiḥ samucchritaiḥ dvīpasya tasya pūrvārdhe citrasānusthito mahān
verses.translation: The lord Siva is infinite. He is devoid of beginning and end. He is the Purusa. He is identical with the seven principles*' beginning from Pradhana. His body is Pradhana itself, having sixteen limbs.*** (i.e. the organs of knowledge, organs of action, elements and mind). He himself is Mahevara and Astatanu (eight-bodied ).
verses.hindi: युतिमानृषिपुत्रस्तु सोमो देवो वसुः स्मृतः। शुक्रो देवस्तु विज्ञेयो भार्गवोऽसुरयाजकः बृहत्तेजाः स्मृतो देवो देवाचार्योऽङ्गिरासुतः। बुधो मनोहरश्चैव ऋषिपुत्रस्तु स स्मृतः
verses.wordMeaning: The lord Siva is infinite. He is devoid of beginning and end. He is the Purusa. He is identical with the seven principles*' beginning from Pradhana. His body is Pradhana itself, having sixteen limbs.*** (i.e. the organs of knowledge, organs of action, elements and mind).…
verses.commentary: Sense: The lord Siva is infinite. He is devoid of beginning and end. He is the Purusa. He is identical with the seven principles*' beginning from Pradhana. His body is Pradhana itself, having sixteen limbs.*** (i.e. the organs of knowledge, organs of action, elements and mind).…

verses.sanskrit: योजनानां सहस्राणि ऊर्ध्वं पञ्चाशदुच्छ्रितः अधश्चैव चतुस्त्रिंशत् सहस्राणि महाचलः
verses.transliteration: yojanānāṃ sahasrāṇi ūrdhvaṃ pañcāśaducchritaḥ adhaścaiva catustriṃśat sahasrāṇi mahācalaḥ
verses.translation: It is due to the power of His command that the earth is held steady. So also the mountains, clouds, oceans, luminaries, Devas beginning with Indra, those who go about in the aerial chariots as well as the mobile and immobile beings.
verses.hindi: अग्निर्विकेश्यां जज्ञे तु युवासौ लोहितार्चिष:
verses.wordMeaning: It is due to the power of His command that the earth is held steady. So also the mountains, clouds, oceans, luminaries, Devas beginning with Indra, those who go about in the aerial chariots as well as the mobile and immobile beings.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is due to the power of His command that the earth is held steady. So also the mountains, clouds, oceans, luminaries, Devas beginning with Indra, those who go about in the aerial chariots as well as the mobile and immobile beings.

verses.sanskrit: द्वीपस्यार्धे परिक्षिप्तः पर्वतो मानसोत्तरः स्थितो वेलासमीपे तु नवचन्द्र इवोदितः
verses.transliteration: dvīpasyārdhe parikṣiptaḥ parvato mānasottaraḥ sthito velāsamīpe tu navacandra ivoditaḥ
verses.translation: Devas including Indra saw the lord devoid of specific characteristics in the guise of a Yaksa.**®On seeing him they wondered "What is this?" They went to the Yaksa. Unable to come to any conclusion, fire and others exerted themselves but became weak and inefficient.
verses.hindi: करनेके कारण चन्द्रमाका नाम बहुल भी है। इसके अतिरिक्त यह शुक्लत्व, अमृतत्व तथा शीतत्वको भी प्रकट करता है॥ ३--५॥ सूर्य तथा चन्द्रमाके मण्डल दिव्य, प्रकाशमान, आकाशगामी, जल-तेजसे युक्त, शुक्लवर्णवाले, गोल घड़ेके समान तथा शुभ हैं। उनमें चनद्रमाका मण्डल घने जलके स्वरूपवाला तथा सूर्यका मण्डल घने तेजके
verses.wordMeaning: Devas including Indra saw the lord devoid of specific characteristics in the guise of a Yaksa.**®On seeing him they wondered "What is this?" They went to the Yaksa. Unable to come to any conclusion, fire and others exerted themselves but became weak and inefficient.
verses.commentary: Sense: Devas including Indra saw the lord devoid of specific characteristics in the guise of a Yaksa.**®On seeing him they wondered "What is this?" They went to the Yaksa. Unable to come to any conclusion, fire and others exerted themselves but became weak and inefficient.

verses.sanskrit: योजनानां सहस्राणि ऊर्ध्वं पञ्चाशदुच्छ्रितः तावदेव तु विस्तीर्णः पार्श्वतः परिमण्डलः
verses.transliteration: yojanānāṃ sahasrāṇi ūrdhvaṃ pañcāśaducchritaḥ tāvadeva tu vistīrṇaḥ pārśvataḥ parimaṇḍalaḥ
verses.translation: O brahmins, in front of that Yaksa the fire-god could not burn even a blade of grass; the wind-God could not shake a blade of grass; all the leading immortal beings failed to exer- cise their respective powers over him.
verses.hindi: स्वरूपवाला शुक्लवर्णका कहा गया है
verses.wordMeaning: O brahmins, in front of that Yaksa the fire-god could not burn even a blade of grass; the wind-God could not shake a blade of grass; all the leading immortal beings failed to exer- cise their respective powers over him.
verses.commentary: Sense: O brahmins, in front of that Yaksa the fire-god could not burn even a blade of grass; the wind-God could not shake a blade of grass; all the leading immortal beings failed to exer- cise their respective powers over him.

verses.sanskrit: स एव द्वीपपश्चार्धे मानसः पृथिवीधरः एक एव महासानुः संनिवेशाद्द्विधा कृतः
verses.transliteration: sa eva dvīpapaścārdhe mānasaḥ pṛthivīdharaḥ eka eva mahāsānuḥ saṃniveśāddvidhā kṛtaḥ
verses.translation: At that time, the enemy of Vrtra (i.e. Indra), the lord
verses.hindi: सभी देवता इन स्थानोंमें भलीभाँति निवास करते हैं। वे सभी मन्वन्तरोंमें नक्षत्रों, सूर्य तथा ग्रहोंका आश्रय ग्रहण करते हैं। इसलिये ग्रह एक तरहसे गृह ही हैं,
verses.wordMeaning: At that time, the enemy of Vrtra (i.e. Indra), the lord
verses.commentary: Sense: At that time, the enemy of Vrtra (i.e. Indra), the lord

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिन्द्वीपे स्मृतौ द्वौ तु पुण्यौ जनपदौ शुभौ राजतौ मानसस्याथ पर्वतस्यानुमण्डलौ
verses.transliteration: tasmindvīpe smṛtau dvau tu puṇyau janapadau śubhau rājatau mānasasyātha parvatasyānumaṇḍalau
verses.translation: The astamilrti (eight-formed, ) Siva is the house- holder whose mistress is Prakrti, whose subjects are intellect, ego and five subtle elements. His eight-formed body has sixteen parts, viz., five gross elements, five organs of action, five organs of knowledge and the mind.
verses.hindi: और वे उन्हींके नामवाले होते हैं। सूर्यने सौरस्थानमे प्रवेश किया एवं सोम (चन्द्रमा)-ने सौम्यस्थानमें प्रवेश किया। सोलह किरणोंवाला प्रतापी शुक्र शौक्रस्थानमें प्रविष्ट हुआ। बृहस्पति बृहत् स्थानमें तथा लोहित
verses.wordMeaning: The astamilrti (eight-formed, ) Siva is the house- holder whose mistress is Prakrti, whose subjects are intellect, ego and five subtle elements. His eight-formed body has sixteen parts, viz., five gross elements, five organs of action, five organs of knowledge and the mind.
verses.commentary: Sense: The astamilrti (eight-formed, ) Siva is the house- holder whose mistress is Prakrti, whose subjects are intellect, ego and five subtle elements. His eight-formed body has sixteen parts, viz., five gross elements, five organs of action, five organs of knowledge and the mind.

verses.sanskrit: महावीतं तु यद्वर्षं बाह्यतो मानसस्य तु तस्यैवाभ्यन्तरो यस्तु धातकीखण्ड उच्यते
verses.transliteration: mahāvītaṃ tu yadvarṣaṃ bāhyato mānasasya tu tasyaivābhyantaro yastu dhātakīkhaṇḍa ucyate
verses.translation: At that time the Yaksa vanished. Then the splendid- faced daughter of Himavat, Uma, shining gloriously with many auspicious ornaments appeared in front of him.
verses.hindi: (भौम) लोहितस्थानमें स्थित हुए। शनैश्चरदेव शनैश्चरस्थानमें, बुध बौधस्थानमें तथा स्वर्भानु (राहु) स्वर्भानुस्थानमें स्थित हुए। सभी नक्षत्र (अपने-अपने) नक्षत्र-स्थानोंमें प्रवेश करते हैं। ये सब ज्योतिस्थान पुण्यात्माओंके गृह हैं। ब्रह्माने इन स्थानोंको निर्मित किया है। ये कल्पके आदिमे प्रवृत्त हुए और प्रलयपर्यन्त बने रहते हैं। वे सभी मन्वन्तरोंमें देवताओंके निवासस्थान हुआ करते हैं। अभिमानी देवतालोग उनमें बार-बार
verses.wordMeaning: At that time the Yaksa vanished. Then the splendid- faced daughter of Himavat, Uma, shining gloriously with many auspicious ornaments appeared in front of him.
verses.commentary: Sense: At that time the Yaksa vanished. Then the splendid- faced daughter of Himavat, Uma, shining gloriously with many auspicious ornaments appeared in front of him.

verses.sanskrit: स्वादूदकेनोदधिना पुष्करः परिवारितः पुष्करद्वीपविस्तारविस्तीर्णो ऽसौ समन्ततः
verses.transliteration: svādūdakenodadhinā puṣkaraḥ parivāritaḥ puṣkaradvīpavistāravistīrṇo 'sau samantataḥ
verses.translation: Indra and others asked that unborn daughter of Himavat, Uma, the intensely bright one; — "O Goddess, O excessively refulgent, what is this? O Uma, who was this shining one in the body of Yaksa?"
verses.hindi: निवास करते हैं। ये स्थान अतीत, भाव्य तथा अभाव्य
verses.wordMeaning: Indra and others asked that unborn daughter of Himavat, Uma, the intensely bright one; — "O Goddess, O excessively refulgent, what is this? O Uma, who was this shining one in the body of Yaksa?"
verses.commentary: Sense: Indra and others asked that unborn daughter of Himavat, Uma, the intensely bright one; — "O Goddess, O excessively refulgent, what is this? O Uma, who was this shining one in the body of Yaksa?"

verses.sanskrit: विस्तारान्मण्डलाच्चैव पुष्करस्य समेन तु एवं द्वीपाः समुद्रैस्तु सप्तसप्तभिर् आवृताः
verses.transliteration: vistārānmaṇḍalāccaiva puṣkarasya samena tu evaṃ dvīpāḥ samudraistu saptasaptabhir āvṛtāḥ
verses.translation: On hearing it, Uma said: "the Yaksa is invisible.*' Devas including Indra bowed down to that deity having the gait of a lion, and to Uma unborn and of red, white and black colour.
verses.hindi: विद्यमान रहते हैं इस मन्वन्तरमें ग्रहोंको वैमानिक कहा गया है। वैवस्वत मन्वन्तरमें अदितिका पुत्र विवस्वान् सूर्य है। ऋषिपुत्र द्युतिमान् देवता वसुको सोम (चन्द्र) कहा गया है। असुरोंके याजक शुक्रदेवको भूगुका पुत्र जानना
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing it, Uma said: "the Yaksa is invisible.*' Devas including Indra bowed down to that deity having the gait of a lion, and to Uma unborn and of red, white and black colour.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing it, Uma said: "the Yaksa is invisible.*' Devas including Indra bowed down to that deity having the gait of a lion, and to Uma unborn and of red, white and black colour.

verses.sanskrit: द्वीपस्यानन्तरो यस्तु समुद्रः सप्तमस्तु वै एवं द्वीपसमुद्राणां वृद्धिर्ज्ञेया परस्परम्
verses.transliteration: dvīpasyānantaro yastu samudraḥ saptamastu vai evaṃ dvīpasamudrāṇāṃ vṛddhirjñeyā parasparam
verses.translation: Hence, O brahmins, the entire Egg originated from the unborn at his behest and from the Egg originated Brahma. The entire world originated from him along with the lumina- ries. Thus the universe is identical with the Unborn (aja).
verses.hindi: चाहिए । महातेजस्वी देवाचार्य बृहस्पतिको अंगिराऋषिका पुत्र कहा गया है। जो सुन्दर बुध है, उसे ऋषिपुत्र कहा गया है। विकृतरूपवाला शनैश्चर संज्ञाका पुत्र है; वह विवस्वान्से उत्पन्न हुआ है लोहित आभावाला यह युवा
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, O brahmins, the entire Egg originated from the unborn at his behest and from the Egg originated Brahma. The entire world originated from him along with the lumina- ries. Thus the universe is identical with the Unborn (aja).
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, O brahmins, the entire Egg originated from the unborn at his behest and from the Egg originated Brahma. The entire world originated from him along with the lumina- ries. Thus the universe is identical with the Unborn (aja).

verses.sanskrit: परेण पुष्करस्याथ अनुवृत्य स्थितो महान् स्वादूदकसमुद्रस्तु समन्तात्परिवेष्ट्य च
verses.transliteration: pareṇa puṣkarasyātha anuvṛtya sthito mahān svādūdakasamudrastu samantātpariveṣṭya ca
verses.translation: Hence, O brahmins, the entire Egg originated from the unborn at his behest and from the Egg originated Brahma. The entire world originated from him along with the lumina- ries. Thus the universe is identical with the Unborn (aja).
verses.hindi: भौम अग्निरूप रुद्रके द्वारा उनको पत्नी विकेशीसे उत्पन्न अध्याय ६९ ज्योतिःसन्निवेशमें ग्रहोंके स्वरूपका वर्णन २५३
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, O brahmins, the entire Egg originated from the unborn at his behest and from the Egg originated Brahma. The entire world originated from him along with the lumina- ries. Thus the universe is identical with the Unborn (aja).

verses.translation: Hence, O brahmins, the entire Egg originated from the unborn at his behest and from the Egg originated Brahma. The entire world originated from him along with the lumina- ries. Thus the universe is identical with the Unborn (aja).

verses.sanskrit: तस्याः परेण शैलस्तु मर्यादापारमण्डलः प्रकाशश्चाप्रकाशश् च लोकालोकः स उच्यते
verses.transliteration: tasyāḥ pareṇa śailastu maryādāpāramaṇḍalaḥ prakāśaścāprakāśaś ca lokālokaḥ sa ucyate
verses.translation: Hence, O brahmins, the entire Egg originated from the unborn at his behest and from the Egg originated Brahma. The entire world originated from him along with the lumina- ries. Thus the universe is identical with the Unborn (aja).
verses.hindi: फफ फा भामा फीकी मी हिक्रा है। नक्षत्र-ऋक्ष नामवाली जो भी हैं, वे दक्षकी स्वर्भानुः कापुत्रो भूतसन्तापनोऽसुरः॥ २०  पुत्रियाँ कही गयी हैं। प्राणियोंके लिये कष्टकारी असुर

verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, O brahmins, the entire Egg originated from the unborn at his behest and from the Egg originated Brahma. The entire world originated from him along with the lumina- ries. Thus the universe is identical with the Unborn (aja).

verses.sanskrit: दृश्यादृश्यगिरिर् यावत् तावदेषा धरा द्विजाः योजनानां सहस्राणि दश तस्योच्छ्रयः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: dṛśyādṛśyagirir yāvat tāvadeṣā dharā dvijāḥ yojanānāṃ sahasrāṇi daśa tasyocchrayaḥ smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: Hence, O brahmins, the entire Egg originated from the unborn at his behest and from the Egg originated Brahma. The entire world originated from him along with the lumina- ries. Thus the universe is identical with the Unborn (aja).
verses.hindi: राहु सिंहिकापुत्र है । इस प्रकार सोम, ऋक्ष, ग्रह तथा सूर्यमें उनके निवासस्थान हैं। इन स्थानोंका वर्णन मैंने कर दिया और अपने-अपने स्थानका अभिमान करनेवाले स्थानी देवताओंका भी वर्णन कर दिया
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, O brahmins, the entire Egg originated from the unborn at his behest and from the Egg originated Brahma. The entire world originated from him along with the lumina- ries. Thus the universe is identical with the Unborn (aja).
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, O brahmins, the entire Egg originated from the unborn at his behest and from the Egg originated Brahma. The entire world originated from him along with the lumina- ries. Thus the universe is identical with the Unborn (aja).

verses.sanskrit: तावांश् च विस्तरस्तस्य लोकालोकमहागिरेः अर्वाचीने तु तस्यार्धे चरन्ति रविरश्मयः
verses.transliteration: tāvāṃś ca vistarastasya lokālokamahāgireḥ arvācīne tu tasyārdhe caranti raviraśmayaḥ
verses.translation: Hence, O brahmins, the entire Egg originated from the unborn at his behest and from the Egg originated Brahma. The entire world originated from him along with the lumina- ries. Thus the universe is identical with the Unborn (aja).
verses.hindi: हजार किरणोंवाले सूर्यका अग्निमय सौरस्थान है। चन्द्रमाका स्थान जलमय तथा शुक्लवर्णका कहा गया है। बुधग्रहका निवासस्थान जलमय, श्याम तथा मनोहर बताया गया है। शुक्रका निवासस्थान भी जलमय, शुक्लवर्णबाला तथा सोलह किरणोंसे युक्त है। भौम (मंगल)-का स्थान उत्तम, लोहितवर्णवाला तथा नौ रश्मियोंसे युक्त है। बृहस्पतिका स्थान हरिद्रा (हल्दी)-की आभावाला, विशाल तथा सोलह रश्मियोंसे
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, O brahmins, the entire Egg originated from the unborn at his behest and from the Egg originated Brahma. The entire world originated from him along with the lumina- ries. Thus the universe is identical with the Unborn (aja).
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, O brahmins, the entire Egg originated from the unborn at his behest and from the Egg originated Brahma. The entire world originated from him along with the lumina- ries. Thus the universe is identical with the Unborn (aja).

verses.sanskrit: परार्धे तु तमो नित्यं लोकालोकस्ततः स्मृतः एवं संक्षेपतः प्रोक्तो भूर्लोकस्य च विस्तरः
verses.transliteration: parārdhe tu tamo nityaṃ lokālokastataḥ smṛtaḥ evaṃ saṃkṣepataḥ prokto bhūrlokasya ca vistaraḥ
verses.translation: Hence, O brahmins, the entire Egg originated from the unborn at his behest and from the Egg originated Brahma. The entire world originated from him along with the lumina- ries. Thus the universe is identical with the Unborn (aja).
verses.hindi: युक्त है। शनैश्चरका स्थान आठ रश्मियोंसे युक्त तथा कृष्ण वर्णवाला कहा गया है। राहुका स्थान अन्धकारमय है; यह प्राणियोंके लिये कष्टकारी स्थान है। सभी तारागणोंको ऋषिरूप तथा एक रश्मिवाला जानना
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, O brahmins, the entire Egg originated from the unborn at his behest and from the Egg originated Brahma. The entire world originated from him along with the lumina- ries. Thus the universe is identical with the Unborn (aja).
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, O brahmins, the entire Egg originated from the unborn at his behest and from the Egg originated Brahma. The entire world originated from him along with the lumina- ries. Thus the universe is identical with the Unborn (aja).

verses.sanskrit: आ भानोर्वै भुवः स्वस्तु आ ध्रुवान्मुनिसत्तमाः आवहाद्या निविष्टास्तु वायोर्वै सप्त नेमयः
verses.transliteration: ā bhānorvai bhuvaḥ svastu ā dhruvānmunisattamāḥ āvahādyā niviṣṭāstu vāyorvai sapta nemayaḥ
verses.translation: Hence, O brahmins, the entire Egg originated from the unborn at his behest and from the Egg originated Brahma. The entire world originated from him along with the lumina- ries. Thus the universe is identical with the Unborn (aja).
verses.hindi: चाहिए, ये पुण्यकीर्तिवालोंके आश्रय हैं तथा अपने वर्णसे शुक्ल हैं। इन्हें घने जलके स्वरूपवाला जानना चाहिए। ये कल्पके प्रारम्भमें ही निर्मित किये गये थे; ये सूर्यकी रश्मियोंके संयोगके कारण उत्तम प्रकाशसे युक्त कहे गये हैं ॥ २२--२७॥
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, O brahmins, the entire Egg originated from the unborn at his behest and from the Egg originated Brahma. The entire world originated from him along with the lumina- ries. Thus the universe is identical with the Unborn (aja).
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, O brahmins, the entire Egg originated from the unborn at his behest and from the Egg originated Brahma. The entire world originated from him along with the lumina- ries. Thus the universe is identical with the Unborn (aja).

verses.sanskrit: आवहः प्रवहश्चैव ततश्चानुवहस् तथा संवहो विवहश्चाथ ततश्चोर्ध्वं परावहः
verses.transliteration: āvahaḥ pravahaścaiva tataścānuvahas tathā saṃvaho vivahaścātha tataścordhvaṃ parāvahaḥ
verses.translation: Hence, O brahmins, the entire Egg originated from the unborn at his behest and from the Egg originated Brahma. The entire world originated from him along with the lumina- ries. Thus the universe is identical with the Unborn (aja).
verses.hindi: सूर्यका विष्कम्भ (व्यास) नौ हजार योजन बताया गया है और मण्डलके प्रमाणसे उसका विस्तार तीन गुना है। चन्द्रमाका विस्तार सूर्यके विस्तारसे दुगुना कहा गया है। उन दोनोंके समान विस्तारवाला होकर राहु उनके
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, O brahmins, the entire Egg originated from the unborn at his behest and from the Egg originated Brahma. The entire world originated from him along with the lumina- ries. Thus the universe is identical with the Unborn (aja).
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, O brahmins, the entire Egg originated from the unborn at his behest and from the Egg originated Brahma. The entire world originated from him along with the lumina- ries. Thus the universe is identical with the Unborn (aja).

verses.sanskrit: द्विजाः परिवहश्चेति वायोर्वै सप्त नेमयः बलाहकास् तथा भानुश् चन्द्रो नक्षत्रराशयः
verses.transliteration: dvijāḥ parivahaśceti vāyorvai sapta nemayaḥ balāhakās tathā bhānuś candro nakṣatrarāśayaḥ
verses.translation: Hence, O brahmins, the entire Egg originated from the unborn at his behest and from the Egg originated Brahma. The entire world originated from him along with the lumina- ries. Thus the universe is identical with the Unborn (aja).
verses.hindi: नीचे गमन करता है। मण्डलके आकारकी बनी हुई पृथ्वी-छायाको लेकर राहुका तीसरा बड़ा स्थान है, जो अन्धकारमय है। वह राहु चन्द्र पर्वोमें सूर्यसे निकलकर चन्द्रमाकी ओर जाता है और सौर पर्वोमें चन्द्रमासे निकलकर सूर्यकी ओर जाता है  चूँकि राहु भानु (सूर्य)-को प्रेरित करता है, अतः इसे स्वर्भानु कहा जाता है॥२८-३१/२॥
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, O brahmins, the entire Egg originated from the unborn at his behest and from the Egg originated Brahma. The entire world originated from him along with the lumina- ries. Thus the universe is identical with the Unborn (aja).
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, O brahmins, the entire Egg originated from the unborn at his behest and from the Egg originated Brahma. The entire world originated from him along with the lumina- ries. Thus the universe is identical with the Unborn (aja).
