verses.sanskrit: अधः सप्ततलानां तु नरकाणां हि कोटयः मायान्ताश्चैव घोराद्या अष्टाविंशतिरेव तु
verses.transliteration: adhaḥ saptatalānāṃ tu narakāṇāṃ hi koṭayaḥ māyāntāścaiva ghorādyā aṣṭāviṃśatireva tu
verses.translation: Hence, O brahmins, the entire Egg originated from the unborn at his behest and from the Egg originated Brahma. The entire world originated from him along with the lumina- ries. Thus the universe is identical with the Unborn (aja).
verses.hindi: विवस्वानदितेः पुत्रः सूर्यो वै मुनिसत्तमाः त्विषिमान् धर्मपुत्रस्तु सोमो देवो वसुस्तु सः
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, O brahmins, the entire Egg originated from the unborn at his behest and from the Egg originated Brahma. The entire world originated from him along with the lumina- ries. Thus the universe is identical with the Unborn (aja).
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, O brahmins, the entire Egg originated from the unborn at his behest and from the Egg originated Brahma. The entire world originated from him along with the lumina- ries. Thus the universe is identical with the Unborn (aja).

verses.sanskrit: पापिनस्तेषु पच्यन्ते स्वस्वकर्मानुरूपतः अवीच्यन्तानि सर्वाणि रौरवाद्यानि तेषु च
verses.transliteration: pāpinasteṣu pacyante svasvakarmānurūpataḥ avīcyantāni sarvāṇi rauravādyāni teṣu ca
verses.translation: Hence, O brahmins, the entire Egg originated from the unborn at his behest and from the Egg originated Brahma. The entire world originated from him along with the lumina- ries. Thus the universe is identical with the Unborn (aja).
verses.hindi: शीतरश्मिः समुत्पन्नः कृत्तिकासु निशाकरः।
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, O brahmins, the entire Egg originated from the unborn at his behest and from the Egg originated Brahma. The entire world originated from him along with the lumina- ries. Thus the universe is identical with the Unborn (aja).
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, O brahmins, the entire Egg originated from the unborn at his behest and from the Egg originated Brahma. The entire world originated from him along with the lumina- ries. Thus the universe is identical with the Unborn (aja).

verses.sanskrit: प्रत्येकं पञ्चकान्याहुर् नरकाणि विशेषतः अण्डमादौ मया प्रोक्तम् अण्डस्यावरणानि च
verses.transliteration: pratyekaṃ pañcakānyāhur narakāṇi viśeṣataḥ aṇḍamādau mayā proktam aṇḍasyāvaraṇāni ca
verses.translation: Hence, O brahmins, the entire Egg originated from the unborn at his behest and from the Egg originated Brahma. The entire world originated from him along with the lumina- ries. Thus the universe is identical with the Unborn (aja).
verses.hindi: तमोमयो मृत्युसुतः प्रजाक्षयकरः शिखी आश्लेषासु समुत्पन्नः सर्वहारी महाग्रहः। तथा स्वनामधेयेषु दाक्षायण्यः समुत्थिताः
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, O brahmins, the entire Egg originated from the unborn at his behest and from the Egg originated Brahma. The entire world originated from him along with the lumina- ries. Thus the universe is identical with the Unborn (aja).
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, O brahmins, the entire Egg originated from the unborn at his behest and from the Egg originated Brahma. The entire world originated from him along with the lumina- ries. Thus the universe is identical with the Unborn (aja).

verses.sanskrit: हिरण्यगर्भसर्गश् च प्रसंगाद्बहुविस्तरात् अण्डानामीदृशानां तु कोट्यो ज्ञेयाः सहस्रशः
verses.transliteration: hiraṇyagarbhasargaś ca prasaṃgādbahuvistarāt aṇḍānāmīdṛśānāṃ tu koṭyo jñeyāḥ sahasraśaḥ
verses.translation: Hence, O brahmins, the entire Egg originated from the unborn at his behest and from the Egg originated Brahma. The entire world originated from him along with the lumina- ries. Thus the universe is identical with the Unborn (aja).
verses.hindi: मण्डल (घेरा)-में चन्द्रमाका सोलहवाँ भाग कहा ग है । बृहस्पतिको शुक्रसे एक चौथाई कम जानना चाहिए। बृहस्पतिसे एक चौथाई कम मंगल तथा शनि--ये दोनों बताये गये हैं। बुध विस्तार तथा मण्डलमें उन दोनोंसे
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, O brahmins, the entire Egg originated from the unborn at his behest and from the Egg originated Brahma. The entire world originated from him along with the lumina- ries. Thus the universe is identical with the Unborn (aja).
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, O brahmins, the entire Egg originated from the unborn at his behest and from the Egg originated Brahma. The entire world originated from him along with the lumina- ries. Thus the universe is identical with the Unborn (aja).

verses.sanskrit: सर्वगत्वात् प्रधानस्य तिर्यग् ऊर्ध्वम् अधस् तथा अण्डेष्वेतेषु सर्वेषु भुवनानि चतुर्दश
verses.transliteration: sarvagatvāt pradhānasya tiryag ūrdhvam adhas tathā aṇḍeṣveteṣu sarveṣu bhuvanāni caturdaśa
verses.translation: Hence, O brahmins, the entire Egg originated from the unborn at his behest and from the Egg originated Brahma. The entire world originated from him along with the lumina- ries. Thus the universe is identical with the Unborn (aja).
verses.hindi: एक चौथाई कम है। तारा-नक्षत्ररूपवाले जो पिण्ड है वे विस्तार तथा मण्डलमें बुधके बराबर हें ॥ ३२-- ता तत्त्ववेत्ताको प्राय: सभी नक्षत्रोंको चन्द्रमासे सम्बद्ध जानना चाहिए। तारा-नक्षत्ररूपवाले वे परस्पर बहुत छोटे हैं। वे छोटे तारे पाँच, चार, तीन तथा दो योजन विस्तारवाले हैं। इन सबके ऊपर अत्यन्त छोटे तारा: मण्डल हैं, जो केवल आधे योजनके हैं, उनसे छोटे कोई तारा नहीं है। उनके ऊपर तीन ग्रह हैं, वे दूर-दूर
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, O brahmins, the entire Egg originated from the unborn at his behest and from the Egg originated Brahma. The entire world originated from him along with the lumina- ries. Thus the universe is identical with the Unborn (aja).
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, O brahmins, the entire Egg originated from the unborn at his behest and from the Egg originated Brahma. The entire world originated from him along with the lumina- ries. Thus the universe is identical with the Unborn (aja).

verses.sanskrit: प्रत्यण्डं द्विजशार्दूलास् तेषां हेतुर्महेश्वरः अण्डेषु चाण्डबाह्येषु तथाण्डावरणेषु च
verses.transliteration: pratyaṇḍaṃ dvijaśārdūlās teṣāṃ heturmaheśvaraḥ aṇḍeṣu cāṇḍabāhyeṣu tathāṇḍāvaraṇeṣu ca
verses.translation: Hence, O brahmins, the entire Egg originated from the unborn at his behest and from the Egg originated Brahma. The entire world originated from him along with the lumina- ries. Thus the universe is identical with the Unborn (aja).
verses.hindi: भ्रमण करनेवाले हैं। वे सौर, अंगिरा (बृहस्पति) तथा वक्र (भौम) हैं, इन्हें मन्दगतिसे भ्रमण करनेवाला जानना चाहिए । उनकी गतिके विषयमें पहले ही क्रमसे बता दिया गया है॥ ३६--३९॥
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, O brahmins, the entire Egg originated from the unborn at his behest and from the Egg originated Brahma. The entire world originated from him along with the lumina- ries. Thus the universe is identical with the Unborn (aja).
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, O brahmins, the entire Egg originated from the unborn at his behest and from the Egg originated Brahma. The entire world originated from him along with the lumina- ries. Thus the universe is identical with the Unborn (aja).

verses.sanskrit: तमो ऽन्ते च तमःपारे चाष्टमूर्तिर्व्यवस्थितः अस्यात्मनो महेशस्य महादेवस्य धीमतः
verses.transliteration: tamo 'nte ca tamaḥpāre cāṣṭamūrtirvyavasthitaḥ asyātmano maheśasya mahādevasya dhīmataḥ
verses.translation: Hence, O brahmins, the entire Egg originated from the unborn at his behest and from the Egg originated Brahma. The entire world originated from him along with the lumina- ries. Thus the universe is identical with the Unborn (aja).
verses.hindi: सभी ग्रह इन्हीं नक्षत्रोंमें उत्पन्न हुए हैं। है श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! अदितिका पुत्र विवस्वान् सूर्य, जो ग्रहोंमें प्रथम हे, विशाखा नक्षत्रमें उत्पन्न हुआ है। धर्मका पुत्र ओजस्वी सोम वसु देवता है, वह शीत रश्मिवाला चन्द्रमा कृत्तिका नक्षत्रमें उत्पन्न हुआ है। सोलह रश्मियोंवाला भूगुपुत्र शुक्र जो ताराग्रहोंमें श्रेष्ठ है, सूर्यके बाद तिष्य नक्षत्रमें उत्पन्न हुआ है। बारह किरणोंवाला अंगिरापुत्र जगद्गुरु बृहस्पति ग्रह पूर्वाफाल्गुनी नक्षत्रमें उत्पन्न हुआ है। नौ
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, O brahmins, the entire Egg originated from the unborn at his behest and from the Egg originated Brahma. The entire world originated from him along with the lumina- ries. Thus the universe is identical with the Unborn (aja).
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, O brahmins, the entire Egg originated from the unborn at his behest and from the Egg originated Brahma. The entire world originated from him along with the lumina- ries. Thus the universe is identical with the Unborn (aja).

verses.sanskrit: अदेहिनस् त्वहो देहम् अखिलं परमात्मनः अस्याष्टमूर्तेः शर्वस्य शिवस्य गृहमेधिनः
verses.transliteration: adehinas tvaho deham akhilaṃ paramātmanaḥ asyāṣṭamūrteḥ śarvasya śivasya gṛhamedhinaḥ
verses.translation: Hence, O brahmins, the entire Egg originated from the unborn at his behest and from the Egg originated Brahma. The entire world originated from him along with the lumina- ries. Thus the universe is identical with the Unborn (aja).
verses.hindi: किरणोंसे युक्त तथा लोहित अंगवाला प्रजापतिपुत्र भौमग्रह पूर्वाषाढ नक्षत्रमें उत्पन्न होनेवाला कहा गया है। सात किरणोंसे युक्त सूर्यपुत्र शनैश्चर रेवती नक्षत्रमें उत्पन्न हुआ है। पाँच किरणोंवाला चन्द्रपुत्र बुध ग्रह धनिष्ठा
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, O brahmins, the entire Egg originated from the unborn at his behest and from the Egg originated Brahma. The entire world originated from him along with the lumina- ries. Thus the universe is identical with the Unborn (aja).
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, O brahmins, the entire Egg originated from the unborn at his behest and from the Egg originated Brahma. The entire world originated from him along with the lumina- ries. Thus the universe is identical with the Unborn (aja).

verses.sanskrit: गृहिणी प्रकृतिर्दिव्या प्रजाश् च महदादयः पशवः किङ्करास्तस्य सर्वे देहाभिमानिनः
verses.transliteration: gṛhiṇī prakṛtirdivyā prajāś ca mahadādayaḥ paśavaḥ kiṅkarāstasya sarve dehābhimāninaḥ
verses.translation: Hence, O brahmins, the entire Egg originated from the unborn at his behest and from the Egg originated Brahma. The entire world originated from him along with the lumina- ries. Thus the universe is identical with the Unborn (aja).
verses.hindi: क्षत्रमें उत्पन्न हुआ है। अन्धकारमय, प्रजाका क्षय करनेवाला तथा सबका विनाशक महाग्रह मृत्युपुत्र शिखी (केतु) आश्लेषा नक्षतरमे उत्पन्न हुआ है। दक्षकी पुत्रियाँ अपने-अपने नामवाले नक्षत्रोंमें उत्पन्न हुई हैं। अन्धकार तथा ओजसे परिपूर्ण, प्रकृतिसे काले मण्डलवाला और
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, O brahmins, the entire Egg originated from the unborn at his behest and from the Egg originated Brahma. The entire world originated from him along with the lumina- ries. Thus the universe is identical with the Unborn (aja).
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, O brahmins, the entire Egg originated from the unborn at his behest and from the Egg originated Brahma. The entire world originated from him along with the lumina- ries. Thus the universe is identical with the Unborn (aja).

verses.sanskrit: आद्यन्तहीनो भगवान् अनन्तः पुमान्प्रधानप्रमुखाश् च सप्त प्रधानमूर्तिस्त्वथ षोडशाङ्गो महेश्वरश्चाष्टतनुः स एव
verses.transliteration: ādyantahīno bhagavān anantaḥ pumānpradhānapramukhāś ca sapta pradhānamūrtistvatha ṣoḍaśāṅgo maheśvaraścāṣṭatanuḥ sa eva
verses.translation: Hence, O brahmins, the entire Egg originated from the unborn at his behest and from the Egg originated Brahma. The entire world originated from him along with the lumina- ries. Thus the universe is identical with the Unborn (aja).
verses.hindi: सूर्य-चन्द्रका मर्दन करनेवाला ग्रह राहु भरणी नक्षत्रमें उत्पन्न हुआ है
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, O brahmins, the entire Egg originated from the unborn at his behest and from the Egg originated Brahma. The entire world originated from him along with the lumina- ries. Thus the universe is identical with the Unborn (aja).
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, O brahmins, the entire Egg originated from the unborn at his behest and from the Egg originated Brahma. The entire world originated from him along with the lumina- ries. Thus the universe is identical with the Unborn (aja).

verses.sanskrit: आज्ञाबलात्तस्य धरा स्थितेह धराधरा वारिधराः समुद्राः ज्योतिर्गणः शक्रमुखाः सुराश् च वैमानिकाः स्थावरजङ्गमाश् च
verses.transliteration: ājñābalāttasya dharā sthiteha dharādharā vāridharāḥ samudrāḥ jyotirgaṇaḥ śakramukhāḥ surāś ca vaimānikāḥ sthāvarajaṅgamāś ca
verses.translation: Hence, O brahmins, the entire Egg originated from the unborn at his behest and from the Egg originated Brahma. The entire world originated from him along with the lumina- ries. Thus the universe is identical with the Unborn (aja).
verses.hindi: ज्योतिःसन्निवेशमें ग्रहोंके स्वरूपका वर्णन ताराग्रहाणां शुक्रस्तु केतूनां चापि धूमवान्। ध्रुवः किल ग्रहाणां तु विभक्तानां चतुर्दिशम्
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, O brahmins, the entire Egg originated from the unborn at his behest and from the Egg originated Brahma. The entire world originated from him along with the lumina- ries. Thus the universe is identical with the Unborn (aja).
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, O brahmins, the entire Egg originated from the unborn at his behest and from the Egg originated Brahma. The entire world originated from him along with the lumina- ries. Thus the universe is identical with the Unborn (aja).

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा यक्षं लक्षणैर्हीनमीशं दृष्ट्वा सेन्द्रास्ते किमेतत्त्विहेति यक्षं गत्वा निश्चयात्पावकाद्याः शक्तिक्षीणाश्चाभवन् यत्ततो ऽपि
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvā yakṣaṃ lakṣaṇairhīnamīśaṃ dṛṣṭvā sendrāste kimetattviheti yakṣaṃ gatvā niścayātpāvakādyāḥ śaktikṣīṇāścābhavan yattato 'pi
verses.translation: Hence, O brahmins, the entire Egg originated from the unborn at his behest and from the Egg originated Brahma. The entire world originated from him along with the lumina- ries. Thus the universe is identical with the Unborn (aja).
verses.hindi: प्रकीर्तितः। मुहूर्तानां तथैवादिरमुहूर्तो रुद्रहैवतः
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, O brahmins, the entire Egg originated from the unborn at his behest and from the Egg originated Brahma. The entire world originated from him along with the lumina- ries. Thus the universe is identical with the Unborn (aja).
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, O brahmins, the entire Egg originated from the unborn at his behest and from the Egg originated Brahma. The entire world originated from him along with the lumina- ries. Thus the universe is identical with the Unborn (aja).

verses.sanskrit: दग्धुं तृणं वापि समक्षमस्य यक्षस्य वह्निर्न शशाक विप्राः वायुस्तृणं चालयितुं तथान्ये स्वान्स्वान्प्रभावान् सकलामरेन्द्राः
verses.transliteration: dagdhuṃ tṛṇaṃ vāpi samakṣamasya yakṣasya vahnirna śaśāka viprāḥ vāyustṛṇaṃ cālayituṃ tathānye svānsvānprabhāvān sakalāmarendrāḥ
verses.translation: Hence, O brahmins, the entire Egg originated from the unborn at his behest and from the Egg originated Brahma. The entire world originated from him along with the lumina- ries. Thus the universe is identical with the Unborn (aja).
verses.hindi: क्षणश्चापि निमेषादिः कालः कालविदां वराः। श्रवणान्तं धनिष्ठादि युगं स्यात्पञ्चवार्षिकम्॥
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, O brahmins, the entire Egg originated from the unborn at his behest and from the Egg originated Brahma. The entire world originated from him along with the lumina- ries. Thus the universe is identical with the Unborn (aja).
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, O brahmins, the entire Egg originated from the unborn at his behest and from the Egg originated Brahma. The entire world originated from him along with the lumina- ries. Thus the universe is identical with the Unborn (aja).

verses.sanskrit: तदा स्वयं वृत्ररिपुः सुरेन्द्रैः सुरेश्वरः सर्वसमृद्धिहेतुः सुरेश्वरं यक्षमुवाच को वा भवानितीत्थं स कुतूहलात्मा
verses.transliteration: tadā svayaṃ vṛtraripuḥ surendraiḥ sureśvaraḥ sarvasamṛddhihetuḥ sureśvaraṃ yakṣamuvāca ko vā bhavānitītthaṃ sa kutūhalātmā
verses.translation: Hence, O brahmins, the entire Egg originated from the unborn at his behest and from the Egg originated Brahma. The entire world originated from him along with the lumina- ries. Thus the universe is identical with the Unborn (aja).
verses.hindi: दिवाकरः स्मृतस्तस्मात्कालकृद्विभुरीश्वरः
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, O brahmins, the entire Egg originated from the unborn at his behest and from the Egg originated Brahma. The entire world originated from him along with the lumina- ries. Thus the universe is identical with the Unborn (aja).
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, O brahmins, the entire Egg originated from the unborn at his behest and from the Egg originated Brahma. The entire world originated from him along with the lumina- ries. Thus the universe is identical with the Unborn (aja).

verses.sanskrit: तदा ह्यदृश्यं गत एव यक्षस् तदांबिका हैमवती शुभास्या उमा शुभैराभरणैरनेकैः सुशोभमाना त्वनु चाविरासीत्
verses.transliteration: tadā hyadṛśyaṃ gata eva yakṣas tadāṃbikā haimavatī śubhāsyā umā śubhairābharaṇairanekaiḥ suśobhamānā tvanu cāvirāsīt
verses.translation: Hence, O brahmins, the entire Egg originated from the unborn at his behest and from the Egg originated Brahma. The entire world originated from him along with the lumina- ries. Thus the universe is identical with the Unborn (aja).
verses.hindi: तस्यापि भगवान् रुद्रः साक्षाद्देवः प्रवर्तकः लोकसंव्यवहारार्थ महादेवेन निर्मितः
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, O brahmins, the entire Egg originated from the unborn at his behest and from the Egg originated Brahma. The entire world originated from him along with the lumina- ries. Thus the universe is identical with the Unborn (aja).
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, O brahmins, the entire Egg originated from the unborn at his behest and from the Egg originated Brahma. The entire world originated from him along with the lumina- ries. Thus the universe is identical with the Unborn (aja).

verses.sanskrit: तां शक्रमुख्या बहुशोभमानाम् उमामजां हैमवतीमपृच्छन् ।* किमेतदीशे बहुशोभमाने वांबिके यक्षवपुश्चकास्ति
verses.transliteration: tāṃ śakramukhyā bahuśobhamānām umāmajāṃ haimavatīmapṛcchan /* kimetadīśe bahuśobhamāne vāṃbike yakṣavapuścakāsti
verses.translation: Hence, O brahmins, the entire Egg originated from the unborn at his behest and from the Egg originated Brahma. The entire world originated from him along with the lumina- ries. Thus the universe is identical with the Unborn (aja).
verses.hindi: एकरूपप्रधानस्य परिणामोऽयमद्भुतः । नैष शक्यः प्रसंख्यातुं याथातथ्येन केनचित्
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, O brahmins, the entire Egg originated from the unborn at his behest and from the Egg originated Brahma. The entire world originated from him along with the lumina- ries. Thus the universe is identical with the Unborn (aja).
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, O brahmins, the entire Egg originated from the unborn at his behest and from the Egg originated Brahma. The entire world originated from him along with the lumina- ries. Thus the universe is identical with the Unborn (aja).

verses.sanskrit: निशम्य तद्यक्षमुमाम्बिकाह त्वगोचरश्चेति सुराः सशक्राः ।* प्रणेमुरेनां मृगराजगामिनीमुमामजां लोहितशुक्लकृष्णाम्
verses.transliteration: niśamya tadyakṣamumāmbikāha tvagocaraśceti surāḥ saśakrāḥ /* praṇemurenāṃ mṛgarājagāminīmumāmajāṃ lohitaśuklakṛṣṇām
verses.translation: Hence, O brahmins, the entire Egg originated from the unborn at his behest and from the Egg originated Brahma. The entire world originated from him along with the lumina- ries. Thus the universe is identical with the Unborn (aja).
verses.hindi: चक्षुः शास्त्रं जलं लेख्यं गणितं मुनिसत्तमाः इन शुक्र आदि ग्रहोंको ताराके नामसे भी जानना चाहिए । ये अपने-अपने जन्म-नक्षत्रोंमें उत्पन्न पीड़ाओंमें
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, O brahmins, the entire Egg originated from the unborn at his behest and from the Egg originated Brahma. The entire world originated from him along with the lumina- ries. Thus the universe is identical with the Unborn (aja).
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, O brahmins, the entire Egg originated from the unborn at his behest and from the Egg originated Brahma. The entire world originated from him along with the lumina- ries. Thus the universe is identical with the Unborn (aja).

verses.sanskrit: संभाविता सा सकलामरेन्द्रैः सर्वप्रवृत्तिस्तु सुरासुराणाम् अहं पुरासं प्रकृतिश् च पुंसो यक्षस्य चाज्ञावशगेत्यथाह
verses.transliteration: saṃbhāvitā sā sakalāmarendraiḥ sarvapravṛttistu surāsurāṇām ahaṃ purāsaṃ prakṛtiś ca puṃso yakṣasya cājñāvaśagetyathāha
verses.translation: Hence, O brahmins, the entire Egg originated from the unborn at his behest and from the Egg originated Brahma. The entire world originated from him along with the lumina- ries. Thus the universe is identical with the Unborn (aja).
verses.hindi: वैगुण्यताको प्राप्त होते हैं, तब उस ग्रहकी पूजा करनेसे
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, O brahmins, the entire Egg originated from the unborn at his behest and from the Egg originated Brahma. The entire world originated from him along with the lumina- ries. Thus the universe is identical with the Unborn (aja).
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, O brahmins, the entire Egg originated from the unborn at his behest and from the Egg originated Brahma. The entire world originated from him along with the lumina- ries. Thus the universe is identical with the Unborn (aja).

verses.sanskrit: तस्माद्द्विजाः सर्वमजस्य तस्य नियोगतश्चाण्डमभूदजाद्वै अजश् च अण्डादखिलं च तस्माज् ज्योतिर्गणैर्लोकमजात्मकं तत्
verses.transliteration: tasmāddvijāḥ sarvamajasya tasya niyogataścāṇḍamabhūdajādvai ajaś ca aṇḍādakhilaṃ ca tasmāj jyotirgaṇairlokamajātmakaṃ tat
verses.translation: Hence, O brahmins, the entire Egg originated from the unborn at his behest and from the Egg originated Brahma. The entire world originated from him along with the lumina- ries. Thus the universe is identical with the Unborn (aja).
verses.hindi: मनुष्य उस दोषसे मुक्त हो जाता है। इन सभी ग्रहोंमें आदित्य (सूर्य) आदि (प्रधान) ग्रह कहा जाता हैं। ताराग्रहोंमें शुक्र, केतुओंमें धूमवान् तथा चारों दिशाओंमें विभक्त ग्रहोंमें धुव प्रधान है । नक्षत्रोमें धनिष्ठा और अयनोंमें उत्तरायण प्रधान है । पाँचों वर्षॉमें संवत्सरको प्रधान कहा
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, O brahmins, the entire Egg originated from the unborn at his behest and from the Egg originated Brahma. The entire world originated from him along with the lumina- ries. Thus the universe is identical with the Unborn (aja).
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, O brahmins, the entire Egg originated from the unborn at his behest and from the Egg originated Brahma. The entire world originated from him along with the lumina- ries. Thus the universe is identical with the Unborn (aja).

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीलिङ्गमहापुराणे पूर्वभागे भुवनकोशविन्यासनिर्णयो नाम त्रिपञ्चाशत्तमो ऽध्यायः ज्योतिर्गणप्रचारं वै संक्षिप्याण्डे ब्रवीम्यहम् देवक्षेत्राणि चालोक्य ग्रहचारप्रसिद्धये
verses.transliteration: iti śrīliṅgamahāpurāṇe pūrvabhāge bhuvanakośavinyāsanirṇayo nāma tripañcāśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ jyotirgaṇapracāraṃ vai saṃkṣipyāṇḍe bravīmyaham devakṣetrāṇi cālokya grahacāraprasiddhaye
verses.translation: In the cast of the Mem, the city of Mahendra is situa- ted on the mountain Manasa; in the south the city of the son of the sun (i.e. Yama); in the west is the city of Varuna and in the north the city of Soma (Moon ). In all these directions, the deities of the quarters are stationed. They are the cities of Amaravatl, Samyamanl, Sukha and Vibha in order.
verses.hindi: गया है। ऋतुओंमें शिशिर तथा मासोंमें माघको आदिमास कहा जाता है। पक्षोमें शुक्लपक्ष और तिथियोंमें प्रतिपदा प्रधान है। दिन तथा रातके विभागोंमें दिनको आदि कहा गया है। मुहू्तोमें रुद्रदेवत आदिमुहूर्त है
verses.wordMeaning: In the cast of the Mem, the city of Mahendra is situa- ted on the mountain Manasa; in the south the city of the son of the sun (i.e. Yama); in the west is the city of Varuna and in the north the city of Soma (Moon ). In all these directions,…
verses.commentary: Sense: In the cast of the Mem, the city of Mahendra is situa- ted on the mountain Manasa; in the south the city of the son of the sun (i.e. Yama); in the west is the city of Varuna and in the north the city of Soma (Moon ). In all these directions,…

verses.sanskrit: मानसोपरि माहेन्द्री प्राच्यां मेरोः पुरी स्थिता दक्षिणे भानुपुत्रस्य वरुणस्य च वारुणी
verses.transliteration: mānasopari māhendrī prācyāṃ meroḥ purī sthitā dakṣiṇe bhānuputrasya varuṇasya ca vāruṇī
verses.translation: Understand the movement of the sun when he has reached quarter over and above the guardians of the quarters in the course of his southern transit.
verses.hindi: हे कालवेत्ताओंमें श्रेष्ठ! क्षणोंमें निमेष आदिकाल है। धनिष्ठासे श्रबणपर्यन्त पाँच वर्षाका युग होता है। भानुकी विशेष गतिके कारण जगत् चक्रकी भाँति परिवर्तित होता रहता है, इसलिये सूर्यको कालकी रचना करनेवाला, व्यापक तथा ईश्वर कहा गया है । सूर्य चारों प्रकारके प्राणियोंका प्रवर्तक एवं निवर्तक है और साक्षात् भगवान् रुद्रदेव उस (सूर्य) -के भी प्रवर्तक हैं । इस प्रकार महादेवने लोकव्यवहारके लिये नक्षत्रका अर्थनिश्चयवाला यह सन्निवेश
verses.wordMeaning: Understand the movement of the sun when he has reached quarter over and above the guardians of the quarters in the course of his southern transit.
verses.commentary: Sense: Understand the movement of the sun when he has reached quarter over and above the guardians of the quarters in the course of his southern transit.

verses.sanskrit: सौम्ये सोमस्य विपुला तासु दिग्देवताः स्थिताः अमरावती संयमनी सुखा चैव विभा क्रमात्
verses.transliteration: saumye somasya vipulā tāsu digdevatāḥ sthitāḥ amarāvatī saṃyamanī sukhā caiva vibhā kramāt
verses.translation: In his southern transit the sun rushes on like an arrow that is shot. Taking the multitude of luminaries with him he revolves perpetually.
verses.hindi: निर्मित किया है। उन भगवानूने ही कल्पके आरम्भमें बुद्धिपूर्वक इनका प्रवर्तन किया है। वे सबके आश्रय, अभिमानी तथा ज्योतिस्वरूप हैं ॥ ५५--५९॥
verses.wordMeaning: In his southern transit the sun rushes on like an arrow that is shot. Taking the multitude of luminaries with him he revolves perpetually.
verses.commentary: Sense: In his southern transit the sun rushes on like an arrow that is shot. Taking the multitude of luminaries with him he revolves perpetually.

verses.sanskrit: लोकपालोपरिष्टात् तु सर्वतो दक्षिणायने काष्ठां गतस्य सूर्यस्य गतिर् या तां निबोधत
verses.transliteration: lokapālopariṣṭāt tu sarvato dakṣiṇāyane kāṣṭhāṃ gatasya sūryasya gatir yā tāṃ nibodhata
verses.translation: O brahmins, when the lordly sun comes to the extremity of the city of Indra the sunrise is seen by all the people in Sam- yamanl.
verses.hindi: एक रूपवाले उन प्रधानका यह अद्भुत परिणाम है। यथार्थरूपसे इसका वर्णन किसीके द्वारा नहीं किया जा सकता है। भौतिक दृष्टिबाले विद्वान् मनुष्यको इन ज्योतिर्गणोंके प्रमाण तथा गतिके 'विषयमें आगम (वेद, शास्त्र), अनुमान, प्रत्यक्ष और उपपत्तिके द्वारा सावधानीपूर्वक बुद्धिसे परीक्षण करके इनपर श्रद्धा करनी चाहिए । है श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! चक्षु, शास्त्र, जल, लेख्य तथा गणित--इन पाँचोंको नक्षत्रोंके प्रमाणके निर्णयमें साधन
verses.wordMeaning: O brahmins, when the lordly sun comes to the extremity of the city of Indra the sunrise is seen by all the people in Sam- yamanl.
verses.commentary: Sense: O brahmins, when the lordly sun comes to the extremity of the city of Indra the sunrise is seen by all the people in Sam- yamanl.

verses.sanskrit: दक्षिणप्रक्रमे भानुः क्षिप्तेषुरिव धावति ज्योतिषां चक्रमादाय सततं परिगच्छति
verses.transliteration: dakṣiṇaprakrame bhānuḥ kṣipteṣuriva dhāvati jyotiṣāṃ cakramādāya satataṃ parigacchati
verses.translation: At the same time in Sukha vat! the sun is seen as at the close of the night. But in Vibha. the lord, the eye of the universe, i.e. the Sun sets.
verses.hindi: अन्तर्गत पूर्वभागमें 'ग्रहसंख्यावर्णन ' नामक इकसठवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ
verses.wordMeaning: At the same time in Sukha vat! the sun is seen as at the close of the night. But in Vibha. the lord, the eye of the universe, i.e. the Sun sets.
verses.commentary: Sense: At the same time in Sukha vat! the sun is seen as at the close of the night. But in Vibha. the lord, the eye of the universe, i.e. the Sun sets.

verses.sanskrit: पुरान्तगो यदा भानुः शक्रस्य भवति प्रभुः सर्वैः सायमनैः सौरो ह्य् उदयो दृश्यते द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: purāntago yadā bhānuḥ śakrasya bhavati prabhuḥ sarvaiḥ sāyamanaiḥ sauro hy udayo dṛśyate dvijāḥ
verses.translation: It has been mentioned by me that just as he absorbs waters in Amaravatl so also he, the traverser of the firmament, after reaching Samyamanl, Sukha** and Vibha, absorbs waters.

verses.wordMeaning: It has been mentioned by me that just as he absorbs waters in Amaravatl so also he, the traverser of the firmament, after reaching Samyamanl, Sukha** and Vibha, absorbs waters.
verses.commentary: Sense: It has been mentioned by me that just as he absorbs waters in Amaravatl so also he, the traverser of the firmament, after reaching Samyamanl, Sukha** and Vibha, absorbs waters.

verses.sanskrit: स एव सुखवत्यां तु निशान्तस्थः प्रदृश्यते अस्तमेति पुनः सूर्यो विभायां विश्वदृग् विभुः
verses.transliteration: sa eva sukhavatyāṃ tu niśāntasthaḥ pradṛśyate astameti punaḥ sūryo vibhāyāṃ viśvadṛg vibhuḥ
verses.translation: When there is afternoon in Agneyl (i.e. south-east), O brahmins, it is forenoon in the south-west. When it is terrible latter half of the night in the north-west, it is the earlier part of the night in the north-east. Similarly, when the sucker of waters (i.e. the sun) moves about in the middle of Puskara®®* the mountain to the north of Manasa, he traverses a thirtieth part of the earth in a Muhurta (48 mts). Understand this number in yojanas travelled in a Muhurta.
verses.hindi: उत्तानपादो राजा वै पालयामास मेदिनीम्
verses.wordMeaning: When there is afternoon in Agneyl (i.e. south-east), O brahmins, it is forenoon in the south-west. When it is terrible latter half of the night in the north-west, it is the earlier part of the night in the north-east. Similarly, when the sucker of waters (i.e.…

verses.sanskrit: मया प्रोक्तो ऽमरावत्यां यथासौ वारितस्करः तथा संयमनीं प्राप्य सुखां चैव विभां खगः
verses.transliteration: mayā prokto 'marāvatyāṃ yathāsau vāritaskaraḥ tathā saṃyamanīṃ prāpya sukhāṃ caiva vibhāṃ khagaḥ
verses.translation: The speed of the noble-souled sun per Muhurta is three million one hundred and fifty thousand yojanas. When the sun moves to the southern quarter with this speed from the north through the middle of Puskara during his northern transit and when he moves into the northern direction (from
verses.hindi: सन्तप्तहृदयो भूत्वा मम शोकं करिष्यसि। स्वस्थस्थानं ध्रुवं पुत्र स्वशक्त्या त्वं समाप्नुयाः सर्वेषामुपरिस्थानं केन प्राप्स्यामि सत्तम
verses.wordMeaning: The speed of the noble-souled sun per Muhurta is three million one hundred and fifty thousand yojanas.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The speed of the noble-souled sun per Muhurta is three million one hundred and fifty thousand yojanas.…

verses.sanskrit: यदापराह्णस्त्वाग्नेय्यां पूर्वाह्णो नैरृते द्विजाः तदा त्वपररात्रश् च वायुभागे सुदारुणः
verses.transliteration: yadāparāhṇastvāgneyyāṃ pūrvāhṇo nairṛte dvijāḥ tadā tvapararātraś ca vāyubhāge sudāruṇaḥ
verses.translation: Sukh& or Su9&. It la the capital of Varuna in the western direc- tion and it the tame as Sus& of the ancient Achemenian empire in Iran.
verses.hindi: ऋषिगण बोले--हे सूतजी ! बुद्धिमानोमे श्रे ध्रुव भगवान् विष्णुको कृपासे ग्रहोंके मेढ़ीभूत (मध्य । स्थानवाले) किस प्रकार हुए, हमलोगोंको इस समय  बताइये
verses.wordMeaning: Sukh& or Su9&. It la the capital of Varuna in the western direc- tion and it the tame as Sus& of the ancient Achemenian empire in Iran.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sukh& or Su9&. It la the capital of Varuna in the western direc- tion and it the tame as Sus& of the ancient Achemenian empire in Iran.

verses.sanskrit: ईशान्यां पूर्वरात्रस्तु गतिरेषा च सर्वतः एवं पुष्करमध्ये तु यदा सर्पति वारिपः
verses.transliteration: īśānyāṃ pūrvarātrastu gatireṣā ca sarvataḥ evaṃ puṣkaramadhye tu yadā sarpati vāripaḥ
verses.translation: Pufkara or sky, atmospheric region. Cf. Vilva cited in ST. «<Pu|karam pahkid vyomni**.
verses.hindi: सूतजी बोले- है द्विजो! मैने पूर्वकालमें अनेक । शास्त्रोंके ज्ञाता मार्कण्डेयजीसे इसी बातको पूछा था, तब उन्होंने सुननेकी इच्छावाले मुझको बताया था मार्कण्डेयजी बोले प्राचीन कालमें सार्वभौम
verses.wordMeaning: Pufkara or sky, atmospheric region. Cf. Vilva cited in ST. «<Pu|karam pahkid vyomni**.
verses.commentary: Sense: Pufkara or sky, atmospheric region. Cf. Vilva cited in ST. «<Pu|karam pahkid vyomni**.

verses.sanskrit: त्रिंशांशकं तु मेदिन्यां मुहूर्तेनैव गच्छति योजनानां मुहूर्तस्य इमां संख्यां निबोधत
verses.transliteration: triṃśāṃśakaṃ tu medinyāṃ muhūrtenaiva gacchati yojanānāṃ muhūrtasya imāṃ saṃkhyāṃ nibodhata
verses.translation: Just as the middle of the potter's wheel moves more slowly (than the end part) so also in the Uttarayana (northern transit) the sun moves slowly.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ राजा उत्तानपाद पृथ्वीका पालन करते थे। सुनीति तथा सुरुचि-ये उनको दो भार्याएँ थीं। उनकी ज्येष्ठ भार्या सुनीतिसे ध्रुव नामक पुत्र उत्पन्न हुआ था; वह महायशस्वी, महाज्ञानी, कुलका दीपक तथा महाबुद्धिमान्
verses.wordMeaning: Just as the middle of the potter's wheel moves more slowly (than the end part) so also in the Uttarayana (northern transit) the sun moves slowly.
verses.commentary: Sense: Just as the middle of the potter's wheel moves more slowly (than the end part) so also in the Uttarayana (northern transit) the sun moves slowly.

verses.sanskrit: पूर्णा शतसहस्राणाम् एकत्रिंशत्तु सा स्मृता पञ्चाशच्च तथान्यानि सहस्राण्यधिकानि तु
verses.transliteration: pūrṇā śatasahasrāṇām ekatriṃśattu sā smṛtā pañcāśacca tathānyāni sahasrāṇyadhikāni tu
verses.translation: Hence he traverses a smaller area in the course of a longer time. That chariot of the sun is occupied by Adityas, sages, Gandharvas, Apsarases, Gramanis, Serpents, and Rak- sasas. The thousand-rayed sun emits his rays in front, behind, below and above. Thereby he illuminates the excellent assembly of Brahma. During the sandhyas (dawn and dusk) the brahmins and sages offer water-libations. With these waters, the sun kills the demons as and when they come near him and then goes ahead.
verses.hindi: था। जब वह सात वर्षका था, तब किसी समय अपने पिताकी गोदमें बैठ गया  है विप्रेन्द्रो! उस समय अपने रूपपर गर्व करनेवाली सुरुचिने उसे गोदसे उतारकर प्रसन्नचित्त होकर अपने पुत्रको राजाकी गोदमें बैठा तदनन्तर पिताकी गोद न पाकर उस बुद्धिमान्  श्रुव-के हृदयमें दु:ख हुआ और वह अपनी माताके पास आकर बार-बार रोने लगा
verses.wordMeaning: Hence he traverses a smaller area in the course of a longer time. That chariot of the sun is occupied by Adityas, sages, Gandharvas, Apsarases, Gramanis, Serpents, and Rak- sasas. The thousand-rayed sun emits his rays in front, behind, below and above.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence he traverses a smaller area in the course of a longer time. That chariot of the sun is occupied by Adityas, sages, Gandharvas, Apsarases, Gramanis, Serpents, and Rak- sasas. The thousand-rayed sun emits his rays in front, behind, below and above.…

verses.sanskrit: मौहूर्तिकी गतिर्ह्येषा भास्करस्य महात्मनः एतेन गतियोगेन यदा काष्ठां तु दक्षिणाम्
verses.transliteration: mauhūrtikī gatirhyeṣā bhāskarasya mahātmanaḥ etena gatiyogena yadā kāṣṭhāṃ tu dakṣiṇām
verses.translation: A star space is 360 or 13® i3*i Star space is thus equal to 180. In other words the whole consists of 360* which is the space of the 27 constellations Afvini etc. The sun is visible at any time only on half of the sphere (called day). Hence half of the sphere is 180° or star spaces. The reference here is to that day when the day time is shortest (i.e. 9 hours 36 minutes) and night longest (14 hours 24 minutes) which occurs in India in Kashmir.
verses.hindi: तब शोकमें डूबी हुई माताने रोते हुए पुत्रसे कहा--सुरुचि अपने पतिकी प्रिय पत्नी है और उसका पुत्र भी उसी प्रकार उन्हें प्रिय है। तुम मुझ अभागिनके अभागे पुत्र उत्पन्न हुए हो। तुम क्यों चिन्ता
verses.wordMeaning: A star space is 360 or 13® i3*i Star space is thus equal to 180. In other words the whole consists of 360* which is the space of the 27 constellations Afvini etc. The sun is visible at any time only on half of the sphere (called day).…
verses.commentary: Sense: A star space is 360 or 13® i3*i Star space is thus equal to 180. In other words the whole consists of 360* which is the space of the 27 constellations Afvini etc. The sun is visible at any time only on half of the sphere (called day).…

verses.sanskrit: पर्यपृच्छेत् पतङ्गो ऽपि सौम्याशां चोत्तरे ऽहनि मध्ये तु पुष्करस्याथ भ्रमते दक्षिणायने
verses.transliteration: paryapṛcchet pataṅgo 'pi saumyāśāṃ cottare 'hani madhye tu puṣkarasyātha bhramate dakṣiṇāyane
verses.translation: Just as the wheel whirls slowly at the nave, so also Dhruva whirls like the lump of clay in the middle.
verses.hindi: करते हो और बार-बार किसलिये रो रहे हो? तुम दुःखितचित्त होकर मेरे शोकको ही बढ़ाओगे। है पुत्र! तुम्हें अपनी शक्तिसे शान्त तथा अटल स्थान प्राप्त करना चाहिए तब माताके इस प्रकार कहनेपर वह वनमें चला गया। वहाँ ऋषि विश्वामित्रो देखकर उन्हें विधिपूर्वक प्रणाम करके दोनों हाथ जोड़कर उसने कहा-है
verses.wordMeaning: Just as the wheel whirls slowly at the nave, so also Dhruva whirls like the lump of clay in the middle.
verses.commentary: Sense: Just as the wheel whirls slowly at the nave, so also Dhruva whirls like the lump of clay in the middle.

verses.sanskrit: मानसोत्तरशैले तु महातेजा विभावसुः मण्डलानां शतं पूर्णं तदशीत्यधिकं विभुः
verses.transliteration: mānasottaraśaile tu mahātejā vibhāvasuḥ maṇḍalānāṃ śataṃ pūrṇaṃ tadaśītyadhikaṃ vibhuḥ
verses.translation: Those who know the ancient lore, say that thirty muhurtas constitute a day and a night during which the sun traverses the space in between the two limits (i.e. the solstitial points). Just as the nave of the wheel of the porter remains there alone (i.e. without moving) so also Auttanapada (i.e. Dhruva) rotates (without moving) as the leader of the lumina- ries along with the planets.
verses.hindi: अध्याय ६२ उत्तानपादके पुत्र श्रुवका आख्यान, ध्रुवकी तपस्या तथा ध्रुवलोकसंस्थानका वर्णन
verses.wordMeaning: Those who know the ancient lore, say that thirty muhurtas constitute a day and a night during which the sun traverses the space in between the two limits (i.e. the solstitial points). Just as the nave of the wheel of the porter remains there alone (i.e.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who know the ancient lore, say that thirty muhurtas constitute a day and a night during which the sun traverses the space in between the two limits (i.e. the solstitial points). Just as the nave of the wheel of the porter remains there alone (i.e.…

verses.sanskrit: बाह्यं चाभ्यन्तरं प्रोक्तम् उत्तरायणदक्षिणे प्रत्यहं चरते तानि सूर्यो वै मण्डलानि तु
verses.transliteration: bāhyaṃ cābhyantaraṃ proktam uttarāyaṇadakṣiṇe pratyahaṃ carate tāni sūryo vai maṇḍalāni tu
verses.translation: The group of the sages and the luminaries moves in accordance with his will (mind). Presided over by him the sun, along with the wind, takes up water from everywhere.
verses.hindi: पितुरङ्के समासीनं माता माँ सुरुचिर्मुने ।  न माया जाओ बता नाव  है सत्तम! आप कृपा करके मुझे बतायें कि व्यधूनयत्स ता राजा ता नोवाच किञ्चन॥ १३  मैं किस उपायसे सबके ऊपर स्थान प्राप्त करूँगा? हे
verses.wordMeaning: The group of the sages and the luminaries moves in accordance with his will (mind). Presided over by him the sun, along with the wind, takes up water from everywhere.
verses.commentary: Sense: The group of the sages and the luminaries moves in accordance with his will (mind). Presided over by him the sun, along with the wind, takes up water from everywhere.

verses.sanskrit: कुलालचक्रपर्यन्तो यथा शीघ्रं प्रवर्तते दक्षिणप्रक्रमे देवस् तथा शीघ्रं प्रवर्तते
verses.transliteration: kulālacakraparyanto yathā śīghraṃ pravartate dakṣiṇaprakrame devas tathā śīghraṃ pravartate
verses.translation: For the welfare of creatures, the waters have been evolved by lord Siva as their ultimate resort. The waters alone constitute Bhu, Bhuvah, Svah, anna (cooked rice) as well as nectar. The waters are the vital breaths of the worlds, the living beings, the worlds themselves. Of what avail is much talk? The world of mobile and immobile beings is constituted by the waters.
verses.hindi: मुने! माता सुरुचिने पिताकी गोदमें बैठे हुए मुझको गोदसे उतार दिया और उन राजाने उन्हें कुछ नहीं कहा। है ब्रह्मन्! इस कारणसे दुःखी होकर मैं माताके पास गया। तब मेरी माता सुनीतिने कहा--हे पुत्र!
verses.wordMeaning: For the welfare of creatures, the waters have been evolved by lord Siva as their ultimate resort. The waters alone constitute Bhu, Bhuvah, Svah, anna (cooked rice) as well as nectar. The waters are the vital breaths of the worlds, the living beings, the worlds themselves.…
verses.commentary: Sense: For the welfare of creatures, the waters have been evolved by lord Siva as their ultimate resort. The waters alone constitute Bhu, Bhuvah, Svah, anna (cooked rice) as well as nectar. The waters are the vital breaths of the worlds, the living beings, the worlds themselves.…

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात्प्रकृष्टां भूमिं तु कालेनाल्पेन गच्छति सूर्यो द्वादशभिः शीघ्रं मुहूर्तैर्दक्षिणायने
verses.transliteration: tasmātprakṛṣṭāṃ bhūmiṃ tu kālenālpena gacchati sūryo dvādaśabhiḥ śīghraṃ muhūrtairdakṣiṇāyane
verses.translation: O brahmins, the cloud originating from the smoke of the dead bodies brings about evil. The cloud originating from the smoke of the fire during magic rites brings about the destruction of living beings.
verses.hindi: शोक मत करो, तुम अपने कर्मसे उत्तम तथा परम स्थान प्राप्त कर सकते हो। है महामुने! उनका वचन सुनकर मैं इस वनमें आपके स्थानपर आया हूँ। हे ब्रह्मन्! आज मैंने आपका दर्शन किया, अतः है प्रभो! आपकी कृपासे मैं अद्भुत तथा उत्तम स्थान अवश्य प्राप्त करूँगा॥ ११--१६॥
verses.wordMeaning: O brahmins, the cloud originating from the smoke of the dead bodies brings about evil. The cloud originating from the smoke of the fire during magic rites brings about the destruction of living beings.
verses.commentary: Sense: O brahmins, the cloud originating from the smoke of the dead bodies brings about evil. The cloud originating from the smoke of the fire during magic rites brings about the destruction of living beings.

verses.sanskrit: त्रयोदशार्धमृक्षाणाम् अह्ना तु चरते रविः मुहूर्तैस्तावदृक्षाणि नक्तमष्टादशैश्चरन्
verses.transliteration: trayodaśārdhamṛkṣāṇām ahnā tu carate raviḥ muhūrtaistāvadṛkṣāṇi naktamaṣṭādaśaiścaran
verses.translation: Thus there is weal or woe unto the worlds due to diffe- rent kinds of smokes. Hence a man shall stifle the smoke arising from the black magic rites.
verses.hindi: ध्रुवके द्वारा इस प्रकार कहे गये श्रीमान् मुनिने हँसते हुए यह कहा-हे राजपुत्र! सुनो, तुम जगत्के स्वामी, कष्टोंका नाश करनेवाले तथा बुद्धिमान् महादेव शम्भुके दक्षिण” अंगसे उत्पन्न केशव (विष्णु)-
verses.wordMeaning: Thus there is weal or woe unto the worlds due to diffe- rent kinds of smokes. Hence a man shall stifle the smoke arising from the black magic rites.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus there is weal or woe unto the worlds due to diffe- rent kinds of smokes. Hence a man shall stifle the smoke arising from the black magic rites.

verses.sanskrit: कुलालचक्रमध्यं तु यथा मन्दं प्रसर्पति तथोदगयने सूर्यः सर्पते मन्दविक्रमः
verses.transliteration: kulālacakramadhyaṃ tu yathā mandaṃ prasarpati tathodagayane sūryaḥ sarpate mandavikramaḥ
verses.translation: If a brahmin were to perform black magic rites with- out covering up the smoke thereof, he will wantonly become the cause of destruction of the world.
verses.hindi: की आराधना करके इस श्रेष्ठ स्थानको प्राप्त कर सकोगे। है महाप्राज्ञ! तुम सभी पापोंका नाश करनेवाले, अभीष्ट प्रदान करनेवाले, परम शुद्ध, पवित्र, दोषरहित तथा श्रेष्ठ मन्त्रका नित्य जप करो। तुम इन्द्रियोंको बशमें करके प्रणबसहित नमोऽस्तु वासुदेवाय  अर्थात् ३ नमोऽस्तु वासुदेवाय इस दिव्य मन्त्रको जपो और सनातन विष्णुका ध्यान करते हुए जप-होममें
verses.wordMeaning: If a brahmin were to perform black magic rites with- out covering up the smoke thereof, he will wantonly become the cause of destruction of the world.
verses.commentary: Sense: If a brahmin were to perform black magic rites with- out covering up the smoke thereof, he will wantonly become the cause of destruction of the world.

verses.sanskrit: तस्माद्दीर्घेण कालेन भूमिमल्पां तु गच्छति स रथो धिष्ठितो भानोर् आदित्यैर्मुनिभिस् तथा
verses.transliteration: tasmāddīrgheṇa kālena bhūmimalpāṃ tu gacchati sa ratho dhiṣṭhito bhānor ādityairmunibhis tathā
verses.translation: O men of holy rites, the clouds that are receptacles of waters shower waters at the behest of the wind for six months for the welfare of the worlds.
verses.hindi: उनके ऐसा कहनेपर महान् यशवाले धुवने उन विश्वामित्रको प्रणाम करके पूर्वकी ओर मुख करके ध्यानमग्न होकर प्रसन्तचित्त हो जप आरम्भ किया। शाक, मूल तथा फलका आहार करते हुए उसने आलस्यरहित होकर
verses.wordMeaning: O men of holy rites, the clouds that are receptacles of waters shower waters at the behest of the wind for six months for the welfare of the worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: O men of holy rites, the clouds that are receptacles of waters shower waters at the behest of the wind for six months for the welfare of the worlds.

verses.sanskrit: गन्धर्वैरप्सरोभिश् च ग्रामणीसर्पराक्षसैः प्रदीपयन् सहस्रांशुर् अग्रतः पृष्ठतो ऽप्यधः
verses.transliteration: gandharvairapsarobhiś ca grāmaṇīsarparākṣasaiḥ pradīpayan sahasrāṃśur agrataḥ pṛṣṭhato 'pyadhaḥ
verses.translation: The thunder pertains to the wind; the lightning arises from fire. O leading sages, the origin of snow from those clouds is in three ways.
verses.hindi: दिन-रात निरन्तर एक वर्षतक मन्त्रका बार-बार जप 'किया। वेताल, भयंकर राक्षस तथा भयानक सिंह आदि बड़े जानवर बुद्धिको मोहित करनेके लिये उस महात्माके पास आये, किंतु वासुदेबका जप करता हुआ वह तनिक एतस्मात्कारणाद् ब्रहस्त्रस्तोऽहं मातरं गत: । सुनीतिराह मे माता मा कृथाः शोकमुत्तमम्
verses.wordMeaning: The thunder pertains to the wind; the lightning arises from fire. O leading sages, the origin of snow from those clouds is in three ways.
verses.commentary: Sense: The thunder pertains to the wind; the lightning arises from fire. O leading sages, the origin of snow from those clouds is in three ways.

verses.sanskrit: ऊर्ध्वतश् च करं त्यक्त्वा सभां ब्राह्मीमनुत्तमाम् अंभोभिर् मुनिभिस्त्यक्तैः संध्यायां तु निशाचरान्
verses.transliteration: ūrdhvataś ca karaṃ tyaktvā sabhāṃ brāhmīmanuttamām aṃbhobhir munibhistyaktaiḥ saṃdhyāyāṃ tu niśācarān
verses.translation: The word abhra is derived thus: — na bhrayanti yatah (since they do not become destroyed).
verses.hindi: प्राप्तो वनमिदं ब्रह्मन्नद्य त्वां दृष्टवान् प्रभो। तव प्रसादात्प्राप्स्येऽहं स्थानमद्भुतमुत्तमम्
verses.wordMeaning: The word abhra is derived thus: — na bhrayanti yatah (since they do not become destroyed).
verses.commentary: Sense: The word abhra is derived thus: — na bhrayanti yatah (since they do not become destroyed).

verses.sanskrit: हत्वा हत्वा तु सम्प्राप्तान् ब्राह्मणैश्चरते रविः अष्टादश मुहूर्तं तु उत्तरायणपश्चिमम्
verses.transliteration: hatvā hatvā tu samprāptān brāhmaṇaiścarate raviḥ aṣṭādaśa muhūrtaṃ tu uttarāyaṇapaścimam
verses.translation: The showers of the clouds Paundras, (i.e., those falling in the land of Pundra) are accompanied by lightning, arc cool and hence conducive to plant (growth). They are ice-cool and look like the spray of waters from elephants' trunks.
verses.hindi: इत्युक्तः स मुनिः श्रीमान् प्रहसन्निदमब्रवीत्। राजपुत्र शृणुष्वेदं स्थानमुत्तममाप्स्यसि आराध्य जगतामीशं केशवं क्लेशनाशनम्। दक्षिणाङ्गभवं शम्भोर्महादेवस्य धीमतः
verses.wordMeaning: The showers of the clouds Paundras, (i.e., those falling in the land of Pundra) are accompanied by lightning, arc cool and hence conducive to plant (growth). They are ice-cool and look like the spray of waters from elephants' trunks.
verses.commentary: Sense: The showers of the clouds Paundras, (i.e., those falling in the land of Pundra) are accompanied by lightning, arc cool and hence conducive to plant (growth). They are ice-cool and look like the spray of waters from elephants' trunks.

verses.sanskrit: अहर्भवति तच्चापि चरते मन्दविक्रमः त्रयोदशार्धम् ऋक्षाणि नक्तं द्वादशभी रविः मुहूर्तैस् तावद् ऋक्षाणि दिवाष्टादशभिश्चरन्
verses.transliteration: aharbhavati taccāpi carate mandavikramaḥ trayodaśārdham ṛkṣāṇi naktaṃ dvādaśabhī raviḥ muhūrtais tāvad ṛkṣāṇi divāṣṭādaśabhiścaran
verses.translation: The clouds called Gangas originate from the waters of Ganga. Through the wind in the Paravaha region these agitate the mountains, rivers and elephants of the quarters.
verses.hindi: जप नित्यं महाप्राज्ञ सर्वपापविनाशनम्। इष्टदं परमं शुद्धं पवित्रममलं परम्
verses.wordMeaning: The clouds called Gangas originate from the waters of Ganga. Through the wind in the Paravaha region these agitate the mountains, rivers and elephants of the quarters.
verses.commentary: Sense: The clouds called Gangas originate from the waters of Ganga. Through the wind in the Paravaha region these agitate the mountains, rivers and elephants of the quarters.

verses.sanskrit: ततो मन्दतरं नाभ्यां चक्रं भ्रमति वै यथा मृत्पिण्ड इव मध्यस्थो ध्रुवो भ्रमति वै तथा
verses.transliteration: tato mandataraṃ nābhyāṃ cakraṃ bhramati vai yathā mṛtpiṇḍa iva madhyastho dhruvo bhramati vai tathā
verses.translation: The water separated from the clouds goes from one mountain to another. The wind Paravaha takes the cloud to the Himavat mountain.
verses.hindi: नमोऽस्तु वासुदेवाय इत्येवं नियतेन्द्रियः २० ध्यायन् सनातनं विष्णुं जपहोमपरायणः।
verses.wordMeaning: The water separated from the clouds goes from one mountain to another. The wind Paravaha takes the cloud to the Himavat mountain.
verses.commentary: Sense: The water separated from the clouds goes from one mountain to another. The wind Paravaha takes the cloud to the Himavat mountain.

verses.sanskrit: कुलालचक्रनाभिस्तु यथा तत्रैव वर्तते औत्तानपादो भ्रमति ग्रहैः सार्धं ग्रहाग्रणीः
verses.transliteration: kulālacakranābhistu yathā tatraiva vartate auttānapādo bhramati grahaiḥ sārdhaṃ grahāgraṇīḥ
verses.translation: Pufkardyit: Puskara, Avarta, etc. coinprise a class of clouds that rain in torrents at the dissolution of the world.
verses.hindi: यहाँ मूलमें विष्णुको भगवान् शंकरके दक्षिणांग से उत्पन्न बताया गया है, किंतु इसी 'लिङ्गपुराणके ३८वें अध्यायमें भगवान् विष्णुने स्वयंको भगवान् शिवके वामांगसे और ब्रह्माजीको दक्षिणांगसे प्रादुर्भूत बताया है अहं वामाङ्गजो ब्रह् शङ्करस्य महात्मनः । भवान् भवस्य देवस्य दक्षिणाङ्गभवः स्वयम् इसकी माता जो सुनीति थी, उसका रूप धारण करके एक पिशाची उसके पास आयी और अत्यन्त दुःखित होकर रोने लगी-तुम मेरे एकमात्र पुत्र हो, तुप कष्ट क्यों सह रहे हो, मुझे अनाथ छोड़कर तुम तपे
verses.wordMeaning: Pufkardyit: Puskara, Avarta, etc. coinprise a class of clouds that rain in torrents at the dissolution of the world.
verses.commentary: Sense: Pufkardyit: Puskara, Avarta, etc. coinprise a class of clouds that rain in torrents at the dissolution of the world.

verses.sanskrit: गणो मुनिज्योतिषां तु मनसा तस्य सर्पति अधिष्ठितः पुनस्तेन भानुस्त्वादाय तिष्ठति
verses.transliteration: gaṇo munijyotiṣāṃ tu manasā tasya sarpati adhiṣṭhitaḥ punastena bhānustvādāya tiṣṭhati
verses.translation: The showers have been recounted now. They are of two types being conducive to the increase of two types of vege- tation. I shall mention them briefly according to my knowledge.
verses.hindi: लग गये हो--इस प्रकारके वचन बोलती हुई उस स्त्रीक ओर बिलकुल न देखकर वह महातपस्वी प्रसन्नचित्त होकर हरिका नाम जपता रहा॥ २५--२७॥
verses.wordMeaning: The showers have been recounted now. They are of two types being conducive to the increase of two types of vege- tation. I shall mention them briefly according to my knowledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: The showers have been recounted now. They are of two types being conducive to the increase of two types of vege- tation. I shall mention them briefly according to my knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: किरणैः सर्वतस्तोयं देवो वै ससमीरणः औत्तानपादस्य सदा ध्रुवत्वं वै प्रसादतः
verses.transliteration: kiraṇaiḥ sarvatastoyaṃ devo vai sasamīraṇaḥ auttānapādasya sadā dhruvatvaṃ vai prasādataḥ
verses.translation: The sun of great splendour, the lord with the eye of the universe is the creator of rains. O excellent brahmins, he is the great Iana, Siva himself.
verses.hindi: तदनन्तर वहाँ सर्वत्र विघ्नोंके स्वरूप शान्त हो गये। तब गरुड़पर सवार होकर कालमेघके समान (श्याम) कान्तिवाले, समस्त देवताओंसे धिरे हुए तथा महर्षियोंके द्वारा स्तुति किये जाते हुए शत्रुसंहारक भगवान् विष्णु ध्रुवके पास आये
verses.wordMeaning: The sun of great splendour, the lord with the eye of the universe is the creator of rains. O excellent brahmins, he is the great Iana, Siva himself.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sun of great splendour, the lord with the eye of the universe is the creator of rains. O excellent brahmins, he is the great Iana, Siva himself.

verses.sanskrit: विष्णोरौत्तानपादेन चाप्तं तातस्य हेतुना आपः पीतास्तु सूर्येण क्रमन्ते शशिनः क्रमात्
verses.transliteration: viṣṇorauttānapādena cāptaṃ tātasya hetunā āpaḥ pītāstu sūryeṇa kramante śaśinaḥ kramāt
verses.translation: He alone is the splendour, power and strength, O brahmins. He is fame himself. He is the eye, ear, mind, Mrtyu, soul, Manyu, the quarters and the interstices, truth, order, discipline, wind, firmament, planets, the guardians of the quarters, Visnu, Brahma, Rudra and Mahevara himself.
verses.hindi: उनको आया हुआ देखकर यह कौन है-एऐसा सोचता हुआ तथा अपने नेत्रोंसे जगत्पति हषीकेशका पान करता हुआ-सा वह महान् प्रभावाला ध्रुव “39

verses.sanskrit: निशाकरान्निस्रवन्ते जीमूतान्प्रत्यपः क्रमात् वृन्दं जलमुचां चैव श्वसनेनाभिताडितम्
verses.transliteration: niśākarānnisravante jīmūtānpratyapaḥ kramāt vṛndaṃ jalamucāṃ caiva śvasanenābhitāḍitam
verses.translation: This glorious thousand-rayed deity lord Siva is very auspicious. He has eight hands, a body semi-female and three eyes. He is the overlord of Devas. O brahmins, it is due to his favour alone that rain of various kinds occurs. The sun takes up water by his rays in order to give it back thousandfold. There is neither increase nor decrease of water, if we consider it duly. The wind presided over by Dhruva withdraws the rain. It falls off the planet sun and spreads through the sphere of the stars. At the close of the movement, it re-enters the sun and is presided over by Dhruva.
verses.hindi: । तब गोविन्दने अपने शंखके अग्रभागसे उसके मुखका स्पर्श किया उसके बाद वह ध्रुव परम ज्ञान प्राप्त करके हाथ जोड़कर सभी लोकोंके स्वामी पुरुषोत्तम हरिकी इस प्रकार स्तुति करने लगा-हे देवदेवेश! हे शंख, चक्र, गदा धारण करनेवाले! है लोकात्मन्! हे

At the close of the movement, it re-enters the sun and is presided over by Dhruva.

verses.sanskrit: सहस्रकिरणः श्रीमान् अष्टहस्तः सुमङ्गलः अर्धनारिवपुः साक्षात् त्रिनेत्रस् त्रिदशाधिपः
verses.transliteration: sahasrakiraṇaḥ śrīmān aṣṭahastaḥ sumaṅgalaḥ ardhanārivapuḥ sākṣāt trinetras tridaśādhipaḥ
verses.translation: This glorious thousand-rayed deity lord Siva is very auspicious. He has eight hands, a body semi-female and three eyes. He is the overlord of Devas. O brahmins, it is due to his favour alone that rain of various kinds occurs. The sun takes up water by his rays in order to give it back thousandfold. There is neither increase nor decrease of water, if we consider it duly. The wind presided over by Dhruva withdraws the rain. It falls off the planet sun and spreads through the sphere of the stars. At the close of the movement, it re-enters the sun and is presided over by Dhruva.
verses.hindi: धर्मको पत्नियाँ कही गयी हैं। है ऋषियो! अब मैं उनके पुत्रोंको बताता हूँ--विश्वासे विश्वेदेव हुए। साध्याने साध्योंको जन्म दिया। मरुत्वतीसे मरुत्वान हुए और वसुसे सभी वसु उत्पन्न हुए। भानुसे भानुगण
verses.wordMeaning: This glorious thousand-rayed deity lord Siva is very auspicious. He has eight hands, a body semi-female and three eyes. He is the overlord of Devas. O brahmins, it is due to his favour alone that rain of various kinds occurs.…

verses.sanskrit: अस्यैवेह प्रसादात्तु वृष्टिर्नानाभवद्द्विजाः सहस्रगुणमुत्स्रष्टुम् आदत्ते किरणैर्जलम्
verses.transliteration: asyaiveha prasādāttu vṛṣṭirnānābhavaddvijāḥ sahasraguṇamutsraṣṭum ādatte kiraṇairjalam

verses.hindi: तथा मुहूर्तासे मुहूर्तगण उत्पन्न बताये गये हैं। लम्बासे घोषनामवाले पुत्र हुए। यामिसे नागवीथि उत्पन्न हुआ। संकल्पासे संकल्प नामक पुत्र हुआ। अब मैं आपलोगोंको वसुओंकी सूष्टि बताता जो देवता ज्योतिष्मान् तथा सभी दिशाओं

verses.sanskrit: जलस्य नाशो वृद्धिर्वा नास्त्येवास्य विचारतः ध्रुवेणाधिष्ठितो वायुर् वृष्टिं संहरते पुनः
verses.transliteration: jalasya nāśo vṛddhirvā nāstyevāsya vicārataḥ dhruveṇādhiṣṭhito vāyur vṛṣṭiṃ saṃharate punaḥ

O brahmins, it is due to his favour alone that rain of various kinds occurs. The sun takes up water by his rays in order to give it back thousandfold. There is neither increase nor decrease of water, if we consider it duly. The wind presided over by Dhruva withdraws the rain. It falls off the planet sun and spreads through the sphere of the stars. At the close of the movement, it re-enters the sun and is presided over by Dhruva.
verses.hindi: अध्याय ६३ दक्षप्रजापतिद्वारा मैथुनी सृष्टिका प्रादुर्भाव“ क्रषिवंशवर्णन २६९

verses.sanskrit: ग्रहान् निःसृत्य सूर्यात् तु कृत्स्ने नक्षत्रमण्डले चारस्यान्ते विशत्यर्के ध्रुवेण समधिष्ठिता
verses.transliteration: grahān niḥsṛtya sūryāt tu kṛtsne nakṣatramaṇḍale cārasyānte viśatyarke dhruveṇa samadhiṣṭhitā
verses.translation: This glorious thousand-rayed deity lord Siva is very auspicious. He has eight hands, a body semi-female and three eyes. He is the overlord of Devas. O brahmins, it is due to his favour alone that rain of various kinds occurs. The sun takes up water by his rays in order to give it back thousandfold. There is neither increase nor decrease of water, if we consider it duly. The wind presided over by Dhruva withdraws the rain. It falls off the planet sun and spreads through the sphere of the stars. At the close of the movement, it re-enters the sun and is presided over by Dhruva.
verses.hindi: पप्र फफफ फ क क फफ फ फफ फ फफ फफ फ फ फ फ फफफ फ फ फ फ फफ क फ फ फा फ फ फफफ फ फा भामा फा क मी की मीमी मी वसवस्ते समाख्याताः सर्वभूतहितेषिणः। हैं, बे वसु कहे गये हैं; वे सभी प्राणियोंके आपो श्रुवश्च सोमश्च धरश्चैवानिलोऽनलः ॥ १९  हितैषी हैं। आप, ध्रुव, सोम, धर, अनिल, अनल, प्रत्यूष प्रत्यूषश्च प्रभासश्च वसवोऽष्टौ प्रकीर्तिताः। तथा प्रभास-ये आठ वसु कहे गये हैं। अजैकपाद,
