verses.hindi: आर्यपुत्रके मुखामृतका आस्वादन करके मुझ मुनीन्द्रने इस अपने शरीरको बचानेका निश्चय किया है, अतः तुम अपने शरीरको रक्षा करो
verses.wordMeaning: When the fifteenth part remains as the last digit, the groups of Pitrs occupy this in the afternoon. For the dura- tion of two kalas (units of time) they drink up the remaining digit — the nectar of svadha that has oozed out of the rays on the Amavasya day.…
verses.commentary: Sense: When the fifteenth part remains as the last digit, the groups of Pitrs occupy this in the afternoon. For the dura- tion of two kalas (units of time) they drink up the remaining digit — the nectar of svadha that has oozed out of the rays on the Amavasya day.…

verses.sanskrit: वृद्धिक्षयौ वै पक्षादौ षोडश्यां शशिनः स्मृतौ एवं सूर्यनिमित्तैषा पक्षवृद्धिर्निशाकरे
verses.transliteration: vṛddhikṣayau vai pakṣādau ṣoḍaśyāṃ śaśinaḥ smṛtau evaṃ sūryanimittaiṣā pakṣavṛddhirniśākare
verses.translation: When the fifteenth part remains as the last digit, the groups of Pitrs occupy this in the afternoon. For the dura- tion of two kalas (units of time) they drink up the remaining digit — the nectar of svadha that has oozed out of the rays on the Amavasya day. After drinking the nectar they attain full satiety for the whole of month and then go away. By the time the remaining digit of the moon drunk by the Pitrs gets dissol- ved, a fifteenth part is replenished. The increase and the decrease of the moon in the beginning of each fortnight is on the sixteenth day.®*' The increase in the moon is thus due to the sun.
verses.hindi: सूतजी बोले--इस प्रकार पुत्रवधू तथा मुनि वसिष्ठसे कहकर अरुन्धती स्थित हो गयी। पुनः दुःखी एवं व्याकुल अरुन्धतीने कहा-हे सुव्रते! अब इन मुनि वसिष्ठका तथा मेरा जीवन तुम्हारे ऊपर निर्भर है, अतः तुम धात्रीकी भाँति अपने देहकी रक्षा करो और जो हितकर हो, उसे करो
verses.wordMeaning: When the fifteenth part remains as the last digit, the groups of Pitrs occupy this in the afternoon. For the dura- tion of two kalas (units of time) they drink up the remaining digit — the nectar of svadha that has oozed out of the rays on the Amavasya day.…
verses.commentary: Sense: When the fifteenth part remains as the last digit, the groups of Pitrs occupy this in the afternoon. For the dura- tion of two kalas (units of time) they drink up the remaining digit — the nectar of svadha that has oozed out of the rays on the Amavasya day.…

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीलिङ्गमहापुराणे पूर्वभागे सोमवर्णनं नाम षट्पञ्चाशत्तमो ऽध्यायः अष्टभिश् च हयैर्युक्तः सोमपुत्रस्य वै रथः वारितेजोमयश्चाथ पिशङ्गैश्चैव शोभनैः
verses.transliteration: iti śrīliṅgamahāpurāṇe pūrvabhāge somavarṇanaṃ nāma ṣaṭpañcāśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ aṣṭabhiś ca hayairyuktaḥ somaputrasya vai rathaḥ vāritejomayaścātha piśaṅgaiścaiva śobhanaiḥ
verses.translation: The chariot of the son of the Moon (i.e. Budha — Mercury) is fitted with eight horses, tawny-coloured and very Splendid. It has the characteristics of water and fire.
verses.hindi: अदृश्यन्ती बोली यदि मुनित्रेष्ठने अपने जीवनकी रक्षा करनेका निश्चय किया है, तो मैं भी किसी रूपमे अपने शुभ या अशुभ देहकी रक्षा करूँगी। मुझ असतीको अपने पतिके वियोगका दुःख प्राप्त हुआ
verses.wordMeaning: The chariot of the son of the Moon (i.e. Budha — Mercury) is fitted with eight horses, tawny-coloured and very Splendid. It has the characteristics of water and fire.
verses.commentary: Sense: The chariot of the son of the Moon (i.e. Budha — Mercury) is fitted with eight horses, tawny-coloured and very Splendid. It has the characteristics of water and fire.

verses.sanskrit: दशभिश्चाकृशैरश्वैर् नानावर्णै रथः स्मृतः शुक्रस्य क्ष्मामयैर्युक्तो दैत्याचार्यस्य धीमतः
verses.transliteration: daśabhiścākṛśairaśvair nānāvarṇai rathaḥ smṛtaḥ śukrasya kṣmāmayairyukto daityācāryasya dhīmataḥ
verses.translation: There are as many rays as there are stars. All of them are bound to the Pole star. While revolving (round it) they make it revolve also.
verses.hindi: है; इसमें सन्देह नहीं है। है मुने! मैं दुःखसे दगध हँ। हे मुने! मैं आपकी पुत्री हूँ; मैंने अद्भुत बात देखी है। हे विभो! मैं दुःखकी पात्र हूँ। अतः है ब्रह्मन्! है वसिष्ठपुत्र शक्तिका आख्यान तथा महर्षि पराशरकी कथा
verses.wordMeaning: There are as many rays as there are stars. All of them are bound to the Pole star. While revolving (round it) they make it revolve also.
verses.commentary: Sense: There are as many rays as there are stars. All of them are bound to the Pole star. While revolving (round it) they make it revolve also.

verses.sanskrit: अष्टाश्वश्चाथ भौमस्य रथो हैमः सुशोभनः जीवस्य हैमश्चाष्टाश्वो मन्दस्यायसनिर्मितः
verses.transliteration: aṣṭāśvaścātha bhaumasya ratho haimaḥ suśobhanaḥ jīvasya haimaścāṣṭāśvo mandasyāyasanirmitaḥ
verses.translation: The stars and the luminaries, urged by the circular gusts of wind, move like fire brands. Since the wind bears the luminaries, it is called Pravaha.
verses.hindi: अहो ममात्र काठिन्यं मनसो मुनिपुङ्गव।
verses.wordMeaning: The stars and the luminaries, urged by the circular gusts of wind, move like fire brands. Since the wind bears the luminaries, it is called Pravaha.
verses.commentary: Sense: The stars and the luminaries, urged by the circular gusts of wind, move like fire brands. Since the wind bears the luminaries, it is called Pravaha.

verses.sanskrit: रथ आपोमयैरश्वैर् दशभिस्तु सितेतरैः स्वर्भानोर्भास्करारेश् च तथा चाष्टहयः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: ratha āpomayairaśvair daśabhistu sitetaraiḥ svarbhānorbhāskarāreś ca tathā cāṣṭahayaḥ smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: Along with the planets and constellations, the sun and stars occupy the firmament in a circle looking upwards and sideways.
verses.hindi: निर्मूलाप्यमृता भर्त्रा त्यक्ता दीना स्थिताप्यहम् कृच्छात्सभायों भगवान् वसिष्ठः स्वाश्रमं क्षणात्।
verses.wordMeaning: Along with the planets and constellations, the sun and stars occupy the firmament in a circle looking upwards and sideways.
verses.commentary: Sense: Along with the planets and constellations, the sun and stars occupy the firmament in a circle looking upwards and sideways.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वे ध्रुवनिबद्धा वै ग्रहास्ते वातरश्मिभिः एतेन भ्राम्यमाणाश् च यथायोगं व्रजन्ति वै
verses.transliteration: sarve dhruvanibaddhā vai grahāste vātaraśmibhiḥ etena bhrāmyamāṇāś ca yathāyogaṃ vrajanti vai
verses.translation: Presided over (i.e. controlled) by Dhruva they circum- ambulate Dhruva. They move on in the firmament to see Lord Dhruva that acts like the pivot.
verses.hindi: सा गर्भ पालयामास कथञ्चिन्मुनिपुङ्गवाः।
verses.wordMeaning: Presided over (i.e. controlled) by Dhruva they circum- ambulate Dhruva. They move on in the firmament to see Lord Dhruva that acts like the pivot.
verses.commentary: Sense: Presided over (i.e. controlled) by Dhruva they circum- ambulate Dhruva. They move on in the firmament to see Lord Dhruva that acts like the pivot.

verses.sanskrit: यावन्त्यश्चैव ताराश् च तावन्तश्चैव रश्मयः सर्वे ध्रुवनिबद्धाश् च भ्रमन्तो भ्रामयन्ति तम्
verses.transliteration: yāvantyaścaiva tārāś ca tāvantaścaiva raśmayaḥ sarve dhruvanibaddhāś ca bhramanto bhrāmayanti tam
verses.translation: Chapters 56-57 describe the movement of the planets Soma, Budha, Mahgala, Brhaspati, Sukra, Sani and Rihu.
verses.hindi: असूत सादितिर्विष्णुं यथा स्वाहा गुह सुतम्। भ्रातृभिः सह पुण्यात्मा आदित्यैरिव भास्करः । राज पितृलोकस्थो वासिष्ठो मुनिपुङ्गवाः
verses.wordMeaning: Chapters 56-57 describe the movement of the planets Soma, Budha, Mahgala, Brhaspati, Sukra, Sani and Rihu.
verses.commentary: Sense: Chapters 56-57 describe the movement of the planets Soma, Budha, Mahgala, Brhaspati, Sukra, Sani and Rihu.

verses.sanskrit: अलातचक्रवद्यान्ति वातचक्रेरितानि तु यस्माद्वहति ज्योतींषि प्रवहस्तेन स स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: alātacakravadyānti vātacakreritāni tu yasmādvahati jyotīṃṣi pravahastena sa smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: The diameter of the sun is nine thousand Yojanas. Its circular area is three times this.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्मपुत्र! है जगद्गुरो! इस दुःखसे मेरी रक्षा कोजिये। पतिरहित स्त्री इस लोकमें दीन तथा असहाय होती है, अतः है आर्येन्द्र! मेरी रक्षा कीजिये । पिता, माता, पुत्र, पौत्र, श्वशुर ये स्त्रियोंके बन्धु नहीं होते हैं; अर्थात् ये
verses.wordMeaning: The diameter of the sun is nine thousand Yojanas. Its circular area is three times this.
verses.commentary: Sense: The diameter of the sun is nine thousand Yojanas. Its circular area is three times this.

verses.sanskrit: नक्षत्रसूर्याश् च तथा ग्रहतारागणैः सह उन्मुखाभिमुखाः सर्वे चक्रभूताः श्रिता दिवि
verses.transliteration: nakṣatrasūryāś ca tathā grahatārāgaṇaiḥ saha unmukhābhimukhāḥ sarve cakrabhūtāḥ śritā divi
verses.translation: The abode of Rahu is full of darkness and is the third (one in size) because it is evolved out of the circular shadow of the earth.
verses.hindi: सब उसका सदाके लिये सम्पूर्ण हितसम्पादन करनेमें समर्थ नहीं होते, केवल पति ही उनका बन्धु तथा परम गति होता है विद्वानोंने जो कहा है कि पत्नी पतिका आधा अंग होती है, वह भी इसमें मिथ्या हो गया; मेरे पति शक्ति तो चले गये, किन्तु मैं जीवित रह गयी। है मुनिश्रेष्ठ! मेरे मनकी यह कठोरता है, जो प्राणतुल्य अपने पतिको
verses.wordMeaning: The abode of Rahu is full of darkness and is the third (one in size) because it is evolved out of the circular shadow of the earth.
verses.commentary: Sense: The abode of Rahu is full of darkness and is the third (one in size) because it is evolved out of the circular shadow of the earth.

verses.sanskrit: ध्रुवेणाधिष्ठिताश्चैव ध्रुवमेव प्रदक्षिणम् प्रयान्ति चेश्वरं द्रष्टुं मेढीभूतं ध्रुवं दिवि
verses.transliteration: dhruveṇādhiṣṭhitāścaiva dhruvameva pradakṣiṇam prayānti ceśvaraṃ draṣṭuṃ meḍhībhūtaṃ dhruvaṃ divi
verses.translation: The diameter, the circumference and the distance in yojanas of Bhargava (Venus) is a sixteenth part of that of the moon.
verses.hindi: छोड़कर मैं क्षणभरके लिये भी जीवित हूँ। है वसिष्ठ! जैसे पीपलके वृक्षपर चढ़ी हुई लता जड़को काट देनेपर भी जीवित रहती है, वैसे ही अपने पतिसे परित्यक्त हुई मैं भी दीन होकर जीवित हूँ
verses.wordMeaning: The diameter, the circumference and the distance in yojanas of Bhargava (Venus) is a sixteenth part of that of the moon.
verses.commentary: Sense: The diameter, the circumference and the distance in yojanas of Bhargava (Venus) is a sixteenth part of that of the moon.

verses.sanskrit: नवयोजनसाहस्रो विष्कम्भः सवितुः स्मृतः त्रिगुणस्तस्य विस्तारो मण्डलस्य प्रमाणतः
verses.transliteration: navayojanasāhasro viṣkambhaḥ savituḥ smṛtaḥ triguṇastasya vistāro maṇḍalasya pramāṇataḥ
verses.translation: Brhaspati (Jupiter) is of three-fourths of the size of Venus. Mars and Saturn are three-fourths of the size of Brhaspati. Budha (Mercury) is three-fourths of their size in extent and circumference. The stars and constellations, that have a body are equal to Budha in extent and circumference. The knower of truth must note that the stars that are in conjun- ction with the moon are ordinarily known as Rksas. The spheres of the comparatively smaller stars extend to five, four, three or two yojanas. Over all these there are still clusters of smaller stars which extend only to two hundred yojanas. There is none smaller than this.
verses.hindi: तब पुत्रवधूका वचन सुनकर गृहस्थाश्रमवाले बुद्धिमान् वसिष्ठने अपनी भार्याके साथ अपने आश्रमको जानेका विचार किया। चिन्ता करते हुए उन भगवान् वसिष्ठने बड़े कष्टसे अपनी भार्या तथा पुत्रवधू अदूश्यन्तीके साथ क्षणभरमें अपने आश्रममें प्रवेश किया
verses.wordMeaning: Brhaspati (Jupiter) is of three-fourths of the size of Venus. Mars and Saturn are three-fourths of the size of Brhaspati. Budha (Mercury) is three-fourths of their size in extent and circumference. The stars and constellations,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Brhaspati (Jupiter) is of three-fourths of the size of Venus. Mars and Saturn are three-fourths of the size of Brhaspati. Budha (Mercury) is three-fourths of their size in extent and circumference. The stars and constellations,…

verses.sanskrit: द्विगुणः सूर्यविस्ताराद् विस्तारः शशिनः स्मृतः तुल्यस्तयोस्तु स्वर्भानुर् भूत्वाधस्तात्प्रसर्पति
verses.transliteration: dviguṇaḥ sūryavistārād vistāraḥ śaśinaḥ smṛtaḥ tulyastayostu svarbhānur bhūtvādhastātprasarpati
verses.translation: Over and above these starry spheres are the three planets viz., Saturn, Jupiter and Mars, which travel at a great distance from them. They should be known as slow-moving ones.
verses.hindi: हे श्रेष्ठ मुनियो उस पतिव्रता शक्तिभार्याने अपनी बंशपरम्पराको सुरक्षित रखनेके लिये किसी प्रकार अपने गर्भकी रक्षा की। तदनन्तर दसवें महीनेमें उस शक्तिपत्नीने अत्यन्त तेजस्वी पुत्रको जन्म दिया, जैसे
verses.wordMeaning: Over and above these starry spheres are the three planets viz., Saturn, Jupiter and Mars, which travel at a great distance from them. They should be known as slow-moving ones.
verses.commentary: Sense: Over and above these starry spheres are the three planets viz., Saturn, Jupiter and Mars, which travel at a great distance from them. They should be known as slow-moving ones.

verses.sanskrit: उद्धृत्य पृथिवीछायां निर्मितां मण्डलाकृतिम् स्वर्भानोस्तु बृहत्स्थानं तृतीयं यत् तमोमयम्
verses.transliteration: uddhṛtya pṛthivīchāyāṃ nirmitāṃ maṇḍalākṛtim svarbhānostu bṛhatsthānaṃ tṛtīyaṃ yat tamomayam
verses.translation: Altogether there are as many crores of stars as there are constellations. They too are stationed in the orbit of con- stellations due to the restraining force of Dhruva,
verses.hindi: अरुन्धतीने शक्तिशाली शक्तिको जन्म दिया था। उस शक्तिपत्नीने साक्षात् पराशरको उसी तरह जन्म दिया, जैसे अदितिने विष्णुको, स्वाहाने गुहको और अरणिने अग्निको पुत्ररूपमें जन्म दिया था जब शक्तिके पुत्रने पृथ्वीतलपर अवतार लिया, तब शक्तिने दुःख त्यागकर पितरोंकी समताको प्राप्त किया। है श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! वे पुण्यात्मा वसिष्ठपुत्र शक्ति पितृलोकमें स्थित होकर अपने भाइयोंके
verses.wordMeaning: Altogether there are as many crores of stars as there are constellations. They too are stationed in the orbit of con- stellations due to the restraining force of Dhruva,
verses.commentary: Sense: Altogether there are as many crores of stars as there are constellations. They too are stationed in the orbit of con- stellations due to the restraining force of Dhruva,

verses.sanskrit: चन्द्रस्य षोडशो भागो भार्गवस्य विधीयते विष्कम्भान्मण्डलाच्चैव योजनाच्च प्रमाणतः
verses.transliteration: candrasya ṣoḍaśo bhāgo bhārgavasya vidhīyate viṣkambhānmaṇḍalāccaiva yojanācca pramāṇataḥ
verses.translation: The sun that has seven horses has an upper and a lower position by turns. When the sun is in his northern transit and when the moon on the full moon nights, appears quickly because its position is above, but the rays are not very clear, the moon (?) then is in the southern orbit that is lower. The sun covered by the line of the earth on Full moon and New Moon days is seen at the usual time, but it sets quickly. Hence on the New-Moon day the moon is in the northern orbit. It is invariably not seen in the southern path on account of
verses.hindi: साथ उसी प्रकार सुशोभित हुए, जैसे सूर्य आदित्योंके साथ सुशोभित होते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: The sun that has seven horses has an upper and a lower position by turns. When the sun is in his northern transit and when the moon on the full moon nights, appears quickly because its position is above, but the rays are not very clear,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The sun that has seven horses has an upper and a lower position by turns. When the sun is in his northern transit and when the moon on the full moon nights, appears quickly because its position is above, but the rays are not very clear,…

verses.sanskrit: भार्गवात्पादहीनस्तु विज्ञेयो वै बृहस्पतिः पादहीनौ वक्रसौरी तथायामप्रमाणतः
verses.transliteration: bhārgavātpādahīnastu vijñeyo vai bṛhaspatiḥ pādahīnau vakrasaurī tathāyāmapramāṇataḥ
verses.translation: In the northern orbits they rise and set without any difference in time on new moon and full moon days. They should then be known as following the groups of luminaries. When the sun is in the southern transit, it moves ahead beneath all other planets.
verses.hindi: क क क क फ़ फ फ़ फ फ़ र फ फ क फ़ फ़ फ़ फ फ़ फ फ फ़ फफ फ फ़ फ फ फा फा की फी फी की की मी कक क्क कक आक्का क कक कक कक कक कक कक मीम लीन
verses.wordMeaning: In the northern orbits they rise and set without any difference in time on new moon and full moon days. They should then be known as following the groups of luminaries. When the sun is in the southern transit, it moves ahead beneath all other planets.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the northern orbits they rise and set without any difference in time on new moon and full moon days. They should then be known as following the groups of luminaries. When the sun is in the southern transit, it moves ahead beneath all other planets.

verses.sanskrit: विस्तारान्मण्डलाच्चैव पादहीनस्तयोर्बुधः तारानक्षत्ररूपाणि वपुष्मन्तीह यानि वै
verses.transliteration: vistārānmaṇḍalāccaiva pādahīnastayorbudhaḥ tārānakṣatrarūpāṇi vapuṣmantīha yāni vai
verses.translation: Keeping his sphere wider the moon revolves above it (the sun). All the groups of constellations move above the moon.
verses.hindi: ये ब्रह्मवादिनो भूमौ ननृतुर्दिवि देवताः। पुष्कराद्याश्च ससृजुः पुष्पवर्षं च खेचराः
verses.wordMeaning: Keeping his sphere wider the moon revolves above it (the sun). All the groups of constellations move above the moon.
verses.commentary: Sense: Keeping his sphere wider the moon revolves above it (the sun). All the groups of constellations move above the moon.

verses.sanskrit: बुधेन तानि तुल्यानि विस्तारान्मण्डलादपि प्रायशश्चन्द्रयोगीनि विद्यादृक्षाणि तत्त्ववित्
verses.transliteration: budhena tāni tulyāni vistārānmaṇḍalādapi prāyaśaścandrayogīni vidyādṛkṣāṇi tattvavit
verses.translation: Mercury is above all constellations; Venus is above Mercury. Mars is above Venus and Jupiter is above Mars.
verses.hindi: अदृश्यन्त्याश्चतुर्वक्त्रो मेघजालाहिवाकरः देवदानवगणैश्च पूजितम्।
verses.wordMeaning: Mercury is above all constellations; Venus is above Mercury. Mars is above Venus and Jupiter is above Mars.
verses.commentary: Sense: Mercury is above all constellations; Venus is above Mercury. Mars is above Venus and Jupiter is above Mars.

verses.sanskrit: तारानक्षत्ररूपाणि हीनानि तु परस्परम् शतानि पञ्च चत्वारि त्रीणि द्वे चैव योजने
verses.transliteration: tārānakṣatrarūpāṇi hīnāni tu parasparam śatāni pañca catvāri trīṇi dve caiva yojane
verses.translation: Saturn is above it. Above Saturn is the sphere of seven sages (Great Bear) and Dhruva(Polc Star) is stationed above the seven sages.
verses.hindi: अथ तस्यास्तदालापं वसिष्ठो मुनिसत्तमः। श्रुत्वा स्नुषामुवाचेदं मा रोदीरिति दुःखितः
verses.wordMeaning: Saturn is above it. Above Saturn is the sphere of seven sages (Great Bear) and Dhruva(Polc Star) is stationed above the seven sages.
verses.commentary: Sense: Saturn is above it. Above Saturn is the sphere of seven sages (Great Bear) and Dhruva(Polc Star) is stationed above the seven sages.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वोपरि निकृष्टानि तारकामण्डलानि तु योजनद्वयमात्राणि तेभ्यो ह्रस्वं न विद्यते
verses.transliteration: sarvopari nikṛṣṭāni tārakāmaṇḍalāni tu yojanadvayamātrāṇi tebhyo hrasvaṃ na vidyate
verses.translation: By knowing the region ofVisnu, beyond all these, one is liberated from sin. Two hundred thousand Yojanas above constellations, stars, the planets — Sun and Moon which are united with divine refulgence, move ahead day and night in due order. They come into contact with the constellations everyday. Hence they are sometimes stationed below, some- times above and sometimes in u straight line. They glance at the subjects (below) simultaneously when in conjunction or when separated.
verses.hindi: हे विप्रेन्द्रो! पराशरके अवतार लेनेपर उस समय लगे। जो ब्रह्मवादी लोग थे, वे पृथ्वीपर एवं देवता लोग स्वर्गमें नृत्य करने लगे। पुष्कर आदि मेघोत जलको तथा अन्य आकाशचारियोंने पुष्पोंकी वर्षा को। उस समय राक्षसोंके नगरोंमें गृध्रादि अमंगल
verses.wordMeaning: By knowing the region ofVisnu, beyond all these, one is liberated from sin. Two hundred thousand Yojanas above constellations, stars, the planets — Sun and Moon which are united with divine refulgence, move ahead day and night in due order.…
verses.commentary: Sense: By knowing the region ofVisnu, beyond all these, one is liberated from sin. Two hundred thousand Yojanas above constellations, stars, the planets — Sun and Moon which are united with divine refulgence, move ahead day and night in due order.…

verses.sanskrit: उपरिष्टात्त्रयस्तेषां ग्रहा ये दूरसर्पिणः सौरो ऽङ्गिराश् च वक्रश् च ज्ञेया मन्दविचारिणः
verses.transliteration: upariṣṭāttrayasteṣāṃ grahā ye dūrasarpiṇaḥ sauro 'ṅgirāś ca vakraś ca jñeyā mandavicāriṇaḥ
verses.translation: Gf. Vi§nu, cited in ST. I
verses.hindi: ध्वनि करने लगे और आश्रममें स्थित मुनियोंने अपार
verses.wordMeaning: Gf. Vi§nu, cited in ST. I
verses.commentary: Sense: Gf. Vi§nu, cited in ST. I

verses.sanskrit: तेभ्यो ऽधस्तात्तु चत्वारः पुनरन्ये महाग्रहाः सूर्यः सोमो बुधश्चैव भार्गवश्चैव शीघ्रगाः
verses.transliteration: tebhyo 'dhastāttu catvāraḥ punaranye mahāgrahāḥ sūryaḥ somo budhaścaiva bhārgavaścaiva śīghragāḥ
verses.translation: Gf. Vi§nu, cited in ST. I
verses.hindi: जैसे अण्डसे चतुरानन (ब्रह्मा) और मेघसमूहोसे सूर्य प्रकट होते हैं, उसी प्रकार वे पराशर भी अदृश्यन्तीसे अवतरित हुए। है द्विजो! पुत्रको देखकर तथा पतिका स्मरण करके अदृश्यन्तीको सुख तथा दु:ख दोनों ही हुआ और अरुन्धती तथा मुनि वसिष्ठ -को भी सुख-दुःख हुआ। अत्यधिक कान्तिवाले पुत्र पराशरको देखकर विहल तथा रुँधे कण्ठवाली वह बाला विलाप करने लगी और भूमिपर गिर पड़ी॥ ५३--५५॥
verses.wordMeaning: Gf. Vi§nu, cited in ST. I
verses.commentary: Sense: Gf. Vi§nu, cited in ST. I

verses.sanskrit: तावन्त्यस्तारकाः कोट्यो यावन्त्यृक्षाणि सर्वशः ध्रुवात् तु नियमाच्चैषाम् ऋक्षमार्गे व्यवस्थितिः
verses.transliteration: tāvantyastārakāḥ koṭyo yāvantyṛkṣāṇi sarvaśaḥ dhruvāt tu niyamāccaiṣām ṛkṣamārge vyavasthitiḥ
verses.translation: Gf. Vi§nu, cited in ST. I
verses.hindi: पवित्र मुसकानवाली वह अदृश्यन्ती उत्पन्न हुए उस पराशरको महाबुद्धिमान्, देवताओं तथा दानवोंसे पूजित और निष्पाप जानकर आँखोंमें आँसू भरकर विलाप करने लगी--'हे वसिष्ठसुत शक्ति ! है प्रभो!
verses.wordMeaning: Gf. Vi§nu, cited in ST. I
verses.commentary: Sense: Gf. Vi§nu, cited in ST. I

verses.sanskrit: सप्ताश्वस्यैव सूर्यस्य नीचोच्चत्वमनुक्रमात् उत्तरायणमार्गस्थो यदा पर्वसु चन्द्रमाः
verses.transliteration: saptāśvasyaiva sūryasya nīcoccatvamanukramāt uttarāyaṇamārgastho yadā parvasu candramāḥ
verses.translation: Gf. Vi§nu, cited in ST. I
verses.hindi: पुत्र-दर्शनकी इच्छावाली इस दीनवदनाको तथा अपने पुत्रको वनके बीचमें छोड़कर आप कहाँ चले गये? अपने निष्पाप पुत्रका दर्शन कीजिये। है शक्ते! आप भाइयोंके साथ अपने पुत्रको देखिये, जैसे महेश्वरने प्रसन्नमुख होकर अपने गणोंके साथ षण्मुख (कार्तिकेय)-को देखा था'
verses.wordMeaning: Gf. Vi§nu, cited in ST. I
verses.commentary: Sense: Gf. Vi§nu, cited in ST. I

verses.sanskrit: उच्चत्वाद्दृश्यते शीघ्रं नातिव्यक्तैर्गभस्तिभिः तदा दक्षिणमार्गस्थो नीचां वीथिमुपाश्रितः
verses.transliteration: uccatvāddṛśyate śīghraṃ nātivyaktairgabhastibhiḥ tadā dakṣiṇamārgastho nīcāṃ vīthimupāśritaḥ
verses.translation: Gf. Vi§nu, cited in ST. I
verses.hindi: तत्पश्चात् उसके विलापको सुनकर मुनिश्रेष्ठ बसिष्ठने दुःखित होकर अपनी पुत्रवधूसे यह वचन कहा-- मत रोओ'
verses.wordMeaning: Gf. Vi§nu, cited in ST. I
verses.commentary: Sense: Gf. Vi§nu, cited in ST. I

verses.sanskrit: भूमिरेखावृतः सूर्यः पौर्णिमावास्ययोस् तदा ददृशे च यथाकालं शीघ्रमस्तमुपैति च
verses.transliteration: bhūmirekhāvṛtaḥ sūryaḥ paurṇimāvāsyayos tadā dadṛśe ca yathākālaṃ śīghramastamupaiti ca
verses.translation: Gf. Vi§nu, cited in ST. I
verses.hindi: तब बालमृगके समान नेत्रोंबाली वह कुलीन बाला वसिष्ठको आज्ञासे शोक त्याग करके उस बालकका पालन करने लगी तदनन्तर आँसुओंसे भरे हुए नेत्रोंवाली तथा व्याकुल उस साध्वी अबलाको आभूषणोंसे रहित होकर बैठी देखकर पराशर यह कहने लगे
verses.wordMeaning: Gf. Vi§nu, cited in ST. I
verses.commentary: Sense: Gf. Vi§nu, cited in ST. I

verses.sanskrit: तस्मादुत्तरमार्गस्थो ह्य् अमावास्यां निशाकरः ददृशे दक्षिणे मार्गे नियमाद्दृश्यते न च
verses.transliteration: tasmāduttaramārgastho hy amāvāsyāṃ niśākaraḥ dadṛśe dakṣiṇe mārge niyamāddṛśyate na ca
verses.translation: Gf. Vi§nu, cited in ST. I
verses.hindi: अध्याय ६४ वसिष्ठपुत्र शक्तिका आख्यान तथा महर्षि पराशरकी कथा २७१
verses.wordMeaning: Gf. Vi§nu, cited in ST. I
verses.commentary: Sense: Gf. Vi§nu, cited in ST. I

verses.sanskrit: ज्योतिषां गतियोगेन सूर्यस्य तमसा वृतः समानकालास्तमयौ विषुवत्सु समोदयौ
verses.transliteration: jyotiṣāṃ gatiyogena sūryasya tamasā vṛtaḥ samānakālāstamayau viṣuvatsu samodayau
verses.translation: Gf. Vi§nu, cited in ST. I
verses.hindi: SI लकापा काक ककफ कका क कफ कफ फफक फफक रा फ फीकी की मीमी फी कील मी क कको की फा छा फफ फफ जी क फफ फ फ क फा फ फ क फ फ फ फ़ फ फ फ फ फ़ फ फ़ क फ़ फ फ फ़ फ फफ फ फफ फ फ़ फ क फफफ फ फफ फ क फ फ देहयष्टिसघे न शोभते। अनघे! जैसे चन्द्रमण्डलसे रहित रात्रि सुशोभित नहीं
verses.wordMeaning: Gf. Vi§nu, cited in ST. I
verses.commentary: Sense: Gf. Vi§nu, cited in ST. I

verses.sanskrit: उत्तरासु च वीथीषु व्यन्तरास्तमनोदयौ पौर्णिमावास्ययोर् ज्ञेयौ ज्योतिश्चक्रानुवर्तिनौ
verses.transliteration: uttarāsu ca vīthīṣu vyantarāstamanodayau paurṇimāvāsyayor jñeyau jyotiścakrānuvartinau
verses.translation: Gf. Vi§nu, cited in ST. I
verses.hindi: वक्तुमरहसि तवाद्य कारणं होती है, वैसे ही आपका यह शरीर मंगल आभूषणोंके
verses.wordMeaning: Gf. Vi§nu, cited in ST. I
verses.commentary: Sense: Gf. Vi§nu, cited in ST. I

verses.sanskrit: दक्षिणायनमार्गस्थो यदा चरति रश्मिवान् ग्रहाणां चैव सर्वेषां सूर्यो ऽधस्तात् प्रसर्पति
verses.transliteration: dakṣiṇāyanamārgastho yadā carati raśmivān grahāṇāṃ caiva sarveṣāṃ sūryo 'dhastāt prasarpati
verses.translation: Gf. Vi§nu, cited in ST. I
verses.hindi: बिना सुशोभित नहीं हो रहा है; कृपा करके आज इसका ८ 0 मङ्गलाभरणानि णी ॥ ६२  कारण बताइये। है मातः! है मातः! मंगल आभरणोंका मातर्मातः कथं त्यक्त्वा मङ्ग वै। त्याग करके पतिविहीनाकी भाँति आप क्यों बैठी हुई
verses.wordMeaning: Gf. Vi§nu, cited in ST. I
verses.commentary: Sense: Gf. Vi§nu, cited in ST. I

verses.sanskrit: विस्तीर्णं मण्डलं कृत्वा तस्योर्ध्वं चरते शशी नक्षत्रमण्डलं कृत्स्नं सोमादूर्ध्वं प्रसर्पति
verses.transliteration: vistīrṇaṃ maṇḍalaṃ kṛtvā tasyordhvaṃ carate śaśī nakṣatramaṇḍalaṃ kṛtsnaṃ somādūrdhvaṃ prasarpati
verses.translation: Gf. Vi§nu, cited in ST. I
verses.hindi: आसीना भर्तृहीनेव वक्तुमहसि शोभने॥ ६३  हैं? है शोभने! कृपा करके बताइये
verses.wordMeaning: Gf. Vi§nu, cited in ST. I
verses.commentary: Sense: Gf. Vi§nu, cited in ST. I

verses.sanskrit: नक्षत्रेभ्यो बुधश्चोर्ध्वं बुधादूर्ध्वं तु भार्गवः वक्रस्तु भार्गवादूर्ध्वं वक्राद् ऊर्ध्वं बृहस्पतिः
verses.transliteration: nakṣatrebhyo budhaścordhvaṃ budhādūrdhvaṃ tu bhārgavaḥ vakrastu bhārgavādūrdhvaṃ vakrād ūrdhvaṃ bṛhaspatiḥ
verses.translation: Gf. Vi§nu, cited in ST. I
verses.hindi: अदृश्यन्ती तदा वाक्यं श्रुत्वा तस्य सुतस्य सा। तब उस पुत्रकी बात सुनकर उस अदृश्यन्तीने न किञ्चिदब्रवीत्पुत्रं शुभं वा यदि वेतरत्॥ ६४ पुत्रसे अच्छा अथवा बुरा कुछ भी नहीं कहा अदृश्यन्तीं पुनः प्राह शाक्तेयो भगवान् मम। भगवान् शाक्तेय (पराशर)-ने उस अदृश्यन्ती मातः कुत्र महातेजा: पिता वद वदेति ताम्॥ ६५ रु pe है या ! मेरे महातेजस्वी पिता कहाँ हैं;
verses.wordMeaning: Gf. Vi§nu, cited in ST. I
verses.commentary: Sense: Gf. Vi§nu, cited in ST. I

verses.sanskrit: तस्माच्छनैश्चरश्चोर्ध्वं तस्मात्सप्तर्षिमण्डलम् ऋषीणां चैव सप्तानां ध्रुवस्योर्ध्वं व्यवस्थितिः
verses.transliteration: tasmācchanaiścaraścordhvaṃ tasmātsaptarṣimaṇḍalam ṛṣīṇāṃ caiva saptānāṃ dhruvasyordhvaṃ vyavasthitiḥ
verses.translation: Gf. Vi§nu, cited in ST. I
verses.hindi: तब पुत्रका वचन सुनकर अत्यधिक व्याकुल भक्षितो रक्षसा तातस्तवेति निपपात च॥ ६६  होकर वह रोने लगी। 'हे तात! राक्षसने तुम्हारे पिताका
verses.wordMeaning: Gf. Vi§nu, cited in ST. I
verses.commentary: Sense: Gf. Vi§nu, cited in ST. I

verses.sanskrit: तं विष्णुलोकं परमं ज्ञात्वा मुच्येत किल्बिषात् द्विगुणेषु सहस्रेषु योजनानां शतेषु च
verses.transliteration: taṃ viṣṇulokaṃ paramaṃ jñātvā mucyeta kilbiṣāt dviguṇeṣu sahasreṣu yojanānāṃ śateṣu ca
verses.translation: Gf. Vi§nu, cited in ST. I
verses.hindi: भक्षण कर लिया'-एऐसा कहकर वह भूमिपर गिर अरुन्धती चाश्रमवासिनस्तदा तब पौत्रकी बात सुनकर दयालु वसिष्ठ भी रोते मुनेर्वसिष्ठस्य मुनीश्वराश्च
verses.wordMeaning: Gf. Vi§nu, cited in ST. I
verses.commentary: Sense: Gf. Vi§nu, cited in ST. I

verses.sanskrit: ग्रहनक्षत्रतारासु उपरिष्टाद्यथाक्रमम् ग्रहाश् च चन्द्रसूर्यौ च युतौ दिव्येन तेजसा
verses.transliteration: grahanakṣatratārāsu upariṣṭādyathākramam grahāś ca candrasūryau ca yutau divyena tejasā
verses.translation: Gf. Vi§nu, cited in ST. I
verses.hindi: हुए भूमिपर गिर पड़े। मुनि वसिष्ठके आश्रममें रहनेवाले
verses.wordMeaning: Gf. Vi§nu, cited in ST. I
verses.commentary: Sense: Gf. Vi§nu, cited in ST. I

verses.sanskrit: नित्यमृक्षेषु युज्यन्ते गच्छन्तो ऽहर्निशं क्रमात् ग्रहनक्षत्रसूर्यास् ते नीचोच्चऋजुसंस्थिताः
verses.transliteration: nityamṛkṣeṣu yujyante gacchanto 'harniśaṃ kramāt grahanakṣatrasūryās te nīcoccaṛjusaṃsthitāḥ
verses.translation: Gf. Vi§nu, cited in ST. I
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनिगण तथा अरुन्धती-ये सब भी गिर पड़े “तुम्हारे पिताको राक्षस खा गया'-माताके मुखसे
verses.wordMeaning: Gf. Vi§nu, cited in ST. I
verses.commentary: Sense: Gf. Vi§nu, cited in ST. I

verses.sanskrit: समागमे च भेदे च पश्यन्ति युगपत्प्रजाः ऋतवः षट् स्मृताः सर्वे समागच्छन्ति पञ्चधा
verses.transliteration: samāgame ca bhede ca paśyanti yugapatprajāḥ ṛtavaḥ ṣaṭ smṛtāḥ sarve samāgacchanti pañcadhā
verses.translation: Gf. Vi§nu, cited in ST. I
verses.hindi: ऐसा सुनकर अश्रुपूर्ण नेत्रवाले बुद्धिमान् पराशर कहने
verses.wordMeaning: Gf. Vi§nu, cited in ST. I
verses.commentary: Sense: Gf. Vi§nu, cited in ST. I

verses.sanskrit: परस्परास्थिता ह्येते युज्यन्ते च परस्परम् असंकरेण विज्ञेयस् तेषां योगस्तु वै बुधैः
verses.transliteration: parasparāsthitā hyete yujyante ca parasparam asaṃkareṇa vijñeyas teṣāṃ yogastu vai budhaiḥ
verses.translation: Gf. Vi§nu, cited in ST. I
verses.hindi: पराशर बोले-हे मातः! देवदेवेश्वर शिव - की पूजा करके तथा चराचरसहित तीनों लोकोंको दग्ध
verses.wordMeaning: Gf. Vi§nu, cited in ST. I
verses.commentary: Sense: Gf. Vi§nu, cited in ST. I

verses.sanskrit: एवं संक्षिप्य कथितं ग्रहाणां गमनं द्विजाः भास्करप्रमुखानां च यथादृष्टं यथाश्रुतम्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ saṃkṣipya kathitaṃ grahāṇāṃ gamanaṃ dvijāḥ bhāskarapramukhānāṃ ca yathādṛṣṭaṃ yathāśrutam
verses.translation: Gf. Vi§nu, cited in ST. I
verses.hindi: करके मैं क्षणभरमें पिताका दर्शन कराता हूँ-ऐसा मेरा
verses.wordMeaning: Gf. Vi§nu, cited in ST. I
verses.commentary: Sense: Gf. Vi§nu, cited in ST. I

verses.sanskrit: ग्रहाधिपत्ये भगवान् ब्रह्मणा पद्मयोनिना अभिषिक्तः सहस्रांशू रुद्रेण तु यथा गुहः
verses.transliteration: grahādhipatye bhagavān brahmaṇā padmayoninā abhiṣiktaḥ sahasrāṃśū rudreṇa tu yathā guhaḥ
verses.translation: Gf. Vi§nu, cited in ST. I
verses.hindi: तब इस शुभ वचनको सुनकर वह आश्चर्यचकित हो गयी; उसकी ओर देखकर मुसकराकर उसने पुत्रसे कहा- है पुत्र! है पुत्र! यह सत्य है; तुम शिवको पूजा करो तदनन्तर इस शक्तिपुत्र पराशर-के संकल्पको जानकर दयानिधि, बुद्धिमान् तथा मुनियोंमें श्रेष्ठ भगवान् बसिष्ठने पौत्रसे कहा-हे पौत्र! है मुनिश्रेष्ठ! है सुव्रत! सुनो; तुम्हारा संकल्प उचित है, फिर भी तुम सम्पूर्ण
verses.wordMeaning: Gf. Vi§nu, cited in ST. I
verses.commentary: Sense: Gf. Vi§nu, cited in ST. I

verses.sanskrit: तस्माद्ग्रहार्चना कार्या अग्नौ चोद्यं यथाविधि आदित्यग्रहपीडायां सद्भिः कार्यार्थसिद्धये
verses.transliteration: tasmādgrahārcanā kāryā agnau codyaṃ yathāvidhi ādityagrahapīḍāyāṃ sadbhiḥ kāryārthasiddhaye
verses.translation: Gf. Vi§nu, cited in ST. I
verses.hindi: लोकका विनाश मत करो। तुम राक्षसोंके नाशके लिये
verses.wordMeaning: Gf. Vi§nu, cited in ST. I
verses.commentary: Sense: Gf. Vi§nu, cited in ST. I

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीलिङ्गमहापुराणे पूर्वभागे ज्योतिश्चक्रे ग्रहचारकथनं नाम सप्तपञ्चाशत्तमो ऽध्यायः अभ्यषिञ्चत्कथं ब्रह्मा चाधिपत्ये प्रजापतिः देवदैत्यमुखान् सर्वान् सर्वात्मा वद सांप्रतम्
verses.transliteration: iti śrīliṅgamahāpurāṇe pūrvabhāge jyotiścakre grahacārakathanaṃ nāma saptapañcāśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ abhyaṣiñcatkathaṃ brahmā cādhipatye prajāpatiḥ devadaityamukhān sarvān sarvātmā vada sāṃpratam
verses.translation: Tell us now how Brahma Prajapati, who is the soul of all, crowned as overlords, Devas, Daityas and others.
verses.hindi: अभ्यर्च्य देवदेवेशं त्रैलोक्यं सचराचरम् क्षणेन मातः पितरं दर्शयामीति मे मतिः जञात्वा शक्तिसुतस्यास्य सङ्कल्पं मुनिपुङ्गवः । वसिष्ठो भगवान् प्राह पौत्र धीमान् घृणानिधिः
verses.wordMeaning: Tell us now how Brahma Prajapati, who is the soul of all, crowned as overlords, Devas, Daityas and others.
verses.commentary: Sense: Tell us now how Brahma Prajapati, who is the soul of all, crowned as overlords, Devas, Daityas and others.

verses.sanskrit: ग्रहाधिपत्ये भगवान् अभ्यषिञ्चद्दिवाकरम् ऋक्षाणामोषधीनां च सोमं ब्रह्मा प्रजापतिः
verses.transliteration: grahādhipatye bhagavān abhyaṣiñcaddivākaram ṛkṣāṇāmoṣadhīnāṃ ca somaṃ brahmā prajāpatiḥ
verses.translation: Lord Brahma crowned the Sun as the overlord of planets. Brahma, Prajapati, crowned Soma (Moon) as the lord of constellations and medicinal herbs.
verses.hindi: स्थाने पौत्र मुनिश्रेष्ठ सङ्कल्पस्तव सुब्रत । तथापि शृणु लोकस्य क्षयं कर्तु न चाह॑सि
verses.wordMeaning: Lord Brahma crowned the Sun as the overlord of planets. Brahma, Prajapati, crowned Soma (Moon) as the lord of constellations and medicinal herbs.
verses.commentary: Sense: Lord Brahma crowned the Sun as the overlord of planets. Brahma, Prajapati, crowned Soma (Moon) as the lord of constellations and medicinal herbs.

verses.sanskrit: अपां च वरुणं देवं धनानां यक्षपुङ्गवम् आदित्यानां तथा विष्णुं वसूनां पावकं तथा
verses.transliteration: apāṃ ca varuṇaṃ devaṃ dhanānāṃ yakṣapuṅgavam ādityānāṃ tathā viṣṇuṃ vasūnāṃ pāvakaṃ tathā
verses.translation: (He crowned) Varuna as the lord of the Waters; the leading Yaksa*(Kubera)as the lord of riches; Visnu as the lord of Adityas; and Pavaka (fire) as the lord of Vasus.
verses.hindi: त्रैलोक्यं शृणु शाक्तेय अपराध्यति किं तव श्रीलिङ्कमहापुराण
verses.wordMeaning: (He crowned) Varuna as the lord of the Waters; the leading Yaksa*(Kubera)as the lord of riches; Visnu as the lord of Adityas; and Pavaka (fire) as the lord of Vasus.
verses.commentary: Sense: (He crowned) Varuna as the lord of the Waters; the leading Yaksa*(Kubera)as the lord of riches; Visnu as the lord of Adityas; and Pavaka (fire) as the lord of Vasus.

verses.sanskrit: प्रजापतीनां दक्षं च मरुतां शक्रमेव च दैत्यानां दानवानां च प्रह्लादं दैत्यपुङ्गवम्
verses.transliteration: prajāpatīnāṃ dakṣaṃ ca marutāṃ śakrameva ca daityānāṃ dānavānāṃ ca prahlādaṃ daityapuṅgavam
verses.translation: (He crowned) Dak$a as the lord of Prajapatis; Indra as the lord of Maruts; Prahlada, the leading Daitya as the over- lord of Daityas and Danavas.
verses.hindi: कृत्वैकलिङ्गं क्षणिकं पांसुना मुनिसन्निधौ
verses.wordMeaning: (He crowned) Dak$a as the lord of Prajapatis; Indra as the lord of Maruts; Prahlada, the leading Daitya as the over- lord of Daityas and Danavas.
verses.commentary: Sense: (He crowned) Dak$a as the lord of Prajapatis; Indra as the lord of Maruts; Prahlada, the leading Daitya as the over- lord of Daityas and Danavas.

verses.sanskrit: धर्मं पितॄणाम् अधिपं निरृतिं पिशिताशिनाम् रुद्रं पशूनां भूतानां नन्दिनं गणनायकम्
verses.transliteration: dharmaṃ pitṝṇām adhipaṃ nirṛtiṃ piśitāśinām rudraṃ paśūnāṃ bhūtānāṃ nandinaṃ gaṇanāyakam
verses.translation: (He crowned) Dharma as the overlord of the Pitrs; Nirrti as the overlord of Raksasas; Rudra as the overlord of Paus (Individual Souls) and Nandin, the leader ofGanas,®® as the overlord of Bhutas (goblins).
verses.hindi: सम्पूज्य शिवसूक्तेन त्यम्बकेन शुभेन च। जप्त्वा त्वरितरुद्रं च शिवसङ्कल्पमेव च नीलरुद्रं च शाक्तेयस्तथा रुद्रं च शोभनम्। वामीयं पवमानं च पञ्चब्रहा तथैव च
verses.wordMeaning: (He crowned) Dharma as the overlord of the Pitrs; Nirrti as the overlord of Raksasas; Rudra as the overlord of Paus (Individual Souls) and Nandin, the leader ofGanas,®® as the overlord of Bhutas (goblins).
verses.commentary: Sense: (He crowned) Dharma as the overlord of the Pitrs; Nirrti as the overlord of Raksasas; Rudra as the overlord of Paus (Individual Souls) and Nandin, the leader ofGanas,®® as the overlord of Bhutas (goblins).

verses.sanskrit: वीराणां वीरभद्रं च पिशाचानां भयंकरम् मातॄणां चैव चामुण्डां सर्वदेवनमस्कृताम्
verses.transliteration: vīrāṇāṃ vīrabhadraṃ ca piśācānāṃ bhayaṃkaram mātṝṇāṃ caiva cāmuṇḍāṃ sarvadevanamaskṛtām
verses.translation: (He crowned) Virabhadra as the overlord of heroes; Bhayahkara (the terrible one) as the overlord of Pisacas (ghosts); Camunda who is bowed to by Devas as the sovereign of Mothers.
verses.hindi: होतारं लिङ्कसूक्तं च अथर्वशिर एव च। अष्टाङ्गमर्घ्य रुद्राय दत्त्वाभ्यर्च्य यथाविधि
verses.wordMeaning: (He crowned) Virabhadra as the overlord of heroes; Bhayahkara (the terrible one) as the overlord of Pisacas (ghosts); Camunda who is bowed to by Devas as the sovereign of Mothers.
verses.commentary: Sense: (He crowned) Virabhadra as the overlord of heroes; Bhayahkara (the terrible one) as the overlord of Pisacas (ghosts); Camunda who is bowed to by Devas as the sovereign of Mothers.

verses.sanskrit: रुद्राणां देवदेवेशं नीललोहितमीश्वरम् विघ्नानां व्योमजं देवं गजास्यं तु विनायकम्
verses.transliteration: rudrāṇāṃ devadeveśaṃ nīlalohitamīśvaram vighnānāṃ vyomajaṃ devaṃ gajāsyaṃ tu vināyakam
verses.translation: (He crowned) lord Nllalohita, lord of the chiefs of Devas, as the overlord of Rudras; the elephant-faced lord Vinayaka, born of Vyoman* as the overlord of obstacles.
verses.hindi: भगवन् रक्षसा रुद्र भक्षितो रुधिरेण वै। पिता मम महातेजा भ्रातृभिः सह शङ्कर एवं विज्ञापयँल्लिङ्गं प्रणिपत्य मुहुर्मुहुः
verses.wordMeaning: (He crowned) lord Nllalohita, lord of the chiefs of Devas, as the overlord of Rudras; the elephant-faced lord Vinayaka, born of Vyoman* as the overlord of obstacles.
verses.commentary: Sense: (He crowned) lord Nllalohita, lord of the chiefs of Devas, as the overlord of Rudras; the elephant-faced lord Vinayaka, born of Vyoman* as the overlord of obstacles.

verses.sanskrit: स्त्रीणां देवीमुमां देवीं वचसां च सरस्वतीम् विष्णुं मायाविनां चैव स्वात्मानं जगतां तथा
verses.transliteration: strīṇāṃ devīmumāṃ devīṃ vacasāṃ ca sarasvatīm viṣṇuṃ māyāvināṃ caiva svātmānaṃ jagatāṃ tathā
verses.translation: (He crowned ) goddess Uma as the sovereign of women; goddess Sarasvati as the sovereign of speech; Visnu as the overlord of the wielders of Maya and himself®® as the overlord of the worlds.
verses.hindi: हा रुद्र रूद्र रुद्रेति रुरोद निपपात च। तं दृष्ट्वा भगवान् रुद्रो देवीमाह च शङ्करः
verses.wordMeaning: (He crowned ) goddess Uma as the sovereign of women; goddess Sarasvati as the sovereign of speech; Visnu as the overlord of the wielders of Maya and himself®® as the overlord of the worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: (He crowned ) goddess Uma as the sovereign of women; goddess Sarasvati as the sovereign of speech; Visnu as the overlord of the wielders of Maya and himself®® as the overlord of the worlds.

verses.sanskrit: हिमवन्तं गिरीणां तु नदीनां चैव जाह्नवीम् समुद्राणां च सर्वेषाम् अधिपं पयसां निधिम्
verses.transliteration: himavantaṃ girīṇāṃ tu nadīnāṃ caiva jāhnavīm samudrāṇāṃ ca sarveṣām adhipaṃ payasāṃ nidhim
verses.translation: (He crowned) Himavat as the overlord of the moun- tains; the Ganges (born of sage Jahnu) as the sovereign of the rivers; and ocean the storehouse of the waters as the lord of all seas.
verses.hindi: सा च दृष्ट्वा महादेवी पराशरमनिन्दिता । दुःखात्संक्लिन्नसर्वाङ्गमस््राकुलविलोचनम् लिङ्गार्चनविधौ सक्तं हर रुद्रेति वादिनम्। प्राह भर्तारमीशानं शङ्करं जगतामुमा
verses.wordMeaning: (He crowned) Himavat as the overlord of the moun- tains; the Ganges (born of sage Jahnu) as the sovereign of the rivers; and ocean the storehouse of the waters as the lord of all seas.
verses.commentary: Sense: (He crowned) Himavat as the overlord of the moun- tains; the Ganges (born of sage Jahnu) as the sovereign of the rivers; and ocean the storehouse of the waters as the lord of all seas.

verses.sanskrit: वृक्षाणां चैव चाश्वत्थं प्लक्षं च प्रपितामहः
verses.transliteration: vṛkṣāṇāṃ caiva cāśvatthaṃ plakṣaṃ ca prapitāmahaḥ
verses.translation: vyomajam: son of Siva, i.e. Gaeia.
verses.hindi: निशम्य वचनं तस्याः शङ्करः परमेश्वरः
verses.wordMeaning: vyomajam: son of Siva, i.e. Gaeia.
verses.commentary: Sense: vyomajam: son of Siva, i.e. Gaeia.

verses.sanskrit: गन्धर्वविद्याधरकिन्नराणाम् ईशं पुनश् चित्ररथं चकार नागाधिपं वासुकिमुग्रवीर्यं सर्पाधिपं तक्षकमुग्रवीर्यम्
verses.transliteration: gandharvavidyādharakinnarāṇām īśaṃ punaś citrarathaṃ cakāra nāgādhipaṃ vāsukimugravīryaṃ sarpādhipaṃ takṣakamugravīryam
verses.translation: sv&tm&nam: his own self, i.e. Brahm&,
verses.hindi: एवमुक्त्वा गणेर्दिव्यैर्भगवान्नीललोहितः सर्वेश्वरका अर्चन करो। है शक्तिपुत्र! सुनो, ज्रैलोक्यने तुम्हारे प्रति क्या अपराध किया है ?॥ ७१--७३॥
verses.wordMeaning: sv&tm&nam: his own self, i.e. Brahm&,
verses.commentary: Sense: sv&tm&nam: his own self, i.e. Brahm&,

verses.sanskrit: दिग्वारणानामधिपं चकार गजेन्द्रम् ऐरावतम् उग्रवीर्यम् ।* सुपर्णमीशं पततामथाश्वराजानमुच्चैःश्रवसं चकार
verses.transliteration: digvāraṇānāmadhipaṃ cakāra gajendram airāvatam ugravīryam /* suparṇamīśaṃ patatāmathāśvarājānamuccaiḥśravasaṃ cakāra
verses.translation: Brahma crowned the Plaksa and Avattha as the lords of trees,* he made Citraratha the lord of Gahdharvas, Vidyadharas and Kinnaras; Vasuki of terrible vigour as the lord of Serpents and Taksaka of terrible vigour as the lord of Safpas (Cobras). He made the leading elephant Airavata of terrible valour the lord of elephants. He made Garuda the lord of birds. He made UccaiiSravas (the horse of Indra) the king of horses.
verses.hindi: उसके बाद उन वसिष्ठकी आज्ञासे महाबुद्धिमान् शक्तिपुत्रने राक्षसोंके विनाशके लिये निश्चय किया। अदृश्यन्ती, वसिष्ठ तथा अरुन्धतीको प्रणाम करनेके अनन्तर मुनिके समीप मिट्टीका एक (पार्थिवेश्वर)
verses.wordMeaning: Brahma crowned the Plaksa and Avattha as the lords of trees,* he made Citraratha the lord of Gahdharvas, Vidyadharas and Kinnaras; Vasuki of terrible vigour as the lord of Serpents and Taksaka of terrible vigour as the lord of Safpas (Cobras).…
verses.commentary: Sense: Brahma crowned the Plaksa and Avattha as the lords of trees,* he made Citraratha the lord of Gahdharvas, Vidyadharas and Kinnaras; Vasuki of terrible vigour as the lord of Serpents and Taksaka of terrible vigour as the lord of Safpas (Cobras).…

verses.sanskrit: सिंहं मृगाणां वृषभं गवां च मृगाधिपानां शरभं चकार सेनाधिपानां गुहमप्रमेयं श्रुतिस्मृतीनां लकुलीशमीशम्
verses.transliteration: siṃhaṃ mṛgāṇāṃ vṛṣabhaṃ gavāṃ ca mṛgādhipānāṃ śarabhaṃ cakāra senādhipānāṃ guhamaprameyaṃ śrutismṛtīnāṃ lakulīśamīśam
verses.translation: He made the lion the lord of animals; the bull the lord of the kine and Sarabha (the fabulous eight-footed beast) the lord of lions; the incomprehensible Guha the lord of all com- manders-in-chief and Lakulisa the lord of Srutis and Smrtis.
verses.hindi: क्षणिक लिङ्ग बनाकर शुभ शिवसूक्त तथा त्र्यम्बकमत्तरसे विधिवत् पूजन करके त्वरितरुद्र, शिवसंकल्पसूक्त, नीलरद्र उत्तम रुद्र, वामीय, पवमान, पंचब्रह्म (सद्योजातादि पाँच जप करके भगवान् रुद्रको अष्टांग अर्घ्य प्रदान करके यथाविधि अभ्यर्चनकर वे शाक्तेय (पराशर) प्रार्थना करने लगे॥ ७४--७८॥
verses.wordMeaning: He made the lion the lord of animals; the bull the lord of the kine and Sarabha (the fabulous eight-footed beast) the lord of lions; the incomprehensible Guha the lord of all com- manders-in-chief and Lakulisa the lord of Srutis and Smrtis.
verses.commentary: Sense: He made the lion the lord of animals; the bull the lord of the kine and Sarabha (the fabulous eight-footed beast) the lord of lions; the incomprehensible Guha the lord of all com- manders-in-chief and Lakulisa the lord of Srutis and Smrtis.

verses.sanskrit: अभ्यषिञ्चत्सुधर्माणं तथा शङ्खपदं दिशाम् केतुमन्तं क्रमेणैव हेमरोमाणमेव च
verses.transliteration: abhyaṣiñcatsudharmāṇaṃ tathā śaṅkhapadaṃ diśām ketumantaṃ krameṇaiva hemaromāṇameva ca
verses.translation: He made Sudharman, Sahkhapala, Ketuman and Hemaroman the overlords of all quarters in order.
verses.hindi: पराशर बोले--'हे भगवन्! है रुद्र! है शंकर! राक्षस रुधिरने भाइयोंसहित मेरे महातेजस्वी पिताका भक्षण कर लिया। है भगवन्! मैं अपने पिताको उनके भाइयोंसहित देखना चाहता हूँ।' इस प्रकार प्रार्थना करते हुए उस
verses.wordMeaning: He made Sudharman, Sahkhapala, Ketuman and Hemaroman the overlords of all quarters in order.
verses.commentary: Sense: He made Sudharman, Sahkhapala, Ketuman and Hemaroman the overlords of all quarters in order.

verses.sanskrit: पृथिव्यां पृथुमीशानं सर्वेषां तु महेश्वरम् चतुर्मूर्तिषु सर्वज्ञं शङ्करं वृषभध्वजम्
verses.transliteration: pṛthivyāṃ pṛthumīśānaṃ sarveṣāṃ tu maheśvaram caturmūrtiṣu sarvajñaṃ śaṅkaraṃ vṛṣabhadhvajam
verses.translation: (He crowned) Prthu as the lord of the earth; Mahesvara as the lord of all; the bull-bannered omniscient lord Sankara as the overlord among the four deities.
verses.hindi: लिङ्गको बार-बार प्रणामकर “हा रुद्र! रुद्र रुद्र !'-यह कहते हुए वे रोने लगे और गिर पड़े॥ ७९-८०/२॥ तब उन्हें देखकर कल्याणकारी भगवान् रुद्रने देवी पार्वती-से कहा-हे महाभागे! अश्रुसे भरे हुए नेत्रोंवाले, मेरे स्मरणमें लगे हुए तथा मेरी आराधनामें तत्पर इस बालकको देखो
verses.wordMeaning: (He crowned) Prthu as the lord of the earth; Mahesvara as the lord of all; the bull-bannered omniscient lord Sankara as the overlord among the four deities.
verses.commentary: Sense: (He crowned) Prthu as the lord of the earth; Mahesvara as the lord of all; the bull-bannered omniscient lord Sankara as the overlord among the four deities.

verses.sanskrit: प्रसादाद्भगवाञ्छम्भोश् चाभ्यषिञ्चद्यथाक्रमम् पुराभिषिच्य पुण्यात्मा रराज भुवनेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: prasādādbhagavāñchambhoś cābhyaṣiñcadyathākramam purābhiṣicya puṇyātmā rarāja bhuvaneśvaraḥ
verses.translation: By the grace of Siva, the lord crowned these in due order. After crowning them at first the lord of the worlds felt fully satisfied.
verses.hindi: तब निष्कलंक उन महादेवी उमाने दुःखसे दुर्बल अंगोंवाले, अश्रुपूरित नेत्रोंवाले, लिङ्गार्चनके कर्ममें संलग्न तथा "हे हर! है रुद्र'-एऐसा उच्चारण करनेवाले पराशरको देखकर सम्पूर्ण लोकोंके स्वामी अपने पति
verses.wordMeaning: By the grace of Siva, the lord crowned these in due order. After crowning them at first the lord of the worlds felt fully satisfied.
verses.commentary: Sense: By the grace of Siva, the lord crowned these in due order. After crowning them at first the lord of the worlds felt fully satisfied.

verses.sanskrit: एतद्वो विस्तरेणैव कथितं मुनिपुङ्गवाः अभिषिक्तास्ततस्त्वेते विशिष्टा विश्वयोनिना
verses.transliteration: etadvo vistareṇaiva kathitaṃ munipuṅgavāḥ abhiṣiktāstatastvete viśiṣṭā viśvayoninā
verses.translation: O leading sages, this has been mentioned to you in detail: These persons of special characteristics were all crown- ed by Lord Brahma the source of origin of the universe.
verses.hindi: शंकरसे कहा-हे परमेश्वर! आप प्रसन्न हो जाइये और इसे सम्पूर्ण अभीष्ट वर प्रदान कीजिये ॥ ८३-८४ /२॥ तदनन्तर उनका वचन सुनकर विषपान करनेवाले परमेश्वर शंकरने अपनी भार्या साध्वी उमासे कहा मैं खिले हुए कमलके समान नेत्रवाले इस ब्राह्मण बालकको रक्षा करूँगा। मैं इसे दिव्य दृष्टि दे रहीं
verses.wordMeaning: O leading sages, this has been mentioned to you in detail: These persons of special characteristics were all crown- ed by Lord Brahma the source of origin of the universe.
verses.commentary: Sense: O leading sages, this has been mentioned to you in detail: These persons of special characteristics were all crown- ed by Lord Brahma the source of origin of the universe.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीलिङ्गमहापुराणे सूर्याद्यभिषेककथनं नामाष्टपञ्चाशत्तमो ऽध्यायः एतच्छ्रुत्वा तु मुनयः पुनस्तं संशयान्विताः पप्रच्छुरुत्तरं भूयस् तदा ते रोमहर्षणम्
verses.transliteration: iti śrīliṅgamahāpurāṇe sūryādyabhiṣekakathanaṃ nāmāṣṭapañcāśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ etacchrutvā tu munayaḥ punastaṃ saṃśayānvitāḥ papracchuruttaraṃ bhūyas tadā te romaharṣaṇam
verses.translation: The four guardian deities, viz. Sudharman, Sahkhapala, Ketu- man, Hemaroman were consecrated in their respective quarters. Gf. Vi?i>u
verses.hindi: हूँ; जिससे यह मेरे रूपका दर्शन करनेमें समर्थ
verses.wordMeaning: The four guardian deities, viz. Sudharman, Sahkhapala, Ketu- man, Hemaroman were consecrated in their respective quarters. Gf. Vi?i>u
verses.commentary: Sense: The four guardian deities, viz. Sudharman, Sahkhapala, Ketu- man, Hemaroman were consecrated in their respective quarters. Gf. Vi?i>u

verses.sanskrit: यदेतदुक्तं भवता सूतेह वदतां वर एतद्विस्तरतो ब्रूहि ज्योतिषां च विनिर्णयम्
verses.transliteration: yadetaduktaṃ bhavatā sūteha vadatāṃ vara etadvistarato brūhi jyotiṣāṃ ca vinirṇayam
verses.translation: caturmurtiu; in four forms, viz. Visva, Prajna, Taijasa, and Turiya.
verses.hindi: अध्याय ६४1 वसिष्ठपुत्र शक्तिका आख्यान तथा महर्षि पराशरकी कथा २७३ दर्शनं तस्मै मुनिपुत्राय क ऐसा कहकर अपने दिव्य गणों तथा ब्रह्मा,
verses.wordMeaning: caturmurtiu; in four forms, viz. Visva, Prajna, Taijasa, and Turiya.
verses.commentary: Sense: caturmurtiu; in four forms, viz. Visva, Prajna, Taijasa, and Turiya.

verses.sanskrit: श्रुत्वा तु वचनं तेषां तदा सूतः समाहितः उवाच परमं वाक्यं तेषां संशयनिर्णये
verses.transliteration: śrutvā tu vacanaṃ teṣāṃ tadā sūtaḥ samāhitaḥ uvāca paramaṃ vākyaṃ teṣāṃ saṃśayanirṇaye
verses.translation: O Suta, most excellent among the speakers, kindly tell us in detail the exact nature of the luminaries briefly.
verses.hindi: द्दौ च दश मुनिपुत्राय धीमते॥ ८८ विष्णु, रूद्र आदिसे घिरे हुए भगवान् नीललोहित
verses.wordMeaning: O Suta, most excellent among the speakers, kindly tell us in detail the exact nature of the luminaries briefly.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Suta, most excellent among the speakers, kindly tell us in detail the exact nature of the luminaries briefly.

verses.sanskrit: अस्मिन्नर्थे महाप्राज्ञैर् यदुक्तं शान्तबुद्धिभिः एतद्वो ऽहं प्रवक्ष्यामि सूर्यचन्द्रमसोर्गतिम्
verses.transliteration: asminnarthe mahāprājñair yaduktaṃ śāntabuddhibhiḥ etadvo 'haṃ pravakṣyāmi sūryacandramasorgatim
verses.translation: On hearing their words, Suta of great concentration and purity spoke these weighty words in order to clear their doubts.
verses.hindi: दोऽपि दृष्ट्वा महादेवमानन्दास्त्राविलेक्षणः। परमेश्वरने उन बुद्धिमान् मुनिपुत्र पराशर-को दर्शन दिया
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing their words, Suta of great concentration and purity spoke these weighty words in order to clear their doubts.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing their words, Suta of great concentration and purity spoke these weighty words in order to clear their doubts.

verses.sanskrit: यथा देवगृहाणीह सूर्यचन्द्रादयो ग्रहाः अतः परं तु त्रिविधम् अग्नेर्वक्ष्ये समुद्भवम्
verses.transliteration: yathā devagṛhāṇīha sūryacandrādayo grahāḥ ataḥ paraṃ tu trividham agnervakṣye samudbhavam
verses.translation: In this matter I shall tell you what has already been stated by highly intelligent persons with tranquil wisdom. I shall recount the movement of the sun and the moon.
verses.hindi: महादेवजीको देखकर आनन्दके अश्रुसे भरे हुए ेत्रॉंबाले वे पराशर भी प्रसन्नचित्त होकर आदरपूर्वक उनके चरणोंपर गिर पड़े और पुनः भवानी पार्वती और महात्मा नन्दीके चरणोंपर गिर पडे। तत्पश्चात्
verses.wordMeaning: In this matter I shall tell you what has already been stated by highly intelligent persons with tranquil wisdom. I shall recount the movement of the sun and the moon.
verses.commentary: Sense: In this matter I shall tell you what has already been stated by highly intelligent persons with tranquil wisdom. I shall recount the movement of the sun and the moon.

verses.sanskrit: दिव्यस्य भौतिकस्याग्नेर् अथो ऽग्नेः पार्थिवस्य च व्युष्टायां तु रजन्यां च ब्रह्मणो ऽव्यक्तजन्मनः
verses.transliteration: divyasya bhautikasyāgner atho 'gneḥ pārthivasya ca vyuṣṭāyāṃ tu rajanyāṃ ca brahmaṇo 'vyaktajanmanaḥ
verses.translation: I shall tell you how the sun, the moon and other planets arc the abodes of Devas. Thereafter, I shall mention the three® types of fires and their origin.
verses.hindi: उन्होंने उन ब्रह्मा आदिसे कहा--' मेरा जीवन आज सफल हो गया। बाल चन्द्रमाके आभूषणवाले साक्षात् शिवजी मेरी रक्षाके लिये आज उपस्थित हुए हैं; अतः देवता अथवा दानव--दूसरा कौन इस लोकमें मेरे समान भाग्यशाली है'॥ ८९--९१॥
verses.wordMeaning: I shall tell you how the sun, the moon and other planets arc the abodes of Devas. Thereafter, I shall mention the three® types of fires and their origin.
verses.commentary: Sense: I shall tell you how the sun, the moon and other planets arc the abodes of Devas. Thereafter, I shall mention the three® types of fires and their origin.

verses.sanskrit: अव्याकृतमिदं त्वासीन् नैशेन तमसा वृतम् चतुर्भागावशिष्टे ऽस्मिन् लोके नष्टे विशेषतः
verses.transliteration: avyākṛtamidaṃ tvāsīn naiśena tamasā vṛtam caturbhāgāvaśiṣṭe 'smin loke naṣṭe viśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: The three types of fire are: the divine fire, the ele- mental fire and the terrestrial fire.
verses.hindi: पिताको भाइयोंसहित अन्तरिक्षमें खड़े देखा । सूर्यमण्डलके समान तेजवाले तथा सभी ओर मुखवाले विमानमें अपने भाइयोंसहित पिताको देखकर उन्होंने प्रणाम किया और वे बहुत हर्षित हुए
verses.wordMeaning: The three types of fire are: the divine fire, the ele- mental fire and the terrestrial fire.
verses.commentary: Sense: The three types of fire are: the divine fire, the ele- mental fire and the terrestrial fire.

verses.sanskrit: स्वयंभूर्भगवांस्तत्र लोकसर्वार्थसाधकः खद्योतवत्स व्यचरद् आविर्भावचिकीर्षया
verses.transliteration: svayaṃbhūrbhagavāṃstatra lokasarvārthasādhakaḥ khadyotavatsa vyacarad āvirbhāvacikīrṣayā
verses.translation: The fire in the world of mankind is called Parthiva. The fire that blazes in the sun is called iSuci. The fire born of lightning is known as Abja (i.e. originating from the water portion). I shall now mention their characteristics. 7'here are three types of fires with water within, viz., Vaidyuta, Jathara (gastric) and Saura (Solar).
verses.hindi: भगवान् वृषभध्वज (शिव) पुत्रको देखनेमें तत्पर बसिष्ठ-पुत्र शक्ति-से यह कहने लगे श्रीदेव बोले-हे शक्ते! है विप्रेन्द्र! आनन्दके आँसुआंसे सिक्त नेत्रोंवाले अपने पुत्र इस बालकको और
verses.wordMeaning: The fire in the world of mankind is called Parthiva. The fire that blazes in the sun is called iSuci. The fire born of lightning is known as Abja (i.e. originating from the water portion). I shall now mention their characteristics.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The fire in the world of mankind is called Parthiva. The fire that blazes in the sun is called iSuci. The fire born of lightning is known as Abja (i.e. originating from the water portion). I shall now mention their characteristics.…

verses.sanskrit: सो ऽग्निं सृष्ट्वाथ लोकादौ पृथिवीजलसंश्रितः संहृत्य तत्प्रकाशार्थं त्रिधा व्यभजदीश्वरः
verses.transliteration: so 'gniṃ sṛṣṭvātha lokādau pṛthivījalasaṃśritaḥ saṃhṛtya tatprakāśārthaṃ tridhā vyabhajadīśvaraḥ
verses.translation: Hence, imbibing water through his rays the sun blazes ( further). The Abja (waterborn — lightning) fire even when immersed in water is not quenched by it. The fire that is
verses.hindi: कल्याणमयी तथा देवतातुल्य माता अरुन्धतीको देखो । हे महामते! अपने माता तथा पिता-इन दोनोंको नमस्कार करो
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, imbibing water through his rays the sun blazes ( further). The Abja (waterborn — lightning) fire even when immersed in water is not quenched by it. The fire that is
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, imbibing water through his rays the sun blazes ( further). The Abja (waterborn — lightning) fire even when immersed in water is not quenched by it. The fire that is

verses.sanskrit: पवनो यस्तु लोके ऽस्मिन् पार्थिवो वह्निरुच्यते यश्चासौ लोकादौ सूर्ये शुचिरग्निस्तु स स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: pavano yastu loke 'smin pārthivo vahnirucyate yaścāsau lokādau sūrye śuciragnistu sa smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: mah&pr&jnaih: by the most intelligent men, i.e. by Vyasa and others.
verses.hindi: तदनन्तर शंकरजीकी आज्ञासे देवदेव हरको, उमाको, श्रेष्ठ वसिष्ठकों तथा अपने पतिको देवता माननेवाली महाभाग्यवती कल्याणी माता अरुन्धतीको शीघ्र प्रणाम करके शक्तिमान् शक्तिने पुनः जगन्नाथ शिव-को सफलं जीवितं मेऽद्य ब्रह्माद्यांस्तांस्तदाह स: ॥
verses.wordMeaning: mah&pr&jnaih: by the most intelligent men, i.e. by Vyasa and others.
verses.commentary: Sense: mah&pr&jnaih: by the most intelligent men, i.e. by Vyasa and others.

verses.sanskrit: वैद्युतो ऽब्जस्तु विज्ञेयस् तेषां वक्ष्ये तु लक्षणम् वैद्युतो जाठरः सौरो वारिगर्भास्त्रयो ऽग्नयः
verses.transliteration: vaidyuto 'bjastu vijñeyas teṣāṃ vakṣye tu lakṣaṇam vaidyuto jāṭharaḥ sauro vārigarbhāstrayo 'gnayaḥ
verses.translation: Threefold fire: (i) celestial, as rep]:esented by the sun, (ii) atmospheric, as smboUzed by the lightning, (iii) terrestrial, which is used for the sacrificial and household purpose. Fire is called Pavaka on earth, Suci in heaven and Vaidyuta in firmament.
verses.hindi: कोऽन्यः समो मया लोके देवो वा दानवोऽपि वा
verses.wordMeaning: Threefold fire: (i) celestial, as rep]:esented by the sun, (ii) atmospheric, as smboUzed by the lightning, (iii) terrestrial, which is used for the sacrificial and household purpose. Fire is called Pavaka on earth, Suci in heaven and Vaidyuta in firmament.
verses.commentary: Sense: Threefold fire: (i) celestial, as rep]:esented by the sun, (ii) atmospheric, as smboUzed by the lightning, (iii) terrestrial, which is used for the sacrificial and household purpose. Fire is called Pavaka on earth, Suci in heaven and Vaidyuta in firmament.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मादपः पिबन्सूर्यो गोभिर् दीप्यत्यसौ विभुः जले चाब्जः समाविष्टो नाद्भिर् अग्निः प्रशाम्यति
verses.transliteration: tasmādapaḥ pibansūryo gobhir dīpyatyasau vibhuḥ jale cābjaḥ samāviṣṭo nādbhir agniḥ praśāmyati
verses.translation: When the sun is setting, the solar lustre becomes a circular mass without heat and enters the fire at night through his rays. Hence the light of fire is seen even from a distance at night. The heat is transmitted to the sun from fire, when the sun rises. Only partially does the terrestrial fire enter the sun. Hence the fire continues to blaze. Thus the fire element in both terrestrial and solar fires contains heat and light. They penetrate mutually and develop each other. In the northern and south- ern hemispheres of the earth, the fire and the sun thus develop each other. The sun rises up from the waters and re-enters them. Therefore, due to this exit (from and into waters) by day and by night, the waters become copper-coloured. Again when the sun sets, the day (i.e. daylight) enters the waters. Hence at night, the waters are seen shining white.
verses.hindi: अथ तस्मिन् क्षणादेव ददर्श दिवि संस्थितम्। सूर्यमण्डलसङ्काशे विमाने विश्वतोमुखे।
verses.wordMeaning: When the sun is setting, the solar lustre becomes a circular mass without heat and enters the fire at night through his rays. Hence the light of fire is seen even from a distance at night. The heat is transmitted to the sun from fire, when the sun rises.…
verses.commentary: Sense: When the sun is setting, the solar lustre becomes a circular mass without heat and enters the fire at night through his rays. Hence the light of fire is seen even from a distance at night. The heat is transmitted to the sun from fire, when the sun rises.…

verses.sanskrit: मानवानां च कुक्षिस्थो नाग्निः शाम्यति पावकः अर्चिष्मान्पवनः सो ऽग्निर् निष्प्रभो जाठरः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: mānavānāṃ ca kukṣistho nāgniḥ śāmyati pāvakaḥ arciṣmānpavanaḥ so 'gnir niṣprabho jāṭharaḥ smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: By means of this activity he enters waters perpetually, during day and night at the time of rising and setting both in the southern and northern hemispheres.
verses.hindi: तदा वृषध्वजो देवः सभार्यः सगणेश्वरः।
verses.wordMeaning: By means of this activity he enters waters perpetually, during day and night at the time of rising and setting both in the southern and northern hemispheres.
verses.commentary: Sense: By means of this activity he enters waters perpetually, during day and night at the time of rising and setting both in the southern and northern hemispheres.

verses.sanskrit: यश्चायं मण्डली शुक्ली निरूष्मा सम्प्रजायते प्रभा सौरी तु पादेन ह्य् अस्तं याते दिवाकरे
verses.transliteration: yaścāyaṃ maṇḍalī śuklī nirūṣmā samprajāyate prabhā saurī tu pādena hy astaṃ yāte divākare
verses.translation: The sun who blazes, imbibing the waters through his rays has the mixture of earthly and fiery particles within it. It is called divine fire,
verses.hindi: अरुन्धतीं महाभागां कल्याणीं देवतोपमाम्। तदा हरं प्रणम्याशु देवदेवमुमां तथा।
verses.wordMeaning: The sun who blazes, imbibing the waters through his rays has the mixture of earthly and fiery particles within it. It is called divine fire,
verses.commentary: Sense: The sun who blazes, imbibing the waters through his rays has the mixture of earthly and fiery particles within it. It is called divine fire,

verses.sanskrit: अग्निमाविशते रात्रौ तस्माद्दूरात्प्रकाशते उद्यन्तं च पुनः सूर्यम् औष्ण्यम् अग्नेः समाविशेत्
verses.transliteration: agnimāviśate rātrau tasmāddūrātprakāśate udyantaṃ ca punaḥ sūryam auṣṇyam agneḥ samāviśet
verses.translation: He has a thousand rays emitting snow, rain and heat. Of them four hundred tubular rays have forms of variegated colours. They shower rain. Their collective name is Amrta and the several individual names are Bhajanas, Malyas, Ketanas and Patanas.
verses.hindi: वसिष्ठं च तदा श्रेष्ठं शक्तिवै शङ्कराज्ञया
verses.wordMeaning: He has a thousand rays emitting snow, rain and heat. Of them four hundred tubular rays have forms of variegated colours. They shower rain. Their collective name is Amrta and the several individual names are Bhajanas, Malyas, Ketanas and Patanas.
verses.commentary: Sense: He has a thousand rays emitting snow, rain and heat. Of them four hundred tubular rays have forms of variegated colours. They shower rain. Their collective name is Amrta and the several individual names are Bhajanas, Malyas, Ketanas and Patanas.

verses.sanskrit: पादेन पार्थिवस्याग्नेस् तस्मादग्निस्तपत्यसौ प्रकाशोष्णस्वरूपे च सौराग्नेये तु तेजसी
verses.transliteration: pādena pārthivasyāgnes tasmādagnistapatyasau prakāśoṣṇasvarūpe ca saurāgneye tu tejasī
verses.translation: Fire on earth is the symbol of heat and fire in heaven is the symbol of light and both are interdependent. Cf. Matsya. 128.12. STTW
verses.hindi: मातरं च महाभागां कल्याणीं पतिदेवताम् वासिष्ठ (शक्ति) बोले-हे वत्स! है वत्स! हे विप्रेक्ध! है पराशर! है महाद्युते! है तात! गर्भमै स्थित रहते हुए तुम महात्माने मेरी रक्षा को। है वत्स! हे
verses.wordMeaning: Fire on earth is the symbol of heat and fire in heaven is the symbol of light and both are interdependent. Cf. Matsya. 128.12. STTW
verses.commentary: Sense: Fire on earth is the symbol of heat and fire in heaven is the symbol of light and both are interdependent. Cf. Matsya. 128.12. STTW

verses.sanskrit: परस्परानुप्रवेशाद् आप्यायेते परस्परम् उत्तरे चैव भूम्यर्धे तथा ह्यग्निश् च दक्षिणे
verses.transliteration: parasparānupraveśād āpyāyete parasparam uttare caiva bhūmyardhe tathā hyagniś ca dakṣiṇe
verses.translation: In the spring the sun is tawny coloured; in the summer he has the lustre of gold. During the rainy season the colour of the sun is white. In the autumn the sun is grey- coloured. In the early winter the sun is copper-coloured and in the late winter he is red in colour.
verses.hindi: अङ्षक्कअ्करक्ओक न काका फुफफकफफफफफफफाफाफ फफक फफ फफफ फ फफ फफफ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ फ फफ फ कफ मी £
verses.wordMeaning: In the spring the sun is tawny coloured; in the summer he has the lustre of gold. During the rainy season the colour of the sun is white. In the autumn the sun is grey- coloured. In the early winter the sun is copper-coloured and in the late winter he is red in colour.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the spring the sun is tawny coloured; in the summer he has the lustre of gold. During the rainy season the colour of the sun is white. In the autumn the sun is grey- coloured. In the early winter the sun is copper-coloured and in the late winter he is red in colour.

verses.sanskrit: उत्तिष्ठति पुनः सूर्यः पुनर्वै प्रविशत्य् अपः तस्मात्ताम्रा भवन्त्यापो दिवारात्रिप्रवेशनात्
verses.transliteration: uttiṣṭhati punaḥ sūryaḥ punarvai praviśaty apaḥ tasmāttāmrā bhavantyāpo divārātripraveśanāt
verses.translation: The numerous solar rays have their functional division. For instance, four hundred of them funcdon for creating rain (V.24-36), three hundred for heat (V.a8) and three hundred for cold V.26). These rays are distributed over the seasons and bring about the changes of cold, heat and rain.
verses.hindi: पुत्रेण लोकान् जयतीत्युक्तं सद्भिः सहैव हि गमिष्याम्यभिवन्द्येशं भ्रातृभिः सह शङ्करम्
verses.wordMeaning: The numerous solar rays have their functional division. For instance, four hundred of them funcdon for creating rain (V.24-36), three hundred for heat (V.a8) and three hundred for cold V.26). These rays are distributed over the seasons and bring about the changes of cold,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The numerous solar rays have their functional division. For instance, four hundred of them funcdon for creating rain (V.24-36), three hundred for heat (V.a8) and three hundred for cold V.26). These rays are distributed over the seasons and bring about the changes of cold,…

verses.sanskrit: अस्तं याति पुनः सूर्यो ऽहर्वै प्रविशत्य् अपः तस्मान्नक्तं पुनः शुक्ला आपो दृश्यन्ति भास्वराः
verses.transliteration: astaṃ yāti punaḥ sūryo 'harvai praviśaty apaḥ tasmānnaktaṃ punaḥ śuklā āpo dṛśyanti bhāsvarāḥ
verses.translation: The sun infuses strength into the medicinal herbs; he propitiates the Pitrs by means of Svadha rays; he instils nectar into the immortal beings. Thus, he imparts three things to the three groups.
verses.hindi: गतं दृष्ट्वाथ पितरं तदाभ्यर्च्यैव शङ्करम्।
verses.wordMeaning: The sun infuses strength into the medicinal herbs; he propitiates the Pitrs by means of Svadha rays; he instils nectar into the immortal beings. Thus, he imparts three things to the three groups.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sun infuses strength into the medicinal herbs; he propitiates the Pitrs by means of Svadha rays; he instils nectar into the immortal beings. Thus, he imparts three things to the three groups.

verses.sanskrit: एतेन क्रमयोगेन भूम्यर्धे दक्षिणोत्तरे उदयास्तमने नित्यम् अहोरात्रं विशत्य् अपः
verses.transliteration: etena kramayogena bhūmyardhe dakṣiṇottare udayāstamane nityam ahorātraṃ viśaty apaḥ
verses.translation: The sun infuses strength into the medicinal herbs; he propitiates the Pitrs by means of Svadha rays; he instils nectar into the immortal beings. Thus, he imparts three things to the three groups.
verses.hindi: ततस्तुष्टो महादेवो मन्मथान्धकमर्दनः। अनुगृह्याथ शाक्तेयं तत्रैवान्तरधीयत तदाह पौत्रं धर्मज्ञो वसिष्ठो मुनिभिर्वृतः। अलमत्यन्तकोपेन तात मन्युमिमं जहि
verses.wordMeaning: The sun infuses strength into the medicinal herbs; he propitiates the Pitrs by means of Svadha rays; he instils nectar into the immortal beings. Thus, he imparts three things to the three groups.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sun infuses strength into the medicinal herbs; he propitiates the Pitrs by means of Svadha rays; he instils nectar into the immortal beings. Thus, he imparts three things to the three groups.

verses.sanskrit: यश्चासौ तपते सूर्यः पिबन्नंभो गभस्तिभिः पार्थिवाग्निविमिश्रो ऽसौ दिव्यः शुचिरिति स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: yaścāsau tapate sūryaḥ pibannaṃbho gabhastibhiḥ pārthivāgnivimiśro 'sau divyaḥ śuciriti smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: The sun infuses strength into the medicinal herbs; he propitiates the Pitrs by means of Svadha rays; he instils nectar into the immortal beings. Thus, he imparts three things to the three groups.
verses.hindi: हन्यते तात कः केन यतः स्वकृतभुक्युमान्। सञ्चितस्यातिमहता वत्स क्लेशेन मानवैः
verses.wordMeaning: The sun infuses strength into the medicinal herbs; he propitiates the Pitrs by means of Svadha rays; he instils nectar into the immortal beings. Thus, he imparts three things to the three groups.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sun infuses strength into the medicinal herbs; he propitiates the Pitrs by means of Svadha rays; he instils nectar into the immortal beings. Thus, he imparts three things to the three groups.

verses.sanskrit: सहस्रपादसौ वह्निर् वृत्तकुम्भनिभः स्मृतः आदत्ते स तु नाडीनां सहस्रेण समन्ततः
verses.transliteration: sahasrapādasau vahnir vṛttakumbhanibhaḥ smṛtaḥ ādatte sa tu nāḍīnāṃ sahasreṇa samantataḥ
verses.translation: The sun infuses strength into the medicinal herbs; he propitiates the Pitrs by means of Svadha rays; he instils nectar into the immortal beings. Thus, he imparts three things to the three groups.
verses.hindi: यशसस्तपसश्चैव क्रोधो नाशकरः स्मृतः। एवं वसिष्ठवाक्येन शाक्तेयो मुनिपुङ्गवः
verses.wordMeaning: The sun infuses strength into the medicinal herbs; he propitiates the Pitrs by means of Svadha rays; he instils nectar into the immortal beings. Thus, he imparts three things to the three groups.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sun infuses strength into the medicinal herbs; he propitiates the Pitrs by means of Svadha rays; he instils nectar into the immortal beings. Thus, he imparts three things to the three groups.

verses.sanskrit: नादेयीश्चैव सामुद्रीः कूपाश्चैव तथा घनाः स्थावरा जङ्गमाश्चैव वापीकुल्यादिका अपः
verses.transliteration: nādeyīścaiva sāmudrīḥ kūpāścaiva tathā ghanāḥ sthāvarā jaṅgamāścaiva vāpīkulyādikā apaḥ
verses.translation: The sun infuses strength into the medicinal herbs; he propitiates the Pitrs by means of Svadha rays; he instils nectar into the immortal beings. Thus, he imparts three things to the three groups.
verses.hindi: पराशर! है बाल! मैंने अणिमा आदि सिद्धियो र ऐश्वर्यको प्राप्त कर लिया, जो कि तुम्हारे मुखका आज मुझे दर्शन हुआ। है वत्स! है महामते! अब तुम मेरी आज्ञासे महाभाग्यशालिनी अदृश्यन्ती, माता अरुन्धत
verses.wordMeaning: The sun infuses strength into the medicinal herbs; he propitiates the Pitrs by means of Svadha rays; he instils nectar into the immortal beings. Thus, he imparts three things to the three groups.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sun infuses strength into the medicinal herbs; he propitiates the Pitrs by means of Svadha rays; he instils nectar into the immortal beings. Thus, he imparts three things to the three groups.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य रश्मिसहस्रं तच् छीतवर्षोष्णनिःस्रवम् तासां चतुःशता नाड्यो वर्षन्ते चित्रमूर्तयः
verses.transliteration: tasya raśmisahasraṃ tac chītavarṣoṣṇaniḥsravam tāsāṃ catuḥśatā nāḍyo varṣante citramūrtayaḥ
verses.translation: The sun infuses strength into the medicinal herbs; he propitiates the Pitrs by means of Svadha rays; he instils nectar into the immortal beings. Thus, he imparts three things to the three groups.
verses.hindi: तथा मेरे पिता वसिष्ठको सर्वदा रक्षा करते रहो। है वत्स! तुमने मेरे समस्त कुलका उद्धार कर दिया सज्जनोंने सदा यही कहा है कि मनुष्य अपने पुत्रके द्वारा सभी लोकोंको जीत लेता है। अब तुम जगतको उत्पन्न करनेवाले प्रभु महेश्वरसे अभीष्ट वर माँगो और मैं अब भगवान् शंकरको प्रणाम करके भाइयोंके साथ जाऊँगा
verses.wordMeaning: The sun infuses strength into the medicinal herbs; he propitiates the Pitrs by means of Svadha rays; he instils nectar into the immortal beings. Thus, he imparts three things to the three groups.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sun infuses strength into the medicinal herbs; he propitiates the Pitrs by means of Svadha rays; he instils nectar into the immortal beings. Thus, he imparts three things to the three groups.

verses.sanskrit: भजनाश्चैव माल्याश् च केतनाः पतनास् तथा अमृता नामतः सर्वा रश्मयो वृष्टिसर्जनाः
verses.transliteration: bhajanāścaiva mālyāś ca ketanāḥ patanās tathā amṛtā nāmataḥ sarvā raśmayo vṛṣṭisarjanāḥ
verses.translation: The sun infuses strength into the medicinal herbs; he propitiates the Pitrs by means of Svadha rays; he instils nectar into the immortal beings. Thus, he imparts three things to the three groups.
verses.hindi: इस प्रकार पुत्रको परामर्श देकर महेश्वर तथा पिता वसिष्ठको प्रणाम करके सभामें अपनी भार्याकी ओर देखकर वे जितेन्द्रिय शक्ति चले गये
verses.wordMeaning: The sun infuses strength into the medicinal herbs; he propitiates the Pitrs by means of Svadha rays; he instils nectar into the immortal beings. Thus, he imparts three things to the three groups.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sun infuses strength into the medicinal herbs; he propitiates the Pitrs by means of Svadha rays; he instils nectar into the immortal beings. Thus, he imparts three things to the three groups.

verses.sanskrit: हिमोद्वहाश् च ता नाड्यो रश्मयस् त्रिशताः पुनः रेशा मेघाश् च वात्स्याश् च ह्लादिन्यो हिमसर्जनाः
verses.transliteration: himodvahāś ca tā nāḍyo raśmayas triśatāḥ punaḥ reśā meghāś ca vātsyāś ca hlādinyo himasarjanāḥ
verses.translation: The sun infuses strength into the medicinal herbs; he propitiates the Pitrs by means of Svadha rays; he instils nectar into the immortal beings. Thus, he imparts three things to the three groups.
verses.hindi: तत्पश्चात् पिताको गया हुआ देखकर वे शक्तिपुत् पराशर चन्द्रभूषण शंकरको पूजा करके प्रिय शब्दोद्वारा उनको स्तुति करने लगे तदनन्तर कामदेव तथा अन्धकका नाश करनेवाले
verses.wordMeaning: The sun infuses strength into the medicinal herbs; he propitiates the Pitrs by means of Svadha rays; he instils nectar into the immortal beings. Thus, he imparts three things to the three groups.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sun infuses strength into the medicinal herbs; he propitiates the Pitrs by means of Svadha rays; he instils nectar into the immortal beings. Thus, he imparts three things to the three groups.

verses.sanskrit: चन्द्रभा नामतः सर्वा पीताभाश् च गभस्तयः शुक्लाश् च ककुभाश्चैव गावो विश्वभृतस् तथा
verses.transliteration: candrabhā nāmataḥ sarvā pītābhāś ca gabhastayaḥ śuklāś ca kakubhāścaiva gāvo viśvabhṛtas tathā
verses.translation: The sun infuses strength into the medicinal herbs; he propitiates the Pitrs by means of Svadha rays; he instils nectar into the immortal beings. Thus, he imparts three things to the three groups.
verses.hindi: महादेव प्रसन्न हो गये और शक्तिपुत्र पराशरपर अनुग्रह
verses.wordMeaning: The sun infuses strength into the medicinal herbs; he propitiates the Pitrs by means of Svadha rays; he instils nectar into the immortal beings. Thus, he imparts three things to the three groups.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sun infuses strength into the medicinal herbs; he propitiates the Pitrs by means of Svadha rays; he instils nectar into the immortal beings. Thus, he imparts three things to the three groups.

verses.sanskrit: शुक्लास्ता नामतः सर्वास् त्रिशतीर्घर्मसर्जनाः सोमो बिभर्ति ताभिस्तु मनुष्यपितृदेवताः
verses.transliteration: śuklāstā nāmataḥ sarvās triśatīrgharmasarjanāḥ somo bibharti tābhistu manuṣyapitṛdevatāḥ
verses.translation: The sun infuses strength into the medicinal herbs; he propitiates the Pitrs by means of Svadha rays; he instils nectar into the immortal beings. Thus, he imparts three things to the three groups.
verses.hindi: करके वहींपर अन्तर्धान हो गये तब पार्वतीसहित महेश्वरके चले जानेपर मन्त्रवेत्ता पराशर महेश्वरको प्रणाम करके मन्त्रके द्वारा राक्षसोंके कुलको जलाने लगे
verses.wordMeaning: The sun infuses strength into the medicinal herbs; he propitiates the Pitrs by means of Svadha rays; he instils nectar into the immortal beings. Thus, he imparts three things to the three groups.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sun infuses strength into the medicinal herbs; he propitiates the Pitrs by means of Svadha rays; he instils nectar into the immortal beings. Thus, he imparts three things to the three groups.

verses.sanskrit: मनुष्यानौषधेनेह स्वधया च पितॄनपि अमृतेन सुरान् सर्वांस् तिसृभिस् तर्पयत्यसौ
verses.transliteration: manuṣyānauṣadheneha svadhayā ca pitṝnapi amṛtena surān sarvāṃs tisṛbhis tarpayatyasau
verses.translation: The sun infuses strength into the medicinal herbs; he propitiates the Pitrs by means of Svadha rays; he instils nectar into the immortal beings. Thus, he imparts three things to the three groups.
verses.hindi: उस समय मुनियोंसे घिरे हुए धर्मज्ञ वसिष्ठे पौत्र पराशर-से कहा--'हे तात! ऐसा महाकोप मत करो; इस क्रोधका त्याग करो। राक्षसोंने अपराध नहीं किया है; तुम्हारे पिताके लिये वैसा ही विहित था। मूर्खोको ही
verses.wordMeaning: The sun infuses strength into the medicinal herbs; he propitiates the Pitrs by means of Svadha rays; he instils nectar into the immortal beings. Thus, he imparts three things to the three groups.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sun infuses strength into the medicinal herbs; he propitiates the Pitrs by means of Svadha rays; he instils nectar into the immortal beings. Thus, he imparts three things to the three groups.

verses.sanskrit: वसन्ते चैव ग्रीष्मे च शतैः स तपते त्रिभिः वर्षास्वथो शरदि च चतुर्भिः संप्रवर्षति
verses.transliteration: vasante caiva grīṣme ca śataiḥ sa tapate tribhiḥ varṣāsvatho śaradi ca caturbhiḥ saṃpravarṣati
verses.translation: The sun infuses strength into the medicinal herbs; he propitiates the Pitrs by means of Svadha rays; he instils nectar into the immortal beings. Thus, he imparts three things to the three groups.
verses.hindi: क्रोध होता है; बुद्धिमानोंको नहीं । है तात! कौन किसे मारता है; मनुष्य तो अपने किये हुएका फल भोगता है। हे वत्स! क्रोध मनुष्योंके द्वारा अत्यधिक कष्टसे अर्जित किये गये यश तथा तपका नाश करनेवाला कहा गया है। अत: तुम दीन तथा निरपराध राक्षसोंको मत जलाओ और अपने इस यज्ञको बन्द करो; सज्जन लोग तो क्षमाशील होते है '॥ १०८--११११/, ॥
verses.wordMeaning: The sun infuses strength into the medicinal herbs; he propitiates the Pitrs by means of Svadha rays; he instils nectar into the immortal beings. Thus, he imparts three things to the three groups.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sun infuses strength into the medicinal herbs; he propitiates the Pitrs by means of Svadha rays; he instils nectar into the immortal beings. Thus, he imparts three things to the three groups.

verses.sanskrit: हेमन्ते शिशिरे चैव हिममुत्सृजते त्रिभिः इन्द्रो धाता भगः पूषा मित्रो ऽथ वरुणो ऽर्यमा
verses.transliteration: hemante śiśire caiva himamutsṛjate tribhiḥ indro dhātā bhagaḥ pūṣā mitro 'tha varuṇo 'ryamā
verses.translation: The sun infuses strength into the medicinal herbs; he propitiates the Pitrs by means of Svadha rays; he instils nectar into the immortal beings. Thus, he imparts three things to the three groups.
verses.hindi: इस प्रकार वसिष्ठको आज्ञासे तथा उनके वचनोंकी
verses.wordMeaning: The sun infuses strength into the medicinal herbs; he propitiates the Pitrs by means of Svadha rays; he instils nectar into the immortal beings. Thus, he imparts three things to the three groups.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sun infuses strength into the medicinal herbs; he propitiates the Pitrs by means of Svadha rays; he instils nectar into the immortal beings. Thus, he imparts three things to the three groups.

verses.sanskrit: अंशुर् विवस्वांस्त्वष्टा च पर्जन्यो विष्णुरेव च वरुणो माघमासे तु सूर्य एव तु फाल्गुने

verses.hindi: अध्याय ६५1 सूर्यवंश तथा चन्द्रवंशका वर्णन एवं शिवभक्त तण्डीप्रोक्त रुद्रसहस्त्रनाम २७५ ममज्ज मअभजजजजजजधजजजाम केकी क्र फ़ फा फ क फफ फ फफ फफफ फक फ फ़ पम्पा फ फ फफ फ फ फ़ फ फ फ क फ फ़ फफ फ फ फ फ फ फ फ फ फ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ फा फफ क फफफ फ फ फा फा मा का मी ममी
