verses.sanskrit: चैत्रे मासि भवेदंशुर् धाता वैशाखतापनः ज्येष्ठे मासि भवेदिन्द्र आषाढे चार्यमा रविः
verses.transliteration: caitre māsi bhavedaṃśur dhātā vaiśākhatāpanaḥ jyeṣṭhe māsi bhavedindra āṣāḍhe cāryamā raviḥ
verses.translation: The sun infuses strength into the medicinal herbs; he propitiates the Pitrs by means of Svadha rays; he instils nectar into the immortal beings. Thus, he imparts three things to the three groups.
verses.hindi: सत्रं सद्यस्तद्वाक्यगौरवात्।  कारण मुनिश्रेष्ठ पराशरने शीघ्र ही यज्ञको बन्द ततः प्रीतश्च भगवान् वसिष्ठो मुनिसत्तमः ॥ ११३  कर दिया। तब मुनिश्रेष्ठ भगवान् वसिष्ठ प्रसन्न हो सम्प्राप्तश्च तदा सत्र पुलस्त्यो ब्रह्मणः सुतः । गये
verses.wordMeaning: The sun infuses strength into the medicinal herbs; he propitiates the Pitrs by means of Svadha rays; he instils nectar into the immortal beings. Thus, he imparts three things to the three groups.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sun infuses strength into the medicinal herbs; he propitiates the Pitrs by means of Svadha rays; he instils nectar into the immortal beings. Thus, he imparts three things to the three groups.

verses.sanskrit: विवस्वान् श्रावणे मासि प्रौष्ठपदे भगः स्मृतः पर्जन्यो ऽश्वयुजे मासि त्वष्टा वै कार्तिके रविः
verses.transliteration: vivasvān śrāvaṇe māsi prauṣṭhapade bhagaḥ smṛtaḥ parjanyo 'śvayuje māsi tvaṣṭā vai kārtike raviḥ
verses.translation: The sun infuses strength into the medicinal herbs; he propitiates the Pitrs by means of Svadha rays; he instils nectar into the immortal beings. Thus, he imparts three things to the three groups.
verses.hindi: बसिष्ठेन तु दत्तार्घ्यः कृतासनपरिग्रहः॥ ९९४ उसी समय ब्रह्माके पुत्र ऋषि पुलस्त्य यज्ञमें आये । पराशरमुवाचेदं प्रणिपत्य स्थितं मुनिः। बसिष्ठने उन्हें अर्घ्य प्रदान किया तथा आसन देकर बैठाया; बैरे महति यद्वाक्याद् गुरोरद्याश्रिता क्षमा॥ ११५ तत्पश्चात् प्रणाम करके सम्मुख खडे पराशरसे मुनि न च्छेदः क्ुद्धेनापि यतः कृतः॥ ११६ वसम क्षमाको आश्रित किया है, अतः तुम सभी शास्त्रोंको जान सन्ततेर्मम वि. RR जाओगे और कुपित होनेपर भी तुमने मेरे वंशका नाश नहीं
verses.wordMeaning: The sun infuses strength into the medicinal herbs; he propitiates the Pitrs by means of Svadha rays; he instils nectar into the immortal beings. Thus, he imparts three things to the three groups.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sun infuses strength into the medicinal herbs; he propitiates the Pitrs by means of Svadha rays; he instils nectar into the immortal beings. Thus, he imparts three things to the three groups.

verses.sanskrit: मार्गशीर्षे भवेन्मित्रः पौषे विष्णुः सनातनः पञ्चरश्मिसहस्राणि वरुणस्यार्ककर्मणि
verses.transliteration: mārgaśīrṣe bhavenmitraḥ pauṣe viṣṇuḥ sanātanaḥ pañcaraśmisahasrāṇi varuṇasyārkakarmaṇi
verses.translation: The sun infuses strength into the medicinal herbs; he propitiates the Pitrs by means of Svadha rays; he instils nectar into the immortal beings. Thus, he imparts three things to the three groups.
verses.hindi: पुराणसंहिताकता किया, अत: है महाभाग ! मैं तुम्है अन्य महान् वर भी प्रदान पुराणसंहिताकर्ता भवान् वत्स भविष्यति॥ ११७  करता हुँ--हे वत्स! तुम पुराणसंहिताके कर्ता होओगे और
verses.wordMeaning: The sun infuses strength into the medicinal herbs; he propitiates the Pitrs by means of Svadha rays; he instils nectar into the immortal beings. Thus, he imparts three things to the three groups.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sun infuses strength into the medicinal herbs; he propitiates the Pitrs by means of Svadha rays; he instils nectar into the immortal beings. Thus, he imparts three things to the three groups.

verses.sanskrit: षड्भिः सहस्रैः पूषा तु देवो ऽंशुः सप्तभिस् तथा धाताष्टभिः सहस्रैस्तु नवभिस्तु शतक्रतुः
verses.transliteration: ṣaḍbhiḥ sahasraiḥ pūṣā tu devo 'ṃśuḥ saptabhis tathā dhātāṣṭabhiḥ sahasraistu navabhistu śatakratuḥ
verses.translation: The sun infuses strength into the medicinal herbs; he propitiates the Pitrs by means of Svadha rays; he instils nectar into the immortal beings. Thus, he imparts three things to the three groups.
verses.hindi: प्रवृत्तौ वा निवृत्तौ वा कर्मणस्तेऽमला मतिः॥ ११८ मेरी कृपासे प्रवृत्ति तथा निवृत्तिके कर्मोसे तुम्हारी बुद्धि मत्प्रसादादसन्दिग्धा तव वत्स भविष्यति। विशुद्ध एवं सन्देहरहित होगी’ ततश्च प्राह भगवान् वसिष्ठो वदतां वरः॥ ११९ तदनन्तर वक्ताओंमें श्रेष्ठ भगवान् वसिष्ठने कहा-- पुलस्त्येन यदुक्तं ते सर्वमेतद्भविष्यति। ' है वत्स! ऋषि पुलस्त्यने तुम्हारे लिये जो कुछ कहा अथ तस्य पुलस्त्यस्य वसिष्ठस्य च धीमतः ॥ १२० है, यह सब होकर रहेगा।' तब उन पुलस्त्य तथा बुद्धिमान् प्रसादाद्वैष्णवं चक्रे पुराणं वै पराशरः।
verses.wordMeaning: The sun infuses strength into the medicinal herbs; he propitiates the Pitrs by means of Svadha rays; he instils nectar into the immortal beings. Thus, he imparts three things to the three groups.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sun infuses strength into the medicinal herbs; he propitiates the Pitrs by means of Svadha rays; he instils nectar into the immortal beings. Thus, he imparts three things to the three groups.

verses.sanskrit: विवस्वान् दशभिर् याति यात्येकादशभिर् भगः सप्तभिस्तपते मित्रस् त्वष्टा चैवाष्टभिः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: vivasvān daśabhir yāti yātyekādaśabhir bhagaḥ saptabhistapate mitras tvaṣṭā caivāṣṭabhiḥ smṛtaḥ

verses.hindi: बसिष्ठकी कृपासे पराशरे विष्णुपुराणकी रचना की । यह छः

verses.transliteration: aryamā daśabhir yāti parjanyo navabhis tathā ṣaḍbhī raśmisahasraistu viṣṇustapati medinīm

verses.transliteration: vasaṃte kapilaḥ sūryo grīṣme kāñcanasaprabhaḥ śveto varṣāsu varṇena pāṇḍuḥ śaradi bhāskaraḥ
verses.translation: The sun infuses strength into the medicinal herbs; he propitiates the Pitrs by means of Svadha rays; he instils nectar into the immortal beings. Thus, he imparts three things to the three groups.
verses.hindi: षट्साहस्त्रमितं सर्व वेदार्थेन च संयुतम्। संहिताओंमें चतुर्थ तथा परम सुन्दर है॥ १९९--१२२॥

verses.sanskrit: हेमन्ते ताम्रवर्णस्तु शिशिरे लोहितो रविः इति वर्णाः समाख्याता मया सूर्यसमुद्भवाः
verses.transliteration: hemante tāmravarṇastu śiśire lohito raviḥ iti varṇāḥ samākhyātā mayā sūryasamudbhavāḥ
verses.translation: The sun infuses strength into the medicinal herbs; he propitiates the Pitrs by means of Svadha rays; he instils nectar into the immortal beings. Thus, he imparts three things to the three groups.
verses.hindi: चतुर्थ हि पुराणानां संहितासु सुशोभनम्॥ १२२  है श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! मैने आपलोगोंसे संक्षेपमें वसिष्ठके एष वः कथितः सर्वो वासिष्ठानां समासतः । पुत्रोंको उत्पत्ति तथा शक्तिपुत्र पराशर कै सम्पूर्ण प्रभवः शक्तिसूनोश्च प्रभावो मुनिपुङ्गवाः १२३
verses.wordMeaning: The sun infuses strength into the medicinal herbs; he propitiates the Pitrs by means of Svadha rays; he instils nectar into the immortal beings. Thus, he imparts three things to the three groups.

verses.sanskrit: ओषधीषु बलं धत्ते स्वधया च पितृष्वपि सूर्यो ऽमरेष्वप्यमृतं त्रयं त्रिषु नियच्छति
verses.transliteration: oṣadhīṣu balaṃ dhatte svadhayā ca pitṛṣvapi sūryo 'mareṣvapyamṛtaṃ trayaṃ triṣu niyacchati
verses.translation: The sun infuses strength into the medicinal herbs; he propitiates the Pitrs by means of Svadha rays; he instils nectar into the immortal beings. Thus, he imparts three things to the three groups.
verses.hindi: प्रभावका वर्णन कर दिया
verses.wordMeaning: The sun infuses strength into the medicinal herbs; he propitiates the Pitrs by means of Svadha rays; he instils nectar into the immortal beings. Thus, he imparts three things to the three groups.

verses.sanskrit: एवं रश्मिसहस्रं तत् सौरं लोकार्थसाधकम् भिद्यते लोकमासाद्य जलशीतोष्णनिःस्रवम्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ raśmisahasraṃ tat sauraṃ lokārthasādhakam bhidyate lokamāsādya jalaśītoṣṇaniḥsravam
verses.translation: The sun infuses strength into the medicinal herbs; he propitiates the Pitrs by means of Svadha rays; he instils nectar into the immortal beings. Thus, he imparts three things to the three groups.
verses.hindi: सूर्यवंश तथा चन्द्रवंशका वर्णन एवं शिवभक्त तण्डोप्रोक्त रुद्रसहस्त्रनाम  ऋषय ऊचुः ऋषिगण बोले--हे वंशविदोंमें श्रेष्ठ! है रोमहर्षण! आदित्यवंशं सोमस्य वंशं वंशविदां वर!  आप संक्षेपमें सूर्यवंश तथा चन्द्रवंशके विषयमें हमलोगोंको वक्तुमहसि चास्माकं सङ्क्षेपाद्रोमहर्षण॥ ९  बतानेकी कृपा करें
verses.wordMeaning: The sun infuses strength into the medicinal herbs; he propitiates the Pitrs by means of Svadha rays; he instils nectar into the immortal beings. Thus, he imparts three things to the three groups.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sun infuses strength into the medicinal herbs; he propitiates the Pitrs by means of Svadha rays; he instils nectar into the immortal beings. Thus, he imparts three things to the three groups.

verses.sanskrit: इत्येतन्मण्डलं शुक्लं भास्वरं सूर्यसंज्ञितम् नक्षत्रग्रहसोमानां प्रतिष्ठायोनिरेव च
verses.transliteration: ityetanmaṇḍalaṃ śuklaṃ bhāsvaraṃ sūryasaṃjñitam nakṣatragrahasomānāṃ pratiṣṭhāyonireva ca
verses.translation: The sun infuses strength into the medicinal herbs; he propitiates the Pitrs by means of Svadha rays; he instils nectar into the immortal beings. Thus, he imparts three things to the three groups.
verses.hindi: इस सूतजी बोले-हे द्विजो! अदितिने कश्यपसे भ यापर द्विजाः २  आदित्य नामक पुत्रको उत्पन्न किया। उस आदित्यको संज्ञा राजी प्रभा छाया पुत्रांस्तासां वदामि वः। ज्येष्ठ भार्याके अतिरिक्त तीन और भार्याएँ थीं। वे संज्ञा,  यले जे स्त्रसहस्रनामस्तत्र दिया है, वह महाभारतके  यासन अ ३७ के अनगत आये शिवसहसनामस्तोत्र से साम्य रखता है, वहाँ अ० १७ के अन्तर्गत आये शिवसहरूनामस्तोत्र से साम्य रखता है, वहाँ

verses.sanskrit: चन्द्रऋक्षग्रहाः सर्वे विज्ञेयाः सूर्यसंभवाः नक्षत्राधिपतिः सोमो नयनं वाममीशितुः
verses.transliteration: candraṛkṣagrahāḥ sarve vijñeyāḥ sūryasaṃbhavāḥ nakṣatrādhipatiḥ somo nayanaṃ vāmamīśituḥ

verses.hindi: उसका विस्तृत माहात्म्य भी पूर्वमें वर्णित है। छाया च तस्मात्सुषुवे सावर्णि भास्कराद् द्विजाः ।

verses.sanskrit: नयनं चैवम् ईशस्य दक्षिणं भास्करः स्वयम् तेषां जनानां लोके ऽस्मिन् नयनं नयते यतः
verses.transliteration: nayanaṃ caivam īśasya dakṣiṇaṃ bhāskaraḥ svayam teṣāṃ janānāṃ loke 'smin nayanaṃ nayate yataḥ

verses.hindi: सोऽपि गोकर्णमाश्रित्य फलकेनानिलाशनः। आराधयन् महादेवं यावद्वर्षायुतायुतम्॥
verses.wordMeaning: The sun infuses strength into the medicinal herbs; he propitiates the Pitrs by means of Svadha rays; he instils nectar into the immortal beings. Thus, he imparts three things to the three groups.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sun infuses strength into the medicinal herbs; he propitiates the Pitrs by means of Svadha rays; he instils nectar into the immortal beings. Thus, he imparts three things to the three groups.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीलिङ्गमहापुराणे पूर्वभागे सूर्यरश्मिस्वरूपकथनं नामैकोनषष्टितमो ऽध्यायः शेषाः पञ्च ग्रहा ज्ञेया ईश्वराः कामचारिणः पठ्यते चाग्निरादित्य उदकं चन्द्रमाः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: iti śrīliṅgamahāpurāṇe pūrvabhāge sūryaraśmisvarūpakathanaṃ nāmaikonaṣaṣṭitamo 'dhyāyaḥ śeṣāḥ pañca grahā jñeyā īśvarāḥ kāmacāriṇaḥ paṭhyate cāgnirāditya udakaṃ candramāḥ smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: It is cited' that the sun is fire and the moon is water. The other five planets are known as lords who move about as they please.
verses.hindi: भवप्रसादादागत्य लोकपालत्वमुत्तमम्। पितृणामाधिपत्यं तु शापमोक्षं तथैव च

verses.sanskrit: शेषाणां प्रकृतिं सम्यग् वक्ष्यमाणां निबोधत सुरसेनापतिः स्कन्दः पठ्यते ऽङ्गारको ग्रहः
verses.transliteration: śeṣāṇāṃ prakṛtiṃ samyag vakṣyamāṇāṃ nibodhata surasenāpatiḥ skandaḥ paṭhyate 'ṅgārako grahaḥ
verses.translation: Understand the source of origin of the remaining planets which is clearly being recounted now. It is cited that the planet Mars is Skanda (Karttikeya) the commander-in-chief of the army of Devas.
verses.hindi: लब्धवान् देवदेवस्य प्रभावाच्छूलपाणिनः। असहन्ती पुरा भानोस्तेजोमयमनिन्दिता
verses.wordMeaning: Understand the source of origin of the remaining planets which is clearly being recounted now. It is cited that the planet Mars is Skanda (Karttikeya) the commander-in-chief of the army of Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Understand the source of origin of the remaining planets which is clearly being recounted now. It is cited that the planet Mars is Skanda (Karttikeya) the commander-in-chief of the army of Devas.

verses.sanskrit: नारायणं बुधं प्राहुर् देवं ज्ञानविदो जनाः सर्वलोकप्रभुः साक्षाद् यमो लोकप्रभुः स्वयम्
verses.transliteration: nārāyaṇaṃ budhaṃ prāhur devaṃ jñānavido janāḥ sarvalokaprabhuḥ sākṣād yamo lokaprabhuḥ svayam
verses.translation: People of perfect knowledge say that Mercury is lord Narayana. O excellent brahmins, the great planet Sanaiicara, the slow-moving Saturn is Yama, the lord of the worlds. The preceptors of Devas and Asuras are the great planets Venus and Jupiter with (refulgent) rays. They are mentioned as the sons of Prajapati.®®
verses.hindi: कालाग्रयलतो ज्ञात्वा छायां छायापतिः प्रभुः । वडवामगमत्संज्ञामश्वरूपेण भास्करः
verses.wordMeaning: People of perfect knowledge say that Mercury is lord Narayana. O excellent brahmins, the great planet Sanaiicara, the slow-moving Saturn is Yama, the lord of the worlds. The preceptors of Devas and Asuras are the great planets Venus and Jupiter with (refulgent) rays.…
verses.commentary: Sense: People of perfect knowledge say that Mercury is lord Narayana. O excellent brahmins, the great planet Sanaiicara, the slow-moving Saturn is Yama, the lord of the worlds. The preceptors of Devas and Asuras are the great planets Venus and Jupiter with (refulgent) rays.…

verses.sanskrit: महाग्रहो द्विजश्रेष्ठा मन्दगामी शनैश्चरः देवासुरगुरू द्वौ तु भानुमन्तौ महाग्रहौ
verses.transliteration: mahāgraho dvijaśreṣṭhā mandagāmī śanaiścaraḥ devāsuragurū dvau tu bhānumantau mahāgrahau
verses.translation: For the celestial fire as identical with the sun, cf. SpT ted in ST.
verses.hindi: वडवा च तदा त्वाष्ट्री संज्ञा तस्माद्दिवाकरात्। सुषुवे चाश्विनौ देवौ देवानां तु भिषग्वरौ
verses.wordMeaning: For the celestial fire as identical with the sun, cf. SpT ted in ST.
verses.commentary: Sense: For the celestial fire as identical with the sun, cf. SpT ted in ST.

verses.sanskrit: प्रजापतिसुतावुक्तौ ततः शुक्रबृहस्पती आदित्यमूलमखिलं त्रैलोक्यं नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: prajāpatisutāvuktau tataḥ śukrabṛhaspatī ādityamūlamakhilaṃ trailokyaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: Sukra (Venus
verses.hindi: लिखितो भास्करः पश्चात्संज्ञा पित्रा महात्मना। विष्णोश्चक्रं तु यद् घोरं मण्डलाद्धास्करस्य तु आप लोगोंको बताता हूँ। त्वष्टाकी पुत्री संज्ञाने
verses.wordMeaning: Sukra (Venus
verses.commentary: Sense: Sukra (Venus

verses.sanskrit: भवत्यस्माज्जगत्कृत्स्नं सदेवासुरमानुषम् रुद्रेन्द्रोपेन्द्रचन्द्राणां विप्रेन्द्राग्निदिवौकसाम्
verses.transliteration: bhavatyasmājjagatkṛtsnaṃ sadevāsuramānuṣam rudrendropendracandrāṇāṃ viprendrāgnidivaukasām
verses.translation: The entire universe including Devas, Asuras and human beings originates from him. He is the lustre of all lumi- naries and the universal refulgence. The refulgence of Rudra, Indra, Upendra, the moon, the leading brahmins, the fire and the heaven-dwellers comes from the sun. He is the soul of all. He is the lord of all worlds. He alone is Mahadeva, PrajS- pati and the lord of the three worlds. He is the originai great deity. Everything originates from him and dissolves in him.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मनुको उत्पन्न किया। राजने यम, यमुना तता
verses.wordMeaning: The entire universe including Devas, Asuras and human beings originates from him. He is the lustre of all lumi- naries and the universal refulgence. The refulgence of Rudra, Indra, Upendra, the moon, the leading brahmins, the fire and the heaven-dwellers comes from the sun.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The entire universe including Devas, Asuras and human beings originates from him. He is the lustre of all lumi- naries and the universal refulgence. The refulgence of Rudra, Indra, Upendra, the moon, the leading brahmins, the fire and the heaven-dwellers comes from the sun.…

verses.sanskrit: द्युतिर्द्युतिमतां कृत्स्नं यत्तेजः सर्वलौकिकम् सर्वात्मा सर्वलोकेशो महादेवः प्रजापतिः
verses.transliteration: dyutirdyutimatāṃ kṛtsnaṃ yattejaḥ sarvalaukikam sarvātmā sarvalokeśo mahādevaḥ prajāpatiḥ
verses.translation: The existence and non-existence of the worlds origi- nated from the sun formerly. O brahmins, this refulgent sun of great lustre is an incomprehensible planet.
verses.hindi: रेवतको जन्म दिया। प्रभाने सूर्यसे प्रभातको क  दिया। संज्ञाने ही छायाको अपने स्थानपर नियोजित
verses.wordMeaning: The existence and non-existence of the worlds origi- nated from the sun formerly. O brahmins, this refulgent sun of great lustre is an incomprehensible planet.
verses.commentary: Sense: The existence and non-existence of the worlds origi- nated from the sun formerly. O brahmins, this refulgent sun of great lustre is an incomprehensible planet.

verses.sanskrit: सूर्य एव त्रिलोकेशो मूलं परमदैवतम् ततः संजायते सर्वं तत्रैव प्रविलीयते
verses.transliteration: sūrya eva trilokeśo mūlaṃ paramadaivatam tataḥ saṃjāyate sarvaṃ tatraiva pravilīyate
verses.translation: All these units of time begin from him and end in him again and again, viz., k§anas (moments), muhurtas. a unit of 48 mts.), days, nights, fortnights, months, years, seasons and yugas. Hence without the sun there is no reckoning of time.
verses.hindi: हे द्विजो! छायाने उन सूर्यसे सावर्णि मनु, शनि, तपती तथा विष्टिको यथाक्रम जन्म दिया। छाया आपने पुत्र सावर्णि मनुसे अधिक स्नेह करती थी। पूर्व मनु (वैवस्वत मनु) तो इसे सहन कर गये, पर क्रोधसे
verses.wordMeaning: All these units of time begin from him and end in him again and again, viz., k§anas (moments), muhurtas. a unit of 48 mts.), days, nights, fortnights, months, years, seasons and yugas. Hence without the sun there is no reckoning of time.
verses.commentary: Sense: All these units of time begin from him and end in him again and again, viz., k§anas (moments), muhurtas. a unit of 48 mts.), days, nights, fortnights, months, years, seasons and yugas. Hence without the sun there is no reckoning of time.

verses.sanskrit: भावाभावौ हि लोकानाम् आदित्यान्निःसृतौ पुरा अविज्ञेयो ग्रहो विप्रा दीप्तिमान्सुप्रभो रविः
verses.transliteration: bhāvābhāvau hi lokānām ādityānniḥsṛtau purā avijñeyo graho viprā dīptimānsuprabho raviḥ
verses.translation: Without Kaia (time) there is no order, no initia- tion, no daily ritual. How can there be the division of the sea- sons? Whence afe these flowers, roots and fruits? Whence is the outcome of plants? How can there be the different kinds of grass and medicinal plants? The dealings of the creatures in heaven and here too will be non-existent without the sun who is the form of Rudra, the scorcher of the universe. He alone is time, fire, Dvadasatman (one having twelve forms) and Praja- pati. O excellent brahmins, he scorches the three worlds includ- ing the mobile and immobile beings. He is the mine of splend- our. He is all in all, the whole set of worlds.
verses.hindi: विश्षुब्ध यम इसे सहन न कर सका और उसने क्रोधे अपना दाहिना पैर उठाकर छायापर प्रहार किया। तब छायाके शापसे यमका वह सुन्दर पैर खराब हो गया, वह मवाद तथा रक्तसे भर गया और कीड़ोंके समूहसे युक्त हो गया। तदनन्तर वह यम गोकर्णमें रहकर एक फलक (पटरे)-पर बैठकर केवल वायु
verses.wordMeaning: Without Kaia (time) there is no order, no initia- tion, no daily ritual. How can there be the division of the sea- sons? Whence afe these flowers,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Without Kaia (time) there is no order, no initia- tion, no daily ritual. How can there be the division of the sea- sons? Whence afe these flowers,…

verses.sanskrit: अत्र गच्छन्ति निधनं जायन्ते च पुनः पुनः क्षणा मुहूर्ता दिवसा निशाः पक्षाश् च कृत्स्नशः
verses.transliteration: atra gacchanti nidhanaṃ jāyante ca punaḥ punaḥ kṣaṇā muhūrtā divasā niśāḥ pakṣāś ca kṛtsnaśaḥ
verses.translation: Adopting the excellent path, he scorches the entire universe from the sides, from above and from below in the course of nights and days.
verses.hindi: पीता हुआ दस हजार वर्षोंतक महादेवजीकी आराधना करता रहा। शिवको कृपासे श्रेष्ठ लोकपालत्व तथा पितरोंका स्वामित्व प्राप्त करके उसने देवदेव शूल- पाणि (शिव)-के प्रभावसे शापसे मुक्ति प्राप्त
verses.wordMeaning: Adopting the excellent path, he scorches the entire universe from the sides, from above and from below in the course of nights and days.
verses.commentary: Sense: Adopting the excellent path, he scorches the entire universe from the sides, from above and from below in the course of nights and days.

verses.sanskrit: मासाः संवत्सरश्चैव ऋतवो ऽथ युगानि च तदादित्यादृते ह्येषा कालसंख्या न विद्यते
verses.transliteration: māsāḥ saṃvatsaraścaiva ṛtavo 'tha yugāni ca tadādityādṛte hyeṣā kālasaṃkhyā na vidyate
verses.translation: If a bright lamp is hung in the middle of the house, it dispels darkness from the sides, the portion above and the portion below, at the same time.
verses.hindi: पूर्वकालमें सूर्यके तेजोमय रूपको सहन न करती हुई त्वष्टाकी शुभ कन्या संज्ञाने अपने शरीरसे दूसरी छाया नामक स्त्रीकी रचना की और वह सुव्रता स्वयं वडवा (घोड़ी)-का रूप धारणकर तप करने लगी। कुछ समयके बाद प्रयत्नपूर्वक छायाको संज्ञाकी प्रतिकृति जानकर छायापति प्रभु सूर्यने घोड़ेका रूप धारणकर उस वडवारूपधारिणी संज्ञाके साथ रमण किया। तब घोड़ीके रूपवाली त्वष्टापुत्री संज्ञाने उन सूर्यसे देवस्वरूप दोनों
verses.wordMeaning: If a bright lamp is hung in the middle of the house, it dispels darkness from the sides, the portion above and the portion below, at the same time.
verses.commentary: Sense: If a bright lamp is hung in the middle of the house, it dispels darkness from the sides, the portion above and the portion below, at the same time.

verses.sanskrit: कालादृते न नियमो न दीक्षा नाह्निकक्रमः ऋतूनां च विभागश् च पुष्पं मूलं फलं कुतः
verses.transliteration: kālādṛte na niyamo na dīkṣā nāhnikakramaḥ ṛtūnāṃ ca vibhāgaś ca puṣpaṃ mūlaṃ phalaṃ kutaḥ
verses.translation: In the same manner the thousand-rayed sun, the king of planets, the lord of the*universe, illuminates the entire universe by means of his rays.
verses.hindi: अश्विनीकुमारोंको जन्म दिया; वे देवताओंके श्रेष्ठ वैद्य थे
verses.wordMeaning: In the same manner the thousand-rayed sun, the king of planets, the lord of the*universe, illuminates the entire universe by means of his rays.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the same manner the thousand-rayed sun, the king of planets, the lord of the*universe, illuminates the entire universe by means of his rays.

verses.sanskrit: कुतः सस्यविनिष्पत्तिस् तृणौषधिगणो ऽपि च अभावो व्यवहाराणां जन्तूनां दिवि चेह च
verses.transliteration: kutaḥ sasyaviniṣpattis tṛṇauṣadhigaṇo 'pi ca abhāvo vyavahārāṇāṃ jantūnāṃ divi ceha ca
verses.translation: Seven rays, that are the source of origin of the planets
verses.hindi: उसके बाद महान् आत्मावाले संज्ञापिता त्वष्टा ने सूर्यको खरादा। भगवान् त्वष्टाने रुद्रकी कृपासे सूर्यके मण्डलसे विष्णुके चक्रका निर्माण किया, जो
verses.wordMeaning: Seven rays, that are the source of origin of the planets
verses.commentary: Sense: Seven rays, that are the source of origin of the planets

verses.sanskrit: जगत्प्रतापनमृते भास्करं रुद्ररूपिणम् स एष कालश्चाग्निश् च द्वादशात्मा प्रजापतिः
verses.transliteration: jagatpratāpanamṛte bhāskaraṃ rudrarūpiṇam sa eṣa kālaścāgniś ca dvādaśātmā prajāpatiḥ
verses.translation: They are Suumna, HarikeSa VKvakarman, ViiSva- vyacas, Sannaddha, Sarvavasu and Svarat*
verses.hindi: पैरसे यमके द्वारा मारे जानेपर वह छाया दुःखित
verses.wordMeaning: They are Suumna, HarikeSa VKvakarman, ViiSva- vyacas, Sannaddha, Sarvavasu and Svarat*
verses.commentary: Sense: They are Suumna, HarikeSa VKvakarman, ViiSva- vyacas, Sannaddha, Sarvavasu and Svarat*

verses.sanskrit: तपत्येष द्विजश्रेष्ठास् त्रैलोक्यं सचराचरम् स एष तेजसां राशिः समस्तः सार्वलौकिकः
verses.transliteration: tapatyeṣa dvijaśreṣṭhās trailokyaṃ sacarācaram sa eṣa tejasāṃ rāśiḥ samastaḥ sārvalaukikaḥ
verses.translation: Harikea which is in front (in the cast) is glorified as the source of origin of constellations.**®® In the south, the ray Vivakarma develops Budha (Mercury). The ray Vi§vavyacas which is in the west (behind) is the source of origin of Sukra (Venus). The ray Sannaddha is the source of origin of Mars. The ray Sarvavasu is the source of origin of Brhaspati (Jupiter). The ray Svarat nourishes!§anaicara (Saturn). Thus it is due to the power of the sun that the constellations, planets and stars are seen in the heaven. This entire universe is sustained by him. The constellations are called Nakatras. The word is derived from -/ksi with the prohibitive particle 'na' i.c. na klyante (i.c. those which do not perish).

verses.sanskrit: न्यगूर्ध्वाधः प्रचारो ऽस्य सुषुम्नः परिकीर्तितः हरिकेशः पुरस्ताद् यो ऋक्षयोनिः प्रकीर्त्यते
verses.transliteration: nyagūrdhvādhaḥ pracāro 'sya suṣumnaḥ parikīrtitaḥ harikeśaḥ purastād yo ṛkṣayoniḥ prakīrtyate

verses.hindi: सोमवंशकी वृद्धे लिये वे मनृपुत्र श्रीमान् सुद्युम्न सत्रीत्वको प्राप्त हुए। इक्ष्वाकुके अश्वमेधके समय वह इला किंपुरुष (पुरुष रूपवाली) हो गयी थी। वह इला किंपुरुष हो जानेपर ' सुद्युम्न'-इस नामसे कही जाती

verses.sanskrit: दक्षिणे विश्वकर्मा च रश्मिर्वर्धयते बुधम् विश्वव्यचास्तु यः पश्चाच् छुक्रयोनिः स्मृतो बुधैः
verses.transliteration: dakṣiṇe viśvakarmā ca raśmirvardhayate budham viśvavyacāstu yaḥ paścāc chukrayoniḥ smṛto budhaiḥ

The ray Vi§vavyacas which is in the west (behind) is the source of origin of Sukra (Venus). The ray Sannaddha is the source of origin of Mars. The word is derived from -/ksi with the prohibitive particle 'na' i.c. na klyante (i.c. those which do not perish).
verses.hindi: वह इला एक महीनेतक वीर पुरुषके रूपमें और पुनः एक महीनेतक स्त्रीके रूपमें रहती थी। वह चन्द्रमाके पुत्र बुके भवनमें रहने लगी। अवसर पाकर वह बुधके साथ मैथुनके लिये तत्पर हुई। तब सोमपुत्र बुध और इलासे पुरूरवा उत्पन्न हुए; जो सोमवंशमें प्रथम उत्पन्न होने वाले, बुद्धिमान, शिवभक्त तथा प्रतापी थे। है तपोधनो ! अब इसके बाद मैं इक्ष्वाकुवंशके विस्तारका वर्णन करूँगा॥ २३--२५॥

verses.sanskrit: संनद्धश् च तु यो रश्मिः स योनिर् लोहितस्य तु षष्ठः सर्वावसू रश्मिः स योनिस्तु बृहस्पतेः
verses.transliteration: saṃnaddhaś ca tu yo raśmiḥ sa yonir lohitasya tu ṣaṣṭhaḥ sarvāvasū raśmiḥ sa yonistu bṛhaspateḥ
verses.translation: Harikea which is in front (in the cast) is glorified as the source of origin of constellations.**®® In the south, the ray Vivakarma develops Budha (Mercury). The ray Vi§vavyacas which is in the west (behind) is the source of origin of Sukra (Venus). The ray Sannaddha is the source of origin of Mars. The ray Sarvavasu is the source of origin of Brhaspati (Jupiter). The ray Svarat nourishes!§anaicara (Saturn). verses.hindi: हे उत्तम द्विजो! उन सुद्युम्नके तीन पुत्र हुए उत्कल, गय तथा विनताश्व। उत्कलका उत्कल नामक राष्ट्र था और विनताश्वका पश्चिमी प्रदेश था। गयकी गया नामक परम सुन्दर पुरी कही
verses.wordMeaning: Harikea which is in front (in the cast) is glorified as the source of origin of constellations.**®® In the south, the ray Vivakarma develops Budha (Mercury). The ray Vi§vavyacas which is in the west (behind) is the source of origin of Sukra (Venus).…

verses.sanskrit: शनैश्चरं पुनश् चापि रश्मिर् आप्यायते स्वराट् एवं सूर्यप्रभावेन नक्षत्रग्रहतारकाः
verses.transliteration: śanaiścaraṃ punaś cāpi raśmir āpyāyate svarāṭ evaṃ sūryaprabhāvena nakṣatragrahatārakāḥ

The ray Vi§vavyacas which is in the west (behind) is the source of origin of Sukra (Venus). The ray Sannaddha is the source of origin of Mars. The ray Sarvavasu is the source of origin of Brhaspati (Jupiter). The ray Svarat nourishes!§anaicara (Saturn). Thus it is due to the power of the sun that the constellations, planets and stars are seen in the heaven. This entire universe is sustained by him. The constellations are called Nakatras. The word is derived from -/ksi with the prohibitive particle 'na' i.c. na klyante (i.c. those which do not perish).
verses.hindi: गयी है, जिसमें देवताओं तथा पितरोंको स्थिति सर्वदा रहती है॥ २६-२७/२॥ इक्ष्वाकुके ज्येष्ठ पुत्रने मध्यदेश प्राप्त किया। कन्या प्रकृतिवाले होनेके कारण महातेजस्वी सुद्युम्न अपना भाग नहीं पा सके; किंतु वसिष्ठके कहनेसे
verses.wordMeaning: Harikea which is in front (in the cast) is glorified as the source of origin of constellations.**®® In the south, the ray Vivakarma develops Budha (Mercury). The ray Vi§vavyacas which is in the west (behind) is the source of origin of Sukra (Venus).…

verses.sanskrit: दृश्यन्ते दिवि ताः सर्वाः विश्वं चेदं पुनर्जगत् न क्षीयन्ते यतस्तानि तस्मान्नक्षत्रता स्मृता
verses.transliteration: dṛśyante divi tāḥ sarvāḥ viśvaṃ cedaṃ punarjagat na kṣīyante yatastāni tasmānnakṣatratā smṛtā
verses.translation: Harikea which is in front (in the cast) is glorified as the source of origin of constellations.**®® In the south, the ray Vivakarma develops Budha (Mercury). The ray Vi§vavyacas which is in the west (behind) is the source of origin of Sukra (Venus). The ray Sannaddha is the source of origin of Mars. verses.hindi: प्रतिष्ठानपुरमें धर्मराज महात्मा सुद्युम्नको प्रतिष्ठा स्थापित
verses.wordMeaning: Harikea which is in front (in the cast) is glorified as the source of origin of constellations.**®® In the south, the ray Vivakarma develops Budha (Mercury). The ray Vi§vavyacas which is in the west (behind) is the source of origin of Sukra (Venus).…

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीलिङ्गमहापुराणे पूर्वभागे षष्टितमो ऽध्यायः क्षेत्राण्येतानि सर्वाणि आतपन्ति गभस्तिभिः तेषां क्षेत्राण्यथादत्ते सूर्यो नक्षत्रतारकाः
verses.transliteration: iti śrīliṅgamahāpurāṇe pūrvabhāge ṣaṣṭitamo 'dhyāyaḥ kṣetrāṇyetāni sarvāṇi ātapanti gabhastibhiḥ teṣāṃ kṣetrāṇyathādatte sūryo nakṣatratārakāḥ
verses.translation: All these are the abodes which blaze by means of solar rays. The constellations and stars are the abodes to be attained by merits. They arc called Tarakas because they enable people to cross the ocean of worldly existence and also because they arc white.
verses.hindi: मानवेयो महाभागः स्त्रीपुंसोर्लक्षणान्वितः।  हुई और स्त्री-पुरुषके लक्षणोंसे युक्त, महायशस्वी तथा इक्ष्वाकोरभवद्वीरी वकिकुक्षिर्धर्मवित्तमः ॥ १  महाभाग्यशाली मनृपुत्र सुद्युम्न-ने राज्य प्राप्त करके उसे पुरूरवाको दे दिया॥ २८--३०१/, ॥
verses.wordMeaning: All these are the abodes which blaze by means of solar rays. The constellations and stars are the abodes to be attained by merits. They arc called Tarakas because they enable people to cross the ocean of worldly existence and also because they arc white.

verses.sanskrit: चीर्णेन सुकृतेनेह सुकृतान्ते ग्रहाश्रयाः तारणात्तारका ह्येताः शुक्लत्वाच्चैव तारकाः
verses.transliteration: cīrṇena sukṛteneha sukṛtānte grahāśrayāḥ tāraṇāttārakā hyetāḥ śuklatvāccaiva tārakāḥ
verses.translation: The sun is called Aditya because he takes up the divine and terrestrial splendours as well as the nocturnal darkness.
verses.hindi: सौ पुत्रोंवाले इक्ष्वाकुके ज्येष्ठ पुत्र विकुक्षि थे; वे महान् धर्मज्ञ थे। उनके पचास पुत्र हुए; उनमें ककुत्स्थ सबसे बड़े थे। ककुत्स्थसे सुयोधन उत्पन्न हुए। है श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! उन सुयोधन-से पृथु और पृथुसे विश्वक
verses.wordMeaning: The sun is called Aditya because he takes up the divine and terrestrial splendours as well as the nocturnal darkness.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sun is called Aditya because he takes up the divine and terrestrial splendours as well as the nocturnal darkness.

verses.sanskrit: दिव्यानां पार्थिवानां च नैशानां चैव सर्वशः आदानान्नित्यमादित्यस् तेजसां तमसामपि
verses.transliteration: divyānāṃ pārthivānāṃ ca naiśānāṃ caiva sarvaśaḥ ādānānnityamādityas tejasāṃ tamasāmapi
verses.translation: The principal seven rays, Susumna etc., of the thousand-rayed tun are the source of energy and movement of stars, planets and constella- tions. For instance, the solar ray, called Susumna, causes the movement of the moon.
verses.hindi: उत्पन्न हुए। विश्वकके पुत्र बुद्धिमान् आर्द्रक थे और उनके पुत्र युवनाश्व थे। है श्रेष्ठ द्विजो! उनके पुत्र महातेजस्वी शाबस्ति थे, जिन्होंने गौड़देशमें शाबस्ती नगरीका निर्माण किया। उनसे वंशक नामक पुत्र उत्पन्न हुए और वंश वंशक-से बृहदश्व हुए।
verses.wordMeaning: The principal seven rays, Susumna etc., of the thousand-rayed tun are the source of energy and movement of stars, planets and constella- tions. For instance, the solar ray, called Susumna, causes the movement of the moon.
verses.commentary: Sense: The principal seven rays, Susumna etc., of the thousand-rayed tun are the source of energy and movement of stars, planets and constella- tions. For instance, the solar ray, called Susumna, causes the movement of the moon.

verses.sanskrit: सवने स्यन्दने ऽर्थे च धातुर् एष विभाष्यते सवनात्तेजसो ऽपां च तेनासौ सविता मतः
verses.transliteration: savane syandane 'rthe ca dhātur eṣa vibhāṣyate savanāttejaso 'pāṃ ca tenāsau savitā mataḥ
verses.translation: dakfiSm rfilim i.e. the moon. The LiAgapura describes vividly the respective fimedons of the seven solar rays.
verses.hindi: ततः पुुर्मुनिश्रेष्ठा विश्वकः पार्थिवस्तथा। विश्वकस्यार्द्रंको धीमान् युवनाश्वस्तु तत्सुतः
verses.wordMeaning: dakfiSm rfilim i.e. the moon. The LiAgapura describes vividly the respective fimedons of the seven solar rays.
verses.commentary: Sense: dakfiSm rfilim i.e. the moon. The LiAgapura describes vividly the respective fimedons of the seven solar rays.

verses.sanskrit: बहुलश्चन्द्र इत्येष ह्लादने धातुरुच्यते शुक्लत्वे चामृतत्वे च शीतत्वे च विभाव्यते
verses.transliteration: bahulaścandra ityeṣa hlādane dhāturucyate śuklatve cāmṛtatve ca śītatve ca vibhāvyate
verses.translation: The root is used in two meanings to extract juice or to flow. Since the sun extracts refulgence and makes water flow» it is called Savitr.
verses.hindi: धुन्धुमारस्य तनयास्त्रयस्त्रैलोक्यविश्रुताः। धुन्धुमारके तीन पुत्र हुए, जो तीनों लोकोंमें प्रसिद्ध थे;
verses.wordMeaning: The root is used in two meanings to extract juice or to flow. Since the sun extracts refulgence and makes water flow» it is called Savitr.
verses.commentary: Sense: The root is used in two meanings to extract juice or to flow. Since the sun extracts refulgence and makes water flow» it is called Savitr.

verses.sanskrit: सूर्याचन्द्रमसोर्दिव्ये मण्डले भास्वरे खगे जलतेजोमये शुक्ले वृत्तकुंभनिभे शुभे
verses.transliteration: sūryācandramasordivye maṇḍale bhāsvare khage jalatejomaye śukle vṛttakuṃbhanibhe śubhe
verses.translation: The root *cadi' from which the word Gandra is derived means *to delight'. It implies whiteness, chillness, and nectarine nature of the moon (Gandra).
verses.hindi: गये हैं। दृढ़ाश्वके पुत्र प्रमोद और उनके पुत्र हर्यश्व थे। हर्यश्वके पुत्र निकुम्भ और उन निकुम्भ-के पुत्र संहताश्व थे। संहताश्वके कृशाश्व तथा रणाश्व  नामक दो पुत्र थे। रणाश्वके पुत्र युवनाश्व थे और उन
verses.wordMeaning: The root *cadi' from which the word Gandra is derived means *to delight'. It implies whiteness, chillness, and nectarine nature of the moon (Gandra).
verses.commentary: Sense: The root *cadi' from which the word Gandra is derived means *to delight'. It implies whiteness, chillness, and nectarine nature of the moon (Gandra).

verses.sanskrit: घनतोयात्मकं तत्र मण्डलं शशिनः स्मृतम् घनतेजोमयं शुक्लं मण्डलं भास्करस्य तु
verses.transliteration: ghanatoyātmakaṃ tatra maṇḍalaṃ śaśinaḥ smṛtam ghanatejomayaṃ śuklaṃ maṇḍalaṃ bhāskarasya tu
verses.translation: The divine discs of the sun and the moon are refulgent. They move in the sky. They are white and arc of the nature of fire and water. They arc splendid and they resemble a circular pot.
verses.hindi: युवनाश्व-के पुत्र मान्धाता थे। मान्धाताके तीन पुत्र मुचुकुन्दश्च पुण्यात्मा त्रयस्त्रैलोक्यविश्रुताः
verses.wordMeaning: The divine discs of the sun and the moon are refulgent. They move in the sky. They are white and arc of the nature of fire and water. They arc splendid and they resemble a circular pot.
verses.commentary: Sense: The divine discs of the sun and the moon are refulgent. They move in the sky. They are white and arc of the nature of fire and water. They arc splendid and they resemble a circular pot.

verses.sanskrit: वसन्ति सर्वदेवाश् च स्थानान्येतानि सर्वशः मन्वन्तरेषु सर्वेषु ऋक्षसूर्यग्रहाश्रयाः
verses.transliteration: vasanti sarvadevāś ca sthānānyetāni sarvaśaḥ manvantareṣu sarveṣu ṛkṣasūryagrahāśrayāḥ
verses.translation: The disc of the moon is of the nature of dense water. The disc of the sun is white and is of the nature of dense fire.
verses.hindi: अध्याय ६५  सूर्यवंश तथा चन्द्रवंशका वर्णन एवं शिवभक्त तण्डीप्रोक्त रुद्रसहस्त्रनाम २७९
verses.wordMeaning: The disc of the moon is of the nature of dense water. The disc of the sun is white and is of the nature of dense fire.
verses.commentary: Sense: The disc of the moon is of the nature of dense water. The disc of the sun is white and is of the nature of dense fire.

verses.sanskrit: तेन ग्रहा गृहाण्येव तदाख्यास्ते भवन्ति च सौरं सूर्यो ऽविशत्स्थानं सौम्यं सोमस्तथैव च
verses.transliteration: tena grahā gṛhāṇyeva tadākhyāste bhavanti ca sauraṃ sūryo 'viśatsthānaṃ saumyaṃ somastathaiva ca
verses.translation: Devas reside in constellations, sun and planets. They live everywhere in these abodes in all the manvantaras.
verses.hindi: अम्बरीषस्य दायादो युवनाश्वोऽपरः स्मृतः । तीनों लोकोंमें विख्यात थे। अम्बरीषके पुत्र युवनाश्व हरितो युवनाश्वस्य हरितास्तु यतः स्मृताः ॥ ४०  द्वितीय बताये गये हैं। युवनाश्वके पुत्र हरित थे, जिनसे एते ह्यङ्गिरसः पक्षे क्षत्रोपेता द्विजातयः। उत्पन्न सभी पुत्र "हरित' नामवाले कहे गये हैं। ये पुरुकुत्सस्य दायादस्त्रसहस्युर्महायशाः ॥ ४१  रन अंगिराके वंशके ब्राह्मण थे, किन्तु क्षेत्रिय- विष्णुवृद्धः सुतस्तस्य विष्णुवृद्धा यतः स्मृताः ॥ ४२ पुरुकुत्सके पुत्र महायशस्वी त्रसहस्यु थे। उनके पुत्र सम्भूति थे, जो नर्मदाके गर्भसे उत्पन्न हुए थे। उन एते ह्यङ्गिरसः पक्षे क्षत्रोपेताः समाश्रिताः। सम्भूति-के पुत्र विष्णुवृद्ध थे। विष्णुवृद्धके सभी सम्भूतिरपरं पुत्रमनरण्यमजीजनत्
verses.wordMeaning: Devas reside in constellations, sun and planets. They live everywhere in these abodes in all the manvantaras.
verses.commentary: Sense: Devas reside in constellations, sun and planets. They live everywhere in these abodes in all the manvantaras.

verses.sanskrit: शौक्रं शुक्रो ऽविशत्स्थानं षोडशार्चिः प्रतापवान् बृहद् बृहस्पतिश्चैव लोहितश्चैव लोहितम्
verses.transliteration: śaukraṃ śukro 'viśatsthānaṃ ṣoḍaśārciḥ pratāpavān bṛhad bṛhaspatiścaiva lohitaścaiva lohitam
verses.translation: Hence the planets arc abodes named after their respec- tive planets. The Sun entered the abode Saura. The Moon entered the abode Saumya.
verses.hindi: वंशज विष्णुवृद्ध नामवाले कहे गये हैं। ये सब भी रावणेन हतो योऽसौ त्रैलोक्यविजये द्विजाः। अंगिराके वंशमें ब्राह्मण थे, किंतु क्षत्रिय-स्वभावसे बुहदश्वोऽनरण्यस्य हर्यश्वस्तस्य चात्मजः॥ ४४ युक्त थे। है द्विजो! सम्भूतिने अनरण्य नामक दूसरे
verses.wordMeaning: Hence the planets arc abodes named after their respec- tive planets. The Sun entered the abode Saura. The Moon entered the abode Saumya.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence the planets arc abodes named after their respec- tive planets. The Sun entered the abode Saura. The Moon entered the abode Saumya.

verses.sanskrit: शनैश्चरं तथा स्थानं देवश्चापि शनैश्चरः बौधं बुधस्तु स्वर्भानुः स्वर्भानुस्थानमाश्रितः
verses.transliteration: śanaiścaraṃ tathā sthānaṃ devaścāpi śanaiścaraḥ baudhaṃ budhastu svarbhānuḥ svarbhānusthānamāśritaḥ
verses.translation: Venus entered the abode Saukra. Jupiter, the valorous with sixteen rays entered the abode Bfhad (big). The Mars entered the abode Lohita pertaining to Mars.
verses.hindi: पुत्रको उत्पन्न किया, जो त्रैलोक्य-विजयके समय तस्य पुत्रोऽभवद्राजा त्रिधन्वा भवभावितः रावणके द्वारा मार दिये गये। अनरण्यके पुत्र बृहदश्व और बृहदश्वके पुत्र हर्यश्व थे। हर्यश्वसे उनको पत्नी दृषद्वतीके गर्भसे राजा 'वसुमना' उत्पन्न हुए। उनके त्रिधन्वा नामक पुत्र हुए; वे शिवभक्त थे। उन
verses.wordMeaning: Venus entered the abode Saukra. Jupiter, the valorous with sixteen rays entered the abode Bfhad (big). The Mars entered the abode Lohita pertaining to Mars.
verses.commentary: Sense: Venus entered the abode Saukra. Jupiter, the valorous with sixteen rays entered the abode Bfhad (big). The Mars entered the abode Lohita pertaining to Mars.

verses.sanskrit: नक्षत्राणि च सर्वाणि नक्षत्राणि विशन्ति च गृहाण्येतानि सर्वाणि ज्योतींषि सुकृतात्मनाम्
verses.transliteration: nakṣatrāṇi ca sarvāṇi nakṣatrāṇi viśanti ca gṛhāṇyetāni sarvāṇi jyotīṃṣi sukṛtātmanām
verses.translation: The Saturn entered the abode Sanaicara. The Mer- cury entered the abode Baudha. The evil planet Rahu entered the abode Svarbhwu (named after him).
verses.hindi: प्रतापी तथा शिवभक्तने ब्रह्माके पुत्र तण्डीको कृपासे उनकी शिष्यता प्राप्त करके और उनकी आज्ञासे हजार अश्वमेधका फल प्राप्तकर गणोंके स्वामीका पद ग्रहण कर लिया था। “मैं अश्वमेध कैसे करूँ'-किसी
verses.wordMeaning: The Saturn entered the abode Sanaicara. The Mer- cury entered the abode Baudha. The evil planet Rahu entered the abode Svarbhwu (named after him).
verses.commentary: Sense: The Saturn entered the abode Sanaicara. The Mer- cury entered the abode Baudha. The evil planet Rahu entered the abode Svarbhwu (named after him).

verses.sanskrit: कल्पादौ सम्प्रवृत्तानि निर्मितानि स्वयंभुवा स्थानान्येतानि तिष्ठन्ति यावद् आभूतसंप्लवम्
verses.transliteration: kalpādau sampravṛttāni nirmitāni svayaṃbhuvā sthānānyetāni tiṣṭhanti yāvad ābhūtasaṃplavam
verses.translation: The deities of constellations entered all these abodes. These luminaries are the abodes of meritorious souls.
verses.hindi: समय ऐसा सोचते हुए उन धनहीन धर्मात्मा  त्रिधन्वा - ने ब्रह्माके पुत्र तण्डी नामक ब्राह्मणको देखा और हे श्रेष्ठ ब्राह्मणो ! रुद्रसहस्रनामको उनसे प्राप्त कर लिया। पूर्वकालमें ब्रह्माजीने तण्डीको रुद्रसह्रनाम बताया था; उसी सहस्रनामसे महेश्वरकी स्तुति करके ब्रह्माजीके
verses.wordMeaning: The deities of constellations entered all these abodes. These luminaries are the abodes of meritorious souls.
verses.commentary: Sense: The deities of constellations entered all these abodes. These luminaries are the abodes of meritorious souls.

verses.sanskrit: मन्वन्तरेषु सर्वेषु देवस्थानानि तानि वै अभिमानिनो ऽवतिष्ठन्ते देवाः स्थानं पुनः पुनः
verses.transliteration: manvantareṣu sarveṣu devasthānāni tāni vai abhimānino 'vatiṣṭhante devāḥ sthānaṃ punaḥ punaḥ
verses.translation: These abodes have been created by the self born deity. They began to function at the beginning of kalpa and they stay until all the living beings are dissolved.
verses.hindi: तदनन्तर पूर्वकालमें तण्डीके द्वारा बताये गये रुद्र सहस्रनामको ग्रहण करके राजा त्रिधन्वा-ने भी
verses.wordMeaning: These abodes have been created by the self born deity. They began to function at the beginning of kalpa and they stay until all the living beings are dissolved.
verses.commentary: Sense: These abodes have been created by the self born deity. They began to function at the beginning of kalpa and they stay until all the living beings are dissolved.

verses.sanskrit: अतीतैस्तु सहैतानि भाव्याभाव्यैः सुरैः सह वर्तन्ते वर्तमानैश् च स्थानिभिस्तैः सुरैः सह
verses.transliteration: atītaistu sahaitāni bhāvyābhāvyaiḥ suraiḥ saha vartante vartamānaiś ca sthānibhistaiḥ suraiḥ saha
verses.translation: In all the manvantaras they alone are the abodes of Devas. These deities who have identified themselves with the abodes occupy these divine abodes again and again.
verses.hindi: ऋषिगण बोले --ब्रह्माके पुत्र तण्डीके द्वारा कहा गया रुद्रसहस्रनाम समग्र वेदार्थोंसे परिपूर्ण है; है सूतजी ! हे सुब्रत! उस उत्तम सहखनामको कृपा करके हम विप्रोंको बताइये सूतजी बोले- है सुब्रतो ! है श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! सभी प्राणियोंके आत्मस्वरूप तथा अमित तेजवाले रूद्रके एक
verses.wordMeaning: In all the manvantaras they alone are the abodes of Devas. These deities who have identified themselves with the abodes occupy these divine abodes again and again.
verses.commentary: Sense: In all the manvantaras they alone are the abodes of Devas. These deities who have identified themselves with the abodes occupy these divine abodes again and again.

verses.sanskrit: अस्मिन्मन्वन्तरे चैव ग्रहा वैमानिकाः स्मृताः विवस्वानदितेः पुत्रः सूर्यो वैवस्वते ऽन्तरे
verses.transliteration: asminmanvantare caiva grahā vaimānikāḥ smṛtāḥ vivasvānaditeḥ putraḥ sūryo vaivasvate 'ntare
verses.translation: They occupy these abodes along with Devas of the past, present and future. In this current manvantara the planets are moving about in aerial chariots.
verses.hindi: प्रसादाद् ब्रह्मसूनोवै तण्डिनः प्राप्य शिष्यताम्। अश्वमेधसहस्रस्य फलं प्राप्य तदाज्ञया
verses.wordMeaning: They occupy these abodes along with Devas of the past, present and future. In this current manvantara the planets are moving about in aerial chariots.
verses.commentary: Sense: They occupy these abodes along with Devas of the past, present and future. In this current manvantara the planets are moving about in aerial chariots.

verses.sanskrit: द्युतिमानृषिपुत्रस्तु सोमो देवो वसुः स्मृतः शुक्रो देवस्तु विज्ञेयो भार्गवो ऽसुरयाजकः
verses.transliteration: dyutimānṛṣiputrastu somo devo vasuḥ smṛtaḥ śukro devastu vijñeyo bhārgavo 'surayājakaḥ
verses.translation: Thus the constellations and planets in the sim and the moon as also their abodes and the various deities occupying them have all been mentioned.
verses.hindi: कथं चैवाश्वमेधं वै करोमीति विचिन्तयन् धनहीनश्च धर्मात्मा दृष्टवान् ब्रह्मणः सुतम्। तण्डिसंज्ञं द्विजं तस्माल्लब्धवान् द्विजसत्तमाः
verses.wordMeaning: Thus the constellations and planets in the sim and the moon as also their abodes and the various deities occupying them have all been mentioned.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus the constellations and planets in the sim and the moon as also their abodes and the various deities occupying them have all been mentioned.

verses.sanskrit: बृहत्तेजाः स्मृतो देवो देवाचार्यो ऽङ्गिरःसुतः बुधो मनोहरश्चैव ऋषिपुत्रस्तु स स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: bṛhattejāḥ smṛto devo devācāryo 'ṅgiraḥsutaḥ budho manoharaścaiva ṛṣiputrastu sa smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: The fiery abode Saura belongs to the thousand-rayed Vivasvan. The abode of the snow-rayed moon is watery and white.
verses.hindi: नाम्नां सहस्त्रं रुद्रस्य ब्रह्मणा कथितं पुरा। तेन नाम्नां सहस्त्रेण स्तुत्वा तण्डिर्महेश्वरम्
verses.wordMeaning: The fiery abode Saura belongs to the thousand-rayed Vivasvan. The abode of the snow-rayed moon is watery and white.
verses.commentary: Sense: The fiery abode Saura belongs to the thousand-rayed Vivasvan. The abode of the snow-rayed moon is watery and white.

verses.sanskrit: शनैश्चरो विरूपस्तु संज्ञापुत्रो विवस्वतः अग्निर्विकेश्यां जज्ञे तु युवासौ लोहितार्चिषः
verses.transliteration: śanaiścaro virūpastu saṃjñāputro vivasvataḥ agnirvikeśyāṃ jajñe tu yuvāsau lohitārciṣaḥ
verses.translation: The abode of Budha (mercury) is watery, dark- coloured and charming. The region of Sukra (Venus) is also watery but white with sixteen rays.
verses.hindi: लब्धवान् गाणपत्यं च ब्रह्मयोनिर्द्विजोत्तमः। ततस्तस्मान्नृपो लब्ध्वा तण्डिना कथितं पुरा नाम्नां सहस्रं रुद्रस्य तण्डिना ब्रह्मयोनिना
verses.wordMeaning: The abode of Budha (mercury) is watery, dark- coloured and charming. The region of Sukra (Venus) is also watery but white with sixteen rays.
verses.commentary: Sense: The abode of Budha (mercury) is watery, dark- coloured and charming. The region of Sukra (Venus) is also watery but white with sixteen rays.

verses.sanskrit: नक्षत्रऋक्षनामिन्यो दाक्षायण्यस्तु ताः स्मृताः स्वर्भानुः सिंहिकापुत्रो भूतसंतापनो ऽसुरः
verses.transliteration: nakṣatraṛkṣanāminyo dākṣāyaṇyastu tāḥ smṛtāḥ svarbhānuḥ siṃhikāputro bhūtasaṃtāpano 'suraḥ
verses.translation: The abode of Bhauma (Mars) is reddish and it has nine rays. The abode of Bfhaspati (Jupiter) is yellow with sixteen rays and is very large.
verses.hindi: यज्जप्त्वा तु मुनिश्रेष्ठा गाणपत्यमवाप्तवान्।
verses.wordMeaning: The abode of Bhauma (Mars) is reddish and it has nine rays. The abode of Bfhaspati (Jupiter) is yellow with sixteen rays and is very large.
verses.commentary: Sense: The abode of Bhauma (Mars) is reddish and it has nine rays. The abode of Bfhaspati (Jupiter) is yellow with sixteen rays and is very large.

verses.sanskrit: सोमर्क्षग्रहसूर्येषु कीर्तितास्त्वभिमानिनः स्थानान्येतान्यथोक्तानि स्थानिन्यश्चैव देवताः
verses.transliteration: somarkṣagrahasūryeṣu kīrtitāstvabhimāninaḥ sthānānyetānyathoktāni sthāninyaścaiva devatāḥ
verses.translation: The abode Sani (Saturn) is black with eight rays. The abode of Svarbhanu (Rahu) is gloomy and is a place of great distress to living beings.
verses.hindi: सर्वात्मा सर्वविख्यातः सर्वः सर्वकरो भवः। श्मशानवासी भगवान् खचरो गोचरोऽर्दनः ।
verses.wordMeaning: The abode Sani (Saturn) is black with eight rays. The abode of Svarbhanu (Rahu) is gloomy and is a place of great distress to living beings.
verses.commentary: Sense: The abode Sani (Saturn) is black with eight rays. The abode of Svarbhanu (Rahu) is gloomy and is a place of great distress to living beings.

verses.sanskrit: सौरम् अग्निमयं स्थानं सहस्रांशोर्विवस्वतः हिमांशोस्तु स्मृतं स्थानम् अम्मयं शुक्लमेव च
verses.transliteration: sauram agnimayaṃ sthānaṃ sahasrāṃśorvivasvataḥ himāṃśostu smṛtaṃ sthānam ammayaṃ śuklameva ca
verses.translation: All the stars should be known as the abodes of sages with one ray each. They arc the resorts of men of meritorious renown and are white in colour.
verses.hindi: अभिवाद्यो महाकर्मा तपस्वी भूतधारणः
verses.wordMeaning: All the stars should be known as the abodes of sages with one ray each. They arc the resorts of men of meritorious renown and are white in colour.
verses.commentary: Sense: All the stars should be known as the abodes of sages with one ray each. They arc the resorts of men of meritorious renown and are white in colour.

verses.sanskrit: आप्यं श्यामं मनोज्ञं च बुधरश्मिगृहं स्मृतम् शुक्लस्याप्यम्मयं शुक्लं पदं षोडशरश्मिवत्
verses.transliteration: āpyaṃ śyāmaṃ manojñaṃ ca budharaśmigṛhaṃ smṛtam śuklasyāpyammayaṃ śuklaṃ padaṃ ṣoḍaśaraśmivat
verses.translation: They are of the nature of dense water (snow). They were created in the beginning of the kalpa. Thanks to the contact with the rays of the sun they have a shining appear- ance.
verses.hindi: उन्मत्तवेषः प्रच्छन्नः सर्वलोकः प्रजापतिः महारूपो महाकायः सर्वरूपो महायशाः
verses.wordMeaning: They are of the nature of dense water (snow). They were created in the beginning of the kalpa. Thanks to the contact with the rays of the sun they have a shining appear- ance.
verses.commentary: Sense: They are of the nature of dense water (snow). They were created in the beginning of the kalpa. Thanks to the contact with the rays of the sun they have a shining appear- ance.

verses.sanskrit: नवरश्मि तु भौमस्य लोहितं स्थानम् उत्तमम् हरिद्राभं बृहच्चापि षोडशार्चिर्बृहस्पतेः
verses.transliteration: navaraśmi tu bhaumasya lohitaṃ sthānam uttamam haridrābhaṃ bṛhaccāpi ṣoḍaśārcirbṛhaspateḥ
verses.translation: The diameter of the sun is nine thousand yojanas. The extent of its circular surface is three times that.
verses.hindi: लोकपालोऽन्तर्हितात्मा प्रसादोऽभयदो विभुः
verses.wordMeaning: The diameter of the sun is nine thousand yojanas. The extent of its circular surface is three times that.
verses.commentary: Sense: The diameter of the sun is nine thousand yojanas. The extent of its circular surface is three times that.

verses.sanskrit: अष्टरश्मिगृहं चापि प्रोक्तं कृष्णं शनैश्चरे स्वर्भानोस्तामसं स्थानं भूतसंतापनालयम्
verses.transliteration: aṣṭaraśmigṛhaṃ cāpi proktaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ śanaiścare svarbhānostāmasaṃ sthānaṃ bhūtasaṃtāpanālayam
verses.translation: The extent of the moon is twice that of the sun. Rfihu assumes a form equal to both of them and moves about beneath them.
verses.hindi: स्वयम्भूः सर्वकर्मा च आदिरादिकरो निधिः चन्द्रः सूर्यः शनिः केतुर्ग्रहो ग्रहपतिर्मतः
verses.wordMeaning: The extent of the moon is twice that of the sun. Rfihu assumes a form equal to both of them and moves about beneath them.
verses.commentary: Sense: The extent of the moon is twice that of the sun. Rfihu assumes a form equal to both of them and moves about beneath them.

verses.sanskrit: विज्ञेयास्तारकाः सर्वास् त्व् ऋषयस्त्वेकरश्मयः आश्रयाः पुण्यकीर्तीनां शुक्लाश्चापि स्ववर्णतः
verses.transliteration: vijñeyāstārakāḥ sarvās tv ṛṣayastvekaraśmayaḥ āśrayāḥ puṇyakīrtīnāṃ śuklāścāpi svavarṇataḥ
verses.translation: Vikeil*: The graha Bhauma (Mahgala) bom of Vikeilis here called agni (fire). Gf. agnir niardba{RV. 8.44.16) wherein Bhauma if called agni. Vikel! it one of the eigdit wivci of the eight-fixrmed (aftamurti) Rudra, others becali, Svavarcalft 'Um&, Sivi, SvShft, Dik, Dikfft and Rohinl.
verses.hindi: राजा राज्योदयः कर्ता मृगबाणार्पणो घनः
verses.wordMeaning: Vikeil*: The graha Bhauma (Mahgala) bom of Vikeilis here called agni (fire). Gf. agnir niardba{RV. 8.44.16) wherein Bhauma if called agni. Vikel! it one of the eigdit wivci of the eight-fixrmed (aftamurti) Rudra, others becali, Svavarcalft 'Um&, Sivi, SvShft, Dik,…

verses.sanskrit: घनतोयात्मिका ज्ञेयाः कल्पादावेव निर्मिताः आदित्यरश्मिसंयोगात् संप्रकाशात्मिकाः स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: ghanatoyātmikā jñeyāḥ kalpādāveva nirmitāḥ ādityaraśmisaṃyogāt saṃprakāśātmikāḥ smṛtāḥ
verses.translation: Mars and Saturn are a fourth less than Jupiter. In extent and width Mercury is a fourth less than these two.
verses.hindi: गणकर्ता गणपतिर्दिग्वासाः काम्य एव च अजश्च मृगरूपश्च तेजस्तेजस्करो विधि:
verses.wordMeaning: Mars and Saturn are a fourth less than Jupiter. In extent and width Mercury is a fourth less than these two.
verses.commentary: Sense: Mars and Saturn are a fourth less than Jupiter. In extent and width Mercury is a fourth less than these two.

verses.sanskrit: नवयोजनसाहस्रो विष्कंभः सवितुः स्मृतः त्रिगुणस्तस्य विस्तारो मण्डलस्य प्रमाणतः
verses.transliteration: navayojanasāhasro viṣkaṃbhaḥ savituḥ smṛtaḥ triguṇastasya vistāro maṇḍalasya pramāṇataḥ
verses.translation: The forms of those constellations and stars that are embodied are equal to Mercury in width and circular area.
verses.hindi: दीर्घश्च हरिकेशश्च सुतीर्थः कृष्ण एव च
verses.wordMeaning: The forms of those constellations and stars that are embodied are equal to Mercury in width and circular area.
verses.commentary: Sense: The forms of those constellations and stars that are embodied are equal to Mercury in width and circular area.

verses.sanskrit: द्विगुणः सूर्यविस्ताराद् विस्तारः शशिनः स्मृतः तुल्यस्तयोस्तु स्वर्भानुर् भूत्वाधस्तात्प्रसर्पति
verses.transliteration: dviguṇaḥ sūryavistārād vistāraḥ śaśinaḥ smṛtaḥ tulyastayostu svarbhānur bhūtvādhastātprasarpati
verses.translation: The constellations that are in conjunction with the moon are ordinarily known as Rksas. The spheres of the com- paratively smaller stars are five, four, three or two yojanas. Over all these there are clusters of still smaller stars which extend to only half a yojana in width. There is none smaller than this. Over and above these starry spheres are the three planets which move at a great distance from them. They should be known as slow moving ones. The speed of these has already been mentioned in due order.
verses.hindi: शृगालरूपः सर्वार्थो मुण्डः सर्वशुभङ्करः । सिंहशार्दूलरूपश्च गन्धकारी कपर्ट्रापि
verses.wordMeaning: The constellations that are in conjunction with the moon are ordinarily known as Rksas. The spheres of the com- paratively smaller stars are five, four, three or two yojanas. Over all these there are clusters of still smaller stars which extend to only half a yojana in width.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The constellations that are in conjunction with the moon are ordinarily known as Rksas. The spheres of the com- paratively smaller stars are five, four, three or two yojanas. Over all these there are clusters of still smaller stars which extend to only half a yojana in width.…

verses.sanskrit: उद्धृत्य पृथिवीछायां निर्मितां मण्डलाकृतिम् स्वर्भानोस्तु बृहत्स्थानं तृतीयं यत्तमोमयम्
verses.transliteration: uddhṛtya pṛthivīchāyāṃ nirmitāṃ maṇḍalākṛtim svarbhānostu bṛhatsthānaṃ tṛtīyaṃ yattamomayam
verses.translation: All the planets are born of constellations. O excellent sages, the sun, the son of Aditi, the first among the planets, is born of the constellation Viakha. The lustrous son of Dharma, lord Vasu, Soma (moon), the cool-rayed lord of the night, is born of the constellation Krttika. The sixteen-rayed son of Bhrgu, Sukra (Venus) who is the most excellent among the stars and planets after the sun, is born of the constellation Tisya. The planet Brhaspati (Jupiter), the twelve-rayed son of Angiras, the preceptor of the universe, is born of the cons- tellation Purvaphalguni.
verses.hindi: त्रिजटी चीरवासाश्च रुद्र: सेना पतिर्विभुः
verses.wordMeaning: All the planets are born of constellations. O excellent sages, the sun, the son of Aditi, the first among the planets, is born of the constellation Viakha. The lustrous son of Dharma, lord Vasu, Soma (moon), the cool-rayed lord of the night,…
verses.commentary: Sense: All the planets are born of constellations. O excellent sages, the sun, the son of Aditi, the first among the planets, is born of the constellation Viakha. The lustrous son of Dharma, lord Vasu, Soma (moon), the cool-rayed lord of the night,…

verses.sanskrit: आदित्यात्तच्च निष्क्रम्य समं गच्छति पर्वसु आदित्यमेति सोमाच्च पुनः सौरेषु पर्वसु
verses.transliteration: ādityāttacca niṣkramya samaṃ gacchati parvasu ādityameti somācca punaḥ saureṣu parvasu
verses.translation: The five-rayed planet Budha (Mercury) the son of the moon is born of the constellation Dhanistha.
verses.hindi: गजहा हैत्यहा कालो लोकधाता गुणाकरः कालयोगी महानादः सर्वावासश्चतुष्पथः
verses.wordMeaning: The five-rayed planet Budha (Mercury) the son of the moon is born of the constellation Dhanistha.
verses.commentary: Sense: The five-rayed planet Budha (Mercury) the son of the moon is born of the constellation Dhanistha.

verses.sanskrit: स्वर्भानुं नुदते यस्मात् तस्मात्स्वर्भानुरुच्यते चन्द्रस्य षोडशो भागो भार्गवस्य विधीयते
verses.transliteration: svarbhānuṃ nudate yasmāt tasmātsvarbhānurucyate candrasya ṣoḍaśo bhāgo bhārgavasya vidhīyate
verses.translation: Read Somam for samaxn.
verses.hindi: हजार आठ नामोंवाले स्तोत्रको सुनिये, जिसका जप करके
verses.wordMeaning: Read Somam for samaxn.
verses.commentary: Sense: Read Somam for samaxn.

verses.sanskrit: विष्कंभान्मण्डलाच्चैव योजनाग्रात्प्रमाणतः भार्गवात्पादहीनस्तु विज्ञेयो वै बृहस्पतिः
verses.transliteration: viṣkaṃbhānmaṇḍalāccaiva yojanāgrātpramāṇataḥ bhārgavātpādahīnastu vijñeyo vai bṛhaspatiḥ
verses.translation: It should be noted that the planets beginning with Bhargava (Venus) are known as star-planets (i.e planets re- sembling stars). Persons who are affected by afflictions from their birthday stars are liberated from that defect by devotion to their respective planets. Ainong all the planets the first one, it is said, is Aditya (Sun).
verses.hindi: सर्वात्मा, सर्वविख्यात, सर्व, सर्वकर, भव, जटी, दण्डी, भगवान्, खचर, गोचर, अर्दन, अभिवाद्य, महाकर्मा तपस्वी, भूतधारण, उन्मत्तवेष, प्रच्छन्न, सर्वलोक, प्रजापति, महारूप, महाकाय, सर्वरूप, महायश॥ ५४--५८ ॥

verses.sanskrit: बृहस्पतेः पादहीनौ वक्रसौरी उभौ स्मृतौ विस्तारान्मण्डलाच्चैव पादहीनस्तयोर्बुधः
verses.transliteration: bṛhaspateḥ pādahīnau vakrasaurī ubhau smṛtau vistārānmaṇḍalāccaiva pādahīnastayorbudhaḥ
verses.translation: Katia has the nimesa as its first unit of tkoe, O excellent ones among the knowers of time. Beginning with the constellation Dhanistha and ending with Sravaa shall be a yuga comprising of five years. The universe whirls like a wheel due to the movement of the sun. Hence the sun is the lord and deity delimiting time. He is the instigator and castigator of tha four types of living beings. Rudra, the lord himself, is the inducer

verses.transliteration: prāyaśaścandrayogīni vidyādṛkṣāṇi tattvavit tārānakṣatrarūpāṇi hīnāni tu parasparam
verses.translation: A group of five yean constitutei a yuga which should not be confused with the cycle of four yugas. This five-yearly cycle laming a yuga corresponds to the Vedic doctrine of paftca-devati or five deities who have entered the Purusa. Cf. TB i. 4.. i. The five yean with their presiding deities are named (i) saihvatsara — agni; (ii) parivatsara— fiirya; (iii) iivatsara-aoma; (iv) anuvatsara--vhyu; (v) vatiarar-rudra. Of. Klhtsya. 141.
