verses.hindi: निष्ठ, महामाय, पयोनिधि, महादन्त, महाद्रंष्ट्र महाजिहै महामुख, महानख, महारोम, महाकेश, महाजट,
verses.wordMeaning: For Rudra as the life-principle of the sun compare: *bh!yodeti «{lryab***-ted in ST.
verses.commentary: Sense: For Rudra as the life-principle of the sun compare: *bh!yodeti «{lryab***-ted in ST.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य भार्याद्वयम् अभूत् सुनीतिः सुरुचिस् तथा अग्रजायामभूत्पुत्रः सुनीत्यां तु महायशाः
verses.transliteration: tasya bhāryādvayam abhūt sunītiḥ surucis tathā agrajāyāmabhūtputraḥ sunītyāṃ tu mahāyaśāḥ
verses.translation: O leading brahmins, Suruci who was proud of her beauty pushed him away. Delighted in her mind she placed her own son on the lap of his father.
verses.hindi: अलवर तथा चन्द्रवशका वर्णन एवं शिवभक्त तण्डीप्रोक्त रुद्रसहस्त्रनाम BRR कका कक कामकाम आमा की जमी ES ररसकक कफ फक अफ फफफ फफफ फ फफफ फफ फक फफ फफफ फफफ काफ माम
verses.wordMeaning: O leading brahmins, Suruci who was proud of her beauty pushed him away. Delighted in her mind she placed her own son on the lap of his father.
verses.commentary: Sense: O leading brahmins, Suruci who was proud of her beauty pushed him away. Delighted in her mind she placed her own son on the lap of his father.

verses.sanskrit: ध्रुवो नाम महाप्राज्ञः कुलदीपो महामतिः कदाचित् सप्तवर्षे ऽपि पितुरङ्कम् उपाविशत्
verses.transliteration: dhruvo nāma mahāprājñaḥ kuladīpo mahāmatiḥ kadācit saptavarṣe 'pi pituraṅkam upāviśat
verses.translation: The intelligent boy Dhruva became dejected in his mind because he was unable to occupy the lap of his father. He went to his mother and lamented.
verses.hindi: ्रस्वेदनोऽस्वहेनश्च आदिकश्च महामुनिः
verses.wordMeaning: The intelligent boy Dhruva became dejected in his mind because he was unable to occupy the lap of his father. He went to his mother and lamented.
verses.commentary: Sense: The intelligent boy Dhruva became dejected in his mind because he was unable to occupy the lap of his father. He went to his mother and lamented.

verses.sanskrit: सुरुचिस्तं विनिर्धूय स्वपुत्रं प्रीतिमानसा न्यवेशयत्तं विप्रेन्द्रा ह्य् अङ्कं रूपेण मानिता
verses.transliteration: surucistaṃ vinirdhūya svaputraṃ prītimānasā nyaveśayattaṃ viprendrā hy aṅkaṃ rūpeṇa mānitā
verses.translation: Overwhelmed by her grief the mother said to her weep- ing son: — "Sumci is the most beloved of her husband. Her son too is likewise.
verses.hindi: वषको वृषकेतुश्च अनलो वायुवाहनः। मण्डली मेरुवासश्च देववाहन एव च यजुःपादभुजो गुह्यः प्रकाशौजास्तथैव च
verses.wordMeaning: Overwhelmed by her grief the mother said to her weep- ing son: — "Sumci is the most beloved of her husband. Her son too is likewise.
verses.commentary: Sense: Overwhelmed by her grief the mother said to her weep- ing son: — "Sumci is the most beloved of her husband. Her son too is likewise.

verses.sanskrit: अलब्ध्वा स पितुर्धीमान् अङ्कं दुःखितमानसः मातुः समीपमागम्य रुरोद स पुनः पुनः
verses.transliteration: alabdhvā sa piturdhīmān aṅkaṃ duḥkhitamānasaḥ mātuḥ samīpamāgamya ruroda sa punaḥ punaḥ
verses.translation: You, a son bom of me, a very unfortunate woman, arc also equally unfortunate. Why do you bewail? What for do you weep again and again?
verses.hindi: उपहारः प्रियः सर्वः कनकः काञ्चनस्थितः
verses.wordMeaning: You, a son bom of me, a very unfortunate woman, arc also equally unfortunate. Why do you bewail? What for do you weep again and again?
verses.commentary: Sense: You, a son bom of me, a very unfortunate woman, arc also equally unfortunate. Why do you bewail? What for do you weep again and again?

verses.sanskrit: रुदन्तं पुत्रमाहेदं माता शोकपरिप्लुता सुरुचिर्दयिता भर्तुस् तस्याः पुत्रो ऽपि तादृशः
verses.transliteration: rudantaṃ putramāhedaṃ mātā śokapariplutā surucirdayitā bhartus tasyāḥ putro 'pi tādṛśaḥ
verses.translation: If you are distressed in heart you will increase my sorrow. My dear son, you shall by your own power attain a more comfortable and stable abode.''
verses.hindi: नाभिर्नन्दिकरो हर्म्यः पुष्करः स्थपतिः स्थितः । सर्वशास्त्रो धनश्चाद्यो यज्ञो यज्चा समाहितः नगो नीलः कविः कालो मकरः कालपूजितः। सगणो गणकारश्च भूतभावनसारथिः
verses.wordMeaning: If you are distressed in heart you will increase my sorrow. My dear son, you shall by your own power attain a more comfortable and stable abode.''
verses.commentary: Sense: If you are distressed in heart you will increase my sorrow. My dear son, you shall by your own power attain a more comfortable and stable abode.''

verses.sanskrit: मम त्वं मन्दभाग्याया जातः पुत्रो ऽप्यभाग्यवान् किं शोचसि किमर्थं त्वं रोदमानः पुनः पुनः
verses.transliteration: mama tvaṃ mandabhāgyāyā jātaḥ putro 'pyabhāgyavān kiṃ śocasi kimarthaṃ tvaṃ rodamānaḥ punaḥ punaḥ
verses.translation: On being advised thus by his mother he set out towards the forest. On meeting Vilvitra, he bowed to him duly and spoke with his palms joined in reverence: —
verses.hindi: आश्रमस्थः कपोतस्थो विश्वकर्मा पतिर्विराट्
verses.wordMeaning: On being advised thus by his mother he set out towards the forest. On meeting Vilvitra, he bowed to him duly and spoke with his palms joined in reverence: —
verses.commentary: Sense: On being advised thus by his mother he set out towards the forest. On meeting Vilvitra, he bowed to him duly and spoke with his palms joined in reverence: —

verses.sanskrit: संतप्तहृदयो भूत्वा मम शोकं करिष्यसि स्वस्थस्थानं ध्रुवं पुत्र स्वशक्त्या त्वं समाप्नुयाः
verses.transliteration: saṃtaptahṛdayo bhūtvā mama śokaṃ kariṣyasi svasthasthānaṃ dhruvaṃ putra svaśaktyā tvaṃ samāpnuyāḥ
verses.translation: O sage, I was seated on the lap of my father. My step-mother Suruci pushed me aside. My father, the king, did not protest.
verses.hindi: परश्वधायुधो देवो ह््ार्थकारी सुबान्धवः तुम्बवीणो महाकोप ऊर्ध्वरेता जलेशयः उग्रो वंशकरो वंशो वंशवादी ह्यनिन्दितः
verses.wordMeaning: O sage, I was seated on the lap of my father. My step-mother Suruci pushed me aside. My father, the king, did not protest.
verses.commentary: Sense: O sage, I was seated on the lap of my father. My step-mother Suruci pushed me aside. My father, the king, did not protest.

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्तः स तु मात्रा वै निर्जगाम तदा वनम् विश्वामित्रं ततो दृष्ट्वा प्रणिपत्य यथाविधि
verses.transliteration: ityuktaḥ sa tu mātrā vai nirjagāma tadā vanam viśvāmitraṃ tato dṛṣṭvā praṇipatya yathāvidhi
verses.translation: For this very reason, O brahmin, I went to my mother in fright. My mother said to me: — son, do not be sorry. You deserve to attain a far greater abode by your own endeavour". On hearing her words, O great sage, I have come to you for shelter in this forest. O holy sir, O brahmin, I have now met you. By your grace I shall attain the wonderful and excellent abode.
verses.hindi: बन्धनो बन्धकर्ता च सुबन्धनविमोचनः
verses.wordMeaning: For this very reason, O brahmin, I went to my mother in fright. My mother said to me: — son, do not be sorry. You deserve to attain a far greater abode by your own endeavour". On hearing her words, O great sage, I have come to you for shelter in this forest. O holy sir,…
verses.commentary: Sense: For this very reason, O brahmin, I went to my mother in fright. My mother said to me: — son, do not be sorry. You deserve to attain a far greater abode by your own endeavour". On hearing her words, O great sage, I have come to you for shelter in this forest. O holy sir,…

verses.sanskrit: उवाच प्राञ्जलिर्भूत्वा भगवन् वक्तुमर्हसि सर्वेषामुपरिस्थानं केन प्राप्स्यामि सत्तम
verses.transliteration: uvāca prāñjalirbhūtvā bhagavan vaktumarhasi sarveṣāmuparisthānaṃ kena prāpsyāmi sattama
verses.translation: On being requested thus, the glorious sage said laughingly * Prince, listen to this. You will attain an excel- lent abode by propitiating Keava the lord of the worl<b, and
verses.hindi: राक्षसघ्नोऽथ कामारिर्महादंष्ट्रो महायुधः लम्बितो लम्बितोष्ठश्च लम्बहस्तो वरप्रदः बाहुस्त्वनिन्दितः सर्वः शङ्कूरोऽथाप्यकोपनः अमरेशो महाघोरो विश्वदेवः सुरारिहा
verses.wordMeaning: On being requested thus, the glorious sage said laughingly * Prince, listen to this. You will attain an excel- lent abode by propitiating Keava the lord of the worl<b, and
verses.commentary: Sense: On being requested thus, the glorious sage said laughingly * Prince, listen to this. You will attain an excel- lent abode by propitiating Keava the lord of the worl<b, and

verses.sanskrit: पितुरङ्के समासीनं माता मां सुरुचिर्मुने व्यधूनयत्स तं राजा पिता नोवाच किंचन
verses.transliteration: pituraṅke samāsīnaṃ mātā māṃ surucirmune vyadhūnayatsa taṃ rājā pitā novāca kiṃcana
verses.translation: O highly intelligent one, repeat the Mantra of the lord continuously. It is great, pure and holy, it destroys all sins and yields all desires.
verses.hindi: अजैकपाच्च कापाली शं कुमारो महागिरिः
verses.wordMeaning: O highly intelligent one, repeat the Mantra of the lord continuously. It is great, pure and holy, it destroys all sins and yields all desires.
verses.commentary: Sense: O highly intelligent one, repeat the Mantra of the lord continuously. It is great, pure and holy, it destroys all sins and yields all desires.

verses.sanskrit: एतस्मात् कारणाद् ब्रह्मंस् त्रस्तो ऽहं मातरं गतः सुनीतिराह मे माता मा कृथाः शोकमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: etasmāt kāraṇād brahmaṃs trasto 'haṃ mātaraṃ gataḥ sunītirāha me mātā mā kṛthāḥ śokamuttamam
verses.translation: Repeat this divine Mantra controlling your sense, with the Praiava: — 'Namostu Vwudevaya** [Obeisance be to Vasu- deva]. Meditate on the eternal Vipu. Be interested in japa and homa.
verses.hindi: धन्वन्तरिर्धूमकेतुः सूर्यो वैश्रवणस्तथा। धाता विष्णुश्च शक्रश्च मित्रस्त्वष्टा धरो श्रुवः नीरस्तीर्थश्च भीमश्च सर्वकर्मा गुणो द्वहः । पदागर्भा महागर्भश्चन्द्रवक्त्रो नभोञ्नघः
verses.wordMeaning: Repeat this divine Mantra controlling your sense, with the Praiava: — 'Namostu Vwudevaya** [Obeisance be to Vasu- deva]. Meditate on the eternal Vipu. Be interested in japa and homa.
verses.commentary: Sense: Repeat this divine Mantra controlling your sense, with the Praiava: — 'Namostu Vwudevaya** [Obeisance be to Vasu- deva]. Meditate on the eternal Vipu. Be interested in japa and homa.

verses.sanskrit: स्वकर्मणा परं स्थानं प्राप्तुमर्हसि पुत्रक तस्या हि वचनं श्रुत्वा स्थानं तव महामुने
verses.transliteration: svakarmaṇā paraṃ sthānaṃ prāptumarhasi putraka tasyā hi vacanaṃ śrutvā sthānaṃ tava mahāmune
verses.translation: On being advised thus, the boy of great renown bowed to Vivamitra and began his japa facing the east He restrained himself and was delighted in his mind. Alertfully he repeated the mantra continuously without break for a year, sustaining himself on vegetables, roots and fruits. Terrible vampires and demons, large fierce beasts like lions rushed at him in order to tonfound his wits. But, repeating the name Vasu- deva he did not take notice of anything else.
verses.hindi: बलवांश्चोपशान्तश्च पुराणः पुण्यकृत्तम: । कूरकर्ता क्रूरवासी तनुरात्मा महौषधः
verses.wordMeaning: On being advised thus, the boy of great renown bowed to Vivamitra and began his japa facing the east He restrained himself and was delighted in his mind. Alertfully he repeated the mantra continuously without break for a year, sustaining himself on vegetables, roots and fruits.…
verses.commentary: Sense: On being advised thus, the boy of great renown bowed to Vivamitra and began his japa facing the east He restrained himself and was delighted in his mind. Alertfully he repeated the mantra continuously without break for a year, sustaining himself on vegetables, roots and fruits.…

verses.sanskrit: प्राप्तो वनमिदं ब्रह्मन्न् अद्य त्वां दृष्टवान्प्रभो तव प्रसादात् प्राप्स्ये ऽहं स्थानमद्भुतमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: prāpto vanamidaṃ brahmann adya tvāṃ dṛṣṭavānprabho tava prasādāt prāpsye 'haṃ sthānamadbhutamuttamam
verses.translation: A female ghost assuming the form of his mother Suniti came pear him and wept bitterly and miserably.
verses.hindi: असपल, प्रसाद, प्रत्यय, गीतसाधक, प्रस्वेदन, अस्वहेन, आदिक, महामुनि, वृषक, वृषकेतु, अनल, वायुवाहन, मण्डली, मेरुवास, देववाहन॥ १०९--११२॥ यजुःपादभुज, गुह्य, प्रकाशौज, अमोघार्थप्रसाद, अन्तर्भाव्य, सुदर्शन, उपहार, प्रिय, सर्व, कनक, कांचनस्थित, नाभि, नन्दिकर, हर्म्य, पुष्कर, स्थपति, स्थित, सर्वास्त्र,
verses.wordMeaning: A female ghost assuming the form of his mother Suniti came pear him and wept bitterly and miserably.
verses.commentary: Sense: A female ghost assuming the form of his mother Suniti came pear him and wept bitterly and miserably.

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्तः स मुनिः श्रीमान् प्रहसन्न् इदम् अब्रवीत् राजपुत्र शृणुष्वेदं स्थानमुत्तममाप्स्यसि
verses.transliteration: ityuktaḥ sa muniḥ śrīmān prahasann idam abravīt rājaputra śṛṇuṣvedaṃ sthānamuttamamāpsyasi
verses.translation: "O you are my only son. Why do you torture your- self? Leaving me helpless, you have taken to penance".
verses.hindi: धन, आद्य, यज्ञ, यज्वा, समाहित, नग, नील, कवि,
verses.wordMeaning: "O you are my only son. Why do you torture your- self? Leaving me helpless, you have taken to penance".
verses.commentary: Sense: "O you are my only son. Why do you torture your- self? Leaving me helpless, you have taken to penance".

verses.sanskrit: आराध्य जगतामीशं केशवं क्लेशनाशनम् दक्षिणाङ्गभवं शंभोर् महादेवस्य धीमतः
verses.transliteration: ārādhya jagatāmīśaṃ keśavaṃ kleśanāśanam dakṣiṇāṅgabhavaṃ śaṃbhor mahādevasya dhīmataḥ
verses.translation: Then all the forms of impediment and harassment subsided from ail sides. Seated on Garuda lord Visnu who resembled the black cloud in lustre, who is the destroyer of enemies, who was surrounded by Devas and who was being eulogised by great sages, came there before Dhruva.
verses.hindi: काल, मकर, कालपूजित, सगण, गणकार, भूतभावन- शुचि, भूतनिषेवित, आश्रमस्थ, कपोतस्थ, विश्वकर्मा,
verses.wordMeaning: Then all the forms of impediment and harassment subsided from ail sides. Seated on Garuda lord Visnu who resembled the black cloud in lustre, who is the destroyer of enemies, who was surrounded by Devas and who was being eulogised by great sages, came there before Dhruva.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then all the forms of impediment and harassment subsided from ail sides. Seated on Garuda lord Visnu who resembled the black cloud in lustre, who is the destroyer of enemies, who was surrounded by Devas and who was being eulogised by great sages, came there before Dhruva.

verses.sanskrit: जप नित्यं महाप्राज्ञ सर्वपापविनाशनम् इष्टदं परमं शुद्धं पवित्रममलं परम्
verses.transliteration: japa nityaṃ mahāprājña sarvapāpavināśanam iṣṭadaṃ paramaṃ śuddhaṃ pavitramamalaṃ param
verses.translation: On seeing the lord come near, he simply thought within his mind *'who is this?" Drinking as it were Hr|ike the lord of the Universe, by his eyes the boy of great lustre, seated himself and repeated Vasudeva". With the tip of his conch the lord touched his face.
verses.hindi: तार्क्ष्य, अविज्ञेय, सुशारद, परश्वधायुध, देव, अर्थकारी, सुबान्धव
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing the lord come near, he simply thought within his mind *'who is this?" Drinking as it were Hr|ike the lord of the Universe, by his eyes the boy of great lustre, seated himself and repeated Vasudeva". With the tip of his conch the lord touched his face.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing the lord come near, he simply thought within his mind *'who is this?" Drinking as it were Hr|ike the lord of the Universe, by his eyes the boy of great lustre, seated himself and repeated Vasudeva". With the tip of his conch the lord touched his face.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रूहि मन्त्रमिमं दिव्यं प्रणवेन समन्वितम् नमो ऽस्तु वासुदेवाय इत्येवं नियतेन्द्रियः
verses.transliteration: brūhi mantramimaṃ divyaṃ praṇavena samanvitam namo 'stu vāsudevāya ityevaṃ niyatendriyaḥ
verses.translation: Thereupon he attained the highest knowledge. With his palms joined in reverence he eulogised the lord the most excellent of all divine beings.
verses.hindi: तुम्बबीण, महाकोप, ऊर्ध्वरेता, जलेशय, उग्र, वंशकर, वंश, वंशवादी, अनिन्दित, सर्वागरूपी, मायावी, सुहृद, अनिल, बल, बन्धन, बन्धकर्ता, सुबन्धन- विमोचन, राक्षसध्न, कामारिं, महादंष्ट्र, महायुध, लम्बित, शंकर, अकोपन, अमरेश, महाघोर, विश्वदेव,
verses.wordMeaning: Thereupon he attained the highest knowledge. With his palms joined in reverence he eulogised the lord the most excellent of all divine beings.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereupon he attained the highest knowledge. With his palms joined in reverence he eulogised the lord the most excellent of all divine beings.

verses.sanskrit: ध्यायन्सनातनं विष्णुं जपहोमपरायणः इत्युक्तः प्रणिपत्यैनं विश्वामित्रं महायशाः
verses.transliteration: dhyāyansanātanaṃ viṣṇuṃ japahomaparāyaṇaḥ ityuktaḥ praṇipatyainaṃ viśvāmitraṃ mahāyaśāḥ
verses.translation: is born of the light side of Siva, while Brahin& is bom
verses.hindi: कापाली, शं, कुमार, महागिरि, धन्वन्तरि, धूमकेतु, सूर्य, वैश्रवण, धाता, विष्णु, शक्र, मित्र, त्वष्टा, धर,
verses.wordMeaning: is born of the light side of Siva, while Brahin& is bom
verses.commentary: Sense: is born of the light side of Siva, while Brahin& is bom

verses.sanskrit: प्राङ्मुखो नियतो भूत्वा जजाप प्रीतमानसः शाकमूलफलाहारः संवत्सरमतन्द्रितः
verses.transliteration: prāṅmukho niyato bhūtvā jajāpa prītamānasaḥ śākamūlaphalāhāraḥ saṃvatsaramatandritaḥ
verses.translation: Be favourable, O lord of the chiefs of Devas, O wielder of conch, discus and iron club! O soul of the worlds! O soul of all, O soul of all secrets of the Vedas, O Keiiava, I have sought refuge in you.
verses.hindi: सर्वकर्मा, गुणोद्वह, पद्मगर्भ, महागर्भ, चन्द्रवक्त्र, नभ, अनघ बलवान्, उपशान्त, पुराण, पुण्यकृत्, तम, क्रूरकर्तो,
verses.wordMeaning: Be favourable, O lord of the chiefs of Devas, O wielder of conch, discus and iron club! O soul of the worlds! O soul of all, O soul of all secrets of the Vedas, O Keiiava, I have sought refuge in you.
verses.commentary: Sense: Be favourable, O lord of the chiefs of Devas, O wielder of conch, discus and iron club! O soul of the worlds! O soul of all, O soul of all secrets of the Vedas, O Keiiava, I have sought refuge in you.

verses.sanskrit: जजाप मन्त्रमनिशम् अजस्रं स पुनः पुनः वेताला राक्षसा घोराः सिंहाद्याश् च महामृगाः
verses.transliteration: jajāpa mantramaniśam ajasraṃ sa punaḥ punaḥ vetālā rākṣasā ghorāḥ siṃhādyāś ca mahāmṛgāḥ
verses.translation: Even the great sages Sanaka and others have not com* prehended you, the great Atman. Then how can I know you? O lord of the worlds, obeisance to you.
verses.hindi: देवदेवः सुखोत्सिक्तः सदसत्सर्वरलवित्
verses.wordMeaning: Even the great sages Sanaka and others have not com* prehended you, the great Atman. Then how can I know you? O lord of the worlds, obeisance to you.
verses.commentary: Sense: Even the great sages Sanaka and others have not com* prehended you, the great Atman. Then how can I know you? O lord of the worlds, obeisance to you.

verses.sanskrit: तमभ्ययुर्महात्मानं बुद्धिमोहाय भीषणाः जपन् स वासुदेवेति न किंचित् प्रत्यपद्यत
verses.transliteration: tamabhyayurmahātmānaṃ buddhimohāya bhīṣaṇāḥ japan sa vāsudeveti na kiṃcit pratyapadyata
verses.translation: Then Visnu said to him smiling: — dear one, come on. You are Dhruva (steady). Attaining a fixed and steady abode be the first among all luminaries.
verses.hindi: कुलहारी कुलाकर्ता बहुवित्तो बहुप्रजः प्राणेशो बन्धकी वृक्षो नकुलश्चाद्रिकस्तथा। हृस्वग्रीवो महाजानुरलोलश्च महौषधिः
verses.wordMeaning: Then Visnu said to him smiling: — dear one, come on. You are Dhruva (steady). Attaining a fixed and steady abode be the first among all luminaries.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then Visnu said to him smiling: — dear one, come on. You are Dhruva (steady). Attaining a fixed and steady abode be the first among all luminaries.

verses.sanskrit: सुनीतिर् अस्य या माता तस्या रूपेण संवृता पिशाचि समनुप्राप्ता रुरोद भृशदुःखिता
verses.transliteration: sunītir asya yā mātā tasyā rūpeṇa saṃvṛtā piśāci samanuprāptā ruroda bhṛśaduḥkhitā
verses.translation: You along with your mother shall attain the abode of luminaries. This abode is mine, the greatest, the steady splen- did abode.
verses.hindi: सिद्धान्तकारी सिद्धार्थश्छन्दो व्याकरणोद्भवः।
verses.wordMeaning: You along with your mother shall attain the abode of luminaries. This abode is mine, the greatest, the steady splen- did abode.
verses.commentary: Sense: You along with your mother shall attain the abode of luminaries. This abode is mine, the greatest, the steady splen- did abode.

verses.sanskrit: मम त्वमेकः पुत्रो ऽसि किमर्थं क्लिश्यते भवान् मामनाथामपहाय तप आस्थितवानसि
verses.transliteration: mama tvamekaḥ putro 'si kimarthaṃ kliśyate bhavān māmanāthāmapahāya tapa āsthitavānasi
verses.translation: It was acquired by me from lord Siva formerly after propitiating him by penance. The devotee who repeats continuously the name Vasudeva along with the Pranava 'om* the word 'Bhagavat' and the word 'namas* denoting obeisance attains the fixed abode of Dhruva."
verses.hindi: प्रभावात्मा जगत्कालः कालः कम्पी तरुस्तनुः । सारङ्रो भूतचक्राङ्कः केतुमाली सुवेधकः
verses.wordMeaning: It was acquired by me from lord Siva formerly after propitiating him by penance. The devotee who repeats continuously the name Vasudeva along with the Pranava 'om* the word 'Bhagavat' and the word 'namas* denoting obeisance attains the fixed abode of Dhruva."
verses.commentary: Sense: It was acquired by me from lord Siva formerly after propitiating him by penance. The devotee who repeats continuously the name Vasudeva along with the Pranava 'om* the word 'Bhagavat' and the word 'namas* denoting obeisance attains the fixed abode of Dhruva."

verses.sanskrit: एवमादीनि वाक्यानि भाषमाणां महातपाः अनिरीक्ष्यैव हृष्टात्मा हरेर्नाम जजाप सः
verses.transliteration: evamādīni vākyāni bhāṣamāṇāṃ mahātapāḥ anirīkṣyaiva hṛṣṭātmā harernāma jajāpa saḥ
verses.translation: Then all Devas, Siddhas, sages and Gan- dharvas installed Dhruva in that abode along with his mother. Thus, at the behest of Visnu he attained the abode of lumi- naries. By means of the twelve-syllabled mantra®*®, Dhruva of great splendour attained the highest perfection.
verses.hindi: महामना महाकामो चित्तकामो जितेन्द्रियः १३८ गान्धारश्च सुरापश्च तापकर्मरतो हितः। महाभूतो भूतवृतो ह्यप्सरो गणसेवितः
verses.wordMeaning: Then all Devas, Siddhas, sages and Gan- dharvas installed Dhruva in that abode along with his mother. Thus, at the behest of Visnu he attained the abode of lumi- naries. By means of the twelve-syllabled mantra®*®, Dhruva of great splendour attained the highest perfection.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then all Devas, Siddhas, sages and Gan- dharvas installed Dhruva in that abode along with his mother. Thus, at the behest of Visnu he attained the abode of lumi- naries. By means of the twelve-syllabled mantra®*®, Dhruva of great splendour attained the highest perfection.

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रशेमुः सर्वत्र विघ्नरूपाणि तत्र वै ततो गरुडमारुह्य कालमेघसमद्युतिः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ praśemuḥ sarvatra vighnarūpāṇi tatra vai tato garuḍamāruhya kālameghasamadyutiḥ
verses.translation: Then all Devas, Siddhas, sages and Gan- dharvas installed Dhruva in that abode along with his mother. Thus, at the behest of Visnu he attained the abode of lumi- naries. By means of the twelve-syllabled mantra®*®, Dhruva of great splendour attained the highest perfection.
verses.hindi: महाकेतुर्धराधाता नैकतानरतः स्वरः। अवेदनीय आवेद्यः सर्वगश्च सुखावहः संयोगी वर्धनो वृद्धो गणिकोऽथ गणाधिपः
verses.wordMeaning: Then all Devas, Siddhas, sages and Gan- dharvas installed Dhruva in that abode along with his mother. Thus, at the behest of Visnu he attained the abode of lumi- naries. By means of the twelve-syllabled mantra®*®, Dhruva of great splendour attained the highest perfection.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then all Devas, Siddhas, sages and Gan- dharvas installed Dhruva in that abode along with his mother. Thus, at the behest of Visnu he attained the abode of lumi- naries. By means of the twelve-syllabled mantra®*®, Dhruva of great splendour attained the highest perfection.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वदेवैः परिवृतः स्तूयमानो महर्षिभिः आययौ भगवान्विष्णुः ध्रुवान्तिकम् अरातिहा
verses.transliteration: sarvadevaiḥ parivṛtaḥ stūyamāno maharṣibhiḥ āyayau bhagavānviṣṇuḥ dhruvāntikam arātihā
verses.translation: Then all Devas, Siddhas, sages and Gan- dharvas installed Dhruva in that abode along with his mother. Thus, at the behest of Visnu he attained the abode of lumi- naries. By means of the twelve-syllabled mantra®*®, Dhruva of great splendour attained the highest perfection.
verses.hindi: नित्यो धाता सहायश्च देवासुरपतिः पतिः। युक्तश्च युक्तबाहुश्च सुदेवोऽपि सुपर्वणः
verses.wordMeaning: Then all Devas, Siddhas, sages and Gan- dharvas installed Dhruva in that abode along with his mother. Thus, at the behest of Visnu he attained the abode of lumi- naries. By means of the twelve-syllabled mantra®*®, Dhruva of great splendour attained the highest perfection.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then all Devas, Siddhas, sages and Gan- dharvas installed Dhruva in that abode along with his mother. Thus, at the behest of Visnu he attained the abode of lumi- naries. By means of the twelve-syllabled mantra®*®, Dhruva of great splendour attained the highest perfection.

verses.sanskrit: समागतं विलोक्याथ को ऽसावित्येव चिन्तयन् पिबन्निव हृषीकेशं नयनाभ्यां जगत्पतिम्
verses.transliteration: samāgataṃ vilokyātha ko 'sāvityeva cintayan pibanniva hṛṣīkeśaṃ nayanābhyāṃ jagatpatim
verses.translation: Then all Devas, Siddhas, sages and Gan- dharvas installed Dhruva in that abode along with his mother. Thus, at the behest of Visnu he attained the abode of lumi- naries. By means of the twelve-syllabled mantra®*®, Dhruva of great splendour attained the highest perfection.
verses.hindi: साम्नायोऽथ महाम्नायस्तीर्थदेवो महायशा: । निर्जीवो जीवनो मन्त्रः सुभगो बहुकर्कशः महाकण्ठो महायोगी युगो युगकरो हरि:
verses.wordMeaning: Then all Devas, Siddhas, sages and Gan- dharvas installed Dhruva in that abode along with his mother. Thus, at the behest of Visnu he attained the abode of lumi- naries. By means of the twelve-syllabled mantra®*®, Dhruva of great splendour attained the highest perfection.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then all Devas, Siddhas, sages and Gan- dharvas installed Dhruva in that abode along with his mother. Thus, at the behest of Visnu he attained the abode of lumi- naries. By means of the twelve-syllabled mantra®*®, Dhruva of great splendour attained the highest perfection.

verses.sanskrit: जपन् स वासुदेवेति ध्रुवस्तस्थौ महाद्युतिः शङ्खप्रान्तेन गोविन्दः पस्पर्शास्यं हि तस्य वै
verses.transliteration: japan sa vāsudeveti dhruvastasthau mahādyutiḥ śaṅkhaprāntena govindaḥ pasparśāsyaṃ hi tasya vai
verses.translation: Then all Devas, Siddhas, sages and Gan- dharvas installed Dhruva in that abode along with his mother. Thus, at the behest of Visnu he attained the abode of lumi- naries. By means of the twelve-syllabled mantra®*®, Dhruva of great splendour attained the highest perfection.
verses.hindi: प्राणेश, प्राणिनांपति, देवदेव, सुखोत्सिक्त, सत्, अप.
verses.wordMeaning: Then all Devas, Siddhas, sages and Gan- dharvas installed Dhruva in that abode along with his mother. Thus, at the behest of Visnu he attained the abode of lumi- naries. By means of the twelve-syllabled mantra®*®, Dhruva of great splendour attained the highest perfection.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then all Devas, Siddhas, sages and Gan- dharvas installed Dhruva in that abode along with his mother. Thus, at the behest of Visnu he attained the abode of lumi- naries. By means of the twelve-syllabled mantra®*®, Dhruva of great splendour attained the highest perfection.

verses.sanskrit: ततः स परमं ज्ञानम् अवाप्य पुरुषोत्तमम् तुष्टाव प्राञ्जलिर्भूत्वा सर्वलोकेश्वरं हरिम्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sa paramaṃ jñānam avāpya puruṣottamam tuṣṭāva prāñjalirbhūtvā sarvalokeśvaraṃ harim
verses.translation: Then all Devas, Siddhas, sages and Gan- dharvas installed Dhruva in that abode along with his mother. Thus, at the behest of Visnu he attained the abode of lumi- naries. By means of the twelve-syllabled mantra®*®, Dhruva of great splendour attained the highest perfection.
verses.hindi: कुलहारी, कुलाकर्ता, बहुवित्त, बहुप्रज, प्राणेश, बन्धकी, सिद्धान्तकारी, सिद्धार्थ, छन्द, व्याकरणोदूभव,
verses.wordMeaning: Then all Devas, Siddhas, sages and Gan- dharvas installed Dhruva in that abode along with his mother. Thus, at the behest of Visnu he attained the abode of lumi- naries. By means of the twelve-syllabled mantra®*®, Dhruva of great splendour attained the highest perfection.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then all Devas, Siddhas, sages and Gan- dharvas installed Dhruva in that abode along with his mother. Thus, at the behest of Visnu he attained the abode of lumi- naries. By means of the twelve-syllabled mantra®*®, Dhruva of great splendour attained the highest perfection.

verses.sanskrit: प्रसीद देवदेवेश शङ्खचक्रगदाधर लोकात्मन् वेदगुह्यात्मन् त्वां प्रपन्नो ऽस्मि केशव
verses.transliteration: prasīda devadeveśa śaṅkhacakragadādhara lokātman vedaguhyātman tvāṃ prapanno 'smi keśava
verses.translation: Then all Devas, Siddhas, sages and Gan- dharvas installed Dhruva in that abode along with his mother. Thus, at the behest of Visnu he attained the abode of lumi- naries. By means of the twelve-syllabled mantra®*®, Dhruva of great splendour attained the highest perfection.
verses.hindi: जगत्काल, काल, कम्पी, तरु, तनु, सारंग, भूतचक्रांक,  केतुमाली, सुवेधक, भूतालय, भूतपति, अहोरात्र, मल,
verses.wordMeaning: Then all Devas, Siddhas, sages and Gan- dharvas installed Dhruva in that abode along with his mother. Thus, at the behest of Visnu he attained the abode of lumi- naries. By means of the twelve-syllabled mantra®*®, Dhruva of great splendour attained the highest perfection.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then all Devas, Siddhas, sages and Gan- dharvas installed Dhruva in that abode along with his mother. Thus, at the behest of Visnu he attained the abode of lumi- naries. By means of the twelve-syllabled mantra®*®, Dhruva of great splendour attained the highest perfection.

verses.sanskrit: न विदुस्त्वां महात्मानं सनकाद्या महर्षयः तत्कथं त्वामहं विद्यां नमस्ते भुवनेश्वर
verses.transliteration: na vidustvāṃ mahātmānaṃ sanakādyā maharṣayaḥ tatkathaṃ tvāmahaṃ vidyāṃ namaste bhuvaneśvara
verses.translation: Then all Devas, Siddhas, sages and Gan- dharvas installed Dhruva in that abode along with his mother. Thus, at the behest of Visnu he attained the abode of lumi- naries. By means of the twelve-syllabled mantra®*®, Dhruva of great splendour attained the highest perfection.
verses.hindi: प्रवेशन, महामना, महाकाम, चित्तकाम, जितेन्द्रिय, गान्धार, सुराप, तापकर्मरत, हित, महाभूत, भूतवृत, अप्सर, गणसेवित, महाकेतु, धराधाता, नैकतानरत, स्वर, अवेदनीय, आवेद्य, सर्वग, सुखावह ॥ १३७--१४०॥ सहाय, देवासुरपति, पति, युक्त, युक्तबाहु, सुदेव,
verses.wordMeaning: Then all Devas, Siddhas, sages and Gan- dharvas installed Dhruva in that abode along with his mother. Thus, at the behest of Visnu he attained the abode of lumi- naries. By means of the twelve-syllabled mantra®*®, Dhruva of great splendour attained the highest perfection.

verses.sanskrit: तमाह प्रहसन्विष्णुर् एहि वत्स ध्रुवो भवान् स्थानं ध्रुवं समासाद्य ज्योतिषाम् अग्रभुग् भव
verses.transliteration: tamāha prahasanviṣṇur ehi vatsa dhruvo bhavān sthānaṃ dhruvaṃ samāsādya jyotiṣām agrabhug bhava
verses.translation: Then all Devas, Siddhas, sages and Gan- dharvas installed Dhruva in that abode along with his mother. Thus, at the behest of Visnu he attained the abode of lumi- naries. By means of the twelve-syllabled mantra®*®, Dhruva of great splendour attained the highest perfection.
verses.hindi: साम्नाय, महाम्नाय, तीर्थदेव, महायश, निर्जीव, जीवन, मन्त्र, सुभग, बहुकर्कश, रत्नभूत, रलांग,
verses.wordMeaning: Then all Devas, Siddhas, sages and Gan- dharvas installed Dhruva in that abode along with his mother. Thus, at the behest of Visnu he attained the abode of lumi- naries. By means of the twelve-syllabled mantra®*®, Dhruva of great splendour attained the highest perfection.

verses.sanskrit: मात्रा त्वं सहितस्तत्र ज्योतिषां स्थानमाप्नुहि मत्स्थानमेतत्परमं ध्रुवं नित्यं सुशोभनम्
verses.transliteration: mātrā tvaṃ sahitastatra jyotiṣāṃ sthānamāpnuhi matsthānametatparamaṃ dhruvaṃ nityaṃ suśobhanam
verses.translation: Then all Devas, Siddhas, sages and Gan- dharvas installed Dhruva in that abode along with his mother. Thus, at the behest of Visnu he attained the abode of lumi- naries. By means of the twelve-syllabled mantra®*®, Dhruva of great splendour attained the highest perfection.
verses.hindi: महाकण्ठ, महायोगी, युग, युगकर, हरि, युगरूप, महारूप, वहन, गहन, नग, न्याय, निर्वापण, अपर सूर्यवंश तथा चन्द्रवंशका वर्णन एवं शिवभक्त तण्डीप्रोक्त रुद्रसहस्त्रनाम

verses.wordMeaning: Then all Devas, Siddhas, sages and Gan- dharvas installed Dhruva in that abode along with his mother. Thus, at the behest of Visnu he attained the abode of lumi- naries. By means of the twelve-syllabled mantra®*®, Dhruva of great splendour attained the highest perfection.

verses.sanskrit: नमस्कारसमायुक्तं भगवच्छब्दसंयुतम् जपेदेवं हि यो विद्वान् ध्रुवं स्थानं प्रपद्यते
verses.transliteration: namaskārasamāyuktaṃ bhagavacchabdasaṃyutam japedevaṃ hi yo vidvān dhruvaṃ sthānaṃ prapadyate
verses.translation: Then all Devas, Siddhas, sages and Gan- dharvas installed Dhruva in that abode along with his mother. Thus, at the behest of Visnu he attained the abode of lumi- naries. By means of the twelve-syllabled mantra®*®, Dhruva of great splendour attained the highest perfection.
verses.hindi: गन्धमाली च भगवाननन्तः सर्वलक्षणः। करस्थाली कपाली च ऊर्ध्वसंहननो युवा। यनत्रतन्त्रसुविख्यातो लोकः सर्वाश्रयो मृदु:
verses.wordMeaning: Then all Devas, Siddhas, sages and Gan- dharvas installed Dhruva in that abode along with his mother. Thus, at the behest of Visnu he attained the abode of lumi- naries. By means of the twelve-syllabled mantra®*®, Dhruva of great splendour attained the highest perfection.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then all Devas, Siddhas, sages and Gan- dharvas installed Dhruva in that abode along with his mother. Thus, at the behest of Visnu he attained the abode of lumi- naries. By means of the twelve-syllabled mantra®*®, Dhruva of great splendour attained the highest perfection.

verses.sanskrit: ततो देवाः सगन्धर्वाः सिद्धाश् च परमर्षयः मात्रा सह ध्रुवं सर्वे तस्मिन् स्थाने न्यवेशयन्
verses.transliteration: tato devāḥ sagandharvāḥ siddhāś ca paramarṣayaḥ mātrā saha dhruvaṃ sarve tasmin sthāne nyaveśayan
verses.translation: Then all Devas, Siddhas, sages and Gan- dharvas installed Dhruva in that abode along with his mother. Thus, at the behest of Visnu he attained the abode of lumi- naries. By means of the twelve-syllabled mantra®*®, Dhruva of great splendour attained the highest perfection.
verses.hindi: सहस्रमूर्धा देवेन्द्रः सर्वदेवमयो गुरुः। सहस्त्रबाहुः सर्वाङ्गः शरण्यः सर्वलोककृत्
verses.wordMeaning: Then all Devas, Siddhas, sages and Gan- dharvas installed Dhruva in that abode along with his mother. Thus, at the behest of Visnu he attained the abode of lumi- naries. By means of the twelve-syllabled mantra®*®, Dhruva of great splendour attained the highest perfection.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then all Devas, Siddhas, sages and Gan- dharvas installed Dhruva in that abode along with his mother. Thus, at the behest of Visnu he attained the abode of lumi- naries. By means of the twelve-syllabled mantra®*®, Dhruva of great splendour attained the highest perfection.

verses.sanskrit: विष्णोराज्ञां पुरस्कृत्य ज्योतिषां स्थानमाप्तवान् एवं ध्रुवो महातेजा द्वादशाक्षरविद्यया
verses.transliteration: viṣṇorājñāṃ puraskṛtya jyotiṣāṃ sthānamāptavān evaṃ dhruvo mahātejā dvādaśākṣaravidyayā
verses.translation: Then all Devas, Siddhas, sages and Gan- dharvas installed Dhruva in that abode along with his mother. Thus, at the behest of Visnu he attained the abode of lumi- naries. By means of the twelve-syllabled mantra®*®, Dhruva of great splendour attained the highest perfection.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्मदण्डविनिर्माता शतघ्नः शतपाशधृक् कला काष्ठा लवो मात्रा मुहूतोऽहः क्षपा क्षणः विश्वक्षेत्रप्रदो बीजं लिङ्गमाझस्तु निर्मुखः
verses.wordMeaning: Then all Devas, Siddhas, sages and Gan- dharvas installed Dhruva in that abode along with his mother. Thus, at the behest of Visnu he attained the abode of lumi- naries. By means of the twelve-syllabled mantra®*®, Dhruva of great splendour attained the highest perfection.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then all Devas, Siddhas, sages and Gan- dharvas installed Dhruva in that abode along with his mother. Thus, at the behest of Visnu he attained the abode of lumi- naries. By means of the twelve-syllabled mantra®*®, Dhruva of great splendour attained the highest perfection.

verses.sanskrit: अवाप महतीं सिद्धिम् एतत्ते कथितं मया
verses.transliteration: avāpa mahatīṃ siddhim etatte kathitaṃ mayā
verses.translation: Then all Devas, Siddhas, sages and Gan- dharvas installed Dhruva in that abode along with his mother. Thus, at the behest of Visnu he attained the abode of lumi- naries. By means of the twelve-syllabled mantra®*®, Dhruva of great splendour attained the highest perfection.
verses.hindi: स्वर्गद्वारं मोक्षद्वारं प्रजाद्वारं त्रिविष्टपः
verses.wordMeaning: Then all Devas, Siddhas, sages and Gan- dharvas installed Dhruva in that abode along with his mother. Thus, at the behest of Visnu he attained the abode of lumi- naries. By means of the twelve-syllabled mantra®*®, Dhruva of great splendour attained the highest perfection.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then all Devas, Siddhas, sages and Gan- dharvas installed Dhruva in that abode along with his mother. Thus, at the behest of Visnu he attained the abode of lumi- naries. By means of the twelve-syllabled mantra®*®, Dhruva of great splendour attained the highest perfection.

verses.sanskrit: तस्माद्यो वासुदेवाय प्रणामं कुरुते नरः स याति ध्रुवसालोक्यं ध्रुवत्वं तस्य तत्तथा
verses.transliteration: tasmādyo vāsudevāya praṇāmaṃ kurute naraḥ sa yāti dhruvasālokyaṃ dhruvatvaṃ tasya tattathā
verses.translation: Then all Devas, Siddhas, sages and Gan- dharvas installed Dhruva in that abode along with his mother. Thus, at the behest of Visnu he attained the abode of lumi- naries. By means of the twelve-syllabled mantra®*®, Dhruva of great splendour attained the highest perfection.
verses.hindi: निर्वाणं हृदयश्चैव ब्रह्मलोकः परागतिः देवासुरविनिर्माता देवासुरपरायणः
verses.wordMeaning: Then all Devas, Siddhas, sages and Gan- dharvas installed Dhruva in that abode along with his mother. Thus, at the behest of Visnu he attained the abode of lumi- naries. By means of the twelve-syllabled mantra®*®, Dhruva of great splendour attained the highest perfection.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then all Devas, Siddhas, sages and Gan- dharvas installed Dhruva in that abode along with his mother. Thus, at the behest of Visnu he attained the abode of lumi- naries. By means of the twelve-syllabled mantra®*®, Dhruva of great splendour attained the highest perfection.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीलिङ्गमहापुराणे पूर्वभागे भुवनकोशे ध्रुवसंस्थानवर्णनं नाम द्विषष्टितमो ऽध्यायः देवानां दानवानां च गन्धर्वोरगरक्षसाम् उत्पत्तिं ब्रूहि सूताद्य यथाक्रममनुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: iti śrīliṅgamahāpurāṇe pūrvabhāge bhuvanakośe dhruvasaṃsthānavarṇanaṃ nāma dviṣaṣṭitamo 'dhyāyaḥ devānāṃ dānavānāṃ ca gandharvoragarakṣasām utpattiṃ brūhi sūtādya yathākramamanuttamam
verses.translation: O Suta, recount the origin of Devas, Danavas, Gan- dharvas. Serpents and Rakasas, in an excellent way and in due order.
verses.hindi: देवासुरगुरु हैवो देवासुरनमस्कृतः । देवासुरमहामात्रो देवासुरगणाश्रयः
verses.wordMeaning: O Suta, recount the origin of Devas, Danavas, Gan- dharvas. Serpents and Rakasas, in an excellent way and in due order.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Suta, recount the origin of Devas, Danavas, Gan- dharvas. Serpents and Rakasas, in an excellent way and in due order.

verses.sanskrit: संकल्पाद्दर्शनात्स्पर्शात् पूर्वेषां सृष्टिरुच्यते दक्षात्प्राचेतसादूर्ध्वं सृष्टिर्मैथुनसंभवा
verses.transliteration: saṃkalpāddarśanātsparśāt pūrveṣāṃ sṛṣṭirucyate dakṣātprācetasādūrdhvaṃ sṛṣṭirmaithunasaṃbhavā
verses.translation: The creation of ancient people was by means of mental conception, direct perception or touch. Subsequent to Dak$a the son of Pracetas, creation is by means of sexual intercourse.
verses.hindi: देवासुरगणाध्यक्षो देवासुरगणाग्रणीः देवाधिदेवो देवर्षि्देवासुरवरप्रदः
verses.wordMeaning: The creation of ancient people was by means of mental conception, direct perception or touch. Subsequent to Dak$a the son of Pracetas, creation is by means of sexual intercourse.
verses.commentary: Sense: The creation of ancient people was by means of mental conception, direct perception or touch. Subsequent to Dak$a the son of Pracetas, creation is by means of sexual intercourse.

verses.sanskrit: यदा तु सृजतस्तस्य देवर्षिगणपन्नगान् न वृद्धिमगमल्लोकस् तदा मैथुनयोगतः
verses.transliteration: yadā tu sṛjatastasya devarṣigaṇapannagān na vṛddhimagamallokas tadā maithunayogataḥ
verses.translation: When he began to create the group of Devas, sages and serpents, the world did not increase. Thereupon, by means of sexual intercourse, Daka begot of Siiti, five thousand sons.
verses.hindi: देवासुरेश्वरो विष्णुदेवासुरमहेश्वरः। सर्वदेबमयोऽचिन्त्यो देवतात्मा स्वयम्भवः
verses.wordMeaning: When he began to create the group of Devas, sages and serpents, the world did not increase. Thereupon, by means of sexual intercourse, Daka begot of Siiti, five thousand sons.
verses.commentary: Sense: When he began to create the group of Devas, sages and serpents, the world did not increase. Thereupon, by means of sexual intercourse, Daka begot of Siiti, five thousand sons.

verses.sanskrit: दक्षः पुत्रसहस्राणि पञ्च सूत्यामजीजनत् तांस्तु दृष्ट्वा महाभागान् सिसृक्षुर्विविधाः प्रजाः
verses.transliteration: dakṣaḥ putrasahasrāṇi pañca sūtyāmajījanat tāṃstu dṛṣṭvā mahābhāgān sisṛkṣurvividhāḥ prajāḥ
verses.translation: Even today they have not returned like the rivers after joining the ocean.
verses.hindi: इज्यो हस्ती तथा व्याघ्रो देवसिंहो महर्षभः विबुधाग्र्यः सुरः श्रेष्ठः स्वर्गदेवस्तथोत्तमः
verses.wordMeaning: Even today they have not returned like the rivers after joining the ocean.
verses.commentary: Sense: Even today they have not returned like the rivers after joining the ocean.

verses.sanskrit: नारदः प्राह हर्यश्वान् दक्षपुत्रान् समागतान् भुवः प्रमाणं सर्वं तु ज्ञात्वोर्ध्वमध एव च
verses.transliteration: nāradaḥ prāha haryaśvān dakṣaputrān samāgatān bhuvaḥ pramāṇaṃ sarvaṃ tu jñātvordhvamadha eva ca
verses.translation: He gave ten of them in marriage to Dharma, thir- teen to Ka£yapa, twentyseven to the moon, four to Aristanemi, two to the son of Bhrgu, two to the intelligent Kfaiva and two to Afigiras. Now listen to the names of the mothers of Devas and the details of their progeny from the very beginning.
verses.hindi: गुरुः कान्तो निजः सर्गः पवित्रः सर्ववाहनः शृङ्गी शृङ्गप्रियो बभ्ू राजराजो निरामयः
verses.wordMeaning: He gave ten of them in marriage to Dharma, thir- teen to Ka£yapa, twentyseven to the moon, four to Aristanemi, two to the son of Bhrgu, two to the intelligent Kfaiva and two to Afigiras.…
verses.commentary: Sense: He gave ten of them in marriage to Dharma, thir- teen to Ka£yapa, twentyseven to the moon, four to Aristanemi, two to the son of Bhrgu, two to the intelligent Kfaiva and two to Afigiras.…

verses.sanskrit: ततः सृष्टिं विशेषेण कुरुध्वं मुनिसत्तमाः ते तु तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा प्रयाताः सर्वतोदिशम्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sṛṣṭiṃ viśeṣeṇa kurudhvaṃ munisattamāḥ te tu tadvacanaṃ śrutvā prayātāḥ sarvatodiśam
verses.translation: or after knowing the extent of the field (i.e. the subtle body) as also its capacity for creating the living beings. ST. cites Bhftga. in *aKwrtoftlii.iiittcpretMion: I
verses.hindi: ललाटाक्षो विश्वदेहो हरिणो ब्रह्मवर्चसः ब्रताधिपः परं ब्रह्म मुक्तानां परमा गतिः। विमुक्तो मुक्तकेशश्च श्रीमाज्छीवर्धनो जगत्
verses.wordMeaning: or after knowing the extent of the field (i.e. the subtle body) as also its capacity for creating the living beings. ST. cites Bhftga. in *aKwrtoftlii.iiittcpretMion: I
verses.commentary: Sense: or after knowing the extent of the field (i.e. the subtle body) as also its capacity for creating the living beings. ST. cites Bhftga. in *aKwrtoftlii.iiittcpretMion: I

verses.sanskrit: अद्यापि न निवर्तन्ते समुद्रादिव सिन्धवः हर्यश्वेषु च नष्टेषु पुनर्दक्षः प्रजापतिः
verses.transliteration: adyāpi na nivartante samudrādiva sindhavaḥ haryaśveṣu ca naṣṭeṣu punardakṣaḥ prajāpatiḥ
verses.translation: We have heard that Diti had two sons from Kayapa viz. Hiraiyakaipu and Hirayaka
verses.hindi: गिरावास, विसर्ग, सर्वलक्षणलक्षवित्, गन्धमाली, भगवान्,
verses.wordMeaning: We have heard that Diti had two sons from Kayapa viz. Hiraiyakaipu and Hirayaka
verses.commentary: Sense: We have heard that Diti had two sons from Kayapa viz. Hiraiyakaipu and Hirayaka

verses.sanskrit: सूत्यामेव च पुत्राणां सहस्रमसृजत्प्रभुः शबला नाम ते विप्राः समेताः सृष्टिहेतवः
verses.transliteration: sūtyāmeva ca putrāṇāṃ sahasramasṛjatprabhuḥ śabalā nāma te viprāḥ sametāḥ sṛṣṭihetavaḥ
verses.translation: Danu bore a hundred sons to KaiSyapa. They were mighty and arrogant. O excellent brahmins, among them Vipracitti was the chief.
verses.hindi: करस्थाली, कपाली, अर्ध्वसंहनन, युवा, यन्त्रतन्त्रसुविख्यात, लोक, सर्वाश्रय, मृदु, मुण्ड, विरूप, वज्री, दीप्ततेज, सहस्रपात्, सहस्रमूर्धा, देवेन्द्र, सर्वदेवमय, गुरु, सहस्रबाहु, सर्वांग, शरण्य, सर्वलोककृत्, पवित्र, त्रिमधु, मन्त्र, कनिष्ठ, कृष्णपिंगल, ब्रह्मदण्डविनिर्माता, शतघ्न, शतपाशधृक्
verses.wordMeaning: Danu bore a hundred sons to KaiSyapa. They were mighty and arrogant. O excellent brahmins, among them Vipracitti was the chief.
verses.commentary: Sense: Danu bore a hundred sons to KaiSyapa. They were mighty and arrogant. O excellent brahmins, among them Vipracitti was the chief.

verses.sanskrit: नारदो ऽनुगतान्प्राह पुनस्तान्सूर्यवर्चसः भुवः प्रमाणं सर्वं तु ज्ञात्वा भ्रातॄन् पुनः पुनः
verses.transliteration: nārado 'nugatānprāha punastānsūryavarcasaḥ bhuvaḥ pramāṇaṃ sarvaṃ tu jñātvā bhrātṝn punaḥ punaḥ
verses.translation: Vasus are a class of deities, eight in number. They seem to have been personifications of natural phenomena. They are Apa (water), Dhruva (Pole sUr), Soma (moon), Dhari (earth), Anila (wi), Anala (fire), Frabhisa (dawn) and Pratyfifa (light).
verses.hindi: कला, काष्ठा, लव, मात्रा, मुहूर्त, अहः, क्षपा, क्षण, विश्वकषेत्रप्रद, बीज, लिङ्ग, आद्य, निर्मुख,
verses.wordMeaning: Vasus are a class of deities, eight in number. They seem to have been personifications of natural phenomena. They are Apa (water), Dhruva (Pole sUr), Soma (moon), Dhari (earth), Anila (wi), Anala (fire), Frabhisa (dawn) and Pratyfifa (light).
verses.commentary: Sense: Vasus are a class of deities, eight in number. They seem to have been personifications of natural phenomena. They are Apa (water), Dhruva (Pole sUr), Soma (moon), Dhari (earth), Anila (wi), Anala (fire), Frabhisa (dawn) and Pratyfifa (light).

verses.sanskrit: आगत्य वाथ सृष्टिं वै करिष्यथ विशेषतः ते ऽपि तेनैव मार्गेण जग्मुर्भ्रातृगतिं तथा
verses.transliteration: āgatya vātha sṛṣṭiṃ vai kariṣyatha viśeṣataḥ te 'pi tenaiva mārgeṇa jagmurbhrātṛgatiṃ tathā
verses.translation: In regard to the names of the eleven Rudras the Purfiljias are not Qoanimous.
verses.hindi: मोक्षद्वार, प्रजाद्वार, त्रिविष्टप, निर्वाण, हृदय, ब्रह्मलोक, परागति, देवासुर-विनिर्माता, देवासुरपरायण, देवासुरगुरू, देव, देवासुरनमस्कृत, देवासुर-महामात्र, देवासुर- देवासुरगणाध्यक्ष, देवासुरगणाग्रणी, देवाधिदेव, देवर्षि, देवासुरवरप्रद, देवासुरेश्वर, विष्णु, देवासुरमहेश्वर, सर्वदेवमय, अचिन्त्य, देवतात्मा, स्वयम्भव, उद्गत,
verses.wordMeaning: In regard to the names of the eleven Rudras the Purfiljias are not Qoanimous.
verses.commentary: Sense: In regard to the names of the eleven Rudras the Purfiljias are not Qoanimous.

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तेष्वपि नष्टेषु षष्टिकन्याः प्रजापतिः वैरिण्यां जनयामास दक्षः प्राचेतसस्तदा
verses.transliteration: tatasteṣvapi naṣṭeṣu ṣaṣṭikanyāḥ prajāpatiḥ vairiṇyāṃ janayāmāsa dakṣaḥ prācetasastadā
verses.translation: O leading brahmins, Ttoira bore six daughters* viz. — iSuki, Sycni, Bhf, Sugrivi, Gfdhrika and Suci.
verses.hindi: व्याघ्र, देवसिंह, महर्षभ, विबुधाग्रथ, सुर, श्रेष्ठ, स्वर्गदेव,
verses.wordMeaning: O leading brahmins, Ttoira bore six daughters* viz. — iSuki, Sycni, Bhf, Sugrivi, Gfdhrika and Suci.
verses.commentary: Sense: O leading brahmins, Ttoira bore six daughters* viz. — iSuki, Sycni, Bhf, Sugrivi, Gfdhrika and Suci.

verses.sanskrit: प्रादात्स दशकं धर्मे कश्यपाय त्रयोदश विंशत्सप्त च सोमाय चतस्रो ऽरिष्टनेमये
verses.transliteration: prādātsa daśakaṃ dharme kaśyapāya trayodaśa viṃśatsapta ca somāya catasro 'riṣṭanemaye
verses.translation: Suki duly gave birth to parrots and owls. Syeni gave birth to hawks (falcons), etc. Bhw gave birth to deers. Gfdhri bore the vultures, doves, pigeons and other birds. Suci gave birth to swans, cranes and other aquatic birds such as Karaa, Plava.
verses.hindi: गुरु, कान्त, निज, सर्ग, पवित्र, सर्ववाहन, निराम, सर्वसाधन, ललाटाक्ष, विश्‍वदेह, हरिण, ब्रह्मवर्चस,
verses.wordMeaning: Suki duly gave birth to parrots and owls. Syeni gave birth to hawks (falcons), etc. Bhw gave birth to deers. Gfdhri bore the vultures, doves, pigeons and other birds. Suci gave birth to swans, cranes and other aquatic birds such as Karaa, Plava.
verses.commentary: Sense: Suki duly gave birth to parrots and owls. Syeni gave birth to hawks (falcons), etc. Bhw gave birth to deers. Gfdhri bore the vultures, doves, pigeons and other birds. Suci gave birth to swans, cranes and other aquatic birds such as Karaa, Plava.

verses.sanskrit: द्वे चैव भृगुपुत्राय द्वे कृशाश्वाय धीमते द्वे चैवाङ्गिरसे तद्वत् तासां नामानि विस्तरात्
verses.transliteration: dve caiva bhṛguputrāya dve kṛśāśvāya dhīmate dve caivāṅgirase tadvat tāsāṃ nāmāni vistarāt
verses.translation: Sugrivi gave birth to goats, horses, sheep, camels and donkeys. Vinata gave birth to Garuda and Aruna, ( two sons) and then a daughter Saudamini (lightning) terrible unto all the worlds.
verses.hindi: अचिन्त्य, सत्य, शुचिव्रत, व्रताधिप, परब्रह्म, मुक्तानां परमा गति, विमुक्त, मुक्तकेश, श्रीमान्, श्रीवर्धन, जगत्
verses.wordMeaning: Sugrivi gave birth to goats, horses, sheep, camels and donkeys. Vinata gave birth to Garuda and Aruna, ( two sons) and then a daughter Saudamini (lightning) terrible unto all the worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sugrivi gave birth to goats, horses, sheep, camels and donkeys. Vinata gave birth to Garuda and Aruna, ( two sons) and then a daughter Saudamini (lightning) terrible unto all the worlds.

verses.sanskrit: शृणुध्वं देवमातॄणां प्रजाविस्तारमादितः मरुत्वती वसूर् यामिर् लम्बा भानुररुन्धती
verses.transliteration: śṛṇudhvaṃ devamātṝṇāṃ prajāvistāramāditaḥ marutvatī vasūr yāmir lambā bhānurarundhatī
verses.translation: They are: — §esa, Vuki, Karkota, l§ahkha, Airavata, Kambala, Dhanafljaya, Mahanila, Padma, Asvatara, Takaka, Elapatra, Mahapadma, Dhrtara$tra, Balahaka, Sah* khapala, Mahaiankha, Pupadaxiiftra, iSubhanana, Sahkhalo- man, Nahua, Vamana, Phaiita, Kapila, Durmukha and Patafijali.
verses.hindi: यथाप्रधानं भगवानिति भक्त्या स्तुतो मया । भक्तिमेवं पुरस्कृत्य मया यज्ञपतिर्विभुः तस्माल्लब्ध्वा स्तवं शम्भोर्नृपस्त्रैलोक्यविश्रुतः
verses.wordMeaning: They are: — §esa, Vuki, Karkota, l§ahkha, Airavata, Kambala, Dhanafljaya, Mahanila, Padma, Asvatara, Takaka, Elapatra, Mahapadma, Dhrtara$tra, Balahaka, Sah* khapala, Mahaiankha, Pupadaxiiftra, iSubhanana, Sahkhalo- man, Nahua, Vamana, Phaiita, Kapila, Durmukha and Patafijali.
verses.commentary: Sense: They are: — §esa, Vuki, Karkota, l§ahkha, Airavata, Kambala, Dhanafljaya, Mahanila, Padma, Asvatara, Takaka, Elapatra, Mahapadma, Dhrtara$tra, Balahaka, Sah* khapala, Mahaiankha, Pupadaxiiftra, iSubhanana, Sahkhalo- man, Nahua, Vamana, Phaiita, Kapila, Durmukha and Patafijali.

verses.sanskrit: संकल्पा च मुहूर्ता च साध्या विश्वा च भामिनी धर्मपत्न्यः समाख्यातास् तासां पुत्रान्वदामि वः
verses.transliteration: saṃkalpā ca muhūrtā ca sādhyā viśvā ca bhāminī dharmapatnyaḥ samākhyātās tāsāṃ putrānvadāmi vaḥ
verses.translation: KrodhavaSa gave birth to the Rak?asas wielding great power of deception and also the group of Rudras. The excellent lady Surabhi, gave birth to cows and buffaloes as 'the children of Kayapa. Muni gave birth to the group of sages and Apsaras. Arista gave birth to Kinnaras and Gandharvas. Ila gave birth to grasses, trees, creepers and hedges. Tvi$a gave birth to crores and crores of Yakas and Rldtasas
verses.hindi: ब्रह्मघ्नश्च सुरापश्च स्तेयी च गुरुतल्पगः । शरणागतघाती च मित्रविशवासघातकः
verses.wordMeaning: KrodhavaSa gave birth to the Rak?asas wielding great power of deception and also the group of Rudras. The excellent lady Surabhi, gave birth to cows and buffaloes as 'the children of Kayapa. Muni gave birth to the group of sages and Apsaras.…
verses.commentary: Sense: KrodhavaSa gave birth to the Rak?asas wielding great power of deception and also the group of Rudras. The excellent lady Surabhi, gave birth to cows and buffaloes as 'the children of Kayapa. Muni gave birth to the group of sages and Apsaras.…

verses.sanskrit: विश्वेदेवास्तु विश्वायाः साध्या साध्यानजीजनत् मरुत्वत्यां मरुत्वन्तो वसोस्तु वसवस् तथा
verses.transliteration: viśvedevāstu viśvāyāḥ sādhyā sādhyānajījanat marutvatyāṃ marutvanto vasostu vasavas tathā
verses.translation: These had their own numerous sonis, grandsons etc. Their races are inany. After the children had been procreated by the noble KaiSyapa, after all the mobile and immobile beings had been well established, Prajapati crowned the chief ones among each of them as overlords. He made Vaivasvata Manu the overlord of human beings. Those who were crowned by Brahma in the Svayambhuva manvantara, even
verses.hindi: संवत्सरं क्रमाजप्त्वा त्रिसन्ध्यं शङ्कराश्रमे देवमिष्ट्वा त्रिसन्ध्यं च सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते॥ १७५  हे॥ १७२--१७५॥
verses.wordMeaning: These had their own numerous sonis, grandsons etc. Their races are inany. After the children had been procreated by the noble KaiSyapa, after all the mobile and immobile beings had been well established, Prajapati crowned the chief ones among each of them as overlords.…
verses.commentary: Sense: These had their own numerous sonis, grandsons etc. Their races are inany. After the children had been procreated by the noble KaiSyapa, after all the mobile and immobile beings had been well established, Prajapati crowned the chief ones among each of them as overlords.…

verses.sanskrit: भानोस्तु भानवः प्रोक्ता मुहूर्ताया मुहूर्तकाः लम्बाया घोषनामानो नागवीथिस्तु यामिजः
verses.transliteration: bhānostu bhānavaḥ proktā muhūrtāyā muhūrtakāḥ lambāyā ghoṣanāmāno nāgavīthistu yāmijaḥ
verses.translation: Kaiyapa'f wives and children are given differently in other authorities, e.g. Mbh. Adi p. xvi. Ixv and Ixvi; Kurma xvtii; Agni sdx; Bd. V. i43-*46.
verses.hindi: इन नामोंकी प्रधानताके अनुसार मैंने भक्तिपूर्वक समाहितचित्त होकर भगवान् यज्ञपति विभु शिवक्ष स्तुति की। इस प्रकार उनसे आज्ञा पाकर मैंने भक्तो गतिस्वरूप शिवको स्तुति को। उन तण्डीसे शिवजीका
verses.wordMeaning: Kaiyapa'f wives and children are given differently in other authorities, e.g. Mbh. Adi p. xvi. Ixv and Ixvi; Kurma xvtii; Agni sdx; Bd. V. i43-*46.
verses.commentary: Sense: Kaiyapa'f wives and children are given differently in other authorities, e.g. Mbh. Adi p. xvi. Ixv and Ixvi; Kurma xvtii; Agni sdx; Bd. V. i43-*46.

verses.sanskrit: संकल्पायास्तु संकल्पो वसुसर्गं वदामि वः ज्योतिष्मन्तस्तु ये देवा व्यापकाः सर्वतोदिशम्
verses.transliteration: saṃkalpāyāstu saṃkalpo vasusargaṃ vadāmi vaḥ jyotiṣmantastu ye devā vyāpakāḥ sarvatodiśam
verses.translation: Only those who had been crowned formerly in the Svayambhuva manvantara by Brahma arc crowned now. They become the Manus.
verses.hindi: स्तोत्र प्राप्त करके तीनों लोकोंमें विख्यात तथा महायशस्वी राजा त्रिधन्वा-ने हजार अश्वमेधयज्ञका फल प्राप्तकर प्रभु तण्डीके तेजसे गणाधिपपद प्राण हे द्विजो! जो इसे पढ़ता है, सुनता है अथवा ब्राह्मणोंको सुनाता है, वह हजार अश्वमेधयज्ञका फल अवश्य प्राप्त करता है । ब्राह्मणका वध करनेवाला, सुरापान करनेवाला, सुवर्ण चुरानेवाला, गुरुपत्नीके साध
verses.wordMeaning: Only those who had been crowned formerly in the Svayambhuva manvantara by Brahma arc crowned now. They become the Manus.
verses.commentary: Sense: Only those who had been crowned formerly in the Svayambhuva manvantara by Brahma arc crowned now. They become the Manus.

verses.sanskrit: वसवस्ते समाख्याताः सर्वभूतहितैषिणः आपो ध्रुवश् च सोमश् च धरश्चैवानिलो ऽनलः
verses.transliteration: vasavaste samākhyātāḥ sarvabhūtahitaiṣiṇaḥ āpo dhruvaś ca somaś ca dharaścaivānilo 'nalaḥ
verses.translation: In the past manvantaras these had been the kings. Others arc being crowned when a new manvantara arrives. All the kings of the past and future manvantaras are mention- ed in detail.
verses.hindi: व्यभिचार करनेवाला, शरणमें आये हुएका वध करनेवाला, मित्रके साथ विश्‍वासघात करनेवाला, माता-पिताका वध करनेवाला, वीर-हत्या करनेवाला तथा भ्रूणहत्या करनेवाला भी शिवमन्दिरमें वर्षपर्यन्त तीनों सन्ध्याकालोंमें क्रमसे
verses.wordMeaning: In the past manvantaras these had been the kings. Others arc being crowned when a new manvantara arrives. All the kings of the past and future manvantaras are mention- ed in detail.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the past manvantaras these had been the kings. Others arc being crowned when a new manvantara arrives. All the kings of the past and future manvantaras are mention- ed in detail.

verses.sanskrit: प्रत्यूषश् च प्रभासश् च वसवो ऽष्टौ प्रकीर्तिताः अजैकपाद् अहिर्बुध्न्यो विरूपाक्षः सभैरवः
verses.transliteration: pratyūṣaś ca prabhāsaś ca vasavo 'ṣṭau prakīrtitāḥ ajaikapād ahirbudhnyo virūpākṣaḥ sabhairavaḥ
verses.translation: Even as KaiSyapa was meditating thus, two son's of great prowess manifested themselves by the grace of Brahman. Those two Vatsara and Asita were expounders of Brahman. Naidhruva and Raibhya were bom of Vatsara.
verses.hindi: इन नामोंका जप करके एवं तीनों सन्ध्याकालोंमें देव शिव-का पूजन करके समस्त पापोंसे मुक्त हो जाता इक्ष्वाकुवंशी राजाओंकी कथा तथा ययातिवंश-वर्णन
verses.wordMeaning: Even as KaiSyapa was meditating thus, two son's of great prowess manifested themselves by the grace of Brahman. Those two Vatsara and Asita were expounders of Brahman. Naidhruva and Raibhya were bom of Vatsara.
verses.commentary: Sense: Even as KaiSyapa was meditating thus, two son's of great prowess manifested themselves by the grace of Brahman. Those two Vatsara and Asita were expounders of Brahman. Naidhruva and Raibhya were bom of Vatsara.

verses.sanskrit: हरश् च बहुरूपश् च त्र्यंबकश् च सुरेश्वरः सावित्रश् च जयन्तश् च पिनाकी चापराजितः
verses.transliteration: haraś ca bahurūpaś ca tryaṃbakaś ca sureśvaraḥ sāvitraś ca jayantaś ca pinākī cāparājitaḥ
verses.translation: The sons of Raibhya are known as Raibhyas. I shall mention those of Naidhruva. Sumedhas was born of the daughter of Cyavana. She became the wife of Naidhruva and the mother of Kudapayins.
verses.hindi: त्रिधन्वा देवदेवस्य प्रसादात्तण्डिनस्तथा। अश्वमेधसहस्रस्य फलं प्राप्य प्रयत्नतः
verses.wordMeaning: The sons of Raibhya are known as Raibhyas. I shall mention those of Naidhruva. Sumedhas was born of the daughter of Cyavana. She became the wife of Naidhruva and the mother of Kudapayins.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sons of Raibhya are known as Raibhyas. I shall mention those of Naidhruva. Sumedhas was born of the daughter of Cyavana. She became the wife of Naidhruva and the mother of Kudapayins.

verses.sanskrit: एते रुद्राः समाख्याता एकादश गणेश्वराः कश्यपस्य प्रवक्ष्यामि पत्नीभ्यः पुत्रपौत्रकम्
verses.transliteration: ete rudrāḥ samākhyātā ekādaśa gaṇeśvarāḥ kaśyapasya pravakṣyāmi patnībhyaḥ putrapautrakam
verses.translation: Devas had nine sources of origin. I shall mention the line of Pulastya.
verses.hindi: गाणपत्यं दृढं प्राप्तः सर्वदेवनमस्कृतः। आसीत्त्रिधन्वनश्चापि विद्ठांस्त्रय्यारुणो नृप: तेनाधर्मेण संयुक्तं राजा त्रस्यारुणोऽत्यजत्
verses.wordMeaning: Devas had nine sources of origin. I shall mention the line of Pulastya.
verses.commentary: Sense: Devas had nine sources of origin. I shall mention the line of Pulastya.

verses.sanskrit: अदितिश् च दितिश्चैव अरिष्टा सुरसा मुनिः सुरभिर् विनता ताम्रा तद्वत् क्रोधवशा इला
verses.transliteration: aditiś ca ditiścaiva ariṣṭā surasā muniḥ surabhir vinatā tāmrā tadvat krodhavaśā ilā
verses.translation: Viravas the great sngt was bom of llavila. His four wives are the progenitors of the famity of Pulastya.
verses.hindi: सूतजी बोले है द्विजो! त्रिधन्वाने देवदेव तण्डीको कृपासे प्रयत्नपूर्वक हजार अश्वमेधयज्ञोंका फल प्राप्त करके सभी देवताओंसे नमस्कृत होकर महान् गणाधिपपद प्राप्त कर लिया। उन त्रिधन्वाके पुत्र
verses.wordMeaning: Viravas the great sngt was bom of llavila. His four wives are the progenitors of the famity of Pulastya.
verses.commentary: Sense: Viravas the great sngt was bom of llavila. His four wives are the progenitors of the famity of Pulastya.

verses.sanskrit: कद्रूस्त्विषा दनुस्तद्वत् तासां पुत्रान्वदामि वः तुषिता नाम ये देवाश् चाक्षुषस्यान्तरे मनोः
verses.transliteration: kadrūstviṣā danustadvat tāsāṃ putrānvadāmi vaḥ tuṣitā nāma ye devāś cākṣuṣasyāntare manoḥ
verses.translation: The first wife Devavarnini was the splendid daugh- ter of Bfhaspati. The second and third wives were the two
verses.hindi: विद्वान् राजा त्रय्यारुण थे। उन त्रय्यारुण-का सत्यव्रत नामक महाबली पुत्र हुआ। उसने अमित तेजवाले विदर्भ देशके राजाको मारकर पाणिग्रहणके मन्त्रके पूर्ण होनेसे पहले ही उसकी पत्नीका हरण कर लिया। तब राजा ्रय्यारुणने उस अधर्मसे युक्त अपने पुत्रका त्याग कर
verses.wordMeaning: The first wife Devavarnini was the splendid daugh- ter of Bfhaspati. The second and third wives were the two
verses.commentary: Sense: The first wife Devavarnini was the splendid daugh- ter of Bfhaspati. The second and third wives were the two

verses.sanskrit: वैवस्वतान्तरे ते वै आदित्या द्वादश स्मृताः इन्द्रो धाता भगस्त्वष्ट मित्रो ऽथ वरुणो ऽर्यमा
verses.transliteration: vaivasvatāntare te vai ādityā dvādaśa smṛtāḥ indro dhātā bhagastvaṣṭa mitro 'tha varuṇo 'ryamā
verses.translation: Vibhi9a9a is glorified as the knower of Dharma. He was a highly pure soul.
verses.hindi: हे द्विजो! तत्पश्चात् पिताके द्वारा त्यक्त उस सत्यत्रत-ने पितासे कहा--'मैं कहाँ जाऊँ?” तर
verses.wordMeaning: Vibhi9a9a is glorified as the knower of Dharma. He was a highly pure soul.
verses.commentary: Sense: Vibhi9a9a is glorified as the knower of Dharma. He was a highly pure soul.

verses.sanskrit: विवस्वान्सविता पूषा अंशुमान् विष्णुरेव च एते सहस्रकिरणा आदित्या द्वादश स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: vivasvānsavitā pūṣā aṃśumān viṣṇureva ca ete sahasrakiraṇā ādityā dvādaśa smṛtāḥ
verses.translation: BhadrMva begot of the celestial damsel Ghftaci ten children viz Bhadra, Abhadra, Jalad, Manda, Analnda (or Nanda), Bala, Abala, Gk>pabala, Tamarasa and Vara- krida
verses.hindi: इक्ष्वाकुवंशी राजाओंकी कथा तथा ययातिवंश-वर्णन स तु सत्यत्रतो धीमाञ्छ्पाकावसथान्तिके
verses.wordMeaning: BhadrMva begot of the celestial damsel Ghftaci ten children viz Bhadra, Abhadra, Jalad, Manda, Analnda (or Nanda), Bala, Abala, Gk>pabala, Tamarasa and Vara- krida
verses.commentary: Sense: BhadrMva begot of the celestial damsel Ghftaci ten children viz Bhadra, Abhadra, Jalad, Manda, Analnda (or Nanda), Bala, Abala, Gk>pabala, Tamarasa and Vara- krida

verses.sanskrit: दितिः पुत्रद्वयं लेभे कश्यपादिति नः श्रुतम् हिरण्यकशिपुं चैव हिरण्याक्षं तथैव च
verses.transliteration: ditiḥ putradvayaṃ lebhe kaśyapāditi naḥ śrutam hiraṇyakaśipuṃ caiva hiraṇyākṣaṃ tathaiva ca
verses.translation: These arc the progenitors of the family of Atreya. Their husband is Prabhakara. When the sun was swallowed by Rahu and he fell down towards the earth from the heavens the whole world was enveloped in darkness. At that time Atri spread lustre everywhere. He said *'Hail to Thee*' and then the falling sun ceased to fall at the instance of the brahmi n sage. Then Atri was called Prabhakara by the great sages.
verses.hindi: सर्वलोकेषु विख्यातस्त्रिशङ्कुरिति वीर्यवान्
verses.wordMeaning: These arc the progenitors of the family of Atreya. Their husband is Prabhakara. When the sun was swallowed by Rahu and he fell down towards the earth from the heavens the whole world was enveloped in darkness. At that time Atri spread lustre everywhere.…
verses.commentary: Sense: These arc the progenitors of the family of Atreya. Their husband is Prabhakara. When the sun was swallowed by Rahu and he fell down towards the earth from the heavens the whole world was enveloped in darkness. At that time Atri spread lustre everywhere.…

verses.sanskrit: दनुः पुत्रशतं लेभे कश्यपाद् बलदर्पितम् विप्रचित्तिः प्रधानो ऽभूत् तेषां मध्ये द्विजोत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: danuḥ putraśataṃ lebhe kaśyapād baladarpitam vipracittiḥ pradhāno 'bhūt teṣāṃ madhye dvijottamāḥ
verses.translation: He bot of Bhadr& the renowned son Soma (Moon). The sage procreated more sons of those wives.
verses.hindi: ब्रसिष्ठकोपात्पुण्यात्मा राजा सत्यव्रतः पुरा। विश्वामित्रों महातेजा वरं दत्त्वा त्रिशङ्कवे राज्येऽभिषिच्य तं पित्र्ये याजयामास तं मुनिः। मिषतां देवतानां च वसिष्ठस्य च कौशिकः
verses.wordMeaning: He bot of Bhadr& the renowned son Soma (Moon). The sage procreated more sons of those wives.
verses.commentary: Sense: He bot of Bhadr& the renowned son Soma (Moon). The sage procreated more sons of those wives.

verses.sanskrit: ताम्रा च जनयामास षट् कन्या द्विजपुङ्गवाः शुकीं श्येनीं च भासीं च सुग्रीवीं गृध्रिकां शुचिम्
verses.transliteration: tāmrā ca janayāmāsa ṣaṭ kanyā dvijapuṅgavāḥ śukīṃ śyenīṃ ca bhāsīṃ ca sugrīvīṃ gṛdhrikāṃ śucim
verses.translation: TTiey arc well known as Svastyatreyas. They were sages and masters of the Vedas. Two of them became well reno- wned. They had realised Brahman. They were very powerful.
verses.hindi: रुचकस्तस्य तनयो राजा परमधार्मिकः
verses.wordMeaning: TTiey arc well known as Svastyatreyas. They were sages and masters of the Vedas. Two of them became well reno- wned. They had realised Brahman. They were very powerful.
verses.commentary: Sense: TTiey arc well known as Svastyatreyas. They were sages and masters of the Vedas. Two of them became well reno- wned. They had realised Brahman. They were very powerful.

verses.sanskrit: शुकी शुकानुलूकांश् च जनयामास धर्मतः श्येनी श्येनांस् तथा भासी कुरङ्गांश् च व्यजीजनत्
verses.transliteration: śukī śukānulūkāṃś ca janayāmāsa dharmataḥ śyenī śyenāṃs tathā bhāsī kuraṅgāṃś ca vyajījanat
verses.translation: Datta was the eldest son of Atri. Durvasas was his younger brother. The youngest sister was Amala, an expounder of the Brahman.
verses.hindi: सगरस्तस्य पुत्रोऽभूद्राजा परमधार्मिकः है भार्ये सगरस्यापि प्रभा भानुमती तथा। ताभ्यामाराधितः पूर्वमौर्वोऽग्निः पुत्रकाम्यया
verses.wordMeaning: Datta was the eldest son of Atri. Durvasas was his younger brother. The youngest sister was Amala, an expounder of the Brahman.
verses.commentary: Sense: Datta was the eldest son of Atri. Durvasas was his younger brother. The youngest sister was Amala, an expounder of the Brahman.

verses.sanskrit: गृध्री गृध्रान् कपोतांश् च पारावती विहंगमान् हंससारसकारण्डप्लवाञ्छुचिरजीजनत्
verses.transliteration: gṛdhrī gṛdhrān kapotāṃś ca pārāvatī vihaṃgamān haṃsasārasakāraṇḍaplavāñchucirajījanat
verses.translation: Four of them bom of two Gotras are well known in the world, viz. Syava, Pratvasa, Vavalgu and Gahvara.
verses.hindi: एका षष्टिसहस्त्राण सुतमेकं परा तथा
verses.wordMeaning: Four of them bom of two Gotras are well known in the world, viz. Syava, Pratvasa, Vavalgu and Gahvara.
verses.commentary: Sense: Four of them bom of two Gotras are well known in the world, viz. Syava, Pratvasa, Vavalgu and Gahvara.

verses.sanskrit: अजाश्वमेषोष्ट्रखरान् सुग्रीवी चाप्यजीजनत् विनता जनयामास गरुडं चारुणं शुभा
verses.transliteration: ajāśvameṣoṣṭrakharān sugrīvī cāpyajījanat vinatā janayāmāsa garuḍaṃ cāruṇaṃ śubhā
verses.translation: Four lines of the spiritual family of Atreyas of noble souls are known as Kayapa N&rada, Parvata and Anudd- hata.
verses.hindi: पिताने उससे कहा--'तुम चाण्डालोंके साथ रहो' इस प्रकार कहा गया वह सत्यव्रत पिताके आदेशसे नगरसे निकल गया और पिताके द्वारा त्यक्त वह बुद्धिमान् सत्यव्रत चाण्डालोंके निवासस्थानके समीप रहने लगा और उसके पिता वनमें चले गये । पूर्वकालमें वसिष्ठके कोपके
verses.wordMeaning: Four lines of the spiritual family of Atreyas of noble souls are known as Kayapa N&rada, Parvata and Anudd- hata.
verses.commentary: Sense: Four lines of the spiritual family of Atreyas of noble souls are known as Kayapa N&rada, Parvata and Anudd- hata.

verses.sanskrit: सौदामिनीं तथा कन्यां सर्वलोकभयङ्करीम् सुरसायाः सहस्रं तु सर्पाणामभवत्पुरा
verses.transliteration: saudāminīṃ tathā kanyāṃ sarvalokabhayaṅkarīm surasāyāḥ sahasraṃ tu sarpāṇāmabhavatpurā
verses.translation: These were born as mental sons. Now understand the children of Arundhati. It was Narada who gave Arundhati to Vasithit*
verses.hindi: कारण वह पुण्यात्मा राजा सत्यव्रत सभी लोकोंमें पराक्रमी त्रिशंकु-इस नामसे विख्यात हुआ  उसके बाद महातेजस्वी मुनि विश्वामित्रने त्रिशंकुको वर प्रदानकर उसे पिताके राज्यपर अभिषिक्त करके उससे यज्ञ कराया था। देवताओं
verses.wordMeaning: These were born as mental sons. Now understand the children of Arundhati. It was Narada who gave Arundhati to Vasithit*
verses.commentary: Sense: These were born as mental sons. Now understand the children of Arundhati. It was Narada who gave Arundhati to Vasithit*

verses.sanskrit: कद्रूः सहस्रशिरसां सहस्रं प्राप सुव्रता प्रधानास्तेषु विख्याताः षड्विंशतिरनुत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: kadrūḥ sahasraśirasāṃ sahasraṃ prāpa suvratā pradhānāsteṣu vikhyātāḥ ṣaḍviṃśatiranuttamāḥ
verses.translation: Due to a curse of Dak$a, Narada of great splendour became a bachelor by compulsion.
verses.hindi: तथा वसिष्ठके निषेध करनेपर भी ऐश्वर्यशाली विश्वामित्रने उसे सशरीर स्वर्ग भेज दिया था॥ ६--९ /२॥ कैकयवंशमें उत्पन्न उसकी सत्यव्रता नामक भार्याने निष्पाप हरिश्चन्द्र नामक पुत्रको जन्म दिया। हरिश्चन्द्रका रोहित नामक पराक्रमी पुत्र था। रोहितका पुत्र हरित था । हरितका पुत्र धुंधु कहा जाता है । धुंधुके दो
verses.wordMeaning: Due to a curse of Dak$a, Narada of great splendour became a bachelor by compulsion.
verses.commentary: Sense: Due to a curse of Dak$a, Narada of great splendour became a bachelor by compulsion.

verses.sanskrit: शेषवासुकिकर्कोटशङ्खैरावतकम्बलाः धनञ्जयमहानीलपद्माश्वतरतक्षकाः
verses.transliteration: śeṣavāsukikarkoṭaśaṅkhairāvatakambalāḥ dhanañjayamahānīlapadmāśvataratakṣakāḥ
verses.translation: Vasitha begot hundred sons of Arundhati. Adfiyantl bore to Sakti, the eldest of those hundred, the son Paraiara.
verses.hindi: पुत्र हुए-विजय और सुतेज। उस विजय -ने समस्त कषत्रियोंको जीत लिया था, अतः उसे विजय कहा गया है। उसका पुत्र रुचक महान् धार्मिक राजा था। रुचकका पुत्र वृक था। उस वृक -से बाहु उत्पन्न हुआ। उसका
verses.wordMeaning: Vasitha begot hundred sons of Arundhati. Adfiyantl bore to Sakti, the eldest of those hundred, the son Paraiara.
verses.commentary: Sense: Vasitha begot hundred sons of Arundhati. Adfiyantl bore to Sakti, the eldest of those hundred, the son Paraiara.

verses.sanskrit: एलापत्रमहापद्मधृतराष्ट्रबलाहकाः शङ्खपालमहाशङ्खपुष्पदंष्ट्रशुभाननाः
verses.transliteration: elāpatramahāpadmadhṛtarāṣṭrabalāhakāḥ śaṅkhapālamahāśaṅkhapuṣpadaṃṣṭraśubhānanāḥ
verses.translation: Sakti was swallowed by the demon Rudhira (along with his brothers). Kali bore to Parara the son K|r$ia Dvaipayana.
verses.hindi: पुत्र सगर हुआ; वह परम धार्मिक राजा था सगरकी भी प्रभा तथा भानुमती नामक दो भार्याएँ थीं। उन दोनोंने पूर्वकालमें पुत्रको कामनासे अग्निसदृश और्व ऋषिकी आराधना की थी; और्वने प्रसन्न होकर उन्हें यथेष्ट उत्तम वर प्रदान किया। उनमेंसे एक रानी-ने
verses.wordMeaning: Sakti was swallowed by the demon Rudhira (along with his brothers). Kali bore to Parara the son K|r$ia Dvaipayana.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sakti was swallowed by the demon Rudhira (along with his brothers). Kali bore to Parara the son K|r$ia Dvaipayana.

verses.sanskrit: शङ्खलोमा च नहुषो वामनः फणितस् तथा कपिलो दुर्मुखश्चापि पतञ्जलिरिति स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: śaṅkhalomā ca nahuṣo vāmanaḥ phaṇitas tathā kapilo durmukhaścāpi patañjaliriti smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: Henceforth understand the descendants of Indrapra miti. Vasi$tha begot of Ghrtaci the son Kapiftjalya. He who is known as Trimtitri is called Indrapramiti. Bhadra was born of Pfthu's daughter. His son was Vasu whose son was Upamanyu. There are many descendants of Upamanyu, Mitra and Vanity. Those who are known as Kaudiy the descendants of Mitra and Varuinui.**
verses.hindi: साठ हजार तथा दूसरीने वंशको बढ़ानेवाले एक प्रको । माँगा था। प्रभाने बहुत पुत्रोंको प्राप्त किया और भानुमतीने  असमंजस नामक एक पुत्रको प्राप्त किया। उसके ॥ प्रभाने जिन साठ हजार पुत्रोंको जन्म दिया था, वे पृथ्वीको
verses.wordMeaning: Henceforth understand the descendants of Indrapra miti. Vasi$tha begot of Ghrtaci the son Kapiftjalya. He who is known as Trimtitri is called Indrapramiti. Bhadra was born of Pfthu's daughter. His son was Vasu whose son was Upamanyu. There are many descendants of Upamanyu,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Henceforth understand the descendants of Indrapra miti. Vasi$tha begot of Ghrtaci the son Kapiftjalya. He who is known as Trimtitri is called Indrapramiti. Bhadra was born of Pfthu's daughter. His son was Vasu whose son was Upamanyu. There are many descendants of Upamanyu,…

verses.sanskrit: रक्षोगणं क्रोधवशा महामायं व्यजीजनत् रुद्राणां च गणं तद्वद् गोमहिष्यौ वराङ्गना
verses.transliteration: rakṣogaṇaṃ krodhavaśā mahāmāyaṃ vyajījanat rudrāṇāṃ ca gaṇaṃ tadvad gomahiṣyau varāṅganā
verses.translation: O Suta, O best speaker, it behoves you to recount how Sakti the son of Vasi§tha was devoured by a demon along with his younger brothers.
verses.hindi: खोदते हुए कपिलरूप विष्णुके हुंकाररूपी बाणोंसे दध  असमंजसके पुत्र अंशुमान् नामसे विख्यात हुए। उन अंशुमान्-के पुत्र दिलीप थे और दिलीपे । भगीरथ हुए, जिन्होंने तपस्या करके भागीरथी गंगाका  अवतरण कराया। भगीरथके श्रुत नामक पुत्र हुए। उन
verses.wordMeaning: O Suta, O best speaker, it behoves you to recount how Sakti the son of Vasi§tha was devoured by a demon along with his younger brothers.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Suta, O best speaker, it behoves you to recount how Sakti the son of Vasi§tha was devoured by a demon along with his younger brothers.

verses.sanskrit: सुरभिर् जनयामास कश्यपादिति नः श्रुतम् मुनिर्मुनीनां च गणं गणमप्सरसां तथा
verses.transliteration: surabhir janayāmāsa kaśyapāditi naḥ śrutam munirmunīnāṃ ca gaṇaṃ gaṇamapsarasāṃ tathā
verses.translation: The demon Rudhira*'* devoured Sakti the son of Vasi§tha along with his younger brothers due to a curse by iSakti on king Kalmasapada. O leading brahmins, urged by ViSvamitra, Rudhira haunted the king Kalmasapada for whom
verses.hindi: श्रुत-के पुत्र नाभाग हुए, जो शिवभक्त तथा प्रतापशाली  थे। उन नाभाग-के अम्बरीष नामक पुत्र हुए। उन  अम्बरीष-से सिन्धुद्दीप उत्पन्न हुए। नाभागुत्र  अम्बरीषके द्वारा भुजाओंसे भली-भाँति पालित की.
verses.wordMeaning: The demon Rudhira*'* devoured Sakti the son of Vasi§tha along with his younger brothers due to a curse by iSakti on king Kalmasapada. O leading brahmins, urged by ViSvamitra, Rudhira haunted the king Kalmasapada for whom
verses.commentary: Sense: The demon Rudhira*'* devoured Sakti the son of Vasi§tha along with his younger brothers due to a curse by iSakti on king Kalmasapada. O leading brahmins, urged by ViSvamitra, Rudhira haunted the king Kalmasapada for whom

verses.sanskrit: तथा किंनरगन्धर्वान् अरिष्टाजनयद्बहून् तृणवृक्षलतागुल्मम् इला सर्वमजीजनत्
verses.transliteration: tathā kiṃnaragandharvān ariṣṭājanayadbahūn tṛṇavṛkṣalatāgulmam ilā sarvamajījanat
verses.translation: On hearing that the most powerful Sakti had been devoured by that demon along with his brothers, Vasistha repeatedly lamented ''ha (my) son, ha (my) son". The wailing sage fell down on the ground along with Arundhatl.
verses.hindi: गयी पृथ्वी हैहिक, हैविक, भौतिक तीनों प्रकारके तापोंसे पूर्णरूपसे विहीन हो गयी थी॥ १९--२२॥ उन सिन्धुद्रीपके अयुतायु नामक पराक्रमी पुत्र हुए। अयुतायुके ऋतुपर्ण नामक पुत्र हुए; वे बुद्धिमान् तथा महायशस्वी थे। वे बलवान् राजा ऋतुपर्ण नलके सखा और दिव्य द्ूतक्री डके मर्मज्ञ थे। पुराणोंमें दृढ्ब्रतवाले दो नल प्रसिद्ध हैं । एक तो वीरसेनका पुत्र था और दूसरा इक्ष्वाकुकुलमें उत्पन्न हुआ था, ऋतुपर्णके पुत्र राजा सार्वभौम
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing that the most powerful Sakti had been devoured by that demon along with his brothers, Vasistha repeatedly lamented ''ha (my) son, ha (my) son". The wailing sage fell down on the ground along with Arundhatl.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing that the most powerful Sakti had been devoured by that demon along with his brothers, Vasistha repeatedly lamented ''ha (my) son, ha (my) son". The wailing sage fell down on the ground along with Arundhatl.

verses.sanskrit: त्विषा तु यक्षरक्षांसि जनयामास कोटिशः एते तु काश्यपेयाश् च संक्षेपात्परिकीर्तिताः
verses.transliteration: tviṣā tu yakṣarakṣāṃsi janayāmāsa koṭiśaḥ ete tu kāśyapeyāś ca saṃkṣepātparikīrtitāḥ
verses.translation: Remembering his hundred sons, the eldest of whom was Sakti, and knowing that the family was extinct, the power- ful sage decided to die. Coming to this conclusion that he will not remain alive without his sons, he felt all the more miser- able. Vasi§tha the son of Brahma, theknower of everything, the self-possessed sage who had realized the Atman, climbed to the top of a mountain along with his wife. With tears welling up in the eyes he suddenly fell down on the ground. As he fell down on the ground, the earth (assuming the form of a lady) who had a wonderful necklace and the sportive gait of an elephant, caught him up with her lotus-like hands and as he cried she too bewailed with him. At that time, his daughter-in-law, the wife of Sakti, cried in great fright and spoke thus to Vasistha, the great sage and the best among the eloquent sages.
verses.hindi: हुए और उनके पुत्र सुदास हुए, वे इन्द्रके समान थे। सुदासके पुत्र राजा सौदास कहे गये हैं । उनका नाम मित्रसह था, किंतु वे कल्माषपाद नामसे प्रसिद्ध हुए। महातेजस्वी कल्माषपादके क्षेत्रमें इक्ष्वाकुकुलकी वृद्धि करनेवाले
verses.wordMeaning: Remembering his hundred sons, the eldest of whom was Sakti, and knowing that the family was extinct, the power- ful sage decided to die. Coming to this conclusion that he will not remain alive without his sons, he felt all the more miser- able. Vasi§tha the son of Brahma,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Remembering his hundred sons, the eldest of whom was Sakti, and knowing that the family was extinct, the power- ful sage decided to die. Coming to this conclusion that he will not remain alive without his sons, he felt all the more miser- able. Vasi§tha the son of Brahma,…

verses.sanskrit: एतेषां पुत्रपौत्रादिवंशाश् च बहवः स्मृताः एवं प्रजासु सृष्टासु कश्यपेन महात्मना
verses.transliteration: eteṣāṃ putrapautrādivaṃśāś ca bahavaḥ smṛtāḥ evaṃ prajāsu sṛṣṭāsu kaśyapena mahātmanā
verses.translation: "O lord, O excellent brahmin, O powerful sage, pre- serve this excellent body of yours to see your grandson, that is my son.
verses.hindi: अश्मकको उत्पन्न किया। उत्तराके गर्भसे अश्मकके मूलक नामक पुत्र उत्पन्न हुए। वे परशुरामके भयसे स्त्रियोंसे घिरे रहते थे और वनमें अपनी रक्षाकी इच्छा करते हुए उत्तम नारीकवच धारण किये रहते थे। मूलकके शतरथ नामक पुत्र हुए, वे धर्मात्मा राजा थे। उन शतरथसे बलशाली राजा इलविल उत्पन्न हुए। इलविलके पुत वृद्धशर्मा थे, जो ऐश्वर्यसम्पन्न तथा प्रतापशाली थे  उनके पुत्र विश्वसह थे, जिन्हें पितृकन्याने जन्म दिया था। उनके
verses.wordMeaning: "O lord, O excellent brahmin, O powerful sage, pre- serve this excellent body of yours to see your grandson, that is my son.
verses.commentary: Sense: "O lord, O excellent brahmin, O powerful sage, pre- serve this excellent body of yours to see your grandson, that is my son.

verses.sanskrit: प्रतिष्ठितासु सर्वासु चरासु स्थावरासु च अभिषिच्याधिपत्येषु तेषां मुख्यान्प्रजापतिः
verses.transliteration: pratiṣṭhitāsu sarvāsu carāsu sthāvarāsu ca abhiṣicyādhipatyeṣu teṣāṃ mukhyānprajāpatiḥ
verses.translation: O leading brahmin, this splendid body should not be discarded by you, since the child that is born of Sakti and that is bound to be one who realises all objects, is within my womb."
verses.hindi: पुत्र दिलीप हुए; वे खट्वांग नामसे प्रसिद्ध हुए, जिन्होनै  एक मुहूर्तका जीवन प्राप्त करके स्वर्गसे इस he  आकर अपनी बुद्धि एवं सत्यके द्वारा तीनों अग्नयो  तथा तीनों लोकोंको जीत लिया था । उनके पुत्र दीर्घब
verses.wordMeaning: O leading brahmin, this splendid body should not be discarded by you, since the child that is born of Sakti and that is bound to be one who realises all objects, is within my womb."
