verses.commentary: Sense: O leading brahmin, this splendid body should not be discarded by you, since the child that is born of Sakti and that is bound to be one who realises all objects, is within my womb."

verses.sanskrit: ततो मनुष्याधिपतिं चक्रे वैवस्वतं मनुम् स्वायंभुवे ऽन्तरे पूर्वं ब्रह्मणा ये ऽभिषेचिताः
verses.transliteration: tato manuṣyādhipatiṃ cakre vaivasvataṃ manum svāyaṃbhuve 'ntare pūrvaṃ brahmaṇā ye 'bhiṣecitāḥ
verses.translation: After saying thus, that lady who was conversant with Dharma and whose eyes resembled lotus flowers lifted up her father-in-law by her hands and wiped his eyes with water. Although she was herself miserable she requested the dejected Arundhati to save her father-in-law.
verses.hindi: अगुहाद्वंशकर्तारं प्रभागृह्णात्सुतान् बहून्। एकं भानुमतिः पुत्रमगृह्णादसमञ्जसम् खनन्तः पृथिवीं दग्धा विष्णुहुङ्कारमार्गणैः
verses.wordMeaning: After saying thus, that lady who was conversant with Dharma and whose eyes resembled lotus flowers lifted up her father-in-law by her hands and wiped his eyes with water. Although she was herself miserable she requested the dejected Arundhati to save her father-in-law.
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying thus, that lady who was conversant with Dharma and whose eyes resembled lotus flowers lifted up her father-in-law by her hands and wiped his eyes with water. Although she was herself miserable she requested the dejected Arundhati to save her father-in-law.

verses.sanskrit: तैरियं पृथिवी सर्वा सप्तद्वीपा सपर्वता यथोपदेशमद्यापि धर्मेण प्रतिपाल्यते
verses.transliteration: tairiyaṃ pṛthivī sarvā saptadvīpā saparvatā yathopadeśamadyāpi dharmeṇa pratipālyate
verses.translation: On hearing the words of his daughter-in-law Vasistha got up from the ground after regaining consciousness. Arundhati embraced him in great distress and fell down. The leading sage touched Arundhati, in whose eyes tears had welled up and cried along with her.
verses.hindi: दिव्याक्षहृदयज्ञो वै राजा नलसखो बली। नलौ द्वावेव विख्यातौ पुराणेषु दूढव्रतौ
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing the words of his daughter-in-law Vasistha got up from the ground after regaining consciousness. Arundhati embraced him in great distress and fell down. The leading sage touched Arundhati, in whose eyes tears had welled up and cried along with her.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the words of his daughter-in-law Vasistha got up from the ground after regaining consciousness. Arundhati embraced him in great distress and fell down. The leading sage touched Arundhati, in whose eyes tears had welled up and cried along with her.

verses.sanskrit: स्वायंभुवे ऽन्तरे पूर्वे ब्रह्मणा ये ऽभिषेचिताः ते ह्येते चाभिषिच्यन्ते मनवश् च भवन्ति ते
verses.transliteration: svāyaṃbhuve 'ntare pūrve brahmaṇā ye 'bhiṣecitāḥ te hyete cābhiṣicyante manavaś ca bhavanti te
verses.translation: Thereafter the son seated in the couch of the womb of his mother, like the four-faced lord Brahma in the umbilical lotus of Visnu repeated a sacred verse. The holy sage Vasisha listened enthusiastically to the sacred verse wondering, by whom could it have been repeated. He then meditated with great con- centration.
verses.hindi: वीरसेनसुतश्चान्यो यश्चेक्ष्वाकुकुलोद्भवः। ऋतुपर्णस्य पुत्रोऽभूत्सार्वभौमः प्रजेशवरः सुदासस्तस्य तनयो राजा त्तिन्द्रसमोऽभवत्।
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter the son seated in the couch of the womb of his mother, like the four-faced lord Brahma in the umbilical lotus of Visnu repeated a sacred verse. The holy sage Vasisha listened enthusiastically to the sacred verse wondering, by whom could it have been repeated.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter the son seated in the couch of the womb of his mother, like the four-faced lord Brahma in the umbilical lotus of Visnu repeated a sacred verse. The holy sage Vasisha listened enthusiastically to the sacred verse wondering, by whom could it have been repeated.…

verses.sanskrit: मन्वन्तरेष्वतीतेषु गता ह्येतेषु पार्थिवाः एवमन्ये ऽभिषिच्यन्ते प्राप्ते मन्वन्तरे ततः
verses.transliteration: manvantareṣvatīteṣu gatā hyeteṣu pārthivāḥ evamanye 'bhiṣicyante prāpte manvantare tataḥ
verses.translation: Thereupon Viu whose eyes resemble the lotus petals, who had been stationed in the courtyard of the firmament, who is the soul of the universe and who is the storehouse of mercy spoke to Vasistha mercifully.
verses.hindi: वसिष्ठस्तु महातेजाः क्षेत्रे कल्माषपादके
verses.wordMeaning: Thereupon Viu whose eyes resemble the lotus petals, who had been stationed in the courtyard of the firmament, who is the soul of the universe and who is the storehouse of mercy spoke to Vasistha mercifully.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereupon Viu whose eyes resemble the lotus petals, who had been stationed in the courtyard of the firmament, who is the soul of the universe and who is the storehouse of mercy spoke to Vasistha mercifully.

verses.sanskrit: अतीतानागताः सर्वे नृपा मन्वन्तरे स्मृताः एतानुत्पाद्य पुत्रांस्तु प्रजासंतानकारणात्
verses.transliteration: atītānāgatāḥ sarve nṛpā manvantare smṛtāḥ etānutpādya putrāṃstu prajāsaṃtānakāraṇāt
verses.translation: O dear one, O dear one, O Vasi§tha the leading brah- min, fond of his son, this sacred verse has emanated from the lotuslike face of your grandson. O sage, this grandson of yours, the powerful one born of Sakti is on a par with me. Hence, O most excellent sage and son of Brahma, diicafd your grief and rise up.
verses.hindi: स हि रामभयाद्राजा स्त्रीभिः परिवृतो वने। बिभर्ति त्राणमिच्छन् वै नारीकवचमुत्तमम् मूलकस्यापि धर्मात्मा राजा शतरथः सुतः। तस्माच्छतरथाजज्ञे राजा त्विलविलो बली
verses.wordMeaning: O dear one, O dear one, O Vasi§tha the leading brah- min, fond of his son, this sacred verse has emanated from the lotuslike face of your grandson. O sage, this grandson of yours, the powerful one born of Sakti is on a par with me. Hence,…
verses.commentary: Sense: O dear one, O dear one, O Vasi§tha the leading brah- min, fond of his son, this sacred verse has emanated from the lotuslike face of your grandson. O sage, this grandson of yours, the powerful one born of Sakti is on a par with me. Hence,…

verses.sanskrit: कश्यपो गोत्रकामस्तु चचार स पुनस्तपः पुत्रो गोत्रकरो मह्यं भवताद् इति चिन्तयन्
verses.transliteration: kaśyapo gotrakāmastu cacāra sa punastapaḥ putro gotrakaro mahyaṃ bhavatād iti cintayan
verses.translation: The child ffii the womb is a devotee of Rudra. He is engaged in the worship of Rudra. Thanks to the power of Rudra he will redeem your family.
verses.hindi: त्रयोऽग्नयस्त्रयो लोका बुद्धया सत्येन वै जिता: । दीर्घबाहुः सुतस्तस्य रघुस्तस्मादजायत
verses.wordMeaning: The child ffii the womb is a devotee of Rudra. He is engaged in the worship of Rudra. Thanks to the power of Rudra he will redeem your family.
verses.commentary: Sense: The child ffii the womb is a devotee of Rudra. He is engaged in the worship of Rudra. Thanks to the power of Rudra he will redeem your family.

verses.sanskrit: तस्यैवं ध्यायमानस्य कश्यपस्य महात्मनः ब्रह्मयोगात्सुतौ पश्चात् प्रादुर्भूतौ महौजसौ
verses.transliteration: tasyaivaṃ dhyāyamānasya kaśyapasya mahātmanaḥ brahmayogātsutau paścāt prādurbhūtau mahaujasau
verses.translation: After saying thus to Vasitha, the leading Brahmin sage, the merciful lord vanished there itself. Vasitha of great splendour bowed his head to the lotus- eyed lord and then stroked the belly of Adjryanti with great respect.
verses.hindi: रामो दशरथाद्वीरो धर्मज्ञो लोकविश्रुतः। रावणं समरे हत्वा यज्ञैरिष्ट्वा च धर्मवित्
verses.wordMeaning: After saying thus to Vasitha, the leading Brahmin sage, the merciful lord vanished there itself. Vasitha of great splendour bowed his head to the lotus- eyed lord and then stroked the belly of Adjryanti with great respect.
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying thus to Vasitha, the leading Brahmin sage, the merciful lord vanished there itself. Vasitha of great splendour bowed his head to the lotus- eyed lord and then stroked the belly of Adjryanti with great respect.

verses.sanskrit: वत्सरश्चासितश्चैव तावुभौ ब्रह्मवादिनौ वत्सरान्नैध्रुवो जज्ञे रैभ्यश् च सुमहायशाः
verses.transliteration: vatsaraścāsitaścaiva tāvubhau brahmavādinau vatsarānnaidhruvo jajñe raibhyaś ca sumahāyaśāḥ
verses.translation: O brahmins, he cried out *'ha my son, ha my son", and fell down extremely depressed. Glancing at Arundhati who was also crying and rememberii his own son he cried out in misery — son, come again, come again. O Sakti, after the birth of your son who will sustain this family. I shall undou- btedly come near you along with your mother".
verses.hindi: रामो राज्यं चकार स:।
verses.wordMeaning: O brahmins, he cried out *'ha my son, ha my son", and fell down extremely depressed. Glancing at Arundhati who was also crying and rememberii his own son he cried out in misery — son, come again, come again. O Sakti, after the birth of your son who will sustain this family.…
verses.commentary: Sense: O brahmins, he cried out *'ha my son, ha my son", and fell down extremely depressed. Glancing at Arundhati who was also crying and rememberii his own son he cried out in misery — son, come again, come again. O Sakti, after the birth of your son who will sustain this family.…

verses.sanskrit: रैभ्यस्य रैभ्या विज्ञेया नैध्रुवस्य वदामि वः च्यवनस्य तु कन्यायां सुमेधाः समपद्यत
verses.transliteration: raibhyasya raibhyā vijñeyā naidhruvasya vadāmi vaḥ cyavanasya tu kanyāyāṃ sumedhāḥ samapadyata
verses.translation: The auspicious lady Ad]:iyanti who was distressed beat her belly — the abode of the child in womb. She cried out in distress and fell down. Arundhad and Vasitha, both of them were extremely frightened. They lifted up the young woman their dxa|ter-in-law and said thus: — "If the excellent saRe ha-» to preserve his life
verses.hindi: नभसः पुण्डरीकाख्यः क्षेमधन्वा ततः स्मृतः तस्य पुत्रोऽभवद्वीरो देवानीकः प्रतापवान्।
verses.wordMeaning: The auspicious lady Ad]:iyanti who was distressed beat her belly — the abode of the child in womb. She cried out in distress and fell down. Arundhad and Vasitha, both of them were extremely frightened.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The auspicious lady Ad]:iyanti who was distressed beat her belly — the abode of the child in womb. She cried out in distress and fell down. Arundhad and Vasitha, both of them were extremely frightened.…

verses.sanskrit: नैध्रुवस्य तु सा पत्नी माता वै कुण्डपायिनाम् असितस्यैकपर्णायां ब्रह्मिष्ठः समपद्यत
verses.transliteration: naidhruvasya tu sā patnī mātā vai kuṇḍapāyinām asitasyaikaparṇāyāṃ brahmiṣṭhaḥ samapadyata
verses.translation: It is because of my sin that I have to bear the sorrow of separation firom my husband. O sage, I am burnt 'vy'ith Rricf, even though I am your daughter-in-law, O sage. Alas, a miracle been seen by me. O lord, I am the victim of grief. O brahmin, be my silTO'ir from raiser/, O sen of Brahma, O preceptor of the universe.
verses.hindi: शुभश्चन्द्रावलोकश्च तारापीडस्ततोऽभवत्। तस्यात्मजश्चन्द्रगिरिर्भानुचन्द्रस्ततोऽभवत्
verses.wordMeaning: It is because of my sin that I have to bear the sorrow of separation firom my husband. O sage, I am burnt 'vy'ith Rricf, even though I am your daughter-in-law, O sage. Alas, a miracle been seen by me. O lord, I am the victim of grief. O brahmin, be my silTO'ir from raiser/,…
verses.commentary: Sense: It is because of my sin that I have to bear the sorrow of separation firom my husband. O sage, I am burnt 'vy'ith Rricf, even though I am your daughter-in-law, O sage. Alas, a miracle been seen by me. O lord, I am the victim of grief. O brahmin, be my silTO'ir from raiser/,…

verses.sanskrit: शाण्डिल्यानां वरः श्रीमान् देवलः सुमहातपाः शाण्डिल्या नैध्रुवा रैभ्यास् त्रयः पक्षास्तु काश्यपाः
verses.transliteration: śāṇḍilyānāṃ varaḥ śrīmān devalaḥ sumahātapāḥ śāṇḍilyā naidhruvā raibhyās trayaḥ pakṣāstu kāśyapāḥ
verses.translation: Still, a woman without a husband shall be miserable. The father, mother, sons, grandsons, even the father-in- law, all arc helpless to such a woman. None of them can be a real kinsman unto women. It is the husband alone who is her real kinsman, her greatest salvation.
verses.hindi: एते इक्ष्वाकुदायादा राजानः प्रायशः स्मृताः। वंशे प्रधाना एतस्मिन् प्राधान्येन प्रकीर्तिताः समभ्यर्च्य यथाज्ञानमिष्ट्वा यज्ञैर्यथाविधि॥
verses.wordMeaning: Still, a woman without a husband shall be miserable. The father, mother, sons, grandsons, even the father-in- law, all arc helpless to such a woman. None of them can be a real kinsman unto women. It is the husband alone who is her real kinsman, her greatest salvation.
verses.commentary: Sense: Still, a woman without a husband shall be miserable. The father, mother, sons, grandsons, even the father-in- law, all arc helpless to such a woman. None of them can be a real kinsman unto women. It is the husband alone who is her real kinsman, her greatest salvation.

verses.sanskrit: नव प्रकृतयो देवाः पुलस्त्यस्य वदामि वः चतुर्युगे ह्यतिक्रान्ते मनोरेकादशे प्रभोः
verses.transliteration: nava prakṛtayo devāḥ pulastyasya vadāmi vaḥ caturyuge hyatikrānte manorekādaśe prabhoḥ
verses.translation: What has been mentioned by the learned men! viz. the wife is half of the husband, has turned out to be not true in my case. Sakti has gone. But I still survive.
verses.hindi: दिवं गता महात्मानः केचिन्मुक्तात्मयोगिनः। नृगो ब्राह्मणशापेन कृकलासत्वमागतः
verses.wordMeaning: What has been mentioned by the learned men! viz. the wife is half of the husband, has turned out to be not true in my case. Sakti has gone. But I still survive.
verses.commentary: Sense: What has been mentioned by the learned men! viz. the wife is half of the husband, has turned out to be not true in my case. Sakti has gone. But I still survive.

verses.sanskrit: अर्धावशिष्टे तस्मिंस्तु द्वापरे सम्प्रवर्तिते मानवस्य नरिष्यन्तः पुत्र आसीद् दमः किल
verses.transliteration: ardhāvaśiṣṭe tasmiṃstu dvāpare sampravartite mānavasya nariṣyantaḥ putra āsīd damaḥ kila
verses.translation: O Vasitha, just as a creeper climbing on the holy fig tree,, survives even after being cut off from its roots, I too survive On hearing these words of his daughter-in-law, the intelligent Vasistha who observed the duties of his stage of life decided to go to his hermitage along with his wife.
verses.hindi: धृष्टस्य धृष्टकेतुश्च यमबालश्च वीर्यवान्। रणधृष्टस्य ते पुत्रास्त्रयः परमधार्मिकाः आनर्तो नाम शर्यातिः सुकन्या नाम दारिका आनर्तस्याभवत्पुत्रो रोचमानः प्रतापवान्
verses.wordMeaning: O Vasitha, just as a creeper climbing on the holy fig tree,, survives even after being cut off from its roots, I too survive On hearing these words of his daughter-in-law,…
verses.commentary: Sense: O Vasitha, just as a creeper climbing on the holy fig tree,, survives even after being cut off from its roots, I too survive On hearing these words of his daughter-in-law,…

verses.sanskrit: दमस्य तस्य दायादस् तृणबिन्दुरिति स्मृतः त्रेतायुगमुखे राजा तृतीये संबभूव ह
verses.transliteration: damasya tasya dāyādas tṛṇabinduriti smṛtaḥ tretāyugamukhe rājā tṛtīye saṃbabhūva ha
verses.translation: The meritorious-souled holy lord Vasistha though suffering badly, entered his hermitage quickly, accompanied by his wife and Adryanti, and began to ponder.
verses.hindi: नाभागादम्बरीषस्तु विष्णुभक्तः प्रतापवान।
verses.wordMeaning: The meritorious-souled holy lord Vasistha though suffering badly, entered his hermitage quickly, accompanied by his wife and Adryanti, and began to ponder.
verses.commentary: Sense: The meritorious-souled holy lord Vasistha though suffering badly, entered his hermitage quickly, accompanied by his wife and Adryanti, and began to ponder.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य कन्या त्विलविला रूपेणाप्रतिमाभवत् पुलस्त्याय स राजर्षिस् तां कन्यां प्रत्यपादयत्
verses.transliteration: tasya kanyā tvilavilā rūpeṇāpratimābhavat pulastyāya sa rājarṣis tāṃ kanyāṃ pratyapādayat
verses.translation: O leading sages, that chaste wife of Sakti preserved the child in the womb with great difficulty for the continuity of the family line. In the tenth month the wife of Sakti gave birth to a lustrous son in the same manner as Arundhati had previously given birth to Sakti.
verses.hindi: ऋतस्तस्य सुतः श्रीमान् सर्वधर्मविदां बर: इक्ष्वाकुवंशी राजाओंकी कथा तथा 'ययातिवंश-वर्णन
verses.wordMeaning: O leading sages, that chaste wife of Sakti preserved the child in the womb with great difficulty for the continuity of the family line. In the tenth month the wife of Sakti gave birth to a lustrous son in the same manner as Arundhati had previously given birth to Sakti.
verses.commentary: Sense: O leading sages, that chaste wife of Sakti preserved the child in the womb with great difficulty for the continuity of the family line. In the tenth month the wife of Sakti gave birth to a lustrous son in the same manner as Arundhati had previously given birth to Sakti.

verses.sanskrit: ऋषिर् ऐरविलो यस्यां विश्रवाः समपद्यत तस्य पत्न्यश्चतस्रस्तु पौलस्त्यकुलवर्धनाः
verses.transliteration: ṛṣir airavilo yasyāṃ viśravāḥ samapadyata tasya patnyaścatasrastu paulastyakulavardhanāḥ
verses.translation: Sakti's wife gave birth to Parasara like Aditi who gave birin lo > uva Rvaha who gave birth to Guha and like Arani who gave birth to Agni.
verses.hindi: जी के के फ फ फ फ फ फ फ फ फ फ फ़ फ फ फ फ फ फ़ फ़ फफ फ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ फफ फफ क क़ फ़ फ
verses.wordMeaning: Sakti's wife gave birth to Parasara like Aditi who gave birin lo > uva Rvaha who gave birth to Guha and like Arani who gave birth to Agni.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sakti's wife gave birth to Parasara like Aditi who gave birin lo > uva Rvaha who gave birth to Guha and like Arani who gave birth to Agni.

verses.sanskrit: बृहस्पतेः शुभा कन्या नाम्ना वै देववर्णिनी पुष्पोत्कटा बलाका च सुते माल्यवतः स्मृतेः
verses.transliteration: bṛhaspateḥ śubhā kanyā nāmnā vai devavarṇinī puṣpotkaṭā balākā ca sute mālyavataḥ smṛteḥ
verses.translation: When the son of Sakti incarnated on the earth, Sakti, abandoned his sorrow and attained equality with the Pitrs. O leading sages, that meritorious son of stationed in the world of the Pitrs alon'* shone like the sin along wi ''
verses.hindi: हुए तथा उनसे रघु उत्पन्न हुए। उन रघुसे अज नामक पुत्र उत्पन्न हुए और उन  अज-से पराक्रमी दशरथ उत्पन्न हुए। उन दशरथसे ऐश्वर्यशाली, इक्ष्वाकुवंशको बढ़ानेवाले, वीर, धर्मज्ञ तथा लोकप्रसिद्ध राम और लक्ष्मण, भरत तथा महाबली शत्रुघ्न उत्पन्न हुए
verses.wordMeaning: When the son of Sakti incarnated on the earth, Sakti, abandoned his sorrow and attained equality with the Pitrs. O leading sages, that meritorious son of stationed in the world of the Pitrs alon'* shone like the sin along wi ''
verses.commentary: Sense: When the son of Sakti incarnated on the earth, Sakti, abandoned his sorrow and attained equality with the Pitrs. O leading sages, that meritorious son of stationed in the world of the Pitrs alon'* shone like the sin along wi ''

verses.sanskrit: कैकसी मालिनः कन्या तासां वै शृणुत प्रजाः ज्येष्ठं वैश्रवणं तस्मात् सुषुवे देववर्णिनी
verses.transliteration: kaikasī mālinaḥ kanyā tāsāṃ vai śṛṇuta prajāḥ jyeṣṭhaṃ vaiśravaṇaṃ tasmāt suṣuve devavarṇinī
verses.translation: The Pitrs who previously expounded the Brahman on the earth and the deities in heaven danced. Puskara and others moved about in the firmament showering flowers.
verses.hindi: उनमें राम श्रेष्ठ, महातेजस्वी तथा महान् ओजस्वी थे। उन धर्मज्ञ रामने युद्धमें रावणका वध करके तथा यज्ञोंके द्वारा यजन करके दस हजार वर्षोतक राज्य किया था। रामके कुश नामसे एक प्रसिद्ध पुत्र उत्पन्न हुए
verses.wordMeaning: The Pitrs who previously expounded the Brahman on the earth and the deities in heaven danced. Puskara and others moved about in the firmament showering flowers.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Pitrs who previously expounded the Brahman on the earth and the deities in heaven danced. Puskara and others moved about in the firmament showering flowers.

verses.sanskrit: कैकसी चाप्यजनयद् रावणं राक्षसाधिपम् कुम्भकर्णं शूर्पणखां धीमन्तं च विभीषणम्
verses.transliteration: kaikasī cāpyajanayad rāvaṇaṃ rākṣasādhipam kumbhakarṇaṃ śūrpaṇakhāṃ dhīmantaṃ ca vibhīṣaṇam
verses.translation: O brahmins, in the cities of the Rakiasas there were odd and painful shouts. The sages in their hermitage applauded continuously with delightful experiences. Just as the four-faced lord incarnated from the Cosmic
verses.hindi: और दूसरे लव उत्पन्न हुए, जो परम भाग्यशाली, सत्यनिष्ठ और सद्बुद्धिवाले थे। कुशसे अतिथि उत्पन्न हुए। उन अतिथि -के पुत्र निषध थे। निषधसे नल उत्पन्न हुए और उन नल-से नभ उत्पन्न हुए। नभसे पुण्डरीक नामक पुत्र उत्पन्न हुए और उनसे क्षेमधन्वा उत्पन्न कहे गये हैं। उनके देवानीक नामक वीर तथा प्रतापी पुत्र हुए। उनके पुत्र अहीनर थे तथा उनके पुत्र सहस्राशव थे। उनसे कल्याणमय चन्द्रावलोक हुए और फिर उनसे तारापीड
verses.wordMeaning: O brahmins, in the cities of the Rakiasas there were odd and painful shouts. The sages in their hermitage applauded continuously with delightful experiences. Just as the four-faced lord incarnated from the Cosmic
verses.commentary: Sense: O brahmins, in the cities of the Rakiasas there were odd and painful shouts. The sages in their hermitage applauded continuously with delightful experiences. Just as the four-faced lord incarnated from the Cosmic

verses.sanskrit: पुष्पोत्कटा ह्यजनयत् पुत्रांस्तस्माद्द्विजोत्तमाः महोदरं प्रहस्तं च महापार्श्वं खरं तथा
verses.transliteration: puṣpotkaṭā hyajanayat putrāṃstasmāddvijottamāḥ mahodaraṃ prahastaṃ ca mahāpārśvaṃ kharaṃ tathā
verses.translation: On seeing the son and remembering her husband, O brahmins, even Adrsyanti felt both joy and grief. So was the case with Arundhati and sage Vasistha.
verses.hindi: हुए। उन तारापीड-के पुत्र चन्द्रगिरि हुए और उनसे भानुचन्द्र हुए। उनसे श्रुतायु उत्पन्न हुए, उन्हें बृहदूबल कहा गया है, जिन महा-तेजस्वीको महाभारतके युद्धमें
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing the son and remembering her husband, O brahmins, even Adrsyanti felt both joy and grief. So was the case with Arundhati and sage Vasistha.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing the son and remembering her husband, O brahmins, even Adrsyanti felt both joy and grief. So was the case with Arundhati and sage Vasistha.

verses.sanskrit: कुम्भीनसीं तथा कन्यां बलायाः शृणुत प्रजाः त्रिशिरा दूषणश्चैव विद्युज्जिह्वश् च राक्षसः
verses.transliteration: kumbhīnasīṃ tathā kanyāṃ balāyāḥ śṛṇuta prajāḥ triśirā dūṣaṇaścaiva vidyujjihvaś ca rākṣasaḥ
verses.translation: On seeing her son, the highly refulgent Par5£ara, the agitated lady lamented. With her throat choked she fell down. Even as her sinless son adored by the groups of Devas and Danavas, was born the mother realized that he was highly intelligent. With tears in her eyes she lamented.
verses.hindi: इक्ष्वाकुवंशके उत्तराधिकारी राजा कहे गये हैं । इस वंशके प्रधान राजाओंका वर्णन मुख्यरूपसे कर दिया गया। ये सब शिवका ज्ञान प्राप्त करके परमेश्वरका अर्चनकर अपने ज्ञानके अनुसार विधिपूर्वक यज्ञोंके द्वारा यजन करके स्वर्ग चले गये; इनमें कुछ महात्मा तथा मुक्त आत्मावाले योगी हुए। राजा नृग एक ब्राह्मणके शापसे गिरगिटको योनिको
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing her son, the highly refulgent Par5£ara, the agitated lady lamented. With her throat choked she fell down. Even as her sinless son adored by the groups of Devas and Danavas, was born the mother realized that he was highly intelligent. With tears in her eyes she lamented.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing her son, the highly refulgent Par5£ara, the agitated lady lamented. With her throat choked she fell down. Even as her sinless son adored by the groups of Devas and Danavas, was born the mother realized that he was highly intelligent. With tears in her eyes she lamented.

verses.sanskrit: कन्या वै मालिका चापि बलायाः प्रसवः स्मृतः इत्येते क्रूरकर्माणः पौलस्त्या राक्षसा नव
verses.transliteration: kanyā vai mālikā cāpi balāyāḥ prasavaḥ smṛtaḥ ityete krūrakarmāṇaḥ paulastyā rākṣasā nava
verses.translation: "Ha, son of Vasi§tha, you have gone somewhere after abandoning me whose wretchedness is visible in the face. You have left me in the middle of the forest as one desirous of see- ing her son. O lord, you too, sec your bosom-born, sinless son.
verses.hindi: धृष्टके तीन पुत्र थे- धृष्टकेतु, यमबाल तथा पराक्रमी रणधृष्ट; वे सब परम धार्मिक थे
verses.wordMeaning: "Ha, son of Vasi§tha, you have gone somewhere after abandoning me whose wretchedness is visible in the face. You have left me in the middle of the forest as one desirous of see- ing her son. O lord, you too, sec your bosom-born, sinless son.
verses.commentary: Sense: "Ha, son of Vasi§tha, you have gone somewhere after abandoning me whose wretchedness is visible in the face. You have left me in the middle of the forest as one desirous of see- ing her son. O lord, you too, sec your bosom-born, sinless son.

verses.sanskrit: विभीषणो ऽतिशुद्धात्मा धर्मज्ञः परिकीर्तितः पुलस्त्यस्य मृगाः पुत्राः सर्वे व्याघ्राश् च दंष्ट्रिणः
verses.transliteration: vibhīṣaṇo 'tiśuddhātmā dharmajñaḥ parikīrtitaḥ pulastyasya mṛgāḥ putrāḥ sarve vyāghrāś ca daṃṣṭriṇaḥ
verses.translation: O Sakti, with his delight evident in his face MaheiSvara saw his six-faced son along with his Gas. Similarly, you too see your son in the company of your brothers". On hearing her lamentation, the excellent sage Vasistha became miserable and said to his daughter-in-law, "Do not cry.
verses.hindi: शर्यातिके आनर्त नामक पुत्र हुए और सुकन्या नामक पुत्री हुई। आनर्तके प्रतापशाली पुत्र रोचमान उत्पन्न हुए। रोचमानके पुत्र रेव हुए और रेवसे रैवत हुए जो ककुद्मी इस दूसरे नामसे भी प्रसिद्ध थे, वे सौ पुत्रोंवाले रेवके ज्येष्ठ पुत्र थे, जिनकी कन्या रेवती थी; वह राम (बलराम) -की पत्नी कही गयी है । नरिष्यन्तके एक जितात्मा तथा महाबली पुत्र था। नाभागसे अम्बरीष हुए, वे विष्णुके भक्त एवं प्रतापशाली थे। उनके पुत्र
verses.wordMeaning: O Sakti, with his delight evident in his face MaheiSvara saw his six-faced son along with his Gas. Similarly, you too see your son in the company of your brothers". On hearing her lamentation, the excellent sage Vasistha became miserable and said to his daughter-in-law,…
verses.commentary: Sense: O Sakti, with his delight evident in his face MaheiSvara saw his six-faced son along with his Gas. Similarly, you too see your son in the company of your brothers". On hearing her lamentation, the excellent sage Vasistha became miserable and said to his daughter-in-law,…

verses.sanskrit: भूताः पिशाचाः सर्पाश् च सूकरा हस्तिनस् तथा वानराः किंनराश्चैव ये च किंपुरुषास् तथा
verses.transliteration: bhūtāḥ piśācāḥ sarpāś ca sūkarā hastinas tathā vānarāḥ kiṃnarāścaiva ye ca kiṃpuruṣās tathā
verses.translation: At the behest of Vasistha, that noble lady eschewed her sorrow. That lady with roving eyes like the fawn nursed and nurtured her son.
verses.hindi: उनके पुत्र कृत हुए; उनके पुत्र सुधर्मा हुए, जो पृषित  नामसे विख्यात हुए। करूषके पुत्र कारूष हुए, वे सब प्रसिद्ध कीर्तिवाले थे। पृषितने अपने गुरुकी गायका वध करके महान् पाप किया; वे च्यवनके शापसे
verses.wordMeaning: At the behest of Vasistha, that noble lady eschewed her sorrow. That lady with roving eyes like the fawn nursed and nurtured her son.
verses.commentary: Sense: At the behest of Vasistha, that noble lady eschewed her sorrow. That lady with roving eyes like the fawn nursed and nurtured her son.

verses.sanskrit: अनपत्यः क्रतुस्तस्मिन् स्मृतो वैवस्वते ऽन्तरे अत्रेः पत्न्यो दशैवासन् सुंदर्यश् च पतिव्रताः
verses.transliteration: anapatyaḥ kratustasmin smṛto vaivasvate 'ntare atreḥ patnyo daśaivāsan suṃdaryaś ca pativratāḥ
verses.translation: On seeing his chaste mother as a weak lady, devoid of ornaments, sitting down dejectedly, with tears agitating the eyes, the boy said to her. '*0 mother, O sinless one, your slender body docs not appear to be splendid without ornaments. It is like the night bereft of the disc of the moon.
verses.hindi: शूद्रत्वको प्राप्त हुए थे--यह प्रसिद्ध है । दिष्टके पुत कृतस्तस्य सुधर्माभूत्पूषितो नाम विश्रुतः। करूषस्य तु कारूषाः सर्वे प्रख्यातकीर्तयः
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing his chaste mother as a weak lady, devoid of ornaments, sitting down dejectedly, with tears agitating the eyes, the boy said to her. '*0 mother, O sinless one, your slender body docs not appear to be splendid without ornaments.…
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing his chaste mother as a weak lady, devoid of ornaments, sitting down dejectedly, with tears agitating the eyes, the boy said to her. '*0 mother, O sinless one, your slender body docs not appear to be splendid without ornaments.…

verses.sanskrit: भद्राश्वस्य घृताच्यां वै दशाप्सरसि सूनवः भद्राभद्रा च जलदा मन्दा नन्दा तथैव च
verses.transliteration: bhadrāśvasya ghṛtācyāṃ vai daśāpsarasi sūnavaḥ bhadrābhadrā ca jaladā mandā nandā tathaiva ca
verses.translation: O my mother, O my mother, O splendid lady, it behoves you to recount to me why you are sitting here setting aside your auspicious marks as a woman without her husband."
verses.hindi: भलन्दनस्य विक्रान्तो राजासीदजवाहनः
verses.wordMeaning: O my mother, O my mother, O splendid lady, it behoves you to recount to me why you are sitting here setting aside your auspicious marks as a woman without her husband."
verses.commentary: Sense: O my mother, O my mother, O splendid lady, it behoves you to recount to me why you are sitting here setting aside your auspicious marks as a woman without her husband."

verses.sanskrit: बलाबला च विप्रेन्द्रा या च गोपाबला स्मृता तथा तामरसा चैव वरक्रीडा च वै दश
verses.transliteration: balābalā ca viprendrā yā ca gopābalā smṛtā tathā tāmarasā caiva varakrīḍā ca vai daśa
verses.translation: On hearing the words of her son, Adiyanti did not tell her son anything, good or bad. The son of Sakti said to Adrsyanti again, "O mother where is my holy father of great refulgence? Tell me, tell me.
verses.hindi: इक्ष्वाकोः पुत्रपौत्राद्या ऐलस्याथ वदामि वः उत्तरे यमुनातीरे प्रयागे मुनिसेविते। प्रतिष्ठानाधिपः श्रीमान् प्रतिष्ठाने प्रतिष्ठित:
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing the words of her son, Adiyanti did not tell her son anything, good or bad. The son of Sakti said to Adrsyanti again, "O mother where is my holy father of great refulgence? Tell me, tell me.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the words of her son, Adiyanti did not tell her son anything, good or bad. The son of Sakti said to Adrsyanti again, "O mother where is my holy father of great refulgence? Tell me, tell me.

verses.sanskrit: आत्रेयवंशप्रभवास् तासां भर्ता प्रभाकरः स्वर्भानुपिहिते सूर्ये पतिते ऽस्मिन्दिवो महीम्
verses.transliteration: ātreyavaṃśaprabhavās tāsāṃ bhartā prabhākaraḥ svarbhānupihite sūrye patite 'smindivo mahīm
verses.translation: On hearing the words of her son, she became extremely agitated and wept. Saying "your father was devoured by a Raksasa" she fell down unconscious.
verses.hindi: गन्धर्वलोकविदिता भवभक्ता महाबलाः
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing the words of her son, she became extremely agitated and wept. Saying "your father was devoured by a Raksasa" she fell down unconscious.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the words of her son, she became extremely agitated and wept. Saying "your father was devoured by a Raksasa" she fell down unconscious.

verses.sanskrit: तमो ऽभिभूते लोके ऽस्मिन् प्रभा येन प्रवर्तिता स्वस्त्यस्तु हि तवेत्युक्ते पतन्निह दिवाकरः
verses.transliteration: tamo 'bhibhūte loke 'smin prabhā yena pravartitā svastyastu hi tavetyukte patanniha divākaraḥ
verses.translation: On hearing the words of his grandson, the kind-hearted On hearing directly from his mother — 'Your father was devoured by a demon", the intelligent Paraara spoke thus with his eyes dimmed and darkened by tears,
verses.hindi: नहुषः प्रथमस्तेषां धर्मज्ञो लोकविश्रुतः। नहुषस्य तु दायादाः षडिन्द्रोपमतेजसः विजातिश्चेति षडिमे सर्वे प्रख्यातकीर्तयः। यतिर्ज्येष्ठश्च तेषां वै ययातिस्तु ततोऽवरः
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing the words of his grandson, the kind-hearted On hearing directly from his mother — 'Your father was devoured by a demon", the intelligent Paraara spoke thus with his eyes dimmed and darkened by tears,
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the words of his grandson, the kind-hearted On hearing directly from his mother — 'Your father was devoured by a demon", the intelligent Paraara spoke thus with his eyes dimmed and darkened by tears,

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मर्षेर्वचनात्तस्य पपात न विभुर्दिवः ततः प्रभाकरेत्युक्तः प्रभुरत्रिर्महर्षिभिः
verses.transliteration: brahmarṣervacanāttasya papāta na vibhurdivaḥ tataḥ prabhākaretyuktaḥ prabhuratrirmaharṣibhiḥ
verses.translation: O mother, I think I will be able to show my father in a moment by worshipping the lord of the chiefs of Devas and of the three worlds including the mobile and immobile beings.®'
verses.hindi: ज्येष्ठस्तु यतिर्मोक्षार्थी ब्रह्मभूतो ऽभवत्प्रभुः ।
verses.wordMeaning: O mother, I think I will be able to show my father in a moment by worshipping the lord of the chiefs of Devas and of the three worlds including the mobile and immobile beings.®'
verses.commentary: Sense: O mother, I think I will be able to show my father in a moment by worshipping the lord of the chiefs of Devas and of the three worlds including the mobile and immobile beings.®'

verses.sanskrit: भद्रायां जनयामास सोमं पुत्रं यशस्विनम् स तासु जनयामास पुनः पुत्रांस्तपोधनः
verses.transliteration: bhadrāyāṃ janayāmāsa somaṃ putraṃ yaśasvinam sa tāsu janayāmāsa punaḥ putrāṃstapodhanaḥ
verses.translation: On hearing these splendid words she was surprised. Smilingly she looked at him and said: — "O son, this is true. Worship the lord." On understanding the proposal and decision of the son of l§akti, Vasisha the holy lord, the intelligent leading sage, and the storehouse of mercy, spoke to his grandson as follows: —
verses.hindi: देवयानीमुशनसः सुतां भार्यामवाप स: । शर्मिष्ठामासुरीं चैव तनयां वृषपर्वणः यदुं च तुर्वसुं चैव देवयानी व्यजायत। तावुभौ शुभकर्माणौ स्तुतौ विद्याविशारदौ
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing these splendid words she was surprised. Smilingly she looked at him and said: — "O son, this is true. Worship the lord." On understanding the proposal and decision of the son of l§akti, Vasisha the holy lord, the intelligent leading sage, and the storehouse of mercy,…
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing these splendid words she was surprised. Smilingly she looked at him and said: — "O son, this is true. Worship the lord." On understanding the proposal and decision of the son of l§akti, Vasisha the holy lord, the intelligent leading sage, and the storehouse of mercy,…

verses.sanskrit: स्वस्त्यात्रेया इति ख्याता ऋषयो वेदपारगाः तेषां द्वौ ख्यातयशसौ ब्रह्मिष्ठौ च महौजसौ
verses.transliteration: svastyātreyā iti khyātā ṛṣayo vedapāragāḥ teṣāṃ dvau khyātayaśasau brahmiṣṭhau ca mahaujasau
verses.translation: "O my grandson, O excellent sage of good holy rites, your proposal is proper and suitable. Still, listen, it does not behove you to destroy the world. You can worship the lord for exterminating Raksasas. But, O son of Sakti, what is the harm done to you by the world that you need destroy it?"
verses.hindi: नाभाग हुए। उन नाभाग-से भलंदन हुए, भलंदनके पुत्र अजवाहन हुए; वे पराक्रमी राजा थे। है ऋषियो  मैंने संक्षेपमें विशाल भुजाओंवाले मनृपुत्रोंका तथा इक्ष्वाकुके पुत्र, पौत्र आदिका वर्णन कर दिया; अब मैं
verses.wordMeaning: "O my grandson, O excellent sage of good holy rites, your proposal is proper and suitable. Still, listen, it does not behove you to destroy the world. You can worship the lord for exterminating Raksasas. But, O son of Sakti,…
verses.commentary: Sense: "O my grandson, O excellent sage of good holy rites, your proposal is proper and suitable. Still, listen, it does not behove you to destroy the world. You can worship the lord for exterminating Raksasas. But, O son of Sakti,…

verses.sanskrit: दत्तो ह्यत्रिवरो ज्येष्ठो दुर्वासास्तस्य चानुजः यवीयसी स्वसा तेषाम् अमला ब्रह्मवादिनी
verses.transliteration: datto hyatrivaro jyeṣṭho durvāsāstasya cānujaḥ yavīyasī svasā teṣām amalā brahmavādinī
verses.translation: Paraara bowed down to Adrsyanti, Vasistha and Arundhati. In the presence of the sage he made a single Lihga, in a trice, out of dust. Repeating the following Mantras from the Vedas he worshipped it. The mantras were Sivasukta, Tryambakasukta, Tvaritarudra, Siva Sahkalpa, Nilarudra, Rudra, Vamiya, Pavamana, Paftca Brahman, Hotrsukta, Lihga- sdkta and Atharvasiras. After worshipping duly he offered the eightfold Arghya to Rudra. "O lord Rudra, O Sankara, my father of great refulgence was swallowed by the demon Rudhira along with his brothers.
verses.hindi: आप लोगोंसे ऐल वंशका वर्णन करता हूँ ॥ ४७--५४॥ हे द्विजो! इलाका पुरूरवा नामक पुत्र रुद्रभक्त तथा प्रतापी था। उसने उत्तरमें यमुनाके तटपर मुनियोंके द्वारा सेवित अत्यन्त पवित्र देश प्रयागमें निष्कंटक राज्य किया। प्रतिष्ठानपुरका स्वामी वह पुरूरवा प्रतिष्ठानपुरमें प्रतिष्ठित हुआ। उसके सात पुत्र हुए। वे सब महान् तेजस्वी, गन्धर्वलोकमें प्रसिद्ध, शिवभक्त तथा महाबली
verses.wordMeaning: Paraara bowed down to Adrsyanti, Vasistha and Arundhati. In the presence of the sage he made a single Lihga, in a trice, out of dust. Repeating the following Mantras from the Vedas he worshipped it. The mantras were Sivasukta, Tryambakasukta, Tvaritarudra, Siva Sahkalpa,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Paraara bowed down to Adrsyanti, Vasistha and Arundhati. In the presence of the sage he made a single Lihga, in a trice, out of dust. Repeating the following Mantras from the Vedas he worshipped it. The mantras were Sivasukta, Tryambakasukta, Tvaritarudra, Siva Sahkalpa,…

verses.sanskrit: तस्य गोत्रद्वये जाताश् चत्वारः प्रथिता भुवि श्यावश् च प्रत्वसश्चैव ववल्गुश्चाथ गह्वरः
verses.transliteration: tasya gotradvaye jātāś catvāraḥ prathitā bhuvi śyāvaś ca pratvasaścaiva vavalguścātha gahvaraḥ
verses.translation: O lord, I wish to see my father along with his brothers."
verses.hindi: शतायु-ये उर्वशीके दिव्य पुत्र थे। आयुके पाँच महान् ओजवाले तथा वीर पुत्र हुए; स्वर्भानुकी पुत्री प्रभासे वे राजा उत्पन्न हुए थे। उनमें पहला पुत्र नहुष था, जो धर्मज्ञ एवं लोकप्रसिद्ध था। नहुषके छः पुत्र हुए। इन्द्रके
verses.wordMeaning: O lord, I wish to see my father along with his brothers."
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord, I wish to see my father along with his brothers."

verses.sanskrit: आत्रेयाणां च चत्वारः स्मृताः पक्षा महात्मनाम् काश्यपो नारदश्चैव पर्वतानुद्धतस् तथा
verses.transliteration: ātreyāṇāṃ ca catvāraḥ smṛtāḥ pakṣā mahātmanām kāśyapo nāradaścaiva parvatānuddhatas tathā
verses.translation: "O highly blessed lady, see this boy whose eyes are dimmed and darkened with tears. He is engaged in propitiating me.** The spotless great goddess saw Para:§ara, his eyes dimmed and his body drenched by tears due to misery. He was interested only in the act of worshipping the Lihga. He repeated the names ''Hara", ''K.udra" etc. Uma then spoke to 5iva her husband and the lord of the worlds.
verses.hindi: विरजासे उत्पन्न हुए थे। यति, ययाति, संयाति, आयाति, अन्धक, विजाति-ये छः पुत्र थे; सब-के-सब प्रसिद्ध कोर्तिवाले थे। उनमें यति ज्येष्ठ था और ययाति उससे कनिष्ठ था। ज्येष्ठ यति मोक्षका इच्छुक था और वह ब्रह्मस्वरूप हो गया। उन शेष पाँचोंमें ययाति महान् बल तथा पराक्रमसे सम्पन्न था। उसने उशना (शुक्राचार्य)- को पुत्री देवयानीको और वृषपर्वाकी पुत्री आसुरी शर्मिष्ठाको भार्यारूपमें प्राप्त किया था॥ ५५-६४॥ र
verses.wordMeaning: "O highly blessed lady, see this boy whose eyes are dimmed and darkened with tears. He is engaged in propitiating me.** The spotless great goddess saw Para:§ara, his eyes dimmed and his body drenched by tears due to misery.…
verses.commentary: Sense: "O highly blessed lady, see this boy whose eyes are dimmed and darkened with tears. He is engaged in propitiating me.** The spotless great goddess saw Para:§ara, his eyes dimmed and his body drenched by tears due to misery.…

verses.sanskrit: जज्ञिरे मानसा ह्येते अरुन्धत्या निबोधत नारदस्तु वसिष्ठाया-रुन्धतीं प्रत्यपादयत्
verses.transliteration: jajñire mānasā hyete arundhatyā nibodhata nāradastu vasiṣṭhāyā-rundhatīṃ pratyapādayat
verses.translation: O supreme lord, be pleased, grant him all his desires. On hearing her words, Sankara Paramevara, the swallower of halahala poison, spoke to his noble consort Uma — I shall save this brahmin boy whose eyes resemble full blown blue lotus.
verses.hindi: देवयानीने यदु और तुर्वसुको उत्पन्न किया; वे दोनों ही उत्तम कर्मवाले, प्रशंसनीय तथा विद्यामें प्रवीण थे! वृषपवांको पुत्री शर्मिष्ठाने द्रुह, अनु एवं पूरुको जन्म दिया। उन ययातिके द्वारा सन्तुष्ट किये गये प्रतापी विप्रेद्र
verses.wordMeaning: O supreme lord, be pleased, grant him all his desires. On hearing her words, Sankara Paramevara, the swallower of halahala poison, spoke to his noble consort Uma — I shall save this brahmin boy whose eyes resemble full blown blue lotus.
verses.commentary: Sense: O supreme lord, be pleased, grant him all his desires. On hearing her words, Sankara Paramevara, the swallower of halahala poison, spoke to his noble consort Uma — I shall save this brahmin boy whose eyes resemble full blown blue lotus.

verses.sanskrit: ऊर्ध्वरेता महातेजा दक्षशापात्तु नारदः पुरा देवासुरे युद्धे घोरे वै तारकामये
verses.transliteration: ūrdhvaretā mahātejā dakṣaśāpāttu nāradaḥ purā devāsure yuddhe ghore vai tārakāmaye
verses.translation: I shall give him divine vision and enable him to see my form." After saying this, lord Nilalohita, Paramevara, surrounded by the divine Ganas — Brahma, Indra, Vi§nu, Rudra, and others granted vision to that intelligent son of the sage. On seeing Mahadeva, his eyes became dimmed with tears of delight. Delighted in his heart he fell at his feet with great respect.
verses.hindi: शुक्रने प्रसन्न होकर उन ययातिको दो अक्षय महान् तरकस और अत्यन्त चमकीला, सुन्दरतापूर्वक निर्मित, स्वर्णमय, दिव्य तथा मनके समान वेगवाले घोड़ोसे जुता इक्ष्वाकुवंशी राजाओंकी कथा तथा ययातिवंश-वर्णन
verses.wordMeaning: I shall give him divine vision and enable him to see my form." After saying this, lord Nilalohita, Paramevara, surrounded by the divine Ganas — Brahma, Indra, Vi§nu, Rudra, and others granted vision to that intelligent son of the sage. On seeing Mahadeva,…
verses.commentary: Sense: I shall give him divine vision and enable him to see my form." After saying this, lord Nilalohita, Paramevara, surrounded by the divine Ganas — Brahma, Indra, Vi§nu, Rudra, and others granted vision to that intelligent son of the sage. On seeing Mahadeva,…

verses.sanskrit: अनावृष्ट्या हते लोके ह्य् उग्रे लोकेश्वरैः सह वसिष्ठस्तपसा धीमान् धारयामास वै प्रजाः
verses.transliteration: anāvṛṣṭyā hate loke hy ugre lokeśvaraiḥ saha vasiṣṭhastapasā dhīmān dhārayāmāsa vai prajāḥ
verses.translation: Thereafter he grasped the feet of Uma and the noble Nandin and then spoke to Brahma, and others — "My life is fruitful today.

verses.sanskrit: अन्नोदकं मूलफलम् ओषधीश् च प्रवर्तयन् तानेताञ्जीवयामास कारुण्यादौषधेन च
verses.transliteration: annodakaṃ mūlaphalam oṣadhīś ca pravartayan tānetāñjīvayāmāsa kāruṇyādauṣadhena ca
verses.translation: Today the crescent moon-bedecked diety has come for my protection. Who else can compare with me in this world, whether a Deva or a Danava?" Thereafter in a moment, Paraiara the son of Sakti saw his father standing in heaven along with his brothers.
verses.hindi: सुसङ्गं काञ्चनं दिव्यमक्षये च महेषुधी युक्तं मनोजवैरश्वैर्येन कन्यां समुद्वहन्। स॒ तेन रथमुख्येन षण्मासेनाजयन्महीम्
verses.wordMeaning: Today the crescent moon-bedecked diety has come for my protection. Who else can compare with me in this world, whether a Deva or a Danava?" Thereafter in a moment, Paraiara the son of Sakti saw his father standing in heaven along with his brothers.
verses.commentary: Sense: Today the crescent moon-bedecked diety has come for my protection. Who else can compare with me in this world, whether a Deva or a Danava?" Thereafter in a moment, Paraiara the son of Sakti saw his father standing in heaven along with his brothers.

verses.sanskrit: अरुन्धत्यां वसिष्ठस्तु सुतान् उत्पादयच्छतम् ज्यायसो ऽजनयच्छक्तेर् अदृश्यन्ती पराशरम्
verses.transliteration: arundhatyāṃ vasiṣṭhastu sutān utpādayacchatam jyāyaso 'janayacchakter adṛśyantī parāśaram
verses.translation: On seeing him accompanied by his brothers in an
verses.hindi: ययातिर्युधि दुर्धषों देवदानवमानुषैः। भवभक्तस्तु पुण्यात्मा धर्मनिष्ठः समञ्जसः
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing him accompanied by his brothers in an

verses.sanskrit: रक्षसा भक्षिते शक्तौ रुधिरेण तु वै तदा काली पराशराज्जज्ञे कृष्णद्वैपायनं प्रभुम्
verses.transliteration: rakṣasā bhakṣite śaktau rudhireṇa tu vai tadā kālī parāśarājjajñe kṛṣṇadvaipāyanaṃ prabhum
verses.translation: Then the bull-bannered lord who was accompanied by his wife and the leading Ganas spoke thus to Sakti, the son of Vasitha who was eager to see his son. O Sakti, see your son, the boy whose eyes are dimmed with tears of delight. O leading brahmin, see Adryanti, Vasita your father, Arundhat! your mother, the highly blessed auspicious lady comparable to goddess. O highly intelligent one, make obeisance to both your father and your mother.
verses.hindi: यज्ञयाजी जितक्रोधः सर्वभूतानुकम्पनः। कौरवाणां च सर्वेषां स भवद्रथ उत्तम: गर्गस्य हि सुतं बालं स राजा जनमेजयः
verses.wordMeaning: Then the bull-bannered lord who was accompanied by his wife and the leading Ganas spoke thus to Sakti, the son of Vasitha who was eager to see his son. O Sakti, see your son, the boy whose eyes are dimmed with tears of delight. O leading brahmin, see Adryanti,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the bull-bannered lord who was accompanied by his wife and the leading Ganas spoke thus to Sakti, the son of Vasitha who was eager to see his son. O Sakti, see your son, the boy whose eyes are dimmed with tears of delight. O leading brahmin, see Adryanti,…

verses.sanskrit: द्वैपायनो ह्यरण्यां वै शुकम् उत्पादयत्सुतम् उपमन्युं च पीवर्यां विद्धीमे शुकसूनवः
verses.transliteration: dvaipāyano hyaraṇyāṃ vai śukam utpādayatsutam upamanyuṃ ca pīvaryāṃ viddhīme śukasūnavaḥ
verses.translation: At the behest of Sankara, Sakti immediately, at first, bowed down to the lord of Devas and to Uma. He then bowed to the excellent Vasifjha and to Arundhati his highly blessed mother, the auspicious lady who considered her husband her god. At the behest of the lord of the Universe the power- ful Sakti said
verses.hindi: अक्रूरं हिंसयामास ब्रह्महत्यामवाप सः।
verses.wordMeaning: At the behest of Sankara, Sakti immediately, at first, bowed down to the lord of Devas and to Uma. He then bowed to the excellent Vasifjha and to Arundhati his highly blessed mother, the auspicious lady who considered her husband her god.…
verses.commentary: Sense: At the behest of Sankara, Sakti immediately, at first, bowed down to the lord of Devas and to Uma. He then bowed to the excellent Vasifjha and to Arundhati his highly blessed mother, the auspicious lady who considered her husband her god.…

verses.sanskrit: भूरिश्रवाः प्रभुः शंभुः कृष्णो गौरस्तु पञ्चमः कन्या कीर्तिमती चैव योगमाता धृतव्रता
verses.transliteration: bhūriśravāḥ prabhuḥ śaṃbhuḥ kṛṣṇo gaurastu pañcamaḥ kanyā kīrtimatī caiva yogamātā dhṛtavratā
verses.translation: O dear son, O leading brahmin, Paraara of great refulgence, I have been saved by you who had been in the womb when I died and who are a noble soul. O dear son, Paraara the attributes and the prosperities Anima®® etc. have been attained by me, on seeing your face today. O dear one, of great intellect, at my behest®' protect Adfsyanti the highly blessed lady and Arundhati, as also my father Vasiha.
verses.hindi: पौरजानपहैस्त्यक्तो न लेभे शर्म कर्हिचित्। ततः स दुःखसन्तप्तो न लेभे संविदं क्वचित् इन्द्रेति्नाम विख्यातो योऽसौ मुनिरुदारधीः
verses.wordMeaning: O dear son, O leading brahmin, Paraara of great refulgence, I have been saved by you who had been in the womb when I died and who are a noble soul. O dear son, Paraara the attributes and the prosperities Anima®® etc. have been attained by me, on seeing your face today.…
verses.commentary: Sense: O dear son, O leading brahmin, Paraara of great refulgence, I have been saved by you who had been in the womb when I died and who are a noble soul. O dear son, Paraara the attributes and the prosperities Anima®® etc. have been attained by me, on seeing your face today.…

verses.sanskrit: जननी ब्रह्मदत्तस्य पत्नी सा त्वनुहस्य च श्वेतः कृष्णश् च गौरश् च श्यामो धूम्रस्तथारुणः
verses.transliteration: jananī brahmadattasya patnī sā tvanuhasya ca śvetaḥ kṛṣṇaś ca gauraś ca śyāmo dhūmrastathāruṇaḥ
verses.translation: O dear son, our entire family' has been redeemed by you. This has always®'® been said by the learned that one conquers the worlds through one's son.
verses.hindi: अश्वमेधेन राजानं पावनार्थं द्विजोत्तमाः
verses.wordMeaning: O dear son, our entire family' has been redeemed by you. This has always®'® been said by the learned that one conquers the worlds through one's son.
verses.commentary: Sense: O dear son, our entire family' has been redeemed by you. This has always®'® been said by the learned that one conquers the worlds through one's son.

verses.sanskrit: नीलो बादरिकश्चैव सर्वे चैते पराशराः पराशराणामष्टौ ते पक्षाः प्रोक्ता महात्मनाम्
verses.transliteration: nīlo bādarikaścaiva sarve caite parāśarāḥ parāśarāṇāmaṣṭau te pakṣāḥ proktā mahātmanām

verses.translation: There arc different versions of this legend in the Ramayana, Mahabharata and Vinupurana. According to Mbh. Kalmapada, king of the solar race, was the son of Sudas and a descendant of Iksvaku. While he was out hunting in the forest he met §akti, the eldest son of Vasistha. Since Sakti refused to get out of his way, Kalmasapada was enraged. then struck Sakti with the whip. Thereupon, Sakti cursed him to become a raksasa. Thus, Kalmasapada was turned into a raksa Rudhira by name and he de- voured Sakti together with his brothers. But according to Lihga, the raksasa Rudhira entered the body of King Kalmasapada when the latter was engaged in sacrifice, under the leadership of Vasistha. Instigated by ViiSvamitra, who was a rival priest, Rudhira devoured Sakti as well as his ninety-nin** brothers.

verses.translation: Remembering his hundred sons, the eldest of whom was Sakti, and knowing that the family was extinct, the power- ful sage decided to die. Coming to this conclusion that he will not remain alive without his sons, he felt all the more miser- able. Vasistha the son of Brahma, theknower of everything, the self-possessed sage who had realized the Atman, climbed to the top of a mountain along with his wife. With tears welling up in the eyes he suddenly fell down on the ground. As he fell down on the ground, the earth (assuming the form of a lady) who had a wonderful necklace and the sportive gait of an elephant, caught him up with her lotus-like hands and as he cried she too bewailed with him. At that time, his daughter-in-law, the wife of Sakti, cried in great fright and spoke thus to Vasisjha, the great sage and the be:>t among the eloquent sages.
