verses.hindi: ययाति बोले-- श्रेष्ठ ब्राह्मण तथा सभी वर्णके लोग  मेरा वचन सुनें--' मैं ज्येष्ठ पुत्रको कभी भी राज्य नहीं. दूँगा। ज्येष्ठ पुत्र यदुने मेरी आज्ञाका पालन नही किया है। जो पिताके प्रति विपरीत बुद्धिवाला हो, वह सजनोंके द्वारा पुत्र नहीं माना गया है। सज्जन लोग  माता-पिताके वचनको माननेवाले पुत्रकी ही प्रशंसा करते हैं। वास्तवमें वही पुत्र है, जो माता-पिताके साथ पुत्रभावमें स्थित होकर व्यवहार करता है। यदुने
verses.wordMeaning: O leading brahmin, this splendid body should not be discarded by you, since the child that is born of Sakti and that is bound to be one who realises all objects, is wdthin my womb."
verses.commentary: Sense: O leading brahmin, this splendid body should not be discarded by you, since the child that is born of Sakti and that is bound to be one who realises all objects, is wdthin my womb."

verses.sanskrit: आरुह्य मूर्धानम् अजात्मजो ऽसौ तयात्मवान् सर्वविद् आत्मविच्च धराधरस्यैव तदा धरायां पपात पत्न्या सह साश्रुदृष्टिः
verses.transliteration: āruhya mūrdhānam ajātmajo 'sau tayātmavān sarvavid ātmavicca dharādharasyaiva tadā dharāyāṃ papāta patnyā saha sāśrudṛṣṭiḥ
verses.translation: After saying thus, that lady who was conversant with Dharma and whose eyes resembled lotus flowers lifted up her father-in-law by her hands and wiped his eyes with water. Although she was herself miserable she requested the dejected Arundhati to save her father-in-law.
verses.hindi: मेरी अवज्ञा की है; उसी प्रकार तुर्वसु, द्रुह्य तथा अनुने भी मेरी बहुत अवहेलना की है। पुरुने मेरे वचनका पालन किया है और विशेषरूपसे मेरा सम्मान किया है। मेरा छोटा पुत्र पुरु ही मेरा उत्तराधिकारी है,
verses.wordMeaning: After saying thus, that lady who was conversant with Dharma and whose eyes resembled lotus flowers lifted up her father-in-law by her hands and wiped his eyes with water. Although she was herself miserable she requested the dejected Arundhati to save her father-in-law.
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying thus, that lady who was conversant with Dharma and whose eyes resembled lotus flowers lifted up her father-in-law by her hands and wiped his eyes with water. Although she was herself miserable she requested the dejected Arundhati to save her father-in-law.

verses.sanskrit: धराधरात्तं पतितं धरा तदा दधार तत्रापि विचित्रकण्ठी करांबुजाभ्यां करिखेलगामिनी रुदन्तमादाय रुरोद सा च
verses.transliteration: dharādharāttaṃ patitaṃ dharā tadā dadhāra tatrāpi vicitrakaṇṭhī karāṃbujābhyāṃ karikhelagāminī rudantamādāya ruroda sā ca
verses.translation: On hearing the words of his daughter-in-law Vasistha got up from the ground after regaining consciousness. Arundhati embraced him in great distress and fell down. The leading sage touched Arundhati, in whose eyes tears had welled up and cried along with her.
verses.hindi: जिसने मेरे बुढ़ापेको स्वीकार किया। शुक्राचार्यने देवयानीके लिये मुझे जरावस्था प्राप्त होनेकी आज्ञा दी थी। जब मैंने उनसे प्रार्थना की, तब उन्होंने पुनः बुढ़ापेको संचारिणी बना दिया। काव्य तथा उशना नामधारी आपके अनुकूल व्यवहार करे, वही आपके राज्यका अधिकारी होगा। अत: है ब्राह्मणो 1 अब आपलोग भी मुझे आज्ञा दें कि यह पुरु राज्यपर अभिषिक्त किया
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing the words of his daughter-in-law Vasistha got up from the ground after regaining consciousness. Arundhati embraced him in great distress and fell down. The leading sage touched Arundhati, in whose eyes tears had welled up and cried along with her.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the words of his daughter-in-law Vasistha got up from the ground after regaining consciousness. Arundhati embraced him in great distress and fell down. The leading sage touched Arundhati, in whose eyes tears had welled up and cried along with her.

verses.sanskrit: तदा तस्य स्नुषा प्राह पत्नी शक्तेर्महामुनिम् वसिष्ठं वदतां श्रेष्ठं रुदन्ती भयविह्वला
verses.transliteration: tadā tasya snuṣā prāha patnī śaktermahāmunim vasiṣṭhaṃ vadatāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ rudantī bhayavihvalā
verses.translation: Thereafter the son seated in the couch of the womb of his mother, like the four-faced lord Brahma in the umbilical lotus of Visriu repeated a sacred verse. The holy sage Vasistha listened enthusiastically to the sacred verse wondering, by whom could it have been repeated. He then meditated with great con- centration.
verses.hindi: हित करनेवाला तथा समस्त कल्याणके योग्य हो, वह छोटा होनेपर भी राज्यका उत्तराधिकारी होता है। अत: पुत्र पुरु ही राज्यके योग्य है, जिसने आपके वचनका पालन किया है; शुक्रके वरदानसे
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter the son seated in the couch of the womb of his mother, like the four-faced lord Brahma in the umbilical lotus of Visriu repeated a sacred verse. The holy sage Vasistha listened enthusiastically to the sacred verse wondering, by whom could it have been repeated.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter the son seated in the couch of the womb of his mother, like the four-faced lord Brahma in the umbilical lotus of Visriu repeated a sacred verse. The holy sage Vasistha listened enthusiastically to the sacred verse wondering, by whom could it have been repeated.…

verses.sanskrit: भगवन्ब्राह्मणश्रेष्ठ तव देहम् इदं शुभम् पालयस्व विभो द्रष्टुं तव पौत्रं ममात्मजम्
verses.transliteration: bhagavanbrāhmaṇaśreṣṭha tava deham idaṃ śubham pālayasva vibho draṣṭuṃ tava pautraṃ mamātmajam
verses.translation: Thereupon Visnu whose eyes resemble the lotus petals, who had been stationed in the courtyard of the firmament, who is the soul of the universe and who is the storehouse of mercy spoke to Vasi$tha mercifully.
verses.hindi: यहुनाहमवज्ञातस्तथा तुर्वसुनापि च। द्रुह्येन चानुना चैव मय्यवज्ञा कृता भृशम् शुक्रेण मे समादिष्टा देवयान्याः कृते जरा। प्रार्थितेन पुनस्तेन जरा सञ्चारिणी कृता
verses.wordMeaning: Thereupon Visnu whose eyes resemble the lotus petals, who had been stationed in the courtyard of the firmament, who is the soul of the universe and who is the storehouse of mercy spoke to Vasi$tha mercifully.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereupon Visnu whose eyes resemble the lotus petals, who had been stationed in the courtyard of the firmament, who is the soul of the universe and who is the storehouse of mercy spoke to Vasi$tha mercifully.

verses.sanskrit: न त्याज्यं तव विप्रेन्द्र देहमेतत्सुशोभनम् गर्भस्थो मम सर्वार्थसाधकः शक्तिजो यतः
verses.transliteration: na tyājyaṃ tava viprendra dehametatsuśobhanam garbhastho mama sarvārthasādhakaḥ śaktijo yataḥ
verses.translation: O dear one, O dear one, O Vasistha the leading brah- min, fond of his son, this sacred verse has emanated from the lotuslike face of your grandson.
verses.hindi: शुक्रेण च वरो दत्तः काव्येनोशनसा स्वयम्। पुत्रो यस्त्वानुवर्तेत स ते राज्यधरस्त्विति
verses.wordMeaning: O dear one, O dear one, O Vasistha the leading brah- min, fond of his son, this sacred verse has emanated from the lotuslike face of your grandson.
verses.commentary: Sense: O dear one, O dear one, O Vasistha the leading brah- min, fond of his son, this sacred verse has emanated from the lotuslike face of your grandson.

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्त्वाथ धर्मज्ञा कराभ्यां कमलेक्षणा उत्थाप्य श्वशुरं नत्वा नेत्रे संमृज्य वारिणा
verses.transliteration: evamuktvātha dharmajñā karābhyāṃ kamalekṣaṇā utthāpya śvaśuraṃ natvā netre saṃmṛjya vāriṇā
verses.translation: O sage, this grandson of yours, the powerful one born of Sakti is on a par with me. Hence, O most excellent sage and son of Brahma, discard your grief and rise up.
verses.hindi: वरदानेन शुक्रस्य न शक्यं कर्तुमन्यथा। एवं जानपदेस्तुष्टेरित्युक्तो नाहुषस्तदा॥ १०  विपरीत कार्य नहीं किया जा सकता है
verses.wordMeaning: O sage, this grandson of yours, the powerful one born of Sakti is on a par with me. Hence, O most excellent sage and son of Brahma, discard your grief and rise up.
verses.commentary: Sense: O sage, this grandson of yours, the powerful one born of Sakti is on a par with me. Hence, O most excellent sage and son of Brahma, discard your grief and rise up.

verses.sanskrit: दुःखितापि परित्रातुं श्वशुरं दुःखितं तदा अरुन्धतीं च कल्याणीं प्रार्थयामास दुःखिताम्
verses.transliteration: duḥkhitāpi paritrātuṃ śvaśuraṃ duḥkhitaṃ tadā arundhatīṃ ca kalyāṇīṃ prārthayāmāsa duḥkhitām
verses.translation: The child in the womb is a devotee of Rudra. He is engaged in the worship of Rudra. Thanks to the power of Rudra he will redeem your family.
verses.hindi: अभिषिच्य ततो राज्ये पूरुं स सुतमात्मनः। सूतजी बोले--इस प्रकार जब प्रसन्न हुए
verses.wordMeaning: The child in the womb is a devotee of Rudra. He is engaged in the worship of Rudra. Thanks to the power of Rudra he will redeem your family.
verses.commentary: Sense: The child in the womb is a devotee of Rudra. He is engaged in the worship of Rudra. Thanks to the power of Rudra he will redeem your family.

verses.sanskrit: स्नुषावाक्यं ततः श्रुत्वा वसिष्ठ उत्थाय भूतलात् संज्ञामवाप्य चालिङ्ग्य सा पपात सुदुःखिता
verses.transliteration: snuṣāvākyaṃ tataḥ śrutvā vasiṣṭha utthāya bhūtalāt saṃjñāmavāpya cāliṅgya sā papāta suduḥkhitā
verses.translation: After saying thus to Vasi?tha, the leading Brahmin sage, the merciful lord vanished there itself.
verses.hindi: नगरवासियोंने नहुषपुत्र ययाति-से कहा, तब उन्होंने अपने पुत्र पुरुको राज्यपर अभिषिक्त करके तुर्वसुको दक्षिण-पूर्व दिशामें रहनेकी आज्ञा प्रदान की। उसके बाद राजा ययाति-ने ज्येष्ठ पुत्र यदुको दक्षिण दिशामें
verses.wordMeaning: After saying thus to Vasi?tha, the leading Brahmin sage, the merciful lord vanished there itself.
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying thus to Vasi?tha, the leading Brahmin sage, the merciful lord vanished there itself.

verses.sanskrit: अरुन्धती कराभ्यां तां संस्पृश्यास्राकुलेक्षणाम् रुरोद मुनिशार्दूलो भार्यया सुतवत्सलः
verses.transliteration: arundhatī karābhyāṃ tāṃ saṃspṛśyāsrākulekṣaṇām ruroda muniśārdūlo bhāryayā sutavatsalaḥ
verses.translation: Vasistha of great splendour bowed his head to the lotus- eyed lord and then stroked the belly of Adjyanti with great respect.
verses.hindi: दक्षिणायामथो राजा यदु ज्येष्ठं न्ययोजयत्। प्रतीच्यामुत्तरस्यां तु द्रुह्यं चानुं च तावुभौ
verses.wordMeaning: Vasistha of great splendour bowed his head to the lotus- eyed lord and then stroked the belly of Adjyanti with great respect.
verses.commentary: Sense: Vasistha of great splendour bowed his head to the lotus- eyed lord and then stroked the belly of Adjyanti with great respect.

verses.sanskrit: अथ नाभ्यंबुजे विष्णोर् यथा तस्याश्चतुर्मुखः आसीनो गर्भशय्यायां कुमार ऋचमाह सः
verses.transliteration: atha nābhyaṃbuje viṣṇor yathā tasyāścaturmukhaḥ āsīno garbhaśayyāyāṃ kumāra ṛcamāha saḥ
verses.translation: O brahmins, he cried out "ha my son, ha my son", and fell down extremely depressed. Glancing at Arundhati who was also crying and remembering his own son he cried out in misery — "O son, come again, come again. O iSakti, after the birth of your son who will sustain this family. I shall undou- btedly come near you along with your mother".
verses.hindi: sR कका काआकककफक काक फाम मीमी ममम सस £ जर्षि ययातिका आख्यान तथा ययातिगाथा
verses.wordMeaning: O brahmins, he cried out "ha my son, ha my son", and fell down extremely depressed. Glancing at Arundhati who was also crying and remembering his own son he cried out in misery — "O son, come again, come again. O iSakti, after the birth of your son who will sustain this family.…
verses.commentary: Sense: O brahmins, he cried out "ha my son, ha my son", and fell down extremely depressed. Glancing at Arundhati who was also crying and remembering his own son he cried out in misery — "O son, come again, come again. O iSakti, after the birth of your son who will sustain this family.…

verses.sanskrit: ततो निशम्य भगवान् वसिष्ठ ऋचमादरात् केनोक्तमिति संचिन्त्य तदातिष्ठत्समाहितः
verses.transliteration: tato niśamya bhagavān vasiṣṭha ṛcamādarāt kenoktamiti saṃcintya tadātiṣṭhatsamāhitaḥ
verses.translation: The auspicious lady AdrSyanti who was distressed beat her belly — the abode of the child in womb. She cried oui in distress and fell down. Arundhati and Vasistha, both of them were extremely frightened. They lifted up the young woman their daugh''er-in-law and said thus: —
verses.hindi: सप्तद्वीपां ययातिस्तु जित्वा पृथ्वी ससागराम्। कर दिया और उन दोनों द्रुह्य तथा अनुको द्यभजच्च त्रिधा राज्यं पुत्रेभ्यो नाहुषस्तदा॥ १३  क्रमशः पश्चिम तथा उत्तर दिशामें नियुक्त कर दिया। नहुषपुत्र ययातिने सात ट्वीपोंवाली सागरोंसहित पृथ्वीको जीतकर पुत्रॉमें राज्यको तीन भागोंमें बाँट दिया। इस
verses.wordMeaning: The auspicious lady AdrSyanti who was distressed beat her belly — the abode of the child in womb. She cried oui in distress and fell down. Arundhati and Vasistha, both of them were extremely frightened. They lifted up the young woman their daugh''er-in-law and said thus: —
verses.commentary: Sense: The auspicious lady AdrSyanti who was distressed beat her belly — the abode of the child in womb. She cried oui in distress and fell down. Arundhati and Vasistha, both of them were extremely frightened. They lifted up the young woman their daugh''er-in-law and said thus: —

verses.sanskrit: व्योमाङ्गणस्थो ऽथ हरिः पुण्डरीकनिभेक्षणः वसिष्ठमाह विश्वात्मा घृणया स घृणानिधिः
verses.transliteration: vyomāṅgaṇastho 'tha hariḥ puṇḍarīkanibhekṣaṇaḥ vasiṣṭhamāha viśvātmā ghṛṇayā sa ghṛṇānidhiḥ
verses.translation: After pulling up her daughter-in-law and the sage, Arundhati the wife of Vasistha stood up and said though highly distressed and agitated.
verses.hindi: प्रकार पुत्रोंमें राज्य संक्रमित करनेवाले तथा हर्षपूर्ण मनवाले राजा बन्धुओंपर उनका भार सौंपकर प्रसन्न हो महाराज ययातिके द्वारा इस विषयमें पहले ये गाथाएँ गायी गयी थीं, जिनके द्वारा मनुष्य जिस प्रकार कछुआ अपने सभी अंगोंको समेट लेता है, वैसे ही अपनी समस्त कामनाओंको समेट लेता है और उन्हींसे
verses.wordMeaning: After pulling up her daughter-in-law and the sage, Arundhati the wife of Vasistha stood up and said though highly distressed and agitated.
verses.commentary: Sense: After pulling up her daughter-in-law and the sage, Arundhati the wife of Vasistha stood up and said though highly distressed and agitated.

verses.sanskrit: भो वत्स वत्स विप्रेन्द्र वसिष्ठ सुतवत्सल तव पौत्रमुखाम्भोजाद् ऋग् एषाद्य विनिःसृता
verses.transliteration: bho vatsa vatsa viprendra vasiṣṭha sutavatsala tava pautramukhāmbhojād ṛg eṣādya viniḥsṛtā
verses.translation: *'If the excellent sage has decided to preserve his life I shall somehow preserve my body pure or impure.
verses.hindi: वह श्रीमान् हो जाता है, अन्यथा नहीं; चाहे वह करोड़ों कर्म करनेवाला ही क्यों न हो। कामनाओंके उपभोगसे इच्छा शान्त नहीं होती है; जैसे हविके द्वारा अग्नि बढ़ती है, उसी प्रकार यह निरन्तर बढ़ती ही जाती है । पृथ्वीपर
verses.wordMeaning: *'If the excellent sage has decided to preserve his life I shall somehow preserve my body pure or impure.
verses.commentary: Sense: *'If the excellent sage has decided to preserve his life I shall somehow preserve my body pure or impure.

verses.sanskrit: मत्समस्तव पौत्रो ऽसौ शक्तिजः शक्तिमान्मुने तस्मादुत्तिष्ठ संत्यज्य शोकं ब्रह्मसुतोत्तम
verses.transliteration: matsamastava pautro 'sau śaktijaḥ śaktimānmune tasmāduttiṣṭha saṃtyajya śokaṃ brahmasutottama
verses.translation: It is because of my sin that I have to bear the sorrow of separation from my husband. O sage, I am burnt with grief, even though I am your daughter-in-law, O sage. Alas, a miracle has been seen by me. O lord, I am the victim of grief. O brahmin, be my saviour from misery, O son of Brahma, O preceptor of the universe.
verses.hindi: जो भी व्रीहि, जौ, सोना, पशु तथा स्त्रियाँ हैं, वे सब वस्तुएँ किसी एकके लिये भी पर्याप्त नहीं हैं-यह मानकर मनुष्यको कामनामुक्त हो जाना चाहिए। जब मनुष्य सभी प्राणियोंके प्रति मन, वचन तथा कर्मसे पापमय भाव नहीं रखता है, तब वह ब्रह्मको प्राप्त होता है। जब वह दूसरेसे डरता नहीं, दूसरे लोग भी उससे नहीं डरते; जब वह दूसरेकी निन्दा नहीं करता तथा उससे द्वेष नहीं करता, तब वह ब्रह्मको प्राप्त होता है।
verses.wordMeaning: It is because of my sin that I have to bear the sorrow of separation from my husband. O sage, I am burnt with grief, even though I am your daughter-in-law, O sage. Alas, a miracle has been seen by me. O lord, I am the victim of grief. O brahmin, be my saviour from misery,…
verses.commentary: Sense: It is because of my sin that I have to bear the sorrow of separation from my husband. O sage, I am burnt with grief, even though I am your daughter-in-law, O sage. Alas, a miracle has been seen by me. O lord, I am the victim of grief. O brahmin, be my saviour from misery,…

verses.sanskrit: रुद्रभक्तश् च गर्भस्थो रुद्रपूजापरायणः रुद्रदेवप्रभावेण कुलं ते संतरिष्यति
verses.transliteration: rudrabhaktaś ca garbhastho rudrapūjāparāyaṇaḥ rudradevaprabhāveṇa kulaṃ te saṃtariṣyati
verses.translation: Still, a woman without a husband shall be miserable.
verses.hindi: जो तृष्णा दुष्ट बुद्धिवालोंके द्वारा बड़ी कठिनाईसे त्यागनेयोग्य है, जो मनुष्यके जीर्ण होनेपर भी स्वयं जीर्ण नहीं होती तथा जो प्राणका आन्त करनेवाला रोग है; उस तृष्णाका त्याग कर देनेवालेको
verses.wordMeaning: Still, a woman without a husband shall be miserable.
verses.commentary: Sense: Still, a woman without a husband shall be miserable.

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्त्वा घृणी विप्रं भगवान् पुरुषोत्तमः वसिष्ठं मुनिशार्दूलं तत्रैवान्तरधीयत
verses.transliteration: evamuktvā ghṛṇī vipraṃ bhagavān puruṣottamaḥ vasiṣṭhaṃ muniśārdūlaṃ tatraivāntaradhīyata
verses.translation: The father, mother, sons, grandsons, even the father-in- law, all are helpless to such a woman. None of them can be a real kinsman unto women. It is the husband alone who is her real kinsman, her greatest salvation.
verses.hindi: सुख होता है। जीर्ण व्यक्तिके केश जीर्ण हो जाते हैं, जीर्ण व्यक्तिके दाँत जीर्ण हो जाते हैं और उसके नेत्र तथा कान भी जीर्ण हो जाते हैं; केवल तृष्णा ही सदा उपद्रवविहीन रहती है अर्थात् यह सदा तरुण बनी रहती है। सभी प्राणी स्वभावतः ही जीर्ण होते हैं, इसमें सन्देह नहीं है, किंतु मनुष्यके जीर्ण हो जानेपर भी जीवनकी आशा एवं धनकी आशा जीर्ण नहीं होती है। संसारमें जो कामसुख है तथा जो स्वर्गका महान् सुख
verses.wordMeaning: The father, mother, sons, grandsons, even the father-in- law, all are helpless to such a woman. None of them can be a real kinsman unto women. It is the husband alone who is her real kinsman, her greatest salvation.
verses.commentary: Sense: The father, mother, sons, grandsons, even the father-in- law, all are helpless to such a woman. None of them can be a real kinsman unto women. It is the husband alone who is her real kinsman, her greatest salvation.

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रणम्य शिरसा वसिष्ठो वारिजेक्षणम् अदृश्यन्त्या महातेजाः पस्पर्शोदरमादरात्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ praṇamya śirasā vasiṣṭho vārijekṣaṇam adṛśyantyā mahātejāḥ pasparśodaramādarāt
verses.translation: What has been mentioned by the learned men! viz. the wife is half of the husband, has turned out to be not true in my case. Sakti has gone. But I still survive.
verses.hindi: प्रीतिमानभवद्राजा भारमावेश्य बन्धुषु
verses.wordMeaning: What has been mentioned by the learned men! viz. the wife is half of the husband, has turned out to be not true in my case. Sakti has gone. But I still survive.
verses.commentary: Sense: What has been mentioned by the learned men! viz. the wife is half of the husband, has turned out to be not true in my case. Sakti has gone. But I still survive.

verses.sanskrit: हा पुत्र पुत्र पुत्रेति पपात च सुदुःखितः ललापारुन्धती प्रेक्ष्य तदासौ रुदतीं द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: hā putra putra putreti papāta ca suduḥkhitaḥ lalāpārundhatī prekṣya tadāsau rudatīṃ dvijāḥ
verses.translation: O Vasistha, just as a creeper climbing on the holy fig tree, survives even after being cut off from its roots, I too survive
verses.hindi: याभिः प्रत्याहरेत्कामान् सर्वतोऽङ्गानि कूर्मवत् ताभिरेव नरः श्रीमान्नान्यथा कर्मकोटिकृत्। न जातु कामः कामानामुपभोगेन शाम्यति
verses.wordMeaning: O Vasistha, just as a creeper climbing on the holy fig tree, survives even after being cut off from its roots, I too survive
verses.commentary: Sense: O Vasistha, just as a creeper climbing on the holy fig tree, survives even after being cut off from its roots, I too survive

verses.sanskrit: स्वपुत्रं च स्मरन् दुःखात् पुनरेह्येहि पुत्रक तव पुत्रमिमं दृष्ट्वा भो शक्ते कुलधारणम्
verses.transliteration: svaputraṃ ca smaran duḥkhāt punarehyehi putraka tava putramimaṃ dṛṣṭvā bho śakte kuladhāraṇam
verses.translation: On hearing these words of his daughter-in-law, the intelligent Vasistha who observed the duties of his stage of life decided to go to his hermitage along with his wife.
verses.hindi: यदा न कुरुते भावं सर्वभूतेषु पापकम्
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing these words of his daughter-in-law, the intelligent Vasistha who observed the duties of his stage of life decided to go to his hermitage along with his wife.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing these words of his daughter-in-law, the intelligent Vasistha who observed the duties of his stage of life decided to go to his hermitage along with his wife.

verses.sanskrit: तवान्तिकं गमिष्यामि तव मात्रा न संशयः एवमुक्त्वा रुदन्विप्र आलिङ्ग्यारुन्धतीं तदा
verses.transliteration: tavāntikaṃ gamiṣyāmi tava mātrā na saṃśayaḥ evamuktvā rudanvipra āliṅgyārundhatīṃ tadā
verses.translation: The mcritorious-souled holy lord Vasistha though suffering badly, entered his hermitage quickly, accompanied by his wife and Adrsyantl, and began to ponder.
verses.hindi: कर्मणा मनसा वाचा ब्रह्म सम्पद्यते तदा। यदा परान्न बिभेति परे चास्मान्न बिभ्यति यदा न निन्देन्न द्वेष्टि ब्रह्म सम्पद्यते तदा। या दुस्त्यजा दुर्मतिभिर्या न जीर्यति जीर्यतः
verses.wordMeaning: The mcritorious-souled holy lord Vasistha though suffering badly, entered his hermitage quickly, accompanied by his wife and Adrsyantl, and began to ponder.
verses.commentary: Sense: The mcritorious-souled holy lord Vasistha though suffering badly, entered his hermitage quickly, accompanied by his wife and Adrsyantl, and began to ponder.

verses.sanskrit: पपात ताडयन्तीव स्वस्य कुक्षी करेण वै अदृश्यन्ती जघानाथ शक्तिजस्यालयं शुभा
verses.transliteration: papāta tāḍayantīva svasya kukṣī kareṇa vai adṛśyantī jaghānātha śaktijasyālayaṃ śubhā
verses.translation: O leading sages, that chaste wife of Sakti preserved the child in the \\omb with great difficulty for the continuity of the family line.
verses.hindi: योऽसौ प्राणान्तिको रोगस्तां तृष्णां त्यजतः सुखम्। जीर्यन्ति जीर्यतः केशा दन्ता जीर्यन्ति जीर्यतः
verses.wordMeaning: O leading sages, that chaste wife of Sakti preserved the child in the \\omb with great difficulty for the continuity of the family line.
verses.commentary: Sense: O leading sages, that chaste wife of Sakti preserved the child in the \\omb with great difficulty for the continuity of the family line.

verses.sanskrit: स्वोदरं दुःखिता भूमौ ललाप च पपात च अरुन्धति तदा भीता वसिष्ठश् च महामतिः
verses.transliteration: svodaraṃ duḥkhitā bhūmau lalāpa ca papāta ca arundhati tadā bhītā vasiṣṭhaś ca mahāmatiḥ
verses.translation: In the tenth month the wife of Sakti gave birth to a lustrous son in the same manner as Arundhati had prcvic'usly given birth to Sakti.
verses.hindi: चक्षुः श्रोत्रे च जीर्येते तृष्णैका निरुपद्रवा। जीर्यन्ति देहिनः सर्वे स्वभावादेव नान्यथा यच्च कामसुखं लोके यच्च दिव्यं महत्सुखम्
verses.wordMeaning: In the tenth month the wife of Sakti gave birth to a lustrous son in the same manner as Arundhati had prcvic'usly given birth to Sakti.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the tenth month the wife of Sakti gave birth to a lustrous son in the same manner as Arundhati had prcvic'usly given birth to Sakti.

verses.sanskrit: समुत्थाप्य स्नुषां बालाम् ऊचतुर्भयविह्वलौ
verses.transliteration: samutthāpya snuṣāṃ bālām ūcaturbhayavihvalau
verses.translation: Sakti's wife gave birth to Parasara like Aditi wlio gave birth to Visnu, like Svaha who gave birth to Guha and like Arani who gave birth to Agni.
verses.hindi: श्रीलिडुमहापुराण
verses.wordMeaning: Sakti's wife gave birth to Parasara like Aditi wlio gave birth to Visnu, like Svaha who gave birth to Guha and like Arani who gave birth to Agni.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sakti's wife gave birth to Parasara like Aditi wlio gave birth to Visnu, like Svaha who gave birth to Guha and like Arani who gave birth to Agni.

verses.sanskrit: विचारमुग्धे तव गर्भमण्डलं करांबुजाभ्यां विनिहत्य दुर्लभम् कुलं वसिष्ठस्य समस्तमप्यहो निहन्तुमार्ये कथमुद्यता वद
verses.transliteration: vicāramugdhe tava garbhamaṇḍalaṃ karāṃbujābhyāṃ vinihatya durlabham kulaṃ vasiṣṭhasya samastamapyaho nihantumārye kathamudyatā vada
verses.translation: When the son of Sakti incarnated on the earth, Sakti, abandoned his sorrow and attained equality with the Pitrs.
verses.hindi: पफ  फफफफफफफफफ फफफफफफाफफफफफ फफफ फफ काम फ फ फफफ फ कक फ फ फक फ क फक ककी क फ फ की ऊ फी फ फे फ फ फ फ क फ फ फ फ़ ७ ड जाफजततच55" लक की फ़
verses.wordMeaning: When the son of Sakti incarnated on the earth, Sakti, abandoned his sorrow and attained equality with the Pitrs.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the son of Sakti incarnated on the earth, Sakti, abandoned his sorrow and attained equality with the Pitrs.

verses.sanskrit: तवात्मजं शक्तिसुतं च दृष्ट्वा चास्वाद्य वक्त्रामृतम् आर्यसूनोः त्रातुं यतो देहमिमं मुनीन्द्रः सुनिश्चितः पाहि ततः शरीरम्
verses.transliteration: tavātmajaṃ śaktisutaṃ ca dṛṣṭvā cāsvādya vaktrāmṛtam āryasūnoḥ trātuṃ yato dehamimaṃ munīndraḥ suniścitaḥ pāhi tataḥ śarīram
verses.translation: O leading sages, that meritorious son of Vasistha, stationed in the world of the Pitrs along with his brother: shone like the sun along with the Adityas.
verses.hindi: तस्य वंशास्तु पञ्चैते पुण्या देवर्षिसत्कृताः । यैर्व्याप्ता पृथिवी कृत्स्ना सूर्यस्येव मरीचिभि:
verses.wordMeaning: O leading sages, that meritorious son of Vasistha, stationed in the world of the Pitrs along with his brother: shone like the sun along with the Adityas.
verses.commentary: Sense: O leading sages, that meritorious son of Vasistha, stationed in the world of the Pitrs along with his brother: shone like the sun along with the Adityas.

verses.sanskrit: एवं स्नुषामुपालभ्य मुनिं चारुन्धती स्थिता अरुन्धती वसिष्ठस्य प्राह चार्तेति विह्वला
verses.transliteration: evaṃ snuṣāmupālabhya muniṃ cārundhatī sthitā arundhatī vasiṣṭhasya prāha cārteti vihvalā
verses.translation: O leading brahmins, when Parasara incarnated, the departed father sang, the grand-fathers and grcat-grand-lathers danced.
verses.hindi: धनी प्रजावानायुष्मान् कीर्तिमांश्च भवेन्नरः। ययातिचरितं पुण्यं पठञ्छुण्वंश्च बुद्धिमान् है, वह तृष्णाके नाशके सुखको सोलहवीं कलाके थे... बराबर नहीं है॥ १५-२३/२॥
verses.wordMeaning: O leading brahmins, when Parasara incarnated, the departed father sang, the grand-fathers and grcat-grand-lathers danced.
verses.commentary: Sense: O leading brahmins, when Parasara incarnated, the departed father sang, the grand-fathers and grcat-grand-lathers danced.

verses.sanskrit: त्वय्येव जीवितं चास्य मुनेर् यत् सुव्रते मम जीवितं रक्ष देहस्य धात्री च कुरु यद्धितम्
verses.transliteration: tvayyeva jīvitaṃ cāsya muner yat suvrate mama jīvitaṃ rakṣa dehasya dhātrī ca kuru yaddhitam
verses.translation: The Pitrs who previously expounded the Brahman on the earth and the deities in heaven danced. Puskara and (Others moved about in the firmament showering flowers.
verses.hindi: ऐसा कहकर वे राजर्षि ययाति पत्नीके साथ वनमें चले गये। उन महायशस्वीने वहीं भूगुतुंग शिखरपर निराहार रहकर महान् तपस्या करके स्वर्गको प्राप्त किया। उनके ये पवित्र तथा देवषियोद्वरा
verses.wordMeaning: The Pitrs who previously expounded the Brahman on the earth and the deities in heaven danced. Puskara and (Others moved about in the firmament showering flowers.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Pitrs who previously expounded the Brahman on the earth and the deities in heaven danced. Puskara and (Others moved about in the firmament showering flowers.

verses.sanskrit: मया यदि मुनिश्रेष्ठस् त्रातुं वै निश्चितं स्वकम् ममाशुभं शुभं देहं कथंचित् पालयाम्यहम्
verses.transliteration: mayā yadi muniśreṣṭhas trātuṃ vai niścitaṃ svakam mamāśubhaṃ śubhaṃ dehaṃ kathaṃcit pālayāmyaham
verses.translation: O brahmins, in the cities of the Raksasas there were odd and painful shouts. The sages in their hermitage applauded continuously with delightful experiences.
verses.hindi: सत्कृत पाँच वंश हैं, जिनके द्वारा सम्पूर्ण पृथ्वी उस प्रकार व्याप्त है, जैसे वह सूर्यकी रश्मियोंसे व्याप्त है। ययातिके पुण्यप्रद चरित्रको पढ़ने तथा सुननेवाला मनुष्य धनी, सन्तानयुक्त, आयुष्मान्, कीर्तिशाली एवं बुद्धिमान् हो जाता है और सभी पापोंसे मुक्त होकर शिवलोकमे
verses.wordMeaning: O brahmins, in the cities of the Raksasas there were odd and painful shouts. The sages in their hermitage applauded continuously with delightful experiences.
verses.commentary: Sense: O brahmins, in the cities of the Raksasas there were odd and painful shouts. The sages in their hermitage applauded continuously with delightful experiences.

verses.sanskrit: प्रियदुःखमहं प्राप्ता ह्य् असती नात्र संशयः मुने दुःखादहं दग्धा यतः पुत्री मुने तव
verses.transliteration: priyaduḥkhamahaṃ prāptā hy asatī nātra saṃśayaḥ mune duḥkhādahaṃ dagdhā yataḥ putrī mune tava
verses.translation: Just as the four-faced lord incarnated from the Cosmic Egg, just as the sun emerges from the clusters of clouds, so ako Parasara was born of Adrsyanti.
verses.hindi: सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तः शिवलोके महीयते॥ २८  प्रतिष्ठा प्राप्त करता है
verses.wordMeaning: Just as the four-faced lord incarnated from the Cosmic Egg, just as the sun emerges from the clusters of clouds, so ako Parasara was born of Adrsyanti.
verses.commentary: Sense: Just as the four-faced lord incarnated from the Cosmic Egg, just as the sun emerges from the clusters of clouds, so ako Parasara was born of Adrsyanti.

verses.sanskrit: अहो ऽद्भुतं मया दृष्टं दुःखपात्री ह्यहं विभो दुःखत्राता भव ब्रह्मन् ब्रह्मसूनो जगद्गुरो
verses.transliteration: aho 'dbhutaṃ mayā dṛṣṭaṃ duḥkhapātrī hyahaṃ vibho duḥkhatrātā bhava brahman brahmasūno jagadguro
verses.translation: On seeing the son and remembering her husband, O brahmins, even Adrsyanti felt both joy and grief. So was the case with Arundhati and sage Vasistha.
verses.hindi: ययातिपुत्र यदुके वंशका वर्णन यदोः पुत्रा बभूवुर्हि पञ्च देवसुतोपमाः। सहस्रजित्सुतो ज्येष्ठो क्रोष्टुर्नीलोऽजको लघुः
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing the son and remembering her husband, O brahmins, even Adrsyanti felt both joy and grief. So was the case with Arundhati and sage Vasistha.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing the son and remembering her husband, O brahmins, even Adrsyanti felt both joy and grief. So was the case with Arundhati and sage Vasistha.

verses.sanskrit: तथापि भर्तृरहिता दीना नारी भवेदिह पाहि मां तत आर्येन्द्र परिभूता भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: tathāpi bhartṛrahitā dīnā nārī bhavediha pāhi māṃ tata āryendra paribhūtā bhaviṣyati
verses.translation: On seeing her son, the highly refulgent Parara, the agitated lady lamented. With her throat choked she fell down.
verses.hindi: सुताः शतजितः ख्यातास्त्रयः परमकीर्तयः
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing her son, the highly refulgent Parara, the agitated lady lamented. With her throat choked she fell down.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing her son, the highly refulgent Parara, the agitated lady lamented. With her throat choked she fell down.

verses.sanskrit: पिता माता च पुत्राश्च पौत्राः श्वशुर एव च एते न बान्धवाः स्त्रीणां भर्ता बन्धुः परा गतिः
verses.transliteration: pitā mātā ca putrāśca pautrāḥ śvaśura eva ca ete na bāndhavāḥ strīṇāṃ bhartā bandhuḥ parā gatiḥ
verses.translation: Even as her sinless son adored by the groups of Devas and Danavas, was born the mother realized that he was highly intelligent. With tears in her eyes she lamented.
verses.hindi: हैहयश्च हयश्चैव राजा वेणुहयश्च यः। हैहयस्य तु दायादो धर्म इत्यभिविश्रुतः तस्य पुत्रोऽभवद्रिप्रा धर्मनेत्र इति श्रुतः। धर्मनेत्रस्य कीर्तिस्तु सञ्जयस्तस्य चात्मजः
verses.wordMeaning: Even as her sinless son adored by the groups of Devas and Danavas, was born the mother realized that he was highly intelligent. With tears in her eyes she lamented.
verses.commentary: Sense: Even as her sinless son adored by the groups of Devas and Danavas, was born the mother realized that he was highly intelligent. With tears in her eyes she lamented.

verses.sanskrit: आत्मनो यद्धि कथितम् अप्यर्धमिति पण्डितैः तदप्यत्र मृषा ह्यासीद् गतः शक्तिरहं स्थिता
verses.transliteration: ātmano yaddhi kathitam apyardhamiti paṇḍitaiḥ tadapyatra mṛṣā hyāsīd gataḥ śaktirahaṃ sthitā
verses.translation: "Ha, son ofVasistha, you have gone somewhere after abandoning me whose wretchedness is visible in the face. You have left me in the middle of the forest as one desirous of see- ing her son. O lord, you too, see your bosom-born, sinless son.
verses.hindi: दुर्दमस्य सुतो धीमान् धनको नाम विश्रुतः
verses.wordMeaning: "Ha, son ofVasistha, you have gone somewhere after abandoning me whose wretchedness is visible in the face. You have left me in the middle of the forest as one desirous of see- ing her son. O lord, you too, see your bosom-born, sinless son.
verses.commentary: Sense: "Ha, son ofVasistha, you have gone somewhere after abandoning me whose wretchedness is visible in the face. You have left me in the middle of the forest as one desirous of see- ing her son. O lord, you too, see your bosom-born, sinless son.

verses.sanskrit: अहो ममात्र काठिन्यं मनसो मुनिपुङ्गव पतिं प्राणसमं त्यक्त्वा स्थिता यत्र क्षणं यतः
verses.transliteration: aho mamātra kāṭhinyaṃ manaso munipuṅgava patiṃ prāṇasamaṃ tyaktvā sthitā yatra kṣaṇaṃ yataḥ
verses.translation: O l§akti, with his delight evident in his face Maheivara saw his six-faced son along with his Gana.. Similarly, you too see your son in the company of your brothers".
verses.hindi: धनकस्य तु दायादाश्चत्वारो लोकसम्मताः। कृतवीर्यः कृताग्निश्च कृतवर्मा तथैव च कृतौजाश्च चतु्थोऽभूत्कार्तवीर्यस्ततोऽर्जुनः। जज्ञे बाहुसहस्रेण सप्तद्वीपेश्‍वरोत्तम:
verses.wordMeaning: O l§akti, with his delight evident in his face Maheivara saw his six-faced son along with his Gana.. Similarly, you too see your son in the company of your brothers".
verses.commentary: Sense: O l§akti, with his delight evident in his face Maheivara saw his six-faced son along with his Gana.. Similarly, you too see your son in the company of your brothers".

verses.sanskrit: वसिष्ठाश्वत्थमाश्रित्य ह्य् अमृता तु यथा लता निर्मूलाप्यमृता भर्त्रा त्यक्ता दीना स्थिताप्यहम्
verses.transliteration: vasiṣṭhāśvatthamāśritya hy amṛtā tu yathā latā nirmūlāpyamṛtā bhartrā tyaktā dīnā sthitāpyaham
verses.translation: At the behest of Vasistha, that noble lady eschewed her sorrow. 'I'hat lady with roving eyes like the fawn nursed and nurtured her son.
verses.hindi: सूतजी बोले है ऋषियो ! अब मैं ययातिके उत्तम तेजवाले ज्येष्ठ पुत्र यदुके वंशका क्रमानुसार संक्षेपमें वर्णन करूँगा; मुझ कहनेवालेसे आपलोग सुनें  यदुके देवपुत्रतुल्य पाँच पुत्र हुए; उनमें सहस्रजित् ज्येष्ठ पुत्र था
verses.wordMeaning: At the behest of Vasistha, that noble lady eschewed her sorrow. 'I'hat lady with roving eyes like the fawn nursed and nurtured her son.
verses.commentary: Sense: At the behest of Vasistha, that noble lady eschewed her sorrow. 'I'hat lady with roving eyes like the fawn nursed and nurtured her son.

verses.sanskrit: स्नुषावाक्यं निशम्यैव वसिष्ठो भार्यया सह तदा चक्रे मतिं धीमान् यातुं स्वाश्रममाश्रमी
verses.transliteration: snuṣāvākyaṃ niśamyaiva vasiṣṭho bhāryayā saha tadā cakre matiṃ dhīmān yātuṃ svāśramamāśramī
verses.translation: On seeing his chaste mother as a weak lady, devoid of ornaments, sitting down dejectedly, with tears agitating the eyes, the boy said to her.
verses.hindi: और क्रोष्टु, नील, अजक तथा लघु अन्य पुत्र थे सहस्रजितका पुत्र उन्हींके समान था। बह शतजित् नामक राजा हुआ। शतजितूके महाकीर्तिशाली तीन पुत्र कहे गये हैं; वे हैहय, हय तथा राजा वेणुहय नामवाले थे । हैहयका जो पुत्र हुआ, वह धर्म नामसे प्रसिद्ध है। है विप्रो! उसका धर्मनेत्र नामक पुत्र हुआ--ऐसा सुना गया है । धर्मनेत्रका पुरे कीर्ति था और उस कीर्ति -का पुत्र संजय था। संजयकां महिष्मान् नामक धार्मिक पुत्र था और महिष्मान्का पुत्र
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing his chaste mother as a weak lady, devoid of ornaments, sitting down dejectedly, with tears agitating the eyes, the boy said to her.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing his chaste mother as a weak lady, devoid of ornaments, sitting down dejectedly, with tears agitating the eyes, the boy said to her.

verses.sanskrit: कृच्छ्रात्सभार्यो भगवान् वसिष्ठः स्वाश्रमं क्षणात् अदृश्यन्त्या च पुण्यात्मा संविवेश स चिन्तयन्
verses.transliteration: kṛcchrātsabhāryo bhagavān vasiṣṭhaḥ svāśramaṃ kṣaṇāt adṛśyantyā ca puṇyātmā saṃviveśa sa cintayan
verses.translation: "O mother, O sinless one, your..lender body does not appear to be splendid without ornaments. It is like the night bereft of the disc of the moon.
verses.hindi: भद्रश्रेण्य था; वह प्रतापशाली था। भद्रश्रेण्यका पुत्र दुर्दम नामक राजा था। दुर्दमका बुद्धिमान् पुत्र धनक
verses.wordMeaning: "O mother, O sinless one, your..lender body does not appear to be splendid without ornaments. It is like the night bereft of the disc of the moon.
verses.commentary: Sense: "O mother, O sinless one, your..lender body does not appear to be splendid without ornaments. It is like the night bereft of the disc of the moon.

verses.sanskrit: सा गर्भं पालयामास कथंचिन्मुनिपुङ्गवाः कुलसंधारणार्थाय शक्तिपत्नी पतिव्रता
verses.transliteration: sā garbhaṃ pālayāmāsa kathaṃcinmunipuṅgavāḥ kulasaṃdhāraṇārthāya śaktipatnī pativratā
verses.translation: O my mother, O my mother, O splendid lady, it behoves you to recount to me why you are sitting here setting aside your auspicious marks as a woman without her husband."
verses.hindi: धनकके कृतवीर्य, कृताग्नि, कृतवर्मा तथा कृतौजा ये चार लोकमान्य पुत्र उत्पन्न हुए। उन कृतवीर्य कातंवीर्यर्जुन (सहस्रार्जुन) उत्पन्न हुआ; वह  अपनी
verses.wordMeaning: O my mother, O my mother, O splendid lady, it behoves you to recount to me why you are sitting here setting aside your auspicious marks as a woman without her husband."
verses.commentary: Sense: O my mother, O my mother, O splendid lady, it behoves you to recount to me why you are sitting here setting aside your auspicious marks as a woman without her husband."

verses.sanskrit: ततः सासूत तनयं दशमे मासि सुप्रभम् शक्तिपत्नी यथा शक्तिं शक्तिमन्तमरुन्धती
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sāsūta tanayaṃ daśame māsi suprabham śaktipatnī yathā śaktiṃ śaktimantamarundhatī
verses.translation: On hearing the words of her son, Adrsyanti did not tell her son anything, good or bad.
verses.hindi: ययातिपुत्र यदुके वंशका वर्णन
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing the words of her son, Adrsyanti did not tell her son anything, good or bad.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the words of her son, Adrsyanti did not tell her son anything, good or bad.

verses.sanskrit: असूत सा दितिर्विष्णुं यथा स्वाहा गुहं सुतम् अग्निं यथारणिः पत्नी शक्तेः साक्षात्पराशरम्
verses.transliteration: asūta sā ditirviṣṇuṃ yathā svāhā guhaṃ sutam agniṃ yathāraṇiḥ patnī śakteḥ sākṣātparāśaram
verses.translation: The son of Sakti said to Adrsyanti again, "O mother where is my holy father of great refulgence? Tell me, tell me."
verses.hindi: फफफफफपीफीफीफीफीफकीफाफकीफाफापाफफफफ कृतास्त्रा बलिनः शूरा धर्मात्मानो मनस्विनः । शूरश्च शूरसेनश्च धृष्टः कृष्णस्तथैव च
verses.wordMeaning: The son of Sakti said to Adrsyanti again, "O mother where is my holy father of great refulgence? Tell me, tell me."
verses.commentary: Sense: The son of Sakti said to Adrsyanti again, "O mother where is my holy father of great refulgence? Tell me, tell me."

verses.sanskrit: यदा तदा शक्तिसूनुर् अवतीर्णो महीतले शक्तिस्त्यक्त्वा तदा दुःखं पितॄणां समतां ययौ
verses.transliteration: yadā tadā śaktisūnur avatīrṇo mahītale śaktistyaktvā tadā duḥkhaṃ pitṝṇāṃ samatāṃ yayau
verses.translation: On hearing the words of her son, she became extremely agitated and wept. Saying "your father was devoured by a Raksasa" she fell down unconscious.
verses.hindi: जयध्वजश्च राजासीदावन्तीनां विशां पतिः। जयध्वजस्य पुत्रोऽभूत्तालजङ्को महाबलः
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing the words of her son, she became extremely agitated and wept. Saying "your father was devoured by a Raksasa" she fell down unconscious.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the words of her son, she became extremely agitated and wept. Saying "your father was devoured by a Raksasa" she fell down unconscious.

verses.sanskrit: भ्रातृभिः सह पुण्यात्मा आदित्यैर् इव भास्करः रराज पितृलोकस्थो वासिष्ठो मुनिपुङ्गवाः
verses.transliteration: bhrātṛbhiḥ saha puṇyātmā ādityair iva bhāskaraḥ rarāja pitṛlokastho vāsiṣṭho munipuṅgavāḥ
verses.translation: On hearing the words of his grandson, the kind-hearted
verses.hindi: शतं पुत्रास्तु तस्येह तालजङ्काः प्रकीर्तिताः। तेषां ज्येष्ठो महावीर्यो वीतिहोत्रोऽभवन्नृपः वृषप्रभूतयश्चान्ये तत्सुताः पुण्यकर्मणः। वृषो वंशकरस्तेषां तस्य पुत्रोऽभवन्मधुः
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing the words of his grandson, the kind-hearted
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the words of his grandson, the kind-hearted

verses.sanskrit: जगुस्तदा च पितरो ननृतुश् च पितामहाः प्रपितामहाश् च विप्रेन्द्रा ह्य् अवतीर्णे पराशरे
verses.transliteration: jagustadā ca pitaro nanṛtuś ca pitāmahāḥ prapitāmahāś ca viprendrā hy avatīrṇe parāśare
verses.translation: On hearing directly from his mother — "Your father was devoured by a demon", the intelligent Paraara spoke thus with his eyes dimmed and darkened by tears.
verses.hindi: यादवा यदुवंशेन निरुच्यन्ते तु हैहयाः॥
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing directly from his mother — "Your father was devoured by a demon", the intelligent Paraara spoke thus with his eyes dimmed and darkened by tears.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing directly from his mother — "Your father was devoured by a demon", the intelligent Paraara spoke thus with his eyes dimmed and darkened by tears.

verses.sanskrit: ये ब्रह्मवादिनो भूमौ ननृतुर् दिवि देवताः पुष्कराद्याश् च ससृजुः पुष्पवर्षं च खेचराः
verses.transliteration: ye brahmavādino bhūmau nanṛtur divi devatāḥ puṣkarādyāś ca sasṛjuḥ puṣpavarṣaṃ ca khecarāḥ
verses.translation: O mother, I think I will be able to show my father in a moment by worshipping the lord of the chiefs of Devas and of the three worlds including the mobile and immobile beings.*
verses.hindi: तेषां पञ्चगणा होते हैहयानां महात्मनाम् शूरसेनास्तु विख्यातास्तालजङ्घास्तथैव च
verses.wordMeaning: O mother, I think I will be able to show my father in a moment by worshipping the lord of the chiefs of Devas and of the three worlds including the mobile and immobile beings.*
verses.commentary: Sense: O mother, I think I will be able to show my father in a moment by worshipping the lord of the chiefs of Devas and of the three worlds including the mobile and immobile beings.*

verses.sanskrit: पुरेषु राक्षसानां च प्रणादं विषमं द्विजाः आश्रमस्थाश् च मुनयः समूहुर्हर्षसंततिम्
verses.transliteration: pureṣu rākṣasānāṃ ca praṇādaṃ viṣamaṃ dvijāḥ āśramasthāś ca munayaḥ samūhurharṣasaṃtatim
verses.translation: On hearing these splendid words she was surprised. Smilingly she looked at him and said: — "O son, this is true. Worship the lord."
verses.hindi: शूरश्च शूरसेनश्च वृषः कृष्णस्तथैव च। जयध्वजः पञ्चमस्तु विख्याता हैहयोत्तमाः
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing these splendid words she was surprised. Smilingly she looked at him and said: — "O son, this is true. Worship the lord."
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing these splendid words she was surprised. Smilingly she looked at him and said: — "O son, this is true. Worship the lord."

verses.sanskrit: अवतीर्णो यथा ह्यण्डाद् भानुः सो ऽपि पराशरः अदृश्यन्त्याश्चतुर्वक्त्रो मेघजालाद्दिवाकरः
verses.transliteration: avatīrṇo yathā hyaṇḍād bhānuḥ so 'pi parāśaraḥ adṛśyantyāścaturvaktro meghajālāddivākaraḥ
verses.translation: On understanding the proposal and decision of the son of Sakti, Vasistha the holy lord, the intelligent leading sage, and the storehouse of mercy, spoke to his grandson as follows: —
verses.hindi: शूरश्च शूरवीरश्च शूरसेनस्य चानधाः। शूरसेना इति ख्याता देशास्तेषां महात्मनाम् हजार भुजाओंके द्वारा सातो द्वीपोंका श्रेष्ठ स्वामी हो
verses.wordMeaning: On understanding the proposal and decision of the son of Sakti, Vasistha the holy lord, the intelligent leading sage, and the storehouse of mercy, spoke to his grandson as follows: —
verses.commentary: Sense: On understanding the proposal and decision of the son of Sakti, Vasistha the holy lord, the intelligent leading sage, and the storehouse of mercy, spoke to his grandson as follows: —

verses.sanskrit: सुखं च दुःखमभवद् अदृश्यन्त्यास्तथा द्विजाः दृष्ट्वा पुत्रं पतिं स्मृत्वा अरुन्धत्या मुनेस्तथा
verses.transliteration: sukhaṃ ca duḥkhamabhavad adṛśyantyāstathā dvijāḥ dṛṣṭvā putraṃ patiṃ smṛtvā arundhatyā munestathā
verses.translation: "O my grandson, O excellent sage of good holy rites, your proposal is proper and suitable. Still, listen, it does not behove you to destroy the world. You can worship the lord for. exterminating Raksasas. But, O son of Sakti, what is the harm done to you by the world that you need destroy it?"
verses.hindi: उसकी मृत्युका कारण बने। उसके सौ पुत्र थे; उनमेंसे पाँच पुत्र महारथी, अस्त्रोंके ज्ञाता, बलशाली वीर, धर्मात्मा तथा मनस्वी थे। वे शूर, शूरसेन, धृष्ट, कृष्ण तथा जयध्वज नामवाले थे। राजा जयध्वज
verses.wordMeaning: "O my grandson, O excellent sage of good holy rites, your proposal is proper and suitable. Still, listen, it does not behove you to destroy the world. You can worship the lord for. exterminating Raksasas. But, O son of Sakti,…
verses.commentary: Sense: "O my grandson, O excellent sage of good holy rites, your proposal is proper and suitable. Still, listen, it does not behove you to destroy the world. You can worship the lord for. exterminating Raksasas. But, O son of Sakti,…

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा च तनयं बाला पराशरमतिद्युतिम् ललाप विह्वला बाला सन्नकण्ठी पपात च
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvā ca tanayaṃ bālā parāśaramatidyutim lalāpa vihvalā bālā sannakaṇṭhī papāta ca
verses.translation: Parasara bowed down to Adrsyanti, Vasistha and Arundhati. In the presence of the sage he made a single Lihga, in a trice, out of dust. Repeating the following Mantras from the Vedas he worshipped it. The mantras were Sivasukta, Tryambakasukta, Tvaritarudra, Siva Sahkalpa, Nilarudra, Rudra, Vamiya, Pavamana, Pahea Brahman, Hotrsukta, Lihga- sukta and Atharvas'iras. After worshipping duly he offered the eightfold Arghya to Rudra.
verses.hindi: अवन्तीयोंका स्वामी था। जयध्वजको तालजंघ नामक महाबली पुत्र हुआ। उस तालजंघ-के सौ पुत्र हुए, जो इस लोकमें “तालजंघ' नामसे प्रसिद्ध हुए। उनमें ज्येष्ठ पुत्र वीतिहोत्र महापराक्रमी राजा हुआ। वृष आदि उसके जो अन्य पुत्र थे, वे पुण्यकर्मवाले थे। उनमें वृष ही वंशको चलानेवाला हुआ। उसका पुत्र मधु हुआ। मधुके सौ पुत्र थे। उस मधु-का पुत्र वृष्णि ही वंशप्रवर्तक हुआ। वृष्णिके सभी
verses.wordMeaning: Parasara bowed down to Adrsyanti, Vasistha and Arundhati. In the presence of the sage he made a single Lihga, in a trice, out of dust. Repeating the following Mantras from the Vedas he worshipped it. The mantras were Sivasukta, Tryambakasukta, Tvaritarudra, Siva Sahkalpa,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Parasara bowed down to Adrsyanti, Vasistha and Arundhati. In the presence of the sage he made a single Lihga, in a trice, out of dust. Repeating the following Mantras from the Vedas he worshipped it. The mantras were Sivasukta, Tryambakasukta, Tvaritarudra, Siva Sahkalpa,…

verses.sanskrit: सा पराशरमहो महामतिं देवदानवगणैश् च पूजितम् जातमात्रम् अनघं शुचिस्मिता बुध्य साश्रुनयना ललाप च
verses.transliteration: sā parāśaramaho mahāmatiṃ devadānavagaṇaiś ca pūjitam jātamātram anaghaṃ śucismitā budhya sāśrunayanā lalāpa ca
verses.translation: trailokyarh sacaracaram: Change the accusative case into the genitive case and supply 'isam' to obtain the required meaning. The ex- pression 'trailokyasya sacaracarasya isam* would mean 'lord of the three worlds including the mobile and immobile beings*. ST. is not in favour of this change. It supplies 'dagdhva* which it construes with 'trailokyam sacara- caraem; i.c. 'having burnt the three worlds including the mobile and immobile beings'.
verses.hindi: वंशज “वृष्णि' तथा मधुके वंशज माधव कहे गये हैं। यदुबंशसे सम्बन्धित यादव हैहय कहे जाते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: trailokyarh sacaracaram: Change the accusative case into the genitive case and supply 'isam' to obtain the required meaning. The ex- pression 'trailokyasya sacaracarasya isam* would mean 'lord of the three worlds including the mobile and immobile beings*. ST.…
verses.commentary: Sense: trailokyarh sacaracaram: Change the accusative case into the genitive case and supply 'isam' to obtain the required meaning. The ex- pression 'trailokyasya sacaracarasya isam* would mean 'lord of the three worlds including the mobile and immobile beings*. ST.…

verses.sanskrit: हा वसिष्ठसुत कुत्रचिद्गतः पश्य पुत्रमनघं तवात्मजम् त्यज्य दीनवदनां वनान्तरे पुत्रदर्शनपरामिमां प्रभो
verses.transliteration: hā vasiṣṭhasuta kutracidgataḥ paśya putramanaghaṃ tavātmajam tyajya dīnavadanāṃ vanāntare putradarśanaparāmimāṃ prabho
verses.translation: "O lord Rudra, O iSankara, my father of great refulgence was swallowed by the demon Rudbira along with his brothers.
verses.hindi: उन महात्मा हैहयोंके ये पाँच वंश हैं-वीतिहोत्र, ह्यात, भोज, अवन्ति तथा शूरसेन; ये तालजंघ भी कहे गये हैं  शूर, शूरसेन, वृष, कृष्ण एवं पाँचवाँ जयध्वज-- ये उत्तम हैहय कहे गये हैं। शूरसेनके वंशज शूर तथा शूरवीर नामवाले थे; है अनघ ऋषियो ! उन महात्माओंके
verses.wordMeaning: "O lord Rudra, O iSankara, my father of great refulgence was swallowed by the demon Rudbira along with his brothers.
verses.commentary: Sense: "O lord Rudra, O iSankara, my father of great refulgence was swallowed by the demon Rudbira along with his brothers.

verses.sanskrit: शक्ते स्वं च सुतं पश्य भ्रातृभिः सह षण्मुखम् यथा महेश्वरो ऽपश्यत् सगणो हृषिताननः
verses.transliteration: śakte svaṃ ca sutaṃ paśya bhrātṛbhiḥ saha ṣaṇmukham yathā maheśvaro 'paśyat sagaṇo hṛṣitānanaḥ
verses.translation: O lord, I wish to see my father along with his brothers."
verses.hindi: दुर्जयः कृष्णपुत्रस्तु बभूवामित्रकर्षण:
verses.wordMeaning: O lord, I wish to see my father along with his brothers."
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord, I wish to see my father along with his brothers."

verses.sanskrit: अथ तस्यास्तदालापं वसिष्ठो मुनिसत्तमः श्रुत्वा स्नुषामुवाचेदं मा रोदीर् इति दुःखितः
verses.transliteration: atha tasyāstadālāpaṃ vasiṣṭho munisattamaḥ śrutvā snuṣāmuvācedaṃ mā rodīr iti duḥkhitaḥ
verses.translation: "O highly blessed lady, see this ooy whose eyes are dimmed and darkened with tears. He is engaged in propitiating
verses.hindi: यस्यान्वये तु सम्भूतो विष्णुर्वीष्णिकुलोद्वहः क्रोष्टोरेकोऽभवत्पुत्रो वृजिनीवान् महायशा: । तस्य पुत्रोभवत्स्वाती कुशंकुस्तत्सुतो५भवत्
verses.wordMeaning: "O highly blessed lady, see this ooy whose eyes are dimmed and darkened with tears. He is engaged in propitiating
verses.commentary: Sense: "O highly blessed lady, see this ooy whose eyes are dimmed and darkened with tears. He is engaged in propitiating

verses.sanskrit: आज्ञया तस्य सा शोकं वसिष्ठस्य कुलाङ्गना त्यक्त्वा ह्यपालयद्बालं बाला बालमृगेक्षणा
verses.transliteration: ājñayā tasya sā śokaṃ vasiṣṭhasya kulāṅganā tyaktvā hyapālayadbālaṃ bālā bālamṛgekṣaṇā
verses.translation: The spotless great goddess saw Parasara, his eyes dimmed and his body drenched by tears due to misery. He was interested only in the act of worshipping the Lihga. He repeated the names ''Hara'', ''Rudra*' etc. Uma then spoke to 5iva her husband and the lord of the worlds.
verses.hindi: जज्ञे चित्ररथस्तस्य पुत्रः कर्मभिरन्वितः। अथ चित्ररथो वीरो यज्चा विपुलदक्षिणः
verses.wordMeaning: The spotless great goddess saw Parasara, his eyes dimmed and his body drenched by tears due to misery. He was interested only in the act of worshipping the Lihga. He repeated the names ''Hara'', ''Rudra*' etc. Uma then spoke to 5iva her husband and the lord of the worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: The spotless great goddess saw Parasara, his eyes dimmed and his body drenched by tears due to misery. He was interested only in the act of worshipping the Lihga. He repeated the names ''Hara'', ''Rudra*' etc. Uma then spoke to 5iva her husband and the lord of the worlds.

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा तामबलां प्राह मङ्गलाभरणैर् विना आसीनामाकुलां साध्वीं बाष्पपर्याकुलेक्षणाम्
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvā tāmabalāṃ prāha maṅgalābharaṇair vinā āsīnāmākulāṃ sādhvīṃ bāṣpaparyākulekṣaṇām
verses.translation: O supreme lord, be pleased, grant him all his desires. On hearing her words, Sankara Paramevara, the swallower of halahala poison, spoke to his noble consort Uma — " I shall save this brahmin boy whose eyes resemble full blown blue lotus.
verses.hindi: देश भी “शूरसेन'-इस नामवाले कहे गये हैं। बोतिहोञका  पुत्र अनर्त नामसे प्रसिद्ध हुआ। कृष्णका दुर्जय नामक पुत्र हुआ, वह शत्रुओंका दमन करनेवाला था  अब राजर्षि क्रोष्टुके उत्तम पौरुषवाले वंशका श्रवण कीजिये जिसके कुलमें वृष्णिवंशको चलानेवाले विष्णु (कृष्ण) उत्पन्न हुए। क्रोष्ट्का एक ही वृजिनीवान् नामक महायशस्वी पुत्र हुआ। उसका पुत्र स्वाती हुआ और उस स्वाती-का पुत्र कुशंकु हुआ। उसके बाद संतानकी
verses.wordMeaning: O supreme lord, be pleased, grant him all his desires. On hearing her words, Sankara Paramevara, the swallower of halahala poison, spoke to his noble consort Uma — " I shall save this brahmin boy whose eyes resemble full blown blue lotus.
verses.commentary: Sense: O supreme lord, be pleased, grant him all his desires. On hearing her words, Sankara Paramevara, the swallower of halahala poison, spoke to his noble consort Uma — " I shall save this brahmin boy whose eyes resemble full blown blue lotus.

verses.sanskrit: अम्ब मङ्गलविभूषणैर् विना देहयष्टिरनघे न शोभते वक्तुमर्हसि तवाद्य कारणं चन्द्रबिंबरहितेव शर्वरी
verses.transliteration: amba maṅgalavibhūṣaṇair vinā dehayaṣṭiranaghe na śobhate vaktumarhasi tavādya kāraṇaṃ candrabiṃbarahiteva śarvarī
verses.translation: I shall give him divine vision.uid enable him to see my form." After saying this, lord Nllalohita, Paramesvara, surrounded by the divine Ganas — Brahma, Indra, Vi§nu, Rudra, and others granted vision to that intelligent son of the sage.
verses.hindi: इच्छा रखते हुए उन महाबली कुशंकुने अनेक प्रकारके पर्याप्त दक्षिणावाले महायज्ञोंके द्वारा यजन किया। इसके परिणामस्वरूप उसका चित्ररथ नामक पुत्र उत्पन्न हुआ, जो शुभ कर्मोसे युक्त था। चित्ररथका
verses.wordMeaning: I shall give him divine vision.uid enable him to see my form." After saying this, lord Nllalohita, Paramesvara, surrounded by the divine Ganas — Brahma, Indra, Vi§nu, Rudra, and others granted vision to that intelligent son of the sage.
verses.commentary: Sense: I shall give him divine vision.uid enable him to see my form." After saying this, lord Nllalohita, Paramesvara, surrounded by the divine Ganas — Brahma, Indra, Vi§nu, Rudra, and others granted vision to that intelligent son of the sage.

verses.sanskrit: मातर्मातः कथं त्यक्त्वा मङ्गलाभरणानि वै आसीना भर्तृहीनेव वक्तुमर्हसि शोभने
verses.transliteration: mātarmātaḥ kathaṃ tyaktvā maṅgalābharaṇāni vai āsīnā bhartṛhīneva vaktumarhasi śobhane
verses.translation: On seeing Mahadeva, his eyes became dimmed with tears of delight. Delighted in his heart he fell at his feet with great respect.
verses.hindi: देकर यज्ञ करके उत्तम तथा पवित्र व्रत आदि किया। इस प्रकार वह महाज्ञानी, महापराक्रमी तथा बहुत प्रजाओंवाला चक्रवर्ती राजा हो गया॥ १६--२५॥ शशबिन्दुके हजार पुत्र उपन्न हुए; लोग उनके पुत्रोंमें अनन्तकको सबसे उत्तम कहते हैं। अनन्तकसे यज्ञ नामक पुत्र उत्पन्न हुआ। यज्ञका पुत्र धृति हुआ। उस धृति-का पुत्र उशना हुआ; उस परम धार्मिकने
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing Mahadeva, his eyes became dimmed with tears of delight. Delighted in his heart he fell at his feet with great respect.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing Mahadeva, his eyes became dimmed with tears of delight. Delighted in his heart he fell at his feet with great respect.

verses.sanskrit: अदृश्यन्ती तदा वाक्यं श्रुत्वा तस्य सुतस्य सा न किंचिद् अब्रवीत् पुत्रं शुभं वा यदि वेतरत्
verses.transliteration: adṛśyantī tadā vākyaṃ śrutvā tasya sutasya sā na kiṃcid abravīt putraṃ śubhaṃ vā yadi vetarat
verses.translation: Thereafter he grasped the feet of Uma and the noble Nandin and then spoke to Brahma, and others — "My life is fruitful today.
verses.hindi: इस पृथ्वीको प्राप्त करके एक सौ अश्वमेध यज्ञ किया। उशनाका पुत्र सितेषु नामक राजा कहा गया है। उसका पुत्र मरुत था; वह वंशको बढ़ानेवाला राजर्षि हुआ। पराक्रमी कम्बलबर्हि उस मरुतका पुत्र बताया गया
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter he grasped the feet of Uma and the noble Nandin and then spoke to Brahma, and others — "My life is fruitful today.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter he grasped the feet of Uma and the noble Nandin and then spoke to Brahma, and others — "My life is fruitful today.

verses.sanskrit: अदृश्यन्तीं पुनः प्राह शाक्तेयो भगवान्मम मातः कुत्र महातेजाः पिता वद वदेति ताम्
verses.transliteration: adṛśyantīṃ punaḥ prāha śākteyo bhagavānmama mātaḥ kutra mahātejāḥ pitā vada vadeti tām
verses.translation: Today the crescent moon-bedecked diety has come for my protection. Who else can compare with me in this world, whether a Deva or a Danava?"
verses.hindi: है। कम्बलबर्हिका पुत्र रुक्मकवच हुआ; वह विद्वान् करनेवाले वीरोंको अपने तीक्ष्ण बाणोंसे मारकर उत्तम श्री प्राप्त कर ली थी। उस धर्मात्माने अश्वमेध- यज्ञमें यज्ञ करानेवाले ऋत्विजोंको पृथ्वीका दान
verses.wordMeaning: Today the crescent moon-bedecked diety has come for my protection. Who else can compare with me in this world, whether a Deva or a Danava?"
verses.commentary: Sense: Today the crescent moon-bedecked diety has come for my protection. Who else can compare with me in this world, whether a Deva or a Danava?"

verses.sanskrit: श्रुत्वा रुरोद सा वाक्यं पुत्रस्यातीव विह्वला भक्षितो रक्षसा तातस् तवेति निपपात च
verses.transliteration: śrutvā ruroda sā vākyaṃ putrasyātīva vihvalā bhakṣito rakṣasā tātas taveti nipapāta ca
verses.translation: Thereafter in a moment, Parasara the son of Sakti saw his father standing in heaven along with his brothers.
verses.hindi: रुक्मकवचसे शत्रुवीरोंका संहार करनेवाला परावृत् उत्पन्न हुआ। उस परावृत्से पाँच महाशक्तिशाली पुत्र उत्पन्न हुए-रुक्मेषु, पृथुरुक्म, ज्यामघ, परिघ और हरि। पिताने परिघ तथा हरिको विदेहदेशोमें स्थापित
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter in a moment, Parasara the son of Sakti saw his father standing in heaven along with his brothers.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter in a moment, Parasara the son of Sakti saw his father standing in heaven along with his brothers.

verses.sanskrit: श्रुत्वा वसिष्ठो ऽपि पपात भूमौ पौत्रस्य वाक्यं स रुदन्दयालुः अरुन्धती चाश्रमवासिनस्तदा मुनेर्वसिष्ठस्य मुनीश्वराश् च
verses.transliteration: śrutvā vasiṣṭho 'pi papāta bhūmau pautrasya vākyaṃ sa rudandayāluḥ arundhatī cāśramavāsinastadā munervasiṣṭhasya munīśvarāś ca
verses.translation: On seeing him accompanied by his brothers in an
verses.hindi: किया। रुवमेषु राजा हुआ और पृथुरुक्म उसके आश्रये शशबिन्दुस्तु वै राजा अन्वयाद् व्रतमुत्तमम्। चक्रवर्ती महासत्त्वो महावीर्यो बहुप्रजः
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing him accompanied by his brothers in an
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing him accompanied by his brothers in an

verses.sanskrit: भक्षितो रक्षसा मातुः पिता तव मुखादिति श्रुत्वा पराशरो धीमान् प्राह चास्राविलेक्षणः
verses.transliteration: bhakṣito rakṣasā mātuḥ pitā tava mukhāditi śrutvā parāśaro dhīmān prāha cāsrāvilekṣaṇaḥ
verses.translation: Then the bull-bannered lord who was accompanied by his wife and the leading Ganas spoke thus to Sakti, the son of Vasistha who was eager to see his son.
verses.hindi: अनन्तकात्सुतो यज्ञो यज्ञस्य तनयो धृतिः। उशनास्तस्य तनयः सम्प्राप्य तु महीमिमाम्
verses.wordMeaning: Then the bull-bannered lord who was accompanied by his wife and the leading Ganas spoke thus to Sakti, the son of Vasistha who was eager to see his son.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the bull-bannered lord who was accompanied by his wife and the leading Ganas spoke thus to Sakti, the son of Vasistha who was eager to see his son.

verses.sanskrit: अभ्यर्च्य देवदेवेशं त्रैलोक्यं सचराचरम् क्षणेन मातः पितरं दर्शयामीति मे मतिः
verses.transliteration: abhyarcya devadeveśaṃ trailokyaṃ sacarācaram kṣaṇena mātaḥ pitaraṃ darśayāmīti me matiḥ
verses.translation: O Sakti, see your son, the boy whose eyes are dimmed with tears of delight. O leading brahmin, see AdHyanti, Vasistha your father, Arundhati your mother, the highly blessed auspicious lady comparable to goddess. O highly intelligent one, make obeisance to both your father and your mother.
verses.hindi: अश्वमेधे तु धर्मात्मा ऋत्विग्भ्यः पृथिवीं ददौ अध्याय ६८  ययातिपुत्र यदुके वंशका वर्णन २९७ रूक्मेषुरभवद्राजा पृथुरुक्मस्तदाश्रयात्। तैस्तु प्रत्राजितो राजा ज्यामघोऽवसदाश्रमे
verses.wordMeaning: O Sakti, see your son, the boy whose eyes are dimmed with tears of delight. O leading brahmin, see AdHyanti, Vasistha your father, Arundhati your mother, the highly blessed auspicious lady comparable to goddess. O highly intelligent one,…
verses.commentary: Sense: O Sakti, see your son, the boy whose eyes are dimmed with tears of delight. O leading brahmin, see AdHyanti, Vasistha your father, Arundhati your mother, the highly blessed auspicious lady comparable to goddess. O highly intelligent one,…

verses.sanskrit: सा निशम्य वचनं तदा शुभं सस्मिता तनयमाह विस्मिता तथ्यम् एतदिति तं निरीक्ष्य सा पुत्र पुत्र भवमर्चयेति च
verses.transliteration: sā niśamya vacanaṃ tadā śubhaṃ sasmitā tanayamāha vismitā tathyam etaditi taṃ nirīkṣya sā putra putra bhavamarcayeti ca
verses.translation: At the behest of Sankara, Sakti immediately, at first, bowed down to the lord of Devas and to Uma. lie then bowed to the excellent Vasistha and to Arundhati his highly blessed mother, the auspicious lady who considered her husband her god. At the behest of the lord of the Universe the power- (ul Sakti said: —
verses.hindi: नर्मदातीरमेकाको केवलं भार्यया युतः। ऋक्षवन्तं गिरिं गत्वा त्यक्तमन्यैरुवास सः
verses.wordMeaning: At the behest of Sankara, Sakti immediately, at first, bowed down to the lord of Devas and to Uma. lie then bowed to the excellent Vasistha and to Arundhati his highly blessed mother, the auspicious lady who considered her husband her god.…
verses.commentary: Sense: At the behest of Sankara, Sakti immediately, at first, bowed down to the lord of Devas and to Uma. lie then bowed to the excellent Vasistha and to Arundhati his highly blessed mother, the auspicious lady who considered her husband her god.…

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञात्वा शक्तिसुतस्यास्य संकल्पं मुनिपुङ्गवः वसिष्ठो भगवान्प्राह पौत्रं धीमान् घृणानिधिः
verses.transliteration: jñātvā śaktisutasyāsya saṃkalpaṃ munipuṅgavaḥ vasiṣṭho bhagavānprāha pautraṃ dhīmān ghṛṇānidhiḥ
verses.translation: p dear son, O leading brahmin, Parara of great refulgence, I have been saved by you who had been in the womb when I died and who are a noble soul.
verses.hindi: लगा। उन सबके द्वारा राज्यसे हटा दिया गया राजा ज्यामघ आश्रममें निवास करने लगा। ब्राह्मणोंने शान्त होकर वनमें निवास करनेवाले उस ज्यामघको ज्ञान प्रदान किया और ध्वजा तथा रथ धारण करनेवाला वह अपना धनुष लेकर दूसरे देशमें चला गया। अन्य लोगांद्वारा त्यक्त वह ऋक्षवान्-पर्वतपर जाकर अपनी भार्याके साथ नर्मदा नदीके तटपर अकेला निवास करने लगा
verses.wordMeaning: p dear son, O leading brahmin, Parara of great refulgence, I have been saved by you who had been in the womb when I died and who are a noble soul.
verses.commentary: Sense: p dear son, O leading brahmin, Parara of great refulgence, I have been saved by you who had been in the womb when I died and who are a noble soul.

verses.sanskrit: ईप्सितं वरयेशानं जगतां प्रभवं प्रभुम् गमिष्याम्यभिवन्द्येशं भ्रातृभिः सह शङ्करम्

verses.hindi: श्वफल्क इति विख्यातस्त्रैलोक्यहितकारकः श्वफल्कश्च महाराजो धर्मात्मा यत्र वर्तते। नास्ति व्याधिभयं तत्र नावृष्टिभयमप्युत

verses.sanskrit: एवं पुत्रमुपामन्त्र्य प्रणम्य च महेश्वरम् निरीक्ष्य भार्यां सदसि जगाम पितरं वशी

verses.hindi: श्वफल्कः काशिराजस्य सुतां भार्यामवाप सः। गान्दिनीं नाम काश्यो हि ददौ तस्मै स्वकन्यकाम्

verses.sanskrit: गतं दृष्ट्वाथ पितरं तदाभ्यर्च्यैव शङ्करम् तुष्टाव वाग्भिर् इष्टाभिः शाक्तेयः शशिभूषणम्
verses.transliteration: gataṃ dṛṣṭvātha pitaraṃ tadābhyarcyaiva śaṅkaram tuṣṭāva vāgbhir iṣṭābhiḥ śākteyaḥ śaśibhūṣaṇam
verses.translation: It extends to six thousand verses, and contains Vedic topics. It is the fourth®® among the Purana collections and a splendid one. Thus O leading sages, the origin oi the descendants of Vasistha and the prowess of the son of Sakti has been succinctly recounted to you.
verses.hindi: श्रीलिड्रमहापुराण तब पिताने उच विताने गर्भमें विद्यमान उस कन्या -से द + विद्यमान उस कन्या-से आहा “तुम शीघ्र जन्म ग्रहण करो, तुम्हारा कल्याण हो, तुम गर्भमें ही क्यों रुकी हुई हो ?' तब गर्भमें स्थित कन्या गान्दिनीने उनसे कहा--'हे पितः ! यदि आप तीन
verses.wordMeaning: It extends to six thousand verses, and contains Vedic topics. It is the fourth®® among the Purana collections and a splendid one. Thus O leading sages, the origin oi the descendants of Vasistha and the prowess of the son of Sakti has been succinctly recounted to you.

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तुष्टो महादेवो मन्मथान्धकमर्दनः अनुगृह्याथ शाक्तेयं तत्रैवान्तरधीयत
verses.transliteration: tatastuṣṭo mahādevo manmathāndhakamardanaḥ anugṛhyātha śākteyaṃ tatraivāntaradhīyata
verses.translation: It extends to six thousand verses, and contains Vedic topics. It is the fourth®® among the Purana collections and a splendid one. Thus O leading sages, the origin oi the descendants of Vasistha and the prowess of the son of Sakti has been succinctly recounted to you.
verses.hindi: वर्षोतक प्रतिदिन एक गाय ब्राह्मणको दानमें दें, तब मै गर्भसे बाहर निकलूँगी।' इसपर पिताने कहा--'वेसा ही होगा।' इसके बाद पिताने उसकी कामना पूर्ण की। उसी कन्यासे श्वफल्कके द्वारा अक्रूर उत्पन्न कहा गया है, जो
verses.wordMeaning: It extends to six thousand verses, and contains Vedic topics. It is the fourth®® among the Purana collections and a splendid one. Thus O leading sages, the origin oi the descendants of Vasistha and the prowess of the son of Sakti has been succinctly recounted to you.

verses.sanskrit: गते महेश्वरे सांबे प्रणम्य च महेश्वरम् ददाह राक्षसानां तु कुलं मन्त्रेण मन्त्रवित्
verses.transliteration: gate maheśvare sāṃbe praṇamya ca maheśvaram dadāha rākṣasānāṃ tu kulaṃ mantreṇa mantravit
verses.translation: It extends to six thousand verses, and contains Vedic topics. It is the fourth®® among the Purana collections and a splendid one. Thus O leading sages, the origin oi the descendants of Vasistha and the prowess of the son of Sakti has been succinctly recounted to you.
verses.hindi: दानी, पराक्रमी, यज्ञ करनेवाला, विद्वान्, अतिथिप्रिय तथा विपुल दक्षिणा देनेवाला था। शैवकी रत्ना नामक कन्या थी, उसीको अक्रूरने  भार्यारूपमें प्राप्त किया था। हे ऋषियो! उसने इस कन्या-से जिन पुत्रोंको उत्पन्न गिरिरक्ष, उपेक्ष, शत्रुघ्न, अरिमर्दन, धर्मभृत्, दृष्टधर्मा,

verses.sanskrit: तदाह पौत्रं धर्मज्ञो वसिष्ठो मुनिभिर् वृतः अलम् अत्यन्तकोपेन तात मन्युमिमं जहि
verses.transliteration: tadāha pautraṃ dharmajño vasiṣṭho munibhir vṛtaḥ alam atyantakopena tāta manyumimaṃ jahi

verses.hindi: अक्रूरको उग्रसेनकी कन्यासे देववान् तथा उपदेव नामक दो पुत्र उत्पन्न हुए; वे कुलको आनन्द प्रदान करनेवाले एवं देवतुल्य थे॥ २१--२८ /३॥
verses.wordMeaning: It extends to six thousand verses, and contains Vedic topics. It is the fourth®® among the Purana collections and a splendid one. Thus O leading sages, the origin oi the descendants of Vasistha and the prowess of the son of Sakti has been succinctly recounted to you.

verses.sanskrit: राक्षसा नापराध्यन्ति पितुस् ते विहितं तथा मूढानामेव भवति क्रोधो बुद्धिमतां न हि

verses.wordMeaning: It extends to six thousand verses, and contains Vedic topics. It is the fourth®® among the Purana collections and a splendid one. Thus O leading sages, the origin oi the descendants of Vasistha and the prowess of the son of Sakti has been succinctly recounted to you.
verses.commentary: Sense: It extends to six thousand verses, and contains Vedic topics. It is the fourth®® among the Purana collections and a splendid one. Thus O leading sages, the origin oi the descendants of Vasistha and the prowess of the son of Sakti has been succinctly recounted to you.

verses.translation: O brahmins, Aditi bore to Kasyapa the son Aditya. Aditya had a chief wife and three others.
verses.hindi: वध कर दिये जानेके बाद और बलरामके जन्म लेनेके बाद बुद्धिमान् वसुदेवने देवकीसे श्रीकृष्णको उत्पन्न किया। वे ही परमात्मा, देवदेव तथा जनार्दन हैं और रजत (चाँदी)- के समान कान्तिवाले हलायुध (बलराम) भगवान् अनन्त

verses.sanskrit: अदितिः सुषुवे पुत्रम् आदित्यं कश्यपाद्द्विजाः तस्यादित्यस्य चैवासीद् भार्या त्रयम् अथापरम्

verses.hindi: (शेष) हैं। वे जनार्दन ( श्रीविष्णु) भृगुके शापके बहाने मानवशरीर धारण करना स्वीकार करते हुए उस देवकोसे वसुदेवके पुत्ररूपमें उत्पन्न हुए थे उसी समय देवदेव  श्रीविष्णु -की आज्ञासे उमाके देहसे उत्पन्न योगनिद्रा भगवती कौशिकीने यशोदाको पुत्रीके रूपमें जन्म लिया था। वे ही सभी देवताओंसे नमस्कृत साक्षात् प्रकृति हैं और धर्म तथा मोक्षका फल

verses.translation: fa4-prakaram — d-axhiarGpam 'consisting of six parts*.

verses.sanskrit: यमं च यमुनां चैव राज्ञी रेवतमेव च प्रभा प्रभातम् आदित्याच् छायां संज्ञाप्यकल्पयत्

verses.sanskrit: छाया च तस्मात्सुषुवे सावर्णिं भास्कराद्द्विजाः ततः शनिं च तपतीं विष्टिं चैव यथाक्रमम्

verses.translation: More than her own sons Ghaya loved Manu.® Yama could not brook this. He became exceedingly infuriated. Lifting up his right foot he kicked her furiously. Assaulted by Yama, Ghaya became very miserable.

verses.commentary: Sense: More than her own sons Ghaya loved Manu.® Yama could not brook this. He became exceedingly infuriated. Lifting up his right foot he kicked her furiously. Assaulted by Yama, Ghaya became very miserable.
