verses.wordMeaning: Due* to the curse of Ghaya one healthy foot of Yama became watery i.e. covered with eczematic eruptions and full of foetid blood and swarms of germs.
verses.commentary: Sense: Due* to the curse of Ghaya one healthy foot of Yama became watery i.e. covered with eczematic eruptions and full of foetid blood and swarms of germs.

verses.sanskrit: संताडयामास रुषा पादमुद्यम्य दक्षिणम् यमेन ताडिता सा तु छाया वै दुःखिताभवत्
verses.transliteration: saṃtāḍayāmāsa ruṣā pādamudyamya dakṣiṇam yamena tāḍitā sā tu chāyā vai duḥkhitābhavat
verses.translation: He went to Gokarna travelling on a plank, and propitia- ted Mahadeva there for millions of years living only on air.
verses.hindi: लिया। लोकोंके रक्षक तथा अपनी इच्छासे शरीर धारण करनेवाले इन विष्णुको देकर उन्होंने नन्दगोपसे कहा... “इसकी रक्षा कीजिये।' अमित तेजवाले देवदेव शिवकी कृपासे बलरामके साथ उन वरदायक, परमेश्वर,
verses.wordMeaning: He went to Gokarna travelling on a plank, and propitia- ted Mahadeva there for millions of years living only on air.
verses.commentary: Sense: He went to Gokarna travelling on a plank, and propitia- ted Mahadeva there for millions of years living only on air.

verses.sanskrit: छायाशापात् पदं चैकं यमस्य क्लिन्नमुत्तमम् पूयशोणितसम्पूर्णं कृमीणां निचयान्वितम्
verses.transliteration: chāyāśāpāt padaṃ caikaṃ yamasya klinnamuttamam pūyaśoṇitasampūrṇaṃ kṛmīṇāṃ nicayānvitam
verses.translation: In course of time lord sun the husband of Chaya realised after a great effort that she was only a shadow. Assum- ing the form of a horse he indulged in sexual intercourse with Sarhjfia who had adopted the form of a mare.
verses.hindi: पृथ्वीका भार दूर करनेके लिये अवतीर्ण तथा गुरु श्रीकृष्ण-को प्रदान करके कहा था--' इससे यादवोंका सब प्रकारका कल्याण होगा। यह देवकीका वही पुत्र है, जो हम लोगोंके कष्टोंको दूर करेगा ॥ ५१--५५ /२॥
verses.wordMeaning: In course of time lord sun the husband of Chaya realised after a great effort that she was only a shadow. Assum- ing the form of a horse he indulged in sexual intercourse with Sarhjfia who had adopted the form of a mare.
verses.commentary: Sense: In course of time lord sun the husband of Chaya realised after a great effort that she was only a shadow. Assum- ing the form of a horse he indulged in sexual intercourse with Sarhjfia who had adopted the form of a mare.

verses.sanskrit: सो ऽपि गोकर्णमाश्रित्य फलकेनानिलाशनः आराधयन्महादेवं यावद्वर्षायुतायुतम्
verses.transliteration: so 'pi gokarṇamāśritya phalakenānilāśanaḥ ārādhayanmahādevaṃ yāvadvarṣāyutāyutam
verses.translation: Thus Sarhjfia the daughter of Tvastr who was in the guise of a mare bore to him the twin lords Alvins, the exce- llent physicians of Devas.
verses.hindi: उसके बाद वसुदेवने उग्रसेनपुत्र कंससे सुन्दर लक्षणोंवाली उस उत्पन्न हुई कन्याके विषयमें बताया-- हे कंस! है सुव्रत! यह देवकीका आठवाँ गर्भ ही तुम्हारा मृत्युरूप होगा; इसमें सन्देह नहीं--यह पुरातन
verses.wordMeaning: Thus Sarhjfia the daughter of Tvastr who was in the guise of a mare bore to him the twin lords Alvins, the exce- llent physicians of Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus Sarhjfia the daughter of Tvastr who was in the guise of a mare bore to him the twin lords Alvins, the exce- llent physicians of Devas.

verses.sanskrit: भवप्रसादाद् आगत्य लोकपालत्वमुत्तमम् पितॄणामाधिपत्यं तु शापमोक्षं तथैव च
verses.transliteration: bhavaprasādād āgatya lokapālatvamuttamam pitṝṇāmādhipatyaṃ tu śāpamokṣaṃ tathaiva ca
verses.translation: Pflrvo Manu: i.c, Vaivasvata. Construe: purvo Manu cak- fama, Manus tu na (Cakama).
verses.hindi: वाणी है। तब कंसने उसे मारना आरम्भ किया । किंतु उसके हाथसे छूटकर आकाशमें जाकर उस अष्टभुजा देवीने मेघके समान गम्भीर वाणीमें कहा--' है कंस! अब तुम अपने देहकी रक्षा करो। मायावी कंसके स्वरूपमें रहनेवाले इस देहकी रक्षा करते हुए तुम्हारी आ गयी है; अरे, मूर्ख! तुमने कैसा अपराध कर डाला, तुम्हारा अन्त करनेवाला तो उत्पन्न हो चुका है'॥ ५६--६० ॥
verses.wordMeaning: Pflrvo Manu: i.c, Vaivasvata. Construe: purvo Manu cak- fama, Manus tu na (Cakama).
verses.commentary: Sense: Pflrvo Manu: i.c, Vaivasvata. Construe: purvo Manu cak- fama, Manus tu na (Cakama).

verses.sanskrit: लब्धवान्देवदेवस्य प्रभावाच्छूलपाणिनः असहन्ती पुरा भानोस् तेजोमयम् अनिन्दिता
verses.transliteration: labdhavāndevadevasya prabhāvācchūlapāṇinaḥ asahantī purā bhānos tejomayam aninditā
verses.translation: For detail about the paring of glory of the sun, see Mdrka, Ch«
verses.hindi: उस कंसने भयसे देवकीके आठवें गर्भको मार डालनेका प्रयत्न किया था; क्योंकि उसने स्मरण कर रखा था कि जिससे उसकी मृत्यु निर्धारित है, वह देवकीका आठवां पुत्र है । है श्रेष्ठ मुनियो ! प्रतीकार करनेमें कंसका
verses.wordMeaning: For detail about the paring of glory of the sun, see Mdrka, Ch«
verses.commentary: Sense: For detail about the paring of glory of the sun, see Mdrka, Ch«

verses.sanskrit: रूपं त्वाष्ट्री स्वदेहात्तु छायाख्यां सा त्वकल्पयत् वडवारूपमास्थाय तपस्तेपे तु सुव्रता
verses.transliteration: rūpaṃ tvāṣṭrī svadehāttu chāyākhyāṃ sā tvakalpayat vaḍavārūpamāsthāya tapastepe tu suvratā
verses.translation: It was at the time of the horse-sacrifice of Ikvaku that Ila became a Kimpurusa. During the state of Kimpurusa, also Ila is called Sudyumna.
verses.hindi: जो भी प्रयास था, वह व्यर्थ हो गया और  भगवान् श्रीहरिके प्रभावसे उस वाणीके द्वारा वह कंस जड़ कर प्रदत्त्वा तु वसुदेवश्च बुद्धिमान्
verses.wordMeaning: It was at the time of the horse-sacrifice of Ikvaku that Ila became a Kimpurusa. During the state of Kimpurusa, also Ila is called Sudyumna.
verses.commentary: Sense: It was at the time of the horse-sacrifice of Ikvaku that Ila became a Kimpurusa. During the state of Kimpurusa, also Ila is called Sudyumna.

verses.sanskrit: कालात्प्रयत्नतो ज्ञात्वा छायां छायापतिः प्रभुः वडवामगमत्संज्ञाम् अश्वरूपेण भास्करः
verses.transliteration: kālātprayatnato jñātvā chāyāṃ chāyāpatiḥ prabhuḥ vaḍavāmagamatsaṃjñām aśvarūpeṇa bhāskaraḥ
verses.translation: Then it chanced she was a woman for one month and a man for another. Ila resorted to the house of Budha, the son of Soma. Finding an opportunity she was made to indulge in sexual intercourse by Budha. Pururavas was born as the son of Ila and Budha.
verses.hindi: रक्षकं जगतां विष्णुं स्वेच्छया धृतविग्रहम्
verses.wordMeaning: Then it chanced she was a woman for one month and a man for another. Ila resorted to the house of Budha, the son of Soma. Finding an opportunity she was made to indulge in sexual intercourse by Budha. Pururavas was born as the son of Ila and Budha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then it chanced she was a woman for one month and a man for another. Ila resorted to the house of Budha, the son of Soma. Finding an opportunity she was made to indulge in sexual intercourse by Budha. Pururavas was born as the son of Ila and Budha.

verses.sanskrit: वडवा च तदा त्वाष्ट्री संज्ञा तस्माद्दिवाकरात् सुषुवे चाश्विनौ देवौ देवानां तु भिषग्वरौ
verses.transliteration: vaḍavā ca tadā tvāṣṭrī saṃjñā tasmāddivākarāt suṣuve cāśvinau devau devānāṃ tu bhiṣagvarau
verses.translation: He was intelligent and the first-born in the line of Soma. He was a devotee of Siva and very valorous. O ascetics, I shall dilate later on the extent of expansion of Iksvaku race.
verses.hindi: प्रसादाच्चैव देवस्य शिवस्यामिततेजसः। रामेण सार्ध तं दत्त्वा वरदं परमेश्वरम् अयं स गर्भो देवक्या यो नः क्लेश्यान् हरिष्यति। उग्रसेनात्मजायाथ कंसायानकदुन्दुभिः
verses.wordMeaning: He was intelligent and the first-born in the line of Soma. He was a devotee of Siva and very valorous. O ascetics, I shall dilate later on the extent of expansion of Iksvaku race.
verses.commentary: Sense: He was intelligent and the first-born in the line of Soma. He was a devotee of Siva and very valorous. O ascetics, I shall dilate later on the extent of expansion of Iksvaku race.

verses.sanskrit: लिखितो भास्करः पश्चात् संज्ञापित्रा महात्मना विष्णोश्चक्रं तु यद्घोरं मण्डलाद्भास्करस्य तु
verses.transliteration: likhito bhāskaraḥ paścāt saṃjñāpitrā mahātmanā viṣṇoścakraṃ tu yadghoraṃ maṇḍalādbhāskarasya tu
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, Sudyumna had three sons viz.: — Utkala, Gaya and VinataSva.
verses.hindi: निवेदयामास तदा जातां कन्यां सुलक्षणाम्। अस्यास्तवाष्टमो गर्भो देवक्याः कंस सुव्रत
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent brahmins, Sudyumna had three sons viz.: — Utkala, Gaya and VinataSva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent brahmins, Sudyumna had three sons viz.: — Utkala, Gaya and VinataSva.

verses.sanskrit: निर्ममे भगवांस्त्वष्टा प्रधानं दिव्यमायुधम् रुद्रप्रसादाच्च शुभं सुदर्शनमिति स्मृतम्
verses.transliteration: nirmame bhagavāṃstvaṣṭā pradhānaṃ divyamāyudham rudraprasādācca śubhaṃ sudarśanamiti smṛtam
verses.translation: The land of Utkala was assigned to Utkala, the western land was given to Vinataiva. Gaya is said to be the excellent city of Gaya.
verses.hindi: उवाचाष्टभुजा देवी मेघगम्भीरया गिरा। रक्षस्व तत्स्वकं देहमायातो मृत्युरेव ते देवक्याः स भयात्कंसो जघानैवाष्टमं त्विति। स्मरन्ति विहितो मृत्युदेवक्यास्तनयोऽष्टमः
verses.wordMeaning: The land of Utkala was assigned to Utkala, the western land was given to Vinataiva. Gaya is said to be the excellent city of Gaya.
verses.commentary: Sense: The land of Utkala was assigned to Utkala, the western land was given to Vinataiva. Gaya is said to be the excellent city of Gaya.

verses.sanskrit: लब्धवान् भगवांश्चक्रं कृष्णः कालाग्निसन्निभम् मनोस्तु प्रथमस्यासन् नव पुत्रास्तु तत्समाः
verses.transliteration: labdhavān bhagavāṃścakraṃ kṛṣṇaḥ kālāgnisannibham manostu prathamasyāsan nava putrāstu tatsamāḥ
verses.translation: In Gaya Devas and the Pitrs are stationed always.
verses.hindi: यस्तत्प्रतिकृतौ यत्नो भोजस्यासीद् वृथा हरेः। दिया गया था। अन्तमें अक्लिष्ट कर्म करनेवाले उन कंसो चैव जडीकृतः ॥ ६२ श्रीकृष्णने कंसको भी मार डाला और देवताओं तथा ऽपि निहतस्तेन ब्राह्मणोंका वध करनेवाले अन्य बहुत-से दुष्टोंको भी मार
verses.wordMeaning: In Gaya Devas and the Pitrs are stationed always.
verses.commentary: Sense: In Gaya Devas and the Pitrs are stationed always.

verses.sanskrit: इक्ष्वाकुर् नभगश् चैव धृष्णुः शर्यातिरेव च नरिष्यन्तश् च वै धीमान् नाभागो ऽरिष्ट एव च
verses.transliteration: ikṣvākur nabhagaś caiva dhṛṣṇuḥ śaryātireva ca nariṣyantaś ca vai dhīmān nābhāgo 'riṣṭa eva ca
verses.translation: In view of his feminine nature Sudyumna did not get his share but at the instance of Vasitha, Sudyumna was installed in Pratisthana, as its glorious and righteous king. After attaining kingdom, the highly blessed son of Manu equipped with the characteristics of both man and woman, the king of great renown gave that kingdom to Pururavas.
verses.hindi: निहता बहवश्चान्ये देवब्राह्मणघातिनः ॥ ६३  डाला अध्याय ६९ चन्द्रवंश-वर्णनमें भगवान् श्रीकृष्णके अवतारकी कथा”“कृष्णचरितका वर्णन ३०३
verses.wordMeaning: In view of his feminine nature Sudyumna did not get his share but at the instance of Vasitha, Sudyumna was installed in Pratisthana, as its glorious and righteous king. After attaining kingdom,…
verses.commentary: Sense: In view of his feminine nature Sudyumna did not get his share but at the instance of Vasitha, Sudyumna was installed in Pratisthana, as its glorious and righteous king. After attaining kingdom,…

verses.sanskrit: करूषश् च पृषध्रश् च नवैते मानवाः स्मृताः इला ज्येष्ठा वरिष्ठा च पुंस्त्वं प्राप च या पुरा
verses.transliteration: karūṣaś ca pṛṣadhraś ca navaite mānavāḥ smṛtāḥ ilā jyeṣṭhā variṣṭhā ca puṃstvaṃ prāpa ca yā purā
verses.translation: Saravaa: a Hizn&layan forest where Kttikeya, the ddest ton of &va, was bom. Lord Siva bad pronounced a curse that a man entering this forest would turn into a woman.
verses.hindi: की भी सन पर्स जज रप्र फा फ फा फा फ फा फ फ फ फ फा फ क फ फ फ़ फ फ फ़ फ फ़ क फ़ फ फ फ फ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ फ़ फ फ फ़ फ़ फा फ फा फ़ फ फ फा फ फ फ़ फ फा मा फी की मी
verses.wordMeaning: Saravaa: a Hizn&layan forest where Kttikeya, the ddest ton of &va, was bom. Lord Siva bad pronounced a curse that a man entering this forest would turn into a woman.
verses.commentary: Sense: Saravaa: a Hizn&layan forest where Kttikeya, the ddest ton of &va, was bom. Lord Siva bad pronounced a curse that a man entering this forest would turn into a woman.

verses.sanskrit: सुद्युम्न इति विख्याता पुंस्त्वं प्राप्ता त्विला पुरा मित्रावरुणयोस्त्वत्र प्रसादान्मुनिपुङ्गवाः
verses.transliteration: sudyumna iti vikhyātā puṃstvaṃ prāptā tvilā purā mitrāvaruṇayostvatra prasādānmunipuṅgavāḥ
verses.translation: O excellent sages, thereafter were born Prthu, Visvaka and Parthiva. ViSvaka's son was Ardraka; YuvanStva was his son.
verses.hindi: तया द्वादशवर्षाणि कृष्णेनाक्लिष्टकर्मणा उन श्रीकृष्णके प्रद्युम्न आदि बहुत-से पुत्र बताये गये ; वे सब युद्धमें प्रवीण थे । कृष्णके पुत्र कृष्णके ही समान थे। श्रीकृष्णके इन सभी पुत्रोमें चारुदेष्ण आदि पुत्र विशिष्ट तथा बलवान् थे; वे रुक्मिणीके पुत्र शत्रुओंका विनाश करनेवाले
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent sages, thereafter were born Prthu, Visvaka and Parthiva. ViSvaka's son was Ardraka; YuvanStva was his son.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent sages, thereafter were born Prthu, Visvaka and Parthiva. ViSvaka's son was Ardraka; YuvanStva was his son.

verses.sanskrit: पुनः शरवणं प्राप्य स्त्रीत्वं प्राप्तो भवाज्ञया सुद्युम्नो मानवः श्रीमान् सोमवंशप्रवृद्धये
verses.transliteration: punaḥ śaravaṇaṃ prāpya strītvaṃ prāpto bhavājñayā sudyumno mānavaḥ śrīmān somavaṃśapravṛddhaye
verses.translation: Vaihsa's son was Brhadasva. Kuvalahva was his son. By killing Dhundhu of great strength he acquired the name of Dhundhumara.
verses.hindi: थे। कृष्णकी सोलह हजार एक सौ भार्याएँ थीं; उन सबमें रुक्मिणी उनकी ज्येष्ठ पत्नी थी । अक्लिष्ट कर्म करनेवाले श्रीकृष्णने उस रुक्मिणी -के साथ बारह वर्षोतक उपवास करते हुए केवल वायुभक्षणसे पुत्रहेतु  भगवान्
verses.wordMeaning: Vaihsa's son was Brhadasva. Kuvalahva was his son. By killing Dhundhu of great strength he acquired the name of Dhundhumara.
verses.commentary: Sense: Vaihsa's son was Brhadasva. Kuvalahva was his son. By killing Dhundhu of great strength he acquired the name of Dhundhumara.

verses.sanskrit: इक्ष्वाकोरश्वमेधेन इला किंपुरुषो ऽभवत् इला किंपुरुषत्वे च सुद्युम्न इति चोच्यते
verses.transliteration: ikṣvākoraśvamedhena ilā kiṃpuruṣo 'bhavat ilā kiṃpuruṣatve ca sudyumna iti cocyate
verses.translation: Dhundhumara had three sons well known in the three worlds. They were Drdhasva, Candava and Kapilava.
verses.hindi: शिवका पूजन किया था। परिणामस्वरूप श्रीकृष्णने शूलपाणि (शिव) -की कृपासे चारुदेष्ण, सुचारु, चारुवेष, यशोधर, चारुश्रवा, चारुयश, प्रद्युम्न तथा साम्ब--इन पुत्रोंको प्राप्त किया था रुक्मिणीके उन वीर पुत्रोंको तथा रुक्मिणीको देखकर बुद्धिमान् कृष्णकी पत्नी जाम्बवतीने कृष्णसे कहा--'हे कमलनयन! आप प्रसन्न होकर मुझे विशिष्ट, महान् गुणी तथा शिवजीको प्रिय पुत्र प्रदान कीजिये।
verses.wordMeaning: Dhundhumara had three sons well known in the three worlds. They were Drdhasva, Candava and Kapilava.
verses.commentary: Sense: Dhundhumara had three sons well known in the three worlds. They were Drdhasva, Candava and Kapilava.

verses.sanskrit: मासमेकं पुमान्वीरः स्त्रीत्वं मासमभूत्पुनः इला बुधस्य भवनं सोमपुत्रस्य चाश्रिता
verses.transliteration: māsamekaṃ pumānvīraḥ strītvaṃ māsamabhūtpunaḥ ilā budhasya bhavanaṃ somaputrasya cāśritā
verses.translation: Pramoda was the son of Drdhasva. Haryasva was his son. Nikumbha was the son of Haryaiva. Samhatasva
verses.hindi: तदनन्तर जाम्बबतीका वचन सुनकर अनिन्द्य एवं तपोनिधि जगन्नाथ श्रीहरिने तप करना प्रारम्भ
verses.wordMeaning: Pramoda was the son of Drdhasva. Haryasva was his son. Nikumbha was the son of Haryaiva. Samhatasva
verses.commentary: Sense: Pramoda was the son of Drdhasva. Haryasva was his son. Nikumbha was the son of Haryaiva. Samhatasva

verses.sanskrit: बुधेनान्तरमासाद्य मैथुनाय प्रवर्तिता सोमपुत्राद्बुधाच्चापि ऐलो जज्ञे पुरूरवाः
verses.transliteration: budhenāntaramāsādya maithunāya pravartitā somaputrādbudhāccāpi ailo jajñe purūravāḥ
verses.translation: Mandhata had three sons well known in the three worlds. They were Purukutsa, Anibarisa and Mucukunda.
verses.hindi: शंख, चक्र तथा गदा धारण करनेवाले उन जनार्दन नारायण श्रीकृष्णने मुनि व्याप्रपादके श्रेष्ठ आश्रममें जाकर उन अंगिरागोत्रिय ऋषिको देखकर उन्हें प्रणाम करके उनकी आज्ञासे दिव्य पाशुपतयोग प्राप्त दाढ़ी तथा सिरको मुण्डित कराकर, शरीरको घृतसे अनुलिप्तकर तथा मूँजकी मेखला धारण करके ब्रतमें दीक्षित होकर परंतप भगवान् श्रीकृष्ण तपस्या करने लगे। उन श्रीकृष्णने हाथोंको ऊपर उठाकर,
verses.wordMeaning: Mandhata had three sons well known in the three worlds. They were Purukutsa, Anibarisa and Mucukunda.
verses.commentary: Sense: Mandhata had three sons well known in the three worlds. They were Purukutsa, Anibarisa and Mucukunda.

verses.sanskrit: सोमवंशाग्रजो धीमान् भवभक्तः प्रतापवान् इक्ष्वाकोर्वंशविस्तारं पश्चाद्वक्ष्ये तपोधनाः
verses.transliteration: somavaṃśāgrajo dhīmān bhavabhaktaḥ pratāpavān ikṣvākorvaṃśavistāraṃ paścādvakṣye tapodhanāḥ
verses.translation: Yuvana,<va the second is said to be the heir to Ambarisa. Harita was the son of Yuvana;§va and from him began the line of Haritas. These were brahmins in the line of Afigiras, but Ksatriyas in temperament.
verses.hindi: आश्रयरहित होकर तथा पैरके अँगूठेके अग्रभागपर स्थित होकर क्रमशः फल, जल एबं वायुका आहार ग्रहण करते हुए तीन ऋतुओंतक तपस्या को
verses.wordMeaning: Yuvana,<va the second is said to be the heir to Ambarisa. Harita was the son of Yuvana;§va and from him began the line of Haritas. These were brahmins in the line of Afigiras, but Ksatriyas in temperament.
verses.commentary: Sense: Yuvana,<va the second is said to be the heir to Ambarisa. Harita was the son of Yuvana;§va and from him began the line of Haritas. These were brahmins in the line of Afigiras, but Ksatriyas in temperament.

verses.sanskrit: पुत्रत्रयमभूत्तस्य सुद्युम्नस्य द्विजोत्तमाः उत्कलश् च गयश्चैव विनताश्वस्तथैव च
verses.transliteration: putratrayamabhūttasya sudyumnasya dvijottamāḥ utkalaś ca gayaścaiva vinatāśvastathaiva ca
verses.translation: These also resorted to the line of Ahgiras and were equipped with the characteristics of Ksatriyas. Sambhuti procreated another son named Anaranya.
verses.hindi: उनकी तपस्यासे सन्तुष्ट होकर भगवान् रुद्रने महात्मा कृष्णको अनेक वर प्रदान किया तथा जाम्बवतीसे साम्ब नामक पुत्र प्राप्त होनेका वर प्रदान किया। तब श्रीकृष्णकी भार्या जाम्बवती पुत्र साम्बको प्राप्त करके मम त्वं पुण्डरीकाक्ष विशिष्टं गुणवत्तरम्। सुरेशसम्मितं पुत्रं प्रसन्नो दातुमहसि
verses.wordMeaning: These also resorted to the line of Ahgiras and were equipped with the characteristics of Ksatriyas. Sambhuti procreated another son named Anaranya.
verses.commentary: Sense: These also resorted to the line of Ahgiras and were equipped with the characteristics of Ksatriyas. Sambhuti procreated another son named Anaranya.

verses.sanskrit: उत्कलस्योत्कलं राष्ट्रं विनताश्वस्य पश्चिमम् गया गयस्य चाख्याता पुरी परमशोभना
verses.transliteration: utkalasyotkalaṃ rāṣṭraṃ vinatāśvasya paścimam gayā gayasya cākhyātā purī paramaśobhanā
verses.translation: O brahmins, in the course of his conquest of the three worlds, Anaranya was killed by Ravana. Brhadasva was the son of Anaranya and Haryasva was his son.
verses.hindi: ऋषिं दृष्ट्वा त्वङ्गिरसं प्रणिपत्य जनार्दनः। दिव्यं पाशुपतं योगं लब्धवांस्तस्य चाज्ञया
verses.wordMeaning: O brahmins, in the course of his conquest of the three worlds, Anaranya was killed by Ravana. Brhadasva was the son of Anaranya and Haryasva was his son.
verses.commentary: Sense: O brahmins, in the course of his conquest of the three worlds, Anaranya was killed by Ravana. Brhadasva was the son of Anaranya and Haryasva was his son.

verses.sanskrit: सुराणां संस्थितिर्यस्यां पितॄणां च सदा स्थितिः इक्ष्वाकुज्येष्ठदायादो मध्यदेशम् अवाप्तवान्
verses.transliteration: surāṇāṃ saṃsthitiryasyāṃ pitṝṇāṃ ca sadā sthitiḥ ikṣvākujyeṣṭhadāyādo madhyadeśam avāptavān
verses.translation: King Vasumanas was born of Drsadvati and Haryasva. His son was the king Tridhanvan a great devotee of Siva.
verses.hindi: प्रलुप्तश्मश्रुकेशश्च घृताक्तो मुञ्जमेखली । दीक्षितो भगवान् कृष्णस्तताप च परंतपः तपसा तस्य सन्तुष्टो ददौ रुद्रौ बहून् वरान्। साम्बं जाम्बवतीपुत्रं कृष्णाय च महात्मने
verses.wordMeaning: King Vasumanas was born of Drsadvati and Haryasva. His son was the king Tridhanvan a great devotee of Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: King Vasumanas was born of Drsadvati and Haryasva. His son was the king Tridhanvan a great devotee of Siva.

verses.sanskrit: कन्याभावाच्च सुद्युम्नो नैव भागमवाप्तवान् वसिष्ठवचनात् त्वासीत् प्रतिष्ठाने महाद्युतिः
verses.transliteration: kanyābhāvācca sudyumno naiva bhāgamavāptavān vasiṣṭhavacanāt tvāsīt pratiṣṭhāne mahādyutiḥ
verses.translation: In fact, the text records less than one thousand names, unless we include *matah* (repeated thrice, cf, verses 61, 75, 87) etc. as proper names. It may also be observed that some names are identical in form: Nilab (105, 116), Aninditab (laz, 124), GuhSvfisi (131, 138}, Vifnu (126, 162), Jafi (55> Bx), Dhtft (126, 141}, Balab (99, 122), Mumb (9l 90> Lambitofthab (109, 123;, MahAkatbab (108, 147}, Vrkfab (85, 132); others are rq>eti- tive in sense: SmaiAnavAsI (57), iSmaiAnavAn (108}; Narab (59) Kara, Vigrahab (105); MahArdmA (no), MahAkeiab (no); Candrab (6x) Indub (150); Others are the names of gods and sages: VAsudevab (92), Adhokiyab (loi), Vi99U (126, 162) (ofYu); DhAtA (126) (of BrahmA); Devendra (155), &xkra (126), Amareia (122), Vajri (154) (of Indra); VAmadeva (92), Kapila (1x9) (of sagea)*
verses.hindi: फ फ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ फ फ़ क फ़ फ़ फ़ फ़ फक फ़ फ़ फ क फा फा फक कमा फी मी फी मी ममी फफफ फा फण कक कीफ जी कफीफाफाफाफफाफफफफ कक
verses.wordMeaning: In fact, the text records less than one thousand names, unless we include *matah* (repeated thrice, cf, verses 61, 75, 87) etc. as proper names. It may also be observed that some names are identical in form: Nilab (105, 116), Aninditab (laz, 124), GuhSvfisi (131, 138},…
verses.commentary: Sense: In fact, the text records less than one thousand names, unless we include *matah* (repeated thrice, cf, verses 61, 75, 87) etc. as proper names. It may also be observed that some names are identical in form: Nilab (105, 116), Aninditab (laz, 124), GuhSvfisi (131, 138},…

verses.sanskrit: प्रतिष्ठा धर्मराजस्य सुद्युम्नस्य महात्मनः तत्पुरूरवसे प्रादाद् राज्यं प्राप्य महायशाः
verses.transliteration: pratiṣṭhā dharmarājasya sudyumnasya mahātmanaḥ tatpurūravase prādād rājyaṃ prāpya mahāyaśāḥ
verses.translation: Grahapati(i— lord of planets (grahas), i.e. Jupiter (Bfhaspati).
verses.hindi: बाणस्य च्छेदितं मुनिपुङ्गवाः । भुजानां चैव साहस्त्रं शापाद्रुद्रस्य धीमतः अथ हैत्यवधं चक्रे हलायुधसहायवान्। तथा दुष्टक्षितीशानां लीलयैव रणाजिरे
verses.wordMeaning: Grahapati(i— lord of planets (grahas), i.e. Jupiter (Bfhaspati).
verses.commentary: Sense: Grahapati(i— lord of planets (grahas), i.e. Jupiter (Bfhaspati).

verses.sanskrit: मानवेयो महाभागः स्त्रीपुंसोर्लक्षणान्वितः इक्ष्वाकोरभवद्वीरो विकुक्षिर्धर्मवित्तमः
verses.transliteration: mānaveyo mahābhāgaḥ strīpuṃsorlakṣaṇānvitaḥ ikṣvākorabhavadvīro vikukṣirdharmavittamaḥ
verses.translation: Matal)i — the planet mercury (budha).
verses.hindi: स हत्वा देवसम्भूतं नरकं हैत्यपुङ्गवम्। ब्राह्मणस्योर्ध्वचक्रस्य वरदानान्महात्मनः
verses.wordMeaning: Matal)i — the planet mercury (budha).
verses.commentary: Sense: Matal)i — the planet mercury (budha).

verses.sanskrit: ज्येष्ठः पुत्रशतस्यासीद् दश पञ्च च तत्सुताः अभूज्ज्येष्ठः ककुत्स्थश् च ककुत्स्थात्तु सुयोधनः
verses.transliteration: jyeṣṭhaḥ putraśatasyāsīd daśa pañca ca tatsutāḥ abhūjjyeṣṭhaḥ kakutsthaś ca kakutsthāttu suyodhanaḥ
verses.translation: KrtI=N.S. text reads krtabkrta-yugarupab ST.
verses.hindi: शताधिकानि जग्राह सहस्त्राणि महाबलः संहृत्य तत्कुलं चैव प्रभासेऽतिष्ठदच्युतः
verses.wordMeaning: KrtI=N.S. text reads krtabkrta-yugarupab ST.
verses.commentary: Sense: KrtI=N.S. text reads krtabkrta-yugarupab ST.

verses.sanskrit: ततः पृथुर्मुनिश्रेष्ठा विश्वकः पार्थिवस् तथा विश्वकस्यार्द्रको धीमान् युवनाश्वस्तु तत्सुतः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ pṛthurmuniśreṣṭhā viśvakaḥ pārthivas tathā viśvakasyārdrako dhīmān yuvanāśvastu tatsutaḥ
verses.translation: (155) Ahoratram (of the forrr of day and night)
verses.hindi: कृष्णस्य द्वारकायां वै जराक्लेशापहारिणः
verses.wordMeaning: (155) Ahoratram (of the forrr of day and night)
verses.commentary: Sense: (155) Ahoratram (of the forrr of day and night)

verses.sanskrit: शाबस्तिश् च महातेजा वंशकस्तु ततो ऽभवत् निर्मिता येन शाबस्ती गौडदेशे द्विजोत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: śābastiś ca mahātejā vaṃśakastu tato 'bhavat nirmitā yena śābastī gauḍadeśe dvijottamāḥ
verses.translation: — in ♦he form of Aghora.
verses.hindi: शापं पिण्डारकेऽरक्षद्चो दुर्वाससस्तदा त्यक्त्वा च मानुषं रूपं जरकास्त्रच्छलेन तु। अनुगृह्य च कृष्णोऽपि लुब्धकं प्रययौ दिवम्
verses.wordMeaning: — in ♦he form of Aghora.
verses.commentary: Sense: — in ♦he form of Aghora.

verses.sanskrit: वंशाच्च बृहदश्वो ऽभूत् कुवलाश्वस्तु तत्सुतः धुन्धुमारत्वमापन्नो धुन्धुं हत्वा महाबलम्
verses.transliteration: vaṃśācca bṛhadaśvo 'bhūt kuvalāśvastu tatsutaḥ dhundhumāratvamāpanno dhundhuṃ hatvā mahābalam
verses.translation: Urdhvai&yl— one who sleeps in the firmament ST.
verses.hindi: सहाग्निं विविशुः सर्वाः कृष्णेनाक्लिष्टकर्मणा। रेवती च तथा देवी बलभद्रेण धीमता
verses.wordMeaning: Urdhvai&yl— one who sleeps in the firmament ST.
verses.commentary: Sense: Urdhvai&yl— one who sleeps in the firmament ST.

verses.sanskrit: धुन्धुमारस्य तनयास् त्रयस्त्रैलोक्यविश्रुताः दृढाश्वश्चैव चण्डाश्वः कपिलाश्वश् च ते स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: dhundhumārasya tanayās trayastrailokyaviśrutāḥ dṛḍhāśvaścaiva caṇḍāśvaḥ kapilāśvaś ca te smṛtāḥ
verses.translation: Loka*dh&t& — support of the fourteen worlds.
verses.hindi: उसी प्रकार परम हर्षित हुई, जैसे अदिति आदित्यके प्राप्त करके हर्षित हुई थीं हे मुनिश्रेष्ठो! उन श्रीकृष्णने बुद्धिमान् रके  शापके कारण बाणासुरको हजार भुजाओंको कार डाला था। इसके बाद बलरामको सहायक बनाकर उन्होंने युद्धक्षेत्रमें लीलापूर्वक अनेक हैत्योंका तथा दुष्ट
verses.wordMeaning: Loka*dh&t& — support of the fourteen worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: Loka*dh&t& — support of the fourteen worlds.

verses.sanskrit: दृढाश्वस्य प्रमोदस्तु हर्यश्वस्तस्य वै सुतः हर्यश्वस्य निकुम्भस्तु संहताश्वस्तु तत्सुतः
verses.transliteration: dṛḍhāśvasya pramodastu haryaśvastasya vai sutaḥ haryaśvasya nikumbhastu saṃhatāśvastu tatsutaḥ
verses.translation: Ott&karah — mine or the recq>tacle of yogic gunas (ch.i6} or of the 24 gut>as admitted by the Nyiya philosophy.
verses.hindi: राजाओंका वध किया
verses.wordMeaning: Ott&karah — mine or the recq>tacle of yogic gunas (ch.i6} or of the 24 gut>as admitted by the Nyiya philosophy.
verses.commentary: Sense: Ott&karah — mine or the recq>tacle of yogic gunas (ch.i6} or of the 24 gut>as admitted by the Nyiya philosophy.

verses.sanskrit: कृशाश्वो ऽथ रणाश्वश् च संहताश्वात्मजावुभौ युवनाश्वो रणाश्वस्य मान्धाता तस्य वै सुतः
verses.transliteration: kṛśāśvo 'tha raṇāśvaś ca saṃhatāśvātmajāvubhau yuvanāśvo raṇāśvasya māndhātā tasya vai sutaḥ
verses.translation: Mah&iarab— one who has a powerful missile. ST. refers to Siva's destruction of Tripuri.
verses.hindi: यज्ञवराहसे उत्पन्न हैत्यश्रेष्ठ नरकासुरका वध करके अतुलनीय पराक्रमवाले तथा महाबली उन श्रीकृष्णने ऊर्ध्वचक्रवाले वायुदेव तथा ब्रह्यापुत्र महात्मा नारदके वरदानसे अपने उपभोगके योग्य सोलह हजार एक सौ कन्याओंको ग्रहण किया था
verses.wordMeaning: Mah&iarab— one who has a powerful missile. ST. refers to Siva's destruction of Tripuri.
verses.commentary: Sense: Mah&iarab— one who has a powerful missile. ST. refers to Siva's destruction of Tripuri.

verses.sanskrit: मान्धातुः पुरुकुत्सो ऽभूद् अम्बरीषश् च वीर्यवान् मुचुकुन्दश् च पुण्यात्मा त्रयस्त्रैलोक्यविश्रुताः
verses.transliteration: māndhātuḥ purukutso 'bhūd ambarīṣaś ca vīryavān mucukundaś ca puṇyātmā trayastrailokyaviśrutāḥ
verses.translation: ST. dissolves *giricaro matab' as 'giricarab amatah*; amatab — unknown or unrecognized. ST refers to the event of Daru forest when the sages could not recognize him dressed in strange guise.
verses.hindi: उन्होंने विप्रोके शापके बहाने अपने कुलका संहार कर डाला और उस कुलका संहरण करके वे अच्युत (श्रीकृष्ण) प्रभासक्षेत्रमें रहने लगे । तदनन्तर वृद्धावस्थाके कष्टका हरण करनेवाले उन श्रीकृष्णका द्वारकामें रहते
verses.wordMeaning: ST. dissolves *giricaro matab' as 'giricarab amatah*; amatab — unknown or unrecognized. ST refers to the event of Daru forest when the sages could not recognize him dressed in strange guise.
verses.commentary: Sense: ST. dissolves *giricaro matab' as 'giricarab amatah*; amatab — unknown or unrecognized. ST refers to the event of Daru forest when the sages could not recognize him dressed in strange guise.

verses.sanskrit: अंबरीषस्य दायादो युवनाश्वो ऽपरः स्मृतः हरितो युवनाश्वस्य हरितास्तु यतः स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: aṃbarīṣasya dāyādo yuvanāśvo 'paraḥ smṛtaḥ harito yuvanāśvasya haritāstu yataḥ smṛtāḥ
verses.translation: Madhyamah the middling. It refers to the Rudra form of iSiva. Cf. ''madhyato Rudram H&nam" — cited in ST.
verses.hindi: हुए सौ वर्षसे अधिक समय व्यतीत हुआ उन्होंने द्वारकाके समीपवर्ती पिण्डारकक्षेत्रमें निवास करनेवाले विश्वामित्र, कण्व, बुद्धिमान् नारद तथा दुर्वासाके शाप तथा वचनकी रक्षा की। व्याधके द्वारा बनाये गये जरकास्त्रके बहाने अपने मानवशरीरका
verses.wordMeaning: Madhyamah the middling. It refers to the Rudra form of iSiva. Cf. ''madhyato Rudram H&nam" — cited in ST.
verses.commentary: Sense: Madhyamah the middling. It refers to the Rudra form of iSiva. Cf. ''madhyato Rudram H&nam" — cited in ST.

verses.sanskrit: एते ह्यङ्गिरसः पक्षे क्षत्रोपेता द्विजातयः पुरुकुत्सस्य दायादस् त्रसद्दस्युर् महायशाः
verses.transliteration: ete hyaṅgirasaḥ pakṣe kṣatropetā dvijātayaḥ purukutsasya dāyādas trasaddasyur mahāyaśāḥ
verses.translation: K&lavid-H>ne who knows auspicious or inauspicious times ST,
verses.hindi: परित्याग करके उस व्याधपर कृपा करके वे श्रीकृष्ण द्युलोक अपने धाम-को चले गये
verses.wordMeaning: K&lavid-H>ne who knows auspicious or inauspicious times ST,
verses.commentary: Sense: K&lavid-H>ne who knows auspicious or inauspicious times ST,

verses.sanskrit: नर्मदायां समुत्पन्नः सम्भूतिस्तस्य चात्मजः विष्णुवृद्धः सुतस्तस्य विष्णुवृद्धा यतः स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: narmadāyāṃ samutpannaḥ sambhūtistasya cātmajaḥ viṣṇuvṛddhaḥ sutastasya viṣṇuvṛddhā yataḥ smṛtāḥ
verses.translation: (239) Jyotisamayanam (the cause of the transit

verses.wordMeaning: (239) Jyotisamayanam (the cause of the transit
verses.commentary: Sense: (239) Jyotisamayanam (the cause of the transit

verses.sanskrit: एते ह्यङ्गिरसः पक्षे क्षत्रोपेताः समाश्रिताः सम्भूतिरपरं पुत्रम् अनरण्यमजीजनत्
verses.transliteration: ete hyaṅgirasaḥ pakṣe kṣatropetāḥ samāśritāḥ sambhūtiraparaṃ putram anaraṇyamajījanat
verses.translation: Jalkcfirab or Jalkdhftrab~ne who is the support or the cause of movement for watery reservoirs, rivers, streams and oceans.
verses.hindi: प्रेतकार्यं हरेः कृत्वा पार्थः परमवीर्यवान्॥ ९०  मार्गका अनुगमन किया॥ न 0 रा पाः पमवीर्थवान्॥९० मार्गका अगा किया
verses.wordMeaning: Jalkcfirab or Jalkdhftrab~ne who is the support or the cause of movement for watery reservoirs, rivers, streams and oceans.
verses.commentary: Sense: Jalkcfirab or Jalkdhftrab~ne who is the support or the cause of movement for watery reservoirs, rivers, streams and oceans.

verses.sanskrit: रावणेन हतो यो ऽसौ त्रैलोक्यविजये द्विजाः बृहदश्वो ऽनरण्यस्य हर्यश्वस्तस्य चात्मजः
verses.transliteration: rāvaṇena hato yo 'sau trailokyavijaye dvijāḥ bṛhadaśvo 'naraṇyasya haryaśvastasya cātmajaḥ
verses.translation: Sarvavy&pl — one who has an sAl-pervadve subtle body.
verses.hindi: मा भैजरै त्वमुत्तिष्ठ काम एष कृतो हि मे। याहि त्वं मदनुज्ातः स्वर्ग सुकृतिनां पदम्॥ ( श्रीमद्भा० ११।३०।३९) वमे  भगवान् श्रीकृष्णने कहा- है जरे! तू डर मत, उठ-उठ  यह तो तूने मेरे मनका काम किया है। जा, मेरी आज्ञासे तू उस i निवास कर, जिसकी प्राप्ति बड़े-बड़े पुण्यवानोंको होती है।
verses.wordMeaning: Sarvavy&pl — one who has an sAl-pervadve subtle body.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sarvavy&pl — one who has an sAl-pervadve subtle body.

verses.sanskrit: हर्यश्वात्तु दृषद्वत्यां जज्ञे वसुमना नृपः तस्य पुत्रो ऽभवद्राजा त्रिधन्वा भवभावितः
verses.transliteration: haryaśvāttu dṛṣadvatyāṃ jajñe vasumanā nṛpaḥ tasya putro 'bhavadrājā tridhanvā bhavabhāvitaḥ
verses.translation: Sr hnalakanmin-- one who resorts to the abode of Lak$ml (Srl- ZD&la) for yogic trance.
verses.hindi: अध्याय ७० महेश्वरसे होनेवाली आदिसृष्टिका स्वरूप““सतीकी देहसे अनेक देवियोंका प्रादुर्भाव
verses.wordMeaning: Sr hnalakanmin-- one who resorts to the abode of Lak$ml (Srl- ZD&la) for yogic trance.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sr hnalakanmin-- one who resorts to the abode of Lak$ml (Srl- ZD&la) for yogic trance.

verses.sanskrit: प्रसादाद् ब्रह्मसूनोर् वै तण्डिनः प्राप्य शिष्यताम् अश्वमेधसहस्रस्य फलं प्राप्य तदाज्ञया
verses.transliteration: prasādād brahmasūnor vai taṇḍinaḥ prāpya śiṣyatām aśvamedhasahasrasya phalaṃ prāpya tadājñayā
verses.translation: One who is the friend of Jiva (i.e, the individual soul) "suparnav aitau sadrau sakhfiyau**. -cited in ST,

verses.sanskrit: गणैश्वर्यमनुप्राप्तो भवभक्तः प्रतापवान् कथं चैवाश्वमेधं वै करोमीति विचिन्तयन्
verses.transliteration: gaṇaiśvaryamanuprāpto bhavabhaktaḥ pratāpavān kathaṃ caivāśvamedhaṃ vai karomīti vicintayan
verses.translation: Pravitsah'—ooe who is the eternal abode of all mobile and immo- bile beings.
verses.hindi: एवं सङ्क्षेपतः प्रोक्तः कृष्णस्याक्लिष्टकर्मणः
verses.wordMeaning: Pravitsah'—ooe who is the eternal abode of all mobile and immo- bile beings.
verses.commentary: Sense: Pravitsah'—ooe who is the eternal abode of all mobile and immo- bile beings.

verses.sanskrit: धनहीनश् च धर्मात्मा दृष्टवान् ब्रह्मणः सुतम् तण्डिसंज्ञं द्विजं तस्माल् लब्धवान्द्विजसत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: dhanahīnaś ca dharmātmā dṛṣṭavān brahmaṇaḥ sutam taṇḍisaṃjñaṃ dvijaṃ tasmāl labdhavāndvijasattamāḥ
verses.translation: Ak&iah — one who shines splendidly.
verses.hindi: ऑर्ध्वहैहिक कृत्य करके द्रव्योंके अभावके कारण कन्द- मूल-फलोंके द्वारा बलि-कार्य (पिण्डदानादि श्राद्धकार्य) किया; इसके बाद वे अर्जुन अपने भाइयोंके साथ स्वयं स्वर्गलोक चले गये॥ ९०-९१ /२॥ इस प्रकार मैंने अक्लिष्ट कर्मवाले महात्मा श्रीकृष्णके प्रभाव तथा अपनी इच्छासे उनके तिरोधानका वर्णन संक्षेपमें कर दिया। है द्विजो! जो मनुष्य सोमवंशीय राजाओंके इस चरित्रको पढ़ता है या सुनता है अथवा
verses.wordMeaning: Ak&iah — one who shines splendidly.
verses.commentary: Sense: Ak&iah — one who shines splendidly.

verses.sanskrit: नाम्नां सहस्रं रुद्रस्य ब्रह्मणा कथितं पुरा तेन नाम्नां सहस्रेण स्तुत्वा तण्डिर्महेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: nāmnāṃ sahasraṃ rudrasya brahmaṇā kathitaṃ purā tena nāmnāṃ sahasreṇa stutvā taṇḍirmaheśvaram

verses.hindi: ब्राह्मणोंको सुनाता है, वह विष्णुलोक प्राप्त करता है;
verses.wordMeaning: Surapav&n— of auspicious form: **tasyaite tanuvau ghoraanya 4ivaiflp§**---ciled in ST*
verses.commentary: Sense: Surapav&n— of auspicious form: **tasyaite tanuvau ghoraanya 4ivaiflp§**---ciled in ST*

verses.transliteration: labdhavāngāṇapatyaṃ ca brahmayonirdvijottamaḥ tatastasmānnṛpo labdhvā taṇḍinā kathitaṃ purā
verses.translation: Pak?i~>one who has two wings: Jlk and Saman. '*|tk daksiiiah pakab samottarab pakab**. ST.
verses.hindi: स याति वैष्णवं लोकं नात्र कार्या विचारणा॥ ९४  इसमें सन्देह नहीं करना चाहिए महेशवरसे होनेवाली आदिसृष्टिका स्वरूप, नवविधसर्गवर्णन एवं प्राजापत्यसर्गनिरूपण तथा भगवती सतीकी देहसे अनेक देवियोंका प्रादुर्भाव
verses.wordMeaning: Pak?i~>one who has two wings: Jlk and Saman. '*|tk daksiiiah pakab samottarab pakab**. ST.
verses.commentary: Sense: Pak?i~>one who has two wings: Jlk and Saman. '*|tk daksiiiah pakab samottarab pakab**. ST.

verses.sanskrit: नाम्नां सहस्रं जप्त्वा वै गाणपत्यमवाप्तवान् नाम्नां सहस्रं रुद्रस्य ताण्डिना ब्रह्मयोनिना
verses.transliteration: nāmnāṃ sahasraṃ japtvā vai gāṇapatyamavāptavān nāmnāṃ sahasraṃ rudrasya tāṇḍinā brahmayoninā
verses.translation: Aneka tfk -multi-eyed. Cf. **namo astu nilagrvya saha- sr&kskya midbue**— cited in ST,
verses.hindi: आदिसर्गस्त्वया सूत सूचितो न प्रकाशितः। साम्प्रतं विस्तरेणैव वक्तुमर्हसि सुव्रत
verses.wordMeaning: Aneka tfk -multi-eyed. Cf. **namo astu nilagrvya saha- sr&kskya midbue**— cited in ST,
verses.commentary: Sense: Aneka tfk -multi-eyed. Cf. **namo astu nilagrvya saha- sr&kskya midbue**— cited in ST,

verses.sanskrit: कथितं सर्ववेदार्थसंचयं सूत सुव्रत नाम्नां सहस्रं विप्राणां वक्तुम् अर्हसि शोभनम्
verses.transliteration: kathitaṃ sarvavedārthasaṃcayaṃ sūta suvrata nāmnāṃ sahasraṃ viprāṇāṃ vaktum arhasi śobhanam
verses.translation: (411) Lokakarta (maker of the worlds ) (412)
verses.hindi: महेश्वरो महादेवः प्रकृतेः पुरुषस्य च। परत्वे संस्थितो देवः परमात्मा मुनीश्वराः २ अव्यक्तं चेश्वरात्तस्मादभवत्कारणं परम् प्रधानं प्रकृतिश्चेति यदाहुस्तत्त्वचिन्तकाः जगद्योनिं महाभूतं परं ब्रह्म सनातनम् विग्रहः सर्वभूतानामीश्वराञ्ञाप्रचोदितम्
verses.wordMeaning: (411) Lokakarta (maker of the worlds ) (412)
verses.commentary: Sense: (411) Lokakarta (maker of the worlds ) (412)

verses.sanskrit: सर्वभूतात्मभूतस्य हरस्यामिततेजसः अष्टोत्तरसहस्रं तु नाम्नां शृणुत सुव्रताः
verses.transliteration: sarvabhūtātmabhūtasya harasyāmitatejasaḥ aṣṭottarasahasraṃ tu nāmnāṃ śṛṇuta suvratāḥ
verses.translation: Lingadhyak§a — lord of unmanifest Prakfti (liAga).
verses.hindi: अप्रकाशमविज्ञेयं ब्रह्माग्रे समवर्तत
verses.wordMeaning: Lingadhyak§a — lord of unmanifest Prakfti (liAga).
verses.commentary: Sense: Lingadhyak§a — lord of unmanifest Prakfti (liAga).

verses.sanskrit: यज्जप्त्वा तु मुनिश्रेष्ठा गाणपत्यमवाप्तवान् ॐ स्थिरः स्थाणुः प्रभुर्भानुः प्रवरो वरदो वरः
verses.transliteration: yajjaptvā tu muniśreṣṭhā gāṇapatyamavāptavān oṃ sthiraḥ sthāṇuḥ prabhurbhānuḥ pravaro varado varaḥ
verses.translation: Mah&mcgha-nivasin — one who ha$ Vi?nu (mahamegha) for his abode;
verses.hindi: ऋषिगण बोले-हे सूतजी! है सुव्रत! आपने आदिसृष्टिका परिचयमात्र दिया, उसपर प्रकाश नहीं अब आप इसे विस्तारसे बतानेको कृपा कोजिये सूतजी बोले--हे मुनीश्वरो ! परमात्मा देव महेश्वर महादेव प्रकृति तथा पुरुषसे परे हैं। उन्हीं ईश्वरसे परम कारणस्वरूप अव्यक्त उत्पन्न हुआ, जिसे तत्त्वचिन्तक प्रधान तथा प्रकृति कहते हैं। यह गन्थ-वर्ण-रससे हीन,
verses.wordMeaning: Mah&mcgha-nivasin — one who ha$ Vi?nu (mahamegha) for his abode;
verses.commentary: Sense: Mah&mcgha-nivasin — one who ha$ Vi?nu (mahamegha) for his abode;

verses.sanskrit: सर्वात्मा सर्वविख्यातः सर्वः सर्वकरो भवः जटी दण्डी शिखण्डी च सर्वगः सर्वभावनः
verses.transliteration: sarvātmā sarvavikhyātaḥ sarvaḥ sarvakaro bhavaḥ jaṭī daṇḍī śikhaṇḍī ca sarvagaḥ sarvabhāvanaḥ
verses.translation: Lambito?thah—It refers to Ganesa.
verses.hindi: शब्द-स्पर्शसे रहित, अजर, स्थिर, अविनाशी, शाश्वत, अपनी आत्मामें स्थित, जगतूकी उत्पत्तिका खरोत, महाभूत, सनातन, परब्रह्म, सभी प्राणियोंका विग्रह (शरीर), ईश्वरकी आज्ञासे प्रेरित, आदि-अन्तसे रहित, अजन्मा,
verses.wordMeaning: Lambito?thah—It refers to Ganesa.
verses.commentary: Sense: Lambito?thah—It refers to Ganesa.

verses.sanskrit: हरिश् च हरिणाक्षश् च सर्वभूतहरः स्मृतः प्रवृत्तिश् च निवृत्तिश् च शान्तात्मा शाश्वतो ध्रुवः

verses.translation: O Brahmins, he who reads this or listens to it or narrates this to the Brahmins, attains the merit of a thousand horse-sacrifices. In order to obtain release, the following sinners should repeat for a year these names, during the three Sandhyas (morning, midday and dusk) in the temple of Siva or in the region sacred to Siva and they should also worship the lord. They are: — the slayer of a Brahmin, the wine addict, the thief, the defiler of the preceptor's bed, the murderer of a refugee, and the one who commits breach of faith with his friends. So also the slayer of mother, father, warrior and the child in the womb.

verses.hindi: वे विशेष (शब्द आदि) नियतत्वके कारण इन्द्रिय-ग्राह्म कहे गये हैं। पूर्व सर्ग (आकाश आदि)- के गुणको उत्तरोत्तर वायु आदि प्राप्त करते हैं। उन शब्द आदिमें जितनी मात्रामें जो गुण होता है, उतनी ही मात्रामें उसे कहा गया है। जलमें गन्धका अनुभव होनेपर कुछ लोग कहते हैं कि यह जलका गुण है। पृथ्वीमें उस गन्धको जल तथा वायुके संयोगसे जानना चाहिए। महान् आत्मावाले ये सातौं महत्तत्त्व अहंकार, शब्द

verses.sanskrit: अग्निज्वालो महाज्वालः परिधूम्रावृतो रविः धिषणः शङ्करो नित्यो वर्चस्वी धूम्रलोचनः

verses.hindi: जलमें बुलबुलेकी भाँति एक विशाल अण्ड उन विशेषों (शब्द आदि)-से एक ही बारमें उत्पन्न हुआ; वह जलमें स्थित था। वह अण्ड अपनेसे दस गुना विस्तारवाले जलसे बाहरसे घिरा था; यह जल दस गुना विस्तारवाले तेज (अग्नि)-से बाहरसे घिरा था, तेज दस गुना विस्तारवाले वायुसे बाहरसे घिरा था और वायु भी दस गुना विस्तारवाले आकाशसे बाहरसे घिरा था, जिस आकाशसे वायु आवूत था, वह आकाश

verses.hindi: शर्वश्चाण्डकपालस्थो भवश्चाम्भसि सुव्रताः।  भूत आदिसे घिरा था। भूत आदि महत्तत्त्वसे घिरे थे शवश्‍्चाणडकपालस्थो भवश्चाम्भसि सुत्रता:।  भूत आदिले चिरा था। भूत आदि महतत घिरे बे चे  रूद्रोऽग्निमध्ये भगवानुग्रो वायौ पुनः स्मृतः॥ महत्तत्त्व उस अव्यक्तसे घिरा था॥ ५३-५६ ।॥ हे सुव्रतो ! शर्व sl अण्डके कपालपर स्थित हैं और भव जलमें स्थित हैं; रुद्र अग्निमें तथा भगवान् उग्र वायुमें स्थित कहे गये हैं; भीम पृथ्वीकै मध्यमें स्थित हैं, महेश्वर अहंकारमें स्थित हैं भगवान् ईश बुद्धिमें स्थित हैं और परमेश्वर सर्वत्र स्थित

verses.hindi: अतीत विश्वात्मा स्वयम्भूका जो काल है उसकी गणना सौ वर्षोमें भी नहीं की जा सकती है। वर्तमान ब्रह्माकी कालसंख्याको परार्ध कहा गया है। उतने ही परिमाणवाला इनका काल द्वितीय परार्ध शेष रहता है; उसके अन्तमें जगतूका संहार हो जाता है। कल्पोंके हजारों करोड़ जो दिन व्यतीत हो गये हैं, उत्ते ही दूसरे अभी शेष हैं॥ १०७-१०८१/२॥

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीलिङ्गमहापुराणे पूर्वभागे रुद्रसहस्रनामकथनं नाम पञ्चषष्टितमो ऽध्यायः त्रिधन्वा देवदेवस्य प्रसादात्तण्डिनस् तथा अश्वमेधसहस्रस्य फलं प्राप्य प्रयत्नतः
verses.transliteration: iti śrīliṅgamahāpurāṇe pūrvabhāge rudrasahasranāmakathanaṃ nāma pañcaṣaṣṭitamo 'dhyāyaḥ tridhanvā devadevasya prasādāttaṇḍinas tathā aśvamedhasahasrasya phalaṃ prāpya prayatnataḥ
verses.translation: By the grace of the lord of Devas as well as of Tannin, Tridhanvan attained assiduously the benefit of a thousand horse-sacrifices. Thereafter he gained the lordship of Siva's attendants. He was bowed to by all Devas. The scholarly king Trayyaruna was the successor to Tridhanvan.
verses.hindi: अध्याय ७० महेश्वरसे होनेवाली आदिसृष्टिका स्वरूप “सतीकी देहसे अनेक देवियोंका प्रादुर्भाव ३१५ फ़पापापापाफापापापाफाफपप

Thereafter he gained the lordship of Siva's attendants. He was bowed to by all Devas. The scholarly king Trayyaruna was the successor to Tridhanvan.
