verses.sanskrit: गाणपत्यं दृढं प्राप्तः सर्वदेवनमस्कृतः आसीत्त्रिधन्वनश्चापि विद्वांस्त्रय्यारुणो नृपः
verses.transliteration: gāṇapatyaṃ dṛḍhaṃ prāptaḥ sarvadevanamaskṛtaḥ āsīttridhanvanaścāpi vidvāṃstrayyāruṇo nṛpaḥ
verses.translation: He had an extremely powerful son named Satyavrata. He killed the king of Vidarbha®"a of unmeasured prowess®®® and abducted his wife before the mantras of the wedding cele- brations were brought to a close. The king Trayyaruna abandoned him because he was defiled by that evil.
verses.hindi: शर्वर्यन्ते प्रकुरुते ब्रह्मत्वं सर्गकारणात्। नारायण' कहे गये हैं॥ ११५-११९/२॥ ब्रह्मा तु सलिले तस्मिन् वायुर्भूत्वा समाचरत्॥ १२१ हजार चतुर्युगीतक जलमें निवास करनेके पश्चात्
verses.wordMeaning: He had an extremely powerful son named Satyavrata. He killed the king of Vidarbha®"a of unmeasured prowess®®® and abducted his wife before the mantras of the wedding cele- brations were brought to a close. The king Trayyaruna abandoned him because he was defiled by that evil.
verses.commentary: Sense: He had an extremely powerful son named Satyavrata. He killed the king of Vidarbha®"a of unmeasured prowess®®® and abducted his wife before the mantras of the wedding cele- brations were brought to a close. The king Trayyaruna abandoned him because he was defiled by that evil.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य सत्यव्रतो नाम कुमारो ऽभून्महाबलः तेन भार्या विदर्भस्य हृता हत्वामितौजसम्
verses.transliteration: tasya satyavrato nāma kumāro 'bhūnmahābalaḥ tena bhāryā vidarbhasya hṛtā hatvāmitaujasam
verses.translation: When abandoned, he said to his father "Where shall I go?" O brahmins, the father replied to him "Go and live among the Candalas.
verses.hindi: निशायामिव खद्योतः प्रावृट्काले ततस्तु सः। प अ उद ता क ततस्तु सलिले तस्मन् विज्ञायान्तर्गतां महीम्॥ १२२ रूप धारण किया। ब्रह्माजी वायु होकर उस जलमें विचरण करने लगे, जैसे कि वर्षाऋतुमें रात्रिमें खद्योत
verses.wordMeaning: When abandoned, he said to his father "Where shall I go?" O brahmins, the father replied to him "Go and live among the Candalas.
verses.commentary: Sense: When abandoned, he said to his father "Where shall I go?" O brahmins, the father replied to him "Go and live among the Candalas.

verses.sanskrit: पाणिग्रहणमन्त्रेषु निष्ठाम् अप्रापितेष्विह तेनाधर्मेण संयुक्तं राजा त्रय्यारुणो ऽत्यजत्
verses.transliteration: pāṇigrahaṇamantreṣu niṣṭhām aprāpiteṣviha tenādharmeṇa saṃyuktaṃ rājā trayyāruṇo 'tyajat
verses.translation: On being ordered thus, he went out of the city. At the instance of his father, the intelligent Satyavrata went to the Canijiala colony. On being abandoned by his father thus he stayed near the slum while his father went to the forest. The valiant (son) and meritorious king Satyavrata became famous in all the worlds under the name Triianku. Once Vasistha pronounced on him a curse. Vivamitra of great splendour granted him boons and crowned him king in the hereditary kingdom. The sage performed a sacrifice on his behalf. Even as Devas and Vasistha were watching, the holy lord Viivamitra raised him up to heaven in his human form.®®® His wife, Satyavrata born of theKekaya family®® gave birth to a spotless son Haricandra. Haricandra's son Rohita was very powerful.
verses.hindi: अनुमानादसम्मूढो भूमेरुद्धरणं पुनः। विचरण करता है। तदनन्तर ज्ञानसम्मन्न उन ब्रह्माने अकरोत्स तनूमन्यां कल्पादिषु यथा पुरा॥ १२३ अनुमानपूर्वक पृथ्वीको जलके भीतर गयी हुई जानकर पहलेके कल्पोंमें जैसा रूप धारण किया था, उस अन्य रूपको धारणकर पृथ्वीका उद्धार करनेका निश्चय
verses.wordMeaning: On being ordered thus, he went out of the city. At the instance of his father, the intelligent Satyavrata went to the Canijiala colony. On being abandoned by his father thus he stayed near the slum while his father went to the forest.…
verses.commentary: Sense: On being ordered thus, he went out of the city. At the instance of his father, the intelligent Satyavrata went to the Canijiala colony. On being abandoned by his father thus he stayed near the slum while his father went to the forest.…

verses.sanskrit: पितरं सो ऽब्रवीत् त्यक्तः क्व गच्छामीति वै द्विजाः पिता त्वेनमथोवाच श्वपाकैः सह वर्तय
verses.transliteration: pitaraṃ so 'bravīt tyaktaḥ kva gacchāmīti vai dvijāḥ pitā tvenamathovāca śvapākaiḥ saha vartaya
verses.translation: Harita was the son of Rohita. Dhundhu was the son of Harita. Vijaya and Sutejas were the sons of Dhimdhu.
verses.hindi: किया। तत्पश्चात् महात्मा भगवान् ब्रह्मा उस दिव्य रूपका चिन्तन करने लगे। सभी ओरसे जलसे व्याप्त पृथ्वीको देखकर उन्होंने सोचा कि मैं कौन-सा रूप धारण करके इस पृथ्वीका उद्धार करूं ॥ १२०-१२४/२॥ उन्होंने जलक्रीड़ाके अनुरूप, सभी प्राणियोंसे अजेय, वेदमय तथा ब्रह्मसंज्ञक वाराहरूप धारण किया और पृथ्वीका उद्धार करनेके लिये रसातलमें प्रवेश किया। उन वाराहरूपधारी प्रजापतिने जलसे घिरी हुई
verses.wordMeaning: Harita was the son of Rohita. Dhundhu was the son of Harita. Vijaya and Sutejas were the sons of Dhimdhu.
verses.commentary: Sense: Harita was the son of Rohita. Dhundhu was the son of Harita. Vijaya and Sutejas were the sons of Dhimdhu.

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्तः स विचक्राम नगराद्वचनात् पितुः स तु सत्यव्रतो धीमाञ् छ्वपाकावसथान्तिके
verses.transliteration: ityuktaḥ sa vicakrāma nagarādvacanāt pituḥ sa tu satyavrato dhīmāñ chvapākāvasathāntike
verses.translation: For detail, DawsoU: ffindu Mythology, p -289.
verses.hindi: पृथ्वीके पास पहुँचकर उसे उठा लिया और समुद्रके जलको समुद्रोमें तथा नदियोंके जलको नदियोंमें समाविष्ट कर दिया। इस प्रकार उन प्रभुने लोक-कल्याणके लिये रसातलमें गयी हुई तथा समुद्रतलमें डूबी हुई पृथ्वीको
verses.wordMeaning: For detail, DawsoU: ffindu Mythology, p -289.
verses.commentary: Sense: For detail, DawsoU: ffindu Mythology, p -289.

verses.sanskrit: पित्रा त्यक्तो ऽवसद्वीरः पिता चास्य वनं ययौ सर्वलोकेषु विख्यातस् त्रिशङ्कुरिति वीर्यवान्
verses.transliteration: pitrā tyakto 'vasadvīraḥ pitā cāsya vanaṃ yayau sarvalokeṣu vikhyātas triśaṅkuriti vīryavān
verses.translation: Vijaya was so called because he conquered the kings of the Ksatriyavarna. His son Rucaka was a righteous king.
verses.hindi: अपने दंष्ट्रापर उठा लिया। इसके बाद उन धरणीधरने पृथ्वीको उसके मूल स्थानमें लाकरके पूर्वकी भाँति रखकर छोड़ दिया। वह पृथ्वी उस जलराशिके ऊपर बिशाल नौकाकी भाँति स्थित हो गयी और उसीके समान विशाल देह होनेके कारण पृथ्वी पुनः डूब न सकी ॥ १२५--१३० /२॥
verses.wordMeaning: Vijaya was so called because he conquered the kings of the Ksatriyavarna. His son Rucaka was a righteous king.
verses.commentary: Sense: Vijaya was so called because he conquered the kings of the Ksatriyavarna. His son Rucaka was a righteous king.

verses.sanskrit: वसिष्ठकोपात्पुण्यात्मा राजा सत्यव्रतः पुरा विश्वामित्रो महातेजा वरं दत्त्वा त्रिशङ्कवे
verses.transliteration: vasiṣṭhakopātpuṇyātmā rājā satyavrataḥ purā viśvāmitro mahātejā varaṃ dattvā triśaṅkave
verses.translation: Vrka was the son of Rucaka. From him was bom Bahu. Sagara, au extremely virtuous king was his son.
verses.hindi: तत्पश्चात् कमलके समान नेत्रवाले भगवानूने उसे उठा करके जगत्को स्थापनाकी इच्छासे पृथ्वीका विभाग करनेके लिये मनमें निश्चय किया। उन्होंने पृथ्वीको समतल करके पृथ्वीपर पर्वतोंको संग्रहीत
verses.wordMeaning: Vrka was the son of Rucaka. From him was bom Bahu. Sagara, au extremely virtuous king was his son.
verses.commentary: Sense: Vrka was the son of Rucaka. From him was bom Bahu. Sagara, au extremely virtuous king was his son.

verses.sanskrit: राज्ये ऽभिषिच्य तं पित्र्ये याजयामास तं मुनिः मिषतां देवतानां च वसिष्ठस्य च कौशिकः
verses.transliteration: rājye 'bhiṣicya taṃ pitrye yājayāmāsa taṃ muniḥ miṣatāṃ devatānāṃ ca vasiṣṭhasya ca kauśikaḥ
verses.translation: Sagara had two wives. Prabha and Bhumati. The fiery sage Aurva®«2 was propitiated by both of them, with a desire for sons,
verses.hindi: किया। संवर्तक अग्निह्वार पूर्व सृष्टिके दग्ध कर दिये अग्निसे विशीर्ण हो गये थे। उस एकार्णवमें वायुप्रवाहके द्वारा एकत्रित होकर शीतके कारण वे जहाँ-जहाँ जम
verses.wordMeaning: Sagara had two wives. Prabha and Bhumati. The fiery sage Aurva®«2 was propitiated by both of them, with a desire for sons,
verses.commentary: Sense: Sagara had two wives. Prabha and Bhumati. The fiery sage Aurva®«2 was propitiated by both of them, with a desire for sons,

verses.sanskrit: सशरीरं तदा तं वै दिवमारोपयद्विभुः तस्य सत्यव्रता नाम भार्या कैकयवंशजा
verses.transliteration: saśarīraṃ tadā taṃ vai divamāropayadvibhuḥ tasya satyavratā nāma bhāryā kaikayavaṃśajā
verses.translation: The delighted Aurva asked them to choose a boon of their liking out of the two, viz. one would have sixty thousand sons and the other a single son, who would continue the family line. Prabha chose to have many sons and Bhanumati one son who was Asamafijasa.
verses.hindi: ततो महात्मा भगवान् दिव्यरूपमचिन्तयत्। सलिलेनाप्लुतां भूमिं दृष्ट्वा स तु समन्तत:
verses.wordMeaning: The delighted Aurva asked them to choose a boon of their liking out of the two, viz. one would have sixty thousand sons and the other a single son, who would continue the family line. Prabha chose to have many sons and Bhanumati one son who was Asamafijasa.
verses.commentary: Sense: The delighted Aurva asked them to choose a boon of their liking out of the two, viz. one would have sixty thousand sons and the other a single son, who would continue the family line. Prabha chose to have many sons and Bhanumati one son who was Asamafijasa.

verses.sanskrit: कुमारं जनयामास हरिश्चन्द्रमकल्मषम् हरिश्चन्द्रस्य च सुतो रोहितो नाम वीर्यवान्
verses.transliteration: kumāraṃ janayāmāsa hariścandramakalmaṣam hariścandrasya ca suto rohito nāma vīryavān
verses.translation: Thereafter Prabha gave biith to sixty thousand sons. While digging the earth, they were burned by the angry out- bursts of Visnu®® in the guise of Kapila as if through arrows.
verses.hindi: अधुष्यं सर्वभूतानां वाङ्मयं ब्रह्मसंज्ञितम् पृथिव्युद्धरणार्थाय प्रविवेश रसातलम् प्रभुर्लोकहितार्थाय दंष्ट्याभ्युज्जहार गाम्। ततः स्वस्थानमानीय पृथिवीं पृथिवीधरः
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter Prabha gave biith to sixty thousand sons. While digging the earth, they were burned by the angry out- bursts of Visnu®® in the guise of Kapila as if through arrows.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter Prabha gave biith to sixty thousand sons. While digging the earth, they were burned by the angry out- bursts of Visnu®® in the guise of Kapila as if through arrows.

verses.sanskrit: हरितो रोहितस्याथ धुन्धुर्हारित उच्यते विजयश् च सुतेजाश् च धुन्धुपुत्रौ बभूवतुः
verses.transliteration: harito rohitasyātha dhundhurhārita ucyate vijayaś ca sutejāś ca dhundhuputrau babhūvatuḥ
verses.translation: The earth, ruled over by Nabhaga Ambarisa with the power of his arms became entirely devoid of the three-fold distress.
verses.hindi: तत उत्क्षिप्य तां देवो जगतः स्थापनेच्छया
verses.wordMeaning: The earth, ruled over by Nabhaga Ambarisa with the power of his arms became entirely devoid of the three-fold distress.
verses.commentary: Sense: The earth, ruled over by Nabhaga Ambarisa with the power of his arms became entirely devoid of the three-fold distress.

verses.sanskrit: जेता क्षत्रस्य सर्वत्र विजयस्तेन स स्मृतः रुचकस्तस्य तनयो राजा परमधार्मिकः
verses.transliteration: jetā kṣatrasya sarvatra vijayastena sa smṛtaḥ rucakastasya tanayo rājā paramadhārmikaḥ
verses.translation: The valorous son of Sindhudvipa was Ayutayus. Rtuparna of great fame was the son of Ayutayus.
verses.hindi: प्राक्सर्गे दह्यमाने तु तदा संवर्तकारिनिना। तेनाग्निना विशीर्णास्ते पर्वता भूरि विस्तराः शैत्यादेकार्णवे तस्मिन् वायुना तेन संहताः । निषिक्ता यत्र यत्रासंस्तत्र तत्राचलाभवन्
verses.wordMeaning: The valorous son of Sindhudvipa was Ayutayus. Rtuparna of great fame was the son of Ayutayus.
verses.commentary: Sense: The valorous son of Sindhudvipa was Ayutayus. Rtuparna of great fame was the son of Ayutayus.

verses.sanskrit: रुचकस्य वृकः पुत्रस् तस्माद्बाहुश् च जज्ञिवान् सगरस्तस्य पुत्रो ऽभूद् राजा परमधार्मिकः
verses.transliteration: rucakasya vṛkaḥ putras tasmādbāhuś ca jajñivān sagarastasya putro 'bhūd rājā paramadhārmikaḥ
verses.translation: This powerful king was a friend of Nala. He was conversant with the secret of dice. In the Puranas, two Nalas of stable holy rites are well known. One was the son of Vlra- $ena and the other born in the family of Ik§vaku. Sarvabhaurna the lord of the subjects was the son of PLtuparna.
verses.hindi: कन हा पर्वत बन गये। चे चलायमा ˆ उ गये, वहाँ-वहाँ पर्वत बन गये। वे चलायमान न न कारण ' अचल, पवाँसे युक्त होनेके कारण “पर्वत! निगीर्ण होनेके कारण 'गिरि' तथा  भूमिपर शयन करनेके कारण 'शिलोच्चय' कहे गये हें । इस प्रकार
verses.wordMeaning: This powerful king was a friend of Nala. He was conversant with the secret of dice. In the Puranas, two Nalas of stable holy rites are well known. One was the son of Vlra- $ena and the other born in the family of Ik§vaku.…
verses.commentary: Sense: This powerful king was a friend of Nala. He was conversant with the secret of dice. In the Puranas, two Nalas of stable holy rites are well known. One was the son of Vlra- $ena and the other born in the family of Ik§vaku.…

verses.sanskrit: द्वे भार्ये सगरस्यापि प्रभा भानुमती तथा ताभ्यामाराधितः पूर्वम् और्वो ऽग्निः पुत्रकाम्यया
verses.transliteration: dve bhārye sagarasyāpi prabhā bhānumatī tathā tābhyāmārādhitaḥ pūrvam aurvo 'gniḥ putrakāmyayā
verses.translation: Aurvo agnih—agnisadriah Aurvo rifr the fiery sage Aurva, the son of Urva and the grandson of the famous sage Bhfgu.
verses.hindi: भगवान् विश्वकर्मा प्रत्येक कल्पमें उन पर्वतोंके इधर-उधर बिखर जानेपर बार-बार उनका विभाग करते हैं॥ १३१--१३६॥ पृथ्वीको, भू: आदि चारों लोकोंको बनाया । इसके बाद लोकोंको रचना करके उन्होंने प्रजासर्गकी रचना कौ, विविध प्रजाओंकी सृष्टि करनेकी इच्छावाले स्वयम्भू भगवान् ब्रह्मा-ने उसी प्रकारकी सृष्टिकी रचना की,
verses.wordMeaning: Aurvo agnih—agnisadriah Aurvo rifr the fiery sage Aurva, the son of Urva and the grandson of the famous sage Bhfgu.
verses.commentary: Sense: Aurvo agnih—agnisadriah Aurvo rifr the fiery sage Aurva, the son of Urva and the grandson of the famous sage Bhfgu.

verses.sanskrit: और्वस्तुष्टस्तयोः प्रादाद् यथेष्टं वरमुत्तमम् एका षष्टिसहस्राणि सुतमेकं परा तथा
verses.transliteration: aurvastuṣṭastayoḥ prādād yatheṣṭaṃ varamuttamam ekā ṣaṣṭisahasrāṇi sutamekaṃ parā tathā
verses.translation: His actual name was Mitrasaha but he was more famous as Kalmasapada.®® Vasisha of great splendour begot of the wife of Kalmasapada the son Amaka who continued the line of Iksvaku. Mulaka was the son of Amaka and Uttara (his wife).
verses.hindi: जैसा उन्होंने पहलेके कल्पोंमें किया था। सृष्टिके समय बुद्धिपूर्वक सर्गका चिन्तन करते हुए उन ब्रह्माकी बुद्धिसे तमोमय अविद्यात्मक सर्ग उत्पन्न हुआ; वह तम, मोह, महामोह, तामिस्र तथा अन्ध--इन नामोंवाला है।
verses.wordMeaning: His actual name was Mitrasaha but he was more famous as Kalmasapada.®® Vasisha of great splendour begot of the wife of Kalmasapada the son Amaka who continued the line of Iksvaku. Mulaka was the son of Amaka and Uttara (his wife).
verses.commentary: Sense: His actual name was Mitrasaha but he was more famous as Kalmasapada.®® Vasisha of great splendour begot of the wife of Kalmasapada the son Amaka who continued the line of Iksvaku. Mulaka was the son of Amaka and Uttara (his wife).

verses.sanskrit: अगृह्णाद् वंशकर्तारं प्रभागृह्णात्सुतान्बहून् एकं भानुमतिः पुत्रम् अगृह्णाद् असमञ्जसम्
verses.transliteration: agṛhṇād vaṃśakartāraṃ prabhāgṛhṇātsutānbahūn ekaṃ bhānumatiḥ putram agṛhṇād asamañjasam
verses.translation: That king was always surrounded by women due to his fear of Paras urama. Desirous of protection he had recourse to the excellent shield in the form of women. The virtuous king l§ataratha was the son of Mulaka. The powerful king Ilabila was bom of Sataratha.
verses.hindi: इस प्रकार पाँच पर्वोवाली यह अविद्या उन महात्मासे उत्पन्न हुई। ध्यान करते हुए अभिमानी ब्रह्माका वह सर्ग पाँच प्रकारसे अवस्थित हुआ। वह तमसे आवृत, बीजांकुरको भाँति ढका हुआ, बाहर तथा भीतरसे उन पर्वतों-की बुद्धि ढँकी हुई थी और उनके दुःख तथा क्रियाकलाप भी ढँके हुए थे, अतः
verses.wordMeaning: That king was always surrounded by women due to his fear of Paras urama. Desirous of protection he had recourse to the excellent shield in the form of women. The virtuous king l§ataratha was the son of Mulaka. The powerful king Ilabila was bom of Sataratha.
verses.commentary: Sense: That king was always surrounded by women due to his fear of Paras urama. Desirous of protection he had recourse to the excellent shield in the form of women. The virtuous king l§ataratha was the son of Mulaka. The powerful king Ilabila was bom of Sataratha.

verses.sanskrit: ततः षष्टिसहस्राणि सुषुवे सा तु वै प्रभा खनन्तः पृथिवीं दग्धा विष्णुहुङ्कारमार्गणैः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ ṣaṣṭisahasrāṇi suṣuve sā tu vai prabhā khanantaḥ pṛthivīṃ dagdhā viṣṇuhuṅkāramārgaṇaiḥ
verses.translation: The valorous Vrddha Sarma was the son of Ilabila. The daughter of the Pitrs bore him the son ViSvasaha.
verses.hindi: उत्पन्न (मुख्य) कहे गये हैं
verses.wordMeaning: The valorous Vrddha Sarma was the son of Ilabila. The daughter of the Pitrs bore him the son ViSvasaha.
verses.commentary: Sense: The valorous Vrddha Sarma was the son of Ilabila. The daughter of the Pitrs bore him the son ViSvasaha.

verses.sanskrit: असमञ्जस्य तनयः सो ऽंशुमान्नाम विश्रुतः तस्य पुत्रो दिलीपस्तु दिलीपात्तु भगीरथः
verses.transliteration: asamañjasya tanayaḥ so 'ṃśumānnāma viśrutaḥ tasya putro dilīpastu dilīpāttu bhagīrathaḥ
verses.translation: Dilipa was his son. He was famous by the name Khatvahga. He obtained a life for the duration of a Muhurta. From heaven he came to this world for this period and conque- red the three fires and the three worlds by means of his intellect and truthfulness. His son was DIrghabahu and Raghu was born of him.
verses.hindi: उस प्रकारके प्रथम सर्गको कार्यहेतु व्यर्थ समझकर वे ब्रह्मा अप्रसन्नचित्त हो गये। तब वे अन्य सर्गका विचार करने लगे। ऐसा चिन्तन करते हुए उन ब्रह्मासे हुआ। वह सर्ग तिर्यक् प्रवृत्तिवाला था, इसलिये उसे तिर्यक्स्रोत कहा गया है। है द्विजो! वे उत्पथग्राही पशु पक्षी आदिके रूपमें प्रसिद्ध हुए। इसके बाद अत सर्गका ध्यान करते हुए उन ब्रह्मासे ऊर्ध्व्रोत (ऊध्व
verses.wordMeaning: Dilipa was his son. He was famous by the name Khatvahga. He obtained a life for the duration of a Muhurta. From heaven he came to this world for this period and conque- red the three fires and the three worlds by means of his intellect and truthfulness.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Dilipa was his son. He was famous by the name Khatvahga. He obtained a life for the duration of a Muhurta. From heaven he came to this world for this period and conque- red the three fires and the three worlds by means of his intellect and truthfulness.…

verses.sanskrit: येन भागीरथी गङ्गा तपः कृत्वावतारिता भगीरथसुतश्चापि श्रुतो नाम बभूव ह
verses.transliteration: yena bhāgīrathī gaṅgā tapaḥ kṛtvāvatāritā bhagīrathasutaścāpi śruto nāma babhūva ha
verses.translation: The powerful and valiant Aja was born of Raghu. From him was >orn the glorious Daaratha, the sustainer of the family of Iksvaku.
verses.hindi: इन्द्रियप्रवाहवाला) तीसरा सात्त्विक सर्ग उत्पन्न हुआ?
verses.wordMeaning: The powerful and valiant Aja was born of Raghu. From him was >orn the glorious Daaratha, the sustainer of the family of Iksvaku.
verses.commentary: Sense: The powerful and valiant Aja was born of Raghu. From him was >orn the glorious Daaratha, the sustainer of the family of Iksvaku.

verses.sanskrit: नाभागस्तस्य दायादो भवभक्तः प्रतापवान् अंबरीषः सुतस्तस्य सिन्धुद्वीपस् ततो ऽभवत्
verses.transliteration: nābhāgastasya dāyādo bhavabhaktaḥ pratāpavān aṃbarīṣaḥ sutastasya sindhudvīpas tato 'bhavat
verses.translation: The heroic Rama who was conversant with Dharma and who was well known in all the worlds was born of Daa- ratha. So also were Bharata, Laksmana and Satrughna.
verses.hindi: ततस्तेषु विकीर्णेषु कोटिशो हि गिरिष्वथ। विश्वकर्मा विभजते कल्पादिषु पुनः पुनः भूराद्यांश्चतुरो लोकान् पुनः सोऽथ व्यकल्पयत्
verses.wordMeaning: The heroic Rama who was conversant with Dharma and who was well known in all the worlds was born of Daa- ratha. So also were Bharata, Laksmana and Satrughna.
verses.commentary: Sense: The heroic Rama who was conversant with Dharma and who was well known in all the worlds was born of Daa- ratha. So also were Bharata, Laksmana and Satrughna.

verses.sanskrit: नाभागेनांबरीषेण भुजाभ्यां परिपालिता बभूव वसुधात्यर्थं तापत्रयविवर्जिता
verses.transliteration: nābhāgenāṃbarīṣeṇa bhujābhyāṃ paripālitā babhūva vasudhātyarthaṃ tāpatrayavivarjitā
verses.translation: Rama, the best among them, had great splendour and excellent valour. After killing Ravana in battle and performing sacrifices Rama who was conversant with Dharma ruled over the kingdom for ten thousand years. A son well known as Ku!§a was born to Rama. His other son Lava was highly blessed, truthful and intelligent. Atithi was born to Kua and his son was Nisadha.
verses.hindi: लोकान् प्रकल्पयित्वाथ प्रजासर्ग ससर्ज ह। ब्रह्मा स्वयम्भूर्भगवान् सिसूक्षुर्विविधाः प्रजाः
verses.wordMeaning: Rama, the best among them, had great splendour and excellent valour. After killing Ravana in battle and performing sacrifices Rama who was conversant with Dharma ruled over the kingdom for ten thousand years. A son well known as Ku!§a was born to Rama.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Rama, the best among them, had great splendour and excellent valour. After killing Ravana in battle and performing sacrifices Rama who was conversant with Dharma ruled over the kingdom for ten thousand years. A son well known as Ku!§a was born to Rama.…

verses.sanskrit: अयुतायुः सुतस्तस्य सिन्धुद्वीपस्य वीर्यवान् पुत्रो ऽयुतायुषो धीमान् ऋतुपर्णो महायशाः
verses.transliteration: ayutāyuḥ sutastasya sindhudvīpasya vīryavān putro 'yutāyuṣo dhīmān ṛtuparṇo mahāyaśāḥ
verses.translation: Nala was born of Nisadha and Nabhas was his son. A son called Pundarika was born to Nabhas, and Ksema Dhanvam was his son.
verses.hindi: बुद्ध्याश्च समकाले वै प्रादुर्भूतस्तमोमयः। तमो मोहो महामोहस्तामिस्त्रशचान्धसंज्ञितः संवृतस्तमसा चैव बीजाङ्करवदावृतः। बहिरन्तश्चाप्रकाशस्तब्धो निःसंज्ञ एव च
verses.wordMeaning: Nala was born of Nisadha and Nabhas was his son. A son called Pundarika was born to Nabhas, and Ksema Dhanvam was his son.
verses.commentary: Sense: Nala was born of Nisadha and Nabhas was his son. A son called Pundarika was born to Nabhas, and Ksema Dhanvam was his son.

verses.sanskrit: दिव्याक्षहृदयज्ञो वै राजा नलसखो बली नलौ द्वावेव विख्यातौ पुराणेषु दृढव्रतौ
verses.transliteration: divyākṣahṛdayajño vai rājā nalasakho balī nalau dvāveva vikhyātau purāṇeṣu dṛḍhavratau
verses.translation: His son was the heroic and valorous Devanika. Ahinara was his son and thereafter was Sahasrava. From him were bom Candravaloka and Tarapla. His son was Chandra- giri. Bhanucandra was his son.
verses.hindi: यस्मात्तेषां वृता बुद्धि्दुःखानि करणानि च। तस्मात्ते संवृतात्मानो नगा मुख्याः प्रकीर्तिताः
verses.wordMeaning: His son was the heroic and valorous Devanika. Ahinara was his son and thereafter was Sahasrava. From him were bom Candravaloka and Tarapla. His son was Chandra- giri. Bhanucandra was his son.
verses.commentary: Sense: His son was the heroic and valorous Devanika. Ahinara was his son and thereafter was Sahasrava. From him were bom Candravaloka and Tarapla. His son was Chandra- giri. Bhanucandra was his son.

verses.sanskrit: वीरसेनसुतश्चान्यो यश्चेक्ष्वाकुकुलोद्भवः ऋतुपर्णस्य पुत्रो ऽभूत् सार्वभौमः प्रजेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: vīrasenasutaścānyo yaścekṣvākukulodbhavaḥ ṛtuparṇasya putro 'bhūt sārvabhaumaḥ prajeśvaraḥ
verses.translation: Kalmaap&da — the same as Mitrasaha, a king of Ik$v&ku dynasty. For detail, Dawson /if. A/, pp, I44-I45'
verses.hindi: मुख्यसर्ग तथाभूतं दृष्ट्वा ब्रह्मा ह्यसाधकम्। अप्रसन्नमनाः सोऽथ ततोऽन्यं सो ह्यमन्यत अध्याय ७० 1महेश्वरसे होनेवाली आदिसृष्टिका स्वरूप -सतीकी देहसे अनेक देवियोंका प्रादुर्भाव ३१७ फरक क्ति RMR fT फफफ फफ पापा पमा पी फा फा फाफाफाफफफफफ फेपाफफफफफफफफफफफफफफफफफफफफफफफफफफफफफफ फफफफफफफफ फफफ फा फफीफीपी फ़फफफफफफप
verses.wordMeaning: Kalmaap&da — the same as Mitrasaha, a king of Ik$v&ku dynasty. For detail, Dawson /if. A/, pp, I44-I45'
verses.commentary: Sense: Kalmaap&da — the same as Mitrasaha, a king of Ik$v&ku dynasty. For detail, Dawson /if. A/, pp, I44-I45'

verses.sanskrit: सुदासस्तस्य तनयो राजा त्विन्द्रसमो ऽभवत् सुदासस्य सुतः प्रोक्तः सौदासो नाम पार्थिवः
verses.transliteration: sudāsastasya tanayo rājā tvindrasamo 'bhavat sudāsasya sutaḥ proktaḥ saudāso nāma pārthivaḥ
verses.translation: His son was Srutayu who was also known as Brhadbala. This powerful king was killed by Saubhadra ( son of Subhadra i. c. Abhimanyu) in the Bhata war.
verses.hindi: प्रकाशा बहिरन्तश्च ऊर्ध्वस्त्रोतोभवा: स्मृता: १४८
verses.wordMeaning: His son was Srutayu who was also known as Brhadbala. This powerful king was killed by Saubhadra ( son of Subhadra i. c. Abhimanyu) in the Bhata war.
verses.commentary: Sense: His son was Srutayu who was also known as Brhadbala. This powerful king was killed by Saubhadra ( son of Subhadra i. c. Abhimanyu) in the Bhata war.

verses.sanskrit: ख्यातः कल्माषपादो वै नाम्ना मित्रसहश् च सः वसिष्ठस्तु महातेजाः क्षेत्रे कल्माषपादके
verses.transliteration: khyātaḥ kalmāṣapādo vai nāmnā mitrasahaś ca saḥ vasiṣṭhastu mahātejāḥ kṣetre kalmāṣapādake
verses.translation: These are the successor kings of Iksvaku. In general only the more important ones in the dynasty are mentioned here in order of their importance.
verses.hindi: ऊर्ध्वरूपसे व्यवस्थित था। चूँकि यह ऊर्ध्व॑भावसे कार्य करता था, अतः यह सर्ग ऊर्ध्व्रोत कहा गया है। वे सुख-प्रीतिको अधिक प्रवृत्तिवाले, बाहर तथा भीतरसे संवृत और बाहर तथा भीतरसे प्रकाशमय थे, इसलिये वे ऊर्ध्वस्रोतसे उत्पन्न कहे गये हैं। वे सत्त्वगुणके योगसे सृजित किये गये, इसलिये वे सत्त्वोद्धव कहे गये हैं ऊर्ध्व्रोत नामक वह तीसरा सर्ग देवसर्ग कहा गया है। बाहर तथा भीतर प्रकाशसे युक्त
verses.wordMeaning: These are the successor kings of Iksvaku. In general only the more important ones in the dynasty are mentioned here in order of their importance.
verses.commentary: Sense: These are the successor kings of Iksvaku. In general only the more important ones in the dynasty are mentioned here in order of their importance.

verses.sanskrit: अश्मकं जनयामास इक्ष्वाकुकुलवर्धनम् अश्मकस्योत्तरायां तु मूलकस्तु सुतो ऽभवत्
verses.transliteration: aśmakaṃ janayāmāsa ikṣvākukulavardhanam aśmakasyottarāyāṃ tu mūlakastu suto 'bhavat
verses.translation: All of them had realized Siva. In accordance with their knowledge®® they had worshipped tlie lord and per- formed sacrifices according to the rules. The noble souls had all attained heaven. Some of them were liberated souls and yogins. As the result of the curse of a brahmin, Nrga attain- ed the state of a chameleon.
verses.hindi: रहनेके कारण वे ऊर्ध्व्रोतसे उत्पन्न कहे गये हैं। ऊर्ध्वस्रोतके रूपमें ज्ञेय वे लोग विद्वानोंके द्वारा सन्तुष्ट आत्मावाले कहे गये हैं
verses.wordMeaning: All of them had realized Siva. In accordance with their knowledge®® they had worshipped tlie lord and per- formed sacrifices according to the rules. The noble souls had all attained heaven. Some of them were liberated souls and yogins. As the result of the curse of a brahmin,…
verses.commentary: Sense: All of them had realized Siva. In accordance with their knowledge®® they had worshipped tlie lord and per- formed sacrifices according to the rules. The noble souls had all attained heaven. Some of them were liberated souls and yogins. As the result of the curse of a brahmin,…

verses.sanskrit: स हि रामभयाद्राजा स्त्रीभिः परिवृतो वने बिभर्ति त्राणमिच्छन्वै नारीकवचमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: sa hi rāmabhayādrājā strībhiḥ parivṛto vane bibharti trāṇamicchanvai nārīkavacamuttamam
verses.translation: Dhrsta had three virtuous sons, viz., Dhrsaketu, Yama- bala and Ranadhrsfa.
verses.hindi: ऊर्ध्वस्रोतवाले देवताओंके सृष्ट हो जानेपर वर प्रदान करनेवाले प्रभु भगवान् ब्रह्मा प्रसन्न हो गये और उसके बाद वे दूसरी सृष्टिका विचार करने लगे। तब प्रभु ब्रह्माने अन्य साधक सर्गका सूजन किया। उस समय ध्यान करते हुए उन सत्यके अभिध्यायी व्यक्त ब्रह्मासे अर्वाक्स्रोत (बाहर तथा भीतरसे इन्द्रियप्रवाहवाला) साधक सर्ग उत्पन्न हुआ। इस सृष्टिके लोग अर्वाक्रूपसे कार्यमें प्रवृत्त हुए, इसलिये वे अर्वाक्ख्रोता कहे गये हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Dhrsta had three virtuous sons, viz., Dhrsaketu, Yama- bala and Ranadhrsfa.
verses.commentary: Sense: Dhrsta had three virtuous sons, viz., Dhrsaketu, Yama- bala and Ranadhrsfa.

verses.sanskrit: मूलकस्यापि धर्मात्मा राजा शतरथः सुतः तस्माच्छतरथाज्जज्ञे राजा त्विलविलो बली
verses.transliteration: mūlakasyāpi dharmātmā rājā śatarathaḥ sutaḥ tasmācchatarathājjajñe rājā tvilavilo balī
verses.translation: Saryati had a son Anarta and a daughter SukanyS. Anarta's son was Rocamana.
verses.hindi: वे प्रकाशबाहुल्यवाले, तमोगुणसे युक्त तथा रजोगुणको अधिकतावाले थे, इसलिये वे बहुत दुःखसे युक्त थे तथा बार-बार कर्म करनेवाले थे। बाहर तथा भीतरसे संवृत वे लोग साधक (कार्यसाधनमें तत्पर) मनुष्य थे; वे
verses.wordMeaning: Saryati had a son Anarta and a daughter SukanyS. Anarta's son was Rocamana.
verses.commentary: Sense: Saryati had a son Anarta and a daughter SukanyS. Anarta's son was Rocamana.

verses.sanskrit: आसीत् त्वैलविलिः श्रीमान् वृद्धशर्मा प्रतापवान् पुत्रो विश्वसहस्तस्य पितृकन्या व्यजीजनत्
verses.transliteration: āsīt tvailaviliḥ śrīmān vṛddhaśarmā pratāpavān putro viśvasahastasya pitṛkanyā vyajījanat
verses.translation: Prsita incurred great sin by killing the cow of his preceptor.*** It is well known that he was degraded as a Sudra due to the curse of Gyavana, his preceptor.
verses.hindi: तारक आदि लक्षणोंके द्वार आठ प्रकारसे व्यवस्थित हुए। सिद्ध आत्मावाले वे मनुष्य गन्धर्वोके समान गुणधर्मवाले थे। इस अर्वाक्स्रोत सृष्टिको “तैजस' सर्ग कहा गया है पाँचवाँ सर्ग “अनुग्रह' हैं; यह विपर्यय, शक्ति, सिद्धि तथा तुष्टिके द्वारा चार प्रकारसे व्यवस्थित है। स्थावरो (वृक्ष आदि) -में विस्तारके कारण भेद होता है, पशु आदिमें सामर्थ्यसे होता है, मनुष्य प्रारन्धजन्य सिद्धिसे
verses.wordMeaning: Prsita incurred great sin by killing the cow of his preceptor.*** It is well known that he was degraded as a Sudra due to the curse of Gyavana, his preceptor.
verses.commentary: Sense: Prsita incurred great sin by killing the cow of his preceptor.*** It is well known that he was degraded as a Sudra due to the curse of Gyavana, his preceptor.

verses.sanskrit: दिलीपस्तस्य पुत्रो ऽभूत् खट्वाङ्ग इति विश्रुतः येन स्वर्गाद् इहागत्य मुहूर्तं प्राप्य जीवितम्
verses.transliteration: dilīpastasya putro 'bhūt khaṭvāṅga iti viśrutaḥ yena svargād ihāgatya muhūrtaṃ prāpya jīvitam
verses.translation: Dicta's son was Nabhaga and from him was bom Bhalandana. His son Ajavahana was a king of great exploits.
verses.hindi: युक्त होते हैं और ऋषियों तथा देवताओं में सम्पूर्ण तुष्टिके द्वारा चतुर्थ भेद होता है। चार प्रकारवाला यह प्राकृत (प्रकृतिनिरूपण विषयवाला) तथा विकारको प्राप्त अनुग्रह नामक सर्ग श्रेष्ठ कहा गया है ॥ १५७- १५८ ५२॥
verses.wordMeaning: Dicta's son was Nabhaga and from him was bom Bhalandana. His son Ajavahana was a king of great exploits.
verses.commentary: Sense: Dicta's son was Nabhaga and from him was bom Bhalandana. His son Ajavahana was a king of great exploits.

verses.sanskrit: त्रयो ऽग्नयस्त्रयो लोका बुद्ध्या सत्येन वै जिताः दीर्घबाहुः सुतस्तस्य रघुस्तस्मादजायत
verses.transliteration: trayo 'gnayastrayo lokā buddhyā satyena vai jitāḥ dīrghabāhuḥ sutastasya raghustasmādajāyata
verses.translation: Thus (the successors of) the mighty sons of Manu are told briefly and the dynasty of Ikfvaku (in some detail). Now I shall recount to you the dynasty of Aila.
verses.hindi: ऊर्ध्वत्रोतास्तृतीयो वै देवसर्गस्तु स स्मृतः प्रकाशाद्वहिरन्तश्च ऊर्ध्वस्त्रोतोद्भवाः स्मृताः। ते ऊर्ध्वस्त्रोतसो ज्ञेयास्तुष्टात्मानो बुधैः स्मृताः
verses.wordMeaning: Thus (the successors of) the mighty sons of Manu are told briefly and the dynasty of Ikfvaku (in some detail). Now I shall recount to you the dynasty of Aila.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus (the successors of) the mighty sons of Manu are told briefly and the dynasty of Ikfvaku (in some detail). Now I shall recount to you the dynasty of Aila.

verses.sanskrit: अजः पुत्रो रघोश्चापि तस्माज्जज्ञे च वीर्यवान् राजा दशरथस्तस्माच् छ्रीमानिक्ष्वाकुवंशकृत्
verses.transliteration: ajaḥ putro raghoścāpi tasmājjajñe ca vīryavān rājā daśarathastasmāc chrīmānikṣvākuvaṃśakṛt
verses.translation: p&upataih jftanam— yogic practices as enjoined in Saiva cult. Gf. note 242.
verses.hindi: ऊर्ध्वस्त्रोतस्सु सृष्टेषु देवेषु वरदः प्रभुः। प्रीतिमानभवद् ब्रह्मा ततोऽन्यं सोऽभ्यमन्यत
verses.wordMeaning: p&upataih jftanam— yogic practices as enjoined in Saiva cult. Gf. note 242.
verses.commentary: Sense: p&upataih jftanam— yogic practices as enjoined in Saiva cult. Gf. note 242.

verses.sanskrit: रामो दशरथाद्वीरो धर्मज्ञो लोकविश्रुतः भरतो लक्ष्मणश्चैव शत्रुघ्नश् च महाबलः
verses.transliteration: rāmo daśarathādvīro dharmajño lokaviśrutaḥ bharato lakṣmaṇaścaiva śatrughnaś ca mahābalaḥ
verses.translation: Pr$ata killed, in ignorance, the cow of his preceptor: Gyavana, mistaking it for a tiger in the darkness of night.
verses.hindi: ते च प्रकाशबहुलास्तमः पृक्ता रजोऽधिकाः। तस्मात्ते दुःखबहुला भूयोभूयश्च कारिणः संवृता बहिरन्तश्च मनुष्याः साधकाश्च ते। लक्षणैस्तारकाय्ैस्ते ह्यष्टधा तु व्यवस्थिताः
verses.wordMeaning: Pr$ata killed, in ignorance, the cow of his preceptor: Gyavana, mistaking it for a tiger in the darkness of night.
verses.commentary: Sense: Pr$ata killed, in ignorance, the cow of his preceptor: Gyavana, mistaking it for a tiger in the darkness of night.

verses.sanskrit: तेषां श्रेष्ठो महातेजा रामः परमवीर्यवान् रावणं समरे हत्वा यज्ञैरिष्ट्वा च धर्मवित्
verses.transliteration: teṣāṃ śreṣṭho mahātejā rāmaḥ paramavīryavān rāvaṇaṃ samare hatvā yajñairiṣṭvā ca dharmavit
verses.translation: O brahmins, Pururavas a valorous son of 11a and a devotee of Rudra, held an unhindered sway in the holy land Prayaga®®' which is. situated on the northern bank of the Yamuna®®® frequented by sages. He was the glorious lord of Pratisthana®®® (Prayaga), and well established there.
verses.hindi: सिद्धात्मानो मनुष्यास्ते गन्धर्वसहधर्मिणः । इत्येष तैजसः सर्गो हार्वाक्स्नोतः प्रकीर्तितः
verses.wordMeaning: O brahmins, Pururavas a valorous son of 11a and a devotee of Rudra, held an unhindered sway in the holy land Prayaga®®' which is. situated on the northern bank of the Yamuna®®® frequented by sages. He was the glorious lord of Pratisthana®®® (Prayaga), and well established there.
verses.commentary: Sense: O brahmins, Pururavas a valorous son of 11a and a devotee of Rudra, held an unhindered sway in the holy land Prayaga®®' which is. situated on the northern bank of the Yamuna®®® frequented by sages. He was the glorious lord of Pratisthana®®® (Prayaga), and well established there.

verses.sanskrit: दशवर्षसहस्राणि रामो राज्यं चकार सः रामस्य तनयो जज्ञे कुश इत्यभिविश्रुतः
verses.transliteration: daśavarṣasahasrāṇi rāmo rājyaṃ cakāra saḥ rāmasya tanayo jajñe kuśa ityabhiviśrutaḥ
verses.translation: He had six powerful glorious sons, well known in the region of the Gandharvas and devoted to Siva. All of them were divine, being the sons of Urvai.®'® They were: — Ayu, Mayu, Amayu, Visvayu, Srutayu and Satayu.
verses.hindi: सिद्धात्मानो मनुष्यास्तु ऋषिदेवेषु कृत्स्तशः भूतादिकानां भूतानां षष्ठः सर्गः स उच्यते
verses.wordMeaning: He had six powerful glorious sons, well known in the region of the Gandharvas and devoted to Siva. All of them were divine, being the sons of Urvai.®'® They were: — Ayu, Mayu, Amayu, Visvayu, Srutayu and Satayu.
verses.commentary: Sense: He had six powerful glorious sons, well known in the region of the Gandharvas and devoted to Siva. All of them were divine, being the sons of Urvai.®'® They were: — Ayu, Mayu, Amayu, Visvayu, Srutayu and Satayu.

verses.sanskrit: लवश् च सुमहाभागः सत्यवान् अभवत् सुधीः अतिथिस्तु कुशाज्जज्ञे निषधस्तस्य चात्मजः
verses.transliteration: lavaś ca sumahābhāgaḥ satyavān abhavat sudhīḥ atithistu kuśājjajñe niṣadhastasya cātmajaḥ
verses.translation: Ayu had five sons of great power. They were kings born of Prabha the daughter of Svarbhanu.
verses.hindi: श्रीलिड्रमहापुराण
verses.wordMeaning: Ayu had five sons of great power. They were kings born of Prabha the daughter of Svarbhanu.
verses.commentary: Sense: Ayu had five sons of great power. They were kings born of Prabha the daughter of Svarbhanu.

verses.sanskrit: नलस्तु निषधाज्जातो नभस्तस्मादजायत नभसः पुण्डरीकाख्यः क्षेमधन्वा ततः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: nalastu niṣadhājjāto nabhastasmādajāyata nabhasaḥ puṇḍarīkākhyaḥ kṣemadhanvā tataḥ smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: Nahusa the first among them was known in all the worlds and conversant with Dharma. Nahusa's successors were six and they were comparable to Indra in splendour.
verses.hindi: निवृत्तं वर्तमानं च तेषां जानन्ति वै पुनः। मु आदिका सर्ग भूतोंका 0002 भूतादिकानां भूतानां सप्तमः सर्ग एव च॥ १६ जाता है। उन उत्पद्यमान भूतोंके ह वर्तमान तथा भविष्यको वे भूतादिक निश्चित रूपसे जानते है  भूतादिक भूतों (मनुष्यों)-का सातवाँ सर्ग है। पूर्वोक्त उन सभी भूतादिकोंको नि:स्पृह, दानशील, कर्मफलका आस्वादन करनेवाला तथा अशील जानना चाहिए।
verses.wordMeaning: Nahusa the first among them was known in all the worlds and conversant with Dharma. Nahusa's successors were six and they were comparable to Indra in splendour.
verses.commentary: Sense: Nahusa the first among them was known in all the worlds and conversant with Dharma. Nahusa's successors were six and they were comparable to Indra in splendour.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य पुत्रो ऽभवद् वीरो देवानीकः प्रतापवान् अहीनरः सुतस् तस्य सहस्राश्वस्ततः परः
verses.transliteration: tasya putro 'bhavad vīro devānīkaḥ pratāpavān ahīnaraḥ sutas tasya sahasrāśvastataḥ paraḥ
verses.translation: Those (kings) of great power were born of Viraja the daughter of the Pitrs. They were Yati, Yayati, Saihyati, Ayati, Andhaka and Vijati. All these six were well renowned. Yati was the eldest of them and Yayati was junior to him.
verses.hindi: भूतादि (अहंकार) अज्ञानसे तथा विष्णुमायासे व्यवस्थित होता है॥ १५९--१६१“/२ ॥
verses.wordMeaning: Those (kings) of great power were born of Viraja the daughter of the Pitrs. They were Yati, Yayati, Saihyati, Ayati, Andhaka and Vijati. All these six were well renowned. Yati was the eldest of them and Yayati was junior to him.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those (kings) of great power were born of Viraja the daughter of the Pitrs. They were Yati, Yayati, Saihyati, Ayati, Andhaka and Vijati. All these six were well renowned. Yati was the eldest of them and Yayati was junior to him.

verses.sanskrit: शुभश्चन्द्रावलोकश् च तारापीडस्ततो ऽभवत् तस्यात्मजश्चन्द्रगिरिर् भानुचन्द्रस् ततो ऽभवत्
verses.transliteration: śubhaścandrāvalokaś ca tārāpīḍastato 'bhavat tasyātmajaścandragirir bhānucandras tato 'bhavat
verses.translation: The eldest royal son Yati seeking salvation, was united with Brahman. Among the other five Yayati was the strongest and most valorous.
verses.hindi: महतूसे होनेवाले सर्गको ब्रह्माका प्रथम सर्ग कहा गया है । तन्मात्राओंका जो दूसरा सर्ग है, वह भूतसर्ग कहा जाता है। वैकारिक तीसरा सर्ग ऐन्द्रियसर्ग कहा गया है। यह सब प्राकृत सर्ग है, जो बुद्धिपूर्वक हुआ है। चौथा मुख्य सर्ग है; सभी स्थावर मुख्य कहे गये हैं। इसके बाद तिर्यक्स्रोत, ऊर्ध्वस्नोत तथा अर्वाक्रोतके क्रमसे अर्वाक्-स्रोतोंका सर्ग है; उनमें सातवाँ जो अर्वाक्स्रोतोंका सर्ग है, वह मानुषसर्ग है। आठवाँ
verses.wordMeaning: The eldest royal son Yati seeking salvation, was united with Brahman. Among the other five Yayati was the strongest and most valorous.
verses.commentary: Sense: The eldest royal son Yati seeking salvation, was united with Brahman. Among the other five Yayati was the strongest and most valorous.

verses.sanskrit: श्रुतायुरभवत्तस्माद् बृहद्बल इति स्मृतः भारते यो महातेजाः सौभद्रेण निपातितः
verses.transliteration: śrutāyurabhavattasmād bṛhadbala iti smṛtaḥ bhārate yo mahātejāḥ saubhadreṇa nipātitaḥ
verses.translation: He married Devayani the daughter of Sukra. She be- came the demoness Sarmistha the daughter of Vrsaparvan.
verses.hindi: अनुग्रहसर्ग है; वह सात्त्विक, तामस तथा राजस भेदाँवाला होता है  सात्त्विकको देवताओंमें, तामसको पशुओंमें तथा राजसको मनुष्योंमें जानना चाहिए । इस प्रकार ये पाँच वैकृत सर्ग तथा तीन प्राकृत सर्ग कहे गये
verses.wordMeaning: He married Devayani the daughter of Sukra. She be- came the demoness Sarmistha the daughter of Vrsaparvan.
verses.commentary: Sense: He married Devayani the daughter of Sukra. She be- came the demoness Sarmistha the daughter of Vrsaparvan.

verses.sanskrit: एते इक्ष्वाकुदायादा राजानः प्रायशः स्मृताः वंशे प्रधाना एतस्मिन् प्राधान्येन प्रकीर्तिताः
verses.transliteration: ete ikṣvākudāyādā rājānaḥ prāyaśaḥ smṛtāḥ vaṃśe pradhānā etasmin prādhānyena prakīrtitāḥ
verses.translation: Devayani gave birth to two sons Yadu and Turvasu. Both of them performed sacrificial rites. They were highly spoken and were experts in all lores.
verses.hindi: हैं। सनक आदिका जो नौवाँ सर्ग है, वह प्राकृत तथा वैकृत दोनों रूपोंबाला कहा गया है । ब्रह्माके जो तीन प्राकृतसर्ग कहे गये हैं, वे अबुद्धिपूर्वक प्रवर्तित हुए हैं और जो शेष छ: सर्ग हैं, वे बुद्धिपूर्वक प्रवर्तित हुए हे ऋषियो! अब मैं विस्तृत अनुग्रहसर्गका वर्णन कर रहा हूँ; आपलोग उसे जान लें। वह सभी भूतोंमें पूर्णरूपसे चार प्रकारसे अवस्थित है। ये जो प्राकृत तथा वैकृत कुल नौ सर्ग कहे गये हैं, उन्हे
verses.wordMeaning: Devayani gave birth to two sons Yadu and Turvasu. Both of them performed sacrificial rites. They were highly spoken and were experts in all lores.
verses.commentary: Sense: Devayani gave birth to two sons Yadu and Turvasu. Both of them performed sacrificial rites. They were highly spoken and were experts in all lores.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वे पाशुपते ज्ञानम् अधीत्य परमेश्वरम् समभ्यर्च्य यथाज्ञानम् इष्ट्वा यज्ञैर्यथाविधि
verses.transliteration: sarve pāśupate jñānam adhītya parameśvaram samabhyarcya yathājñānam iṣṭvā yajñairyathāvidhi
verses.translation: Sarmi$th§ the daughter of Vf aparvan gave birth to Druhyu, Anu and Puru. Propitiated by Yayati, Sukra,the leading brahmin gave him a shining well-built golden car and two everlasting great quivers.
verses.hindi: विद्वानोंने कारणोंके द्वारा एक-दूसरेसे अनुरक्त (सम्बद्ध) बताया हे
verses.wordMeaning: Sarmi$th§ the daughter of Vf aparvan gave birth to Druhyu, Anu and Puru. Propitiated by Yayati, Sukra,the leading brahmin gave him a shining well-built golden car and two everlasting great quivers.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sarmi$th§ the daughter of Vf aparvan gave birth to Druhyu, Anu and Puru. Propitiated by Yayati, Sukra,the leading brahmin gave him a shining well-built golden car and two everlasting great quivers.

verses.sanskrit: दिवं गता महात्मानः केचिन्मुक्तात्मयोगिनः नृगो ब्राह्मणशापेन कृकलासत्वम् आगतः
verses.transliteration: divaṃ gatā mahātmānaḥ kecinmuktātmayoginaḥ nṛgo brāhmaṇaśāpena kṛkalāsatvam āgataḥ
verses.translation: The chariot was yoked to horses as quick as the mind. It was in this chariot that he brought home his bride. With that excellent chariot he conquered the earth within six months.
verses.hindi: आरस्भमें ब्रह्माजीने अपने ही सदृश मानस पुत्रोंका सृजन किया। उनमेंसे सबसे पहले उत्पन्न तथा स पूर्वज ऋभु तथा सनत्कुमार--ये दोनों ऊध्वरिता (ब्रह्मचारी) थे। आठवाँ कल्प व्यतीत होनेपर प्राचीन एवं लोकसाक्षी स्वादनाश्चाप्यशीलाश्च ज्ञेया भूतादिकाश्च ते
verses.wordMeaning: The chariot was yoked to horses as quick as the mind. It was in this chariot that he brought home his bride. With that excellent chariot he conquered the earth within six months.
verses.commentary: Sense: The chariot was yoked to horses as quick as the mind. It was in this chariot that he brought home his bride. With that excellent chariot he conquered the earth within six months.

verses.sanskrit: धृष्टश् च धृष्टकेतुश् च यमबालश् च वीर्यवान् रणधृष्टश् च ते पुत्रास् त्रयः परमधार्मिकाः
verses.transliteration: dhṛṣṭaś ca dhṛṣṭaketuś ca yamabālaś ca vīryavān raṇadhṛṣṭaś ca te putrās trayaḥ paramadhārmikāḥ
verses.translation: Yayati was invincible to Devas, Davas and mortals. He was a devotee of Siva, a meritorious soul abiding by Dhar- ma. He performed sacrifices. He conquered anger. He was sympatlietic to all living beings. That excellent chariot was inherited by all the descendants of Kuru until Janamejaya the son of Paiikit the king in the line of Puru. As a result of the curse of the sage Garga*' that chariot was destroyed.
verses.hindi: प्रथमो महतः सर्गो विज्ञेयो ब्रह्मणः स्मृतः
verses.wordMeaning: Yayati was invincible to Devas, Davas and mortals. He was a devotee of Siva, a meritorious soul abiding by Dhar- ma. He performed sacrifices. He conquered anger. He was sympatlietic to all living beings.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Yayati was invincible to Devas, Davas and mortals. He was a devotee of Siva, a meritorious soul abiding by Dhar- ma. He performed sacrifices. He conquered anger. He was sympatlietic to all living beings.…

verses.sanskrit: आनर्तो नाम शर्यातेः सुकन्या नाम दारिका आनर्तस्याभवत् पुत्रो रोचमानः प्रतापवान्
verses.transliteration: ānarto nāma śaryāteḥ sukanyā nāma dārikā ānartasyābhavat putro rocamānaḥ pratāpavān
verses.translation: The king Janamejaya harassed the son of Garga, the boy Akrura, and hence attained the sin of brahmin slaugh- ter. The king began to emit the odour of rusting iron. He ran about helterskelter. Since he was boycotted by the citizens and the people of the land he did not obtain happiness. Dejected, he did not even have perfect knowledge anywhere. In his anguish he went to sage iSaunaka and sought refuge in him. The liberal-minded sage who was known as Indreti performed sacrifice on his behalf. O excellent brahmins, for the sake of purification he made the king Janamejaya perform a horse sacrifice.
verses.hindi: वैकारिकस्तृतीयस्तु सर्ग ऐन्द्रियकः स्मृतः अबुद्धिपूर्वकाः सर्गाः प्राकृतास्तु त्रयः स्मृताः । बुद्धिपूर्व प्रवर्तन्ते षट् पुनर्त्रह्मणस्तु ते
verses.wordMeaning: The king Janamejaya harassed the son of Garga, the boy Akrura, and hence attained the sin of brahmin slaugh- ter. The king began to emit the odour of rusting iron. He ran about helterskelter.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The king Janamejaya harassed the son of Garga, the boy Akrura, and hence attained the sin of brahmin slaugh- ter. The king began to emit the odour of rusting iron. He ran about helterskelter.…

verses.sanskrit: रोचमानस्य रेवो ऽभूद् रेवाद् रैवत एव च ककुद्मी चापरो ज्येष्ठपुत्रः पुत्रशतस्य तु
verses.transliteration: rocamānasya revo 'bhūd revād raivata eva ca kakudmī cāparo jyeṣṭhaputraḥ putraśatasya tu
verses.translation: That king of great renown was relieved of the bad odour of iron as well as of his sin. In the middle of the Avabhftha ablution the divine and splendid chariot vanished. Lost from that family it was given to Vasu king of Cedi*'* by the delighted Indra. From him Brhadratha acquired the chariot. Thereafter, killing Jarasandha (a successor of Brhadratha) Bhima, the scion of the family of Kurus, gave that excellent chariot to Srikr§na out of love.
verses.hindi: विस्तरानुग्रहः सर्गः कीर्त्यमानो निबोधत।
verses.wordMeaning: That king of great renown was relieved of the bad odour of iron as well as of his sin. In the middle of the Avabhftha ablution the divine and splendid chariot vanished. Lost from that family it was given to Vasu king of Cedi*'* by the delighted Indra.…
verses.commentary: Sense: That king of great renown was relieved of the bad odour of iron as well as of his sin. In the middle of the Avabhftha ablution the divine and splendid chariot vanished. Lost from that family it was given to Vasu king of Cedi*'* by the delighted Indra.…

verses.sanskrit: रेवती यस्य सा कन्या पत्नी रामस्य विश्रुता नरिष्यन्तस्य पुत्रो ऽभूज् जितात्मा तु महाबली
verses.transliteration: revatī yasya sā kanyā patnī rāmasya viśrutā nariṣyantasya putro 'bhūj jitātmā tu mahābalī
verses.translation: King Yayati son of Nahua crowned his son Puru (as king). O excellent brahmins, it was by that Puru alone that he had been helped before. People of all castes including the leading brahmins spoke to the king who was desirous of crown- ing his youngest son: — O lord, how does the youngest son deserve the kingdom after overlooking the claims of the eldest son Yadu, the son of Devay and the grandson of Sukra? We are addressing you to keep up the traditional Dharma."
verses.hindi: परस्परानुरक्ताश्च कारणैश्च बुधैः स्मृताः अग्रे ससर्ज वै ब्रह्मा मानसानात्मनः समान्। ऋभुः सनत्कुमारश्च द्वावेतावूर्ध्वरेतसौ
verses.wordMeaning: King Yayati son of Nahua crowned his son Puru (as king). O excellent brahmins, it was by that Puru alone that he had been helped before. People of all castes including the leading brahmins spoke to the king who was desirous of crown- ing his youngest son: — O lord,…
verses.commentary: Sense: King Yayati son of Nahua crowned his son Puru (as king). O excellent brahmins, it was by that Puru alone that he had been helped before. People of all castes including the leading brahmins spoke to the king who was desirous of crown- ing his youngest son: — O lord,…

verses.sanskrit: नाभागादंबरीषस्तु विष्णुभक्तः प्रतापवान् ऋतस्तस्य सुतः श्रीमान् सर्वधर्मविदांवरः
verses.transliteration: nābhāgādaṃbarīṣastu viṣṇubhaktaḥ pratāpavān ṛtastasya sutaḥ śrīmān sarvadharmavidāṃvaraḥ
verses.translation: King Yayati son of Nahua crowned his son Puru (as king). O excellent brahmins, it was by that Puru alone that he had been helped before. People of all castes including the leading brahmins spoke to the king who was desirous of crown- ing his youngest son: — O lord, how does the youngest son deserve the kingdom after overlooking the claims of the eldest son Yadu, the son of Devay and the grandson of Sukra? We are addressing you to keep up the traditional Dharma."
verses.hindi: व्यतीते त्वष्टमे कल्पे पुराणौ लोकसाक्षिणौ
verses.wordMeaning: King Yayati son of Nahua crowned his son Puru (as king). O excellent brahmins, it was by that Puru alone that he had been helped before. People of all castes including the leading brahmins spoke to the king who was desirous of crown- ing his youngest son: — O lord,…

verses.sanskrit: तस्माद्वंशात्परिभ्रष्टो वसोश्चेदिपतेः पुनः दत्तः शक्रेण तुष्टेन लेभे तस्माद् बृहद्रथः

verses.hindi: यया सृष्टासुराः सर्वे तां तनुं स व्यपोहत। विप्रो! ' असु: ' को प्राण कहा गया है; इसलिये उससे सापविद्धा तनुस्तेन सद्यो रात्रिरजायत॥ २००  जन्म लेनेके कारण वे असुर हुए। जिस शरीरसे उन्होंने सभी असुरोंको उत्पन्न किया था, उस शरीरको छोड़ दिया। तब उनके द्वारा त्यक्त वह शरीर तत्काल रात्रि हो

verses.sanskrit: ततो हत्वा जरासंधं भीमस्तं रथमुत्तमम् प्रददौ वासुदेवाय प्रीत्या कौरवनन्दनः
verses.transliteration: tato hatvā jarāsaṃdhaṃ bhīmastaṃ rathamuttamam pradadau vāsudevāya prītyā kauravanandanaḥ
verses.translation: King Yayati son of Nahua crowned his son Puru (as king). O excellent brahmins, it was by that Puru alone that he had been helped before. People of all castes including the leading brahmins spoke to the king who was desirous of crown- ing his youngest son: — O lord, how does the youngest son deserve the kingdom after overlooking the claims of the eldest son Yadu, the son of Devay and the grandson of Sukra? We are addressing you to keep up the traditional Dharma."
verses.hindi: गयी। वह रात्रि अन्धकारकी अधिकतासे युक्त होती है, अत: वह नियामिका (सबको शयन करानेवाली) है । प्रजाएँ रातमें अन्धकारसे आवृत हो जाती हैं, इसलिये वे सोती हैं तत्पश्चात् असुरोंका सृजन करके उन्होंने अन्य अव्यक्त तथा सत्त्वबहुल शरीर धारण किया; इसलिये उन्होंने उसकी पूजा की। तब उस शरीरको धारण करनेवाले उन ब्रह्माको प्रसन्नता हुई। इसके बाद

verses.sanskrit: अभ्यषिञ्चत्पुरुं पुत्रं ययातिर्नाहुषः प्रभुः कृतोपकारस्तेनैव पुरुणा द्विजसत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: abhyaṣiñcatpuruṃ putraṃ yayātirnāhuṣaḥ prabhuḥ kṛtopakārastenaiva puruṇā dvijasattamāḥ
verses.translation: King Yayati son of Nahua crowned his son Puru (as king). O excellent brahmins, it was by that Puru alone that he had been helped before. People of all castes including the leading brahmins spoke to the king who was desirous of crown- ing his youngest son: — O lord, how does the youngest son deserve the kingdom after overlooking the claims of the eldest son Yadu, the son of Devay and the grandson of Sukra? We are addressing you to keep up the traditional Dharma."
verses.hindi: क्रीड़ा करते हुए ब्रह्मके मुखसे देवता उत्पन्न हुए। चूँकि क्रीड़ा करते हुए इन ब्रह्मासे वे उत्पन्न हुए, इसलिये वे देवता कहे गये हैं। जो 'दिव्' धातु कही गयी है, वह क्रीड़ाके अर्थमें जानी जाती है। उन
verses.wordMeaning: King Yayati son of Nahua crowned his son Puru (as king). O excellent brahmins, it was by that Puru alone that he had been helped before. People of all castes including the leading brahmins spoke to the king who was desirous of crown- ing his youngest son: — O lord,…

verses.sanskrit: अभिषेक्तुकामं च नृपं पुरुं पुत्रं कनीयसम् ब्राह्मणप्रमुखा वर्णा इदं वचनमब्रुवन्
verses.transliteration: abhiṣektukāmaṃ ca nṛpaṃ puruṃ putraṃ kanīyasam brāhmaṇapramukhā varṇā idaṃ vacanamabruvan
verses.translation: King Yayati son of Nahua crowned his son Puru (as king). O excellent brahmins, it was by that Puru alone that he had been helped before. People of all castes including the leading brahmins spoke to the king who was desirous of crown- ing his youngest son: — O lord, how does the youngest son deserve the kingdom after overlooking the claims of the eldest son Yadu, the son of Devay and the grandson of Sukra? We are addressing you to keep up the traditional Dharma."
verses.hindi: ब्रह्मासे वे क्रीड़ा करते हुए उत्पन्न हुए, इसलिये देवता कहे जाते हैं ॥ २०२-२०४/२॥ धारण किया और उनके द्वारा छोड़ा गया वह पहलेवाला शरीर शीघ्र ही दिन बन गया। इसलिये देवतालोग धर्मयुक्त दिनकी उपासना करते हैं। उन्होंने सत्त्वगुणमय उस अन्य शरीरकी भी पूजा की। पिताके समान मानते

verses.commentary: Sense: King Yayati son of Nahua crowned his son Puru (as king). O excellent brahmins, it was by that Puru alone that he had been helped before. People of all castes including the leading brahmins spoke to the king who was desirous of crown- ing his youngest son: — O lord,…

verses.sanskrit: कथं शुक्रस्य नप्तारं देवयान्याः सुतं प्रभो ज्येष्ठं यदुमतिक्रम्य कनीयान्राज्यमर्हति
verses.transliteration: kathaṃ śukrasya naptāraṃ devayānyāḥ sutaṃ prabho jyeṣṭhaṃ yadumatikramya kanīyānrājyamarhati

People of all castes including the leading brahmins spoke to the king who was desirous of crown- ing his youngest son: — O lord, how does the youngest son deserve the kingdom after overlooking the claims of the eldest son Yadu, the son of Devay and the grandson of Sukra? We are addressing you to keep up the traditional Dharma."
verses.hindi: हुए तथा उन उत्पद्यमान पुत्रोंका ध्यान करते हुए प्रभु (ब्रह्मा)-के दाहिने-बाएँ दोनों पार्श्वभागसे दिन तथा रातके बीच पितर उत्पन्न हुए, इसलिये वे पितर देवता हैं और उनमें पितृत्व है
verses.wordMeaning: King Yayati son of Nahua crowned his son Puru (as king). O excellent brahmins, it was by that Puru alone that he had been helped before. People of all castes including the leading brahmins spoke to the king who was desirous of crown- ing his youngest son: — O lord,…
