verses.sanskrit: एते संबोधयामस्त्वां धर्मं च अनुपालय
verses.transliteration: ete saṃbodhayāmastvāṃ dharmaṃ ca anupālaya
verses.translation: King Yayati son of Nahua crowned his son Puru (as king). O excellent brahmins, it was by that Puru alone that he had been helped before. People of all castes including the leading brahmins spoke to the king who was desirous of crown- ing his youngest son: — O lord, how does the youngest son deserve the kingdom after overlooking the claims of the eldest son Yadu, the son of Devay and the grandson of Sukra? We are addressing you to keep up the traditional Dharma."
verses.hindi: उन्होंने जिस कायासे पितरोंका सूजन किया था, उस कायाको त्याग दिया। उनके द्वारा त्यक्त वह काया शीघ्र ही सन्ध्या हो गयी। चूँकि दिन देवताओंका होता है और जो रात है, वह आसुरी कही गयी है; अतः उन दोनोंके मध्य जो पत्री (पितरोंकी) काया है, वह सबसे श्रेष्ठ है। इसी कारणसे सभी देवता, असुर, ऋषि तथा मनुष्य प्रसन्नतासे युक्त होकर रात्रि तथा दिनके मध्यको काया (सन्ध्या)-की उपासना करते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: King Yayati son of Nahua crowned his son Puru (as king). O excellent brahmins, it was by that Puru alone that he had been helped before. People of all castes including the leading brahmins spoke to the king who was desirous of crown- ing his youngest son: — O lord,…
verses.commentary: Sense: King Yayati son of Nahua crowned his son Puru (as king). O excellent brahmins, it was by that Puru alone that he had been helped before. People of all castes including the leading brahmins spoke to the king who was desirous of crown- ing his youngest son: — O lord,…

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीलिङ्गमहापुराणे पूर्वभागे षट्षष्टितमो ऽध्यायः ब्राह्मणप्रमुखा वर्णाः सर्वे शृण्वन्तु मे वचः ज्येष्ठं प्रति यथा राज्यं न देयं मे कथञ्चन
verses.transliteration: iti śrīliṅgamahāpurāṇe pūrvabhāge ṣaṭṣaṣṭitamo 'dhyāyaḥ brāhmaṇapramukhā varṇāḥ sarve śṛṇvantu me vacaḥ jyeṣṭhaṃ prati yathā rājyaṃ na deyaṃ me kathañcana
verses.translation: Let the members of all castes beginning with the brah- mins listen to my words in regard to this why I have decided that the kingdom should in no way be given to the eldest son Yadu.
verses.hindi: सा तमोबहुला यस्मात्ततो रात्रिर्नियामिका। आवृतास्तमसा रात्रौ प्रजास्तस्मात्स्वपन्त्युत॥
verses.wordMeaning: Let the members of all castes beginning with the brah- mins listen to my words in regard to this why I have decided that the kingdom should in no way be given to the eldest son Yadu.
verses.commentary: Sense: Let the members of all castes beginning with the brah- mins listen to my words in regard to this why I have decided that the kingdom should in no way be given to the eldest son Yadu.

verses.sanskrit: मम ज्येष्ठेन यदुना नियोगो नानुपालितः प्रतिकूलमतिश्चैव न स पुत्रः सतां मतः
verses.transliteration: mama jyeṣṭhena yadunā niyogo nānupālitaḥ pratikūlamatiścaiva na sa putraḥ satāṃ mataḥ
verses.translation: My behest was not carried out by Yadu my eldest son. The son who is mentally opposed to his father is not approved of by good men.
verses.hindi: ततो मुखात्समुत्पन्ना दीव्यतस्तस्य देवताः यतोऽस्य दीव्यतो जातास्तेन देवाः प्रकीर्तिताः ।
verses.wordMeaning: My behest was not carried out by Yadu my eldest son. The son who is mentally opposed to his father is not approved of by good men.
verses.commentary: Sense: My behest was not carried out by Yadu my eldest son. The son who is mentally opposed to his father is not approved of by good men.

verses.sanskrit: मातापित्रोर्वचनकृत् सद्भिः पुत्रः प्रशस्यते स पुत्रः पुत्रवद् यस् तु वर्तते मातृपितृषु
verses.transliteration: mātāpitrorvacanakṛt sadbhiḥ putraḥ praśasyate sa putraḥ putravad yas tu vartate mātṛpitṛṣu
verses.translation: The son who acts according to the instructions of his parents is praised by good men. He is the real son who behaves towards his parents in a manner befitting a son.
verses.hindi: यस्मात्तस्य तु दीव्यन्तो जज्ञिरे तेन देवताः। देवान् सृष्ट्वाथ देवेशस्तनुमन्यामपद्यत
verses.wordMeaning: The son who acts according to the instructions of his parents is praised by good men. He is the real son who behaves towards his parents in a manner befitting a son.
verses.commentary: Sense: The son who acts according to the instructions of his parents is praised by good men. He is the real son who behaves towards his parents in a manner befitting a son.

verses.sanskrit: यदुनाहमवज्ञातस् तथा तुर्वसुनापि च द्रुह्येन चानुना चैव मय्यवज्ञा कृता भृशम्
verses.transliteration: yadunāhamavajñātas tathā turvasunāpi ca druhyena cānunā caiva mayyavajñā kṛtā bhṛśam
verses.translation: I have been treated with disrespect by Yadu, Tnrvasu, Druhyu and Anu.
verses.hindi: तस्मादहो धर्मयुक्तं देवताः समुपासते सत्त्वमात्रात्मिकामेव ततोऽन्यां सोऽभ्यमन्यत। पितृवन्मन्यमानस्य पुत्रांस्तान् ध्यायतः प्रभोः
verses.wordMeaning: I have been treated with disrespect by Yadu, Tnrvasu, Druhyu and Anu.
verses.commentary: Sense: I have been treated with disrespect by Yadu, Tnrvasu, Druhyu and Anu.

verses.sanskrit: पुरुणा च कृतं वाक्यं मानितश् च विशेषतः कनीयान्मम दायादो जरा येन धृता मम
verses.transliteration: puruṇā ca kṛtaṃ vākyaṃ mānitaś ca viśeṣataḥ kanīyānmama dāyādo jarā yena dhṛtā mama
verses.translation: My instructions were particularly honoured and carried out by Pfiru. He is my youngest son by whom my old age had been taken over.
verses.hindi: पितरो ह्युपपक्षाभ्यां रात्र्यह्नोरन्तरेऽभवन्। तस्मात्ते पितरो देवाः पितृत्वं तेन तेषु तत्
verses.wordMeaning: My instructions were particularly honoured and carried out by Pfiru. He is my youngest son by whom my old age had been taken over.
verses.commentary: Sense: My instructions were particularly honoured and carried out by Pfiru. He is my youngest son by whom my old age had been taken over.

verses.sanskrit: शुक्रेण मे समादिष्टा देवयान्याः कृते जरा प्रार्थितेन पुनस्तेन जरा संचारिणी कृता
verses.transliteration: śukreṇa me samādiṣṭā devayānyāḥ kṛte jarā prārthitena punastena jarā saṃcāriṇī kṛtā
verses.translation: Because of Devayani, Sukra had ordained that I would be attacked by old age. When he was requested, my old age was made transferable by him.
verses.hindi: यस्मादहर्देवतानां रात्रिर्या सासुरी स्मृता। तयोर्मध्ये तु पैत्री या तनुः सा तु गरीयसी उपासन्ते मुदायुक्ता रात्र्यह्वोर्मध्यमाँ तनुम्
verses.wordMeaning: Because of Devayani, Sukra had ordained that I would be attacked by old age. When he was requested, my old age was made transferable by him.
verses.commentary: Sense: Because of Devayani, Sukra had ordained that I would be attacked by old age. When he was requested, my old age was made transferable by him.

verses.sanskrit: शुक्रेण च वरो दत्तः काव्येनोशनसा स्वयम् पुत्रो यस्त्वनुवर्तेत स ते राज्यधरस्त्विति
verses.transliteration: śukreṇa ca varo dattaḥ kāvyenośanasā svayam putro yastvanuvarteta sa te rājyadharastviti
verses.translation: This boon was given by 8ukra himself— **The son who favours you shall be your heir to the kingdom.'' May ye all, O sires, approve of it. Puru shall then be crowned king."
verses.hindi: ३२२ श्रीलिड्रमहापुराण  त म साताका लल ततो हन्यां पुनर्ब्रह्मा तनुं वै समगृह्ृत। इसके बाद ब्रह्माने अन्य शरीर धारण किया  उन रजोमात्रात्मिकायां तु मनसा सोऽसृजत्प्रभुः ॥ २१ प्रभुने उस राजस तनुसे मानसिक सृजन करना
verses.wordMeaning: This boon was given by 8ukra himself— **The son who favours you shall be your heir to the kingdom.'' May ye all, O sires, approve of it. Puru shall then be crowned king."
verses.commentary: Sense: This boon was given by 8ukra himself— **The son who favours you shall be your heir to the kingdom.'' May ye all, O sires, approve of it. Puru shall then be crowned king."

verses.sanskrit: भवन्तो ऽप्यनुजानन्तु पूरू राज्ये ऽभिषिच्यते यः पुत्रो गुणसम्पन्नो मातापित्रोर्हितः सदा
verses.transliteration: bhavanto 'pyanujānantu pūrū rājye 'bhiṣicyate yaḥ putro guṇasampanno mātāpitrorhitaḥ sadā
verses.translation: Similarly the king employed the eldest son Yadu in the southern frontier and Druhyu and Anu in the west and in the north respectively.
verses.hindi: किया । उन्होंने रजोगुणप्रिय मानस पुत्रोंका सृजन किया। तब उनके मनस्वी मानवपुत्र उत्पन्न हुए। उन सन्तानोको सृष्टि करके उन्होंने पुनः उस कायाका त्याग कर दिया। तब उनके द्वारा त्यक्त वह काया तुरंत ज्योत्स्ना हो गयी; इसीलिये ज्योत्स्नाका उद्धव होनेपर प्रजाएँ प्रसन्न हो जाती हैं ॥ २१२-२१४/२॥
verses.wordMeaning: Similarly the king employed the eldest son Yadu in the southern frontier and Druhyu and Anu in the west and in the north respectively.
verses.commentary: Sense: Similarly the king employed the eldest son Yadu in the southern frontier and Druhyu and Anu in the west and in the north respectively.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वमर्हति कल्याणं कनीयान् अपि स प्रभुः अर्हः पूरुरिदं राज्यं यः सुतो वाक्यकृत्तव
verses.transliteration: sarvamarhati kalyāṇaṃ kanīyān api sa prabhuḥ arhaḥ pūruridaṃ rājyaṃ yaḥ suto vākyakṛttava
verses.translation: After conquering the earth including the seven islands and seven oceans, the son of Nahuga divided the kingdom into three parts among his sons.
verses.hindi: इस प्रकार उन महात्मा ब्रह्मा-ने जब इन शरीराँका त्याग किया, तब तुरंत रात, दिन, सन्ध्या तथा
verses.wordMeaning: After conquering the earth including the seven islands and seven oceans, the son of Nahuga divided the kingdom into three parts among his sons.
verses.commentary: Sense: After conquering the earth including the seven islands and seven oceans, the son of Nahuga divided the kingdom into three parts among his sons.

verses.sanskrit: वरदानेन शुक्रस्य न शक्यं कर्तुमन्यथा एवं जानपदैस्तुष्टैर् इत्युक्तो नाहुषस्तदा
verses.transliteration: varadānena śukrasya na śakyaṃ kartumanyathā evaṃ jānapadaistuṣṭair ityukto nāhuṣastadā
verses.translation: With the royal glory transferred to his sons and with the burden placed on his kins, the king became pleased. His mind was filled with delight.
verses.hindi: ये तीनों सत्त्वमात्रात्मक हैं। रात्रि तमोमात्रात्मिका है, इसलिये वह निशास्वरूपिणी है। अतः देवतालोग दिनके तनुसे सुखपूर्वक ब्रह्माके मुखसे सृजित हुए। चूँकि उनका जन्म दिनमें हुआ, इसलिये वे दिनमें बलशाली सद्यो रात्र्यहनी चैव सन्ध्या ज्योत्स्ना च जज्ञिरे। ज्योत्स्ना सन्ध्या अहश्चैव सत्त्वमात्रात्मकं त्रयम्
verses.wordMeaning: With the royal glory transferred to his sons and with the burden placed on his kins, the king became pleased. His mind was filled with delight.
verses.commentary: Sense: With the royal glory transferred to his sons and with the burden placed on his kins, the king became pleased. His mind was filled with delight.

verses.sanskrit: अभिषिच्य ततो राज्यं पूरुं स सुतम् आत्मनः दिशि दक्षिणपूर्वस्यां तुर्वसुं पुत्रमादिशत्
verses.transliteration: abhiṣicya tato rājyaṃ pūruṃ sa sutam ātmanaḥ diśi dakṣiṇapūrvasyāṃ turvasuṃ putramādiśat
verses.translation: In this context the following song was formerly sung by the great king Yayati: —
verses.hindi: तमोमात्रात्मिका रात्रिः सा वै तस्मानिशात्मिका। तस्माद्देवा दिवातन्वा तुष्ट्या सृष्टा मुखात्तु वै
verses.wordMeaning: In this context the following song was formerly sung by the great king Yayati: —
verses.commentary: Sense: In this context the following song was formerly sung by the great king Yayati: —

verses.sanskrit: दक्षिणायामथो राजा यदुं ज्येष्ठं न्ययोजयत् प्रतीच्यामुत्तरस्यां तु द्रुह्युं चानुं च तावुभौ
verses.transliteration: dakṣiṇāyāmatho rājā yaduṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ nyayojayat pratīcyāmuttarasyāṃ tu druhyuṃ cānuṃ ca tāvubhau
verses.translation: This vcric is repeated (1.8.25}. B is the same as Palm-
verses.hindi: यस्मात्तेषां दिवा जन्म बलिनस्तेन वै दिवा। होते हैं। प्रभुने अपने शरीरके द्वारा जघनसे असुरोंको तन्वा ययासुरान् रात्रौ जघनादसृजत्प्रभुः ॥ २१८ रातमें उत्पन्न किया था, अतः प्राणोंसे रातमें जन्म लेनेवाले वे असुर रातमें बलवान् होते हैं। ये ही प्राणेभ्यो निशिजन्मानो बलिनो निशि तेन ते। समय बीते हुए तथा आगे आनेवाले समस्त मन्वन्तरोमें
verses.wordMeaning: This vcric is repeated (1.8.25}. B is the same as Palm-
verses.commentary: Sense: This vcric is repeated (1.8.25}. B is the same as Palm-

verses.sanskrit: सप्तद्वीपां ययातिस्तु जित्वा पृथ्वीं ससागराम् व्यभजच्च त्रिधा राज्यं पुत्रेभ्यो नाहुषस्तदा
verses.transliteration: saptadvīpāṃ yayātistu jitvā pṛthvīṃ sasāgarām vyabhajacca tridhā rājyaṃ putrebhyo nāhuṣastadā
verses.translation: He performed penance on the peak Bhrgutuhga.'*® I'here the renowned king practised fast and attained heaven along with his wives. His line of successors consisted of five holy kings who were honoured even by divine sages. The entire earth is pervaded by these descendants like the rays of the sun. By reading or listening to the holy narrative of Yayati a man becomes intelligent, rich, long lived, famous and blessed with issues. Liberated from all sins he shall be honoured in the world of Siva.
verses.hindi: एतान्येव भविष्याणां देवानामसुरैः सह॥ २१९  होनेवाले देवताओं, असुरों, पितरों एवं मानवोंके निमित्त (कारणभूत) होते हैं ॥ २१५--२२०॥
verses.wordMeaning: He performed penance on the peak Bhrgutuhga.'*® I'here the renowned king practised fast and attained heaven along with his wives. His line of successors consisted of five holy kings who were honoured even by divine sages.…
verses.commentary: Sense: He performed penance on the peak Bhrgutuhga.'*® I'here the renowned king practised fast and attained heaven along with his wives. His line of successors consisted of five holy kings who were honoured even by divine sages.…

verses.sanskrit: पुत्रसंक्रामितश्रीस्तु हर्षनिर्भरमानसः प्रीतिमानभवद्राजा भारम् आवेश्य बन्धुषु
verses.transliteration: putrasaṃkrāmitaśrīstu harṣanirbharamānasaḥ prītimānabhavadrājā bhāram āveśya bandhuṣu
verses.translation: This is an oft-quoted verse.
verses.hindi: हैं; वे भासित होते हैं, इसलिये अम्भ हैं। विद्वानोंने “भा' धातुको दीप्ति (प्रकाश) अर्थमें कहा है, उसीसे यह “अम्भ' शब्द व्युत्पन्न है। उन ब्रह्माने इन अम्भोंका सूजन करके पुनः अपने शरीरसे विविध इसके बाद प्रभु ब्रह्मा-ने उस ज्योत्स्तामय शरीरका त्याग करके अन्य तमोमय तथा रजोमय शरीर धारण करके पुनः इसका पूजन किया। उन प्रभुने अन्धकारमें क्षुधापीडित अन्य लोगोंका सूजन किया।
verses.wordMeaning: This is an oft-quoted verse.
verses.commentary: Sense: This is an oft-quoted verse.

verses.sanskrit: अत्र गाथा महाराज्ञा पुरा गीता ययातिना याभिः प्रत्याहरेत् कामान् सर्वतो ऽङ्गानि कूर्मवत्
verses.transliteration: atra gāthā mahārājñā purā gītā yayātinā yābhiḥ pratyāharet kāmān sarvato 'ṅgāni kūrmavat
verses.translation: This is an oft-quoted verse.
verses.hindi: उनके द्वारा सृजित ये क्षुधायुक्त लोग उन अम्भोंको ग्रहण करनेके लिये उद्यत हुए  उनमें जिन्होंने कहा- है इन अम्भोंकी रक्षा करते हैं' वे राक्षस नामवाले हु
verses.wordMeaning: This is an oft-quoted verse.
verses.commentary: Sense: This is an oft-quoted verse.

verses.sanskrit: ताभिर् एव नरः श्रीमान् नान्यथा कर्मकोटिकृत् न जातु कामः कामानाम् उपभोगेन शाम्यति
verses.transliteration: tābhir eva naraḥ śrīmān nānyathā karmakoṭikṛt na jātu kāmaḥ kāmānām upabhogena śāmyati
verses.translation: This is an oft-quoted verse.
verses.hindi: ज्योत्स्ना रात्र्यहनी सन्ध्या चत्वार्यम्भांसि तानि वै। भान्ति यस्मात्ततोऽम्भांसि शब्दोऽयं सुमनीषिभिः सोऽम्भांस्येतानि सृष्ट्वा तु देवमानुषदानवान्
verses.wordMeaning: This is an oft-quoted verse.
verses.commentary: Sense: This is an oft-quoted verse.

verses.sanskrit: हविषा कृष्णवर्त्मेव भूय एवाभिवर्धते यत्पृथिव्यां व्रीहियवं हिरण्यं पशवः स्त्रियः
verses.transliteration: haviṣā kṛṣṇavartmeva bhūya evābhivardhate yatpṛthivyāṃ vrīhiyavaṃ hiraṇyaṃ paśavaḥ striyaḥ
verses.translation: This is an oft-quoted verse.
verses.hindi: अन्धकारे क्षुधाविष्टंस्ततोऽन्यान् सोऽसृजत्प्रभुः
verses.wordMeaning: This is an oft-quoted verse.
verses.commentary: Sense: This is an oft-quoted verse.

verses.sanskrit: नालमेकस्य तत्सर्वम् इति मत्वा शमं व्रजेत् यदा न कुरुते भावं सर्वभूतेषु पापकम्
verses.transliteration: nālamekasya tatsarvam iti matvā śamaṃ vrajet yadā na kurute bhāvaṃ sarvabhūteṣu pāpakam
verses.translation: This is an oft-quoted verse.
verses.hindi: अध्याय ७० 1महेश्वरसे होनेवाली आदिसृष्टिका स्वरूप “सतीकी देहसे अनेक देवियोंका प्रादुर्भाव की त कक कस म फफ फ फ फ फ फ फ फ फ फ फ़ फ फ फ फ फ़ फ फ फ फ़ फफ फ फ़ फ़ फ फ़ फ़ फ फ़ फ फ़ फ फ फ़ फ़ फ फ फ फ फ फ़ फ फ़ फ़ फ फ फ फ़ फ़ फ फा फा फा मी मी फर
verses.wordMeaning: This is an oft-quoted verse.
verses.commentary: Sense: This is an oft-quoted verse.

verses.sanskrit: कर्मणा मनसा वाचा ब्रह्म सम्पद्यते तदा यदा परान्न बिभेति परे चास्मान्न बिभ्यति
verses.transliteration: karmaṇā manasā vācā brahma sampadyate tadā yadā parānna bibheti pare cāsmānna bibhyati
verses.translation: This is an oft-quoted verse.
verses.hindi: तेन ते कर्मणा यक्षा गुह्यका गूढकर्मणा। रक्षेति पालने चापि धातुरेष विभाष्यते
verses.wordMeaning: This is an oft-quoted verse.
verses.commentary: Sense: This is an oft-quoted verse.

verses.sanskrit: यदा न निन्देन्न द्वेष्टि ब्रह्म सम्पद्यते तदा या दुस्त्यजा दुर्मतिभिर् यानजीर्यति जीर्यतः
verses.transliteration: yadā na nindenna dveṣṭi brahma sampadyate tadā yā dustyajā durmatibhir yānajīryati jīryataḥ
verses.translation: This is an oft-quoted verse.
verses.hindi: तं दृष्ट्वा हप्रियेणास्य केशाः शीर्णास्तु धीमतः अष्टस्वेतासु सृष्टासु देवयोनिषु स प्रभुः। ततः स्वच्छन्दतोऽन्यानि वयांसि वयसासूजत्
verses.wordMeaning: This is an oft-quoted verse.
verses.commentary: Sense: This is an oft-quoted verse.

verses.sanskrit: यो ऽसौ प्राणान्तिको रोगस् तां तृष्णां त्यजतः सुखम् जीर्यन्ति जीर्यतः केशा दन्ता जीर्यन्ति जीर्यतः
verses.transliteration: yo 'sau prāṇāntiko rogas tāṃ tṛṣṇāṃ tyajataḥ sukham jīryanti jīryataḥ keśā dantā jīryanti jīryataḥ
verses.translation: This is an oft-quoted verse.
verses.hindi: पशून् सृष्ट्वा स देवेशोऽसृजत्पक्षिगणानपि
verses.wordMeaning: This is an oft-quoted verse.
verses.commentary: Sense: This is an oft-quoted verse.

verses.sanskrit: चक्षुःश्रोत्रे च जीर्येते तृष्णैका निरुपद्रवा जीर्यन्ति देहिनः सर्वे स्वभावादेव नान्यथा
verses.transliteration: cakṣuḥśrotre ca jīryete tṛṣṇaikā nirupadravā jīryanti dehinaḥ sarve svabhāvādeva nānyathā
verses.translation: This is an oft-quoted verse.
verses.hindi: गाशचैवाथोदराद् ब्रह्मा पार्श्वाभ्यां च विनिर्ममे क्योंकि वे क्षुधापीडित तथा रात्रिमें विचरण करनेवाले थे। उनमेंसे प्रसन्न होकर जिन्होंने परस्पर यह कहा- हम इन अम्भोंका भक्षण करते हैं ' वे अपने उस कर्मके कारण यक्ष तथा गूढ़ कर्मके कारण गुह्यक हुए। रक्ष यह धातु पालन
verses.wordMeaning: This is an oft-quoted verse.
verses.commentary: Sense: This is an oft-quoted verse.

verses.sanskrit: जीविताशा धनाशा च जीर्यतो ऽपि न जीर्यते यच्च कामसुखं लोके यच्च दिव्यं महत्सुखम्
verses.transliteration: jīvitāśā dhanāśā ca jīryato 'pi na jīryate yacca kāmasukhaṃ loke yacca divyaṃ mahatsukham
verses.translation: This is an oft-quoted verse.
verses.hindi: अर्थमें जानी जाती है और इसी प्रकार “यक्षति' धातु भक्षण अर्थमें कही जाती है॥ २२३-२२७/२॥ उस सृष्टिको देखकर अप्रसन्नतासे युक्त उन
verses.wordMeaning: This is an oft-quoted verse.
verses.commentary: Sense: This is an oft-quoted verse.

verses.sanskrit: तृष्णाक्षयसुखस्यैतत् कलां नार्हति षोडशीम् एवमुक्त्वा स राजर्षिः सदारः प्राविशद्वनम्
verses.transliteration: tṛṣṇākṣayasukhasyaitat kalāṃ nārhati ṣoḍaśīm evamuktvā sa rājarṣiḥ sadāraḥ prāviśadvanam
verses.translation: This is an oft-quoted verse.
verses.hindi: बुद्धिमान् ब्रह्माके बाल शीर्ण हो गये। वे शीर्ण बाल पुनः ऊपर उठ गये और उन्होंने प्रभुको अवरुद्ध कर
verses.wordMeaning: This is an oft-quoted verse.
verses.commentary: Sense: This is an oft-quoted verse.

verses.sanskrit: भृगुतुङ्गे तपस्तप्त्वा तत्रैव च महायशाः साधयित्वा त्वनशनं सदारः स्वर्गमाप्तवान्
verses.transliteration: bhṛgutuṅge tapastaptvā tatraiva ca mahāyaśāḥ sādhayitvā tvanaśanaṃ sadāraḥ svargamāptavān
verses.translation: This is an oft-quoted verse.
verses.hindi: दिया। वे बाल सिरसे हीन हो गये थे, इसलिये नीचेको
verses.wordMeaning: This is an oft-quoted verse.
verses.commentary: Sense: This is an oft-quoted verse.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य वंशास्तु पञ्चैते पुण्या देवर्षिसत्कृताः यैर्व्याप्ता पृथिवी कृत्स्ना सूर्यस्येव मरीचिभिः
verses.transliteration: tasya vaṃśāstu pañcaite puṇyā devarṣisatkṛtāḥ yairvyāptā pṛthivī kṛtsnā sūryasyeva marīcibhiḥ
verses.translation: This is an oft-quoted verse.
verses.hindi: ओर अपसर्पण करनेवाले हो गये; वे बाल व्यालस्वरूप कहे गये। बे हीन होनेके कारण ' अहि', गिरनेके कारण
verses.wordMeaning: This is an oft-quoted verse.
verses.commentary: Sense: This is an oft-quoted verse.

verses.sanskrit: धनी प्रजावान् आयुष्मान् कीर्तिमांश् च भवेन्नरः ययातिचरितं पुण्यं पठञ्छृण्वंश् च बुद्धिमान्
verses.transliteration: dhanī prajāvān āyuṣmān kīrtimāṃś ca bhavennaraḥ yayāticaritaṃ puṇyaṃ paṭhañchṛṇvaṃś ca buddhimān
verses.translation: This is an oft-quoted verse.
verses.hindi: 'पन्नग' और अपसर्पण करनेके कारण 'सर्प' कहे गये
verses.wordMeaning: This is an oft-quoted verse.
verses.commentary: Sense: This is an oft-quoted verse.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तः शिवलोके महीयते
verses.transliteration: sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ śivaloke mahīyate
verses.translation: This is an oft-quoted verse.
verses.hindi: हैं। उनके क्रोधसे उत्पन्न जो महाभयंकर विषमय अग्निगर्भ था, वह साथमें उत्पन्न हुए सर्पोमें प्रविष्ट हो
verses.wordMeaning: This is an oft-quoted verse.
verses.commentary: Sense: This is an oft-quoted verse.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीलिङ्गमहापुराणे पूर्वभागे सोमवंशे ययातिचरितं नाम सप्तषष्टितमो ऽध्यायः यदोर्वंशं प्रवक्ष्यामि ज्येष्ठस्योत्तमतेजसः संक्षेपेणानुपूर्व्याच्च गदतो मे निबोधत
verses.transliteration: iti śrīliṅgamahāpurāṇe pūrvabhāge somavaṃśe yayāticaritaṃ nāma saptaṣaṣṭitamo 'dhyāyaḥ yadorvaṃśaṃ pravakṣyāmi jyeṣṭhasyottamatejasaḥ saṃkṣepeṇānupūrvyācca gadato me nibodhata
verses.translation: Yadu had five sons comparable to the sons of Devas. Sahasrajit was the eldest. The others were Kro§tu, Nila, Ajaka and Laghu.
verses.hindi: तब सर्पोको देखकर ब्रह्माजी क्रुद्ध हुए और उन्होंने क्रोधमय स्वरूपवालोंको उत्पन्न किया। वे कपिश वर्ण, अत्यन्त उग्र तथा मांसका भक्षण करनेवाले भूत थे। वे भूतत्वके कारण 'भूत' तथा मांसभक्षण
verses.wordMeaning: Yadu had five sons comparable to the sons of Devas. Sahasrajit was the eldest. The others were Kro§tu, Nila, Ajaka and Laghu.
verses.commentary: Sense: Yadu had five sons comparable to the sons of Devas. Sahasrajit was the eldest. The others were Kro§tu, Nila, Ajaka and Laghu.

verses.sanskrit: यदोः पुत्रा बभूवुर् हि पञ्च देवसुतोपमाः सहस्रजित्सुतो ज्येष्ठः क्रोष्टुर् नीलो ऽजको लघुः
verses.transliteration: yadoḥ putrā babhūvur hi pañca devasutopamāḥ sahasrajitsuto jyeṣṭhaḥ kroṣṭur nīlo 'jako laghuḥ
verses.translation: The king Satajit was the son of Sahasrajit. Satajit had three renowned sons.
verses.hindi: करनेके कारण “पिशाच' कहे गये हैं। प्रसन्नतापूर्वक गान करते हुए उन ब्रह्मासे गन्धर्व उत्पन्न हुए थे।  धयति'-यह धातु गान अर्थमें पढ़ी जाती है; वे वाणीका गान करते हुए उत्पन्न हुए, इसलिये ' गन्धर्व ' इन आठ देवयोनियोंको सृजित करनेके अनन्तर उन प्रभुने स्वच्छन्दतापूर्वक अपनी आयुसे अन्य पक्षियोंका सृजन किया। पुनः उन्होंने स्वच्छन्दतापूर्वक स्वेच्छासे विचरण करनेवाले पक्षियोंका सृजन किया। इस प्रकार
verses.wordMeaning: The king Satajit was the son of Sahasrajit. Satajit had three renowned sons.
verses.commentary: Sense: The king Satajit was the son of Sahasrajit. Satajit had three renowned sons.

verses.sanskrit: सहस्रजित्सुतस्तद्वच् छतजिन्नाम पार्थिवः सुताः शतजितः ख्यातास् त्रयः परमकीर्तयः
verses.transliteration: sahasrajitsutastadvac chatajinnāma pārthivaḥ sutāḥ śatajitaḥ khyātās trayaḥ paramakīrtayaḥ
verses.translation: They were Haihaya, Haya and the king Venuhaya. The successor of Haihaya was the well known Dharma.
verses.hindi: उन देवेशने पशुओंकी सृष्टि करके पक्षिसमुदायका भी सृजन किया था
verses.wordMeaning: They were Haihaya, Haya and the king Venuhaya. The successor of Haihaya was the well known Dharma.
verses.commentary: Sense: They were Haihaya, Haya and the king Venuhaya. The successor of Haihaya was the well known Dharma.

verses.sanskrit: हैहयश् च हयश्चैव राजा वेणुहयश् च यः हैहयस्य तु दायादो धर्म इत्यभिविश्रुतः
verses.transliteration: haihayaś ca hayaścaiva rājā veṇuhayaś ca yaḥ haihayasya tu dāyādo dharma ityabhiviśrutaḥ
verses.translation: O brahmins, his son was Dharmanetra. Kirti was the son of Dharmanetra and his son was Sailjaya.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्माने अपने मुखसे बकरियोंका तथा वक्ष (छाती)से भेड़ोंका सृजन किया। उन्होंने उदरसे तथा पार्श्वभागोंसे गायोंकी रचना की । उन्होंने अपने पैरोसे घोड़ों, हाथियों, गधों, आवयों, मृगों, ऊँटों और खच्चरोंका श्रीलिड्रमहापुराण
verses.wordMeaning: O brahmins, his son was Dharmanetra. Kirti was the son of Dharmanetra and his son was Sailjaya.
verses.commentary: Sense: O brahmins, his son was Dharmanetra. Kirti was the son of Dharmanetra and his son was Sailjaya.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य पुत्रो ऽभवद्विप्रा धर्मनेत्र इति श्रुतः धर्मनेत्रस्य कीर्तिस् तु संजयस् तस्य चात्मजः
verses.transliteration: tasya putro 'bhavadviprā dharmanetra iti śrutaḥ dharmanetrasya kīrtis tu saṃjayas tasya cātmajaḥ
verses.translation: The virtuous Mahisman was the heir and successor of Safijaya. The valorous BhadraiSrenya was the son of Mahisman.
verses.hindi: RR फफ फ फ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ़ क फ़ फ ऊ फ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ क फ़ फ फ फ फ फ फ फ फ़ फा फ़ फ फ फ फ फ फ फ फी फी फी मी फी फी की फी की की की फी फ फ फ फ फ फ फ फ़ फ फ़ झकपक
verses.wordMeaning: The virtuous Mahisman was the heir and successor of Safijaya. The valorous BhadraiSrenya was the son of Mahisman.
verses.commentary: Sense: The virtuous Mahisman was the heir and successor of Safijaya. The valorous BhadraiSrenya was the son of Mahisman.

verses.sanskrit: संजयस्य तु दायादो महिष्मान्नाम धार्मिकः आसीन् महिष्मतः पुत्रो भद्रश्रेण्यः प्रतापवान्
verses.transliteration: saṃjayasya tu dāyādo mahiṣmānnāma dhārmikaḥ āsīn mahiṣmataḥ putro bhadraśreṇyaḥ pratāpavān
verses.translation: Bhadrarenya's legal heir was the king named Durdama who had an intelligent son known as Dhanaka.
verses.hindi: सृजन किया; इसी प्रकार अन्य जातियाँ भी उनके रोमोंसे फल तथा मूलवाली औषधियाँ उत्पन्न हुई  इस प्रकार पशुओं तथा औषधियोंका सृजन करके पर यज्ञमें लग गये
verses.wordMeaning: Bhadrarenya's legal heir was the king named Durdama who had an intelligent son known as Dhanaka.
verses.commentary: Sense: Bhadrarenya's legal heir was the king named Durdama who had an intelligent son known as Dhanaka.

verses.sanskrit: भद्रश्रेण्यस्य दायादो दुर्दमो नाम पार्थिवः दुर्दमस्य सुतो धीमान् धनको नाम विश्रुतः
verses.transliteration: bhadraśreṇyasya dāyādo durdamo nāma pārthivaḥ durdamasya suto dhīmān dhanako nāma viśrutaḥ
verses.translation: The sons of Dhanaka were four and they were very popular. They were — Krtavirya, Krtagni, Krtavarma and Kftaujas. Arjuna was the son of Kytavirya. He was born with thousand arms and became the best of the lords of the seven islands.
verses.hindi: तथा गधे-इन्हेँ ग्राम्य पशु कहा गया है। नरमेध पशुत्वको कल्पनाके कारण मनुष्यको पशुकोटिमे माना गया है अब जंगली पशुओंको जान लीजिये। श्वापद
verses.wordMeaning: The sons of Dhanaka were four and they were very popular. They were — Krtavirya, Krtagni, Krtavarma and Kftaujas. Arjuna was the son of Kytavirya. He was born with thousand arms and became the best of the lords of the seven islands.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sons of Dhanaka were four and they were very popular. They were — Krtavirya, Krtagni, Krtavarma and Kftaujas. Arjuna was the son of Kytavirya. He was born with thousand arms and became the best of the lords of the seven islands.

verses.sanskrit: धनकस्य तु दायादाश् चत्वारो लोकसंमताः कृतवीर्यः कृताग्निश् च कृतवर्मा तथैव च
verses.transliteration: dhanakasya tu dāyādāś catvāro lokasaṃmatāḥ kṛtavīryaḥ kṛtāgniś ca kṛtavarmā tathaiva ca
verses.translation: Rama who was identical with Nariyana was the cause of his death. He had a hundred sons. Five of them were great heroes. They were strong, heroic, virtuous and learned. They had good practice in the use of all missiles. They were Sura, Silrsena, Dhrta, Kfna and Jayadhvaja the king of Avanti. Jayadhvaja's son Talajangha was very powerful.
verses.hindi: ये जंगली पशु हैं। इनके अतिरिक्त महिष, गवय, हिरण, कहे गये हैं॥ २४०--२४२॥
verses.wordMeaning: Rama who was identical with Nariyana was the cause of his death. He had a hundred sons. Five of them were great heroes. They were strong, heroic, virtuous and learned. They had good practice in the use of all missiles. They were Sura, Silrsena, Dhrta,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Rama who was identical with Nariyana was the cause of his death. He had a hundred sons. Five of them were great heroes. They were strong, heroic, virtuous and learned. They had good practice in the use of all missiles. They were Sura, Silrsena, Dhrta,…

verses.sanskrit: कृतौजाश् च चतुर्थो ऽभूत् कार्तवीर्यस्ततो ऽर्जुनः जज्ञे बाहुसहस्रेण सप्तद्वीपेश्वरोत्तमः
verses.transliteration: kṛtaujāś ca caturtho 'bhūt kārtavīryastato 'rjunaḥ jajñe bāhusahasreṇa saptadvīpeśvarottamaḥ
verses.translation: He had a hundred sons. They were known as Tala- janghas. The eldest of them the powerful Vitihotra was the ruler.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्माने अपने प्रथम (पूर्व) मुखसे गायत्री
verses.wordMeaning: He had a hundred sons. They were known as Tala- janghas. The eldest of them the powerful Vitihotra was the ruler.
verses.commentary: Sense: He had a hundred sons. They were known as Tala- janghas. The eldest of them the powerful Vitihotra was the ruler.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य रामस् तदा त्वासीन् मृत्युर्नारायणात्मकः तस्य पुत्रशतान्यासन् पञ्च तत्र महारथाः
verses.transliteration: tasya rāmas tadā tvāsīn mṛtyurnārāyaṇātmakaḥ tasya putraśatānyāsan pañca tatra mahārathāḥ
verses.translation: Vf?a and others too were his sons of meritorious deeds. Vr$a was the founder of a dynasty. His son was Madhu.
verses.hindi: तथा यज्ञोंमें मुख्य अग्निष्टोमकी रचना की। उन्होंने दक्षिण मुखसे यजुर्वेद, त्रिष्टुप् छन्द, पंचदशावृत्त साम, बृहत्साम तथा उक्थ्यकी रचना की। उन्होंने पश्चिम मुखसे साम, जगतीछन्द, सप्तदशावृत्त स्तोम, वैरूपसाम तथा अतिरात्रयञ्चकी रचना की। उन्होंने उत्तर मुखसे इक्कीस अथर्व प्रार्थना-मन्त्रो, आप्तोर्यामाण, अनुष्टुप्
verses.wordMeaning: Vf?a and others too were his sons of meritorious deeds. Vr$a was the founder of a dynasty. His son was Madhu.
verses.commentary: Sense: Vf?a and others too were his sons of meritorious deeds. Vr$a was the founder of a dynasty. His son was Madhu.

verses.sanskrit: कृतास्त्रा बलिनः शूरा धर्मात्मानो मनस्विनः शूरश् च शूरसेनश् च धृष्टः कृष्णस्तथैव च
verses.transliteration: kṛtāstrā balinaḥ śūrā dharmātmāno manasvinaḥ śūraś ca śūrasenaś ca dhṛṣṭaḥ kṛṣṇastathaiva ca
verses.translation: Madhu had hundred sons and V|*?ni the eldest was the founder of a dynasty. Vr?9i*s descendants were also called Vftikis and those of Madhu are known as Mdhavas.
verses.hindi: कल्पके आरम्भमें विद्युत्, वज्र, मेघों, रोहित वर्णवाले  तथा तेजोंकी रचना की। प्रजाओंकी सृष्टि करते हुए उन प्रजापति ब्रह्माके अंगोंसे उच्च तथा निम्न भूत (प्राणी) उत्पन्न हुए॥ २४३--२४८॥
verses.wordMeaning: Madhu had hundred sons and V|*?ni the eldest was the founder of a dynasty. Vr?9i*s descendants were also called Vftikis and those of Madhu are known as Mdhavas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Madhu had hundred sons and V|*?ni the eldest was the founder of a dynasty. Vr?9i*s descendants were also called Vftikis and those of Madhu are known as Mdhavas.

verses.sanskrit: जयध्वजश् च राजासीद् आवन्तीनां विशां पतिः जयध्वजस्य पुत्रो ऽभूत् तालजङ्घो महाबलः
verses.transliteration: jayadhvajaś ca rājāsīd āvantīnāṃ viśāṃ patiḥ jayadhvajasya putro 'bhūt tālajaṅgho mahābalaḥ
verses.translation: Sura and Suravira were the pious descendants of Sura- sena. The land of these noble souls is known as Surasenas.
verses.hindi: पहले देवता, असुर, मनुष्य तथा पितर--ईन चारोंकी सृष्टि करके उन्होंने स्थावर तथा जंगम भूतोंका सर्पो तथा अव्यय एवं व्यय; जो भी स्थावर-जंगम हैं: उन सबका सृजन किया। पूर्व सृष्टिमें उनके जो कर्म थे, बार-बार सृजित किये जाते हुए वे प्राणी उन्ह कर्मोको प्राप्त करते हैं। वे अपने लिये अनुकूल हिंसा
verses.wordMeaning: Sura and Suravira were the pious descendants of Sura- sena. The land of these noble souls is known as Surasenas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sura and Suravira were the pious descendants of Sura- sena. The land of these noble souls is known as Surasenas.

verses.sanskrit: शतं पुत्रास्तु तस्येह तालजङ्घाः प्रकीर्तिताः तेषां ज्येष्ठो महावीर्यो वीतिहोत्रो ऽभवन्नृपः
verses.transliteration: śataṃ putrāstu tasyeha tālajaṅghāḥ prakīrtitāḥ teṣāṃ jyeṣṭho mahāvīryo vītihotro 'bhavannṛpaḥ
verses.translation: The son of Vitihotra was the well known Narta. Dur- jaya the son of Kr$na was a destroyer of his enemies.
verses.hindi: अहिंसा, मृदुता-क्रूरता, धर्म-अधर्म तथा मिथ्या”
verses.wordMeaning: The son of Vitihotra was the well known Narta. Dur- jaya the son of Kr$na was a destroyer of his enemies.
verses.commentary: Sense: The son of Vitihotra was the well known Narta. Dur- jaya the son of Kr$na was a destroyer of his enemies.

verses.sanskrit: वृषप्रभृतयश्चान्ये तत्सुताः पुण्यकर्मणः वृषो वंशकरस्तेषां तस्य पुत्रो ऽभवन्मधुः
verses.transliteration: vṛṣaprabhṛtayaścānye tatsutāḥ puṇyakarmaṇaḥ vṛṣo vaṃśakarasteṣāṃ tasya putro 'bhavanmadhuḥ
verses.translation: Listen to the race of the saintly king Krotu. It con- sisted of excellent men. Visu the scion of the family of Vsni was born of this race.
verses.hindi: आदकाः पशवः षष्ठाः सप्तमास्तु सरीसृपाः २४१ महिषा गवयाक्षाश्च प्लवङ्गाः शरभा वृकाः।
verses.wordMeaning: Listen to the race of the saintly king Krotu. It con- sisted of excellent men. Visu the scion of the family of Vsni was born of this race.
verses.commentary: Sense: Listen to the race of the saintly king Krotu. It con- sisted of excellent men. Visu the scion of the family of Vsni was born of this race.

verses.sanskrit: मधोः पुत्रशतं चासीद् वृष्णिस्तस्य तु वंशभाक् वृष्णेस्तु वृष्णयः सर्वे मधोर्वै माधवाः स्मृताः यादवा यदुवंशेन निरुच्यन्ते तु हैहयाः
verses.transliteration: madhoḥ putraśataṃ cāsīd vṛṣṇistasya tu vaṃśabhāk vṛṣṇestu vṛṣṇayaḥ sarve madhorvai mādhavāḥ smṛtāḥ yādavā yaduvaṃśena nirucyante tu haihayāḥ
verses.translation: Krostu had a son of great renown named Vrjini van. His son was Svati and KuiSanku was his son.
verses.hindi: अग्निष्टोमं च यज्ञानां निर्ममे प्रथमान्मुखात्
verses.wordMeaning: Krostu had a son of great renown named Vrjini van. His son was Svati and KuiSanku was his son.
verses.commentary: Sense: Krostu had a son of great renown named Vrjini van. His son was Svati and KuiSanku was his son.

verses.sanskrit: तेषां पञ्च गणा ह्येते हैहयानां महात्मनाम्
verses.transliteration: teṣāṃ pañca gaṇā hyete haihayānāṃ mahātmanām
verses.translation: Desirous of progeny, the extremely powerful king Kusanku performed great sacrifices of various kinds with the requisite gifts.
verses.hindi: तेजांसि च ससर्जादौ कल्पस्य भगवान् प्रभुः ब्रह्मणस्तु प्रजासर्ग सृजतो हि प्रजापतेः
verses.wordMeaning: Desirous of progeny, the extremely powerful king Kusanku performed great sacrifices of various kinds with the requisite gifts.
verses.commentary: Sense: Desirous of progeny, the extremely powerful king Kusanku performed great sacrifices of various kinds with the requisite gifts.

verses.sanskrit: वीतिहोत्राश् च हर्याता भोजाश्चावन्तयस् तथा शूरसेनास्तु विख्यातास् तालजङ्घास्तथैव च
verses.transliteration: vītihotrāś ca haryātā bhojāścāvantayas tathā śūrasenāstu vikhyātās tālajaṅghāstathaiva ca
verses.translation: Citraratha his son did glorious deeds. The heroic son of Citraratha was king Saabindu who performed sacrifices giving large sums as gifts. He observed excellent holy rites, and was an Emperor of great strength and valour over a large num- ber of subjects.
verses.hindi: सृष्ट्वा चतुष्टयं पूर्व देवासुरनरान् पितृन्। ततोऽसृजत्स भूतानि स्थावराणि चराणि च
verses.wordMeaning: Citraratha his son did glorious deeds. The heroic son of Citraratha was king Saabindu who performed sacrifices giving large sums as gifts. He observed excellent holy rites, and was an Emperor of great strength and valour over a large num- ber of subjects.
verses.commentary: Sense: Citraratha his son did glorious deeds. The heroic son of Citraratha was king Saabindu who performed sacrifices giving large sums as gifts. He observed excellent holy rites, and was an Emperor of great strength and valour over a large num- ber of subjects.

verses.sanskrit: शूरश् च शूरसेनश् च वृषः कृष्णस्तथैव च जयध्वजः पञ्चमस्तु विख्याता हैहयोत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: śūraś ca śūrasenaś ca vṛṣaḥ kṛṣṇastathaiva ca jayadhvajaḥ pañcamastu vikhyātā haihayottamāḥ
verses.translation: Saabindu had twenty thousand sons. They specifically praise Anantaka as the most excellent of all of them.
verses.hindi: तेषां वै यानि कर्माणि प्राक्सृष्ट्यां प्रतिपेदिरि॥ २५ १ हिंस्राहिंस्रे मृदुक्रूरे धर्माधर्मे नृतानृते
verses.wordMeaning: Saabindu had twenty thousand sons. They specifically praise Anantaka as the most excellent of all of them.
verses.commentary: Sense: Saabindu had twenty thousand sons. They specifically praise Anantaka as the most excellent of all of them.

verses.sanskrit: शूरश् च शूरवीरश् च शूरसेनस्य चानघाः शूरसेना इति ख्याता देशास्तेषां महात्मनाम्
verses.transliteration: śūraś ca śūravīraś ca śūrasenasya cānaghāḥ śūrasenā iti khyātā deśāsteṣāṃ mahātmanām
verses.translation: The son Yajfia was born to Anantaka. Yajfia's son was Dhrti. His son was Uanas. That most virtuous king after obtaining the kingdom, performed a hundred horse sacrifices. The king named Siteu is known as the son of Uianas.
verses.hindi: अध्याय ७० महेश्वरसे होनेवाली आदिसृष्टिका स्वरूप““सतीकी देहसे अनेक देवियोंका प्रादुर्भाव ३२५
verses.wordMeaning: The son Yajfia was born to Anantaka. Yajfia's son was Dhrti. His son was Uanas. That most virtuous king after obtaining the kingdom, performed a hundred horse sacrifices. The king named Siteu is known as the son of Uianas.
verses.commentary: Sense: The son Yajfia was born to Anantaka. Yajfia's son was Dhrti. His son was Uanas. That most virtuous king after obtaining the kingdom, performed a hundred horse sacrifices. The king named Siteu is known as the son of Uianas.

verses.sanskrit: वीतिहोत्रसुतश्चापि विश्रुतो नर्त इत्युत दुर्जयः कृष्णपुत्रस्तु बभूवामित्रकर्शनः
verses.transliteration: vītihotrasutaścāpi viśruto narta ityuta durjayaḥ kṛṣṇaputrastu babhūvāmitrakarśanaḥ
verses.translation: Marutta, the saintly king who made his family flourish, was his son. The heroic Kambalabarhis was the son of Marutta.
verses.hindi: तद्धाविताः प्रपद्यन्ते तस्मात्तत्तस्य रोचते। होते हैं; इसीलिये वे उनमें आनन्दका अनुभव महाभूतेषु सृष्टेषु इन्द्रियार्थेषु मूर्तिषु॥ २५३  करते हैं। महाभूतों, इन्द्रिय-विषयों तथा उनके स्वरूपोंकी सृष्टि हो जानेपर स्रष्टाने स्वयं उन भूतोंका विनियोग कुछ लोग होनेवाली घटनाओंका कारण पुरुषार्थको बताते हैं तथा कुछ श्रेष्ठ मनुष्य कर्मको उसका कारण बताते हैं । है विप्रो! अन्य लोग हैव (भाग्य)-को और कुछ तत्त्वचिन्तक स्वभावको उसका कारण बताते हैं। इस
verses.wordMeaning: Marutta, the saintly king who made his family flourish, was his son. The heroic Kambalabarhis was the son of Marutta.
verses.commentary: Sense: Marutta, the saintly king who made his family flourish, was his son. The heroic Kambalabarhis was the son of Marutta.

verses.sanskrit: क्रोष्टुश् च शृणु राजर्षेर् वंशमुत्तमपौरुषम् यस्यान्वये तु सम्भूतो विष्णुर् वृष्णिकुलोद्वहः
verses.transliteration: kroṣṭuś ca śṛṇu rājarṣer vaṃśamuttamapauruṣam yasyānvaye tu sambhūto viṣṇur vṛṣṇikulodvahaḥ
verses.translation: Rukmakavaca, a learned king was the son of Kambalabarhis. This Rukmakavaca had killed in battle many heroic archers wearing coats of mail with sharp arrows and attained great glory. The pious soul gave land to the Btviks (Brahmins oflBciating) in the Horse-sacrifice.
verses.hindi: प्रकार पुरुषार्थ, कर्म, हैव तथा स्वभावको कारण माना गया है। कर्ममार्गका अनुसरण करनेवाले जीव जगतूकी विषमताके प्रति पूर्वोक्त चार कारणोंमेंसे किसी एकको कारण न मानकर उनके समुच्चयको कारण मानते हैं; क्योंकि वे इन
verses.wordMeaning: Rukmakavaca, a learned king was the son of Kambalabarhis. This Rukmakavaca had killed in battle many heroic archers wearing coats of mail with sharp arrows and attained great glory. The pious soul gave land to the Btviks (Brahmins oflBciating) in the Horse-sacrifice.
verses.commentary: Sense: Rukmakavaca, a learned king was the son of Kambalabarhis. This Rukmakavaca had killed in battle many heroic archers wearing coats of mail with sharp arrows and attained great glory. The pious soul gave land to the Btviks (Brahmins oflBciating) in the Horse-sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit: क्रोष्टोरेको ऽभवत्पुत्रो वृजिनीवान्महायशाः तस्य पुत्रो ऽभवत् स्वाती कुशङ्कुस् तत्सुतो ऽभवत्
verses.transliteration: kroṣṭoreko 'bhavatputro vṛjinīvānmahāyaśāḥ tasya putro 'bhavat svātī kuśaṅkus tatsuto 'bhavat
verses.translation: Paravrt, the slayer of heroic enemies, was bom of Rukmakavaca. Five sons of great strength were bom to PafSvrt«
verses.hindi: चारोंसे भी परे सकलनियन्ता महेश्वरको नहीं जानते हैं। सत्त्वगुणमें स्थित समदर्शी लोग जगतूके मायामय होनेके कारण पूर्वोक्त कारणचतुष्टयोंमेंसे नामभेदके रूपमें न तो किसी एकको और न किन्हीं दोको कारण मानते हैं॥ २५४-- उन ब्रह्मरूपी महेश्वरने पूर्वकल्पके भूतोंके नाम, रूप तथा प्रपंचको सर्गके आदिमें वेदके शब्दोंसे ही निर्मित किया। ब्रह्माजी रात्रिके अन्तमें (प्रलय समाप्त होनेपर) उत्पन्न ऋषियोंके नाम एवं उनकी जो वृत्तियाँ
verses.wordMeaning: Paravrt, the slayer of heroic enemies, was bom of Rukmakavaca. Five sons of great strength were bom to PafSvrt«
verses.commentary: Sense: Paravrt, the slayer of heroic enemies, was bom of Rukmakavaca. Five sons of great strength were bom to PafSvrt«

verses.sanskrit: अथ प्रसूतिमिच्छन्वै कुशङ्कुः सुमहाबलः महाक्रतुभिर् ईजे ऽसौ विविधैराप्तदक्षिणैः
verses.transliteration: atha prasūtimicchanvai kuśaṅkuḥ sumahābalaḥ mahākratubhir īje 'sau vividhairāptadakṣiṇaiḥ
verses.translation: They were Rukmesu, Prthurukma, Jyamagha, Parigha and Hari. The father fixed Parigha and Hari in Videha.
verses.hindi: वेदोंमें हैं, उन सबको उन्हें प्रदान करते हैं। अव्यक्तसे जन्म लेनेवाले ब्रह्माकी इस प्रकारकी सृष्टियाँ होती हैं। ब्रह्माकी रात्रिके अन्तमें मानसी सिद्धिका आश्रय लेकर सृजित किये गये इस प्रकारके स्थावर-जंगम प्राणी दिखायी
verses.wordMeaning: They were Rukmesu, Prthurukma, Jyamagha, Parigha and Hari. The father fixed Parigha and Hari in Videha.
verses.commentary: Sense: They were Rukmesu, Prthurukma, Jyamagha, Parigha and Hari. The father fixed Parigha and Hari in Videha.

verses.sanskrit: जज्ञे चित्ररथस्तस्य पुत्रः कर्मभिर् अन्वितः अथ चैत्ररथो वीरो यज्वा विपुलदक्षिणः
verses.transliteration: jajñe citrarathastasya putraḥ karmabhir anvitaḥ atha caitraratho vīro yajvā vipuladakṣiṇaḥ
verses.translation: Rukmesu became the king and Prthurukma was depen- dent on him. Compelled by them, king Jyamagha abdicated the throne and stayed in the hermitage.
verses.hindi: देते हैं॥ २५७--२६०॥ हे सत्तमो  जब उनकी वे सृजित प्रजाएँ वृद्धिको प्राप्त नहीं हुई; तब तमोमात्रासे आवृत ब्रह्मा शोकसे दुःखित हो उठे। इसके बाद उन्होंने अर्थका निश्चय करनेवाली बुद्धिको धारण किया और सत्त्व तथा रजोगुणोंका परित्याग
verses.wordMeaning: Rukmesu became the king and Prthurukma was depen- dent on him. Compelled by them, king Jyamagha abdicated the throne and stayed in the hermitage.
verses.commentary: Sense: Rukmesu became the king and Prthurukma was depen- dent on him. Compelled by them, king Jyamagha abdicated the throne and stayed in the hermitage.

verses.sanskrit: शशबिन्दुस् तु वै राजा अन्वयाद् व्रतम् उत्तमम् चक्रवर्ती महासत्त्वो महावीर्यो बहुप्रजाः
verses.transliteration: śaśabindus tu vai rājā anvayād vratam uttamam cakravartī mahāsattvo mahāvīryo bahuprajāḥ
verses.translation: He remained quiescent while he stayed in the forest. He received enlightenment from the brahmins. Then he took up his bow and went to another land in his chariot decorated with flags. He went to the Narmada' river accompanied by his wife. He went to the mountain Rksavan®® and passed his days.
verses.hindi: करके अपने धर्मसे वर्तमान नियामिका तमोमात्राको अपने अन्दर देखा। तब वे जगत्पति उस दुःखसे बहुत दुःखित हुए
verses.wordMeaning: He remained quiescent while he stayed in the forest. He received enlightenment from the brahmins. Then he took up his bow and went to another land in his chariot decorated with flags. He went to the Narmada' river accompanied by his wife.…
verses.commentary: Sense: He remained quiescent while he stayed in the forest. He received enlightenment from the brahmins. Then he took up his bow and went to another land in his chariot decorated with flags. He went to the Narmada' river accompanied by his wife.…

verses.sanskrit: शशबिन्दोस्तु पुत्राणां सहस्राणामभूच्छतम् शंसन्ति तस्य पुत्राणाम् अनन्तकम् अनुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: śaśabindostu putrāṇāṃ sahasrāṇāmabhūcchatam śaṃsanti tasya putrāṇām anantakam anuttamam
verses.translation: iSaibya the chaste woman of good conduct was the wife of Jyamagha. After observing severe penance that fortu- nate lady, in her advanced age, gave birth to Sruta and Vidar- bha. King Sruta had no son. Two scholarly sons Kratha and Kaiika were born to Vidarbha. They were heroic and very efficient in battle. A third son was Romapada and Babhru was his son.
verses.hindi: तदनन्तर उन्होंने तमोगुणको प्रेरित किया; उस तमने रज तथा सत्त्वको आवृत किया। इस प्रकार प्रेरित केचित्पुरुषकारं तु प्राहुः कर्म सुमानवाः
verses.wordMeaning: iSaibya the chaste woman of good conduct was the wife of Jyamagha. After observing severe penance that fortu- nate lady, in her advanced age, gave birth to Sruta and Vidar- bha. King Sruta had no son. Two scholarly sons Kratha and Kaiika were born to Vidarbha.…
verses.commentary: Sense: iSaibya the chaste woman of good conduct was the wife of Jyamagha. After observing severe penance that fortu- nate lady, in her advanced age, gave birth to Sruta and Vidar- bha. King Sruta had no son. Two scholarly sons Kratha and Kaiika were born to Vidarbha.…

verses.sanskrit: अनन्तकात् सुतो यज्ञो यज्ञस्य तनयो धृतिः उशनास्तस्य तनयः सम्प्राप्य तु महीमिमाम्
verses.transliteration: anantakāt suto yajño yajñasya tanayo dhṛtiḥ uśanāstasya tanayaḥ samprāpya tu mahīmimām
verses.translation: Sudhrti a learned and very pious king was his son. His son was Kuika who was the originator of the family of Caidya.
verses.hindi: हैवमित्यपरे विप्राः स्वभावं भूतचिन्तकाः। पौरुषं कर्म हैवं च फलवृत्तिस्वभावतः
verses.wordMeaning: Sudhrti a learned and very pious king was his son. His son was Kuika who was the originator of the family of Caidya.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sudhrti a learned and very pious king was his son. His son was Kuika who was the originator of the family of Caidya.

verses.sanskrit: आजहाराश्वमेधानां शतमुत्तमधार्मिकः स्मृतश्चोशनसः पुत्रः सितेषुर् नाम पार्थिवः
verses.transliteration: ājahārāśvamedhānāṃ śatamuttamadhārmikaḥ smṛtaścośanasaḥ putraḥ siteṣur nāma pārthivaḥ
verses.translation: Kratha was the son of Vidarbha. His son was Kunti. Kunti's son was Vrta and from him was born the valo- rous Ranadhrsta. His son Nidhrti was a slayer of enemies. The son of Nidhrti was Dasarha, the destroyer of his foes.
verses.hindi: एतदेवं च नैकं च नामभेदेन नाप्युभे कर्मस्था विषमं ब्रूयुः सत्त्वस्थाः समदर्शनाः । नाम रूपं च भूतानां कृतानां च प्रपञ्चनम्
verses.wordMeaning: Kratha was the son of Vidarbha. His son was Kunti. Kunti's son was Vrta and from him was born the valo- rous Ranadhrsta. His son Nidhrti was a slayer of enemies. The son of Nidhrti was Dasarha, the destroyer of his foes.
verses.commentary: Sense: Kratha was the son of Vidarbha. His son was Kunti. Kunti's son was Vrta and from him was born the valo- rous Ranadhrsta. His son Nidhrti was a slayer of enemies. The son of Nidhrti was Dasarha, the destroyer of his foes.

verses.sanskrit: मरुतस्तस्य तनयो राजर्षिर्वंशवर्धनः वीरः कम्बलबर्हिस्तु मरुस्तस्यात्मजः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: marutastasya tanayo rājarṣirvaṃśavardhanaḥ vīraḥ kambalabarhistu marustasyātmajaḥ smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: Vyapta was the son of Dasarha, and Jimuta his son. Vikrti was the son of Jimuta. His son was Bhimaratha.
verses.hindi: एवंविधाः सृष्टयस्तु ब्रह्मणोऽव्यक्तजन्मनः
verses.wordMeaning: Vyapta was the son of Dasarha, and Jimuta his son. Vikrti was the son of Jimuta. His son was Bhimaratha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Vyapta was the son of Dasarha, and Jimuta his son. Vikrti was the son of Jimuta. His son was Bhimaratha.

verses.sanskrit: पुत्रस्तु रुक्मकवचो विद्वान् कम्बलबर्हिषः निहत्य रुक्मकवचो वीरान् कवचिनो रणे
verses.transliteration: putrastu rukmakavaco vidvān kambalabarhiṣaḥ nihatya rukmakavaco vīrān kavacino raṇe
verses.translation: Navaratha was the son of Bhimaratha. He was per- petually engaged in charitable gifts and holy rites. He was devoted to truthfulness and good conduct.
verses.hindi: तमोमात्रावृतो ब्रह्मा तदा शोकेन दुःखितः अथात्मनि समद्राक्षीत्तमोमात्रां नियामिकाम्
verses.wordMeaning: Navaratha was the son of Bhimaratha. He was per- petually engaged in charitable gifts and holy rites. He was devoted to truthfulness and good conduct.
verses.commentary: Sense: Navaratha was the son of Bhimaratha. He was per- petually engaged in charitable gifts and holy rites. He was devoted to truthfulness and good conduct.

verses.sanskrit: धन्विनो निशितैर् बाणैर् अवाप श्रियमुत्तमाम् अश्वमेधे तु धर्मात्मा ऋत्विग्भ्यः पृथिवीं ददौ
verses.transliteration: dhanvino niśitair bāṇair avāpa śriyamuttamām aśvamedhe tu dharmātmā ṛtvigbhyaḥ pṛthivīṃ dadau
verses.translation: His son was Dfdharatha. Sakuni was his son. Karam- bha was born of him. Devarata was his son.
verses.hindi: रजः सत्त्वं परित्यज्य वर्तमानां स्वधर्मतः । ततः स तेन दुःखेन दुःखं चक्रे जगत्पतिः
verses.wordMeaning: His son was Dfdharatha. Sakuni was his son. Karam- bha was born of him. Devarata was his son.
verses.commentary: Sense: His son was Dfdharatha. Sakuni was his son. Karam- bha was born of him. Devarata was his son.

verses.sanskrit: जज्ञे तु रुक्मकवचात् परावृत्परवीरहा जज्ञिरे पञ्च पुत्रास्तु महासत्त्वाः परावृतः
verses.transliteration: jajñe tu rukmakavacāt parāvṛtparavīrahā jajñire pañca putrāstu mahāsattvāḥ parāvṛtaḥ
verses.translation: From Devarata was born king Devarati of great re- nown. He was equal to the son of Devas. From him was born Devaksatra.
verses.hindi: फमकभकककककककककककझफझझभभ्रकरभझझभझकभझभभझझमझमकमम कक फ फ़ क फ़ फ़ फ फ़ फ फ फ़ फ फ़ फ फ फ फ़ फ फफ फ फ फक काकी फो की की फी फक्रफफ्फफकफ्रकफफफ्फफफकफफफफफफफफफफफफफ नी अधर्मस्तमसो जज्ञे हिंसाशोकादजायत। ततस्तस्मिन् समुद्धूते मिथुने दारुणात्मिके

verses.sanskrit: रुक्मेषुः पृथुरुक्मश् च ज्यामघः परिघो हरिः परिघं च हरिं चैव विदेहेषु पिता न्यसत्
