verses.sanskrit: रुक्मेषुरभवद्राजा पृथुरुक्मस्तदाश्रयात् तैस्तु प्रव्राजितो राजा ज्यामघो ऽवसदाश्रमे
verses.transliteration: rukmeṣurabhavadrājā pṛthurukmastadāśrayāt taistu pravrājito rājā jyāmagho 'vasadāśrame
verses.translation: Devaksatra's son was Madhu of great renown. He was the founder of the line of Madhus. From Madhu was born Kuruvariiaka.
verses.hindi: प्रकृतिं भूतधात्रीं तां कामाद्वै सृष्टवान् प्रभुः । सा दिवं पृथिवीं चैव महिम्ना व्याप्यधिष्ठिता ब्रह्मणः सा तनुः पूर्वा दिवमावृत्य तिष्ठति।
verses.wordMeaning: Devaksatra's son was Madhu of great renown. He was the founder of the line of Madhus. From Madhu was born Kuruvariiaka.
verses.commentary: Sense: Devaksatra's son was Madhu of great renown. He was the founder of the line of Madhus. From Madhu was born Kuruvariiaka.

verses.sanskrit: प्रशान्तः स वनस्थो ऽपि ब्राह्मणैरेव बोधितः जगाम धनुरादाय देशमन्यं ध्वजी रथी
verses.transliteration: praśāntaḥ sa vanastho 'pi brāhmaṇaireva bodhitaḥ jagāma dhanurādāya deśamanyaṃ dhvajī rathī
verses.translation: After Kuruvama was Anu and from him was born Purutvan, the best among men. From him Aihsu was born to queen Bhadravati of Vidarbha.
verses.hindi: सा देवी नियुतं तप्त्वा तपः परमदुश्चरम्।
verses.wordMeaning: After Kuruvama was Anu and from him was born Purutvan, the best among men. From him Aihsu was born to queen Bhadravati of Vidarbha.
verses.commentary: Sense: After Kuruvama was Anu and from him was born Purutvan, the best among men. From him Aihsu was born to queen Bhadravati of Vidarbha.

verses.sanskrit: नर्मदातीरमेकाकी केवलं भार्यया युतः ऋक्षवन्तं गिरिं गत्वा त्यक्तमन्यैरुवास सः
verses.transliteration: narmadātīramekākī kevalaṃ bhāryayā yutaḥ ṛkṣavantaṃ giriṃ gatvā tyaktamanyairuvāsa saḥ
verses.translation: After Kuruvama was Anu and from him was born Purutvan, the best among men. From him Aihsu was born to queen Bhadravati of Vidarbha.
verses.hindi: विराजमसृजद् ब्रह्मा सोऽभवत्पुरुषो विराट् वैराजात्पुरुषाद्वीराच्छतरूपा व्यजायत। प्रियव्रतोत्तानपादौ पुत्रौ द्वौ लोकसम्मतौ
verses.wordMeaning: After Kuruvama was Anu and from him was born Purutvan, the best among men. From him Aihsu was born to queen Bhadravati of Vidarbha.
verses.commentary: Sense: After Kuruvama was Anu and from him was born Purutvan, the best among men. From him Aihsu was born to queen Bhadravati of Vidarbha.

verses.sanskrit: ज्यामघस्याभवद्भार्या शैब्या शीलवती सती सा चैव तपसोग्रेण शैब्या वै सम्प्रसूयत
verses.transliteration: jyāmaghasyābhavadbhāryā śaibyā śīlavatī satī sā caiva tapasogreṇa śaibyā vai samprasūyata
verses.translation: After Kuruvama was Anu and from him was born Purutvan, the best among men. From him Aihsu was born to queen Bhadravati of Vidarbha.
verses.hindi: कन्ये द्वे च महाभागे याभ्यां जाता इमाः प्रजाः।
verses.wordMeaning: After Kuruvama was Anu and from him was born Purutvan, the best among men. From him Aihsu was born to queen Bhadravati of Vidarbha.
verses.commentary: Sense: After Kuruvama was Anu and from him was born Purutvan, the best among men. From him Aihsu was born to queen Bhadravati of Vidarbha.

verses.sanskrit: सुतं विदर्भं सुभगा वयःपरिणता सती राजा पुत्रसुतायां तु विद्वांसौ क्रथकैशिकौ
verses.transliteration: sutaṃ vidarbhaṃ subhagā vayaḥpariṇatā satī rājā putrasutāyāṃ tu vidvāṃsau krathakaiśikau
verses.translation: After Kuruvama was Anu and from him was born Purutvan, the best among men. From him Aihsu was born to queen Bhadravati of Vidarbha.
verses.hindi: देवी नाम तथाकूतिः प्रसूतिश्चैव ते उभे हुआ वह तम ही दो रूपोंमें उत्पन्न हुआ
verses.wordMeaning: After Kuruvama was Anu and from him was born Purutvan, the best among men. From him Aihsu was born to queen Bhadravati of Vidarbha.
verses.commentary: Sense: After Kuruvama was Anu and from him was born Purutvan, the best among men. From him Aihsu was born to queen Bhadravati of Vidarbha.

verses.sanskrit: पुत्रौ विदर्भराजस्य शूरौ रणविशारदौ रोमपादस्तृतीयश् च बभ्रुस्तस्यात्मजः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: putrau vidarbharājasya śūrau raṇaviśāradau romapādastṛtīyaś ca babhrustasyātmajaḥ smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: After Kuruvama was Anu and from him was born Purutvan, the best among men. From him Aihsu was born to queen Bhadravati of Vidarbha.
verses.hindi: तमसे अधर्म उत्पन्न हुआ और शोकसे हिंसा उत्पन्न हुई। तब भयानक रूपवाले उस मिथुन ( अधर्म और हिंसा)-के प्रादुर्भूत होनेपर भगवान् ब्रह्मा प्राणहीन हो गये और प्रीतिने इनको सेवा की। इसके
verses.wordMeaning: After Kuruvama was Anu and from him was born Purutvan, the best among men. From him Aihsu was born to queen Bhadravati of Vidarbha.
verses.commentary: Sense: After Kuruvama was Anu and from him was born Purutvan, the best among men. From him Aihsu was born to queen Bhadravati of Vidarbha.

verses.sanskrit: सुधृतिस्तनयस्तस्य विद्वान्परमधार्मिकः कौशिकस्तनयस्तस्मात् तस्माच्चैद्यान्वयः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: sudhṛtistanayastasya vidvānparamadhārmikaḥ kauśikastanayastasmāt tasmāccaidyānvayaḥ smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: After Kuruvama was Anu and from him was born Purutvan, the best among men. From him Aihsu was born to queen Bhadravati of Vidarbha.
verses.hindi: बाद ब्रह्माने अपने उस दीप्त शरीरको अपोहित कर लिया। अपने देहको दो भागोंमें करके वे आधे शरीरसे पुरुष हो गये और उनके आधे शरीरसे नारी शतरूपा उत्पन्न हुईं। ब्रह्माने प्राणियोंकी धात्री उस प्रकृतिको कामनापूर्वक उत्पन्न किया था; वे अपनी महिमासे स्वर्ग तथा पृथ्वीको व्याप्त करके अधिष्ठित हैं। ब्रह्माका वह पूर्व शरीर स्वर्गको आवृत करके स्थित है। सृजन करनेवाले ब्रह्माके आधे शरीरसे जो नारी शतरूपा उत्पन्न
verses.wordMeaning: After Kuruvama was Anu and from him was born Purutvan, the best among men. From him Aihsu was born to queen Bhadravati of Vidarbha.
verses.commentary: Sense: After Kuruvama was Anu and from him was born Purutvan, the best among men. From him Aihsu was born to queen Bhadravati of Vidarbha.

verses.sanskrit: क्रथो विदर्भस्य सुतः कुन्तिस्तस्यात्मजो ऽभवत् कुन्तेर् वृतस्ततो जज्ञे रणधृष्टः प्रतापवान्
verses.transliteration: kratho vidarbhasya sutaḥ kuntistasyātmajo 'bhavat kunter vṛtastato jajñe raṇadhṛṣṭaḥ pratāpavān
verses.translation: After Kuruvama was Anu and from him was born Purutvan, the best among men. From him Aihsu was born to queen Bhadravati of Vidarbha.
verses.hindi: कठोर तप करके दीप्त यशवाले पुरुषको पतिरूपमें प्राप्त किया
verses.wordMeaning: After Kuruvama was Anu and from him was born Purutvan, the best among men. From him Aihsu was born to queen Bhadravati of Vidarbha.
verses.commentary: Sense: After Kuruvama was Anu and from him was born Purutvan, the best among men. From him Aihsu was born to queen Bhadravati of Vidarbha.

verses.sanskrit: रणधृष्टस्य च सुतो निधृतिः परवीरहा दशार्हो नैधृतो नाम्ना महारिगणसूदनः
verses.transliteration: raṇadhṛṣṭasya ca suto nidhṛtiḥ paravīrahā daśārho naidhṛto nāmnā mahārigaṇasūdanaḥ
verses.translation: After Kuruvama was Anu and from him was born Purutvan, the best among men. From him Aihsu was born to queen Bhadravati of Vidarbha.
verses.hindi: वे पूर्वपुरुष ही स्वायम्भुव मनु कहे जाते हैं। उनका इकहत्तर चतुर्युगी मन्वन्तर कहा जाता है। उस पुरुषने अयोनिजा शतरूपाको पत्नीरूपमें प्राप्त किया। वे उनके साथ रमण करते हैं, अतः वे “रति' कही जाती हैं। कल्पके आदिमें यह पहला परस्पर संयोग हुआ। ब्रह्माने विराटको उत्पन्न किया
verses.wordMeaning: After Kuruvama was Anu and from him was born Purutvan, the best among men. From him Aihsu was born to queen Bhadravati of Vidarbha.
verses.commentary: Sense: After Kuruvama was Anu and from him was born Purutvan, the best among men. From him Aihsu was born to queen Bhadravati of Vidarbha.

verses.sanskrit: दशार्हस्य सुतो व्याप्तो जीमूत इति तत्सुतः जीमूतपुत्रो विकृतिस् तस्य भीमरथः सुतः
verses.transliteration: daśārhasya suto vyāpto jīmūta iti tatsutaḥ jīmūtaputro vikṛtis tasya bhīmarathaḥ sutaḥ
verses.translation: After Kuruvama was Anu and from him was born Purutvan, the best among men. From him Aihsu was born to queen Bhadravati of Vidarbha.
verses.hindi: (विराट्पुत्र) मनुको सम्राट् कहा गया है। उन वैराज पुरुष मनुने प्रजासर्गका सृजन किया। शतरूपाने वीर वैराज पुरुषसे प्रियत्रत तथा उत्तानपाद नामक दो लोकमान्य पुत्रोंको उत्पन्न किया। उन्होंने दो
verses.wordMeaning: After Kuruvama was Anu and from him was born Purutvan, the best among men. From him Aihsu was born to queen Bhadravati of Vidarbha.
verses.commentary: Sense: After Kuruvama was Anu and from him was born Purutvan, the best among men. From him Aihsu was born to queen Bhadravati of Vidarbha.

verses.sanskrit: अथ भीमरथस्यासीत् पुत्रो नवरथः किल दानधर्मरतो नित्यं सत्यशीलपरायणः
verses.transliteration: atha bhīmarathasyāsīt putro navarathaḥ kila dānadharmarato nityaṃ satyaśīlaparāyaṇaḥ
verses.translation: After Kuruvama was Anu and from him was born Purutvan, the best among men. From him Aihsu was born to queen Bhadravati of Vidarbha.
verses.hindi: महाभाग्यशालिनी कन्याओंको भी उत्पन्न किया, जिनसे ये प्रजाएँ उत्पन्न हुई हैं। वे दोनों देवी आकूति तथा प्रभु स्वायम्भुव मनुने प्रसूतिको दक्षको अर्पित र्क दिया। दक्षको प्राण जानना चाहिए और मनुको सँ कहा जाता है । उन्होंने आकूतिको रुचिप्रजापतिको दि ब्र्ाके मानसपुत्र रुचिकी मिथुन (जुड़वा) सत्त
verses.wordMeaning: After Kuruvama was Anu and from him was born Purutvan, the best among men. From him Aihsu was born to queen Bhadravati of Vidarbha.
verses.commentary: Sense: After Kuruvama was Anu and from him was born Purutvan, the best among men. From him Aihsu was born to queen Bhadravati of Vidarbha.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य चासीद्दृढरथः शकुनिस्तस्य चात्मजः तस्मात् करम्भः सम्भूतो देवरातो ऽभवत्ततः
verses.transliteration: tasya cāsīddṛḍharathaḥ śakunistasya cātmajaḥ tasmāt karambhaḥ sambhūto devarāto 'bhavattataḥ
verses.translation: After Kuruvama was Anu and from him was born Purutvan, the best among men. From him Aihsu was born to queen Bhadravati of Vidarbha.
verses.hindi: अध्याय ७०  महेश्वरसे होनेवाली आदिसृष्टिका स्वरूप"सतीकी देहसे अनेक देवियोंका प्रादुर्भाव
verses.wordMeaning: After Kuruvama was Anu and from him was born Purutvan, the best among men. From him Aihsu was born to queen Bhadravati of Vidarbha.
verses.commentary: Sense: After Kuruvama was Anu and from him was born Purutvan, the best among men. From him Aihsu was born to queen Bhadravati of Vidarbha.

verses.sanskrit: देवरातादभूद्राजा देवरातिर् महायशाः देवगर्भोपमो जज्ञे यो देवक्षत्रनामकः
verses.transliteration: devarātādabhūdrājā devarātir mahāyaśāḥ devagarbhopamo jajñe yo devakṣatranāmakaḥ
verses.translation: After Kuruvama was Anu and from him was born Purutvan, the best among men. From him Aihsu was born to queen Bhadravati of Vidarbha.
verses.hindi: - यत यत्र पाद ।  उत्पन्न हुई। यज्ञ तथा दक्षिणा-ये जुड़वाँ यज्ञस्य i दश जञ्चिरे॥ २७९  सन्ताने हुईं। दक्षिणासे यज्ञके बारह पुत्रोंने जन्म लिया । यामा इति समाख्याता देवाः स्वायम्भुवेऽन्तरे।
verses.wordMeaning: After Kuruvama was Anu and from him was born Purutvan, the best among men. From him Aihsu was born to queen Bhadravati of Vidarbha.
verses.commentary: Sense: After Kuruvama was Anu and from him was born Purutvan, the best among men. From him Aihsu was born to queen Bhadravati of Vidarbha.

verses.sanskrit: देवक्षत्रसुतः श्रीमान् मधुर्नाम महायशाः मधूनां वंशकृद्राजा मधोस्तु कुरुवंशकः
verses.transliteration: devakṣatrasutaḥ śrīmān madhurnāma mahāyaśāḥ madhūnāṃ vaṃśakṛdrājā madhostu kuruvaṃśakaḥ
verses.translation: After Kuruvama was Anu and from him was born Purutvan, the best among men. From him Aihsu was born to queen Bhadravati of Vidarbha.
verses.hindi: वे देवगण, स्वायम्भुव मन्वन्तरमें “याम '--इस नामसे एतस्य पुत्रा यज्ञस्य तस्माद्यामाश्च ते स्मृताः ॥ २८०  प्रसिद्ध हुए; वे इस यज्ञके पुत्र थे, इसलिये वे “याम
verses.wordMeaning: After Kuruvama was Anu and from him was born Purutvan, the best among men. From him Aihsu was born to queen Bhadravati of Vidarbha.
verses.commentary: Sense: After Kuruvama was Anu and from him was born Purutvan, the best among men. From him Aihsu was born to queen Bhadravati of Vidarbha.

verses.sanskrit: कुरुवंशाद् अनुस् तस्मात् पुरुत्वान् पुरुषोत्तमः अंशुर्जज्ञे च वैदर्भ्यां भद्रवत्यां पुरुत्वतः
verses.transliteration: kuruvaṃśād anus tasmāt purutvān puruṣottamaḥ aṃśurjajñe ca vaidarbhyāṃ bhadravatyāṃ purutvataḥ
verses.translation: After Kuruvama was Anu and from him was born Purutvan, the best among men. From him Aihsu was born to queen Bhadravati of Vidarbha.
verses.hindi: अजितश्चैव शुक्रश्च गणौ द्वौ ब्रह्मणा कृतौ। कहे गये हैं। ब्रह्माने अजित तथा शुक्र-इन दो गणोंको यामाः पूर्व प्रजाता ये तेऽभवंस्तु दिवौकसः ॥ २८१  उत्पन्न किया था। पूर्वमें जो 'याम' उत्पन्न हुए थे, वे स्वायम्भुवसुतायां तु प्रसूत्यां लोकमातरः। देवता हुए सर्वाश्च ब्रह्मवादिन्यः सर्वा विश्वस्य मातर: । श्रद्धा लक्ष्मीर्धृतिस्तुष्टिः पुष्टिर्मेधा क्रिया तथा
verses.wordMeaning: After Kuruvama was Anu and from him was born Purutvan, the best among men. From him Aihsu was born to queen Bhadravati of Vidarbha.
verses.commentary: Sense: After Kuruvama was Anu and from him was born Purutvan, the best among men. From him Aihsu was born to queen Bhadravati of Vidarbha.

verses.sanskrit: ऐक्ष्वाकीम् अवहच्चांशुः सत्त्वस्तस्मादजायत सत्त्वात् सर्वगुणोपेतः सात्वतः कुलवर्धनः
verses.transliteration: aikṣvākīm avahaccāṃśuḥ sattvastasmādajāyata sattvāt sarvaguṇopetaḥ sātvataḥ kulavardhanaḥ
verses.translation: After Kuruvama was Anu and from him was born Purutvan, the best among men. From him Aihsu was born to queen Bhadravati of Vidarbha.
verses.hindi: पत्यर्थं प्रतिजग्राह धर्मो दाक्षायणीः प्रभु:
verses.wordMeaning: After Kuruvama was Anu and from him was born Purutvan, the best among men. From him Aihsu was born to queen Bhadravati of Vidarbha.
verses.commentary: Sense: After Kuruvama was Anu and from him was born Purutvan, the best among men. From him Aihsu was born to queen Bhadravati of Vidarbha.

verses.sanskrit: ज्यामघस्य मया प्रोक्ता सृष्टिर्वै विस्तरेण वः यः पठेच्छृणुयाद्वापि निसृष्टिं ज्यामघस्य तु
verses.transliteration: jyāmaghasya mayā proktā sṛṣṭirvai vistareṇa vaḥ yaḥ paṭhecchṛṇuyādvāpi nisṛṣṭiṃ jyāmaghasya tu
verses.translation: After Kuruvama was Anu and from him was born Purutvan, the best among men. From him Aihsu was born to queen Bhadravati of Vidarbha.
verses.hindi: ताभ्यः शिष्टा यवीयस्य एकादश सुलोचनाः रुद्रो भृगुर्मरीचिश्च अङ्गिराः पुलहः क्रतु:
verses.wordMeaning: After Kuruvama was Anu and from him was born Purutvan, the best among men. From him Aihsu was born to queen Bhadravati of Vidarbha.
verses.commentary: Sense: After Kuruvama was Anu and from him was born Purutvan, the best among men. From him Aihsu was born to queen Bhadravati of Vidarbha.

verses.sanskrit: प्रजीवत्येति वै स्वर्गं राज्यं सौख्यं च विन्दति
verses.transliteration: prajīvatyeti vai svargaṃ rājyaṃ saukhyaṃ ca vindati
verses.translation: After Kuruvama was Anu and from him was born Purutvan, the best among men. From him Aihsu was born to queen Bhadravati of Vidarbha.
verses.hindi: मरीचये च सम्भूतिं स्मृतिमङ्गिरसे ददौ। प्रीतिं चैव पुलस्त्याय क्षमां वै पुलहाय च
verses.wordMeaning: After Kuruvama was Anu and from him was born Purutvan, the best among men. From him Aihsu was born to queen Bhadravati of Vidarbha.
verses.commentary: Sense: After Kuruvama was Anu and from him was born Purutvan, the best among men. From him Aihsu was born to queen Bhadravati of Vidarbha.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीलिङ्गमहापुराणे पूर्वभागे वंशानुवर्णनं नामाष्टषष्टितमो ऽध्यायः सात्वतः सत्यसम्पन्नः प्रजज्ञे चतुरः सुतान् भजनं भ्राजमानं च दिव्यं देवावृधं नृपम्
verses.transliteration: iti śrīliṅgamahāpurāṇe pūrvabhāge vaṃśānuvarṇanaṃ nāmāṣṭaṣaṣṭitamo 'dhyāyaḥ sātvataḥ satyasampannaḥ prajajñe caturaḥ sutān bhajanaṃ bhrājamānaṃ ca divyaṃ devāvṛdhaṃ nṛpam
verses.translation: Sattvata endowed with the sattva guna begot four sons: Bhajana the bi'illiant, the divine king Dovavrdha, Andhaka the highly blessed one and Vrsni the delighter of all the descen- dants of Yadu. Hear in detail the families of these four.
verses.hindi: श्रद्धा कामं विजज्ञे वै दपा लक्ष्मीसुतः स्मृतः प्रभु दक्षने स्वायम्भुव मनु-की पुत्री उस प्रसूतिसे चौबीस कन्याएँ उत्पन्न कौं; वे लोकमाता हुई। वे सभी महाभाग्यशालिनी, कमलके समान नेत्रवाली, भोगवती, योगमाताएँ, ब्रह्मवादिनी तथा विश्वकी माताएँ
verses.wordMeaning: Sattvata endowed with the sattva guna begot four sons: Bhajana the bi'illiant, the divine king Dovavrdha, Andhaka the highly blessed one and Vrsni the delighter of all the descen- dants of Yadu. Hear in detail the families of these four.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sattvata endowed with the sattva guna begot four sons: Bhajana the bi'illiant, the divine king Dovavrdha, Andhaka the highly blessed one and Vrsni the delighter of all the descen- dants of Yadu. Hear in detail the families of these four.

verses.sanskrit: अन्धकं च महाभागं वृष्णिं च यदुनन्दनम् तेषां निसर्गांश्चतुरः शृणुध्वं विस्तरेण वै
verses.transliteration: andhakaṃ ca mahābhāgaṃ vṛṣṇiṃ ca yadunandanam teṣāṃ nisargāṃścaturaḥ śṛṇudhvaṃ vistareṇa vai
verses.translation: Ayutayus, Satayus and the powerful Harakrt were born to Srnjayi and Bhajana the brilliant.
verses.hindi: थीं। उनमें जो श्रद्धा, लक्ष्मी, धृति, तुष्टि, पुष्टि, मेधा, क्रिया, बुद्धि, लज्जा, वपु, शान्ति, सिद्धि एवं कीर्ति-- तेरह पुत्रियाँ थीं, उन दक्षकन्याओंको प्रभु धर्मने पत्नीके रूपमें ग्रहण कर लिया। स्वायम्भुवने इन सबको
verses.wordMeaning: Ayutayus, Satayus and the powerful Harakrt were born to Srnjayi and Bhajana the brilliant.
verses.commentary: Sense: Ayutayus, Satayus and the powerful Harakrt were born to Srnjayi and Bhajana the brilliant.

verses.sanskrit: सृञ्जय्यां भजनाच्चैव भ्राजमानाद्विजज्ञिरे अयुतायुः शतायुश् च बलवान् हर्षकृत्स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: sṛñjayyāṃ bhajanāccaiva bhrājamānādvijajñire ayutāyuḥ śatāyuś ca balavān harṣakṛtsmṛtaḥ
verses.translation: Among the four sons of Sattvata, king Devavrdha per- formed a great penance desiring, shall have a son endowed with good qualities."
verses.hindi: उन धर्मकी पत्नी बनाया। उन सभीसे कनिष्ठ जो शिष्ट मह्षियोंने प्राप्त किया; वे रुद्र, भृगु, मरीचि, अंगिरा,
verses.wordMeaning: Among the four sons of Sattvata, king Devavrdha per- formed a great penance desiring, shall have a son endowed with good qualities."
verses.commentary: Sense: Among the four sons of Sattvata, king Devavrdha per- formed a great penance desiring, shall have a son endowed with good qualities."

verses.sanskrit: तेषां देवावृधो राजा चचार परमं तपः पुत्रः सर्वगुणोपेतो मम भूयादिति स्मरन्
verses.transliteration: teṣāṃ devāvṛdho rājā cacāra paramaṃ tapaḥ putraḥ sarvaguṇopeto mama bhūyāditi smaran
verses.translation: It is heard that those who are conversant with the mythology of the race of Anu sing that his son was known as Babhru. He was an excellent king of meritorious renown.
verses.hindi: उन्होंने सतीको भव (रुद्र)-को तथा ख्यातिको भृगुको दे दिया। इसके बाद उन्होंने सम्भूतिको मरीचिको और स्मृतिको अंगिराको प्रदान कर दिया। उन्होंने प्रीतिको पुलस्त्यको, क्षमाको पुलहको, सन्ततिको क्रतुको,
verses.wordMeaning: It is heard that those who are conversant with the mythology of the race of Anu sing that his son was known as Babhru. He was an excellent king of meritorious renown.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is heard that those who are conversant with the mythology of the race of Anu sing that his son was known as Babhru. He was an excellent king of meritorious renown.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य बभ्रुरिति ख्यातः पुण्यश्लोको नृपोत्तमः अनुवंशपुराणज्ञा गायन्तीति परिश्रुतम्
verses.transliteration: tasya babhruriti khyātaḥ puṇyaśloko nṛpottamaḥ anuvaṃśapurāṇajñā gāyantīti pariśrutam
verses.translation: Noble men glorify the qualities of Devavrdha the great soul. Just as we hear about them from far we see them from near.
verses.hindi: अनसूयाको अत्रिको तथा ऊर्जाको वसिष्ठको अर्पित कर दिया और स्वाहाको अग्निको तथा स्वधाको 'पितरोंको सौंप दिया। अब उनसे उत्पन्न सन्तानोंको ये समस्त महाभाग्यवती कन्याएँ सभी मन्वन्तरोंमें प्रलयपर्यन्त प्रजाओंके सूजनमें लगी रहती थीं। श्रद्धाने कामको उत्पन्न किया। दर्प लक्ष्मीका पुत्र कहा गया है। धृतिका पुत्र नियम, तुष्टिका पुत्र सन्तोष, पुष्टिका पुत्र
verses.wordMeaning: Noble men glorify the qualities of Devavrdha the great soul. Just as we hear about them from far we see them from near.
verses.commentary: Sense: Noble men glorify the qualities of Devavrdha the great soul. Just as we hear about them from far we see them from near.

verses.sanskrit: गुणान्देवावृधस्याथ कीर्तयन्तो महात्मनः यथैव शृणुमो दूरात् संपश्यामस्तथान्तिकात्
verses.transliteration: guṇāndevāvṛdhasyātha kīrtayanto mahātmanaḥ yathaiva śṛṇumo dūrāt saṃpaśyāmastathāntikāt
verses.translation: Babhru is the best among men and Devavrdha was equal to Devas. Fourteen thousand and sixty five persons had attained immortality, thanks to Babhru and Devavrdha. He performed sacrifices. He was charitably inclined. He was a
verses.hindi: लोभ तथा मेधाका पुत्र श्रुत है  क्रियासे दण्ड तथा समय
verses.wordMeaning: Babhru is the best among men and Devavrdha was equal to Devas. Fourteen thousand and sixty five persons had attained immortality, thanks to Babhru and Devavrdha. He performed sacrifices. He was charitably inclined. He was a
verses.commentary: Sense: Babhru is the best among men and Devavrdha was equal to Devas. Fourteen thousand and sixty five persons had attained immortality, thanks to Babhru and Devavrdha. He performed sacrifices. He was charitably inclined. He was a

verses.sanskrit: बभ्रुः श्रेष्ठो मनुष्याणां देवैर्देवावृधः समः पुरुषाः पञ्च षष्टिस्तु षट् सहस्राणि चाष्ट च
verses.transliteration: babhruḥ śreṣṭho manuṣyāṇāṃ devairdevāvṛdhaḥ samaḥ puruṣāḥ pañca ṣaṣṭistu ṣaṭ sahasrāṇi cāṣṭa ca
verses.translation: Gwdhar! and Madn were the wives of Vr?i. Gand- hari gave birth to Sumitra and Mitranandana.
verses.hindi: 0 कक र मा 2. फफफफफफफफफफफफफफफफफफफफफफफफफफ फक क फाम की फफ फफफफफफफफफ फफफ फी फी फफी मामा HH फफाकफफफफफफ फफफ फ़ छि यशः कीर्तिसुतश्चापि इत्येते धर्मसूनवः। कामस्य हर्षः पुत्रो वै देव्यां प्रीत्यां व्यजायत
verses.wordMeaning: Gwdhar! and Madn were the wives of Vr?i. Gand- hari gave birth to Sumitra and Mitranandana.
verses.commentary: Sense: Gwdhar! and Madn were the wives of Vr?i. Gand- hari gave birth to Sumitra and Mitranandana.

verses.sanskrit: ये ऽमृतत्वमनुप्राप्ता बभ्रोर्देवावृधादपि यज्वा दानमतिर्वीरो ब्रह्मण्यस्तु दृढव्रतः
verses.transliteration: ye 'mṛtatvamanuprāptā babhrordevāvṛdhādapi yajvā dānamatirvīro brahmaṇyastu dṛḍhavrataḥ
verses.translation: MadrI obtained from him the son Devamidhua at first and then two excellent heroes Anamitra and Sini.
verses.hindi: इत्येष वै सुतोदर्कः सर्गो धर्मस्य कीर्तितः। जज्ञे हिंसा त्वधर्माद्वै निकृतिं चानृतं सुतम्
verses.wordMeaning: MadrI obtained from him the son Devamidhua at first and then two excellent heroes Anamitra and Sini.
verses.commentary: Sense: MadrI obtained from him the son Devamidhua at first and then two excellent heroes Anamitra and Sini.

verses.sanskrit: कीर्तिमांश् च महातेजाः सात्वतानां महारथः तस्यान्ववाये सम्भूता भोजा वै दैवतोपमाः
verses.transliteration: kīrtimāṃś ca mahātejāḥ sātvatānāṃ mahārathaḥ tasyānvavāye sambhūtā bhojā vai daivatopamāḥ
verses.translation: Anamitra's son was Nighna. Nighna had two sons the highly blessed Prasena and Satrajit.
verses.hindi: दुःखोत्तराः सुता होते सर्वे चाधर्मलक्षणाः नैषां भार्यास्तु पुत्राश्च सर्वे होते परिग्रहाः । इत्येष तामसः सगो जज्ञे धर्मनियामकः
verses.wordMeaning: Anamitra's son was Nighna. Nighna had two sons the highly blessed Prasena and Satrajit.
verses.commentary: Sense: Anamitra's son was Nighna. Nighna had two sons the highly blessed Prasena and Satrajit.

verses.sanskrit: गान्धारी चैव माद्री च वृष्णिभार्ये बभूवतुः गान्धारी जनयामास सुमित्रं मित्रनन्दनम्
verses.transliteration: gāndhārī caiva mādrī ca vṛṣṇibhārye babhūvatuḥ gāndhārī janayāmāsa sumitraṃ mitranandanam
verses.translation: The sun was an intimate friend of Satrajit. He gave him the jewel Syamantaka.®'®
verses.hindi: प्रजाः सृजेति व्यादिष्टो ब्रह्मणा नीललोहितः । सोऽभिध्याय सतीं भार्या निर्ममे ह्यत्मसम्भवान्
verses.wordMeaning: The sun was an intimate friend of Satrajit. He gave him the jewel Syamantaka.®'®
verses.commentary: Sense: The sun was an intimate friend of Satrajit. He gave him the jewel Syamantaka.®'®

verses.sanskrit: माद्री लेभे च तं पुत्रं ततः सा देवमीढुषम् अनमित्रं शिनिं चैव तावुभौ पुरुषोत्तमौ
verses.transliteration: mādrī lebhe ca taṃ putraṃ tataḥ sā devamīḍhuṣam anamitraṃ śiniṃ caiva tāvubhau puruṣottamau
verses.translation: This jewel was the best among all the jewels in the world. Once he went for hunting along with Prasena. He was killed there by a terrible lion as he was helpless. From Sini the youngest son of Vfi a son Satyaka was born. He was faithful in words and was richly endowed with truthfulness. His son was the valorous Yuyudhana, the grandson of Sini.
verses.hindi: नाधिकान च हीनांस्तान् मानसानात्मनः समान्। सहस्त्रं हि सहस्त्राणां सोऽसृजत्कृत्तिवाससः नामक पुत्र उत्पन्न हुए। बुद्धिसे बोध तथा प्रमाद नामक पुत्र उत्पन्न हुए। लज्जासे विनय नामक हुआ। वसुका पुत्र व्यवसाय तथा शान्तिका पुत्र क्षेम है। सिद्धिसे सुख नामक पुत्र उत्पन्न हुआ। कीर्तिका पुत्र
verses.wordMeaning: This jewel was the best among all the jewels in the world. Once he went for hunting along with Prasena. He was killed there by a terrible lion as he was helpless. From Sini the youngest son of Vfi a son Satyaka was born.…
verses.commentary: Sense: This jewel was the best among all the jewels in the world. Once he went for hunting along with Prasena. He was killed there by a terrible lion as he was helpless. From Sini the youngest son of Vfi a son Satyaka was born.…

verses.sanskrit: अनमित्रसुतो निघ्नो निघ्नस्य द्वौ बभूवतुः प्रसेनश् च महाभागः सत्राजिच्च सुतावुभौ
verses.transliteration: anamitrasuto nighno nighnasya dvau babhūvatuḥ prasenaś ca mahābhāgaḥ satrājicca sutāvubhau
verses.translation: Asahga was the son of Yuyudhana. Kuni was his son. The son of Ku was Yugandhara. Thus the descendants of Sini (Saincyas) have been described.
verses.hindi: यश है। ये सब धर्मके पुत्र हैं। कामका पुत्र हर्ष देवी प्रीतिसे उत्पन्न हुआ। धर्मका यह सुतोदर्क सर्ग बता दिया गया
verses.wordMeaning: Asahga was the son of Yuyudhana. Kuni was his son. The son of Ku was Yugandhara. Thus the descendants of Sini (Saincyas) have been described.
verses.commentary: Sense: Asahga was the son of Yuyudhana. Kuni was his son. The son of Ku was Yugandhara. Thus the descendants of Sini (Saincyas) have been described.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य सत्राजितः सूर्यः सखा प्राणसमो ऽभवत् स्यमन्तको नाम मणिर् दत्तस्तस्मै विवस्वता
verses.transliteration: tasya satrājitaḥ sūryaḥ sakhā prāṇasamo 'bhavat syamantako nāma maṇir dattastasmai vivasvatā
verses.translation: A son was born to Yudhajit the son of Vrsni and Madri. He was known as Svaphalka. He was the benefactor of the three worlds.
verses.hindi: हिंसाने अधर्मसे निकृति नामकी कन्या तथा अनृत पुत्रको उत्पन्न किया। निकृतिसे भय तथा नरक दो पुत्र उत्पन्न हुए और इनकी  पत्नियाँ माया तथा वेदना जुडा कन्याएँ हुई । इसके बाद मायाने प्राणियोंका हरण करनेवाले मृत्युको जन्म दिया और वेदनासे रौरवके द्वारा पुत्ररूपमें 'दुःख' उत्पन्न हुआ । मृत्युसे व्याधि, जरा, शोक, क्रोध तथा असूया उत्पन्न हुए। उत्तरोत्तर दु:ख देनेवाले ये सभी पुत्र अधर्मके लक्षणोसे युक्त थे । इन सबको भार्याएँ तथा
verses.wordMeaning: A son was born to Yudhajit the son of Vrsni and Madri. He was known as Svaphalka. He was the benefactor of the three worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: A son was born to Yudhajit the son of Vrsni and Madri. He was known as Svaphalka. He was the benefactor of the three worlds.

verses.sanskrit: पृथिव्यां सर्वरत्नानाम् असौ राजाभवन्मणिः कदाचिन्मृगयां यातः प्रसेनेन सहैव सः
verses.transliteration: pṛthivyāṃ sarvaratnānām asau rājābhavanmaṇiḥ kadācinmṛgayāṃ yātaḥ prasenena sahaiva saḥ
verses.translation: Wherever the pious king Svaphalka was present, there was no fear of either ailment or of drought.
verses.hindi: पुत्र नहीं थे; ये सभी परिग्रह स्वभाववाले थे । इस प्रकार यह धर्मनियामक तामस सर्ग उत्पन्न हुआ ॥ २९८--३०२॥
verses.wordMeaning: Wherever the pious king Svaphalka was present, there was no fear of either ailment or of drought.
verses.commentary: Sense: Wherever the pious king Svaphalka was present, there was no fear of either ailment or of drought.

verses.sanskrit: वधं प्राप्तो ऽसहायश् च सिंहादेव सुदारुणात् अथ पुत्रः शिनेर्जज्ञे कनिष्ठाद् वृष्णिनन्दनात्
verses.transliteration: vadhaṃ prāpto 'sahāyaś ca siṃhādeva sudāruṇāt atha putraḥ śinerjajñe kaniṣṭhād vṛṣṇinandanāt
verses.translation: Svaphalka took as his wife, Gandin! the daughter of the king of Kai, who gave him his daughter.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्माने नीललोहित शिवसे कहा था--'प्रजाओंका सृजन कोजिये।' तब उन्होंने अपनी भार्या सतीका ध्यान करके पुत्रोंका सृजन किया। उन्होंने न अधिक, न कम, अपने ही समान तथा व्याघ्रचर्म धारण किये हुए हजारों-हजार मानसपुत्रों  रुद्रगणों-को उत्पन्न किया
verses.wordMeaning: Svaphalka took as his wife, Gandin! the daughter of the king of Kai, who gave him his daughter.
verses.commentary: Sense: Svaphalka took as his wife, Gandin! the daughter of the king of Kai, who gave him his daughter.

verses.sanskrit: सत्यवाक् सत्यसम्पन्नः सत्यकस्तस्य चात्मजः सात्यकिर्युयुधानस्तु शिनेर्नप्ता प्रतापवान्
verses.transliteration: satyavāk satyasampannaḥ satyakastasya cātmajaḥ sātyakiryuyudhānastu śinernaptā pratāpavān
verses.translation: For many years she remained in the womb of her mother without being born. The father spoke to her even as she was within the womb. "Be born quickly. Welfare unto thee. Why dost thou tarry." Then the girl Gaiidini stationed within the womb replied to him — "O father, everyday you must give a cow to a brahmin. If you give thus for three years I will come out of the womb of my mother."
verses.hindi: अध्याय ७० 1महेश्वरसे होनेवाली आदिसृष्टिका स्वरूप“सतीकी देहसे अनेक देवियोंका प्रादुर्भाव
verses.wordMeaning: For many years she remained in the womb of her mother without being born. The father spoke to her even as she was within the womb. "Be born quickly. Welfare unto thee. Why dost thou tarry." Then the girl Gaiidini stationed within the womb replied to him — "O father,…
verses.commentary: Sense: For many years she remained in the womb of her mother without being born. The father spoke to her even as she was within the womb. "Be born quickly. Welfare unto thee. Why dost thou tarry." Then the girl Gaiidini stationed within the womb replied to him — "O father,…

verses.sanskrit: असंगो युयुधानस्य कुणिस्तस्य सुतो ऽभवत् कुणेर् युगंधरः पुत्रः शैनेया इति कीर्तिताः
verses.transliteration: asaṃgo yuyudhānasya kuṇistasya suto 'bhavat kuṇer yugaṃdharaḥ putraḥ śaineyā iti kīrtitāḥ
verses.translation: Syamaataka. Sit H.M.
verses.hindi: है सर्वान् रूपतेजोबल श्रुत 3 फ र सन  करपदोन, सीति । उन्होंने रूप-तेज-बल-ज्ञानमें अपने ही सदृश, पिंगलवर्णवाले, विशिष्टान् हरिकेशांश्च दृष्टिघ्नांश्च कपालिनः। केशवाले, देखनेमात्रसे नाश करनेवाले, कपालधारी, विशाल
verses.wordMeaning: Syamaataka. Sit H.M.
verses.commentary: Sense: Syamaataka. Sit H.M.

verses.sanskrit: माद्र्याः सुतस्य संजज्ञे सुतो वार्ष्णिर्युधाजितः श्वफल्क इति विख्यातस् त्रैलोक्यहितकारकः
verses.transliteration: mādryāḥ sutasya saṃjajñe suto vārṣṇiryudhājitaḥ śvaphalka iti vikhyātas trailokyahitakārakaḥ
verses.translation: Akrura married Ratna the daughter of Saiva. He begot of her Upamanyu, Mangii, Vjrta, Janamejaya, Girirak$a, Upek§a, Satrughna, Arimardana, Dharmabhit, Vftadharma, Godhana, Vara, Avidia and Prativaha. He had also an excel** lent daughter Sudhara. Two sons who delighted the faitiily were born of UgrasenI (daughter of Ugrasena) to Akrdra* They were Devavan and Upadeva equal to Devas.
verses.hindi: रथिनश्चर्मिणश्चैव वर्मिणश्च वरूधिनः। वजा 4 गी क़ I १ हुए, यी हे वाले, स्वर्ग-पृथ्वी-अन्तरिक्षमें गमन करनेवा
verses.wordMeaning: Akrura married Ratna the daughter of Saiva. He begot of her Upamanyu, Mangii, Vjrta, Janamejaya, Girirak$a, Upek§a, Satrughna, Arimardana, Dharmabhit, Vftadharma, Godhana, Vara, Avidia and Prativaha. He had also an excel** lent daughter Sudhara.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Akrura married Ratna the daughter of Saiva. He begot of her Upamanyu, Mangii, Vjrta, Janamejaya, Girirak$a, Upek§a, Satrughna, Arimardana, Dharmabhit, Vftadharma, Godhana, Vara, Avidia and Prativaha. He had also an excel** lent daughter Sudhara.…

verses.sanskrit: श्वफल्कश् च महाराजो धर्मात्मा यत्र वर्तते नास्ति व्याधिभयं तत्र नावृष्टिभयमप्युत
verses.transliteration: śvaphalkaś ca mahārājo dharmātmā yatra vartate nāsti vyādhibhayaṃ tatra nāvṛṣṭibhayamapyuta
verses.translation: The following were the sons of Citraka — Vipfthu, Prthu, Asvagrlva. Subahu, Sudhasuka, Gavekaii, Ari$tanemi» Asva, Dharma, Adharmabhft, Subhumi and Bahubhumi. He had two daughters Sravisha and Sravana.
verses.hindi: टान्द्रिजिह्णांस्तांस्त्रिलोचनान्। ेत्रोंवाले, अन्न खानेवाले, मांस भक्षण करनेवाले, घृत हव्यादाज्छुतधर्माश्च धर्मिणो ह्यथ बर्हिणः
verses.wordMeaning: The following were the sons of Citraka — Vipfthu, Prthu, Asvagrlva. Subahu, Sudhasuka, Gavekaii, Ari$tanemi» Asva, Dharma, Adharmabhft, Subhumi and Bahubhumi. He had two daughters Sravisha and Sravana.
verses.commentary: Sense: The following were the sons of Citraka — Vipfthu, Prthu, Asvagrlva. Subahu, Sudhasuka, Gavekaii, Ari$tanemi» Asva, Dharma, Adharmabhft, Subhumi and Bahubhumi. He had two daughters Sravisha and Sravana.

verses.sanskrit: श्वफल्कः काशिराजस्य सुतां भार्यामवाप सः गान्दिनीं नाम काश्यो हि ददौ तस्मै स्वकन्यकाम्
verses.transliteration: śvaphalkaḥ kāśirājasya sutāṃ bhāryāmavāpa saḥ gāndinīṃ nāma kāśyo hi dadau tasmai svakanyakām
verses.translation: To Andhaka the daughter of the king of Kasi bore four sons viz:— Kukura, Bhajamana, Suci and Kambala- barhis.
verses.hindi: वृद्धान् बुद्धिमतश्चैव ब्रह्मिष्ठाञशुभदर्शनान्
verses.wordMeaning: To Andhaka the daughter of the king of Kasi bore four sons viz:— Kukura, Bhajamana, Suci and Kambala- barhis.
verses.commentary: Sense: To Andhaka the daughter of the king of Kasi bore four sons viz:— Kukura, Bhajamana, Suci and Kambala- barhis.

verses.sanskrit: सा मातुरुदरस्था वै बहून्वर्षगणान्किल वसन्ती न च संजज्ञे गर्भस्था तां पिताब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: sā māturudarasthā vai bahūnvarṣagaṇānkila vasantī na ca saṃjajñe garbhasthā tāṃ pitābravīt
verses.translation: Vri(U was the son of Kukura. Sura was the son of Vfijii. The highly powerful Kapotaroma was his son and his son was Vilomaka.
verses.hindi: नीलग्रीवान्सहस्त्ाक्षान्सर्वाश्चाथ क्षमाकरान्। अदृश्यान् सर्वभूतानां महायोगान् महौजसः पीनेवाले, सोमपान करनेवाले, सुन्दर, बड़े-बड़े कपालवाले, नीले कण्ठवाले, ऊर्ध्वरेता (ब्रह्मचारी), हव्य खानेवाले, वेदपरायण, धार्मिक, मोरपंखसे सुशोभित, कुछ बैठे हुए, कुछ दौड़ते हुए, पाँच भूतोंवाले, कुछ अध्यापन करनेवाले,
verses.wordMeaning: Vri(U was the son of Kukura. Sura was the son of Vfijii. The highly powerful Kapotaroma was his son and his son was Vilomaka.
verses.commentary: Sense: Vri(U was the son of Kukura. Sura was the son of Vfijii. The highly powerful Kapotaroma was his son and his son was Vilomaka.

verses.sanskrit: जायस्व शीघ्रं भद्रं ते किमर्थं चाभितिष्ठसि प्रोवाच चैनं गर्भस्था सा कन्या गान्दिनी तदा
verses.transliteration: jāyasva śīghraṃ bhadraṃ te kimarthaṃ cābhitiṣṭhasi provāca cainaṃ garbhasthā sā kanyā gāndinī tadā
verses.translation: He had a scholarly son Nala who was a comrade of Tumburu. He is known by the name Candananaka Dundubhi.
verses.hindi: कुछ अध्ययन करनेवाले, कुछ जप करते हुए, कुछ योगाभ्यास करते हुए, कुछ धूमयुक्त, कुछ दीप्तिमान्, गंगाको धारण किये हुए, अत्यन्त कान्तिमान्, वृद्ध, बुद्धिसम्मन्न, ब्रह्मिष्ठ, शुभ दर्शनवाले, नीलग्रीवा (कण्ठ)-
verses.wordMeaning: He had a scholarly son Nala who was a comrade of Tumburu. He is known by the name Candananaka Dundubhi.
verses.commentary: Sense: He had a scholarly son Nala who was a comrade of Tumburu. He is known by the name Candananaka Dundubhi.

verses.sanskrit: वर्षत्रयं प्रतिदिनं गामेकां ब्राह्मणाय तु यदि दद्यास्ततः कुक्षेर् निर्गमिष्याम्यहं पितः
verses.transliteration: varṣatrayaṃ pratidinaṃ gāmekāṃ brāhmaṇāya tu yadi dadyāstataḥ kukṣer nirgamiṣyāmyahaṃ pitaḥ
verses.translation: From him was born the son Abhijit. His son was Punarvasu. That king performed a horse sacrifice for obtaining a son.
verses.hindi: वाले, हजार नेत्रोंवाले, क्षमाकी निधि, सभी प्राणियोंसे अदृश्य, महान् योगवाले, महातेजस्वी, भ्रमण करते हुए, इधर-उधर भागते हुए, कूदते हुए तथा अयातयाम- इन हजारों-हजार उत्तम रुद्र्देवताओंको उत्पन्न इन्हें देखकर ब्रह्माजीने इन नीललोहित-से कहा--"ऐसी प्रजाओंका सूजन मत कीजिये; अपने सदूश प्रजाओंकी सृष्टि आपको नहीं करनी चाहिए। हे देव! आपको नमस्कार है। आपका कल्याण हो। आप
verses.wordMeaning: From him was born the son Abhijit. His son was Punarvasu. That king performed a horse sacrifice for obtaining a son.
verses.commentary: Sense: From him was born the son Abhijit. His son was Punarvasu. That king performed a horse sacrifice for obtaining a son.

verses.sanskrit: तथेत्युवाच तस्या वै पिता काममपूरयत् दाता शूरश् च यज्वा च श्रुतवानतिथिप्रियः
verses.transliteration: tathetyuvāca tasyā vai pitā kāmamapūrayat dātā śūraś ca yajvā ca śrutavānatithipriyaḥ
verses.translation: In the course of that sacrifice when Atiratra mantras were being chanted in the middle of the assembly of priests the child Punarvasu was bom. Later on he became a scholar, omnis- cient, charitable and a performer of sacrifices.
verses.hindi: मृत्युयुक्त अन्य प्रजाओंका सूजन कीजिये; क्योंकि मृत्युरहित प्रजाएँ कार्योका आरम्भ नहीं करेंगी
verses.wordMeaning: In the course of that sacrifice when Atiratra mantras were being chanted in the middle of the assembly of priests the child Punarvasu was bom. Later on he became a scholar, omnis- cient, charitable and a performer of sacrifices.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the course of that sacrifice when Atiratra mantras were being chanted in the middle of the assembly of priests the child Punarvasu was bom. Later on he became a scholar, omnis- cient, charitable and a performer of sacrifices.

verses.sanskrit: तस्याः पुत्रः स्मृतो ऽक्रूरः श्वफल्काद्भूरिदक्षिणः रत्ना कन्या च शैवस्य ह्य् अक्रूरस्तामवाप्तवान्
verses.transliteration: tasyāḥ putraḥ smṛto 'krūraḥ śvaphalkādbhūridakṣiṇaḥ ratnā kanyā ca śaivasya hy akrūrastāmavāptavān
verses.translation: Twins were born to Abhijit also. They were well known as Ahuka and Ahuld. They were the best among renow- ned people.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्माके द्वारा ऐसा कहे गये रुद्रने उनसे कहा- मैं मृत्यु तथा जरासे युक्त प्रजाओंका सूजन नहीं करूँगा। आपका कल्याण हो। अब मैं शान्त होकर बैठता हूँ और आपही सृजन कीजिये ।जिन हजारों-हजार विरूप नीललोहित रुद्रोंको मैंने सृजित किया है, वे मेरी आत्मासे निकली हुई प्रजाएँ हैं। ये रुद्र नामवाले महाबली देवता होंगे । ये पृथ्वी, आकाश तथा सभी दिशाओंमें व्याप्त रहेंगे। इनमें समान आत्मावाले सौ रुद्र याज्ञिक होंगे; वे सभी देवताओंके साथ
verses.wordMeaning: Twins were born to Abhijit also. They were well known as Ahuka and Ahuld. They were the best among renow- ned people.
verses.commentary: Sense: Twins were born to Abhijit also. They were well known as Ahuka and Ahuld. They were the best among renow- ned people.

verses.sanskrit: अस्यामुत्पादयामास तनयांस्तान्निबोधत उपमन्युस् तथा माङ्गुर् वृतस्तु जनमेजयः
verses.transliteration: asyāmutpādayāmāsa tanayāṃstānnibodhata upamanyus tathā māṅgur vṛtastu janamejayaḥ
verses.translation: Two sons were bom to the daughter of the king of KaI and Ahuka: — viz. Devaka and Ugrasena. Both of them were equal to the sons of Devas.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्मा दृष्ट्वाब्रवीदेनं मास्त्राक्षीरीदूशीः प्रजाः। स्रष्टव्या नात्मनस्तुल्याः प्रजा देव नमोऽस्तु ते
verses.wordMeaning: Two sons were bom to the daughter of the king of KaI and Ahuka: — viz. Devaka and Ugrasena. Both of them were equal to the sons of Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Two sons were bom to the daughter of the king of KaI and Ahuka: — viz. Devaka and Ugrasena. Both of them were equal to the sons of Devas.

verses.sanskrit: गिरिरक्षस्तथोपेक्षः शत्रुघ्नो यो ऽरिमर्दनः धर्मभृद् वृष्टधर्मा च गोधनो ऽथ वरस् तथा
verses.transliteration: girirakṣastathopekṣaḥ śatrughno yo 'rimardanaḥ dharmabhṛd vṛṣṭadharmā ca godhano 'tha varas tathā
verses.translation: Childern equal to Devas were bom to Devaka. They were Devavan, Upadeva, Sudeva and Devarakfita.
verses.hindi: नारप्स्यन्ते हि कर्माणि प्रजा विगतमृत्यवः एते देवा भविष्यन्ति रुद्रा नाम महाबलाः । पृथिव्यामन्तरिश्षे च दिक्षु चैव परिश्रिताः
verses.wordMeaning: Childern equal to Devas were bom to Devaka. They were Devavan, Upadeva, Sudeva and Devarakfita.
verses.commentary: Sense: Childern equal to Devas were bom to Devaka. They were Devavan, Upadeva, Sudeva and Devarakfita.

verses.sanskrit: आवाहप्रतिवाहौ च सुधारा च वराङ्गना अक्रूरस्योग्रसेन्यां तु पुत्रौ द्वौ कुलनन्दनौ
verses.transliteration: āvāhaprativāhau ca sudhārā ca varāṅganā akrūrasyograsenyāṃ tu putrau dvau kulanandanau
verses.translation: They had seven sisters. The kiig gave them to Vasudeva. They were Vnadevi, Upadevft, Devarakfitfi, Sridevfi
verses.hindi: शतरुद्रा: समात्मानो भविष्यन्तीति यासिकाः । यज्ञभाजो भविष्यन्ति सर्वदेवगणैः सह॥ २९ ९
verses.wordMeaning: They had seven sisters. The kiig gave them to Vasudeva. They were Vnadevi, Upadevft, Devarakfitfi, Sridevfi
verses.commentary: Sense: They had seven sisters. The kiig gave them to Vasudeva. They were Vnadevi, Upadevft, Devarakfitfi, Sridevfi

verses.sanskrit: देववानुपदेवश् च जज्ञाते देवसंमतौ सुमित्रस्य सुतो जज्ञे चित्रकश् च महायशाः
verses.transliteration: devavānupadevaś ca jajñāte devasaṃmatau sumitrasya suto jajñe citrakaś ca mahāyaśāḥ
verses.translation: Ugrasena had nine sons. Kamsa was the eldest among them. Their sons and grandsons were hundreds and thousands.
verses.hindi: मन्वन्तरेषु ये देवा भविष्यन्तीह भेदत: । सार्ध तैरीज्यमानास्ते स्थास्यन्तीहायुगक्षयात् एवमुक्तस्तदा ब्रह्मा महादेवेन धीमता। प्रत्युवाच नमस्कृत्य हृष्यमाणः प्रजापतिः
verses.wordMeaning: Ugrasena had nine sons. Kamsa was the eldest among them. Their sons and grandsons were hundreds and thousands.
verses.commentary: Sense: Ugrasena had nine sons. Kamsa was the eldest among them. Their sons and grandsons were hundreds and thousands.

verses.sanskrit: चित्रकस्याभवन्पुत्रा विपृथुः पृथुरेव च अश्वग्रीवः सुबाहुश् च सुधासूकगवेक्षणौ
verses.transliteration: citrakasyābhavanputrā vipṛthuḥ pṛthureva ca aśvagrīvaḥ subāhuś ca sudhāsūkagavekṣaṇau
verses.translation: The daughter of Devaka and the wife of Vasudeva was worthy of being honoured and worshipped even by Devas.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्मणा समनुज्ञाते तथा सर्वमभूत्किल
verses.wordMeaning: The daughter of Devaka and the wife of Vasudeva was worthy of being honoured and worshipped even by Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: The daughter of Devaka and the wife of Vasudeva was worthy of being honoured and worshipped even by Devas.

verses.sanskrit: अरिष्टनेमिरश्वश् च धर्मो धर्मभृदेव च सुभूमिर्बहुभूमिश् च श्रविष्ठाश्रवणे स्त्रियौ
verses.transliteration: ariṣṭanemiraśvaś ca dharmo dharmabhṛdeva ca subhūmirbahubhūmiś ca śraviṣṭhāśravaṇe striyau
verses.translation: The other two wives of Anakadundubhi, (Vasudeva) viz. the blessed Rohini and Pauravi the daughter of Bahlika were also worthy of being worshipped by Devas.
verses.hindi: ततः प्रभृति देवेशो न चासूयत वै प्रजा: । एष देवो महादेवः पुरुषोऽर्कसमद्युतिः
verses.wordMeaning: The other two wives of Anakadundubhi, (Vasudeva) viz. the blessed Rohini and Pauravi the daughter of Bahlika were also worthy of being worshipped by Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: The other two wives of Anakadundubhi, (Vasudeva) viz. the blessed Rohini and Pauravi the daughter of Bahlika were also worthy of being worshipped by Devas.

verses.sanskrit: अन्धकात्काश्यदुहिता लेभे च चतुरः सुतान् कुकुरं भजमानं च शुचिं कम्बलबर्हिषम्
verses.transliteration: andhakātkāśyaduhitā lebhe ca caturaḥ sutān kukuraṃ bhajamānaṃ ca śuciṃ kambalabarhiṣam
verses.translation: Rohini gave birth to Rama who wielded the plough- share as his weapon and had great strength. Due to the fear of Kamsa he had resorted to his own tranquil self.
verses.hindi: स एवैकादशार्धेन स्थितोऽसौ परमेश्वर: । तत्र या सा महाभागा शङ्करस्यार्धकायिनी
verses.wordMeaning: Rohini gave birth to Rama who wielded the plough- share as his weapon and had great strength. Due to the fear of Kamsa he had resorted to his own tranquil self.
verses.commentary: Sense: Rohini gave birth to Rama who wielded the plough- share as his weapon and had great strength. Due to the fear of Kamsa he had resorted to his own tranquil self.

verses.sanskrit: कुकुरस्य सुतो वृष्णिर् वृष्णेः शूरस्ततो ऽभवत् कपोतरोमातिबलस् तस्य पुत्रो विलोमकः
verses.transliteration: kukurasya suto vṛṣṇir vṛṣṇeḥ śūrastato 'bhavat kapotaromātibalas tasya putro vilomakaḥ
verses.translation: After the six innocent childern had been killed, and after Balarama had been bom the intelligent Vasudeva, begot Krna of Devaki.
verses.hindi: प्रागुक्ता तु महादेवी स्त्री सैवेह सती ह्यभूत्। हिताय जगतां देवी दक्षेणाराधिता पुरा कार्यार्थ दक्षिणं तस्याः शुक्लं वामं तथासितम्। आत्मानं विभजस्वेति प्रोक्ता देवेन शम्भुना
verses.wordMeaning: After the six innocent childern had been killed, and after Balarama had been bom the intelligent Vasudeva, begot Krna of Devaki.
verses.commentary: Sense: After the six innocent childern had been killed, and after Balarama had been bom the intelligent Vasudeva, begot Krna of Devaki.

verses.sanskrit: तस्यासीत् तुम्बुरुसखो विद्वान्पुत्रो नलः किल ख्यायते स सुनाम्ना तु चन्दनानकदुन्दुभिः
verses.transliteration: tasyāsīt tumburusakho vidvānputro nalaḥ kila khyāyate sa sunāmnā tu candanānakadundubhiḥ
verses.translation: He alone is the supreme soul. He is Visnu the lord of Devas, Balarama was the lord Sesa with silver lustre.
verses.hindi: यज्ञभाग ग्रहण करनेवाले होंगे। सभी मन्वन्तरोंमें जो देवता भेदपूर्वक यहाँपर होंगे, उनके साथ पूजित होते हुए वे सभी रुद्र युगक्षयपर्यन्त यहाँ स्थित रहेंगे ॥ ३१६--३२० ॥
verses.wordMeaning: He alone is the supreme soul. He is Visnu the lord of Devas, Balarama was the lord Sesa with silver lustre.
verses.commentary: Sense: He alone is the supreme soul. He is Visnu the lord of Devas, Balarama was the lord Sesa with silver lustre.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मादप्यभिजित्पुत्र उत्पन्नो ऽस्य पुनर्वसुः अश्वमेधं स पुत्रार्थम् आजहार नरोत्तमः
verses.transliteration: tasmādapyabhijitputra utpanno 'sya punarvasuḥ aśvamedhaṃ sa putrārtham ājahāra narottamaḥ
verses.translation: Under the pretext of the curse of Bhrgu, Visnu agreed to take a human body and was bom of Devaki as the son of Vasudeva.
verses.hindi: बुद्धिमान् महादेवजीके द्वारा इस प्रकार कहे गये प्रजापति ब्रह्माजी प्रसन्न होकर प्रणाम करके उनसे बोले--'हे विभो! आपने जैसा कहा है, वैसा ही हो. आपका कल्याण हो ।' ब्रह्माके ऐसा कहनेके बाद सब कुछ उसी प्रकारसे हुआ
verses.wordMeaning: Under the pretext of the curse of Bhrgu, Visnu agreed to take a human body and was bom of Devaki as the son of Vasudeva.
verses.commentary: Sense: Under the pretext of the curse of Bhrgu, Visnu agreed to take a human body and was bom of Devaki as the son of Vasudeva.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य मध्ये ऽतिरात्रस्य सदोमध्यात्समुत्थितः ततस्तु विद्वान् सर्वज्ञो दाता यज्वा पुनर्वसुः
verses.transliteration: tasya madhye 'tirātrasya sadomadhyātsamutthitaḥ tatastu vidvān sarvajño dātā yajvā punarvasuḥ
verses.translation: At the same time the Yogicslumber Kauiki originating from the body of Uma became the daughter of Yasoda at the behest of the lord of Devas.
verses.hindi: उसी समयसे देवताओंके स्वामी शिवने प्रजाओंका सृजन नहीं किया और वे प्रलयपर्यन्त स्थाणुवत् स्थित रहे तथा ब्रह्मचारी बने रहे। चूँकि उन्होंने कहा था कि “मैं स्थित हूँ-इसलिये वे ' स्थाणु' कहे गये । ये भगवान्
verses.wordMeaning: At the same time the Yogicslumber Kauiki originating from the body of Uma became the daughter of Yasoda at the behest of the lord of Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: At the same time the Yogicslumber Kauiki originating from the body of Uma became the daughter of Yasoda at the behest of the lord of Devas.

verses.sanskrit: तस्यापि पुत्रमिथुनं बभूवाभिजितः किल आहुकश्चाहुकी चैव ख्यातौ कीर्तिमतां वरौ
verses.transliteration: tasyāpi putramithunaṃ babhūvābhijitaḥ kila āhukaścāhukī caiva khyātau kīrtimatāṃ varau
verses.translation: She alone is the Prakrti bowed to by all Devas. Lord Krna is Purua the bestower of the fruit of virtue and salva- tion.
verses.hindi: महादेव पुरुषस्वरूप, सूर्यके समान तेजवाले, अपने तेजसे अग्निके समान प्रतीत होनेवाले तथा आधा भाग नर और आधा भाग नारीके शरीरवाले हैं। वे अपनी इच्छासे दो भागोंमें अलग-अलग स्त्री तथा पुरुषरूपमें विभक्त हुए। वे परमेश्वर आधे भागसे ग्यारह रूपोंमें स्थित हैं । उसमें जो शंकरकी अर्धांगिनी महाभागा महादेवी कही गयी हैं; वे ही भगवती पूर्वकालमें दक्षके द्वारा आराधित होकर
verses.wordMeaning: She alone is the Prakrti bowed to by all Devas. Lord Krna is Purua the bestower of the fruit of virtue and salva- tion.
verses.commentary: Sense: She alone is the Prakrti bowed to by all Devas. Lord Krna is Purua the bestower of the fruit of virtue and salva- tion.

verses.sanskrit: आहुकात् काश्यदुहितुर् द्वौ पुत्रौ संबभूवतुः देवकश्चोग्रसेनश् च देवगर्भसमावुभौ
verses.transliteration: āhukāt kāśyaduhitur dvau putrau saṃbabhūvatuḥ devakaścograsenaś ca devagarbhasamāvubhau
verses.translation: Saving his own son from Kaihsa, Vasudeva took the daughter of Yasoda and instead gave her his own four- armed, wide-eyed son who was marked by the scar Srivatsa and who held the conch, discus, iron club and lotus.
verses.hindi: जगत्के हितके लिये सतीके रूपमें आविर्भूत हुई थीं सृष्टिकार्यके लिये उनका दाहिना भाग श्वेत तथा बाया भाग कृष्ण था। जब भगवान् शम्भुने उनसे कहा कि अपनेको विभक्त करो, तब है द्विजो! उनके ऐसा कहनेपर
verses.wordMeaning: Saving his own son from Kaihsa, Vasudeva took the daughter of Yasoda and instead gave her his own four- armed, wide-eyed son who was marked by the scar Srivatsa and who held the conch, discus, iron club and lotus.
verses.commentary: Sense: Saving his own son from Kaihsa, Vasudeva took the daughter of Yasoda and instead gave her his own four- armed, wide-eyed son who was marked by the scar Srivatsa and who held the conch, discus, iron club and lotus.

verses.sanskrit: देवकस्य सुता राज्ञो जज्ञिरे त्रिदशोपमाः देववान् उपदेवश् च सुदेवो देवरक्षितः
verses.transliteration: devakasya sutā rājño jajñire tridaśopamāḥ devavān upadevaś ca sudevo devarakṣitaḥ
verses.translation: After giving to Nanda (the husband of Yasoda) his son Vi§nu the protector of the worlds who had taken up a physical form out of his own will, he said to Nanda — ''May he be protected.''
verses.hindi: वे शुक्ल तथा कृष्ण दो रूपोंमें विभक्त हो गयीं। थ मैं उनके नाम बताऊँगा; आपलोग एकाग्रचित्त होकर अध्याय ७० महेश्वरसे होनेवाली आदिसृष्टिका स्वरूप-“सतीकी देहसे अनेक देवियोंका प्रादुर्भाव हर
verses.wordMeaning: After giving to Nanda (the husband of Yasoda) his son Vi§nu the protector of the worlds who had taken up a physical form out of his own will, he said to Nanda — ''May he be protected.''
verses.commentary: Sense: After giving to Nanda (the husband of Yasoda) his son Vi§nu the protector of the worlds who had taken up a physical form out of his own will, he said to Nanda — ''May he be protected.''

verses.sanskrit: तेषां स्वसारः सप्तासन् वसुदेवाय ता ददौ वृषदेवोपदेवा च तथान्या देवरक्षिता
verses.transliteration: teṣāṃ svasāraḥ saptāsan vasudevāya tā dadau vṛṣadevopadevā ca tathānyā devarakṣitā
verses.translation: It was due to the grace of Siva the lord of Devas of immense splendour that Vifu assumed the physical body. Along widi Ra he handed over the lord the bestower of boons, the great livara, the preceptor of the universe, who had
verses.hindi: तन सालका त तत तत नत
verses.wordMeaning: It was due to the grace of Siva the lord of Devas of immense splendour that Vifu assumed the physical body. Along widi Ra he handed over the lord the bestower of boons, the great livara, the preceptor of the universe, who had
verses.commentary: Sense: It was due to the grace of Siva the lord of Devas of immense splendour that Vifu assumed the physical body. Along widi Ra he handed over the lord the bestower of boons, the great livara, the preceptor of the universe, who had

verses.sanskrit: श्रीदेवा शान्तिदेवा च सहदेवा तथापरा देवकी चापि तासां च वरिष्ठाभूत्सुमध्यमा
verses.transliteration: śrīdevā śāntidevā ca sahadevā tathāparā devakī cāpi tāsāṃ ca variṣṭhābhūtsumadhyamā
verses.translation: O foolish Kaihsa, even as you were guarding your own body you have committed sins. Indeed your destroyer is already born."
verses.hindi: सती दक्षायणी विद्या इच्छा शक्तिः क्रियात्मिका उमा हैमवती चैव कल्याणी चैकमातृका
verses.wordMeaning: O foolish Kaihsa, even as you were guarding your own body you have committed sins. Indeed your destroyer is already born."
verses.commentary: Sense: O foolish Kaihsa, even as you were guarding your own body you have committed sins. Indeed your destroyer is already born."

verses.sanskrit: नवोग्रसेनस्य सुतास् तेषां कंसस्तु पूर्वजः तेषां पुत्राश्च पौत्राश् च शतशो ऽथ सहस्रशः
verses.transliteration: navograsenasya sutās teṣāṃ kaṃsastu pūrvajaḥ teṣāṃ putrāśca pautrāś ca śataśo 'tha sahasraśaḥ
verses.translation: It is said that due to his fear of Devaki, Kariisa killed the eighth child. But the eighth son of Devaki was really the cause of his death.
verses.hindi: द्यातिः प्रज्ञा महाभागा लोके गौरीति विश्रुता
verses.wordMeaning: It is said that due to his fear of Devaki, Kariisa killed the eighth child. But the eighth son of Devaki was really the cause of his death.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is said that due to his fear of Devaki, Kariisa killed the eighth child. But the eighth son of Devaki was really the cause of his death.

verses.sanskrit: देवकस्य सुता पत्नी वसुदेवस्य धीमतः बभूव वन्द्या पूज्या च देवैरपि पतिव्रता
verses.transliteration: devakasya sutā patnī vasudevasya dhīmataḥ babhūva vandyā pūjyā ca devairapi pativratā
verses.translation: O leading sages, all attempts of Bhoja to take revenge on him became futile due to Krsna's power. Moreover he was rendered insentient by the Maya Kausiki.
verses.hindi: गणाम्बिका महादेवी नन्दिनी जातवेदसी दाक्षायणी, विद्या, इच्छा, शक्ति, क्रियात्मिका, अपर्णा, एकपर्णा, एकपाटला, उमा, हैमवती, कल्याणी, एकमातूका, ख्याति, प्रज्ञा, महाभागा, लोकप्रसिद्ध गौरी, गणाम्बिका, महादेवी, नन्दिनी तथा जातवेदसी-ये नाम हैं  पृथक् देह
verses.wordMeaning: O leading sages, all attempts of Bhoja to take revenge on him became futile due to Krsna's power. Moreover he was rendered insentient by the Maya Kausiki.
verses.commentary: Sense: O leading sages, all attempts of Bhoja to take revenge on him became futile due to Krsna's power. Moreover he was rendered insentient by the Maya Kausiki.

verses.sanskrit: रोहिणी च महाभागा पत्नी चानकदुन्दुभेः पौरवी बाह्लिकसुता संपूज्यासीत्सुरैरपि
verses.transliteration: rohiṇī ca mahābhāgā patnī cānakadundubheḥ pauravī bāhlikasutā saṃpūjyāsītsurairapi
verses.translation: Thus Kamsa was killed by Krsna of unimpeded acti- vity. Many other destroyers of Devas and brahmins too were killed.
verses.hindi: एकरूपमथैतस्या पृथग्देहविभावनात्। धारण करनेसे पहले इनका एक ही रूप था। सावित्री, सावित्री वरदा पुण्या पावनी लोकविश्रुता॥ ३३३ वरदा, पुण्या, पावनी, लोकविश्रुता, आज्ञा, आवेशनी, कृष्णा, आज्ञा आवेशनी कृष्णा तामसी सात्त्विकी शिवा । तामसी, सात्त्विकी, शिवा, प्रकृति, विकृता, रौद्री, दुर्गा,
verses.wordMeaning: Thus Kamsa was killed by Krsna of unimpeded acti- vity. Many other destroyers of Devas and brahmins too were killed.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus Kamsa was killed by Krsna of unimpeded acti- vity. Many other destroyers of Devas and brahmins too were killed.

verses.sanskrit: असूत रोहिणी रामं बलश्रेष्ठं हलायुधम् आश्रितं कंसभीत्या च स्वात्मानं शान्ततेजसम्
verses.transliteration: asūta rohiṇī rāmaṃ balaśreṣṭhaṃ halāyudham āśritaṃ kaṃsabhītyā ca svātmānaṃ śāntatejasam
verses.translation: Krsna's sons Pradyumna and others have already been enumerated. They were many and all of them were experts in battle.
verses.hindi: भद्रा, प्रमाथिनी, कालरात्रि, महामाया, रेवती, भूतनायिका- हे सुब्रतो! द्वापरयुगके अन्तमें ये उनके नाम हुए। इसी प्रकार गौतमी, कोशिकी, आर्या, चण्डी, कात्यायनी, सती, कुमारी, यादवी, देवी, वरदा, कृष्णपिंगला, बर्हिध्वजा, शूलधरा, परमा, ब्रह्मचारिणी, महेन्द्रोपेद्रभगिनी, दूषद्वती,
verses.wordMeaning: Krsna's sons Pradyumna and others have already been enumerated. They were many and all of them were experts in battle.
verses.commentary: Sense: Krsna's sons Pradyumna and others have already been enumerated. They were many and all of them were experts in battle.

verses.sanskrit: जाते रामे ऽथ निहते षड्गर्भे चातिदक्षिणे वसुदेवो हरिं धीमान् देवक्यामुदपादयत्
verses.transliteration: jāte rāme 'tha nihate ṣaḍgarbhe cātidakṣiṇe vasudevo hariṃ dhīmān devakyāmudapādayat
verses.translation: Krsna's sons were equal to Krsna. Among all these sons Carudesna and his brothers are of special importance. They were the sons of Rukmini. They were the destroyers of their enemies. Kfsna had sixteen thousand and one hundred wives. The most beloved and the eldest of them all was Rukrninl.
verses.hindi: शुम्भादिहैत्यहन्त्री, महामहिषमर्दिनी, अमोघा, विन्ध्यनिलया, विक्रान्ता, गणनायिका-मैंने देवी भद्रकालीके इन नामविकारोंको यथाक्रम बता दिया, जो सम्यक् फल प्रदान करनेवाले हैं। जो लोग इनका पाठ करते हैं, उनका पाप
verses.wordMeaning: Krsna's sons were equal to Krsna. Among all these sons Carudesna and his brothers are of special importance. They were the sons of Rukmini. They were the destroyers of their enemies. Kfsna had sixteen thousand and one hundred wives.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Krsna's sons were equal to Krsna. Among all these sons Carudesna and his brothers are of special importance. They were the sons of Rukmini. They were the destroyers of their enemies. Kfsna had sixteen thousand and one hundred wives.…

verses.sanskrit: स एव परमात्मासौ देवदेवो जनार्दनः हलायुधश् च भगवान् अनन्तो रजतप्रभः
verses.transliteration: sa eva paramātmāsau devadevo janārdanaḥ halāyudhaś ca bhagavān ananto rajataprabhaḥ
verses.translation: On seeing those heroic sons of Rukmini as well as Rukmif, Jambavati the wife of Ksna once spoke to him thus.
verses.hindi: शेष नहीं रह जाता है। जंगलमें, पर्वतपर, नगरमें, घरमें, जल अथवा स्थल कहीं भी रक्षाके लिये इनका प्रयोग करना चाहिए। विशेष रूपसे बाघ, हाथी तथा चोरोंसे भयके स्थानमें और सभी प्रकारकी विपत्तियोंमें देवीके नामोंको पढ़ना चाहिए । बुरे ग्रहों, भूतों, पूतना तथा मातृगणोंसे पीडित शिशुओंकी रक्षाके लिये इन नामोंका प्रयोग करना चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing those heroic sons of Rukmini as well as Rukmif, Jambavati the wife of Ksna once spoke to him thus.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing those heroic sons of Rukmini as well as Rukmif, Jambavati the wife of Ksna once spoke to him thus.

verses.sanskrit: भृगुशापछलेनैव मानयन्मानुषीं तनुम् बभूव तस्यां देवक्यां वासुदेवो जनार्दन
verses.transliteration: bhṛguśāpachalenaiva mānayanmānuṣīṃ tanum babhūva tasyāṃ devakyāṃ vāsudevo janārdana
verses.translation: O lotus-eyed one, it behoves you, if you are delighted, to give me a son equal to Devas, a son endowed with superior qualities.
verses.hindi: परज्ञा' तथा ' श्री -ये महादेवीकी दो कलाएँ कही गयी हैं । इन दोनोंसे हजारों देवियाँ उत्पन्न हुई हैं, जिनके
verses.wordMeaning: O lotus-eyed one, it behoves you, if you are delighted, to give me a son equal to Devas, a son endowed with superior qualities.
verses.commentary: Sense: O lotus-eyed one, it behoves you, if you are delighted, to give me a son equal to Devas, a son endowed with superior qualities.

verses.sanskrit: उमादेहसमुद्भूता योगनिद्रा च कौशिकी नियोगाद्देवदेवस्य यशोदातनया ह्यभूत्
verses.transliteration: umādehasamudbhūtā yoganidrā ca kauśikī niyogāddevadevasya yaśodātanayā hyabhūt
verses.translation: On hearing the words of Jambavati, Krsna the lord of the universe and a real storehouse of penance began to perform penance.
verses.hindi: कालरात्रिर्महामाया रेवती भूतनायिका। गौतमी कौशिकी चार्या चण्डी कात्यायनी सती। कुमारी यादवी देवी वरदा कृष्णपिङ्लला
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing the words of Jambavati, Krsna the lord of the universe and a real storehouse of penance began to perform penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the words of Jambavati, Krsna the lord of the universe and a real storehouse of penance began to perform penance.

verses.sanskrit: सा चैव प्रकृतिः साक्षात् सर्वदेवनमस्कृता पुरुषो भगवान्कृष्णो धर्ममोक्षफलप्रदः
verses.transliteration: sā caiva prakṛtiḥ sākṣāt sarvadevanamaskṛtā puruṣo bhagavānkṛṣṇo dharmamokṣaphalapradaḥ
verses.translation: Kr§igia NarSyana, the wieldcr of the conch, discus and iron club, went to the excellent hermitage of the sage Vyaghrapada. After bowing to the sage, Krsna obtained the divine Paupata Yoga. At his behest he shaved off the beard, moustache and the hair on the head, applied ghee all over the body and wore the girdle of the Munja grass. Thus initiated, lord Krsa the scorcher of foes performed a great penance.
verses.hindi: बर्दिध्वजा शूलधरा परमा ब्रह्मचारिणी। महेन्द्रोपेन्द्रभगिनी दूषद्ठत्येकशूलधृक्
verses.wordMeaning: Kr§igia NarSyana, the wieldcr of the conch, discus and iron club, went to the excellent hermitage of the sage Vyaghrapada. After bowing to the sage, Krsna obtained the divine Paupata Yoga. At his behest he shaved off the beard, moustache and the hair on the head,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Kr§igia NarSyana, the wieldcr of the conch, discus and iron club, went to the excellent hermitage of the sage Vyaghrapada. After bowing to the sage, Krsna obtained the divine Paupata Yoga. At his behest he shaved off the beard, moustache and the hair on the head,…

verses.sanskrit: तां कन्यां जगृहे रक्षन् कंसात्स्वस्यात्मजं तदा चतुर्भुजं विशालाक्षं श्रीवत्सकृतलाञ्छनम्
verses.transliteration: tāṃ kanyāṃ jagṛhe rakṣan kaṃsātsvasyātmajaṃ tadā caturbhujaṃ viśālākṣaṃ śrīvatsakṛtalāñchanam
verses.translation: He performed the penance in various poses. He stood with arms raised up and without support, he stood on the tips of his toes. He spent three seasons sustaining himself on fruits, water and air.
verses.hindi: शुम्भादिहैत्यहन्त्री च महामहिषमर्दिनी अमोघा विन्ध्यनिलया विक्रान्ता गणनायिका। देव्या नामविकाराणि इत्येतानि यथाक्रमम्
verses.wordMeaning: He performed the penance in various poses. He stood with arms raised up and without support, he stood on the tips of his toes. He spent three seasons sustaining himself on fruits, water and air.
verses.commentary: Sense: He performed the penance in various poses. He stood with arms raised up and without support, he stood on the tips of his toes. He spent three seasons sustaining himself on fruits, water and air.

verses.sanskrit: शङ्खचक्रगदापद्मं धारयन्तं जनार्दनम् यशोदायै प्रदत्त्वा तु वसुदेवश् च बुद्धिमान्
verses.transliteration: śaṅkhacakragadāpadmaṃ dhārayantaṃ janārdanam yaśodāyai pradattvā tu vasudevaś ca buddhimān
verses.translation: Satisfied with his penance, lord Siva granted him boons. He gave Samba the son of Jbavati to Krma the noble soul.
verses.hindi: भद्रकाल्या मयोक्तानि सम्यक्फलप्रदानि च। ये पठन्ति नरास्तेषां विद्यते न च पातकम्
verses.wordMeaning: Satisfied with his penance, lord Siva granted him boons. He gave Samba the son of Jbavati to Krma the noble soul.
verses.commentary: Sense: Satisfied with his penance, lord Siva granted him boons. He gave Samba the son of Jbavati to Krma the noble soul.

verses.sanskrit: दत्त्वैनं नन्दगोपस्य रक्षतामिति चाब्रवीत् रक्षकं जगतां विष्णुं स्वेच्छया धृतविग्रहम्
verses.transliteration: dattvainaṃ nandagopasya rakṣatāmiti cābravīt rakṣakaṃ jagatāṃ viṣṇuṃ svecchayā dhṛtavigraham
verses.translation: On getting the son Samba from Krsna, his wife Jamba- vat! became highly delighted in the same way as Aditi when she obtained Aditya.
verses.hindi: आपत्स्वपि च सर्वासु देव्या नामानि कीर्तयेत् बनी कले द्वे तु प्रज्ञा श्रीश्च EE ३४  सम्पूर्ण जगत् व्याप्त है । देवदेव महेश्वर परमेश्वर रुद्र
verses.wordMeaning: On getting the son Samba from Krsna, his wife Jamba- vat! became highly delighted in the same way as Aditi when she obtained Aditya.
verses.commentary: Sense: On getting the son Samba from Krsna, his wife Jamba- vat! became highly delighted in the same way as Aditi when she obtained Aditya.

verses.sanskrit: प्रसादाच्चैव देवस्य शिवस्यामिततेजसः रामेण सार्धं तं दत्त्वा वरदं परमेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: prasādāccaiva devasya śivasyāmitatejasaḥ rāmeṇa sārdhaṃ taṃ dattvā varadaṃ parameśvaram
verses.translation: O leading sages, by the curse®®® of Lord Siva the thousand hands of Bana were cut off by Kr$na.
verses.hindi: विद्यमान रहते हैं रुद्र पशुपति हैं । इन्होंने ही पूर्वकालमें त्रिपुरको दग्ध किया था। उन्हींके तेजसे सभी देवता पशु जीव हुए। जो व्यक्ति आदिसृष्टिके शुभ क्रमको पढ़ता है अथवा सुनता है अथवा उत्तम द्विजोंको सुनाता है,
verses.wordMeaning: O leading sages, by the curse®®® of Lord Siva the thousand hands of Bana were cut off by Kr$na.
verses.commentary: Sense: O leading sages, by the curse®®® of Lord Siva the thousand hands of Bana were cut off by Kr$na.

verses.sanskrit: भूभारनिग्रहार्थं च ह्य् अवतीर्णं जगद्गुरुम् अतो वै सर्वकल्याणं यादवानां भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: bhūbhāranigrahārthaṃ ca hy avatīrṇaṃ jagadgurum ato vai sarvakalyāṇaṃ yādavānāṃ bhaviṣyati
verses.translation: Then with Balarama to assist him he carried out the destruction of Daityas. He sportively killed several wicked kings in the battlefield.
verses.hindi: बह ब्रह्मलोकको जाता है ॥ ३५४ ३४७॥ आतिष्ठत्सर्वलोकानां हिताय परमेश्वरः
verses.wordMeaning: Then with Balarama to assist him he carried out the destruction of Daityas. He sportively killed several wicked kings in the battlefield.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then with Balarama to assist him he carried out the destruction of Daityas. He sportively killed several wicked kings in the battlefield.

verses.sanskrit: अयं स गर्भो देवक्या यो नः क्लेश्यान्हरिष्यति उग्रसेनात्मजायाथ कंसायानकदुन्दुभिः
verses.transliteration: ayaṃ sa garbho devakyā yo naḥ kleśyānhariṣyati ugrasenātmajāyātha kaṃsāyānakadundubhiḥ
verses.translation: He killed the leading Daitya Naraka born of Devas.
verses.hindi: रुद्रः पशुपतिश्चासीत्पुरा दग्धं पुरत्रयम् देवाश्च पशवः सर्वे बभूवुस्तस्य तेजसा
verses.wordMeaning: He killed the leading Daitya Naraka born of Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: He killed the leading Daitya Naraka born of Devas.

verses.sanskrit: निवेदयामास तदा जातां कन्यां सुलक्षणाम् अस्यास्तवाष्टमो गर्भो देवक्याः कंस सुव्रत
verses.transliteration: nivedayāmāsa tadā jātāṃ kanyāṃ sulakṣaṇām asyāstavāṣṭamo garbho devakyāḥ kaṃsa suvrata
verses.translation: Rudrasya i&p&t— -S&mba, ion of Srlkroa, cut off a thousand arms of Bfta. For a difoent verdon, see H.M.
verses.hindi: स याति ब्रह्मणो लोक श्रावयेद्वा द्विजोत्तमात् ३४७ जिम सन अजब कल Rn फ फ़ फ फ फफ फ फ़ फ फ फ फ़ फ फ़ फ फ फ फ़ फ फ फ़ फ़ फ फ़ फ छ क फ फर फ़ फा फी फफ फफफ फ फफ फ फफ फक फफ फफफ काका फफफ फफफ फक फफफ फ फफफ फ फफफ कक र

verses.commentary: Sense: Rudrasya i&p&t— -S&mba, ion of Srlkroa, cut off a thousand arms of Bfta. For a difoent verdon, see H.M.

verses.sanskrit: मृत्युर् एव न संदेह इति वाणी पुरातनी ततस्तां हन्तुमारेभे कंसः सोल्लङ्घ्य चांबरम्
verses.transliteration: mṛtyur eva na saṃdeha iti vāṇī purātanī tatastāṃ hantumārebhe kaṃsaḥ sollaṅghya cāṃbaram
verses.translation: The excessively strong one, of unequalled exploit, Kfsna took up sixteen thousand one hundred girls for his own pleasure.
verses.hindi: तारकासुरके पुत्रों--विद्युन्माली, तारकाक्ष तथा कमलाक्षका वृत्तान्त एवं तपस्याद्वारा ङ्ह कामचारी तीन पुरोंकी प्राप्ति, त्रिपुरासुरके विनाशके लिये देवताओंका उद्योग तथा भगवान् शंकरका उनपर अनुग्रह
verses.wordMeaning: The excessively strong one, of unequalled exploit, Kfsna took up sixteen thousand one hundred girls for his own pleasure.
verses.commentary: Sense: The excessively strong one, of unequalled exploit, Kfsna took up sixteen thousand one hundred girls for his own pleasure.

verses.sanskrit: उवाचाष्टभुजा देवी मेघगंभीरया गिरा रक्षस्व तत्स्वकं देहम् आयातो मृत्युरेव ते
verses.transliteration: uvācāṣṭabhujā devī meghagaṃbhīrayā girā rakṣasva tatsvakaṃ deham āyāto mṛtyureva te
verses.translation: More than hundred years elapsed thus even as Krsna ruled over Dvaraka* removing the distress due to old age. He acceded to the curses of Vivamitra,®®® Kanva®® and Narada,®® as also the words of Durvasas (and stayed) in Pindaraka.®®®
verses.hindi: कथं च पशवश्चासन् देवाः सब्रह्मकाः प्रभोः । मयस्य तपसा पूर्व सुदुर्गं निर्मितं पुरम् हैमं च राजतं दिव्यमयस्मयमनुत्तमम्। सुदुर्ग देवदेवेन दग्धमित्येव नः श्रुतम्
verses.wordMeaning: More than hundred years elapsed thus even as Krsna ruled over Dvaraka* removing the distress due to old age. He acceded to the curses of Vivamitra,®®® Kanva®® and Narada,®® as also the words of Durvasas (and stayed) in Pindaraka.®®®
verses.commentary: Sense: More than hundred years elapsed thus even as Krsna ruled over Dvaraka* removing the distress due to old age. He acceded to the curses of Vivamitra,®®® Kanva®® and Narada,®® as also the words of Durvasas (and stayed) in Pindaraka.®®®

verses.sanskrit: रक्षमाणस्य देहस्य मायावी कंसरूपिणः किं कृतं दुष्कृतं मूर्ख जातः खलु तवान्तकृत्
verses.transliteration: rakṣamāṇasya dehasya māyāvī kaṃsarūpiṇaḥ kiṃ kṛtaṃ duṣkṛtaṃ mūrkha jātaḥ khalu tavāntakṛt
verses.translation: Krsna abandoned the human form under the pretext of the arrow of the hunter Jaraka, and after blessing that hunter he returned to heaven.
verses.hindi: कथं ददाह भगवान् भगनेत्रनिपातनः। एकेनेषुनिपातेन दिव्येनापि तदा कथम्
verses.wordMeaning: Krsna abandoned the human form under the pretext of the arrow of the hunter Jaraka, and after blessing that hunter he returned to heaven.
verses.commentary: Sense: Krsna abandoned the human form under the pretext of the arrow of the hunter Jaraka, and after blessing that hunter he returned to heaven.

verses.sanskrit: देवक्याः स भयात्कंसो जघानैवाष्टमं त्विति स्मरन्ति विहितो मृत्युर् देवक्यास् तनयो ऽष्टमः
verses.transliteration: devakyāḥ sa bhayātkaṃso jaghānaivāṣṭamaṃ tviti smaranti vihito mṛtyur devakyās tanayo 'ṣṭamaḥ
verses.translation: Due to the curse of Asfavakra®®' as also due to his own Maya (power) the wives of lord Kra were abducted by thieves.
verses.hindi: विष्णुनोत्पादितैर्भूतैर्न दग्धं तत्पुरत्रयम्। तेषां तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा सूतः पौराणिकोत्तमः
verses.wordMeaning: Due to the curse of Asfavakra®®' as also due to his own Maya (power) the wives of lord Kra were abducted by thieves.
verses.commentary: Sense: Due to the curse of Asfavakra®®' as also due to his own Maya (power) the wives of lord Kra were abducted by thieves.

verses.sanskrit: यस्तत्प्रतिकृतौ यत्नो भोजस्यासीद्वृथा हरेः प्रभावान्मुनिशार्दूलास् तया चैव जडीकृतः
verses.transliteration: yastatpratikṛtau yatno bhojasyāsīdvṛthā hareḥ prabhāvānmuniśārdūlās tayā caiva jaḍīkṛtaḥ
verses.translation: Balarama abandoned his human form and assuming that of Sesa went to his heavenly abode. The auspicious queens of Krsna — Rukmini and others — entered fire along with the body of their lord. O brahmins, the gentle lady Revati too entered the pyre along with her husband Balarama and followed his path. The extremely powerful Arjuna performed the obsequies of Krsna, Rama and also of other Vrnis. O men
verses.hindi: यथा श्रुतं तथा प्राह व्यासाद्विश्वार्थसूचकात्।
verses.wordMeaning: Balarama abandoned his human form and assuming that of Sesa went to his heavenly abode. The auspicious queens of Krsna — Rukmini and others — entered fire along with the body of their lord. O brahmins,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Balarama abandoned his human form and assuming that of Sesa went to his heavenly abode. The auspicious queens of Krsna — Rukmini and others — entered fire along with the body of their lord. O brahmins,…

verses.sanskrit: कंसो ऽपि निहतस्तेन कृष्णेनाक्लिष्टकर्मणा निहता बहवश्चान्ये देवब्राह्मणघातिनः
verses.transliteration: kaṃso 'pi nihatastena kṛṣṇenākliṣṭakarmaṇā nihatā bahavaścānye devabrāhmaṇaghātinaḥ
verses.translation: Prabh§sa— it is a celebrated place of pilgrimage in Saura§tra the southern part of Kathiawar. *a city near Okha in Kathiawar.
verses.hindi: त्रैलोक्यस्यास्य शापाद्धि मनोवाक्कायसम्भवात् निहते तारके हैत्ये तारपुत्रे सबान्धवे। स्कन्देन वा प्रयतेन तस्य पुत्रा महाबलाः
verses.wordMeaning: Prabh§sa— it is a celebrated place of pilgrimage in Saura§tra the southern part of Kathiawar. *a city near Okha in Kathiawar.
verses.commentary: Sense: Prabh§sa— it is a celebrated place of pilgrimage in Saura§tra the southern part of Kathiawar. *a city near Okha in Kathiawar.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य कृष्णस्य तनयाः प्रद्युम्नप्रमुखास् तथा बहवः परिसंख्याताः सर्वे युद्धविशारदाः
verses.transliteration: tasya kṛṣṇasya tanayāḥ pradyumnapramukhās tathā bahavaḥ parisaṃkhyātāḥ sarve yuddhaviśāradāḥ
verses.translation: For detail, Bhaga, Janayi9yati vo manda musalath kulana- ianam -cited in ST,
verses.hindi: विद्युन्माली तारकाक्षः कमलाक्षश्च वीर्यवान्। तपस्तेपुर्महात्मानो महाबलपराक्रमाः

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीलिङ्गमहापुराणे पूर्वभागे सोमवंशानुकीर्तनं नामैकोनसप्ततितमो ऽध्यायः आदिसर्गस्त्वया सूत सूचितो न प्रकाशितः सांप्रतं विस्तरेणैव वक्तुमर्हसि सुव्रत
verses.transliteration: iti śrīliṅgamahāpurāṇe pūrvabhāge somavaṃśānukīrtanaṃ nāmaikonasaptatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ ādisargastvayā sūta sūcito na prakāśitaḥ sāṃprataṃ vistareṇaiva vaktumarhasi suvrata
verses.translation: O leading sages, the great lord Siva is stationed beyond Prakrti and Purusa.®*® He is the greatest soul.
verses.hindi: महादेवेतरं त्यक्त्वा देवं तस्यार्चनं स्थितैः। नीलाद्रिमेरुसङ्काशैरनीरदोपमनिःस्वनैः ।
verses.wordMeaning: O leading sages, the great lord Siva is stationed beyond Prakrti and Purusa.®*® He is the greatest soul.
verses.commentary: Sense: O leading sages, the great lord Siva is stationed beyond Prakrti and Purusa.®*® He is the greatest soul.

verses.sanskrit: महेश्वरो महादेवः प्रकृतेः पुरुषस्य च परत्वे संस्थितो देवः परमात्मा मुनीश्वराः
verses.transliteration: maheśvaro mahādevaḥ prakṛteḥ puruṣasya ca paratve saṃsthito devaḥ paramātmā munīśvarāḥ
verses.translation: The unmanifest originated from that lord as the
verses.hindi: हे सुव्रतो! है विप्रेन्द्रो! इस प्रकार हैत्योंके किलोंसे युक्त वे तीनों पुर दूसरे त्रिलोकीके समान धे। तब तीनों पुरोंके निर्मित हो जानेपर वे सभी हैत्य उन तीनों पुरोंमें प्रवेश करके तीनों लोकोंमें अत्यधिक
verses.wordMeaning: The unmanifest originated from that lord as the
verses.commentary: Sense: The unmanifest originated from that lord as the

verses.sanskrit: अव्यक्तं चेश्वरात्तस्माद् अभवत्कारणं परम् प्रधानं प्रकृतिश्चेति यदाहुस्तत्त्वचिन्तकाः
verses.transliteration: avyaktaṃ ceśvarāttasmād abhavatkāraṇaṃ param pradhānaṃ prakṛtiśceti yadāhustattvacintakāḥ
verses.translation: It is devoid of smell, colour and taste. It has neither sound nor touch. It is unageing, stable, imperishable and per- petually stationed in the soul.
verses.hindi: उनके तीनों पुर कल्पवृक्षोंसे भरे हुए, हाथी. घोड़ोंसे परिपूर्ण, अनेक भवनोंसे सुशोभित, मणियोंके जालोंसे घिरे हुए, सभी और द्वारोंवाले, सूर्यमण्डलसदृश विमानोंसे युक्त, पद्मरागमय चन्द्रसदृश उज्ज्वल महलोंसे सुशोभित और कैलासशिखरके समान दिव्य तथा अत्युत्तम फाटकोंसे पृथक्-पृथक् मण्डित थे। है श्रेष्ठ द्विजो। वे पुर दिव्य स्त्रियों, गन्धर्वो, सिद्धों एवं चारणोंसे भरे हुए थे। प्रत्येक घरमें रुद्रालय थे और अग्निहोत्र होता था।
verses.wordMeaning: It is devoid of smell, colour and taste. It has neither sound nor touch. It is unageing, stable, imperishable and per- petually stationed in the soul.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is devoid of smell, colour and taste. It has neither sound nor touch. It is unageing, stable, imperishable and per- petually stationed in the soul.

verses.sanskrit: गन्धवर्णरसैर् हीनं शब्दस्पर्शविवर्जितम् अजरं ध्रुवमक्षय्यं नित्यं स्वात्मन्यवस्थितम्
verses.transliteration: gandhavarṇarasair hīnaṃ śabdasparśavivarjitam ajaraṃ dhruvamakṣayyaṃ nityaṃ svātmanyavasthitam
verses.translation: It is the source of origin of the universe. It is the eter- nal great Brahman, the massive being. It is the physical
verses.hindi: बड़ी झीलोंसे युक्त थे; मत्त हाथियोंके झुण्डों, अति सुन्दर घोड़ों, चारों ओर मुखवाले अनेक प्रकारके अद्भुत रथों, सभाभवनों, पानीय (जल)-की शालाओं तथा क्रोड़ास्थलोंसे पृथक्-पृथक् समन्वित थे। वे पुर चारों
verses.wordMeaning: It is the source of origin of the universe. It is the eter- nal great Brahman, the massive being. It is the physical
verses.commentary: Sense: It is the source of origin of the universe. It is the eter- nal great Brahman, the massive being. It is the physical

verses.sanskrit: जगद्योनिं महाभूतं परं ब्रह्म सनातनम् विग्रहः सर्वभूतानाम् ईश्वराज्ञाप्रचोदितम्
verses.transliteration: jagadyoniṃ mahābhūtaṃ paraṃ brahma sanātanam vigrahaḥ sarvabhūtānām īśvarājñāpracoditam
verses.translation: At the outset the Pradhana existed in the form of
verses.hindi: ओर अनेकविध वेदाध्ययनशालाओंसे युक्त थे और मय दानव-को मायासे अन्य लोगाँद्वारा मनसे भी अलंघ्य थे। है मुनिश्रेष्ठो! वे पुर सर्वत्र पतिव्रता स्त्रियोंके द्वारा सेवित थे। है द्विजो! वे पुर बड़े-बड़े पाप करके भी शंकरजीकी पूजाके कारण पापरहित, श्रौत-स्मार्त धर्मोके ज्ञाता तथा अपने धर्मके प्रति परायण भार्यासहित महाभाग्यशाली हैत्योंसे सदा समन्वित थे; महादेवके अतिरिक्त अन्य देवताको छोड़कर उन शिव-के
verses.wordMeaning: At the outset the Pradhana existed in the form of
verses.commentary: Sense: At the outset the Pradhana existed in the form of

verses.sanskrit: अनाद्यन्तमजं सूक्ष्मं त्रिगुणं प्रभवाव्ययम् अप्रकाशमविज्ञेयं ब्रह्माग्रे समवर्तत
verses.transliteration: anādyantamajaṃ sūkṣmaṃ triguṇaṃ prabhavāvyayam aprakāśamavijñeyaṃ brahmāgre samavartata
verses.translation: The transcendent God Mahevara is higher than Prakrti and Purua* (Sec note 56). Gf. SP, Prakrtei ca parath Brahma yat tac chivam udahrtam— cited in ST,
verses.hindi: अर्चनमें स्थित, चौड़ी छातीवाले, बैलके समान कंधेवाले, सर्वदा समस्त आयुध धारण करनेवाले, सदा उपवास करनेवाले, दावानलके समान नेत्रोंवाले, उनमें कुछ शान्त तथा कुछ कुपित, कुबड़े, बौने, नील कमलदलकी
verses.wordMeaning: The transcendent God Mahevara is higher than Prakrti and Purua* (Sec note 56). Gf. SP, Prakrtei ca parath Brahma yat tac chivam udahrtam— cited in ST,
verses.commentary: Sense: The transcendent God Mahevara is higher than Prakrti and Purua* (Sec note 56). Gf. SP, Prakrtei ca parath Brahma yat tac chivam udahrtam— cited in ST,

verses.sanskrit: अस्यात्मना सर्वमिदं व्याप्तं त्वासीच्छिवेच्छया गुणसाम्ये तदा तस्मिन्न् अविभागे तमोमये
verses.transliteration: asyātmanā sarvamidaṃ vyāptaṃ tvāsīcchivecchayā guṇasāmye tadā tasminn avibhāge tamomaye
verses.translation: When the Gunas were in equilibrium when it had not been differentiated, when it was identical with darkness,**® all this visible universe had been pervaded by its existence due to Siva's will.
verses.hindi: आभाके सदृश, काले एवं घुँघराले बालोंवाले, नीलपर्वत तथा मेरुके समान प्रतीत होनेवाले, मेघके समान गर्जन करनेवाले, मयके द्वारा रक्षित तथा शिक्षित और युद्धकी तीव्र इच्छावाले हैत्योंसे परिपूर्ण थे। इस प्रकार वे पु तारकासुरके पुत्रों अध्याय ७९ सुरके पुत्रो --विद्युन्माली, तारकाक्ष तथा कमलाक्षका वृत्तान्त ३३५
verses.wordMeaning: When the Gunas were in equilibrium when it had not been differentiated, when it was identical with darkness,**® all this visible universe had been pervaded by its existence due to Siva's will.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the Gunas were in equilibrium when it had not been differentiated, when it was identical with darkness,**® all this visible universe had been pervaded by its existence due to Siva's will.

verses.sanskrit: सर्गकाले प्रधानस्य क्षेत्रज्ञाधिष्ठितस्य वै गुणभावाद्व्यज्यमानो महान् प्रादुर्बभूव ह
verses.transliteration: sargakāle pradhānasya kṣetrajñādhiṣṭhitasya vai guṇabhāvādvyajyamāno mahān prādurbabhūva ha
verses.translation: At the time of creation, as the Pradhana was presided over by the individual soul — Purusa, the principle Mahat menifested revealing itself as subsidiary to Prakrti.
verses.hindi: 9553 भाम अअम ऊारमअकअजधकजबज्अकाजजजाओअ मामज फ्रफफफफफ yA कीरा क ७ क फफ फफ फफ फ फफ फ फ फ फ फ फफ फ फफफ फ फा फ फफफ फ क क फफफ फक कफर फ कक
verses.wordMeaning: At the time of creation, as the Pradhana was presided over by the individual soul — Purusa, the principle Mahat menifested revealing itself as subsidiary to Prakrti.
verses.commentary: Sense: At the time of creation, as the Pradhana was presided over by the individual soul — Purusa, the principle Mahat menifested revealing itself as subsidiary to Prakrti.

verses.sanskrit: सूक्ष्मेण महता चाथ अव्यक्तेन समावृतम् सत्त्वोद्रिक्तो महानग्रे सत्तामात्रप्रकाशकः
verses.transliteration: sūkṣmeṇa mahatā cātha avyaktena samāvṛtam sattvodrikto mahānagre sattāmātraprakāśakaḥ
verses.translation: It was enveloped by the subtle and great Avyakta (unmanifest). At the outset, when the principle of Mahat had the predominance of Sattva, then only it revealed existence.
verses.hindi: रविमरुदमरे्द्रसन्तिकाशैः सुरमथनैः सुदूढैः सुसेवितं तत् युद्धपरायण, भलीभाँति शिवके चरणोंकी पूजाके द्वारा प्राप्त पराक्रमवाले, सूर्य-वायु-इनद्रसदूश, देवताओंका दमन करनेवाले तथा अत्यन्त दृढ़ हैत्योंसे सेवित थे
verses.wordMeaning: It was enveloped by the subtle and great Avyakta (unmanifest). At the outset, when the principle of Mahat had the predominance of Sattva, then only it revealed existence.
