verses.commentary: Sense: It was enveloped by the subtle and great Avyakta (unmanifest). At the outset, when the principle of Mahat had the predominance of Sattva, then only it revealed existence.

verses.sanskrit: मनो महांस्तु विज्ञेयम् एकं तत्कारणं स्मृतम् समुत्पन्नं लिङ्गमात्रं क्षेत्रज्ञाधिष्ठितं हि तत्
verses.transliteration: mano mahāṃstu vijñeyam ekaṃ tatkāraṇaṃ smṛtam samutpannaṃ liṅgamātraṃ kṣetrajñādhiṣṭhitaṃ hi tat
verses.translation: The Mahat should be known as the Cosmic Mind. It is said to be the sole cause of creation. It originated as presided over by the individual soul and only as a beneficent symbol.
verses.hindi: हे द्विजश्रेष्ठो! देत्योके वैभवके कारण तीनों पुरोंकी अग्निसे इन्द्रसहित देवतागण उसी प्रकार दग्ध हो गये, जैसे दावाग्निसे वृक्ष दग्ध हो जाते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: The Mahat should be known as the Cosmic Mind. It is said to be the sole cause of creation. It originated as presided over by the individual soul and only as a beneficent symbol.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Mahat should be known as the Cosmic Mind. It is said to be the sole cause of creation. It originated as presided over by the individual soul and only as a beneficent symbol.

verses.sanskrit: धर्मादीनि च रूपाणि लोकतत्त्वार्थहेतवः महान् सृष्टिं विकुरुते चोद्यमानः सिसृक्षया
verses.transliteration: dharmādīni ca rūpāṇi lokatattvārthahetavaḥ mahān sṛṣṭiṃ vikurute codyamānaḥ sisṛkṣayā
verses.translation: Its forms Dharma etc., are the causes of the principles and objects of the world. Induced by the desire to create the Mahat carries on the activity of creation.
verses.hindi: इस प्रकार उन दग्ध देवताओंने अतुलनीय तेजवाले देवेश्वर विष्णुको प्रणाम करके उनको यह सब बताया तब उन श्रीमान् प्रभु भगवान् नारायणने मनमें सोचा कि देवताओंके कार्यके विषयमें क्या किया जाना चाहिए। इसके बाद यज्ञभोक्ता, यज्ञकर्ता, यज्ञकर्ताओंको फल प्रदान करनेवाले तथा यज्ञमूर्ति प्रभु जनार्दनने
verses.wordMeaning: Its forms Dharma etc., are the causes of the principles and objects of the world. Induced by the desire to create the Mahat carries on the activity of creation.
verses.commentary: Sense: Its forms Dharma etc., are the causes of the principles and objects of the world. Induced by the desire to create the Mahat carries on the activity of creation.

verses.sanskrit: मनो महान्मतिर्ब्रह्म पूर्बुद्धिः ख्यातिरीश्वरः प्रज्ञा चितिः स्मृतिः संविद् विश्वेशश्चेति स स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: mano mahānmatirbrahma pūrbuddhiḥ khyātirīśvaraḥ prajñā citiḥ smṛtiḥ saṃvid viśveśaśceti sa smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: It is named variously as Manas (mind), Mahat (great), Mati (intellect), Brahman, Puh (city), Buddhi (intellect), Khyati (faculty of discriminatory knowledge), Isvara (lord), Prajfia (perfect knowledge), Citi (consciousness), Smrti (memory), Saihvid (cognition), and Vivea (lord of the universe).
verses.hindi: यज्ञदेवका स्मरण किया
verses.wordMeaning: It is named variously as Manas (mind), Mahat (great), Mati (intellect), Brahman, Puh (city), Buddhi (intellect), Khyati (faculty of discriminatory knowledge), Isvara (lord), Prajfia (perfect knowledge), Citi (consciousness), Smrti (memory), Saihvid (cognition),…
verses.commentary: Sense: It is named variously as Manas (mind), Mahat (great), Mati (intellect), Brahman, Puh (city), Buddhi (intellect), Khyati (faculty of discriminatory knowledge), Isvara (lord), Prajfia (perfect knowledge), Citi (consciousness), Smrti (memory), Saihvid (cognition),…

verses.sanskrit: मनुते सर्वभूतानां यस्माच्चेष्टा फलं ततः सौक्ष्म्यात्तेन विभक्तं तु येन तन्मन उच्यते
verses.transliteration: manute sarvabhūtānāṃ yasmācceṣṭā phalaṃ tataḥ saukṣmyāttena vibhaktaṃ tu yena tanmana ucyate
verses.translation: It is called Manas because it ponders over the fruit of the activity of all living beings [from the root man to think] Subtle as it is, the fruits of its activities appear to be divided i. e. many and different.
verses.hindi: तदनन्तर देवताओंके कार्यकी सिद्धिके लिये उनके द्वारा स्मरण किये गये यज्ञदेव उपस्थित हुए। तब उन की। इसके बाद सनातन यज्ञको देखकर पुनः इन्द्रसहित
verses.wordMeaning: It is called Manas because it ponders over the fruit of the activity of all living beings [from the root man to think] Subtle as it is, the fruits of its activities appear to be divided i. e. many and different.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is called Manas because it ponders over the fruit of the activity of all living beings [from the root man to think] Subtle as it is, the fruits of its activities appear to be divided i. e. many and different.

verses.sanskrit: तत्त्वानाम् अग्रजो यस्मान् महांश् च परिमाणतः विशेषेभ्यो गुणेभ्यो ऽपि महानिति ततः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: tattvānām agrajo yasmān mahāṃś ca parimāṇataḥ viśeṣebhyo guṇebhyo 'pi mahāniti tataḥ smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: It is called Mahat because it originated at the outset prior to all other principles as well as due to its magnitude. It is greater than Visesas*® and Gunas.***
verses.hindi: सेन्रा देवा द्विजश्रेष्ठा हरुमा दावाग्निना यथा। पुरत्रयाग्निना दग्धा हाभवन् हैत्यवैभवात्
verses.wordMeaning: It is called Mahat because it originated at the outset prior to all other principles as well as due to its magnitude. It is greater than Visesas*® and Gunas.***
verses.commentary: Sense: It is called Mahat because it originated at the outset prior to all other principles as well as due to its magnitude. It is greater than Visesas*® and Gunas.***

verses.sanskrit: बिभर्ति मानं मनुते विभागं मन्यते ऽपि च पुरुषो भोगसंबन्धात् तेन चासौ मतिः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: bibharti mānaṃ manute vibhāgaṃ manyate 'pi ca puruṣo bhogasaṃbandhāt tena cāsau matiḥ smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: It possesses magnitude [Manaih Bibharti]. It ponders and causes differentiation. It is also greatly related to the enjoy- ment (i, e. experience) of Purusa. Hence, it is known as Mati.
verses.hindi: अधैवं ते तदा दग्धा देवा देवेश्वरं हरिम्। अभिवन्द्य तदा प््राहुस्तमप्रतिमवर्चसम् किं कार्य देवकार्येषु भगवानिति स प्रभुः
verses.wordMeaning: It possesses magnitude [Manaih Bibharti]. It ponders and causes differentiation. It is also greatly related to the enjoy- ment (i, e. experience) of Purusa. Hence, it is known as Mati.
verses.commentary: Sense: It possesses magnitude [Manaih Bibharti]. It ponders and causes differentiation. It is also greatly related to the enjoy- ment (i, e. experience) of Purusa. Hence, it is known as Mati.

verses.sanskrit: बृहत्त्वाद् बृंहणत्वाच्च भावानां सकलाश्रयात् यस्माद्धारयते भावान् ब्रह्म तेन निरुच्यते
verses.transliteration: bṛhattvād bṛṃhaṇatvācca bhāvānāṃ sakalāśrayāt yasmāddhārayate bhāvān brahma tena nirucyate
verses.translation: It is defined as Brahman because of its brhatva (massiveness) and bj-mhanatva (state of becoming swollen)
verses.hindi: तदा सस्मार वै यज्ञं यज्ञमूर्तिजनार्दन:। यज्वा यज्ञभुगीशानो यज्चनां फलदः प्रभुः
verses.wordMeaning: It is defined as Brahman because of its brhatva (massiveness) and bj-mhanatva (state of becoming swollen)
verses.commentary: Sense: It is defined as Brahman because of its brhatva (massiveness) and bj-mhanatva (state of becoming swollen)

verses.sanskrit: यः पूरयति यस्माच्च कृत्स्नान्देवाननुग्रहैः नयते तत्त्वभावं च तेन पूरिति चोच्यते
verses.transliteration: yaḥ pūrayati yasmācca kṛtsnāndevānanugrahaiḥ nayate tattvabhāvaṃ ca tena pūriti cocyate
verses.translation: tamomaye. Gf. **tancia aait tameia guham agre'* — cited in ST.
verses.hindi: ततो यज्ञः स्मृतस्तेन देवकार्यार्थसिद्धये। देवं ते पुरुषं चैव प्रणमुस्तुष्टुवुस्तदा भगवानपि तं दृष्ट्या यज्ञं प्राह सनातनम्। सनातनस्तदा सेन्द्रान् देवानालोक्य चाच्युतः
verses.wordMeaning: tamomaye. Gf. **tancia aait tameia guham agre'* — cited in ST.
verses.commentary: Sense: tamomaye. Gf. **tancia aait tameia guham agre'* — cited in ST.

verses.sanskrit: बुध्यते पुरुषश्चात्र सर्वान् भावान् हितं तथा यस्माद्बोधयते चैव बुद्धिस्तेन निरुच्यते
verses.transliteration: budhyate puruṣaścātra sarvān bhāvān hitaṃ tathā yasmādbodhayate caiva buddhistena nirucyate
verses.translation: It is called Puh because it fills Devas with blessings and leads men to the state of awareness [from the root pr].
verses.hindi: श्रीविष्णुरुवाच (विष्णु) उनसे कहने लगे
verses.wordMeaning: It is called Puh because it fills Devas with blessings and leads men to the state of awareness [from the root pr].
verses.commentary: Sense: It is called Puh because it fills Devas with blessings and leads men to the state of awareness [from the root pr].

verses.sanskrit: ख्यातिः प्रत्युपभोगश् च यस्मात्संवर्तते ततः भोगस्य ज्ञाननिष्ठत्वात् तेन ख्यातिरिति स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: khyātiḥ pratyupabhogaś ca yasmātsaṃvartate tataḥ bhogasya jñānaniṣṭhatvāt tena khyātiriti smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: Since thePurua is known through it and since it makes known all objects, what is wholesome, from what is not it is called Buddhi.
verses.hindi: अनेनोपसदा देवा यजध्वं परमेश्वरम्। श्रीविष्णु बोले--हे देवताओ। तीनों पुरोंके विनाशके पुरत्रयविनाशाय जगत्त्रयविभूतये॥ ४४  लिये तथा तीनों लोकोंकी समृद्धिके लिये इन उपस्थित उपसद नामक यज्ञके द्वारा परमेश्वरका यजन कोजिये सूतजी बोले-उन बुद्धिमान् देवदेवका वचन सुनकर महान् सिंहनाद करके देवतागण उन यज्ञेशको स्तुति करने लगे
verses.wordMeaning: Since thePurua is known through it and since it makes known all objects, what is wholesome, from what is not it is called Buddhi.
verses.commentary: Sense: Since thePurua is known through it and since it makes known all objects, what is wholesome, from what is not it is called Buddhi.

verses.sanskrit: ख्यायते तद्गुणैर् वापि ज्ञानादिभिर् अनेकशः तस्माच्च महतः संज्ञा ख्यातिरित्यभिधीयते
verses.transliteration: khyāyate tadguṇair vāpi jñānādibhir anekaśaḥ tasmācca mahataḥ saṃjñā khyātirityabhidhīyate
verses.translation: Since enjoyment of pleasures is based on the knowledge thereof, and also since each item of enjoyment is dependent on knowledge, it is known by the word khyati.
verses.hindi: इसके बाद स्वयं बिचार करके देवताओंके स्वामी वे भगवान् जनार्दन पुनः सभी देवताओंसे बोले- प्राणियोंको मारकर तथा जलाकर और अन्यायपूर्वक भोग-विलास करके भी यदि कोई महादेवको पूजा करे,
verses.wordMeaning: Since enjoyment of pleasures is based on the knowledge thereof, and also since each item of enjoyment is dependent on knowledge, it is known by the word khyati.
verses.commentary: Sense: Since enjoyment of pleasures is based on the knowledge thereof, and also since each item of enjoyment is dependent on knowledge, it is known by the word khyati.

verses.sanskrit: साक्षात्सर्वं विजानाति महात्मा तेन चेश्वरः यस्माज्ज्ञानानुगश्चैव प्रज्ञा तेन स उच्यते
verses.transliteration: sākṣātsarvaṃ vijānāti mahātmā tena ceśvaraḥ yasmājjñānānugaścaiva prajñā tena sa ucyate
verses.translation: The principle of Mahat is called by the term "Khyati** also because objects in many instances are named (khyayante) through its qualities such as knowledge, etc.
verses.hindi: तो बह पापरहित हो जाता है, इसमें सन्देह नहीं है “निष्पाप लोगोंकी हत्या नहीं की जानी चाहिए; केवल -पापियोंकी ही हत्या पूर्णप्रयलसे को जानी
verses.wordMeaning: The principle of Mahat is called by the term "Khyati** also because objects in many instances are named (khyayante) through its qualities such as knowledge, etc.
verses.commentary: Sense: The principle of Mahat is called by the term "Khyati** also because objects in many instances are named (khyayante) through its qualities such as knowledge, etc.

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञानादीनि च रूपाणि बहुकर्मफलानि च चिनोति यस्माद्भोगार्थं तेनासौ चितिरुच्यते
verses.transliteration: jñānādīni ca rūpāṇi bahukarmaphalāni ca cinoti yasmādbhogārthaṃ tenāsau citirucyate
verses.translation: It is a great soul and it directly perceives everything. Hence, it is called Isvara. Since it follows up knowledge it is called Prajfta.
verses.hindi: अथ तस्य वचः श्रुत्वा देवदेवस्य धीमतः। सिंहनादं महत्कृत्वा यज्ञेशं तुष्टुवुः सुरा;
verses.wordMeaning: It is a great soul and it directly perceives everything. Hence, it is called Isvara. Since it follows up knowledge it is called Prajfta.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is a great soul and it directly perceives everything. Hence, it is called Isvara. Since it follows up knowledge it is called Prajfta.

verses.sanskrit: वर्तमानव्यतीतानि तथैवानागतान्यपि स्मरते सर्वकार्याणि तेनासौ स्मृतिरुच्यते
verses.transliteration: vartamānavyatītāni tathaivānāgatānyapi smarate sarvakāryāṇi tenāsau smṛtirucyate
verses.translation: Since it collects such forms- as Jnana (knowledge) etc., and the fruits of many holy rites, for the sake of enjoyment, it is called citi (from the root ci).
verses.hindi: ततः सञ्चिन्त्य भगवान् स्वयमेव जनार्दनः । यजेद्यदि महादेवमपापो नात्र संशय:
verses.wordMeaning: Since it collects such forms- as Jnana (knowledge) etc., and the fruits of many holy rites, for the sake of enjoyment, it is called citi (from the root ci).
verses.commentary: Sense: Since it collects such forms- as Jnana (knowledge) etc., and the fruits of many holy rites, for the sake of enjoyment, it is called citi (from the root ci).

verses.sanskrit: कृत्स्नं च विन्दते ज्ञानं यस्मान्माहात्म्यमुत्तमम् तस्माद् विन्देर् विदेश्चैव संविदित्यभिधीयते
verses.transliteration: kṛtsnaṃ ca vindate jñānaṃ yasmānmāhātmyamuttamam tasmād vinder videścaiva saṃvidityabhidhīyate
verses.translation: Since it remembers all affairs of the present, past and future it is called Smrti (from the root smr).
verses.hindi: अपापा नेव हन्तव्याः पापा एव न संशय: ।
verses.wordMeaning: Since it remembers all affairs of the present, past and future it is called Smrti (from the root smr).
verses.commentary: Sense: Since it remembers all affairs of the present, past and future it is called Smrti (from the root smr).

verses.sanskrit: विद्यते ऽपि च सर्वत्र तस्मिन्सर्वं च विन्दति तस्मात्संविदिति प्रोक्तो महद्भिर् मुनिसत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: vidyate 'pi ca sarvatra tasminsarvaṃ ca vindati tasmātsaṃviditi prokto mahadbhir munisattamāḥ
verses.translation: It is called Samvid because it obtains the entire knowledge and knows the greatness of everything [from the roots vid to know and vind to obtain].
verses.hindi: श्रीलिड्रमहापुराण  पूर्वभाग असुरा दुर्मदाः पापा अपि देवैर्महाबलैः । तस्मान्न वध्या रुद्रस्य प्रभावात्परमेष्ठिनः
verses.wordMeaning: It is called Samvid because it obtains the entire knowledge and knows the greatness of everything [from the roots vid to know and vind to obtain].
verses.commentary: Sense: It is called Samvid because it obtains the entire knowledge and knows the greatness of everything [from the roots vid to know and vind to obtain].

verses.sanskrit: जानातेर् ज्ञानम् इत्याहुर् भगवान् ज्ञानसंनिधिः बन्धनादिपरीभावाद् ईश्वरः प्रोच्यते बुधैः
verses.transliteration: jānāter jñānam ityāhur bhagavān jñānasaṃnidhiḥ bandhanādiparībhāvād īśvaraḥ procyate budhaiḥ
verses.translation: O excellent sages, (for another reason also) it is called Samvid by great men. It exists [from root vid to exist] every- where and within it one obtains everything [vindati].
verses.hindi: कोऽहं ब्रह्माथवा देवा हैत्या देवारिसूदनाः। मुनयश्च महात्मानः प्रसादेन विना प्रभोः
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent sages, (for another reason also) it is called Samvid by great men. It exists [from root vid to exist] every- where and within it one obtains everything [vindati].
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent sages, (for another reason also) it is called Samvid by great men. It exists [from root vid to exist] every- where and within it one obtains everything [vindati].

verses.sanskrit: पर्यायवाचकैः शब्दैस् तत्त्वम् आद्यम् अनुत्तमम् व्याख्यातं तत्त्वभावज्ञैर् देवसद्भावचेतकैः
verses.transliteration: paryāyavācakaiḥ śabdais tattvam ādyam anuttamam vyākhyātaṃ tattvabhāvajñair devasadbhāvacetakaiḥ
verses.translation: From the root Jiia (to know) they call it Jftanam. For the lord is the fountainhead of all knowledge. Since it repu- diates bondage etc., [the Mahat] is called Ivara by learned men.
verses.hindi: यः सप्तविंशको नित्यः परात्परतरः प्रभुः। विश्वामरेश्वरो वन्द्यो विश्वाधारो महेश्वरः स॒ एव सर्वदेवेशः सर्वेषामपि शङ्करः। लीलया देवहैत्येन्द्रविभागमकरोद्धरः
verses.wordMeaning: From the root Jiia (to know) they call it Jftanam. For the lord is the fountainhead of all knowledge. Since it repu- diates bondage etc., [the Mahat] is called Ivara by learned men.
verses.commentary: Sense: From the root Jiia (to know) they call it Jftanam. For the lord is the fountainhead of all knowledge. Since it repu- diates bondage etc., [the Mahat] is called Ivara by learned men.

verses.sanskrit: महान्सृष्टिं विकुरुते चोद्यमानः सिसृक्षया संकल्पो ऽध्यवसायश् च तस्य वृत्तिद्वयं स्मृतम्
verses.transliteration: mahānsṛṣṭiṃ vikurute codyamānaḥ sisṛkṣayā saṃkalpo 'dhyavasāyaś ca tasya vṛttidvayaṃ smṛtam
verses.translation: This first excellent tattva — Mahat — has been thus explained by many synonymous words by those who are conversant with the nature of tattvas and who always think about the existence of the lord.
verses.hindi: तस्यांशमेकं सम्पूज्य देवा देवत्वमागताः। ब्रह्मा ब्रह्मत्वमापन्नो ह्यहं विष्णुत्वमेव च
verses.wordMeaning: This first excellent tattva — Mahat — has been thus explained by many synonymous words by those who are conversant with the nature of tattvas and who always think about the existence of the lord.
verses.commentary: Sense: This first excellent tattva — Mahat — has been thus explained by many synonymous words by those who are conversant with the nature of tattvas and who always think about the existence of the lord.

verses.sanskrit: त्रिगुणाद् रजसोद्रिक्ताद् अहङ्कारस्ततो ऽभवत् महता च वृतः सर्गो भूतादिर् बाह्यतस्तु सः
verses.transliteration: triguṇād rajasodriktād ahaṅkārastato 'bhavat mahatā ca vṛtaḥ sargo bhūtādir bāhyatastu saḥ
verses.translation: The Mahat carries out the work of creation when it is induced by the desire to create. Samkalpa (volition) and Adhyavasaya (effort) are its two traits.
verses.hindi: तस्मात्तेनैव हन्तव्या लिङ्कार्चनविधेर्बलात् धर्मनिष्ठाश्च ते सर्वे श्रौतस्मार्तविधौ स्थिताः।
verses.wordMeaning: The Mahat carries out the work of creation when it is induced by the desire to create. Samkalpa (volition) and Adhyavasaya (effort) are its two traits.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Mahat carries out the work of creation when it is induced by the desire to create. Samkalpa (volition) and Adhyavasaya (effort) are its two traits.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मादेव तमोद्रिक्ताद् अहङ्कारादजायत भूततन्मात्रसर्गस्तु भूतादिस्तामसस्तु सः
verses.transliteration: tasmādeva tamodriktād ahaṅkārādajāyata bhūtatanmātrasargastu bhūtādistāmasastu saḥ
verses.translation: (From this Mahat) having three Guas but with Rajas prevailing, the Ahaxhldura (ego) originated. All the
verses.hindi: रुद्रमिष्ट्वा यथान्यायं जेष्यामो हैत्यसत्तमान्
verses.wordMeaning: (From this Mahat) having three Guas but with Rajas prevailing, the Ahaxhldura (ego) originated. All the
verses.commentary: Sense: (From this Mahat) having three Guas but with Rajas prevailing, the Ahaxhldura (ego) originated. All the

verses.sanskrit: भूतादिस्तु विकुर्वाणः शब्दमात्रं ससर्ज ह आकाशं सुषिरं तस्माद् उत्पन्नं शब्दलक्षणम्
verses.transliteration: bhūtādistu vikurvāṇaḥ śabdamātraṃ sasarja ha ākāśaṃ suṣiraṃ tasmād utpannaṃ śabdalakṣaṇam
verses.translation: From the same ahaihkara with tamas predominating over the other two came about the creation of Bhutatan- matras (the essence of sound, etc). It is called Bhutadi (cause of the' elements ) and it is tamasa in nature.
verses.hindi: सतारकाक्षेण मयेन गुप्तं स्वस्थं च गुप्तं स्फटिकाभमेकम्। को नाम हन्तुं त्रिपुरं समर्थो मुक्त्वा त्रिनेत्रं भगवन्तमेकम्
verses.wordMeaning: From the same ahaihkara with tamas predominating over the other two came about the creation of Bhutatan- matras (the essence of sound, etc). It is called Bhutadi (cause of the' elements ) and it is tamasa in nature.
verses.commentary: Sense: From the same ahaihkara with tamas predominating over the other two came about the creation of Bhutatan- matras (the essence of sound, etc). It is called Bhutadi (cause of the' elements ) and it is tamasa in nature.

verses.sanskrit: आकाशं शब्दमात्रं तु स्पर्शमात्रं समावृणोत् वायुश्चापि विकुर्वाणो रूपमात्रं ससर्ज ह
verses.transliteration: ākāśaṃ śabdamātraṃ tu sparśamātraṃ samāvṛṇot vāyuścāpi vikurvāṇo rūpamātraṃ sasarja ha
verses.translation: The BhutMi on disintegration created Sabdatanma- tra (the essence of sound). From this was born Akasa (ether) (also called) Susira (hole), that is marked by sound.
verses.hindi: एवमुक्त्वा हरिश्चेष्ट्वा यज्ञेनोपसदा प्रभुम्। उपविष्टो ददर्शाथ भूतसङ्घान् सहस्त्रशः
verses.wordMeaning: The BhutMi on disintegration created Sabdatanma- tra (the essence of sound). From this was born Akasa (ether) (also called) Susira (hole), that is marked by sound.
verses.commentary: Sense: The BhutMi on disintegration created Sabdatanma- tra (the essence of sound). From this was born Akasa (ether) (also called) Susira (hole), that is marked by sound.

verses.sanskrit: ज्योतिरुत्पद्यते वायोस् तद्रूपगुणम् उच्यते स्पर्शमात्रस्तु वै वायू रूपमात्रं समावृणोत्
verses.transliteration: jyotirutpadyate vāyos tadrūpaguṇam ucyate sparśamātrastu vai vāyū rūpamātraṃ samāvṛṇot
verses.translation: Akasa characterised by sound enveloped Sparsa- tanmatra which on disintegration created Vayu characterised by touch. Vayu on disintegration created Rupatanmatra. Therefore, it is said that Jyotis originated out of vayu, with colour as its quality. Jyotis on disintegration created Rasa- tanmatra. Apah (waters) originated from it with taste as their main quality.
verses.hindi: शूलशक्तिगदाहस्तान् टङ्कोपलशिलायुधान्। नानाप्रहरणोपेतान्नानावेषधरांस्तदा कालाग्निरुद्रसङ्काशान् कालरुद्रोपमांस्तदा। प्राह देवो हरिः साक्षात्प्रणिपत्य स्थितान् प्रभुः
verses.wordMeaning: Akasa characterised by sound enveloped Sparsa- tanmatra which on disintegration created Vayu characterised by touch. Vayu on disintegration created Rupatanmatra. Therefore, it is said that Jyotis originated out of vayu, with colour as its quality.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Akasa characterised by sound enveloped Sparsa- tanmatra which on disintegration created Vayu characterised by touch. Vayu on disintegration created Rupatanmatra. Therefore, it is said that Jyotis originated out of vayu, with colour as its quality.…

verses.sanskrit: ज्योतिश्चापि विकुर्वाणं रसमात्रं ससर्ज ह सम्भवन्ति ततो ह्यापस् ता वै सर्वरसात्मिकाः
verses.transliteration: jyotiścāpi vikurvāṇaṃ rasamātraṃ sasarja ha sambhavanti tato hyāpas tā vai sarvarasātmikāḥ
verses.translation: Agni (i. e. the fiery element) with the Rupa-tanmatra enveloped Rasatanmatras. Waters on disintegration created Gandhatanmatra.
verses.hindi: चाहिए; इसमें सन्देह नहीं है। है श्रेष्ठ देवताओ। पापी होते हुए भी दुर्मद असुर महाबली देवताओंके द्वारा वध्य कैसे हो सकते हैं? क्योंकि परमेष्ठी रुद्रके प्रभावके कारण वे वध्य नहीं हैं। है देवताओ! प्रभु शिव दौ
verses.wordMeaning: Agni (i. e. the fiery element) with the Rupa-tanmatra enveloped Rasatanmatras. Waters on disintegration created Gandhatanmatra.
verses.commentary: Sense: Agni (i. e. the fiery element) with the Rupa-tanmatra enveloped Rasatanmatras. Waters on disintegration created Gandhatanmatra.

verses.sanskrit: रसमात्रास्तु ता ह्यापो रूपमात्रो ऽग्निर् आवृणोत् आपश्चापि विकुर्वत्यो गन्धमात्रं ससर्जिरे
verses.transliteration: rasamātrāstu tā hyāpo rūpamātro 'gnir āvṛṇot āpaścāpi vikurvatyo gandhamātraṃ sasarjire
verses.translation: From it the sahghata (solid earth) originated. Its special attribute is smell when each of the elements remains within its specific quality (sound, etc) it is called tanmatra and this exclusive nature is called tanmatrata.
verses.hindi: कृपाके बिना मैं कौन हूँ, ब्रह्मा कौन हैं, हैत्य कौन हैं देवशत्रुओंके विनाशक कौन हैं और महात्मा मुनिगण कौन हैं ?॥ ४८--५० ॥ जो सत्ताईस तत्त्वोसे युक्त, शाश्वत, महानूसे भी महत्तर, प्रभुतासम्मन्न, सम्पूर्ण देवताओंके स्वामी, वन्दनीय, विश्वके आधार, महेश्वर, सर्वदेवेश तथा सबके स्वामी हैं; उन हर शंकरने ही अपनी लीलासे देवताओं एवं
verses.wordMeaning: From it the sahghata (solid earth) originated. Its special attribute is smell when each of the elements remains within its specific quality (sound, etc) it is called tanmatra and this exclusive nature is called tanmatrata.
verses.commentary: Sense: From it the sahghata (solid earth) originated. Its special attribute is smell when each of the elements remains within its specific quality (sound, etc) it is called tanmatra and this exclusive nature is called tanmatrata.

verses.sanskrit: संघातो जायते तस्मात् तस्य गन्धो गुणो मतः तस्मिंस्तस्मिंश् च तन्मात्रं तेन तन्मात्रता स्मृता
verses.transliteration: saṃghāto jāyate tasmāt tasya gandho guṇo mataḥ tasmiṃstasmiṃś ca tanmātraṃ tena tanmātratā smṛtā
verses.translation: The Tanmatras are also called Avisesas, because in that stage they do not define anything in particular (as distinct from others. They are Avisesas for another reason also — they are Pra:§antas (quiescent) or Ghoras (terrible) or Mudhas (confused).
verses.hindi: हैत्योंका विभाजन किया है
verses.wordMeaning: The Tanmatras are also called Avisesas, because in that stage they do not define anything in particular (as distinct from others. They are Avisesas for another reason also — they are Pra:§antas (quiescent) or Ghoras (terrible) or Mudhas (confused).
verses.commentary: Sense: The Tanmatras are also called Avisesas, because in that stage they do not define anything in particular (as distinct from others. They are Avisesas for another reason also — they are Pra:§antas (quiescent) or Ghoras (terrible) or Mudhas (confused).

verses.sanskrit: अविशेषवाचकत्वाद् अविशेषास् ततस् तु ते प्रशान्तघोरमूढत्वाद् अविशेषास्ततः पुनः
verses.transliteration: aviśeṣavācakatvād aviśeṣās tatas tu te praśāntaghoramūḍhatvād aviśeṣāstataḥ punaḥ
verses.translation: This creation by the tanmatras of the Bhutas should be known as one that is mutual. The other creations are from the Vaikarika (that which has undergone alteration) i.e. the Aharhk&ra (ego) or from the SEttvika wherein sattva guna predominates.
verses.hindi: उनके एक अंश (लिङ्गरूप)-की पूजा करके किया है और मुझ विष्णुने विष्णुत्व प्राप्त किया है। उनकी पूजा किये बिना इस जगत्में कौन व्यक्ति सिद्धि प्राप्त कर सकता है? अतः लिङ्गार्चनविधिके प्रभावसे उन्हींके द्वारा वे हैत्य हन्तव्य हैं। यद्यपि वे सभी हैत्य
verses.wordMeaning: This creation by the tanmatras of the Bhutas should be known as one that is mutual. The other creations are from the Vaikarika (that which has undergone alteration) i.e. the Aharhk&ra (ego) or from the SEttvika wherein sattva guna predominates.
verses.commentary: Sense: This creation by the tanmatras of the Bhutas should be known as one that is mutual. The other creations are from the Vaikarika (that which has undergone alteration) i.e. the Aharhk&ra (ego) or from the SEttvika wherein sattva guna predominates.

verses.sanskrit: भूततन्मात्रसर्गो ऽयं विज्ञेयस्तु परस्परम् वैकारिकादहङ्कारात् सत्त्वोद्रिक्तात्तु सात्त्विकात्
verses.transliteration: bhūtatanmātrasargo 'yaṃ vijñeyastu parasparam vaikārikādahaṅkārāt sattvodriktāttu sāttvikāt
verses.translation: The Vaikarika creation functions simultaneously. There are five senses of knowledge and five senses of activity. These ten senses are the means of achievement. The eleventh is mind. By its very nature the mind has both qualities i. e. of the organ of sense and of the organ of function.
verses.hindi: धर्मनिष्ठ हैं तथा श्रौत-स्मार्तविधानमें स्थित हैं, फिर भी उपसद नामक रुद्रयज्ञसे यजमानके द्वारा विधिपूर्वक प्रभु रुद्रका यजन करके हमलोग महाहैत्योंको जीत सकेंगे। एकमात्र त्रिनेत्र भगवान् शिव-को छोड़कर तारकाक्षसहित
verses.wordMeaning: The Vaikarika creation functions simultaneously. There are five senses of knowledge and five senses of activity. These ten senses are the means of achievement. The eleventh is mind. By its very nature the mind has both qualities i. e.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The Vaikarika creation functions simultaneously. There are five senses of knowledge and five senses of activity. These ten senses are the means of achievement. The eleventh is mind. By its very nature the mind has both qualities i. e.…

verses.sanskrit: वैकारिकः स सर्गस्तु युगपत् सम्प्रवर्तते बुद्धीन्द्रियाणि पञ्चैव पञ्च कर्मेन्द्रियाणि च
verses.transliteration: vaikārikaḥ sa sargastu yugapat sampravartate buddhīndriyāṇi pañcaiva pañca karmendriyāṇi ca
verses.translation: The five organs of sense are, ear, sk' 'ye, tongue.
verses.hindi: दानव मयके द्वारा सुरक्षित, स्वस्थ, गुप्त तथा स्फटिकके समान आभावाले तीनों पुरोंको नष्ट करनेमें भला कौन समर्थ है ? सूतजी बोले-इस प्रकार उपसद नामक यज्ञके द्वारा प्रभु शिव-का यजन करके बैठे हुए विष्णुने हजारों भूतसमुदायोंको देखा। तब शूल-शक्ति- गदासे युक्त हाथोंवाले, टंक-उपल-शिलाको आयुधे
verses.wordMeaning: The five organs of sense are, ear, sk' 'ye, tongue.
verses.commentary: Sense: The five organs of sense are, ear, sk' 'ye, tongue.

verses.sanskrit: साधकानीन्द्रियाणि स्युर् देवा वैकारिका दश एकादशं मनस्तत्र स्वगुणेनोभयात्मकम्
verses.transliteration: sādhakānīndriyāṇi syur devā vaikārikā daśa ekādaśaṃ manastatra svaguṇenobhayātmakam
verses.translation: The legs, rectum, private parts, hands and the organ of speech (the tenth Indriya) are the organs of function or activity. Their activities are respectively gait (movement), evacuation, pleasure, arts, crafts and speech.
verses.hindi: रूपमें धारण किये हुए, अनेक प्रकारके प्रहारयोग्य अस्त्रोंसे समन्वित, अनेक वेषोंको धारण किये हु कालाग्नि रुद्रके समान प्रतीत होनेवाले तथा कालरुद्रके सदृश उन उपस्थित भूतोंको प्रणाम करके साक्षात् प्र
verses.wordMeaning: The legs, rectum, private parts, hands and the organ of speech (the tenth Indriya) are the organs of function or activity. Their activities are respectively gait (movement), evacuation, pleasure, arts, crafts and speech.
verses.commentary: Sense: The legs, rectum, private parts, hands and the organ of speech (the tenth Indriya) are the organs of function or activity. Their activities are respectively gait (movement), evacuation, pleasure, arts, crafts and speech.

verses.sanskrit: श्रोत्रं त्वक् चक्षुषी जिह्वा नासिका चैव पञ्चमी शब्दादीनामवाप्त्यर्थं बुद्धियुक्तानि तानि वै
verses.transliteration: śrotraṃ tvak cakṣuṣī jihvā nāsikā caiva pañcamī śabdādīnāmavāptyarthaṃ buddhiyuktāni tāni vai
verses.translation: Both ether and the element of sound penetrated the element of touch. Hence wind has both the attributes — sound and touch.
verses.hindi: विष्णुदेव कहने लगे॥ ५७--५९ ॥ अध्याय ७९  तारकासुरके पुत्रों विद्युन्माली, तारकाक्ष तथा कमलाक्षका वृत्तान्त
verses.wordMeaning: Both ether and the element of sound penetrated the element of touch. Hence wind has both the attributes — sound and touch.
verses.commentary: Sense: Both ether and the element of sound penetrated the element of touch. Hence wind has both the attributes — sound and touch.

verses.sanskrit: पादौ पायुरुपस्थश् च हस्तौ वाग्दशमी भवेत् गतिर्विसर्गो ह्यानन्दः शिल्पं वाक्यं च कर्म तत्
verses.transliteration: pādau pāyurupasthaś ca hastau vāgdaśamī bhavet gatirvisargo hyānandaḥ śilpaṃ vākyaṃ ca karma tat
verses.translation: Similarly both sound and touch entered colour. Hence, the fire has three attributes, viz, sound, touch and colour.
verses.hindi: 101 क्य मामकी औक फ्रफफ फपपप्सफाफफापप्मपफफफप्फ अर ऊफफफफफफफफफफफफफफ्फफफफफफफफफफफफफफफफ कफ फफ कफ फफ फफफ 07 Pe
verses.wordMeaning: Similarly both sound and touch entered colour. Hence, the fire has three attributes, viz, sound, touch and colour.
verses.commentary: Sense: Similarly both sound and touch entered colour. Hence, the fire has three attributes, viz, sound, touch and colour.

verses.sanskrit: आकाशं शब्दमात्रं च स्पर्शमात्रं समाविशत् द्विगुणस्तु ततो वायुः शब्दस्पर्शात्मको ऽभवत्
verses.transliteration: ākāśaṃ śabdamātraṃ ca sparśamātraṃ samāviśat dviguṇastu tato vāyuḥ śabdasparśātmako 'bhavat
verses.translation: The attributes of sound, touch, and colour penetrated the element of taste. Hence, waters have four attributes includ- ing taste as their special attribute.
verses.hindi: भित्त्वा देत्यपुरत्रयम् विष्णु बोले--हे वीरो! उस त्रिपुर हैत्यके ना RT । पुरोंमें जाकर सभीको जलाकर, छिन्न-भिन्न करके
verses.wordMeaning: The attributes of sound, touch, and colour penetrated the element of taste. Hence, waters have four attributes includ- ing taste as their special attribute.
verses.commentary: Sense: The attributes of sound, touch, and colour penetrated the element of taste. Hence, waters have four attributes includ- ing taste as their special attribute.

verses.sanskrit: रूपं तथैव विशतः शब्दस्पर्शगुणावुभौ त्रिगुणस्तु ततस्त्वग्निः सशब्दस्पर्शरूपवान्
verses.transliteration: rūpaṃ tathaiva viśataḥ śabdasparśaguṇāvubhau triguṇastu tatastvagniḥ saśabdasparśarūpavān
verses.translation: Sound, touch, colour and taste penetrated smell. Combined with the element of smell they pervaded the earth.
verses.hindi: ततः प्रणम्य देवेशं भूतसङ्घाः पुरत्रयम्। प्रविश्य नष्टास्ते सर्वे शलभा इव पावकम्
verses.wordMeaning: Sound, touch, colour and taste penetrated smell. Combined with the element of smell they pervaded the earth.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sound, touch, colour and taste penetrated smell. Combined with the element of smell they pervaded the earth.

verses.sanskrit: सशब्दस्पर्शरूपं च रसमात्रं समाविशत् तस्माच्चतुर्गुणा आपो विज्ञेयास्तु रसात्मिकाः
verses.transliteration: saśabdasparśarūpaṃ ca rasamātraṃ samāviśat tasmāccaturguṇā āpo vijñeyāstu rasātmikāḥ
verses.translation: Hence, the earth contains all the five attributes and is considered the grossest of all elements. They are quiescent, terrible or confused. Hence, they are called Viesas.
verses.hindi: ततस्तु नष्टास्ते सर्वे भूता देवेश्वराज्ञया। ननतु्मुमुदुश्चैव जगुर्हैत्याः सहस्त्रशः तुष्टुवुर्देबदेवेशं परमात्मानमीश्वरम्। ततः पराजिता देवा ध्वस्तवीर्याः क्षणेन तु
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, the earth contains all the five attributes and is considered the grossest of all elements. They are quiescent, terrible or confused. Hence, they are called Viesas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, the earth contains all the five attributes and is considered the grossest of all elements. They are quiescent, terrible or confused. Hence, they are called Viesas.

verses.sanskrit: शब्दस्पर्शं च रूपं च रसो वै गन्धमाविशत् संगता गन्धमात्रेण आविशन्तो महीमिमाम्
verses.transliteration: śabdasparśaṃ ca rūpaṃ ca raso vai gandhamāviśat saṃgatā gandhamātreṇa āviśanto mahīmimām
verses.translation: Since they have penetrated mutually they sustain one another.®*®
verses.hindi: सेन्द्रा: सङ्गम्य देवेशमुपेन्द्रं धिष्ठिता भयात्। तान् दृष्ट्वा चिन्तयामास भगवान् पुरुषोत्तमः
verses.wordMeaning: Since they have penetrated mutually they sustain one another.®*®
verses.commentary: Sense: Since they have penetrated mutually they sustain one another.®*®

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात्पञ्चगुणा भूमिः स्थूला भूतेषु शस्यते शान्ता घोराश् च मूढाश् च विशेषास्तेन ते स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: tasmātpañcaguṇā bhūmiḥ sthūlā bhūteṣu śasyate śāntā ghorāś ca mūḍhāś ca viśeṣāstena te smṛtāḥ
verses.translation: They are called Vie§as because they can be perceived by means of the sense-organs invariably. The latter ones have all the qualities of the previous creation.®*
verses.hindi: किं कृत्यमिति सन्तप्तः सन्तप्तान् सेन्द्रकान् क्षणम्। कथं तु तेषां हैत्यानां बलं हत्वा प्रयलतः देवकार्यं करिष्यामि प्रसादात्परमेष्ठिनः। पापं विचारतो नास्ति धर्मिष्ठानां न संशयः
verses.wordMeaning: They are called Vie§as because they can be perceived by means of the sense-organs invariably. The latter ones have all the qualities of the previous creation.®*
verses.commentary: Sense: They are called Vie§as because they can be perceived by means of the sense-organs invariably. The latter ones have all the qualities of the previous creation.®*

verses.sanskrit: परस्परानुप्रवेशाद् धारयन्ति परस्परम् भूमेरन्तस्त्विदं सर्वं लोकालोकाचलावृतम्
verses.transliteration: parasparānupraveśād dhārayanti parasparam bhūmerantastvidaṃ sarvaṃ lokālokācalāvṛtam
verses.translation: Each of these qualities is a distinct characteristic of each element. (Any other quality found in an element should be known to be due to the contact of the other element;
verses.hindi: तस्माहैत्या न वध्यास्ते भूतैश्चोपसदोद्भवैः। पापं नुदति धर्मेण धर्मे सर्व प्रतिष्ठितम्
verses.wordMeaning: Each of these qualities is a distinct characteristic of each element. (Any other quality found in an element should be known to be due to the contact of the other element;
verses.commentary: Sense: Each of these qualities is a distinct characteristic of each element. (Any other quality found in an element should be known to be due to the contact of the other element;

verses.sanskrit: विशेषाश्चेन्द्रियग्राह्या नियतत्वाच्च ते स्मृताः गुणं पूर्वस्य सर्गस्य प्राप्नुवन्त्युत्तरोत्तराः
verses.transliteration: viśeṣāścendriyagrāhyā niyatatvācca te smṛtāḥ guṇaṃ pūrvasya sargasya prāpnuvantyuttarottarāḥ
verses.translation: Paraspar&nupraveia: Each preceding element enters into each succeeding element. Each new life-centre is a link in the chain. The seed is permeated by its creative potency. The seed in the form of the father is reborn as the son in endless generations. This principle of anupraveia, i.e. the ancestor transmitting its whole potency to the successor is a bioiogtea 1 law.
verses.hindi: ध्माहैश्वर्यमित्येषा श्रुतिरेषा सनातनी। हैत्याश्चैते हि धर्मिष्ठाः सर्वे त्रिपुरवासिनः कृत्वापि सुमहत्पापं रुद्रमभ्यर्चयन्ति ये
verses.wordMeaning: Paraspar&nupraveia: Each preceding element enters into each succeeding element. Each new life-centre is a link in the chain. The seed is permeated by its creative potency. The seed in the form of the father is reborn as the son in endless generations.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Paraspar&nupraveia: Each preceding element enters into each succeeding element. Each new life-centre is a link in the chain. The seed is permeated by its creative potency. The seed in the form of the father is reborn as the son in endless generations.…

verses.sanskrit: तेषां यावच्च तद् यच्च यच्च तावद्गुणं स्मृतम् उपलभ्याप्सु वै गन्धं केचिद् ब्रूयुर् अपां गुणम्
verses.transliteration: teṣāṃ yāvacca tad yacca yacca tāvadguṇaṃ smṛtam upalabhyāpsu vai gandhaṃ kecid brūyur apāṃ guṇam
verses.translation: Sec verses 43-47 of this chapter.
verses.hindi: तस्मात्ते भोगिनो हैत्या लिङ्गार्चनपरायणाः। तस्मात्कृत्वा धर्मविघ्नमहं देवाः स्वमायया
verses.wordMeaning: Sec verses 43-47 of this chapter.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sec verses 43-47 of this chapter.

verses.sanskrit: पृथिव्यामेव तं विद्याद् अपां वायोश् च संश्रयात् एते सप्त महात्मानो ह्य् अन्योन्यस्य समाश्रयात्
verses.transliteration: pṛthivyāmeva taṃ vidyād apāṃ vāyoś ca saṃśrayāt ete sapta mahātmāno hy anyonyasya samāśrayāt
verses.translation: Like the bubbles in the water the big cosmic egg is born at once from the Vises. The whole egg is embedded in water.
verses.hindi: हैत्यानां देवकार्यार्थं जेष्येऽहं त्रिपुरं क्षणात! विचार्यैवं ततस्तेषां भगवान्. पुरुषोत्तमः ।
verses.wordMeaning: Like the bubbles in the water the big cosmic egg is born at once from the Vises. The whole egg is embedded in water.
verses.commentary: Sense: Like the bubbles in the water the big cosmic egg is born at once from the Vises. The whole egg is embedded in water.

verses.sanskrit: पुरुषाधिष्ठितत्वाच्च अव्यक्तानुग्रहेण च महादयो विशेषान्ता ह्य् अण्डमुत्पादयन्ति ते
verses.transliteration: puruṣādhiṣṭhitatvācca avyaktānugraheṇa ca mahādayo viśeṣāntā hy aṇḍamutpādayanti te
verses.translation: The cosmic egg is encircled by waters ten times in extent. The waters are externally encircled by the fire ten times in extent.
verses.hindi: कर्तु व्यवसितश्चाभूद्धर्मविष्तं सुरारिणाम्
verses.wordMeaning: The cosmic egg is encircled by waters ten times in extent. The waters are externally encircled by the fire ten times in extent.
verses.commentary: Sense: The cosmic egg is encircled by waters ten times in extent. The waters are externally encircled by the fire ten times in extent.

verses.sanskrit: एककालसमुत्पन्नं जलबुद्बुदवच्च तत् विशेषेभ्यो ऽण्डम् अभवन् महत् तद् उदकेशयम्
verses.transliteration: ekakālasamutpannaṃ jalabudbudavacca tat viśeṣebhyo 'ṇḍam abhavan mahat tad udakeśayam
verses.translation: The fire is externally encircled by the wind ten limes in extent and the wind is externally encircled by the ether ten times in extent.
verses.hindi: मायी मायामयं तेषां धर्मविष्नार्थमच्युतः और उनका भक्षण करके पुनः आपलोग जैसे आये हैं, वैसे ही भूतलपर चले जायँ
verses.wordMeaning: The fire is externally encircled by the wind ten limes in extent and the wind is externally encircled by the ether ten times in extent.
verses.commentary: Sense: The fire is externally encircled by the wind ten limes in extent and the wind is externally encircled by the ether ten times in extent.

verses.sanskrit: अद्भिर् दशगुणाभिस्तु बाह्यतो ऽण्डं समावृतम् आपो दशगुणेनैतास् तेजसा बाह्यतो वृताः
verses.transliteration: adbhir daśaguṇābhistu bāhyato 'ṇḍaṃ samāvṛtam āpo daśaguṇenaitās tejasā bāhyato vṛtāḥ
verses.translation: The wind is encircled by the ether. The ether is encir- cled by the ego. The ego is encircled by intellect and intellect is encircled by the unmanifest.
verses.hindi: तत्पश्चात् देवेशको प्रणाम करके तीनों पुरोंमें प्रवेश करके वे भूतगण उसी तरह नष्ट हो गये, जैसे अग्निमें प्रवेश करके शलभ (पतिंगे) नष्ट हो जाते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: The wind is encircled by the ether. The ether is encir- cled by the ego. The ego is encircled by intellect and intellect is encircled by the unmanifest.
verses.commentary: Sense: The wind is encircled by the ether. The ether is encir- cled by the ego. The ego is encircled by intellect and intellect is encircled by the unmanifest.

verses.sanskrit: तेजो दशगुणेनैव वायुना बाह्यतो वृतम् वायुर्दशगुणेनैव बाह्यतो नभसा वृतः
verses.transliteration: tejo daśaguṇenaiva vāyunā bāhyato vṛtam vāyurdaśaguṇenaiva bāhyato nabhasā vṛtaḥ
verses.translation: Sarva is stationed in the covering lid of the cos- mic egg. O persons of good holy rites, Bhava is stationed in waters; Rudra is stationed in the middle of fire. Ugra is stationed in the wind. Bhima is stationed in the middle of the earth. Mahevara is stationed in ego. Lord Ia is stationed in intellect. Paramesvara is stationed everywhere. The egg is encircled by the seven coverings originating from Prakrtis. These eight Prakrtis are thus stationed encircling one an other.
verses.hindi: तब देवेश्वरकी आज्ञासे उन सभी भूतोंके नष्ट हो जानेपर हजारों हैत्य आनन्द मनाने लगे, नाचने-गाने लगे और देवेश परमात्मा ईश्वरकी स्तुति करने लगे॥ ६२ /२॥ तदनन्तर क्षणभरमें पराजित तथा नष्ट पराक्रमवाले इन्द्रसहित देवतागण देवेश विष्णुके पास पहुँचकर भयपूर्वक खड़े हो गये । तब इन्द्रसहित उन सन्तप्त देवताओंको देखकर भगवान् पुरुषोत्तम उस समय दुःखी होकर सोचने लगे--
verses.wordMeaning: Sarva is stationed in the covering lid of the cos- mic egg. O persons of good holy rites, Bhava is stationed in waters; Rudra is stationed in the middle of fire. Ugra is stationed in the wind. Bhima is stationed in the middle of the earth. Mahevara is stationed in ego.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Sarva is stationed in the covering lid of the cos- mic egg. O persons of good holy rites, Bhava is stationed in waters; Rudra is stationed in the middle of fire. Ugra is stationed in the wind. Bhima is stationed in the middle of the earth. Mahevara is stationed in ego.…

verses.sanskrit: आकाशेनावृतो वायुः खं तु भूतादिनावृतम् भूतादिर्महता चापि अव्यक्तेनावृतो महान्
verses.transliteration: ākāśenāvṛto vāyuḥ khaṃ tu bhūtādināvṛtam bhūtādirmahatā cāpi avyaktenāvṛto mahān
verses.translation: Stationing themselves thus at the time of creation they attract one another. Thus mutually interdependent they uphold one another,
verses.hindi: क्या किया जाना चाहिए ? प्रयत्नपूर्वक उन हैत्योंका बल नष्ट करके मैं कैसे देवताओंका कार्य करूँगा ? विचारपूर्वक देखा जाय, तो शिवकी कृपासे उन धर्मनिष्ठ हैत्योंमें पाप नहीं है, अतः वे हैत्य उपसद नामक यज्ञसे उत्पन्न
verses.wordMeaning: Stationing themselves thus at the time of creation they attract one another. Thus mutually interdependent they uphold one another,
verses.commentary: Sense: Stationing themselves thus at the time of creation they attract one another. Thus mutually interdependent they uphold one another,

verses.sanskrit: शर्वश्चाण्डकपालस्थो भवश्चांभसि सुव्रताः रुद्रो ऽग्निमध्ये भगवान् उग्रो वायौ पुनः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: śarvaścāṇḍakapālastho bhavaścāṃbhasi suvratāḥ rudro 'gnimadhye bhagavān ugro vāyau punaḥ smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: Read mahaddi for mahdayo (Linga. 1.3.18). The principle of intellect and mind and the five gross elements constitute each Egg. These seven constituents of the Egg are also known as the seven sages, seven Angirases (Gf. Linga. 1.70. 51).
verses.hindi: भूतोंके द्वारा वध्य नहीं हैं। धर्मसे ही पाप नष्ट होता है; सब कुछ धर्ममें ही प्रतिष्ठित है । धर्मसे ऐश्वर्य प्राप्त होता है--यह सनातनी श्रुति है। सूतजीने कहा-- है द्विजश्रैष्ठो ! तीनों पुरोंमें निवास करनेवाले वे सभी हैत्य धर्मनिष्ठ थे, अर्थात् अनुष्ठानमें तत्पर थे। अतः वे अवध्यताको प्राप्त हो गये थे; इसमें सन्देह नहीं है । बहुत बड़ा पाप करके भी जो लोग रुद्रका अर्चन करते हैं, वे सभी पापोंसे मुक्त हो जाते हैं; जैसे जलसे कमल मुक्त रहता है। है द्विजो!
verses.wordMeaning: Read mahaddi for mahdayo (Linga. 1.3.18). The principle of intellect and mind and the five gross elements constitute each Egg. These seven constituents of the Egg are also known as the seven sages, seven Angirases (Gf. Linga. 1.70. 51).
verses.commentary: Sense: Read mahaddi for mahdayo (Linga. 1.3.18). The principle of intellect and mind and the five gross elements constitute each Egg. These seven constituents of the Egg are also known as the seven sages, seven Angirases (Gf. Linga. 1.70. 51).

verses.sanskrit: भीमश्चावनिमध्यस्थो ह्य् अहङ्कारे महेश्वरः बुद्धौ च भगवानीशः सर्वतः परमेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: bhīmaścāvanimadhyastho hy ahaṅkāre maheśvaraḥ buddhau ca bhagavānīśaḥ sarvataḥ parameśvaraḥ
verses.translation: The Egg constitutes the unmanifest Prakfti (avyakta) and its manifestations — intellect (mahat,) ego(ahaxhkSra)and the five gross elements (bhutas). (Gf. VSyu. 1.4.76). These seven comprise the shells of the life-principle in the egg. Of. BhSlg. 6.16.37: 'kfityidibhir e$a kilUvrtab saptabhir do|a-gunottarair aodkoiab**.
verses.hindi: शिवकी पूजासे भोगसम्पदा अवश्य प्राप्त होती है; वे हैत्य लिङ्ग-पूजामें परायण हैं, अतः वे भोगोंसे युक्त हैं ।  विष्णुने कहा-- है देवताओ ! इसलिये मैं देवताओंके कार्यके लिये अपनी मायासे हैत्योंके धर्म (अनुष्ठान) -में विघ्न डालकर
verses.wordMeaning: The Egg constitutes the unmanifest Prakfti (avyakta) and its manifestations — intellect (mahat,) ego(ahaxhkSra)and the five gross elements (bhutas). (Gf. VSyu. 1.4.76). These seven comprise the shells of the life-principle in the egg. Of. BhSlg.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The Egg constitutes the unmanifest Prakfti (avyakta) and its manifestations — intellect (mahat,) ego(ahaxhkSra)and the five gross elements (bhutas). (Gf. VSyu. 1.4.76). These seven comprise the shells of the life-principle in the egg. Of. BhSlg.…

verses.sanskrit: एतैरावरणैरण्डं सप्तभिः प्राकृतैर् वृतम् एता आवृत्य चान्योन्यम् अष्टौ प्रकृतयः स्थिताः
verses.transliteration: etairāvaraṇairaṇḍaṃ saptabhiḥ prākṛtair vṛtam etā āvṛtya cānyonyam aṣṭau prakṛtayaḥ sthitāḥ
verses.translation: The vikaras (effects) exist in the vikarins (cause) by means of the relationship of the support and the supported. Mahebvara is beyond Avyakta. The egg is born of Avyakta. The same lord is bom of the egg as Purusa with solar lustre. In it the generating of the effect is achieved by his own free will. He alone is the primordial embodied being, called Purusa. Visnu who is bowed to by all Devas is born of his left limb.
verses.hindi: क्षणभरमें तीनों पुरोंको जीत लूँगा ॥ ६३--७१ अश सूतजी बोले--ऐसा विचार करके भगवान् पुरुषोत्तम उन देवशत्रुओं (हैत्यों)-के धर्ममें विघ्न उत्पन्न करनेके लिये प्रवृत्त हुए। महातेजस्वी मायावी अच्युतने उनके धर्मविघ्नके
verses.wordMeaning: The vikaras (effects) exist in the vikarins (cause) by means of the relationship of the support and the supported. Mahebvara is beyond Avyakta. The egg is born of Avyakta. The same lord is bom of the egg as Purusa with solar lustre.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The vikaras (effects) exist in the vikarins (cause) by means of the relationship of the support and the supported. Mahebvara is beyond Avyakta. The egg is born of Avyakta. The same lord is bom of the egg as Purusa with solar lustre.…

verses.sanskrit: प्रसर्गकाले स्थित्वा तु ग्रसन्त्येताः परस्परम् एवं परस्परोत्पन्ना धारयन्ति परस्परम्
verses.transliteration: prasargakāle sthitvā tu grasantyetāḥ parasparam evaṃ parasparotpannā dhārayanti parasparam
verses.translation: The period of his creation is his day and the period of dissolution his night.
verses.hindi: ण ४11012... मा फ्फफफफफफफफ्फफ्फ्फ्फफफ्फफफफफ्फफ्फकफफऊ फफफ फ फफफ फफ फफ कफ फफफ फ फफफ कमका मा मा मी मी भी क मी फ फ फ फ फ फ फ फ फ फफफ ऊ
verses.wordMeaning: The period of his creation is his day and the period of dissolution his night.
verses.commentary: Sense: The period of his creation is his day and the period of dissolution his night.

verses.sanskrit: आधाराधेयभावेन विकारास्ते विकारिषु महेश्वरः परो ऽव्यक्ताद् अण्डम् अव्यक्तसंभवम्
verses.transliteration: ādhārādheyabhāvena vikārāste vikāriṣu maheśvaraḥ paro 'vyaktād aṇḍam avyaktasaṃbhavam
verses.translation: At the end of the day they get dissolved. At the end of the night they originate again.
verses.hindi: शास्त्रं च शास्ता सर्वेषामकरोत्कामरूपधृक् । सर्वसम्मोहनं मायी दृष्टप्रत्ययसंयुतम् इहैव स्वर्गनरकं प्रत्ययं नान्यथा पुनः
verses.wordMeaning: At the end of the day they get dissolved. At the end of the night they originate again.
verses.commentary: Sense: At the end of the day they get dissolved. At the end of the night they originate again.

verses.sanskrit: अण्डाज्जज्ञे स एवेशः पुरुषो ऽर्कसमप्रभः तस्मिन्कार्यस्य करणं संसिद्धं स्वेच्छयैव तु
verses.transliteration: aṇḍājjajñe sa eveśaḥ puruṣo 'rkasamaprabhaḥ tasminkāryasya karaṇaṃ saṃsiddhaṃ svecchayaiva tu
verses.translation: Just as there is oil latent in the gingelly seed, just as the ghee is present in the milk, so also the universe is present in tamas, sattva and rsyas.
verses.hindi: पुरत्रयविनाशाय प्राहैनं पुरुषं हरिः
verses.wordMeaning: Just as there is oil latent in the gingelly seed, just as the ghee is present in the milk, so also the universe is present in tamas, sattva and rsyas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Just as there is oil latent in the gingelly seed, just as the ghee is present in the milk, so also the universe is present in tamas, sattva and rsyas.

verses.sanskrit: स वै शरीरी प्रथमः स वै पुरुष उच्यते तस्य वामाङ्गजो विष्णुः सर्वदेवनमस्कृतः
verses.transliteration: sa vai śarīrī prathamaḥ sa vai puruṣa ucyate tasya vāmāṅgajo viṣṇuḥ sarvadevanamaskṛtaḥ
verses.translation: After enjoying the goddess throughout the night the creator begins to function in the beginning* of the day when Prakfti originates from Him.
verses.hindi: धर्मास्तथा प्रणश्यन्तु श्रौतस्मार्ता न संशयः प्रविश्य तत्पुरं तूर्णं मुनिर्मायां तदाकरोत्
verses.wordMeaning: After enjoying the goddess throughout the night the creator begins to function in the beginning* of the day when Prakfti originates from Him.
verses.commentary: Sense: After enjoying the goddess throughout the night the creator begins to function in the beginning* of the day when Prakfti originates from Him.

verses.sanskrit: लक्ष्म्या देव्या ह्यभूद्देव इच्छया परमेष्ठिनः दक्षिणाङ्गभवो ब्रह्मा सरस्वत्या जगद्गुरुः
verses.transliteration: lakṣmyā devyā hyabhūddeva icchayā parameṣṭhinaḥ dakṣiṇāṅgabhavo brahmā sarasvatyā jagadguruḥ
verses.translation: The great lord penetrates Pradhana and Purusa agitat- ing®' them by means of yoga.
verses.hindi: मायया तस्य ते हैत्याः पुरत्रयनिवासिनः।
verses.wordMeaning: The great lord penetrates Pradhana and Purusa agitat- ing®' them by means of yoga.
verses.commentary: Sense: The great lord penetrates Pradhana and Purusa agitat- ing®' them by means of yoga.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिन्नण्डे इमे लोका अन्तर्विश्वमिदं जगत् चन्द्रादित्यौ सनक्षत्रौ सग्रहौ सह वायुना
verses.transliteration: tasminnaṇḍe ime lokā antarviśvamidaṃ jagat candrādityau sanakṣatrau sagrahau saha vāyunā
verses.translation: The three deities originate from the great lord, the lord of the Universe. They are permanent, extremely worthy of con- cealment and protection, embodied ones, and the souls of all.
verses.hindi: तत्यजुश्च महादेवं शङ्करं परमेश्वरम्। नारदोऽपि तदा मायी नियोगान्मायिनः प्रभो: मुनिः शिष्यैः प्रशिष्यैश्च संवृतः सर्वतः स्वयम्
verses.wordMeaning: The three deities originate from the great lord, the lord of the Universe. They are permanent, extremely worthy of con- cealment and protection, embodied ones, and the souls of all.
verses.commentary: Sense: The three deities originate from the great lord, the lord of the Universe. They are permanent, extremely worthy of con- cealment and protection, embodied ones, and the souls of all.

verses.sanskrit: लोकालोकद्वयं किंचिद् अण्डे ह्यस्मिन्समर्पितम् यत्तु सृष्टौ प्रसंख्यातं मया कालान्तरं द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: lokālokadvayaṃ kiṃcid aṇḍe hyasminsamarpitam yattu sṛṣṭau prasaṃkhyātaṃ mayā kālāntaraṃ dvijāḥ
verses.translation: These alone are the three devas, the three Gunas, the three worlds, and the three fires.®®®
verses.hindi: स्त्रीधर्म चाकरोत्स्त्रीणां दुश्चारफलसिद्धिदम्।
verses.wordMeaning: These alone are the three devas, the three Gunas, the three worlds, and the three fires.®®®
verses.commentary: Sense: These alone are the three devas, the three Gunas, the three worlds, and the three fires.®®®

verses.sanskrit: एतत्कालान्तरं ज्ञेयम् अहर्वै पारमेश्वरम् रात्रिश्चैतावती ज्ञेया परमेशस्य कृत्स्नशः
verses.transliteration: etatkālāntaraṃ jñeyam aharvai pārameśvaram rātriścaitāvatī jñeyā parameśasya kṛtsnaśaḥ
verses.translation: They are mutually supported and they devotedly follow one another. They exist on mutual help and they hold one another.
verses.hindi: जनासक्ता बभूवुस्ता विनिन्द्य पतिदेवताः। अद्यापि गौरवात्तस्य नारदस्य कलौ मुनेः कृत्वापि सुमहत्पापं या भर्तुः प्रेमसंयुता
verses.wordMeaning: They are mutually supported and they devotedly follow one another. They exist on mutual help and they hold one another.
verses.commentary: Sense: They are mutually supported and they devotedly follow one another. They exist on mutual help and they hold one another.

verses.sanskrit: अहस्तस्य तु या सृष्टिः रात्रिश् च प्रलयः स्मृतः नाहस्तु विद्यते तस्य न रात्रिरिति धारयेत्
verses.transliteration: ahastasya tu yā sṛṣṭiḥ rātriś ca pralayaḥ smṛtaḥ nāhastu vidyate tasya na rātririti dhārayet
verses.translation: They are paired together and mutually interdependent. There is not even a moment's separation among them. They do not eschew one another.®®®
verses.hindi: लिये अपने शरीरसे मायामय पुरुषका सृजन किया। सबके शासक तथा स्वेच्छासे रूप धारण करनेवाले मायापति विष्णु -ने देखनेमात्रसे विश्वास उत्पन्न करनेवाले भावसे युक्त अतएव सबको मोहित करनेवाले शास्त्रका निर्माण
verses.wordMeaning: They are paired together and mutually interdependent. There is not even a moment's separation among them. They do not eschew one another.®®®
verses.commentary: Sense: They are paired together and mutually interdependent. There is not even a moment's separation among them. They do not eschew one another.®®®

verses.sanskrit: उपचारस्तु क्रियते लोकानां हितकाम्यया इन्द्रियाणीन्द्रियार्थाश् च महाभूतानि पञ्च च
verses.transliteration: upacārastu kriyate lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā indriyāṇīndriyārthāś ca mahābhūtāni pañca ca
verses.translation: iva is the greatest lord. Visnu is beyond or above in- tellect. Brahma is endowed with rajas. He functions at the beginning of Creation.
verses.hindi: किया  षोडशलक्षक अर्थात् अत्यन्त विस्तृत श्रुति-स्मृतिसे विरुद्ध तथा वर्णाश्रम-धर्मोसे रहित इस मायामय शास्त्रका उपदेश अपने शरीरसे उत्पन्न पुरुषको करना चाहिए और स्वर्ग-नरक यहींपर है, ऐसा विश्वास करना चाहिए, इसके अतिरिक्त कुछ नहीं--इसे प्रतिपादित करनेवाले उस शास्त्रको उस पुरुषको स्वयं पढ़ाकर मायामय अच्युत विष्णुने तीनों पुरोंके विनाशहेतु उस पुरुषसे कहा-हे पुरुष! त्रिपुरवासियोंके नाशके लिये तुम शीघ्र जाओ और ऐसा
verses.wordMeaning: iva is the greatest lord. Visnu is beyond or above in- tellect. Brahma is endowed with rajas. He functions at the beginning of Creation.
verses.commentary: Sense: iva is the greatest lord. Visnu is beyond or above in- tellect. Brahma is endowed with rajas. He functions at the beginning of Creation.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात् सर्वाणि भूतानि बुद्धिश् च सह दैवतैः अहस्तिष्ठन्ति सर्वाणि परमेशस्य धीमतः
verses.transliteration: tasmāt sarvāṇi bhūtāni buddhiś ca saha daivataiḥ ahastiṣṭhanti sarvāṇi parameśasya dhīmataḥ
verses.translation: That Purusa is known as Part and Prakrti as Para.
verses.hindi: प्रयत्न करो, जिससे वहाँके श्रौत-स्मार्त धर्म नष्ट हो जाये; इसमें संशय नहीं है ॥७२--७८॥ तत्पश्चात् उन्हें प्रणाम करके मायाशास्त्रविशारद मायावी मुनिने उन पुरोंमें शीघ्र प्रवेश करके माया
verses.wordMeaning: That Purusa is known as Part and Prakrti as Para.
verses.commentary: Sense: That Purusa is known as Part and Prakrti as Para.

verses.sanskrit: अहरन्ते प्रलीयन्ते रात्र्यन्ते विश्वसंभवः स्वात्मन्यवस्थिते व्यक्ते विकारे प्रतिसंहृते
verses.transliteration: aharante pralīyante rātryante viśvasaṃbhavaḥ svātmanyavasthite vyakte vikāre pratisaṃhṛte
verses.translation: When the life-principle enters into Prakrti, there occurs an agita- tion (kfobha) in the form of contraction and expansion. Out of this agitation which is a process of Coming and Going, the universal teed is created, which has both the characteristics of the male and female. For detail, see MP, A siudjf, p -37.
verses.hindi: तब तीनों पुरोंमें निवास करनेवाले वे हैत्य उसकी मायाके कारण श्रौत-स्मार्त धर्मोका त्याग करके उसके शिष्य हो गये और उन्होंने महादेव परमेश्वर शंकरको तत्पश्चात् मायामय प्रभुके आदेशसे अपने शिष्यों-प्रशिष्योंसे चारों ओरसे घिरे हुए मायावी नारदमुनि भी उस पुरमें प्रवेश करके उस मायावी पुरुष-से स्वयं दीक्षित हुए। उन्होंने स्त्रयोंको दुराचार फलकी
verses.wordMeaning: When the life-principle enters into Prakrti, there occurs an agita- tion (kfobha) in the form of contraction and expansion. Out of this agitation which is a process of Coming and Going, the universal teed is created, which has both the characteristics of the male and female.…
verses.commentary: Sense: When the life-principle enters into Prakrti, there occurs an agita- tion (kfobha) in the form of contraction and expansion. Out of this agitation which is a process of Coming and Going, the universal teed is created, which has both the characteristics of the male and female.…

verses.sanskrit: साधर्म्येणावतिष्ठेते प्रधानपुरुषावुभौ तमःसत्त्वरजोपेतौ समत्वेन व्यवस्थितौ
verses.transliteration: sādharmyeṇāvatiṣṭhete pradhānapuruṣāvubhau tamaḥsattvarajopetau samatvena vyavasthitau
verses.translation: Out of this egg agitated thus, there come into existence the triadic principles known as Brahml, Vifpu and Siva identical with three gunas — rajas, sattva and tamas.
verses.hindi: सिद्धि देनेवाले स्त्रीधर्मका उपदेश दिया। उन स्त्रिये उसका सदा पालन किया और शीघ्र ही उसका फल प्राप्तकर वे अपने पतिदेवोंकी अवहेलना करके अन लोगोंमें आसक्त हो गयीं। उन नारदमुनिके गुरुत्वके
verses.wordMeaning: Out of this egg agitated thus, there come into existence the triadic principles known as Brahml, Vifpu and Siva identical with three gunas — rajas, sattva and tamas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Out of this egg agitated thus, there come into existence the triadic principles known as Brahml, Vifpu and Siva identical with three gunas — rajas, sattva and tamas.

verses.sanskrit: अनुपृक्तावभूतां ताव् ओतप्रोतौ परस्परम् गुणसाम्ये लयो ज्ञेयो वैषम्ये सृष्टिरुच्यते
verses.transliteration: anupṛktāvabhūtāṃ tāv otaprotau parasparam guṇasāmye layo jñeyo vaiṣamye sṛṣṭirucyate
verses.translation: The Pur&nas refer to the joint birth and joint activity of the triad.
verses.hindi: कारण आज भी कलियुगमें अधम स्त्रियाँ पतियोंका त्याग करके व्यभिचार करती हैं ॥ ८१-८४ /२॥ पति ही स्त्रियोंका माता-पिता, बन्थु, सखा, i तथा बान्धव होता है; इसमें सन्देह नहीं है। फिर भौ विष्णुकी असह मायाके कारण उन स्त्रियोंने वैसा किया   पाप करके भी जो स्त्री पतिके प्रति
verses.wordMeaning: The Pur&nas refer to the joint birth and joint activity of the triad.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Pur&nas refer to the joint birth and joint activity of the triad.

verses.sanskrit: तिले यथा भवेत्तैलं घृतं पयसि वा स्थितम् तथा तमसि सत्त्वे च रजस्यनुसृतं जगत्
verses.transliteration: tile yathā bhavettailaṃ ghṛtaṃ payasi vā sthitam tathā tamasi sattve ca rajasyanusṛtaṃ jagat
verses.translation: He is endowed with positive knowledge and lordship. They, (i.e. the three devas) are also endowed with positive virtue and detachment.
verses.hindi: अध्याय ७१ 1 तारकासुरके पुत्रों--विद्युन्माली, तारकाक्ष तथा 'कमलाक्षका वृत्तान्त ३३९
verses.wordMeaning: He is endowed with positive knowledge and lordship. They, (i.e. the three devas) are also endowed with positive virtue and detachment.
verses.commentary: Sense: He is endowed with positive knowledge and lordship. They, (i.e. the three devas) are also endowed with positive virtue and detachment.

verses.sanskrit: उपास्य रजनीं कृत्स्नां परां माहेश्वरीं तथा अर्हमुखे प्रवृत्तश् च परः प्रकृतिसंभवः
verses.transliteration: upāsya rajanīṃ kṛtsnāṃ parāṃ māheśvarīṃ tathā arhamukhe pravṛttaś ca paraḥ prakṛtisaṃbhavaḥ
verses.translation: Whatever has been mentally conceived or uttered by diem is bom out of the unmanifest, since it has been made to be subservient, and since the activities are dependent on the three Guas by nature.
verses.hindi: प्राप्नुयात्यरम स्वर्ग नरकं च विपर्ययात्। रहती है, वह परम स्वर्ग प्राप्त करती है और पुरैका मुनिशार्दूलाः सर्वधर्मान् सदा पतिम्॥ ८७  इससे विपरीत आचरणसे नरक प्राप्त करती है। हे सन्त्यज्यापूजयन् साध्व्यो देवानन्याञ्जगद्गुरून्। मुनिश्रेष्ठो! पूर्वकालमें स्त्रियाँ सभी धर्मों, अन्य देवताओं ताः स्वर्गलोकमासाद्य मोल विग री तथा जगद्गुरुओंको त्यागकर सर्वदा पतिकी पूजा करती थीं; वे स्वर्गलोक प्राप्त करके निश्चिन्त होकर आनन्द मनाती थीं, इसके विपरीत अन्य स्त्रियाँ नरक जाती थीं। अत: पति ही स्त्रियोंक लिये परम गति है। तथापि देवदेव प्रभु विष्णुकी आज्ञासे तथा उनकी
verses.wordMeaning: Whatever has been mentally conceived or uttered by diem is bom out of the unmanifest, since it has been made to be subservient, and since the activities are dependent on the three Guas by nature.
verses.commentary: Sense: Whatever has been mentally conceived or uttered by diem is bom out of the unmanifest, since it has been made to be subservient, and since the activities are dependent on the three Guas by nature.

verses.sanskrit: क्षोभयामास योगेन परेण परमेश्वरः प्रधानं पुरुषं चैव प्रविश्य स महेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: kṣobhayāmāsa yogena pareṇa parameśvaraḥ pradhānaṃ puruṣaṃ caiva praviśya sa maheśvaraḥ
verses.translation: The self-born deity has three conditions: in the capa- city of Brahma he is the four-faced one; in the capacity of K&la (i.e. Rudia)he is the destroyer; he is the thousand-headed Pnrua (i.e. Vijtiu) also.
verses.hindi: मायाके कारण वे त्रिपुरवासिनी स्त्रियाँ अपने पतियोंका त्याग करके व्यभिचारिणी हो गयीं ॥ ८५-८९ /२॥
verses.wordMeaning: The self-born deity has three conditions: in the capa- city of Brahma he is the four-faced one; in the capacity of K&la (i.e. Rudia)he is the destroyer; he is the thousand-headed Pnrua (i.e. Vijtiu) also.
verses.commentary: Sense: The self-born deity has three conditions: in the capa- city of Brahma he is the four-faced one; in the capacity of K&la (i.e. Rudia)he is the destroyer; he is the thousand-headed Pnrua (i.e. Vijtiu) also.

verses.sanskrit: महेश्वरात्त्रयो देवा जज्ञिरे जगदीश्वरात् शाश्वताः परमा गुह्यः सर्वात्मानः शरीरिणः
verses.transliteration: maheśvarāttrayo devā jajñire jagadīśvarāt śāśvatāḥ paramā guhyaḥ sarvātmānaḥ śarīriṇaḥ
verses.translation: In the capacity of Brahma, he creates the worlds; in the capacity of Kala, he destroys the world; in the capacity of Purua, he is indifferent. Prajapati has three stages.
verses.hindi: उन विष्णु-की आज्ञासे अलक्ष्मी तीनों पुरोंमें चली गयीं और जो लक्ष्मी उन हैत्यों-की तपस्याके द्वारा देवेश्वर ब्रह्मासे उन्हें प्राप्त थीं, वे उन्हीं प्रभु ब्रह्माके आदेशसे त्रिपुरको छोड़कर बाहर चली गयीं। इस प्रकार धर्मविघ्नके लिये उन हैत्योंको उस प्रकारका विष्णुमाया-निर्मित बुद्धिमोह देकर भगवान् पुरुष और उन स्त्रियोंको विपरीत आचरणका उपदेश देकर मायावी नारद--ये दोनों अव्यय देव निराकुल होकर
verses.wordMeaning: In the capacity of Brahma, he creates the worlds; in the capacity of Kala, he destroys the world; in the capacity of Purua, he is indifferent. Prajapati has three stages.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the capacity of Brahma, he creates the worlds; in the capacity of Kala, he destroys the world; in the capacity of Purua, he is indifferent. Prajapati has three stages.

verses.sanskrit: एत एव त्रयो देवा एत एव त्रयो गुणाः एत एव त्रयो लोका एत एव त्रयो ऽग्नयः
verses.transliteration: eta eva trayo devā eta eva trayo guṇāḥ eta eva trayo lokā eta eva trayo 'gnayaḥ
verses.translation: Brahmi has the lustre of the interior of a lotus; Rudra is like the fire at the time of dissolution; Puru$a is lotus-eyed. This is the form of the great soul.
verses.hindi: इस प्रकार परम उत्तम श्रौत-स्मार्त धर्मके नष्ट हो जानेपर, विश्वकर्ता उन विष्णुके द्वारा वहाँ पाखण्ड स्थापित कर दिये जानेपर, हैत्योंके द्वारा महेश्वरका त्याग कर दिये जानेपर तथा लिङ्गपूजाका परित्याग कर
verses.wordMeaning: Brahmi has the lustre of the interior of a lotus; Rudra is like the fire at the time of dissolution; Puru$a is lotus-eyed. This is the form of the great soul.
verses.commentary: Sense: Brahmi has the lustre of the interior of a lotus; Rudra is like the fire at the time of dissolution; Puru$a is lotus-eyed. This is the form of the great soul.

verses.sanskrit: परस्पराश्रिता ह्येते परस्परमनुव्रताः परस्परेण वर्तन्ते धारयन्ति परस्परम्
verses.transliteration: parasparāśritā hyete parasparamanuvratāḥ paraspareṇa vartante dhārayanti parasparam
verses.translation: The lord takes up a single body, two bodies, three bodies, and then many bodies. He creates and destroys these bodies, and dispels them too.
verses.hindi: दिये जानेपर, सम्पूर्ण स्त्रीधर्मके नष्ट हो जानेपर और दुराचार स्थापित हो जानेपर देवेश विष्णु कृतार्थ हो गये और वे पुरुषोत्तम सभी देवताओंके साथ तपस्याद्वारा सर्वज्ञ उमापतिको प्राप्त करके उनकी स्तुति करने श्रीभगवान् बोले- आप महेश्वर, देव, परमात्माको नमस्कार है । आप नारायण, शर्व, ब्रह्म, ब्रह्मरूप, शाश्वत, अनन्त तथा अव्यक्तको नमस्कार है
verses.wordMeaning: The lord takes up a single body, two bodies, three bodies, and then many bodies. He creates and destroys these bodies, and dispels them too.
verses.commentary: Sense: The lord takes up a single body, two bodies, three bodies, and then many bodies. He creates and destroys these bodies, and dispels them too.

verses.sanskrit: अन्योन्यमिथुना ह्येते अन्योन्यमुपजीविनः क्षणं वियोगो न ह्येषां न त्यजन्ति परस्परम्
verses.transliteration: anyonyamithunā hyete anyonyamupajīvinaḥ kṣaṇaṃ viyogo na hyeṣāṃ na tyajanti parasparam
verses.translation: The great lord creates and destroys bodies of different shapes, activities, forms and names.
verses.hindi: सूतजी बोले-इस प्रकार भगवान् विष्णु -ने महादेवकी स्तुति करके दण्डवत् प्रणाम करके जलमें स्थित होकर एक करोड़ बार रुद्रमन्त्रका जप किया। इसके बाद वे सभी देवता इन्द्र, साध्यगण, यम, रुद्र्गण
verses.wordMeaning: The great lord creates and destroys bodies of different shapes, activities, forms and names.
verses.commentary: Sense: The great lord creates and destroys bodies of different shapes, activities, forms and names.

verses.sanskrit: ईश्वरस्तु परो देवो विष्णुश् च महतः परः ब्रह्मा च रजसा युक्तः सर्गादौ हि प्रवर्तते
verses.transliteration: īśvarastu paro devo viṣṇuś ca mahataḥ paraḥ brahmā ca rajasā yuktaḥ sargādau hi pravartate
verses.translation: Since he assumes three different forms, he is called Trigutia. When divided into four, he is called Caturvyuha. (having four arrays).
verses.hindi: मायया देवदेवस्य विष्णोस्तस्याज्ञया प्रभो: । अलक्ष्मीश्च स्वयं तस्य नियोगात्त्रिपुरं गता या लक्ष्मीस्तपसा तेषां लब्धा देवेशवरादजात्। बहिर्गता परित्यज्य नियोगाद् ब्रह्मणः प्रभोः
verses.wordMeaning: Since he assumes three different forms, he is called Trigutia. When divided into four, he is called Caturvyuha. (having four arrays).
verses.commentary: Sense: Since he assumes three different forms, he is called Trigutia. When divided into four, he is called Caturvyuha. (having four arrays).

verses.sanskrit: परः स पुरुषो ज्ञेयः प्रकृतिः सा परा स्मृता
verses.transliteration: paraḥ sa puruṣo jñeyaḥ prakṛtiḥ sā parā smṛtā
verses.translation: He is defined as atman (soul) because he attains the sense objects (V&p to attain), because he takes up (a-f \/da to take up) the sense objects and because he swallows up (\/adto eat) the sense objects. Moreover, he has perpetual existence.
verses.hindi: बुद्धिमोह तथाभूतं विष्णुमायाविनिर्मितम्। तेषां दत्त्वा क्षणं देवस्तासां मायी च नारदः
verses.wordMeaning: He is defined as atman (soul) because he attains the sense objects (V&p to attain), because he takes up (a-f \/da to take up) the sense objects and because he swallows up (\/adto eat) the sense objects. Moreover, he has perpetual existence.
verses.commentary: Sense: He is defined as atman (soul) because he attains the sense objects (V&p to attain), because he takes up (a-f \/da to take up) the sense objects and because he swallows up (\/adto eat) the sense objects. Moreover, he has perpetual existence.

verses.sanskrit: अधिष्ठिता सा हि महेश्वरेण प्रवर्तते चोद्यमने समन्तात् अनुप्रवृत्तस्तु महांस्तदेनां चिरस्थिरत्वाद् विषयं श्रियः स्वयम्
verses.transliteration: adhiṣṭhitā sā hi maheśvareṇa pravartate codyamane samantāt anupravṛttastu mahāṃstadenāṃ cirasthiratvād viṣayaṃ śriyaḥ svayam
verses.translation: He is called 9-91 because he goes everywhere. He is Saririn because he b its (body's) lord. He b (called) Svfimin because he possesses everything. He b called Viitlu be- cause he enters everything.
verses.hindi: सुखासीनौ हयसम्भ्रान्तौ धर्मविघ्नार्थमव्ययौ। एवं नष्टे तदा धर्मे श्रौतस्मार्ते सुशोभने पाषण्डे ख्यापिते तेन विष्णुना विश्वयोनिना। त्यक्ते महेश्वरे हैत्यैस्त्यक्ते लिङ्गार्चने तथा
verses.wordMeaning: He is called 9-91 because he goes everywhere. He is Saririn because he b its (body's) lord. He b (called) Svfimin because he possesses everything. He b called Viitlu be- cause he enters everything.
verses.commentary: Sense: He is called 9-91 because he goes everywhere. He is Saririn because he b its (body's) lord. He b (called) Svfimin because he possesses everything. He b called Viitlu be- cause he enters everything.

verses.sanskrit: प्रधानगुणवैषम्यात् सर्गकालः प्रवर्तते ईश्वराधिष्ठितात्पूर्वं तस्मात्सदसदात्मकात्
verses.transliteration: pradhānaguṇavaiṣamyāt sargakālaḥ pravartate īśvarādhiṣṭhitātpūrvaṃ tasmātsadasadātmakāt
verses.translation: He b called Bhagavan because he possesses Bhaga
verses.hindi: स्त्रीधर्मे निखिले नष्टे दुराचारे व्यवस्थिते। कृतार्थं इव देवेशो देवैः सार्धमुमापतिम्
verses.wordMeaning: He b called Bhagavan because he possesses Bhaga
verses.commentary: Sense: He b called Bhagavan because he possesses Bhaga

verses.sanskrit: संसिद्धः कार्यकरणे रुद्रश्चाग्रे ह्यवर्तत तेजसाप्रतिमो धीमान् अव्यक्तः सम्प्रकाशकः
verses.transliteration: saṃsiddhaḥ kāryakaraṇe rudraścāgre hyavartata tejasāpratimo dhīmān avyaktaḥ samprakāśakaḥ
verses.translation: He is called Sarvajfia because he knows everything perfectly. He is Sarva because he is identical with all. He divides himself into three and functions in the three worlds.
verses.hindi: श्रीभगवानुवाच महेश्वराय देवाय नमस्ते परमात्मने नारायणाय शर्वाय ब्रह्मणे ब्रह्मरूपिणे। शाश्वताय ह्यनन्ताय अव्यक्ताय च ते नमः
verses.wordMeaning: He is called Sarvajfia because he knows everything perfectly. He is Sarva because he is identical with all. He divides himself into three and functions in the three worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: He is called Sarvajfia because he knows everything perfectly. He is Sarva because he is identical with all. He divides himself into three and functions in the three worlds.

verses.sanskrit: स वै शरीरी प्रथमः स वै पुरुष उच्यते ब्रह्मा च भगवांस्तस्माच् चतुर्वक्त्रः प्रजापतिः
verses.transliteration: sa vai śarīrī prathamaḥ sa vai puruṣa ucyate brahmā ca bhagavāṃstasmāc caturvaktraḥ prajāpatiḥ
verses.translation: By means of three forms he creates, swallows and protects. Since he is primordial he is called "Adideva''. He is called Aja because he is not born.
verses.hindi: एवं स्तुत्वा महादेवं दण्डवत्प्रणिपत्य च। जजाप रुद्रं भगवान् कोटिवारं जले स्थितः
verses.wordMeaning: By means of three forms he creates, swallows and protects. Since he is primordial he is called "Adideva''. He is called Aja because he is not born.
verses.commentary: Sense: By means of three forms he creates, swallows and protects. Since he is primordial he is called "Adideva''. He is called Aja because he is not born.

verses.sanskrit: संसिद्धः कार्यकारणे तथा वै समवर्तत एक एव महादेवस् त्रिधैवं स व्यवस्थितः
verses.transliteration: saṃsiddhaḥ kāryakāraṇe tathā vai samavartata eka eva mahādevas tridhaivaṃ sa vyavasthitaḥ
verses.translation: Since he protects people he is known as Prajapati, Since he is the greatest among Devas he is called Mahadeva.
verses.hindi: देवाश्च सर्वे ते देवं तुष्टुवुः परमेश्वरम्। सेन्रा: ससाध्याः सयमाः सरुद्राः समरुद्गणाः नमः सर्वात्मने तुभ्यं शङ्करायार्तिहारिणे। रुद्राय नीलरुद्राय कद्रुद्राय प्रचेतसे
verses.wordMeaning: Since he protects people he is known as Prajapati, Since he is the greatest among Devas he is called Mahadeva.
verses.commentary: Sense: Since he protects people he is known as Prajapati, Since he is the greatest among Devas he is called Mahadeva.

verses.sanskrit: अप्रतीपेन ज्ञानेन ऐश्वर्येण समन्वितः धर्मेण चाप्रतीपेन वैराग्येण च ते ऽन्विताः
verses.transliteration: apratīpena jñānena aiśvaryeṇa samanvitaḥ dharmeṇa cāpratīpena vairāgyeṇa ca te 'nvitāḥ
verses.translation: He is Omnipresent and not subservient to Devas. Hence, he is Hvara. He is Brahma because he is massive. He is called Bhuta because of his existence.
verses.hindi: गतिर्नः सर्वदास्माभिर्वन्द्यो देवारिमर्दनः। त्वमादिस्त्वमनन्तश्च अनन्तश्चाक्षयः प्रभुः
verses.wordMeaning: He is Omnipresent and not subservient to Devas. Hence, he is Hvara. He is Brahma because he is massive. He is called Bhuta because of his existence.
verses.commentary: Sense: He is Omnipresent and not subservient to Devas. Hence, he is Hvara. He is Brahma because he is massive. He is called Bhuta because of his existence.

verses.sanskrit: अव्यक्ताज्जायते तेषां मनसा यद्यदीहितम् वशीकृतत्वात्त्रैगुण्यं सापेक्षत्वात्स्वभावतः
verses.transliteration: avyaktājjāyate teṣāṃ manasā yadyadīhitam vaśīkṛtatvāttraiguṇyaṃ sāpekṣatvātsvabhāvataḥ
verses.translation: He is. called the knower of the field (i.e. body); he comprehends the inner organs, mind, etc. Since he is single he is called Kevala. Since he lies down in the soul he is called Purus a.
verses.hindi: वदन्ति सूरयः सन्तं परं ब्रह्मस्वरूपिणम् सर्वतः श्रुतिमल्लोके सर्वमावृत्य तिष्ठसि
verses.wordMeaning: He is. called the knower of the field (i.e. body); he comprehends the inner organs, mind, etc. Since he is single he is called Kevala. Since he lies down in the soul he is called Purus a.
verses.commentary: Sense: He is. called the knower of the field (i.e. body); he comprehends the inner organs, mind, etc. Since he is single he is called Kevala. Since he lies down in the soul he is called Purus a.

verses.sanskrit: चतुर्मुखस्तु ब्रह्मत्वे कालत्वे चान्तकः स्मृतः सहस्रमूर्धा पुरुषस् तिस्रो ऽवस्थाः स्वयंभुवः
verses.transliteration: caturmukhastu brahmatve kālatve cāntakaḥ smṛtaḥ sahasramūrdhā puruṣas tisro 'vasthāḥ svayaṃbhuvaḥ
verses.translation: He is Kramana because he has access to all (or is accessible to all). He is Palaka because he protects all. He is Aditya because he is tan-coloured. Being born at the outset he is Agni (fire).
verses.hindi: महादेवमनिर्देश्यं सर्वज्ञं त्वामनामयम्। विश्वरूपं विरूपाक्षं सदाशिवमनामयम्
verses.wordMeaning: He is Kramana because he has access to all (or is accessible to all). He is Palaka because he protects all. He is Aditya because he is tan-coloured. Being born at the outset he is Agni (fire).
verses.commentary: Sense: He is Kramana because he has access to all (or is accessible to all). He is Palaka because he protects all. He is Aditya because he is tan-coloured. Being born at the outset he is Agni (fire).

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मत्वे सृजते लोकान् कालत्वे संक्षिपत्यपि पुरुषत्वे ह्युदासीनस् तिस्रो ऽवस्थाः प्रजापतेः
verses.transliteration: brahmatve sṛjate lokān kālatve saṃkṣipatyapi puruṣatve hyudāsīnas tisro 'vasthāḥ prajāpateḥ
verses.translation: Because he is the cause of origin of all golden things and also because he is born of the golden Egg, he is called Hiranyagarbha.
verses.hindi: कोटिभास्करसङ्काशं कोटिशीतांशुसन्निभम्। कोटिकालाग्निसङ्काशं षड्विंशकमनीश्वरम् वदन्ति वरदं देवं सर्वावासं स्वयम्भुवम्
verses.wordMeaning: Because he is the cause of origin of all golden things and also because he is born of the golden Egg, he is called Hiranyagarbha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Because he is the cause of origin of all golden things and also because he is born of the golden Egg, he is called Hiranyagarbha.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मा कमलगर्भाभो रुद्रः कालाग्निसन्निभः पुरुषः पुण्डरीकाक्षो रूपं तत्परमात्मनः
verses.transliteration: brahmā kamalagarbhābho rudraḥ kālāgnisannibhaḥ puruṣaḥ puṇḍarīkākṣo rūpaṃ tatparamātmanaḥ
verses.translation: The time that has gone by after the self-born has been in existence cannot be reckoned even in hundreds of years.
verses.hindi: विना कृतं यद्भवताथ लोके।
verses.wordMeaning: The time that has gone by after the self-born has been in existence cannot be reckoned even in hundreds of years.
verses.commentary: Sense: The time that has gone by after the self-born has been in existence cannot be reckoned even in hundreds of years.

verses.sanskrit: एकधा स द्विधा चैव त्रिधा च बहुधा पुनः महेश्वरः शरीराणि करोति विकरोति च
verses.transliteration: ekadhā sa dvidhā caiva tridhā ca bahudhā punaḥ maheśvaraḥ śarīrāṇi karoti vikaroti ca
verses.translation: The first half Parardha in the age of the present Brahma has already elapsed and another period of equal duration i.e. second half still remains. At its end begins the dissolution of the worlds.
verses.hindi: हैत्यान् सुरभूतसङ्घान् देवान्नरान् स्थावरजङ्गमांश्च
verses.wordMeaning: The first half Parardha in the age of the present Brahma has already elapsed and another period of equal duration i.e. second half still remains. At its end begins the dissolution of the worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: The first half Parardha in the age of the present Brahma has already elapsed and another period of equal duration i.e. second half still remains. At its end begins the dissolution of the worlds.

verses.sanskrit: नानाकृतिक्रियारूपनामवन्ति स्वलीलया महेश्वरः शरीराणि करोति विकरोति च
verses.transliteration: nānākṛtikriyārūpanāmavanti svalīlayā maheśvaraḥ śarīrāṇi karoti vikaroti ca
verses.translation: Crores and thousands of crores of these days of kalpas
verses.hindi: Cth TE ल्न फफफ्रफफफफफफफ्रफफफफ फफक फ फापर कपका फ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ फ़ फ फ़ फ़ फ फ़ फ फ फ फ फ फ़ फक क फ़ फ फफफ क्रपाफामा ममम कमफ फफ फफफ फफफ फफक कफ
verses.wordMeaning: Crores and thousands of crores of these days of kalpas
verses.commentary: Sense: Crores and thousands of crores of these days of kalpas

verses.sanskrit: त्रिधा यद्वर्तते लोके तस्मात्त्रिगुण उच्यते चतुर्धा प्रविभक्तत्वाच् चतुर्व्यूहः प्रकीर्तितः
verses.transliteration: tridhā yadvartate loke tasmāttriguṇa ucyate caturdhā pravibhaktatvāc caturvyūhaḥ prakīrtitaḥ
verses.translation: If one manvantara is recounted, the other man- vantaras are also recounted. If one kalpa is explained, all the other kalpas too are explained.
verses.hindi: तथा मरुद्गणोंके साथ देव परमेश्वरकी स्तुति करने लगे रुद्र, नीलरुद्र, कद्रद्र (प्रशस्त रुद्र) तथा प्रचेताको नमस्कार है। आप हमलोगोंकी गति हैं। हैत्योंका संहार करनेवाले आप हमलोगोंद्वारा सर्वदा वन्द्य हैं। आप आदि तथा अन्तरहित हैं; आप अनन्त (शेषरूप), अविनाशी एवं प्रभुतासम्पन
verses.wordMeaning: If one manvantara is recounted, the other man- vantaras are also recounted. If one kalpa is explained, all the other kalpas too are explained.
verses.commentary: Sense: If one manvantara is recounted, the other man- vantaras are also recounted. If one kalpa is explained, all the other kalpas too are explained.

verses.sanskrit: यदाप्नोति यदादत्ते यच्चात्ति विषयानयम् यच्चास्य सततं भावस् तस्मादात्मा निरुच्यते
verses.transliteration: yadāpnoti yadādatte yaccātti viṣayānayam yaccāsya satataṃ bhāvas tasmādātmā nirucyate
