verses.translation: The past kalpas are such that they leave their con* sequences on the future ones along with (or including) the dynasties of Kings etc. and the same reasoning should be applied to future kalpas by the knowing man (i.e., the past has left its marks on the present and in the same way the future will carry the marks of the present,
verses.hindi: हैं। है जगद्गुरो ! आप प्रकृति, पुरुष, साक्षात् स्रष्टा, रक्षक तथा संहारक हैं । है द्विजवत्सल ! आप इस जगतूमें द्विजोंके नेता हैं। आप वरदाता, वाणीमय, वाच्य, वाच्य-वाचकसे रहित ईशान हैं; आप मुक्तिके लिये योगपरायण योगियोंके
verses.wordMeaning: The past kalpas are such that they leave their con* sequences on the future ones along with (or including) the dynasties of Kings etc. and the same reasoning should be applied to future kalpas by the knowing man (i.e.,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The past kalpas are such that they leave their con* sequences on the future ones along with (or including) the dynasties of Kings etc. and the same reasoning should be applied to future kalpas by the knowing man (i.e.,…

verses.sanskrit: ऋषिः सर्वगतत्वाच्च शरीरी सो ऽस्य यत्प्रभुः स्वामित्वमस्य यत्सर्वं विष्णुः सर्वप्रवेशनात्
verses.transliteration: ṛṣiḥ sarvagatatvācca śarīrī so 'sya yatprabhuḥ svāmitvamasya yatsarvaṃ viṣṇuḥ sarvapraveśanāt
verses.translation: The waters were in existence at the outset when the whole surface of the earth had been destroyed. In the vast quiet and sparkling waters nothing else was known. When the mobile and immobile beings are destroyed in that vast, sealike expanse of water, Brahmfi assumes a form with thousand eyes, thousand feet, thousand heads.«®i He is then called Narayana. He is the golden-coloured Purusa beyond the sense organs. He had his shrrber in that expanse of water.
verses.hindi: द्वारा पूज्य हैं। आप योगियोंके हृदयरूपी कमलके छिद्रमें सदा स्थित हैं । विद्वानूलोग आपको सर्वत्र विद्यमान श्रेष्ठ तथा ब्रह्मस्वरूप कहते हैं । है विभो ! ऋषिगण आपको इस जगतूमें तत्त्वरूप, तेजोराशि, परात्पर एवं परमात्मा कहते हैं । है जगद्गुरो ! आप दृष्ट, श्रुत, स्थित तथा जायमान सब कुछ हैं। लोग आपको अणुसे भी अल्पतर, महानसे भी
verses.wordMeaning: The waters were in existence at the outset when the whole surface of the earth had been destroyed. In the vast quiet and sparkling waters nothing else was known. When the mobile and immobile beings are destroyed in that vast, sealike expanse of water,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The waters were in existence at the outset when the whole surface of the earth had been destroyed. In the vast quiet and sparkling waters nothing else was known. When the mobile and immobile beings are destroyed in that vast, sealike expanse of water,…

verses.sanskrit: भगवान् भगवद्भावान् निर्मलत्वाच्छिवः स्मृतः परमः सम्प्रकृष्टत्वाद् अवनाद् ओमिति स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: bhagavān bhagavadbhāvān nirmalatvācchivaḥ smṛtaḥ paramaḥ samprakṛṣṭatvād avanād omiti smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: When saliva guna was prevalent he woke up and found the world a void. They cite this verse about Narayana.
verses.hindi: मुखवाला तथा सभी ओर कानवाला कहते हैं । आप संसारमें सभीको आच्छादित करके स्थित हैं
verses.wordMeaning: When saliva guna was prevalent he woke up and found the world a void. They cite this verse about Narayana.
verses.commentary: Sense: When saliva guna was prevalent he woke up and found the world a void. They cite this verse about Narayana.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वज्ञः सर्वविज्ञानात् सर्वः सर्वमयो यतः त्रिधा विभज्य चात्मानं त्रैलोक्यं सम्प्रवर्तते
verses.transliteration: sarvajñaḥ sarvavijñānāt sarvaḥ sarvamayo yataḥ tridhā vibhajya cātmānaṃ trailokyaṃ sampravartate
verses.translation: See * note. 86.
verses.hindi: लोग आपको महादेव, अनिर्देश्य, सर्वज्ञ, अनामय, विश्वरूप, विरूपाक्ष, सदाशिव, निर्विकार, करोड़ों सूर्योके समान तेजस्वी करोड़ों चन्द्रमासदूश प्रकाशमान, करोड़ों कालाग्निके समान  प्रज्वलित, छब्बीस ततत्वोसे युक्त, अनीश्वर, इस जगतूमें प्रकृतिके प्रवर्तक, प्रपितामह, सबके आवास-स्वरूप तथा स्वयम्भू (स्वयं उत्पन्न होनेवाला) एवं बर देनेवाला देव कहते हैं; श्रुतियाँ तथा श्रुति-तत्त्वोंको जाननेवाले लोग आपकी
verses.wordMeaning: See * note. 86.
verses.commentary: Sense: See * note. 86.

verses.sanskrit: सृजते ग्रसते चैव रक्षते च त्रिभिः स्वयम् आदित्वाद् आदिदेवो ऽसाव् अजातत्वाद् अजः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: sṛjate grasate caiva rakṣate ca tribhiḥ svayam āditvād ādidevo 'sāv ajātatvād ajaḥ smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: In that boar form he approached the earth envelop- ed by water and quickly lifted it up.
verses.wordMeaning: In that boar form he approached the earth envelop- ed by water and quickly lifted it up.
verses.commentary: Sense: In that boar form he approached the earth envelop- ed by water and quickly lifted it up.

verses.sanskrit: पाति यस्मात्प्रजाः सर्वाः प्रजापतिर् इति स्मृतः देवेषु च महान्देवो महादेवस्ततः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: pāti yasmātprajāḥ sarvāḥ prajāpatir iti smṛtaḥ deveṣu ca mahāndevo mahādevastataḥ smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: The waters immediately filled up the oceans, and the rivers. For the welfare of the worlds, the lord lifted up the earth by means of his curved fangs, the earth, that had submerged and got embedded in the nether worlds. The hol- der of the earth, Lord Visnu, the lifter of the earth held it, brought it to its original place and left it there as it was before. The earth stood like a great ship above that vast collection of water and on a par with it. Because of its massive body the earth did not sink and get submerged. After lifting it up the lotus-eyed lord with the desire to fit the world firmly turned his attention towards the demarcation of the earth. He made the earth level and then collected the mountains.
verses.hindi: ऐसा कुछ भी नहीं देखा है, जो आपके बिना किसी अन्यके द्वारा रचित हो; आपने ही हैत्यों, सुके भूतसमुदायों, देवताओं, मनुष्यों, स्थावर-जंगम आदिकी उत्पन्न किया है हे शम्भो! हमलोगोंकी कोई अन्य गति नहीं है;
verses.wordMeaning: The waters immediately filled up the oceans, and the rivers. For the welfare of the worlds, the lord lifted up the earth by means of his curved fangs, the earth, that had submerged and got embedded in the nether worlds. The hol- der of the earth, Lord Visnu,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The waters immediately filled up the oceans, and the rivers. For the welfare of the worlds, the lord lifted up the earth by means of his curved fangs, the earth, that had submerged and got embedded in the nether worlds. The hol- der of the earth, Lord Visnu,…

verses.sanskrit: सर्वगत्वाच्च देवानाम् अवश्यत्वाच्च ईश्वरः बृहत्त्वाच्च स्मृतो ब्रह्मा भूतत्वाद्भूत उच्यते
verses.transliteration: sarvagatvācca devānām avaśyatvācca īśvaraḥ bṛhattvācca smṛto brahmā bhūtatvādbhūta ucyate
verses.translation: When everything of the previous creation was burnt by the fire at the time of dissolution the mountains got scattered over an extensive area. Due to chilliness in that vast sea-like expanse of water the scattered pieces of mountains were heaped up by the wind. Wherever they were deposited they became the stable mountains.
verses.hindi: अध्याय ७१  तारकासुरके पुत्रों-विद्युन्माली, तारकाक्ष तथा कमलाक्षका वृत्तान्त ३४१
verses.wordMeaning: When everything of the previous creation was burnt by the fire at the time of dissolution the mountains got scattered over an extensive area. Due to chilliness in that vast sea-like expanse of water the scattered pieces of mountains were heaped up by the wind.…
verses.commentary: Sense: When everything of the previous creation was burnt by the fire at the time of dissolution the mountains got scattered over an extensive area. Due to chilliness in that vast sea-like expanse of water the scattered pieces of mountains were heaped up by the wind.…

verses.sanskrit: क्षेत्रज्ञः क्षेत्रविज्ञानाद् एकत्वात्केवलः स्मृतः यस्मात्पुर्यां स शेते च तस्मात्पूरुष उच्यते
verses.transliteration: kṣetrajñaḥ kṣetravijñānād ekatvātkevalaḥ smṛtaḥ yasmātpuryāṃ sa śete ca tasmātpūruṣa ucyate
verses.translation: Mountains are called acalas because they never move, they are called parvatas because they have knots (par- vans). They are giris because they are absorbed and hidden. They are called iloccayas because they keep lying down.
verses.hindi: FD i EEE CECE EEE EEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEE नल नल पक्की अकफफफफफफफफफफफफफफफफफफफफफ फफफ फ फ फ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ फ़ फ़ फ फ़ फ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ फा म की £ यया नुस लहरीसमूहा  संहार करके आप हमारी रक्षा कोजिये। युध्यन्ति चान्योन्यमपांनिधौ च । है परमेश्वर ! सभीलोग आपकी मायासे मोहित हैं
verses.wordMeaning: Mountains are called acalas because they never move, they are called parvatas because they have knots (par- vans). They are giris because they are absorbed and hidden. They are called iloccayas because they keep lying down.
verses.commentary: Sense: Mountains are called acalas because they never move, they are called parvatas because they have knots (par- vans). They are giris because they are absorbed and hidden. They are called iloccayas because they keep lying down.

verses.sanskrit: अनादित्वाच्च पूर्वत्वात् स्वयंभूरिति संस्मृतः याज्यत्वादुच्यते यज्ञः कविर् विक्रान्तदर्शनात्
verses.transliteration: anāditvācca pūrvatvāt svayaṃbhūriti saṃsmṛtaḥ yājyatvāducyate yajñaḥ kavir vikrāntadarśanāt
verses.translation: He then divided the earth into seven continents,
verses.hindi: जलाश्रयादेव जडीकृताश्च जिस प्रकार तरंगें तथा लहरें समुद्रमें परस्पर सुरासुरास्तद्वदजस्य सर्वम्॥ ११४ टकराती हैं और जलाश्रयसे ही जड़ीभूत होकर उसीमें
verses.wordMeaning: He then divided the earth into seven continents,
verses.commentary: Sense: He then divided the earth into seven continents,

verses.sanskrit: क्रमणः क्रमणीयत्वात् पालकश्चापि पालनात् आदित्यसंज्ञः कपिलो ह्य् अग्रजो ऽग्निरिति स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: kramaṇaḥ kramaṇīyatvāt pālakaścāpi pālanāt ādityasaṃjñaḥ kapilo hy agrajo 'gniriti smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: After evolving the worlds, the self-born Brahma, the lord who was desirous of creating different subjects, began creating them.
verses.hindi: लाक विलीन हो जाती हैं, उसी प्रकार ब्रह्माकी सृष्टिके अन्तमें जडीभूत होकर आपमें ही विलीन हो जाते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: After evolving the worlds, the self-born Brahma, the lord who was desirous of creating different subjects, began creating them.
verses.commentary: Sense: After evolving the worlds, the self-born Brahma, the lord who was desirous of creating different subjects, began creating them.

verses.sanskrit: हिरण्यमस्य गर्भो ऽभूद् धिरण्यस्यापि गर्भजः तस्माद्धिरण्यगर्भत्वं पुराणे ऽस्मिन्निरुच्यते
verses.transliteration: hiraṇyamasya garbho 'bhūd dhiraṇyasyāpi garbhajaḥ tasmāddhiraṇyagarbhatvaṃ purāṇe 'sminnirucyate
verses.translation: On seeing this first creation in that situation as well as useless for any action (being immobile) he became dissatis- fied in mind, and thought about another.
verses.hindi: सूतजी बोले--जो मनुष्य प्रातःकाल उठकर शुद्ध होकर इस पवित्र स्तुतिको पढ़ता अथवा सुनता है, वह सभी कामनाओंको प्राप्त कर लेता है
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing this first creation in that situation as well as useless for any action (being immobile) he became dissatis- fied in mind, and thought about another.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing this first creation in that situation as well as useless for any action (being immobile) he became dissatis- fied in mind, and thought about another.

verses.sanskrit: स्वयंभुवो ऽपि वृत्तस्य कालो विश्वात्मनस्तु यः न शक्यः परिसंख्यातुम् अपि वर्षशतैरपि
verses.transliteration: svayaṃbhuvo 'pi vṛttasya kālo viśvātmanastu yaḥ na śakyaḥ parisaṃkhyātum api varṣaśatairapi
verses.translation: Even as he meditated over it the Tiryaksrotas creation (moving sideways) was developed. Since it functioned sideways it is called Tiryaksrotas.
verses.hindi: इस प्रकार देवताओंके द्वारा स्तुति किये जाने तथा विष्णुके जपसे प्रसन्न हुए महेश्वर शंकरने उमाका आलिङ्गन करके नन्दीके ऊपर हाथ रखकर देवताओंकी ओर देखकर गम्भीर वाणीमें मुसकराते हुए कहा-- हे सुरेश्वरो! अब मैंने इस देवकार्यको और विष्णु तथा बुद्धिमान् नारदके मायाबलको जान लिया है। है श्रेष्ठ
verses.wordMeaning: Even as he meditated over it the Tiryaksrotas creation (moving sideways) was developed. Since it functioned sideways it is called Tiryaksrotas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Even as he meditated over it the Tiryaksrotas creation (moving sideways) was developed. Since it functioned sideways it is called Tiryaksrotas.

verses.sanskrit: कालसंख्याविवृत्तस्य परार्धो ब्रह्मणः स्मृतः तावच्छेषो ऽस्य कालो ऽन्यस् तस्यान्ते प्रतिसृज्यते
verses.transliteration: kālasaṃkhyāvivṛttasya parārdho brahmaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ tāvaccheṣo 'sya kālo 'nyas tasyānte pratisṛjyate
verses.translation: The animals etc. (i.e. birds and reptiles) constitute this well-known creation. O brahmins, they are those who adopt wrong paths. So he meditated on another creation and the Sattvika creation was evolved.
verses.wordMeaning: The animals etc. (i.e. birds and reptiles) constitute this well-known creation. O brahmins, they are those who adopt wrong paths. So he meditated on another creation and the Sattvika creation was evolved.
verses.commentary: Sense: The animals etc. (i.e. birds and reptiles) constitute this well-known creation. O brahmins, they are those who adopt wrong paths. So he meditated on another creation and the Sattvika creation was evolved.

verses.sanskrit: कोटिकोटिसहस्राणि अहर्भूतानि यानि वै समतीतानि कल्पानां तावच्छेषाः परे तु ये यस्त्वयं वर्तते कल्पो वाराहस्तं निबोधत
verses.transliteration: koṭikoṭisahasrāṇi aharbhūtāni yāni vai samatītāni kalpānāṃ tāvaccheṣāḥ pare tu ye yastvayaṃ vartate kalpo vārāhastaṃ nibodhata
verses.translation: This third creation is Ordhvasrotas which is directed upwards. Since it functions upwards it is called Crdhva- srotas. The beings created under this category are mostly happy and delighted. They are enshrouded within and without as well as illuminated on both sides.
verses.hindi: सूतजी बोले-इसके बाद वहाँ आये हुए वे इन्द्र-ब्रह्मा-विष्णुसहित देवताओंने प्रभुका वचन सुनकर उन्हें प्रणाम किया तथा उनकी स्तुति को। इसके अनन्तर शिवकी ओर देखकर विस्मित देवी भी अपने लीला-कमलसे शिवजीको मारकर (स्पर्शकर) यह
verses.wordMeaning: This third creation is Ordhvasrotas which is directed upwards. Since it functions upwards it is called Crdhva- srotas. The beings created under this category are mostly happy and delighted. They are enshrouded within and without as well as illuminated on both sides.
verses.commentary: Sense: This third creation is Ordhvasrotas which is directed upwards. Since it functions upwards it is called Crdhva- srotas. The beings created under this category are mostly happy and delighted. They are enshrouded within and without as well as illuminated on both sides.

verses.sanskrit: प्रथमः सांप्रतस्तेषां कल्पो ऽयं वर्तते द्विजाः यस्मिन्स्वायंभुवाद्यास्तु मनवस्ते चतुर्दश
verses.transliteration: prathamaḥ sāṃpratasteṣāṃ kalpo 'yaṃ vartate dvijāḥ yasminsvāyaṃbhuvādyāstu manavaste caturdaśa
verses.translation: Because they have been created with the union of Sattvaguna, they are known as originating from Sattva. This third creation of Ordhvasrotas is that of Devas.
verses.hindi: देवी बोलीं-हे विभो! है पुत्रवानोंमें श्रेष्ठ! उत्तम आभूषणोंसे सुशोभित तथा सूर्यके समान प्रतीत होनेवाले अपने इस खेलते हुए श्रेष्ठ पुत्र षडाननको देखिये। है महादेव! मुकुटों, कटकों, कुण्डलों, सुन्दर
verses.wordMeaning: Because they have been created with the union of Sattvaguna, they are known as originating from Sattva. This third creation of Ordhvasrotas is that of Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Because they have been created with the union of Sattvaguna, they are known as originating from Sattva. This third creation of Ordhvasrotas is that of Devas.

verses.sanskrit: अतीता वर्तमानाश् च भविष्या ये च वै पुनः तैरियं पृथिवी सर्वा सप्तद्वीपा सपर्वता
verses.transliteration: atītā vartamānāś ca bhaviṣyā ye ca vai punaḥ tairiyaṃ pṛthivī sarvā saptadvīpā saparvatā
verses.translation: The creations originating in the category of Crdhva- srotas are brilliant within and without. The Crdhvasrotas crea- tions are stated by the learned to be satisfied souls.
verses.hindi: कंगनों, नूपुरों, छन्नवारों, करधनियों, अनेक किंकिणियों, सुवर्णमय पीपलके पत्तों, कल्पद्ुमके पुष्पोंसे शोभित सुन्दर अलकों, प्राग आदि मणियोंसे चमत्कृत हारों तथा बाजूबन्दो, पूर्णचन्द्रमाके समान प्रभावाले मुक्ताफलमय हारों और तिलकोंसे मण्डित परम सुन्दर पुत्रको देखिये। हे ईश! कुंकुम आदिसे अंकित तथा भस्मनिर्मित
verses.wordMeaning: The creations originating in the category of Crdhva- srotas are brilliant within and without. The Crdhvasrotas crea- tions are stated by the learned to be satisfied souls.
verses.commentary: Sense: The creations originating in the category of Crdhva- srotas are brilliant within and without. The Crdhvasrotas crea- tions are stated by the learned to be satisfied souls.

verses.sanskrit: पूर्णं युगसहस्रं वै परिपाल्या महेश्वरैः प्रजाभिस्तपसा चैव तेषां शृणुत विस्तरम्
verses.transliteration: pūrṇaṃ yugasahasraṃ vai paripālyā maheśvaraiḥ prajābhistapasā caiva teṣāṃ śṛṇuta vistaram
verses.translation: When Devas, the creations in the category of Crdhva- srotas were created Brahma, the lord who grants boons, became delighted, but he still meditated on another creation.
verses.hindi: श्रुणुयाद्वा स्तवं पुण्यं सर्वकाममवाप्नुयात्
verses.wordMeaning: When Devas, the creations in the category of Crdhva- srotas were created Brahma, the lord who grants boons, became delighted, but he still meditated on another creation.
verses.commentary: Sense: When Devas, the creations in the category of Crdhva- srotas were created Brahma, the lord who grants boons, became delighted, but he still meditated on another creation.

verses.sanskrit: मन्वन्तरेण चैकेन सर्वाण्येवान्तराणि च कथितानि भविष्यन्ति कल्पः कल्पेन चैव हि
verses.transliteration: manvantareṇa caikena sarvāṇyevāntarāṇi ca kathitāni bhaviṣyanti kalpaḥ kalpena caiva hi
verses.translation: He pondered over the creation that will be Sadhaka*® (active and fit for action). Even as he was meditating truthfully, the active Arvaksrotas creation manifested itself from the unmanifest Prakrti. Since it functions downwards it is called Arvaksrotas.
verses.hindi: सोमः सोमामथालिङ्ग्य नन्दिदत्तकरः स्मयन् प्राह गम्भीरया वाचा देवानालोक्य शङ्करः ।
verses.wordMeaning: He pondered over the creation that will be Sadhaka*® (active and fit for action). Even as he was meditating truthfully, the active Arvaksrotas creation manifested itself from the unmanifest Prakrti. Since it functions downwards it is called Arvaksrotas.
verses.commentary: Sense: He pondered over the creation that will be Sadhaka*® (active and fit for action). Even as he was meditating truthfully, the active Arvaksrotas creation manifested itself from the unmanifest Prakrti. Since it functions downwards it is called Arvaksrotas.

verses.sanskrit: अतीतानि च कल्पानि सोदर्काणि सहान्वयैः अनागतेषु तद्वच्च तर्कः कार्यो विजानता
verses.transliteration: atītāni ca kalpāni sodarkāṇi sahānvayaiḥ anāgateṣu tadvacca tarkaḥ kāryo vijānatā
verses.translation: The beings created thus are mostly brilliant; rajas predominates in them and there is a mixture of tamas also. Hence, there is a predominance of misery and they do their tasks again and again.
verses.hindi: ज्ञातं मयेदमधुना देवकार्यं सुरेश्वराः
verses.wordMeaning: The beings created thus are mostly brilliant; rajas predominates in them and there is a mixture of tamas also. Hence, there is a predominance of misery and they do their tasks again and again.
verses.commentary: Sense: The beings created thus are mostly brilliant; rajas predominates in them and there is a mixture of tamas also. Hence, there is a predominance of misery and they do their tasks again and again.

verses.sanskrit: आपो ह्यग्रे समभवन् नष्टे च पृथिवीतले शान्ततारैकनीरे ऽस्मिन् न प्राज्ञायत किंचन
verses.transliteration: āpo hyagre samabhavan naṣṭe ca pṛthivītale śāntatāraikanīre 'smin na prājñāyata kiṃcana
verses.translation: They are human beings enshrouded within and with- out, and active. They are classified into eight categories through their redeeming feature,
verses.hindi: तेषामधर्मनिष्ठानां हैत्यानां देवसत्तमाः पुरत्रयविनाशं च करिष्येऽहं सुरोत्तमाः।
verses.wordMeaning: They are human beings enshrouded within and with- out, and active. They are classified into eight categories through their redeeming feature,
verses.commentary: Sense: They are human beings enshrouded within and with- out, and active. They are classified into eight categories through their redeeming feature,

verses.sanskrit: एकार्णवे तदा तस्मिन् नष्टे स्थावरजङ्गमे तदा भवति वै ब्रह्मा सहस्राक्षः सहस्रपात्
verses.transliteration: ekārṇave tadā tasmin naṣṭe sthāvarajaṅgame tadā bhavati vai brahmā sahasrākṣaḥ sahasrapāt
verses.translation: They are men who have realized souls with attributes similar to those of Gandharvas. Thus, the creation of Arvaksro- tas is called Taijasa (luminous, fiery).
verses.hindi: अथ सब्रह्मका देवाः सेनद्रोपेन्द्राः समागताः
verses.wordMeaning: They are men who have realized souls with attributes similar to those of Gandharvas. Thus, the creation of Arvaksro- tas is called Taijasa (luminous, fiery).
verses.commentary: Sense: They are men who have realized souls with attributes similar to those of Gandharvas. Thus, the creation of Arvaksro- tas is called Taijasa (luminous, fiery).

verses.sanskrit: सहस्रशीर्षा पुरुषो रुक्मवर्णस् त्वतीन्द्रियः ब्रह्मा नारायणाख्यस्तु सुष्वाप सलिले तदा
verses.transliteration: sahasraśīrṣā puruṣo rukmavarṇas tvatīndriyaḥ brahmā nārāyaṇākhyastu suṣvāpa salile tadā
verses.translation: The fifth creation is Anugraha (the creation of blessings). It is fourfold according to the distinctive feature of contrariety, power, achievement and satisfaction. The contra- riety inheres the beings that are immobile; the power is the element that characterizes the Tiryak yonis (animals); men are characterized by their realized souls. Of Devas and sages satis- faction is the distinctive feature.
verses.hindi: अप्येतदन्तरं देवी देवमालोक्य विस्मिता किङ्किणीभिरनेकाभिहेमैरश्वत्थपत्रकैः
verses.wordMeaning: The fifth creation is Anugraha (the creation of blessings). It is fourfold according to the distinctive feature of contrariety, power, achievement and satisfaction. The contra- riety inheres the beings that are immobile;…
verses.commentary: Sense: The fifth creation is Anugraha (the creation of blessings). It is fourfold according to the distinctive feature of contrariety, power, achievement and satisfaction. The contra- riety inheres the beings that are immobile;…

verses.sanskrit: सत्त्वोद्रेकात्प्रबुद्धस्तु शून्यं लोकमुदैक्षत इमं चोदाहरन्त्यत्र श्लोकं नारायणं प्रति
verses.transliteration: sattvodrekātprabuddhastu śūnyaṃ lokamudaikṣata imaṃ codāharantyatra ślokaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ prati
verses.translation: This group is called Prakfta (pertaining to Prakrti). This fifth (fourfold) Vaikarika creation is the best (anavamai) among all. The creation of the origins of gross elements and the gross elements, siddhas, sages, etc., is the sixth. The creation of
verses.hindi: हारैर्वारीजरागादिमणिचित्रैस्तथाङ्गहैः
verses.wordMeaning: This group is called Prakfta (pertaining to Prakrti). This fifth (fourfold) Vaikarika creation is the best (anavamai) among all. The creation of the origins of gross elements and the gross elements, siddhas, sages, etc., is the sixth. The creation of
verses.commentary: Sense: This group is called Prakfta (pertaining to Prakrti). This fifth (fourfold) Vaikarika creation is the best (anavamai) among all. The creation of the origins of gross elements and the gross elements, siddhas, sages, etc., is the sixth. The creation of

verses.sanskrit: आपो नाराश् च सूनव इत्यपां नाम शुश्रुमः आपूर्य ताभिर् अयनं कृतवानात्मनो यतः
verses.transliteration: āpo nārāś ca sūnava ityapāṃ nāma śuśrumaḥ āpūrya tābhir ayanaṃ kṛtavānātmano yataḥ
verses.translation: They (of the sixth group represented by the sages) know what has taken place in the past, what is taking placo at present, and what will take place in future.®®® These (sages, etc.) remain detached though they enjoy and share the fruits of their activities.
verses.hindi: तिलकैश्च महादेव पश्य पुत्रं सुशोभनम् चक्त्रवृन्दं च पश्येश वृन्दं कामलकं यथा
verses.wordMeaning: They (of the sixth group represented by the sages) know what has taken place in the past, what is taking placo at present, and what will take place in future.®®® These (sages, etc.) remain detached though they enjoy and share the fruits of their activities.
verses.commentary: Sense: They (of the sixth group represented by the sages) know what has taken place in the past, what is taking placo at present, and what will take place in future.®®® These (sages, etc.) remain detached though they enjoy and share the fruits of their activities.

verses.sanskrit: अप्सु शेते यतस्तस्मात् ततो नारायणः स्मृतः चतुर्युगसहस्रस्य नैशं कालम् उपास्यतः
verses.transliteration: apsu śete yatastasmāt tato nārāyaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ caturyugasahasrasya naiśaṃ kālam upāsyataḥ
verses.translation: This creation is characterized by contrariety and imperfection. The first ( 1 ) creation of Brahma is that of Mahat; the next (2) that of tanmatras; the third (3) is Vaikarika(i.e. of the nature of transformation and ramification); this three-fold creation was evolved prior to intelligence. (4) The primary (mukhya) creation (of insentient beings) is the fourth. The immobile beings are the mukhyas.
verses.hindi: की की पाज फी फ पी कको फ भी फ फ फ फ फ ७६३७+
verses.wordMeaning: This creation is characterized by contrariety and imperfection. The first ( 1 ) creation of Brahma is that of Mahat; the next (2) that of tanmatras; the third (3) is Vaikarika(i.e. of the nature of transformation and ramification);…
verses.commentary: Sense: This creation is characterized by contrariety and imperfection. The first ( 1 ) creation of Brahma is that of Mahat; the next (2) that of tanmatras; the third (3) is Vaikarika(i.e. of the nature of transformation and ramification);…

verses.sanskrit: शर्वर्यन्ते प्रकुरुते ब्रह्मत्वं सर्गकारणात् ब्रह्मा तु सलिले तस्मिन् वायुर्भूत्वा समाचरत्
verses.transliteration: śarvaryante prakurute brahmatvaṃ sargakāraṇāt brahmā tu salile tasmin vāyurbhūtvā samācarat
verses.translation: Then there are (5) tiryak (horizontal); (6) urdhva (upward) and (7) arvaksrotas (downward) creations. (8) Then comes the anugraha creation, the eighth in the serial order. It is both Sattvika and Tamasa.
verses.hindi: गङ्ादिभिः कृत्तिकाद्यैः स्वाहया च विशेषतः । इत्येवं लोकमातुश्च वाग्भिः सम्बोधितः शिवः न सस्मार च तान् देवान् हैत्यशस्त्रनिपीडितान्
verses.wordMeaning: Then there are (5) tiryak (horizontal); (6) urdhva (upward) and (7) arvaksrotas (downward) creations. (8) Then comes the anugraha creation, the eighth in the serial order. It is both Sattvika and Tamasa.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then there are (5) tiryak (horizontal); (6) urdhva (upward) and (7) arvaksrotas (downward) creations. (8) Then comes the anugraha creation, the eighth in the serial order. It is both Sattvika and Tamasa.

verses.sanskrit: निशायामिव खद्योतः प्रावृट्काले ततस्तु सः ततस् तु सलिले तस्मिन् विज्ञायान्तर्गतां महीम्
verses.transliteration: niśāyāmiva khadyotaḥ prāvṛṭkāle tatastu saḥ tatas tu salile tasmin vijñāyāntargatāṃ mahīm
verses.translation: Thus with the five vaikrta types and three prakrtas there are eight types of creation. (9) The ninth creation, i.e., of Kumaras is both prakrta and vaikrta.
verses.hindi: स्कन्दमालिङ्ग्य चाघ्राय नृत्य पुत्रेत्युवाच ह।
verses.wordMeaning: Thus with the five vaikrta types and three prakrtas there are eight types of creation. (9) The ninth creation, i.e., of Kumaras is both prakrta and vaikrta.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus with the five vaikrta types and three prakrtas there are eight types of creation. (9) The ninth creation, i.e., of Kumaras is both prakrta and vaikrta.

verses.sanskrit: अनुमानाद् असंमूढो भूमेरुद्धरणं पुनः अकरोत्स तनूमन्यां कल्पादिषु यथापुरा
verses.transliteration: anumānād asaṃmūḍho bhūmeruddharaṇaṃ punaḥ akarotsa tanūmanyāṃ kalpādiṣu yathāpurā
verses.translation: The three prakrta creations are prior to the creation of intellect. But the other six creations (Nos. 4-9) are posterior to intellect.
verses.hindi: सहैव ननृतुश्चान्ये सह तेन गणेश्वराः। त्रैलोक्यमखिलं तत्र ननर्तेशाज्ञया क्षणम् नागाश्च ननृतुः सर्वे देवाः सेन्द्रपुरोगमाः। तुष्टुवुर्गणपाः स्कन्दं मुमोदाम्बा च मातरः
verses.wordMeaning: The three prakrta creations are prior to the creation of intellect. But the other six creations (Nos. 4-9) are posterior to intellect.
verses.commentary: Sense: The three prakrta creations are prior to the creation of intellect. But the other six creations (Nos. 4-9) are posterior to intellect.

verses.sanskrit: ततो महात्मा भगवान् दिव्यरूपम् अचिन्तयत् सलिलेनाप्लुतां भूमिं दृष्ट्वा स तु समन्ततः
verses.transliteration: tato mahātmā bhagavān divyarūpam acintayat salilenāplutāṃ bhūmiṃ dṛṣṭvā sa tu samantataḥ
verses.translation: I shall now give the detail of Anugraha sarga which you will understand properly. It stands in four ways®®® among all living beings.
verses.hindi: नृत्यामृतं तदा पीत्वा पार्वतीपरमेश्वरौ। अवापतुस्तदा तृप्तिं नन्दिना च गणेश्वराः
verses.wordMeaning: I shall now give the detail of Anugraha sarga which you will understand properly. It stands in four ways®®® among all living beings.
verses.commentary: Sense: I shall now give the detail of Anugraha sarga which you will understand properly. It stands in four ways®®® among all living beings.

verses.sanskrit: किंनु रूपमहं कृत्वा उद्धरेयं महीमिमाम् जलक्रीडानुसदृशं वाराहं रूपमाविशत्
verses.transliteration: kiṃnu rūpamahaṃ kṛtvā uddhareyaṃ mahīmimām jalakrīḍānusadṛśaṃ vārāhaṃ rūpamāviśat
verses.translation: The text is corrupted. The commentator's interpretation is far-fetched. He explains prakftah (V-159) as prakrta-niriipana-viayah — the subject of present discourse. He dissolves vaikrto navamah as vaikrtab anavamah and explains anavamab as irethab, superior.
verses.hindi: द्वारस्य पार्श्वे ते तस्थुर्देवा देवस्य धीमत: । तुष्टुवुश्च महादेवं किञ्चिदुद्विग्नचेतसः पापा वयमिति ह्यन्ये अभाग्याश्चेति चापरे
verses.wordMeaning: The text is corrupted. The commentator's interpretation is far-fetched. He explains prakftah (V-159) as prakrta-niriipana-viayah — the subject of present discourse. He dissolves vaikrto navamah as vaikrtab anavamah and explains anavamab as irethab, superior.
verses.commentary: Sense: The text is corrupted. The commentator's interpretation is far-fetched. He explains prakftah (V-159) as prakrta-niriipana-viayah — the subject of present discourse. He dissolves vaikrto navamah as vaikrtab anavamah and explains anavamab as irethab, superior.

verses.sanskrit: अधृष्यं सर्वभूतानां वाङ्मयं ब्रह्मसंज्ञितम् पृथिव्युद्धरणार्थाय प्रविवेश रसातलम्
verses.transliteration: adhṛṣyaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ vāṅmayaṃ brahmasaṃjñitam pṛthivyuddharaṇārthāya praviveśa rasātalam
verses.translation: The anugraha creation is characterized by contrariety (viparyaya), power (sakti), satisfaction (tuti) and perfection (siddhi).
verses.hindi: भाग्यवन्तश्च हैत्येन्द्रा इति चान्ये सुरेश्वराः । पूजाफलमिमं तेषामित्यन्ये नेति चापरे
verses.wordMeaning: The anugraha creation is characterized by contrariety (viparyaya), power (sakti), satisfaction (tuti) and perfection (siddhi).
verses.commentary: Sense: The anugraha creation is characterized by contrariety (viparyaya), power (sakti), satisfaction (tuti) and perfection (siddhi).

verses.sanskrit: अद्भिः संछादितां भूमिं स तामाशु प्रजापतिः उपगम्योज्जहारैनाम् आपश्चापि समाविशत्
verses.transliteration: adbhiḥ saṃchāditāṃ bhūmiṃ sa tāmāśu prajāpatiḥ upagamyojjahārainām āpaścāpi samāviśat
verses.translation: The Prakfta and Vaikrta creations together are nine. The learned consider them interconnected through causes.
verses.hindi: दु्रुबुस्ते भयाविष्टा देवा हाहेतिवादिन:। अपतन् मुनयश्चान्ये देवाश्च धरणीतले वृत्ताकार तिलकसे युक्त इसके कमलसमूह- मुखोको देखिये। है विभो! आप इसके अत्यन्त कि देखिये, गंगा आदि, कृत्तिका आदि तथा विशेष रूपे स्वाहा माताओंके द्वारा मंगलके लिये लगाये गये भव्य
verses.wordMeaning: The Prakfta and Vaikrta creations together are nine. The learned consider them interconnected through causes.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Prakfta and Vaikrta creations together are nine. The learned consider them interconnected through causes.

verses.sanskrit: सामुद्रा वै समुद्रेषु नादेयाश् च नदीषु च रसातलतले मग्नां रसातलपुटे गताम्
verses.transliteration: sāmudrā vai samudreṣu nādeyāś ca nadīṣu ca rasātalatale magnāṃ rasātalapuṭe gatām
verses.translation: As before, the lotus-born deity assigned abodes to all the expounders of Brahman, who were equal to Brahma him- self.
verses.wordMeaning: As before, the lotus-born deity assigned abodes to all the expounders of Brahman, who were equal to Brahma him- self.
verses.commentary: Sense: As before, the lotus-born deity assigned abodes to all the expounders of Brahman, who were equal to Brahma him- self.

verses.sanskrit: प्रभुर्लोकहितार्थाय दंष्ट्रयाभ्युज्जहार गाम् ततः स्वस्थानमानीय पृथिवीं पृथिवीधरः
verses.transliteration: prabhurlokahitārthāya daṃṣṭrayābhyujjahāra gām tataḥ svasthānamānīya pṛthivīṃ pṛthivīdharaḥ
verses.translation: Then the lord created Saihkalpa and Dharma: Dharma through enterprise and Saihkalpa out of determina- tion. Then another mental son Ruci was born of lord Brahma.
verses.hindi: इस प्रकार जगज्जननी उमा-के वचनोंसे सम्बोधित किये गये ईशान शिव कार्तिकेयके मुखामृतका पान करते हुए तृप्त नहीं हुए। उन्हें हैत्योंके शस्त्रोंसे पीडित उन करके उसका सिर सूँघकर कहा-- है पुत्र! नृत्य करो।' तब कष्ट दूर करनेवाले बालकरूप प्रभु स्कन्द भी लीला करते हुए नाचने लगे। सभी गणेश्वर भी उनके साथ नृत्य करने लगे और क्षणभरमें शिवकी आज्ञासे
verses.wordMeaning: Then the lord created Saihkalpa and Dharma: Dharma through enterprise and Saihkalpa out of determina- tion. Then another mental son Ruci was born of lord Brahma.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the lord created Saihkalpa and Dharma: Dharma through enterprise and Saihkalpa out of determina- tion. Then another mental son Ruci was born of lord Brahma.

verses.sanskrit: मुमोच पूर्ववद् असौ धारयित्वा धराधरः तस्योपरि जलौघस्य महती नौरिव स्थिता
verses.transliteration: mumoca pūrvavad asau dhārayitvā dharādharaḥ tasyopari jalaughasya mahatī nauriva sthitā
verses.translation: Brahma created Daksa from his vital breath and Marici from his eyes. Bhrgu was born of the heart of Brahma.
verses.hindi: सम्पूर्ण त्रिलोकी वहाँ नृत्य करने लगा। नाग और इन्द्रसहित सभी देवता भी नाचने लगे। गणेश्वरोने स्कन्दकी स्तुति की। उस समय पार्वती तथा अन्य
verses.wordMeaning: Brahma created Daksa from his vital breath and Marici from his eyes. Bhrgu was born of the heart of Brahma.
verses.commentary: Sense: Brahma created Daksa from his vital breath and Marici from his eyes. Bhrgu was born of the heart of Brahma.

verses.sanskrit: तत्समा ह्युरुदेहत्वान् न मही याति संप्लवम् तत उत्क्षिप्य तां देवो जगतः स्थापनेच्छया
verses.transliteration: tatsamā hyurudehatvān na mahī yāti saṃplavam tata utkṣipya tāṃ devo jagataḥ sthāpanecchayā
verses.translation: He created Angiras from his head and Atri from his ears. He created Pulastya from the organic wind Udana and Pulaha from the wind Vyana.
verses.hindi: करने लगे एवं गाने लगे। तब उस नृत्यरूपी अमृतका पान करके पार्वती तथा परमेश्वर तृप्त हो गये और नन्दीसहित गणेश्वर भी तृप्त हुए॥ १२८--१३३॥ तदनन्तर सूर्यके समान कान्तिवाले शिवजीने भी नन्दी, षडानन (स्कन्द) तथा गिरिराजपुत्री पार्वती - के साथ दिव्य भवनमें प्रवेश किया, जैसे मेघ अन्य मेघमें प्रवेश करता है
verses.wordMeaning: He created Angiras from his head and Atri from his ears. He created Pulastya from the organic wind Udana and Pulaha from the wind Vyana.
verses.commentary: Sense: He created Angiras from his head and Atri from his ears. He created Pulastya from the organic wind Udana and Pulaha from the wind Vyana.

verses.sanskrit: पृथिव्याः प्रविभागाय मनश्चक्रे ऽम्बुजेक्षणः पृथिवीं च समां कृत्वा पृथिव्यां सो ऽचिनोद् गिरीन्
verses.transliteration: pṛthivyāḥ pravibhāgāya manaścakre 'mbujekṣaṇaḥ pṛthivīṃ ca samāṃ kṛtvā pṛthivyāṃ so 'cinod girīn
verses.translation: Vasi$tha was born of Samana. He created Kratu from Apana. Thus these divine sons of Brahma are eleven altogether.
verses.hindi: वे देवता उन बुद्धिमान् शिवके द्वारके पास खड़े हो गये और कुछ-कुछ व्याकुलचित्त होकर महादेवकी स्तुति करने लगे। वे व्याकुल होकर एक-दूसरेकी ओर देखकर कहने लगे--'यह क्या, यह क्या; हमलोग पापी
verses.wordMeaning: Vasi$tha was born of Samana. He created Kratu from Apana. Thus these divine sons of Brahma are eleven altogether.
verses.commentary: Sense: Vasi$tha was born of Samana. He created Kratu from Apana. Thus these divine sons of Brahma are eleven altogether.

verses.sanskrit: प्राक्सर्गे दह्यमाने तु तदा संवर्तकाग्निना तेनाग्निना विशीर्णास्ते पर्वता भूरिविस्तराः
verses.transliteration: prāksarge dahyamāne tu tadā saṃvartakāgninā tenāgninā viśīrṇāste parvatā bhūrivistarāḥ
verses.translation: Individual souls were born out of the body of that intelligent lord through the cause and effect process.
verses.hindi: हैं अन्य दूसरोंने कहा-- हम अभागे हैं' अन्य सुरेश्वर कहा--'ये महाहैत्य भाग्यशाली हैं।' कुछने कहा- यह उनकी पूजाका फल है' और कुछने कहा- ऐसा नहीं है'॥ १३५--१३७॥ इसी बीच उनके अनेक शब्दोंको सुनकर महातेजस्वी कुम्भोदर नामक शिवगण दण्डसे देवताओंको पीटने लगा। तब वे देवता भयभीत होकर 'हा-हा' कहते हु"
verses.wordMeaning: Individual souls were born out of the body of that intelligent lord through the cause and effect process.
verses.commentary: Sense: Individual souls were born out of the body of that intelligent lord through the cause and effect process.

verses.sanskrit: शैत्यादेकार्णवे तस्मिन् वायुना तेन संहताः निषिक्ता यत्र यत्रासंस् तत्र तत्राचलाभवन्
verses.transliteration: śaityādekārṇave tasmin vāyunā tena saṃhatāḥ niṣiktā yatra yatrāsaṃs tatra tatrācalābhavan
verses.translation: Thereafter he was desirous of creating the four groups, viz. Devas, AsUras, Pitfs and human beings. He infused
verses.hindi: अध्याय ७१  तारकासुरके पुत्रों--विद्युन्माली, तारकाक्ष तथा कमलाक्षका वृत्तान्त ३४३
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter he was desirous of creating the four groups, viz. Devas, AsUras, Pitfs and human beings. He infused
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter he was desirous of creating the four groups, viz. Devas, AsUras, Pitfs and human beings. He infused

verses.sanskrit: तदाचलत्वाद् अचलाः पर्वभिः पर्वताः स्मृताः गिरयो हि निगीर्णत्वाच् छयानत्वाच्छिलोच्चयाः
verses.transliteration: tadācalatvād acalāḥ parvabhiḥ parvatāḥ smṛtāḥ girayo hi nigīrṇatvāc chayānatvācchiloccayāḥ
verses.translation: And he then eschewed that body whereby the Asuras were created and cast it off. It then became Night.
verses.hindi: कमी मकी म्न ललकी कक काक काआ कफ आफ कक काक फ कक फफफ फफ फफक फफ फफफ फफ फफक ककम फ आमामा अहो विधेर्बलं चेति मुनयः कश्यपादयः । लगे; कुछ मुनि तथा देवता पृथ्वीतलपर गिर दृष्ट्वापि देवदेवेशं देवानां चासुरद्विषाम्॥ १४०  पड़े ८ कश्यप आदि मुनियोंने कहा--' विधिका बल अभाग्यान्न समाप्तं तु कार्यमित्यपरे द्विजाः । है
verses.wordMeaning: And he then eschewed that body whereby the Asuras were created and cast it off. It then became Night.
verses.commentary: Sense: And he then eschewed that body whereby the Asuras were created and cast it off. It then became Night.

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तेषु विकीर्णेषु कोटिशो हि गिरिष्वथ विश्वकर्मा विभजते कल्पादिषु पुनः पुनः
verses.transliteration: tatasteṣu vikīrṇeṣu koṭiśo hi giriṣvatha viśvakarmā vibhajate kalpādiṣu punaḥ punaḥ
verses.translation: Since Night is mostly constituted of darkness it is something that restricts movement. The subjects enveloped in darkness, sleep at night.
verses.hindi: प्रोचुर्नमः शिवायेति पूज्य चाल्पतरं हृदि॥ १४१  देवेशका दर्शन करके भी असुरशत्रु देवताओंके अभाग्यसे ततः कपर्दी नन्दीशो महादेवप्रियो मुनि: ।
verses.wordMeaning: Since Night is mostly constituted of darkness it is something that restricts movement. The subjects enveloped in darkness, sleep at night.
verses.commentary: Sense: Since Night is mostly constituted of darkness it is something that restricts movement. The subjects enveloped in darkness, sleep at night.

verses.sanskrit: ससमुद्रामिमां पृथ्वीं सप्तद्वीपां सपर्वताम् भूराद्यांश् चतुरो लोकान् पुनः सो ऽथ व्यकल्पयत्
verses.transliteration: sasamudrāmimāṃ pṛthvīṃ saptadvīpāṃ saparvatām bhūrādyāṃś caturo lokān punaḥ so 'tha vyakalpayat
verses.translation: After creating the Asuras he took up another body. It was unmanifest and it mostly consisted of the quality of good- ness. So he adored it. Even as he united that body in yogic activities he was pleased. Then from his shining mouth were born Devas.
verses.hindi: ही कार्य पूर्ण नहीं हो सका। इसके बाद वे सब हृदयमें शूली माली तथा हाली कुण्डली बलयी गदी थोडा अर्चन करके 'शिवको नमस्कार है '--ऐसा कहने लगे
verses.wordMeaning: After creating the Asuras he took up another body. It was unmanifest and it mostly consisted of the quality of good- ness. So he adored it. Even as he united that body in yogic activities he was pleased. Then from his shining mouth were born Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: After creating the Asuras he took up another body. It was unmanifest and it mostly consisted of the quality of good- ness. So he adored it. Even as he united that body in yogic activities he was pleased. Then from his shining mouth were born Devas.

verses.sanskrit: लोकान् प्रकल्पयित्वाथ प्रजासर्गं ससर्ज ह ब्रह्मा स्वयंभूर्भगवान् सिसृक्षुर्विविधाः प्रजाः
verses.transliteration: lokān prakalpayitvātha prajāsargaṃ sasarja ha brahmā svayaṃbhūrbhagavān sisṛkṣurvividhāḥ prajāḥ
verses.translation: Since they were born of him even as he was shin- ing they are called Devas (shining ones). The root *Div means 'to play'. Therefore, Devas were born sportingly. After creating them the lord of Devas took another body.
verses.hindi: तत्पश्चात् जटाजूट धारण किये, हाथमें त्रिशूल लिये, माला पहने हुए, हाला धारण किये हुए, कुण्डल धारण किये हुए, कंगन पहने हुए तथा गदा धारण किये हुए महादेवप्रिय मुनि नन्दीश सुन्दर श्वेत
verses.wordMeaning: Since they were born of him even as he was shin- ing they are called Devas (shining ones). The root *Div means 'to play'. Therefore, Devas were born sportingly. After creating them the lord of Devas took another body.
verses.commentary: Sense: Since they were born of him even as he was shin- ing they are called Devas (shining ones). The root *Div means 'to play'. Therefore, Devas were born sportingly. After creating them the lord of Devas took another body.

verses.sanskrit: ससर्ज सृष्टिं तद्रूपां कल्पादिषु यथापुरा तस्याभिध्यायतः सर्गं तथा वै बुद्धिपूर्वकम्
verses.transliteration: sasarja sṛṣṭiṃ tadrūpāṃ kalpādiṣu yathāpurā tasyābhidhyāyataḥ sargaṃ tathā vai buddhipūrvakam
verses.translation: That body was cast off by him and when cast off it became day. Hence, Devas adore the day that consists of Dharma.
verses.hindi: बैलपर चढ़कर उन शिव-की आज्ञासे वहाँ जाने लगे। तब नन्दीको देखकर कुम्भोदर नामक वह गण भी नन्दीको प्रणाम करके शीघ्रता करते हुए उनके साथ चल दिया। गणसहित वे महातेजस्वी वृषध्वज गणोंके सेनापति नन्दी बैलकी पीठपर उसी तरह प्रतीत हो रहे थे, मानो मेघरूप विष्णुके पृष्ठठर शिवजी विराजमान हों। नन्दीश्वरका दस योजन विस्तृत तथा मुक्ताजालोंसे अलंकृत श्वेत छत्र आकाशकी भाँति प्रतीत हो रहा था।
verses.wordMeaning: That body was cast off by him and when cast off it became day. Hence, Devas adore the day that consists of Dharma.
verses.commentary: Sense: That body was cast off by him and when cast off it became day. Hence, Devas adore the day that consists of Dharma.

verses.sanskrit: बुद्ध्याश् च समकाले वै प्रादुर्भूतस् तमोमयः तमोमोहो महामोहस् तामिस्रश्चान्धसंज्ञितः
verses.transliteration: buddhyāś ca samakāle vai prādurbhūtas tamomayaḥ tamomoho mahāmohas tāmisraścāndhasaṃjñitaḥ
verses.translation: Then he took up another body characterized by the quality of goodness. The lord considered himself like a father meditating on sons. Hence, the Pitrs were born in between the night and day from his two sides. Hence, Devas are the Pitrs and their state of being Pitrs is due to that. He cast off that body too. That body cast off by him, immediately became the Twilight.
verses.hindi: उस छत्रमें भीतरसे बँधी हुई मुक्ताफलोंकी वह श्वेत माला ऐसी लग रही थी, मानो शिवजीके सिरपर आकाशसे गंगा गिर रही हों॥ १४२--१४६ /२॥
verses.wordMeaning: Then he took up another body characterized by the quality of goodness. The lord considered himself like a father meditating on sons. Hence, the Pitrs were born in between the night and day from his two sides. Hence,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Then he took up another body characterized by the quality of goodness. The lord considered himself like a father meditating on sons. Hence, the Pitrs were born in between the night and day from his two sides. Hence,…

verses.sanskrit: अविद्या पञ्चपर्वैषा प्रादुर्भूता महात्मनः पञ्चधावस्थितः सर्गो ध्यायतः सो ऽभिमानिनः
verses.transliteration: avidyā pañcaparvaiṣā prādurbhūtā mahātmanaḥ pañcadhāvasthitaḥ sargo dhyāyataḥ so 'bhimāninaḥ
verses.translation: The day pertains to Devas and the night to Asu- ras. In between the two is stationed the body that belongs to the Pitrs. Hence, all Devas, Asuras, sages and men adore the body that lies in between night and day*
verses.hindi: हे मुनिश्रेष्ठो! तदनन्तर गणाध्यक्ष नन्दी-को देखकर इन्द्रकी आज्ञासे दिव्य देवढुन्दुभियाँ बजने लगीं; सभी लोग वाणीद्वारा वांछित फल प्रदान करनेवाले शुभ गणेश्वरकी स्तुति करने लगे, जैसे शिवको देखकर करते हैं ॥ १४७-१४८ /२॥
verses.wordMeaning: The day pertains to Devas and the night to Asu- ras. In between the two is stationed the body that belongs to the Pitrs. Hence, all Devas, Asuras, sages and men adore the body that lies in between night and day*
verses.commentary: Sense: The day pertains to Devas and the night to Asu- ras. In between the two is stationed the body that belongs to the Pitrs. Hence, all Devas, Asuras, sages and men adore the body that lies in between night and day*

verses.sanskrit: संवृतस्तमसा चैव बीजाङ्कुरवदावृतः बहिरन्तश्चाप्रकाशस् तब्धो निःसंज्ञ एव च
verses.transliteration: saṃvṛtastamasā caiva bījāṅkuravadāvṛtaḥ bahirantaścāprakāśas tabdho niḥsaṃjña eva ca
verses.translation: Then Brahma adopted another body characteriz- ed by the particle of passion. The lord created with his mind the mental sons of passionate activities. Thereby, the passionate sons were born of him.
verses.hindi: आकाशचारियोंने इन्द्रकी आज्ञासे नन्दीके सिरपर आकाशसे सुगन्धमय पुष्पवृष्टि की । तुष्टि-पुष्टिसे युक्त यथार्थ वृष्टिसे प्रसन्न होकर नन्दी उसी तरह शोभा पा रहे थे, जैसे शिवजी गन्धजलसे अभिसिंचित चन्द्रलेखासे
verses.wordMeaning: Then Brahma adopted another body characteriz- ed by the particle of passion. The lord created with his mind the mental sons of passionate activities. Thereby, the passionate sons were born of him.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then Brahma adopted another body characteriz- ed by the particle of passion. The lord created with his mind the mental sons of passionate activities. Thereby, the passionate sons were born of him.

verses.sanskrit: यस्मात्तेषां वृता बुद्धिर् दुःखानि करणानि च तस्मात्ते संवृतात्मानो नगा मुख्याः प्रकीर्तिताः
verses.transliteration: yasmātteṣāṃ vṛtā buddhir duḥkhāni karaṇāni ca tasmātte saṃvṛtātmāno nagā mukhyāḥ prakīrtitāḥ
verses.translation: The morning twilight, night, day and evening twilight, these four are the bodies of Brahma. They are called 'Ambharhsi'. The root bha means to 'shine'. The word Ambha- riisi is traced by the learned to this root. After creating these, Prajapati created Devas, human beings, Danavas and Pitrs from his body. Thereafter he foresook that body which turned into moonlight and assumed another form characterized by passion and darkness. The lord created other beings during the night; these beings were overwhelmed with hunger.
verses.hindi: शोभा प्राप्त करते हैं। है सुव्रतो! वृषभका पृष्ठ अनेक प्रकारके पुष्पोंसे ऐसा प्रतीत हो रहा था, मानो आकाशपूष्ठ सगणो गणसेनानीर्मेघपृष्ठे यथा भवः। दशयोजनविस्तीर्णं मुक्ताजालैरलङ्कतम्
verses.wordMeaning: The morning twilight, night, day and evening twilight, these four are the bodies of Brahma. They are called 'Ambharhsi'. The root bha means to 'shine'. The word Ambha- riisi is traced by the learned to this root. After creating these, Prajapati created Devas, human beings,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The morning twilight, night, day and evening twilight, these four are the bodies of Brahma. They are called 'Ambharhsi'. The root bha means to 'shine'. The word Ambha- riisi is traced by the learned to this root. After creating these, Prajapati created Devas, human beings,…

verses.sanskrit: मुख्यसर्गं तथाभूतं दृष्ट्वा ब्रह्मा ह्यसाधकम् अप्रसन्नमनाः सो ऽथ ततो ऽन्यं सो ह्यमन्यत
verses.transliteration: mukhyasargaṃ tathābhūtaṃ dṛṣṭvā brahmā hyasādhakam aprasannamanāḥ so 'tha tato 'nyaṃ so hyamanyata
verses.translation: These hungry beings created by him attempted to seize the bodies of the lord. Some of them who said, "We will protect these bodies" were known as Raksasas. They were night-walkers who were overcome by hunger. Those who said, 'We will eat them up,' were called yaksas as also guhyakas because of their secret activity. The root 'raks* means 'to pro- tect and the root 'yaks' means 'to eat.' On observing this crea- tion, the hair of the intelligent lord Brahma became withered due to displeasure.
verses.hindi: सितातपत्रं शैलादेराकाशमिव भाति तत्। तत्रान्तर्बद्धमाला सा मुक्ताफलमयी शुभा
verses.wordMeaning: These hungry beings created by him attempted to seize the bodies of the lord. Some of them who said, "We will protect these bodies" were known as Raksasas. They were night-walkers who were overcome by hunger. Those who said,…
verses.commentary: Sense: These hungry beings created by him attempted to seize the bodies of the lord. Some of them who said, "We will protect these bodies" were known as Raksasas. They were night-walkers who were overcome by hunger. Those who said,…

verses.sanskrit: तस्याभिध्यायतश्चैव तिर्यक्स्रोता ह्यवर्तत तस्मात् तिर्यक्प्रवृत्तः स तिर्यक्स्रोतास् ततः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: tasyābhidhyāyataścaiva tiryaksrotā hyavartata tasmāt tiryakpravṛttaḥ sa tiryaksrotās tataḥ smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: After these eight divine beings had been created that lord created birds from his own youthful stage out of his own inclination.
verses.hindi: गङ्गाकाशान्निपतिता भाति मूर्धि विभोर्यथा। अथ दृष्ट्वा गणाध्यक्षं देवदुन्दुभयः शुभाः नियोगाद्वज्जिणः सर्वे विनेदुर्मुनिपुङ्गवाः। तुष्टुबुश्च गणेशानं वाग्भिरिष्टप्रदं शुभम्
verses.wordMeaning: After these eight divine beings had been created that lord created birds from his own youthful stage out of his own inclination.
verses.commentary: Sense: After these eight divine beings had been created that lord created birds from his own youthful stage out of his own inclination.

verses.sanskrit: पश्वादयस्ते विख्याता उत्पथग्राहिणो द्विजाः तस्याभिध्यायतो ऽन्यं वै सात्त्विकः समवर्तत
verses.transliteration: paśvādayaste vikhyātā utpathagrāhiṇo dvijāḥ tasyābhidhyāyato 'nyaṃ vai sāttvikaḥ samavartata
verses.translation: Since they are able to move as they please they are known as such. They are named Vayas (birds) because they were created from his youth. After creating the animals the lord of Devas created the flocks of winged animals.
verses.hindi: यथा देवा भवं दृष्ट्वा प्रीतिकण्टकितत्वचः। नियोगाद्वज़िणो मूर्धिन पुष्पवर्ष च खेचराः
verses.wordMeaning: Since they are able to move as they please they are known as such. They are named Vayas (birds) because they were created from his youth. After creating the animals the lord of Devas created the flocks of winged animals.
verses.commentary: Sense: Since they are able to move as they please they are known as such. They are named Vayas (birds) because they were created from his youth. After creating the animals the lord of Devas created the flocks of winged animals.

verses.sanskrit: ऊर्ध्वस्रोतास्तृतीयस्तु स वै चोर्ध्वं व्यवस्थितः यस्मात्प्रवर्तते चोर्ध्वम् ऊर्ध्वस्रोतास्ततः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: ūrdhvasrotāstṛtīyastu sa vai cordhvaṃ vyavasthitaḥ yasmātpravartate cordhvam ūrdhvasrotāstataḥ smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: He created goats from his mouth; he created sheep from his chest; he created cows and bulls from his belly and sides. From his feet he created horses, elephants, donkeys, deer, camels, mules and other kinds and classes of beasts. Plants and fruit trees were produced from the hair of his body. After creating the cattle and plants, he engaged himself in a sacrifice.
verses.hindi: सङ्कीर्ण तु दिवः पृष्ठं नक्षत्रैरिव सुव्रत: । कुसुमैः संवृतो नन्दी वृषपृष्ठे रराज सः त॑ दृष्ट्वा नन्दिं देवाः सेन्द्रोपेन्द्रास्तथाविधम्
verses.wordMeaning: He created goats from his mouth; he created sheep from his chest; he created cows and bulls from his belly and sides. From his feet he created horses, elephants, donkeys, deer, camels, mules and other kinds and classes of beasts.…
verses.commentary: Sense: He created goats from his mouth; he created sheep from his chest; he created cows and bulls from his belly and sides. From his feet he created horses, elephants, donkeys, deer, camels, mules and other kinds and classes of beasts.…

verses.sanskrit: ते सुखप्रीतिबहुला बहिरन्तश् च संवृताः प्रकाशा बहिरन्तश् च ऊर्ध्वस्रोतोभवाः स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: te sukhaprītibahulā bahirantaś ca saṃvṛtāḥ prakāśā bahirantaś ca ūrdhvasrotobhavāḥ smṛtāḥ
verses.translation: They call these the domesticated animals, viz. — the cow, the bull, the man, the ram, the horse, the mule, the don- key. Understand the wild animals.
verses.hindi: तुष्टुवुर्गणपेशानं देवदेवमिवापरम्।
verses.wordMeaning: They call these the domesticated animals, viz. — the cow, the bull, the man, the ram, the horse, the mule, the don- key. Understand the wild animals.
verses.commentary: Sense: They call these the domesticated animals, viz. — the cow, the bull, the man, the ram, the horse, the mule, the don- key. Understand the wild animals.

verses.sanskrit: ते सत्त्वस्य च योगेन सृष्टाः सत्त्वोद्भवाः स्मृताः ऊर्ध्वस्रोतास्तृतीयो वै देवसर्गस्तु स स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: te sattvasya ca yogena sṛṣṭāḥ sattvodbhavāḥ smṛtāḥ ūrdhvasrotāstṛtīyo vai devasargastu sa smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: They call these the wild animals, viz. — the beasts of prey, the cloven hoofed elephants, monkeys, fifthly, birds, six- thly, aquatic beasts and seventhly, the reptiles. The following seven are forest animals, viz. — buflaloes, gavayas (a species of ox), bears, monkeys, arabhas (the fabulous animal of eight feet), wolves, and lions.
verses.hindi: नमस्ते रुद्रभक्ताय रुद्र्जाप्यताय च रुद्रभक्तार्तिनाशाय रौद्रकर्मरताय ते। कूष्माण्डगणनाथाय योगिनां पतये नमः
verses.wordMeaning: They call these the wild animals, viz. — the beasts of prey, the cloven hoofed elephants, monkeys, fifthly, birds, six- thly, aquatic beasts and seventhly, the reptiles. The following seven are forest animals, viz. — buflaloes, gavayas (a species of ox), bears, monkeys,…
verses.commentary: Sense: They call these the wild animals, viz. — the beasts of prey, the cloven hoofed elephants, monkeys, fifthly, birds, six- thly, aquatic beasts and seventhly, the reptiles. The following seven are forest animals, viz. — buflaloes, gavayas (a species of ox), bears, monkeys,…

verses.sanskrit: प्रकाशाद् बहिरन्तश् च ऊर्ध्वस्रोतोद्भवाः स्मृताः ते ऊर्ध्वस्रोतसो ज्ञेयास् तुष्टात्मानो बुधैः स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: prakāśād bahirantaś ca ūrdhvasrotodbhavāḥ smṛtāḥ te ūrdhvasrotaso jñeyās tuṣṭātmāno budhaiḥ smṛtāḥ
verses.translation: From his front face he created Gay atri and tre Man- tras, Trivrt Saman, Rathantara and Agnisoma verses.
verses.hindi: रक्तानां भवपादाब्जे रुद्रलोकप्रदायिने
verses.wordMeaning: From his front face he created Gay atri and tre Man- tras, Trivrt Saman, Rathantara and Agnisoma verses.
verses.commentary: Sense: From his front face he created Gay atri and tre Man- tras, Trivrt Saman, Rathantara and Agnisoma verses.

verses.sanskrit: ऊर्ध्वस्रोतःसु सृष्टेषु देवेषु वरदः प्रभुः प्रीतिमानभवद्ब्रह्मा ततो ऽन्यं सो ऽभ्यमन्यत
verses.transliteration: ūrdhvasrotaḥsu sṛṣṭeṣu deveṣu varadaḥ prabhuḥ prītimānabhavadbrahmā tato 'nyaṃ so 'bhyamanyata
verses.translation: From his southern face he created Yajur hymns, Tritubh metre, Paftcadaiama Stoman, brhat Saman and Ukthya verses.
verses.hindi: नमः सेनाधिपतये रुद्राणां पतये नमः। भूतानां भुवनेशानां पतये पापहारिणे रुद्राय रुद्रपतये रौद्रपापहराय ते। नमः शिवाय सौम्याय रुद्रभक्ताय ते नम:
verses.wordMeaning: From his southern face he created Yajur hymns, Tritubh metre, Paftcadaiama Stoman, brhat Saman and Ukthya verses.
verses.commentary: Sense: From his southern face he created Yajur hymns, Tritubh metre, Paftcadaiama Stoman, brhat Saman and Ukthya verses.

verses.sanskrit: ससर्ज सर्गमन्यं हि साधकं प्रभुरीश्वरः ततो ऽभिध्यायतस्तस्य सत्याभिध्यायिनस्तदा
verses.transliteration: sasarja sargamanyaṃ hi sādhakaṃ prabhurīśvaraḥ tato 'bhidhyāyatastasya satyābhidhyāyinastadā
verses.translation: From his western face he created Saman, the metre Jagati, Saptadaj5ama Stoman, Vairupa Saman and Atiratra verses.
verses.hindi: ततः प्रीतो गणाध्यक्षः प्राह देवांश्छिलात्मजः। रथं च सारथिं शम्भोः कार्मुकं शरमुत्तमम्
verses.wordMeaning: From his western face he created Saman, the metre Jagati, Saptadaj5ama Stoman, Vairupa Saman and Atiratra verses.
verses.commentary: Sense: From his western face he created Saman, the metre Jagati, Saptadaj5ama Stoman, Vairupa Saman and Atiratra verses.

verses.sanskrit: प्रादुरासीत्तदा व्यक्ताद् अर्वाक्स्रोतास्तु साधकः यस्माद् अर्वाङ्न्यवर्तन्त ततो ऽर्वाक्स्रोतसस् तु ते
verses.transliteration: prādurāsīttadā vyaktād arvāksrotāstu sādhakaḥ yasmād arvāṅnyavartanta tato 'rvāksrotasas tu te
verses.translation: From his northern face he created the set of twenty
verses.hindi: कर्तुमर्हथ यलेन नष्टं मत्वा पुरत्रयम्। अथ ते ब्रह्मणा सार्ध तथा वै विश्वकर्मणा रथं चक्रुः सुसंरब्धा देवदेवस्य धीमतः
verses.wordMeaning: From his northern face he created the set of twenty
verses.commentary: Sense: From his northern face he created the set of twenty

verses.sanskrit: ते च प्रकाशबहुलास् तमःपृक्ता रजो ऽधिकाः तस्मात्ते दुःखबहुला भूयोभूयश् च कारिणः
verses.transliteration: te ca prakāśabahulās tamaḥpṛktā rajo 'dhikāḥ tasmātte duḥkhabahulā bhūyobhūyaś ca kāriṇaḥ
verses.translation: At the beginning of the kalpa the lord created the lightning, the thunderbolts, the clouds, the reddy rainbows and the luminaries.
verses.hindi: तारोंसे भर गया हो। है सुव्रतो! पुष्पोंसे ढँके हुए बैलकी पीठपर उसी प्रकार सुशोभित हो रहे थे, जैसे आकाशपृष्ठपर विराजमान चन्द्रमा तारोंसे आच्छादित होकर सुशोभित होते हैं॥ १४९-१५२१/.॥
verses.wordMeaning: At the beginning of the kalpa the lord created the lightning, the thunderbolts, the clouds, the reddy rainbows and the luminaries.
verses.commentary: Sense: At the beginning of the kalpa the lord created the lightning, the thunderbolts, the clouds, the reddy rainbows and the luminaries.

verses.sanskrit: संवृता बहिरन्तश् च मनुष्याः साधकाश् च ते
verses.transliteration: saṃvṛtā bahirantaś ca manuṣyāḥ sādhakāś ca te
verses.translation: The high and the low living beings were born from his limbs.
verses.hindi: उस प्रकारकी शोभावाले उन नन्दीको देखकर इन्द्र तथा विष्णुसहित देवता साक्षात् महादेवजीकी भते प्रतीत होनेवाले गणाधिपोंके स्वामी नन्दीकी स्तुति करने नमस्कार है । रुद्रभक्तोंकी पीडाका नाश करनेवाले, रौद्रकर्मपें संलग्न, कृष्माण्डगणोंके स्वामी तथा योगियोंके पति आप नन्दी-को नमस्कार है। सब कुछ प्रदान करनेवाले, शरण देनेवाले, सब कुछ जाननेवाले, कष्ट दूर करनेवाले,
verses.wordMeaning: The high and the low living beings were born from his limbs.
verses.commentary: Sense: The high and the low living beings were born from his limbs.

verses.sanskrit: लक्षणैस्तारकाद्यैस्ते ह्य् अष्टधा तु व्यवस्थिताः
verses.transliteration: lakṣaṇaistārakādyaiste hy aṣṭadhā tu vyavasthitāḥ
verses.translation: After creating the four groups, viz. Devas, Asuras, human beings and Pitrs he created beings, mobile and immo- bile, Yaksas, Piacas, Gandharvas, Apsarases, Naras, Kinnaras, Raksasas, birds, cattle, wild animals and snakes.
verses.hindi: वेदोंके पति तथा वेदोंसे जाननेयोग्य आप नन्दी-को नमस्कार है । वज्रधारी, वज्रतुल्य दंष्ट्रावाले, इन्द्रके वज्रका निवारण करनेवाले, वञ्रसे अलंकृत देहवाले तथा इब्द्रके द्वारा आराधित आप नन्दी -को नमस्कार है । रक्त वर्णवाले,
verses.wordMeaning: After creating the four groups, viz. Devas, Asuras, human beings and Pitrs he created beings, mobile and immo- bile, Yaksas, Piacas, Gandharvas, Apsarases, Naras, Kinnaras, Raksasas, birds, cattle, wild animals and snakes.
verses.commentary: Sense: After creating the four groups, viz. Devas, Asuras, human beings and Pitrs he created beings, mobile and immo- bile, Yaksas, Piacas, Gandharvas, Apsarases, Naras, Kinnaras, Raksasas, birds, cattle, wild animals and snakes.

verses.sanskrit: सिद्धात्मानो मनुष्यास्ते गन्धर्वसहधर्मिणः इत्येष तैजसः सर्गो ह्य् अर्वाक्स्रोतःप्रकीर्तितः
verses.transliteration: siddhātmāno manuṣyāste gandharvasahadharmiṇaḥ ityeṣa taijasaḥ sargo hy arvāksrotaḥprakīrtitaḥ
verses.translation: There are mobile and immobile as well as chang- ing and unchanging created beings. Whatever activities they had in a previous creation they resume the same activities in succeeding creations. They have the same nature, etc. whether savage or timid, kind or cruel, righteous or evil, true or false. Urged by their attributes they adopt and take pleasure in their respective qualities.
verses.hindi: रक्त नेत्रवाले, रक्त वस्त्र धारण करनेवाले तथा शिवके चरणकमलमें अनुरागयुक्त लोगोंको रुद्रलोक प्रदान करनेवाले आप नन्दी-को नमस्कार है । सेनाके अधिपति, रुद्रोंके पति, भूतों तथा भुवनेशोंके पति और पापोंका हरण करनेवाले आप नन्दी -को नमस्कार है । रुद्र, रुद्रपति, रौद्र पापोंका हरण करनेवाले आप नन्दी -को नमस्कार है  शिवस्वरूप, सौम्य स्वभाववाले तथा रुद्रभक्त आप नन्दी-को नमस्कार है॥ १५४--१६० ॥
verses.wordMeaning: There are mobile and immobile as well as chang- ing and unchanging created beings. Whatever activities they had in a previous creation they resume the same activities in succeeding creations. They have the same nature, etc. whether savage or timid, kind or cruel,…
verses.commentary: Sense: There are mobile and immobile as well as chang- ing and unchanging created beings. Whatever activities they had in a previous creation they resume the same activities in succeeding creations. They have the same nature, etc. whether savage or timid, kind or cruel,…

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चमो ऽनुग्रहः सर्गश् चतुर्धा तु व्यवस्थितः विपर्ययेण शक्त्या च सिद्ध्या तुष्ट्या तथैव च
verses.transliteration: pañcamo 'nugrahaḥ sargaś caturdhā tu vyavasthitaḥ viparyayeṇa śaktyā ca siddhyā tuṣṭyā tathaiva ca
verses.translation: The Purhaas assign the division of society and the distribution of functions to the primeval being— Maheivara, Cf. yaafio janturanlioyam sukhadubUiayob / livara-prerito gacchet svargaih narakam eva vl//— dted inW.
verses.hindi: सूतजी बोले-हे ऋषियो! तदनन्तर प्रसन हुए शिलादपुत्र गणेश्वर नन्दी-ने देवताओंसे कहा-- “अब तीनों पुरोंको नष्ट मानकर आपलोग शम्भुके लिये
verses.wordMeaning: The Purhaas assign the division of society and the distribution of functions to the primeval being— Maheivara, Cf. yaafio janturanlioyam sukhadubUiayob / livara-prerito gacchet svargaih narakam eva vl//— dted inW.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Purhaas assign the division of society and the distribution of functions to the primeval being— Maheivara, Cf. yaafio janturanlioyam sukhadubUiayob / livara-prerito gacchet svargaih narakam eva vl//— dted inW.

verses.sanskrit: स्थावरेषु विपर्यासस् तिर्यग्योनिषु शक्तितः सिद्धात्मानो मनुष्यास्तु ऋषिदेवेषु कृत्स्नशः
verses.transliteration: sthāvareṣu viparyāsas tiryagyoniṣu śaktitaḥ siddhātmāno manuṣyāstu ṛṣideveṣu kṛtsnaśaḥ
verses.translation: Adharma (sin) was born of tamas and Hiihsa ( violence) was born of grief. When this pair of terrible nature originated, the life (vital breaths) left the lord and pleasure resorted to him. Then Brahma eschewed his shining body and bifurcated it. With one half of his body he became a man. With the other half he created a woman SatarOpa.
verses.hindi: कराइये।' इसके बाद उन देवताओंने अतिशीप्रतासे झु होकर ब्रह्माके साथ विश्वकर्माके द्वारा बुद्धिमान देवदेव शिव-का रथ बनवाया नामक इकहत्तरवोँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ
verses.wordMeaning: Adharma (sin) was born of tamas and Hiihsa ( violence) was born of grief. When this pair of terrible nature originated, the life (vital breaths) left the lord and pleasure resorted to him. Then Brahma eschewed his shining body and bifurcated it.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Adharma (sin) was born of tamas and Hiihsa ( violence) was born of grief. When this pair of terrible nature originated, the life (vital breaths) left the lord and pleasure resorted to him. Then Brahma eschewed his shining body and bifurcated it.…

verses.sanskrit: इत्येष प्राकृतः सर्गो वैकृतो नवमः स्मृतः भूतादिकानां भूतानां षष्ठः सर्गः स उच्यते
verses.transliteration: ityeṣa prākṛtaḥ sargo vaikṛto navamaḥ smṛtaḥ bhūtādikānāṃ bhūtānāṃ ṣaṣṭhaḥ sargaḥ sa ucyate
verses.translation: With love the lord created Prakfti, the mother of the elements. With her greatness she stood pervading heaven and earth.
verses.hindi: अध्याय ७२ त्रिपुरासुरके वधके लिये विश्वकर्माद्वारा एक दिव्य रथका निर्माण....शिवकी स्तुति
verses.wordMeaning: With love the lord created Prakfti, the mother of the elements. With her greatness she stood pervading heaven and earth.
verses.commentary: Sense: With love the lord created Prakfti, the mother of the elements. With her greatness she stood pervading heaven and earth.

verses.sanskrit: निवृत्तं वर्तमानं च तेषां जानन्ति वै पुनः भूतादिकानां भूतानां सप्तमः सर्ग एव च
verses.transliteration: nivṛttaṃ vartamānaṃ ca teṣāṃ jānanti vai punaḥ bhūtādikānāṃ bhūtānāṃ saptamaḥ sarga eva ca
verses.translation: The first half of body of Brahma envelopes heaven and stays there. The woman Satarupa.®®® bom out of the other half performed difficult penance for hundred thousand years and obtained a man of brilliant renown as her husband.
verses.hindi: फक कफ कफ क फफ ऊक फफफ फफफ फफक फा का फक मी मीमी की कजी केजी कफ क फफ फ फ फ फफ फ फ फफ फफ फफफ फ फफ फ फ फ फ फफ फ फफ फ फफक फफफ फ फ फक फाम फक कफम त्रिपुरासुरके वधके लिये विश्वकर्माद्वारा एक दिव्य रथका निर्माण तथा भगवान् महेशवरका उस रथपर आरूढ़ हो त्रिपुरासुरको दग्ध करना एवं ब्रह्माद्वारा भगवान् शिवकी स्तुति
verses.wordMeaning: The first half of body of Brahma envelopes heaven and stays there. The woman Satarupa.®®® bom out of the other half performed difficult penance for hundred thousand years and obtained a man of brilliant renown as her husband.
verses.commentary: Sense: The first half of body of Brahma envelopes heaven and stays there. The woman Satarupa.®®® bom out of the other half performed difficult penance for hundred thousand years and obtained a man of brilliant renown as her husband.

verses.sanskrit: ते परिग्राहिणः सर्वे संविभागरताः पुनः स्वादनाश् चाप्यशीलाश् च ज्ञेया भूतादिकाश् च ते
verses.transliteration: te parigrāhiṇaḥ sarve saṃvibhāgaratāḥ punaḥ svādanāś cāpyaśīlāś ca jñeyā bhūtādikāś ca te
verses.translation: That man is at the outset called Manu the self-bora. Seventy sets of four yugas constitute his manvantata.
verses.hindi: अथ रुद्रस्य देवस्य निर्मितो विश्वकर्मणा। सर्वलोकमयो दिव्यो रथो यत्नेन सादरम्
verses.wordMeaning: That man is at the outset called Manu the self-bora. Seventy sets of four yugas constitute his manvantata.
verses.commentary: Sense: That man is at the outset called Manu the self-bora. Seventy sets of four yugas constitute his manvantata.

verses.sanskrit: विपर्ययेण भूतादिर् अशक्त्या च व्यवस्थितः प्रथमो महतः सर्गो विज्ञेयो ब्रह्मणः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: viparyayeṇa bhūtādir aśaktyā ca vyavasthitaḥ prathamo mahataḥ sargo vijñeyo brahmaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: That man obtained as his wife Satarupa who was not born of a womb. He sported with her. Hence, she is called Rati (pleasure),
verses.hindi: सर्वदेवनमस्कृतः। सौवर्णः सर्वसम्मतः पुष्करं चान्तरिक्षं वै रथनीडश्च मन्दरः। अस्ताद्रिरुदयाद्रिशच उभौ तौ कूबरौ स्मृतौ
verses.wordMeaning: That man obtained as his wife Satarupa who was not born of a womb. He sported with her. Hence, she is called Rati (pleasure),
verses.commentary: Sense: That man obtained as his wife Satarupa who was not born of a womb. He sported with her. Hence, she is called Rati (pleasure),

verses.sanskrit: तन्मात्राणां द्वितीयस्तु भूतसर्गः स उच्यते वैकारिकस्तृतीयस्तु सर्ग ऐन्द्रियकः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: tanmātrāṇāṃ dvitīyastu bhūtasargaḥ sa ucyate vaikārikastṛtīyastu sarga aindriyakaḥ smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: The first mutual relation of two souls took place at the beginning of the kalpa when Brahma created Virit. He be- came the Virat (massive) Purusa.
verses.hindi: अधिष्ठानं महामेरुराश्रयाः केसराचलाः। वेगः संवत्सरस्तस्य अयने चक्रसङ्भमौ
verses.wordMeaning: The first mutual relation of two souls took place at the beginning of the kalpa when Brahma created Virit. He be- came the Virat (massive) Purusa.
verses.commentary: Sense: The first mutual relation of two souls took place at the beginning of the kalpa when Brahma created Virit. He be- came the Virat (massive) Purusa.

verses.sanskrit: इत्येष प्राकृतः सर्गः सम्भूतो बुद्धिपूर्वकः मुख्यसर्गश्चतुर्थश् च मुख्या वै स्थावराः स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: ityeṣa prākṛtaḥ sargaḥ sambhūto buddhipūrvakaḥ mukhyasargaścaturthaś ca mukhyā vai sthāvarāḥ smṛtāḥ
verses.translation: Satarupa was the empress. The son of Virat, i.e. Svayambhuva was known as Manu. Manu Vairaja created the subjects.
verses.hindi: तस्य काष्ठाः स्मृता घोणा चाक्षदण्डाः क्षणाश्च वै॥ निमेषाश्चानुकर्षाश्च ईषा चास्य लवाः स्मृताः । चौर्वरूथं रथस्यास्य स्वर्गमोक्षावुभौ ध्वजौ
verses.wordMeaning: Satarupa was the empress. The son of Virat, i.e. Svayambhuva was known as Manu. Manu Vairaja created the subjects.
verses.commentary: Sense: Satarupa was the empress. The son of Virat, i.e. Svayambhuva was known as Manu. Manu Vairaja created the subjects.

verses.sanskrit: ततो ऽर्वाक्स्रोतसां सर्गः सप्तमः स तु मानुषः अष्टमो ऽनुग्रहः सर्गः सात्त्विकस्तामसश् च सः
verses.transliteration: tato 'rvāksrotasāṃ sargaḥ saptamaḥ sa tu mānuṣaḥ aṣṭamo 'nugrahaḥ sargaḥ sāttvikastāmasaś ca saḥ
verses.translation: From the heroic son of Virat (i.e. Vairaja) Satarupa gave birth to two sons: Priyavrata and Uttanapada who were honoured by the worlds.
verses.hindi: धर्मो विरागो दण्डोऽस्य यज्ञा दण्डाश्रयाः स्मृताः ।
verses.wordMeaning: From the heroic son of Virat (i.e. Vairaja) Satarupa gave birth to two sons: Priyavrata and Uttanapada who were honoured by the worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: From the heroic son of Virat (i.e. Vairaja) Satarupa gave birth to two sons: Priyavrata and Uttanapada who were honoured by the worlds.

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चैते वैकृताः सर्गाः प्राकृतास्तु त्रयः स्मृताः प्राकृतो वैकृतश्चैव कौमारो नवमः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: pañcaite vaikṛtāḥ sargāḥ prākṛtāstu trayaḥ smṛtāḥ prākṛto vaikṛtaścaiva kaumāro navamaḥ smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: She gave birth to two blessed daughters also from whom the subjects of the world were born. They were the gentle ladies Akuti and Prasuti.
verses.hindi: युगान्तकोटी तौ तस्य धर्मकामावुभौ स्मृतौ। ईषादण्डस्तथाव्यक्तं बुद्धिस्तस्यैव नड्वलः सूतजी बोले- है ऋषियो! विश्वकर्माने प्रयलके साथ आदरपूर्वक भगवान् रुद्रका रथ बनाया; वह सर्वलोकमय, दिव्य, सर्वभूतमय, सभी देवताओंसे नमस्कृत, सभी देवताओंसे युक्त, सुवर्णमय तथा सबके अनुकूल
verses.wordMeaning: She gave birth to two blessed daughters also from whom the subjects of the world were born. They were the gentle ladies Akuti and Prasuti.
verses.commentary: Sense: She gave birth to two blessed daughters also from whom the subjects of the world were born. They were the gentle ladies Akuti and Prasuti.

verses.sanskrit: अबुद्धिपूर्वकाः सर्गाः प्राकृतास्तु त्रयः स्मृताः बुद्धिपूर्वं प्रवर्तन्ते षट् पुनर्ब्रह्मणस्तु ते
verses.transliteration: abuddhipūrvakāḥ sargāḥ prākṛtāstu trayaḥ smṛtāḥ buddhipūrvaṃ pravartante ṣaṭ punarbrahmaṇastu te
verses.translation: The lord Svayambhuva Manu gave PrasCkti to Daksa. Daksa should be known as Prana (vital breath); Manu isSankalpa (Idea).
verses.hindi: था। उसका दाहिना चक्र सूर्य एवं बायाँ चक्र चन्द्रमा
verses.wordMeaning: The lord Svayambhuva Manu gave PrasCkti to Daksa. Daksa should be known as Prana (vital breath); Manu isSankalpa (Idea).
verses.commentary: Sense: The lord Svayambhuva Manu gave PrasCkti to Daksa. Daksa should be known as Prana (vital breath); Manu isSankalpa (Idea).

verses.sanskrit: विस्तरानुग्रहः सर्गः कीर्त्यमानो निबोधत चतुर्धावस्थितः सो ऽथ सर्वभूतेषु कृत्स्नशः
verses.transliteration: vistarānugrahaḥ sargaḥ kīrtyamāno nibodhata caturdhāvasthitaḥ so 'tha sarvabhūteṣu kṛtsnaśaḥ
verses.translation: He gave Akiiti to Ruci the Prajapati. Ruci the mental son of Brahma begot auspicious twins of Akuti. Yajna and Dakina were born as twins: Yajfia begot of Daksina twelve sons.
verses.hindi: अरोंवाला था। है विप्रेन्द्रो! है सुब्रतो! दाहिने चक्रके उन आरोंमें बारह आदित्य थे और बायें चक्रके सोलह आरोंमें चन्द्रमाकी सोलह कलाएँ थीं। है मुनिश्रेष्ठो! नक्षत्रगण उस बाएँ चक्रके भूषण थे और छः ऋतुएँ उन दोनों चक्रोंकी नेमियाँ थीं । आकाश इसकी छत थी और मन्दर पर्वत रथका सारथि-स्थान था। अस्ताचल तथा उदयाचल उसके दोनों स्तम्भ कहे गये हैं। महामेरु पर्वत उसका अधिष्ठान मुख्य स्थान था और
verses.wordMeaning: He gave Akiiti to Ruci the Prajapati. Ruci the mental son of Brahma begot auspicious twins of Akuti. Yajna and Dakina were born as twins: Yajfia begot of Daksina twelve sons.
verses.commentary: Sense: He gave Akiiti to Ruci the Prajapati. Ruci the mental son of Brahma begot auspicious twins of Akuti. Yajna and Dakina were born as twins: Yajfia begot of Daksina twelve sons.

verses.sanskrit: इत्येते प्राकृताश्चैव वैकृताश् च नव स्मृताः परस्परानुरक्ताश् च कारणैश् च बुधैः स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: ityete prākṛtāścaiva vaikṛtāś ca nava smṛtāḥ parasparānuraktāś ca kāraṇaiś ca budhaiḥ smṛtāḥ
verses.translation: The devas called yamas were born as his sons in the Sv&yambhuva manvantara. Hence, they too are known as Yamas.
verses.hindi: केसरपर्वत मेरुको आश्रय देनेवाले थे। संवत्सर उसका वेग था और दोनों अयन (उत्तरायण, दक्षिणायन) उसके चक्रसंगम (अक्षके प्रान्तभाग) थे। मुहूर्त उस स्थके बंधुर तल्पभाग और कलाएँ उसको शम्या
verses.wordMeaning: The devas called yamas were born as his sons in the Sv&yambhuva manvantara. Hence, they too are known as Yamas.
verses.commentary: Sense: The devas called yamas were born as his sons in the Sv&yambhuva manvantara. Hence, they too are known as Yamas.

verses.sanskrit: अग्रे ससर्ज वै ब्रह्मा मानसानात्मनः समान् ऋभुः सनत्कुमारश् च द्वावेतावूर्ध्वरेतसौ
verses.transliteration: agre sasarja vai brahmā mānasānātmanaḥ samān ṛbhuḥ sanatkumāraś ca dvāvetāvūrdhvaretasau
verses.translation: Two groups, the Ajitas and the Sukras were created by Brahma. The Yamas who were born at the outset became heaven-dwellers.
verses.hindi: (वर्तुलपट्टिकाएँ) कही गयी हैं। काष्ठाएँ उसकी नासिका तथा क्षण उसके अक्षदण्ड (चक्रोंका आधारदण्ड) कहे गये हैं। निमेष इस रथके अनुकर्ष (नीचेका तल) तथा लव (निमेषसे भी छोटा समय) इसकी ईषा (दोनों अक्षोंको जोड़नेवाला काष्ठ) कहे गये हैं ॥ १--८ /२॥
verses.wordMeaning: Two groups, the Ajitas and the Sukras were created by Brahma. The Yamas who were born at the outset became heaven-dwellers.
verses.commentary: Sense: Two groups, the Ajitas and the Sukras were created by Brahma. The Yamas who were born at the outset became heaven-dwellers.

verses.sanskrit: पूर्वोत्पन्नौ पुरा तेभ्यः सर्वेषामपि पूर्वजौ व्यतीते त्वष्टमे कल्पे पुराणौ लोकसाक्षिणौ
verses.transliteration: pūrvotpannau purā tebhyaḥ sarveṣāmapi pūrvajau vyatīte tvaṣṭame kalpe purāṇau lokasākṣiṇau
verses.translation: Lord Daka begot of Prasuti, the daughter of Sviyam- bhuva, twentyfour daughters who became the mothers of the worlds.
verses.hindi: अन्तरिक्ष इस रथका वरूथ (कवच) था और स्वर्ग तथा मोक्ष इस रथके दोनों ध्वज थे। धर्म तथा विराग इसके दण्ड थे; यज्ञ इस दण्डको आश्रय (सहारा) देनेवाले कहे गये हैं। दक्षिणाएँ उस रथकी
verses.wordMeaning: Lord Daka begot of Prasuti, the daughter of Sviyam- bhuva, twentyfour daughters who became the mothers of the worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: Lord Daka begot of Prasuti, the daughter of Sviyam- bhuva, twentyfour daughters who became the mothers of the worlds.

verses.sanskrit: तौ वाराहे तु भूर्लोके तेजः संक्षिप्य धिष्ठितौ तावुभौ मोक्षकर्माणाव् आरोप्यात्मानमात्मनि
verses.transliteration: tau vārāhe tu bhūrloke tejaḥ saṃkṣipya dhiṣṭhitau tāvubhau mokṣakarmāṇāv āropyātmānamātmani
verses.translation: All of them were highly blessed, lotus-eyed, pleasure- seeking and yogic mothers.
verses.hindi: सन्धियाँ थीं और पचासों अग्नियाँ इसकी कोलें थीं। धर्म तथा काम-ये दोनों उसके जुओंके सिरे कहे गये हैं। अव्यक्त तत्त्व उसका ईषादण्ड था तथा बुद्धि इसका श्रीलिड्रमहापुराण
verses.wordMeaning: All of them were highly blessed, lotus-eyed, pleasure- seeking and yogic mothers.
verses.commentary: Sense: All of them were highly blessed, lotus-eyed, pleasure- seeking and yogic mothers.

verses.sanskrit: प्रजां धर्मं च कामं च त्यक्त्वा वैराग्यमास्थितौ यथोत्पन्नस्तथैवेह कुमारः स इहोच्यते
verses.transliteration: prajāṃ dharmaṃ ca kāmaṃ ca tyaktvā vairāgyamāsthitau yathotpannastathaiveha kumāraḥ sa ihocyate
verses.translation: All of them were expounders of the Brahman as well as mothers of the universe: Lord Dharma took as his wives thirteen of the daughters of Dak$a, viz:— SraddhS (faith); Lak$m! (fortune), Dhfti (fortitude), Tusti (satisfaction), Pu§ti (nourishment), MedhS (intellect), Kriya (rituals), Buddhi (wisdom), Lajj (bashfulness), Vapuh (beauty), Santi (peace), Siddhi (achievement) and Kirti (renown) the thirteenth.
verses.hindi: 2 111111 क त त क” फ कर फ़ फ फ़ फ़ फफ फ़ फ़ फ फ़ फ फ फ फक फ फ़क़ फ फ़ फक क फक फ फ फ फ कमा फक मी की की फी फफफफझफफफफफफाफफफफफ झफफफफफफाफाफाफीफाफफफफफफपाफ ५७
verses.wordMeaning: All of them were expounders of the Brahman as well as mothers of the universe: Lord Dharma took as his wives thirteen of the daughters of Dak$a, viz:— SraddhS (faith); Lak$m! (fortune), Dhfti (fortitude), Tusti (satisfaction), Pu§ti (nourishment), MedhS (intellect),…
verses.commentary: Sense: All of them were expounders of the Brahman as well as mothers of the universe: Lord Dharma took as his wives thirteen of the daughters of Dak$a, viz:— SraddhS (faith); Lak$m! (fortune), Dhfti (fortitude), Tusti (satisfaction), Pu§ti (nourishment), MedhS (intellect),…

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात् सनत्कुमारेति नामास्येह प्रकीर्तितम् सनन्दं सनकं चैव विद्वांसं च सनातनम्
verses.transliteration: tasmāt sanatkumāreti nāmāsyeha prakīrtitam sanandaṃ sanakaṃ caiva vidvāṃsaṃ ca sanātanam
verses.translation: The lord Dharma took these daughters of Daka
verses.hindi: कोणस्तथा ह्यहङ्कारो भूतानि च बलं स्मृतम्। पुराणन्यायमीमांसाधर्मशास्त्राणि सुव्रताः । वालाश्रयाः पटाश्चैव सर्वलक्षणसंयुताः
verses.wordMeaning: The lord Dharma took these daughters of Daka
verses.commentary: Sense: The lord Dharma took these daughters of Daka

verses.sanskrit: विज्ञानेन निवृत्तास्ते व्यवर्तन्त महौजसः संबुद्धाश्चैव नानात्वे अप्रवृत्ताश् च योगिनः
verses.transliteration: vijñānena nivṛttāste vyavartanta mahaujasaḥ saṃbuddhāścaiva nānātve apravṛttāś ca yoginaḥ
verses.translation: Sraddha gave birth to Kama. Darpa was the son ofLaksmi; Niyama of Dhrti; Santosa of Tusti; Lobha of Pusti; Sruta of Medha; Danda and Samaya were born as the sons of Kriya; Bodha and Pramada of Buddhi; Vinaya (Humi- lity) was born of Lajja; Vyavasaya (Enterprise) of Vapus; Ksema of Santi; Sukha of Siddhi; and Yaah of Kirti — these were the offspring of Dharma. Harsa was Kama's son born of the gentle lady Priti. Thus, the creation of Dharma has been recounted. Hirhsa bore to Adharma, Ntkrti and Anrta.
verses.hindi: पुष्कराद्याः पताकाश्च सौवर्णा रत्नभूषिताः
verses.wordMeaning: Sraddha gave birth to Kama. Darpa was the son ofLaksmi; Niyama of Dhrti; Santosa of Tusti; Lobha of Pusti; Sruta of Medha; Danda and Samaya were born as the sons of Kriya; Bodha and Pramada of Buddhi; Vinaya (Humi- lity) was born of Lajja; Vyavasaya (Enterprise) of Vapus;…
verses.commentary: Sense: Sraddha gave birth to Kama. Darpa was the son ofLaksmi; Niyama of Dhrti; Santosa of Tusti; Lobha of Pusti; Sruta of Medha; Danda and Samaya were born as the sons of Kriya; Bodha and Pramada of Buddhi; Vinaya (Humi- lity) was born of Lajja; Vyavasaya (Enterprise) of Vapus;…

verses.sanskrit: असृष्ट्वैव प्रजासर्गं प्रतिसर्गं गताः पुनः ततस्तेषु व्यतीतेषु ततो ऽन्यान् साधकान् सुतान्
verses.transliteration: asṛṣṭvaiva prajāsargaṃ pratisargaṃ gatāḥ punaḥ tatasteṣu vyatīteṣu tato 'nyān sādhakān sutān
verses.translation: Pairs of twins were born of Nikrti: Bhaya and Naraka; Maya and Vedana, Maya gave birth to Mrtyu, the dispeller of living beings. Raurava got a son of Vedana called Duhkha.
