From Mrtyu were born Vyadhi, Jara, l§oka, Krodhaand Asuya. All these ending with Duhkha had the cha- racteristics of Adharma. These had no wives nor sons. They live in perpetual chastity. Thus, the Tamasa creation was evolved with Adharma as the controlling factor.
verses.hindi: समुद्रास्तस्य चत्वारो रथकम्बलिकाः स्मृताः । आवहाद्यास्तथा सप्त सोपानं हैममुत्तमम्। सारथिर्भगवान् ब्रह्मा देवाभीषुधराः स्मृताः
verses.wordMeaning: Pairs of twins were born of Nikrti: Bhaya and Naraka; Maya and Vedana, Maya gave birth to Mrtyu, the dispeller of living beings. Raurava got a son of Vedana called Duhkha. From Mrtyu were born Vyadhi, Jara, l§oka, Krodhaand Asuya.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Pairs of twins were born of Nikrti: Bhaya and Naraka; Maya and Vedana, Maya gave birth to Mrtyu, the dispeller of living beings. Raurava got a son of Vedana called Duhkha. From Mrtyu were born Vyadhi, Jara, l§oka, Krodhaand Asuya.…

verses.sanskrit: मानसानसृजद्ब्रह्मा पुनः स्थानाभिमानिनः आ भूतसम्प्लवावस्था यैरियं विधृता मही
verses.transliteration: mānasānasṛjadbrahmā punaḥ sthānābhimāninaḥ ā bhūtasamplavāvasthā yairiyaṃ vidhṛtā mahī
verses.translation: Nilalohita was given the direction by Brahma to create the subjects. Meditating on his wife Sati he created thousands of hide-clad beings as his mental sons who were neither superior nor inferior but equal to him.
verses.hindi: प्रतोदो ब्रह्मणस्तस्य प्रणवो ब्रह्महैवतम्। 'लोकालोकाचलस्तस्य ससोपानः समन्ततः
verses.wordMeaning: Nilalohita was given the direction by Brahma to create the subjects. Meditating on his wife Sati he created thousands of hide-clad beings as his mental sons who were neither superior nor inferior but equal to him.
verses.commentary: Sense: Nilalohita was given the direction by Brahma to create the subjects. Meditating on his wife Sati he created thousands of hide-clad beings as his mental sons who were neither superior nor inferior but equal to him.

verses.sanskrit: आपो ऽग्निं पृथिवीं वायुम् अन्तरिक्षं दिवं तथा समुद्रांश् च नदीश्चैव तथा शैलवनस्पतीन्
verses.transliteration: āpo 'gniṃ pṛthivīṃ vāyum antarikṣaṃ divaṃ tathā samudrāṃś ca nadīścaiva tathā śailavanaspatīn
verses.translation: They were all equal to him in form, splendour, strength and learning. They were tawny-coloured. They were equipped with quivers. They had their matted hairs of red- dish hue. They were having special features. Their hairs were greenish. They held skulls. They could kill with their eyes. They had massive figures. They were deformed. They
verses.hindi: तलाः कपोताः कापोताः सर्वे तलनिवासिनः। मेरुरेव महाछत्रं मन्दरः पार्श्वडिण्डिमः शैलेन्द्रः कार्मुकं चैव ज्याभुजङ्गाधिपः स्वयम्। कालरात्र्या तथैवेह तथेन्द्र्धनुषा पुनः
verses.wordMeaning: They were all equal to him in form, splendour, strength and learning. They were tawny-coloured. They were equipped with quivers. They had their matted hairs of red- dish hue. They were having special features. Their hairs were greenish. They held skulls.…
verses.commentary: Sense: They were all equal to him in form, splendour, strength and learning. They were tawny-coloured. They were equipped with quivers. They had their matted hairs of red- dish hue. They were having special features. Their hairs were greenish. They held skulls.…

verses.sanskrit: ओषधीनां तथात्मानो वल्लीनां वृक्षवीरुधाम् लताः काष्ठाः कलाश्चैव मुहूर्ताः संधिरात्र्यहान्
verses.transliteration: oṣadhīnāṃ tathātmāno vallīnāṃ vṛkṣavīrudhām latāḥ kāṣṭhāḥ kalāścaiva muhūrtāḥ saṃdhirātryahān
verses.translation: On seeing him (i.e. Rudra) Brahma spoke to him — "Do not create subjects like these. O lord, do not create subjects equal to yourself. Obeisance be to you! Welfare unto you. Create subjects endowed with death. Subjects devoid of death will not start holy rites."
verses.hindi: घण्टा सरस्वती देवी धनुषः श्रुतिरूपिणी। इषुविष्णुर्महातेजाः शल्यं सोमः शरस्य च
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing him (i.e. Rudra) Brahma spoke to him — "Do not create subjects like these. O lord, do not create subjects equal to yourself. Obeisance be to you! Welfare unto you. Create subjects endowed with death. Subjects devoid of death will not start holy rites."
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing him (i.e. Rudra) Brahma spoke to him — "Do not create subjects like these. O lord, do not create subjects equal to yourself. Obeisance be to you! Welfare unto you. Create subjects endowed with death. Subjects devoid of death will not start holy rites."

verses.sanskrit: अर्धमासांश् च मासांश् च अयनाब्दयुगानि च स्थानाभिमानिनः सर्वे स्थानाख्याश्चैव ते स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: ardhamāsāṃś ca māsāṃś ca ayanābdayugāni ca sthānābhimāninaḥ sarve sthānākhyāścaiva te smṛtāḥ
verses.translation: A hundred Rudras will be devoted to sacrifice. They will partake offerings in sacrifices along with the groups of Devas.
verses.hindi: नड्वल (अक्षको स्निग्ध बनानेवाले द्रव्यका पात्र) थी। णानि समन्ततः॥ १२  अहंकार इसका कोण था। पंचमहाभूतोंको इसका
verses.wordMeaning: A hundred Rudras will be devoted to sacrifice. They will partake offerings in sacrifices along with the groups of Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: A hundred Rudras will be devoted to sacrifice. They will partake offerings in sacrifices along with the groups of Devas.

verses.sanskrit: देवानृषींश् च महतो गदतस्तान् निबोधत मरीचिभृग्वङ्गिरसं पुलस्त्यं पुलहं क्रतुम्
verses.transliteration: devānṛṣīṃś ca mahato gadatastān nibodhata marīcibhṛgvaṅgirasaṃ pulastyaṃ pulahaṃ kratum
verses.translation: They will stay till the end of a yuga. They will be worshipped along with Devas in different manvantaras."
verses.hindi: बताया गया है। सभी इन्द्रियाँ उसके सभी ओर लगे हुए आभूषण थे। श्रद्धा इस रथ-को गति थी। बेद उसके घोडे कहे गये हैं । वेदोंके पदविभाग इसके भूषण थे तथा शिक्षा आदि छ: वेदांग इसके उपभूषण थे।
verses.wordMeaning: They will stay till the end of a yuga. They will be worshipped along with Devas in different manvantaras."
verses.commentary: Sense: They will stay till the end of a yuga. They will be worshipped along with Devas in different manvantaras."

verses.sanskrit: दक्षमत्रिं वसिष्ठं च सो ऽसृजन्मानसान् नव नव ब्रह्माण इत्येते पुराणे निश्चयं गताः
verses.transliteration: dakṣamatriṃ vasiṣṭhaṃ ca so 'sṛjanmānasān nava nava brahmāṇa ityete purāṇe niścayaṃ gatāḥ
verses.translation: Thus addressed by the intelligent lord, Brahma the delighted patriarch bowed down to him and replied.
verses.hindi: हे सुव्रतो! पुराण, न्याय, मीमांसा तथा धर्मशास्त्र इसके वालाश्रय पट थीं, जो सभी लक्षणोंसे युक्त थे। गायत्री आदि मन्त्र, क आदि वर्ण, पाद (छन्दोंके चतुर्थांश) तथा ब्रह्मचर्य आदि आश्रम उन पटोंके घंटे कहे गये हैं। हजार फणोंसे विभूषित अनन्त शेषनाग उसके
verses.wordMeaning: Thus addressed by the intelligent lord, Brahma the delighted patriarch bowed down to him and replied.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus addressed by the intelligent lord, Brahma the delighted patriarch bowed down to him and replied.

verses.sanskrit: तेषां ब्रह्मात्मकानां वै सर्वेषां ब्रह्मवादिनाम् स्थानानि कल्पयामास पूर्ववत्पद्मसंभवः
verses.transliteration: teṣāṃ brahmātmakānāṃ vai sarveṣāṃ brahmavādinām sthānāni kalpayāmāsa pūrvavatpadmasaṃbhavaḥ
verses.translation: "O lord, welfare unto you. Let it be even as it had been mentioned by you.'' When it was approved by Brahma, everything happened in that manner.
verses.hindi: दिशाएँ तथा उपदिशाएँ इस रथके पाद थे। पुष्कर आदि मेघ रत्नभूषित सुवर्णनिर्मित पताकाएँ थीं । चारो समुद्र उस रथके बाह्य कम्बल कहे गये हैं । गंगा आदि सभी श्रेष्ठ नदियाँ समस्त आभूषणोंसे अलंकृत होकर
verses.wordMeaning: "O lord, welfare unto you. Let it be even as it had been mentioned by you.'' When it was approved by Brahma, everything happened in that manner.
verses.commentary: Sense: "O lord, welfare unto you. Let it be even as it had been mentioned by you.'' When it was approved by Brahma, everything happened in that manner.

verses.sanskrit: ततो ऽसृजच्च संकल्पं धर्मं चैव सुखावहम् सो ऽसृजद् व्यवसायात्तु धर्मं देवो महेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: tato 'sṛjacca saṃkalpaṃ dharmaṃ caiva sukhāvaham so 'sṛjad vyavasāyāttu dharmaṃ devo maheśvaraḥ
verses.translation: Ever since that day, the lord of Devas (i. e., Rudra) did not procreate progeny. He remained as Sthanu with sublimated sexuality till the time of Dissolution. Since lord Mahadeva, the Purusa shining like the sun said ''I am staying"; he is known as Sthanu (motionless).
verses.hindi: अपने हाथोंके अग्रभागमें चामर (चँँवर) धारण किये हुए स्त्रीरूपसे शोभित होती हुई जहाँ-तहाँ अपना स्थान बनाकर रथको सुशोभित कर रही थीं आवह आदि सात वायु उसकी सुवर्णमय उत्तम सीढ़ियाँ थीं। भगवान् ब्रह्मा सारथि थे और देवतालोग रथकी रश्मियोंको पकड़नेवाले कहे गये हैं । ब्रह्महैवत प्रणव ब्रह्माके हाथमें स्थित उसका प्रतोद (चाबुक)
verses.wordMeaning: Ever since that day, the lord of Devas (i. e., Rudra) did not procreate progeny. He remained as Sthanu with sublimated sexuality till the time of Dissolution. Since lord Mahadeva, the Purusa shining like the sun said ''I am staying"; he is known as Sthanu (motionless).
verses.commentary: Sense: Ever since that day, the lord of Devas (i. e., Rudra) did not procreate progeny. He remained as Sthanu with sublimated sexuality till the time of Dissolution. Since lord Mahadeva, the Purusa shining like the sun said ''I am staying"; he is known as Sthanu (motionless).

verses.sanskrit: संकल्पं चैव संकल्पात् सर्वलोकपितामहः मानसश् च रुचिर्नाम विजज्ञे ब्रह्मणः प्रभोः
verses.transliteration: saṃkalpaṃ caiva saṃkalpāt sarvalokapitāmahaḥ mānasaś ca rucirnāma vijajñe brahmaṇaḥ prabhoḥ
verses.translation: He has the female form in one half of his body. In splendour he is comparable to the fire. By his own will he divided himself into two, a separate woman, and a separate man.
verses.hindi: था। विस्तृत लोकालोक पर्वत उसके सात वायुओंके स्कन्धरूप सोपानसे युक्त था। परम सुन्दर मानस पर्वत उसमें पैर रखनेका अधोभाग (पायदान) था। समस्त पर्वत सभी ओर इस रथकी नासा (नासिका)
verses.wordMeaning: He has the female form in one half of his body. In splendour he is comparable to the fire. By his own will he divided himself into two, a separate woman, and a separate man.
verses.commentary: Sense: He has the female form in one half of his body. In splendour he is comparable to the fire. By his own will he divided himself into two, a separate woman, and a separate man.

verses.sanskrit: प्राणाद्ब्रह्मासृजद्दक्षं चक्षुर्भ्यां च मरीचिनम् भृगुस्तु हृदयाज्जज्ञे ऋषिः सलिलजन्मनः
verses.transliteration: prāṇādbrahmāsṛjaddakṣaṃ cakṣurbhyāṃ ca marīcinam bhṛgustu hṛdayājjajñe ṛṣiḥ salilajanmanaḥ
verses.translation: The same lord stationed himself in eleven halves. The great goddess mentioned before as the highly blessed lady sharing half the body of the lord became Sati for the welfare of the worlds. The goddess had been formerly propitiated by Daksa.
verses.hindi: कहे गये हैं॥ १९-२१॥ छ सातों तल उस रथके मज्जन थे; उन तलोमे रहनेवाले सभी लोग कपोतपक्षीके समान थे। मेरु पर्वत उस रथका महाछत्र था और मन्दर पर्वत पृष्ठवाद्यके रूपमें था। शैलराज मेरु धनुष थे और स्व
verses.wordMeaning: The same lord stationed himself in eleven halves. The great goddess mentioned before as the highly blessed lady sharing half the body of the lord became Sati for the welfare of the worlds. The goddess had been formerly propitiated by Daksa.
verses.commentary: Sense: The same lord stationed himself in eleven halves. The great goddess mentioned before as the highly blessed lady sharing half the body of the lord became Sati for the welfare of the worlds. The goddess had been formerly propitiated by Daksa.

verses.sanskrit: शिरसो ऽङ्गिरसश्चैव श्रोत्रादत्रिं तथासृजत् पुलस्त्यं च तथोदानाद् व्यानाच्च पुलहं पुनः
verses.transliteration: śiraso 'ṅgirasaścaiva śrotrādatriṃ tathāsṛjat pulastyaṃ ca tathodānād vyānācca pulahaṃ punaḥ
verses.translation: 'Tor the sake of creation, divide yourself into two, right half being white and the left black." — On being asked thus by lord Siva, O brahmins, she bifurcated herself into white and black. I shall mention her names; listen atten- tively.
verses.hindi: भुजंगपति वासुकि कालरात्रि तथा इन्द्रधनुषके दार ज्या (धनुषकी डोरी) थे। वेदस्वरूपिणी सरस्वती उस धनुषकी घण्टा थीं, महातेजस्वी विष्णु बाण थै
verses.wordMeaning: 'Tor the sake of creation, divide yourself into two, right half being white and the left black." — On being asked thus by lord Siva, O brahmins, she bifurcated herself into white and black. I shall mention her names; listen atten- tively.
verses.commentary: Sense: 'Tor the sake of creation, divide yourself into two, right half being white and the left black." — On being asked thus by lord Siva, O brahmins, she bifurcated herself into white and black. I shall mention her names; listen atten- tively.

verses.sanskrit: समानजो वसिष्ठश् च अपानान्निर्ममे क्रतुम् इत्येते ब्रह्मणः पुत्रा दिव्या एकादशा स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: samānajo vasiṣṭhaś ca apānānnirmame kratum ityete brahmaṇaḥ putrā divyā ekādaśā smṛtāḥ
verses.translation: They are: — Svaha, Svadha, Mahavidya, Medha, Laksmi, Sarasvati, Sati, Daksayani, Vidya, Iccha Sakti, Kriyat- mika, Aparna, Ekaparna, Ekapaala, Uma, Haimavati, Kalyani, Ekamatrka, Khyati, Prajna Mahabhaga, Gauri, Ganambika, Mahadevi, Nandini, and Jatavedasi. These are some of the names when she was one (i.e. before division). After she had divi- ded into two, her names are: — Savitri, Varada, Punya, Pavani, Lokavisruta, Ajna, Avesani, Krsna, Tamasi, Sattviki, Siva, Prakrti, Vikrta, Raudri, Durga, Bhadra, Pramathini, Kalaratri, Mahamaya, Revati, Bhutanayika. At the end of Dvapara yuga, O sages of good holy rites, her names are as follows: —
verses.hindi: अध्याय ७२ त्रिपुरासुरके वधके लिये विश्वकर्माद्वारा एक दिव्य रथका निर्माण....शिवकी स्तुति ३४७ कालाग्निस्तच्छरस्यैव साक्षात्तीक्षण: सुदारुण: । चन्द्रमा उस बाणके शल्य (लौहनिर्मित अग्रभाग) अनीकं विषसम्भूतं वायवो वाजकाः स्मृताः ॥ २५  थे। साक्षात् प्रलयाग्नि उस बाणके तीक्ष्ण तथा अतिभयंकर एवं कृत्वा रथं दिव्यं कार्मुकं च शरं तथा। ना bs थे) अल प ७ आक
verses.wordMeaning: They are: — Svaha, Svadha, Mahavidya, Medha, Laksmi, Sarasvati, Sati, Daksayani, Vidya, Iccha Sakti, Kriyat- mika, Aparna, Ekaparna, Ekapaala, Uma, Haimavati, Kalyani, Ekamatrka, Khyati, Prajna Mahabhaga, Gauri, Ganambika, Mahadevi, Nandini, and Jatavedasi.…
verses.commentary: Sense: They are: — Svaha, Svadha, Mahavidya, Medha, Laksmi, Sarasvati, Sati, Daksayani, Vidya, Iccha Sakti, Kriyat- mika, Aparna, Ekaparna, Ekapaala, Uma, Haimavati, Kalyani, Ekamatrka, Khyati, Prajna Mahabhaga, Gauri, Ganambika, Mahadevi, Nandini, and Jatavedasi.…

verses.sanskrit: धर्मादयः प्रथमजाः सर्वे ते ब्रह्मणः सुताः भृग्वादयस्तु ते सृष्टा नवैते ब्रह्मवादिनः
verses.transliteration: dharmādayaḥ prathamajāḥ sarve te brahmaṇaḥ sutāḥ bhṛgvādayastu te sṛṣṭā navaite brahmavādinaḥ
verses.translation: Lord Siva has a body half man and half woman. Thus when we speak of eleven Rudras we mean eleven half males and eleven half females. Both the male and female forms, divided into hundreds and thousands, have their distinct names and activities.
verses.hindi: सारथिं जगतां चैव है गये हैं॥ २२--२५॥ सारथिं जगतां चेव ब्रह्माणं प्रभुमीश्वरम्॥ २६ कि लिला या ए बाण तथा जगतूके स्वामी प्रभु ब्रह्माको सारथि बनाकर तथा कवच, मुकुट आदि रणभूषणोंको धारण करनेवाले
verses.wordMeaning: Lord Siva has a body half man and half woman. Thus when we speak of eleven Rudras we mean eleven half males and eleven half females. Both the male and female forms, divided into hundreds and thousands, have their distinct names and activities.
verses.commentary: Sense: Lord Siva has a body half man and half woman. Thus when we speak of eleven Rudras we mean eleven half males and eleven half females. Both the male and female forms, divided into hundreds and thousands, have their distinct names and activities.

verses.sanskrit: गृहमेधिनः पुराणास् ते धर्मस् तैः सम्प्रवर्तितः तेषां द्वादश ते वंशा दिव्या देवगुणान्विताः
verses.transliteration: gṛhamedhinaḥ purāṇās te dharmas taiḥ sampravartitaḥ teṣāṃ dvādaśa te vaṃśā divyā devaguṇānvitāḥ
verses.translation: GautamI, Kausiki, Arya, Candi, Katyayini, Sati, Kumari, Yadavi, Varada, Krsnapingala, Bahirdhvaja or Barhirdhvaja, Suladhara, Parama, Brahmacarini, Mahendro- pendrabhagini, Drsadvati, Ekasuladhrk, Aparajita, Bahubhuja, Pragalbha, Sirhhavahini, the slayer of the Daityas such as Sumbha and others, the suppressor of the great demon Mahisa, Amogha, Vindhyanilaya, Vikranta and Gananayika. These are the various names of the goddess in order.
verses.hindi: शिवजी सभी देवताओंसहित पृथ्वी तथा स्वर्गको कम्पित करते हुए उस दिव्य रथपर आरूढ़ हुए ऋषियोंके द्वारा स्तुत होते हुए और बन्दीजनों तथा नृत्य करती हुई नृत्यप्रवीण अप्सराओंके द्वारा वन्दित होते हुए वे वरद शिव अत्यन्त सुशोभित हो रहे थे। सारथिकी ओर देखकर उस लोकसम्भृत कल्पित रथपर
verses.wordMeaning: GautamI, Kausiki, Arya, Candi, Katyayini, Sati, Kumari, Yadavi, Varada, Krsnapingala, Bahirdhvaja or Barhirdhvaja, Suladhara, Parama, Brahmacarini, Mahendro- pendrabhagini, Drsadvati, Ekasuladhrk, Aparajita, Bahubhuja, Pragalbha, Sirhhavahini,…
verses.commentary: Sense: GautamI, Kausiki, Arya, Candi, Katyayini, Sati, Kumari, Yadavi, Varada, Krsnapingala, Bahirdhvaja or Barhirdhvaja, Suladhara, Parama, Brahmacarini, Mahendro- pendrabhagini, Drsadvati, Ekasuladhrk, Aparajita, Bahubhuja, Pragalbha, Sirhhavahini,…

verses.sanskrit: क्रियावन्तः प्रजावन्तो महर्षिभिर् अलंकृताः ऋभुः सनत्कुमारश् च द्वावेतावूर्ध्वरेतसौ
verses.transliteration: kriyāvantaḥ prajāvanto maharṣibhir alaṃkṛtāḥ ṛbhuḥ sanatkumāraś ca dvāvetāvūrdhvaretasau
verses.translation: The names of Bhadrakali mentioned by me yield the best results. Those men who read these become devoid of sons.
verses.hindi: उनके आरूढ़ होते ही वेदसम्भूत घोड़े सिरके बल भूमिपर गिर पड़े। तदनन्तर वृषेन्द्रका रूप धारण किये हुए भगवान् शेषने इस रथको नीचेसे उठाकर क्षणभरमें स्थापित करना चाहा, किंतु वे वृषेन्द्र भी एक क्षणके
verses.wordMeaning: The names of Bhadrakali mentioned by me yield the best results. Those men who read these become devoid of sons.
verses.commentary: Sense: The names of Bhadrakali mentioned by me yield the best results. Those men who read these become devoid of sons.

verses.sanskrit: पूर्वोत्पन्नौ परं तेभ्यः सर्वेषामपि पूर्वजौ व्यतीते त्वष्टमे कल्पे पुराणौ लोकसाक्षिणौ
verses.transliteration: pūrvotpannau paraṃ tebhyaḥ sarveṣāmapi pūrvajau vyatīte tvaṣṭame kalpe purāṇau lokasākṣiṇau
verses.translation: In the forest, on the mountain, in the city or in the house, in the water or on dry land these names are used as saving remedy. One shall repeat them when there is danger from tigers, elephants, kings or thieves — nay in all adversities.
verses.hindi: बाद घुटनोंके बल पृथ्वीपर गिर पड़े। तब हाथमें लगाम पकड़े हुए सर्वव्यापी भगवान् ब्रह्माने शिवके आदेशसे घोड़ोंको उद्यत (उत्साहित) करके उस शुभ रथको स्थापित कर दिया और उन्होंने मन तथा वायुके समान वेगवाले घोड़ोंको साहसी दानवोंके आकाश-स्थित पुरोंको उद्देश्य करके प्रेरित किया॥ २८--३३ ॥ इसके बाद भगवान् शंकर रुद्रने देवताओंको देखकर कहा--' मुझे ही पशुओं (जीवों)-का आधिपत्य
verses.wordMeaning: In the forest, on the mountain, in the city or in the house, in the water or on dry land these names are used as saving remedy. One shall repeat them when there is danger from tigers, elephants, kings or thieves — nay in all adversities.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the forest, on the mountain, in the city or in the house, in the water or on dry land these names are used as saving remedy. One shall repeat them when there is danger from tigers, elephants, kings or thieves — nay in all adversities.

verses.sanskrit: विराजेतामुभौ लोके तेजः संक्षिप्य धिष्ठितौ तावुभौ योगकर्माणाव् आरोप्यात्मानम् आत्मनि
verses.transliteration: virājetāmubhau loke tejaḥ saṃkṣipya dhiṣṭhitau tāvubhau yogakarmāṇāv āropyātmānam ātmani
verses.translation: One shall repeat these names as protective measure in the case of children afflicted by evil eye, evil planets, goblins as well as mothers.
verses.hindi: दिया गया है; अतः मैं असुरोंका हनन करता हूँ। है श्रेष्ठ
verses.wordMeaning: One shall repeat these names as protective measure in the case of children afflicted by evil eye, evil planets, goblins as well as mothers.
verses.commentary: Sense: One shall repeat these names as protective measure in the case of children afflicted by evil eye, evil planets, goblins as well as mothers.

verses.sanskrit: प्रजां धर्मं च कामं च त्यक्त्वा वैराग्यमास्थितौ यथोत्पन्नः स एवेह कुमारः स इहोच्यते
verses.transliteration: prajāṃ dharmaṃ ca kāmaṃ ca tyaktvā vairāgyamāsthitau yathotpannaḥ sa eveha kumāraḥ sa ihocyate
verses.translation: The following two are the parts of the great goddess. They are Prajha and Sri. From these two were born thousands of goddesses by whom the entire universe is pervaded.
verses.hindi: होनेके कारण ही वे महादानव वधके योग्य होंगे; अन्यथा नहीं बुद्धिमान् देवदेव शिव -का सम्पूर्ण वचन सुनकर पशुत्वके प्रति शंकित होते हुए सभी देवता विषादग्रस्त हो गये

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीलिङ्गमहापुराणे पूर्वभागे सृष्टिविस्तारो नाम सप्ततितमो ऽध्यायः समासाद् विस्तराच्चैव सर्गः प्रोक्तस्त्वया शुभः कथं पशुपतिश्चासीत् पुरं दग्धुं महेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: iti śrīliṅgamahāpurāṇe pūrvabhāge sṛṣṭivistāro nāma saptatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ samāsād vistarāccaiva sargaḥ proktastvayā śubhaḥ kathaṃ paśupatiścāsīt puraṃ dagdhuṃ maheśvaraḥ
verses.translation: O holy lord, how did Devas including Brahma become Pasus? The set of cities was formerly built by Maya by per- forming penance. It was an excellent set of three cities of divine nature, made of gold, silver and iron. We have heard that these along with their forts were burned by the lord of Devas. How did the lord who struck down the eyes of Bhaga burn these cities by discharging a single arrow even though it was divine.
verses.hindi: रुद्राय मूर्धाननिकृन्तनाय ममादिदेवस्य च यग्चमूर्तेः। विध्वान्तभङ्ग मम कर्तुमीश दृष्ट्वैव भूमौ करजाग्रकोट्या

verses.commentary: Sense: O holy lord, how did Devas including Brahma become Pasus? The set of cities was formerly built by Maya by per- forming penance. It was an excellent set of three cities of divine nature, made of gold, silver and iron.…

verses.sanskrit: कथं च पशवश्चासन् देवाः सब्रह्मकाः प्रभोः मयस्य तपसा पूर्वं सुदुर्गं निर्मितं पुरम्
verses.transliteration: kathaṃ ca paśavaścāsan devāḥ sabrahmakāḥ prabhoḥ mayasya tapasā pūrvaṃ sudurgaṃ nirmitaṃ puram
verses.translation: That set of three cities was not burned by the goblins created by Visnu. The entire details of the origin of the cities and the acquisition of boons have been heard formerly.
verses.hindi: अहो विचित्रं तव देवदेव
verses.wordMeaning: That set of three cities was not burned by the goblins created by Visnu. The entire details of the origin of the cities and the acquisition of boons have been heard formerly.
verses.commentary: Sense: That set of three cities was not burned by the goblins created by Visnu. The entire details of the origin of the cities and the acquisition of boons have been heard formerly.

verses.sanskrit: हैमं च राजतं दिव्यम् अयस्मयम् अनुत्तमम् सुदुर्गं देवदेवेन दग्धमित्येव नः श्रुतम्
verses.transliteration: haimaṃ ca rājataṃ divyam ayasmayam anuttamam sudurgaṃ devadevena dagdhamityeva naḥ śrutam
verses.translation: O sage of good holy rites, it behoves you to narrate the burning of the cities wholly.
verses.hindi: देहीव देवैः सह देवकार्य करिष्यसे निर्गुणरूपतत्त्व आपके द्वारा त्रिपुरके नाशके लिये मैंने अनेक यत्नोंसे रथ, श्रेष्ठ बाण तथा सुन्दर धनुष आपके लिये निर्मित किया था; किंतु देवताओं तथा सिद्धजनोंद्वार युद्धरूपी फलको नहीं जाना जा सका अर्थात् परम
verses.wordMeaning: O sage of good holy rites, it behoves you to narrate the burning of the cities wholly.
verses.commentary: Sense: O sage of good holy rites, it behoves you to narrate the burning of the cities wholly.

verses.sanskrit: कथं ददाह भगवान् भगनेत्रनिपातनः एकेनेषुनिपातेन दिव्येनापि तदा कथम्
verses.transliteration: kathaṃ dadāha bhagavān bhaganetranipātanaḥ ekeneṣunipātena divyenāpi tadā katham
verses.translation: Those excellent Danavas, while performing fierce penance, observed great restraints. By means of penance they emaciated their bodies. The delighted Brahma, the bestower of boons granted them the boon of their choice.
verses.hindi: महिमावाले आपने क्षणभरमें त्रिपुरका नाश कर दिया
verses.wordMeaning: Those excellent Danavas, while performing fierce penance, observed great restraints. By means of penance they emaciated their bodies. The delighted Brahma, the bestower of boons granted them the boon of their choice.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those excellent Danavas, while performing fierce penance, observed great restraints. By means of penance they emaciated their bodies. The delighted Brahma, the bestower of boons granted them the boon of their choice.

verses.sanskrit: विष्णुनोत्पादितैर्भूतैर् न दग्धं तत्पुरत्रयम् पुरस्य संभवः सर्वो वरलाभः पुरा श्रुतः
verses.transliteration: viṣṇunotpāditairbhūtair na dagdhaṃ tatpuratrayam purasya saṃbhavaḥ sarvo varalābhaḥ purā śrutaḥ
verses.translation: "O Asuras, there is no universal immortality. Desist from this desire. Choose another boon that may appeal to you."
verses.hindi: रथ, रथी, देवश्रेष्ठ विष्णु, स्वयं रुद्र, इर ब्रह्म-ये सब आप ही हैं। है भगवन्! मैं आप अतोष्य (स्तुति न किये जा सकनेवाले)-की स्तुति कैसे करूं. अतः सिर झुकाकर केवल प्रणाम करता हूँ अनन्त सिरवाले, अनन्त रूपोंवाले, संहार करनेवाले तथा कल्याण करनेवाले हैं-ऐसे प्रभाववाले आपकी स्तुति कैसे करूँ; आप अतोष्यकी स्तुति कैसे करूँ ?
verses.wordMeaning: "O Asuras, there is no universal immortality. Desist from this desire. Choose another boon that may appeal to you."
verses.commentary: Sense: "O Asuras, there is no universal immortality. Desist from this desire. Choose another boon that may appeal to you."

verses.sanskrit: इदानीं दहनं सर्वं वक्तुमर्हसि सुव्रत तेषां तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा सूतः पौराणिकोत्तमः
verses.transliteration: idānīṃ dahanaṃ sarvaṃ vaktumarhasi suvrata teṣāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā sūtaḥ paurāṇikottamaḥ
verses.translation: Then the Daityas after consulting one another bowed to Brahma, the preceptor of the universe and said to him: —
verses.hindi: आप सर्ववेत्ता, शिव, रुद्र, शर्व, भव, स्थूल, सूक्ष्म, अत्यन्त सूक्ष्मसे भी सूक्ष्म, सूक्ष्म अर्थोको जाननेवाले तथा विधाताको नमस्कार है
verses.wordMeaning: Then the Daityas after consulting one another bowed to Brahma, the preceptor of the universe and said to him: —
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the Daityas after consulting one another bowed to Brahma, the preceptor of the universe and said to him: —

verses.sanskrit: यथा श्रुतं तथा प्राह व्यासाद् विश्वार्थसूचकात् त्रैलोक्यस्यास्य शापाद्धि मनोवाक्कायसंभवात्
verses.transliteration: yathā śrutaṃ tathā prāha vyāsād viśvārthasūcakāt trailokyasyāsya śāpāddhi manovākkāyasaṃbhavāt
verses.translation: "By your grace, O lord of worlds, O preceptor of the universe, we shall roam over this earth and live in three cities.
verses.hindi: सभी देवताओं तथा असुरोंके स्रष्टा, लोकोंका सृजन-पालन-संहार करनेवाले, देवताओं तथा असुरोंके शासन करनेवालेको नमस्कार है
verses.wordMeaning: "By your grace, O lord of worlds, O preceptor of the universe, we shall roam over this earth and live in three cities.
verses.commentary: Sense: "By your grace, O lord of worlds, O preceptor of the universe, we shall roam over this earth and live in three cities.

verses.sanskrit: निहते तारके दैत्ये तारपुत्रे सबान्धवे स्कन्देन वा प्रयत्नेन तस्य पुत्रा महाबलाः
verses.transliteration: nihate tārake daitye tāraputre sabāndhave skandena vā prayatnena tasya putrā mahābalāḥ
verses.translation: Once in a thousand years we shall meet together. O sinless one, these cities shall then fuse into one city.
verses.hindi: वेदान्तके द्वारा जाननेयोग्य, परम शुद्ध, वेदार्थके ज्ञाताओंद्वारा निरन्तर स्तुत, वेदके आत्मास्वरूप, भव, अन्त, मध्य तथा सुमध्यम आपको नमस्कार है
verses.wordMeaning: Once in a thousand years we shall meet together. O sinless one, these cities shall then fuse into one city.
verses.commentary: Sense: Once in a thousand years we shall meet together. O sinless one, these cities shall then fuse into one city.

verses.sanskrit: विद्युन्माली तारकाक्षः कमलाक्षश् च वीर्यवान् तपस्तेपुर्महात्मानो महाबलपराक्रमाः
verses.transliteration: vidyunmālī tārakākṣaḥ kamalākṣaś ca vīryavān tapastepurmahātmāno mahābalaparākramāḥ
verses.translation: The lord who strikes at these when they have fused into one with a single arrow shall be death unto us.
verses.hindi: आदि तथा अन्तसे रहित, सर्वत्र विद्यमान, शून्यत्वसे रहित, लिङ्गी, अलिङ्गी, लिङ्गमय, लिङ्गस्वरूप तथा साक्षात् वेदादिमय (प्रणवरूप) आपको नमस्कार है मेरे भी आदिदेव यज्ञमूर्ति विष्णुके तथा मुर ब्रह्माके अज्ञानान्धकारका नाश करनेके लिये अपराधस्थानमें देखकर अपने नाखूनके अग्रभागसे मेरे मस्तकका छेदन करनेवाले है ईश! आप रुद्रको नमस्कार है
verses.wordMeaning: The lord who strikes at these when they have fused into one with a single arrow shall be death unto us.
verses.commentary: Sense: The lord who strikes at these when they have fused into one with a single arrow shall be death unto us.

verses.sanskrit: तप उग्रं समास्थाय नियमे परमे स्थिताः तपसा कर्शयामासुर् देहान् स्वान्दानवोत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: tapa ugraṃ samāsthāya niyame parame sthitāḥ tapasā karśayāmāsur dehān svāndānavottamāḥ
verses.translation: The cities of those noble asuras were stationed as follows: — the golden one was in the heaven; the silver city was in the firmament and the iron city was on the earth.
verses.hindi: हे देवदेव! है समस्त देवताओं तथा असुरोंके ईश आपका क्रिया-कलाप विचित्र है। है निर्गुणरूपतत्त' आप देवताओंके साथ देहधारीकी भाँति देवोंका कार्य करेंगे
verses.wordMeaning: The cities of those noble asuras were stationed as follows: — the golden one was in the heaven; the silver city was in the firmament and the iron city was on the earth.
verses.commentary: Sense: The cities of those noble asuras were stationed as follows: — the golden one was in the heaven; the silver city was in the firmament and the iron city was on the earth.

verses.sanskrit: तेषां पितामहः प्रीतो वरदः प्रददौ वरम् अवध्यत्वं च सर्वेषां सर्वभूतेषु सर्वदा
verses.transliteration: teṣāṃ pitāmahaḥ prīto varadaḥ pradadau varam avadhyatvaṃ ca sarveṣāṃ sarvabhūteṣu sarvadā
verses.translation: Each of these cities was a hundred yojanas in length and in breadth. The city of Tarakaksa was made of gold; the city of Kamalaksa was made of silver; that of Vidyunmali was made of iron; they had three types of excellent forts. Maya was worshipped by the Daityas and Danavas there. This powerful architect built his own abode in everyone of them and lived there.
verses.hindi: अध्याय ७२ त्रिपुरासुरके वधके लिये विश्वकर्माद्वारा एक दिव्य रथका निर्माण....शिवकी स्तुति ३५९ पजक अ ककअकऊ अकमक अक ५) भक फक झा फा भ फ भ भाका जक जऊ मडका
verses.wordMeaning: Each of these cities was a hundred yojanas in length and in breadth. The city of Tarakaksa was made of gold; the city of Kamalaksa was made of silver; that of Vidyunmali was made of iron; they had three types of excellent forts.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Each of these cities was a hundred yojanas in length and in breadth. The city of Tarakaksa was made of gold; the city of Kamalaksa was made of silver; that of Vidyunmali was made of iron; they had three types of excellent forts.…

verses.sanskrit: सहिता वरयामासुः सर्वलोकपितामहम् तान् अब्रवीत् तदा देवो लोकानां प्रभुर् अव्ययः
verses.transliteration: sahitā varayāmāsuḥ sarvalokapitāmaham tān abravīt tadā devo lokānāṃ prabhur avyayaḥ
verses.translation: Thus, O men of good holy rites, came into existence the well- fortified three cities. O leading brahmins, they were like the three worlds.
verses.hindi: मूर्तिनों वै देवमीशानदेवै- लक्ष्या यत्नैरप्यलक्ष्यं कथं तु
verses.wordMeaning: Thus, O men of good holy rites, came into existence the well- fortified three cities. O leading brahmins, they were like the three worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus, O men of good holy rites, came into existence the well- fortified three cities. O leading brahmins, they were like the three worlds.

verses.sanskrit: नास्ति सर्वामरत्वं वै निवर्तध्वम् अतो ऽसुराः अन्यं वरं वृणीध्वं वै यादृशं सम्प्ररोचते
verses.transliteration: nāsti sarvāmaratvaṃ vai nivartadhvam ato 'surāḥ anyaṃ varaṃ vṛṇīdhvaṃ vai yādṛśaṃ samprarocate
verses.translation: When the trio of cities grew up, the Daityas in the three worlds entered the three cities and became superior in strength.
verses.hindi: दिव्यः क्व देवेश भवत्प्रभावो इस ब्रह्माण्डमें आपका एक स्थूल रूप (पृथ्वीरूप),
verses.wordMeaning: When the trio of cities grew up, the Daityas in the three worlds entered the three cities and became superior in strength.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the trio of cities grew up, the Daityas in the three worlds entered the three cities and became superior in strength.

verses.sanskrit: ततस्ते सहिता दैत्याः सम्प्रधार्य परस्परम् ब्रह्माणमब्रुवन्दैत्याः प्रणिपत्य जगद्गुरुम्
verses.transliteration: tataste sahitā daityāḥ sampradhārya parasparam brahmāṇamabruvandaityāḥ praṇipatya jagadgurum
verses.translation: The cities were full of kalpa trees.®® They abounded in elephants and horses. There were innumerable mansions richly decorated with clusters of jewels.
verses.hindi: (अग्निरूप), मूर्तामूर्त रूप (क्षय-वृद्धिकि आश्रयके कारण चन्द्ररूप), एक मूर्तरूप (सूर्यरूप), एक अमूर्तरूप (वायुरूप), एक दृष्ट वाङ्मयरूप (शब्दगुणसे ज्ञात गगनरूप) और एक ध्येय अद्भुत ईशरूप है
verses.wordMeaning: The cities were full of kalpa trees.®® They abounded in elephants and horses. There were innumerable mansions richly decorated with clusters of jewels.
verses.commentary: Sense: The cities were full of kalpa trees.®® They abounded in elephants and horses. There were innumerable mansions richly decorated with clusters of jewels.

verses.sanskrit: वयं पुराणि त्रीण्येव समास्थाय महीमिमाम् विचरिष्याम लोकेश त्वत्प्रसादाज्जगद्गुरो
verses.transliteration: vayaṃ purāṇi trīṇyeva samāsthāya mahīmimām vicariṣyāma lokeśa tvatprasādājjagadguro
verses.translation: There were aerial chariots that resembled the solar
verses.hindi: स्वप्नमें जो पदार्थ दिखायी देता है, वह प्रत्यक्षकी भाँति प्रतीत होता है; उसे मैं अलक्ष्य नहीं मानता हूँ। वैसे ही है ईशान! देवताओंके द्वारा प्रयत्नपूर्वक देखा गया आपका विग्रह हमारे लिये निर्गुण तथा अलक्ष्य कैसे हो सकता है ?
verses.wordMeaning: There were aerial chariots that resembled the solar
verses.commentary: Sense: There were aerial chariots that resembled the solar

verses.sanskrit: तथा वर्षसहस्रेषु समेष्यामः परस्परम् एकीभावं गमिष्यन्ति पुराण्येतानि चानघ
verses.transliteration: tathā varṣasahasreṣu sameṣyāmaḥ parasparam ekībhāvaṃ gamiṣyanti purāṇyetāni cānagha
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, it was filled with divine ladies (i.e. ladies of divine beauty and excellence), Gandharvas, Siddhas and Caranas. There were shrines of Rudra in every house and Agnihotra was performed every day.
verses.hindi: हे देवेश! कहाँ आपका दिव्य प्रभाव और कहाँ हमलोग, कहाँ हमारी भक्ति और कहाँ आपकी यह स्तुति; फिर भी है देवेश! है भगवन्! भक्तिपूर्वक विलाप करते हुए मुझ ब्रह्माको क्षमा कोजिये
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent brahmins, it was filled with divine ladies (i.e. ladies of divine beauty and excellence), Gandharvas, Siddhas and Caranas. There were shrines of Rudra in every house and Agnihotra was performed every day.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent brahmins, it was filled with divine ladies (i.e. ladies of divine beauty and excellence), Gandharvas, Siddhas and Caranas. There were shrines of Rudra in every house and Agnihotra was performed every day.

verses.sanskrit: समागतानि चैतानि यो हन्याद्भगवंस्तदा एकेनैवेषुणा देवः स नो मृत्युर्भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: samāgatāni caitāni yo hanyādbhagavaṃstadā ekenaiveṣuṇā devaḥ sa no mṛtyurbhaviṣyati
verses.translation: They were filled with wells, tanks, large oblong lakes all round. Herds of elephants in their rut, splendid horses, chariots of every shape, wonderfully made with faces on all sides — all these abounded there. There were drinking sheds, assemblies, playgrounds, etc. Different kinds of halls and cham- bers for the study of the Vedas were found all round. The cities were well fortified and made unassailable even mentally by others, due to the illusionary power of Maya. O leading sages, the cities were frequented by chaste ladies everywhere. There were many Daityas. Although they committed great sins they got rid of them through their worship of Sankara. O brahmins, the leading Daityas were highly blessed. They were accom- panied by their wives and sons. They were conversant with the holy rites laid down in the Srutis and Smrtis. They were engaged in those virtuous rites always. They abandoned all lords other than Mahadeva and were engaged in the worship of that lord alone. They had broad chests and shoulders like those of bulls. They used to hold all weapons. They were always hungry. Their eyes shone like the forest fire. Some of them were quiescent; some were infuriated. Some were dwar- fish and some were hump-backed; they had the lustre of blue lotuses; their hairs were darkcoloured and curly. They re- sembled the blue mountain and the Meru; their voice was comparable to the sound of the rumbling cloud. All of them were protected by Maya. They were well-trained and were desirous of fighting. That trio of cities was well frequented by the firm and steadfast suppressors of Devas (i.e. Daityas) who were interested in fighting always and all round, who had perfectly achieved prowess and virility by the worship of Siva and who resembled the sun, wind and king of immortal beings.
verses.hindi: सूतजी बोले- है द्विजश्रेष्ठो! पृथ्वीपर जो भी शिवको प्रणाम करके त्रिपुरके शास्ता भगवान् शिवकी इस स्तुतिको सुनता अथवा पढ़ता है, वह भवभक्तिके द्वारा पापबन्धनसे मुक्त हो जाता है तब ब्रह्माके द्वारा भक्तिपूर्वक स्तुत हुए मन्दरशिखरवासी तथा महान् भुजाओंवाले शिवजी उस स्तुतिको सुनकर पार्वतीकी ओर देखकर महानुभाव ब्रह्मासे हँसते हुए कहने लगे-
verses.wordMeaning: They were filled with wells, tanks, large oblong lakes all round. Herds of elephants in their rut, splendid horses, chariots of every shape, wonderfully made with faces on all sides — all these abounded there. There were drinking sheds, assemblies, playgrounds, etc.…
verses.commentary: Sense: They were filled with wells, tanks, large oblong lakes all round. Herds of elephants in their rut, splendid horses, chariots of every shape, wonderfully made with faces on all sides — all these abounded there. There were drinking sheds, assemblies, playgrounds, etc.…

verses.sanskrit: एवमस्त्विति तान्देवः प्रत्युक्त्वा प्राविशद्दिवम् ततो मयः स्वतपसा चक्रे वीरः पुराण्यथ
verses.transliteration: evamastviti tāndevaḥ pratyuktvā prāviśaddivam tato mayaḥ svatapasā cakre vīraḥ purāṇyatha
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, thanks to the prowess of the Daityas, Dcvas including Indra were burned by the fire of the set of three cities like the trees consumed by the forest fire.
verses.hindi: शिवजी बोले-हे पद्मयोने! भक्तिपूर्वक को गयी आपकी इस स्तुतिसे मैं प्रसन्न हूँ.। आप यथेष्ट वर माँगिये; आपका तथा देवताओंका कल्याण हो
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent brahmins, thanks to the prowess of the Daityas, Dcvas including Indra were burned by the fire of the set of three cities like the trees consumed by the forest fire.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent brahmins, thanks to the prowess of the Daityas, Dcvas including Indra were burned by the fire of the set of three cities like the trees consumed by the forest fire.

verses.sanskrit: काञ्चनं दिवि तत्रासीद् अन्तरिक्षे च राजतम् आयसं चाभवद् भूमौ पुरं तेषां महात्मनाम्
verses.transliteration: kāñcanaṃ divi tatrāsīd antarikṣe ca rājatam āyasaṃ cābhavad bhūmau puraṃ teṣāṃ mahātmanām
verses.translation: Devas who were thus scorched saluted lord Visnu of unrivalled splendour and said to him.
verses.hindi: सूतजी बोले-तत्पश्चात् पद्मयोनि ब्रह्माजी देवेशको प्रणाम करके हाथ जोड़कर प्रसन्नचित्त होकर यह वचन कहने लगे- श्रीपितामह बोले-- है भगवन्! है देवदेवेश! हे ्रिपुरविनाशक! है शंकर! आपमें अपनी परम भक्ति चाहता हूँ। है परमेश्वर! अब प्रसन्न हो जाइये। सभी कामनाओंको पूर्ण करनेवाले है ईश्वर! आपमें सभी
verses.wordMeaning: Devas who were thus scorched saluted lord Visnu of unrivalled splendour and said to him.
verses.commentary: Sense: Devas who were thus scorched saluted lord Visnu of unrivalled splendour and said to him.

verses.sanskrit: एकैकं योजनशतं विस्तारायामतः समम् काञ्चनं तारकाक्षस्य कमलाक्षस्य राजतम्
verses.transliteration: ekaikaṃ yojanaśataṃ vistārāyāmataḥ samam kāñcanaṃ tārakākṣasya kamalākṣasya rājatam
verses.translation: The glorious lord, Narayana thought within his mind as to what should be done in the affairs of Devas. Janardana, whose form is sacrifice, who was himself the per- former of sacrifices, who was the partaker of the fruit of sacrifices and who is the lord and bestower of benefits unto those who perform sacrifices, remembered the sacrifice.
verses.hindi: भुवि देवं प्रणिपत्य वा पठेत्। स च मुञ्चति पापबन्धनं भवभक्त्या पुरशासितुः स्तवम्
verses.wordMeaning: The glorious lord, Narayana thought within his mind as to what should be done in the affairs of Devas. Janardana, whose form is sacrifice, who was himself the per- former of sacrifices,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The glorious lord, Narayana thought within his mind as to what should be done in the affairs of Devas. Janardana, whose form is sacrifice, who was himself the per- former of sacrifices,…

verses.sanskrit: विद्युन्मालेश्चायसं वै त्रिविधं दुर्गमुत्तमम् मयश् च बलवांस्तत्र दैत्यदानवपूजितः
verses.transliteration: vidyunmāleścāyasaṃ vai trividhaṃ durgamuttamam mayaś ca balavāṃstatra daityadānavapūjitaḥ
verses.translation: The sacrifice remembered by him for the achievement of the objects of Devas bowed down to that lord and eulogised him.
verses.hindi: वरान् वरय भ्रं ते देवानां च यथेप्सितान् ततः प्रणम्य देवेशं भगवान् पद्मसम्भवः । कृताञ्जलिपुटो भूत्वा प्राहेदं प्रीतमानसः
verses.wordMeaning: The sacrifice remembered by him for the achievement of the objects of Devas bowed down to that lord and eulogised him.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sacrifice remembered by him for the achievement of the objects of Devas bowed down to that lord and eulogised him.

verses.sanskrit: हैरण्ये राजते चैव कृष्णायसमये तथा आलयं चात्मनः कृत्वा तत्रास्ते बलवांस्तदा
verses.transliteration: hairaṇye rājate caiva kṛṣṇāyasamaye tathā ālayaṃ cātmanaḥ kṛtvā tatrāste balavāṃstadā
verses.translation: Seeing the smiling sacrifice, the eternal lord Visnu observed Devas including Indra and said; —
verses.hindi: भगवन् देवदेवेश त्रिपुरान्तक शङ्कर। त्वयि भक्ति परां मेऽद्य प्रसीद परमेश्वर
verses.wordMeaning: Seeing the smiling sacrifice, the eternal lord Visnu observed Devas including Indra and said; —
verses.commentary: Sense: Seeing the smiling sacrifice, the eternal lord Visnu observed Devas including Indra and said; —

verses.sanskrit: एवं बभूवुर्दैत्यानाम् अतिदुर्गाणि सुव्रताः पुराणि त्रीणि विप्रेन्द्रास् त्रैलोक्यमिव चापरम्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ babhūvurdaityānām atidurgāṇi suvratāḥ purāṇi trīṇi viprendrās trailokyamiva cāparam
verses.translation: For the destruction of the three cities and for the prosperity of the three worlds, O Devas, worship the lord with ths Upasad sacrifice.
verses.hindi: देवानां चैव सर्वेषां त्वयि सवार्थदेश्वर। प्रसीद भक्तियोगेन सारथ्येन च सर्वदा जनार्दनोऽपि भगवान्नमस्कृत्य महेश्वरम्। कृताञ्जलिपुटो भूत्वा प्राह साम्बं त्रियम्बकम्
verses.wordMeaning: For the destruction of the three cities and for the prosperity of the three worlds, O Devas, worship the lord with ths Upasad sacrifice.
verses.commentary: Sense: For the destruction of the three cities and for the prosperity of the three worlds, O Devas, worship the lord with ths Upasad sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit: पुरत्रये तदा जाते सर्वे दैत्या जगत्त्रये पुरत्रयं प्रविश्यैव बभूवुस्ते बलाधिकाः
verses.transliteration: puratraye tadā jāte sarve daityā jagattraye puratrayaṃ praviśyaiva babhūvuste balādhikāḥ
verses.translation: On hearing the words of the intelligent lord of Devas, Devas made great leonine roaring sound and eulogised the lord of sacrifices.
verses.hindi: त्वयि भक्ति च देवेश देवदेव नमोऽस्तु ते
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing the words of the intelligent lord of Devas, Devas made great leonine roaring sound and eulogised the lord of sacrifices.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the words of the intelligent lord of Devas, Devas made great leonine roaring sound and eulogised the lord of sacrifices.

verses.sanskrit: कल्पद्रुमसमाकीर्णं गजवाजिसमाकुलम् नानाप्रसादसंकीर्णं मणिजालैः समावृतम्
verses.transliteration: kalpadrumasamākīrṇaṃ gajavājisamākulam nānāprasādasaṃkīrṇaṃ maṇijālaiḥ samāvṛtam
verses.translation: Thereafter, lord Visnu himself thought once again. The lord of Devas again spoke to all Devas.
verses.hindi: सर्वज्ञत्वं च वरद सर्वगत्वं च शङ्कर तयोः श्रुत्वा महादेवो विज्ञप्तिं परमेश्वरः। सारथ्ये वाहनत्वे च कल्पयामास वै भवः
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, lord Visnu himself thought once again. The lord of Devas again spoke to all Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, lord Visnu himself thought once again. The lord of Devas again spoke to all Devas.

verses.sanskrit: सूर्यमण्डलसंकाशैर् विमानैर्विश्वतोमुखैः पद्मरागमयैः शुभ्रैः शोभितं चन्द्रसंनिभैः
verses.transliteration: sūryamaṇḍalasaṃkāśair vimānairviśvatomukhaiḥ padmarāgamayaiḥ śubhraiḥ śobhitaṃ candrasaṃnibhaiḥ
verses.translation: Even after killing and burning all living beings and even after enjoying pleasures without the basic justice, if one worships Mahadeva, one is undoubtedly sinless.
verses.hindi: दत्त्वा तस्मै ब्रह्मणे विष्णवे च
verses.wordMeaning: Even after killing and burning all living beings and even after enjoying pleasures without the basic justice, if one worships Mahadeva, one is undoubtedly sinless.
verses.commentary: Sense: Even after killing and burning all living beings and even after enjoying pleasures without the basic justice, if one worships Mahadeva, one is undoubtedly sinless.

verses.sanskrit: प्रासादैर्गोपुरैर्दिव्यैः कैलासशिखरोपमैः शोभितं त्रिपुरं तेषां पृथक्पृथगनुत्तमैः
verses.transliteration: prāsādairgopurairdivyaiḥ kailāsaśikharopamaiḥ śobhitaṃ tripuraṃ teṣāṃ pṛthakpṛthaganuttamaiḥ
verses.translation: There is no doubt that sinless persons should not be killed and only sinners should be killed assiduously. O excellent Devas, how could the wicked Asuras be killed by Devas al- though they are sinners and Devas are very strong? Hence they should not be killed due to the power of Rudra Paramesthin.
verses.hindi: दग्ध्वा हैत्यान् देवदेवो महात्मा। सार्धं देव्या नन्दिना भूतसङ्घै- रन्तर्धानं कारयामास शर्वः
verses.wordMeaning: There is no doubt that sinless persons should not be killed and only sinners should be killed assiduously. O excellent Devas,…
verses.commentary: Sense: There is no doubt that sinless persons should not be killed and only sinners should be killed assiduously. O excellent Devas,…

verses.sanskrit: दिव्यस्त्रीभिः सुसम्पूर्णं गन्धर्वैः सिद्धचारणैः रुद्रालयैः प्रतिगृहं साग्निहोत्रैर् द्विजोत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: divyastrībhiḥ susampūrṇaṃ gandharvaiḥ siddhacāraṇaiḥ rudrālayaiḥ pratigṛhaṃ sāgnihotrair dvijottamāḥ
verses.translation: Without the grace of the lord who am I? O Devas,
verses.hindi: सुरेश्वराः सुविस्मिता भवं प्रणम्य पार्वतीम्
verses.wordMeaning: Without the grace of the lord who am I? O Devas,
verses.commentary: Sense: Without the grace of the lord who am I? O Devas,

verses.sanskrit: वापीकूपतडागैश् च दीर्घिकाभिस्तु सर्वतः मत्तमातङ्गयूथैश् च तुरङ्गैश् च सुशोभनैः
verses.transliteration: vāpīkūpataḍāgaiś ca dīrghikābhistu sarvataḥ mattamātaṅgayūthaiś ca turaṅgaiś ca suśobhanaiḥ
verses.translation: He is the lord, greater than the greatest. He is per- petual; he is the twentyseventh principle who is worthy of being saluted, who is the lord of all the immortal beings in the universe and who is Mahesvara the support of the universe.
verses.hindi: सुरेश्वरा मुनीश्वरा गणेश्वराश्च भास्करा: त्रिपुरारेरिमं पुण्यं निर्मितं ब्रह्मणा पुरा। यः पठेच्छ्राद्धकाले वा हैवे कर्मणि च द्विजा:
verses.wordMeaning: He is the lord, greater than the greatest. He is per- petual; he is the twentyseventh principle who is worthy of being saluted, who is the lord of all the immortal beings in the universe and who is Mahesvara the support of the universe.
verses.commentary: Sense: He is the lord, greater than the greatest. He is per- petual; he is the twentyseventh principle who is worthy of being saluted, who is the lord of all the immortal beings in the universe and who is Mahesvara the support of the universe.

verses.sanskrit: रथैश् च विविधाकारैर् विचित्रैर्विश्वतोमुखैः सभाप्रपादिभिश् चैव क्रीडास्थानैः पृथक् पृथक्
verses.transliteration: rathaiś ca vividhākārair vicitrairviśvatomukhaiḥ sabhāprapādibhiś caiva krīḍāsthānaiḥ pṛthak pṛthak
verses.translation: He alone is the lord of all Devas. He is the benefactor of all. He has made a distinction between Devas and Daityas sportingly.
verses.hindi: श्रावयेद्वा द्विजान् भक्त्या ब्रह्मलोकं स गच्छति। मानसैर्वाचिकैः पापैस्तथा वै कायिकैः पुनः
verses.wordMeaning: He alone is the lord of all Devas. He is the benefactor of all. He has made a distinction between Devas and Daityas sportingly.
verses.commentary: Sense: He alone is the lord of all Devas. He is the benefactor of all. He has made a distinction between Devas and Daityas sportingly.

verses.sanskrit: वेदाध्ययनशालाभिर् विविधाभिः समन्ततः अधृष्यं मनसाप्यन्यैर् मयस्यैव च मायया
verses.transliteration: vedādhyayanaśālābhir vividhābhiḥ samantataḥ adhṛṣyaṃ manasāpyanyair mayasyaiva ca māyayā
verses.translation: It is by worshipping a part of his® that Devas attained immortality; Brahma attained his status as Brahma and I attained my status as Visnu.
verses.hindi: पापैश्च मुच्यते जन्तुः श्रुत्वाध्यायमिमं शुभम्। शत्रवो नाशमायान्ति सङ्ग्रामे विजयी भवेत् भगवान् विष्णुने भी पार्वतीसहित नेत्र शि
verses.wordMeaning: It is by worshipping a part of his® that Devas attained immortality; Brahma attained his status as Brahma and I attained my status as Visnu.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is by worshipping a part of his® that Devas attained immortality; Brahma attained his status as Brahma and I attained my status as Visnu.

verses.sanskrit: पतिव्रताभिः सर्वत्र सेवितं मुनिपुङ्गवाः कृत्वापि सुमहत् पापम् अपापैः शङ्करार्चनात्
verses.transliteration: pativratābhiḥ sarvatra sevitaṃ munipuṅgavāḥ kṛtvāpi sumahat pāpam apāpaiḥ śaṅkarārcanāt
verses.translation: Without worshipping him, which man attains per- fcclion in this world? Thanks to the worship of Lihga, they could be killed by him alone.
verses.hindi: प्रणाम करके हाथ जोड़कर उनसे कहा--'हे ईशान। मैं वृषभ आदि रूपसे सदा आपका वाहन होनेकी अभिलाषा करता हूँ और है देवेश! आपमें  अपनी भक्ति चाहता हूँ। है देवदेव! आपको नमस्कार है। हे
verses.wordMeaning: Without worshipping him, which man attains per- fcclion in this world? Thanks to the worship of Lihga, they could be killed by him alone.
verses.commentary: Sense: Without worshipping him, which man attains per- fcclion in this world? Thanks to the worship of Lihga, they could be killed by him alone.

verses.sanskrit: दैत्येश्वरैर्महाभागैः सदारैः ससुतैर्द्विजाः श्रौतस्मार्तार्थधर्मज्ञैस् तद्धर्मनिरतैः सदा
verses.transliteration: daityeśvarairmahābhāgaiḥ sadāraiḥ sasutairdvijāḥ śrautasmārtārthadharmajñais taddharmanirataiḥ sadā
verses.translation: Moreover, all of them abide by their Dharmas. They adhere to the injunctions of Sruti and Smrti. Still we shall worship Rudra by performing the rite of Upasad pertain- ing to that lord and become victorious over the excellent Daityas. Excepting the sole lord, the three-eyed deity, who else is competent to destroy the Tripuras? They are well protected by Maya along with Tarakaksa. They have the sole lustre of crystals and they are well stationed in themselves.
verses.hindi: वरद! है शंकर! आप ईश्वरको सदा वहन करनेका सामर्थ्य, सर्वज्ञत्व तथा सर्वत्र गमन करनेकी शक्ति मुझे प्रदान कीजिये॥ १७३--१७५ ॥ सूतजी बोले--उन दोनोंकी प्रार्थना सुनकर महादेव परमेश्वर शिवने उन्हें सारथि तथा वाहन होनेका वर प्रदान किया
verses.wordMeaning: Moreover, all of them abide by their Dharmas. They adhere to the injunctions of Sruti and Smrti. Still we shall worship Rudra by performing the rite of Upasad pertain- ing to that lord and become victorious over the excellent Daityas. Excepting the sole lord,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Moreover, all of them abide by their Dharmas. They adhere to the injunctions of Sruti and Smrti. Still we shall worship Rudra by performing the rite of Upasad pertain- ing to that lord and become victorious over the excellent Daityas. Excepting the sole lord,…

verses.sanskrit: महादेवेतरं त्यक्त्वा देवं तस्यार्चने स्थितैः व्यूढोरस्कैर् वृषस्कन्धैः सर्वायुधधरैः सदा
verses.transliteration: mahādevetaraṃ tyaktvā devaṃ tasyārcane sthitaiḥ vyūḍhoraskair vṛṣaskandhaiḥ sarvāyudhadharaiḥ sadā
verses.translation: After saying this Visnu performed the worship of the lord by means of Upasad sacrifice. Sitting there he saw thou- sands of goblins.
verses.hindi: इस प्रकार हैत्योंको दग्ध करके और उन ब्रह्मा तथा विष्णुको वर प्रदान करके देवदेव महात्मा शिव देवी पार्वती, नन्दी तथा भूतगणोंसहित अन्तर्धान हो गये
verses.wordMeaning: After saying this Visnu performed the worship of the lord by means of Upasad sacrifice. Sitting there he saw thou- sands of goblins.
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying this Visnu performed the worship of the lord by means of Upasad sacrifice. Sitting there he saw thou- sands of goblins.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वदा क्षुधितैश्चैव दावाग्निसदृशेक्षणैः प्रशान्तैः कुपितैश्चैव कुब्जैर् वामनकैस् तथा
verses.transliteration: sarvadā kṣudhitaiścaiva dāvāgnisadṛśekṣaṇaiḥ praśāntaiḥ kupitaiścaiva kubjair vāmanakais tathā
verses.translation: They were armed with spears, javelins and iron clubs. They had various weapons; they were in various guises. They resembled Rudra fierce as the fire at the time of dissolu- tion; they were comparable to Rudra the destroyer. They bowed to him and halted. Lord Visnu then spoke to them.
verses.hindi: इसके बाद युद्धभूमिसे गणोंसहित शिवके चले जानेपर श्रेष्ठ देवतालोग अतिविस्मित हुए। है मुनीश्वरो! शिव तथा पार्वतीको प्रणाम करके दुःखरहित होकर सुरेश्वर, गणेश्वर तथा आदित्यगण अपने-अपने वाहनोंसे हे द्विजो! जो व्यक्ति पूर्वकालमें ब्रह्माके द्वारा निर्मित किये गये त्रिपुरशत्रु शिव-के इस पवित्र स्तोत्रको श्राद्धके समय अथवा देवकार्यमें भक्तिपूर्वक पढ़ता है अथवा द्विजोंको सुनाता है, वह ब्रह्मलोकको जाता
verses.wordMeaning: They were armed with spears, javelins and iron clubs. They had various weapons; they were in various guises. They resembled Rudra fierce as the fire at the time of dissolu- tion; they were comparable to Rudra the destroyer. They bowed to him and halted.…
verses.commentary: Sense: They were armed with spears, javelins and iron clubs. They had various weapons; they were in various guises. They resembled Rudra fierce as the fire at the time of dissolu- tion; they were comparable to Rudra the destroyer. They bowed to him and halted.…

verses.sanskrit: नीलोत्पलदलप्रख्यैर् नीलकुञ्चितमूर्धजैः नीलाद्रिमेरुसंकाशैर् नीरदोपमनिःस्वनैः मयेन रक्षितैः सर्वैः शिक्षितैर्युद्धलालसैः
verses.transliteration: nīlotpaladalaprakhyair nīlakuñcitamūrdhajaiḥ nīlādrimerusaṃkāśair nīradopamaniḥsvanaiḥ mayena rakṣitaiḥ sarvaiḥ śikṣitairyuddhalālasaiḥ
verses.translation: "O heroic ones, go to the three cities of Daityas, burn them, split them and swallow them. Then return to the surface of the earth in the manner you had gone."
verses.hindi: है। है द्विजश्रेष्ठो! इस शुभ अध्यायको सुनकर प्राणी मानसिक, वाचिक तथा शारीरिक पापोंसे; स्थूल, सूक्ष्म तथा अतिसूक्ष्म पापोंसे; घोर अपराधसे होनेवाले पापोंसे तथा अल्प अपराधसे होनेवाले पापोंसे मुक्त हो जाता है;
verses.wordMeaning: "O heroic ones, go to the three cities of Daityas, burn them, split them and swallow them. Then return to the surface of the earth in the manner you had gone."
verses.commentary: Sense: "O heroic ones, go to the three cities of Daityas, burn them, split them and swallow them. Then return to the surface of the earth in the manner you had gone."

verses.sanskrit: अथ समररतैः सदा समन्ताच् छिवपदपूजनया सुलब्धवीर्यैः रविमरुदमरेन्द्रसंनिकाशैः सुरमथनैः सुदृढैः सुसेवितं तत्
verses.transliteration: atha samararataiḥ sadā samantāc chivapadapūjanayā sulabdhavīryaiḥ ravimarudamarendrasaṃnikāśaiḥ suramathanaiḥ sudṛḍhaiḥ susevitaṃ tat
verses.translation: Thereafter, the groups of goblins bowed down to the lord of Devas and entered the three cities. Like the moths in fire, they became destroyed.
verses.hindi: उसके शत्रु नष्ट हो जाते हैं, वह संग्राममें विजयी होता है, सभी रोग उसे बाधा नहीं पहुँचाते, आपदाएँ उसे स्पर्शतक नहीं करतीं और वह धन-आयु-यश-विदया तथा धनमायुर्यशो विद्यां प्रभावमतुलं लभेत्॥ १८४  अतुलनीय प्रभाव प्राप्त करता है॥ १८०--१५४॥
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, the groups of goblins bowed down to the lord of Devas and entered the three cities. Like the moths in fire, they became destroyed.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, the groups of goblins bowed down to the lord of Devas and entered the three cities. Like the moths in fire, they became destroyed.

verses.sanskrit: सेन्द्रा देवा द्विजश्रेष्ठा द्रुमा दावाग्निना यथा पुरत्रयाग्निना दग्धा ह्य् अभवन् दैत्यवैभवात्
verses.transliteration: sendrā devā dvijaśreṣṭhā drumā dāvāgninā yathā puratrayāgninā dagdhā hy abhavan daityavaibhavāt
verses.translation: "What is to be done?" After thinking thus he became distressed as he looked at the distresed Devas inclu- ding Indra. After a while he thought again "How shall I des- troy the army of Daityas assiduously and carryout the tasks of Devas without the grace of the supreme lord. If one ponders over it, there is no doubt about this that those who are virtuous have no sin at all.
verses.hindi: अध्याय ७३ लिङ्गार्चनकी विधि तथा उसकी महिमा Rt
verses.wordMeaning: "What is to be done?" After thinking thus he became distressed as he looked at the distresed Devas inclu- ding Indra. After a while he thought again "How shall I des- troy the army of Daityas assiduously and carryout the tasks of Devas without the grace of the supreme lord.…
verses.commentary: Sense: "What is to be done?" After thinking thus he became distressed as he looked at the distresed Devas inclu- ding Indra. After a while he thought again "How shall I des- troy the army of Daityas assiduously and carryout the tasks of Devas without the grace of the supreme lord.…

verses.sanskrit: अथैवं ते तदा दग्धा देवा देवेश्वरं हरिम् अभिवन्द्य तदा प्राहुस् तमप्रतिमवर्चसम्
verses.transliteration: athaivaṃ te tadā dagdhā devā deveśvaraṃ harim abhivandya tadā prāhus tamapratimavarcasam
verses.translation: Hence, know that the Daityas cannot be killed by those Bhutas originating from the Upasad sacrifice. They dis- pel sin by means ofDharma. Everything is founded onDharma. The eternal Sruti says that prosperity originates from Dharma. All these Daityas, the residents of the three cities, are virtuous. Hence, O leading brahmins, they have attained immortality and not otherwise. Even after committing a very great sin, people are liberated from all the sins if they worship Rudra. They are not affected by sins like the lotus leaves which are not affected by water. O brahmins, the achievement of worldly pleasures definitely takes place through his worship. Hence, those Daityas who are devoted to the worship of the Linga do enjoy worldly pleasures. Hence, O Devas, for your purpose I shall create obstacles in the holy rites of Daityas by means of my Maya and so shall conquer the three cities instantaneously"
verses.hindi: लिङ्गार्चनकी विधि तथा उसकी महिमा गाते महेश्वरे देवे दग्ध्वा च त्रिपुरं क्षणात्। सदस्याह सुरेन्द्राणां भगवान् पदासम्भवः
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, know that the Daityas cannot be killed by those Bhutas originating from the Upasad sacrifice. They dis- pel sin by means ofDharma. Everything is founded onDharma. The eternal Sruti says that prosperity originates from Dharma. All these Daityas,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, know that the Daityas cannot be killed by those Bhutas originating from the Upasad sacrifice. They dis- pel sin by means ofDharma. Everything is founded onDharma. The eternal Sruti says that prosperity originates from Dharma. All these Daityas,…

verses.sanskrit: सो ऽपि नारायणः श्रीमान् चिन्तयामास चेतसा किं कार्यं देवकार्येषु भगवानिति स प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: so 'pi nārāyaṇaḥ śrīmān cintayāmāsa cetasā kiṃ kāryaṃ devakāryeṣu bhagavāniti sa prabhuḥ
verses.translation: After thinking thus, the lord Visnu decided to bring about impediments in the holy rituals of asuras.
verses.hindi: सन्त्यज्य देवदेवेशं लिङ्गमूर्ति महेश्वरम्। तारपौत्रो महातेजास्तारकस्य सुतो बली
verses.wordMeaning: After thinking thus, the lord Visnu decided to bring about impediments in the holy rituals of asuras.
verses.commentary: Sense: After thinking thus, the lord Visnu decided to bring about impediments in the holy rituals of asuras.

verses.sanskrit: तदा सस्मार वै यज्ञं यज्ञमूर्तिर्जनार्दनः यज्वा यज्ञभुगीशानो यज्वनां फलदः प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: tadā sasmāra vai yajñaṃ yajñamūrtirjanārdanaḥ yajvā yajñabhugīśāno yajvanāṃ phaladaḥ prabhuḥ
verses.translation: Visnu of great splendour, wielding Maya generated an illusory Purusa®® born of himself to create obstacles to the holy rites of Daityas.
verses.hindi: तारकाक्षोऽपि दितिजः कमलाक्षश्च वीर्यवान्। विद्युन्माली च हैत्येशः अन्ये चापि सबान्धवाः त्यक्त्वा देवं महादेवं मायया च हरेः प्रभोः।
verses.wordMeaning: Visnu of great splendour, wielding Maya generated an illusory Purusa®® born of himself to create obstacles to the holy rites of Daityas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Visnu of great splendour, wielding Maya generated an illusory Purusa®® born of himself to create obstacles to the holy rites of Daityas.

verses.sanskrit: ततो यज्ञः स्मृतस्तेन देवकार्यार्थसिद्धये देवं ते पुरुषं चैव प्रणेमुस्तुष्टुवुस्तदा
verses.transliteration: tato yajñaḥ smṛtastena devakāryārthasiddhaye devaṃ te puruṣaṃ caiva praṇemustuṣṭuvustadā
verses.translation: Visnu the ruler of all, the person who could assume any form he liked, the wielder of Maya, evolved a holy treatise that could fascinate everyone and that had within its basic principles the belief in what is seen.
verses.hindi: तस्मात्सदा पूजनीयो लिङ्गमूर्तिः सदाशिवः। यावत्पूजा सुरेशानां तावदेव स्थितिर्यतः
verses.wordMeaning: Visnu the ruler of all, the person who could assume any form he liked, the wielder of Maya, evolved a holy treatise that could fascinate everyone and that had within its basic principles the belief in what is seen.
verses.commentary: Sense: Visnu the ruler of all, the person who could assume any form he liked, the wielder of Maya, evolved a holy treatise that could fascinate everyone and that had within its basic principles the belief in what is seen.

verses.sanskrit: भगवानपि तं दृष्ट्वा यज्ञं प्राह सनातनम् सनातनस्तदा सेन्द्रान् देवान् आलोक्य चाच्युतः
verses.transliteration: bhagavānapi taṃ dṛṣṭvā yajñaṃ prāha sanātanam sanātanastadā sendrān devān ālokya cācyutaḥ
verses.translation: This sacred treatise contained one million six hundred thousand verses. Lord Visnu taught this scripture to the Purusa born of his own limbs.
verses.hindi: पूजनीयः शिवो नित्यं श्रद्धया देवपुङ्गवैः। सर्वलिङ्गमयो लोकः सर्व लिङ्गे प्रतिष्ठितम्॥ तस्मात् सम्पूजयेल्लिङ्गं य इच्छेत्सिद्धिमात्मनः। सर्वे लिङ्गार्चनादेव देवा हैत्याश्च दानवाः सूतजी बोले-हे ऋषियो! क्षणभरमें त्रिपुरको देव महेश्वरके चले जानेपर भगवान् पद्मयोनि (ब्रह्मा)-ने श्रेष्ठ देवताओंकी सभामें इस प्रकार कहा-
verses.wordMeaning: This sacred treatise contained one million six hundred thousand verses. Lord Visnu taught this scripture to the Purusa born of his own limbs.
verses.commentary: Sense: This sacred treatise contained one million six hundred thousand verses. Lord Visnu taught this scripture to the Purusa born of his own limbs.

verses.sanskrit: अनेनोपसदा देवा यजध्वं परमेश्वरम् पुरत्रयविनाशाय जगत्त्रयविभूतये
verses.transliteration: anenopasadā devā yajadhvaṃ parameśvaram puratrayavināśāya jagattrayavibhūtaye
verses.translation: It was against those treatises that followed the Srutis and the Smrtis. It was devoid of the discipline pertain- ing to the four castes and four stages of life. It was taught in it that heaven and hell are here itself.®® There was no belief otherwise. Visnu himself taught this scripture to that Purusa. For the destruction of the three cities he said to that Purusa:
verses.hindi: पितामह बोले-लिङ्गमूर्ति देवदेवेश महेश्वरको उपेक्षा करके दितिसे उत्पन्न महातेजस्वी तारकपौत्र और तारकका बलवान् पुत्र तारकाक्ष, पराक्रमी कमलाक्ष, हैत्यराज विद्युन्माली तथा अन्य राक्षस भी अपने
verses.wordMeaning: It was against those treatises that followed the Srutis and the Smrtis. It was devoid of the discipline pertain- ing to the four castes and four stages of life. It was taught in it that heaven and hell are here itself.®® There was no belief otherwise.…
verses.commentary: Sense: It was against those treatises that followed the Srutis and the Smrtis. It was devoid of the discipline pertain- ing to the four castes and four stages of life. It was taught in it that heaven and hell are here itself.®® There was no belief otherwise.…

verses.sanskrit: अथ तस्य वचः श्रुत्वा देवदेवस्य धीमतः सिंहनादं महत्कृत्वा यज्ञेशं तुष्टुवुः सुराः
verses.transliteration: atha tasya vacaḥ śrutvā devadevasya dhīmataḥ siṃhanādaṃ mahatkṛtvā yajñeśaṃ tuṣṭuvuḥ surāḥ
verses.translation: 'O, undoubtedly it behoves you to go there for the quick destruction of the residents of the three cities. May their Dharmas in pursuit of the Srutis and Smrtis be destroyed."
verses.hindi: बन्धुओंसहित मारे गये। इस प्रकार प्रभु श्रीहरिकी मायासे भगवान् महादेवका त्याग करके वे सब अपने पुरों तथा नागरिकोंसहित विनष्ट तथा ध्वस्त हो गये अतः लिङ्गमूर्ति सदाशिवकी सर्वदा पूजा करनी चाहिए । जबतक उनकी पूजा होगी, तभीतक देवताओंको स्थिति बनी रहेगी, अतः श्रेष्ठ देवताओंको नित्य श्रद्धापूर्वक शिवका पूजन करना चाहिए। समस्त जगत्
verses.wordMeaning: 'O, undoubtedly it behoves you to go there for the quick destruction of the residents of the three cities. May their Dharmas in pursuit of the Srutis and Smrtis be destroyed."
verses.commentary: Sense: 'O, undoubtedly it behoves you to go there for the quick destruction of the residents of the three cities. May their Dharmas in pursuit of the Srutis and Smrtis be destroyed."

verses.sanskrit: ततः संचिन्त्य भगवान् स्वयमेव जनार्दनः पुनः प्राह स सर्वांस्तांस् त्रिदशांस्त्रिदशेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ saṃcintya bhagavān svayameva janārdanaḥ punaḥ prāha sa sarvāṃstāṃs tridaśāṃstridaśeśvaraḥ
verses.translation: The wielder of Maya®®, the expert in the deceptive scripture, bowed to him. After entering those cities the sage immediately created his Maya.
verses.hindi: लिङ्गमय है, सब कुछ लिङ्गमें प्रतिष्ठित है, अतः जो आत्मसिद्धि चाहता है, उसे शिव लिङ्गकी विधिवत् पूजा करनी चाहिए॥ ५-६ /२॥
verses.wordMeaning: The wielder of Maya®®, the expert in the deceptive scripture, bowed to him. After entering those cities the sage immediately created his Maya.
verses.commentary: Sense: The wielder of Maya®®, the expert in the deceptive scripture, bowed to him. After entering those cities the sage immediately created his Maya.

verses.sanskrit: हत्वा दग्ध्वा च भूतानि भुक्त्वा चान्यायतो ऽपि वा यजेद्यदि महादेवम् अपापो नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: hatvā dagdhvā ca bhūtāni bhuktvā cānyāyato 'pi vā yajedyadi mahādevam apāpo nātra saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: On account of his Maya, those Daityas who were the residents of the three cities, eschewed their holy rites based on the Srutis and Smrtis and became his disciples.
verses.hindi: सभी देवता, हैत्य तथा दानव लिङ्गार्चनसे ही प्रतिष्ठित हैं। यक्ष, विद्याधर, सिद्धगण, मांसभक्षी राक्षस, पितर, मुनि, पिशाच, किन्नर आदि लिङ्गमूर्तिका अर्चन करके सिद्धिको प्राप्त हुए हैं; इसमें सन्देह नहीं अत: है देवताओ! जिस किसी भी प्रकारसे नित्य लिङ्गकी पूजा करनी चाहिए। हम लोग उन बुद्धिमान् देवाधिदेवके पशु हैं। अतः पाशुपत व्रत करके पशुत्वका त्याग करके लिङ्गमूर्ति सनातन महादेवको पूजा करनी
verses.wordMeaning: On account of his Maya, those Daityas who were the residents of the three cities, eschewed their holy rites based on the Srutis and Smrtis and became his disciples.
verses.commentary: Sense: On account of his Maya, those Daityas who were the residents of the three cities, eschewed their holy rites based on the Srutis and Smrtis and became his disciples.

verses.sanskrit: अपापा नैव हन्तव्याः पापा एव न संशयः हन्तव्याः सर्वयत्नेन कथं वध्याः सुरोत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: apāpā naiva hantavyāḥ pāpā eva na saṃśayaḥ hantavyāḥ sarvayatnena kathaṃ vadhyāḥ surottamāḥ
verses.translation: They left off Sankara, Mahadeva, the great Ivara.
verses.hindi: चाहिए। है श्रेष्ठ देवताओ! पाँच प्रणवयुक्त पाँच प्राणायामोंके द्वारा पंचभूतोंका शोधन करके; हे
verses.wordMeaning: They left off Sankara, Mahadeva, the great Ivara.
verses.commentary: Sense: They left off Sankara, Mahadeva, the great Ivara.

verses.sanskrit: असुरा दुर्मदाः पापा अपि देवैर्महाबलैः तस्मान्न वध्या रुद्रस्य प्रभावात् परमेष्ठिनः
verses.transliteration: asurā durmadāḥ pāpā api devairmahābalaiḥ tasmānna vadhyā rudrasya prabhāvāt parameṣṭhinaḥ
verses.translation: According to the present context Visnu created a delusive teacher called Mayamoha who created a Mayaiiastra of sixteen lakhs of verses preaching a-dharma for misguiding the Asuras. Mayamoha created disciples for the propagation of a~dharma» He preached non-violence, forbade lrauta and Smarta rituals, discarded Varnasrama system, created an order for women that resulted in leaving their home and leading the life of nuns. In some versions, the role is assigned to Brhaspati, the preceptor of Gods who in the guise of the preceptor Sukra deludes the Asuras. For detail, see Mayamoha prakarana in Padma Vxnu, Matsya and Siva puraas.
verses.hindi: उसी प्रकारके तीन प्रणवोंके साथ तीन प्राणायामोंद्वारा, अर्चयित्वा लिङ्गमूर्ति संसिद्धा नात्र संशयः। तस्माल्लिङ्गं यजेन्नित्यं येन केनापि वा सुराः
verses.wordMeaning: According to the present context Visnu created a delusive teacher called Mayamoha who created a Mayaiiastra of sixteen lakhs of verses preaching a-dharma for misguiding the Asuras. Mayamoha created disciples for the propagation of a~dharma» He preached non-violence,…
verses.commentary: Sense: According to the present context Visnu created a delusive teacher called Mayamoha who created a Mayaiiastra of sixteen lakhs of verses preaching a-dharma for misguiding the Asuras. Mayamoha created disciples for the propagation of a~dharma» He preached non-violence,…

verses.sanskrit: को ऽहं ब्रह्माथवा देवा दैत्या देवारिसूदनाः मुनयश् च महात्मानः प्रसादेन विना प्रभोः
verses.transliteration: ko 'haṃ brahmāthavā devā daityā devārisūdanāḥ munayaś ca mahātmānaḥ prasādena vinā prabhoḥ
verses.translation: This is not clear which text is meant.
verses.hindi: पशवश्च वयं तस्य देवदेवस्य धीमतः। पशुत्वं च परित्यज्य कृत्वा पाशुपतं ततः
verses.wordMeaning: This is not clear which text is meant.
verses.commentary: Sense: This is not clear which text is meant.

verses.sanskrit: यः सप्तविंशको नित्यः परात्परतरः प्रभुः विश्वामरेश्वरो वन्द्यो विश्वाधारो महेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: yaḥ saptaviṃśako nityaḥ parātparataraḥ prabhuḥ viśvāmareśvaro vandyo viśvādhāro maheśvaraḥ
verses.translation: On the heretic doctrines compare:
verses.hindi: पूजनीयो महादेवो लिङ्गमूर्तिः सनातन: । त्रिभिश्च प्रणवैर्देवा: प्राणायामैस्तथाविधैः।
verses.wordMeaning: On the heretic doctrines compare:
verses.commentary: Sense: On the heretic doctrines compare:

verses.sanskrit: स एव सर्वदेवेशः सर्वेषामपि शङ्करः लीलया देवदैत्येन्द्रविभागमकरोद्धरः
verses.transliteration: sa eva sarvadeveśaḥ sarveṣāmapi śaṅkaraḥ līlayā devadaityendravibhāgamakaroddharaḥ
verses.translation: He ordained rules of conduct for women that would give them the benefit of licentious activities. They followed those rules and achieved the result immediately. These women began to censure the ladies faithful to their husbands and themselves became enamoured of other people. Even today in the Kali age, base women give due honour to the sage Narada®', abandon their husbands and move about unfettered. Really it is the husband who is mother, father, kinsman, comrade, friend and relative unto the women. There is no doubt about this. Still he said thus through his Maya. Really the woman who has love towards her husband shall attain the greatest heaven even after committing a great sin. She who does contrary to this attains hell. O leading sages, formerly, chaste ladies forsook all Dharmas, all Devas and other pre- ceptors of the universe and worshipped their husbands always. After attaining the heavenly world they became free from ailments and rejoiced. But those who were the followers of Maya attained hell. Hence, it is the husband who is the greatest goal.
verses.hindi: ततश्चोङ्कारमुच्चार्य प्राणापानौ नियम्य च।
verses.wordMeaning: He ordained rules of conduct for women that would give them the benefit of licentious activities. They followed those rules and achieved the result immediately. These women began to censure the ladies faithful to their husbands and themselves became enamoured of other people.…
verses.commentary: Sense: He ordained rules of conduct for women that would give them the benefit of licentious activities. They followed those rules and achieved the result immediately. These women began to censure the ladies faithful to their husbands and themselves became enamoured of other people.…

verses.sanskrit: तस्यांशम् एकं सम्पूज्य देवा देवत्वम् आगताः ब्रह्मा ब्रह्मत्वम् आपन्नो ह्य् अहं विष्णुत्वमेव च
verses.transliteration: tasyāṃśam ekaṃ sampūjya devā devatvam āgatāḥ brahmā brahmatvam āpanno hy ahaṃ viṣṇutvameva ca
verses.translation: Yet on account of the Maya of the lord of Devas and at the behest of lord Visnu, the women abandoned their husbands and became self-willed and unrestrained in their conducts. Misfortune went to the three cities at the behest of that lord himself. The glory and prosperity that they had obtained from Brahma, the unborn lord, the lord of Devas, abandoned them and went out of the cities.
verses.hindi: गुणत्रयं चतुर्धाख्यमहङ्कारै च सुत्रता: । तन्मात्राणि च भूतानि तथा बुद्धीन्द्रियाणि च कर्मेन्द्रियाणि संशोध्य पुरुषं युगलं तथा। चिदात्मानं तनुं कृत्वा चाग्निर्भस्मेति संस्पृशेत्
verses.wordMeaning: Yet on account of the Maya of the lord of Devas and at the behest of lord Visnu, the women abandoned their husbands and became self-willed and unrestrained in their conducts. Misfortune went to the three cities at the behest of that lord himself.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Yet on account of the Maya of the lord of Devas and at the behest of lord Visnu, the women abandoned their husbands and became self-willed and unrestrained in their conducts. Misfortune went to the three cities at the behest of that lord himself.…

verses.sanskrit: तम् अपूज्य जगत्यस्मिन् कः पुमान् सिद्धिमिच्छति तस्मात्तेनैव हन्तव्या लिङ्गार्चनविधेर् बलात्
verses.transliteration: tam apūjya jagatyasmin kaḥ pumān siddhimicchati tasmāttenaiva hantavyā liṅgārcanavidher balāt
verses.translation: The lord thus preached delusion of the intellect as evolved by the Maya of Visnu. The Purusa deluded the Daityas and Narada the wielder of Maya deluded the ladies. In order to create obstacles in Dharmas these two were com- fortably seated there. They were unexcited and unchanging,
verses.hindi: भवेन पाशमोक्षार्थं कथितं देवसत्तमाः
verses.wordMeaning: The lord thus preached delusion of the intellect as evolved by the Maya of Visnu. The Purusa deluded the Daityas and Narada the wielder of Maya deluded the ladies. In order to create obstacles in Dharmas these two were com- fortably seated there.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The lord thus preached delusion of the intellect as evolved by the Maya of Visnu. The Purusa deluded the Daityas and Narada the wielder of Maya deluded the ladies. In order to create obstacles in Dharmas these two were com- fortably seated there.…

verses.sanskrit: धर्मनिष्ठाश् च ते सर्वे श्रौतस्मार्तविधौ स्थिताः तथापि यजमानेन रौद्रेणोपसदा प्रभुम् रुद्रमिष्ट्वा यथान्यायं जेष्यामो दैत्यसत्तमान्
verses.transliteration: dharmaniṣṭhāś ca te sarve śrautasmārtavidhau sthitāḥ tathāpi yajamānena raudreṇopasadā prabhum rudramiṣṭvā yathānyāyaṃ jeṣyāmo daityasattamān
verses.translation: The preaching in regard to sexual freedom is attributed to N&rada, the disciple of Mayamoha.
verses.hindi: लिङ्गे पुरा मया दृष्टे विष्णुना च महात्मना पशवो नैव जायन्ते वर्षमात्रेण देवता: । अस्माभिः सर्वकार्याणां देवमभ्यर्च्य यत्नतः
verses.wordMeaning: The preaching in regard to sexual freedom is attributed to N&rada, the disciple of Mayamoha.
verses.commentary: Sense: The preaching in regard to sexual freedom is attributed to N&rada, the disciple of Mayamoha.

verses.sanskrit: सतारकाक्षेण मयेन गुप्तं स्वस्थं च गुप्तं स्फटिकाभमेकम् को नाम हन्तुं त्रिपुरं समर्थो मुक्त्वा त्रिनेत्रं भगवन्तमेकम्
verses.transliteration: satārakākṣeṇa mayena guptaṃ svasthaṃ ca guptaṃ sphaṭikābhamekam ko nāma hantuṃ tripuraṃ samartho muktvā trinetraṃ bhagavantamekam
verses.translation: After eulogising the great lord and after bowing down like a long staff', the lord Visnu stationed himself in water and performed the japa of the Rudra Mantra ten million times. All Devas including Indra, Sadhyas, Yama, Rudras and Maruts eulogised lord Siva.
verses.hindi: बाह्ये चाभ्यन्तरे चैव मन्ये कर्तव्यमीश्वरम्। प्रतिज्ञा मम विष्णोश्च दिव्यैषा सुरसत्तमाः
verses.wordMeaning: After eulogising the great lord and after bowing down like a long staff', the lord Visnu stationed himself in water and performed the japa of the Rudra Mantra ten million times. All Devas including Indra, Sadhyas, Yama, Rudras and Maruts eulogised lord Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: After eulogising the great lord and after bowing down like a long staff', the lord Visnu stationed himself in water and performed the japa of the Rudra Mantra ten million times. All Devas including Indra, Sadhyas, Yama, Rudras and Maruts eulogised lord Siva.

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्त्वा हरिश्चेष्ट्वा यज्ञेनोपसदा प्रभुम् उपविष्टो ददर्शाथ भूतसंघान्सहस्रशः
verses.transliteration: evamuktvā hariśceṣṭvā yajñenopasadā prabhum upaviṣṭo dadarśātha bhūtasaṃghānsahasraśaḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to you the Atman of all; obeisance to Sankara the dispeller of affliction, to Rudra, to Nila Rudra, to Kadrudra and to Pracetas.
verses.hindi: यत्क्षणं वा मुहूर्त वा शिवमेकं न चिन्तयेत्। भवभक्तिपरा ये च भवप्रणतचेतसः धनं वा तुष्टिपर्यन्तं शिवपूजाविधेः फलम्।
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to you the Atman of all; obeisance to Sankara the dispeller of affliction, to Rudra, to Nila Rudra, to Kadrudra and to Pracetas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to you the Atman of all; obeisance to Sankara the dispeller of affliction, to Rudra, to Nila Rudra, to Kadrudra and to Pracetas.

verses.sanskrit: शूलशक्तिगदाहस्तान् टङ्कोपलशिलायुधान् नानाप्रहरणोपेतान् नानावेषधरांस्तदा
verses.transliteration: śūlaśaktigadāhastān ṭaṅkopalaśilāyudhān nānāpraharaṇopetān nānāveṣadharāṃstadā
verses.translation: You are our perpetual goal; the suppressor of the enemies of Devas should be always worshipped and honoured by us. You are the primordial one; you are the endles.s one; you are the infinite imperishable lord,
verses.hindi: तेऽर्चयन्तु सदा कालं लिङ्गमूर्ति महेश्वरम्
verses.wordMeaning: You are our perpetual goal; the suppressor of the enemies of Devas should be always worshipped and honoured by us. You are the primordial one; you are the endles.s one; you are the infinite imperishable lord,
verses.commentary: Sense: You are our perpetual goal; the suppressor of the enemies of Devas should be always worshipped and honoured by us. You are the primordial one; you are the endles.s one; you are the infinite imperishable lord,

verses.sanskrit: कालाग्निरुद्रसंकाशान् कालरुद्रोपमांस्तदा प्राह देवो हरिः साक्षात् प्रणिपत्य स्थितान् प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: kālāgnirudrasaṃkāśān kālarudropamāṃstadā prāha devo hariḥ sākṣāt praṇipatya sthitān prabhuḥ
verses.translation: O preceptor of the universe, you are Prakrti and Purusa himself; you are the creator, the destroyer; the pro- tector; the leader of the brahmins in this universe, O deity, favourably disposed towards the brahmins.
verses.hindi: फ क छ फ फ़ फ फ़ क फ क फ फ़ क फ़ फ फफ क फ फ फ़ क फ फ फ फ क कामी फ फी की जी फी कष पुन: दो प्रणवोंसहित दो प्राणायामोंके द्वारा शोध करके; प्राणायामपरायण होकर ओंकारका न्यास तदनन्तर ओंकारका उच्चारण करके प्राण तथा अपार वायु-को नियन्त्रितकर ज्ञानामृतरूपी प्रणवसे सभी
verses.wordMeaning: O preceptor of the universe, you are Prakrti and Purusa himself; you are the creator, the destroyer; the pro- tector; the leader of the brahmins in this universe, O deity, favourably disposed towards the brahmins.
