verses.commentary: Sense: O preceptor of the universe, you are Prakrti and Purusa himself; you are the creator, the destroyer; the pro- tector; the leader of the brahmins in this universe, O deity, favourably disposed towards the brahmins.

verses.sanskrit: दग्ध्वा भित्त्वा च भुक्त्वा च गत्वा दैत्यपुरत्रयम् पुनर्यथागतं वीरा गन्तुमर्हथ भूतये
verses.transliteration: dagdhvā bhittvā ca bhuktvā ca gatvā daityapuratrayam punaryathāgataṃ vīrā gantumarhatha bhūtaye
verses.translation: You are the granter of boons; you are identical with speech. You arc worthy of being directly expressed; you are devoid of the expressed and expression. For the sake of salvation, you arc worshipped by the yogins and by those who whirl in the yogic practice. You are stationed in the
verses.hindi: अंगोंको आप्लावित मानकर; है सुव्रतो! तीनों गुणों चौथा अहंकार, पाँच तन्मात्राओ, पाँच भने पाँच ज्ञानेन्द्रियों, पाँच कर्मेन्द्रियोंका शोधन करके पुनः युगलपुरुषका शोधन करके अपने शरीरको
verses.wordMeaning: You are the granter of boons; you are identical with speech. You arc worthy of being directly expressed; you are devoid of the expressed and expression. For the sake of salvation, you arc worshipped by the yogins and by those who whirl in the yogic practice.…
verses.commentary: Sense: You are the granter of boons; you are identical with speech. You arc worthy of being directly expressed; you are devoid of the expressed and expression. For the sake of salvation, you arc worshipped by the yogins and by those who whirl in the yogic practice.…

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रणम्य देवेशं भूतसंघाः पुरत्रयम् प्रविश्य नष्टास्ते सर्वे शलभा इव पावकम्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ praṇamya deveśaṃ bhūtasaṃghāḥ puratrayam praviśya naṣṭāste sarve śalabhā iva pāvakam
verses.translation: O lord, the noble sages say that you are reality, the mass of splendour, greater than the greatest and the greatest Atman in this world.
verses.hindi: चिदात्मस्वरूप मानकर अग्नि भस्म है, वायु भस्म है, भस्म है, भस्म हे व्योम आकाश भस्म है, जल भस्म है, पृथ्वी भस्म भस्म है, पृथ्वी भस्म है--ऐसा कहकर भस्मका स्पर्श करना चाहिए। जो तीनों सन्ध्याओंमें भस्मस्नान करता है, वह योगी तथा सभी तत्त्वोंका ज्ञाता हो जाता है। है श्रेष्ठ देवताओ! स्वयं भगवान् शिवने पाश (बन्धन)-से मुक्तिके लिये इस पाशुपतत्रतको कहा है॥ ९--१८॥
verses.wordMeaning: O lord, the noble sages say that you are reality, the mass of splendour, greater than the greatest and the greatest Atman in this world.
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord, the noble sages say that you are reality, the mass of splendour, greater than the greatest and the greatest Atman in this world.

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तु नष्टास्ते सर्वे भूता देवेश्वराज्ञया ननृतुर् मुमुदुश् चैव जगुर् दैत्याः सहस्रशः
verses.transliteration: tatastu naṣṭāste sarve bhūtā deveśvarājñayā nanṛtur mumuduś caiva jagur daityāḥ sahasraśaḥ
verses.translation: O preceptor of the universe, you are everything that is seen, heard, stationed or born. They call you minuter than the minutest and greater than the greatest.
verses.hindi: है देवताओ! इस प्रकार पाशुपतब्रत करके पूर्वकालमें मेरे तथा महात्मा विष्णुके द्वारा देखे गये लिङ्गमें परमेश्वरको विधिपूर्वक पूजा करके लोग एक वर्षमें पशुत्वसे मुक्त हो जाते हैं। हम लोगोंको
verses.wordMeaning: O preceptor of the universe, you are everything that is seen, heard, stationed or born. They call you minuter than the minutest and greater than the greatest.
verses.commentary: Sense: O preceptor of the universe, you are everything that is seen, heard, stationed or born. They call you minuter than the minutest and greater than the greatest.

verses.sanskrit: तुष्टुवुर्देवदेवेशं परमात्मानमीश्वरम् ततः पराजिता देवा ध्वस्तवीर्याः क्षणेन तु
verses.transliteration: tuṣṭuvurdevadeveśaṃ paramātmānamīśvaram tataḥ parājitā devā dhvastavīryāḥ kṣaṇena tu
verses.translation: They call you one with hands and feet everywhere, one with eyes, heads and mouths everywhere. You have ears all round and you stand enveloping everything in the world.
verses.hindi: सभी कर्मोके देव महेश्वरकी पूजा यत्नपूर्वक बाह्य तथा आभ्यन्तर विधिसे करनी चाहिए-एऐसा मैं मानता हूँ। है श्रेष्ठ देवताओ। मेरी, विष्णुकी तथा मुनियोंको यह दिव्य प्रतिज्ञा है; इसमें सन्देह नहीं है। अतः शिवका पूजन अवश्य करना चाहिए॥ १९-२१/२॥
verses.wordMeaning: They call you one with hands and feet everywhere, one with eyes, heads and mouths everywhere. You have ears all round and you stand enveloping everything in the world.
verses.commentary: Sense: They call you one with hands and feet everywhere, one with eyes, heads and mouths everywhere. You have ears all round and you stand enveloping everything in the world.

verses.sanskrit: सेन्द्राः संगम्य देवेशम् उपेन्द्रं धिष्ठिता भयात् तान्दृष्ट्वा चिन्तयामास भगवान्पुरुषोत्तमः
verses.transliteration: sendrāḥ saṃgamya deveśam upendraṃ dhiṣṭhitā bhayāt tāndṛṣṭvā cintayāmāsa bhagavānpuruṣottamaḥ
verses.translation: They call you Mahadeva, the omniscient, one without ailment, one who cannot be specifically pointed out, one having a universal form, one with deformed eyes, Sadasiva without ailment, one who makes others in the world function, one who makes Prakrti work, the great-grandfather, the lord who bestows boons, the self-born deity, the abode of all and the lord of twentysix principles. You resemble ten million suns in refulgence; you are similar to ten million moons in brightness, you are on a par with ten million fires that blaze at the time of dissolution and you have no other lord to control you.
verses.hindi: यदि कोई एक क्षण या एक मुहूर्त भी शिवकी चिन्तन नहीं करता, तो वही उसकी हानि है, वही दोष है, वही उसका अज्ञान है और वही उसकी मूकता है। जो लोग शिवभक्तिमें संलग्न हैं, अन्तःकरणसे
verses.wordMeaning: They call you Mahadeva, the omniscient, one without ailment, one who cannot be specifically pointed out, one having a universal form, one with deformed eyes, Sadasiva without ailment, one who makes others in the world function, one who makes Prakrti work, the great-grandfather,…
verses.commentary: Sense: They call you Mahadeva, the omniscient, one without ailment, one who cannot be specifically pointed out, one having a universal form, one with deformed eyes, Sadasiva without ailment, one who makes others in the world function, one who makes Prakrti work, the great-grandfather,…

verses.sanskrit: किं कृत्यमिति संतप्तः संतप्तान्सेन्द्रकान्क्षणम् कथं तु तेषां दैत्यानां बलं हत्वा प्रयत्नतः
verses.transliteration: kiṃ kṛtyamiti saṃtaptaḥ saṃtaptānsendrakānkṣaṇam kathaṃ tu teṣāṃ daityānāṃ balaṃ hatvā prayatnataḥ
verses.translation: The Srutis and the people who are conversant with the essence of JSrutis call you the essence of the Srutis. O deity with many forms, that which is evolved in the world without you has not been seen by us. You alone protect the Daityas, Devas, Bhutas, the mobile and immobile beings, O Sambhu, we have no other goal. Protect us by killng all the Asuras.
verses.hindi: शिवको प्रणाम करनेवाले हैं तथा भगवान् शिवके स्मरणमें लगे हुए हैं, वे दुःखके पात्र नहीं होते हँ धन-यह सब शिवपूजाविधिका फल है। जो लोग महाभोगों तथा स्वर्गका राज्य चाहते हैं, वे सभी समयोंमें लिङ्गमूर्ति महेशवरका अर्चन करें।  ति प्राणियोंका वध तथा छेदन करके और इस सम्प
verses.wordMeaning: The Srutis and the people who are conversant with the essence of JSrutis call you the essence of the Srutis. O deity with many forms, that which is evolved in the world without you has not been seen by us. You alone protect the Daityas, Devas, Bhutas,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The Srutis and the people who are conversant with the essence of JSrutis call you the essence of the Srutis. O deity with many forms, that which is evolved in the world without you has not been seen by us. You alone protect the Daityas, Devas, Bhutas,…

verses.sanskrit: देवकार्यं करिष्यामि प्रसादात्परमेष्ठिनः पापं विचारतो नास्ति धर्मिष्ठानां न संशयः
verses.transliteration: devakāryaṃ kariṣyāmi prasādātparameṣṭhinaḥ pāpaṃ vicārato nāsti dharmiṣṭhānāṃ na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: The man who gets up early in the morning, purifies
verses.hindi: अध्याय ७४  ब्रह्माकी आज्ञासे विश्वकर्माद्वारा विभिन्न लिड्रोंका निर्माण-स्थापनाका माहात्म्य
verses.wordMeaning: The man who gets up early in the morning, purifies
verses.commentary: Sense: The man who gets up early in the morning, purifies

verses.sanskrit: तस्माद्दैत्या न वध्यास्ते भूतैश्चोपसदोद्भवैः पापं नुदति धर्मेण धर्मे सर्वं प्रतिष्ठितम्
verses.transliteration: tasmāddaityā na vadhyāste bhūtaiścopasadodbhavaiḥ pāpaṃ nudati dharmeṇa dharme sarvaṃ pratiṣṭhitam
verses.translation: He is marked with saffron. A round mark has been made with Bhasma. O lord, see the row of faces like the cluster of lotuses. O lord, see his splendid eyes. See the splendid marks of collyrium applied by his mothers Ganga, Krttika and Svaha®® as an auspicious benediction.**
verses.hindi: अक्षी कीक फक फक फफफ फफफ अफ फ आधा फफफ कझाक फ मामका फ कका मी की की मजी की की क क फ क फ फ फ फ फ फ फ फ क फ फ फ फ फ़ फ फ फ फ फ फ फ फ फ फ़ फ़ फ फ फ फ़ फ फ़ फफ फफ फ़ क फ फ़ फ फ क फ फा की फी यजेदेकं विरूपाक्षं न पापैः स प्रलिप्यते।
verses.wordMeaning: He is marked with saffron. A round mark has been made with Bhasma. O lord, see the row of faces like the cluster of lotuses. O lord, see his splendid eyes. See the splendid marks of collyrium applied by his mothers Ganga, Krttika and Svaha®® as an auspicious benediction.**
verses.commentary: Sense: He is marked with saffron. A round mark has been made with Bhasma. O lord, see the row of faces like the cluster of lotuses. O lord, see his splendid eyes. See the splendid marks of collyrium applied by his mothers Ganga, Krttika and Svaha®® as an auspicious benediction.**

verses.sanskrit: धर्मादैश्वर्यमित्येषा श्रुतिरेषा सनातनी दैत्याश्चैते हि धर्मिष्ठाः सर्वे त्रिपुरवासिनः
verses.transliteration: dharmādaiśvaryamityeṣā śrutireṣā sanātanī daityāścaite hi dharmiṣṭhāḥ sarve tripuravāsinaḥ
verses.translation: He embraced Skanda, kissed him, smelling the head and said — "Dance, dear son". The great boy, dispelling the anguish of all danced gently and sportingly.
verses.hindi: शैलं लिङ्ग मदीयं हि सर्वदेबनमस्कृतम्
verses.wordMeaning: He embraced Skanda, kissed him, smelling the head and said — "Dance, dear son". The great boy, dispelling the anguish of all danced gently and sportingly.
verses.commentary: Sense: He embraced Skanda, kissed him, smelling the head and said — "Dance, dear son". The great boy, dispelling the anguish of all danced gently and sportingly.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मादवध्यतां प्राप्ता नान्यथा द्विजपुङ्गवाः कृत्वापि सुमहत्पापं रुद्रमभ्यर्चयन्ति ये
verses.transliteration: tasmādavadhyatāṃ prāptā nānyathā dvijapuṅgavāḥ kṛtvāpi sumahatpāpaṃ rudramabhyarcayanti ye
verses.translation: The other leading Ganas danced along with him. At the bidding of the lord, the entire universe, danced for a moment.
verses.hindi: इत्युक्त्वा पूर्वमभ्यर्च्य रुद्रं त्रिभुवनेश्वरम्। तुष्टाव वाग्भिरिष्टाभिर्देवदेवं त्रियम्बकम्
verses.wordMeaning: The other leading Ganas danced along with him. At the bidding of the lord, the entire universe, danced for a moment.
verses.commentary: Sense: The other leading Ganas danced along with him. At the bidding of the lord, the entire universe, danced for a moment.

verses.sanskrit: मुच्यन्ते पातकैः सर्वैः पद्मपत्रमिवांभसा पूजया भोगसंपत्तिर् अवश्यं जायते द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: mucyante pātakaiḥ sarvaiḥ padmapatramivāṃbhasā pūjayā bhogasaṃpattir avaśyaṃ jāyate dvijāḥ
verses.translation: All the Nagas (serpents) and Devas with Indra at their forefront danced. The chiefs of the Ganas eulogised Skanda. Uma and the mothers rejoiced.
verses.hindi: जगतूको जलाकर भी जो एकमात्र विरूपाक्ष शिव- की पूजा करता है, बह पापॉंसे लिप्त नहीं होता है, मेरे द्वारा पूजित यह शिलामय लिङ्ग सभी देवताओंके द्वारा नमस्कृत है
verses.wordMeaning: All the Nagas (serpents) and Devas with Indra at their forefront danced. The chiefs of the Ganas eulogised Skanda. Uma and the mothers rejoiced.
verses.commentary: Sense: All the Nagas (serpents) and Devas with Indra at their forefront danced. The chiefs of the Ganas eulogised Skanda. Uma and the mothers rejoiced.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात्ते भोगिनो दैत्या लिङ्गार्चनपरायणाः तस्मात्कृत्वा धर्मविघ्नम् अहं देवाः स्वमायया
verses.transliteration: tasmātte bhogino daityā liṅgārcanaparāyaṇāḥ tasmātkṛtvā dharmavighnam ahaṃ devāḥ svamāyayā
verses.translation: The Gandharvas and Kinnaras showered flowers and sang. On drinking the nectar of the fine dance Parvati and Paramesvara attained satisfaction along with Nandin and the leading Ganas.
verses.hindi: ऐसा कहकर पहले ब्रह्माजीने तीनों लोकोंके स्वामी, देवोंके भी देव तथा तीन नेत्रोंवाले रुद्रकी पूजा करके प्रिय वचनोंसे उनकी स्तुति की। उसी समयसे इन्द्रादि देवता शरीरमें भस्म पोतकर पाशुपतत्रत साक्षात्पाशुपतं कृत्वा भस्मोद्धूलितविग्रहाः॥ २९  करके साक्षात् महेश्वरकी पूजा करने लगे
verses.wordMeaning: The Gandharvas and Kinnaras showered flowers and sang. On drinking the nectar of the fine dance Parvati and Paramesvara attained satisfaction along with Nandin and the leading Ganas.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Gandharvas and Kinnaras showered flowers and sang. On drinking the nectar of the fine dance Parvati and Paramesvara attained satisfaction along with Nandin and the leading Ganas.

verses.sanskrit: दैत्यानां देवकार्यार्थं जेष्ये ऽहं त्रिपुरं क्षणात् विचार्यैवं ततस्तेषां भगवान्पुरुषोत्तमः कर्तुं व्यवसितश्चाभूद् धर्मविघ्नं सुरारिणाम्
verses.transliteration: daityānāṃ devakāryārthaṃ jeṣye 'haṃ tripuraṃ kṣaṇāt vicāryaivaṃ tatasteṣāṃ bhagavānpuruṣottamaḥ kartuṃ vyavasitaścābhūd dharmavighnaṃ surāriṇām
verses.translation: Then along with Nandin, Karttikeya, and the daughter of the king of mountains, Siva entered the divine abode, like the cloud entering other clouds. He too had the lustre of the clouds.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्माकी आज्ञासे विश्वकर्माद्वारा विभिन्न लिङ्गोंका निर्माण करके देवताओंको प्रदान करना एवं देवताओंद्वारा उन-उन लिड्रोंका पूजन, लिङ्गोंके विविध भेद तथा उनकी स्थापनाका माहात्म्य
verses.wordMeaning: Then along with Nandin, Karttikeya, and the daughter of the king of mountains, Siva entered the divine abode, like the cloud entering other clouds. He too had the lustre of the clouds.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then along with Nandin, Karttikeya, and the daughter of the king of mountains, Siva entered the divine abode, like the cloud entering other clouds. He too had the lustre of the clouds.

verses.sanskrit: असृजच्च महातेजाः पुरुषं चात्मसंभवम् मायी मायामयं तेषां धर्मविघ्नार्थमच्युतः
verses.transliteration: asṛjacca mahātejāḥ puruṣaṃ cātmasaṃbhavam māyī māyāmayaṃ teṣāṃ dharmavighnārthamacyutaḥ
verses.translation: Devas stood by the door of the abode. Slightly distressed in their minds they eulogised the lord.
verses.hindi: लिङ्गानि कल्पयित्वैवं स्वाधिकारानुरूपतः। विश्वकर्मा ददौ तेषां नियोगाद् ब्रह्मणः प्रभोः इन्द्रनीलमयं लिङ्गं विष्णुना पूजितं सदा। पद्मरागमयं शक्रो हैमं विश्रवसः सुतः
verses.wordMeaning: Devas stood by the door of the abode. Slightly distressed in their minds they eulogised the lord.
verses.commentary: Sense: Devas stood by the door of the abode. Slightly distressed in their minds they eulogised the lord.

verses.sanskrit: शास्त्रं च शास्ता सर्वेषाम् अकरोत्कामरूपधृक् सर्वसंमोहनं मायी दृष्टप्रत्ययसंयुतम्
verses.transliteration: śāstraṃ ca śāstā sarveṣām akarotkāmarūpadhṛk sarvasaṃmohanaṃ māyī dṛṣṭapratyayasaṃyutam
verses.translation: They told one another: "What is this? What is this?" and they looked at one another in their excited dejection. Some said, "we are sinners", still others said, "we are unfor- tunate".
verses.hindi: विश्वेदेवास्तथा रौप्यं वसवः कान्तिकं शुभम्। आरकूटमयं वायुरश्विनौ पार्थिवं सदा
verses.wordMeaning: They told one another: "What is this? What is this?" and they looked at one another in their excited dejection. Some said, "we are sinners", still others said, "we are unfor- tunate".
verses.commentary: Sense: They told one another: "What is this? What is this?" and they looked at one another in their excited dejection. Some said, "we are sinners", still others said, "we are unfor- tunate".

verses.sanskrit: एतत्स्वाङ्गभवायैव पुरुषायोपदिश्य तु मायी मायामयं शास्त्रं ग्रन्थषोडशलक्षकम्
verses.transliteration: etatsvāṅgabhavāyaiva puruṣāyopadiśya tu māyī māyāmayaṃ śāstraṃ granthaṣoḍaśalakṣakam
verses.translation: The leading Devas said: — Daityas are lucky. Others said, "This is the fruit of their worship." Still others said — "No."
verses.hindi: स्फाटिकं वरुणो राजा आदित्यास्ताम्रनिर्मितम्। मौक्तिकं सोमराड् धीमांस्तथा लिङ्गमनुत्तमम् हैत्या ह्ययोमयं लिङ्गं राक्षसाश्च महात्मनः
verses.wordMeaning: The leading Devas said: — Daityas are lucky. Others said, "This is the fruit of their worship." Still others said — "No."
verses.commentary: Sense: The leading Devas said: — Daityas are lucky. Others said, "This is the fruit of their worship." Still others said — "No."

verses.sanskrit: श्रौतस्मार्तविरुद्धं च वर्णाश्रमविवर्जितम् इहैव स्वर्गनरकं प्रत्ययं नान्यथा पुनः
verses.transliteration: śrautasmārtaviruddhaṃ ca varṇāśramavivarjitam ihaiva svarganarakaṃ pratyayaṃ nānyathā punaḥ
verses.translation: In the meantime, on hearing their grim voices Kumbhodara*® of great splendour struck them with his staff.
verses.hindi: त्रैलोहिकं -गुह्यकाश्च सर्वलोहमयं गणाः। चामुण्डा सैकतं साक्षान्मातरश्च द्विजोत्तमाः
verses.wordMeaning: In the meantime, on hearing their grim voices Kumbhodara*® of great splendour struck them with his staff.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the meantime, on hearing their grim voices Kumbhodara*® of great splendour struck them with his staff.

verses.sanskrit: तच्छास्त्रमुपदिश्यैव पुरुषायाच्युतः स्वयम् पुरत्रयविनाशाय प्राहैनं पुरुषं हरिः
verses.transliteration: tacchāstramupadiśyaiva puruṣāyācyutaḥ svayam puratrayavināśāya prāhainaṃ puruṣaṃ hariḥ
verses.translation: Devas were frightened. Crying "Ha, Ha" they fled. The sages and Devas fell on the ground,
verses.hindi: नीलाद्याश्च तथा रुद्राः शुद्धं भस्ममयं शुभम् सूतजी बोले--विश्वकमनि प्रभु ब्रह्मकी आज्ञासे अपने अधिकारके अनुरूप लिङ्गोंका निर्माण करके उन देवताओं-को दिया
verses.wordMeaning: Devas were frightened. Crying "Ha, Ha" they fled. The sages and Devas fell on the ground,
verses.commentary: Sense: Devas were frightened. Crying "Ha, Ha" they fled. The sages and Devas fell on the ground,

verses.sanskrit: गन्तुमर्हसि नाशाय भो तूर्णं पुरवासिनाम् धर्मास् तथा प्रणश्यन्तु श्रौतस्मार्ता न संशयः
verses.transliteration: gantumarhasi nāśāya bho tūrṇaṃ puravāsinām dharmās tathā praṇaśyantu śrautasmārtā na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: At the behest of Mahadeva Nandisa, the favourite sage of the lord came there riding on a white bull. He had matted hair and held the trident and the iron club. He wore garlands, necklaces, ear-rings and bangles. On seeing Nandin, the Kumbhodara bowed to Nandin with his lowered head and hastened along with him. Nandin of great splendour was seated on the back of a bull. He had the bull banner. He was the commander-in-chief of the Ganas and was accompanied by the Ganas like the great lord himself, riding on the back of the cloud. The white umbrella of Nandin stretched to ten Yojanas. It was bedecked in clusters of pearls. It shone like the firmament. The splendid pearl necklace suspended from it from within appeared like the Ganga falling from the sky ovcr the head of the lord.
verses.hindi: विष्णुने इन्द्रनील (नीलकान्तमणि)-से निर्मित लिङ्गकी सदा पूजा की। इन्द्रने पद्मरागनिर्मित लिङ्गकी, विश्रवाके पुत्र कुबेरे सुवर्णनिर्मित लिङ्गकी, विश्वेदेवोंने चाँदीसे बने हुए लिङ्गकी, वसुओंने चन्रकान्तमणिसे
verses.wordMeaning: At the behest of Mahadeva Nandisa, the favourite sage of the lord came there riding on a white bull. He had matted hair and held the trident and the iron club. He wore garlands, necklaces, ear-rings and bangles. On seeing Nandin,…
verses.commentary: Sense: At the behest of Mahadeva Nandisa, the favourite sage of the lord came there riding on a white bull. He had matted hair and held the trident and the iron club. He wore garlands, necklaces, ear-rings and bangles. On seeing Nandin,…

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रणम्य तं मायी मायाशास्त्रविशारदः प्रविश्य तत्पुरं तूर्णं मुनिर्मायां तदाकरोत्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ praṇamya taṃ māyī māyāśāstraviśāradaḥ praviśya tatpuraṃ tūrṇaṃ munirmāyāṃ tadākarot
verses.translation: O leading sages, at the behest of Indra, the wielder of the thunderbolt, the splendid divine drums were sounded in honour of the presiding oflicer of t he Ganas. They eulogised him with pleasing words, just as they eulogised Siva with thrilling joy and loving devotion. At the bidding of the thunder- bolt-wielding lord, the sky- walkers showered fragrant flowers from the firmament over the head of Nandin. Satisfied with that shower he shone with real and sincere satisfaction. Nandin was drenched in fragrant water dropping from the moon on the forehead of the lord. The back of the bull shone with different kinds of flowers. O sages of good holy rites, just as the firmament is scattered with stars so also the back of the bull was covered with flowers. Covered by them Nandin shone on the back of the bull, like the moon on the back of the firmament. O sages of holy rites, on seeing Nandin that way Devas including Indra and Visnu eulogised the chieftain of the Ganas as if he was another lord of Devas.
verses.hindi: बने हुए सुन्दर लिङ्गकी, वायुने आरकूट (पीतल) -से बने हुए लिङ्गको तथा दोनों अश्विनीकुमारोंने मिट्टीसे बने हुए लिङ्गकी सदा पूजा को राजा वरुणने स्फटिकसे बने हुए लिङ्गकी, आदित्योंने ताँबेसे बने हुए लिङ्गकी, बुद्धिमान् सोमराट्ने मोतीसे बने हुए अत्युत्तम लिङ्गकी, अनन्त आदि महानागोंने प्रवालनिर्मित शुभ लिङ्गकी और महात्मा हैत्यों तथा राक्षसोंने लोहेसे बने
verses.wordMeaning: O leading sages, at the behest of Indra, the wielder of the thunderbolt, the splendid divine drums were sounded in honour of the presiding oflicer of t he Ganas. They eulogised him with pleasing words, just as they eulogised Siva with thrilling joy and loving devotion.…
verses.commentary: Sense: O leading sages, at the behest of Indra, the wielder of the thunderbolt, the splendid divine drums were sounded in honour of the presiding oflicer of t he Ganas. They eulogised him with pleasing words, just as they eulogised Siva with thrilling joy and loving devotion.…

verses.sanskrit: मायया तस्य ते दैत्याः पुरत्रयनिवासिनः श्रौतं स्मार्तं च संत्यज्य तस्य शिष्यास्तदाभवन्
verses.transliteration: māyayā tasya te daityāḥ puratrayanivāsinaḥ śrautaṃ smārtaṃ ca saṃtyajya tasya śiṣyāstadābhavan
verses.translation: Obeisance to you the devotee of Rudra, to one engaged in the japa of Rudra mantras; obeisance to one who
verses.hindi: हुए लिङ्गकी पूजा की
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to you the devotee of Rudra, to one engaged in the japa of Rudra mantras; obeisance to one who
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to you the devotee of Rudra, to one engaged in the japa of Rudra mantras; obeisance to one who

verses.sanskrit: तत्यजुश् च महादेवं शङ्करं परमेश्वरम् नारदो ऽपि तदा मायी नियोगान्मायिनः प्रभोः
verses.transliteration: tatyajuś ca mahādevaṃ śaṅkaraṃ parameśvaram nārado 'pi tadā māyī niyogānmāyinaḥ prabhoḥ
verses.translation: meghapr§the — mcgha-rupa-Vi9nu-pr9thc ST. This refers to Vi9nu in the form of cloud which lord Siva made his vehicle. Hence, Siva is called *megha-vahana.*
verses.hindi: हे द्विजोत्तमो ! गुह्यकोंने तीन प्रकारके लोहेसे निर्मित लिङ्गकी, गणोंने सर्वलोहमय लिङ्गकी और चामुण्डा तथा सभी माताओंने बालूसे बने हुए लिङ्गको पूजा की। नै्ऋतिने लकड़ीसे बने लिङ्गकी, यमने मरकतसे बने शुभ श्रीलिड्रमहापुराण
verses.wordMeaning: meghapr§the — mcgha-rupa-Vi9nu-pr9thc ST. This refers to Vi9nu in the form of cloud which lord Siva made his vehicle. Hence, Siva is called *megha-vahana.*
verses.commentary: Sense: meghapr§the — mcgha-rupa-Vi9nu-pr9thc ST. This refers to Vi9nu in the form of cloud which lord Siva made his vehicle. Hence, Siva is called *megha-vahana.*

verses.sanskrit: प्रविश्य तत्पुरं तेन मायिना सह दीक्षितः मुनिः शिष्यैः प्रशिष्यैश् च संवृतः सर्वतः स्वयम्
verses.transliteration: praviśya tatpuraṃ tena māyinā saha dīkṣitaḥ muniḥ śiṣyaiḥ praśiṣyaiś ca saṃvṛtaḥ sarvataḥ svayam
verses.translation: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.hindi: किए: प्रात लिन फ्रफफफफ्फफफफफ्फ्फ्फ्रफक्रफक फफफफफफफफ फाफ फी पीप पीफी फफफफफफफ फा फ फी फी फफफ फफफफपापापापामापापाफाफापाफापाफफफफफ फफफफ फफ फफ
verses.wordMeaning: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—

verses.sanskrit: स्त्रीधर्मं चाकरोत्स्त्रीणां दुश्चारफलसिद्धिदम् चक्रुस्ताः सर्वदा लब्ध्वा सद्य एव फलं स्त्रियः
verses.transliteration: strīdharmaṃ cākarotstrīṇāṃ duścāraphalasiddhidam cakrustāḥ sarvadā labdhvā sadya eva phalaṃ striyaḥ
verses.translation: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.hindi: मुनयो मुनिशार्दूलाः कुशाग्रमयमुत्तमम्॥ वामाद्याः पुष्पलिङ्गं तु गन्धलिङ्गं मनोन्मनी । सरस्वती च रत्नेन कृतं रुद्रस्य वाम्भसा
verses.wordMeaning: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—

verses.sanskrit: जनासक्ता बभूवुस्ता विनिन्द्य पतिदेवताः अद्यापि गौरवात्तस्य नारदस्य कलौ मुनेः
verses.transliteration: janāsaktā babhūvustā vinindya patidevatāḥ adyāpi gauravāttasya nāradasya kalau muneḥ
verses.translation: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.hindi: दुर्गां हैमं महादेवं सवेदिकमनुत्तमम्। उग्रा पिष्टमयं सर्वे मन्त्रा ह्याज्यमयं शुभम्
verses.wordMeaning: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—

verses.sanskrit: नार्यश्चरन्ति संत्यज्य भर्तॄन् स्वैरं वृथाधमाः स्त्रीणां माता पिता बन्धुः सखा मित्रं च बान्धवः
verses.transliteration: nāryaścaranti saṃtyajya bhartṝn svairaṃ vṛthādhamāḥ strīṇāṃ mātā pitā bandhuḥ sakhā mitraṃ ca bāndhavaḥ
verses.translation: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.hindi: लेभिरे च यथायोय्यं प्रसादाद् ब्रह्मणः पदम् शिवलिङ्गं समभ्यर्च्य स्थितमत्र न संशयः
verses.wordMeaning: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—

verses.sanskrit: भर्ता एव न संदेहस् तथाप्य् आसहमायया कृत्वापि सुमहत्पापं या भर्तुः प्रेमसंयुता
verses.transliteration: bhartā eva na saṃdehas tathāpy āsahamāyayā kṛtvāpi sumahatpāpaṃ yā bhartuḥ premasaṃyutā
verses.translation: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.hindi: षड्विधं लिङ्गमित्याहुर््रव्याणां च प्रभेदतः। तेषां भेदाश्चतुर्युक्तचत्वारिंशदिति स्मृताः
verses.wordMeaning: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—

verses.sanskrit: प्राप्नुयात् परमं स्वर्गं नरकं च विपर्ययात् पुरैका मुनिशार्दूलाः सर्वधर्मान् सदा पतिम्
verses.transliteration: prāpnuyāt paramaṃ svargaṃ narakaṃ ca viparyayāt puraikā muniśārdūlāḥ sarvadharmān sadā patim
verses.translation: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.hindi: द्वितीयं रत्नजं तच्च सप्तधा मुनिसत्तमाः तुरीयं दारुजं लिङ्गं तत्तु षोडशधोच्यते
verses.wordMeaning: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—

verses.sanskrit: संत्यज्यापूजयन्साध्व्यो देवानन्याञ्जगद्गुरून् ताः स्वर्गलोकमासाद्य मोदन्ते विगतज्वराः
verses.transliteration: saṃtyajyāpūjayansādhvyo devānanyāñjagadgurūn tāḥ svargalokamāsādya modante vigatajvarāḥ
verses.translation: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.hindi: मृन्मयं पञ्चमं लिङ्गं द्विधा भिन्नं द्विजोत्तमाः । षष्ठं तु क्षणिकं लिङ्गं सप्तधा परिकीर्तितम्
verses.wordMeaning: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—

verses.sanskrit: नरकं च जगामान्या तस्माद्भर्ता परा गतिः तथापि भर्तॄन् स्वांस् त्यक्त्वा बभूवुः स्वैरवृत्तयः
verses.transliteration: narakaṃ ca jagāmānyā tasmādbhartā parā gatiḥ tathāpi bhartṝn svāṃs tyaktvā babhūvuḥ svairavṛttayaḥ
verses.translation: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.hindi: श्रीप्रदं रत्नजं लिङ्गं शैलजं सर्वसिद्धिदम्। धातुजं धनदं साक्षाद्दारुजं भोगसिद्धिदम् मृन्मयं चैव विप्रेन्द्राः सर्वसिद्धिकरं शुभम्। शैलजं चोत्तमं प्रोक्तं मध्यमं चैव धातुजम्
verses.wordMeaning: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—

verses.sanskrit: मायया देवदेवस्य विष्णोस्तस्याज्ञया प्रभोः अलक्ष्मीश् च स्वयं तस्य नियोगात्त्रिपुरं गता
verses.transliteration: māyayā devadevasya viṣṇostasyājñayā prabhoḥ alakṣmīś ca svayaṃ tasya niyogāttripuraṃ gatā
verses.translation: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.hindi: लिङ्गको, नील आदि रुद्रोंने भस्मनिर्मित शुद्ध तथा शुभ लिङ्गकी भक्तिपूर्वक पूजा को
verses.wordMeaning: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—

verses.sanskrit: या लक्ष्मीस्तपसा तेषां लब्धा देवेश्वरादजात् बहिर्गता परित्यज्य नियोगाद्ब्रह्मणः प्रभोः
verses.transliteration: yā lakṣmīstapasā teṣāṃ labdhā deveśvarādajāt bahirgatā parityajya niyogādbrahmaṇaḥ prabhoḥ
verses.translation: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.hindi: हे श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! लक्ष्मीने लक्ष्मीवृक्ष (बेल) -से निर्मित लिङ्गकी, गुहने गोमयसे निर्मित लिङ्गकी मुनियोंने कुशके अग्रभागसे निर्मित उत्तम लिङ्गको वामदेव आदिने पुष्पके लिङ्गकी, मनोन्मनीने गनो निर्मित लिङ्गकी और सरस्वतीने रत्न अथवा सुद्रके जलसे निर्मित लिङ्गको पूजा को। दुर्गाने वेदीसहित सुवर्णनिर्मित अत्युत्तम शिवलिङ्गकी, उग्नोंने आरेसे बने हुए लिङ्गको, सभी मन्त्रोंने घृतनिर्मित शुभ
verses.wordMeaning: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—

verses.sanskrit: बुद्धिमोहं तथाभूतं विष्णुमायाविनिर्मितम् तेषां दत्त्वा क्षणं देवस् तासां मायी च नारदः
verses.transliteration: buddhimohaṃ tathābhūtaṃ viṣṇumāyāvinirmitam teṣāṃ dattvā kṣaṇaṃ devas tāsāṃ māyī ca nāradaḥ
verses.translation: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.hindi: लिङ्गकी, सभी वेदोंने दधिनिर्मित लिङ्गकी एवं पिशाचोंने सीसनिर्मित लिङ्गको पूजा की। इन सभीने पूजा करके ब्रह्माजीकी कृपासे यथायोग्य पद प्राप्त किया, इस विषयमें अधिक कहनेसे क्या लाभ? शिवलिङ्गकी
verses.wordMeaning: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—

verses.sanskrit: सुखासीनौ ह्यसंभ्रान्तौ धर्मविघ्नार्थमव्ययौ एवं नष्टे तदा धर्मे श्रौतस्मार्ते सुशोभने
verses.transliteration: sukhāsīnau hyasaṃbhrāntau dharmavighnārthamavyayau evaṃ naṣṭe tadā dharme śrautasmārte suśobhane
verses.translation: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.hindi: पूजा करनेसे ही यह चराचर जगत् स्थित है; इसमें सन्देह नहीं है॥ ८--१२॥ द्रव्योंके भेदसे छ: प्रकारका लिङ्ग कहा गया है। उनके कुल चौवालीस भेद कहे गये हैं। प्रथम प्रकारका लिङ्ग पाषाणनिर्मित कहा गया है; वह चार प्रकारका होता है। है श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! द्वितीय प्रकारका लिङ्ग
verses.wordMeaning: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—

verses.sanskrit: पाषण्डे ख्यापिते तेन विष्णुना विश्वयोनिना त्यक्ते महेश्वरे दैत्यैस् त्यक्ते लिङ्गार्चने तथा
verses.transliteration: pāṣaṇḍe khyāpite tena viṣṇunā viśvayoninā tyakte maheśvare daityais tyakte liṅgārcane tathā
verses.translation: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.hindi: रत्ननिर्मित होता है; वह सात प्रकारका होता है। शिवजीका तीसरे प्रकारका लिङ्ग धातुनिर्मित होता है; वह आठ प्रकारका होता है। चौथे प्रकारका लिङ्ग लकड़ीसे बना होता है; बह सोलह प्रकारका कहा जाता
verses.wordMeaning: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—

verses.sanskrit: स्त्रीधर्मे निखिले नष्टे दुराचारे व्यवस्थिते कृतार्थ इव देवेशो देवैः सार्धमुमापतिम्
verses.transliteration: strīdharme nikhile naṣṭe durācāre vyavasthite kṛtārtha iva deveśo devaiḥ sārdhamumāpatim
verses.translation: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.hindi: है। है श्रेष्ठ द्विजो! पाँचवें प्रकारका लिङ्ग मिट्टीसे बना होता है; वह दो विभागोंवाला होता है । छठे प्रकारका लिङ्ग क्षणिक (रंगवल्लीनिर्मित) होता है; वह साप प्रकारका कहा गया है रत्ननिर्मित लिङ्ग श्री (लक्ष्मी) प्रदान करनेवाला, पाषाणनिर्मित लिङ्ग समस्त सिद्धियोंको देनेवाला, धातुनिर्मित लिङ्ग साक्षात् धन प्रदान करनेवाला तथा काष्ठनिर्मित लिङ्ग भोग सिद्धि प्रदान करनेवाला है ह श्रेष्ठ विप्रो!
verses.wordMeaning: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—

verses.sanskrit: तपसा प्राप्य सर्वज्ञं तुष्टाव पुरुषोत्तमः महेश्वराय देवाय नमस्ते परमात्मने
verses.transliteration: tapasā prāpya sarvajñaṃ tuṣṭāva puruṣottamaḥ maheśvarāya devāya namaste paramātmane
verses.translation: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.hindi: मिट्टीसे बना हुआ (पार्थिव) शुभ लिङ्ग सभी प्राप्ति करानेवाला है। पाषाणनिर्मित लिङ्ग उत्तम तथा धातुनिर्मित लिङ्ग मध्यम कहा गया है॥ १७-१८ !
verses.wordMeaning: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—

verses.sanskrit: नारायणाय शर्वाय ब्रह्मणे ब्रह्मरूपिणे शाश्वताय ह्यनन्ताय अव्यक्ताय च ते नमः
verses.transliteration: nārāyaṇāya śarvāya brahmaṇe brahmarūpiṇe śāśvatāya hyanantāya avyaktāya ca te namaḥ
verses.translation: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.hindi: अध्याय ७४ ब्रह्माकी आज्ञासे विश्वकर्माद्वारा विभिन्न लिङ्गोंका निर्माण""स्थापनाका माहात्म्य परी करकजा क फ कअक फ फ फ फफ फ फा फाफ फ फफफ फ फ फफफ फा क फ फ फ माफ फक क क म की मी फी मी क की जी मीनी ज फफ फ फ फ फ फ फ फ क क फ फ फ फ़ फ फ क फ फ फ फ फ़ फ़ फ फ फ़ फ़ फ फ फ़ फ फ फ़ फ क फ फफ फ़ फ फा फ फ फा मी फ मी जी मी मी
verses.wordMeaning: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—

verses.sanskrit: एवं स्तुत्वा महादेवं दण्डवत्प्रणिपत्य च जजाप रुद्रं भगवान् कोटिवारं जले स्थितः
verses.transliteration: evaṃ stutvā mahādevaṃ daṇḍavatpraṇipatya ca jajāpa rudraṃ bhagavān koṭivāraṃ jale sthitaḥ
verses.translation: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.hindi: लिङ्गभेदाश्च नव चैव समासतः। मूले ब्रह्मा तथा मध्ये विष्णुस्त्रिभुवनेशवरः
verses.wordMeaning: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—

verses.sanskrit: देवाश् च सर्वे ते देवं तुष्टुवुः परमेश्वरम् सेन्द्राः ससाध्याः सयमाः सरुद्राः समरुद्गणाः
verses.transliteration: devāś ca sarve te devaṃ tuṣṭuvuḥ parameśvaram sendrāḥ sasādhyāḥ sayamāḥ sarudrāḥ samarudgaṇāḥ
verses.translation: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.hindi: रूद्रोपरि महादेवः प्रणवाख्यः सदाशिवः। लिङ्गवेदी महादेवी त्रिगुणा त्रिमयाम्बिका तया च पूजयेद्यस्तु देवी देवश्च पूजितौ। शैलजं रत्नजं वापि धातुजं वापि दारुजम्
verses.wordMeaning: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—

verses.sanskrit: नमः सर्वात्मने तुभ्यं शङ्करायार्तिहारिणे रुद्राय नीलरुद्राय कद्रुद्राय प्रचेतसे
verses.transliteration: namaḥ sarvātmane tubhyaṃ śaṅkarāyārtihāriṇe rudrāya nīlarudrāya kadrudrāya pracetase
verses.translation: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.hindi: स्तूयमानः सुपुण्यात्मा देवदुन्दुभिनिःस्वनैः
verses.wordMeaning: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—

verses.sanskrit: गतिर्नः सर्वदास्माभिर् वन्द्यो देवारिमर्दनः त्वमादिस्त्वमनन्तश् च अनन्तश्चाक्षयः प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: gatirnaḥ sarvadāsmābhir vandyo devārimardanaḥ tvamādistvamanantaś ca anantaścākṣayaḥ prabhuḥ
verses.translation: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.hindi: भूर्भुवःस्वर्महरलोकान् क्रमाद्वै जनतः परम्। तपः सत्यं पराक्रम्य भासयन् स्वेन तेजसा आशु ब्रह्माण्डमुद्भिद्य निर्गच्छेन्निर्विशङ्कया
verses.wordMeaning: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—

verses.sanskrit: प्रकृतिः पुरुषः साक्षात् स्रष्टा हर्ता जगद्गुरो त्राता नेता जगत्यस्मिन् द्विजानां द्विजवत्सल
verses.transliteration: prakṛtiḥ puruṣaḥ sākṣāt sraṣṭā hartā jagadguro trātā netā jagatyasmin dvijānāṃ dvijavatsala
verses.translation: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.hindi: कुन्दगोक्षीरसङ्काशं लिङ्गं यः स्थापयेन्नरः
verses.wordMeaning: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—

verses.sanskrit: वरदो वाङ्मयो वाच्यो वाच्यवाचकवर्जितः याज्यो मुक्त्यर्थमीशानो योगिभिर् योगविभ्रमैः
verses.transliteration: varado vāṅmayo vācyo vācyavācakavarjitaḥ yājyo muktyarthamīśāno yogibhir yogavibhramaiḥ
verses.translation: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.hindi: नृणां तनुं समास्थाय स्थितो रुद्रो न संशयः। दर्शनात्स्पर्शनात्तस्य लभन्ते निर्वृतिं नराः लिङ्गोंके बहुत भेद हैं; संक्षेपमें वे नौ हैं। लिङ्गके मूलमें ब्रह्मा, मध्यमें तीनों लोकोंके ईश्वर
verses.wordMeaning: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—

verses.sanskrit: हृत्पुण्डरीकसुषिरे योगिनां संस्थितः सदा वदन्ति सूरयः सन्तं परं ब्रह्मस्वरूपिणम्
verses.transliteration: hṛtpuṇḍarīkasuṣire yogināṃ saṃsthitaḥ sadā vadanti sūrayaḥ santaṃ paraṃ brahmasvarūpiṇam
verses.translation: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.hindi: विष्णु तथा ऊपरी भागमें प्रणवसंज्ञक महादेव रुद्र सदाशिव विराजमान रहते हैं। लिङ्गको वेदी महादेवी
verses.wordMeaning: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—

verses.sanskrit: भवन्तं तत्त्वम् इत्यार्यास् तेजोराशिं परात्परम् परमात्मानमित्याहुर् अस्मिञ्जगति तद्विभो
verses.transliteration: bhavantaṃ tattvam ityāryās tejorāśiṃ parātparam paramātmānamityāhur asmiñjagati tadvibho
verses.translation: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.hindi: अम्बिका हैं; वे सत्, रज, तम तीनों गुणोंसे तथा त्रिदेबोंसे युक्त रहती हैं। जो उस वेदी-के साथ
verses.wordMeaning: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—

verses.sanskrit: दृष्टं श्रुतं स्थितं सर्वं जायमानं जगद्गुरो अणोरल्पतरं प्राहुर् महतो ऽपि महत्तरम्
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭaṃ śrutaṃ sthitaṃ sarvaṃ jāyamānaṃ jagadguro aṇoralpataraṃ prāhur mahato 'pi mahattaram
verses.translation: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.hindi: लिङ्गकी पूजा करता है, उसने मानो महादेव तथा भगवती पार्वती -का पूजन कर लिया । पाषाणनिर्मित, रत्ननिर्मित, धातुनिर्मित, काष्ठनिर्मित, पार्थिव अथवा क्षणिक जो भी लिङ्ग हो-उसे भक्तिपूर्वक स्थापित करके व्यक्ति
verses.wordMeaning: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—

verses.sanskrit: सर्वतः पाणिपादं त्वां सर्वतो ऽक्षिशिरोमुखम् सर्वतः श्रुतिमल्लोके सर्वमावृत्य तिष्ठसि
verses.transliteration: sarvataḥ pāṇipādaṃ tvāṃ sarvato 'kṣiśiromukham sarvataḥ śrutimalloke sarvamāvṛtya tiṣṭhasi
verses.translation: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.hindi: शुभ फल प्राप्त करता है। वह परम पुण्यात्मा इन्द्र, ब्रह्मा, यक्षों, दानवों तथा किन्नरोंके द्वारा देवढुन्दुभियोंकी ध्वनिसे स्तुत होता हुआ क्रमशः भूः, भुवः, स्वः, महः, जन, तप तथा सत्य लोकोंको लाँघकर अपने तेजसे प्रकाशित होता हुआ लिङ्गस्थापन आदि सन्मार्गमे निहित
verses.wordMeaning: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—

verses.sanskrit: महादेवमनिर्देश्यं सर्वज्ञं त्वामनामयम् विश्वरूपं विरूपाक्षं सदाशिवम् अनामयम्
verses.transliteration: mahādevamanirdeśyaṃ sarvajñaṃ tvāmanāmayam viśvarūpaṃ virūpākṣaṃ sadāśivam anāmayam
verses.translation: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.hindi: स्वाधीन खड्गसे शीघ्र ही ब्रह्माण्डका भेदन करके निःशंक भावसे मुक्त हो जाता है
verses.wordMeaning: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—

verses.sanskrit: कोटिभास्करसंकाशं कोटिशीतांशुसन्निभम् कोटिकालाग्निसंकाशं षड्विंशकमनीश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: koṭibhāskarasaṃkāśaṃ koṭiśītāṃśusannibham koṭikālāgnisaṃkāśaṃ ṣaḍviṃśakamanīśvaram
verses.translation: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.hindi: पाषाणनिर्मित, रत्ननिर्मित, धातुनिर्मित, काष्ठनिर्मित, पार्थिव अथवा क्षणिक लिङ्गकी अपेक्षा चन्द्रकलादिसहित बाणलिङ्ग आदिकी स्थापना करनी चाहिए। विधिपूर्वक लिङ्ग बनाकर जो मनुष्य कार्तिकेय-पार्वतीसहित कुन्द पुष्प तथा गायके दूधके समान वर्णवाले शुभ लिङ्गको स्थापित करता है, वह मानव-शरीर धारण करके भी रुद्रके रूपमें स्थित रहता है; इसमें सन्देह नहीं है। उसके दर्शन तथा स्पर्शसे अन्य मनुष्य मुक्ति प्राप्त करते हैं। हे
verses.wordMeaning: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—

verses.sanskrit: प्रवर्तकं जगत्यस्मिन् प्रकृतेः प्रपितामहम् वदन्ति वरदं देवं सर्वावासं स्वयंभुवम्
verses.transliteration: pravartakaṃ jagatyasmin prakṛteḥ prapitāmaham vadanti varadaṃ devaṃ sarvāvāsaṃ svayaṃbhuvam
verses.translation: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.hindi: विप्रेन्द्रो मैं उसके पुण्यका सम्यक् वर्णन सैकड़ों युगोंमें भी नहीं कर सकता हूँ, अतः विधिपूर्वक लिङ्गको स्थापित करना चाहिए। सभी मनुष्योंके लिये प्रभुका सकल (सगुण), दिव्य तथा शुभ विग्रह भावनाके योग्य है, किंतु
verses.wordMeaning: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—

verses.sanskrit: श्रुतयः श्रुतिसारं त्वां श्रुतिसारविदो जनाः
verses.transliteration: śrutayaḥ śrutisāraṃ tvāṃ śrutisāravido janāḥ
verses.translation: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.hindi: योगियोंके लिये निष्कल (निर्गुण) विग्रह भावनाके योग्य है शिवलिङ्गभेदसंस्थापनादिवर्णं नाम चतुः सप्ततितमोऽध्यायः
verses.wordMeaning: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—

verses.sanskrit: अदृष्टमस्माभिर् अनेकमूर्ते विना कृतं यद्भवताथ लोके त्वमेव दैत्यासुरभूतसंघान् देवान् नरान् स्थावरजङ्गमांश् च
verses.transliteration: adṛṣṭamasmābhir anekamūrte vinā kṛtaṃ yadbhavatātha loke tvameva daityāsurabhūtasaṃghān devān narān sthāvarajaṅgamāṃś ca
verses.translation: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.hindi: नामक चौहत्तरवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ
verses.wordMeaning: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—

verses.sanskrit: पाहि नान्या गतिः शंभो विनिहत्यासुरोत्तमान् मायया मोहिताः सर्वे भवतः परमेश्वर
verses.transliteration: pāhi nānyā gatiḥ śaṃbho vinihatyāsurottamān māyayā mohitāḥ sarve bhavataḥ parameśvara
verses.translation: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.hindi: 0000 अकम पिसमा फ फ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ फफ फ़ फ फ़ फ़ फ फ़ फ क फ फ़ फ़ फक फ़ फ फ़ फफ फा फा का मी की फी की की फी ऊ फ फ फा फ फ क फ फ फ फा क क क का का फ फ़ फ फ फ फ का फ फ फ फ फ फ फ फ फ फ फ कफ शिवके निर्गुण एवं सगुणस्वरूपका निरूपण
verses.wordMeaning: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—

verses.sanskrit: यथा तरङ्गा लहरीसमूहा युध्यन्ति चान्योन्यमपांनिधौ च जलाश्रयादेव जडीकृताश् च सुरासुरास्तद्वदजस्य सर्वम्
verses.transliteration: yathā taraṅgā laharīsamūhā yudhyanti cānyonyamapāṃnidhau ca jalāśrayādeva jaḍīkṛtāś ca surāsurāstadvadajasya sarvam
verses.translation: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.hindi: परमार्थविदः केचिदूचुः प्रणवरूपिणम्। विज्ञानमिति विप्रेन्द्राः श्रुत्वा श्रुतिशिरस्यजम्
verses.wordMeaning: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—

verses.sanskrit: य इदं प्रातरुत्थाय शुचिर्भूत्वा जपेन्नरः शृणुयाद्वा स्तवं पुण्यं सर्वकामम् अवाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: ya idaṃ prātarutthāya śucirbhūtvā japennaraḥ śṛṇuyādvā stavaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvakāmam avāpnuyāt
verses.translation: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.hindi: गुरुप्रकाशकं ज्ञानमित्यन्ये मुनयो द्विजा: वदन्ति मुनयः केचित्कर्मणा तस्य सङ्घतिम्। कल्पनाकल्पितं रूपं संहृत्य स्वेच्छयैव हि
verses.wordMeaning: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—

verses.sanskrit: स्तुतस्त्वेवं सुरैर्विष्णोर् जपेन च महेश्वरः सोमः सोमाम् अथालिङ्ग्य नन्दिदत्तकरः स्मयन्
verses.transliteration: stutastvevaṃ surairviṣṇor japena ca maheśvaraḥ somaḥ somām athāliṅgya nandidattakaraḥ smayan
verses.translation: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.hindi: देवास्तस्य भुजाः सर्वे नक्षत्राणि च भूषणम्
verses.wordMeaning: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—

verses.sanskrit: प्राह गंभीरया वाचा देवानालोक्य शङ्करः ज्ञातं मयेदमधुना देवकार्यं सुरेश्वराः
verses.transliteration: prāha gaṃbhīrayā vācā devānālokya śaṅkaraḥ jñātaṃ mayedamadhunā devakāryaṃ sureśvarāḥ
verses.translation: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.hindi: वक्त्राद्वै ब्राह्मणाः सर्वे ब्रह्मा च भगवान् प्रभुः पुष्करावर्तकाद्यास्तु केशास्तस्य प्रकीर्तिताः । वायवो घ्राणजास्तस्य गतिः श्रौतं स्मृतिस्तथा
verses.wordMeaning: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—

verses.sanskrit: विष्णोर् मायाबलं चैव नारदस्य च धीमतः तेषामधर्मनिष्ठानां दैत्यानां देवसत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: viṣṇor māyābalaṃ caiva nāradasya ca dhīmataḥ teṣāmadharmaniṣṭhānāṃ daityānāṃ devasattamāḥ
verses.translation: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.hindi: ऋषिगण बोले--निष्कल (निर्गुण), निर्मल ल नित्य (शाश्वत) शिव सकलत्व (सगुणता)-को कैसे प्राप्त हुए? है सूतजी! आपने जैसा पहले सुना है, उसे हम लोगोंको बताइये
verses.wordMeaning: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—

verses.sanskrit: पुरत्रयविनाशं च करिष्ये ऽहं सुरोत्तमाः अथ सब्रह्मका देवाः सेन्द्रोपेन्द्राः समागताः
verses.transliteration: puratrayavināśaṃ ca kariṣye 'haṃ surottamāḥ atha sabrahmakā devāḥ sendropendrāḥ samāgatāḥ
verses.translation: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.hindi: सूतजी बोले- है श्रेष्ठ विप्रो! कुछ तत्त्वज्ञे उपनिषदोंमें शिवको अजन्मा सुनकर उन्हें प्रणवरूप विज्ञान कहा है । शब्द आदि विषयोंका जो ज्ञान है, उसे 'ज्ञान' कहा जाता है। अन्य लोग कहते हैं कि जो भ्रान्तिरहित ज्ञान है, वही ज्ञान है; दूसरे लोग कहते हैं कि ऐसा कुछ नहीं है
verses.wordMeaning: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—

verses.sanskrit: श्रुत्वा प्रभोस्तदा वाक्यं प्रणेमुस्तुष्टुवुश् च ते अप्येतदन्तरे देवी देवमालोक्य विस्मिता
verses.transliteration: śrutvā prabhostadā vākyaṃ praṇemustuṣṭuvuś ca te apyetadantare devī devamālokya vismitā
verses.translation: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.hindi: हे द्विजो! अन्य मुनि लोग कहते हैं कि जो ज्ञान निर्मल, शुद्ध, निर्विकल्प, आश्रयरहित तथा गुरुके द्वारा प्रकाशित है, वह वास्तविक ज्ञान है
verses.wordMeaning: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—

verses.sanskrit: लीलांबुजेन चाहत्य कलमाह वृषध्वजम् क्रीडमानं विभो पश्य षण्मुखं रविसन्निभम्
verses.transliteration: līlāṃbujena cāhatya kalamāha vṛṣadhvajam krīḍamānaṃ vibho paśya ṣaṇmukhaṃ ravisannibham
verses.translation: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.hindi: ज्ञानसे ही मुक्ति प्राप्त होती है; ज्ञानसिद्धिके लिये ईश्वरकी  प्रसन्‍नता आवश्यक है। दोनोंके द्वारा योगी मुक्त हो जाता है और वह आनन्दमय हो जाता है। कुछ मुनि स्वेच्छासे मायाविरचित रूपको हृदयमें भावित करके (विचारकर) विधिप्रतिपादित निष्काम कर्मद्वारा उस ज्ञानकी संगतिको बताते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—

verses.sanskrit: पुत्रं पुत्रवतां श्रेष्ठं भूषितं भूषणैः शुभैः मुकुटैः कटकैश्चैव कुण्डलैर्वलयैः शुभैः
verses.transliteration: putraṃ putravatāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ bhūṣitaṃ bhūṣaṇaiḥ śubhaiḥ mukuṭaiḥ kaṭakaiścaiva kuṇḍalairvalayaiḥ śubhaiḥ
verses.translation: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.hindi: द्यौ (स्वर्ग) उन विभुका सिर है, आकाश उन परमेश्वरकी नाभि है, चन्द्र-सूर्य-अग्नि उनके नेत्र हैं, दिशाएँ उन महात्माके कान हैं, पाताल ही उनके दोनों चरण हैं, समुद्र उनका वस्त्र है, सभी
verses.wordMeaning: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—

verses.sanskrit: नूपुरैश्छन्नवारैश् च तथा ह्य् उदरबन्धनैः किङ्किणीभिर् अनेकाभिर् हैमैरश्वत्थपत्रकैः
verses.transliteration: nūpuraiśchannavāraiś ca tathā hy udarabandhanaiḥ kiṅkiṇībhir anekābhir haimairaśvatthapatrakaiḥ
verses.translation: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.hindi: आभूषण हैं। प्रकृतिको उनकी पत्नी तथा पुरुषको उनका लिङ्ग कहा जाता है। सभी ब्राह्मण, ब्रह्मा भगवान् विष्णु, इन्द्र तथा उपेन्द्र उनके मुखसे; महात्मा क्षत्रिय भुजाओंसे; वैश्य उनके उरुप्रदेशसे तथा शह उन पिनाकधारीके पैरसे उत्पन्न हुए हैं। पुष्कर आवर्त आदि मेघ उनके केश कहे गये हैं। सभी वायु उनकी नासिकासे उत्पन्न हुए हैं। श्रुति तथा स्मृतिमें कथित कर्म उनकी गति हैँ
verses.wordMeaning: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—

verses.sanskrit: कल्पकद्रुमजैः पुष्पैः शोभितैरलकैः शुभैः हारैर् वारिजरागादिमणिचित्रैस् तथाङ्गदैः
verses.transliteration: kalpakadrumajaiḥ puṣpaiḥ śobhitairalakaiḥ śubhaiḥ hārair vārijarāgādimaṇicitrais tathāṅgadaiḥ
verses.translation: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.hindi: शिवके निर्गुण एवं सगुणस्वरूपका निरूपण
verses.wordMeaning: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—

verses.sanskrit: मुक्ताफलमयैर्हारैः पूर्णचन्द्रसमप्रभैः तिलकैश् च महादेव पश्य पुत्रं सुशोभनम्
verses.transliteration: muktāphalamayairhāraiḥ pūrṇacandrasamaprabhaiḥ tilakaiś ca mahādeva paśya putraṃ suśobhanam
verses.translation: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.hindi: अथानेनैव कर्मात्मा प्रकृतेस्तु प्रवर्तक: । पुंसां तु पुरुषः श्रीमान् ज्ञानगम्यो न चान्यथा कर्मयञ्ञसहस्त्रेभ्यस्तपोयज्ञो विशिष्यते।
verses.wordMeaning: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—

verses.sanskrit: अङ्कितं कुङ्कुमाद्यैश् च वृत्तं भसितनिर्मितम् वक्त्रवृन्दं च पश्येश वृन्दं कामलकं यथा
verses.transliteration: aṅkitaṃ kuṅkumādyaiś ca vṛttaṃ bhasitanirmitam vaktravṛndaṃ ca paśyeśa vṛndaṃ kāmalakaṃ yathā
verses.translation: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.hindi: तपोयज्ञसहस्त्रेभ्यो जपयज्ञो विशिष्यते
verses.wordMeaning: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—

verses.sanskrit: नेत्राणि च विभो पश्य शुभानि त्वं शुभानि च अञ्जनानि विचित्राणि मङ्गलार्थं च मातृभिः
verses.transliteration: netrāṇi ca vibho paśya śubhāni tvaṃ śubhāni ca añjanāni vicitrāṇi maṅgalārthaṃ ca mātṛbhiḥ
verses.translation: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.hindi: जपयज्ञसहस्त्रेभ्यो ध्यानयज्ञो विशिष्यते। ध्यानयज्ञात्परो नास्ति ध्यानं ज्ञानस्य साधनम्
verses.wordMeaning: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—

verses.sanskrit: गङ्गादिभिः कृत्तिकाद्यैः स्वाहया च विशेषतः इत्येवं लोकमातुश् च वाग्भिः संबोधितः शिवः
verses.transliteration: gaṅgādibhiḥ kṛttikādyaiḥ svāhayā ca viśeṣataḥ ityevaṃ lokamātuś ca vāgbhiḥ saṃbodhitaḥ śivaḥ
verses.translation: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.hindi: यदा समरसे निष्ठो योगी ध्यानेन पश्यति।
verses.wordMeaning: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—

verses.sanskrit: न ययौ तृप्तिमीशानः पिबन्स्कन्दाननामृतम् न सस्मार च तान्देवान् दैत्यशस्त्रनिपीडितान्
verses.transliteration: na yayau tṛptimīśānaḥ pibanskandānanāmṛtam na sasmāra ca tāndevān daityaśastranipīḍitān
verses.translation: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.hindi: ध्यानयज्ञरतस्यास्य तदा सन्निहितः शिवः विशुद्धा विद्यया सर्वे ब्रह्मविद्याविदो जनाः
verses.wordMeaning: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—

verses.sanskrit: स्कन्दमालिङ्ग्य चाघ्राय नृत्य पुत्रेत्युवाच ह सो ऽपि लीलालसो बालो ननर्तार्तिहरः प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: skandamāliṅgya cāghrāya nṛtya putretyuvāca ha so 'pi līlālaso bālo nanartārtiharaḥ prabhuḥ
verses.translation: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.hindi: नास्ति क्रिया च लोकेषु सुखं दुःखं विचारतः।
verses.wordMeaning: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—

verses.sanskrit: सहैव ननृतुश्चान्ये सह तेन गणेश्वराः त्रैलोक्यमखिलं तत्र ननर्तेशाज्ञया क्षणम्
verses.transliteration: sahaiva nanṛtuścānye saha tena gaṇeśvarāḥ trailokyamakhilaṃ tatra nanarteśājñayā kṣaṇam
verses.translation: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.hindi: धर्माधर्मौं जपो होमो ध्यानिनां सन्निधिः सदा परानन्दात्मकं लिङ्गं विशुद्धं शिवमक्षरम्। निष्कलं सर्वगं ज्ञेयं योगिनां हृदि संस्थितम्
verses.wordMeaning: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—

verses.sanskrit: नागाश् च ननृतुः सर्वे देवाः सेन्द्रपुरोगमाः तुष्टुवुर्गणपाः स्कन्दं मुमोदांबा च मातरः
verses.transliteration: nāgāś ca nanṛtuḥ sarve devāḥ sendrapurogamāḥ tuṣṭuvurgaṇapāḥ skandaṃ mumodāṃbā ca mātaraḥ
verses.translation: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.hindi: लिङ्गं तु द्विविधं प्राहुर्बाह्ममाभ्यन्तरं द्विजाः । बाह्यं स्थूलं मुनिश्रेष्ठाः सूक्ष्ममाभ्यन्तरं द्विजाः
verses.wordMeaning: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—

verses.sanskrit: ससृजुः पुष्पवर्षाणि जगुर्गन्धर्वकिन्नराः नृत्यामृतं तदा पीत्वा पार्वतीपरमेश्वरौ अवापतुस् तदा तृप्तिं नन्दिना च गणेश्वराः
verses.transliteration: sasṛjuḥ puṣpavarṣāṇi jagurgandharvakinnarāḥ nṛtyāmṛtaṃ tadā pītvā pārvatīparameśvarau avāpatus tadā tṛptiṃ nandinā ca gaṇeśvarāḥ
verses.translation: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.hindi: कर्मयज्ञरताः स्थूलाः स्थूललिङ्गार्चने रताः। असतां भावनार्थाय नान्यथा स्थूलविग्रहः आध्यात्मिकं च यल्लिङ्ग प्रत्यक्षं यस्य नो भवेत्। असौ मूढो बहिः सर्व कल्पयित्वैव नान्यथा
verses.wordMeaning: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—

verses.sanskrit: ततः स नन्दी सह षण्मुखेन तथा च सार्धं गिरिराजपुत्र्या विवेश दिव्यं भवनं भवो ऽपि यथाम्बुदो ऽन्याम्बुदम् अम्बुदाभः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sa nandī saha ṣaṇmukhena tathā ca sārdhaṃ girirājaputryā viveśa divyaṃ bhavanaṃ bhavo 'pi yathāmbudo 'nyāmbudam ambudābhaḥ
verses.translation: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.hindi: यथा स्थूलमयुक्तानां मृत्काष्ठाद्यैः प्रकल्पितम्
verses.wordMeaning: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—

verses.sanskrit: द्वारस्य पार्श्वे ते तस्थुर् देवा देवस्य धीमतः तुष्टुवुश् च महादेवं किंचिद् उद्विग्नचेतसः
verses.transliteration: dvārasya pārśve te tasthur devā devasya dhīmataḥ tuṣṭuvuś ca mahādevaṃ kiṃcid udvignacetasaḥ
verses.translation: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.hindi: निष्कलः सकलश्चेति सर्व शिवमयं ततः॥ २३ सतता त सकलश्चेति सर्व शिवमयं ततः  श्रोमद्धागवतके एकादश स्कन्धके अनुसार बन्धन मायामूलक है मत तिना
verses.wordMeaning: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—

verses.sanskrit: किंतु किंत्विति चान्योन्यं प्रेक्ष्य चैतत्समाकुलाः पापा वयम् इति ह्यन्ये अभाग्याश्चेति चापरे
verses.transliteration: kiṃtu kiṃtviti cānyonyaṃ prekṣya caitatsamākulāḥ pāpā vayam iti hyanye abhāgyāśceti cāpare
verses.translation: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.hindi: इसी शरीर-से वे परमात्मा कर्मरूप होकर प्रकृतिका प्रवर्तन करते हैं । वे ऐश्वर्यशाली पुरुष (परमात्मा) मनुष्योंके लिये ज्ञानगम्य हैं; इसमें सन्देह नहीं है । तपोयज्ञ हजार कर्मयज्ञोंसे बढ़कर है, जपयज्ञ हजार तपोयज्ञोंसे
verses.wordMeaning: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—

verses.sanskrit: भाग्यवन्तश् च दैत्येन्द्रा इति चान्ये सुरेश्वराः पूजाफलमिमं तेषाम् इत्यन्ये नेति चापरे
verses.transliteration: bhāgyavantaś ca daityendrā iti cānye sureśvarāḥ pūjāphalamimaṃ teṣām ityanye neti cāpare
verses.translation: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.hindi: बढ़कर है और ध्यानयज्ञ हजार जपयज्ञोंसे बढ़कर है। ध्यानयज्ञसे श्रेष्ठ कुछ भी नहीं है; ध्यान ज्ञानका साधन है। जब योगी समरसमें स्थित होकर ध्यानके द्वारा देखता है, तब शिव ध्यानयज्ञमें लीन उस योगी -को प्रत्यक्ष दर्शन देते हैं॥ १२--१५॥
verses.wordMeaning: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—

verses.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे तेषां श्रुत्वा शब्दाननेकशः कुम्भोदरो महातेजा दण्डेनाताडयत्सुरान्
verses.transliteration: etasminnantare teṣāṃ śrutvā śabdānanekaśaḥ kumbhodaro mahātejā daṇḍenātāḍayatsurān
verses.translation: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.hindi: विज्ञानियोंके लिये शुद्धि, प्रायश्चित्त आदि कर्म आवश्यक नहीं हैं; ब्रह्मविद्याको जाननेवाले सभी लोग ब्रह्म विद्यासे पूर्णरूपसे शुद्ध हो जाते हैं। विचारकी दृष्टिसे ध्यानियोंके लिये लोकोंमें क्रिया, सुख, दुःख,
verses.wordMeaning: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—

verses.sanskrit: दुद्रुवुस्ते भयाविष्टा देवा हाहेतिवादिनः अपतन्मुनयश्चान्ये देवाश् च धरणीतले
verses.transliteration: dudruvuste bhayāviṣṭā devā hāhetivādinaḥ apatanmunayaścānye devāś ca dharaṇītale
verses.translation: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.hindi: धर्म, अधर्म, जप, होम आदि आवश्यक नहीं हैं; उनके लिये शिव-सन्निधि ही मुख्य है। परम आनन्दमय, विशुद्ध, कल्याणकारी, अविनाशी, निष्कल तथा सर्वव्यापी लिङ्गको योगियोंके हृदयमें सदा विराजमान जानना हे द्विजो! लिङ्ग दो प्रकारका कहा गया है-बाह्य तथा आभ्यन्तर। है श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! स्थूल लिङ्ग बाह्य होता है और सूक्ष्म लिङ्ग आभ्यन्तर होता है
verses.wordMeaning: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—

verses.sanskrit: अहो विधेर्बलं चेति मुनयः कश्यपादयः दृष्ट्वापि देवदेवेशं देवानां चासुरद्विषाम्
verses.transliteration: aho vidherbalaṃ ceti munayaḥ kaśyapādayaḥ dṛṣṭvāpi devadeveśaṃ devānāṃ cāsuradviṣām
verses.translation: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.hindi: कर्मयज्ञमें निरत तथा स्थूलस्वभाववाले स्थूललिङ्गके अर्चनमें संलग्न रहते हैं। अज्ञानी जनोंकी भावनासिद्धिके लिये ही स्थूलविग्रह कल्पित किया गया है; इसमें दूसरा हेतु नहीं है। जो आध्यात्मिक सूक्ष्मलिद्ध है, उसका
verses.wordMeaning: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—

verses.sanskrit: अभाग्यान्न समाप्तं तु कार्यमित्यपरे द्विजाः प्रोचुर्नमः शिवायेति पूज्य चाल्पतरं हृदि
verses.transliteration: abhāgyānna samāptaṃ tu kāryamityapare dvijāḥ procurnamaḥ śivāyeti pūjya cālpataraṃ hṛdi
verses.translation: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.hindi: प्रत्यक्ष दर्शन जिसे नहीं होता है, ऐसा वह अज्ञानी व्यक्ति “सन कुछ बाहर है '--यह कल्पना करके ही पूजनादिमें प्रवृत्त होता है; इसमें सन्देह नहीं है। जैसे ज्ञानियोंके लिये प्रत्यक्षरूपसे सूक्ष्म, निर्मल तथा अव्यय (अविनाशी) लिङ्गकी कल्पना की गयी है, वैसे ही सामान्य लोगोंके लिये मिट्टी, काष्ठ आदिसे निर्मित स्थूल लिङ्ग प्रकल्पित है। अतः विचार करनेसे निरवयव तथा सावयव-- सब कुछ शिवमय ही है। मोक्षरूप पुरुषार्थको भी
verses.wordMeaning: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—

verses.sanskrit: ततः कपर्दी नन्दीशो महादेवप्रियो मुनिः शूली माली तथा हाली कुण्डली वलयी गदी
verses.transliteration: tataḥ kapardī nandīśo mahādevapriyo muniḥ śūlī mālī tathā hālī kuṇḍalī valayī gadī
verses.translation: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.hindi: सत्ता नहीं है-एऐसा अन्य तत्त्ववेत्तालोग कहते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—

verses.sanskrit: वृषमारुह्य सुश्वेतं ययौ तस्याज्ञया तदा ततो वै नन्दिनं दृष्ट्वा गणः कुम्भोदरो ऽपि सः
verses.transliteration: vṛṣamāruhya suśvetaṃ yayau tasyājñayā tadā tato vai nandinaṃ dṛṣṭvā gaṇaḥ kumbhodaro 'pi saḥ
verses.translation: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.hindi: FRNA नन न ति कालाकार फफ फ़ फ फ़ फ़ फ फ फ फ़ फ फ फ फ़ फ फ फ फ फ फ फी फ़ फ फी फ फ फी फफफफफफ्फ्रफ फफफ फफ फफ फ फफ कफम फफफ फफफ भाक फफफफफफफ फफफ फ फफफ फक ५ पृथक्त्वञ्चापृथक्त्वं च शङ्करस्येति चापरे
verses.wordMeaning: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—

verses.sanskrit: प्रणम्य नन्दिनं मूर्ध्ना सह तेन त्वरन् ययौ नन्दी भाति महातेजा वृषपृष्ठे वृषध्वजः
verses.transliteration: praṇamya nandinaṃ mūrdhnā saha tena tvaran yayau nandī bhāti mahātejā vṛṣapṛṣṭhe vṛṣadhvajaḥ
verses.translation: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.hindi: प्रत्ययार्थं हि जगतामेकस्थोऽपि दिवाकरः । एकोऽपि बहुधा दृष्टो जलाधारेषु सुव्रताः
verses.wordMeaning: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—

verses.sanskrit: सगणो गणसेनानीर् मेघपृष्ठे यथा भवः दशयोजनविस्तीर्णं मुक्ताजालैर् अलंकृतम्
verses.transliteration: sagaṇo gaṇasenānīr meghapṛṣṭhe yathā bhavaḥ daśayojanavistīrṇaṃ muktājālair alaṃkṛtam
verses.translation: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.hindi: जन्तवो दिवि भूमौ च सर्वे वै पाञ्चभौतिकाः। तथापि बहुला दृष्टा जातिव्यक्तिविभेदतः दृश्यते श्रूयते यद्यत्तत्तद्विद्धि शिवात्मकम्। भेदो जनानां लोकेऽस्मिन् प्रतिभासो विचारत:
verses.wordMeaning: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—

verses.sanskrit: सितातपत्रं शैलादेर् आकाशमिव भाति तत् तत्रान्तर्बद्धमाला सा मुक्ताफलमयी शुभा
verses.transliteration: sitātapatraṃ śailāder ākāśamiva bhāti tat tatrāntarbaddhamālā sā muktāphalamayī śubhā
verses.translation: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.hindi: योगिनां निष्कलो देवो ज्ञानिनां च जगन्मयः। त्रिविधं परमेशस्य वपुर्लोके प्रशस्यते
verses.wordMeaning: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—

verses.sanskrit: गङ्गाकाशान्निपतिता भाति मूर्ध्नि विभोर्यथा अथ दृष्ट्वा गणाध्यक्षं देवदुन्दुभयः शुभाः
verses.transliteration: gaṅgākāśānnipatitā bhāti mūrdhni vibhoryathā atha dṛṣṭvā gaṇādhyakṣaṃ devadundubhayaḥ śubhāḥ
verses.translation: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.hindi: अर्चयन्ति मुहुः केचित्सदा सकलनिष्कलम्। सर्वज्ञं हृदये केचिच्छिवलिङ्गे विभावसौ सकलं मुनयः केचित्सदा संसारवर्तिनः। एवमभ्यर्चयन्त्येव सदाराः ससुता नराः
verses.wordMeaning: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—

verses.sanskrit: नियोगाद्वज्रिणः सर्वे विनेदुर्मुनिपुङ्गवाः तुष्टुवुश् च गणेशानं वाग्भिर् इष्टप्रदं शुभम्
verses.transliteration: niyogādvajriṇaḥ sarve vinedurmunipuṅgavāḥ tuṣṭuvuś ca gaṇeśānaṃ vāgbhir iṣṭapradaṃ śubham
verses.translation: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.hindi: यथा शिवस्तथा देवी यथा देवी तथा शिव: । तस्मादभेदबुद्भ्यैव सप्तविंशत्प्रभेदतः
verses.wordMeaning: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—

verses.sanskrit: यथा देवा भवं दृष्ट्वा प्रीतिकण्टकितत्वचः नियोगाद्वज्रिणो मूर्ध्नि पुष्पवर्षं च खेचराः
verses.transliteration: yathā devā bhavaṃ dṛṣṭvā prītikaṇṭakitatvacaḥ niyogādvajriṇo mūrdhni puṣpavarṣaṃ ca khecarāḥ
verses.translation: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.hindi: यजन्ति देहे बाह्यो च चतुष्कोणे षडस्त्रके। दशारे द्वादशारे च षोडशारे त्रिरस्त्रके आकाशके एक होते हुए भी जैसे वह शराव (मिट्टीका कसोरा)- आदि उपाधियोंके भेदसे अनेक रूपो प्रतीत होता है, वैसे ही भगवान् शिवके एक होनेपर भी उनकी एकता तथा अनेकता दिखायी देती हे
verses.wordMeaning: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—

verses.sanskrit: ववृषुश् च सुगन्धाढ्यं नन्दिनो गगनोदितम् वृष्ट्या तुष्टस्तदा रेजे तुष्ट्या पुष्ट्या यथार्थया
verses.transliteration: vavṛṣuś ca sugandhāḍhyaṃ nandino gaganoditam vṛṣṭyā tuṣṭastadā reje tuṣṭyā puṣṭyā yathārthayā
verses.translation: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.hindi: दूसरे लोग कहते हैं। है सुत्रतो ! एक स्थानपर स्थित होते हुए तथा एक होनेपर भी सूर्य जलके आश्रयभूत विभिन्न पात्रोमे अनेक रूपॉमें दिखायी देते हैं-यह दृष्टान्त लोगोंको ज्ञान करानेके लिये है
verses.wordMeaning: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—

verses.sanskrit: नन्दी भवश् चान्द्रयातु स्नातया गन्धवारिणा पुष्पैर्नानाविधैस्तत्र भाति पृष्ठं वृषस्य तत्
verses.transliteration: nandī bhavaś cāndrayātu snātayā gandhavāriṇā puṣpairnānāvidhaistatra bhāti pṛṣṭhaṃ vṛṣasya tat
verses.translation: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.hindi: स्वर्ग तथा पृथ्वीके सभी प्राणी पंचभूतों (पृथ्वी जल, अग्नि, वायु, आकाश)-से निर्मित हैं; तथापि जाति तथा व्यक्तिके भेदसे वे अनेक रूपोंमें दिखायी देते हैं। जो कुछ भी दिखायी देता है अथवा सुनायी पड़ता है, उसे शिवमय जानिये; विचार करनेपर इस लोकमें लोगोंका भेद तो प्रतिभास (भ्रम)-मात्र है
verses.wordMeaning: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—

verses.sanskrit: संकीर्णं तु दिवः पृष्ठं नक्षत्रैरिव सुव्रताः कुसुमैः संवृतो नन्दी वृषपृष्ठे रराज सः
verses.transliteration: saṃkīrṇaṃ tu divaḥ pṛṣṭhaṃ nakṣatrairiva suvratāḥ kusumaiḥ saṃvṛto nandī vṛṣapṛṣṭhe rarāja saḥ
verses.translation: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.hindi: स्वप्नमें बहुत-से सुखोंका उपभोग करके मनुष्य सुखी तथा दुःखी हो जाता है; विचार करनेसे देखा जाय, तो वास्तवमें सुख-दुःखका अनुभव नहीं होता। इसी प्रकार अन्य सभी वेदार्थतत्त्वज्ञ बन्धन तथा
verses.wordMeaning: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—

verses.sanskrit: दिवः पृष्ठे यथा चन्द्रो नक्षत्रैरिव सुव्रताः तं दृष्ट्वा नन्दिनं देवाः सेन्द्रोपेन्द्रास् तथाविधम्
verses.transliteration: divaḥ pṛṣṭhe yathā candro nakṣatrairiva suvratāḥ taṃ dṛṣṭvā nandinaṃ devāḥ sendropendrās tathāvidham
verses.translation: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.hindi: मोक्षको भी स्वप्नकी भाँति बताते हैं। परमेश्वर शिव संसारी लोगोंके हृदयमें साक्षात् सकल (सगुण)- रूपसे विराजमान रहते हैं और वे ही जगन्मय देव योगियों तथा ज्ञानियोंके हृदयमें निष्कल (निर्गुण)- रूपसे विराजमान रहते हैं ॥ २८-२९/२॥ परमेश्वरका तीन प्रकारका विग्रह लोकमें पूजित होता है। है श्रेष्ठ द्विजो! पहला निष्कल (निर्गुण),
verses.wordMeaning: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—

verses.sanskrit: तुष्टुवुर् गणपेशानं देवदेवमिवापरम् नमस्ते रुद्रभक्ताय रुद्रजाप्यरताय च
verses.transliteration: tuṣṭuvur gaṇapeśānaṃ devadevamivāparam namaste rudrabhaktāya rudrajāpyaratāya ca
verses.translation: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.hindi: सकल (सगुण); इसमें सन्देह नहीं है
verses.wordMeaning: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—

verses.sanskrit: रुद्रभक्तार्तिनाशाय रौद्रकर्मरताय ते कूष्माण्डगणनाथाय योगिनां पतये नमः
verses.transliteration: rudrabhaktārtināśāya raudrakarmaratāya te kūṣmāṇḍagaṇanāthāya yogināṃ pataye namaḥ
verses.translation: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.hindi: कुछ लोग सदा सकल-निष्कल रूपकी भू करते हैं; कुछ लोग उन सर्वज्ञकी पूजा हृदयम शिवलिङ्गमें तथा अग्निमें करते हैं और है मुनियो! संसारमें रहनेवाले कुछ मनुष्य स्त्री-पुत्रोंसहित सकल (सगुण) रूपकी सर्वदा पूजा करते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—

verses.sanskrit: सर्वदाय शरण्याय सर्वज्ञायार्तिहारिणे वेदानां पतये चैव वेदवेद्याय ते नमः
verses.transliteration: sarvadāya śaraṇyāya sarvajñāyārtihāriṇe vedānāṃ pataye caiva vedavedyāya te namaḥ
verses.translation: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.hindi: जैसे शिव हैं, वैसे ही देवी हैं और जैसे देवी है, वैस ही शिव हैं; अत: लोग सत्ताईस प्रभेदसे अभेद बुद्धिसे  तथा शरीरके बाहर चतुष्कोण (मूलाधार) ॥
verses.wordMeaning: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—

verses.sanskrit: वज्रिणे वज्रदंष्ट्राय वज्रिवज्रनिवारिणे वज्रालंकृतदेहाय वज्रिणाराधिताय ते
verses.transliteration: vajriṇe vajradaṃṣṭrāya vajrivajranivāriṇe vajrālaṃkṛtadehāya vajriṇārādhitāya te
verses.translation: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.hindi: अध्याय ७६ विविध शिवस्वरूपोंकी प्रतिष्ठा एवं उपासनाका फल ३६९ स स्वेच्छया शिवः साक्षाहेव्या सार्ध स्थितः प्रभु: । षडस्र (स्वाधिष्ठान)-में, दस आरों (मूर्धा) -में, बारह सन्तारणार्थं च शिवः सदसदव्यक्तिवर्जितः॥ ३६  अरों (हृदय) -में, सोलह अरों (कण्ठ) -में तथा तीन आरों (भ्रूमध्य) -में उनकी पूजा करते हैं
