verses.wordMeaning: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—

verses.sanskrit: रक्ताय रक्तनेत्राय रक्तांबरधराय ते रक्तानां भवपादाब्जे रुद्रलोकप्रदायिने
verses.transliteration: raktāya raktanetrāya raktāṃbaradharāya te raktānāṃ bhavapādābje rudralokapradāyine
verses.translation: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.hindi: तमेकमाहु्विगुणं च केचित् सत्-असत्से रहित अर्थात् विलक्षण वे प्रभु केचित्तमाहुस्त्रिगुणात्मकं च। शिव जगत्के उद्धाके लिये अपनी इच्छासे साक्षात् ऊचुस्तथा तं च शिवं तथान्ये देवीके साथ स्थित हैं
verses.wordMeaning: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—

verses.sanskrit: नमः सेनाधिपतये रुद्राणां पतये नमः भूतानां भुवनेशानां पतये पापहारिणे
verses.transliteration: namaḥ senādhipataye rudrāṇāṃ pataye namaḥ bhūtānāṃ bhuvaneśānāṃ pataye pāpahāriṇe
verses.translation: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.hindi: संसारिणं वेदविदो वदन्ति॥ ३७ कुछ लोग उन अद्वितीय शिवको द्विगुण (प्रकृति- पुरुषरूप) कहते हैं, कुछ लोग त्रिगुणात्मक (ब्रह्मा- भक्त्या च योगेन शुभेन युक्ता विष्णु-रुद्ररूप) कहते हैं और अन्य वेदज्ञ लोग उन्हें विप्राः सदा धर्मरता विशिष्टाः। संसारका कारण बताते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—

verses.sanskrit: रुद्राय रुद्रपतये रौद्रपापहराय ते नमः शिवाय सौम्याय रुद्रभक्ताय ते नमः
verses.transliteration: rudrāya rudrapataye raudrapāpaharāya te namaḥ śivāya saumyāya rudrabhaktāya te namaḥ
verses.translation: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.hindi: यजन्ति योगेशमशेषमूर्तिं भक्ति तथा शुभ योगसे समन्वित, धर्मपरायण तथा षडस्त्रमध्ये भगवन्तमेव॥ ३८  विशिष्ट ब्राह्मण उन योगेश्वर, अशेषमूर्ति भगवानका
verses.wordMeaning: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रीतो गणाध्यक्षः प्राह देवांश्छिवात्मजः रथं च सारथिं शंभोः कार्मुकं शरमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prīto gaṇādhyakṣaḥ prāha devāṃśchivātmajaḥ rathaṃ ca sārathiṃ śaṃbhoḥ kārmukaṃ śaramuttamam
verses.translation: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.hindi: पूजन षङ्ख्रमें करते हैं ये तत्र पश्यन्ति शिवं त्रिरस्रे जो लोग त्रिरस्र (भ्रूमध्य)-में, तीन तत्त्वोंके त्रितत्त्वमध्ये त्रिगुणं त्रियक्षम्। मध्यमें त्रिगुण तथा त्रिनेत्र शिवका दर्शन करते हैं, वे
verses.wordMeaning: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—

verses.sanskrit: कर्तुमर्हथ यत्नेन नष्टं मत्वा पुरत्रयम् अथ ते ब्रह्मणा सार्धं तथा वै विश्वकर्मणा
verses.transliteration: kartumarhatha yatnena naṣṭaṃ matvā puratrayam atha te brahmaṇā sārdhaṃ tathā vai viśvakarmaṇā
verses.translation: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.hindi: ते यान्ति चैनं न च योगिनोऽन्ये ही उन देवीके साथ इन पुरातन पुरुष शिव-को प्राप्त
verses.wordMeaning: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—

verses.sanskrit: रथं चक्रुः सुसंरब्धा देवदेवस्य धीमतः
verses.transliteration: rathaṃ cakruḥ susaṃrabdhā devadevasya dhīmataḥ
verses.translation: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.hindi: तया च देव्या पुरुषं पुराणम्॥ ३९  करते हैं; अन्य योगी नहीं विविध शिवस्वरूपोंकी प्रतिष्ठा एवं उपासनाका फल
verses.wordMeaning: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus eulogised, the delighted presiding officer of theGanas, the son of Silada said to Devas:—

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीलिङ्गमहापुराणे पूर्वभागे पुरदाहे नन्दिकेश्वरवाक्यं नाम एकसप्ततितमो ऽध्यायः अथ रुद्रस्य देवस्य निर्मितो विश्वकर्मणा सर्वलोकमयो दिव्यो रथो यत्नेन सादरम्
verses.transliteration: iti śrīliṅgamahāpurāṇe pūrvabhāge puradāhe nandikeśvaravākyaṃ nāma ekasaptatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ atha rudrasya devasya nirmito viśvakarmaṇā sarvalokamayo divyo ratho yatnena sādaram
verses.translation: With great assiduity and eagerness the divine and cos- mic chariot® of lord Rudra was made by Visvakarman.
verses.hindi: अ सूतजी बोले--हे विप्रो! इसके आगे मैं सभी
verses.wordMeaning: With great assiduity and eagerness the divine and cos- mic chariot® of lord Rudra was made by Visvakarman.
verses.commentary: Sense: With great assiduity and eagerness the divine and cos- mic chariot® of lord Rudra was made by Visvakarman.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वभूतमयश्चैव सर्वदेवनमस्कृतः सर्वदेवमयश्चैव सौवर्णः सर्वसंमतः
verses.transliteration: sarvabhūtamayaścaiva sarvadevanamaskṛtaḥ sarvadevamayaścaiva sauvarṇaḥ sarvasaṃmataḥ
verses.translation: It was identical with all living beings;®® it was bowed to by all Devas; it was identical with all Devas;®* it was golden and it was honoured by all.
verses.hindi: लोकोंके कल्याणके लिये अपनी इच्छासे उनके विग्रहको प्रतिष्ठायाः फलं सर्व सर्वलोकहिताय वै उत्पत्ति तथा मूर्ति प्रतिष्ठाके सम्पूर्ण फलका वर्णन करूँगा
verses.wordMeaning: It was identical with all living beings;®® it was bowed to by all Devas; it was identical with all Devas;®* it was golden and it was honoured by all.
verses.commentary: Sense: It was identical with all living beings;®® it was bowed to by all Devas; it was identical with all Devas;®* it was golden and it was honoured by all.

verses.sanskrit: रथाङ्गं दक्षिणं सूर्यो वामाङ्गं सोम एव च दक्षिणं द्वादशारं हि षोडशारं तथोत्तरम्
verses.transliteration: rathāṅgaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ sūryo vāmāṅgaṃ soma eva ca dakṣiṇaṃ dvādaśāraṃ hi ṣoḍaśāraṃ tathottaram
verses.translation: The sun was the right wheel and the moon was the left wheel. The right wheel had twelve spokes and the left wheel had sixteen spokes.
verses.hindi: स्कन्द (कार्तिकेय) तथा उमासहित महादेवको स्कन्दोमासहितं देवमासीनं परमासने।  मूर्ति बनाकर उन्हें उत्तम आसनपर विराजमान करके कृत्वा भक्त्या प्रतिष्ठाप्य सर्वान् कामानवाण्नुयात्॥ २  भक्तिपूर्वक उस मूर्तिको प्रतिष्ठाकर सभी कामनाओंको प्राप्त करना चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: The sun was the right wheel and the moon was the left wheel. The right wheel had twelve spokes and the left wheel had sixteen spokes.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sun was the right wheel and the moon was the left wheel. The right wheel had twelve spokes and the left wheel had sixteen spokes.

verses.sanskrit: अरेषु तेषु विप्रेन्द्राश् चादित्या द्वादशैव तु शशिनः षोडशारेषु कला वामस्य सुव्रताः
verses.transliteration: areṣu teṣu viprendrāś cādityā dvādaśaiva tu śaśinaḥ ṣoḍaśāreṣu kalā vāmasya suvratāḥ
verses.translation: O leading brahmins, the twelve Adityas were in those twelve spokes on the right. O sages of good holy rites, in the sixteen spokes of the left wheel were the sixteen digits of the moon.
verses.hindi: कार्तिकेय तथा उमासहित शिवको विधिपूर्वक स्कन्दोमासहितं देवं सम्पूज्य विधिना सकृत्। एक बार भी पूजा करके मनुष्य जो फल प्राप्त करता
verses.wordMeaning: O leading brahmins, the twelve Adityas were in those twelve spokes on the right. O sages of good holy rites, in the sixteen spokes of the left wheel were the sixteen digits of the moon.
verses.commentary: Sense: O leading brahmins, the twelve Adityas were in those twelve spokes on the right. O sages of good holy rites, in the sixteen spokes of the left wheel were the sixteen digits of the moon.

verses.sanskrit: ऋक्षाणि च तदा तस्य वामस्यैव तु भूषणम् नेम्यः षडृतवश्चैव तयोर्वै विप्रपुङ्गवाः
verses.transliteration: ṛkṣāṇi ca tadā tasya vāmasyaiva tu bhūṣaṇam nemyaḥ ṣaḍṛtavaścaiva tayorvai viprapuṅgavāḥ
verses.translation: The constellations were the ornaments of the left whecl®"* alone. The six seasons were the rims of those two wheels, O leading brahmins.
verses.hindi: यत्फलं लभते मर्त्यस्तद्वदामि यथाश्चुतम्॥ ३ है, उसे जैसा मैंने सुना है; वैसा बताता हूँ
verses.wordMeaning: The constellations were the ornaments of the left whecl®"* alone. The six seasons were the rims of those two wheels, O leading brahmins.
verses.commentary: Sense: The constellations were the ornaments of the left whecl®"* alone. The six seasons were the rims of those two wheels, O leading brahmins.

verses.sanskrit: पुष्करं चान्तरिक्षं वै रथनीडश् च मन्दरः अस्ताद्रिरुदयाद्रिश् च उभौ तौ कूबरौ स्मृतौ
verses.transliteration: puṣkaraṃ cāntarikṣaṃ vai rathanīḍaś ca mandaraḥ astādrirudayādriś ca ubhau tau kūbarau smṛtau
verses.translation: The firmament was the roof®® of the chariot and the interior®? of the chariot was the Mandara. The mountain of rising sun and the mountain of the setting sun were the poles to which the yoke was fixed.
verses.hindi: ण प 1101111... ता कक” व कअकक फफफफफफफफफफफफफफफफफफफफफफफफ फ़ क क फ फ़ फ़ फ फ कक की की फी की फी फ फ फ़ फ़ फ क फ़ फ़ फ फ फ फ फ मा फा फा फी फी फी फी की फ क फे फे फ फ फ फ फ फ फ फ फ ऊफ सूर्यकोटिप्रतीकाशैर्विमानैः सार्वकामिकैः । रूद्रकन्यासमाकीणैरगेयनाट्यसमन्वितैः
verses.wordMeaning: The firmament was the roof®® of the chariot and the interior®? of the chariot was the Mandara. The mountain of rising sun and the mountain of the setting sun were the poles to which the yoke was fixed.
verses.commentary: Sense: The firmament was the roof®® of the chariot and the interior®? of the chariot was the Mandara. The mountain of rising sun and the mountain of the setting sun were the poles to which the yoke was fixed.

verses.sanskrit: अधिष्ठानं महामेरुर् आश्रयाः केसराचलाः वेगः संवत्सरस्तस्य अयने चक्रसंगमौ
verses.transliteration: adhiṣṭhānaṃ mahāmerur āśrayāḥ kesarācalāḥ vegaḥ saṃvatsarastasya ayane cakrasaṃgamau
verses.translation: Mahameru was the pedestal and the mountain Kesara was the supporting seat. The year was its velocity and the two transits of the sun were the joints of the wheels.
verses.hindi: शिववत्क्रीडते योगी यावदाभूतसम्प्लवम्। तत्र भुक्त्वा महाभोगान् विमानैः सार्वकामिकैः
verses.wordMeaning: Mahameru was the pedestal and the mountain Kesara was the supporting seat. The year was its velocity and the two transits of the sun were the joints of the wheels.
verses.commentary: Sense: Mahameru was the pedestal and the mountain Kesara was the supporting seat. The year was its velocity and the two transits of the sun were the joints of the wheels.

verses.sanskrit: मुहूर्ता बन्धुरास्तस्य शम्याश्चैव कलाः स्मृताः तस्य काष्ठाः स्मृता घोणा चाक्षदण्डाः क्षणाश् च वै
verses.transliteration: muhūrtā bandhurāstasya śamyāścaiva kalāḥ smṛtāḥ tasya kāṣṭhāḥ smṛtā ghoṇā cākṣadaṇḍāḥ kṣaṇāś ca vai
verses.translation: The Muhurtas were holes to fix the nails or pins and
verses.hindi: प्राजापत्यं महातेजा जनलोकं महस्तथा भुक्त्वा चैव भुवलोंके भोगान् दिव्यान् सुशोभनान्
verses.wordMeaning: The Muhurtas were holes to fix the nails or pins and
verses.commentary: Sense: The Muhurtas were holes to fix the nails or pins and

verses.sanskrit: निमेषाश्चानुकर्षाश् च ईषा चास्य लवाः स्मृताः द्यौर्वरूथं रथस्यास्य स्वर्गमोक्षावुभौ ध्वजौ
verses.transliteration: nimeṣāścānukarṣāś ca īṣā cāsya lavāḥ smṛtāḥ dyaurvarūthaṃ rathasyāsya svargamokṣāvubhau dhvajau
verses.translation: In the Puran as Visvakarman is invested with the powers and offices of the Vedic Tvastr. He is the great architect, executor of handi- crafts and the builder of great cities. He is the son of Prabhasa, the eighth Vasu, by his wife Yogasiddha.
verses.hindi: मेरुमासाद्य देवानां भवनेषु प्रमोदते। एकपादं चतुर्बाहुं त्रिनेत्रं शूलसंयुतम्
verses.wordMeaning: In the Puran as Visvakarman is invested with the powers and offices of the Vedic Tvastr. He is the great architect, executor of handi- crafts and the builder of great cities. He is the son of Prabhasa, the eighth Vasu, by his wife Yogasiddha.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the Puran as Visvakarman is invested with the powers and offices of the Vedic Tvastr. He is the great architect, executor of handi- crafts and the builder of great cities. He is the son of Prabhasa, the eighth Vasu, by his wife Yogasiddha.

verses.sanskrit: धर्मो विरागो दण्डो ऽस्य यज्ञा दण्डाश्रयाः स्मृताः दक्षिणाः संधयस्तस्य लोहाः पञ्चाशदग्नयः
verses.transliteration: dharmo virāgo daṇḍo 'sya yajñā daṇḍāśrayāḥ smṛtāḥ dakṣiṇāḥ saṃdhayastasya lohāḥ pañcāśadagnayaḥ
verses.translation: The cosmic chariot- represents the cosmic powers with seven worlds as wheels, with five gross elements and all-gods as its constituents.
verses.hindi: अष्टाविंशतिरुद्राणां कोटिः सर्वाङ्गसुप्रभम् अहङ्कारमहङ्कारात्तन्मात्राण तु तत्र वै। इन्द्रियाणीन्द्रियादेब लीलया परमेश्वरम्
verses.wordMeaning: The cosmic chariot- represents the cosmic powers with seven worlds as wheels, with five gross elements and all-gods as its constituents.
verses.commentary: Sense: The cosmic chariot- represents the cosmic powers with seven worlds as wheels, with five gross elements and all-gods as its constituents.

verses.sanskrit: युगान्तकोटी तौ तस्य धर्मकामावुभौ स्मृतौ ईषादण्डस्तथाव्यक्तं बुद्धिस्तस्यैव नड्वलः
verses.transliteration: yugāntakoṭī tau tasya dharmakāmāvubhau smṛtau īṣādaṇḍastathāvyaktaṃ buddhistasyaiva naḍvalaḥ
verses.translation: Varna i.e the moon, the left side of the cosmic car.
verses.hindi: नाभिदेशात्तथा वह्निं हृदयाद्भास्करं तथा
verses.wordMeaning: Varna i.e the moon, the left side of the cosmic car.
verses.commentary: Sense: Varna i.e the moon, the left side of the cosmic car.

verses.sanskrit: कोणस् तथा ह्यहङ्कारो भूतानि च बलं स्मृतम् इन्द्रियाणि च तस्यैव भूषणानि समन्ततः
verses.transliteration: koṇas tathā hyahaṅkāro bhūtāni ca balaṃ smṛtam indriyāṇi ca tasyaiva bhūṣaṇāni samantataḥ
verses.translation: pu$kara— vacuum, it stands in apposition to antariksa — the atmospheric region, the sky.
verses.hindi: कण्ठात्सोमं तथात्मानं भ्रूमध्यान्मस्तकाहिवम्। सृष्ट्वैवं संस्थितं साक्षाज्जगत्सर्व चराचरम् सर्वज्ञं सर्वगं देवं कृत्वा विद्याविधानतः। प्रतिष्ठाप्य यथान्यायं शिवसायुज्यमाप्नुयात्
verses.wordMeaning: pu$kara— vacuum, it stands in apposition to antariksa — the atmospheric region, the sky.
verses.commentary: Sense: pu$kara— vacuum, it stands in apposition to antariksa — the atmospheric region, the sky.

verses.sanskrit: श्रद्धा च गतिरस्यैव वेदास्तस्य हयाः स्मृताः पदानि भूषणान्येव षडङ्गान्युपभूषणम्
verses.transliteration: śraddhā ca gatirasyaiva vedāstasya hayāḥ smṛtāḥ padāni bhūṣaṇānyeva ṣaḍaṅgānyupabhūṣaṇam
verses.translation: The Nimesas were its Axle-tree and the Lavas consti- tuted its shafts. The sky was the fender of that chariot. The heaven and salvation were its flags.
verses.hindi: कृत्वा यज्ञेशमीशानं विष्णुलोके महीयते
verses.wordMeaning: The Nimesas were its Axle-tree and the Lavas consti- tuted its shafts. The sky was the fender of that chariot. The heaven and salvation were its flags.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Nimesas were its Axle-tree and the Lavas consti- tuted its shafts. The sky was the fender of that chariot. The heaven and salvation were its flags.

verses.sanskrit: पुराणन्यायमीमांसाधर्मशास्त्राणि सुव्रताः वालाश्रयाः पटाश्चैव सर्वलक्षणसंयुताः
verses.transliteration: purāṇanyāyamīmāṃsādharmaśāstrāṇi suvratāḥ vālāśrayāḥ paṭāścaiva sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutāḥ
verses.translation: Virtue and detachment were its staffs and sacrifices were the supports of the staffs. The monetary gifts were the joints and the fifty fires were the iron pieces or bolts.
verses.hindi: क्रमादागत्य लोकेऽस्मिन् सर्वयज्ञान्तगो भवेत् वह योगी करोड़ों सूर्योके समान तेजवाले, सभी अभीष्ट वस्तुओंसे सम्पन्न, रुद्रकन्याओंसे युक्त, गान. नृत्य आदिसे परिपूर्ण विमानोंमें  भगवान् शिवकी भाँति प्रलयपर्यन्त विहार करता है। वहाँ महान् सुखोंका
verses.wordMeaning: Virtue and detachment were its staffs and sacrifices were the supports of the staffs. The monetary gifts were the joints and the fifty fires were the iron pieces or bolts.
verses.commentary: Sense: Virtue and detachment were its staffs and sacrifices were the supports of the staffs. The monetary gifts were the joints and the fifty fires were the iron pieces or bolts.

verses.sanskrit: मन्त्रा घण्टाः स्मृतास्तेषां वर्णाः पादास्तथाश्रमाः अवच्छेदो ह्यनन्तस्तु सहस्रफणभूषितः
verses.transliteration: mantrā ghaṇṭāḥ smṛtāsteṣāṃ varṇāḥ pādāstathāśramāḥ avacchedo hyanantastu sahasraphaṇabhūṣitaḥ
verses.translation: Dharma and Kama (love) were the tips of the two yokes; the unmanifest principle was the poleshaft; the cosmic intellect was its connecting shaft.
verses.hindi: उपभोग करके वह महातेजस्वी योगी सभी कामनाओंको पूर्ण करनेवाले विमानोंसे क्रमशः  उमालोक, कुमारलोक, ईशानलोक, विष्णुलोक, ब्रह्मलोक, प्रजापतिलोक, जनलोक तथा महर्लोक पहुँच जाता है; पुनः इन्द्रलोकमें पहुँचकर
verses.wordMeaning: Dharma and Kama (love) were the tips of the two yokes; the unmanifest principle was the poleshaft; the cosmic intellect was its connecting shaft.
verses.commentary: Sense: Dharma and Kama (love) were the tips of the two yokes; the unmanifest principle was the poleshaft; the cosmic intellect was its connecting shaft.

verses.sanskrit: दिशः पादा रथस्यास्य तथा चोपदिशश् च ह पुष्कराद्याः पताकाश् च सौवर्णा रत्नभूषिताः
verses.transliteration: diśaḥ pādā rathasyāsya tathā copadiśaś ca ha puṣkarādyāḥ patākāś ca sauvarṇā ratnabhūṣitāḥ
verses.translation: The ego was its angular points; the elements were its strength; the sense organs its ornamental fittings all round.
verses.hindi: वहाँ दस हजार वर्षोतक इन्द्रपदका भोग करनेके अनन्तर भुवर्लोकमें दिव्य तथा परम सुन्दर सुखोंको भोगकर मेरु पर्वतपर पहुँचकर देवताओंके भवनोंमें आनन्द प्राप्त करता है ॥ ४--७/२॥ त्रिशूलसे युक्त हैं; जो अपने वाम भागसे विष्णु तथा दक्षिण भागसे ब्रह्माको उत्पन्न करके विराजमान हैं; जिनसे अट्टाईस करोड़ रुद्र उत्पन्न हुए हैं; जो सभी अंगोंसे अत्यन्त प्रभावाले तथा पचीस तत्त्वोंवाले जीवात्मा
verses.wordMeaning: The ego was its angular points; the elements were its strength; the sense organs its ornamental fittings all round.
verses.commentary: Sense: The ego was its angular points; the elements were its strength; the sense organs its ornamental fittings all round.

verses.sanskrit: समुद्रास्तस्य चत्वारो रथकम्बलिकाः स्मृताः गङ्गाद्याः सरितः श्रेष्ठाः सर्वाभरणभूषिताः
verses.transliteration: samudrāstasya catvāro rathakambalikāḥ smṛtāḥ gaṅgādyāḥ saritaḥ śreṣṭhāḥ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitāḥ
verses.translation: Sraddha (faith) was its movement; the Vedas were its horses; the Padas (words) of the Vedas its ornaments and the six ancillaries were its trinkets.
verses.hindi: साक्षात् पुरुषको हृदयसे, अपने बायें भागसे प्रकृतिको, बुद्धिदेशसे बुद्धिको, अपने अहंकारसे अहंकारको, तन्मात्राओंसे तन्मात्राओंको, अपनी इन्द्रियोंसे लीलापूर्वक इन्द्रियोंको, पैरके मूलभागसे पृथ्वीको, गुह्यदेशसे जलको,
verses.wordMeaning: Sraddha (faith) was its movement; the Vedas were its horses; the Padas (words) of the Vedas its ornaments and the six ancillaries were its trinkets.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sraddha (faith) was its movement; the Vedas were its horses; the Padas (words) of the Vedas its ornaments and the six ancillaries were its trinkets.

verses.sanskrit: चामरासक्तहस्ताग्राः सर्वाः स्त्रीरूपशोभिताः तत्रतत्र कृतस्थानाः शोभयांचक्रिरे रथम्
verses.transliteration: cāmarāsaktahastāgrāḥ sarvāḥ strīrūpaśobhitāḥ tatratatra kṛtasthānāḥ śobhayāṃcakrire ratham
verses.translation: O sages of good holy rites, the Puranas, Nyaya( science of logic), Mimamsa (treatise on holy rites), the Dharmaastras (ethical literature) were its perfect screen cloths and supports of the tails. It was equipped with all characteristics.
verses.hindi: नाभिस्थलसे अग्निको, हृदयदेशसे सूर्यको, कण्ठसे चन्द्रमाको, भौहोंके मध्यभागसे आत्मा (रुद्र)-को, मस्तकसे स्वर्गको--इस प्रकार सम्पूर्ण चराचर जगत्को उत्पन्न करके साक्षात् विराजमान हैं, उन सर्वज्ञ तथा सर्वव्यापी परमेश्वरकी मूर्तिको विद्याविधानके अनुसार बनाकर विधिपूर्वक उनकी प्रतिष्ठा करके मनु शिवसायुज्य प्राप्त करता है
verses.wordMeaning: O sages of good holy rites, the Puranas, Nyaya( science of logic), Mimamsa (treatise on holy rites), the Dharmaastras (ethical literature) were its perfect screen cloths and supports of the tails. It was equipped with all characteristics.
verses.commentary: Sense: O sages of good holy rites, the Puranas, Nyaya( science of logic), Mimamsa (treatise on holy rites), the Dharmaastras (ethical literature) were its perfect screen cloths and supports of the tails. It was equipped with all characteristics.

verses.sanskrit: आवहाद्यास् तथा सप्त सोपानं हैममुत्तमम् सारथिर्भगवान्ब्रह्मा देवाभीषुधराः स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: āvahādyās tathā sapta sopānaṃ haimamuttamam sārathirbhagavānbrahmā devābhīṣudharāḥ smṛtāḥ
verses.translation: The mantras, syllables, feet and the four stages in life were its bells. Ananta the serpent adorned by his thousand hoods formed its bounding limit.
verses.hindi: दो सिरोंवाले यज्ञेश्वर अग्निस्वरूप ईशानको स्थापित करके मनुष्य विष्णुलोकमें प्रतिष्ठित होता है। वहाँ एक लाख कल्पतक महान् भोगोंको भोगकर मनुष्य सुखी रहता है और पुनः क्रमसे इस लोकमें आकर समर
verses.wordMeaning: The mantras, syllables, feet and the four stages in life were its bells. Ananta the serpent adorned by his thousand hoods formed its bounding limit.
verses.commentary: Sense: The mantras, syllables, feet and the four stages in life were its bells. Ananta the serpent adorned by his thousand hoods formed its bounding limit.

verses.sanskrit: प्रतोदो ब्रह्मणस्तस्य प्रणवो ब्रह्मदैवतम् लोकालोकाचलस्तस्य ससोपानः समन्ततः
verses.transliteration: pratodo brahmaṇastasya praṇavo brahmadaivatam lokālokācalastasya sasopānaḥ samantataḥ
verses.translation: The quarters and the interstices were the pillars of this chariot. The Puskara and other clouds were its golden banners studded with jewels.
verses.hindi: यज्ञोंको सम्पन्न करता है अध्याय ७६ विविध शिवस्वरूपोंकी प्रतिष्ठा एवं उपासनाका फल ३७१
verses.wordMeaning: The quarters and the interstices were the pillars of this chariot. The Puskara and other clouds were its golden banners studded with jewels.
verses.commentary: Sense: The quarters and the interstices were the pillars of this chariot. The Puskara and other clouds were its golden banners studded with jewels.

verses.sanskrit: विषमश् च तदा बाह्यो मानसाद्रिः सुशोभनः नासाः समन्ततस्तस्य सर्व एवाचलाः स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: viṣamaś ca tadā bāhyo mānasādriḥ suśobhanaḥ nāsāḥ samantatastasya sarva evācalāḥ smṛtāḥ
verses.translation: The four oceans formed the blankets spread on its surface. The Ganga and other rivers appeared splendid in female forms, bedecked in all ornaments and holding the chow- ries in their hands. They occupied different parts in the chariot and rendered it beautiful.
verses.hindi: काञ्चनेन विमानेन क्िङ्किणीजालमालिना। गत्वा शिवपुरं दिव्यं तत्रैव स विमुच्यते
verses.wordMeaning: The four oceans formed the blankets spread on its surface. The Ganga and other rivers appeared splendid in female forms, bedecked in all ornaments and holding the chow- ries in their hands. They occupied different parts in the chariot and rendered it beautiful.
verses.commentary: Sense: The four oceans formed the blankets spread on its surface. The Ganga and other rivers appeared splendid in female forms, bedecked in all ornaments and holding the chow- ries in their hands. They occupied different parts in the chariot and rendered it beautiful.

verses.sanskrit: तलाः कपोताः कापोताः सर्वे तलनिवासिनः मेरुरेव महाछत्रं मन्दरः पार्श्वडिण्डिमः
verses.transliteration: talāḥ kapotāḥ kāpotāḥ sarve talanivāsinaḥ merureva mahāchatraṃ mandaraḥ pārśvaḍiṇḍimaḥ
verses.translation: The seven layers of winds, Avaha etc. were the seven excellent golden steps. The charioteer was lord Brahma and he held the reins.
verses.hindi: मूर्तिको स्थापित करता है, वह दस हजार अश्वमेध यज्ञोंको करनेसे जो पुण्य होता है, उसे प्राप्तकर
verses.wordMeaning: The seven layers of winds, Avaha etc. were the seven excellent golden steps. The charioteer was lord Brahma and he held the reins.
verses.commentary: Sense: The seven layers of winds, Avaha etc. were the seven excellent golden steps. The charioteer was lord Brahma and he held the reins.

verses.sanskrit: शैलेन्द्रः कार्मुकं चैव ज्या भुजङ्गाधिपः स्वयम् कालरात्र्या तथैवेह तथेन्द्रधनुषा पुनः
verses.transliteration: śailendraḥ kārmukaṃ caiva jyā bhujaṅgādhipaḥ svayam kālarātryā tathaiveha tathendradhanuṣā punaḥ
verses.translation: Pranava with Brahman for its deity was the whip. The mountain Lokaloka was its landing ground with stairs all round. The splendid Manasa mountain was its external preci- pice. The other mountains constituted its noses all round [the upper timbers].
verses.hindi: किंकिणीजालोंसे युक्त स्वर्ण-विमानसे दिव्य शिवलोकमें हन जाकर वहाँपर मुक्त हो जाता है
verses.wordMeaning: Pranava with Brahman for its deity was the whip. The mountain Lokaloka was its landing ground with stairs all round. The splendid Manasa mountain was its external preci- pice. The other mountains constituted its noses all round [the upper timbers].
verses.commentary: Sense: Pranava with Brahman for its deity was the whip. The mountain Lokaloka was its landing ground with stairs all round. The splendid Manasa mountain was its external preci- pice. The other mountains constituted its noses all round [the upper timbers].

verses.sanskrit: घण्टा सरस्वती देवी धनुषः श्रुतिरूपिणी इषुर्विष्णुर्महातेजाः शल्यं सोमः शरस्य च
verses.transliteration: ghaṇṭā sarasvatī devī dhanuṣaḥ śrutirūpiṇī iṣurviṣṇurmahātejāḥ śalyaṃ somaḥ śarasya ca
verses.translation: The Tala and the residents thereof constituted its pigeon holes, and the pigeons. The mountain Meru was the great umbrella and the Mandara constituted the side drum.
verses.hindi: नन्दिना सहितं देवं साम्बं सर्वगणैर्वृतम्। हि क नन्दी तथा उमासहित और सभी गणाँसे घिरे हुए कृत्वा यत्फलमाप्नोति वक्ष्ये तद्वै यथाश्रुतम्
verses.wordMeaning: The Tala and the residents thereof constituted its pigeon holes, and the pigeons. The mountain Meru was the great umbrella and the Mandara constituted the side drum.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Tala and the residents thereof constituted its pigeon holes, and the pigeons. The mountain Meru was the great umbrella and the Mandara constituted the side drum.

verses.sanskrit: कालाग्निस्तच्छरस्यैव साक्षात्तीक्ष्णः सुदारुणः अनीकं विषसम्भूतं वायवो वाजकाः स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: kālāgnistaccharasyaiva sākṣāttīkṣṇaḥ sudāruṇaḥ anīkaṃ viṣasambhūtaṃ vāyavo vājakāḥ smṛtāḥ
verses.translation: The king of mountains (Himavan) was his bow and the bowstring was the lord of serpents ( Vasuki) himself, along with Kalaratri (the night of nightmares) and Indradhanus (rain- bow).
verses.hindi: महादेवकी प्रतिष्ठा करके मनुष्य जो फल प्राप्त करता
verses.wordMeaning: The king of mountains (Himavan) was his bow and the bowstring was the lord of serpents ( Vasuki) himself, along with Kalaratri (the night of nightmares) and Indradhanus (rain- bow).
verses.commentary: Sense: The king of mountains (Himavan) was his bow and the bowstring was the lord of serpents ( Vasuki) himself, along with Kalaratri (the night of nightmares) and Indradhanus (rain- bow).

verses.sanskrit: एवं कृत्वा रथं दिव्यं कार्मुकं च शरं तथा सारथिं जगतां चैव ब्रह्माणं प्रभुमीश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ kṛtvā rathaṃ divyaṃ kārmukaṃ ca śaraṃ tathā sārathiṃ jagatāṃ caiva brahmāṇaṃ prabhumīśvaram
verses.translation: The bell of the bow was goddess Sarasvati of the form of the Srutis (Vedas). Visnu of great splendour was the arrow and Soma (moon) was the spike-head of the arrow.
verses.hindi: है, जैसा मैंने सुना है, उसे बता रहा हूँ। वह सूर्यमण्डलके समान देदीप्यमान वृषभोंसे जुते हुए, अप्सराओंसे भरे हुए, देव-दानवोंके लिये दुर्लभ और नृत्य करती हुई अप्सराओंसे चारों ओरसे पूर्णतः सुशोभित विमानोंसे दिव्य शिवलोकमें जाकर गणाधिपति पदको प्राप्त करता है
verses.wordMeaning: The bell of the bow was goddess Sarasvati of the form of the Srutis (Vedas). Visnu of great splendour was the arrow and Soma (moon) was the spike-head of the arrow.
verses.commentary: Sense: The bell of the bow was goddess Sarasvati of the form of the Srutis (Vedas). Visnu of great splendour was the arrow and Soma (moon) was the spike-head of the arrow.

verses.sanskrit: आरुरोह रथं दिव्यं रणमण्डनधृग् भवः सर्वदेवगणैर्युक्तं कम्पयन्निव रोदसी
verses.transliteration: āruroha rathaṃ divyaṃ raṇamaṇḍanadhṛg bhavaḥ sarvadevagaṇairyuktaṃ kampayanniva rodasī
verses.translation: The Kalagni fire at the end of kalpa was the sharp and terrible point of that arrow. The army originated from the waters. The winds were feathers fixed to the arrow.
verses.hindi: सूर्यमण्डलसङ्काशैविमानैर्वृषसंयुतैः । अप्सरोगणसड्डीर्णंदिवदानवदुर्लभे:
verses.wordMeaning: The Kalagni fire at the end of kalpa was the sharp and terrible point of that arrow. The army originated from the waters. The winds were feathers fixed to the arrow.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Kalagni fire at the end of kalpa was the sharp and terrible point of that arrow. The army originated from the waters. The winds were feathers fixed to the arrow.

verses.sanskrit: ऋषिभिः स्तूयमानश् च वन्द्यमानश् च बन्दिभिः उपनृत्तश्चाप्सरसां गणैर्नृत्यविशारदैः
verses.transliteration: ṛṣibhiḥ stūyamānaś ca vandyamānaś ca bandibhiḥ upanṛttaścāpsarasāṃ gaṇairnṛtyaviśāradaiḥ
verses.translation: After making the divine chariot, bow and arrows with Brahma the lord of the worlds as his charioteer, Siva mounted the divine chariot wearing martial decorations. He was accompanied by the groups of Devas and he shook heaven and earth by his movements.
verses.hindi: गत्वा शिवपुरं दिव्यं गाणपत्यमवाप्नुयात् नृत्यन्तं देवदेवेशं शैलजासहितं प्रभुम्। जी ज् वकि सहस्त्रबाहु सर्वज्ञं चतुर्बाहुमथापि वा॥ २२ पार्वतीसहित नृत्य करते हुए, हजार भुजाओंवाले अथवा चार भुजाओंवाले, भृगु आदि तथा भूतसमूहोंसे घिरे हुए, पार्वतीके साथ, ब्रह्मा-विष्णु-इन्द्र-चन्द्र आदि सभी
verses.wordMeaning: After making the divine chariot, bow and arrows with Brahma the lord of the worlds as his charioteer, Siva mounted the divine chariot wearing martial decorations. He was accompanied by the groups of Devas and he shook heaven and earth by his movements.
verses.commentary: Sense: After making the divine chariot, bow and arrows with Brahma the lord of the worlds as his charioteer, Siva mounted the divine chariot wearing martial decorations. He was accompanied by the groups of Devas and he shook heaven and earth by his movements.

verses.sanskrit: सुशोभमानो वरदः सम्प्रेक्ष्यैव च सारथिम् तस्मिन्नारोहति रथं कल्पितं लोकसंभृतम्
verses.transliteration: suśobhamāno varadaḥ samprekṣyaiva ca sārathim tasminnārohati rathaṃ kalpitaṃ lokasaṃbhṛtam
verses.translation: Eulogised by the sages and saluted by the bards the shining splendid lord, the bestower of boons occupied the chariot glancing at the charioteer. The groups of Apsarases, skilled in dancing, danced in his presence (to honour him). When he got into the chariot, evolved out of the different material, the horse originating from the Vedas fell headlong over the earth. The lord Dharanidhara (uplifttr of the earth i.e., Visnu), assuming the form of a leading bull lifted up the chariot for a while and tried to stabilise it. But at the next moment even that leading bull slipped down to the earth on his knees.
verses.hindi: घिरे हुए देवदेवेश्वर-प्रभु-सर्वज्ञ-परमेश्वर-वृषभध्वज शिवकी मूर्ति बनाकर भक्तिपूर्वक उसकी प्रतिष्ठा करके मनुष्य जो फल प्राप्त करता है, उसे मैं बताता हूँ--सभी यज्ञ, तप, दान, तीर्थ तथा देवदर्शन करनेमें जो फल होता
verses.wordMeaning: Eulogised by the sages and saluted by the bards the shining splendid lord, the bestower of boons occupied the chariot glancing at the charioteer. The groups of Apsarases, skilled in dancing, danced in his presence (to honour him). When he got into the chariot,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Eulogised by the sages and saluted by the bards the shining splendid lord, the bestower of boons occupied the chariot glancing at the charioteer. The groups of Apsarases, skilled in dancing, danced in his presence (to honour him). When he got into the chariot,…

verses.sanskrit: शिरोभिः पतिता भूमीं तुरगा वेदसंभवाः अथाधस्ताद्रथस्यास्य भगवान् धरणीधरः
verses.transliteration: śirobhiḥ patitā bhūmīṃ turagā vedasaṃbhavāḥ athādhastādrathasyāsya bhagavān dharaṇīdharaḥ
verses.translation: At the instance of the lord Siva, lord Brahma who held the reins in his hands lifted up the horses and steadied the splendid chariot.
verses.hindi: है, उसका करोड़ों गुना फल प्राप्त करके वह शिवलोकको जाता है और वहाँ प्रलयपर्यन्त महान् सुखोंको भोगकर पुन: दूसरी सृष्टिका प्रारम्भ होनेपर मनु-पद प्राप्त करता है ॥ २२-२६/२॥ नेत्रोंबाले, सर्पकी मेखलावाले, हाथमें कपाल धारण किये हुए और काले तथा घुँघराले केशवाले देवेशवरको मूर्विरूपमें बनाकर भक्तिपूर्वक प्रतिष्ठा करके मनुष्य शिव-सायुज्य प्राप्त करता है
verses.wordMeaning: At the instance of the lord Siva, lord Brahma who held the reins in his hands lifted up the horses and steadied the splendid chariot.
verses.commentary: Sense: At the instance of the lord Siva, lord Brahma who held the reins in his hands lifted up the horses and steadied the splendid chariot.

verses.sanskrit: वृषेन्द्ररूपी चोत्थाप्य स्थापयामास वै क्षणम् क्षणान्तरे वृषेन्द्रो ऽपि जानुभ्यामगमद्धराम्
verses.transliteration: vṛṣendrarūpī cotthāpya sthāpayāmāsa vai kṣaṇam kṣaṇāntare vṛṣendro 'pi jānubhyāmagamaddharām
verses.translation: Then he drove the horses that had the speed of the wind, towards the cities of the swift and courageous Danavas. The cities till then had peace and comfort.
verses.hindi: गजासुरको विदीर्ण करनेवाले, उमासहित, सभी कामनाओंको पूर्ण करनेवाले, कृष्ण वर्णवाले, लाल नेत्रोंवाले, तीन नेत्रोंवाले, चन्द्रको आभूषणके रूपमें धारण करनेवाले, सिरपर काकपक्ष धारण करनेवाले,
verses.wordMeaning: Then he drove the horses that had the speed of the wind, towards the cities of the swift and courageous Danavas. The cities till then had peace and comfort.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then he drove the horses that had the speed of the wind, towards the cities of the swift and courageous Danavas. The cities till then had peace and comfort.

verses.sanskrit: अभीषुहस्तो भगवान् उद्यम्य च हयान् विभुः स्थापयामास देवस्य वचनाद्वै रथं शुभम्
verses.transliteration: abhīṣuhasto bhagavān udyamya ca hayān vibhuḥ sthāpayāmāsa devasya vacanādvai rathaṃ śubham
verses.translation: Thereafter looking at Devas, lord Rudra said; —
verses.hindi: भृग्वाद्येर्भूतसङ्केशच संवृतं परमेश्वरम्। शैलजासहितं साक्षाद् वृषभध्वजमीश्वरम् ब्रह्मोन्द्रविष्णुसोमाद्यै: सदा सर्वैर्नमस्कृतम्। मातृभिर्मुनिभिश्चैव संवृतं परमेश्वरम्
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter looking at Devas, lord Rudra said; —
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter looking at Devas, lord Rudra said; —

verses.sanskrit: ततो ऽश्वांश्चोदयामास मनोमारुतरंहसः पुराण्युद्दिश्य खस्थानि दानवानां तरस्विनाम्
verses.transliteration: tato 'śvāṃścodayāmāsa manomārutaraṃhasaḥ purāṇyuddiśya khasthāni dānavānāṃ tarasvinām
verses.translation: O excellent Devas, only after assigning you a status of animal souls distinct from that of Devas and others, can they be killed, not otherwise, O excellent ones."
verses.hindi: कृत्वा भक्त्या प्रतिष्ठाप्य यत्फलं तद्वदाम्यहम्। सर्वयज्ञतपोदानतीर्थदेवेषु यत् फलम्
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent Devas, only after assigning you a status of animal souls distinct from that of Devas and others, can they be killed, not otherwise, O excellent ones."
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent Devas, only after assigning you a status of animal souls distinct from that of Devas and others, can they be killed, not otherwise, O excellent ones."

verses.sanskrit: अथाह भगवान् रुद्रो देवानालोक्य शङ्करः पशूनामाधिपत्यं मे दत्तं हन्मि ततो ऽसुरान्
verses.transliteration: athāha bhagavān rudro devānālokya śaṅkaraḥ paśūnāmādhipatyaṃ me dattaṃ hanmi tato 'surān
verses.translation: After hearing these words of the intelligent lord, all of them became suspicious and uneasy over this change and felt great distress.
verses.hindi: तत्फलं कोटिगुणितं लब्ध्वा याति शिवं पदम्। तत्र भुक्त्वा महाभोगान् यावदाभूतसम्प्लवम् कपालहस्तं देवेशं कृष्णकुञ्चितमूर्थजम्। कृत्वा भक्त्या प्रतिष्ठाप्य शिवसायुज्यमाप्ुयात्
verses.wordMeaning: After hearing these words of the intelligent lord, all of them became suspicious and uneasy over this change and felt great distress.
verses.commentary: Sense: After hearing these words of the intelligent lord, all of them became suspicious and uneasy over this change and felt great distress.

verses.sanskrit: पृथक्पशुत्वं देवानां तथान्येषां सुरोत्तमाः कल्पयित्वैव वध्यास्ते नान्यथा नैव सत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: pṛthakpaśutvaṃ devānāṃ tathānyeṣāṃ surottamāḥ kalpayitvaiva vadhyāste nānyathā naiva sattamāḥ
verses.translation: On realising their mental reaction, the lord spoke to them thus: — "O excellent Devas, let there be no fear or misgiving in you in regard to your becoming Pai§us.
verses.hindi: इभेन्द्रदारकं देवं साम्बं सिद्धार्थदं प्रभुम्। सुधूप्रवर्ण रक्ताक्षं त्रिनेत्रं चन्द्रभूषणम्
verses.wordMeaning: On realising their mental reaction, the lord spoke to them thus: — "O excellent Devas, let there be no fear or misgiving in you in regard to your becoming Pai§us.
verses.commentary: Sense: On realising their mental reaction, the lord spoke to them thus: — "O excellent Devas, let there be no fear or misgiving in you in regard to your becoming Pai§us.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रुत्वा वचः सर्वं देवदेवस्य धीमतः विषादमगमन् सर्वे पशुत्वं प्रति शङ्किताः
verses.transliteration: iti śrutvā vacaḥ sarvaṃ devadevasya dhīmataḥ viṣādamagaman sarve paśutvaṃ prati śaṅkitāḥ
verses.translation: Now listen and try to pursue the means of libera- tion from the state of Pasu. He who performs the divine holy rite "Pasupata" will be liberated from the state of Pas u. O pure ones, I solemnly promise this to you. O excellent Devas, there is no doubt in this that those others too who perform the Pasupata rite will be liberated from the state of a Pau. He who renders service steadily for twelve years or even half that period or even three years can be liberated from that state. Hence, O excellent Devas, perform this great and divine rite".
verses.hindi: काकपक्षधरं मूर्ध्ना नागटङ्कधरं हरम्। सिंहाजिनोत्तरीयं च मृगचर्माम्बरं प्रभुम् इक न ता ny फफफफफफफफफफफफफफफफाफीफीफीफीक फाफफफ फफफफफ फा फफफ फ्रफ्रफ्फ्फफ्फफ्फफ्फरफ्क्रफ््फफक्रफ्करक्र फफफ फफफफफ फफफफ फफ ता
verses.wordMeaning: Now listen and try to pursue the means of libera- tion from the state of Pasu. He who performs the divine holy rite "Pasupata" will be liberated from the state of Pas u. O pure ones, I solemnly promise this to you. O excellent Devas,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Now listen and try to pursue the means of libera- tion from the state of Pasu. He who performs the divine holy rite "Pasupata" will be liberated from the state of Pas u. O pure ones, I solemnly promise this to you. O excellent Devas,…

verses.sanskrit: तेषां भावं ततो ज्ञात्वा देवस्तानिदमब्रवीत् मा वो ऽस्तु पशुभावे ऽस्मिन् भयं विबुधसत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: teṣāṃ bhāvaṃ tato jñātvā devastānidamabravīt mā vo 'stu paśubhāve 'smin bhayaṃ vibudhasattamāḥ
verses.translation: ''So be it", said Devas to Siva, who is bowed to by all the worlds. That is why Devas, Asuras and human beings are called Pas us. Rudra is the lord of Paus®® and the liberator of Paus from their bondage. He who is Pasu, shall eschew that state through this holy rite. The scriptures declare that even by committing sins he does not become a sinner.
verses.hindi: हुंफट्कारे महाशब्दशब्दिताखिलदिङ्मुखम्
verses.wordMeaning: ''So be it", said Devas to Siva, who is bowed to by all the worlds. That is why Devas, Asuras and human beings are called Pas us. Rudra is the lord of Paus®® and the liberator of Paus from their bondage. He who is Pasu, shall eschew that state through this holy rite.…
verses.commentary: Sense: ''So be it", said Devas to Siva, who is bowed to by all the worlds. That is why Devas, Asuras and human beings are called Pas us. Rudra is the lord of Paus®® and the liberator of Paus from their bondage. He who is Pasu, shall eschew that state through this holy rite.…

verses.sanskrit: श्रूयतां पशुभावस्य विमोक्षः क्रियतां च सः यो वै पाशुपतं दिव्यं चरिष्यति स मोक्ष्यति
verses.transliteration: śrūyatāṃ paśubhāvasya vimokṣaḥ kriyatāṃ ca saḥ yo vai pāśupataṃ divyaṃ cariṣyati sa mokṣyati
verses.translation: paSunam adhipatyam — lordship of the individual souls (jivas); Gf. ''so *bravid varaih vrna ahamcva paunam adhipatir asani'' — cited in ST.
verses.hindi: पुण्डरीकाजिनं दोर्भ्या बिभ्रन्तं कम्बुकं तथा । हसन्तं च नदन्तं च पिबन्तं कृष्णसागरम् सर्वविघ्नानतिक्रम्य शिवलोके महीयते। तत्र भुक्त्वा महाभोगान् यावदाभूतसम्प्लवम्
verses.wordMeaning: paSunam adhipatyam — lordship of the individual souls (jivas); Gf. ''so *bravid varaih vrna ahamcva paunam adhipatir asani'' — cited in ST.
verses.commentary: Sense: paSunam adhipatyam — lordship of the individual souls (jivas); Gf. ''so *bravid varaih vrna ahamcva paunam adhipatir asani'' — cited in ST.

verses.sanskrit: पशुत्वादिति सत्यं च प्रतिज्ञातं समाहिताः ये चाप्यन्ये चरिष्यन्ति व्रतं पाशुपतं मम
verses.transliteration: paśutvāditi satyaṃ ca pratijñātaṃ samāhitāḥ ye cāpyanye cariṣyanti vrataṃ pāśupataṃ mama
verses.translation: Siva is named Pasupati, the lord of animals. According to the legend, recorded in the present chapter, every deity was asked by Siva to declare himself a mere Paiu or animal before Tripuras could be slain in the battle. The Gods accepted the proposal, declared themselves as animals and fought brutally. Lord iva won them the battle but Gods were still distressed. The lord then enjoined the observance of Pasupata vrata for the attainment of their release from animal nature.
verses.hindi: ज्ञानं विचारतो लब्ध्वा रुद्रेभ्यस्तत्र मुच्यते। अर्धनारीश्वरं देवं चतुर्भुजमनुत्तमम्
verses.wordMeaning: Siva is named Pasupati, the lord of animals. According to the legend, recorded in the present chapter, every deity was asked by Siva to declare himself a mere Paiu or animal before Tripuras could be slain in the battle. The Gods accepted the proposal,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Siva is named Pasupati, the lord of animals. According to the legend, recorded in the present chapter, every deity was asked by Siva to declare himself a mere Paiu or animal before Tripuras could be slain in the battle. The Gods accepted the proposal,…

verses.sanskrit: मोक्ष्यन्ति ते न संदेहः पशुत्वात् सुरसत्तमाः नैष्ठिकं द्वादशाब्दं वा तदर्धं वर्षकत्रयम्
verses.transliteration: mokṣyanti te na saṃdehaḥ paśutvāt surasattamāḥ naiṣṭhikaṃ dvādaśābdaṃ vā tadardhaṃ varṣakatrayam
verses.translation: Mounted on a chariot as huge as the lord of mountains, Nandin went ahead of Devas and the chiefs of Ganas, in order to strike at the trio of the cities, like the great lord Isa going ahead to strike the god of Death.
verses.hindi: वरदाभयहस्तं च शूलपद्मधरं प्रभुम्। स्त्रीपुम्भावेन संस्थानं सर्वाभरणभूषितम् कृत्वा भक्त्या प्रतिष्ठाप्य शिवलोके महीयते। तत्र भुक्त्वा महाभोगानणिमादिगुणैर्युतः
verses.wordMeaning: Mounted on a chariot as huge as the lord of mountains, Nandin went ahead of Devas and the chiefs of Ganas, in order to strike at the trio of the cities, like the great lord Isa going ahead to strike the god of Death.
verses.commentary: Sense: Mounted on a chariot as huge as the lord of mountains, Nandin went ahead of Devas and the chiefs of Ganas, in order to strike at the trio of the cities, like the great lord Isa going ahead to strike the god of Death.

verses.sanskrit: शुश्रूषां कारयेद्यस्तु स पशुत्वाद्विमुच्यते तस्मात्परमिदं दिव्यं चरिष्यथ सुरोत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: śuśrūṣāṃ kārayedyastu sa paśutvādvimucyate tasmātparamidaṃ divyaṃ cariṣyatha surottamāḥ
verses.translation: Mounting on lordly elephants, huge bulls and stately horses, Devas, the lords of Ganas, and the Ganas, with thier respective weapons and symbols in their hands followed their leader Nandin.
verses.hindi: यः कुयद्दिवदेवेशं सर्वज्ञं लकुलीश्वरम्
verses.wordMeaning: Mounting on lordly elephants, huge bulls and stately horses, Devas, the lords of Ganas, and the Ganas, with thier respective weapons and symbols in their hands followed their leader Nandin.
verses.commentary: Sense: Mounting on lordly elephants, huge bulls and stately horses, Devas, the lords of Ganas, and the Ganas, with thier respective weapons and symbols in their hands followed their leader Nandin.

verses.sanskrit: तथेति चाब्रुवन्देवाः शिवे लोकनमस्कृते तस्माद्वै पशवः सर्वे देवासुरनराः प्रभोः
verses.transliteration: tatheti cābruvandevāḥ śive lokanamaskṛte tasmādvai paśavaḥ sarve devāsuranarāḥ prabhoḥ
verses.translation: Mounting on. the lord of the birds (i.e. Garusi) as huge as the lord of mountains the bird-bannered lord Visnu of great prowess hurriedly went ahead, on the left side of Rudra in order to burn the three cities for the welfare of the worlds.
verses.hindi: कृत्वा भक्त्या प्रतिष्ठाप्य शिवलोकं स गच्छति पूर्वदेवामराणां च यत्स्थानं सकलेप्सितम्। कृतमुद्रस्य देवस्य चिताभस्मानुलेपिनः
verses.wordMeaning: Mounting on. the lord of the birds (i.e. Garusi) as huge as the lord of mountains the bird-bannered lord Visnu of great prowess hurriedly went ahead, on the left side of Rudra in order to burn the three cities for the welfare of the worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: Mounting on. the lord of the birds (i.e. Garusi) as huge as the lord of mountains the bird-bannered lord Visnu of great prowess hurriedly went ahead, on the left side of Rudra in order to burn the three cities for the welfare of the worlds.

verses.sanskrit: रुद्रः पशुपतिश्चैव पशुपाशविमोचकः यः पशुस्तत्पशुत्वं च व्रतेनानेन संत्यजेत्
verses.transliteration: rudraḥ paśupatiścaiva paśupāśavimocakaḥ yaḥ paśustatpaśutvaṃ ca vratenānena saṃtyajet
verses.translation: All Devas followed that lord of the world, the lord of Devas and Asuras, the incomprehensible deity, with their ex- cellent weapons such as the sharp lances, axes, iron clubs, tridents and swords.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्मणः केशकेनैकमुपवीतं च बिभ्रतः
verses.wordMeaning: All Devas followed that lord of the world, the lord of Devas and Asuras, the incomprehensible deity, with their ex- cellent weapons such as the sharp lances, axes, iron clubs, tridents and swords.
verses.commentary: Sense: All Devas followed that lord of the world, the lord of Devas and Asuras, the incomprehensible deity, with their ex- cellent weapons such as the sharp lances, axes, iron clubs, tridents and swords.

verses.sanskrit: तत्कृत्वा न च पापीयान् इति शास्त्रस्य निश्चयः ततो विनायकः साक्षाद् बालो ऽबालपराक्रमः
verses.transliteration: tatkṛtvā na ca pāpīyān iti śāstrasya niścayaḥ tato vināyakaḥ sākṣād bālo 'bālaparākramaḥ
verses.translation: In the middle of Devas, lord Visnu whose vehicle was a bird and whose complexion was like that of the lotus leaf (petal) shone in the same manner as the thousand-rayed fierce sun when he ascends the peak of Sumeru.
verses.hindi: बिभ्रतो वामहस्तेन कपालं ब्रह्मणो वरम्। नागटंक धारण करनेवाले, व्याघ्रचर्मको उत्तरीयके रूपमे
verses.wordMeaning: In the middle of Devas, lord Visnu whose vehicle was a bird and whose complexion was like that of the lotus leaf (petal) shone in the same manner as the thousand-rayed fierce sun when he ascends the peak of Sumeru.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the middle of Devas, lord Visnu whose vehicle was a bird and whose complexion was like that of the lotus leaf (petal) shone in the same manner as the thousand-rayed fierce sun when he ascends the peak of Sumeru.

verses.sanskrit: अपूजितस्तदा देवैः प्राह देवान्निवारयन् मामपूज्य जगत्यस्मिन् भक्ष्यभोज्यादिभिः शुभैः
verses.transliteration: apūjitastadā devaiḥ prāha devānnivārayan māmapūjya jagatyasmin bhakṣyabhojyādibhiḥ śubhaiḥ
verses.translation: In order to destroy the cities, like Garuda who des- troyed the serpents, the thousand-eyed Indra, the first among Devas, went ahead on the right side of Rudra. He was seated on his lordly elephant.
verses.hindi: लपेटे हुए, मृगचर्मको वस्त्ररूपमें धारण किये हुए तीक्ष्ण दाँतोंवाले, हाथमें गदा लिये हुए, हाथमें कपाल लिये हुए, हुं-फट् महाशब्दसे सभी दिशाओंको गुंजित करते हुए, दोनों हाथोंमें व्याघ्रचर्म तथा कमण्डलु धारण
verses.wordMeaning: In order to destroy the cities, like Garuda who des- troyed the serpents, the thousand-eyed Indra, the first among Devas, went ahead on the right side of Rudra. He was seated on his lordly elephant.
verses.commentary: Sense: In order to destroy the cities, like Garuda who des- troyed the serpents, the thousand-eyed Indra, the first among Devas, went ahead on the right side of Rudra. He was seated on his lordly elephant.

verses.sanskrit: कः पुमान्सिद्धिमाप्नोति देवो वा दानवो ऽपि वा ततस्तस्मिन् क्षणादेव देवकार्ये सुरेश्वराः
verses.transliteration: kaḥ pumānsiddhimāpnoti devo vā dānavo 'pi vā tatastasmin kṣaṇādeva devakārye sureśvarāḥ
verses.translation: The heroes of the Siddhas, Gandharvas and leading Devas all round, eulogised Indra who was the bestower of des- ired objects and who was the overlord of the leading Devas by saying "Be victorious." They honoured him with the excellent shower of flowers.
verses.hindi: किये हुए, हँसते हुए, गरजते हुए, काले समुद्रको पीते हुए, भूतसमूहोंके साथ नृत्य करते हुए और गणसमुदायोंसे सुशोभित होते हुए देवेश्वर प्रभु शिवको मूर्तिरूपमें अपने सामर्थ्यके अनुसार बनाकर तथा प्रतिष्ठा करके मनुष्य सभी विघ्नोंसे रहित होकर शिवलोकमें प्रतिष्ठित होता है और वहाँ प्रलयपर्यन्त महान् सुखोंको भोगकर रुद्रोंसे विचारपूर्वक ज्ञान प्राप्त करके मुक्त हो जाता है॥ २९--३४ /२॥
verses.wordMeaning: The heroes of the Siddhas, Gandharvas and leading Devas all round, eulogised Indra who was the bestower of des- ired objects and who was the overlord of the leading Devas by saying "Be victorious." They honoured him with the excellent shower of flowers.
verses.commentary: Sense: The heroes of the Siddhas, Gandharvas and leading Devas all round, eulogised Indra who was the bestower of des- ired objects and who was the overlord of the leading Devas by saying "Be victorious." They honoured him with the excellent shower of flowers.

verses.sanskrit: विघ्नं करिष्ये देवेश कथं कर्तुं समुद्यताः ततः सेन्द्राः सुराः सर्वे भीताः सम्पूज्य तं प्रभुम्
verses.transliteration: vighnaṃ kariṣye deveśa kathaṃ kartuṃ samudyatāḥ tataḥ sendrāḥ surāḥ sarve bhītāḥ sampūjya taṃ prabhum
verses.translation: At that time those who' were stationed in the heaven bowed to the thousand-eyed Indra, who was the paramour of Ahalya, who was the overlord of the universe and who was the leader of Devas after seeing him sporting like the son of Uma i.e. Karttikeya.
verses.hindi: मुद्रायुक्त हाथवाले, त्रिशूल तथा पद्म धारण किये हुए, स्त्री तथा पुरुष भावमें स्थित और समस्त आशभूषणोंसे सुशोभित अत्युत्तम प्रभु महादेवको  मूर्तिरूपमें बनाकर भक्तिपूर्वक प्रतिष्ठा करके वह शिवलोकमें प्रतिष्ठित
verses.wordMeaning: At that time those who' were stationed in the heaven bowed to the thousand-eyed Indra, who was the paramour of Ahalya, who was the overlord of the universe and who was the leader of Devas after seeing him sporting like the son of Uma i.e. Karttikeya.
verses.commentary: Sense: At that time those who' were stationed in the heaven bowed to the thousand-eyed Indra, who was the paramour of Ahalya, who was the overlord of the universe and who was the leader of Devas after seeing him sporting like the son of Uma i.e. Karttikeya.

verses.sanskrit: भक्ष्यभोज्यादिभिश्चैव उण्डरैश्चैव मोदकैः अब्रुवंस्ते गणेशानं निर्विघ्नं चास्तु नः सदा
verses.transliteration: bhakṣyabhojyādibhiścaiva uṇḍaraiścaiva modakaiḥ abruvaṃste gaṇeśānaṃ nirvighnaṃ cāstu naḥ sadā
verses.translation: Yama, Fire, Kubera, Vayu, Nirrti, Varuna and Isana followed Rudra.
verses.hindi: होता है और वहाँ चन्द्रमा तथा तारोंकी स्थितिपर्यन्त महान् सुखोंको भोगकर अणिमा आदि गुणोंसे युक्त होकर ज्ञान प्राप्त करके वह मुक्त हो जाता है ॥ ३५-३७ ४२॥ जो मनुष्य शिष्य-प्रशिष्योंसे घिरे हुए, उपदेशकी मुद्रामें उठे हुए हाथवाले, देवदेवेश तथा सर्वज्ञ लकुलीश्वरको मूर्तिरूपमें बनाकर और पुनः भक्तिपूर्वक उन्हे स्थापित करके शिवलोकको जाता है। वह मनुष्य सौ
verses.wordMeaning: Yama, Fire, Kubera, Vayu, Nirrti, Varuna and Isana followed Rudra.
verses.commentary: Sense: Yama, Fire, Kubera, Vayu, Nirrti, Varuna and Isana followed Rudra.

verses.sanskrit: भवो ऽप्यनेकैः कुसुमैर् गणेशं भक्ष्यैश् च भोज्यैः सुरसैः सुगन्धैः ।* आलिङ्ग्य चाघ्राय सुतं तदानीमपूजयत्सर्वसुरेन्द्रमुख्यः
verses.transliteration: bhavo 'pyanekaiḥ kusumair gaṇeśaṃ bhakṣyaiś ca bhojyaiḥ surasaiḥ sugandhaiḥ /* āliṅgya cāghrāya sutaṃ tadānīmapūjayatsarvasurendramukhyaḥ
verses.translation: Virabhadra who was very efficient in battle, followed at the south west side of the chariot. He was mounted on a huge bull and surrounded by the beings born of his hairs. He thus served the three-eyed lord of Devas in order to destroy the Asura cities. Mahakala of great splendour who appeared like another Mahadeva, served the chariot on its north-western side.
verses.hindi: युगोंतक वहाँ महान् सुखोंको भोगकर पुनः ज्ञानयोग प्राप्त करके वहींपर मुक्त हो जाता है, जो पूर्वदेवो तथा अमरोंका सर्वाभीष्ट स्थान है॥ ३८-४०/२॥
verses.wordMeaning: Virabhadra who was very efficient in battle, followed at the south west side of the chariot. He was mounted on a huge bull and surrounded by the beings born of his hairs. He thus served the three-eyed lord of Devas in order to destroy the Asura cities.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Virabhadra who was very efficient in battle, followed at the south west side of the chariot. He was mounted on a huge bull and surrounded by the beings born of his hairs. He thus served the three-eyed lord of Devas in order to destroy the Asura cities.…

verses.sanskrit: सम्पूज्य पूज्यं सह देवसंघैर् विनायकं नायकमीश्वराणाम् गणेश्वरैरेव नगेन्द्रधन्वा पुरत्रयं दग्धुमसौ जगाम
verses.transliteration: sampūjya pūjyaṃ saha devasaṃghair vināyakaṃ nāyakamīśvarāṇām gaṇeśvaraireva nagendradhanvā puratrayaṃ dagdhumasau jagāma
verses.translation: After creating impediments unto the leading Asuras and after removing obstacles in the case of Devas, lord Ganea Vighnevara went to the camp of Isana, accompanied by the groups of Vighnas (his followers).
verses.hindi: ध्यानमुद्रामें स्थित, चिताकी भस्म लगाये हुए त्रिपुण्ड धारण किये हुए, मुण्डमाला धारण हुए, ब्रह्माके केशसे निर्मित एक यज्ञोपवीत धारण किये हुए, बाएँ हाथमें ब्रह्माका श्रेष्ठ कपाल धारण किये हुए और भगवान् विष्णुका शरीर धारण हुए महादेव शिवको मूर्ति बनाकर तथा उसकी प्रतिष्ठा करके मनुष्य भवसागरसे पार
verses.wordMeaning: After creating impediments unto the leading Asuras and after removing obstacles in the case of Devas, lord Ganea Vighnevara went to the camp of Isana, accompanied by the groups of Vighnas (his followers).
verses.commentary: Sense: After creating impediments unto the leading Asuras and after removing obstacles in the case of Devas, lord Ganea Vighnevara went to the camp of Isana, accompanied by the groups of Vighnas (his followers).

verses.sanskrit: तं देवदेवं सुरसिद्धसंघा महेश्वरं भूतगणाश् च सर्वे गणेश्वरा नन्दिमुखास्तदानीं स्ववाहनैरन्वयुरीशमीशाः
verses.transliteration: taṃ devadevaṃ surasiddhasaṃghā maheśvaraṃ bhūtagaṇāś ca sarve gaṇeśvarā nandimukhāstadānīṃ svavāhanairanvayurīśamīśāḥ
verses.translation: Saying ''Be victorious", the chiefs of the Siddhas, Gandharvas, Pisacas, Yaksas, Vidyadharas, lordly serpents and leading Devas bowed to the goddess, the daughter of the mountain of snow and eulogised her loudly.
verses.hindi: विविध शिवस्वरूपोंकी प्रतिष्ठा एवं उपासनाका फल
verses.wordMeaning: Saying ''Be victorious", the chiefs of the Siddhas, Gandharvas, Pisacas, Yaksas, Vidyadharas, lordly serpents and leading Devas bowed to the goddess, the daughter of the mountain of snow and eulogised her loudly.
verses.commentary: Sense: Saying ''Be victorious", the chiefs of the Siddhas, Gandharvas, Pisacas, Yaksas, Vidyadharas, lordly serpents and leading Devas bowed to the goddess, the daughter of the mountain of snow and eulogised her loudly.

verses.sanskrit: अग्रे सुराणां च गणेश्वराणां तदाथ नन्दी गिरिराजकल्पम् विमानमारुह्य पुरं प्रहर्तुं जगाम मृत्युं भगवानिवेशः
verses.transliteration: agre surāṇāṃ ca gaṇeśvarāṇāṃ tadātha nandī girirājakalpam vimānamāruhya puraṃ prahartuṃ jagāma mṛtyuṃ bhagavāniveśaḥ
verses.translation: The mothers (Brahini, Mahesvari, etc.) who were respectfully adored by the groups of Devas and who were bent on killing the Raksasas went to the great Mother (Amba, Gauri) on their vehicles, along with their followers who held banners all round.
verses.hindi: प्रप्र अकी कलक क कक फक कक कफफफफकऊफकफफफफफफफफफफफफफफकफफफफ फक्क फफफ सम्पूज्य देवदेवेशं शिवलोके महीयते। जालन्धरान्तकं देवं सुदर्शनधरं प्रभुम्
verses.wordMeaning: The mothers (Brahini, Mahesvari, etc.) who were respectfully adored by the groups of Devas and who were bent on killing the Raksasas went to the great Mother (Amba, Gauri) on their vehicles, along with their followers who held banners all round.
verses.commentary: Sense: The mothers (Brahini, Mahesvari, etc.) who were respectfully adored by the groups of Devas and who were bent on killing the Raksasas went to the great Mother (Amba, Gauri) on their vehicles, along with their followers who held banners all round.

verses.sanskrit: यान्तं तदानीं तु शिलादपुत्रम् आरुह्य नागेन्द्रवृषाश्ववर्यान् देवास्तदानीं गणपाश् च सर्वे गणा ययुः स्वायुधचिह्नहस्ताः
verses.transliteration: yāntaṃ tadānīṃ tu śilādaputram āruhya nāgendravṛṣāśvavaryān devāstadānīṃ gaṇapāś ca sarve gaṇā yayuḥ svāyudhacihnahastāḥ
verses.translation: Riding on a lion, the goddess Durga went forth to chastise Daityas. The auspicious deity was one whose orders could not be transgressed. In her mighty arms she held weapons of different kinds such as the trident, axe, goad, noose, discus, sword and couch. She burned and scorched the pathway with her eyes as dazzling as thousands of midday suns and fires. Though a woman, her exploits were uncommon among women.
verses.hindi: प्रयाति शिवसायुज्यं नात्र कार्या विचारणा
verses.wordMeaning: Riding on a lion, the goddess Durga went forth to chastise Daityas. The auspicious deity was one whose orders could not be transgressed. In her mighty arms she held weapons of different kinds such as the trident, axe, goad, noose, discus, sword and couch.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Riding on a lion, the goddess Durga went forth to chastise Daityas. The auspicious deity was one whose orders could not be transgressed. In her mighty arms she held weapons of different kinds such as the trident, axe, goad, noose, discus, sword and couch.…

verses.sanskrit: खगेन्द्रमारुह्य नगेन्द्रकल्पं खगध्वजो वामत एव शंभोः ।* जगाम जगतां हिताय पुरत्रयं दग्धुमलुप्तशक्तिः
verses.transliteration: khagendramāruhya nagendrakalpaṃ khagadhvajo vāmata eva śaṃbhoḥ /* jagāma jagatāṃ hitāya puratrayaṃ dagdhumaluptaśaktiḥ
verses.translation: Equipped with ploughs, ploughshares, iron clubs, missiles, Bhusundas and peaks of lofty mountains, the lords of Devas and the chiefs of goblins as huge as mountains went ahead of Mahesvara,
verses.hindi: सुदर्शनप्रदं देवं साक्षात्ूर्वोक्तलक्षणम्। अर्चमानेन देवेन चाचितं नेत्रपूजया
verses.wordMeaning: Equipped with ploughs, ploughshares, iron clubs, missiles, Bhusundas and peaks of lofty mountains, the lords of Devas and the chiefs of goblins as huge as mountains went ahead of Mahesvara,
verses.commentary: Sense: Equipped with ploughs, ploughshares, iron clubs, missiles, Bhusundas and peaks of lofty mountains, the lords of Devas and the chiefs of goblins as huge as mountains went ahead of Mahesvara,

verses.sanskrit: तं सर्वदेवाः सुरलोकनाथं समन्ततश्चान्वयुरप्रमेयम् ।* सुरासुरेशं सहस्ररश्मिर् भगवान् सुतीक्ष्णः
verses.transliteration: taṃ sarvadevāḥ suralokanāthaṃ samantataścānvayuraprameyam /* surāsureśaṃ sahasraraśmir bhagavān sutīkṣṇaḥ
verses.translation: Devas, the chiefs of whom were Indra, the lotus-born Brahma, Visnu, and the lords of Ganas, surrounding lord Ganeia on all sides, spoke the words, "Be victorious" with palms joined in reverence over their coronets.
verses.hindi: कृत्वा भक्त्या प्रतिष्ठाप्य शिवलोके महीयते। तिष्ठतोऽथ निकुम्भस्य पृष्ठतश्चरणाम्बुजम्
verses.wordMeaning: Devas, the chiefs of whom were Indra, the lotus-born Brahma, Visnu, and the lords of Ganas, surrounding lord Ganeia on all sides, spoke the words, "Be victorious" with palms joined in reverence over their coronets.
verses.commentary: Sense: Devas, the chiefs of whom were Indra, the lotus-born Brahma, Visnu, and the lords of Ganas, surrounding lord Ganeia on all sides, spoke the words, "Be victorious" with palms joined in reverence over their coronets.

verses.sanskrit: रराज मध्ये भगवान्सुराणां विवाहनो वारिजपत्रवर्णः यथा सुमेरोः शिखराधिरूढः सहस्ररश्मिर् भगवान् सुतीक्ष्णः
verses.transliteration: rarāja madhye bhagavānsurāṇāṃ vivāhano vārijapatravarṇaḥ yathā sumeroḥ śikharādhirūḍhaḥ sahasraraśmir bhagavān sutīkṣṇaḥ
verses.translation: With staffs in their hands the sages with matted hairs danced. Siddhas, Caranas and other heaven-walkers showered
verses.hindi: वामेतरं सुविन्यस्य वामे चालिङ्ग्य चाद्रिजाम्। शूलाग्रे कूर्परं स्थाप्य किङ्किणीकृतपन्नगम् रूपं कृत्वा यथान्यायं शिवसायुज्यमाप्नुयात्
verses.wordMeaning: With staffs in their hands the sages with matted hairs danced. Siddhas, Caranas and other heaven-walkers showered
verses.commentary: Sense: With staffs in their hands the sages with matted hairs danced. Siddhas, Caranas and other heaven-walkers showered

verses.sanskrit: सहस्रनेत्रः प्रथमः सुराणां गजेन्द्रमारुह्य च दक्षिणे ऽस्य जगाम रुद्रस्य पुरं निहन्तुं यथोरगांस्तत्र तु वैनतेयः
verses.transliteration: sahasranetraḥ prathamaḥ surāṇāṃ gajendramāruhya ca dakṣiṇe 'sya jagāma rudrasya puraṃ nihantuṃ yathoragāṃstatra tu vainateyaḥ
verses.translation: Bhrngi, the most excellent among all the leading Ganas, w'as surrounded by lords of Ganas and Devas. A Yogin, he got into an aerial and went forth like Mahendra, to destroy the three cities.
verses.hindi: यः कुयद्दिवदेवेशं त्रिपुरान्तकमीश्वरम्। धनुर्बाणसमायुक्तं सोमं सोमार्धभूषणम्
verses.wordMeaning: Bhrngi, the most excellent among all the leading Ganas, w'as surrounded by lords of Ganas and Devas. A Yogin, he got into an aerial and went forth like Mahendra, to destroy the three cities.
verses.commentary: Sense: Bhrngi, the most excellent among all the leading Ganas, w'as surrounded by lords of Ganas and Devas. A Yogin, he got into an aerial and went forth like Mahendra, to destroy the three cities.

verses.sanskrit: तं सिद्धगन्धर्वसुरेन्द्रवीराः सुरेन्द्रवृन्दाधिपम् इन्द्रम् ईशम् समन्ततस्तुष्टुवुरिष्टदं ते जयेति शक्रं वरपुष्पवृष्ट्या
verses.transliteration: taṃ siddhagandharvasurendravīrāḥ surendravṛndādhipam indram īśam samantatastuṣṭuvuriṣṭadaṃ te jayeti śakraṃ varapuṣpavṛṣṭyā
verses.translation: The following leaders of Ganas surrounded Ia and went forth to chastise the Tripuras: — Kesa, Vigatavasas, Mahakesa, Mahajvara, Somavalli, Savarna, Somapa, Senaka, Somadhrk, Suryavaca, Suryapesanaka, Suryaksa, Surinama, Sura, Sundara, Prakuda, Kakudanta, Kampana, Prakampana, Indra, Indrajaya, Mahabhl, Bhimaka, Sataksa, Pancaksa, Sahasraksa, Mahodara, Yamajihva, Satasva, Kunthana, Kan- thapujana, Dvisikha, Trifikha, Pancaiikha, Munda, Ardha- munda, Dirgha, Pisacasya, Pinakadhrk, Pippalayatana, Ahgarakaana, Sithila, Sithilasya, Aksapada, Aja, Kuja, Aja- vaktra, Hayavaktra, Gajavaktra, Crdhvavaktra and others. They surrounded lord Soma in groups and went ahead. There were thousands and thousands of Rudras of sublimated sexu- ality, Surrounded by crores and crores of Ganas they rallied round Mahadeva, Mahesvara, the lord of Devas and went forth to burn the three cities.
verses.hindi: रथे सुसंस्थितं देवं चतुराननसारथिम्। तदाकारतया सोऽपि गत्वा शिवपुरं सुखी क्रोडते नात्र सन्देहो द्वितीय इव शङ्करः।
verses.wordMeaning: The following leaders of Ganas surrounded Ia and went forth to chastise the Tripuras: — Kesa, Vigatavasas, Mahakesa, Mahajvara, Somavalli, Savarna, Somapa, Senaka, Somadhrk, Suryavaca, Suryapesanaka, Suryaksa, Surinama, Sura, Sundara, Prakuda, Kakudanta, Kampana, Prakampana,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The following leaders of Ganas surrounded Ia and went forth to chastise the Tripuras: — Kesa, Vigatavasas, Mahakesa, Mahajvara, Somavalli, Savarna, Somapa, Senaka, Somadhrk, Suryavaca, Suryapesanaka, Suryaksa, Surinama, Sura, Sundara, Prakuda, Kakudanta, Kampana, Prakampana,…

verses.sanskrit: तदा ह्यहल्योपपतिं सुरेशं जगत्पतिं दिविष्ठाः ।* प्रणेमुरालोक्य सहस्रनेत्रं सलीलमंबा तनयं यथेन्द्रम्
verses.transliteration: tadā hyahalyopapatiṃ sureśaṃ jagatpatiṃ diviṣṭhāḥ /* praṇemurālokya sahasranetraṃ salīlamaṃbā tanayaṃ yathendram
verses.translation: The thirty three, the three hundred and three and three thousand and three Devas went forth on all sides.
verses.hindi: जाता है। जो एक बार भी ' ओम् नमो नीलकण्ठाय'- इस पुण्यदायक अष्टाक्षर मन्त्रका उच्चारण करता है, वह पापोंसे छूट जाता है; और अपने सामर्थ्यके अनुसार गन्ध आदि उपचारों-से इस मन्त्रके द्वारा
verses.wordMeaning: The thirty three, the three hundred and three and three thousand and three Devas went forth on all sides.
verses.commentary: Sense: The thirty three, the three hundred and three and three thousand and three Devas went forth on all sides.

verses.sanskrit: यमपावकवित्तेशा वायुर्निरृतिरेव च अपाम्पतिस् तथेशानो भवं चानु समागताः
verses.transliteration: yamapāvakavitteśā vāyurnirṛtireva ca apāmpatis tatheśāno bhavaṃ cānu samāgatāḥ
verses.translation: The mothers of the world, the mothers of Ganas, and the mothers of the Bhutas followed the lord.
verses.hindi: भक्तिपूर्वक देवदेवेश्वरकी विधिवत् पूजा करके शिवलोकमें प्रतिष्ठा प्राप्त करता है॥ ४९--४५ /२॥ सुदर्शन चक्र धारण किये हुए तथा जलन्धरको दो टुकड़ोंमें किये हुए स्वरूपमें जलन्धर-विनाशक प्रभु महादेवको मूर्तिरूपमें बनाकर भक्तिपूर्वक उनकी  प्रतिष्ठा करके मनुष्य शिवसायुज्य प्राप्त करता है; इसमें
verses.wordMeaning: The mothers of the world, the mothers of Ganas, and the mothers of the Bhutas followed the lord.
verses.commentary: Sense: The mothers of the world, the mothers of Ganas, and the mothers of the Bhutas followed the lord.

verses.sanskrit: वीरभद्रो रणे भद्रो नैरृत्यां वै रथस्य तु वृषभेन्द्रं समारुह्य रोमजैश् च समावृतः
verses.transliteration: vīrabhadro raṇe bhadro nairṛtyāṃ vai rathasya tu vṛṣabhendraṃ samāruhya romajaiś ca samāvṛtaḥ
verses.translation: Seated in the middle of the chariot amongst Ganas the lord of the Ganas shone like the moon amongst stars and constellations.
verses.hindi: सन्देह नहीं करना चाहिए। पूर्वकथित लक्षणोंवाले, सुदर्शन चक्रके दाता तथा पूज्यमान विष्णुके द्वारा नेत्रदानरूपी पूजासे अचित देवेशवरको मूर्तिरूपमें बनाकर तथा भक्तिपूर्वक उन्हें स्थापित करके मनुष्य
verses.wordMeaning: Seated in the middle of the chariot amongst Ganas the lord of the Ganas shone like the moon amongst stars and constellations.
verses.commentary: Sense: Seated in the middle of the chariot amongst Ganas the lord of the Ganas shone like the moon amongst stars and constellations.

verses.sanskrit: सेवां चक्रे पुरं हन्तुं देवदेवं त्रियंबकम् महाकालो महातेजा महादेव इवापरः
verses.transliteration: sevāṃ cakre puraṃ hantuṃ devadevaṃ triyaṃbakam mahākālo mahātejā mahādeva ivāparaḥ
verses.translation: Goddess Gauri, the daughter of the Himalaya, identical with the worlds, was seated on the left side of the lord. She shone forth as though due to the splendour of lord Siva.
verses.hindi: शिवलोकमें प्रतिष्ठित होता है ॥ ४६--४८ /२॥ निकुम्भकी पीठपर स्थित, अपना दाहिना चरणकमल उसकी पीठपर टिकाये हुए, वामभागमें पार्वतीको बैठाये हुए, सर्परूपी किंकिणीसे वेष्टित कुहनीको अपने त्रिशूलके अग्रभागपर टिकाये हुए
verses.wordMeaning: Goddess Gauri, the daughter of the Himalaya, identical with the worlds, was seated on the left side of the lord. She shone forth as though due to the splendour of lord Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: Goddess Gauri, the daughter of the Himalaya, identical with the worlds, was seated on the left side of the lord. She shone forth as though due to the splendour of lord Siva.

verses.sanskrit: वायव्यां सगणैः सार्धं सेवां चक्रे रथस्य तु
verses.transliteration: vāyavyāṃ sagaṇaiḥ sārdhaṃ sevāṃ cakre rathasya tu
verses.translation: The goddess, of auspicious marks, on the left side of the lord, shone with the tips of her hands holding the chowries. She had the lustre and colour of the golden lotus.
verses.hindi: और पासमें हाथ जोडकर खडे अन्धककी ओर देखते हुए स्वरूप (मूर्त) -को विधिके अनुसार बनाकर उसको प्रतिष्ठा करनेसे मनुष्य शिवसायुज्य प्राप्त करता है
verses.wordMeaning: The goddess, of auspicious marks, on the left side of the lord, shone with the tips of her hands holding the chowries. She had the lustre and colour of the golden lotus.
verses.commentary: Sense: The goddess, of auspicious marks, on the left side of the lord, shone with the tips of her hands holding the chowries. She had the lustre and colour of the golden lotus.

verses.sanskrit: षण्मुखो ऽपि सह सिद्धचारणैः सेनया च गिरिराजसंनिभः देवनाथगणवृन्दसंवृतो वारणेन च तथाग्निसंभवः
verses.transliteration: ṣaṇmukho 'pi saha siddhacāraṇaiḥ senayā ca girirājasaṃnibhaḥ devanāthagaṇavṛndasaṃvṛto vāraṇena ca tathāgnisaṃbhavaḥ
verses.translation: The pure white body of the supreme lord, the lord of Devas, was shining with Bhasman. In the company of Ambika it shone like the white cloud in the sky with the streaks of lightning.
verses.hindi: जो भक्त त्रिपुरका विनाश करनेवाले देवदेवेश ईश्वरको इस स्वरूपमें स्थापित करता है-जिसमें वे धनुषबाण लिये हुए हों, अर्धचन्द्रको आभूषणके रूपमें धारण किये हुए हों, उमाके साथ रथपर बैठे हुए हों, ब्रह्माजी उनके सारथि हों; वह भी उसी स्वरूपसे शिवलोकमें जाकर आनन्दपूर्वक दूसरे शिवकी भाँति क्रीडा करता है; इसमें सन्देह नहीं है। है श्रेष्ठ ब्राह्मणो! वहाँ अपनी इच्छाके अनुसार महान् सुखोंको भोगकर
verses.wordMeaning: The pure white body of the supreme lord, the lord of Devas, was shining with Bhasman. In the company of Ambika it shone like the white cloud in the sky with the streaks of lightning.
verses.commentary: Sense: The pure white body of the supreme lord, the lord of Devas, was shining with Bhasman. In the company of Ambika it shone like the white cloud in the sky with the streaks of lightning.

verses.sanskrit: विघ्नं गणेशो ऽप्यसुरेश्वराणां कृत्वा सुराणां भगवानविघ्नम् विघ्नेश्वरो विघ्नगणैश् च सार्धं तं देशमीशानपदं जगाम
verses.transliteration: vighnaṃ gaṇeśo 'pyasureśvarāṇāṃ kṛtvā surāṇāṃ bhagavānavighnam vighneśvaro vighnagaṇaiś ca sārdhaṃ taṃ deśamīśānapadaṃ jagāma
verses.translation: The gentle body of lord Siva, having the lustre of the moon shone with the golden bow like the sky that shines with the rainbow or the universe that shines witli the Meru mountain.
verses.hindi: उत्तम ज्ञान प्राप्त करके वह वहींपर मुक्त हो जाता है ॥ ५२-५४ /२॥
verses.wordMeaning: The gentle body of lord Siva, having the lustre of the moon shone with the golden bow like the sky that shines with the rainbow or the universe that shines witli the Meru mountain.
verses.commentary: Sense: The gentle body of lord Siva, having the lustre of the moon shone with the golden bow like the sky that shines with the rainbow or the universe that shines witli the Meru mountain.

verses.sanskrit: काली तदा कालनिशाप्रकाशं शूलं कपालाभरणा करेण प्रकम्पयन्ती च तदा सुरेन्द्रान् महासुरासृङ्मधुपानमत्ता
verses.transliteration: kālī tadā kālaniśāprakāśaṃ śūlaṃ kapālābharaṇā kareṇa prakampayantī ca tadā surendrān mahāsurāsṛṅmadhupānamattā
verses.translation: His white umbrella interspersed with the rays of jewels shone like the full disc of the moon at the time of its rising.
verses.hindi: गंगाको धारण किये हुए; सुखसे बैठे हुए; त न कन्नन फ फ फ फ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ फ फ फ़ फ़ फ फ़ फ़ फ फ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ फ़ फ फ फा फ फ फफफ फफफ फफफ फफफ फ क फफफ मा मी भी की फफाफीपीफाफफपापाफाफाफफफफ फफफफ फफफ
verses.wordMeaning: His white umbrella interspersed with the rays of jewels shone like the full disc of the moon at the time of its rising.
verses.commentary: Sense: His white umbrella interspersed with the rays of jewels shone like the full disc of the moon at the time of its rising.

verses.sanskrit: मत्तेभगामी मदलोलनेत्रा मत्तैः पिशाचैश् च गणैश् च मत्तैः मत्तेभचर्मांबरवेष्टिताङ्गी ययौ पुरस्ताच्च गणेश्वरस्य
verses.transliteration: mattebhagāmī madalolanetrā mattaiḥ piśācaiś ca gaṇaiś ca mattaiḥ mattebhacarmāṃbaraveṣṭitāṅgī yayau purastācca gaṇeśvarasya
verses.translation: The gem-set necklace round the neck of Siva suspen- ded along with his silken upper cloth near the extremity of the umbrella shone like the excellent river Gahga falling from the sky.
verses.hindi: गड़या सहितं चैव वामोत्सङ्गेऽम्बिकान्वितम्। विनायकं तथा स्कन्दं ज्येष्ठ दुर्गा सुशोभनाम्
verses.wordMeaning: The gem-set necklace round the neck of Siva suspen- ded along with his silken upper cloth near the extremity of the umbrella shone like the excellent river Gahga falling from the sky.
verses.commentary: Sense: The gem-set necklace round the neck of Siva suspen- ded along with his silken upper cloth near the extremity of the umbrella shone like the excellent river Gahga falling from the sky.

verses.sanskrit: तां सिद्धगन्धर्वपिशाचयक्षविद्याधराहीन्द्रसुरेन्द्रमुख्याः प्रणेमुरुच्चैरभितुष्टुवुश् च जयेति देवीं हिमशैलपुत्रीम्
verses.transliteration: tāṃ siddhagandharvapiśācayakṣavidyādharāhīndrasurendramukhyāḥ praṇemuruccairabhituṣṭuvuś ca jayeti devīṃ himaśailaputrīm
verses.translation: Then the lord whose lotus-like feet were bowed to by Indra, Brahma, fire-god and others, went to the three cities along with Amba for the welfare of the world.
verses.hindi: भास्करं च तथा सोमं ब्रह्माणीं च महेश्वरीम्। कौमारीं वैष्णवीं देवीं वाराहीं वरदां तथा विघ्नेशेन च यो धीमान् शिवसायुज्यमाप्नुयात्
verses.wordMeaning: Then the lord whose lotus-like feet were bowed to by Indra, Brahma, fire-god and others, went to the three cities along with Amba for the welfare of the world.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the lord whose lotus-like feet were bowed to by Indra, Brahma, fire-god and others, went to the three cities along with Amba for the welfare of the world.

verses.sanskrit: मातरः सुरवरारिसूदनाः सादरं सुरगणैः सुपूजिताः मातरं ययुरथ स्ववाहनैः स्वैर्गणैर्ध्वजधरैः समन्ततः
verses.transliteration: mātaraḥ suravarārisūdanāḥ sādaraṃ suragaṇaiḥ supūjitāḥ mātaraṃ yayuratha svavāhanaiḥ svairgaṇairdhvajadharaiḥ samantataḥ
verses.translation: The trident- bearing lord is competent to burn mentally, within a trice, the entire universe including the mobile and immobile beings. Why should then the Pinaka-bearing lord go there himself along with the Ganas in order to burn the three cities?
verses.hindi: लिङ्गमूर्ति महाज्चालामालासंवृतमव्ययम्। लिङ्गस्य मध्ये वै कृत्वा चन्द्रशेखरमीश्वरम्
verses.wordMeaning: The trident- bearing lord is competent to burn mentally, within a trice, the entire universe including the mobile and immobile beings. Why should then the Pinaka-bearing lord go there himself along with the Ganas in order to burn the three cities?
verses.commentary: Sense: The trident- bearing lord is competent to burn mentally, within a trice, the entire universe including the mobile and immobile beings. Why should then the Pinaka-bearing lord go there himself along with the Ganas in order to burn the three cities?

verses.sanskrit: दुर्गारूढमृगाधिपा दुरतिगा दोर्दण्डवृन्दैः शिवा बिभ्राणाङ्कुशशूलपाशपरशुं चक्रासिशङ्खायुधम् प्रौढादित्यसहस्रसदृशैर्नेत्रैर्दहन्ती पथं बालाबालपराक्रमा भगवती दैत्यान्प्रहर्तुं ययौ
verses.transliteration: durgārūḍhamṛgādhipā duratigā dordaṇḍavṛndaiḥ śivā bibhrāṇāṅkuśaśūlapāśaparaśuṃ cakrāsiśaṅkhāyudham prauḍhādityasahasrasadṛśairnetrairdahantī pathaṃ bālābālaparākramā bhagavatī daityānprahartuṃ yayau
verses.translation: Devas, Visnu, Brahma and Indra said: — "Of what avail is the chariot to Sambhu? Of what avail is the excellent arrow to him? What has he to do with the groups of Devas? He is never wanting in power to burn the three cities. Then what is this?
verses.hindi: व्योम्नि कुर्यात्तथा लिङ्ग ब्रह्माणं हंसरूपिणम्। विष्णुं वराहरूपेण लिङ्गस्याधस्त्वधोमुखम् ब्रह्माणं दक्षिणे तस्य कृताञ्जलिपुटं स्थितम्। मध्ये लिङ्गं महाघोरं महाम्भसि च संस्थितम्
verses.wordMeaning: Devas, Visnu, Brahma and Indra said: — "Of what avail is the chariot to Sambhu? Of what avail is the excellent arrow to him? What has he to do with the groups of Devas? He is never wanting in power to burn the three cities. Then what is this?
verses.commentary: Sense: Devas, Visnu, Brahma and Indra said: — "Of what avail is the chariot to Sambhu? Of what avail is the excellent arrow to him? What has he to do with the groups of Devas? He is never wanting in power to burn the three cities. Then what is this?

verses.sanskrit: तं देवमीशं त्रिपुरं निहन्तुं तदा तु देवेन्द्ररविप्रकाशाः गजैर्हयैः सिंहवरै रथैश् च वृषैर्ययुस्ते गणराजमुख्याः
verses.transliteration: taṃ devamīśaṃ tripuraṃ nihantuṃ tadā tu devendraraviprakāśāḥ gajairhayaiḥ siṃhavarai rathaiś ca vṛṣairyayuste gaṇarājamukhyāḥ
verses.translation: We think that just for his pastime the Pinakabear- ing lord set about doing all these things. Otherwise, what other benefit has he to derive from this elaborate show?
verses.hindi: कृत्वा भक्त्या प्रतिष्ठाप्य शिवसायुज्यमाण्नुयात्। क्षेत्रसंरक्षकं देवं तथा पाशुपतं प्रभुम्
verses.wordMeaning: We think that just for his pastime the Pinakabear- ing lord set about doing all these things. Otherwise, what other benefit has he to derive from this elaborate show?
verses.commentary: Sense: We think that just for his pastime the Pinakabear- ing lord set about doing all these things. Otherwise, what other benefit has he to derive from this elaborate show?

verses.sanskrit: हलैश् च फालैर् मुसलैर् भुशुण्डैर् गिरीन्द्रकूटैर् गिरिसन्निभास्ते ययुः पुरस्ताद्धि महेश्वरस्य सुरेश्वरा भूतगणेश्वराश् च
verses.transliteration: halaiś ca phālair musalair bhuśuṇḍair girīndrakūṭair girisannibhāste yayuḥ purastāddhi maheśvarasya sureśvarā bhūtagaṇeśvarāś ca
verses.translation: Delighted in the company of leading Devas and Ganas headed by lord Nandin, and with the universe for his chariot he shone along with the goddess, like the mountain Meru with its eight peaks. He shone thus as he neared the three cities.
verses.hindi: कृत्वा भक्त्या यथान्यायं शिवलोके महीयते चन्द्रमाको सिरपर धारण किये हुए; गंगासहित बाएं गोदमें पार्वतीको बैठाये हुए और विनायक कार्तिकेय, सुन्दरी दुर्गा, सूर्य, चन्द्रमा, ब्रह्माणी महेश्व कौमारी, वैष्णवीदेवी, वरदायिनी वाराही, इन्द्राणी चामुण्डा
verses.wordMeaning: Delighted in the company of leading Devas and Ganas headed by lord Nandin, and with the universe for his chariot he shone along with the goddess, like the mountain Meru with its eight peaks. He shone thus as he neared the three cities.
verses.commentary: Sense: Delighted in the company of leading Devas and Ganas headed by lord Nandin, and with the universe for his chariot he shone along with the goddess, like the mountain Meru with its eight peaks. He shone thus as he neared the three cities.

verses.sanskrit: तथेन्द्रपद्मोद्भवविष्णुमुख्याः सुरा गणेशाश् च गणेशमीशम् जयेति वाग्भिर् भगवन्तमूचुः किरीटदत्ताञ्जलयः समन्तात्
verses.transliteration: tathendrapadmodbhavaviṣṇumukhyāḥ surā gaṇeśāś ca gaṇeśamīśam jayeti vāgbhir bhagavantamūcuḥ kirīṭadattāñjalayaḥ samantāt
verses.translation: On seeing Kvara, the lord of Devas seated in the arena of the three cities along with Ganas and the daughter of Himavat, the group of Devas followed him.
verses.hindi: वीरभद्र तथा विघ्नेशसहित शिवको मूर्तिरूपमें जो बुद्धिमान् स्थापित करता है, वह शिवसायुज्य प्राप्त करता है
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing Kvara, the lord of Devas seated in the arena of the three cities along with Ganas and the daughter of Himavat, the group of Devas followed him.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing Kvara, the lord of Devas seated in the arena of the three cities along with Ganas and the daughter of Himavat, the group of Devas followed him.

verses.sanskrit: ननृतुर्मुनयः सर्वे दण्डहस्ता जटाधराः ववृषुः पुष्पवर्षाणि खेचराः सिद्धचारणाः पुरत्रयं च विप्रेन्द्राः प्राणदत्सर्वतस् तथा
verses.transliteration: nanṛturmunayaḥ sarve daṇḍahastā jaṭādharāḥ vavṛṣuḥ puṣpavarṣāṇi khecarāḥ siddhacāraṇāḥ puratrayaṃ ca viprendrāḥ prāṇadatsarvatas tathā
verses.translation: O leading sages, the three cities appeared like ano- ther set of the three worlds (because it was occupied) by leading men, the Ganas, Devas and the three kinds of Asuras.
