verses.hindi: ऐसी मूर्ति जिसमें अव्यय शिवजी लिङ्गके रूपमै हों, बड़ी-बड़ी ज्वालाओंके समूहोंसे घिरे हुए हों, लिङ्गके मध्यमें चन्द्रमाको धारण किये हुए स्थित हों, हंसरूपधारी ब्रह्मा उनके दाहिने भागमें हाथ जोड़े हुए विराजमान हों, वाराहरूपधारी विष्णु नीचेकी ओर मुख किये हुए लिङ्गके अधोभागमें स्थित हों, अघोर महान् लिङ्ग अत्यधिक जलके मध्यमें स्थित हो--उसे बनाकर तथा भक्तिपूर्वक स्थापित करके भक्त शिवसायुज्य
verses.wordMeaning: O leading sages, the three cities appeared like ano- ther set of the three worlds (because it was occupied) by leading men, the Ganas, Devas and the three kinds of Asuras.
verses.commentary: Sense: O leading sages, the three cities appeared like ano- ther set of the three worlds (because it was occupied) by leading men, the Ganas, Devas and the three kinds of Asuras.

verses.sanskrit: गणेश्वरैर् देवगणैश् च भृङ्गी सहावृतः सर्वगणेन्द्रवर्यः जगाम योगी त्रिपुरं निहन्तुं विमानमारुह्य यथा महेन्द्रः
verses.transliteration: gaṇeśvarair devagaṇaiś ca bhṛṅgī sahāvṛtaḥ sarvagaṇendravaryaḥ jagāma yogī tripuraṃ nihantuṃ vimānamāruhya yathā mahendraḥ
verses.translation: Then Sarva tied up the string of the bow, fitted the
verses.hindi: प्राप्त करता है। क्षेत्रकी रक्षा करनेवाले क्षेत्रपाल तथा प्रभु पशुपति शिवको  मूर्तिरूपमें बनाकर भक्तिपूर्वक विधानके अनुसार उनको स्थापित करके भक्त शिवलोकमें प्रतिष्ठित होता है
verses.wordMeaning: Then Sarva tied up the string of the bow, fitted the
verses.commentary: Sense: Then Sarva tied up the string of the bow, fitted the

verses.sanskrit: केशो विगतवासाश् च महाकेशो महाज्वरः सोमवल्ली सवर्णश् च सोमपः सेनकस् तथा
verses.transliteration: keśo vigatavāsāś ca mahākeśo mahājvaraḥ somavallī savarṇaś ca somapaḥ senakas tathā
verses.translation: When the great lord stood ready with the bow well- drawn, the three cities merged into one.
verses.hindi: छिहत्तरवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ शिवमन्दिरोंके निर्माणका फल, शिवक्षेत्रों तथा शिवतीर्थाके सेबनकी महिमा, शिवमन्दिरके उपलेपन आदिका माहात्म्य
verses.wordMeaning: When the great lord stood ready with the bow well- drawn, the three cities merged into one.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the great lord stood ready with the bow well- drawn, the three cities merged into one.

verses.sanskrit: सोमधृक् सूर्यवाचश् च सूर्यपेषणकस् तथा सूर्याक्षः सूरिनामा च सुरः सुन्दर एव च
verses.transliteration: somadhṛk sūryavācaś ca sūryapeṣaṇakas tathā sūryākṣaḥ sūrināmā ca suraḥ sundara eva ca
verses.translation: When the three cities had attained fusion into one, the delight of the noble-souled deities was tumultuous and excited.
verses.hindi: लिङ्कप्रतिष्ठापुण्यं च लिङ्गस्थापनमेव च। लिङ्गानां चैव भेदाश्च श्रुतं तव मुखादिह
verses.wordMeaning: When the three cities had attained fusion into one, the delight of the noble-souled deities was tumultuous and excited.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the three cities had attained fusion into one, the delight of the noble-souled deities was tumultuous and excited.

verses.sanskrit: प्रकुदः ककुदन्तश् च कम्पनश् च प्रकम्पनः इन्द्रश् चेन्द्रजयश्चैव महाभीर् भीमकस् तथा
verses.transliteration: prakudaḥ kakudantaś ca kampanaś ca prakampanaḥ indraś cendrajayaścaiva mahābhīr bhīmakas tathā
verses.translation: Eulogising the deity with eight cosmic bodies, all the groups of Devas, Siddhas and sages shouted the words, ''Be victorious'*.
verses.hindi: मृदादिरलपर्यन्तैद्रेव्यैः कृत्वा शिवालयम्। यत्फलं लभते मर्त्यस्तत्फलं वक्तुमर्हसि यस्य भक्तोऽपि लोकेऽस्मिन् पुत्रदारगृहादिभिः । बाध्यते ज्ञानयुक्तश्चेन्न च तस्य गृहैस्तु किम्
verses.wordMeaning: Eulogising the deity with eight cosmic bodies, all the groups of Devas, Siddhas and sages shouted the words, ''Be victorious'*.
verses.commentary: Sense: Eulogising the deity with eight cosmic bodies, all the groups of Devas, Siddhas and sages shouted the words, ''Be victorious'*.

verses.sanskrit: शताक्षश्चैव पञ्चाक्षः सहस्राक्षो महोदरः यमजिह्वः शताश्वश् च कण्ठनः कण्ठपूजनः
verses.transliteration: śatākṣaścaiva pañcākṣaḥ sahasrākṣo mahodaraḥ yamajihvaḥ śatāśvaś ca kaṇṭhanaḥ kaṇṭhapūjanaḥ
verses.translation: Even when the auspicious Pusyayoga was attained, the lord, the husband of Uma, who had destroyed the eye of Bhaga indulged in sportive pastime. Then lord Brahma spoke to him: —
verses.hindi: ऋषिगण बोले-हे सूतजी! हमलोगोंने आपके मुखसे लिङ्गकी स्थापना, लिङ्गप्रतिष्ठाके फल तथा लिङ्गोंके भेदोंको सुना; अब आप मिट्टीसे लेकर रत्नोंतक द्रव्योसे शिवालयका निर्माण करके मनु
verses.wordMeaning: Even when the auspicious Pusyayoga was attained, the lord, the husband of Uma, who had destroyed the eye of Bhaga indulged in sportive pastime. Then lord Brahma spoke to him: —
verses.commentary: Sense: Even when the auspicious Pusyayoga was attained, the lord, the husband of Uma, who had destroyed the eye of Bhaga indulged in sportive pastime. Then lord Brahma spoke to him: —

verses.sanskrit: द्विशिखस् त्रिशिखश्चैव तथा पञ्चशिखो द्विजाः मुण्डो ऽर्धमुण्डो दीर्घश् च पिशाचास्यः पिनाकधृक्
verses.transliteration: dviśikhas triśikhaścaiva tathā pañcaśikho dvijāḥ muṇḍo 'rdhamuṇḍo dīrghaś ca piśācāsyaḥ pinākadhṛk
verses.translation: O Mahadeva, Paramesvara, this gesture on your part is but proper, since, O lord, Asuras and Devas are equal to you.
verses.hindi: जो फल प्राप्त करता है, उस फलको कृपापूर्वक बतायें सूतजी बोले-हे ऋषियो! जिन शिक ज्ञानसम्पन्न भक्त इस लोकमें पुत्र, स्त्री, घर आदिसे बन्धनको प्राप्त नहीं होता, उसे गृहोंसे क्या प्रयोजन
verses.wordMeaning: O Mahadeva, Paramesvara, this gesture on your part is but proper, since, O lord, Asuras and Devas are equal to you.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Mahadeva, Paramesvara, this gesture on your part is but proper, since, O lord, Asuras and Devas are equal to you.

verses.sanskrit: पिप्पलायतनश्चैव तथा ह्यङ्गारकाशनः शिथिलः शिथिलास्यश् च अक्षपादो ह्यजः कुजः
verses.transliteration: pippalāyatanaścaiva tathā hyaṅgārakāśanaḥ śithilaḥ śithilāsyaś ca akṣapādo hyajaḥ kujaḥ
verses.translation: Still, in view of the fact that Devas are virtuous and asuras are sinful, it behoves you, O lord of the universe, to eschew your sportive pastime.
verses.hindi: शिवमन्दिरोंके निर्माणका फल"“शिवमन्दिरके उपलेपन आदिका माहात्म्य
verses.wordMeaning: Still, in view of the fact that Devas are virtuous and asuras are sinful, it behoves you, O lord of the universe, to eschew your sportive pastime.
verses.commentary: Sense: Still, in view of the fact that Devas are virtuous and asuras are sinful, it behoves you, O lord of the universe, to eschew your sportive pastime.

verses.sanskrit: अजवक्त्रो हयवक्त्रो गजवक्त्रो ऽर्ध्ववक्त्रकः इत्याद्याः परिवार्येशं लक्ष्यलक्षणवर्जिताः
verses.transliteration: ajavaktro hayavaktro gajavaktro 'rdhvavaktrakaḥ ityādyāḥ parivāryeśaṃ lakṣyalakṣaṇavarjitāḥ
verses.translation: O Isa, O lord, of what avail is the chariot, or the banner or the arrow, or Visnu, or I or even these goblins unto you for burning the three cities?
verses.hindi: कृत्वेष्टलोष्टेरपि रुद्रलोकम्। बाल्यात्तु लोष्टेन शिवं च कृत्वा मृदापि वा पांसुभिरादिदेवम्।
verses.wordMeaning: O Isa, O lord, of what avail is the chariot, or the banner or the arrow, or Visnu, or I or even these goblins unto you for burning the three cities?
verses.commentary: Sense: O Isa, O lord, of what avail is the chariot, or the banner or the arrow, or Visnu, or I or even these goblins unto you for burning the three cities?

verses.sanskrit: वृन्दशस्तं समावृत्य जग्मुः सोमं गणैर्वृताः सहस्राणां सहस्राणि रुद्राणामूर्ध्वरेतसाम्
verses.transliteration: vṛndaśastaṃ samāvṛtya jagmuḥ somaṃ gaṇairvṛtāḥ sahasrāṇāṃ sahasrāṇi rudrāṇāmūrdhvaretasām
verses.translation: It behoves you to burn the trio of the cities even as the Pusya conjunction still prevails. O lord of Devas, it behoves you to burn the three cities quickly lest they should get separated. Then the great lord Virupaksa, glanced at the three cities. Instantaneously they were reduced to ashes. All those deities, viz.. Soma (Moon), lord Visnu, Kalagni (Black fire) and Vayu who were stationed in the arrow bowed down to the lord and said: — "O lord of Devas, although the trio of the cities has been burned by your glance it behoves you to discharge the arrow for our welfare." Thereupon O leading brahmins, Ivara, Tripurardana, laughingly brushed the string of the bow, pulled it as far as his ear and discharged the arrow.
verses.hindi: सम्पूज्य रुद्रत्वमवाप्नुवन्ति॥
verses.wordMeaning: It behoves you to burn the trio of the cities even as the Pusya conjunction still prevails. O lord of Devas, it behoves you to burn the three cities quickly lest they should get separated. Then the great lord Virupaksa, glanced at the three cities.…
verses.commentary: Sense: It behoves you to burn the trio of the cities even as the Pusya conjunction still prevails. O lord of Devas, it behoves you to burn the three cities quickly lest they should get separated. Then the great lord Virupaksa, glanced at the three cities.…

verses.sanskrit: समावृत्य महादेवं देवदेवं महेश्वरम् दग्धुं पुरत्रयं जग्मुः कोटिकोटिगणैर्वृताः
verses.transliteration: samāvṛtya mahādevaṃ devadevaṃ maheśvaram dagdhuṃ puratrayaṃ jagmuḥ koṭikoṭigaṇairvṛtāḥ
verses.translation: Afterburning the three cities in a moment the arrow that brought about the destruction of the Tripuras came back to the lord of Devas, bowed to him and stood by. The
verses.hindi: तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन भक्त्या भक्तैः शिवालयम्। कर्तव्यं सर्वयत्नेन धर्मकामार्थसिद्धये केशरं नागरं वापि द्राविडं वा तथापरम्। कृत्वा रुद्रालयं भक्त्या शिवलोके महीयते
verses.wordMeaning: Afterburning the three cities in a moment the arrow that brought about the destruction of the Tripuras came back to the lord of Devas, bowed to him and stood by. The
verses.commentary: Sense: Afterburning the three cities in a moment the arrow that brought about the destruction of the Tripuras came back to the lord of Devas, bowed to him and stood by. The

verses.sanskrit: त्रयस्त्रिंशत्सुराश्चैव त्रयश् च त्रिशतास् तथा त्रयश् च त्रिसहस्राणि जग्मुर्देवाः समन्ततः
verses.transliteration: trayastriṃśatsurāścaiva trayaś ca triśatās tathā trayaś ca trisahasrāṇi jagmurdevāḥ samantataḥ
verses.translation: Be pleased, O lord of the chiefs of Devas; be pleased, O Paramesvara; be pleased, O lord of the worlds; be pleased, O eternal lord, the bestower of bliss.
verses.hindi: कैलासशिखराकारैर्विमानैमोदते सुखी
verses.wordMeaning: Be pleased, O lord of the chiefs of Devas; be pleased, O Paramesvara; be pleased, O lord of the worlds; be pleased, O eternal lord, the bestower of bliss.
verses.commentary: Sense: Be pleased, O lord of the chiefs of Devas; be pleased, O Paramesvara; be pleased, O lord of the worlds; be pleased, O eternal lord, the bestower of bliss.

verses.sanskrit: मातरः सर्वलोकानां गणानां चैव मातरः भूतानां मातरश्चैव जग्मुर्देवस्य पृष्ठतः
verses.transliteration: mātaraḥ sarvalokānāṃ gaṇānāṃ caiva mātaraḥ bhūtānāṃ mātaraścaiva jagmurdevasya pṛṣṭhataḥ
verses.translation: O Rudra of five faces, obeisance to you; obeisance to one who has fifty crores of physical forms; obeisance to the principle of learning, seated on the threefold Atman.
verses.hindi: मन्दरं वा प्रकुर्वीत शिवाय विधिपूर्वकम्। भक्त्या वित्तानुसारेण उत्तमाधममध्यमम् मन्दराद्रिप्रतीकाशैर्विमानैर्विश्वतोमुखैः । अप्सरोगणसङ्कीणैर्देवदानवदुर्ल भैः
verses.wordMeaning: O Rudra of five faces, obeisance to you; obeisance to one who has fifty crores of physical forms; obeisance to the principle of learning, seated on the threefold Atman.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Rudra of five faces, obeisance to you; obeisance to one who has fifty crores of physical forms; obeisance to the principle of learning, seated on the threefold Atman.

verses.sanskrit: भाति मध्ये गणानां च रथमध्ये गणेश्वरः नभस्यमलनक्षत्रे तारामध्य इवोडुराट्
verses.transliteration: bhāti madhye gaṇānāṃ ca rathamadhye gaṇeśvaraḥ nabhasyamalanakṣatre tārāmadhya ivoḍurāṭ
verses.translation: Obeisance to Siva, to the principle of Siva; obeisance to Aghora; obeisance to the principle of the set of eight forms*® Aghora and others; obeisance to one of the form of twelve®' Atmans.
verses.hindi: गत्वा शिवपुरं रम्यं भुक्त्वा भोगान् यथेप्सितान्। ज्ञानयोगं समासाद्य गाणपत्यं लभेन्नरः
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to Siva, to the principle of Siva; obeisance to Aghora; obeisance to the principle of the set of eight forms*® Aghora and others; obeisance to one of the form of twelve®' Atmans.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to Siva, to the principle of Siva; obeisance to Aghora; obeisance to the principle of the set of eight forms*® Aghora and others; obeisance to one of the form of twelve®' Atmans.

verses.sanskrit: रराज देवी देवस्य गिरिजा पार्श्वसंस्थिता तदा प्रभावतो गौरी भवस्येव जगन्मयी
verses.transliteration: rarāja devī devasya girijā pārśvasaṃsthitā tadā prabhāvato gaurī bhavasyeva jaganmayī
verses.translation: Obeisance to the Atman of Siva stationed in this world after adopting the splendid form that resembles crores of lightnings and that has sway over the eight quarters.
verses.hindi: सर्वयज्ञतपोदानतीर्थवेदेषु यत्फलम्। तत्फलं सकलं लब्ध्वा शिववन्मोदते चिरम् शिवलोकमनृप्राप्य शिववन्मोदते चिरम्
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to the Atman of Siva stationed in this world after adopting the splendid form that resembles crores of lightnings and that has sway over the eight quarters.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to the Atman of Siva stationed in this world after adopting the splendid form that resembles crores of lightnings and that has sway over the eight quarters.

verses.sanskrit: शुभावती तदा देवी पार्श्वसंस्था विभाति सा चामरासक्तहस्ताग्रा सा हेमांबुजवर्णिका
verses.transliteration: śubhāvatī tadā devī pārśvasaṃsthā vibhāti sā cāmarāsaktahastāgrā sā hemāṃbujavarṇikā
verses.translation: Obeisance to the fierce one of fiery complexion; obeisance to one with Ambika occupying half of his body; obeisance to the immortal being; to the bestower of salvation unto those of white, black and red colour.
verses.hindi: हिमशैलोपमैर्याैर्गत्वा शिवपुरं शुभम्
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to the fierce one of fiery complexion; obeisance to one with Ambika occupying half of his body; obeisance to the immortal being; to the bestower of salvation unto those of white, black and red colour.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to the fierce one of fiery complexion; obeisance to one with Ambika occupying half of his body; obeisance to the immortal being; to the bestower of salvation unto those of white, black and red colour.

verses.sanskrit: अथ विभाति विभोर्विशदं वपुर् भसितभासितमंबिकया तया सितमिवाभ्रमहो सह विद्युता नभसि देवपतेः परमेष्ठिनः
verses.transliteration: atha vibhāti vibhorviśadaṃ vapur bhasitabhāsitamaṃbikayā tayā sitamivābhramaho saha vidyutā nabhasi devapateḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ
verses.translation: aghora$taka-tattvaya— the set of eight forms beginning with Aghora.
verses.hindi: फिर भी इन्द्र तथा ब्रह्माके द्वारा नमस्कृत परमेश्वरके भक्त ईंटों अथवा पत्थरोंसे उनका उत्तम मन्दिर बनवाकर दिव्य रुद्रलोकको जाते हैं बालभावसे भी पत्थर, मिट्टी अथवा धूलसे इन शम्भुका उस प्रकारका आलय (मन्दिर) बनाकर आदिदेव शिवका विधिपूर्वक पूजन करके वे रुद्रत्व प्राप्त करते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: aghora$taka-tattvaya— the set of eight forms beginning with Aghora.
verses.commentary: Sense: aghora$taka-tattvaya— the set of eight forms beginning with Aghora.

verses.sanskrit: भातीन्द्रधनुषाकाशं मेरुणा च यथा जगत् हिरण्यधनुषा सौम्यं वपुः शंभोः शशिद्युति
verses.transliteration: bhātīndradhanuṣākāśaṃ meruṇā ca yathā jagat hiraṇyadhanuṣā saumyaṃ vapuḥ śaṃbhoḥ śaśidyuti
verses.translation: Obeisance to the Eldest one in the form of Rudra; to the deity accompanied by Uma; to the bestower of boons; obeisance to the deity of the three worlds; obeisance to the Trinity; obeisance to Vasatkara.
verses.hindi: अतः भक्तोंको धर्म, अर्थ, कामकी सिद्धिके लिये पूर्ण प्रयसे भक्तिपूर्वक शिवालयका निर्माण करना चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to the Eldest one in the form of Rudra; to the deity accompanied by Uma; to the bestower of boons; obeisance to the deity of the three worlds; obeisance to the Trinity; obeisance to Vasatkara.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to the Eldest one in the form of Rudra; to the deity accompanied by Uma; to the bestower of boons; obeisance to the deity of the three worlds; obeisance to the Trinity; obeisance to Vasatkara.

verses.sanskrit: सितातपत्रं रत्नांशुमिश्रितं परमेष्ठिनः यथोदये शशाङ्कस्य भात्यखण्डं हि मण्डलम्
verses.transliteration: sitātapatraṃ ratnāṃśumiśritaṃ parameṣṭhinaḥ yathodaye śaśāṅkasya bhātyakhaṇḍaṃ hi maṇḍalam
verses.translation: Obeisance to the one of the form of firmament in the middle; obeisance to you stationed in the firmament; obei- sance to the deity with eight forms®® in the eight shrines obeisance to one having eight principles.
verses.hindi: केसर, नागर, द्राविड अथवा अन्य प्रकारका शिवालय भक्तिपूर्वक बनाकर भक्त शिवलोकमें प्रतिष्ठा प्राप्त करता है जो भक्त कैलास नामक शिवालयका निर्माण करता है, वह कैलासशिखरके आकारवाले विमानोंमें सुखपूर्वक आनन्द मनाता है
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to the one of the form of firmament in the middle; obeisance to you stationed in the firmament; obei- sance to the deity with eight forms®® in the eight shrines obeisance to one having eight principles.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to the one of the form of firmament in the middle; obeisance to you stationed in the firmament; obei- sance to the deity with eight forms®® in the eight shrines obeisance to one having eight principles.

verses.sanskrit: सदुकूला शिवे रक्ता लम्बिता भाति मालिका छत्रान्ता रत्नजाकाशात् पतन्तीव सरिद्वरा
verses.transliteration: sadukūlā śive raktā lambitā bhāti mālikā chatrāntā ratnajākāśāt patantīva saridvarā
verses.translation: Obeisance to one stationed in three different sets of four and two different sets of five;®*® obeisance to one having five mantras as his physical form.
verses.hindi: जो मनुष्य शिवके लिये अपने सामर्थ्यके अनुसार भक्तिके साथ विधिपूर्वक उत्तम, मध्यम अथवा अधम श्रेणीका मन्दरनामक शिवालय बनाता है, वह मन्दरपर्वतके सदृश, सभी ओर मुखवाले, अप्सराओंसे
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to one stationed in three different sets of four and two different sets of five;®*® obeisance to one having five mantras as his physical form.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to one stationed in three different sets of four and two different sets of five;®*® obeisance to one having five mantras as his physical form.

verses.sanskrit: अथ महेन्द्रविरिञ्चिविभावसुप्रभृतिभिर् नतपादसरोरुहः सह तदा च जगाम तयांबया सकललोकहिताय पुरत्रयम्
verses.transliteration: atha mahendraviriñcivibhāvasuprabhṛtibhir natapādasaroruhaḥ saha tadā ca jagāma tayāṃbayā sakalalokahitāya puratrayam
verses.translation: Obeisance to the letter "A", of sixtyfour®' types; obeisance to the letter ''U" of the form of thirty two®"*® princi- ples.
verses.hindi: युक्त तथा देवदानवोंके लिये दुर्लभ विमानोंसे रम्य शिवलोकमें जाकर अभीष्ट सुखोंका उपभोग करके ज्ञानयोग प्राप्तकर गणाधिपति पद प्राप्त करता है जो मेरु नामक शिवालय बनाता है, वह जो फल प्राप्त करता है, वह फल सभी महायज्ञोंके द्वारा भी सम्भव नहीं है; सभी प्रकारके यज्ञ, तप, दान, तीर्थ तथा वेदाध्ययन करनेसे जो फल होता है, उस समस्त
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to the letter "A", of sixtyfour®' types; obeisance to the letter ''U" of the form of thirty two®"*® princi- ples.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to the letter "A", of sixtyfour®' types; obeisance to the letter ''U" of the form of thirty two®"*® princi- ples.

verses.sanskrit: दग्धुं समर्थो मनसा क्षणेन चराचरं सर्वमिदं त्रिशूली किमत्र दग्धुं त्रिपुरं पिनाकी स्वयं गतश्चात्र गणैश् च सार्धम्
verses.transliteration: dagdhuṃ samartho manasā kṣaṇena carācaraṃ sarvamidaṃ triśūlī kimatra dagdhuṃ tripuraṃ pinākī svayaṃ gataścātra gaṇaiś ca sārdham
verses.translation: Obeisance to the letter "M**, having the sixteen forms®®® of the Atman; obeisance to the deity in the eight forms®®® of half a Matra.
verses.hindi: फलको प्राप्त करके वह मनुष्य शिवकी भाँति चिरकालतक आनन्दित रहता है
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to the letter "M**, having the sixteen forms®®® of the Atman; obeisance to the deity in the eight forms®®® of half a Matra.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to the letter "M**, having the sixteen forms®®® of the Atman; obeisance to the deity in the eight forms®®® of half a Matra.

verses.sanskrit: रथेन किं चेषुवरेण तस्य गणैश् च किं देवगणैश् च शंभोः पुरत्रयं दग्धुमलुप्तशक्तेः किमेतद् इत्याहुर् अजेन्द्रमुख्याः
verses.transliteration: rathena kiṃ ceṣuvareṇa tasya gaṇaiś ca kiṃ devagaṇaiś ca śaṃbhoḥ puratrayaṃ dagdhumaluptaśakteḥ kimetad ityāhur ajendramukhyāḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to you, to the Omkara stationed in four®® ways; obeisance to the lord of the firmament, to the lord of heaven.
verses.hindi: शिवालय बनाता है, वह शिवलोक प्राप्त करके शिवके समान चिरकालतक आनन्दित रहता है शुभ शिवालय बनाता है, वह हिमशैलके समान
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to you, to the Omkara stationed in four®® ways; obeisance to the lord of the firmament, to the lord of heaven.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to you, to the Omkara stationed in four®® ways; obeisance to the lord of the firmament, to the lord of heaven.

verses.sanskrit: मन्वाम नूनं भगवान्पिनाकी लीलार्थमेतत्सकलं प्रवर्त्तुम् व्यवस्थितश्चेति तथान्यथा चेद् आडम्बरेणास्य फलं किमन्यत्
verses.transliteration: manvāma nūnaṃ bhagavānpinākī līlārthametatsakalaṃ pravarttum vyavasthitaśceti tathānyathā ced āḍambareṇāsya phalaṃ kimanyat
verses.translation: Obeisance to the lord having the seven worlds (as his form); obeisance to the lord of the Patala (Nether-worlds) and Naraka (hell); obeisance to the deity having eight forms in the eight®® holy shrines; obeisance to the deity greater than the greatest.
verses.hindi: श्रीलिड्रमहापुराण
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to the lord having the seven worlds (as his form); obeisance to the lord of the Patala (Nether-worlds) and Naraka (hell); obeisance to the deity having eight forms in the eight®® holy shrines; obeisance to the deity greater than the greatest.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to the lord having the seven worlds (as his form); obeisance to the lord of the Patala (Nether-worlds) and Naraka (hell); obeisance to the deity having eight forms in the eight®® holy shrines; obeisance to the deity greater than the greatest.

verses.sanskrit: पुरत्रयस्यास्य समीपवर्ती सुरेश्वरैर् नन्दिमुखैश् च नन्दी गणैर्गणेशस्तु रराज देव्या जगद्रथो मेरुरिवाष्टशृङ्गैः
verses.transliteration: puratrayasyāsya samīpavartī sureśvarair nandimukhaiś ca nandī gaṇairgaṇeśastu rarāja devyā jagadratho merurivāṣṭaśṛṅgaiḥ
verses.translation: a9ta-k?etra — right stations, sun, etc.
verses.hindi: क्क्ष फफफफफफफफफफफफफफफ्फफफ्रफफ्रफ फ्रफ्फफफ्फफफ्फफ्फ्फ्फ्फफकफ फफफफ्रफफ्रफ्फरफफफफ्फ पापी फ्रफफफ्रफफफ्रफ््फफकक्रफफफफ फ फफ फ़फफफ फक कृत्वा वित्तानुसारेण भक्त्या रुद्राय शम्भवे। यत्फलं लभते मर्त्यस्तत्फलं प्रवदाम्यहम्
verses.wordMeaning: a9ta-k?etra — right stations, sun, etc.
verses.commentary: Sense: a9ta-k?etra — right stations, sun, etc.

verses.sanskrit: अथ निरीक्ष्य सुरेश्वरमीश्वरं सगणमद्रिसुतासहितं तदा त्रिपुररङ्गतलोपरि संस्थितः सुरगणो ऽनुजगाम स्वयं तथा
verses.transliteration: atha nirīkṣya sureśvaramīśvaraṃ sagaṇamadrisutāsahitaṃ tadā tripuraraṅgatalopari saṃsthitaḥ suragaṇo 'nujagāma svayaṃ tathā
verses.translation: It refers to four Vedas, four airamas and four vyuhas.
verses.hindi: तत्फलं सकलं लब्ध्वा सर्वदेवनमस्कृतः
verses.wordMeaning: It refers to four Vedas, four airamas and four vyuhas.
verses.commentary: Sense: It refers to four Vedas, four airamas and four vyuhas.

verses.sanskrit: जगत्त्रयं सर्वमिवापरं तत् पुरत्रयं तत्र विभाति सम्यक् नरेश्वरैश्चैव गणैश् च देवैः सुरेतरैश् च त्रिविधैर्मुनीन्द्राः
verses.transliteration: jagattrayaṃ sarvamivāparaṃ tat puratrayaṃ tatra vibhāti samyak nareśvaraiścaiva gaṇaiś ca devaiḥ suretaraiś ca trividhairmunīndrāḥ
verses.translation: It refers to five mahabhutas, five forms, Sadyojata, etc., and Bve mantras.
verses.hindi: रद्रलोकमनृप्राप्य रुद्रैः सार्धं प्रमोदते। महेन्द्रशैलनामानं प्रासादं रुद्रसम्मतम् कृत्वा यत्फलमाप्नोति तत्फलं प्रवदाम्यहम्। महेन्द्रपर्वताकारैविमानैर्वृषसंयुतैः
verses.wordMeaning: It refers to five mahabhutas, five forms, Sadyojata, etc., and Bve mantras.
verses.commentary: Sense: It refers to five mahabhutas, five forms, Sadyojata, etc., and Bve mantras.

verses.sanskrit: अथ सज्यं धनुः कृत्वा शर्वः संधाय तं शरम् युक्त्वा पाशुपतास्त्रेण त्रिपुरं समचिन्तयत्
verses.transliteration: atha sajyaṃ dhanuḥ kṛtvā śarvaḥ saṃdhāya taṃ śaram yuktvā pāśupatāstreṇa tripuraṃ samacintayat
verses.translation: It refers to the syllable 'a' and its sixtyfour divisions.
verses.hindi: गत्वा शिवपुरं दिव्यं भुक्त्वा भोगान्यथेप्सितान्। ज्ञानं विचारितं रुद्रैः सम्प्राप्य मुनिपुङ्गवाः
verses.wordMeaning: It refers to the syllable 'a' and its sixtyfour divisions.
verses.commentary: Sense: It refers to the syllable 'a' and its sixtyfour divisions.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिन् स्थिते महादेवे रुद्रे विततकार्मुके पुराणि तेन कालेन जग्मुरेकत्वमाशु वै
verses.transliteration: tasmin sthite mahādeve rudre vitatakārmuke purāṇi tena kālena jagmurekatvamāśu vai
verses.translation: It refers to the *u' and its thirtytwo kinds.
verses.hindi: द्राविडं नागरं वापि केसरं वा विधानतः। कूटं वा मण्डपं वापि समं वा दीर्घमेव च पूर्ववत्कारयेद्यस्तु द्वाराद्यैः सुशुभं द्विजाः। प्रासादं मण्डपं वापि प्राकारं गोपुरं तु वा
verses.wordMeaning: It refers to the *u' and its thirtytwo kinds.
verses.commentary: Sense: It refers to the *u' and its thirtytwo kinds.

verses.sanskrit: एकीभावं गते चैव त्रिपुरे समुपागते बभूव तुमुलो हर्षो देवतानां महात्मनाम्
verses.transliteration: ekībhāvaṃ gate caiva tripure samupāgate babhūva tumulo harṣo devatānāṃ mahātmanām
verses.translation: It refers to the syllable 'm' and its sixteen divisions.
verses.hindi: कर्तुरप्यधिकं पुण्यं लभते नात्र संशयः। वृत्त्यर्थं वा प्रकुर्वीत नरः कर्म शिवालये
verses.wordMeaning: It refers to the syllable 'm' and its sixteen divisions.
verses.commentary: Sense: It refers to the syllable 'm' and its sixteen divisions.

verses.sanskrit: ततो देवगणाः सर्वे सिद्धाश् च परमर्षयः जयेति वाचो मुमुचुः संस्तुवन्तो ऽष्टमूर्तिकम्
verses.transliteration: tato devagaṇāḥ sarve siddhāś ca paramarṣayaḥ jayeti vāco mumucuḥ saṃstuvanto 'ṣṭamūrtikam
verses.translation: It refers to the eight-formed 8iva.
verses.hindi: यः स याति न सन्देहः स्वर्गलोकं सबान्धवः। यश्चात्मभोगसिद्धयर्थमपि रुद्रालये सकृत् कर्म कुर्याद्यदि सुखं लब्ध्वा चापि प्रमोदते। तस्मादायतनं भक्त्या यः कुर्यान्मुनिसत्तमाः
verses.wordMeaning: It refers to the eight-formed 8iva.
verses.commentary: Sense: It refers to the eight-formed 8iva.

verses.sanskrit: अथाह भगवान्ब्रह्मा भगनेत्रनिपातनम् पुष्ययोगे ऽपि सम्प्राप्ते लीलावशमुमापतिम्
verses.transliteration: athāha bhagavānbrahmā bhaganetranipātanam puṣyayoge 'pi samprāpte līlāvaśamumāpatim
verses.translation: It refers to the syllables *a', *u*, and nada sound.
verses.hindi: काष्ठेष्टकादिभिर्मरत्यः शिवलोके महीयते। प्रसादार्थं महेशस्य प्रासादो मुनिपुङ्कवाः
verses.wordMeaning: It refers to the syllables *a', *u*, and nada sound.
verses.commentary: Sense: It refers to the syllables *a', *u*, and nada sound.

verses.sanskrit: स्थाने तव महादेव चेष्टेयं परमेश्वर पूर्वदेवाश् च देवाश् च समास्तव यतः प्रभो
verses.transliteration: sthāne tava mahādeva ceṣṭeyaṃ parameśvara pūrvadevāś ca devāś ca samāstava yataḥ prabho
verses.translation: It refers to the eight forms of Siva, such as consist of earth, water, fire, etc.
verses.hindi: विमानोंसे दिव्य शिवलोक पहुंचकर ज्ञानयोग प्राप्त करके गणाधिपति पद प्राप्त करता है॥ १५५,  जो मनुष्य अपने सामर्थ्यके अनुसार रुद्र शिवके
verses.wordMeaning: It refers to the eight forms of Siva, such as consist of earth, water, fire, etc.
verses.commentary: Sense: It refers to the eight forms of Siva, such as consist of earth, water, fire, etc.

verses.sanskrit: तथापि देवा धर्मिष्ठाः पूर्वदेवाश् च पापिनः यतस्तस्माज्जगन्नाथ लीलां त्यक्तुमिहार्हसि
verses.transliteration: tathāpi devā dharmiṣṭhāḥ pūrvadevāś ca pāpinaḥ yatastasmājjagannātha līlāṃ tyaktumihārhasi
verses.translation: Obeisance to one with the form of nine® principles of the Atman; obeisance to one having nine times eight®®® Atmans and Atmaaktis; obeisance to one having eight®®® modes of revelation; obeisance to one having eight times eight®®® physical forms.
verses.hindi: शिवालय बनाता है, वह जो फल प्राप्त करता है, उसे मैं बता रहा हूँ। भक्तिपूर्वक हिमशैल नामक शिवालय  का निर्माण करनेपर जो फल पहले बताया गया है, उस सम्पूर्ण फलको प्राप्त करके वह सभी देवताओसे
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to one with the form of nine® principles of the Atman; obeisance to one having nine times eight®®® Atmans and Atmaaktis; obeisance to one having eight®®® modes of revelation; obeisance to one having eight times eight®®® physical forms.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to one with the form of nine® principles of the Atman; obeisance to one having nine times eight®®® Atmans and Atmaaktis; obeisance to one having eight®®® modes of revelation; obeisance to one having eight times eight®®® physical forms.

verses.sanskrit: किं रथेन ध्वजेनेश तव दग्धुं पुरत्रयम् इषुणा भूतसंघैश् च विष्णुना च मया प्रभो
verses.transliteration: kiṃ rathena dhvajeneśa tava dagdhuṃ puratrayam iṣuṇā bhūtasaṃghaiś ca viṣṇunā ca mayā prabho
verses.translation: Obeisance to one possessing sixtyfour®® principles of the Atman, obeisance to one (stationed) in eight®®® different forms; obeisance to one encompassed by the eight Gunas;®®® obeisance to one the Saguna as well as Nirguna.
verses.hindi: नमस्कृत होता हुआ रुद्रलोक प्राप्त करके रुद्रोंके साथ आनन्द मनाता है॥ १६--१८ /२॥ रुद्रका अत्यन्त प्रिय महेन्द्रशैल नामक शिवालय बनाकर मनुष्य जो फल प्राप्त करता है, उस फलको मैं बता रहा हुँ- है मुनिश्रेष्ठो ! वह मनुष्य महेन्द्रपर्वतके आकारवाले तथा वृषभोंसे जुते हुए विमानोंसे दिव्य
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to one possessing sixtyfour®® principles of the Atman, obeisance to one (stationed) in eight®®® different forms; obeisance to one encompassed by the eight Gunas;®®® obeisance to one the Saguna as well as Nirguna.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to one possessing sixtyfour®® principles of the Atman, obeisance to one (stationed) in eight®®® different forms; obeisance to one encompassed by the eight Gunas;®®® obeisance to one the Saguna as well as Nirguna.

verses.sanskrit: पुष्ययोगे त्वनुप्राप्ते पुरं दग्धुमिहार्हसि यावन्न यान्ति देवेश वियोगं तावदेव तु
verses.transliteration: puṣyayoge tvanuprāpte puraṃ dagdhumihārhasi yāvanna yānti deveśa viyogaṃ tāvadeva tu
verses.translation: Obeisance to you stationed at the root; obeisance to the resident of the eternal abode; obeisance to one stationed in the umbilical regions; obeisance to one who causes sounds in the heart.
verses.hindi: शिवलोकमें जाकर वहाँ यथेष्ट सुखोंको भोगकर रुद्रोंसे पूर्ण ज्ञान प्राप्त करके विषयोंको विषको भाँति त्यागकर शिवसायुज्य प्राप्त करता है॥ १९-२१/२॥
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to you stationed at the root; obeisance to the resident of the eternal abode; obeisance to one stationed in the umbilical regions; obeisance to one who causes sounds in the heart.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to you stationed at the root; obeisance to the resident of the eternal abode; obeisance to one stationed in the umbilical regions; obeisance to one who causes sounds in the heart.

verses.sanskrit: दग्धुमर्हसि शीघ्रं त्वं त्रीण्येतानि पुराणि वै अथ देवो महादेवः सर्वज्ञस्तदवैक्षत
verses.transliteration: dagdhumarhasi śīghraṃ tvaṃ trīṇyetāni purāṇi vai atha devo mahādevaḥ sarvajñastadavaikṣata
verses.translation: Obeisance to one stationed in the neck; to one who is stationed in the aperture of the cymbals; to one stationed in the middle of the eyebrows; to one stationed in the middle of sounds.
verses.hindi: जो मनुष्य रत्नजटित सोनेका द्राविड, नागर अथवा केसर कोटिका शिवालय विधानपूर्वक बनवाता है अथवा सम अथवा दीर्घ शिखर (चोटी) या मण्डप बनवाता है, उसके पुण्यका वर्णन सैकड़ों युगोंमें भी नहीं किया जा सकता है। है द्विजो! जो मनुष्य जीर्ण (पुराने), गिरे हुए, टूटे हुए अथवा फूटे हुए शिवालय, उसके मण्डप, चहारदीवारी, फाटक अथवा द्वार आदिको पूर्वकी भाँति अत्यन्त सुन्दर करा देता है; वह वास्तविक
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to one stationed in the neck; to one who is stationed in the aperture of the cymbals; to one stationed in the middle of the eyebrows; to one stationed in the middle of sounds.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to one stationed in the neck; to one who is stationed in the aperture of the cymbals; to one stationed in the middle of the eyebrows; to one stationed in the middle of sounds.

verses.sanskrit: पुरत्रयं विरूपाक्षस् तत्क्षणाद्भस्म वै कृतम् सोमश् च भगवान्विष्णुः कालाग्निर्वायुरेव च
verses.transliteration: puratrayaṃ virūpākṣas tatkṣaṇādbhasma vai kṛtam somaś ca bhagavānviṣṇuḥ kālāgnirvāyureva ca
verses.translation: Obeisance to Siva stationed in the disc of the moon; to one of auspicious forms; to one, having the forms of fire, moon and the sun; obeisance to one having the form of the thirtysix®'*' Saktis.
verses.hindi: निर्मातासे भी अधिक पुण्य प्राप्त करता है; इसमें सन्देह नहीं है॥ २२-२५/२॥
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to Siva stationed in the disc of the moon; to one of auspicious forms; to one, having the forms of fire, moon and the sun; obeisance to one having the form of the thirtysix®'*' Saktis.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to Siva stationed in the disc of the moon; to one of auspicious forms; to one, having the forms of fire, moon and the sun; obeisance to one having the form of the thirtysix®'*' Saktis.

verses.sanskrit: शरे व्यवस्थिताः सर्वे देवमूचुः प्रणम्य तम् दग्धमप्यथ देवेश वीक्षणेन पुरत्रयम्
verses.transliteration: śare vyavasthitāḥ sarve devamūcuḥ praṇamya tam dagdhamapyatha deveśa vīkṣaṇena puratrayam
verses.translation: Obeisance to one who is the Atman of the Serpent that is asleep after encircling the worlds three times; obeisance to one stationed in three different forms; obeisance to one with the forms of threefold (sacrificial) fires.
verses.hindi: जो मनुष्य आजीविकाके लिये शिवालयमें कार्य करता है, वह अपने बान्धवोंसहित स्वर्गलोक जाता है; इसमें सन्देह नहीं है। जो अपने सुखकी सिद्धिके लिये शिवालयमें एक बार भी कुछ कार्य कर देता है, वह सुख प्राप्त करके प्रसन्न रहता है॥ २६-२७ /२॥
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to one who is the Atman of the Serpent that is asleep after encircling the worlds three times; obeisance to one stationed in three different forms; obeisance to one with the forms of threefold (sacrificial) fires.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to one who is the Atman of the Serpent that is asleep after encircling the worlds three times; obeisance to one stationed in three different forms; obeisance to one with the forms of threefold (sacrificial) fires.

verses.sanskrit: अस्मद्धितार्थं देवेश शरं मोक्तुमिहार्हसि अथ संमृज्य धनुषो ज्यां हसन् त्रिपुरार्दनः
verses.transliteration: asmaddhitārthaṃ deveśa śaraṃ moktumihārhasi atha saṃmṛjya dhanuṣo jyāṃ hasan tripurārdanaḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to Sadasiva; to the Pinaka-bearing quie- scent Mahesa; obeisance to the omniscient one; worthy of being sought refuge in; obeisance to Sadyojata.
verses.hindi: अतः है उत्तम मुनियो! जो मनुष्य काष्ठ, पत्थर आदिसे शिवालय बनवाता है, वह शिवलोकरमें प्रतिष्ठा प्राप्त करता है । है श्रेष्ठ मुनियो ! महेशकी
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to Sadasiva; to the Pinaka-bearing quie- scent Mahesa; obeisance to the omniscient one; worthy of being sought refuge in; obeisance to Sadyojata.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to Sadasiva; to the Pinaka-bearing quie- scent Mahesa; obeisance to the omniscient one; worthy of being sought refuge in; obeisance to Sadyojata.

verses.sanskrit: मुमोच बाणं विप्रेन्द्रा व्याकृष्याकर्णम् ईश्वरः तत्क्षणात्त्रिपुरं दग्ध्वा त्रिपुरान्तकरः शरः
verses.transliteration: mumoca bāṇaṃ viprendrā vyākṛṣyākarṇam īśvaraḥ tatkṣaṇāttripuraṃ dagdhvā tripurāntakaraḥ śaraḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to Aghora; to Vamadeva; to latpurusa, and to Tsana.
verses.hindi: शिवमन्दिरोंके निर्माणका फल” शिवमन्दिरके उपलेपन आदिका माहात्म्य कर्तव्यः सर्वयलेन धर्मकामार्थमुक्तये। अशक्तश्चेन्मुनिश्रेष्ठाः प्रासादं कर्तुमुत्तमम्
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to Aghora; to Vamadeva; to latpurusa, and to Tsana.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to Aghora; to Vamadeva; to latpurusa, and to Tsana.

verses.sanskrit: देवदेवं समासाद्य नमस्कृत्वा व्यवस्थितः रेजे पुरत्रयं दग्धं दैत्यकोटिशतैर्वृतम्
verses.transliteration: devadevaṃ samāsādya namaskṛtvā vyavasthitaḥ reje puratrayaṃ dagdhaṃ daityakoṭiśatairvṛtam
verses.translation: It refers to his nine forms. Gf. Mbh: puru§a prakrtir vyaktam ahamkaro nabho' nilah / jyotir apok§itir iti tattvanyuktani te nava.
verses.hindi: सम्मार्जनादिभिर्वापि सर्वान् कामानवाप्नुयात्। सम्मार्जनं तु यः कुर्यान्मार्जन्या मृदुसूक्ष्मया
verses.wordMeaning: It refers to his nine forms. Gf. Mbh: puru§a prakrtir vyaktam ahamkaro nabho' nilah / jyotir apok§itir iti tattvanyuktani te nava.
verses.commentary: Sense: It refers to his nine forms. Gf. Mbh: puru§a prakrtir vyaktam ahamkaro nabho' nilah / jyotir apok§itir iti tattvanyuktani te nava.

verses.sanskrit: इषुणा तेन कल्पान्ते रुद्रेणेव जगत्त्रयम् ये पूजयन्ति तत्रापि दैत्या रुद्रं सबान्धवाः
verses.transliteration: iṣuṇā tena kalpānte rudreṇeva jagattrayam ye pūjayanti tatrāpi daityā rudraṃ sabāndhavāḥ
verses.translation: It refers to the seventytwo forms not mentioned by name.
verses.hindi: चान्द्रायणसहस्त्रस्य फलं मासेन लभ्यते। यः कुर्याद्ठस्त्रपूतेन गन्धगोमयवारिणा अर्धक्रोशं शिवक्षेत्रं शिवलिङ्गात्समन्ततः
verses.wordMeaning: It refers to the seventytwo forms not mentioned by name.
verses.commentary: Sense: It refers to the seventytwo forms not mentioned by name.

verses.sanskrit: गाणपत्यं तदा शंभोर् ययुः पूजाविधेर्बलात् न किंचिद् अब्रुवन् देवाः सेन्द्रोपेन्द्रा गणेश्वराः
verses.transliteration: gāṇapatyaṃ tadā śaṃbhor yayuḥ pūjāvidherbalāt na kiṃcid abruvan devāḥ sendropendrā gaṇeśvarāḥ
verses.translation: i.e. the life-principle of sixtyfour yoginis.
verses.hindi: यस्त्यजेहुस्त्यजान् प्राणाञ्शिवसायुज्यमाप्नुयात्। स्वायम्भुवस्य मानं हि तथा बाणस्य सुव्रताः
verses.wordMeaning: i.e. the life-principle of sixtyfour yoginis.
verses.commentary: Sense: i.e. the life-principle of sixtyfour yoginis.

verses.sanskrit: भयाद्देवं निरीक्ष्यैव देवीं हिमवतः सुताम् दृष्ट्वा भीतं तदानीकं देवानां देवपुङ्गवः
verses.transliteration: bhayāddevaṃ nirīkṣyaiva devīṃ himavataḥ sutām dṛṣṭvā bhītaṃ tadānīkaṃ devānāṃ devapuṅgavaḥ
verses.translation: The text docs not mention the names of the thirty -six Saktis.
verses.hindi: एवं यतीनामावासे क्षेत्रमानं द्विजोत्तमाः। रुद्रावतारे चाद्यं यच्छिष्ये चैव प्रशिष्यके नरावतारे तच्छिष्ये तच्छिष्ये च प्रशिष्यके । श्रीपर्वते महापुण्ये तस्य प्रान्ते च वा द्विजाः
verses.wordMeaning: The text docs not mention the names of the thirty -six Saktis.
verses.commentary: Sense: The text docs not mention the names of the thirty -six Saktis.

verses.sanskrit: किं चेत्याह तदा देवान् प्रणेमुस्तं समन्ततः
verses.transliteration: kiṃ cetyāha tadā devān praṇemustaṃ samantataḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to one having thirty® modes of revela- tion; obeisance to one beyond Santa (the digit of that name); obeisance to the lord Ananta to the subtle and tlic excellent one.
verses.hindi: केदारे च महाक्षेत्रे प्रयागे च विशेषतः। कुरुक्षेत्रे च यः प्राणान् सन्त्यजेद्याति निर्वृतिम्
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to one having thirty® modes of revela- tion; obeisance to one beyond Santa (the digit of that name); obeisance to the lord Ananta to the subtle and tlic excellent one.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to one having thirty® modes of revela- tion; obeisance to one beyond Santa (the digit of that name); obeisance to the lord Ananta to the subtle and tlic excellent one.

verses.sanskrit: ववन्दिरे नन्दिनमिन्दुभूषणं ववन्दिरे पर्वतराजसंभवाम् ववन्दिरे चाद्रिसुतासुतं प्रभुं ववन्दिरे देवगणा महेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: vavandire nandinamindubhūṣaṇaṃ vavandire parvatarājasaṃbhavām vavandire cādrisutāsutaṃ prabhuṃ vavandire devagaṇā maheśvaram
verses.translation: Obeisance to you, the single-eyed; obeisance to you, the Ekarudra; obeisance to you, the trinity;®'- to Srikaiitha; to Sikhandin (the tufted one).
verses.hindi: प्रभासे पुष्करेऽवन्त्यां तथा चैवामरेश्वरे। वणीशेलाकुले चैव मृतो याति शिवात्मताम् त्रिविष्टपे विमुक्ते च केदारे सङ्गमेश्वरे
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to you, the single-eyed; obeisance to you, the Ekarudra; obeisance to you, the trinity;®'- to Srikaiitha; to Sikhandin (the tufted one).
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to you, the single-eyed; obeisance to you, the Ekarudra; obeisance to you, the trinity;®'- to Srikaiitha; to Sikhandin (the tufted one).

verses.sanskrit: तुष्टाव हृदये ब्रह्मा देवैः सह समाहितः विष्णुना च भवं देवं त्रिपुरारातिमीश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: tuṣṭāva hṛdaye brahmā devaiḥ saha samāhitaḥ viṣṇunā ca bhavaṃ devaṃ tripurārātimīśvaram
verses.translation: Obeisance to the Infinite one; to one stationed in the seat of the Infinite; obeisance to the cause of destruction; obeisance to one devoid of impurities; obeisance to the large one; obeisance to you of pure body.
verses.hindi: लिये तथा धर्म, अर्थ, काम, मोक्षके लिये पूर्ण प्रयत्नके साथ शिवालयका निर्माण करना चाहिए॥ २८-२९ /२॥
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to the Infinite one; to one stationed in the seat of the Infinite; obeisance to the cause of destruction; obeisance to one devoid of impurities; obeisance to the large one; obeisance to you of pure body.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to the Infinite one; to one stationed in the seat of the Infinite; obeisance to the cause of destruction; obeisance to one devoid of impurities; obeisance to the large one; obeisance to you of pure body.

verses.sanskrit: प्रसीद देवदेवेश प्रसीद परमेश्वर प्रसीद जगतां नाथ प्रसीदानन्ददाव्यय
verses.transliteration: prasīda devadeveśa prasīda parameśvara prasīda jagatāṃ nātha prasīdānandadāvyaya
verses.translation: Obeisance to one stationed in the seat devoid of im- purities;®'** obeisance to one of the form of wcahh for the pure purpose; obeisance to the yogin stationed in yogapithas; obei- sance to the bes tower of yoga.
verses.hindi: हे श्रेष्ठ मुनियो ! यदि कोई उत्तम शिवालय बनानेमें असमर्थ हो, तो वह शिवालयमें सम्मार्जन (बुहारना) आदिके द्वारा भी समस्त वांछित फलोंको प्राप्त कर लेता है। जो व्यक्ति कोमल तथा सूक्ष्म झाड्से सफाई करता है, वह महीने भरमें हजार चान्द्रायण व्रतका फल प्राप्त करता है । जो मनुष्य पवित्र वस्त्रसे छने हुए गन्ध तथा गोमयके जलसे विधानके अनुसार आलेपन (लीपनेका कार्य) करता है, वह वर्षपर्यन्त चान्द्रायणत्रत
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to one stationed in the seat devoid of im- purities;®'** obeisance to one of the form of wcahh for the pure purpose; obeisance to the yogin stationed in yogapithas; obei- sance to the bes tower of yoga.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to one stationed in the seat devoid of im- purities;®'** obeisance to one of the form of wcahh for the pure purpose; obeisance to the yogin stationed in yogapithas; obei- sance to the bes tower of yoga.

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चास्यरुद्ररुद्राय पञ्चाशत्कोटिमूर्तये आत्मत्रयोपविष्टाय विद्यातत्त्वाय ते नमः
verses.transliteration: pañcāsyarudrarudrāya pañcāśatkoṭimūrtaye ātmatrayopaviṣṭāya vidyātattvāya te namaḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to one stationed in the heart of yogins like the awn of the wild rice Nivara; obeisance to you the Pratya- hara, to you engaged in Pratyahara.
verses.hindi: करनेका फल प्राप्त करता है॥ ३०-३२/२॥
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to one stationed in the heart of yogins like the awn of the wild rice Nivara; obeisance to you the Pratya- hara, to you engaged in Pratyahara.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to one stationed in the heart of yogins like the awn of the wild rice Nivara; obeisance to you the Pratya- hara, to you engaged in Pratyahara.

verses.sanskrit: शिवाय शिवतत्त्वाय अघोराय नमोनमः अघोराष्टकतत्त्वाय द्वादशात्मस्वरूपिणे
verses.transliteration: śivāya śivatattvāya aghorāya namonamaḥ aghorāṣṭakatattvāya dvādaśātmasvarūpiṇe
verses.translation: Obeisance to one stationed in the heart of those who are engaged in Pratyahara, and Dharana (retention) and Dhyana (meditation); of the form of Dharana and Dhyana; and to one who is comprehensible througli Dhyana.
verses.hindi: शिवलिङ्गके चारों ओर आधा कोशका क्षेत्र शिवक्षेत्र होता है। जो अपने दुस्त्यज प्राणोंको इस क्षेत्रमें छोड़ता है, वह शिव-सायुज्य प्राप्त करता है । है सुव्रतो! यह अर्धकोश मान स्वयम्भू बाणलिङ्ग अर्थात् केवल ज्योतिर्लिङ्गका है। है द्विजोत्तमो! अन्य स्वयम्भू लिङ्गके लिये शिवक्षेत्रका मान उसका आधा (कोशका चतुर्थांश), ऋषिस्थापित लिङ्गके लिये उसका आधा (कोशका आठवाँ भाग) और मनुष्यके द्वारा स्थापित लिङ्गके लिये उसका
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to one stationed in the heart of those who are engaged in Pratyahara, and Dharana (retention) and Dhyana (meditation); of the form of Dharana and Dhyana; and to one who is comprehensible througli Dhyana.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to one stationed in the heart of those who are engaged in Pratyahara, and Dharana (retention) and Dhyana (meditation); of the form of Dharana and Dhyana; and to one who is comprehensible througli Dhyana.

verses.sanskrit: विद्युत्कोटिप्रतीकाशम् अष्टकाशं सुशोभनम् रूपमास्थाय लोके ऽस्मिन् संस्थिताय शिवात्मने
verses.transliteration: vidyutkoṭipratīkāśam aṣṭakāśaṃ suśobhanam rūpamāsthāya loke 'smin saṃsthitāya śivātmane
verses.translation: Obeisance to one worthy of meditation. Obeisance to one approachable through meditation; obeisance to you of lau- dable meditation; obeisance to one worthy of meditation even by those who themselves are worthy of meditation; obeisance to you the worthiest of those who are worthy of meditation by others.
verses.hindi: भी आधा (कोशका सोलहवाँ) भाग होता है है द्विजोत्तमो! इसी प्रकार यतियोंके निवासस्थानसे कोशके सोलहवें भागका क्षेत्र शिवक्षेत्र है। रुद्रोंके अवतारस्थल, उनके शिष्यों-प्रशिष्योंके अवतारस्थल, योगाचार्योके अवतारस्थल,
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to one worthy of meditation. Obeisance to one approachable through meditation; obeisance to you of lau- dable meditation; obeisance to one worthy of meditation even by those who themselves are worthy of meditation;…
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to one worthy of meditation. Obeisance to one approachable through meditation; obeisance to you of lau- dable meditation; obeisance to one worthy of meditation even by those who themselves are worthy of meditation;…

verses.sanskrit: अग्निवर्णाय रौद्राय अंबिकार्धशरीरिणे धवलश्यामरक्तानां मुक्तिदायामराय च
verses.transliteration: agnivarṇāya raudrāya aṃbikārdhaśarīriṇe dhavalaśyāmaraktānāṃ muktidāyāmarāya ca
verses.translation: Obeisance to one worthy of approach through contem- plation; obeisance to you, who are contemplc.tion itself; obei- sance to one in the form of Nirvikalpa object unto those who are engaged in meditation.
verses.hindi: उनके शिष्योंके अवतारस्थल तथा उनके भी शिष्य- प्रशिष्योंके अवतारस्थलसे आधे कोशका मण्डल शिवक्षेत्र होता है॥ ३३-३६ /२॥ हे द्विजो! महापुण्यप्रद श्रीपर्वत तथा उसके प्रान्तभाग-इस शिवक्षेत्रमें जो प्राणोंका त्याग करता है, वह शिवसायुज्य प्राप्त करता है। जो मनुष्य वाराणसीमें तथा विशेषकर वहाँ अविमुक्त क्ेत्रमें,
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to one worthy of approach through contem- plation; obeisance to you, who are contemplc.tion itself; obei- sance to one in the form of Nirvikalpa object unto those who are engaged in meditation.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to one worthy of approach through contem- plation; obeisance to you, who are contemplc.tion itself; obei- sance to one in the form of Nirvikalpa object unto those who are engaged in meditation.

verses.sanskrit: ज्येष्ठाय रुद्ररूपाय सोमाय वरदाय च त्रिलोकाय त्रिदेवाय वषट्काराय वै नमः
verses.transliteration: jyeṣṭhāya rudrarūpāya somāya varadāya ca trilokāya tridevāya vaṣaṭkārāya vai namaḥ
verses.translation: O Rudra, by burning the three cities this entire set of the three worlds has been redeemed by you today. Who will
verses.hindi: केदारमें, विशेषकर महाक्षेत्र प्रयागमें तथा कुरुक्षेत्रमें प्राणत्याग करता है, वह मोक्ष प्राप्त करता है। प्रभास, पुष्कर, अवन्ती, अमरेश्वर तथा वणीशेलाकुलमें मृत प्राणी शिवात्मताको प्राप्त होता है। वाराणसीमें मरनेवाला
verses.wordMeaning: O Rudra, by burning the three cities this entire set of the three worlds has been redeemed by you today. Who will
verses.commentary: Sense: O Rudra, by burning the three cities this entire set of the three worlds has been redeemed by you today. Who will

verses.sanskrit: मध्ये गगनरूपाय गगनस्थाय ते नमः अष्टक्षेत्राष्टरूपाय अष्टतत्त्वाय ते नमः
verses.transliteration: madhye gaganarūpāya gaganasthāya te namaḥ aṣṭakṣetrāṣṭarūpāya aṣṭatattvāya te namaḥ
verses.translation: i.e. in the form of Brahma, Vinu and Rudra.
verses.hindi: प्राणी पुनर्जन्मको प्राप्त नहीं होता है। जो प्राणी शालके वा त्यजेत्प्राणांस्तथा वै जम्बुकेश्वरे। शुक्रेश्वरे वा गोकर्णे भास्करेशे गुहेश्वरे
verses.wordMeaning: i.e. in the form of Brahma, Vinu and Rudra.
verses.commentary: Sense: i.e. in the form of Brahma, Vinu and Rudra.

verses.sanskrit: चतुर्धा च चतुर्धा च चतुर्धा संस्थिताय च पञ्चधा पञ्चधा चैव पञ्चमन्त्रशरीरिणे
verses.transliteration: caturdhā ca caturdhā ca caturdhā saṃsthitāya ca pañcadhā pañcadhā caiva pañcamantraśarīriṇe
verses.translation: Verses 145-149 speak of his yogic postures, viz. asana, pratyS- bSra, dhkranH, dhyana and sam&dhi.
verses.hindi: नियमैः शोष्य यो देहं त्यजेत्क्षेत्रे शिवस्य तु
verses.wordMeaning: Verses 145-149 speak of his yogic postures, viz. asana, pratyS- bSra, dhkranH, dhyana and sam&dhi.
verses.commentary: Sense: Verses 145-149 speak of his yogic postures, viz. asana, pratyS- bSra, dhkranH, dhyana and sam&dhi.

verses.sanskrit: चतुःषष्टिप्रकाराय अकाराय नमोनमः द्वात्रिंशत्तत्त्वरूपाय उकाराय नमोनमः
verses.transliteration: catuḥṣaṣṭiprakārāya akārāya namonamaḥ dvātriṃśattattvarūpāya ukārāya namonamaḥ
verses.translation: O lord of Devas, thanks to their devotion, contentment and vision of miracle, that the mortals, immortals, Ganas, and Siddhas, make obeisance to you. O lord of Ganas, obeisance to you.
verses.hindi: स याति शिवतां योगी मानुषे हैविकेऽपि वा। आर्षे वापि मुनिश्रेष्ठास्तथा स्वायम्भुवेऽपि वा स्वयम्भूते तथा देवे नात्र कार्या विचारणा। आधायाग्निं शिवक्षेत्रे सम्पूज्य परमेश्वरम्
verses.wordMeaning: O lord of Devas, thanks to their devotion, contentment and vision of miracle, that the mortals, immortals, Ganas, and Siddhas, make obeisance to you. O lord of Ganas, obeisance to you.
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord of Devas, thanks to their devotion, contentment and vision of miracle, that the mortals, immortals, Ganas, and Siddhas, make obeisance to you. O lord of Ganas, obeisance to you.

verses.sanskrit: षोडशात्मस्वरूपाय मकाराय नमोनमः अष्टधात्मस्वरूपाय अर्धमात्रात्मने नमः
verses.transliteration: ṣoḍaśātmasvarūpāya makārāya namonamaḥ aṣṭadhātmasvarūpāya ardhamātrātmane namaḥ
verses.translation: O lord, you are competent to burn the three cities, nay even the three worlds by a single glance of yours. Leisurely sporting with Ambika, you have burned them in a trice; and the arrow too was discharged.
verses.hindi: शिवक्षेत्रे मुनिश्रेष्ठाः शिवसायुज्यमाण्नुयात्। छित्त्वा पादद्वयं चापि शिवक्षेत्रे वसेत्तु यः
verses.wordMeaning: O lord, you are competent to burn the three cities, nay even the three worlds by a single glance of yours. Leisurely sporting with Ambika, you have burned them in a trice; and the arrow too was discharged.
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord, you are competent to burn the three cities, nay even the three worlds by a single glance of yours. Leisurely sporting with Ambika, you have burned them in a trice; and the arrow too was discharged.

verses.sanskrit: ओङ्काराय नमस्तुभ्यं चतुर्धा संस्थिताय च गगनेशाय देवाय स्वर्गेशाय नमो नमः
verses.transliteration: oṅkārāya namastubhyaṃ caturdhā saṃsthitāya ca gaganeśāya devāya svargeśāya namo namaḥ
verses.translation: For your work of annihilating the Tripuras, I made with great deal of effort the excellent chariot, the speedy arrow and the splendid bow; but the benefit thereof was not seen by Devas as well as Siddhas.
verses.hindi: स याति शिवतां चैव नात्र कार्या विचारणा। क्षेत्रस्य दर्शनं पुण्यं प्रवेशस्तच्छताधिकः घृतस्नानेन चानन्तं शार्करे तच्छताधिकम्। शिवक्षेत्रसमीपस्थां नदीं प्राप्यावगाह्य च
verses.wordMeaning: For your work of annihilating the Tripuras, I made with great deal of effort the excellent chariot, the speedy arrow and the splendid bow; but the benefit thereof was not seen by Devas as well as Siddhas.
verses.commentary: Sense: For your work of annihilating the Tripuras, I made with great deal of effort the excellent chariot, the speedy arrow and the splendid bow; but the benefit thereof was not seen by Devas as well as Siddhas.

verses.sanskrit: सप्तलोकाय पातालनरकेशाय वै नमः अष्टक्षेत्राष्टरूपाय परात्परतराय च
verses.transliteration: saptalokāya pātālanarakeśāya vai namaḥ aṣṭakṣetrāṣṭarūpāya parātparatarāya ca
verses.translation: O lord, you are all these combined: —the chariot, the charioteer, Visnu the excellent Deva Rudra himself, Sakti and Pitaraaha. How shall I adequately eulogise you? I bow down my head to you, who cannot be adequately pro- pitiated.®*
verses.hindi: त्यजेद्देहं विहायान्नं शिवलोके महीयते। शिवक्षेत्रसमीपस्था नद्यः सर्वाः सुशोभनाः
verses.wordMeaning: O lord, you are all these combined: —the chariot, the charioteer, Visnu the excellent Deva Rudra himself, Sakti and Pitaraaha. How shall I adequately eulogise you? I bow down my head to you, who cannot be adequately pro- pitiated.®*
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord, you are all these combined: —the chariot, the charioteer, Visnu the excellent Deva Rudra himself, Sakti and Pitaraaha. How shall I adequately eulogise you? I bow down my head to you, who cannot be adequately pro- pitiated.®*

verses.sanskrit: सहस्रशिरसे तुभ्यं सहस्राय च ते नमः सहस्रपादयुक्ताय शर्वाय परमेष्ठिने
verses.transliteration: sahasraśirase tubhyaṃ sahasrāya ca te namaḥ sahasrapādayuktāya śarvāya parameṣṭhine
verses.translation: O lord, you have infinite number of feet, infinite number of arms, infinite number of heads and infinite number of forms. You are the annihilator as well as the auspicious one. Shall I propitiate you of this nature? How shall I please you, who are of this nature?
verses.hindi: वापीकूपतडागाश्च शिवतीर्था इति स्मृताः। स्नात्वा तेषु नरो भक्त्या तीर्थेषु द्विजसत्तमाः ब्रह्महत्यादिभिः पापैर्मुच्यते नात्र संशयः। प्रातः स्नात्वा मुनिश्रेष्ठाः शिवतीर्थेषु मानव:
verses.wordMeaning: O lord, you have infinite number of feet, infinite number of arms, infinite number of heads and infinite number of forms. You are the annihilator as well as the auspicious one. Shall I propitiate you of this nature? How shall I please you, who are of this nature?
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord, you have infinite number of feet, infinite number of arms, infinite number of heads and infinite number of forms. You are the annihilator as well as the auspicious one. Shall I propitiate you of this nature? How shall I please you, who are of this nature?

verses.sanskrit: नवात्मतत्त्वरूपाय नवाष्टात्मात्मशक्तये पुनरष्टप्रकाशाय तथाष्टाष्टकमूर्तये
verses.transliteration: navātmatattvarūpāya navāṣṭātmātmaśaktaye punaraṣṭaprakāśāya tathāṣṭāṣṭakamūrtaye
verses.translation: Obeisance to you, the knower of everything; obei- sance to you Rudra, Sarva and Bhava; obeisance to the gross, to the subtle, to the subtler than the subtlest; to the creator and to one conversant with the subtle meaning.
verses.hindi: त्रिविष्टप, विमुक्त, केदारक्षेत्र, संगमेश्वर, शालक जम्बुकेश्वर, शुक्रेश्वर, गोकर्ण, भास्करेश, गुहेश्वर हिरण्यगर्भ तथा नन्दीशक्षेत्रमे प्राण छोड़ता है क द परम गति प्राप्त करता है। है श्रेष्ठ मुनियो!  अपने
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to you, the knower of everything; obei- sance to you Rudra, Sarva and Bhava; obeisance to the gross, to the subtle, to the subtler than the subtlest; to the creator and to one conversant with the subtle meaning.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to you, the knower of everything; obei- sance to you Rudra, Sarva and Bhava; obeisance to the gross, to the subtle, to the subtler than the subtlest; to the creator and to one conversant with the subtle meaning.

verses.sanskrit: चतुःषष्ट्यात्मतत्त्वाय पुनरष्टविधाय ते गुणाष्टकवृतायैव गुणिने निर्गुणाय ते
verses.transliteration: catuḥṣaṣṭyātmatattvāya punaraṣṭavidhāya te guṇāṣṭakavṛtāyaiva guṇine nirguṇāya te
verses.translation: Obeisance to the creator, sustainer and the annihila- tor of all Devas and Asuras; obeisance to the creator of the worlds, to the leader of Devas and the lord of Asuras. Obeisance to the giver, to the ruler, to the chastiser of all.
verses.hindi: शरीरको नियमोंसे सुखाकर जो योगी (मानवस्थापित), हैविक (देवस्थापित), आर्ष (मुनि- शिवक्षेत्रमें प्राणत्याग करता है, वह शिवत्वको प्राप्त होता है। ज्योतिलिङ्ग-क्षेत्र तथा देवक्षेत्रके विषयमें सन्देह नहीं करना चाहिए॥ ३७--४४/२॥
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to the creator, sustainer and the annihila- tor of all Devas and Asuras; obeisance to the creator of the worlds, to the leader of Devas and the lord of Asuras. Obeisance to the giver, to the ruler, to the chastiser of all.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to the creator, sustainer and the annihila- tor of all Devas and Asuras; obeisance to the creator of the worlds, to the leader of Devas and the lord of Asuras. Obeisance to the giver, to the ruler, to the chastiser of all.

verses.sanskrit: मूलस्थाय नमस्तुभ्यं शाश्वतस्थानवासिने नाभिमण्डलसंस्थाय हृदि निःस्वनकारिणे
verses.transliteration: mūlasthāya namastubhyaṃ śāśvatasthānavāsine nābhimaṇḍalasaṃsthāya hṛdi niḥsvanakāriṇe
verses.translation: Obeisance to the purest one comprehensible only through Vedanta; obei sance to one continuously eulogised by those who know the meanings of Vedas; obeisance to Bhava in
verses.hindi: शिवक्षेत्रमें भलीभाँति परमेश्वरकी पूजा करके आग जलाकर जो प्राणी अपने शरीरको उसमें होम कर देता है, वह परम गति प्राप्त करता है। है श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो मनुष्य निराहार रहकर शित्क्षेत्रमें
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to the purest one comprehensible only through Vedanta; obei sance to one continuously eulogised by those who know the meanings of Vedas; obeisance to Bhava in
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to the purest one comprehensible only through Vedanta; obei sance to one continuously eulogised by those who know the meanings of Vedas; obeisance to Bhava in

verses.sanskrit: कन्धरे च स्थितायैव तालुरन्ध्रस्थिताय च भ्रूमध्ये संस्थितायैव नादमध्ये स्थिताय च
verses.transliteration: kandhare ca sthitāyaiva tālurandhrasthitāya ca bhrūmadhye saṃsthitāyaiva nādamadhye sthitāya ca
verses.translation: ato9yam — tofayitum aiakyam. According to ST, one who cannot bedescribca by speech or conceived by the mind.* Cf. *yato v&co nivartante aprpya manasa saha" — cited in ST.
verses.hindi: प्राणका त्याग करता है, वह शिवसायुज्य प्राप्त करता है। जो अपने दोनों पैरोंको काटकर भी शिवक्षेत्रमें निवास करता है, वह शिवत्वको प्राप्त होता है; इसमें सन्देह नहीं करना चाहिए ॥ ४५--४७/२॥ शिवक्षेत्रका दर्शन पुण्यदायक होता है, वहाँपर प्रवेश करना उससे सौ गुना अधिक पुण्यदायक होता है और उसका स्पर्श तथा प्रदक्षिणा उससे भी सौ गुना पुण्यप्रद होता है  वहाँपर मूर्तिको जल-स्तान करानेसे उससे भी
verses.wordMeaning: ato9yam — tofayitum aiakyam. According to ST, one who cannot bedescribca by speech or conceived by the mind.* Cf. *yato v&co nivartante aprpya manasa saha" — cited in ST.
verses.commentary: Sense: ato9yam — tofayitum aiakyam. According to ST, one who cannot bedescribca by speech or conceived by the mind.* Cf. *yato v&co nivartante aprpya manasa saha" — cited in ST.

verses.sanskrit: चन्द्रबिम्बस्थितायैव शिवाय शिवरूपिणे वह्निसोमार्करूपाय षट्त्रिंशच्छक्तिरूपिणे
verses.transliteration: candrabimbasthitāyaiva śivāya śivarūpiṇe vahnisomārkarūpāya ṣaṭtriṃśacchaktirūpiṇe
verses.translation: Obeisance to one who is devoid of a beginning or an end; to one who exists; to one devoid of expressibility; to the Lihgin (one having a Lihga form); obeisance to you who have no symbols and yet are identical with the Lihga; to Lihga identical with Veda, etc.
verses.hindi: सौ गुना पुण्य होता है। है विप्रो! दुग्धसे स्नान करानेसे उससे सौ गुना, दहीसे स्नान करानेसे उससे हजार गुना, मधुसे स्नान करानेसे उससे सौ गुना, घृतसे स्नान करानेसे उससे अनन्त गुना और शर्करासे स्नान करानेसे उससे भी
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to one who is devoid of a beginning or an end; to one who exists; to one devoid of expressibility; to the Lihgin (one having a Lihga form); obeisance to you who have no symbols and yet are identical with the Lihga; to Lihga identical with Veda, etc.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to one who is devoid of a beginning or an end; to one who exists; to one devoid of expressibility; to the Lihgin (one having a Lihga form); obeisance to you who have no symbols and yet are identical with the Lihga; to Lihga identical with Veda, etc.

verses.sanskrit: त्रिधा संवृत्य लोकान्वै प्रसुप्तभुजगात्मने त्रिप्रकारं स्थितायैव त्रेताग्निमयरूपिणे
verses.transliteration: tridhā saṃvṛtya lokānvai prasuptabhujagātmane triprakāraṃ sthitāyaiva tretāgnimayarūpiṇe
verses.translation: Obeisance to Rudra who had severed my head — I am the primordial lord and yajnamurti (one whose form is yajna). O lord, it was for dispelling my darkness that you had severed my head* by the tip of your finger on observing my crime which deserved that punishment.
verses.hindi: सौ गुना अधिक पुण्य कहा गया है॥ ४८-५० /२॥ शिवक्षेत्रके समीपमें स्थित किसी नदीपर जाकर उसमें स्नान करके और अन्नका त्याग करके अपना शरीर छोड्ता है, वह शिवलोकमें प्रतिष्ठा प्राप्त करता है। शिवक्षेत्रके समीपमें स्थित सभी
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to Rudra who had severed my head — I am the primordial lord and yajnamurti (one whose form is yajna). O lord, it was for dispelling my darkness that you had severed my head* by the tip of your finger on observing my crime which deserved that punishment.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to Rudra who had severed my head — I am the primordial lord and yajnamurti (one whose form is yajna). O lord, it was for dispelling my darkness that you had severed my head* by the tip of your finger on observing my crime which deserved that punishment.

verses.sanskrit: सदाशिवाय शान्ताय महेशाय पिनाकिने सर्वज्ञाय शरण्याय सद्योजाताय वै नमः
verses.transliteration: sadāśivāya śāntāya maheśāya pinākine sarvajñāya śaraṇyāya sadyojātāya vai namaḥ
verses.translation: O lord of Devas, O lord of Asuras, wonderful indeed are your activities. O deity devoid of attributes and forms, like an embodied soul you will carry out the task of Devas along with them.
verses.hindi: सुन्दर नदियाँ, बावलियाँ, कुएँ तथा तालाब शिवती कहे गये हैं। है श्रेष्ठ द्विजो! उन तीर्थोमें श्रद्धापूर्वक स्नान करके मनुष्य ब्रह्महत्या आदि पापोंसे मुक्त जाता है; इसमें सन्देह नहीं है ॥ ५१-५३ /२॥
verses.wordMeaning: O lord of Devas, O lord of Asuras, wonderful indeed are your activities. O deity devoid of attributes and forms, like an embodied soul you will carry out the task of Devas along with them.
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord of Devas, O lord of Asuras, wonderful indeed are your activities. O deity devoid of attributes and forms, like an embodied soul you will carry out the task of Devas along with them.

verses.sanskrit: अघोराय नमस्तुभ्यं वामदेवाय ते नमः तत्पुरुषाय नमो ऽस्तु ईशानाय नमोनमः
verses.transliteration: aghorāya namastubhyaṃ vāmadevāya te namaḥ tatpuruṣāya namo 'stu īśānāya namonamaḥ
verses.translation: Among your tattvas one is gross;®®® one is subtle; one is very subtle; one is both embodied and unembodied; one is embodied; one is unembodied; one is visible; and one is in- visible and one is worthy of being meditated upon, the wonder- ful Ia.
verses.hindi: शिवमन्दिरोके निर्माणका फल""शिवमन्दिरके उपलेपन आदिका माहात्म्य करका फफक कफ फ फफ फ फफफ फफफ् फ फफ्फ फफफ फफफ्फफफफफ कफ फ कफ फफ़फ फरक कीक फ कफ कफ फ फ फ फ फ फ फ फफ फ फ फ फ फफ फ फ फफफ फ फ फ़ फ फफफ फ फ फ़ फ फ़ फ़ फ़ फफ फफक फक
verses.wordMeaning: Among your tattvas one is gross;®®® one is subtle; one is very subtle; one is both embodied and unembodied; one is embodied; one is unembodied; one is visible; and one is in- visible and one is worthy of being meditated upon, the wonder- ful Ia.
verses.commentary: Sense: Among your tattvas one is gross;®®® one is subtle; one is very subtle; one is both embodied and unembodied; one is embodied; one is unembodied; one is visible; and one is in- visible and one is worthy of being meditated upon, the wonder- ful Ia.

verses.sanskrit: नमस्त्रिंशत्प्रकाशाय शान्तातीताय वै नमः अनन्तेशाय सूक्ष्माय उत्तमाय नमो ऽस्तु ते
verses.transliteration: namastriṃśatprakāśāya śāntātītāya vai namaḥ ananteśāya sūkṣmāya uttamāya namo 'stu te
verses.translation: O lord, what is seen in a dre;. n is an uncharac tended object; I think that it certainly appears as well as does not ap- pear; Your divine form cannot be perceived even by Devas, in spite of their efforts. Yet appears in the visible lihga form.
verses.hindi: अश्वमेधफलं प्राप्य रुद्रलोकं स गच्छति। मध्याह्ने शिवतीर्थेषु स्नात्वा भक्त्या सकृन्नरः
verses.wordMeaning: O lord, what is seen in a dre;. n is an uncharac tended object; I think that it certainly appears as well as does not ap- pear; Your divine form cannot be perceived even by Devas, in spite of their efforts. Yet appears in the visible lihga form.
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord, what is seen in a dre;. n is an uncharac tended object; I think that it certainly appears as well as does not ap- pear; Your divine form cannot be perceived even by Devas, in spite of their efforts. Yet appears in the visible lihga form.

verses.sanskrit: एकाक्षाय नमस्तुभ्यम् एकरुद्राय ते नमः नमस्त्रिमूर्तये तुभ्यं श्रीकण्ठाय शिखण्डिने
verses.transliteration: ekākṣāya namastubhyam ekarudrāya te namaḥ namastrimūrtaye tubhyaṃ śrīkaṇṭhāya śikhaṇḍine
verses.translation: O lord of Devas, •. ■.ere is your divine prowess? Where are we? Where is devotion? \ 'here is your eulogy? Still, O lord, forgive me who though a primeval being am lamenting, inspired by devotion,
verses.hindi: गङ्कास्तानसमं पुण्यं लभते नात्र संशयः। अस्तं गते तथा चार्के स्नात्वा गच्छेच्छिवं पदम् पापकञ्चुकमुत्सृज्य शिवतीर्थेषु मानवः। द्विजास्त्रिषवणं स्नात्वा शिवतीर्थे सकृन्नरः
verses.wordMeaning: O lord of Devas, •. ■.ere is your divine prowess? Where are we? Where is devotion? \ 'here is your eulogy? Still, O lord, forgive me who though a primeval being am lamenting, inspired by devotion,
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord of Devas, •. ■.ere is your divine prowess? Where are we? Where is devotion? \ 'here is your eulogy? Still, O lord, forgive me who though a primeval being am lamenting, inspired by devotion,

verses.sanskrit: अनन्तासनसंस्थाय अनन्तायान्तकारिणे विमलाय विशालाय विमलाङ्गाय ते नमः
verses.transliteration: anantāsanasaṃsthāya anantāyāntakāriṇe vimalāya viśālāya vimalāṅgāya te namaḥ
verses.translation: The verse explains the characteristics of each of the eight forms of Siva, viz., gross (earth), subtle (water), subtler (fire), manifCst- unmanifest (moon), manifest (sun), unmanifest (wind), having the quality of sound (ether), and the object of meditation (dhyeyam i4am) on the part of the mind.
verses.hindi: शिवसायुज्यमाप्नोति नात्र कार्या विचारणा। पुराथ सूकरः कश्चित् श्वानं दृष्ट्वा भयात्पथि
verses.wordMeaning: The verse explains the characteristics of each of the eight forms of Siva, viz., gross (earth), subtle (water), subtler (fire), manifCst- unmanifest (moon), manifest (sun), unmanifest (wind), having the quality of sound (ether),…
verses.commentary: Sense: The verse explains the characteristics of each of the eight forms of Siva, viz., gross (earth), subtle (water), subtler (fire), manifCst- unmanifest (moon), manifest (sun), unmanifest (wind), having the quality of sound (ether),…

verses.sanskrit: विमलासनसंस्थाय विमलार्थार्थरूपिणे योगपीठान्तरस्थाय योगिने योगदायिने
verses.transliteration: vimalāsanasaṃsthāya vimalārthārtharūpiṇe yogapīṭhāntarasthāya yogine yogadāyine
verses.translation: On hearing this hymn, the mighty-armed resident of the peak of Matidara who was eulogised devotedly by the four- faced deity looked laughingly at the daughter of the mountain and said to Brahma of great exalted dignity.
verses.hindi: प्रसङ्गाद्वारमेकं तु शिवतीर्थेऽवगाह्य च। मृतः स्वयं द्विजश्रेष्ठा गाणपत्यमवाप्तवान् यः प्रातर्देवदेवेशं शिवं लिङ्गस्वरूपिणम्। पश्येत्स याति सर्वस्मादधिकां गतिमेव च
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing this hymn, the mighty-armed resident of the peak of Matidara who was eulogised devotedly by the four- faced deity looked laughingly at the daughter of the mountain and said to Brahma of great exalted dignity.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing this hymn, the mighty-armed resident of the peak of Matidara who was eulogised devotedly by the four- faced deity looked laughingly at the daughter of the mountain and said to Brahma of great exalted dignity.

verses.sanskrit: योगिनां हृदि संस्थाय सदा नीवारशूकवत् प्रत्याहाराय ते नित्यं प्रत्याहाररताय ते
verses.transliteration: yogināṃ hṛdi saṃsthāya sadā nīvāraśūkavat pratyāhārāya te nityaṃ pratyāhāraratāya te
verses.translation: O lotus-born one, I am delighted by this hymn as well as by your devotion. Welfare unto you. Choose the boons in accordance with the desire of Devas.
verses.hindi: मध्याह्ले च महादेवं दृष्ट्या यज्ञफलं लभेत्। सायाह्ने सर्वयज्ञानां फलं प्राप्य विमुच्यते
verses.wordMeaning: O lotus-born one, I am delighted by this hymn as well as by your devotion. Welfare unto you. Choose the boons in accordance with the desire of Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: O lotus-born one, I am delighted by this hymn as well as by your devotion. Welfare unto you. Choose the boons in accordance with the desire of Devas.

verses.sanskrit: प्रत्याहाररतानां च प्रतिस्थानस्थिताय च धारणायै नमस्तुभ्यं धारणाभिरताय ते
verses.transliteration: pratyāhāraratānāṃ ca pratisthānasthitāya ca dhāraṇāyai namastubhyaṃ dhāraṇābhiratāya te
verses.translation: Thereupon, after bowing to the lord of Devas, the lotus-born deity became delighted in his mind and spoke with palms joined in reverence.
verses.hindi: मानसैर्वाचिकैः पापैः कायिकैश्च महत्तरैः । तथोपपातकैश्चैव पापैश्चैवानृपातकैः सङ्क्रमे देवमीशानं दृष्ट्वा लिङ्गाकृतिं प्रभुम्। मासेन यत्कृतं पापं त्यक्त्वा याति शिवं पदम्
verses.wordMeaning: Thereupon, after bowing to the lord of Devas, the lotus-born deity became delighted in his mind and spoke with palms joined in reverence.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereupon, after bowing to the lord of Devas, the lotus-born deity became delighted in his mind and spoke with palms joined in reverence.

verses.sanskrit: धारणाभ्यासयुक्तानां पुरस्तात्संस्थिताय च ध्यानाय ध्यानरूपाय ध्यानगम्याय ते नमः
verses.transliteration: dhāraṇābhyāsayuktānāṃ purastātsaṃsthitāya ca dhyānāya dhyānarūpāya dhyānagamyāya te namaḥ
verses.translation: O lord Sankara, O lord of the cliiefs of Devas, O destroyer of Tripuras, O Paramesvara, be pleased to confer on me the greatest devotion towards you.
verses.hindi: अयने चार्धमासेन दक्षिणे चोत्तरायणे। विषुवे चैव सम्पूज्य प्रयाति परमां गतिम्
verses.wordMeaning: O lord Sankara, O lord of the cliiefs of Devas, O destroyer of Tripuras, O Paramesvara, be pleased to confer on me the greatest devotion towards you.
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord Sankara, O lord of the cliiefs of Devas, O destroyer of Tripuras, O Paramesvara, be pleased to confer on me the greatest devotion towards you.

verses.sanskrit: ध्येयाय ध्येयगम्याय ध्येयध्यानाय ते नमः ध्येयानामपि ध्येयाय नमो ध्येयतमाय ते
verses.transliteration: dhyeyāya dhyeyagamyāya dhyeyadhyānāya te namaḥ dhyeyānāmapi dhyeyāya namo dhyeyatamāya te
verses.translation: O lord, the bestower of all riches on all Devas. Be pleased with our devotion towards you always as well as with my charioteership.
verses.hindi: पदे पदेऽश्वमेधस्य यज्ञस्य फलमाण्नुयात्। वाचा यस्तु शिं नित्यं संरौति परमेश्वरम् सोऽपि याति शिवं स्थानं प्राप्य किं पुनरेव च। कृत्वा मण्डलकं क्षेत्रं गन्धगोमयवारिणा
verses.wordMeaning: O lord, the bestower of all riches on all Devas. Be pleased with our devotion towards you always as well as with my charioteership.
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord, the bestower of all riches on all Devas. Be pleased with our devotion towards you always as well as with my charioteership.

verses.sanskrit: समाधानाभिगम्याय समाधानाय ते नमः समाधानरतानां तु निर्विकल्पार्थरूपिणे
verses.transliteration: samādhānābhigamyāya samādhānāya te namaḥ samādhānaratānāṃ tu nirvikalpārtharūpiṇe
verses.translation: Lord Visnu also bowed down to Mahes vara. Joining his palms together in reverence he said thus to the three-eyed lord accompanied by Uma.
verses.hindi: हे श्रेष्ठ मुनियो ! शिवतीर्थोमें प्रातःकाल स्नान करके वह मनुष्य अश्वमेध यज्ञका फल प्राप्त करके रुद्रलोकको जाता है । मध्याहकालमें शिवतीर्थोमें एक बार भी भक्तिपूर्वक स्नान करके मनुष्य गंगास्तानके समान पुण्य प्राप्त करता
verses.wordMeaning: Lord Visnu also bowed down to Mahes vara. Joining his palms together in reverence he said thus to the three-eyed lord accompanied by Uma.
verses.commentary: Sense: Lord Visnu also bowed down to Mahes vara. Joining his palms together in reverence he said thus to the three-eyed lord accompanied by Uma.

verses.sanskrit: दग्ध्वोद्धृतं सर्वमिदं त्वयाद्य जगत्त्रयं रुद्र पुरत्रयं हि कः स्तोतुमिच्छेत् कथमीदृशं त्वां स्तोष्ये हि तुष्टाय शिवाय तुभ्यम्
verses.transliteration: dagdhvoddhṛtaṃ sarvamidaṃ tvayādya jagattrayaṃ rudra puratrayaṃ hi kaḥ stotumicchet kathamīdṛśaṃ tvāṃ stoṣye hi tuṣṭāya śivāya tubhyam
verses.translation: ''O lord, be pleased with me. O lord of Devas,
verses.hindi: है; इसमें सन्देह नहीं है सूर्यके अस्त हो जानेपर शिवतीर्थोमें स्नान करके मनुष्य पापकंचुक छोड़कर शिवपद प्राप्त करता है। है द्विजो! शिवतीर्थोमें एक बार भी त्रिस्रबण (तीनों कालोंमें) स्नान करके मनुष्य शिवसायुज्य प्राप्त कर लेता है; इसमें सन्देह नहीं करना चाहिए। है श्रेष्ठ द्विजो! पूर्वकालमें कोई सुअर मार्गमें कुत्तेको देखकर डरके मारे संयोगवश शिवतीर्थमें गिर पड़ा और वह एक बार डुबकी लगाकर स्वयं मर गया; इससे उसने गणाधिपति
verses.wordMeaning: ''O lord, be pleased with me. O lord of Devas,
verses.commentary: Sense: ''O lord, be pleased with me. O lord of Devas,

verses.sanskrit: भक्त्या च तुष्ट्याद्भुतदर्शनाच्च मर्त्या अमर्त्या अपि देवदेव एते गणाः सिद्धगणैः प्रणामं कुर्वन्ति देवेश गणेश तुभ्यम्
verses.transliteration: bhaktyā ca tuṣṭyādbhutadarśanācca martyā amartyā api devadeva ete gaṇāḥ siddhagaṇaiḥ praṇāmaṃ kurvanti deveśa gaṇeśa tubhyam
verses.translation: On hearing their submission Paramesvara, Mahadeva, Bhava engaged them respectively in charioteership and the position of vehicle.
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing their submission Paramesvara, Mahadeva, Bhava engaged them respectively in charioteership and the position of vehicle.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing their submission Paramesvara, Mahadeva, Bhava engaged them respectively in charioteership and the position of vehicle.

verses.sanskrit: निरीक्षणादेव विभो ऽसि दग्धुं पुरत्रयं चैव जगत्त्रयं च लीलालसेनांबिकया क्षणेन दग्धं किलेषुश् च तदाथ मुक्तः
verses.transliteration: nirīkṣaṇādeva vibho 'si dagdhuṃ puratrayaṃ caiva jagattrayaṃ ca līlālasenāṃbikayā kṣaṇena dagdhaṃ kileṣuś ca tadātha muktaḥ
verses.translation: After burning Daityas, and after giving boons to Brahma and \i§nu, Siva, the noble-souled lord of Devas, vanished along with the goddess, Bhutas and Nandin.
verses.hindi: जो प्रातःकाल लिङ्गस्वरूपी देवदेवेश्वर शिवका दर्शन करता है, वह सबसे उच्च पद प्राप्त करता है; मध्याहमें महादेवका दर्शन करके वह यज्ञका फल प्राप्त करता है और सायंकाल दर्शन करके सभी यज्ञोंका फल प्राप्तकर मानसिक तथा वाचिक पापों, बड़े-से-बड़े शारीरिक पापों, उपपातकों और अनृपातकोंसे मुक्त हो जाता है । सूर्यकी सभी संक्रान्तियोंमें लिङ्गके आकारवाले महादेव प्रभु ईशानका दर्शन करके मनुष्य महीनेभरमें किये गये पापका त्याग

verses.transliteration: kṛto rathaśceṣuvaraś ca śubhraṃ śarasanaṃ te tripurakṣayāya anekayatnaiś ca mayātha tubhyaṃ phalaṃ na dṛṣṭaṃ surasiddhasaṃghaiḥ
verses.translation: When the lord had gone awdy from the battle- field along with his Ganas, the awe-struck lords of Devas bowed down to Bhava and Parvati. verses.sanskrit: रथो रथी देववरो हरिश् च रुद्रः स्वयं शक्रपितामहौ च त्वमेव सर्वे भगवन् कथं तु स्तोष्ये ह्य् अतोष्यं प्रणिपत्य मूर्ध्ना

verses.translation: O brahmins, he who reads this chapter on the exploits of the destroyer of Tripuras, originally composed by Brahma formerly or he who narrates this devotedly to the brah- mins at the time of!§raddha or during the rites of Devas goes to the world of Brahma. O excellent brahmins, the indi- vidual soul is liberated from all kinds of sins mental, physical or verbal. He is liberated from the principal as well as subsi- diary sins, gross, subtle or subtlest on hearing this splendid chapter. His enemies will perish and he will be victorious in battle. He will never be harassed by any sickness. Adversities will not afflict him. He shall attain wealth, longevity, renown, learning and incomparable prowess.

verses.translation: When lord Mahesvara departed thence after burning the three cities in a trice the lotus-born deity (Brahma) spoke thus in the assembly of the leading Devas.
verses.hindi: इसके बाद सभी क्रियाओंका त्याग करके ब्रह्मविद्याका अध्ययनकर यत्नपूर्वक ज्ञान प्राप्तकर पुन: उस ज्ञानके द्वारा ज्ञेयका दर्शन करके वह योगी जो फल पाता है, उस फलको वह सम्पूर्ण वर्णमण्डलके दर्शनमात्रसे प्राप्त कर

verses.sanskrit: संत्यज्य देवदेवेशं लिङ्गमूर्तिमहेश्वरम् तारपौत्रो महातेजास् तारकस्य सुतो बली
verses.transliteration: saṃtyajya devadeveśaṃ liṅgamūrtimaheśvaram tārapautro mahātejās tārakasya suto balī
verses.translation: Due to the Maya of Lord Visiiu the following Daityas forsook Mahadeva and perished along with their cities and citizens. They were the grandson of Tara of great brilliance, the powerful son of Taraka, the asura Tarakaksa, the powerful Kamalaksa, Vidyunmalin, the lord of Daityas and many others along with kith and kin. They left the worship of the lord Mahevara and so they perished. Hence Sadasiva in the Lihga form should always be worshipped since Devas have stability
verses.hindi: फफपफफफफपाफपपापापापापापातालापापापामाधापापापफफ येन केनापि वा मर्त्यः प्रलिप्यायतनाग्रतः । उत्तरे दक्षिणे वापि पृष्ठतो वा द्विजोत्तमा:
verses.wordMeaning: Due to the Maya of Lord Visiiu the following Daityas forsook Mahadeva and perished along with their cities and citizens. They were the grandson of Tara of great brilliance, the powerful son of Taraka, the asura Tarakaksa, the powerful Kamalaksa, Vidyunmalin,…
