verses.sanskrit: तारकाक्षो ऽपि दितिजः कमलाक्षश् च वीर्यवान् विद्युन्माली च दैत्येशः अन्ये चापि सबान्धवाः
verses.transliteration: tārakākṣo 'pi ditijaḥ kamalākṣaś ca vīryavān vidyunmālī ca daityeśaḥ anye cāpi sabāndhavāḥ
verses.translation: Hence, he who wishes for perfection of the soul shall worship the Lihga. It Is only through the worship of the Lihga that Devas, Daityas, Danavas, Yaksas, Vidyadharas, Siddhas, Pisitaianas, Pitrs, Sages, Piiacas, Kinnaras and others have undoubtedly achieved Siddhi. Hence, O Devas, by any means whatsoever one should always worship the Lihga.
verses.hindi: चतुष्कोणं तु वा चूर्णैरलङ्कृत्य समन्ततः । पुष्पाक्षतादिभिः पूज्य सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, he who wishes for perfection of the soul shall worship the Lihga. It Is only through the worship of the Lihga that Devas, Daityas, Danavas, Yaksas, Vidyadharas, Siddhas, Pisitaianas, Pitrs, Sages, Piiacas, Kinnaras and others have undoubtedly achieved Siddhi. Hence,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, he who wishes for perfection of the soul shall worship the Lihga. It Is only through the worship of the Lihga that Devas, Daityas, Danavas, Yaksas, Vidyadharas, Siddhas, Pisitaianas, Pitrs, Sages, Piiacas, Kinnaras and others have undoubtedly achieved Siddhi. Hence,…

verses.sanskrit: त्यक्त्वा देवं महादेवं मायया च हरेः प्रभोः सर्वे विनष्टाः प्रध्वस्ताः स्वपुरैः पुरसंभवैः
verses.transliteration: tyaktvā devaṃ mahādevaṃ māyayā ca hareḥ prabhoḥ sarve vinaṣṭāḥ pradhvastāḥ svapuraiḥ purasaṃbhavaiḥ
verses.translation: i.c, the five pranSyamas preceded by the five pranavas (om syllables).
verses.hindi: विकीर्य गन्धकुसुमैर्धूपैर्ध्य चतुर्विधैः । प्रार्थयेहेवमीशानं शिवलोकं स गच्छति तत्र भुक्त्वा महाभोगान् कल्पकोटिशतं नरः। स्वदेहगन्धकुसुमैः पूरयञ्छिवमन्दिरम्
verses.wordMeaning: i.c, the five pranSyamas preceded by the five pranavas (om syllables).
verses.commentary: Sense: i.c, the five pranSyamas preceded by the five pranavas (om syllables).

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात्सदा पूजनीयो लिङ्गमूर्तिः सदाशिवः यावत्पूजा सुरेशानां तावदेव स्थितिर्यतः
verses.transliteration: tasmātsadā pūjanīyo liṅgamūrtiḥ sadāśivaḥ yāvatpūjā sureśānāṃ tāvadeva sthitiryataḥ
verses.translation: fourfold, viz., manas (mind), buddhi (intellect), aharfikara(cgo), and citta (consciousness).
verses.hindi: क्रमादागत्य लोकेऽस्मिन् राजा भवति वीर्यवान्
verses.wordMeaning: fourfold, viz., manas (mind), buddhi (intellect), aharfikara(cgo), and citta (consciousness).
verses.commentary: Sense: fourfold, viz., manas (mind), buddhi (intellect), aharfikara(cgo), and citta (consciousness).

verses.sanskrit: पूजनीयः शिवो नित्यं श्रद्धया देवपुङ्गवैः सर्वलिङ्गमयो लोकः सर्वं लिङ्गे प्रतिष्ठितम्
verses.transliteration: pūjanīyaḥ śivo nityaṃ śraddhayā devapuṅgavaiḥ sarvaliṅgamayo lokaḥ sarvaṃ liṅge pratiṣṭhitam
verses.translation: the two puruas: taijasa (the universal) and prajfia (the in- dividual) soul.
verses.hindi: आदिदेवो महादेवः प्रलयस्थितिकारकः । सर्गश्च भुवनाधीशः सर्वव्यापी सदाशिव: । शिवब्रह्मामृतं ग्राह्यं मोक्षसाधनमुत्तमम् हे श्रेष्ठ द्विजो! जिस किसी भी प्रकार लीपकर सामने, पीछे, उत्तरमें तथा दक्षिणमें मण्डल बनाकर उसे चारों ओरसे चूर्णांसे सजाकर पुष्प अक्षत आदिसे पूजन करके मनुष्य सभी पापोंसे मुक्त
verses.wordMeaning: the two puruas: taijasa (the universal) and prajfia (the in- dividual) soul.
verses.commentary: Sense: the two puruas: taijasa (the universal) and prajfia (the in- dividual) soul.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात् सम्पूजयेल्लिङ्गं य इच्छेत्सिद्धिमात्मनः सर्वे लिङ्गार्चनादेव देवा दैत्याश् च दानवाः
verses.transliteration: tasmāt sampūjayelliṅgaṃ ya icchetsiddhimātmanaḥ sarve liṅgārcanādeva devā daityāś ca dānavāḥ
verses.translation: There is no doubt that it is the vow of the sages also. Hence one should worship Siva. If one does not think about ihr% only God Siva, even for a moment, it is a loss, it is a great blemish, it is delusion, it is silence. Those who indulge in devotion to him, those who mentally bow down to him, and those who attempt to remember Bhava arc never subjected to misery. The fruit of the worship of Siva is as follows: — Pleasant and charming abodes, divine ornaments, women, and riches till one is satisfied. May those who wish for enjoyment of great pleasures or the kingdom of heaven, worship Mahevara in the Lihga form, at all times.
verses.hindi: हो जाता है। जो मनुष्य एक बार भी भक्तिपूर्वक गर्भगृहको चन्दन आदि तथा कपूरसहित गन्धद्रव्योसे चारों ओरसे लीपकर सभी ओर सुगन्थित पुष्प बिखेरकर चार प्रकारके धूपोंसे उसे धूपित करके भगवान् ईशान
verses.wordMeaning: There is no doubt that it is the vow of the sages also. Hence one should worship Siva. If one does not think about ihr% only God Siva, even for a moment, it is a loss, it is a great blemish, it is delusion, it is silence. Those who indulge in devotion to him,…
verses.commentary: Sense: There is no doubt that it is the vow of the sages also. Hence one should worship Siva. If one does not think about ihr% only God Siva, even for a moment, it is a loss, it is a great blemish, it is delusion, it is silence. Those who indulge in devotion to him,…

verses.sanskrit: यक्षा विद्याधराः सिद्धा राक्षसाः पिशिताशनाः पितरो मुनयश्चापि पिशाचाः किन्नरादयः
verses.transliteration: yakṣā vidyādharāḥ siddhā rākṣasāḥ piśitāśanāḥ pitaro munayaścāpi piśācāḥ kinnarādayaḥ
verses.translation: Even after striking and destroying all living beings, and after burning this entire universe if one should worship the only God Virupaksa (i.e. Siva), one is never tarnished with sins.
verses.hindi: (शिव)-को प्रार्थना करता है, वह शिवलोकको जाता है। वह मनुष्य वहाँ सौ करोड़ कल्पोंतक महान् सुखोंको भोगकर अपने देहरूपी सुगन्धित पुष्पोंसे शिवमन्दिरको पूरित करता हुआ क्रमसे गन्धर्वलोक पहुँचकर वहाँ गन्धवाँसे भलीभाँति पूजित होता है, पुनः क्रमसे इस लोकमें आकर पराक्रमी राजा होता है
verses.wordMeaning: Even after striking and destroying all living beings, and after burning this entire universe if one should worship the only God Virupaksa (i.e. Siva), one is never tarnished with sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: Even after striking and destroying all living beings, and after burning this entire universe if one should worship the only God Virupaksa (i.e. Siva), one is never tarnished with sins.

verses.sanskrit: अर्चयित्वा लिङ्गमूर्ति संसिद्धा नात्र संशयः तस्माल्लिङ्गं यजेन्नित्यं येन केनापि वा सुराः
verses.transliteration: arcayitvā liṅgamūrti saṃsiddhā nātra saṃśayaḥ tasmālliṅgaṃ yajennityaṃ yena kenāpi vā surāḥ
verses.translation: Even after striking and destroying all living beings, and after burning this entire universe if one should worship the only God Virupaksa (i.e. Siva), one is never tarnished with sins.

verses.wordMeaning: Even after striking and destroying all living beings, and after burning this entire universe if one should worship the only God Virupaksa (i.e. Siva), one is never tarnished with sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: Even after striking and destroying all living beings, and after burning this entire universe if one should worship the only God Virupaksa (i.e. Siva), one is never tarnished with sins.

verses.sanskrit: पशवश् च वयं तस्य देवदेवस्य धीमतः पशुत्वं च परित्यज्य कृत्वा पाशुपतं ततः
verses.transliteration: paśavaś ca vayaṃ tasya devadevasya dhīmataḥ paśutvaṃ ca parityajya kṛtvā pāśupataṃ tataḥ
verses.translation: Even after striking and destroying all living beings, and after burning this entire universe if one should worship the only God Virupaksa (i.e. Siva), one is never tarnished with sins.

verses.wordMeaning: Even after striking and destroying all living beings, and after burning this entire universe if one should worship the only God Virupaksa (i.e. Siva), one is never tarnished with sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: Even after striking and destroying all living beings, and after burning this entire universe if one should worship the only God Virupaksa (i.e. Siva), one is never tarnished with sins.

verses.sanskrit: पूजनीयो महादेवो लिङ्गमूर्तिः सनातनः विशोध्य चैव भूतानि पञ्चभिः प्रणवैः समम्

verses.wordMeaning: Even after striking and destroying all living beings, and after burning this entire universe if one should worship the only God Virupaksa (i.e. Siva), one is never tarnished with sins.

verses.sanskrit: प्राणायामैः समायुक्तैः पञ्चभिः सुरपुङ्गवाः चतुर्भिः प्रणवैश्चैव प्राणायामपरायणैः
verses.transliteration: prāṇāyāmaiḥ samāyuktaiḥ pañcabhiḥ surapuṅgavāḥ caturbhiḥ praṇavaiścaiva prāṇāyāmaparāyaṇaiḥ
verses.translation: Even after striking and destroying all living beings, and after burning this entire universe if one should worship the only God Virupaksa (i.e. Siva), one is never tarnished with sins.

verses.transliteration: tribhiś ca praṇavairdevāḥ prāṇāyāmaistathāvidhaiḥ dvidhā nyasya tathauṃkāraṃ prāṇāyāmaparāyaṇaḥ
verses.translation: Even after striking and destroying all living beings, and after burning this entire universe if one should worship the only God Virupaksa (i.e. Siva), one is never tarnished with sins.
verses.hindi: सूतजी बोले--हे श्रेष्ठ मुनियो ! शिवक्षेत्रमें वस्त्रके द्वारा छाने हुए पवित्र जलसे ही उपलेपन-कार्य करना चाहिए; अन्यथा सिद्धि नहीं मिलती है । है श्रेष्ठ मुनियी' विशेषकर नदीसे ग्रहण किया गया फेनरहित जल
verses.wordMeaning: Even after striking and destroying all living beings, and after burning this entire universe if one should worship the only God Virupaksa (i.e. Siva), one is never tarnished with sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: Even after striking and destroying all living beings, and after burning this entire universe if one should worship the only God Virupaksa (i.e. Siva), one is never tarnished with sins.

verses.sanskrit: ततश्चौंकारम् उच्चार्य प्राणापानौ नियम्य च ज्ञानामृतेन सर्वाङ्गान्य् आपूर्य प्रणवेन च
verses.transliteration: tataścauṃkāram uccārya prāṇāpānau niyamya ca jñānāmṛtena sarvāṅgāny āpūrya praṇavena ca
verses.translation: Even after striking and destroying all living beings, and after burning this entire universe if one should worship the only God Virupaksa (i.e. Siva), one is never tarnished with sins.
verses.hindi: पुन: वस्त्रसे छाना गया हो--ऐसा जल पवित्र होता है अतः है उत्तम द्विजो! समस्त कार्योंकी सिद्धिके लिये सभी देवकायाँको पवित्र जलसे करना चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: Even after striking and destroying all living beings, and after burning this entire universe if one should worship the only God Virupaksa (i.e. Siva), one is never tarnished with sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: Even after striking and destroying all living beings, and after burning this entire universe if one should worship the only God Virupaksa (i.e. Siva), one is never tarnished with sins.

verses.transliteration: guṇatrayaṃ caturdhākhyam ahaṅkāraṃ ca suvratāḥ tanmātrāṇi ca bhūtāni tathā buddhīndriyāṇi ca
verses.translation: Even after striking and destroying all living beings, and after burning this entire universe if one should worship the only God Virupaksa (i.e. Siva), one is never tarnished with sins.

verses.commentary: Sense: Even after striking and destroying all living beings, and after burning this entire universe if one should worship the only God Virupaksa (i.e. Siva), one is never tarnished with sins.

verses.transliteration: karmendriyāṇi saṃśodhya puruṣaṃ yugalaṃ tathā cidātmānaṃ tanuṃ kṛtvā cāgnirbhasmeti saṃspṛśet
verses.translation: Even after striking and destroying all living beings, and after burning this entire universe if one should worship the only God Virupaksa (i.e. Siva), one is never tarnished with sins.

verses.sanskrit: वायुर्भस्मेति च व्योम तथाम्भः पृथिवी तथा त्रियायुषं त्रिसंध्यं च धूलयेद् भसितेन यः
verses.transliteration: vāyurbhasmeti ca vyoma tathāmbhaḥ pṛthivī tathā triyāyuṣaṃ trisaṃdhyaṃ ca dhūlayed bhasitena yaḥ
verses.translation: Even after striking and destroying all living beings, and after burning this entire universe if one should worship the only God Virupaksa (i.e. Siva), one is never tarnished with sins.
verses.hindi: अग्नौ कण्डनके चैव पेषणे तोयसङ्ग्रहे
verses.wordMeaning: Even after striking and destroying all living beings, and after burning this entire universe if one should worship the only God Virupaksa (i.e. Siva), one is never tarnished with sins.

verses.translation: Even after striking and destroying all living beings, and after burning this entire universe if one should worship the only God Virupaksa (i.e. Siva), one is never tarnished with sins.
verses.hindi: अहिंसेयं परो धर्मः सर्वेषां प्राणिनां द्विजा: मनसा कर्मणा वाचा सर्वदाहिंसकं नरम्
verses.wordMeaning: Even after striking and destroying all living beings, and after burning this entire universe if one should worship the only God Virupaksa (i.e. Siva), one is never tarnished with sins.

verses.translation: Even after striking and destroying all living beings, and after burning this entire universe if one should worship the only God Virupaksa (i.e. Siva), one is never tarnished with sins.
