verses.wordMeaning: Even after striking and destroying all living beings, and after burning this entire universe if one should worship the only God Virupaksa (i.e. Siva), one is never tarnished with sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: Even after striking and destroying all living beings, and after burning this entire universe if one should worship the only God Virupaksa (i.e. Siva), one is never tarnished with sins.

verses.sanskrit: पशवो नैव जायन्ते वर्षमात्रेण देवताः अस्माभिः सर्वकार्याणां देवमभ्यर्च्य यत्नतः
verses.transliteration: paśavo naiva jāyante varṣamātreṇa devatāḥ asmābhiḥ sarvakāryāṇāṃ devamabhyarcya yatnataḥ
verses.translation: Even after striking and destroying all living beings, and after burning this entire universe if one should worship the only God Virupaksa (i.e. Siva), one is never tarnished with sins.
verses.hindi: तत्फलं कोटिगुणितं लभतेऽहिंसको नरः। मनसा कर्मणा वाचा सर्वभूतहिते रताः दयादर्शितपन्थानो रुद्रलोकं व्रजन्ति च। स्वामिवत्परिरक्षन्ति बहूनि विविधानि च
verses.wordMeaning: Even after striking and destroying all living beings, and after burning this entire universe if one should worship the only God Virupaksa (i.e. Siva), one is never tarnished with sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: Even after striking and destroying all living beings, and after burning this entire universe if one should worship the only God Virupaksa (i.e. Siva), one is never tarnished with sins.

verses.sanskrit: बाह्ये चाभ्यन्तरे चैव मन्ये कर्तव्यमीश्वरम् प्रतिज्ञा मम विष्णोश् च दिव्यैषा सुरसत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: bāhye cābhyantare caiva manye kartavyamīśvaram pratijñā mama viṣṇoś ca divyaiṣā surasattamāḥ
verses.translation: Even after striking and destroying all living beings, and after burning this entire universe if one should worship the only God Virupaksa (i.e. Siva), one is never tarnished with sins.
verses.hindi: ये पुत्रपौत्रवतस्नेहान्रुद्रलोकं ब्रजन्ति ते। तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन वस्त्रपूतेन वारिणा
verses.wordMeaning: Even after striking and destroying all living beings, and after burning this entire universe if one should worship the only God Virupaksa (i.e. Siva), one is never tarnished with sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: Even after striking and destroying all living beings, and after burning this entire universe if one should worship the only God Virupaksa (i.e. Siva), one is never tarnished with sins.

verses.sanskrit: मुनीनां च न संदेहस् तस्मात् सम्पूजयेच्छिवम् सा हानिस्तन्महच्छिद्रं स मोहः सा च मूकता
verses.transliteration: munīnāṃ ca na saṃdehas tasmāt sampūjayecchivam sā hānistanmahacchidraṃ sa mohaḥ sā ca mūkatā
verses.translation: Even after striking and destroying all living beings, and after burning this entire universe if one should worship the only God Virupaksa (i.e. Siva), one is never tarnished with sins.
verses.hindi: कार्यमभ्युक्षणं नित्यं स्नपनं च विशेषतः। त्रैलोक्यमखिलं हत्वा यत्फलं परिकीर्त्यते शिवालये निहत्यैकमपि तत्सकलं लभेत्। शिवार्थ सर्वदा कार्या पुष्पहिंसा द्विजोत्तमाः
verses.wordMeaning: Even after striking and destroying all living beings, and after burning this entire universe if one should worship the only God Virupaksa (i.e. Siva), one is never tarnished with sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: Even after striking and destroying all living beings, and after burning this entire universe if one should worship the only God Virupaksa (i.e. Siva), one is never tarnished with sins.

verses.sanskrit: यत्क्षणं वा मुहूर्तं वा शिवमेकं न चिन्तयेत् भवभक्तिपरा ये च भवप्रणतचेतसः
verses.transliteration: yatkṣaṇaṃ vā muhūrtaṃ vā śivamekaṃ na cintayet bhavabhaktiparā ye ca bhavapraṇatacetasaḥ
verses.translation: Even after striking and destroying all living beings, and after burning this entire universe if one should worship the only God Virupaksa (i.e. Siva), one is never tarnished with sins.
verses.hindi: विहिताविहितं नास्ति योगिनां ब्रह्मवादिनाम्
verses.wordMeaning: Even after striking and destroying all living beings, and after burning this entire universe if one should worship the only God Virupaksa (i.e. Siva), one is never tarnished with sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: Even after striking and destroying all living beings, and after burning this entire universe if one should worship the only God Virupaksa (i.e. Siva), one is never tarnished with sins.

verses.sanskrit: भवसंस्मरणोद्युक्ता न ते दुःखस्य भाजनम् भवनानि मनोज्ञानि दिव्यमाभरणं स्त्रियः
verses.transliteration: bhavasaṃsmaraṇodyuktā na te duḥkhasya bhājanam bhavanāni manojñāni divyamābharaṇaṃ striyaḥ
verses.translation: Even after striking and destroying all living beings, and after burning this entire universe if one should worship the only God Virupaksa (i.e. Siva), one is never tarnished with sins.
verses.hindi: सर्वकर्माणि विन्यस्य संन्यस्ताद् ब्रह्मवादिनः जल सूक्ष्म कीटाणुओंसे युक्त रहता है, अतः निश्चय ही अपवित्र जलसे देवकार्य करनेपर वही सारा पाप होता है, जो उन्हें मारनेसे होता है। झाड़ लगाने, सफाई करने, विशेष करके अग्निकर्ममें, कूटने- पीसनेमें तथा
verses.wordMeaning: Even after striking and destroying all living beings, and after burning this entire universe if one should worship the only God Virupaksa (i.e. Siva), one is never tarnished with sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: Even after striking and destroying all living beings, and after burning this entire universe if one should worship the only God Virupaksa (i.e. Siva), one is never tarnished with sins.

verses.sanskrit: धनं वा तुष्टिपर्यन्तं शिवपूजाविधेः फलम् ये वाञ्छन्ति महाभोगान् राज्यं च त्रिदशालये ते ऽर्चयन्तु सदा कालं लिङ्गमूर्तिं महेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: dhanaṃ vā tuṣṭiparyantaṃ śivapūjāvidheḥ phalam ye vāñchanti mahābhogān rājyaṃ ca tridaśālaye te 'rcayantu sadā kālaṃ liṅgamūrtiṃ maheśvaram
verses.translation: Even after striking and destroying all living beings, and after burning this entire universe if one should worship the only God Virupaksa (i.e. Siva), one is never tarnished with sins.
verses.hindi: जलके संग्रहमें गृहस्थ मनुष्योंसे हिंसा हो जाती है, अतः हिंसासे बचना चाहिए। है द्विजो! सभी प्राणियोंके प्रति यह अहिंसा भाव सबसे बड़ा धर्म है, अतः पूर्ण प्रयत्लसे वस्त्रसे पवित्र किया हुआ (छाना हुआ) जल
verses.wordMeaning: Even after striking and destroying all living beings, and after burning this entire universe if one should worship the only God Virupaksa (i.e. Siva), one is never tarnished with sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: Even after striking and destroying all living beings, and after burning this entire universe if one should worship the only God Virupaksa (i.e. Siva), one is never tarnished with sins.

verses.sanskrit: हत्वा भित्त्वा च भूतानि दग्ध्वा सर्वमिदं जगत्
verses.transliteration: hatvā bhittvā ca bhūtāni dagdhvā sarvamidaṃ jagat
verses.translation: Even after striking and destroying all living beings, and after burning this entire universe if one should worship the only God Virupaksa (i.e. Siva), one is never tarnished with sins.
verses.hindi: प्रयोग करना चाहिए॥ ३--६ /२॥ वह दान पुण्यप्रद तथा सभी दानोंमें उत्तमोत्तम है, जो अभय देनेवाला होता है, अतः सभी जगह सर्वदा हिंसाका त्याग करना चाहिए। मन-वाणी तथा कर्मसे जो किसीकी हिंसा नहीं करता अर्थात् उन्हें
verses.wordMeaning: Even after striking and destroying all living beings, and after burning this entire universe if one should worship the only God Virupaksa (i.e. Siva), one is never tarnished with sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: Even after striking and destroying all living beings, and after burning this entire universe if one should worship the only God Virupaksa (i.e. Siva), one is never tarnished with sins.

verses.sanskrit: यजेदेकं विरूपाक्षं न पापैः स प्रलिप्यते शैलं लिङ्गं मदीयं हि सर्वदेवनमस्कृतम्
verses.transliteration: yajedekaṃ virūpākṣaṃ na pāpaiḥ sa pralipyate śailaṃ liṅgaṃ madīyaṃ hi sarvadevanamaskṛtam
verses.translation: Even after striking and destroying all living beings, and after burning this entire universe if one should worship the only God Virupaksa (i.e. Siva), one is never tarnished with sins.
verses.hindi: दुःख नहीं पहुँचाता, ऐसे अहिंसक व्यक्तिकी सभी प्राणी सदा रक्षा करते हैं और हिंसकको कष्ट पहुँचाते हैं। वेदके पारगामी विद्वान्को सम्पूर्ण त्रिलोकका दान देकर मनुष्य जो फल पाता है, उसका
verses.wordMeaning: Even after striking and destroying all living beings, and after burning this entire universe if one should worship the only God Virupaksa (i.e. Siva), one is never tarnished with sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: Even after striking and destroying all living beings, and after burning this entire universe if one should worship the only God Virupaksa (i.e. Siva), one is never tarnished with sins.

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्त्वा पूर्वमभ्यर्च्य रुद्रं त्रिभुवनेश्वरम् तुष्टाव वाग्भिर् इष्टाभिर् देवदेवं त्रियंबकम्
verses.transliteration: ityuktvā pūrvamabhyarcya rudraṃ tribhuvaneśvaram tuṣṭāva vāgbhir iṣṭābhir devadevaṃ triyaṃbakam
verses.translation: Even after striking and destroying all living beings, and after burning this entire universe if one should worship the only God Virupaksa (i.e. Siva), one is never tarnished with sins.
verses.hindi: करोड़ों गुना फल अहिंसक मनुष्य प्राप्त करता है॥ ७--९ /२॥ मन, वचन तथा कर्मसे सभी प्राणियोंके हितमें संलग्न और दयादृष्टिके मार्गपर चलनेवाले रुद्रलोकको जाते हैं। जो लोग स्वामीके समान विभिन्न प्राणियोंको अपने पुत्र-पौत्रके समान समझकर स्नेहपूर्वक उनकी रक्षा
verses.wordMeaning: Even after striking and destroying all living beings, and after burning this entire universe if one should worship the only God Virupaksa (i.e. Siva), one is never tarnished with sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: Even after striking and destroying all living beings, and after burning this entire universe if one should worship the only God Virupaksa (i.e. Siva), one is never tarnished with sins.

verses.sanskrit: तदाप्रभृति शक्राद्याः पूजयामासुरीश्वरम् साक्षात्पाशुपतं कृत्वा भस्मोद्धूलितविग्रहाः
verses.transliteration: tadāprabhṛti śakrādyāḥ pūjayāmāsurīśvaram sākṣātpāśupataṃ kṛtvā bhasmoddhūlitavigrahāḥ
verses.translation: Even after striking and destroying all living beings, and after burning this entire universe if one should worship the only God Virupaksa (i.e. Siva), one is never tarnished with sins.
verses.hindi: करते हैं, वे रुद्रलोकको जाते हैं। अतः पूरे प्रयत्नसे वस्त्रसे पवित्र किये गये जलके द्वारा सदा अभ्युक्षण तथा विशेषरूपसे स्नान कराना चाहिए। सम्पूर्ण त्रिलोकका संहार करनेपर जो पापका फल कहा गया है, उस
verses.wordMeaning: Even after striking and destroying all living beings, and after burning this entire universe if one should worship the only God Virupaksa (i.e. Siva), one is never tarnished with sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: Even after striking and destroying all living beings, and after burning this entire universe if one should worship the only God Virupaksa (i.e. Siva), one is never tarnished with sins.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीलिङ्गमहापुराणे पूर्वभागे ब्रह्मप्रोक्तलिङ्गार्चनविधिर् नाम त्रिसप्ततितमो ऽध्यायः लिङ्गानि कल्पयित्वैवं स्वाधिकारानुरूपतः विश्वकर्मा ददौ तेषां नियोगाद्ब्रह्मणः प्रभोः
verses.transliteration: iti śrīliṅgamahāpurāṇe pūrvabhāge brahmaproktaliṅgārcanavidhir nāma trisaptatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ liṅgāni kalpayitvaivaṃ svādhikārānurūpataḥ viśvakarmā dadau teṣāṃ niyogādbrahmaṇaḥ prabhoḥ
verses.translation: At the bidding of Lord Brahma, Vivakarma made the following Lingas befitting the office of Devas and gave those Lingas to them.
verses.hindi: सम्पूर्ण पापको मनुष्य शिवालयमें मात्र एक प्राणीको हत्या करके प्राप्त करता है हे श्रेष्ठ द्विजो! शिवके निमित्त सदा पुष्पहिंसा की जानी चाहिए। यज्ञके लिये पशुहिंसा दुष्ट शासन है; यह क्षत्रियोंके द्वारा की जा सकती है। ब्रह्मवादी योगियोंके लिये कोई विधिनिषेध नहीं है। अतः निषिद्धका सेवन
verses.wordMeaning: At the bidding of Lord Brahma, Vivakarma made the following Lingas befitting the office of Devas and gave those Lingas to them.
verses.commentary: Sense: At the bidding of Lord Brahma, Vivakarma made the following Lingas befitting the office of Devas and gave those Lingas to them.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रनीलमयं लिङ्गं विष्णुना पूजितं सदा पद्मरागमयं शक्रो हैमं विश्रवसः सुतः
verses.transliteration: indranīlamayaṃ liṅgaṃ viṣṇunā pūjitaṃ sadā padmarāgamayaṃ śakro haimaṃ viśravasaḥ sutaḥ
verses.translation: The Lihga made of Sapphire was worshipped by Visnu. Indra worshipped that of ruby. The son of Viravas worshipped the Lihga made of gold,
verses.hindi: करनेपर भी वे वध्य नहीं हैं। सभी कर्माका त्याग करके संन्यास
verses.wordMeaning: The Lihga made of Sapphire was worshipped by Visnu. Indra worshipped that of ruby. The son of Viravas worshipped the Lihga made of gold,
verses.commentary: Sense: The Lihga made of Sapphire was worshipped by Visnu. Indra worshipped that of ruby. The son of Viravas worshipped the Lihga made of gold,

verses.sanskrit: विश्वेदेवास् तथा रौप्यं वसवः कान्तिकं शुभम् आरकूटमयं वायुर् अश्विनौ पार्थिवं सदा
verses.transliteration: viśvedevās tathā raupyaṃ vasavaḥ kāntikaṃ śubham ārakūṭamayaṃ vāyur aśvinau pārthivaṃ sadā
verses.translation: Visvedevas worshipped Silver Lihga, Vasus the aus- picious magnetic Lihga, Vayu the Lihga made of brass; and Asvins the Earthen Lihga.
verses.hindi: न हन्तव्याः सदा पूज्याः पापकर्मरता अपि। ब्रह्महत्यासमं पापमात्रेयीं विनिहत्य च। स्त्रियः सर्वा न हन्तव्याः पापकर्मरता अपि
verses.wordMeaning: Visvedevas worshipped Silver Lihga, Vasus the aus- picious magnetic Lihga, Vayu the Lihga made of brass; and Asvins the Earthen Lihga.
verses.commentary: Sense: Visvedevas worshipped Silver Lihga, Vasus the aus- picious magnetic Lihga, Vayu the Lihga made of brass; and Asvins the Earthen Lihga.

verses.sanskrit: स्फाटिकं वरुणो राजा आदित्यास्ताम्रनिर्मितम् मौक्तिकं सोमराड् धीमांस् तथा लिङ्गमनुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: sphāṭikaṃ varuṇo rājā ādityāstāmranirmitam mauktikaṃ somarāḍ dhīmāṃs tathā liṅgamanuttamam
verses.translation: King Varuna worshipped the crystal Lihga; Adilyas ihe excellent Lihga made of copper, and king Soma the excel- lent Lihga made of pearls.
verses.hindi: न यज्ञार्थ स्त्रियो ग्राह्माः सर्वैः सर्वत्र सर्वदा। सर्ववर्णेषु विप्रेन्द्राः पापकर्मरता अपि
verses.wordMeaning: King Varuna worshipped the crystal Lihga; Adilyas ihe excellent Lihga made of copper, and king Soma the excel- lent Lihga made of pearls.
verses.commentary: Sense: King Varuna worshipped the crystal Lihga; Adilyas ihe excellent Lihga made of copper, and king Soma the excel- lent Lihga made of pearls.

verses.sanskrit: अनन्ताद्या महानागाः प्रवालकमयं शुभम् दैत्या ह्ययोमयं लिङ्गं राक्षसाश् च महात्मनः
verses.transliteration: anantādyā mahānāgāḥ pravālakamayaṃ śubham daityā hyayomayaṃ liṅgaṃ rākṣasāś ca mahātmanaḥ
verses.translation: Ananta and the other great serpents worshipped the Lihga of coral; Daityas and Raksasas the ferrous Lihga,
verses.hindi: न हन्तव्याः सदा मर्त्ये: शिववच्छङ्कया तथा प्रसङ्काद्वापि यो मर्त्यः सतां सकृदहो द्विजाः। रुद्रलोकमवाप्नोति समभ्यर्च्य महेश्वरम्
verses.wordMeaning: Ananta and the other great serpents worshipped the Lihga of coral; Daityas and Raksasas the ferrous Lihga,
verses.commentary: Sense: Ananta and the other great serpents worshipped the Lihga of coral; Daityas and Raksasas the ferrous Lihga,

verses.sanskrit: त्रैलोहिकं गुह्यकाश् च सर्वलोहमयं गणाः चामुण्डा सैकतं साक्षान् मातरश् च द्विजोत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: trailohikaṃ guhyakāś ca sarvalohamayaṃ gaṇāḥ cāmuṇḍā saikataṃ sākṣān mātaraś ca dvijottamāḥ
verses.translation: Guhyakas worshipped the Lihga of three metals, Ganas that made of all metals and O excellent brahmins, Camunda and Mothers worshipped the Lihga of Sand.
verses.hindi: भवन्ति दुःखिताः सर्वे निर्दया मुनिसत्तमाः। भक्तिहीना नराः सर्वे भवे परमकारणे
verses.wordMeaning: Guhyakas worshipped the Lihga of three metals, Ganas that made of all metals and O excellent brahmins, Camunda and Mothers worshipped the Lihga of Sand.
verses.commentary: Sense: Guhyakas worshipped the Lihga of three metals, Ganas that made of all metals and O excellent brahmins, Camunda and Mothers worshipped the Lihga of Sand.

verses.sanskrit: दारुजं नैरृतिर् भक्त्या यमो मारकतं शुभम् नीलाद्याश् च तथा रुद्राः शुद्धं भस्ममयं शुभम्
verses.transliteration: dārujaṃ nairṛtir bhaktyā yamo mārakataṃ śubham nīlādyāś ca tathā rudrāḥ śuddhaṃ bhasmamayaṃ śubham
verses.translation: Nairrti worshipped the Lihga of wood; Yama that of emerald; Nila rudra and others the pure and splendid Lihga made ofBhasman (ashes).
verses.hindi: ये भक्ता देवदेवस्य शिवस्य परमेष्ठिनः । भागयवन्तो विमुच्यन्ते भुक्त्वा भोगानिहैव ते भक्त यथा चित्तमथादिदेवे।
verses.wordMeaning: Nairrti worshipped the Lihga of wood; Yama that of emerald; Nila rudra and others the pure and splendid Lihga made ofBhasman (ashes).
verses.commentary: Sense: Nairrti worshipped the Lihga of wood; Yama that of emerald; Nila rudra and others the pure and splendid Lihga made ofBhasman (ashes).

verses.sanskrit: लक्ष्मीवृक्षमयं लक्ष्मीर् गुहो वै गोमयात्मकम् मुनयो मुनिशार्दूलाः कुशाग्रमयम् उत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: lakṣmīvṛkṣamayaṃ lakṣmīr guho vai gomayātmakam munayo muniśārdūlāḥ kuśāgramayam uttamam
verses.translation: Laksmi worshipped the Lihga of Laksmivrksa (Bilva tree); Guha the Lihga of cowdung. O leading sages, the sages worshipped the excellent Lihga of Kusa grass.
verses.hindi: तेषां न दूरः परमेशलोकः
verses.wordMeaning: Laksmi worshipped the Lihga of Laksmivrksa (Bilva tree); Guha the Lihga of cowdung. O leading sages, the sages worshipped the excellent Lihga of Kusa grass.
verses.commentary: Sense: Laksmi worshipped the Lihga of Laksmivrksa (Bilva tree); Guha the Lihga of cowdung. O leading sages, the sages worshipped the excellent Lihga of Kusa grass.

verses.sanskrit: वामाद्याः पुष्पलिङ्गं तु गन्धलिङ्गं मनोन्मनी सरस्वती च रत्नेन कृतं रुद्रस्य वाग्भवा
verses.transliteration: vāmādyāḥ puṣpaliṅgaṃ tu gandhaliṅgaṃ manonmanī sarasvatī ca ratnena kṛtaṃ rudrasya vāgbhavā
verses.translation: Vamadeva and others worshipped the Puspa lihga and Manonmani the Lihga made of scents. Sarasvati wor- shipped the Lihga made of jewels.
verses.hindi: लिये हुए ब्रह्मवादी लोगोंका वध नहीं करना चाहिए; ३ पापकर्ममें लगे रहनेपर भी सदा पूज्य हैं ॥ १४--१ ह
verses.wordMeaning: Vamadeva and others worshipped the Puspa lihga and Manonmani the Lihga made of scents. Sarasvati wor- shipped the Lihga made of jewels.
verses.commentary: Sense: Vamadeva and others worshipped the Puspa lihga and Manonmani the Lihga made of scents. Sarasvati wor- shipped the Lihga made of jewels.

verses.sanskrit: दुर्गा हैमं महादेवं सवेदिकमनुत्तमम् उग्रा पिष्टमयं सर्वे मन्त्रा ह्याज्यमयं शुभम्
verses.transliteration: durgā haimaṃ mahādevaṃ savedikamanuttamam ugrā piṣṭamayaṃ sarve mantrā hyājyamayaṃ śubham
verses.translation: Durga worshipped the Lihga made of gold along with the pedestal. All the Mantras worshipped Ugra in the form of sacrifice with the splendid Lihga made of ghee.
verses.hindi: अत्रिके कुलमें उत्पन्न सभी स्त्रियाँ पवित्र होती ह अत्रिवंशकी स्त्रीक हत्या करनेपर ब्रह्महत्याके समान पाप लगता है, अतः पापकर्ममें रत होनेपर भी उन स्त्रियोंक) हत्या नहीं करनी चाहिए। सभी लोगोंको चाहिए कि
verses.wordMeaning: Durga worshipped the Lihga made of gold along with the pedestal. All the Mantras worshipped Ugra in the form of sacrifice with the splendid Lihga made of ghee.
verses.commentary: Sense: Durga worshipped the Lihga made of gold along with the pedestal. All the Mantras worshipped Ugra in the form of sacrifice with the splendid Lihga made of ghee.

verses.sanskrit: वेदाः सर्वे दधिमयं पिशाचाः सीसनिर्मितम् लेभिरे च यथायोग्यं प्रसादाद्ब्रह्मणः पदम्
verses.transliteration: vedāḥ sarve dadhimayaṃ piśācāḥ sīsanirmitam lebhire ca yathāyogyaṃ prasādādbrahmaṇaḥ padam
verses.translation: The Vedas worshipped the Lihga of curds; P-'acas the Lihga of lead. All the worshippers attained the suitable region by the favour of Brahma.
verses.hindi: यह्ञहेतु सर्वत्र सर्वदा स्त्रियोंको ग्रहण न करें; है विप्रेद्रो  सभी वर्णोकी स्त्रियाँ चाहे वे पापकर्ममें रत हों, मलिन हों, मनुष्योंके द्वारा वध्य नहीं हैं; उनमें शिवभाव रखना चाहिए॥ १७--२० ॥
verses.wordMeaning: The Vedas worshipped the Lihga of curds; P-'acas the Lihga of lead. All the worshippers attained the suitable region by the favour of Brahma.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Vedas worshipped the Lihga of curds; P-'acas the Lihga of lead. All the worshippers attained the suitable region by the favour of Brahma.

verses.sanskrit: बहुनात्र किमुक्तेन चराचरमिदं जगत् शिवलिङ्गं समभ्यर्च्य स्थितमत्र न संशयः
verses.transliteration: bahunātra kimuktena carācaramidaṃ jagat śivaliṅgaṃ samabhyarcya sthitamatra na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: Of what avail is much talk? There is no doubt in this that it was due to their worshipping the Lihga that the universe of mobile and immobile beings could stand.
verses.hindi: स्मृतिसे विमुख लोग पाखण्डी कहे गये हैं । द्विजातियोंको उनके साथ बातचीत नहीं करनी चाहिए, उनका स्पर्श नहीं करना चाहिए और उन्हें देखना नहीं चाहिए; उन्हे देखनेपर सूर्यका दर्शन करना चाहिए; फिर भी राजाओं
verses.wordMeaning: Of what avail is much talk? There is no doubt in this that it was due to their worshipping the Lihga that the universe of mobile and immobile beings could stand.
verses.commentary: Sense: Of what avail is much talk? There is no doubt in this that it was due to their worshipping the Lihga that the universe of mobile and immobile beings could stand.

verses.sanskrit: षड्विधं लिङ्गमित्याहुर् द्रव्याणां च प्रभेदतः तेषां भेदाश्चतुर्युक्तचत्वारिंशदिति स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: ṣaḍvidhaṃ liṅgamityāhur dravyāṇāṃ ca prabhedataḥ teṣāṃ bhedāścaturyuktacatvāriṃśaditi smṛtāḥ
verses.translation: Due to the difference injthe material, they say, there are six types of Lihgas. Their subdivisions are fortyfour in number. The first type of Lihga is called Sailaja (made of rock). It has four sub-divisions. O excellent sages, the second type is made of jewels. It has seven sub-divisions. The third type originates from metals and it has eight sub-divisions. The fourth Lihga originates from wood and it is of sixteen sub-
verses.hindi: तथा अन्य प्राणियोंको चाहिए कि उनका वध न करें हे द्विजो! मनुष्य सज्जनोंके संसर्गवश एक बार भी महेश्वरका पूजन करके रुद्रलोक प्राप्त कर लेता है। है श्रेष्ठ द्विजो! सभी दयारहित लोग तथा परमकारण शिवमें भक्तिसे हीन सभी मनुष्य दुःख भोगते हैं। जो
verses.wordMeaning: Due to the difference injthe material, they say, there are six types of Lihgas. Their subdivisions are fortyfour in number. The first type of Lihga is called Sailaja (made of rock). It has four sub-divisions. O excellent sages, the second type is made of jewels.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Due to the difference injthe material, they say, there are six types of Lihgas. Their subdivisions are fortyfour in number. The first type of Lihga is called Sailaja (made of rock). It has four sub-divisions. O excellent sages, the second type is made of jewels.…

verses.sanskrit: शैलजं प्रथमं प्रोक्तं तद्धि साक्षाच्चतुर्विधम् द्वितीयं रत्नजं तच्च सप्तधा मुनिसत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: śailajaṃ prathamaṃ proktaṃ taddhi sākṣāccaturvidham dvitīyaṃ ratnajaṃ tacca saptadhā munisattamāḥ
verses.translation: The Lihga originating from jewels bestows fortune; that originating from rock yields all Siddhis. The Lihga made of metals bestows wealth and the Lihga made of wood yields the achievement of worldly pleasures.
verses.hindi: लोग देवदेव परमेष्ठी शिवके भक्त हैं, वे भाग्यशाली हैं और इस लोकमें सुखोंको भोगकर मुक्त हो जात हैं॥ २३--२५॥
verses.wordMeaning: The Lihga originating from jewels bestows fortune; that originating from rock yields all Siddhis. The Lihga made of metals bestows wealth and the Lihga made of wood yields the achievement of worldly pleasures.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Lihga originating from jewels bestows fortune; that originating from rock yields all Siddhis. The Lihga made of metals bestows wealth and the Lihga made of wood yields the achievement of worldly pleasures.

verses.sanskrit: तृतीयं धातुजं लिङ्गम् अष्टधा परमेष्ठिनः तुरीयं दारुजं लिङ्गं तत्तु षोडशधोच्यते
verses.transliteration: tṛtīyaṃ dhātujaṃ liṅgam aṣṭadhā parameṣṭhinaḥ turīyaṃ dārujaṃ liṅgaṃ tattu ṣoḍaśadhocyate
verses.translation: O leading brahmins, the Lihga of clay is splendid and brings about all Siddhis. The Lihga of rock is very excellent; the Lihga of metals is the middling one.
verses.hindi: जैसे गृहस्थ मनुष्योंका चित्त पुत्रों, स्त्रियों तथा घरोंमें आसक्त रहता है, उसी प्रकार उनका चित्त यदि यतियों तथा तपस्वियोंके सान्निध्यसे एक बार भी आदिदेवमें लग जाय तो परमेश्वरका लोक उनके लिये शिवपूजासे सभीका कल्याण, शिवपूजाकी विधि““दीपदानकी महिमा
verses.wordMeaning: O leading brahmins, the Lihga of clay is splendid and brings about all Siddhis. The Lihga of rock is very excellent; the Lihga of metals is the middling one.
verses.commentary: Sense: O leading brahmins, the Lihga of clay is splendid and brings about all Siddhis. The Lihga of rock is very excellent; the Lihga of metals is the middling one.

verses.sanskrit: मृन्मयं पञ्चमं लिङ्गं द्विधा भिन्नं द्विजोत्तमाः षष्ठं तु क्षणिकं लिङ्गं सप्तधा परिकीर्तितम्
verses.transliteration: mṛnmayaṃ pañcamaṃ liṅgaṃ dvidhā bhinnaṃ dvijottamāḥ ṣaṣṭhaṃ tu kṣaṇikaṃ liṅgaṃ saptadhā parikīrtitam
verses.translation: Lihgas are of numerous types. In brief, they are of nine types.
verses.hindi: शिवपूजासे सभीका कल्याण, शिवपूजाकी विधि एवं शिवमन्दिरमें दीपदानकी महिमा
verses.wordMeaning: Lihgas are of numerous types. In brief, they are of nine types.
verses.commentary: Sense: Lihgas are of numerous types. In brief, they are of nine types.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीप्रदं रत्नजं लिङ्गं शैलजं सर्वसिद्धिदम् धातुजं धनदं साक्षाद् दारुजं भोगसिद्धिदम्
verses.transliteration: śrīpradaṃ ratnajaṃ liṅgaṃ śailajaṃ sarvasiddhidam dhātujaṃ dhanadaṃ sākṣād dārujaṃ bhogasiddhidam
verses.translation: The goddess as well as the lord is adored by the person who worships with that pedestal. The splendid Liiiga whether of rock, or of jewel or of metals, or of wood or of clay or of momentary type, should be installed with devotion. The result is very splendid.
verses.hindi: कथं पूज्यो महादेवो मत्यँर्मन्हैर्महामते। अल्पायुषेरल्पवीर्यैरल्पसत्त्वैः प्रजापति: संवत्सरसहस्त्रेश्च तपसा पूज्य शङ्करम्। न पश्यन्ति सुराश्चापि कथं देवं यजन्ति ते
verses.wordMeaning: The goddess as well as the lord is adored by the person who worships with that pedestal. The splendid Liiiga whether of rock, or of jewel or of metals, or of wood or of clay or of momentary type, should be installed with devotion. The result is very splendid.
verses.commentary: Sense: The goddess as well as the lord is adored by the person who worships with that pedestal. The splendid Liiiga whether of rock, or of jewel or of metals, or of wood or of clay or of momentary type, should be installed with devotion. The result is very splendid.

verses.sanskrit: मृन्मयं चैव विप्रेन्द्राः सर्वसिद्धिकरं शुभम् शैलजं चोत्तमं प्रोक्तं मध्यमं चैव धातुजम्
verses.transliteration: mṛnmayaṃ caiva viprendrāḥ sarvasiddhikaraṃ śubham śailajaṃ cottamaṃ proktaṃ madhyamaṃ caiva dhātujam
verses.translation: After eschewing the Lihgas of rock, or of jewels, or of metals, or of wood or of clay or of the momentary type he shall establish his entire body in the Lihga.
verses.hindi: कथितं तथ्यमेवात्र युष्माभिर्मुनिपुङ्गवाः। तथापि श्रद्धया दृश्य: पूज्यः सम्भाष्य एव च
verses.wordMeaning: After eschewing the Lihgas of rock, or of jewels, or of metals, or of wood or of clay or of the momentary type he shall establish his entire body in the Lihga.
verses.commentary: Sense: After eschewing the Lihgas of rock, or of jewels, or of metals, or of wood or of clay or of the momentary type he shall establish his entire body in the Lihga.

verses.sanskrit: बहुधा लिङ्गभेदाश् च नव चैव समासतः मूले ब्रह्मा तथा मध्ये विष्णुस्त्रिभुवनेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: bahudhā liṅgabhedāś ca nava caiva samāsataḥ mūle brahmā tathā madhye viṣṇustribhuvaneśvaraḥ
verses.translation: After eschewing the Lihgas of rock, or of jewels, or of metals, or of wood or of clay or of the momentary type he shall establish his entire body in the Lihga.
verses.hindi: भावानुरूपफलदो भगवानिति कीर्तितः मदार्तः पूजयन् रुद्रं सोमस्थानमवाप्नुयात्
verses.wordMeaning: After eschewing the Lihgas of rock, or of jewels, or of metals, or of wood or of clay or of the momentary type he shall establish his entire body in the Lihga.
verses.commentary: Sense: After eschewing the Lihgas of rock, or of jewels, or of metals, or of wood or of clay or of the momentary type he shall establish his entire body in the Lihga.

verses.sanskrit: रुद्रोपरि महादेवः प्रणवाख्यः सदाशिवः लिङ्गवेदी महादेवी त्रिगुणा त्रिमयांबिका
verses.transliteration: rudropari mahādevaḥ praṇavākhyaḥ sadāśivaḥ liṅgavedī mahādevī triguṇā trimayāṃbikā
verses.translation: After eschewing the Lihgas of rock, or of jewels, or of metals, or of wood or of clay or of the momentary type he shall establish his entire body in the Lihga.
verses.hindi: गायत्र्या देवमभ्यर्च्य प्राजापत्यमवाण्नुयात्। ब्राहां हि प्रणवेनैव वैष्णवं चाभिनन्द्य च
verses.wordMeaning: After eschewing the Lihgas of rock, or of jewels, or of metals, or of wood or of clay or of the momentary type he shall establish his entire body in the Lihga.
verses.commentary: Sense: After eschewing the Lihgas of rock, or of jewels, or of metals, or of wood or of clay or of the momentary type he shall establish his entire body in the Lihga.

verses.sanskrit: तया च पूजयेद्यस्तु देवी देवश् च पूजितौ शैलजं रत्नजं वापि धातुजं वापि दारुजम्
verses.transliteration: tayā ca pūjayedyastu devī devaś ca pūjitau śailajaṃ ratnajaṃ vāpi dhātujaṃ vāpi dārujam
verses.translation: After eschewing the Lihgas of rock, or of jewels, or of metals, or of wood or of clay or of the momentary type he shall establish his entire body in the Lihga.
verses.hindi: श्रद्धया सकृदेवापि समभ्यर्च्यं महेश्वरम्। रुद्रलोकमनृप्राप्य रुद्रैः सार्धं प्रमोदते संशोध्य च शुभं लिङ्गममरासुरपूजितम्। जलैः पूतैस्तथा पीठे देवमावाह्य भक्तितः
verses.wordMeaning: After eschewing the Lihgas of rock, or of jewels, or of metals, or of wood or of clay or of the momentary type he shall establish his entire body in the Lihga.
verses.commentary: Sense: After eschewing the Lihgas of rock, or of jewels, or of metals, or of wood or of clay or of the momentary type he shall establish his entire body in the Lihga.

verses.sanskrit: मृन्मयं क्षणिकं वापि भक्त्या स्थाप्य फलं शुभम् सुरेन्द्राम्भोजगर्भाग्नियमाम्बुपधनेश्वरैः
verses.transliteration: mṛnmayaṃ kṣaṇikaṃ vāpi bhaktyā sthāpya phalaṃ śubham surendrāmbhojagarbhāgniyamāmbupadhaneśvaraiḥ
verses.translation: After eschewing the Lihgas of rock, or of jewels, or of metals, or of wood or of clay or of the momentary type he shall establish his entire body in the Lihga.
verses.hindi: दृष्ट्वा देवं यथान्यायं प्रणिपत्य च शङ्करम्। कल्पिते चासने स्थाप्य धर्मज्ञानमये शुभे
verses.wordMeaning: After eschewing the Lihgas of rock, or of jewels, or of metals, or of wood or of clay or of the momentary type he shall establish his entire body in the Lihga.
verses.commentary: Sense: After eschewing the Lihgas of rock, or of jewels, or of metals, or of wood or of clay or of the momentary type he shall establish his entire body in the Lihga.

verses.sanskrit: सिद्धविद्याधराहीन्द्रैर् यक्षदानवकिन्नरैः स्तूयमानः सुपुण्यात्मा देवदुन्दुभिनिःस्वनैः
verses.transliteration: siddhavidyādharāhīndrair yakṣadānavakinnaraiḥ stūyamānaḥ supuṇyātmā devadundubhiniḥsvanaiḥ
verses.translation: After eschewing the Lihgas of rock, or of jewels, or of metals, or of wood or of clay or of the momentary type he shall establish his entire body in the Lihga.
verses.hindi: वैरा्यैश्वर्यसम्पन्ने सर्वलोकनमस्कृते। ओङ्कारपदामध्ये तु सोमसूर्याग्निसम्भवे ऋषिगण बोले-हे महामते! मन्दबुद्धिवाले,
verses.wordMeaning: After eschewing the Lihgas of rock, or of jewels, or of metals, or of wood or of clay or of the momentary type he shall establish his entire body in the Lihga.
verses.commentary: Sense: After eschewing the Lihgas of rock, or of jewels, or of metals, or of wood or of clay or of the momentary type he shall establish his entire body in the Lihga.

verses.sanskrit: भूर्भूवःस्वर्महर्लोकान् क्रमाद् वै जनतः परम् तपः सत्यं पराक्रम्य भासयन् स्वेन तेजसा
verses.transliteration: bhūrbhūvaḥsvarmaharlokān kramād vai janataḥ param tapaḥ satyaṃ parākramya bhāsayan svena tejasā
verses.translation: After eschewing the Lihgas of rock, or of jewels, or of metals, or of wood or of clay or of the momentary type he shall establish his entire body in the Lihga.
verses.hindi: मनुष्योंको प्रजापति महादेवकी पूजा किस प्रकार करनी चाहिए ? हजार वर्षोतक तपस्याके द्वारा शंकरको पूजा करके देवता भी उनका दर्शन नहीं कर पाते; तो फिर वे मनुष्य भगवान् शिवकी पूजा कैसे करें ?
verses.wordMeaning: After eschewing the Lihgas of rock, or of jewels, or of metals, or of wood or of clay or of the momentary type he shall establish his entire body in the Lihga.
verses.commentary: Sense: After eschewing the Lihgas of rock, or of jewels, or of metals, or of wood or of clay or of the momentary type he shall establish his entire body in the Lihga.

verses.sanskrit: लिङ्गस्थापनसन्मार्गनिहितस्वायतासिना आशु ब्रह्माण्डमुद्भिद्य निर्गच्छन्निर्विशङ्कया
verses.transliteration: liṅgasthāpanasanmārganihitasvāyatāsinā āśu brahmāṇḍamudbhidya nirgacchannirviśaṅkayā
verses.translation: After eschewing the Lihgas of rock, or of jewels, or of metals, or of wood or of clay or of the momentary type he shall establish his entire body in the Lihga.
verses.hindi: सूतजी बोले--हे श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! आपलोगोंने यथार्थ बात कही है, फिर भी श्रद्धापूर्वक शिवकी पूजा करनेपर उनका दर्शन हो सकता है और उनसे सम्भाषण किया जा सकता है । है द्विजो ! प्रसंगवश भक्तिहीन लोगोंके द्वारा भी पूजित होकर वे भगवान् उनके भावके अनुरूप फल देनेवाले कहे गये हैं
verses.wordMeaning: After eschewing the Lihgas of rock, or of jewels, or of metals, or of wood or of clay or of the momentary type he shall establish his entire body in the Lihga.
verses.commentary: Sense: After eschewing the Lihgas of rock, or of jewels, or of metals, or of wood or of clay or of the momentary type he shall establish his entire body in the Lihga.

verses.sanskrit: शैलजं रत्नजं वापि धातुजं वापि दारुजम् मृन्मयं क्षणिकं त्यक्त्वा स्थापयेत्सकलं वपुः
verses.transliteration: śailajaṃ ratnajaṃ vāpi dhātujaṃ vāpi dārujam mṛnmayaṃ kṣaṇikaṃ tyaktvā sthāpayetsakalaṃ vapuḥ
verses.translation: After eschewing the Lihgas of rock, or of jewels, or of metals, or of wood or of clay or of the momentary type he shall establish his entire body in the Lihga.
verses.hindi: हे द्विजो! उच्छिष्ट अधम ब्राह्मण शिवको पूजा करके पिशाचलोकको जाता है और क्रोधमें भरकर पूजन करनेवाला मूढ्बुद्धि राक्षसका स्थान (लोक) प्राप्त करता है। अभक्ष्य भोजन-का भक्षण करनेवाला दुष्ट मनुष्य
verses.wordMeaning: After eschewing the Lihgas of rock, or of jewels, or of metals, or of wood or of clay or of the momentary type he shall establish his entire body in the Lihga.
verses.commentary: Sense: After eschewing the Lihgas of rock, or of jewels, or of metals, or of wood or of clay or of the momentary type he shall establish his entire body in the Lihga.

verses.sanskrit: विधिना चैव कृत्वा तु स्कन्दोमासहितं शुभम् कुन्दगोक्षीरसंकाशं लिङ्गं यः स्थापयेन्नरः
verses.transliteration: vidhinā caiva kṛtvā tu skandomāsahitaṃ śubham kundagokṣīrasaṃkāśaṃ liṅgaṃ yaḥ sthāpayennaraḥ
verses.translation: After eschewing the Lihgas of rock, or of jewels, or of metals, or of wood or of clay or of the momentary type he shall establish his entire body in the Lihga.
verses.hindi: शिवकी पूजा करके यक्षलोक प्राप्त करता है और नृत्य-गान करनेवाला उनकी पूजा करके गन्धर्वलोक प्राप्त करता है। प्रसिद्धिका इच्छुक और स्त्रियोंमें आसक्त नराधम बुधलोक प्राप्त करता है। मदोन्मत्त व्यक्ति रुद्रको पूजा करता हुआ सोमलोक प्राप्त करता है॥ ५--७॥
verses.wordMeaning: After eschewing the Lihgas of rock, or of jewels, or of metals, or of wood or of clay or of the momentary type he shall establish his entire body in the Lihga.
verses.commentary: Sense: After eschewing the Lihgas of rock, or of jewels, or of metals, or of wood or of clay or of the momentary type he shall establish his entire body in the Lihga.

verses.sanskrit: नृणां तनुं समास्थाय स्थितो रुद्रो न संशयः दर्शनात्स्पर्शनात्तस्य लभन्ते निर्वृतिं नराः
verses.transliteration: nṛṇāṃ tanuṃ samāsthāya sthito rudro na saṃśayaḥ darśanātsparśanāttasya labhante nirvṛtiṃ narāḥ
verses.translation: After eschewing the Lihgas of rock, or of jewels, or of metals, or of wood or of clay or of the momentary type he shall establish his entire body in the Lihga.
verses.hindi: रुद्र गायत्री मन्त्र द्वारा शिवका पूजन करके मनुष्य प्रजापतिलोकको और प्रणवके द्वारा पूजन करके ब्रह्मलोक तथा विष्णुलोकको प्राप्त करता है। श्रद्धापूर्वक एक बार भी महेशवरका पूजन करके मनुष्य रुद्रलोकमें
verses.wordMeaning: After eschewing the Lihgas of rock, or of jewels, or of metals, or of wood or of clay or of the momentary type he shall establish his entire body in the Lihga.
verses.commentary: Sense: After eschewing the Lihgas of rock, or of jewels, or of metals, or of wood or of clay or of the momentary type he shall establish his entire body in the Lihga.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य पुण्यं मया वक्तुं सम्यग्युगशतैरपि शक्यते नैव विप्रेन्द्रास् तस्माद् वै स्थापयेत् तथा
verses.transliteration: tasya puṇyaṃ mayā vaktuṃ samyagyugaśatairapi śakyate naiva viprendrās tasmād vai sthāpayet tathā
verses.translation: After eschewing the Lihgas of rock, or of jewels, or of metals, or of wood or of clay or of the momentary type he shall establish his entire body in the Lihga.
verses.hindi: पहुँचकर रुद्रोंके साथ आमोद-प्रमोद करता है जलसे स्वच्छ करके पीठमें भक्तिपूर्वक शिवका आवाहन करके उन्हें देखकर विधिपूर्वक प्रणाम करके धर्मज्ञानमय, उत्तम, वैराग्य-ऐश्वर्यसे सम्पन्न, सभी लोगोंसे नमस्कृत, ओंकार पद्मसे युक्त मध्यभागवाले तथा चन्द्र-सूर्य-अग्निसे
verses.wordMeaning: After eschewing the Lihgas of rock, or of jewels, or of metals, or of wood or of clay or of the momentary type he shall establish his entire body in the Lihga.
verses.commentary: Sense: After eschewing the Lihgas of rock, or of jewels, or of metals, or of wood or of clay or of the momentary type he shall establish his entire body in the Lihga.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वेषामेव मर्त्यानां विभोर्दिव्यं वपुः शुभम् सकलं भावनायोग्यं योगिनामेव निष्कलम्
verses.transliteration: sarveṣāmeva martyānāṃ vibhordivyaṃ vapuḥ śubham sakalaṃ bhāvanāyogyaṃ yogināmeva niṣkalam
verses.translation: After eschewing the Lihgas of rock, or of jewels, or of metals, or of wood or of clay or of the momentary type he shall establish his entire body in the Lihga.
verses.hindi: उत्पन्न कल्पित आसनपर स्थापित करके रुद्र शम्भुको
verses.wordMeaning: After eschewing the Lihgas of rock, or of jewels, or of metals, or of wood or of clay or of the momentary type he shall establish his entire body in the Lihga.
verses.commentary: Sense: After eschewing the Lihgas of rock, or of jewels, or of metals, or of wood or of clay or of the momentary type he shall establish his entire body in the Lihga.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीलिङ्गमहापुराणे पूर्वभागे शिवलिङ्गभेदसंस्थापनादिवर्णनं नाम चतुःसप्ततितमो ऽध्यायः निष्कलो निर्मलो नित्यः सकलत्वं कथं गतः वक्तुमर्हसि चास्माकं यथा पूर्वं यथा श्रुतम्
verses.transliteration: iti śrīliṅgamahāpurāṇe pūrvabhāge śivaliṅgabhedasaṃsthāpanādivarṇanaṃ nāma catuḥsaptatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ niṣkalo nirmalo nityaḥ sakalatvaṃ kathaṃ gataḥ vaktumarhasi cāsmākaṃ yathā pūrvaṃ yathā śrutam
verses.translation: How did the lord who is ni.skala (attrihuteless), nirinala (pure), and nitya (eternal) adopt sakalatva (the state ol being wiih attributes). It behoves you to tell ns about this in the same manner you had learnt it formerly.
verses.hindi: दध्ना च स्नापयेद् रुद्रं शोधयेच्च यथाविधि। ततः शुद्धाम्बुना स्नाप्य चन्दनाद्यैश्च पूजयेत् चम्पकैर्जातिपुष्पैश् बकुलैः करवीरकैः
verses.wordMeaning: How did the lord who is ni.skala (attrihuteless), nirinala (pure), and nitya (eternal) adopt sakalatva (the state ol being wiih attributes). It behoves you to tell ns about this in the same manner you had learnt it formerly.
verses.commentary: Sense: How did the lord who is ni.skala (attrihuteless), nirinala (pure), and nitya (eternal) adopt sakalatva (the state ol being wiih attributes). It behoves you to tell ns about this in the same manner you had learnt it formerly.

verses.sanskrit: परमार्थविदः केचिद् ऊचुः प्रणवरूपिणम् विज्ञानमिति विप्रेन्द्राः श्रुत्वा श्रुतिशिरस्यजम्
verses.transliteration: paramārthavidaḥ kecid ūcuḥ praṇavarūpiṇam vijñānamiti viprendrāḥ śrutvā śrutiśirasyajam
verses.translation: O leading brahmins, persons who know reality reco- gnize the lord in the form of the Pranava, Vijhana (perfect knowledge), after hearing about the unborn lord in the Veda- ntic treatises.
verses.hindi: केवलं चापि शुद्धान्नमाढकं तण्डुलं पचेत्। कृत्वा प्रदक्षिणं चान्ते नमस्कृत्य मुहुर्मुहुः
verses.wordMeaning: O leading brahmins, persons who know reality reco- gnize the lord in the form of the Pranava, Vijhana (perfect knowledge), after hearing about the unborn lord in the Veda- ntic treatises.
verses.commentary: Sense: O leading brahmins, persons who know reality reco- gnize the lord in the form of the Pranava, Vijhana (perfect knowledge), after hearing about the unborn lord in the Veda- ntic treatises.

verses.sanskrit: शब्दादिविषयं ज्ञानं ज्ञानमित्यभिधीयते तज्ज्ञानं भ्रान्तिरहितम् इत्यन्ये नेति चापरे
verses.transliteration: śabdādiviṣayaṃ jñānaṃ jñānamityabhidhīyate tajjñānaṃ bhrāntirahitam ityanye neti cāpare
verses.translation: The knowledge that has sound, etc. for its object is called Jnana. Others say that jnana is devoid of Error. Still others say that it is not so.
verses.hindi: स्तुत्वा च देवमीशानं पुनः सम्पूज्य शङ्करम्। ईशानं पुरुषं चैव अघोरं वाममेव च अनेन विधिना देवः प्रसीदति महेश्वरः
verses.wordMeaning: The knowledge that has sound, etc. for its object is called Jnana. Others say that jnana is devoid of Error. Still others say that it is not so.
verses.commentary: Sense: The knowledge that has sound, etc. for its object is called Jnana. Others say that jnana is devoid of Error. Still others say that it is not so.

verses.sanskrit: यज्ज्ञानं निर्मलं शुद्धं निर्विकल्पं निराश्रयम् गुरुप्रकाशकं ज्ञानम् इत्यन्ये मुनयो द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: yajjñānaṃ nirmalaṃ śuddhaṃ nirvikalpaṃ nirāśrayam guruprakāśakaṃ jñānam ityanye munayo dvijāḥ
verses.translation: O brahmins, some sages say that knowledge which is pure, devoid of impurities, has no alternatives as objects and docs not require a support and is made manifest through a teacher, is the real one.
verses.hindi: वृक्षाः पुष्पादिपत्राद्यैरुपयुक्ताः शिवार्चने। गावश्चैव द्विजश्रेष्ठाः प्रयान्ति परमां गतिम्
verses.wordMeaning: O brahmins, some sages say that knowledge which is pure, devoid of impurities, has no alternatives as objects and docs not require a support and is made manifest through a teacher, is the real one.
verses.commentary: Sense: O brahmins, some sages say that knowledge which is pure, devoid of impurities, has no alternatives as objects and docs not require a support and is made manifest through a teacher, is the real one.

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञानेनैव भवेन्मुक्तिः प्रसादो ज्ञानसिद्धये उभाभ्यां मुच्यते योगी तत्रानन्दमयो भवेत्
verses.transliteration: jñānenaiva bhavenmuktiḥ prasādo jñānasiddhaye ubhābhyāṃ mucyate yogī tatrānandamayo bhavet
verses.translation: Salvation results only from perfect knowledge. Grace of the lord is conducive to the achievement of perfect knowledge.
verses.hindi: पूजयेद्यः शिवं रुद्रं शर्वं भवमजं सकृत्। स याति शिवसायुज्यं पुनरावृत्तिवर्जितम् सकृत्प्रसङ्घाद्वा दृष्ट्वा सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते
verses.wordMeaning: Salvation results only from perfect knowledge. Grace of the lord is conducive to the achievement of perfect knowledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: Salvation results only from perfect knowledge. Grace of the lord is conducive to the achievement of perfect knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: वदन्ति मुनयः केचित् कर्मणा तस्य संगतिम् कल्पनाकल्पितं रूपं संहृत्य स्वेच्छयैव हि
verses.transliteration: vadanti munayaḥ kecit karmaṇā tasya saṃgatim kalpanākalpitaṃ rūpaṃ saṃhṛtya svecchayaiva hi
verses.translation: Some sages say that His contact can be acquired by means of holy rites. By one's own free will, the form that is conceived fancifully shall be withdrawn.
verses.hindi: पूजितं वा महादेवं पूज्यमानमथापि वा। दृष्ट्वा प्रयाति वै मर्त्यो ब्रह्मलोकं न संशयः
verses.wordMeaning: Some sages say that His contact can be acquired by means of holy rites. By one's own free will, the form that is conceived fancifully shall be withdrawn.
verses.commentary: Sense: Some sages say that His contact can be acquired by means of holy rites. By one's own free will, the form that is conceived fancifully shall be withdrawn.

verses.sanskrit: द्यौर्मूर्धा तु विभोस्तस्य खं नाभिः परमेष्ठिनः सोमसूर्याग्नयो नेत्रे दिशः श्रोत्रं महात्मनः
verses.transliteration: dyaurmūrdhā tu vibhostasya khaṃ nābhiḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ somasūryāgnayo netre diśaḥ śrotraṃ mahātmanaḥ
verses.translation: The heaven is the head of Lord, the sky® is his umbilicus, the moon, sun and fire are his eyes, the quarters are his cars. The nether worlds constitute his feet, the ocean is his cloth, Devas are his arms, the constellations are his ornaments, Prakrti is his wife, Purusa is his Litiga. From his facc®®' issued forth all the Brahmins, Brahma, Indra, and Visnu. The Ksatri- yas issued from his arms. The Vaiyas issued from his thighs and Sudras from his feet. Puskara Avartaka and other clouds are his hairs. The winds are born of his nose. The Sruti and Smrti texts constitute his gait.
verses.hindi: यो दद्याद् घृतदीपं च सकृल्लिङ्गस्य चाग्रतः दीपवृक्षं पार्थिवं वा दारवं वा शिवालये
verses.wordMeaning: The heaven is the head of Lord, the sky® is his umbilicus, the moon, sun and fire are his eyes, the quarters are his cars. The nether worlds constitute his feet, the ocean is his cloth, Devas are his arms, the constellations are his ornaments, Prakrti is his wife,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The heaven is the head of Lord, the sky® is his umbilicus, the moon, sun and fire are his eyes, the quarters are his cars. The nether worlds constitute his feet, the ocean is his cloth, Devas are his arms, the constellations are his ornaments, Prakrti is his wife,…

verses.sanskrit: चरणौ चैव पातालं समुद्रस्तस्य चांबरम् देवास्तस्य भुजाः सर्वे नक्षत्राणि च भूषणम्
verses.transliteration: caraṇau caiva pātālaṃ samudrastasya cāṃbaram devāstasya bhujāḥ sarve nakṣatrāṇi ca bhūṣaṇam
verses.translation: The lord in the form of Karman makes Prakrti function by means of this cosmic body. The glorious Purusa is compre- hensible to man through perfect knowledge, not otherwise.
verses.hindi: पूजन करना चाहिए; पुनः रोचन आदिसे पूजन करके दिव्य पुष्पो, अखण्ड बिल्वपत्रो, अनेक प्रकारके पदो नीलकमलों, रक्तकमलों, नन्द्यावर्तपुष्पो, मल्लिका, चम्पक जातिपुष्पों, बकुलों, कनैरके पुष्पों, शमीपुष्पों, बृहत्पुष्पों
verses.wordMeaning: The lord in the form of Karman makes Prakrti function by means of this cosmic body. The glorious Purusa is compre- hensible to man through perfect knowledge, not otherwise.
verses.commentary: Sense: The lord in the form of Karman makes Prakrti function by means of this cosmic body. The glorious Purusa is compre- hensible to man through perfect knowledge, not otherwise.

verses.sanskrit: प्रकृतिस्तस्य पत्नी च पुरुषो लिङ्गमुच्यते वक्त्राद्वै ब्राह्मणाः सर्वे ब्रह्मा च भगवान्प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: prakṛtistasya patnī ca puruṣo liṅgamucyate vaktrādvai brāhmaṇāḥ sarve brahmā ca bhagavānprabhuḥ
verses.translation: Tapoyajna (sacrifice in the form of austerity) is superior to thousands of Karmayajnas (sacrifice in the form of holy rites). Japayajna (sacrifice in the form of Japa) is superior to thousands of Tapoyajnas. Dliyanayajha (sacrifice in the form of meditation) is superior to thousands of Japayajiias. There is nothing greater than Dhyanayajfia. Dhyana (meditation) is a means of perfect knowledge.
verses.hindi: धतूरके पुष्पों, अगस्त्यके उदित होनेपर खिलनेवाले पुग्यो, अपामार्ग-कदम्बके गुच्छों तथा सुन्दर आभूषणोंसे पूजन करके पाँच प्रकारके धूप प्रदान करके पायस (खीर) निवेदित करना चाहिए। तदनन्तर दधिमिश्रित भात, मधु- घृत मिला हुआ भात, पका हुआ अन्न और मूँगका पका हुआ अन्न--यह छः प्रकारका अन्न निवेदित करे; अथवा पाँच प्रकारका घृतमिश्रित अन्न निवेदित करे; अथवा केवल एक आढ़क (चार प्रस्थ) शुद्ध चावल पकाये
verses.wordMeaning: Tapoyajna (sacrifice in the form of austerity) is superior to thousands of Karmayajnas (sacrifice in the form of holy rites). Japayajna (sacrifice in the form of Japa) is superior to thousands of Tapoyajnas.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Tapoyajna (sacrifice in the form of austerity) is superior to thousands of Karmayajnas (sacrifice in the form of holy rites). Japayajna (sacrifice in the form of Japa) is superior to thousands of Tapoyajnas.…

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रोपेन्द्रौ भुजाभ्यां तु क्षत्रियाश् च महात्मनः वैश्याश्चोरुप्रदेशात्तु शूद्राः पादात्पिनाकिनः
verses.transliteration: indropendrau bhujābhyāṃ tu kṣatriyāś ca mahātmanaḥ vaiśyāścorupradeśāttu śūdrāḥ pādātpinākinaḥ
verses.translation: When the yogin stands firmly by equal elegance and sees through meditation, when he is engaged in the Dhyana- yajfta, Siva becomes manifest in him.
verses.hindi: और उसे निवेदित करे। अन्तमें प्रदक्षिणा करके बार- बार नमस्कारकर देवता ईशानकी स्तुति करके पुनः शंकरजीको विधिवत् पूजा करके ईशान, तत्पुरुष, अघोर, वामदेव तथा सद्योजात मन्त्रोंका जप करते हुए इन पाँच
verses.wordMeaning: When the yogin stands firmly by equal elegance and sees through meditation, when he is engaged in the Dhyana- yajfta, Siva becomes manifest in him.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the yogin stands firmly by equal elegance and sees through meditation, when he is engaged in the Dhyana- yajfta, Siva becomes manifest in him.

verses.sanskrit: पुष्करावर्तकाद्यास्तु केशास्तस्य प्रकीर्तिताः वायवो घ्राणजास्तस्य गतिः श्रौतं स्मृतिस् तथा
verses.transliteration: puṣkarāvartakādyāstu keśāstasya prakīrtitāḥ vāyavo ghrāṇajāstasya gatiḥ śrautaṃ smṛtis tathā
verses.translation: All people conversant with the knowledge of Brahman are pure, thanks to that Vidya. There is no expiatory rite or any injunction in regard to VijnSnins (knowers); nor do they have purificatory rites.
verses.hindi: देव महेश्वर प्रसन्न होते हैं॥ १०--२२॥ हे श्रेष्ठ द्विजो! शिवपूजनमें उपयोग किये गये पुष्प, पत्र आदिके साथ वृक्ष और गायें-ये सब परम गतिको प्राप्त होते हैं। जो एक बार भी शिव, रुद्र, शर्व, भव, अजको पूजा करता है; वह पुनर्जन्मरहित शिवसायुज्यको
verses.wordMeaning: All people conversant with the knowledge of Brahman are pure, thanks to that Vidya. There is no expiatory rite or any injunction in regard to VijnSnins (knowers); nor do they have purificatory rites.
verses.commentary: Sense: All people conversant with the knowledge of Brahman are pure, thanks to that Vidya. There is no expiatory rite or any injunction in regard to VijnSnins (knowers); nor do they have purificatory rites.

verses.sanskrit: अथानेनैव कर्मात्मा प्रकृतेस्तु प्रवर्तकः पुंसां तु पुरुषः श्रीमान् ज्ञानगम्यो न चान्यथा
verses.transliteration: athānenaiva karmātmā prakṛtestu pravartakaḥ puṃsāṃ tu puruṣaḥ śrīmān jñānagamyo na cānyathā
verses.translation: The divine origin of society and its division into four classes, viz. BrShmana Katriya, Vaiiya and Scdra. can be traced as far back as the Puru-sCikta of the figvida.
verses.hindi: प्राप्त कर लेता है। एक बार अथवा प्रसंगवश भी पूजित परमेश्वर, भव, उमापतिका दर्शन करके मनुष्य सभी पापोंसे मुक्त हो जाता है। पूजित किये गये अथवा पूर्जित होते हुए महादेवका दर्शनकर मनुष्य ब्रह्मलोकको जाता
verses.wordMeaning: The divine origin of society and its division into four classes, viz. BrShmana Katriya, Vaiiya and Scdra. can be traced as far back as the Puru-sCikta of the figvida.
verses.commentary: Sense: The divine origin of society and its division into four classes, viz. BrShmana Katriya, Vaiiya and Scdra. can be traced as far back as the Puru-sCikta of the figvida.

verses.sanskrit: कर्मयज्ञसहस्रेभ्यस् तपोयज्ञो विशिष्यते तपोयज्ञसहस्रेभ्यो जपयज्ञो विशिष्यते
verses.transliteration: karmayajñasahasrebhyas tapoyajño viśiṣyate tapoyajñasahasrebhyo japayajño viśiṣyate
verses.translation: The Lihga is pure, auspicious and imperishable. It is exceedingly blissful in nature. The Niskala form, that is, the form devoid of attributes is all-pervasive. It is always stationed in the heart of yogins.
verses.hindi: है; इसमें सन्देह नहीं है॥ २३--२६ ॥ जो शिवके सम्बन्धमें कुछ भी सुनकर उसकी अनुमोदन करता है, वह परमगति प्राप्त करता हैं। जौ शिवके समक्ष एक बार भी घृतका दीपक अर्पित करता है, वह वर्णाश्रमी लोगोंके लिये दुर्लभ स्थिर गति प्रात
verses.wordMeaning: The Lihga is pure, auspicious and imperishable. It is exceedingly blissful in nature. The Niskala form, that is, the form devoid of attributes is all-pervasive. It is always stationed in the heart of yogins.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Lihga is pure, auspicious and imperishable. It is exceedingly blissful in nature. The Niskala form, that is, the form devoid of attributes is all-pervasive. It is always stationed in the heart of yogins.

verses.sanskrit: जपयज्ञसहस्रेभ्यो ध्यानयज्ञो विशिष्यते ध्यानयज्ञात्परो नास्ति ध्यानं ज्ञानस्य साधनम्
verses.transliteration: japayajñasahasrebhyo dhyānayajño viśiṣyate dhyānayajñātparo nāsti dhyānaṃ jñānasya sādhanam
verses.translation: O brahmins, they say that the Lihga is of two tyi)cs viz., — the external and the internal. O excellent sage.s, the gross one is the external. O brahmins, the subtle one is the internal. [So are the devotees].
verses.hindi: अध्याय ८० देवताओंका
verses.wordMeaning: O brahmins, they say that the Lihga is of two tyi)cs viz., — the external and the internal. O excellent sage.s, the gross one is the external. O brahmins, the subtle one is the internal. [So are the devotees].
verses.commentary: Sense: O brahmins, they say that the Lihga is of two tyi)cs viz., — the external and the internal. O excellent sage.s, the gross one is the external. O brahmins, the subtle one is the internal. [So are the devotees].

verses.sanskrit: यदा समरसे निष्ठो योगी ध्यानेन पश्यति ध्यानयज्ञरतस्यास्य तदा संनिहितः शिवः
verses.transliteration: yadā samarase niṣṭho yogī dhyānena paśyati dhyānayajñaratasyāsya tadā saṃnihitaḥ śivaḥ
verses.translation: The gross devotees are tliosc engaged in the worship of gross Liagas and interested in holy rites and sacrifices. The gross idol is just for awakening knowledge of the gross devotees.®®
verses.hindi: कैलासपुरी आकर उमासहित भगवान् शिवके दर्शन करना दत्त्वा कुलशतं साग्रं शिवलोके महीयते। आयसं ताम्रजं वापि रौप्यं सौवर्णिकं तथा
verses.wordMeaning: The gross devotees are tliosc engaged in the worship of gross Liagas and interested in holy rites and sacrifices. The gross idol is just for awakening knowledge of the gross devotees.®®
verses.commentary: Sense: The gross devotees are tliosc engaged in the worship of gross Liagas and interested in holy rites and sacrifices. The gross idol is just for awakening knowledge of the gross devotees.®®

verses.sanskrit: नास्ति विज्ञानिनां शौचं प्रायश्चित्तादि चोदना विशुद्धा विद्यया सर्वे ब्रह्मविद्याविदो जनाः
verses.transliteration: nāsti vijñānināṃ śaucaṃ prāyaścittādi codanā viśuddhā vidyayā sarve brahmavidyāvido janāḥ
verses.translation: The spiritual lihga is not perceptible to the delud- ed person who conceives things only externally and not other- wise. The gross lihga made of clay, wood, etc., is perceptible only to non-yogin as the subtle and eternal Ihhga is perceptible to thejhanin.
verses.hindi: शिवाय दीपं यो दद्याद्विधिना वापि भक्तित: । सूर्यायुतसमैः श्लक्ष्णैर्यानैः शिवपुरं व्रजेत्
verses.wordMeaning: The spiritual lihga is not perceptible to the delud- ed person who conceives things only externally and not other- wise. The gross lihga made of clay, wood, etc., is perceptible only to non-yogin as the subtle and eternal Ihhga is perceptible to thejhanin.
verses.commentary: Sense: The spiritual lihga is not perceptible to the delud- ed person who conceives things only externally and not other- wise. The gross lihga made of clay, wood, etc., is perceptible only to non-yogin as the subtle and eternal Ihhga is perceptible to thejhanin.

verses.sanskrit: नास्ति क्रिया च लोकेषु सुखं दुःखं विचारतः धर्माधर्मौ जपो होमो ध्यानिनां संनिधिः सदा
verses.transliteration: nāsti kriyā ca lokeṣu sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ vicārataḥ dharmādharmau japo homo dhyānināṃ saṃnidhiḥ sadā
verses.translation: Other knowers of reality say that the object, on consi- deration, is non-existent.®® Therefore, everything, the Niskala and the Sakai a is of the nature of 6iva.
verses.hindi: कार्तिके मासि यो दद्याद् घृतदीपं शिवाग्रतः। सम्पूज्यमानं वा पश्येद्विधिना परमेश्वरम् स याति ब्रह्मणो लोकं श्रद्धया मुनिसत्तमाः। आवाहनं सुसान्निध्यं स्थापनं पूजनं तथा
verses.wordMeaning: Other knowers of reality say that the object, on consi- deration, is non-existent.®® Therefore, everything, the Niskala and the Sakai a is of the nature of 6iva.
verses.commentary: Sense: Other knowers of reality say that the object, on consi- deration, is non-existent.®® Therefore, everything, the Niskala and the Sakai a is of the nature of 6iva.

verses.sanskrit: परानन्दात्मकं लिङ्गं विशुद्धं शिवमक्षरम् निष्कलं सर्वगं ज्ञेयं योगिनां हृदि संस्थितम्
verses.transliteration: parānandātmakaṃ liṅgaṃ viśuddhaṃ śivamakṣaram niṣkalaṃ sarvagaṃ jñeyaṃ yogināṃ hṛdi saṃsthitam
verses.translation: Others say like this, O men of good holy rites — Al- though the ether is one, it is perceived separately in regard to separate platters. Similarly Siva has separateness as well as non- separateness,
verses.hindi: सम्प्रोक्तं रुद्रगायत्र्या आसनं प्रणवेन वै। पञ्चभिः स्नपनं प्रोक्तं रुद्राद्यैशच विशेषतः
verses.wordMeaning: Others say like this, O men of good holy rites — Al- though the ether is one, it is perceived separately in regard to separate platters. Similarly Siva has separateness as well as non- separateness,
verses.commentary: Sense: Others say like this, O men of good holy rites — Al- though the ether is one, it is perceived separately in regard to separate platters. Similarly Siva has separateness as well as non- separateness,

verses.sanskrit: लिङ्गं तु द्विविधं प्राहुर् बाह्यमाभ्यन्तरं द्विजाः बाह्यं स्थूलं मुनिश्रेष्ठाः सूक्ष्ममाभ्यन्तरं द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: liṅgaṃ tu dvividhaṃ prāhur bāhyamābhyantaraṃ dvijāḥ bāhyaṃ sthūlaṃ muniśreṣṭhāḥ sūkṣmamābhyantaraṃ dvijāḥ
verses.translation: O men of good holy rites, though the sun is only one he is seen manifold in the diflerent water-reservoirs. This example is cited in order to convince the people.
verses.hindi: एवं सम्पूजयेन्नित्यं देवदेवमुमापतिम्। ब्रह्माणं दक्षिणे तस्य प्रणवेन समर्चयेत् उत्तरे देवदेवेशं विष्णुं गायत्रिया यजेत्। वह्नौ हुत्वा यथान्यायं पञ्चभिः प्रणवेन च
verses.wordMeaning: O men of good holy rites, though the sun is only one he is seen manifold in the diflerent water-reservoirs. This example is cited in order to convince the people.
verses.commentary: Sense: O men of good holy rites, though the sun is only one he is seen manifold in the diflerent water-reservoirs. This example is cited in order to convince the people.

verses.sanskrit: कर्मयज्ञरताः स्थूलाः स्थूललिङ्गार्चने रताः असतां भावनार्थाय नान्यथा स्थूलविग्रहः
verses.transliteration: karmayajñaratāḥ sthūlāḥ sthūlaliṅgārcane ratāḥ asatāṃ bhāvanārthāya nānyathā sthūlavigrahaḥ
verses.translation: I'he creatures in the heaven and on the earth arc evolved out of the five elements. Still they are seen in multiples of forms as different species and individuals.
verses.hindi: स याति शिवसायुज्यमेवं सम्पूज्य शङ्करम्। इति सङ्क्षेपतः प्रोक्तो लिङ्गार्चनविधिक्रमः
verses.wordMeaning: I'he creatures in the heaven and on the earth arc evolved out of the five elements. Still they are seen in multiples of forms as different species and individuals.
verses.commentary: Sense: I'he creatures in the heaven and on the earth arc evolved out of the five elements. Still they are seen in multiples of forms as different species and individuals.

verses.sanskrit: आध्यात्मिकं च यल्लिङ्गं प्रत्यक्षं यस्य नो भवेत् असौ मूढो बहिः सर्वं कल्पयित्वैव नान्यथा
verses.transliteration: ādhyātmikaṃ ca yalliṅgaṃ pratyakṣaṃ yasya no bhavet asau mūḍho bahiḥ sarvaṃ kalpayitvaiva nānyathā
verses.translation: The gross (lihga) form of the su[>reme lord iva is meant just to create a feeling of devotion in the gross-minded people. In fact, lord Siva (like the ether) is an indivisible entity. His division into sakala and niskala forms, as of the ether into ghatkaSa and mathakaia is conditioned byexternsd factors.
verses.hindi: व्यासेन कथितः पूर्व श्रुत्वा रुद्रमुखात्स्वयम् करता है। शिवालयमें मिट्टी अथवा लकड़ीका बना हुआ दीपवृक्ष (दीवट) प्रदान करके मनुष्य आगेके सौ कुलोंसहित शिवलोकमें प्रतिष्ठा प्राप्त करता है। जो विधानके अनुसार भक्तिपूर्वक लोहे, ताँबे, चाँदी अथवा
verses.wordMeaning: The gross (lihga) form of the su[>reme lord iva is meant just to create a feeling of devotion in the gross-minded people. In fact, lord Siva (like the ether) is an indivisible entity. His division into sakala and niskala forms,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The gross (lihga) form of the su[>reme lord iva is meant just to create a feeling of devotion in the gross-minded people. In fact, lord Siva (like the ether) is an indivisible entity. His division into sakala and niskala forms,…

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञानिनां सूक्ष्मममलं भवेत्प्रत्यक्षमव्ययम् यथा स्थूलमयुक्तानां मृत्काष्ठाद्यैः प्रकल्पितम्
verses.transliteration: jñānināṃ sūkṣmamamalaṃ bhavetpratyakṣamavyayam yathā sthūlamayuktānāṃ mṛtkāṣṭhādyaiḥ prakalpitam
verses.translation: Know that whatever is seen or heard is identical with Siva. The difference among the people, on deliberation, is mere illusion.
verses.hindi: सोनेका बना हुआ दीपक शिवको समर्पित करता है, वह दस हजार सूर्योके समान देदीप्यमान विमानोंसे शिवलोकको जाता है। है श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! जो कार्तिक महीनेमें शिवके सामने घृतका दीपक समर्पित करता है
verses.wordMeaning: Know that whatever is seen or heard is identical with Siva. The difference among the people, on deliberation, is mere illusion.
verses.commentary: Sense: Know that whatever is seen or heard is identical with Siva. The difference among the people, on deliberation, is mere illusion.

verses.sanskrit: अर्थो विचारतो नास्तीत्य् अन्ये तत्त्वार्थवेदिनः निष्कलः सकलश्चेति सर्वं शिवमयं ततः
verses.transliteration: artho vicārato nāstīty anye tattvārthavedinaḥ niṣkalaḥ sakalaśceti sarvaṃ śivamayaṃ tataḥ
verses.translation: After experiencing extensive pleasures in dream a man may be happy or miserable. But on pondering we understand that neither the pleasure nor the misery has been really expe- rienced.
verses.hindi: अथवा विधानके साथ पूजित होते हुए परमेश्वरका दर्शन श्रद्धापूर्वक करता है, वह ब्रह्मलोकको जाता है॥ २७३१/२ ॥ शिवका आवाहन, उत्तम सान्निध्य, स्थापन तथा पूजन रुद्रगायत्री मन्त्र-द्वारा और आसन प्रणव- द्वारा बताया गया है। सद्योजात आदि पाँच मन्त्रोंसे तथा विशेषरूपसे रुद्रमन्त्रोंसे उनका स्नान बताया गया
verses.wordMeaning: After experiencing extensive pleasures in dream a man may be happy or miserable. But on pondering we understand that neither the pleasure nor the misery has been really expe- rienced.
verses.commentary: Sense: After experiencing extensive pleasures in dream a man may be happy or miserable. But on pondering we understand that neither the pleasure nor the misery has been really expe- rienced.

verses.sanskrit: व्योमैकमपि दृष्टं हि शरावं प्रति सुव्रताः पृथक्त्वं चापृथक्त्वं च शङ्करस्येति चापरे
verses.transliteration: vyomaikamapi dṛṣṭaṃ hi śarāvaṃ prati suvratāḥ pṛthaktvaṃ cāpṛthaktvaṃ ca śaṅkarasyeti cāpare
verses.translation: All those who have understood the real meanings of the Vedas also speak thus in regard to w'orldly matters. The great lord invested with attributes is directly perceptible in the hearts of the worldly-minded persons. The lord devoid of attributes appears in the hearts of yogins and is identical with the universe. He appears to the wise ones only. Ihe physical body of the great lord is of three types.
verses.hindi: है। इस प्रकार देवदेव उमापतिकी पूजा नित्य करे। उनके दक्षिणमें ब्रह्माकी पूजा प्रणवसे करे और उत्तरमें देवदेवेश विष्णुकी पूजा गायत्री मन्त्र-से करे। विधिके अनुसार सद्योजात आदि पाँच मन्त्रोसे तथा प्रणवसे
verses.wordMeaning: All those who have understood the real meanings of the Vedas also speak thus in regard to w'orldly matters. The great lord invested with attributes is directly perceptible in the hearts of the worldly-minded persons.…
verses.commentary: Sense: All those who have understood the real meanings of the Vedas also speak thus in regard to w'orldly matters. The great lord invested with attributes is directly perceptible in the hearts of the worldly-minded persons.…

verses.sanskrit: प्रत्ययार्थं हि जगताम् एकस्थो ऽपि दिवाकरः एको ऽपि बहुधा दृष्टो जलाधारेषु सुव्रताः
verses.transliteration: pratyayārthaṃ hi jagatām ekastho 'pi divākaraḥ eko 'pi bahudhā dṛṣṭo jalādhāreṣu suvratāḥ
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, the first-one is Niskala, the second one is Sakala-Niskala and the third-one is Sakala.
verses.hindi: अग्निमें होम करे। इस प्रकार शंकरकी भलीभाँति पूजा करके वह मनुष्य शिवसायुज्य प्राप्त करता है। है ऋषियो! मैंने संक्षेपमें लिङ्गार्चनविधिका क्रम बता दिया; पहले स्वयं रुद्रके मुखसे इसे सुनकर व्यासजीने मुझको बताया था
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent brahmins, the first-one is Niskala, the second one is Sakala-Niskala and the third-one is Sakala.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent brahmins, the first-one is Niskala, the second one is Sakala-Niskala and the third-one is Sakala.

verses.sanskrit: जन्तवो दिवि भूमौ च सर्वे वै पाञ्चभौतिकाः तथापि बहुला दृष्टा जातिव्यक्तिविभेदतः
verses.transliteration: jantavo divi bhūmau ca sarve vai pāñcabhautikāḥ tathāpi bahulā dṛṣṭā jātivyaktivibhedataḥ
verses.translation: Some worship the Sakala-Niskala form, some wor- ship in the heart, or in the Lifiga or in the fire. Some worship the Sakala form along with their wives and sons.
verses.hindi: तथा भगवान् शिवद्वारा देवताओंको पाशुपतव्रतका उपदेश प्रदान करना
verses.wordMeaning: Some worship the Sakala-Niskala form, some wor- ship in the heart, or in the Lifiga or in the fire. Some worship the Sakala form along with their wives and sons.
verses.commentary: Sense: Some worship the Sakala-Niskala form, some wor- ship in the heart, or in the Lifiga or in the fire. Some worship the Sakala form along with their wives and sons.

verses.sanskrit: दृश्यते श्रूयते यद्यत् तत्तद्विद्धि शिवात्मकम् भेदो जनानां लोके ऽस्मिन् प्रतिभासो विचारतः
verses.transliteration: dṛśyate śrūyate yadyat tattadviddhi śivātmakam bhedo janānāṃ loke 'smin pratibhāso vicārataḥ
verses.translation: Just as Siva so also is the goddess. Just as the god- dess so also is Siva. Hence people worship the deities with the consciou.sness of mm- difference. They worship the twenty- seven*®® principles in the body as well as outside, in the mystic diagrams of four, six, ten angles, twelve, sixteen and three sides.
verses.hindi: कथं पशुपतिं दृष्ट्वा पशुपाशविमोक्षणम्। ऋषिगण बोले है सूतजी! पशुपतिका दर्शन करके पशुपाशसे मुक्ति किस प्रकार होती है; देवताओंने
verses.wordMeaning: Just as Siva so also is the goddess. Just as the god- dess so also is Siva. Hence people worship the deities with the consciou.sness of mm- difference. They worship the twenty- seven*®® principles in the body as well as outside, in the mystic diagrams of four, six, ten angles,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Just as Siva so also is the goddess. Just as the god- dess so also is Siva. Hence people worship the deities with the consciou.sness of mm- difference. They worship the twenty- seven*®® principles in the body as well as outside, in the mystic diagrams of four, six, ten angles,…

verses.sanskrit: स्वप्ने च विपुलान् भोगान् भुक्त्वा मर्त्यः सुखी भवेत् दुःखी च भोगं दुःखं च नानुभूतं विचारतः
verses.transliteration: svapne ca vipulān bhogān bhuktvā martyaḥ sukhī bhavet duḥkhī ca bhogaṃ duḥkhaṃ ca nānubhūtaṃ vicārataḥ
verses.translation: Siva, the lord, devoid of difference of Sat and Asat is stationed out of his own free will along with the goddess for the protection of the world.
verses.hindi: पशुत्वं तत्यजुर्देवास्तन्नो वक्तुमिहा्ह॑सि॥ १  पशुत्वका कैसे त्याग किया? इसे आप कृपा करके हम
verses.wordMeaning: Siva, the lord, devoid of difference of Sat and Asat is stationed out of his own free will along with the goddess for the protection of the world.
verses.commentary: Sense: Siva, the lord, devoid of difference of Sat and Asat is stationed out of his own free will along with the goddess for the protection of the world.

verses.sanskrit: एवमाहुस्तथान्ये च सर्वे वेदार्थतत्त्वगाः हृदि संसारिणां साक्षात् सकलः परमेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: evamāhustathānye ca sarve vedārthatattvagāḥ hṛdi saṃsāriṇāṃ sākṣāt sakalaḥ parameśvaraḥ
verses.translation: Some call him one, some call him one with two Gunas.*** Some call him Triguna**' (having three Gunas). Some say that it is Siva. Others, the knowers of the Vedas speak of him as the cause of the universe.
verses.hindi: सूतजी बोले पूर्वकालमें केलास-शिखरपर भोग्य समेत्य देवाः सर्वज्ञमाजग्मुस्तत्प्रसादतः॥ २  नामक अपने पुरमें स्थित सर्वज्ञ शिवके पास सभी देवता
verses.wordMeaning: Some call him one, some call him one with two Gunas.*** Some call him Triguna**' (having three Gunas). Some say that it is Siva. Others, the knowers of the Vedas speak of him as the cause of the universe.
verses.commentary: Sense: Some call him one, some call him one with two Gunas.*** Some call him Triguna**' (having three Gunas). Some say that it is Siva. Others, the knowers of the Vedas speak of him as the cause of the universe.

verses.sanskrit: योगिनां निष्कलो देवो ज्ञानिनां च जगन्मयः त्रिविधं परमेशस्य वपुर्लोके प्रशस्यते
verses.transliteration: yogināṃ niṣkalo devo jñānināṃ ca jaganmayaḥ trividhaṃ parameśasya vapurloke praśasyate
verses.translation: All Brahmins equipped with devotion and auspicious yoga are persons of special characteristics. They are interested
verses.hindi: श्रीलिड्रमहापुराण  पूर्वभाग
verses.wordMeaning: All Brahmins equipped with devotion and auspicious yoga are persons of special characteristics. They are interested
verses.commentary: Sense: All Brahmins equipped with devotion and auspicious yoga are persons of special characteristics. They are interested

verses.hindi: जगाम देवताभिर्वै देवदेवान्तिकं हरिः। सर्वे सम्प्राप्य देवस्य सार्धे गिरिवरं शुभम्

verses.sanskrit: सकलं मुनयः केचित् सदा संसारवर्तिनः एवमभ्यर्चयन्त्येव सदाराः ससुता नराः

verses.hindi: सेन्द्राः ससाध्याः सयमाः प्रणेमुर्गिरिमुत्तमम्। भगवान् वासुदेवोऽसौ गरुडाद् गरुडध्वजः । अवतीर्य गिरिं मेरुमारुरोह सुरोत्तमैः मुदितकुररवृन्दं नादितं नागवृन्हैः । मधुररणितगीतं सानुकूलान्धकारं पदरचितवनान्तं कान्तवातान्ततोयम्

verses.hindi: लॅलितगतिविदग्धैर्हसवृन्हैश्च भिन्नम्।

verses.transliteration: yajanti dehe bāhye ca catuṣkoṇe ṣaḍasrake daśāre dvādaśāre ca ṣoḍaśāre trirasrake
verses.translation: Those who perceive Siva in the three-sided (mystic diagram), in the middle of the three principles, attain him; not the other yogins. They perceive the three-eyed*** lord with the three Guijas, ihe ancient Puru§a along with the goddess.
verses.hindi: हिंजवरगणवृन्हैः कोकिलाद्यैद्वरिफेः गिरेः पृष्ठे पुरं शार्वं कल्पितं विश्वकर्मणा। क्रीडार्थं देवदेवस्य भवस्य परमेष्ठिनः
verses.wordMeaning: Those who perceive Siva in the three-sided (mystic diagram), in the middle of the three principles, attain him; not the other yogins. They perceive the three-eyed*** lord with the three Guijas, ihe ancient Puru§a along with the goddess.

verses.sanskrit: स स्वेच्छया शिवः साक्षाद् देव्या सार्धं स्थितः प्रभुः संतारणार्थं च शिवः सदसद्व्यक्तिवर्जितः

verses.sanskrit: तमेकमाहुर्द्विगुणं च केचित् केचित्तमाहुस्त्रिगुणात्मकं च ऊचुस् तथा तं च शिवं तथान्ये संसारिणं वेदविदो वदन्ति

verses.hindi: मेरुप्रभागे पुरमादिदेवः उनकी कृपासे एक साथ मिलकर आये  सभी देवताओंके हितके लिये जनार्दन पुरुषोत्तम विष्णु भी गरुडके स्कन्धपर बैठकर ब्रह्मा प तथा सभी देवताओंके साथ देवदेव शिवके पास पहुँचे॥ २-३ /२॥
