verses.sanskrit: भक्त्या च योगेन शुभेन युक्ता विप्राः सदा धर्मरता विशिष्टाः यजन्ति योगेशम् अशेषमूर्तिं षडस्रमध्ये भगवन्तमेव
verses.transliteration: bhaktyā ca yogena śubhena yuktā viprāḥ sadā dharmaratā viśiṣṭāḥ yajanti yogeśam aśeṣamūrtiṃ ṣaḍasramadhye bhagavantameva
verses.translation: Those who perceive Siva in the three-sided (mystic diagram), in the middle of the three principles, attain him; not the other yogins. They perceive the three-eyed*** lord with the three Guijas, ihe ancient Puru§a along with the goddess.
verses.hindi: साथ शिवके गिरिश्रेष्ठ, शुभ तथा उत्तम पर्वतश्रेष्ठ मेरुपर आकर उस गिरिको प्रणाम किया। वे गरुड्ध्वज भगवान् वासुदेव गरुड़से उतरकर उत्तम देवताओंके साथ मेरु पर्वतपर चढ़ गये; वह समस्त पापोंसे रहित,
verses.wordMeaning: Those who perceive Siva in the three-sided (mystic diagram), in the middle of the three principles, attain him; not the other yogins. They perceive the three-eyed*** lord with the three Guijas, ihe ancient Puru§a along with the goddess.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who perceive Siva in the three-sided (mystic diagram), in the middle of the three principles, attain him; not the other yogins. They perceive the three-eyed*** lord with the three Guijas, ihe ancient Puru§a along with the goddess.

verses.sanskrit: ये तत्र पश्यन्ति शिवं त्रिरस्रे त्रितत्त्वमध्ये त्रिगुणं त्रियक्षम् ते यान्ति चैनं न च योगिनो ऽन्ये तया च देव्या पुरुषं पुराणम्
verses.transliteration: ye tatra paśyanti śivaṃ trirasre tritattvamadhye triguṇaṃ triyakṣam te yānti cainaṃ na ca yogino 'nye tayā ca devyā puruṣaṃ purāṇam
verses.translation: Those who perceive Siva in the three-sided (mystic diagram), in the middle of the three principles, attain him; not the other yogins. They perceive the three-eyed*** lord with the three Guijas, ihe ancient Puru§a along with the goddess.
verses.hindi: सबकुछ देनेवाला, उत्तम भोगोंसे युक्त, आनन्दित कुर पक्षियोंसे समन्वित, हाथियोंकी ध्वनियोंसे निनादित, मधुर गीतोंसे गुंजित, अन्य पर्वतोंके पृष्ठभागको अपने छायारूपी अन्धकारसे युक्त करनेवाला, पदचिल्नोंसे युक्त वन-प्रदेशवाला, सुन्दर हवाओं तथा जलसे परिपूर्ण, सूर्यके समान प्रदीप्त सैकड़ों-हजारों भवनोंसे युक्त, मनोहर गतिवाले हंससमूहोंसे मण्डित, धव-खदिर- पलाश-चन्दन आदि वृक्षोंसे परिपूर्ण, उत्तम पक्षियोंके
verses.wordMeaning: Those who perceive Siva in the three-sided (mystic diagram), in the middle of the three principles, attain him; not the other yogins. They perceive the three-eyed*** lord with the three Guijas, ihe ancient Puru§a along with the goddess.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who perceive Siva in the three-sided (mystic diagram), in the middle of the three principles, attain him; not the other yogins. They perceive the three-eyed*** lord with the three Guijas, ihe ancient Puru§a along with the goddess.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीलिङ्गमहापुराणे पूर्वभागे शिवाद्वैतकथनं नाम पञ्चसप्ततितमो ऽध्यायः अतः परं प्रवक्ष्यामि स्वेच्छाविग्रहसंभवम् प्रतिष्ठायाः फलं सर्वं सर्वलोकहिताय वै
verses.transliteration: iti śrīliṅgamahāpurāṇe pūrvabhāge śivādvaitakathanaṃ nāma pañcasaptatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi svecchāvigrahasaṃbhavam pratiṣṭhāyāḥ phalaṃ sarvaṃ sarvalokahitāya vai
verses.translation: Henceforth, I shall mention the benefit accruing from the installation of the idol entirely, for the welfare of the world. The idol may be in accordance with one's own wish.
verses.hindi: समूहोंसे युक्त, कोकिल आदि तथा भौंरोंसे शोभायमान, कहीं-कहीं बहुत-से दिव्य वृक्षोंसे भरा हुआ, कुरबकः प्रियक-तिलक पुष्पवृक्षोंसे सम्पन्न, बहुत-से कदम्बः तमाल-लताओंसे घिरा हुआ तथा अनेक प्रकारके शिखरोंसे
verses.wordMeaning: Henceforth, I shall mention the benefit accruing from the installation of the idol entirely, for the welfare of the world. The idol may be in accordance with one's own wish.
verses.commentary: Sense: Henceforth, I shall mention the benefit accruing from the installation of the idol entirely, for the welfare of the world. The idol may be in accordance with one's own wish.

verses.sanskrit: स्कन्दोमासहितं देवम् आसीनं परमासने कृत्वा भक्त्या प्रतिष्ठाप्य सर्वान्कामानवाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: skandomāsahitaṃ devam āsīnaṃ paramāsane kṛtvā bhaktyā pratiṣṭhāpya sarvānkāmānavāpnuyāt
verses.translation: After making the idol of the lord seated in an elegant seat along with Skauda and Uma and after installing it with devotion one shall fulfil desires.
verses.hindi: युक्त श्रेष्ठ पर्वत है ॥ ४--८॥ इस पर्वतके पृष्ठपर देवदेव परमेश्वर शिवके विहारके लिये विश्वकर्माने एक शिवपुरका निर्माण किया है। इन्द्र तथा उपेन्द्रसहित सभी देवताओंने उस पुरको ध्यानपूर्वक देखा और शिवजीके प्रभावसे दसे
verses.wordMeaning: After making the idol of the lord seated in an elegant seat along with Skauda and Uma and after installing it with devotion one shall fulfil desires.
verses.commentary: Sense: After making the idol of the lord seated in an elegant seat along with Skauda and Uma and after installing it with devotion one shall fulfil desires.

verses.sanskrit: स्कन्दोमासहितं देवं सम्पूज्य विधिना सकृत् यत्फलं लभते मर्त्यस् तद्वदामि यथाश्रुतम्
verses.transliteration: skandomāsahitaṃ devaṃ sampūjya vidhinā sakṛt yatphalaṃ labhate martyas tadvadāmi yathāśrutam
verses.translation: In the manner I had heard, I shall mention the benefit that a man obtains by worshipping the lord along with Skanda and Uma (even) once (but) in accordance with the injunctions.
verses.hindi: ही उसे प्रणाम किया॥ ९-१०॥ हि
verses.wordMeaning: In the manner I had heard, I shall mention the benefit that a man obtains by worshipping the lord along with Skanda and Uma (even) once (but) in accordance with the injunctions.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the manner I had heard, I shall mention the benefit that a man obtains by worshipping the lord along with Skanda and Uma (even) once (but) in accordance with the injunctions.

verses.sanskrit: सूर्यकोटिप्रतिकाशैर् विमानैः सार्वकामिकैः रुद्रकन्यासमाकीर्णैर् गेयनाट्यसमन्वितैः
verses.transliteration: sūryakoṭipratikāśair vimānaiḥ sārvakāmikaiḥ rudrakanyāsamākīrṇair geyanāṭyasamanvitaiḥ
verses.translation: Until the dissolution of all living beings, he becomes a yogin and sports like Siva in aerial chariots resembling crores of suns wherein everything desirable is available and where virgins of Rudra sing and dance. In the aerial chariots where everything desirable is available he enjoys great pleasures. He then goes to the following worlds one after the other viz: — the world of Uma, of Kumara, of Mana, of Vispu, of Brahma and of Prajapati. The deity of great splendour passes through the Janaloka and Maharloka. After reaching the world of Indra he assumes the role of Indra for ten thousand years. Again, after enjoying divine and brilliant pleasure in the
verses.hindi: महात्मा आदिदेव विष्णु मेरुके एक भागम स्थित हजारों सूर्योके समान देदीप्यमान, हजारों तरहसे महान्, सभी गुणोंसे युक्त कैलासगिरिपर गये। तला ब्रह्मा तथा देवशत्रुओका विनाश करनेवाले विष्णु ३५ महान् पुरके द्वारपर पहुँचे; जो स्त्रियों, हाथियों, घोडी, अनेक रथों, गणों तथा गणेश्वरोंसे भरा हुआ था. महापर्वतके समान प्रतीत हो रहा था
verses.wordMeaning: Until the dissolution of all living beings, he becomes a yogin and sports like Siva in aerial chariots resembling crores of suns wherein everything desirable is available and where virgins of Rudra sing and dance.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Until the dissolution of all living beings, he becomes a yogin and sports like Siva in aerial chariots resembling crores of suns wherein everything desirable is available and where virgins of Rudra sing and dance.…

verses.sanskrit: शिववत्क्रीडते योगी यावदाभूतसंप्लवम् तत्र भुक्त्वा महाभोगान् विमानैः सार्वकामिकैः
verses.transliteration: śivavatkrīḍate yogī yāvadābhūtasaṃplavam tatra bhuktvā mahābhogān vimānaiḥ sārvakāmikaiḥ
verses.translation: One shall attain Sayujya (union) with Siva by duly installing the omniscient, omnipresent lord in accordance with the injunctions of the Sastras; the lord who has a single foot, four arms, three eyes and trident, the lord who is stationed after creating Vi§nu from his left side and the four-faced Brahma from the right side. The lord who created twenty eight crores of Rudras, and then the twenty fifth®*® principle Purua, brilliant in all the limbs, from his heart; the lord who created Prakrti from his left; cosmic intellect from the region of the intellect, the cosmic ego from his own ego and the Taiimatras therefrom. The great lord sportingly created the sense-organs from his own sense-organs. He created the earth from the root of his foot and water from the private parts. He created fire from the umbilical region, the sun from the heart, the moon from his neck, the soul from the middle of his eyebrows and the heaven from the forehead. One shall instal the image of the lord who is stationed thus after creating the entire universe inclusive of the mobile and immobile beings.
verses.hindi: विमानैर्विविधाकारैः प्राकारैश्च समावृतम्
verses.wordMeaning: One shall attain Sayujya (union) with Siva by duly installing the omniscient, omnipresent lord in accordance with the injunctions of the Sastras; the lord who has a single foot, four arms, three eyes and trident,…
verses.commentary: Sense: One shall attain Sayujya (union) with Siva by duly installing the omniscient, omnipresent lord in accordance with the injunctions of the Sastras; the lord who has a single foot, four arms, three eyes and trident,…

verses.sanskrit: औमं कौमारमैशानं वैष्णवं ब्राह्ममेव च प्राजापत्यं महातेजा जनलोकं महस् तथा
verses.transliteration: aumaṃ kaumāramaiśānaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ brāhmameva ca prājāpatyaṃ mahātejā janalokaṃ mahas tathā
verses.translation: By making the idol of Iana, the lord of the sacrifices®®, who has three feet, seven hands, four horns and two heads, the devotee is honoured in the world of Visnu.
verses.hindi: दृष्ट्वा शम्भोः पुरं बाह्यं देवैः सब्रह्मकैहरिः । द्वितीयं देवदेवस्य चतुर्द्वारं सुशोभनम्
verses.wordMeaning: By making the idol of Iana, the lord of the sacrifices®®, who has three feet, seven hands, four horns and two heads, the devotee is honoured in the world of Visnu.
verses.commentary: Sense: By making the idol of Iana, the lord of the sacrifices®®, who has three feet, seven hands, four horns and two heads, the devotee is honoured in the world of Visnu.

verses.sanskrit: ऐन्द्रम् आसाद्य चैन्द्रत्वं कृत्वा वर्षायुतं पुनः भुक्त्वा चैव भुवर्लोके भोगान् दिव्यान् सुशोभनान्
verses.transliteration: aindram āsādya caindratvaṃ kṛtvā varṣāyutaṃ punaḥ bhuktvā caiva bhuvarloke bhogān divyān suśobhanān
verses.translation: The man will enjoy great pleasures there for a hun- dred thousand kalpas. He shall be happy and in due course return to his world as master of all sacrifices.
verses.hindi: देवे्रभवनाकारैर्भवनेर्दूष्टिमोहनैः
verses.wordMeaning: The man will enjoy great pleasures there for a hun- dred thousand kalpas. He shall be happy and in due course return to his world as master of all sacrifices.
verses.commentary: Sense: The man will enjoy great pleasures there for a hun- dred thousand kalpas. He shall be happy and in due course return to his world as master of all sacrifices.

verses.sanskrit: मेरुमासाद्य देवानां भवनेषु प्रमोदते एकपादं चतुर्बाहुं त्रिनेत्रं शूलसंयुतम्
verses.transliteration: merumāsādya devānāṃ bhavaneṣu pramodate ekapādaṃ caturbāhuṃ trinetraṃ śūlasaṃyutam
verses.translation: If the devotee makes the idol of the lord who rides on a bull accompanied by Uma and with the crescent moon as his ornament, he attains that merit which one usually obtains by performing tex thousand horse-sacrifices. He goes to Siva's divine city in a golden aerial chariot having clusteis of tinkling bells and he is liberated there itself.
verses.hindi: करैस्तस्य हरेः समन्तात् प्रचिक्षिपुर्मूर्थनि यथा भवस्य दृष्ट्वा नार्यस्तदा विष्णुं मदाघूणितलोचनाः
verses.wordMeaning: If the devotee makes the idol of the lord who rides on a bull accompanied by Uma and with the crescent moon as his ornament, he attains that merit which one usually obtains by performing tex thousand horse-sacrifices.…
verses.commentary: Sense: If the devotee makes the idol of the lord who rides on a bull accompanied by Uma and with the crescent moon as his ornament, he attains that merit which one usually obtains by performing tex thousand horse-sacrifices.…

verses.sanskrit: सृष्ट्वा स्थितं हरिं वामे दक्षिणे चतुराननम् अष्टाविंशतिरुद्राणां कोटिः सर्वाङ्गसुप्रभम्
verses.transliteration: sṛṣṭvā sthitaṃ hariṃ vāme dakṣiṇe caturānanam aṣṭāviṃśatirudrāṇāṃ koṭiḥ sarvāṅgasuprabham
verses.translation: In the manner I have heard, I shall mention the benefit that one attains by making the idol of the lord accom- panied by Nandin and Uma and surrounded by all Ganas.
verses.hindi: काश्चिद् दृष्ट्वा हरि नार्यः किञ्चित््रहसिताननाः
verses.wordMeaning: In the manner I have heard, I shall mention the benefit that one attains by making the idol of the lord accom- panied by Nandin and Uma and surrounded by all Ganas.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the manner I have heard, I shall mention the benefit that one attains by making the idol of the lord accom- panied by Nandin and Uma and surrounded by all Ganas.

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चविंशतिकं साक्षात् पुरुषं हृदयात्तथा प्रकृतिं वामतश्चैव बुद्धिं वै बुद्धिदेशतः
verses.transliteration: pañcaviṃśatikaṃ sākṣāt puruṣaṃ hṛdayāttathā prakṛtiṃ vāmataścaiva buddhiṃ vai buddhideśataḥ
verses.translation: He will go to the city of Siva on the aerial chariots that resemble the solar sphere, that are tied to the bulls, tliat are difficult of access even to Devas and Danavas that are occupied and beautified all round by the dancing nymphs. He shall then attain the chieftainship of the Ganas.
verses.hindi: किञ्चिद्विस्रस्तवस्त्राशच स्रस्तकाञ्चीगुणा जगुः। चतुर्थं पञ्चमं चैव षष्ठं च सप्तमं तथा अतीत्यासाद्य देवस्य पुरं शम्भोः सुशोभनम्
verses.wordMeaning: He will go to the city of Siva on the aerial chariots that resemble the solar sphere, that are tied to the bulls, tliat are difficult of access even to Devas and Danavas that are occupied and beautified all round by the dancing nymphs.…
verses.commentary: Sense: He will go to the city of Siva on the aerial chariots that resemble the solar sphere, that are tied to the bulls, tliat are difficult of access even to Devas and Danavas that are occupied and beautified all round by the dancing nymphs.…

verses.sanskrit: अहङ्कारमहङ्कारात् तन्मात्राणि तु तत्र वै इन्द्रियाणीन्द्रियादेव लीलया परमेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: ahaṅkāramahaṅkārāt tanmātrāṇi tu tatra vai indriyāṇīndriyādeva līlayā parameśvaram
verses.translation: I shall mention the benefit that one attains by making any of the following idols of Siva and installing it with devotion viz: — the lord of the chiefs of Devas as in his dancing posture and accompanied by the daughter of the lord of mountains; the omniscient lord having a thousand arms or having four arms; lord Paramesvara surrounded by Bhrgu and others as well as the groups of goblins; the bull-bannered Ivara accom- panied by the daughter of the lord of mountain, the diety as perpetually being bowed to by Brahma, Indra, Visnu, Soma (the moon) and all other Devas; Paramesvara as surrounded by Mothers and sages. He shall attain a crorc times the benefit that accrues from all yajnas, penances, charitable gifts, pilgri- mages to the holy centres and visits to the deities. He shall then go to the region of auspiciousness.®' Until the dissolution of all living beings he shall enjoy great pleasure there. When the next creation arrives be shall return to the region of mortals.
verses.hindi: सूर्यमण्डलसङ्काशैर्विमानैश्च विभूषितम्
verses.wordMeaning: I shall mention the benefit that one attains by making any of the following idols of Siva and installing it with devotion viz: — the lord of the chiefs of Devas as in his dancing posture and accompanied by the daughter of the lord of mountains;…
verses.commentary: Sense: I shall mention the benefit that one attains by making any of the following idols of Siva and installing it with devotion viz: — the lord of the chiefs of Devas as in his dancing posture and accompanied by the daughter of the lord of mountains;…

verses.sanskrit: पृथिवीं पादमूलात्तु गुह्यदेशाज्जलं तथा नाभिदेशात् तथा वह्निं हृदयाद्भास्करं तथा
verses.transliteration: pṛthivīṃ pādamūlāttu guhyadeśājjalaṃ tathā nābhideśāt tathā vahniṃ hṛdayādbhāskaraṃ tathā
verses.translation: One shall attain identity with Siva by making the idol of Siva as follows and installing it with devotion; the lord as naked, white-complexioned, having four arms, three eyes and the serpent as girdle, with black curly hairs and holding a skull in his hand.
verses.hindi: प्राकारैर्विविधाकारैरष्टाविंशतिभिर्वृतम् । उपद्वारैर्महाद्वारैर्विदिक्षु विविधेर्दुढे: गुद्यालयैर्गुहागृहैर्गुहस्य भवनेः शुभैः। ग्राम्यैरन्यैर्महाभागा :
verses.wordMeaning: One shall attain identity with Siva by making the idol of Siva as follows and installing it with devotion; the lord as naked, white-complexioned, having four arms, three eyes and the serpent as girdle, with black curly hairs and holding a skull in his hand.
verses.commentary: Sense: One shall attain identity with Siva by making the idol of Siva as follows and installing it with devotion; the lord as naked, white-complexioned, having four arms, three eyes and the serpent as girdle, with black curly hairs and holding a skull in his hand.

verses.sanskrit: कण्ठात्सोमं तथात्मानं भ्रूमध्यान्मस्तकाद्दिवम् सृष्टैवं संस्थितं साक्षाज् जगत्सर्वं चराचरम्
verses.transliteration: kaṇṭhātsomaṃ tathātmānaṃ bhrūmadhyānmastakāddivam sṛṣṭaivaṃ saṃsthitaṃ sākṣāj jagatsarvaṃ carācaram
verses.translation: By making the idol of the lord as follows and instal- ling it with devotion according to the extent of one's affluence, one surmounts all obstacles and is honoured in the world of Siva; the lord as tearing asunder the leading elephant as accompanied by Amba, as the bestower of all desired objects; as smoke-coloured, red in eyes and adorned with the moon on the forehead, as having three eyes, wearing the sidelocks of hairs, holding the serpent-shaped hatchet, wearing the lion's hide as his upper garment and the deer skin as the lower one, as
verses.hindi: अनेक आकारवाले प्राकारों (चहारदीवारियों)-से घिरे हुए शिवके बाहरी पुरको देखकर प्रसन्नमुख होकर विष्णुने ब्रह्मासहित सभी देवताओंके साथ देवदेवके उस दूसरे पुरमें प्रवेश किया; जो विशाल
verses.wordMeaning: By making the idol of the lord as follows and instal- ling it with devotion according to the extent of one's affluence, one surmounts all obstacles and is honoured in the world of Siva; the lord as tearing asunder the leading elephant as accompanied by Amba,…
verses.commentary: Sense: By making the idol of the lord as follows and instal- ling it with devotion according to the extent of one's affluence, one surmounts all obstacles and is honoured in the world of Siva; the lord as tearing asunder the leading elephant as accompanied by Amba,…

verses.sanskrit: सर्वज्ञं सर्वगं देवं कृत्वा विद्याविधानतः प्रतिष्ठाप्य यथान्यायं शिवसायुज्यमाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: sarvajñaṃ sarvagaṃ devaṃ kṛtvā vidyāvidhānataḥ pratiṣṭhāpya yathānyāyaṃ śivasāyujyamāpnuyāt
verses.translation: Tliere (in the world of Siva) he enjoys great plea- sures until the dissolution of all living beings. By means of deliberation he gains perfect knowledge from the Rudras there and becomes liberated.
verses.hindi: भवनों तथा महलोंसे अवरुद्ध, ऊँची अट्टालिकाओंसे माणिक्य-मणियोंके जालोंसे आवृत, आन्दोलित हो रहे हिण्डोलोंसे समन्वित, घण्टा तथा चामरसे विभूषित, मृदंग-मुरज आदि वाद्ययन्त्रोंसे परिपूर्ण, वीणा-वेणुसे निनादित, नृत्य करती हुई अप्सराओं तथा भूतगणोंसे
verses.wordMeaning: Tliere (in the world of Siva) he enjoys great plea- sures until the dissolution of all living beings. By means of deliberation he gains perfect knowledge from the Rudras there and becomes liberated.
verses.commentary: Sense: Tliere (in the world of Siva) he enjoys great plea- sures until the dissolution of all living beings. By means of deliberation he gains perfect knowledge from the Rudras there and becomes liberated.

verses.sanskrit: त्रिपादं सप्तहस्तं च चतुःशृङ्गं द्विशीर्षकम् कृत्वा यज्ञेशमीशानं विष्णुलोके महीयते
verses.transliteration: tripādaṃ saptahastaṃ ca catuḥśṛṅgaṃ dviśīrṣakam kṛtvā yajñeśamīśānaṃ viṣṇuloke mahīyate
verses.translation: He who makes the idol of the omniscient lord of the chiefs of Devas, NakuliSvara, who is surrounded by disci- ples and their disciples and who has uplifted his hand in expounding the principles and then instals it with devotion goes to the world of Siva. The man enjoys extensive pleasures there for a hundred yugas. After attaining the path of knowledge he attains liberation there itself.
verses.hindi: घिरा हुआ और दृष्टिको मोह लेनेवाले देवेन्द्रभवनके आकारवाले भवनोंसे मण्डित था
verses.wordMeaning: He who makes the idol of the omniscient lord of the chiefs of Devas, NakuliSvara, who is surrounded by disci- ples and their disciples and who has uplifted his hand in expounding the principles and then instals it with devotion goes to the world of Siva.…
verses.commentary: Sense: He who makes the idol of the omniscient lord of the chiefs of Devas, NakuliSvara, who is surrounded by disci- ples and their disciples and who has uplifted his hand in expounding the principles and then instals it with devotion goes to the world of Siva.…

verses.sanskrit: तत्र भुक्त्वा महाभोगान् कल्पलक्षं सुखी नरः क्रमादागत्य लोके ऽस्मिन् सर्वयज्ञान्तगो भवेत्
verses.transliteration: tatra bhuktvā mahābhogān kalpalakṣaṃ sukhī naraḥ kramādāgatya loke 'smin sarvayajñāntago bhavet
verses.translation: His abode is liked by all among Devas and Asuras. By making the idol of the lord as follows and by installing it, one is liberated from the ocean of worldly existence: — The lord shows gestures. He has the ashes from the funeral pyre for his unguent; he has the triple mark of Tripunra; he wears a gar- land made of skulls; he wears a single sacred thread constituted
verses.hindi: तीसरे पुरमें प्रवेश करनेपर महलोंके शिखरोंपर विराजमान हजारों पुरस्त्रियाँ अपने हाथोंसे सभी ओरसे शिवकी भाँति विष्णुके मस्तकपर भी पुष्प, फल, अक्षत आदिकी वर्षा करने लगीं। उस समय विष्णुको देखकर मदसे घूर्णित नेत्रोंबाली तथा विशाल
verses.wordMeaning: His abode is liked by all among Devas and Asuras. By making the idol of the lord as follows and by installing it, one is liberated from the ocean of worldly existence: — The lord shows gestures. He has the ashes from the funeral pyre for his unguent;…

verses.sanskrit: नृत्यन्तं भूतसंघैश् च गणसंघैस् त्वलंकृतम् कृत्वा भक्त्या प्रतिष्ठाप्य यथाविभवविस्तरम्
verses.transliteration: nṛtyantaṃ bhūtasaṃghaiś ca gaṇasaṃghais tvalaṃkṛtam kṛtvā bhaktyā pratiṣṭhāpya yathāvibhavavistaram
verses.translation: If anyone repairs or rebuilds the old, dilapidated fallen or broken temples and reconstructs them with doors, etc. or if he repairs the mansion, platform, rampart or the orna- mental gateway, he derives more benefit than even the origi- nal maker. There is no doubt about this. The man who does some job in the temple of Siva though it be for his sustenance undoubtedly goes to the heavenly world along with his kins- men. If a man does some job in the temple of Rudra even for once and for hb own pleasure he attains happiness and rejoices. Hence, O excellent sages, the man who devoutly makes the temple by means of wood, bricks, etc., is honoured in the world of Siva.
verses.hindi: थीं, कमलकी पंखुड़ीके समान कोमल वस्त्रेसि
verses.wordMeaning: If anyone repairs or rebuilds the old, dilapidated fallen or broken temples and reconstructs them with doors, etc. or if he repairs the mansion, platform, rampart or the orna- mental gateway, he derives more benefit than even the origi- nal maker. There is no doubt about this.…
verses.commentary: Sense: If anyone repairs or rebuilds the old, dilapidated fallen or broken temples and reconstructs them with doors, etc. or if he repairs the mansion, platform, rampart or the orna- mental gateway, he derives more benefit than even the origi- nal maker. verses.sanskrit: ज्ञानं विचारतो लब्ध्वा रुद्रेभ्यस्तत्र मुच्यते अर्धनारीश्वरं देवं चतुर्भुजमनुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: jñānaṃ vicārato labdhvā rudrebhyastatra mucyate ardhanārīśvaraṃ devaṃ caturbhujamanuttamam
verses.translation: The place within the radius of half a Kroa from the Linga ofliva is called Siva-ksetra (holy centre of Siva). He who casts off his life (within that centre) usually very diffi- cult to be cast off, shall obtain Sayujya with Siva. O sages of good holy rites, these are the measuring units of the self-born Bana Linga. In the Svayambhuva, O excellent brahmins, the measure of the holy centre shall be half, in theAr (pertaining to the sages) it shall be half of that. In the Manusa (pertain- ing to human beings) it shall be still half of that. O excellent brahmins, the measure of holy centres in the abode of ascetics is thus.

verses.translation: The ablution with ghee has infinite merit; that with sugar is hundred times more. One shall eschew cooked rice after reaching a river near the holy centre of Siva and plunging into it. He shall thus cast off his body. He is honoured in the world of Siva. All the rivers near the holy centres of Siva are very meritorious.

verses.sanskrit: सम्पूज्य देवदेवेशं शिवलोके महीयते जालन्धरान्तकं देवं सुदर्शनधरं प्रभुम्
verses.transliteration: sampūjya devadeveśaṃ śivaloke mahīyate jālandharāntakaṃ devaṃ sudarśanadharaṃ prabhum
verses.translation: The wells, tanks and lakes are Sivatirthas (sacred waters of Siva). O excellent brahmins, by taking his bath in those (wells, etc.) with devotion a man is undoubtedly liberated from brahmin-slaughter and other sins. O excellent sages, by taking his morning plunge in the sacred waters of Siva, a man attains the benefit of horse sacrifice and goes to Rudra's world. By taking a single plunge in the sacred waters of Siva at midday with great devotion a man surely obtains merit equal to that of taking bath in the Gahga. By taking bath after the sunset one shall attain the auspicious region of Siva.
verses.hindi: परमेश्वर शिवके द्वारा पाशुपतत्रत कहा गया है; हे भूतेश! इस व्रतके करनेसे पशुत्व नहीं रहता है। भी उस उत्तम व्रतको करके समस्त पशु  भगवान् शिवके पशुपाशोंसे मुक्त हो जाते हैं ॥ ४९-५० /२॥
verses.wordMeaning: The wells, tanks and lakes are Sivatirthas (sacred waters of Siva). O excellent brahmins, by taking his bath in those (wells, etc.) with devotion a man is undoubtedly liberated from brahmin-slaughter and other sins. O excellent sages,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The wells, tanks and lakes are Sivatirthas (sacred waters of Siva). O excellent brahmins, by taking his bath in those (wells, etc.) with devotion a man is undoubtedly liberated from brahmin-slaughter and other sins. O excellent sages,…

verses.sanskrit: कृत्वा भक्त्या प्रतिष्ठाप्य द्विधाभूतं जलंधरम् प्रयाति शिवसायुज्यं नात्र कार्या विचारणा
verses.transliteration: kṛtvā bhaktyā pratiṣṭhāpya dvidhābhūtaṃ jalaṃdharam prayāti śivasāyujyaṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā
verses.translation: Casting off his slough of sins in the holy waters of Siva the man attains the auspicious region of Siva. O brah- mins, by taking the threefold bath once in tlie sacred water's of Siva, the man obtains Sayujya with Siva. No doubt need be entertained in this respect.
verses.hindi: तदनन्तर सभी भूतगणोंमें अग्रणी शिलादपुत्र नन्दीने नारायण आदि उन देवताओंको शिवका दर्शन कराया । तब उमा तथा गणोंसहित उन सनातन प्रभु ईशानका दर्शन करके प्रीतिके कारण रोमांचित देवताओंने उन्हें प्रणाम
verses.wordMeaning: Casting off his slough of sins in the holy waters of Siva the man attains the auspicious region of Siva. O brah- mins, by taking the threefold bath once in tlie sacred water's of Siva, the man obtains Sayujya with Siva. No doubt need be entertained in this respect.
verses.commentary: Sense: Casting off his slough of sins in the holy waters of Siva the man attains the auspicious region of Siva. O brah- mins, by taking the threefold bath once in tlie sacred water's of Siva, the man obtains Sayujya with Siva. No doubt need be entertained in this respect.

verses.sanskrit: सुदर्शनप्रदं देवं साक्षात्पूर्वोक्तलक्षणम् अर्चमानेन देवेन चार्चितं नेत्रपूजया
verses.transliteration: sudarśanapradaṃ devaṃ sākṣātpūrvoktalakṣaṇam arcamānena devena cārcitaṃ netrapūjayā
verses.translation: He who sees Siva, the lord of the chiefs of Devas, in the form of Linga at dawn attains a goal superior to ail.
verses.hindi: किया और उनकी स्तुति की तथा उन शितिकण्ठ (शिव)- से पशुपाशसे मुक्तिका निवेदन करके बार-बार प्रणामकर उन शम्भुके सामने वे खड़े हो गये॥ ५१-५३ /२॥ तत्पश्चात् उन सबकी ओर देखकर देवदेव, वृषभध्वज, परमेश्वर भगवान् महेश्वर उन देवताओं तथा
verses.wordMeaning: He who sees Siva, the lord of the chiefs of Devas, in the form of Linga at dawn attains a goal superior to ail.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who sees Siva, the lord of the chiefs of Devas, in the form of Linga at dawn attains a goal superior to ail.

verses.sanskrit: कृत्वा भक्त्या प्रतिष्ठाप्य शिवलोके महीयते तिष्ठतो ऽथ निकुम्भस्य पृष्ठतश्चरणांबुजम्
verses.transliteration: kṛtvā bhaktyā pratiṣṭhāpya śivaloke mahīyate tiṣṭhato 'tha nikumbhasya pṛṣṭhataścaraṇāṃbujam
verses.translation: By seeing Mahadeva at midday one attains the bene- fit of sacrifices. By seeing the lord in the evening, one attains the benefit of yajfias and is liberated.
verses.hindi: श्रीलिड्रमहापुराण
verses.wordMeaning: By seeing Mahadeva at midday one attains the bene- fit of sacrifices. By seeing the lord in the evening, one attains the benefit of yajfias and is liberated.
verses.commentary: Sense: By seeing Mahadeva at midday one attains the bene- fit of sacrifices. By seeing the lord in the evening, one attains the benefit of yajfias and is liberated.

verses.sanskrit: वामेतरं सुविन्यस्य वामे चालिङ्ग्य चाद्रिजाम् शूलाग्रे कूर्परं स्थाप्य किङ्किणीकृतपन्नगम्
verses.transliteration: vāmetaraṃ suvinyasya vāme cāliṅgya cādrijām śūlāgre kūrparaṃ sthāpya kiṅkiṇīkṛtapannagam
verses.translation: He is liberated from all great sins, mental, verbal and physical; subsidiary sins occurring as a sequel.
verses.hindi: झम फाफ फी पापा फाफीफाफफाफ फफाफफफफफ फफफफ तु विशोध्य तेषां देवानां पशुत्वं परमेश्वर: । ब्रतं पाशुपतं चैव स्वयं देवो महेश्वर:
verses.wordMeaning: He is liberated from all great sins, mental, verbal and physical; subsidiary sins occurring as a sequel.
verses.commentary: Sense: He is liberated from all great sins, mental, verbal and physical; subsidiary sins occurring as a sequel.

verses.sanskrit: सम्प्रेक्ष्य चान्धकं पार्श्वे कृताञ्जलिपुटं स्थितम् रूपं कृत्वा यथान्यायं शिवसायुज्यमाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: samprekṣya cāndhakaṃ pārśve kṛtāñjalipuṭaṃ sthitam rūpaṃ kṛtvā yathānyāyaṃ śivasāyujyamāpnuyāt
verses.translation: By visiting lord lana in the form of the Lifiga at the time of transit of the sun from one sign of Zodiac to the next, one eschews sins committed in the course of month and he attains the auspicious region of Siva.
verses.hindi: तदाप्रभृति ते देवाः सर्वे पाशुपताः स्मृताः
verses.wordMeaning: By visiting lord lana in the form of the Lifiga at the time of transit of the sun from one sign of Zodiac to the next, one eschews sins committed in the course of month and he attains the auspicious region of Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: By visiting lord lana in the form of the Lifiga at the time of transit of the sun from one sign of Zodiac to the next, one eschews sins committed in the course of month and he attains the auspicious region of Siva.

verses.sanskrit: यः कुर्याद्देवदेवेशं त्रिपुरान्तकमीश्वरम् धनुर्बाणसमायुक्तं सोमं सोमार्धभूषणम्
verses.transliteration: yaḥ kuryāddevadeveśaṃ tripurāntakamīśvaram dhanurbāṇasamāyuktaṃ somaṃ somārdhabhūṣaṇam
verses.translation: By vi siting the lord at the beginning of the southern or
verses.hindi: पशूनां च पतिर्यस्मात्तेषां साक्षाद्धि देवता: । तस्मात्पाशुपताः प्रोक्तास्तपस्तेपुश्च ते पुनः ययुर्यथागतं सर्वे ब्रह्मणा सह विष्णुना
verses.wordMeaning: By vi siting the lord at the beginning of the southern or
verses.commentary: Sense: By vi siting the lord at the beginning of the southern or

verses.sanskrit: रथे सुसंस्थितं देवं चतुराननसारथिम् तदाकारतया सो ऽपि गत्वा शिवपुरं सुखी
verses.transliteration: rathe susaṃsthitaṃ devaṃ caturānanasārathim tadākāratayā so 'pi gatvā śivapuraṃ sukhī
verses.translation: (After sprinkling) with scented cowdung water the devotee shall make the mystic diagram of the auspicious lotus along with the pericarp. For this purpose the dust particles of pearls, sapphires, rubies, crystals, emerald, gold or silver may be used. Those who are not sufficiently rich may use other powders similar in colour to the powders mentioned above. The mystic diagram shall extend upto ten Hastas. It should be described near Mahadeva. Mahadeva accompanied by the nine Saklis shall be invoked therein: The devotee shall invoke the lord who bestows the desired things by means offive elements, six sense-organs and eight cosmic bodies. Again the devotee shall worship Iana in the ten-cornered (mystic diagram) through the eight cosmic bodies or the ten organs of sense and know- ledge externally. After the worship the devotee shall bow down and offer food offerings to the lord of Devas. He shall thereby obtain the benefit of the charitable gift of earth. The indigent person shall make the mystic diagram of the lotus by means of the powdered grains of Sali rice. Even then he shall obtain the merits as mentioned before.
verses.hindi: पुरा सनत्कुमारेण तस्माद् व्यासेन धीमता
verses.wordMeaning: (After sprinkling) with scented cowdung water the devotee shall make the mystic diagram of the auspicious lotus along with the pericarp. For this purpose the dust particles of pearls, sapphires, rubies, crystals, emerald, gold or silver may be used.…
verses.commentary: Sense: (After sprinkling) with scented cowdung water the devotee shall make the mystic diagram of the auspicious lotus along with the pericarp. For this purpose the dust particles of pearls, sapphires, rubies, crystals, emerald, gold or silver may be used.…

verses.sanskrit: क्रीडते नात्र संदेहो द्वितीय इव शङ्करः तत्र भुक्त्वा महाभोगान् यावद् इच्छा द्विजोत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: krīḍate nātra saṃdeho dvitīya iva śaṅkaraḥ tatra bhuktvā mahābhogān yāvad icchā dvijottamāḥ
verses.translation: The devotee shall draw the mystic diagram of twelve sides and then the excellent lotus by means of such powders as those of jewels, etc. In the middle of the mystic diagram he shall instal Bhaskara along with the twelve deities and then worship the sun surrounded by the planets. He shall attain the excellent Sayujya (the salvation of identity) with the sun. Similarly he shall draw the six-sided figure by means of red chalk to depict deities pertaining to Prakrti. In the middle region he shall worship the goddess of Devas, Prakrti, in the form of Brahman. To the right he shall worship the deity of Sattva-Ouia; to the left that of Rajo-Gua and in front
verses.hindi: मुनियोंके पशुत्वभावका शोधनकर उन्हें स्वयं उपदेश करके उमाके साथ बैठ गये  तभीसे वे सब
verses.wordMeaning: The devotee shall draw the mystic diagram of twelve sides and then the excellent lotus by means of such powders as those of jewels, etc.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The devotee shall draw the mystic diagram of twelve sides and then the excellent lotus by means of such powders as those of jewels, etc.…

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञानं विचारितं लब्ध्वा तत्रैव स विमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: jñānaṃ vicāritaṃ labdhvā tatraiva sa vimucyate
verses.translation: O leading brahmins, thus the great Prakyta Mandala (the mystic diagram pertaining to Prakrti) has been mentioned to you. Henceforth I shadl mention the means of achieving all desired objects.
verses.hindi: साक्षात् पति हैं, अतः देवता पाशुपत कहे गये हैं। इसके बाद उन सबने पुनः तपस्या की । तदनन्तर बारह वर्षके अन्तमें सभी श्रेष्ठ देवता पशुपाशसे मुक्त हो गये और जैसे आये थे, वैसे ही ब्रह्मा तथा विष्णुके साथ वापस लौट
verses.wordMeaning: O leading brahmins, thus the great Prakyta Mandala (the mystic diagram pertaining to Prakrti) has been mentioned to you. Henceforth I shadl mention the means of achieving all desired objects.
verses.commentary: Sense: O leading brahmins, thus the great Prakyta Mandala (the mystic diagram pertaining to Prakrti) has been mentioned to you. Henceforth I shadl mention the means of achieving all desired objects.

verses.sanskrit: गङ्गाधरं सुखासीनं चन्द्रशेखरमेव च
verses.transliteration: gaṅgādharaṃ sukhāsīnaṃ candraśekharameva ca
verses.translation: The devotee conversant with the mantras shall sprinkle the ground duly with water and scrub it with cow- dung. He shall then make the mystic diagram in the form of a square measuring a go-carma (i.e. 150 Hastas a side). He shall then decorate it with canopies, or charming umbrellas. He shall embellish them with globe-like bubbles or crescent- shaped trinkets made of gold or the leaves of Avattha tree. He shall decorate it with full blown white, red or blue lotuses; also strings of pearls shall be suspended from the extremities of the canopies. He shall embellish it with white banners and silken Vaijayantis (Ensigns) or garlands of sprouts and fruits. There shall be white mud-pots and elegant water-jars filled with water. He shall have fifty lamps in a row and five kinds of incense.
verses.hindi: हे मुनियो! मैंने आप लोगोंसे यह सब कह दिया, पूर्वकालमें इसे सनत्कुमारने ब्रह्माजीके मुखसे तथा बुद्धिमान् व्यासजीने उन सनत्कुमार -से सुना था। जो मनुष्य शुद्ध होकर इसे ब्राह्मणोंको सुनाता है अथवा शुद्ध होकर स्वयं सुनता है, वह दूसरा शरीर प्राप्त करके पशुपाशोंसे मुक्त हो जाता है
verses.wordMeaning: The devotee conversant with the mantras shall sprinkle the ground duly with water and scrub it with cow- dung. He shall then make the mystic diagram in the form of a square measuring a go-carma (i.e. 150 Hastas a side). He shall then decorate it with canopies,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The devotee conversant with the mantras shall sprinkle the ground duly with water and scrub it with cow- dung. He shall then make the mystic diagram in the form of a square measuring a go-carma (i.e. 150 Hastas a side). He shall then decorate it with canopies,…

verses.sanskrit: गङ्गया सहितं चैव वामोत्सङ्गे ऽंबिकान्वितम् विनायकं तथा स्कन्दं ज्येष्ठं दुर्गां सुशोभनाम्
verses.transliteration: gaṅgayā sahitaṃ caiva vāmotsaṅge 'ṃbikānvitam vināyakaṃ tathā skandaṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ durgāṃ suśobhanām
verses.translation: The devotee shall make an excellent lotus with fifty petals by means of powders of different colours or only with white powder. The lotus shall extend to one Hasta in magni- tude. It shall be made in accordance with the injunctions. He shall fix the lord Rudra, the lord of Devas along with the goddess in the pericarp. Beginning with the petal in the east and proceeding gradually he shall fix the syllables in the petals along with the Rudras. O sages of good holy rites, the syllables are to begin with the Pranava and end with Namas. O excellent sages, after duly worshipping thus with scents and fragrant flowers, he shall feed fifty brahmins in accordance with the in- junctions. He shall give those leading sages the charitable gifts of garlands of rosary, sacred thread, ear-rings, water-pots, scats,
verses.hindi: विविध मासोंमें किये जानेवाले पशुपाशविमोचक लिडुव्रतका विधान तथा उसका माहात्म्य
verses.wordMeaning: The devotee shall make an excellent lotus with fifty petals by means of powders of different colours or only with white powder. The lotus shall extend to one Hasta in magni- tude. It shall be made in accordance with the injunctions. He shall fix the lord Rudra,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The devotee shall make an excellent lotus with fifty petals by means of powders of different colours or only with white powder. The lotus shall extend to one Hasta in magni- tude. It shall be made in accordance with the injunctions. He shall fix the lord Rudra,…

verses.sanskrit: भास्करं च तथा सोमं ब्रह्माणीं च महेश्वरीम् कौमारीं वैष्णवीं देवीं वाराहीं वरदां तथा
verses.transliteration: bhāskaraṃ ca tathā somaṃ brahmāṇīṃ ca maheśvarīm kaumārīṃ vaiṣṇavīṃ devīṃ vārāhīṃ varadāṃ tathā
verses.translation: By seeing the coloured Mandala and by wor- shipping it one attains the same benefit as a yogin attains in the following circumstances: — When he has learned the Vedas duly along with their Angas (ancillary subjects); when he has worshipped God by means of sacrifices,, such as Jyoti§toma etc., ending with that of Vivajit; when (as a householder) he has procreated sons like himself; when he has adopted the stage of life of a forest-dweller with earnestness maintaining the sacrificial fire, and performing all rites such as Candrayana, etc.; when he has renounced all holy rites, learned Brahmavidya assiduously and attained perfect knowledge and when with perfect knowledge he has seen what should be seen.
verses.hindi: ब्रतमेतत्त्वया प्रोक्तं पशुपाशविमोक्षणम्। व्रतं पाशुपतं लैङ्गं पुरा देवैरनुष्ठितम् देवैहैत्यैस्तथा सिद्धैर्गन्धर्वैः सिद्धचारणैः
verses.wordMeaning: By seeing the coloured Mandala and by wor- shipping it one attains the same benefit as a yogin attains in the following circumstances: — When he has learned the Vedas duly along with their Angas (ancillary subjects); when he has worshipped God by means of sacrifices,,…
verses.commentary: Sense: By seeing the coloured Mandala and by wor- shipping it one attains the same benefit as a yogin attains in the following circumstances: — When he has learned the Vedas duly along with their Angas (ancillary subjects); when he has worshipped God by means of sacrifices,,…

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्राणीं चैव चामुण्डां वीरभद्रसमन्विताम् विघ्नेशेन च यो धीमान् शिवसायुज्यमाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: indrāṇīṃ caiva cāmuṇḍāṃ vīrabhadrasamanvitām vighneśena ca yo dhīmān śivasāyujyamāpnuyāt
verses.translation: After scrubbing and cleaning the front yard of the shrine by any material, O excellent brahmins, if a devotee describes a mystic diagram in the form of a square to the north or south or to the west of the shrine and embellishes it with the pow'ders, flowers, raw rice grains etc., and then wor- ships the deity with flowers, raw rice grains, etc., he is liberated from all sins.
verses.hindi: मुनिभिश्च महाभागैरनुष्ठितमनुत्तमम्। व्रतं द्वादशलिङ्गाख्यं पशुपाशविमोक्षणम्
verses.wordMeaning: After scrubbing and cleaning the front yard of the shrine by any material, O excellent brahmins, if a devotee describes a mystic diagram in the form of a square to the north or south or to the west of the shrine and embellishes it with the pow'ders, flowers,…
verses.commentary: Sense: After scrubbing and cleaning the front yard of the shrine by any material, O excellent brahmins, if a devotee describes a mystic diagram in the form of a square to the north or south or to the west of the shrine and embellishes it with the pow'ders, flowers,…

verses.sanskrit: लिङ्गमूर्तिं महाज्वालामालासंवृतम् अव्ययम् लिङ्गस्य मध्ये वै कृत्वा चन्द्रशेखरमीश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: liṅgamūrtiṃ mahājvālāmālāsaṃvṛtam avyayam liṅgasya madhye vai kṛtvā candraśekharamīśvaram
verses.translation: He, who devoutly scrubs and cleans the sanctum sanctorum all round, even once, scatters scented flowers all round, offers fragrant articles like sandal paste, camphor, etc., makes the place sweet smelling with incense of four kinds and prays to the lord liSana, goes to the world of Siva.
verses.hindi: भोगदं योगदं चैव कामदं मुक्तिदं शुभम्। अवियोगकरं पुण्यं भक्तानां भयनाशनम् ऋषिगण बोले है सूतजी ! आपने पशुपाशसे मुक्त करनेवाले इस व्रतको बता दिया; पूर्वकालमें
verses.wordMeaning: He, who devoutly scrubs and cleans the sanctum sanctorum all round, even once, scatters scented flowers all round, offers fragrant articles like sandal paste, camphor, etc., makes the place sweet smelling with incense of four kinds and prays to the lord liSana,…
verses.commentary: Sense: He, who devoutly scrubs and cleans the sanctum sanctorum all round, even once, scatters scented flowers all round, offers fragrant articles like sandal paste, camphor, etc., makes the place sweet smelling with incense of four kinds and prays to the lord liSana,…

verses.sanskrit: व्योम्नि कुर्यात् तथा लिङ्गं ब्रह्माणं हंसरूपिणम् विष्णुं वराहरूपेण लिङ्गस्याधस्त्वधोमुखम्
verses.transliteration: vyomni kuryāt tathā liṅgaṃ brahmāṇaṃ haṃsarūpiṇam viṣṇuṃ varāharūpeṇa liṅgasyādhastvadhomukham
verses.translation: The man enjoys pleasures for a hundred crores of kalpas. His body emits sweet fragrance like that of flowers with which he fills the temple of Siva. Gradually he goes to the world of Gandharvas and is worshipped by the Gandh- arvas..He comes to this world in due course and becomes a powerful monarch.
verses.hindi: था, अतः आपने पहले इसके विषयमे जैसा भौ श्रवण किया था, उसे हम लोगोंको बताइये॥ १ /२॥
verses.wordMeaning: The man enjoys pleasures for a hundred crores of kalpas. His body emits sweet fragrance like that of flowers with which he fills the temple of Siva.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The man enjoys pleasures for a hundred crores of kalpas. His body emits sweet fragrance like that of flowers with which he fills the temple of Siva.…

verses.sanskrit: केसरं नागरं वापि द्राविडं वा तथापरम् कृत्वा रुद्रालयं भक्त्या शिवलोके महीयते

verses.translation: The intelligent devotee who makes the mansion Nisadha with devotion attains Jiva's world and like Siva rejoices for a long time.

verses.sanskrit: कैलासाख्यं च यः कुर्यात् प्रासादं परमेष्ठिनः कैलासशिखराकारैर् विमानैर् मोदते सुखी

verses.translation: O brahmins, he who makes the splendid and excellent mansion called ilimasaila, goes to the splendid city of Siva by means of vehicles comparable to the mountain Himavat. Attaining the path of knowledge, he shall achieve the chieftainship of the Ganas.

verses.wordMeaning: He who makes jewel-studded mansion with gold, in accordance with the injunctions, of the type of Ihavicja, Nagara or Kesara or makes the peak**'" or platform square or oblong in shape attains great merit. His merit cannot be men- tioned even in hundreds of yugas.

verses.translation: If anyone repairs or rebuilds the old, dilapidated fallen or broken temples and reconstructs them with doois, etc. or if he repairs the mansion, platform, rampart or the orna- mental gateway, he derives more benefit than even the origi- nal maker. There is no doubt about this. The man who docs some job in the temple of Siva though it be for his sustenance undoubtedly goes to the heavenly world along with his kins- men. If a man does some job iu the temple of Rudra even for once and for his ov n pleasure he attains happiness and rejoices. Henc*, O excellent sages, the man w'ho devoutly makes the temple by means of wood, bricks, etc., is honoured in the world of Siva.
verses.hindi: एक सुन्दर सुवर्णमय कमलकी रचना करके उसकी कर्णिकामें विधिके अनुसार वेदीयुक्त स्फटिकके लिङ्गकी स्थापना करनी चाहिए। है सुब्रतो! उसमें भक्तिपूर्वक विधिके अनुसार बिल्वपत्रोंसे, हजार श्वेत-लाल-नीले
verses.wordMeaning: If anyone repairs or rebuilds the old, dilapidated fallen or broken temples and reconstructs them with doois, etc. or if he repairs the mansion, platform, rampart or the orna- mental gateway, he derives more benefit than even the origi- nal maker. There is no doubt about this.…

verses.sanskrit: चान्द्रायणादिकाः सर्वाः कृत्वा न्यस्य क्रिया द्विजाः ब्रह्मविद्यामधीत्यैव ज्ञानमासाद्य यत्नतः

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञानेन ज्ञेयम् आलोक्य योगी यत्काममाप्नुयात् तत्फलं लभते सर्वं वर्णमण्डलदर्शनात्

verses.hindi: विकर्तनो विवस्वांश्च मार्तण्डो भास्करो रविः। लोकप्रकाशकश्चैव लोकसाक्षी त्रिविक्रमः महातेजस्वी, दूसरे महादेवसदूश, श्रीयुक्त तथा शिवके अर्चनमें लीन महाकाय मेरे पापको दूर करें। जो मेरु, मन्दर, कैलासकी चोटियोंका भेदन करनेवाले हैं; जो ऐरावत आदि दिव्य दिग्गजोंसे सम्यक् पूजित हैं;

verses.sanskrit: येन केनापि वा मर्त्यः प्रलिप्यायतनाग्रतः उत्तरे दक्षिणे वापि पृष्ठतो वा द्विजोत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: yena kenāpi vā martyaḥ pralipyāyatanāgrataḥ uttare dakṣiṇe vāpi pṛṣṭhato vā dvijottamāḥ

verses.hindi: सातौं पाताल जिनके पैर हैं; सातौं द्वीप जिनके ऊरु तथा जंघा हैं; सातों समुद्र जिनके अंकुश हैं; सभी तीर्थ जिनके उदर हैं; जो कल्याणकारी हैं; आकाश जिनका शरीर है; दिशाएँ जिनकी भुजाएँ हैं; चन्द्र, सूर्य तथा

verses.sanskrit: चतुष्कोणं तु वा चूर्णैर् अलंकृत्य समन्ततः पुष्पाक्षतादिभिः पूज्य सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: catuṣkoṇaṃ tu vā cūrṇair alaṃkṛtya samantataḥ puṣpākṣatādibhiḥ pūjya sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate

verses.hindi: अग्नि जिनके नेत्र हैं; जिन्होंने असुररूपी महावृक्षको काट डाला है; जो ब्रह्मविद्यासे परम उत्कट हैं; अपनी चित्तवृत्तिको रोककर दिव्य तथा योगपाशसे समन्वित ब्रह्मा आदि महावतोंके द्वारा जो हृदयकमलरूपी स्तम्भमें आबद्ध किये गये हैं; जो गजराजके समान मुखवाले हैं; जो साक्षात् करोड़ों गणोंसे घिरे हुए हैं तथा जो एकमात्र शिवध्यानमें लीन हैं, वे गजानन मेरे पापको दूर करें

verses.sanskrit: यस्तु गर्भगृहं भक्त्या सकृदालिप्य सर्वतः चन्दनाद्यैः सकर्पूरैर् गन्धद्रव्यैः समन्ततः
verses.transliteration: yastu garbhagṛhaṃ bhaktyā sakṛdālipya sarvataḥ candanādyaiḥ sakarpūrair gandhadravyaiḥ samantataḥ

verses.hindi: जो पिंगल वर्णके नेत्रवाले, भस्मको ग्रहण करनेवाले, विशिष्ट देहयुक्त, शिवार्चनमें लीन तथा ऐश्वर्यसम्पन्न हैं, वे भृंगीश मेरे पापको दूर करें। जो अपने चार शरीरोंसे सर्वदा सभी असुरोंका संहार करनेवाले,

verses.sanskrit: विकीर्य गन्धकुसुमैर् धूपैर्धूप्य चतुर्विधैः प्रार्थयेद्देवमीशानं शिवलोकं स गच्छति
verses.transliteration: vikīrya gandhakusumair dhūpairdhūpya caturvidhaiḥ prārthayeddevamīśānaṃ śivalokaṃ sa gacchati

verses.transliteration: tatra bhuktvā mahābhogān kalpakoṭiśataṃ naraḥ svadehagandhakusumaiḥ pūrayañchivamandiram

verses.sanskrit: क्रमाद्गान्धर्वमासाद्य गन्धर्वैश् च सुपूजितः क्रमादागत्य लोके ऽस्मिन् राजा भवति वीर्यवान्
verses.transliteration: kramādgāndharvamāsādya gandharvaiś ca supūjitaḥ kramādāgatya loke 'smin rājā bhavati vīryavān
verses.translation: Mahacleva is the primordial lord. He is the cause of creation, dissolution and sustenance. Sadasiva is all pervaisivc and is the overlord of the worlds. The nectar of Siva- Brahman should be known as the excellent means of salvation. One shall always worship the lord, the manifest and the un manifest being the lord beyond imagination.
verses.hindi: विकर्तन, विवस्वान्, मार्तण्ड, भास्कर, रवि, ज्वरे पाडत रहता है उसके शरसे बसाके समान गन्ध आती हे, वह बार-बार बेहोश हो जाता है इत्यादि। सुश्रुतसंहितामें इन हो जाता है इत्यादि । सुश्रुतसंहितामें इन अरिष्टकारी बालग्रहोंकी चिकित्सा भी बतायी गयी है और इन ग्रहोके स्वामी स्कन्दग्रहसे प्रार्थना की गयी है कि मेरा बच्चा वेदना और रोगसे शीघ्र कष्टमुक्त हो स्वस्थ हो जाय--' नीरुजो निर्विकारश्च शिशुरमे जायतां द्ुतम्' (सुश्रुत० उत्तर २७1 २१ ) । ये सभी ग्रह दिव्य तथा ऐश्वर्यशाली हैं। कृत्तिका, पार्वती, अग्नि तथा महादेवजीने अपने पुत्र कार्तिकेयकी रक्षाके लिये इन्हें उत्पन्न किया है। नैगमेयको

verses.sanskrit: आदिदेवो महादेवः प्रलयस्थितिकारकः सर्गश् च भुवनाधीशः शर्वव्यापी सदाशिवः शिवब्रह्मामृतं ग्राह्यं मोक्षसाधनम् उत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: ādidevo mahādevaḥ pralayasthitikārakaḥ sargaś ca bhuvanādhīśaḥ śarvavyāpī sadāśivaḥ śivabrahmāmṛtaṃ grāhyaṃ mokṣasādhanam uttamam

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीलिङ्गमहापुराणे पूर्वभागे उपलेपनादिकथनं नाम सप्तसप्ततितमो ऽध्यायः वस्त्रपूतेन तोयेन कार्यं चैवोपलेपनम् शिवक्षेत्रे मुनिश्रेष्ठा नान्यथा सिद्धिरिष्यते
verses.transliteration: iti śrīliṅgamahāpurāṇe pūrvabhāge upalepanādikathanaṃ nāma saptasaptatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ vastrapūtena toyena kāryaṃ caivopalepanam śivakṣetre muniśreṣṭhā nānyathā siddhiriṣyate
verses.translation: O excellent sages, the holy shrine of Siva should be scr- ubbed and cleaned by means of water filtered and purified with a cloth. Otherwise no Siddhi is attained.
verses.hindi: वरुणो वायुसोमौ च ईशानो भगवान् हरिः। पितामहश्च भगवान् शिवध्यानपरायणः
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent sages, the holy shrine of Siva should be scr- ubbed and cleaned by means of water filtered and purified with a cloth. Otherwise no Siddhi is attained.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent sages, the holy shrine of Siva should be scr- ubbed and cleaned by means of water filtered and purified with a cloth. Otherwise no Siddhi is attained.

verses.sanskrit: आपः पूता भवन्त्येता वस्त्रपूताः समुद्धृताः अफेना मुनिशार्दूला नादेयाश् च विशेषतः
verses.transliteration: āpaḥ pūtā bhavantyetā vastrapūtāḥ samuddhṛtāḥ aphenā muniśārdūlā nādeyāś ca viśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: O leading sages, waters that have no foam, particularly from the rivers, should be taken. When filtered with a cloth they become pure and holy.
verses.hindi: एते पापं व्यपोहन्तु मनसा कर्मणा कृतम्। नभस्वान् स्पर्शनो वायुरनिलो मारुतस्तथा प्राणः प्राणेशजीवेशौ मारुतः शिवभाषिताः । शिवार्चनरताः सर्वे व्यपोहन्तु मलं मम
verses.wordMeaning: O leading sages, waters that have no foam, particularly from the rivers, should be taken. When filtered with a cloth they become pure and holy.
verses.commentary: Sense: O leading sages, waters that have no foam, particularly from the rivers, should be taken. When filtered with a cloth they become pure and holy.

verses.sanskrit: तस्माद्वै सर्वकार्याणि दैविकानि द्विजोत्तमाः अद्भिः कार्याणि पूताभिः सर्वकार्यप्रसिद्धये
verses.transliteration: tasmādvai sarvakāryāṇi daivikāni dvijottamāḥ adbhiḥ kāryāṇi pūtābhiḥ sarvakāryaprasiddhaye
verses.translation: Hence, O excellent brahmins, all divine holy rites should he performed by the purified waters for achieving the results in all rites.
verses.hindi: खेचरी वसुचारी च ब्रह्मेशो ब्रह्म ब्रह्मधीः।
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, O excellent brahmins, all divine holy rites should he performed by the purified waters for achieving the results in all rites.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, O excellent brahmins, all divine holy rites should he performed by the purified waters for achieving the results in all rites.

verses.sanskrit: जन्तुभिर् मिश्रिता ह्यापः सूक्ष्माभिस्तान्निहत्य तु यत्पापं सकलं चाद्भिर् अपूताभिश्चिरं लभेत्
verses.transliteration: jantubhir miśritā hyāpaḥ sūkṣmābhistānnihatya tu yatpāpaṃ sakalaṃ cādbhir apūtābhiściraṃ labhet
verses.translation: Waters are mixed with minute germs. By using the un fil- tered waters one attains the same sin as by killing them.
verses.hindi: व्यपोहन्तु मलं सर्व पापं चैव मया कृतम् व्यपोहन्तु मलं सर्वे सिद्धाः शिवपदार्चकाः। यक्षो यक्षेश धनदो जुम्भको मणिभद्रकः
verses.wordMeaning: Waters are mixed with minute germs. By using the un fil- tered waters one attains the same sin as by killing them.
verses.commentary: Sense: Waters are mixed with minute germs. By using the un fil- tered waters one attains the same sin as by killing them.

verses.sanskrit: संमार्जने तथा नॄणां मार्जने च विशेषतः अग्नौ कण्डनके चैव पेषणे तोयसंग्रहे
verses.transliteration: saṃmārjane tathā nṝṇāṃ mārjane ca viśeṣataḥ agnau kaṇḍanake caiva peṣaṇe toyasaṃgrahe
verses.translation: Hence, By all means one shall prfictise water purified 1biy cloth. The meritorious and charitable gift of giving protection the excellent of all charitable gifts.
verses.hindi: कर्कोटको महापद्मः शङ्खपालो महाबलः
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, By all means one shall prfictise water purified 1biy cloth. The meritorious and charitable gift of giving protection the excellent of all charitable gifts.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, By all means one shall prfictise water purified 1biy cloth. The meritorious and charitable gift of giving protection the excellent of all charitable gifts.

verses.sanskrit: हिंसा सदा गृहस्थानां तस्माद्धिंसां विवर्जयेत् अहिंसेयं परो धर्मः सर्वेषां प्राणिनां द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: hiṃsā sadā gṛhasthānāṃ tasmāddhiṃsāṃ vivarjayet ahiṃseyaṃ paro dharmaḥ sarveṣāṃ prāṇināṃ dvijāḥ
verses.translation: Hence, violence should be avoided always and at all /places. All violent creatures do not harm a man who abstains, from violence mentally, verbally and physically. They harass 0ne,who injures others. A man who abstains from violence >obtain$ a crore timfes the benefit that one attains by gifting " i.way the 'three Worlds to one who has mastered the Vedas. ' Those who are engaged in the welfare of living beings, men*
verses.hindi: शिवप्रणामसम्पन्नाः शिवदेहप्रभूषणाः । मम पापं व्यपोहन्तु विषं स्थावरजङ्गमम् वीणाज्ञः किन्नरश्चैव सुरसेनः प्रमर्दनः। अतीशयः सप्रयोगी गीतज्ञश्चैव किन्नराः
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, violence should be avoided always and at all /places. All violent creatures do not harm a man who abstains, from violence mentally, verbally and physically. They harass 0ne,who injures others.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, violence should be avoided always and at all /places. All violent creatures do not harm a man who abstains, from violence mentally, verbally and physically. They harass 0ne,who injures others.…

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन वस्त्रपूतं समाचरेत् तद्दानमभयं पुण्यं सर्वदानोत्तमोत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: tasmātsarvaprayatnena vastrapūtaṃ samācaret taddānamabhayaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvadānottamottamam
verses.translation: Women from any caste should not be taken up for the Yajrlas at any time, by anyone or in any place, O leading brahmins. Women engaged in sinful activities, whether they be dirty or beautiful, ugly or robed in ugly clothes should never be killed by men due to the suspicion that they may be Siva.
verses.hindi: शिवप्रणामसम्पन्नाः व्यपोहन्तु मलं मम। विद्याधरश्च विबुधो विद्याराशिर्विदां वरः
verses.wordMeaning: Women from any caste should not be taken up for the Yajrlas at any time, by anyone or in any place, O leading brahmins. Women engaged in sinful activities, whether they be dirty or beautiful,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Women from any caste should not be taken up for the Yajrlas at any time, by anyone or in any place, O leading brahmins. Women engaged in sinful activities, whether they be dirty or beautiful,…

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात्तु परिहर्तव्या हिंसा सर्वत्र सर्वदा मनसा कर्मणा वाचा सर्वदाहिंसकं नरम्
verses.transliteration: tasmāttu parihartavyā hiṃsā sarvatra sarvadā manasā karmaṇā vācā sarvadāhiṃsakaṃ naram
verses.translation: Those who practise the holy rites and conduct of life outside the pale of the Vedas, those who are excluded from the rites laid down in Srutis and Smrtis and those who are notori- ous as heretics should not be conversed with by the twice-born.
verses.hindi: एते विद्याधराः सर्वे शिवध्यानपरायणाः व्यपोहन्तु मलं घोरं महादेवप्रसादतः। वामदेवी महाजम्भः कालनेमिर्महाबलः
verses.wordMeaning: Those who practise the holy rites and conduct of life outside the pale of the Vedas, those who are excluded from the rites laid down in Srutis and Smrtis and those who are notori- ous as heretics should not be conversed with by the twice-born.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who practise the holy rites and conduct of life outside the pale of the Vedas, those who are excluded from the rites laid down in Srutis and Smrtis and those who are notori- ous as heretics should not be conversed with by the twice-born.

verses.sanskrit: रक्षन्ति जन्तवः सर्वे हिंसकं बाधयन्ति च त्रैलोक्यमखिलं दत्त्वा यत्फलं वेदपारगे
verses.transliteration: rakṣanti jantavaḥ sarve hiṃsakaṃ bādhayanti ca trailokyamakhilaṃ dattvā yatphalaṃ vedapārage
verses.translation: violence incumd by plucking flowers (puspa-hixhta) for $iva*s worship is not sinful, so also the slaughter of animals in propidation cSiva.
verses.hindi: सुग्रीवो मर्दकश्चैव पिङ्गलो देवमर्दनः।
verses.wordMeaning: violence incumd by plucking flowers (puspa-hixhta) for $iva*s worship is not sinful, so also the slaughter of animals in propidation cSiva.
verses.commentary: Sense: violence incumd by plucking flowers (puspa-hixhta) for $iva*s worship is not sinful, so also the slaughter of animals in propidation cSiva.

verses.sanskrit: तत्फलं कोटिगुणितं लभते ऽहिंसको नरः मनसा कर्मणा वाचा सर्वभूतहिते रताः
verses.transliteration: tatphalaṃ koṭiguṇitaṃ labhate 'hiṃsako naraḥ manasā karmaṇā vācā sarvabhūtahite ratāḥ
verses.translation: They should neither be seen nor touched. After seeing them one should look at the sun. Still they should not be killed by kings or other creatures.
verses.hindi: जम्भः कुम्भश्च मायावी कार्तवीर्यः कृतञ्जयः। एतेऽसुरा महात्मानो महादेवपरायणाः आकाश, वायु, अग्नि, व पृथ्वी, चन्द्र, सूर्य तथा आत्मा- यै शिवजीकी मूर्तियों कही गयी हैं; ये मेरै पापको दूर करें और मेरे भयका नाश करें। इन्द्र, पावक, यम्, निति, वरुण, वायु, सोम, ईशान, भगवान् हरि तथा
verses.wordMeaning: They should neither be seen nor touched. After seeing them one should look at the sun. Still they should not be killed by kings or other creatures.
verses.commentary: Sense: They should neither be seen nor touched. After seeing them one should look at the sun. Still they should not be killed by kings or other creatures.

verses.sanskrit: दयादर्शितपन्थानो रुद्रलोकं व्रजन्ति च स्वामिवत्परिरक्षन्ति बहूनि विविधानि च
verses.transliteration: dayādarśitapanthāno rudralokaṃ vrajanti ca svāmivatparirakṣanti bahūni vividhāni ca
verses.translation: O brahmins, by worshipping lord Siva even for once, thanks to the contact with good men, a man attains Rudra's world.
verses.hindi: शिवध्यानमें लीन प्रभु ब्रह्मा-ये मेरेद्वारा मन तथा कर्मसे किये गये पापको दूर करें ॥ ४४--४६ /२॥
verses.wordMeaning: O brahmins, by worshipping lord Siva even for once, thanks to the contact with good men, a man attains Rudra's world.
verses.commentary: Sense: O brahmins, by worshipping lord Siva even for once, thanks to the contact with good men, a man attains Rudra's world.

verses.sanskrit: ये पुत्रपौत्रवत्स्नेहाद् रुद्रलोकं व्रजन्ति ते तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन वस्त्रपूतेन वारिणा
verses.transliteration: ye putrapautravatsnehād rudralokaṃ vrajanti te tasmātsarvaprayatnena vastrapūtena vāriṇā
verses.translation: O excellent sages, all unkind persons become miserable. So also, all men who are devoid of devotion towards the great lord.
verses.hindi: और जीवेश-ये सब शिवभाषित तथा शिवार्चनपरायण मारुत मेरे पापको दूर करें  खेचरी, वसुचारी, ब्रह्मश, ब्रह्म, ब्रह्मधी, सुषेण, शाश्वत, पुष्ट, सुपुष्ट, महाबल--ये चारण जो शम्भुकी पूजासे अत्यन्त पवित्र हैं, मेरेद्वारा किये गये समस्त पाप तथा दोषको दूर करें ॥ ४७--५० ॥
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent sages, all unkind persons become miserable. So also, all men who are devoid of devotion towards the great lord.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent sages, all unkind persons become miserable. So also, all men who are devoid of devotion towards the great lord.

verses.sanskrit: कार्यमभ्युक्षणं नित्यं स्नपनं च विशेषतः त्रैलोक्यमखिलं हत्वा यत्फलं परिकीर्त्यते
verses.transliteration: kāryamabhyukṣaṇaṃ nityaṃ snapanaṃ ca viśeṣataḥ trailokyamakhilaṃ hatvā yatphalaṃ parikīrtyate
verses.translation: Those who arc devotees of Siva, the lord of Devas, are fortunate. After enjoying pleasures here itself they become liberated.
verses.hindi: सिद्धियोंके प्रदाता तथा शिवके चरणोंके उपासक हैं, मेरे पापको दूर करें । यक्ष, यक्षेश, धनद, जम्भक, मणिभद्रक, पूर्णभद्रेशवर, माली, शितिकुण्डलि और नरेन्द्र-ये यक्षोंके स्वामी मेरे पापको दूर करें॥ ५१--५३॥
verses.wordMeaning: Those who arc devotees of Siva, the lord of Devas, are fortunate. After enjoying pleasures here itself they become liberated.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who arc devotees of Siva, the lord of Devas, are fortunate. After enjoying pleasures here itself they become liberated.

verses.sanskrit: शिवालये निहत्यैकम् अपि तत्सकलं लभेत् शिवार्थं सर्वदा कार्या पुष्पहिंसा द्विजोत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: śivālaye nihatyaikam api tatsakalaṃ labhet śivārthaṃ sarvadā kāryā puṣpahiṃsā dvijottamāḥ
verses.translation: The minds of men are attached towards sons, wives and houses. Just as the minds of ascetics and sages are attached towards the primordial lord. But if men turn their minds to- wards the lord at least once by chance the world of great la b not far for them.
verses.hindi: शिवके प्रणाममें रत तथा शिवके शरीरके ककोंटक, महापद्म, शंखपाल और महाबल मेरे पापको तथा स्थावर-जंगम विषको दूर करें
verses.wordMeaning: The minds of men are attached towards sons, wives and houses. Just as the minds of ascetics and sages are attached towards the primordial lord. But if men turn their minds to- wards the lord at least once by chance the world of great la b not far for them.
verses.commentary: Sense: The minds of men are attached towards sons, wives and houses. Just as the minds of ascetics and sages are attached towards the primordial lord. But if men turn their minds to- wards the lord at least once by chance the world of great la b not far for them.

verses.sanskrit: यज्ञार्थं पशुहिंसा च क्षत्रियैर्दुष्टशासनम् विहिताविहितं नास्ति योगिनां ब्रह्मवादिनाम्
verses.transliteration: yajñārthaṃ paśuhiṃsā ca kṣatriyairduṣṭaśāsanam vihitāvihitaṃ nāsti yogināṃ brahmavādinām
verses.translation: The minds of men are attached towards sons, wives and houses. Just as the minds of ascetics and sages are attached towards the primordial lord. But if men turn their minds to- wards the lord at least once by chance the world of great la b not far for them.
verses.hindi: शिवको प्रणाम करनेमें तल्लीन वीणाज्ञ, किन्नर, सुरसेन, प्रमर्दन, अतीशय, सप्रयोगी और गीतज्ञ-ये किन्नरगण मेरे पापको दूर करें  विद्याधर विबुध, विद्याराशि,
verses.wordMeaning: The minds of men are attached towards sons, wives and houses. Just as the minds of ascetics and sages are attached towards the primordial lord. But if men turn their minds to- wards the lord at least once by chance the world of great la b not far for them.
verses.commentary: Sense: The minds of men are attached towards sons, wives and houses. Just as the minds of ascetics and sages are attached towards the primordial lord. But if men turn their minds to- wards the lord at least once by chance the world of great la b not far for them.

verses.sanskrit: यतस्तस्मान्न हन्तव्या निषिद्धानां निषेवणात् सर्वकर्माणि विन्यस्य संन्यस्ता ब्रह्मवादिनः
verses.transliteration: yatastasmānna hantavyā niṣiddhānāṃ niṣevaṇāt sarvakarmāṇi vinyasya saṃnyastā brahmavādinaḥ
verses.translation: The minds of men are attached towards sons, wives and houses. Just as the minds of ascetics and sages are attached towards the primordial lord. But if men turn their minds to- wards the lord at least once by chance the world of great la b not far for them.
verses.hindi: ये सभी शिवध्यानपरायण विद्याधर महादेवकी कृपासे मेरे घोर पापको दूर करें॥ ५६-५८१/२॥ वामदेवी, महाजम्भ, कालनेमि, महाबल, सुग्रीव, मर्दक, पिंगल, देवमर्दन, प्रह्णाद, अनुह्णाद, संह बाष्कलद्वय, जम्भ, कुम्भ, मायावी, कार्तवीर्य, कृतंजय ये महादेवपरायण महात्मा असुर मेरे घोर भय तथा
verses.wordMeaning: The minds of men are attached towards sons, wives and houses. Just as the minds of ascetics and sages are attached towards the primordial lord. But if men turn their minds to- wards the lord at least once by chance the world of great la b not far for them.
verses.commentary: Sense: The minds of men are attached towards sons, wives and houses. Just as the minds of ascetics and sages are attached towards the primordial lord. But if men turn their minds to- wards the lord at least once by chance the world of great la b not far for them.

verses.sanskrit: न हन्तव्याः सदा पूज्याः पापकर्मरता अपि पवित्रास्तु स्त्रियः सर्वा अत्रेश् च कुलसंभवाः
verses.transliteration: na hantavyāḥ sadā pūjyāḥ pāpakarmaratā api pavitrāstu striyaḥ sarvā atreś ca kulasaṃbhavāḥ
verses.translation: The minds of men are attached towards sons, wives and houses. Just as the minds of ascetics and sages are attached towards the primordial lord. But if men turn their minds to- wards the lord at least once by chance the world of great la b not far for them.
verses.hindi: 1 उच्छेदक तथा शिवसायुज्य प्रदान करनेवाला व्यपोहनस्तव
verses.wordMeaning: The minds of men are attached towards sons, wives and houses. Just as the minds of ascetics and sages are attached towards the primordial lord. But if men turn their minds to- wards the lord at least once by chance the world of great la b not far for them.
verses.commentary: Sense: The minds of men are attached towards sons, wives and houses. Just as the minds of ascetics and sages are attached towards the primordial lord. But if men turn their minds to- wards the lord at least once by chance the world of great la b not far for them.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्महत्यासमं पापम् आत्रेयीं विनिहत्य च स्त्रियः सर्वा न हन्तव्याः पापकर्मरता अपि
verses.transliteration: brahmahatyāsamaṃ pāpam ātreyīṃ vinihatya ca striyaḥ sarvā na hantavyāḥ pāpakarmaratā api
verses.translation: The minds of men are attached towards sons, wives and houses. Just as the minds of ascetics and sages are attached towards the primordial lord. But if men turn their minds to- wards the lord at least once by chance the world of great la b not far for them.
verses.hindi: नागाशीर्विषनाशश्च विष्णुवाहन एव च एते हिरण्यवर्णाभा गरुडा विष्णुवाहनाः। नानाभरणसम्पन्ना व्यपोहन्तु मलं मम
verses.wordMeaning: The minds of men are attached towards sons, wives and houses. Just as the minds of ascetics and sages are attached towards the primordial lord. But if men turn their minds to- wards the lord at least once by chance the world of great la b not far for them.
verses.commentary: Sense: The minds of men are attached towards sons, wives and houses. Just as the minds of ascetics and sages are attached towards the primordial lord. But if men turn their minds to- wards the lord at least once by chance the world of great la b not far for them.

verses.sanskrit: न यज्ञार्थं स्त्रियो ग्राह्याः सर्वैः सर्वत्र सर्वदा सर्ववर्णेषु विप्रेन्द्राः पापकर्मरता अपि
verses.transliteration: na yajñārthaṃ striyo grāhyāḥ sarvaiḥ sarvatra sarvadā sarvavarṇeṣu viprendrāḥ pāpakarmaratā api
verses.translation: The minds of men are attached towards sons, wives and houses. Just as the minds of ascetics and sages are attached towards the primordial lord. But if men turn their minds to- wards the lord at least once by chance the world of great la b not far for them.
verses.hindi: काश्यपो नारदश्चैव Nu च ऋषयः शिवभाविताः। शिवार्चनरताः सर्वे व्यपोहन्तु मलं मम
verses.wordMeaning: The minds of men are attached towards sons, wives and houses. Just as the minds of ascetics and sages are attached towards the primordial lord. But if men turn their minds to- wards the lord at least once by chance the world of great la b not far for them.
verses.commentary: Sense: The minds of men are attached towards sons, wives and houses. Just as the minds of ascetics and sages are attached towards the primordial lord. But if men turn their minds to- wards the lord at least once by chance the world of great la b not far for them.

verses.sanskrit: मलिना रूपवत्यश् च विरूपा मलिनांबराः न हन्तव्याः सदा मर्त्यैः शिववच्छङ्कया तथा
verses.transliteration: malinā rūpavatyaś ca virūpā malināṃbarāḥ na hantavyāḥ sadā martyaiḥ śivavacchaṅkayā tathā
verses.translation: The minds of men are attached towards sons, wives and houses. Just as the minds of ascetics and sages are attached towards the primordial lord. But if men turn their minds to- wards the lord at least once by chance the world of great la b not far for them.
verses.hindi: व्यपोहन्तु भयं पापं शिवध्यानपरायणाः। लक्ष्मीश्च धरणी चैव गायत्री च सरस्वती देवानां मातरश्चैव गणानां मातरस्तथा
verses.wordMeaning: The minds of men are attached towards sons, wives and houses. Just as the minds of ascetics and sages are attached towards the primordial lord. But if men turn their minds to- wards the lord at least once by chance the world of great la b not far for them.

verses.sanskrit: वेदबाह्यव्रताचाराः श्रौतस्मार्तबहिष्कृताः पाषण्डिन इति ख्याता न संभाष्या द्विजातिभिः
verses.transliteration: vedabāhyavratācārāḥ śrautasmārtabahiṣkṛtāḥ pāṣaṇḍina iti khyātā na saṃbhāṣyā dvijātibhiḥ
verses.translation: The minds of men are attached towards sons, wives and houses. Just as the minds of ascetics and sages are attached towards the primordial lord. But if men turn their minds to- wards the lord at least once by chance the world of great la b not far for them.
verses.hindi: प्रसादाद्देवदेवस्य व्यपोहन्तु मलं मम
verses.wordMeaning: The minds of men are attached towards sons, wives and houses. Just as the minds of ascetics and sages are attached towards the primordial lord. But if men turn their minds to- wards the lord at least once by chance the world of great la b not far for them.
verses.commentary: Sense: The minds of men are attached towards sons, wives and houses. Just as the minds of ascetics and sages are attached towards the primordial lord. But if men turn their minds to- wards the lord at least once by chance the world of great la b not far for them.

verses.sanskrit: न स्पृष्टव्या न द्रष्टव्या दृष्ट्वा भानुं समीक्षते तथापि तेन वध्याश् च नृपैरन्यैश् च जन्तुभिः
verses.transliteration: na spṛṣṭavyā na draṣṭavyā dṛṣṭvā bhānuṃ samīkṣate tathāpi tena vadhyāś ca nṛpairanyaiś ca jantubhiḥ
verses.translation: The minds of men are attached towards sons, wives and houses. Just as the minds of ascetics and sages are attached towards the primordial lord. But if men turn their minds to- wards the lord at least once by chance the world of great la b not far for them.
verses.hindi: उर्वशी मेनका चैव रम्भारतितिलोत्तमाः। सुमुखी दुर्मुखी चैव कामुकी कामवर्धनी तथान्याः सर्वलोकेषु दिव्याश्चाप्सरसस्तथा। शिवाय ताएडवं नित्यं कुर्वन्त्योऽतीव भाविताः
verses.wordMeaning: The minds of men are attached towards sons, wives and houses. Just as the minds of ascetics and sages are attached towards the primordial lord. But if men turn their minds to- wards the lord at least once by chance the world of great la b not far for them.
verses.commentary: Sense: The minds of men are attached towards sons, wives and houses. Just as the minds of ascetics and sages are attached towards the primordial lord. But if men turn their minds to- wards the lord at least once by chance the world of great la b not far for them.

verses.sanskrit: प्रसंगाद्वापि यो मर्त्यः सतां सकृदहो द्विजाः रुद्रलोकमवाप्नोति समभ्यर्च्य महेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: prasaṃgādvāpi yo martyaḥ satāṃ sakṛdaho dvijāḥ rudralokamavāpnoti samabhyarcya maheśvaram
verses.translation: The minds of men are attached towards sons, wives and houses. Just as the minds of ascetics and sages are attached towards the primordial lord. But if men turn their minds to- wards the lord at least once by chance the world of great la b not far for them.
verses.hindi: देव्यः शिवार्चनरता व्यपोहन्तु मलं मम।
verses.wordMeaning: The minds of men are attached towards sons, wives and houses. Just as the minds of ascetics and sages are attached towards the primordial lord. But if men turn their minds to- wards the lord at least once by chance the world of great la b not far for them.
verses.commentary: Sense: The minds of men are attached towards sons, wives and houses. Just as the minds of ascetics and sages are attached towards the primordial lord. But if men turn their minds to- wards the lord at least once by chance the world of great la b not far for them.

verses.sanskrit: भवन्ति दुःखिताः सर्वे निर्दया मुनिसत्तमाः भक्तिहीना नराः सर्वे भवे परमकारणे
verses.transliteration: bhavanti duḥkhitāḥ sarve nirdayā munisattamāḥ bhaktihīnā narāḥ sarve bhave paramakāraṇe
verses.translation: The minds of men are attached towards sons, wives and houses. Just as the minds of ascetics and sages are attached towards the primordial lord. But if men turn their minds to- wards the lord at least once by chance the world of great la b not far for them.
verses.hindi: शुक्रः शनैश्चरश्चैव राहुः केतुस्तथैव च। व्यपोहन्तु भयं घोरं ग्रहपीडां शिवार्चकाः मेषो वृषोऽथ मिथुनस्तथा कर्कटकः शुभः। सिंहश्च कन्या विपुला तुला वै वृश्चिकस्तथा
verses.wordMeaning: The minds of men are attached towards sons, wives and houses. Just as the minds of ascetics and sages are attached towards the primordial lord. But if men turn their minds to- wards the lord at least once by chance the world of great la b not far for them.
verses.commentary: Sense: The minds of men are attached towards sons, wives and houses. Just as the minds of ascetics and sages are attached towards the primordial lord. But if men turn their minds to- wards the lord at least once by chance the world of great la b not far for them.

verses.sanskrit: ये भक्ता देवदेवस्य शिवस्य परमेष्ठिनः भाग्यवन्तो विमुच्यन्ते भुक्त्वा भोगानिहैव ते
verses.transliteration: ye bhaktā devadevasya śivasya parameṣṭhinaḥ bhāgyavanto vimucyante bhuktvā bhogānihaiva te
verses.translation: The minds of men are attached towards sons, wives and houses. Just as the minds of ascetics and sages are attached towards the primordial lord. But if men turn their minds to- wards the lord at least once by chance the world of great la b not far for them.
verses.hindi: धनुश्च मकरश्चैव कुम्भो मीनस्तथैव च। राशयो द्वादश होते शिवपूजापरायणाः
verses.wordMeaning: The minds of men are attached towards sons, wives and houses. Just as the minds of ascetics and sages are attached towards the primordial lord. But if men turn their minds to- wards the lord at least once by chance the world of great la b not far for them.
verses.commentary: Sense: The minds of men are attached towards sons, wives and houses. Just as the minds of ascetics and sages are attached towards the primordial lord. But if men turn their minds to- wards the lord at least once by chance the world of great la b not far for them.

verses.sanskrit: पुत्रेषु दारेषु गृहेषु नॄणां भक्तं यथा चित्तमथादिदेवे सकृत्प्रसंगाद्यतितापसानां तेषां न दूरः परमेशलोकः
verses.transliteration: putreṣu dāreṣu gṛheṣu nṝṇāṃ bhaktaṃ yathā cittamathādideve sakṛtprasaṃgādyatitāpasānāṃ teṣāṃ na dūraḥ parameśalokaḥ
verses.translation: The minds of men are attached towards sons, wives and houses. Just as the minds of ascetics and sages are attached towards the primordial lord. But if men turn their minds to- wards the lord at least once by chance the world of great la b not far for them.
verses.hindi: व्यपोहन्तु भयं पापं प्रसादात्परमेष्ठिनः। अश्विनी भरणी चैव कृत्तिका रोहिणी तथा॥ श्रीमन्मृगशिरश्चारद्रा पुनर्वसुपुष्यसार्पकाः। मघा वै पूर्वफाल्गुन्य उत्तराफाल्गुनी तथा हस्तश्चित्रा तथा स्वाती विशाखा चानुराधिका। ज्येष्ठा मूलं महाभागा पूर्वाषाढा तथैव च
verses.wordMeaning: The minds of men are attached towards sons, wives and houses. Just as the minds of ascetics and sages are attached towards the primordial lord. But if men turn their minds to- wards the lord at least once by chance the world of great la b not far for them.
verses.commentary: Sense: The minds of men are attached towards sons, wives and houses. Just as the minds of ascetics and sages are attached towards the primordial lord. But if men turn their minds to- wards the lord at least once by chance the world of great la b not far for them.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीलिङ्गमहापुराणे पूर्वभागे भक्तिमहिमवर्णनं नामाष्टसप्ततितमो ऽध्यायः कथं पूज्यो महादेवो मर्त्यैर्मन्दैर्महामते कल्पायुषैर् अल्पवीर्यैर् अल्पसत्त्वैः प्रजापतिः
verses.transliteration: iti śrīliṅgamahāpurāṇe pūrvabhāge bhaktimahimavarṇanaṃ nāmāṣṭasaptatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ kathaṃ pūjyo mahādevo martyairmandairmahāmate kalpāyuṣair alpavīryair alpasattvaiḥ prajāpatiḥ
verses.translation: O sages of great intellect, how should the great lord, the lord of subjects be worshipped by tardy and dull-witted men who are short-lived, whose strength is trifling and whose virility is insignificant. Even after worshipping lord Siva by means of penance for thousands of years, Devas do not see him. How then do they worship the lord?
verses.hindi: उत्तराषाढिका चैव श्रवणं च श्रविष्ठिका। शतभिषक्मूर्वभद्रा च तथा प्रोष्ठपदा तथा
verses.wordMeaning: O sages of great intellect, how should the great lord, the lord of subjects be worshipped by tardy and dull-witted men who are short-lived, whose strength is trifling and whose virility is insignificant.…
verses.commentary: Sense: O sages of great intellect, how should the great lord, the lord of subjects be worshipped by tardy and dull-witted men who are short-lived, whose strength is trifling and whose virility is insignificant.…

verses.sanskrit: संवत्सरसहस्रैश् च तपसा पूज्य शङ्करम् न पश्यन्ति सुराश्चापि कथं देवं यजन्ति ते
verses.transliteration: saṃvatsarasahasraiś ca tapasā pūjya śaṅkaram na paśyanti surāścāpi kathaṃ devaṃ yajanti te
verses.translation: O leading sages, what you have said is quite true. Still with faith the lord can be seen and pleased and even conversed with.
verses.hindi: पौष्णं च देव्यः सततं व्यपोहन्तु मलं मम। ज्वर: कुम्भोदरश्चैव शङ्कुकर्णो महाबलः आसुरी भावको दूर करें। गरुत्मान्, खगति, पक्षिराट्,
verses.wordMeaning: O leading sages, what you have said is quite true. Still with faith the lord can be seen and pleased and even conversed with.
verses.commentary: Sense: O leading sages, what you have said is quite true. Still with faith the lord can be seen and pleased and even conversed with.
