verses.sanskrit: उच्छिष्टः पूजयन्याति पैशाचं तु द्विजाधमः संक्रुद्धो राक्षसं स्थानं प्राप्नुयान् मूढधीर् द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: ucchiṣṭaḥ pūjayanyāti paiśācaṃ tu dvijādhamaḥ saṃkruddho rākṣasaṃ sthānaṃ prāpnuyān mūḍhadhīr dvijāḥ
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, those trees which are utilised irt the worship of Siva through their flowers, leaves, etc., and the cows too, attain the supreme goal.
verses.hindi: मेरे भय तथा पापको दूर करें। लक्ष्मी, धरणी,
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent brahmins, those trees which are utilised irt the worship of Siva through their flowers, leaves, etc., and the cows too, attain the supreme goal.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent brahmins, those trees which are utilised irt the worship of Siva through their flowers, leaves, etc., and the cows too, attain the supreme goal.

verses.sanskrit: अभक्ष्यभक्षी सम्पूज्य याक्षं प्राप्नोति दुर्जनः गानशीलश् च गान्धर्वं नृत्यशीलस्तथैव च
verses.transliteration: abhakṣyabhakṣī sampūjya yākṣaṃ prāpnoti durjanaḥ gānaśīlaś ca gāndharvaṃ nṛtyaśīlastathaiva ca
verses.translation: He who but once worships Siva, Rudra, Sarva, the un- born Bhava attains Siva's Sayujya devoid of returning here again.
verses.hindi: देवपूजित माताएँ, देवताओंकी माताएँ, गणोंकी माताएँ, भूतोंकी माताएँ तथा अन्य जो भी गणमाताएँ जहाँ-कहीं भी हों-वे सब देवदेव शिव-के अनुग्रहसे मेरे पापको दूर करें॥ ६७--७० ॥ अत्यन्त भक्तियुक्त होकर शिवके लिये नित्य ताण्डव नृत्य करनेवाली तथा शिवार्चनमें रत रहनेवाली उर्वशी, मेनका, रम्भा, रति, तिलोत्तमा, सुमुखी, दुर्मुखी, कामुकी, कामवर्धनी--ये तथा सभी लोकोंकी अन्य दिव्य
verses.wordMeaning: He who but once worships Siva, Rudra, Sarva, the un- born Bhava attains Siva's Sayujya devoid of returning here again.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who but once worships Siva, Rudra, Sarva, the un- born Bhava attains Siva's Sayujya devoid of returning here again.

verses.sanskrit: ख्यातिशीलस् तथा चान्द्रं स्त्रीषु सक्तो नराधमः मदार्तः पूजयन् रुद्रं सोमस्थानमवाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: khyātiśīlas tathā cāndraṃ strīṣu sakto narādhamaḥ madārtaḥ pūjayan rudraṃ somasthānamavāpnuyāt
verses.translation: One is liberated frdm asin veii by seeing but once incidentally Parameana, Bhava, Sarva, lord of Uma who was worshipped thus.
verses.hindi: अप्सराएँ और देवियाँ मेरे पापको दूर करें ॥ ७१-७२ /२॥
verses.wordMeaning: One is liberated frdm asin veii by seeing but once incidentally Parameana, Bhava, Sarva, lord of Uma who was worshipped thus.
verses.commentary: Sense: One is liberated frdm asin veii by seeing but once incidentally Parameana, Bhava, Sarva, lord of Uma who was worshipped thus.

verses.sanskrit: गायत्र्या देवमभ्यर्च्य प्राजापत्यमवाप्नुयात् ब्राह्मं हि प्रणवेनैव वैष्णवं चाभिनन्द्य च
verses.transliteration: gāyatryā devamabhyarcya prājāpatyamavāpnuyāt brāhmaṃ hi praṇavenaiva vaiṣṇavaṃ cābhinandya ca
verses.translation: There is no doubt in this that a man attains Brahma's world by seeing Mahadeva who has been worshipped or is being worshipped.
verses.hindi: शिवका अर्चन करनेवाले सूर्य, चन्द्रमा, मंगल, बुध, बृहस्पति, शुक्र, शनैश्चर, राहु और केतु मेरे घोर भय तथा ग्रहकष्टका निवारण करें। मेष, वृष, मिथुन, शुभ कर्क, सिंह, कन्या, विशद तुला, वृश्चिक, धनु, मकर, कुम्भ तथा मीन--ये बारह शिवपूजापरायण राशियाँ महेश्वरकी कृपासे मेरे भय तथा पापको दूर करें। अश्विनी, भरणी, कृत्तिका, रोहिणी, श्रीयुक्त
verses.wordMeaning: There is no doubt in this that a man attains Brahma's world by seeing Mahadeva who has been worshipped or is being worshipped.
verses.commentary: Sense: There is no doubt in this that a man attains Brahma's world by seeing Mahadeva who has been worshipped or is being worshipped.

verses.sanskrit: श्रद्धया सकृदेवापि समभ्यर्च्य महेश्वरम् रुद्रलोकमनुप्राप्य रुद्रैः सार्धं प्रमोदते
verses.transliteration: śraddhayā sakṛdevāpi samabhyarcya maheśvaram rudralokamanuprāpya rudraiḥ sārdhaṃ pramodate
verses.translation: There is no doubt in this that a man attains Brahma's world by seeing Mahadeva who has been worshipped or is being worshipped.
verses.hindi: ज्येष्ठा, मूल, महाभाग पूर्वाषाढा, उत्तराषाढा, श्रवण,
verses.wordMeaning: There is no doubt in this that a man attains Brahma's world by seeing Mahadeva who has been worshipped or is being worshipped.
verses.commentary: Sense: There is no doubt in this that a man attains Brahma's world by seeing Mahadeva who has been worshipped or is being worshipped.

verses.sanskrit: संशोध्य च शुभं लिङ्गम् अमरासुरपूजितम् जलैः पूतैस्तथा पीठे देवमावाह्य भक्तितः
verses.transliteration: saṃśodhya ca śubhaṃ liṅgam amarāsurapūjitam jalaiḥ pūtaistathā pīṭhe devamāvāhya bhaktitaḥ
verses.translation: There is no doubt in this that a man attains Brahma's world by seeing Mahadeva who has been worshipped or is being worshipped.
verses.hindi: ये देवियाँ निरन्तर मेरे पापको दूर करें॥ ७३--८० /२॥ ज्वर, कुम्भोदर, शंकुकर्ण, महाबल, महाकर्ण,
verses.wordMeaning: There is no doubt in this that a man attains Brahma's world by seeing Mahadeva who has been worshipped or is being worshipped.
verses.commentary: Sense: There is no doubt in this that a man attains Brahma's world by seeing Mahadeva who has been worshipped or is being worshipped.

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा देवं यथान्यायं प्रणिपत्य च शङ्करम् कल्पिते चासने स्थाप्य धर्मज्ञानमये शुभे
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvā devaṃ yathānyāyaṃ praṇipatya ca śaṅkaram kalpite cāsane sthāpya dharmajñānamaye śubhe
verses.translation: There is no doubt in this that a man attains Brahma's world by seeing Mahadeva who has been worshipped or is being worshipped.
verses.hindi: नन नन नि वा आमामा काहा? महाकर्णः प्रभातश्च महाभूतप्रमर्दनः ।
verses.wordMeaning: There is no doubt in this that a man attains Brahma's world by seeing Mahadeva who has been worshipped or is being worshipped.
verses.commentary: Sense: There is no doubt in this that a man attains Brahma's world by seeing Mahadeva who has been worshipped or is being worshipped.

verses.sanskrit: वैराग्यैश्वर्यसम्पन्ने सर्वलोकनमस्कृते ओङ्कारपद्ममध्ये तु सोमसूर्याग्निसंभवे
verses.transliteration: vairāgyaiśvaryasampanne sarvalokanamaskṛte oṅkārapadmamadhye tu somasūryāgnisaṃbhave
verses.translation: There is no doubt in this that a man attains Brahma's world by seeing Mahadeva who has been worshipped or is being worshipped.
verses.hindi: कोटिकोटिशतैश्चैव भूतानां मातरः सदा। व्यपोहन्तु भयं पापं महादेवप्रसादतः प्रभात, महाभूतप्रमर्दन, श्येनजित्, शिवदूत--ये टक वर्धक प्रमथगण और करोड़ों-करोड़ों माता महादेवकी कृपासे मेरे भय तथा पापको करें॥ ८१--८३ ॥ के र
verses.wordMeaning: There is no doubt in this that a man attains Brahma's world by seeing Mahadeva who has been worshipped or is being worshipped.
verses.commentary: Sense: There is no doubt in this that a man attains Brahma's world by seeing Mahadeva who has been worshipped or is being worshipped.

verses.sanskrit: पाद्यमाचमनं चार्घ्यं दत्त्वा रुद्राय शंभवे स्नापयेद्दिव्यतोयैश् च घृतेन पयसा तथा
verses.transliteration: pādyamācamanaṃ cārghyaṃ dattvā rudrāya śaṃbhave snāpayeddivyatoyaiś ca ghṛtena payasā tathā
verses.translation: There is no doubt in this that a man attains Brahma's world by seeing Mahadeva who has been worshipped or is being worshipped.
verses.hindi: जो क शिवके ध्यानमें तल्लीन, हिमालयसे प्रादुर्भूत गंगाके जलके समान पापनाशक, कुन्द पुष्पा तथा चन्द्रमाके समान आकारवाले, कुम्भ-कुन्दपुष्यो तथा इन्दुको भूषणके रूपमें धारण करनेवाले, बड़वानलके
verses.wordMeaning: There is no doubt in this that a man attains Brahma's world by seeing Mahadeva who has been worshipped or is being worshipped.
verses.commentary: Sense: There is no doubt in this that a man attains Brahma's world by seeing Mahadeva who has been worshipped or is being worshipped.

verses.sanskrit: दध्ना च स्नापयेद्रुद्रं शोधयेच्च यथाविधि ततः शुद्धांबुना स्नाप्य चन्दनाद्यैश् च पूजयेत्
verses.transliteration: dadhnā ca snāpayedrudraṃ śodhayecca yathāvidhi tataḥ śuddhāṃbunā snāpya candanādyaiś ca pūjayet
verses.translation: There is no doubt in this that a man attains Brahma's world by seeing Mahadeva who has been worshipped or is being worshipped.
verses.hindi: शत्रु, बड़वाके मुखका भेदन करनेवाले हैं, चार पैरोंवाले क्षीरसागरके समान पाण्डुर वर्णवाले, रुद्रो तथा गणेश्वरोंके साथ सदा रुद्रलोकमें रहनेवाले, विश्वको धारण करनेवाले, सम्पूर्ण जगत्के पिता, नन्दा आदि माताओंसे सदा घिरे हुए, यज्ञका नाश करनेवाले तथा शिवार्चनपरायण हैँ-वे वृषेन्द्र मेरे पापको सदा दूर करें ॥ ८४--८७॥
verses.wordMeaning: There is no doubt in this that a man attains Brahma's world by seeing Mahadeva who has been worshipped or is being worshipped.
verses.commentary: Sense: There is no doubt in this that a man attains Brahma's world by seeing Mahadeva who has been worshipped or is being worshipped.

verses.sanskrit: रोचनाद्यैश् च सम्पूज्य दिव्यपुष्पैश् च पूजयेत् बिल्वपत्रैरखण्डैश् च पद्मैर्नानाविधैस् तथा
verses.transliteration: rocanādyaiś ca sampūjya divyapuṣpaiś ca pūjayet bilvapatrairakhaṇḍaiś ca padmairnānāvidhais tathā
verses.translation: There is no doubt in this that a man attains Brahma's world by seeing Mahadeva who has been worshipped or is being worshipped.
verses.hindi: रुद्रलोकमें स्थित जगज्जननी गंगामाता मेरे पापको दूर करें। जो शिवभक्त नन्दा नामक गौ हैं, वे मेरे पापको दूर करें। भद्रपदवाली, शिवलोकमें स्थित, गायोंको माता महाभाग्यशालिनी जो देवी भद्रा नामक
verses.wordMeaning: There is no doubt in this that a man attains Brahma's world by seeing Mahadeva who has been worshipped or is being worshipped.
verses.commentary: Sense: There is no doubt in this that a man attains Brahma's world by seeing Mahadeva who has been worshipped or is being worshipped.

verses.sanskrit: नीलोत्पलैश् च राजीवैर् नद्यावर्तैश् च मल्लिकैः चम्पकैर् जातिपुष्पैश्च बकुलैः करवीरकैः
verses.transliteration: nīlotpalaiś ca rājīvair nadyāvartaiś ca mallikaiḥ campakair jātipuṣpaiśca bakulaiḥ karavīrakaiḥ
verses.translation: There is no doubt in this that a man attains Brahma's world by seeing Mahadeva who has been worshipped or is being worshipped.
verses.hindi: गौ हैं, वे मेरे पापको दूर करें। सब प्रकारसे कल्याण करनेवाली, सभी पापोंका नाश करनेवाली तथा सदा रुद्रपूजामें लीन रहनेवाली वे सुरभि नामक गौ मेरे पापको दूर करें। शीलसे सम्पन्न, ऐश्वर्य प्रदान करनेवाली, शिवभक्त तथा नित्य शिवलोकमें रहनेवाली वे सुशीला नामक गौ मेरे पापको दूर करें
verses.wordMeaning: There is no doubt in this that a man attains Brahma's world by seeing Mahadeva who has been worshipped or is being worshipped.
verses.commentary: Sense: There is no doubt in this that a man attains Brahma's world by seeing Mahadeva who has been worshipped or is being worshipped.

verses.sanskrit: शमीपुष्पैर् बृहत्पुष्पैर् उन्मत्तागस्त्यजैरपि अपामार्गकदम्बैश् च भूषणैरपि शोभनैः
verses.transliteration: śamīpuṣpair bṛhatpuṣpair unmattāgastyajairapi apāmārgakadambaiś ca bhūṣaṇairapi śobhanaiḥ
verses.translation: There is no doubt in this that a man attains Brahma's world by seeing Mahadeva who has been worshipped or is being worshipped.
verses.hindi: वेदों तथा शास्त्रोंके अर्थ तथा तत्त्वके ज्ञाता, समस्त कार्योका चिन्तन करनेवाले, सभी गुणोंसे सम्पन्न, सर्वदेवेश्वर शिव-के पुत्र, श्रेष्ठ, सर्वेश्वर, सौम्य, साक्षात् महाविष्णुके विग्रहस्वरूप, देवताओंके सेनापति,
verses.wordMeaning: There is no doubt in this that a man attains Brahma's world by seeing Mahadeva who has been worshipped or is being worshipped.
verses.commentary: Sense: There is no doubt in this that a man attains Brahma's world by seeing Mahadeva who has been worshipped or is being worshipped.

verses.sanskrit: दत्त्वा पञ्चविधं धूपं पायसं च निवेदयेत् दधिभक्तं च मध्वाज्यपरिप्लुतमतः परम्
verses.transliteration: dattvā pañcavidhaṃ dhūpaṃ pāyasaṃ ca nivedayet dadhibhaktaṃ ca madhvājyapariplutamataḥ param
verses.translation: There is no doubt in this that a man attains Brahma's world by seeing Mahadeva who has been worshipped or is being worshipped.
verses.hindi: गम्भीरतासे युक्त, यज्ञको विनष्ट करनेवाले, ऐरावत हाथीपर सवार, काले तथा घुँघराले केशवाले, कृष्णवर्णके अंगवाले, लाल नेत्रोंवाले, चन्द्रमा तथा सर्पके आभूषणवाले, भूतों-प्रेतों-पिशाचों तथा कृष्माण्डोंसे घिरे हुए और शिवार्चनमें तल्लीन वे आर्य कालभैरव मेरे पापको दूर करें
verses.wordMeaning: There is no doubt in this that a man attains Brahma's world by seeing Mahadeva who has been worshipped or is being worshipped.
verses.commentary: Sense: There is no doubt in this that a man attains Brahma's world by seeing Mahadeva who has been worshipped or is being worshipped.

verses.sanskrit: शुद्धान्नं चैव मुद्गान्नं षड्विधं च निवेदयेत् अथ पञ्चविधं वापि सघृतं विनिवेदयेत्
verses.transliteration: śuddhānnaṃ caiva mudgānnaṃ ṣaḍvidhaṃ ca nivedayet atha pañcavidhaṃ vāpi saghṛtaṃ vinivedayet
verses.translation: There is no doubt in this that a man attains Brahma's world by seeing Mahadeva who has been worshipped or is being worshipped.
verses.hindi: शिवध्यानैकसम्पन्नो हिमराङम्बुसन्निभः। कुन्देन्दुसटृशाकारः कुम्भकुन्देन्दुqभूषणः
verses.wordMeaning: There is no doubt in this that a man attains Brahma's world by seeing Mahadeva who has been worshipped or is being worshipped.
verses.commentary: Sense: There is no doubt in this that a man attains Brahma's world by seeing Mahadeva who has been worshipped or is being worshipped.

verses.sanskrit: केवलं चापि शुद्धान्नम् आढकं तण्डुलं पचेत् कृत्वा प्रदक्षिणं चान्ते नमस्कृत्य मुहुर्मुहुः
verses.transliteration: kevalaṃ cāpi śuddhānnam āḍhakaṃ taṇḍulaṃ pacet kṛtvā pradakṣiṇaṃ cānte namaskṛtya muhurmuhuḥ
verses.translation: There is no doubt in this that a man attains Brahma's world by seeing Mahadeva who has been worshipped or is being worshipped.
verses.hindi: रूद्रलोके स्थितो नित्यं रुद्रैः सार्धं गणेश्वरैः । वृषेन्द्रो विश्वधृग्देवो विश्वस्य जगतः पिता शिवार्चनरतो नित्यं स मे पापं व्यपोहतु
verses.wordMeaning: There is no doubt in this that a man attains Brahma's world by seeing Mahadeva who has been worshipped or is being worshipped.
verses.commentary: Sense: There is no doubt in this that a man attains Brahma's world by seeing Mahadeva who has been worshipped or is being worshipped.

verses.sanskrit: स्तुत्वा च देवमीशानं पुनः सम्पूज्य शङ्करम् ईशानं पुरुषं चैव अघोरं वाममेव च
verses.transliteration: stutvā ca devamīśānaṃ punaḥ sampūjya śaṅkaram īśānaṃ puruṣaṃ caiva aghoraṃ vāmameva ca
verses.translation: There is no doubt in this that a man attains Brahma's world by seeing Mahadeva who has been worshipped or is being worshipped.
verses.hindi: गङ्गा माता जगन्माता रुद्रलोके व्यवस्थिता। शिवभक्ता तु या नन्दा सा मे पापं व्यपोहतु
verses.wordMeaning: There is no doubt in this that a man attains Brahma's world by seeing Mahadeva who has been worshipped or is being worshipped.
verses.commentary: Sense: There is no doubt in this that a man attains Brahma's world by seeing Mahadeva who has been worshipped or is being worshipped.

verses.sanskrit: सद्योजातं जपंश्चापि पञ्चभिः पूजयेच्छिवम् अनेन विधिना देवः प्रसीदति महेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: sadyojātaṃ japaṃścāpi pañcabhiḥ pūjayecchivam anena vidhinā devaḥ prasīdati maheśvaraḥ
verses.translation: There is no doubt in this that a man attains Brahma's world by seeing Mahadeva who has been worshipped or is being worshipped.
verses.hindi: भद्रा भद्रपदा देवी शिवलोके व्यवस्थिता । माता गवां महाभागा सा मे पापं व्यपोहतु सुरभिः सर्वतोभद्रा सर्वपापप्रणाशनी। रुद्रपूजारता नित्यं सा मे पापं व्यपोहतु
verses.wordMeaning: There is no doubt in this that a man attains Brahma's world by seeing Mahadeva who has been worshipped or is being worshipped.
verses.commentary: Sense: There is no doubt in this that a man attains Brahma's world by seeing Mahadeva who has been worshipped or is being worshipped.

verses.sanskrit: वृक्षाः पुष्पादिपत्राद्यैर् उपयुक्ताः शिवार्चने गावश्चैव द्विजश्रेष्ठाः प्रयान्ति परमां गतिम्
verses.transliteration: vṛkṣāḥ puṣpādipatrādyair upayuktāḥ śivārcane gāvaścaiva dvijaśreṣṭhāḥ prayānti paramāṃ gatim
verses.translation: There is no doubt in this that a man attains Brahma's world by seeing Mahadeva who has been worshipped or is being worshipped.
verses.hindi: सुशीला शीलसम्पन्ना श्रीप्रदा शिवभाविता। शिवलोके स्थिता नित्यं सा मे पापं व्यपोहतु
verses.wordMeaning: There is no doubt in this that a man attains Brahma's world by seeing Mahadeva who has been worshipped or is being worshipped.
verses.commentary: Sense: There is no doubt in this that a man attains Brahma's world by seeing Mahadeva who has been worshipped or is being worshipped.

verses.sanskrit: पूजयेद्यः शिवं रुद्रं शर्वं भवमजं सकृत् स याति शिवसायुज्यं पुनरावृत्तिवर्जितम्
verses.transliteration: pūjayedyaḥ śivaṃ rudraṃ śarvaṃ bhavamajaṃ sakṛt sa yāti śivasāyujyaṃ punarāvṛttivarjitam
verses.translation: There is no doubt in this that a man attains Brahma's world by seeing Mahadeva who has been worshipped or is being worshipped.
verses.hindi: वेदशास्त्रार्थतत्त्वज्ञः सर्वकार्याभिचिन्तकः। समस्तगुणसम्पन्नः सर्वदेवेश्वरात्मजः ज्येष्ठ: सर्वेश्वरः सौम्यो महाविष्णुतनुः स्वयम्। आर्यः सेनापतिः साक्षाद् गहनो मखमर्दनः
verses.wordMeaning: There is no doubt in this that a man attains Brahma's world by seeing Mahadeva who has been worshipped or is being worshipped.
verses.commentary: Sense: There is no doubt in this that a man attains Brahma's world by seeing Mahadeva who has been worshipped or is being worshipped.

verses.sanskrit: अर्चितं परमेशानं भवं शर्वमुमापतिम् सकृत्प्रसंगाद्वा दृष्ट्वा सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: arcitaṃ parameśānaṃ bhavaṃ śarvamumāpatim sakṛtprasaṃgādvā dṛṣṭvā sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate
verses.translation: There is no doubt in this that a man attains Brahma's world by seeing Mahadeva who has been worshipped or is being worshipped.
verses.hindi: शिवार्चनरतः साक्षात् स मे पापं व्यपोहतु
verses.wordMeaning: There is no doubt in this that a man attains Brahma's world by seeing Mahadeva who has been worshipped or is being worshipped.
verses.commentary: Sense: There is no doubt in this that a man attains Brahma's world by seeing Mahadeva who has been worshipped or is being worshipped.

verses.sanskrit: पूजितं वा महादेवं पूज्यमानमथापि वा दृष्ट्वा प्रयाति वै मर्त्यो ब्रह्मलोकं न संशयः
verses.transliteration: pūjitaṃ vā mahādevaṃ pūjyamānamathāpi vā dṛṣṭvā prayāti vai martyo brahmalokaṃ na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: There is no doubt in this that a man attains Brahma's world by seeing Mahadeva who has been worshipped or is being worshipped.
verses.hindi: सभी पापोंका उच्छेदक तथा शिवसायुज्य प्रदान करनेवाला व्यपोहनस्तव अफर सकफ क काक क कफ फ क फफ फ फ फ फफ फफ फ फफ फफ फफ फा फफफ फफ फफफ फफ फफक फा
verses.wordMeaning: There is no doubt in this that a man attains Brahma's world by seeing Mahadeva who has been worshipped or is being worshipped.
verses.commentary: Sense: There is no doubt in this that a man attains Brahma's world by seeing Mahadeva who has been worshipped or is being worshipped.

verses.sanskrit: श्रुत्वानुमोदयेच्चापि स याति परमां गतिम् यो दद्याद् घृतदीपं च सकृल्लिङ्गस्य चाग्रतः
verses.transliteration: śrutvānumodayeccāpi sa yāti paramāṃ gatim yo dadyād ghṛtadīpaṃ ca sakṛlliṅgasya cāgrataḥ
verses.translation: There is no doubt in this that a man attains Brahma's world by seeing Mahadeva who has been worshipped or is being worshipped.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्माणी चैव माहेशी कौमारी वैष्णवी तथा।
verses.wordMeaning: There is no doubt in this that a man attains Brahma's world by seeing Mahadeva who has been worshipped or is being worshipped.
verses.commentary: Sense: There is no doubt in this that a man attains Brahma's world by seeing Mahadeva who has been worshipped or is being worshipped.

verses.sanskrit: स तां गतिम् अवाप्नोति स्वाश्रमैर् दुर्लभां स्थिराम् दीपवृक्षं पार्थिवं वा दारवं वा शिवालये
verses.transliteration: sa tāṃ gatim avāpnoti svāśramair durlabhāṃ sthirām dīpavṛkṣaṃ pārthivaṃ vā dāravaṃ vā śivālaye
verses.translation: There is no doubt in this that a man attains Brahma's world by seeing Mahadeva who has been worshipped or is being worshipped.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्माणी, माहेशी, कौमारी, वैष्णवी, वाराही, माहेन्द्री, बाराही चैव माहेन्द्री चामुण्डाग्नेयिका तथा॥ ९६ आग्नेयिका-समस्त लोकोंसे पूजित तथा
verses.wordMeaning: There is no doubt in this that a man attains Brahma's world by seeing Mahadeva who has been worshipped or is being worshipped.
verses.commentary: Sense: There is no doubt in this that a man attains Brahma's world by seeing Mahadeva who has been worshipped or is being worshipped.

verses.sanskrit: दत्त्वा कुलशतं साग्रं शिवलोके महीयते आयसं ताम्रजं वापि रौप्यं सौवर्णिकं तथा
verses.transliteration: dattvā kulaśataṃ sāgraṃ śivaloke mahīyate āyasaṃ tāmrajaṃ vāpi raupyaṃ sauvarṇikaṃ tathā
verses.translation: There is no doubt in this that a man attains Brahma's world by seeing Mahadeva who has been worshipped or is being worshipped.
verses.hindi: एता वै मातरः सर्वाः सर्वलोकप्रपूजिताः। योगिनीभिर्महापापं व्यपोहन्तु समाहिताः
verses.wordMeaning: There is no doubt in this that a man attains Brahma's world by seeing Mahadeva who has been worshipped or is being worshipped.
verses.commentary: Sense: There is no doubt in this that a man attains Brahma's world by seeing Mahadeva who has been worshipped or is being worshipped.

verses.sanskrit: शिवाय दीपं यो दद्याद् विधिना वापि भक्तितः सूर्यायुतसमैः श्लक्ष्णैर् यानैः शिवपुरं व्रजेत्
verses.transliteration: śivāya dīpaṃ yo dadyād vidhinā vāpi bhaktitaḥ sūryāyutasamaiḥ ślakṣṇair yānaiḥ śivapuraṃ vrajet
verses.translation: There is no doubt in this that a man attains Brahma's world by seeing Mahadeva who has been worshipped or is being worshipped.
verses.hindi: रुद्रस्य तनयो रौद्रः शूलासक्तमहाकरः त्रेताग्निनयनो देवस्त्रैलोक्याभयदः प्रभुः
verses.wordMeaning: There is no doubt in this that a man attains Brahma's world by seeing Mahadeva who has been worshipped or is being worshipped.
verses.commentary: Sense: There is no doubt in this that a man attains Brahma's world by seeing Mahadeva who has been worshipped or is being worshipped.

verses.sanskrit: कार्तिके मासि यो दद्याद् घृतदीपं शिवाग्रतः सम्पूज्यमानं वा पश्येद् विधिना परमेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: kārtike māsi yo dadyād ghṛtadīpaṃ śivāgrataḥ sampūjyamānaṃ vā paśyed vidhinā parameśvaram
verses.translation: There is no doubt in this that a man attains Brahma's world by seeing Mahadeva who has been worshipped or is being worshipped.
verses.hindi: मातृणां रक्षको नित्यं महावूषभवाहनः। त्रैलोक्यनमितः श्रीमान् शिवपादार्चने रतः
verses.wordMeaning: There is no doubt in this that a man attains Brahma's world by seeing Mahadeva who has been worshipped or is being worshipped.
verses.commentary: Sense: There is no doubt in this that a man attains Brahma's world by seeing Mahadeva who has been worshipped or is being worshipped.

verses.sanskrit: स याति ब्रह्मणो लोकं श्रद्धया मुनिसत्तमाः आवाहनं सुसान्निध्यं स्थापनं पूजनं तथा
verses.transliteration: sa yāti brahmaṇo lokaṃ śraddhayā munisattamāḥ āvāhanaṃ susānnidhyaṃ sthāpanaṃ pūjanaṃ tathā
verses.translation: There is no doubt in this that a man attains Brahma's world by seeing Mahadeva who has been worshipped or is being worshipped.
verses.hindi: यज्ञस्य च शिरश्‍च्छेत्ता पूष्णो दन्तविनाशनः। वह्नेहस्तहरः साक्षाद् भगनेत्रनिपातनः उपेनद्रेनद्रयमादीनां देवानामङ्गरक्षकः
verses.wordMeaning: There is no doubt in this that a man attains Brahma's world by seeing Mahadeva who has been worshipped or is being worshipped.
verses.commentary: Sense: There is no doubt in this that a man attains Brahma's world by seeing Mahadeva who has been worshipped or is being worshipped.

verses.sanskrit: सम्प्रोक्तं रुद्रगायत्र्या आसनं प्रणवेन वै पञ्चभिः स्नपनं प्रोक्तं रुद्राद्यैश् च विशेषतः
verses.transliteration: samproktaṃ rudragāyatryā āsanaṃ praṇavena vai pañcabhiḥ snapanaṃ proktaṃ rudrādyaiś ca viśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: There is no doubt in this that a man attains Brahma's world by seeing Mahadeva who has been worshipped or is being worshipped.
verses.hindi: सरस्वत्या महादेव्या नासिकोष्ठावकर्तनः। गणेश्वरो यः सेनानीः स मे पापं व्यपोहतु
verses.wordMeaning: There is no doubt in this that a man attains Brahma's world by seeing Mahadeva who has been worshipped or is being worshipped.
verses.commentary: Sense: There is no doubt in this that a man attains Brahma's world by seeing Mahadeva who has been worshipped or is being worshipped.

verses.sanskrit: एवं सम्पूजयेन्नित्यं देवदेवमुमापतिम् ब्रह्माणं दक्षिणे तस्य प्रणवेन समर्चयेत्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ sampūjayennityaṃ devadevamumāpatim brahmāṇaṃ dakṣiṇe tasya praṇavena samarcayet
verses.translation: There is no doubt in this that a man attains Brahma's world by seeing Mahadeva who has been worshipped or is being worshipped.
verses.hindi: महालक्ष्सीर्जगन्माता सा मे पापं व्यपोहतु १०४ शिवार्चनरता नित्यं सा मे पापं व्यपोहतु
verses.wordMeaning: There is no doubt in this that a man attains Brahma's world by seeing Mahadeva who has been worshipped or is being worshipped.
verses.commentary: Sense: There is no doubt in this that a man attains Brahma's world by seeing Mahadeva who has been worshipped or is being worshipped.

verses.sanskrit: उत्तरे देवदेवेशं विष्णुं गायत्रिया यजेत् वह्नौ हुत्वा यथान्यायं पञ्चभिः प्रणवेन च
verses.transliteration: uttare devadeveśaṃ viṣṇuṃ gāyatriyā yajet vahnau hutvā yathānyāyaṃ pañcabhiḥ praṇavena ca
verses.translation: There is no doubt in this that a man attains Brahma's world by seeing Mahadeva who has been worshipped or is being worshipped.
verses.hindi: सर्वदा सर्वगा देवी सा मे पापं व्यपोहतु
verses.wordMeaning: There is no doubt in this that a man attains Brahma's world by seeing Mahadeva who has been worshipped or is being worshipped.
verses.commentary: Sense: There is no doubt in this that a man attains Brahma's world by seeing Mahadeva who has been worshipped or is being worshipped.

verses.sanskrit: स याति शिवसायुज्यम् एवं सम्पूज्य शङ्करम् इति संक्षेपतः प्रोक्तो लिङ्गार्चनविधिक्रमः
verses.transliteration: sa yāti śivasāyujyam evaṃ sampūjya śaṅkaram iti saṃkṣepataḥ prokto liṅgārcanavidhikramaḥ
verses.translation: There is no doubt in this that a man attains Brahma's world by seeing Mahadeva who has been worshipped or is being worshipped.
verses.hindi: सिंहारूढा महादेवी पार्वत्यास्तनयाव्यया। विष्णोर्निद्रा महामाया वैष्णवी सुरपूजिता त्रिनेत्रा वरदा देवी महिषासुरमर्दिनी। शिवार्चनरता दुर्गा सा मे पापं व्यपोहतु
verses.wordMeaning: There is no doubt in this that a man attains Brahma's world by seeing Mahadeva who has been worshipped or is being worshipped.
verses.commentary: Sense: There is no doubt in this that a man attains Brahma's world by seeing Mahadeva who has been worshipped or is being worshipped.

verses.sanskrit: व्यासेन कथितः पूर्वं श्रुत्वा रुद्रमुखात्स्वयम्
verses.transliteration: vyāsena kathitaḥ pūrvaṃ śrutvā rudramukhātsvayam
verses.translation: There is no doubt in this that a man attains Brahma's world by seeing Mahadeva who has been worshipped or is being worshipped.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्माण्डधारका रुद्राः सर्वलोकप्रपूजिताः। सत्याश्च मानसाः सर्वे व्यपोहन्तु भयं मम
verses.wordMeaning: There is no doubt in this that a man attains Brahma's world by seeing Mahadeva who has been worshipped or is being worshipped.
verses.commentary: Sense: There is no doubt in this that a man attains Brahma's world by seeing Mahadeva who has been worshipped or is being worshipped.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीलिङ्गमहापुराणे पूर्वभागे शिवार्चनविधिर् नामैकोनाशीतितमो ऽध्यायः कथं पशुपतिं दृष्ट्वा पशुपाशविमोक्षणम् पशुत्वं तत्यजुर्देवास् तन्नो वक्तुमिहार्हसि
verses.transliteration: iti śrīliṅgamahāpurāṇe pūrvabhāge śivārcanavidhir nāmaikonāśītitamo 'dhyāyaḥ kathaṃ paśupatiṃ dṛṣṭvā paśupāśavimokṣaṇam paśutvaṃ tatyajurdevās tanno vaktumihārhasi
verses.translation: Meru was devoid of all sins. It bestowed each and every object of desire. It was the chief means of enjoyment. The fiocks of sparrows rejoiced therein. Herds of elephants
verses.hindi: भूताः प्रेताः पिशाचाश्च कूष्माण्डगणनायकाः। कूष्माण्डकाश्च ते पापं व्यपोहन्तु समाहिताः १९० योगिनियंसे घिरी हुई ये सभी माताएँ मेरे महापापको दूर करें
verses.wordMeaning: Meru was devoid of all sins. It bestowed each and every object of desire. It was the chief means of enjoyment. The fiocks of sparrows rejoiced therein. Herds of elephants
verses.commentary: Sense: Meru was devoid of all sins. It bestowed each and every object of desire. It was the chief means of enjoyment. The fiocks of sparrows rejoiced therein. Herds of elephants

verses.sanskrit: पुरा कैलासशिखरे भोग्याख्ये स्वपुरे स्थितम् समेत्य देवाः सर्वज्ञम् आजग्मुस्तत्प्रसादतः
verses.transliteration: purā kailāsaśikhare bhogyākhye svapure sthitam sametya devāḥ sarvajñam ājagmustatprasādataḥ
verses.translation: Bhogya ot Bhogyft, The city ti located on the mountain Kailfisa.
verses.hindi: महातेजस्वी, हिम (बर्फ)-कुन्दपुष्प तथा चन्द्रमाके सदृश, रुद्रके पुत्र, भयानक, शूलयुक्त विशाल भुजावाले, हजार भुजाओंवाले, सब कुछ जाननेवाले, सभी प्रकारके शस्त्र धारण करनेवाले, तीन अग्निरूप नेत्रवाले, देवस्वरूप,
verses.wordMeaning: Bhogya ot Bhogyft, The city ti located on the mountain Kailfisa.
verses.commentary: Sense: Bhogya ot Bhogyft, The city ti located on the mountain Kailfisa.

verses.sanskrit: हिताय सर्वदेवानां ब्रह्मणा च जनार्दनः गरुडस्य तथा स्कन्धम् आरुह्य पुरुषोत्तमः
verses.transliteration: hitāya sarvadevānāṃ brahmaṇā ca janārdanaḥ garuḍasya tathā skandham āruhya puruṣottamaḥ
verses.translation: In some places it abounded in divine trees. There were Kurabaka, Priyaka and Tilaka trees. The excellent mountain had many Kadamba trees and was surrounded by the creepers of Tamala. The mountain had many peaks.
verses.hindi: तीनों लोकोंको अभय प्रदान करनेवाले, ऐश्वर्यशाली, माताओंकी सर्वदा रक्षा करनेवाले, महान् वृषभपर आरूढ, तीनों लोकोंसे नमस्कृत, श्रीयुक्त, शिवके पादार्चनमें तल्लीन, यज्ञके सिरका छेदन करनेवाले, पूषाके दाँतको तोड्नेवाले, अग्निके हाथको नष्ट करनेवाले, साक्षात् भगके नेत्रको नीचे गिरानेवाले, अपने पैरके अँगूठेसे सोमके अंगको पीसनेवाले, प्रभु नामवाले, उपेन्द्र-इन्द्र-यम आदि देवताओंके अंगरक्षक,
verses.wordMeaning: In some places it abounded in divine trees. There were Kurabaka, Priyaka and Tilaka trees. The excellent mountain had many Kadamba trees and was surrounded by the creepers of Tamala. The mountain had many peaks.
verses.commentary: Sense: In some places it abounded in divine trees. There were Kurabaka, Priyaka and Tilaka trees. The excellent mountain had many Kadamba trees and was surrounded by the creepers of Tamala. The mountain had many peaks.

verses.sanskrit: जगाम देवताभिर् वै देवदेवान्तिकं हरिः सर्वे सम्प्राप्य देवस्य सार्धं गिरिवरं शुभम्
verses.transliteration: jagāma devatābhir vai devadevāntikaṃ hariḥ sarve samprāpya devasya sārdhaṃ girivaraṃ śubham
verses.translation: The city of lord Siva was built by Vivakarman on the top of this mountain for the sports of lord Siva.
verses.hindi: महादेवी सरस्वतीके ओठ तथा नाकको कारनेवाले, गणोंके ईश्वर (स्वामी) तथा सेनानायक जो वीरभद्र हैं- वे मेरे पापको दूर करें
verses.wordMeaning: The city of lord Siva was built by Vivakarman on the top of this mountain for the sports of lord Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: The city of lord Siva was built by Vivakarman on the top of this mountain for the sports of lord Siva.

verses.sanskrit: सेन्द्राः ससाध्याः सयमाः प्रणेमुर् गिरिमुत्तमम् भगवान् वासुदेवो ऽसौ गरुडाद् गरुडध्वजः अवतीर्य गिरिं मेरुम् आरुरोह सुरोत्तमैः
verses.transliteration: sendrāḥ sasādhyāḥ sayamāḥ praṇemur girimuttamam bhagavān vāsudevo 'sau garuḍād garuḍadhvajaḥ avatīrya giriṃ merum āruroha surottamaiḥ
verses.translation: Devas including Indra and Visnu saw that city and with great concentration and attention they bowed down from a great distance due to the power of the trident-bearing lord.
verses.hindi: ज्येष्ठ, वरिष्ठ, वरदायिनी, श्रेष्ठ आभूषणोंसे विभूषित तथा जगज्जननी जो महालक्ष्मी हैं-वे मेरे पापको दूर करें। महाभाग्यवती, महान् भूतगणोंसे घिरी हुई तथा शिवपूजनमें सदा रत जो महामोहा (महामाया) हैं-वे मेरे पापको दूर करें। सभी गुणोंसे सम्पन्न, सभी लक्षणोंसे युक्त, सब कुछ देनेवाली और सर्वत्र गमन करनेवाली जो देवी लक्ष्मी हैँ-वे मेरे पापको दूर करें। सिंहपर आरूढ, पार्वतीको पुत्री, शाश्वत,
verses.wordMeaning: Devas including Indra and Visnu saw that city and with great concentration and attention they bowed down from a great distance due to the power of the trident-bearing lord.
verses.commentary: Sense: Devas including Indra and Visnu saw that city and with great concentration and attention they bowed down from a great distance due to the power of the trident-bearing lord.

verses.sanskrit: सकलदुरितहीनं सर्वदं भोगमुख्यं मुदितकुररवृन्दं नादितं नागवृन्दैः मधुररणितगीतं सानुकूलान्धकारं पदरचितवनान्तं कान्तवातान्ततोयम्
verses.transliteration: sakaladuritahīnaṃ sarvadaṃ bhogamukhyaṃ muditakuraravṛndaṃ nāditaṃ nāgavṛndaiḥ madhuraraṇitagītaṃ sānukūlāndhakāraṃ padaracitavanāntaṃ kāntavātāntatoyam
verses.translation: The great primordial lord went to the mountain Kailasa, a part of the Meru, which is as refulgent as thousand suns, and which is great and which has thousands of virtues blended with it.
verses.hindi: विष्णुकी निद्रारूपा, महामाया, वैष्णवी (विष्णुको शक्ति),
verses.wordMeaning: The great primordial lord went to the mountain Kailasa, a part of the Meru, which is as refulgent as thousand suns, and which is great and which has thousands of virtues blended with it.
verses.commentary: Sense: The great primordial lord went to the mountain Kailasa, a part of the Meru, which is as refulgent as thousand suns, and which is great and which has thousands of virtues blended with it.

verses.sanskrit: भवनशतसहस्रैर् जुष्टम् आदित्यकल्पैर् ललितगतिविदग्धैर् हंसवृन्दैश् च भिन्नम् धवखदिरपलाशैश् चन्दनाद्यैश् च वृक्षैर् द्विजवरगणवृन्दैः कोकिलाद्यैर्द्विरेफैः
verses.transliteration: bhavanaśatasahasrair juṣṭam ādityakalpair lalitagatividagdhair haṃsavṛndaiś ca bhinnam dhavakhadirapalāśaiś candanādyaiś ca vṛkṣair dvijavaragaṇavṛndaiḥ kokilādyairdvirephaiḥ
verses.translation: Then Brahma and Visnu the destroyer of Asuras reached the gateway of the city which resembled the lofty mountain and which abounded in women, horses, elephants, chariots, Ganas and their chiefs.
verses.hindi: महिषासुरका संहार करनेवाली तथा शिवके अर्चनमें तल्लीन जो महादेवी भगवती दुर्गा है--वे मेरे पापको दूर करें ब्रह्माण्डको धारण करनेवाले तथा सभी लोकोंद्वारा पूजित सभी सत्य और मानस रुद्र मेरे भयको दूर करें। जो भूत, प्रेत, पिशाच, कूष्माण्डगणनायक तथा
verses.wordMeaning: Then Brahma and Visnu the destroyer of Asuras reached the gateway of the city which resembled the lofty mountain and which abounded in women, horses, elephants, chariots, Ganas and their chiefs.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then Brahma and Visnu the destroyer of Asuras reached the gateway of the city which resembled the lofty mountain and which abounded in women, horses, elephants, chariots, Ganas and their chiefs.

verses.sanskrit: क्वचिदशेषसुरद्रुमसंकुलं कुरबकैः प्रियकैस्तिलकैस् तथा बहुकदम्बतमाललतावृतं गिरिवरं शिखरैर्विविधैस् तथा
verses.transliteration: kvacidaśeṣasuradrumasaṃkulaṃ kurabakaiḥ priyakaistilakais tathā bahukadambatamālalatāvṛtaṃ girivaraṃ śikharairvividhais tathā
verses.translation: It was surrounded by big mansions full of gold and bedecked in jewels. It contained lofty palaces of various shapes and also ramparts.
verses.hindi: अनेन देवं स्तुत्वा तु चान्ते सर्व समापयेत्। प्रणम्य शिरसा भूमौ प्रतिमासे द्विजोत्तमाः १११
verses.wordMeaning: It was surrounded by big mansions full of gold and bedecked in jewels. It contained lofty palaces of various shapes and also ramparts.
verses.commentary: Sense: It was surrounded by big mansions full of gold and bedecked in jewels. It contained lofty palaces of various shapes and also ramparts.

verses.sanskrit: गिरेः पृष्ठे परं शार्वं कल्पितं विश्वकर्मणा क्रीडार्थं देवदेवस्य भवस्य परमेष्ठिनः
verses.transliteration: gireḥ pṛṣṭhe paraṃ śārvaṃ kalpitaṃ viśvakarmaṇā krīḍārthaṃ devadevasya bhavasya parameṣṭhinaḥ
verses.translation: On seeing the exterior of the city of lord Siva along with Devas including Brahma, Visnu with beaming face became delighted in his mind. He then entered the city which had great palaces and mansions with lofty upper storeys. The second city of the lord of Devas was also splendid. It had four entrances. It was encompassed by diamonds, lapis lazuli, rubies and clusters of jewels and hanging swings. It was bedecked with bells and chowries, and resonant with musical instruments, such as Mrdanga, Muraja, Vina and Venu. It was surrounded by dancing Apsarases and Bhutas (goblins). There were mansions
verses.hindi: विधूय सर्वपापानि रुद्रलोके महीयते कन्यार्थी लभते कन्यां जयकामो जयं लभेत्। अर्थकामो लभेदर्थ पुत्रकामो बहून् सुतान्
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing the exterior of the city of lord Siva along with Devas including Brahma, Visnu with beaming face became delighted in his mind. He then entered the city which had great palaces and mansions with lofty upper storeys.…
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing the exterior of the city of lord Siva along with Devas including Brahma, Visnu with beaming face became delighted in his mind. He then entered the city which had great palaces and mansions with lofty upper storeys.…

verses.sanskrit: अपश्यंस्तत्पुरं देवाः सेन्द्रोपेन्द्राः समाहिताः प्रणेमुर्दूरतश्चैव प्रभावादेव शूलिनः
verses.transliteration: apaśyaṃstatpuraṃ devāḥ sendropendrāḥ samāhitāḥ praṇemurdūrataścaiva prabhāvādeva śūlinaḥ
verses.translation: Visnu then went beyond those excellent cities (one within the other) the fourth, fifth, sixth, seventh, eighth, ninth and tenth. Then he reached the highly-splendid city of Siva. It was perfectly circular and very splendid, stationed on the auspicious peak of Kailua. It was adorned with lofty mansions resembling the sphere of the sun. In different quarters it contained crystal Mariapas and splendid platforms made of gold and different jewels. The ornamental gateways were adorned with different kinds of jewellery and many jewel-stud- ded Sarvatobhadras (temples with openings on all the four sides). There were twentyeight fort walls of different forms and shapes. There were side doors and main doors in the inter- stices of the quarters, all firmly built and of diverse kinds. There were hidden apartments and houses. There were splendid abodes of Guha. O highly blessed ones, they were built in the rural model and other types. There were charming pearls too. The divine abodes of the leaders of Ganas were full of rubies. There were many splendid flower gardens of various shapes with sandal trees in them. There were many lakes and tanks with golden rows of steps. They were frequented by swans that had been defeated by the gaits of women. The tanks had divine and nectarine water and the water fouls (Karandas), peacocks, cuckoos and ruddy geese heightened their splendour. There were thousands of Rudrakanyas (virgins) who were be- decked in all ornaments, who were adepts in conversation and elocution, who stooped down due to the weight of their heavy breasts, whose eyes were roving due to inebriation and who were engaged in singing and playing on instruments. There were groups of dancing nymphs. The lakes contained full-
verses.hindi: यान् यान् प्रार्थयते कामान् मानवः श्रवणादिह
verses.wordMeaning: Visnu then went beyond those excellent cities (one within the other) the fourth, fifth, sixth, seventh, eighth, ninth and tenth. Then he reached the highly-splendid city of Siva. It was perfectly circular and very splendid, stationed on the auspicious peak of Kailua.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Visnu then went beyond those excellent cities (one within the other) the fourth, fifth, sixth, seventh, eighth, ninth and tenth. Then he reached the highly-splendid city of Siva. It was perfectly circular and very splendid, stationed on the auspicious peak of Kailua.…

verses.sanskrit: सहस्रसूर्यप्रतिमं महान्तं सहस्रशः सर्वगुणैश् च भिन्नम् जगाम कैलासगिरिं महात्मा मेरुप्रभागे पुरमादिदेवः
verses.transliteration: sahasrasūryapratimaṃ mahāntaṃ sahasraśaḥ sarvaguṇaiś ca bhinnam jagāma kailāsagiriṃ mahātmā meruprabhāge puramādidevaḥ
verses.translation: There itself they saw Rudraganas and thousands of their heroic leaders.
verses.hindi: तान् सर्वान् शीघ्रमाप्नोति देवानां च प्रियो भवेत्। पठ्यमानमिदं पुण्यं यमुद्दिश्य तु पठ्यते नाकाले मरणं तस्य न सर्पैरपि दंश्यते
verses.wordMeaning: There itself they saw Rudraganas and thousands of their heroic leaders.
verses.commentary: Sense: There itself they saw Rudraganas and thousands of their heroic leaders.

verses.sanskrit: ततो ऽथ नारिगजवाजिसंकुलं रथैर् अनेकैर् अमरारिसूदनः गणैर्गणेशैश् च गिरीन्द्रसंनिभं महापुरद्वारमजो हरिश् च
verses.transliteration: tato 'tha nārigajavājisaṃkulaṃ rathair anekair amarārisūdanaḥ gaṇairgaṇeśaiś ca girīndrasaṃnibhaṃ mahāpuradvāramajo hariś ca
verses.translation: They saw the crystalline aerial chariots, lofty palaces bedecked in diamonds, lapis lazuli and golden steps.
verses.hindi: यत्पुण्यं चैव तीर्थानां यज्ञानां चैव यत्फलम्। दानानां चैव यत्पुण्यं व्रतानां च विशेषत:
verses.wordMeaning: They saw the crystalline aerial chariots, lofty palaces bedecked in diamonds, lapis lazuli and golden steps.
verses.commentary: Sense: They saw the crystalline aerial chariots, lofty palaces bedecked in diamonds, lapis lazuli and golden steps.

verses.sanskrit: अथ जांबूनदमयैर् भवनैर्मणिभूषितैः विमानैर्विविधाकारैः प्राकारैश् च समावृतम्
verses.transliteration: atha jāṃbūnadamayair bhavanairmaṇibhūṣitaiḥ vimānairvividhākāraiḥ prākāraiś ca samāvṛtam
verses.translation: On the tops of palaces there were delighted women with lotus-like eyes, and ample buttocks. There were Yakas, Gandharvas and Apsarases, Kinnaris, Kinnaras, serpents, and siddha girls. They had different kinds of dresses. They were bedecked in different ornaments. They had diverse efficiency. They were fond of pleasure and amorous dalliance. They had the lustre of the blue lotus petals. They had eyes as large as the petals of lotus. They looked resplendent by their upper garments resembling the filaments of lotus. They were bedecked in bangles, anklets, necklaces and umbrellas of variegated colours as well as attractive garments. They were fond of embellishments and they were bedecked in various ornaments also.
verses.hindi: तत्पुण्यं कोटिगुणितं जप्त्वा चाप्नोति मानव: । गोघ्नश्चैव कृतघ्नश्च वीरहा ब्रह्महा भवेत् दुष्टः पापसमाचारो मातृहा पितृहा तथा
verses.wordMeaning: On the tops of palaces there were delighted women with lotus-like eyes, and ample buttocks. There were Yakas, Gandharvas and Apsarases, Kinnaris, Kinnaras, serpents, and siddha girls. They had different kinds of dresses. They were bedecked in different ornaments.…
verses.commentary: Sense: On the tops of palaces there were delighted women with lotus-like eyes, and ample buttocks. There were Yakas, Gandharvas and Apsarases, Kinnaris, Kinnaras, serpents, and siddha girls. They had different kinds of dresses. They were bedecked in different ornaments.…

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा शंभोः पुरं बाह्यं देवैः सब्रह्मकैर्हरिः प्रहृष्टवदनो भूत्वा प्रविवेश ततः पुरम्
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvā śaṃbhoḥ puraṃ bāhyaṃ devaiḥ sabrahmakairhariḥ prahṛṣṭavadano bhūtvā praviveśa tataḥ puram
verses.translation: On seeing these beaudfiil women of the chieft of Ganas, the leading Dcvas — Indra and others went to the mansion of the destroyer of Tripuras.
verses.hindi: व्यपोह्य सर्वपापानि शिवलोके महीयते
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing these beaudfiil women of the chieft of Ganas, the leading Dcvas — Indra and others went to the mansion of the destroyer of Tripuras.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing these beaudfiil women of the chieft of Ganas, the leading Dcvas — Indra and others went to the mansion of the destroyer of Tripuras.

verses.sanskrit: हर्म्यप्रासादसम्बाधं महाट्टालसमन्वितम् द्वितीयं देवदेवस्य चतुर्द्वारं सुशोभनम्
verses.transliteration: harmyaprāsādasambādhaṃ mahāṭṭālasamanvitam dvitīyaṃ devadevasya caturdvāraṃ suśobhanam
verses.translation: On seeing the first palace of the lord, that had the colour of a thousand rising suns, in the middle of the city, the groups of Devas and Siddhas beginning with Indra halted there.
verses.hindi: कूष्माण्ड हैं--वे समाहितचित्त होकर मेरे पाप दूर करें हे श्रेष्ठ ब्राह्मणो ! प्रत्येक महीनेमें इस  व्यपोहनस्तव से शिवको स्तुति करके भूमिपर मस्तक टेककर प्रणाम करके अन्तमें सम्पूर्ण अनुष्ठानका समापन करना चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing the first palace of the lord, that had the colour of a thousand rising suns, in the middle of the city, the groups of Devas and Siddhas beginning with Indra halted there.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing the first palace of the lord, that had the colour of a thousand rising suns, in the middle of the city, the groups of Devas and Siddhas beginning with Indra halted there.

verses.sanskrit: वज्रवैडूर्यमाणिक्यमणिजालैः समावृतम् दोलाविक्षेपसंयुक्तं घण्टाचामरभूषितम्
verses.transliteration: vajravaiḍūryamāṇikyamaṇijālaiḥ samāvṛtam dolāvikṣepasaṃyuktaṃ ghaṇṭācāmarabhūṣitam
verses.translation: Thpn all Devas with Indra at their head saw Nandin, the lord of Garias standing at the doorway of the palace.
verses.hindi: जो इस दिव्य व्यपोहनस्तवको पढ़ता अथवा सुनता है, वह समस्त पापोंको ध्वस्त करके रुद्रलोकमे प्रतिष्ठा प्राप्त करता है
verses.wordMeaning: Thpn all Devas with Indra at their head saw Nandin, the lord of Garias standing at the doorway of the palace.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thpn all Devas with Indra at their head saw Nandin, the lord of Garias standing at the doorway of the palace.

verses.sanskrit: मृदङ्गमुरजैर्जुष्टं वीणावेणुनिनादितम् नृत्यद्भिर् अप्सरःसंघैर् भूतसंघैश् च संवृतम् देवेन्द्रभवनाकारैर् भवनैर् दृष्टिमोहनैः
verses.transliteration: mṛdaṅgamurajairjuṣṭaṃ vīṇāveṇunināditam nṛtyadbhir apsaraḥsaṃghair bhūtasaṃghaiś ca saṃvṛtam devendrabhavanākārair bhavanair dṛṣṭimohanaiḥ
verses.translation: On seeing Nandin the leader of Gaiias, Devas bowed down to him and said ''Be Victorious*'. On seeing them the leader of Garias replied: —
verses.hindi: कन्याकी अभिलाषा रखनेवाला कन्या प्राप्त करता है, विजयकी कामना करनेवाला विजय प्राप्त करता है, धनको इच्छा रखनेवाला धन प्राप्त करता हे, पुत्रकी कामना करनेवाला अनेक पुत्र प्राप्त करता है, विद्या चाहनेवाला विद्या प्राप्त करता है और सुख चाहनेवाला सुख प्राप्त करता है; मनुष्य जिन-जिन कामनाओंकी प्रार्थना करता है, इसके श्रवणसे इस लोकमें उन सबको शीघ्र प्राप्त कर लेता है और देवताओंका प्रिय हो जाता है । जिस किसीके
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing Nandin the leader of Gaiias, Devas bowed down to him and said ''Be Victorious*'. On seeing them the leader of Garias replied: —
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing Nandin the leader of Gaiias, Devas bowed down to him and said ''Be Victorious*'. On seeing them the leader of Garias replied: —

verses.sanskrit: प्रासादशृङ्गेष्वथ पौरनार्यः सहस्रशः पुष्पफलाक्षताद्यैः स्थिताः करैस्तस्य हरेः समन्तात् प्रचिक्षिपुर्मूर्ध्नि यथा भवस्य
verses.transliteration: prāsādaśṛṅgeṣvatha pauranāryaḥ sahasraśaḥ puṣpaphalākṣatādyaiḥ sthitāḥ karaistasya hareḥ samantāt pracikṣipurmūrdhni yathā bhavasya
verses.translation: "O highly blessed Devas, why have you come here? O persons of good holy rites, you who have shaken off your sins, ye the lord of all worlds, it behoves you to say.
verses.hindi: निमित्त इस पवित्र स्तवको पढ़ा जाता है, उसे वात, पित्त आदिसे होनेवाले रोग पीड़ित नहीं करते हैं, असमयमें उसकी मृत्यु नहीं होती है और उसे सर्प नहीं डँसते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: "O highly blessed Devas, why have you come here? O persons of good holy rites, you who have shaken off your sins, ye the lord of all worlds, it behoves you to say.
verses.commentary: Sense: "O highly blessed Devas, why have you come here? O persons of good holy rites, you who have shaken off your sins, ye the lord of all worlds, it behoves you to say.

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा नार्यस्तदा विष्णुं मदाघूर्णितलोचनाः
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvā nāryastadā viṣṇuṃ madāghūrṇitalocanāḥ
verses.translation: They then spoke to the lord, the bestower of boons, the lord having the lustre of a lordly elephant. "For our liberation from the bondage of Paus kindly show lord Mahesvara to us.
verses.hindi: जो पुण्य तीर्थाकी यात्रा करनेसे, जो फल यज्ञोंके करनेसे, जो पुण्य दान करनेसे और जो पुण्य विशेषरूपसे व्रतोंके करनेसे होता है; उससे करोड़ों गुना फल इसे जप करके मनुष्य प्राप्त करता है। जो गायको हत्या करनेवाला, कृतघ्न, वीरघाती, ब्रह्महत्यारा, शरणागतका वध करनेवाला, मित्रके साथ विश्वासघात करनेवाला, पापमय आचरणवाला और माता-पिताका वध करनेवाला होता है, वह भी इसके पाठसे सभौ
verses.wordMeaning: They then spoke to the lord, the bestower of boons, the lord having the lustre of a lordly elephant. "For our liberation from the bondage of Paus kindly show lord Mahesvara to us.
verses.commentary: Sense: They then spoke to the lord, the bestower of boons, the lord having the lustre of a lordly elephant. "For our liberation from the bondage of Paus kindly show lord Mahesvara to us.

verses.sanskrit: विशालजघनाः सद्यो ननृतुर्मुमुदुर्जगुः काश्चिद्दृष्ट्वा हरिं नार्यः किंचित् प्रहसिताननाः
verses.transliteration: viśālajaghanāḥ sadyo nanṛturmumudurjaguḥ kāściddṛṣṭvā hariṃ nāryaḥ kiṃcit prahasitānanāḥ
verses.translation: Formerly in order to burn the three cities, the Paiutva was stipulated. O you of good holy rites, now we are worried over this Pautva.
verses.hindi: पापोंसे मुक्त होकर शिवलोकमें प्रतिष्ठा प्राप्त करता है
verses.wordMeaning: Formerly in order to burn the three cities, the Paiutva was stipulated. O you of good holy rites, now we are worried over this Pautva.
verses.commentary: Sense: Formerly in order to burn the three cities, the Paiutva was stipulated. O you of good holy rites, now we are worried over this Pautva.

verses.sanskrit: किंचिद् विस्रस्तवस्त्राश् च स्रस्तकाञ्चीगुणा जगुः चतुर्थं पञ्चमं चैव षष्ठं च सप्तमं तथा
verses.transliteration: kiṃcid visrastavastrāś ca srastakāñcīguṇā jaguḥ caturthaṃ pañcamaṃ caiva ṣaṣṭhaṃ ca saptamaṃ tathā
verses.translation: The holy rite Paupata was mentioned by lord Siva. O leader of Bhutas, thanks to this holy rite, the state of Pa.<u ceases to exist.
verses.hindi: नामक बयासीवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ विभिन्न मासोंमें किये जानेवाले शिवत्रतोंका विधान
verses.wordMeaning: The holy rite Paupata was mentioned by lord Siva. O leader of Bhutas, thanks to this holy rite, the state of Pa.<u ceases to exist.
verses.commentary: Sense: The holy rite Paupata was mentioned by lord Siva. O leader of Bhutas, thanks to this holy rite, the state of Pa.<u ceases to exist.

verses.sanskrit: अष्टमं नवमं चैव दशमं च पुरोत्तमम् अतीत्यासाद्य देवस्य पुरं शंभोः सुशोभनम्
verses.transliteration: aṣṭamaṃ navamaṃ caiva daśamaṃ ca purottamam atītyāsādya devasya puraṃ śaṃbhoḥ suśobhanam
verses.translation: By performing this excellent Vrata for twelve years, or for twelve months or for twelve days, all Pasus are liberated from the bondage of worldly existence." Nandin, the son of Silada, the leader of the Bhutas showed the lord to all Dcvas including Visnu. On seeing lord Siva the unchanging deity accompanied by Amba and Gaias, Devas were thrilled with pleasure. They bowed to the lord and eulogised him. After submitting to lord Siva, their desire for liberation from bondage, Devas stood in front of lord Siva bowing again and again.

verses.transliteration: sphāṭikair maṇḍapaiḥ śubhrair jāṃbūnadamayais tathā nānāratnamayaiścaiva digvidikṣu vibhūṣitam
verses.translation: The excellent Devas performed penance for twelve years and became free from bondage. They went back with Brahma and Visiju. Thus everything that had been heard from Brahma has been mentioned to you. It had been heard by Sanat and by Vyasa from him. The man who remains pure and hears this or narrates this to the brahmins attains a different body and is liberated from the bondage of Paus.

verses.sanskrit: प्रणेमुस् तुष्टुवुश् चैव प्रीतिकण्टकितत्वचः विज्ञाप्य शितिकण्ठाय पशुपाशविमोक्षणम्

verses.hindi: चैत्रेऽपि रुद्रमभ्यर्च्य कुर्याद्वै नक्तभोजनम्। शाल्यन्नं पयसा युक्तं घृतेन च यथासुखम् गोष्ठशायी मुनिश्रेष्ठाः क्षितौ निशि भवं स्मरेत्। पौर्णमास्यां शिवं स्नाप्य दद्याद् गोमिथुनं सितम्
verses.wordMeaning: The excellent Devas performed penance for twelve years and became free from bondage. They went back with Brahma and Visiju. Thus everything that had been heard from Brahma has been mentioned to you. It had been heard by Sanat and by Vyasa from him.…

verses.sanskrit: तस्थुस्तदाग्रतः शंभोः प्रणिपत्य पुनः पुनः ततः सम्प्रेक्ष्य तान् सर्वान् देवदेवो वृषध्वजः
verses.transliteration: tasthustadāgrataḥ śaṃbhoḥ praṇipatya punaḥ punaḥ tataḥ samprekṣya tān sarvān devadevo vṛṣadhvajaḥ

verses.hindi: वैशाखे च तथा मासे कृत्वा वै नक्तभोजनम्
verses.wordMeaning: The excellent Devas performed penance for twelve years and became free from bondage. They went back with Brahma and Visiju. Thus everything that had been heard from Brahma has been mentioned to you. It had been heard by Sanat and by Vyasa from him.…

verses.sanskrit: विशोध्य तेषां देवानां पशुत्वं परमेश्वरः व्रतं पाशुपतं चैव स्वयं देवो महेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: viśodhya teṣāṃ devānāṃ paśutvaṃ parameśvaraḥ vrataṃ pāśupataṃ caiva svayaṃ devo maheśvaraḥ
verses.translation: The excellent Devas performed penance for twelve years and became free from bondage. They went back with Brahma and Visiju. Thus everything that had been heard from Brahma has been mentioned to you. It had been heard by Sanat and by Vyasa from him. The man who remains pure and hears this or narrates this to the brahmins attains a different body and is liberated from the bondage of Paus.
verses.hindi: ज्येष्ठे मासे च देवेशं भवं शर्वमुमापतिम्। सम्पूज्य श्रद्धया भक्त्या कृत्वा वै नक्तभोजनम् पौर्णमास्यां तु सम्पूज्य देवदेवमुमापतिम्। स्नाप्य शक्त्या यथान्यायं चरुं दद्याच्च शूलिने
verses.wordMeaning: The excellent Devas performed penance for twelve years and became free from bondage. They went back with Brahma and Visiju. Thus everything that had been heard from Brahma has been mentioned to you. It had been heard by Sanat and by Vyasa from him.…

verses.sanskrit: उपदिश्य मुनीनां च सहास्ते चांबया भवः तदाप्रभृति ते देवाः सर्वे पाशुपताः स्मृताः
verses.transliteration: upadiśya munīnāṃ ca sahāste cāṃbayā bhavaḥ tadāprabhṛti te devāḥ sarve pāśupatāḥ smṛtāḥ
verses.translation: The excellent Devas performed penance for twelve years and became free from bondage. They went back with Brahma and Visiju. Thus everything that had been heard from Brahma has been mentioned to you. It had been heard by Sanat and by Vyasa from him. verses.hindi: धूप्रं गोमिथुनं दत्त्वा वायुलोके महीयते
verses.wordMeaning: The excellent Devas performed penance for twelve years and became free from bondage. They went back with Brahma and Visiju. Thus everything that had been heard from Brahma has been mentioned to you. It had been heard by Sanat and by Vyasa from him.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The excellent Devas performed penance for twelve years and became free from bondage. They went back with Brahma and Visiju. Thus everything that had been heard from Brahma has been mentioned to you. It had been heard by Sanat and by Vyasa from him.…

verses.sanskrit: पशूनां च पतिर्यस्मात् तेषां साक्षाद्धि देवताः तस्मात्पाशुपताः प्रोक्तास् तपस्तेपुश् च ते पुनः
verses.transliteration: paśūnāṃ ca patiryasmāt teṣāṃ sākṣāddhi devatāḥ tasmātpāśupatāḥ proktās tapastepuś ca te punaḥ

Thus everything that had been heard from Brahma has been mentioned to you. It had been heard by Sanat and by Vyasa from him. The man who remains pure and hears this or narrates this to the brahmins attains a different body and is liberated from the bondage of Paus.
verses.hindi: दद्याद् गोमिथुनं गौरं वारुणं लोकमाण्नुयात्। श्रावणे च द्विजा मासे कृत्वा वै नक्तभोजनम् पौर्णमास्यां घृताहैस्तु स्नाप्य पूज्य यथाविधि
verses.wordMeaning: The excellent Devas performed penance for twelve years and became free from bondage. They went back with Brahma and Visiju. Thus everything that had been heard from Brahma has been mentioned to you. It had been heard by Sanat and by Vyasa from him.…

verses.sanskrit: ततो द्वादशवर्षान्ते मुक्तपाशाः सुरोत्तमाः ययुर्यथागतं सर्वे ब्रह्मणा सह विष्णुना
verses.transliteration: tato dvādaśavarṣānte muktapāśāḥ surottamāḥ yayuryathāgataṃ sarve brahmaṇā saha viṣṇunā

The man who remains pure and hears this or narrates this to the brahmins attains a different body and is liberated from the bondage of Paus.
verses.hindi: अफफमपपपरप्रफफफपफ्कफाफापाफफफफफफफफफफफपफ जानेवाले वाले शिवव्रतोंका विधान

verses.sanskrit: एतद्वः कथितं सर्वं पितामहमुखाच्छ्रुतम् पुरा सनत्कुमारेण तस्माद्व्यासेन धीमता
verses.transliteration: etadvaḥ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ pitāmahamukhācchrutam purā sanatkumāreṇa tasmādvyāsena dhīmatā

Thus everything that had been heard from Brahma has been mentioned to you. It had been heard by Sanat and by Vyasa from him. The man who remains pure and hears this or narrates this to the brahmins attains a different body and is liberated from the bondage of Paus.
verses.hindi: दिन उपवास करता है, पूर्णिमाके दिन महादेव शंकरको स्नान कराकर उनकी पूजा करके उन शूलपाणि शिव- को ताम्रवर्णका गोमिथुन प्रदान करता है और ब्राह्मणोंको भोजन कराकर परमेश्वरसे प्रार्थना करता है, वह चन्द्रमाका सायुज्य प्राप्त करता है; इसमें सन्देह नहीं करना चाहिए ॥ २३--२६॥
verses.wordMeaning: The excellent Devas performed penance for twelve years and became free from bondage. They went back with Brahma and Visiju. Thus everything that had been heard from Brahma has been mentioned to you. It had been heard by Sanat and by Vyasa from him.…

verses.sanskrit: यः श्रावयेच्छुचिर् विप्राञ् छृणुयाद्वा शुचिर्नरः स देहभेदमासाद्य पशुपाशैः प्रमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: yaḥ śrāvayecchucir viprāñ chṛṇuyādvā śucirnaraḥ sa dehabhedamāsādya paśupāśaiḥ pramucyate
