Thus everything that had been heard from Brahma has been mentioned to you. It had been heard by Sanat and by Vyasa from him. The man who remains pure and hears this or narrates this to the brahmins attains a different body and is liberated from the bondage of Paus.
verses.hindi: हे शरेष्ठ मुनियो ! जो चैत्र महीनेमें रुद्रकी पूजा करके घी और दूधसे युक्त तथा पके हुए शालि-चावलको अपनी रुचिके अनुसार रात्रिमें ग्रहण करता है, रातमें गोशालामें भूमिपर शयन करता है, शिवजीका स्मरण करता है,
verses.wordMeaning: The excellent Devas performed penance for twelve years and became free from bondage. They went back with Brahma and Visiju. Thus everything that had been heard from Brahma has been mentioned to you. It had been heard by Sanat and by Vyasa from him.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The excellent Devas performed penance for twelve years and became free from bondage. They went back with Brahma and Visiju. Thus everything that had been heard from Brahma has been mentioned to you. It had been heard by Sanat and by Vyasa from him.…

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीलिङ्गमहापुराणे पूर्वभागे पाशुपतव्रतमाहात्म्यं नामाशीतितमो ऽध्यायः व्रतमेतत्त्वया प्रोक्तं पशुपाशविमोक्षणम् व्रतं पाशुपतं लैङ्गं पुरा देवैर् अनुष्ठितम्
verses.transliteration: iti śrīliṅgamahāpurāṇe pūrvabhāge pāśupatavratamāhātmyaṃ nāmāśītitamo 'dhyāyaḥ vratametattvayā proktaṃ paśupāśavimokṣaṇam vrataṃ pāśupataṃ laiṅgaṃ purā devair anuṣṭhitam
verses.translation: This holy rite that liberates Pasus (individual souls) from bondage has been mentioned by you. This holy rite of Paiupati pertaining to the Lihga had been performed formerly by Devas. It behoves you to mention this to us in the manner you had heard it formerly.
verses.hindi: पूर्णमासीके दिन शिवको स्नान कराकर श्वेतवर्णका गोमिथुन प्रदान करता है और ब्राह्मणोंको भोजन कराता है, वह निर्क्रतिलोकको प्राप्त करता है॥ २७-२८ /२॥ वैशाख महीनेमें नक्तभोजन करके पूर्णमासी तिथिमें पंचगव्य, घृत आदिसे शिवजीको स्नान कराकर श्वेतवर्णका गोमिथुन अर्पित करके वह मनुष्य अश्वमेध यज्ञका फल प्राप्त करता है
verses.wordMeaning: This holy rite that liberates Pasus (individual souls) from bondage has been mentioned by you. This holy rite of Paiupati pertaining to the Lihga had been performed formerly by Devas. It behoves you to mention this to us in the manner you had heard it formerly.
verses.commentary: Sense: This holy rite that liberates Pasus (individual souls) from bondage has been mentioned by you. This holy rite of Paiupati pertaining to the Lihga had been performed formerly by Devas. It behoves you to mention this to us in the manner you had heard it formerly.

verses.sanskrit: वक्तुमर्हसि चास्माकं यथापूर्वं त्वया श्रुतम् पुरा सनत्कुमारेण पृष्टः शैलादिरादरात्
verses.transliteration: vaktumarhasi cāsmākaṃ yathāpūrvaṃ tvayā śrutam purā sanatkumāreṇa pṛṣṭaḥ śailādirādarāt
verses.translation: It has been evolved after churning the Vedas and their six ancillaries,'® It excels all charitable gifts and is holier than ten thousand horse-sacrifices.
verses.hindi: ज्येष्ठ मासमें देवेश, भव, शर्व, उमापतिकी श्रद्धापूर्वक पूजा करके मधु-जल-घृतमिश्रित पवित्र शालिचावलका केवल रातमें आहार ग्रहण करके वीर आसनमें स्थित होकर आधी रातमें गायोंकी सेवामें तत्पर रहकर पूर्णिमाके
verses.wordMeaning: It has been evolved after churning the Vedas and their six ancillaries,'® It excels all charitable gifts and is holier than ten thousand horse-sacrifices.
verses.commentary: Sense: It has been evolved after churning the Vedas and their six ancillaries,'® It excels all charitable gifts and is holier than ten thousand horse-sacrifices.

verses.sanskrit: नन्दी प्राह वचस्तस्मै प्रवदामि समासतः देवैर्दैत्यैस् तथा सिद्धैर् गन्धर्वैः सिद्धचारणैः
verses.transliteration: nandī prāha vacastasmai pravadāmi samāsataḥ devairdaityais tathā siddhair gandharvaiḥ siddhacāraṇaiḥ
verses.translation: It is sacred, bestows all auspicious things, destroys all enemies, brings about salvation even to those creatures that are immersed in the ocean of worldly existence.
verses.hindi: दिन देवदेव उमापतिको स्नान कराकर उनकी पूजा करके विधानपूर्वक शिवजीको चरु अर्पित करके पुनः अपने सामर्थ्यके अनुसार ब्राह्मणोंको भोजन कराकर धूम्रवर्णका गोमिथुन शिवजीको अर्पित करनेसे वह वायुलोकमें प्रतिष्ठा प्राप्त करता है॥ ३१--३४॥
verses.wordMeaning: It is sacred, bestows all auspicious things, destroys all enemies, brings about salvation even to those creatures that are immersed in the ocean of worldly existence.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is sacred, bestows all auspicious things, destroys all enemies, brings about salvation even to those creatures that are immersed in the ocean of worldly existence.

verses.sanskrit: मुनिभिश् च महाभागैर् अनुष्ठितमनुत्तमम् व्रतं द्वादशलिङ्गाख्यं पशुपाशविमोक्षणम्
verses.transliteration: munibhiś ca mahābhāgair anuṣṭhitamanuttamam vrataṃ dvādaśaliṅgākhyaṃ paśupāśavimokṣaṇam
verses.translation: It dispels all sickness and destroys all fevers. It had been performed formerly by Devas as well as by Brahma and Visnu.
verses.hindi: इसी प्रकार आषाढ़ महीनेमें भी चीनी, घृत तथा गोदुग्धमिश्रित सचूके नक्त-भोजनमें तत्पर रहते हुए पूर्णिमाके दिन घृत आदिसे शिवजीको स्नान कराकर विधिपूर्वक पूजन करके वेदमें पारंगत श्रोत्रिय ब्राह्मणोंको
verses.wordMeaning: It dispels all sickness and destroys all fevers. It had been performed formerly by Devas as well as by Brahma and Visnu.
verses.commentary: Sense: It dispels all sickness and destroys all fevers. It had been performed formerly by Devas as well as by Brahma and Visnu.

verses.sanskrit: भोगदं योगदं चैव कामदं मुक्तिदं शुभम् अवियोगकरं पुण्यं भक्तानां भयनाशनम्
verses.transliteration: bhogadaṃ yogadaṃ caiva kāmadaṃ muktidaṃ śubham aviyogakaraṃ puṇyaṃ bhaktānāṃ bhayanāśanam
verses.translation: N.S. edition reads 'aviyoga-karam' for *abhiyoga-karam'. avi- yogakaram — sarvada siva-sannidhyadayakam ST. that which brings about the devotee's proximity to Siva.
verses.hindi: भोजन कराकर जो गौरवर्णका गोमिथुन अर्पित करता है, बह वरुणलोक प्राप्त करता है॥ ३५-३६ /२॥ हे द्विजो! सावन महीनेमें दूधमिश्रित षष्टिक (साठ दिनमें उत्पन्न होनेवाले शालिचावल)-के भातका नक्तभोजन करके वृषभध्वजको पूजा करके अन्तमें
verses.wordMeaning: N.S. edition reads 'aviyoga-karam' for *abhiyoga-karam'. avi- yogakaram — sarvada siva-sannidhyadayakam ST. that which brings about the devotee's proximity to Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: N.S. edition reads 'aviyoga-karam' for *abhiyoga-karam'. avi- yogakaram — sarvada siva-sannidhyadayakam ST. that which brings about the devotee's proximity to Siva.

verses.sanskrit: षडङ्गसहितान् वेदान् मथित्वा तेन निर्मितम् सर्वदानोत्तमं पुण्यम् अश्वमेधायुताधिकम्
verses.transliteration: ṣaḍaṅgasahitān vedān mathitvā tena nirmitam sarvadānottamaṃ puṇyam aśvamedhāyutādhikam
verses.translation: Sadahga: six ancillaries to the Veda, namely (i) Sik?a — the science of proper articulation and pronunciation, (ii) Chandas — the science of prosody, (iii) Vyakaraua— grammar, (iv) Nirukta— etymological expla- nation of difficult Vedic words, (v) Jyotisa— astronomy, (vi)Kalpa— ritual or ceremonial.
verses.hindi: श्रीलिडुमहापुराण
verses.wordMeaning: Sadahga: six ancillaries to the Veda, namely (i) Sik?a — the science of proper articulation and pronunciation, (ii) Chandas — the science of prosody, (iii) Vyakaraua— grammar, (iv) Nirukta— etymological expla- nation of difficult Vedic words, (v) Jyotisa— astronomy,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Sadahga: six ancillaries to the Veda, namely (i) Sik?a — the science of proper articulation and pronunciation, (ii) Chandas — the science of prosody, (iii) Vyakaraua— grammar, (iv) Nirukta— etymological expla- nation of difficult Vedic words, (v) Jyotisa— astronomy,…

verses.sanskrit: सर्वमङ्गलदं पुण्यं सर्वशत्रुविनाशनम् संसारार्णवमग्नानां जन्तूनामपि मोक्षदम्
verses.transliteration: sarvamaṅgaladaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvaśatruvināśanam saṃsārārṇavamagnānāṃ jantūnāmapi mokṣadam
verses.translation: O leading brahmins, the devotee shall make a small Lihga and bathe it with sandal water. Beginning in the month of Caitra he shall perform the holy rite of Sivalihga.
verses.hindi: 02०५. स्तक क जका फ़ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ़ ऊ फ फ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ क़ फ़ फ फ फ फ फ फ फ फ़ फ फ़ फफ क कक क क मी मी की फी की की की फक फफ फफ कक कफ कककक फफफ फफफ फफ फफ फफफ फक प्राप्ते भाद्रपदे मासे कृत्वैवं नक्तभोजनम्
verses.wordMeaning: O leading brahmins, the devotee shall make a small Lihga and bathe it with sandal water. Beginning in the month of Caitra he shall perform the holy rite of Sivalihga.
verses.commentary: Sense: O leading brahmins, the devotee shall make a small Lihga and bathe it with sandal water. Beginning in the month of Caitra he shall perform the holy rite of Sivalihga.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वव्याधिहरं चैव सर्वज्वरविनाशनम् देवैरनुष्ठितं पूर्वं ब्रह्मणा विष्णुना तथा
verses.transliteration: sarvavyādhiharaṃ caiva sarvajvaravināśanam devairanuṣṭhitaṃ pūrvaṃ brahmaṇā viṣṇunā tathā
verses.translation: He shall make an auspicious golden lotus with pericarp and filaments. It shall have eight petals duly studded with all the nine precious gems. He shall then fix the crystal Linga in the pericarp along with its pedestal. Me shall then duly and devoutly worship it with Bilva leaves.
verses.hindi: पौर्णमास्यां तु देवेशं स्नाप्य सम्पूज्य शङ्करम्
verses.wordMeaning: He shall make an auspicious golden lotus with pericarp and filaments. It shall have eight petals duly studded with all the nine precious gems. He shall then fix the crystal Linga in the pericarp along with its pedestal.…
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall make an auspicious golden lotus with pericarp and filaments. It shall have eight petals duly studded with all the nine precious gems. He shall then fix the crystal Linga in the pericarp along with its pedestal.…

verses.sanskrit: कृत्वा कनीयसं लिङ्गं स्नाप्य चन्दनवारिणा चैत्रमासादि विप्रेन्द्राः शिवलिङ्गव्रतं चरेत्
verses.transliteration: kṛtvā kanīyasaṃ liṅgaṃ snāpya candanavāriṇā caitramāsādi viprendrāḥ śivaliṅgavrataṃ caret
verses.translation: O sages of good holy rites, he shall worship the linga with thousands of white, red and blue lotuses, with white Arka, Karavira, Karnikara and Kurabaka as well as with other flowers in accordance with their availability repea- ting the Gayatri. After adoring with scents, etc., with incense, with auspicious lamps and with Nirajanas (wavingsof lights) the devotee shall worship the great lord in Linga form. O excellent brahmins, he shall oflfer Aguru (agallochum) in the south by means of Aghora Mantra.
verses.hindi: यक्षलोकमनृप्राप्य यक्षराजो भवेन्नरः। ततश्चाश्वयुजे मासि कृत्वैवं नक्तभोजनम् सघृतं शङ्करं पूज्य पौर्णमास्यां च पूर्ववत्। ब्राह्मणान् भोजयित्वा च शिवभक्तान् सदा शुचीन्
verses.wordMeaning: O sages of good holy rites, he shall worship the linga with thousands of white, red and blue lotuses, with white Arka, Karavira, Karnikara and Kurabaka as well as with other flowers in accordance with their availability repea- ting the Gayatri. After adoring with scents, etc.,…
verses.commentary: Sense: O sages of good holy rites, he shall worship the linga with thousands of white, red and blue lotuses, with white Arka, Karavira, Karnikara and Kurabaka as well as with other flowers in accordance with their availability repea- ting the Gayatri. After adoring with scents, etc.,…

verses.sanskrit: कृत्वा हैमं शुभं पद्मं कर्णिकाकेसरान्वितम् नवरत्नैश् च खचितम् अष्टपत्रं यथाविधि
verses.transliteration: kṛtvā haimaṃ śubhaṃ padmaṃ karṇikākesarānvitam navaratnaiś ca khacitam aṣṭapatraṃ yathāvidhi
verses.translation: He shall offer the divine Manahila (red arsenic) in the west with the mantra of Sadyojata, and sandal paste in the north with the Vamadeva Mantra.
verses.hindi: गां च दत्त्वा यथान्यायमैशानं लोकमाण्नुयात्
verses.wordMeaning: He shall offer the divine Manahila (red arsenic) in the west with the mantra of Sadyojata, and sandal paste in the north with the Vamadeva Mantra.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall offer the divine Manahila (red arsenic) in the west with the mantra of Sadyojata, and sandal paste in the north with the Vamadeva Mantra.

verses.sanskrit: कर्णिकायां न्यसेल्लिङ्गं स्फाटिकं पीठसंयुतम् तत्र भक्त्या यथान्यायम् अर्चयेद् बिल्वपत्रकैः
verses.transliteration: karṇikāyāṃ nyaselliṅgaṃ sphāṭikaṃ pīṭhasaṃyutam tatra bhaktyā yathānyāyam arcayed bilvapatrakaiḥ
verses.translation: O excellent sages, he shall offer Haritala (yellow orpiment) in the east by means of Tatpurusa. With devotion he shall offer the following varieties of incense, viz., that origi- nating from white Aguru and black Aguru; then the Guggula dhupa (aromatic gum resin), the excellent Saugandhika (fragrant incense) and the incense named Sitara.
verses.hindi: कार्तिके च तथा मासे कृत्वा वै नक्तभोजनम्। क्षीरोदनेन साज्येन सम्पूज्य च भवं प्रभुम् दत्त्वा गोमिथुनं चैव कापिलं पूर्ववद् द्विजाः । सूर्यसायुज्यमाप्नोति नात्र कार्या विचारणा
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent sages, he shall offer Haritala (yellow orpiment) in the east by means of Tatpurusa. With devotion he shall offer the following varieties of incense, viz., that origi- nating from white Aguru and black Aguru; then the Guggula dhupa (aromatic gum resin),…
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent sages, he shall offer Haritala (yellow orpiment) in the east by means of Tatpurusa. With devotion he shall offer the following varieties of incense, viz., that origi- nating from white Aguru and black Aguru; then the Guggula dhupa (aromatic gum resin),…

verses.sanskrit: सितैः सहस्रकमलै रक्तैर्नीलोत्पलैरपि श्वेतार्ककर्णिकारैश् च करवीरैर्बकैरपि
verses.transliteration: sitaiḥ sahasrakamalai raktairnīlotpalairapi śvetārkakarṇikāraiś ca karavīrairbakairapi
verses.translation: Mahacaru or an Ahaka measure of cooked rice should be offered as Naivedya. Thus, this great holy rite of Sivalihga has been narrated to you.
verses.hindi: मार्गशीर्षे च मासेऽपि कृत्वैवं नक्तभोजनम् यवान्नेन यथान्यायमाज्यक्षीरादिभिः समम्
verses.wordMeaning: Mahacaru or an Ahaka measure of cooked rice should be offered as Naivedya. Thus, this great holy rite of Sivalihga has been narrated to you.
verses.commentary: Sense: Mahacaru or an Ahaka measure of cooked rice should be offered as Naivedya. Thus, this great holy rite of Sivalihga has been narrated to you.

verses.sanskrit: एतैरन्यैर् यथालाभं गायत्र्या तस्य सुव्रताः सम्पूज्य चैव गन्धाद्यैर् धूपैर्दीपैश् च मङ्गलैः
verses.transliteration: etairanyair yathālābhaṃ gāyatryā tasya suvratāḥ sampūjya caiva gandhādyair dhūpairdīpaiś ca maṅgalaiḥ
verses.translation: All these are common to all months. 1 shall mention the particular features now: — The Lihga shall be adamantine in Vaiakha in Jyestha it shall be made of emerald; in A$a4ha of pearl; in Sravana of lapis lazuli and in Bhadrapada of rubies. O leading brahmins, in ASvina, the Lihga shall be made of onyx; in Karttika of coral; in Marga§!r of lapis
verses.hindi: सोमलोकमनृप्राप्य सोमेन सह मोदते पूर्णिमाके दिन घृत आदिसे स्नान कराकर विधिपूर्वक उनकी पूजा करके वेदमें पारंगत श्रोत्रिय ब्राह्मणोंको भोजन कराकर जो मनुष्य सफेद खुरवाला तथा चितकबरा गोमिथुन शिवजीको अर्पित करता है, वह
verses.wordMeaning: All these are common to all months. 1 shall mention the particular features now: — The Lihga shall be adamantine in Vaiakha in Jyestha it shall be made of emerald; in A$a4ha of pearl; in Sravana of lapis lazuli and in Bhadrapada of rubies. O leading brahmins, in ASvina,…
verses.commentary: Sense: All these are common to all months. 1 shall mention the particular features now: — The Lihga shall be adamantine in Vaiakha in Jyestha it shall be made of emerald; in A$a4ha of pearl; in Sravana of lapis lazuli and in Bhadrapada of rubies. O leading brahmins, in ASvina,…

verses.sanskrit: नीराजनाद्यैश्चान्यैश् च लिङ्गमूर्तिमहेश्वरम् अगरुं दक्षिणे दद्याद् अघोरेण द्विजोत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: nīrājanādyaiścānyaiś ca liṅgamūrtimaheśvaram agaruṃ dakṣiṇe dadyād aghoreṇa dvijottamāḥ
verses.translation: Vaiiikhe. For the worship of Lihga in Caitra read V-9 ff The crystal (spbatika) lihga is recommended in Caitra. Gf. 3f?r
verses.hindi: वायुदेवका सायुज्य त करता है और वायुके समान सर्वगामी हो जाता है॥ ३७--३९ /२॥
verses.wordMeaning: Vaiiikhe. For the worship of Lihga in Caitra read V-9 ff The crystal (spbatika) lihga is recommended in Caitra. Gf. 3f?r
verses.commentary: Sense: Vaiiikhe. For the worship of Lihga in Caitra read V-9 ff The crystal (spbatika) lihga is recommended in Caitra. Gf. 3f?r

verses.sanskrit: पश्चिमे सद्यमन्त्रेण दिव्यां चैव मनःशिलाम् उत्तरे वामदेवेन चन्दनं वापि दापयेत्
verses.transliteration: paścime sadyamantreṇa divyāṃ caiva manaḥśilām uttare vāmadevena candanaṃ vāpi dāpayet
verses.translation: In all months one golden lotus ' shall be used for worship; if that is not available a silver lotus shall be used; if that too is not available ordinary lotus shall be used.
verses.hindi: हे श्रेष्ठ ब्राह्मणो! इसी प्रकार भाद्रपद महीना आनेपर हवनसे बची हुई सामग्रीका नक्तभोजन करके दिनमें वृक्षके मूलका आश्रय लेकर विश्राम करते हुए अन्तमें पूर्णिमाके दिन देवेश शंकरको स्नान कराकर उनको पूजा करके भक्तिपूर्वक विधिके अनुसार नीलवर्णके स्कन्धवाला वृषभ तथा एक गाय शिवजीको अर्पित करके वेद-वेदांगमें पारंगत ब्राह्मणोंको भोजन कराकर मनुष्य यक्षलोक प्राप्त करके यक्षोंका राजा हो
verses.wordMeaning: In all months one golden lotus ' shall be used for worship; if that is not available a silver lotus shall be used; if that too is not available ordinary lotus shall be used.
verses.commentary: Sense: In all months one golden lotus ' shall be used for worship; if that is not available a silver lotus shall be used; if that too is not available ordinary lotus shall be used.

verses.sanskrit: पुरुषेण मुनिश्रेष्ठा हरितालं च पूर्वतः सितागरूद्भवं विप्रास् तथा कृष्णागरूद्भवम्
verses.transliteration: puruṣeṇa muniśreṣṭhā haritālaṃ ca pūrvataḥ sitāgarūdbhavaṃ viprās tathā kṛṣṇāgarūdbhavam
verses.translation: The Lihga can be made of rock, wood or clay along with its pedestal. Or he shall make a temporary Lihga with fragrant substances.
verses.wordMeaning: The Lihga can be made of rock, wood or clay along with its pedestal. Or he shall make a temporary Lihga with fragrant substances.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Lihga can be made of rock, wood or clay along with its pedestal. Or he shall make a temporary Lihga with fragrant substances.

verses.sanskrit: तथा गुग्गुलुधूपं च सौगन्धिकमनुत्तमम् सितारं नाम धूपं च दद्याद् ईशाय भक्तितः
verses.transliteration: tathā gugguludhūpaṃ ca saugandhikamanuttamam sitāraṃ nāma dhūpaṃ ca dadyād īśāya bhaktitaḥ
verses.translation: In the season of Hemanta (early winter) one shall worship Mahadeva with Sripatra'®® (Bilva leaves) alone. In all the months a lotus made of gold or a lotus made of silver with golden pericarp can be used. If silver lotus is not available he shall worship with Bilva leaves.
verses.hindi: इसके बाद इसी तरह आश्विन (कवार) मासमें केवल रातमें घीसे बना हुआ भोजन करके पूर्णिमा तिथिमें पूर्वकी भाँति शंकरकी पूजा करके ब्राह्मणों तथा सर्वदा पवित्र रहनेवाले शिवभक्तोंको भोजन कराकर नीलवर्णकी आभावाले तथा उन्नत उरुदेशवाले एक वृषभ और एक गायका विधिपूर्वक दान करके मनुष्य ईशानलोक प्राप्त करता है
verses.wordMeaning: In the season of Hemanta (early winter) one shall worship Mahadeva with Sripatra'®® (Bilva leaves) alone. In all the months a lotus made of gold or a lotus made of silver with golden pericarp can be used. If silver lotus is not available he shall worship with Bilva leaves.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the season of Hemanta (early winter) one shall worship Mahadeva with Sripatra'®® (Bilva leaves) alone. In all the months a lotus made of gold or a lotus made of silver with golden pericarp can be used. If silver lotus is not available he shall worship with Bilva leaves.

verses.sanskrit: महाचरुर्निवेद्यः स्याद् आढकान्नमथापि वा एतद् वः कथितं पुण्यं शिवलिङ्गमहाव्रतम्
verses.transliteration: mahācarurnivedyaḥ syād āḍhakānnamathāpi vā etad vaḥ kathitaṃ puṇyaṃ śivaliṅgamahāvratam
verses.translation: If thousand lotuses are not available one shall worship with half that quantity; or he shall worship Rudra with a moiety of the said half or he shall worship with a hundred and eight lotuses.
verses.hindi: हे द्विजो ! कार्तिक मासमें रात्रिमें घृतयुक्त दुग्धोदनका भोजन करके भगवान् शिवका पूजनकर  अन्तमें पूर्णिमा तिथिमें विधिपूर्वक शिवजीको स्नान कराकर पुनः उन्हें चरुका नैवेद्य अर्पित करके अपने सामर्थ्यंके
verses.wordMeaning: If thousand lotuses are not available one shall worship with half that quantity; or he shall worship Rudra with a moiety of the said half or he shall worship with a hundred and eight lotuses.
verses.commentary: Sense: If thousand lotuses are not available one shall worship with half that quantity; or he shall worship Rudra with a moiety of the said half or he shall worship with a hundred and eight lotuses.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वमासेषु सामान्यं विशेषो ऽपि च कीर्त्यते वैशाखे वज्रलिङ्गं च ज्येष्ठे मारकतं तथा
verses.transliteration: sarvamāseṣu sāmānyaṃ viśeṣo 'pi ca kīrtyate vaiśākhe vajraliṅgaṃ ca jyeṣṭhe mārakataṃ tathā
verses.translation: Gk)ddess Laksm! endowed with alj characteristics is stationed on the leaf of the Bilva. Ambika is directly present in the blue lotus and §anmukha® himself is present in the red lotus.
verses.hindi: अनुसार ब्राह्मणोंको भोजन कराकर पूर्वकी भाँति कपिल वर्णका गोमिथुन शिवजीको समर्पित करके मनुष्य सूर्यसायुज्य प्राप्त करता है; इसमें सन्देह नहीं करना चाहिए ॥ ४६--४८॥ मार्गशीर्ष (अगहन) महीनेमें भी विधिपूर्वक ६ तथा घीमें पकाये हुए जौका रात्रिमें भोजन अन्तमें पूर्णिमाके दिन पूर्वकी भाँति शर्व शम्भुकी स्नान कराकर उनकी पूजा करके वेदमें पारंगत नि
verses.wordMeaning: Gk)ddess Laksm! endowed with alj characteristics is stationed on the leaf of the Bilva. Ambika is directly present in the blue lotus and §anmukha® himself is present in the red lotus.
verses.commentary: Sense: Gk)ddess Laksm! endowed with alj characteristics is stationed on the leaf of the Bilva. Ambika is directly present in the blue lotus and §anmukha® himself is present in the red lotus.

verses.sanskrit: आषाढे मौक्तिकं लिङ्गं श्रावणे नीलनिर्मितम् मासि भाद्रपदे लिङ्गं पद्मरागमयं शुभम्
verses.transliteration: āṣāḍhe mauktikaṃ liṅgaṃ śrāvaṇe nīlanirmitam māsi bhādrapade liṅgaṃ padmarāgamayaṃ śubham
verses.translation: Mahadeva, Siva, the lord of all Devas occupies the lotus. Hence the learned man shall never forsake the Bilva leaf. He must employ every means to secure it.
verses.hindi: ब्राह्मणोंको भोजन कराकर तथा विधिपूर्वक पाण्डुरवर्णकी
verses.wordMeaning: Mahadeva, Siva, the lord of all Devas occupies the lotus. Hence the learned man shall never forsake the Bilva leaf. He must employ every means to secure it.
verses.commentary: Sense: Mahadeva, Siva, the lord of all Devas occupies the lotus. Hence the learned man shall never forsake the Bilva leaf. He must employ every means to secure it.

verses.sanskrit: आश्विने चैव विप्रेन्द्राः गोमेदकमयं शुभम् प्रवालेनैव कार्तिक्यां तथा वै मार्गशीर्षके
verses.transliteration: āśvine caiva viprendrāḥ gomedakamayaṃ śubham pravālenaiva kārtikyāṃ tathā vai mārgaśīrṣake
verses.translation: He shall not forsake the blue lotus, the red lilies and particularly the red lotuses. The lotus fascinates everyone. Sila
verses.hindi: उमामहेश्वरव्रतका वर्णन तथा पूजाविधान माक फफ काक फ अफ फफ फफफफफफफ्फ्फ़फफफफफफफ कफ फफ़ कफ फफ फ़ फ नस लऊफफकफफफ्फफफफक्फफफफ्फ्फफफफफ्फफफफ्फफफ्फ्फफफफफ्फ्फ्फ्फ्फफ्फफ्फ्फ्फफ्फफकफ कफ फ
verses.wordMeaning: He shall not forsake the blue lotus, the red lilies and particularly the red lotuses. The lotus fascinates everyone. Sila
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall not forsake the blue lotus, the red lilies and particularly the red lotuses. The lotus fascinates everyone. Sila

verses.sanskrit: वैडूर्यनिर्मितं लिङ्गं पुष्परागेण पुष्यके माघे च सूर्यकान्तेन फाल्गुने स्फाटिकेन च
verses.transliteration: vaiḍūryanirmitaṃ liṅgaṃ puṣparāgeṇa puṣyake māghe ca sūryakāntena phālgune sphāṭikena ca
verses.translation: The incense originating from the black agallochum dispels all sins; the offering of aromatic gum, resin, etc. and the gift of lamps destroy all ailments; sandal paste bestows all
verses.hindi: अहिंसा सत्यमस्तेयं ब्रह्मचर्य क्षमा दया। त्रिःस्नानं चाग्निहोत्रं च भूशय्या नक्तभोजनम्
verses.wordMeaning: The incense originating from the black agallochum dispels all sins; the offering of aromatic gum, resin, etc. and the gift of lamps destroy all ailments; sandal paste bestows all
verses.commentary: Sense: The incense originating from the black agallochum dispels all sins; the offering of aromatic gum, resin, etc. and the gift of lamps destroy all ailments; sandal paste bestows all

verses.sanskrit: सर्वमासेषु कमलं हैममेकं विधीयते अलाभे राजतं वापि केवलं कमलं तु वा
verses.transliteration: sarvamāseṣu kamalaṃ haimamekaṃ vidhīyate alābhe rājataṃ vāpi kevalaṃ kamalaṃ tu vā
verses.translation: The incense originating from white agallochum as well as black agallochum and the gentle incense Sitari bestow salvation.
verses.hindi: इत्येतदखिलं प्रोक्तं प्रतिमासं शिवत्रतम् गोमिथुन शिवजीको समर्पित करके मनुष्य सोमलोक प्राप्त करके वबहाँपर सोमके साथ आनन्द प्राप्त करता
verses.wordMeaning: The incense originating from white agallochum as well as black agallochum and the gentle incense Sitari bestow salvation.
verses.commentary: Sense: The incense originating from white agallochum as well as black agallochum and the gentle incense Sitari bestow salvation.

verses.sanskrit: रत्नानाम् अप्यलाभे तु हेम्ना वा राजतेन वा रजतस्याप्यलाभे तु ताम्रलोहेन कारयेत्
verses.transliteration: ratnānām apyalābhe tu hemnā vā rājatena vā rajatasyāpyalābhe tu tāmralohena kārayet
verses.translation: The four- faced Brahma is present in the white Arka flower; the goddess of intelligence is well established in the Karnikara flower; the presiding deity of the Ganas is present in theKaravira flower. Narayana himself is present in the Kura- baka flower, the daughter of the mountain is present in all fragrant flowers. Hence, one shall devoutly and in accordance with one's means, worship the lord of the chiefs of Devas by means of these splendid flowers, incenses, etc. according to their availability.
verses.hindi: अहिंसा, सत्य, चोरी न करना, ब्रह्मचर्य, क्षमा, दया, तीनों कालमें स्नान, अग्निहोत्र, पृथ्वीपर शयन, रात्रिभोजन और दोनों पक्षोंकी अष्टमी तथा चतुर्दशीको उपवास-इन सबको तथा प्रत्येक महीनेके शिवव्रतको
verses.wordMeaning: The four- faced Brahma is present in the white Arka flower; the goddess of intelligence is well established in the Karnikara flower; the presiding deity of the Ganas is present in theKaravira flower. Narayana himself is present in the Kura- baka flower,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The four- faced Brahma is present in the white Arka flower; the goddess of intelligence is well established in the Karnikara flower; the presiding deity of the Ganas is present in theKaravira flower. Narayana himself is present in the Kura- baka flower,…

verses.sanskrit: शैलं वा दारुजं वापि मृन्मयं वा सवेदिकम् सर्वगन्धमयं वापि क्षणिकं परिकल्पयेत्
verses.transliteration: śailaṃ vā dārujaṃ vāpi mṛnmayaṃ vā savedikam sarvagandhamayaṃ vāpi kṣaṇikaṃ parikalpayet
verses.translation: Thereafter, he shall devoutly offer Mahacaru made of milk, as Naivedya along with ghee and side-dishes, prepared with all materials of diet.
verses.hindi: मैंने कह दिया; है द्विजो! जो मनुष्य क्रमसे अथवा विपरीत क्रमसे वर्षभर इसे करता है, वह शिवसायुज्य स याति शिवसायुज्यं ज्ञानयोगमवाप्नुयात्॥ ५४  तथा ज्ञानयोग प्राप्त करता है
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, he shall devoutly offer Mahacaru made of milk, as Naivedya along with ghee and side-dishes, prepared with all materials of diet.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, he shall devoutly offer Mahacaru made of milk, as Naivedya along with ghee and side-dishes, prepared with all materials of diet.

verses.sanskrit: हैमन्तिके महादेवं श्रीपत्त्रेणैव पूजयेत् सर्वमासेषु कमलं हैममेकमथापि वा
verses.transliteration: haimantike mahādevaṃ śrīpattreṇaiva pūjayet sarvamāseṣu kamalaṃ haimamekamathāpi vā
verses.translation: Or the devotee shall offer an Adhaka measure or half of it of pure cooked rice or cooked with green gram dal. The devotee shall offer Camara (chowries) and fans to the deity. He shall also dedicate presents that had been earned by legally j ustifiable means. They shall be holy and befitting and of diverse kinds. They should be sprinkled with water before de- dication and offered to Rudra with a devoted mind. It was from milk that nectar had been extracted by the victorious Visnu for the sustenance of Devas. Everything is founded on cooked rice. By giving charitable gifts of rice to all living beings lord Siva is delighted. Hence, one shall worship the lord with cooked rice. The vital breaths are stabilised in cooked rice. There is also pleasure in the offering of other presents; the wind-god is present in the fan. Mahadeva himself is present in all materials; the lord of waters, Varuna is present in the scented water; Prakrti along with the principle Mahat is present in the pedestal. Hence, one shall worship the lord duly every month. For achieving all desired objects the Vrata should be observed on the full moon day.
verses.hindi: उमामहेश्वरव्रतका वर्णन तथा पूजाविधान सूत उवाच सूतजी बोले--हे श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! अब मैं नर, नारी उमामहेश्वरं वक्ष्ये व्रतमीश्वरभाषितम्।  आदि प्राणियोंके हितके लिये स्वयं शिवजीद्वारा कहे नरनार्यादिजन्तूनां हिताय मुनिसत्तमाः॥ १  गये उमामहेश्वरव्रतको बताऊँगा । वर्षभर अष्टमी, चतुर्दशी,
verses.wordMeaning: Or the devotee shall offer an Adhaka measure or half of it of pure cooked rice or cooked with green gram dal. The devotee shall offer Camara (chowries) and fans to the deity. He shall also dedicate presents that had been earned by legally j ustifiable means.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Or the devotee shall offer an Adhaka measure or half of it of pure cooked rice or cooked with green gram dal. The devotee shall offer Camara (chowries) and fans to the deity. He shall also dedicate presents that had been earned by legally j ustifiable means.…

verses.sanskrit: राजतं वापि कमलं हैमकर्णिकमुत्तमम् राजतस्याप्यभावे तु बिल्वपत्रैः समर्चयेत्
verses.transliteration: rājataṃ vāpi kamalaṃ haimakarṇikamuttamam rājatasyāpyabhāve tu bilvapatraiḥ samarcayet
verses.translation: One shall preserve truthfulness, cleanliness, kindness, quiescence, contentment and liberal-mindedness. The devotee shall observe fast on full moon and new moon days.
verses.hindi: अमावस्या तथा पूर्णिमाको रातमें हविष्य ग्रहण करना चाहिए और शिवजीकी पूजा करनी चाहिए  शैलादि बोले--  है प्रभो सनत्कुमार ! जो मनुष्य सुवर्ण अथवा चाँदीकी उमा-महेशकी परम सुन्दर
verses.wordMeaning: One shall preserve truthfulness, cleanliness, kindness, quiescence, contentment and liberal-mindedness. The devotee shall observe fast on full moon and new moon days.
verses.commentary: Sense: One shall preserve truthfulness, cleanliness, kindness, quiescence, contentment and liberal-mindedness. The devotee shall observe fast on full moon and new moon days.

verses.sanskrit: सहस्रकमलालाभे तदर्धेनापि पूजयेत् तदर्धार्धेन वा रुद्रम् अष्टोत्तरशतेन वा
verses.transliteration: sahasrakamalālābhe tadardhenāpi pūjayet tadardhārdhena vā rudram aṣṭottaraśatena vā
verses.translation: At the end of the year he shall make a gift of a cow. Particularly he shall observe the rite of Vr§otsarga.® With devotion he shall feed brahmins who have mastered the Vedas and who have sound learning.
verses.hindi: नन कक नलम फफफ फ फ फ़ फ़ फ फ़ फ़ फ फ फ फ़ फ फ़ फ फ़ फ़ फ फ़ फ़ फ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ र फ फ फ फ़ क फ फ फा फ फ फ फफफ मा फाया भाकामा म फफफ फफफ फ फ फ फ़ फ फ फफफ फफ
verses.wordMeaning: At the end of the year he shall make a gift of a cow. Particularly he shall observe the rite of Vr§otsarga.® With devotion he shall feed brahmins who have mastered the Vedas and who have sound learning.
verses.commentary: Sense: At the end of the year he shall make a gift of a cow. Particularly he shall observe the rite of Vr§otsarga.® With devotion he shall feed brahmins who have mastered the Vedas and who have sound learning.

verses.sanskrit: बिल्वपत्रे स्थिता लक्ष्मीर् देवी लक्षणसंयुता नीलोत्पले ऽंबिका साक्षाद् उत्पले षण्मुखः स्वयम्
verses.transliteration: bilvapatre sthitā lakṣmīr devī lakṣaṇasaṃyutā nīlotpale 'ṃbikā sākṣād utpale ṣaṇmukhaḥ svayam
verses.translation: The devotee shall deposit the Lihga that he has worshipped, in the shrine of Siva along with the materials of worship or he may give them to a brahmin.
verses.hindi: रथाद्येर्वापि देवेशं नीत्वा रुद्रालयं प्रति॥ निवेदयेद् व्रतं चैव शिवाय परमेष्ठिने
verses.wordMeaning: The devotee shall deposit the Lihga that he has worshipped, in the shrine of Siva along with the materials of worship or he may give them to a brahmin.
verses.commentary: Sense: The devotee shall deposit the Lihga that he has worshipped, in the shrine of Siva along with the materials of worship or he may give them to a brahmin.

verses.sanskrit: पद्माश्रितो महादेवः सर्वदेवपतिः शिवः तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन श्रीपत्त्रं न त्यजेद्बुधः
verses.transliteration: padmāśrito mahādevaḥ sarvadevapatiḥ śivaḥ tasmātsarvaprayatnena śrīpattraṃ na tyajedbudhaḥ
verses.translation: O excellent sages, only he who devoutly performs this great lioly rite of Sivalihga in all the months, is the most excellent one among those who perform penance.
verses.hindi: स याति शिवसायुज्यं नारी देव्या यदि प्रभो । अष्टम्यां च चतुर्दश्यां नियता ब्रह्मचारिणी
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent sages, only he who devoutly performs this great lioly rite of Sivalihga in all the months, is the most excellent one among those who perform penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent sages, only he who devoutly performs this great lioly rite of Sivalihga in all the months, is the most excellent one among those who perform penance.

verses.sanskrit: नीलोत्पलं चोत्पलं च कमलं च विशेषतः सर्ववश्यकरं पद्मं शिला सर्वार्थसिद्धिदा
verses.transliteration: nīlotpalaṃ cotpalaṃ ca kamalaṃ ca viśeṣataḥ sarvavaśyakaraṃ padmaṃ śilā sarvārthasiddhidā
verses.translation: In aerial chariots that are bedecked in jewels and that are as refulgent as crores of suns, he goes to the divine city of givaoa and never returns here.
verses.hindi: प्रतिष्ठाप्य यथान्यायं दत्त्वा रुद्रालये पुनः। ब्राह्मणान् भोजयित्वा च भवान्या सह मोदते या नार्येवं चरेदब्दं कृष्णामेकां चतुर्दशीम्। वर्षन्ति प्रतिमां कृत्वा येन केनापि वा द्विजा:
verses.wordMeaning: In aerial chariots that are bedecked in jewels and that are as refulgent as crores of suns, he goes to the divine city of givaoa and never returns here.
verses.commentary: Sense: In aerial chariots that are bedecked in jewels and that are as refulgent as crores of suns, he goes to the divine city of givaoa and never returns here.

verses.sanskrit: कृष्णागरुसमुद्भूतं सर्वपापनिकृन्तनम् गुग्गुलुप्रभृतीनां चैव दीपानां च निवेदनम्
verses.transliteration: kṛṣṇāgarusamudbhūtaṃ sarvapāpanikṛntanam gugguluprabhṛtīnāṃ caiva dīpānāṃ ca nivedanam
verses.translation: Or he shall perform this excellent vrata only for a month. Even then he attains the world of Siva. No doubt need be entertained in this respect.
verses.hindi: राजतं कमलं चैव जाम्बूनदसुकर्णिकम्। दत्त्वा भवाय विप्रेभ्यः प्रदद्याइक्षिणामपि
verses.wordMeaning: Or he shall perform this excellent vrata only for a month. Even then he attains the world of Siva. No doubt need be entertained in this respect.
verses.commentary: Sense: Or he shall perform this excellent vrata only for a month. Even then he attains the world of Siva. No doubt need be entertained in this respect.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वरोगक्षयं चैव चन्दनं सर्वसिद्धिदम् सौगन्धिकं तथा धूपं सर्वकामार्थसाधकम्
verses.transliteration: sarvarogakṣayaṃ caiva candanaṃ sarvasiddhidam saugandhikaṃ tathā dhūpaṃ sarvakāmārthasādhakam
verses.translation: Or, if the mind of the devotee is attracted to worldly pleasures he shall observe the holy rite for a year. He will attain whatever boons he craves for and obtain Siva.
verses.hindi: कामतोऽपि कृतं पापं भ्रूणहत्यादिकं च यत्। तत्सर्वं शूलदानेन भिन्द्यान्नारी न संशयः कुर्याद्यद्वा नरः सोऽपि रुद्रसायुज्यमाप्नुयात्
verses.wordMeaning: Or, if the mind of the devotee is attracted to worldly pleasures he shall observe the holy rite for a year. He will attain whatever boons he craves for and obtain Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: Or, if the mind of the devotee is attracted to worldly pleasures he shall observe the holy rite for a year. He will attain whatever boons he craves for and obtain Siva.

verses.sanskrit: श्वेतागरूद्भवं चैव तथा कृष्णागरूद्भवम् सौम्यं सीतारिधूपं च साक्षान्निर्वाणसिद्धिदम्
verses.transliteration: śvetāgarūdbhavaṃ caiva tathā kṛṣṇāgarūdbhavam saumyaṃ sītāridhūpaṃ ca sākṣānnirvāṇasiddhidam
verses.translation: The devoted man obtains Deva-hood, Pitr-hood, or becomes the king of Devas or the chieftain of Ganas.
verses.hindi: नियोगादेव तत्कार्य भर्तृणां द्विजसत्तमाः।
verses.wordMeaning: The devoted man obtains Deva-hood, Pitr-hood, or becomes the king of Devas or the chieftain of Ganas.
verses.commentary: Sense: The devoted man obtains Deva-hood, Pitr-hood, or becomes the king of Devas or the chieftain of Ganas.

verses.sanskrit: श्वेतार्ककुसुमे साक्षाच् चतुर्वक्त्रः प्रजापतिः कर्णिकारस्य कुसुमे मेधा साक्षाद्व्यवस्थिता
verses.transliteration: śvetārkakusume sākṣāc caturvaktraḥ prajāpatiḥ karṇikārasya kusume medhā sākṣādvyavasthitā
verses.translation: He who seeks learning obtains learning; he who seeks worldly pleasures will attain them; he who seeks wealth may espy a treasure-trove and he who desires for longevity will achieve longevity.
verses.hindi: प्रतिमा बनाकर वर्षके अन्तमें LER उसको प्रतिष्ठा करके ब्राह्मणोंको भोजन कराकर उन्हें यथाशक्ति दक्षिण प्रदान करके पूर्ण फे तथा छत्र-चामर- आभूषणे अलंकृत रथ आदिसे देवेश शिव-को शिवालयमें ले जाकर इस ब्रतको परमेश्वर शिवको निवेदित करता है वह शिवसायुज्य प्राप्त करता है और यदि नारी हो, तो वह भगवती उमाका सायुज्य प्राप्त करती है॥ ३ ५,  कन्या हो अथवा विधवा हो-वह एक वर्षतक
verses.wordMeaning: He who seeks learning obtains learning; he who seeks worldly pleasures will attain them; he who seeks wealth may espy a treasure-trove and he who desires for longevity will achieve longevity.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who seeks learning obtains learning; he who seeks worldly pleasures will attain them; he who seeks wealth may espy a treasure-trove and he who desires for longevity will achieve longevity.

verses.sanskrit: करवीरे गणाध्यक्षो बके नारायणः स्वयम् सुगन्धिषु च सर्वेषु कुसुमेषु नगात्मजा
verses.transliteration: karavīre gaṇādhyakṣo bake nārāyaṇaḥ svayam sugandhiṣu ca sarveṣu kusumeṣu nagātmajā
verses.translation: One rejoices by attaining whatever desires he cheri- shes by performing the vrata, only for a month. In the end he will attain Rudratva.
verses.hindi: अष्टमी तथा चतुर्दशीको नियमपूर्वक ब्रह्मचारिणी रहकर भोजन न करे; वर्षके अन्तमें पूर्वोक्त विधिसे प्रतिमा बनाकर विधानके अनुसार उसकी प्रतिष्ठा करके उसे रुद्रालयमें प्रदान करके पुनः ब्राह्मणोंको भोजन कराकर
verses.wordMeaning: One rejoices by attaining whatever desires he cheri- shes by performing the vrata, only for a month. In the end he will attain Rudratva.
verses.commentary: Sense: One rejoices by attaining whatever desires he cheri- shes by performing the vrata, only for a month. In the end he will attain Rudratva.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मादेतैर्यथालाभं पुष्पधूपादिभिः शुभैः पूजयेद्देवदेवेशं भक्त्या वित्तानुसारतः
verses.transliteration: tasmādetairyathālābhaṃ puṣpadhūpādibhiḥ śubhaiḥ pūjayeddevadeveśaṃ bhaktyā vittānusārataḥ
verses.translation: This sacred and excellent vrata which is a great secret is evolved by Siva the creator of the universe, for the benefit of Devas, Asuras, Siddhas, Vidyadharas and human beings.
verses.hindi: वह भवानी (पार्वती)-के साथ आनन्द मनाती है। हे द्विजो! जो स्त्री वर्षपर्यन्त केवल कृष्णपक्षकी चतुर्दशीको यह व्रत करती है और वर्षके अन्तमें जिस किसी पदार्थसे प्रतिमा बनाकर पूर्वोक्त समस्त विधान सम्पन्न करती है, वह भवानीके साथ आनन्द मनाती है ॥ ६-९१/२॥ स्त्रीको चाहिए कि वर्षपर्यन्त नियन्त्रित रहती हुई अमावस्याके दिन आहार ग्रहण न करे और वर्षके अन्तमें विधिपूर्वक त्रिशूल बनवाकर शिवको निवेदित
verses.wordMeaning: This sacred and excellent vrata which is a great secret is evolved by Siva the creator of the universe, for the benefit of Devas, Asuras, Siddhas, Vidyadharas and human beings.
verses.commentary: Sense: This sacred and excellent vrata which is a great secret is evolved by Siva the creator of the universe, for the benefit of Devas, Asuras, Siddhas, Vidyadharas and human beings.

verses.sanskrit: निवेदयेत्ततो भक्त्या पायसं च महाचरुम् सघृतं सोपदंशं च सर्वद्रव्यसमन्वितम्
verses.transliteration: nivedayettato bhaktyā pāyasaṃ ca mahācarum saghṛtaṃ sopadaṃśaṃ ca sarvadravyasamanvitam
verses.translation: After duly worshipping the lord who is worthy of worship, after bowing to him with head bent down along with
verses.hindi: करे तथा ईशानको स्नान कराकर हजार श्वेत कमलोंसे भक्तिपूर्वक उनका पूजन करे और सुवर्णमयी कर्णिकासे युक्त चाँदीका कमल शिवजीको समर्पित करके ब्राह्मणोंको दक्षिणा भी प्रदान करे। वह स्त्री शिवजीके निमित्त
verses.wordMeaning: After duly worshipping the lord who is worthy of worship, after bowing to him with head bent down along with
verses.commentary: Sense: After duly worshipping the lord who is worthy of worship, after bowing to him with head bent down along with

verses.sanskrit: शुद्धान्नं वापि मुद्गान्नम् आढकं चार्धकं तु वा चामरं तालवृन्तं च तस्मै भक्त्या निवेदयेत्
verses.transliteration: śuddhānnaṃ vāpi mudgānnam āḍhakaṃ cārdhakaṃ tu vā cāmaraṃ tālavṛntaṃ ca tasmai bhaktyā nivedayet
verses.translation: A mythical city 'Siva-pura' on the Himalayas, particularly on the Kailasa peak is conceived as the abode of Siva.
verses.hindi: त्रिशूलके दानसे जानबूझकर भ्रूणहत्या आदि जो भी पाप होता है, उन सबको ध्वस्त कर डालती है; इसमें सन्देह नहीं है और है श्रेष्ठ द्विजो! वह भवानीका सायुज्य प्रात कर लेती है। यदि कोई मनुष्य इसे करता है, तो वह भी रुद्रसायुज्य प्राप्त कर लेता है
verses.wordMeaning: A mythical city 'Siva-pura' on the Himalayas, particularly on the Kailasa peak is conceived as the abode of Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: A mythical city 'Siva-pura' on the Himalayas, particularly on the Kailasa peak is conceived as the abode of Siva.

verses.sanskrit: उपहाराणि पुण्यानि न्यायेनैवार्जितान्यपि नानाविधानि चार्हाणि प्रोक्षितान्यंभसा पुनः
verses.transliteration: upahārāṇi puṇyāni nyāyenaivārjitānyapi nānāvidhāni cārhāṇi prokṣitānyaṃbhasā punaḥ
verses.translation: This highly precious hymn was composed by lord Brahma, the Creator of the Universe. For the welfare of the three worlds this was repeated by the magnanimous lord along withDevas.
verses.hindi: अमावस्याको आलस्यरहित तथा उपवासपरायण होकर नारीको तथा नरको भी इसे करना चाहिए । है श्रेष्ठ द्विजो! पतिकी आज्ञासे ही स्त्रियोंको यह व्रत, जप, दान, त सब कुछ करना चाहिए; क्योंकि स्त्रियँ स्वतन्त्र नहीं हैं ।
verses.wordMeaning: This highly precious hymn was composed by lord Brahma, the Creator of the Universe. For the welfare of the three worlds this was repeated by the magnanimous lord along withDevas.
verses.commentary: Sense: This highly precious hymn was composed by lord Brahma, the Creator of the Universe. For the welfare of the three worlds this was repeated by the magnanimous lord along withDevas.

verses.sanskrit: निवेदयेच्च रुद्राय भक्तियुक्तेन चेतसा क्षीराद्वै सर्वदेवानां स्थित्यर्थममृतं ध्रुवम्
verses.transliteration: nivedayecca rudrāya bhaktiyuktena cetasā kṣīrādvai sarvadevānāṃ sthityarthamamṛtaṃ dhruvam
verses.translation: This highly precious hymn was composed by lord Brahma, the Creator of the Universe. For the welfare of the three worlds this was repeated by the magnanimous lord along withDevas.
verses.hindi: हे सुब्रतो! वर्षके अन्तमें सभी प्रकारके गन्धोंसे युक्त उस उमामहेश्वरव्रतका वर्णन तथा पूजाविधान
verses.wordMeaning: This highly precious hymn was composed by lord Brahma, the Creator of the Universe. For the welfare of the three worlds this was repeated by the magnanimous lord along withDevas.
verses.commentary: Sense: This highly precious hymn was composed by lord Brahma, the Creator of the Universe. For the welfare of the three worlds this was repeated by the magnanimous lord along withDevas.

verses.sanskrit: विष्णुना जिष्णुना साक्षाद् अन्ने सर्वं प्रतिष्ठितम् भूतानाम् अन्नदानेन प्रीतिर् भवति शङ्करे
verses.transliteration: viṣṇunā jiṣṇunā sākṣād anne sarvaṃ pratiṣṭhitam bhūtānām annadānena prītir bhavati śaṅkare
verses.translation: This highly precious hymn was composed by lord Brahma, the Creator of the Universe. For the welfare of the three worlds this was repeated by the magnanimous lord along withDevas.
