verses.sanskrit: तस्मात् सम्पूजयेद् देवम् अन्ने प्राणाः प्रतिष्ठिताः उपहारे तथा तुष्टिर् व्यञ्जने पवनः स्वयम्
verses.transliteration: tasmāt sampūjayed devam anne prāṇāḥ pratiṣṭhitāḥ upahāre tathā tuṣṭir vyañjane pavanaḥ svayam
verses.translation: This highly precious hymn was composed by lord Brahma, the Creator of the Universe. For the welfare of the three worlds this was repeated by the magnanimous lord along withDevas.
verses.hindi: लभते नात्र सन्देहः सत्यं सत्यं वदाम्यहम्। कार्तिक्यां वा तु या नारी एकभक्तेन वर्तते क्षमाहिसादिनियमैः संयुक्ता ब्रह्मचारिणी । दद्यात्कृष्णतिलानां च भारमेकमतन्द्रिता
verses.wordMeaning: This highly precious hymn was composed by lord Brahma, the Creator of the Universe. For the welfare of the three worlds this was repeated by the magnanimous lord along withDevas.
verses.commentary: Sense: This highly precious hymn was composed by lord Brahma, the Creator of the Universe. For the welfare of the three worlds this was repeated by the magnanimous lord along withDevas.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वात्मको महादेवो गन्धतोये ह्यपाम्पतिः पीठे वै प्रकृतिः साक्षान् महदाद्यैर्व्यवस्थिता
verses.transliteration: sarvātmako mahādevo gandhatoye hyapāmpatiḥ pīṭhe vai prakṛtiḥ sākṣān mahadādyairvyavasthitā
verses.translation: This highly precious hymn was composed by lord Brahma, the Creator of the Universe. For the welfare of the three worlds this was repeated by the magnanimous lord along withDevas.
verses.hindi: सर्वव्रतेष्वयं धर्मः सामान्यो रुद्रपूजनम्
verses.wordMeaning: This highly precious hymn was composed by lord Brahma, the Creator of the Universe. For the welfare of the three worlds this was repeated by the magnanimous lord along withDevas.
verses.commentary: Sense: This highly precious hymn was composed by lord Brahma, the Creator of the Universe. For the welfare of the three worlds this was repeated by the magnanimous lord along withDevas.

verses.sanskrit: तस्माद्देवं यजेद्भक्त्या प्रतिमासं यथाविधि पौर्णमास्यां व्रतं कार्यं सर्वकामार्थसिद्धये
verses.transliteration: tasmāddevaṃ yajedbhaktyā pratimāsaṃ yathāvidhi paurṇamāsyāṃ vrataṃ kāryaṃ sarvakāmārthasiddhaye
verses.translation: This highly precious hymn was composed by lord Brahma, the Creator of the Universe. For the welfare of the three worlds this was repeated by the magnanimous lord along withDevas.
verses.hindi: मार्गशीर्षकमासादि कार्तिक्यान्तं यथाक्रमम् मार्गशीर्षकमासेऽथ वृषं पूर्णाङ्गमुत्तमम्
verses.wordMeaning: This highly precious hymn was composed by lord Brahma, the Creator of the Universe. For the welfare of the three worlds this was repeated by the magnanimous lord along withDevas.
verses.commentary: Sense: This highly precious hymn was composed by lord Brahma, the Creator of the Universe. For the welfare of the three worlds this was repeated by the magnanimous lord along withDevas.

verses.sanskrit: सत्यं शौचं दया शान्तिः संतोषो दानमेव च पौर्णमास्याममावास्याम् उपवासं च कारयेत्
verses.transliteration: satyaṃ śaucaṃ dayā śāntiḥ saṃtoṣo dānameva ca paurṇamāsyāmamāvāsyām upavāsaṃ ca kārayet
verses.translation: This highly precious hymn was composed by lord Brahma, the Creator of the Universe. For the welfare of the three worlds this was repeated by the magnanimous lord along withDevas.
verses.hindi: अलङ्कृत्य यथान्यायं शिवाय विनिवेदयेत्। सा च सार्ध भवान्या वै मोदते नात्र संशयः
verses.wordMeaning: This highly precious hymn was composed by lord Brahma, the Creator of the Universe. For the welfare of the three worlds this was repeated by the magnanimous lord along withDevas.
verses.commentary: Sense: This highly precious hymn was composed by lord Brahma, the Creator of the Universe. For the welfare of the three worlds this was repeated by the magnanimous lord along withDevas.

verses.sanskrit: संवत्सरान्ते गोदानं वृषोत्सर्गं विशेषतः भोजयेद्ब्राह्मणान्भक्त्या श्रोत्रियान् वेदपारगान्
verses.transliteration: saṃvatsarānte godānaṃ vṛṣotsargaṃ viśeṣataḥ bhojayedbrāhmaṇānbhaktyā śrotriyān vedapāragān
verses.translation: This highly precious hymn was composed by lord Brahma, the Creator of the Universe. For the welfare of the three worlds this was repeated by the magnanimous lord along withDevas.
verses.hindi: पुष्यमासे तु वै शूलं प्रतिष्ठाप्य निवेदयेत्। पूर्वोक्तमखिलं कृत्वा भवान्या सह मोदते माघमासे रथं कृत्वा सर्वलक्षणलक्षितम्। दद्यात्सम्पूज्य देवेशं ब्राह्मणांश्चैव भोजयेत्
verses.wordMeaning: This highly precious hymn was composed by lord Brahma, the Creator of the Universe. For the welfare of the three worlds this was repeated by the magnanimous lord along withDevas.
verses.commentary: Sense: This highly precious hymn was composed by lord Brahma, the Creator of the Universe. For the welfare of the three worlds this was repeated by the magnanimous lord along withDevas.

verses.sanskrit: तल् लिङ्गं पूजितं तेन सर्वद्रव्यसमन्वितम् स्थापयेद् वा शिवक्षेत्रे दापयेद् ब्राह्मणाय वा
verses.transliteration: tal liṅgaṃ pūjitaṃ tena sarvadravyasamanvitam sthāpayed vā śivakṣetre dāpayed brāhmaṇāya vā
verses.translation: This highly precious hymn was composed by lord Brahma, the Creator of the Universe. For the welfare of the three worlds this was repeated by the magnanimous lord along withDevas.
verses.hindi: सा च देव्या महाभागा मोदते नात्र संशयः। फाले प्रतिमा कतवा हिण्येन यथाविधि॥२८ विधि ता चर 00 या प्रतिमां कृत्वा हिरण्येन यथाविधि
verses.wordMeaning: This highly precious hymn was composed by lord Brahma, the Creator of the Universe. For the welfare of the three worlds this was repeated by the magnanimous lord along withDevas.
verses.commentary: Sense: This highly precious hymn was composed by lord Brahma, the Creator of the Universe. For the welfare of the three worlds this was repeated by the magnanimous lord along withDevas.

verses.sanskrit: य एवं सर्वमासेषु शिवलिङ्गमहाव्रतम् कुर्याद्भक्त्या मुनिश्रेष्ठाः स एव तपतां वरः
verses.transliteration: ya evaṃ sarvamāseṣu śivaliṅgamahāvratam kuryādbhaktyā muniśreṣṭhāḥ sa eva tapatāṃ varaḥ
verses.translation: This highly precious hymn was composed by lord Brahma, the Creator of the Universe. For the welfare of the three worlds this was repeated by the magnanimous lord along withDevas.
verses.hindi: भारका परिमाण इस प्रकार है-- नु प्रतिमाको शिवको निवेदित कर देना चाहिए; वह सुव्रता स्त्री भवानीका सायुज्य तथा सारूप्य प्राप्त कर लेती है; इसमें सन्देह नहीं है, मैं यह पूर्णतः सत्य कह रहा
verses.wordMeaning: This highly precious hymn was composed by lord Brahma, the Creator of the Universe. For the welfare of the three worlds this was repeated by the magnanimous lord along withDevas.
verses.commentary: Sense: This highly precious hymn was composed by lord Brahma, the Creator of the Universe. For the welfare of the three worlds this was repeated by the magnanimous lord along withDevas.

verses.sanskrit: सूर्यकोटिप्रतीकाशैर् विमानै रत्नभूषितैः गत्वा शिवपुरं दिव्यं नेहायाति कदाचन
verses.transliteration: sūryakoṭipratīkāśair vimānai ratnabhūṣitaiḥ gatvā śivapuraṃ divyaṃ nehāyāti kadācana
verses.translation: This highly precious hymn was composed by lord Brahma, the Creator of the Universe. For the welfare of the three worlds this was repeated by the magnanimous lord along withDevas.
verses.hindi: जो स्त्री कार्तिक मासमें एक बार भोजन करती है, क्षमा-अहिंसा आदि नियमोंसे युक्त रहती है, ब्रह्मचर्यका पालन करती है, आलस्यरहित होकर एक भार काला तिल तथा घृत-गुड़ मिलाकर पकाया भात परमेश्वरको
verses.wordMeaning: This highly precious hymn was composed by lord Brahma, the Creator of the Universe. For the welfare of the three worlds this was repeated by the magnanimous lord along withDevas.
verses.commentary: Sense: This highly precious hymn was composed by lord Brahma, the Creator of the Universe. For the welfare of the three worlds this was repeated by the magnanimous lord along withDevas.

verses.sanskrit: अथवा ह्येकमासं वा चरेदेवं व्रतोत्तमम् शिवलोकमवाप्नोति नात्र कार्या विचारणा
verses.transliteration: athavā hyekamāsaṃ vā caredevaṃ vratottamam śivalokamavāpnoti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā
verses.translation: This highly precious hymn was composed by lord Brahma, the Creator of the Universe. For the welfare of the three worlds this was repeated by the magnanimous lord along withDevas.
verses.hindi: निवेदित करती है, ब्राह्मणोंको अपने सामर्थ्यके अनुसार दान देती है और अष्टमी तथा चतुर्दशीको उपवास करती है--वह उत्तम ब्रतवाली स्त्री भवानीका सारूप्य प्राप्त करके उनके साथ आनन्द मनाती है॥ १८--२१॥ समस्त व्रतोंमें क्षमा, सत्य, दया, दान, शुद्धि तथा इन्द्रियोंका निग्रह और रुद्रपूजन--यह सामान्य धर्म है
verses.wordMeaning: This highly precious hymn was composed by lord Brahma, the Creator of the Universe. For the welfare of the three worlds this was repeated by the magnanimous lord along withDevas.
verses.commentary: Sense: This highly precious hymn was composed by lord Brahma, the Creator of the Universe. For the welfare of the three worlds this was repeated by the magnanimous lord along withDevas.

verses.sanskrit: अथवा सक्तचित्तश्चेद् यान्यान् संचिन्तयेद्वरान् वर्षमेकं चरेदेवं तांस्तान्प्राप्य शिवं व्रजेत्
verses.transliteration: athavā saktacittaśced yānyān saṃcintayedvarān varṣamekaṃ caredevaṃ tāṃstānprāpya śivaṃ vrajet
verses.translation: This highly precious hymn was composed by lord Brahma, the Creator of the Universe. For the welfare of the three worlds this was repeated by the magnanimous lord along withDevas.
verses.hindi: अब मैं संक्षेपमें क्रमसे मार्गशीर्षसे प्रारम्भ करके कार्तिकतक प्रत्येक महीनेके व्रतको बताऊँगा; इस परम पुण्यप्रद व्रतको स्वयं नन्दीने कहा था॥ २३ /२॥
verses.wordMeaning: This highly precious hymn was composed by lord Brahma, the Creator of the Universe. For the welfare of the three worlds this was repeated by the magnanimous lord along withDevas.
verses.commentary: Sense: This highly precious hymn was composed by lord Brahma, the Creator of the Universe. For the welfare of the three worlds this was repeated by the magnanimous lord along withDevas.

verses.sanskrit: देवत्वं वा पितृत्वं वा देवराजत्वमेव च गाणपत्यपदं वापि सक्तो ऽपि लभते नरः
verses.transliteration: devatvaṃ vā pitṛtvaṃ vā devarājatvameva ca gāṇapatyapadaṃ vāpi sakto 'pi labhate naraḥ
verses.translation: This highly precious hymn was composed by lord Brahma, the Creator of the Universe. For the welfare of the three worlds this was repeated by the magnanimous lord along withDevas.
verses.hindi: जो स्त्री मार्गशीर्ष मासमें पूर्ण अंगोंवाले उत्तम वृषभको अलंकृत करके विधिपूर्वक शिवको निवेदित करती है, वह भवानीके साथ आनन्दित रहती है; इसमें सन्देह नहीं है जो पौष मासमें पूर्वोक्त विधिके अनुसार सम्पूर्ण कृत्य करके त्रिशूलकी स्थापनाकर उसे शिवको समर्पित करती है, वह भवानीके साथ आनन्द मनाती है
verses.wordMeaning: This highly precious hymn was composed by lord Brahma, the Creator of the Universe. For the welfare of the three worlds this was repeated by the magnanimous lord along withDevas.
verses.commentary: Sense: This highly precious hymn was composed by lord Brahma, the Creator of the Universe. For the welfare of the three worlds this was repeated by the magnanimous lord along withDevas.

verses.sanskrit: विद्यार्थी लभते विद्यां भोगार्थी भोगमाप्नुयात् द्रव्यार्थी च निधिं पश्येद् आयुःकामश् चिरायुषम्
verses.transliteration: vidyārthī labhate vidyāṃ bhogārthī bhogamāpnuyāt dravyārthī ca nidhiṃ paśyed āyuḥkāmaś cirāyuṣam
verses.translation: This highly precious hymn was composed by lord Brahma, the Creator of the Universe. For the welfare of the three worlds this was repeated by the magnanimous lord along withDevas.
verses.hindi: हे महाभाग मुनियो ! जो माघ महीनेमें सभी लक्षणोंसे युक्त रथ बनाकर देवेशकी पूजा करके उसे शिवको समर्पित करती है और ब्राह्मणोंको भोजन कराती है, वह देवी पार्वती-के साथ आनन्द करती है; इसमें सन्देह
verses.wordMeaning: This highly precious hymn was composed by lord Brahma, the Creator of the Universe. For the welfare of the three worlds this was repeated by the magnanimous lord along withDevas.
verses.commentary: Sense: This highly precious hymn was composed by lord Brahma, the Creator of the Universe. For the welfare of the three worlds this was repeated by the magnanimous lord along withDevas.

verses.sanskrit: यान्यांश्चिन्तयते कामांस् तांस्तान्प्राप्येह मोदते एकमासव्रतादेव सो ऽन्ते रुद्रत्वमाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: yānyāṃścintayate kāmāṃs tāṃstānprāpyeha modate ekamāsavratādeva so 'nte rudratvamāpnuyāt
verses.translation: This highly precious hymn was composed by lord Brahma, the Creator of the Universe. For the welfare of the three worlds this was repeated by the magnanimous lord along withDevas.
verses.hindi: जो फाल्गुन मासमें अपने सामर्थ्यके अनुसार विधिपूर्वक सोने, चाँदी अथवा ताँबेकी प्रतिमा बनाकर अष्टौ धरणमष्टौ च कर्ष तांश्चतुरः पलम्। तुलां पलशतं प्राहुर्भारं स्याद्विंशतिस्तुला: ॥ अर्थात् ' चार व्रीहि (धान)-की एक गुंजा, पाँच गुंजाका एक पण, आठ पणका एक धरण, आठ धरणका एक कर्ष, चार कर्षका एक पल, सौ पलकी एक तुला और बीस तुलाका एक भार कहलाता है।'
verses.wordMeaning: This highly precious hymn was composed by lord Brahma, the Creator of the Universe. For the welfare of the three worlds this was repeated by the magnanimous lord along withDevas.
verses.commentary: Sense: This highly precious hymn was composed by lord Brahma, the Creator of the Universe. For the welfare of the three worlds this was repeated by the magnanimous lord along withDevas.

verses.sanskrit: इदं पवित्रं परमं रहस्यं व्रतोत्तमं विश्वसृजापि सृष्टम् हिताय देवासुरसिद्धमर्त्यविद्याधराणां परमं शिवेन
verses.transliteration: idaṃ pavitraṃ paramaṃ rahasyaṃ vratottamaṃ viśvasṛjāpi sṛṣṭam hitāya devāsurasiddhamartyavidyādharāṇāṃ paramaṃ śivena
verses.translation: This highly precious hymn was composed by lord Brahma, the Creator of the Universe. For the welfare of the three worlds this was repeated by the magnanimous lord along withDevas.
verses.hindi: प्रतिष्ठाप्य समभ्यर्च्य स्थापयेच्छङ्करालये॥ सा च सार्ध महादेव्या मोदते नात्र संशयः। चैत्रे भवं कुमारं च भवानीं च यथाविधि
verses.wordMeaning: This highly precious hymn was composed by lord Brahma, the Creator of the Universe. For the welfare of the three worlds this was repeated by the magnanimous lord along withDevas.
verses.commentary: Sense: This highly precious hymn was composed by lord Brahma, the Creator of the Universe. For the welfare of the three worlds this was repeated by the magnanimous lord along withDevas.

verses.sanskrit: सम्पूज्य पूज्यं विधिनैवमीशं प्रणम्य मूर्ध्ना सह भृत्यपुत्रैः व्यपोहनं नाम जपेत्स्तवं च प्रदक्षिणं कृत्य शिवं प्रयत्नात्
verses.transliteration: sampūjya pūjyaṃ vidhinaivamīśaṃ praṇamya mūrdhnā saha bhṛtyaputraiḥ vyapohanaṃ nāma japetstavaṃ ca pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtya śivaṃ prayatnāt
verses.translation: This highly precious hymn was composed by lord Brahma, the Creator of the Universe. For the welfare of the three worlds this was repeated by the magnanimous lord along withDevas.
verses.hindi: भवान्या मोदते सार्धे दत्त्वा रुद्राय शम्भवे वैशाखे वै चरेदेवं कैलासाख्यं व्रतोत्तमम्। कैलासपर्वतं प्राप्य भवान्या सह मोदते
verses.wordMeaning: This highly precious hymn was composed by lord Brahma, the Creator of the Universe. For the welfare of the three worlds this was repeated by the magnanimous lord along withDevas.
verses.commentary: Sense: This highly precious hymn was composed by lord Brahma, the Creator of the Universe. For the welfare of the three worlds this was repeated by the magnanimous lord along withDevas.

verses.sanskrit: पुराकृतं विश्वसृजा स्तवं च हिताय देवेन जगत्त्रयस्य पितामहेनैव सुरैश्च सार्धं महानुभावेन महार्घ्यम् एतत्
verses.transliteration: purākṛtaṃ viśvasṛjā stavaṃ ca hitāya devena jagattrayasya pitāmahenaiva suraiśca sārdhaṃ mahānubhāvena mahārghyam etat
verses.translation: This highly precious hymn was composed by lord Brahma, the Creator of the Universe. For the welfare of the three worlds this was repeated by the magnanimous lord along withDevas.
verses.hindi: ज्येष्ठे मासि महादेवं लिङ्गमू्तिमुमापतिम्। कृताञ्जलिपुटेनैव ब्रह्मणा विष्णुना तथा
verses.wordMeaning: This highly precious hymn was composed by lord Brahma, the Creator of the Universe. For the welfare of the three worlds this was repeated by the magnanimous lord along withDevas.
verses.commentary: Sense: This highly precious hymn was composed by lord Brahma, the Creator of the Universe. For the welfare of the three worlds this was repeated by the magnanimous lord along withDevas.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीलिङ्गमहापुराणे पूर्वभागे पशुपाशविमोचनलिङ्गपूजादिकथनं नामैकाशीतितमो ऽध्यायः व्यपोहनस्तवं वक्ष्ये सर्वसिद्धिप्रदं शुभम् नन्दिनश् च मुखाच्छ्रुत्वा कुमारेण महात्मना
verses.transliteration: iti śrīliṅgamahāpurāṇe pūrvabhāge paśupāśavimocanaliṅgapūjādikathanaṃ nāmaikāśītitamo 'dhyāyaḥ vyapohanastavaṃ vakṣye sarvasiddhipradaṃ śubham nandinaś ca mukhācchrutvā kumāreṇa mahātmanā
verses.translation: I shall now mention the auspicious hymn that dispels sins and bestows Siddhis. This was at first heard by the noble Kumara from Nandin and narrated to Vyasa and from him heard by me with great attention.
verses.hindi: मध्ये भवेन संयुक्तं लिङ्गमूतिं द्विजोत्तमाः। हंसेन च वराहेण कृत्वा ताम्रादिभिः शुभाम् शिवाय शिवमासाद्य शिवस्थाने यथाविधि
verses.wordMeaning: I shall now mention the auspicious hymn that dispels sins and bestows Siddhis. This was at first heard by the noble Kumara from Nandin and narrated to Vyasa and from him heard by me with great attention.
verses.commentary: Sense: I shall now mention the auspicious hymn that dispels sins and bestows Siddhis. This was at first heard by the noble Kumara from Nandin and narrated to Vyasa and from him heard by me with great attention.

verses.sanskrit: व्यासाय कथितं तस्माद् बहुमानेन वै मया नमः शिवाय शुद्धाय निर्मलाय यशस्विने
verses.transliteration: vyāsāya kathitaṃ tasmād bahumānena vai mayā namaḥ śivāya śuddhāya nirmalāya yaśasvine
verses.translation: May IiSa, Puru§a, Aghora, Sadya and Vamadeva dispel sin quickly. May Ananta, the lord of all learning, the omniscient lord who is the bestower of everything and who is richly endowed with meditation on Siva dispel my sin. May the subtle lord of Devas and Asuras, the lord of the universe, worshipped by Ganas and endowed with the sole meditation on Siva dispel my sin. May the most excellent one among auspi-
verses.hindi: बराह्मणैः सहितां स्थाप्य देव्याः सायुज्यमाप्नुयात्। आषाढे च शुभे मासे गृहं कृत्वा सुशोभनम्
verses.wordMeaning: May IiSa, Puru§a, Aghora, Sadya and Vamadeva dispel sin quickly. May Ananta, the lord of all learning, the omniscient lord who is the bestower of everything and who is richly endowed with meditation on Siva dispel my sin. May the subtle lord of Devas and Asuras,…
verses.commentary: Sense: May IiSa, Puru§a, Aghora, Sadya and Vamadeva dispel sin quickly. May Ananta, the lord of all learning, the omniscient lord who is the bestower of everything and who is richly endowed with meditation on Siva dispel my sin. May the subtle lord of Devas and Asuras,…

verses.sanskrit: दुष्टान्तकाय सर्वाय भवाय परमात्मने पञ्चवक्त्रो दशभुजो ह्य् अक्षपञ्चदशैर्युतः
verses.transliteration: duṣṭāntakāya sarvāya bhavāya paramātmane pañcavaktro daśabhujo hy akṣapañcadaśairyutaḥ
verses.translation: padm&sanar-'See note 47.
verses.hindi: पक्वेष्टकाभिर्विधिवद्यथाविभवविस्तरम् । सर्वबीजरसैश्चापि सम्पूर्ण सर्वशोभनैः गृहोपकरणैश्चैव मुसलोलूखलादिभिः।
verses.wordMeaning: padm&sanar-'See note 47.
verses.commentary: Sense: padm&sanar-'See note 47.

verses.sanskrit: शुद्धस्फटिकसंकाशः सर्वाभरणभूषितः सर्वज्ञः सर्वगः शान्तः सर्वोपरि सुसंस्थितः
verses.transliteration: śuddhasphaṭikasaṃkāśaḥ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ sarvajñaḥ sarvagaḥ śāntaḥ sarvopari susaṃsthitaḥ
verses.translation: May the single-eyed lord Ia, engrossed in aus- picious worship, the lord richly endowed with meditation on Siva dispel my sin. May lord Ua. of three forms, the inducer of Siva's devotion and richly endowed with meditation on Siva dispel my sin. May Srikantha the glorious lord of fortune, always engaged in meditation and worship of Siva, dispel my sin. May the tufted quiescent lord, smeared with ashes from the corpse and the glorious one engaged in the worship of Siva, dispel my sin.
verses.hindi: देवं घृतादिभिः स्नाप्य महादेवमुमापतिम्
verses.wordMeaning: May the single-eyed lord Ia, engrossed in aus- picious worship, the lord richly endowed with meditation on Siva dispel my sin. May lord Ua. of three forms, the inducer of Siva's devotion and richly endowed with meditation on Siva dispel my sin.…
verses.commentary: Sense: May the single-eyed lord Ia, engrossed in aus- picious worship, the lord richly endowed with meditation on Siva dispel my sin. May lord Ua. of three forms, the inducer of Siva's devotion and richly endowed with meditation on Siva dispel my sin.…

verses.sanskrit: पद्मासनस्थः सोमेशः पापमाशु व्यपोहतु ईशानः पुरुषश्चैव अघोरः सद्य एव च
verses.transliteration: padmāsanasthaḥ someśaḥ pāpamāśu vyapohatu īśānaḥ puruṣaścaiva aghoraḥ sadya eva ca
verses.translation: sraj& — the first-bom.
verses.hindi: कन्यां सुमध्यमां यावत्कालजीवनसंयुताम् उसकी प्रतिष्ठा तथा पूजा करके शिवालयमें करती है, वह महादेवीके साथ आनन्दित रहती है सन्देह नहीं है॥ २८-२९/२॥ चैत्र मासमें ताँबे आदिसे शिव, कुमार ( कार्तिकेय
verses.wordMeaning: sraj& — the first-bom.
verses.commentary: Sense: sraj& — the first-bom.

verses.sanskrit: वामदेवश् च भगवान् पापमाशु व्यपोहतु अनन्तः सर्वविद्येशः सर्वज्ञः सर्वदः प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: vāmadevaś ca bhagavān pāpamāśu vyapohatu anantaḥ sarvavidyeśaḥ sarvajñaḥ sarvadaḥ prabhuḥ
verses.translation: Naigamcya, etc. The four brothers (sons of Uma) are named (i) Kumara, (ii) Sakha, (iii) ViSakha, (iv) Naigameya. These appear on the gold coins of Kuviska in the early Kushan period.
verses.hindi: तथा भवानीकी मूर्तियाँ यथाविधि बनाकर विधिपूर्वक उसको प्रतिष्ठा करके उन्हें रुद्र शम्भुको अर्पण करनेसे स्त्री भवानीके साथ आनन्दित रहती है॥ ३० ३१॥ कुबेरका रजतमय कैलास आलय बनाकर उसे चारों
verses.wordMeaning: Naigamcya, etc. The four brothers (sons of Uma) are named (i) Kumara, (ii) Sakha, (iii) ViSakha, (iv) Naigameya. These appear on the gold coins of Kuviska in the early Kushan period.
verses.commentary: Sense: Naigamcya, etc. The four brothers (sons of Uma) are named (i) Kumara, (ii) Sakha, (iii) ViSakha, (iv) Naigameya. These appear on the gold coins of Kuviska in the early Kushan period.

verses.sanskrit: शिवध्यानैकसम्पन्नः स मे पापं व्यपोहतु सूक्ष्मः सुरासुरेशानो विश्वेशो गणपूजितः
verses.transliteration: śivadhyānaikasampannaḥ sa me pāpaṃ vyapohatu sūkṣmaḥ surāsureśāno viśveśo gaṇapūjitaḥ
verses.translation: The tvventythree principles consist of ten senses, five bhutas, five tanmatras, buddhi, ahaihkara and manas. Of. Bhaga 3.6.2 "trayo- vimSati tattvanam ganam.
verses.hindi: ओरसे सभी रलोंसे युक्त करके उसमें शिव, उमा तथा गणेश्वरोंको रजतमय मूर्ति रखकर उसकी यथाविधि प्रतिष्ठा करके उसे परमेश्वर शिवके सुन्दर मन्दिरमे स्थापित करना चाहिए; जो स्त्री वैशाख मासमें इस प्रकार कैलास नामक उत्तम व्रतको करती है, वह कैलासपर्वत पहुँचकर भवानीके साथ आनन्द करती है॥ ३२--३४॥ हे उत्तम ब्राह्मणो ! ज्येष्ठ मासमें उमापति महादेवकी ताम्र आदिसे एक शुभ्र लिङ्गमूर्ति बनवाये, जो हाथ जोडे
verses.wordMeaning: The tvventythree principles consist of ten senses, five bhutas, five tanmatras, buddhi, ahaihkara and manas. Of. Bhaga 3.6.2 "trayo- vimSati tattvanam ganam.
verses.commentary: Sense: The tvventythree principles consist of ten senses, five bhutas, five tanmatras, buddhi, ahaihkara and manas. Of. Bhaga 3.6.2 "trayo- vimSati tattvanam ganam.

verses.sanskrit: शिवध्यानैकसम्पन्नः स मे पापं व्यपोहतु शिवोत्तमो महापूज्यः शिवध्यानपरायणः
verses.transliteration: śivadhyānaikasampannaḥ sa me pāpaṃ vyapohatu śivottamo mahāpūjyaḥ śivadhyānaparāyaṇaḥ
verses.translation: May Canda the lord of all the Ganas, who came out of the mouth of Siva, the glorious one engaged in the worship of Siva, dispel my sin.
verses.hindi: हुए हंसपर सवार ब्रह्मा तथा वाराहपर सवार विष्णुसे संयुक्त हो और मध्यमें भव (महेश्वर) विराजमान हों-ऐसी लिङ्गमूर्ति बनवाकर विधिपूर्वक उसकी प्रतिष्ठा करनेके अनन्तर ब्राह्मणोंको भोजन कराये और
verses.wordMeaning: May Canda the lord of all the Ganas, who came out of the mouth of Siva, the glorious one engaged in the worship of Siva, dispel my sin.
verses.commentary: Sense: May Canda the lord of all the Ganas, who came out of the mouth of Siva, the glorious one engaged in the worship of Siva, dispel my sin.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वगः सर्वदः शान्तः स मे पापं व्यपोहतु एकाक्षो भगवानीशः शिवार्चनपरायणः
verses.transliteration: sarvagaḥ sarvadaḥ śāntaḥ sa me pāpaṃ vyapohatu ekākṣo bhagavānīśaḥ śivārcanaparāyaṇaḥ
verses.translation: May the lord Nandin dispel all sins; Nandin the son of Salahkayana, originating from the path of the plough- share, the son-in-law of the Maruts, the lord of all Bhutas, the all-pervasive, one who has eyes everywhere; the lord who is like the lord of all, may he dispel sins. He is the lord of the three worlds eulogised by Devas including Narayana, Indra* moon, sun, Siddhas, Yaksas, Gandharvas, Bhutas, the creators of Bhutas, serpents, sages and the noble-souled Brahma. He is stationed in the harem of the lord. He is always wor- shipped by all.
verses.hindi: अपने कल्याणके लिये शिवको प्रसन्न करके ब्राह्मणोंको साथ लेकर शिवालयमें उसे विधिपूर्वक स्थापित करके वह देवीका सायुज्य प्राप्त कर लेती है जो स्त्री शुभ आषाढ़ महीनेमें अपने सामर्थ्यके अनुसार पके हुए ईटोंसे विधिवत् गृह बनवाकर उसे सभी बीजरसोंसे, परम सुन्दर मूसल-उलूखल आदि गृहोपयोगी सामग्रियोंसे, दास-दासी आदिसे, पलंग-विस्तर आदि
verses.wordMeaning: May the lord Nandin dispel all sins; Nandin the son of Salahkayana, originating from the path of the plough- share, the son-in-law of the Maruts, the lord of all Bhutas, the all-pervasive, one who has eyes everywhere; the lord who is like the lord of all, may he dispel sins.…
verses.commentary: Sense: May the lord Nandin dispel all sins; Nandin the son of Salahkayana, originating from the path of the plough- share, the son-in-law of the Maruts, the lord of all Bhutas, the all-pervasive, one who has eyes everywhere; the lord who is like the lord of all, may he dispel sins.…

verses.sanskrit: शिवध्यानैकसम्पन्नः स मे पापं व्यपोहतु त्रिमूर्तिर् भगवान् ईशः शिवभक्तिप्रबोधकः
verses.transliteration: śivadhyānaikasampannaḥ sa me pāpaṃ vyapohatu trimūrtir bhagavān īśaḥ śivabhaktiprabodhakaḥ
verses.translation: May he who has great splendour and strength, he who is like another Mahadeva, the glorious one engaged in the worship of Siva, dispel my sin.
verses.hindi: शयन-वस्तुओंसे, अन्न आदि खाद्य पदार्थोसे युक्त करके उस गृहको सभी ओरसे पूर्ण वस्त्रोंसे ढुँककर उमापति प्रभु महादेवको घृत आदिसे स्नान कराकर विधिपूर्वक एक हजार ब्राह्मणोंको भोजन कराकर विद्या-विनयसे
verses.wordMeaning: May he who has great splendour and strength, he who is like another Mahadeva, the glorious one engaged in the worship of Siva, dispel my sin.
verses.commentary: Sense: May he who has great splendour and strength, he who is like another Mahadeva, the glorious one engaged in the worship of Siva, dispel my sin.

verses.sanskrit: शिवध्यानैकसम्पन्नः स मे पापं व्यपोहतु श्रीकण्ठः श्रीपतिः श्रीमाञ् शिवध्यानरतः सदा
verses.transliteration: śivadhyānaikasampannaḥ sa me pāpaṃ vyapohatu śrīkaṇṭhaḥ śrīpatiḥ śrīmāñ śivadhyānarataḥ sadā
verses.translation: May the auspicious elephant- faced deity surrounded by hundreds and crores of Ganas and engrossed in the medita- tion on Siva dispel my sin. He splits and pierces the ridges and peaks of the Meru, Mandara and Kailasa; he is worshipped by Airavata and other divine elephants of the quarters. The seven Pa talas'® constitute his feet; the seven continents'*® his thighs and calves; the seven oceans'* his goads; all the holy centres
verses.hindi: सम्पन्न तथा वेदमें पारंगत ब्रह्मचारी ब्राह्मणको यथाविधि पूजा करके पूर्ण जीवनभरके लिये एक परर समान महाराशिवाले अनेक प्रकारके दिव्य
verses.wordMeaning: May the auspicious elephant- faced deity surrounded by hundreds and crores of Ganas and engrossed in the medita- tion on Siva dispel my sin. He splits and pierces the ridges and peaks of the Meru, Mandara and Kailasa;…
verses.commentary: Sense: May the auspicious elephant- faced deity surrounded by hundreds and crores of Ganas and engrossed in the medita- tion on Siva dispel my sin. He splits and pierces the ridges and peaks of the Meru, Mandara and Kailasa;…

verses.sanskrit: शिवार्चनरतः श्रीमान् स मे पापं व्यपोहतु त्रैलोक्यनमिता देवी सोल्काकारा पुरातनी
verses.transliteration: śivārcanarataḥ śrīmān sa me pāpaṃ vyapohatu trailokyanamitā devī solkākārā purātanī
verses.translation: seven nether regions, see note 90
verses.hindi: उमामहेश्वरव्रतका वर्णन तथा पूजाविधान
verses.wordMeaning: seven nether regions, see note 90
verses.commentary: Sense: seven nether regions, see note 90

verses.sanskrit: शिवार्चनरतः श्रीमान् स मे पापं व्यपोहतु त्रैलोक्यनमिता देवी सोल्काकारा पुरातनी
verses.transliteration: śivārcanarataḥ śrīmān sa me pāpaṃ vyapohatu trailokyanamitā devī solkākārā purātanī
verses.translation: See note 247.
verses.hindi: गोलोकं समनृप्राप्य भवान्या सह मोदते। भवान्या सदूशी भूत्वा सर्वकल्पेषु साव्यया सर्वधातुसमाकीर्णं विचित्रध्वजशोभितम्
verses.wordMeaning: See note 247.
verses.commentary: Sense: See note 247.

verses.sanskrit: दाक्षायणी महादेवी गौरी हैमवती शुभा एकपर्णाग्रजा सौम्या तथा वै चैकपाटला
verses.transliteration: dākṣāyaṇī mahādevī gaurī haimavatī śubhā ekaparṇāgrajā saumyā tathā vai caikapāṭalā
verses.translation: See note 247; p. igi note 282.
verses.hindi: सा च सूर्याशुसङ्काशा भवान्या सह मोदते। कृत्वा चाश्वयुजे मासि विपुलं धान्यपर्वतम्
verses.wordMeaning: See note 247; p. igi note 282.
verses.commentary: Sense: See note 247; p. igi note 282.

verses.sanskrit: अपर्णा वरदा देवी वरदानैकतत्परा उमा सुरहरा साक्षात् कौशिकी वा कपर्दिनी
verses.transliteration: aparṇā varadā devī varadānaikatatparā umā suraharā sākṣāt kauśikī vā kapardinī
verses.translation: May the glorious tawny-eyed lord Bhrngin who has a body that has brightened the quarters, and who is engaged in the worship of Siva dispel my sin.
verses.hindi: सुवर्णवस्त्रसंयुक्तं दत्त्वा सम्पूज्य शङ्करम्। ब्राह्मणान् भोजयित्वा च पूर्वोक्तमखिलं भवेत् शृङ्केश्चतुर्भिः संयुक्तं वितानच्छत्रशोभितम्। गन्धमाल्यैस्तथा धूपैश्चित्रैश्चापि सुशोभितम्
verses.wordMeaning: May the glorious tawny-eyed lord Bhrngin who has a body that has brightened the quarters, and who is engaged in the worship of Siva dispel my sin.
verses.commentary: Sense: May the glorious tawny-eyed lord Bhrngin who has a body that has brightened the quarters, and who is engaged in the worship of Siva dispel my sin.

verses.sanskrit: खट्वाङ्गधारिणी दिव्या कराग्रतरुपल्लवा नैगमेयादिभिर् दिव्यैश् चतुर्भिः पुत्रकैर्वृता
verses.transliteration: khaṭvāṅgadhāriṇī divyā karāgratarupallavā naigameyādibhir divyaiś caturbhiḥ putrakairvṛtā
verses.translation: May the Sakti-bearing commander-in-chief of the army of Devas, the glorious destroyer of Asuras by means of his four bodies [?], the quiescent peacock-vehicled leader of the armies dispel my sin. May these forms' of Paramesthin dispel my sin, viz., — Bhava, Sarva, Isana, Rudra, Pasupati, Ugra, Bhima and Mahadeva, who are always engaged in the worship of Siva. The following parts of his body, viz., — Mahadeva, Siva, Rudra, Sankara, Nilalohita, Isana, Vijaya, Bhima, Bhavo- dbhava the lord of Devas, Kapalin and Isa, who are all engag- ed in doing obeisance of Siva. May they dispel my impurity (sin).
verses.hindi: नगेन्द्रं मेरुनामानं त्रैलोक्याधारमुत्तमम्
verses.wordMeaning: May the Sakti-bearing commander-in-chief of the army of Devas, the glorious destroyer of Asuras by means of his four bodies [?], the quiescent peacock-vehicled leader of the armies dispel my sin. May these forms' of Paramesthin dispel my sin, viz., — Bhava, Sarva, Isana, Rudra,…
verses.commentary: Sense: May the Sakti-bearing commander-in-chief of the army of Devas, the glorious destroyer of Asuras by means of his four bodies [?], the quiescent peacock-vehicled leader of the armies dispel my sin. May these forms' of Paramesthin dispel my sin, viz., — Bhava, Sarva, Isana, Rudra,…

verses.sanskrit: मेनाया नन्दिनी देवी वारिजा वारिजेक्षणा अंबाया वीतशोकस्य नन्दिनश् च महात्मनः
verses.transliteration: menāyā nandinī devī vārijā vārijekṣaṇā aṃbāyā vītaśokasya nandinaś ca mahātmanaḥ
verses.translation: May these twelve Adityas' dispel my impurity — Vikartana, Vivasvan, Martanda, Bhaskara, Ravi, Lokapraka- saka ( the illuminator of the worlds), Lokasaksin (the witness of the worlds), Trivikrama, Aditya, Surya, Amsuman and Divakara.
verses.hindi: तस्य मूर्शिन शिवं कुर्यान्मध्यतो धातुनैव तु। दक्षिणे च यथान्यायं ब्रह्माणं च चतुर्मुखम् उत्तरे देवदेवेशं नारायणमनामयम्। इन्द्रादिलोकपालांशच कृत्वा भवत्या यथाविधि
verses.wordMeaning: May these twelve Adityas' dispel my impurity — Vikartana, Vivasvan, Martanda, Bhaskara, Ravi, Lokapraka- saka ( the illuminator of the worlds), Lokasaksin (the witness of the worlds), Trivikrama, Aditya, Surya, Amsuman and Divakara.
verses.commentary: Sense: May these twelve Adityas' dispel my impurity — Vikartana, Vivasvan, Martanda, Bhaskara, Ravi, Lokapraka- saka ( the illuminator of the worlds), Lokasaksin (the witness of the worlds), Trivikrama, Aditya, Surya, Amsuman and Divakara.

verses.sanskrit: शुभावत्याः सखी शान्ता पञ्चचूडा वरप्रदा सृष्ट्यर्थं सर्वभूतानां प्रकृतित्वं गताव्यया
verses.transliteration: śubhāvatyāḥ sakhī śāntā pañcacūḍā varapradā sṛṣṭyarthaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ prakṛtitvaṃ gatāvyayā
verses.translation: Sec p. i66 note 273.
verses.hindi: देवस्य दक्षिणे हस्ते शूलं त्रिदशपूजितम्
verses.wordMeaning: Sec p. i66 note 273.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sec p. i66 note 273.

verses.sanskrit: त्रयोविंशतिभिस् तत्त्वैर् महदाद्यैर् विजृम्भिता लक्ष्म्यादिशक्तिभिर् नित्यं नमिता नन्दनन्दिनी
verses.transliteration: trayoviṃśatibhis tattvair mahadādyair vijṛmbhitā lakṣmyādiśaktibhir nityaṃ namitā nandanandinī
verses.translation: Sec note 275.
verses.hindi: वह गृह शिवको समर्पित करती है; वह गोलोक प्राप्त करके भवानीके साथ आनन्द करती है, भवानीके सदृश होकर सभी कल्पोंमें अव्यय (शाश्वत) बनी रहती है और अन्तमें भवानीका सायुज्य प्राप्त करती है; इसमें सन्देह नहीं है॥ ३८-४५/२॥
verses.wordMeaning: Sec note 275.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sec note 275.

verses.sanskrit: मनोन्मनी महादेवी मायावी मण्डनप्रिया मायया या जगत्सर्वं ब्रह्माद्यं सचराचरम्
verses.transliteration: manonmanī mahādevī māyāvī maṇḍanapriyā māyayā yā jagatsarvaṃ brahmādyaṃ sacarācaram
verses.translation: twelve adityas, viz,, dhatr, mitra, aryaman, rudra, varuna, surya, bhaga, vivasvSn, pusan, savity, tvatr and vifou. These represent the Sun in the twelve months of the year.
verses.hindi: सावन महीनेमें सभी धातुओंसे युक्त तथा विचित्र ध्वजोंसे सुशोभित तिलपर्वत शिवको समर्पित करना चाहिए। जो स्त्री वितान, ध्वज, वस्त्र, धातु आदि सहित तिलपर्वत निवेदित करती है और अन्तमें
verses.wordMeaning: twelve adityas, viz,, dhatr, mitra, aryaman, rudra, varuna, surya, bhaga, vivasvSn, pusan, savity, tvatr and vifou. These represent the Sun in the twelve months of the year.
verses.commentary: Sense: twelve adityas, viz,, dhatr, mitra, aryaman, rudra, varuna, surya, bhaga, vivasvSn, pusan, savity, tvatr and vifou. These represent the Sun in the twelve months of the year.

verses.sanskrit: क्षोभिणी मोहिनी नित्यं योगिनां हृदि संस्थिता एकानेकस्थिता लोके इन्दीवरनिभेक्षणा
verses.transliteration: kṣobhiṇī mohinī nityaṃ yogināṃ hṛdi saṃsthitā ekānekasthitā loke indīvaranibhekṣaṇā
verses.translation: For detail, see MP—A Study,
verses.hindi: ब्राह्मणोंको भोजन कराती है, उसे पूर्वमें कहा गया सबकुछ प्राप्त हो जाता है ॥ ४६-४७ /२॥ जो भाद्रपद मासमें वितान, ध्वज, वस्त्र, धातु आदिसहित शालि चावलका सुन्दर पर्वत बनाकर उसे शिवको समर्पित करती है और ब्राह्मणोंको भोजन कराकर विधिपूर्वक उसका दान करती है, वह सूर्यकी किरणोंके समान होकर
verses.wordMeaning: For detail, see MP—A Study,
verses.commentary: Sense: For detail, see MP—A Study,

verses.sanskrit: भक्त्या परमया नित्यं सर्वदेवैरभिष्टुता गणेन्द्राम्भोजगर्भेन्द्रयमवित्तेशपूर्वकैः
verses.transliteration: bhaktyā paramayā nityaṃ sarvadevairabhiṣṭutā gaṇendrāmbhojagarbhendrayamavitteśapūrvakaiḥ
verses.translation: The following are the Caranas highly purified by his worship — Khecarin, Vasucarin, Brahmesa, Brahmabrah- madhi, Suena, Sasvata, Pusa, Supu§ta and Mahabala. May they dispel my impurities and all sins committed by me.
verses.hindi: भवानीके साथ आनन्द करती है ॥ ४८-४९ /२॥
verses.wordMeaning: The following are the Caranas highly purified by his worship — Khecarin, Vasucarin, Brahmesa, Brahmabrah- madhi, Suena, Sasvata, Pusa, Supu§ta and Mahabala. May they dispel my impurities and all sins committed by me.
verses.commentary: Sense: The following are the Caranas highly purified by his worship — Khecarin, Vasucarin, Brahmesa, Brahmabrah- madhi, Suena, Sasvata, Pusa, Supu§ta and Mahabala. May they dispel my impurities and all sins committed by me.

verses.sanskrit: संस्तुता जननी तेषां सर्वोपद्रवनाशिनी भक्तानामार्तिहा भव्या भवभावविनाशनी
verses.transliteration: saṃstutā jananī teṣāṃ sarvopadravanāśinī bhaktānāmārtihā bhavyā bhavabhāvavināśanī
verses.translation: May these who constitute the ornaments in the body of Siva dispel my sin and all poison mobile and immobile — Ananta, Kulika, Vasuki, Taksaka, Karkotaka. Mahapadma, Sahkhapala and Mahabala, all engaged in doing obeisance to Siva.
verses.hindi: आश्विन महीनेमें सुवर्ण तथा वस्त्रसे युक्त एक विशाल धान्यपर्वत बनाकर उसे शिवको अर्पण करके शंकरकी विधिवत् पूजा करके ब्राह्मणोंको भोजन करानेसे पूर्वमें कहा गया सबकुछ प्राप्त हो जाता है। तीनों लोकोंके आधारस्वरूप मेरु नामक उत्तम पर्वतराजका निर्माण करे, जो सभी धान्योंसे युक्त हो, सभी बीजों तथा रसोंसे परिपूर्ण हो, सभी धातुओंसे संयुक्त हो, सभी रत्नोंसे सुशोभित हो, चार श्रृंगों (शिखर) -से युक्त हो, वितान तथा छत्रसे
verses.wordMeaning: May these who constitute the ornaments in the body of Siva dispel my sin and all poison mobile and immobile — Ananta, Kulika, Vasuki, Taksaka, Karkotaka. Mahapadma, Sahkhapala and Mahabala, all engaged in doing obeisance to Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: May these who constitute the ornaments in the body of Siva dispel my sin and all poison mobile and immobile — Ananta, Kulika, Vasuki, Taksaka, Karkotaka. Mahapadma, Sahkhapala and Mahabala, all engaged in doing obeisance to Siva.

verses.sanskrit: भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदा दिव्या भक्तानामप्रयत्नतः सा मे साक्षान्महादेवी पापम् आशु व्यपोहतु
verses.transliteration: bhuktimuktipradā divyā bhaktānāmaprayatnataḥ sā me sākṣānmahādevī pāpam āśu vyapohatu
verses.translation: May these sages who are sanctified by Siva and who are engaged in His worship, dispel my impurity — Agastya,
verses.hindi: सुशोभित हो, गन्ध-पुष्प एवं अद्भुत धूपोंसे सुशोभित हो, विचित्र नृत्य-गानोंसे शोभायमान हो, शंख-वीणाकी ध्वनियोंसे युक्त हो, वेदध्वनियोंसे और विशेषकर मंगलसूचक प्रार्थना आदिसे अत्यन्त पवित्र हो, आठ बड़ी
verses.wordMeaning: May these sages who are sanctified by Siva and who are engaged in His worship, dispel my impurity — Agastya,
verses.commentary: Sense: May these sages who are sanctified by Siva and who are engaged in His worship, dispel my impurity — Agastya,

verses.sanskrit: चण्डः सर्वगणेशानो मुखाच्छंभोर्विनिर्गतः शिवार्चनरतः श्रीमान् स मे पापं व्यपोहतु
verses.transliteration: caṇḍaḥ sarvagaṇeśāno mukhācchaṃbhorvinirgataḥ śivārcanarataḥ śrīmān sa me pāpaṃ vyapohatu
verses.translation: Ssuram bhlvam -evil thoughts created by Satan.
verses.hindi: ध्वजाओंसे युक्त हो और विचित्र पुष्पोंसे सुशोभित हो। उस पर्वत-के शिखरपर मध्यमें धातुनिर्मित शिवको विराजमान करे। दक्षिणमें चतुर्मुख ब्रह्मा, उत्तरमें निर्विकार देवदेवेश नारायण, इन्द्र आदि लोकपालोंको भक्तिपूर्वक यथाविधि विराजमान करके उनकी प्रतिष्ठा करनेके अनन्तर स्नान कराकर महेश्वरकी पूजा करके महादेवके दाहिने हाथमें देवपूजित त्रिशूल तथा बायें हाथमें पाश, भवानीके
verses.wordMeaning: Ssuram bhlvam -evil thoughts created by Satan.
verses.commentary: Sense: Ssuram bhlvam -evil thoughts created by Satan.

verses.sanskrit: शालङ्कायनपुत्रस्तु हलमार्गोत्थितः प्रभुः जामाता मरुतां देवः सर्वभूतमहेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: śālaṅkāyanaputrastu halamārgotthitaḥ prabhuḥ jāmātā marutāṃ devaḥ sarvabhūtamaheśvaraḥ
verses.translation: May mother Ganga,'*® the mother of the universe, stationed in the world of Rudra, a delighted devotee of Siva, dispel my sin.
verses.hindi: SCLC ००-12 नाना 2. छ छ ऊ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ़ क़ ़ फ़ ऊ फ फ फ़ फ़ फ फ फ़ फ ऊ फ़ फ़ फ फ़ फ फ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ फ़ फा फ फी फ फा फा का मी मी मी मी मी फी जी मी मी मी मी मी की की फी की फी क फ फ फ फ़ फ फ फ फ फ फ कप
verses.wordMeaning: May mother Ganga,'*® the mother of the universe, stationed in the world of Rudra, a delighted devotee of Siva, dispel my sin.
verses.commentary: Sense: May mother Ganga,'*® the mother of the universe, stationed in the world of Rudra, a delighted devotee of Siva, dispel my sin.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वगः सर्वदृक् शर्वः सर्वेशसदृशः प्रभुः सनारायणकैर् देवैः सेन्द्रचन्द्रदिवाकरैः
verses.transliteration: sarvagaḥ sarvadṛk śarvaḥ sarveśasadṛśaḥ prabhuḥ sanārāyaṇakair devaiḥ sendracandradivākaraiḥ
verses.translation: May Goddess Bhadra of auspicious position stationed in the world of Siva, the highly blessed mother of all kine, dis- pel my sin.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्मणश्चाक्षसूत्रं च कमण्डलुमनुत्तमम्। इन्द्रस्य वज्रमग्नेश्च शक्त्याख्यं परमायुधम् वरुणस्य महापाशं नागाख्यं रुद्रमद्धुतम्
verses.wordMeaning: May Goddess Bhadra of auspicious position stationed in the world of Siva, the highly blessed mother of all kine, dis- pel my sin.
verses.commentary: Sense: May Goddess Bhadra of auspicious position stationed in the world of Siva, the highly blessed mother of all kine, dis- pel my sin.

verses.sanskrit: सिद्धैश् च यक्षगन्धर्वैर् भूतैर्भूतविधायकैः उरगैरृषिभिश्चैव ब्रह्मणा च महात्मना
verses.transliteration: siddhaiś ca yakṣagandharvair bhūtairbhūtavidhāyakaiḥ uragairṛṣibhiścaiva brahmaṇā ca mahātmanā
verses.translation: May Surabhi, who is auspicious all round, who is the destroyer of all sins and who is always engaged in the worship of Rudra dispel my sin.
verses.hindi: वायोर्यष्टिं कुबेरस्य गदां लोकप्रपूजिताम्। टङ्कं चेशानदेवस्य निवेद्यैवं क्रमेण च
verses.wordMeaning: May Surabhi, who is auspicious all round, who is the destroyer of all sins and who is always engaged in the worship of Rudra dispel my sin.
verses.commentary: Sense: May Surabhi, who is auspicious all round, who is the destroyer of all sins and who is always engaged in the worship of Rudra dispel my sin.

verses.sanskrit: स्तुतस्त्रैलोक्यनाथस्तु मुनिरन्तः पुरं स्थितः सर्वदा पूजितः सर्वैर् नन्दी पापं व्यपोहतु
verses.transliteration: stutastrailokyanāthastu munirantaḥ puraṃ sthitaḥ sarvadā pūjitaḥ sarvair nandī pāpaṃ vyapohatu
verses.translation: May Suila of good conduct and glorious position, sanctified by Siva and stationed in the world of Siva dispel my sin.
verses.hindi: शिवस्य महतीं पूजां कृत्वा चरुसमन्विताम्। पूजयेत्सर्वदेवांशचच यथाविभवविस्तरम् महामेरुव्रतं कृत्वा महादेवाय दापयेत्
verses.wordMeaning: May Suila of good conduct and glorious position, sanctified by Siva and stationed in the world of Siva dispel my sin.
verses.commentary: Sense: May Suila of good conduct and glorious position, sanctified by Siva and stationed in the world of Siva dispel my sin.

verses.sanskrit: महाकायो महातेजा महादेव इवापरः शिवार्चनरतः श्रीमान् स मे पापं व्यपोहतु
verses.transliteration: mahākāyo mahātejā mahādeva ivāparaḥ śivārcanarataḥ śrīmān sa me pāpaṃ vyapohatu
verses.translation: May SenSpati (Skanda)lhe son of the lord of Devas dispel my sin. He is conversant with the reality of the teaching in the Vedas and Sastras; he ponders over all actions, he is richly endowed with all attributes, he is the eldest and the lord of all; he is gentle, and has the body of Mahavisnu, he is the noble commander of the army, he is the mysterious suppressor of sacrifice; he rides on the elephant Airavata, he has black curly hairs; his limbs are black, his eyes are red; moon and ser- pent constitute his ornaments; he is surrounded by goblins, ghosts, evil spirits and Kusmandas and he is engaged in the worship of Siva.
verses.hindi: महामेरुमनृप्राप्य महादेव्या प्रमोदते। चिरं सायुज्यमाप्नोति महादेव्या न संशयः
verses.wordMeaning: May SenSpati (Skanda)lhe son of the lord of Devas dispel my sin. He is conversant with the reality of the teaching in the Vedas and Sastras; he ponders over all actions, he is richly endowed with all attributes, he is the eldest and the lord of all; he is gentle,…
verses.commentary: Sense: May SenSpati (Skanda)lhe son of the lord of Devas dispel my sin. He is conversant with the reality of the teaching in the Vedas and Sastras; he ponders over all actions, he is richly endowed with all attributes, he is the eldest and the lord of all; he is gentle,…

verses.sanskrit: मेरुमन्दारकैलासतटकूटप्रभेदनः ऐरावतादिभिर् दिव्यैर् दिग्गजैश् च सुपूजितः
verses.transliteration: merumandārakailāsataṭakūṭaprabhedanaḥ airāvatādibhir divyair diggajaiś ca supūjitaḥ
verses.translation: The river GaflgS, the mother of the worlds (jaganmSta), is invoked in her various forms.
verses.hindi: कार्तिक्यामपि या नारी कृत्वा देवीमुमां शुभाम्। सर्वाभरणसम्पूर्णा सर्वलक्षणलक्षिताम् देवं च कृत्वा देवेशं सर्वलक्षणसंयुतम्
verses.wordMeaning: The river GaflgS, the mother of the worlds (jaganmSta), is invoked in her various forms.
verses.commentary: Sense: The river GaflgS, the mother of the worlds (jaganmSta), is invoked in her various forms.

verses.sanskrit: सप्तपातालपादश् च सप्तद्वीपोरुजङ्घकः सप्तार्णवाङ्कुशश्चैव सर्वतीर्थोदरः शिवः
verses.transliteration: saptapātālapādaś ca saptadvīporujaṅghakaḥ saptārṇavāṅkuśaścaiva sarvatīrthodaraḥ śivaḥ
verses.translation: May all these mothers accompanied by Yoginis dis- pel all great sins:— Brahmai, Mahei, Kaumaii, Vaisnavi, Varahi> MahendH) Camund and Agneyika. They arc worship- ped by all the worlds and they arc pure and attentive.
verses.hindi: तयोरग्रे हुताशं च स्त्रुवहस्त॑ पितामहम्। नारायणं च दातारं सर्वाभरणभूषितम्
verses.wordMeaning: May all these mothers accompanied by Yoginis dis- pel all great sins:— Brahmai, Mahei, Kaumaii, Vaisnavi, Varahi> MahendH) Camund and Agneyika. They arc worship- ped by all the worlds and they arc pure and attentive.
verses.commentary: Sense: May all these mothers accompanied by Yoginis dis- pel all great sins:— Brahmai, Mahei, Kaumaii, Vaisnavi, Varahi> MahendH) Camund and Agneyika. They arc worship- ped by all the worlds and they arc pure and attentive.

verses.sanskrit: आकाशदेहो दिग्बाहुः सोमसूर्याग्निलोचनः हतासुरमहावृक्षो ब्रह्मविद्यामहोत्कटः
verses.transliteration: ākāśadeho digbāhuḥ somasūryāgnilocanaḥ hatāsuramahāvṛkṣo brahmavidyāmahotkaṭaḥ
verses.translation: Virabhadra of great splendour is the son of Rudra. He is the leader of the armies and lord of the Ganas. May he dispel sin. He resembles the snow, the Kunda flower and the moon; he is terrible, his great hand closely clinging to the trident. He is omniscient and thousand-armed. He holds all weapons. The three sacrificial fires constitute his eyes. He is the lord, the bcstowcr of fearlessness on the three worlds. He is the permanent protector of the mothers. His vehicle is the great bull. He is glorious and is bowed to by the three worlds. He is engaged in the worship of Siva. He beheaded Yaksa;'*® he destroyed the tooth of Pufan;* he removed the hand of the fire-god;** he caused the eye of Bhaga to fall down;'** he pounded the limbs of Soma by the big toe of his foot; he is the bodyguard of Upendra, Indra, Yama and other Devas; he cut oflf the nose and lips of the great goddess Sarasvati.'** May the lord of Ganas dispel my sin.
verses.hindi: लोकपालैस्तथा सिद्धैः संवृतं स्थाप्य यत्नतः। रुद्रालये व्रतं तस्मै दापयेद्भक्तिपूर्वकम् मार्गशीर्षकमासादिकार्तिकान्तं प्रवर्तितम्। नरनार्यादिजन्तूनां हिताय मुनिसत्तमाः
verses.wordMeaning: Virabhadra of great splendour is the son of Rudra. He is the leader of the armies and lord of the Ganas. May he dispel sin. He resembles the snow, the Kunda flower and the moon; he is terrible, his great hand closely clinging to the trident. He is omniscient and thousand-armed.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Virabhadra of great splendour is the son of Rudra. He is the leader of the armies and lord of the Ganas. May he dispel sin. He resembles the snow, the Kunda flower and the moon; he is terrible, his great hand closely clinging to the trident. He is omniscient and thousand-armed.…

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्माद्याधोरणैर् दिव्यैर् योगपाशसमन्वितैः बद्धो हृत्पुण्डरीकाख्ये स्तंभे वृत्तिं निरुध्य च
verses.transliteration: brahmādyādhoraṇair divyair yogapāśasamanvitaiḥ baddho hṛtpuṇḍarīkākhye staṃbhe vṛttiṃ nirudhya ca
verses.translation: May Mahalaksmi the mother of the universe dispel my sin. She is the eldest, most excellent, bcstowcr of boons and bedecked in excellent ornaments.
verses.hindi: नरः कृत्वा व्रतं चैव शिवसायुज्यमाप्नुयात्। नारी देव्या न सन्देहः शिवेन परिभाषितम्
verses.wordMeaning: May Mahalaksmi the mother of the universe dispel my sin. She is the eldest, most excellent, bcstowcr of boons and bedecked in excellent ornaments.
verses.commentary: Sense: May Mahalaksmi the mother of the universe dispel my sin. She is the eldest, most excellent, bcstowcr of boons and bedecked in excellent ornaments.

verses.sanskrit: नागेन्द्रवक्त्रो यः साक्षाद् गणकोटिशतैर्वृतः शिवध्यानैकसम्पन्नः स मे पापं व्यपोहतु
verses.transliteration: nāgendravaktro yaḥ sākṣād gaṇakoṭiśatairvṛtaḥ śivadhyānaikasampannaḥ sa me pāpaṃ vyapohatu
verses.translation: May the highly blessed Mahamoh (the great delu- sion), surrounded by the great groups of goblins and engaged in the worship of Siva dispel my sin.
verses.hindi: हाथमें हेमभूषित कमल, विष्णुके हाथोंमें शंख-चक्र-गदा पद्म, ब्रह्माके हाथोंमें अक्षमाला तथा उत्तम कमण्डलु इनद्रके हाथमें वज्र, अग्निके हाथमें शक्ति नामक आयुध, यमके हाथमें दण्ड, निशिचर निर्क्रतिके हाथमे खड्ग, वरुणके हाथमें नाग नामक भयंकर तथा अद्भुत महापाश, वायुदेवके हाथमें यष्टि (छड़ी), कुबेरके हाथमे लोकपूजित गदा और ईशान देवके हाथमें टंक--इस प्रकार क्रमसे निवेदित करके शिवकी चरुसमन्वित महान् पूजा
verses.wordMeaning: May the highly blessed Mahamoh (the great delu- sion), surrounded by the great groups of goblins and engaged in the worship of Siva dispel my sin.
verses.commentary: Sense: May the highly blessed Mahamoh (the great delu- sion), surrounded by the great groups of goblins and engaged in the worship of Siva dispel my sin.

verses.sanskrit: भृङ्गीशः पिङ्गलाक्षो ऽसौ भसिताशस्तु देहयुक् शिवार्चनरतः श्रीमान् स मे पापं व्यपोहतु
verses.transliteration: bhṛṅgīśaḥ piṅgalākṣo 'sau bhasitāśastu dehayuk śivārcanarataḥ śrīmān sa me pāpaṃ vyapohatu
verses.translation: May Lakm! who is endowed with all attributes, who has ail the characteristics, who is the goddess that bestows all and who is omnipresent, dispel my sin.
verses.hindi: करके अपने सामर्थ्यके अनुसार सभी देवताओंकी पूजा करे  इसके बाद ब्राह्मणोंको भोजन कराकर प्रयत्नपूर्वक उनका सम्मान करके महामेरुव्रत सम्पन्नकर महादेवको समर्पित कर दे। ऐसा करनेवाली स्त्री महामेरुपर्वत पहुंचकर
verses.wordMeaning: May Lakm! who is endowed with all attributes, who has ail the characteristics, who is the goddess that bestows all and who is omnipresent, dispel my sin.
verses.commentary: Sense: May Lakm! who is endowed with all attributes, who has ail the characteristics, who is the goddess that bestows all and who is omnipresent, dispel my sin.

verses.sanskrit: चतुर्भिस्तनुभिर् नित्यं सर्वासुरनिबर्हणः स्कन्दः शक्तिधरः शान्तः सेनानीः शिखिवाहनः
verses.transliteration: caturbhistanubhir nityaṃ sarvāsuranibarhaṇaḥ skandaḥ śaktidharaḥ śāntaḥ senānīḥ śikhivāhanaḥ
verses.translation: May Duiga engaged in the worship of Siva dis- pel my sin. She is the great goddess riding on a lion. She is the unchanging daughter of Parvati. She is Mahamaya of Vi§u constituting his slumber. She is worshipped by Devas. She has
verses.hindi: महादेवीके साथ आनन्द करती है और चिरकालतक महादेवीका सायुज्य प्राप्त किये रहती है; इसमें सन्देह नहीं है॥ ५०--६५ ॥ जो स्त्री कार्तिक मासमें सोने अथवा ताँबेकी सभी आभरणोंसे युक्त तथा सभी लक्षणोंसे समन्वित देवी उमाकी सुन्दर प्रतिमा बनाकर; साथ ही देवेश महादेवकी भी सभी लक्षणोंसे युक्त मूर्ति बनाकर विधानपूर्वक उनकी प्रतिष्ठा
verses.wordMeaning: May Duiga engaged in the worship of Siva dis- pel my sin. She is the great goddess riding on a lion. She is the unchanging daughter of Parvati. She is Mahamaya of Vi§u constituting his slumber. She is worshipped by Devas. She has
verses.commentary: Sense: May Duiga engaged in the worship of Siva dis- pel my sin. She is the great goddess riding on a lion. She is the unchanging daughter of Parvati. She is Mahamaya of Vi§u constituting his slumber. She is worshipped by Devas. She has

verses.sanskrit: देवसेनापतिः श्रीमान् स मे पापं व्यपोहतु भवः शर्वस्तथेशानो रुद्रः पशुपतिस् तथा
verses.transliteration: devasenāpatiḥ śrīmān sa me pāpaṃ vyapohatu bhavaḥ śarvastatheśāno rudraḥ paśupatis tathā
verses.translation: Ihe transistors pitfa yakfisya to tianslate accor-
verses.hindi: करके उन दोनोंके सम्मुख अग्निको, हाथमें खुव लिये हुए ब्रह्माको और लोकपालों तथा सिद्धोंसे घिरे हुए एवं सभी आभूषणोंसे विभूषित कन्या-दाता नारायणको यत्नपूर्वक स्थापित करके भक्तिपूर्वक इस व्रतको रुद्रालयमें उन

verses.sanskrit: उग्रो भीमो महादेवः शिवार्चनरतः सदा एताः पापं व्यपोहन्तु मूर्तयः परमेष्ठिनः
verses.transliteration: ugro bhīmo mahādevaḥ śivārcanarataḥ sadā etāḥ pāpaṃ vyapohantu mūrtayaḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ
verses.translation: Thii legend i» not tnuwahle.
verses.hindi: शिव-को समर्पित करती है, वह भवानीका स्वरूप प्राप्त करके शिवके साथ आनन्द करती है॥ ६६-६९ /२॥. एक बार भोजन करके प्रत्येक मासके पुण्यप्रद व्रतको क्रमसे करे; है श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! नर, नारी आदि प्राणियोंके कल्याणके लिये मार्गशीर्षसे आरम्भ करके कार्तिकतर्क किये जानेवाले इस व्रतको प्रवर्तित किया गया है । शिवके

verses.sanskrit: महादेवः शिवो रुद्रः शङ्करो नीललोहितः ईशानो विजयो भीमो देवदेवो भवोद्भवः
verses.transliteration: mahādevaḥ śivo rudraḥ śaṅkaro nīlalohitaḥ īśāno vijayo bhīmo devadevo bhavodbhavaḥ
verses.translation: May all the mental sons of Sati, the Rudras who sus- tain the Cosmic egg, and who are worshipped by all the worlds, dispel my fear.

verses.wordMeaning: May all the mental sons of Sati, the Rudras who sus- tain the Cosmic egg, and who are worshipped by all the worlds, dispel my fear.

verses.sanskrit: कपालीशश् च विज्ञेयो रुद्रा रुद्रांशसंभवाः शिवप्रणामसम्पन्ना व्यपोहन्तु मलं मम

verses.translation: He who seeks learning obtains learning; he who seeks enjoyment of pleasures will attain pleasures. By listening to this, a man obtains immediately whatever he desires. He will be favourite of Devas. If this meritorious hymn is read on behalf of some one, the ailments arising from gas, bile, etc., do not harass him. He courts no premature death nor is he bitten by snakes.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीलिङ्गमहापुराणे पूर्वभागे व्यपोहनस्तवनिरूपणं नाम द्व्यशीतितमो ऽध्यायः व्यपोहनस्तवं पुण्यं श्रुतमस्माभिर् आदरात् प्रसंगाल्लिङ्गदानस्य व्रतान्यपि वदस्व नः
verses.transliteration: iti śrīliṅgamahāpurāṇe pūrvabhāge vyapohanastavanirūpaṇaṃ nāma dvyaśītitamo 'dhyāyaḥ vyapohanastavaṃ puṇyaṃ śrutamasmābhir ādarāt prasaṃgālliṅgadānasya vratānyapi vadasva naḥ
verses.translation: O excellent sages, I shall mention to you the auspicious vratas that were narrated by Nandin to the son of Brahma.
verses.hindi: कनिष्ठातक जो न्यास किया जाता है, वह होता है; है देवि! वह न्यास गृहस्थोंको परम सुख प्रदान करनेवाला है । सर्वप्रथम करन्यास करके देहन्यास करना चाहिए और उसके बाद अंगन्यास करना चाहिए. यह सामान्य विधि है ॥ ६०-६३१/२॥
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent sages, I shall mention to you the auspicious vratas that were narrated by Nandin to the son of Brahma.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent sages, I shall mention to you the auspicious vratas that were narrated by Nandin to the son of Brahma.

verses.sanskrit: व्रतानि वः प्रवक्ष्यामि शुभानि मुनिसत्तमाः नन्दिना कथितानीह ब्रह्मपुत्राय धीमते
verses.transliteration: vratāni vaḥ pravakṣyāmi śubhāni munisattamāḥ nandinā kathitānīha brahmaputrāya dhīmate
verses.translation: I shall mention them to you as I have heard them from Vyasa. On the eighth and fourteenth days of both the fortnights, the devotee shall cat only once, at night, and conti- nue this rite for one year and worship Siva. He acquires the benefit of all sacrifices and attains the greatest goal.
verses.hindi: प्रत्येक मन्त्रको ओंकारसे सम्पुटित करके सभी अंगोंमें, दोनों हाथोंमें तथा दसों अँगुलियोंके अग्रभागे क्रमसे न्यास करना चाहिए। दोनों पैर धोकर आचमन करके शुद्ध होकर समाहित चित्त होकर पूर्वकी ओर
verses.wordMeaning: I shall mention them to you as I have heard them from Vyasa. On the eighth and fourteenth days of both the fortnights, the devotee shall cat only once, at night, and conti- nue this rite for one year and worship Siva.…
verses.commentary: Sense: I shall mention them to you as I have heard them from Vyasa. On the eighth and fourteenth days of both the fortnights, the devotee shall cat only once, at night, and conti- nue this rite for one year and worship Siva.…

verses.sanskrit: तानि व्यासादुपश्रुत्य युष्माकं प्रवदाम्यहम् अष्टम्यां च चतुर्दश्यां पक्षयोरुभयोरपि
verses.transliteration: tāni vyāsādupaśrutya yuṣmākaṃ pravadāmyaham aṣṭamyāṃ ca caturdaśyāṃ pakṣayorubhayorapi
verses.translation: By performing this rite for one day and one night on Parvan days and by making the earth the vessel, the devotee attains the benefit of three nights on Parvan days. By performing the K§iradharavrata,** the devotee obtains the benefit of horse-sacrifice. He shall perform this holy rite on the two Pratipads ( first day) and two Paficamis (fifth day) in the month.
verses.hindi: अथवा उत्तकी ओर मुख करके न्यासकर्म करना चाहिए ॥ ६४-६५ /२॥ हे वरानने! प्रारम्भमें ऋषि, छन्द, देवता, बीज, शक्ति, परमात्मा तथा गुरुका स्मरण करना चाहिए।
verses.wordMeaning: By performing this rite for one day and one night on Parvan days and by making the earth the vessel, the devotee attains the benefit of three nights on Parvan days. By performing the K§iradharavrata,** the devotee obtains the benefit of horse-sacrifice.…
verses.commentary: Sense: By performing this rite for one day and one night on Parvan days and by making the earth the vessel, the devotee attains the benefit of three nights on Parvan days. By performing the K§iradharavrata,** the devotee obtains the benefit of horse-sacrifice.…

verses.sanskrit: वर्षमेकं तु भुञ्जानो नक्तं यः पूजयेच्छिवम् सर्वयज्ञफलं प्राप्य स याति परमां गतिम्
verses.transliteration: varṣamekaṃ tu bhuñjāno naktaṃ yaḥ pūjayecchivam sarvayajñaphalaṃ prāpya sa yāti paramāṃ gatim
verses.translation: The devotee shall take food only once a day at night, between the eighth and the fourteenth day in the dark half of the month. He attains all worldly pleasures and goes to the world of Brahma.
verses.hindi: करतलोंमें प्रणवका न्यास करना चाहिए। सभी अँगुलियोंके
verses.wordMeaning: The devotee shall take food only once a day at night, between the eighth and the fourteenth day in the dark half of the month. He attains all worldly pleasures and goes to the world of Brahma.
verses.commentary: Sense: The devotee shall take food only once a day at night, between the eighth and the fourteenth day in the dark half of the month. He attains all worldly pleasures and goes to the world of Brahma.

verses.sanskrit: पृथिवीं भाजनं कृत्वा भुक्त्वा पर्वसु मानवः अहोरात्रेण चैकेन त्रिरात्रफलमश्नुते
verses.transliteration: pṛthivīṃ bhājanaṃ kṛtvā bhuktvā parvasu mānavaḥ ahorātreṇa caikena trirātraphalamaśnute
verses.translation: The devotee shall perform this holy rite for a year in the night of all Parvan days. He shall be edibate, conquer anger and be devoted to meditation on Siva. At the end of a year he shall duly feed leading brahmins. He then attains the world of Siva. No doubt need be entertained in this respect.
verses.hindi: पाँच बीजोंका उत्पत्ति आदि तीन भेदोंसे तथा ब्रह्मचर्य आदिके क्रमसे न्यास करना चाहिए। दोनों हाथोंसे मस्तकसे लेकर पैरतक प्रणवके द्वारा सम्पुटित मन्त्रसे देहका स्पर्श करना चाहिए। प्रणवयुक्त मन्त्रसे सिर, मुख, कण्ठ, हृदय, गुह्यस्थान एवं दोनों पैरोंमें; गुह्यस्थान, हदय, कण्ठ, मुख तथा सिरमें; पुनः हृदय, गुद्यस्थाग, दोनों पैरों, सिर, मुख तथा कण्ठमें तीन प्रकारका न्यास करना चाहिए। इस प्रकार अंगन्यास करके प्रणवसहित
verses.wordMeaning: The devotee shall perform this holy rite for a year in the night of all Parvan days. He shall be edibate, conquer anger and be devoted to meditation on Siva. At the end of a year he shall duly feed leading brahmins. He then attains the world of Siva.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The devotee shall perform this holy rite for a year in the night of all Parvan days. He shall be edibate, conquer anger and be devoted to meditation on Siva. At the end of a year he shall duly feed leading brahmins. He then attains the world of Siva.…

verses.sanskrit: द्वयोर् मासस्य पञ्चम्योर् द्वयोः प्रतिपदोर्नरः क्षीरधाराव्रतं कुर्यात् सो ऽश्वमेधफलं लभेत्
verses.transliteration: dvayor māsasya pañcamyor dvayoḥ pratipadornaraḥ kṣīradhārāvrataṃ kuryāt so 'śvamedhaphalaṃ labhet
verses.translation: Greater than the observance of fast is the partaking of alms and greater still is food acquired without begging. Taking
verses.hindi: नकारसे प्रारम्भ होकर यकारपर पूर्ण होनेवाले इन नकार आदि वर्णोकी क्रमशः अपने शरीरमें भावना करे। इसके बाद मन्त्रमें नमः, स्वाहा, बषट्, हुम्, वौषट् तथा फटके साथ यथास्थान छहों अंगोंमें उत्तम रीतिसे न्यास करता
verses.wordMeaning: Greater than the observance of fast is the partaking of alms and greater still is food acquired without begging. Taking
verses.commentary: Sense: Greater than the observance of fast is the partaking of alms and greater still is food acquired without begging. Taking

verses.sanskrit: कृष्णाष्टम्यां तु नक्तेन यावत्कृष्णचतुर्दशी भुञ्जन्भोगानवाप्नोति ब्रह्मलोकं च गच्छति
verses.transliteration: kṛṣṇāṣṭamyāṃ tu naktena yāvatkṛṣṇacaturdaśī bhuñjanbhogānavāpnoti brahmalokaṃ ca gacchati
verses.translation: The following shall be practised throughout: non-violence truthfulness, non-stealing, celibacy, forgiveness, mercifulness, three times ablution, Agnihotra, sleeping on the bare ground, food at night only, observance of fast on eighth and fourteenth days in both the fortnights. Thus the &vavrata for each nmnth has been fully recounted. O brahmins, the devotee shall observe this Vrata for a year in the order mentioned or in the reverse order. He then attains identity with Siva and obtains the path of perfect knowledgfc.**
