verses.commentary: Sense: Thus, the mode and procedure for chanting the five-syllabled Mantra has been recounted to you. He who reads this and listens to this, attains the greatest goal. He who

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीलिङ्गमहापुराणे पूर्वभागे उमामहेश्वरव्रतं नाम चतुरशीतितमो ऽध्यायः सर्वव्रतेषु सम्पूज्य देवदेवमुमापतिम् जपेत्पञ्चाक्षरीं विद्यां विधिनैव द्विजोत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: iti śrīliṅgamahāpurāṇe pūrvabhāge umāmaheśvaravrataṃ nāma caturaśītitamo 'dhyāyaḥ sarvavrateṣu sampūjya devadevamumāpatim japetpañcākṣarīṃ vidyāṃ vidhinaiva dvijottamāḥ
verses.translation: O splendid lady, these Nyasas relate to the reli- gious students, householders and the ascetics respectively. Repeating the Mantras one shall touch the body along with the bead. That is common to all householders, religious students and ascetics.
verses.hindi: जप तथा अन्य अनुष्ठान व्यर्थ हो जाते हैं; इसमें सन्देह नहीं करना चाहिए ॥ १७३--१७५ /२॥
verses.wordMeaning: O splendid lady, these Nyasas relate to the reli- gious students, householders and the ascetics respectively. Repeating the Mantras one shall touch the body along with the bead. That is common to all householders, religious students and ascetics.
verses.commentary: Sense: O splendid lady, these Nyasas relate to the reli- gious students, householders and the ascetics respectively. Repeating the Mantras one shall touch the body along with the bead. That is common to all householders, religious students and ascetics.

verses.sanskrit: जपादेव न संदेहो व्रतानां वै विशेषतः समाप्तिर्नान्यथा तस्माज् जपेत्पञ्चाक्षरीं शुभाम्
verses.transliteration: japādeva na saṃdeho vratānāṃ vai viśeṣataḥ samāptirnānyathā tasmāj japetpañcākṣarīṃ śubhām
verses.translation: At the outset he shall remember the sage, metre, deity, Bija, Sakti, Atman and preceptor, O lady of splendid face. Repeating the Mantra, he shall wipe off the hands and fix the Praiiava in the palms and in the first and last knots in all the fingers. He shall fix the Bijas along with the Bindus in the five middle knots. In accordance with the order of the
verses.hindi: पूर्ण प्रयत्नपूर्वक गुरुके विरुद्ध कुछ भी वचन नहीं बोलना चाहिए; यदि कोई अज्ञानवश ऐसा बोलता हे, तो वह रौरव नरकमें पडता है । है देवि! मन, धन, वचन तथा कर्मसे गुरुको कभी झूठा सिद्ध नहीं करना चाहिए । उनका दुर्गुण कहनेपर व्यक्ति सौ दुर्गुणोंसे युक्त हो जाता है और उनका गुण कहनेपर सभी गुणोंका फल मिलता है। गुरुने आदेश दिया हो अथवा नहीं, सर्वदा उनका हित तथा प्रिय करना चाहिए; गुरु सामने हों अथवा परोक्षमें
verses.wordMeaning: At the outset he shall remember the sage, metre, deity, Bija, Sakti, Atman and preceptor, O lady of splendid face. Repeating the Mantra, he shall wipe off the hands and fix the Praiiava in the palms and in the first and last knots in all the fingers.…
verses.commentary: Sense: At the outset he shall remember the sage, metre, deity, Bija, Sakti, Atman and preceptor, O lady of splendid face. Repeating the Mantra, he shall wipe off the hands and fix the Praiiava in the palms and in the first and last knots in all the fingers.…

verses.sanskrit: कथं पञ्चाक्षरी विद्या प्रभावो वा कथं वद क्रमोपायं महाभाग श्रोतुं कौतूहलं हि नः
verses.transliteration: kathaṃ pañcākṣarī vidyā prabhāvo vā kathaṃ vada kramopāyaṃ mahābhāga śrotuṃ kautūhalaṃ hi naḥ
verses.translation: Alter fixing the limbs thus, the devotee shall medi- tate upon the faces (of Siva). Beginning with the face in the east and ending with the face upward he shall fix the syllables beginning with na in due order. Thereafter he shall perform the Nyasa rite of the six limbs in the respective places with delight. The Nyasa shall be accompanied with the words Namas (obeisance), Svaha, Vasat, Hum, Vausat and Phat. The Prana va is known as the heart; the syllable na the head; the syllable ma the tuft; the syllable the coat of mail: the syllable the eye; the syllable the "Astra" (missile). After fixing the letters on the limbs as mentioned the devotee shall bind the quarters.
verses.hindi: हों, उनका कार्य करना चाहिए। मन, वचन, शरीर तथा कर्मसे गुरुका हित तथा प्रिय करना चाहिए। ऐसा न करनेवाला नरकमें गिरता है और वहाँ जाकर वहींपर विचरण करता रहता है। अतः सर्वदा उनकी उपासना
verses.wordMeaning: Alter fixing the limbs thus, the devotee shall medi- tate upon the faces (of Siva). Beginning with the face in the east and ending with the face upward he shall fix the syllables beginning with na in due order.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Alter fixing the limbs thus, the devotee shall medi- tate upon the faces (of Siva). Beginning with the face in the east and ending with the face upward he shall fix the syllables beginning with na in due order.…

verses.sanskrit: पुरा देवेन रुद्रेण देवदेवेन शंभुना पार्वत्याः कथितं पुण्यं प्रवदामि समासतः
verses.transliteration: purā devena rudreṇa devadevena śaṃbhunā pārvatyāḥ kathitaṃ puṇyaṃ pravadāmi samāsataḥ
verses.translation: The deities of the four corners beginning with the south-east, are respectively Vighnesa, the mother Durga and Ksetrajna (?). The devotee shall fix them with the tip of the thumb fixed on that of the index finger with a beaming face. After saying "Protect ye all" he shall make obeisance to them severally.
verses.hindi: तथा वन्दना करनी चाहिए । पास रहते हुए भी गुरुसे आज्ञा लेकर तथा उनकी ओर मुख न करके बोलना चाहिए । ऐसा आचारवान्, भक्ति-सम्पन्न, नित्य जप करनेवाला तथा गुरुका प्रिय करनेवाला  शिष्य इस मन्त्रका विनियोग करनेके योग्य होता है ॥ १७६-१८२/२॥
verses.wordMeaning: The deities of the four corners beginning with the south-east, are respectively Vighnesa, the mother Durga and Ksetrajna (?). The devotee shall fix them with the tip of the thumb fixed on that of the index finger with a beaming face.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The deities of the four corners beginning with the south-east, are respectively Vighnesa, the mother Durga and Ksetrajna (?). The devotee shall fix them with the tip of the thumb fixed on that of the index finger with a beaming face.…

verses.sanskrit: भगवन्देवदेवेश सर्वलोकमहेश्वर पञ्चाक्षरस्य माहात्म्यं श्रोतुमिच्छामि तत्त्वतः
verses.transliteration: bhagavandevadeveśa sarvalokamaheśvara pañcākṣarasya māhātmyaṃ śrotumicchāmi tattvataḥ
verses.translation: The expert devotee shall perform the Nyasa of the hand on the fingers beginning with the index finger with his thumb. He shall perform the Nyasa on the middle of the neck also. This Nyasa rite is said to be splendid and destructive of sins. Jt is conducive to the achievement of Siddhis. It i? holy, auspicious and affords all protection.
verses.hindi: हे देवि! अब मैं सिद्धमन्त्रके प्रयोजनस्वरूप विनियोगको बताऊँगा; विनियोग न जाननेवालेका वह
verses.wordMeaning: The expert devotee shall perform the Nyasa of the hand on the fingers beginning with the index finger with his thumb. He shall perform the Nyasa on the middle of the neck also. This Nyasa rite is said to be splendid and destructive of sins.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The expert devotee shall perform the Nyasa of the hand on the fingers beginning with the index finger with his thumb. He shall perform the Nyasa on the middle of the neck also. This Nyasa rite is said to be splendid and destructive of sins.…

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चाक्षरस्य माहात्म्यं वर्षकोटिशतैरपि न शक्यं कथितुं देवि तस्मात् संक्षेपतः शृणु
verses.transliteration: pañcākṣarasya māhātmyaṃ varṣakoṭiśatairapi na śakyaṃ kathituṃ devi tasmāt saṃkṣepataḥ śṛṇu
verses.translation: When the Nyasa rite has been performed by means of the splendid Mantra the devotee shall be on a par with Siva, Within a moment, all the sins committed in the previous births are destroyed.
verses.hindi: विशेष रूपसे संयोजन किया जाय, उसे विनियोग कहा गया है। यह इस लोकमें तथा परलोकमें फल प्रदान करता है। विनियोगसे आयु, आरोग्य, शरीरकी नित्यता, राज्य, ऐश्वर्य, उत्तम ज्ञान, स्वर्ग तथा मोक्षये सब स्नाने च सन्ध्ययोश्चैव कुर्यादेकादशेन वै।
verses.wordMeaning: When the Nyasa rite has been performed by means of the splendid Mantra the devotee shall be on a par with Siva, Within a moment, all the sins committed in the previous births are destroyed.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the Nyasa rite has been performed by means of the splendid Mantra the devotee shall be on a par with Siva, Within a moment, all the sins committed in the previous births are destroyed.

verses.sanskrit: प्रलये समनुप्राप्ते नष्टे स्थावरजङ्गमे नष्टे देवासुरे चैव नष्टे चोरगराक्षसे
verses.transliteration: pralaye samanuprāpte naṣṭe sthāvarajaṅgame naṣṭe devāsure caiva naṣṭe coragarākṣase
verses.translation: The intelligent devotee shall be pure in body by per- forming this Ny&sa rile. Steady in the performance of holy rite
verses.hindi: दूर्वाङ्कुरास्तिला वाणी गुडूची घुटिका तथा
verses.wordMeaning: The intelligent devotee shall be pure in body by per- forming this Ny&sa rile. Steady in the performance of holy rite
verses.commentary: Sense: The intelligent devotee shall be pure in body by per- forming this Ny&sa rile. Steady in the performance of holy rite

verses.sanskrit: सर्वं प्रकृतिमापन्नं त्वया प्रलयमेष्यति एको ऽहं संस्थितो देवि न द्वितीयो ऽस्ति कुत्रचित्
verses.transliteration: sarvaṃ prakṛtimāpannaṃ tvayā pralayameṣyati eko 'haṃ saṃsthito devi na dvitīyo 'sti kutracit
verses.translation: O splendid lady, henceforth, I shall recount the procedure for acquiring the Mantra. Without it the Mantra is futile and vtrith it, it is efficacious. The futile ones are the following; —.jnahina (i.e. Mantra acquired without permis- sion), Kriyahina ( devoid of holy rites), Sraddhahina (devoid of faith), Amanasa (non-mental i.e. if the devotee does not devote full attention), Anajftaptam (that which has been prohi- bited), Daksinahinam (permitted but devoid of gifts) and Sadajapta (indiscriminately repeated always).
verses.hindi: औददयैर्व्याधिभिः सर्वैर्मासेनैकेन मुच्यते। एकादशेन भुञ्जीयादन्नं चैवाभिमन्त्रितम् अष्टाविंशज्जपित्वान्नमश्नीयादन्वहं शुचि:
verses.wordMeaning: O splendid lady, henceforth, I shall recount the procedure for acquiring the Mantra. Without it the Mantra is futile and vtrith it, it is efficacious. The futile ones are the following; —.jnahina (i.e. Mantra acquired without permis- sion), Kriyahina ( devoid of holy rites),…
verses.commentary: Sense: O splendid lady, henceforth, I shall recount the procedure for acquiring the Mantra. Without it the Mantra is futile and vtrith it, it is efficacious. The futile ones are the following; —.jnahina (i.e. Mantra acquired without permis- sion), Kriyahina ( devoid of holy rites),…

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिन्वेदाश् च शास्त्राणि मन्त्रे पञ्चाक्षरे स्थिताः ते नाशं नैव सम्प्राप्ता मच्छक्त्या ह्यनुपालिताः
verses.transliteration: tasminvedāś ca śāstrāṇi mantre pañcākṣare sthitāḥ te nāśaṃ naiva samprāptā macchaktyā hyanupālitāḥ
verses.translation: The devotee shall approach the brahmin preceptor who is conversant with the real meaning of the Mantra, who has perfect knowledge who is interested in the path of medi- tation and who is endowed with good qualities: With emo- tional purity the devotee shall assiduously propitiate him mentally, verbally, physically and monetarily. The disciple shall always worship the preceptor with all attention. If he is suffi- ciently affluent the disciple shall give these things devoutly to the preceptor:— elephants, horses, chariots, jewels, fields, houses, ornaments, clothes, and different kinds of grains. If he wishes for his Siddhi he shall not be stingy in spending money. O gentle lady, thereafter he shall dedicate himself along with his possessions and attendants. After worshipping thus in accor- dance with his capacity and not at all attempting deception, the disciple shall grasp the mantra and perfect knowledge from the preceptor, gradually.
verses.wordMeaning: The devotee shall approach the brahmin preceptor who is conversant with the real meaning of the Mantra,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The devotee shall approach the brahmin preceptor who is conversant with the real meaning of the Mantra,…

verses.sanskrit: अहमेको द्विधाप्यासं प्रकृत्यात्मप्रभेदतः स तु नारायणः शेते देवो मायामयीं तनुम्
verses.transliteration: ahameko dvidhāpyāsaṃ prakṛtyātmaprabhedataḥ sa tu nārāyaṇaḥ śete devo māyāmayīṃ tanum
verses.translation: Thus propitiated, the preceptor shall make the dis- ciple take his bath after testing him thus. The disciple, shall stay with him for a year and serve him. He shall be pure and devoid of egotism. He shall become emaciated due to constant fasts. The preceptor shall then bless the disciple with the ex- cellent perfect knowledge of Siva in a holy place at an auspi- cious hour. The place may be the shore of the sea or the bank of a river, the cowpen or a temple, or a clean place in the house
verses.hindi: स्नानमें तथा प्रातः-सायं दोनों सम्ध्या ग्यारह बार पंचाक्षरमन्त्रसे प्रोक्षण, अभिषेक तथा करना चाहिए। जो शुद्ध होकर पर्वतपर आलस्यरहित हो एक लाख बार मन्त्रका जप करता है अथवा किसी महानदीके तटपर दो लाख बार जप करता है, वह दीर्घ आयु प्राप्त करता है
verses.wordMeaning: Thus propitiated, the preceptor shall make the dis- ciple take his bath after testing him thus. The disciple, shall stay with him for a year and serve him. He shall be pure and devoid of egotism. He shall become emaciated due to constant fasts.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus propitiated, the preceptor shall make the dis- ciple take his bath after testing him thus. The disciple, shall stay with him for a year and serve him. He shall be pure and devoid of egotism. He shall become emaciated due to constant fasts.…

verses.sanskrit: आस्थाय योगपर्यङ्कशयने तोयमध्यगः तन्नाभिपङ्कजाज्जातः पञ्चवक्त्रः पितामहः
verses.transliteration: āsthāya yogaparyaṅkaśayane toyamadhyagaḥ tannābhipaṅkajājjātaḥ pañcavaktraḥ pitāmahaḥ
verses.translation: The preceptor shall utter himself and make the dis- ciple utter after him. He shall then bestow Siddhi (on the disci- ple) saying — 'May there be auspiciousness. May it be splen- did. May it be pleasing".
verses.hindi: दूर्वाकुर, तिल, वाणी, गुरुच और घुटिका-इनका दस हजार होम आयुको वृद्धि करनेवाला होता है। बुद्धिमानूको चाहिए कि पीपलके वृक्षका आश्रय लेकर दो लाख जप करे। शनिवारको पीपल वृक्षका स्पर्श
verses.wordMeaning: The preceptor shall utter himself and make the dis- ciple utter after him. He shall then bestow Siddhi (on the disci- ple) saying — 'May there be auspiciousness. May it be splen- did. May it be pleasing".
verses.commentary: Sense: The preceptor shall utter himself and make the dis- ciple utter after him. He shall then bestow Siddhi (on the disci- ple) saying — 'May there be auspiciousness. May it be splen- did. May it be pleasing".

verses.sanskrit: सिसृक्षमाणो लोकान्वै त्रीनशक्तो ऽसहायवान् दश ब्रह्मा ससर्जादौ मानसानमितौजसः
verses.transliteration: sisṛkṣamāṇo lokānvai trīnaśakto 'sahāyavān daśa brahmā sasarjādau mānasānamitaujasaḥ
verses.translation: After acquiring the great Mantra and perfect know- ledge from the preceptor the disciple shall repeat it every day with the due Samkalpa. He shall perform Purascarana too.
verses.hindi: करके मनुष्य दीर्घ आयु प्राप्त करता है। बुद्धिमानको शनैश्चरके दिन अपने दोनों हाथोंसे पीपलके वृक्षका स्पर्श करना चाहिए और एक सौ आठ बार मन्त्रका जप करना चाहिए; यह भी अकाल मृत्युको दूर करनेवाला होता है॥ १८८-१९०/२॥
verses.wordMeaning: After acquiring the great Mantra and perfect know- ledge from the preceptor the disciple shall repeat it every day with the due Samkalpa. He shall perform Purascarana too.
verses.commentary: Sense: After acquiring the great Mantra and perfect know- ledge from the preceptor the disciple shall repeat it every day with the due Samkalpa. He shall perform Purascarana too.

verses.sanskrit: तेषां सृष्टिप्रसिद्ध्यर्थं मां प्रोवाच पितामहः मत्पुत्राणां महादेव शक्तिं देहि महेश्वर
verses.transliteration: teṣāṃ sṛṣṭiprasiddhyarthaṃ māṃ provāca pitāmahaḥ matputrāṇāṃ mahādeva śaktiṃ dehi maheśvara
verses.translation: As long as he lives, he shall repeat this a thousand and eight times every day. Without repeating it, he shall not take food. Thus interested in it he attains the greatest goal. He who repeats this Mantra a hundred thousand times for each syllable and then repeats it four times with great attention is known as one who has made a Purascarana. He shall take food only at night. He shall be self-controlled.
verses.hindi: सूर्यको ओर मुख करके एकाग्रचित्त होकर एंक लाख जप करना चाहिए; अर्कको समिधाओंसे प्रतिदिन एक सौ आठ होम करनेवाला व्यक्ति रोगसे मुक्त हो जाता है। मनुष्यको समस्त रोगोंके शमनके लिये
verses.wordMeaning: As long as he lives, he shall repeat this a thousand and eight times every day. Without repeating it, he shall not take food. Thus interested in it he attains the greatest goal.…
verses.commentary: Sense: As long as he lives, he shall repeat this a thousand and eight times every day. Without repeating it, he shall not take food. Thus interested in it he attains the greatest goal.…

verses.sanskrit: इति तेन समादिष्टः पञ्चवक्त्रधरो ह्यहम् पञ्चाक्षरान्पञ्चमुखैः प्रोक्तवान् पद्मयोनये
verses.transliteration: iti tena samādiṣṭaḥ pañcavaktradharo hyaham pañcākṣarānpañcamukhaiḥ proktavān padmayonaye
verses.translation: A person who seeks for Siddhi, ere long, shall be one of these two:— either a Purascarana repeater or daily repeater.
verses.hindi: पलाश-समिधाओंसे होम करना चाहिए; इससे दस हजार होम करके मनुष्य रोगरहित हो जाता है। प्रतिदिन
verses.wordMeaning: A person who seeks for Siddhi, ere long, shall be one of these two:— either a Purascarana repeater or daily repeater.
verses.commentary: Sense: A person who seeks for Siddhi, ere long, shall be one of these two:— either a Purascarana repeater or daily repeater.

verses.sanskrit: तान्पञ्चवदनैर्गृह्णन् ब्रह्मा लोकपितामहः वाच्यवाचकभावेन ज्ञातवान्परमेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: tānpañcavadanairgṛhṇan brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ vācyavācakabhāvena jñātavānparameśvaram
verses.translation: If a devotee performs Purascarana and continues to be a daily repeater too, there is no one else in the world who is equally accomplished, self-controlled and competent to bestow Siddhis.
verses.hindi: एक सौ आठ बार जप करके सूर्यके समक्ष जल पीना चाहिए; ऐसा करनेवाला एक महीनेमें ही सभौ उदर सम्बन्धी रोगोंसे मुक्त हो जाता है॥ १९१--१९३/२॥
verses.wordMeaning: If a devotee performs Purascarana and continues to be a daily repeater too, there is no one else in the world who is equally accomplished, self-controlled and competent to bestow Siddhis.
verses.commentary: Sense: If a devotee performs Purascarana and continues to be a daily repeater too, there is no one else in the world who is equally accomplished, self-controlled and competent to bestow Siddhis.

verses.sanskrit: वाच्यः पञ्चाक्षरैर्देवि शिवस्त्रैलोक्यपूजितः वाचकः परमो मन्त्रस् तस्य पञ्चाक्षरः स्थितः
verses.transliteration: vācyaḥ pañcākṣarairdevi śivastrailokyapūjitaḥ vācakaḥ paramo mantras tasya pañcākṣaraḥ sthitaḥ
verses.translation: Sitting in a comfortable posture he shall be silent with his mind fully concentrated. He may sit facing the east or the north and then repeat the excellent Mantra. At the beginning of the japa and at its conclusion he shall restrain his breath. In the end, he shall repeat the excellent Bija mantra a hundred and eight times in all.
verses.hindi: ग्यारह बार मन्त्रसे अभिमन्त्रित करके अन्न तथा अन्य भक्ष्य-पेय पदार्थ ग्रहण करना चाहिए; इससे विष  भी अमृत हो जाता है। प्रतिदिन पूर्वाहमें एक सौ अ.
verses.wordMeaning: Sitting in a comfortable posture he shall be silent with his mind fully concentrated. He may sit facing the east or the north and then repeat the excellent Mantra. At the beginning of the japa and at its conclusion he shall restrain his breath. In the end,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Sitting in a comfortable posture he shall be silent with his mind fully concentrated. He may sit facing the east or the north and then repeat the excellent Mantra. At the beginning of the japa and at its conclusion he shall restrain his breath. In the end,…

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञात्वा प्रयोगं विधिना च सिद्धिं लब्ध्वा तथा पञ्चमुखो महात्मा प्रोवाच पुत्रेषु जगद्धिताय मन्त्रं महार्थं किल पञ्चवर्णम्
verses.transliteration: jñātvā prayogaṃ vidhinā ca siddhiṃ labdhvā tathā pañcamukho mahātmā provāca putreṣu jagaddhitāya mantraṃ mahārthaṃ kila pañcavarṇam
verses.translation: The devotee shall restrain the breath forty times and repeat the mantra. Thus the Pranayama for the five-sylla- bled Mantra has been cited. Thanks to Pranayama, his sins will be destroyed soon and the sense-organs shall become con- trolled. Hence, one shall practise Prariayama.
verses.hindi: आहुति देकर तथा सूर्योपस्थान करके एक लाख जप करा
verses.wordMeaning: The devotee shall restrain the breath forty times and repeat the mantra. Thus the Pranayama for the five-sylla- bled Mantra has been cited. Thanks to Pranayama, his sins will be destroyed soon and the sense-organs shall become con- trolled. Hence, one shall practise Prariayama.
verses.commentary: Sense: The devotee shall restrain the breath forty times and repeat the mantra. Thus the Pranayama for the five-sylla- bled Mantra has been cited. Thanks to Pranayama, his sins will be destroyed soon and the sense-organs shall become con- trolled. Hence, one shall practise Prariayama.

verses.sanskrit: ते लब्ध्वा मन्त्ररत्नं तु साक्षाल्लोकपितामहात् तमाराधयितुं देवं परात्परतरं शिवम्
verses.transliteration: te labdhvā mantraratnaṃ tu sākṣāllokapitāmahāt tamārādhayituṃ devaṃ parātparataraṃ śivam
verses.translation: It should be known that the japa performed in the house has ordinary benefit; that performed in the cowpen shall be hundred times more efficacious; if it is on the banks of a
verses.hindi: चाहिए; ऐसा करनेवाला पूर्ण आरोग्य प्राप्त करता है नदीके जलसे भरे हुए सुन्दर घड़ेको स्पर्श करते ह” रत
verses.wordMeaning: It should be known that the japa performed in the house has ordinary benefit; that performed in the cowpen shall be hundred times more efficacious; if it is on the banks of a
verses.commentary: Sense: It should be known that the japa performed in the house has ordinary benefit; that performed in the cowpen shall be hundred times more efficacious; if it is on the banks of a

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तुतोष भगवान् त्रिमूर्तीनां परः शिवः दत्तवानखिलं ज्ञानम् अणिमादिगुणाष्टकम्
verses.transliteration: tatastutoṣa bhagavān trimūrtīnāṃ paraḥ śivaḥ dattavānakhilaṃ jñānam aṇimādiguṇāṣṭakam
verses.translation: The japa performed on the seashore in a divine pond, on a mountain, in a temple and in a sacred hermitage has crore times the benefit.
verses.hindi: हजार जप करनेसे तथा उसी जलसे स्नान करसे स
verses.wordMeaning: The japa performed on the seashore in a divine pond, on a mountain, in a temple and in a sacred hermitage has crore times the benefit.
verses.commentary: Sense: The japa performed on the seashore in a divine pond, on a mountain, in a temple and in a sacred hermitage has crore times the benefit.

verses.sanskrit: ते ऽपि लब्ध्वा वरान्विप्रास् तदाराधनकाङ्क्षिणः मेरोस्तु शिखरे रम्ये मुञ्जवान्नाम पर्वतः
verses.transliteration: te 'pi labdhvā varānviprās tadārādhanakāṅkṣiṇaḥ merostu śikhare ramye muñjavānnāma parvataḥ
verses.translation: The rite of japa is commended if it is in the presence of Siva or in front of the sun, the preceptor, the lamp, cow or water.
verses.hindi: रोगोंकी चिकित्सा हो जाती है ॥ १९४-१९६ /२॥ पवित्र होकर प्रतिदिन अट्टाईस बार । हट जप करके अन्न ग्रहण करना चाहिए और बाद
verses.wordMeaning: The rite of japa is commended if it is in the presence of Siva or in front of the sun, the preceptor, the lamp, cow or water.
verses.commentary: Sense: The rite of japa is commended if it is in the presence of Siva or in front of the sun, the preceptor, the lamp, cow or water.

verses.sanskrit: मत्प्रियः सततं श्रीमान् मद्भूतैः परिरक्षितः तस्याभ्याशे तपस्तीव्रं लोकसृष्टिसमुत्सुकाः
verses.transliteration: matpriyaḥ satataṃ śrīmān madbhūtaiḥ parirakṣitaḥ tasyābhyāśe tapastīvraṃ lokasṛṣṭisamutsukāḥ
verses.translation: O lady of auspicious face, if the number of the repetitions is reckoned on the fingers it has the ordinary benefit; if lines arc drawn and the number is calculated the benefit is said to be eight times more; if it is reckoned by means of the fruits of Putrajiva it has ten times more benefit; if it is cal- culated by means of conches and jewels the benefit is hundred times more; through coral the benefit a thousand times more; it is ten thousand times more, if the reckoning is through crys- tals; it is hundred thousand times more if the calculation is by pearls; it is one million times more if the calculation is by lotus-seeds; if it is calculated by gold pieces the benefit is ten million times more. The benefit is infinite if the calculation is by knots of Ku:Sa grass or Rudraksa beads.
verses.hindi: पंचाक्षरीविद्या ( पंचाक्षरमन्त्र ), जपविधान तथा उसकी महिमा
verses.wordMeaning: O lady of auspicious face, if the number of the repetitions is reckoned on the fingers it has the ordinary benefit; if lines arc drawn and the number is calculated the benefit is said to be eight times more;…
verses.commentary: Sense: O lady of auspicious face, if the number of the repetitions is reckoned on the fingers it has the ordinary benefit; if lines arc drawn and the number is calculated the benefit is said to be eight times more;…

verses.sanskrit: दिव्यवर्षसहस्रं तु वायुभक्षाः समाचरन् तिष्ठन्तो ऽनुग्रहार्थाय देवि ते ऋषयः पुरा
verses.transliteration: divyavarṣasahasraṃ tu vāyubhakṣāḥ samācaran tiṣṭhanto 'nugrahārthāya devi te ṛṣayaḥ purā
verses.translation: The necklace of twenty- five Rudraksa beads is conducive to salvation; that of twenty-seven is nourishing, that of thirty is conducive to the achievement of wealth and tiiat of fifty pertains to black magic.
verses.hindi: यावद्ग्रहणमोक्षं तु तावन्नद्यां समाहित:। जपेत्समुद्रगामिन्यां विमोक्षे ग्रहणस्य तु ऐहिकां लभते मेधां सर्वशास्त्रधरां शुभाम्
verses.wordMeaning: The necklace of twenty- five Rudraksa beads is conducive to salvation; that of twenty-seven is nourishing, that of thirty is conducive to the achievement of wealth and tiiat of fifty pertains to black magic.
verses.commentary: Sense: The necklace of twenty- five Rudraksa beads is conducive to salvation; that of twenty-seven is nourishing, that of thirty is conducive to the achievement of wealth and tiiat of fifty pertains to black magic.

verses.sanskrit: तेषां भक्तिमहं दृष्ट्वा सद्यः प्रत्यक्षतामियाम् पञ्चाक्षरम् ऋषिच्छन्दो दैवतं शक्तिबीजवत्
verses.transliteration: teṣāṃ bhaktimahaṃ dṛṣṭvā sadyaḥ pratyakṣatāmiyām pañcākṣaram ṛṣicchando daivataṃ śaktibījavat
verses.translation: Any holy rite performed without the thumb is fruit- less. Listen. The japayajfla excels all other sacrifices.
verses.hindi: सारस्वती भवेद्देवी तस्य वागतिमानुषी। ग्रहनक्षत्रपीडासु जपेद्भक्त्यायुतं नरः
verses.wordMeaning: Any holy rite performed without the thumb is fruit- less. Listen. The japayajfla excels all other sacrifices.
verses.commentary: Sense: Any holy rite performed without the thumb is fruit- less. Listen. The japayajfla excels all other sacrifices.

verses.sanskrit: न्यासं षडङ्गं दिग्बन्धं विनियोगमशेषतः प्रोक्तवानहमार्याणां लोकानां हितकाम्यया
verses.transliteration: nyāsaṃ ṣaḍaṅgaṃ digbandhaṃ viniyogamaśeṣataḥ proktavānahamāryāṇāṃ lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā
verses.translation: All the ritualistic sacrifices, charitable gifts and austerities do not merit even a sixteenth fraction of the japa-
verses.hindi: चन्द्रसूर्यग्रहे लिङ्गं समभ्यर्च्य यथाविधि सन्निधावस्य देवस्य शुचिः संयतमानसः
verses.wordMeaning: All the ritualistic sacrifices, charitable gifts and austerities do not merit even a sixteenth fraction of the japa-
verses.commentary: Sense: All the ritualistic sacrifices, charitable gifts and austerities do not merit even a sixteenth fraction of the japa-

verses.sanskrit: तच्छ्रुत्वा मन्त्रमाहात्म्यम् ऋषयस्ते तपोधनाः मन्त्रस्य विनियोगं च कृत्वा सर्वमनुष्ठिताः
verses.transliteration: tacchrutvā mantramāhātmyam ṛṣayaste tapodhanāḥ mantrasya viniyogaṃ ca kṛtvā sarvamanuṣṭhitāḥ
verses.translation: The quality of the benefit varies according to the mode of yajfia. If the deity is eulogised continuously by japa it becomes pleased and on being pleased it shall bestow extensive pleasures and permanent liberation. Neither the yaksas nor the Raksasas, neither the Pisacas nor the terrible and evil planets even approach the person doing the japa. They are frightened all round. One shall entirely suppress by means of japa all the sins committed in a number of previous births. One wins worldly pleasures, Siddhis and liberation and also conquers death by means of japa.
verses.hindi: सर्वान् कामानवाप्नोति पुरुषो नात्र संशय: । गजानां तुरगाणां तु गोजातीनां विशेषतः
verses.wordMeaning: The quality of the benefit varies according to the mode of yajfia. If the deity is eulogised continuously by japa it becomes pleased and on being pleased it shall bestow extensive pleasures and permanent liberation. Neither the yaksas nor the Raksasas,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The quality of the benefit varies according to the mode of yajfia. If the deity is eulogised continuously by japa it becomes pleased and on being pleased it shall bestow extensive pleasures and permanent liberation. Neither the yaksas nor the Raksasas,…

verses.sanskrit: तन्माहात्म्यात् तदा लोकान् सदेवासुरमानुषान् वर्णान्वर्णविभागांश् च सर्वधर्मांश् च शोभनान्
verses.transliteration: tanmāhātmyāt tadā lokān sadevāsuramānuṣān varṇānvarṇavibhāgāṃś ca sarvadharmāṃś ca śobhanān
verses.translation: Since performance devoid of good conduct shall be fruitless good conduct is the greatest virtue, the greatest penance.
verses.hindi: पालाशसमिधैर्देवि तस्य शान्तिर्भविष्यति। आभिचारिकबाधायामेतह्देवि समाचरेत् विषेण रुधिराभ्यक्तो विद्वेषणकरं नृणाम्
verses.wordMeaning: Since performance devoid of good conduct shall be fruitless good conduct is the greatest virtue, the greatest penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: Since performance devoid of good conduct shall be fruitless good conduct is the greatest virtue, the greatest penance.

verses.sanskrit: पूर्वकल्पसमुद्भूताञ् छ्रुतवन्तो यथा पुरा पञ्चाक्षरप्रभावाच्च लोका वेदा महर्षयः
verses.transliteration: pūrvakalpasamudbhūtāñ chrutavanto yathā purā pañcākṣaraprabhāvācca lokā vedā maharṣayaḥ
verses.translation: Good conduct is the greatest learning. Good conduct is the greatest goal. Men of good conduct shall be fearless everywhere.
verses.hindi: ही पलाश-समिधाओंसे हवन करनेसे व्यक्ति आरोग्य प्राप्त करता है। चन्द्रग्रहण तथा सूर्यग्रहणके अवसरपर पवित्र होकर विधिपूर्वक उपवास करके जबतक ग्रहणका मोक्ष हो, तबतक किसी समुद्रगामिनी नदीमें एकाग्रचित्त
verses.wordMeaning: Good conduct is the greatest learning. Good conduct is the greatest goal. Men of good conduct shall be fearless everywhere.
verses.commentary: Sense: Good conduct is the greatest learning. Good conduct is the greatest goal. Men of good conduct shall be fearless everywhere.

verses.sanskrit: तिष्ठन्ति शाश्वता धर्मा देवाः सर्वमिदं जगत् तद् इदानीं प्रवक्ष्यामि शृणु चावहिताखिलम्
verses.transliteration: tiṣṭhanti śāśvatā dharmā devāḥ sarvamidaṃ jagat tad idānīṃ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇu cāvahitākhilam
verses.translation: Similarly men devoid of good conduct shall meet with fear everywhere.
verses.hindi: होकर जप करना चाहिए और है द्विजो! ग्रहणके समाप्त होनेपर एक हजार आठ मन्त्रका जप करके ब्राह्मीरसका पान करना चाहिए। ऐसा करनेवाला सभी शास्त्रोंको धारण करनेवाली कल्याणमयी लौकिक प्रतिभा प्राप्त करता है और उसकी वाणी अतिमानुषी होकर देवी सरस्वतीकी वाणीके तुल्य हो जाती है॥ १९७--२०० /२॥ ग्रह तथा नक्षत्रके कारण कष्ट होनेपर मनुष्य भक्तिपूर्वक दस हजार जप करके तथा आठ हजार
verses.wordMeaning: Similarly men devoid of good conduct shall meet with fear everywhere.
verses.commentary: Sense: Similarly men devoid of good conduct shall meet with fear everywhere.

verses.sanskrit: अल्पाक्षरं महार्थं च वेदसारं विमुक्तिदम् आज्ञासिद्धमसंदिग्धं वाक्यमेतच्छिवात्मकम्
verses.transliteration: alpākṣaraṃ mahārthaṃ ca vedasāraṃ vimuktidam ājñāsiddhamasaṃdigdhaṃ vākyametacchivātmakam
verses.translation: One who performs the rites laid down for him is always my favourite. In the evening and in the morning he shall practise worship with a delighted mind. He shall begin the rite, clean in mind and body before sunrise and before sunset and perform it duly. A brahmin shall not transgress Sandhy a due to lust, delusion, fear or covetousness. Since by giving up Sandhya prayers, the brahmin falls off from the status of brahminhood.
verses.hindi: आहुति देकर ग्रहपीड़ासे मुक्त हो जाता है। दुःस्वप्न देखनेपर स्नान करके मनुष्यको दस हजार जप करना चाहिए; इसके बाद घृतकी एक सौ आठ आहुति देनेसे उसे शीघ्र ही शान्ति प्राप्त होगी ॥ २०१-२०२/२॥
verses.wordMeaning: One who performs the rites laid down for him is always my favourite. In the evening and in the morning he shall practise worship with a delighted mind. He shall begin the rite, clean in mind and body before sunrise and before sunset and perform it duly.…
verses.commentary: Sense: One who performs the rites laid down for him is always my favourite. In the evening and in the morning he shall practise worship with a delighted mind. He shall begin the rite, clean in mind and body before sunrise and before sunset and perform it duly.…

verses.sanskrit: नानासिद्धियुतं दिव्यं लोकचित्तानुरञ्जकम् सुनिश्चितार्थं गंभीरं वाक्यं मे पारमेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: nānāsiddhiyutaṃ divyaṃ lokacittānurañjakam suniścitārthaṃ gaṃbhīraṃ vākyaṃ me pārameśvaram
verses.translation: Even those brahmins who are the expounders of Brahman are defiled by accepting gifts from their patrons, kings, etc. There is no rebirth unto those who are defiled by taking gifts, as unto the seeds that are heated in fire.
verses.hindi: चनद्रग्रहण तथा सूर्यग्रहणके समय विधिपूर्वक लिङ्गका पूजन करके शुद्ध तथा एकाग्रचित्त होकर इन महादेवके समीप आदरपूर्वक दस हजार जप करना चाहिए; है देवि! वह मनुष्य जो कुछ भी माँगता है, उसकी सभी कामनाएँ पूर्ण होती है; इसमें सन्देह नहीं है॥ २०३-२०४/२॥ हाथियों, घोड़ों तथा विशेषकर गोजातिके पशुओंमें रोग उत्पन्न होनेपर शुद्ध होकर तथा भक्तियुक्त होकर विधिपूर्वक महीनेभर पूजन करके समिधाकी दस हजार
verses.wordMeaning: Even those brahmins who are the expounders of Brahman are defiled by accepting gifts from their patrons, kings, etc. There is no rebirth unto those who are defiled by taking gifts, as unto the seeds that are heated in fire.
verses.commentary: Sense: Even those brahmins who are the expounders of Brahman are defiled by accepting gifts from their patrons, kings, etc. There is no rebirth unto those who are defiled by taking gifts, as unto the seeds that are heated in fire.

verses.sanskrit: मन्त्रं मुखसुखोच्चार्यम् अशेषार्थप्रसाधकम् तद्बीजं सर्वविद्यानां मन्त्रमाद्यं सुशोभनम्
verses.transliteration: mantraṃ mukhasukhoccāryam aśeṣārthaprasādhakam tadbījaṃ sarvavidyānāṃ mantramādyaṃ suśobhanam
verses.translation: Gift from kings is sinful. It is comparable to poison. After realising this at the outset it shall be avoided by a learned man as heidiall avoid the flesh of a dog«
verses.hindi: आहुति देनेसे उन पशुओंके रोगको शान्ति तथा उनकी वृद्धि होती है; इसमें सन्देह नहीं है॥ २०५-२०६१/२॥ हे देवि! उपद्रव तथा शत्रुबाधा उत्पन्न होनेपर जो व्यक्ति पवित्र होकर पलाशकी समिधाओंसे दस
verses.wordMeaning: Gift from kings is sinful. It is comparable to poison. After realising this at the outset it shall be avoided by a learned man as heidiall avoid the flesh of a dog«
verses.commentary: Sense: Gift from kings is sinful. It is comparable to poison. After realising this at the outset it shall be avoided by a learned man as heidiall avoid the flesh of a dog«

verses.sanskrit: अतिसूक्ष्मं महार्थं च ज्ञेयं तद्वटबीजवत् वेदः स त्रिगुणातीतः सर्वज्ञः सर्वकृत्प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: atisūkṣmaṃ mahārthaṃ ca jñeyaṃ tadvaṭabījavat vedaḥ sa triguṇātītaḥ sarvajñaḥ sarvakṛtprabhuḥ
verses.translation: One shall not take food without taking bath, or performing japa or worshipping the fire. One shall not take food on the outer side of a leaf. At night one shall not take food without a lamp.
verses.hindi: हजार होम करता है; उसकी शान्ति होती है। है देवि! आभिचारिक बाधामें भी ऐसा ही करना चाहिए; ऐसा करनेसे उसको शक्ति प्रकट होती है और शत्रुको पीड़ा उत्पन्न होती है। विद्वेषणके लिये बहेडेको समिधाओंसे आठ आहुति डालनी चाहिए; अथवा रुधिरसे स्नान करके विपरीत अक्षरसे मन्त्रका जप करते हुए गीले
verses.wordMeaning: One shall not take food without taking bath, or performing japa or worshipping the fire. One shall not take food on the outer side of a leaf. At night one shall not take food without a lamp.
verses.commentary: Sense: One shall not take food without taking bath, or performing japa or worshipping the fire. One shall not take food on the outer side of a leaf. At night one shall not take food without a lamp.

verses.sanskrit: ओमित्येकाक्षरं मन्त्रं स्थितः सर्वगतः शिवः मन्त्रे षडक्षरे सूक्ष्मे पञ्चाक्षरतनुः शिवः
verses.transliteration: omityekākṣaraṃ mantraṃ sthitaḥ sarvagataḥ śivaḥ mantre ṣaḍakṣare sūkṣme pañcākṣaratanuḥ śivaḥ
verses.translation: One shall never take food in a broken pot, in the open street, and in the presence of fallen people. One shall not take food partly consumed by a Sudra nor shall one take cooked rice along with infants. One shall take in only pure food which is unctuous, emollient, consecrated and inspired with mantras. While taking food one shall remember that it is Siva who eats. He shall keep silent and concentrated.
verses.hindi: प्रायश्चित्तं प्रवक्ष्यामि सर्वपापविशुद्धये। पापशुद्धिर्यथा सम्यक् कर्तुमभ्युद्यतो नरः
verses.wordMeaning: One shall never take food in a broken pot, in the open street, and in the presence of fallen people. One shall not take food partly consumed by a Sudra nor shall one take cooked rice along with infants. One shall take in only pure food which is unctuous, emollient,…
verses.commentary: Sense: One shall never take food in a broken pot, in the open street, and in the presence of fallen people. One shall not take food partly consumed by a Sudra nor shall one take cooked rice along with infants. One shall take in only pure food which is unctuous, emollient,…

verses.sanskrit: वाच्यवाचकभावेन स्थितः साक्षात्स्वभावतः वाच्यः शिवः प्रमेयत्वान् मन्त्रस्तद्वाचकः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: vācyavācakabhāvena sthitaḥ sākṣātsvabhāvataḥ vācyaḥ śivaḥ prameyatvān mantrastadvācakaḥ smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: One shall not drink water, sipping standing, through folded hands, nor with the left hand or seated on a bed even with the right hand.
verses.hindi: पापशुद्धिर्यतः सम्यग् ज्ञानसम्पत्तिहैतुकी । पापशुद्धिर्न चेत्पुंसः क्रियाः सर्वाश्च निष्फला: ज्ञानं च हीयते तस्मात्कर्तव्यं पापशोधनम्। विद्यालक्ष्मीविशुद्धयर्थ मां ध्यात्वाञ्जलिना शुभे
verses.wordMeaning: One shall not drink water, sipping standing, through folded hands, nor with the left hand or seated on a bed even with the right hand.
verses.commentary: Sense: One shall not drink water, sipping standing, through folded hands, nor with the left hand or seated on a bed even with the right hand.

verses.sanskrit: वाच्यवाचकभावो ऽयम् अनादिः संस्थितस्तयोः वेदे शिवागमे वापि यत्र यत्र षडक्षरः
verses.transliteration: vācyavācakabhāvo 'yam anādiḥ saṃsthitastayoḥ vede śivāgame vāpi yatra yatra ṣaḍakṣaraḥ
verses.translation: One shall not resort to the shade of Vibhi taka,'*® Arka,'* Karafija'** and Snuhi'®* trees, nor shall one stand in the shadow of a pillar, lamp post, human beings and other animals.
verses.hindi: शिवेनैकादशेनाद्भिरभिषिञ्चेत्समन्ततः । अष्टोत्तरशतेनैव स्तायात्पापविशुद्धये
verses.wordMeaning: One shall not resort to the shade of Vibhi taka,'*® Arka,'* Karafija'** and Snuhi'®* trees, nor shall one stand in the shadow of a pillar, lamp post, human beings and other animals.
verses.commentary: Sense: One shall not resort to the shade of Vibhi taka,'*® Arka,'* Karafija'** and Snuhi'®* trees, nor shall one stand in the shadow of a pillar, lamp post, human beings and other animals.

verses.sanskrit: मन्त्रः स्थितः सदा मुख्यो लोके पञ्चाक्षरो मतः किं तस्य बहुभिर् मन्त्रैः शास्त्रैर्वा बहुविस्तृतैः
verses.transliteration: mantraḥ sthitaḥ sadā mukhyo loke pañcākṣaro mataḥ kiṃ tasya bahubhir mantraiḥ śāstrairvā bahuvistṛtaiḥ
verses.translation: One shall not go on a long journey by oneself nor cross a river with one's hands; one shall never descend into a well nor climb tall trees.
verses.hindi: सर्वतीर्थफलं तच्च सर्वपापहरं शुभम्। सन्ध्योपासनविच्छेदे जपेदष्टशतं नरः विड्वराहैश्च चाण्डालैदुर्जनैः कुक्कुटैरपि। स्पृष्टमन्नं न भुञ्जीत भुक्त्वा चाष्टशतं जपेत्
verses.wordMeaning: One shall not go on a long journey by oneself nor cross a river with one's hands; one shall never descend into a well nor climb tall trees.
verses.commentary: Sense: One shall not go on a long journey by oneself nor cross a river with one's hands; one shall never descend into a well nor climb tall trees.

verses.sanskrit: यस्यैवं हृदि संस्थो ऽयं मन्त्रः स्यात्पारमेश्वरः तेनाधीतं श्रुतं तेन तेन सर्वमनुष्ठितम्
verses.transliteration: yasyaivaṃ hṛdi saṃstho 'yaṃ mantraḥ syātpārameśvaraḥ tenādhītaṃ śrutaṃ tena tena sarvamanuṣṭhitam
verses.translation: O splendid lady, one shall never perform religious actions, japas and other holy rites with the face turned away from the sun, fire, water, Devas and the preceptors.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्महत्याविशुद्धयर्थं जपेल्लक्षायुतं नरः। पातकानां तदर्ध स्यान्नात्र कार्या विचारणा
verses.wordMeaning: O splendid lady, one shall never perform religious actions, japas and other holy rites with the face turned away from the sun, fire, water, Devas and the preceptors.
verses.commentary: Sense: O splendid lady, one shall never perform religious actions, japas and other holy rites with the face turned away from the sun, fire, water, Devas and the preceptors.

verses.sanskrit: यो विद्वान्वै जपेत्सम्यग् अधीत्यैव विधानतः एतावद्धि शिवज्ञानम् एतावत्परमं पदम्
verses.transliteration: yo vidvānvai japetsamyag adhītyaiva vidhānataḥ etāvaddhi śivajñānam etāvatparamaṃ padam
verses.translation: One shall not warm one's feet over the fire; one shall not touch the hand by means of legs; one shall not occupy a lofty place above the fire; one shall never cast impurities or ordure into the fire.
verses.hindi: उपपातकदुष्टानां तदर्धं परिकीर्तितम्। शेषाणामपि पापानां जपेत्पञ्चसहस्त्रकम् आत्मबोधपरं गुह्यं शिवबोधप्रकाशकम्। शिवः स्यात्स जपेन्मन्त्रं पञ्चलक्षमनाकुलः
verses.wordMeaning: One shall not warm one's feet over the fire; one shall not touch the hand by means of legs; one shall not occupy a lofty place above the fire; one shall never cast impurities or ordure into the fire.
verses.commentary: Sense: One shall not warm one's feet over the fire; one shall not touch the hand by means of legs; one shall not occupy a lofty place above the fire; one shall never cast impurities or ordure into the fire.

verses.sanskrit: एतावद् ब्रह्मविद्या च तस्मान्नित्यं जपेद्बुधः पञ्चाक्षरैः सप्रणवो मन्त्रो ऽयं हृदयं मम
verses.transliteration: etāvad brahmavidyā ca tasmānnityaṃ japedbudhaḥ pañcākṣaraiḥ sapraṇavo mantro 'yaṃ hṛdayaṃ mama
verses.translation: One shall never kick the water with the feet; one shall never cast the dirt of the limbs into the water. After washing the dirt on the banks one shall take one's bath.
verses.hindi: रक्तसे या विषसे होम करना चाहिए; यह मनुषय
verses.wordMeaning: One shall never kick the water with the feet; one shall never cast the dirt of the limbs into the water. After washing the dirt on the banks one shall take one's bath.
verses.commentary: Sense: One shall never kick the water with the feet; one shall never cast the dirt of the limbs into the water. After washing the dirt on the banks one shall take one's bath.

verses.sanskrit: गुह्याद्गुह्यतरं साक्षान् मोक्षज्ञानम् अनुत्तमम् अस्य मन्त्रस्य वक्ष्यामि ऋषिच्छन्दो ऽधिदैवतम्
verses.transliteration: guhyādguhyataraṃ sākṣān mokṣajñānam anuttamam asya mantrasya vakṣyāmi ṛṣicchando 'dhidaivatam
verses.translation: The water shaken off from the tip of the nail or hairs, from the garments after bath and from the water pot, is con- ducive to misfortune. If one touches it, it is impure.
verses.hindi: लिये विद्वेषणकारी है हे देवि! अब मैं समस्त पापोंसे fe न करूँगा। fe पाता र
verses.wordMeaning: The water shaken off from the tip of the nail or hairs, from the garments after bath and from the water pot, is con- ducive to misfortune. If one touches it, it is impure.
verses.commentary: Sense: The water shaken off from the tip of the nail or hairs, from the garments after bath and from the water pot, is con- ducive to misfortune. If one touches it, it is impure.

verses.sanskrit: बीजं शक्तिं स्वरं वर्णं स्थानं चैवाक्षरं प्रति वामदेवो नाम ऋषिः पङ्क्तिश्छन्द उदाहृतः
verses.transliteration: bījaṃ śaktiṃ svaraṃ varṇaṃ sthānaṃ caivākṣaraṃ prati vāmadevo nāma ṛṣiḥ paṅktiśchanda udāhṛtaḥ
verses.translation: If a man of deluded mind touches husks and dust particles licked up and raised by a goat, dog, donkey,
verses.hindi: पूर्णरूपसे प्रयत्नशील होना चाहिए; क्योंकि सम्यक ज्ञान-सम्पदाका मूल कारण होती है। यदि पापशुद्ध नहीं होती है, तो मनुष्यकी सभी क्रियाएँ व्यर्थ हो जाती है और उसका ज्ञान क्षीण होता रहता है, इसलिये पापका
verses.wordMeaning: If a man of deluded mind touches husks and dust particles licked up and raised by a goat, dog, donkey,
verses.commentary: Sense: If a man of deluded mind touches husks and dust particles licked up and raised by a goat, dog, donkey,

verses.sanskrit: देवता शिव एवाहं मन्त्रस्यास्य वरानने नकारादीनि बीजानि पञ्चभूतात्मकानि च
verses.transliteration: devatā śiva evāhaṃ mantrasyāsya varānane nakārādīni bījāni pañcabhūtātmakāni ca
verses.translation: K&railja— pertaining to the Karahja tree Pongamia Glabra.
verses.hindi: शोधन अवश्य करना चाहिए॥ २११-२१२ १,। हे शुभे! विद्या तथा लक्ष्मीको विशुद्धिके लिये अंजलिमें जल लेकर मेरा ध्यान करके ग्यारह बार शिव-मन्त्रका जप करके उस जलसे अभिषेक करना चाहिए। पाप-शोधनके लिये एक सौ आठ बार मन्त्रका
verses.wordMeaning: K&railja— pertaining to the Karahja tree Pongamia Glabra.
verses.commentary: Sense: K&railja— pertaining to the Karahja tree Pongamia Glabra.

verses.sanskrit: आत्मानं प्रणवं विद्धि सर्वव्यापिनमव्ययम् शक्तिस्त्वमेव देवेशि सर्वदेवनमस्कृते
verses.transliteration: ātmānaṃ praṇavaṃ viddhi sarvavyāpinamavyayam śaktistvameva deveśi sarvadevanamaskṛte
verses.translation: A man who keeps a cat in his house is on a par with a low caste person. If a man feeds leading brahmins in the presence of a cat it shall be considered to be similar to the act of a Candala. No doubt need be entertained in this respect. The wind from the buttocks, the wind from the win- nowing basket, the wind coming out of the mouths of animals, all these coming into contact with a person dispel his merits.
verses.hindi: जप करके स्नान करना चाहिए; यह सभी तीर्थांका फल देनेवाला, सभी पापोंको दूर करनेवाला तथा कल्याणकारक है। सन्ध्योपासनके छूट जानेपर मनुष्यको एक सौ आठ बार मन्त्रका जप करना चाहिए। सुअर, चाण्डाल, दुर्जन
verses.wordMeaning: A man who keeps a cat in his house is on a par with a low caste person. If a man feeds leading brahmins in the presence of a cat it shall be considered to be similar to the act of a Candala. No doubt need be entertained in this respect. The wind from the buttocks,…
verses.commentary: Sense: A man who keeps a cat in his house is on a par with a low caste person. If a man feeds leading brahmins in the presence of a cat it shall be considered to be similar to the act of a Candala. No doubt need be entertained in this respect. The wind from the buttocks,…

verses.sanskrit: त्वदीयं प्रणवं किंचिन् मदीयं प्रणवं तथा त्वदीयं देवि मन्त्राणां शक्तिभूतं न संशयः
verses.transliteration: tvadīyaṃ praṇavaṃ kiṃcin madīyaṃ praṇavaṃ tathā tvadīyaṃ devi mantrāṇāṃ śaktibhūtaṃ na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: The devotee shall mentally think about the meaning of mantra. Seated on a cosy scat he shall perform japa perfectly. He shall have any of the following for a seat:— viz., a silk cloth, tiger skin, a cotton cloth, an upper cloth or a cotton quilt, a wooden plank or a palmyra leaf. The worship of the preceptor shall be performed in all the three Sandhyas by one who wishes for welfare. He who is the preceptor is also Siva. He who is Siva is the preceptor. As is Siva so is the learning; as is the learning so is the preceptor. The knowledge about Siva is obtained from the preceptor. The benefit accrues in accordance with devotion. O fair lady, indeed he (the pre-
verses.hindi: तथा कुक्कुटका स्पर्श किया हुआ अन्न नहीं खाना चाहिए और खा लेनेपर एक सौ आठ बार मन्त्रका जप करना चाहिए ब्रह्महत्याके शोधनके लिये मनुष्यको सौ हजार करोड़ बार मन्त्रका जप करना चाहिए, अन्य बढे
verses.wordMeaning: The devotee shall mentally think about the meaning of mantra. Seated on a cosy scat he shall perform japa perfectly. He shall have any of the following for a seat:— viz., a silk cloth, tiger skin, a cotton cloth, an upper cloth or a cotton quilt,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The devotee shall mentally think about the meaning of mantra. Seated on a cosy scat he shall perform japa perfectly. He shall have any of the following for a seat:— viz., a silk cloth, tiger skin, a cotton cloth, an upper cloth or a cotton quilt,…

verses.sanskrit: अकारोकारमकारा मदीये प्रणवे स्थिताः उकारं च मकारं च अकारं च क्रमेण वै
verses.transliteration: akārokāramakārā madīye praṇave sthitāḥ ukāraṃ ca makāraṃ ca akāraṃ ca krameṇa vai
verses.translation: The disciple shall bear the behests of his prece- ptor on his head (i. e, he shall obey him) whether he is with or without good qualities. He who seeks welfare shall not trans- gress, even menially, the behests of the preceptor. One who strictly conforms to the biddings of the preceptor attains the wealth of knowledge. Whatever he does in the presence of the preceptor shall be done with the permission of the preceptor viz. — going, standing, sleeping, eating, etc. Neither in front of the preceptor nor in the presence of the deity shall he be compla- cently seated as he pleases, since the preceptor is the lord himself and his house is the temple of the lord. If one comes into contact with sinners one will have downfall due to their sins. If one comes into contact with the preceptor one shall incur the benefit of his holy rites.
verses.hindi: पापोंके शोधनके लिये उसका आधा जप होना चाहिए;  इसमें सन्देह नहीं करना चाहिए। उपपातक शोधनके  लिये उसका आधा जप करना बताया गया है। शैष
verses.wordMeaning: The disciple shall bear the behests of his prece- ptor on his head (i. e, he shall obey him) whether he is with or without good qualities. He who seeks welfare shall not trans- gress, even menially, the behests of the preceptor.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The disciple shall bear the behests of his prece- ptor on his head (i. e, he shall obey him) whether he is with or without good qualities. He who seeks welfare shall not trans- gress, even menially, the behests of the preceptor.…

verses.sanskrit: त्वदीयं प्रणवं विद्धि त्रिमात्रं प्लुतमुत्तमम् ओङ्कारस्य स्वरोदात्त ऋषिर्ब्रह्म सितं वपुः
verses.transliteration: tvadīyaṃ praṇavaṃ viddhi trimātraṃ plutamuttamam oṅkārasya svarodātta ṛṣirbrahma sitaṃ vapuḥ
verses.translation: Undoubtedly if the preceptor is satisfied, Bra- hma, Visnu, Rudra, Devas and sages are also satisfied and they bless him. One shall never infuriate the preceptor physically, mentally or verbally. By his wrath are burned the longevity, fortune, wisdom and good holy rites. The sacrifices of those who infuriate him are futile. His japas and other observances are also futile. No doubt need be entertained in this respect. One shall assiduously refrain from making any statement against the preceptor. If out of great delusion he speaks it out, he will fall into Raurava hell. O fair lady, never should one falsely cheat the preceptor mentally, or verbally or physically or mone- tarily. If he proclaims the wicked qualities of his preceptor he will have hundred times that wickedness. If he proclaims the good qualities he will have the benefit of all good qualities. Whether directed or not, he shall always do what is beneficent and pleasing to the preceptor.
verses.hindi: छोटे पापोंकी शुद्धे लिये भी पाँच हजार बी मन्त्रको जपना चाहिए जो शान्त होकर आत्मबोध करानेवाले, गोपनीय
verses.wordMeaning: Undoubtedly if the preceptor is satisfied, Bra- hma, Visnu, Rudra, Devas and sages are also satisfied and they bless him. One shall never infuriate the preceptor physically, mentally or verbally. By his wrath are burned the longevity, fortune, wisdom and good holy rites.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Undoubtedly if the preceptor is satisfied, Bra- hma, Visnu, Rudra, Devas and sages are also satisfied and they bless him. One shall never infuriate the preceptor physically, mentally or verbally. By his wrath are burned the longevity, fortune, wisdom and good holy rites.…

verses.sanskrit: छन्दो देवी च गायत्री परमात्माधिदेवता उदात्तः प्रथमस्तद्वच् चतुर्थश् च द्वितीयकः
verses.transliteration: chando devī ca gāyatrī paramātmādhidevatā udāttaḥ prathamastadvac caturthaś ca dvitīyakaḥ
verses.translation: Whether within sight or out of sight of the pre- ceptor, one shall do what is beneBccnt or pleasing to the preceptor. If he does anything against him mentally, physically or verbally, he goes down and revolves there itself. Hence, he should be worshipped and saluted always.
verses.hindi: तथा शिवज्ञानको प्रकाशित करनेवाले इस मन्त्रका पा लाख जप करता है, वह साक्षात् शिव हो जाता
verses.wordMeaning: Whether within sight or out of sight of the pre- ceptor, one shall do what is beneBccnt or pleasing to the preceptor. If he does anything against him mentally, physically or verbally, he goes down and revolves there itself. Hence, he should be worshipped and saluted always.
verses.commentary: Sense: Whether within sight or out of sight of the pre- ceptor, one shall do what is beneBccnt or pleasing to the preceptor. If he does anything against him mentally, physically or verbally, he goes down and revolves there itself. Hence, he should be worshipped and saluted always.

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चमः स्वरितश्चैव मध्यमो निषधः स्मृताः नकारः पीतवर्णश् च स्थानं पूर्वमुखं स्मृतम्
verses.transliteration: pañcamaḥ svaritaścaiva madhyamo niṣadhaḥ smṛtāḥ nakāraḥ pītavarṇaś ca sthānaṃ pūrvamukhaṃ smṛtam
verses.translation: The disciple shall speak to the preceptor only after getting permission from him even when he is nearby. Otherwise he shall not look at him straight in the face. The disciple who adheres to all these rules, who is devout, who is perpetually engaged in japa and who does everything pleasing to his preceptor deserves to utilise the Mantra. I shall mention the application and the purpose of the Mantra that has been accomplished. If the devotee does not know the mode of appli- cation, the mantra becomes ineffective. That should be known as Viniyoga whereby the desired benefit is put in conjunction with the activity. It is the benefit of this world as well as of the next. The benefit arising out of Viniyoga is longevity, health, the permanence of the body [?] kingdom, royal glory, perfect knowledge, heaven and salvation.
verses.hindi: और है भद्रे! वह मनुष्य सुखपूर्वक पाँचौं वायुर Es प्राप्त कर लेता है। है सुमुखि! जो शुद्ध होकर पवो वशमें करके पाँच लाख मन्त्र जप करता है, वह
verses.wordMeaning: The disciple shall speak to the preceptor only after getting permission from him even when he is nearby. Otherwise he shall not look at him straight in the face. The disciple who adheres to all these rules, who is devout,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The disciple shall speak to the preceptor only after getting permission from him even when he is nearby. Otherwise he shall not look at him straight in the face. The disciple who adheres to all these rules, who is devout,…

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रो ऽधिदैवतं छन्दो गायत्री गौतम ऋषिः मकारः कृष्णवर्णो ऽस्य स्थानं वै दक्षिणामुखम्
verses.transliteration: indro 'dhidaivataṃ chando gāyatrī gautama ṛṣiḥ makāraḥ kṛṣṇavarṇo 'sya sthānaṃ vai dakṣiṇāmukham
verses.translation: The following rites shall be performed by repeating the five-syllabled Mantra eleven times: — Proksana (ritualistic sprinkling with water); Abhiseka( ablution); Agham- arsana ( praying for forgiveness for sins) and the two baths — one at dawn and one at day. The intelligent devotee shall be clean and after climbing the mountain shall alertfuJly repeat the mantra a hundred thousand times, or two hundred thousand times on the banks of a great river; he will attain long life. Ten thousand Homas with the following materials of worship are conducive to longevity viz: — The sprouts of the Durva grass, gingclly seeds, Vani (?), Guduci and Ghujika (?). I he wise devotee shall repeat the japa two hundred thousand times after resorting to the holy fig tree. By touching the Asvattha tree on a Saturday the man obtains long life. The intelligent devotee shall touch the Asvattha tree with both the hands on Saturdays and repeat the japa hundred and eight times. It will dispel premature death. Facing the sun and with the mind not dwelling on anything else the devotee shall repeat the japa a hundred thousand times. By performing hundred and eight Homas everyday with Arka twigs the devotee is
verses.hindi: पंचाक्षरीविद्या ( पंचाक्षरमन्त्र ), जपविधान तथा उसकी महिमा
verses.wordMeaning: The following rites shall be performed by repeating the five-syllabled Mantra eleven times: — Proksana (ritualistic sprinkling with water); Abhiseka( ablution); Agham- arsana ( praying for forgiveness for sins) and the two baths — one at dawn and one at day.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The following rites shall be performed by repeating the five-syllabled Mantra eleven times: — Proksana (ritualistic sprinkling with water); Abhiseka( ablution); Agham- arsana ( praying for forgiveness for sins) and the two baths — one at dawn and one at day.…

verses.sanskrit: छन्दो ऽनुष्टुप् ऋषिश्चात्री रुद्रो दैवतमुच्यते शिकारो धूम्रवर्णो ऽस्य स्थानं वै पश्चिमं मुखम्
verses.transliteration: chando 'nuṣṭup ṛṣiścātrī rudro daivatamucyate śikāro dhūmravarṇo 'sya sthānaṃ vai paścimaṃ mukham
verses.translation: I shall now recount the mode of expiation for the atonement of sins. Since the atonement of sins is the cause of enrichment in perfect knowledge, all the holy rites will be futile if sins are not properly atoned for.
verses.hindi: सम्यग्विजयमाप्नोति करणानां वरानने। ब्रह्मसिद्धिमवाप्नोति व्रतेनानेन सुन्दरि।
verses.wordMeaning: I shall now recount the mode of expiation for the atonement of sins. Since the atonement of sins is the cause of enrichment in perfect knowledge, all the holy rites will be futile if sins are not properly atoned for.
verses.commentary: Sense: I shall now recount the mode of expiation for the atonement of sins. Since the atonement of sins is the cause of enrichment in perfect knowledge, all the holy rites will be futile if sins are not properly atoned for.

verses.sanskrit: विश्वामित्र ऋषिस्त्रिष्टुप् छन्दो विष्णुस्तु दैवतम् वाकारो हेमवर्णो ऽस्य स्थानं चैवोत्तरं मुखम्
verses.transliteration: viśvāmitra ṛṣistriṣṭup chando viṣṇustu daivatam vākāro hemavarṇo 'sya sthānaṃ caivottaraṃ mukham
verses.translation: Because knowledge dwindles, therefore sins must be properly atoned for. O auspicious lady, for the betterment of learning and fortune the devotee shall take handfuls of water and, meditating on me (iSiva) and repeating the mantra eleven times he shall perform ablution. For the eradication of the sin he shall take bath, repeating the mantra hundred and eight times. It has the same benefit as the pilgrimage to all holy centres. It is auspicious and it dispels all sins. If there is any break in the continuity in the Sandhya prayers the man shall perform hundred and eight japas.
verses.hindi: मध्यरात्रे च शिवयोः पश्यत्येव न संशयः।
verses.wordMeaning: Because knowledge dwindles, therefore sins must be properly atoned for. O auspicious lady, for the betterment of learning and fortune the devotee shall take handfuls of water and, meditating on me (iSiva) and repeating the mantra eleven times he shall perform ablution.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Because knowledge dwindles, therefore sins must be properly atoned for. O auspicious lady, for the betterment of learning and fortune the devotee shall take handfuls of water and, meditating on me (iSiva) and repeating the mantra eleven times he shall perform ablution.…

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्माधिदैवतं छन्दो बृहती चाङ्गिरा ऋषिः यकारो रक्तवर्णश् च स्थानम् ऊर्ध्वं मुखं विराट्
verses.transliteration: brahmādhidaivataṃ chando bṛhatī cāṅgirā ṛṣiḥ yakāro raktavarṇaś ca sthānam ūrdhvaṃ mukhaṃ virāṭ
verses.translation: He shall not partake of the cooked rice touched and defiled by pigs, CaneJas, wicked people and cocks. If he eats it he shall repeat the japa hundred and eight times.
verses.hindi: अन्धकारविनाशश्च दीपस्येव प्रकाशनम् हैवे कर्मणि पित्रे वा शिबलोके महीयते
verses.wordMeaning: He shall not partake of the cooked rice touched and defiled by pigs, CaneJas, wicked people and cocks. If he eats it he shall repeat the japa hundred and eight times.
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall not partake of the cooked rice touched and defiled by pigs, CaneJas, wicked people and cocks. If he eats it he shall repeat the japa hundred and eight times.

verses.sanskrit: छन्द ऋषिर्भरद्वाजः स्कन्दो दैवतमुच्यते न्यासमस्य प्रवक्ष्यामि सर्वसिद्धिकरं शुभम्
verses.transliteration: chanda ṛṣirbharadvājaḥ skando daivatamucyate nyāsamasya pravakṣyāmi sarvasiddhikaraṃ śubham
verses.translation: For the atonement of the sin of brahmin slaughter the man shall repeat the mantra thousand million times i.e. hundred crores. For the expiation of great sins he shall perform the japa to the extent of half that number. No doubt need be entertained in this respect.
verses.hindi: इन्द्रियोंपर विजय प्राप्त कर लेता है। जो शान्त होकर ध्यानमग्न हो पाँच लाख बार मन्त्रका जप करता है, वह पाँचों विषयोंपर विजय प्राप्त करता है। जो मनुष्य भक्तियुक्त होकर चौथी बार इस मन्त्रको पाँच लाख बार
verses.wordMeaning: For the atonement of the sin of brahmin slaughter the man shall repeat the mantra thousand million times i.e. hundred crores. For the expiation of great sins he shall perform the japa to the extent of half that number. No doubt need be entertained in this respect.
verses.commentary: Sense: For the atonement of the sin of brahmin slaughter the man shall repeat the mantra thousand million times i.e. hundred crores. For the expiation of great sins he shall perform the japa to the extent of half that number. No doubt need be entertained in this respect.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वपापहरं चैव त्रिविधो न्यास उच्यते उत्पत्तिस्थितिसंहारभेदतस्त्रिविधः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: sarvapāpaharaṃ caiva trividho nyāsa ucyate utpattisthitisaṃhārabhedatastrividhaḥ smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: It is ordained that in the case of those who are de- filed by subsidiary sins, the japa shall extend to half that num- ber. For the expiation of other sins one shall repeat the japa five thousand times.
verses.hindi: जपता है, वह इस लोकमें पृथ्वी आदि पंचभूतोंपर विजय प्राप्त कर लेता है॥ २१९-२२२/२॥ हे वरानने! जो अपने मनको नियन्त्रित करके प्रयत्नपूर्वक चार लाख बार मन्त्रका जप करता है, वह मन, बुद्धि आदि अन्तःकरणोंपर पूर्णरूपसे विजय प्राप्त कर लेता है। है कमलमुखि! पचीस लाख बार
verses.wordMeaning: It is ordained that in the case of those who are de- filed by subsidiary sins, the japa shall extend to half that num- ber. For the expiation of other sins one shall repeat the japa five thousand times.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is ordained that in the case of those who are de- filed by subsidiary sins, the japa shall extend to half that num- ber. For the expiation of other sins one shall repeat the japa five thousand times.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मचारिगृहस्थानां यतीनां क्रमशो भवेत् उत्पत्तिर्ब्रह्मचारिणां गृहस्थानां स्थितिः सदा
verses.transliteration: brahmacārigṛhasthānāṃ yatīnāṃ kramaśo bhavet utpattirbrahmacāriṇāṃ gṛhasthānāṃ sthitiḥ sadā
verses.translation: The mantra has bearing on the knowledge of the Atman. It is a secret and it illuminates the understanding of Siva. He who repeats the mantra unexcitedly to the extent of five hundred thousand times shall become Siva himself.
verses.hindi: लेता है। है सुन्दरि! जो मध्यरात्रिमें वातरहित स्थानमें आदरपूर्वक दस हजार जप करता है, वह इस ब्रतके द्वारा ब्रह्मसिद्धि प्राप्त कर लेता है। जो मनुष्य आलस्यरहित होकर मध्यरात्रिमें वातशून्य तथा ध्वनि-
verses.wordMeaning: The mantra has bearing on the knowledge of the Atman. It is a secret and it illuminates the understanding of Siva. He who repeats the mantra unexcitedly to the extent of five hundred thousand times shall become Siva himself.
verses.commentary: Sense: The mantra has bearing on the knowledge of the Atman. It is a secret and it illuminates the understanding of Siva. He who repeats the mantra unexcitedly to the extent of five hundred thousand times shall become Siva himself.

verses.sanskrit: यतीनां संहृतिर् न्यासः सिद्धिर् भवति नान्यथा अङ्गन्यासः करन्यासो देहन्यास इति त्रिधा
verses.transliteration: yatīnāṃ saṃhṛtir nyāsaḥ siddhir bhavati nānyathā aṅganyāsaḥ karanyāso dehanyāsa iti tridhā
verses.translation: The devotee shall with purity and devotion repeat the mantra ten million times affixed with the Bijas. He shall attain Sayujya with me. What else is greater than this?
verses.hindi: रहित स्थानमें एक लाख बार जप करता है, वह शिव तथा पार्वतीका दर्शन कर लेता है; इसमें सन्देह नहीं है। उस समय अन्धकारका विनाश हो जाता है और हृदयके बाहर तथा भीतर दीपककी भाँति प्रकाश हो जाता है; इसमें सन्देह नहीं है। आत्मञ्ञको सभी प्रकारकी सम्पदा तथा समृद्धिके लिये मन्त्रका दस हजार जप करना चाहिए। है देवि! जो पवित्र तथा भक्तियुक्त होकर बीजके सम्मुटसहित मन्त्रका सौ लाख
verses.wordMeaning: The devotee shall with purity and devotion repeat the mantra ten million times affixed with the Bijas. He shall attain Sayujya with me. What else is greater than this?
verses.commentary: Sense: The devotee shall with purity and devotion repeat the mantra ten million times affixed with the Bijas. He shall attain Sayujya with me. What else is greater than this?

verses.sanskrit: उत्पत्त्यादित्रिभेदेन वक्ष्यते ते वरानने न्यसेत्पूर्वं करन्यासं देहन्यासम् अनन्तरम्
verses.transliteration: utpattyāditribhedena vakṣyate te varānane nyasetpūrvaṃ karanyāsaṃ dehanyāsam anantaram
verses.translation: Thus, the mode and procedure for chanting the five-syllabled Mantra has been recounted to you. He who reads this and listens to this, attains the greatest goal. He who
verses.hindi: (एक करोड़) जप करता है, वह मेरा सायुज्य प्राप्त कर लेता है; इससे बढ़कर फल क्या हो सकता है।
verses.wordMeaning: Thus, the mode and procedure for chanting the five-syllabled Mantra has been recounted to you. He who reads this and listens to this, attains the greatest goal. He who
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus, the mode and procedure for chanting the five-syllabled Mantra has been recounted to you. He who reads this and listens to this, attains the greatest goal. He who

verses.sanskrit: अङ्गन्यासं ततः पश्चाद् अक्षराणां विधिक्रमात् मूर्धादिपादपर्यन्तम् उत्पत्तिन्यास उच्यते
verses.transliteration: aṅganyāsaṃ tataḥ paścād akṣarāṇāṃ vidhikramāt mūrdhādipādaparyantam utpattinyāsa ucyate
verses.translation: Hence, O Suta, tell us today about the sacrifice of meditation suited for unattached noble souls in detail and with all effort.
verses.hindi: हे देवि! मैंने तुम्हें पंचाक्षरमन्त्रके जपको सम्पूर्ण विधि बता दी। जो इसे पढ़ता अथवा सुनता है, वह परम गति प्राप्त करता है। जो देवकर्म अथवा पितृकर्ममें शुद्ध ब्राह्मणोंको पंचाक्षर विधिके क्रमका ' श्रवण कराता है, वह शिवलोकमें प्रतिष्ठा प्राप्त करता है
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, O Suta, tell us today about the sacrifice of meditation suited for unattached noble souls in detail and with all effort.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, O Suta, tell us today about the sacrifice of meditation suited for unattached noble souls in detail and with all effort.

verses.sanskrit: पादादिमूर्धपर्यन्तं संहारो भवति प्रिये हृदयास्यगलन्यासः स्थितिन्यास उदाहृतः
verses.transliteration: pādādimūrdhaparyantaṃ saṃhāro bhavati priye hṛdayāsyagalanyāsaḥ sthitinyāsa udāhṛtaḥ
verses.translation: "O lord, O bull-bannered lord, the terrible poison Kalakuta has been neutralised by you. Hence everything has been stabilised by you.'*
verses.hindi: पाशुपतयोगज्ञानका स्वरूप तथा उसकी महिमा न ऋषिगण बोले-दग्ध पापवाले ब्राहमणो जपाच्छ्रेष्ठतमं प्राहुर्ब्राह्मणा दग्धकिल्विषाः । ज्ञानियोंके उत्तम ध्यानयज्ञको जपसे श्रेष्ठ कहा हेपत
verses.wordMeaning: "O lord, O bull-bannered lord, the terrible poison Kalakuta has been neutralised by you. Hence everything has been stabilised by you.'*
verses.commentary: Sense: "O lord, O bull-bannered lord, the terrible poison Kalakuta has been neutralised by you. Hence everything has been stabilised by you.'*

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मचारिगृहस्थानां यतीनां चैव शोभने सशिरस्कं ततो देहं सर्वमन्त्रेण संस्पृशेत्
verses.transliteration: brahmacārigṛhasthānāṃ yatīnāṃ caiva śobhane saśiraskaṃ tato dehaṃ sarvamantreṇa saṃspṛśet
verses.translation: On hearing their words, lord Nilalohita, the Atman of the Universe, smilingly said to those sages, Sanandana and others.
verses.hindi: हे सूतजी! अब आप विरक्त महात्माओंके ध्यानयज्ञके हमलोगोंको बताइये
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing their words, lord Nilalohita, the Atman of the Universe, smilingly said to those sages, Sanandana and others.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing their words, lord Nilalohita, the Atman of the Universe, smilingly said to those sages, Sanandana and others.

verses.sanskrit: स देहन्यास इत्युक्तः सर्वेषां सम एव स दक्षिणाङ्गुष्ठमारभ्य वामाङ्गुष्ठान्त एव हि
verses.transliteration: sa dehanyāsa ityuktaḥ sarveṣāṃ sama eva sa dakṣiṇāṅguṣṭhamārabhya vāmāṅguṣṭhānta eva hi
verses.translation: The poison K&lakuta or halShala — a product of the churned ocean was swallowed by Siva. The blue colour of his neck and his extreme ire are the effects of that poison.
verses.hindi: दीर्घ कालतक यज्ञ करनेवाले उन ऋषियोंका वचन सुनकर सूतजीने वह सारा वृत्तान्त कहा, जिसे विश्वकी रचना करनेवाले रुद्रने कालकूट नामक विषको निष्क्रिय करके मेरुपर्वतकी गुफामें आकर
verses.wordMeaning: The poison K&lakuta or halShala — a product of the churned ocean was swallowed by Siva. The blue colour of his neck and his extreme ire are the effects of that poison.
verses.commentary: Sense: The poison K&lakuta or halShala — a product of the churned ocean was swallowed by Siva. The blue colour of his neck and his extreme ire are the effects of that poison.

verses.sanskrit: न्यस्यते यत्तदुत्पत्तिर् विपरीतं तु संहृतिः अङ्गुष्ठादिकनिष्ठान्तं न्यस्यते हस्तयोर् द्वयोः
verses.transliteration: nyasyate yattadutpattir viparītaṃ tu saṃhṛtiḥ aṅguṣṭhādikaniṣṭhāntaṃ nyasyate hastayor dvayoḥ
verses.translation: What is called Kalajkuta is not at all poison when compared to worldly existence which is the real poison. Hence, with all efforts one shall try to dispel that terrible poison.
verses.hindi: महात्माओंको बताया था॥३+/२॥ सूतजी बोले--हे ऋषियो! गुफामें पहुँचकर पार्वतीके साथ सुखपूर्वक बैठे हुए उन शंकरको महात्मा मुनियोंने प्रणाम किया। उसके बाद उन सभीने गुफामें विराजमान उमापति भगवान्
verses.wordMeaning: What is called Kalajkuta is not at all poison when compared to worldly existence which is the real poison. Hence, with all efforts one shall try to dispel that terrible poison.
verses.commentary: Sense: What is called Kalajkuta is not at all poison when compared to worldly existence which is the real poison. Hence, with all efforts one shall try to dispel that terrible poison.

verses.sanskrit: अतीव भोगदो देवि स्थितिन्यासः कुटुंबिनाम् करन्यासं पुरा कृत्वा देहन्यासम् अनन्तरम्
verses.transliteration: atīva bhogado devi sthitinyāsaḥ kuṭuṃbinām karanyāsaṃ purā kṛtvā dehanyāsam anantaram
verses.translation: The mundane existence is two-fold'® in accordance with one's rights and duties. In regard to men of deluded minds, the mundane existence is very terrible and burden- some. O sages of good holy rites, creation is caused by ignorance due to the defects of malice and attachment.'®® It is certainly due to these, that virtue and evil befall everyone. O brahmins, even in regard to things not near at hand,'®® the scripture creates desire for them even in the minds of good men in the world merely by hearing of it. Hence, the perceptible world and the world of Vedic tradition"® and rituals both should be eschewed" with great effort. He then becomes Virakta (unattached person) altogether.
verses.hindi: नीलकण्ठको स्तुति की और कहा--हे भगवन्! आपने अति भयंकर कालकूट नामक विषको निष्क्रिय कर दिया; अतः है देव! है वृषध्वज! आपके द्वारा ही कुछ प्रतिष्ठित है ॥ ४--६॥
verses.wordMeaning: The mundane existence is two-fold'® in accordance with one's rights and duties. In regard to men of deluded minds, the mundane existence is very terrible and burden- some. O sages of good holy rites,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The mundane existence is two-fold'® in accordance with one's rights and duties. In regard to men of deluded minds, the mundane existence is very terrible and burden- some. O sages of good holy rites,…

verses.sanskrit: अङ्गन्यासं न्यसेत्पश्चाद् एष साधारणो विधिः ओङ्कारं संपुटीकृत्य सर्वाङ्गेषु च विन्यसेत्
verses.transliteration: aṅganyāsaṃ nyasetpaścād eṣa sādhāraṇo vidhiḥ oṅkāraṃ saṃpuṭīkṛtya sarvāṅgeṣu ca vinyaset
verses.translation: Those who do not know these things say: — "Desire is natural" in everyone. The opposite is not seen. It is the Veda that makes them work (for fulfilling such desires).
verses.hindi: उनका वह वचन सुनकर विश्वात्मा भगवान् नीललोहित सनन्दन आदि मुनियों -से हँसते हुए कहने लगे- है श्रेष्ठ द्विजो ! यह विष क्या है ! मैं अति भयंकर विषके विषयमें बताऊँगा, जो इस कालकूट विषको भी निष्क्रिय कर देता है, वह परम समर्थ है; यह कालकूट विष कौन-सी चीज है । कालकूट नामक विष वास्तवमें, विष नहीं है, बल्कि संसार ही विष कहा जाता है। अतः पूर्ण प्रयत्नसे इस संसाररूपी अत्यन्त भीषण विषको नष्ट
verses.wordMeaning: Those who do not know these things say: — "Desire is natural" in everyone. The opposite is not seen. It is the Veda that makes them work (for fulfilling such desires).
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who do not know these things say: — "Desire is natural" in everyone. The opposite is not seen. It is the Veda that makes them work (for fulfilling such desires).

verses.sanskrit: करयोरुभयोश्चैव दशाग्रांगुलिषु क्रमात् प्रक्षाल्य पादावाचम्य शुचिर्भूत्वा समाहितः
verses.transliteration: karayorubhayoścaiva daśāgrāṃguliṣu kramāt prakṣālya pādāvācamya śucirbhūtvā samāhitaḥ
verses.translation: i.e. tamasa and rjasa.
verses.hindi: करना चाहिए अर्थात् संसारमें मिथ्यात्वका भाव रखी चाहिए ॥७--९॥
verses.wordMeaning: i.e. tamasa and rjasa.
verses.commentary: Sense: i.e. tamasa and rjasa.

verses.sanskrit: प्राङ्मुखोदङ्मुखो वापि न्यासकर्म समाचरेत् स्मरेत् पूर्वम् ऋषिं छन्दो दैवतं बीजमेव च
verses.transliteration: prāṅmukhodaṅmukho vāpi nyāsakarma samācaret smaret pūrvam ṛṣiṃ chando daivataṃ bījameva ca
verses.translation: ST* dkjoins 'ucyate bhagam' as 'ucyatc abhagam* and con- strues with 'karmasu*. i.e, karmasu abhagam — non-participation in activities. ST, interprets: hert- metaphysics (kdhyatma-Skstra) is considered to be superior to the Vedas.
verses.hindi: अपने अधिकारके अनुसार यह संसार दो प्रकारका कहा गया है; मूढ़चित्तवाले मनुष्योंके लिये यह असंक्षीण (क्षय न होनेवाला) तथा अत्यन्त भयंकर है। है सुत्रतो यह सृष्टि इच्छा तथा रागजनित दोषके कारण है; इसका विरक्तानां प्रबुद्धानां ध्यानयज्ञं सुशोभनम्॥
verses.wordMeaning: ST* dkjoins 'ucyate bhagam' as 'ucyatc abhagam* and con- strues with 'karmasu*. i.e, karmasu abhagam — non-participation in activities. ST, interprets: hert- metaphysics (kdhyatma-Skstra) is considered to be superior to the Vedas.
verses.commentary: Sense: ST* dkjoins 'ucyate bhagam' as 'ucyatc abhagam* and con- strues with 'karmasu*. i.e, karmasu abhagam — non-participation in activities. ST, interprets: hert- metaphysics (kdhyatma-Skstra) is considered to be superior to the Vedas.

verses.sanskrit: शक्तिं च परमात्मानं गुरुं चैव वरानने मन्त्रेण पाणी संमृज्य तलयोः प्रणवं न्यसेत्
verses.transliteration: śaktiṃ ca paramātmānaṃ guruṃ caiva varānane mantreṇa pāṇī saṃmṛjya talayoḥ praṇavaṃ nyaset
verses.translation: The virtue of renunciation from worldly affairs, is intended for eificicni persons.'" Hence, it is said that worldly exigence is caused by ignorance of all embodied persons.
verses.hindi: तस्माद्वदस्व सूताद्य ध्यानयज्ञमशेषतः। विस्तरात्सर्वयत्ेन विरक्तानां महात्मनाम्
verses.wordMeaning: The virtue of renunciation from worldly affairs, is intended for eificicni persons.'" Hence, it is said that worldly exigence is caused by ignorance of all embodied persons.
verses.commentary: Sense: The virtue of renunciation from worldly affairs, is intended for eificicni persons.'" Hence, it is said that worldly exigence is caused by ignorance of all embodied persons.

verses.sanskrit: अङ्गुलीनां च सर्वेषां तथा चाद्यन्तपर्वसु सबिन्दुकानि बीजानि पञ्च मध्यमपर्वसु
verses.transliteration: aṅgulīnāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ tathā cādyantaparvasu sabindukāni bījāni pañca madhyamaparvasu
verses.translation: Salvation is not attained by good men through their progeny, through actions, or through wealth.'' Liberation shall occur only through renunciation. He wanders in the world due to the absence of it (renunciation).
verses.hindi: रुद्रेण कथितं प्राह गुहां प्राप्य महात्मनाम् संहृत्य कालकूटाख्यं विषं वै विश्वकर्मणा।
verses.wordMeaning: Salvation is not attained by good men through their progeny, through actions, or through wealth.'' Liberation shall occur only through renunciation. He wanders in the world due to the absence of it (renunciation).
verses.commentary: Sense: Salvation is not attained by good men through their progeny, through actions, or through wealth.'' Liberation shall occur only through renunciation. He wanders in the world due to the absence of it (renunciation).

verses.sanskrit: उत्पत्त्यादित्रिभेदेन न्यसेदाश्रमतः क्रमात् उभाभ्यामेव पाणिभ्याम् आपादतलमस्तकम्
verses.transliteration: utpattyāditribhedena nyasedāśramataḥ kramāt ubhābhyāmeva pāṇibhyām āpādatalamastakam
verses.translation: Thus due to the fault of ignorance and as a result of various Karmans, the individual soul adopts a body produced by six Kosas'" (vestures).
verses.hindi: गुहां प्राप्य सुखासीनं भवान्या सह शङ्करम्॥
verses.wordMeaning: Thus due to the fault of ignorance and as a result of various Karmans, the individual soul adopts a body produced by six Kosas'" (vestures).
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus due to the fault of ignorance and as a result of various Karmans, the individual soul adopts a body produced by six Kosas'" (vestures).

verses.sanskrit: मन्त्रेण संस्पृशेद्देहं प्रणवेनैव संपुटम् मूर्ध्नि वक्त्रे च कण्ठे च हृदये गुह्यके तथा
verses.transliteration: mantreṇa saṃspṛśeddehaṃ praṇavenaiva saṃpuṭam mūrdhni vaktre ca kaṇṭhe ca hṛdaye guhyake tathā
verses.translation: Many miseries are to be faced by the individual in the womb, in the vaginal passage, on the earth, in boyhood, in youth, in old age and in death.
verses.hindi: अत्युग्रं कालकूटाख्यं संहृतं भगवंस्त्वया। अतः प्रतिष्ठितं सर्व त्वया देव वृषध्वज तेषां तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा भगवान्नीललोहितः।
verses.wordMeaning: Many miseries are to be faced by the individual in the womb, in the vaginal passage, on the earth, in boyhood, in youth, in old age and in death.
verses.commentary: Sense: Many miseries are to be faced by the individual in the womb, in the vaginal passage, on the earth, in boyhood, in youth, in old age and in death.

verses.sanskrit: पादयोर् उभयोश्चैव गुह्ये च हृदये तथा कण्ठे च मुखमध्ये च मूर्ध्नि च प्रणवादिकम्
verses.transliteration: pādayor ubhayoścaiva guhye ca hṛdaye tathā kaṇṭhe ca mukhamadhye ca mūrdhni ca praṇavādikam
verses.translation: For those who are unattached activities arc not unavoidable. Gf. "pravrttir esa bhutam nivrttistu mahabala" — Manu; Or activities have no fixed goal, Gf. Bhaga. 'vedoktam eva kurvano nissangarpitamisvarc/ naiskarmyani labhate siddbim rocanartha phalarutih //
verses.hindi: न विषं कालकूटाख्यं संसारो विषमुच्यते।
verses.wordMeaning: For those who are unattached activities arc not unavoidable. Gf. "pravrttir esa bhutam nivrttistu mahabala" — Manu; Or activities have no fixed goal, Gf. Bhaga. 'vedoktam eva kurvano nissangarpitamisvarc/ naiskarmyani labhate siddbim rocanartha phalarutih //
verses.commentary: Sense: For those who are unattached activities arc not unavoidable. Gf. "pravrttir esa bhutam nivrttistu mahabala" — Manu; Or activities have no fixed goal, Gf. Bhaga. 'vedoktam eva kurvano nissangarpitamisvarc/ naiskarmyani labhate siddbim rocanartha phalarutih //

verses.sanskrit: हृदये गुह्यके चैव पादयोर्मूर्ध्नि वाचि वा कण्ठे चैव न्यसेदेव प्रणवादित्रिभेदतः
verses.transliteration: hṛdaye guhyake caiva pādayormūrdhni vāci vā kaṇṭhe caiva nyasedeva praṇavāditribhedataḥ
