verses.translation: trividhah jivah— the invidividual soul is threefold (See V-iB below ).
verses.hindi: संसारो द्विविधः प्रोक्तः स्वाधिकारानुरूपतः। तद्वशादेव सर्वेषां धर्माधमौ न संशयः
verses.wordMeaning: trividhah jivah— the invidividual soul is threefold (See V-iB below ).
verses.commentary: Sense: trividhah jivah— the invidividual soul is threefold (See V-iB below ).

verses.sanskrit: कृत्वाङ्गन्यासमेवं हि मुखानि परिकल्पयेत् पूर्वादि चोर्ध्वपर्यन्तं नकारादि यथाक्रमम्
verses.transliteration: kṛtvāṅganyāsamevaṃ hi mukhāni parikalpayet pūrvādi cordhvaparyantaṃ nakārādi yathākramam
verses.translation: §at-kausikam— snayvadi-§atko5a-yuktam ST. consistini of six coverings cf.
verses.hindi: अध्याय ८६ पाशुपतयोगज्ञानका स्वरूप तथा उसकी महिमा
verses.wordMeaning: §at-kausikam— snayvadi-§atko5a-yuktam ST. consistini of six coverings cf.
verses.commentary: Sense: §at-kausikam— snayvadi-§atko5a-yuktam ST. consistini of six coverings cf.

verses.sanskrit: षडङ्गानि न्यसेत्पश्चाद् यथास्थानं च शोभनम् नमः स्वाहा वषड्ढुं च वौषट्फट्कारकैः सह
verses.transliteration: ṣaḍaṅgāni nyasetpaścād yathāsthānaṃ ca śobhanam namaḥ svāhā vaṣaḍḍhuṃ ca vauṣaṭphaṭkārakaiḥ saha
verses.translation: O brahmins, if duly pondered over, good men have to face only misery through the contact with women and similar activities. The miserable try to quell one misery only by another misery.
verses.hindi: ससरत होनेपर संसार बाधित हो जाता है। उन्हीं (ईषणा बुद्धिमुत्पादयत्येव संसारे विदुषां द्विजाः॥ १२  और ज्ञान)-के वशमें होनेसे ही सभी लोगोंकी धर्म तथा अधर्ममें प्रवृत्ति होती है; इसमें सन्देह नहीं है
verses.wordMeaning: O brahmins, if duly pondered over, good men have to face only misery through the contact with women and similar activities. The miserable try to quell one misery only by another misery.
verses.commentary: Sense: O brahmins, if duly pondered over, good men have to face only misery through the contact with women and similar activities. The miserable try to quell one misery only by another misery.

verses.sanskrit: प्रणवं हृदयं विद्यान् नकारः शिर उच्यते शिखा मकार आख्यातः शिकारः कवचं तथा
verses.transliteration: praṇavaṃ hṛdayaṃ vidyān nakāraḥ śira ucyate śikhā makāra ākhyātaḥ śikāraḥ kavacaṃ tathā
verses.translation: Lust is never quelled by means of enjoyment of plea- sures. Just as fire blazes all the more by Havis (ghee offer- ing) so also lust is inflamed all the more by indulging into pleasure.'®
verses.hindi: हे ब्राह्मणो! पारलौकिक पदार्थके प्रत्यक्ष न रहनेपर भी शास्त्रके द्वारा उसके विषयमें श्रवण कर लेनेसे उसमें सज्जनं तथा विद्वानोंकी प्रवृत्ति हो जाती है। अतः जो इहलौकिक तथा पारलौकिक-इन दोनों
verses.wordMeaning: Lust is never quelled by means of enjoyment of plea- sures. Just as fire blazes all the more by Havis (ghee offer- ing) so also lust is inflamed all the more by indulging into pleasure.'®
verses.commentary: Sense: Lust is never quelled by means of enjoyment of plea- sures. Just as fire blazes all the more by Havis (ghee offer- ing) so also lust is inflamed all the more by indulging into pleasure.'®

verses.sanskrit: आकारो नेत्रमस्त्रं तु यकारः परिकीर्तितः इत्थमङ्गानि विन्यस्य ततो वै बन्धयेद्दिशः
verses.transliteration: ākāro netramastraṃ tu yakāraḥ parikīrtitaḥ itthamaṅgāni vinyasya tato vai bandhayeddiśaḥ
verses.translation: Hence, on pondering over, it will be seen that there is no happiness unto men even due to coitus. There is misery in earning wealth as also in preserving and spending it. O excellent brahmins, if we ponder over it, there is misery amongst the Piacas, Raksasas, Yaksas, Gandharvas, in the world of the moon, in the world of mercury, in the world of Prajapati, in the world of the Brahman, in the world of Prakrti and Purusa also. O sages of good holy rites, there are miseries due to destruction of possessions, due to one's possession being excelled by another's, etc. These cause only other miseries.
verses.hindi: पदार्थोको हेय समझकर पूर्ण प्रयत्नसे इनका परित्याग हे द्विजो! श्रुतिप्रतिपादित सकाम कमोँमें, जिसमें सबकी प्रवृत्ति है तथा वेदके मस्तकस्वरूप एवं मन्त्र- द्रष्टा ऋषियोंके सारस्वरूप निष्कामकर्मफलको प्रतिपादित करनेवाला जो अध्यात्मशास्त्र है, वही शास्त्र कहा जाता
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, on pondering over, it will be seen that there is no happiness unto men even due to coitus. There is misery in earning wealth as also in preserving and spending it. O excellent brahmins, if we ponder over it, there is misery amongst the Piacas, Raksasas, Yaksas,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, on pondering over, it will be seen that there is no happiness unto men even due to coitus. There is misery in earning wealth as also in preserving and spending it. O excellent brahmins, if we ponder over it, there is misery amongst the Piacas, Raksasas, Yaksas,…

verses.sanskrit: विघ्नेशो मातरो दुर्गा क्षेत्रज्ञो देवता दिशः आग्नेयादिषु कोणेषु चतुर्ष्वपि यथाक्रमम्
verses.transliteration: vighneśo mātaro durgā kṣetrajño devatā diśaḥ āgneyādiṣu koṇeṣu caturṣvapi yathākramam
verses.translation: One shall eschew those impure fortunes and riches. Hence, O sinless sages of good holy rites, all kinds of pleasures are really miseries to the discriminating person in whatever way you view them, viz., eightfold or sixteenfold or of twentyfour, thirty two, fortyeight, fiftysix, or sixtyfour types.
verses.hindi: जो श्रुतिके रहस्यको नहीं जानते हैं, वे ही ऐसा कहते हैं कि चूँकि सभी लोगोंका स्वभाव कामनामूलक दिखायी देता है, अतः श्रुति सकामकर्मकी ही प्रवर्तिका है
verses.wordMeaning: One shall eschew those impure fortunes and riches. Hence, O sinless sages of good holy rites, all kinds of pleasures are really miseries to the discriminating person in whatever way you view them, viz., eightfold or sixteenfold or of twentyfour, thirty two, fortyeight,…
verses.commentary: Sense: One shall eschew those impure fortunes and riches. Hence, O sinless sages of good holy rites, all kinds of pleasures are really miseries to the discriminating person in whatever way you view them, viz., eightfold or sixteenfold or of twentyfour, thirty two, fortyeight,…

verses.sanskrit: अङ्गुष्ठतर्जन्यग्राभ्यां संस्थाप्य सुमुखं शुभम् रक्षध्वमिति चोक्त्वा तु नमस्कुर्यात्पृथक्पृथक्
verses.transliteration: aṅguṣṭhatarjanyagrābhyāṃ saṃsthāpya sumukhaṃ śubham rakṣadhvamiti coktvā tu namaskuryātpṛthakpṛthak
verses.translation: The pleasures of the following types are undoubte- dly miseries if pondered over properly even to those yogins who talk of Brahman: — Parthiva (earthly), Apya (watery) Taijasa (fiery), Vayavya (gaseous), Vyauma (of the firmament), Manasa (mental), Abhimanika, (bringing pride), Bauddha'®® (intellectual), PrSkrta (pertaining to Prakrti).
verses.hindi: वास्तविक रूपमें विरक्त जनोंके लिये निष्कामकर्मका प्रतिपादन करनेमें ही श्रुतिका तात्पर्य है, अतः सभी देहधारियोके लिये संसार अज्ञानमूलक है। वेदोक्त निष्कामकर्मके द्वारा जीवभाव क्षीण होता है। अविद्यासे उत्पन्न जो अज्ञान है, उसके कारण सकामकर्मके वशीभूत तीन प्रकारका जीवभाव दृढ़ होता है
verses.wordMeaning: The pleasures of the following types are undoubte- dly miseries if pondered over properly even to those yogins who talk of Brahman: — Parthiva (earthly), Apya (watery) Taijasa (fiery), Vayavya (gaseous), Vyauma (of the firmament), Manasa (mental), Abhimanika, (bringing pride),…
verses.commentary: Sense: The pleasures of the following types are undoubte- dly miseries if pondered over properly even to those yogins who talk of Brahman: — Parthiva (earthly), Apya (watery) Taijasa (fiery), Vayavya (gaseous), Vyauma (of the firmament), Manasa (mental), Abhimanika, (bringing pride),…

verses.sanskrit: गले मध्ये तथाङ्गुष्ठे तर्जन्याद्याङ्गुलीषु च अङ्गुष्ठेन करन्यासं कुर्यादेव विचक्षणः
verses.transliteration: gale madhye tathāṅguṣṭhe tarjanyādyāṅgulīṣu ca aṅguṣṭhena karanyāsaṃ kuryādeva vicakṣaṇaḥ
verses.translation: The attributes (?) of the leaders of the Ganas are, on reflection, causes of misery. In all the worlds there is always misery in the beginning, in the middle and in the end. The present ones are miseries, the future ones are miseries. (?) In the lands defiled by faults, there are various kinds af miseries.
verses.hindi: पापकर्म करनेवाला नारकी होता है, पुण्यकर्म करनेवाला अपने पुण्यकी महिमाके कारण स्वर्गी होता है और पाप-पुण्यकर्मके मिश्रणवाला जीव उद्भिज, स्वेदज, अण्डज तथा जरायुज-इन चार रूपोंमें व्यवस्थित
verses.wordMeaning: The attributes (?) of the leaders of the Ganas are, on reflection, causes of misery. In all the worlds there is always misery in the beginning, in the middle and in the end. The present ones are miseries, the future ones are miseries. (?) In the lands defiled by faults,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The attributes (?) of the leaders of the Ganas are, on reflection, causes of misery. In all the worlds there is always misery in the beginning, in the middle and in the end. The present ones are miseries, the future ones are miseries. (?) In the lands defiled by faults,…

verses.sanskrit: एवं न्यासमिमं प्रोक्तं सर्वपापहरं शुभम् सर्वसिद्धिकरं पुण्यं सर्वरक्षाकरं शिवम्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ nyāsamimaṃ proktaṃ sarvapāpaharaṃ śubham sarvasiddhikaraṃ puṇyaṃ sarvarakṣākaraṃ śivam
verses.translation: bauddham prakrtam eva ca: the intellectual enjoymertt is also material.
verses.hindi: होता है। इस प्रकारसे व्यवस्थित वह अज्ञानी जीव अपने कर्मके कारण संसारचक्रसे मुक्त नहीं हो पाता है होती है; एकमात्र त्यागके द्वारा ही मुक्ति प्राप्त होती है  और उसके अभावके कारण यह जीव भ्रमण करता रहता है। इस प्रकार अज्ञानके दोषके कारण तथा अनेक
verses.wordMeaning: bauddham prakrtam eva ca: the intellectual enjoymertt is also material.
verses.commentary: Sense: bauddham prakrtam eva ca: the intellectual enjoymertt is also material.

verses.sanskrit: न्यस्ते मन्त्रे ऽथ सुभगे शङ्करप्रतिमो भवेत् जन्मान्तरकृतं पापम् अपि नश्यति तत्क्षणात्
verses.transliteration: nyaste mantre 'tha subhage śaṅkarapratimo bhavet janmāntarakṛtaṃ pāpam api naśyati tatkṣaṇāt
verses.translation: Just as the tree whose roots have been cut falls down to the ground helplessly so also the living being overwhelmed by various kinds of ailments, passion, hatred, fear, etc.®
verses.hindi: शास्त्रमित्युच्यतेऽभागं श्रुतेः कर्मसु तद् द्विजाः । मूर्धानं ब्रह्मणः सारं ऋषीणां कर्मणः फलम्
verses.wordMeaning: Just as the tree whose roots have been cut falls down to the ground helplessly so also the living being overwhelmed by various kinds of ailments, passion, hatred, fear, etc.®
verses.commentary: Sense: Just as the tree whose roots have been cut falls down to the ground helplessly so also the living being overwhelmed by various kinds of ailments, passion, hatred, fear, etc.®

verses.sanskrit: एवं विन्यस्य मेधावी शुद्धकायो दृढव्रतः जपेत्पञ्चाक्षरं मन्त्रं लब्ध्वाचार्यप्रसादतः
verses.transliteration: evaṃ vinyasya medhāvī śuddhakāyo dṛḍhavrataḥ japetpañcākṣaraṃ mantraṃ labdhvācāryaprasādataḥ
verses.translation: Similarly the heaven-dwellers fall down to the earth due to the destruction of the tree of merit. Even for heaven-dwellers who desire for things that cause misery and who are richly endowed with pleasures that cause misery, there is terrible misery when they fall from that heaven. There is definitely misery in the hell due to the fact that even religious students resort to it when they do not perform those rites that are laid down, O leading sages.
verses.hindi: ननु स्वभावः सर्वेषां कामो दूष्टो न चान्यथा। श्रुतिः प्रवर्तिका तेषामिति कर्मण्यतद्विदः निवृत्तिलक्षणो धर्मः समर्थानामिहोच्यते। तस्मादज्ञानमूलो हि संसारः सर्वदेहिनाम्
verses.wordMeaning: Similarly the heaven-dwellers fall down to the earth due to the destruction of the tree of merit. Even for heaven-dwellers who desire for things that cause misery and who are richly endowed with pleasures that cause misery,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Similarly the heaven-dwellers fall down to the earth due to the destruction of the tree of merit. Even for heaven-dwellers who desire for things that cause misery and who are richly endowed with pleasures that cause misery,…

verses.sanskrit: अतः परं प्रवक्ष्यामि मन्त्रसंग्रहणं शुभे यं विना निष्फलं नित्यं येन वा सफलं भवेत्
verses.transliteration: ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi mantrasaṃgrahaṇaṃ śubhe yaṃ vinā niṣphalaṃ nityaṃ yena vā saphalaṃ bhavet
verses.translation: Just as the deer frightened of death and uprooted from his habitation does not obtain sleep so also the noble-souled as- cetic engaged in meditation and frightened of the worldly existence does not obtain slumber.
verses.hindi: कला संशोषमायाति कर्मणान्यस्वभावतः। सकलस्त्रिविधो जीवो ज्ञानहीनस्त्वविद्यया
verses.wordMeaning: Just as the deer frightened of death and uprooted from his habitation does not obtain sleep so also the noble-souled as- cetic engaged in meditation and frightened of the worldly existence does not obtain slumber.
verses.commentary: Sense: Just as the deer frightened of death and uprooted from his habitation does not obtain sleep so also the noble-souled as- cetic engaged in meditation and frightened of the worldly existence does not obtain slumber.

verses.sanskrit: आज्ञाहीनं क्रियाहीनं श्रद्धाहीनम् अमानसम् आज्ञप्तं दक्षिणाहीनं सदा जप्तं च निष्फलम्
verses.transliteration: ājñāhīnaṃ kriyāhīnaṃ śraddhāhīnam amānasam ājñaptaṃ dakṣiṇāhīnaṃ sadā japtaṃ ca niṣphalam
verses.translation: Unhappiness is seen even in germs, birds, animals, deer, elephants and horses. Hence there is great happiness unto a man who renounces.
verses.hindi: नारकी पापकृत्स्वर्गी पुण्यकृत्पुण्यगौरवात्। व्यतिमिश्रेण वै जीवश्चतुर्धा संव्यवस्थितः एवं व्यवस्थितो देही कर्मणाज्ञो हानिर्वृतः
verses.wordMeaning: Unhappiness is seen even in germs, birds, animals, deer, elephants and horses. Hence there is great happiness unto a man who renounces.
verses.commentary: Sense: Unhappiness is seen even in germs, birds, animals, deer, elephants and horses. Hence there is great happiness unto a man who renounces.

verses.sanskrit: आज्ञासिद्धं क्रियासिद्धं श्रद्धासिद्धं सुमानसम् एवं च दक्षिणासिद्धं मन्त्रं सिद्धं यतस्ततः
verses.transliteration: ājñāsiddhaṃ kriyāsiddhaṃ śraddhāsiddhaṃ sumānasam evaṃ ca dakṣiṇāsiddhaṃ mantraṃ siddhaṃ yatastataḥ
verses.translation: O sages of good holy rites, there is misery unto even those officers on duty spread over the whole kalpa who move about in aerial chariots, unto Manu and others who take pride in their respective positions.
verses.hindi: प्रजया कर्मणा मुक्तिर्धनेन च सतां न हि। त्यागेनैकेन मुक्तिः स्यात्तदभावाद् भ्रमत्यसौ
verses.wordMeaning: O sages of good holy rites, there is misery unto even those officers on duty spread over the whole kalpa who move about in aerial chariots, unto Manu and others who take pride in their respective positions.
verses.commentary: Sense: O sages of good holy rites, there is misery unto even those officers on duty spread over the whole kalpa who move about in aerial chariots, unto Manu and others who take pride in their respective positions.

verses.sanskrit: उपागम्य गुरुं विप्रं मन्त्रतत्त्वार्थवेदिनम् ज्ञानिनं सद्गुणोपेतं ध्यानयोगपरायणम्
verses.transliteration: upāgamya guruṃ vipraṃ mantratattvārthavedinam jñāninaṃ sadguṇopetaṃ dhyānayogaparāyaṇam
verses.translation: The activities enjoined for the attainment of heaven are not
verses.hindi: एवमज्ञानदोषेण नानाकर्मवशेन च! षट्कौशिकं समुद्भूतं भजत्येष कलेवरम्  ० ० ० का नाममा.
verses.wordMeaning: The activities enjoined for the attainment of heaven are not
verses.commentary: Sense: The activities enjoined for the attainment of heaven are not

verses.sanskrit: तोषयेत्तं प्रयत्नेन भावशुद्धिसमन्वितः वाचा च मनसा चैव कायेन द्रविणेन च
verses.transliteration: toṣayettaṃ prayatnena bhāvaśuddhisamanvitaḥ vācā ca manasā caiva kāyena draviṇena ca
verses.translation: As soon as he has exhausted merit the heaven-dweller falls from
verses.hindi: गर्भे दुःखान्यनेकानि योनिमार्गे च भूतले।
verses.wordMeaning: As soon as he has exhausted merit the heaven-dweller falls from
verses.commentary: Sense: As soon as he has exhausted merit the heaven-dweller falls from

verses.sanskrit: आचार्यं पूजयेच्छिष्यः सर्वदातिप्रयत्नतः हस्त्यश्वरथरत्नानि क्षेत्राणि च गृहाणि च
verses.transliteration: ācāryaṃ pūjayecchiṣyaḥ sarvadātiprayatnataḥ hastyaśvaratharatnāni kṣetrāṇi ca gṛhāṇi ca
verses.translation: Devas and Daityas undergo misery due to their desire for mutual conquest. Even kings and Raksasas in the three worlds undergo misery.
verses.hindi: कौमारे यौवने चैव वार्धके मरणेऽपि वा दुःखेनैकेन वै दुःखं प्रशाम्यन्तीह दुःखिनः
verses.wordMeaning: Devas and Daityas undergo misery due to their desire for mutual conquest. Even kings and Raksasas in the three worlds undergo misery.
verses.commentary: Sense: Devas and Daityas undergo misery due to their desire for mutual conquest. Even kings and Raksasas in the three worlds undergo misery.

verses.sanskrit: भूषणानि च वासांसि धान्यानि विविधानि च एतानि गुरवे दद्याद् भक्त्या च विभवे सति
verses.transliteration: bhūṣaṇāni ca vāsāṃsi dhānyāni vividhāni ca etāni gurave dadyād bhaktyā ca vibhave sati
verses.translation: In fact the Aramas bring about only misery or exhaustion (rama) unto the different castes. People do not attain the Atman through Asramas (stages in life), Vedas, yajnas, Samkhyas, (numerical knowledge), vratas (holy rites), severe penances, different kinds of charitable gifts, etc. But people with knowledge obtain it. Hence, with all efforts one shall perform the Pasupata rite. In the holy rite of Pasu- pata, the learned devotee shall perpetually lie on bhasman, besmeared with ashes.
verses.hindi: न जातु कामः कामानामुपभोगेन शाम्यति।
verses.wordMeaning: In fact the Aramas bring about only misery or exhaustion (rama) unto the different castes. People do not attain the Atman through Asramas (stages in life), Vedas, yajnas, Samkhyas, (numerical knowledge), vratas (holy rites), severe penances, different kinds of charitable gifts,…
verses.commentary: Sense: In fact the Aramas bring about only misery or exhaustion (rama) unto the different castes. People do not attain the Atman through Asramas (stages in life), Vedas, yajnas, Samkhyas, (numerical knowledge), vratas (holy rites), severe penances, different kinds of charitable gifts,…

verses.sanskrit: वित्तशाठ्यं न कुर्वीत यदीच्छेत्सिद्धिमात्मनः पश्चान्निवेदयेद्देवि आत्मानं सपरिच्छदम्
verses.transliteration: vittaśāṭhyaṃ na kurvīta yadīcchetsiddhimātmanaḥ paścānnivedayeddevi ātmānaṃ saparicchadam
verses.translation: The learned devotee, richly endowed with the knowledge of the five objects and having great attention to- wards the principle of Siva shall adopt the yoga that causes salvation and destroys fate and karman and shall become intelligent and endowed v/ith the yoga of five objects. There- by he attains the end of misery. The devotees understand the knowable by means of Para Vidya'®* and not by Apara Vidya.
verses.hindi: पैशाचे राक्षसे दुःखं याक्षे चैव विचारतः। गान्धर्वे च तथा चान्द्रे सौम्यलोके द्विजोत्तमाः
verses.wordMeaning: The learned devotee, richly endowed with the knowledge of the five objects and having great attention to- wards the principle of Siva shall adopt the yoga that causes salvation and destroys fate and karman and shall become intelligent and endowed v/ith the yoga of five objects.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The learned devotee, richly endowed with the knowledge of the five objects and having great attention to- wards the principle of Siva shall adopt the yoga that causes salvation and destroys fate and karman and shall become intelligent and endowed v/ith the yoga of five objects.…

verses.sanskrit: एवं सम्पूज्य विधिवद् यथाशक्ति त्ववञ्चयन् आददीत गुरोर्मन्त्रं ज्ञानं चैव क्रमेण तु
verses.transliteration: evaṃ sampūjya vidhivad yathāśakti tvavañcayan ādadīta gurormantraṃ jñānaṃ caiva krameṇa tu
verses.translation: Two Vidyas (topics of knowledge) are to be known: Para and Apara, O excellent brahmins, Apara consists of Rg, Yajur, Sama, and Atharva Vedas. Siksa, Kalpa, grammar, semantics, prosody and astrology also constitute Apara Vidya.
verses.hindi: प्राजापत्ये तथा ब्राह्मो प्राकृते पौरुषे तथा।
verses.wordMeaning: Two Vidyas (topics of knowledge) are to be known: Para and Apara, O excellent brahmins, Apara consists of Rg, Yajur, Sama, and Atharva Vedas. Siksa, Kalpa, grammar, semantics, prosody and astrology also constitute Apara Vidya.
verses.commentary: Sense: Two Vidyas (topics of knowledge) are to be known: Para and Apara, O excellent brahmins, Apara consists of Rg, Yajur, Sama, and Atharva Vedas. Siksa, Kalpa, grammar, semantics, prosody and astrology also constitute Apara Vidya.

verses.sanskrit: एवं तुष्टो गुरुः शिष्यं पूजितं वत्सरोषितम् शुश्रूषुम् अनहङ्कारम् उपवासकृशं शुचिम्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ tuṣṭo guruḥ śiṣyaṃ pūjitaṃ vatsaroṣitam śuśrūṣum anahaṅkāram upavāsakṛśaṃ śucim
verses.translation: It has no touch, no form, no taste, no smell, no change, no support. It is perpetual, omnipresent and all-power- ful. It it great and massive. O brahmins, it is unborn and identical with cit (consciousness); it is devoid of Pranas (vital airs); it has no mind; it is non-emollient and it is devoid of blood. It is incomprehensible; it is neither stout nor long; it is
verses.hindi: चतुर्विशत्प्रकारेण संस्थितं चापि सुव्रताः । हात्रिंशद्भेदमनघाश्चत्वारिंशदगुणं पुनः तथाष्टचत्वारिंशच्य षट्पञ्चाशत्प्रकारतः। चतुःषष्टिविधं चैव दुःखमेव विवेकिनः
verses.wordMeaning: It has no touch, no form, no taste, no smell, no change, no support. It is perpetual, omnipresent and all-power- ful. It it great and massive. O brahmins, it is unborn and identical with cit (consciousness); it is devoid of Pranas (vital airs); it has no mind;…
verses.commentary: Sense: It has no touch, no form, no taste, no smell, no change, no support. It is perpetual, omnipresent and all-power- ful. It it great and massive. O brahmins, it is unborn and identical with cit (consciousness); it is devoid of Pranas (vital airs); it has no mind;…

verses.sanskrit: स्नापयित्वा तु शिष्याय ब्राह्मणानपि पूज्य च समुद्रतीरे नद्यां च गोष्ठे देवालये ऽपि वा
verses.transliteration: snāpayitvā tu śiṣyāya brāhmaṇānapi pūjya ca samudratīre nadyāṃ ca goṣṭhe devālaye 'pi vā
verses.translation: padc&rtha-yoga-fampaxmah— 'It can be interpreted as accom- panied by knowledge derived from the practice of the five-syllabled mantra 'namai iiv&ya*.
verses.hindi: दुःखमेव न सन्देहो योगिनां ब्रह्मवादिनाम्
verses.wordMeaning: padc&rtha-yoga-fampaxmah— 'It can be interpreted as accom- panied by knowledge derived from the practice of the five-syllabled mantra 'namai iiv&ya*.
verses.commentary: Sense: padc&rtha-yoga-fampaxmah— 'It can be interpreted as accom- panied by knowledge derived from the practice of the five-syllabled mantra 'namai iiv&ya*.

verses.sanskrit: शुचौ देशे गृहे वापि काले सिद्धिकरे तिथौ नक्षत्रे शुभयोगे च सर्वदा दोषवर्जिते
verses.transliteration: śucau deśe gṛhe vāpi kāle siddhikare tithau nakṣatre śubhayoge ca sarvadā doṣavarjite
verses.translation: pars vidy& — knowledge of Brahma as taught in the Upaniads,
verses.hindi: आदौ मध्ये तथा चान्ते सर्वलोकेषु सर्वदा कर्मोके वशीभूत होनेके कारण यह जीव छः कोशों (स्नायु, अस्थि, मज्जा, त्वचा, मांस, रक्त) -से इस शरीरको धारण करता है
verses.wordMeaning: pars vidy& — knowledge of Brahma as taught in the Upaniads,
verses.commentary: Sense: pars vidy& — knowledge of Brahma as taught in the Upaniads,

verses.sanskrit: अनुगृह्य ततो दद्याच् छिवज्ञानम् अनुत्तमम् स्वरेणोच्चारयेत् सम्यग् एकान्ते ऽपि प्रसन्नधीः
verses.transliteration: anugṛhya tato dadyāc chivajñānam anuttamam svareṇoccārayet samyag ekānte 'pi prasannadhīḥ
verses.translation: apar& vidy&-- knowledge of the ritual as taught in the Srauta and Cthya Sutras,
verses.hindi: युवावस्थामें, वृद्धावस्थामें और मृत्युके समय ५ अनेक दुःख होते हैं। है द्विजो! विचारपूर्वक देखा जाय तो स्त्रीसंसर्ग आदिसे ही सज्जनोंको दुःख उत्पन्न होता है; वे एक दुःखसे दूसरे दुःखको शान्त करना चाहते
verses.wordMeaning: apar& vidy&-- knowledge of the ritual as taught in the Srauta and Cthya Sutras,
verses.commentary: Sense: apar& vidy&-- knowledge of the ritual as taught in the Srauta and Cthya Sutras,

verses.sanskrit: उच्चार्योच्चारयित्वा तु आचार्यः सिद्धिदः स्वयम् शिवं चास्तु शुभं चास्तु शोभनो ऽस्तु प्रियो ऽस्त्विति
verses.transliteration: uccāryoccārayitvā tu ācāryaḥ siddhidaḥ svayam śivaṃ cāstu śubhaṃ cāstu śobhano 'stu priyo 'stviti
verses.translation: But these Para and Apara are not the real. I alone am identical with the universe; the universe is in me alone.
verses.hindi: हैं और दुःखी होते रहते हैं। विषयोंके उपभोगसे कामकी शान्ति कभी नहीं होती है; जैसे हविसे अग्नि बढ़ती है, वैसे ही वह वासना निरन्तर बढ़ती ही जाती है॥ २२--२४॥ अत: विचार किया जाय तो मनुष्योंको विषयोंके प्राप्त होनेपर भी सुख नहीं प्राप्त होता है। धनके अर्जनमें, उसको सुरक्षा करनेमें तथा व्ययमें भी दुःख है। है श्रेष्ठ ब्राह्मणो! विचार करनेपर देखा जाय, तो पिशाचलोक,
verses.wordMeaning: But these Para and Apara are not the real. I alone am identical with the universe; the universe is in me alone.
verses.commentary: Sense: But these Para and Apara are not the real. I alone am identical with the universe; the universe is in me alone.

verses.sanskrit: एवं लब्ध्वा परं मन्त्रं ज्ञानं चैव गुरोस्ततः जपेन्नित्यं ससंकल्पं पुरश्चरणमेव च
verses.transliteration: evaṃ labdhvā paraṃ mantraṃ jñānaṃ caiva gurostataḥ japennityaṃ sasaṃkalpaṃ puraścaraṇameva ca
verses.translation: Everything originates from me, stays within me and gets dissolved in me; there is nothing different from me. This shall be realised mentally, verbally and physically. The devotee shall with concentration sec everything: the 'sat' (the existent) and the 'asat' (the non-existent), in the Atman. One seeing everything in the Atman does not allow the mind to stray to other objects.
verses.hindi: राक्षसलोक, यक्षलोक, गन्धर्वलोक, चन्द्रलोक, बुधलोक, प्रजापतिलोक, ब्राह्मलोक और प्रकृतिलोक तथा पुरुषलोकमें भी भोगोंके नाशको सम्भावनासे तथा एक-दूसरेसे श्रेष्ठ होनेके कारण ईर्ष्याजन्य दुःखोंसे वे भी दुःखी ही रहते
verses.wordMeaning: Everything originates from me, stays within me and gets dissolved in me; there is nothing different from me. This shall be realised mentally, verbally and physically.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Everything originates from me, stays within me and gets dissolved in me; there is nothing different from me. This shall be realised mentally, verbally and physically.…

verses.sanskrit: यावज्जीवं जपेन्नित्यम् अष्टोत्तरसहस्रकम् अनश्नंस्तत्परो भूत्वा स याति परमां गतिम्
verses.transliteration: yāvajjīvaṃ japennityam aṣṭottarasahasrakam anaśnaṃstatparo bhūtvā sa yāti paramāṃ gatim
verses.translation: On lowering the vision, one shall see the Atman stationed in Vitasti above the umbilicus in the heart, the abode of the universe.
verses.hindi: हैं। अतः है सुव्रतो! भाग्यसे प्राप्त अशुद्ध भोगों तथा अशुद्ध धनोंका त्याग कर देना चाहिए; है सुव्रतो! चाहे वह भोग (सुख) आठ प्रकारका हो, अथवा सोलह प्रकारका हो, अथवा चौबीस प्रकारका हो, अथवा बत्तीस प्रकारका हो, अथवा चालीस प्रकारका हो, अथवा अड़तालीस प्रकारका हो, अथवा छप्पन प्रकारका हो अथवा चौसठ प्रकारका हो,” विवेकयुक्त व्यक्तिके लिये भोग दुःखरूप ही होता है॥ २५--३०॥
verses.wordMeaning: On lowering the vision, one shall see the Atman stationed in Vitasti above the umbilicus in the heart, the abode of the universe.
verses.commentary: Sense: On lowering the vision, one shall see the Atman stationed in Vitasti above the umbilicus in the heart, the abode of the universe.

verses.sanskrit: जपेदक्षरलक्षं वै चतुर्गुणितमादरात् नक्ताशी संयमी यश् च पौरश्चरणिकः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: japedakṣaralakṣaṃ vai caturguṇitamādarāt naktāśī saṃyamī yaś ca pauraścaraṇikaḥ smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: It sees mostly and in due order on being united Avith Prana, etc. O leading sages, each of the veins (Nadis) carries the ten Pranas (vital airs). Altogether there arc seventy- wo thousand Naejis. The Jagrat (waking stage) is stati- oned in the eyes, the svapna (dream stage) in the neck; the susupta (sleeping stage) in the heart and turiya (the fourth above the three) in the head. The presiding deity in the jagrat state is brahma; in Svapna Visnu; Is vara in Susupta and in Turiya Mahevara. Others say as follows when the person is in full possession of his senses and organs it is called Jagrat; when only the four organs, mind, intellect, ego and citta function, it is Svapna. O sages of good holy rites, when the organs and senses are merged into the Atman
verses.hindi: अग्निसम्बन्धी, वायुसम्बन्धी, आकाशसम्बन्धी, मनसम्बन्धी, अहंकारसम्बन्धी, बुद्धिसम्बन्धी तथा प्रकृतिसम्बन्धी भोग भी ब्रह्मवादी योगियोंके लिये दुःख ही हैं; इसमें सब्देह
verses.wordMeaning: It sees mostly and in due order on being united Avith Prana, etc. O leading sages, each of the veins (Nadis) carries the ten Pranas (vital airs). Altogether there arc seventy- wo thousand Naejis. The Jagrat (waking stage) is stati- oned in the eyes,…
verses.commentary: Sense: It sees mostly and in due order on being united Avith Prana, etc. O leading sages, each of the veins (Nadis) carries the ten Pranas (vital airs). Altogether there arc seventy- wo thousand Naejis. The Jagrat (waking stage) is stati- oned in the eyes,…

verses.sanskrit: पुरश्चरणजापी वा अपि वा नित्यजापकः अचिरात्सिद्धिकाङ्क्षी तु तयोरन्यतरो भवेत्
verses.transliteration: puraścaraṇajāpī vā api vā nityajāpakaḥ acirātsiddhikāṅkṣī tu tayoranyataro bhavet
verses.translation: para vidy& anyathfi na— anya-prakirena vanjitum aSakyS Cf. "yato vSeo nivartante.*'
verses.hindi: नहीं है। विचारपूर्वक देखा जाय, तो गणेश्वरोंके गु -  अष्टक पार्थिव आदि सुखभोग (ऐश्‍वर्य) से लेकर चेक (खळा उ हर पग अध्य अष्टगुणयुक्त पार्थिव आदि सुखभोग (ऐश्वर्य)-से लेकर चौंसठ प्रकारके सुखभोग (ऐश्वर्य) इसी लिङ्गपुराणे पूर्वभाग अध्या"
verses.wordMeaning: para vidy& anyathfi na— anya-prakirena vanjitum aSakyS Cf. "yato vSeo nivartante.*'
verses.commentary: Sense: para vidy& anyathfi na— anya-prakirena vanjitum aSakyS Cf. "yato vSeo nivartante.*'

verses.sanskrit: यः पुरश्चरणं कृत्वा नित्यजापी भवेन्नरः तस्य नास्ति समो लोके स सिद्धः सिद्धिदो वशी
verses.transliteration: yaḥ puraścaraṇaṃ kṛtvā nityajāpī bhavennaraḥ tasya nāsti samo loke sa siddhaḥ siddhido vaśī
verses.translation: The four states Jagrat (wakefulness), Svapna (dream), Suupti (slumber) and Turiya (the fourth) have been mentioned. I shall now describe the Adhibhautika, Adhyatmika and Adhidaivika terms, O leading brahmins. It should be known by the learned that all these are I myself. O great sages, the Adhyatmika (organic) is said to be fourteen in all, viz., the sense organs (five), the organs of action (five) and the mind, intellect, ego, and will (four).
verses.hindi: ९ में विस्तारसे बताये गये हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: The four states Jagrat (wakefulness), Svapna (dream), Suupti (slumber) and Turiya (the fourth) have been mentioned. I shall now describe the Adhibhautika, Adhyatmika and Adhidaivika terms, O leading brahmins. It should be known by the learned that all these are I myself.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The four states Jagrat (wakefulness), Svapna (dream), Suupti (slumber) and Turiya (the fourth) have been mentioned. I shall now describe the Adhibhautika, Adhyatmika and Adhidaivika terms, O leading brahmins. It should be known by the learned that all these are I myself.…

verses.sanskrit: आसनं रुचिरं बद्ध्वा मौनी चैकाग्रमानसः प्राङ्मुखोदङ्मुखो वापि जपेन्मन्त्रमनुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: āsanaṃ ruciraṃ baddhvā maunī caikāgramānasaḥ prāṅmukhodaṅmukho vāpi japenmantramanuttamam
verses.translation: The following are fourteen NaIs (tubular vessels), viz.— Rajfti, Sudarfana, Jita, Saumya, Mogha, Rudra, Mrta, (Amrta), Satya, Madhyama, Na(jhra, Stfuka, Asura, Krttika and Bhasvatl.
verses.hindi: ध्यावे 2६ पाशुपतयोगञ्चानका स्वरूप तथा उसकी महिमा bs वर्तमानानि दुःखानि भविष्याणि यथातथम्। वास्तवमें दुःख ही हैं। समस्त लोकोंमें प्रारम्भ, दोषदुष्टेषु देशेषु दुःखानि विविधानि च॥ ३४  मध्य तथा अन्तमें सर्वदा दुःख ही है । वास्तवमें वर्तमानमें भी दु:ख है और भविष्यमें भी दुःख होंगे। दोषोंसे ग्रस्त सभी देशोंमें अनेक प्रकारके दुःख हैं; अपनेको ज्ञानी
verses.wordMeaning: The following are fourteen NaIs (tubular vessels), viz.— Rajfti, Sudarfana, Jita, Saumya, Mogha, Rudra, Mrta, (Amrta), Satya, Madhyama, Na(jhra, Stfuka, Asura, Krttika and Bhasvatl.
verses.commentary: Sense: The following are fourteen NaIs (tubular vessels), viz.— Rajfti, Sudarfana, Jita, Saumya, Mogha, Rudra, Mrta, (Amrta), Satya, Madhyama, Na(jhra, Stfuka, Asura, Krttika and Bhasvatl.

verses.sanskrit: आद्यान्तयोर् जपस्यापि कुर्याद्वै प्राणसंयमान् तथा चान्ते जपेद्बीजं शतमष्टोत्तरं शुभम्
verses.transliteration: ādyāntayor japasyāpi kuryādvai prāṇasaṃyamān tathā cānte japedbījaṃ śatamaṣṭottaraṃ śubham
verses.translation: There are fourteen carrying winds'®® stationed in the middle of Na(s: — Thcy arc Prma, Vya, Apana, Udana, Samana, Vairambha, the important Antarya, Prabhahjana, Kurmaka, Syena, Sveta, Kr§na, Anila and Naga.
verses.hindi: समझनेवाले कुछ लोग अज्ञानके कारण अतीतका स्मरण नहीं करते हैं। जिस प्रकार औषधि रोगोंके उपचारके लिये होती है; न कि सुखके लिये, उसी प्रकार आहारको भूखरूपी रोगको दूर करनेके लिये बताया गया
verses.wordMeaning: There are fourteen carrying winds'®® stationed in the middle of Na(s: — Thcy arc Prma, Vya, Apana, Udana, Samana, Vairambha, the important Antarya, Prabhahjana, Kurmaka, Syena, Sveta, Kr§na, Anila and Naga.
verses.commentary: Sense: There are fourteen carrying winds'®® stationed in the middle of Na(s: — Thcy arc Prma, Vya, Apana, Udana, Samana, Vairambha, the important Antarya, Prabhahjana, Kurmaka, Syena, Sveta, Kr§na, Anila and Naga.

verses.sanskrit: चत्वारिंशत्समावृत्ति प्राणानायम्य संस्मरेत् पञ्चाक्षरस्य मन्त्रस्य प्राणायाम उदाहृतः
verses.transliteration: catvāriṃśatsamāvṛtti prāṇānāyamya saṃsmaret pañcākṣarasya mantrasya prāṇāyāma udāhṛtaḥ
verses.translation: The omniscient Being is only one. There is only one lord of all. He is the overlord of all. He is the immanent soul of great lustre.
verses.hindi: है, न कि सुखके लिये। शीत, ताप, वायु, वर्षा आदिके द्वारा उन-उन कालोंमें शरीरधारिंयोंको दुःख ही होता है, इसमें सन्देह नहीं है; किंतु अज्ञानी लोग इसे नहीं समझ पाते हैं॥ ३१--३६ /२॥ हे श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! इसी प्रकार स्वर्गमें भी लोग पुण्यके क्षय आदि दुःखोंसे तथा राग, द्वेष, भय आदि नानाविध रोगोंसे ग्रस्त होते हैं। जैसे जड़से कटा हुआ वृक्ष विवश होकर पृथ्वीपर गिर जाता है, वैसे ही स्वर्गमें
verses.wordMeaning: The omniscient Being is only one. There is only one lord of all. He is the overlord of all. He is the immanent soul of great lustre.
verses.commentary: Sense: The omniscient Being is only one. There is only one lord of all. He is the overlord of all. He is the immanent soul of great lustre.

verses.sanskrit: प्राणायामाद्भवेत्क्षिप्रं सर्वपापपरिक्षयः इन्द्रियाणां वशित्वं च तस्मात्प्राणांश् च संयमेत्
verses.transliteration: prāṇāyāmādbhavetkṣipraṃ sarvapāpaparikṣayaḥ indriyāṇāṃ vaśitvaṃ ca tasmātprāṇāṃś ca saṃyamet
verses.translation: On being worshipped, the eternal lord grants happi- ness. O excellent brahmins, if one does not worship him one does not attain happiness.®®
verses.hindi: रहनेवाले भी पुण्यरूपी वृक्षके क्षय होनेसे पृथ्वीपर पुनः आ जाते हैं। दु:खमय कामनाओंसे युक्त तथा दुःखमय भोगसम्पदासे परिपूर्ण स्वर्गवासी देवताओं-को भी इस स्वर्गसे पतित होनेपर दुःख तथा कष्ट ही होता है।
verses.wordMeaning: On being worshipped, the eternal lord grants happi- ness. O excellent brahmins, if one does not worship him one does not attain happiness.®®
verses.commentary: Sense: On being worshipped, the eternal lord grants happi- ness. O excellent brahmins, if one does not worship him one does not attain happiness.®®

verses.sanskrit: गृहे जपः समं विद्याद् गोष्ठे शतगुणं भवेत् नद्यां शतसहस्रं तु अनन्तः शिवसन्निधौ
verses.transliteration: gṛhe japaḥ samaṃ vidyād goṣṭhe śataguṇaṃ bhavet nadyāṃ śatasahasraṃ tu anantaḥ śivasannidhau
verses.translation: He is being worshipped by the Vedas and other scrip- tures. But this omniscient lord does not go unto them for succour.
verses.hindi: हे श्रेष्ठ मुनियो ! शास्त्रोचित कर्मको न करनेसे विभिन्न वर्णके लोगोंको नरकोंमें पड्नेके कारण वहाँ दुःख ही भोगना पड़ता है जैसे उजड़े हुए निवासवाला मृग मृत्युसे भयभीत होकर निद्रा ग्रहण नहीं कर पाता, उसी प्रकार
verses.wordMeaning: He is being worshipped by the Vedas and other scrip- tures. But this omniscient lord does not go unto them for succour.
verses.commentary: Sense: He is being worshipped by the Vedas and other scrip- tures. But this omniscient lord does not go unto them for succour.

verses.sanskrit: समुद्रतीरे देवह्रदे गिरौ देवालयेषु च पुण्याश्रमेषु सर्वेषु जपः कोटिगुणो भवेत्
verses.transliteration: samudratīre devahrade girau devālayeṣu ca puṇyāśrameṣu sarveṣu japaḥ koṭiguṇo bhavet
verses.translation: This visible universe is his Anna'®® (food). He does not become the Anna himself (unto anyone else). Nowhere docs one devour Anna guarded by one's own self.
verses.hindi: निद्रा ग्रहण नहीं कर पाता अर्थात् प्रमादरहित होकर सर्वथा सजग रहता है
verses.wordMeaning: This visible universe is his Anna'®® (food). He does not become the Anna himself (unto anyone else). Nowhere docs one devour Anna guarded by one's own self.
verses.commentary: Sense: This visible universe is his Anna'®® (food). He does not become the Anna himself (unto anyone else). Nowhere docs one devour Anna guarded by one's own self.

verses.sanskrit: शिवस्य संनिधाने च सूर्यस्याग्रे गुरोरपि दीपस्य गोर्जलस्यापि जपकर्म प्रशस्यते
verses.transliteration: śivasya saṃnidhāne ca sūryasyāgre gurorapi dīpasya gorjalasyāpi japakarma praśasyate
verses.translation: I am the food taken in by the living beings everywhere. I am the knot of the living beings and I bring about all great things. I am five-fold Atman divided into several parts.
verses.hindi: कीटों, पक्षियों, मृगों, घोड़ा-हाथी आदि पशुओंमें भी सर्वदा दुःख ही देखा गया है; अतः भोगका त्याग  करनेवालेको उत्तम सुख प्राप्त होता है । है सुत्रतो ! वैमानिक अभिमान करनेवाले मनु आदिको भी दुःख प्राप्त होता है। तीनों लोकोंमें एक-दूसरेको जीतनेको इच्छाके कारण
verses.wordMeaning: I am the food taken in by the living beings everywhere. I am the knot of the living beings and I bring about all great things. I am five-fold Atman divided into several parts.
verses.commentary: Sense: I am the food taken in by the living beings everywhere. I am the knot of the living beings and I bring about all great things. I am five-fold Atman divided into several parts.

verses.sanskrit: अङ्गुलीजपसंख्यानम् एकमेकं शुभानने रेखैरष्टगुणं प्रोक्तं पुत्रजीवफलैर् दश
verses.transliteration: aṅgulījapasaṃkhyānam ekamekaṃ śubhānane rekhairaṣṭaguṇaṃ proktaṃ putrajīvaphalair daśa
verses.translation: I am the soul of the living beings identical with Anna. What is taken in is called Anna. I am the soul of the sense-organs identical with Prana (vital breaths). I am the soul of mental conceptions identical with the mind.
verses.hindi: शीतोष्णवातवर्षाद्यैस्तत्तत्कालेषु देहिनाम्
verses.wordMeaning: I am the soul of the living beings identical with Anna. What is taken in is called Anna. I am the soul of the sense-organs identical with Prana (vital breaths). I am the soul of mental conceptions identical with the mind.
verses.commentary: Sense: I am the soul of the living beings identical with Anna. What is taken in is called Anna. I am the soul of the sense-organs identical with Prana (vital breaths). I am the soul of mental conceptions identical with the mind.

verses.sanskrit: शतं वै शङ्खमणिभिः प्रवालैश् च सहस्रकम् स्फाटिकैर् दशसाहस्रं मौक्तिकैर्लक्षमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: śataṃ vai śaṅkhamaṇibhiḥ pravālaiś ca sahasrakam sphāṭikair daśasāhasraṃ mauktikairlakṣamucyate
verses.translation: As Soma I am Kalatman (the soul of Time), identi- cal with Vijfiana (perfect knowledge). As Mahesa Paramesvara I become identical with Ananda ( Bliss ).'®
verses.hindi: स्वर्गेऽप्येवं मुनिश्रेष्ठा ह्यविशुद्धक्षयादिभिः नरके दुःखमेवात्र नरकाणां निषेवणात्
verses.wordMeaning: As Soma I am Kalatman (the soul of Time), identi- cal with Vijfiana (perfect knowledge). As Mahesa Paramesvara I become identical with Ananda ( Bliss ).'®
verses.commentary: Sense: As Soma I am Kalatman (the soul of Time), identi- cal with Vijfiana (perfect knowledge). As Mahesa Paramesvara I become identical with Ananda ( Bliss ).'®

verses.sanskrit: पद्माक्षैर्दशलक्षं तु सौवर्णैः कोटिरुच्यते कुशग्रन्थ्या च रुद्राक्षैर् अनन्तगुणमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: padmākṣairdaśalakṣaṃ tu sauvarṇaiḥ koṭirucyate kuśagranthyā ca rudrākṣair anantaguṇamucyate
verses.translation: Thus I am the entire universe and everything is stationed in me. I am independent but everything is depend- ent on me. This can be understood on pondering over the real form of various things.
verses.hindi: विहिताकरणाच्चैव वर्णिनां मुनिपुङ्गवाः
verses.wordMeaning: Thus I am the entire universe and everything is stationed in me. I am independent but everything is depend- ent on me. This can be understood on pondering over the real form of various things.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus I am the entire universe and everything is stationed in me. I am independent but everything is depend- ent on me. This can be understood on pondering over the real form of various things.

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चविंशति मोक्षार्थं सप्तविंशति पौष्टिकम् त्रिंशच्च धनसंपत्त्यै पञ्चाशच्चाभिचारिकम्
verses.transliteration: pañcaviṃśati mokṣārthaṃ saptaviṃśati pauṣṭikam triṃśacca dhanasaṃpattyai pañcāśaccābhicārikam
verses.translation: Even the state of being one (i.e. ekatva) is not present
verses.hindi: कीटपक्षिमृगाणां च पशूनां गजवाजिनाम्। दृष्टमेवासुखं तस्मात्त्यजतः सुखमुत्तमम् वैमानिकानामप्येवं दुःखं कल्पाधिकारिणाम्।
verses.wordMeaning: Even the state of being one (i.e. ekatva) is not present
verses.commentary: Sense: Even the state of being one (i.e. ekatva) is not present

verses.sanskrit: तत्पूर्वाभिमुखं वश्यं दक्षिणं चाभिचारिकम् पश्चिमं धनदं विद्याद् उत्तरं शान्तिकं भवेत्
verses.transliteration: tatpūrvābhimukhaṃ vaśyaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ cābhicārikam paścimaṃ dhanadaṃ vidyād uttaraṃ śāntikaṃ bhavet
verses.translation: The lord is the source of food for others but he has no source of food for himself. Of. Bhagavadgitai
verses.hindi: देवानां चैव हैत्यानामन्योन्यविजिगीषया। दुःखमेव नृपाणां च राक्षसानां जगत्त्रये
verses.wordMeaning: The lord is the source of food for others but he has no source of food for himself. Of. Bhagavadgitai
verses.commentary: Sense: The lord is the source of food for others but he has no source of food for himself. Of. Bhagavadgitai

verses.sanskrit: अङ्गुष्ठं मोक्षदं विद्यात् तर्जनी शत्रुनाशनी मध्यमा धनदा शान्तिं करोत्येषा ह्य् अनामिका
verses.transliteration: aṅguṣṭhaṃ mokṣadaṃ vidyāt tarjanī śatrunāśanī madhyamā dhanadā śāntiṃ karotyeṣā hy anāmikā
verses.translation: The Atman is neither Antaljprajha (having intellec- tual awareness within) nor Bahihprajna (having the intellectual awareness without) nor is He in both ways(Ubhayatahprajna). He is not Prajfianaghana (solid in perfect knowledge) nor Prajha (wise being) nor Ajhanapurvaka (having ignorance).
verses.hindi: आश्रमैर्न च देवैश्च यज्ञः सांख्ये्त्रतेस्तथा ॥ पञ्चार्थज्ञानसम्पन्नः शिवतत्त्वे समाहितः।
verses.wordMeaning: The Atman is neither Antaljprajha (having intellec- tual awareness within) nor Bahihprajna (having the intellectual awareness without) nor is He in both ways(Ubhayatahprajna).…
verses.commentary: Sense: The Atman is neither Antaljprajha (having intellec- tual awareness within) nor Bahihprajna (having the intellectual awareness without) nor is He in both ways(Ubhayatahprajna).…

verses.sanskrit: कनिष्ठा रक्षणीया सा जपकर्मणि शोभने अङ्गुष्ठेन जपेज्जप्यम् अन्यैरङ्गुलिभिः सह
verses.transliteration: kaniṣṭhā rakṣaṇīyā sā japakarmaṇi śobhane aṅguṣṭhena japejjapyam anyairaṅgulibhiḥ saha
verses.translation: Brahman is not one that is known nor one to be known. In fact it is Nirvana (extinction, Kaivalya, Nihreyasa. Anamaya (devoid of ailments), Amrta (immortal), Aksara imperishable, Brahman, Parama Atman, Paratpara (greater than the greatest), Nirvikalpa (devoid oi doubtful alternatives), Nirabhasa (devoid of fallacious appearances), Jhana (know- ledge); all these are synonyms (for perfect knowledge).
verses.hindi: कैवल्यकरणं योगविधिकर्मच्छिदं बुधः
verses.wordMeaning: Brahman is not one that is known nor one to be known. In fact it is Nirvana (extinction, Kaivalya, Nihreyasa. Anamaya (devoid of ailments), Amrta (immortal), Aksara imperishable, Brahman, Parama Atman, Paratpara (greater than the greatest),…
verses.commentary: Sense: Brahman is not one that is known nor one to be known. In fact it is Nirvana (extinction, Kaivalya, Nihreyasa. Anamaya (devoid of ailments), Amrta (immortal), Aksara imperishable, Brahman, Parama Atman, Paratpara (greater than the greatest),…

verses.sanskrit: अङ्गुष्ठेन विना कर्म कृतं तदफलं यतः शृणुष्व सर्वयज्ञेभ्यो जपयज्ञो विशिष्यते
verses.transliteration: aṅguṣṭhena vinā karma kṛtaṃ tadaphalaṃ yataḥ śṛṇuṣva sarvayajñebhyo japayajño viśiṣyate
verses.translation: When it is pleased and concentrated in a single form it is known as Jhana (Perfect knowledge). Everything else is Ajhana ( Ignorance). No doubt need be entertained in this regard.
verses.hindi: शिक्षा कल्पो व्याकरणं निरुक्तं छन्द एव च दुःख प्राप्त होता है ॥ ४३--४५ ॥ वस्तुतः समस्त वर्णोके आश्रम भी दुःख ही देते हैं। लोग आश्रमों, देवों, छ.” ब्रतों, विविध कठोर तपों तथा अनेक प्रकारके दनो
verses.wordMeaning: When it is pleased and concentrated in a single form it is known as Jhana (Perfect knowledge). Everything else is Ajhana ( Ignorance). No doubt need be entertained in this regard.
verses.commentary: Sense: When it is pleased and concentrated in a single form it is known as Jhana (Perfect knowledge). Everything else is Ajhana ( Ignorance). No doubt need be entertained in this regard.

verses.sanskrit: हिंसया ते प्रवर्तन्ते जपयज्ञो न हिंसया यावन्तः कर्मयज्ञाः स्युः प्रदानानि तपांसि च
verses.transliteration: hiṃsayā te pravartante japayajño na hiṃsayā yāvantaḥ karmayajñāḥ syuḥ pradānāni tapāṃsi ca
verses.translation: Perfect clear knowledge certainly originates from contact with the preceptor. It is uncontaminated by lust, hat- red, falsehood, anger, passion, covetousness and the like. It should be known as the bestower of salvation. Since the man has the impurity of ignorance he is contaminated. Salvation takes place only when impurity is dispelled and not otherwise, even if one takes a crore of births. Without perfect knowledge'® neither merit nor demerit is destroyed. Hence, O most excellent ones among the knowers of the Brahman, practise knowledge alone as the means of liberation. It is only by practice of per- fect knowledge that the intellect cf men becomes free from impurities.
verses.hindi: भी आत्मतत्त्व नहीं प्राप्त करते; अपितु ज्ञानवान् लोग स्वतः प्राप्त कर लेते हैं, अत: यलो पाशा करना चाहिए। बुद्धिमानको पाशुपतत्रतमें स्थित जच का क क पत । नित्य भस्मशायी होना ता चाहिए । संदोजाताद सोके
verses.wordMeaning: Perfect clear knowledge certainly originates from contact with the preceptor. It is uncontaminated by lust, hat- red, falsehood, anger, passion, covetousness and the like. It should be known as the bestower of salvation.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Perfect clear knowledge certainly originates from contact with the preceptor. It is uncontaminated by lust, hat- red, falsehood, anger, passion, covetousness and the like. It should be known as the bestower of salvation.…

verses.sanskrit: सर्वे ते जपयज्ञस्य कलां नार्हन्ति षोडशीम् माहात्म्यं वाचिकस्यैव जपयज्ञस्य कीर्तितम्
verses.transliteration: sarve te japayajñasya kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm māhātmyaṃ vācikasyaiva japayajñasya kīrtitam
verses.translation: Hence, one shall always practise perfect know- ledge having that as the foundation and the ultimate goal. O leading brahmins, a yogin who is satiated with knowledge
verses.hindi: अर्थ-ज्ञानसे सम्पन्न तथा शिवतत्वं समाहित बुद्ध शिवतत्त्वमें समाहित र व्यक्तिको मुक्तिदायक तथा कर्मका नाश फि पथा कमका नारा पाशुपत योगका आश्रय लेना चाहिए । पंचार्थयोगसे युक्त विद्वान् दुःखके अन्तको प्राप्त होता है भक्तजन परा विद्यासे ही ज्ञान प्राप्त करते हैं, अपरा विद्यासे नहीं। परा तथा अपरा--ये दो प्रकारकी विद्याएँ कही गयी हैं । है श्रेष्ठ ब्राहमणो ! ऋग्वेद, यजुर्वेद, सामवेद, सभी अर्थोको सिद्ध करनेवाला अथर्ववेद, शिक्षा, कल्प,
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, one shall always practise perfect know- ledge having that as the foundation and the ultimate goal. O leading brahmins, a yogin who is satiated with knowledge
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, one shall always practise perfect know- ledge having that as the foundation and the ultimate goal. O leading brahmins, a yogin who is satiated with knowledge

verses.sanskrit: तस्माच्छतगुणोपांशुः सहस्रो मानसः स्मृतः यद् उच्चनीचस्वरितैः शब्दैः स्पष्टपदाक्षरैः
verses.transliteration: tasmācchataguṇopāṃśuḥ sahasro mānasaḥ smṛtaḥ yad uccanīcasvaritaiḥ śabdaiḥ spaṣṭapadākṣaraiḥ
verses.translation: ekatvam api nSsti — The terms ckatva (singleness), etc., are relative and hence, they shall be avoided in regard to the exposition of Brahman.
verses.hindi: व्याकरण, निरुक्त, छन्द और ज्योतिष--ये अपरा विद्या हैं। परा विद्या अक्षररूपमें स्थित है । है श्रेष्ठ ब्राह्मणो! वह अदृश्य, अग्राह्य, गोत्ररहित, वर्णरहित, नेत्र-कान-हाथ- पैर आदिसे रहित, अजात, अभूत तथा शब्दविहीन है। हे
verses.wordMeaning: ekatvam api nSsti — The terms ckatva (singleness), etc., are relative and hence, they shall be avoided in regard to the exposition of Brahman.
verses.commentary: Sense: ekatvam api nSsti — The terms ckatva (singleness), etc., are relative and hence, they shall be avoided in regard to the exposition of Brahman.

verses.sanskrit: मन्त्रमुच्चारयेद्वाचा जपयज्ञः स वाचिकः शनैरुच्चारयेन्मन्त्रम् ईषद् ओष्ठौ तु चालयेत्
verses.transliteration: mantramuccārayedvācā japayajñaḥ sa vācikaḥ śanairuccārayenmantram īṣad oṣṭhau tu cālayet
verses.translation: Gf. *'jiianad eva hi kaivalyam**— cited in 57*.; also "rte jhanan na muktih*'.
verses.hindi: द्विजो! वह स्पर्शरहित, रूपरहित, रस-गन्धहीन, अव्यय, बृहत्, अज तथा चित्स्वरूप है । वह प्राणरहित, मनरहित, स्नेहरहित तथा अलोहित है । वह अप्रमेय, अस्थूल, अदीर्घ तथा अनुल्बण है। वह अहस्व, अपार आनन्दमय एवं अच्युत है। वह अनपावृत्, अद्वैत, अनन्त, अगोचर,
verses.wordMeaning: Gf. *'jiianad eva hi kaivalyam**— cited in 57*.; also "rte jhanan na muktih*'.
verses.commentary: Sense: Gf. *'jiianad eva hi kaivalyam**— cited in 57*.; also "rte jhanan na muktih*'.

verses.sanskrit: किंचित् कर्णान्तरं विद्याद् उपांशुः स जपः स्मृतः धिया यदक्षरश्रेण्या वर्णाद्वर्णं पदात्पदम्
verses.transliteration: kiṃcit karṇāntaraṃ vidyād upāṃśuḥ sa japaḥ smṛtaḥ dhiyā yadakṣaraśreṇyā varṇādvarṇaṃ padātpadam
verses.translation: Similarly, Jhana (perfect knowledge) is the cause of salvation. I'he liberated man abides in his own Atman. O leading brahmins, there is no doubt about this (hat wrath etc., occur only when there is ignorance. Wrath, delight, cove- tousness, delusion, arrogance, virtue and evil, all these, O excellent brahmins, cause adoption of physical bodies.
verses.hindi: आवरणरहित तथा आत्मस्वरूप है; उस पराविद्याका अर्र प्रकारसे वर्णन नहीं किया जा सकता है ॥ ५०--५८॥ जो परा तथा अपरा विद्याएँ कही गयी हैं; वै परमार्थकी दृष्टिसे नहीं हैं। वास्तवमें मैं ही सम्पूर्ण जगत
verses.wordMeaning: Similarly, Jhana (perfect knowledge) is the cause of salvation. I'he liberated man abides in his own Atman. O leading brahmins, there is no doubt about this (hat wrath etc., occur only when there is ignorance. Wrath, delight, cove- tousness, delusion, arrogance,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Similarly, Jhana (perfect knowledge) is the cause of salvation. I'he liberated man abides in his own Atman. O leading brahmins, there is no doubt about this (hat wrath etc., occur only when there is ignorance. Wrath, delight, cove- tousness, delusion, arrogance,…

verses.sanskrit: शब्दार्थं चिन्तयेद्भूयः स तूक्तो मानसो जपः त्रयाणां जपयज्ञानां श्रेयान् स्यादुत्तरोत्तरः
verses.transliteration: śabdārthaṃ cintayedbhūyaḥ sa tūkto mānaso japaḥ trayāṇāṃ japayajñānāṃ śreyān syāduttarottaraḥ
verses.translation: rfcct knowledge is obtained by personal contact
verses.hindi: हूँ; मुझमें ही सम्पूर्ण जगत् स्थित है। यह जगत् मुझसे ही उत्पन्न होता है, मुझमें ही स्थित रहता है और अन्तमें मुझमें ही विलीन हो जाता है। मुझसे पर्थ कुछ नहीं है-ऐसा मन, वचन तथा कर्मसे अनुभव ह चाहिए। एकाग्रचित्त होकर सत् तथा असत् सब कुक
verses.wordMeaning: rfcct knowledge is obtained by personal contact
verses.commentary: Sense: rfcct knowledge is obtained by personal contact

verses.sanskrit: भवेद्यज्ञविशेषेण वैशिष्ट्यं तत्फलस्य च जपेन देवता नित्यं स्तूयमाना प्रसीदति
verses.transliteration: bhavedyajñaviśeṣeṇa vaiśiṣṭyaṃ tatphalasya ca japena devatā nityaṃ stūyamānā prasīdati
verses.translation: atmanam ced vijaniyad ahamasmiti paru?ah kixn japan kasya kamaya -ariram anu sarii jvaret
verses.hindi: अध्याय ८६1 पाशुपतयोगज्ञानका स्वरूप तथा उसकी महिमा US
verses.wordMeaning: atmanam ced vijaniyad ahamasmiti paru?ah kixn japan kasya kamaya -ariram anu sarii jvaret
verses.commentary: Sense: atmanam ced vijaniyad ahamasmiti paru?ah kixn japan kasya kamaya -ariram anu sarii jvaret

verses.sanskrit: प्रसन्ना विपुलान् भोगान् दद्यान्मुक्तिं च शाश्वतीम् यक्षरक्षःपिशाचाश् च ग्रहाः सर्वे च भीषणाः जापिनं नोपसर्पन्ति भयभीताः समन्ततः
verses.transliteration: prasannā vipulān bhogān dadyānmuktiṃ ca śāśvatīm yakṣarakṣaḥpiśācāś ca grahāḥ sarve ca bhīṣaṇāḥ jāpinaṃ nopasarpanti bhayabhītāḥ samantataḥ
verses.translation: Like fire that burns the dry fuel quickly, the fire of knowledge burns sins whether inborn or extraneous or origi- nating from bones and speech (i.e. physically and verbally).
verses.hindi: अधोदृष्ट्या वितस्त्यां तु नाभ्यामुपरि तिष्ठति। ही देखना चाहिए; आत्मामें ही सब कुछ  हृदयं तद्विजानीयाद्विश्वस्यायतनं महत्॥ ६२  देखनेवाला साधक अपने मनको बाह्य जगतमें आसक्त नहीं करता है नाभिसे बारह अंगुल ऊपर अधोमुख हत्कमल- स्थित है; उसे विश्वका महान् गृह समझना चाहिए । इस हृदयके मध्यमें कमल विराजमान है; जो धर्मरूपी कन्दसे
verses.wordMeaning: Like fire that burns the dry fuel quickly, the fire of knowledge burns sins whether inborn or extraneous or origi- nating from bones and speech (i.e. physically and verbally).
verses.commentary: Sense: Like fire that burns the dry fuel quickly, the fire of knowledge burns sins whether inborn or extraneous or origi- nating from bones and speech (i.e. physically and verbally).

verses.sanskrit: जपेन पापं शमयेदशेषं यत्तत्कृतं जन्मपरंपरासु ।* जपेन भोगान् जयते च मृत्युं जपेन सिद्धिं लभते च मुक्तिम्
verses.transliteration: japena pāpaṃ śamayedaśeṣaṃ yattatkṛtaṃ janmaparaṃparāsu /* japena bhogān jayate ca mṛtyuṃ japena siddhiṃ labhate ca muktim
verses.translation: There is nothing greater than perfect knowledge for the destruction of all sins. One shall always practise perfect knowledge after eschewing all attachment to worldly objects.
verses.hindi: सिद्धिस्वरूप अष्ट दलसे युक्त और श्वेत तथा उत्तम बैराग्यरूपी कर्णिकावाला है एवं जिसके छिद्र प्राणवायुरूपी दिशाओंके रूपमें प्रतिष्ठित हैं॥ ६२--६४ ॥
verses.wordMeaning: There is nothing greater than perfect knowledge for the destruction of all sins. One shall always practise perfect knowledge after eschewing all attachment to worldly objects.
verses.commentary: Sense: There is nothing greater than perfect knowledge for the destruction of all sins. One shall always practise perfect knowledge after eschewing all attachment to worldly objects.

verses.sanskrit: एवं लब्ध्वा शिवं ज्ञानं ज्ञात्वा जपविधिक्रमम्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ labdhvā śivaṃ jñānaṃ jñātvā japavidhikramam
verses.translation: There is no doubt that all the sins of a Jfianin shall perish. Even if he indulges in dalliance he is not aSected by sins.
verses.hindi: प्राण आदिसे युक्त होनेपर साधक बहुत रूपोंमें इसे क्रमसे देख सकता है। है श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! प्रत्येक नाड़ी दस प्राणोंका वहन करती है; कुल बहत्तर हजार नाडियाँ बतायी गयी हैं। जाग्रत् अवस्था -को नेत्रमें स्थित जानना चाहिए और स्वप्नको कण्ठमें स्थित जानना चाहिए । इसी प्रकार सुषुप्तको हृदयमें स्थित तथा तुरीयको सिरमें स्थित जानना चाहिए। क्रमके अनुसार जाग्रत्-अवस्थामे ब्रह्मा, स्वप्नावस्थामें विष्णु, सुषुप्तावस्थामें
verses.wordMeaning: There is no doubt that all the sins of a Jfianin shall perish. Even if he indulges in dalliance he is not aSected by sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: There is no doubt that all the sins of a Jfianin shall perish. Even if he indulges in dalliance he is not aSected by sins.

verses.sanskrit: सदाचारी जपन्नित्यं ध्यायन् भद्रं समश्नुते सदाचारं प्रवक्ष्यामि सम्यग्धर्मस्य साधनम्
verses.transliteration: sadācārī japannityaṃ dhyāyan bhadraṃ samaśnute sadācāraṃ pravakṣyāmi samyagdharmasya sādhanam
verses.translation: As is knowledge so is meditation. Hence, one should practise meditation.'®' At the outset meditation is laid down as Savi$aya (having an object) and then Nirvisaya (having no object). The leading yogin shall practise meditation in six ways'®® as follows: — for the duration of two, four, six, ten, twelve and sixteen units of time in order. Certainly he shall be liberated.
verses.hindi: ईश्वर (शिव) तथा तुरीयावस्थामें महेश्वर प्रतिष्ठित रहते हैं। अन्य लोग ऐसा भी कहते हैं कि जब मनुष्य सभी इन्द्रियोंके द्वारा संयमित रहता है, तब उसको जाग्रत्-अवस्था कही जाती है। मन, बुद्धि, अहंकार,
verses.wordMeaning: As is knowledge so is meditation. Hence, one should practise meditation.'®' At the outset meditation is laid down as Savi$aya (having an object) and then Nirvisaya (having no object).…
verses.commentary: Sense: As is knowledge so is meditation. Hence, one should practise meditation.'®' At the outset meditation is laid down as Savi$aya (having an object) and then Nirvisaya (having no object).…

verses.sanskrit: यस्मादाचारहीनस्य साधनं निष्फलं भवेत् आचारः परमो धर्म आचारः परमं तपः
verses.transliteration: yasmādācārahīnasya sādhanaṃ niṣphalaṃ bhavet ācāraḥ paramo dharma ācāraḥ paramaṃ tapaḥ
verses.translation: In Saiva system of thought, emphasis is laid upon knowledge and meditation. For detail, see Siva-rakaJa, section X.
verses.hindi: चित्त--यह अन्तःकरणचतुष्टय है; इनके द्वारा जब मनुष्य व्यवस्थित रहता है, तब उसको स्वप्नावस्था कही जाती है। है सुव्रतो! जब मनुष्यको इन्द्रियाँ उसकी आत्मामें विलीन हो जाती हैं, तब उसको सुषुप्तावस्था कही जाती है। इन्द्रियोंसे अतीत मनुष्य तुरीय-अवस्थावाला कहा जाता है। जगत्के परम कारण तथा परस्वरूप ये शिव तुरीयसे भी अतीत हैं॥ ६५--७१॥ हे विप्रेन्द्रो । जाग्रत्, स्वप्न, सुषुप्ति तथा तुरीयके
verses.wordMeaning: In Saiva system of thought, emphasis is laid upon knowledge and meditation. For detail, see Siva-rakaJa, section X.
verses.commentary: Sense: In Saiva system of thought, emphasis is laid upon knowledge and meditation. For detail, see Siva-rakaJa, section X.

verses.sanskrit: आचारः परमा विद्या आचारः परमा गतिः सदाचारवतां पुंसां सर्वत्राप्यभयं भवेत्
verses.transliteration: ācāraḥ paramā vidyā ācāraḥ paramā gatiḥ sadācāravatāṃ puṃsāṃ sarvatrāpyabhayaṃ bhavet
verses.translation: For detail about the varieties of meditation, ibid, section X.
verses.hindi: आधिहैविक स्वरूपका वर्णन करूँगा; यह सब मैं ही हूँ--ऐसा बुद्धिमान्को जानना चाहिए । मन-बुद्धि-अहंकार- चित्त-यह चतुर्वर्ग, पाँच ज्ञानेन्द्रियाँ और पाँच कर्मेन्द्रियाँ-ये पृथक् रूपसे चौदह आध्यात्मिक पदार्थ
verses.wordMeaning: For detail about the varieties of meditation, ibid, section X.
verses.commentary: Sense: For detail about the varieties of meditation, ibid, section X.

verses.sanskrit: तद्वदाचारहीनानां सर्वत्रैव भयं भवेत् सदाचारेण देवत्वम् ऋषित्वं च वरानने
verses.transliteration: tadvadācārahīnānāṃ sarvatraiva bhayaṃ bhavet sadācāreṇa devatvam ṛṣitvaṃ ca varānane
verses.translation: uddha-jSmbilnada. The verse describes the form of the lord in the savikalpaka sam&dhi. Gf. muninSxh jfiSnadStri ca sadaivopaniac chruta kaivalya-sruti-bodhy& iri miirtir mama xaaheivm--ivarahaa cited in ST,
verses.hindi: धर्मकन्दसमुद्भूतं ज्ञाननालं सुशोभनम्  ऐश्वर्याष्टदल श्वेतं परं वैराग्यकर्णिकम्। । (छिद्राणि च दिशो यस्य प्राणाद्याश्च प्रतिष्ठिताः
verses.wordMeaning: uddha-jSmbilnada. The verse describes the form of the lord in the savikalpaka sam&dhi. Gf. muninSxh jfiSnadStri ca sadaivopaniac chruta kaivalya-sruti-bodhy& iri miirtir mama xaaheivm--ivarahaa cited in ST,
verses.commentary: Sense: uddha-jSmbilnada. The verse describes the form of the lord in the savikalpaka sam&dhi. Gf. muninSxh jfiSnadStri ca sadaivopaniac chruta kaivalya-sruti-bodhy& iri miirtir mama xaaheivm--ivarahaa cited in ST,

verses.sanskrit: उपयान्ति कुयोनित्वं तद्वद् आचारलङ्घनात् आचारहीनः पुरुषो लोके भवति निन्दितः
verses.transliteration: upayānti kuyonitvaṃ tadvad ācāralaṅghanāt ācārahīnaḥ puruṣo loke bhavati ninditaḥ
verses.translation: These principles including the first entity Jiva, Prakrti, sattva, rajas, tamas, intellect, the ego, the subtle ele- ments, the sense-organs, the elements beginning with ether are not real®®®. Because he stands steady pervading the universe he is called Sthanu.
verses.hindi: दशप्राणवहा नाड्यः प्रत्येकं मुनिपुङ्गवाः
verses.wordMeaning: These principles including the first entity Jiva, Prakrti, sattva, rajas, tamas, intellect, the ego, the subtle ele- ments, the sense-organs, the elements beginning with ether are not real®®®. Because he stands steady pervading the universe he is called Sthanu.
verses.commentary: Sense: These principles including the first entity Jiva, Prakrti, sattva, rajas, tamas, intellect, the ego, the subtle ele- ments, the sense-organs, the elements beginning with ether are not real®®®. Because he stands steady pervading the universe he is called Sthanu.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात्संसिद्धिमन्विच्छन् सम्यगाचारवान् भवेत् दुर्वृत्तः शुद्धिभूयिष्ठः पापीयान् ज्ञानदूषकः
verses.transliteration: tasmātsaṃsiddhimanvicchan samyagācāravān bhavet durvṛttaḥ śuddhibhūyiṣṭhaḥ pāpīyān jñānadūṣakaḥ
verses.translation: The verse describes the method of paficatattva-devatS-dhya in the savikalpaka samadhi.
verses.hindi: द्विसप्ततिसहस्त्राणि नाड्यः सम्परिकीर्तिताः। नेत्रस्थं जाग्रतं विद्यात्कण्ठे स्वप्नं समादिशेत् जाग्रे ब्रह्मा च विष्णुश्च स्वप्ने चैव यथाक्रमात्
verses.wordMeaning: The verse describes the method of paficatattva-devatS-dhya in the savikalpaka samadhi.
verses.commentary: Sense: The verse describes the method of paficatattva-devatS-dhya in the savikalpaka samadhi.

verses.sanskrit: वर्णाश्रमविधानोक्तं धर्मं कुर्वीत यत्नतः
verses.transliteration: varṇāśramavidhānoktaṃ dharmaṃ kurvīta yatnataḥ
verses.translation: na jivah -In fact, meditation, its varieties and ancillaries are all due to rnajd — the lord's power of projection. Actually, meditation, medi- tator and the object meditated upon are all unreal, vide PaUcadaii vi. 35.
verses.hindi: वदन्त्येवमथान्येऽपि समस्तकरणैः पुमान्
verses.wordMeaning: na jivah -In fact, meditation, its varieties and ancillaries are all due to rnajd — the lord's power of projection. Actually, meditation, medi- tator and the object meditated upon are all unreal, vide PaUcadaii vi. 35.
verses.commentary: Sense: na jivah -In fact, meditation, its varieties and ancillaries are all due to rnajd — the lord's power of projection. Actually, meditation, medi- tator and the object meditated upon are all unreal, vide PaUcadaii vi. 35.

verses.sanskrit: यस्य यद्विहितं कर्म तत्कुर्वन्मत्प्रियः सदा संध्योपासनशीलः स्यात् सायं प्रातः प्रसन्नधीः
verses.transliteration: yasya yadvihitaṃ karma tatkurvanmatpriyaḥ sadā saṃdhyopāsanaśīlaḥ syāt sāyaṃ prātaḥ prasannadhīḥ
verses.translation: It is at the behest of Bhava that the frightened sun rises, the wind blows and purifies, the moon shines, the fire blazes, waters flow, the earth holds aloft and the firmament gives room. Hence, O brahmins, one shall think about all these. O excellent brahmins, all these are presided over by him alone. One shall remember Bhava, thinking that he is identical with all forms in the universe.
verses.hindi: मनोबुद्धिरहङ्कारं चित्तं चेति चतुष्टयम् करणानि विलीनानि यदा स्वात्मनि सुव्रताः
verses.wordMeaning: It is at the behest of Bhava that the frightened sun rises, the wind blows and purifies, the moon shines, the fire blazes, waters flow, the earth holds aloft and the firmament gives room. Hence, O brahmins, one shall think about all these. O excellent brahmins,…
verses.commentary: Sense: It is at the behest of Bhava that the frightened sun rises, the wind blows and purifies, the moon shines, the fire blazes, waters flow, the earth holds aloft and the firmament gives room. Hence, O brahmins, one shall think about all these. O excellent brahmins,…

verses.sanskrit: उदयास्तमयात्पूर्वम् आरम्य विधिना शुचिः कामान्मोहाद्भयाल्लोभात् संध्यां नातिक्रमेद्द्विजः
verses.transliteration: udayāstamayātpūrvam āramya vidhinā śuciḥ kāmānmohādbhayāllobhāt saṃdhyāṃ nātikrameddvijaḥ
verses.translation: To those who are scorched by the poison of mundane existence, the only antidote is the nectar-like perfect knowledge and meditation. O excellent brahmins, no other solution has been laid down anywhere.
verses.hindi: सुषुप्तः करणैर्भिनस्तुरीयः परिकीर्त्यते। परस्तुरीयातीतोऽसौ शिवः परमकारणम्
verses.wordMeaning: To those who are scorched by the poison of mundane existence, the only antidote is the nectar-like perfect knowledge and meditation. O excellent brahmins, no other solution has been laid down anywhere.
verses.commentary: Sense: To those who are scorched by the poison of mundane existence, the only antidote is the nectar-like perfect knowledge and meditation. O excellent brahmins, no other solution has been laid down anywhere.

verses.sanskrit: संध्यातिक्रमणाद्विप्रो ब्राह्मण्यात्पतते यतः असत्यं न वदेत् किंचिन् न सत्यं च परित्यजेत्
verses.transliteration: saṃdhyātikramaṇādvipro brāhmaṇyātpatate yataḥ asatyaṃ na vadet kiṃcin na satyaṃ ca parityajet
verses.translation: Perfect knowledge originates directly from Dharma (virtue). Vairagya (detachment) originates from knowledge; from Vairagya arises the supreme knowledge that illuminates the true meanings of objects.
verses.hindi: आध्यात्मिकं च विप्रनद्राशचाधिहैविकमुच्यते बुद्धीन्द्रियाणि विप्रेन्द्रास्तथा कर्मेन्द्रियाणि च
verses.wordMeaning: Perfect knowledge originates directly from Dharma (virtue). Vairagya (detachment) originates from knowledge; from Vairagya arises the supreme knowledge that illuminates the true meanings of objects.
verses.commentary: Sense: Perfect knowledge originates directly from Dharma (virtue). Vairagya (detachment) originates from knowledge; from Vairagya arises the supreme knowledge that illuminates the true meanings of objects.

verses.sanskrit: यत्सत्यं ब्रह्म इत्याहुर् असत्यं ब्रह्मदूषणम् अनृतं परुषं शाठ्यं पैशुन्यं पापहेतुकम्
verses.transliteration: yatsatyaṃ brahma ityāhur asatyaṃ brahmadūṣaṇam anṛtaṃ paruṣaṃ śāṭhyaṃ paiśunyaṃ pāpahetukam
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, he who is endowed with know- ledge and detachment attains Yogic Siddhi. One who abides by sattva guna attains liberation through yogic siddhi and not otherwise.
verses.hindi: मनोबुद्धिरहङ्कारश्चित्तं चेति चतुष्टयम्। अध्यात्मं पृथगेवेदं चतुर्दशविधं स्मृतम्
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent brahmins, he who is endowed with know- ledge and detachment attains Yogic Siddhi. One who abides by sattva guna attains liberation through yogic siddhi and not otherwise.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent brahmins, he who is endowed with know- ledge and detachment attains Yogic Siddhi. One who abides by sattva guna attains liberation through yogic siddhi and not otherwise.

verses.transliteration: āsyena na pibettoyaṃ tiṣṭhannañjalināpi vā vāmahastena śayyāyāṃ tathaivānyaṃkareṇa vā

verses.hindi: योग्य, बोलनेयोग्य, ग्रहण , गमन करनेयोग्य आधिभौतिक हैं । सूर्य, दिशाएँ, पृथ्वी, वरुण, वायु चन्द ब्रह्मा, रुद्र, क्षेत्रज्ञ, अग्नि, इन्द्र, विष्णु, मित्र और हि प्रजापति--ये चौदह क्रमसे आधिहैविक हें ॥ ७२ 02  मोघा, रुद्रा, अमृता, सत्या, मध्यमा, नाड़ी, राशिशुका असुरा, कृत्तिका और भास्वती-ये चौदह निबन्धन नाड्या हैं। नाड़ियोंके मध्य चौदह वाहक वायु स्थित हैं। प्राण, व्यान, अपान, उदान, समान, वैरम्भ, मुख्य

verses.transliteration: vibhītakārkakārañjasnuhicchāyāṃ na cāśrayet staṃbhadīpamanuṣyāṇām anyeṣāṃ prāṇināṃ tathā

verses.sanskrit: एको न गच्छेदध्वानं बाहुभ्यां नोत्तरेन्नदीम् नावरोहेत कूपादिं नारोहेदुच्चपादपान्
verses.transliteration: eko na gacchedadhvānaṃ bāhubhyāṃ nottarennadīm nāvaroheta kūpādiṃ nāroheduccapādapān
verses.translation: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:
verses.hindi: हे सुव्रतो! नेत्रोंमें, द्रष्टव्य पदार्थोमें, सूर्यमे, नाड़ीमें, प्राणमें, विज्ञानमें, आनन्दमें, हृदयाकाशमें तथा इस सम्पूर्ण ब्रह्माण्डमें जो एकमात्र आत्माके रूपमें संचरण करता है, उस मुझ अजर, अनन्त, शोकरहित, अमृतस्वरूप तथा अटल प्रभुकी उपासना करनी चाहिए। एकमात्र वह ही चौदहों प्रकारकी नाड़ियोंमें संचरण करता है और है द्विजो! वे सब उसीमें लीन हो जाते हैं; क्योंकि उसके अतिरिक्त अन्य कुछ भी नहीं है।

verses.commentary: Sense: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:

verses.sanskrit: सूर्याग्निजलदेवानां गुरूणां विमुखः शुभे न कुर्यादिह कार्याणि जपकर्म शुभानि वा
verses.transliteration: sūryāgnijaladevānāṃ gurūṇāṃ vimukhaḥ śubhe na kuryādiha kāryāṇi japakarma śubhāni vā

verses.hindi: एकमात्र वह ही सर्वज्ञ है और एकमात्र वह ही सर्वेश्वर है। वह सबका स्वामी, देवता, अन्तर्यामी तथा महाज्योतिसे युक्त है। है उत्तम द्विजो! सभी प्रकारका सुख देनेवाले सनातन परमात्मा सभीके द्वारा उपासना किये

verses.transliteration: agnau na tāpayetpādau hastaṃ padbhyāṃ na saṃspṛśet agnernocchrayam āsīta nāgnau kiṃcin malaṃ tyajet

verses.transliteration: taccāṇḍālasamaṃ jñeyaṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā sphigvātaṃ śūrpavātaṃ ca vātaṃ prāṇamukhānilam

verses.hindi: रागद्वेषानृतक्रोधं कामतृष्णादिभिः सदा तत्क्षयाद्धि भवेनमुक्तिर्नान्यथा जन्मकोटिभिः। ज्ञानमेकं विना नास्ति पुण्यपापपरिक्षयः

verses.hindi: तस्मात्सदाभ्यसेज्ज्ञानं तन्निष्ठस्तत्परायणः। ज्ञानेनैकेन तृप्तस्य त्यक्तसङ्गस्य योगिनः सबपर शासन करनेवाला, सबको ले जानेवाला और विभागपूर्वक पंचकोशरूप पंचात्मा हूँ। जो ग्रहण किया जाता है, वह अन्न कहा जाता है। वह भूतात्मा अन्नमयकोश है, इन्द्रियात्मा प्राणमयकोश है, संकल्पात्मा

verses.transliteration: ācamya vā japeccheṣaṃ kṛtvā vā prāṇasaṃyamam sūryo 'gniścandramāścaiva grahanakṣatratārakāḥ

verses.sanskrit: एते ज्योतींषि प्रोक्तानि विद्वद्भिर् ब्राह्मणैस् तथा प्रसार्य पादौ न जपेत् कुक्कुटासन एव च
verses.transliteration: ete jyotīṃṣi proktāni vidvadbhir brāhmaṇais tathā prasārya pādau na japet kukkuṭāsana eva ca

verses.hindi: अभावके कारण परतन्त्ररूप सम्पूर्ण जगत् मुझ स्वतन्त्रमें ही स्थित है॥ ९१--९५॥ एकत्व भी नहीं है, तब द्वैत कैसे हो सकता है? इसी प्रकार कोई मर्त्य नहीं है। तब वे अजोद्भव भी अमर कैसे होंगे? इस प्रकार वह न अन्त:प्रज्ञ है, न बहि:प्रज्ञ है, न दोनों प्रकारकी प्रज्ञावाला है, न प्रज्ञानघन

verses.transliteration: anāsanaḥ śayāno vā rathyāyāṃ śūdrasannidhau raktabhūmyāṃ ca khaṭvāyāṃ na japejjāpakas tathā

verses.transliteration: āsanastho japetsamyak mantrārthagatamānasaḥ kauśeyaṃ vyāghracarmaṃ vā cailaṃ taulamathāpi vā

verses.transliteration: dāravaṃ tālaparṇaṃ vā āsanaṃ parikalpayet trisaṃdhyaṃ tu guroḥ pūjā kartavyā hitamicchatā

verses.transliteration: saguṇo nirguṇo vāpi tasyājñāṃ śirasā vahet śreyo 'rthī yastu gurvājñāṃ manasāpi na laṅghayet
verses.translation: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:
