verses.sanskrit: गुर्वाज्ञापालकः सम्यक् ज्ञानसंपत्तिमश्नुते गच्छंस्तिष्ठन्स्वपन् भुञ्जन् यद्यत्कर्म समाचरेत्
verses.transliteration: gurvājñāpālakaḥ samyak jñānasaṃpattimaśnute gacchaṃstiṣṭhansvapan bhuñjan yadyatkarma samācaret
verses.translation: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:
verses.hindi: कर्तव्याभ्यासमुत्सृज्य ज्ञानमेवाधिगच्छति।
verses.wordMeaning: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:
verses.commentary: Sense: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:

verses.sanskrit: समक्षं यदि तत्सर्वं कर्तव्यं गुर्वनुज्ञया गुरोर्देवसमक्षं वा न यथेष्टासनो भवेत्
verses.transliteration: samakṣaṃ yadi tatsarvaṃ kartavyaṃ gurvanujñayā gurordevasamakṣaṃ vā na yatheṣṭāsano bhavet
verses.translation: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:
verses.hindi: मोक्षहेतुस्तथा ज्ञानं मुक्तः स्वात्मन्यवस्थितः । अज्ञाने सति विप्रेन्द्राः क्रोधाद्या नात्र संशयः धर्माधर्मौ हि तेषां च तद्वशात्तनुसङ्ग्रहः
verses.wordMeaning: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:
verses.commentary: Sense: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:

verses.sanskrit: गुरुर्देवो यतः साक्षात् तद्गृहं देवमन्दिरम् पापिना च यथासंगात् तत्पापैः पतनं भवेत्
verses.transliteration: gururdevo yataḥ sākṣāt tadgṛhaṃ devamandiram pāpinā ca yathāsaṃgāt tatpāpaiḥ patanaṃ bhavet
verses.translation: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:
verses.hindi: क्रोधाद्या नाशमायान्ति धर्माधर्मौ च वै द्विजाः । तत्क्षयाच्य शरीरेण न पुनः सम्प्रयुज्यते
verses.wordMeaning: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:
verses.commentary: Sense: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:

verses.sanskrit: तद्वदाचार्यसंगेन तद्धर्मफलभाग्भवेत् यथैव वह्निसंपर्कान् मलं त्यजति काञ्चनम्
verses.transliteration: tadvadācāryasaṃgena taddharmaphalabhāgbhavet yathaiva vahnisaṃparkān malaṃ tyajati kāñcanam
verses.translation: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:
verses.hindi: ज्ञानं गुरोर्हि सम्पर्कान्न वाचा परमार्थतः। चतुर्व्यूहमिति ज्ञात्वा ध्याता ध्यानं समभ्यसेत् सहजागन्तुकं पापमस्थिवागुद्भवं तथा। ज्ञानाग्निर्दहते क्षिप्रं शुष्केन्धनमिवानलः
verses.wordMeaning: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:
verses.commentary: Sense: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:

verses.sanskrit: तथैव गुरुसंपर्कात् पापं त्यजति मानवः यथा वह्निसमीपस्थो घृतकुंभो विलीयते
verses.transliteration: tathaiva gurusaṃparkāt pāpaṃ tyajati mānavaḥ yathā vahnisamīpastho ghṛtakuṃbho vilīyate
verses.translation: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:
verses.hindi: तत्त्वज्ञानी नहीं है। इस अव तथा परलोकमें उसके लिये कुछ भी करनेयोग्य नहीं रहता है। चूँकि कक जीवन्मुक्त है, अतः वास्तविक रूपसे ब्रह्मवेत्ता है, ज्ञानके अभ्यासमें संलग्न तथा ज्ञानतत्त्वार्थविद् स्वयं
verses.wordMeaning: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:
verses.commentary: Sense: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:

verses.sanskrit: तथा पापं विलीयेत आचार्यस्य समीपतः यथा प्रज्वलितो वह्निर् विष्ठां काष्ठं च निर्दहेत्
verses.transliteration: tathā pāpaṃ vilīyeta ācāryasya samīpataḥ yathā prajvalito vahnir viṣṭhāṃ kāṣṭhaṃ ca nirdahet
verses.translation: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:
verses.hindi: कर्तव्योंके अभ्यासका त्याग करके ज्ञानको ही प्राण होता है॥ १०३--१०७०/२॥ करनेवाला है तथा क्रोधका त्याग कर चुका है, किंतु मूढ़ होकर ज्ञानातिरिक्त अन्य साधनोंमें सुखका अनुभव करता है। वह अज्ञानी है; इसमें सन्देह नहीं है। अज्ञान ही संसारका कारण है; शरीर धारण करना ही संसार
verses.wordMeaning: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:
verses.commentary: Sense: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:

verses.sanskrit: गुरुस्तुष्टो दहत्येवं पापं तन्मन्त्रतेजसा ब्रह्मा हरिस् तथा रुद्रो देवाश् च मुनयस् तथा
verses.transliteration: gurustuṣṭo dahatyevaṃ pāpaṃ tanmantratejasā brahmā haris tathā rudro devāś ca munayas tathā
verses.translation: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:
verses.hindi: है। ज्ञान मोक्षका हेतु है; मुक्त व्यक्ति अपनेमें ही अवस्थित रहता है॥ १०८-१०९१/२॥
verses.wordMeaning: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:
verses.commentary: Sense: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:

verses.sanskrit: कुर्वन्त्यनुग्रहं तुष्टा गुरौ तुष्टे न संशयः कर्मणा मनसा वाचा गुरोः क्रोधं न कारयेत्
verses.transliteration: kurvantyanugrahaṃ tuṣṭā gurau tuṣṭe na saṃśayaḥ karmaṇā manasā vācā guroḥ krodhaṃ na kārayet
verses.translation: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:
verses.hindi: होते हैं; इसमें सन्देह नहीं है। है उत्तम द्विजो! क्रोध, हर्ष, लोभ, मोह, दम्भ, धर्म, अधर्म लोगोंको होता है और उनके कारण शरीर धारण करना पड़ता है और शरीर रहनेपर क्लेश अवश्य होता है, अतः बुद्धिमानूको चाहिए कि अज्ञानका त्याग कर दे। है द्विजो! विद्या (ज्ञान)-के द्वारा अविद्या (अज्ञान)-को नष्ट करके स्थित हुए योगीके क्रोध आदि तथा धर्म-अर्धम स्वयं नष्ट हो जाते हैं। उनका नाश हो जानेसे पुत
verses.wordMeaning: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:
verses.commentary: Sense: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:

verses.sanskrit: तस्य क्रोधेन दह्यन्ते आयुःश्रीज्ञानसत्क्रियाः तत्क्रोधं ये करिष्यन्ति तेषां यज्ञाश् च निष्फलाः
verses.transliteration: tasya krodhena dahyante āyuḥśrījñānasatkriyāḥ tatkrodhaṃ ye kariṣyanti teṣāṃ yajñāś ca niṣphalāḥ
verses.translation: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:
verses.hindi: शरीरसे प्राणीका संयोग नहीं होता है, वह संसारसे मुक्त हो जाता है और तीनों प्रकारके तापोंसे रहित ही जाता है॥ ११०--११३ /२॥
verses.wordMeaning: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:
verses.commentary: Sense: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:

verses.sanskrit: जपान्यनियमाश्चैव नात्र कार्या विचारणा गुरोर्विरुद्धं यद्वाक्यं न वदेत्सर्वयत्नतः
verses.transliteration: japānyaniyamāścaiva nātra kāryā vicāraṇā gurorviruddhaṃ yadvākyaṃ na vadetsarvayatnataḥ
verses.translation: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:
verses.hindi: हे श्रेष्ठ द्विजो! इस प्रकार ज्ञानके बिना विल करनेवालेका ध्यान सिद्ध नहीं होता है, वास्तवमै शी गुरुके सम्पर्कसे ही होता है, केवल शब्दसे नहीं  चर्ख (तैजस, विश्व, प्राज्ञ, तुरीय)-का ज्ञान झी करनेवालेको ध्यानका अभ्यास करना चाहिए । ला
verses.wordMeaning: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:
verses.commentary: Sense: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:

verses.sanskrit: वदेद् यदि महामोहाद् रौरवं नरकं व्रजेत् चित्तेनैव च वित्तेन तथा वाचा च सुव्रताः
verses.transliteration: vaded yadi mahāmohād rauravaṃ narakaṃ vrajet cittenaiva ca vittena tathā vācā ca suvratāḥ
verses.translation: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:
verses.hindi: होनेवाले पापको उसी प्रकार शीघ्र जला डालती है,
verses.wordMeaning: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:
verses.commentary: Sense: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:

verses.sanskrit: मिथ्या न कारयेद्देवि क्रियया च गुरोः सदा दुर्गुणे ख्यापिते तस्य नैर्गुण्यशतभाग्भवेत्
verses.transliteration: mithyā na kārayeddevi kriyayā ca guroḥ sadā durguṇe khyāpite tasya nairguṇyaśatabhāgbhavet
verses.translation: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:
verses.hindi: पाशुपतयोगज्ञानका स्वरूप तथा उसकी महिमा ज्ञानात्परतरं नास्ति सर्वपापविनाशनम्। सर्वसङ्गविवर्जितः
verses.wordMeaning: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:
verses.commentary: Sense: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:

verses.sanskrit: गुणे तु ख्यापिते तस्य सार्वगुण्यफलं भवेत् गुरोर्हितं प्रियं कुर्याद् आदिष्टो वा न वा सदा
verses.transliteration: guṇe tu khyāpite tasya sārvaguṇyaphalaṃ bhavet gurorhitaṃ priyaṃ kuryād ādiṣṭo vā na vā sadā
verses.translation: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:
verses.hindi: ज्ञानिनः सर्वपापानि जीर्यन्ते नात्र संशय: । क्रीडन्नपि न लिप्येत पापैर्नानाविध्ैरपि
verses.wordMeaning: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:
verses.commentary: Sense: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:

verses.sanskrit: असमक्षं समक्षं वा गुरोः कार्यं समाचरेत् गुरोर्हितं प्रियं कुर्यान् मनोवाक्कायकर्मभिः
verses.transliteration: asamakṣaṃ samakṣaṃ vā guroḥ kāryaṃ samācaret gurorhitaṃ priyaṃ kuryān manovākkāyakarmabhiḥ
verses.translation: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:
verses.hindi: ज्ञानं यथा तथा ध्यानं तस्माद्ध्यानं समभ्यसेत्। ध्यानं निर्विषयं प्रोक्तमादौ सविषयं तथा षट्प्रकारं समभ्यस्य चतुःषट्दशभिस्तथा। तथा द्वादशधा चैव पुनः षोडशधा क्रमात्
verses.wordMeaning: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:
verses.commentary: Sense: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:

verses.sanskrit: कुर्वन्पतत्यधो गत्वा तत्रैव परिवर्तते तस्मात्स सर्वदोपास्यो वन्दनीयश् च सर्वदा
verses.transliteration: kurvanpatatyadho gatvā tatraiva parivartate tasmātsa sarvadopāsyo vandanīyaś ca sarvadā
verses.translation: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:
verses.hindi: शुद्धजाम्बूनदाकारं विधूमाङ्गारसन्निभम्
verses.wordMeaning: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:
verses.commentary: Sense: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:

verses.sanskrit: समीपस्थो ऽप्यनुज्ञाप्य वदेत्तद्विमुखो गुरुम् एवमाचारवान् भक्तो नित्यं जपपरायणः
verses.transliteration: samīpastho 'pyanujñāpya vadettadvimukho gurum evamācāravān bhakto nityaṃ japaparāyaṇaḥ
verses.translation: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:
verses.hindi: पीतं रक्तसितं विद्युत्कोटिकोटिसमप्रभम्। अथवा ब्रह्मारन्ध्रस्थं चित्तं कृत्वा प्रयलतः न सितं वासितं पीतं न स्मरेद् ब्रह्मविद्भवेत्। अहिंसकः सत्यवादी अस्तेयी सर्वयलतः
verses.wordMeaning: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:
verses.commentary: Sense: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:

verses.sanskrit: गुरुप्रियकरो मन्त्रं विनियोक्तुं ततो ऽर्हति विनियोगं प्रवक्ष्यामि सिद्धमन्त्रप्रयोजनम्
verses.transliteration: gurupriyakaro mantraṃ viniyoktuṃ tato 'rhati viniyogaṃ pravakṣyāmi siddhamantraprayojanam
verses.translation: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:
verses.hindi: परिग्रहविनिर्मुक्तो ब्रह्मचारी दृढव्रतः।
verses.wordMeaning: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:
verses.commentary: Sense: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:

verses.sanskrit: दौर्बल्यं याति तन्मन्त्रं विनियोगमजानतः यस्य येन वियुञ्जीत कार्येण तु विशेषतः
verses.transliteration: daurbalyaṃ yāti tanmantraṃ viniyogamajānataḥ yasya yena viyuñjīta kāryeṇa tu viśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:
verses.hindi: मद्धक्तशचाभ्यसेद्धयानं गुरुसम्पर्कजं ्रुवम्। न बुध्यति तथा ध्याता स्थाप्य चित्तं द्विजोत्तमाः पार्थिवे पटले ब्रह्मा वारितत्त्वे हरिः स्वयम्
verses.wordMeaning: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:
verses.commentary: Sense: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:

verses.sanskrit: विनियोगः स विज्ञेय ऐहिकामुष्मिकं फलम् विनियोगजमायुष्यम् आरोग्यं तनुनित्यता
verses.transliteration: viniyogaḥ sa vijñeya aihikāmuṣmikaṃ phalam viniyogajamāyuṣyam ārogyaṃ tanunityatā
verses.translation: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:
verses.hindi: वाह्वेये कालरुद्राख्यो वायुतत्त्वे महेश्वरः सुषिरे स शिवः साक्षात्क्रमादेवं विचिन्तयेत्
verses.wordMeaning: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:
verses.commentary: Sense: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:

verses.sanskrit: राज्यैश्वर्यं च विज्ञानं स्वर्गो निर्वाण एव च प्रोक्षणं चाभिषेकं च अघमर्षणमेव च
verses.transliteration: rājyaiśvaryaṃ ca vijñānaṃ svargo nirvāṇa eva ca prokṣaṇaṃ cābhiṣekaṃ ca aghamarṣaṇameva ca
verses.translation: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:
verses.hindi: क्षितौ शर्वः स्मृतो देवो ह्यपां भव इति स्मृतः । रुद्र एव तथा वह्नौ उग्रो वायौ व्यवस्थित: १२९ अग्नि सूखे ईधनको जला डालती है॥ ११४--११६॥
verses.wordMeaning: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:
verses.commentary: Sense: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:

verses.sanskrit: स्नाने च संध्ययोश्चैव कुर्यादेकादशेन वै शुचिः पर्वतमारुह्य जपेल्लक्षमतन्द्रितः
verses.transliteration: snāne ca saṃdhyayoścaiva kuryādekādaśena vai śuciḥ parvatamāruhya japellakṣamatandritaḥ
verses.translation: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:
verses.hindi: ज्ञानसे बढ़कर पापका नाश करनेवाला अन्य कुछ भी नहीं है, अत: संसारसे आसक्तिरहित होकर जानका अभ्यास करना चाहिए। ज्ञानीके समस्त पाप नष्ट हो जाते हैं; इसमें सन्देह नहीं है। आमोद-प्रमोद
verses.wordMeaning: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:
verses.commentary: Sense: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:

verses.sanskrit: महानद्यां द्विलक्षं तु दीर्घमायुरवाप्नुयात् दूर्वाङ्कुरास्तिला वाणी गुडूची घुटिका तथा
verses.transliteration: mahānadyāṃ dvilakṣaṃ tu dīrghamāyuravāpnuyāt dūrvāṅkurāstilā vāṇī guḍūcī ghuṭikā tathā
verses.translation: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:
verses.hindi: करता हुआ भी ज्ञानी व्यक्ति नानाविध पापोंसे लिप्त नहीं होता है जैसा ज्ञान है, वैसा ही ध्यान भी है, अत: ध्यानका अभ्यास करना चाहिए। ध्यान निर्विषय बताया गया है; जो आदिमें सविषय होता है । चार, छः, दस, बारह तथा सोलह और पुनः दो प्रकारसे-इन छः रूपोंमें क्रमशः
verses.wordMeaning: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:
verses.commentary: Sense: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:

verses.sanskrit: तेषां तु दशसाहस्रं होममायुष्यवर्धनम् अश्वत्थवृक्षमाश्रित्य जपेल्लक्षद्वयं सुधीः
verses.transliteration: teṣāṃ tu daśasāhasraṃ homamāyuṣyavardhanam aśvatthavṛkṣamāśritya japellakṣadvayaṃ sudhīḥ
verses.translation: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:
verses.hindi: अभ्यास करके श्रेष्ठ योगी मुक्त हो जाता है; इसमें सन्देह नहीं है। साधकको विशुद्ध सुवर्णके आकारवाले, धूमरहित अंगारके सदृश, पीले-लाल या श्वेत वर्णवाले, करोड़ों विद्युतके समान कान्तिवाले आकारमें ध्यान
verses.wordMeaning: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:
verses.commentary: Sense: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:

verses.sanskrit: शनैश्चरदिने स्पृष्ट्वा दीर्घायुष्यं लभेन्नरः शनैश्चरदिने ऽश्वत्थं पाणिभ्यां संस्पृशेत्सुधीः
verses.transliteration: śanaiścaradine spṛṣṭvā dīrghāyuṣyaṃ labhennaraḥ śanaiścaradine 'śvatthaṃ pāṇibhyāṃ saṃspṛśetsudhīḥ
verses.translation: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:
verses.hindi: लगाना चाहिए, अथवा चित्तको प्रयत्नपूर्वक ब्रह्मरन्श्रमें स्थित करके श्वेत, कृष्ण अथवा पीतवर्णसे रहित ब्रह्मका स्मरण करे; ऐसा ध्यान करनेवाला ब्रह्मवेत्ता होता है॥ ११९-१२२/२॥ पूर्ण प्रयलके साथ अहिंसक, सत्यवादी, चौरवृत्तिसे रहित, परिंग्रहरहित, ब्रह्मचारी, दृढ व्रतवाला, सन्तुष्ट, शुद्धिसे युक्त, सर्वदा स्वाध्यायपरायण और मेरी भक्तिसे युक्त होकर गुरुके सान्निध्यमें ध्यानका अविचल अभ्यास
verses.wordMeaning: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:
verses.commentary: Sense: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:

verses.sanskrit: जपेदष्टोत्तरशतं सोममृत्युहरो भवेत् आदित्याभिमुखो भूत्वा जपेल्लक्षमनन्यधीः
verses.transliteration: japedaṣṭottaraśataṃ somamṛtyuharo bhavet ādityābhimukho bhūtvā japellakṣamananyadhīḥ
verses.translation: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:
verses.hindi: करना चाहिए। है श्रेष्ठ ब्राह्मणो! ध्यान-साधना करनेवाला योगी अपने चित्तको स्थिर करके किसी अन्य वस्तुका बोध नहीं करता, उसे कुछ भी भान नहीं होता, वह अपने चारों ओर कुछ नहीं देखता, वह न सूँघता है,
verses.wordMeaning: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:
verses.commentary: Sense: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:

verses.sanskrit: अर्कैरष्टशतं जप्त्वा जुह्वन्व्याधेर्विमुच्यते समस्तव्याधिशान्त्यर्थं पलाशसमिधैर् नरः
verses.transliteration: arkairaṣṭaśataṃ japtvā juhvanvyādhervimucyate samastavyādhiśāntyarthaṃ palāśasamidhair naraḥ
verses.translation: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:
verses.hindi: न सुनता है और न स्पर्शका ही अनुभव करता है; जिसने स्वयंको पूर्णतः अपनी आत्मामें लीन कर दिया है, वह समरस कहा गया है॥ १२३-१२६/२॥ पार्थिव पटलमें ब्रह्मा, जलतत्त्वमें स्वयं विष्णु, अग्नितत्त्वमें कालरुद्र, वायुतत्त्वमें महेश्वर और आकाश तत्त्वमें वे साक्षात् शिव विद्यमान हैं-एऐसा क्रमसे चिन्तन करना चाहिए। शर्व पृथ्वीमें विद्यमान कहे
verses.wordMeaning: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:
verses.commentary: Sense: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:

verses.sanskrit: हुत्वा दशसहस्रं तु निरोगी मनुजो भवेत् नित्यमष्टशतं जप्त्वा पिबेद् अम्भो ऽर्कसन्निधौ
verses.transliteration: hutvā daśasahasraṃ tu nirogī manujo bhavet nityamaṣṭaśataṃ japtvā pibed ambho 'rkasannidhau
verses.translation: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:
verses.hindi: गये हैं। भव देवता जलमें विद्यमान कहे गये हें । रुद्र
verses.wordMeaning: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:
verses.commentary: Sense: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:

verses.sanskrit: औदर्यैर्व्याधिभिः सर्वैर् मासेनैकेन मुच्यते एकादशेन भुञ्जीयाद् अन्नं चैवाभिमन्त्रितम्
verses.transliteration: audaryairvyādhibhiḥ sarvair māsenaikena mucyate ekādaśena bhuñjīyād annaṃ caivābhimantritam
verses.translation: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:
verses.hindi: श्रीलिड्रमहापुराण भीमः भीमः सुषिरनाकेऽसौ भास्कर मण्डले स्थिः।  अग्निमें और उग्र वाये प्रतिष्ठित हैं। भीम “००७ भास्करे मण्डले स्थित: । ईशानः सोमबिम्बे च महादेव इति स्मृतः
verses.wordMeaning: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:
verses.commentary: Sense: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:

verses.sanskrit: भक्ष्यं चान्यत्तथा पेयं विषमप्यमृतं भवेत् जपेल् लक्षं तु पूर्वाह्णे हुत्वा चाष्टशतेन वै
verses.transliteration: bhakṣyaṃ cānyattathā peyaṃ viṣamapyamṛtaṃ bhavet japel lakṣaṃ tu pūrvāhṇe hutvā cāṣṭaśatena vai
verses.translation: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:
verses.hindi: पुंसां पशुपतिर्देवश्चाष्टधाहं व्यवस्थितः । काठिन्यं यत्तनौ सर्वं पार्थिवं परिगीयते
verses.wordMeaning: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:
verses.commentary: Sense: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:

verses.sanskrit: सूर्यं नित्यमुपस्थाय सम्यगारोग्यमाप्नुयात् नदीतोयेन सम्पूर्णं घटं संस्पृश्य शोभनम्
verses.transliteration: sūryaṃ nityamupasthāya samyagārogyamāpnuyāt nadītoyena sampūrṇaṃ ghaṭaṃ saṃspṛśya śobhanam
verses.translation: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:
verses.hindi: आप्यं द्रवमिति प्रोक्तं वर्णाख्यो वह्निरुच्यते । तदाकाशं च विज्ञानं शब्दजं व्योमसम्भवम्। तथैव विप्रा विज्ञानं स्पर्शाख्यं वायुसम्भवम्
verses.wordMeaning: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:
verses.commentary: Sense: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:

verses.sanskrit: जप्त्वायुतं च तत्स्नानाद् रोगाणां भेषजं भवेत् अष्टाविंशज्जपित्वान्नम् अश्नीयाद् अन्वहं शुचिः
verses.transliteration: japtvāyutaṃ ca tatsnānād rogāṇāṃ bheṣajaṃ bhavet aṣṭāviṃśajjapitvānnam aśnīyād anvahaṃ śuciḥ
verses.translation: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:
verses.hindi: गन्धाख्यं पार्थिवं भूयश्चिन्तयेद्भास्करं क्रमात्
verses.wordMeaning: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:
verses.commentary: Sense: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:

verses.sanskrit: हुत्वा च तावत्पालाशैर् एवं वारोग्यम् अश्नुते चन्द्रसूर्यग्रहे पूर्वम् उपोष्य विधिना शुचिः
verses.transliteration: hutvā ca tāvatpālāśair evaṃ vārogyam aśnute candrasūryagrahe pūrvam upoṣya vidhinā śuciḥ
verses.translation: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:
verses.hindi: आकण्ठं वह्नितत्त्वं स्याल्ललाटान्तं द्विजोत्तमाः । वायव्यं वै ललाटाद्यं व्योमाख्यं वा शिखाग्रकम् हंसाख्यं च ततो ब्रह्म व्योम्नश्चोर्ध्वं ततः परम्। व्योमाख्यो व्योममध्यस्थो ह्ययं प्राथमिकः स्मरेत्
verses.wordMeaning: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:
verses.commentary: Sense: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:

verses.sanskrit: यावद्ग्रहणमोक्षं तु तावन्नद्यां समाहितः जपेत्समुद्रगामिन्यां विमोक्षे ग्रहणस्य तु
verses.transliteration: yāvadgrahaṇamokṣaṃ tu tāvannadyāṃ samāhitaḥ japetsamudragāminyāṃ vimokṣe grahaṇasya tu
verses.translation: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:
verses.hindi: द्योतते चन्द्रमा वह्नि््वलत्यापो वहन्ति च
verses.wordMeaning: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:
verses.commentary: Sense: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:

verses.sanskrit: अष्टोत्तरसहस्रेण पिबेद्ब्राह्मीरसं द्विजाः ऐहिकां लभते मेधां सर्वशास्त्रधरां शुभाम्
verses.transliteration: aṣṭottarasahasreṇa pibedbrāhmīrasaṃ dvijāḥ aihikāṃ labhate medhāṃ sarvaśāstradharāṃ śubhām
verses.translation: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:
verses.hindi: दधाति भूमिराकाशमवकाशं ददाति च। तदाज्ञया ततं सर्व तस्माद्वै चिन्तयेद् द्विजाः और ईशान सूर्यके मण्डलमें स्थित हैं। ह
verses.wordMeaning: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:
verses.commentary: Sense: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:

verses.sanskrit: सारस्वती भवेद्देवी तस्य वागतिमानुषी ग्रहनक्षत्रपीडासु जपेद्भक्त्यायुतं नरः

verses.sanskrit: हुत्वा चाष्टसहस्रं तु ग्रहपीडां व्यपोहति दुःस्वप्नदर्शने स्नात्वा जपेद्वै चायुतं नरः
verses.transliteration: hutvā cāṣṭasahasraṃ tu grahapīḍāṃ vyapohati duḥsvapnadarśane snātvā japedvai cāyutaṃ naraḥ

verses.hindi: शरीरमें जो सम्पूर्ण कठोरता है, वह पृथ्वीतसत्वमय कही जाती है, आप्य (तरल) पदार्थको सम्बन्धित कहा गया है । वर्ण (रंग)-को अग्निसे सम्बन्धित कहा जाता है। है श्रेष्ठ ब्राह्मणो! जो शरीरमें संचरण करता है, वह वायुसे सम्बन्धित है । जो शरीरमें अवकाश (रिक्त स्थान) है, वह आकाशतत्त्व है । शब्दसे होनेबाला ज्ञान आकाशसे उत्पन्न होता है; उसी प्रकार है विप्रो  स्पर्शसे होनेवाला ज्ञान वायुसे उत्पन्न होता है । है द्विजो
verses.wordMeaning: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:
verses.commentary: Sense: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:

verses.sanskrit: घृतेनाष्टशतं हुत्वा सद्यः शान्तिर्भविष्यति चन्द्रसूर्यग्रहे लिङ्गं समभ्यर्च्य यथाविधि
verses.transliteration: ghṛtenāṣṭaśataṃ hutvā sadyaḥ śāntirbhaviṣyati candrasūryagrahe liṅgaṃ samabhyarcya yathāvidhi

verses.hindi: रूपका ज्ञान अग्निसे और रसका ज्ञान जलसे उत्पन कहा गया है; गन्धका ज्ञान पृथ्वीसे उत्पन्न होता है। पुन; हे विप्रो! दाहिने नेत्रमें सूर्य, बायें नेत्रमें सोम तथा हृदयमें सर्वव्यापक पुरुषका चिन्तन करना चाहिए । है द्विजोत्तमो!

verses.transliteration: brahmahatyāviśuddhyarthaṃ japellakṣāyutaṃ naraḥ pātakānāṃ tadardhaṃ syān nātra kāryā vicāraṇā
verses.translation: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:
verses.hindi: अविनाशी जो शिवपद है, सत्त्वशक्तिका आश्रय लेकर उसका अर्चन करना चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:
verses.commentary: Sense: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:

verses.sanskrit: उपपातकदुष्टानां तदर्धं परिकीर्तितम् शेषाणामपि पापानां जपेत्पञ्चसहस्रकम्
verses.transliteration: upapātakaduṣṭānāṃ tadardhaṃ parikīrtitam śeṣāṇāmapi pāpānāṃ japetpañcasahasrakam
verses.translation: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:
verses.hindi: पूजामें लीन रहनेवाला, सब प्रकारसे धर्में निष्ठा रखनेवाला, सदा उत्साहसे सम्पन्न, एकाग्रचित्त, सभी इन्द्दोंको सहनेवाला, धैर्यशाली, सभी प्राणियोंके हितमें रत, सरल स्वभाववाला, सदा स्वस्थ मनवाला, कोमल चित्तवाला, मानरहित, बुद्धिमान्, शान्त, प्रतिद्दन्द्वितासे रहित, सदा मुक्तिको इच्छा रखनेवाला, धर्मज्ञ, आत्माके लक्षणोंको जाननेवाला, तीनों प्रकारके ऋणोंसे मुक्त तथा पूर्वजन्ममें पुण्यशाली होता है; वह द्विज श्रद्धाके साथ
verses.wordMeaning: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:
verses.commentary: Sense: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:

verses.sanskrit: आत्मबोधपरं गुह्यं शिवबोधप्रकाशकम् शिवः स्यात्स जपेन्मन्त्रं पञ्चलक्षम् अनाकुलः
verses.transliteration: ātmabodhaparaṃ guhyaṃ śivabodhaprakāśakam śivaḥ syātsa japenmantraṃ pañcalakṣam anākulaḥ
verses.translation: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:
verses.hindi: पाखण्डरहित होकर गुरुकी सेवा करके वृद्ध होनेपर स्वर्गलोक प्राप्त करके वहाँ क्रमसे सुखोंका भोग करके पुनः भारतवर्षमें जन्म लेकर ब्रह्मवेत्ता होता है और हे द्विजो ! ज्ञानीके सम्पर्कसे ज्ञान प्राप्त करके योगवेत्ता होता
verses.wordMeaning: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:
verses.commentary: Sense: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चवायुजयं भद्रे प्राप्नोति मनुजः सुखम् जपेच्च पञ्चलक्षं तु विगृहीतेन्द्रियः शुचिः
verses.transliteration: pañcavāyujayaṃ bhadre prāpnoti manujaḥ sukham japecca pañcalakṣaṃ tu vigṛhītendriyaḥ śuciḥ
verses.translation: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:
verses.hindi: है। है श्रेष्ठ द्विजो ! अज्ञानीके लिये ज्ञानप्राप्तिकी यही विधि है; अतः है श्रेष्ठ मुनियो ! इसी मार्गके द्वारा आसक्तिरहित तथा दृढ़ व्रतवाला व्यक्ति संसाररूपी कालकूट (विष) - से मुक्त हो जाता है॥ १४७-१५३१/२॥ इस प्रकार मैंने आप लोगोंको संक्षेपमें प्रसंगवश ज्ञानका अचल तथा उत्तम माहात्म्य बता दिया। इस पाशुपत योगको स्वयं महेश्वरने कहा है। है श्रेष्ठ मुनियो ! शिवके द्वारा कहे गये इस योगको जिस किसीको
verses.wordMeaning: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:
verses.commentary: Sense: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चेन्द्रियाणां विजयो भविष्यति वरानने ध्यानयुक्तो जपेद्यस्तु पञ्चलक्षमनाकुलः
verses.transliteration: pañcendriyāṇāṃ vijayo bhaviṣyati varānane dhyānayukto japedyastu pañcalakṣamanākulaḥ
verses.translation: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:
verses.hindi: भी नहीं बताना चाहिए, अपितु भस्मनिष्ठ अर्थात् शिवतत्त्वनिष्ठ योगीको ही इस अत्यन्त प्रिय योगका
verses.wordMeaning: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:
verses.commentary: Sense: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:

verses.sanskrit: विषयाणां च पञ्चानां जयं प्राप्नोति मानवः चतुर्थं पञ्चलक्षं तु यो जपेद्भक्तिसंयुतः
verses.transliteration: viṣayāṇāṃ ca pañcānāṃ jayaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ caturthaṃ pañcalakṣaṃ tu yo japedbhaktisaṃyutaḥ
verses.translation: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:
verses.hindi: UTES 0 ककया. फफफ फक फफ फफफफफफफफफफफफफफी मा का फफफ फ फ फफ फफ क फ़ फ फ फ फ फ़ फ फ फ़ फ फ फ फ फा फा फ फा मा फ फ फ फ फ फ फ फ फ फ फ फ फ फ़ फ फफफफफ फफफ सदा उपदेश करना चाहिए। जो मनुष्य इस स॑ विषका नाश करनेवाले आख्यानको पढता अथवा है, वह ब्रह्मसायुज्य प्राप्त करता है; इसमें सह
verses.wordMeaning: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:
verses.commentary: Sense: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:

verses.sanskrit: भूतानामिह पञ्चानां विजयं मनुजो लभेत् चतुर्लक्षं जपेद्यस्तु मनः संयम्य यत्नतः
verses.transliteration: bhūtānāmiha pañcānāṃ vijayaṃ manujo labhet caturlakṣaṃ japedyastu manaḥ saṃyamya yatnataḥ
verses.translation: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:
verses.hindi: स याति ब्रह्मसायुज्यं नात्र कार्या विचारणा॥ १५७  करना चाहिए ॥ १५४--१५७॥॥
verses.wordMeaning: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:
verses.commentary: Sense: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:

verses.sanskrit: सम्यग्विजयमाप्नोति करणानां वरानने पञ्चविंशतिलक्षाणां जपेन कमलानने
verses.transliteration: samyagvijayamāpnoti karaṇānāṃ varānane pañcaviṃśatilakṣāṇāṃ japena kamalānane
verses.translation: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:
verses.hindi: सनकादि मुनीश्वरोंको शिवज्ञानका उपदेश एवं चेदनया देव्या हैमवत्या महेश्वर । क्रीडसे विविधैभागैः कथं वक्तुमिहार्हसि
verses.wordMeaning: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:
verses.commentary: Sense: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चविंशतितत्त्वानां विजयं मनुजो लभेत् मध्यरात्रे ऽतिनिर्वाते जपेदयुतमादरात्
verses.transliteration: pañcaviṃśatitattvānāṃ vijayaṃ manujo labhet madhyarātre 'tinirvāte japedayutamādarāt
verses.translation: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:
verses.hindi: एवमुक्तः प्रहस्येशः पिनाकी नीललोहितः। प्राह तामम्बिकां प्रक्ष्य प्रणिपत्य स्थितान् द्विजान्
verses.wordMeaning: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:
verses.commentary: Sense: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मसिद्धिमवाप्नोति व्रतेनानेन सुंदरि जपेल्लक्षमनालस्यो निर्वाते ध्वनिवर्जिते
verses.transliteration: brahmasiddhimavāpnoti vratenānena suṃdari japellakṣamanālasyo nirvāte dhvanivarjite
verses.translation: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:
verses.hindi: बन्धमोक्षौ न चैवेह मम स्वेच्छाशरीरिणः। अकर्ताज्ञः पशुर्जीवो विभुर्भोक्ता ह्यणुः पुमान् मायी च मायया बद्धः कर्मभिर्युज्यते तु सः। ज्ञानं ध्यानं च बन्धश्च मोक्षो नास्त्यात्मनो द्विजाः
verses.wordMeaning: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:
verses.commentary: Sense: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:

verses.sanskrit: मध्यरात्रे च शिवयोः पश्यत्येव न संशयः अन्धकारविनाशश् च दीपस्येव प्रकाशनम्
verses.transliteration: madhyarātre ca śivayoḥ paśyatyeva na saṃśayaḥ andhakāravināśaś ca dīpasyeva prakāśanam
verses.translation: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:
verses.hindi: यहैवं मयि विद्वान् यस्तस्यापि न च सर्वतः। एषा विद्या ह्यहं वेद्यः प्रज्ञैषा च श्रुतिः स्मृतिः
verses.wordMeaning: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:
verses.commentary: Sense: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:

verses.sanskrit: हृदयान्तर्बहिर्वापि भविष्यति न संशयः सर्वसंपत्समृद्ध्यर्थं जपेदयुतमात्मवान्
verses.transliteration: hṛdayāntarbahirvāpi bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ sarvasaṃpatsamṛddhyarthaṃ japedayutamātmavān
verses.translation: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:
verses.hindi: विकारो नैव मायैषा सदसद्व्यक्तिवर्जिता ऋषिगण बोले-यह सुनकर कुमार आदि उ महाबुद्धिमान् मुनियोंने भयभीत होकर प्रसन्न पिनाकधारी परमेश्वरको प्रणाम करके उनसे कहा--'हे महेश्वर! यदि ऐसा है, तो आप इन देवी पार्वतीके साथ
verses.wordMeaning: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:
verses.commentary: Sense: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:

verses.sanskrit: सबीजसंपुटं मन्त्रं शतलक्षं जपेच्छुचिः मत्सायुज्यमवाप्नोति भक्तिमान् किमतः परम्
verses.transliteration: sabījasaṃpuṭaṃ mantraṃ śatalakṣaṃ japecchuciḥ matsāyujyamavāpnoti bhaktimān kimataḥ param
verses.translation: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:
verses.hindi: अनेकविध भोगोंके द्वारा क्रीड़ा क्यों करते हैं; कृपा करके यह बतायें'
verses.wordMeaning: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:
verses.commentary: Sense: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:

verses.sanskrit: इति ते सर्वमाख्यातं पञ्चाक्षरविधिक्रमम् यः पठेच्छृणुयाद्वापि स याति परमां गतिम्
verses.transliteration: iti te sarvamākhyātaṃ pañcākṣaravidhikramam yaḥ paṭhecchṛṇuyādvāpi sa yāti paramāṃ gatim
verses.translation: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:
verses.hindi: सूतजी बोले-- है ऋषियो ! ऐसा कहे जानेपर पिनाकधारी नीललोहित ईश्वरने हँसकर उन अम्बिकाको ओर देखकर वहाँ स्थित द्विजोंको प्रणाम करके उनसे कहा--' अपनी इच्छासे शरीर धारण करनेवाले मेरे लिये न बन्धन है, न मोक्ष है। मैं सर्वव्यापी, कर्तृत्वरहित तथा सर्वज्ञ हुँ; जबकि यह जीव अणुरूप, भोक्ता तथा अज्ञ है। जो मायी है, वह मायासे सकाम कर्मह्वार बँधा हुआ है और वह कमॉसे लिप्त है। है द्विगो!
verses.wordMeaning: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:
verses.commentary: Sense: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:

verses.sanskrit: श्रावयेच्च द्विजाञ्छुद्धान् पञ्चाक्षरविधिक्रमम् दैवे कर्मणि पित्र्ये वा शिवलोके महीयते
verses.transliteration: śrāvayecca dvijāñchuddhān pañcākṣaravidhikramam daive karmaṇi pitrye vā śivaloke mahīyate
verses.translation: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:
verses.hindi: आत्माके लिये ज्ञान, ध्यान, बन्धन तथा मोक्ष नहीं हैं। जो विद्वान् मुझमें ऐसा अनुभव कर लेता है, उसके लिये भी ये सब नहीं होते हैं। ये पार्वती विद्या हँ और मैं वेद्य हूँ। ये प्रज्ञा, श्रुति तथा स्मृति हैं। ये मेर
verses.wordMeaning: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:
verses.commentary: Sense: After hearing it, those sages of great intellect Sanat and others who were frightened, bowed to the Pinaka-bcaring lord Paramesvara who was pleased and spoke to him thus:

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीलिङ्गमहापुराणे पूर्वभागे पञ्चाक्षरमाहात्म्यं नाम पञ्चाशीतितमो ऽध्यायः जपाच्छ्रेष्ठतमं प्राहुर् ब्राह्मणा दग्धकिल्बिषाः विरक्तानां प्रबुद्धानां ध्यानयज्ञं सुशोभनम्
verses.transliteration: iti śrīliṅgamahāpurāṇe pūrvabhāge pañcākṣaramāhātmyaṃ nāma pañcāśītitamo 'dhyāyaḥ japācchreṣṭhatamaṃ prāhur brāhmaṇā dagdhakilbiṣāḥ viraktānāṃ prabuddhānāṃ dhyānayajñaṃ suśobhanam
verses.translation: Hence, O Suta, tell us today about the sacrifice of meditation suited for unattached noble souls in detail and with all effort.
verses.hindi: तथा आज्ञा हैं। ये (परा-अपरा) दोनों विद्या हत इसमें सन्देह नहीं है। ये जीवसम्बन्थी प्रकृति 2 हैं। विचार किया जाय, तो ये विकृति भी नहीं हँ! विकार नहीं हैं; ये माया हैं, जो सत्-असत्से अर्थात् अनिर्वचनीय हैं। पूर्वकालमें लोगोंकों ॐ प्रदान करनेवाली, महाभाग्यवती तथा पाँच मुखवाती
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, O Suta, tell us today about the sacrifice of meditation suited for unattached noble souls in detail and with all effort.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, O Suta, tell us today about the sacrifice of meditation suited for unattached noble souls in detail and with all effort.

verses.sanskrit: तस्माद्वदस्व सूताद्य ध्यानयज्ञमशेषतः विस्तारात्सर्वयत्नेन विरक्तानां महात्मनाम्
verses.transliteration: tasmādvadasva sūtādya dhyānayajñamaśeṣataḥ vistārātsarvayatnena viraktānāṃ mahātmanām
verses.translation: "O lord, O bull-bannered lord, the terrible poison Kalakuta has been neutralised by you. Hence everything has been stabilised by you.'*
verses.hindi: सप्तविंशत्प्रकारेण सर्व व्याप्यानया शिवः
verses.wordMeaning: "O lord, O bull-bannered lord, the terrible poison Kalakuta has been neutralised by you. Hence everything has been stabilised by you.'*
verses.commentary: Sense: "O lord, O bull-bannered lord, the terrible poison Kalakuta has been neutralised by you. Hence everything has been stabilised by you.'*

verses.sanskrit: तेषां तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा मुनीनां दीर्घसत्त्रिणाम् रुद्रेण कथितं प्राह गुहां प्राप्य महात्मनाम्
verses.transliteration: teṣāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā munīnāṃ dīrghasattriṇām rudreṇa kathitaṃ prāha guhāṃ prāpya mahātmanām
verses.translation: On hearing their words, lord Nilalohita, the Atman of the Universe, smilingly said to those sages, Sanandana and others.
verses.hindi: तदाप्रभृति वै मोक्षप्रवृत्तिद्रिजसत्तमा: । भवानी च तमालोक्य मायामहरदव्यया। ते मायामलनिर्मुक्ता मुनयः प्रेक्ष्य पार्वतीम्
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing their words, lord Nilalohita, the Atman of the Universe, smilingly said to those sages, Sanandana and others.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing their words, lord Nilalohita, the Atman of the Universe, smilingly said to those sages, Sanandana and others.

verses.sanskrit: संहृत्य कालकूटाख्यं विषं वै विश्वकर्मणा गुहां प्राप्य सुखासीनं भवान्या सह शङ्करम्
verses.transliteration: saṃhṛtya kālakūṭākhyaṃ viṣaṃ vai viśvakarmaṇā guhāṃ prāpya sukhāsīnaṃ bhavānyā saha śaṅkaram
verses.translation: The poison K&lakuta or halShala — a product of the churned ocean was swallowed by Siva. The blue colour of his neck and his extreme ire are the effects of that poison.
verses.hindi: उमाशङ्करयोर्भेदो नास्त्येव परमार्थतः
verses.wordMeaning: The poison K&lakuta or halShala — a product of the churned ocean was swallowed by Siva. The blue colour of his neck and his extreme ire are the effects of that poison.
verses.commentary: Sense: The poison K&lakuta or halShala — a product of the churned ocean was swallowed by Siva. The blue colour of his neck and his extreme ire are the effects of that poison.

verses.sanskrit: मुनयः संशितात्मानः प्रणेमुस्तं गुहाश्रयम् अस्तुवंश् च ततः सर्वे नीलकण्ठमुमापतिम्
verses.transliteration: munayaḥ saṃśitātmānaḥ praṇemustaṃ guhāśrayam astuvaṃś ca tataḥ sarve nīlakaṇṭhamumāpatim
verses.translation: What is called Kalajkuta is not at all poison when compared to worldly existence which is the real poison. Hence, with all efforts one shall try to dispel that terrible poison.
verses.hindi: तदा मुक्तिः क्षणादेव नान्यथा कर्मकोटिभिः। क्रमोऽविवक्षितो भूतविवृद्धः परमेष्ठिनः प्रसादाहेवदेवस्य नात्र कार्या विचारणा। एष एव जगन्नाथो बन्धमोक्षकरः शिवः
verses.wordMeaning: What is called Kalajkuta is not at all poison when compared to worldly existence which is the real poison. Hence, with all efforts one shall try to dispel that terrible poison.
verses.commentary: Sense: What is called Kalajkuta is not at all poison when compared to worldly existence which is the real poison. Hence, with all efforts one shall try to dispel that terrible poison.

verses.sanskrit: अत्युग्रं कालकूटाख्यं संहृतं भगवंस्त्वया अतः प्रतिष्ठितं सर्वं त्वया देव वृषध्वज
verses.transliteration: atyugraṃ kālakūṭākhyaṃ saṃhṛtaṃ bhagavaṃstvayā ataḥ pratiṣṭhitaṃ sarvaṃ tvayā deva vṛṣadhvaja
verses.translation: The mundane existence is two-fold'® in accordance with one's rights and duties. In regard to men of deluded minds, the mundane existence is very terrible and burden- some. O sages of good holy rites, creation is caused by ignorance due to the defects of malice and attachment.'®® It is certainly due to these, that virtue and evil befall everyone. O brahmins, even in regard to things not near at hand,'®® the scripture creates desire for them even in the minds of good men in the world merely by hearing of it. Hence, the perceptible world and the world of Vedic tradition"® and rituals both should be eschewed" with great effort. He then becomes Virakta (unattached person) altogether.
verses.hindi: सत्यलोकस्तथाण्डानां कोटिकोटिशतानि च
verses.wordMeaning: The mundane existence is two-fold'® in accordance with one's rights and duties. In regard to men of deluded minds, the mundane existence is very terrible and burden- some. O sages of good holy rites,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The mundane existence is two-fold'® in accordance with one's rights and duties. In regard to men of deluded minds, the mundane existence is very terrible and burden- some. O sages of good holy rites,…

verses.sanskrit: तेषां तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा भगवान्नीललोहितः प्रहसन्प्राह विश्वात्मा सनन्दनपुरोगमान्
verses.transliteration: teṣāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā bhagavānnīlalohitaḥ prahasanprāha viśvātmā sanandanapurogamān
verses.translation: Those who do not know these things say: — "Desire is natural" in everyone. The opposite is not seen. It is the Veda that makes them work (for fulfilling such desires).
verses.hindi: विग्रहं देवदेवस्य तथाण्डावरणाष्टकम्। सप्तद्वीपेषु सर्वेषु पर्वतेषु वनेषु च तथान्येषु च लोकेषु वसन्ति च चराचराः
verses.wordMeaning: Those who do not know these things say: — "Desire is natural" in everyone. The opposite is not seen. It is the Veda that makes them work (for fulfilling such desires).
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who do not know these things say: — "Desire is natural" in everyone. The opposite is not seen. It is the Veda that makes them work (for fulfilling such desires).

verses.sanskrit: किमनेन द्विजश्रेष्ठा विषं वक्ष्ये सुदारुणम् संहरेत्तद्विषं यस्तु स समर्थो ह्यनेन किम्
verses.transliteration: kimanena dvijaśreṣṭhā viṣaṃ vakṣye sudāruṇam saṃharettadviṣaṃ yastu sa samartho hyanena kim
verses.translation: i.e. tamasa and rjasa.
verses.hindi: विश्वं भूतं तथा जातं बहुधा रुद्र एव सः। रुद्राज्लेषा स्थिता देवी ह्यनया मुक्तिरम्बिका
verses.wordMeaning: i.e. tamasa and rjasa.
verses.commentary: Sense: i.e. tamasa and rjasa.

verses.sanskrit: न विषं कालकूटाख्यं संसारो विषमुच्यते तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन संहरेत सुदारुणम्
verses.transliteration: na viṣaṃ kālakūṭākhyaṃ saṃsāro viṣamucyate tasmātsarvaprayatnena saṃhareta sudāruṇam
verses.translation: ST* dkjoins 'ucyate bhagam' as 'ucyatc abhagam* and con- strues with 'karmasu*. i.e, karmasu abhagam — non-participation in activities. ST, interprets: hert- metaphysics (kdhyatma-Skstra) is considered to be superior to the Vedas.
verses.hindi: सनकादि मुनीश्वरोंको शिवज्ञानका उपदेश मेरी यह सनातनी आज्ञा मेरे मुखसे उत्पन्न हुई थी। तब जगत्के कल्याणका चिन्तन करता हुआ मैं शिव उस आज्ञामें प्रविष्ट होकर इनके साथ सत्ताईस तत्त्वोंसे सबको व्याप्त करके स्थित हुआ। है श्रेष्ठ द्विजो!
verses.wordMeaning: ST* dkjoins 'ucyate bhagam' as 'ucyatc abhagam* and con- strues with 'karmasu*. i.e, karmasu abhagam — non-participation in activities. ST, interprets: hert- metaphysics (kdhyatma-Skstra) is considered to be superior to the Vedas.
verses.commentary: Sense: ST* dkjoins 'ucyate bhagam' as 'ucyatc abhagam* and con- strues with 'karmasu*. i.e, karmasu abhagam — non-participation in activities. ST, interprets: hert- metaphysics (kdhyatma-Skstra) is considered to be superior to the Vedas.

verses.sanskrit: संसारो द्विविधः प्रोक्तः स्वाधिकारानुरूपतः पुंसां संमूढचित्तानाम् असंक्षीणः सुदारुणः
verses.transliteration: saṃsāro dvividhaḥ proktaḥ svādhikārānurūpataḥ puṃsāṃ saṃmūḍhacittānām asaṃkṣīṇaḥ sudāruṇaḥ
verses.translation: The virtue of renunciation from worldly affairs, is intended for eificicni persons.'" Hence, it is said that worldly exigence is caused by ignorance of all embodied persons.
verses.hindi: तभीसे मुक्ति प्रारम्भ हुई'॥ ३--१०/२॥
verses.wordMeaning: The virtue of renunciation from worldly affairs, is intended for eificicni persons.'" Hence, it is said that worldly exigence is caused by ignorance of all embodied persons.
verses.commentary: Sense: The virtue of renunciation from worldly affairs, is intended for eificicni persons.'" Hence, it is said that worldly exigence is caused by ignorance of all embodied persons.

verses.sanskrit: ईषणारागदोषेण सर्गो ज्ञानेन सुव्रताः तद्वशादेव सर्वेषां धर्माधर्मौ न संशयः
verses.transliteration: īṣaṇārāgadoṣeṇa sargo jñānena suvratāḥ tadvaśādeva sarveṣāṃ dharmādharmau na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: Salvation is not attained by good men through their progeny, through actions, or through wealth.'' Liberation shall occur only through renunciation. He wanders in the world due to the absence of it (renunciation).
verses.hindi: सूतजी बोले-हे ऋषियो! ऐसा कहकर परमेश्वरने भवानीको ओर देखा और सनातनी भवानीने उन परमेशवर-को देखकर मायाको हटा लिया; तब मायाके मलसे मुक्त हुए वे मुनिगण पार्वतीको देखकर प्रसन्न होकर मुक्त हो गये। अतः ये पार्वती ही परागति हैं। वस्तुतः उमा तथा शंकरमें भेद नहीं है; वे शिव दो रूप धारण करके स्थित हैं; इसमें सन्देह नहीं है॥ ११-१३/२॥
verses.wordMeaning: Salvation is not attained by good men through their progeny, through actions, or through wealth.'' Liberation shall occur only through renunciation. He wanders in the world due to the absence of it (renunciation).
verses.commentary: Sense: Salvation is not attained by good men through their progeny, through actions, or through wealth.'' Liberation shall occur only through renunciation. He wanders in the world due to the absence of it (renunciation).

verses.sanskrit: असन्निकृष्टे त्वर्थे ऽपि शास्त्रं तच्छ्रवणात्सताम् बुद्धिमुत्पादयत्येव संसारे विदुषां द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: asannikṛṣṭe tvarthe 'pi śāstraṃ tacchravaṇātsatām buddhimutpādayatyeva saṃsāre viduṣāṃ dvijāḥ
verses.translation: Thus due to the fault of ignorance and as a result of various Karmans, the individual soul adopts a body produced by six Kosas'" (vestures).
verses.hindi: जब शिवकी मायासे विद्वान् अनासक्त हो जाता है, तब क्षणभरमें उसकी मुक्ति हो जाती है; अन्यथा करोड़ों कर्मोसे भी मुक्ति नहीं होती। ऋषियोंके द्वारा बताया गया मुक्तिक्रम परमेष्ठी शिवके लिये विवक्षित
verses.wordMeaning: Thus due to the fault of ignorance and as a result of various Karmans, the individual soul adopts a body produced by six Kosas'" (vestures).
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus due to the fault of ignorance and as a result of various Karmans, the individual soul adopts a body produced by six Kosas'" (vestures).

verses.sanskrit: तस्माद्दृष्टानुश्रविकं दुष्टमित्युभयात्मकम् संत्यजेत्सर्वयत्नेन विरक्तः सो ऽभिधीयते
verses.transliteration: tasmāddṛṣṭānuśravikaṃ duṣṭamityubhayātmakam saṃtyajetsarvayatnena viraktaḥ so 'bhidhīyate
verses.translation: Many miseries are to be faced by the individual in the womb, in the vaginal passage, on the earth, in boyhood, in youth, in old age and in death.
verses.hindi: नहीं है। परमेश्वरको कृपासे क्षणभरमें मुक्ति हो जाती है, यह उनकी प्रतिज्ञा है; इसमें सन्देह नहीं है । परमेष्ठी शिवकी कृपासे जीव मुक्त हो जाता है, चाहे वह गर्भमें वृद्ध हो। देवोंके देव महेश्वर-के अनुग्रहसे अण्डज, उद्भिज्ज तथा स्वेदज प्राणी भी मुक्त हो जाता है; इसमें सन्देह नहीं करना चाहिए॥ १४-१७/२॥
verses.wordMeaning: Many miseries are to be faced by the individual in the womb, in the vaginal passage, on the earth, in boyhood, in youth, in old age and in death.
verses.commentary: Sense: Many miseries are to be faced by the individual in the womb, in the vaginal passage, on the earth, in boyhood, in youth, in old age and in death.

verses.sanskrit: शास्त्रमित्युच्यते भागं श्रुतेः कर्मसु तद्द्विजाः मूर्धानं ब्रह्मणः सारम् ऋषीणां कर्मणः फलम्
verses.transliteration: śāstramityucyate bhāgaṃ śruteḥ karmasu taddvijāḥ mūrdhānaṃ brahmaṇaḥ sāram ṛṣīṇāṃ karmaṇaḥ phalam
verses.translation: For those who are unattached activities arc not unavoidable. Gf. "pravrttir esa bhutam nivrttistu mahabala" — Manu; Or activities have no fixed goal, Gf. Bhaga. 'vedoktam eva kurvano nissangarpitamisvarc/ naiskarmyani labhate siddbim rocanartha phalarutih //
verses.hindi: ये जगत्पति शिव ही बन्धन तथा मोक्ष करनेवाले हैं। भूः, भुवः, स्वः, महः, जनः, तपः तथा सत्यम् ये लोक और करोड़ों-करोड़ों ब्रह्माण्ड तथा अण्डोंके आठौं आवरण-ये सब उन देवदेव महेश्वर-के
verses.wordMeaning: For those who are unattached activities arc not unavoidable. Gf. "pravrttir esa bhutam nivrttistu mahabala" — Manu; Or activities have no fixed goal, Gf. Bhaga. 'vedoktam eva kurvano nissangarpitamisvarc/ naiskarmyani labhate siddbim rocanartha phalarutih //
verses.commentary: Sense: For those who are unattached activities arc not unavoidable. Gf. "pravrttir esa bhutam nivrttistu mahabala" — Manu; Or activities have no fixed goal, Gf. Bhaga. 'vedoktam eva kurvano nissangarpitamisvarc/ naiskarmyani labhate siddbim rocanartha phalarutih //

verses.sanskrit: ननु स्वभावः सर्वेषां कामो दृष्टो न चान्यथा श्रुतिः प्रवर्तिका तेषाम् इति कर्मण्यतद्विदः
verses.transliteration: nanu svabhāvaḥ sarveṣāṃ kāmo dṛṣṭo na cānyathā śrutiḥ pravartikā teṣām iti karmaṇyatadvidaḥ
verses.translation: trividhah jivah— the invidividual soul is threefold (See V-iB below ).
verses.hindi: विग्रह (शरीर) हें । सातौं द्वीपोंमें, सभी पर्वतोंमें, वनोंमें, समुद्रोंमें, सभी वायुके स्कन्धोंमें तथा अन्य लोकोंमें जो चराचर जीव निवास करते हैं-वे सब शिवके अंशसे उत्पन्न हुए हैं; निश्चित रूपसे इनकी गति वे ही हैं। सब कुछ रुद्र ही हैं। उन महात्मा पुरुषको नमस्कार है
verses.wordMeaning: trividhah jivah— the invidividual soul is threefold (See V-iB below ).
verses.commentary: Sense: trividhah jivah— the invidividual soul is threefold (See V-iB below ).

verses.sanskrit: निवृत्तिलक्षणो धर्मः समर्थानाम् इहोच्यते तस्मादज्ञानमूलो हि संसारः सर्वदेहिनाम्
verses.transliteration: nivṛttilakṣaṇo dharmaḥ samarthānām ihocyate tasmādajñānamūlo hi saṃsāraḥ sarvadehinām
verses.translation: §at-kausikam— snayvadi-§atko5a-yuktam ST. consistini of six coverings cf.
verses.hindi: उन रुद्रने ही सम्पूर्ण जगत्को तथा सभी जीवोंको
verses.wordMeaning: §at-kausikam— snayvadi-§atko5a-yuktam ST. consistini of six coverings cf.
verses.commentary: Sense: §at-kausikam— snayvadi-§atko5a-yuktam ST. consistini of six coverings cf.

verses.sanskrit: कला संशोषमायाति कर्मणान्यस्वभावतः सकलस्त्रिविधो जीवो ज्ञानहीनस्त्वविद्यया
verses.transliteration: kalā saṃśoṣamāyāti karmaṇānyasvabhāvataḥ sakalastrividho jīvo jñānahīnastvavidyayā
verses.translation: O brahmins, if duly pondered over, good men have to face only misery through the contact with women and similar activities. The miserable try to quell one misery only by another misery.
verses.hindi: श्रीलिड्रमहापुराण यदावलोक्य तान् सर्वान् प्रसादादनयाम्बिका
verses.wordMeaning: O brahmins, if duly pondered over, good men have to face only misery through the contact with women and similar activities. The miserable try to quell one misery only by another misery.
verses.commentary: Sense: O brahmins, if duly pondered over, good men have to face only misery through the contact with women and similar activities. The miserable try to quell one misery only by another misery.

verses.sanskrit: नारकी पापकृत्स्वर्गी पुण्यकृत् पुण्यगौरवात् व्यतिमिश्रेण वै जीवश् चतुर्धा संव्यवस्थितः
verses.transliteration: nārakī pāpakṛtsvargī puṇyakṛt puṇyagauravāt vyatimiśreṇa vai jīvaś caturdhā saṃvyavasthitaḥ
verses.translation: Lust is never quelled by means of enjoyment of plea- sures. Just as fire blazes all the more by Havis (ghee offer- ing) so also lust is inflamed all the more by indulging into pleasure.'®
verses.hindi: उत्पन्न किया है । ये देवी अम्बिका रुद्रकी
verses.wordMeaning: Lust is never quelled by means of enjoyment of plea- sures. Just as fire blazes all the more by Havis (ghee offer- ing) so also lust is inflamed all the more by indulging into pleasure.'®
verses.commentary: Sense: Lust is never quelled by means of enjoyment of plea- sures. Just as fire blazes all the more by Havis (ghee offer- ing) so also lust is inflamed all the more by indulging into pleasure.'®

verses.sanskrit: उद्भिज्जः स्वेदजश्चैव अण्डजो वै जरायुजः एवं व्यवस्थितो देही कर्मणाज्ञो ह्यनिर्वृतः
verses.transliteration: udbhijjaḥ svedajaścaiva aṇḍajo vai jarāyujaḥ evaṃ vyavasthito dehī karmaṇājño hyanirvṛtaḥ
verses.translation: Hence, on pondering over, it will be seen that there is no happiness unto men even due to coitus. There is misery in earning wealth as also in preserving and spending it. O excellent brahmins, if we ponder over it, there is misery amongst the Piacas, Raksasas, Yaksas, Gandharvas, in the world of the moon, in the world of mercury, in the world of Prajapati, in the world of the Brahman, in the world of Prakrti and Purusa also. O sages of good holy rites, there are miseries due to destruction of possessions, due to one's possession being excelled by another's, etc. These cause only other miseries.
verses.hindi: विराजमान हैं; मुक्ति इन्हींसे प्रप्त होती है--ऐसा सिद्धोंने प्रसन्नचित्त होकर कहा है। जब वे शिव इन आज्ञारूपी अम्बिकाके साथ स्थित होकर उन सबको कृपापूर्वक देखते हैं, तब वे आकाशचारी सिद्धगण प्रभुका सायुज्य प्राप्त कर लेते हैं और सदाके लिये उसीमें स्थित
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, on pondering over, it will be seen that there is no happiness unto men even due to coitus. There is misery in earning wealth as also in preserving and spending it. O excellent brahmins, if we ponder over it, there is misery amongst the Piacas, Raksasas, Yaksas,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, on pondering over, it will be seen that there is no happiness unto men even due to coitus. There is misery in earning wealth as also in preserving and spending it. O excellent brahmins, if we ponder over it, there is misery amongst the Piacas, Raksasas, Yaksas,…

verses.sanskrit: प्रजया कर्मणा मुक्तिर् धनेन च सतां न हि त्यागेनैकेन मुक्तिः स्यात् तदभावाद्भ्रमत्यसौ
verses.transliteration: prajayā karmaṇā muktir dhanena ca satāṃ na hi tyāgenaikena muktiḥ syāt tadabhāvādbhramatyasau
verses.translation: One shall eschew those impure fortunes and riches. Hence, O sinless sages of good holy rites, all kinds of pleasures are really miseries to the discriminating person in whatever way you view them, viz., eightfold or sixteenfold or of twentyfour, thirty two, fortyeight, fiftysix, or sixtyfour types.
verses.hindi: तदा तिष्ठन्ति सायुज्यं प्राप्तास्ते खेचराः प्रभोः ॥ २५  हो जाते हैं ॥ २३--२५॥
verses.wordMeaning: One shall eschew those impure fortunes and riches. Hence, O sinless sages of good holy rites, all kinds of pleasures are really miseries to the discriminating person in whatever way you view them, viz., eightfold or sixteenfold or of twentyfour, thirty two, fortyeight,…
verses.commentary: Sense: One shall eschew those impure fortunes and riches. Hence, O sinless sages of good holy rites, all kinds of pleasures are really miseries to the discriminating person in whatever way you view them, viz., eightfold or sixteenfold or of twentyfour, thirty two, fortyeight,…

verses.sanskrit: एवमज्ञानदोषेण नानाकर्मवशेन च षट्कौशिकं समुद्भूतं भजत्येष कलेवरम्
verses.transliteration: evamajñānadoṣeṇa nānākarmavaśena ca ṣaṭkauśikaṃ samudbhūtaṃ bhajatyeṣa kalevaram
verses.translation: The pleasures of the following types are undoubte- dly miseries if pondered over properly even to those yogins who talk of Brahman: — Parthiva (earthly), Apya (watery) Taijasa (fiery), Vayavya (gaseous), Vyauma (of the firmament), Manasa (mental), Abhimanika, (bringing pride), Bauddha'®® (intellectual), PrSkrta (pertaining to Prakrti).
verses.hindi: पाशुपतयोगसे प्राप्त होनेवाली अष्टसिद्रियोंका वर्णन तथा प्राणाग्निहोमका स्वरूप केन योगेन वै सूत गुणप्राप्तिः सतामिह।
verses.wordMeaning: The pleasures of the following types are undoubte- dly miseries if pondered over properly even to those yogins who talk of Brahman: — Parthiva (earthly), Apya (watery) Taijasa (fiery), Vayavya (gaseous), Vyauma (of the firmament), Manasa (mental), Abhimanika, (bringing pride),…
verses.commentary: Sense: The pleasures of the following types are undoubte- dly miseries if pondered over properly even to those yogins who talk of Brahman: — Parthiva (earthly), Apya (watery) Taijasa (fiery), Vayavya (gaseous), Vyauma (of the firmament), Manasa (mental), Abhimanika, (bringing pride),…

verses.sanskrit: गर्भे दुःखान्यनेकानि योनिमार्गे च भूतले कौमारे यौवने चैव वार्द्धके मरणे ऽपि वा
verses.transliteration: garbhe duḥkhānyanekāni yonimārge ca bhūtale kaumāre yauvane caiva vārddhake maraṇe 'pi vā
verses.translation: The attributes (?) of the leaders of the Ganas are, on reflection, causes of misery. In all the worlds there is always misery in the beginning, in the middle and in the end. The present ones are miseries, the future ones are miseries. (?) In the lands defiled by faults, there are various kinds af miseries.
verses.hindi: स्मरेच्च तत्तथा मध्ये देव्या देवमुमापतिम्
verses.wordMeaning: The attributes (?) of the leaders of the Ganas are, on reflection, causes of misery. In all the worlds there is always misery in the beginning, in the middle and in the end. The present ones are miseries, the future ones are miseries. (?) In the lands defiled by faults,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The attributes (?) of the leaders of the Ganas are, on reflection, causes of misery. In all the worlds there is always misery in the beginning, in the middle and in the end. The present ones are miseries, the future ones are miseries. (?) In the lands defiled by faults,…

verses.sanskrit: विचारतः सतां दुःखं स्त्रीसंसर्गादिभिर् द्विजाः दुःखेनैकेन वै दुःखं प्रशाम्यतीह दुःखिनः
verses.transliteration: vicārataḥ satāṃ duḥkhaṃ strīsaṃsargādibhir dvijāḥ duḥkhenaikena vai duḥkhaṃ praśāmyatīha duḥkhinaḥ
verses.translation: bauddham prakrtam eva ca: the intellectual enjoymertt is also material.
verses.hindi: ताभिश्चाष्टविधा रुद्राश्चतुःषष्टिविधाः पुन: एवं पाशुपतं योगं मोक्षसिद्धिप्रदायकम्। तस्याणिमादयो विप्रा नान्यथा कर्मकोटिभिः
verses.wordMeaning: bauddham prakrtam eva ca: the intellectual enjoymertt is also material.
verses.commentary: Sense: bauddham prakrtam eva ca: the intellectual enjoymertt is also material.

verses.sanskrit: न जातु कामः कामानाम् उपभोगेन शाम्यति हविषा कृष्णवर्त्मेव भूय एवाभिवर्धते
verses.transliteration: na jātu kāmaḥ kāmānām upabhogena śāmyati haviṣā kṛṣṇavartmeva bhūya evābhivardhate
verses.translation: Just as the tree whose roots have been cut falls down to the ground helplessly so also the living being overwhelmed by various kinds of ailments, passion, hatred, fear, etc.®
verses.hindi: ऋषिगण बोले--हे सूतजी ! किस योगसे सज्जनोंको इस लोकमें मोक्षकी प्राप्ति होती है और योगिजन अणिमा आदि गुणोंसे युक्त होते हें ? है सूतजी! इस समय आप विस्तारपूर्वक यह सब बतायें
verses.wordMeaning: Just as the tree whose roots have been cut falls down to the ground helplessly so also the living being overwhelmed by various kinds of ailments, passion, hatred, fear, etc.®
verses.commentary: Sense: Just as the tree whose roots have been cut falls down to the ground helplessly so also the living being overwhelmed by various kinds of ailments, passion, hatred, fear, etc.®

verses.sanskrit: तस्माद्विचारतो नास्ति संयोगादपि वै नृणाम् अर्थानाम् अर्जने ऽप्येवं पालने च व्यये तथा
verses.transliteration: tasmādvicārato nāsti saṃyogādapi vai nṛṇām arthānām arjane 'pyevaṃ pālane ca vyaye tathā
verses.translation: Similarly the heaven-dwellers fall down to the earth due to the destruction of the tree of merit. Even for heaven-dwellers who desire for things that cause misery and who are richly endowed with pleasures that cause misery, there is terrible misery when they fall from that heaven. There is definitely misery in the hell due to the fact that even religious students resort to it when they do not perform those rites that are laid down, O leading sages.
verses.hindi: सूतजी बोले-हे ऋषियो! अब मैं परम दुर्लभ योगका वर्णन करूँगा। सबसे पहले चित्तमें सनातन शिवको स्थापित करके उनके सद्योजात आदि पाँच रूपोंका स्मरण करना चाहिए और है श्रेष्ठ ब्राह्मणो ! चन्द्र-सूर्य-अग्निसे युक्त तथा छब्बीस शक्तियो समन्वित अष्टदलकमल, उसके ऊपर षोडशदल- कमल, पुनः उसके ऊपर द्वादशदलकमलरूप आसनकी भावना करनी चाहिए। तदनन्तर है द्विजो! उसके मध्य
verses.wordMeaning: Similarly the heaven-dwellers fall down to the earth due to the destruction of the tree of merit. Even for heaven-dwellers who desire for things that cause misery and who are richly endowed with pleasures that cause misery,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Similarly the heaven-dwellers fall down to the earth due to the destruction of the tree of merit. Even for heaven-dwellers who desire for things that cause misery and who are richly endowed with pleasures that cause misery,…

verses.sanskrit: पैशाचे राक्षसे दुःखं याक्षे चैव विचारतः गान्धर्वे च तथा चान्द्रे सौम्यलोके द्विजोत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: paiśāce rākṣase duḥkhaṃ yākṣe caiva vicārataḥ gāndharve ca tathā cāndre saumyaloke dvijottamāḥ
verses.translation: Just as the deer frightened of death and uprooted from his habitation does not obtain sleep so also the noble-souled as- cetic engaged in meditation and frightened of the worldly existence does not obtain slumber.
verses.hindi: देवीके साथ आठ शक्तियोंसहित अष्टमूर्ति, अजन्मा, ऐश्वर्यमय भगवान् उमापतिका स्मरण करना चाहिए  उन शक्तियोंके साथ आठ रुद्र और आठौं सिड्धयांसे सम्पन्न सभी चौंसठ शक्तियाँ प्रतिष्ठित हैं--ऐसा क्रमसे
verses.wordMeaning: Just as the deer frightened of death and uprooted from his habitation does not obtain sleep so also the noble-souled as- cetic engaged in meditation and frightened of the worldly existence does not obtain slumber.
verses.commentary: Sense: Just as the deer frightened of death and uprooted from his habitation does not obtain sleep so also the noble-souled as- cetic engaged in meditation and frightened of the worldly existence does not obtain slumber.

verses.sanskrit: प्राजापत्ये तथा ब्राह्मे प्राकृते पौरुषे तथा क्षयसातिशयाद्यैस्तु दुःखैर्दुःखानि सुव्रताः
verses.transliteration: prājāpatye tathā brāhme prākṛte pauruṣe tathā kṣayasātiśayādyaistu duḥkhairduḥkhāni suvratāḥ
verses.translation: Unhappiness is seen even in germs, birds, animals, deer, elephants and horses. Hence there is great happiness unto a man who renounces.
verses.hindi: स्मरण करना चाहिए। है विप्रो! इस प्रकार उत्तम जा प्राप्त करके जो मोक्षसिद्धि प्रदान करनेवाले करता है, उसे अणिमा आदि सिद्धियाँ प्राप्त हो जाती हैं; अन्यथा करोड़ों उपाय करनेपर भी नहीं हे मुनियो! योगियोंका आठ गुणोंसे युक्त श्व
verses.wordMeaning: Unhappiness is seen even in germs, birds, animals, deer, elephants and horses. Hence there is great happiness unto a man who renounces.
verses.commentary: Sense: Unhappiness is seen even in germs, birds, animals, deer, elephants and horses. Hence there is great happiness unto a man who renounces.

verses.sanskrit: तानि भाग्यान्यशुद्धानि संत्यजेच्च धनानि च तस्मादष्टगुणं भोगं तथा षोडशधा स्थितम्
verses.transliteration: tāni bhāgyānyaśuddhāni saṃtyajecca dhanāni ca tasmādaṣṭaguṇaṃ bhogaṃ tathā ṣoḍaśadhā sthitam
verses.translation: O sages of good holy rites, there is misery unto even those officers on duty spread over the whole kalpa who move about in aerial chariots, unto Manu and others who take pride in their respective positions.
verses.hindi: ८  पाशुपतयोगसे अष्टसिद्धियोंका अध्याय ८८ पाशु प्राप्त होनेवाली अष्टसिद्धियोंका वर्णन तथा प्राणाग्निहोमका स्वरूप ४४९
verses.wordMeaning: O sages of good holy rites, there is misery unto even those officers on duty spread over the whole kalpa who move about in aerial chariots, unto Manu and others who take pride in their respective positions.
verses.commentary: Sense: O sages of good holy rites, there is misery unto even those officers on duty spread over the whole kalpa who move about in aerial chariots, unto Manu and others who take pride in their respective positions.

verses.sanskrit: चतुर्विंशत्प्रकारेण संस्थितं चापि सुव्रताः द्वात्रिंशद्भेदमनघाश् चत्वारिंशद्गुणं पुनः
verses.transliteration: caturviṃśatprakāreṇa saṃsthitaṃ cāpi suvratāḥ dvātriṃśadbhedamanaghāś catvāriṃśadguṇaṃ punaḥ
verses.translation: The activities enjoined for the attainment of heaven are not
verses.hindi: अर कज कक ककी फफफफफ प्राकाम्यं चैव सर्वत्र ईशित्वं चैव सर्वतः
verses.wordMeaning: The activities enjoined for the attainment of heaven are not
verses.commentary: Sense: The activities enjoined for the attainment of heaven are not

verses.sanskrit: तथाष्टचत्वारिंशच्च षट्पञ्चाशत्प्रकारतः चतुःषष्टिविधं चैव दुःखमेव विवेकिनः
verses.transliteration: tathāṣṭacatvāriṃśacca ṣaṭpañcāśatprakārataḥ catuḥṣaṣṭividhaṃ caiva duḥkhameva vivekinaḥ
verses.translation: As soon as he has exhausted merit the heaven-dweller falls from
verses.hindi: गया है। उन सबको क्रमसे बता रहा हूँ;
verses.wordMeaning: As soon as he has exhausted merit the heaven-dweller falls from
verses.commentary: Sense: As soon as he has exhausted merit the heaven-dweller falls from

verses.sanskrit: पार्थिवं च तथाप्यं च तैजसं च विचारतः वायव्यं च तथा व्यौम[ं] मानसं च यथाक्रमम्
verses.transliteration: pārthivaṃ ca tathāpyaṃ ca taijasaṃ ca vicārataḥ vāyavyaṃ ca tathā vyauma[ṃ] mānasaṃ ca yathākramam
verses.translation: Devas and Daityas undergo misery due to their desire for mutual conquest. Even kings and Raksasas in the three worlds undergo misery.
verses.hindi: प्राकाम्य, ईशित्व, वशित्व तथा कामावसायिता-ये आठ सिद्धियाँ हैं। सभी कामनाओंको पूर्ण करनेवाले उस ऐश्वर्यको भी तीन प्रकारका जानना चाहिए; सावद्य, निरवद्य तथा सूक्ष्म-ये तीन प्रकार होते हैं। उनमें जो सावद्य है, वह पंचभूतात्मक कहा गया है। इन्द्रियाँ, मन तथा जो अहंकार कहा गया है-ये निरवद्य ऐश्वर्य हैं। आत्मामें पंचभूतोंको तन्मात्रारूपा सूक्ष्म प्रवृत्ति ही सूक्ष्म ऐश्वर्य है। इस प्रकार इन्द्रियाँ, मन,
verses.wordMeaning: Devas and Daityas undergo misery due to their desire for mutual conquest. Even kings and Raksasas in the three worlds undergo misery.
verses.commentary: Sense: Devas and Daityas undergo misery due to their desire for mutual conquest. Even kings and Raksasas in the three worlds undergo misery.

verses.sanskrit: आभिमानिकमप्येवं बौद्धं प्राकृतमेव च दुःखमेव न संदेहो योगिनां ब्रह्मवादिनाम्
verses.transliteration: ābhimānikamapyevaṃ bauddhaṃ prākṛtameva ca duḥkhameva na saṃdeho yogināṃ brahmavādinām
verses.translation: In fact the Aramas bring about only misery or exhaustion (rama) unto the different castes.
