People do not attain the Atman through Asramas (stages in life), Vedas, yajnas, Samkhyas, (numerical knowledge), vratas (holy rites), severe penances, different kinds of charitable gifts, etc. But people with knowledge obtain it. Hence, with all efforts one shall perform the Pasupata rite. In the holy rite of Pasu- pata, the learned devotee shall perpetually lie on bhasman, besmeared with ashes.
verses.hindi: चित्त, बुद्धि तथा अहंकार निरवद्य ऐश्वर्य हैं; पंचभूतमय ऐश्वर्य सावद्य नामवाला है और शब्द आदि
verses.wordMeaning: In fact the Aramas bring about only misery or exhaustion (rama) unto the different castes. People do not attain the Atman through Asramas (stages in life), Vedas, yajnas, Samkhyas, (numerical knowledge), vratas (holy rites), severe penances, different kinds of charitable gifts,…
verses.commentary: Sense: In fact the Aramas bring about only misery or exhaustion (rama) unto the different castes. People do not attain the Atman through Asramas (stages in life), Vedas, yajnas, Samkhyas, (numerical knowledge), vratas (holy rites), severe penances, different kinds of charitable gifts,…

verses.sanskrit: गौणं गणेश्वराणां च दुःखमेव विचारतः आदौ मध्ये तथा चान्ते सर्वलोकेषु सर्वदा
verses.transliteration: gauṇaṃ gaṇeśvarāṇāṃ ca duḥkhameva vicārataḥ ādau madhye tathā cānte sarvalokeṣu sarvadā
verses.translation: The learned devotee, richly endowed with the knowledge of the five objects and having great attention to- wards the principle of Siva shall adopt the yoga that causes salvation and destroys fate and karman and shall become intelligent and endowed v/ith the yoga of five objects. There- by he attains the end of misery. The devotees understand the knowable by means of Para Vidya'®* and not by Apara Vidya.
verses.hindi: अणिमा आदि सूक्ष्म ऐश्वर्योमें प्रवृत्त होता है। पुनः आठ गुणोंका भेद भी सूक्ष्म ऐश्वर्योमें होता है। तीनों लोकोंके सभी प्राणियोंमें सर्वत्र यह अणिमादि अव्यक्त ऐश्वर्य जिस प्रकारसे प्रतिष्ठित है और जैसा इसका नियम बताया गया है-भगवान् प्रभुने इस विषयमे जैसा कहा है, उसके स्वरूपको मैं बताऊँगा। जो ऐश्वर्य त्रिलोकीमें सभी प्राणियोंके लिये दुर्लभ बताया गया है, वह योगियोंके लिये प्राप्त होनेवाला अणिमारूप पहला
verses.wordMeaning: The learned devotee, richly endowed with the knowledge of the five objects and having great attention to- wards the principle of Siva shall adopt the yoga that causes salvation and destroys fate and karman and shall become intelligent and endowed v/ith the yoga of five objects.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The learned devotee, richly endowed with the knowledge of the five objects and having great attention to- wards the principle of Siva shall adopt the yoga that causes salvation and destroys fate and karman and shall become intelligent and endowed v/ith the yoga of five objects.…

verses.sanskrit: वर्तमानानि दुःखानि भविष्याणि यथातथम् दोषदुष्टेषु देशेषु दुःखानि विविधानि च
verses.transliteration: vartamānāni duḥkhāni bhaviṣyāṇi yathātatham doṣaduṣṭeṣu deśeṣu duḥkhāni vividhāni ca
verses.translation: Two Vidyas (topics of knowledge) are to be known: Para and Apara, O excellent brahmins, Apara consists of Rg, Yajur, Sama, and Atharva Vedas. Siksa, Kalpa, grammar, semantics, prosody and astrology also constitute Apara Vidya.
verses.hindi: बल होता है; इसका स्वरूप संसारमें कहीं भी, कभी भी लंघन तथा प्लवन करनेका होता है॥ ८--१७॥ सभी प्राणियोंको अपेक्षा शीघ्रत्व गुणसे सम्पन्न होना लघिमा नामक दूसरी सिद्धि कही गयी है। तीनों
verses.wordMeaning: Two Vidyas (topics of knowledge) are to be known: Para and Apara, O excellent brahmins, Apara consists of Rg, Yajur, Sama, and Atharva Vedas. Siksa, Kalpa, grammar, semantics, prosody and astrology also constitute Apara Vidya.
verses.commentary: Sense: Two Vidyas (topics of knowledge) are to be known: Para and Apara, O excellent brahmins, Apara consists of Rg, Yajur, Sama, and Atharva Vedas. Siksa, Kalpa, grammar, semantics, prosody and astrology also constitute Apara Vidya.

verses.sanskrit: न भावयन्त्यतीतानि ह्य् अज्ञाने ज्ञानमानिनः क्षुद्व्याधेः परिहारार्थं न सुखायान्नमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: na bhāvayantyatītāni hy ajñāne jñānamāninaḥ kṣudvyādheḥ parihārārthaṃ na sukhāyānnamucyate
verses.translation: It has no touch, no form, no taste, no smell, no change, no support. It is perpetual, omnipresent and all-power- ful. It it great and massive. O brahmins, it is unborn and identical with cit (consciousness); it is devoid of Pranas (vital airs); it has no mind; it is non-emollient and it is devoid of blood. It is incomprehensible; it is neither stout nor long; it is
verses.hindi: लोकोंमें सभी प्राणियोंमें माहात्म्यबलसे वन्दित तथा पूजित होना इस लोकमें महिमारूप तीसरी सिद्धि कही जाती है। त्रिलोकीमें सभी प्राणियोंके भीतर स्वेच्छासे प्रवेश करना प्राप्ति नामक सिद्धि कही गयी प्राकाम्य ऐश्‍वर्यसे युक्त व्यक्ति तीनों लोकोंमें कहीं भी बाधारहित होकर विषयोंका भोग करता है और सभी प्राणियोंको सुख दुःखमें प्रवृत्त कर सकता है। ईशित्व ऐश्वर्यके द्वारा वह योगवेत्ता यथेष्ट देहधारणके
verses.wordMeaning: It has no touch, no form, no taste, no smell, no change, no support. It is perpetual, omnipresent and all-power- ful. It it great and massive. O brahmins, it is unborn and identical with cit (consciousness); it is devoid of Pranas (vital airs); it has no mind;…
verses.commentary: Sense: It has no touch, no form, no taste, no smell, no change, no support. It is perpetual, omnipresent and all-power- ful. It it great and massive. O brahmins, it is unborn and identical with cit (consciousness); it is devoid of Pranas (vital airs); it has no mind;…

verses.sanskrit: यथेतरेषां रोगाणाम् औषधं न सुखाय तत् शीतोष्णवातवर्षाद्यैस् तत्तत्कालेषु देहिनाम्
verses.transliteration: yathetareṣāṃ rogāṇām auṣadhaṃ na sukhāya tat śītoṣṇavātavarṣādyais tattatkāleṣu dehinām
verses.translation: padc&rtha-yoga-fampaxmah— 'It can be interpreted as accom- panied by knowledge derived from the practice of the five-syllabled mantra 'namai iiv&ya*.
verses.hindi: द्वारा सभी जगह स्वामी बन जाता है। वशित्वसे
verses.wordMeaning: padc&rtha-yoga-fampaxmah— 'It can be interpreted as accom- panied by knowledge derived from the practice of the five-syllabled mantra 'namai iiv&ya*.
verses.commentary: Sense: padc&rtha-yoga-fampaxmah— 'It can be interpreted as accom- panied by knowledge derived from the practice of the five-syllabled mantra 'namai iiv&ya*.

verses.sanskrit: दुःखमेव न संदेहो न जानन्ति ह्यपण्डिताः स्वर्गे ऽप्येवं मुनिश्रेष्ठा ह्य् अविशुद्धक्षयादिभिः
verses.transliteration: duḥkhameva na saṃdeho na jānanti hyapaṇḍitāḥ svarge 'pyevaṃ muniśreṣṭhā hy aviśuddhakṣayādibhiḥ
verses.translation: pars vidy& — knowledge of Brahma as taught in the Upaniads,
verses.hindi: वशित्वमथ सर्वत्र यत्र कामावसायिता। तच्चापि त्रिविधं ज्ञेयमैश्वर्य सार्वकामिकम् इन्द्रियाणि मनश्चैव अहङ्कारश्च यः स्मृतः। तत्र सूक्ष्मप्रवृत्तिस्तु पञ्चभूतात्मिका पुनः
verses.wordMeaning: pars vidy& — knowledge of Brahma as taught in the Upaniads,
verses.commentary: Sense: pars vidy& — knowledge of Brahma as taught in the Upaniads,

verses.sanskrit: रोगैर् नानाविधैर् ग्रस्ता रागद्वेषभयादिभिः छिन्नमूलतरुर्यद्वद् अवशः पतति क्षितौ
verses.transliteration: rogair nānāvidhair grastā rāgadveṣabhayādibhiḥ chinnamūlataruryadvad avaśaḥ patati kṣitau
verses.translation: apar& vidy&-- knowledge of the ritual as taught in the Srauta and Cthya Sutras,
verses.hindi: इन्द्रियाणि मनश्चित्तबुद्भयहङ्कारसंज्ञितम्। तथा सर्वमयं चैव आत्मस्था ख्यातिरिव च
verses.wordMeaning: apar& vidy&-- knowledge of the ritual as taught in the Srauta and Cthya Sutras,
verses.commentary: Sense: apar& vidy&-- knowledge of the ritual as taught in the Srauta and Cthya Sutras,

verses.sanskrit: पुण्यवृक्षक्षयात्तद्वद् गां पतन्ति दिवौकसः दुःखाभिलाषनिष्ठानां दुःखभोगादिसंपदाम्
verses.transliteration: puṇyavṛkṣakṣayāttadvad gāṃ patanti divaukasaḥ duḥkhābhilāṣaniṣṭhānāṃ duḥkhabhogādisaṃpadām
verses.translation: But these Para and Apara are not the real. I alone am identical with the universe; the universe is in me alone.
verses.hindi: तस्य रूपं प्रवक्ष्यामि यथाह भगवान् प्रभुः। त्रैलोक्ये सर्वभूतेषु यथास्य नियमः स्मृतः त्रैलोक्ये सर्वभूतानां दुष्प्राप्यं समुदाहृतम्
verses.wordMeaning: But these Para and Apara are not the real. I alone am identical with the universe; the universe is in me alone.
verses.commentary: Sense: But these Para and Apara are not the real. I alone am identical with the universe; the universe is in me alone.

verses.sanskrit: अस्मात्तु पततां दुःखं कष्टं स्वर्गाद्दिवौकसाम् नरके दुःखमेवात्र नरकाणां निषेवणात्
verses.transliteration: asmāttu patatāṃ duḥkhaṃ kaṣṭaṃ svargāddivaukasām narake duḥkhamevātra narakāṇāṃ niṣevaṇāt
verses.translation: Everything originates from me, stays within me and gets dissolved in me; there is nothing different from me. This shall be realised mentally, verbally and physically. The devotee shall with concentration sec everything: the 'sat' (the existent) and the 'asat' (the non-existent), in the Atman. One seeing everything in the Atman does not allow the mind to stray to other objects.
verses.hindi: लङ्घनं प्लवनं लोके रूपमस्य सदा भवेत्
verses.wordMeaning: Everything originates from me, stays within me and gets dissolved in me; there is nothing different from me. This shall be realised mentally, verbally and physically.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Everything originates from me, stays within me and gets dissolved in me; there is nothing different from me. This shall be realised mentally, verbally and physically.…

verses.sanskrit: विहिताकरणाच्चैव वर्णिनां मुनिपुङ्गवाः
verses.transliteration: vihitākaraṇāccaiva varṇināṃ munipuṅgavāḥ
verses.translation: On lowering the vision, one shall see the Atman stationed in Vitasti above the umbilicus in the heart, the abode of the universe.
verses.hindi: त्रैलोक्ये सर्वभूतानां महिम्ना चैव वन्दितम् महित्वं चापि लोकेऽस्मिंस्तृतीयो योग उच्यते । त्रैलोक्ये सर्वभूतेषु यथेष्टगमनं स्मृतम्
verses.wordMeaning: On lowering the vision, one shall see the Atman stationed in Vitasti above the umbilicus in the heart, the abode of the universe.
verses.commentary: Sense: On lowering the vision, one shall see the Atman stationed in Vitasti above the umbilicus in the heart, the abode of the universe.

verses.sanskrit: यथा मृगो मृत्युभयस्य भीत उच्छिन्नवासो न लभेत निद्राम् एवं यतिर्ध्यानपरो महात्मा संसारभीतो न लभेत निद्राम्
verses.transliteration: yathā mṛgo mṛtyubhayasya bhīta ucchinnavāso na labheta nidrām evaṃ yatirdhyānaparo mahātmā saṃsārabhīto na labheta nidrām
verses.translation: It sees mostly and in due order on being united Avith Prana, etc. O leading sages, each of the veins (Nadis) carries the ten Pranas (vital airs). Altogether there arc seventy- wo thousand Naejis. The Jagrat (waking stage) is stati- oned in the eyes, the svapna (dream stage) in the neck; the susupta (sleeping stage) in the heart and turiya (the fourth above the three) in the head. The presiding deity in the jagrat state is brahma; in Svapna Visnu; Is vara in Susupta and in Turiya Mahevara. Others say as follows when the person is in full possession of his senses and organs it is called Jagrat; when only the four organs, mind, intellect, ego and citta function, it is Svapna. O sages of good holy rites, when the organs and senses are merged into the Atman
verses.hindi: प्राकामान् विषयान् भुङ्के तथाप्रतिहतः क्वचित्। त्रैलोक्ये सर्वभूतानां सुखदुःखं प्रवर्तते
verses.wordMeaning: It sees mostly and in due order on being united Avith Prana, etc. O leading sages, each of the veins (Nadis) carries the ten Pranas (vital airs). Altogether there arc seventy- wo thousand Naejis. The Jagrat (waking stage) is stati- oned in the eyes,…
verses.commentary: Sense: It sees mostly and in due order on being united Avith Prana, etc. O leading sages, each of the veins (Nadis) carries the ten Pranas (vital airs). Altogether there arc seventy- wo thousand Naejis. The Jagrat (waking stage) is stati- oned in the eyes,…

verses.sanskrit: कीटपक्षिमृगाणां च पशूनां गजवाजिनाम् दृष्टम् एवासुखं तस्मात् त्यजतः सुखमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: kīṭapakṣimṛgāṇāṃ ca paśūnāṃ gajavājinām dṛṣṭam evāsukhaṃ tasmāt tyajataḥ sukhamuttamam
verses.translation: para vidy& anyathfi na— anya-prakirena vanjitum aSakyS Cf. "yato vSeo nivartante.*'
verses.hindi: वश्यानि चास्य भूतानि त्रैलोक्ये सचराचरे यत्र कामावसायित्वं त्रैलोक्ये सचराचरे
verses.wordMeaning: para vidy& anyathfi na— anya-prakirena vanjitum aSakyS Cf. "yato vSeo nivartante.*'
verses.commentary: Sense: para vidy& anyathfi na— anya-prakirena vanjitum aSakyS Cf. "yato vSeo nivartante.*'

verses.sanskrit: वैमानिकानामप्येवं दुःखं कल्पाधिकारिणाम् स्थानाभिमानिनां चैव मन्वादीनां च सुव्रताः
verses.transliteration: vaimānikānāmapyevaṃ duḥkhaṃ kalpādhikāriṇām sthānābhimānināṃ caiva manvādīnāṃ ca suvratāḥ
verses.translation: The four states Jagrat (wakefulness), Svapna (dream), Suupti (slumber) and Turiya (the fourth) have been mentioned. I shall now describe the Adhibhautika, Adhyatmika and Adhidaivika terms, O leading brahmins. It should be known by the learned that all these are I myself. O great sages, the Adhyatmika (organic) is said to be fourteen in all, viz., the sense organs (five), the organs of action (five) and the mind, intellect, ego, and will (four).
verses.hindi: अवर्णो ह्यास्वरश्चैव असवर्णस्तु कर्हिचित्
verses.wordMeaning: The four states Jagrat (wakefulness), Svapna (dream), Suupti (slumber) and Turiya (the fourth) have been mentioned. I shall now describe the Adhibhautika, Adhyatmika and Adhidaivika terms, O leading brahmins. It should be known by the learned that all these are I myself.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The four states Jagrat (wakefulness), Svapna (dream), Suupti (slumber) and Turiya (the fourth) have been mentioned. I shall now describe the Adhibhautika, Adhyatmika and Adhidaivika terms, O leading brahmins. It should be known by the learned that all these are I myself.…

verses.sanskrit: देवानां चैव दैत्यानाम् अन्योन्यविजिगीषया दुःखमेव नृपाणां च राक्षसानां जगत्त्रये
verses.transliteration: devānāṃ caiva daityānām anyonyavijigīṣayā duḥkhameva nṛpāṇāṃ ca rākṣasānāṃ jagattraye
verses.translation: The following are fourteen NaIs (tubular vessels), viz.— Rajfti, Sudarfana, Jita, Saumya, Mogha, Rudra, Mrta, (Amrta), Satya, Madhyama, Na(jhra, Stfuka, Asura, Krttika and Bhasvatl.
verses.hindi: स भुङ्के विषयांश्चैव विषयैर्न च युज्यते। व्यापकस्त्वपवर्गाच्च व्यापकात्पुरुषः स्मृतः । पुरुषः सूक्ष्मभावात्तु ऐश्वर्ये परमे स्थितः
verses.wordMeaning: The following are fourteen NaIs (tubular vessels), viz.— Rajfti, Sudarfana, Jita, Saumya, Mogha, Rudra, Mrta, (Amrta), Satya, Madhyama, Na(jhra, Stfuka, Asura, Krttika and Bhasvatl.
verses.commentary: Sense: The following are fourteen NaIs (tubular vessels), viz.— Rajfti, Sudarfana, Jita, Saumya, Mogha, Rudra, Mrta, (Amrta), Satya, Madhyama, Na(jhra, Stfuka, Asura, Krttika and Bhasvatl.

verses.sanskrit: श्रमार्थमाश्रमश्चापि वर्णानां परमार्थतः आश्रमैर्न च देवैश् च यज्ञैः सांख्यैर्व्रतैस् तथा
verses.transliteration: śramārthamāśramaścāpi varṇānāṃ paramārthataḥ āśramairna ca devaiś ca yajñaiḥ sāṃkhyairvratais tathā
verses.translation: There are fourteen carrying winds'®® stationed in the middle of Na(s: — Thcy arc Prma, Vya, Apana, Udana, Samana, Vairambha, the important Antarya, Prabhahjana, Kurmaka, Syena, Sveta, Kr§na, Anila and Naga.
verses.hindi: एवं पाशुपतं योगं ज्ञातव्यं मुनिपुङ्गवाः
verses.wordMeaning: There are fourteen carrying winds'®® stationed in the middle of Na(s: — Thcy arc Prma, Vya, Apana, Udana, Samana, Vairambha, the important Antarya, Prabhahjana, Kurmaka, Syena, Sveta, Kr§na, Anila and Naga.
verses.commentary: Sense: There are fourteen carrying winds'®® stationed in the middle of Na(s: — Thcy arc Prma, Vya, Apana, Udana, Samana, Vairambha, the important Antarya, Prabhahjana, Kurmaka, Syena, Sveta, Kr§na, Anila and Naga.

verses.sanskrit: उग्रैस्तपोभिर् विविधैर् दानैर्नानाविधैरपि न लभन्ते तथात्मानं लभन्ते ज्ञानिनः स्वयम्
verses.transliteration: ugraistapobhir vividhair dānairnānāvidhairapi na labhante tathātmānaṃ labhante jñāninaḥ svayam
verses.translation: The omniscient Being is only one. There is only one lord of all. He is the overlord of all. He is the immanent soul of great lustre.
verses.hindi: स्वर्गापवर्गफलदं शिवसायुज्यकारणम्। अथवा गतविज्ञानो रागात्कर्म समाचरेत् तथा सुकृतकर्मा तु फलं स्वगे समश्नुते
verses.wordMeaning: The omniscient Being is only one. There is only one lord of all. He is the overlord of all. He is the immanent soul of great lustre.
verses.commentary: Sense: The omniscient Being is only one. There is only one lord of all. He is the overlord of all. He is the immanent soul of great lustre.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन चरेत्पाशुपतव्रतम् भस्मशायी भवेन्नित्यं व्रते पाशुपते बुधः
verses.transliteration: tasmātsarvaprayatnena caretpāśupatavratam bhasmaśāyī bhavennityaṃ vrate pāśupate budhaḥ
verses.translation: On being worshipped, the eternal lord grants happi- ness. O excellent brahmins, if one does not worship him one does not attain happiness.®®
verses.hindi: तस्माद् ब्रह्म परं सौख्यं ब्रह्म शाश्वतमुत्तमम्
verses.wordMeaning: On being worshipped, the eternal lord grants happi- ness. O excellent brahmins, if one does not worship him one does not attain happiness.®®
verses.commentary: Sense: On being worshipped, the eternal lord grants happi- ness. O excellent brahmins, if one does not worship him one does not attain happiness.®®

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चार्थज्ञानसम्पन्नः शिवतत्त्वे समाहितः कैवल्यकरणं योगविधिकर्मच्छिदं बुधः
verses.transliteration: pañcārthajñānasampannaḥ śivatattve samāhitaḥ kaivalyakaraṇaṃ yogavidhikarmacchidaṃ budhaḥ
verses.translation: He is being worshipped by the Vedas and other scrip- tures. But this omniscient lord does not go unto them for succour.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्म एव हि सेवेत ब्रह्मैव हि परं सुखम्। परिश्रमो हि यज्ञानां महतार्थेन वर्तते
verses.wordMeaning: He is being worshipped by the Vedas and other scrip- tures. But this omniscient lord does not go unto them for succour.
verses.commentary: Sense: He is being worshipped by the Vedas and other scrip- tures. But this omniscient lord does not go unto them for succour.

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चार्थयोगसम्पन्नो दुःखान्तं व्रजते सुधीः परया विद्यया वेद्यं विदन्त्यपरया न हि
verses.transliteration: pañcārthayogasampanno duḥkhāntaṃ vrajate sudhīḥ parayā vidyayā vedyaṃ vidantyaparayā na hi
verses.translation: This visible universe is his Anna'®® (food). He does not become the Anna himself (unto anyone else). Nowhere docs one devour Anna guarded by one's own self.
verses.hindi: चराचरसहित त्रिलोकीमें सभी प्राणी उसके जाते हैं। जिसके पास कामावसित्व ऐश्वर्य है, चराचरसहित तीनों लोकोंमें उसके रूप अनुसार बन सकते हैं और नहीं भी बन सकते है.
verses.wordMeaning: This visible universe is his Anna'®® (food). He does not become the Anna himself (unto anyone else). Nowhere docs one devour Anna guarded by one's own self.
verses.commentary: Sense: This visible universe is his Anna'®® (food). He does not become the Anna himself (unto anyone else). Nowhere docs one devour Anna guarded by one's own self.

verses.sanskrit: द्वे विद्ये वेदितव्ये हि परा चैवापरा तथा अपरा तत्र ऋग्वेदो यजुर्वेदो द्विजोत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: dve vidye veditavye hi parā caivāparā tathā aparā tatra ṛgvedo yajurvedo dvijottamāḥ
verses.translation: I am the food taken in by the living beings everywhere. I am the knot of the living beings and I bring about all great things. I am five-fold Atman divided into several parts.
verses.hindi: शब्द, आह रस, गन्ध, रूप तथा मन उसकी इच्छा होते हैं और उसकी इच्छाके अनुसार नहीँ भी होते हैं। वह कभी भी न उत्पन्न होता है, न मरता है, न कट सकता है, न भेदा जा सकता है, न जलाया सकता है, न मूर्च्छित होता है, न आकर्षित होता १ न लिप्त (आसक्त) होता है, न उसका क्षय होता है वह नष्ट नहीं होता है और न तो खिन्न होता है। वह सर्वत्र न तो कुछ करता है और न तो विकृत
verses.wordMeaning: I am the food taken in by the living beings everywhere. I am the knot of the living beings and I bring about all great things. I am five-fold Atman divided into several parts.
verses.commentary: Sense: I am the food taken in by the living beings everywhere. I am the knot of the living beings and I bring about all great things. I am five-fold Atman divided into several parts.

verses.sanskrit: सामवेदस्तथाथर्वो वेदः सर्वार्थसाधकः शिक्षा कल्पो व्याकरणं निरुक्तं छन्द एव च
verses.transliteration: sāmavedastathātharvo vedaḥ sarvārthasādhakaḥ śikṣā kalpo vyākaraṇaṃ niruktaṃ chanda eva ca
verses.translation: I am the soul of the living beings identical with Anna. What is taken in is called Anna. I am the soul of the sense-organs identical with Prana (vital breaths). I am the soul of mental conceptions identical with the mind.
verses.hindi: ही होता है। वह शब्द, स्पर्श, गन्ध, रस तथा रूपसे रहित होता है। वह सदा अवर्ण, स्वररहित तथा असवर्ण होता है। वह विषयोंका भोग करता है, किन्तु उनसे लिप्त नहीं होता है॥ २०--२६॥
verses.wordMeaning: I am the soul of the living beings identical with Anna. What is taken in is called Anna. I am the soul of the sense-organs identical with Prana (vital breaths). I am the soul of mental conceptions identical with the mind.
verses.commentary: Sense: I am the soul of the living beings identical with Anna. What is taken in is called Anna. I am the soul of the sense-organs identical with Prana (vital breaths). I am the soul of mental conceptions identical with the mind.

verses.sanskrit: ज्योतिषं चापरा विद्या पराक्षरमिति स्थितम् तददृश्यं तदग्राह्यम् अगोत्रं तदवर्णकम्
verses.transliteration: jyotiṣaṃ cāparā vidyā parākṣaramiti sthitam tadadṛśyaṃ tadagrāhyam agotraṃ tadavarṇakam
verses.translation: As Soma I am Kalatman (the soul of Time), identi- cal with Vijfiana (perfect knowledge). As Mahesa Paramesvara I become identical with Ananda ( Bliss ).'®
verses.hindi: अणुभाववाला होनेके कारण जीव सूक्ष्म है और सूक्ष्म होनेके कारण मुक्तिके योग्य है। मुक्त होनेके कारण व्यापक है और व्यापक होनेके कारण वह पुरुष कहा गया है  सूक्ष्म भाव होनेके कारण वह पुरुष परम ऐश्वर्यमें स्थित होता है। ऐश्वर्योका गुण क्रमश: सूक्ष्म होता जाता है- ऐसा कहा गया है । अबाधित ऐश्वर्य तथा उत्तम योग प्राप्त करके साधक मुक्ति प्राप्त करता है; वही सूक्ष्म परम पद है॥ २७--२९ /२॥
verses.wordMeaning: As Soma I am Kalatman (the soul of Time), identi- cal with Vijfiana (perfect knowledge). As Mahesa Paramesvara I become identical with Ananda ( Bliss ).'®
verses.commentary: Sense: As Soma I am Kalatman (the soul of Time), identi- cal with Vijfiana (perfect knowledge). As Mahesa Paramesvara I become identical with Ananda ( Bliss ).'®

verses.sanskrit: तदचक्षुस्तदश्रोत्रं तदपाणि अपादकम् तदजातमभूतं च तदशब्दं द्विजोत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: tadacakṣustadaśrotraṃ tadapāṇi apādakam tadajātamabhūtaṃ ca tadaśabdaṃ dvijottamāḥ
verses.translation: Thus I am the entire universe and everything is stationed in me. I am independent but everything is depend- ent on me. This can be understood on pondering over the real form of various things.
verses.hindi: हे श्रेष्ठ मुनियो! इस प्रकार पाशुपतयोगको जानना चाहिए, जो स्वर्ग तथा मोक्षका फल प्रदान करनेवाला और शिव-सायुज्यका कारण है । विज्ञानरहित व्यक्ति रागके कारण कर्म करता है और राजस अथवा तामस
verses.wordMeaning: Thus I am the entire universe and everything is stationed in me. I am independent but everything is depend- ent on me. This can be understood on pondering over the real form of various things.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus I am the entire universe and everything is stationed in me. I am independent but everything is depend- ent on me. This can be understood on pondering over the real form of various things.

verses.sanskrit: अस्पर्शं तदरूपं च रसगन्धविवर्जितम् अव्ययं चाप्रतिष्ठं च तन्नित्यं सर्वगं विभुम्
verses.transliteration: asparśaṃ tadarūpaṃ ca rasagandhavivarjitam avyayaṃ cāpratiṣṭhaṃ ca tannityaṃ sarvagaṃ vibhum
verses.translation: Even the state of being one (i.e. ekatva) is not present
verses.hindi: भोग करके वहींपर मुक्त हो जाता है। पुण्यकर्म करनेवाला स्वर्गमें फल प्राप्त करता है; तत्पश्चात् १६ श्रेष्ठ प्राणी पुण्यके क्षीण होनेपर पुनः मनुष्यलोक वापस आता है। अत: ब्रह्म ही परम सुख है और बर
verses.wordMeaning: Even the state of being one (i.e. ekatva) is not present
verses.commentary: Sense: Even the state of being one (i.e. ekatva) is not present

verses.sanskrit: महान्तं तद् बृहन्तं च तदजं चिन्मयं द्विजाः अप्राणममनस्कं च तदस्निग्धमलोहितम्
verses.transliteration: mahāntaṃ tad bṛhantaṃ ca tadajaṃ cinmayaṃ dvijāḥ aprāṇamamanaskaṃ ca tadasnigdhamalohitam
verses.translation: The lord is the source of food for others but he has no source of food for himself. Of. Bhagavadgitai
verses.hindi: ही परम शाश्वत है। ब्रह्मकी ही उपासना करनी चाहिए च ।
verses.wordMeaning: The lord is the source of food for others but he has no source of food for himself. Of. Bhagavadgitai
verses.commentary: Sense: The lord is the source of food for others but he has no source of food for himself. Of. Bhagavadgitai

verses.sanskrit: अप्रमेयं तदस्थूलम् अदीर्घं तदनुल्बणम् अह्रस्वं तदपारं च तदानन्दं तदच्युतम्
verses.transliteration: aprameyaṃ tadasthūlam adīrghaṃ tadanulbaṇam ahrasvaṃ tadapāraṃ ca tadānandaṃ tadacyutam
verses.translation: The Atman is neither Antaljprajha (having intellec- tual awareness within) nor Bahihprajna (having the intellectual awareness without) nor is He in both ways(Ubhayatahprajna). He is not Prajfianaghana (solid in perfect knowledge) nor Prajha (wise being) nor Ajhanapurvaka (having ignorance).
verses.hindi: क्योंकि ब्रह्म ही परम आनन्दस्वरूप है॥ २० २२  अध्याय ८८ 1 पाशुपतयोगसे प्राप्त होनेवाली अष्टसिद्धियोंका वर्णन तथा प्राणाग्निहोमका स्वरूप
verses.wordMeaning: The Atman is neither Antaljprajha (having intellec- tual awareness within) nor Bahihprajna (having the intellectual awareness without) nor is He in both ways(Ubhayatahprajna).…
verses.commentary: Sense: The Atman is neither Antaljprajha (having intellec- tual awareness within) nor Bahihprajna (having the intellectual awareness without) nor is He in both ways(Ubhayatahprajna).…

verses.sanskrit: अनपावृतमद्वैतं तदनन्तमगोचरम् असंवृतं तदात्मैकं परा विद्या न चान्यथा
verses.transliteration: anapāvṛtamadvaitaṃ tadanantamagocaram asaṃvṛtaṃ tadātmaikaṃ parā vidyā na cānyathā
verses.translation: Brahman is not one that is known nor one to be known. In fact it is Nirvana (extinction, Kaivalya, Nihreyasa. Anamaya (devoid of ailments), Amrta (immortal), Aksara imperishable, Brahman, Parama Atman, Paratpara (greater than the greatest), Nirvikalpa (devoid oi doubtful alternatives), Nirabhasa (devoid of fallacious appearances), Jhana (know- ledge); all these are synonyms (for perfect knowledge).
verses.hindi: की प फा फ क फक फा फा फ का फ फ फा का कफ फ फफ फफफफफफफफफफफफफफफफफ फफफफफफफफफफ फफफ फफफ फफफ फफ फ फफ रक फफफ फफ फफफ
verses.wordMeaning: Brahman is not one that is known nor one to be known. In fact it is Nirvana (extinction, Kaivalya, Nihreyasa. Anamaya (devoid of ailments), Amrta (immortal), Aksara imperishable, Brahman, Parama Atman, Paratpara (greater than the greatest),…
verses.commentary: Sense: Brahman is not one that is known nor one to be known. In fact it is Nirvana (extinction, Kaivalya, Nihreyasa. Anamaya (devoid of ailments), Amrta (immortal), Aksara imperishable, Brahman, Parama Atman, Paratpara (greater than the greatest),…

verses.sanskrit: परापरेति कथिते नैवेह परमार्थतः अहमेव जगत्सर्वं मय्येव सकलं जगत्
verses.transliteration: parāpareti kathite naiveha paramārthataḥ ahameva jagatsarvaṃ mayyeva sakalaṃ jagat
verses.translation: When it is pleased and concentrated in a single form it is known as Jhana (Perfect knowledge). Everything else is Ajhana ( Ignorance). No doubt need be entertained in this regard.
verses.hindi: भूयो मृत्युवशं याति तस्मान्मोक्षः परं सुखम्। अथवा ध्यानसंयुक्तो ब्रह्मतत्त्वपरायणः पुराणमनुशासितारं सूक्ष्माच्च सूक्ष्मं महतो महान्तम्
verses.wordMeaning: When it is pleased and concentrated in a single form it is known as Jhana (Perfect knowledge). Everything else is Ajhana ( Ignorance). No doubt need be entertained in this regard.
verses.commentary: Sense: When it is pleased and concentrated in a single form it is known as Jhana (Perfect knowledge). Everything else is Ajhana ( Ignorance). No doubt need be entertained in this regard.

verses.sanskrit: मत्त उत्पद्यते तिष्ठन् मयि मय्येव लीयते मत्तो नान्यदितीक्षेत मनोवाक्पाणिभिस् तथा
verses.transliteration: matta utpadyate tiṣṭhan mayi mayyeva līyate matto nānyaditīkṣeta manovākpāṇibhis tathā
verses.translation: Perfect clear knowledge certainly originates from contact with the preceptor. It is uncontaminated by lust, hat- red, falsehood, anger, passion, covetousness and the like. It should be known as the bestower of salvation. Since the man has the impurity of ignorance he is contaminated. Salvation takes place only when impurity is dispelled and not otherwise, even if one takes a crore of births. Without perfect knowledge'® neither merit nor demerit is destroyed. Hence, O most excellent ones among the knowers of the Brahman, practise knowledge alone as the means of liberation. It is only by practice of per- fect knowledge that the intellect cf men becomes free from impurities.
verses.hindi: आलिङ्गनं निर्गुणं चेतनं च
verses.wordMeaning: Perfect clear knowledge certainly originates from contact with the preceptor. It is uncontaminated by lust, hat- red, falsehood, anger, passion, covetousness and the like. It should be known as the bestower of salvation.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Perfect clear knowledge certainly originates from contact with the preceptor. It is uncontaminated by lust, hat- red, falsehood, anger, passion, covetousness and the like. It should be known as the bestower of salvation.…

verses.sanskrit: सर्वमात्मनि संपश्येत् सच्चासच्च समाहितः सर्वं ह्यात्मनि संपश्यन् न बाह्ये कुरुते मनः
verses.transliteration: sarvamātmani saṃpaśyet saccāsacca samāhitaḥ sarvaṃ hyātmani saṃpaśyan na bāhye kurute manaḥ
verses.translation: Hence, one shall always practise perfect know- ledge having that as the foundation and the ultimate goal. O leading brahmins, a yogin who is satiated with knowledge
verses.hindi: पश्यन्ति युक्त्या ह्यचलप्रकाशं पश्यत्यचक्षुः स श्रृणोत्यकर्णो
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, one shall always practise perfect know- ledge having that as the foundation and the ultimate goal. O leading brahmins, a yogin who is satiated with knowledge
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, one shall always practise perfect know- ledge having that as the foundation and the ultimate goal. O leading brahmins, a yogin who is satiated with knowledge

verses.sanskrit: अधोदृष्ट्या वितस्त्यां तु नाभ्यामुपरितिष्ठति हृदयं तद्विजानीयाद् विश्वस्यायतनं महत्
verses.transliteration: adhodṛṣṭyā vitastyāṃ tu nābhyāmuparitiṣṭhati hṛdayaṃ tadvijānīyād viśvasyāyatanaṃ mahat
verses.translation: ekatvam api nSsti — The terms ckatva (singleness), etc., are relative and hence, they shall be avoided in regard to the exposition of Brahman.
verses.hindi: अचेतनां सर्वगतां सूक्ष्मां प्रसवधर्मिणीम्। प्रकृतिं सर्वभूतानां युक्ताः पश्यन्ति योगिनः
verses.wordMeaning: ekatvam api nSsti — The terms ckatva (singleness), etc., are relative and hence, they shall be avoided in regard to the exposition of Brahman.
verses.commentary: Sense: ekatvam api nSsti — The terms ckatva (singleness), etc., are relative and hence, they shall be avoided in regard to the exposition of Brahman.

verses.sanskrit: हृदयस्यास्य मध्ये तु पुण्डरीकमवस्थितम् धर्मकन्दसमुद्भूतं ज्ञाननालं सुशोभनम्
verses.transliteration: hṛdayasyāsya madhye tu puṇḍarīkamavasthitam dharmakandasamudbhūtaṃ jñānanālaṃ suśobhanam
verses.translation: Gf. *'jiianad eva hi kaivalyam**— cited in 57*.; also "rte jhanan na muktih*'.
verses.hindi: सर्वतः श्रुतिमल्लोके सर्वमावृत्य तिष्ठति॥ सर्वात्मानं परं ब्रह्म तद्वै ध्याता न मुह्यति
verses.wordMeaning: Gf. *'jiianad eva hi kaivalyam**— cited in 57*.; also "rte jhanan na muktih*'.
verses.commentary: Sense: Gf. *'jiianad eva hi kaivalyam**— cited in 57*.; also "rte jhanan na muktih*'.

verses.sanskrit: ऐश्वर्याष्टदलं श्वेतं परं वैराग्यकर्णिकम् छिद्राणि च दिशो यस्य प्राणाद्याश् च प्रतिष्ठिताः
verses.transliteration: aiśvaryāṣṭadalaṃ śvetaṃ paraṃ vairāgyakarṇikam chidrāṇi ca diśo yasya prāṇādyāś ca pratiṣṭhitāḥ
verses.translation: Similarly, Jhana (perfect knowledge) is the cause of salvation. I'he liberated man abides in his own Atman. O leading brahmins, there is no doubt about this (hat wrath etc., occur only when there is ignorance. Wrath, delight, cove- tousness, delusion, arrogance, virtue and evil, all these, O excellent brahmins, cause adoption of physical bodies.
verses.hindi: यज्ञोंमें बहुत धनके व्ययके साथ ही परिश्रम होता है; उसके बाद भी मनुष्यको मृत्युके वशमें होना पड़ता है, अतः मोक्ष ही परम आनन्द है। विश्व नामवाले, सभी ओर मुख-पैर-सिर-ग्रीवावाले, विश्वके स्वामी,
verses.wordMeaning: Similarly, Jhana (perfect knowledge) is the cause of salvation. I'he liberated man abides in his own Atman. O leading brahmins, there is no doubt about this (hat wrath etc., occur only when there is ignorance. Wrath, delight, cove- tousness, delusion, arrogance,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Similarly, Jhana (perfect knowledge) is the cause of salvation. I'he liberated man abides in his own Atman. O leading brahmins, there is no doubt about this (hat wrath etc., occur only when there is ignorance. Wrath, delight, cove- tousness, delusion, arrogance,…

verses.sanskrit: प्राणाद्यैश्चैव संयुक्तः पश्यते बहुधा क्रमात् दशप्राणवहा नाड्यः प्रत्येकं मुनिपुङ्गवाः
verses.transliteration: prāṇādyaiścaiva saṃyuktaḥ paśyate bahudhā kramāt daśaprāṇavahā nāḍyaḥ pratyekaṃ munipuṅgavāḥ
verses.translation: rfcct knowledge is obtained by personal contact
verses.hindi: सभी रूपोंबाले, सभी गन्थोसे युक्त, सम्पूर्ण विश्वको माला तथा चस्त्रके रूपमें धारण करनेवाले (सर्वव्यापक) भगवान् दिव्य पुरुषका दर्शन करके ध्यानयुक्त तथा ब्रह्मतत्त्वपरायण व्यक्तिको सैकड़ों मन्वन्तरोंमें भी उसके पदसे च्युत नहीं किया जा सकता है ॥ ३४--३७॥
verses.wordMeaning: rfcct knowledge is obtained by personal contact
verses.commentary: Sense: rfcct knowledge is obtained by personal contact

verses.sanskrit: द्विसप्ततिसहस्राणि नाड्यः सम्परिकीर्तिताः नेत्रस्थं जाग्रतं विद्यात् कण्ठे स्वप्नं समादिशेत्
verses.transliteration: dvisaptatisahasrāṇi nāḍyaḥ samparikīrtitāḥ netrasthaṃ jāgrataṃ vidyāt kaṇṭhe svapnaṃ samādiśet
verses.translation: atmanam ced vijaniyad ahamasmiti paru?ah kixn japan kasya kamaya -ariram anu sarii jvaret
verses.hindi: पुरुषरूप ईश्वर सूर्यकी किरणोंके माध्यमसे पृथ्वीपर पहुँचता है और निरन्तर ही पूर्वसदूश जगत्को उत्पन्न करता है; किंतु प्रलयकालमें उत्पन्न नहीं करता योगी उस कवि, पुरातन, सभीपर शासन करनेवाले, सूक्ष्मसे भी
verses.wordMeaning: atmanam ced vijaniyad ahamasmiti paru?ah kixn japan kasya kamaya -ariram anu sarii jvaret
verses.commentary: Sense: atmanam ced vijaniyad ahamasmiti paru?ah kixn japan kasya kamaya -ariram anu sarii jvaret

verses.sanskrit: सुषुप्तं हृदयस्थं तु तुरीयं मूर्धनि स्थितम् जाग्रे ब्रह्मा च विष्णुश् च स्वप्ने चैव यथाक्रमात्
verses.transliteration: suṣuptaṃ hṛdayasthaṃ tu turīyaṃ mūrdhani sthitam jāgre brahmā ca viṣṇuś ca svapne caiva yathākramāt
verses.translation: Like fire that burns the dry fuel quickly, the fire of knowledge burns sins whether inborn or extraneous or origi- nating from bones and speech (i.e. physically and verbally).
verses.hindi: सूक्ष्म, महानसे भी महान्, इन्द्रियोंसे रहित, स्वर्णके गमन करनेवाले (सर्वव्यापी) तथा सर्वसारस्वरूप पुरुषको योगसे देख सकता है न कि चक्षुसे। उसी ब्रह्ममें लीन रहनेवाले साधक उस अचल प्रकाशवाले तथा अपने तेजसे प्रकाशित प्रभुको योगसे देखते हैं । बह ब्रह्म हाथ-पैर-
verses.wordMeaning: Like fire that burns the dry fuel quickly, the fire of knowledge burns sins whether inborn or extraneous or origi- nating from bones and speech (i.e. physically and verbally).
verses.commentary: Sense: Like fire that burns the dry fuel quickly, the fire of knowledge burns sins whether inborn or extraneous or origi- nating from bones and speech (i.e. physically and verbally).

verses.sanskrit: ईश्वरस्तु सुषुप्ते तु तुरीये च महेश्वरः वदन्त्य् एवम् अथान्ये ऽपि समस्तकरणैः पुमान्
verses.transliteration: īśvarastu suṣupte tu turīye ca maheśvaraḥ vadanty evam athānye 'pi samastakaraṇaiḥ pumān
verses.translation: There is nothing greater than perfect knowledge for the destruction of all sins. One shall always practise perfect knowledge after eschewing all attachment to worldly objects.
verses.hindi: उदर-पार्श्व-जिह्वासे रहित है, इन्द्रियोंसे अतीत है, अत्यन्त सूक्ष्म है तथा अद्वितीय है । वह नेत्ररहित होता हुआ भी देखता है, कानोंसे रहित होता हुआ भी सुनता है और बुद्धिरहित होता हुआ भी सब कुछ जानता है। वह सबको
verses.wordMeaning: There is nothing greater than perfect knowledge for the destruction of all sins. One shall always practise perfect knowledge after eschewing all attachment to worldly objects.
verses.commentary: Sense: There is nothing greater than perfect knowledge for the destruction of all sins. One shall always practise perfect knowledge after eschewing all attachment to worldly objects.

verses.sanskrit: वर्तमानस्तदा तस्य जाग्रदित्यभिधीयते मनोबुद्धिर् अहङ्कारं चित्तं चेति चतुष्टयम्
verses.transliteration: vartamānastadā tasya jāgradityabhidhīyate manobuddhir ahaṅkāraṃ cittaṃ ceti catuṣṭayam
verses.translation: There is no doubt that all the sins of a Jfianin shall perish. Even if he indulges in dalliance he is not aSected by sins.
verses.hindi: जानता है, किंतु सबके द्वारा वेद्य नहीं है । उसे आदि महान् पुरुष कहा गया है उनसे युक्त योगिजन सभी प्राणियोंको प्रकृतिको अचेतन, सर्वव्यापिनी, सूक्ष्म तथा प्रसवधर्मिणी (सृष्टि- उत्पादनकत्री)-के रूपमें देखते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: There is no doubt that all the sins of a Jfianin shall perish. Even if he indulges in dalliance he is not aSected by sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: There is no doubt that all the sins of a Jfianin shall perish. Even if he indulges in dalliance he is not aSected by sins.

verses.sanskrit: यदा व्यवस्थितस्त्वेतैः स्वप्न इत्यभिधीयते करणानि विलीनानि यदा स्वात्मनि सुव्रताः
verses.transliteration: yadā vyavasthitastvetaiḥ svapna ityabhidhīyate karaṇāni vilīnāni yadā svātmani suvratāḥ
verses.translation: As is knowledge so is meditation. Hence, one should practise meditation.'®' At the outset meditation is laid down as Savi$aya (having an object) and then Nirvisaya (having no object). The leading yogin shall practise meditation in six ways'®® as follows: — for the duration of two, four, six, ten, twelve and sixteen units of time in order. Certainly he shall be liberated.
verses.hindi: वह ब्रह्म सभी ओर हाथ तथा पैरवाला है। बह सभी ओर नेत्र, सिर तथा मुखवाला है। बह सभी ओर कानवाला है तथा संसारमें सभीको व्याप्त करके स्थित है। योगसे युक्त विद्वान् व्यक्ति ईशान, सनातन तथा सभी
verses.wordMeaning: As is knowledge so is meditation. Hence, one should practise meditation.'®' At the outset meditation is laid down as Savi$aya (having an object) and then Nirvisaya (having no object).…
verses.commentary: Sense: As is knowledge so is meditation. Hence, one should practise meditation.'®' At the outset meditation is laid down as Savi$aya (having an object) and then Nirvisaya (having no object).…

verses.sanskrit: सुषुप्तः करणैर्भिन्नस् तुरीयः परिकीर्त्यते परस्तुरीयातीतो ऽसौ शिवः परमकारणम्
verses.transliteration: suṣuptaḥ karaṇairbhinnas turīyaḥ parikīrtyate parasturīyātīto 'sau śivaḥ paramakāraṇam
verses.translation: In Saiva system of thought, emphasis is laid upon knowledge and meditation. For detail, see Siva-rakaJa, section X.
verses.hindi: प्राणियोंके परम पुरुष उन ब्रह्मके विषयमें मोहित नहीं होता है। जो व्यक्ति सभी प्राणियोंको आत्मा, महात्मा, परमात्मा, पुरि शेते सुदुर्ग्राह्मस्तस्मात्पुरुष उच्यते॥ वह मोहको प्राप्त नहीं होता है
verses.wordMeaning: In Saiva system of thought, emphasis is laid upon knowledge and meditation. For detail, see Siva-rakaJa, section X.
verses.commentary: Sense: In Saiva system of thought, emphasis is laid upon knowledge and meditation. For detail, see Siva-rakaJa, section X.

verses.sanskrit: जाग्रत्स्वप्नसुषुप्तिश् च तुरीयं चाधिभौतिकम् आध्यात्मिकं च विप्रेन्द्राश् चाधिदैविकमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: jāgratsvapnasuṣuptiś ca turīyaṃ cādhibhautikam ādhyātmikaṃ ca viprendrāś cādhidaivikamucyate
verses.translation: For detail about the varieties of meditation, ibid, section X.
verses.hindi: अथ चेल्लुप्तधर्मा तु सावशेषैः स्वकर्मभिः। ततस्तु ब्रह्मगर्भे वै शुक्रशोणितसंयुते
verses.wordMeaning: For detail about the varieties of meditation, ibid, section X.
verses.commentary: Sense: For detail about the varieties of meditation, ibid, section X.

verses.sanskrit: तत्सर्वमहम् एवेति वेदितव्यं विजानता बुद्धीन्द्रियाणि विप्रेन्द्रास् तथा कर्मेन्द्रियाणि च
verses.transliteration: tatsarvamaham eveti veditavyaṃ vijānatā buddhīndriyāṇi viprendrās tathā karmendriyāṇi ca
verses.translation: uddha-jSmbilnada. The verse describes the form of the lord in the savikalpaka sam&dhi. Gf. muninSxh jfiSnadStri ca sadaivopaniac chruta kaivalya-sruti-bodhy& iri miirtir mama xaaheivm--ivarahaa cited in ST,
verses.hindi: ततस्तु गर्भकालेन कललं नाम जायते कालेन कललं चापि बुद्बुदं सम्प्रजायते। मृत्पिण्डस्तु यथा चक्रे चक्रावर्तेन पीडितः
verses.wordMeaning: uddha-jSmbilnada. The verse describes the form of the lord in the savikalpaka sam&dhi. Gf. muninSxh jfiSnadStri ca sadaivopaniac chruta kaivalya-sruti-bodhy& iri miirtir mama xaaheivm--ivarahaa cited in ST,
verses.commentary: Sense: uddha-jSmbilnada. The verse describes the form of the lord in the savikalpaka sam&dhi. Gf. muninSxh jfiSnadStri ca sadaivopaniac chruta kaivalya-sruti-bodhy& iri miirtir mama xaaheivm--ivarahaa cited in ST,

verses.sanskrit: मनोबुद्धिर् अहङ्कारश् चित्तं चेति चतुष्टयम् अध्यात्मं पृथगेवेदं चतुर्दशविधं स्मृतम्
verses.transliteration: manobuddhir ahaṅkāraś cittaṃ ceti catuṣṭayam adhyātmaṃ pṛthagevedaṃ caturdaśavidhaṃ smṛtam
verses.translation: These principles including the first entity Jiva, Prakrti, sattva, rajas, tamas, intellect, the ego, the subtle ele- ments, the sense-organs, the elements beginning with ether are not real®®®. Because he stands steady pervading the universe he is called Sthanu.
verses.hindi: तावत्कालं महादेवमर्चयामीति चिन्तयेत्। जायते मानुषस्तत्र यथारूपं यथावयः
verses.wordMeaning: These principles including the first entity Jiva, Prakrti, sattva, rajas, tamas, intellect, the ego, the subtle ele- ments, the sense-organs, the elements beginning with ether are not real®®®. Because he stands steady pervading the universe he is called Sthanu.
verses.commentary: Sense: These principles including the first entity Jiva, Prakrti, sattva, rajas, tamas, intellect, the ego, the subtle ele- ments, the sense-organs, the elements beginning with ether are not real®®®. Because he stands steady pervading the universe he is called Sthanu.

verses.sanskrit: द्रष्टव्यं चैव श्रोतव्यं घ्रातव्यं च यथाक्रमम् रसितव्यं मुनिश्रेष्ठाः स्पर्शितव्यं तथैव च
verses.transliteration: draṣṭavyaṃ caiva śrotavyaṃ ghrātavyaṃ ca yathākramam rasitavyaṃ muniśreṣṭhāḥ sparśitavyaṃ tathaiva ca
verses.translation: The verse describes the method of paficatattva-devatS-dhya in the savikalpaka samadhi.
verses.hindi: अविनाशी तथा सर्वात्मा परब्रह्मका ध्यान करनेवाला जिस प्रकार सभी प्राणियोंके भीतर विचरण क हुआ भी वायु अग्राह्य है, ठीक उसी तरह देहमें स्थित हे हुए भी परमात्मा सुदुग्ग्राह्म है। वह देहरूपी करता है, अतः पुरुष कहा जाता है
verses.wordMeaning: The verse describes the method of paficatattva-devatS-dhya in the savikalpaka samadhi.
verses.commentary: Sense: The verse describes the method of paficatattva-devatS-dhya in the savikalpaka samadhi.

verses.sanskrit: मन्तव्यं चैव बोद्धव्यम् अहंकर्तव्यमेव च तथा चेतयितव्यं च वक्तव्यं मुनिपुङ्गवाः
verses.transliteration: mantavyaṃ caiva boddhavyam ahaṃkartavyameva ca tathā cetayitavyaṃ ca vaktavyaṃ munipuṅgavāḥ
verses.translation: na jivah -In fact, meditation, its varieties and ancillaries are all due to rnajd — the lord's power of projection. Actually, meditation, medi- tator and the object meditated upon are all unreal, vide PaUcadaii vi. 35.
verses.hindi: पुण्यफलके भोगके अनन्तर लुप्त धर्मवाला जीव अपने अवशिष्ट कर्मोके साथ पुनः ब्राह्मणयोनिमें लेता है। स्त्री-पुरुषके संयोग होनेके अनन्तर शुक्र तथा रक्तके मिलनेपर गर्भकी उत्पत्ति होती है, पुन: वह कललके
verses.wordMeaning: na jivah -In fact, meditation, its varieties and ancillaries are all due to rnajd — the lord's power of projection. Actually, meditation, medi- tator and the object meditated upon are all unreal, vide PaUcadaii vi. 35.
verses.commentary: Sense: na jivah -In fact, meditation, its varieties and ancillaries are all due to rnajd — the lord's power of projection. Actually, meditation, medi- tator and the object meditated upon are all unreal, vide PaUcadaii vi. 35.

verses.sanskrit: आदातव्यं च गन्तव्यं विसर्गायितमेव च आनन्दितव्यमित्येते ह्य् अधिभूतमनुक्रमात्
verses.transliteration: ādātavyaṃ ca gantavyaṃ visargāyitameva ca ānanditavyamityete hy adhibhūtamanukramāt
verses.translation: It is at the behest of Bhava that the frightened sun rises, the wind blows and purifies, the moon shines, the fire blazes, waters flow, the earth holds aloft and the firmament gives room. Hence, O brahmins, one shall think about all these. O excellent brahmins, all these are presided over by him alone. One shall remember Bhava, thinking that he is identical with all forms in the universe.
verses.hindi: रूपमें हो जाता है और कुछ समय बाद वह कलल भी बुलबुला बन जाता है। जिस प्रकार मिट्टीका पिण्ड घूमते हुए चाकपर कुम्हारके हाथोंसे आकार प्राप्त करता है, वैसे ही यह जीव पंचमहाभूतोंसे युक्त होकर तथा वायुसे पूरित होकर आकार प्राप्त करता है  ४७--५० ॥
verses.wordMeaning: It is at the behest of Bhava that the frightened sun rises, the wind blows and purifies, the moon shines, the fire blazes, waters flow, the earth holds aloft and the firmament gives room. Hence, O brahmins, one shall think about all these. O excellent brahmins,…
verses.commentary: Sense: It is at the behest of Bhava that the frightened sun rises, the wind blows and purifies, the moon shines, the fire blazes, waters flow, the earth holds aloft and the firmament gives room. Hence, O brahmins, one shall think about all these. O excellent brahmins,…

verses.sanskrit: आदित्यो ऽपि दिशश्चैव पृथिवी वरुणस् तथा वायुश्चन्द्रस् तथा ब्रह्मा रुद्रः क्षेत्रज्ञ एव च
verses.transliteration: ādityo 'pi diśaścaiva pṛthivī varuṇas tathā vāyuścandras tathā brahmā rudraḥ kṣetrajña eva ca
verses.translation: To those who are scorched by the poison of mundane existence, the only antidote is the nectar-like perfect knowledge and meditation. O excellent brahmins, no other solution has been laid down anywhere.
verses.hindi: गर्भमें जीव सोचता है कि यदि मैं गर्भसे निकलूँगा, तो महेश्वरकी शरणमें जाऊँगा और उत्पन्न होनेपर जबतक वैष्णव वायु अर्थात् माया मेरा स्पर्श नहीं करेगी, तबतक मैं महादेवका अर्चन करूँगा। इस प्रकार जीव अपने रूप
verses.wordMeaning: To those who are scorched by the poison of mundane existence, the only antidote is the nectar-like perfect knowledge and meditation. O excellent brahmins, no other solution has been laid down anywhere.
verses.commentary: Sense: To those who are scorched by the poison of mundane existence, the only antidote is the nectar-like perfect knowledge and meditation. O excellent brahmins, no other solution has been laid down anywhere.

verses.sanskrit: अग्निरिन्द्रस् तथा विष्णुर् मित्रो देवः प्रजापतिः आधिदैविकमेवं हि चतुर्दशविधं क्रमात्
verses.transliteration: agnirindras tathā viṣṇur mitro devaḥ prajāpatiḥ ādhidaivikamevaṃ hi caturdaśavidhaṃ kramāt
verses.translation: Perfect knowledge originates directly from Dharma (virtue). Vairagya (detachment) originates from knowledge; from Vairagya arises the supreme knowledge that illuminates the true meanings of objects.
verses.hindi: तथा वयके अनुसार अर्थात् अपने प्रारब्धके अनुसार मनुष्य बनता है आकाशसे वायु उत्पन्न होता है, वायुसे जल उत्पन होता है, जलसे प्राण होता है और प्राणसे शुक्र बढ़ता है। रक्तके तैंतीस भाग तथा शुक्रके चौदह भाग मिश्रित होते हैं; उन दोनोंके भागसे आधे जातीफलके सदृश देह प्राप
verses.wordMeaning: Perfect knowledge originates directly from Dharma (virtue). Vairagya (detachment) originates from knowledge; from Vairagya arises the supreme knowledge that illuminates the true meanings of objects.
verses.commentary: Sense: Perfect knowledge originates directly from Dharma (virtue). Vairagya (detachment) originates from knowledge; from Vairagya arises the supreme knowledge that illuminates the true meanings of objects.

verses.sanskrit: राज्ञी सुदर्शना चैव जिता सौम्या यथाक्रमम् मोघा रुद्रामृता सत्या मध्यमा च द्विजोत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: rājñī sudarśanā caiva jitā saumyā yathākramam moghā rudrāmṛtā satyā madhyamā ca dvijottamāḥ
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, he who is endowed with know- ledge and detachment attains Yogic Siddhi. One who abides by sattva guna attains liberation through yogic siddhi and not otherwise.
verses.hindi: करके गर्भकी वृद्धि होती है। तत्पश्चात् गर्भसे युक्त जीर पाँच वायुओंसे घिर जाता है । पिताके शरीरसे इसके आ. प्रत्यंग तथा रूपका विकास होता है और माताके नाभिदेशसे पीये गये तथा चूसे गये रस आदिके प्रवेशसे
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent brahmins, he who is endowed with know- ledge and detachment attains Yogic Siddhi. One who abides by sattva guna attains liberation through yogic siddhi and not otherwise.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent brahmins, he who is endowed with know- ledge and detachment attains Yogic Siddhi. One who abides by sattva guna attains liberation through yogic siddhi and not otherwise.

verses.sanskrit: नाडी राशिशुका चैव असुरा चैव कृत्तिका भास्वती नाडयश्चैताश् चतुर्दशनिबन्धनाः
verses.transliteration: nāḍī rāśiśukā caiva asurā caiva kṛttikā bhāsvatī nāḍayaścaitāś caturdaśanibandhanāḥ
verses.translation: It is surprising that his unchanging region is covered by the words tamas and Avidya. O brahmins, one should adopt Sattvaakti (the power of Sattvaguna) and worship Siva.
verses.hindi: जीवका पोषण होता है। वे प्राण (वायु) देहधारियाँकै आधार हैं ॥ ५३--५६ ॥ नौ महीनेतक शिशु बहुत कष्टमें रहता है उसकी गर्दन नाभिनालसे लिपटी रहती है, उसका सम्पूर्ण ह संकुचित रहता है, वह गर्भमें अपर्याप्त ( iis
verses.wordMeaning: It is surprising that his unchanging region is covered by the words tamas and Avidya. O brahmins, one should adopt Sattvaakti (the power of Sattvaguna) and worship Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is surprising that his unchanging region is covered by the words tamas and Avidya. O brahmins, one should adopt Sattvaakti (the power of Sattvaguna) and worship Siva.

verses.sanskrit: वायवो नाडिमध्यस्था वाहकाश् च चतुर्दश प्राणो व्यानस्त्वपानश् च उदानश् च समानकः
verses.transliteration: vāyavo nāḍimadhyasthā vāhakāś ca caturdaśa prāṇo vyānastvapānaś ca udānaś ca samānakaḥ
verses.translation: It is surprising that his unchanging region is covered by the words tamas and Avidya. O brahmins, one should adopt Sattvaakti (the power of Sattvaguna) and worship Siva.
verses.hindi: 'पाशुपतयोगसे होनेवाली अष्टसिद्धियोंका अध्याय ८८ 1 पाशुपतयोगसे प्राप्त होनेवाली अष्टसिद्धियोंका वर्णन तथा प्राणार्निहोमका स्वरूप ४५३
verses.wordMeaning: It is surprising that his unchanging region is covered by the words tamas and Avidya. O brahmins, one should adopt Sattvaakti (the power of Sattvaguna) and worship Siva.

verses.sanskrit: वैरम्भश् च तथा मुख्यो ह्य् अन्तर्यामः प्रभञ्जनः कूर्मकश् च तथा श्येनः श्वेतः कृष्णस् तथानिलः
verses.transliteration: vairambhaś ca tathā mukhyo hy antaryāmaḥ prabhañjanaḥ kūrmakaś ca tathā śyenaḥ śvetaḥ kṛṣṇas tathānilaḥ
verses.translation: It is surprising that his unchanging region is covered by the words tamas and Avidya. O brahmins, one should adopt Sattvaakti (the power of Sattvaguna) and worship Siva.
verses.hindi: नवमासोषितश्चापि योनिच्छिद्रादवाङ्मुखः । पड़ा रहता है। नौ महीनेतक गर्भमें रहनेके बाद ततः स्वकर्मभिः पापैर्निरयं सम्प्रपद्यते ॥ ५८  वह शिशु नीचेकी ओर मुख किये हुए योनिमार्गसे बाहर निकलता है। इसके पश्चात् अपने पापमय कर्मोके कारण नरकमें गिरता है; असिपत्रवन तथा शाल्म- लिछेदन नामक नरकमें उसका ताडन तथा भक्षण किया जाता है और उसे पीव तथा रक्तका भक्षण करना पड़ता है। जैसे गर्म किये जानेपर जल श्लेष्मायुक्त (बुलबुला- युक्त) हो जाता है, वैसे ही जीव यातनास्थानको प्राप्त
verses.wordMeaning: It is surprising that his unchanging region is covered by the words tamas and Avidya. O brahmins, one should adopt Sattvaakti (the power of Sattvaguna) and worship Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is surprising that his unchanging region is covered by the words tamas and Avidya. O brahmins, one should adopt Sattvaakti (the power of Sattvaguna) and worship Siva.

verses.sanskrit: नाग इत्येव कथिता वायवश् च चतुर्दश यश्चक्षुःष्वथ द्रष्टव्ये तथादित्ये च सुव्रताः
verses.transliteration: nāga ityeva kathitā vāyavaś ca caturdaśa yaścakṣuḥṣvatha draṣṭavye tathāditye ca suvratāḥ
verses.translation: It is surprising that his unchanging region is covered by the words tamas and Avidya. O brahmins, one should adopt Sattvaakti (the power of Sattvaguna) and worship Siva.
verses.hindi: करके छिन्न-भिन्न हो जाते हैं। इस प्रकार जीव अपने द्वारा किये गये उन पापोंसे तप्त होते हैं; वे अपने अवशिष्ट कर्मोके अनुसार दुःख या सुख प्राप्त करते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: It is surprising that his unchanging region is covered by the words tamas and Avidya. O brahmins, one should adopt Sattvaakti (the power of Sattvaguna) and worship Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is surprising that his unchanging region is covered by the words tamas and Avidya. O brahmins, one should adopt Sattvaakti (the power of Sattvaguna) and worship Siva.

verses.sanskrit: नाड्यां प्राणे च विज्ञाने त्व् आनन्दे च यथाक्रमम् हृद्याकाशे य एतस्मिन् सर्वस्मिन्नन्तरे परः
verses.transliteration: nāḍyāṃ prāṇe ca vijñāne tv ānande ca yathākramam hṛdyākāśe ya etasmin sarvasminnantare paraḥ
verses.translation: It is surprising that his unchanging region is covered by the words tamas and Avidya. O brahmins, one should adopt Sattvaakti (the power of Sattvaguna) and worship Siva.
verses.hindi: सभीलोगोंको छोड़कर जीवको अकेला ही जाना पड़ता है और अकेला ही भोगना पड़ता है; अतः उत्तम आचरण करना चाहिए । मृत्युके पश्चात् प्रस्थान करनेवाले इस जीवके पीछे-पीछे कोई भी नहीं जाता है; इस जीवके द्वारा जो कर्म किया गया होता है, वही इसके साथ जाता है
verses.wordMeaning: It is surprising that his unchanging region is covered by the words tamas and Avidya. O brahmins, one should adopt Sattvaakti (the power of Sattvaguna) and worship Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is surprising that his unchanging region is covered by the words tamas and Avidya. O brahmins, one should adopt Sattvaakti (the power of Sattvaguna) and worship Siva.

verses.sanskrit: आत्मा एकश् च चरति तमुपासीत मां प्रभुम् अजरं तमनन्तं च अशोकममृतं ध्रुवम्
verses.transliteration: ātmā ekaś ca carati tamupāsīta māṃ prabhum ajaraṃ tamanantaṃ ca aśokamamṛtaṃ dhruvam
verses.translation: It is surprising that his unchanging region is covered by the words tamas and Avidya. O brahmins, one should adopt Sattvaakti (the power of Sattvaguna) and worship Siva.
verses.hindi: वे जीव यमलोकमें निरन्तर अनिष्ट दण्डोंके द्वारा कराहते हुए नित्य यमविषयोंमें प्रवृत्त रहते हैं; अनेक प्रकारकी बड़ी-बड़ी अनन्त यातनाओंके द्वारा वेदनाओंसे घिरे हुए शरीरवाले वे जीव शोकसन्तप्त
verses.wordMeaning: It is surprising that his unchanging region is covered by the words tamas and Avidya. O brahmins, one should adopt Sattvaakti (the power of Sattvaguna) and worship Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is surprising that his unchanging region is covered by the words tamas and Avidya. O brahmins, one should adopt Sattvaakti (the power of Sattvaguna) and worship Siva.

verses.sanskrit: चतुर्दशविधेष्वेव संचरत्येक एव सः लीयन्ते तानि तत्रैव यदन्यं नास्ति वै द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: caturdaśavidheṣveva saṃcaratyeka eva saḥ līyante tāni tatraiva yadanyaṃ nāsti vai dvijāḥ
verses.translation: It is surprising that his unchanging region is covered by the words tamas and Avidya. O brahmins, one should adopt Sattvaakti (the power of Sattvaguna) and worship Siva.
verses.hindi: व्यक्ति मन, वाणी तथा कर्मद्वारा बार-बार जो भी आचरण करता है, वही अभ्यास बनकर इसे उधर ही ले जाता है, अतः सर्वदा शुभाचरण करना चाहिए। जीवात्माका पूर्वकर्ममें अनादि दूढ्बन्धन है, उसीसे जीव घोर तामसिक षड्विध संसारको प्राप्त होता है। जीव मनुष्ययोनिसे पशुभावको प्राप्त होता है और पशुभावसे वह मृग होता है, पुनः वह मृगजन्मसे पक्षीका जन्म और पक्षीसे सरीसृप (रेंगनेवाला जन्तु)
verses.wordMeaning: It is surprising that his unchanging region is covered by the words tamas and Avidya. O brahmins, one should adopt Sattvaakti (the power of Sattvaguna) and worship Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is surprising that his unchanging region is covered by the words tamas and Avidya. O brahmins, one should adopt Sattvaakti (the power of Sattvaguna) and worship Siva.

verses.sanskrit: एक एव हि सर्वज्ञः सर्वेशस्त्वेक एव सः एष सर्वाधिपो देवस् त्व् अन्तर्यामी महाद्युतिः
verses.transliteration: eka eva hi sarvajñaḥ sarveśastveka eva saḥ eṣa sarvādhipo devas tv antaryāmī mahādyutiḥ
verses.translation: It is surprising that his unchanging region is covered by the words tamas and Avidya. O brahmins, one should adopt Sattvaakti (the power of Sattvaguna) and worship Siva.
verses.hindi: होता है, इसके बाद वह सरीसूपसे स्थावरत्वको प्राप्त होता है; इसमें सन्देह नहीं है। पुनः स्थावररूप प्राप्त होनेपर जबतक जीव पुनः मनुष्ययोनि नहीं प्राप्त कर
verses.wordMeaning: It is surprising that his unchanging region is covered by the words tamas and Avidya. O brahmins, one should adopt Sattvaakti (the power of Sattvaguna) and worship Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is surprising that his unchanging region is covered by the words tamas and Avidya. O brahmins, one should adopt Sattvaakti (the power of Sattvaguna) and worship Siva.

verses.sanskrit: उपास्यमानः सर्वस्य सर्वसौख्यः सनातनः उपास्यति न चैवेह सर्वसौख्यं द्विजोत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: upāsyamānaḥ sarvasya sarvasaukhyaḥ sanātanaḥ upāsyati na caiveha sarvasaukhyaṃ dvijottamāḥ
verses.translation: It is surprising that his unchanging region is covered by the words tamas and Avidya. O brahmins, one should adopt Sattvaakti (the power of Sattvaguna) and worship Siva.
verses.hindi: एवं जीवास्तु तैः पापैस्तप्यमानाः स्वयंकृतैः । प्राप्नुयुः कर्मभिः शेषैर्दुःखं वा यदि वेतरत् एकेनैव तु गन्तव्यं सर्वमुत्सृज्य वै जनम्। एकेनैव तु भोक्तव्यं तस्मात्सुकृतमाचरेत्
verses.wordMeaning: It is surprising that his unchanging region is covered by the words tamas and Avidya. O brahmins, one should adopt Sattvaakti (the power of Sattvaguna) and worship Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is surprising that his unchanging region is covered by the words tamas and Avidya. O brahmins, one should adopt Sattvaakti (the power of Sattvaguna) and worship Siva.

verses.sanskrit: उपास्यमानो वेदैश् च शास्त्रैर्नानाविधैरपि न वैष वेदशास्त्राणि सर्वज्ञो यास्यति प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: upāsyamāno vedaiś ca śāstrairnānāvidhairapi na vaiṣa vedaśāstrāṇi sarvajño yāsyati prabhuḥ
verses.translation: It is surprising that his unchanging region is covered by the words tamas and Avidya. O brahmins, one should adopt Sattvaakti (the power of Sattvaguna) and worship Siva.
verses.hindi: यदनेन कृतं कर्म तदेनमनुगच्छति
verses.wordMeaning: It is surprising that his unchanging region is covered by the words tamas and Avidya. O brahmins, one should adopt Sattvaakti (the power of Sattvaguna) and worship Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is surprising that his unchanging region is covered by the words tamas and Avidya. O brahmins, one should adopt Sattvaakti (the power of Sattvaguna) and worship Siva.

verses.sanskrit: अस्यैवान्नमिदं सर्वं न सो ऽन्नं भवति स्वयम् स्वात्मना रक्षितं चाद्याद् अन्नभूतं न कुत्रचित्
verses.transliteration: asyaivānnamidaṃ sarvaṃ na so 'nnaṃ bhavati svayam svātmanā rakṣitaṃ cādyād annabhūtaṃ na kutracit

verses.hindi: कर्मणा मनसा वाचा यदभीक्ष्णां निषेवते। तदभ्यासो हरत्येनं तस्मात्कल्याणमाचरेत् अनादिमान् प्रबन्धः स्यात्पूर्वकर्मणि देहिनः । संसारं तामसं घोरं षड्विधं प्रतिपद्यते

verses.sanskrit: सर्वत्र प्राणिनामन्नं प्राणिनां ग्रन्थिरस्म्यहम् प्रशास्ता नयनश्चैव पञ्चात्मा स विभागशः
verses.transliteration: sarvatra prāṇināmannaṃ prāṇināṃ granthirasmyaham praśāstā nayanaścaiva pañcātmā sa vibhāgaśaḥ

verses.hindi: सरीसृपत्वाद् गच्छेद्है स्थावरत्वं न संशयः। स्थावरत्वे पुनः प्राप्ते यावदुन्मिलते जनः
verses.wordMeaning: It is surprising that his unchanging region is covered by the words tamas and Avidya. O brahmins, one should adopt Sattvaakti (the power of Sattvaguna) and worship Siva.

verses.sanskrit: अन्नमयो ऽसौ भूतात्मा चाद्यते ह्यन्नमुच्यते प्राणमयश्चेन्द्रियात्मा संकल्पात्मा मनोमयः
verses.transliteration: annamayo 'sau bhūtātmā cādyate hyannamucyate prāṇamayaścendriyātmā saṃkalpātmā manomayaḥ

verses.hindi: सात्त्विकश्चापि संसारो ब्रह्मादिः परिकीर्तितः ॥ ब्राह्ो तु केवलं सत्त्वं स्थावरे केवलं तमः

verses.sanskrit: कालात्मा सोम एवेह विज्ञानमय उच्यते सदानन्दमयो भूत्वा महेशः परमेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: kālātmā soma eveha vijñānamaya ucyate sadānandamayo bhūtvā maheśaḥ parameśvaraḥ

verses.hindi: ततस्तत्परमं ब्रह्म कथं विप्रः स्मरिष्यति। संसारः पूर्वधर्मस्य भावनाभिः प्रणोदितः

verses.sanskrit: सो ऽहम् एवं जगत्सर्वं मय्येव सकलं स्थितम् परतन्त्रं स्वतन्त्रे ऽपि तदभावाद्विचारतः
verses.transliteration: so 'ham evaṃ jagatsarvaṃ mayyeva sakalaṃ sthitam paratantraṃ svatantre 'pi tadabhāvādvicārataḥ

verses.hindi: नित्यं समारभेद्धर्मं संसारभयपीडितः। ततस्तरति संसारं क्रमेण परिवर्तितः एष आपः परं ज्योतिरेष सेतुरनुत्तमः। विवृत्या होष सम्भेदाद्भूतानां चैव शाश्वतः
verses.wordMeaning: It is surprising that his unchanging region is covered by the words tamas and Avidya. O brahmins, one should adopt Sattvaakti (the power of Sattvaguna) and worship Siva.

verses.sanskrit: एकत्वमपि नास्त्येव द्वैतं तत्र कुतस्त्वहो एवं नास्त्यथ मर्त्यं च कुतो ऽमृतमजोद्भवः
verses.transliteration: ekatvamapi nāstyeva dvaitaṃ tatra kutastvaho evaṃ nāstyatha martyaṃ ca kuto 'mṛtamajodbhavaḥ
verses.translation: It is surprising that his unchanging region is covered by the words tamas and Avidya. O brahmins, one should adopt Sattvaakti (the power of Sattvaguna) and worship Siva.
verses.hindi: तदेनं सेतुमात्मानमरिनं वै विश्वतोमुखम्। हृदिस्थं सर्वभूतानामुपासीत महेश्वरम्
verses.wordMeaning: It is surprising that his unchanging region is covered by the words tamas and Avidya. O brahmins, one should adopt Sattvaakti (the power of Sattvaguna) and worship Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is surprising that his unchanging region is covered by the words tamas and Avidya. O brahmins, one should adopt Sattvaakti (the power of Sattvaguna) and worship Siva.

verses.sanskrit: नान्तःप्रज्ञो बहिःप्रज्ञो न चोभयगतस् तथा न प्रज्ञानघनस्त्वेवं न प्राज्ञो ज्ञानपूर्वकः
verses.transliteration: nāntaḥprajño bahiḥprajño na cobhayagatas tathā na prajñānaghanastvevaṃ na prājño jñānapūrvakaḥ
verses.translation: It is surprising that his unchanging region is covered by the words tamas and Avidya. O brahmins, one should adopt Sattvaakti (the power of Sattvaguna) and worship Siva.
verses.hindi: तथान्तःसंस्थितं देवं स्वशक्त्या परिमण्डितम्। अष्टधा चाष्टधा चैव तथा चाष्टविधेन च सृष्ट्यर्थं संस्थितं वहि सङ्क्षिप्य च हृदि स्थितम्। ध्यात्वा यथावद्देवेशं रुद्रं भुवननायकम्
verses.wordMeaning: It is surprising that his unchanging region is covered by the words tamas and Avidya. O brahmins, one should adopt Sattvaakti (the power of Sattvaguna) and worship Siva.

verses.sanskrit: स एव मुक्तः संसाराद् दुःखत्रयविवर्जितः एवं ज्ञानं विना नास्ति ध्यानं ध्यातुर् द्विजर्षभाः
verses.transliteration: sa eva muktaḥ saṃsārād duḥkhatrayavivarjitaḥ evaṃ jñānaṃ vinā nāsti dhyānaṃ dhyātur dvijarṣabhāḥ

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञानात्परतरं नास्ति सर्वपापविनाशनम् अभ्यसेच्च सदा ज्ञानं सर्वसंगविवर्जितः

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञानिनः सर्वपापानि जीर्यन्ते नात्र संशयः क्रीडन्नपि न लिप्येत पापैर्नानाविधैरपि
verses.transliteration: jñāninaḥ sarvapāpāni jīryante nātra saṃśayaḥ krīḍannapi na lipyeta pāpairnānāvidhairapi

verses.hindi: अवसरपर इसे पढ़ता है या सुनता है या श्रेष्ठ ब्राह्मणोंको सुनाता है, वह परमगति प्राप्त करता है

verses.sanskrit: षट्प्रकारं समभ्यस्य चतुःषड्दशभिस् तथा तथा द्वादशधा चैव पुनः षोडशधा क्रमात्
verses.transliteration: ṣaṭprakāraṃ samabhyasya catuḥṣaḍdaśabhis tathā tathā dvādaśadhā caiva punaḥ ṣoḍaśadhā kramāt

verses.sanskrit: मद्रक्तश्चाभ्यसेद्ध्यानं गुरुसंपर्कजं ध्रुवम् न बुध्यति तथा ध्याता स्थाप्य चित्तं द्विजोत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: madraktaścābhyaseddhyānaṃ gurusaṃparkajaṃ dhruvam na budhyati tathā dhyātā sthāpya cittaṃ dvijottamāḥ

verses.sanskrit: न चाभिमन्यते योगी न पश्यति समन्ततः न घ्राति न शृणोत्येव लीनः स्वात्मनि यः स्वयम्

verses.transliteration: vāhneye kālarudrākhyo vāyutattve maheśvaraḥ suṣire sa śivaḥ sākṣāt kramādevaṃ vicintayet

verses.commentary: Sense: Thus requested, the Pinaka-beari ng lord, Nilalohita laughingly glanced at Ambika and spoke to those brahmins who stood by after bowing to him.

verses.sanskrit: बन्धमोक्षौ न चैवेह मम स्वेच्छा शरीरिणः अकर्तज्ञः पशुर्जीवो विभुर्भोक्ता ह्यणुः पुमान्
verses.transliteration: bandhamokṣau na caiveha mama svecchā śarīriṇaḥ akartajñaḥ paśurjīvo vibhurbhoktā hyaṇuḥ pumān
verses.translation: "I am one who can adopt any body as I choose. Hence, I have neither bondage nor liberation.®®' He who is not an agent is ignorant. The jiva is Pau (one in bondage). The all-pervading Lord is the enjoyer. Man is only an atom. He who is bound by Maya and disallusioned is the one who is entangled in Karraans. O brahmins, the Atman has neither knowledge nor meditation, neither bondage nor liberation.
verses.hindi: आज्ञाका उल्लंघन न करे॥ ३३--३५॥ धातुवाद, नास्तिकवाद, कसर स्थानमें निवास, ्षुद्र-मन्त्रोंका उपयोग, सर्पांको पकड़ना आदि निन्दनीय कार्योका पूर्ण प्रयत्नसे परित्याग करना चाहिए। धूर्तता, धनको कृपणता तथा पिशुनता (परनिन्दा)-का सदा
verses.wordMeaning: "I am one who can adopt any body as I choose. Hence, I have neither bondage nor liberation.®®' He who is not an agent is ignorant. The jiva is Pau (one in bondage). The all-pervading Lord is the enjoyer. Man is only an atom.…
verses.commentary: Sense: "I am one who can adopt any body as I choose. Hence, I have neither bondage nor liberation.®®' He who is not an agent is ignorant. The jiva is Pau (one in bondage). The all-pervading Lord is the enjoyer. Man is only an atom.…

verses.sanskrit: मायी च मायया बद्धः कर्मभिर् युज्यते तु सः ज्ञानं ध्यानं च बन्धश् च मोक्षो नास्त्यात्मनो द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: māyī ca māyayā baddhaḥ karmabhir yujyate tu saḥ jñānaṃ dhyānaṃ ca bandhaś ca mokṣo nāstyātmano dvijāḥ
verses.translation: He too who realises this in me has none of these. This Haimavati is Vidya®®® and I am Vcdya (one who should be known). She is Prajfia (intellect). She is Sruti and Smrti. She is Dhrti (fortitude) stabilized by me. She is the power of know- ledge, Kriya (rite); and Iccha (will). She is Ajna (Behest). Undoubtedly we are the two Vidyas.
verses.hindi: त्याग करना चाहिए। गुरुजनोंके सान्निध्यमें अत्यधिक हँसना, अशिष्टता तथा मनमाना कार्य करना-इन सबका पूर्ण प्रयसे परित्याग करना चाहिए। गुरुको आज्ञाके प्रतिकूल आचरण नहीं करना चाहिए और पूर्ण
verses.wordMeaning: He too who realises this in me has none of these. This Haimavati is Vidya®®® and I am Vcdya (one who should be known). She is Prajfia (intellect). She is Sruti and Smrti. She is Dhrti (fortitude) stabilized by me. She is the power of know- ledge, Kriya (rite); and Iccha (will).…
verses.commentary: Sense: He too who realises this in me has none of these. This Haimavati is Vidya®®® and I am Vcdya (one who should be known). She is Prajfia (intellect). She is Sruti and Smrti. She is Dhrti (fortitude) stabilized by me. She is the power of know- ledge, Kriya (rite); and Iccha (will).…

verses.sanskrit: यदैवं मयि विद्वान् यस् तस्यापि न च सर्वतः एषा विद्या ह्यहं वेद्यः प्रज्ञैषा च श्रुतिः स्मृतिः
verses.transliteration: yadaivaṃ mayi vidvān yas tasyāpi na ca sarvataḥ eṣā vidyā hyahaṃ vedyaḥ prajñaiṣā ca śrutiḥ smṛtiḥ
verses.translation: This Prakrti does not belong to the Jiva. Nor is she a Vikrti on consideration. She is Maya. She is not a Vikara (effect). She is devoid of clarity of *Sat* and 'Asat',
verses.hindi: प्रयत्नपूर्वक कभी भी उनका अनिष्ट (बुरा) नहीं सोचना चाहिए॥ ३६--३८ /२॥ यतियों (संन्यासियों)-के आसन, वस्त्र, दण्ड, खड़ाऊँ, माला, शयनस्थान, पात्र, छाया तथा यज्ञके उपकरणोंको पैरसे कभी नहीं छूना चाहिए। है विप्रो!
verses.wordMeaning: This Prakrti does not belong to the Jiva. Nor is she a Vikrti on consideration. She is Maya. She is not a Vikara (effect). She is devoid of clarity of *Sat* and 'Asat',
verses.commentary: Sense: This Prakrti does not belong to the Jiva. Nor is she a Vikrti on consideration. She is Maya. She is not a Vikara (effect). She is devoid of clarity of *Sat* and 'Asat',

verses.sanskrit: धृतिरेषा मया निष्ठा ज्ञानशक्तिः क्रिया तथा इच्छाख्या च तथा ह्याज्ञा द्वे विद्ये न च संशयः
verses.transliteration: dhṛtireṣā mayā niṣṭhā jñānaśaktiḥ kriyā tathā icchākhyā ca tathā hyājñā dve vidye na ca saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: Formerly she originated from my mouth at my behest. She is the eternal deity of five faces. She is the highly blessed and bestows fearlessness on the worlds.
verses.hindi: करना चाहिए; प्रमादवश द्रोह कर लेनेपर प्रणवका दस हजार जप करना चाहिए। जानबूझकर गुरुद्रोह तथा देवद्रोह करनेपर एक करोड़ जपके द्वारा व्यक्ति शुद्ध होता है। महापातकोंसे शुद्धिके लिये भी वही विधि है,
verses.wordMeaning: Formerly she originated from my mouth at my behest. She is the eternal deity of five faces. She is the highly blessed and bestows fearlessness on the worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: Formerly she originated from my mouth at my behest. She is the eternal deity of five faces. She is the highly blessed and bestows fearlessness on the worlds.

verses.sanskrit: न ह्येषा प्रकृतिर्जैवी विकृतिश् च विचारतः विकारो नैव मायैषा सदसद्व्यक्तिवर्जिता
verses.transliteration: na hyeṣā prakṛtirjaivī vikṛtiś ca vicārataḥ vikāro naiva māyaiṣā sadasadvyaktivarjitā
verses.translation: On seeing him, the unchanging Bhavani removed the Maya. Rid of the impurities of Maya those sages looked at Parvati, became pleased and were liberated. Hence she is
verses.hindi: जो इसके लिये है। पातकी यदि चरित्रवान् है, तो वह उसके आधे जपसे शुद्ध हो जाता है। है सुव्रतो! सभी उपपातकी उसके भी आधे जपसे शुद्ध हो जाते हैं॥ ३९--४३ ॥ सन्ध्यावन्दनका लोप करनेपर विप्र इसको तीन आवृत्ति करके शुद्ध हो जाता है और हैनिक कृत्यका उल्लंघन होनेपर एक सौ बार जप करना बताया गया है
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing him, the unchanging Bhavani removed the Maya. Rid of the impurities of Maya those sages looked at Parvati, became pleased and were liberated. Hence she is
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing him, the unchanging Bhavani removed the Maya. Rid of the impurities of Maya those sages looked at Parvati, became pleased and were liberated. Hence she is

verses.sanskrit: पुरा ममाज्ञा मद्वक्त्रात् समुत्पन्ना सनातनी पञ्चवक्त्रा महाभागा जगतामभयप्रदा
verses.transliteration: purā mamājñā madvaktrāt samutpannā sanātanī pañcavaktrā mahābhāgā jagatāmabhayapradā
verses.translation: Of.   5T  1
verses.hindi: नियत समयका उल्लंघन करनेपर, अभक्ष्य पदार्थ -का भक्षण करनेपर और न बोलनेयोग्य वचन बोलनेपर एक हजार जपसे शुद्धि कही जाती है

verses.sanskrit: तामाज्ञां सम्प्रविश्याहं चिन्तयन् जगतां हितम् सप्तविंशत्प्रकारेण सर्वं व्याप्यानया शिवः
verses.transliteration: tāmājñāṃ sampraviśyāhaṃ cintayan jagatāṃ hitam saptaviṃśatprakāreṇa sarvaṃ vyāpyānayā śivaḥ
verses.translation: Gf. note. 12.
verses.hindi: कौआ, उल्लू तथा कबूतर पक्षियोंका वध करनेपर ४६० श्रीलिड्रमहापुराण
verses.wordMeaning: Gf. note. 12.
verses.commentary: Sense: Gf. note. 12.

verses.sanskrit: तदाप्रभृति वै मोक्षप्रवृत्तिर्द्विजसत्तमाः एवमुक्त्वा तदापश्यद् भवानीं परमेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: tadāprabhṛti vai mokṣapravṛttirdvijasattamāḥ evamuktvā tadāpaśyad bhavānīṃ parameśvaraḥ
verses.translation: There is no doubt that he is stationed after adopting the two forms. When there is a contact with Vijftana (perfect knowledge) at the behest of Paramethin, liberation occurs within a moment and not otherwise, even with crorcs of holy rites. Here the order intended for the living beings is not applicable. By the grace of Paramesthin liberation takes place in a trice. This is undoubtedly the vow of the lord. The creature (i.e. individual soul) is liberated, thanks to the grace of Paramesthin even when he is in the womb or when he is born, or when he is a boy, a young man or an old man. By the grace of the lord of Devas every living being is liberated whether it is oviparous or a plant or one bom of sweat. No doubt need be entertained in this regard.
verses.hindi: फफफफफफफफ फक फफा फा पीप पीपीपी पीपीपी पीसी पीप फ़ खाका न असम अजब ए
verses.wordMeaning: There is no doubt that he is stationed after adopting the two forms. When there is a contact with Vijftana (perfect knowledge) at the behest of Paramethin, liberation occurs within a moment and not otherwise, even with crorcs of holy rites.…

verses.sanskrit: भवानी च तमालोक्य मायामहरदव्यया ते मायामलनिर्मुक्ता मुनयः प्रेक्ष्य पार्वतीम्
verses.transliteration: bhavānī ca tamālokya māyāmaharadavyayā te māyāmalanirmuktā munayaḥ prekṣya pārvatīm
verses.translation: There is no doubt that he is stationed after adopting the two forms. When there is a contact with Vijftana (perfect knowledge) at the behest of Paramethin, liberation occurs within a moment and not otherwise, even with crorcs of holy rites. Here the order intended for the living beings is not applicable. By the grace of Paramesthin liberation takes place in a trice. This is undoubtedly the vow of the lord. The creature (i.e. individual soul) is liberated, thanks to the grace of Paramesthin even when he is in the womb or when he is born, or when he is a boy, a young man or an old man. By the grace of the lord of Devas every living being is liberated whether it is oviparous or a plant or one bom of sweat. No doubt need be entertained in this regard.
verses.hindi: एक सौ आठ बार जप करनेसे पापसे मुक्ति हो जाती है; इसमें सन्देह नहीं है। जो तत्त्वज्ञानी, ब्रह्मवेत्ता तथा उत्तम ब्राह्मण है, वह तो केवल प्रणवके स्मरणसे शुद्धि प्राप्त कर लेता है; इसमें सन्देह नहीं करा आत्रज्ञानियोंके लिये प्रायश्चित्त होते ही नहीं हैं; ब्रह्मविद्याको जाननेवाले लोग विश्वके कल्याणके प्रेरक होते हैं, अत: वे स्वतः  शुद्ध हैं । योगध्यानमें एकनिष्ठ वे लोग निर्लेप (शुद्ध) होते हैं, जैसे सुवर्ण शुद्ध होता है।
verses.wordMeaning: There is no doubt that he is stationed after adopting the two forms. When there is a contact with Vijftana (perfect knowledge) at the behest of Paramethin, liberation occurs within a moment and not otherwise, even with crorcs of holy rites.…

verses.sanskrit: प्रीता बभूवुर्मुक्ताश् च तस्मादेषा परा गतिः उमाशङ्करयोर्भेदो नास्त्येव परमार्थतः
verses.transliteration: prītā babhūvurmuktāś ca tasmādeṣā parā gatiḥ umāśaṅkarayorbhedo nāstyeva paramārthataḥ
verses.translation: There is no doubt that he is stationed after adopting the two forms. When there is a contact with Vijftana (perfect knowledge) at the behest of Paramethin, liberation occurs within a moment and not otherwise, even with crorcs of holy rites. Here the order intended for the living beings is not applicable. By the grace of Paramesthin liberation takes place in a trice. This is undoubtedly the vow of the lord. verses.hindi: शुद्ध लोगोंका शोधन नहीं होता है; वे तो ब्रह्मविद्याके द्वारा पहले ही शुद्ध होते हैं

verses.sanskrit: द्विधासौ रूपमास्थाय स्थित एव न संशयः यदा विद्वानसंगः स्याद् आज्ञया परमेष्ठिनः
verses.transliteration: dvidhāsau rūpamāsthāya sthita eva na saṃśayaḥ yadā vidvānasaṃgaḥ syād ājñayā parameṣṭhinaḥ

When there is a contact with Vijftana (perfect knowledge) at the behest of Paramethin, liberation occurs within a moment and not otherwise, even with crorcs of holy rites. Here the order intended for the living beings is not applicable. By the grace of Paramesthin liberation takes place in a trice. This is undoubtedly the vow of the lord. The creature (i.e. individual soul) is liberated, thanks to the grace of Paramesthin even when he is in the womb or when he is born, or when he is a boy, a young man or an old man. By the grace of the lord of Devas every living being is liberated whether it is oviparous or a plant or one bom of sweat. No doubt need be entertained in this regard.
verses.hindi: नदी आदिसे ग्रहण किये गये, वस्त्र तथा नेत्रसे भलीभाँति पवित्र, शीतल तथा फेनरहित जलसे सभी अनुष्ठान करना चाहिए; अशुद्ध जलका प्रयोग नहीं करना चाहिए। गन्ध-रंग-रससे दूषित जल, अपवित्र स्थानमें रखे हुए जल, कीचड़ तथा कंकड़से दूषित जल, समुद्री जल, तालाबके जल, शैवालयुक्त जल और अन्य दोषोंसे विकृत जलका सर्वथा त्याग कर देना चाहिए ॥ ५०-५११/२॥
verses.wordMeaning: There is no doubt that he is stationed after adopting the two forms. When there is a contact with Vijftana (perfect knowledge) at the behest of Paramethin, liberation occurs within a moment and not otherwise, even with crorcs of holy rites.…

verses.sanskrit: तदा मुक्तिः क्षणादेव नान्यथा कर्मकोटिभिः क्रमो ऽविवक्षितो भूतविवृद्धः परमेष्ठिनः
verses.transliteration: tadā muktiḥ kṣaṇādeva nānyathā karmakoṭibhiḥ kramo 'vivakṣito bhūtavivṛddhaḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ
verses.translation: There is no doubt that he is stationed after adopting the two forms. When there is a contact with Vijftana (perfect knowledge) at the behest of Paramethin, liberation occurs within a moment and not otherwise, even with crorcs of holy rites. Here the order intended for the living beings is not applicable. By the grace of Paramesthin liberation takes place in a trice. This is undoubtedly the vow of the lord. The creature (i.e. individual soul) is liberated, thanks to the grace of Paramesthin even when he is in the womb or when he is born, or when he is a boy, a young man or an old man. verses.hindi: हे द्विजो! वस्त्रकी शुद्धिसे युक्त होकर नमस्कार तथा गुरुसेवा आदि समस्त कार्य करने चाहिए; वस्त्रशुद्धिसे रहित व्यक्ति निश्चित रूपसे अपवित्र रहता है; इसमें सन्देह नहीं है। देवकार्यमें उपयोग किये
verses.wordMeaning: There is no doubt that he is stationed after adopting the two forms. When there is a contact with Vijftana (perfect knowledge) at the behest of Paramethin, liberation occurs within a moment and not otherwise, even with crorcs of holy rites.…

verses.sanskrit: प्रसादेन क्षणान्मुक्तिः प्रतिज्ञैषा न संशयः गर्भस्थो जायमानो वा बालो वा तरुणो ऽपि वा
verses.transliteration: prasādena kṣaṇānmuktiḥ pratijñaiṣā na saṃśayaḥ garbhastho jāyamāno vā bālo vā taruṇo 'pi vā

When there is a contact with Vijftana (perfect knowledge) at the behest of Paramethin, liberation occurs within a moment and not otherwise, even with crorcs of holy rites. Here the order intended for the living beings is not applicable. By the grace of Paramesthin liberation takes place in a trice. This is undoubtedly the vow of the lord. The creature (i.e. individual soul) is liberated, thanks to the grace of Paramesthin even when he is in the womb or when he is born, or when he is a boy, a young man or an old man. By the grace of the lord of Devas every living being is liberated whether it is oviparous or a plant or one bom of sweat. No doubt need be entertained in this regard.
verses.hindi: जानेवाले वस्त्रोकी शुद्धि प्रतिदिन आवश्यक है; मैले हो जानेपर अन्य चस्त्रोंकी शुद्धि करनी चाहिए। है द्विजो! दूसरोंके द्वारा धारण किये गये चस्त्रका पूर्ण प्रयलसे त्याग करना चाहिए॥ ५२-५४१५. ॥ रेशमी तथा ऊनी सस्त्रोंकी शुद्धि रीठे आदि रुक्ष पदार्थासे, क्षौम (दुकूल) सस्त्रोंकी शुद्धि श्वेत सरसोंसे, स्वर्णकिरणयुक्त वस्त्रोंकी शुद्धि बिल्व फलोंसे, कुशास्तरणों या छाग-कम्बलोंकी शुद्धि मद्ठेके सेचनसे
verses.wordMeaning: There is no doubt that he is stationed after adopting the two forms. When there is a contact with Vijftana (perfect knowledge) at the behest of Paramethin, liberation occurs within a moment and not otherwise, even with crorcs of holy rites.…

verses.translation: There is no doubt that he is stationed after adopting the two forms. When there is a contact with Vijftana (perfect knowledge) at the behest of Paramethin, liberation occurs within a moment and not otherwise, even with crorcs of holy rites. Here the order intended for the living beings is not applicable. By the grace of Paramesthin liberation takes place in a trice. This is undoubtedly the vow of the lord. The creature (i.e. individual soul) is liberated, thanks to the grace of Paramesthin even when he is in the womb or when he is born, or when he is a boy, a young man or an old man. By the grace of the lord of Devas every living being is liberated whether it is oviparous or a plant or one bom of sweat. No doubt need be entertained in this regard.
