Aiguma (minuteness), Laghima (lightness), Mahima (greatness), Prapti (the power of obtaining any thing), Pra- kamyam (irresistible will); llitva (lordship) over everything, Vaigitva (ability to make others subservient) and Kama* vasayita (when everything happens according to one's desires), these are eight types. This Aiivarya desired by everyone should be known as of three types.
verses.hindi: शुद्धि भस्मसे होती है, लौहपात्रकी शुद्धि क्षारसे, ताँबा- पात्रकी शुद्धि अम्लसे कही जाती है। हे श्रेष्ठ ब्राह्मणो ! सोने तथा चाँदीके पवित्र पात्र जलसे शुद्ध होते हैं; मणि, पत्थर, शंख तथा मोतीकी शुद्धि भी
verses.wordMeaning: See note 241. Aiguma (minuteness), Laghima (lightness), Mahima (greatness), Prapti (the power of obtaining any thing), Pra- kamyam (irresistible will); llitva (lordship) over everything,…

verses.sanskrit: अष्टशक्तिसमायुक्तम् अष्टमूर्तिमजं प्रभुम् ताभिश्चाष्टविधा रुद्राश् चतुःषष्टिविधाः पुनः
verses.transliteration: aṣṭaśaktisamāyuktam aṣṭamūrtimajaṃ prabhum tābhiścāṣṭavidhā rudrāś catuḥṣaṣṭividhāḥ punaḥ
verses.translation: The three types are Savadya, Niravadya and Suksma. What is termed Savadya is of the nature of five elements. The function of the Suksma (subtle) is in respect of the sense organs, mind and ego. The function is again of the nature of five elements (?). The sense-organs, mind, will, intellect and ego — the Atman comes into contact with all these. This three- fold contact functions only in the subtle things. Again the eight attributes are laid down only in the subtle forms. 1 shall men- tion their nature as described by the lord and as they are known among all living beings of the three worlds. The Anima, etc. are self-evident. They are well esta- blislied everywhere. They are cited as difficult of access to all living beings in the three worlds.
verses.hindi: सुवर्णपात्रकी भाँति कही गयी है। अत्यधिक दूषित पदार्थकी शुद्धि अग्नि तथा जलके संयोगसे होती है। सभी रसोंकी शुद्धि उत्प्लवन-क्रियाद्वारा बतायी गयी है तृण, काष्ठ आदि वस्तुओंकी शुद्धिहेतु पवित्र जलसे अभ्युक्षण (छिड़काव) बताया गया है और खुक्-स्रुवाकी शुद्धि उष्ण जलसे होती है। उसी प्रकार यज्ञपात्रों, मूसल, उलूखल (ओखली), सींग-अस्थि-

verses.sanskrit: शक्तयश् च तथा सर्वा गुणाष्टकसमन्विताः एवं स्मरेत्क्रमेणैव लब्ध्वा ज्ञानमनुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: śaktayaś ca tathā sarvā guṇāṣṭakasamanvitāḥ evaṃ smaretkrameṇaiva labdhvā jñānamanuttamam
verses.translation: On attaining the first Aisvarya, the devotee gets the power of the yogins. This will make him assume such forms that will enable him to cross or float (on water or air). The second (Laghima) is known as the attainment of great quick- ness (Sigliratva) among all living beings. In all the three worlds honour among all living beings is due to one's greatness. Therefore, the third yoga (i.e. Aisvarya) is called Mahitva ( = Mahima) in the world. Prapti enables one to mix at one's will and pleasure with all living beings in the three worlds. By Prakamya the devotee enjoys all desired objects. It is through obstruction somewhere that happiness and misery are brought about in all living beings in the three worlds.
verses.hindi: काष्ठ तथा हाथीदाँतकी बनी वस्तुओंको शुद्धि तक्षण (छीलने)-से होती है। है महाभागो! संहत (मिली- जुली) वस्तुओंकी शुद्धिहेतु प्रोक्षण बताया गया है और असंहत (पृथक्) वस्तुओंको अलग-अलग शुद्ध करना
verses.wordMeaning: On attaining the first Aisvarya, the devotee gets the power of the yogins. This will make him assume such forms that will enable him to cross or float (on water or air). The second (Laghima) is known as the attainment of great quick- ness (Sigliratva) among all living beings.…

verses.sanskrit: एवं पाशुपतं योगं मोक्षसिद्धिप्रदायकम् तस्याणिमादयो विप्रा नान्यथा कर्मकोटिभिः
verses.transliteration: evaṃ pāśupataṃ yogaṃ mokṣasiddhipradāyakam tasyāṇimādayo viprā nānyathā karmakoṭibhiḥ
verses.translation: The knower of the yoga Ilitva (sixth AMvarya) be- comes the overlord everywhere in every stage. In the three worlds consisting of the mobile and immobile beings all the living beings become subservient to him. This is Vasitva the seventh Aiivarya. Where there is Kamavasayitva (the eighth and highest Aiivarya) forms occur and cea to be as the devotee wbhes
verses.hindi: भोजनहेतु अनाजकी राशिके एक भागके दूषित हो जानेपर उतने भागको निकालकर शेष भागका कुशके जलसे प्रोक्षण करना चाहिए। शाक, मूल, फल आदिकी शुद्धि धान्य (अनाज)-की शुद्धिकी भाँति कही जाती है। घरकी शुद्धि मार्जन (जलसेचन) तथा गोबरसे लीपनेसे होती है। मिट्टीका पात्र अग्निमें गर्म करनेसे शुद्ध होता है। भूमिकी शुद्धि खनन (खोदने)- से, गायके गोबरसे लीपनेसे, मलापकरणसे, गायके
verses.wordMeaning: The knower of the yoga Ilitva (sixth AMvarya) be- comes the overlord everywhere in every stage. In the three worlds consisting of the mobile and immobile beings all the living beings become subservient to him. This is Vasitva the seventh Aiivarya.…

verses.sanskrit: तत्राष्टगुणमैश्वर्यं योगिनां समुदाहृतम् तत्सर्वं क्रमयोगेन ह्य् उच्यमानं निबोधत
verses.transliteration: tatrāṣṭaguṇamaiśvaryaṃ yogināṃ samudāhṛtam tatsarvaṃ kramayogena hy ucyamānaṃ nibodhata
verses.translation: When all these Siddhis or Aivaryas are attained, sound, touch, taste, smell, colour and the mind, all function or cease to function as the devotee wishes. Thanks to salvation, he is all-pervasive. Being all-per- vasive, he is called Purusa. Due to his subtle nature, Purusa is stationed in the greatest Aivarya (prosperity and glory).
verses.hindi: निवाससे तथा जलके द्वारा सेचनसे बतायी गयी है। भूमिपर ठहरा हुआ जल जो अपवित्र पदार्थसे युक्त न हो तथा गन्ध, वर्ण, रससे युक्त हो, वह गायके द्वारा प्यास बुझनेतक पी लिये जानेपर शुद्ध हो जाता है।
verses.wordMeaning: When all these Siddhis or Aivaryas are attained, sound, touch, taste, smell, colour and the mind, all function or cease to function as the devotee wishes. Thanks to salvation, he is all-pervasive. Being all-per- vasive, he is called Purusa. Due to his subtle nature,…

verses.sanskrit: अणिमा लघिमा चैव महिमा प्राप्तिरेव च प्राकाम्यं चैव सर्वत्र ईशित्वं चैव सर्वतः
verses.transliteration: aṇimā laghimā caiva mahimā prāptireva ca prākāmyaṃ caiva sarvatra īśitvaṃ caiva sarvataḥ
verses.translation: The AUvaryas are said to be subtler and greater in ascending order all round. After obtaining the excellent yoga and the unimpeded Aisvaryas, one shall attain salvation. That is the greatest subtle goal. O leading sages, the yoga pertaining to Paupati should be known thus. It bestows the benefits of heaven and salvation. It is the cause of identity with Siva. Or, one who has no perfect knowledge may perform holy rites due to attachments. After enjoying Rjasa and Tamasa pleasures he is liberated there itsclf(i.e. in this world). Similarly, he who performs meritorious deeds attains the benefit in heaven.
verses.hindi: बछडा गोदोहनके समय शुद्ध होता है और पक्षी  चोंचह्वारा फल गिरानेके समय शुद्ध होता है। भार्याकी आकांक्षासे रतिके समय गृहस्थोंके लिये पत्नी शुद्ध होती है। धर्मवेत्ताको चाहिए कि धोबीके द्वारा हाथसे धोये गये वस्त्रको विधिपूर्वक कुशके जलसे प्रोक्षित करके धारण करे

verses.sanskrit: वशित्वमथ सर्वत्र यत्र कामावसायिता तच्चापि त्रिविधं ज्ञेयम् ऐश्वर्यं सार्वकामिकम्
verses.transliteration: vaśitvamatha sarvatra yatra kāmāvasāyitā taccāpi trividhaṃ jñeyam aiśvaryaṃ sārvakāmikam
verses.translation: But the moment his merits are exhausted the ex- cellent man reverts to the mortal world from that abode. Hence Brahman is the greatest happiness. Brahman is the best and permanent goal. One shall resort to the Brahman alone. Brahman alone is the greatest happiness. All yajfias arc mere waste of energy and no good results from them. One becomes a prey to death by resorting to Yajfias. So liberation is the sole happiness. After seeing the divine Purusa of universal names with fates all rounds the devotee, engaged in medita- tion, devoutly engrossed in the principle of the Brahman can- The yogins who are in union with the deity see the Prakfti of all living beings as acetana (insentient) subtle, all- pervasive and habitually giving birth to many effects.
verses.hindi: ग श्रीलिड्रमहापुराण

verses.commentary: Sense: But the moment his merits are exhausted the ex- cellent man reverts to the mortal world from that abode. Hence Brahman is the greatest happiness. Brahman is the best and permanent goal. One shall resort to the Brahman alone. Brahman alone is the greatest happiness.…

verses.sanskrit: सावद्यं निरवद्यं च सूक्ष्मं चैव प्रवर्तते सावद्यं नाम यत्तत्र पञ्चभूतात्मकं स्मृतम्
verses.transliteration: sāvadyaṃ niravadyaṃ ca sūkṣmaṃ caiva pravartate sāvadyaṃ nāma yattatra pañcabhūtātmakaṃ smṛtam
verses.translation: She has hands and feet all round. She has eyes, heads and faces all round. She has ears all round. She stands enve- loping everything in the world. One who is endowed with yoga and knows the eternal Purusa, the lord of all living beings, never gets disillusioned.
verses.hindi: शुचिराकरजं तेषां श्वा मृगग्रहणे शुचिः॥ खानसे निकालकर विक्रयहेतु फैलायी गयी वस्तभ वर्णाश्रमविभागके अनुसार शुद्धता होती है और मृगयामें हरिण आदि पशुओंको पकडते समय श्‍वान शुद्ध होता है
verses.wordMeaning: She has hands and feet all round. She has eyes, heads and faces all round. She has ears all round. She stands enve- loping everything in the world. One who is endowed with yoga and knows the eternal Purusa, the lord of all living beings, never gets disillusioned.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रियाणि मनश्चैव अहङ्कारश् च यः स्मृतः तत्र सूक्ष्मप्रवृत्तिस्तु पञ्चभूतात्मिका पुनः
verses.transliteration: indriyāṇi manaścaiva ahaṅkāraś ca yaḥ smṛtaḥ tatra sūkṣmapravṛttistu pañcabhūtātmikā punaḥ
verses.translation: One who meditates on the unchanging, great and noble Brahman which is the soul of all living beings, and which is the greatest Atman, does not get disillusioned. Just as the wind moving amongst all bodies is per- ceptible so also the Purusa. Because he lies down in the puh®* so be is called Purufa [puri £ete]. He is too difficult to be grasped.
verses.hindi: हे द्विजश्रेष्ठो! अनिषिद्ध छाया, वेदपाठके समय मुखसे निकली बुँदे, विप्र, मक्खियाँ, धूल, भूमि, वायु अग्नि-ये सब स्पर्शके लिये सदा शुद्ध होते है  हे विप्रो! सोकर उठनेपर, भोजनके अनन्तर, छींक आनेपर,

verses.transliteration: indriyāṇi manaścittabuddhyahaṅkārasaṃjñitam tathā sarvamayaṃ caiva ātmasthā khyātireva ca
verses.translation: If one neglects Dharma, that man is born in the %vomb®' Mrith the residue of his activities.®* When a man and a woman indulge in intercourse and the semen gets mixed with the blood, in due course, the sperm becomes the foetus. In due course, the foetus becomes a bubble.®*® Just as the lump of clay assumes some form of an image on being whirled in the wheel and shaped by the potter's hands so also the physical body is evolved, endowed with organic matter and filled with vital airs. As long as the external air®*® does not touch the child in the womb he thinks thus — ''when I leave off the vaginal passage®* I shall resort to Maheivara and worship Mahadeva. The foetus becomes a human being accord- ing to the pre-ordained form and age.
verses.hindi: जल आदि पीनेपर, थूकनेपर और अध्ययनके आदिमे पवित्र होते हुए भी फिरसे आचमन करना चाहिए अन्य लोगोंके द्वारा किये गये आचमनकी जो बूँहै पैरोंपर पड़ जायं, उन्हें धूलके समान समझना चाहिए; उनसे कोई अशुद्ध नहीं होता है॥७१--७३ ॥

verses.sanskrit: संयोग एव त्रिविधः सूक्ष्मेष्वेव प्रवर्तते पुनरष्टगुणश्चापि सूक्ष्मेष्वेव विधीयते
verses.transliteration: saṃyoga eva trividhaḥ sūkṣmeṣveva pravartate punaraṣṭaguṇaścāpi sūkṣmeṣveva vidhīyate
verses.translation: Wind originates from the firmament, from wind water is evolved; from water originates the vital air and the semen is generated and it flourishes through the vital airs. Thirtythrce parts of blood are mixed with fourteen parts of semen. When halves of these parts mix together the foetus is evolved.
verses.hindi: मैथुनके अनन्तर, पतितका स्पर्श करके, मुर्गा- सूअर-कौवा-कुत्ता-ऊँट-गधा-यूप, चाण्डाल आदिका स्पर्श करके व्यक्ति स्नानके द्वारा शुद्ध होता है। रजस्वला, प्रसूता तथा शूद्रा स्त्रीका स्पर्श नहीं करना
verses.wordMeaning: Wind originates from the firmament, from wind water is evolved; from water originates the vital air and the semen is generated and it flourishes through the vital airs. Thirtythrce parts of blood are mixed with fourteen parts of semen.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Wind originates from the firmament, from wind water is evolved; from water originates the vital air and the semen is generated and it flourishes through the vital airs. Thirtythrce parts of blood are mixed with fourteen parts of semen.…

verses.sanskrit: तस्य रूपं प्रवक्ष्यामि यथाह भगवान्प्रभुः त्रैलोक्ये सर्वभूतेषु यथास्य नियमः स्मृतः
verses.transliteration: tasya rūpaṃ pravakṣyāmi yathāha bhagavānprabhuḥ trailokye sarvabhūteṣu yathāsya niyamaḥ smṛtaḥ
verses.translation: Then the child in the womb is encircled by the five vital airs. The child's form is evolved limb by limb from the physical body of the father. Through the umbilical region the child is sustained by the food taken in by the mother, by the liquid drink and by the lambatives licked.
verses.hindi: चाहिए। जननाशौच तथा मरणाशौचसे युक्त व्यक्तिको चाहिए कि अपने सम्बन्धियोंकी स्त्रियोंमें रजस्वला स्त्रीको न छुए और छू लेनेपर वह स्नान करके ही शुद्ध होता है ॥ ७४--७६॥ ब्रह्मचारियों, राजाओं तथा उनके मन्त्रियोंको अशौच नहीं लगता है। कार्यमें अवरोध न हो, इसलिये राजाओंको, भ्रमणशील संन्यासियों और ब्राह्मणोंको तथा पतितजनोंके लिये सम्भव न होनेके कारण अशौच नहीं
verses.wordMeaning: Then the child in the womb is encircled by the five vital airs. The child's form is evolved limb by limb from the physical body of the father. Through the umbilical region the child is sustained by the food taken in by the mother, by the liquid drink and by the lambatives licked.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the child in the womb is encircled by the five vital airs. The child's form is evolved limb by limb from the physical body of the father. Through the umbilical region the child is sustained by the food taken in by the mother, by the liquid drink and by the lambatives licked.

verses.sanskrit: अणिमाद्यं तथाव्यक्तं सर्वत्रैव प्रतिष्ठितम् त्रैलोक्ये सर्वभूतानां दुष्प्राप्यं समुदाहृतम्
verses.transliteration: aṇimādyaṃ tathāvyaktaṃ sarvatraiva pratiṣṭhitam trailokye sarvabhūtānāṃ duṣprāpyaṃ samudāhṛtam
verses.translation: For nine months the child undergoes the pain and avaMitaib karmabhih*
verses.hindi: होता है। कुछ भी संचय न करनेवाले ब्राह्मणों, यज्ञके लिये दीक्षित यजमान तथा जिन्हें अशोचकालमें उसकी जानकारी न हुई हो--ऐसे लोगोंकी स्नानमात्रसे शुद्धि हो जाती है। यज्ञमें दीक्षित ऋत्विजों तथा उनकी वैदिक
verses.wordMeaning: For nine months the child undergoes the pain and avaMitaib karmabhih*
verses.commentary: Sense: For nine months the child undergoes the pain and avaMitaib karmabhih*

verses.sanskrit: तत् तस्य भवति प्राप्यं प्रथमं योगिनां बलम् लङ्घनं प्लवनं लोके रूपमस्य सदा भवेत्
verses.transliteration: tat tasya bhavati prāpyaṃ prathamaṃ yogināṃ balam laṅghanaṃ plavanaṃ loke rūpamasya sadā bhavet
verses.translation: cT?iTRr?r; After spending nine months in the womb the child falls down through the vaginal passage with his head down- wards. Then in the course of his life on the earth he commits sins and due to these sins he falls into hell after death.
verses.hindi: शाखाका अध्ययन करनेवालोंका अशौच ब्रह्माजीने एक दिनका बताया है। अपने गोत्रसे भिन्न जनोंकी शुद्धि चार दिनोंमें हो जाती है; क्योंकि उनके लिये जननाशौच तथा मरणाशौच तीन दिनोंसे अधिक नहीं होता है । परिवारमें मृत्यु हो जानेपर बान्धवोंकी दस दिनोंमें शुद्धि हो जाती
verses.wordMeaning: cT?iTRr?r; After spending nine months in the womb the child falls down through the vaginal passage with his head down- wards. Then in the course of his life on the earth he commits sins and due to these sins he falls into hell after death.
verses.commentary: Sense: cT?iTRr?r; After spending nine months in the womb the child falls down through the vaginal passage with his head down- wards. Then in the course of his life on the earth he commits sins and due to these sins he falls into hell after death.

verses.sanskrit: शीघ्रत्वं सर्वभूतेषु द्वितीयं तु पदं स्मृतम् त्रैलोक्ये सर्वभूतानां महिम्ना चैव वन्दितम्
verses.transliteration: śīghratvaṃ sarvabhūteṣu dvitīyaṃ tu padaṃ smṛtam trailokye sarvabhūtānāṃ mahimnā caiva vanditam
verses.translation: For example, he may fall into the hells of Asipatravana and Salmalicchedana. There he may have to suffer being beaten, eaten or forced to partake of footed blood. Just as the water becomes sticky and binding to- gether when things are cut and thrown in, so also the living beings are cut and thrown into the places of torture. They are scorched by means of the sins committed by themselves. They shall attain misery or happiness according to the residue of their actions.
verses.hindi: छाया च विप्लुषो विप्रा मक्षिकाद्या द्विजोत्तमा: । रजोभूर्वायुरग्निशच मेध्यानि स्पर्शने सदा
verses.wordMeaning: For example, he may fall into the hells of Asipatravana and Salmalicchedana. There he may have to suffer being beaten, eaten or forced to partake of footed blood. Just as the water becomes sticky and binding to- gether when things are cut and thrown in,…
verses.commentary: Sense: For example, he may fall into the hells of Asipatravana and Salmalicchedana. There he may have to suffer being beaten, eaten or forced to partake of footed blood. Just as the water becomes sticky and binding to- gether when things are cut and thrown in,…

verses.sanskrit: महित्वं चापि लोके ऽस्मिंस् तृतीयो योग उच्यते त्रैलोक्ये सर्वभूतेषु यथेष्टगमनं स्मृतम्
verses.transliteration: mahitvaṃ cāpi loke 'smiṃs tṛtīyo yoga ucyate trailokye sarvabhūteṣu yatheṣṭagamanaṃ smṛtam
verses.translation: One has to go alone after leaving off all people. One has to experience pleasure or pain all alone. Hence, one shall perform meritorious rites. When he starts on his journey after death, none follows him as he goes ahead. The action performed by him follows him.
verses.hindi: सूकरं चैव काकादि श्वानमुष्ट्रं खरं तथा यूपं चाण्डालकाद्यांश्च स्पृष्ट्वा स्नानेन शुध्यति। रजस्वलां सूतिकां च न स्पृशेदन्त्यजामपि
verses.wordMeaning: One has to go alone after leaving off all people. One has to experience pleasure or pain all alone. Hence, one shall perform meritorious rites. When he starts on his journey after death, none follows him as he goes ahead. The action performed by him follows him.
verses.commentary: Sense: One has to go alone after leaving off all people. One has to experience pleasure or pain all alone. Hence, one shall perform meritorious rites. When he starts on his journey after death, none follows him as he goes ahead. The action performed by him follows him.

verses.sanskrit: प्राकामान् विषयान् भुङ्क्ते तथाप्रतिहतः क्वचित् त्रैलोक्ये सर्वभूतानां सुखदुःखं प्रवर्तते
verses.transliteration: prākāmān viṣayān bhuṅkte tathāpratihataḥ kvacit trailokye sarvabhūtānāṃ sukhaduḥkhaṃ pravartate
verses.translation: They function thus in the realms of Yama. When the treatment is against their liking they always groan loudly. Their bodies are dessicated by diversified tortures and surrounded by torments and agonies. The practice of what one repeatedly resorts to mentally, physically and verbally influences him. Hence, one shall per- form auspicious things always.
verses.hindi: सूतिकाशौचसंयुक्तः शावाशौचसमन्वितः । संस्पृशेन्न रजस्तासां सपृष्ट्वा स्नात्वैव शुध्यति
verses.wordMeaning: They function thus in the realms of Yama. When the treatment is against their liking they always groan loudly. Their bodies are dessicated by diversified tortures and surrounded by torments and agonies. The practice of what one repeatedly resorts to mentally,…
verses.commentary: Sense: They function thus in the realms of Yama. When the treatment is against their liking they always groan loudly. Their bodies are dessicated by diversified tortures and surrounded by torments and agonies. The practice of what one repeatedly resorts to mentally,…

verses.sanskrit: ईशो भवति सर्वत्र प्रविभागेन योगवित् वश्यानि चास्य भूतानि त्रैलोक्ये सचराचरे
verses.transliteration: īśo bhavati sarvatra pravibhāgena yogavit vaśyāni cāsya bhūtāni trailokye sacarācare
verses.translation: The uninterrupted scries of previous actions of the embodied soul has no beginning: The individual soul adopts six types of terrible worldly existence full of tamaoguiia. From human form it adopts <he form of cow (domestic animal); from that of a cow, the domestic animal, he may become a wild animal; from that of a wild animal he may attain bird-hood; from that the form of a reptile and from that he may attain the form of an immobile being. When he attains the form of an immobile being it whirls like the wheel of the potter there itself till the soul is uplifted. Thus is the worldly existence beginning from human being and ending
verses.hindi: नैवाशौचं यतीनां च वनस्थब्रह्मचारिणाम्। नैष्ठिकानां नृपाणां च मण्डलीनां च सुव्रताः ततः कार्यविरोधाद्धि नृपाणां नान्यथा भवेत्। वैखानसानां विप्राणां पतितानामसम्भवात्
verses.wordMeaning: The uninterrupted scries of previous actions of the embodied soul has no beginning: The individual soul adopts six types of terrible worldly existence full of tamaoguiia. From human form it adopts <he form of cow (domestic animal); from that of a cow, the domestic animal,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The uninterrupted scries of previous actions of the embodied soul has no beginning: The individual soul adopts six types of terrible worldly existence full of tamaoguiia. From human form it adopts <he form of cow (domestic animal); from that of a cow, the domestic animal,…

verses.sanskrit: इच्छया तस्य रूपाणि भवन्ति न भवन्ति च यत्र कामावसायित्वं त्रैलोक्ये सचराचरे
verses.transliteration: icchayā tasya rūpāṇi bhavanti na bhavanti ca yatra kāmāvasāyitvaṃ trailokye sacarācare
verses.translation: In the middle of the fourteen abodes, Rajas is that which impedes or fixes firmly even as the vital parts of the body of the embodied being who is in agony, are being cut and pierced. How can the brahmin then remember the greatest Brahman? The worldly existence is prompted by the impression and effects of the previous Dharma and accordingly human birth is achieved. Hence one shall practise meditation always. One shall realise that the zone of the worlds is of four- teen types and so shall be frightened of it and begin to practise Dharma. Then, he changes and gradually crosses worldly ex- istence. Hence, one shall always be engaged in yoga and interested in meditation. He shall meditate on the greatest being. He shall so begin the practice of yoga that he sees the Atman within himself.
verses.hindi: तथासन्निहितानां च यज्ञार्थं दीक्षितस्य च
verses.wordMeaning: In the middle of the fourteen abodes, Rajas is that which impedes or fixes firmly even as the vital parts of the body of the embodied being who is in agony, are being cut and pierced.…
verses.commentary: Sense: In the middle of the fourteen abodes, Rajas is that which impedes or fixes firmly even as the vital parts of the body of the embodied being who is in agony, are being cut and pierced.…

verses.sanskrit: शब्दः स्पर्शो रसो गन्धो रूपं चैव मनस् तथा प्रवर्तन्ते ऽस्य चेच्छातो न भवन्ति यथेच्छया
verses.transliteration: śabdaḥ sparśo raso gandho rūpaṃ caiva manas tathā pravartante 'sya cecchāto na bhavanti yathecchayā
verses.translation: He is the waters. He is the greatest light. He is the excellent bridge. He is the cause of all living beings by means of evolution and combination. He is the permanent one. Hence, one shall worship Mabeivara the bridge, the Atman, the fire with faces all round, and stationed in the heart of all living beings. The devotee shall meditate on Rudra, the lord who is stationed within who is embdlished by his own Sakti who, for the sake of creation, is stationed in a series of eight* different forms and who is stationed in the heart by compres* sing the fire. With the mind contemplating the fire stationed in the heart he shall perform five offerings. He shall drink pure water silently cmce (in the ritualistic way) in the squatting position. He shall utter **Prku&ya Svahfi''. This is the first
verses.hindi: एकाहाद्यज्ञयाजीनां शुद्धिरुक्ता स्वयम्भुवा। ततस्त्वधीतशाखानां चतुर्भिः सर्वदेहिनाम् सूतकं प्रेतकं नास्ति त्र्यहादूर्ध्वममुत्र वै। अर्वागेकादशाहान्तं बान्धवानां द्विजोत्तमाः ॥ ८ ९
verses.wordMeaning: He is the waters. He is the greatest light. He is the excellent bridge. He is the cause of all living beings by means of evolution and combination. He is the permanent one. Hence, one shall worship Mabeivara the bridge, the Atman, the fire with faces all round,…
verses.commentary: Sense: He is the waters. He is the greatest light. He is the excellent bridge. He is the cause of all living beings by means of evolution and combination. He is the permanent one. Hence, one shall worship Mabeivara the bridge, the Atman, the fire with faces all round,…

verses.sanskrit: न जायते न म्रियते छिद्यते न च भिद्यते न दह्यते न मुह्येत लीयते न च लिप्यते
verses.transliteration: na jāyate na mriyate chidyate na ca bhidyate na dahyate na muhyeta līyate na ca lipyate
verses.translation: He shall perform the rite of satiety with this mantra: — 'you are the knot of the vital airs.®*® Rudra is Atman. Atman is the destroyer of the subjects. Rudra, indeed, is the vital air of the Atman.'' At the time of Sraddha he shall perform five offer- ings as per injunction:— ( 1) Indeed, Rudra is embedded in Prana (2) Hence, he himself is identical with Prana, (3) One performs the excellent nectar unto Prana and Rudra, (4) O Siva, O Isa, enter me, (5) Svaha unto Brahmatman himself.
verses.hindi: अध्याय ८९ सदाचार तथा शौचाचारका निरूपण, द्रव्यशुद्धि, अशौचप्रवृत्ति एवं स्त्रीधर्मविवेचन
verses.wordMeaning: He shall perform the rite of satiety with this mantra: — 'you are the knot of the vital airs.®*® Rudra is Atman. Atman is the destroyer of the subjects. Rudra, indeed,…
verses.commentary: Sense: He shall perform the rite of satiety with this mantra: — 'you are the knot of the vital airs.®*® Rudra is Atman. Atman is the destroyer of the subjects. Rudra, indeed,…

verses.sanskrit: न क्षीयते न क्षरति खिद्यते न कदाचन क्रियते वा न सर्वत्र तथा विक्रियते न च
verses.transliteration: na kṣīyate na kṣarati khidyate na kadācana kriyate vā na sarvatra tathā vikriyate na ca
verses.translation: The Homa shall be concluded with the following mantras: — You arePuru§a. You lie down in the body, in the size of the thumb. l:a is the great cause of all though based on the thumb.®** May the permanent lord of all the Universe be pleased. You are the eldest of all Devas. You are Rudra. For- merly you were Indra. You are soft by nature. May this sacri- ficial offering unto you be our food. The practice of yoga has been formerly mentioned by Brahma himself. Thus, the pect knowledge belonging to Paiupati should be known with effort. One shall take bath with Bhasman. One shall smear Bhasman. He who reads this, listens to this or narrates this to excellent brahmins in divine rites or in those of the Pitfs attains the greatest goal.

verses.sanskrit: अगन्धरसरूपस्तु अस्पर्शः शब्दवर्जितः अवर्णो ह्यस्वरश् चैव असवर्णस्तु कर्हिचित्
verses.transliteration: agandharasarūpastu asparśaḥ śabdavarjitaḥ avarṇo hyasvaraś caiva asavarṇastu karhicit
verses.translation: gnmthir TA. lo. 31.1; Mahan. U. 16.2. iiAgit9tfiiiiitrD*ysm« TA. 10.38. i;Mali&ii. U. 16. 3*
verses.hindi: दशाहं सूतिकाशौचं मातुरप्येवमव्ययाः। अर्वाक् त्रिवर्षात्स्नानेन बान्धवानां पितुः सदा

verses.sanskrit: स भुङ्क्ते विषयांश्चैव विषयैर्न च युज्यते अणुत्वात्तु परः सूक्ष्मः सूक्ष्मत्वाद् अपवर्गिकः
verses.transliteration: sa bhuṅkte viṣayāṃścaiva viṣayairna ca yujyate aṇutvāttu paraḥ sūkṣmaḥ sūkṣmatvād apavargikaḥ
verses.translation: This has been formerly mentioned by Brahma for the welfare of living beings. This is the summary of the implication of the Vedas. It is a collection of things expounding the Brah- man. It is conducive to the rise of cleanliness. It is the excellent position of the sages. The sage who does not err in this does not come to grief.
verses.hindi: अष्टाब्दादेकरात्रेण शुद्धि: स्याद् बान्धवस्य तु। द्वादशाब्दात्ततश्चार्वाक् त्रिरात्रं स्त्रीषु सुव्रताः ततः सन्निहितो विप्रश्चार्वाक् पूर्व तदेव वै। संवत्सरे व्यतीते तु स्नानमात्रेण शुद्धयति
verses.wordMeaning: This has been formerly mentioned by Brahma for the welfare of living beings. This is the summary of the implication of the Vedas. It is a collection of things expounding the Brah- man. It is conducive to the rise of cleanliness. It is the excellent position of the sages.…
verses.commentary: Sense: This has been formerly mentioned by Brahma for the welfare of living beings. This is the summary of the implication of the Vedas. It is a collection of things expounding the Brah- man. It is conducive to the rise of cleanliness. It is the excellent position of the sages.…

verses.sanskrit: व्यापकस्त्वपवर्गाच्च व्यापकात्पुरुषः स्मृतः पुरुषः सूक्ष्मभावात्तु ऐश्वर्ये परमे स्थितः
verses.transliteration: vyāpakastvapavargācca vyāpakātpuruṣaḥ smṛtaḥ puruṣaḥ sūkṣmabhāvāttu aiśvarye parame sthitaḥ
verses.translation: Honour and dishonour are two things which they call poison and nectar. Dishonour is nectar and honour is poison. He, the disciple, shall live with the preceptor for a year engaged in the w'elfarc of the preceptor. He shall always be unerring in the holy observances and restraints.
verses.hindi: स्पृष्ट्वा प्रेतं त्रिरात्रेण धर्मार्थं स्नानमुच्यते। दाहकानां च नेतृणां स्नानमात्रमबान्धवे
verses.wordMeaning: Honour and dishonour are two things which they call poison and nectar. Dishonour is nectar and honour is poison. He, the disciple, shall live with the preceptor for a year engaged in the w'elfarc of the preceptor.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Honour and dishonour are two things which they call poison and nectar. Dishonour is nectar and honour is poison. He, the disciple, shall live with the preceptor for a year engaged in the w'elfarc of the preceptor.…

verses.sanskrit: गुणोत्तरमथैश्वर्ये सर्वतः सूक्ष्ममुच्यते ऐश्वर्यं चाप्रतीघातं प्राप्य योगमनुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: guṇottaramathaiśvarye sarvataḥ sūkṣmamucyate aiśvaryaṃ cāpratīghātaṃ prāpya yogamanuttamam
verses.translation: After obtaining his permission along with the excellent path of knowledge he shall walk over the earth [i. e. fulfil the duties of the mundane existence] without repugnance to Dharma. One shall traverse the path sanctified by the eyes; one shall drink the water rendered pure by a cloth (i. e. well- filtered); one shall speak out words sanctified by truth; one shall practise those things that arc purified by the mind.*®
verses.hindi: केवलं द्वादशाहेन क्षत्रियाणां द्विजोत्तमाः । नाभिषिक्तस्य चाशौचं सम्म्रमादेषु वै रणे वैश्यः पञ्चदशाहेन शूद्रो मासेन शुद्धयति। इति सङ्क्षेपतः प्रोक्ता द्रव्यशुद्धिरुत्तमा
verses.wordMeaning: After obtaining his permission along with the excellent path of knowledge he shall walk over the earth [i. e. fulfil the duties of the mundane existence] without repugnance to Dharma. One shall traverse the path sanctified by the eyes;…
verses.commentary: Sense: After obtaining his permission along with the excellent path of knowledge he shall walk over the earth [i. e. fulfil the duties of the mundane existence] without repugnance to Dharma. One shall traverse the path sanctified by the eyes;…

verses.sanskrit: अपवर्गं ततो गच्छेत् सूक्ष्मं तत्परमं पदम् एवं पाशुपतं योगं ज्ञातव्यं मुनिपुङ्गवाः
verses.transliteration: apavargaṃ tato gacchet sūkṣmaṃ tatparamaṃ padam evaṃ pāśupataṃ yogaṃ jñātavyaṃ munipuṅgavāḥ
verses.translation: If one drinks impure water for a day one incurs that sin which a fisherman incurs in the course of six months. On drinking impure water one shall as expiation perform five hundred japas of Aghora mantra and then attain purity.
verses.hindi: है। जन्मके दस दिनके बाद छः मासके भीतर बालकको मृत्यु होनेपर एक दिनका अशौच होता है। तत्पश्चात् सात वर्षसे छोटे बालककी मृत्यु होनेपर तीन रातका अशौच होता है। सात वर्षसे बड़े उपनीत
verses.wordMeaning: If one drinks impure water for a day one incurs that sin which a fisherman incurs in the course of six months. On drinking impure water one shall as expiation perform five hundred japas of Aghora mantra and then attain purity.
verses.commentary: Sense: If one drinks impure water for a day one incurs that sin which a fisherman incurs in the course of six months. On drinking impure water one shall as expiation perform five hundred japas of Aghora mantra and then attain purity.

verses.sanskrit: स्वर्गापवर्गफलदं शिवसायुज्यकारणम् अथवा गतविज्ञानो रागात्कर्म समाचरेत्
verses.transliteration: svargāpavargaphaladaṃ śivasāyujyakāraṇam athavā gatavijñāno rāgātkarma samācaret
verses.translation: Or he shall worship Siva with elaborate details, such as ablution with ghee, etc. Then he shall circumambulate the deity three times, when he shall undoubtedly be purified. The mtelligent mendicant shaU go in for alms to a house where all people have taken food but still there is plenty
verses.hindi: ब्राह्मण-बालककी मृत्युपर दस दिनका अशौच होता है, किंतु विकल्पसे पिताके लिये एक दिनका भी अशौच बताया गया है, माताके लिये तो दस दिनका अशौच रहता ही है। तीन वर्षसे कमके बालककी मृत्युपर बान्धवोंकी शुद्धि स्नानमात्रसे हो जाती है, किंतु पिताकी शुद्धि सदा ही तीन रात्रिके उपरान्त ही होती है। आठ वर्षसे अधिकके सम्बन्धीकी मृत्यु होनेपर बान्धवोंको शुद्धि एक दिनमें हो जाती है। है सुव्रतो! आठ वर्षके
verses.wordMeaning: Or he shall worship Siva with elaborate details, such as ablution with ghee, etc. Then he shall circumambulate the deity three times, when he shall undoubtedly be purified.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Or he shall worship Siva with elaborate details, such as ablution with ghee, etc. Then he shall circumambulate the deity three times, when he shall undoubtedly be purified.…

verses.sanskrit: राजसं तामसं वापि भुक्त्वा तत्रैव मुच्यते तथा सुकृतकर्मा तु फलं स्वर्गे समश्नुते
verses.transliteration: rājasaṃ tāmasaṃ vāpi bhuktvā tatraiva mucyate tathā sukṛtakarmā tu phalaṃ svarge samaśnute
verses.translation: In that case people will insult him and the enemies Will disgrace and humiliate him. So one shall beg for alms in the proper manner. He shall not defile the Dharma of good men. One shall beg for alms in the houses of vagrant mendicants and in the houses situated in the forests. The latter shall be the better mode of sustenance.
verses.hindi: बाद बारह वर्षके पहलेतक स््त्रियोंको तीन रातका अशौच होता है। सातवीं पीढ़ीके बाद सपिण्डता समाप्त हो जाती है। दस दिन बीत जानेपर अशौचका ज्ञान होनेपर तीन रातका अशौच होता है। है विप्रो! छः
verses.wordMeaning: In that case people will insult him and the enemies Will disgrace and humiliate him. So one shall beg for alms in the proper manner. He shall not defile the Dharma of good men. One shall beg for alms in the houses of vagrant mendicants and in the houses situated in the forests.…
verses.commentary: Sense: In that case people will insult him and the enemies Will disgrace and humiliate him. So one shall beg for alms in the proper manner. He shall not defile the Dharma of good men. One shall beg for alms in the houses of vagrant mendicants and in the houses situated in the forests.…

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात्स्थानात्पुनः श्रेष्ठो मानुष्यमुपपद्यते तस्माद्ब्रह्म परं सौख्यं ब्रह्म शाश्वतम् उत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: tasmātsthānātpunaḥ śreṣṭho mānuṣyamupapadyate tasmādbrahma paraṃ saukhyaṃ brahma śāśvatam uttamam
verses.translation: O brahmins, thereafter he shall go in for alms at the places of humble householders who have faith, who have control over the sense-organs and who are noble-souled scho- lars of the Vedas. Thereafter, he shall go in for alms in the houses of the non-defiled and not-fallen. The practice of begging for alms from people of other castes is considered the meanest of all modes.
verses.hindi: मासके पहले मृत्युकी जानकारी होनेपर पक्षिणी (दो रात-एक दिन)-का अशौच होता है और उसके बाद एक वर्षसे पहले एक दिनका अशौच होता है। वर्ष व्यतीत हो जानेपर स्तानमात्रसे सपिण्डोंकी शुद्धि हो शवका स्पर्श कर लेनेपर तीन रातमें शुद्धि होती है। धर्मके लिये स्नान ही शुद्धिहेतु कहा जाता है। बान्धव न होनेपर शवका दाह करनेवाले तथा उसे ले जानेवालोंके लिये स्नानमात्र ही विहित है। शवके साथ
verses.wordMeaning: O brahmins, thereafter he shall go in for alms at the places of humble householders who have faith, who have control over the sense-organs and who are noble-souled scho- lars of the Vedas. Thereafter, he shall go in for alms in the houses of the non-defiled and not-fallen.…
verses.commentary: Sense: O brahmins, thereafter he shall go in for alms at the places of humble householders who have faith, who have control over the sense-organs and who are noble-souled scho- lars of the Vedas. Thereafter, he shall go in for alms in the houses of the non-defiled and not-fallen.…

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्म एव हि सेवेत ब्रह्मैव हि परं सुखम् परिश्रमो हि यज्ञानां महतार्थेन वर्तते
verses.transliteration: brahma eva hi seveta brahmaiva hi paraṃ sukham pariśramo hi yajñānāṃ mahatārthena vartate
verses.translation: Any of the following things can be received in the form of alms, viz. gruel, butter milk, milk, barley water, ripe fruits and roots, bits of grains, oil- cakes and powdered fried grains. The items of food mentioned by me are those that in- crease the accomplishments of the yogins. If they are realised the alms are said to be excellent.
verses.hindi: यात्रामें जानेपर स्नान करके तथा घृतका प्राशन करनेपर व्यक्ति शुद्ध होता है। है द्विजो! आचार्य तथा श्रोत्रियके मरणमें तीन रातका अशौच होता है। माताके भाइयोंके मरणमें पक्षिणी अशौच होता है और उपकारी
verses.wordMeaning: Any of the following things can be received in the form of alms, viz. gruel, butter milk, milk, barley water, ripe fruits and roots, bits of grains, oil- cakes and powdered fried grains.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Any of the following things can be received in the form of alms, viz. gruel, butter milk, milk, barley water, ripe fruits and roots, bits of grains, oil- cakes and powdered fried grains.…

verses.sanskrit: भूयो मृत्युवशं याति तस्मान्मोक्षः परं सुखम् अथवा ध्यानसंयुक्तो ब्रह्मतत्त्वपरायणः
verses.transliteration: bhūyo mṛtyuvaśaṃ yāti tasmānmokṣaḥ paraṃ sukham athavā dhyānasaṃyukto brahmatattvaparāyaṇaḥ
verses.translation: Of these two persons, viz. one who begs for alms by means that are justifiable and the other who, ( by way of penance) drinks a drop of water by means of the tip of the darbha grass once in a month, the former excels the latter.
verses.hindi: जनोंके मरणमें तीन रातका अशौच होता है। राजाओं, सामन्तों तथा देशान्तरवासियोंके मरणमें स्नानमात्रसे शुद्धि हो जाती है। है श्रेष्ठ ब्राह्मणो! क्षत्रियोंका अशौच बारह दिनका होता है। अभिषिक्त राजाके रणमें मरनेपर बान्धवोंको अशौच नहीं होता है। वैश्य पन्द्रह दिनोंमें और शूद्र एक महीनेमें शुद्ध होता है। है विप्रो! इस
verses.wordMeaning: Of these two persons, viz. one who begs for alms by means that are justifiable and the other who, ( by way of penance) drinks a drop of water by means of the tip of the darbha grass once in a month, the former excels the latter.
verses.commentary: Sense: Of these two persons, viz. one who begs for alms by means that are justifiable and the other who, ( by way of penance) drinks a drop of water by means of the tip of the darbha grass once in a month, the former excels the latter.

verses.sanskrit: न तु च्यावयितुं शक्यो मन्वन्तरशतैरपि दृष्ट्वा तु पुरुषं दिव्यं विश्वाख्यं विश्वतोमुखम्
verses.transliteration: na tu cyāvayituṃ śakyo manvantaraśatairapi dṛṣṭvā tu puruṣaṃ divyaṃ viśvākhyaṃ viśvatomukham
verses.translation: Bhaiksya is so called because it removes the sins of one who is afraid of old age, death, rebirth, residence in hells, etc. Those who arc addicted to the regular use of curds or milk or those who cause wastage in the individual souls-— ail these do not merit even a sixteenth part of one who partakes of the alms.
verses.hindi: कृते सकृद्युगवशाज्ञायन्ते वै सहैव तु। प्रयान्ति च महाभागा भार्याभिः कुरवो यथा
verses.wordMeaning: Bhaiksya is so called because it removes the sins of one who is afraid of old age, death, rebirth, residence in hells, etc.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Bhaiksya is so called because it removes the sins of one who is afraid of old age, death, rebirth, residence in hells, etc.…

verses.sanskrit: विश्वपादशिरोग्रीवं विश्वेशं विश्वरूपिणम् विश्वगन्धं विश्वमाल्यं विश्वांबरधरं प्रभुम्
verses.transliteration: viśvapādaśirogrīvaṃ viśveśaṃ viśvarūpiṇam viśvagandhaṃ viśvamālyaṃ viśvāṃbaradharaṃ prabhum
verses.translation: One diall always lie down on Bhasman; with control over the sense-organs he shall for alms. He who wishes for the greatest abode shall perform the Paupata vrata.
verses.hindi: शाकद्वीपादिषु प्रोक्तो धर्मो वै भारते यथा मैथुनात्कामतो विप्रास्तथैव परुषादिभिः। यवाद्याः सम्प्रजायन्ते ग्राम्यारण्याश्चतुर्दश
verses.wordMeaning: One diall always lie down on Bhasman; with control over the sense-organs he shall for alms. He who wishes for the greatest abode shall perform the Paupata vrata.
verses.commentary: Sense: One diall always lie down on Bhasman; with control over the sense-organs he shall for alms. He who wishes for the greatest abode shall perform the Paupata vrata.

verses.sanskrit: गोभिर् महीं संपतते पतत्रिणो नैवं भूयो जनयत्येवमेव कविं पुराणम् अनुशासितारं सूक्ष्माच्च सूक्ष्मं महतो महान्तम्
verses.transliteration: gobhir mahīṃ saṃpatate patatriṇo naivaṃ bhūyo janayatyevameva kaviṃ purāṇam anuśāsitāraṃ sūkṣmācca sūkṣmaṃ mahato mahāntam
verses.translation: The rite of Candryaiia shall be most excellent for all yogSins. According to his capacity, the devotee shall per- form it once, twice, thrice or four times. Bhikus (mendicants) have five vratas, viz: — Astcya (non-stealing); Brahmacarya (celibacy); Alobha (non- covetousness); Tyaga (renunciation) and Ahizhsa (non-vio- lence) which is the greatest.
verses.hindi: अकालकृष्टा विध्वस्ताः पुनरुत्पादितास्तथा
verses.wordMeaning: The rite of Candryaiia shall be most excellent for all yogSins. According to his capacity, the devotee shall per- form it once, twice, thrice or four times. Bhikus (mendicants) have five vratas, viz: — Astcya (non-stealing); Brahmacarya (celibacy); Alobha (non- covetousness);…
verses.commentary: Sense: The rite of Candryaiia shall be most excellent for all yogSins. According to his capacity, the devotee shall per- form it once, twice, thrice or four times. Bhikus (mendicants) have five vratas, viz: — Astcya (non-stealing); Brahmacarya (celibacy); Alobha (non- covetousness);…

verses.sanskrit: योगेन पश्येन्न च चक्षुषा पुनर् निरिन्द्रियं पुरुषं रुक्मवर्णम् अलिङ्गिनं निर्गुणं चेतनं च नित्यं सदा सर्वगं सर्वसारम्
verses.transliteration: yogena paśyenna ca cakṣuṣā punar nirindriyaṃ puruṣaṃ rukmavarṇam aliṅginaṃ nirguṇaṃ cetanaṃ ca nityaṃ sadā sarvagaṃ sarvasāram
verses.translation: The niyamas (observances and restraints) arc the following: — akrodha (abstention from anger), guruurusa (service to the preceptor), iSauca (cleanliness), aharalaghava (lightness of food) and study of the Vedas regularly.
verses.hindi: द्वितीयेऽहनि विप्रा हि यथा वै ब्रह्मघातिनी । तृतीयेऽह्नि तदर्धेन चतुर्थेऽहनि सुत्रता: प्रकार मैंने संक्षेपमें अत्युत्तम द्रव्यशुद्धिका वर्णन कर
verses.wordMeaning: The niyamas (observances and restraints) arc the following: — akrodha (abstention from anger), guruurusa (service to the preceptor), iSauca (cleanliness), aharalaghava (lightness of food) and study of the Vedas regularly.
verses.commentary: Sense: The niyamas (observances and restraints) arc the following: — akrodha (abstention from anger), guruurusa (service to the preceptor), iSauca (cleanliness), aharalaghava (lightness of food) and study of the Vedas regularly.

verses.sanskrit: पश्यन्ति युक्त्या ह्यचलप्रकाशं तद्भावितास्तेजसा दीप्यमानम् ।* अपाणिपादोदरपार्श्वजिह्वो ह्यतीन्द्रियो वापि सुसूक्ष्म एकः
verses.transliteration: paśyanti yuktyā hyacalaprakāśaṃ tadbhāvitāstejasā dīpyamānam /* apāṇipādodarapārśvajihvo hyatīndriyo vāpi susūkṣma ekaḥ
verses.translation: The qualities of the seed, the vagina and bondage with the objects — are due to karmans(?). Just as in the case of the elephant in the forest so also in regard to men it is laid down. All the sacrificial rites are equal to Devas. But japa is superior to sacrificial rites; perfect knowledge is superior to meditation; and meditation, devoid of attachment, is still supe- rior to that. When that is acquired, the eternal goal is obtained.
verses.hindi: पूर्वको भाँति यतियोंका अशौच होता ही नहीं है, हे द्विजो! अब मैं स्त्रियोंके रजोधर्मकी प्रवृत्तिका वर्णन करता हूँ त्रेता आदि युगमें प्रत्येक मासमें स्त्रियोंको रजोधर्म होता है। युगकी प्रकृतिके अनुसार सत्ययुगमे
verses.wordMeaning: The qualities of the seed, the vagina and bondage with the objects — are due to karmans(?). Just as in the case of the elephant in the forest so also in regard to men it is laid down. All the sacrificial rites are equal to Devas. But japa is superior to sacrificial rites;…
verses.commentary: Sense: The qualities of the seed, the vagina and bondage with the objects — are due to karmans(?). Just as in the case of the elephant in the forest so also in regard to men it is laid down. All the sacrificial rites are equal to Devas. But japa is superior to sacrificial rites;…

verses.sanskrit: पश्यत्यचक्षुः स शृणोत्यकर्णो न चास्त्यबुद्धं न च बुद्धिर् अस्ति ।* स वेद सर्वं न च सर्ववेद्यं तमाहुरग्र्यं पुरुषं महान्तम्
verses.transliteration: paśyatyacakṣuḥ sa śṛṇotyakarṇo na cāstyabuddhaṃ na ca buddhir asti /* sa veda sarvaṃ na ca sarvavedyaṃ tamāhuragryaṃ puruṣaṃ mahāntam
verses.translation: Those persons whose intellects have been purified by perfect knowledge say that the following are auspicious qualities, viz: — control of the mind, suppression of the sense- organs, truthfulness, state of being free from sins, silence, straightforwardness in regard to all living beings and the knowledge of those objects beyond the scope of the sense- organs.
verses.hindi: लोग स्त्रियोंक साथ एक बार सहवास करते धे और सन्तानें उत्पन्न होती थीं, जिस प्रकार भाग्यशाली कुरुवर्षनिवासी करते थे हे सुव्रतो! दक्षिणमें भारतवर्षमें वर्णाश्रम-व्यवस्था त्रेतायुगसे लेकर है; यह व्यवस्था अन्य आठ किंपुरुष आदि वर्षोमे, महावीतमें तथा सुवीतमें नहीं है । शाकट्टीप आदि द्वीपोंमें भारतके ही समान धर्मकी व्यवस्था बतायी
verses.wordMeaning: Those persons whose intellects have been purified by perfect knowledge say that the following are auspicious qualities, viz: — control of the mind, suppression of the sense- organs, truthfulness, state of being free from sins, silence,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Those persons whose intellects have been purified by perfect knowledge say that the following are auspicious qualities, viz: — control of the mind, suppression of the sense- organs, truthfulness, state of being free from sins, silence,…

verses.sanskrit: अचेतनां सर्वगतां सूक्ष्मां प्रसवधर्मिणीम् प्रकृतिं सर्वभूतानां युक्ताः पश्यन्ति योगिनः
verses.transliteration: acetanāṃ sarvagatāṃ sūkṣmāṃ prasavadharmiṇīm prakṛtiṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ yuktāḥ paśyanti yoginaḥ
verses.translation: Only a noble soul who has concentration, who is devoted to the Brahman, who does not err, who is pure, who likes seclusion, and who has omquered the sense-organs shall attain this yoga. Thus, say the sages who are devoid of impuri- ties and are above censure. The devotee who has destroyed even the seeds of sins by means of dns pure path, restrained by the same goad (of pure path ) attains the desired places.
verses.hindi: सत्ययुगमें लोगोंको वृत्ति सहज आनन्दकी थी, त्रेतामे गृह, वृक्ष आदिपर आधारित वृत्ति थी। वही वृत्त बादमें रजोदोषके कारण लोगोंके राग-द्वेषपर आधारित हो गयी। है विप्रो! कामवश स्त्रीसंग, क्रोध इत्यादि
verses.wordMeaning: Only a noble soul who has concentration, who is devoted to the Brahman, who does not err, who is pure, who likes seclusion, and who has omquered the sense-organs shall attain this yoga. Thus, say the sages who are devoid of impuri- ties and are above censure.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Only a noble soul who has concentration, who is devoted to the Brahman, who does not err, who is pure, who likes seclusion, and who has omquered the sense-organs shall attain this yoga. Thus, say the sages who are devoid of impuri- ties and are above censure.…

verses.sanskrit: सर्वतः पाणिपादं तत् सर्वतो ऽक्षिशिरोमुखम् सर्वतः श्रुतिमल् लोके सर्वमावृत्य तिष्ठति
verses.transliteration: sarvataḥ pāṇipādaṃ tat sarvato 'kṣiśiromukham sarvataḥ śrutimal loke sarvamāvṛtya tiṣṭhati
verses.translation: Qinesicmt perscmi engaged in good conduct and
verses.hindi: दोषोंके कारण जौ आदि हविष्यान्न एवं औषधियाँ चौदह प्रकारके ग्राम्य तथा वन्य पदार्थोके रूपमें उत्पन्न होने लगीं; जो अकालमें नष्ट होकर पुन: उत्पन्न होती थीं, इसलिये प्रयत्नपूर्वक रजस्वला स्त्रीसे सम्भाषण आदि नहीं करना चाहिए॥ ९७--९९१/, ॥
verses.wordMeaning: Qinesicmt perscmi engaged in good conduct and
verses.commentary: Sense: Qinesicmt perscmi engaged in good conduct and

verses.sanskrit: युक्तो योगेन चेशानं सर्वतश् च सनातनम् पुरुषं सर्वभूतानां तं विद्वान्न विमुह्यति
verses.transliteration: yukto yogena ceśānaṃ sarvataś ca sanātanam puruṣaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ taṃ vidvānna vimuhyati
verses.translation: The eternal Dharma has been imparted by Brahma himself for the utility of the people. Listen now when I recount it to you. One shall duly perform his duties such as obeisance and standing up by way of welcome towards elderly persons who have acquired instructions from preceptors and who stri- ctly adhere to their routine (i. e. the rules relating to their AiSrama).
verses.hindi: पहले दिन रजस्वला स्त्री चाण्डालीकी भाँति वर्ज्य होती है। है विप्रो! दूसरे दिन वह ब्रह्मघातिनीके समान होती है और तीसरे दिन उसके आधे पापसे युक्त रहती है। है सुव्रतो! चौथे दिन स्नान करके वह आधे
verses.wordMeaning: The eternal Dharma has been imparted by Brahma himself for the utility of the people. Listen now when I recount it to you.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The eternal Dharma has been imparted by Brahma himself for the utility of the people. Listen now when I recount it to you.…

verses.sanskrit: भूतात्मानं महात्मानं परमात्मानमव्ययम् सर्वात्मानं परं ब्रह्म तद्वै ध्याता न मुह्यति
verses.transliteration: bhūtātmānaṃ mahātmānaṃ paramātmānamavyayam sarvātmānaṃ paraṃ brahma tadvai dhyātā na muhyati
verses.translation: O sages of good holy rites, the brahmin and the prece- ptor are to be honoured by obeisance with eight limbs touch- ing the ground with the following three set aside viz: — head- dress, upper garment and footwear and with three circum am- bulations.
verses.hindi: महीनेतक देवपूजन आदिके लिये शुद्ध रहती है । पाँचवें दिनसे सोलहवें दिनतक रजोदोष रहनेके कारण स्त्रीस्पर्श आदिको शुद्धि मूत्रोत्सर्गकी शुद्धिकी तरह कही गयी हैं। इसके बाद ही उसकी पूर्ण शुद्धि होगी यदि स्त्री रजोदोषसे युक्त है, तो पाँच रात्रितर्क वह अस्पृश्य (अगम्य) होती है। बीस दिनके बाद भौ वह यदि रजोदोषसे युक्त है, तो वह ूर्वकी भाँति अस्पृश्य होती है
verses.wordMeaning: O sages of good holy rites, the brahmin and the prece- ptor are to be honoured by obeisance with eight limbs touch- ing the ground with the following three set aside viz: — head- dress, upper garment and footwear and with three circum am- bulations.
verses.commentary: Sense: O sages of good holy rites, the brahmin and the prece- ptor are to be honoured by obeisance with eight limbs touch- ing the ground with the following three set aside viz: — head- dress, upper garment and footwear and with three circum am- bulations.

verses.sanskrit: पवनो हि यथा ग्राह्यो विचरन्सर्वमूर्तिषु पुरि शेते सुदुर्ग्राह्यस् तस्मात्पुरुष उच्यते
verses.transliteration: pavano hi yathā grāhyo vicaransarvamūrtiṣu puri śete sudurgrāhyas tasmātpuruṣa ucyate
verses.translation: All elderly persons should be respected. If one wishes for excellent Siddhi one shall never break their behests. One shall avoid all these things: — Taking up iron and other metals for sustenance, living in a desert or unproductive soil®* and using worthless mantras as means of support, snake- charming®' and backbiting, flattery®'a or scandal.
verses.hindi: अध्याय ८९  सदाचार तथा शौचाचारका निरूपण, द्रव्यशुद्धि, अशौचप्रवृत्ति एवं स्त्रीधर्मविवेचन
verses.wordMeaning: All elderly persons should be respected. If one wishes for excellent Siddhi one shall never break their behests. One shall avoid all these things: — Taking up iron and other metals for sustenance,…
verses.commentary: Sense: All elderly persons should be respected. If one wishes for excellent Siddhi one shall never break their behests. One shall avoid all these things: — Taking up iron and other metals for sustenance,…

verses.sanskrit: अथ चेल्लुप्तधर्मा तु सावशेषैः स्वकर्मभिः ततस्तु ब्रह्मगर्भे वै शुक्रशोणितसंयुते
verses.transliteration: atha celluptadharmā tu sāvaśeṣaiḥ svakarmabhiḥ tatastu brahmagarbhe vai śukraśoṇitasaṃyute
verses.translation: One shall scrupulously avoid deception, stinginess in spending money, censure of others. In the presence of preceptors and ciders one shall avoid laughter, haughtiness, sportive dalliance and wilfulness. One shall never contradict the preceptor; one shall never speak unbecoming words against him. One shall scrupulously avoid mentioning things disliked by the preceptor and shall not think evil of him. One shall never touch these things with one's foot — the clothes, staff, etc., of ascetics their sandals, garlands, places of sleep [i. e. bed- mattress etc.], vessel, shadow and the requisite things of use in sacrifices.
verses.hindi: मैथुनं मानसं वापि वाचिकं देवतार्चनम् बर्जयेत्सर्वयलेन नमस्कारं रजस्वला। रजस्वलाङ्कनास्पर्शसम्भाषे च रजस्वला
verses.wordMeaning: One shall scrupulously avoid deception, stinginess in spending money, censure of others. In the presence of preceptors and ciders one shall avoid laughter, haughtiness, sportive dalliance and wilfulness. One shall never contradict the preceptor;…
verses.commentary: Sense: One shall scrupulously avoid deception, stinginess in spending money, censure of others. In the presence of preceptors and ciders one shall avoid laughter, haughtiness, sportive dalliance and wilfulness. One shall never contradict the preceptor;…

verses.sanskrit: स्त्रीपुंसोः संप्रयोगे हि जायते हि ततः प्रभुः ततस्तु गर्भकालेन कललं नाम जायते
verses.transliteration: strīpuṃsoḥ saṃprayoge hi jāyate hi tataḥ prabhuḥ tatastu garbhakālena kalalaṃ nāma jāyate
verses.translation: O brahmins, one shall scrupulously avoid treachery If he repeats the japas a crorc of times he is purified from the sins of treachery to the preceptor and the deities. For the expiation of great sins, one shall repeat Siva's mantra in accordance with the injunction. If the sinner is, otherwise, of good conduct he is purified by half the number of japas. O sages of good holy rites, all the Upapatakins (those who commit subsidiary sins) get purified by half the number of japas.
verses.hindi: ईक्षयेद्धास्करं देवं ब्रह्मकूर्चं ततः पिबेत्। केबलं पञ्चगव्यं वा क्षीरं वा चात्मशुद्धये
verses.wordMeaning: O brahmins, one shall scrupulously avoid treachery If he repeats the japas a crorc of times he is purified from the sins of treachery to the preceptor and the deities. For the expiation of great sins, one shall repeat Siva's mantra in accordance with the injunction.…
verses.commentary: Sense: O brahmins, one shall scrupulously avoid treachery If he repeats the japas a crorc of times he is purified from the sins of treachery to the preceptor and the deities. For the expiation of great sins, one shall repeat Siva's mantra in accordance with the injunction.…

verses.sanskrit: कालेन कललं चापि बुद्बुदं सम्प्रजायते मृत्पिण्डस्तु यथा चक्रे चक्रावर्तेन पीडितः
verses.transliteration: kālena kalalaṃ cāpi budbudaṃ samprajāyate mṛtpiṇḍastu yathā cakre cakrāvartena pīḍitaḥ
verses.translation: In the following circumstances, one is purified by repeating the mantra for thousand times. The instances are: — violating agreements, eating forbidden food and speaking what should not be spoken.
verses.hindi: समे नपुंसकं चैव पञ्चम्यां कन्यका भवेत् नवम्यां दारिकायार्थी दशम्यां पण्डितो भवेत् एकादश्यां तथा नारीं जनयेत्सैव पूर्ववत्
verses.wordMeaning: In the following circumstances, one is purified by repeating the mantra for thousand times. The instances are: — violating agreements, eating forbidden food and speaking what should not be spoken.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the following circumstances, one is purified by repeating the mantra for thousand times. The instances are: — violating agreements, eating forbidden food and speaking what should not be spoken.

verses.sanskrit: हस्ताभ्यां क्रियमाणस्तु बिंबत्वमनुगच्छति एवमाध्यात्मिकैर्युक्ता वायुना संप्रपूरितः
verses.transliteration: hastābhyāṃ kriyamāṇastu biṃbatvamanugacchati evamādhyātmikairyuktā vāyunā saṃprapūritaḥ
verses.translation: There is no doubt in this that if one kills birds like crows, owls and doves, etc., he is liberated from the sin by repeating the mantra hundred and eigit times. The excellent brahmin who knows the truth and has realised Brahman becomes pure merely by remembering the deity. No doubt need be entertained in this respect.
verses.hindi: रजस्वला स्त्रीको स्नान, शौच, गायन, रोदन, हास- परिहास, यात्रा करना, अभ्यंग, द्यूत, अनुलेपन, विशेष रूपसे दिनमें शयन, दन्तधावन, मैथुन, मन तथा वाणीसे भी देवपूजन, नमस्कार आदिको पूर्णप्रयत्नसे त्याग देना
verses.wordMeaning: There is no doubt in this that if one kills birds like crows, owls and doves, etc., he is liberated from the sin by repeating the mantra hundred and eigit times. The excellent brahmin who knows the truth and has realised Brahman becomes pure merely by remembering the deity.…
verses.commentary: Sense: There is no doubt in this that if one kills birds like crows, owls and doves, etc., he is liberated from the sin by repeating the mantra hundred and eigit times. The excellent brahmin who knows the truth and has realised Brahman becomes pure merely by remembering the deity.…

verses.sanskrit: यदि योनिं विमुञ्चामि तत्प्रपद्ये महेश्वरम् यावद्धि वैष्णवो वायुर् जातमात्रं न संस्पृशेत्
verses.transliteration: yadi yoniṃ vimuñcāmi tatprapadye maheśvaram yāvaddhi vaiṣṇavo vāyur jātamātraṃ na saṃspṛśet
verses.translation: There arc no expiatory rites nor injunctions regard- ing them in the case of the knowers of the Atman. People who are conversant with the learning of the brahman are pure themselves (because they are engaged) in the welfare of the universe.
verses.hindi: चाहिए । रजस्वलाको चाहिए कि अन्य रजस्वला स्त्रीके अंगस्पर्श तथा उसके साथ बातचीतका त्याग कर दे; उसे पूर्णप्रयत्नके साथ वस्त्र बदलनेका त्याग कर देना चाहिए । रजस्वला स्त्रीको चाहिए कि स्नान करके शुद्ध होनेपर पतिके अतिरिक्त अन्य पुरुषका स्पर्श न करे और सूर्यदेवका दर्शन करे। तदनन्तर आत्मशुद्धिके लिये ब्रह्मकूर्च अथवा केवल पंचगव्य अथवा दुग्धका पान करे॥ १०४--१०८॥
verses.wordMeaning: There arc no expiatory rites nor injunctions regard- ing them in the case of the knowers of the Atman. People who are conversant with the learning of the brahman are pure themselves (because they are engaged) in the welfare of the universe.
verses.commentary: Sense: There arc no expiatory rites nor injunctions regard- ing them in the case of the knowers of the Atman. People who are conversant with the learning of the brahman are pure themselves (because they are engaged) in the welfare of the universe.

verses.sanskrit: तावत्कालं महादेवम् अर्चयामीति चिन्तयेत् जायते मानुषस्तत्र यथारूपं यथावयः
verses.transliteration: tāvatkālaṃ mahādevam arcayāmīti cintayet jāyate mānuṣastatra yathārūpaṃ yathāvayaḥ
verses.translation: Those who adhere to yoga and dhyana are stainless like gold. They become pure by resorting to Brahmavidya and there is no further purification for persons already pure. One shall avoid turbid water. He shall perform all rites by means of waters that have been purified by filtering through the pores of a cloth and that do not contain cold foams.
verses.hindi: रजोधर्मके चौथे दिन स्त्री गमनके योग्य नहीं होती है; वह स्त्री नष्ट तथा अल्प आयुवाले  पुत्र - को जन्म देती है। वह विद्यारहित, ब्रतसे च्युत, पतित, दूसरोंकी स्त्रियोंके साथ दुराचार करनेवाले तथा दरिद्रताके
verses.wordMeaning: Those who adhere to yoga and dhyana are stainless like gold. They become pure by resorting to Brahmavidya and there is no further purification for persons already pure. One shall avoid turbid water.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who adhere to yoga and dhyana are stainless like gold. They become pure by resorting to Brahmavidya and there is no further purification for persons already pure. One shall avoid turbid water.…

verses.sanskrit: वायुः संभवते खात्तु वाताद्भवति वै जलम् जलात् सम्भवति प्राणः प्राणाच्छुक्रं विवर्धते
verses.transliteration: vāyuḥ saṃbhavate khāttu vātādbhavati vai jalam jalāt sambhavati prāṇaḥ prāṇācchukraṃ vivardhate
verses.translation: One shall avoid waters of these types: — that which has defective smell, colour and taste; that which stagnates in impure places; that which is defiled by mud and pebbles, the sea water, the water from puddles the water mingled with
verses.hindi: समुद्रमें डूबे रहनेवाले पुत्रको उत्पन्न करती है । पुत्रीकी कामना करनेवालेको पाँचवें दिन स्त्रीके साथ गमन करना चाहिए । रक्तका आधिक्य होनेपर कन्या होती है, शुक्रका आधिक्य होनेपर पुत्र होता है और दोनोंके समान होनेपर नपुंसक संतान उत्पन्न होती है । पाँचवें दिन सहवास करनेपर कन्या उत्पन्न होती है । छठें दिन यदि स्त्रीके साथ गमन किया जाय, तो वह महाभाग्यवती स्त्री उत्तम पुत्रको उत्पन्न करती है, उसके पुत्रत्वको
verses.wordMeaning: One shall avoid waters of these types: — that which has defective smell, colour and taste; that which stagnates in impure places; that which is defiled by mud and pebbles, the sea water, the water from puddles the water mingled with
verses.commentary: Sense: One shall avoid waters of these types: — that which has defective smell, colour and taste; that which stagnates in impure places; that which is defiled by mud and pebbles, the sea water, the water from puddles the water mingled with

verses.sanskrit: रक्तभागास् त्रयस्त्रिंशद् रेतोभागाश् चतुर्दश भागतो ऽर्धफलं कृत्वा ततो गर्भो निषिच्यते
verses.transliteration: raktabhāgās trayastriṃśad retobhāgāś caturdaśa bhāgato 'rdhaphalaṃ kṛtvā tato garbho niṣicyate
verses.translation: One shall perform the rites of obeisance as well as service to the preceptors with pure and clean clothes. One devoid of cleanliness and purity in clothes is undoubtedly impure. It is desired that the clothes used in divine rites should be washed every day. Other clothes should be washed when they become dirty.
verses.hindi: प्रकट करती है और वह पैदा हुआ पुत्र महातेजस्वी होता है। 'पुम्'--यह एक नरकका नाम है और  नरकको दुःखपूर्ण कहा गया है; वह स्त्री पुम्  नरक- से त्राण (रक्षा) करनेवाले उस प्रकारके पुत्रको जन्म
verses.wordMeaning: One shall perform the rites of obeisance as well as service to the preceptors with pure and clean clothes. One devoid of cleanliness and purity in clothes is undoubtedly impure. It is desired that the clothes used in divine rites should be washed every day.…
verses.commentary: Sense: One shall perform the rites of obeisance as well as service to the preceptors with pure and clean clothes. One devoid of cleanliness and purity in clothes is undoubtedly impure. It is desired that the clothes used in divine rites should be washed every day.…

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तु गर्भसंयुक्तः पञ्चभिर् वायुभिर् वृतः पितुः शरीरात्प्रत्यङ्गं रूपमस्योपजायते
verses.transliteration: tatastu garbhasaṃyuktaḥ pañcabhir vāyubhir vṛtaḥ pituḥ śarīrātpratyaṅgaṃ rūpamasyopajāyate
verses.translation: O brahmins, one shall scrupulously eschew the clothes worn by others.
verses.hindi: कन्याकी इच्छावालेको सातवीं रात्रिमें गमन करना चाहिए; किंतु वह कन्या वन्ध्या होती है। आठवीं रात्रिमें स्त्री सर्वगुणसम्पन्न पुत्रको जन्म देती है। कन्याकी इच्छावाले व्यक्तिको नौवीं रातमें सहवास करना चाहिए । दसवीं रातमें संभोग करनेपर विद्वान् पुत्र उत्पन्न होता है। ग्यारहवीं रातमें सहवास करनेपर वह स्त्री पूर्वकी
verses.wordMeaning: O brahmins, one shall scrupulously eschew the clothes worn by others.
verses.commentary: Sense: O brahmins, one shall scrupulously eschew the clothes worn by others.

verses.sanskrit: ततो ऽस्य मातुराहारात् पीतलीढप्रवेशनात् नाभिदेशेन वै प्राणास् ते ह्य् आधारा हि देहिनाम्
verses.transliteration: tato 'sya māturāhārāt pītalīḍhapraveśanāt nābhideśena vai prāṇās te hy ādhārā hi dehinām
verses.translation: Bell metal is purified by Bhasman, iron is purified by acid; O brahmins, copper, tin and lead are cleaned with vinegar. O excellent brahmins, the pots of gold and silver can be purified by water. The cleansing of jewels, rock, conch and pearls is similar to that of metals.
verses.hindi: श्रीलिड्रमहापुराण
verses.wordMeaning: Bell metal is purified by Bhasman, iron is purified by acid; O brahmins, copper, tin and lead are cleaned with vinegar. O excellent brahmins, the pots of gold and silver can be purified by water. The cleansing of jewels, rock, conch and pearls is similar to that of metals.
verses.commentary: Sense: Bell metal is purified by Bhasman, iron is purified by acid; O brahmins, copper, tin and lead are cleaned with vinegar. O excellent brahmins, the pots of gold and silver can be purified by water. The cleansing of jewels, rock, conch and pearls is similar to that of metals.

verses.sanskrit: नवमासात् परिक्लिष्टः संवेष्टितशिरोधरः वेष्टितः सर्वगात्रैश् च अपर्याप्तप्रवेशनः
verses.transliteration: navamāsāt parikliṣṭaḥ saṃveṣṭitaśirodharaḥ veṣṭitaḥ sarvagātraiś ca aparyāptapraveśanaḥ
verses.translation: The purity of excessively polluted things is through contact with fire and water. The cleansing of all beverages is called Utplavana.
verses.hindi: द्वादश्यां धर्मतत्त्वज्ञं श्रौतस्मार्तप्रवर्तकम्। त्रयोदश्यां जड़ां नारीं सर्वसङ्करकारिणीम् पञ्चदश्यां च धर्मिष्ठां षोडश्यां ज्ञानपारगम्। स्त्रीणां वै मैथुने काले वामपार्श्वे प्रभञ्जनः
verses.wordMeaning: The purity of excessively polluted things is through contact with fire and water. The cleansing of all beverages is called Utplavana.
verses.commentary: Sense: The purity of excessively polluted things is through contact with fire and water. The cleansing of all beverages is called Utplavana.

verses.sanskrit: नवमासोषितश्चापि योनिच्छिद्रादवाङ्मुखः ततः स्वकर्मभिः पापैर् निरयं सम्प्रपद्यते
verses.transliteration: navamāsoṣitaścāpi yonicchidrādavāṅmukhaḥ tataḥ svakarmabhiḥ pāpair nirayaṃ samprapadyate
verses.translation: Objects made of grass, wood, etc., are purified by sprinkling them with sacred water. The purity of Sruk and Sruva (the sacrificial plate and ladle) is through hot water. The cleansing of the utensils of yajftas, that of the mortar and pestle and the purification of those made of horn, bone, wood and ivory is by means of poring.
verses.hindi: स्त्रीणां मैथुनकाले तु पापग्रहविवर्जिते
verses.wordMeaning: Objects made of grass, wood, etc., are purified by sprinkling them with sacred water. The purity of Sruk and Sruva (the sacrificial plate and ladle) is through hot water. The cleansing of the utensils of yajftas,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Objects made of grass, wood, etc., are purified by sprinkling them with sacred water. The purity of Sruk and Sruva (the sacrificial plate and ladle) is through hot water. The cleansing of the utensils of yajftas,…

verses.sanskrit: असिपत्रवनं चैव शाल्मलिच्छेदनं तथा ताडनं भक्षणं चैव पूयशोणितभक्षणम्
verses.transliteration: asipatravanaṃ caiva śālmalicchedanaṃ tathā tāḍanaṃ bhakṣaṇaṃ caiva pūyaśoṇitabhakṣaṇam
verses.translation: O highly blessed ones, sprinkling is the means of puri- fication of compact solid bodies; if the things are disjointed they shall be severally cleansed.
verses.hindi: उक्तकाले शुचिभूत्वा शुद्धां गच्छेच्छुचिस्मिताम्। इत्येवं सम्प्रसङ्गेन यतीनां धर्मसङ्ग्रहे सर्वेषामेव भूतानां सदाचारः प्रकीर्तितः।
verses.wordMeaning: O highly blessed ones, sprinkling is the means of puri- fication of compact solid bodies; if the things are disjointed they shall be severally cleansed.
verses.commentary: Sense: O highly blessed ones, sprinkling is the means of puri- fication of compact solid bodies; if the things are disjointed they shall be severally cleansed.

verses.sanskrit: यथा ह्यापस्तु संछिन्नाः संश्लेष्मम् उपयान्ति वै तथा छिन्नाश् च भिन्नाश्च यातनास्थानम् आगताः
verses.transliteration: yathā hyāpastu saṃchinnāḥ saṃśleṣmam upayānti vai tathā chinnāś ca bhinnāśca yātanāsthānam āgatāḥ
verses.translation: If a portion of a heap of grains not eaten, is defiled that poiion is removed and the remaining part is sprinkled with Kuia grass-water. It is desirable that vegetables, roots and fruits are purified like grains. The house is purified by sweeping and scrubbing. A mud-pot is purified by heating it over fire.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्मलोकमनृप्राप्य ब्रह्मणा सह मोदते
verses.wordMeaning: If a portion of a heap of grains not eaten, is defiled that poiion is removed and the remaining part is sprinkled with Kuia grass-water. It is desirable that vegetables, roots and fruits are purified like grains. The house is purified by sweeping and scrubbing.…
verses.commentary: Sense: If a portion of a heap of grains not eaten, is defiled that poiion is removed and the remaining part is sprinkled with Kuia grass-water. It is desirable that vegetables, roots and fruits are purified like grains. The house is purified by sweeping and scrubbing.…

verses.sanskrit: एवं जीवास्तु तैः पापैस् तप्यमानाः स्वयंकृतैः प्राप्नुयुः कर्मभिः शेषैर् दुःखं वा यदि वेतरत्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ jīvāstu taiḥ pāpais tapyamānāḥ svayaṃkṛtaiḥ prāpnuyuḥ karmabhiḥ śeṣair duḥkhaṃ vā yadi vetarat
verses.translation: The floor can be cleansed by scraping, digging, bed- aubing, sweeping, sprinkling and by tethering cows over it.
verses.hindi: भाँति कन्या उत्पन्न करती है। बारहवें चनि ज्ञ धर्मतत्त्वके ज्ञाता तथा श्रुति-स्मृतिके धर्मोको चलानेवाले पुत्रको उत्पन्न करती है और तेरहवीं रातमें करनेपर मूर्ख तथा वर्णसंकर दोष फैलानेवाली क्या उत्पन्न करती है; अतः पूरे प्रयत्नसे उस दिन स्त्री. सहवास नहीं करना चाहिए। यदि चौदहवीं रातमें गमन किया जाय, तो वह स्त्री पुत्र उत्पन्न करनेवाली होती है। पन्द्रहवीं रातमें गमन करनेपर वह धर्मनिष्ठ
verses.wordMeaning: The floor can be cleansed by scraping, digging, bed- aubing, sweeping, sprinkling and by tethering cows over it.
verses.commentary: Sense: The floor can be cleansed by scraping, digging, bed- aubing, sweeping, sprinkling and by tethering cows over it.

verses.sanskrit: एकेनैव तु गन्तव्यं सर्वमुत्सृज्य वै जनम् एकेनैव तु भोक्तव्यं तस्मात्सुकृतमाचरेत्
verses.transliteration: ekenaiva tu gantavyaṃ sarvamutsṛjya vai janam ekenaiva tu bhoktavyaṃ tasmātsukṛtamācaret
verses.translation: The water stagnating over the surface of lands becomes pure if a oow drinks from there and quenches its thirst, but filth should not spread over it along with foul smell, taste and colour. The excellent knowcr of Dharmas shall sprinkle with Kuia grass water, the cloth manually washed by a washerman duly, and then take it for use.
verses.hindi: कन्याको तथा सोलहवीं रातमें गमन करनेपर ज्ञानमें पारंगत पुत्रको उत्पन्न करती है ॥ ११४--१ १७५ ॥
verses.wordMeaning: The water stagnating over the surface of lands becomes pure if a oow drinks from there and quenches its thirst, but filth should not spread over it along with foul smell, taste and colour. The excellent knowcr of Dharmas shall sprinkle with Kuia grass water,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The water stagnating over the surface of lands becomes pure if a oow drinks from there and quenches its thirst, but filth should not spread over it along with foul smell, taste and colour. The excellent knowcr of Dharmas shall sprinkle with Kuia grass water,…

verses.sanskrit: न ह्येनं प्रस्थितं कश्चिद् गच्छन्तम् अनुगच्छति यदनेन कृतं कर्म तदेनमनुगच्छति
verses.transliteration: na hyenaṃ prasthitaṃ kaścid gacchantam anugacchati yadanena kṛtaṃ karma tadenamanugacchati
verses.translation: Merchandise spread in accordance with the division of castes and stages of life is pure. Things taken out of mines are naturally pure. A hound is p\Stt when it catches hold of a deer.
verses.hindi: मैथुनके समय यदि स्त्रियोंके बायें पार्श्वमें वायु प्रवाहित होता हो, तो कन्या होती है और दक्षिण पाश्वे प्रवाहित हो, तो पुत्र प्राप्त होता है । पापग्रहसे रहित मैथुन- कालमें स्त्रियोंसे सहवास करना चाहिए। ऐसे बताये गये शुभ समयमें पवित्र होकर उत्तम मुसकानवाली भायकि साथ गमन करना चाहिए॥ ११८-११९१/, ॥
verses.wordMeaning: Merchandise spread in accordance with the division of castes and stages of life is pure. Things taken out of mines are naturally pure. A hound is p\Stt when it catches hold of a deer.
verses.commentary: Sense: Merchandise spread in accordance with the division of castes and stages of life is pure. Things taken out of mines are naturally pure. A hound is p\Stt when it catches hold of a deer.

verses.sanskrit: ते नित्यं यमविषयेषु सम्प्रवृत्ताः क्रोशन्तः सततमनिष्टसंप्रयोगैः शुष्यन्ते परिगतवेदनाः शरीरा बह्वीभिः सुभृशमनन्तयातनाभिः
verses.transliteration: te nityaṃ yamaviṣayeṣu sampravṛttāḥ krośantaḥ satatamaniṣṭasaṃprayogaiḥ śuṣyante parigatavedanāḥ śarīrā bahvībhiḥ subhṛśamanantayātanābhiḥ
verses.translation: All these are pure even when they come into contact with the body, viz. — shadow, drops of water, brahmins, flies etc., dust, ground, wind and fire, O excellent brahmins. O brahmins, even when one is pure, one shall perform the icamana rite after sleeping, taking food, sneezing, drinking and spitting. At the beginning of the study of the Vedas and on similar occasions one shall perform the acamana rite.
verses.hindi: हे विप्रो! इस प्रकार मैंने यतियोंके धर्मसंग्रहमें प्रसंगपूर्वक सभी प्राणियोंके सदाचारका वर्णन कर दिया। जो मनुष्य पवित्र होकर इस सदाचारको विधिपूर्वक पढ़ता है अथवा सुनता है अथवा दग्ध पापवाले
verses.wordMeaning: All these are pure even when they come into contact with the body, viz. — shadow, drops of water, brahmins, flies etc., dust, ground, wind and fire, O excellent brahmins. O brahmins, even when one is pure, one shall perform the icamana rite after sleeping, taking food,…
verses.commentary: Sense: All these are pure even when they come into contact with the body, viz. — shadow, drops of water, brahmins, flies etc., dust, ground, wind and fire, O excellent brahmins. O brahmins, even when one is pure, one shall perform the icamana rite after sleeping, taking food,…

verses.sanskrit: कर्मणा मनसा वाचा यदभीक्ष्णं निषेवते तदभ्यासो हरत्येनं तस्मात्कल्याणमाचरेत्
verses.transliteration: karmaṇā manasā vācā yadabhīkṣṇaṃ niṣevate tadabhyāso haratyenaṃ tasmātkalyāṇamācaret
verses.translation: If the drops of water fall on the feet while others per- form the Scamana rite they shall be known as earthly things. One shall not become impure thereby.
verses.hindi: ब्राह्मणोंको सुनाता है, वह ब्रह्मलोक प्राप्त करके ब्रह्माके साथ आनन्द करता है॥ १२०--१२२॥ यतियोंके लिये प्रायश्चित्तनिरूपण
verses.wordMeaning: If the drops of water fall on the feet while others per- form the Scamana rite they shall be known as earthly things. One shall not become impure thereby.
verses.commentary: Sense: If the drops of water fall on the feet while others per- form the Scamana rite they shall be known as earthly things. One shall not become impure thereby.

verses.sanskrit: अनादिमान्प्रबन्धः स्यात् पूर्वकर्मणि देहिनः संसारं तामसं घोरं षड्विधं प्रतिपद्यते
verses.transliteration: anādimānprabandhaḥ syāt pūrvakarmaṇi dehinaḥ saṃsāraṃ tāmasaṃ ghoraṃ ṣaḍvidhaṃ pratipadyate
verses.translation: After sexual intercourse and after touching a fallen man, cocks, pig, crows, dog, camel, donkey, post, ciindila and others, one becomes pure, just by a bath. One shall not touch a woman in her monthly course, a woman aft delivery and a Sudra woman. One defiled by pollution after birth or death shall not touch their dust. If he touches he shall be pure by taking bath.
verses.hindi: प्रायश्चित्तं शिवप्रोक्तं यतीनां पापशोधनम्
verses.wordMeaning: After sexual intercourse and after touching a fallen man, cocks, pig, crows, dog, camel, donkey, post, ciindila and others, one becomes pure, just by a bath. One shall not touch a woman in her monthly course, a woman aft delivery and a Sudra woman.…
verses.commentary: Sense: After sexual intercourse and after touching a fallen man, cocks, pig, crows, dog, camel, donkey, post, ciindila and others, one becomes pure, just by a bath. One shall not touch a woman in her monthly course, a woman aft delivery and a Sudra woman.…

verses.sanskrit: मानुष्यात्पशुभावश् च पशुभावान् मृगो भवेत् मृगत्वात्पक्षिभावश् च तस्माच्चैव सरीसृपः
verses.transliteration: mānuṣyātpaśubhāvaś ca paśubhāvān mṛgo bhavet mṛgatvātpakṣibhāvaś ca tasmāccaiva sarīsṛpaḥ
verses.translation: O sages of good holy rites, the following persons arc not defiled by pollution — ascetics, forest-dwellers, religious students, life-long celibates, kings and rulers of provinces.
verses.hindi: पापं हि त्रिविधं ज्ञेयं वाड्मनःकायसम्भवम्। तत्कर्मणा विनाप्येष तिष्ठतीति परा श्रुतिः।
verses.wordMeaning: O sages of good holy rites, the following persons arc not defiled by pollution — ascetics, forest-dwellers, religious students, life-long celibates, kings and rulers of provinces.
verses.commentary: Sense: O sages of good holy rites, the following persons arc not defiled by pollution — ascetics, forest-dwellers, religious students, life-long celibates, kings and rulers of provinces.

verses.sanskrit: सरीसृपत्वाद्गच्छेद्वै स्थावरत्वं न संशयः स्थावरत्वे पुनः प्राप्ते यावद् उन्मिलते जनः
verses.transliteration: sarīsṛpatvādgacchedvai sthāvaratvaṃ na saṃśayaḥ sthāvaratve punaḥ prāpte yāvad unmilate janaḥ
verses.translation: Only when there are impedinnents in their tasks, do kings, sages and brahmins who have fallen become impure and not otherwise. The Asauca of the brahmins is upto the collection of bones after cremation and they are purified merely by taking bath. Similarly for those who are initiated in the sacrifice. It has been mentioned by the self-born deity that for those who had performed sacrifices the pollution is for one day. Then for those who have studied their respective branches of the Vedas it is for four days.
verses.hindi: सूतजी बोले-हे ऋषियो! इसके बाद मैं यतियोंके लिये निश्चित किये गये प्रायश्चित्तका वर्णन करूँगा; शिवके द्वारा कहा गया यह प्रायश्चित्त यतियोंके पापका शोधन करनेवाला है
verses.wordMeaning: Only when there are impedinnents in their tasks, do kings, sages and brahmins who have fallen become impure and not otherwise. The Asauca of the brahmins is upto the collection of bones after cremation and they are purified merely by taking bath.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Only when there are impedinnents in their tasks, do kings, sages and brahmins who have fallen become impure and not otherwise. The Asauca of the brahmins is upto the collection of bones after cremation and they are purified merely by taking bath.…

verses.sanskrit: कुलालचक्रवद्भ्रान्तस् तत्रैव परिवर्तते इत्येवं हि मनुष्यादिः संसारः स्थावरान्तिकः
verses.transliteration: kulālacakravadbhrāntas tatraiva parivartate ityevaṃ hi manuṣyādiḥ saṃsāraḥ sthāvarāntikaḥ
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, kinsmen do not have pollution due to birth or death beyond three days (if they hear of the birth or death) after the eleventh day.
verses.hindi: मन, वाणी तथा शरीरसे होनेबाले पापको तीन प्रकारका जानना चाहिए, जिसके द्वारा दिन-रात निरन्तर अह जगत् व्याप्त है। यति कर्मके बिना भी स्थित रहता है यतियोंके लिये प्रायश्चित्तनिरूपण
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent brahmins, kinsmen do not have pollution due to birth or death beyond three days (if they hear of the birth or death) after the eleventh day.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent brahmins, kinsmen do not have pollution due to birth or death beyond three days (if they hear of the birth or death) after the eleventh day.

verses.sanskrit: विज्ञेयस्तामसो नाम तत्रैव परिवर्तते सात्त्विकश्चापि संसारो ब्रह्मादिः परिकीर्तितः
verses.transliteration: vijñeyastāmaso nāma tatraiva parivartate sāttvikaścāpi saṃsāro brahmādiḥ parikīrtitaḥ
verses.translation: If one is present at the time of death one is purified merely by taking bath. If the fact of death is known after three seasons (i.e. six months)®® the pollution is for one day. If the fact of death is known before seven years®2» the pollution is for three days and beyond that for the brah- mins, it is for ten days. The pollution due to birth is for the first day in the case of the father. O sages, in the case of the mother it is for ten days. If the fact is known after three years,®®® the purity is attained by bath by the father as well as by kinsmen.
