verses.hindi: RB क फफ फ फ फ फफक कफ फाकफकआाकाकाआम हक मिमकमझकफफफझझफझफझफफफझफफफफफपाकफफझफफाफफफफफफफफफफफफफफफ पप काण फी पापमा
verses.wordMeaning: If one is present at the time of death one is purified merely by taking bath. If the fact of death is known after three seasons (i.e. six months)®® the pollution is for one day.…
verses.commentary: Sense: If one is present at the time of death one is purified merely by taking bath. If the fact of death is known after three seasons (i.e. six months)®® the pollution is for one day.…

verses.sanskrit: पिशाचान्तः स विज्ञेयः स्वर्गस्थानेषु देहिनाम् ब्राह्मे तु केवलं सत्त्वं स्थावरे केवलं तमः
verses.transliteration: piśācāntaḥ sa vijñeyaḥ svargasthāneṣu dehinām brāhme tu kevalaṃ sattvaṃ sthāvare kevalaṃ tamaḥ
verses.translation: If the fact is known after eight years®® the kinsmen become pure within a day. O sages of good holy rites, if the fact
verses.hindi: तस्माद्योगं प्रशंसन्ति धर्मयुक्ता मनीषिणः। विद्यया जित्वा प्राप्यैश्वर्यमनुत्तमम् एकैकातिक्रमे तेषां प्रायश्चित्तं विधीयते। उपेत्य तु स्त्रियं कामात्प्रायश्चित्तं विनिर्दिशेत्
verses.wordMeaning: If the fact is known after eight years®® the kinsmen become pure within a day. O sages of good holy rites, if the fact
verses.commentary: Sense: If the fact is known after eight years®® the kinsmen become pure within a day. O sages of good holy rites, if the fact

verses.sanskrit: चतुर्दशानां स्थानानां मध्ये विष्टम्भकं रजः मर्मसु छिद्यमानेषु वेदनार्तस्य देहिनः
verses.transliteration: caturdaśānāṃ sthānānāṃ madhye viṣṭambhakaṃ rajaḥ marmasu chidyamāneṣu vedanārtasya dehinaḥ
verses.translation: arv2Lk sapta-var?at— if the deceased is not seven years old. Editor. arvak saptavarf&t— if the deceased is not seven years old. Editor.
verses.hindi: न धर्मयुक्तमनृतं हिनस्तीति मनीषिणः
verses.wordMeaning: arv2Lk sapta-var?at— if the deceased is not seven years old. Editor. arvak saptavarf&t— if the deceased is not seven years old. Editor.
verses.commentary: Sense: arv2Lk sapta-var?at— if the deceased is not seven years old. Editor. arvak saptavarf&t— if the deceased is not seven years old. Editor.

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तत्परमं ब्रह्म कथं विप्रः स्मरिष्यति संसारः पूर्वधर्मस्य भावनाभिः प्रणोदितः
verses.transliteration: tatastatparamaṃ brahma kathaṃ vipraḥ smariṣyati saṃsāraḥ pūrvadharmasya bhāvanābhiḥ praṇoditaḥ
verses.translation: aft&bdSt— if the deceased is not eight years old. Editor.
verses.hindi: तथापि न च कर्तव्यं प्रसङ्गो ह्येष दारुणः। अहोरात्रोपवासश्च प्राणायामशतं तथा असद्वादो न कर्तव्यो यतिना धर्मलिप्सुना। परमापद्गतेनापि न कार्य स्तेयमप्युत
verses.wordMeaning: aft&bdSt— if the deceased is not eight years old. Editor.
verses.commentary: Sense: aft&bdSt— if the deceased is not eight years old. Editor.

verses.sanskrit: मानुषं भजते नित्यं तस्माद्ध्यानं समाचरेत् चतुर्दशविधं ह्येतद् बुद्ध्वा संसारमण्डलम्
verses.transliteration: mānuṣaṃ bhajate nityaṃ tasmāddhyānaṃ samācaret caturdaśavidhaṃ hyetad buddhvā saṃsāramaṇḍalam
verses.translation: Sapindata (the state of being kinsman by way of offering the funeral rice balls) recedes in the seventh genera- tion. If the ten days immediately after death have elapsed, one shall be impure for three days. The brahmin beyond that period or after a year has elapsed, becomes pure merely by taking bath.
verses.hindi: स्तेयादभ्यधिकः कश्चिन्नास्त्यधर्म इति श्रुतिः । हिंसा ह्येषा परा सृष्टा स्तैन्यं वै कथितं तथा
verses.wordMeaning: Sapindata (the state of being kinsman by way of offering the funeral rice balls) recedes in the seventh genera- tion. If the ten days immediately after death have elapsed, one shall be impure for three days. The brahmin beyond that period or after a year has elapsed,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Sapindata (the state of being kinsman by way of offering the funeral rice balls) recedes in the seventh genera- tion. If the ten days immediately after death have elapsed, one shall be impure for three days. The brahmin beyond that period or after a year has elapsed,…

verses.sanskrit: नित्यं समारभेद्धर्मं संसारभयपीडितः ततस्तरति संसारं क्रमेण परिवर्तितः
verses.transliteration: nityaṃ samārabheddharmaṃ saṃsārabhayapīḍitaḥ tatastarati saṃsāraṃ krameṇa parivartitaḥ
verses.translation: If one touches a dead body, one becomes pure after three days. It is for the sake of Dharma that ablution is enjoin- ed in regard to the persons who cremate the dead body. If he is not a relative he need take bath alone.
verses.hindi: अहिंसा सर्वभूतानां कर्मणा मनसा गिरा। अकामादपि हिंसेत यदि भिक्षु: पशून् कृमीन् उपनिषद्का कथन है; प्रत्येक क्षणको योगमें प्रयुक्त करना चाहिए; क्योंकि आयु अत्यन्त चलायमान है। प्रमादरहितको ही योग प्राप्त होता है। योग महान् बल है; मनुष्योंके लिये योगसे बढ़कर कल्याणकारी कुछ भी नहीं
verses.wordMeaning: If one touches a dead body, one becomes pure after three days. It is for the sake of Dharma that ablution is enjoin- ed in regard to the persons who cremate the dead body. If he is not a relative he need take bath alone.
verses.commentary: Sense: If one touches a dead body, one becomes pure after three days. It is for the sake of Dharma that ablution is enjoin- ed in regard to the persons who cremate the dead body. If he is not a relative he need take bath alone.

verses.sanskrit: तस्माच्च सततं युक्तो ध्यानतत्परयुञ्जकः तथा समारभेद्योगं यथात्मानं स पश्यति
verses.transliteration: tasmācca satataṃ yukto dhyānatatparayuñjakaḥ tathā samārabhedyogaṃ yathātmānaṃ sa paśyati
verses.translation: If one follows the dead body, one becomes pure by taking bath and drinking ghee. When the preceptor dies, or when a vedic-scholar passes away, pollution remains for three days.®- O brahmins, if maternal uncles and their wives or brothers die, if kings and rulers die, the people become pure immediately. O excellent brahmins, the pollution of the Ksa- triyas is for twelve days. A crowned king need not observe pollution if his kinsmen die in battle. A Vaisya becomes pure in fifteen days. A Sudra becomes pure within a month.
verses.hindi: दिखायी देता है। अतः धर्मयुक्त विद्वान् लोग योगकी प्रशंसा करते हैं विद्याके द्वारा अविद्याको जीतकर अत्युत्तम ऐश्वर्य प्राप्त करके पुनः ब्रह्म तथा मायाविलासका भली- भाँति विचार करके धीर लोग शिवनामक उस परम
verses.wordMeaning: If one follows the dead body, one becomes pure by taking bath and drinking ghee. When the preceptor dies, or when a vedic-scholar passes away, pollution remains for three days.®- O brahmins, if maternal uncles and their wives or brothers die, if kings and rulers die,…
verses.commentary: Sense: If one follows the dead body, one becomes pure by taking bath and drinking ghee. When the preceptor dies, or when a vedic-scholar passes away, pollution remains for three days.®- O brahmins, if maternal uncles and their wives or brothers die, if kings and rulers die,…

verses.sanskrit: एष आपः परं ज्योतिर् एष सेतुरनुत्तमः विवृत्या ह्येष संभेदाद् भूतानां चैव शाश्वतः
verses.transliteration: eṣa āpaḥ paraṃ jyotir eṣa seturanuttamaḥ vivṛtyā hyeṣa saṃbhedād bhūtānāṃ caiva śāśvataḥ
verses.translation: Ascetics do not have to observe pollution accruing from birth or death.
verses.hindi: पदको प्राप्त करते हैं ॥ २-५ /२॥ यतियोंके लिये जो व्रत तथा उपत्रत हैं; उनमें प्रत्येकका अतिक्रम (उल्लंघन) होनेपर उनके लिये प्रायश्‍्चित्तका विधान किया गया है । गृहस्थको भी कामनापूर्वक स्त्री- गमन करनेपर प्रायश्चित्त करना चाहिए; यतिको प्राणायामयुक्त
verses.wordMeaning: Ascetics do not have to observe pollution accruing from birth or death.
verses.commentary: Sense: Ascetics do not have to observe pollution accruing from birth or death.

verses.sanskrit: तदेनं सेतुमात्मानम् अग्निं वै विश्वतोमुखम् हृदिस्थं सर्वभूतानाम् उपासीत महेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: tadenaṃ setumātmānam agniṃ vai viśvatomukham hṛdisthaṃ sarvabhūtānām upāsīta maheśvaram
verses.translation: Due to the nature of the yuga, in the Krta age, ladies gave birth but once. The blessed ones repaired to the forests along with their wives like the Kurus.®®® O sages of good holy rites, the arrangement regarding the castes and stages of life began ever since the Treta yuga.
verses.hindi: सान्तपनव्रत करना चाहिए, इसके बाद एकाग्रचित्त होकर नियमानुसार कृच्छूत्रत करना चाहिए, तत्पश्चात् अपने आश्रममें लौटकर आलस्यरहित होकर भिक्षुक (यति)- को आचारपूर्वक रहना चाहिए॥ ६--८ /२॥
verses.wordMeaning: Due to the nature of the yuga, in the Krta age, ladies gave birth but once. The blessed ones repaired to the forests along with their wives like the Kurus.®®® O sages of good holy rites, the arrangement regarding the castes and stages of life began ever since the Treta yuga.
verses.commentary: Sense: Due to the nature of the yuga, in the Krta age, ladies gave birth but once. The blessed ones repaired to the forests along with their wives like the Kurus.®®® O sages of good holy rites, the arrangement regarding the castes and stages of life began ever since the Treta yuga.

verses.sanskrit: तथान्तः संस्थितं देवं स्वशक्त्या परिमण्डितम् अष्टधा चाष्टधा चैव तथा चाष्टविधेन च
verses.transliteration: tathāntaḥ saṃsthitaṃ devaṃ svaśaktyā parimaṇḍitam aṣṭadhā cāṣṭadhā caiva tathā cāṣṭavidhena ca
verses.translation: InKrtayuga, the sustenance of people was from taking liquids; in Treta yuga from domestic trees. But this was discontinued during the subsequent ages. The same occurred in regard to the untimely intercourse, during the menstrual dis- charge, due to lust of men. O Brahmins, so barley and other plants of the village and forest as well as the fourteen types of medicinal herbs were cultivated untimely and destroyed, as in the case of sexual intercourse during the menstrual period due to the passion of men.
verses.hindi: धर्मार्थ असत्य किसीको दूषित नहीं करता है-- ऐसा विद्वान् लोग कहते हैं; फिर भी उसे नहीं करना चाहिए। यह असत्य प्रसंग भयंकर होता है। यदि यह हो जाता है, तो एक दिन तथा एक रात उपवास और सौ प्राणायाम इसका प्रायश्चित्त है । धर्मके इच्छुक यतिको असद्वाद नहीं करना चाहिए; बड़ी-से-बड़ी विपत्ति पड्नेपर भी उसे चोरी नहीं करनी चाहिए; क्योंकि चोरीसे बढ़कर कोई अधर्म नहीं है--ऐसा श्रुति कहती है । चोरीको
verses.wordMeaning: InKrtayuga, the sustenance of people was from taking liquids; in Treta yuga from domestic trees. But this was discontinued during the subsequent ages. The same occurred in regard to the untimely intercourse, during the menstrual dis- charge, due to lust of men. O Brahmins,…
verses.commentary: Sense: InKrtayuga, the sustenance of people was from taking liquids; in Treta yuga from domestic trees. But this was discontinued during the subsequent ages. The same occurred in regard to the untimely intercourse, during the menstrual dis- charge, due to lust of men. O Brahmins,…

verses.sanskrit: सृष्ट्यर्थं संस्थितं वह्निं संक्षिप्य च हृदि स्थितम् ध्यात्वा यथावद्देवेशं रुद्रं भुवननायकम्
verses.transliteration: sṛṣṭyarthaṃ saṃsthitaṃ vahniṃ saṃkṣipya ca hṛdi sthitam dhyātvā yathāvaddeveśaṃ rudraṃ bhuvananāyakam
verses.translation: Hence, one shall assiduously avoid conversing with a wontan in her monthly course. On the first day, she has to be avoided like a candala woman. O brahmins, on the second day, she is to be treat- ed like a woman who has slain a brahmin. On the third day,®®® she has half that sinful nature. O sages of good holy rites, she shall take bath on the fourth day.®® She shall then be pure within half a month. From the sixteenth day onwards the women shall observe cleanliness in regard to passing of urine.
verses.hindi: प्राणवधके समान होनेवाली हिंसाके रूपमें कहा गया है। जो यह धन है, वह मनुष्योंका बाहर विचरण करनेवाला प्राण ही है। जो जिसके धनका हरण करता है, वह मानो उसका प्राण ही हर लेता है। इस चौर कर्मको करके
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, one shall assiduously avoid conversing with a wontan in her monthly course. On the first day, she has to be avoided like a candala woman. O brahmins, on the second day, she is to be treat- ed like a woman who has slain a brahmin.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, one shall assiduously avoid conversing with a wontan in her monthly course. On the first day, she has to be avoided like a candala woman. O brahmins, on the second day, she is to be treat- ed like a woman who has slain a brahmin.…

verses.sanskrit: हुत्वा पञ्चाहुतीः सम्यक् तच्चिन्तागतमानसः वैश्वानरं हृदिस्थं तु यथावदनुपूर्वशः
verses.transliteration: hutvā pañcāhutīḥ samyak taccintāgatamānasaḥ vaiśvānaraṃ hṛdisthaṃ tu yathāvadanupūrvaśaḥ
verses.translation: If the menstrual discharge continues she cannot be touched for five days.®® As far as twenty days she is defiled by the menstrual discharge and remains untouchable.
verses.hindi: वह अत्यन्त दुष्ट मनवाला व्यक्ति आचाररहित तथा व्रतच्युत हो जाता है। उसे फिरसे वैराग्ययुक्त होकर शास्त्रोक्त विधिसे एक वर्षतक चान्द्रायणब्रत करना चाहिए-ऐसा श्रुति कहती है । वर्षके अन्तमें वह पापरहित हो जाता है; इसके बाद यतिको वैराग्ययुक्त होकर आलस्यरहित हो सदाचारका पालन करना चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: If the menstrual discharge continues she cannot be touched for five days.®® As far as twenty days she is defiled by the menstrual discharge and remains untouchable.
verses.commentary: Sense: If the menstrual discharge continues she cannot be touched for five days.®® As far as twenty days she is defiled by the menstrual discharge and remains untouchable.

verses.sanskrit: आपः पूताः सकृत्प्राश्य तूष्णीं हुत्वा ह्युपाविशन् प्राणायेति ततस्तस्य प्रथमा ह्याहुतिः स्मृता
verses.transliteration: āpaḥ pūtāḥ sakṛtprāśya tūṣṇīṃ hutvā hyupāviśan prāṇāyeti tatastasya prathamā hyāhutiḥ smṛtā
verses.translation: Jambudvipa, see note 292a. ST. docs not construe 'a?tasu* with 'aka-dvipadisu* but takes it with 'kimpurusadisu' which it supplies since it docs not occur in the verse. It explains 'saka-dvipadisu' along with plaksadvjpantike?u, on the authority of Lihga. I. 46. 46.
verses.hindi: सभी प्राणियोंके प्रति मन, वचन तथा कर्मसे अहिंसा भाव रखना चाहिए । यदि यति अनजानमें भी पशुओं तथा
verses.wordMeaning: Jambudvipa, see note 292a. ST. docs not construe 'a?tasu* with 'aka-dvipadisu* but takes it with 'kimpurusadisu' which it supplies since it docs not occur in the verse. It explains 'saka-dvipadisu' along with plaksadvjpantike?u, on the authority of Lihga. I. 46. 46.
verses.commentary: Sense: Jambudvipa, see note 292a. ST. docs not construe 'a?tasu* with 'aka-dvipadisu* but takes it with 'kimpurusadisu' which it supplies since it docs not occur in the verse. It explains 'saka-dvipadisu' along with plaksadvjpantike?u, on the authority of Lihga. I. 46. 46.

verses.sanskrit: अपानाय द्वितीया च व्यानायेति तथा परा उदानाय चतुर्थी स्यात् समानायेति पञ्चमी
verses.transliteration: apānāya dvitīyā ca vyānāyeti tathā parā udānāya caturthī syāt samānāyeti pañcamī
verses.translation: Bharata, see note 289; note 318.
verses.hindi: श्रीलिडुमहापुराण  एकान्नं मधुमांसं वा अश्रृतान्नं तथैव च
verses.wordMeaning: Bharata, see note 289; note 318.
verses.commentary: Sense: Bharata, see note 289; note 318.

verses.sanskrit: स्वाहाकारैः पृथग्घुत्वा शेषं भुञ्जीत कामतः अपः पुनः सकृत्प्राश्य आचम्य हृदयं स्पृशेत्
verses.transliteration: svāhākāraiḥ pṛthagghutvā śeṣaṃ bhuñjīta kāmataḥ apaḥ punaḥ sakṛtprāśya ācamya hṛdayaṃ spṛśet
verses.translation: tftiya'hni — on the third day of menstruation she is as impure as the washerwoman: 'trtiye rajaki prokta'— cited in ST. She becomes pure on the fourth day; 'bhartufi Buddha caturthe- hni* — nud in ST.
verses.hindi: एकैकातिक्रमात्तेषां प्रायश्चित्तं विधीयते
verses.wordMeaning: tftiya'hni — on the third day of menstruation she is as impure as the washerwoman: 'trtiye rajaki prokta'— cited in ST. She becomes pure on the fourth day; 'bhartufi Buddha caturthe- hni* — nud in ST.
verses.commentary: Sense: tftiya'hni — on the third day of menstruation she is as impure as the washerwoman: 'trtiye rajaki prokta'— cited in ST. She becomes pure on the fourth day; 'bhartufi Buddha caturthe- hni* — nud in ST.

verses.sanskrit: प्राणानां ग्रन्थिरस्यात्मा रुद्रो ह्यात्मा विशान्तकः रुद्रो वै ह्यात्मनः प्राण एवमाप्याययेत्स्वयम्
verses.transliteration: prāṇānāṃ granthirasyātmā rudro hyātmā viśāntakaḥ rudro vai hyātmanaḥ prāṇa evamāpyāyayetsvayam
verses.translation: If her menses do not stop after three days she remains impure for five nights. But Apastamba considers her to be impure so long as her menses continue:
verses.hindi: प्राजापत्येन कृच्छेण ततः पापात्प्रमुच्यते। व्यतिक्रमाश्च ये केचिद्वाङ्मनःकायसम्भवाः चरेद्धि शुद्धः समलोष्ठकाञ्चनः
verses.wordMeaning: If her menses do not stop after three days she remains impure for five nights. But Apastamba considers her to be impure so long as her menses continue:
verses.commentary: Sense: If her menses do not stop after three days she remains impure for five nights. But Apastamba considers her to be impure so long as her menses continue:

verses.sanskrit: प्राणे निविष्टो वै रुद्रस् तस्मात्प्राणमयः स्वयम् प्राणाय चैव रुद्राय जुहोत्यमृतमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: prāṇe niviṣṭo vai rudras tasmātprāṇamayaḥ svayam prāṇāya caiva rudrāya juhotyamṛtamuttamam
verses.translation: A woman in her monthly course shall avoid bath, toilet, singing, crying, laughing, going in vehicles, applying collyrium, playing dice, applying unguents, sleeping during the daytime, washing the teeth, sexual intercourse, worship of deities whether mental, verbal or physical as well as bowing down. A woman in her monthly course shall avoid touching another woman in her monthly course and talking to her also. She shall assiduously avoid changing her garments. A woman in her monthly course shall not touch another man after her bath. She shall look at the brilliant sun and drink Brahma- kurca or Paficagavya or milk for self purification.
verses.hindi: छक कक क कक कक कक कक कक क क फक ककम कक फ कक क क कफ कफ कक ल नरक क आफ काकफफ क ड
verses.wordMeaning: A woman in her monthly course shall avoid bath, toilet, singing, crying, laughing, going in vehicles, applying collyrium, playing dice, applying unguents, sleeping during the daytime, washing the teeth, sexual intercourse, worship of deities whether mental,…
verses.commentary: Sense: A woman in her monthly course shall avoid bath, toilet, singing, crying, laughing, going in vehicles, applying collyrium, playing dice, applying unguents, sleeping during the daytime, washing the teeth, sexual intercourse, worship of deities whether mental,…

verses.sanskrit: शिवाविशेह मामीश स्वाहा ब्रह्मात्मने स्वयम् एवं पञ्चाहुतीश्चैव प्रभुः प्रीणातु शाश्वतः
verses.transliteration: śivāviśeha māmīśa svāhā brahmātmane svayam evaṃ pañcāhutīścaiva prabhuḥ prīṇātu śāśvataḥ
verses.translation: The husband shall not indulge in sexual inter- course on the fourth night after the monthly discharge has started. If he indulges thus, the child born will be short-lived. The son born of this sexual contact will be devoid of learning, depraved, deviating from the observance of holy rites, violating the chastity of other men's wives and immersed in the ocean of penury. The woman should be approached on the fifth night if he seeks a daughter.
verses.hindi: कीड़ोंतककी हिंसा कर दे, तो अथवा चान्द्रायणव्रत करना चाहिए। स्त्रीको को इन्द्रिय-दौर्बल्यके कारण यदि यति स्खलित हो जाता है तो उसे सोलह बार प्राणायाम करना चाहिए। दिनमे वीर्यस्खलन करनेवाले विप्रके लिये प्रायश्चित्तस्वरूप तीन राततक उपवास और सौ प्राणायामका विधान है। यदि रातमें स्खलन होता है, तो स्नान करके बारह धारणा (प्राणायाम) करनेके अनन्तर वह शुद्ध हो जाता है। हे
verses.wordMeaning: The husband shall not indulge in sexual inter- course on the fourth night after the monthly discharge has started. If he indulges thus, the child born will be short-lived. The son born of this sexual contact will be devoid of learning, depraved,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The husband shall not indulge in sexual inter- course on the fourth night after the monthly discharge has started. If he indulges thus, the child born will be short-lived. The son born of this sexual contact will be devoid of learning, depraved,…

verses.sanskrit: पुरुषो ऽसि पुरे शेषे त्वं अङ्गुष्ठप्रमाणतः आश्रितश्चैव चाङ्गुष्ठम् ईशः परमकारणम्
verses.transliteration: puruṣo 'si pure śeṣe tvaṃ aṅguṣṭhapramāṇataḥ āśritaścaiva cāṅguṣṭham īśaḥ paramakāraṇam
verses.translation: If the blood is predominant, the child will be a girl; if the semen is predominant the child will be a boy; if both are equal the child will be an eunuch; if the sexual intercourse is on the fifth night the child will be a girl. The blessed lady shall be approached on the sixth night; she will be the mother of a good son. The son will be excessively brilliant and he will remain dutiful as a son.
verses.hindi: द्विजो! प्राणायामके द्वारा विप्र शुद्धमनवाला तथा पापसे रहित हो जाता है॥ १६--१९ /२ ॥
verses.wordMeaning: If the blood is predominant, the child will be a girl; if the semen is predominant the child will be a boy; if both are equal the child will be an eunuch; if the sexual intercourse is on the fifth night the child will be a girl.…
verses.commentary: Sense: If the blood is predominant, the child will be a girl; if the semen is predominant the child will be a boy; if both are equal the child will be an eunuch; if the sexual intercourse is on the fifth night the child will be a girl.…

verses.sanskrit: सर्वस्य जगतश्चैव प्रभुः प्रीणातु शाश्वतः त्वं देवानामसि ज्येष्ठो रुद्रस्त्वं च पुरो वृषा
verses.transliteration: sarvasya jagataścaiva prabhuḥ prīṇātu śāśvataḥ tvaṃ devānāmasi jyeṣṭho rudrastvaṃ ca puro vṛṣā
verses.translation: The word Pum means ''hell" and they say that hell is miserable. She will give birth to a son who will save his parents from Pum (i.e. hell),®
verses.hindi: किसी एक व्यक्तिसे प्राप्त अन्न, मधु (शहद), मांस, बिना पका हुआ भोजन तथा प्रत्यक्ष लबण--ये सभी पदार्थ यतियोंके लिये अभोज्य हैं । इनमें किसी एकका भी उल्लंघन होनेपर उनके लिये प्रायश्चित्तका विधान किया गया है; कृच्छूप्राजापत्यत्रतके द्वारा उस पापसे यति छूट जाता है। मन, वाणी तथा शरीरसे जो कोई भी अन्य व्यतिक्रम हो जाय, तो उनके प्रायश्चित्तके लिये सत्पुरुषोंके साथ निर्णय करके बे जो बतायें, उसे करना चाहिए॥ २०--२३॥
verses.wordMeaning: The word Pum means ''hell" and they say that hell is miserable. She will give birth to a son who will save his parents from Pum (i.e. hell),®
verses.commentary: Sense: The word Pum means ''hell" and they say that hell is miserable. She will give birth to a son who will save his parents from Pum (i.e. hell),®

verses.sanskrit: मृदुस्त्वमन्नमस्मभ्यम् एतदस्तु हुतं तव इत्येवं कथितं सर्वं गुणप्राप्तिविशेषतः
verses.transliteration: mṛdustvamannamasmabhyam etadastu hutaṃ tava ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ guṇaprāptiviśeṣataḥ
verses.translation: The husband who seeks a daughter shall approach her on the seventh night. She will give birth to a daughter.®® If approached on the eighth night she will give birth to a son equipped with everything. Cf. Manu* IX. 138.
verses.hindi: जो शुद्ध मनसे मिट्टीके ढेले तथा सुवर्णमें समान भाव रखता है और सभी प्राणियोंमें ब्रह्मका चिन्तन करता है; वह स्थिर, शाश्वत तथा अविनाशी परम धामको प्राप्त करके पुन: जन्म नहीं ग्रहण करता है
verses.wordMeaning: The husband who seeks a daughter shall approach her on the seventh night. She will give birth to a daughter.®® If approached on the eighth night she will give birth to a son equipped with everything. Cf. Manu* IX. 138.
verses.commentary: Sense: The husband who seeks a daughter shall approach her on the seventh night. She will give birth to a daughter.®® If approached on the eighth night she will give birth to a son equipped with everything. Cf. Manu* IX. 138.

verses.sanskrit: योगाचारः स्वयं तेन ब्रह्मणा कथितः पुरा एवं पाशुपतं ज्ञानं ज्ञातव्यं च प्रयत्नतः
verses.transliteration: yogācāraḥ svayaṃ tena brahmaṇā kathitaḥ purā evaṃ pāśupataṃ jñānaṃ jñātavyaṃ ca prayatnataḥ
verses.translation: saiva prasuyate — BandhyS bhavati ST. she becomes barren. ST. quotes Nirriaya-sindhu in support of his view: "saptamyam apraja yo?it.** But this meaning is not borne out by the text.
verses.hindi: आसननमृत्युसूचक लक्षण एवं योगसाधनामें प्रणवका माहात्म्य तथा शिवोपासनानिरूपण यः पश्यति न जीवेद्वै मासादेकादशात्परम्
verses.wordMeaning: saiva prasuyate — BandhyS bhavati ST. she becomes barren. ST. quotes Nirriaya-sindhu in support of his view: "saptamyam apraja yo?it.** But this meaning is not borne out by the text.
verses.commentary: Sense: saiva prasuyate — BandhyS bhavati ST. she becomes barren. ST. quotes Nirriaya-sindhu in support of his view: "saptamyam apraja yo?it.** But this meaning is not borne out by the text.

verses.sanskrit: भस्मस्नायी भवेन् नित्यं भस्मलिप्तः सदा भवेत् यः पठेच्छृणुयाद्वापि श्रावयेद्वा द्विजोत्तमान्
verses.transliteration: bhasmasnāyī bhaven nityaṃ bhasmaliptaḥ sadā bhavet yaḥ paṭhecchṛṇuyādvāpi śrāvayedvā dvijottamān
verses.translation: If approached on the twelfth night she will give birth to a son who is conversant with the principle of Dharma and who will observe the holy rites laid down in Srutis and Smrtis. If approached on the thirteenth night she will give birth to a sluggish girl who will bring about mixture of castes. Hence, one shall assiduously avoid her on that night. If he approaches her on the fourteenth night she will be the mother of a son. If approached on the fifteenth night she will give birth to a virtuous daughter; if approached on the sixteenth night she will give birth to a son who will be a master of per- fect knowledge.
verses.hindi: सूतजी बोले-हे ऋषियो! इसके बाद मैं अरिषटों (मृत्युको सूचित करनेवाले चिह्वों)-को बताऊँगा, जिस ज्ञानविशेषसे योगीलोग मृत्युको देखते हैं; आपलोग उन्हें जानिये
verses.wordMeaning: If approached on the twelfth night she will give birth to a son who is conversant with the principle of Dharma and who will observe the holy rites laid down in Srutis and Smrtis.…
verses.commentary: Sense: If approached on the twelfth night she will give birth to a son who is conversant with the principle of Dharma and who will observe the holy rites laid down in Srutis and Smrtis.…

verses.sanskrit: दैवे कर्मणि पित्र्ये वा स याति परमां गतिम्
verses.transliteration: daive karmaṇi pitrye vā sa yāti paramāṃ gatim
verses.translation: Construe 'purvat' with the following vcisc. i. c. dv&da£ym purvavat («panditavat) dfaarma-tattvajfiam (sutam prasutc).
verses.hindi: तथा आकाशगंगामार्गको नहीं देख पाता है, वह एक वर्षसे अधिक नहीं जीवित रहता है। जो रश्मिरहित सूर्यको तथा रश्मियुक्त अग्निको देखता है, वह ग्यार€ महीनेसे अधिक नहीं जीता है। जो प्रत्यक्ष अथवा आसननमृत्युसूचक लक्षण एवं योगसाधनामें प्रणवका माहात्म्य
verses.wordMeaning: Construe 'purvat' with the following vcisc. i. c. dv&da£ym purvavat («panditavat) dfaarma-tattvajfiam (sutam prasutc).
verses.commentary: Sense: Construe 'purvat' with the following vcisc. i. c. dv&da£ym purvavat («panditavat) dfaarma-tattvajfiam (sutam prasutc).

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीलिङ्गमहापुराणे पूर्वभागे ऽणिमाद्यष्टसिद्धित्रिगुणसंसारप्राग्नौ होमादिवर्णनं नामाष्टाशीतितमो ऽध्यायः अत ऊर्ध्वं प्रवक्ष्यामि शौचाचारस्य लक्षणम् यदनुष्ठाय शुद्धात्मा परेत्य गतिमाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: iti śrīliṅgamahāpurāṇe pūrvabhāge 'ṇimādyaṣṭasiddhitriguṇasaṃsāraprāgnau homādivarṇanaṃ nāmāṣṭāśītitamo 'dhyāyaḥ ata ūrdhvaṃ pravakṣyāmi śaucācārasya lakṣaṇam yadanuṣṭhāya śuddhātmā paretya gatimāpnuyāt
verses.translation: This has been formerly mentioned by Brahma for the welfare of living beings. This is the summary of the implication of the Vedas. It is a collection of things expounding the Brah- man.
verses.hindi: RAR पापकमा पा कपा काममा कक कक कक पकक FT TE फफीफफफफफफफफफफफफफफफ झफफफफफाफफफफफफफफफफफफफफफफफफफफफफाफफफफफफकफफफफ
verses.wordMeaning: This has been formerly mentioned by Brahma for the welfare of living beings. This is the summary of the implication of the Vedas. It is a collection of things expounding the Brah- man.
verses.commentary: Sense: This has been formerly mentioned by Brahma for the welfare of living beings. This is the summary of the implication of the Vedas. It is a collection of things expounding the Brah- man.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मणा कथितं पूर्वं सर्वभूतहिताय वै संक्षेपात्सर्ववेदार्थं संचयं ब्रह्मवादिनाम्
verses.transliteration: brahmaṇā kathitaṃ pūrvaṃ sarvabhūtahitāya vai saṃkṣepātsarvavedārthaṃ saṃcayaṃ brahmavādinām
verses.translation: It is conducive to the rise of cleanliness. It is the excellent position of the sages. The sage who docs not err in this does not come to grief.
verses.hindi: पांशुके कर्दमे वापि सप्तमासान् स जीवति॥ काकः कपोतो गृध्रो वा निलीयेद्यस्य मूर्धनि। क्रव्यादो वा खगो यस्य षण्मासान्नातिवर्तते
verses.wordMeaning: It is conducive to the rise of cleanliness. It is the excellent position of the sages. The sage who docs not err in this does not come to grief.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is conducive to the rise of cleanliness. It is the excellent position of the sages. The sage who docs not err in this does not come to grief.

verses.sanskrit: उदयार्थं तु शौचानां मुनीनामुत्तमं पदम् यस्तत्राथाप्रमत्तः स्यात् स मुनिर्नावसीदति
verses.transliteration: udayārthaṃ tu śaucānāṃ munīnāmuttamaṃ padam yastatrāthāpramattaḥ syāt sa munirnāvasīdati
verses.translation: Honour and dishonour arc two things which they call poison and nectar. Dishonour is nectar and honour is poison.
verses.hindi: गच्छेद्वायसपङ्कीभिः पांसुवर्षेण वा पुनः। स्वच्छायां विकृतां पश्येच्चतुः पञ्च स जीवति
verses.wordMeaning: Honour and dishonour arc two things which they call poison and nectar. Dishonour is nectar and honour is poison.
verses.commentary: Sense: Honour and dishonour arc two things which they call poison and nectar. Dishonour is nectar and honour is poison.

verses.sanskrit: मानावमानौ द्वावेतौ तावेवाहुर् विषामृते अवमानो ऽमृतं तत्र सन्मानो विषमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: mānāvamānau dvāvetau tāvevāhur viṣāmṛte avamāno 'mṛtaṃ tatra sanmāno viṣamucyate
verses.translation: He, the disciple, shall live with the preceptor for a year engaged in the welfare of the preceptor. He shall always be unerring in the holy observances and restraints.
verses.hindi: उदके धनुरै्द्रं वा त्रीणि द्वौ वा स जीवति धूमं वा मस्तकात्पश्येद्शाहान्न स जीवति
verses.wordMeaning: He, the disciple, shall live with the preceptor for a year engaged in the welfare of the preceptor. He shall always be unerring in the holy observances and restraints.
verses.commentary: Sense: He, the disciple, shall live with the preceptor for a year engaged in the welfare of the preceptor. He shall always be unerring in the holy observances and restraints.

verses.sanskrit: गुरोरपि हिते युक्तः स तु संवत्सरं वसेत् नियमेष्वप्रमत्तस्तु यमेषु च सदा भवेत्
verses.transliteration: gurorapi hite yuktaḥ sa tu saṃvatsaraṃ vaset niyameṣvapramattastu yameṣu ca sadā bhavet
verses.translation: After obtaining his permission along with the excellent path of knowledge -he shall walk over the earth [i. c. fulfil the duties of the mundane existence] without repugnance to Dharma.
verses.hindi: स्वप्ममें मूत्र, पुरीष (विष्ठा), सुवर्ण अथवा रजत (चाँदी)-का वमन करता है, वह दस महीनेसे अधिक नहीं जीता है। जो स्वप्नमें सुनहरे वृक्षको देखता है और गन्धर्वनगरों तथा प्रेतपिशाचोंको देखता है, वह नौ
verses.wordMeaning: After obtaining his permission along with the excellent path of knowledge -he shall walk over the earth [i. c. fulfil the duties of the mundane existence] without repugnance to Dharma.
verses.commentary: Sense: After obtaining his permission along with the excellent path of knowledge -he shall walk over the earth [i. c. fulfil the duties of the mundane existence] without repugnance to Dharma.

verses.sanskrit: प्राप्यानुज्ञां ततश्चैव ज्ञानयोगमनुत्तमम् अविरोधेन धर्मस्य चरेत पृथिवीमिमाम्
verses.transliteration: prāpyānujñāṃ tataścaiva jñānayogamanuttamam avirodhena dharmasya careta pṛthivīmimām
verses.translation: One shall traverse the path sanctified by the eyes; one shall drink the water rendered pure by a cloth (i. e. well- filtered); one shall speak out words sanctified by truth; one shall practise those things that arc purified by the mind.*'-*
verses.hindi: महीनेतक जीवित रहता है। जो अकस्मात् स्थूल हो जाता है, अकस्मात् दुर्बल हो जाता है और अपने स्वभावसे दूर हो जाता है, वह आठ महीनेतक जीवित रहता है॥ २--६॥ जिसके पैरकी आकृति धूल या कीचड़में सामने या पीछेसे खण्डित दिखायी दे, वह सात महीनेतक जीता है। जिसके सिरपर कौआ, कबूतर, गीध अथवा मांसभक्षी अन्य पक्षी बैठ जाता है, वह छ: महीनेसे
verses.wordMeaning: One shall traverse the path sanctified by the eyes; one shall drink the water rendered pure by a cloth (i. e. well- filtered); one shall speak out words sanctified by truth; one shall practise those things that arc purified by the mind.*'-*
verses.commentary: Sense: One shall traverse the path sanctified by the eyes; one shall drink the water rendered pure by a cloth (i. e. well- filtered); one shall speak out words sanctified by truth; one shall practise those things that arc purified by the mind.*'-*

verses.sanskrit: चक्षुःपूतं चरेन्मार्गं वस्त्रपूतं जलं पिबेत् सत्यपूतं वदेद्वाक्यं मनःपूतं समाचरेत्
verses.transliteration: cakṣuḥpūtaṃ carenmārgaṃ vastrapūtaṃ jalaṃ pibet satyapūtaṃ vadedvākyaṃ manaḥpūtaṃ samācaret
verses.translation: If one drinks impure water for a day one incurs that sin which a fisherman incurs in the course of six months.
verses.hindi: अधिक नहीं जीता है। जो कौओंकी पंक्तियोंके साथ गमन करता है अथवा धूलवृष्टि (आँधी)-के साथ गमन करता है और अपनी छायाको विकृत देखता है, वह चार-पाँच महीनेतक जीता है। जो मेघरहित
verses.wordMeaning: If one drinks impure water for a day one incurs that sin which a fisherman incurs in the course of six months.
verses.commentary: Sense: If one drinks impure water for a day one incurs that sin which a fisherman incurs in the course of six months.

verses.sanskrit: मत्स्यगृह्यस्य यत्पापं षण्मासाभ्यन्तरे भवेत् एकाहं तत्समं ज्ञेयम् अपूतं यज्जलं भवेत्
verses.transliteration: matsyagṛhyasya yatpāpaṃ ṣaṇmāsābhyantare bhavet ekāhaṃ tatsamaṃ jñeyam apūtaṃ yajjalaṃ bhavet
verses.translation: On drinking impure water one shall as expiation perform five hundred japas of Aghora mantra and then attain purity.
verses.hindi: आकाशमें विद्युतको दक्षिण दिशामें स्थित देखता है अथवा जलमें इन्द्रधनुषको देखता है, वह दो अथवा तीन महीनेतक जीवित रहता है जो जलमें अथवा दर्पणमें अपने प्रतिबिम्बको नहीं देख पाता है और अपनेको सिरविहीन देखता है, वह एक महीनेसे अधिक नहीं जीता है। यदि किसीका शरीर शवकी गन्धवाला अथवा चर्बीकी गन्धवाला हो
verses.wordMeaning: On drinking impure water one shall as expiation perform five hundred japas of Aghora mantra and then attain purity.
verses.commentary: Sense: On drinking impure water one shall as expiation perform five hundred japas of Aghora mantra and then attain purity.

verses.sanskrit: अपूतोदकपाने तु जपेच्च शतपञ्चकम् अघोरलक्षणं मन्त्रं ततः शुद्धिमवाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: apūtodakapāne tu japecca śatapañcakam aghoralakṣaṇaṃ mantraṃ tataḥ śuddhimavāpnuyāt
verses.translation: Or he shall worship Siva with elaborate details, such as ablution with ghee, etc. Then he shall circumambulate the deity three times, when he shall undoubtedly be purified.
verses.hindi: जाता है, तो उसकी मृत्यु समीप आयी हुई होती है; वह आधे महीनेसे अधिक नहीं जीवित रहता है। स्नान करनेके तुरंत बाद जिसका हृदय सूख जाता है अथवा मस्तकसे धुआँ दिखायी देता है, वह दस दिनसे अधिक
verses.wordMeaning: Or he shall worship Siva with elaborate details, such as ablution with ghee, etc. Then he shall circumambulate the deity three times, when he shall undoubtedly be purified.
verses.commentary: Sense: Or he shall worship Siva with elaborate details, such as ablution with ghee, etc. Then he shall circumambulate the deity three times, when he shall undoubtedly be purified.

verses.sanskrit: अथवा पूजयेच्छंभुं घृतस्नानादिविस्तरैः त्रिधा प्रदक्षिणीकृत्य शुध्यते नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: athavā pūjayecchaṃbhuṃ ghṛtasnānādivistaraiḥ tridhā pradakṣiṇīkṛtya śudhyate nātra saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: Gf. Manusmrti VI. 46.
verses.hindi: प्रवाहमय वायु जिसके मर्मस्थानोंको भेद देता है और जो जलसे स्पृष्ट होकर प्रसन्न नहीं होता है, उसको मृत्युको उपस्थित समझना चाहिए। यदि कोई स्वप्नमें ऋक्ष (भालू) तथा बन्दरसे जुते हुए रथसे दक्षिण दिशाको ओर गाते तथा नाचते हुए यात्रा करता है, तो उसकी मृत्युको उपस्थित समझना चाहिए। स्वप्नमें काले रंगका वस्त्र धारण किये कृष्ण वर्णवाली
verses.wordMeaning: Gf. Manusmrti VI. 46.
verses.commentary: Sense: Gf. Manusmrti VI. 46.

verses.sanskrit: आतिथ्यश्राद्धयज्ञेषु न गच्छेद्योगवित्क्वचित् एवं ह्यहिंसको योगी भवेदिति विचारितम्
verses.transliteration: ātithyaśrāddhayajñeṣu na gacchedyogavitkvacit evaṃ hyahiṃsako yogī bhavediti vicāritam
verses.translation: The intelligent mendicant shall go in for alms to a house where all people have taken food but still there is plenty of tire without smoke. But he shaH not go to the same house every day.
verses.hindi: भस्माङ्गारांश्च केशांश्च नदी शुष्कां भुजङ्गमान्। पश्येद्यो दशरात्रं तु न स जीवति तादूशः
verses.wordMeaning: The intelligent mendicant shall go in for alms to a house where all people have taken food but still there is plenty of tire without smoke. But he shaH not go to the same house every day.
verses.commentary: Sense: The intelligent mendicant shall go in for alms to a house where all people have taken food but still there is plenty of tire without smoke. But he shaH not go to the same house every day.

verses.sanskrit: वह्नौ विधूमे ऽत्यङ्गारे सर्वस्मिन्भुक्तवज्जने चरेत्तु मतिमान् भैक्ष्यं न तु तेष्वेव नित्यशः
verses.transliteration: vahnau vidhūme 'tyaṅgāre sarvasminbhuktavajjane carettu matimān bhaikṣyaṃ na tu teṣveva nityaśaḥ
verses.translation: In that case people will insult him and the enemies will disgrace and humiliate him. So one shall beg for alms in the proper manner. He shall not defile the Dharma oi good men.
verses.hindi: सूर्योदये प्रत्युषसि प्रत्यक्षं यस्य वै शिवाः। क्रोशन्त्यभिमुखं प्रेत्य स॒ गतायुर्भवेन्नरः भूयो भूयस्त्रसेद्यस्तु रात्रौ वा यदि वा दिवा। दीपगन्धं च नाघ्राति विद्यान्मृत्युमुपस्थितम्
verses.wordMeaning: In that case people will insult him and the enemies will disgrace and humiliate him. So one shall beg for alms in the proper manner. He shall not defile the Dharma oi good men.
verses.commentary: Sense: In that case people will insult him and the enemies will disgrace and humiliate him. So one shall beg for alms in the proper manner. He shall not defile the Dharma oi good men.

verses.sanskrit: अथैनम् अवमन्यन्ते परे परिभवन्ति च तथा युक्तं चरेद्भैक्ष्यं सतां धर्ममदूषयन्
verses.transliteration: athainam avamanyante pare paribhavanti ca tathā yuktaṃ caredbhaikṣyaṃ satāṃ dharmamadūṣayan
verses.translation: One shall beg for alms in the houses of vagrant mendicants and in the houses situated in the forests. Ihc latter shall be better mode of su:>tenance.
verses.hindi: नेत्रमेकं स्त्रवेद्यस्य कर्णौ स्थानाच्च भ्रशयतः। वक्रा च नासा भवति विज्ञेयो गतजीवितः
verses.wordMeaning: One shall beg for alms in the houses of vagrant mendicants and in the houses situated in the forests. Ihc latter shall be better mode of su:>tenance.
verses.commentary: Sense: One shall beg for alms in the houses of vagrant mendicants and in the houses situated in the forests. Ihc latter shall be better mode of su:>tenance.

verses.sanskrit: भैक्ष्यं चरेद्वनस्थेषु यायावरगृहेषु च श्रेष्ठा तु प्रथमा हीयं वृत्तिरस्योपजायते
verses.transliteration: bhaikṣyaṃ caredvanastheṣu yāyāvaragṛheṣu ca śreṣṭhā tu prathamā hīyaṃ vṛttirasyopajāyate
verses.translation: Thereafter, he shall go in for aims in the houses ol ihc non-dcfilcd and not-fallcn. The practice of hogging lor alms trom people of other eastes is eonsidcred the meanest ol all
verses.hindi: गण्डे वा पिण्डिकारक्ते तस्य मृत्युरुपस्थितः मुक्तकेशो हसंश्चैव गायन्नृत्यंश्च यो नरः। याम्यामभिमुखं गच्छेत्तदन्तं तस्य जीवितम्
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, he shall go in for aims in the houses ol ihc non-dcfilcd and not-fallcn. The practice of hogging lor alms trom people of other eastes is eonsidcred the meanest ol all
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, he shall go in for aims in the houses ol ihc non-dcfilcd and not-fallcn. The practice of hogging lor alms trom people of other eastes is eonsidcred the meanest ol all

verses.sanskrit: अत ऊर्ध्वं गृहस्थेषु शीलीनेषु चरेद्द्विजाः श्रद्दधानेषु दान्तेषु श्रोत्रियेषु महात्मसु
verses.transliteration: ata ūrdhvaṃ gṛhastheṣu śīlīneṣu careddvijāḥ śraddadhāneṣu dānteṣu śrotriyeṣu mahātmasu
verses.translation: Of these two persons, viz. one wno begs for alms by means that are justifiable and the other who, (by way of petumcc) drinks a <lrop of water by means ol the tip of the
verses.hindi: स्त्री गाती हुई जिसे दक्षिण दिशाकी ओर ले जाय, भी जीवित नहीं रहता है॥ १४--१६॥
verses.wordMeaning: Of these two persons, viz. one wno begs for alms by means that are justifiable and the other who, (by way of petumcc) drinks a <lrop of water by means ol the tip of the
verses.commentary: Sense: Of these two persons, viz. one wno begs for alms by means that are justifiable and the other who, (by way of petumcc) drinks a <lrop of water by means ol the tip of the

verses.sanskrit: अत ऊर्ध्वं पुनश्चापि अदुष्टापतितेषु च भैक्ष्यचर्या हि वर्णेषु जघन्या वृत्तिरुच्यते
verses.transliteration: ata ūrdhvaṃ punaścāpi aduṣṭāpatiteṣu ca bhaikṣyacaryā hi varṇeṣu jaghanyā vṛttirucyate
verses.translation: One shall always lie down on Bhasman; with control over the sense-organs he shall beg for alms. He who wishes for the greatest abode shall perform the Pasupata vrata.
verses.hindi: जो मनुष्य स्वप्नमें अपने कण्ठका छिद्र है अथवा नग्न श्रमण (भिक्षु)-को देखता है, उ्से अपनी मृत्युको उपस्थित समझना चाहिए। जो मनुष्य स्वप्नमें अपनेको पैरसे मस्तकतक कीचड़के समुद्रमे डूबा हुआ पाता है; वह उस प्रकारके स्वणको देखनेपर जीवित नहीं रहता है और शीघ्र ही मर जाता है। जो भस्म, अंगारों, केशों, सूखी नदी तथा सपाँको स्वप्नमें देखता है; वह दस राततक जीवित
verses.wordMeaning: One shall always lie down on Bhasman; with control over the sense-organs he shall beg for alms. He who wishes for the greatest abode shall perform the Pasupata vrata.
verses.commentary: Sense: One shall always lie down on Bhasman; with control over the sense-organs he shall beg for alms. He who wishes for the greatest abode shall perform the Pasupata vrata.

verses.sanskrit: भैक्ष्यं यवागूस्तक्रं वा पयो यावकमेव च फलमूलादि पक्वं वा कणपिण्याकसक्तवः
verses.transliteration: bhaikṣyaṃ yavāgūstakraṃ vā payo yāvakameva ca phalamūlādi pakvaṃ vā kaṇapiṇyākasaktavaḥ
verses.translation: The rite of Candrayana shall be most excellent for all yogins. According to his capacity, the devotee shall per- form it once, twice, thrice or four times.
verses.hindi: नहीं रह पाता है। जो उठाये हुए शस्त्रोंवाले काले तथा विकट (विकराल) पुरुषोंके द्वारा पत्थरोंसे स्वणमें मारा जाता है, वह जीवित नहीं रहता है॥ १७--२०॥
verses.wordMeaning: The rite of Candrayana shall be most excellent for all yogins. According to his capacity, the devotee shall per- form it once, twice, thrice or four times.
verses.commentary: Sense: The rite of Candrayana shall be most excellent for all yogins. According to his capacity, the devotee shall per- form it once, twice, thrice or four times.

verses.sanskrit: इत्येव ते मया प्रोक्ता योगिनां सिद्धिवर्द्धनाः आहारास्तेषु सिद्धेषु श्रेष्ठं भैक्ष्यमिति स्मृतम्
verses.transliteration: ityeva te mayā proktā yogināṃ siddhivarddhanāḥ āhārāsteṣu siddheṣu śreṣṭhaṃ bhaikṣyamiti smṛtam
verses.translation: The niyamas (observances and restraints) are the following: — akrodha (abstention from anger), guruSurusa (service to the preceptor), Sauca (cleanliness), aharalaghava (lightness of food) and study of the Vedas regularly.
verses.hindi: सूर्योदयके समय प्रातःकाल जिसके सामने प्रत्यक्ष आकर सियार रुदन करते हैं, वह मनुष्य समाप्त आयुवाला होता है। स्नान करनेके तुरंत बाद जिसके हृदयमें तीव्र वेदना होती है और दाँतोंमें कम्पन होता है, उसे समाप्त आयुवाला समझना चाहिए। जो मनुष्य दिनमें अथवा रातमें बार-बार भयभीत होता हो और दीपककी गन्धको न सूँघ पाता हो, उसे अपनी मृत्युको उपस्थित जानना चाहिए। जो रातमें इन्द्रधनुषको तथा
verses.wordMeaning: The niyamas (observances and restraints) are the following: — akrodha (abstention from anger), guruSurusa (service to the preceptor), Sauca (cleanliness), aharalaghava (lightness of food) and study of the Vedas regularly.
verses.commentary: Sense: The niyamas (observances and restraints) are the following: — akrodha (abstention from anger), guruSurusa (service to the preceptor), Sauca (cleanliness), aharalaghava (lightness of food) and study of the Vedas regularly.

verses.sanskrit: अब्बिन्दुं यः कुशाग्रेण मासि मासि समश्नुते न्यायतो यश्चरेद्भैक्ष्यं पूर्वोक्तात्स विशिष्यते
verses.transliteration: abbinduṃ yaḥ kuśāgreṇa māsi māsi samaśnute nyāyato yaścaredbhaikṣyaṃ pūrvoktātsa viśiṣyate
verses.translation: The qualities of the seed, the vagina and bondage with the objects — are due to karmans(?). Just as in the case of the elephant in the forest so also in regard to men it is laid down.
verses.hindi: दिनमें तारामण्डलको देखे और दूसरोंके नेत्रोंमें अपना प्रतिबिम्ब न देख सके; वह जीवित नहीं रहता
verses.wordMeaning: The qualities of the seed, the vagina and bondage with the objects — are due to karmans(?). Just as in the case of the elephant in the forest so also in regard to men it is laid down.
verses.commentary: Sense: The qualities of the seed, the vagina and bondage with the objects — are due to karmans(?). Just as in the case of the elephant in the forest so also in regard to men it is laid down.

verses.sanskrit: जरामरणगर्भेभ्यो भीतस्य नरकादिषु एवं दाययते तस्मात् तद्भैक्ष्यमिति संस्मृतम्
verses.transliteration: jarāmaraṇagarbhebhyo bhītasya narakādiṣu evaṃ dāyayate tasmāt tadbhaikṣyamiti saṃsmṛtam
verses.translation: All the sacrificial rites are equal to Devas. But japa is superior to sacrificial rites; perfect knowledge is superior to meditation; and meditation, devoid of attachment, is still supe- rior to that. When that is acquired, the eternal goal is obtained.
verses.hindi: जिसके एक नेत्रसे पानी आता हो, दोनों कान अपने स्थानसे खिसके हुए हों और जिसकी नाक टेढ़ी हो गयी हो, उसे समाप्त जीवनवाला समझना चाहिए। जिसकी जीभ काली तथा खुरदुरी हो जाय, फलके समान रक्तवर्णे हो जायँ, उसकी मृत्यु सन्निकट होती है। जो मनुष्य स्वप्नमें खुले बालोंवाला होकर हँसता हुआ, गाता हुआ तथा नाचता हुआ दक्षिण दिशाकी ओर जाता है, उसका जीवन समाप्त
verses.wordMeaning: All the sacrificial rites are equal to Devas. But japa is superior to sacrificial rites; perfect knowledge is superior to meditation; and meditation, devoid of attachment, is still supe- rior to that. When that is acquired, the eternal goal is obtained.
verses.commentary: Sense: All the sacrificial rites are equal to Devas. But japa is superior to sacrificial rites; perfect knowledge is superior to meditation; and meditation, devoid of attachment, is still supe- rior to that. When that is acquired, the eternal goal is obtained.

verses.sanskrit: दधिभक्षाः पयोभक्षा ये चान्ये जीवक्षीणकाः सर्वे ते भैक्ष्यभक्षस्य कलां नार्हन्ति षोडशीम्
verses.transliteration: dadhibhakṣāḥ payobhakṣā ye cānye jīvakṣīṇakāḥ sarve te bhaikṣyabhakṣasya kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm
verses.translation: Those persons whose intellects have been purified by perfect knowledge say that the following are auspicious qualities, viz: — control of the mind, suppression of the sense- organs, truthfulness, state of being free from sins, silence, straightforwardness in regard to all living beings and the knowledge of those objects beyond the scope of the sense- organs.
verses.wordMeaning: Those persons whose intellects have been purified by perfect knowledge say that the following are auspicious qualities, viz: — control of the mind, suppression of the sense- organs, truthfulness, state of being free from sins, silence,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Those persons whose intellects have been purified by perfect knowledge say that the following are auspicious qualities, viz: — control of the mind, suppression of the sense- organs, truthfulness, state of being free from sins, silence,…

verses.sanskrit: भस्मशायी भवेन्नित्यं भिक्षाचारी जितेन्द्रियः य इच्छेत् परमं स्थानं व्रतं पाशुपतं चरेत्
verses.transliteration: bhasmaśāyī bhavennityaṃ bhikṣācārī jitendriyaḥ ya icchet paramaṃ sthānaṃ vrataṃ pāśupataṃ caret
verses.translation: Only a noble soul who has concentration, who is devoted to the Brahman, who does not err, who is pure, who likes seclusion, and who has conquered the sense-organs shall attain this yoga. Thus, say the sages who are devoid of impuri- ties and are above censure.
verses.hindi: जिसका शरीर श्वेत मेघोंकी आभाके समान और आसनमृत्युसूचक लक्षण एवं योगसाधनामें प्रणवका माहात्म्य
verses.wordMeaning: Only a noble soul who has concentration, who is devoted to the Brahman, who does not err, who is pure, who likes seclusion, and who has conquered the sense-organs shall attain this yoga. Thus, say the sages who are devoid of impuri- ties and are above censure.
verses.commentary: Sense: Only a noble soul who has concentration, who is devoted to the Brahman, who does not err, who is pure, who likes seclusion, and who has conquered the sense-organs shall attain this yoga. Thus, say the sages who are devoid of impuri- ties and are above censure.

verses.sanskrit: योगिनां चैव सर्वेषां श्रेष्ठं चान्द्रायणं भवेत् एकं द्वे त्रीणि चत्वारि शक्तितो वा समाचरेत्
verses.transliteration: yogināṃ caiva sarveṣāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ cāndrāyaṇaṃ bhavet ekaṃ dve trīṇi catvāri śaktito vā samācaret
verses.translation: The devotee who has destroyed even the seeds of sins by means of this pure path, restrained by the same goad (of pure path ) attains the desired places.

verses.wordMeaning: The devotee who has destroyed even the seeds of sins by means of this pure path, restrained by the same goad (of pure path ) attains the desired places.
verses.commentary: Sense: The devotee who has destroyed even the seeds of sins by means of this pure path, restrained by the same goad (of pure path ) attains the desired places.

verses.sanskrit: अस्तेयं ब्रह्मचर्यं च अलोभस्त्याग एव च व्रतानि पञ्च भिक्षूणाम् अहिंसा परमा त्विह
verses.transliteration: asteyaṃ brahmacaryaṃ ca alobhastyāga eva ca vratāni pañca bhikṣūṇām ahiṃsā paramā tviha
verses.translation: Qjiiescent persons engaged in good conduct and
verses.hindi: द्रे बाथ परमेऽरिष्टे एकीभूतः परं भवेत्। घोषं न शृणुयात्कर्णे ज्योतिर्नेत्रे न पश्यति अरिष्टे सूचिते देहे तस्मिन् काल उपस्थिते। त्यक्त्वा खेदं विषादं च उपेक्षेद् बुद्धिमान्तरः
