verses.commentary: Sense: Qjiiescent persons engaged in good conduct and

verses.sanskrit: अक्रोधो गुरुशुश्रूषा शौचमाहारलाघवम् नित्यं स्वाध्याय इत्येते नियमाः परिकीर्तिताः
verses.transliteration: akrodho guruśuśrūṣā śaucamāhāralāghavam nityaṃ svādhyāya ityete niyamāḥ parikīrtitāḥ
verses.translation: The eternal Dharma has been imparted by Brahma himself for the utility of the people. Listen now when I recount it to you.
verses.hindi: स्वस्तिकेनोपविष्टस्तु नमस्कृत्वा महेश्वरम् ३८
verses.wordMeaning: The eternal Dharma has been imparted by Brahma himself for the utility of the people. Listen now when I recount it to you.
verses.commentary: Sense: The eternal Dharma has been imparted by Brahma himself for the utility of the people. Listen now when I recount it to you.

verses.sanskrit: बीजयोनिगुणा वस्तुबन्धः कर्मभिर् एव च यथा द्विप इवारण्ये मनुष्याणां विधीयते
verses.transliteration: bījayoniguṇā vastubandhaḥ karmabhir eva ca yathā dvipa ivāraṇye manuṣyāṇāṃ vidhīyate
verses.translation: One shall duly perform his duties such as obeisance and standing up by way of welcome towards elderly persons who have acquired instructions from preceptors and who stri- ctly adhere to their routine (i. e. the rules relating to their Asrama).
verses.hindi: समकायशिरोग्रीवो धारयन्तावलोकयेत्। यथा दीपो निवातस्थो नेङ्गते सोपमा स्मृता श्वेत सरसोंके समान गौर वर्णका हो जाय, उसकी मृत्यु सन्निकट होती है। जिसके स्वप्नमें रथमें जुते हुए अशुभ ऊँट अथवा गधे दिखायी पड़ें और वह दक्षिण दिशाको ओर जा रहा हो, वह व्यक्ति जीवित नहीं
verses.wordMeaning: One shall duly perform his duties such as obeisance and standing up by way of welcome towards elderly persons who have acquired instructions from preceptors and who stri- ctly adhere to their routine (i. e. the rules relating to their Asrama).
verses.commentary: Sense: One shall duly perform his duties such as obeisance and standing up by way of welcome towards elderly persons who have acquired instructions from preceptors and who stri- ctly adhere to their routine (i. e. the rules relating to their Asrama).

verses.sanskrit: देवैस्तुल्याः सर्वयज्ञक्रियास्तु यज्ञाज्जाप्यं ज्ञानमाहुश् च जाप्यात् ज्ञानाद् ध्यानं संगरागादपेतं तस्मिन्प्राप्ते शाश्वतस्योपलम्भः
verses.transliteration: devaistulyāḥ sarvayajñakriyāstu yajñājjāpyaṃ jñānamāhuś ca jāpyāt jñānād dhyānaṃ saṃgarāgādapetaṃ tasminprāpte śāśvatasyopalambhaḥ
verses.translation: O sages of good holy rites, the brahmin and the prece- ptor arc to be honoured by obeisance with eight limbs touch- ing th 4/ '»id with the following three set aside viz: — head- dress, upper garment and footwear and with three circiiinain- bulalions.
verses.hindi: रहता है। जो कानमें ध्वनि न सुन सके और नेत्रमें प्रकाश न देख सके-यदि ये दो बहुत अनिष्टकारी घटनाएँ स्वप्नमें एक साथ घटित हों, तो वह व्यक्ति मृत्युको प्राप्त होता है। जो स्वप्नमें गङ्लेमें गिर पड़े तथा
verses.wordMeaning: O sages of good holy rites, the brahmin and the prece- ptor arc to be honoured by obeisance with eight limbs touch- ing th 4/ '»id with the following three set aside viz: — head- dress, upper garment and footwear and with three circiiinain- bulalions.
verses.commentary: Sense: O sages of good holy rites, the brahmin and the prece- ptor arc to be honoured by obeisance with eight limbs touch- ing th 4/ '»id with the following three set aside viz: — head- dress, upper garment and footwear and with three circiiinain- bulalions.

verses.sanskrit: दमः शमः सत्यमकल्मषत्वं मौनं च भूतेष्वखिलेषु चार्जवम् अतीन्द्रियं ज्ञानमिदं तथा शिवं प्राहुस् तथा ज्ञानविशुद्धबुद्धयः
verses.transliteration: damaḥ śamaḥ satyamakalmaṣatvaṃ maunaṃ ca bhūteṣvakhileṣu cārjavam atīndriyaṃ jñānamidaṃ tathā śivaṃ prāhus tathā jñānaviśuddhabuddhayaḥ
verses.translation: All elderly persons should be respected. If one wishes for excellent Siddhi one shall never break their behests.
verses.hindi: उसका द्वार बन्द हो जाय और वह गड्टेसे निकल न सके, उसका जीवन समाप्त हो जाता है जिसके नेत्र ऊपरकी ओर उलट जाय, स्थिर हो जाय, रक्तवर्णके हो जायँ, बार-बार घूमते हों, मुख
verses.wordMeaning: All elderly persons should be respected. If one wishes for excellent Siddhi one shall never break their behests.
verses.commentary: Sense: All elderly persons should be respected. If one wishes for excellent Siddhi one shall never break their behests.

verses.sanskrit: समाहितो ब्रह्मपरो ऽप्रमादी शुचिस् तथैकान्तरतिर् जितेन्द्रियः ।* समाप्नुयाद्योगमिमं महात्मा महर्षयश्चैवम् अनिन्दितामलाः
verses.transliteration: samāhito brahmaparo 'pramādī śucis tathaikāntaratir jitendriyaḥ /* samāpnuyādyogamimaṃ mahātmā maharṣayaścaivam aninditāmalāḥ
verses.translation: One shall avoid all these things: — Taking up iron and other metals for.sustenance, living in a desert or unproductive soil*® and using worthless mantras as means of support, snakc- charming nd backbiting, flattery'a or scandal.
verses.hindi: गर्म हो; वह संकटग्रस्त होता है अर्थात् उसको मृत्यु आसन्न होती है
verses.wordMeaning: One shall avoid all these things: — Taking up iron and other metals for.sustenance, living in a desert or unproductive soil*® and using worthless mantras as means of support, snakc- charming nd backbiting, flattery'a or scandal.
verses.commentary: Sense: One shall avoid all these things: — Taking up iron and other metals for.sustenance, living in a desert or unproductive soil*® and using worthless mantras as means of support, snakc- charming nd backbiting, flattery'a or scandal.

verses.sanskrit: प्राप्यते ऽभिमतान् देशान् अङ्कुशेन निवारितः एतन्मार्गेण शुद्धेन दग्धबीजो ह्यकल्मषः
verses.transliteration: prāpyate 'bhimatān deśān aṅkuśena nivāritaḥ etanmārgeṇa śuddhena dagdhabījo hyakalmaṣaḥ
verses.translation: One shall scrupulously avoid deccptioi, stinginess in.spending money, censure of others. In the pi:sence of preceptors and ciders one shall avoid laughter, haughtiness, sportive dalliance and wilfulness. One shall never contradict the preceptor; one shall never speak unbecoming words against him. One shall scrupulously avoid mentioning things disliked by the preceptor and shall not think evil of him. One shall never touch these things with one's foot — the clothes, staff, etc., of ascetics, their sandals, garlands, places of sleep [i. e. bed- mattress etc.], vessel, shadow and the requisite things of use in sacrifices.
verses.hindi: जो दिनमें अथवा रातमें किसीके द्वारा प्रत्यक्ष रूपसे मारा जाय, किंतु मारनेवालेको देख न सके; वह समाप्त आयुवाला होता है और जीवित नहीं रह पाता है। जो मनुष्य स्वप्नमें अग्निमें प्रवेश करे और स्वप्नके अन्तमें इसका स्मरण न कर सके; उसका जीवन समाप्त हो जाता है। जो मनुष्य स्वप्नमें अपने श्वेत प्रावरण (ओढ्नेके वस्त्र)-को काला तथा लाल देखता है, उसकी मृत्यु सन्निकट होती है
verses.wordMeaning: One shall scrupulously avoid deccptioi, stinginess in.spending money, censure of others. In the pi:sence of preceptors and ciders one shall avoid laughter, haughtiness, sportive dalliance and wilfulness. One shall never contradict the preceptor;…
verses.commentary: Sense: One shall scrupulously avoid deccptioi, stinginess in.spending money, censure of others. In the pi:sence of preceptors and ciders one shall avoid laughter, haughtiness, sportive dalliance and wilfulness. One shall never contradict the preceptor;…

verses.sanskrit: सदाचाररताः शान्ताः स्वधर्मपरिपालकाः सर्वांल्लोकान् विनिर्जित्य ब्रह्मलोकं व्रजन्ति ते
verses.transliteration: sadācāraratāḥ śāntāḥ svadharmaparipālakāḥ sarvāṃllokān vinirjitya brahmalokaṃ vrajanti te
verses.translation: O brahmins, one shall scrupulously avoid treachery
verses.hindi: उस मृत्युकालके उपस्थित होनेपर और शरीरमें अरिष्टके सूचित होनेपर बुद्धिमान् मनुष्यको चाहिए कि खेद तथा विषादका परित्यागकर उपेक्षाभाव धारण करे
verses.wordMeaning: O brahmins, one shall scrupulously avoid treachery
verses.commentary: Sense: O brahmins, one shall scrupulously avoid treachery

verses.sanskrit: पितामहेनोपदिष्टो धर्मः साक्षात्सनातनः सर्वलोकोपकारार्थं शृणुध्वं प्रवदामि वः
verses.transliteration: pitāmahenopadiṣṭo dharmaḥ sākṣātsanātanaḥ sarvalokopakārārthaṃ śṛṇudhvaṃ pravadāmi vaḥ
verses.translation: If he repeats the japas a crore of times he is purified from the sins of treachery to the preceptor and the deities. For the expiation of great sins, one shall repeat Siva's mantra in accordance with the injunction. If the sinner is, otherwise, of good conduct he is purified by half the number of japas. O sages of good holy rites, all the Upapatakins (those who commit subsidiary sins) get purified by half the number of japas.
verses.hindi: पूरब या उत्तर दिशामें जाकर पवित्र हो करके किसी समतल, अतिस्थावर (आकाशरहित), एकान्त तथा जन्तुविहीन स्थानमें पूरब या उत्तरको ओर मुख करके स्वस्तिक आसनमें बैठ जाय और शान्त होकर आचमन करके महेश्वरको प्रणामकर शरीर, सिर तथा गरदनको सीधा करके धारणा करते हुए किसी वस्तुकी ओर न देखे, जैसे वायुरहित स्थानमें रखे दीपककी लौ विचलित नहीं होती है; इसके लिये यह उपमा बतायी
verses.wordMeaning: If he repeats the japas a crore of times he is purified from the sins of treachery to the preceptor and the deities. For the expiation of great sins, one shall repeat Siva's mantra in accordance with the injunction. If the sinner is, otherwise,…
verses.commentary: Sense: If he repeats the japas a crore of times he is purified from the sins of treachery to the preceptor and the deities. For the expiation of great sins, one shall repeat Siva's mantra in accordance with the injunction. If the sinner is, otherwise,…

verses.sanskrit: गुरूपदेशयुक्तानां वृद्धानां क्रमवर्त्तिनाम् अभ्युत्थानादिकं सर्वं प्रणामं चैव कारयेत्
verses.transliteration: gurūpadeśayuktānāṃ vṛddhānāṃ kramavarttinām abhyutthānādikaṃ sarvaṃ praṇāmaṃ caiva kārayet
verses.translation: In the following circumstances, one is purified by repeating the mantra for thousand times. The instances are: - violating agreements, eating forbidden food and speaking what should not be spoken.
verses.hindi: फक्फकफफफफ फफफ फफ फफफ फफ फ क क फफ मी फफफफफ्फफफफफफ फफफ कक कापा फ मामा मामा मामा मीमा फा फ फ फा
verses.wordMeaning: In the following circumstances, one is purified by repeating the mantra for thousand times. The instances are: - violating agreements, eating forbidden food and speaking what should not be spoken.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the following circumstances, one is purified by repeating the mantra for thousand times. The instances are: - violating agreements, eating forbidden food and speaking what should not be spoken.

verses.sanskrit: अष्टाङ्गप्रणिपातेन त्रिधा न्यस्तेन सुव्रताः त्रिःप्रदक्षिणयोगेन वन्द्यो वै ब्रह्मणो गुरुः
verses.transliteration: aṣṭāṅgapraṇipātena tridhā nyastena suvratāḥ triḥpradakṣiṇayogena vandyo vai brahmaṇo guruḥ
verses.translation: There is no doubt in this that if one kills birds like crows, owls and doves, etc., he is liberated from the sin by repeating the mantra hundred and eight times.
verses.hindi: कामं वितर्क प्रीतिं च सुखदुःखे उभे तथा कालकर्माणि विज्ञाय समूहेष्वेब नित्यशः
verses.wordMeaning: There is no doubt in this that if one kills birds like crows, owls and doves, etc., he is liberated from the sin by repeating the mantra hundred and eight times.
verses.commentary: Sense: There is no doubt in this that if one kills birds like crows, owls and doves, etc., he is liberated from the sin by repeating the mantra hundred and eight times.

verses.sanskrit: ज्येष्ठान्ये ऽपि च ते सर्वे वन्दनीया विजानता आज्ञाभङ्गं न कुर्वीत यदीच्छेत् सिद्धिम् उत्तमाम्
verses.transliteration: jyeṣṭhānye 'pi ca te sarve vandanīyā vijānatā ājñābhaṅgaṃ na kurvīta yadīcchet siddhim uttamām
verses.translation: The e3{cellent brahmin who knows the truth and has lealised Brahman becomes pure merely by remembering the deity. No doubt need be entertained in this respect.
verses.hindi: ततश्चापूरयेद्देहमो ङ्कारेण समन्वितः
verses.wordMeaning: The e3{cellent brahmin who knows the truth and has lealised Brahman becomes pure merely by remembering the deity. No doubt need be entertained in this respect.
verses.commentary: Sense: The e3{cellent brahmin who knows the truth and has lealised Brahman becomes pure merely by remembering the deity. No doubt need be entertained in this respect.

verses.sanskrit: धातुशून्यबिलक्षेत्रक्षुद्रमन्त्रोपजीवनम् विषग्रहविडम्बादीन् वर्जयेत् सर्वयत्नतः
verses.transliteration: dhātuśūnyabilakṣetrakṣudramantropajīvanam viṣagrahaviḍambādīn varjayet sarvayatnataḥ
verses.translation: There are no expiatory rites nor injunctions regard- ing them in the case of the knowers of the Atman. People who are conversant with the learning of the brahman are pure themselves (because they are engaged) in the welfare of the universe.
verses.hindi: तथोङ्कारमयो योगी अक्षरे त्वक्षरी भवेत्। अत ऊर्ध्व प्रवक्ष्यामि ओङ्कारप्राप्तिलक्षणम् पिपीलिकागतिस्पर्शा प्रयुक्ता मूर्ध्नि लक्ष्यते। यथा प्रयुक्त ओङ्कारः प्रतिनिर्याति मूर्धनि
verses.wordMeaning: There are no expiatory rites nor injunctions regard- ing them in the case of the knowers of the Atman. People who are conversant with the learning of the brahman are pure themselves (because they are engaged) in the welfare of the universe.
verses.commentary: Sense: There are no expiatory rites nor injunctions regard- ing them in the case of the knowers of the Atman. People who are conversant with the learning of the brahman are pure themselves (because they are engaged) in the welfare of the universe.

verses.sanskrit: कैतवं वित्तशाठ्यं च पैशुन्यं वर्जयेत्सदा अतिहासम् अवष्टम्भं लीलास्वेच्छाप्रवर्तनम्
verses.transliteration: kaitavaṃ vittaśāṭhyaṃ ca paiśunyaṃ varjayetsadā atihāsam avaṣṭambhaṃ līlāsvecchāpravartanam
verses.translation: Those who adhere to yoga and dhyana are stainless like gold. They become pure by resorting to Brahmavidya and there is no further purification for persons already pure.
verses.hindi: तथोङ्कारमयो योगी त्वक्षरे त्वक्षरी भवेत्। प्रणवो धनुः शरो ह्यात्मा ब्रह्मलक्षणमुच्यते
verses.wordMeaning: Those who adhere to yoga and dhyana are stainless like gold. They become pure by resorting to Brahmavidya and there is no further purification for persons already pure.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those who adhere to yoga and dhyana are stainless like gold. They become pure by resorting to Brahmavidya and there is no further purification for persons already pure.

verses.sanskrit: वर्जयेत्सर्वयत्नेन गुरूणामपि संनिधौ तद्वाक्यप्रतिकूलं च अयुक्तं वै गुरोर्वचः
verses.transliteration: varjayetsarvayatnena gurūṇāmapi saṃnidhau tadvākyapratikūlaṃ ca ayuktaṃ vai gurorvacaḥ
verses.translation: One shall avoid turbid water. He shall perform all rites by means of waters that have been purified by filtering through the pores of a cloth and that do not contain cold foams.
verses.hindi: ओमित्येकाक्षरं ह्येतद् गुहायां निहितं पदम् ओसमित्येतत् त्रयो लोकास्त्रयो वेदास्त्रयोऽग्नयः। विष्णुक्रमास्त्रयस्त्वेते ऋक्सामानि यजूंषि च
verses.wordMeaning: One shall avoid turbid water. He shall perform all rites by means of waters that have been purified by filtering through the pores of a cloth and that do not contain cold foams.
verses.commentary: Sense: One shall avoid turbid water. He shall perform all rites by means of waters that have been purified by filtering through the pores of a cloth and that do not contain cold foams.

verses.sanskrit: न वदेत्सर्वयत्नेन अनिष्टं न स्मरेत्सदा यतीनामासनं वस्त्रं दण्डाद्यं पादुके तथा
verses.transliteration: na vadetsarvayatnena aniṣṭaṃ na smaretsadā yatīnāmāsanaṃ vastraṃ daṇḍādyaṃ pāduke tathā
verses.translation: One shall avoid waters of these types: — that which
verses.hindi: शास्त्रवेत्ताको चाहिए कि पूर्व अथवा उत्तरको ओर विस्तारवाले स्थानमें ध्यानपरायण होबे। उसे कामना, तर्क, आसक्ति तथा सुख-दु:खको मनसे नियन्त्रित करके पूर्ण विशुद्ध ध्यानमें लीन हो जाना
verses.wordMeaning: One shall avoid waters of these types: — that which
verses.commentary: Sense: One shall avoid waters of these types: — that which

verses.sanskrit: माल्यं च शयनस्थानं पात्रं छायां च यत्नतः यज्ञोपकरणाङ्गं च न स्पृशेद् वै पदेन च
verses.transliteration: mālyaṃ ca śayanasthānaṃ pātraṃ chāyāṃ ca yatnataḥ yajñopakaraṇāṅgaṃ ca na spṛśed vai padena ca
verses.translation: One shall perform the rites of obeisance as well as service to the preceptors with pure and clean clothes. One devoid of cleanliness and purity in clothes is undoubtedly impure.
verses.hindi: चाहिए। काल तथा कर्मोंको सदा लिङ्गशरीरोंके अन्तर्गत समझकर नाक, जिल्वा, नेत्र, त्वचा, कान, मन, बुद्धि तथा हृदयमें धारणा करनी चाहिए । इस प्रकार योगधारणको द्वादशाध्यात्म (बारह अध्यात्म) नामवाला कहा जाता है। सौ अथवा पचास धारणाको सिरमें धारण करना चाहिए। धारणाके अभ्याससे श्रान्त योगीकी वायु ऊपरकी ओर होने लगती है; तब ओंकारसे युक्त होकर शरीरको वायुसे पूर्ण करना चाहिए । इस प्रकार ओंकारमय योगी
verses.wordMeaning: One shall perform the rites of obeisance as well as service to the preceptors with pure and clean clothes. One devoid of cleanliness and purity in clothes is undoubtedly impure.
verses.commentary: Sense: One shall perform the rites of obeisance as well as service to the preceptors with pure and clean clothes. One devoid of cleanliness and purity in clothes is undoubtedly impure.

verses.sanskrit: देवद्रोहं गुरुद्रोहं न कुर्यात्सर्वयत्नतः कृत्वा प्रमादतो विप्राः प्रणवस्यायुतं जपेत्
verses.transliteration: devadrohaṃ gurudrohaṃ na kuryātsarvayatnataḥ kṛtvā pramādato viprāḥ praṇavasyāyutaṃ japet
verses.translation: It is desired that the clothes used in divine rites should be washed every day. Other clothes should be washed when they become dirty.
verses.hindi: अपनेको ब्रह्ममें लीन करके ब्रह्मसायुज्य प्राप्त कर लेता है ॥ ४०४४/२ ॥
verses.wordMeaning: It is desired that the clothes used in divine rites should be washed every day. Other clothes should be washed when they become dirty.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is desired that the clothes used in divine rites should be washed every day. Other clothes should be washed when they become dirty.

verses.sanskrit: देवद्रोहगुरुद्रोहात् कोटिमात्रेण शुध्यति महापातकशुद्ध्यर्थं तथैव च यथाविधि
verses.transliteration: devadrohagurudrohāt koṭimātreṇa śudhyati mahāpātakaśuddhyarthaṃ tathaiva ca yathāvidhi
verses.translation: O brahmins, one shall scrupulously eschew the clothes worn by others.
verses.hindi: हे क्रषियो! इसके बाद मैं ओंकारकी प्राप्तिका लक्षण बताऊँगा। इसे तीन मात्रावाला जानना चाहिए  इसमें व्यंजनसहित मकार ईश्वर (शिव) है। इसमें पहली मात्रा विद्युती (राजसी) एवं दूसरी मात्रा तामसी कही गयी है तीसरी मकाररूप अक्षरगामिनी मात्राको सत्त्वगुणरूपवाली जानना चाहिए । इसे गान्धारी नामसे भी जानना चाहिए; क्योंकि यह गान्धारस्वरसे उत्पन्न है और पिपीलिकाकी गतिके स्पर्शके समान सूक्ष्म गतिवाली है तथा यह
verses.wordMeaning: O brahmins, one shall scrupulously eschew the clothes worn by others.
verses.commentary: Sense: O brahmins, one shall scrupulously eschew the clothes worn by others.

verses.sanskrit: पातकी च तदर्धेन शुध्यते वृत्तवान्यदि उपपातकिनः सर्वे तदर्धेनैव सुव्रताः
verses.transliteration: pātakī ca tadardhena śudhyate vṛttavānyadi upapātakinaḥ sarve tadardhenaiva suvratāḥ
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, the pots of gold and silver can be purified by water. The cleansing of jewels, rock, conch and pearls is similar to that of metals.
verses.hindi: मूर्धादेशमें लक्षित होती है। जिस प्रकार उच्चारित किया गया ओंकार मूर्धा देशमें गमन करता है, वैसे ही ओंकारमय योगी ब्रह्ममें लीन होकर ब्रह्मसायुज्य प्राप्त कर लेता है। परमेश्वरका वाचक प्रणव ही धनुष है, यह जीवात्मा ही
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent brahmins, the pots of gold and silver can be purified by water. The cleansing of jewels, rock, conch and pearls is similar to that of metals.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent brahmins, the pots of gold and silver can be purified by water. The cleansing of jewels, rock, conch and pearls is similar to that of metals.

verses.sanskrit: संध्यालोपे कृते विप्रः त्रिरावृत्त्यैव शुध्यति आह्निकच्छेदने जाते शतमेकमुदाहृतम्
verses.transliteration: saṃdhyālope kṛte vipraḥ trirāvṛttyaiva śudhyati āhnikacchedane jāte śatamekamudāhṛtam
verses.translation: The purity of excessively polluted things is through contact with fire and water. The cleansing of all beverages is called Utplavana.
verses.hindi: बाण है और परब्रह्म परमेश्वर ही उसके लक्ष्य हैं। तत्परतासे उनकी उपासना करनेवाले प्रमादरहित साधकके द्वारा ही वह लक्ष्य वेधा जा सकता है, इसलिये उस लक्ष्यको वेधकर बाणकी ही भाँति उसमें तन्मय हो जाना चाहिए॥ ४५-४९ १ ॥
verses.wordMeaning: The purity of excessively polluted things is through contact with fire and water. The cleansing of all beverages is called Utplavana.
verses.commentary: Sense: The purity of excessively polluted things is through contact with fire and water. The cleansing of all beverages is called Utplavana.

verses.sanskrit: लङ्घने समयानां तु अभक्ष्यस्य च भक्षणे अवाच्यवाचने चैव सहस्राच्छुद्धिरुच्यते
verses.transliteration: laṅghane samayānāṃ tu abhakṣyasya ca bhakṣaṇe avācyavācane caiva sahasrācchuddhirucyate
verses.translation: Objects made of grass, wood, etc., are purified by sprinkling them with sacred water. The purity of Sruk and Sruva (the sacrificial plate and ladle j is through hot w.iter.
verses.hindi: ओम् -यह एकाक्षर पद गुहा (बुद्धि)-में निहित है। यह 'ओम्' तीनों लोकों, ऋक्-यजुः-साम तीती वेदों, तीनों अग्नियों तथा विष्णुके तीनों पदोंके स्वरूपवाला
verses.wordMeaning: Objects made of grass, wood, etc., are purified by sprinkling them with sacred water. The purity of Sruk and Sruva (the sacrificial plate and ladle j is through hot w.iter.
verses.commentary: Sense: Objects made of grass, wood, etc., are purified by sprinkling them with sacred water. The purity of Sruk and Sruva (the sacrificial plate and ladle j is through hot w.iter.

verses.sanskrit: काकोलूककपोतानां पक्षिणामपि घातने शतमष्टोत्तरं जप्त्वा मुच्यते नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: kākolūkakapotānāṃ pakṣiṇāmapi ghātane śatamaṣṭottaraṃ japtvā mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: The cleansing of the uter* ds of yajnas, that of the mortar and pestle and the purification of those made of horn, bone, wood and ivory is by means of poring.
verses.hindi: आसननमृत्युसूचक लक्षण एवं योगसाधनामें प्रणवका माहात्म्य कक ककऊफक्फफफफफफअककककफकक फफफ फफफ आ हलिफककफफकककफफकफफझभझफकफझफफफकफफफफफफफफफफफफफफफफफफ फा फा पापी फा फापाफफ
verses.wordMeaning: The cleansing of the uter* ds of yajnas, that of the mortar and pestle and the purification of those made of horn, bone, wood and ivory is by means of poring.
verses.commentary: Sense: The cleansing of the uter* ds of yajnas, that of the mortar and pestle and the purification of those made of horn, bone, wood and ivory is by means of poring.

verses.sanskrit: यः पुनस्तत्त्ववेत्ता च ब्रह्मविद् ब्राह्मणोत्तमः स्मरणाच्छुद्धिमाप्नोति नात्र कार्या विचारणा
verses.transliteration: yaḥ punastattvavettā ca brahmavid brāhmaṇottamaḥ smaraṇācchuddhimāpnoti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā
verses.translation: O highly blessed ones, sprinkling is the means of puri- fication of compact solid bodies; if the things arc disjointed
verses.hindi: तत्प्रयुक्तस्तु यो योगी तस्य सालोक्यमाप्नुयात्
verses.wordMeaning: O highly blessed ones, sprinkling is the means of puri- fication of compact solid bodies; if the things arc disjointed
verses.commentary: Sense: O highly blessed ones, sprinkling is the means of puri- fication of compact solid bodies; if the things arc disjointed

verses.sanskrit: नैवमात्मविदामस्ति प्रायश्चित्तानि चोदना विश्वस्यैव हि ते शुद्धा ब्रह्मविद्याविदो जनाः
verses.transliteration: naivamātmavidāmasti prāyaścittāni codanā viśvasyaiva hi te śuddhā brahmavidyāvido janāḥ
verses.translation: If a portion of a heap of grains not eaten, is defiled that portion is removed and the remaining part is sprinkled with Kusa grass-water.
verses.hindi: अकारो ह्यक्षरो ज्ञेय उकारः सहितः स्मृतः। म्रकारसहितोङ्कारस्त्रिमात्र इति संज्ञितः अकारस्त्वेष भूर्लोक उकारो भुव उच्यते। सव्यञ्जनो मकारस्तु स्वलोक इति गीयते
verses.wordMeaning: If a portion of a heap of grains not eaten, is defiled that portion is removed and the remaining part is sprinkled with Kusa grass-water.
verses.commentary: Sense: If a portion of a heap of grains not eaten, is defiled that portion is removed and the remaining part is sprinkled with Kusa grass-water.

verses.sanskrit: योगध्यानैकनिष्ठाश् च निर्लेपाः काञ्चनं यथा शुद्धानां शोधनं नास्ति विशुद्धा ब्रह्मविद्यया
verses.transliteration: yogadhyānaikaniṣṭhāś ca nirlepāḥ kāñcanaṃ yathā śuddhānāṃ śodhanaṃ nāsti viśuddhā brahmavidyayā
verses.translation: It is desirable that vegetables, roots and fruits are purified like grains. The house is purified by sweeping and scrubbing. A mud-pot is purified by heating it over fire.
verses.hindi: ओड्कारस्तु त्रयो लोकाः शिरस्तस्य त्रिविष्टपम्। भुवनाङ्गं च तत्सर्वं ब्राह्म तत्पदमुच्यते
verses.wordMeaning: It is desirable that vegetables, roots and fruits are purified like grains. The house is purified by sweeping and scrubbing. A mud-pot is purified by heating it over fire.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is desirable that vegetables, roots and fruits are purified like grains. The house is purified by sweeping and scrubbing. A mud-pot is purified by heating it over fire.

verses.sanskrit: उद्धृतानुष्णफेनाभिः पूताभिर् वस्त्रचक्षुषा अद्भिः समाचरेत्सर्वं वर्जयेत्कलुषोदकम्
verses.transliteration: uddhṛtānuṣṇaphenābhiḥ pūtābhir vastracakṣuṣā adbhiḥ samācaretsarvaṃ varjayetkaluṣodakam
verses.translation: The floor can be cleansed by scraping, digging, bed- aubing, sweeping, sprinkling and by tethering cows over it.
verses.hindi: मात्रापादो रुद्रलोको ह्यमात्रं तु शिवं पदम्। एवं ज्ञानविशेषेण तत्पदं समुपास्यते यावदेव तु शक्यन्ते धार्यन्ते तावदेव हि
verses.wordMeaning: The floor can be cleansed by scraping, digging, bed- aubing, sweeping, sprinkling and by tethering cows over it.
verses.commentary: Sense: The floor can be cleansed by scraping, digging, bed- aubing, sweeping, sprinkling and by tethering cows over it.

verses.sanskrit: गन्धवर्णरसैर्दुष्टम् अशुचिस्थानसंस्थितम् पङ्काश्मदूषितं चैव सामुद्रं पल्वलोदकम्
verses.transliteration: gandhavarṇarasairduṣṭam aśucisthānasaṃsthitam paṅkāśmadūṣitaṃ caiva sāmudraṃ palvalodakam
verses.translation: The water stagnating over the surface of lands becomes pure if a cow drinks from there and quenches its thirst, but filth should not spread over it along with foul smell, taste and colour.
verses.hindi: मासे मासेऽश्वमेधेन यो यजेत शतं समाः। तेन यत्प्राप्यते पुण्यं मात्रया तदवाप्नुयात्
verses.wordMeaning: The water stagnating over the surface of lands becomes pure if a cow drinks from there and quenches its thirst, but filth should not spread over it along with foul smell, taste and colour.
verses.commentary: Sense: The water stagnating over the surface of lands becomes pure if a cow drinks from there and quenches its thirst, but filth should not spread over it along with foul smell, taste and colour.

verses.sanskrit: सशैवालं तथान्यैर्वा दोषैर्दुष्टं विवर्जयेत् वस्त्रशौचान्वितः कुर्यात् सर्वकार्याणि वै द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: saśaivālaṃ tathānyairvā doṣairduṣṭaṃ vivarjayet vastraśaucānvitaḥ kuryāt sarvakāryāṇi vai dvijāḥ
verses.translation: The excellent knower of Dharmas shall sprinkle with KuSa grass water, the cloth manually washed by a washerman duly, and then take it for use.
verses.hindi: एषा एव भवेत्कार्या गृहस्थानां तु योगिनाम् है; वस्तुतः अर्धमात्रासहित इसकी तीन मात्राएँ जाननी चाहिए। जो योगी इस प्रणवसे प्रेरित होता है, वह ब्रह्मका सायुज्य प्राप्त कर लेता है
verses.wordMeaning: The excellent knower of Dharmas shall sprinkle with KuSa grass water, the cloth manually washed by a washerman duly, and then take it for use.
verses.commentary: Sense: The excellent knower of Dharmas shall sprinkle with KuSa grass water, the cloth manually washed by a washerman duly, and then take it for use.

verses.sanskrit: नमस्कारादिकं सर्वं गुरुशुश्रूषणादिकम् वस्त्रशौचविहीनात्मा ह्य् अशुचिर्नात्र संशयः
verses.transliteration: namaskārādikaṃ sarvaṃ guruśuśrūṣaṇādikam vastraśaucavihīnātmā hy aśucirnātra saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: Merchandise spread in accordance with the division of castes and stages of life is pure. Things taken out of mines are naturally pure. A hound is pifre when it catches lujld of a deer.
verses.hindi: अकारको अक्षर जानना चाहिए; इसके साथ उकारका संयोग कहा गया है । पुन: मकार (अनुस्वार) - के योगसे बना हुआ ओंकार तीन मात्रावाला कहा गया है। अकारको भूलोक तथा उकारको भुवर्लोक कहा
verses.wordMeaning: Merchandise spread in accordance with the division of castes and stages of life is pure. Things taken out of mines are naturally pure. A hound is pifre when it catches lujld of a deer.
verses.commentary: Sense: Merchandise spread in accordance with the division of castes and stages of life is pure. Things taken out of mines are naturally pure. A hound is pifre when it catches lujld of a deer.

verses.sanskrit: देवकार्योपयुक्तानां प्रत्यहं शौचमिष्यते इतरेषां हि वस्त्राणां शौचं कार्यं मलागमे
verses.transliteration: devakāryopayuktānāṃ pratyahaṃ śaucamiṣyate itareṣāṃ hi vastrāṇāṃ śaucaṃ kāryaṃ malāgame
verses.translation: All these are pure even when they come into contact with the body, viz. — shadow, drops of water, brahmins, flies etc., dust, ground, wind and fire, O excellent brahmins.
verses.hindi: जाता है। व्यंजनसहित मकारको स्वर्लोक कहा जाता है। ओंकार त्रिलोकस्वरूप है, उसका सिर स्वर्ग है, सभी भुवन अंग हैं। ब्रह्मलोकको उसका पाद कहा जाता है। रुद्रलोक मात्रापादरूप है। शिवपद मात्रासे अतीत है-- इस ज्ञानविशेषके द्वारा उस तुरीय पदकी उपासना की जाती है। इसलिये सदा ध्यानपरायणता होनी चाहिए। शाश्‍वत (स्थिर) सुख चाहनेवालेको उस मात्रातीत अक्षर शिवतत्त्व-की प्रयत्नपूर्वक उपासना करनी
verses.wordMeaning: All these are pure even when they come into contact with the body, viz. — shadow, drops of water, brahmins, flies etc., dust, ground, wind and fire, O excellent brahmins.
verses.commentary: Sense: All these are pure even when they come into contact with the body, viz. — shadow, drops of water, brahmins, flies etc., dust, ground, wind and fire, O excellent brahmins.

verses.sanskrit: वर्जयेत्सर्वयत्नेन वासो ऽन्यैर् विधृतं द्विजाः कौशेयाविकयो रूक्षैः क्षौमाणां गौरसर्षपैः
verses.transliteration: varjayetsarvayatnena vāso 'nyair vidhṛtaṃ dvijāḥ kauśeyāvikayo rūkṣaiḥ kṣaumāṇāṃ gaurasarṣapaiḥ
verses.translation: O brahmins, even when one is pure, one shall perform the acamana rite after sleeping, taking food, sneezing, drinking and spitting. At the beginning of the study of the Vedas and on similar occasions one shall perform the acamana rite.
verses.hindi: की पहली मात्रा हस्व है और दूसरी मात्रा दीर्घ है। तीसरी मात्रा प्लुत कही जाती है। इन मात्राओको क्रमशः यथावत् जानना चाहिए। जितना अपना सामर्थ्य हो सके, उतना मनीषी लोग इन्हें धारण
verses.wordMeaning: O brahmins, even when one is pure, one shall perform the acamana rite after sleeping, taking food, sneezing, drinking and spitting. At the beginning of the study of the Vedas and on similar occasions one shall perform the acamana rite.
verses.commentary: Sense: O brahmins, even when one is pure, one shall perform the acamana rite after sleeping, taking food, sneezing, drinking and spitting. At the beginning of the study of the Vedas and on similar occasions one shall perform the acamana rite.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीफलैरंशुपट्टानां कुतपानामरिष्टकैः चर्मणां विदलानां च वेत्राणां वस्त्रवन्मतम्
verses.transliteration: śrīphalairaṃśupaṭṭānāṃ kutapānāmariṣṭakaiḥ carmaṇāṃ vidalānāṃ ca vetrāṇāṃ vastravanmatam
verses.translation: If the drops of water fall on the feet while others per- form the acamana rite they shall be known as earthly things. One shall not become impure thereby.
verses.hindi: कर सकते हैं। इन्द्रियों, मन तथा बुद्धिको नियन्त्रित करके यदि जो कोई आत्मामें सदा अर्धमात्राका ध्यान करता है, तो वह जिस फलको प्राप्त करता है, उसे सुनिये। जो सौ वर्षपर्यन्त प्रत्येक मासमें अश्वमेध यज्ञ करता है, वह उसके द्वारा जो पुण्य पाता है, उसे इस मात्रासे प्राप्त कर लेता है। जो फल न तो कठोर तपस्यासे और न तो विपुल दक्षिणावाले यज्ञोसे प्राप्त किया जा सकता है, बह फल इस मात्राके द्वारा सम्यक्
verses.wordMeaning: If the drops of water fall on the feet while others per- form the acamana rite they shall be known as earthly things. One shall not become impure thereby.
verses.commentary: Sense: If the drops of water fall on the feet while others per- form the acamana rite they shall be known as earthly things. One shall not become impure thereby.

verses.sanskrit: वल्कलानां तु सर्वेषां छत्रचामरयोरपि चैलवच्छौचमाख्यातं ब्रह्मविद्भिर् मुनीश्वरैः
verses.transliteration: valkalānāṃ tu sarveṣāṃ chatracāmarayorapi cailavacchaucamākhyātaṃ brahmavidbhir munīśvaraiḥ
verses.translation: After sexual intercourse and after touching a fallen man, cocks, pig, crows, dog, camel, donkey, post, can(ala and others, one becomes pure, just by a bath. One shall not touch a woman in her monthly course, a woman after delivery and a i§udra woman.
verses.hindi: प्राप्त हो जाता है
verses.wordMeaning: After sexual intercourse and after touching a fallen man, cocks, pig, crows, dog, camel, donkey, post, can(ala and others, one becomes pure, just by a bath. One shall not touch a woman in her monthly course, a woman after delivery and a i§udra woman.
verses.commentary: Sense: After sexual intercourse and after touching a fallen man, cocks, pig, crows, dog, camel, donkey, post, can(ala and others, one becomes pure, just by a bath. One shall not touch a woman in her monthly course, a woman after delivery and a i§udra woman.

verses.sanskrit: भस्मना शुध्यते कांस्यं क्षारेणायसम् उच्यते ताम्रमम्लेन वै विप्रास् त्रपुसीसकयोरपि
verses.transliteration: bhasmanā śudhyate kāṃsyaṃ kṣāreṇāyasam ucyate tāmramamlena vai viprās trapusīsakayorapi
verses.translation: One defiled by pollution after birth or death shall not touch their dust. If he touches he shall be pure by taking bath.
verses.hindi: उस प्रणवमें जो यह प्लुत नामक मात्रा बतायी गयी है, गृहस्थ योगियोंको उसका अभ्यास करना चाहिए। विशेषरूपसे आठ लक्षणोंवाले अणिमा आदि ऐश्वर्या (सिद्धियों)-के लिये इस मात्राको जानना चाहिए; अतः है द्विजो! उस मात्राकी साधना करनी चाहिए
verses.wordMeaning: One defiled by pollution after birth or death shall not touch their dust. If he touches he shall be pure by taking bath.
verses.commentary: Sense: One defiled by pollution after birth or death shall not touch their dust. If he touches he shall be pure by taking bath.

verses.sanskrit: हैमम् अद्भिः शुभं पात्रं रौप्यपात्रं द्विजोत्तमाः मण्यश्मशङ्खमुक्तानां शौचं तैजसवत्स्मृतम्
verses.transliteration: haimam adbhiḥ śubhaṃ pātraṃ raupyapātraṃ dvijottamāḥ maṇyaśmaśaṅkhamuktānāṃ śaucaṃ taijasavatsmṛtam
verses.translation: O Sages of good holy rites, the following persons are not defiled by pollution — ascetics, forest-dwellers, religious students, life-long celibates, kings and rulers of provinces.
verses.hindi: सर्वदेवमयो भूत्वा अभूतः स तु जायते। योनिसङ्क्रमणं त्यक्त्वा याति वै शाश्वतं पदम्
verses.wordMeaning: O Sages of good holy rites, the following persons are not defiled by pollution — ascetics, forest-dwellers, religious students, life-long celibates, kings and rulers of provinces.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Sages of good holy rites, the following persons are not defiled by pollution — ascetics, forest-dwellers, religious students, life-long celibates, kings and rulers of provinces.

verses.sanskrit: अग्नेर् अपां च संयोगाद् अत्यन्तोपहतस्य च रसानामिह सर्वेषां शुद्धिरुत्प्लवनं स्मृतम्
verses.transliteration: agner apāṃ ca saṃyogād atyantopahatasya ca rasānāmiha sarveṣāṃ śuddhirutplavanaṃ smṛtam
verses.translation: Only when there are impediments in their tasks, do kings, sages and brahmins who have fallen become impure and not otherwise.
verses.hindi: नमस्कारेण रुद्रस्य तथा पापं प्रणश्यति यत्र रुद्रनमस्कारः सर्वकर्मफलो ध्षुवः। अन्यदेवनमस्कारान्न तत्फलमवाप्नुयात्
verses.wordMeaning: Only when there are impediments in their tasks, do kings, sages and brahmins who have fallen become impure and not otherwise.
verses.commentary: Sense: Only when there are impediments in their tasks, do kings, sages and brahmins who have fallen become impure and not otherwise.

verses.sanskrit: तृणकाष्ठादिवस्तूनां शुभेनाभ्युक्षणं स्मृतम् उष्णेन वारिणा शुद्धिस् तथा स्रुक्स्रुवयोरपि
verses.transliteration: tṛṇakāṣṭhādivastūnāṃ śubhenābhyukṣaṇaṃ smṛtam uṣṇena vāriṇā śuddhis tathā sruksruvayorapi
verses.translation: The Asauca of the brahmins is upto the collection of bones after cremation and they are purified merely b\ taking bath. Similarly for those who are initiated in the sacrifice. It has mentioned by the sell-born deity that for those who
verses.hindi: दशविस्तारकं ब्रह्म तथा च ब्रह्माविस्तरैः
verses.wordMeaning: The Asauca of the brahmins is upto the collection of bones after cremation and they are purified merely b\ taking bath. Similarly for those who are initiated in the sacrifice. It has mentioned by the sell-born deity that for those who
verses.commentary: Sense: The Asauca of the brahmins is upto the collection of bones after cremation and they are purified merely b\ taking bath. Similarly for those who are initiated in the sacrifice. It has mentioned by the sell-born deity that for those who

verses.sanskrit: तथैव यज्ञपात्राणां मुशलोलूखलस्य च शृङ्गास्थिदारुदन्तानां तक्षणेनैव शोधनम्
verses.transliteration: tathaiva yajñapātrāṇāṃ muśalolūkhalasya ca śṛṅgāsthidārudantānāṃ takṣaṇenaiva śodhanam
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, kinsmen do not have pollution due to birth or death beyond three days (if they hear of the birth or death) after the eleventh day.
verses.hindi: स याति शिवसायुज्यं समुदधृत्य कुलत्रयम् अथवारिष्टमालोक्य मरणे समुपस्थिते। अविमुक्तेश्वरं गत्वा वाराणस्यां तु शोधनम्
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent brahmins, kinsmen do not have pollution due to birth or death beyond three days (if they hear of the birth or death) after the eleventh day.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent brahmins, kinsmen do not have pollution due to birth or death beyond three days (if they hear of the birth or death) after the eleventh day.

verses.sanskrit: संहतानां महाभागा द्रव्याणां प्रोक्षणं स्मृतम् असंहतानां द्रव्याणां प्रत्येकं शौचमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: saṃhatānāṃ mahābhāgā dravyāṇāṃ prokṣaṇaṃ smṛtam asaṃhatānāṃ dravyāṇāṃ pratyekaṃ śaucamucyate
verses.translation: If one is present at the time of death one is purified merely by taking bath. If the fact of death is known after three seasons (i.c. six months)**-** the pollution: r one day.
verses.hindi: येन केनापि वा देहं सन्त्यजेन्मुच्यते नर: । श्रीपर्वते वा विप्रेन्द्रा: सन्त्यजेत्स्वतनुं नर:
verses.wordMeaning: If one is present at the time of death one is purified merely by taking bath. If the fact of death is known after three seasons (i.c. six months)**-** the pollution: r one day.
verses.commentary: Sense: If one is present at the time of death one is purified merely by taking bath. If the fact of death is known after three seasons (i.c. six months)**-** the pollution: r one day.

verses.sanskrit: अभुक्तराशिधान्यानाम् एकदेशस्य दूषणे तावन्मात्रं समुद्धृत्य प्रोक्षयेद्वै कुशांभसा
verses.transliteration: abhuktarāśidhānyānām ekadeśasya dūṣaṇe tāvanmātraṃ samuddhṛtya prokṣayedvai kuśāṃbhasā
verses.translation: If the fact of death is known before sc' en years**'® the pollution is for three days and beyond that for the brah- mins, it is for ten days. The pollution due to oirth is for the first day in the case of the father. O sages, in the case of the mother it is for ten days. If the fact is known after three years,***® the purity is attained by bath by the father as well as by kinsmen.
verses.hindi: स याति शिवसायुज्यं नात्र कार्या विचारणा। अविमुक्तं परं क्षेत्रं जन्तूनां मुक्तिदं सदा सेवेत सततं धीमान् विशेषान्मरणान्तिके
verses.wordMeaning: If the fact of death is known before sc' en years**'® the pollution is for three days and beyond that for the brah- mins, it is for ten days. The pollution due to oirth is for the first day in the case of the father. O sages, in the case of the mother it is for ten days.…
verses.commentary: Sense: If the fact of death is known before sc' en years**'® the pollution is for three days and beyond that for the brah- mins, it is for ten days. The pollution due to oirth is for the first day in the case of the father. O sages, in the case of the mother it is for ten days.…

verses.sanskrit: शाकमूलफलादीनां धान्यवच्छुद्धिरिष्यते मार्जनोन्मार्जनैर् वेश्म पुनःपाकेन मृन्मयम्
verses.transliteration: śākamūlaphalādīnāṃ dhānyavacchuddhiriṣyate mārjanonmārjanair veśma punaḥpākena mṛnmayam
verses.translation: If the fact is known after eight years® the kinsmen become pure within a day. O sages of good hoiy rites, if the fact
verses.hindi: अफर क़ फफक फ फ फ़ फ़ फ फफ फफफ फ काका फ क फफ कका का फी की जी मी मी मी फी मी की की फम य वीची
verses.wordMeaning: If the fact is known after eight years® the kinsmen become pure within a day. O sages of good hoiy rites, if the fact
verses.commentary: Sense: If the fact is known after eight years® the kinsmen become pure within a day. O sages of good hoiy rites, if the fact

verses.sanskrit: उल्लेखनेनाञ्जनेन तथा संमार्जनेन च गोनिवासेन वै शुद्धा सेचनेन धरा स्मृता
verses.transliteration: ullekhanenāñjanena tathā saṃmārjanena ca gonivāsena vai śuddhā secanena dharā smṛtā
verses.translation: arvak sapta-varsat — if the deceased is not seven yean old. Editor.
verses.hindi: हे द्विजो! इस प्रकार योगसम्पन्न, विशुद्ध, मा नियन्त्रण करनेवाला तथा जितेन्द्रिय जो व्यक्ति आत्माको जान लेता है, वह सब कुछ प्राप्त कर लेता है। अत. बुद्धिमानूको पाशुपत योगोंके द्वारा आत्मचिन्तन ७३... चाहिए। जो आत्माको जान लेते हैं, वे शुद्ध हैं, र्ष
verses.wordMeaning: arvak sapta-varsat — if the deceased is not seven yean old. Editor.
verses.commentary: Sense: arvak sapta-varsat — if the deceased is not seven yean old. Editor.

verses.sanskrit: भूमिस्थम् उदकं शुद्धं वैतृष्ण्यं यत्र गौर्व्रजेत् अव्याप्तं यदमेध्येन गन्धवर्णरसान्वितम्
verses.transliteration: bhūmistham udakaṃ śuddhaṃ vaitṛṣṇyaṃ yatra gaurvrajet avyāptaṃ yadamedhyena gandhavarṇarasānvitam
verses.translation: arvak sapta-varsat -if the deceased is not seven years old. Editor.
verses.hindi: अध्यात्मका चिन्तन करनेवाला ब्राह्मण योगज्ञानके द्वारा ऋकु-यजु:-सामकी ऋचाओं, सभी वेदों तथा उपनिषदोंका ज्ञान प्राप्त कर लेता है। वह सर्वदेवमय होकर लिङ्गशरीरसे शून्य हो जाता है और पुनर्जन्मका
verses.wordMeaning: arvak sapta-varsat -if the deceased is not seven years old. Editor.
verses.commentary: Sense: arvak sapta-varsat -if the deceased is not seven years old. Editor.

verses.sanskrit: वत्सः शुचिः प्रस्रवणे शकुनिः फलपातने स्वदारास्यं गृहस्थानां रतौ भार्याभिकाङ्क्षया
verses.transliteration: vatsaḥ śuciḥ prasravaṇe śakuniḥ phalapātane svadārāsyaṃ gṛhasthānāṃ ratau bhāryābhikāṅkṣayā
verses.translation: asfabdat' if the deceased is not eight years old. Editor.
verses.hindi: त्याग करके शाश्वत पद (शिवपद)-को प्राप्त करता है जिस प्रकार पका हुआ फल वायुद्वारा हिलाये जानेपर
verses.wordMeaning: asfabdat' if the deceased is not eight years old. Editor.
verses.commentary: Sense: asfabdat' if the deceased is not eight years old. Editor.

verses.sanskrit: हस्ताभ्यां क्षालितं वस्त्रं कारुणा च यथाविधि कुशांबुना सुसंप्रोक्ष्य गृह्णीयाद्धर्मवित्तमः
verses.transliteration: hastābhyāṃ kṣālitaṃ vastraṃ kāruṇā ca yathāvidhi kuśāṃbunā susaṃprokṣya gṛhṇīyāddharmavittamaḥ
verses.translation: Sapindata (the state of being kinsman by way of offering the funeral rice balls) recedes in the seventh genera- tion. If the ten days immediately after death have elapsed, one shall be impure for three days.
verses.hindi: वृक्षसे गिर पड़ता है, उसी प्रकार भगवान् सदाशिवके
verses.wordMeaning: Sapindata (the state of being kinsman by way of offering the funeral rice balls) recedes in the seventh genera- tion. If the ten days immediately after death have elapsed, one shall be impure for three days.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sapindata (the state of being kinsman by way of offering the funeral rice balls) recedes in the seventh genera- tion. If the ten days immediately after death have elapsed, one shall be impure for three days.

verses.sanskrit: पण्यं प्रसारितं चैव वर्णाश्रमविभागशः शुचिराकरजं तेषां श्वा मृगग्रहणे शुचिः
verses.transliteration: paṇyaṃ prasāritaṃ caiva varṇāśramavibhāgaśaḥ śucirākarajaṃ teṣāṃ śvā mṛgagrahaṇe śuciḥ
verses.translation: The brahmin beyond that period or after a year has elai)sed, becomes pure merely by taking bath.
verses.hindi: नमस्कारसे पाप नष्ट हो जाता है । रुद्रनमस्कार निश्चितरूपसे सभी कर्मोका फल देनेवाला है; अन्य देवताओंको नमस्कार करनेसे उनका फल प्राप्त नहीं होता है, अत: मन, वचन, कर्म--इन तीनोंसे विनम्र होकर योगीको महेश्वर तथा दसों इन्द्रियोंका विस्तार करनेवाले ब्रह्मकी उपासना दसों
verses.wordMeaning: The brahmin beyond that period or after a year has elai)sed, becomes pure merely by taking bath.
verses.commentary: Sense: The brahmin beyond that period or after a year has elai)sed, becomes pure merely by taking bath.

verses.sanskrit: छाया च विप्लुषो विप्रा मक्षिकाद्या द्विजोत्तमाः रजो भूर् वायुर् अग्निश् च मेध्यानि स्पर्शने सदा
verses.transliteration: chāyā ca vipluṣo viprā makṣikādyā dvijottamāḥ rajo bhūr vāyur agniś ca medhyāni sparśane sadā
verses.translation: If one touches a dead body, one becomes pure after three days. It is for the sake of Dharma that ablution is enjoin- ed in regard to the persons who cremate the dead body. If he is not a relative he need take bath alone.
verses.hindi: इन्द्रियोंसे करनी चाहिए ॥ ६९--७१॥
verses.wordMeaning: If one touches a dead body, one becomes pure after three days. It is for the sake of Dharma that ablution is enjoin- ed in regard to the persons who cremate the dead body. If he is not a relative he need take bath alone.
verses.commentary: Sense: If one touches a dead body, one becomes pure after three days. It is for the sake of Dharma that ablution is enjoin- ed in regard to the persons who cremate the dead body. If he is not a relative he need take bath alone.

verses.sanskrit: सुप्त्वा भुक्त्वा च वै विप्राः क्षुत्त्वा पीत्वा च वै तथा ष्ठीवित्वाध्ययनादौ च शुचिरप्याचमेत्पुनः
verses.transliteration: suptvā bhuktvā ca vai viprāḥ kṣuttvā pītvā ca vai tathā ṣṭhīvitvādhyayanādau ca śucirapyācametpunaḥ
verses.translation: If one follows the dead body, one becomes pure by taking \ 3 ath and drinking ghee. When the preceptor dies, or when a vcdic-scholar passes away, pollution remains for three days.*
verses.hindi: इस प्रकार ध्यानमग्न होकर जो अपने शरीरका त्याग  करता है, वह तीनों कुलोंका उद्धार करके शिवसायुज्य प्राप्त करता है । अथवा योगोपासनामें असमर्थ होनेपर कुछ अरिष्ट देखनेपर और मृत्यु आसन्न होनेपर वाराणसीमें अविमुक्तेश्‍वरमें जाकर शुद्धि (प्रायश्चित्त) करनी चाहिए;
verses.wordMeaning: If one follows the dead body, one becomes pure by taking \ 3 ath and drinking ghee. When the preceptor dies, or when a vcdic-scholar passes away, pollution remains for three days.*
verses.commentary: Sense: If one follows the dead body, one becomes pure by taking \ 3 ath and drinking ghee. When the preceptor dies, or when a vcdic-scholar passes away, pollution remains for three days.*

verses.sanskrit: पादौ स्पृशन्ति ये चापि पराचमनबिन्दवः ते पार्थिवैः समा ज्ञेया न तैरप्रयतो भवेत्
verses.transliteration: pādau spṛśanti ye cāpi parācamanabindavaḥ te pārthivaiḥ samā jñeyā na tairaprayato bhavet
verses.translation: O brahmins, if maternal uncles and their wives ct brothers die, if kings and rulers die, the people become pure immediately. O excellent brahmins, the pollution of the Ksa- triyas is for twelve days. A crowned king need not observe pollution if his kinsmen die J.i battle. A \'aisya becomes pure in fifteen days. A Sudra becomes pure within a month.
verses.hindi: जिस-किसी तरह वहाँ देहत्याग कर देना चाहिए; इससे  वह मनुष्य मुक्त हो जाता है। है विप्रेन्धो! जो मनुष्य  श्रीपर्वतपर अपने शरीरको छोड़ता है, वह शिवसायुज्य  प्राप्त करता है; इसमें सन्देह नहीं करना चाहिए । बुद्धिम,
verses.wordMeaning: O brahmins, if maternal uncles and their wives ct brothers die, if kings and rulers die, the people become pure immediately. O excellent brahmins, the pollution of the Ksa- triyas is for twelve days. A crowned king need not observe pollution if his kinsmen die J.i battle.…
verses.commentary: Sense: O brahmins, if maternal uncles and their wives ct brothers die, if kings and rulers die, the people become pure immediately. O excellent brahmins, the pollution of the Ksa- triyas is for twelve days. A crowned king need not observe pollution if his kinsmen die J.i battle.…

verses.sanskrit: कृत्वा च मैथुनं स्पृष्ट्वा पतितं कुक्कुटादिकम् सूकरं चैव काकादि श्वानमुष्ट्रं खरं तथा
verses.transliteration: kṛtvā ca maithunaṃ spṛṣṭvā patitaṃ kukkuṭādikam sūkaraṃ caiva kākādi śvānamuṣṭraṃ kharaṃ tathā
verses.translation: Ascetics do not have to observe pollution accruing from birth or death.
verses.hindi: व्यक्ति-को प्राणियोंको सदा मुक्ति देनेवाले उत्तम अविमुक्तक्षेत्र (काशी) -में विशेषरूपसे मरणकालमें वास करना चाहिए॥ ७२--७६॥ अविमुक्तक्षेत्र वाराणसीका माहात्म्य तथा श्रीविश्वेश्वरपूजाविधिवर्णन
verses.wordMeaning: Ascetics do not have to observe pollution accruing from birth or death.
verses.commentary: Sense: Ascetics do not have to observe pollution accruing from birth or death.

verses.sanskrit: यूपं चाण्डालकाद्यांश् च स्पृष्ट्वा स्नानेन शुध्यति रजस्वलां सूतिकां च न स्पृशेदन्त्यजामपि
verses.transliteration: yūpaṃ cāṇḍālakādyāṃś ca spṛṣṭvā snānena śudhyati rajasvalāṃ sūtikāṃ ca na spṛśedantyajāmapi
verses.translation: Due to the nature ot the yaga, in the Krta age, ladies gave birth but once, 'flic blessed ones repaired to the forests along with their wives like the Kurus.
verses.hindi: 011. केक फक ठकमिकिकककककफझझफझफफफफफझफफफझफफफफफफफफफफफफफफ फक फफ फक पाक फाफफफाफफाफफ
verses.wordMeaning: Due to the nature ot the yaga, in the Krta age, ladies gave birth but once, 'flic blessed ones repaired to the forests along with their wives like the Kurus.
verses.commentary: Sense: Due to the nature ot the yaga, in the Krta age, ladies gave birth but once, 'flic blessed ones repaired to the forests along with their wives like the Kurus.

verses.sanskrit: सूतिकाशौचसंयुक्तः शावाशौचसमन्वितः संस्पृशेन्न रजस्तासां स्पृष्ट्वा स्नात्वैव शुध्यति
verses.transliteration: sūtikāśaucasaṃyuktaḥ śāvāśaucasamanvitaḥ saṃspṛśenna rajastāsāṃ spṛṣṭvā snātvaiva śudhyati
verses.translation: O sages ol good holy riles, the arrangement regarding the castes and stages of life began ever since the Tieta yuga.
verses.hindi: अविमुक्तक्षेत्र वाराणसीका माहात्म्य तथा श्रीविश्वेश्वरपूजाविधिवर्णन अविमुक्तस्य माहात्म्यं यथाह भगवान् भवः॥
verses.wordMeaning: O sages ol good holy riles, the arrangement regarding the castes and stages of life began ever since the Tieta yuga.
verses.commentary: Sense: O sages ol good holy riles, the arrangement regarding the castes and stages of life began ever since the Tieta yuga.

verses.sanskrit: नैवाशौचं यतीनां च वनस्थब्रह्मचारिणाम् नैष्ठिकानां नृपाणां च मण्डलीनां च सुव्रताः
verses.transliteration: naivāśaucaṃ yatīnāṃ ca vanasthabrahmacāriṇām naiṣṭhikānāṃ nṛpāṇāṃ ca maṇḍalīnāṃ ca suvratāḥ
verses.translation: Dharma is observed in the following continents and sub-coiitinentSj viz. Mahavita,®** Suvita,®® Jambudvipa®®® and its eight other sub-continen, and Sakadvipa,®®" etc. and in Bharata. ®'®
verses.hindi: विस्तरेण मया वक्तुं ब्रह्मणा च महात्मना। शक्यते नैव विप्रेनद्रा वर्षकोटिशतैरपि
verses.wordMeaning: Dharma is observed in the following continents and sub-coiitinentSj viz. Mahavita,®** Suvita,®® Jambudvipa®®® and its eight other sub-continen, and Sakadvipa,®®" etc. and in Bharata. ®'®
verses.commentary: Sense: Dharma is observed in the following continents and sub-coiitinentSj viz. Mahavita,®** Suvita,®® Jambudvipa®®® and its eight other sub-continen, and Sakadvipa,®®" etc. and in Bharata. ®'®

verses.sanskrit: ततः कार्यविरोधाद्धि नृपाणां नान्यथा भवेत् वैखानसानां विप्राणां पतितानामसंभवात्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ kāryavirodhāddhi nṛpāṇāṃ nānyathā bhavet vaikhānasānāṃ viprāṇāṃ patitānāmasaṃbhavāt
verses.translation: In Krta yuga, the sustenance of people was from taking liquids; in Treta yuga from domestic trees. But this was discontinued during the subsequent ages. The same occurred in regard to the untimely intercourse, during the menstrual dis- charge, due to lust of men. O Brahmins, so barley and other plants of the village and forest as well as the fourteen types of mcdic'nal herbs were cultivated untimely and destroyed, as in the case oi sexual intercourse during the menstrual period due to the passion of men.
verses.hindi: देवः पुरा कृतोद्वाहः शङ्करो नीललोहितः। हिमवच्छिखराद्देव्या हैमवत्या गणेश्वरेः वाराणस्ीमनृप्राप्य दर्शयामास शङ्करः। अविमुक्तेश्वरं लिङ्गं वासं तत्र चकार सः
verses.wordMeaning: In Krta yuga, the sustenance of people was from taking liquids; in Treta yuga from domestic trees. But this was discontinued during the subsequent ages. The same occurred in regard to the untimely intercourse, during the menstrual dis- charge, due to lust of men. O Brahmins,…
verses.commentary: Sense: In Krta yuga, the sustenance of people was from taking liquids; in Treta yuga from domestic trees. But this was discontinued during the subsequent ages. The same occurred in regard to the untimely intercourse, during the menstrual dis- charge, due to lust of men. O Brahmins,…

verses.sanskrit: असंचयाद् द्विजानां च स्नानमात्रेण नान्यथा तथा संनिहितानां च यज्ञार्थं दीक्षितस्य च
verses.transliteration: asaṃcayād dvijānāṃ ca snānamātreṇa nānyathā tathā saṃnihitānāṃ ca yajñārthaṃ dīkṣitasya ca
verses.translation: Hence, one shall assiduously avoid conversing with a woman in her monthly course. On the first day, she has to be avoided like a candala woman.
verses.hindi: तुङ्गेश्वरे च केदारे तत्स्थाने यो यतिर्भवेत्
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, one shall assiduously avoid conversing with a woman in her monthly course. On the first day, she has to be avoided like a candala woman.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, one shall assiduously avoid conversing with a woman in her monthly course. On the first day, she has to be avoided like a candala woman.

verses.sanskrit: एकाहाद् यज्ञयाजिनां शुद्धिरुक्ता स्वयंभुवा ततस्त्वधीतशाखानां चतुर्भिः सर्वदेहिनाम्
verses.transliteration: ekāhād yajñayājināṃ śuddhiruktā svayaṃbhuvā tatastvadhītaśākhānāṃ caturbhiḥ sarvadehinām
verses.translation: O brahmins, on the second day, she is to be treat- ed like a woman who has slain a brahmin. On the third day,®**® she has hall that sinful nature. O sages of good holy rites, she shall take bath on the fourth day.®® She shall then be pure within half a month. From the sixteenth day onwards the women shall observe cleanliness in regard to passing of urine.
verses.hindi: देवोद्याने वसेत्तत्र शर्वोद्यानमनुत्तमम्। मनसा निर्ममे रुद्रो विमानं च सुशोभनम् दर्शयामास च तदा देवोद्यानमनुत्तमम्। हैमवत्याः स्वयं देवः सनन्दी परमेश्वरः
verses.wordMeaning: O brahmins, on the second day, she is to be treat- ed like a woman who has slain a brahmin. On the third day,®**® she has hall that sinful nature. O sages of good holy rites, she shall take bath on the fourth day.®® She shall then be pure within half a month.…
verses.commentary: Sense: O brahmins, on the second day, she is to be treat- ed like a woman who has slain a brahmin. On the third day,®**® she has hall that sinful nature. O sages of good holy rites, she shall take bath on the fourth day.®® She shall then be pure within half a month.…

verses.sanskrit: सूतकं प्रेतकं नास्ति त्र्यहाद् ऊर्ध्वम् अमुत्र वै अर्वाग् एकादशाहान्तं बान्धवानां द्विजोत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: sūtakaṃ pretakaṃ nāsti tryahād ūrdhvam amutra vai arvāg ekādaśāhāntaṃ bāndhavānāṃ dvijottamāḥ
verses.translation: If the menstrual discharge continues she cannot be touched for five days.®** As far as twenty days she is defiled by tlie menstrual discharge and remains untouchable.
verses.hindi: ऋषिगण बोले-हे महाबुद्धिमान् सूतजी! यदि वाराणसी ऐसी पुण्यदायिनी है, तो अब हमलोगोंको प्रभाव कृपापूर्वक बताइये; हमलोगोंको इस अविमुक्तक्षेत्रके उत्तम माहात्म्यको विस्तारपूर्वक विधिके
verses.wordMeaning: If the menstrual discharge continues she cannot be touched for five days.®** As far as twenty days she is defiled by tlie menstrual discharge and remains untouchable.
verses.commentary: Sense: If the menstrual discharge continues she cannot be touched for five days.®** As far as twenty days she is defiled by tlie menstrual discharge and remains untouchable.

verses.sanskrit: स्नानमात्रेण वै शुद्धिर् मरणे समुपस्थिते तत ऋतुत्रयादर्वाग् एकाहः परिगीयते
verses.transliteration: snānamātreṇa vai śuddhir maraṇe samupasthite tata ṛtutrayādarvāg ekāhaḥ parigīyate
verses.translation: Mahavita see G note 323.
verses.hindi: अनुसार सुननेकी बड़ी उत्सुकता है सूतजी बोले--वाराणसीके अविमुक्तक्षेत्रके अति उत्तम माहात्म्यको मैं भली-भाँति संक्षेपमें बता रहा हूँ, जैसा कि भगवान् शिवने कहा था। है विप्रेन्द्रो ! मेरे तथा महात्मा ब्रह्माके द्वारा सौ करोड़ वर्षामें भी विस्तारे
verses.wordMeaning: Mahavita see G note 323.
verses.commentary: Sense: Mahavita see G note 323.

verses.sanskrit: सप्तवर्षात् ततश्चार्वाक् त्रिरात्रं हि ततः परम् दशाहं ब्राह्मणानां वै प्रथमे ऽहनि वा पितुः
verses.transliteration: saptavarṣāt tataścārvāk trirātraṃ hi tataḥ param daśāhaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ vai prathame 'hani vā pituḥ
verses.translation: ST. does not construe 'assu' with 'sfika-dvipadisu' but takes It with 'kimpurustdisu* which it supplies since it does not occur in the verse. It explains 'saka-dvipadisu* along with plaksadvipantikesu, on the authority of Linga. I. 48. 48.
verses.hindi: इसका वर्णन नहीं किया जा सकता है
verses.wordMeaning: ST. does not construe 'assu' with 'sfika-dvipadisu' but takes It with 'kimpurustdisu* which it supplies since it does not occur in the verse. It explains 'saka-dvipadisu* along with plaksadvipantikesu, on the authority of Linga. I. 48. 48.
verses.commentary: Sense: ST. does not construe 'assu' with 'sfika-dvipadisu' but takes It with 'kimpurustdisu* which it supplies since it does not occur in the verse. It explains 'saka-dvipadisu* along with plaksadvipantikesu, on the authority of Linga. I. 48. 48.

verses.sanskrit: दशाहं सूतिकाशौचं मातुरप्येवमव्ययाः अर्वाक् त्रिवर्षात्स्नानेन बान्धवानां पितुः सदा
verses.transliteration: daśāhaṃ sūtikāśaucaṃ māturapyevamavyayāḥ arvāk trivarṣātsnānena bāndhavānāṃ pituḥ sadā
verses.translation: Bharata, sec note 289. 20a note 318.
verses.hindi: प्राचीन कालमें विवाह करनेके पश्चात् नीललोहित भगवान् शंकरने हिमालयके शिखरसे देवी पार्वती तथा गणेश्वरोंके साथ वाराणसौमें पहुँचकर अपने अविमुक्तेश्वर लिङ्गका दर्शन कराया और वे वहीं रहने लगे । वाराणसी, कुरुक्षेत्र, श्रीपर्वत, महालय, तुंगेश्वर और केदार--इन स्थानोंमें जो यति होता है; वह दूसरे जन्ममें पाशुपतयोग सिद्ध हो जानेपर एक ही दिनमें सम्यक् (ब्रह्मज्ञानसम्मन्न)
verses.wordMeaning: Bharata, sec note 289. 20a note 318.
verses.commentary: Sense: Bharata, sec note 289. 20a note 318.

verses.sanskrit: अष्टाब्दाद् एकरात्रेण शुद्धिः स्याद् बान्धवस्य तु द्वादशाब्दात्ततश्चार्वाक् त्रिरात्रं स्त्रीषु सुव्रताः
verses.transliteration: aṣṭābdād ekarātreṇa śuddhiḥ syād bāndhavasya tu dvādaśābdāttataścārvāk trirātraṃ strīṣu suvratāḥ
verses.translation: A woman in her monthly course shall avoid bath, toilet, singing, crying, laughing, going in vehicles, applying collyrium, playing dice, applying unguents, sleeping during the daytime, washing the teeth, sexual intercourse, worship of deities whether mental, verbal or physical as well as bowing down. A woman in her monthly course shall avoid touching anothet woman in her monthly course and talking to her also. She shall assiduously avoid changing her garments. A woman in her monthly course shall not touch another man after her bath.
verses.hindi: यति हो जाता है। अत: सबकुछ छोड़कर पाशुपतत्रत करना चाहिए और वहाँ देवोद्यानमें वास करना चाहिए । शिवजीका उद्यान अत्यन्त उत्तम है। रुद्रने मनसे एक परम सुन्दर भवनका निर्माण किया है। तब नन्दीसहित
verses.wordMeaning: A woman in her monthly course shall avoid bath, toilet, singing, crying, laughing, going in vehicles, applying collyrium, playing dice, applying unguents, sleeping during the daytime, washing the teeth, sexual intercourse, worship of deities whether mental,…
verses.commentary: Sense: A woman in her monthly course shall avoid bath, toilet, singing, crying, laughing, going in vehicles, applying collyrium, playing dice, applying unguents, sleeping during the daytime, washing the teeth, sexual intercourse, worship of deities whether mental,…

verses.sanskrit: सपिण्डता च पुरुषे सप्तमे विनिवर्तते अतिक्रान्ते दशाहे तु त्रिरात्रमशुचिर्भवेत्
verses.transliteration: sapiṇḍatā ca puruṣe saptame vinivartate atikrānte daśāhe tu trirātramaśucirbhavet
verses.translation: She shall look at the brilliant sun and drink Brahma- kurca or Pancagavya or milk for self purification.
verses.hindi: देव परमेश्वरने स्वयं पार्वतीको उस अत्युत्तम देवोद्यान (आनन्दकानन)-को दिखाया । भगवान् परमेश्वर श  पार्वतीकी प्रसन्नताके लिये इस अविमुक्तक्षेत्रके महात्मा वर्णन किया
verses.wordMeaning: She shall look at the brilliant sun and drink Brahma- kurca or Pancagavya or milk for self purification.
verses.commentary: Sense: She shall look at the brilliant sun and drink Brahma- kurca or Pancagavya or milk for self purification.

verses.sanskrit: ततः संनिहितो विप्रश् चार्वाक् पूर्वं तदेव वै संवत्सरे व्यतीते तु स्नानमात्रेण शुध्यति
verses.transliteration: tataḥ saṃnihito vipraś cārvāk pūrvaṃ tadeva vai saṃvatsare vyatīte tu snānamātreṇa śudhyati
verses.translation: The husband shall not indulge in sexual inter- course on the fourth night after the monthly discharge has started. If he indulges thus, the child born will be short-li\cd. The son born of this sexual contact will be devoid of learning, depraved, deviating from the observance of holy rites, violating the chastity of other men's wives and immersed in the ocean of penury. The woman should be appi cached on the fifth night if he seeks a daughter.
verses.hindi: वह उद्यान अनेक प्रकारके विकसित मो  सुशोभित था, बाहरसे लता-शाखाओं आदिसे अत्यन्त मनोहर था और विरूढ़ पुष्पोंवाले प्रियंगुसे तथा पूर्ण  रूपसे खिले हुए काँटेदार केतकीवृक्षोंसे युक्त था। वह
verses.wordMeaning: The husband shall not indulge in sexual inter- course on the fourth night after the monthly discharge has started. If he indulges thus, the child born will be short-li\cd. The son born of this sexual contact will be devoid of learning, depraved,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The husband shall not indulge in sexual inter- course on the fourth night after the monthly discharge has started. If he indulges thus, the child born will be short-li\cd. The son born of this sexual contact will be devoid of learning, depraved,…

verses.sanskrit: स्पृष्ट्वा प्रेतं त्रिरात्रेण धर्मार्थं स्नानमुच्यते दाहकानां च नेतॄणां स्नानमात्रमबान्धवे
verses.transliteration: spṛṣṭvā pretaṃ trirātreṇa dharmārthaṃ snānamucyate dāhakānāṃ ca netṝṇāṃ snānamātramabāndhave
verses.translation: If the blood is predominant, the child will be a girl; if the semen is predominant the child will be a boy; if both are equal the child will be an eunuch; if the sexual intercourse is on the fifth night the child will be a girl.
verses.hindi: सुगन्धसे युक्त तमालके गुच्छोंसे घिरा हुआ था, अत्यधिक पुष्पोंबाले बकुलके वृक्षोंसे सभी ओरसे सुशोभित धा और भौरोंकी पंक्तियोंसे शोभायमान तथा खिले हुए क्षेत्रस्यास्य च माहात्म्यमविमुक्तस्य शङ्करः।
verses.wordMeaning: If the blood is predominant, the child will be a girl; if the semen is predominant the child will be a boy; if both are equal the child will be an eunuch; if the sexual intercourse is on the fifth night the child will be a girl.
verses.commentary: Sense: If the blood is predominant, the child will be a girl; if the semen is predominant the child will be a boy; if both are equal the child will be an eunuch; if the sexual intercourse is on the fifth night the child will be a girl.

verses.sanskrit: अनुगम्य च वै स्नात्वा घृतं प्राश्य विशुध्यति आचार्यमरणे चैव त्रिरात्रं श्रोत्रिये मृते
verses.transliteration: anugamya ca vai snātvā ghṛtaṃ prāśya viśudhyati ācāryamaraṇe caiva trirātraṃ śrotriye mṛte
verses.translation: The blessed lady shall be approached on the sixth night; she will be the mother of a good son. The son will be excessively brilliant and he will remain dutiful as a son.
verses.hindi: सुपुष्पितैः कण्टकितैश्च केतकैः
verses.wordMeaning: The blessed lady shall be approached on the sixth night; she will be the mother of a good son. The son will be excessively brilliant and he will remain dutiful as a son.
verses.commentary: Sense: The blessed lady shall be approached on the sixth night; she will be the mother of a good son. The son will be excessively brilliant and he will remain dutiful as a son.

verses.sanskrit: पक्षिणी मातुलानां च सोदराणां च वा द्विजाः भूपानां मण्डलीनां च सद्यो नीराष्ट्रवासिनाम्
verses.transliteration: pakṣiṇī mātulānāṃ ca sodarāṇāṃ ca vā dvijāḥ bhūpānāṃ maṇḍalīnāṃ ca sadyo nīrāṣṭravāsinām
verses.translation: The word Pum means "hell" and they say that hell is miserable. She will give birth to a son who will save his parents from Pum (i.e. hell).®**
verses.hindi: निकामपुष्पैर्बकुलैश्च सर्वतः। क्वचित्रफुल्लाम्बुजरेणुभूषितै- पुष्पोंवाले सैकड़ों अशोक एवं पुन्नागके वृक्षोसे युक्त
verses.wordMeaning: The word Pum means "hell" and they say that hell is miserable. She will give birth to a son who will save his parents from Pum (i.e. hell).®**
verses.commentary: Sense: The word Pum means "hell" and they say that hell is miserable. She will give birth to a son who will save his parents from Pum (i.e. hell).®**

verses.sanskrit: केवलं द्वादशाहेन क्षत्त्रियाणां द्विजोत्तमाः नाभिषिक्तस्य चाशौचं संप्रमादेषु वै रणे
verses.transliteration: kevalaṃ dvādaśāhena kṣattriyāṇāṃ dvijottamāḥ nābhiṣiktasya cāśaucaṃ saṃpramādeṣu vai raṇe
verses.translation: Cf. IX. 138.
verses.hindi: विनादितं सारसचक्रवाके: वह उद्यान कहीं विकसित कमलोंके परागसे
verses.wordMeaning: Cf. IX. 138.
verses.commentary: Sense: Cf. IX. 138.

verses.sanskrit: वैश्यः पञ्चदशाहेन शूद्रो मासेन शुध्यति इति संक्षेपतः प्रोक्ता द्रव्यशुद्धिरनुत्तमा
verses.transliteration: vaiśyaḥ pañcadaśāhena śūdro māsena śudhyati iti saṃkṣepataḥ proktā dravyaśuddhiranuttamā
verses.translation: saiva prasuyate — Bandhya bhavati ST. she becomes barren. ST. quotes Nirnaya-sindhu in support of his view: "saptamyam apraja yosit." But this meaning is not borne out by the text.
verses.hindi: नामक पक्षियोंकी मधुर ध्वनियोंसे सभी ओर विशेष रूपसे । गुंजित था वह सुन्दर उद्यान कहीं-कहीं मयूरोंकी ध्वनिसे निनादित था, कहीं-कहीं कारण्डव पक्षीकी ध्वनिसे शब्दायमान था और कहों-कहीं मत्त भ्रमर-समूहोंसे तथा मदसे आकुल भ्रमरांगनाओंसे गुंजायमान था
verses.wordMeaning: saiva prasuyate — Bandhya bhavati ST. she becomes barren. ST. quotes Nirnaya-sindhu in support of his view: "saptamyam apraja yosit." But this meaning is not borne out by the text.
verses.commentary: Sense: saiva prasuyate — Bandhya bhavati ST. she becomes barren. ST. quotes Nirnaya-sindhu in support of his view: "saptamyam apraja yosit." But this meaning is not borne out by the text.

verses.sanskrit: अशौचं चानुपूर्व्येण यतीनां नैव विद्यते त्रेताप्रभृति नारीणां मासि मास्यार्तवं द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: aśaucaṃ cānupūrvyeṇa yatīnāṃ naiva vidyate tretāprabhṛti nārīṇāṃ māsi māsyārtavaṃ dvijāḥ
verses.translation: II approached on the twelfth night she will give birth to a son who is conversant with the principle of Oharma and who will observe the holy rites laid down in Srutis and Sniriis. If approached on the thirteenth night she will give birth to a sluggish girl who will bring about mixture of castes. Hence, one shall assiduously avoid her on that night. If he approaches her on the fourteenth night she will be the mother of a son.
verses.hindi: वह उद्यान कहीं-कहीं अति सुगन्धित पुष्पोंसे युक्त
verses.wordMeaning: II approached on the twelfth night she will give birth to a son who is conversant with the principle of Oharma and who will observe the holy rites laid down in Srutis and Sniriis.…
verses.commentary: Sense: II approached on the twelfth night she will give birth to a son who is conversant with the principle of Oharma and who will observe the holy rites laid down in Srutis and Sniriis.…

verses.sanskrit: कृते सकृद् युगवशाज् जायन्ते वै सहैव तु प्रयान्ति च महाभागा भार्याभिः कुरवो यथा
verses.transliteration: kṛte sakṛd yugavaśāj jāyante vai sahaiva tu prayānti ca mahābhāgā bhāryābhiḥ kuravo yathā
verses.translation: If approached on the fifteenth niglu she will give birth to a virtuous daughter; if approached on the sixteenth night she will give birth to a son who will be a master of per- fect knowledge.
verses.hindi: क्वचिच्च केकारुतनादितं शुभं क्वचिच्च कारण्डवनादनादितम्। क्वचित्सुपुष्पैः सहकारवृक्षैः।
verses.wordMeaning: If approached on the fifteenth niglu she will give birth to a virtuous daughter; if approached on the sixteenth night she will give birth to a son who will be a master of per- fect knowledge.
verses.commentary: Sense: If approached on the fifteenth niglu she will give birth to a virtuous daughter; if approached on the sixteenth night she will give birth to a son who will be a master of per- fect knowledge.

verses.sanskrit: वर्णाश्रमव्यवस्था च त्रेताप्रभृति सुव्रताः भारते दक्षिणे वर्षे व्यवस्था नेतरेष्वथ
verses.transliteration: varṇāśramavyavasthā ca tretāprabhṛti suvratāḥ bhārate dakṣiṇe varṣe vyavasthā netareṣvatha
verses.translation: Construe 'purvat' with the following veise. i. e. dvadasyam uurvavat (=panditavat) dharma-tattvajnam (sutam prasQte).
verses.hindi: लतोपगूढैस्तिलकैश्च प्रगीतविद्याधरसिद्धचारणम् गू था, कहीं-कहीं सुन्दर पुष्पोंसे लदे हुए आमके वृक्षोंसे प्रवृत्तनृत्तानुगताप्सरोगणं जा 1 १८ सुशोभित था, लताओंसे परिपूर्ण तिलक वृक्षोंसे समन्वित था और विद्याधरों-सिद्धों तथा चारणोंके गायनसे युक्त
verses.wordMeaning: Construe 'purvat' with the following veise. i. e. dvadasyam uurvavat (=panditavat) dharma-tattvajnam (sutam prasQte).
verses.commentary: Sense: Construe 'purvat' with the following veise. i. e. dvadasyam uurvavat (=panditavat) dharma-tattvajnam (sutam prasQte).

verses.sanskrit: महावीते सुवीते च जंबूद्वीपे तथाष्टसु शाकद्वीपादिषु प्रोक्तो धर्मो वै भारते यथा
verses.transliteration: mahāvīte suvīte ca jaṃbūdvīpe tathāṣṭasu śākadvīpādiṣu prokto dharmo vai bhārate yathā
verses.translation: Construe 'purvat' with the following veise. i. e. dvadasyam uurvavat (=panditavat) dharma-tattvajnam (sutam prasQte).
verses.hindi: प्रहृष्टनानाविधपक्षिसेवितम् । गावा प्रवृत्तहारीतकुलोपनादितं हन वहाँ अप्सराओंका समूह नृत्य करनेमें लीन था, मृगेन्द्रनादाकुलमत्तमानसैः अनेक प्रकारके प्रसन्न पक्षी वहाँ निवास करते थे, वह क्वचित्कवचिद्गन्धकदम्बकैर्मृगै- उद्यान नृत्य करते हुए हारीत पक्षियोंके समुदायोंसे निनादित विलूनदर्भाडुरपुष्पसज्चयम् । था। वह कहीं-कहीं सिंहोके नादसे आकुल तथा मं प्रफुल्लनानाविधचारुपङ्कजै मनवाले कस्तूरीमृग-समुदायोंसे चरे गये दर्भाकुरों तथा
verses.wordMeaning: Construe 'purvat' with the following veise. i. e. dvadasyam uurvavat (=panditavat) dharma-tattvajnam (sutam prasQte).
verses.commentary: Sense: Construe 'purvat' with the following veise. i. e. dvadasyam uurvavat (=panditavat) dharma-tattvajnam (sutam prasQte).

verses.sanskrit: रसोल्लासा कृते वृत्तिस् त्रेतायां गृहवृक्षजा सैवार्तवकृताद् दोषाद् रागद्वेषादिभिर् नृणाम्
verses.transliteration: rasollāsā kṛte vṛttis tretāyāṃ gṛhavṛkṣajā saivārtavakṛtād doṣād rāgadveṣādibhir nṛṇām
verses.translation: Construe 'purvat' with the following veise. i. e. dvadasyam uurvavat (=panditavat) dharma-tattvajnam (sutam prasQte).
verses.hindi: पुष्पोंसे सुशोभित था और कहीं-कहीं अनेकविध विकसित सुन्दर कमलोंसे युक्त सरोबरों तथा तडागोंसे सुशोभित था
verses.wordMeaning: Construe 'purvat' with the following veise. i. e. dvadasyam uurvavat (=panditavat) dharma-tattvajnam (sutam prasQte).
verses.commentary: Sense: Construe 'purvat' with the following veise. i. e. dvadasyam uurvavat (=panditavat) dharma-tattvajnam (sutam prasQte).

verses.sanskrit: मैथुनात्कामतो विप्रास् तथैव परुषादिभिः यवाद्याः सम्प्रजायन्ते ग्राम्यारण्याश्चतुर्दश
verses.transliteration: maithunātkāmato viprās tathaiva paruṣādibhiḥ yavādyāḥ samprajāyante grāmyāraṇyāścaturdaśa
verses.translation: Construe 'purvat' with the following veise. i. e. dvadasyam uurvavat (=panditavat) dharma-tattvajnam (sutam prasQte).
verses.hindi: वह उद्यान वृक्षोंके समुदायोंसे सम्पन्न था, नीलकण्ठ पक्षियोंके द्वारा सुन्दर प्रतीत होता था, प्रसन्न 1: ररणण्रन्््ग्ग््   काकाक कामक
verses.wordMeaning: Construe 'purvat' with the following veise. i. e. dvadasyam uurvavat (=panditavat) dharma-tattvajnam (sutam prasQte).
verses.commentary: Sense: Construe 'purvat' with the following veise. i. e. dvadasyam uurvavat (=panditavat) dharma-tattvajnam (sutam prasQte).

verses.sanskrit: ओषध्यश् च रजोदोषाः स्त्रीणां रागादिभिर् नृणाम् अकालकृष्टा विध्वस्ताः पुनरुत्पादितास् तथा
verses.transliteration: oṣadhyaś ca rajodoṣāḥ strīṇāṃ rāgādibhir nṛṇām akālakṛṣṭā vidhvastāḥ punarutpāditās tathā
verses.translation: Construe 'purvat' with the following veise. i. e. dvadasyam uurvavat (=panditavat) dharma-tattvajnam (sutam prasQte).
verses.hindi: क्वचिल्लतालिङ्गितिचारुवृक्षकम् ।
verses.wordMeaning: Construe 'purvat' with the following veise. i. e. dvadasyam uurvavat (=panditavat) dharma-tattvajnam (sutam prasQte).
verses.commentary: Sense: Construe 'purvat' with the following veise. i. e. dvadasyam uurvavat (=panditavat) dharma-tattvajnam (sutam prasQte).

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन न संभाष्या रजस्वला प्रथमे ऽहनि चाण्डाली यथा वर्ज्या तथाङ्गना
verses.transliteration: tasmātsarvaprayatnena na saṃbhāṣyā rajasvalā prathame 'hani cāṇḍālī yathā varjyā tathāṅganā
verses.translation: Construe 'purvat' with the following veise. i. e. dvadasyam uurvavat (=panditavat) dharma-tattvajnam (sutam prasQte).
verses.hindi: आकीर्णपुष्पनिकरप्रविभक्तहंसै- तोयाशयैः समनुशोभितदेवमार्गम्।
verses.wordMeaning: Construe 'purvat' with the following veise. i. e. dvadasyam uurvavat (=panditavat) dharma-tattvajnam (sutam prasQte).
verses.commentary: Sense: Construe 'purvat' with the following veise. i. e. dvadasyam uurvavat (=panditavat) dharma-tattvajnam (sutam prasQte).

verses.sanskrit: द्वितीये ऽहनि विप्रा हि यथा वै ब्रह्मघातिनी तृतीये ऽह्नि तदर्धेन चतुर्थे ऽहनि सुव्रताः
verses.transliteration: dvitīye 'hani viprā hi yathā vai brahmaghātinī tṛtīye 'hni tadardhena caturthe 'hani suvratāḥ
verses.translation: Construe 'purvat' with the following veise. i. e. dvadasyam uurvavat (=panditavat) dharma-tattvajnam (sutam prasQte).
verses.hindi: ुडग्रैनीलपुष्पैस्तबकभरनतप्रांशुशाखैरशोके-
verses.wordMeaning: Construe 'purvat' with the following veise. i. e. dvadasyam uurvavat (=panditavat) dharma-tattvajnam (sutam prasQte).
verses.commentary: Sense: Construe 'purvat' with the following veise. i. e. dvadasyam uurvavat (=panditavat) dharma-tattvajnam (sutam prasQte).

verses.sanskrit: स्नात्वार्धमासात् संशुद्धा ततः शुद्धिर्भविष्यति आ षोडशात् ततः स्त्रीणां मूत्रवच्छौचमिष्यते
verses.transliteration: snātvārdhamāsāt saṃśuddhā tataḥ śuddhirbhaviṣyati ā ṣoḍaśāt tataḥ strīṇāṃ mūtravacchaucamiṣyate
verses.translation: Construe 'purvat' with the following veise. i. e. dvadasyam uurvavat (=panditavat) dharma-tattvajnam (sutam prasQte).
verses.hindi: अविमुक्तक्षेत्र वाराणसीका माहात्म्य तथा श्रीविश्वेश्वरपूजाविधिवर्णन पक्षियोंसे युक्त था, सभी ओर ध्वनि होनेसे यह अति सुन्दर था, खिले हुए पुष्पोंवाले वृक्षोंकी शाखाओंमें विद्यमान मस्त भौरोंसे सुशोभित था, नूतन कलियोंकी सुन्दरतासे सुशोभित था और ऊँची-ऊँची शाखाओंसे युक्त था
verses.wordMeaning: Construe 'purvat' with the following veise. i. e. dvadasyam uurvavat (=panditavat) dharma-tattvajnam (sutam prasQte).
verses.commentary: Sense: Construe 'purvat' with the following veise. i. e. dvadasyam uurvavat (=panditavat) dharma-tattvajnam (sutam prasQte).

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चरात्रं तथास्पृश्या रजसा वर्तते यदि सा विंशद्दिवसादूर्ध्वं रजसा पूर्ववत्तथा
verses.transliteration: pañcarātraṃ tathāspṛśyā rajasā vartate yadi sā viṃśaddivasādūrdhvaṃ rajasā pūrvavattathā
verses.translation: Construe 'purvat' with the following veise. i. e. dvadasyam uurvavat (=panditavat) dharma-tattvajnam (sutam prasQte).
verses.hindi: वह उद्यान कहीं-कहीं दाँतोंसे क्षत को गयी सुन्दर लताओंसे सुशोभित था, कहीं-कहीं लताओंसे वेष्टित वृक्षोंसे मण्डित था और कहीं-कहीं विलासके कारण मन्थर गतिवाली किंपुरुष अंगनाओंसे सेवित
verses.wordMeaning: Construe 'purvat' with the following veise. i. e. dvadasyam uurvavat (=panditavat) dharma-tattvajnam (sutam prasQte).
verses.commentary: Sense: Construe 'purvat' with the following veise. i. e. dvadasyam uurvavat (=panditavat) dharma-tattvajnam (sutam prasQte).

verses.sanskrit: स्नानं शौचं तथा गानं रोदनं हसनं तथा यानमभ्यञ्जनं नारी द्यूतं चैवानुलेपनम्
verses.transliteration: snānaṃ śaucaṃ tathā gānaṃ rodanaṃ hasanaṃ tathā yānamabhyañjanaṃ nārī dyūtaṃ caivānulepanam
verses.translation: Construe 'purvat' with the following veise. i. e. dvadasyam uurvavat (=panditavat) dharma-tattvajnam (sutam prasQte).
verses.hindi: वह उद्यान पारावत पक्षियोंकी ध्वनिसे निनादित तथा गगनचुम्बी श्रंगोंवाले वृक्षोंसे, बिखरे हुए पुष्पसमूहोंको विभक्त कर देनेवाले श्वेत वर्णक मनोहर तथा सुन्दर रूपवाले हंसोंसे और अनेक देवताओंके दिव्य कुलोंसे सुशोभित है । वह विकसित नीलकमलके हजारों वितानोंसे युक्त है, जलाशयोंसे सुशोभित देवमार्गवाला है और मार्गके मध्यमें खिले हुए विचित्र पुष्पोंकी पंक्तिसे सम्बद्ध विविध गुल्मों तथा विटपोंसे समन्वित है
verses.wordMeaning: Construe 'purvat' with the following veise. i. e. dvadasyam uurvavat (=panditavat) dharma-tattvajnam (sutam prasQte).
verses.commentary: Sense: Construe 'purvat' with the following veise. i. e. dvadasyam uurvavat (=panditavat) dharma-tattvajnam (sutam prasQte).

verses.sanskrit: दिवास्वप्नं विशेषेण तथा वै दन्तधावनम् मैथुनं मानसं वापि वाचिकं देवतार्चनम्
verses.transliteration: divāsvapnaṃ viśeṣeṇa tathā vai dantadhāvanam maithunaṃ mānasaṃ vāpi vācikaṃ devatārcanam

verses.hindi: उस उद्यानमें पुन्नागके वृक्षोंपर सैकड़ों पक्षियोंकी  ध्वनि होती रहती थी, गुच्छोंके भारसे रक्त अशोकवृक्ष  झुके रहते थे, रम्य सीमास्थलपर थकानको हरनेवाले  भवन थे और खिले हुए कमलोंपर भोरे मँडराते रहते उस समय हिमालयपुत्री पार्वती और मत,  प्रसन्न तथा शरीरसे पुष्ट प्रिय गणेश्वरोंके साथ विद्यमान  सम्पूर्ण भवनोंके भर्ता शिवने अनेकविध विशाल वृक्षोंवाले अत्यन्त रम्य उपवनको देवीको दिखाया
verses.wordMeaning: Construe 'purvat' with the following veise. i. e. dvadasyam uurvavat (=panditavat) dharma-tattvajnam (sutam prasQte).
verses.commentary: Sense: Construe 'purvat' with the following veise. i. e. dvadasyam uurvavat (=panditavat) dharma-tattvajnam (sutam prasQte).

verses.sanskrit: सर्वेषामेव भूतानां सदाचारः प्रकीर्तितः यः पठेच्छृणुयाद् वापि सदाचारं शुचिर्नरः
verses.transliteration: sarveṣāmeva bhūtānāṃ sadācāraḥ prakīrtitaḥ yaḥ paṭhecchṛṇuyād vāpi sadācāraṃ śucirnaraḥ
verses.translation: Construe 'purvat' with the following veise. i. e. dvadasyam uurvavat (=panditavat) dharma-tattvajnam (sutam prasQte).
verses.hindi: शिवजीने अत्यन्त सुन्दर वन्य पुष्पोंसे बनाये गये दिव्य आभूषणोंसे उपवनमें गयी हुई दिव्य देवीको  सजाया और उन पार्वतीने भी अत्यन्त सुन्दर दि.
verses.wordMeaning: Construe 'purvat' with the following veise. i. e. dvadasyam uurvavat (=panditavat) dharma-tattvajnam (sutam prasQte).
verses.commentary: Sense: Construe 'purvat' with the following veise. i. e. dvadasyam uurvavat (=panditavat) dharma-tattvajnam (sutam prasQte).

verses.transliteration: śrāvayedvā yathānyāyaṃ brāhmaṇān dagdhakilbiṣān brahmalokamanuprāpya brahmaṇā saha modate
