verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीलिङ्गमहापुराणे पूर्वभागे सदाचारकथनं नामैकोननवतितमो ऽध्यायः अत ऊर्ध्वं प्रवक्ष्यामि यतीनामिह निश्चितम् प्रायश्चित्तं शिवप्रोक्तं यतीनां पापशोधनम्
verses.transliteration: iti śrīliṅgamahāpurāṇe pūrvabhāge sadācārakathanaṃ nāmaikonanavatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ ata ūrdhvaṃ pravakṣyāmi yatīnāmiha niścitam prāyaścittaṃ śivaproktaṃ yatīnāṃ pāpaśodhanam
verses.translation: Henceforth, I shall mention decisively the mode of expiation by asectics. This is recounted by Siva and it makes adequate atonement for the sins of ascetics. Sins are of three types: those originating from speech, mind and body. It is by these that the universe is en- compassed always, by day and by night. "Without activities the world cannot be sustained even for a moment", says the sacred Sruti. It is the only instrument that is conducive to longevity and sustenance.
verses.hindi: मुवाच देवं प्रणिपत्य देवी
verses.wordMeaning: Henceforth, I shall mention decisively the mode of expiation by asectics. This is recounted by Siva and it makes adequate atonement for the sins of ascetics. Sins are of three types: those originating from speech, mind and body.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Henceforth, I shall mention decisively the mode of expiation by asectics. This is recounted by Siva and it makes adequate atonement for the sins of ascetics. Sins are of three types: those originating from speech, mind and body.…

verses.sanskrit: पापं हि त्रिविधं ज्ञेयं वाङ्मनःकायसंभवम् सततं हि दिवा रात्रौ येनेदं वेष्ट्यते जगत्
verses.transliteration: pāpaṃ hi trividhaṃ jñeyaṃ vāṅmanaḥkāyasaṃbhavam satataṃ hi divā rātrau yenedaṃ veṣṭyate jagat
verses.translation: It is only to the unerring that the yoga becomes accessi- ble. Indeed, yoga is the greatest strength. There is no otlier auspicious thing for men that is greater than yoga. He shall perform Pranayama and observe the rite Santapana. Then with great concentration and attention at the end, he shall perform the Krcchra® rite in accordance with the direction. Again the Bhiksu shall return to the hermitage and perform the rite alertfully. Learned men say that a virtuous falsehood does not injure one. Still it should not be pursued. Its mere context is terrible. The expiatory rite is fasting for a night and a day and a hundred Pranayamas.
verses.hindi: उद्यानं दर्शितं देव प्रभया परया युतम्। क्षेत्रस्य च गुणान् सर्वान् पुनर्मे वक्तुमरहसि वक्तुमर्हसि देवेश देवदेव वृषध्वज
verses.wordMeaning: It is only to the unerring that the yoga becomes accessi- ble. Indeed, yoga is the greatest strength. There is no otlier auspicious thing for men that is greater than yoga. He shall perform Pranayama and observe the rite Santapana.…
verses.commentary: Sense: It is only to the unerring that the yoga becomes accessi- ble. Indeed, yoga is the greatest strength. There is no otlier auspicious thing for men that is greater than yoga. He shall perform Pranayama and observe the rite Santapana.…

verses.sanskrit: तत्कर्मणा विनाप्येष तिष्ठतीति परा श्रुतिः क्षणमेवं प्रयोज्यं तु आयुष्यं तु विधारणम्
verses.transliteration: tatkarmaṇā vināpyeṣa tiṣṭhatīti parā śrutiḥ kṣaṇamevaṃ prayojyaṃ tu āyuṣyaṃ tu vidhāraṇam
verses.translation: ST, supplies prajapatyam with krechram. For detail, sec note 6a. iSruti says that there is no evil greater than stealing. What is mentioned as ''stealing" is a great violence that is inseparable from it. What is named "wealth" constitutes the external vital airs (Pranas). Hence, he who takes away the wealth of anyone really takes away the vital airs of that person. A person who is wicked in mind becomes one who has transgressed the bounds of good conduct by doing so (i.e. by stealing). He becomes one who has fallen down from his holy rite. He shall repent for it again and again and perform the rite of Candrayana®' for a year in accordance with the injunctions laid down in scriptures. So says Sruti. At the end of the year he shall eliminate all his sins. The Bhiksu shall then alerifully repent and perform the rites.
verses.hindi: देव्यास्तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा देवदेवो वरप्रभुः। आघ्राय वदनाम्भोजं तदाह गिरिजां हसन्
verses.wordMeaning: ST, supplies prajapatyam with krechram. For detail, sec note 6a. iSruti says that there is no evil greater than stealing. What is mentioned as ''stealing" is a great violence that is inseparable from it. What is named "wealth" constitutes the external vital airs (Pranas).…
verses.commentary: Sense: ST, supplies prajapatyam with krechram. For detail, sec note 6a. iSruti says that there is no evil greater than stealing. verses.sanskrit: भवेद्योगो ऽप्रमत्तस्य योगो हि परमं बलम् न हि योगात्परं किंचिन् नराणां दृश्यते शुभम्
verses.transliteration: bhavedyogo 'pramattasya yogo hi paramaṃ balam na hi yogātparaṃ kiṃcin narāṇāṃ dṛśyate śubham
verses.translation: He is freed from that sin by the observance of Prajapatya and Krcchra. In regard to other transgressions whether mental, verbal or physical he shall consult good men and perform what they lay down. CandrSyana: See note 61. One shall view a lump of clay and gold alike and par- form the rites. He shall be pure and clean. He shall have great concentration and attention in regard to all living beings. By living thus he attains that stable, unchanging and great abode from where he is not born again.
verses.hindi: सर्वेषामेव जन्तूनां हेतुर्मोक्षस्य सर्वदा अस्मिन् सिद्धाः सदा देवि मदीयं व्रतमास्थिताः । नानालिङ्गधरा नित्यं मम लोकाभिकाङ्क्षिणः
verses.wordMeaning: He is freed from that sin by the observance of Prajapatya and Krcchra. In regard to other transgressions whether mental, verbal or physical he shall consult good men and perform what they lay down. CandrSyana: See note 61.…
verses.commentary: Sense: He is freed from that sin by the observance of Prajapatya and Krcchra. In regard to other transgressions whether mental, verbal or physical he shall consult good men and perform what they lay down. CandrSyana: See note 61.…

verses.sanskrit: तस्माद् योगं प्रशंसन्ति धर्मयुक्ता मनीषिणः अविद्यां विद्यया जित्वा प्राप्यैश्वर्यमनुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: tasmād yogaṃ praśaṃsanti dharmayuktā manīṣiṇaḥ avidyāṃ vidyayā jitvā prāpyaiśvaryamanuttamam
verses.translation: Henceforth, I shall mention the Aristas (the phenomena that indicate misfortune and even death); understand them. It is by means of this special knowledge that the yogins visua- lise death. He who is not able to see Arundhati (a constellation among the Pleiades) Dhruva (Pole star), the shadow of the moon and the Mahapatha (Milky Way) shall not live more than a year. He who sees the sun without rays and the fire with rays will not live beyond the eleventh month.
verses.hindi: नानावृक्षसमाकीणें नानाविहगशोभिते ४०
verses.wordMeaning: Henceforth, I shall mention the Aristas (the phenomena that indicate misfortune and even death); understand them. It is by means of this special knowledge that the yogins visua- lise death.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Henceforth, I shall mention the Aristas (the phenomena that indicate misfortune and even death); understand them. It is by means of this special knowledge that the yogins visua- lise death.…

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा परावरं धीराः परं गच्छन्ति तत्पदम् व्रतानि यानि भिक्षूणां तथैवोपव्रतानि च
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvā parāvaraṃ dhīrāḥ paraṃ gacchanti tatpadam vratāni yāni bhikṣūṇāṃ tathaivopavratāni ca
verses.translation: He who dreams that he vomits, passes urine and eva- cuates stools in the form of gold and silver shall not live full ten months thereafter. He who sees a gold-coloured tree, the Gandharva city, (i.e. the hallucination of an imaginary city), ghosts and spirits shall live only for nine months. He who becomes stout or lean all of a sudden, i.e., he who thus moves away from his nature shall live only for eight months.
verses.hindi: अप्सरोगणगन्धर्वैः सदा संसेविते शुभे रोचते मे सदा वासो येन कार्येण तच्छणु। मन्मना मम भक्तश्च मयि नित्यार्पितक्रियः
verses.wordMeaning: He who dreams that he vomits, passes urine and eva- cuates stools in the form of gold and silver shall not live full ten months thereafter. He who sees a gold-coloured tree, the Gandharva city, (i.e. the hallucination of an imaginary city),…
verses.commentary: Sense: He who dreams that he vomits, passes urine and eva- cuates stools in the form of gold and silver shall not live full ten months thereafter. He who sees a gold-coloured tree, the Gandharva city, (i.e. the hallucination of an imaginary city),…

verses.sanskrit: एकैकातिक्रमे तेषां प्रायश्चित्तं विधीयते उपेत्य तु स्त्रियं कामात् प्रायश्चित्तं विनिर्दिशेत्
verses.transliteration: ekaikātikrame teṣāṃ prāyaścittaṃ vidhīyate upetya tu striyaṃ kāmāt prāyaścittaṃ vinirdiśet
verses.translation: He whose footprint appears split in front or behind in the dust or in mud lives only up to seven months. If a crow, or a dove, or a vulture or any other bird of prey perches on one's head, one shall not survive six months. He who goes in the company of rows of crows or of a dust storm, he who sees his own shadow in a deformed state shall live only for four or five months.
verses.hindi: यथा मोक्षमवाप्नोति अन्यत्र न तथा क्वचित्। कामं ह्यत्र मृतो देवि जन्तुर्मोक्षाय 'कल्पते
verses.wordMeaning: He whose footprint appears split in front or behind in the dust or in mud lives only up to seven months. If a crow, or a dove, or a vulture or any other bird of prey perches on one's head, one shall not survive six months.…
verses.commentary: Sense: He whose footprint appears split in front or behind in the dust or in mud lives only up to seven months. If a crow, or a dove, or a vulture or any other bird of prey perches on one's head, one shall not survive six months.…

verses.sanskrit: प्राणायामसमायुक्तं चरेत्सांतपनं व्रतम् ततश्चरति निर्देशात् कृच्छ्रं चान्ते समाहितः
verses.transliteration: prāṇāyāmasamāyuktaṃ caretsāṃtapanaṃ vratam tataścarati nirdeśāt kṛcchraṃ cānte samāhitaḥ
verses.translation: He who sees lightning in a spot that is not the sky and the lightning in the southern direction or he who sees the rain- bow in the water shall live for only one or two months. If one is not able to see oneself either in water or in the mirror or if he sees it devoid of the head he will not live beyond a month. If the body emits the odour of a dead body or of fat, his death is imminent. He will not live beyond a fortnight.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्मादयो विजानन्ति ये च सिद्धा मुमुक्षवः विमुक्तं न मया यस्मान्मोक्ष्यते वा कदाचन
verses.wordMeaning: He who sees lightning in a spot that is not the sky and the lightning in the southern direction or he who sees the rain- bow in the water shall live for only one or two months.…
verses.commentary: Sense: He who sees lightning in a spot that is not the sky and the lightning in the southern direction or he who sees the rain- bow in the water shall live for only one or two months.…

verses.sanskrit: पुनर् आश्रमम् आगत्य चरेद्भिक्षुरतन्द्रितः न धर्मयुक्तमनृतं हिनस्तीति मनीषिणः
verses.transliteration: punar āśramam āgatya caredbhikṣuratandritaḥ na dharmayuktamanṛtaṃ hinastīti manīṣiṇaḥ
verses.translation: If immediately after the bath the heart appears to dry up or smoke is seen coming out of the head, he will not live even for ten days. If the bursting wind pierces the vital parts, if the hairs do not stand on their ends on being sprinkled with water, his death is imminent. If one dreams of going towards the southern direction in a chariot to which monkeys and bears are yoked, and sings and dances in the meantime, it should be known that death is imminent.
verses.hindi: पुष्पोंसे इन देवदेव शंकरको भक्तिपूर्वक अलंकृत किया
verses.wordMeaning: If immediately after the bath the heart appears to dry up or smoke is seen coming out of the head, he will not live even for ten days. If the bursting wind pierces the vital parts, if the hairs do not stand on their ends on being sprinkled with water, his death is imminent.…
verses.commentary: Sense: If immediately after the bath the heart appears to dry up or smoke is seen coming out of the head, he will not live even for ten days. If the bursting wind pierces the vital parts, if the hairs do not stand on their ends on being sprinkled with water, his death is imminent.…

verses.sanskrit: तथापि न च कर्तव्यं प्रसंगो ह्येष दारुणः अहोरात्रोपवासश् च प्राणायामशतं तथा
verses.transliteration: tathāpi na ca kartavyaṃ prasaṃgo hyeṣa dāruṇaḥ ahorātropavāsaś ca prāṇāyāmaśataṃ tathā
verses.translation: If in the dream, a singing dark-complexioned woman who wears black clothes leads a person to the southern direc- tion he will not live long. If a man sees a slit in his own neck in the dream, or dreams of a naked sramana (Buddhist recluse), know that death is imminent. 'The person sinks into the ocean of mire upto the head*. On seeing a dream like this, he ceases to live immediately.
verses.hindi: तदनन्तर उस अत्यन्त रम्य उद्यानको देखकर आह  नन्दी आदि गणेश्वरोंके साथ देवताओंके लिये पूज्य देव
verses.wordMeaning: If in the dream, a singing dark-complexioned woman who wears black clothes leads a person to the southern direc- tion he will not live long. If a man sees a slit in his own neck in the dream, or dreams of a naked sramana (Buddhist recluse), know that death is imminent.…
verses.commentary: Sense: If in the dream, a singing dark-complexioned woman who wears black clothes leads a person to the southern direc- tion he will not live long. If a man sees a slit in his own neck in the dream, or dreams of a naked sramana (Buddhist recluse), know that death is imminent.…

verses.sanskrit: असद्वादो न कर्तव्यो यतिना धर्मलिप्सुना परमापद्गतेनापि न कार्यं स्तेयमप्युत
verses.transliteration: asadvādo na kartavyo yatinā dharmalipsunā paramāpadgatenāpi na kāryaṃ steyamapyuta
verses.translation: A person who sees ashes, burning coal, hairs, dry river, and serpents in dream does not live for ten days thereafter. He who is beaten in dream by dark-complexioned hideous persons with arms lifted up or hit by stones, ceases to live immediately. If jackals howl directly at a person early in the mor- ning, at sunrise, that person's days are numbered.
verses.hindi: शंकर-को पूजा करके और उन्हें प्रणामकर देवी पार्वती कहने लगीं
verses.wordMeaning: A person who sees ashes, burning coal, hairs, dry river, and serpents in dream does not live for ten days thereafter. He who is beaten in dream by dark-complexioned hideous persons with arms lifted up or hit by stones, ceases to live immediately.…
verses.commentary: Sense: A person who sees ashes, burning coal, hairs, dry river, and serpents in dream does not live for ten days thereafter. He who is beaten in dream by dark-complexioned hideous persons with arms lifted up or hit by stones, ceases to live immediately.…

verses.sanskrit: स्तेयादभ्यधिकः कश्चिन् नास्त्यधर्म इति श्रुतिः हिंसा ह्येषा परा सृष्टा स्तैन्यं वै कथितं तथा
verses.transliteration: steyādabhyadhikaḥ kaścin nāstyadharma iti śrutiḥ hiṃsā hyeṣā parā sṛṣṭā stainyaṃ vai kathitaṃ tathā
verses.translation: If the heart is excessively pained immediately after the bath and there is a morbid sensitiveness in the teeth one can say that he is sure to die. If a person is extremely frightened whether at night If one sees the rainbow at night or the cluster of stars during the day and is unable to see himself in the eyes of others, he ceases to live.
verses.hindi: श्रीदेवी बोलीं--हे देव! आपने परम शोभासे युक्त उद्यानको मुझे दिखाया; अब आप इस क्षेत्रके समस्त गुणोंको मुझे बतानेकी कृपा करें। है देवेश! हे देवदेव! है वृषभध्वज! आप इस अविमुक्तक्षेत्रका माहात्म्य पूर्णरूपसे बतायें
verses.wordMeaning: If the heart is excessively pained immediately after the bath and there is a morbid sensitiveness in the teeth one can say that he is sure to die.…
verses.commentary: Sense: If the heart is excessively pained immediately after the bath and there is a morbid sensitiveness in the teeth one can say that he is sure to die.…

verses.sanskrit: यदेतद्द्रविणं नाम प्राणा ह्येते बहिश्चराः स तस्य हरते प्राणान् यो यस्य हरते धनम्
verses.transliteration: yadetaddraviṇaṃ nāma prāṇā hyete bahiścarāḥ sa tasya harate prāṇān yo yasya harate dhanam
verses.translation: If one of the eyes begins to water, if the ears arc dis- lodged and if the nose becomes bent in dream the man is sure to die soon. If the tongue becomes black and rough, if the face be- comes red like lotus, and if the cheeks develop red fleshy swelling, his death is imminent. If a man with dishevelled hair were to come face to face in the southern direction, singing, laughing and dancing, his life ends with that.
verses.hindi: सूतजी बोले--हे ऋषियो! तब देवीका वह वचन सुनकर देवदेव श्रेष्ठ प्रभु उनके मुखकमलको सूँघकर हँसते हुए पार्वतीसे कहने लगे
verses.wordMeaning: If one of the eyes begins to water, if the ears arc dis- lodged and if the nose becomes bent in dream the man is sure to die soon. If the tongue becomes black and rough, if the face be- comes red like lotus, and if the cheeks develop red fleshy swelling, his death is imminent.…
verses.commentary: Sense: If one of the eyes begins to water, if the ears arc dis- lodged and if the nose becomes bent in dream the man is sure to die soon. If the tongue becomes black and rough, if the face be- comes red like lotus, and if the cheeks develop red fleshy swelling, his death is imminent.…

verses.sanskrit: एवं कृत्वा सुदुष्टात्मा भिन्नवृत्तो व्रताच्च्युतः भूयो निर्वेदमापन्नश् चरेच्चान्द्रायणं व्रतम्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ kṛtvā suduṣṭātmā bhinnavṛtto vratāccyutaḥ bhūyo nirvedamāpannaś careccāndrāyaṇaṃ vratam
verses.translation: If the body is frequently pale, white in colour with the lustre of white clouds or like white mustard his death is imminent. If one dreams that camels and donkeys are yoked to chariots they are inauspicious. If the chariot is seen going towards the southern direction he will cease to live. The following dreams indicate that death is im- minent:— Any two of the previous portents occurring simultane- ously, not hearing noise in the ear, not seeing lustre in the eye, falling into a pit, inability to rise up from the pit and closing of a door.
verses.hindi: श्रीभगवान् बोले- वाराणसी नामक यह मेरा नित्य गुह्यतम क्षेत्र है; यह सर्वदा सभी प्राणियोंके मोक्षका हेतु है  है देवि! इस क्षेत्र-में सिद्ध लोग सदा मेरे ब्रतमें स्थित रहते हैं और मेरे लोकको अभिलाषा करनेवाले लोग नित्य अनेकविध लिङ्गोंको धारण किये रहते हैं। अनेक प्रकारके वृक्षोंसे युक्त, अनेक प्रकारके पक्षियोंसे सुशोभित, कमल तथा उत्पलके पुष्पासे सम्पन्न सरोवरोंसे अलंकृत और अप्सराओं तथा
verses.wordMeaning: If the body is frequently pale, white in colour with the lustre of white clouds or like white mustard his death is imminent. If one dreams that camels and donkeys are yoked to chariots they are inauspicious.…
verses.commentary: Sense: If the body is frequently pale, white in colour with the lustre of white clouds or like white mustard his death is imminent. If one dreams that camels and donkeys are yoked to chariots they are inauspicious.…

verses.sanskrit: विधिना शास्त्रदृष्टेन संवत्सरमिति श्रुतिः ततः संवत्सरस्यान्ते भूयः प्रक्षीणकल्मषः पुनर्निर्वेदमापन्नश् चरेद्भिक्षुरतन्द्रितः
verses.transliteration: vidhinā śāstradṛṣṭena saṃvatsaramiti śrutiḥ tataḥ saṃvatsarasyānte bhūyaḥ prakṣīṇakalmaṣaḥ punarnirvedamāpannaś caredbhikṣuratandritaḥ
verses.translation: These are signs of imminent death: The eyes are turned upwards, they are not steady, they are red, they revolve, there is dryness in the mouth, there is a hole in the umbilicus and the urine is excessively hot. The person is indeed in difficulties. Whether during day or night if a person is directly killed but he does not sec the murderer his life is extinct. He will cease to live. If at the end of a dream, a man sees that he enters fire and does not remember it at all, his life ends with that.
verses.hindi: गन्धर्वोसे सेवित इस शुभ क्षेत्रमें युक्तात्मा जितेन्द्रिय लोग श्रेष्ठ योगका अभ्यास करते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: These are signs of imminent death: The eyes are turned upwards, they are not steady, they are red, they revolve, there is dryness in the mouth, there is a hole in the umbilicus and the urine is excessively hot. The person is indeed in difficulties.…
verses.commentary: Sense: These are signs of imminent death: The eyes are turned upwards, they are not steady, they are red, they revolve, there is dryness in the mouth, there is a hole in the umbilicus and the urine is excessively hot. The person is indeed in difficulties.…

verses.sanskrit: अहिंसा सर्वभूतानां कर्मणा मनसा गिरा अकामादपि हिंसेत यदि भिक्षुः पशून् कृमीन्
verses.transliteration: ahiṃsā sarvabhūtānāṃ karmaṇā manasā girā akāmādapi hiṃseta yadi bhikṣuḥ paśūn kṛmīn
verses.translation: If a man sees his own white blanket as a black one, in the course of the dream or as a red one, his death is imminent. If the portents are indicated in the body and that time of deatli has arrived, the intelligent man shall eschew sorrow and dejection and treat it with indifference. With cleanliness and purity he shall set off in the direction of east or north. He shall sit in a steady level ground in a secluded spot devoid of creatures. He shall sit facing the east or the north and perform the rite of acamana. He shall sit in the posture of Svastika and bow to Mahevara. The body, the head and the neck shall be erect like a lamp in a wind- less spot. He shall be steady without flickering. He shall not look at anything else while practising Dharana (Retention).
verses.hindi: हे देवि! जिस कारणसे मुझे यहाँ निवास करना अच्छा लगता है, उसे सुनो। मुझमें अपने मनको स्थिर रखनेवाला तथा मुझमें सदा सभी क्रियाएँ अर्पित करनेवाला मेरा भक्त जिस प्रकारका मोक्ष यहाँ प्राप्त करता है, वैसा अन्यत्र कहीं भी नहीं। है देवि! यहाँ मरनेवाला प्राणी मोक्ष प्राप्त करता है। मेरा यह पुर दिव्य, गुह्यसे भी गुह्यतम तथा महान् है-इसे ब्रह्मा आदि, सिद्धगण तथा मुक्तिके इच्छुक लोग जानते हैं।
verses.wordMeaning: If a man sees his own white blanket as a black one, in the course of the dream or as a red one, his death is imminent. If the portents are indicated in the body and that time of deatli has arrived,…
verses.commentary: Sense: If a man sees his own white blanket as a black one, in the course of the dream or as a red one, his death is imminent. If the portents are indicated in the body and that time of deatli has arrived,…

verses.sanskrit: कृच्छ्रातिकृच्छ्रं कुर्वीत चान्द्रायणमथापि वा स्कन्देदिन्द्रियदौर्बल्यात् स्त्रियं दृष्ट्वा यतिर्यदि
verses.transliteration: kṛcchrātikṛcchraṃ kurvīta cāndrāyaṇamathāpi vā skandedindriyadaurbalyāt striyaṃ dṛṣṭvā yatiryadi
verses.translation: The knower of scriptures shall practise yoga in the spot facing the north-east. He shall restrain lust, doubt, pleasure, happiness and misery mentally and only concentrate on clean meditation. He shall meditate on the nose, tongue, eyes, skin, ears and mind. He shall retain them in the intellect and chest. After realising the time and actions he shall retain these parts of the body in the groups perpetually. This retention of the twelve parts of the body is called yogadharana. The man shall perform hundred or fifty such Dharanas on the head. If he becomes exhausted due to the practice of Dharana, the wind begins to function upwards. He shall fill the body with the wind along with the Oihkara. The yogin identifying himself with Oihkara shall merge himself in imperi- shable being. He shall become imperishable thus. This should be known as having three Matras (units), the consonant in it is the deity. The first Matra is Vidyuti (pertaining to lightning). The second is Tamasi [having Tamo-Guna].
verses.hindi: अतः यह परम क्षेत्र मेरी परम गति है। मैंने कभी भी इसका त्याग नहीं किया है और न तो कभी इसका त्याग करूँगा, अतः मेरा यह क्षेत्र अविमुक्त कहा गया
verses.wordMeaning: The knower of scriptures shall practise yoga in the spot facing the north-east. He shall restrain lust, doubt, pleasure, happiness and misery mentally and only concentrate on clean meditation. He shall meditate on the nose, tongue, eyes, skin, ears and mind.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The knower of scriptures shall practise yoga in the spot facing the north-east. He shall restrain lust, doubt, pleasure, happiness and misery mentally and only concentrate on clean meditation. He shall meditate on the nose, tongue, eyes, skin, ears and mind.…

verses.sanskrit: तेन धारयितव्या वै प्राणायामास्तु षोडश दिवा स्कन्नस्य विप्रस्य प्रायश्चित्तं विधीयते
verses.transliteration: tena dhārayitavyā vai prāṇāyāmāstu ṣoḍaśa divā skannasya viprasya prāyaścittaṃ vidhīyate
verses.translation: The third is Nirguna (devoid of attributes). It covers up the imperishable Being. It should be known as Gandhari too, because it originates from the Gandhara note (the third of the seven primary notes of Indian Gamut). When the Oihkara that is uttered recedes to the head The yogin identical with the Oihkara becomes identi- cal with the imperishable Being. Pranava is the bow, Atman is the arrow and Brahman is the target. It should be pierced by one who does not err. He shall be concentrated I"
verses.hindi: नैमिषे च कुरुक्षेत्रे गङ्गाद्वारे च पुष्करे॥ स्नानात्संसेवनाद्वापि न मोक्षः प्राप्यते यतः। प्रयागे वा भवेन्मोक्ष इह वा मत्परिग्रहात्। प्रयागादपि तीर्थाग्र्थादविमुक्तमिदं शुभम्
verses.wordMeaning: The third is Nirguna (devoid of attributes). It covers up the imperishable Being. It should be known as Gandhari too, because it originates from the Gandhara note (the third of the seven primary notes of Indian Gamut).…
verses.commentary: Sense: The third is Nirguna (devoid of attributes). It covers up the imperishable Being. It should be known as Gandhari too, because it originates from the Gandhara note (the third of the seven primary notes of Indian Gamut).…

verses.sanskrit: त्रिरात्रमुपवासाश् च प्राणायामशतं तथा रात्रौ स्कन्नः शुचिः स्नात्वा द्वादशैव तु धारणा
verses.transliteration: trirātramupavāsāś ca prāṇāyāmaśataṃ tathā rātrau skannaḥ śuciḥ snātvā dvādaśaiva tu dhāraṇā
verses.translation: The letter "A" should be known as Aksara (Imperish- able); the letter "U** is then along with it. Including the letter The letter "A** is the Bhurloka; the letter "U** is Bhuvarloka, the letter "M'* is Svarloka. The Om represents the three worlds. Its head is the Heaven. All the worlds constitute its limbs (body). Its feet are constituted by Brahmaloka.
verses.hindi: धर्मस्योपनिषत्सत्यं मोक्षस्योपनिषच्छमः। क्षेत्रतीर्थोपनिषदं न विदुर्बुधसत्तमाः
verses.wordMeaning: The letter "A" should be known as Aksara (Imperish- able); the letter "U** is then along with it. Including the letter The letter "A** is the Bhurloka; the letter "U** is Bhuvarloka, the letter "M'* is Svarloka. The Om represents the three worlds. Its head is the Heaven.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The letter "A" should be known as Aksara (Imperish- able); the letter "U** is then along with it. Including the letter The letter "A** is the Bhurloka; the letter "U** is Bhuvarloka, the letter "M'* is Svarloka. The Om represents the three worlds. Its head is the Heaven.…

verses.sanskrit: प्राणायामेन शुद्धात्मा विरजा जायते द्विजाः एकान्नं मधुमांसं वा अशृतान्नं तथैव च
verses.transliteration: prāṇāyāmena śuddhātmā virajā jāyate dvijāḥ ekānnaṃ madhumāṃsaṃ vā aśṛtānnaṃ tathaiva ca
verses.translation: Rudra's world is the foot of the Matra, Siva's region is devoid of Matras (i.e. above them). It is with this special knowledge that, that region is worshipped. Hence, the devotee shall be interested in meditation. Indeed that imperishable Being devoid of Matras, should be assiduously worshipped by one who wishes for permanent happiness. The first Matra is a short, the next one is long; the third Matra is Pluta (prolated vowel). These Matras should be known in their proper order. They are to be retained only as long as it is possible.
verses.hindi: कामं भुञ्जन् स्वपन् क्रीडन् कुर्वन् हि विविधाः क्रिया: । अविमुक्ते त्यजेत्प्राणान् जन्तुर्मोक्षाय कल्पते कृत्वा पापसहस्त्राणि पिशाचत्वं वरं नृणाम्।
verses.wordMeaning: Rudra's world is the foot of the Matra, Siva's region is devoid of Matras (i.e. above them). It is with this special knowledge that, that region is worshipped. Hence, the devotee shall be interested in meditation. Indeed that imperishable Being devoid of Matras,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Rudra's world is the foot of the Matra, Siva's region is devoid of Matras (i.e. above them). It is with this special knowledge that, that region is worshipped. Hence, the devotee shall be interested in meditation. Indeed that imperishable Being devoid of Matras,…

verses.sanskrit: अभोज्यानि यतीनां तु प्रत्यक्षलवणानि च एकैकातिक्रमात्तेषां प्रायश्चित्तं विधीयते
verses.transliteration: abhojyāni yatīnāṃ tu pratyakṣalavaṇāni ca ekaikātikramātteṣāṃ prāyaścittaṃ vidhīyate
verses.translation: He who always meditates on the sense-organs, mind and intellect in the Atman and listens to even half a Matra shall attain its benefit. Thanks to that Matra, one attains the merit which a person attains by a horse-sacrifice every month, continuing it for a hundred years. Neither by a severe penance nor by sacrifices with plenty of gifts can that merit be obtained which is perfectly obtained by means of the Matra. The householder yogins shall practise only that Matra which is taught as Pluta (Prolated Vowel).
verses.hindi: न तु शक्रसहस्रत्वं स्वर्गे काशीपुरीं विना
verses.wordMeaning: He who always meditates on the sense-organs, mind and intellect in the Atman and listens to even half a Matra shall attain its benefit. Thanks to that Matra, one attains the merit which a person attains by a horse-sacrifice every month, continuing it for a hundred years.…
verses.commentary: Sense: He who always meditates on the sense-organs, mind and intellect in the Atman and listens to even half a Matra shall attain its benefit. Thanks to that Matra, one attains the merit which a person attains by a horse-sacrifice every month, continuing it for a hundred years.…

verses.sanskrit: प्राजापत्येन कृच्छ्रेण ततः पापात्प्रमुच्यते व्यतिक्रमाश् च ये केचिद् वाङ्मनःकायसंभवाः
verses.transliteration: prājāpatyena kṛcchreṇa tataḥ pāpātpramucyate vyatikramāś ca ye kecid vāṅmanaḥkāyasaṃbhavāḥ
verses.translation: This Matra alone comprises the eightfold Aiivarya beginning with Anima.®*® Hence, O brahmins, be in commu- nion with it. O brahmins, he who knows and realises the Atman obtains everything. He shall be endowed with yoga.**® He shall be pure. He shall subdue the sense-organs. He shall control them. Hence, the learned man shall contemplate the Atman by means of the yoga pertaining to Paupati. Those who know the Atman are certainly pure beings.
verses.hindi: तस्मात्संसेवनीयं हि अविमुक्तं हि मुक्तये। जैगीषव्यः परां सिद्धिं गतो यत्र महातपाः कैवल्यं परमं याति देवानामपि दुर्लभम्
verses.wordMeaning: This Matra alone comprises the eightfold Aiivarya beginning with Anima.®*® Hence, O brahmins, be in commu- nion with it. O brahmins, he who knows and realises the Atman obtains everything. He shall be endowed with yoga.**® He shall be pure. He shall subdue the sense-organs.…
verses.commentary: Sense: This Matra alone comprises the eightfold Aiivarya beginning with Anima.®*® Hence, O brahmins, be in commu- nion with it. O brahmins, he who knows and realises the Atman obtains everything. He shall be endowed with yoga.**® He shall be pure. He shall subdue the sense-organs.…

verses.sanskrit: सद्भिः सह विनिश्चित्य यद्ब्रूयुस्तत्समाचरेत्
verses.transliteration: sadbhiḥ saha viniścitya yadbrūyustatsamācaret
verses.translation: It is through the knowledge of yoga that the brahmin, thinker on spiritual topics, attains the Rk, Saman, Yajur mantras, in fact all the Vedas and the Upanisads. He becomes identical with all Devas and devoid of all elements. He gets rid of the necessity of passing through wombs and attains the perpetual region. Just as the ripe fruit falls off the tree on being tossed about by the wind, so also sin perishes by the grace of Rudra. Where the obeisance to Rudra yields the benefits of all Karmans, one shall not attain those benefits through the obei- sance to the other deities.
verses.hindi: अव्यक्तलिङ्कैर्मुनिभिः सर्वसिद्धान्तवेदिभिः। इह सम्प्राप्यते मोक्षो दुर्लभोऽन्यत्र कर्हिचित्
verses.wordMeaning: It is through the knowledge of yoga that the brahmin, thinker on spiritual topics, attains the Rk, Saman, Yajur mantras, in fact all the Vedas and the Upanisads. He becomes identical with all Devas and devoid of all elements.…
verses.commentary: Sense: It is through the knowledge of yoga that the brahmin, thinker on spiritual topics, attains the Rk, Saman, Yajur mantras, in fact all the Vedas and the Upanisads. He becomes identical with all Devas and devoid of all elements.…

verses.sanskrit: चरेद्धि शुद्धः समलोष्टकाञ्चनः समस्तभूतेषु च सत्समाहितः स्थानं ध्रुवं शाश्वतमव्ययं तु परं हि गत्वा न पुनर्हि जायते
verses.transliteration: careddhi śuddhaḥ samaloṣṭakāñcanaḥ samastabhūteṣu ca satsamāhitaḥ sthānaṃ dhruvaṃ śāśvatamavyayaṃ tu paraṃ hi gatvā na punarhi jāyate
verses.translation: Hence, the yogin shall worship Mahe vara repeat- ing the Pranava twice. He who enlarges the scope of the Vedas ten times more by elaborating the Vedic texts shall meditate and then forsake the body. He uplifts three generations and attains Sayujja salvation with iSiva. Or after seeing any evil portent and when the time of death has arrived the man shall go to Avimuktesvara in Varanasi and perform the expiatory rite. Somehow the man shall abandon his body there when, O leading brahmins, he is liberated. The man may abandon his body on the mountain, Sriparvata.®*® He attains identity with Siva. No doubt need be entertained in this regard. Avimukta is a greatest shrine always bestowing salvation on the creatures. The intelligent man shall resort to it always especially when death is imminent. ST. defines 'yoga-jnSnam' as yoga-yuktam jfianam' i. e. know- ledge joined with meditation. Yoga is the means for the attainment of right or perfect knowledge *yogo hi jfiana-shanam.*
verses.hindi: कषेत्रसंसेवनादेव गणेशत्वमवाप ह इहैवाराध्य मां देवि सिद्धि यास्यत्यनुत्तमाम्
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, the yogin shall worship Mahe vara repeat- ing the Pranava twice. He who enlarges the scope of the Vedas ten times more by elaborating the Vedic texts shall meditate and then forsake the body. He uplifts three generations and attains Sayujja salvation with iSiva.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, the yogin shall worship Mahe vara repeat- ing the Pranava twice. He who enlarges the scope of the Vedas ten times more by elaborating the Vedic texts shall meditate and then forsake the body. He uplifts three generations and attains Sayujja salvation with iSiva.…

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीलिङ्गमहापुराणे पूर्वभागे यतिप्रायश्चित्तं नाम नवतितमो ऽध्यायः अत ऊर्ध्वं प्रवक्ष्यामि अरिष्टानि निबोधत येन ज्ञानविशेषेण मृत्युं पश्यन्ति योगिनः
verses.transliteration: iti śrīliṅgamahāpurāṇe pūrvabhāge yatiprāyaścittaṃ nāma navatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ ata ūrdhvaṃ pravakṣyāmi ariṣṭāni nibodhata yena jñānaviśeṣeṇa mṛtyuṃ paśyanti yoginaḥ
verses.translation: Henceforth, I shall mention the Aristas (the phenomena that indicate misfortune and even death); understand them. It is by means of this special knowledge that the yogins visua- lise death.
verses.hindi: पराशरसुतो योगी ऋषिर्व्यासो महातपाः । मम भक्तो भविष्यश्च वेदसंस्थाप्रवर्तकः
verses.wordMeaning: Henceforth, I shall mention the Aristas (the phenomena that indicate misfortune and even death); understand them. It is by means of this special knowledge that the yogins visua- lise death.
verses.commentary: Sense: Henceforth, I shall mention the Aristas (the phenomena that indicate misfortune and even death); understand them. It is by means of this special knowledge that the yogins visua- lise death.

verses.sanskrit: अरुन्धतीं ध्रुवं चैव सोमछायां महापथम् यो न पश्येन्न जीवेत्स नरः संवत्सरात्परम्
verses.transliteration: arundhatīṃ dhruvaṃ caiva somachāyāṃ mahāpatham yo na paśyenna jīvetsa naraḥ saṃvatsarātparam
verses.translation: He who is not able to see Arundhati (a constellation among the Pleiades) Dhruva (Pole star), the shadow of the moon and the Mahapatha (Milky Way) shall not live more than a year.
verses.hindi: नैमिषारण्य, कुरुक्षेत्र, हरिद्वार तथा पुष्करमें करने तथा वहाँ निवास नेसे मोक्ष नहीं प्राप्त होता है बल्कि यहाँ प्राप्त हो जाता है, अत: यह अन्य तीथ विशिष्ट है । प्रयागमें अथवा यहाँपर मेरे परिग्रहके मुक्ति होती है; तीर्थॉमें अग्रणी (श्रेष्ठ) प्रयागसे भी यह अविमुक्त क्षेत्र है ॥ ४६-४८१. ॥
verses.wordMeaning: He who is not able to see Arundhati (a constellation among the Pleiades) Dhruva (Pole star), the shadow of the moon and the Mahapatha (Milky Way) shall not live more than a year.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who is not able to see Arundhati (a constellation among the Pleiades) Dhruva (Pole star), the shadow of the moon and the Mahapatha (Milky Way) shall not live more than a year.

verses.sanskrit: अरिश्मवन्तम् आदित्यं रश्मिवन्तं च पावकम् यः पश्यति न जीवेद्वै मासादेकादशात्परम्
verses.transliteration: ariśmavantam ādityaṃ raśmivantaṃ ca pāvakam yaḥ paśyati na jīvedvai māsādekādaśātparam
verses.translation: He who dreams that he vomits, passes urine and eva- cuates stools in the form of gold and silver shall not live full ten months thereafter.
verses.hindi: धर्मका सारतत्त्व सत्य है, मोक्षका सारतत्त्व शम है किंतु क्षेत्रतीर्थके सारतत्त्वको क्रषिगण भी नहीं जानते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: He who dreams that he vomits, passes urine and eva- cuates stools in the form of gold and silver shall not live full ten months thereafter.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who dreams that he vomits, passes urine and eva- cuates stools in the form of gold and silver shall not live full ten months thereafter.

verses.sanskrit: वमेन्मूत्रं पुरीषं च सुवर्णं रजतं तथा प्रत्यक्षमथवा स्वप्ने दशमासान्न जीवति
verses.transliteration: vamenmūtraṃ purīṣaṃ ca suvarṇaṃ rajataṃ tathā pratyakṣamathavā svapne daśamāsānna jīvati
verses.translation: He who sees a gold-coloured tree, the Gandharva city, (i.e. the hallucination of an imaginary city), ghosts and spirits shall live only for nine months.
verses.hindi: इच्छानुसार खाता हुआ, सोता हुआ, क्रीड़ा करता हुआ तथा अनेक क्रियाएँ करता हुआ भी प्राणी इस अविमुक्तक्षेत्रमें प्राणत्याग करे, तो वह मोक्ष प्राप्त करता  है यहाँ हजारों पाप करके पिशाचत्वको प्राप्त होना मनुष्योंके लिये अच्छा है, किंतु काशीपुरीको छोड़कर  स्वर्गमें हजार बार इन्द्र होना अच्छा नहीं है। अतएव मुक्तिके लिये इस अविमुक्तक्षेत्रमे निवास करना चाहिए।
verses.wordMeaning: He who sees a gold-coloured tree, the Gandharva city, (i.e. the hallucination of an imaginary city), ghosts and spirits shall live only for nine months.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who sees a gold-coloured tree, the Gandharva city, (i.e. the hallucination of an imaginary city), ghosts and spirits shall live only for nine months.

verses.sanskrit: रुक्मवर्णं द्रुमं पश्येद् गन्धर्वनगराणि च पश्येत् प्रेतपिशाचांश् च नवमासान् स जीवति
verses.transliteration: rukmavarṇaṃ drumaṃ paśyed gandharvanagarāṇi ca paśyet pretapiśācāṃś ca navamāsān sa jīvati
verses.translation: He who becomes stout or lean all of a sudden, i.e., he who thus moves away from his nature shall live only for eight months.
verses.hindi: महातपस्वी महर्षि जैगीषव्यने इस क्षेत्रके माहात्म्यसे तथा  मेरी भक्तिसे युक्त होकर परम सिद्धि प्राप्त की थी।  महर्षि जैगीषव्यकी श्रेष्ठ गुफा योगियोंकी स्थली मानी जाती है। योगी लोग वहाँ सदा मेरा ध्यान करते हैं और
verses.wordMeaning: He who becomes stout or lean all of a sudden, i.e., he who thus moves away from his nature shall live only for eight months.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who becomes stout or lean all of a sudden, i.e., he who thus moves away from his nature shall live only for eight months.

verses.sanskrit: अकस्माच्च भवेत्स्थूलो ह्य् अकस्माच्च कृशो भवेत् प्रकृतेश् च निवर्तेत चाष्टौ मासांश् च जीवति
verses.transliteration: akasmācca bhavetsthūlo hy akasmācca kṛśo bhavet prakṛteś ca nivarteta cāṣṭau māsāṃś ca jīvati
verses.translation: He whose footprint appears split in front or behind in the dust or in mud lives only up to seven months.
verses.hindi: वहाँ योगकी अग्नि तीव्रतासे प्रज्चलित होती रहती है। मनुष्य यहाँ परम कैवल्य (मोक्ष) प्राप्त करता है, जो देवताओंके लिये भी दुर्लभ है अव्यक्त लिङ्गोंवाले तथा सभी सिद्धान्तोंकी  जाननेवाले मुनिगण यहाँ मोक्ष प्राप्त करते हैं, जो अन्यत्र  कहीं भी दुर्लभ है। मैं उनके लिये अत्युत्तम योगैश्वर्य  तथा अपने सायुज्यरूप अभीष्ट स्थानको बताऊँगा। मेरे
verses.wordMeaning: He whose footprint appears split in front or behind in the dust or in mud lives only up to seven months.
verses.commentary: Sense: He whose footprint appears split in front or behind in the dust or in mud lives only up to seven months.

verses.sanskrit: अग्रतः पृष्ठतो वापि खण्डं यस्य पदं भवेत् पांसुके कर्दमे वापि सप्तमासान्स जीवति
verses.transliteration: agrataḥ pṛṣṭhato vāpi khaṇḍaṃ yasya padaṃ bhavet pāṃsuke kardame vāpi saptamāsānsa jīvati
verses.translation: If a crow, or a dove, or a vulture or any other bird of prey perches on one's head, one shall not survive six months.
verses.hindi: क्षेत्रमें अपनी सभी क्रियाएँ मुझमें समर्पित करनेवाले कुबेरने क्षेत्रके सेवनसे ही गणेशत्वको प्राप्त किया था।  हे देवि! जो ऋषि संवर्त नामक मेरे भक्त जन्म लँगै,  वे भी यहाँ मेरी आराधना करके उत्तम सिद्धि प्रा
verses.wordMeaning: If a crow, or a dove, or a vulture or any other bird of prey perches on one's head, one shall not survive six months.
verses.commentary: Sense: If a crow, or a dove, or a vulture or any other bird of prey perches on one's head, one shall not survive six months.

verses.sanskrit: काकः कपोतो गृध्रो वा निलीयेद्यस्य मूर्धनि क्रव्यादो वा खगो यस्य षण्मासान् नातिवर्तते
verses.transliteration: kākaḥ kapoto gṛdhro vā nilīyedyasya mūrdhani kravyādo vā khago yasya ṣaṇmāsān nātivartate
verses.translation: He who goes in the company of lows of crows or of a dust storm, he who sees his own shadow in a deformed state shall live only for four or five months.
verses.hindi: करेंगे। है कमलनयने! महातपस्वी पराशरपुत्र योगै  ऋषि व्यास मेरे भक्त होंगे; वेदसंहिताओंका प्रवर्तन ३स्यते सोऽपि पद्याक्षि क्षेत्रेऽस्मिन् मुनिपुङ्कवः। ब्रह्मा देवर्षिभिः सार्धे विष्णुर्वापि दिवाकरः
verses.wordMeaning: He who goes in the company of lows of crows or of a dust storm, he who sees his own shadow in a deformed state shall live only for four or five months.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who goes in the company of lows of crows or of a dust storm, he who sees his own shadow in a deformed state shall live only for four or five months.

verses.sanskrit: गच्छेद् वायसपङ्क्तीभिः पांसुवर्षेण वा पुनः स्वच्छायां विकृतां पश्येच् चतुःपञ्च स जीवति
verses.transliteration: gacched vāyasapaṅktībhiḥ pāṃsuvarṣeṇa vā punaḥ svacchāyāṃ vikṛtāṃ paśyec catuḥpañca sa jīvati
verses.translation: He who sees lightning in a spot that is not the sky and the lightning in the southern direction or he who sees the rain- bow in the water shall live for only one or two months.
verses.hindi: देवदेवं समासाद्य धीमन्तः सङ्गवर्जिताः। गता इह परं मोक्षं प्रसादान्मम सुद्रते
verses.wordMeaning: He who sees lightning in a spot that is not the sky and the lightning in the southern direction or he who sees the rain- bow in the water shall live for only one or two months.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who sees lightning in a spot that is not the sky and the lightning in the southern direction or he who sees the rain- bow in the water shall live for only one or two months.

verses.sanskrit: अनभ्रे विद्युतं पश्येद् दक्षिणां दिशमास्थिताम् उदके धनुर् ऐन्द्रं वा त्रीणि द्वौ वा स जीवति
verses.transliteration: anabhre vidyutaṃ paśyed dakṣiṇāṃ diśamāsthitām udake dhanur aindraṃ vā trīṇi dvau vā sa jīvati
verses.translation: If one is not able to see oneself either in water or in the mirror or if he sees it devoid of the head he will not live beyond a month.
verses.hindi: तमिहैव परं मोक्षं प्रसादान्मम सुव्रते गोप्रेक्षकमिदं क्षेत्रं ब्रह्मणा स्थापितं पुरा। कैलासभवनं चात्र पश्य दिव्यं वरानने
verses.wordMeaning: If one is not able to see oneself either in water or in the mirror or if he sees it devoid of the head he will not live beyond a month.
verses.commentary: Sense: If one is not able to see oneself either in water or in the mirror or if he sees it devoid of the head he will not live beyond a month.

verses.sanskrit: अप्सु वा यदि वादर्शे यो ह्यात्मानं न पश्यति अशिरस्कं तथा पश्येन् मासाद् ऊर्ध्वं न जीवति
verses.transliteration: apsu vā yadi vādarśe yo hyātmānaṃ na paśyati aśiraskaṃ tathā paśyen māsād ūrdhvaṃ na jīvati
verses.translation: If the body emits the odour of a dead body or of fat, his death is imminent. He will not live beyond a fortnight.
verses.hindi: कपिलाहृदमित्येवं तथा वै ब्रह्मणा कृतम्। गवां स्तन्यजतोयेन तीर्थ पुण्यतमं महत्
verses.wordMeaning: If the body emits the odour of a dead body or of fat, his death is imminent. He will not live beyond a fortnight.
verses.commentary: Sense: If the body emits the odour of a dead body or of fat, his death is imminent. He will not live beyond a fortnight.

verses.sanskrit: शवगन्धि भवेद्गात्रं वसागन्धमथापि वा मृत्युर्ह्युपागतस्तस्य अर्धमासान्न जीवति
verses.transliteration: śavagandhi bhavedgātraṃ vasāgandhamathāpi vā mṛtyurhyupāgatastasya ardhamāsānna jīvati
verses.translation: If immediately after the bath the heart appears to dry up or smoke is seen coming out of the head, he will not live even for ten days.
verses.hindi: सान्निध्यं कृतवान् देवि सदाहं दृश्यते त्वया भद्र्तोयं च पश्येह ब्रह्मणा च कृतं हृदम्। सर्वैर्देवेरह देवि अस्मिन् देशे प्रसादितः
verses.wordMeaning: If immediately after the bath the heart appears to dry up or smoke is seen coming out of the head, he will not live even for ten days.
verses.commentary: Sense: If immediately after the bath the heart appears to dry up or smoke is seen coming out of the head, he will not live even for ten days.

verses.sanskrit: यस्य वै स्नातमात्रस्य हृदयं परिशुष्यति धूमं वा मस्तकात्पश्येद् दशाहान्न स जीवति
verses.transliteration: yasya vai snātamātrasya hṛdayaṃ pariśuṣyati dhūmaṃ vā mastakātpaśyed daśāhānna sa jīvati
verses.translation: If the bursting wind pierces the vital parts, if the hairs do not stand on their ends on being sprinkled with water, his deaih is imminent.
verses.hindi: गच्छोपशममीशेति उपशान्तः शिवस्तथा। अत्राहं ब्रह्मणानीय स्थापितः परमेष्ठिना
verses.wordMeaning: If the bursting wind pierces the vital parts, if the hairs do not stand on their ends on being sprinkled with water, his deaih is imminent.
verses.commentary: Sense: If the bursting wind pierces the vital parts, if the hairs do not stand on their ends on being sprinkled with water, his deaih is imminent.

verses.sanskrit: संभिन्नो मारुतो यस्य मर्मस्थानानि कृन्तति अद्भिः स्पृष्टो न हृष्येत तस्य मृत्युरुपस्थितः
verses.transliteration: saṃbhinno māruto yasya marmasthānāni kṛntati adbhiḥ spṛṣṭo na hṛṣyeta tasya mṛtyurupasthitaḥ
verses.translation: If one dreams of going towards the southern diicction in a chariot to which monkeys and bears are yoked, and sings and dances in the meantime, it should be known that death is imminent.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्मणा चापि सङ्गृह्य विष्णुना स्थापितः पुनः । ब्रह्मणापि ततो विष्णुः प्रोक्तः संविग्नचेतसा मयानीतमिदं लिङ्गं 'कस्मात्स्थापितवानसि। तमुवाच पुनर्विष्णुर्बह्माणं कुपिताननम्
verses.wordMeaning: If one dreams of going towards the southern diicction in a chariot to which monkeys and bears are yoked, and sings and dances in the meantime, it should be known that death is imminent.
verses.commentary: Sense: If one dreams of going towards the southern diicction in a chariot to which monkeys and bears are yoked, and sings and dances in the meantime, it should be known that death is imminent.

verses.sanskrit: ऋक्षवानरयुक्तेन रथेनाशां च दक्षिणाम् गायन्नृत्यन् व्रजेत् स्वप्ने विद्यान्मृत्युरुपस्थितः
verses.transliteration: ṛkṣavānarayuktena rathenāśāṃ ca dakṣiṇām gāyannṛtyan vrajet svapne vidyānmṛtyurupasthitaḥ
verses.translation: If in the dream, a singing dark-complexioned woman who wears black clothes leads a person to the southern direc- tion he will not live long.
verses.hindi: अविमुक्तक्षेत्र वाराणसीका माहात्म्य तथा श्रीविश्वेश्वरपूजाविधिवर्णन
verses.wordMeaning: If in the dream, a singing dark-complexioned woman who wears black clothes leads a person to the southern direc- tion he will not live long.
verses.commentary: Sense: If in the dream, a singing dark-complexioned woman who wears black clothes leads a person to the southern direc- tion he will not live long.

verses.sanskrit: कृष्णांबरधरा श्यामा गायन्ती वाप्यथाङ्गना यं नयेद्दक्षिणामाशां स्वप्ने सो ऽपि न जीवति
verses.transliteration: kṛṣṇāṃbaradharā śyāmā gāyantī vāpyathāṅganā yaṃ nayeddakṣiṇāmāśāṃ svapne so 'pi na jīvati
verses.translation: If a man secs a slit in his own neck in thf' dream, or dreams of a naked sramana (Buddhist recluse) know that death is imminent.
verses.hindi: करनेवाले वे मुनिश्रेष्ठ भी इस क्षेत्रमें विहार करेंगे। हे सुत्रते ! देवर्षियोंके साथ ब्रह्मा, विष्णु, सूर्य, देवराज इन्द्र अन्य देवता लोग तथा महात्मा-ये सब यहाँपर मेरी उपासना करते हैं गुप्त रूप धारणकर एकाग्रचित्त होकर यहाँपर सदा मेरी उपासना करते रहते हैं । विषयोंमें आसक्त मनवाला तथा धर्मका त्याग किया हुआ मनुष्य भी यदि इस क्षेत्रमें मृत हो जाय, तो वह भी संसारमें पुन: जन्म नहीं प्राप्त
verses.wordMeaning: If a man secs a slit in his own neck in thf' dream, or dreams of a naked sramana (Buddhist recluse) know that death is imminent.
verses.commentary: Sense: If a man secs a slit in his own neck in thf' dream, or dreams of a naked sramana (Buddhist recluse) know that death is imminent.

verses.sanskrit: छिद्रं वा स्वस्य कण्ठस्य स्वप्ने यो वीक्षते नरः नग्नं वा श्रमणं दृष्ट्वा विद्यान्मृत्युमुपस्थितम्
verses.transliteration: chidraṃ vā svasya kaṇṭhasya svapne yo vīkṣate naraḥ nagnaṃ vā śramaṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā vidyānmṛtyumupasthitam
verses.translation: 'The person sinks into the ocean of mire upto the head. On seeing a dream like this, he ceases to live immediately.
verses.hindi: करता है; तो फिर है सुव्रते! जो ममतारहित, धीर, सत्त्वगुणमें स्थित, जितेन्द्रिय, ब्रती, कर्मप्रवृत्तिसे रहित, मुझमें ध्यानरत, बुद्धिमान् तथा संगरहित हैं-वे सब मुझ देवदेवको प्राप्त करके मेरी कृपासे यहाँ श्रेष्ठ
verses.wordMeaning: 'The person sinks into the ocean of mire upto the head. On seeing a dream like this, he ceases to live immediately.
verses.commentary: Sense: 'The person sinks into the ocean of mire upto the head. On seeing a dream like this, he ceases to live immediately.

verses.sanskrit: आ मस्तकतलाद्यस् तु निमज्जेत्पङ्कसागरे दृष्ट्वा तु तादृशं स्वप्नं सद्य एव न जीवति
verses.transliteration: ā mastakatalādyas tu nimajjetpaṅkasāgare dṛṣṭvā tu tādṛśaṃ svapnaṃ sadya eva na jīvati
verses.translation: He who is beaten in dream by dark-complexioned hideous persons with arms lifted up or hit by <tones, ceases to live immediately.
verses.hindi: मोक्ष अवश्य प्राप्त करते हैं। है सुव्रते! हजारों जन्मोंमें भी योगी जिस मोक्ष-को प्राप्त नहीं कर पाता है, उस उत्तम मोक्षको वह यहाँपर मेरी कृपासे प्राप्त कर लेता है हे वरानने! पूर्वकालमें यहाँ ब्रह्माके द्वारा स्थापित किये गये कैलास भवन नामक इस गोप्रेक्षक क्षेत्रको देखो। इस गोप्रेक्षक क्षेत्र-में आकर मेरा दर्शन करके मनुष्य दुर्गति नहीं प्राप्त करता है और पापोंसे छूट जाता
verses.wordMeaning: He who is beaten in dream by dark-complexioned hideous persons with arms lifted up or hit by <tones, ceases to live immediately.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who is beaten in dream by dark-complexioned hideous persons with arms lifted up or hit by <tones, ceases to live immediately.

verses.sanskrit: भस्माङ्गारांश् च केशांश् च नदीं शुष्कां भुजङ्गमान् पश्येद्यो दशरात्रं तु न स जीवति तादृशः
verses.transliteration: bhasmāṅgārāṃś ca keśāṃś ca nadīṃ śuṣkāṃ bhujaṅgamān paśyedyo daśarātraṃ tu na sa jīvati tādṛśaḥ
verses.translation: If jackals howl directly at a, erson early in the mor- ning, at sunrise, that person's days are numbered.
verses.hindi: है। इसी प्रकार यहाँपर ब्रह्माने गायोंके दूधसे कपिलाहृद नामक विशाल तथा पुण्यतम तीर्थका निर्माण किया है। यहाँ भी मैं स्वयं वृषध्वज--इस नामसे विख्यात हूँ। हे देवि! मैंने सदासे यहाँ निवास किया है; ऐसा आप
verses.wordMeaning: If jackals howl directly at a, erson early in the mor- ning, at sunrise, that person's days are numbered.
verses.commentary: Sense: If jackals howl directly at a, erson early in the mor- ning, at sunrise, that person's days are numbered.

verses.sanskrit: कृष्णैश् च विकटैश्चैव पुरुषैरुद्यतायुधैः पाषाणैस्ताड्यते स्वप्ने यः सद्यो न स जीवति
verses.transliteration: kṛṣṇaiś ca vikaṭaiścaiva puruṣairudyatāyudhaiḥ pāṣāṇaistāḍyate svapne yaḥ sadyo na sa jīvati
verses.translation: If the heart is excessively pained immediately after the bath and there is a morbid sensitiveness in the teeth one can say that he is sure to die.
verses.hindi: देखती भी हैं॥ ६७--७०॥ यहाँ ब्रह्माके द्वारा निर्मित किये गये भद्रतोय नामक सरोवरको देखो। है देवि! सभी देवताओंने ' हे ईश! शान्त हो जाइए'-एऐसा कहकर इस स्थानपर मुझ शिवको प्रसन्न किया था, तब मैं शान्त हो गया था। परमेष्ठी ब्रह्माने यहाँ लाकर मुझे स्थापित किया। ब्रह्माजीसे प्राप्त करके विष्णुने पुनः स्थापित किया। तब दुःखी चित्तवाले ब्रह्माने विष्णुसे कहा-आपने मेरे द्वारा
verses.wordMeaning: If the heart is excessively pained immediately after the bath and there is a morbid sensitiveness in the teeth one can say that he is sure to die.
verses.commentary: Sense: If the heart is excessively pained immediately after the bath and there is a morbid sensitiveness in the teeth one can say that he is sure to die.

verses.sanskrit: सूर्योदये प्रत्युषसि प्रत्यक्षं यस्य वै शिवाः क्रोशन्त्यभिमुखं प्रेत्य स गतायुर्भवेन्नरः
verses.transliteration: sūryodaye pratyuṣasi pratyakṣaṃ yasya vai śivāḥ krośantyabhimukhaṃ pretya sa gatāyurbhavennaraḥ
verses.translation: If one sees the rainbow at night or the cluster of stars during the day and is unable to see himself in the eyes of others, he ceases to live.
verses.hindi: लाये गये इस लिङ्गको क्यों स्थापित किया ? तत्पश्चात् विष्णु कुपितमुखवाले उन ब्रह्मासे पुनः बोले-रुद्र
verses.wordMeaning: If one sees the rainbow at night or the cluster of stars during the day and is unable to see himself in the eyes of others, he ceases to live.
verses.commentary: Sense: If one sees the rainbow at night or the cluster of stars during the day and is unable to see himself in the eyes of others, he ceases to live.

verses.sanskrit: यस्य वा स्नातमात्रस्य हृदयं पीड्यते भृशम् जायते दन्तहर्षश् च तं गतायुषमादिशेत्
verses.transliteration: yasya vā snātamātrasya hṛdayaṃ pīḍyate bhṛśam jāyate dantaharṣaś ca taṃ gatāyuṣamādiśet
verses.translation: If one of the eyes begins to water, if the cars are dis- lodged and if the nose becomes bent in dream the man is sure to die soon.
verses.hindi: फफ्फफफफफफफफ्फफफफफाफफाककककामामामामा ममामी माफ फफ फाफ फफफ फफ फफ फफ र फफफ फ़ रुद्रे देवे ममात्यन्तं परा भक्तिर्महत्तरा। मयैव स्थापितं लिङ्गं तव नाम्ना भविष्यति ॥
verses.wordMeaning: If one of the eyes begins to water, if the cars are dis- lodged and if the nose becomes bent in dream the man is sure to die soon.
verses.commentary: Sense: If one of the eyes begins to water, if the cars are dis- lodged and if the nose becomes bent in dream the man is sure to die soon.

verses.sanskrit: भूयोभूयस्त्रसेद्यस्तु रात्रौ वा यदि वा दिवा दीपगन्धं च नाघ्राति विद्यान्मृत्युम् उपस्थितम्
verses.transliteration: bhūyobhūyastrasedyastu rātrau vā yadi vā divā dīpagandhaṃ ca nāghrāti vidyānmṛtyum upasthitam
verses.translation: If the tongue becomes black and rough, if the face be- comes red like lotus, and if the cheeks develop red fleshy swelling, his death is imminent.
verses.hindi: दृष्ट्वैनमपि देवेशं मम लोकं व्रजेन्नरः
verses.wordMeaning: If the tongue becomes black and rough, if the face be- comes red like lotus, and if the cheeks develop red fleshy swelling, his death is imminent.
verses.commentary: Sense: If the tongue becomes black and rough, if the face be- comes red like lotus, and if the cheeks develop red fleshy swelling, his death is imminent.

verses.sanskrit: रात्रौ चेन्द्रधनुः पश्येद् दिवा नक्षत्रमण्डलम् परनेत्रेषु चात्मानं न पश्येन्न स जीवति
verses.transliteration: rātrau cendradhanuḥ paśyed divā nakṣatramaṇḍalam paranetreṣu cātmānaṃ na paśyenna sa jīvati
verses.translation: If a man with dishevelled hair were to come face to face in the southern direction, singing, laugliing and dancing, his life ends with that.
verses.hindi: ततः पुनरपि ब्रह्मा मम लिङ्गमिदं शुभम्। स्थापयामास विधिवद्भक्त्या परमया युतः अस्मिन्नपि मया देशे हैत्यो हैवतकण्टक:
verses.wordMeaning: If a man with dishevelled hair were to come face to face in the southern direction, singing, laugliing and dancing, his life ends with that.
verses.commentary: Sense: If a man with dishevelled hair were to come face to face in the southern direction, singing, laugliing and dancing, his life ends with that.

verses.sanskrit: नेत्रमेकं स्रवेद्यस्य कर्णौ स्थानाच्च भ्रश्यतः वक्रा च नासा भवति विज्ञेयो गतजीवितः
verses.transliteration: netramekaṃ sravedyasya karṇau sthānācca bhraśyataḥ vakrā ca nāsā bhavati vijñeyo gatajīvitaḥ
verses.translation: If the body is frequently pale, white in colour with the lustre of white clouds or like white mustard his dcatli is imminent.
verses.hindi: उत्पलो विदलशचैव यौ हैत्यौ ब्रह्मणा पुरा
verses.wordMeaning: If the body is frequently pale, white in colour with the lustre of white clouds or like white mustard his dcatli is imminent.
verses.commentary: Sense: If the body is frequently pale, white in colour with the lustre of white clouds or like white mustard his dcatli is imminent.

verses.sanskrit: यस्य कृष्णा खरा जिह्वा पद्माभासं च वै मुखम् गण्डे वा पिण्डिकारक्ते तस्य मृत्युरुपस्थितः
verses.transliteration: yasya kṛṣṇā kharā jihvā padmābhāsaṃ ca vai mukham gaṇḍe vā piṇḍikārakte tasya mṛtyurupasthitaḥ
verses.translation: If one dreams that camels and donkeys are yoked to chariots they are inauspicious. If the chariot is seen going towards the southern direction he will cease to live.
verses.hindi: सावज्ञं कन्दुकेनात्र तस्येदं देहमास्थितम् देवैः समन्तादेतानि लिङ्गानि स्थापितान्यतः। दृष्ट्वापि नियतो मर्त्यो देहभेदे गणो भवेत्
verses.wordMeaning: If one dreams that camels and donkeys are yoked to chariots they are inauspicious. If the chariot is seen going towards the southern direction he will cease to live.
verses.commentary: Sense: If one dreams that camels and donkeys are yoked to chariots they are inauspicious. If the chariot is seen going towards the southern direction he will cease to live.

verses.sanskrit: मुक्तकेशो हसंश्चैव गायन्नृत्यंश् च यो नरः याम्यामभिमुखं गच्छेत् तदन्तं तस्य जीवितम्
verses.transliteration: muktakeśo hasaṃścaiva gāyannṛtyaṃś ca yo naraḥ yāmyāmabhimukhaṃ gacchet tadantaṃ tasya jīvitam
verses.translation: These are signs of imminent death: The eyes are turned upwards, they arc not.steady, they arc red, they revolve, there is dryness in the mouth, there is a hole in the umbilicus and the urine is excessively hot. The person is indeed in difficulties.
verses.hindi: मम प्रियहितं स्थानं ज्ञात्वा लिङ्गं प्रतिष्ठितम्
verses.wordMeaning: These are signs of imminent death: The eyes are turned upwards, they arc not.steady, they arc red, they revolve, there is dryness in the mouth, there is a hole in the umbilicus and the urine is excessively hot. The person is indeed in difficulties.
verses.commentary: Sense: These are signs of imminent death: The eyes are turned upwards, they arc not.steady, they arc red, they revolve, there is dryness in the mouth, there is a hole in the umbilicus and the urine is excessively hot. The person is indeed in difficulties.

verses.sanskrit: यस्य श्वेतघनाभासा श्वेतसर्षपसंनिभा श्वेता च मूर्तिर्ह्यसकृत् तस्य मृत्युरुपस्थितः
verses.transliteration: yasya śvetaghanābhāsā śvetasarṣapasaṃnibhā śvetā ca mūrtirhyasakṛt tasya mṛtyurupasthitaḥ
verses.translation: Whether during day or night if a person i.s directly killed but he does not see the murderer his life is extinct. He will cease to live.
verses.hindi: दृष्ट्वैतन्मनुजो देवि न दुर्गतिमतो व्रजेत् नद्येषा वरुणा देवि पुण्या पापप्रमोचनी। क्षेत्रमेतदलङ्कृत्य जाहूव्या सह सङ्गता
verses.wordMeaning: Whether during day or night if a person i.s directly killed but he does not see the murderer his life is extinct. He will cease to live.
verses.commentary: Sense: Whether during day or night if a person i.s directly killed but he does not see the murderer his life is extinct. He will cease to live.

verses.sanskrit: उष्ट्रा वा रासभा वाभियुक्ताः स्वप्ने रथे शुभाः यस्य सो ऽपि न जीवेत्तु दक्षिणाभिमुखो गतः
verses.transliteration: uṣṭrā vā rāsabhā vābhiyuktāḥ svapne rathe śubhāḥ yasya so 'pi na jīvettu dakṣiṇābhimukho gataḥ
verses.translation: If at the end of a dream, a man sees that he enters fire and docs not remember it at all, his life ends with that.
verses.hindi: द्वारा स्थापित किया गया यह लिङ्ग प्रसिद्ध होगा
verses.wordMeaning: If at the end of a dream, a man sees that he enters fire and docs not remember it at all, his life ends with that.
verses.commentary: Sense: If at the end of a dream, a man sees that he enters fire and docs not remember it at all, his life ends with that.

verses.sanskrit: द्वे वाथ परमे ऽरिष्टे एकीभूतः परं भवेत् घोषं न शृणुयात्कर्णे ज्योतिर् नेत्रे न पश्यति
verses.transliteration: dve vātha parame 'riṣṭe ekībhūtaḥ paraṃ bhavet ghoṣaṃ na śṛṇuyātkarṇe jyotir netre na paśyati
verses.translation: I f the portents arc indicated in the body and that time of deatli has arrived, the inUdligcnt man shall eschew sorrow and dejection and treat it with itidiirercnce.
verses.hindi: हे देवि! मैं तभीसे यहाँ हिरण्यग नामसे स्थित हूँ। इन देवेश्वरका दर्शन करके मनुष्य मेर लोक प्राप्त करता है । तत्पश्चात् ब्रह्माने परम भक्ते युक्त होकर मेरे इस पवित्र लिङ्गको विधिपूर्वक पुन: स्थापित किया। मैं यहाँ स्वर्लीनेश्वर नामसे स्वयं विद्यमान हूँ; यहाँ प्राणत्याग करनेपर मनुष्य कभी जन्म नहीं लेता है। जो गति योगियोंकी कही गयी हे, ह अनन्य गति उसकी भी होती है॥ ७६-७८१, ॥
verses.wordMeaning: I f the portents arc indicated in the body and that time of deatli has arrived, the inUdligcnt man shall eschew sorrow and dejection and treat it with itidiirercnce.
verses.commentary: Sense: I f the portents arc indicated in the body and that time of deatli has arrived, the inUdligcnt man shall eschew sorrow and dejection and treat it with itidiirercnce.

verses.sanskrit: श्वभ्रे यो निपतेत्स्वप्ने द्वारं चापि पिधीयते न चोत्तिष्ठति यः श्वभ्रात् तदन्तं तस्य जीवितम्
verses.transliteration: śvabhre yo nipatetsvapne dvāraṃ cāpi pidhīyate na cottiṣṭhati yaḥ śvabhrāt tadantaṃ tasya jīvitam
verses.translation: With cleanliness and purity he shall set off in the direction of east or north. He shall sit in a steady level ground in a secluded spot devoid of creatures. He shall sit facing the east or the north and perform the rite of acamana. He shall sit in the posture of Svastika and bow to MaheSvara. The body, the head and the neck shall be erect like a lamp in a wind- less spot. He shall be steady without flickering. He shall not look at anything else while practising Dharana (Retention).
verses.hindi: इसी स्थानपर मैंने व्याघ्रका रूप धारण करके
verses.wordMeaning: With cleanliness and purity he shall set off in the direction of east or north. He shall sit in a steady level ground in a secluded spot devoid of creatures. He shall sit facing the east or the north and perform the rite of acamana.…
verses.commentary: Sense: With cleanliness and purity he shall set off in the direction of east or north. He shall sit in a steady level ground in a secluded spot devoid of creatures. He shall sit facing the east or the north and perform the rite of acamana.…

verses.sanskrit: ऊर्ध्वा च दृष्टिर्न च सम्प्रतिष्ठा रक्ता पुनः सम्परिवर्तमाना ।* मुखस्य शोषः सुषिरा च नाभिरत्युष्णमूत्रो विषमस्थ एव
verses.transliteration: ūrdhvā ca dṛṣṭirna ca sampratiṣṭhā raktā punaḥ samparivartamānā /* mukhasya śoṣaḥ suṣirā ca nābhiratyuṣṇamūtro viṣamastha eva
verses.translation: 'I'hc knower of scriptures shall practise yoga in the spot facing the north-east. He shall restrain lust, doubt, pleasure, happiness and misery mentally and only concent-aie on clean meditation. He shall meditate on the nose, tongue, eyes, skin, ears and mind. He shall retain them in the intellcet and chest. After j cajiLing the time and actions he shall retain these parts of the body in the groups perpetually. This retention of the twelve parts of the body is called yogadharana. The man shall perform hundred or fifty such Dharanas on the head.
verses.hindi: हैत्यका वध किया था; तभीसे व्याघ्रेश्वर इस नामसे प्रसिद्ध होकर मैं यहाँ सदा स्थित हूँ । इन व्याघ्रेशवरका दर्शन करके मनुष्य पुनः दुर्गतिको प्राप्त नहीं होता है । पूर्वकालमें उत्पल तथा विदल नामक जिन दो हैत्योंके लिये ब्रह्माने तरीके द्वारा वध्य होनेका विधान किया था, उन्हे अभिमानयुक्त देखकर आपने ही रणमें अवज्ञापूर्वक एक कन्दुकसे मार डाला था; आपके उसी कन्दुकका यह देह यहाँ स्थापित हो गया अर्थात् वह कन्दुक लिङ्गरूपमें परिणत होकर
verses.wordMeaning: 'I'hc knower of scriptures shall practise yoga in the spot facing the north-east. He shall restrain lust, doubt, pleasure, happiness and misery mentally and only concent-aie on clean meditation. He shall meditate on the nose, tongue, eyes, skin, ears and mind.…
verses.commentary: Sense: 'I'hc knower of scriptures shall practise yoga in the spot facing the north-east. He shall restrain lust, doubt, pleasure, happiness and misery mentally and only concent-aie on clean meditation. He shall meditate on the nose, tongue, eyes, skin, ears and mind.…

verses.sanskrit: दिवा वा यदि वा रात्रौ प्रत्यक्षं यो निहन्यते हन्तारं न च पश्येच्च स गतायुर्न जीवति
verses.transliteration: divā vā yadi vā rātrau pratyakṣaṃ yo nihanyate hantāraṃ na ca paśyecca sa gatāyurna jīvati
verses.translation: If he becomes exhausted due to the practice of Dhfirana, the wind begins to function upwards. He shall fill the body with the wind along with the Orhkara. The yogin identifying himself with Orhkara shall merge himself in imperi- shable being. He shall become imperishable thus.
verses.hindi: प्राम्भमें गणपोंके साथ आकर मैं यहाँ स्थित हो गया, अतः यह ज्येष्ठस्थान है; यहाँ मेरा दर्शन पुण्यप्रद है।
verses.wordMeaning: If he becomes exhausted due to the practice of Dhfirana, the wind begins to function upwards. He shall fill the body with the wind along with the Orhkara. The yogin identifying himself with Orhkara shall merge himself in imperi- shable being. He shall become imperishable thus.
verses.commentary: Sense: If he becomes exhausted due to the practice of Dhfirana, the wind begins to function upwards. He shall fill the body with the wind along with the Orhkara. The yogin identifying himself with Orhkara shall merge himself in imperi- shable being. He shall become imperishable thus.

verses.sanskrit: अग्निप्रवेशं कुरुते स्वप्नान्ते यस्तु मानवः स्मृतिं नोपलभेच्चापि तदन्तं तस्य जीवितम्
verses.transliteration: agnipraveśaṃ kurute svapnānte yastu mānavaḥ smṛtiṃ nopalabheccāpi tadantaṃ tasya jīvitam
verses.translation: This should be known as having three Matras (units), the consonant in it is the deity. The first Matra is Vidyuti (pertaining to lightning). The second is TamasI [having Tamo-Guna].
verses.hindi: है; अतः भक्तयुक्त होकर इन लिङ्गोंका केवल दर्शन करके मनुष्य मृत्यु होनेपर शिवका गण हो जाता है हे देवि! पूर्वकालमें स्वयं तुम्हारे पिता पर्वतः राज हिमालयने इसे मेरा प्रिय तथा हितकर स्थान समझकर यहाँ लिङ्गकी स्थापना की थी। शैलेश्वर नामसे प्रसिद्ध इस लिङ्गको तुम आदरपूर्वक देखो। है
verses.wordMeaning: This should be known as having three Matras (units), the consonant in it is the deity. The first Matra is Vidyuti (pertaining to lightning). The second is TamasI [having Tamo-Guna].
verses.commentary: Sense: This should be known as having three Matras (units), the consonant in it is the deity. The first Matra is Vidyuti (pertaining to lightning). The second is TamasI [having Tamo-Guna].

verses.sanskrit: यस्तु प्रावरणं शुक्लं स्वकं पश्यति मानवः कृष्णं रक्तमपि स्वप्ने तस्य मृत्युरुपस्थितः
verses.transliteration: yastu prāvaraṇaṃ śuklaṃ svakaṃ paśyati mānavaḥ kṛṣṇaṃ raktamapi svapne tasya mṛtyurupasthitaḥ
verses.translation: The third is Nirguna (devoid of attributes). It covers up the imperishable Being. It should be known cs Gandharl too, because it originates from the Gandhara note (the third of the seven primary notes of Indian Gamut).
verses.hindi: देवि! इसका दर्शन करके मनुष्य दुर्गतिको नहीं प्राप्त होता है
verses.wordMeaning: The third is Nirguna (devoid of attributes). It covers up the imperishable Being. It should be known cs Gandharl too, because it originates from the Gandhara note (the third of the seven primary notes of Indian Gamut).
verses.commentary: Sense: The third is Nirguna (devoid of attributes). It covers up the imperishable Being. It should be known cs Gandharl too, because it originates from the Gandhara note (the third of the seven primary notes of Indian Gamut).

verses.sanskrit: अरिष्टे सूचिते देहे तस्मिन्काल उपस्थिते त्यक्त्वा खेदं विषादं च उपेक्षेद् बुद्धिमान् नरः
verses.transliteration: ariṣṭe sūcite dehe tasminkāla upasthite tyaktvā khedaṃ viṣādaṃ ca upekṣed buddhimān naraḥ
verses.translation: When the Oihkara that is uttered recedes to the head the devotee feels the touch of the mi mg ant.
verses.hindi: हे देवि! पुण्यमयी तथा पापको नष्ट करनेवाली अविमुक्तक्षेत्र वाराणसीका माहात्म्य तथा श्रीविश्वेश्वरपूजाविधिवर्णन
verses.wordMeaning: When the Oihkara that is uttered recedes to the head the devotee feels the touch of the mi mg ant.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the Oihkara that is uttered recedes to the head the devotee feels the touch of the mi mg ant.

verses.sanskrit: प्राचीं वा यदि वोदीचीं दिशं निष्क्रम्य वै शुचिः समे ऽतिस्थावरे देशे विविक्ते जन्तुवर्जिते
verses.transliteration: prācīṃ vā yadi vodīcīṃ diśaṃ niṣkramya vai śuciḥ same 'tisthāvare deśe vivikte jantuvarjite
verses.translation: The yogin identical with the Orhkara becomes identi- cal with the imperishable Being. Pranava is the bow, Atman is the arrow and Brahman is the target. It should be pierced by one who docs not err. He shall be concentrated therein as in regard to the arrow. The single-syllabled word Om is hidden in
verses.hindi: स्थापित ब्रह्मणा चापि सङ्गमे लिङ्गमुत्तमम्। सङ्गमेश्वरमित्येवं ख्यातं जगति दृश्यताम्
verses.wordMeaning: The yogin identical with the Orhkara becomes identi- cal with the imperishable Being. Pranava is the bow, Atman is the arrow and Brahman is the target. It should be pierced by one who docs not err. He shall be concentrated therein as in regard to the arrow.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The yogin identical with the Orhkara becomes identi- cal with the imperishable Being. Pranava is the bow, Atman is the arrow and Brahman is the target. It should be pierced by one who docs not err. He shall be concentrated therein as in regard to the arrow.…

verses.sanskrit: उदङ्मुखः प्राङ्मुखो वा स्वस्थश् चाचान्त एव च स्वस्तिकेनोपविष्टस्तु नमस्कृत्वा महेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: udaṅmukhaḥ prāṅmukho vā svasthaś cācānta eva ca svastikenopaviṣṭastu namaskṛtvā maheśvaram
verses.translation: The letter "A" should be known as Aksara (Imperish- able); the letter "U" is then along with it. Including the letter '*M", Oihkara becomes one with three Matras.
verses.hindi: सङ्घमे देवनद्या हि यः स्नात्वा मनुजः शुचि: । अर्चयेत्सड्रमेशानं तस्य जन्मभयं कुतः योगिनां मोक्षलिप्सूनां ज्ञानयोगरतात्मनाम्। दृष्ट्वैनं मध्यमेशानं जन्म प्रति न शोचति
verses.wordMeaning: The letter "A" should be known as Aksara (Imperish- able); the letter "U" is then along with it. Including the letter '*M", Oihkara becomes one with three Matras.
verses.commentary: Sense: The letter "A" should be known as Aksara (Imperish- able); the letter "U" is then along with it. Including the letter '*M", Oihkara becomes one with three Matras.

verses.sanskrit: समकायशिरोग्रीवो धारयन् नावलोकयेत् यथा दीपो निवातस्थो नेङ्गते सोपमा स्मृता
verses.transliteration: samakāyaśirogrīvo dhārayan nāvalokayet yathā dīpo nivātastho neṅgate sopamā smṛtā
verses.translation: The letter "A" is the Bhurloka; the letter "U" is Bhuvarloka, the letter "M" is Svarloka.
verses.hindi: स्थापितं लिङ्गमेतत्तु शुक्रेण भृगुसूनुना। नाम्ना शुक्रेश्वरं नाम सर्वसिद्धामराचितम्
verses.wordMeaning: The letter "A" is the Bhurloka; the letter "U" is Bhuvarloka, the letter "M" is Svarloka.
verses.commentary: Sense: The letter "A" is the Bhurloka; the letter "U" is Bhuvarloka, the letter "M" is Svarloka.

verses.sanskrit: प्रागुदक्प्रवणे देशे तथा युञ्जीत शास्त्रवित् कामं वितर्कं प्रीतिं च सुखदुःखे उभे तथा
verses.transliteration: prāgudakpravaṇe deśe tathā yuñjīta śāstravit kāmaṃ vitarkaṃ prītiṃ ca sukhaduḥkhe ubhe tathā
verses.translation: The Om represents the three worlds. Its head is the Heaven. All the worlds constitute its limbs (body). Its feet are constituted by Brahmaloka.
verses.hindi: पुरा जम्बुकरूपेण असुरो देवकण्टकः। ब्रह्मणो हि वरं लब्ध्वा गोमायुर्बन्धशङ्कितः निहतो हिमवत्पुत्रि जम्बुकेशस्ततो ह्यहम्। अद्यापि जगति ख्यातं सुरासुरनमस्कृतम्
verses.wordMeaning: The Om represents the three worlds. Its head is the Heaven. All the worlds constitute its limbs (body). Its feet are constituted by Brahmaloka.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Om represents the three worlds. Its head is the Heaven. All the worlds constitute its limbs (body). Its feet are constituted by Brahmaloka.

verses.sanskrit: निगृह्य मनसा सर्वं शुक्लं ध्यानम् अनुस्मरेत् घ्राणे च रसने नित्यं चक्षुषी स्पर्शने तथा
verses.transliteration: nigṛhya manasā sarvaṃ śuklaṃ dhyānam anusmaret ghrāṇe ca rasane nityaṃ cakṣuṣī sparśane tathā
verses.translation: Rudra's world is the foot of the Matra, Siva's region is devoid of Matras (i.e. above them). It is with this special knowledge that, that region is worshipped.
verses.hindi: दृष्ट्वैनमपि देवेशं सर्वान् कामानवाण्नुयात्। ग्रहैः शुक्रपुरोगैश्च एतानि स्थापितानि ह
verses.wordMeaning: Rudra's world is the foot of the Matra, Siva's region is devoid of Matras (i.e. above them). It is with this special knowledge that, that region is worshipped.
verses.commentary: Sense: Rudra's world is the foot of the Matra, Siva's region is devoid of Matras (i.e. above them). It is with this special knowledge that, that region is worshipped.

verses.sanskrit: श्रोत्रे मनसि बुद्धौ च तत्र वक्षसि धारयेत् कालकर्माणि विज्ञाय समूहेष्वेव नित्यशः
verses.transliteration: śrotre manasi buddhau ca tatra vakṣasi dhārayet kālakarmāṇi vijñāya samūheṣveva nityaśaḥ
verses.translation: Hence, the devotee shall be interested in meditation. Indeed that imperishable Being devoid of Matr, should be assiduously worshipped by one who wishes for permanent happiness.
verses.hindi: पश्य पुण्यानि लिङ्गानि सर्वकामप्रदानि तु। एवमेतानि पुण्यानि मन्निवासानि पार्वति यह वरुणा नदी इस क्षेत्रको अलंकृत करके गंगाके साथ मिल जाती है। इनके संगमपर भी ब्रह्माके द्वारा उत्तम लिङ्ग स्थापित किया गया है; यह संगमेश्वर--इस नामसे जगतमें प्रसिद्ध है, तुम इसका दर्शन करो।
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, the devotee shall be interested in meditation. Indeed that imperishable Being devoid of Matr, should be assiduously worshipped by one who wishes for permanent happiness.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, the devotee shall be interested in meditation. Indeed that imperishable Being devoid of Matr, should be assiduously worshipped by one who wishes for permanent happiness.

verses.sanskrit: द्वादशाध्यात्ममित्येवं योगधारणमुच्यते शतमर्धशतं वापि धारणां मूर्ध्नि धारयेत्
verses.transliteration: dvādaśādhyātmamityevaṃ yogadhāraṇamucyate śatamardhaśataṃ vāpi dhāraṇāṃ mūrdhni dhārayet
verses.translation: The first Matra is a short, the next one is long; the third Matra isluta (prolated vowel). These Matras should be known in their proper order. They are to be retained only as long as it is possible.
verses.hindi: देवनदीके संगमपर स्नान करके शुद्ध होकर जो मनुष्य संगमेश्वरकी पूजा करता है, उसे जन्मभय कहाँसे हो सकता है!॥ ८७--८९॥
verses.wordMeaning: The first Matra is a short, the next one is long; the third Matra isluta (prolated vowel). These Matras should be known in their proper order. They are to be retained only as long as it is possible.
verses.commentary: Sense: The first Matra is a short, the next one is long; the third Matra isluta (prolated vowel). These Matras should be known in their proper order. They are to be retained only as long as it is possible.

verses.sanskrit: खिन्नस्य धारणायोगाद् वायुरूर्ध्वं प्रवर्तते ततश्चापूरयेद् देहम् ओङ्कारेण समन्वितः
verses.transliteration: khinnasya dhāraṇāyogād vāyurūrdhvaṃ pravartate tataścāpūrayed deham oṅkāreṇa samanvitaḥ
verses.translation: He who always meditates on the sense-organs, mind and intellect in the Atman and listens to even half a Matra shall attain its benefit.
verses.hindi: हे देवि! मैं इसे महाक्षेत्र मानता हूँ; यह योगियोंका परम निवास-स्थान है। इस श्रेष्ठ क्षेत्रके मध्यमें मैं स्वयं प्रकट होकर अधिष्ठित हूँ। सभी सुर तथा असुर यहाँ मुझे मध्यमेश्वर--इस नामसे कहते हैं। मेरा व्रत धारण करनेवाले सिद्धों और मोक्षको अभिलाषावाले तथा ज्ञानयोगमें परायण मनवाले योगियोंका यह निवास-स्थान है। इन मध्यमेश्वरका दर्शन कर लेनेपर मनुष्य अपने जन्मके विषयमे चिन्ता नहीं करता
verses.wordMeaning: He who always meditates on the sense-organs, mind and intellect in the Atman and listens to even half a Matra shall attain its benefit.
verses.commentary: Sense: He who always meditates on the sense-organs, mind and intellect in the Atman and listens to even half a Matra shall attain its benefit.

verses.sanskrit: तथौंकारमयो योगी अक्षरे त्वक्षरी भवेत् अत ऊर्ध्वं प्रवक्ष्यामि ओङ्कारप्राप्तिलक्षणम्
verses.transliteration: tathauṃkāramayo yogī akṣare tvakṣarī bhavet ata ūrdhvaṃ pravakṣyāmi oṅkāraprāptilakṣaṇam
verses.translation: Thanks to that Matra, one attains tlie merit which a person attains by a horse-sacrifice every month, continuing it for a hundred years.
verses.hindi: भृगुपुत्र शुक्राचार्यने भी यहाँ लिङ्गको स्थापित किया है; शुक्रेश्वर नामसे विख्यात यह लिङ्ग सभी सिद्धां तथा देवताओंसे पूजित है। नियमित होकर इनका दर्शन करके मनुष्य सभी पापोंसे मुक्त हो जाता है और
verses.wordMeaning: Thanks to that Matra, one attains tlie merit which a person attains by a horse-sacrifice every month, continuing it for a hundred years.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thanks to that Matra, one attains tlie merit which a person attains by a horse-sacrifice every month, continuing it for a hundred years.

verses.sanskrit: एष त्रिमात्रो विज्ञेयो व्यञ्जनं चात्र चेश्वरः प्रथमा विद्युती मात्रा द्वितीया तामसी स्मृता
verses.transliteration: eṣa trimātro vijñeyo vyañjanaṃ cātra ceśvaraḥ prathamā vidyutī mātrā dvitīyā tāmasī smṛtā
verses.translation: Neither by a severe penance nor by sacrifices with plenty of gifts can that merit be obtained which is perfectly obtained by means of the Matra.
verses.hindi: मरनेपर पुनः संसारी जीव नहीं होता है पूर्वकालमें देवताओंके लिये कंटकस्वरूप एक हैत्य सियारके रूपमें विद्यमान था। अपने बन्धनसे सशंकित उस हैत्यने ब्रह्मासे वर प्राप्त करके गोमायु (सियार)-का रूप धारण कर लिया था। है पार्वति!
verses.wordMeaning: Neither by a severe penance nor by sacrifices with plenty of gifts can that merit be obtained which is perfectly obtained by means of the Matra.
verses.commentary: Sense: Neither by a severe penance nor by sacrifices with plenty of gifts can that merit be obtained which is perfectly obtained by means of the Matra.

verses.sanskrit: तृतीयां निर्गुणां चैव मात्रामक्षरगामिनीम् गान्धारी चैव विज्ञेया गान्धारस्वरसंभवा
verses.transliteration: tṛtīyāṃ nirguṇāṃ caiva mātrāmakṣaragāminīm gāndhārī caiva vijñeyā gāndhārasvarasaṃbhavā
verses.translation: The householder yogins shall practise only that Matra which is taught as Pluta (Prolated Vowel).
verses.hindi: मैंने उसका वध किया और तब मैं जम्बुकेश कहा जाने लगा; आज भी लोकमें प्रसिद्ध तथा देवताओं और असुरोंसे नमस्कृत इन देवेश्वरका दर्शन करके मनुष्य समस्त कामनाओंको प्राप्त कर लेता है। हे
verses.wordMeaning: The householder yogins shall practise only that Matra which is taught as Pluta (Prolated Vowel).
verses.commentary: Sense: The householder yogins shall practise only that Matra which is taught as Pluta (Prolated Vowel).

verses.sanskrit: पिपीलिकागतिस्पर्शा प्रयुक्ता मूर्ध्नि लक्ष्यते यथा प्रयुक्त ओङ्कारः प्रतिनिर्याति मूर्धनि
verses.transliteration: pipīlikāgatisparśā prayuktā mūrdhni lakṣyate yathā prayukta oṅkāraḥ pratiniryāti mūrdhani
verses.translation: This Matra alone comprises the eightfold Aivarya beginning with Anima. Hence, O brahmins, be in commu- nion with it.
verses.hindi: देवि! शुक्र आदि प्रधान ग्रहोंके द्वारा स्थापित किये गये इन पुण्यमय तथा सभी कामनाओंको पूर्ण करनेवाले लिङ्गोंका दर्शन करो। है पार्वति! इस प्रकार मैंने अपने निवासस्वरूप इन पवित्र लिङ्गोंका वर्णन किया; मेरे क्षेत्रमै एक अन्य गुप्त रहस्य भी है, इसे
