verses.wordMeaning: This Matra alone comprises the eightfold Aivarya beginning with Anima. Hence, O brahmins, be in commu- nion with it.
verses.commentary: Sense: This Matra alone comprises the eightfold Aivarya beginning with Anima. Hence, O brahmins, be in commu- nion with it.

verses.sanskrit: तथौंकारमयो योगी त्व् अक्षरी त्वक्षरी भवेत् प्रणवो धनुः शरो ह्यात्मा ब्रह्मलक्षणमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: tathauṃkāramayo yogī tv akṣarī tvakṣarī bhavet praṇavo dhanuḥ śaro hyātmā brahmalakṣaṇamucyate
verses.translation: Atjtimi, etc. Gf. note 241.
verses.hindi: रका बस्याल. OO... 1 नि
verses.wordMeaning: Atjtimi, etc. Gf. note 241.
verses.commentary: Sense: Atjtimi, etc. Gf. note 241.

verses.sanskrit: अप्रमत्तेन वेद्धव्यं शरवत् तन्मयो भवेत् ओमित्येकाक्षरं ह्येतद् गुहायां निहितं पदम्
verses.transliteration: apramattena veddhavyaṃ śaravat tanmayo bhavet omityekākṣaraṃ hyetad guhāyāṃ nihitaṃ padam
verses.translation: O brahmins, he who knows and realises the Atman obtains everything. He shall be endowed with yoga.®*® He shall be pure. He shall subdue the sense-organs. He shall control them.
verses.hindi: योजनं विद्धि चार्वङ्गि मृत्युकालेऽमृतप्रदम्। महालयगिरिस्थं मां केदारे च व्यवस्थितम् गणत्वं लभते दृष्ट्वा ह्यस्मिन् मोक्षो ह्यवाप्यते। गाणपत्यं लभेद्यस्माद्यतः सा मुक्तिरुत्तमा
verses.wordMeaning: O brahmins, he who knows and realises the Atman obtains everything. He shall be endowed with yoga.®*® He shall be pure. He shall subdue the sense-organs. He shall control them.
verses.commentary: Sense: O brahmins, he who knows and realises the Atman obtains everything. He shall be endowed with yoga.®*® He shall be pure. He shall subdue the sense-organs. He shall control them.

verses.sanskrit: ओमित्येतत्त्रयो लोकास् त्रयो वेदास्त्रयो ऽग्नयः विष्णुक्रमास्त्रयस्त्वेते ऋक्सामानि यजूंषि च
verses.transliteration: omityetattrayo lokās trayo vedāstrayo 'gnayaḥ viṣṇukramāstrayastvete ṛksāmāni yajūṃṣi ca
verses.translation: Hence, the learned man shall contemplate the Atman by means of the yoga pertaining to Pasupati. Those who know the Atman are certainly pure beings.
verses.hindi: ततो महालयात्तस्मात्केदारान्मध्यमादपि। स्मृतं पुण्यतमं क्षेत्रमविमुक्तं वरानने
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, the learned man shall contemplate the Atman by means of the yoga pertaining to Pasupati. Those who know the Atman are certainly pure beings.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, the learned man shall contemplate the Atman by means of the yoga pertaining to Pasupati. Those who know the Atman are certainly pure beings.

verses.sanskrit: मात्रा चार्धं च तिस्रस्तु विज्ञेयाः परमार्थतः तत्प्रयुक्तस्तु यो योगी तस्य सालोक्यमाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: mātrā cārdhaṃ ca tisrastu vijñeyāḥ paramārthataḥ tatprayuktastu yo yogī tasya sālokyamāpnuyāt
verses.translation: It is through the knowledge of yoga that the brahmin, thinker on spiritual topics, attains the Rk, Saman, Yajur mantras, in fact all the Vedas and the Upanisads.
verses.hindi: केदारं मध्यमं क्षेत्रं स्थानं चैव महालयम्। मम पुण्यानि भूर्लोके तेभ्यः श्रेष्ठतमं त्विदम् यतः सृष्टास्त्विमे लोकास्ततः क्षेत्रमिदं शुभम्। कदाचिन्न मया मुक्तमविमुक्तं ततोऽभवत्
verses.wordMeaning: It is through the knowledge of yoga that the brahmin, thinker on spiritual topics, attains the Rk, Saman, Yajur mantras, in fact all the Vedas and the Upanisads.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is through the knowledge of yoga that the brahmin, thinker on spiritual topics, attains the Rk, Saman, Yajur mantras, in fact all the Vedas and the Upanisads.

verses.sanskrit: अकारो ह्यक्षरो ज्ञेय उकारः सहितः स्मृतः मकारसहितौंकारस् त्रिमात्र इति संज्ञितः
verses.transliteration: akāro hyakṣaro jñeya ukāraḥ sahitaḥ smṛtaḥ makārasahitauṃkāras trimātra iti saṃjñitaḥ
verses.translation: He becomes identical with all Devas and devoid of all elements. He gets rid of the necessity of passing through wombs and attains the perpetual region.
verses.hindi: अविमुक्तेश्वरं लिङ्गं मम दृष्ट्वेह मानवः। सद्यः पापविनिर्मुक्तः पशुपाशैविमुच्यते
verses.wordMeaning: He becomes identical with all Devas and devoid of all elements. He gets rid of the necessity of passing through wombs and attains the perpetual region.
verses.commentary: Sense: He becomes identical with all Devas and devoid of all elements. He gets rid of the necessity of passing through wombs and attains the perpetual region.

verses.sanskrit: अकारस् त्वेष भूर्लोक उकारो भुव उच्यते सव्यञ्जनो मकारस्तु स्वर्लोक इति गीयते
verses.transliteration: akāras tveṣa bhūrloka ukāro bhuva ucyate savyañjano makārastu svarloka iti gīyate
verses.translation: as the ripe fruit falls off the tree on being tossed about by the wind, so also sin perishes by the grace of Rudra.
verses.hindi: उपशान्तं शिवं चैव ज्येष्ठस्थाननिवासिनम्। शुक्रेश्वरं च विख्यातं व्याघ्रेशं जम्बुकेश्वरम् एवमुक्त्वा महादेवो दिशः सर्वा व्यलोकयत्
verses.wordMeaning: as the ripe fruit falls off the tree on being tossed about by the wind, so also sin perishes by the grace of Rudra.
verses.commentary: Sense: as the ripe fruit falls off the tree on being tossed about by the wind, so also sin perishes by the grace of Rudra.

verses.sanskrit: ओङ्कारस्तु त्रयो लोकाः शिरस्तस्य त्रिविष्टपम् भुवनाङ्गं च तत्सर्वं ब्राह्मं तत्पदमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: oṅkārastu trayo lokāḥ śirastasya triviṣṭapam bhuvanāṅgaṃ ca tatsarvaṃ brāhmaṃ tatpadamucyate
verses.translation: Where the obeisance to Rudra yields the benefits of all Karinans, one shall not attain those benefits through the obei- sance to the other deities.
verses.hindi: विलोक्य संस्थिते पश्चाहेवदेवे महेश्वरे। अकस्मादभवत्सर्वः स देशोज्चलितो यथा
verses.wordMeaning: Where the obeisance to Rudra yields the benefits of all Karinans, one shall not attain those benefits through the obei- sance to the other deities.
verses.commentary: Sense: Where the obeisance to Rudra yields the benefits of all Karinans, one shall not attain those benefits through the obei- sance to the other deities.

verses.sanskrit: मात्रापादो रुद्रलोको ह्य् अमात्रं तु शिवं पदम् एवं ज्ञानविशेषेण तत्पदं समुपास्यते
verses.transliteration: mātrāpādo rudraloko hy amātraṃ tu śivaṃ padam evaṃ jñānaviśeṣeṇa tatpadaṃ samupāsyate
verses.translation: Hence, the yogin shall worship Mahes vara repeat- ing the Pranava twice. He who enlarges the scope of the Vedas ten times more by elaborating the Vedic texts shall meditate and then forsake the body. He uplifts three generations and attains Sayujja salvation with Siva.
verses.hindi: स्थितानां स तदा तेषां देवदेव उमापतिः कृत्स्नं जगदिहैकस्थं कर्तुमन्त इव स्थितः
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, the yogin shall worship Mahes vara repeat- ing the Pranava twice. He who enlarges the scope of the Vedas ten times more by elaborating the Vedic texts shall meditate and then forsake the body. He uplifts three generations and attains Sayujja salvation with Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, the yogin shall worship Mahes vara repeat- ing the Pranava twice. He who enlarges the scope of the Vedas ten times more by elaborating the Vedic texts shall meditate and then forsake the body. He uplifts three generations and attains Sayujja salvation with Siva.

verses.sanskrit: तस्माद्ध्यानरतिर्नित्यम् अमात्रं हि तदक्षरम् उपास्यं हि प्रयत्नेन शाश्वतं सुखमिच्छता
verses.transliteration: tasmāddhyānaratirnityam amātraṃ hi tadakṣaram upāsyaṃ hi prayatnena śāśvataṃ sukhamicchatā
verses.translation: Or after seeing any evil poitent and wl. n the time of death has arrived the man shall go to Avimuktesvara in Varanasi and perform the expiatory rite. Somehow the man shall abandon his body there when, O leading brahmins, he is liberated. The man may abandon his body on the mountain, Sriparvata.®®® He attains identity with Siva. No doubt need be entertained in this regard. Avimukta is a greatest shrine always bestowing salvation on the creatures. The intelligent man shall resort to it always especially when death is imminent.
verses.hindi: यह क्षेत्र चारों दिशाओंमें चार कोस अतएव एक योजनमें कहा गया है; है सुन्दर अंगोंवाली। मृत्युकाल इसे अमरता प्रदान करनेवाला जानो। महालय गिरि विराजमान और केदारपर स्थित मेरा दर्शन करके
verses.wordMeaning: Or after seeing any evil poitent and wl. n the time of death has arrived the man shall go to Avimuktesvara in Varanasi and perform the expiatory rite. Somehow the man shall abandon his body there when, O leading brahmins, he is liberated.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Or after seeing any evil poitent and wl. n the time of death has arrived the man shall go to Avimuktesvara in Varanasi and perform the expiatory rite. Somehow the man shall abandon his body there when, O leading brahmins, he is liberated.…

verses.sanskrit: ह्रस्वा तु प्रथमा मात्रा ततो दीर्घा त्वनन्तरम् ततः प्लुतवती चैव तृतीया चोपदिश्यते
verses.transliteration: hrasvā tu prathamā mātrā tato dīrghā tvanantaram tataḥ plutavatī caiva tṛtīyā copadiśyate
verses.translation: ST. defines 'yoga-jnanam' as yoga-yuktam jnanam' i. e. know- ledge joined with meditation. Yoga is the means for the attainment of right or perfect knowledge *yogo hi jhana-sadhanam.*
verses.hindi: गणत्व प्राप्त करता है, किंतु इस क्षेत्रमें मोक्षकी प्राप्त होती है। उन स्थानोंमें गणपति पद प्राप्त होता है और यहाँपर उत्तम मुक्ति प्राप्त होती है, अतः है वरानने! उम् महालय, केदार तथा मध्यम क्षेत्र-इन सबसे पुण्यप्रद यह अविमुक्त क्षेत्र कहा गया है । केदार, मध्यमक्षेत्र तथा महालय स्थान--ये तीनों पृथ्वीलोकमें मेरे पवित्र क्षेत्र हैं, किंतु यह अविमुक्तक्षेत्र उनसे भी अधिक श्रेष्ठ है
verses.wordMeaning: ST. defines 'yoga-jnanam' as yoga-yuktam jnanam' i. e. know- ledge joined with meditation. Yoga is the means for the attainment of right or perfect knowledge *yogo hi jhana-sadhanam.*
verses.commentary: Sense: ST. defines 'yoga-jnanam' as yoga-yuktam jnanam' i. e. know- ledge joined with meditation. Yoga is the means for the attainment of right or perfect knowledge *yogo hi jhana-sadhanam.*

verses.sanskrit: एतास्तु मात्रा विज्ञेया यथावदनुपूर्वशः यावदेव तु शक्यन्ते धार्यन्ते तावदेव हि
verses.transliteration: etāstu mātrā vijñeyā yathāvadanupūrvaśaḥ yāvadeva tu śakyante dhāryante tāvadeva hi
verses.translation: ST. defines 'yoga-jnanam' as yoga-yuktam jnanam' i. e. know- ledge joined with meditation. Yoga is the means for the attainment of right or perfect knowledge *yogo hi jhana-sadhanam.*
verses.hindi: जबसे इन लोकोंको सृष्टि की गयी है, तबसे मैंने इस पवित्र क्षेत्रका परित्याग कभी नहीं किया, इसलिये यह अविमुक्त क्षेत्र हो गया। यहाँ मेरे अविमुक्तेश्वर लिङ्गका दर्शन करके मनुष्य शीघ्र ही पापोंसे मुक्त
verses.wordMeaning: ST. defines 'yoga-jnanam' as yoga-yuktam jnanam' i. e. know- ledge joined with meditation. Yoga is the means for the attainment of right or perfect knowledge *yogo hi jhana-sadhanam.*
verses.commentary: Sense: ST. defines 'yoga-jnanam' as yoga-yuktam jnanam' i. e. know- ledge joined with meditation. Yoga is the means for the attainment of right or perfect knowledge *yogo hi jhana-sadhanam.*

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रियाणि मनो बुद्धिं ध्यायन्नात्मनि यः सदा अर्धं तन्मात्रम् अपि चेच् छृणु यत् फलमाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: indriyāṇi mano buddhiṃ dhyāyannātmani yaḥ sadā ardhaṃ tanmātram api cec chṛṇu yat phalamāpnuyāt
verses.translation: ST. defines 'yoga-jnanam' as yoga-yuktam jnanam' i. e. know- ledge joined with meditation. Yoga is the means for the attainment of right or perfect knowledge *yogo hi jhana-sadhanam.*
verses.hindi: होकर पशुपाशों (जीवबन्धन)-से छूट जाता है । शैलेश्वर, गोप्रेक्ष, वृषभध्वज, उपशान्त, ज्येष्ठस्थानमें निवास करनेवाले शिव, शुक्रेशवर, प्रसिद्ध व्याघ्रेश्वर तथा जम्बुकेश्वरका दर्शन करके मनुष्य दुःखके सागररूप संसारमें पुनः जन्म नहीं लेता है॥ १०४-१०७/२॥
verses.wordMeaning: ST. defines 'yoga-jnanam' as yoga-yuktam jnanam' i. e. know- ledge joined with meditation. Yoga is the means for the attainment of right or perfect knowledge *yogo hi jhana-sadhanam.*
verses.commentary: Sense: ST. defines 'yoga-jnanam' as yoga-yuktam jnanam' i. e. know- ledge joined with meditation. Yoga is the means for the attainment of right or perfect knowledge *yogo hi jhana-sadhanam.*

verses.sanskrit: मासे मासे ऽश्वमेधेन यो यजेत शतं समाः तेन यत्प्राप्यते पुण्यं मात्रया तदवाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: māse māse 'śvamedhena yo yajeta śataṃ samāḥ tena yatprāpyate puṇyaṃ mātrayā tadavāpnuyāt
verses.translation: ST. defines 'yoga-jnanam' as yoga-yuktam jnanam' i. e. know- ledge joined with meditation. Yoga is the means for the attainment of right or perfect knowledge *yogo hi jhana-sadhanam.*
verses.hindi: सूतजी बोले-हे ऋषियो! ऐसा कहकर महादेवने सभी दिशाओंकी ओर देखा। दिशाओंको ओर देखकर देवदेव महेश्वरके बैठ जानेके अनन्तर वह सम्पूर्ण स्थान सहसा देदीप्यमान हो गया। तत्पश्चात्
verses.wordMeaning: ST. defines 'yoga-jnanam' as yoga-yuktam jnanam' i. e. know- ledge joined with meditation. Yoga is the means for the attainment of right or perfect knowledge *yogo hi jhana-sadhanam.*
verses.commentary: Sense: ST. defines 'yoga-jnanam' as yoga-yuktam jnanam' i. e. know- ledge joined with meditation. Yoga is the means for the attainment of right or perfect knowledge *yogo hi jhana-sadhanam.*

verses.sanskrit: न तथा तपसोग्रेण न यज्ञैर्भूरिदक्षिणैः यत्फलं प्राप्यते सम्यङ् मात्रया तदवाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: na tathā tapasogreṇa na yajñairbhūridakṣiṇaiḥ yatphalaṃ prāpyate samyaṅ mātrayā tadavāpnuyāt
verses.translation: ST. defines 'yoga-jnanam' as yoga-yuktam jnanam' i. e. know- ledge joined with meditation. Yoga is the means for the attainment of right or perfect knowledge *yogo hi jhana-sadhanam.*
verses.hindi: भस्म लगानेसे श्वेत प्रभावाले, नियम-व्रत धारण करनेवाले, पशुपतिके भक्त और महेश्वरके प्रति समर्पित बहुत-से सैकड़ों सिद्ध तथा महात्माओंने वहाँ आकर महेश्वरको प्रणाम किया; पुन: वे ध्यानयोगमें स्थित योगेश्वर शिव-को बार-बार देखकर अपने मनको स्थिर करके उन ईश्वरमै लीन होते हुए-से स्थित ही गये। उनके इस प्रकार स्थित होनेपर वे देवदेव उमापतिं
verses.wordMeaning: ST. defines 'yoga-jnanam' as yoga-yuktam jnanam' i. e. know- ledge joined with meditation. Yoga is the means for the attainment of right or perfect knowledge *yogo hi jhana-sadhanam.*
verses.commentary: Sense: ST. defines 'yoga-jnanam' as yoga-yuktam jnanam' i. e. know- ledge joined with meditation. Yoga is the means for the attainment of right or perfect knowledge *yogo hi jhana-sadhanam.*

verses.sanskrit: तत्र चैषा तु या मात्रा प्लुता नामोपदिश्यते एषा एव भवेत्कार्या गृहस्थानां तु योगिनाम्
verses.transliteration: tatra caiṣā tu yā mātrā plutā nāmopadiśyate eṣā eva bhavetkāryā gṛhasthānāṃ tu yoginām
verses.translation: ST. defines 'yoga-jnanam' as yoga-yuktam jnanam' i. e. know- ledge joined with meditation. Yoga is the means for the attainment of right or perfect knowledge *yogo hi jhana-sadhanam.*
verses.hindi: परम मूर्ति धारण करते हुए विराट् पुरुषके रूपमें हौ
verses.wordMeaning: ST. defines 'yoga-jnanam' as yoga-yuktam jnanam' i. e. know- ledge joined with meditation. Yoga is the means for the attainment of right or perfect knowledge *yogo hi jhana-sadhanam.*
verses.commentary: Sense: ST. defines 'yoga-jnanam' as yoga-yuktam jnanam' i. e. know- ledge joined with meditation. Yoga is the means for the attainment of right or perfect knowledge *yogo hi jhana-sadhanam.*

verses.sanskrit: एषां चैव विशेषेण ऐश्वर्ये ह्यष्टलक्षणे अणिमाद्ये तु विज्ञेया तस्माद्युञ्जीत तां द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: eṣāṃ caiva viśeṣeṇa aiśvarye hyaṣṭalakṣaṇe aṇimādye tu vijñeyā tasmādyuñjīta tāṃ dvijāḥ
verses.translation: ST. defines 'yoga-jnanam' as yoga-yuktam jnanam' i. e. know- ledge joined with meditation. Yoga is the means for the attainment of right or perfect knowledge *yogo hi jhana-sadhanam.*
verses.hindi: गये; वे सम्पूर्ण जगतूको एक स्थानपर एकत्र करै अविमुक्तक्षेत्र वाराणसीका माहात्म्य तथा श्रीविश्वेश्वरपूजाविधिवर्णन
verses.wordMeaning: ST. defines 'yoga-jnanam' as yoga-yuktam jnanam' i. e. know- ledge joined with meditation. Yoga is the means for the attainment of right or perfect knowledge *yogo hi jhana-sadhanam.*
verses.commentary: Sense: ST. defines 'yoga-jnanam' as yoga-yuktam jnanam' i. e. know- ledge joined with meditation. Yoga is the means for the attainment of right or perfect knowledge *yogo hi jhana-sadhanam.*

verses.sanskrit: एवं हि योगसंयुक्तः शुचिर् दान्तो जितेन्द्रियः आत्मानं विद्यते यस्तु स सर्वं विन्दते द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: evaṃ hi yogasaṃyuktaḥ śucir dānto jitendriyaḥ ātmānaṃ vidyate yastu sa sarvaṃ vindate dvijāḥ
verses.translation: ST. defines 'yoga-jnanam' as yoga-yuktam jnanam' i. e. know- ledge joined with meditation. Yoga is the means for the attainment of right or perfect knowledge *yogo hi jhana-sadhanam.*
verses.hindi: ततस्त्वदूष्टमाकारं बुद्ध्वा सा प्रकृतिस्थितम्। प्रकृतेर्मूर्तिमास्थाय योगेन परमेश्वरी
verses.wordMeaning: ST. defines 'yoga-jnanam' as yoga-yuktam jnanam' i. e. know- ledge joined with meditation. Yoga is the means for the attainment of right or perfect knowledge *yogo hi jhana-sadhanam.*
verses.commentary: Sense: ST. defines 'yoga-jnanam' as yoga-yuktam jnanam' i. e. know- ledge joined with meditation. Yoga is the means for the attainment of right or perfect knowledge *yogo hi jhana-sadhanam.*

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात्पाशुपतैर्योगैर् आत्मानं चिन्तयेद्बुधः आत्मानं जानते ये तु शुचयस्ते न संशयः
verses.transliteration: tasmātpāśupatairyogair ātmānaṃ cintayedbudhaḥ ātmānaṃ jānate ye tu śucayaste na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: ST. defines 'yoga-jnanam' as yoga-yuktam jnanam' i. e. know- ledge joined with meditation. Yoga is the means for the attainment of right or perfect knowledge *yogo hi jhana-sadhanam.*

verses.sanskrit: यत्र रुद्रनमस्कारः सर्वकर्मफलो ध्रुवः अन्यदेवनमस्कारान् न तत्फलमवाप्नुयात्
verses.transliteration: yatra rudranamaskāraḥ sarvakarmaphalo dhruvaḥ anyadevanamaskārān na tatphalamavāpnuyāt

verses.hindi: पुण्यस्थानस्थितां पुण्यां पुण्यदिक्प्रवहाँ सदा। भजन्ते सर्वतोऽभ्येत्य ये ताञ्छणु वरानने कफीकाफीफफफफफफफफफफफफफफफफफफफफफफफफफफफफफफफफफापफाफफ

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात्त्रिःप्रवणं योगी उपासीत महेश्वरम् दशविस्तारकं ब्रह्म तथा च ब्रह्मविस्तरैः
verses.transliteration: tasmāttriḥpravaṇaṃ yogī upāsīta maheśvaram daśavistārakaṃ brahma tathā ca brahmavistaraiḥ

verses.hindi: लिये प्रलयकालके समान खडे हो गये॥ १०८--११३॥

verses.sanskrit: एवं ध्यानसमायुक्तः स्वदेहं यः परित्यजेत् स याति शिवसायुज्यं समुद्धृत्य कुलत्रयम्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ dhyānasamāyuktaḥ svadehaṃ yaḥ parityajet sa yāti śivasāyujyaṃ samuddhṛtya kulatrayam
verses.translation: ST. defines 'yoga-jnanam' as yoga-yuktam jnanam' i. e. know- ledge joined with meditation. Yoga is the means for the attainment of right or perfect knowledge *yogo hi jhana-sadhanam.*
verses.hindi: तब पुलकित रोमोंवाली पार्वती वहाँ स्थित उन जगत्प्रभुकी उस परम मूर्तिको पुनः देखनेमें समर्थ न हो सकीं। तदनन्तर पहले कभी न देखे गये उस स्वरूपको प्रकृतिमें स्थित समझकर वे परमेश्वरी योगके द्वारा प्रकृतिका रूप धारणकर महात्मा शिवके उस स्वरूपको पुनः देखनेमें समर्थ हो गयीं॥ ११४-११५/२॥

verses.sanskrit: अथवारिष्टमालोक्य मरणे समुपस्थिते अविमुक्तेश्वरं गत्वा वाराणस्यां तु शोधनम्
verses.transliteration: athavāriṣṭamālokya maraṇe samupasthite avimukteśvaraṃ gatvā vārāṇasyāṃ tu śodhanam
verses.translation: ST. defines 'yoga-jnanam' as yoga-yuktam jnanam' i. e. know- ledge joined with meditation. Yoga is the means for the attainment of right or perfect knowledge *yogo hi jhana-sadhanam.*
verses.hindi: तब अत्यन्त सुन्दर पंचाक्षर मन्त्रका स्मरण करते हुए दग्ध लिङ्गवाले वे सभी योगी शिवके ध्यानमें लीन होकर उन विराट् पुरुषके हृदयमें प्रविष्ट हुए। तदनन्तर शिवजीने सभी पापोंका हरण करनेवाले, दिव्य

verses.sanskrit: येन केनापि वा देहं संत्यजेन् मुच्यते नरः श्रीपर्वते वा विप्रेन्द्राः संत्यजेत्स्वतनुं नरः
verses.transliteration: yena kenāpi vā dehaṃ saṃtyajen mucyate naraḥ śrīparvate vā viprendrāḥ saṃtyajetsvatanuṃ naraḥ
verses.translation: ST. defines 'yoga-jnanam' as yoga-yuktam jnanam' i. e. know- ledge joined with meditation. Yoga is the means for the attainment of right or perfect knowledge *yogo hi jhana-sadhanam.*
verses.hindi: तथा पूर्वमें प्रकट किये गये नीललोहितमूर्तिस्थ रूपको पुनः धारण किया उस रूपको देखकर पुलकित समस्त रोमोंवाली पार्वतीने स्तुति करते हुए तथा उनके चरणोंमें प्रणाम करके कहा-“हे भगवन्! ये कौन हैं ?' तब सुरश्रेष्ठ शिव पर्वतराजकी उन पुत्रीसे कहने लगे॥ ११९/२॥
verses.wordMeaning: ST. defines 'yoga-jnanam' as yoga-yuktam jnanam' i. e. know- ledge joined with meditation. Yoga is the means for the attainment of right or perfect knowledge *yogo hi jhana-sadhanam.*

verses.sanskrit: स याति शिवसायुज्यं नात्र कार्या विचारणा अविमुक्तं परं क्षेत्रं जन्तूनां मुक्तिदं सदा
verses.transliteration: sa yāti śivasāyujyaṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā avimuktaṃ paraṃ kṣetraṃ jantūnāṃ muktidaṃ sadā

verses.hindi: श्रीभगवान् बोले-हे भामिनि! मेरे व्रतका आश्रय लेकर जिन-जिन भक्तियुक्त श्रेष्ठ ट्विजोंने यहाँ योगका अभ्यास किया है, उनके एक जन्ममें ही इस क्षेत्रके प्रभाव तथा उनकी भक्तिके कारण मैं स्वयं
verses.wordMeaning: ST. defines 'yoga-jnanam' as yoga-yuktam jnanam' i. e. know- ledge joined with meditation. Yoga is the means for the attainment of right or perfect knowledge *yogo hi jhana-sadhanam.*

verses.sanskrit: सेवेत सततं धीमान् विशेषान्मरणान्तिके
verses.transliteration: seveta satataṃ dhīmān viśeṣānmaraṇāntike

verses.hindi: विग्रहरूपसे इस प्रकारका अनुग्रह करता हूँ। अतः यह महान् क्षेत्र ब्रह्मा आदि देवताओं, वेदज श्रेष्ठ ब्राह्मणों, सिद्धों तथा तपस्वियोंके द्वार सेवित है। हे देवि! प्रत्येक महीनेमें दोनों पक्षोंको अष्टमी तथा चतुर्दशीको वाराणसीमें शिवकी पूजा की जाती है। सूर्यग्रहण तथा चन्द्रग्रहणके अवसरपर, विशेषकर कार्तिक महीनेमें, पुण्यप्रद सभी पर्वोमें, विषुवत् एवं अयन संक्रान्तियोंमें पृथ्वीपर स्थित सभी तीर्थ वाराणसीमें
verses.wordMeaning: ST. defines 'yoga-jnanam' as yoga-yuktam jnanam' i. e. know- ledge joined with meditation. Yoga is the means for the attainment of right or perfect knowledge *yogo hi jhana-sadhanam.*
verses.commentary: Sense: ST. defines 'yoga-jnanam' as yoga-yuktam jnanam' i. e. know- ledge joined with meditation. Yoga is the means for the attainment of right or perfect knowledge *yogo hi jhana-sadhanam.*

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीलिङ्गमहापुराणे पूर्वभागे अरिष्टकथनं नाम एकनवतितमो ऽध्यायः एवं वाराणसी पुण्या यदि सूत महामते वक्तुमर्हसि चास्माकं तत्प्रभावं हि सांप्रतम्
verses.transliteration: iti śrīliṅgamahāpurāṇe pūrvabhāge ariṣṭakathanaṃ nāma ekanavatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ evaṃ vārāṇasī puṇyā yadi sūta mahāmate vaktumarhasi cāsmākaṃ tatprabhāvaṃ hi sāṃpratam
verses.translation: O suta of great intellect, if Varanasi is so meritori- ous it behoves you to recount its greatness to us now. We are eager to hear in detail the excellent greatness of this holy centre Avimukta.
verses.hindi: विद्यमान उत्तरवाहिनी, पुण्यमयी, मेरे सिरसे निकली
verses.wordMeaning: O suta of great intellect, if Varanasi is so meritori- ous it behoves you to recount its greatness to us now. We are eager to hear in detail the excellent greatness of this holy centre Avimukta.
verses.commentary: Sense: O suta of great intellect, if Varanasi is so meritori- ous it behoves you to recount its greatness to us now. We are eager to hear in detail the excellent greatness of this holy centre Avimukta.

verses.sanskrit: क्षेत्रस्यास्य च माहात्म्यम् अविमुक्तस्य शोभनम् विस्तरेण यथान्यायं श्रोतुं कौतूहलं हि नः
verses.transliteration: kṣetrasyāsya ca māhātmyam avimuktasya śobhanam vistareṇa yathānyāyaṃ śrotuṃ kautūhalaṃ hi naḥ
verses.translation: I shall succinctly mention the glory of Avimukta, of Varanasi in the manner in which lord Bhava had narrated it.
verses.hindi: पुण्यमयस्थानमें विराजमान और सदा पुण्य दिशाको ओर प्रवाहित होनेवाली पवित्र गंगाका सेवन करते हैं । हे वरानने! सभी ओरसे आकर जो उन भागीरथीका सेवन करते हैं, उन्हें सुनो का) ०१००१२ फफ फ्रम अफफफफफककक मामा मामामा फाम माफ फफ फ फ फ फ फ फ फ फ़ फफ फफफफफफफफाफ फा फफाफ फी फा का
verses.wordMeaning: I shall succinctly mention the glory of Avimukta, of Varanasi in the manner in which lord Bhava had narrated it.
verses.commentary: Sense: I shall succinctly mention the glory of Avimukta, of Varanasi in the manner in which lord Bhava had narrated it.

verses.sanskrit: वक्ष्ये संक्षेपतः सम्यक् वाराणस्याः सुशोभनम् अविमुक्तस्य माहात्म्यं यथाह भगवान् भवः
verses.transliteration: vakṣye saṃkṣepataḥ samyak vārāṇasyāḥ suśobhanam avimuktasya māhātmyaṃ yathāha bhagavān bhavaḥ
verses.translation: O leading brahmins, even in hundreds and crores of years it cannot be mentioned in detail by me or by the noble Brahma.
verses.hindi: हे देवि! है सुव्रते! कुरुक्षेत्र, पुष्कर, निप
verses.wordMeaning: O leading brahmins, even in hundreds and crores of years it cannot be mentioned in detail by me or by the noble Brahma.
verses.commentary: Sense: O leading brahmins, even in hundreds and crores of years it cannot be mentioned in detail by me or by the noble Brahma.

verses.sanskrit: विस्तरेण मया वक्तुं ब्रह्मणा च महात्मना शक्यते नैव विप्रेन्द्रा वर्षकोटिशतैरपि
verses.transliteration: vistareṇa mayā vaktuṃ brahmaṇā ca mahātmanā śakyate naiva viprendrā varṣakoṭiśatairapi
verses.translation: Formerly, after his marriage, Sankara, Nilalohita start- ed from the peak of the Himav in the company of the goddess the daughter of the Himavan, and the leading Ganas. After reaching Varanasi Sankara showed his Lihga Avimuktevara and began to stay there.
verses.hindi: पुष्कर निमिषं चैव प्रयागं च पृथूदकम्॥ १२८  प्रयाग, पृथूदक, दुमक्षेतर, कुरुक्षेत्र, तीर्थमय नैमिष, सः क्षेत्राणि सर्वतो देवि देवता ऋषयस्तथा
verses.wordMeaning: Formerly, after his marriage, Sankara, Nilalohita start- ed from the peak of the Himav in the company of the goddess the daughter of the Himavan, and the leading Ganas. After reaching Varanasi Sankara showed his Lihga Avimuktevara and began to stay there.
verses.commentary: Sense: Formerly, after his marriage, Sankara, Nilalohita start- ed from the peak of the Himav in the company of the goddess the daughter of the Himavan, and the leading Ganas. After reaching Varanasi Sankara showed his Lihga Avimuktevara and began to stay there.

verses.sanskrit: देवः पुरा कृतोद्वाहः शङ्करो नीललोहितः हिमवच्छिखराद्देव्या हैमवत्या गणेश्वरैः
verses.transliteration: devaḥ purā kṛtodvāhaḥ śaṅkaro nīlalohitaḥ himavacchikharāddevyā haimavatyā gaṇeśvaraiḥ
verses.translation: One can become an ascetic in the following places, viz., Varanasi, Kuruksetra,®® Sriparvata, Mahalaya,®®® TuhgeS- vara,®®® and Kedara,®® But if one performs the yoga of Pasupati perfectly for a day, one becomes an ascetic. Hence, one shall eschew everything and perform the PaiSupata yoga.
verses.hindi: समुद्राः सप्त चैवात्र देवतीर्थानि कृत्स्नशः
verses.wordMeaning: One can become an ascetic in the following places, viz., Varanasi, Kuruksetra,®® Sriparvata, Mahalaya,®®® TuhgeS- vara,®®® and Kedara,®® But if one performs the yoga of Pasupati perfectly for a day, one becomes an ascetic. Hence,…
verses.commentary: Sense: One can become an ascetic in the following places, viz., Varanasi, Kuruksetra,®® Sriparvata, Mahalaya,®®® TuhgeS- vara,®®® and Kedara,®® But if one performs the yoga of Pasupati perfectly for a day, one becomes an ascetic. Hence,…

verses.sanskrit: वाराणसीमनुप्राप्य दर्शयामास शङ्करः अविमुक्तेश्वरं लिङ्गं वासं तत्र चकार सः
verses.transliteration: vārāṇasīmanuprāpya darśayāmāsa śaṅkaraḥ avimukteśvaraṃ liṅgaṃ vāsaṃ tatra cakāra saḥ
verses.translation: One shall stay there in the garden of the Lord. There is an excellent garden of Sarva at that place. Rudra created mentally a splendid mansion also.
verses.hindi: कालभैरवमासाद्य धूतपापानि सर्वशः। भवन्ति हि सुरेशानि सर्वपर्वसु पर्वसु अविमुक्तं क्षेत्रवरं महापापनिबर्हणम्
verses.wordMeaning: One shall stay there in the garden of the Lord. There is an excellent garden of Sarva at that place. Rudra created mentally a splendid mansion also.
verses.commentary: Sense: One shall stay there in the garden of the Lord. There is an excellent garden of Sarva at that place. Rudra created mentally a splendid mansion also.

verses.sanskrit: वाराणसीकुरुक्षेत्रश्रीपर्वतमहालये तुङ्गेश्वरे च केदारे तत्स्थाने यो यतिर्भवेत्
verses.transliteration: vārāṇasīkurukṣetraśrīparvatamahālaye tuṅgeśvare ca kedāre tatsthāne yo yatirbhavet
verses.translation: The lord accompanied by Nandin pointed out that divine excellent garden to the daughter of the Himavan.
verses.hindi: केदारे चैव यल्लिङ्गं यच्च लिङ्गं महालये
verses.wordMeaning: The lord accompanied by Nandin pointed out that divine excellent garden to the daughter of the Himavan.
verses.commentary: Sense: The lord accompanied by Nandin pointed out that divine excellent garden to the daughter of the Himavan.

verses.sanskrit: योगे पाशुपते सम्यक् दिनमेकं यतिर्भवेत् तस्मात्सर्वं परित्यज्य चरेत् पाशुपतं व्रतम्
verses.transliteration: yoge pāśupate samyak dinamekaṃ yatirbhavet tasmātsarvaṃ parityajya caret pāśupataṃ vratam
verses.translation: Sankara Paramesana, Bhava mentioned to her the greatness of this holy centre Avimukta just for her pleasure.
verses.hindi: शङ्कुकर्णेश्वरं चैव गोकर्णौ च तथा ह्युभौ स्थानेशवरं तथैकाग्रं कालेश्वरमजेश्वरम्
verses.wordMeaning: Sankara Paramesana, Bhava mentioned to her the greatness of this holy centre Avimukta just for her pleasure.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sankara Paramesana, Bhava mentioned to her the greatness of this holy centre Avimukta just for her pleasure.

verses.sanskrit: देवोद्याने वसेत्तत्र शर्वोद्यानमनुत्तमम् मनसा निर्ममे रुद्रो विमानं च सुशोभनम्
verses.transliteration: devodyāne vasettatra śarvodyānamanuttamam manasā nirmame rudro vimānaṃ ca suśobhanam
verses.translation: The garden was rendered beautiful by the different clusters of trees in full bloom. It was very charming due to the spreading creepers, the Priyahgu plants with growing flowers, and the Ketaka plants in full bloom though covered with thorns.
verses.hindi: भैरवेश्वरमीशानं तथोङ्कारकसंज्ञितम्। अमरेशं महाकालं ज्योतिषं भस्मगात्रकम्
verses.wordMeaning: The garden was rendered beautiful by the different clusters of trees in full bloom. It was very charming due to the spreading creepers, the Priyahgu plants with growing flowers, and the Ketaka plants in full bloom though covered with thorns.
verses.commentary: Sense: The garden was rendered beautiful by the different clusters of trees in full bloom. It was very charming due to the spreading creepers, the Priyahgu plants with growing flowers, and the Ketaka plants in full bloom though covered with thorns.

verses.sanskrit: दर्शयामास च तदा देवोद्यानमनुत्तमम् हैमवत्याः स्वयं देवः सनन्दी परमेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: darśayāmāsa ca tadā devodyānamanuttamam haimavatyāḥ svayaṃ devaḥ sanandī parameśvaraḥ
verses.translation: It was overspread with clusters of the Tamala trees. It was strewn with plenty of fragrant Bakula flowers all round. Hundreds of As oka and Punnaga trees were in full bloom. Swarms of bees hovered round the flowers.
verses.hindi: सर्वयज्ञफलैस्तुल्यमिष्टैः शतसहस्त्रशः। परात्परतरं देवि बुध्यस्वेति मयोदितम्
verses.wordMeaning: It was overspread with clusters of the Tamala trees. It was strewn with plenty of fragrant Bakula flowers all round. Hundreds of As oka and Punnaga trees were in full bloom. Swarms of bees hovered round the flowers.
verses.commentary: Sense: It was overspread with clusters of the Tamala trees. It was strewn with plenty of fragrant Bakula flowers all round. Hundreds of As oka and Punnaga trees were in full bloom. Swarms of bees hovered round the flowers.

verses.sanskrit: क्षेत्रस्यास्य च माहात्म्यम् अविमुक्तस्य शङ्करः उक्तवान्परमेशानः पार्वत्याः प्रीतये भवः
verses.transliteration: kṣetrasyāsya ca māhātmyam avimuktasya śaṅkaraḥ uktavānparameśānaḥ pārvatyāḥ prītaye bhavaḥ
verses.translation: In some places the garden was resonant with the birds, Sarasas (Indian cranes), Cakravakas (Ruddy geese) and the intoxicated excellent Datyuhas (water-crows) all round. These birds were embellished by means of the pollen dust of the full-blown lotuses. They were chirping every moment.
verses.hindi: अविशब्देन पापस्तु वेदोक्तः कथ्यते द्विजैः । तेन मुक्तं मया जुष्टमविमुक्तमतोच्यते
verses.wordMeaning: In some places the garden was resonant with the birds, Sarasas (Indian cranes), Cakravakas (Ruddy geese) and the intoxicated excellent Datyuhas (water-crows) all round. These birds were embellished by means of the pollen dust of the full-blown lotuses.…
verses.commentary: Sense: In some places the garden was resonant with the birds, Sarasas (Indian cranes), Cakravakas (Ruddy geese) and the intoxicated excellent Datyuhas (water-crows) all round. These birds were embellished by means of the pollen dust of the full-blown lotuses.…

verses.sanskrit: प्रफुल्लनानाविधगुल्मशोभितं लताप्रतानादिमनोहरं बहिः विरूढपुष्पैः परितः प्रियङ्गुभिः सुपुष्पितैः कण्टकितैश् च केतकैः
verses.transliteration: praphullanānāvidhagulmaśobhitaṃ latāpratānādimanoharaṃ bahiḥ virūḍhapuṣpaiḥ paritaḥ priyaṅgubhiḥ supuṣpitaiḥ kaṇṭakitaiś ca ketakaiḥ
verses.translation: In some places the excellent garden was resonant with the crowing sound of the peacocks; in some places it was resonant with the cackling sound of the Karancava ducks; in some places the garden was rendered noisy by the swarms of the inebriate bees accompanied by their bee-mates equally agitated due to intoxication.
verses.hindi: क्षेत्र, देवता, ऋषिगण, सन्ध्या, ऋतुएँ, सभी नदियां सभी सरोवर, सातौं समुद्र तथा समस्त देवतीर्थ एको होकर सैकड़ों तीर्थोसहित सभी पर्वोके अवसर भागीरथीमें आकर मिल जाते हैं और है सुरेशानि! सभी पर्वोपर अविमुक्तेश्वर तथा त्रिविष्टपका दर्शन करके पुनः कालभैरव पहुँचकर पूर्णरूपसे पापमुक्त हो जाते
verses.wordMeaning: In some places the excellent garden was resonant with the crowing sound of the peacocks; in some places it was resonant with the cackling sound of the Karancava ducks;…
verses.commentary: Sense: In some places the excellent garden was resonant with the crowing sound of the peacocks; in some places it was resonant with the cackling sound of the Karancava ducks;…

verses.sanskrit: तमालगुल्मैर्निचितं सुगन्धिभिर् निकामपुष्पैर्वकुलैश् च सर्वतः अशोकपुन्नागशतैः सुपुष्पितैर् द्विरेफमालाकुलपुष्पसंचयैः
verses.transliteration: tamālagulmairnicitaṃ sugandhibhir nikāmapuṣpairvakulaiś ca sarvataḥ aśokapunnāgaśataiḥ supuṣpitair dvirephamālākulapuṣpasaṃcayaiḥ
verses.translation: It abounded in charming and fragrant flowers. In some places it was full of Sahakara (mango) trees with fresh sprouts; some places (in the garden) were hidden by Tilaka trees encircled by creepers. The Vidyadharas, Siddhas and Car anas sang in some places in the garden.
verses.hindi: हैं। पृथ्वीपर जो भी पवित्र तथा महान् आयत
verses.wordMeaning: It abounded in charming and fragrant flowers. In some places it was full of Sahakara (mango) trees with fresh sprouts; some places (in the garden) were hidden by Tilaka trees encircled by creepers. The Vidyadharas, Siddhas and Car anas sang in some places in the garden.
verses.commentary: Sense: It abounded in charming and fragrant flowers. In some places it was full of Sahakara (mango) trees with fresh sprouts; some places (in the garden) were hidden by Tilaka trees encircled by creepers. The Vidyadharas, Siddhas and Car anas sang in some places in the garden.

verses.sanskrit: क्वचित् प्रफुल्लाम्बुजरेणुभूषितैर् विहङ्गमैश् चानुकलप्रणादिभिः विनादितं सारसचक्रवाकैः प्रमत्तदात्यूहवरैश् च सर्वतः
verses.transliteration: kvacit praphullāmbujareṇubhūṣitair vihaṅgamaiś cānukalapraṇādibhiḥ vināditaṃ sārasacakravākaiḥ pramattadātyūhavaraiś ca sarvataḥ
verses.translation: In some places it abounded in fragrant bunches of flowers and sprouts of the Darbha grass plucked by the deer. In some places it was embellished by lakes and ponds aboun- ding in different charming full-blown lotuses.
verses.hindi: (देवालय) हैं, वे समस्त पर्वोके अवसरपर महापापोंका नाश करनेवाले क्षेत्रश्रेष्ठ पुण्यमय अविमुक्तमें आकर प्रविष्ट हो जाते हैं केदार खण्ड -में स्थित लिङ्ग, महालयमें स्थित लिङ्ग, मध्यमेश्वर नामक लिङ्ग, पाशुपतेश्वर, शंकु- कर्णेश्वर, दोनों गोकर्णेश्वर, द्रुमचण्डेश्वर, अत्युत्तम भद्रेश्वर, स्थानेश्वर, एकाग्रेशवर, कालेश्वर, अजेश्वर,
verses.wordMeaning: In some places it abounded in fragrant bunches of flowers and sprouts of the Darbha grass plucked by the deer. In some places it was embellished by lakes and ponds aboun- ding in different charming full-blown lotuses.
verses.commentary: Sense: In some places it abounded in fragrant bunches of flowers and sprouts of the Darbha grass plucked by the deer. In some places it was embellished by lakes and ponds aboun- ding in different charming full-blown lotuses.

verses.sanskrit: क्वचिच्च केकारुतनादितं शुभं क्वचिच्च कारण्डवनादनादितम् क्वचिच्च मत्तालिकुलाकुलीकृतं मदाकुलाभिर् भ्रमराङ्गनादिभिः
verses.transliteration: kvacicca kekārutanāditaṃ śubhaṃ kvacicca kāraṇḍavanādanāditam kvacicca mattālikulākulīkṛtaṃ madākulābhir bhramarāṅganādibhiḥ
verses.translation: In some places the beautiful creepers were chewed by the ladies of the Kimpurusa clan who walked in the garden in their elegant slow gait. In some places the beautiful trees were embraced by the creepers.
verses.hindi: भैरवेश्वर, ईशान, ओंकारेश्वर, अमरेश्वर, महाकालेश्वर,
verses.wordMeaning: In some places the beautiful creepers were chewed by the ladies of the Kimpurusa clan who walked in the garden in their elegant slow gait. In some places the beautiful trees were embraced by the creepers.
verses.commentary: Sense: In some places the beautiful creepers were chewed by the ladies of the Kimpurusa clan who walked in the garden in their elegant slow gait. In some places the beautiful trees were embraced by the creepers.

verses.sanskrit: निषेवितं चारुसुगन्धिपुष्पकैः क्वचित् सुपुष्पैः सहकारवृक्षैः लतोपगूढैस्तिलकैश् च गूढं प्रगीतविद्याधरसिद्धचारणम्
verses.transliteration: niṣevitaṃ cārusugandhipuṣpakaiḥ kvacit supuṣpaiḥ sahakāravṛkṣaiḥ latopagūḍhaistilakaiś ca gūḍhaṃ pragītavidyādharasiddhacāraṇam
verses.translation: (?) The beautiful tops of the trees touched the clouds. The pigeons and doves sat on these tops and made a cooing noise. The tips of the trees had beautiful white forms that captivated the minds. The flowers that were scattered by these pigeons from tree tops disturbed the swans (in the lakes below ). The garden was rendered charming by several groups of divine beings.
verses.hindi: मेरे पवित्र स्थान इस भूतलपर हैं एवं जो अन्य सभी लोकप्रसिद्ध स्थान हैं; वे सब वाराणसीमें मेरे पास सभी पुण्यप्रद पर्वोपर आ जाते हैं। है देवि! इसी कारणसे यहाँपर मृत्युको प्राप्त प्राणी दिव्य अमृत  (अमर) पद प्राप्त करता है; मैंने यह रहस्यमय बात
verses.wordMeaning: (?) The beautiful tops of the trees touched the clouds. The pigeons and doves sat on these tops and made a cooing noise. The tips of the trees had beautiful white forms that captivated the minds.…
verses.commentary: Sense: (?) The beautiful tops of the trees touched the clouds. The pigeons and doves sat on these tops and made a cooing noise. The tips of the trees had beautiful white forms that captivated the minds.…

verses.sanskrit: प्रवृत्तनृत्तानुगताप्सरोगणं प्रहृष्टनानाविधपक्षिसेवितम् प्रनृत्तहारीतकुलोपनादितं मृगेन्द्रनादाकुलमत्तमानसैः
verses.transliteration: pravṛttanṛttānugatāpsarogaṇaṃ prahṛṣṭanānāvidhapakṣisevitam pranṛttahārītakulopanāditaṃ mṛgendranādākulamattamānasaiḥ
verses.translation: It contained number of garden lakes with full-blown lilies and lotuses spreading far and wide and these brightened up the path leading to the shrine of lord Siva. The place was covered with different hedges and branches in combination with wonderful rows of flowers in the middle of the paths.
verses.wordMeaning: It contained number of garden lakes with full-blown lilies and lotuses spreading far and wide and these brightened up the path leading to the shrine of lord Siva.…
verses.commentary: Sense: It contained number of garden lakes with full-blown lilies and lotuses spreading far and wide and these brightened up the path leading to the shrine of lord Siva.…

verses.sanskrit: क्वचित् क्वचिद् गन्धकदम्बकैर् मृगैर् विलूनदर्भाङ्कुरपुष्पसंचयम् प्रफुल्लनानाविधचारुपङ्कजैः सरस्तडागैरुपशोभितं क्वचित्
verses.transliteration: kvacit kvacid gandhakadambakair mṛgair vilūnadarbhāṅkurapuṣpasaṃcayam praphullanānāvidhacārupaṅkajaiḥ sarastaḍāgairupaśobhitaṃ kvacit
verses.translation: The borderlands of the garden were brightened up by charming Asoka trees with lofty tops and with their tall bran- ches stooping down due to the weight of branches of the flowers. There were swings on either side of these trees and the songs of the birds resting therein caused pleasure to the ears. At night these trees in full bloom became indistinguishable from the Tilaka trees in bloom, thanks to the lustre of the moon. Herds of deer lay under the cool shade of the trees, some sleeping and some awake. Some of these deer had completely nibbled the tips of the Durva grass.
verses.hindi: हे शुभे! वाराणसीमें गंगामें स्नान करके मेरा दर्शन करनेसे मनुष्य सैकड़ों-हजारों समस्त यशोंके अभीष्ट फलोंके समान फल शीघ्र ही प्राप्त करता है, इससे बढ़कर आश्चर्य क्या हो सकता है? है देवि! देवस्थान हैं, उनमें मेरे द्वार बताये गये इस वाराणसीक्षेत्रकी सबसे श्रेष्ठ जानो। ब्राह्मणोने वेदोंमे वर्णित पापकी अवि' शब्दसे कहा है; यह क्षेत्र उस पाप-से मुक्त
verses.wordMeaning: The borderlands of the garden were brightened up by charming Asoka trees with lofty tops and with their tall bran- ches stooping down due to the weight of branches of the flowers.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The borderlands of the garden were brightened up by charming Asoka trees with lofty tops and with their tall bran- ches stooping down due to the weight of branches of the flowers.…

verses.sanskrit: विटपनिचयलीनं नीलकण्ठाभिरामं मदमुदितविहङ्गं प्राप्तनादाभिरामम् कुसुमिततरुशाखालीनमत्तद्विरेफं नवकिसलयशोभाशोभितं प्रांशुशाखम्
verses.transliteration: viṭapanicayalīnaṃ nīlakaṇṭhābhirāmaṃ madamuditavihaṅgaṃ prāptanādābhirāmam kusumitataruśākhālīnamattadvirephaṃ navakisalayaśobhāśobhitaṃ prāṃśuśākham
verses.translation: The clear waters of the lakes were spreading out due to the moving lotuses which were set in motion by the wind from the fluttering of the wings of swans. Flocks of* peacocks danced elegantly on seeing the plantain trees on the banks of these lakes set in motion by the waters coming to their roots. The lands in some places appeared beautiful due to the eyelets on the feathers strewn on the ground from the tails of these peacocks. In these spots, inebriate pigeons and doves of the species called "Harita** lurked leisurely and rejoiced.
verses.hindi: है तथा मेरे द्वारा सेवित है, अत: इसे 'अविमुक्त' कही
verses.wordMeaning: The clear waters of the lakes were spreading out due to the moving lotuses which were set in motion by the wind from the fluttering of the wings of swans.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The clear waters of the lakes were spreading out due to the moving lotuses which were set in motion by the wind from the fluttering of the wings of swans.…

verses.sanskrit: क्वचिच्च दन्तक्षतचारुवीरुधं क्वचिल्लतालिङ्गितचारुवृक्षकम् ।* क्वचिद्विलासालसगामिनीभिर् निषेवितं किंपुरुषाङ्गनाभिः
verses.transliteration: kvacicca dantakṣatacāruvīrudhaṃ kvacillatāliṅgitacāruvṛkṣakam /* kvacidvilāsālasagāminībhir niṣevitaṃ kiṃpuruṣāṅganābhiḥ
verses.translation: In some places the spots were beautified by the Sarahga (flamingo) birds. Some places were covered with
verses.hindi: जाता है॥ १४०--१४३ ॥ अविमुक्तक्षेत्र वाराणसीका माहात्म्य तथा श्रीविश्वेश्वरपूजाविधिवर्णन
verses.wordMeaning: In some places the spots were beautified by the Sarahga (flamingo) birds. Some places were covered with
verses.commentary: Sense: In some places the spots were beautified by the Sarahga (flamingo) birds. Some places were covered with

verses.sanskrit: पारावतध्वनिविकूजितचारुशृङ्गैर् अभ्रङ्कषैः सितमनोहरचारुरूपैः आकीर्णपुष्पनिकरप्रविभक्तहंसैर् विभ्राजितं त्रिदशदिव्यकुलैरनेकैः
verses.transliteration: pārāvatadhvanivikūjitacāruśṛṅgair abhraṅkaṣaiḥ sitamanoharacārurūpaiḥ ākīrṇapuṣpanikarapravibhaktahaṃsair vibhrājitaṃ tridaśadivyakulairanekaiḥ
verses.translation: The trees thickly growing there harboured the resi- dences of the sages beneath them, with flowers strewn around. In some places the garden contained a lot of Jack trees, tall and spreading all round, with fruits growing from their very bottom.
verses.hindi: भगवान् रुद्रः सर्वलोकमहेश्वरः । सुदृष्टं कुरु देवेशि अविमुक्तं गृहं मम
verses.wordMeaning: The trees thickly growing there harboured the resi- dences of the sages beneath them, with flowers strewn around. In some places the garden contained a lot of Jack trees, tall and spreading all round, with fruits growing from their very bottom.
verses.commentary: Sense: The trees thickly growing there harboured the resi- dences of the sages beneath them, with flowers strewn around. In some places the garden contained a lot of Jack trees, tall and spreading all round, with fruits growing from their very bottom.

verses.sanskrit: फुल्लोत्पलांबुजवितानसहस्रयुक्तं तोयाशयैः समनुशोभितदेवमार्गम् मार्गान्तराकलितपुष्पविचित्रपङ्क्तिसम्बद्धगुल्मविटपैर् विविधैरुपेतम्
verses.transliteration: phullotpalāṃbujavitānasahasrayuktaṃ toyāśayaiḥ samanuśobhitadevamārgam mārgāntarākalitapuṣpavicitrapaṅktisambaddhagulmaviṭapair vividhairupetam
verses.translation: The garden looked charming and resonant with the sounds of the golden anklets of the Siddhas and the Siddha women resorting to the grottos of Atimuktaka creepers in full bloom. The bees eagerly hovered round the bunches of flowers of the charming Priyahgu trees. Swarms of bees imbibed honey from the flowers of the mango and Kadamba trees.
verses.hindi: भगवान् देवस्तया सार्धमुमापतिः । दर्शयामास भगवान् ्रीपर्वतमनुत्तमम् ्रीपर्वतमनृप्राप्य देव्या देवेश्वरो हरः। क्षेत्राणि दर्शयामास सर्वभूतपतिर्भवः
verses.wordMeaning: The garden looked charming and resonant with the sounds of the golden anklets of the Siddhas and the Siddha women resorting to the grottos of Atimuktaka creepers in full bloom. The bees eagerly hovered round the bunches of flowers of the charming Priyahgu trees.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The garden looked charming and resonant with the sounds of the golden anklets of the Siddhas and the Siddha women resorting to the grottos of Atimuktaka creepers in full bloom. The bees eagerly hovered round the bunches of flowers of the charming Priyahgu trees.…

verses.sanskrit: तुङ्गाग्रैर् नीलपुष्पस्तबकभरनतप्रांशुशाखैर् अशोकैर् दोलाप्रान्तान्तनीलश्रुतिसुखजनकैर् भासितान्तं मनोज्ञैः रात्रौ चन्द्रस्य भासा कुसुमिततिलकैरेकतां सम्प्रयातं छायासुप्तप्रबुद्धस्थितहरिणकुलालुप्तदूर्वाङ्कुराग्रम्
verses.transliteration: tuṅgāgrair nīlapuṣpastabakabharanataprāṃśuśākhair aśokair dolāprāntāntanīlaśrutisukhajanakair bhāsitāntaṃ manojñaiḥ rātrau candrasya bhāsā kusumitatilakairekatāṃ samprayātaṃ chāyāsuptaprabuddhasthitahariṇakulāluptadūrvāṅkurāgram
verses.translation: The garden which bestows salvation on embodied beings looked charming with the water in the ponds gently shaken by the breeze and strewn with clusters of flowers. The fascinating hedges with bees humming therein beautified the garden. Herds of doves which got suddenly frightened by the gusts of wind took shelter within the thickets there.
verses.hindi: कुण्डिप्रभं च परमं दिव्यं वैश्रवणेश्वरम्। आशालिङ्गं च देवेशं दिव्यं यच्च बिलेशवरम्
verses.wordMeaning: The garden which bestows salvation on embodied beings looked charming with the water in the ponds gently shaken by the breeze and strewn with clusters of flowers. The fascinating hedges with bees humming therein beautified the garden.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The garden which bestows salvation on embodied beings looked charming with the water in the ponds gently shaken by the breeze and strewn with clusters of flowers. The fascinating hedges with bees humming therein beautified the garden.…

verses.sanskrit: हंसानां पक्षवातप्रचलितकमलस्वच्छविस्तीर्णतोयं तोयानां तीरजातप्रचकितकदलीचाटुनृत्यन्मयूरम् मायूरैः पक्षचन्द्रैः क्वचिदवनिगतै रञ्जितक्ष्माप्रदेशं देशे देशे विलीनप्रमुदितविलसन्मत्तहारीतवृन्दम्
verses.transliteration: haṃsānāṃ pakṣavātapracalitakamalasvacchavistīrṇatoyaṃ toyānāṃ tīrajātapracakitakadalīcāṭunṛtyanmayūram māyūraiḥ pakṣacandraiḥ kvacidavanigatai rañjitakṣmāpradeśaṃ deśe deśe vilīnapramuditavilasanmattahārītavṛndam
verses.translation: The garden was heightened in beauty by the charm- ing Tilaka trees as brindled as clusters of moon's rays; by the A§oka trees resembling saffron of the various types such as Sindura, Kuxhkuma and Kusumbha and by the KarikHra trees having the lustre of gold. These trees had large spreading branches and were in full bloom with plenty of flowers.
verses.hindi: रामेश्वरं च परमं विष्णुना यत्प्रतिष्ठितम्। दक्षिणद्वारपार्श्वे तु कुण्डलेश्वरमीश्वरम् विवृद्धं गिरिणा सार्धं देवदेवनमस्कृतम्
verses.wordMeaning: The garden was heightened in beauty by the charm- ing Tilaka trees as brindled as clusters of moon's rays; by the A§oka trees resembling saffron of the various types such as Sindura, Kuxhkuma and Kusumbha and by the KarikHra trees having the lustre of gold.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The garden was heightened in beauty by the charm- ing Tilaka trees as brindled as clusters of moon's rays; by the A§oka trees resembling saffron of the various types such as Sindura, Kuxhkuma and Kusumbha and by the KarikHra trees having the lustre of gold.…

verses.sanskrit: सारङ्गैः क्वचिदुपशोभितप्रदेशं प्रच्छन्नं कुसुमचयैः क्वचिद्विचित्रैः हृष्टाभिः क्वचिदपि किन्नराङ्गनाभिर् वीणाभिः सुमधुरगीतनृत्तकण्ठम्
verses.transliteration: sāraṅgaiḥ kvacidupaśobhitapradeśaṃ pracchannaṃ kusumacayaiḥ kvacidvicitraiḥ hṛṣṭābhiḥ kvacidapi kinnarāṅganābhir vīṇābhiḥ sumadhuragītanṛttakaṇṭham
verses.translation: The ground was covered with flowers of various colours. In some places they had the lustre of powdered col- iyrium; in some places they resembled coral and in other places they were like gold.
verses.hindi: मध्यमेश्वरमित्युक्तं त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुतम्। अमरेश्वरं च वरदं देवैः पूर्व प्रतिष्ठितम्
verses.wordMeaning: The ground was covered with flowers of various colours. In some places they had the lustre of powdered col- iyrium; in some places they resembled coral and in other places they were like gold.
verses.commentary: Sense: The ground was covered with flowers of various colours. In some places they had the lustre of powdered col- iyrium; in some places they resembled coral and in other places they were like gold.

verses.sanskrit: संसृष्टैः क्वचिदुपलिप्तकीर्णपुष्पैर् आवासैः परिवृतपादपं मुनीनाम् आ मूलात् फलनिचितैः क्वचिद्विशालैर् उत्तुङ्गैः पनसमहीरुहैरुपेतम्
verses.transliteration: saṃsṛṣṭaiḥ kvacidupaliptakīrṇapuṣpair āvāsaiḥ parivṛtapādapaṃ munīnām ā mūlāt phalanicitaiḥ kvacidviśālair uttuṅgaiḥ panasamahīruhairupetam
verses.translation: Hundreds of birds chirped on the Punnaga trees. The red Aoka trees bent down due to the weight of bunches of flowers. There were rest houses on the charming outskirts of the garden and they dispelled fatigue. The bees danced spor- tively on the full-blown lotuses.
verses.hindi: कर्मेशवरं च विपुलं कार्यार्थ ब्रह्मणा कृतम् तत्रैव पादुके दिव्ये मदीये च बिलेश्वरे। तत्र शृङ्काटकाकारं श्रृङ्गाटाचलमध्यमे
verses.wordMeaning: Hundreds of birds chirped on the Punnaga trees. The red Aoka trees bent down due to the weight of bunches of flowers. There were rest houses on the charming outskirts of the garden and they dispelled fatigue. The bees danced spor- tively on the full-blown lotuses.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hundreds of birds chirped on the Punnaga trees. The red Aoka trees bent down due to the weight of bunches of flowers. There were rest houses on the charming outskirts of the garden and they dispelled fatigue. The bees danced spor- tively on the full-blown lotuses.

verses.sanskrit: फुल्लातिमुक्तकलतागृहनीतसिद्धसिद्धाङ्गनाकनकनूपुररावरम्यम् ।* रम्यं प्रियङ्गुतरुमञ्जरिसक्तभृङ्गं भृङ्गावलीकवलिताम्रकदम्बपुष्पम्
verses.transliteration: phullātimuktakalatāgṛhanītasiddhasiddhāṅganākanakanūpurarāvaramyam /* ramyaṃ priyaṅgutarumañjarisaktabhṛṅgaṃ bhṛṅgāvalīkavalitāmrakadambapuṣpam
verses.translation: Accompanied by the daughter of the mountain with snow-clad peaks, as wdl as by the friendly leaders of Ganias who were intoxicated, delighted, and well nourished with food, lord Siva, the ruler of all the worlds, thus pointed out the
verses.hindi: शरृद्ठाटकेश्वरं नाम श्रीदेव्या तु प्रतिष्ठितम्। मल्लिकार्जुनकं चैव मम वासमिदं शुभम्
verses.wordMeaning: Accompanied by the daughter of the mountain with snow-clad peaks, as wdl as by the friendly leaders of Ganias who were intoxicated, delighted, and well nourished with food, lord Siva, the ruler of all the worlds, thus pointed out the
verses.commentary: Sense: Accompanied by the daughter of the mountain with snow-clad peaks, as wdl as by the friendly leaders of Ganias who were intoxicated, delighted, and well nourished with food, lord Siva, the ruler of all the worlds, thus pointed out the

verses.sanskrit: पुष्पोत्करानिलविघूर्णितवारिरम्यं रम्यद्विरेफविनिपातितमञ्जुगुल्मम् गुल्मान्तरप्रसभभीतमृगीसमूहं वातेरितं तनुभृतामपवर्गदातृ
verses.transliteration: puṣpotkarānilavighūrṇitavāriramyaṃ ramyadvirephavinipātitamañjugulmam gulmāntaraprasabhabhītamṛgīsamūhaṃ vāteritaṃ tanubhṛtāmapavargadātṛ
verses.translation: With divine ornaments evolved out of the most auspi- cious flowers of the forest, Siva decorated the divine goddess who was present in the garden. The daughter of the snow- capped mountain also devoutly embellished Siva the lord of Devas with divine flowers that were exceedingly auspicious and beautiful.
verses.hindi: कोटीश्वरं महातीर्थं रुद्रकोटिगणैः पुरा। सेवितं देवि पश्याद्य सर्वस्मादधिकं शुभम् द्विदेवकुलसंज्ञं च ब्रह्मणा दक्षिणे शुभम्। उत्तरे स्थापितं चैव विष्णुना चैव शैलजम्
verses.wordMeaning: With divine ornaments evolved out of the most auspi- cious flowers of the forest, Siva decorated the divine goddess who was present in the garden.…
verses.commentary: Sense: With divine ornaments evolved out of the most auspi- cious flowers of the forest, Siva decorated the divine goddess who was present in the garden.…

verses.sanskrit: चन्द्रांशुजालशबलैस् तिलकैर् मनोज्ञैः सिन्दूरकुङ्कुमकुसुम्भनिभैर् अशोकैः चामीकरद्युतिसमैरथ कर्णिकारैः पुष्पोत्करैरुपचितं सुविशालशाखैः
verses.transliteration: candrāṃśujālaśabalais tilakair manojñaiḥ sindūrakuṅkumakusumbhanibhair aśokaiḥ cāmīkaradyutisamairatha karṇikāraiḥ puṣpotkarairupacitaṃ suviśālaśākhaiḥ
verses.translation: After seeing the extremely charming garden, after worshipping the lord worthy of being worshipped by the leaders of the gods and after bowing down to the lord who was accompanied by the leading Ganas, Nandin and others the goddess spoke to the lord.
verses.hindi: महाप्रमाणलिङ्गं च मया पूर्व प्रतिष्ठितम् पश्चिमे पर्वते पश्य ब्रहोश्वरमलेश्वरम्
verses.wordMeaning: After seeing the extremely charming garden, after worshipping the lord worthy of being worshipped by the leaders of the gods and after bowing down to the lord who was accompanied by the leading Ganas, Nandin and others the goddess spoke to the lord.
verses.commentary: Sense: After seeing the extremely charming garden, after worshipping the lord worthy of being worshipped by the leaders of the gods and after bowing down to the lord who was accompanied by the leading Ganas, Nandin and others the goddess spoke to the lord.

verses.sanskrit: क्वचिदञ्जनचूर्णाभैः क्वचिद् विद्रुमसन्निभैः क्वचित्काञ्चनसंकाशैः पुष्पैर् आचितभूतलम्
verses.transliteration: kvacidañjanacūrṇābhaiḥ kvacid vidrumasannibhaiḥ kvacitkāñcanasaṃkāśaiḥ puṣpair ācitabhūtalam
verses.translation: O lord, the garden equipped with excessive lustre has been seen by me. It behoves you now to recount all the quali- ties of this holy centre.
verses.hindi: ऐसा कहकर सभी लोकोंके स्वामी भगवान् रुद्र पुनः बोले--' देवेशि! मेरे इस अविमुक्त निवास-स्थानको भली-भाँति देखो।' ऐसा कहनेके बाद उन देवीको साथ लेकर भगवान् उमापतिने उन्हें अत्युत्तम श्रीपर्वत दिखाया और वे वहाँ अविमुक्तेश्वरमें उनके साथ नित्य रहने लगे। सर्वत्र गमनकी शक्तिसे युक्त होने तथा सर्वव्यापी होनेके कारण सर्वात्मा, सत्-असत्स्वरूपवाले, देवताओंके स्वामी तथा सभी प्राणियोंके स्वामी भगवान् शिव उन
verses.wordMeaning: O lord, the garden equipped with excessive lustre has been seen by me. It behoves you now to recount all the quali- ties of this holy centre.
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord, the garden equipped with excessive lustre has been seen by me. It behoves you now to recount all the quali- ties of this holy centre.

verses.sanskrit: पुन्नागेषु द्विजशतविरुतं रक्ताशोकस्तबकभरनतम् रम्योपान्तक्लमहारभवनं फुल्लाब्जेषु भ्रमरविलसितम्
verses.transliteration: punnāgeṣu dvijaśatavirutaṃ raktāśokastabakabharanatam ramyopāntaklamahārabhavanaṃ phullābjeṣu bhramaravilasitam
verses.translation: O lord of Devas, O bull-emblemed lord it behoves you now to recount the glory of this holy centre, Avimukta in every respect.
verses.hindi: देवीके साथ श्रीपर्वतपर पहुँचकर वहाँके पवित्र क्षेत्र
verses.wordMeaning: O lord of Devas, O bull-emblemed lord it behoves you now to recount the glory of this holy centre, Avimukta in every respect.
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord of Devas, O bull-emblemed lord it behoves you now to recount the glory of this holy centre, Avimukta in every respect.

verses.sanskrit: सकलभुवनभर्ता लोकनाथस्तदानीं तुहिनशिखरपुत्र्या सार्धमिष्टैर्गणेशैः विविधतरुविशालं मत्तहृष्टान्नपुष्टैर् उपवनम् अतिरम्यं दर्शयामास देव्याः
verses.transliteration: sakalabhuvanabhartā lokanāthastadānīṃ tuhinaśikharaputryā sārdhamiṣṭairgaṇeśaiḥ vividhataruviśālaṃ mattahṛṣṭānnapuṣṭair upavanam atiramyaṃ darśayāmāsa devyāḥ
verses.translation: O hearing those words of the goddess the excellent lord, the lord of Devas smelt her lotus-like face. Then he laughingly spoke to her.
verses.hindi: यहाँ कुण्डिप्रभ, परम दिव्य वैश्रवणेश्वर, आशालिङ्ग, देवेश्वर, दिव्य बिलेश्वर, विष्णुके द्वारा स्थापित महान् रामेश्वर, दक्षिण द्वारके पार्श्वभागमें भगवान् कुण्डलेश्वर, पूर्व द्वारके समीप स्थित और पर्वतके साथ वृद्धिको प्राप्त सर्वदेवनमस्कृत उत्तम त्रिपुरान्तक, तीनों लोकोंमें प्रसिद्ध मध्यमेश्वर, पूर्वकालमें देवताओंके द्वारा स्थापित
verses.wordMeaning: O hearing those words of the goddess the excellent lord, the lord of Devas smelt her lotus-like face. Then he laughingly spoke to her.
verses.commentary: Sense: O hearing those words of the goddess the excellent lord, the lord of Devas smelt her lotus-like face. Then he laughingly spoke to her.

verses.sanskrit: पुष्पैर्वन्यैः शुभशुभतमैः कल्पितैर्दिव्यभूषैर् देवीं दिव्यामुपवनगतां भूषयामास शर्वः सा चाप्येनं तुहिनगिरिसुता शङ्करं देवदेवं पुष्पैर्दिव्यैः शुभतरतमैर् भूषयामास भक्त्या
verses.transliteration: puṣpairvanyaiḥ śubhaśubhatamaiḥ kalpitairdivyabhūṣair devīṃ divyāmupavanagatāṃ bhūṣayāmāsa śarvaḥ sā cāpyenaṃ tuhinagirisutā śaṅkaraṃ devadevaṃ puṣpairdivyaiḥ śubhataratamair bhūṣayāmāsa bhaktyā
verses.translation: This extremely mysterious holy centre of mine, viz. Varaigias! is the hidden cause of the liberation of all creatures.
verses.hindi: और अपने कार्यके लिये ब्रह्माके द्वार स्थापित विशाल कर्मेश्वर लिङ्ग हैं। है अव्यये! श्रीमत्सिद्धवट सदा मेरा निवासस्थान है। साक्षात् ब्रह्माके द्वारा निर्मित यह दिव्य तथा पवित्र अजबिल नामक स्थान है; वहीं बिलेश्वरमें
verses.wordMeaning: This extremely mysterious holy centre of mine, viz. Varaigias! is the hidden cause of the liberation of all creatures.
verses.commentary: Sense: This extremely mysterious holy centre of mine, viz. Varaigias! is the hidden cause of the liberation of all creatures.

verses.sanskrit: सम्पूज्य पूज्यं त्रिदशेश्वराणां सम्प्रेक्ष्य चोद्यानम् अतीव रम्यम् गणेश्वरैर् नन्दिमुखैश् च सार्धम् उवाच देवं प्रणिपत्य देवी
verses.transliteration: sampūjya pūjyaṃ tridaśeśvarāṇāṃ samprekṣya codyānam atīva ramyam gaṇeśvarair nandimukhaiś ca sārdham uvāca devaṃ praṇipatya devī
verses.translation: O fair lady, many Siddhas have adopted my Vrata in this holy centre. They have taken up different types of Lingas and they always desire my world.
verses.hindi: मेरी दिव्य पादुकाएँ भी हैं। वहाँ शृंगाटक पर्वतके मध्य शिखरपर श्रृंगाटकके आकारवाला (त्रिकोण) श्रृंगाटकेश्वर नामक लिङ्ग है, जो श्रीदेवी (लक्ष्मी)-के द्वारा स्थापित किया गया है। यह मल्लिकार्जुन लिङ्ग मेरा शुभ निवासस्थान है। है देवि! युगादिके परिवर्तित होनेपर ब्रह्माके द्वारा स्थापित रजेश्वरको, स्कन्दके द्वारा स्थापित गजेशवरको, अविनाशी कपोतेश्वरको तथा सबसे अधिक शुभ और करोड़ों रुद्रगणोंके द्वारा सेवित कोटीश्वर
verses.wordMeaning: O fair lady, many Siddhas have adopted my Vrata in this holy centre. They have taken up different types of Lingas and they always desire my world.
verses.commentary: Sense: O fair lady, many Siddhas have adopted my Vrata in this holy centre. They have taken up different types of Lingas and they always desire my world.

verses.sanskrit: उद्यानं दर्शितं देव प्रभया परया युतम् क्षेत्रस्य च गुणान्सर्वान् पुनर्मे वक्तुमर्हसि
verses.transliteration: udyānaṃ darśitaṃ deva prabhayā parayā yutam kṣetrasya ca guṇānsarvān punarme vaktumarhasi
verses.translation: They are saintly souls one with the supreme spirit. They have conquered their sense-organs. They practise the greatest yoga in this garden abounding in different trees and birds and embellished by lakes abounding in lotus and lily flowers. This holy place is always resorted to by Apsarases and Gandharvas.
verses.hindi: नामक महातीर्थको इस समय देखो ॥ १४८--१५७॥
verses.wordMeaning: They are saintly souls one with the supreme spirit. They have conquered their sense-organs. They practise the greatest yoga in this garden abounding in different trees and birds and embellished by lakes abounding in lotus and lily flowers.…
verses.commentary: Sense: They are saintly souls one with the supreme spirit. They have conquered their sense-organs. They practise the greatest yoga in this garden abounding in different trees and birds and embellished by lakes abounding in lotus and lily flowers.…

verses.sanskrit: अस्य क्षेत्रस्य माहात्म्यम् अविमुक्तस्य सर्वथा वक्तुमर्हसि देवेश देवदेव वृषध्वज
verses.transliteration: asya kṣetrasya māhātmyam avimuktasya sarvathā vaktumarhasi deveśa devadeva vṛṣadhvaja
verses.translation: Why this residence appeals to me, listen. One
verses.hindi: दक्षिणमें ब्रह्माके द्वारा तथा उत्तरमें विष्णुके द्वारा स्थापित किये गये पाषाणनिर्मित सुन्दर द्विजदेवकुल नामक लिङ्गको, पूर्वमें मेरे द्वारा स्थापित महाप्रमाण लिङ्ग तथा पश्चिममें पर्वतपर स्थित ब्रह्मेशवर अलेश्वर नामक फफफफफफफफफफफफफफाफफफफफफफफकफपफाफफाफीफफफाककीकी फफफ फफफफफफफ फफक लत हे
verses.wordMeaning: Why this residence appeals to me, listen. One
verses.commentary: Sense: Why this residence appeals to me, listen. One

verses.sanskrit: देव्यास्तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा देवदेवो वरप्रभुः आघ्राय वदनाम्भोजं तदाह गिरिजां हसन्
verses.transliteration: devyāstadvacanaṃ śrutvā devadevo varaprabhuḥ āghrāya vadanāmbhojaṃ tadāha girijāṃ hasan
verses.translation: This great and divine city of mine is the most mys- terious of all mysterious places. Brahma, Siddhas and others who are desirous of liberation know this. The goal in me is the greatest one. Hence, this holy centre will never be aban-* doned by me nor has it been eschewed by me. This holy centre, therefore, is known as Avimukta.*®* Absolution is not obtained by taking dip in Naimi§a,®®* Kuruketra,®®' Gangadvara®*® and Pu§kara®® nor by resorting to these. But it is obtained here. Hence, this excels all those holy centres.
verses.hindi: अलङ्कृतं त्वया ब्रह्मन् पुरस्तान्मुनिभिः सह। इत्युक्त्वा तदगृहेतिष्ठदलड्गृहमिति स्मृतम्
verses.wordMeaning: This great and divine city of mine is the most mys- terious of all mysterious places. Brahma, Siddhas and others who are desirous of liberation know this. The goal in me is the greatest one. Hence,…
verses.commentary: Sense: This great and divine city of mine is the most mys- terious of all mysterious places. Brahma, Siddhas and others who are desirous of liberation know this. The goal in me is the greatest one. Hence,…

verses.sanskrit: इदं गुह्यतमं क्षेत्रं सदा वाराणसी मम सर्वेषामेव जन्तूनां हेतुर्मोक्षस्य सर्वदा
verses.transliteration: idaṃ guhyatamaṃ kṣetraṃ sadā vārāṇasī mama sarveṣāmeva jantūnāṃ heturmokṣasya sarvadā
verses.translation: Liberation may be achieved either at Prayaga or here, thanks to my adopting them. This Avimukta is more auspicious than even Prayaga which is the foremost of all holy centres.
verses.hindi: तत्रापि तीर्थ तीर्थज्ञे व्योमलिङ्गं च पश्य मे। कदम्बेश्वरमेतद्धि स्कन्देनैव प्रतिष्ठितम् देवैः सर्वैस्तु शक्राद्यैः स्थापितानि वरानने
verses.wordMeaning: Liberation may be achieved either at Prayaga or here, thanks to my adopting them. This Avimukta is more auspicious than even Prayaga which is the foremost of all holy centres.
verses.commentary: Sense: Liberation may be achieved either at Prayaga or here, thanks to my adopting them. This Avimukta is more auspicious than even Prayaga which is the foremost of all holy centres.

verses.sanskrit: अस्मिन्सिद्धाः सदा देवि मदीयं व्रतमास्थिताः नानालिङ्गधरा नित्यं मम लोकाभिकाङ्क्षिणः
verses.transliteration: asminsiddhāḥ sadā devi madīyaṃ vratamāsthitāḥ nānāliṅgadharā nityaṃ mama lokābhikāṅkṣiṇaḥ
verses.translation: Truthfulness is the esoteric principle underlying vir- tue; self-control is the esoteric principle underlying salvation: but excellent learned men do not know the esoteric principle underlying holy centres and sacred waters.
verses.hindi: श्रीमद्देवहृदप्रान्ते स्थानानीमानि पश्य मे। तथा हारपुरे देवि तव हारे निपातिते
verses.wordMeaning: Truthfulness is the esoteric principle underlying vir- tue; self-control is the esoteric principle underlying salvation: but excellent learned men do not know the esoteric principle underlying holy centres and sacred waters.
verses.commentary: Sense: Truthfulness is the esoteric principle underlying vir- tue; self-control is the esoteric principle underlying salvation: but excellent learned men do not know the esoteric principle underlying holy centres and sacred waters.

verses.sanskrit: अभ्यस्यन्ति परं योगं युक्तात्मानो जितेन्द्रियाः नानावृक्षसमाकीर्णे नानाविहगशोभिते
verses.transliteration: abhyasyanti paraṃ yogaṃ yuktātmāno jitendriyāḥ nānāvṛkṣasamākīrṇe nānāvihagaśobhite
verses.translation: Taking food, sleeping, sporting and performing dif- ferent activities as one pleases, one shall cast off one's vital airs in Avimukta. The creature is then competent to achieve libera- tion.
verses.hindi: शिवरुद्रप्र चैव तत्कायोपरि सुव्रते अलङ्कृतं मया ब्रह्मपुरस्तान्मुनिभिः सह
verses.wordMeaning: Taking food, sleeping, sporting and performing dif- ferent activities as one pleases, one shall cast off one's vital airs in Avimukta. The creature is then competent to achieve libera- tion.
verses.commentary: Sense: Taking food, sleeping, sporting and performing dif- ferent activities as one pleases, one shall cast off one's vital airs in Avimukta. The creature is then competent to achieve libera- tion.

verses.sanskrit: कमलोत्पलपुष्पाढ्यैः सरोभिः समलंकृते अप्सरोगणगन्धर्वैः सदा संसेविते शुभे
verses.transliteration: kamalotpalapuṣpāḍhyaiḥ sarobhiḥ samalaṃkṛte apsarogaṇagandharvaiḥ sadā saṃsevite śubhe
verses.translation: For men it is better to commit thousands of sins and court Piacahood than to become Indra in thousands of births without resorting to the city of Kail.
verses.hindi: चण्डिकेश्वरकं देवि चण्डिकेशा तवात्मजा। चण्डिकानिर्मितं स्थानमम्बिकातीर्थमुत्तमम्
verses.wordMeaning: For men it is better to commit thousands of sins and court Piacahood than to become Indra in thousands of births without resorting to the city of Kail.
verses.commentary: Sense: For men it is better to commit thousands of sins and court Piacahood than to become Indra in thousands of births without resorting to the city of Kail.

verses.sanskrit: रोचते मे सदा वासो येन कार्येण तच्छृणु मन्मना मम भक्तश् च मयि नित्यार्पितक्रियः
verses.transliteration: rocate me sadā vāso yena kāryeṇa tacchṛṇu manmanā mama bhaktaś ca mayi nityārpitakriyaḥ
verses.translation: Hence, Avimukta should be resorted to for achieving salvation. It is here that Jaigifavya®*® of great penance attained Siddhi.
verses.hindi: रुचिकेश्वरकं चैव धारैषा कपिला शुभा। एतेषु देवि स्थानेषु तीर्थेषु विविधेषु च पलानां द्वे सहस्रे तु महास्नानं प्रकीर्तितम्। स्नाप्य लिङ्गं मदीयं तु गव्येनैव घृतेन च
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, Avimukta should be resorted to for achieving salvation. It is here that Jaigifavya®*® of great penance attained Siddhi.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, Avimukta should be resorted to for achieving salvation. It is here that Jaigifavya®*® of great penance attained Siddhi.

verses.sanskrit: यथा मोक्षमवाप्नोति अन्यत्र न तथा क्वचित् कामं ह्यत्र मृतो देवि जन्तुर्मोक्षाय कल्पते
verses.transliteration: yathā mokṣamavāpnoti anyatra na tathā kvacit kāmaṃ hyatra mṛto devi janturmokṣāya kalpate
verses.translation: The excellent cave of Jaigi§avya is purified, thanks to
verses.hindi: सम्मार्ज्यं शतयज्ञानां स्नानेन प्रयुतं तथा
verses.wordMeaning: The excellent cave of Jaigi§avya is purified, thanks to
verses.commentary: Sense: The excellent cave of Jaigi§avya is purified, thanks to

verses.sanskrit: एतन्मम पुरं दिव्यं गुह्याद्गुह्यतमं महत् ब्रह्मादयो विजानन्ति ये च सिद्धा मुमुक्षवः
verses.transliteration: etanmama puraṃ divyaṃ guhyādguhyatamaṃ mahat brahmādayo vijānanti ye ca siddhā mumukṣavaḥ
verses.translation: Kuruktra See note 683.
verses.hindi: जलेन केवलेनैव गन्धतोयेन भक्तित:। अनुलेपनं तु तत्सर्वं पञ्चविंशत्पलेन वै लिङ्गको देखो। महादेवने ब्रह्मासे कहा था हे आपने मुनियोंके साथ इसे अलंकृत किया ह कहकर वे रुद्र उस गृहमें स्थित हो गये, अत: उसे अलंग कहा गया है॥ १५८--१६०॥
verses.wordMeaning: Kuruktra See note 683.
verses.commentary: Sense: Kuruktra See note 683.

verses.sanskrit: अतः परमिदं क्षेत्रं परा चेयं गतिर्मम विमुक्तं न मया यस्मान् मोक्ष्यते वा कदाचन
verses.transliteration: ataḥ paramidaṃ kṣetraṃ parā ceyaṃ gatirmama vimuktaṃ na mayā yasmān mokṣyate vā kadācana
verses.translation: They always meditate upon me at this place. The yogic fire shines brilliantly here. They attain the greatest salvation which is inaccessible even to Devas.
verses.hindi: हे तीर्थज्ञे! वहाँपर स्थित मेरे व्योमलिङ्ग तीके भी देखो; कदम्बेश्वर नामवाला यह तीर्थ स्कन्दके रए स्थापित किया गया है। नन्द आदिके द्वारा विधिक स्थापित गोमण्डलेश्वरको भी देखो । है वरानने !
verses.wordMeaning: They always meditate upon me at this place. The yogic fire shines brilliantly here. They attain the greatest salvation which is inaccessible even to Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: They always meditate upon me at this place. The yogic fire shines brilliantly here. They attain the greatest salvation which is inaccessible even to Devas.

verses.sanskrit: मम क्षेत्रमिदं तस्माद् अविमुक्तमिति स्मृतम् नैमिषे च कुरुक्षेत्रे गङ्गाद्वारे च पुष्करे
verses.transliteration: mama kṣetramidaṃ tasmād avimuktamiti smṛtam naimiṣe ca kurukṣetre gaṅgādvāre ca puṣkare
verses.translation: Here itself, salvation is attained by the sages who have the unmanifest for their symbols and who know the basic tenets. It is difficult of access anywhere else.
verses.hindi: देव-हद (सरोवर) -के तटपर इन्द्र आदि सभी देवताओंके द्वारा स्थापित किये गये मेरे इन स्थानोंका अवलोकन करो। है देवि! हारपुरमें तुम्हारे हारके गिर जानेपर तुमने जगतूके हितके लिये इसे हारकुण्ड बना दिया था। हे सुव्रते! शिवरुद्रपुरमें उस पर्वतपर तुम्हारे पिता सुशैलने अचलेश्वरकी स्थापना की थी, जिसे मैंने ब्रह्मा आदि ऋषियोंके साथ सुशोभित किया था। है देवि! तुम्हारी पुत्री चण्डिकेशाने चण्डिकेश्वरको स्थापित किया है;
verses.wordMeaning: Here itself, salvation is attained by the sages who have the unmanifest for their symbols and who know the basic tenets. It is difficult of access anywhere else.
verses.commentary: Sense: Here itself, salvation is attained by the sages who have the unmanifest for their symbols and who know the basic tenets. It is difficult of access anywhere else.

verses.sanskrit: स्नानात्संसेवनाद्वापि न मोक्षः प्राप्यते यतः इह सम्प्राप्यते येन तत एतद्विशिष्यते
verses.transliteration: snānātsaṃsevanādvāpi na mokṣaḥ prāpyate yataḥ iha samprāpyate yena tata etadviśiṣyate
verses.translation: To them I expound the excellent glory of the yogic practice, the Sayujya type of salvation of the Atman as well as the desired abode.
verses.hindi: चण्डिकाके द्वारा स्थापित यह स्थान उत्तम अम्बिकातीर्थ है। यह रुचिकेश्वर तीर्थ है; यह पवित्र कपिलधारा तीर्थ है॥ १६१--१६६१/२ ॥
verses.wordMeaning: To them I expound the excellent glory of the yogic practice, the Sayujya type of salvation of the Atman as well as the desired abode.
verses.commentary: Sense: To them I expound the excellent glory of the yogic practice, the Sayujya type of salvation of the Atman as well as the desired abode.

verses.sanskrit: प्रयागे वा भवेन्मोक्ष इह वा मत्परिग्रहात् प्रयागादपि तीर्थाग्र्याद् अविमुक्तमिदं शुभम्
verses.transliteration: prayāge vā bhavenmokṣa iha vā matparigrahāt prayāgādapi tīrthāgryād avimuktamidaṃ śubham
verses.translation: Kubera®* dedicated his holy rites to me at this holy centre. It is by having recourse to this holy centre that he attained the leadership of the Gaas.
verses.hindi: हे देवि! जो इन विविध स्थानों तथा तीर्थोमें भक्तिपूर्वक सदा मेरी पूजा करता है, वह मेरे साथ आनन्द करता है। जो ब्राह्मण श्रीशैलपर शरीरत्याग करता है, वह पापरहित होकर मुक्त हो जाता है, जिस प्रकार अविमुक्तक्षेत्रमें शुभ फल होता है; इसमें सन्देह नहीं है । है सुब्रते ! जो इन स्थानोंमे
verses.wordMeaning: Kubera®* dedicated his holy rites to me at this holy centre. It is by having recourse to this holy centre that he attained the leadership of the Gaas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Kubera®* dedicated his holy rites to me at this holy centre. It is by having recourse to this holy centre that he attained the leadership of the Gaas.

verses.sanskrit: धर्मस्योपनिषत् सत्यं मोक्षस्योपनिषच् छमः क्षेत्रतीर्थोपनिषदं न विदुर्बुधसत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: dharmasyopaniṣat satyaṃ mokṣasyopaniṣac chamaḥ kṣetratīrthopaniṣadaṃ na vidurbudhasattamāḥ
verses.translation: Saihvarta*®* who is yet to be born will be my devotee. O fair lady, propitiating me here alone he will attain excellent perfection.
verses.hindi: विधिपूर्वक घृतसे महास्नान कराता है, वह मेरा सायुज्य
verses.wordMeaning: Saihvarta*®* who is yet to be born will be my devotee. O fair lady, propitiating me here alone he will attain excellent perfection.
verses.commentary: Sense: Saihvarta*®* who is yet to be born will be my devotee. O fair lady, propitiating me here alone he will attain excellent perfection.

verses.sanskrit: कामं भुञ्जन् स्वपन् क्रीडन् कुर्वन् हि विविधाः क्रियाः अविमुक्ते त्यजेत्प्राणान् जन्तुर्मोक्षाय कल्पते
verses.transliteration: kāmaṃ bhuñjan svapan krīḍan kurvan hi vividhāḥ kriyāḥ avimukte tyajetprāṇān janturmokṣāya kalpate
verses.translation: The yogin sage Vyasa,®** son of Paraara, will be performing here a great penance. He will be my devotee and he will inaugurate the institution of the Vedas.
verses.hindi: प्राप्त करता है। पचीस पल घृत-का ' अभ्यंग' तथा सौ पलका 'स्नान' जानना चाहिए। दो हजार पलोंसे स्नान
verses.wordMeaning: The yogin sage Vyasa,®** son of Paraara, will be performing here a great penance. He will be my devotee and he will inaugurate the institution of the Vedas.
verses.commentary: Sense: The yogin sage Vyasa,®** son of Paraara, will be performing here a great penance. He will be my devotee and he will inaugurate the institution of the Vedas.

verses.sanskrit: कृत्वा पापसहस्राणि पिशाचत्वं वरं नृणाम् न तु शक्रसहस्रत्वं स्वर्गे काशीपुरीं विना
verses.transliteration: kṛtvā pāpasahasrāṇi piśācatvaṃ varaṃ nṛṇām na tu śakrasahasratvaṃ svarge kāśīpurīṃ vinā
verses.translation: O lotus-eyed lady, that leading sage will be spor- ting about in this holy centre. Brahma along with the divine sages, Visnu, Sun, Indra and all other noble-souled heaven- dwellers do worship me here, O lady of good holy rites.
verses.wordMeaning: O lotus-eyed lady, that leading sage will be spor- ting about in this holy centre. Brahma along with the divine sages, Visnu, Sun, Indra and all other noble-souled heaven- dwellers do worship me here, O lady of good holy rites.
verses.commentary: Sense: O lotus-eyed lady, that leading sage will be spor- ting about in this holy centre. Brahma along with the divine sages, Visnu, Sun, Indra and all other noble-souled heaven- dwellers do worship me here, O lady of good holy rites.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात्संसेवनीयं हि अविमुक्तं हि मुक्तये जैगीषव्यः परां सिद्धिं गतो यत्र महातपाः
verses.transliteration: tasmātsaṃsevanīyaṃ hi avimuktaṃ hi muktaye jaigīṣavyaḥ parāṃ siddhiṃ gato yatra mahātapāḥ
verses.translation: Other divine yogins, noble souls in disguise, worship me here always with their minds not turning to anything ebe.
verses.hindi: जो मेरे लिङ्गको गायके घीसे स्नान कराकर सभी  पूजादरव्योंसे विशुद्ध करके जलसे मेरा अभिषेक करता
verses.wordMeaning: Other divine yogins, noble souls in disguise, worship me here always with their minds not turning to anything ebe.
verses.commentary: Sense: Other divine yogins, noble souls in disguise, worship me here always with their minds not turning to anything ebe.

verses.sanskrit: अस्य क्षेत्रस्य माहात्म्याद् भक्त्या च मम भावितः जैगीषव्यगुहा श्रेष्ठा योगिनां स्थानमिष्यते
verses.transliteration: asya kṣetrasya māhātmyād bhaktyā ca mama bhāvitaḥ jaigīṣavyaguhā śreṣṭhā yogināṃ sthānamiṣyate
verses.translation: Even a man whose mind is attracted by mundane affairs and who has eschewed interest in religious piety may not be reborn in this world if he dies at this holy centre.
verses.hindi: है--इस प्रकार मार्जन करनेसे सौ यज्ञोंका, स्नान करानेसे तथा
verses.wordMeaning: Even a man whose mind is attracted by mundane affairs and who has eschewed interest in religious piety may not be reborn in this world if he dies at this holy centre.
verses.commentary: Sense: Even a man whose mind is attracted by mundane affairs and who has eschewed interest in religious piety may not be reborn in this world if he dies at this holy centre.

verses.sanskrit: ध्यायन्तस्तत्र मां नित्यं योगाग्निर्दीप्यते भृशम् कैवल्यं परमं याति देवानामपि दुर्लभम्
verses.transliteration: dhyāyantastatra māṃ nityaṃ yogāgnirdīpyate bhṛśam kaivalyaṃ paramaṃ yāti devānāmapi durlabham
verses.translation: But those who arc bold and free from ego, who main- tain the Sattva Guna, who have conquered their sense-organs,
verses.hindi: पूजा करानेसे लाख-लाख यज्ञोंका, गीतवाद्य आदिसे अर्चन करनेपर अनन्त यज्ञोंका फल प्राप्त होता है । महास्नानमें रुचि
verses.wordMeaning: But those who arc bold and free from ego, who main- tain the Sattva Guna, who have conquered their sense-organs,
verses.commentary: Sense: But those who arc bold and free from ego, who main- tain the Sattva Guna, who have conquered their sense-organs,

verses.sanskrit: अव्यक्तलिङ्गैर्मुनिभिः सर्वसिद्धान्तवेदिभिः इह सम्प्राप्यते मोक्षो दुर्लभो ऽन्यत्र कर्हिचित्
verses.transliteration: avyaktaliṅgairmunibhiḥ sarvasiddhāntavedibhiḥ iha samprāpyate mokṣo durlabho 'nyatra karhicit
verses.translation: Resorting to me, all the intelligent persons devoid of attachment have attained salvation here due to my favour, O lady of holy rites.
verses.hindi: रखनेवाले भक्तको स्नानका आठ गुना (आठ लाख यज्ञोंक) फल बताया गया है। केवल जलसे अथवा भक्ति
verses.wordMeaning: Resorting to me, all the intelligent persons devoid of attachment have attained salvation here due to my favour, O lady of holy rites.
verses.commentary: Sense: Resorting to me, all the intelligent persons devoid of attachment have attained salvation here due to my favour, O lady of holy rites.

verses.sanskrit: तेभ्यश्चाहं प्रवक्ष्यामि योगैश्वर्यमनुत्तमम् आत्मनश्चैव सायुज्यम् ईप्सितं स्थानमेव च
verses.transliteration: tebhyaścāhaṃ pravakṣyāmi yogaiśvaryamanuttamam ātmanaścaiva sāyujyam īpsitaṃ sthānameva ca
verses.translation: Thanks to my favour, O lady of holy rites, one attains salvation easily here itself which a yogin might attain in the course of thousand births.
verses.hindi: की शरण अअजङऊअअजअधधकळअममजकरामओबामअअ चतुद्रोणेर्महादेवमष्टद्रोणैरथापि वा।
verses.wordMeaning: Thanks to my favour, O lady of holy rites, one attains salvation easily here itself which a yogin might attain in the course of thousand births.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thanks to my favour, O lady of holy rites, one attains salvation easily here itself which a yogin might attain in the course of thousand births.

verses.sanskrit: कुबेरो ऽत्र मम क्षेत्रे मयि सर्वार्पितक्रियः क्षेत्रसंसेवनादेव गणेशत्वमवाप ह
verses.transliteration: kubero 'tra mama kṣetre mayi sarvārpitakriyaḥ kṣetrasaṃsevanādeva gaṇeśatvamavāpa ha
verses.translation: This holy centre Goprekka has been formerly esta- blished by Brahma. O excellent lady, sec the divine abode Kailasa here.
verses.hindi: शतद्रोणसमं पुण्यमाढकेऽपि विधीयते। वित्तहीनस्य विप्रस्य नात्र कार्या विचारणा
verses.wordMeaning: This holy centre Goprekka has been formerly esta- blished by Brahma. O excellent lady, sec the divine abode Kailasa here.
verses.commentary: Sense: This holy centre Goprekka has been formerly esta- blished by Brahma. O excellent lady, sec the divine abode Kailasa here.
