verses.sanskrit: संवर्तो भविता यश् च सो ऽपि भक्तो ममैव तु इहैवाराध्य मां देवि सिद्धिं यास्यत्यनुत्तमाम्
verses.transliteration: saṃvarto bhavitā yaś ca so 'pi bhakto mamaiva tu ihaivārādhya māṃ devi siddhiṃ yāsyatyanuttamām
verses.translation: Going to Gopreksaka the man shall visit me here. Thereby, he avoids evil mishaps and is released forthwith from sins.
verses.hindi: वादित्रर्विविधैश्चान्यैर्निनाहैर्विविधैरपि जागरं कारयेद्यस्तु प्रार्थयेच्च यथाक्रमम्। स भृत्यपुत्रदारशच तथा सम्बन्धिबान्धवैः
verses.wordMeaning: Going to Gopreksaka the man shall visit me here. Thereby, he avoids evil mishaps and is released forthwith from sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: Going to Gopreksaka the man shall visit me here. Thereby, he avoids evil mishaps and is released forthwith from sins.

verses.sanskrit: पराशरसुतौ योगी ऋषिर्व्यासो महातपाः मम भक्तो भविष्यश् च वेदसंस्थाप्रवर्तकः
verses.transliteration: parāśarasutau yogī ṛṣirvyāso mahātapāḥ mama bhakto bhaviṣyaś ca vedasaṃsthāpravartakaḥ
verses.translation: The great holy Tirtha named Kapilahrada has been made here by Brahma. This Tirtha, evolved out of the milk from the udders of cows, is extremely holy and sacred.
verses.hindi: सार्ध प्रदक्षिणं कृत्वा प्रार्थयेल्लिङ्गमुत्तमम्। द्रव्यहीनं क्रियाहीनं श्रद्धाहीनं सुरेश्वर
verses.wordMeaning: The great holy Tirtha named Kapilahrada has been made here by Brahma. This Tirtha, evolved out of the milk from the udders of cows, is extremely holy and sacred.
verses.commentary: Sense: The great holy Tirtha named Kapilahrada has been made here by Brahma. This Tirtha, evolved out of the milk from the udders of cows, is extremely holy and sacred.

verses.sanskrit: रंस्यते सो ऽपि पद्माक्षि क्षेत्रे ऽस्मिन्मुनिपुङ्गवः ब्रह्मा देवर्षिभिः सार्द्धं विष्णुर्वापि दिवाकरः
verses.transliteration: raṃsyate so 'pi padmākṣi kṣetre 'sminmunipuṅgavaḥ brahmā devarṣibhiḥ sārddhaṃ viṣṇurvāpi divākaraḥ
verses.translation: Here I am known as the bull-bannered lord. O gentle lady, I am present here as seen by you.
verses.hindi: कृतं वा न कृतं वापि क्षन्तुमर्हसि शङ्कर। इत्युक्त्वा वै जपेद्रुद्रं त्वरितं शान्तिमेव च स एवं सर्वतीर्थेषु सर्वयज्ञेषु यत्फलम्
verses.wordMeaning: Here I am known as the bull-bannered lord. O gentle lady, I am present here as seen by you.
verses.commentary: Sense: Here I am known as the bull-bannered lord. O gentle lady, I am present here as seen by you.

verses.sanskrit: देवराजस्तथा शक्रो ये ऽपि चान्ये दिवौकसः उपासते महात्मानः सर्वे मामिह सुव्रते
verses.transliteration: devarājastathā śakro ye 'pi cānye divaukasaḥ upāsate mahātmānaḥ sarve māmiha suvrate
verses.translation: See the deep pool of water here made by Brahm. It is named Bhadratoya (having auspicious waters). O gentle lady, I have been propitiated in this place by all Devas saying 'Be subdued, O lord" and I became calm. I have been brought by Brahma Parame$thin and installed here.
verses.hindi: मत्त्रयार्थमिदं कार्य मद्भक्तैविधिपूर्वकम्। ये न कुर्वन्ति ते भक्ता न भवन्ति न संशयः
verses.wordMeaning: See the deep pool of water here made by Brahm. It is named Bhadratoya (having auspicious waters). O gentle lady, I have been propitiated in this place by all Devas saying 'Be subdued, O lord" and I became calm. I have been brought by Brahma Parame$thin and installed here.
verses.commentary: Sense: See the deep pool of water here made by Brahm. It is named Bhadratoya (having auspicious waters). O gentle lady, I have been propitiated in this place by all Devas saying 'Be subdued, O lord" and I became calm. I have been brought by Brahma Parame$thin and installed here.

verses.sanskrit: अन्ये ऽपि योगिनो दिव्याश् छन्नरूपा महात्मनः अनन्यमनसो भूत्वा मामिहोपासते सदा
verses.transliteration: anye 'pi yogino divyāś channarūpā mahātmanaḥ ananyamanaso bhūtvā māmihopāsate sadā
verses.translation: I was seized by Vi nu from Brahma and re-installed by him. Then Vinu was addressed by Brahma with a dejected mind.
verses.hindi: निशम्य वचनं देवी गत्वा वाराणसीं पुरीम्। अविमुक्तेश्वरं लिङ्गं पयसा च घृतेन च अर्चयामास देवेशं रुद्रं भुवननायकम् ।
verses.wordMeaning: I was seized by Vi nu from Brahma and re-installed by him. Then Vinu was addressed by Brahma with a dejected mind.
verses.commentary: Sense: I was seized by Vi nu from Brahma and re-installed by him. Then Vinu was addressed by Brahma with a dejected mind.

verses.sanskrit: विषयासक्तचित्तो ऽपि त्यक्तधर्मरतिर्नरः इह क्षेत्रे मृतः सो ऽपि संसारे न पुनर्भवेत्
verses.transliteration: viṣayāsaktacitto 'pi tyaktadharmaratirnaraḥ iha kṣetre mṛtaḥ so 'pi saṃsāre na punarbhavet
verses.translation: "This Lihga has been brought by me. Wherefore have you installed it." Wiiu then said to Brahma, with anger evident in his face.
verses.hindi: तत्रान्धकं महाहैत्यं हिरण्याक्षसुतं प्रभु:
verses.wordMeaning: "This Lihga has been brought by me. Wherefore have you installed it." Wiiu then said to Brahma, with anger evident in his face.
verses.commentary: Sense: "This Lihga has been brought by me. Wherefore have you installed it." Wiiu then said to Brahma, with anger evident in his face.

verses.sanskrit: ये पुनर्निर्ममा धीराः सत्त्वस्था विजितेन्द्रियाः व्रतिनश् च निरारम्भाः सर्वे ते मयि भाविताः
verses.transliteration: ye punarnirmamā dhīrāḥ sattvasthā vijitendriyāḥ vratinaś ca nirārambhāḥ sarve te mayi bhāvitāḥ
verses.translation: "My devotion to lord Rudra is extremely great and noble. Although the Lihga has been installed by me it will be known after your name."
verses.hindi: अविमुक्तक्षेत्र वाराणसीका माहात्म्य तथा श्रीविश्वेश्वरपूजाविधिवर्णन पूर्वक गन्धयुक्त जलसे अभ्यंग पचीस पलसे करना चाहिए॥ १७१--१७४॥
verses.wordMeaning: "My devotion to lord Rudra is extremely great and noble. Although the Lihga has been installed by me it will be known after your name."
verses.commentary: Sense: "My devotion to lord Rudra is extremely great and noble. Although the Lihga has been installed by me it will be known after your name."

verses.sanskrit: देवदेवं समासाद्य धीमन्तः संगवर्जिताः गता इह परं मोक्षं प्रसादान्मम सुव्रते
verses.transliteration: devadevaṃ samāsādya dhīmantaḥ saṃgavarjitāḥ gatā iha paraṃ mokṣaṃ prasādānmama suvrate
verses.translation: Therefore, I have occupied this place by the name of Hiranyagarbha. Man shall visit this lord of Devas and attain my world thereby.
verses.hindi: अन्य पुष्प अर्पित करना चाहिए; बिल्वपत्रका त्याग कभी नहीं करना चाहिए। महादेवको पूजा चार अथवा आठ द्रोण पुष्पोंसे करनी चाहिए और दस अथवा आठ द्रोण नेवेद्य अर्पित करना चाहिए। धनहीन
verses.wordMeaning: Therefore, I have occupied this place by the name of Hiranyagarbha. Man shall visit this lord of Devas and attain my world thereby.
verses.commentary: Sense: Therefore, I have occupied this place by the name of Hiranyagarbha. Man shall visit this lord of Devas and attain my world thereby.

verses.sanskrit: जन्मान्तरसहस्रेषु यं न योगी समाप्नुयात् तमिहैव परं मोक्षं प्रसादान्मम सुव्रते
verses.transliteration: janmāntarasahasreṣu yaṃ na yogī samāpnuyāt tamihaiva paraṃ mokṣaṃ prasādānmama suvrate
verses.translation: Thereafter, Brahma who was equipped with the greatest devotion once again duly installed this auspiciotis Lihga of mine.
verses.hindi: ब्राह्मणके लिये एक आढक नैवेद्यका पुण्य सौ द्रोण नैवेद्यके पुण्यके समान बताया गया है; इसमें सन्देह नहीं करना चाहिए वाद्य यन्त्रं और अन्य प्रकारके निनादोंके द्वारा रात्रिमें जो जागरण करे, उसे अपने सेवकों, पुत्रों, पत्नी, सम्बन्धियों तथा बन्धुओंके साथ प्रदक्षिणा करके उत्तम लिङ्गसे इस प्रकार प्रार्थना करनी
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, Brahma who was equipped with the greatest devotion once again duly installed this auspiciotis Lihga of mine.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, Brahma who was equipped with the greatest devotion once again duly installed this auspiciotis Lihga of mine.

verses.sanskrit: गोप्रेक्षकम् इदं क्षेत्रं ब्रह्मणा स्थापितं पुरा कैलासभवनं चात्र पश्य दिव्यं वरानने
verses.transliteration: goprekṣakam idaṃ kṣetraṃ brahmaṇā sthāpitaṃ purā kailāsabhavanaṃ cātra paśya divyaṃ varānane
verses.translation: I am known here as Svarllnevara (the lord who has merged into the heaven). I have come here voluntarily. A man who gives up his life here is not reborn anywhere.
verses.hindi: चाहिए-- है सुरेश्वर! है शंकर! मैंने जो भी द्रव्यहीन, क्रियाहीन तथा श्रद्धाहीन पूजन किया है अथवा जो नहीं भी किया गया है, उसे आप कृपा करके क्षमा करें'--यह प्रार्थना करके त्वरित रुद्र तथा शान्तिमन्त्रका
verses.wordMeaning: I am known here as Svarllnevara (the lord who has merged into the heaven). I have come here voluntarily. A man who gives up his life here is not reborn anywhere.
verses.commentary: Sense: I am known here as Svarllnevara (the lord who has merged into the heaven). I have come here voluntarily. A man who gives up his life here is not reborn anywhere.

verses.sanskrit: गोप्रेक्षकम् अथागम्य दृष्ट्वा मामत्र मानवः न दुर्गतिमवाप्नोति कल्मषैश् च विमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: goprekṣakam athāgamya dṛṣṭvā māmatra mānavaḥ na durgatimavāpnoti kalmaṣaiś ca vimucyate
verses.translation: That goal is not attained by any one else. It is what is known as the goal of yogins. In this place a haughty power- ful Daitya who was a thorn to Devas, was killed by me after assuming the form of a tiger. I am perpetually settled here and am well known as VyaghreSvara (Tiger-Lord).
verses.hindi: जप करना चाहिए। पंचाक्षरके महाबीजका जप करके वह सभी तीर्थोमें जाने तथा सभी यज्ञोंको करनेसे जो फल होता है, उस फलको प्राप्त कर लेता है और वाराणसीमें मरनेपर जो सायुज्य गति होती है, मेरे उस सायुज्यको प्राप्त कर लेता है; इसमें सन्देह नहीं है। हे देवि! मेरे भक्तोंको चाहिए कि मेरी प्रसन्नताके लिये विधिपूर्वक यह सब करें। जो ऐसा नहीं करते, वे मेरे भक्त नहीं होते हैं; इसमें सन्देह नहीं
verses.wordMeaning: That goal is not attained by any one else. It is what is known as the goal of yogins. In this place a haughty power- ful Daitya who was a thorn to Devas, was killed by me after assuming the form of a tiger.…
verses.commentary: Sense: That goal is not attained by any one else. It is what is known as the goal of yogins. In this place a haughty power- ful Daitya who was a thorn to Devas, was killed by me after assuming the form of a tiger.…

verses.sanskrit: कपिलाह्रदम् इत्येवं तथा वै ब्रह्मणा कृतम् गवां स्तन्यजतोयेन तीर्थं पुण्यतमं महत्
verses.transliteration: kapilāhradam ityevaṃ tathā vai brahmaṇā kṛtam gavāṃ stanyajatoyena tīrthaṃ puṇyatamaṃ mahat
verses.translation: By visiting Vyaghrevara one will avoid courting disaster. There were two Daityas Utpala®®* and Vidala®®® who were, as ordained by Brahma previously, destined to be killed by a lady. They were therefore killed by you in a battle with a ball contemptuously thrown at them. Their bodies have occu- pied this place.
verses.hindi: सूतजी बोले-- है ऋषियो! यह वचन सुनकर वाराणसीपुरी जाकर देवीने दूध तथा घीसे अविमुक्तेश्वर लिङ्गको स्नान कराकर भुवननायक देवेश रुद्रका अर्चन किया और अविमुक्त काशी-में तपस्याके द्वारा
verses.wordMeaning: By visiting Vyaghrevara one will avoid courting disaster. There were two Daityas Utpala®®* and Vidala®®® who were, as ordained by Brahma previously, destined to be killed by a lady. They were therefore killed by you in a battle with a ball contemptuously thrown at them.…
verses.commentary: Sense: By visiting Vyaghrevara one will avoid courting disaster. There were two Daityas Utpala®®* and Vidala®®® who were, as ordained by Brahma previously, destined to be killed by a lady. They were therefore killed by you in a battle with a ball contemptuously thrown at them.…

verses.sanskrit: अत्रापि स्वयमेवाहं वृषध्वज इति स्मृतः सान्निध्यं कृतवान् देवि सदाहं दृश्यते त्वया
verses.transliteration: atrāpi svayamevāhaṃ vṛṣadhvaja iti smṛtaḥ sānnidhyaṃ kṛtavān devi sadāhaṃ dṛśyate tvayā
verses.translation: It was here that I came and settled at the outset along with the leaders of the Ganas. Hence, this is the greatest abode of mine. Its vision is conducive to merit.
verses.hindi: मन्दर-पर्वतपर एक सुन्दर कन्दरामें महात्मा मन्दरका क्षेत्र निर्मित किया; वहाँ प्रभु शिव-ने हिरण्याक्षके अनुगृह्य गणत्वं च प्रापयामास लीलया। पुत्र महाहैत्य अन्धकपर अनुग्रह करके एतद्रः कथितं सर्वं कथासर्वस्वमादरात्॥ १८८  उसे गणत्व प्राप्त कराया था। है ऋषियो। हे प्रकार मैंने आप लोगोंसे आदरपूर्वक सम्पूर्ण कथा कहा। जो मनुष्य इस क्षेत्रके उत्तम माहात्म्यको ह
verses.wordMeaning: It was here that I came and settled at the outset along with the leaders of the Ganas. Hence, this is the greatest abode of mine. Its vision is conducive to merit.
verses.commentary: Sense: It was here that I came and settled at the outset along with the leaders of the Ganas. Hence, this is the greatest abode of mine. Its vision is conducive to merit.

verses.sanskrit: भद्रतोयं च पश्येह ब्रह्मणा च कृतं ह्रदम् सर्वैर्देवैरहं देवि अस्मिन्देशे प्रसादितः
verses.transliteration: bhadratoyaṃ ca paśyeha brahmaṇā ca kṛtaṃ hradam sarvairdevairahaṃ devi asmindeśe prasāditaḥ
verses.translation: These Lihgas have been installed all round by Devas. Hence, by visiting the lord in Lihgas man shall invariably be a Gana when he dies.
verses.hindi: यः पठेच्छूणुयाद्वापि क्षेत्रमाहात्म्यसुत्तमम्। अथवा सुनता है, वह सभी क्षेत्रोंमें वासका जो
verses.wordMeaning: These Lihgas have been installed all round by Devas. Hence, by visiting the lord in Lihgas man shall invariably be a Gana when he dies.
verses.commentary: Sense: These Lihgas have been installed all round by Devas. Hence, by visiting the lord in Lihgas man shall invariably be a Gana when he dies.

verses.sanskrit: गच्छोपशमम् ईशेति उपशान्तः शिवस् तथा अत्राहं ब्रह्मणानीय स्थापितः परमेष्ठिना
verses.transliteration: gacchopaśamam īśeti upaśāntaḥ śivas tathā atrāhaṃ brahmaṇānīya sthāpitaḥ parameṣṭhinā
verses.translation: Realising that this place is pleasing and beneficial to me a Lihga has been established by your father Himavan, the king of mountains. It is known as Sailevara. May this be seen with respect. O gentle lady, by visiting this no men shall court disaster or become wretched.
verses.hindi: अथवा जो सभी पवित्र तथा जितेन्द्रिय द्विजोंको सुनात श्रावयेद्वा द्विजान् सर्वान् कृतशौचान् जितेद््रियान्। है, वह भी समस्त यज्ञोंका फल प्राप्त का
verses.wordMeaning: Realising that this place is pleasing and beneficial to me a Lihga has been established by your father Himavan, the king of mountains. It is known as Sailevara. May this be seen with respect. O gentle lady, by visiting this no men shall court disaster or become wretched.
verses.commentary: Sense: Realising that this place is pleasing and beneficial to me a Lihga has been established by your father Himavan, the king of mountains. It is known as Sailevara. May this be seen with respect. O gentle lady, by visiting this no men shall court disaster or become wretched.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मणा चापि संगृह्य विष्णुना स्थापितः पुनः ब्रह्मणापि ततो विष्णुः प्रोक्तः संविग्नचेतसा
verses.transliteration: brahmaṇā cāpi saṃgṛhya viṣṇunā sthāpitaḥ punaḥ brahmaṇāpi tato viṣṇuḥ proktaḥ saṃvignacetasā
verses.translation: O gentle lady, this river Varuna is holy. It liberates one from sins. It embellishes this holy centre and becomes united with the Ganges.
verses.hindi: स एव सर्वयज्ञस्य फलं प्राप्नोति मानवः ॥ १९०  लेता है॥ १८५--१९०॥
verses.wordMeaning: O gentle lady, this river Varuna is holy. It liberates one from sins. It embellishes this holy centre and becomes united with the Ganges.
verses.commentary: Sense: O gentle lady, this river Varuna is holy. It liberates one from sins. It embellishes this holy centre and becomes united with the Ganges.

verses.sanskrit: मयानीतमिदं लिङ्गं कस्मात् स्थापितवान् असि तमुवाच पुनर् विष्णुर् ब्रह्माणं कुपिताननम्
verses.transliteration: mayānītamidaṃ liṅgaṃ kasmāt sthāpitavān asi tamuvāca punar viṣṇur brahmāṇaṃ kupitānanam
verses.translation: An excellent Lihga has been installed by Brahma at this confluence. It is known in the world as Sahgamevara, (lord of the confluence).
verses.hindi: हिरण्याक्षपुत्र अन्धकासुरका आख्यान तथा शिवानुग्रहसे उसे गाणपत्यपदकी प्राप्ति ऋषय ऊचुः ऋषिगण बोले--हे सूतजी! अन्धक नामक अन्धको नाम हैत्येन्द्रो मन्दरे चारुकन्दरे।  हैत्यराजने मन्दरपर्वतकी सुन्दर गुफामें दमित होकर दमितस्तु कथं लेभे गाणपत्यं महेश्वरात्॥ १  किस प्रकार महेश्वरसे गाणपत्य (गणपतिपद) प्राप्त किया; जिस प्रकार यह घटित हुआ और जैसा आपने
verses.wordMeaning: An excellent Lihga has been installed by Brahma at this confluence. It is known in the world as Sahgamevara, (lord of the confluence).
verses.commentary: Sense: An excellent Lihga has been installed by Brahma at this confluence. It is known in the world as Sahgamevara, (lord of the confluence).

verses.sanskrit: रुद्रे देवे ममात्यन्तं परा भक्तिर्महत्तरा मयैव स्थापितं लिङ्गं तव नाम्ना भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: rudre deve mamātyantaṃ parā bhaktirmahattarā mayaiva sthāpitaṃ liṅgaṃ tava nāmnā bhaviṣyati
verses.translation: If a man shall become pure taking his bath at the confluence of the divine river and then worship SahgameiSa whence need he fear rebirth?
verses.hindi: सुना है, वह कृपापूर्वक हम लोगोंको बताइये ॥ १५;
verses.wordMeaning: If a man shall become pure taking his bath at the confluence of the divine river and then worship SahgameiSa whence need he fear rebirth?
verses.commentary: Sense: If a man shall become pure taking his bath at the confluence of the divine river and then worship SahgameiSa whence need he fear rebirth?

verses.sanskrit: हिरण्यगर्भ इत्येवं ततो ऽत्राहं समास्थितः दृष्ट्वैनमपि देवेशं मम लोकं व्रजेन्नरः
verses.transliteration: hiraṇyagarbha ityevaṃ tato 'trāhaṃ samāsthitaḥ dṛṣṭvainamapi deveśaṃ mama lokaṃ vrajennaraḥ
verses.translation: I consider this great holy centre as the exalted abode of the yogins, I am self-bom in the centre of this holy spot occupying the acme of the same.
verses.hindi: AREY सूतजी बोले-हे ऋषियो! मैं अन्धकपर अन्धकानुग्रहं चैव मन्दरे शोषणं तथा॥ २ शिवजीके अनुग्रह, मन्दरपर उसके दमन तथा वरलाभमशेषं च प्रवदामि समासतः।  वरप्राप्ति-यह सब संक्षेपमें बता रहा हूँ । प्राचीनकालमें हिरण्याक्षस्य तनयो हिरण्यनयनोपमः॥ ३  हिरण्याक्षका एक पुत्र था; हिरण्याक्षके समान शक्तिशाली वह अन्धक-इस नामसे प्रसिद्ध हुआ और उसने तपस्यासे पुरान्धक इति ख्यातस्तपसा लब्धविक्रमः। ES ब्रह्माकी महानू पराक्रम प्राप्त कर लिया। वह साक्षात् ब्रह्माक
verses.wordMeaning: I consider this great holy centre as the exalted abode of the yogins, I am self-bom in the centre of this holy spot occupying the acme of the same.
verses.commentary: Sense: I consider this great holy centre as the exalted abode of the yogins, I am self-bom in the centre of this holy spot occupying the acme of the same.

verses.sanskrit: ततः पुनरपि ब्रह्मा मम लिङ्गमिदं शुभम् स्थापयामास विधिवद् भक्त्या परमया युतः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ punarapi brahmā mama liṅgamidaṃ śubham sthāpayāmāsa vidhivad bhaktyā paramayā yutaḥ
verses.translation: Utpala and Vidala— two daityas who were killed by Siva.
verses.hindi: प्रसादाद् ब्रह्मणः साक्षादवध्यत्वमवाप्य हरहा च कृपासे किसीसे न मारे जानेका वर प्राप्त करके सम्पूर्ण
verses.wordMeaning: Utpala and Vidala— two daityas who were killed by Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: Utpala and Vidala— two daityas who were killed by Siva.

verses.sanskrit: स्वर्लीनेश्वर इत्येवम् अत्राहं स्वयमागतः प्राणान् इह नरस्त्यक्त्वा न पुनर्जायते क्वचित्
verses.transliteration: svarlīneśvara ityevam atrāhaṃ svayamāgataḥ prāṇān iha narastyaktvā na punarjāyate kvacit
verses.translation: It is glorified by all Devas and Asuras as Madhya- mesvara (Lord of the centre). Indeed this is the abode of Siddhas who observe the holy rites pertaining to me. It is the abode of yogins desirous of salvation and of those who are interested in the path of knowledge. By visiting this Madhya- mesana one will not bevail one's birth.
verses.hindi: त्रैलोक्यमखिलं भुक्त्वा जित्वा चेनद्रपुरं पुरा।  त्रिलोकोंका उपभोग करके इनद्रलोकको लीलापूर्वक लीलया चाप्रयत्नेन त्रासयामास वासवम्॥ ५  बिना प्रयासके ही जीतकर इन्द्रको पीड़ित करी विविशुर्मन्दरं भीता नारायणपुरोगमाः ॥ ६ उसके द्वारा कष्ट पहुँचाये गये, पीटे गये, अ
verses.wordMeaning: It is glorified by all Devas and Asuras as Madhya- mesvara (Lord of the centre). Indeed this is the abode of Siddhas who observe the holy rites pertaining to me. It is the abode of yogins desirous of salvation and of those who are interested in the path of knowledge.…
verses.commentary: Sense: It is glorified by all Devas and Asuras as Madhya- mesvara (Lord of the centre). Indeed this is the abode of Siddhas who observe the holy rites pertaining to me. It is the abode of yogins desirous of salvation and of those who are interested in the path of knowledge.…

verses.sanskrit: अनन्या सा गतिस्तस्य योगिनां चैव या स्मृता अस्मिन्नपि मया देशे दैत्यो दैवतकण्टकः
verses.transliteration: ananyā sā gatistasya yogināṃ caiva yā smṛtā asminnapi mayā deśe daityo daivatakaṇṭakaḥ
verses.translation: This Lihga has been installed by §ukra the son of Bhrgu. It is named Sukrevara and is worshipped by all the Siddhas and immortal beings. By visiting this deity the man who has self-control is immediately liberated from all sins. The creature that dies here is not reborn in the world.
verses.hindi: , गये, गिराये गये नारायण आदि वे देवता डरकर एवं सम्पीड्य वै देवानन्धकोऽपि महासुरः। मन्दरपर्वतकी गुफामें प्रविष्ट हो गये
verses.wordMeaning: This Lihga has been installed by §ukra the son of Bhrgu. It is named Sukrevara and is worshipped by all the Siddhas and immortal beings. By visiting this deity the man who has self-control is immediately liberated from all sins.…
verses.commentary: Sense: This Lihga has been installed by §ukra the son of Bhrgu. It is named Sukrevara and is worshipped by all the Siddhas and immortal beings. By visiting this deity the man who has self-control is immediately liberated from all sins.…

verses.sanskrit: व्याघ्ररूपं समास्थाय निहतो दर्पितो बली व्याघ्रेश्वर इति ख्यातो नित्यमत्राहमास्थितः
verses.transliteration: vyāghrarūpaṃ samāsthāya nihato darpito balī vyāghreśvara iti khyāto nityamatrāhamāsthitaḥ
verses.translation: Formerly, an Asura who was a thorn to Devas assumed the form of a jackal. The jackal was not capable of being caught by others as he had acquired boons from Brahma. O daughter of Himavan, he was killed by me here and so I am called Jambukea even today. I am known as such bowed to by Devas and Asuras. By visiting this lord of Devas one shall attain all cherished desires. These Lihgas have been installed by the planets beginning with Sukra. Sec these sacred Lihgas that bestow all cherished desires. Thus, O Parvati, these sacred Lihgas wherein I reside have been recounted. Listen to another esoteric secret of mine in this holy centre. This is glorified as extending to four Kronas in every direction.
verses.hindi: यदृच्छया गिरिं प्राप्तो मन्दरं चारुकन्दरम्॥ ७ इस प्रकार देवताओंको बहुत पीड़ित करे अध्याय ९३  हिरण्याक्षपुत्र अन्धकासुरका आख्यान तथा शिवानुग्रहसे उसे गाणपत्यपदकी प्राप्ति
verses.wordMeaning: Formerly, an Asura who was a thorn to Devas assumed the form of a jackal. The jackal was not capable of being caught by others as he had acquired boons from Brahma. O daughter of Himavan, he was killed by me here and so I am called Jambukea even today.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Formerly, an Asura who was a thorn to Devas assumed the form of a jackal. The jackal was not capable of being caught by others as he had acquired boons from Brahma. O daughter of Himavan, he was killed by me here and so I am called Jambukea even today.…

verses.sanskrit: न पुनर्दुर्गतिं याति दृष्ट्वैनं व्याघ्रमीश्वरम् उत्पलो विदलश्चैव यौ दैत्यौ ब्रह्मणा पुरा
verses.transliteration: na punardurgatiṃ yāti dṛṣṭvainaṃ vyāghramīśvaram utpalo vidalaścaiva yau daityau brahmaṇā purā
verses.translation: O lady of charming features, this place exten- ding to a yojana bestows immortality after death. Know, that, by visiting me stationed in the Mahalaya mountain and in Kedara, one attains the state of being a Gana. Salvation is obtained in this place. That liberation is excellent since one attains the headship of Ganas.

verses.wordMeaning: O lady of charming features, this place exten- ding to a yojana bestows immortality after death. Know, that, by visiting me stationed in the Mahalaya mountain and in Kedara, one attains the state of being a Gana. Salvation is obtained in this place.…
verses.commentary: Sense: O lady of charming features, this place exten- ding to a yojana bestows immortality after death. Know, that, by visiting me stationed in the Mahalaya mountain and in Kedara, one attains the state of being a Gana. Salvation is obtained in this place.…

verses.sanskrit: स्त्रीवध्यौ दर्पितौ दृष्ट्वा त्वयैव निहतौ रणे सावज्ञं कन्दुकेनात्र तस्येदं देहमास्थितम्
verses.transliteration: strīvadhyau darpitau dṛṣṭvā tvayaiva nihatau raṇe sāvajñaṃ kandukenātra tasyedaṃ dehamāsthitam
verses.translation: O lady of excellent face, this Avimukta is known as the most sacred holy centre greater than even Mahalaya, Kedara and Madhyama.
verses.hindi: वयं हैत्यराजस्य शस्त्रैर्निकृत्ता: इतीदमखिलं श्रुत्वा हैत्यागममनौपमम्। गणेश्वरैश्च भगवानन्धकाभिमुखं ययौ
verses.wordMeaning: O lady of excellent face, this Avimukta is known as the most sacred holy centre greater than even Mahalaya, Kedara and Madhyama.
verses.commentary: Sense: O lady of excellent face, this Avimukta is known as the most sacred holy centre greater than even Mahalaya, Kedara and Madhyama.

verses.sanskrit: आदावत्राहमागम्य प्रस्थितो गणपैः सह ज्येष्ठस्थानमिदं तस्माद् एतन्मे पुण्यदर्शनम्
verses.transliteration: ādāvatrāhamāgamya prasthito gaṇapaiḥ saha jyeṣṭhasthānamidaṃ tasmād etanme puṇyadarśanam
verses.translation: These holy centres are sacred in the Bhurloka (earth)
verses.hindi: तत्रे्रपद्यो्भवविष्णुमुख्याः
verses.wordMeaning: These holy centres are sacred in the Bhurloka (earth)
verses.commentary: Sense: These holy centres are sacred in the Bhurloka (earth)

verses.sanskrit: देवैः समन्ताद् एतानि लिङ्गानि स्थापितान्यतः दृष्ट्वापि नियतो मर्त्यो देहभेदे गणो भवेत्
verses.transliteration: devaiḥ samantād etāni liṅgāni sthāpitānyataḥ dṛṣṭvāpi niyato martyo dehabhede gaṇo bhavet
verses.translation: Ever since these worlds have been created, this auspicious holy centre has never been abandoned by me. Hence it became Avimukta (un-abandoned).®®*a
verses.hindi: अथाशेषासुरांस्तस्य कोटिकोटिशतैस्ततः। भस्मीकृत्य महादेवो निर्बिभेदान्धकं तदा तन्नादश्रवणान्नेदुर्देवा देवं प्रणम्य तम्। ननृतुर्मुनयः सर्वे मुमुदुर्गणपुङ्गवाः
verses.wordMeaning: Ever since these worlds have been created, this auspicious holy centre has never been abandoned by me. Hence it became Avimukta (un-abandoned).®®*a
verses.commentary: Sense: Ever since these worlds have been created, this auspicious holy centre has never been abandoned by me. Hence it became Avimukta (un-abandoned).®®*a

verses.sanskrit: पित्रा ते शैलराजेन पुरा हिमवता स्वयम् मम प्रियहितं स्थानं ज्ञात्वा लिङ्गं प्रतिष्ठितम्
verses.transliteration: pitrā te śailarājena purā himavatā svayam mama priyahitaṃ sthānaṃ jñātvā liṅgaṃ pratiṣṭhitam
verses.translation: By visiting the Lihga named AvimukteiSvara the man is immediately liberated from sins. He is liberated from the bondages of jiva.
verses.hindi: ससृजुः पुष्पवर्षाणि देवाः शम्भोस्तदोपरि। त्रैलोक्यमखिलं हर्षान्ननन्द च ननाद च
verses.wordMeaning: By visiting the Lihga named AvimukteiSvara the man is immediately liberated from sins. He is liberated from the bondages of jiva.
verses.commentary: Sense: By visiting the Lihga named AvimukteiSvara the man is immediately liberated from sins. He is liberated from the bondages of jiva.

verses.sanskrit: शैलेश्वरमिति ख्यातं दृश्यतामिह चादरात् दृष्ट्वैतन्मनुजो देवि न दुर्गतिमतो व्रजेत्
verses.transliteration: śaileśvaramiti khyātaṃ dṛśyatāmiha cādarāt dṛṣṭvaitanmanujo devi na durgatimato vrajet
verses.translation: By visiting all these holy centres, viz Sailea, Sahgamea, Svarlina, Madhyamevara, Hiranyagarbha, Gopr- eksa, Vrsadhvaja Upaanta Siva (?) the deity residing in Jyesthasthana, Sukresvara, VyaghreiSa and Jambukevara a man is not born again in the world which is the ocean of misery.
verses.hindi: जन्मान्तरेऽपि देवेन दग्धो यस्माच्छिवेन वै। यः स्मरेन्मनसा रुद्रं प्राणान्ते सकृदेव वा
verses.wordMeaning: By visiting all these holy centres, viz Sailea, Sahgamea, Svarlina, Madhyamevara, Hiranyagarbha, Gopr- eksa, Vrsadhvaja Upaanta Siva (?) the deity residing in Jyesthasthana, Sukresvara, VyaghreiSa and Jambukevara a man is not born again in the world which is the ocean of misery.
verses.commentary: Sense: By visiting all these holy centres, viz Sailea, Sahgamea, Svarlina, Madhyamevara, Hiranyagarbha, Gopr- eksa, Vrsadhvaja Upaanta Siva (?) the deity residing in Jyesthasthana, Sukresvara, VyaghreiSa and Jambukevara a man is not born again in the world which is the ocean of misery.

verses.sanskrit: नद्येषा वरुणा देवि पुण्या पापप्रमोचनी क्षेत्रमेतद् अलंकृत्य जाह्नव्या सह संगता
verses.transliteration: nadyeṣā varuṇā devi puṇyā pāpapramocanī kṣetrametad alaṃkṛtya jāhnavyā saha saṃgatā
verses.translation: When Mahesvara the lord of Devas stopped after surveying, that place suddenly became blazing as it were.
verses.hindi: स याति शिवसायुज्यं किं पुनर्बहुशः स्मरन्। ब्रह्मा च भगवान् विष्णुः सर्वे देवाः सवासवाः
verses.wordMeaning: When Mahesvara the lord of Devas stopped after surveying, that place suddenly became blazing as it were.
verses.commentary: Sense: When Mahesvara the lord of Devas stopped after surveying, that place suddenly became blazing as it were.

verses.sanskrit: स्थापितं ब्रह्मणा चापि संगमे लिङ्गमुत्तमम् संगमेश्वरम् इत्येवं ख्यातं जगति दृश्यताम्
verses.transliteration: sthāpitaṃ brahmaṇā cāpi saṃgame liṅgamuttamam saṃgameśvaram ityevaṃ khyātaṃ jagati dṛśyatām
verses.translation: Then hundreds of Siddhas who were devotees of Paupati, who were white by being bathed in ashes, who were great souls devoted to MahetSvara and who invariably obs- erved holy rites came there and bowed down to Mahesvara. They then observed the lord of the yogas and adopted Dhyanayoga (path of meditation) assiduously. They took to the support of the Atman and stationed themselves as though they would merge into Mahesvara. Even as they stood by, the consort of Uma, the lord of Devas, the lord Purusa assumed the greatest of his physical forms. He stood as though towards the close of the worlds in order to make the entire universe present in one place. With hairs standing on their ends due to her delight, the daughter of the lord of the mountains could not look at the lord of the universe who had assumed the greatest of his physical forms.
verses.hindi: अन्धक भी अपनी इच्छासे सुन्दर गुफावाले मन्दरपर्वतपर पहुँच गया तब साध्योंसहित वे सभी देवगण शीघ्र ही सुरेश्वर महेशके सामने पहुँचकर इस प्रकार बोले- 'हैत्यराज अन्धक-के शस्त्रोंसे काटे गये हमलोग छिन्न-भिन्न अंगोंवाले हो गये हैं और अल्प पराक्रमवाले
verses.wordMeaning: Then hundreds of Siddhas who were devotees of Paupati, who were white by being bathed in ashes, who were great souls devoted to MahetSvara and who invariably obs- erved holy rites came there and bowed down to Mahesvara.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Then hundreds of Siddhas who were devotees of Paupati, who were white by being bathed in ashes, who were great souls devoted to MahetSvara and who invariably obs- erved holy rites came there and bowed down to Mahesvara.…

verses.sanskrit: संगमे देवनद्या हि यः स्नात्वा मनुजः शुचिः अर्चयेत् संगमेश्वरं तस्य जन्मभयं कुतः
verses.transliteration: saṃgame devanadyā hi yaḥ snātvā manujaḥ śuciḥ arcayet saṃgameśvaraṃ tasya janmabhayaṃ kutaḥ
verses.translation: Then she understood that that form which had not been seen before was stationed in Prakrti, and so ParameS- vari adopted the form of the Prakrti by means of yoga. Then she could see the form of the noble soul. Then the yogins engaged in the meditation of merging (laya) entered the heart of the Puru§a. They burnt all the seeds of mundane existence by remembering the splendid Bija of the five-syllabled Mantra. Then the Lord established his divine and holy form which dispels all sins and which had been revealed formerly in this Nilalohita image.
verses.hindi: तब हैत्यका अद्भुत आगमन-सम्बन्धौ यह सब वृत्तान्त सुनकर भगवान् शिव अपने गणेश्वरोंके साथ अन्धकके समक्ष पहुँचे
verses.wordMeaning: Then she understood that that form which had not been seen before was stationed in Prakrti, and so ParameS- vari adopted the form of the Prakrti by means of yoga. Then she could see the form of the noble soul.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Then she understood that that form which had not been seen before was stationed in Prakrti, and so ParameS- vari adopted the form of the Prakrti by means of yoga. Then she could see the form of the noble soul.…

verses.sanskrit: इदं मन्ये महाक्षेत्रं निवासो योगिनां परम् क्षेत्रमध्ये च यत्राहं स्वयं भूत्वाग्रमास्थितः
verses.transliteration: idaṃ manye mahākṣetraṃ nivāso yogināṃ param kṣetramadhye ca yatrāhaṃ svayaṃ bhūtvāgramāsthitaḥ
verses.translation: On seeing him, the daughter of the mountains
verses.hindi: उस समय इन्द्र, ब्रह्मा, विष्णु आदि प्रधान सुरेश्वर तथा श्रेष्ठ विप्र-ये सब बद्ध अंजलियोंको सिरसे लगाकर चारों ओरसे भगवान् शिवको जय बोलने लगे तब महादेवने सैकड़ों-करोड़ों सैनिकोंके साथ उस अन्धकके समस्त राक्षसोंको भस्म करके अन्धकको अपने त्रिशूलसे बींध डाला
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing him, the daughter of the mountains
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing him, the daughter of the mountains

verses.sanskrit: मध्यमेश्वरमित्येवं ख्यातः सर्वसुरासुरैः सिद्धानां स्थानमेतद्धि मदीयव्रतधारिणाम्
verses.transliteration: madhyameśvaramityevaṃ khyātaḥ sarvasurāsuraiḥ siddhānāṃ sthānametaddhi madīyavratadhāriṇām
verses.translation: Hence, this great holy centre is resorted to by Brahma and others, by leading brahmins well-versed in the Vedic learning and by ascetics of great accomplishments. O goddess, the deity is worshipped at Varanasi on the eighth and fourteenth day in both the fortnights every month. It is particularly worshipped on solar and lunar eclipse days, espe- cially in the month of Karttika, during all full moon and new moon days, and during equinoctial and solstitial transits. All the Tirlhas of the earth resort to the holy Gahga flowing north at Varanasi, the Gahga that flowed out of my matted hairs, the Gahga that is the daughter of your father Himavan the king of mountains, the Gahga that is stationed in the holy abode and flows towards sacred quarters always. O lady of excellent face, what are these Tirthas? Listen.
verses.hindi: शिवके द्वारा त्रिशूलसे बींधे गये उस दग्धपापरूपी कंचुकवाले अन्धकको देखकर ब्रह्माजी ईश्वर (शिव)- को प्रणाम करके  प्रसन्नतासे निनाद करने लगे
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, this great holy centre is resorted to by Brahma and others, by leading brahmins well-versed in the Vedic learning and by ascetics of great accomplishments. O goddess, the deity is worshipped at Varanasi on the eighth and fourteenth day in both the fortnights every month.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, this great holy centre is resorted to by Brahma and others, by leading brahmins well-versed in the Vedic learning and by ascetics of great accomplishments. O goddess, the deity is worshipped at Varanasi on the eighth and fourteenth day in both the fortnights every month.…

verses.sanskrit: योगिनां मोक्षलिप्सूनां ज्ञानयोगरतात्मनाम् दृष्ट्वैनं मध्यमेशानं जन्म प्रति न शोचति
verses.transliteration: yogināṃ mokṣalipsūnāṃ jñānayogaratātmanām dṛṣṭvainaṃ madhyameśānaṃ janma prati na śocati
verses.translation: These Tirthas accompanied by hundreds of Tirthas flow through Kuruk§etra, Puskara, Naimisa, Prayaga where there is plenty of water, and Drumaksetra. O fair lady, they flow through all the holy centres all round. The deities, sages, Sandhyas, seasons, rivers, lakes, oceans and the divine Tirthas join Gahga during the Parvan days. O lady of good holy rites, O goddess of Devas, by visiting Avimuktesvara and Trivistapa and reaching Kalabhairava, the holy centre, men become rid of their sins during the Parvans. The sacred rivers of the earth and the great shrines and abodes enter Gahga at Varanasi in the course of holy Parvans.
verses.hindi: उस ध्वनिको सुनकर सभी देवता, मुनि तथा श्रेष्ठ गण भी उन्हें प्रणाम करके हर्षध्वनि करने लगे, नाचने लगे और आनन्द मनाने लगे। देवताओंने उस समय शिवजीके ऊपर पुष्मोंकी वर्षा की और सम्पूर्ण त्रैलोक्य हर्षके कारण आनन्दित हो उठा तथा ध्वनि करने लगा
verses.wordMeaning: These Tirthas accompanied by hundreds of Tirthas flow through Kuruk§etra, Puskara, Naimisa, Prayaga where there is plenty of water, and Drumaksetra. O fair lady, they flow through all the holy centres all round. The deities, sages, Sandhyas, seasons, rivers, lakes,…
verses.commentary: Sense: These Tirthas accompanied by hundreds of Tirthas flow through Kuruk§etra, Puskara, Naimisa, Prayaga where there is plenty of water, and Drumaksetra. O fair lady, they flow through all the holy centres all round. The deities, sages, Sandhyas, seasons, rivers, lakes,…

verses.sanskrit: स्थापितं लिङ्गमेतत्तु शुक्रेण भृगुसूनुना नाम्ना शुक्रेश्वरं नाम सर्वसिद्धामरार्चितम्
verses.transliteration: sthāpitaṃ liṅgametattu śukreṇa bhṛgusūnunā nāmnā śukreśvaraṃ nāma sarvasiddhāmarārcitam
verses.translation: The different shrines in and around this place are as follows:— Avimukta is the most excellent holy centre. It dispels great sins. The Linga that is at Kedara,
verses.hindi: प्रज्वलित अग्निवाले त्रिशूलसे बींधा हुआ प्रेततुल्य वह अन्धक सात्त्विक भावमें स्थित होकर मनमें सोचने लगा--' पूर्वजन्ममें भी शिवने मुझे दग्ध किया था, मैंने पहले साक्षात् महेश्वर शिवको आराधना को थी,
verses.wordMeaning: The different shrines in and around this place are as follows:— Avimukta is the most excellent holy centre. It dispels great sins. The Linga that is at Kedara,
verses.commentary: Sense: The different shrines in and around this place are as follows:— Avimukta is the most excellent holy centre. It dispels great sins. The Linga that is at Kedara,

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वैनं नियतः सद्यो मुच्यते सर्वकिल्बिषैः मृतश् च न पुनर्जन्तुः संसारी तु भवेन्नरः
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvainaṃ niyataḥ sadyo mucyate sarvakilbiṣaiḥ mṛtaś ca na punarjantuḥ saṃsārī tu bhavennaraḥ
verses.translation: Therefore, the creature that dies here attains the divine immortal* region if he takes ablution in the Gahga and visits me, O auspicious lady.
verses.hindi: इसीलिये मैंने ऐसी गति प्राप्त को, अन्यथा ऐसा कभी न होता। जो व्यक्ति मृत्युकालके समय एक बार भी मनसे शिवका स्मरण करता है, वह शिवसायुज्य प्राप्त करता है, तो फिर जो बहुत बार स्मरण करे, उसका कहना ही क्या! ब्रह्मा, भगवान् विष्णु और इन्ट्रसहित सभी
verses.wordMeaning: Therefore, the creature that dies here attains the divine immortal* region if he takes ablution in the Gahga and visits me, O auspicious lady.
verses.commentary: Sense: Therefore, the creature that dies here attains the divine immortal* region if he takes ablution in the Gahga and visits me, O auspicious lady.

verses.sanskrit: पुरा जम्बूकरूपेण असुरो देवकण्टकः ब्रह्मणो हि वरं लब्ध्वा गोमायुर्बन्धशङ्कितः
verses.transliteration: purā jambūkarūpeṇa asuro devakaṇṭakaḥ brahmaṇo hi varaṃ labdhvā gomāyurbandhaśaṅkitaḥ
verses.translation: The creature immediately obtains a benefit equal to that of hundreds and thousands of sacrifices. What is more wonderful than that? O fair lady, of all the important shrines on the earth and on mountains, Avimukta is the grea- test. Understand what has been said by me. The sin mentioned in the Vedas is recounted by brahmins by the word ''Avi". The holy centre is called Avimukta because it is free from Avi (i. e. sin)®' and resorted to by me.
verses.hindi: श्रीलिड्रमहापुराण
verses.wordMeaning: The creature immediately obtains a benefit equal to that of hundreds and thousands of sacrifices. What is more wonderful than that? O fair lady, of all the important shrines on the earth and on mountains, Avimukta is the grea- test. Understand what has been said by me.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The creature immediately obtains a benefit equal to that of hundreds and thousands of sacrifices. What is more wonderful than that? O fair lady, of all the important shrines on the earth and on mountains, Avimukta is the grea- test. Understand what has been said by me.…

verses.sanskrit: निहतो हिमवत्पुत्रि जम्बूकेशस्ततो ह्यहम् अद्यापि जगति ख्यातं सुरासुरनमस्कृतम्
verses.transliteration: nihato himavatputri jambūkeśastato hyaham adyāpi jagati khyātaṃ surāsuranamaskṛtam
verses.translation: After saying this, the lord of all the worlds said — ''O goddess of Devas, Avimukta is my abode. See it well.'* After saying this, the lord, the consort of Uma, pointed out the excellent Srlparvata to her. He stayed at Avimuktevara permanently along with her. In view of his ability to go every- where, the lord of Devas, the soul of all, identical with 'Sat* and 'Asat' came to Sriparvata along with the goddess. He, the lord of all living beings, pointed out to her the following holy centres and idols:
verses.hindi: एवं सञ्चिन्त्य तुष्टात्मा सोऽन्धकश्चान्धकार्दनम् सगणं शिवमीशानमस्तुवत्पुण्यगौरवात्। प्रार्थितस्तेन भगवान् परमार्तिहरो हरः
verses.wordMeaning: After saying this, the lord of all the worlds said — ''O goddess of Devas, Avimukta is my abode. See it well.'* After saying this, the lord, the consort of Uma, pointed out the excellent Srlparvata to her. He stayed at Avimuktevara permanently along with her.…
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying this, the lord of all the worlds said — ''O goddess of Devas, Avimukta is my abode. See it well.'* After saying this, the lord, the consort of Uma, pointed out the excellent Srlparvata to her. He stayed at Avimuktevara permanently along with her.…

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वैनमपि देवेशं सर्वान्कामानवाप्नुयात् ग्रहैः शुक्रपुरोगैश् च एतानि स्थापितानि ह
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvainamapi deveśaṃ sarvānkāmānavāpnuyāt grahaiḥ śukrapurogaiś ca etāni sthāpitāni ha
verses.translation: Kundlprabha; the great and divine Vairavane- vara; Aalihga; Devea;the divine Bale vara; the great Rames-
verses.hindi: तुष्टोऽस्मि वत्स भद्रं ते कामं किं करवाणि ते। वरान् वरय हैत्येन्द्र वरदोऽहं तवान्धक
verses.wordMeaning: Kundlprabha; the great and divine Vairavane- vara; Aalihga; Devea;the divine Bale vara; the great Rames-
verses.commentary: Sense: Kundlprabha; the great and divine Vairavane- vara; Aalihga; Devea;the divine Bale vara; the great Rames-

verses.sanskrit: पश्य पुण्यानि लिङ्गानि सर्वकामप्रदानि तु एवमेतानि पुण्यानि मन्निवासानि पार्वति
verses.transliteration: paśya puṇyāni liṅgāni sarvakāmapradāni tu evametāni puṇyāni mannivāsāni pārvati
verses.translation: The shrine Rajevara is installed in succession by means of Rajas; the Gajevara, the VaiiSakha idol, the unchanging Kapotel vara; O fair lady, see now the splendid great Tirtha Kotisvara, which was formerly resorted to by crores of the Ganas of Rudra and which is superior to all the other shrines.
verses.hindi: भगवन् देवदेवेश भक्तार्तिहर शङ्कर। त्वयि भक्तिः प्रसीदेश यदि देयो वरश्च मे प्रददौ दुर्लभां श्रद्धां हैत्येन्द्रा महाद्युतिः
verses.wordMeaning: The shrine Rajevara is installed in succession by means of Rajas; the Gajevara, the VaiiSakha idol, the unchanging Kapotel vara; O fair lady, see now the splendid great Tirtha Kotisvara,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The shrine Rajevara is installed in succession by means of Rajas; the Gajevara, the VaiiSakha idol, the unchanging Kapotel vara; O fair lady, see now the splendid great Tirtha Kotisvara,…

verses.sanskrit: कथितानि मम क्षेत्रे गुह्यं चान्यदिदं शृणु चतुःक्रोशं चतुर्दिक्षु क्षेत्रमेतत्प्रकीर्तितम्
verses.transliteration: kathitāni mama kṣetre guhyaṃ cānyadidaṃ śṛṇu catuḥkrośaṃ caturdikṣu kṣetrametatprakīrtitam
verses.translation: A splendid rocky idol was installed by Brahma in the south and another was installed in the north by Visnu. Both these together constitute the shrine called Dvidevakula.
verses.hindi: गाणपत्यं च हैत्याय प्रददौ चावरोप्य तम्। प्रणेमुस्तं सुरेन्द्राद्या गाणपत्ये प्रतिष्ठितम्
verses.wordMeaning: A splendid rocky idol was installed by Brahma in the south and another was installed in the north by Visnu. Both these together constitute the shrine called Dvidevakula.
verses.commentary: Sense: A splendid rocky idol was installed by Brahma in the south and another was installed in the north by Visnu. Both these together constitute the shrine called Dvidevakula.

verses.sanskrit: योजनं विद्धि चार्वङ्गि मृत्युकाले ऽमृतप्रदम् महालयगिरिस्थं मां केदारे च व्यवस्थितम्
verses.transliteration: yojanaṃ viddhi cārvaṅgi mṛtyukāle 'mṛtapradam mahālayagiristhaṃ māṃ kedāre ca vyavasthitam
verses.translation: See, on the western mountain a Lihga of huge size had been installed by me formerly. It is called Brahmesvara, Malcsvara.
verses.hindi: शिव-की शरणमें जाना चाहिए'॥ १५- १८१,  इस प्रकार विचार करके वह अन्धक अधि पुण्यगौरवके कारण गणोंसहित अन्धकका संहार करनेवाले उन ईशान शिवको स्तुति करने लगा। तब उसके द्र प्रार्थित होकर बड़े-से-बड़े दुःखका हरण करनेवाले
verses.wordMeaning: See, on the western mountain a Lihga of huge size had been installed by me formerly. It is called Brahmesvara, Malcsvara.
verses.commentary: Sense: See, on the western mountain a Lihga of huge size had been installed by me formerly. It is called Brahmesvara, Malcsvara.

verses.sanskrit: गणत्वं लभते दृष्ट्वा ह्य् अस्मिन्मोक्षो ह्यवाप्यते गाणपत्यं लभेद्यस्माद् यतः सा मुक्तिरुत्तमा
verses.transliteration: gaṇatvaṃ labhate dṛṣṭvā hy asminmokṣo hyavāpyate gāṇapatyaṃ labhedyasmād yataḥ sā muktiruttamā
verses.translation: A shrine is remembered by the name Alarhgrha. The lord said thus: — ''O Brahma, this has been embellished by you at the outset, along with the sages." After saying this he stayed in the house. Hence, the shrine came to be known as Alarh- gfha.
verses.hindi: नीललोहित सुरेश्वर भगवान् हर अपने त्रिशूलके अग्रभागपर स्थित हिरण्याक्षपुत्र अन्धक-की ओर दयापूर्वक देखकर उससे बोले“ है वत्स! मैं तुमपर
verses.wordMeaning: A shrine is remembered by the name Alarhgrha. The lord said thus: — ''O Brahma, this has been embellished by you at the outset, along with the sages." After saying this he stayed in the house. Hence, the shrine came to be known as Alarh- gfha.
verses.commentary: Sense: A shrine is remembered by the name Alarhgrha. The lord said thus: — ''O Brahma, this has been embellished by you at the outset, along with the sages." After saying this he stayed in the house. Hence, the shrine came to be known as Alarh- gfha.

verses.sanskrit: ततो महालयात् तस्मात् केदारान्मध्यमादपि स्मृतं पुण्यतमं क्षेत्रम् अविमुक्तं वरानने
verses.transliteration: tato mahālayāt tasmāt kedārānmadhyamādapi smṛtaṃ puṇyatamaṃ kṣetram avimuktaṃ varānane
verses.translation: O lady conversant with the Tirthas, see there is a Tirtha and a Vyomalihga of mine there also. This is called Kadambesvara, installed by Skanda himself.
verses.hindi: कामना पूर्ण करूँ? है हैत्येन्द्र! वर माँगो। है अन्धक! तब शम्भुका वचन सुनकर हिरण्याक्षे हर्षके कारण गद्गद वाणीमें महेश्वरसे यह कहा--'हे भगवन्! है देवदेवेश! भक्तोंका कष्ट हरनेवाले हे शंकर! मुझपर प्रसन्न होइये। है ईश! यदि आप मुझे वर
verses.wordMeaning: O lady conversant with the Tirthas, see there is a Tirtha and a Vyomalihga of mine there also. This is called Kadambesvara, installed by Skanda himself.
verses.commentary: Sense: O lady conversant with the Tirthas, see there is a Tirtha and a Vyomalihga of mine there also. This is called Kadambesvara, installed by Skanda himself.

verses.sanskrit: यतः सृष्टास्त्विमे लोकास् ततः क्षेत्रमिदं शुभम् कदाचिन्न मया मुक्तम् अविमुक्तं ततो ऽभवत्
verses.transliteration: yataḥ sṛṣṭāstvime lokās tataḥ kṣetramidaṃ śubham kadācinna mayā muktam avimuktaṃ tato 'bhavat
verses.translation: Formerly, the Brahman was embellished by me along with the sages. O fair lady, the shrine vara is evolved by Caridika — Cadikea is your daughter— This spot is the excellent Ambika Tirtha.
verses.hindi: महान् आत्मावाले अन्धकका वचन सुनकर परम कान्तिवाले शिवने उस हैत्येन्द्रको अपनी दुर्लभ भक्ति प्रदान की और उस हैत्यको त्रिशूलपरसे उतारकर उसे गणाधिप पद प्रदान किया। तब इन्द्र आदि भगवानूके वाराहावतारकी कथा, हिरण्याक्षका वध तथा देवताओंद्वारा भगवान् वाराहकी स्तुति
verses.wordMeaning: Formerly, the Brahman was embellished by me along with the sages. O fair lady, the shrine vara is evolved by Caridika — Cadikea is your daughter— This spot is the excellent Ambika Tirtha.
verses.commentary: Sense: Formerly, the Brahman was embellished by me along with the sages. O fair lady, the shrine vara is evolved by Caridika — Cadikea is your daughter— This spot is the excellent Ambika Tirtha.

verses.sanskrit: अविमुक्तेश्वरं लिङ्गं मम दृष्ट्वेह मानवः सद्यः पापविनिर्मुक्तः पशुपाशैर्विमुच्यते
verses.transliteration: avimukteśvaraṃ liṅgaṃ mama dṛṣṭveha mānavaḥ sadyaḥ pāpavinirmuktaḥ paśupāśairvimucyate
verses.translation: If the ablution is made with twentyfive Palas of the sacred material of worship it should be known as Abh- yahga; if it is with a hundred Palas, it should be known as Snana. Two thousand Palas of the material are said to consti- tute a Mahasnana (great ablution). The devotee bathes my Lihga at the outset with cow's ghee. Then he consecrates it with the other materials. Thereafter he washes with water. The benefit of a hundred Yajfias is attained by the mere rite of wiping off the Lihga; by bathing it the benefit of ten thou- sand sacrifices is attained; by worship the benefit of hundred thousand sacrifices is obtained. The benefit of those who sing and play on instruments of music is infinite. By means of the great bath eight times the benefit of bath is acquired. If the devotee wishes to perform the rite of ablution by means of water alone he shall do so by means of fragrant scented water with devotion. The unguent in every case is by means of twentyfive Palas of the material used.
verses.hindi: कथमस्य पिता हैत्यो हिरण्याक्षः सुदारुणः। विष्णुना सूदितो विष्णुर्वाराहत्वं कथं गतः
verses.wordMeaning: If the ablution is made with twentyfive Palas of the sacred material of worship it should be known as Abh- yahga; if it is with a hundred Palas, it should be known as Snana. Two thousand Palas of the material are said to consti- tute a Mahasnana (great ablution).…
verses.commentary: Sense: If the ablution is made with twentyfive Palas of the sacred material of worship it should be known as Abh- yahga; if it is with a hundred Palas, it should be known as Snana. Two thousand Palas of the material are said to consti- tute a Mahasnana (great ablution).…

verses.sanskrit: शैलेशं संगमेशं च स्वर्लीनं मध्यमेश्वरम् हिरण्यगर्भम् ईशानं गोप्रेक्षं वृषभध्वजम्
verses.transliteration: śaileśaṃ saṃgameśaṃ ca svarlīnaṃ madhyameśvaram hiraṇyagarbham īśānaṃ goprekṣaṃ vṛṣabhadhvajam
verses.translation: The devotee shall use Sami flower, Bilva leaves and lotuses duly. He can use other flowers also but he shall not abandon the Bilva leaf.
verses.hindi: ऋषिगणा बोले है सूतजी ! भगवान् विष्णुके हार इस  अन्धक-का पिता महाभयंकर हैत्य हिरण्याक्ष कैसे मारा गया, विष्णुने वाराहका रूप क्यों धारण किया और उनकी सींगने महेश्वरका भूषणत्व कैसे प्रा किया? यह सब आप विशेषरूपसे बताइये
verses.wordMeaning: The devotee shall use Sami flower, Bilva leaves and lotuses duly. He can use other flowers also but he shall not abandon the Bilva leaf.
verses.commentary: Sense: The devotee shall use Sami flower, Bilva leaves and lotuses duly. He can use other flowers also but he shall not abandon the Bilva leaf.

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा न जायते मर्त्यः संसारे दुःखसागरे एवम् उक्त्वा महादेवो दिशः सर्वा व्यलोकयत्
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvā na jāyate martyaḥ saṃsāre duḥkhasāgare evam uktvā mahādevo diśaḥ sarvā vyalokayat
verses.translation: If the devotee is a brahmin devoid of wealth, he attains the same benefit and merit as with the worship of a hundred Dronas even when he worships only with an Adhaka measure. No doubt need be entertained in this respect.
verses.hindi: पुरान्धकासुरेशस्य पिता कालान्तकोपमः हैत्येन्द्रो बद्ध्वा च धरणीमिमाम्। नीत्वा रसातलं चक्रे बन्दीमिन्दीवरप्रभाम्
verses.wordMeaning: If the devotee is a brahmin devoid of wealth, he attains the same benefit and merit as with the worship of a hundred Dronas even when he worships only with an Adhaka measure. No doubt need be entertained in this respect.
verses.commentary: Sense: If the devotee is a brahmin devoid of wealth, he attains the same benefit and merit as with the worship of a hundred Dronas even when he worships only with an Adhaka measure. No doubt need be entertained in this respect.

verses.wordMeaning: He who reads or listens to the glory of the shrines shall immediately attain those merits which one attaim* by visiting holy centres. He shall narrate this to all the brah-
verses.commentary: Sense: He who reads or listens to the glory of the shrines shall immediately attain those merits which one attaim* by visiting holy centres. He shall narrate this to all the brah-

verses.sanskrit: कल्पयामास वै क्षेत्रं मन्दरे चारुकन्दरे तत्रान्धकं महादैत्यं हिरण्याक्षसुतं प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: kalpayāmāsa vai kṣetraṃ mandare cārukandare tatrāndhakaṃ mahādaityaṃ hiraṇyākṣasutaṃ prabhuḥ
verses.translation: He who reads or listens to the glory of the shrines shall immediately attain those merits which one attaim* by visiting holy centres. He shall narrate this to all the brah-
verses.hindi: हे द्विजो ! विविध भावोंसे युक्त नानाविध स्तुतियोंसे प्रार्थना किये जानेपर भी वे प्रभु अपने सिंहरूपका सम्मान करते हुए शान्त नहीं हुए। जो नृसिंह-स्तुतिको भक्तिपूर्वक पढ़ता है अथवा इसके अर्थका चिन्तन
verses.wordMeaning: He who reads or listens to the glory of the shrines shall immediately attain those merits which one attaim* by visiting holy centres. He shall narrate this to all the brah-
verses.commentary: Sense: He who reads or listens to the glory of the shrines shall immediately attain those merits which one attaim* by visiting holy centres. He shall narrate this to all the brah-

verses.sanskrit: अनुगृह्य गणत्वं च प्रापयामास लीलया एतद्वः कथितं सर्वं कथासर्वस्वमादरात्
verses.transliteration: anugṛhya gaṇatvaṃ ca prāpayāmāsa līlayā etadvaḥ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ kathāsarvasvamādarāt
verses.translation: He who reads or listens to the glory of the shrines shall immediately attain those merits which one attaim* by visiting holy centres. He shall narrate this to all the brah-
verses.hindi: करता है अथवा सभी द्विजोंको सुनाता है, वह विष्णुलोकमें प्रतिष्ठा प्राप्त करता है ॥ २९-३०/२॥ तत्पश्चात् इन्द्र तथा ब्रह्मासहित सभी देवता प्रभु शिवका ध्यान करके नूसिंहरूपधारी विष्णुके विषयमें सब कुछ कहकर उनकी स्तुति करने लगे। तदनन्तर परमेश्वरकी स्तुति करके ब्रह्मा आदि देवता अपनी
verses.wordMeaning: He who reads or listens to the glory of the shrines shall immediately attain those merits which one attaim* by visiting holy centres. He shall narrate this to all the brah-
verses.commentary: Sense: He who reads or listens to the glory of the shrines shall immediately attain those merits which one attaim* by visiting holy centres. He shall narrate this to all the brah-

verses.sanskrit: यः पठेच्छृणुयाद्वापि क्षेत्रमाहात्म्यमुत्तमम् सर्वक्षेत्रेषु यत्पुण्यं तत्सर्वं सहसा लभेत्
verses.transliteration: yaḥ paṭhecchṛṇuyādvāpi kṣetramāhātmyamuttamam sarvakṣetreṣu yatpuṇyaṃ tatsarvaṃ sahasā labhet
verses.translation: He who reads or listens to the glory of the shrines shall immediately attain those merits which one attaim* by visiting holy centres. He shall narrate this to all the brah-
verses.hindi: रक्षाके लिये मन्दर पर्वतपर स्थित, उमाके साथ विहार करते हुए और गन्धर्वो, सिद्धों-अप्सराओंसे सेवित परमकारण महादेवकी शरणमें गये। भयभीत ब्रह्माजी
verses.wordMeaning: He who reads or listens to the glory of the shrines shall immediately attain those merits which one attaim* by visiting holy centres. He shall narrate this to all the brah-
verses.commentary: Sense: He who reads or listens to the glory of the shrines shall immediately attain those merits which one attaim* by visiting holy centres. He shall narrate this to all the brah-

verses.sanskrit: श्रावयेद्वा द्विजान्सर्वान् कृतशौचान् जितेन्द्रियान् स एव सर्वयज्ञस्य फलं प्राप्नोति मानवः
verses.transliteration: śrāvayedvā dvijānsarvān kṛtaśaucān jitendriyān sa eva sarvayajñasya phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ
verses.translation: He who reads or listens to the glory of the shrines shall immediately attain those merits which one attaim* by visiting holy centres. He shall narrate this to all the brah-
verses.hindi: वाणीमें परमेश्वरकी स्तुति करने लगे ब्रह्माजी बोले-- है शिव! आप कालान्तकको नमस्कार है। है रुद्र! आप क्रोधरूपको नमस्कार है। आप मोक्षरूप रुद्र, शंकर तथा शिवको नमस्कार है। आप उग्र हैं, सभी प्राणियोंके नियन्ता हैं और
verses.wordMeaning: He who reads or listens to the glory of the shrines shall immediately attain those merits which one attaim* by visiting holy centres. He shall narrate this to all the brah-
verses.commentary: Sense: He who reads or listens to the glory of the shrines shall immediately attain those merits which one attaim* by visiting holy centres. He shall narrate this to all the brah-

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीलिङ्गमहापुराणे पूर्वभागे वाराणसीश्रीशैलमाहात्म्यकथनं नाम द्विनवतितमो ऽध्यायः अन्धको नाम दैत्येन्द्रो मन्दरे चारुकन्दरे दमितस्तु कथं लेभे गाणपत्यं महेश्वरात्
verses.transliteration: iti śrīliṅgamahāpurāṇe pūrvabhāge vārāṇasīśrīśailamāhātmyakathanaṃ nāma dvinavatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ andhako nāma daityendro mandare cārukandare damitastu kathaṃ lebhe gāṇapatyaṃ maheśvarāt
verses.translation: How did the leading Daitya named Andhaka obtain the chieftaincy of the Gaas from Mahevara after being sub- dued in the Mandara mountain with many charming caves? It behoves you to recount it in the manner it happened and in the way you have heard.
verses.hindi: हम भक्तोंके लिये कल्याणकारक हैं। दुःखका नाश करनेवाले शिव, शर्व तथा शंकरको नमस्कार है
verses.wordMeaning: How did the leading Daitya named Andhaka obtain the chieftaincy of the Gaas from Mahevara after being sub- dued in the Mandara mountain with many charming caves? It behoves you to recount it in the manner it happened and in the way you have heard.
verses.commentary: Sense: How did the leading Daitya named Andhaka obtain the chieftaincy of the Gaas from Mahevara after being sub- dued in the Mandara mountain with many charming caves? It behoves you to recount it in the manner it happened and in the way you have heard.

verses.sanskrit: वक्तुमर्हसि चास्माकं यथावृत्तं यथाश्रुतम् अन्धकानुग्रहं चैव मन्दरे शोषणं तथा
verses.transliteration: vaktumarhasi cāsmākaṃ yathāvṛttaṃ yathāśrutam andhakānugrahaṃ caiva mandare śoṣaṇaṃ tathā
verses.translation: All Devas, Narayana and others were oppressed, beaten, bound and struck down by him. They became frightened and entered Mandara.
verses.hindi: आप सुखकर, विश्वरूप, विष्णु, ब्रह्माको नमस्कार है। आप अन्तक (संहारकर्ता)-को नमस्कार है; उमापतिको नमस्कार है। सुवर्णमय नाहुवाले तथा साक्षात् हिरण्यपतिको बार-बार नमस्कार है; शर्व, सर्वरूप तथा पुरुषको बार- बार नमस्कार है । सत्-असत्रूपसे रहित और महत्तत्त्वके उत्पादक आपको नमस्कार है; आप नित्य, विश्वरूप तथा उत्पन्न होनेवालेको नमस्कार है। संसारमें अनेक रूपोंमें अवतार लेनेवाले और प्रभूतको नमस्कार है;
verses.wordMeaning: All Devas, Narayana and others were oppressed, beaten, bound and struck down by him. They became frightened and entered Mandara.
verses.commentary: Sense: All Devas, Narayana and others were oppressed, beaten, bound and struck down by him. They became frightened and entered Mandara.

verses.sanskrit: वरलाभमशेषं च प्रवदामि समासतः हिरण्याक्षस्य तनयो हिरण्यनयनोपमः
verses.transliteration: varalābhamaśeṣaṃ ca pravadāmi samāsataḥ hiraṇyākṣasya tanayo hiraṇyanayanopamaḥ
verses.translation: After afflicting Devas thus, Andhaka the great Asura happened to come casually to the mountain Mandara with charming caves.
verses.hindi: आप रुद्र, नीलरुद्र, कद्रुद्र नामक मन्त्ररूप तथा प्रचेताको नमस्कार है॥ ३७--४०॥
verses.wordMeaning: After afflicting Devas thus, Andhaka the great Asura happened to come casually to the mountain Mandara with charming caves.
verses.commentary: Sense: After afflicting Devas thus, Andhaka the great Asura happened to come casually to the mountain Mandara with charming caves.

verses.sanskrit: पुरान्धक इति ख्यातस् तपसा लब्धविक्रमः प्रसादाद्ब्रह्मणः साक्षाद् अवध्यत्वमवाप्य च
verses.transliteration: purāndhaka iti khyātas tapasā labdhavikramaḥ prasādādbrahmaṇaḥ sākṣād avadhyatvamavāpya ca
verses.translation: Then all those leading Devas including Sadhyas, approached Maheia, the lord of all Devas and said thus: —
verses.hindi: श्रावयेद्वा द्विजान् सर्वान् विष्णुलोके महीयते। तदन्तरे शिवं देवाः सेन्द्राः सब्रह्मकाः प्रभुम् ततो ब्रह्मादयस्तूर्णं॑ संस्तूय परमेश्वरम्
verses.wordMeaning: Then all those leading Devas including Sadhyas, approached Maheia, the lord of all Devas and said thus: —
verses.commentary: Sense: Then all those leading Devas including Sadhyas, approached Maheia, the lord of all Devas and said thus: —

verses.sanskrit: त्रैलोक्यमखिलं भुक्त्वा जित्वा चेन्द्रपुरं पुरा लीलया चाप्रयत्नेन त्रासयामास वासवम्
verses.transliteration: trailokyamakhilaṃ bhuktvā jitvā cendrapuraṃ purā līlayā cāprayatnena trāsayāmāsa vāsavam
verses.translation: On hearing thus of the arrival of the Daitya through this leading Gaoas the lord set out against Andhaka. At that
verses.hindi: आत्मत्राणाय शरणं जग्मुः परमकारणम्। मन्दरस्थं महादेवं क्रीडमानं सहोमया
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing thus of the arrival of the Daitya through this leading Gaoas the lord set out against Andhaka. At that
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing thus of the arrival of the Daitya through this leading Gaoas the lord set out against Andhaka. At that

verses.sanskrit: बाधितास्ताडिता बद्धाः पातितास्तेन ते सुराः विविशुर्मन्दरं भीता नारायणपुरोगमाः
verses.transliteration: bādhitāstāḍitā baddhāḥ pātitāstena te surāḥ viviśurmandaraṃ bhītā nārāyaṇapurogamāḥ
verses.translation: Reducing the entire host of the Asuras to ashes in crores and hundreds of crores, Mahadeva pierced Andhaka with his trident. On seeing that Andhaka was pierced and that his coat of mail of sin had been burnt, Brahma, shouted in joy after bowing down to li2i. On hearing that shout Devas bowed down to the lord and shouted. The sages danced. The Ganas rejoiced.
verses.hindi: सेवितं गणगन्धर्वैः सिद्धैरप्सरसां गणैः। नमस्ते कालकालाय नमस्ते रुद्र मन्यवे। नमः शिवाय रुद्राय शङ्कराय शिवाय ते
verses.wordMeaning: Reducing the entire host of the Asuras to ashes in crores and hundreds of crores, Mahadeva pierced Andhaka with his trident. On seeing that Andhaka was pierced and that his coat of mail of sin had been burnt, Brahma, shouted in joy after bowing down to li2i.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Reducing the entire host of the Asuras to ashes in crores and hundreds of crores, Mahadeva pierced Andhaka with his trident. On seeing that Andhaka was pierced and that his coat of mail of sin had been burnt, Brahma, shouted in joy after bowing down to li2i.…

verses.sanskrit: एवं संपीड्य वै देवान् अन्धको ऽपि महासुरः यदृच्छया गिरिं प्राप्तो मन्दरं चारुकन्दरम्
verses.transliteration: evaṃ saṃpīḍya vai devān andhako 'pi mahāsuraḥ yadṛcchayā giriṃ prāpto mandaraṃ cārukandaram
verses.translation: Then Devas showered plenty of flowers on lord Siva. The whole of the three worlds rejoiced with delight and shouted.
verses.hindi: उग्रोऽसि सर्वभूतानां नियन्तासि शिवोऽसि नः। नमः शिवाय शर्वाय शङ्करायार्तिहारिणे
verses.wordMeaning: Then Devas showered plenty of flowers on lord Siva. The whole of the three worlds rejoiced with delight and shouted.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then Devas showered plenty of flowers on lord Siva. The whole of the three worlds rejoiced with delight and shouted.

verses.sanskrit: ततस्ते समस्ताः सुरेन्द्राः ससाध्याः सुरेशं महेशं पुरेत्याहुरेवम् द्रुतं चाल्पवीर्यप्रभिन्नाङ्गभिन्ना वयं दैत्यराजस्य शस्त्रैर्निकृत्ताः
verses.transliteration: tataste samastāḥ surendrāḥ sasādhyāḥ sureśaṃ maheśaṃ puretyāhurevam drutaṃ cālpavīryaprabhinnāṅgabhinnā vayaṃ daityarājasya śastrairnikṛttāḥ
verses.translation: Transfixed to the trident and burned like a dead body in fire the demon assumed Sattvika emotions and thought thus in his mind.
verses.hindi: मयस्कराय विश्वाय विष्णवे ब्रह्मणे नमः। अन्तकाय नमस्तुभ्यमुमायाः पतये नमः सदसद्ट्यक्तिहीनाय महतः कारणाय ते। नित्याय विश्वरूपाय जायमानाय ते नमः
verses.wordMeaning: Transfixed to the trident and burned like a dead body in fire the demon assumed Sattvika emotions and thought thus in his mind.
verses.commentary: Sense: Transfixed to the trident and burned like a dead body in fire the demon assumed Sattvika emotions and thought thus in his mind.

verses.sanskrit: इतीदमखिलं श्रुत्वा दैत्यागमम् अनौपमम् गणेश्वरैश् च भगवान् अन्धकाभिमुखं ययौ
verses.transliteration: itīdamakhilaṃ śrutvā daityāgamam anaupamam gaṇeśvaraiś ca bhagavān andhakābhimukhaṃ yayau
verses.translation: 'Treviously, lord Mahevara had been propitiated by me in the previous birth since I have been burned now by Siva. Hence, this has come to pass. Otherwise, this does not fit in. He who remembers Rudra even once in his mind at the time of death attains identity with him. Why not then he who remembers many times. Brahma, Visnu, and Devas including Indra seek refuge in him. One shall certainly seek refuge in him alone." After thinking thus, Andhaka, delighted in his mind, eulogised Siva, IiSana who had suppressed him. It was due to the weightiness of his merit that Andhaka could eulogise thus.
verses.hindi: जाताय बहुधा लोके प्रभूताय नमो नमः। रुद्राय नीलरुद्राय कद्रुद्राय प्रचेतसे
verses.wordMeaning: 'Treviously, lord Mahevara had been propitiated by me in the previous birth since I have been burned now by Siva. Hence, this has come to pass. Otherwise, this does not fit in. He who remembers Rudra even once in his mind at the time of death attains identity with him.…
verses.commentary: Sense: 'Treviously, lord Mahevara had been propitiated by me in the previous birth since I have been burned now by Siva. Hence, this has come to pass. Otherwise, this does not fit in. He who remembers Rudra even once in his mind at the time of death attains identity with him.…

verses.sanskrit: तत्रेन्द्रपद्मोद्भवविष्णुमुख्याः सुरेश्वरा विप्रवराश् च सर्वे ।* जयेति वाचा भगवन्तम् ऊचुः किरीटबद्धाञ्जलयः समन्तात्
verses.transliteration: tatrendrapadmodbhavaviṣṇumukhyāḥ sureśvarā vipravarāś ca sarve /* jayeti vācā bhagavantam ūcuḥ kirīṭabaddhāñjalayaḥ samantāt
verses.translation: On being prayed to by him, lord Siva, the lord of Devas, the dispcllcr of dejection, said to Andhaka the son of Hiranyanetra, who was fixed to the tip of the trident. Glancing at the Danava, the lord spoke with mercy.
verses.hindi: फ फ़ फ फ़ छ फ छ फ फ छ फ फ़ फ़ फ फ़ क क फ फ फ फ़ फ़ क फ फ़ फ फ फ फ़ फ फ़ फ़ क फ फ़ फफ फ र का का कमी मी मी मीमी की की मी ज हनन र फफफ कालाय कालरूपाय नमः कालाङ्गहारिणे। मीढुष्टमाय देवाय शितिकण्ठाय ते नमः॥
verses.wordMeaning: On being prayed to by him, lord Siva, the lord of Devas, the dispcllcr of dejection, said to Andhaka the son of Hiranyanetra, who was fixed to the tip of the trident. Glancing at the Danava, the lord spoke with mercy.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being prayed to by him, lord Siva, the lord of Devas, the dispcllcr of dejection, said to Andhaka the son of Hiranyanetra, who was fixed to the tip of the trident. Glancing at the Danava, the lord spoke with mercy.

verses.sanskrit: अथाशेषासुरांस्तस्य कोटिकोटिशतैस् ततः भस्मीकृत्य महादेवो निर्बिभेदान्धकं तदा
verses.transliteration: athāśeṣāsurāṃstasya koṭikoṭiśatais tataḥ bhasmīkṛtya mahādevo nirbibhedāndhakaṃ tadā
verses.translation: ''O dear one, I am delighted with you. Welfare unto you. What cherished desire of yours shall I fulfil. O leading Daitya, O Andhaka, choose the boons. I am known as the best- ower of boons.
verses.hindi: महीयसे नमस्तुभ्यं हन्त्रे देवारिणां सदा। ताराय च सुताराय तारणाय नमो नमः
verses.wordMeaning: ''O dear one, I am delighted with you. Welfare unto you. What cherished desire of yours shall I fulfil. O leading Daitya, O Andhaka, choose the boons. I am known as the best- ower of boons.
verses.commentary: Sense: ''O dear one, I am delighted with you. Welfare unto you. What cherished desire of yours shall I fulfil. O leading Daitya, O Andhaka, choose the boons. I am known as the best- ower of boons.

verses.sanskrit: शूलेन शूलिना प्रोतं दग्धकल्मषकञ्चुकम् दृष्ट्वान्धकं ननादेशं प्रणम्य स पितामहः
verses.transliteration: śūlena śūlinā protaṃ dagdhakalmaṣakañcukam dṛṣṭvāndhakaṃ nanādeśaṃ praṇamya sa pitāmahaḥ
verses.translation: On hearing the words of the lord, the son of Hiraiiya- nayana spoke thus to Maheivara in words choked within, due to excess of delight.
