verses.transliteration: iti śrīliṅgamahāpurāṇe pūrvabhāge andhakagāṇapatyātmako nāma trinavatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ kathamasya pitā daityo hiraṇyākṣaḥ sudāruṇaḥ viṣṇunā sūdito viṣṇur vārāhatvaṃ kathaṃ gataḥ
verses.translation: How was his father the terrible demon Hiraiyaksa, slain by Viu? How did Viu assume the form of a Boar? How did his horn attain the status of an ornament of Mahesa. O Suta, it behoves you to narrate all this to us in detail.
verses.hindi: शुक्रं तु वृत्तं विश्वेश क्रीडा वै केवलं वयम्। तवोन्मेषनिमेषाभ्यामस्माकं प्रलयोदयौ
verses.wordMeaning: How was his father the terrible demon Hiraiyaksa, slain by Viu? How did Viu assume the form of a Boar? How did his horn attain the status of an ornament of Mahesa. O Suta, it behoves you to narrate all this to us in detail.
verses.commentary: Sense: How was his father the terrible demon Hiraiyaksa, slain by Viu? How did Viu assume the form of a Boar? How did his horn attain the status of an ornament of Mahesa. O Suta, it behoves you to narrate all this to us in detail.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य शृङ्गं महेशस्य भूषणत्वं कथं गतम् एतत्सर्वं विशेषेण सूत वक्तुमिहार्हसि
verses.transliteration: tasya śṛṅgaṃ maheśasya bhūṣaṇatvaṃ kathaṃ gatam etatsarvaṃ viśeṣeṇa sūta vaktumihārhasi
verses.translation: The brother of Hiranyakaipu is known as Hirayaka. He was comparable to Kala the destroyer. He was the father of Andhaka the lord of the Asuras.
verses.hindi: उन्मीलये त्वयि ब्रह्मन् विनाशोऽस्ति न ते शिव। सन्तप्ताः स्मो वयं देव हरिणामिततेजसा सर्वलोकहितायैनं तत्त्वं संहर्तुमिच्छसि।
verses.wordMeaning: The brother of Hiranyakaipu is known as Hirayaka. He was comparable to Kala the destroyer. He was the father of Andhaka the lord of the Asuras.
verses.commentary: Sense: The brother of Hiranyakaipu is known as Hirayaka. He was comparable to Kala the destroyer. He was the father of Andhaka the lord of the Asuras.

verses.sanskrit: हिरण्यकशिपोर्भ्राता हिरण्याक्ष इति स्मृतः पुरान्धकासुरेशस्य पिता कालान्तकोपमः
verses.transliteration: hiraṇyakaśiporbhrātā hiraṇyākṣa iti smṛtaḥ purāndhakāsureśasya pitā kālāntakopamaḥ
verses.translation: This leading Daitya defeated all Devas. He bound the earth that has the lustre of blue lotus and took it to Nether regions. He made it his prisoner.
verses.hindi: विज्ञापितस्तथा देवः प्रहसन् प्राह तान् सुरान्
verses.wordMeaning: This leading Daitya defeated all Devas. He bound the earth that has the lustre of blue lotus and took it to Nether regions. He made it his prisoner.
verses.commentary: Sense: This leading Daitya defeated all Devas. He bound the earth that has the lustre of blue lotus and took it to Nether regions. He made it his prisoner.

verses.sanskrit: देवाञ्जित्वाथ दैत्येन्द्रो बद्ध्वा च धरणीमिमाम् नीत्वा रसातलं चक्रे वन्दीम् इन्दीवरप्रभाम्
verses.transliteration: devāñjitvātha daityendro baddhvā ca dharaṇīmimām nītvā rasātalaṃ cakre vandīm indīvaraprabhām
verses.translation: Devas including Brahma were oppressed, struck and bound by this cruel leader of the Daityas, Hiranyaksa, the strong and wicked soul. Their facial splendour became faded. They bowed down their heads to Vinu who formerly had suppressed crorcs of Daityas. They submitted to him the news about the imprisonment of the earth. On hearing this. Lord Vi§rLU assumed the form of Yajftavaraha®* as at the time of the manifestation of the Lihga. With the tip of his curved fangs he killed Hiraiyaka the leading Daitya of great strength. After
verses.hindi: जगाम भगवान् ब्रह्मा तथान्ये च सुरोत्तमाः। अथोत्थाय महादेवः शारभं रूपमास्थितः एवं स्तुतस्तदा देवैर्जगाम स यथाक्रमम्॥
verses.wordMeaning: Devas including Brahma were oppressed, struck and bound by this cruel leader of the Daityas, Hiranyaksa, the strong and wicked soul. Their facial splendour became faded. They bowed down their heads to Vinu who formerly had suppressed crorcs of Daityas.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Devas including Brahma were oppressed, struck and bound by this cruel leader of the Daityas, Hiranyaksa, the strong and wicked soul. Their facial splendour became faded. They bowed down their heads to Vinu who formerly had suppressed crorcs of Daityas.…

verses.sanskrit: ततः सब्रह्मका देवाः परिम्लानमुखश्रियः बाधितास्ताडिता बद्ध्वा हिरण्याक्षेण तेन वै
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sabrahmakā devāḥ parimlānamukhaśriyaḥ bādhitāstāḍitā baddhvā hiraṇyākṣeṇa tena vai
verses.translation: Just as in the beginnings of kalpas before, he enter- ed the Nether regions and brought the earth out of the ocean and made her seated on his lap. Then Brahma, the best of Devas, accompanied by Indra and others eulogised Visnu the lord of Devas with words choked with great emotion.
verses.hindi: रुद्रलोकमनृप्राप्य रुद्रेण सह मोदते
verses.wordMeaning: Just as in the beginnings of kalpas before, he enter- ed the Nether regions and brought the earth out of the ocean and made her seated on his lap. Then Brahma, the best of Devas,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Just as in the beginnings of kalpas before, he enter- ed the Nether regions and brought the earth out of the ocean and made her seated on his lap. Then Brahma, the best of Devas,…

verses.sanskrit: बलिना दैत्यमुख्येन क्रूरेण सुदुरात्मना प्रणम्य शिरसा विष्णुं दैत्यकोटिविमर्दनम्
verses.transliteration: balinā daityamukhyena krūreṇa sudurātmanā praṇamya śirasā viṣṇuṃ daityakoṭivimardanam
verses.translation: O lord of earth, the earth was lifted up by you and held at the tip of your curved fangs, O lord, having the lustre of clouds, O lotus-faced God, served by all the people, all the mountains, all the oceans, and by all Devas and Asuras.
verses.hindi: लिये अनेक प्रमुख हैत्योंसहित हिरण्यकशिपुको अपने तीक्ष्ण नखोंसे स्वयं मारकर सिंहरूपका सम्मान करते हुए सम्पूर्ण जगतको सन्त्रस्त कर रहे हैं; है देवेश! अब इस विषयमें जो उचित कार्य हो, उसे आप आप उग्र हैं, सभी दुष्टोंको नियन्त्रणमें रखनेवाले हैं और हम लोगोंके लिये कल्याणकारक हैं। कालकूट आदि शरीरसे हम शरणागतोंकी रक्षा कीजिये। हे विश्वेश! आपका आचरण शुद्ध है और हम लोग
verses.wordMeaning: O lord of earth, the earth was lifted up by you and held at the tip of your curved fangs, O lord, having the lustre of clouds, O lotus-faced God, served by all the people, all the mountains, all the oceans, and by all Devas and Asuras.
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord of earth, the earth was lifted up by you and held at the tip of your curved fangs, O lord, having the lustre of clouds, O lotus-faced God, served by all the people, all the mountains, all the oceans, and by all Devas and Asuras.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वे विज्ञापयामासुर् धरणीबन्धनं हरेः श्रुत्वैतद्भगवान् विष्णुर् धरणीबन्धनं हरिः
verses.transliteration: sarve vijñāpayāmāsur dharaṇībandhanaṃ hareḥ śrutvaitadbhagavān viṣṇur dharaṇībandhanaṃ hariḥ
verses.translation: O lord, it was by you alone that the victory of the Devas was brought about. Ha! a boon has been given; the goddess of speech has been bestowed on the lotus-born deity, O lord, be pleased.
verses.hindi: आपके क्रीड़ामात्र हैं। आपके उन्मेष तथा निमेषसे हम लोगोंके प्रलय तथा उदय होते हैं। है ब्रह्मन्! है शिव! आपके उन्मीलन करनेपर भी आपका विनाश नहीं होता है। है देव! अमित तेजवाले नूसिंहरूपधारी विष्णुके
verses.wordMeaning: O lord, it was by you alone that the victory of the Devas was brought about. Ha! a boon has been given; the goddess of speech has been bestowed on the lotus-born deity, O lord, be pleased.
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord, it was by you alone that the victory of the Devas was brought about. Ha! a boon has been given; the goddess of speech has been bestowed on the lotus-born deity, O lord, be pleased.

verses.sanskrit: भूत्वा यज्ञवराहो ऽसौ यथा लिङ्गोद्भवे तथा दैत्यैश् च सार्धं दैत्येन्द्रं हिरण्याक्षं महाबलम्
verses.transliteration: bhūtvā yajñavarāho 'sau yathā liṅgodbhave tathā daityaiś ca sārdhaṃ daityendraṃ hiraṇyākṣaṃ mahābalam
verses.translation: All the leading immortal beings find a place in your hairs; the moon and the sun in your eyes; the earth that had been taken to the nether worlds was placed at the pair of your feet. All the constellations find a place on your back.
verses.hindi: द्वारा हमलोग सन्तप्त हो रहे हैं; अतः सभी लोकोंके हितके लिये आप इस नृसिंहरूप-को समाप्त करनेका विचार करें॥ ५५--५७/२॥ सूतजी बोले--इस प्रकार प्रार्थना किये जानेपर प्रभु महादेवने उन देवताओंको अभयदान दिया और मुसकराते हुए उनसे कहा-- मैं उनका संहार करूँगा ।' इसके बाद शिवको प्रणाम करके इन्द्र सभी देवताओंके
verses.wordMeaning: All the leading immortal beings find a place in your hairs; the moon and the sun in your eyes; the earth that had been taken to the nether worlds was placed at the pair of your feet. All the constellations find a place on your back.
verses.commentary: Sense: All the leading immortal beings find a place in your hairs; the moon and the sun in your eyes; the earth that had been taken to the nether worlds was placed at the pair of your feet. All the constellations find a place on your back.

verses.sanskrit: दंष्ट्राग्रकोट्या हत्वैनं रेजे दैत्यान्तकृत्प्रभुः कल्पादिषु यथापूर्वं प्रविश्य च रसातलम्
verses.transliteration: daṃṣṭrāgrakoṭyā hatvainaṃ reje daityāntakṛtprabhuḥ kalpādiṣu yathāpūrvaṃ praviśya ca rasātalam
verses.translation: O lord, O preceptor of the universe, the earth that had been taken to the cavity of the nether regions, has been uplifted by you without the help of any army, for the welfare of the worlds. Everything has been held by you alone.
verses.hindi: साथ जैसे आये थे, वैसे ही चले गये और भगवान् ब्रह्मा तथा अन्य श्रेष्ठ देवता भी चले गये॥ ५८-५९ /२॥
verses.wordMeaning: O lord, O preceptor of the universe, the earth that had been taken to the cavity of the nether regions, has been uplifted by you without the help of any army, for the welfare of the worlds. Everything has been held by you alone.
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord, O preceptor of the universe, the earth that had been taken to the cavity of the nether regions, has been uplifted by you without the help of any army, for the welfare of the worlds. Everything has been held by you alone.

verses.sanskrit: आनीय वसुधां देवीम् अङ्कस्थामकरोद्बहिः ततस् तुष्टाव देवेशं देवदेवः पितामहः
verses.transliteration: ānīya vasudhāṃ devīm aṅkasthāmakarodbahiḥ tatas tuṣṭāva deveśaṃ devadevaḥ pitāmahaḥ
verses.translation: Thus, the lord of speech, Prajapati, bowed down to Vi?nu along with Devas repeating different hymns and wor-
verses.hindi: तदनन्तर वहाँसे उठकर शरभका रूप धारणकर महादेवजी असुरभक्षक गर्वयुक्त नृसिंहके पास पहुँचे। तब प्राणोंका हरण करके वे शरभरूपधारी शिव होकर वे विष्णु बहाँसे चले गये। इस प्रकार उस समय देवताओंसे स्तुत होकर शिवजी भी अपने स्थानको चले गये
verses.wordMeaning: Thus, the lord of speech, Prajapati, bowed down to Vi?nu along with Devas repeating different hymns and wor-
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus, the lord of speech, Prajapati, bowed down to Vi?nu along with Devas repeating different hymns and wor-

verses.sanskrit: शक्राद्यैः सहितो भूत्वा हर्षगद्गदया गिरा शाश्वताय वराहाय दंष्ट्रिणे दण्डिने नमः
verses.transliteration: śakrādyaiḥ sahito bhūtvā harṣagadgadayā girā śāśvatāya varāhāya daṃṣṭriṇe daṇḍine namaḥ
verses.translation: Devas and the leading sages received on their heads the earth that had been uplifted by him. In the presence of the discus-bearing lord they kept the earth on their heads and bowled down to him.
verses.hindi: जो व्यक्ति शिवजीकी इस उत्तम स्तुतिको पढ़ता अथवा सुनता है, वह रुद्र्लोक प्राप्त करके भगवान् रुद्रके साथ आनन्दित रहता है
verses.wordMeaning: Devas and the leading sages received on their heads the earth that had been uplifted by him. In the presence of the discus-bearing lord they kept the earth on their heads and bowled down to him.
verses.commentary: Sense: Devas and the leading sages received on their heads the earth that had been uplifted by him. In the presence of the discus-bearing lord they kept the earth on their heads and bowled down to him.

verses.sanskrit: नारायणाय सर्वाय ब्रह्मणे परमात्मने कर्त्रे धर्त्रे धरायास्तु हर्त्रे देवारिणां स्वयम् कर्त्रे नेत्रे सुरेन्द्राणां शास्त्रे च सकलस्य च
verses.transliteration: nārāyaṇāya sarvāya brahmaṇe paramātmane kartre dhartre dharāyāstu hartre devāriṇāṃ svayam kartre netre surendrāṇāṃ śāstre ca sakalasya ca
verses.translation: earth, O bes tower of boons, you have been fcdeemcd by this Varaha alone, by Krsna, by Vi§nu who has hundreds of hands and whose activities are not strained. O earth, you are highly blessed. O unchanging one, you are an extensive being. O earth, you are the supporter of all the worlds. Dispel our sins.
verses.hindi: य सस्तन छ फ फ फ़ क फ ऊ फ फ़ फ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ फ फ़ क फ़ फ फ़ फ़ फ फ़ फ फ फफफ फ़ फ क फ फफ फक कक मी फ म फीकी की जी अकककफफफफ फफ डक म भगवान् महेश्वरद्वारा वीरभद्रका आवाहन और नूसिंहके तेजको शमन करनेके लिये
verses.wordMeaning: earth, O bes tower of boons, you have been fcdeemcd by this Varaha alone, by Krsna, by Vi§nu who has hundreds of hands and whose activities are not strained. O earth, you are highly blessed. O unchanging one, you are an extensive being. O earth,…
verses.commentary: Sense: earth, O bes tower of boons, you have been fcdeemcd by this Varaha alone, by Krsna, by Vi§nu who has hundreds of hands and whose activities are not strained. O earth, you are highly blessed. O unchanging one, you are an extensive being. O earth,…

verses.sanskrit: त्वमष्टमूर्तिस्त्वमनन्तमूर्तिस् त्वमादिदेवस्त्वमनन्तवेदितः त्वया कृतं सर्वमिदं प्रसीद सुरेश लोकेश वराह विष्णो
verses.transliteration: tvamaṣṭamūrtistvamanantamūrtis tvamādidevastvamanantaveditaḥ tvayā kṛtaṃ sarvamidaṃ prasīda sureśa lokeśa varāha viṣṇo
verses.translation: O lotus-eyed bestower of boons, it is by your favour that we live after our sins have been destroyed by you, mentally, verbally and physically.*'
verses.hindi: भेजना, वीरभद्र तथा नृसिंहका संवाद, भगवान् शिवका शरभावतार धारणकर नृसिंहतेजको शान्त करना एवं नृसिंहद्वारा शिवस्तुति
verses.wordMeaning: O lotus-eyed bestower of boons, it is by your favour that we live after our sins have been destroyed by you, mentally, verbally and physically.*'
verses.commentary: Sense: O lotus-eyed bestower of boons, it is by your favour that we live after our sins have been destroyed by you, mentally, verbally and physically.*'

verses.sanskrit: तथैकदंष्ट्राग्रमुखाग्रकोटिभागैकभागार्धतमेन विष्णो हताः क्षणात् कामद दैत्यमुख्याः स्वदंष्ट्रकोट्या सह पुत्रभृत्यैः
verses.transliteration: tathaikadaṃṣṭrāgramukhāgrakoṭibhāgaikabhāgārdhatamena viṣṇo hatāḥ kṣaṇāt kāmada daityamukhyāḥ svadaṃṣṭrakoṭyā saha putrabhṛtyaiḥ
verses.translation: Bhava, the lord of the universe, who casually went that way, saw that curved fang and took it up for his own embellishment. Mahadeva kept it on his head as well as on his chest. Devas including Indra eulogised Bhava, the lord of Devas.
verses.hindi: कथं देवो महादेवो विश्वसंहारकारकः। शरभाख्यं महाघोरं विकृतं रूपमास्थितः एवमभ्यर्थितो देवैर्मतिं चक्रे कृपालयः
verses.wordMeaning: Bhava, the lord of the universe, who casually went that way, saw that curved fang and took it up for his own embellishment. Mahadeva kept it on his head as well as on his chest. Devas including Indra eulogised Bhava, the lord of Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Bhava, the lord of the universe, who casually went that way, saw that curved fang and took it up for his own embellishment. Mahadeva kept it on his head as well as on his chest. Devas including Indra eulogised Bhava, the lord of Devas.

verses.sanskrit: त्वयोद्धृता देव धरा धरेश धराधराकार धृताग्रदंष्ट्रे धराधरैः सर्वजनैः समुद्रैः सुरासुरैः सेवितचन्द्रवक्त्र
verses.transliteration: tvayoddhṛtā deva dharā dhareśa dharādharākāra dhṛtāgradaṃṣṭre dharādharaiḥ sarvajanaiḥ samudraiḥ surāsuraiḥ sevitacandravaktra
verses.translation: Bhava, the lord of the universe, who casually went that way, saw that curved fang and took it up for his own embellishment. Mahadeva kept it on his head as well as on his chest. Devas including Indra eulogised Bhava, the lord of Devas.
verses.hindi: तदर्थ स्मृतवान् रुद्रो वीरभद्रं महाबलम्
verses.wordMeaning: Bhava, the lord of the universe, who casually went that way, saw that curved fang and took it up for his own embellishment. Mahadeva kept it on his head as well as on his chest. Devas including Indra eulogised Bhava, the lord of Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Bhava, the lord of the universe, who casually went that way, saw that curved fang and took it up for his own embellishment. Mahadeva kept it on his head as well as on his chest. Devas including Indra eulogised Bhava, the lord of Devas.

verses.sanskrit: त्वयैव देवेश विभो कृतश् च जयः सुराणामसुरेश्वराणाम् अहो प्रदत्तस्तु वरः प्रसीद वाग्देवता वारिजसंभवाय
verses.transliteration: tvayaiva deveśa vibho kṛtaś ca jayaḥ surāṇāmasureśvarāṇām aho pradattastu varaḥ prasīda vāgdevatā vārijasaṃbhavāya
verses.translation: Bhava, the lord of the universe, who casually went that way, saw that curved fang and took it up for his own embellishment. Mahadeva kept it on his head as well as on his chest. Devas including Indra eulogised Bhava, the lord of Devas.
verses.hindi: आत्मनो भेरवं रूपं महाप्रलयकारकम्। आजगाम पुरा सद्यो गणानामग्रतो हसन् नृसिंहरूपैरत्युग्रैः कोटिभिः परिवारितः
verses.wordMeaning: Bhava, the lord of the universe, who casually went that way, saw that curved fang and took it up for his own embellishment. Mahadeva kept it on his head as well as on his chest. Devas including Indra eulogised Bhava, the lord of Devas.

verses.sanskrit: तव रोम्णि सकलामरेश्वरानयनद्वये शशिरवी पदद्वये ।* निहिता रसातलगता वसुंधरा तव पृष्ठतः सकलतारकादयः

verses.sanskrit: अथ तामुद्धृतां तेन धरां देवा मुनीश्वराः मूर्ध्न्यारोप्य नमश्चक्रुश् चक्रिणः संनिधौ तदा

verses.hindi: ऋषिगण बोले--हे सूतजी! विश्वका संहा करनेवाले भगवान् महादेवने अत्यन्त भयंकर तथा विकृत शरभनामक रूप कैसे धारण किया और उन्होने कौन-सा साहसपूर्ण कृत्य किया; यह सब पूर्णरूपसे सूतजी बोले--इस प्रकार देवताओंके प्रार्थना करनेपर कृपानिधान शिवने नूसिंहसंज्ञक तेजको नष्ट करनेका निश्चय किया और इसके लिये रुद्रने महाप्रलय करनेवाले अपने भैरवरूप महाबली वीरभद्रका स्मरण

verses.sanskrit: अनेनैव वराहेण चोद्धृतासि वरप्रदे कृष्णेनाक्लिष्टकार्येण शतहस्तेन विष्णुना
verses.transliteration: anenaiva varāheṇa coddhṛtāsi varaprade kṛṣṇenākliṣṭakāryeṇa śatahastena viṣṇunā

verses.hindi: तब वे वीरभद्र गणोंके आगे होकर हँसते हुए शीघ्र ही वहाँ आये। वे करोड़ों श्रेष्ठ गणोंसे घिरे हुए थे, जो अट्टहास कर रहे थे, इधर-उधर उछल रहे थे, नृसिंहके रूपवाले थे तथा अत्यन्त उग्र थे। वे नृत्य करते
verses.wordMeaning: Bhava, the lord of the universe, who casually went that way, saw that curved fang and took it up for his own embellishment. Mahadeva kept it on his head as well as on his chest. Devas including Indra eulogised Bhava, the lord of Devas.

verses.sanskrit: धरणि त्वं महाभोगे भूमिस्त्वं धेनुरव्यये लोकानां धारिणी त्वं हि मृत्तिके हर पातकम्
verses.transliteration: dharaṇi tvaṃ mahābhoge bhūmistvaṃ dhenuravyaye lokānāṃ dhāriṇī tvaṃ hi mṛttike hara pātakam
verses.translation: Bhava, the lord of the universe, who casually went that way, saw that curved fang and took it up for his own embellishment. Mahadeva kept it on his head as well as on his chest. Devas including Indra eulogised Bhava, the lord of Devas.
verses.hindi: हुए तथा महाधीर ब्रह्मा आदिके साथ गेंदकी भाँति खेलते हुए प्रसन्न वीरोंसे घिरे हुए थे। वे वीरवनद् वीरभद्र कभी न देखे गये अन्य वीरोंसे भी आवृत थे। वे वीरभद्र प्रलयाग्निकी ज्वालाके समान थे, वे तीन नेत्रोंसे विभूषित थे, वे शस्त्र धारण किये हुए धे, उनके जटाजूटमें देदीप्यमान बालचन्द्रमा शोभा दे रहा था, वे बालचन्द्रके समान आकारवाले अति शुभ्र तथा तीक्ष्ण दो दाँतोंसे सुशोभित थे, वे इन्द्रधनुषके समान

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मणश् च तथान्येषां देवानामपि लीलया विभुरङ्गविभागेन भूषितो न यदि प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: brahmaṇaś ca tathānyeṣāṃ devānāmapi līlayā vibhuraṅgavibhāgena bhūṣito na yadi prabhuḥ
verses.translation: Bhava, the lord of the universe, who casually went that way, saw that curved fang and took it up for his own embellishment. Mahadeva kept it on his head as well as on his chest. Devas including Indra eulogised Bhava, the lord of Devas.
verses.hindi: उससे वह शान्त नहीं होती है, तब मेरे महाभयंकर भैरवरूपको दिखाओ। है वीरभद्र! मेरी आज्ञासे सूक्ष्मरूपको सूक्ष्म तेजसे तथा स्थूलरूपको स्थूल तेजसे विनष्ट करके उसके मुख तथा उसकी त्वचाको मेरे पास
verses.wordMeaning: Bhava, the lord of the universe, who casually went that way, saw that curved fang and took it up for his own embellishment. Mahadeva kept it on his head as well as on his chest. Devas including Indra eulogised Bhava, the lord of Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Bhava, the lord of the universe, who casually went that way, saw that curved fang and took it up for his own embellishment. Mahadeva kept it on his head as well as on his chest. Devas including Indra eulogised Bhava, the lord of Devas.

verses.sanskrit: कथं विमुक्तिर्विप्राणां तस्माद्दंष्ट्री महेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: kathaṃ vimuktirviprāṇāṃ tasmāddaṃṣṭrī maheśvaraḥ
verses.translation: Bhava, the lord of the universe, who casually went that way, saw that curved fang and took it up for his own embellishment. Mahadeva kept it on his head as well as on his chest. Devas including Indra eulogised Bhava, the lord of Devas.
verses.hindi: इस प्रकार आज्ञा प्राप्त किये हुए गणेश्वर वीरभद्र शान्तस्वरूप धारण करके वेगपूर्वक वहाँ पहुँच गये, जहाँ नृसिंह विराजमान थे। तदनन्तर भगवान् वीरभद्रने नृसिंहरूपधारी उन विष्णुको समझाया और जैसे पिता औरस पुत्रसे कहता है, उसी प्रकार ईशान वीरभद्र उनसे यह वचन कहने लगे॥ १५-१६ /२॥
verses.wordMeaning: Bhava, the lord of the universe, who casually went that way, saw that curved fang and took it up for his own embellishment. Mahadeva kept it on his head as well as on his chest. Devas including Indra eulogised Bhava, the lord of Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Bhava, the lord of the universe, who casually went that way, saw that curved fang and took it up for his own embellishment. Mahadeva kept it on his head as well as on his chest. Devas including Indra eulogised Bhava, the lord of Devas.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीलिङ्गमहापुराणे पूर्वभागे वराहप्रादुर्भावो नाम चतुर्नवतितमो ऽध्यायः नृसिंहेन हतः पूर्वं हिरण्याक्षाग्रजः श्रुतम् कथं निषूदितस्तेन हिरण्यकशिपुर्वद
verses.transliteration: iti śrīliṅgamahāpurāṇe pūrvabhāge varāhaprādurbhāvo nāma caturnavatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ nṛsiṃhena hataḥ pūrvaṃ hiraṇyākṣāgrajaḥ śrutam kathaṃ niṣūditastena hiraṇyakaśipurvada
verses.translation: It is heard that I iirariy'\kasipu the elder brother of Hiranyaksa was iormerly killed by Nrsiriiha. How was he killed by him, kindly tell us.
verses.hindi: श्रीवीरभद्र बोले--हे भगवन्! है माधव! आप तो जगत्के सुखके लिये अवतीर्ण हुए हैं; श्रेष्ठ ब्रह्मने संसारकी स्थितिके कार्यमें आपको लगाया है। पूर्वकालमें अपनी पूँछमें नावको बाँधकर विशाल
verses.wordMeaning: It is heard that I iirariy'\kasipu the elder brother of Hiranyaksa was iormerly killed by Nrsiriiha. How was he killed by him, kindly tell us.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is heard that I iirariy'\kasipu the elder brother of Hiranyaksa was iormerly killed by Nrsiriiha. How was he killed by him, kindly tell us.

verses.sanskrit: हिरण्यकशिपोः पुत्रः प्रह्राद इति विश्रुतः धर्मज्ञः सत्यसम्पन्नस् तपस्वी चाभवत्सुधीः
verses.transliteration: hiraṇyakaśipoḥ putraḥ prahrāda iti viśrutaḥ dharmajñaḥ satyasampannas tapasvī cābhavatsudhīḥ
verses.translation: I he son of Hii anyakasi])ii was known bv the name Prahlada. He was conversant with virtue endowee with truth- lulncss, asceticism and intelligence.
verses.hindi: सागरमें भ्रमण करते हुए मत्स्यरूपधारी आप भगवान् विष्णु-ने जीव-समुदायकी रक्षा की थी। आप कूर्मके रूपसे जगत्को धारण करते हैं और वाराहरूपके द्वारा आपने पृथ्वीका उद्धार किया है। आपने इस सिंहरूपसे हिरण्यकशिपुका वध किया है। आपने वामनरूप धारणकर तीन पगोंद्वारा त्रिलोकोको मापकर बलिको बाँध लिया था
verses.wordMeaning: I he son of Hii anyakasi])ii was known bv the name Prahlada. He was conversant with virtue endowee with truth- lulncss, asceticism and intelligence.
verses.commentary: Sense: I he son of Hii anyakasi])ii was known bv the name Prahlada. He was conversant with virtue endowee with truth- lulncss, asceticism and intelligence.

verses.sanskrit: जन्मप्रभृति देवेशं पूजयामास चाव्ययम् सर्वज्ञं सर्वगं विष्णुं सर्वदेवभवोद्भवम्
verses.transliteration: janmaprabhṛti deveśaṃ pūjayāmāsa cāvyayam sarvajñaṃ sarvagaṃ viṣṇuṃ sarvadevabhavodbhavam
verses.translation: Ever since his birth he devoutly worshipped the unchanging omniscieiil Visnn who is lord of Devas, who is omni- present, who is the cause ol origin of all Devas, who is the primordial Purusa, who has the form of Brahman, who is the overlord of Brahma and who is the cause of creation, susten- ance and annihilation.
verses.hindi: आप ही सभी प्राणियोंको उत्पन्न करनेवाले, सबके स्वामी और अविनाशी हैं। जब-जब संसारपर कोई विपत्ति पड़ी है, तब-तब आपने अवतार लेकर उसे दुःखरहित किया है। है हरे! है शिवपरायण!
verses.wordMeaning: Ever since his birth he devoutly worshipped the unchanging omniscieiil Visnn who is lord of Devas, who is omni- present, who is the cause ol origin of all Devas, who is the primordial Purusa, who has the form of Brahman,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Ever since his birth he devoutly worshipped the unchanging omniscieiil Visnn who is lord of Devas, who is omni- present, who is the cause ol origin of all Devas, who is the primordial Purusa, who has the form of Brahman,…

verses.sanskrit: तमादिपुरुषं भक्त्या परब्रह्मस्वरूपिणम् ब्रह्मणो ऽधिपतिं सृष्टिस्थितिसंहारकारणम्

verses.sanskrit: सो ऽपि विष्णोस्तथाभूतं दृष्ट्वा पुत्रं समाहितम् नमो नारायणायेति गोविन्देति मुहुर्मुहुः
verses.transliteration: so 'pi viṣṇostathābhūtaṃ dṛṣṭvā putraṃ samāhitam namo nārāyaṇāyeti govindeti muhurmuhuḥ
verses.translation: O Prahlada, listen to me if you have any desire to be alive."
verses.hindi: ततोऽधिकं महाघोरं कोपं प्रज्चालयद्धरिः
verses.wordMeaning: O Prahlada, listen to me if you have any desire to be alive."
verses.commentary: Sense: O Prahlada, listen to me if you have any desire to be alive."

verses.sanskrit: स्तुवन्तं प्राह देवारिः प्रदहन्निव पापधीः न मां जानासि दुर्बुद्धे सर्वदैत्यामरेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: stuvantaṃ prāha devāriḥ pradahanniva pāpadhīḥ na māṃ jānāsi durbuddhe sarvadaityāmareśvaram
verses.translation: Thus ordered by that Daitya of extremely wicked heart, Danavas hit and struck the undaunted Prahlada who considered himself a servant of the lord of Devas.
verses.hindi: शासितं मम सर्वत्र शास्ता कोऽपि न विद्यते मदंशाः शक्तिसम्पन्ना ब्रह्मशक्रादयः सुराः
verses.wordMeaning: Thus ordered by that Daitya of extremely wicked heart, Danavas hit and struck the undaunted Prahlada who considered himself a servant of the lord of Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus ordered by that Daitya of extremely wicked heart, Danavas hit and struck the undaunted Prahlada who considered himself a servant of the lord of Devas.

verses.sanskrit: प्रह्राद वीर दुष्पुत्र द्विजदेवार्तिकारणम् को विष्णुः पद्मजो वापि शक्रश् च वरुणो ऽथवा
verses.transliteration: prahrāda vīra duṣputra dvijadevārtikāraṇam ko viṣṇuḥ padmajo vāpi śakraś ca varuṇo 'thavā
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, w'hat had been evilly perpetrated then by tliose Asuras on the son of the king of Daityas became futile, thanks to the brilliance of the lord who lies down in the milk ocean.
verses.hindi: मन्नाभिपङ्कजाज्जातः पुरा ब्रह्मा चतुर्मुखः। तल्ललाटसमुत्पन्नो भगवान् वृषभध्वजः
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent brahmins, w'hat had been evilly perpetrated then by tliose Asuras on the son of the king of Daityas became futile, thanks to the brilliance of the lord who lies down in the milk ocean.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent brahmins, w'hat had been evilly perpetrated then by tliose Asuras on the son of the king of Daityas became futile, thanks to the brilliance of the lord who lies down in the milk ocean.

verses.sanskrit: वायुः सोमस्तथेशानः पावको मम यः समः मामेवार्चय भक्त्या च स्वल्पं नारायणं सदा
verses.transliteration: vāyuḥ somastatheśānaḥ pāvako mama yaḥ samaḥ māmevārcaya bhaktyā ca svalpaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ sadā
verses.translation: In order to kill Hiranyakasipu who was furious due to his haughtiness, the lord assumed the form of the man-lion and manifested himself there itself. Glancing at the son kindly he hit the father the base Danava. At the very same moment he split him with his sharp daws.
verses.hindi: रजसाधिष्ठितः स्त्रष्टा रुद्रस्तामस उच्यते। अहं नियन्ता सर्वस्य मत्परं नास्ति हैवतम् विश्वाधिकः स्वतन्त्रश्च कर्ता हर्ताखिलेश्वरः ।
verses.wordMeaning: In order to kill Hiranyakasipu who was furious due to his haughtiness, the lord assumed the form of the man-lion and manifested himself there itself. Glancing at the son kindly he hit the father the base Danava. At the very same moment he split him with his sharp daws.
verses.commentary: Sense: In order to kill Hiranyakasipu who was furious due to his haughtiness, the lord assumed the form of the man-lion and manifested himself there itself. Glancing at the son kindly he hit the father the base Danava. At the very same moment he split him with his sharp daws.

verses.sanskrit: प्रह्राद जीविते वाञ्छा तवैषा शृणु चास्ति चेत् श्रुत्वापि तस्य वचनं हिरण्यकशिपोः सुधीः
verses.transliteration: prahrāda jīvite vāñchā tavaiṣā śṛṇu cāsti cet śrutvāpi tasya vacanaṃ hiraṇyakaśipoḥ sudhīḥ
verses.translation: Then, the dispeller of sins killed that Daitya along w'ith his kinsmen. Like a fire of annihilation at the dose of yugas he harassed the leading Daitya.
verses.hindi: कालोऽस्म्यहं कालविनाशहेतु- लोकान् समाहर्तुमहं प्रवृत्त: ।
verses.wordMeaning: Then, the dispeller of sins killed that Daitya along w'ith his kinsmen. Like a fire of annihilation at the dose of yugas he harassed the leading Daitya.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then, the dispeller of sins killed that Daitya along w'ith his kinsmen. Like a fire of annihilation at the dose of yugas he harassed the leading Daitya.

verses.sanskrit: प्रह्रादः पूजयामास नमो नारायणेति च नमो नारायणायेति सर्वदैत्यकुमारकान्
verses.transliteration: prahrādaḥ pūjayāmāsa namo nārāyaṇeti ca namo nārāyaṇāyeti sarvadaityakumārakān
verses.translation: O brahmins of good holy rites, the entire universe be- came terrified due to the terrible roar of Nrsimha. All the worlds beginning.with the world of Brahma trembled.
verses.hindi: जीवन्त्येते मत्प्रसादेन देवाः साहङ्कारमिदं श्रुत्वा हरेरमितविक्रमः। विहस्योवाच सावज्ञं ततो विस्फुरिताधरः
verses.wordMeaning: O brahmins of good holy rites, the entire universe be- came terrified due to the terrible roar of Nrsimha. All the worlds beginning.with the world of Brahma trembled.
verses.commentary: Sense: O brahmins of good holy rites, the entire universe be- came terrified due to the terrible roar of Nrsimha. All the worlds beginning.with the world of Brahma trembled.

verses.sanskrit: अध्यापयामास च तां ब्रह्मविद्यां सुशोभनाम् दुर्लङ्घ्यां चात्मनो दृष्ट्वा शक्रादिभिर् अपि स्वयम्
verses.transliteration: adhyāpayāmāsa ca tāṃ brahmavidyāṃ suśobhanām durlaṅghyāṃ cātmano dṛṣṭvā śakrādibhir api svayam
verses.translation: On seeing Nrsirhha, Devas, Asuras, Nagas, Siddhas, Sadhyas, Visnu, Brahma and others left olf their courage and strength and went off' in different directions in order to pro- tect their lives. When they had gone, the lord Nrsimha who had a thousand shapes, who had all feet and all arms, wlio had a thousand eyes, whose three eyes were the moon, sun and fire, who was the wieldcr of Maya remained there enveloping every thing. The excellent Devas who were stationed on the Lokaloka accompanied by Brahma, Siddhas, Yama and the Maruts, eulogised him.
verses.hindi: अतः है भगवन्! है विश्वात्मन् । है नरसिंह उपस्थितिमें अपने इस अत्यन्त भयानक लीजिये
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing Nrsirhha, Devas, Asuras, Nagas, Siddhas, Sadhyas, Visnu, Brahma and others left olf their courage and strength and went off' in different directions in order to pro- tect their lives. When they had gone, the lord Nrsimha who had a thousand shapes,…
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing Nrsirhha, Devas, Asuras, Nagas, Siddhas, Sadhyas, Visnu, Brahma and others left olf their courage and strength and went off' in different directions in order to pro- tect their lives. When they had gone, the lord Nrsimha who had a thousand shapes,…

verses.sanskrit: पुत्रेण लङ्घितामाज्ञां हिरण्यः प्राह दानवान् एतं नानाविधैर्वध्यं दुष्पुत्रं हन्तुमर्हथ
verses.transliteration: putreṇa laṅghitāmājñāṃ hiraṇyaḥ prāha dānavān etaṃ nānāvidhairvadhyaṃ duṣputraṃ hantumarhatha
verses.translation: You arc the Brahman that is greater than the greatest. You are the greatest of realities. You are the greatest splendour among all luminaries. You are the greatest Atman. You are identical with the universe.
verses.hindi: सूतजी बोले वीरभद्रके द्वारा शान्त वाणीने प्रकार कहे जानेपर नृसिंहरूपधारी विष्णुने पहलेसे र
verses.wordMeaning: You arc the Brahman that is greater than the greatest. You are the greatest of realities. You are the greatest splendour among all luminaries. You are the greatest Atman. You are identical with the universe.
verses.commentary: Sense: You arc the Brahman that is greater than the greatest. You are the greatest of realities. You are the greatest splendour among all luminaries. You are the greatest Atman. You are identical with the universe.

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्तास्तदा तेन दैत्येन सुदुरात्मना निजघ्नुर्देवदेवस्य भृत्यं प्रह्रादमव्ययम्
verses.transliteration: evamuktāstadā tena daityena sudurātmanā nijaghnurdevadevasya bhṛtyaṃ prahrādamavyayam
verses.translation: You ure the partaker of sacrifices of sacrificers. You are the lord bestowing fruits on those who perform sacrifices. You assume the form of a fish.®' You are stationed in the universe after assuming the form of a tortoise.®'®
verses.hindi: अधिक तथा महाभयानक कोपको प्रज्वलित किया
verses.wordMeaning: You ure the partaker of sacrifices of sacrificers. You are the lord bestowing fruits on those who perform sacrifices. You assume the form of a fish.®' You are stationed in the universe after assuming the form of a tortoise.®'®
verses.commentary: Sense: You ure the partaker of sacrifices of sacrificers. You are the lord bestowing fruits on those who perform sacrifices. You assume the form of a fish.®' You are stationed in the universe after assuming the form of a tortoise.®'®

verses.sanskrit: तत्र तत्प्रतिकृतं तदा सुरैर् दैत्यराजतनयं द्विजोत्तमाः क्षीरवारिनिधिशायिनः प्रभोर् निष्फलं त्वथ बभूव तेजसा
verses.transliteration: tatra tatpratikṛtaṃ tadā surair daityarājatanayaṃ dvijottamāḥ kṣīravārinidhiśāyinaḥ prabhor niṣphalaṃ tvatha babhūva tejasā
verses.translation: You have assumed the forms of the Boar and the lion for saving the kingdom of Devas by killing the lord of Daityas.
verses.hindi: आये हो, वहाँ चले जाओ; हितकी बात मत बोलो।मै  इस समय इस चराचर जगतूका संहार कर
verses.wordMeaning: You have assumed the forms of the Boar and the lion for saving the kingdom of Devas by killing the lord of Daityas.
verses.commentary: Sense: You have assumed the forms of the Boar and the lion for saving the kingdom of Devas by killing the lord of Daityas.

verses.sanskrit: तदाथ गर्वभिन्नस्य हिरण्यकशिपोः प्रभुः तत्रैवाविरभूद्धन्तुं नृसिंहाकृतिमास्थितः
verses.transliteration: tadātha garvabhinnasya hiraṇyakaśipoḥ prabhuḥ tatraivāvirabhūddhantuṃ nṛsiṃhākṛtimāsthitaḥ
verses.translation: Under the pretext of the curse of brahmin (i.e. Bhrgu) you sportingly incarnated on the earth. Noth.ig is seen as distinctly different from you. You are the whole universe con- sisting of the mobile and immobile beings.
verses.hindi: श्रीयुक्त तथा ऊर्जासे परिपूर्ण है, उसे मेरे ही तेजसे  परिवधित जानो। देवताओंके परम अर्थको जाननेवाले  मेरे महान् सामर्थ्यको जानते हैं। शक्तिसम्पन्न ब्रह्मा, इद्र  आदि देवता मेरे ही अंश हैं। पूर्वकालमें चतुर्मुख ब्रह्म
verses.wordMeaning: Under the pretext of the curse of brahmin (i.e. Bhrgu) you sportingly incarnated on the earth. Noth.ig is seen as distinctly different from you. You are the whole universe con- sisting of the mobile and immobile beings.
verses.commentary: Sense: Under the pretext of the curse of brahmin (i.e. Bhrgu) you sportingly incarnated on the earth. Noth.ig is seen as distinctly different from you. You are the whole universe con- sisting of the mobile and immobile beings.

verses.sanskrit: जघान च सुतं प्रेक्ष्य पितरं दानवाधमम् बिभेद तत्क्षणादेव करजैर् निशितैः शतैः
verses.transliteration: jaghāna ca sutaṃ prekṣya pitaraṃ dānavādhamam bibheda tatkṣaṇādeva karajair niśitaiḥ śataiḥ
verses.translation: You alone arc the universe. O lord, of what avail is mere prattling. C) lord, that which is non*dualistic is stationed m manifold wa.s, due to Maya.
verses.hindi: मेरे नाभिकमलसे उत्पन्न हुए थे और उनके ललाट्से  भगवान् वृषभध्वज (शिव) उत्पन्न हुए थे ब्रा रजोगुणसे अधिष्ठित हैं। रुद्र तमोगुणसे युक्त कहे जाते हैं। मैं सबका नियन्ता हूँ; मुझसे श्रेष्ठ कोई देवता नहीं है। मैं सबसे बढ़कर हूँ, स्वतन्त्र हूं सबका स्रष्टा हूँ, संहार करनेवाला हुँ तथा सबका स्वामी
verses.wordMeaning: You alone arc the universe. O lord, of what avail is mere prattling. C) lord, that which is non*dualistic is stationed m manifold wa.s, due to Maya.
verses.commentary: Sense: You alone arc the universe. O lord, of what avail is mere prattling. C) lord, that which is non*dualistic is stationed m manifold wa.s, due to Maya.

verses.sanskrit: ततो निहत्य तं दैत्यं सबान्धवमघापहः पीडयामास दैत्येन्द्रं युगान्ताग्निरिवापरः
verses.transliteration: tato nihatya taṃ daityaṃ sabāndhavamaghāpahaḥ pīḍayāmāsa daityendraṃ yugāntāgnirivāparaḥ
verses.translation: Hosv shall we eulogise you? O lord of the paus! O lord of Devas, how you shine!"
verses.hindi: हूँ। मेरे इस नृसिंह नामक परम तेजके विषयमें कौन सुनना चाहता है? अत: मेरी शरण प्राप्त करके तुम संतापरहित होकर यहाँसे जाओ; भूतोंके महेश्वर तुम मेरे इस परम भावको समझो ॥ ३२--३४॥
verses.wordMeaning: Hosv shall we eulogise you? O lord of the paus! O lord of Devas, how you shine!"
verses.commentary: Sense: Hosv shall we eulogise you? O lord of the paus! O lord of Devas, how you shine!"

verses.sanskrit: नादैस्तस्य नृसिंहस्य घोरैर्वित्रासितं जगत् आ ब्रह्मभुवनाद् विप्राः प्रचचाल च सुव्रताः
verses.transliteration: nādaistasya nṛsiṃhasya ghorairvitrāsitaṃ jagat ā brahmabhuvanād viprāḥ pracacāla ca suvratāḥ
verses.translation: In the meantime, Devas including Indra and Brahma came to loril fiiva and eulogised him after informing him about the activities of Visnu who assumed the form of a beast (Lion). I'hen Brahma and others eulogised Paramesvara. They sought refuge in him who is the great cause, lor saving their souls. Accompanied by Devas and e'tremely afraid, Brahma eulogised Paramesvara Mahadeva wtio was staying on the Mandara mountain sporting with Uina and who was served by

verses.wordMeaning: In the meantime, Devas including Indra and Brahma came to loril fiiva and eulogised him after informing him about the activities of Visnu who assumed the form of a beast (Lion). I'hen Brahma and others eulogised Paramesvara. They sought refuge in him who is the great cause,…
verses.commentary: Sense: In the meantime, Devas including Indra and Brahma came to loril fiiva and eulogised him after informing him about the activities of Visnu who assumed the form of a beast (Lion). I'hen Brahma and others eulogised Paramesvara. They sought refuge in him who is the great cause,…

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा सुरासुरमहोरगसिद्धसाध्यास् तस्मिन् क्षणे हरिविरिञ्चिमुखा नृसिंहम् धैर्यं बलं च समवाप्य ययुर्विसृज्य आ दिङ्मुखान्तम् असुरक्षणतत्पराश् च
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvā surāsuramahoragasiddhasādhyās tasmin kṣaṇe hariviriñcimukhā nṛsiṃham dhairyaṃ balaṃ ca samavāpya yayurvisṛjya ā diṅmukhāntam asurakṣaṇatatparāś ca
verses.translation: Obeisance to Mayaskara,®'" obeisance to Visva, to Visnu, to Brahma; obeisanc<' to you the destroyer; obeisance to the lord of Uma.
verses.hindi: संहारकर्ताका संहार अपनेसे अथवा दूसरेसे भी नहीं हो  सकता है। सभी जगह मेरा ही शासन है; अन्य कोई  भी शासन करनेवाला नहीं है। मेरी कृपासे सम्पूर्ण जग्  मर्यादायुक्त होकर क्रियाशील है; मैं ही सभी शक्तियोंका
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to Mayaskara,®'" obeisance to Visva, to Visnu, to Brahma; obeisanc<' to you the destroyer; obeisance to the lord of Uma.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to Mayaskara,®'" obeisance to Visva, to Visnu, to Brahma; obeisanc<' to you the destroyer; obeisance to the lord of Uma.

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तैर्गतैः सैष देवो नृसिंहः सहस्राकृतिः सर्वपात् सर्वबाहुः सहस्रेक्षणः सोमसूर्याग्निनेत्रस् तदा संस्थितः सर्वमावृत्य मायी
verses.transliteration: tatastairgataiḥ saiṣa devo nṛsiṃhaḥ sahasrākṛtiḥ sarvapāt sarvabāhuḥ sahasrekṣaṇaḥ somasūryāgninetras tadā saṃsthitaḥ sarvamāvṛtya māyī
verses.translation: Obeisance to Hiranyabahu (one with golden arms); obeisance to the lord of Hiranya (gold); obeisance to farva,®® having all forms; obeisance to Purusa.
verses.hindi: अध्याय ९६1 ह. भावान नहर वीरभद्रका आवाहन"नुसिंहद्वारा शिवस्तुति ५०५ त गावही कर तिरस्कारपूर्ण भावसे हँसकर नृसिंहसे कहने किं न जानासि विश्वेशं संहर्तार पिनाकिनम्। लगे
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to Hiranyabahu (one with golden arms); obeisance to the lord of Hiranya (gold); obeisance to farva,®® having all forms; obeisance to Purusa.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to Hiranyabahu (one with golden arms); obeisance to the lord of Hiranya (gold); obeisance to farva,®® having all forms; obeisance to Purusa.

verses.sanskrit: तं तुष्टुवुः सुरश्रेष्ठा लोका लोकाचले स्थिताः सब्रह्मकाः ससाध्याश् च सयमाः समरुद्गणाः
verses.transliteration: taṃ tuṣṭuvuḥ suraśreṣṭhā lokā lokācale sthitāḥ sabrahmakāḥ sasādhyāś ca sayamāḥ samarudgaṇāḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance unto one devoid of distinction between 'Sat' and 'Asat'; obeisance unto you the cause of 'mahat'; obeisance to the permanent Being of the form of the universe that is being born.
verses.hindi: असद्वादो विवादश्च विनाशस्त्वयि केवलः॥ ३७ श्रीवीरभद्र बोले क्या आप संहारकर्ता, पिनाकधारी विश्वेश्वर (शिव)-को नहीं जानते हैं? मिथ्या वाद- तबान्योन्यावताराणि कानि शेषाणि साम्प्रतम्। विवाद आपके लिये केवल विनाशस्वरूप ही है। जिस
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance unto one devoid of distinction between 'Sat' and 'Asat'; obeisance unto you the cause of 'mahat'; obeisance to the permanent Being of the form of the universe that is being born.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance unto one devoid of distinction between 'Sat' and 'Asat'; obeisance unto you the cause of 'mahat'; obeisance to the permanent Being of the form of the universe that is being born.

verses.sanskrit: परात्परतरं ब्रह्म तत्त्वात् तत्त्वतमं भवान् ज्योतिषां तु परं ज्योतिः परमात्मा जगन्मयः
verses.transliteration: parātparataraṃ brahma tattvāt tattvatamaṃ bhavān jyotiṣāṃ tu paraṃ jyotiḥ paramātmā jaganmayaḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance unto one born in many wa>s; obeisance unto the ])lentiful being; obeisance to Rudra; obeisance to Nilarudra; toKadrudra; obeisance to Pracetas.
verses.hindi: कृतानि येन केनापि कथाशेषो भविष्यति प्रकृतिस्त्वं पुमान् रुद्रस्त्वयि वीर्य समाहितम्।
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance unto one born in many wa>s; obeisance unto the ])lentiful being; obeisance to Rudra; obeisance to Nilarudra; toKadrudra; obeisance to Pracetas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance unto one born in many wa>s; obeisance unto the ])lentiful being; obeisance to Rudra; obeisance to Nilarudra; toKadrudra; obeisance to Pracetas.

verses.sanskrit: स्थूलं सूक्ष्मं सुसूक्ष्मं च शब्दब्रह्ममयः शुभः वागतीतो निरालंबो निर्द्वन्द्वो निरुपप्लवः
verses.transliteration: sthūlaṃ sūkṣmaṃ susūkṣmaṃ ca śabdabrahmamayaḥ śubhaḥ vāgatīto nirālaṃbo nirdvandvo nirupaplavaḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to Kala of dark complexion; obeisanc e to the destroyer of Kala; obeisance to lord Midhustama®'® (bounti- ful ): obeisance to you Sitikantha (blue-nccked).
verses.hindi: सृष्ट्यर्थन जगत्पूर्वं शङ्करं नीललोहितम्। ललाटे चिन्तयामास तपस्युग्रे व्यवस्थित:
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to Kala of dark complexion; obeisanc e to the destroyer of Kala; obeisance to lord Midhustama®'® (bounti- ful ): obeisance to you Sitikantha (blue-nccked).
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to Kala of dark complexion; obeisanc e to the destroyer of Kala; obeisance to lord Midhustama®'® (bounti- ful ): obeisance to you Sitikantha (blue-nccked).

verses.sanskrit: यज्ञभुग्यज्ञमूर्तिस्त्वं यज्ञिनां फलदः प्रभुः भवान्मत्स्याकृतिः कौर्मम् आस्थाय जगति स्थितः
verses.transliteration: yajñabhugyajñamūrtistvaṃ yajñināṃ phaladaḥ prabhuḥ bhavānmatsyākṛtiḥ kaurmam āsthāya jagati sthitaḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to you the great one; to the perpetual destroyer of Daityas; obeisance to Tara®®® (redeemer) and to Sutara (the excellent redeemer); obeisance to 'Parana (one engaged in redeeming sinners).
verses.hindi: अंशोऽहं देवदेवस्य महाभैरवरूपिणः अहङ्कारावलेपेन गर्जसि त्वमतन्द्रितः। उपकारो ह्वासाधूनामपकाराय केवलम्
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to you the great one; to the perpetual destroyer of Daityas; obeisance to Tara®®® (redeemer) and to Sutara (the excellent redeemer); obeisance to 'Parana (one engaged in redeeming sinners).
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to you the great one; to the perpetual destroyer of Daityas; obeisance to Tara®®® (redeemer) and to Sutara (the excellent redeemer); obeisance to 'Parana (one engaged in redeeming sinners).

verses.sanskrit: वाराहीं चैव तां सैंहीम् आस्थायेहव्यवस्थितः देवानां देवरक्षार्थं निहत्य दितिजेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: vārāhīṃ caiva tāṃ saiṃhīm āsthāyehavyavasthitaḥ devānāṃ devarakṣārthaṃ nihatya ditijeśvaram
verses.translation: Obeisance to Harikesa (one with tawny hair); obeis- ance to Sambhii the groat Atman; obeisance to you the benefactor ol Devas; obeisance to one the benefactor of living beings.
verses.hindi: यदि सिंह महेशानं स्वपुनर्भूत मन्यसे। नत्वं स्रष्टा न संहर्ता न स्वतन्त्रो हि कुत्रचित्
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to Harikesa (one with tawny hair); obeis- ance to Sambhii the groat Atman; obeisance to you the benefactor ol Devas; obeisance to one the benefactor of living beings.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to Harikesa (one with tawny hair); obeis- ance to Sambhii the groat Atman; obeisance to you the benefactor ol Devas; obeisance to one the benefactor of living beings.

verses.sanskrit: द्विजशापच्छलेनैवम् अवतीर्णो ऽसि लीलया न दृष्टं यत्त्वदन्यं हि भवान् सर्वं चराचरम्
verses.transliteration: dvijaśāpacchalenaivam avatīrṇo 'si līlayā na dṛṣṭaṃ yattvadanyaṃ hi bhavān sarvaṃ carācaram
verses.translation: Obeisance to the bcnefictor ofUmii, the daughter of Hiniavari; obeisance to wrath in the form of Rudra; obeis- ance to Kcipardin (one with matted hair). Obeisance to Krda- kantha(the blue-neckcd).
verses.hindi: हरहारलतामध्ये मुग्ध कस्मान्त बुध्यसे। विस्मृतं किं तदंशेन दंष्ट्रोत्यातनपीडितः वाराहविग्रहस्तेऽद्य साक्रोशं तारकारिणा। द्धोऽसि यस्य शूलाग्रे विष्वक्सेनच्छलाद्भवान्
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to the bcnefictor ofUmii, the daughter of Hiniavari; obeisance to wrath in the form of Rudra; obeis- ance to Kcipardin (one with matted hair). Obeisance to Krda- kantha(the blue-neckcd).
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to the bcnefictor ofUmii, the daughter of Hiniavari; obeisance to wrath in the form of Rudra; obeis- ance to Kcipardin (one with matted hair). Obeisance to Krda- kantha(the blue-neckcd).

verses.sanskrit: भवान्विष्णुर्भवान् रुद्रो भवानेव पितामहः भवानादिर्भवानन्तो भवानेव वयं विभो
verses.transliteration: bhavānviṣṇurbhavān rudro bhavāneva pitāmahaḥ bhavānādirbhavānanto bhavāneva vayaṃ vibho
verses.translation: Obeisance to gold-complexioned Mahe.sa; obeisance to Srikantha; obeisance to ow: who is smeared witli atihes; obeis- ance to Dande.svara (lord with the staff or rod of punishment); obeisance to Mundisvara (lord with skulls).
verses.hindi: किसी प्रकारसे आपके द्वारा लिये गये विभिन्न अवतारोंमें कौन शेष रह गये हैं; अब तो केवल आप ही बचे हुए हैं। आप इस दोषको देखिये, जो आप इस दशाको प्राप्त हुए हैं। संहारमें दक्ष उन शिव-के द्वारा आप क्षणभरमें
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to gold-complexioned Mahe.sa; obeisance to Srikantha; obeisance to ow: who is smeared witli atihes; obeis- ance to Dande.svara (lord with the staff or rod of punishment); obeisance to Mundisvara (lord with skulls).

verses.sanskrit: भवानेव जगत्सर्वं प्रलापेन किमीश्वर मायया बहुधा संस्थम् अद्वितीयमयं प्रभो
verses.transliteration: bhavāneva jagatsarvaṃ pralāpena kimīśvara māyayā bahudhā saṃstham advitīyamayaṃ prabho
verses.translation: Obeisance to Bluma (the terrible), to one of terrible form; obeisance to you interested in te rrible activities; obeis- ance to one, the foremost among the annihilators; obeisance to one who can kill from far.
verses.hindi: विनाशको प्राप्त हो जायेँगे आप प्रकृति हैं, रुद्र पुरुष हैं; आपमें सम्पूर्ण तेज समाहित है। पाँच मुखवाले पितामह (ब्रह्मा) आपके नाभिकमले प्रादुर्भूत हुए हैं। घोर तपस्यामें लीन उन्होंने पूर्वकालमें जगतूकी सृष्टिके लिये अपने
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to Bluma (the terrible), to one of terrible form; obeisance to you interested in te rrible activities; obeis- ance to one, the foremost among the annihilators; obeisance to one who can kill from far.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to Bluma (the terrible), to one of terrible form; obeisance to you interested in te rrible activities; obeis- ance to one, the foremost among the annihilators; obeisance to one who can kill from far.

verses.translation: ObeisaiK e to Brahma, to onr of the form of Brahman; obeisance to you, to Siva himself.

verses.sanskrit: सेवितं गणगन्धर्वैः सिद्धैरप्सरसां गणैः देवताभिः सह ब्रह्मा भीतभीतः सगद्गदम् प्रणम्य दण्डवद्भूमौ तुष्टाव परमेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: sevitaṃ gaṇagandharvaiḥ siddhairapsarasāṃ gaṇaiḥ devatābhiḥ saha brahmā bhītabhītaḥ sagadgadam praṇamya daṇḍavadbhūmau tuṣṭāva parameśvaram
verses.translation: O lord of the universe, your conduct is spotless; we are but tools of your game. Our dissolution and rise depend upon the closing or opening ol your eyes. Even when you are wide awake, O lord, we arc distressed by Visnu ol unmeas- ured splendour. O Siva, our destruction cannot happen when you are wide awake. It behoves you to curb and check Nr- simha, for the welfare of the worlds.

verses.transliteration: namaste kālakālāya namaste rudra manyave namaḥ śivāya rudrāya śaṅkarāya śivāya te
verses.translation: The lord offered them fearlessness saying "1 shall kill him." Indra bowed to the lord along with Devas. Lord Bra- hma and Devas returned to their homes. Soon after Maliadeva assumed the form of a.aiabha and approached the haughty Man-lion. The lord in the form ofSarabha took away his life and was worshipped by Devas. From the form of a lion Vi§nu assum- ed his original form and went away gradually. The lord too who was thus eulogised by Devas went away.

verses.translation: He was encircled by others also who were of the same number, who had not been seen before, who were joyful and who were playing with Brahma and others of great cou- rage as though with balls. He was saluted by heroes. He had the flames of the fire that occur at the end of the kalpas. He had three shining eyes and he wielded arms. He was embellish- ed by the crescent moon that shone amidst his matted hairs. He had two curved fangs that resembled sprouts and had the shapes of two crescent moons. He possessed eyebrows which resembled parts of the bow of Indra (rainbow). By means of his fierce Huriikara (the gruff sound of "Hum* 9 ) he deafened all quarters. He had the features of the blue cloud and colly- rium. His moustaches were terrible. He had a wonderful form. With his invincible arms he frequently whirled his all- conquering trident. Lord Virabhadra was fluttering in his heroic power. He submitted this to the lord: — "O lord of the universe, command us, What caused you to remember me?

At my behest make him realize his duty 884 (or bring him in front of me. )

verses.transliteration: ātmano bhairavaṃ rūpaṃ mahāpralayakārakam ājagāma purā sadyo gaṇānāmagrato hasan
verses.translation: O lord Vi§pu, you have incarnated for the happi- ness of the world. You have been engaged by the great Para- me$thin for the purpose of sustenance. Multitudes of creatures have been saved by you in the form of a fish. You moved about in the vast ocean-like sheet of water formerly, after tying up the boat to your tail. You held aloft the Mandara mountain in the form of a tortoise; the earth was lifted up by the Boar. With this leonine form Hiranyaka$ipu was killed. Again Bali was bound by you in the form of Vamana taking up three steps. You alone are the unchanging lord of all living beings. This is your prowess: whenever any misery befalls the world, you take incarnations and make your devotees free from ailments. O lord, devoutly attached to Siva, no one excels you; there is none equal to you.

verses.transliteration: tāvadbhir abhito vīrair nṛtyadbhiś ca mudānvitaiḥ krīḍadbhiś ca mahādhīrair brahmādyaiḥ kandukairiva
verses.translation: vaktram Anaya kfttifi ca — vaktrarh mukhaifa kfttiih tvacaft ca Anaya ST. you bring his head as well as his skin. There is a variant kftyam lor kfttim which the translators have adopted here. But this does not suit the contest. verses.sanskrit: अदृष्टपूर्वैरन्यैश् च वेष्टितो वीरवन्दितः कल्पान्तज्वलनज्वालो विलसल्लोचनत्रयः
verses.transliteration: adṛṣṭapūrvairanyaiś ca veṣṭito vīravanditaḥ kalpāntajvalanajvālo vilasallocanatrayaḥ
verses.translation: Thus addressed in mild words by Vlrabhadra, lord Nrsimha (Man-lion) blazed more than before with extremely terrible wrath.
verses.hindi: मखेश, वरेण्य, अग्निरूप, महाप्राण, (महानासिकावाले), अपान वायुको गति देनेवाले)-को नमस्कार है । त्रिगुण
verses.wordMeaning: Thus addressed in mild words by Vlrabhadra, lord Nrsimha (Man-lion) blazed more than before with extremely terrible wrath.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus addressed in mild words by Vlrabhadra, lord Nrsimha (Man-lion) blazed more than before with extremely terrible wrath.

verses.sanskrit: आत्तशस्त्रो जटाजूटे ज्वलद्बालेन्दुमण्डितः बालेन्दुद्वितयाकारतीक्ष्णदंष्ट्राङ्कुरद्वयः
verses.transliteration: āttaśastro jaṭājūṭe jvaladbālendumaṇḍitaḥ bālendudvitayākāratīkṣṇadaṃṣṭrāṅkuradvayaḥ
verses.translation: O dear, go back to that place wherefrom you have come. Dp not be presumptuous enough to advise me what is beneficial to me. I shall now annihilate this universe of the mobile and immobile beings. There can't be the annihilation of the annihilator at his own hands or from others. My sway extends everywhere. There is none to boss over me. Thanks to my favour that everything functions within limits. I alone am the instigator and restrainer of all &aktis. O Ganadhyak$a (presiding deity over the Ganas), know that everything that is glorious, rich, powerful and energetic in the world is a dis- play of my splendour. 885 Those who are conversant with the
verses.hindi: नमस्कार है। चद्ध-अग्नि-सूर्य, मुक्ति-विचित्रयहेतु, वर अवतार (अभिमानियोंका पतन करनेवाले), सर्वकारणहै कपाली, कराल, पति, पुण्यकोर्ति, अमोघ, अग्नि लकुलीश, शम्भु (कल्याण करनेवाले), भिषर्केर'
verses.wordMeaning: O dear, go back to that place wherefrom you have come. Dp not be presumptuous enough to advise me what is beneficial to me. I shall now annihilate this universe of the mobile and immobile beings.…
verses.commentary: Sense: O dear, go back to that place wherefrom you have come. Dp not be presumptuous enough to advise me what is beneficial to me. I shall now annihilate this universe of the mobile and immobile beings.…

verses.sanskrit: आखण्डलधनुःखण्डसंनिभभ्रूलतायुतः महाप्रचण्डहुङ्कारबधिरीकृतदिङ्मुखः
verses.transliteration: ākhaṇḍaladhanuḥkhaṇḍasaṃnibhabhrūlatāyutaḥ mahāpracaṇḍahuṅkārabadhirīkṛtadiṅmukhaḥ
verses.translation: I am superior to the universe. I am independent OOtd of all. I am the maker and unmaker (annihilator). This is my greatest splendour. Who then wishes to hear your sugges- tion? Hence, seek refuge in me, be rid of ailments and go back. O great lord of the Bhutas, understand this great feature of mine. O Vlrabhadra, I am Kala (Time, Death). I am the cause of the destruction of Kala. I am engaged in the activity of annihilation. Know me as Death unto the god of Death. It is due to my favour that these Devas are alive.
verses.hindi: अव्यक्ताय विशोकाय स्थिराय स्थिरधन्विने। स्थाणवे कृत्तिवासाय नमः पञ्चार्थहेतवे नमस्तेध्वरराजाय वयसां पतये नमः
verses.wordMeaning: I am superior to the universe. I am independent OOtd of all. I am the maker and unmaker (annihilator). This is my greatest splendour. Who then wishes to hear your sugges- tion? Hence, seek refuge in me, be rid of ailments and go back. O great lord of the Bhutas,…
verses.commentary: Sense: I am superior to the universe. I am independent OOtd of all. I am the maker and unmaker (annihilator). This is my greatest splendour. Who then wishes to hear your sugges- tion? Hence, seek refuge in me, be rid of ailments and go back. O great lord of the Bhutas,…

verses.sanskrit: नीलमेघाञ्जनाकारभीषणश्मश्रुरद्भुतः वादखण्डम् अखण्डाभ्यां भ्रामयंस्त्रिशिखं मुहुः
verses.transliteration: nīlameghāñjanākārabhīṣaṇaśmaśruradbhutaḥ vādakhaṇḍam akhaṇḍābhyāṃ bhrāmayaṃstriśikhaṃ muhuḥ
verses.translation: With minor variations, the verse occurs in the Bhagavad Gltft, X. 41.
verses.hindi: यदा यदा ममाज्ञानमत्यहङ्कारदूषितम्। तदा तदापनेतव्यं त्वयैव परमेश्वर
verses.wordMeaning: With minor variations, the verse occurs in the Bhagavad Gltft, X. 41.
verses.commentary: Sense: With minor variations, the verse occurs in the Bhagavad Gltft, X. 41.

verses.sanskrit: वीरभद्रो ऽपि भगवान् वीरशक्तिविजृम्भितः स्वयं विज्ञापयामास किमत्र स्मृतिकारणम्
verses.transliteration: vīrabhadro 'pi bhagavān vīraśaktivijṛmbhitaḥ svayaṃ vijñāpayāmāsa kimatra smṛtikāraṇam
verses.translation: On hearing these haughty words of Nfsimha, Virabha- dra of unmeasured exploits laughed in derision. With throbbing lips he said thus.
verses.hindi: एवं विज्ञापयन् प्रीतः शङ्करं नरकेसरी। नन्वशक्तो भवान् विष्णो जीवितान्तं पराजित: अथ ब्रह्मादयः सर्वे वीरभद्र त्वया दृशा।
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing these haughty words of Nfsimha, Virabha- dra of unmeasured exploits laughed in derision. With throbbing lips he said thus.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing these haughty words of Nfsimha, Virabha- dra of unmeasured exploits laughed in derision. With throbbing lips he said thus.

verses.sanskrit: आज्ञापय जगत्स्वामिन् प्रसादः क्रियतां मयि अकाले भयमुत्पन्नं देवानामपि भैरव
verses.transliteration: ājñāpaya jagatsvāmin prasādaḥ kriyatāṃ mayi akāle bhayamutpannaṃ devānāmapi bhairava
verses.translation: Don't you know the Pinfika-bearing lord of the uni- verse who is the annihilator? Wrdng assertions and disputes will bring in only destruction unto you.
verses.hindi: जीविताः स्मो वयं देवाः पर्जन्येनेव पादपा:
verses.wordMeaning: Don't you know the Pinfika-bearing lord of the uni- verse who is the annihilator? Wrdng assertions and disputes will bring in only destruction unto you.
verses.commentary: Sense: Don't you know the Pinfika-bearing lord of the uni- verse who is the annihilator? Wrdng assertions and disputes will bring in only destruction unto you.

verses.sanskrit: ज्वलितः स नृसिंहाग्निः शमयैनं दुरासदम् सान्त्वयन् बोधयादौ तं तेन किं नोपशाम्यति
verses.transliteration: jvalitaḥ sa nṛsiṃhāgniḥ śamayainaṃ durāsadam sāntvayan bodhayādau taṃ tena kiṃ nopaśāmyati
verses.translation: Out of your different incarnations what are they that remain now? Whatever may be the purpose for which they have been taken, it is only the story thereof that remains. 886
verses.hindi: यदव्यक्तं परं व्योम कलातीतं सदाशिवम् भगवान् महेश्वरद्वारा वीरभद्रका ““नुसिंहद्वारा
verses.wordMeaning: Out of your different incarnations what are they that remain now? Whatever may be the purpose for which they have been taken, it is only the story thereof that remains. 886
verses.commentary: Sense: Out of your different incarnations what are they that remain now? Whatever may be the purpose for which they have been taken, it is only the story thereof that remains. 886

verses.sanskrit: ततो मत्परमं भावं भैरवं संप्रदर्शय सूक्ष्मं सूक्ष्मेण संहृत्य स्थूलं स्थूलेन तेजसा
verses.transliteration: tato matparamaṃ bhāvaṃ bhairavaṃ saṃpradarśaya sūkṣmaṃ sūkṣmeṇa saṃhṛtya sthūlaṃ sthūlena tejasā
verses.translation: See this defect that you have attained such a plight. Within a trice, you will court destruction through Siva who is an adept in annihilation.
verses.hindi: फफफ फफ फाम फीकी फ पफ फफ फफ फफ फफफ फफफ फफफ फफ ड UE RE

verses.commentary: Sense: See this defect that you have attained such a plight. Within a trice, you will court destruction through Siva who is an adept in annihilation.

verses.sanskrit: वक्त्रमानय कृत्तिं च वीरभद्र ममाज्ञया इत्यादिष्टो गणाध्यक्षः प्रशान्तवपुरास्थितः
verses.transliteration: vaktramānaya kṛttiṃ ca vīrabhadra mamājñayā ityādiṣṭo gaṇādhyakṣaḥ praśāntavapurāsthitaḥ
verses.translation: You are Prakjrti and Rudra is Puru§a. Power has been induced in you, it is not natural. The five-faced Brahma was born of your umbilical lotus.
verses.hindi: मुण्ड, दण्डी, योगरूपी, मेघवाह, देव तथा पार्वतीपतिको नमस्कार है। अव्यक्त, विशोक (शोकरहित), स्थिर, स्थिरधन्वी, स्थाणु (जगत्के आधाररूप), कृत्तिवास तथा पंचार्थहेतुको नमस्कार है। वर तथा एकपाद (एकमात्र ज्ञानियोंके द्वारा प्राप्य)-को नमस्कार है। चन्द्रार्धमौलिको नमस्कार है । अध्वरराज तथा वयसाम्पति (शरभरूप)-को नमस्कार है। आप योगीश्वर, नित्य, सत्य, परमेष्ठी तथा सर्वात्माको नमस्कार है। आप
verses.wordMeaning: You are Prakjrti and Rudra is Puru§a. Power has been induced in you, it is not natural. The five-faced Brahma was born of your umbilical lotus.
verses.commentary: Sense: You are Prakjrti and Rudra is Puru§a. Power has been induced in you, it is not natural. The five-faced Brahma was born of your umbilical lotus.

verses.sanskrit: जगाम रंहसा तत्र यत्रास्ते नरकेसरी ततस्तं बोधयामास वीरभद्रो हरो हरिम्
verses.transliteration: jagāma raṃhasā tatra yatrāste narakesarī tatastaṃ bodhayāmāsa vīrabhadro haro harim
verses.translation: Brahma who was engaged in a severe penance thought of Sankara within his forehead. It was for effecting creation that he thought of Nilalohita the ancestor of the universe.
verses.hindi: सर्वेश्वरको नमस्कार है। आपको एक, दो, तीन, चार, पाँच बार नमस्कार है। आपको दस बार तथा हजार बार नमस्कार है। आपको अपरिमित बार, अनन्त बार नमस्कार है। आपको बार-बार नमस्कार है; पुनः बार-
verses.wordMeaning: Brahma who was engaged in a severe penance thought of Sankara within his forehead. It was for effecting creation that he thought of Nilalohita the ancestor of the universe.
verses.commentary: Sense: Brahma who was engaged in a severe penance thought of Sankara within his forehead. It was for effecting creation that he thought of Nilalohita the ancestor of the universe.

verses.sanskrit: उवाच वाक्यमीशानः पिता पुत्रमिवौरसम् जगत्सुखाय भगवन्न् अवतीर्णो ऽसि माधव
verses.transliteration: uvāca vākyamīśānaḥ pitā putramivaurasam jagatsukhāya bhagavann avatīrṇo 'si mādhava
verses.translation: For the purpose of creation Siva originated from his forehead. That is not disparaging to the lord Siva. I am a part of the lord of Devas. I have assumed the form of Bhairava.
verses.hindi: सूतजी बोले-- है ऋषियो! इस प्रकार नृसिंह विष्णु-ने एक सौ आठ अमृतमय नामोंसे शरभरूप ईश्वर (शिव)-को स्तुति करके पुन: उनसे प्रार्थना कौ-- हे परमेश्‍वर! जब-जब अति अहंकारसे दूषित अज्ञान मुझमें उत्पन्न हो, तब-तब आप उसे दूर करें । इस प्रकार शंकरसे प्रार्थना करते हुए वे नृसिंह प्रसन्न हो गये; तब वीरभद्रने कहा--'हे विष्णो! आप वास्तवमें अशक्त हैं और जीवनके अन्तमें पराजित हुए हैं।' इसके बाद
verses.wordMeaning: For the purpose of creation Siva originated from his forehead. That is not disparaging to the lord Siva. I am a part of the lord of Devas. I have assumed the form of Bhairava.
verses.commentary: Sense: For the purpose of creation Siva originated from his forehead. That is not disparaging to the lord Siva. I am a part of the lord of Devas. I have assumed the form of Bhairava.

verses.sanskrit: स्थित्यर्थेन च युक्तो ऽसि परेण परमेष्ठिना जन्तुचक्रं भगवता रक्षितं मत्स्यरूपिणा
verses.transliteration: sthityarthena ca yukto 'si pareṇa parameṣṭhinā jantucakraṃ bhagavatā rakṣitaṃ matsyarūpiṇā
verses.translation: I have been employed to subdue you with humility at the outset, and if that fails, with force afterwards. You are endowed with the digit of his Sakti. Thus, you have torn asunder the Asura. Merely on account of this you are crying hoarse with haughtiness again and again. A help rendered to the wicked is conducive only to a malicious misbehaviour.
verses.hindi: वीरभद्रने क्षणभरमें ही नूसिंहरूपधारी विष्णुके विग्रहको बचे हुए मुखवाला करके शेष विग्रहसे त्वचा खींचकर उसे मात्र हडियोंसे युक्त कर दिया और इस प्रकार बह विग्रह अति श्वेत वर्णवाला हो गया
verses.wordMeaning: I have been employed to subdue you with humility at the outset, and if that fails, with force afterwards. You are endowed with the digit of his Sakti. Thus, you have torn asunder the Asura. Merely on account of this you are crying hoarse with haughtiness again and again.…
verses.commentary: Sense: I have been employed to subdue you with humility at the outset, and if that fails, with force afterwards. You are endowed with the digit of his Sakti. Thus, you have torn asunder the Asura. Merely on account of this you are crying hoarse with haughtiness again and again.…

verses.sanskrit: पुच्छेनैव समाबध्य भ्रमन्नेकार्णवे पुरा बिभर्षि कूर्मरूपेण वाराहेणोद्धृता मही
verses.transliteration: pucchenaiva samābadhya bhramannekārṇave purā bibharṣi kūrmarūpeṇa vārāheṇoddhṛtā mahī
verses.translation: O lion, if you consider Mahelana (lord Siva) to be one born after you, you are mistaken. You are neither the creator nor the annihilator and never independent.
verses.hindi: मेघसे जीवन प्राप्त करते हैं जिसके भयसे अग्नि जलती है, साक्षात् सूर्य उगता है, वायु बहती है और पाँचवीं मृत्यु दौड़ती है; वह आप ही हैं
verses.wordMeaning: O lion, if you consider Mahelana (lord Siva) to be one born after you, you are mistaken. You are neither the creator nor the annihilator and never independent.
verses.commentary: Sense: O lion, if you consider Mahelana (lord Siva) to be one born after you, you are mistaken. You are neither the creator nor the annihilator and never independent.

verses.sanskrit: तदा तदावतीर्णस्त्वं करिष्यसि निरामयम् नाधिकस्त्वत्समो ऽप्यस्ति हरे शिवपरायण
verses.transliteration: tadā tadāvatīrṇastvaṃ kariṣyasi nirāmayam nādhikastvatsamo 'pyasti hare śivaparāyaṇa
verses.translation: O Cakrapani the discus is your favourite weapon, thanks to its exploits. Whence has it been acquired by you? By whom was it made? Even that has been forgotten by you. All your worlds have been seized from you. Overwhelmed by slum- ber you lie down in the ocean. How then can you be a Sattvika? Everything beginning with you and ending with blade of grass is the display of Rudra's Sakti. The fire-god and you, though powerful all round, were deluded. Both of you were in- competent to realize the greatness of his splendour.
verses.hindi: फुफफफफफफफफफफफफफफफफफीफीफीपीकी
verses.wordMeaning: O Cakrapani the discus is your favourite weapon, thanks to its exploits. Whence has it been acquired by you? By whom was it made? Even that has been forgotten by you. All your worlds have been seized from you. Overwhelmed by slum- ber you lie down in the ocean.…
verses.commentary: Sense: O Cakrapani the discus is your favourite weapon, thanks to its exploits. Whence has it been acquired by you? By whom was it made? Even that has been forgotten by you. All your worlds have been seized from you. Overwhelmed by slum- ber you lie down in the ocean.…

verses.sanskrit: त्वया धर्माश् च वेदाश् च शुभे मार्गे प्रतिष्ठिताः यदर्थम् अवतारो ऽयं निहतः सो ऽपि केशव
verses.transliteration: tvayā dharmāś ca vedāś ca śubhe mārge pratiṣṭhitāḥ yadartham avatāro 'yaṃ nihataḥ so 'pi keśava
verses.translation: Only to the gross intellect appear the great forms of Vi$$u, Indra, Agni, Yama, Varuna, of heaven and earth. You are bom in the belly of the moon. 889 You are Kfila. Par amei vara is Mahak&la. MaheSvara is Kilakila. Hence, you will become the victim of Death through the burning digit of Ugra (Siva). The lord with a steady bow is imperishable, heroic and superior to the universe. He destroys fear of fever. 890 He is the lord of all animals and birds and gold(?). Neither you nor the four-faced deity can be the overlord and ruler of the entire universe.
