verses.sanskrit: अत्यन्तघोरं भगवन् नरसिंह वपुस्तव उपसंहर विश्वात्मंस् त्वमेव मम संनिधौ
verses.transliteration: atyantaghoraṃ bhagavan narasiṃha vapustava upasaṃhara viśvātmaṃs tvameva mama saṃnidhau
verses.translation: See note. 78.
verses.hindi: हे गणाधिप! सभी विपत्तियोंमें हमलोगोंको क कीजिये। है एकादशरुद्ररूप  आप भगवान् विशिष विग्रहवाले हैं
verses.wordMeaning: See note. 78.
verses.commentary: Sense: See note. 78.

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्तो वीरभद्रेण नृसिंहः शान्तया गिरा ततो ऽधिकं महाघोरं कोपं प्रज्वालयद्धरिः
verses.transliteration: ityukto vīrabhadreṇa nṛsiṃhaḥ śāntayā girā tato 'dhikaṃ mahāghoraṃ kopaṃ prajvālayaddhariḥ
verses.translation: Cf. Lifiga, part I. chs. 35, 36.
verses.hindi: हे शिव! आपके इस प्रकारके अनेक देखकर हमारा अज्ञान हममें कदाचित् सन्देह न करे तथा आपका ध्यान नष्ट न हो। जैसे गुंजाके पर्वतके प्रान्तभागसे गुंजाओंकी अमित संख्या होती ह  वैसे ही आपके अनन्त रूप हैं, जिन्हें आप चारों ओरसे  उपसंहृत कर लीजिये। यह संसार आपके प्रवेशयोगय हो, इसका संहार मत कीजिये। वेदवेत्ता ब्राह्मण कहते हैं कि आप रुद्रके पर-अपर दो शरीर हैं-एक घोर
verses.wordMeaning: Cf. Lifiga, part I. chs. 35, 36.
verses.commentary: Sense: Cf. Lifiga, part I. chs. 35, 36.

verses.sanskrit: आगतो ऽसि यतस्तत्र गच्छ त्वं मा हितं वद इदानीं संहरिष्यामि जगदेतच्चराचरम्
verses.transliteration: āgato 'si yatastatra gaccha tvaṃ mā hitaṃ vada idānīṃ saṃhariṣyāmi jagadetaccarācaram
verses.translation: Vlrabhadra refer* tauntingly to the various forms of Vifpu, sucl as VAmana from Aditi, Jayanta from Indra, KArttikeya from Agni, NArA- yaoa from Yama, Bhrgu from Varupa and Budha from Soma, implying thereby the subordinate position of Vifpu.
verses.hindi: तथा दूसरा शिव (शान्त); उनमें प्रत्येकके अनेक प्रकार  हैं। है भगवन्! कभी भी हत न होनेवाले महान् बलसे  युक्त आप यहाँपर हम लोगोंकी रक्षा कीजिये। आपने  अपने ही तेजसे सम्पूर्ण जगत्को व्याप्त कर रखा
verses.wordMeaning: Vlrabhadra refer* tauntingly to the various forms of Vifpu, sucl as VAmana from Aditi, Jayanta from Indra, KArttikeya from Agni, NArA- yaoa from Yama, Bhrgu from Varupa and Budha from Soma, implying thereby the subordinate position of Vifpu.
verses.commentary: Sense: Vlrabhadra refer* tauntingly to the various forms of Vifpu, sucl as VAmana from Aditi, Jayanta from Indra, KArttikeya from Agni, NArA- yaoa from Yama, Bhrgu from Varupa and Budha from Soma, implying thereby the subordinate position of Vifpu.

verses.sanskrit: संहर्तुर् न हि संहारः स्वतो वा परतो ऽपि वा शासितं मम सर्वत्र शास्ता को ऽपि न विद्यते
verses.transliteration: saṃhartur na hi saṃhāraḥ svato vā parato 'pi vā śāsitaṃ mama sarvatra śāstā ko 'pi na vidyate
verses.translation: upabastA jvaram— jvaraih tatsaihjfiaka-rogam upahastA upahAs* karab ST.— said of Siva who scoffs even at tt)e.flra)jgiil disease callec jvara*
verses.hindi: हे महेश्वर! ब्रह्मा-विष्णु-इन्द्र-चन्द्र आदि हम  प्रमुख देवतागण तथा अन्य देवता और असुर-सभी  लोग आपसे उत्पन्न हुए हैं ब्रह्मा, इन्द्र, विष्णु, यम आदि देवता, असुर तथा  भ्रान्त अन्त:करणवाले नृसिंह हरिका निग्रह करके अपने  शरीरको आठ प्रकारसे सूर्य आदि रूपमें विभाजित  करके आप सभीका धारण-पोषण करते हैं; अतः है
verses.wordMeaning: upabastA jvaram— jvaraih tatsaihjfiaka-rogam upahastA upahAs* karab ST.— said of Siva who scoffs even at tt)e.flra)jgiil disease callec jvara*
verses.commentary: Sense: upabastA jvaram— jvaraih tatsaihjfiaka-rogam upahastA upahAs* karab ST.— said of Siva who scoffs even at tt)e.flra)jgiil disease callec jvara*

verses.sanskrit: मत्प्रसादेन सकलं समर्यादं प्रवर्तते अहं हि सर्वशक्तीनां प्रवर्तकनिवर्तकः
verses.transliteration: matprasādena sakalaṃ samaryādaṃ pravartate ahaṃ hi sarvaśaktīnāṃ pravartakanivartakaḥ
verses.translation: Thus viewing everything, restrain and withdraw the Atman through the Atman. Otherwise, death will befall you like the thunderbolt on a stump. You will be the victim of a severe wrath that has the form of great Bhairava.
verses.hindi: भगवन्! अभीष्ट दानोंके द्वारा हम देवताओंकी रक्ष कोजिये
verses.wordMeaning: Thus viewing everything, restrain and withdraw the Atman through the Atman. Otherwise, death will befall you like the thunderbolt on a stump. You will be the victim of a severe wrath that has the form of great Bhairava.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus viewing everything, restrain and withdraw the Atman through the Atman. Otherwise, death will befall you like the thunderbolt on a stump. You will be the victim of a severe wrath that has the form of great Bhairava.

verses.sanskrit: यद् यद् विभूतिमत् सत्त्वं श्रीमदूर्जितमेव वा तत्तद्विद्धि गणाध्यक्ष मम तेजोविजृम्भितम्
verses.transliteration: yad yad vibhūtimat sattvaṃ śrīmadūrjitameva vā tattadviddhi gaṇādhyakṣa mama tejovijṛmbhitam
verses.translation: It was not a golden splendour. It was not one per- taining to the moon or the sun nor was it fiery in origin. It was not similar to lightning or the moonlight. It belonged to Mahe£vara and it was incomparable.
verses.hindi: तत्पश्चात् देव वीरभद्र -ने उन देवताओं तथा प्राचीन ऋषियोंसे कहा--जैसे जलमें जल, दूधमें दूध तथा घृतमें घृत डाले जानेपर एक हो जाता है; वैसे हौँ विष्णु शिवमें लीन हैं; इसमें सन्देह नहीं है। ये गर्व जातहासो वथा महाबली नृसिंह जगतूका संहार करनेवाले जगत्संहारकारेण प्रवृत्तो नरकेसरी। प्रकट हुए हँ मेरी भक्तिको सिद्धिकी इच्छा
verses.wordMeaning: It was not a golden splendour. It was not one per- taining to the moon or the sun nor was it fiery in origin. It was not similar to lightning or the moonlight. It belonged to Mahe£vara and it was incomparable.
verses.commentary: Sense: It was not a golden splendour. It was not one per- taining to the moon or the sun nor was it fiery in origin. It was not similar to lightning or the moonlight. It belonged to Mahe£vara and it was incomparable.

verses.sanskrit: देवतापरमार्थज्ञा ममैव परमं विदुः मदंशाः शक्तिसम्पन्ना ब्रह्मशक्रादयः सुराः
verses.transliteration: devatāparamārthajñā mamaiva paramaṃ viduḥ madaṃśāḥ śaktisampannā brahmaśakrādayaḥ surāḥ
verses.translation: Then all fiery splendours merged into the splendour of Sankara. The highly brilliant and immanent (i.e. Vira- bhadra) became manifest.
verses.hindi: याजनीयो नमस्तस्मै मद्भक्तिसिद्धिकाङ्क्षिभिः ॥ ११३ नृसिंहकी पूजा करनी चाहिए: उन नृसिंहरूप्धा
verses.wordMeaning: Then all fiery splendours merged into the splendour of Sankara. The highly brilliant and immanent (i.e. Vira- bhadra) became manifest.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then all fiery splendours merged into the splendour of Sankara. The highly brilliant and immanent (i.e. Vira- bhadra) became manifest.

verses.sanskrit: मन्नाभिपङ्कजाज्जातः पुरा ब्रह्मा चतुर्मुखः तल्ललाटसमुत्पन्नो भगवान्वृषभध्वजः
verses.transliteration: mannābhipaṅkajājjātaḥ purā brahmā caturmukhaḥ tallalāṭasamutpanno bhagavānvṛṣabhadhvajaḥ
verses.translation: He assumed a hideous form characteristic of Rudra. Then Paramesvara became visible in the form of the anniliilator.
verses.hindi: एकादशात्मन् भगवान् वर्तते रूपवान् हरः ईदूशान् तेऽवताराणि दृष्ट्वा शिव बहूंस्तमः । कदाचित्सन्दिहेन्नास्मांस्त्वच्चिन्तास्तमया तथा
verses.wordMeaning: He assumed a hideous form characteristic of Rudra. Then Paramesvara became visible in the form of the anniliilator.
verses.commentary: Sense: He assumed a hideous form characteristic of Rudra. Then Paramesvara became visible in the form of the anniliilator.

verses.sanskrit: रजसाधिष्ठितः स्रष्टा रुद्रस्तामस उच्यते अहं नियन्ता सर्वस्य मत्परं नास्ति दैवतम्
verses.transliteration: rajasādhiṣṭhitaḥ sraṣṭā rudrastāmasa ucyate ahaṃ niyantā sarvasya matparaṃ nāsti daivatam
verses.translation: Raising auspicious shouts of victory Devas stood obser- ving. Virabhadra adopted thousand arms. His hairs were matted. The crescent moon adorned his head.
verses.hindi: दवे तनू तव रुद्रस्य वेदज्ञा ब्राह्मणा विदुः। घोराप्यन्या शिवाप्यन्या ते प्रत्येकमनेकधा
verses.wordMeaning: Raising auspicious shouts of victory Devas stood obser- ving. Virabhadra adopted thousand arms. His hairs were matted. The crescent moon adorned his head.
verses.commentary: Sense: Raising auspicious shouts of victory Devas stood obser- ving. Virabhadra adopted thousand arms. His hairs were matted. The crescent moon adorned his head.

verses.sanskrit: विश्वाधिकः स्वतन्त्रश् च कर्ता हर्ताखिलेश्वरः इदं तु मत्परं तेजः कः पुनः श्रोतुमिच्छति
verses.transliteration: viśvādhikaḥ svatantraś ca kartā hartākhileśvaraḥ idaṃ tu matparaṃ tejaḥ kaḥ punaḥ śrotumicchati
verses.translation: Half of his body was an animal's. 891 With wings and a beak he was a bird. His great curved fangs were very sharp. Adamantine claws were his weapons.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्मविष्णवीन्द्रचनद्रादि वयं च प्रमुखाः सुरा: । ब्रह्मा च इनदरो विष्णुश्च यमाद्या न सुरासुरान्। ततो निगृह्य च हरिं सिंह इत्युपचेतसम्
verses.wordMeaning: Half of his body was an animal's. 891 With wings and a beak he was a bird. His great curved fangs were very sharp. Adamantine claws were his weapons.
verses.commentary: Sense: Half of his body was an animal's. 891 With wings and a beak he was a bird. His great curved fangs were very sharp. Adamantine claws were his weapons.

verses.sanskrit: अतो मां शरणं प्राप्य गच्छ त्वं विगतज्वरः अवेहि परमं भावम् इदं भूतमहेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: ato māṃ śaraṇaṃ prāpya gaccha tvaṃ vigatajvaraḥ avehi paramaṃ bhāvam idaṃ bhūtamaheśvaraḥ
verses.translation: He was blue-neckcd and long-armed. The beak and the feet were born of fire as it were. His majestie roaring sound resembled the terrible thunder of the cloud rising up at the close of a yuga.
verses.hindi: उवाच तान् सुरान् देवो महर्षीश्च पुरातनान्। यथा जले जलं क्षिप्तं क्षीरं क्षीरे घृतं घृते
verses.wordMeaning: He was blue-neckcd and long-armed. The beak and the feet were born of fire as it were. His majestie roaring sound resembled the terrible thunder of the cloud rising up at the close of a yuga.
verses.commentary: Sense: He was blue-neckcd and long-armed. The beak and the feet were born of fire as it were. His majestie roaring sound resembled the terrible thunder of the cloud rising up at the close of a yuga.

verses.sanskrit: कालो ऽस्म्यहं कालविनाशहेतुर् लोकान् समाहर्तुम् अहं प्रवृत्तः मृत्योर्मृत्युं विद्धि मां वीरभद्र जीवन्त्येते मत्प्रसादेन देवाः
verses.transliteration: kālo 'smyahaṃ kālavināśahetur lokān samāhartum ahaṃ pravṛttaḥ mṛtyormṛtyuṃ viddhi māṃ vīrabhadra jīvantyete matprasādena devāḥ
verses.translation: His three eyes became round and furious like fiery balls. His lower lips and curved fangs became prominent. He thundered a Humkara.
verses.hindi: एक एव तदा विष्णुः शिवलीनो न चान्यथा। एष एव नृसिंहात्मा सदर्पश्च महाबलः त माका??? ललल तिते एतावदुक्त्वा भगवान् वीरभद्रो महाबल: । अपश्यन् सर्वभूतानां तत्रैवान्तरधीयत
verses.wordMeaning: His three eyes became round and furious like fiery balls. His lower lips and curved fangs became prominent. He thundered a Humkara.
verses.commentary: Sense: His three eyes became round and furious like fiery balls. His lower lips and curved fangs became prominent. He thundered a Humkara.

verses.sanskrit: साहङ्कारमिदं श्रुत्वा हरेर् अमितविक्रमः विहस्योवाच सावज्ञं ततो विस्फुरिताधरः
verses.transliteration: sāhaṅkāramidaṃ śrutvā harer amitavikramaḥ vihasyovāca sāvajñaṃ tato visphuritādharaḥ
verses.translation: At his very sight Nrsimha lost his strength and exploit. He had the same uneasiness and flutter as that of a glow-worm
verses.hindi: नृसिंहकृत्तिवसनस्तदाप्रभृति शङ्करः। र्तर तन्मुण्डमालायां नायकत्वेन कल्पितम्
verses.wordMeaning: At his very sight Nrsimha lost his strength and exploit. He had the same uneasiness and flutter as that of a glow-worm
verses.commentary: Sense: At his very sight Nrsimha lost his strength and exploit. He had the same uneasiness and flutter as that of a glow-worm

verses.sanskrit: किं न जानासि विश्वेशं संहर्तारं पिनाकिनम् असद्वादो विवादश् च विनाशस्त्वयि केवलः
verses.transliteration: kiṃ na jānāsi viśveśaṃ saṃhartāraṃ pinākinam asadvādo vivādaś ca vināśastvayi kevalaḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to Rudra, 892 to Sarva, to one who is all- consuming, all-pervading. Obeisance to Ugra, 893 to Bhima 8tt4 (the terrible), to Krodha (anger), to Manyu 896 (wrath), to Bhava, to Sarva. Obeisance to you, to Sankara, to Siva, 896 to Kalakala, to Kala, to Mahakala, to Mytyu, to the heroic Virabhadra; to the trident-bearing lord, to K§ayadvira 897 (he who destroys powerful persons), to the great Mahadeva, to the
verses.hindi: ततो देवा निरातङ्काः कीर्तयन्तः कथामिमाम्। ब्रिस्मयोत्फुल्लनयना जग्मुः सर्वे यथागतम् य इदं परमाख्यानं पुण्यं वेहैः समन्वितम्। पठित्वा शृणुते चैव सर्वदुःखविनाशनम्
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to Rudra, 892 to Sarva, to one who is all- consuming, all-pervading. Obeisance to Ugra, 893 to Bhima 8tt4 (the terrible), to Krodha (anger), to Manyu 896 (wrath), to Bhava, to Sarva. Obeisance to you, to Sankara, to Siva, 896 to Kalakala, to Kala, to Mahakala,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to Rudra, 892 to Sarva, to one who is all- consuming, all-pervading. Obeisance to Ugra, 893 to Bhima 8tt4 (the terrible), to Krodha (anger), to Manyu 896 (wrath), to Bhava, to Sarva. Obeisance to you, to Sankara, to Siva, 896 to Kalakala, to Kala, to Mahakala,…

verses.sanskrit: तवान्योन्यावताराणि कानि शेषाणि सांप्रतम् कृतानि येन केनापि कथाशेषो भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: tavānyonyāvatārāṇi kāni śeṣāṇi sāṃpratam kṛtāni yena kenāpi kathāśeṣo bhaviṣyati
verses.translation: ugr&ya — ucyati(krudha)sambadhyate iti ugrafr ST. Cf. Ahobala- Rudrabhdjya — cited in ST.
verses.hindi: अपमृत्युप्रशमनं महाशान्तिकरं शुभम्। अरिचक्रप्रशमनं सर्वाधिप्रविनाशनम्
verses.wordMeaning: ugr&ya — ucyati(krudha)sambadhyate iti ugrafr ST. Cf. Ahobala- Rudrabhdjya — cited in ST.
verses.commentary: Sense: ugr&ya — ucyati(krudha)sambadhyate iti ugrafr ST. Cf. Ahobala- Rudrabhdjya — cited in ST.

verses.sanskrit: दोषं त्वं पश्य एतत्त्वम् अवस्थामीदृशीं गतः तेन संहारदक्षेण क्षणात्संक्षयमेष्यसि
verses.transliteration: doṣaṃ tvaṃ paśya etattvam avasthāmīdṛśīṃ gataḥ tena saṃhāradakṣeṇa kṣaṇātsaṃkṣayameṣyasi
verses.translation: bhfm&ya — cf. bhii'sm&t pavate vatafr.
verses.hindi: विषग्रहक्षयकरं पुत्रपौत्रादिवर्धनम् योगसिद्धिप्रदं सम्यक् शिवज्ञानप्रकाशकम्। शेषलोकस्य सोपानं वाञ्छितार्थैकसाधनम्
verses.wordMeaning: bhfm&ya — cf. bhii'sm&t pavate vatafr.
verses.commentary: Sense: bhfm&ya — cf. bhii'sm&t pavate vatafr.

verses.sanskrit: प्रकृतिस्त्वं पुमान् रुद्रस् त्वयि वीर्यं समाहितम् त्वन्नाभिपङ्कजाज्जातः पञ्चवक्त्रः पितामहः
verses.transliteration: prakṛtistvaṃ pumān rudras tvayi vīryaṃ samāhitam tvannābhipaṅkajājjātaḥ pañcavaktraḥ pitāmahaḥ
verses.translation: iiv&ya — kaly&parfipfiya ST. Cf. Ahobala:
verses.hindi: विष्णुमायानिरसनं देवतापरमार्थदम्। वाञ्छासिद््रिप्रदं चैव ऋद्द्रिप्रज्ञादिसाधनम्
verses.wordMeaning: iiv&ya — kaly&parfipfiya ST. Cf. Ahobala:
verses.commentary: Sense: iiv&ya — kaly&parfipfiya ST. Cf. Ahobala:

verses.sanskrit: सृष्ट्यर्थेन जगत्पूर्वं शङ्करं नीललोहितम् ललाटे चिन्तयामास तपस्युग्रे व्यवस्थितः
verses.transliteration: sṛṣṭyarthena jagatpūrvaṃ śaṅkaraṃ nīlalohitam lalāṭe cintayāmāsa tapasyugre vyavasthitaḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to the lord greater than the greatest. 001 Obeisance to Vidva, to Vifvamfirti ( cosmic-formed), to Vignu- kalatra (one with Vi gnu as bride 909 (since Vigrju represents Prakyti), to Vignukgetra (having Vifpu as wife), to Bhanu (the blazing one), toKaivarta (fisherman), to Kirata (hunter), to the great hunter, to the permanent being, to Bhairava worthy of being sought refuge in, to one of the form of Mahabhairava, to the annihilator of Man-lion, to the slayer of Kama, Kala and the Tripuras, to the destroyer of great tangles of P&a (bond- age), to one who causes the end of Vigiu's Mfiya, to Tryam- baka (three-eyed), to Tryakgara (three-syllabled one), to Sipivigta 003 (bold man in the midst of rays of light), to the bountiful one, to the conqueror of Mftyu (death), to Sarva, to Sarvajfia (the omniscient), to the enemy of sacrifice. Obei- sance to the lord of Makha (sacrifice), to the most excellent one, to you of the form of fire, to Mahaghraa (one of huge nose), to Mahajihva (one of long tongue), to the deity that sets Prana and Apana in motion, to one of three Gunas, to the the lord who identifies himself with the continuous flow of mundane existence, to the deity who makes the great Yantra function, to one having the moon, fire and sun (as his eyes), to the cause of the mysterious liberation, to the bestower of boons, to the incarnation, to the cause of all reasons.
verses.hindi: इदं तु शरभाकारं परं रूपं पिनाकिनः। प्रकाशितव्यं भक्तेषु चिरेषूद्यमितेषु च तैरेव पठितव्यं च श्रोतव्यं च शिवात्मभिः। शिवोत्सवेषु सर्वेषु चतुर्दश्यष्टमीषु च
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to the lord greater than the greatest. 001 Obeisance to Vidva, to Vifvamfirti ( cosmic-formed), to Vignu- kalatra (one with Vi gnu as bride 909 (since Vigrju represents Prakyti), to Vignukgetra (having Vifpu as wife), to Bhanu (the blazing one),…
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to the lord greater than the greatest. 001 Obeisance to Vidva, to Vifvamfirti ( cosmic-formed), to Vignu- kalatra (one with Vi gnu as bride 909 (since Vigrju represents Prakyti), to Vignukgetra (having Vifpu as wife), to Bhanu (the blazing one),…

verses.sanskrit: तल्ललाटादभूच्छंभोः सृष्ट्यर्थं तन्न दूषणम् अंशो ऽहं देवदेवस्य महाभैरवरूपिणः
verses.transliteration: tallalāṭādabhūcchaṃbhoḥ sṛṣṭyarthaṃ tanna dūṣaṇam aṃśo 'haṃ devadevasya mahābhairavarūpiṇaḥ
verses.translation: par&t paratar&ya. para is jlva (the individual soul) *. paratara is Siva (the supreme soul).
verses.hindi: पटेत्प्रतिष्ठाकालेषु शिवसन्निधिकारणम् चोरव्याघ्राहिसिंहान्तकृतो राजभयेषु च
verses.wordMeaning: par&t paratar&ya. para is jlva (the individual soul) *. paratara is Siva (the supreme soul).
verses.commentary: Sense: par&t paratar&ya. para is jlva (the individual soul) *. paratara is Siva (the supreme soul).

verses.sanskrit: त्वत्संहारे नियुक्तो ऽस्मि विनयेन बलेन च एवं रक्षो विदार्यैव त्वं शक्तिकलया युतः
verses.transliteration: tvatsaṃhāre niyukto 'smi vinayena balena ca evaṃ rakṣo vidāryaiva tvaṃ śaktikalayā yutaḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to Kapalin [one having the skull (in the hand) ], to the terrible one, to the lord of meritorious renown, to the Amogha (one who is never futile), to the fiery-eyed one, to Nakuli&a, to Sambhu, to the greatest physician, to one having shaven head, to one holding a staff, to one of yogic form, to the lord having the cloud for vehicle. Obeisance to the lord of Parvati, to the unmanifest, to one devoid of grief, to the steady one, to one with steady bow, to Sth&u, to one having tigerskin as garment, to the cause of the five substances, to the bestower of boons, to one of a simple foot, to one who has the crescent moon on his head, to the king of Adhvaras 904 (sacri- fices ), obeisance to the lord of yogins.
verses.hindi: उल्कापाते महावाते विना वृष्ट्यातिवृष्टिषु भगवान् महेश्वरद्वारा वीरभद्रका आवाहन”नृसिंहद्वारा शिवस्तुति
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to Kapalin [one having the skull (in the hand) ], to the terrible one, to the lord of meritorious renown, to the Amogha (one who is never futile), to the fiery-eyed one, to Nakuli&a, to Sambhu, to the greatest physician, to one having shaven head,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to Kapalin [one having the skull (in the hand) ], to the terrible one, to the lord of meritorious renown, to the Amogha (one who is never futile), to the fiery-eyed one, to Nakuli&a, to Sambhu, to the greatest physician, to one having shaven head,…

verses.sanskrit: अहङ्कारावलेपेन गर्जसि त्वमतन्द्रितः उपकारो ह्यसाधूनाम् अपकाराय केवलम्
verses.transliteration: ahaṅkārāvalepena garjasi tvamatandritaḥ upakāro hyasādhūnām apakārāya kevalam
verses.translation: Obeisance to the lord of yogins, to the permanent Being, to the truthful Being, to Paramegthin, to the Atman of all, to the lord of all, to you once, twice, thrice, four times, five times, ten times, a thousand times, unlimited number of times infinite number of times. Obeisance, obeisance, obeisance, again and again to you.
verses.hindi: फफफाफफफफफफफफफफफफफफफफफ फफफफफफफफफफफफफफफफफफकी
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to the lord of yogins, to the permanent Being, to the truthful Being, to Paramegthin, to the Atman of all, to the lord of all, to you once, twice, thrice, four times, five times, ten times, a thousand times, unlimited number of times infinite number of times.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to the lord of yogins, to the permanent Being, to the truthful Being, to Paramegthin, to the Atman of all, to the lord of all, to you once, twice, thrice, four times, five times, ten times, a thousand times, unlimited number of times infinite number of times.…

verses.sanskrit: यदि सिंह महेशानं स्वपुनर्भूत मन्यसे न त्वं स्रष्टा न संहर्ता न स्वतन्त्रो हि कुत्रचित्
verses.transliteration: yadi siṃha maheśānaṃ svapunarbhūta manyase na tvaṃ sraṣṭā na saṃhartā na svatantro hi kutracit
verses.translation: After eulogising Sarabhefvara (Siva) with these hund- red and eight names identical with nectar, Nrsiihha prayed again to the lord (in the form of a Sarabha).
verses.hindi: विष्णु-को नमस्कार है॥ १९१--११३॥ इतना कहकर महाबली भगवान् वीरभद्र सभी
verses.wordMeaning: After eulogising Sarabhefvara (Siva) with these hund- red and eight names identical with nectar, Nrsiihha prayed again to the lord (in the form of a Sarabha).
verses.commentary: Sense: After eulogising Sarabhefvara (Siva) with these hund- red and eight names identical with nectar, Nrsiihha prayed again to the lord (in the form of a Sarabha).

verses.sanskrit: कुलालचक्रवच्छक्त्या प्रेरितो ऽसि पिनाकिना अद्यापि तव निक्षिप्तं कपालं कूर्मरूपिणः
verses.transliteration: kulālacakravacchaktyā prerito 'si pinākinā adyāpi tava nikṣiptaṃ kapālaṃ kūrmarūpiṇaḥ
verses.translation: O ParameSvara, whenever I am defiled by ignorance and great haughtiness I must be saved by you.
verses.hindi: समयसे शंकरजी नृसिंहके चर्मको वस्त्रके रूपमें धारण करने लगे और नृसिंहका मुण्ड उनकी मुण्डमालामें मणिके रूपमें शोभा पाने लगा
verses.wordMeaning: O ParameSvara, whenever I am defiled by ignorance and great haughtiness I must be saved by you.
verses.commentary: Sense: O ParameSvara, whenever I am defiled by ignorance and great haughtiness I must be saved by you.

verses.sanskrit: हरहारलतामध्ये मुग्ध कस्मान्न बुध्यसे विस्मृतं किं तदंशेन दंष्ट्रोत्पातनपीडितः
verses.transliteration: harahāralatāmadhye mugdha kasmānna budhyase vismṛtaṃ kiṃ tadaṃśena daṃṣṭrotpātanapīḍitaḥ
verses.translation: The delighted Man-lion thus submitted to Sankara. Then Virabhadra, said: "O Vi$nu, you are indeed a weakling. You have been defeated till the end of your life". Then Vira- bhadra skinned off his body which was now left only with bone and then reduced him to a mere face. 906
verses.hindi: तदनन्तर विस्मयसे प्रसन्न नेत्रवाले सभी देवतागण भयरहित होकर इस कथाको कहते हुए जैसे आये थे, वैसे ही वापस चले गये जो मनुष्य इस पुण्यप्रद तथा वेदमय श्रेष्ठ आख्यानको पढ़ता अथवा सुनता है, उसके सभी दुःखोंका नाश हो जाता है। यह आख्यान धन्य बनानेवाला, यश देनेवाला, आयु प्रदान करनेवाला,
verses.wordMeaning: The delighted Man-lion thus submitted to Sankara. Then Virabhadra, said: "O Vi$nu, you are indeed a weakling. You have been defeated till the end of your life". Then Vira- bhadra skinned off his body which was now left only with bone and then reduced him to a mere face. 906
verses.commentary: Sense: The delighted Man-lion thus submitted to Sankara. Then Virabhadra, said: "O Vi$nu, you are indeed a weakling. You have been defeated till the end of your life". Then Vira- bhadra skinned off his body which was now left only with bone and then reduced him to a mere face. 906

verses.sanskrit: वाराहविग्रहस्ते ऽद्य साक्रोशं तारकारिणा दग्धो ऽसि यस्य शूलाग्रे विष्वक्सेनच्छलाद्भवान्
verses.transliteration: vārāhavigrahaste 'dya sākrośaṃ tārakāriṇā dagdho 'si yasya śūlāgre viṣvaksenacchalādbhavān
verses.translation: u O Virabhadra, all of us including Brahma have been enlivened by you by your mere sight like the trees by the cloud. You are that deity fearing whom the fire burns, the sun
verses.hindi: रोगरहित करनेवाला, पुष्टिकी वृद्धि करनेवाला, सभी विघ्नोंको शान्त करनेवाला, सभी व्याधियोंको नष्ट करनेवाला, अकाल मृत्युका शमन करनेवाला, परमशान्ति प्रदान करनेवाला, मंगलकारक, शत्रु-समूहका दमन
verses.wordMeaning: u O Virabhadra, all of us including Brahma have been enlivened by you by your mere sight like the trees by the cloud. You are that deity fearing whom the fire burns, the sun
verses.commentary: Sense: u O Virabhadra, all of us including Brahma have been enlivened by you by your mere sight like the trees by the cloud. You are that deity fearing whom the fire burns, the sun

verses.sanskrit: दक्षयज्ञे शिरश्छिन्नं मया ते यज्ञरूपिणः अद्यापि तव पुत्रस्य ब्रह्मणः पञ्चमं शिरः
verses.transliteration: dakṣayajñe śiraśchinnaṃ mayā te yajñarūpiṇaḥ adyāpi tava putrasya brahmaṇaḥ pañcamaṃ śiraḥ
verses.translation: O Paramefvara, who are we to understand you the support of the universe? 906 Know that we are unable to des- cribe your beauty of form.
verses.hindi: करनेवाला, सभी मानसिक रोगोंका विनाश करनेवाला, बुरे स्वप्नोंका निवारण करनेवाला, सभी भूत-प्रेतको दूर करनेवाला, दुष्ट ग्रहोंका क्षय करनेवाला, पुत्र-पौत्रकी बृद्धि करनेवाला, योग-सिद्धि प्रदान करनेवाला, भली- भाँति शिवज्ञानको प्रकाशित करनेवाला, शेषलोकका सोपानस्वरूप, वांछित फलोंको सिद्ध करनेवाला, विष्णुमायाको दूर करनेवाला, देवताओंके परमार्थको देनेवाला, वांछाकी सिद्धि प्रदान करनेवाला और ऋद्ध,
verses.wordMeaning: O Paramefvara, who are we to understand you the support of the universe? 906 Know that we are unable to des- cribe your beauty of form.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Paramefvara, who are we to understand you the support of the universe? 906 Know that we are unable to des- cribe your beauty of form.

verses.sanskrit: छिन्नं तमेनाभिसंधं तदंशं तस्य तद्बलम् निर्जितस्त्वं दधीचेन संग्रामे समरुद्गणः
verses.transliteration: chinnaṃ tamenābhisaṃdhaṃ tadaṃśaṃ tasya tadbalam nirjitastvaṃ dadhīcena saṃgrāme samarudgaṇaḥ
verses.translation: O Overlord of the Gaias, protect us in the course of all calamities. O lord with eleven souls, you are the embodi- ment of Siva.
verses.hindi: प्रज्ञा आदि देनेवाला है
verses.wordMeaning: O Overlord of the Gaias, protect us in the course of all calamities. O lord with eleven souls, you are the embodi- ment of Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Overlord of the Gaias, protect us in the course of all calamities. O lord with eleven souls, you are the embodi- ment of Siva.

verses.sanskrit: कण्डूयमाने शिरसि कथं तद्विस्मृतं त्वया चक्रं विक्रमतो यस्य चक्रपाणे तव प्रियम्
verses.transliteration: kaṇḍūyamāne śirasi kathaṃ tadvismṛtaṃ tvayā cakraṃ vikramato yasya cakrapāṇe tava priyam
verses.translation: O Siva, on seeing these incarnations of yours let not doubt about you enter us. Let no worry trouble us. You have unmeasured forms as black berries on the ridges of mountains. 907 Please withdraw this form. Let it not frighten the world.
verses.hindi: पिनाकधारी शिव-के इस शरभकी आकृतिवाले शरेष्ठ रूपको स्थिर प्रज्ञावाले उत्सुक भक्तोंमें प्रकाशित करना चाहिए और उन्हीं शिवसमर्पित मनवाले भक्तोंके द्वारा शिवके सभी उत्सवोंमें और अष्टमी तथा चतुर्दशीके दिन इसका पाठ तथा श्रवण किया जाना चाहिए। शिव- प्रतिष्ठाके अवसरोंपर शिवकी सन्निधि प्राप्त करनेवाले इस स्तोत्रको पढ़ना चाहिए। अतः चोर-बाघ-सर्प-सिंह आदिसे भय होनेपर, राजासे भय उत्पन्न होनेपर, इस
verses.wordMeaning: O Siva, on seeing these incarnations of yours let not doubt about you enter us. Let no worry trouble us. You have unmeasured forms as black berries on the ridges of mountains. 907 Please withdraw this form. Let it not frighten the world.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Siva, on seeing these incarnations of yours let not doubt about you enter us. Let no worry trouble us. You have unmeasured forms as black berries on the ridges of mountains. 907 Please withdraw this form. Let it not frighten the world.

verses.sanskrit: कुतः प्राप्तं कृतं केन त्वया तदपि विस्मृतम् ते मया सकला लोका गृहीतास्त्वं पयोनिधौ
verses.transliteration: kutaḥ prāptaṃ kṛtaṃ kena tvayā tadapi vismṛtam te mayā sakalā lokā gṛhītāstvaṃ payonidhau
verses.translation: The brahmins conversant with the Vedas know that Rudra has two bodies: one Ghora ( the terrible) and the other Siva (calm and pleasing). Each one of them is manifold.
verses.hindi: 'लोकमें अन्य उत्पात-भूकम्प-दावाग्नि, धूलवृष्टि (आँधी)
verses.wordMeaning: The brahmins conversant with the Vedas know that Rudra has two bodies: one Ghora ( the terrible) and the other Siva (calm and pleasing). Each one of them is manifold.
verses.commentary: Sense: The brahmins conversant with the Vedas know that Rudra has two bodies: one Ghora ( the terrible) and the other Siva (calm and pleasing). Each one of them is manifold.

verses.sanskrit: निद्रापरवशः शेषे स कथं सात्त्विको भवान् त्वदादिस्तम्बपर्यन्तं रुद्रशक्तिविजृम्भितम्
verses.transliteration: nidrāparavaśaḥ śeṣe sa kathaṃ sāttviko bhavān tvadādistambaparyantaṃ rudraśaktivijṛmbhitam
verses.translation: O Mahefvara, we, the chief of Devas, Brahma, Visnu. Indra, Soma and all other Devas and Asuras are born of you.
verses.hindi: स्तोत्रको पढ़ता अथवा सुनता है, वह रुद्रत्व प्राप्त काऊ स रुद्रत्वं समासाद्य रुद्रस्यानुचरो भवेत् ॥ १२८  रुद्रका अनुचर हो जाता है॥ १२३--१२८॥
verses.wordMeaning: O Mahefvara, we, the chief of Devas, Brahma, Visnu. Indra, Soma and all other Devas and Asuras are born of you.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Mahefvara, we, the chief of Devas, Brahma, Visnu. Indra, Soma and all other Devas and Asuras are born of you.

verses.sanskrit: शक्तिमानभितस्त्वं च ह्य् अनलस्त्वं च मोहितः तत्तेजसो ऽपि माहात्म्यं युवां द्रष्टुं न हि क्षमौ
verses.transliteration: śaktimānabhitastvaṃ ca hy analastvaṃ ca mohitaḥ tattejaso 'pi māhātmyaṃ yuvāṃ draṣṭuṃ na hi kṣamau
verses.translation: O lord, you support the universe after dividing your body as Brahma, Indra, Visnu, Yama, etc. in eight ways. 008 Protect us, Devas, by granting us our desired gifts.
verses.hindi: कथं जघान भगवान् भगनेत्रहरो हरः॥
verses.wordMeaning: O lord, you support the universe after dividing your body as Brahma, Indra, Visnu, Yama, etc. in eight ways. 008 Protect us, Devas, by granting us our desired gifts.
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord, you support the universe after dividing your body as Brahma, Indra, Visnu, Yama, etc. in eight ways. 008 Protect us, Devas, by granting us our desired gifts.

verses.sanskrit: स्थूला ये हि प्रपश्यन्ति तद्विष्णोः परमं पदम् द्यावापृथिव्या इन्द्राग्नियमस्य वरुणस्य च
verses.transliteration: sthūlā ye hi prapaśyanti tadviṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam dyāvāpṛthivyā indrāgniyamasya varuṇasya ca
verses.translation: The lord Virabhadra spoke to Devas and the ancient great sages. Just as water mixed with water, milk with milk, and ghee with ghee, all merge into one, in the same manner Visu has merged into Siva. This deity in the form of Nrsimha has great strength and is haughty.
verses.hindi: आसीदन्तकसङ्काशस्तपसा लब्धविक्रमः। तेन देवाः सगन्धर्वाः सयक्षोरगराक्षसाः ॥ निर्जिताः समरे सर्वे ब्रह्मा च भगवानजः। जित्वैव देवसङ्घातं ब्रह्माणं वै जलन्धरः॥ जगाम देवदेवेशं विष्णुं विश्वहरं गुरुम्।
verses.wordMeaning: The lord Virabhadra spoke to Devas and the ancient great sages. Just as water mixed with water, milk with milk, and ghee with ghee, all merge into one, in the same manner Visu has merged into Siva. This deity in the form of Nrsimha has great strength and is haughty.
verses.commentary: Sense: The lord Virabhadra spoke to Devas and the ancient great sages. Just as water mixed with water, milk with milk, and ghee with ghee, all merge into one, in the same manner Visu has merged into Siva. This deity in the form of Nrsimha has great strength and is haughty.

verses.sanskrit: ध्वान्तोदरे शशाङ्कस्य जनित्वा परमेश्वरः कालो ऽसि त्वं महाकालः कालकालो महेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: dhvāntodare śaśāṅkasya janitvā parameśvaraḥ kālo 'si tvaṃ mahākālaḥ kālakālo maheśvaraḥ
verses.translation: This man-lion has been made to function by him who causes the annihilation of the universe. He should be
verses.hindi: जलन्धरोऽपि तं जित्वा देवदेवं जनार्दनम्॥
verses.wordMeaning: This man-lion has been made to function by him who causes the annihilation of the universe. He should be
verses.commentary: Sense: This man-lion has been made to function by him who causes the annihilation of the universe. He should be

verses.sanskrit: अतस्त्वमुग्रकलया मृत्योर्मृत्युर्भविष्यसि स्थिरधन्वा क्षयो वीरो वीरो विश्वाधिकः प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: atastvamugrakalayā mṛtyormṛtyurbhaviṣyasi sthiradhanvā kṣayo vīro vīro viśvādhikaḥ prabhuḥ
verses.translation: dh&tukye — jagaddh&rak&ya ST. the support of the universe.
verses.hindi: सर्वे जिता मया युद्धे शङ्करो ह्यजितो रणे॥ अहमेव भवत्वं च ब्रह्मत्वं वैष्णवं तथा॥
verses.wordMeaning: dh&tukye — jagaddh&rak&ya ST. the support of the universe.
verses.commentary: Sense: dh&tukye — jagaddh&rak&ya ST. the support of the universe.

verses.sanskrit: उपहस्ता ज्वरं भीमो मृगपक्षिहिरण्मयः शास्ताशेषस्य जगतो न त्वं नैवचतुर्मुखः
verses.transliteration: upahastā jvaraṃ bhīmo mṛgapakṣihiraṇmayaḥ śāstāśeṣasya jagato na tvaṃ naivacaturmukhaḥ
verses.translation: ST. interprets 1 04-1 05 as follows: 'O lord, on looking at these incarnations of yours, let not a doubt enter our mind. May we not give uf thinking on you. Withdraw your dreadful form, shining as the black berries on a mount. Do not destroy this world which you pervade by your soul.
verses.hindi: जगर्जुरुच्चैः पापिष्ठा मृत्युदर्शनतत्पराः। हैत्यैरेतैस्तथान्यैश्च
verses.wordMeaning: ST. interprets 1 04-1 05 as follows: 'O lord, on looking at these incarnations of yours, let not a doubt enter our mind. May we not give uf thinking on you. Withdraw your dreadful form, shining as the black berries on a mount.…
verses.commentary: Sense: ST. interprets 1 04-1 05 as follows: 'O lord, on looking at these incarnations of yours, let not a doubt enter our mind. May we not give uf thinking on you. Withdraw your dreadful form, shining as the black berries on a mount.…

verses.sanskrit: इत्थं सर्वं समालोक्य संहरात्मानम् आत्मना नो चेदिदानीं क्रोधस्य महाभैरवरूपिणः
verses.transliteration: itthaṃ sarvaṃ samālokya saṃharātmānam ātmanā no cedidānīṃ krodhasya mahābhairavarūpiṇaḥ
verses.translation: aftadhfi tanum, see note 326.
verses.hindi: ऋषिगण बोले--हे रोमहर्षण! है सुब्रत! सिरप जटाधारण करनेवाले तथा भगके नेत्रोंका हरण करनेवाले भगवान् शिवने इन्द्रके समान पराक्रमी जलन्धरका वध कैसे किया; हम लोगोंको यह बतानेकी कृपा सूतजी बोले-- है ऋषियो ! जलमण्डलसे उत्पन
verses.wordMeaning: aftadhfi tanum, see note 326.
verses.commentary: Sense: aftadhfi tanum, see note 326.

verses.sanskrit: वज्राशनिरिव स्थाणोस् त्व् एवं मृत्युः पतिष्यति इत्युक्तो वीरभद्रेण नृसिंहः क्रोधविह्वलः
verses.transliteration: vajrāśaniriva sthāṇos tv evaṃ mṛtyuḥ patiṣyati ityukto vīrabhadreṇa nṛsiṃhaḥ krodhavihvalaḥ
verses.translation: After saying this, lord Virabhadra of great strength vanished there itself, even as all the Bhutas were watching.
verses.hindi: जलन्धर नामसे प्रसिद्ध यमराजतुल्य एक असुर था;  वह अपनी तपस्यासे बडा पराक्रमी हो गया था।
verses.wordMeaning: After saying this, lord Virabhadra of great strength vanished there itself, even as all the Bhutas were watching.
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying this, lord Virabhadra of great strength vanished there itself, even as all the Bhutas were watching.

verses.sanskrit: ननाद तनुवेगेन तं गृहीतुं प्रचक्रमे अत्रान्तरे महाघोरं विपक्षभयकारणम्
verses.transliteration: nanāda tanuvegena taṃ gṛhītuṃ pracakrame atrāntare mahāghoraṃ vipakṣabhayakāraṇam
verses.translation: Ever since that day, Sankara is said to wear the skin of Nrsimha (as his garment). The lion's face is also set as the leading bead in the garland of skulls.
verses.hindi: उसने युद्धमें गन्धर्व, यक्ष, उरग तथा राक्षसोंसहित सभी देवसमुदाय तथा ब्रह्माको जीत करके वह जलन्धर
verses.wordMeaning: Ever since that day, Sankara is said to wear the skin of Nrsimha (as his garment). The lion's face is also set as the leading bead in the garland of skulls.
verses.commentary: Sense: Ever since that day, Sankara is said to wear the skin of Nrsimha (as his garment). The lion's face is also set as the leading bead in the garland of skulls.

verses.sanskrit: गगनव्यापि दुर्धर्षशैवतेजःसमुद्भवम् वीरभद्रस्य तद्रूपं तत्क्षणादेव दृश्यते
verses.transliteration: gaganavyāpi durdharṣaśaivatejaḥsamudbhavam vīrabhadrasya tadrūpaṃ tatkṣaṇādeva dṛśyate
verses.translation: Thereafter, Devas became free from agony. They began to repeat and glorify this story. Their eyes became beaming with wonder. They went back to their respective abodes.
verses.hindi: विश्वविनाशक देवदेवेश्वर गुरु विष्णुके यहाँ पहुँचा। उन
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter, Devas became free from agony. They began to repeat and glorify this story. Their eyes became beaming with wonder. They went back to their respective abodes.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter, Devas became free from agony. They began to repeat and glorify this story. Their eyes became beaming with wonder. They went back to their respective abodes.

verses.sanskrit: न तद्धिरण्मयं सौम्यं न सौरं नाग्निसंभवम् न तडिच्चन्द्रसदृशम् अनौपम्यं महेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: na taddhiraṇmayaṃ saumyaṃ na sauraṃ nāgnisaṃbhavam na taḍiccandrasadṛśam anaupamyaṃ maheśvaram
verses.translation: If any one reads or listens to this great and holy narrative pertaining to Devas he becomes free from miseries.
verses.hindi: दोनोंमें दिन-रात निरन्तर युद्ध होता रहा और उसने मधुसूदन (विष्णु)-को भी पराजित कर दिया ॥ ४-५/२॥ उन देवदेव जनार्दनको भी जीतकर न्यायबुद्धिवाे जलन्धरने ईश्वर (शिव)-को जीतनेके लिये दिंतिकें पुत्रोसे कहा--'मैने युद्धमें सबको जीत लिया है, केवल शंकर ही अजित रह गये हैं। है श्रेष्ठ दानवो ! गणेश्वर
verses.wordMeaning: If any one reads or listens to this great and holy narrative pertaining to Devas he becomes free from miseries.
verses.commentary: Sense: If any one reads or listens to this great and holy narrative pertaining to Devas he becomes free from miseries.

verses.sanskrit: तदा तेजांसि सर्वाणि तस्मिन् लीनानि शाङ्करे ततो व्यक्तो महातेजा व्यक्ते संभवतस्ततः
verses.transliteration: tadā tejāṃsi sarvāṇi tasmin līnāni śāṅkare tato vyakto mahātejā vyakte saṃbhavatastataḥ
verses.translation: It is conducive to the attainment of wealth, renown, longevity and good health. It increases nourishment, subdues all obstacles and dispels all ailments.
verses.hindi: तथा नन्दीसहित उन सर्व ईशानको क्षणभरमें जीतर्क मैं तुम लोगोंको शिव, ब्रह्मा, विष्णु तथा इद्रका पद प्रदान कर दूँगा'॥ ६-८१, ॥
verses.wordMeaning: It is conducive to the attainment of wealth, renown, longevity and good health. It increases nourishment, subdues all obstacles and dispels all ailments.
verses.commentary: Sense: It is conducive to the attainment of wealth, renown, longevity and good health. It increases nourishment, subdues all obstacles and dispels all ailments.

verses.sanskrit: रुद्रसाधारणं चैव चिह्नितं विकृताकृति ततः संहाररूपेण सुव्यक्तः परमेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: rudrasādhāraṇaṃ caiva cihnitaṃ vikṛtākṛti tataḥ saṃhārarūpeṇa suvyaktaḥ parameśvaraḥ
verses.translation: It prevents premature death. It causes great peace. It is auspicious. It subdues multitudes of enemies and destroys all mental agonies.
verses.hindi: तब जलन्धरका वचन सुनकर वे सभी अर्ष!  पापी तथा मृत्युके दर्शनमें तत्पर दानव उच्च
verses.wordMeaning: It prevents premature death. It causes great peace. It is auspicious. It subdues multitudes of enemies and destroys all mental agonies.
verses.commentary: Sense: It prevents premature death. It causes great peace. It is auspicious. It subdues multitudes of enemies and destroys all mental agonies.

verses.sanskrit: पश्यतां सर्वदेवानां जयशब्दादिमङ्गलैः सहस्रबाहुर् जटिलश् चन्द्रार्धकृतशेखरः
verses.transliteration: paśyatāṃ sarvadevānāṃ jayaśabdādimaṅgalaiḥ sahasrabāhur jaṭilaś candrārdhakṛtaśekharaḥ
verses.translation: It removes evil dreams; it prevents evil spirits; it reduces the ill effects of poison and evil planets; it causes the increase of sons and grandsons.
verses.hindi: अध्याय ९७  जलन्धर-वधको कथा
verses.wordMeaning: It removes evil dreams; it prevents evil spirits; it reduces the ill effects of poison and evil planets; it causes the increase of sons and grandsons.
verses.commentary: Sense: It removes evil dreams; it prevents evil spirits; it reduces the ill effects of poison and evil planets; it causes the increase of sons and grandsons.

verses.sanskrit: स मृगार्धशरीरेण पक्षाभ्यां चञ्चुना द्विजाः अतितीक्ष्णमहादंष्ट्रो वज्रतुल्यनखायुधः
verses.transliteration: sa mṛgārdhaśarīreṇa pakṣābhyāṃ cañcunā dvijāḥ atitīkṣṇamahādaṃṣṭro vajratulyanakhāyudhaḥ
verses.translation: It bestows yogic Siddhis; it illuminates the know- ledge of Siva; it is the staircase leading to the world of Se§a; it is the sole means of attaining all desired objects.
verses.hindi: भ्रवोऽपि दृष्ट्वा हैत्येन्द्रं मेरुकूटमिव स्थितम् लगे। इसके बाद वह बलशाली जलन्धर रथ, हाथी तथा घोड़ोंपर सवार शस्त्रयुक्त इन हैत्यों तथा अन्य सैनिकों -के साथ सावधान होकर शिवजीकी ओर
verses.wordMeaning: It bestows yogic Siddhis; it illuminates the know- ledge of Siva; it is the staircase leading to the world of Se§a; it is the sole means of attaining all desired objects.
verses.commentary: Sense: It bestows yogic Siddhis; it illuminates the know- ledge of Siva; it is the staircase leading to the world of Se§a; it is the sole means of attaining all desired objects.

verses.sanskrit: कण्ठे कालो महाबाहुश् चतुष्पाद् वह्निसंभवः युगान्तोद्यतजीमूतभीमगंभीरनिःस्वनः
verses.transliteration: kaṇṭhe kālo mahābāhuś catuṣpād vahnisaṃbhavaḥ yugāntodyatajīmūtabhīmagaṃbhīraniḥsvanaḥ
verses.translation: It dispels the Maya of Visnu; it gives the real know- ledge of the deities; it bestows the Siddhi of all ambitions; it is the means of achievement of prosperity and wisdom.
verses.hindi: तब मेरुके शिखरके समान स्थित उस हैत्यराजको देखकर तथा उसके अवध्यत्वको दूसरोंसे सुनकर भगके नेत्रका हरण करनेवाले तथा लोकोंकी रक्षा करनेवाले प्रभु शिवने, जो पार्वती, नन्दी तथा गणोंसहित
verses.wordMeaning: It dispels the Maya of Visnu; it gives the real know- ledge of the deities; it bestows the Siddhi of all ambitions; it is the means of achievement of prosperity and wisdom.
verses.commentary: Sense: It dispels the Maya of Visnu; it gives the real know- ledge of the deities; it bestows the Siddhi of all ambitions; it is the means of achievement of prosperity and wisdom.

verses.sanskrit: समं कुपितवृत्ताग्निव्यावृत्तनयनत्रयः स्पष्टदंष्ट्रो ऽधरोष्ठश् च हुङ्कारेण युतो हरः
verses.transliteration: samaṃ kupitavṛttāgnivyāvṛttanayanatrayaḥ spaṣṭadaṃṣṭro 'dharoṣṭhaś ca huṅkāreṇa yuto haraḥ
verses.translation: This great form of the Pinaka- bearing lord having the shape of the Sarabha should be revealed among devotees and also when great endeavours are undertaken.
verses.hindi: वहाँ थे, ब्रह्माके वचनकी रक्षा करते हुए हँसते हुए उस हैत्यसे कहा-- है असुरेश्‍वर! अब इस युद्धसे कौन-सा कार्य सिद्ध होगा? मेरे बाणोंके द्वारा छिन्न- भिन्न अंगोंवाला होकर प्रसन्ततापूर्वक मरनेके लिये कानोंको विदीर्ण करनेवाले उस वचनको सुनकर असुरसेनाके स्वामी जलन्धरने भी सुरेश्वर शिव -से यह वचन कहा-हे महाबाहो, है देवदेव! है वृषभध्वज ! ऐसी बात मत बोलिये; है हर! मैं चन्द्रकिरणोंके समान
verses.wordMeaning: This great form of the Pinaka- bearing lord having the shape of the Sarabha should be revealed among devotees and also when great endeavours are undertaken.
verses.commentary: Sense: This great form of the Pinaka- bearing lord having the shape of the Sarabha should be revealed among devotees and also when great endeavours are undertaken.

verses.sanskrit: हरिस्तद्दर्शनादेव विनष्टबलविक्रमः बिभ्रद् और्म्यं सहस्रांशोर् अधः खद्योतविभ्रमम्
verses.transliteration: haristaddarśanādeva vinaṣṭabalavikramaḥ bibhrad aurmyaṃ sahasrāṃśor adhaḥ khadyotavibhramam
verses.translation: In the course of all festivals of Siva on Caturdasf (fourteenth) and on A$tami (eighth) days, this should be read and listened to by devotees whose minds dwell in Siva.
verses.hindi: चमकते हुए शस्त्रोंसे युद्ध करनेके लिये यहाँ आया
verses.wordMeaning: In the course of all festivals of Siva on Caturdasf (fourteenth) and on A$tami (eighth) days, this should be read and listened to by devotees whose minds dwell in Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the course of all festivals of Siva on Caturdasf (fourteenth) and on A$tami (eighth) days, this should be read and listened to by devotees whose minds dwell in Siva.

verses.sanskrit: अथ विभ्रम्य पक्षाभ्यां नाभिपादे ऽभ्युदारयन् पादावाबध्य पुच्छेन बाहुभ्यां बाहुमण्डलम्
verses.transliteration: atha vibhramya pakṣābhyāṃ nābhipāde 'bhyudārayan pādāvābadhya pucchena bāhubhyāṃ bāhumaṇḍalam
verses.translation: If one reads this at the installation of Siva's image, it establishes the presence of Siva. verses.sanskrit: आसीदन्तकसंकाशस् तपसा लब्धविक्रमः तेन देवाः सगन्धर्वाः सयक्षोरगराक्षसाः
verses.transliteration: āsīdantakasaṃkāśas tapasā labdhavikramaḥ tena devāḥ sagandharvāḥ sayakṣoragarākṣasāḥ
verses.translation: Siva saw the leader of the Daityas stationed on the peak of the Meru. He had already heard about his indestructi- bility through others. The destroyer of the eyes of Bhaga, the lord and protector of the worlds wanted to keep his promise to BrahmsL He was accompanied by Amba and Nandin and his Ganas. He said laughingly: — "O lord of Asuras, what purpose shall be served now with a fight?
verses.hindi: वध करनेके लिये शिवजीके द्वारा बनाये गये चक्रको प्राप्त करके उसीके द्वारा सभी महान् असुरों, धुन्धु आदि हैत्यों तथा अरसठ सौ अन्य असुरोंको बान्धवोसहित क्षणभरमें मारकर मैं आप देवताओंका उद्धार करूँगा॥ १७-१९ /२॥ सूतजी बोले--हे ऋषियो ! श्रेष्ठ देवताओंसे यह कहकर देवताओंमें श्रेष्ठ विष्णुने सुरश्रेष्ठ शिवका स्मरण करते हुए उन श्रेष्ठ शंकरको पूजा की। विश्वकर्माद्वारा निर्मित मेरुपर्वत-सदूश लिङ्गको हिमवान्के
verses.wordMeaning: Siva saw the leader of the Daityas stationed on the peak of the Meru. He had already heard about his indestructi- bility through others. The destroyer of the eyes of Bhaga,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Siva saw the leader of the Daityas stationed on the peak of the Meru. He had already heard about his indestructi- bility through others. The destroyer of the eyes of Bhaga,…

verses.sanskrit: निर्जिताः समरे सर्वे ब्रह्मा च भगवानजः जित्वैव देवसंघातं ब्रह्माणं वै जलन्धरः
verses.transliteration: nirjitāḥ samare sarve brahmā ca bhagavānajaḥ jitvaiva devasaṃghātaṃ brahmāṇaṃ vai jalandharaḥ
verses.translation: You have joyously attempted to die with your limbs pierced and split by my arrows."
verses.hindi: उत्तम शिखरपर विधिपूर्वक स्थापित करके त्वरितरुद्र तथा रुद्रसूक्तके द्वारा अभिषेक करके गन्ध आदिके द्वारा पूजा करके जनार्दने ज्योतिरूप मनोरम शिवको स्तुति की। पुनः अग्निमें देव रुद्रको पूजा करके और उन्हें
verses.wordMeaning: You have joyously attempted to die with your limbs pierced and split by my arrows."
verses.commentary: Sense: You have joyously attempted to die with your limbs pierced and split by my arrows."

verses.sanskrit: जगाम देवदेवेशं विष्णुं विश्वहरं गुरुम् तयोः समभवद्युद्धं दिवारात्रम् अविश्रमम्
verses.transliteration: jagāma devadeveśaṃ viṣṇuṃ viśvaharaṃ gurum tayoḥ samabhavadyuddhaṃ divārātram aviśramam
verses.translation: "O Jalandhara, O Asura, if you are strong enough to lift up the weapon evolved by me by my leg, stand face to face for fighting, and not otherwise"
verses.hindi: प्रणाम करके आदिमें भव नामवाले सहस्रनामके द्वारा क्रमसे आदिमें प्रणव तथा अन्तमें नमः लगाकर शिवको पूजा की। प्रारम्भमें भव नामवाले सहस्रनामके द्वारा प्रत्येक नामका उच्चारण करते हुए उन्होंने कमलपुष्पसे महेश्वर भगवान् शंकरको पूजा को। तदनन्तर उन्होंने अन्तमें स्वाहावाले भव आदि नामोंसे समिधा आदिके द्वारा विधिपूर्वक अग्निमें प्रत्येक नामको दस हजार आहुति
verses.wordMeaning: "O Jalandhara, O Asura, if you are strong enough to lift up the weapon evolved by me by my leg, stand face to face for fighting, and not otherwise"
verses.commentary: Sense: "O Jalandhara, O Asura, if you are strong enough to lift up the weapon evolved by me by my leg, stand face to face for fighting, and not otherwise"

verses.sanskrit: जलन्धरेशयोस्तेन निर्जितो मधुसूदनः जलन्धरो ऽपि तं जित्वा देवदेवं जनार्दनम्
verses.transliteration: jalandhareśayostena nirjito madhusūdanaḥ jalandharo 'pi taṃ jitvā devadevaṃ janārdanam
verses.translation: O Sankara, I will lift up my iron club and kill Nandin as well as you. Even as Garuda kills the water snakes I will destroy the worlds along with Devas. I am competent to annihilate all mobile and immobile beings, including Indr a. O MaheSvara, who is there in the three worlds who cannot be pierced by my arrows?
verses.hindi: श्रीविष्णुरुवाच भवः शिवो हरो रुद्रः पुरुषः पद्मलोचनः ॥
verses.wordMeaning: O Sankara, I will lift up my iron club and kill Nandin as well as you. Even as Garuda kills the water snakes I will destroy the worlds along with Devas. I am competent to annihilate all mobile and immobile beings, including Indr a. O MaheSvara,…
verses.commentary: Sense: O Sankara, I will lift up my iron club and kill Nandin as well as you. Even as Garuda kills the water snakes I will destroy the worlds along with Devas. I am competent to annihilate all mobile and immobile beings, including Indr a. O MaheSvara,…

verses.sanskrit: प्रोवाचेदं दितेः पुत्रान् न्यायधीर्जेतुमीश्वरम् सर्वे जिता मया युद्धे शङ्करो ह्यजितो रणे
verses.transliteration: provācedaṃ diteḥ putrān nyāyadhīrjetumīśvaram sarve jitā mayā yuddhe śaṅkaro hyajito raṇe
verses.translation: Within a short while, the three worlds consisting of the mobile and immobile beings were burnt by me. O Rudra, was any lord defeated by you by means of penance?
verses.hindi: वरीयान् वरदो वन्द्यः शङ्करः परमेश्वरः। सर्वज्ञः सर्वदेवादिगिरिधन्वा जटाधरः। चन्द्रापीडश्चन्द्रमौलिर्विद्वान् विश्वामरेश्वरः
verses.wordMeaning: Within a short while, the three worlds consisting of the mobile and immobile beings were burnt by me. O Rudra, was any lord defeated by you by means of penance?
verses.commentary: Sense: Within a short while, the three worlds consisting of the mobile and immobile beings were burnt by me. O Rudra, was any lord defeated by you by means of penance?

verses.sanskrit: तं जित्वा सर्वमीशानं गणपैर् नन्दिना क्षणात् अहमेव भवत्वं च ब्रह्मत्वं वैष्णवं तथा
verses.transliteration: taṃ jitvā sarvamīśānaṃ gaṇapair nandinā kṣaṇāt ahameva bhavatvaṃ ca brahmatvaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ tathā
verses.translation: Just as the serpents cannot bear even the odour of Garua, the lord of the birds, so also Indra, Agni, Yama, Kubera, Vayu, Vanina and others cannot bear me.
verses.hindi: ज्ञानगम्यो दृढप्रज्ञो देवदेवस्त्रिलोचनः
verses.wordMeaning: Just as the serpents cannot bear even the odour of Garua, the lord of the birds, so also Indra, Agni, Yama, Kubera, Vayu, Vanina and others cannot bear me.
verses.commentary: Sense: Just as the serpents cannot bear even the odour of Garua, the lord of the birds, so also Indra, Agni, Yama, Kubera, Vayu, Vanina and others cannot bear me.

verses.sanskrit: वासवत्वं च युष्माकं दास्ये दानवपुङ्गवाः जलन्धरवचः श्रुत्वा सर्वे ते दानवाधमाः
verses.transliteration: vāsavatvaṃ ca yuṣmākaṃ dāsye dānavapuṅgavāḥ jalandharavacaḥ śrutvā sarve te dānavādhamāḥ
verses.translation: O Sankara, neither in the heaven nor on the earth could my arms get rival. O lord of the Ganas, I have gone to all the mountains and attacked them.
verses.hindi: वामदेवो महादेवः पाण्डुः परिदूढोऽदूढः। विश्वरूपो विरूपाक्षो वागीशः शुचिरन्तरः सर्वप्रणयसंवादी वृषाङ्को वृषवाहनः। ईशः पिनाकी खट्वाङ्की चित्रवेषश्‍्चिरन्तनः
verses.wordMeaning: O Sankara, neither in the heaven nor on the earth could my arms get rival. O lord of the Ganas, I have gone to all the mountains and attacked them.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Sankara, neither in the heaven nor on the earth could my arms get rival. O lord of the Ganas, I have gone to all the mountains and attacked them.

verses.sanskrit: जगर्जुरुच्चैः पापिष्ठा मृत्युदर्शनतत्पराः दैत्यैरेतैस्तथान्यैश् च रथनागतुरङ्गमैः
verses.transliteration: jagarjuruccaiḥ pāpiṣṭhā mṛtyudarśanatatparāḥ daityairetaistathānyaiś ca rathanāgaturaṅgamaiḥ
verses.translation: Mandara 909 the lord of the mountains, the glorious Nila 910 and the splendid Meru 911 have been attacked by me with my staff-like arms. The mountain Meru fell when I scratched it with arms for removing their itching sensation.
verses.hindi: तमोहरो महायोगी गोप्ता ब्रह्माङ्गहज्जटी। कालकालः कृत्तिवासाः सुभगः प्रणवात्मकः
verses.wordMeaning: Mandara 909 the lord of the mountains, the glorious Nila 910 and the splendid Meru 911 have been attacked by me with my staff-like arms. The mountain Meru fell when I scratched it with arms for removing their itching sensation.
verses.commentary: Sense: Mandara 909 the lord of the mountains, the glorious Nila 910 and the splendid Meru 911 have been attacked by me with my staff-like arms. The mountain Meru fell when I scratched it with arms for removing their itching sensation.

verses.sanskrit: संनद्धैः सह संनह्य शर्वं प्रति ययौ बली भवो ऽपि दृष्ट्वा दैत्येन्द्रं मेरुकूटमिव स्थितम्
verses.transliteration: saṃnaddhaiḥ saha saṃnahya śarvaṃ prati yayau balī bhavo 'pi dṛṣṭvā daityendraṃ merukūṭamiva sthitam
verses.translation: Just for a sport, the Gariga was restrained with my arms on the mountain Himavan. A group of celestial women was caught and imprisoned by my servants.
verses.hindi: कुबेरबन्धुः श्रीकण्ठो लोकवर्णोत्तमोत्तमः सामान्यदेवः कोदण्डी नीलकण्ठः परश्वधी।
verses.wordMeaning: Just for a sport, the Gariga was restrained with my arms on the mountain Himavan. A group of celestial women was caught and imprisoned by my servants.
verses.commentary: Sense: Just for a sport, the Gariga was restrained with my arms on the mountain Himavan. A group of celestial women was caught and imprisoned by my servants.

verses.sanskrit: अवध्यत्वम् अपि श्रुत्वा तथान्यैर् भगनेत्रहा ब्रह्मणो वचनं रक्षन् रक्षको जगतां प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: avadhyatvam api śrutvā tathānyair bhaganetrahā brahmaṇo vacanaṃ rakṣan rakṣako jagatāṃ prabhuḥ
verses.translation: The mouth of the submarine fire was held by me and choked with the hand. Instantaneously all this was tnrned into a vast sheet of water.
verses.hindi: धर्मकर्माक्षमः क्षेत्रं भगवान् भगनेत्रभित्।
verses.wordMeaning: The mouth of the submarine fire was held by me and choked with the hand. Instantaneously all this was tnrned into a vast sheet of water.
verses.commentary: Sense: The mouth of the submarine fire was held by me and choked with the hand. Instantaneously all this was tnrned into a vast sheet of water.

verses.sanskrit: सांबः सनन्दी सगणः प्रोवाच प्रहसन्निव किं कृत्यमसुरेशान युद्धेनानेन सांप्रतम्
verses.transliteration: sāṃbaḥ sanandī sagaṇaḥ provāca prahasanniva kiṃ kṛtyamasureśāna yuddhenānena sāṃpratam
verses.translation: Airavata and other elephants were cast off by me into ihc water of the ocean. Lord Indra was hurled a hundred yojanas along with his chariot.
verses.hindi: दान्तोदयाकरो दक्षः कपदी कामशासनः । लोककर्ता भूतपतिर्महाकर्ता महौषधी।
verses.wordMeaning: Airavata and other elephants were cast off by me into ihc water of the ocean. Lord Indra was hurled a hundred yojanas along with his chariot.
verses.commentary: Sense: Airavata and other elephants were cast off by me into ihc water of the ocean. Lord Indra was hurled a hundred yojanas along with his chariot.

verses.sanskrit: मद्बाणैर्भिन्नसर्वाङ्गो मर्तुमभ्युद्यते मुदा जलन्धरो ऽपि तद्वाक्यं श्रुत्वा श्रोत्रविदारणम्
verses.transliteration: madbāṇairbhinnasarvāṅgo martumabhyudyate mudā jalandharo 'pi tadvākyaṃ śrutvā śrotravidāraṇam
verses.translation: Garuda too was bound by me along with Vi$nu by means of Nagapa£a. Urvasi and other women were imprisoned by me.
verses.hindi: अजातशत्रुरालोकः सम्भाव्यो हव्यवाहनः। लोककारो वेदकारः सूत्रकारः सनातनः
verses.wordMeaning: Garuda too was bound by me along with Vi$nu by means of Nagapa£a. Urvasi and other women were imprisoned by me.
verses.commentary: Sense: Garuda too was bound by me along with Vi$nu by means of Nagapa£a. Urvasi and other women were imprisoned by me.

verses.sanskrit: सुरेश्वरमुवाचेदं सुरेतरबलेश्वरः वाक्येनालं महाबाहो देवदेव वृषध्वज
verses.transliteration: sureśvaramuvācedaṃ suretarabaleśvaraḥ vākyenālaṃ mahābāho devadeva vṛṣadhvaja
verses.translation: With very great difficulty Indra got back Sac! alone after bowing down to me. O lord of Uma, you do not know me, Jalandhara the leader of the Daityas.
verses.hindi: देकर पुनः भव आदि नामोंसे  फ फ क फ़ क फ की फा फ की की मी मी मी फी फी मी जी जी फ भ फ फ फ़ फ फ छ  शम्भुकी इस प्रकार स्तुति को-॥ २ ०-२६१ he
verses.wordMeaning: With very great difficulty Indra got back Sac! alone after bowing down to me. O lord of Uma, you do not know me, Jalandhara the leader of the Daityas.
verses.commentary: Sense: With very great difficulty Indra got back Sac! alone after bowing down to me. O lord of Uma, you do not know me, Jalandhara the leader of the Daityas.

verses.sanskrit: चन्द्रांशुसन्निभैः शस्त्रैर् हर योद्धुमिहागतः निशम्यास्य वचः शूली पादाङ्गुष्ठेन लीलया महांभसि चकाराशु रथाङ्गं रौद्रमायुधम्
verses.transliteration: candrāṃśusannibhaiḥ śastrair hara yoddhumihāgataḥ niśamyāsya vacaḥ śūlī pādāṅguṣṭhena līlayā mahāṃbhasi cakārāśu rathāṅgaṃ raudramāyudham
verses.translation: Mahadeva who was addressed thus, burned his chariot then with the fire of his eye. 912
verses.hindi: श्रीविष्णु बोले भव-शिव, हर-रुद्र ह
verses.wordMeaning: Mahadeva who was addressed thus, burned his chariot then with the fire of his eye. 912
verses.commentary: Sense: Mahadeva who was addressed thus, burned his chariot then with the fire of his eye. 912

verses.sanskrit: कृत्वार्णवांभसि सितं भगवान् रथाङ्गं स्मृत्वा जगत्त्रयमनेन हताः सुराश् च दक्षान्धकान्तकपुरत्रययज्ञहर्ता लोकत्रयान्तककरः प्रहसंतदाह
verses.transliteration: kṛtvārṇavāṃbhasi sitaṃ bhagavān rathāṅgaṃ smṛtvā jagattrayamanena hatāḥ surāś ca dakṣāndhakāntakapuratrayayajñahartā lokatrayāntakakaraḥ prahasaṃtadāha
verses.translation: Since the lord of the Daitya* was surrounded by the
verses.hindi: वरीयान् वरद-वन्द्य, शङ्कर, परमेश्वर, गंगा शूलधर, परार्थेकप्रयोजन सर्वज्ञ, सर्वदेवादिगिरिधन्वा, जटाधर, चदा.  चन्द्रमौलि, विद्वान्, विश्वामरेश्वर
verses.wordMeaning: Since the lord of the Daitya* was surrounded by the
verses.commentary: Sense: Since the lord of the Daitya* was surrounded by the

verses.sanskrit: पादेन निर्मितं दैत्य जलन्धर महार्णवे बलवान् यदि चोद्धर्तुं तिष्ठ योद्धुं न चान्यथा
verses.transliteration: pādena nirmitaṃ daitya jalandhara mahārṇave balavān yadi coddhartuṃ tiṣṭha yoddhuṃ na cānyathā
verses.translation: What purpose of mine can be served in the battle by the mutual clash of Devas and Asuras? I alone am compe- tent to destroy all these in an instant. I have no fear of fighting. O Isa, this is my earnest desire. Hence, O enemy of Kama, Daksa, Yajfia and Tripuras, if you have strength to fight with my heroes with the help of your leading Bhfitas and the monkey-faced Nandin, then you stand here to fight with me.
verses.hindi: टृढ्प्रज्ञ, देवदेव, त्रिलोचन
verses.wordMeaning: What purpose of mine can be served in the battle by the mutual clash of Devas and Asuras? I alone am compe- tent to destroy all these in an instant. I have no fear of fighting. O Isa, this is my earnest desire. Hence, O enemy of Kama, Daksa, Yajfia and Tripuras,…
verses.commentary: Sense: What purpose of mine can be served in the battle by the mutual clash of Devas and Asuras? I alone am compe- tent to destroy all these in an instant. I have no fear of fighting. O Isa, this is my earnest desire. Hence, O enemy of Kama, Daksa, Yajfia and Tripuras,…

verses.sanskrit: तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा क्रोधेनादीप्तलोचनः प्रदहन्निव नेत्राभ्यां प्राहालोक्य जगत्त्रयम्
verses.transliteration: tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā krodhenādīptalocanaḥ pradahanniva netrābhyāṃ prāhālokya jagattrayam
verses.translation: After saying thus to Mahadeva, the great demon did not move nor did he think of his kins killed in battle.
verses.hindi: वामदेव, महादेव, पाण्डु, परिदूढ, अदृढ, विश्वरूप, विरूपाक्ष, वागीश, शुचि, अन्तर सर्वप्रणयसंवादी, वृषांक, वृषवाहन, ईश-पिनाकी, खट्वाङ्गी, चित्रवेष, चिरन्तन
verses.wordMeaning: After saying thus to Mahadeva, the great demon did not move nor did he think of his kins killed in battle.
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying thus to Mahadeva, the great demon did not move nor did he think of his kins killed in battle.

verses.sanskrit: गदामुद्धृत्य हत्वा च नन्दिनं त्वां च शङ्कर हत्वा लोकान्सुरैः सार्धं डुण्डुभान् गरुडो यथा
verses.transliteration: gadāmuddhṛtya hatvā ca nandinaṃ tvāṃ ca śaṅkara hatvā lokānsuraiḥ sārdhaṃ ḍuṇḍubhān garuḍo yathā
verses.translation: Urged by evil haughtiness that demon of impolite nature clapped his hands together and then seized the discus called Sudargana. He attempted to kill Siva with that discus.
verses.hindi: तमोहर, महायोगी-गोप्ता, ब्रह्मांगहज्जटी, कालकाल, कृत्तिवासा, सुभग, प्रणवात्मक
verses.wordMeaning: Urged by evil haughtiness that demon of impolite nature clapped his hands together and then seized the discus called Sudargana. He attempted to kill Siva with that discus.
verses.commentary: Sense: Urged by evil haughtiness that demon of impolite nature clapped his hands together and then seized the discus called Sudargana. He attempted to kill Siva with that discus.

In order to test Visnu, Mahesvara the lord of the worlds hid one of the lotus flowers intended for the worship. Visnu from whom the flower was taken away thought thus, "What is this?"

verses.translation: On seeing the lord of Devas, Vi$nu became glad and paid obeisance to him. The lord was embellished with matted hair as if with a crown. He resembled a hundred million suns. He was divine and surrounded by clusters of flames. He was terrible with sharp fangs. He was holding the trident, axe, iron club, discus, javelin and noose. He showed gestures of granting boon and protection with his hands. He wore the hide of a tiger as his upper garment. He was adorned with Bhasman.

verses.translation: O destroyer of the enemies of Devas, in order to fight, one shall not evince forgiveness in the battle, when weakness has passed away or not yet come in. It should not be practised towards one's own people at improper times, and when unrighteousness and calamities have disappeared. After
verses.hindi: पुलस्त्य, पुलह, अगस्त्य, जातूकर्ण्य, पराशर निरावरणधर्मज्ञ, विरिंच, विष्टरश्रवा
verses.wordMeaning: O destroyer of the enemies of Devas, in order to fight, one shall not evince forgiveness in the battle, when weakness has passed away or not yet come in. It should not be practised towards one's own people at improper times,…
verses.commentary: Sense: O destroyer of the enemies of Devas, in order to fight, one shall not evince forgiveness in the battle, when weakness has passed away or not yet come in. It should not be practised towards one's own people at improper times,…

verses.sanskrit: दाता दयाकरो दक्षः कपर्दी कामशासनः श्मशाननिलयः सूक्ष्मः श्मशानस्थो महेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: dātā dayākaro dakṣaḥ kapardī kāmaśāsanaḥ śmaśānanilayaḥ sūkṣmaḥ śmaśānastho maheśvaraḥ
verses.translation: tasmit lifig&t, p&vakasya mand*l&t avatatfira ST. he descended from his lifigaJmage that had a fiery circle around it.
verses.hindi: लोकचूड़ामणि, वीर, चण्डसत्यपराक्रम अलंकरिष्णु, अचल, रोचिष्णु, विक्रमोत्तम
verses.wordMeaning: tasmit lifig&t, p&vakasya mand*l&t avatatfira ST. he descended from his lifigaJmage that had a fiery circle around it.
verses.commentary: Sense: tasmit lifig&t, p&vakasya mand*l&t avatatfira ST. he descended from his lifigaJmage that had a fiery circle around it.

verses.sanskrit: लोककर्ता भूतपतिर् महाकर्ता महौषधी उत्तरो गोपतिर्गोप्ता ज्ञानगम्यः पुरातनः
verses.transliteration: lokakartā bhūtapatir mahākartā mahauṣadhī uttaro gopatirgoptā jñānagamyaḥ purātanaḥ
verses.translation: The lord, the leader of the worlds, gave him an eye also resembling the lotus. Ever since then they call that deity of good holy rites "Padmakga" (lotus-eyed).
verses.hindi: अतिथि, शक्रप्रमाथी, पापनाशन
verses.wordMeaning: The lord, the leader of the worlds, gave him an eye also resembling the lotus. Ever since then they call that deity of good holy rites "Padmakga" (lotus-eyed).
verses.commentary: Sense: The lord, the leader of the worlds, gave him an eye also resembling the lotus. Ever since then they call that deity of good holy rites "Padmakga" (lotus-eyed).

verses.sanskrit: नीतिः सुनीतिः शुद्धात्मा सोमः सोमरतः सुखी सोमपो ऽमृतपः सोमो महानीतिर्महामतिः
verses.transliteration: nītiḥ sunītiḥ śuddhātmā somaḥ somarataḥ sukhī somapo 'mṛtapaḥ somo mahānītirmahāmatiḥ
verses.translation: After giving the eye and discus, thus to Vi$nu, lord Siva touched him with his auspicious hands and said: —
verses.hindi: अंगिरा, मुनिआत्रेय, विमल, विशववाहन, पावन, पुरुजित्, शक्र, त्रिविद्य, नरवाहन मनोबुद्धि, अहंकार क्षेत्रज्ञ, क्षेत्रपालक, तेजोतिषि, ज्ञाननिधि, विपाक, विघ्नकारक
verses.wordMeaning: After giving the eye and discus, thus to Vi$nu, lord Siva touched him with his auspicious hands and said: —
verses.commentary: Sense: After giving the eye and discus, thus to Vi$nu, lord Siva touched him with his auspicious hands and said: —

verses.sanskrit: अजातशत्रुरालोकः संभाव्यो हव्यवाहनः लोककारो वेदकारः सूत्रकारः सनातनः
verses.transliteration: ajātaśatrurālokaḥ saṃbhāvyo havyavāhanaḥ lokakāro vedakāraḥ sūtrakāraḥ sanātanaḥ
verses.translation: " O excellent Vi§nu, I am the bestower of boons. Choose the desired boons. I have been captivated by you by your devotion, to be sure,"
verses.hindi: चारुधीर्जनक, चारुविशल्य, लोकशल्यकृत्, चतुव चतुर्भाव, चतुरचतुरप्रिय
verses.wordMeaning: " O excellent Vi§nu, I am the bestower of boons. Choose the desired boons. I have been captivated by you by your devotion, to be sure,"
verses.commentary: Sense: " O excellent Vi§nu, I am the bestower of boons. Choose the desired boons. I have been captivated by you by your devotion, to be sure,"

verses.sanskrit: महर्षिः कपिलाचार्यो विश्वदीप्तिस्त्रिलोचनः पिनाकपाणिर् भूदेवः स्वस्तिदः स्वस्तिकृत्सदा
verses.transliteration: maharṣiḥ kapilācāryo viśvadīptistrilocanaḥ pinākapāṇir bhūdevaḥ svastidaḥ svastikṛtsadā
verses.translation: On being urged thus by the lord of Devas, Visriu bowed down to the lord of Devas and said u O Mahadeva, bless me with this excellent boon of devotion to you.
verses.hindi: आम्नाय, समाम्नाय, तीर्थदेवशिबालय, बहुरू? महारूप, सर्वरूप, चराचर देवेन्द्र, सर्वशस्त्रप्रभंजन
verses.wordMeaning: On being urged thus by the lord of Devas, Visriu bowed down to the lord of Devas and said u O Mahadeva, bless me with this excellent boon of devotion to you.
verses.commentary: Sense: On being urged thus by the lord of Devas, Visriu bowed down to the lord of Devas and said u O Mahadeva, bless me with this excellent boon of devotion to you.

verses.sanskrit: त्रिधामा सौभगः शर्वः सर्वज्ञः सर्वगोचरः ब्रह्मधृग् विश्वसृक् स्वर्गः कर्णिकारः प्रियः कविः
verses.transliteration: tridhāmā saubhagaḥ śarvaḥ sarvajñaḥ sarvagocaraḥ brahmadhṛg viśvasṛk svargaḥ karṇikāraḥ priyaḥ kaviḥ
verses.translation: I do not wish for anything else, O lord, because devotees do not have any other desire."
verses.hindi: अध्याय ९८ भगवान् विष्णुद्वारा एक सहस्त्र नामोंसे भगवान् शिवकी स्तुति करना ९९
verses.wordMeaning: I do not wish for anything else, O lord, because devotees do not have any other desire."
verses.commentary: Sense: I do not wish for anything else, O lord, because devotees do not have any other desire."

verses.sanskrit: शाखो विशाखो गोशाखः शिवो नैकः क्रतुः समः गङ्गाप्लवोदको भावः सकलः स्थपतिः स्थिरः
verses.transliteration: śākho viśākho gośākhaḥ śivo naikaḥ kratuḥ samaḥ gaṅgāplavodako bhāvaḥ sakalaḥ sthapatiḥ sthiraḥ
verses.translation: O excellent Deva, you will always remain a devotee of mine. You will certainly be worthy of being saluted and wor- shipped by Devas and Asuras, thanks to my grace.
verses.hindi: सहस्रबाहुः सर्वेशः शरण्यः सर्वलोकभूत्। सहस्रबाहुसर्वेश, शरण्य, सर्वलोकभृत्, पद्मासन, परंज्योति, परावरपरंफल
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent Deva, you will always remain a devotee of mine. You will certainly be worthy of being saluted and wor- shipped by Devas and Asuras, thanks to my grace.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent Deva, you will always remain a devotee of mine. You will certainly be worthy of being saluted and wor- shipped by Devas and Asuras, thanks to my grace.

verses.sanskrit: विजितात्मा विधेयात्मा भूतवाहनसारथिः सगणो गणकार्यश् च सुकीर्तिश् छिन्नसंशयः
verses.transliteration: vijitātmā vidheyātmā bhūtavāhanasārathiḥ sagaṇo gaṇakāryaś ca sukīrtiś chinnasaṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: When Sati the daughter of Daksa, the goddess of Devas, with splendid eyes, reproaches her mother and father and becomes the divine daughter of Himavan, Uma by name, O Vi$nu of good holy rites, you will give her as your sister to me at the behest of Brahma and thus become my kinsman. You will be worthy of being worshipped in the world.
verses.hindi: देवासुरनमस्कृतः।
verses.wordMeaning: When Sati the daughter of Daksa, the goddess of Devas, with splendid eyes, reproaches her mother and father and becomes the divine daughter of Himavan, Uma by name, O Vi$nu of good holy rites,…
verses.commentary: Sense: When Sati the daughter of Daksa, the goddess of Devas, with splendid eyes, reproaches her mother and father and becomes the divine daughter of Himavan, Uma by name, O Vi$nu of good holy rites,…

verses.sanskrit: कामदेवः कामपालो भस्मोद्धूलितविग्रहः भस्मप्रियो भस्मशायी कामी कान्तः कृतागमः
verses.transliteration: kāmadevaḥ kāmapālo bhasmoddhūlitavigrahaḥ bhasmapriyo bhasmaśāyī kāmī kāntaḥ kṛtāgamaḥ
verses.translation: Ever since that time you will view me with divine feelings and delight, as though I have become your friend.
verses.hindi: देवासुरगुरुदेव, देवासुरनमस्कृत, देवासुरमहामात्र, देवासुरमहाश्रय देवादिदेव, देवर्षिदेवासुरवरप्रद, देवासुरेशवर, दिव्य, देवासुरमहेश्वर
verses.wordMeaning: Ever since that time you will view me with divine feelings and delight, as though I have become your friend.
verses.commentary: Sense: Ever since that time you will view me with divine feelings and delight, as though I have become your friend.

verses.sanskrit: समायुक्तो निवृत्तात्मा धर्मयुक्तः सदाशिवः चतुर्मुखश्चतुर्बाहुर् दुरावासो दुरासदः
verses.transliteration: samāyukto nivṛttātmā dharmayuktaḥ sadāśivaḥ caturmukhaścaturbāhur durāvāso durāsadaḥ
verses.translation: After saying this the lord Siva vanished. Then lord Viiiu requested Brahma who is on a par with the sages, in the presence of Devas:
verses.hindi: सर्वदेवमय, अचिन्त्य, देवतात्मा, आत्मसम्भव, ईड्य, अनीश, सुरव्याघ्र, देवसिंह, दिवाकर
verses.wordMeaning: After saying this the lord Siva vanished. Then lord Viiiu requested Brahma who is on a par with the sages, in the presence of Devas:
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying this the lord Siva vanished. Then lord Viiiu requested Brahma who is on a par with the sages, in the presence of Devas:

verses.sanskrit: दुर्गमो दुर्लभो दुर्गः सर्वायुधविशारदः अध्यात्मयोगनिलयः सुतन्तुस्तन्तुवर्धनः
verses.transliteration: durgamo durlabho durgaḥ sarvāyudhaviśāradaḥ adhyātmayoganilayaḥ sutantustantuvardhanaḥ

verses.translation: His benefit shall be that of a thousand horse- sacrifices. He shall bathe Rudra with ghee, etc. by means of holy vessel or auspicious water pots, repeating the thousand
