verses.hindi: देवदेवेश वृषभध्वज शंकरकी स्तुति की उन ०००५  होकर महातेजस्वी शिवने उत्तम कर्मवाले उन्ह विविध वर प्रदान करके उन्हें गाणपत्य पद ह  तब सभी देवताओने देवेश परमेश्वरको दा की। भगवान् नारायणने भी हाथ जोड़कर उनकी सु. की। ब्रह्मा तथा सभी मुनियोंने भी ब्रह्माकी करनेवाले देवदेवेश नीलकण्ठ वृषभध्वजकी पृथक...
verses.wordMeaning: O Suta of great intellect, the origin of the goddess has been indicated by you. Now, mention in detail her birth as the daughter of Mena after her self immolation as Sati in the previous birth and then the destruction of Dak$a's sacri- fice. How was she given to Siva,…
verses.commentary: Sense: O Suta of great intellect, the origin of the goddess has been indicated by you. Now, mention in detail her birth as the daughter of Mena after her self immolation as Sati in the previous birth and then the destruction of Dak$a's sacri- fice. How was she given to Siva,…

verses.sanskrit: मेनाजत्वं महादेव्या दक्षयज्ञविमर्दनम् विष्णुना च कथं दत्ता देवदेवाय शंभवे
verses.transliteration: menājatvaṃ mahādevyā dakṣayajñavimardanam viṣṇunā ca kathaṃ dattā devadevāya śaṃbhave
verses.translation: How was her marriage with him? It behoves you to narrate all this to us now.
verses.hindi: पृथक् स्तुति की। इसके बाद उन देवताओंपर आनु्रह
verses.wordMeaning: How was her marriage with him? It behoves you to narrate all this to us now.
verses.commentary: Sense: How was her marriage with him? It behoves you to narrate all this to us now.

verses.sanskrit: कल्याणं वा कथं तस्य वक्तुमर्हसि सांप्रतम् तेषां तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा सूतः पौराणिकोत्तमः
verses.transliteration: kalyāṇaṃ vā kathaṃ tasya vaktumarhasi sāṃpratam teṣāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā sūtaḥ paurāṇikottamaḥ
verses.translation: O highly blessed ones, at your entreaty I shall men- tion it to you after bowing down to Umfi and Siva.
verses.hindi: तान् देवाननुगृह्मैव भवोऽप्यन्तरधीयत॥ ५१  करके शिवजी भी अन्तर्धान हो गये॥ ४९-५ १॥ सतीका हिमवानूकी पुत्री पार्वतीके रूपमें प्राकट्य, शिवकी प्राप्तिके लिये उनका कठोर तप, तारकासुरद्वारा देवताओंको पराजित करना, शिवद्वारा कामदेवका दहन तथा पुनः जीवित करना
verses.wordMeaning: O highly blessed ones, at your entreaty I shall men- tion it to you after bowing down to Umfi and Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O highly blessed ones, at your entreaty I shall men- tion it to you after bowing down to Umfi and Siva.

verses.sanskrit: संभवं च महादेव्याः प्राह तेषां महात्मनाम् ब्रह्मणा कथितं पूर्वं दण्डिने तत् सुविस्तरम्
verses.transliteration: saṃbhavaṃ ca mahādevyāḥ prāha teṣāṃ mahātmanām brahmaṇā kathitaṃ pūrvaṃ daṇḍine tat suvistaram
verses.translation: In view of the union of Linga and pedestal he became Ardhanarftvara (lord with the form of a woman in one half). At the outset he created his son Brahma the four-faced lord. 934
verses.hindi: कथं वा देवदेवेशमवाप पतिमीश्वरम्
verses.wordMeaning: In view of the union of Linga and pedestal he became Ardhanarftvara (lord with the form of a woman in one half). At the outset he created his son Brahma the four-faced lord. 934
verses.commentary: Sense: In view of the union of Linga and pedestal he became Ardhanarftvara (lord with the form of a woman in one half). At the outset he created his son Brahma the four-faced lord. 934

verses.sanskrit: युष्माभिर् वै कुमाराय तेन व्यासाय धीमते तस्मादहमुपश्रुत्य प्रवदामि सुविस्तरम्
verses.transliteration: yuṣmābhir vai kumārāya tena vyāsāya dhīmate tasmādahamupaśrutya pravadāmi suvistaram
verses.translation: Siva who excels the whole universe, the lord Ardha- narHvara, full of knowledge, granted knowledge to Brahmfi.
verses.hindi: तदा हैमवती जज्ञे तपसा च द्विजोत्तमाः जातकर्मादिकाः सर्वाश्चकार च गिरीशवरः। द्वादशे च तदा वर्षे पूर्णे हैमवती शुभा
verses.wordMeaning: Siva who excels the whole universe, the lord Ardha- narHvara, full of knowledge, granted knowledge to Brahmfi.
verses.commentary: Sense: Siva who excels the whole universe, the lord Ardha- narHvara, full of knowledge, granted knowledge to Brahmfi.

verses.sanskrit: वचनाद्वो महाभागाः प्रणम्योमां तथा भवम् सा भगाख्या जगद्धात्री लिङ्गमूर्तेस्त्रिवेदिका
verses.transliteration: vacanādvo mahābhāgāḥ praṇamyomāṃ tathā bhavam sā bhagākhyā jagaddhātrī liṅgamūrtestrivedikā
verses.translation: The unborn lord requested the lord the soul of the uni- verse, by saying "Divide yourself." He created the goddess from the left side of his body as his befitting wife.
verses.hindi: अन्या च देवी ह्यनुजा सर्वलोकनमस्कृता
verses.wordMeaning: The unborn lord requested the lord the soul of the uni- verse, by saying "Divide yourself." He created the goddess from the left side of his body as his befitting wife.
verses.commentary: Sense: The unborn lord requested the lord the soul of the uni- verse, by saying "Divide yourself." He created the goddess from the left side of his body as his befitting wife.

verses.sanskrit: लिङ्गस्तु भगवान्द्वाभ्यां जगत्सृष्टिर्द्विजोत्तमाः लिङ्गमूर्तिः शिवो ज्योतिस् तमसश्चोपरि स्थितः
verses.transliteration: liṅgastu bhagavāndvābhyāṃ jagatsṛṣṭirdvijottamāḥ liṅgamūrtiḥ śivo jyotis tamasaścopari sthitaḥ
verses.translation: This ancient splendid lady, viz: — Sraddha, 936 became the daughter of Dak$a at the behest of the lord.
verses.hindi: तुष्टुवुस्तपसा देवी समावृत्य समन्तत: तपसा च महादेव्याः पार्वत्याः परमेश्वर: । वशीकृतो महादेवः सर्वभूतपतिर्भवः
verses.wordMeaning: This ancient splendid lady, viz: — Sraddha, 936 became the daughter of Dak$a at the behest of the lord.
verses.commentary: Sense: This ancient splendid lady, viz: — Sraddha, 936 became the daughter of Dak$a at the behest of the lord.

verses.sanskrit: लिङ्गवेदिसमायोगाद् अर्धनारीश्वरोभवत् ब्रह्माणं विदधे देवम् अग्रे पुत्रं चतुर्मुखम्
verses.transliteration: liṅgavedisamāyogād ardhanārīśvarobhavat brahmāṇaṃ vidadhe devam agre putraṃ caturmukham
verses.translation: At that time, her name was Satl. She resorted to Rudra alone as her husband. In course of time, she rebuked Daksa. The goddess then became the daughter of Mena.
verses.hindi: ऋषिगण बोले--कल्याणमयी अम्बा सती हिमवान्को पुत्री कैसे हुई और उन्होंने देवदेवेश महेश्वरको पतिके रूपमें कैसे प्राप्त किया ?
verses.wordMeaning: At that time, her name was Satl. She resorted to Rudra alone as her husband. In course of time, she rebuked Daksa. The goddess then became the daughter of Mena.
verses.commentary: Sense: At that time, her name was Satl. She resorted to Rudra alone as her husband. In course of time, she rebuked Daksa. The goddess then became the daughter of Mena.

verses.sanskrit: प्राहिणोति स्म तस्यैव ज्ञानं ज्ञानमयो हरः विश्वाधिको ऽसौ भगवान् अर्धनारीश्वरो विभुः
verses.transliteration: prāhiṇoti sma tasyaiva jñānaṃ jñānamayo haraḥ viśvādhiko 'sau bhagavān ardhanārīśvaro vibhuḥ
verses.translation: It was due to the curse of Narada that Dak§a also was prompted to censure them. The haughty Dak$a, dishonoured the lord of Uma contemptuously. When Sati came to know of this action of her father Daksa, by her yogic power
verses.hindi: सूतजी बोले है श्रेष्ठ द्विजो! उस श्रेष्ठ अंगनाने तपस्याके द्वारा अपनी इच्छासे मेनाके शरीरका आश्रय लेकर हिमालयकी पुत्रीके रूपमें जन्म लिया। पर्वतराजने उसके जातकर्म आदि समस्त संस्कार सम्पन्न किये । तब बारहवाँ वर्ष पूर्ण होनेपर हिमवानूकी वह सुन्दर पुत्री तपस्या करने लगी; उसके साथ सुन्दर मुखवाली उसकी छोटी बहन और सर्वलोकनमस्कृत एक दूसरी छोटी
verses.wordMeaning: It was due to the curse of Narada that Dak§a also was prompted to censure them. The haughty Dak$a, dishonoured the lord of Uma contemptuously. When Sati came to know of this action of her father Daksa, by her yogic power
verses.commentary: Sense: It was due to the curse of Narada that Dak§a also was prompted to censure them. The haughty Dak$a, dishonoured the lord of Uma contemptuously. When Sati came to know of this action of her father Daksa, by her yogic power

verses.sanskrit: हिरण्यगर्भं तं देवो जायमानमपश्यत सो ऽपि रुद्रं महादेवं ब्रह्मापश्यत शङ्करम्
verses.transliteration: hiraṇyagarbhaṃ taṃ devo jāyamānamapaśyata so 'pi rudraṃ mahādevaṃ brahmāpaśyata śaṅkaram
verses.translation: Brahmin am vidadhe dev&m. Gf. yo brahmin am vidadhati purvaxh yo dev&n&m prathamam pur as tat —cited in ST.
verses.hindi: तब सभी ऋषि सभी लोकोंकी महेश्वरी उस देवीको चारों ओरसे घेरकर तपके लिये उसकी स्तुति करने लगे
verses.wordMeaning: Brahmin am vidadhe dev&m. Gf. yo brahmin am vidadhati purvaxh yo dev&n&m prathamam pur as tat —cited in ST.
verses.commentary: Sense: Brahmin am vidadhe dev&m. Gf. yo brahmin am vidadhati purvaxh yo dev&n&m prathamam pur as tat —cited in ST.

verses.sanskrit: तं दृष्ट्वा संस्थितं देवम् अर्धनारीश्वरं प्रभुम् तुष्टाव वाग्भिर् इष्टाभिर् वरदं वारिजोद्भवः
verses.transliteration: taṃ dṛṣṭvā saṃsthitaṃ devam ardhanārīśvaraṃ prabhum tuṣṭāva vāgbhir iṣṭābhir varadaṃ vārijodbhavaḥ
verses.translation: Sraddhi, the first wife of Siva who afterwards became Sati the daughter of Dakfa. [She became Parvati in her third birth. Gf.
verses.hindi: उनमें सबसे बड़ी अपर्णा थी, उससे छोटी उकपाटला नामवाली थी। महादेवी पार्वतीकी
verses.wordMeaning: Sraddhi, the first wife of Siva who afterwards became Sati the daughter of Dakfa. [She became Parvati in her third birth. Gf.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sraddhi, the first wife of Siva who afterwards became Sati the daughter of Dakfa. [She became Parvati in her third birth. Gf.

verses.sanskrit: विभजस्वेति विश्वेशं विश्वात्मानमजो विभुः ससर्ज देवीं वामाङ्गात् पत्नीं चैवात्मनः समाम्
verses.transliteration: vibhajasveti viśveśaṃ viśvātmānamajo vibhuḥ sasarja devīṃ vāmāṅgāt patnīṃ caivātmanaḥ samām
verses.translation: Sraddhi, the first wife of Siva who afterwards became Sati the daughter of Dakfa. [She became Parvati in her third birth. Gf.
verses.hindi: 5091 सतीका हिमवानूकी पुत्री पार्वतीके रूपमें प्राकट्य
verses.wordMeaning: Sraddhi, the first wife of Siva who afterwards became Sati the daughter of Dakfa. [She became Parvati in her third birth. Gf.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sraddhi, the first wife of Siva who afterwards became Sati the daughter of Dakfa. [She became Parvati in her third birth. Gf.

verses.sanskrit: श्रद्धा ह्यस्य शुभा पत्नी ततः पुंसः पुरातनी सैवाज्ञया विभोर्देवी दक्षपुत्री बभूव ह
verses.transliteration: śraddhā hyasya śubhā patnī tataḥ puṃsaḥ purātanī saivājñayā vibhordevī dakṣaputrī babhūva ha
verses.translation: Sraddhi, the first wife of Siva who afterwards became Sati the daughter of Dakfa. [She became Parvati in her third birth. Gf.
verses.hindi: एतस्मिनेव काले तु तारको नाम : प्राणियोंके एुतस्मिनेव ह तु म दानव: । प्राणियोंके स्वामी परमेश्वर महादेव शिव उनके तारात्मजो महातेजा बभूत दितिनन्दनः ॥ ८  वशमें हो गये तस्य पुत्रास्त्रयश्चापि तारकाक्षो महासुरः। इसी समय तारक नामवाला एक दानव हुआ; विद्युमाली च भगवान् कमलाक्षश्च वीर्यवान्॥ ९ दितिको आनन्दित करनेवाला वह तारपुत्र (तारक) महातेजस्वी था। उसके तीन पुत्र थे-महान् असुर तारकाक्ष, भाग्यशाली विद्युन्माली और पराक्रमी कमलाक्ष।
verses.wordMeaning: Sraddhi, the first wife of Siva who afterwards became Sati the daughter of Dakfa. [She became Parvati in her third birth. Gf.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sraddhi, the first wife of Siva who afterwards became Sati the daughter of Dakfa. [She became Parvati in her third birth. Gf.

verses.sanskrit: सतीसंज्ञा तदा सा वै रुद्रमेवाश्रिता पतिम् दक्षं विनिन्द्य कालेन देवी मैना ह्यभूत्पुनः
verses.transliteration: satīsaṃjñā tadā sā vai rudramevāśritā patim dakṣaṃ vinindya kālena devī mainā hyabhūtpunaḥ
verses.translation: Sraddhi, the first wife of Siva who afterwards became Sati the daughter of Dakfa. [She became Parvati in her third birth. Gf.
verses.hindi: तार नामक इनके महाबली पितामहने प्रभु ब्रह्माको कृपासे अपनी तपस्याके द्वारा  अतुलनीय पराक्रम प्राप्त कर लिया था। उस महातेजस्वी तारने चराचरसहित तीनों लोकोंको जीतकर संग्राममें विष्णुको भी जीत
verses.wordMeaning: Sraddhi, the first wife of Siva who afterwards became Sati the daughter of Dakfa. [She became Parvati in her third birth. Gf.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sraddhi, the first wife of Siva who afterwards became Sati the daughter of Dakfa. [She became Parvati in her third birth. Gf.

verses.sanskrit: नारदस्यैव दक्षो ऽपि शापादेवं विनिन्द्य च अवज्ञादुर्मदो दक्षो देवदेवमुमापतिम्
verses.transliteration: nāradasyaiva dakṣo 'pi śāpādevaṃ vinindya ca avajñādurmado dakṣo devadevamumāpatim
verses.translation: Sraddhi, the first wife of Siva who afterwards became Sati the daughter of Dakfa. [She became Parvati in her third birth. Gf.
verses.hindi: उन दोनोंमें दिन-रात बिना विश्रामके (निरन्तर) रोमांचकारी युद्ध हुआ। उसने रथसहित विष्णुको पकड़कर सौ योजन दूर फेंक दिया। तारके द्वारा युद्धमें पराजित होकर विष्णु भाग गये। ब्रह्मासे एक सौ वर तथा सैकड़ों गुना बल प्राप्त करके दितिनन्दन
verses.wordMeaning: Sraddhi, the first wife of Siva who afterwards became Sati the daughter of Dakfa. [She became Parvati in her third birth. Gf.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sraddhi, the first wife of Siva who afterwards became Sati the daughter of Dakfa. [She became Parvati in her third birth. Gf.

verses.sanskrit: अनादृत्य कृतिं ज्ञात्वा सती दक्षेण तत्क्षणात् भस्मीकृत्वात्मनो देहं योगमार्गेण सा पुनः
verses.transliteration: anādṛtya kṛtiṃ jñātvā satī dakṣeṇa tatkṣaṇāt bhasmīkṛtvātmano dehaṃ yogamārgeṇa sā punaḥ
verses.translation: Sraddhi, the first wife of Siva who afterwards became Sati the daughter of Dakfa. [She became Parvati in her third birth. Gf.
verses.hindi: तारने सम्पूर्ण जगत्पर अधिकार कर लिया। देवेन्द्र आदि देवताओंको जीतकर देवेश्वरेश्वरके रूपमें होकर उसने अपनी मायासे देवताओंको सभी लोकोंमें उनके कार्योसे बंचित कर दिया
verses.wordMeaning: Sraddhi, the first wife of Siva who afterwards became Sati the daughter of Dakfa. [She became Parvati in her third birth. Gf.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sraddhi, the first wife of Siva who afterwards became Sati the daughter of Dakfa. [She became Parvati in her third birth. Gf.

verses.sanskrit: बभूव पार्वती देवी तपसा च गिरेः प्रभोः ज्ञात्वैतद्भगवान् भर्गो ददाह रुषितः प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: babhūva pārvatī devī tapasā ca gireḥ prabhoḥ jñātvaitadbhagavān bhargo dadāha ruṣitaḥ prabhuḥ
verses.translation: Sraddhi, the first wife of Siva who afterwards became Sati the daughter of Dakfa. [She became Parvati in her third birth. Gf.
verses.hindi: इन्द्रसहित देवतागण तारकासुरके भयसे पीडित हो गये; वीर होते हुए भी वे भयग्रस्त होनेके कारण कहीं भी शान्ति अथवा शरण प्राप्त नहीं कर सके। तब देवताओंके स्वामी श्रीमान् प्रभु इन्द्र बृहस्पतिको शरणमें जाकर देवताओंकी उपस्थितिमें उनसे कहने लगे
verses.wordMeaning: Sraddhi, the first wife of Siva who afterwards became Sati the daughter of Dakfa. [She became Parvati in her third birth. Gf.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sraddhi, the first wife of Siva who afterwards became Sati the daughter of Dakfa. [She became Parvati in her third birth. Gf.

verses.sanskrit: दक्षस्य विपुलं यज्ञं च्यावनेर् वचनादपि च्यवनस्य सुतो धीमान् दधीच इति विश्रुतः
verses.transliteration: dakṣasya vipulaṃ yajñaṃ cyāvaner vacanādapi cyavanasya suto dhīmān dadhīca iti viśrutaḥ
verses.translation: Sraddhi, the first wife of Siva who afterwards became Sati the daughter of Dakfa. [She became Parvati in her third birth. Gf.
verses.hindi: हे भगवन्! तारसे उत्पन्न तारक नामक एक महादानव है; उसने युद्धमें हमलोगोंको उसी तरह आहत किया है, जैसे बैल बछड़ोंको आहत कर देता है । अतः है महाभाग! हे बृहस्पते! भयके कारण इस विशाल युद्धमें देवतालोग
verses.wordMeaning: Sraddhi, the first wife of Siva who afterwards became Sati the daughter of Dakfa. [She became Parvati in her third birth. Gf.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sraddhi, the first wife of Siva who afterwards became Sati the daughter of Dakfa. [She became Parvati in her third birth. Gf.

verses.sanskrit: विजित्य विष्णुं समरे प्रसादात् त्र्यंबकस्य च विष्णुना लोकपालांश् च शशाप च मुनीश्वरः
verses.transliteration: vijitya viṣṇuṃ samare prasādāt tryaṃbakasya ca viṣṇunā lokapālāṃś ca śaśāpa ca munīśvaraḥ
verses.translation: Sraddhi, the first wife of Siva who afterwards became Sati the daughter of Dakfa. [She became Parvati in her third birth. Gf.
verses.hindi: आश्रयविहीन होकर उसी प्रकार भ्रमण कर रहे हैं, जैसे पिँजरेमै पक्षी। है अंगिरोवर! हमलोगोंके जो अस्त्र पहले तपसा लब्धवीर्यश्च प्रसादाद् ब्रह्मणः प्रभोः
verses.wordMeaning: Sraddhi, the first wife of Siva who afterwards became Sati the daughter of Dakfa. [She became Parvati in her third birth. Gf.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sraddhi, the first wife of Siva who afterwards became Sati the daughter of Dakfa. [She became Parvati in her third birth. Gf.

verses.sanskrit: रुद्रस्य क्रोधजेनैव वह्निना हविषा सुराः विनाशो वै क्षणादेव मायया शङ्करस्य वै
verses.transliteration: rudrasya krodhajenaiva vahninā haviṣā surāḥ vināśo vai kṣaṇādeva māyayā śaṅkarasya vai
verses.translation: Sraddhi, the first wife of Siva who afterwards became Sati the daughter of Dakfa. [She became Parvati in her third birth. Gf.
verses.hindi: सोऽपि तारो महातेजास्त्रैलोक्यं सचराचरम्। विजित्य समरे पूर्व विष्णुं च जितवानसौ
verses.wordMeaning: Sraddhi, the first wife of Siva who afterwards became Sati the daughter of Dakfa. [She became Parvati in her third birth. Gf.
verses.commentary: Sense: Sraddhi, the first wife of Siva who afterwards became Sati the daughter of Dakfa. [She became Parvati in her third birth. Gf.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीलिङ्गमहापुराणे पूर्वभागे देवीसंभवो नाम नवनवतितमो ऽध्यायः विजित्य विष्णुना सार्धं भगवान्परमेश्वरः सर्वान्दधीचवचनात् कथं भेजे महेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: iti śrīliṅgamahāpurāṇe pūrvabhāge devīsaṃbhavo nāma navanavatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ vijitya viṣṇunā sārdhaṃ bhagavānparameśvaraḥ sarvāndadhīcavacanāt kathaṃ bheje maheśvaraḥ
verses.translation: In the great sacrifice of Daksa, lord Rudra burned Devas along with Visnu and sages.
verses.hindi: सरथं विष्णुमादाय चिक्षेप शतयोजनम्। देवेन्द्रप्रमुखाडिजत्वा देवान् देवेश्वरेश्वरः। वारयामास तैर्देवान् सर्वलोकेषु मायया
verses.wordMeaning: In the great sacrifice of Daksa, lord Rudra burned Devas along with Visnu and sages.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the great sacrifice of Daksa, lord Rudra burned Devas along with Visnu and sages.

verses.sanskrit: दक्षयज्ञे सुविपुले देवान् विष्णुपुरोगमान् ददाह भगवान् रुद्रः सर्वान् मुनिगणान् अपि
verses.transliteration: dakṣayajñe suvipule devān viṣṇupurogamān dadāha bhagavān rudraḥ sarvān munigaṇān api
verses.translation: O sages of good holy rites, his Gana named Bhadra was sent by the lord Paramesthin distressed as he was by the unbearable pangs of separation from the goddess.
verses.hindi: उवाचाङ्गिरस॑ देवो देवानामपि सन्निधौ
verses.wordMeaning: O sages of good holy rites, his Gana named Bhadra was sent by the lord Paramesthin distressed as he was by the unbearable pangs of separation from the goddess.
verses.commentary: Sense: O sages of good holy rites, his Gana named Bhadra was sent by the lord Paramesthin distressed as he was by the unbearable pangs of separation from the goddess.

verses.sanskrit: भद्रो नाम गणस्तेन प्रेषितः परमेष्ठिना विप्रयोगेन देव्या वै दुःसहेनैव सुव्रताः
verses.transliteration: bhadro nāma gaṇastena preṣitaḥ parameṣṭhinā viprayogena devyā vai duḥsahenaiva suvratāḥ
verses.translation: Virabhadra created splendid lords of Ganas born of
verses.hindi: भगवंस्तारको नाम तारजो दानवोत्तमः। तेन सन्निहता युद्धे वत्सा गोपतिना यथा अनिकेता त्येते शकता ईव पग १९
verses.wordMeaning: Virabhadra created splendid lords of Ganas born of
verses.commentary: Sense: Virabhadra created splendid lords of Ganas born of

verses.sanskrit: सो ऽसृजद् वीरभद्रश् च गणेशान्रोमजाञ्छुभान् गणेश्वरैः समारुह्य रथं भद्रः प्रतापवान्
verses.transliteration: so 'sṛjad vīrabhadraś ca gaṇeśānromajāñchubhān gaṇeśvaraiḥ samāruhya rathaṃ bhadraḥ pratāpavān
verses.translation: cr. arorwr awltra tost Ptst s fast 1
verses.hindi: अस्माकं यान्यमोघानि अस्मां यान्यमोघानि आयुधा्यङगिरोवर।  अमो बै, ने उस देवशतुके प्रभावके कारण रि । तानि मोघानि जायन्ते प्रभावादमरद्विषः
verses.wordMeaning: cr. arorwr awltra tost Ptst s fast 1
verses.commentary: Sense: cr. arorwr awltra tost Ptst s fast 1

verses.sanskrit: गन्तुं चक्रे मतिं यस्य सारथिर्भगवानजः गणेश्वराश् च ते सर्वे विविधायुधपाणयः
verses.transliteration: gantuṃ cakre matiṃ yasya sārathirbhagavānajaḥ gaṇeśvarāś ca te sarve vividhāyudhapāṇayaḥ
verses.translation: The mountains crumbled; the earth quaked; the winds whirled to and fro and the ocean became agitated.
verses.hindi: विष्णुना योधितो युद्धे तेनापि न च सूदितः यस्तेनानिर्जितो युद्धे विष्णुना प्रभविष्णुना। कथमस्मद्विधस्तस्य स्थास्यते समरेऽग्रतः
verses.wordMeaning: The mountains crumbled; the earth quaked; the winds whirled to and fro and the ocean became agitated.
verses.commentary: Sense: The mountains crumbled; the earth quaked; the winds whirled to and fro and the ocean became agitated.

verses.sanskrit: विमानैर्विश्वतो भद्रैस् तमन्वयुरथो सुराः हिमवच्छिखरे रम्ये हेमशृङ्गे सुशोभने
verses.transliteration: vimānairviśvato bhadrais tamanvayuratho surāḥ himavacchikhare ramye hemaśṛṅge suśobhane
verses.translation: The fires did not blaze; the sun did not shine; the planets were not illuminated. Neither Devas nor Danavas looked pleased.
verses.hindi: देवैरशेषैः सेन्दरैस्तु जीवमाह पितामहः
verses.wordMeaning: The fires did not blaze; the sun did not shine; the planets were not illuminated. Neither Devas nor Danavas looked pleased.
verses.commentary: Sense: The fires did not blaze; the sun did not shine; the planets were not illuminated. Neither Devas nor Danavas looked pleased.

verses.sanskrit: यज्ञवाटस् तथा तस्य गङ्गाद्वारसमीपतः तद्देशे चैव विख्यातं शुभं कनखलं द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: yajñavāṭas tathā tasya gaṅgādvārasamīpataḥ taddeśe caiva vikhyātaṃ śubhaṃ kanakhalaṃ dvijāḥ
verses.translation: The infuriated leaders of the Ganas uprooted the sacrificial posts and hurled them about along with the Hotr and Prastotr. They burned everything.
verses.hindi: विनिन्द्य दक्षं या देवी सती रुद्राङ्गसम्भवा उमा हैमवती जज्ञे सर्वलोकनमस्कृता। तस्याश्चैवेह रूपेण यूयं देवाः सुरोत्तमाः
verses.wordMeaning: The infuriated leaders of the Ganas uprooted the sacrificial posts and hurled them about along with the Hotr and Prastotr. They burned everything.
verses.commentary: Sense: The infuriated leaders of the Ganas uprooted the sacrificial posts and hurled them about along with the Hotr and Prastotr. They burned everything.

verses.sanskrit: दग्धुं वै प्रेषितश्चासौ भगवान् परमेष्ठिना तदोत्पातो बभूवाथ लोकानां भयशंसनः
verses.transliteration: dagdhuṃ vai preṣitaścāsau bhagavān parameṣṭhinā tadotpāto babhūvātha lokānāṃ bhayaśaṃsanaḥ
verses.translation: The lords of the Ganas seized them and cast them into the running current of the Ganga. Virabhadra of great splendour and undistressed soul made the hands of Indra and other Devas stunned as they raised them. He uprooted the eyes of Bhaga sportively with the tip of his finger. With his fist he hit the teeth of Pu$an and made them fall. He kicked the moon with the toe of his foot. He cut off the head of lord Indra. After cutting off the hands of Agni and after uprooting his tongue sportively he kicked him on his head with his leg.
verses.hindi: विभोर्यतध्वमाक्रष्टुं रुद्रस्यास्य मनो महत्।
verses.wordMeaning: The lords of the Ganas seized them and cast them into the running current of the Ganga. Virabhadra of great splendour and undistressed soul made the hands of Indra and other Devas stunned as they raised them. He uprooted the eyes of Bhaga sportively with the tip of his finger.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The lords of the Ganas seized them and cast them into the running current of the Ganga. Virabhadra of great splendour and undistressed soul made the hands of Indra and other Devas stunned as they raised them. He uprooted the eyes of Bhaga sportively with the tip of his finger.…

verses.sanskrit: पर्वताश् च व्यशीर्यन्त प्रचकम्पे वसुंधरा मरुतश् चाप्य् अघूर्णन्त चुक्षुभे मकरालयः
verses.transliteration: parvatāś ca vyaśīryanta pracakampe vasuṃdharā marutaś cāpy aghūrṇanta cukṣubhe makarālayaḥ
verses.translation: He cut off the staff of Yama. He hit lord ISana 939 a guardian of the quarters of great strength by means of his trident. Without any difficulty he killed thirty three Devas thus. Sportingly he killed three thousand three hundred and thirty
verses.hindi: अमोघ थे, वे उस देवशत्रुके प्रभावके कारण गये हैं। है बृहस्पते! विष्णुने बीस हजार वर्षोतक हौ साथ युद्ध किया; किंतु वह उनके भी द्वारा युद्धमें ऱ्ह गया । महाशक्तिसम्पन्न विष्णुके द्वारा भी युद्धमें जो न नहीं जा सका, तब हम-जैसे लोग युद्धमें उसके सा
verses.wordMeaning: He cut off the staff of Yama. He hit lord ISana 939 a guardian of the quarters of great strength by means of his trident. Without any difficulty he killed thirty three Devas thus. Sportingly he killed three thousand three hundred and thirty
verses.commentary: Sense: He cut off the staff of Yama. He hit lord ISana 939 a guardian of the quarters of great strength by means of his trident. Without any difficulty he killed thirty three Devas thus. Sportingly he killed three thousand three hundred and thirty

verses.sanskrit: अग्नयो नैव दीप्यन्ति न च दीप्यति भास्करः ग्रहाश् च न प्रकाश्यन्ते न देवा न च दानवाः
verses.transliteration: agnayo naiva dīpyanti na ca dīpyati bhāskaraḥ grahāś ca na prakāśyante na devā na ca dānavāḥ
verses.translation: Thanks to his yogic power, innumerable and divine bodies with conch, discus and iron clubs in their hands were born of Vis$u. They were equal to him in lustre. Lord Virabhadra killed all of them by means of his iron club and hit Vi§gu on the head. Then he sportively hit him on the chest, he fell senseless on the ground. The lord got up again and lifted up his discus to kill him. He stood there gloriously with his eyes reddened with anger. Virabhadra of undistressed soul stunned his terrible discus that had the lustre of black sun and which he had kept in his hand. He did not move. He stood stunned thereby motionless like a mountain.
verses.hindi: इन्द्रके ऐसा कहनेपर श्रेष्ठ देवताओं तथा रो साथ लेकर बृहस्पतिने विभु ब्रह्माके पास
verses.wordMeaning: Thanks to his yogic power, innumerable and divine bodies with conch, discus and iron clubs in their hands were born of Vis$u. They were equal to him in lustre. Lord Virabhadra killed all of them by means of his iron club and hit Vi§gu on the head.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Thanks to his yogic power, innumerable and divine bodies with conch, discus and iron clubs in their hands were born of Vis$u. They were equal to him in lustre. Lord Virabhadra killed all of them by means of his iron club and hit Vi§gu on the head.…

verses.sanskrit: ततः क्षणात् प्रविश्यैव यज्ञवाटं महात्मनः रोमजैः सहितो भद्रः कालाग्निरिवचापरः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ kṣaṇāt praviśyaiva yajñavāṭaṃ mahātmanaḥ romajaiḥ sahito bhadraḥ kālāgnirivacāparaḥ
verses.translation: The bow of the lord was attacked with three hits and it split into three. Through contact with the tips of the bits of the bow he cut off the head of the lord.
verses.hindi: उनके मुखसे सारा वृत्तान्त सुनकर शरणागतोंका कष्ट दूर करनेवाले उन पितामहने इन्द्रसहित सभी मैं आप सब देवताओंकी विपत्तिको जानता हूँ; फिर भी इस समय सुनिये। रुद्रके अंगसे उत्पन्न जो देवी सती हैं, वे दक्षकी निन्दा करके समस्त लोकोंब्रार नमस्कृत उमाके रूपमें हिमवानूकी पुत्री होकर उत्पन
verses.wordMeaning: The bow of the lord was attacked with three hits and it split into three. Through contact with the tips of the bits of the bow he cut off the head of the lord.
verses.commentary: Sense: The bow of the lord was attacked with three hits and it split into three. Through contact with the tips of the bits of the bow he cut off the head of the lord.

verses.sanskrit: उवाच भद्रो भगवान् दक्षं चामिततेजसम् संपर्कादेव दक्षाद्य मुनीन्देवान् पिनाकिना
verses.transliteration: uvāca bhadro bhagavān dakṣaṃ cāmitatejasam saṃparkādeva dakṣādya munīndevān pinākinā
verses.translation: His head that was cut off fell quickly into the nether worlds wafted by the wind originating from the vital breaths of the Pinaka-bearing lord. At that time the Ahavaniya fire too entered there. On seeing the great sacrificial hall utterly in disarray with the sacred vessels destroyed, sacrificial posts broken along with the arched gateway, and the great hall burned, sacrifice fled. As it fled towards the sky in the guise of a deer, Virabhadra seized and beheaded it. Thereafter the powerful Virabhadra kicked the following on their heads, viz. — Prajapati, Dhanna, Ka£yapa the preceptor of the uni- verse, Arigtanemi the leading sage with his sons, sage Ahgiras, Kr$na£va and the renowned Dak*a. O excellent brahmins, he cut off Daka's head and burned it in the fire.
verses.hindi: हुई हैं। है उत्तम देवताओं! आप देवतागण उन्हींके रूपके द्वारा इन विभु रुद्रके महान् मनको आकृ करानेका प्रयत्न कीजिये। उन दोनोंके संयोगसे शक्तिधर
verses.wordMeaning: His head that was cut off fell quickly into the nether worlds wafted by the wind originating from the vital breaths of the Pinaka-bearing lord. At that time the Ahavaniya fire too entered there.…
verses.commentary: Sense: His head that was cut off fell quickly into the nether worlds wafted by the wind originating from the vital breaths of the Pinaka-bearing lord. At that time the Ahavaniya fire too entered there.…

verses.sanskrit: दग्धुं संप्रेषितश् चाहं भवन्तं समुनीश्वरैः इत्युक्त्वा यज्ञशालां तां ददाह गणपुङ्गवः
verses.transliteration: dagdhuṃ saṃpreṣitaś cāhaṃ bhavantaṃ samunīśvaraiḥ ityuktvā yajñaśālāṃ tāṃ dadāha gaṇapuṅgavaḥ
verses.translation: tttyifl caivm. the three: India, Agnl, nod Soma.
verses.hindi: अध्याय १०१ J सतीका हिमवान्की पुत्री पार्वतीके रूपमें प्राकट्य प फ की फ क फे फ फ का क फ फ फ फ फ फ फ़ फ फ फ़ फ़ फ फ फ फ फ़ फ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ़ फ़ क फ फ़ फ़ फ फ़ फफ फ फ़ फ क फ फ़ फ़ फ फ़
verses.wordMeaning: tttyifl caivm. the three: India, Agnl, nod Soma.
verses.commentary: Sense: tttyifl caivm. the three: India, Agnl, nod Soma.

verses.sanskrit: गणेश्वराश् च संक्रुद्धा यूपानुत्पाट्य चिक्षिपुः प्रस्तोत्रा सह होत्रा च दग्धं चैव गणेश्वरैः
verses.transliteration: gaṇeśvarāś ca saṃkruddhā yūpānutpāṭya cikṣipuḥ prastotrā saha hotrā ca dagdhaṃ caiva gaṇeśvaraiḥ
verses.translation: O deity of good holy rites, be pleased. May every- body be forgiven by you along with those born of your hairs. Thanks to the influence of Brahma, Paramesthin, he gradually calmed down. At his behest he became quiescent.
verses.hindi: घडास्यो द्वादशभुजः सेनानी: पावकि: प्रभु:। स्वाहेयः कार्तिकेयश्च गाङ्गेयः शरधामजः
verses.wordMeaning: O deity of good holy rites, be pleased. May every- body be forgiven by you along with those born of your hairs. Thanks to the influence of Brahma, Paramesthin, he gradually calmed down. At his behest he became quiescent.
verses.commentary: Sense: O deity of good holy rites, be pleased. May every- body be forgiven by you along with those born of your hairs. Thanks to the influence of Brahma, Paramesthin, he gradually calmed down. At his behest he became quiescent.

verses.sanskrit: गृहीत्वा गणपाः सर्वान् गङ्गास्रोतसि चिक्षिपुः वीरभद्रो महातेजाः शक्रस्योद्यच्छतः करम्
verses.transliteration: gṛhītvā gaṇapāḥ sarvān gaṅgāsrotasi cikṣipuḥ vīrabhadro mahātejāḥ śakrasyodyacchataḥ karam
verses.translation: Daksa regained consciousness and got up. With palms joined in reverence he eulogised the bull-bannered lord of the chiefs of Devas. On being eulogised by him the lord of great splendour granted him different boons. He bestowed the chieftaincy of Ganas upon Daksa of undistressed activities. Devas eulogised lord Narayana with palms joined in reverence. Brahma and the sages severally eulogised the bull-bannered, blue-necked lord who was the chief of Devas, and the cause of the origin of Brahma. After blessing those Devas, the supreme lord vanished.
verses.hindi: देवः शाखो विशाखश्च नैगमेशश्च वीर्यवान्। नापतिः कुमाराख्यः सर्वलोकनमस्कृतः महासेनः प्रबलं तारकासुरम्। ब्रालोऽपि विनिहत्यैको देवान् सन्तारयिष्यति
verses.wordMeaning: Daksa regained consciousness and got up. With palms joined in reverence he eulogised the bull-bannered lord of the chiefs of Devas. On being eulogised by him the lord of great splendour granted him different boons.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Daksa regained consciousness and got up. With palms joined in reverence he eulogised the bull-bannered lord of the chiefs of Devas. On being eulogised by him the lord of great splendour granted him different boons.…

verses.sanskrit: व्यष्टम्भयद् अदीनात्मा तथान्येषां दिवौकसाम् भगस्य नेत्रे चोत्पाट्य करजाग्रेण लीलया
verses.transliteration: vyaṣṭambhayad adīnātmā tathānyeṣāṃ divaukasām bhagasya netre cotpāṭya karajāgreṇa līlayā
verses.translation: The head of Dak$a, that was smashed by Vlrabbadra, was substituted by Siva with the bead of sacrificial animal.
verses.hindi: एवमुक्तस्तदा तेन ब्रह्मणा परमेष्ठिना। बृहस्पतिस्तथा सेन्दर्देवेर्देवं प्रणम्य तम्
verses.wordMeaning: The head of Dak$a, that was smashed by Vlrabbadra, was substituted by Siva with the bead of sacrificial animal.
verses.commentary: Sense: The head of Dak$a, that was smashed by Vlrabbadra, was substituted by Siva with the bead of sacrificial animal.

verses.sanskrit: निहत्य मुष्टिना दन्तान् पूष्णश्चैवं न्यपातयत् तथा चन्द्रमसं देवं पादाङ्गुष्ठेन लीलया
verses.transliteration: nihatya muṣṭinā dantān pūṣṇaścaivaṃ nyapātayat tathā candramasaṃ devaṃ pādāṅguṣṭhena līlayā
verses.translation: The head of Dak$a, that was smashed by Vlrabbadra, was substituted by Siva with the bead of sacrificial animal.
verses.hindi: (बारह भुजाओंवाले), सेनानी, पावकि, प्रभु, स्वाहेय, कार्तिकेय, गांगेय, शरधामज, देव, शाख, विशाख, नैगमेश, वीर्यवान्, सेनापति और कुमार नामवाले होकर सभी लोकोंसे नमस्कृत होंगे। वे महासेन बालक होते हुए भी बिना प्रयासके अकेले ही उस महाबली तारकासुरका वध करके देवताओंका उद्धार करेंगे॥ २४--३०॥
verses.wordMeaning: The head of Dak$a, that was smashed by Vlrabbadra, was substituted by Siva with the bead of sacrificial animal.
verses.commentary: Sense: The head of Dak$a, that was smashed by Vlrabbadra, was substituted by Siva with the bead of sacrificial animal.

verses.sanskrit: घर्षयामास भगवान् वीरभद्रः प्रतापवान् चिछेद च शिरस्तस्य शक्रस्य भगवान्प्रभोः
verses.transliteration: gharṣayāmāsa bhagavān vīrabhadraḥ pratāpavān cicheda ca śirastasya śakrasya bhagavānprabhoḥ
verses.translation: The head of Dak$a, that was smashed by Vlrabbadra, was substituted by Siva with the bead of sacrificial animal.
verses.hindi: तब उन परमेष्ठी ब्रह्मके इस प्रकार कहनेपर इन्द्रसहित सभी देवताओंके साथ सुत्रत बृहस्मतिने देवदेव उन ब्रह्माको प्रणाम करके मेरुके शिखरपर पहुँचकर कामदेवका स्मरण किया। है श्रेष्ठ द्विजो!
verses.wordMeaning: The head of Dak$a, that was smashed by Vlrabbadra, was substituted by Siva with the bead of sacrificial animal.
verses.commentary: Sense: The head of Dak$a, that was smashed by Vlrabbadra, was substituted by Siva with the bead of sacrificial animal.

verses.sanskrit: वह्नेर्हस्तद्वयं छित्त्वा जिह्वामुत्पाट्य लीलया जघान मूर्ध्नि पादेन वीरभद्रो महाबलः
verses.transliteration: vahnerhastadvayaṃ chittvā jihvāmutpāṭya līlayā jaghāna mūrdhni pādena vīrabhadro mahābalaḥ
verses.translation: The head of Dak$a, that was smashed by Vlrabbadra, was substituted by Siva with the bead of sacrificial animal.
verses.hindi: देवगुरु ब्रह्माके स्मरण करनेसे जगतका जौवस्वरूप कामदेव भी अपनी भार्या रतिके साथ वहाँ आकर हाथ जोड़कर नमस्कार करके इन्द्रसहित उन बृहस्पतिसे बोला--'हे बृहस्पते! आपने मेरा स्मरण किया है, अतः मैं आपके पास आया हूँ; मुझे जो करना हो, उसे बताइये।' तब देवपूजित बृहस्पति उससे कुछ बोलने ही बाले थे कि उत्सुकतावश भगवान् इन्द्रने कामदेवको प्रशंसा करके उससे कहा- अब आप सुखपूर्वक
verses.wordMeaning: The head of Dak$a, that was smashed by Vlrabbadra, was substituted by Siva with the bead of sacrificial animal.
verses.commentary: Sense: The head of Dak$a, that was smashed by Vlrabbadra, was substituted by Siva with the bead of sacrificial animal.

verses.sanskrit: यमस्य दण्डं भगवान् प्रचिछेद स्वयं प्रभुः जघान देवमीशानं त्रिशूलेन महाबलम्
verses.transliteration: yamasya daṇḍaṃ bhagavān pracicheda svayaṃ prabhuḥ jaghāna devamīśānaṃ triśūlena mahābalam
verses.translation: The head of Dak$a, that was smashed by Vlrabbadra, was substituted by Siva with the bead of sacrificial animal.
verses.hindi: शंकरके साथ अम्बिकाका संयोग कराइये। बे भगवान् वृषभध्वज जिस भी उपायसे उनके साथ रमण करें; अपनी पत्नी रतिके साथ आप उस उपायको खोजिये । पहलेसे ही उन अम्बिका-से वियुक्त हुए वे महादेव
verses.wordMeaning: The head of Dak$a, that was smashed by Vlrabbadra, was substituted by Siva with the bead of sacrificial animal.
verses.commentary: Sense: The head of Dak$a, that was smashed by Vlrabbadra, was substituted by Siva with the bead of sacrificial animal.

verses.sanskrit: त्रयस्त्रिंशत्सुरानेवं विनिहत्याप्रयत्नतः त्रयश् च त्रिशतं तेषां त्रिसाहस्रं च लीलया
verses.transliteration: trayastriṃśatsurānevaṃ vinihatyāprayatnataḥ trayaś ca triśataṃ teṣāṃ trisāhasraṃ ca līlayā
verses.translation: The head of Dak$a, that was smashed by Vlrabbadra, was substituted by Siva with the bead of sacrificial animal.
verses.hindi: भी उन पार्वती उमाको पुनः प्राप्त करके प्रसन्न होकर आपको शुभ गति प्रदान करेंगे ॥ ३१--३७॥ उनके ऐसा कहनेपर देवदेव इन्द्रको नमस्कार करके कामदेवने उस रति-के साथ शंकरजीके आश्रममें जानेका निश्चय किया। तब रति तथा अपने सहायक वसन्तके साथ शिवजीके आश्रममें जाकर महाबली कामदेवने पार्वतीके साथ महादेवका संयोग करानेका मन बनाया
verses.wordMeaning: The head of Dak$a, that was smashed by Vlrabbadra, was substituted by Siva with the bead of sacrificial animal.
verses.commentary: Sense: The head of Dak$a, that was smashed by Vlrabbadra, was substituted by Siva with the bead of sacrificial animal.

verses.sanskrit: त्रयं चैव सुरेन्द्राणां जघान च मुनीश्वरान् अन्यांश् च देवान् देवो ऽसौ सर्वान्युद्धाय संस्थितान्
verses.transliteration: trayaṃ caiva surendrāṇāṃ jaghāna ca munīśvarān anyāṃś ca devān devo 'sau sarvānyuddhāya saṃsthitān
verses.translation: The head of Dak$a, that was smashed by Vlrabbadra, was substituted by Siva with the bead of sacrificial animal.
verses.hindi: तत्पश्चात् कामदेवको देखकर हँसते हुए त्रिनेत्र शिवने अवज्ञापूर्वक उसे अपने तीसरे नेत्रसे देखा। इसके बाद उनके नेत्रसे उत्पन्न अग्निने पासमें ही खडे कामदेवको उसी क्षण जला दिया। तब रति करुण
verses.wordMeaning: The head of Dak$a, that was smashed by Vlrabbadra, was substituted by Siva with the bead of sacrificial animal.
verses.commentary: Sense: The head of Dak$a, that was smashed by Vlrabbadra, was substituted by Siva with the bead of sacrificial animal.

verses.sanskrit: जघान भगवान् रुद्रः खड्गमुष्ट्यादिसायकैः अथ विष्णुर्महातेजाश् चक्रम् उद्यम्य मूर्छितः
verses.transliteration: jaghāna bhagavān rudraḥ khaḍgamuṣṭyādisāyakaiḥ atha viṣṇurmahātejāś cakram udyamya mūrchitaḥ
verses.translation: The head of Dak$a, that was smashed by Vlrabbadra, was substituted by Siva with the bead of sacrificial animal.
verses.hindi: स्मरणाददेवदेवस्य स्मरोऽपि सह भार्यया तमाह भगवान् शक्रः सम्भाव्य मकरध्वजम्। शङ्करेणाम्बिकामद्य संयोजय यथासुखम्
verses.wordMeaning: The head of Dak$a, that was smashed by Vlrabbadra, was substituted by Siva with the bead of sacrificial animal.
verses.commentary: Sense: The head of Dak$a, that was smashed by Vlrabbadra, was substituted by Siva with the bead of sacrificial animal.

verses.sanskrit: युयोध भगवांस्तेन रुद्रेण सह माधवः तयोः समभवद्युद्धं सुघोरं रोमहर्षणम्
verses.transliteration: yuyodha bhagavāṃstena rudreṇa saha mādhavaḥ tayoḥ samabhavadyuddhaṃ sughoraṃ romaharṣaṇam
verses.translation: The head of Dak$a, that was smashed by Vlrabbadra, was substituted by Siva with the bead of sacrificial animal.
verses.hindi: तया स रमते येन भगवान् वृषभध्वजः। तेन मार्गेण मार्गस्व पत्न्या रत्यानया सह
verses.wordMeaning: The head of Dak$a, that was smashed by Vlrabbadra, was substituted by Siva with the bead of sacrificial animal.
verses.commentary: Sense: The head of Dak$a, that was smashed by Vlrabbadra, was substituted by Siva with the bead of sacrificial animal.

verses.sanskrit: विष्णोर्योगबलात्तस्य दिव्यदेहाः सुदारुणाः
verses.transliteration: viṣṇoryogabalāttasya divyadehāḥ sudāruṇāḥ
verses.translation: The head of Dak$a, that was smashed by Vlrabbadra, was substituted by Siva with the bead of sacrificial animal.
verses.hindi: सोऽपि तुष्टो महादेवः प्रदास्यति शुभां गतिम्। विप्रयुक्तस्तया पूर्व लब्ध्वा तां गिरिजामुमाम् एवमुक्तो नमस्कृत्य देवदेवं शचीपतिम्। देवदेवाश्रमं गन्तुं मतिं चक्रे तया सह
verses.wordMeaning: The head of Dak$a, that was smashed by Vlrabbadra, was substituted by Siva with the bead of sacrificial animal.
verses.commentary: Sense: The head of Dak$a, that was smashed by Vlrabbadra, was substituted by Siva with the bead of sacrificial animal.

verses.sanskrit: शङ्खचक्रगदाहस्ता असंख्याताश् च जज्ञिरे तान्सर्वानपि देवो ऽसौ नारायणसमप्रभान्
verses.transliteration: śaṅkhacakragadāhastā asaṃkhyātāś ca jajñire tānsarvānapi devo 'sau nārāyaṇasamaprabhān
verses.translation: The head of Dak$a, that was smashed by Vlrabbadra, was substituted by Siva with the bead of sacrificial animal.
verses.hindi: वसन्तेन सहायेन देवं योक्तुमनाभवत्
verses.wordMeaning: The head of Dak$a, that was smashed by Vlrabbadra, was substituted by Siva with the bead of sacrificial animal.
verses.commentary: Sense: The head of Dak$a, that was smashed by Vlrabbadra, was substituted by Siva with the bead of sacrificial animal.

verses.sanskrit: निहत्य गदया विष्णुं ताडयामास मूर्धनि ततश्चोरसि तं देवं लीलयैव रणाजिरे
verses.transliteration: nihatya gadayā viṣṇuṃ tāḍayāmāsa mūrdhani tataścorasi taṃ devaṃ līlayaiva raṇājire
verses.translation: The head of Dak$a, that was smashed by Vlrabbadra, was substituted by Siva with the bead of sacrificial animal.
verses.hindi: ततः सम्प्रेक्ष्य मदनं हसन्, देवस्त्रियम्बकः  ततोऽस्य नेत्रजो वहिर्मदनं पार्श्वतः स्थितम् अदहत्तत्क्षणादेव ललाप करूणं रतिः
verses.wordMeaning: The head of Dak$a, that was smashed by Vlrabbadra, was substituted by Siva with the bead of sacrificial animal.
verses.commentary: Sense: The head of Dak$a, that was smashed by Vlrabbadra, was substituted by Siva with the bead of sacrificial animal.

verses.sanskrit: पपात च तदा भूमौ विसंज्ञः पुरुषोत्तमः पुनरुत्थाय तं हन्तुं चक्रमुद्यम्य स प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: papāta ca tadā bhūmau visaṃjñaḥ puruṣottamaḥ punarutthāya taṃ hantuṃ cakramudyamya sa prabhuḥ
verses.translation: The head of Dak$a, that was smashed by Vlrabbadra, was substituted by Siva with the bead of sacrificial animal.
verses.hindi: शरीलिङ्गमहापुराण
verses.wordMeaning: The head of Dak$a, that was smashed by Vlrabbadra, was substituted by Siva with the bead of sacrificial animal.
verses.commentary: Sense: The head of Dak$a, that was smashed by Vlrabbadra, was substituted by Siva with the bead of sacrificial animal.

verses.sanskrit: क्रोधरक्तेक्षणः श्रीमान् अतिष्ठत् पुरुषर्षभः तस्य चक्रं च यद्रौद्रं कालादित्यसमप्रभम्
verses.transliteration: krodharaktekṣaṇaḥ śrīmān atiṣṭhat puruṣarṣabhaḥ tasya cakraṃ ca yadraudraṃ kālādityasamaprabham
verses.translation: The head of Dak$a, that was smashed by Vlrabbadra, was substituted by Siva with the bead of sacrificial animal.
verses.hindi: वृषध्वजने परम कृपासे कामदेवकी पत्नीकी ओर ख  उससे कहा- है भद्रे! तुम्हारा पति देहरहित होते अमूर्तोऽपि ध्रुवं भद्रे कार्य सर्व पतिस्तव। भी रतिकालमें निश्चित रूपसे सम्पूर्ण कार्य को रतिकाले धुवं भद्रे करिष्यति न संशय: ॥ ४३  भद्रे! इसमें सन्देह नहीं है। जब  भगवान् व्ष  भृगुके शापसे सभी लोकोंके हितके लिये महायशस्वी यदा विष्णुश्च भविता वासुदेवो महायशाः। तथा महातेजस्वी वासुदेव (वसुदेवपुत्र)-के रूपमै अती शापाद् भूगोर्महातेजाः सर्वलोकहिताय वै॥ ४४ होंगे, तब उनका प्त नामक जो पुत्र उत्पन है  वही तुम्हारा पति होगा'
verses.wordMeaning: The head of Dak$a, that was smashed by Vlrabbadra, was substituted by Siva with the bead of sacrificial animal.
verses.commentary: Sense: The head of Dak$a, that was smashed by Vlrabbadra, was substituted by Siva with the bead of sacrificial animal.

verses.sanskrit: व्यष्टम्भयद् अदीनात्मा करस्थं न चचाल सः अतिष्ठत् स्तम्भितस्तेन शृङ्गवानिव निश्चलः
verses.transliteration: vyaṣṭambhayad adīnātmā karasthaṃ na cacāla saḥ atiṣṭhat stambhitastena śṛṅgavāniva niścalaḥ
verses.translation: The head of Dak$a, that was smashed by Vlrabbadra, was substituted by Siva with the bead of sacrificial animal.
verses.hindi: इसके बाद रुद्रको प्रणाम करके पवित्र मुसकानबाल्ली वह कामपली अनंगको प्राप्त करके वसन्तके साथ चली
verses.wordMeaning: The head of Dak$a, that was smashed by Vlrabbadra, was substituted by Siva with the bead of sacrificial animal.
verses.commentary: Sense: The head of Dak$a, that was smashed by Vlrabbadra, was substituted by Siva with the bead of sacrificial animal.

verses.sanskrit: त्रिभिश् च धर्षितं शार्ङ्गं त्रिधाभूतं प्रभोस्तदा शार्ङ्गकोटिप्रसङ्गाद् वै चिछेद च शिरः प्रभोः
verses.transliteration: tribhiś ca dharṣitaṃ śārṅgaṃ tridhābhūtaṃ prabhostadā śārṅgakoṭiprasaṅgād vai cicheda ca śiraḥ prabhoḥ
verses.translation: The head of Dak$a, that was smashed by Vlrabbadra, was substituted by Siva with the bead of sacrificial animal.
verses.hindi: पार्वतीकी तपस्यासे प्रसन्न हो भगवान् शिवका ब्राह्मणवेषमें आकर उन्हें बरदान देना, हिमालयद्वारा पार्वतीस्वयंवरकी घोषणा, स्वयंवरमें भगवान् शिवका बालरूपमें उपस्थित होकर सभीको मोहित करना, पुनः ब्रह्माकी स्तुतिसे प्रसन्न हो महेशवरका मनोहर वररूप धारणकर सबको आनन्दित करना र उनल सूतजी बोले-- है ऋषियो ! भगवान् वृषभध्वज तपसा च महादेव्याः पार्वत्या वृषभध्वजः।  शर्व पार्वतीकी तपस्यासे प्रसन्न हो गये। इसके बाद प्रीतश्च भगवान् शर्वो वचनाद् ब्रह्मणस्तदा॥ १  बह्याजीके कहनेसे भगवान् भवने सभी आश्रमोके हितके हिताय चाश्रमाणां च क्रीडार्थं भगवान् भवः।  लिये और क्रीड़ा करनेके लिये विधिपूर्वक पार्वतीके
verses.wordMeaning: The head of Dak$a, that was smashed by Vlrabbadra, was substituted by Siva with the bead of sacrificial animal.
verses.commentary: Sense: The head of Dak$a, that was smashed by Vlrabbadra, was substituted by Siva with the bead of sacrificial animal.

verses.sanskrit: छिन्नं च निपपातासु शिरस्तस्य रसातले वायुना प्रेरितं चैव प्राणजेन पिनाकिना
verses.transliteration: chinnaṃ ca nipapātāsu śirastasya rasātale vāyunā preritaṃ caiva prāṇajena pinākinā
verses.translation: The head of Dak$a, that was smashed by Vlrabbadra, was substituted by Siva with the bead of sacrificial animal.
verses.hindi: तदा हैमवतीं देवीमुपयेमे यथाविधि॥ २  साथ विवाह किया
verses.wordMeaning: The head of Dak$a, that was smashed by Vlrabbadra, was substituted by Siva with the bead of sacrificial animal.
verses.commentary: Sense: The head of Dak$a, that was smashed by Vlrabbadra, was substituted by Siva with the bead of sacrificial animal.

verses.sanskrit: प्रविवेश तदा चैव तदीयाहवनीयकम् तत् प्रतिध्वस्तकलशं भग्नयूपं सतोरणम्
verses.transliteration: praviveśa tadā caiva tadīyāhavanīyakam tat pratidhvastakalaśaṃ bhagnayūpaṃ satoraṇam
verses.translation: The head of Dak$a, that was smashed by Vlrabbadra, was substituted by Siva with the bead of sacrificial animal.
verses.hindi: जगाम स स्वयं ब्रह्मा मरीच्या्येर्महर्षिभिः। उस समय कमलसे उत्पन्न ब्रह्माजी स्वयं मरीचि तपोवनं महादेव्याः पार्वत्याः पदासम्भव: ॥ ३  आदि महर्षियोंके साथ महादेवी पार्वतीके तपोवनमें गग थे। उन्होंने जगत्की निमित्तकारणस्वरूपा उन देवीकी प्रदक्षिणा करके कहा-“हे शैलजे! आप लोकोंको किसलिये संतप्त कर रही हैं? है मार”
verses.wordMeaning: The head of Dak$a, that was smashed by Vlrabbadra, was substituted by Siva with the bead of sacrificial animal.
verses.commentary: Sense: The head of Dak$a, that was smashed by Vlrabbadra, was substituted by Siva with the bead of sacrificial animal.

verses.sanskrit: प्रदीपितमहाशालं दृष्ट्वा यज्ञो ऽपि दुद्रुवे तं तदा मृगरूपेण धावन्तं गगनं प्रति
verses.transliteration: pradīpitamahāśālaṃ dṛṣṭvā yajño 'pi dudruve taṃ tadā mṛgarūpeṇa dhāvantaṃ gaganaṃ prati
verses.translation: The head of Dak$a, that was smashed by Vlrabbadra, was substituted by Siva with the bead of sacrificial animal.
verses.hindi: रत्याः प्रलापमाकर्ण्य देवदेवो वृषध्वजः । कृपया परया प्राह कामपत्नीं निरीक्ष्य च
verses.wordMeaning: The head of Dak$a, that was smashed by Vlrabbadra, was substituted by Siva with the bead of sacrificial animal.
verses.commentary: Sense: The head of Dak$a, that was smashed by Vlrabbadra, was substituted by Siva with the bead of sacrificial animal.

verses.sanskrit: वीरभद्रः समाधाय विशिरस्कमथाकरोत् ततः प्रजापतिं धर्मं कश्यपं च जगद्गुरुम्
verses.transliteration: vīrabhadraḥ samādhāya viśiraskamathākarot tataḥ prajāpatiṃ dharmaṃ kaśyapaṃ ca jagadgurum
verses.translation: The head of Dak$a, that was smashed by Vlrabbadra, was substituted by Siva with the bead of sacrificial animal.
verses.hindi: सा प्रणम्य तदा रुद्रं कामपत्नी शुचिस्मिता प्रदक्षिणीकृत्य च तां देवीं स जगतोऽरणीम्।
verses.wordMeaning: The head of Dak$a, that was smashed by Vlrabbadra, was substituted by Siva with the bead of sacrificial animal.
verses.commentary: Sense: The head of Dak$a, that was smashed by Vlrabbadra, was substituted by Siva with the bead of sacrificial animal.

verses.sanskrit: अरिष्टनेमिनं वीरो बहुपुत्रं मुनीश्वरम् मुनिम् अङ्गिरसं चैव कृष्णाश्वं च महाबलः
verses.transliteration: ariṣṭaneminaṃ vīro bahuputraṃ munīśvaram munim aṅgirasaṃ caiva kṛṣṇāśvaṃ ca mahābalaḥ
verses.translation: The head of Dak$a, that was smashed by Vlrabbadra, was substituted by Siva with the bead of sacrificial animal.
verses.hindi: किमर्थ तपसा लोकान् सन्तापयसि शैलजे
verses.wordMeaning: The head of Dak$a, that was smashed by Vlrabbadra, was substituted by Siva with the bead of sacrificial animal.
verses.commentary: Sense: The head of Dak$a, that was smashed by Vlrabbadra, was substituted by Siva with the bead of sacrificial animal.

verses.sanskrit: जघान मूर्ध्नि पादेन दक्षं चैव यशस्विनम् चिछेद च शिरस्तस्य ददाहाग्नौ द्विजोत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: jaghāna mūrdhni pādena dakṣaṃ caiva yaśasvinam cicheda ca śirastasya dadāhāgnau dvijottamāḥ
verses.translation: The head of Dak$a, that was smashed by Vlrabbadra, was substituted by Siva with the bead of sacrificial animal.
verses.hindi: ह सम्पूर्ण जगतका सृजन किया है, अर्त त्वं हि सन्धारये लोकानिमान् सर्वान् स्वतेजसा ॥ ५ इसका विनाश भत कि आप अपने तेजसे ई
verses.wordMeaning: The head of Dak$a, that was smashed by Vlrabbadra, was substituted by Siva with the bead of sacrificial animal.
verses.commentary: Sense: The head of Dak$a, that was smashed by Vlrabbadra, was substituted by Siva with the bead of sacrificial animal.

verses.sanskrit: सरस्वत्याश् च नासाग्रं देवमातुस्तथैव च निकृत्य करजाग्रेण वीरभद्रः प्रतापवान्
verses.transliteration: sarasvatyāś ca nāsāgraṃ devamātustathaiva ca nikṛtya karajāgreṇa vīrabhadraḥ pratāpavān
verses.translation: The head of Dak$a, that was smashed by Vlrabbadra, was substituted by Siva with the bead of sacrificial animal.
verses.hindi: सर्वदेवेश्वरः श्रीमान् सर्वलोकपतिर्भवः।  समस्त लोकोंको धारण कीजिये। श्रीमान् शिवजी ह
verses.wordMeaning: The head of Dak$a, that was smashed by Vlrabbadra, was substituted by Siva with the bead of sacrificial animal.
verses.commentary: Sense: The head of Dak$a, that was smashed by Vlrabbadra, was substituted by Siva with the bead of sacrificial animal.

verses.sanskrit: तस्थौ श्रिया वृतो मध्ये प्रेतस्थाने यथा भवः एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु भगवान्पद्मसंभवः
verses.transliteration: tasthau śriyā vṛto madhye pretasthāne yathā bhavaḥ etasminneva kāle tu bhagavānpadmasaṃbhavaḥ
verses.translation: The head of Dak$a, that was smashed by Vlrabbadra, was substituted by Siva with the bead of sacrificial animal.
verses.hindi: यस्य वै देवदेवस्य वयं किङ्करवादिनः॥ ६  देवताओंके ईश्वर तथा सभी लोकोंके स्वामी ९ अध्याय १०२  पार्वतीकी तपस्यासे प्रसन्न हो भगवान् शिवका उन्हें वरदान देना
verses.wordMeaning: The head of Dak$a, that was smashed by Vlrabbadra, was substituted by Siva with the bead of sacrificial animal.
verses.commentary: Sense: The head of Dak$a, that was smashed by Vlrabbadra, was substituted by Siva with the bead of sacrificial animal.

verses.sanskrit: भद्रमाह महातेजाः प्रार्थयन्प्रणतः प्रभुः अलं क्रोधेन वै भद्र नष्टाश्चैव दिवौकसः
verses.transliteration: bhadramāha mahātejāḥ prārthayanpraṇataḥ prabhuḥ alaṃ krodhena vai bhadra naṣṭāścaiva divaukasaḥ
verses.translation: The head of Dak$a, that was smashed by Vlrabbadra, was substituted by Siva with the bead of sacrificial animal.
verses.hindi: एवं परमेशानः स्वयं च वरयिष्यति।  जिन देवाधिदेवके सेवक कहे जाते हैं, वे वरदे येन सृष्टासि न विना यस्त्वयाम्बिके॥ ७  परमेश्वर ही स्वयं आपका वरण करेंगे। है वरदे! जिन्होंने आपका सृजन किया है और है अम्बिके! जो आपके बिना रह नहीं सकते; वे शिवजी आपके पति
verses.wordMeaning: The head of Dak$a, that was smashed by Vlrabbadra, was substituted by Siva with the bead of sacrificial animal.
verses.commentary: Sense: The head of Dak$a, that was smashed by Vlrabbadra, was substituted by Siva with the bead of sacrificial animal.

verses.sanskrit: प्रसीद क्षम्यतां सर्वं रोमजैः सह सुव्रत सो ऽपि भद्रः प्रभावेण ब्रह्मणः परमेष्ठिनः
verses.transliteration: prasīda kṣamyatāṃ sarvaṃ romajaiḥ saha suvrata so 'pi bhadraḥ prabhāveṇa brahmaṇaḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ
verses.translation: The head of Dak$a, that was smashed by Vlrabbadra, was substituted by Siva with the bead of sacrificial animal.
verses.hindi: वर्तते नात्र सन्देहस्तव भर्ता भविष्यति।  होंगे; इसमें सन्देह नहीं है'॥ ३--७ /२॥ त्यकत्वा तां नमस्कृत्य मुहुः सम्प्रेक्ष्य पार्वतीम्॥ ८ ऐसा कहकर उन पार्वतीको नमस्कार करके बार- बार उनकी ओर देखकर पितामह (ब्रह्मा)-के चले जानेपर भगवान् परमेश्वर शिव अनुग्रह करनेके लिये गते पितामहे देवो भगवान् परमेश्वर: । ब्राह्मणके रूपमें उस आश्रममें गये
verses.wordMeaning: The head of Dak$a, that was smashed by Vlrabbadra, was substituted by Siva with the bead of sacrificial animal.
verses.commentary: Sense: The head of Dak$a, that was smashed by Vlrabbadra, was substituted by Siva with the bead of sacrificial animal.

verses.sanskrit: शमं जगाम शनकैः शान्तस्तस्थौ तदाज्ञया देवो ऽपि तत्र भगवान् अन्तरिक्षे वृषध्वजः
verses.transliteration: śamaṃ jagāma śanakaiḥ śāntastasthau tadājñayā devo 'pi tatra bhagavān antarikṣe vṛṣadhvajaḥ
verses.translation: The head of Dak$a, that was smashed by Vlrabbadra, was substituted by Siva with the bead of sacrificial animal.
verses.hindi: जगामानुग्रहं कर्तु द्विजरूपेण चाश्रमम्॥ ९ द्विजरूपसे उपस्थित महादेवको देखकर उन पार्वतीने
verses.wordMeaning: The head of Dak$a, that was smashed by Vlrabbadra, was substituted by Siva with the bead of sacrificial animal.
verses.commentary: Sense: The head of Dak$a, that was smashed by Vlrabbadra, was substituted by Siva with the bead of sacrificial animal.

verses.sanskrit: सगणः सर्वदः शर्वः सर्वलोकमहेश्वरः प्रार्थितश्चैव देवेन ब्रह्मणा भगवान् भवः
verses.transliteration: sagaṇaḥ sarvadaḥ śarvaḥ sarvalokamaheśvaraḥ prārthitaścaiva devena brahmaṇā bhagavān bhavaḥ
verses.translation: The head of Dak$a, that was smashed by Vlrabbadra, was substituted by Siva with the bead of sacrificial animal.
verses.hindi: उन्हें भगवान् वृषभध्वज सा च दृष्ट्वा महादेवं द्विजरूपेण संस्थितम्। प्रतिभाद्यैः प्रभुं ज्ञात्वा ननाम वृषभध्वजम्
verses.wordMeaning: The head of Dak$a, that was smashed by Vlrabbadra, was substituted by Siva with the bead of sacrificial animal.
verses.commentary: Sense: The head of Dak$a, that was smashed by Vlrabbadra, was substituted by Siva with the bead of sacrificial animal.

verses.sanskrit: हतानां च तदा तेषां प्रददौ पूर्ववत्तनुम् इन्द्रस्य च शिरस्तस्य विष्णोश्चैव महात्मनः
verses.transliteration: hatānāṃ ca tadā teṣāṃ pradadau pūrvavattanum indrasya ca śirastasya viṣṇoścaiva mahātmanaḥ
verses.translation: The head of Dak$a, that was smashed by Vlrabbadra, was substituted by Siva with the bead of sacrificial animal.
verses.hindi: सम्पूज्य वरदं देवं ब्राह्मणं छदानागतम्। तुष्टाव परमेशानं पार्वती परमेश्वरम्
verses.wordMeaning: The head of Dak$a, that was smashed by Vlrabbadra, was substituted by Siva with the bead of sacrificial animal.
verses.commentary: Sense: The head of Dak$a, that was smashed by Vlrabbadra, was substituted by Siva with the bead of sacrificial animal.

verses.sanskrit: दक्षस्य च मुनीन्द्रस्य तथान्येषां महेश्वरः वागीश्याश्चैव नासाग्रं देवमातुस्तथैव च
verses.transliteration: dakṣasya ca munīndrasya tathānyeṣāṃ maheśvaraḥ vāgīśyāścaiva nāsāgraṃ devamātustathaiva ca
verses.translation: The head of Dak$a, that was smashed by Vlrabbadra, was substituted by Siva with the bead of sacrificial animal.
verses.hindi: अनुगृह्य तदा देवीमुवाच प्रहसन्तिव। कुलधर्माश्रयं रक्षन् भूधरस्य महात्मन: जानकर प्रणाम किया। ब्राह्मणके छद्मरूपमें आये हुए क्रीडार्थं च सतां मध्ये सर्वदेवपतिर्भवः। बरदाता महादेवकी पूजा करके पार्वतीने उन परमेशान
verses.wordMeaning: The head of Dak$a, that was smashed by Vlrabbadra, was substituted by Siva with the bead of sacrificial animal.
verses.commentary: Sense: The head of Dak$a, that was smashed by Vlrabbadra, was substituted by Siva with the bead of sacrificial animal.

verses.sanskrit: नष्टानां जीवितं चैव वराणि विविधानि च दक्षस्य ध्वस्तवक्त्रस्य शिरसा भगवान्प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: naṣṭānāṃ jīvitaṃ caiva varāṇi vividhāni ca dakṣasya dhvastavaktrasya śirasā bhagavānprabhuḥ
verses.translation: The head of Dak$a, that was smashed by Vlrabbadra, was substituted by Siva with the bead of sacrificial animal.
verses.hindi: स्वयंवरे महादेवि तव दिव्यसुशोभने॥ १३  परमेश्वरकी स्तुति की
verses.wordMeaning: The head of Dak$a, that was smashed by Vlrabbadra, was substituted by Siva with the bead of sacrificial animal.
verses.commentary: Sense: The head of Dak$a, that was smashed by Vlrabbadra, was substituted by Siva with the bead of sacrificial animal.

verses.sanskrit: कल्पयामास वै वक्त्रं लीलया च महान् भवः दक्षो ऽपि लब्धसंज्ञश् च समुत्थाय कृताञ्जलिः
verses.transliteration: kalpayāmāsa vai vaktraṃ līlayā ca mahān bhavaḥ dakṣo 'pi labdhasaṃjñaś ca samutthāya kṛtāñjaliḥ
verses.translation: The head of Dak$a, that was smashed by Vlrabbadra, was substituted by Siva with the bead of sacrificial animal.
verses.hindi: तदनन्तर देवीपर अनुग्रह करके शिवजी हँसते हुए बोले-- है महादेवि! सभी देवताओंका स्वामी मैं शिव आस्थाय रूपं यत्सौम्यं समेष्येऽहं सह त्वया । महात्मा हिमालयके कुलधर्मकी परम्पराको रक्षा करता इत्युक्त्वा तां समालोक्य देवो दिव्येन चक्षुषा॥ १४  हुआ क्रीड़ा करनेके लिये सज्जनोंके मध्य तुम्हारे दिव्य तथा अतिसुन्दर स्वयंवरमें सौम्य रूप धारण करके तुमसे
verses.wordMeaning: The head of Dak$a, that was smashed by Vlrabbadra, was substituted by Siva with the bead of sacrificial animal.
verses.commentary: Sense: The head of Dak$a, that was smashed by Vlrabbadra, was substituted by Siva with the bead of sacrificial animal.

verses.sanskrit: तुष्टाव देवदेवेशं शङ्करं वृषभध्वजम् स्तुतस्तेन महातेजाः प्रदाय विविधान्वरान्
verses.transliteration: tuṣṭāva devadeveśaṃ śaṅkaraṃ vṛṣabhadhvajam stutastena mahātejāḥ pradāya vividhānvarān
verses.translation: The head of Dak$a, that was smashed by Vlrabbadra, was substituted by Siva with the bead of sacrificial animal.
verses.hindi: जगामेष्टं तदा दिव्यं स्वपुरं प्रययौ च सा। ऐसा कह करके उन्हें दिव्य दृष्टिसे देखकर दृष्ट्वा हृष्टस्तदा देवीं मेनया तुहिनाचलः ॥ १५ शिवजी अपने अभीष्ट (प्रिय) दिव्य लोकको चले गये
verses.wordMeaning: The head of Dak$a, that was smashed by Vlrabbadra, was substituted by Siva with the bead of sacrificial animal.
verses.commentary: Sense: The head of Dak$a, that was smashed by Vlrabbadra, was substituted by Siva with the bead of sacrificial animal.

verses.sanskrit: गाणपत्यं ददौ तस्मै दक्षायाक्लिष्टकर्मणे देवाश् च सर्वे देवेशं तुष्टुवुः परमेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: gāṇapatyaṃ dadau tasmai dakṣāyākliṣṭakarmaṇe devāś ca sarve deveśaṃ tuṣṭuvuḥ parameśvaram
verses.translation: The head of Dak$a, that was smashed by Vlrabbadra, was substituted by Siva with the bead of sacrificial animal.
verses.hindi: म याया दावे भी चली गयी।  = 5 फ़ फफफफफ्फफफफ कका फ छ जक फक फफ कक फफफ फक फ कक फ फफक क कका कमक फ ममी कजी झफकफफफ आलिङ्ग्याघ्राय सम्पूज्य पुत्री साक्षात्तपस्विनीम्। दुहितुर्देवदेवेने न जानन्नभिमन्त्रितम्
verses.wordMeaning: The head of Dak$a, that was smashed by Vlrabbadra, was substituted by Siva with the bead of sacrificial animal.
verses.commentary: Sense: The head of Dak$a, that was smashed by Vlrabbadra, was substituted by Siva with the bead of sacrificial animal.

verses.sanskrit: नारायणश् च भगवान् तुष्टाव च कृताञ्जलिः ब्रह्मा च मुनयः सर्वे पृथक्पृथगजोद्भवम्
verses.transliteration: nārāyaṇaś ca bhagavān tuṣṭāva ca kṛtāñjaliḥ brahmā ca munayaḥ sarve pṛthakpṛthagajodbhavam
verses.translation: The head of Dak$a, that was smashed by Vlrabbadra, was substituted by Siva with the bead of sacrificial animal.
verses.hindi: स्वयंवरं तदा देव्याः सर्वलोकेष्वघोषयत्। अथ ब्रह्मा च भगवान् विष्णुः साक्षाजनार्दनः
verses.wordMeaning: The head of Dak$a, that was smashed by Vlrabbadra, was substituted by Siva with the bead of sacrificial animal.
verses.commentary: Sense: The head of Dak$a, that was smashed by Vlrabbadra, was substituted by Siva with the bead of sacrificial animal.

verses.sanskrit: तुष्टुवुर् देवदेवेशं नीलकण्ठं वृषध्वजम् तान् देवान् अनुगृह्यैव भवो ऽप्यन्तरधीयत
verses.transliteration: tuṣṭuvur devadeveśaṃ nīlakaṇṭhaṃ vṛṣadhvajam tān devān anugṛhyaiva bhavo 'pyantaradhīyata
verses.translation: The head of Dak$a, that was smashed by Vlrabbadra, was substituted by Siva with the bead of sacrificial animal.
verses.hindi: शक्रश्च भगवान् वह्निर्भास्करो भग एव च। त्वष्टार्यमा विवस्वांश्च यमो वरुण एव च वायुः सोमस्तथेशानो रुद्राश्च मुनयस्तथा। अश्विनौ द्वादशादित्या गन्धर्वा गरुडस्तथा
verses.wordMeaning: The head of Dak$a, that was smashed by Vlrabbadra, was substituted by Siva with the bead of sacrificial animal.
verses.commentary: Sense: The head of Dak$a, that was smashed by Vlrabbadra, was substituted by Siva with the bead of sacrificial animal.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीलिङ्गमहापुराणे पूर्वभागे शिवकृद्दक्षयज्ञविध्वंसनो नाम शततमो ऽध्यायः कथं हिमवतः पुत्री बभूवांबा सती शुभा कथं वा देवदेवेशम् अवाप पतिमीश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: iti śrīliṅgamahāpurāṇe pūrvabhāge śivakṛddakṣayajñavidhvaṃsano nāma śatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ kathaṃ himavataḥ putrī babhūvāṃbā satī śubhā kathaṃ vā devadeveśam avāpa patimīśvaram
verses.translation: How did the mother goddess, the splendid Sati become the daughter of the lord Himavan? How did she attain Siva, lord of the chiefs of Devas as her husband?
verses.hindi: यक्षाः सिद्धास्तथा साध्या हैत्याः किंपुरुषोरगाः ।
verses.wordMeaning: How did the mother goddess, the splendid Sati become the daughter of the lord Himavan? How did she attain Siva, lord of the chiefs of Devas as her husband?
verses.commentary: Sense: How did the mother goddess, the splendid Sati become the daughter of the lord Himavan? How did she attain Siva, lord of the chiefs of Devas as her husband?

verses.sanskrit: सा मेनातनुम् आश्रित्य स्वेच्छयैव वराङ्गना तदा हैमवती जज्ञे तपसा च द्विजोत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: sā menātanum āśritya svecchayaiva varāṅganā tadā haimavatī jajñe tapasā ca dvijottamāḥ
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, that excellent lady by her own will resorted to the body of Mena. By practising penance she was born as the daughter of Himavan.
verses.hindi: नागाश्च पर्वताः सर्वे यज्ञाः सूर्यादयो ग्रहाः। त्रयस्त्रिंशच्च देवानां त्रयश्च त्रिशतं तथा अथ शैलसुता देवी हैममारुह्य शोभनम्। विमानं सर्वतोभद्रं सर्वरलैरलङ्कृतम्
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent brahmins, that excellent lady by her own will resorted to the body of Mena. By practising penance she was born as the daughter of Himavan.
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent brahmins, that excellent lady by her own will resorted to the body of Mena. By practising penance she was born as the daughter of Himavan.

verses.sanskrit: जातकर्मादिकाः सर्वाश् चकार च गिरीश्वरः द्वादशे च तदा वर्षे पूर्णे हैमवती शुभा
verses.transliteration: jātakarmādikāḥ sarvāś cakāra ca girīśvaraḥ dvādaśe ca tadā varṣe pūrṇe haimavatī śubhā
verses.translation: The lord of the mountains celebrated her post-natal and other rites. When she attained twelfth year she performed a penance. Along with her, her younger sister of splendid face too performed the penance. Both the sisters were different entities. She was bowed to by all the worlds. The sages surroun- ded her and eulogised her for her penance. She was called Aparina and her younger sister of splendid face was called Ekaparna. 942 The third excellent sister was Ekapatala. The supreme lord Siva was captivated by her penance.
verses.hindi: सितातपत्रं रत्नांशुमिश्रितं चावहत्तथा
verses.wordMeaning: The lord of the mountains celebrated her post-natal and other rites. When she attained twelfth year she performed a penance. Along with her, her younger sister of splendid face too performed the penance. Both the sisters were different entities.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The lord of the mountains celebrated her post-natal and other rites. When she attained twelfth year she performed a penance. Along with her, her younger sister of splendid face too performed the penance. Both the sisters were different entities.…

verses.sanskrit: तपस्तेपे तया सार्धम् अनुजा च शुभानना अन्या च देवी ह्यनुजा सर्वलोके नमस्कृता
verses.transliteration: tapastepe tayā sārdham anujā ca śubhānanā anyā ca devī hyanujā sarvaloke namaskṛtā
verses.translation: In the meantime, there was an asura of great splendour, named Taraka. He was the son of Tara.
verses.hindi: विजया व्यजनं गृह्य स्थिता देव्याः समीपगा मालां प्रगृह्य देव्यां तु स्थितायां देवसंसदि। शिशुर्भूत्वा महादेवः क्रीडार्थं वृषभध्वजः
verses.wordMeaning: In the meantime, there was an asura of great splendour, named Taraka. He was the son of Tara.
verses.commentary: Sense: In the meantime, there was an asura of great splendour, named Taraka. He was the son of Tara.

verses.sanskrit: ऋषयश् च तदा सर्वे सर्वलोकमहेश्वरीम् तुष्टुवुस् तपसा देवीं समावृत्य समन्ततः
verses.transliteration: ṛṣayaś ca tadā sarve sarvalokamaheśvarīm tuṣṭuvus tapasā devīṃ samāvṛtya samantataḥ
verses.translation: He had three sons: — Tarakaksa, Vidyunmali and Kamalaksa.
verses.hindi: उत्सङ्गतलसंसुप्तो बभूव भगवान् भवः। अथ दृष्ट्वा शिशुं देवास्तस्या उत्सङ्गवर्तिनम्
verses.wordMeaning: He had three sons: — Tarakaksa, Vidyunmali and Kamalaksa.
verses.commentary: Sense: He had three sons: — Tarakaksa, Vidyunmali and Kamalaksa.

verses.sanskrit: ज्येष्ठा ह्यपर्णा ह्यनुजा चैकपर्णा शुभानना तृतीया च वरारोहा तथा चैवैकपाटला
verses.transliteration: jyeṣṭhā hyaparṇā hyanujā caikaparṇā śubhānanā tṛtīyā ca varārohā tathā caivaikapāṭalā
verses.translation: Their grandfather was an asura of great strength named T5ra. By means of his penance as also by the grace of lord Brahma, he had acquired great power.
verses.hindi: कोऽयमत्रेति सम्मन्त्र्य चुक्षुभुश्च समागताः। वञ्रमाहारयत्तस्य बाहुमुद्यम्य वृत्रहा और इसके बाद वे भी चली गयीं । तब देवीको इ
verses.wordMeaning: Their grandfather was an asura of great strength named T5ra. By means of his penance as also by the grace of lord Brahma, he had acquired great power.
verses.commentary: Sense: Their grandfather was an asura of great strength named T5ra. By means of his penance as also by the grace of lord Brahma, he had acquired great power.

verses.sanskrit: तपसा च महादेव्याः पार्वत्याः परमेश्वरः वशीकृतो महादेवः सर्वभूतपतिर्भवः
verses.transliteration: tapasā ca mahādevyāḥ pārvatyāḥ parameśvaraḥ vaśīkṛto mahādevaḥ sarvabhūtapatirbhavaḥ
verses.translation: Tara of great splendour conquered the three worlds consisting of the mobile and immobile beings. At the outset he conquered Vi§nu too.
verses.hindi: आलिंगन करके, उनका मस्तक सूँघकर और पूजा करके अत्यन्त प्रसन्‍न हुए। तत्पश्चात् दे धरे शिव-द्वारा अपनी पुत्रीको दिये गये सा  जानते हुए भी हिमालयने सभी लोकोंमें देवीके स्क
verses.wordMeaning: Tara of great splendour conquered the three worlds consisting of the mobile and immobile beings. At the outset he conquered Vi§nu too.
verses.commentary: Sense: Tara of great splendour conquered the three worlds consisting of the mobile and immobile beings. At the outset he conquered Vi§nu too.

verses.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु तारको नाम दानवः तारात्मजो महातेजा बभूव दितिनन्दनः
verses.transliteration: etasminneva kāle tu tārako nāma dānavaḥ tārātmajo mahātejā babhūva ditinandanaḥ
verses.translation: A fierce, thrilling fight ensued between them. It lasted a thousand divine years without intermission, both by day and night.
verses.hindi: घोषणा कर दी॥ १४--१६ /२॥  इसके अनन्तर ब्रह्मा, साक्षात् भगवान् जना  विष्णु, ऐश्वर्यशाली इन्द्र, अग्निदेव, सूर्य, भग, त्व
verses.wordMeaning: A fierce, thrilling fight ensued between them. It lasted a thousand divine years without intermission, both by day and night.
verses.commentary: Sense: A fierce, thrilling fight ensued between them. It lasted a thousand divine years without intermission, both by day and night.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य पुत्रास्त्रयश्चापि तारकाक्षो महासुरः विद्युन्माली च भगवान् कमलाक्षश् च वीर्यवान्
verses.transliteration: tasya putrāstrayaścāpi tārakākṣo mahāsuraḥ vidyunmālī ca bhagavān kamalākṣaś ca vīryavān
verses.translation: Seizing Vi snu along with his chariot, he hurled him a hundred yojanas away. Defeated in battle by Tara, the Garuda- bannered deity Visnu fled.
verses.hindi: रुद्र, मुनिगण, दोनों अश्विनीकुमार, बारहों आदित्य समस्त गन्धर्व, गरुड, यक्ष, सिद्ध, साध्य, हैत्य, किंपुरुष
verses.wordMeaning: Seizing Vi snu along with his chariot, he hurled him a hundred yojanas away. Defeated in battle by Tara, the Garuda- bannered deity Visnu fled.
verses.commentary: Sense: Seizing Vi snu along with his chariot, he hurled him a hundred yojanas away. Defeated in battle by Tara, the Garuda- bannered deity Visnu fled.

verses.sanskrit: पितामहस् तथा चैषां तारो नाम महाबलः तपसा लब्धवीर्यश् च प्रसादाद्ब्रह्मणः प्रभोः
verses.transliteration: pitāmahas tathā caiṣāṃ tāro nāma mahābalaḥ tapasā labdhavīryaś ca prasādādbrahmaṇaḥ prabhoḥ
verses.translation: Tara, the son of Diti, acquired boons and strength a hundred times more from Brahma. He occupied the entire universe.
verses.hindi: पर्वत, सभी यज्ञ, सूर्य आदि ग्रह, वसु, रुद्र तथा आदित्य आदि तैंतीस देवताओंके भेद-प्रभेदरूप ब्रह्मा, विशु तथा शिव ये तीन, तीन सौ तथा तीन हजार तीन देवता तथा अन्य बहुत-से देवता पर्वतराजकी पुत्रीके अत्युत्तम स्वयंवरमें पहुँचे॥ १७--२२॥
verses.wordMeaning: Tara, the son of Diti, acquired boons and strength a hundred times more from Brahma. He occupied the entire universe.
verses.commentary: Sense: Tara, the son of Diti, acquired boons and strength a hundred times more from Brahma. He occupied the entire universe.

verses.sanskrit: सो ऽपि तारो महातेजास् त्रैलोक्यं सचराचरम् विजित्य समरे पूर्वं विष्णुं च जितवान् असौ
verses.transliteration: so 'pi tāro mahātejās trailokyaṃ sacarācaram vijitya samare pūrvaṃ viṣṇuṃ ca jitavān asau
verses.translation: The lord of the chiefs of Daityas conquered Devas along with their chief, Indra. With his Maya he prevented Devas from functioning as lords of the worlds. Devas along with Indra were afflicted with fear. Although they were heroic they never attained peace. Afflicted with fear they never got a refuge.
verses.hindi: तदनन्तर पार्वती देवी स्वर्णनिर्मित तथा सभी रत्नोंसे अलंकृत सर्वतोभद्र नामक उत्तम विमानपर आरूढ होकर नृत्य करती हुई अप्सराओं, सभी आभूषणोंसे
verses.wordMeaning: The lord of the chiefs of Daityas conquered Devas along with their chief, Indra. With his Maya he prevented Devas from functioning as lords of the worlds. Devas along with Indra were afflicted with fear. Although they were heroic they never attained peace.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The lord of the chiefs of Daityas conquered Devas along with their chief, Indra. With his Maya he prevented Devas from functioning as lords of the worlds. Devas along with Indra were afflicted with fear. Although they were heroic they never attained peace.…

verses.sanskrit: तयोः समभवद्युद्धं सुघोरं रोमहर्षणम् दिव्यं वर्षसहस्रं तु दिवारात्रम् अविश्रमम्
verses.transliteration: tayoḥ samabhavadyuddhaṃ sughoraṃ romaharṣaṇam divyaṃ varṣasahasraṃ tu divārātram aviśramam
verses.translation: "O sir, the great Danava Taraka is the son of Tara. We have been overpowered by him as calves by the lordly bull.
verses.hindi: किनरोंके साथ और बन्दीजनोंद्वारा स्तुत होती हुई वहाँ उपस्थित हुईं। उनकी सखी मालिनी रत्नकिरणोंसे मिश्रित श्वेत वर्णका सन्ध्याकालीन चन्द्रमण्डलसदृश छत्र उन पार्वतीके ऊपर लगाये हुए थी। वे पार्वती हाथोंमें चँवर लिये हुई दिव्य स्त्रियोंसे घिरी हुई थीं। कल्पवृक्षके पुष्पोंसे निर्मित माला हाथमें लेकर जया
verses.wordMeaning: "O sir, the great Danava Taraka is the son of Tara. We have been overpowered by him as calves by the lordly bull.
verses.commentary: Sense: "O sir, the great Danava Taraka is the son of Tara. We have been overpowered by him as calves by the lordly bull.

verses.sanskrit: सरथं विष्णुमादाय चिक्षेप शतयोजनम् तारेण विजितः संख्ये दुद्राव गरुडध्वजः
verses.transliteration: sarathaṃ viṣṇumādāya cikṣepa śatayojanam tāreṇa vijitaḥ saṃkhye dudrāva garuḍadhvajaḥ
verses.translation: O highly blessed one, O Bfhaspati, Devas whirl about here and there like birds in a cage. They have no fixed abode. In the great fight they have been defeated and are now afraid of him.
verses.hindi: लेकर देवीके समीप खड़ी थी॥ २३--२७॥
verses.wordMeaning: O highly blessed one, O Bfhaspati, Devas whirl about here and there like birds in a cage. They have no fixed abode. In the great fight they have been defeated and are now afraid of him.
verses.commentary: Sense: O highly blessed one, O Bfhaspati, Devas whirl about here and there like birds in a cage. They have no fixed abode. In the great fight they have been defeated and are now afraid of him.

verses.sanskrit: तारो वराञ्छतगुणं लब्ध्वा शतगुणं बलम् पितामहाज्जगत्सर्वम् अवाप दितिनन्दनः
verses.transliteration: tāro varāñchataguṇaṃ labdhvā śataguṇaṃ balam pitāmahājjagatsarvam avāpa ditinandanaḥ
verses.translation: Due to the power of this demon, O excellent Angirasa, all those weapons of ours which never failed before have now become futile.
verses.hindi: देवी पार्वतीके स्थित होनेपर भगवान् वृषभध्वज र महादेव क्रीडा करनेके लिये एक शिशुके रूपमें ह देवीको गोदमें सोये हुएकी भाँति स्थित हो गये उनको गोदमें स्थित शिशुको देखकर “यहाँपर यह है'--ऐसा विचार करके वहाँ उपस्थित देवता
verses.wordMeaning: Due to the power of this demon, O excellent Angirasa, all those weapons of ours which never failed before have now become futile.
verses.commentary: Sense: Due to the power of this demon, O excellent Angirasa, all those weapons of ours which never failed before have now become futile.

verses.sanskrit: देवेन्द्रप्रमुखाञ्जित्वा देवान्देवेश्वरेश्वरः वारयामास तैर् देवान् सर्वलोकेषु मायया
verses.transliteration: devendrapramukhāñjitvā devāndeveśvareśvaraḥ vārayāmāsa tair devān sarvalokeṣu māyayā
verses.translation: This demon fought with Vi$$u, O Bfhaspati, for twenty thousand years and still he has not been killed by him. Since he has not been defeated in battle even by the powerful Vi§nu how can people like us stand in front of him in battle?"
verses.hindi: १०२ पार्वतीकी तपस्यासे प्रसन्न हो भगवान् शिवका उन्हे वरदान देना
verses.wordMeaning: This demon fought with Vi$$u, O Bfhaspati, for twenty thousand years and still he has not been killed by him. Since he has not been defeated in battle even by the powerful Vi§nu how can people like us stand in front of him in battle?"
verses.commentary: Sense: This demon fought with Vi$$u, O Bfhaspati, for twenty thousand years and still he has not been killed by him. Since he has not been defeated in battle even by the powerful Vi§nu how can people like us stand in front of him in battle?"

verses.translation: Thus advised by Brahma, Paramesthin, Brhaspati of good holy rites bowed to the lord of Devas. verses.commentary: Sense: He was accompanied also by Vasanta his comrade. He decided to join the lord with Parvati. Beholding Kama laughingly, the lord stared at him contemptuously. Then the fire blazed forth from his third eye burned Kama as he stood by his side. Rati then cried piteously.…

verses.sanskrit: यदा विष्णुश् च भविता वासुदेवो महायशाः शापाद्भृगोर्महातेजाः सर्वलोकहिताय वै
verses.transliteration: yadā viṣṇuś ca bhavitā vāsudevo mahāyaśāḥ śāpādbhṛgormahātejāḥ sarvalokahitāya vai
verses.translation: He was accompanied also by Vasanta his comrade. He decided to join the lord with Parvati. Beholding Kama laughingly, the lord stared at him contemptuously. Then the fire blazed forth from his third eye burned Kama as he stood by his side. Rati then cried piteously. On hearing her lamentations, the bull-emblemed lord was overwhelmed by mercy. He looked at her mercifully and said: — "O gentle lady, it is true that

verses.transliteration: tadā tasya suto yaś ca sa patiste bhaviṣyati sā praṇamya tadā rudraṃ kāmapatnī śucismitā

verses.sanskrit: जगाम मदनं लब्ध्वा वसंतेन समन्विता
verses.transliteration: jagāma madanaṃ labdhvā vasaṃtena samanvitā

Then the fire blazed forth from his third eye burned Kama as he stood by his side. Rati then cried piteously. On hearing her lamentations, the bull-emblemed lord was overwhelmed by mercy. He looked at her mercifully and said: — "O gentle lady, it is true that
verses.hindi: तत एवं प्रसन्ने तु सर्वदेवनिवारणम्। वपुशचकार देवेशो दिव्यं परममद्भुतम् हो गये और उन प्रभुने ब्रह्याके वचनानुसार सबको पूर्वकी भाँति कर दिया
verses.wordMeaning: He was accompanied also by Vasanta his comrade. He decided to join the lord with Parvati. Beholding Kama laughingly, the lord stared at him contemptuously. Then the fire blazed forth from his third eye burned Kama as he stood by his side. Rati then cried piteously.…
