verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीलिङ्गमहापुराणे पूर्वभागे मदनदाहो नामैकाधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः तपसा च महादेव्याः पार्वत्या वृषभध्वज प्रीतिश् च भगवाञ्छर्वो वचनाद्ब्रह्मणस्तदा
verses.transliteration: iti śrīliṅgamahāpurāṇe pūrvabhāge madanadāho nāmaikādhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ tapasā ca mahādevyāḥ pārvatyā vṛṣabhadhvaja prītiś ca bhagavāñcharvo vacanādbrahmaṇastadā
verses.translation: The bull-emblemed lord Siva was delighted by the penance of Parvati the great goddess. At the instance of Brahma, he married her for the welfare of persons in all stages of life and for his own pleasure.
verses.hindi: इस प्रकार प्रसन्न हो जानेपर उन देवेश्वरने सभी
verses.wordMeaning: The bull-emblemed lord Siva was delighted by the penance of Parvati the great goddess. At the instance of Brahma, he married her for the welfare of persons in all stages of life and for his own pleasure.
verses.commentary: Sense: The bull-emblemed lord Siva was delighted by the penance of Parvati the great goddess. At the instance of Brahma, he married her for the welfare of persons in all stages of life and for his own pleasure.

verses.sanskrit: हिताय चाश्रमाणां च क्रीडार्थं भगवान्भवः तदा हैमवतीं देवीम् उपयेमे यथाविधि
verses.transliteration: hitāya cāśramāṇāṃ ca krīḍārthaṃ bhagavānbhavaḥ tadā haimavatīṃ devīm upayeme yathāvidhi
verses.translation: Accompanied by the great sages — Marlci and others, the lotus-born Brahma went to the penance-grove of Parvati the great goddess.
verses.hindi: तब उनके तेजसे इन्द्र, चन्द्र, सूर्य, ब्रह्मा, साध्यगण, नारायण, यम, सभी रुद्र आदिके सहित वे देवता प्रभुसे दिव्य दृष्टिके लिये प्रार्थना की। इसपर उमापति शर्वने उन्हें सब कुछ देखनेमें समर्थ दिव्य दृष्टि प्रदान की; साथ ही उन्होंने भवानी तथा हिमालयको
verses.wordMeaning: Accompanied by the great sages — Marlci and others, the lotus-born Brahma went to the penance-grove of Parvati the great goddess.
verses.commentary: Sense: Accompanied by the great sages — Marlci and others, the lotus-born Brahma went to the penance-grove of Parvati the great goddess.

verses.sanskrit: जगाम स स्वयं ब्रह्मा मरीच्याद्यैर्महर्षिभिः तपोवनं महादेव्याः पार्वत्याः पद्मसंभवः
verses.transliteration: jagāma sa svayaṃ brahmā marīcyādyairmaharṣibhiḥ tapovanaṃ mahādevyāḥ pārvatyāḥ padmasaṃbhavaḥ
verses.translation: He circumambulated that goddess the fountain-head of the universe and said to her: — "O daughter of the mountain, why do you cause distress to the worlds by means of your penance?**
verses.hindi: तब दिव्य दृष्टि प्राप्त करके ब्रह्मा तथा शक्र- सहित इन्द्र, विष्णु आदि प्रधान देवताओंने उन महेश्वरका दर्शन किया। ब्रह्मा आदि देवताओं, भवानी (पार्वती), गिरीश्वर हिमालय, मुनियों तथा शिवप्रिय
verses.wordMeaning: He circumambulated that goddess the fountain-head of the universe and said to her: — "O daughter of the mountain, why do you cause distress to the worlds by means of your penance?**
verses.commentary: Sense: He circumambulated that goddess the fountain-head of the universe and said to her: — "O daughter of the mountain, why do you cause distress to the worlds by means of your penance?**

verses.sanskrit: प्रदक्षिणीकृत्य च तां देवीं स जगतो ऽरणीम् किम् अर्थं तपसा लोकान् संतापयसि शैलजे
verses.transliteration: pradakṣiṇīkṛtya ca tāṃ devīṃ sa jagato 'raṇīm kim arthaṃ tapasā lokān saṃtāpayasi śailaje
verses.translation: O mother, it was by you that the universe Was created. Do not destroy it. Hold up and preserve all these worlds by means of your splendour.
verses.hindi: गणेशवरोंने शीघ्र ही महादेवको प्रणाम किया। आकाशचारी सिद्धों तथा चारणोंने उनपर पुष्पवृष्टि को, देवदुन्दुभियाँ बजने लगीं, मुनिगण प्रभुकी स्तुति करने लगे, प्रधान गणेश्वर आनन्दित हो उठे और अम्बा पार्वती भी
verses.wordMeaning: O mother, it was by you that the universe Was created. Do not destroy it. Hold up and preserve all these worlds by means of your splendour.
verses.commentary: Sense: O mother, it was by you that the universe Was created. Do not destroy it. Hold up and preserve all these worlds by means of your splendour.

verses.sanskrit: त्वया सृष्टं जगत्सर्वं मातस्त्वं मा विनाशय त्वं हि संधारयेल्लोकान् इमान् सर्वान् स्वतेजसा
verses.transliteration: tvayā sṛṣṭaṃ jagatsarvaṃ mātastvaṃ mā vināśaya tvaṃ hi saṃdhārayellokān imān sarvān svatejasā
verses.translation: Siva is the glorious lord of all the worlds and Devas. All of us are only his servants. That great lord will woo you. O bestower of boons, O Mother, you have been created by him and surely he can never remain without you. He will be your husband.
verses.hindi: उस समय आह्लादित देवी पार्वती -ने त्रिदेवोंके
verses.wordMeaning: Siva is the glorious lord of all the worlds and Devas. All of us are only his servants. That great lord will woo you. O bestower of boons, O Mother, you have been created by him and surely he can never remain without you. He will be your husband.
verses.commentary: Sense: Siva is the glorious lord of all the worlds and Devas. All of us are only his servants. That great lord will woo you. O bestower of boons, O Mother, you have been created by him and surely he can never remain without you. He will be your husband.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वदेवेश्वरः श्रीमान् सर्वलोकपतिर्भवः यस्य वै देवदेवस्य वयं किङ्करवादिनः
verses.transliteration: sarvadeveśvaraḥ śrīmān sarvalokapatirbhavaḥ yasya vai devadevasya vayaṃ kiṅkaravādinaḥ
verses.translation: On seeing the great lord come there in the guise of a brahmin, she could recognize him as the lord through her in- telligence. She bowed to the bull-bannered lord.
verses.hindi: तेजसा तस्य देवास्ते सेन्द्रचन्द्रदिवाकराः। सब्रहाकाः ससाध्याश्च सनारायणकास्तथा सयमाश्च सरुद्राशच चक्षुरप्रार्थयन् विभुम्। तेभ्यश्च परमं चक्षुः सर्वदृष्टौ च शक्तिमत्
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing the great lord come there in the guise of a brahmin, she could recognize him as the lord through her in- telligence. She bowed to the bull-bannered lord.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing the great lord come there in the guise of a brahmin, she could recognize him as the lord through her in- telligence. She bowed to the bull-bannered lord.

verses.sanskrit: स एवं परमेशानः स्वयं च वरयिष्यति वरदे येन सृष्टासि न विना यस्त्वयांबिके
verses.transliteration: sa evaṃ parameśānaḥ svayaṃ ca varayiṣyati varade yena sṛṣṭāsi na vinā yastvayāṃbike
verses.translation: Preserving the traditional practice of the noble- soulcd mountain, the lord blessed the goddess and said laugh- ingly. Moreover, Siva, the lord of all Devas wanted some fun in the midst of the good elite — "O great goddess, I shall, assuming a gentle form, meet you at the celebration of your Svayamvara." After saying this the lord looked at her with a divine vision and went away. She too returned home. On seeing the goddess come back Himavan, along with Mena ( his wife) became delighted. He embraced her in her ascetic garb and kissed her on the head. Without knowing what had been whispered to his daughter by the lord of Devas, he announced publicly to hold the Svayamvara celebration of his daughter.
verses.hindi: लब्ध्वा चक्षुस्तदा देवा इन्द्रविष्णुपुरोगमा:
verses.wordMeaning: Preserving the traditional practice of the noble- soulcd mountain, the lord blessed the goddess and said laugh- ingly. Moreover, Siva, the lord of all Devas wanted some fun in the midst of the good elite — "O great goddess, I shall, assuming a gentle form,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Preserving the traditional practice of the noble- soulcd mountain, the lord blessed the goddess and said laugh- ingly. Moreover, Siva, the lord of all Devas wanted some fun in the midst of the good elite — "O great goddess, I shall, assuming a gentle form,…

verses.sanskrit: वर्तते नात्र संदेहस् तव भर्त्ता भविष्यति इत्युक्त्वा तां नमस्कृत्य मुहुः सम्प्रेक्ष्य पार्वतीम्
verses.transliteration: vartate nātra saṃdehas tava bharttā bhaviṣyati ityuktvā tāṃ namaskṛtya muhuḥ samprekṣya pārvatīm
verses.translation: Then all these came to attend the Svayamvara celebration of the daughter of the mountain lord. They were — lord Brahma, lord Visnu, lord Indra, the fire-god, the sun, Bhaga, Tvastr, Aryaman, Vivasvan, Yama, Varuna, Vayu, Soma, Isana, the Rudras, sages, Asvins, twelve Adityas, Gandharvas, Garuda, Yaksas, Siddhas, Sadhyas, Daityas, Kim- purusas, Nagas, oceans, rivers, Vedas, Mantras, Suktas, Ksanas, elephants, mountains, sacrifices, planets beginning with the sun, the three thousand three hundred and thirtythree Devas and many others.
verses.hindi: सब्रह्मकाः सशक्राशच तमपश्यन् महेश्वरम्। ब्रह्माद्या नेमिरे तूर्णं भवानी च गिरीश्वर: मुनयश्च महादेवं गणेशाः शिवसम्मताः।
verses.wordMeaning: Then all these came to attend the Svayamvara celebration of the daughter of the mountain lord. They were — lord Brahma, lord Visnu, lord Indra, the fire-god, the sun, Bhaga, Tvastr, Aryaman, Vivasvan, Yama, Varuna, Vayu, Soma, Isana, the Rudras, sages, Asvins, twelve Adityas,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Then all these came to attend the Svayamvara celebration of the daughter of the mountain lord. They were — lord Brahma, lord Visnu, lord Indra, the fire-god, the sun, Bhaga, Tvastr, Aryaman, Vivasvan, Yama, Varuna, Vayu, Soma, Isana, the Rudras, sages, Asvins, twelve Adityas,…

verses.sanskrit: गते पितामहे देवो भगवान् परमेश्वरः जगामानुग्रहं कर्तुं द्विजरूपेण चाश्रमम्
verses.transliteration: gate pitāmahe devo bhagavān parameśvaraḥ jagāmānugrahaṃ kartuṃ dvijarūpeṇa cāśramam
verses.translation: Then the daughter of the mountain, the goddess, mounted the aerial chariot Sarvatobhadra. It was a splendid car made of gold, and embellished with the jewels. She was accompanied by the Apsarases who bedecked in ornaments were singing and dancing. She was eulogised by the bards, Gandharvas, Siddhas and Kinnaras. Malini held the white umbrella interspersed with the rays of jewels, in honour of the bride. Sandhya held the disc of full moon. She was surrounded by divine ladies holding chowries in their hands.
verses.hindi: देवदुन्दुभयो नेदुस्तुष्टुवुर्मुनयः प्रु जगुर्गन्धर्वमुख्याश्च ननृतुश्चाप्सरोगणाः
verses.wordMeaning: Then the daughter of the mountain, the goddess, mounted the aerial chariot Sarvatobhadra. It was a splendid car made of gold, and embellished with the jewels. She was accompanied by the Apsarases who bedecked in ornaments were singing and dancing.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the daughter of the mountain, the goddess, mounted the aerial chariot Sarvatobhadra. It was a splendid car made of gold, and embellished with the jewels. She was accompanied by the Apsarases who bedecked in ornaments were singing and dancing.…

verses.sanskrit: सा च दृष्ट्वा महादेवं द्विजरूपेण संस्थितम् प्रतिभाद्यैः प्रभुं ज्ञात्वा ननाम वृषभध्वजम्
verses.transliteration: sā ca dṛṣṭvā mahādevaṃ dvijarūpeṇa saṃsthitam pratibhādyaiḥ prabhuṃ jñātvā nanāma vṛṣabhadhvajam
verses.translation: Jay a stood there holding the garland of flowers of divine trees. Vijaya held a fan and stood near the goddess.
verses.hindi: मुमुहुर्गणपाः सर्वे मुमोदाम्बा च पार्वती। तस्य देवी तदा हष्टा समक्षं त्रिदिवौकसाम् साधु साध्विति सम्प्रोच्य तया तत्रैव चार्चितम्॥ ६२  समक्ष उन शिवके चरणोंमें दिव्य तथा सुगन्धित माला
verses.wordMeaning: Jay a stood there holding the garland of flowers of divine trees. Vijaya held a fan and stood near the goddess.
verses.commentary: Sense: Jay a stood there holding the garland of flowers of divine trees. Vijaya held a fan and stood near the goddess.

verses.sanskrit: सम्पूज्य वरदं देवं ब्राह्मणच्छद्मनागतम् तुष्टाव परमेशानं पार्वती परमेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: sampūjya varadaṃ devaṃ brāhmaṇacchadmanāgatam tuṣṭāva parameśānaṃ pārvatī parameśvaram
verses.translation: Devas saw' the infant in her lap and asked her "Who is this infant here?" They were greatly agitated. Indra, the slayer of Vrtra, lifted up his arm and brought forth his thunderbolt. The hand that was lifted, remained stunned by the will of the lord of Devas who was in the form of an infant. Indra could not hurl his thunderbolt nor could he shake his arm. Agni too stood similarly and could not hurl his Sakti.
verses.hindi: कर्क कक क फ फफ छ क फक फक क फ फक कमा मी मी मकी हा समर्पित कर दी। ब्रह्मा-यक्ष-उरग-रा क्षसोंसहित ३३
verses.wordMeaning: Devas saw' the infant in her lap and asked her "Who is this infant here?" They were greatly agitated. Indra, the slayer of Vrtra, lifted up his arm and brought forth his thunderbolt. The hand that was lifted,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Devas saw' the infant in her lap and asked her "Who is this infant here?" They were greatly agitated. Indra, the slayer of Vrtra, lifted up his arm and brought forth his thunderbolt. The hand that was lifted,…

verses.sanskrit: अनुगृह्य तदा देवीम् उवाच प्रहसन्निव कुलधर्माश्रयं रक्षन् भूधरस्य महात्मनः
verses.transliteration: anugṛhya tadā devīm uvāca prahasanniva kuladharmāśrayaṃ rakṣan bhūdharasya mahātmanaḥ
verses.translation: Yama could not wield his staff. O leading sages, Nirrti could not wield his sword. Varuna could not use his weapon Nagapaga (serpentine noose). Samirana (wind god) could not wield the staff of his banner.
verses.hindi: सहदेव्या नमश्चक्रुः शिरोभिभूंतलाश्रितैः। द्वारा पूजित शिवको उन देवीसमेत पृथ्वीतलपर म
verses.wordMeaning: Yama could not wield his staff. O leading sages, Nirrti could not wield his sword. Varuna could not use his weapon Nagapaga (serpentine noose). Samirana (wind god) could not wield the staff of his banner.
verses.commentary: Sense: Yama could not wield his staff. O leading sages, Nirrti could not wield his sword. Varuna could not use his weapon Nagapaga (serpentine noose). Samirana (wind god) could not wield the staff of his banner.

verses.sanskrit: क्रीडार्थं च सतां मध्ये सर्वदेवपतिर्भवः स्वयंवरे महादेवी तव दिव्यसुशोभने
verses.transliteration: krīḍārthaṃ ca satāṃ madhye sarvadevapatirbhavaḥ svayaṃvare mahādevī tava divyasuśobhane
verses.translation: The following persons lifted up their respective weapons (but could not use them): Soma (Moon) lifted up his iron club and stood (motionless). Dhanesa the most excel- lent among staff-bearers lifted up his staff (and stood motion- less). Similarly, Isana lifted up his sharp trident and stood motionless; the Rudras too lifted the trident; the Adityas their threshing rod and the Vasus their Mudgara (iron-club). But all these heaven-dwellers were immediately rendered stunned and motionless by the lord.
verses.hindi: सर्वे सब्रह्मका देवाः सयक्षोरगराक्षसाः॥ ६३  टेककर प्रणाम किया॥ ६१--६३॥
verses.wordMeaning: The following persons lifted up their respective weapons (but could not use them): Soma (Moon) lifted up his iron club and stood (motionless). Dhanesa the most excel- lent among staff-bearers lifted up his staff (and stood motion- less). Similarly,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The following persons lifted up their respective weapons (but could not use them): Soma (Moon) lifted up his iron club and stood (motionless). Dhanesa the most excel- lent among staff-bearers lifted up his staff (and stood motion- less). Similarly,…

verses.sanskrit: आस्थाय रूपं यत्सौम्यं समेष्ये ऽहं सह त्वया इत्युक्त्वा तां समालोक्य देवो दिव्येन चक्षुषा
verses.transliteration: āsthāya rūpaṃ yatsaumyaṃ sameṣye 'haṃ saha tvayā ityuktvā tāṃ samālokya devo divyena cakṣuṣā
verses.translation: Similarly, other heaven-dwellers too were rendered stunned by the lord of Devas. Shaking his head Vi$nu lifted up his discus and stood ready to strike. The hair on his head became steady. He could not hurl his discus nor could he move his arms.
verses.hindi: भगवान् शिव एवं पार्वतीके विवाहकी मांगलिक कथा तथा विवाहके अनन्तर भगवान् शिवका काशी-आगमन और पार्वतीको मुक्तिक्षेत्र काशीकी महिमा बताना अथ ब्रह्मा महादेवमभिवन्द्य कृताञ्जलिः। उद्वाहः क्रियतां देव इत्युवाच महेश्वरम्
verses.wordMeaning: Similarly, other heaven-dwellers too were rendered stunned by the lord of Devas. Shaking his head Vi$nu lifted up his discus and stood ready to strike. The hair on his head became steady. He could not hurl his discus nor could he move his arms.
verses.commentary: Sense: Similarly, other heaven-dwellers too were rendered stunned by the lord of Devas. Shaking his head Vi$nu lifted up his discus and stood ready to strike. The hair on his head became steady. He could not hurl his discus nor could he move his arms.

verses.sanskrit: जगामेष्टं तदा दिव्यं स्वपुरं प्रययौ च सा दृष्ट्वा हृष्टस्तदा देवीं मेनया तुहिनाचलः
verses.transliteration: jagāmeṣṭaṃ tadā divyaṃ svapuraṃ prayayau ca sā dṛṣṭvā hṛṣṭastadā devīṃ menayā tuhinācalaḥ
verses.translation: The deluded Pu§an gnashed his teeth on glancing at the boy. The moment he was looked at by Siva his teeth fell down.
verses.hindi: तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा ब्रह्मणः परमेष्ठिनः। यथेष्टमिति लोकेशं प्राह भूतपतिः प्रभुः
verses.wordMeaning: The deluded Pu§an gnashed his teeth on glancing at the boy. The moment he was looked at by Siva his teeth fell down.
verses.commentary: Sense: The deluded Pu§an gnashed his teeth on glancing at the boy. The moment he was looked at by Siva his teeth fell down.

verses.sanskrit: आलिङ्ग्याघ्राय सम्पूज्य पुत्रीं साक्षात्तपस्विनीम् दुहितुर्देवदेवेन न जानन्नभिमन्त्रितम्
verses.transliteration: āliṅgyāghrāya sampūjya putrīṃ sākṣāttapasvinīm duhiturdevadevena na jānannabhimantritam
verses.translation: Similarly, the lord curbed their strength, splendour and yogic power.
verses.hindi: उद्वाहार्थं महेशस्य तत्क्षणादेव सुव्रताः। ब्रह्मणा कल्पितं दिव्यं पुरं रलमयं शुभम् अथादितिर्दितिः साक्षाइनु: कद्रुः सुकालिका। पुलोमा सुरसा चैव सिंहिका विनता तथा
verses.wordMeaning: Similarly, the lord curbed their strength, splendour and yogic power.
verses.commentary: Sense: Similarly, the lord curbed their strength, splendour and yogic power.

verses.sanskrit: स्वयंवरं तदा देव्याः सर्वलोकेष्वघोषयत् अथ ब्रह्मा च भगवान् विष्णुः साक्षाज्जनार्दनः
verses.transliteration: svayaṃvaraṃ tadā devyāḥ sarvalokeṣvaghoṣayat atha brahmā ca bhagavān viṣṇuḥ sākṣājjanārdanaḥ
verses.translation: On realising the lord Brahma, he became surprised. He rose up immediately and saluted his feet and eulogised him.
verses.hindi: सिद्धिर्माया क्रिया दुर्गा देवी साक्षात्सुधा स्वधा। सावित्री वेदमाता च रजनी दक्षिणा द्युतिः
verses.wordMeaning: On realising the lord Brahma, he became surprised. He rose up immediately and saluted his feet and eulogised him.
verses.commentary: Sense: On realising the lord Brahma, he became surprised. He rose up immediately and saluted his feet and eulogised him.

verses.sanskrit: शक्रश् च भगवान् वह्निर् भास्करो भग एव च त्वष्टार्यमा विवस्वांश् च यमो वरुण एव च
verses.transliteration: śakraś ca bhagavān vahnir bhāskaro bhaga eva ca tvaṣṭāryamā vivasvāṃś ca yamo varuṇa eva ca
verses.translation: After imploring thus to MaheSvara the lord of Devas, the lotus-bom lord Brahma spoke to Devas who had been rendered stunned and motionless.
verses.hindi: राका कुहूः सिनीवाली देवी अनुमती तथा एताश्चान्याश्च देवानां मातरः पलयस्तथा
verses.wordMeaning: After imploring thus to MaheSvara the lord of Devas, the lotus-bom lord Brahma spoke to Devas who had been rendered stunned and motionless.
verses.commentary: Sense: After imploring thus to MaheSvara the lord of Devas, the lotus-bom lord Brahma spoke to Devas who had been rendered stunned and motionless.

verses.sanskrit: वायुः सोमस्तथेशानो रुद्राश् च मुनयस् तथा अश्विनौ द्वादशादित्या गन्धर्वा गरुडस् तथा
verses.transliteration: vāyuḥ somastatheśāno rudrāś ca munayas tathā aśvinau dvādaśādityā gandharvā garuḍas tathā
verses.translation: O ye Devas, all of you are deluded. You have not understood Sankara, your lord, who is bowed to by all of you, the lord who has come into our midst.
verses.hindi: उद्वाहः शङ्करस्येति जग्मुः सर्वा मुदान्विताः । उरगा गरुडा यक्षा गन्धर्वा: किन्नरा गणा:
verses.wordMeaning: O ye Devas, all of you are deluded. You have not understood Sankara, your lord, who is bowed to by all of you, the lord who has come into our midst.
verses.commentary: Sense: O ye Devas, all of you are deluded. You have not understood Sankara, your lord, who is bowed to by all of you, the lord who has come into our midst.

verses.sanskrit: यक्षाः सिद्धास्तथा साध्या दैत्याः किंपुरुषोरगाः समुद्राश् च नदा वेदा मन्त्राः स्तोत्रादयः क्षणाः
verses.transliteration: yakṣāḥ siddhāstathā sādhyā daityāḥ kiṃpuruṣoragāḥ samudrāś ca nadā vedā mantrāḥ stotrādayaḥ kṣaṇāḥ
verses.translation: O Devas, all of you beginning with Indra including Narayaria and accompanied by the sages quickly seek refuge in lord Sankara.
verses.hindi: वेदा मनत्रास्तथा यज्ञाः स्तोमा धर्माश्च सर्वश: हुङ्कारः प्रणवश्चैव प्रतिहाराः सहस्त्रश: । कोटिरप्सरसो दिव्यास्तासां च परिचारिकाः
verses.wordMeaning: O Devas, all of you beginning with Indra including Narayaria and accompanied by the sages quickly seek refuge in lord Sankara.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Devas, all of you beginning with Indra including Narayaria and accompanied by the sages quickly seek refuge in lord Sankara.

verses.sanskrit: नागाश् च पर्वताः सर्वे यज्ञाः सूर्यादयो ग्रहाः त्रयस्त्रिंशच्च देवानां त्रयश् च त्रिशतं तथा
verses.transliteration: nāgāś ca parvatāḥ sarve yajñāḥ sūryādayo grahāḥ trayastriṃśacca devānāṃ trayaś ca triśataṃ tathā
verses.translation: You seek refuge in Is vara the great Atman, your lord as well as mine. You seek refuge in the most excellent lord accompanied by the daughter of Himavan who is Prakfti.
verses.hindi: याश्च सर्वेषु द्वीपेषु देवलोकेषु निम्नगाः।
verses.wordMeaning: You seek refuge in Is vara the great Atman, your lord as well as mine. You seek refuge in the most excellent lord accompanied by the daughter of Himavan who is Prakfti.
verses.commentary: Sense: You seek refuge in Is vara the great Atman, your lord as well as mine. You seek refuge in the most excellent lord accompanied by the daughter of Himavan who is Prakfti.

verses.sanskrit: त्रयश् च त्रिसहस्रं च तथान्ये बहवः सुरा जग्मुर् गिरीन्द्रपुत्र्यास्तु स्वयंवरमनुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: trayaś ca trisahasraṃ ca tathānye bahavaḥ surā jagmur girīndraputryāstu svayaṃvaramanuttamam
verses.translation: The most excellent Devas, all those who had been rendered stunned and motionless including Narayana men- tally bowed down to lord Siva.
verses.hindi: गणपाश्च महाभागाः सर्वलोकनमस्कृताः । उद्वाहः शङ्करस्येति तत्राजग्मुर्मुदान्विताः सूतजी बोले-हे ऋषियो ! इसके बाद ब्रह्म हाथ जोड़कर महादेव महेश्वरको प्रणाम करके य्ह कहा-'हे देव! अब विवाह कीजिये'
verses.wordMeaning: The most excellent Devas, all those who had been rendered stunned and motionless including Narayana men- tally bowed down to lord Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: The most excellent Devas, all those who had been rendered stunned and motionless including Narayana men- tally bowed down to lord Siva.

verses.sanskrit: अथ शैलसुता देवी हैममारुह्य शोभनम् विमानं सर्वतोभद्रं सर्वरत्नैर् अलंकृतम्
verses.transliteration: atha śailasutā devī haimamāruhya śobhanam vimānaṃ sarvatobhadraṃ sarvaratnair alaṃkṛtam
verses.translation: Then the three-eyed lord of Devas became pleased with them. At the instance of Brahma, the lord made them as they were before.
verses.hindi: उन परमेष्ठी ब्रह्माका वह वचन सुनका भूतपति शिवने लोकेश ब्रह्मा-से कहा--'जो आपकी इच्छा हो'
verses.wordMeaning: Then the three-eyed lord of Devas became pleased with them. At the instance of Brahma, the lord made them as they were before.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then the three-eyed lord of Devas became pleased with them. At the instance of Brahma, the lord made them as they were before.

verses.sanskrit: अप्सरोभिः प्रनृत्ताभिः सर्वाभरणभूषितैः गन्धर्वसिद्धैर्विविधैः किन्नरैश् च सुशोभनैः
verses.transliteration: apsarobhiḥ pranṛttābhiḥ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitaiḥ gandharvasiddhairvividhaiḥ kinnaraiś ca suśobhanaiḥ
verses.translation: After being pleased, the lord of Devas assumed an
verses.hindi: हे सुव्रतो! ब्रह्माने महेशके विवाहके लिये उसी क्षण रत्नमय, दिव्य तथा सुन्दर नगरका निर्माण किया इसके बाद अदिति, दिति, साक्षात् दनु, कढ सुकालिका, पुलोमा, सुरसा, सिंहिका, विनता, सिद्धि, माय, क्रिया, साक्षात् देवी दुर्गा, सुधा, स्वधा, वेदमाता सावित्र
verses.wordMeaning: After being pleased, the lord of Devas assumed an
verses.commentary: Sense: After being pleased, the lord of Devas assumed an

verses.sanskrit: बन्दिभिः स्तूयमाना च स्थिता शैलसुता तदा सितातपत्रं रत्नांशुमिश्रितं चावहत्तथा
verses.transliteration: bandibhiḥ stūyamānā ca sthitā śailasutā tadā sitātapatraṃ ratnāṃśumiśritaṃ cāvahattathā
verses.translation: Thanks to his brilliance, Devas including Indr a, Candra (Moon), the sun, Brahma, Sadhyas, Narayana, Yama, and Rudra requested the lord for an eye that will enable them to see the dazzling form of the lord* The lord gave them the divine eye competent to see everything. To Bhavanl and to the mountain too he gave the excellent vision. After acquiring divine sight Devas with Indra and Vignu as their leaders, in- cluding Brahma and Indra saw the lord. Then they immediately bowed down to the lord. So also Bhavanl, the lord of the mountains, sages and Ganas approved of by Siva bowed down to Mahadeva. The Siddhas, Caranas, and other heaven-dwellers showered flowers.
verses.hindi: वृद्धि, सरस्वती, राका, कुहू, सिनीवाली, देवी अनुमती,
verses.wordMeaning: Thanks to his brilliance, Devas including Indr a, Candra (Moon), the sun, Brahma, Sadhyas, Narayana, Yama, and Rudra requested the lord for an eye that will enable them to see the dazzling form of the lord* The lord gave them the divine eye competent to see everything.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Thanks to his brilliance, Devas including Indr a, Candra (Moon), the sun, Brahma, Sadhyas, Narayana, Yama, and Rudra requested the lord for an eye that will enable them to see the dazzling form of the lord* The lord gave them the divine eye competent to see everything.…

verses.sanskrit: मालिनी गिरिपुत्र्यास्तु संध्या पूर्णेन्दुमण्डलम् चामरासक्तहस्ताभिर् दिव्यस्त्रीभिश् च संवृता
verses.transliteration: mālinī giriputryāstu saṃdhyā pūrṇendumaṇḍalam cāmarāsaktahastābhir divyastrībhiś ca saṃvṛtā
verses.translation: The divine Dundubhis were sounded; the sages eulogised the lord; the chiefs of the Gandharvas sang; the Apsarases danced; the leaders of the Ganas rejoiced; Arnba the daughter of the lord of mountains too rejoiced. The delighted goddess placed at his feet the divine fragrant garland in the presence of the heaven-dwellers. Devas including Brahma, Yak§as, Nagas and Rakgasas shouted "Well done, well done'* and made obeisance to him then and there with their heads touching the ground.
verses.hindi: सभी देवमाताएँ तथा देवपत्नियाँ 'शंकरका विवाह ही रही है '--ऐसा सोचकर आनन्दमग्न होकर वहाँ गयी । सर मेघ, मास, संवत्सर, वेद, मन्त्र, यज्ञ, स्तोम, धर्म, हरी प्रणव, हजारों प्रतिहार, करोड़ों दिव्य अप्सराएँ तथा उनकी परिचारिकाएँ और समस्त द्वीपों तथा देवलोकोंमें जो शी नदियाँ हैं, वे सब स्त्रीका रूप धारण करके
verses.wordMeaning: The divine Dundubhis were sounded; the sages eulogised the lord; the chiefs of the Gandharvas sang; the Apsarases danced; the leaders of the Ganas rejoiced; Arnba the daughter of the lord of mountains too rejoiced.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The divine Dundubhis were sounded; the sages eulogised the lord; the chiefs of the Gandharvas sang; the Apsarases danced; the leaders of the Ganas rejoiced; Arnba the daughter of the lord of mountains too rejoiced.…

verses.sanskrit: मालां गृह्य जया तस्थौ सुरद्रुमसमुद्भवाम् विजया व्यजनं गृह्य स्थिता देव्याः समीपगा
verses.transliteration: mālāṃ gṛhya jayā tasthau suradrumasamudbhavām vijayā vyajanaṃ gṛhya sthitā devyāḥ samīpagā
verses.translation: The divine Dundubhis were sounded; the sages eulogised the lord; the chiefs of the Gandharvas sang; the Apsarases danced; the leaders of the Ganas rejoiced; Arnba the daughter of the lord of mountains too rejoiced. The delighted goddess placed at his feet the divine fragrant garland in the presence of the heaven-dwellers. Devas including Brahma, Yak§as, Nagas and Rakgasas shouted "Well done, well done'* and made obeisance to him then and there with their heads touching the ground.
verses.hindi: होकर वहाँ गयीं  सभी लोकोंसे नमस्कृत महाभाग गणेश भी “यह शंकरका विवाह है'--यह सोचकर युक्त हो वहाँ आये
verses.wordMeaning: The divine Dundubhis were sounded; the sages eulogised the lord; the chiefs of the Gandharvas sang; the Apsarases danced; the leaders of the Ganas rejoiced; Arnba the daughter of the lord of mountains too rejoiced.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The divine Dundubhis were sounded; the sages eulogised the lord; the chiefs of the Gandharvas sang; the Apsarases danced; the leaders of the Ganas rejoiced; Arnba the daughter of the lord of mountains too rejoiced.…

verses.sanskrit: मालां प्रगृह्य देव्यां तु स्थितायां देवसंसदि शिशुर्भूत्वा महादेवः क्रीडार्थं वृषभध्वजः
verses.transliteration: mālāṃ pragṛhya devyāṃ tu sthitāyāṃ devasaṃsadi śiśurbhūtvā mahādevaḥ krīḍārthaṃ vṛṣabhadhvajaḥ
verses.translation: The divine Dundubhis were sounded; the sages eulogised the lord; the chiefs of the Gandharvas sang; the Apsarases danced; the leaders of the Ganas rejoiced; Arnba the daughter of the lord of mountains too rejoiced. The delighted goddess placed at his feet the divine fragrant garland in the presence of the heaven-dwellers. Devas including Brahma, Yak§as, Nagas and Rakgasas shouted "Well done, well done'* and made obeisance to him then and there with their heads touching the ground.
verses.hindi: शंखके समान वर्णवाले गणेश्वर अपने करोडौं  साथ पहुँचे। केकराक्ष दस करोड़ गणोंके साथ, विद्युत आठ करोड़ गणोंके साथ, विशाख चौंसठ करोड़ गणोंके साथ, पारयात्रिक नौ करोड़ गणोंके साथ, श्रीमान् सर्वान्तक छः करोड़ गणोंके साथ, विकृतानन भी छः करोड़ गणोंके साथ, गणोंमें श्रेष्ठ ज्वालाकेश बारह करोड़ गणोंके साथ, श्रीमान् समद सात करोड़ गणोंके साथ, दुन्दुभ आठ करोड़ गणोंके साथ, 'कपालीश पाँच
verses.wordMeaning: The divine Dundubhis were sounded; the sages eulogised the lord; the chiefs of the Gandharvas sang; the Apsarases danced; the leaders of the Ganas rejoiced; Arnba the daughter of the lord of mountains too rejoiced.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The divine Dundubhis were sounded; the sages eulogised the lord; the chiefs of the Gandharvas sang; the Apsarases danced; the leaders of the Ganas rejoiced; Arnba the daughter of the lord of mountains too rejoiced.…

verses.sanskrit: उत्सङ्गतलसंसुप्तो बभूव भगवान्भवः अथ दृष्ट्वा शिशुं देवास् तस्या उत्संगवर्त्तिनम्
verses.transliteration: utsaṅgatalasaṃsupto babhūva bhagavānbhavaḥ atha dṛṣṭvā śiśuṃ devās tasyā utsaṃgavarttinam
verses.translation: The divine Dundubhis were sounded; the sages eulogised the lord; the chiefs of the Gandharvas sang; the Apsarases danced; the leaders of the Ganas rejoiced; Arnba the daughter of the lord of mountains too rejoiced. The delighted goddess placed at his feet the divine fragrant garland in the presence of the heaven-dwellers. Devas including Brahma, Yak§as, Nagas and Rakgasas shouted "Well done, well done'* and made obeisance to him then and there with their heads touching the ground.
verses.hindi: करोड़ गणोंके साथ, उत्तम संदारक छः करोड़ गणोंके साथ और गण्डक तथा कुम्भक करोड़ों-करोड़ों गणोंके साथ आये

verses.transliteration: tavāhaṃ dakṣiṇāddhastāt sṛṣṭaḥ pūrvaṃ purātanaḥ vāmahastān mahābāho devo nārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ

verses.hindi: पञ्चाक्षः शतमन्युश्च मेघमन्युस्तथैव च॥ २६  करोड़ गणोंके साथ और केवल, ५४९ पंचाक्ष, शान  काष्ठकूटश्चतुःषष्ट्या सुकेशो वृषभस्तथा।  तथा  न a ०; साथ आहे  विरूपाक्षश्च भगवान् चतुःषष्ट्या सनातन: ॥ २७  ऋत, सुश भ si गणोंके साथ  तालकेतुः षडास्यश्च पञ्चास्यश्च सनातनः।   भगवान् सनातन विरूपाक्ष भी चौसठ करोड़ गणोके ..

verses.sanskrit: इयं च प्रकृतिर्देवी सदा ते सृष्टिकारण पत्नीरूपं समास्थाय जगत्कारणमागता
verses.transliteration: iyaṃ ca prakṛtirdevī sadā te sṛṣṭikāraṇa patnīrūpaṃ samāsthāya jagatkāraṇamāgatā

verses.hindi: साथ आये। इसी प्रकार तालकेतु, षडास्य, पंचास्य लोकान्तकश्च दीप्तास्यो तथा हैत्यान्तकः प्रभुः । शिक

verses.sanskrit: नमस्तुभ्यं महादेव महादेव्यै नमोनमः प्रसादात्तव देवेश नियोगाच्च मया प्रजाः
verses.transliteration: namastubhyaṃ mahādeva mahādevyai namonamaḥ prasādāttava deveśa niyogācca mayā prajāḥ
verses.translation: The divine Dundubhis were sounded; the sages eulogised the lord; the chiefs of the Gandharvas sang; the Apsarases danced; the leaders of the Ganas rejoiced; Arnba the daughter of the lord of mountains too rejoiced. verses.hindi: दीप्तास्य, प्रभु हैत्यान्तक, मृत्युहत्, कालहा, काल मृत्युहृत्कालहा कालो मृत्युञ्जयकरस्तथा॥ २९ मृतयुंजयकर, विषाद, विषद, विद्युत, प्रभु कनक र विषादो विषदश्चैव विद्युत: कान्तकः प्रभुः । भृंगी, रिटि, श्रीमान् देवदेवप्रिय, अशनि, भासक दछ. देवो भृङ्गी रिटिः श्रीमान् देवदेवप्रियस्तथा
verses.wordMeaning: The divine Dundubhis were sounded; the sages eulogised the lord; the chiefs of the Gandharvas sang; the Apsarases danced; the leaders of the Ganas rejoiced; Arnba the daughter of the lord of mountains too rejoiced.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The divine Dundubhis were sounded; the sages eulogised the lord; the chiefs of the Gandharvas sang; the Apsarases danced; the leaders of the Ganas rejoiced; Arnba the daughter of the lord of mountains too rejoiced.…

verses.sanskrit: देवाद्यास्तु इमाः सृष्टा मूढास्त्वद्योगमोहिताः कुरु प्रसादमेतेषां यथापूर्वं भवन्त्विमे
verses.transliteration: devādyāstu imāḥ sṛṣṭā mūḍhāstvadyogamohitāḥ kuru prasādameteṣāṃ yathāpūrvaṃ bhavantvime
verses.translation: The divine Dundubhis were sounded; the sages eulogised the lord; the chiefs of the Gandharvas sang; the Apsarases danced; the leaders of the Ganas rejoiced; Arnba the daughter of the lord of mountains too rejoiced. The delighted goddess placed at his feet the divine fragrant garland in the presence of the heaven-dwellers. Devas including Brahma, Yak§as, Nagas and Rakgasas shouted "Well done, well done'* and made obeisance to him then and there with their heads touching the ground.
verses.hindi: सहस्रपात् चौसठ करोड़ गणोंके साथ आये  ये सब तथा अशनिर्भासकश्चैव चतुःषष्ट्या सहस्त्रपात्। अन्य असंख्य महाबली गणेश्वर भी वहाँ आये । वे सभी एते चान्ये च गणपा असंख्याता महाबला: हजार हाथोंवाले, जटा-मुकुट धारण किये हुए, मस्तकपर
verses.wordMeaning: The divine Dundubhis were sounded; the sages eulogised the lord; the chiefs of the Gandharvas sang; the Apsarases danced; the leaders of the Ganas rejoiced; Arnba the daughter of the lord of mountains too rejoiced.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The divine Dundubhis were sounded; the sages eulogised the lord; the chiefs of the Gandharvas sang; the Apsarases danced; the leaders of the Ganas rejoiced; Arnba the daughter of the lord of mountains too rejoiced.…

verses.sanskrit: विज्ञाप्यैवं तदा ब्रह्मा देवदेवं महेश्वरम् संस्तम्भितांस्तदा तेन भगवान् आह पद्मजः
verses.transliteration: vijñāpyaivaṃ tadā brahmā devadevaṃ maheśvaram saṃstambhitāṃstadā tena bhagavān āha padmajaḥ
verses.translation: The divine Dundubhis were sounded; the sages eulogised the lord; the chiefs of the Gandharvas sang; the Apsarases danced; the leaders of the Ganas rejoiced; Arnba the daughter of the lord of mountains too rejoiced. The delighted goddess placed at his feet the divine fragrant garland in the presence of the heaven-dwellers. Devas including Brahma, Yak§as, Nagas and Rakgasas shouted "Well done, well done'* and made obeisance to him then and there with their heads touching the ground.
verses.hindi: चन्द्ररेखासे विभूषित, नीलकण्ठवाले, तीन नेत्रोंवाले, चन्द्रेखावतंसाश्च नीलकण्ठास्त्रिलोचना: ॥ ३२ हार-कुण्डल-केयूर-मुकुट आदिसे अलंकृत, ब्रह्मा- हारकुण्डलकेयूरमुकुटाद्यैरलडूकृता: । इन्द्र-विष्णुके समान प्रतीत होनेवाले, अणिमा आदि ब्रह्वोन्द्रविष्णुसङ्काशा अणिमादिगुणै्वृताः॥ ३३  सिद्धियोंसे युक्त थे; करोड़ों सूर्योके सदृश आभावाले
verses.wordMeaning: The divine Dundubhis were sounded; the sages eulogised the lord; the chiefs of the Gandharvas sang; the Apsarases danced; the leaders of the Ganas rejoiced; Arnba the daughter of the lord of mountains too rejoiced.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The divine Dundubhis were sounded; the sages eulogised the lord; the chiefs of the Gandharvas sang; the Apsarases danced; the leaders of the Ganas rejoiced; Arnba the daughter of the lord of mountains too rejoiced.…

verses.sanskrit: मूढास्थ देवताः सर्वा नैव बुध्यत शङ्करम् देवदेवम् इहायान्तं सर्वदेवनमस्कृतम्
verses.transliteration: mūḍhāstha devatāḥ sarvā naiva budhyata śaṅkaram devadevam ihāyāntaṃ sarvadevanamaskṛtam
verses.translation: The divine Dundubhis were sounded; the sages eulogised the lord; the chiefs of the Gandharvas sang; the Apsarases danced; the leaders of the Ganas rejoiced; Arnba the daughter of the lord of mountains too rejoiced. The delighted goddess placed at his feet the divine fragrant garland in the presence of the heaven-dwellers. Devas including Brahma, Yak§as, Nagas and Rakgasas shouted "Well done, well done'* and made obeisance to him then and there with their heads touching the ground.
verses.hindi: सूर्यकोटिप्रतीकाशास्तत्राजम्मुर्गणेश्वरा । पाताललोकमें विचरण करनेवाले तथा सभी लोकोंमें पातालचारिणश्चैव सर्वलोकनिवासिन: निवास करनेवाले वे गणेश्वर वहाँ आये। तुम्बुरु, नारद,

verses.sanskrit: गच्छध्वं शरणं शीघ्रं देवाः शक्रपुरोगमाः सनारायणकाः सर्वे मुनिभिः शङ्करं प्रभुम्
verses.transliteration: gacchadhvaṃ śaraṇaṃ śīghraṃ devāḥ śakrapurogamāḥ sanārāyaṇakāḥ sarve munibhiḥ śaṅkaraṃ prabhum

verses.hindi: तुम्बरुर्नारदो हाहा हूहूश्चैव तु सामगाः। हाहा, हुहू एवं साम गान करनेवाले भी रलों तथा रलान्यादाय वाद्यांश्च तत्राजग्मुस्तदा पुरम्॥ ३५  वाधयन्त्रोंको लेकर उस पुरमें आये
verses.wordMeaning: The divine Dundubhis were sounded; the sages eulogised the lord; the chiefs of the Gandharvas sang; the Apsarases danced; the leaders of the Ganas rejoiced; Arnba the daughter of the lord of mountains too rejoiced.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The divine Dundubhis were sounded; the sages eulogised the lord; the chiefs of the Gandharvas sang; the Apsarases danced; the leaders of the Ganas rejoiced; Arnba the daughter of the lord of mountains too rejoiced.…

verses.sanskrit: सार्धं मयैव देवेशं परमात्मानमीश्वरम् अनया हैमवत्या च प्रकृत्या सह सत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: sārdhaṃ mayaiva deveśaṃ paramātmānamīśvaram anayā haimavatyā ca prakṛtyā saha sattamam

The delighted goddess placed at his feet the divine fragrant garland in the presence of the heaven-dwellers. Devas including Brahma, Yak§as, Nagas and Rakgasas shouted "Well done, well done'* and made obeisance to him then and there with their heads touching the ground.
verses.hindi: ऋषयः कृत्स्नशस्तत्र देवगीतास्तपोधनाः । देवताओद्वारा स्तुत तथा तपोधन बहुत से म पुण्यान् वैवाहिकान् मन्ञरानजपुर्हष्टमानसा: ॥ ३६  “चित्त होकर विवाहसम्बन्धी पवित्र मन्त्रोंका उच्चारण गिरिजां तामलडूकृत्य स्वयमेव शुचिस्मिताम्॥ ३७ इस प्रकार पूर्णरूपसे सबके उपस्थित हो कर
verses.wordMeaning: The divine Dundubhis were sounded; the sages eulogised the lord; the chiefs of the Gandharvas sang; the Apsarases danced; the leaders of the Ganas rejoiced; Arnba the daughter of the lord of mountains too rejoiced.…

verses.sanskrit: तत्र ते स्तम्भितास्तेन तथैव सुरसत्तमाः प्रणेमुर् मनसा सर्वे सनारायणकाः प्रभुम्
verses.transliteration: tatra te stambhitāstena tathaiva surasattamāḥ praṇemur manasā sarve sanārāyaṇakāḥ prabhum
verses.translation: The divine Dundubhis were sounded; the sages eulogised the lord; the chiefs of the Gandharvas sang; the Apsarases danced; the leaders of the Ganas rejoiced; Arnba the daughter of the lord of mountains too rejoiced. Devas including Brahma, Yak§as, Nagas and Rakgasas shouted "Well done, well done'* and made obeisance to him then and there with their heads touching the ground.
verses.hindi: विष्णुने स्वयं पवित्र मुसकानवाली पार्वतीको अलंकृत पुरं प्रवेशयामास स्वयमादाय केशव: । करके तथा स्वयं उन्हें ला करके परम प्रवेश कराया! सदस्याह च देवेशं नारायणमजो हरिम्

verses.transliteration: atha teṣāṃ prasanno bhūd devadevastriyaṃbakaḥ yathāpūrvaṃ cakārāśu vacanādbrahmaṇaḥ prabhuḥ

verses.hindi: भवानग्रे समुत्पन्नो भवान्या सह हैवतैः । तदनन्तर ब्रह्माने देवताओंके स्वामी नारायण विष्ुस वामाङ्गादस्य रुद्रस्य दक्षिणाङ्गादहं प्रभो

verses.hindi: सभामें कहा-“हे प्रभो! पहले आप इन रुद्रके बाए अंगसे भवानी तथा देवताओंके साथ उत्पन्न हुए

verses.hindi: मन्पूर्तिस्तुहिनाद्रीशो यज्ञार्थं सृष्ट एव हि। एषा हैमवती जज्ञे मायया परमेष्ठिन:

verses.sanskrit: सयमाश् च सरुद्राश् च चक्षुरप्रार्थयन् विभुम् तेभ्यश् च परमं चक्षुः सर्वदृष्टौ च शक्तिमत्
verses.transliteration: sayamāś ca sarudrāś ca cakṣuraprārthayan vibhum tebhyaś ca paramaṃ cakṣuḥ sarvadṛṣṭau ca śaktimat

Devas including Brahma, Yak§as, Nagas and Rakgasas shouted "Well done, well done'* and made obeisance to him then and there with their heads touching the ground.
verses.hindi: मैं इनके दाहिने अंगसे उत्पन्न हुआ। मेरे गग  पर्वतराज हिमालय वास्तवमें इस यज्ञके लिये ही उत्पन
verses.wordMeaning: The divine Dundubhis were sounded; the sages eulogised the lord; the chiefs of the Gandharvas sang; the Apsarases danced; the leaders of the Ganas rejoiced; Arnba the daughter of the lord of mountains too rejoiced.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The divine Dundubhis were sounded; the sages eulogised the lord; the chiefs of the Gandharvas sang; the Apsarases danced; the leaders of the Ganas rejoiced; Arnba the daughter of the lord of mountains too rejoiced.…

verses.sanskrit: ददावंबापतिः शर्वो भवान्याश् च चलस्य च लब्ध्वा चक्षुस्तदा देवा इन्द्रविष्णुपुरोगमाः
verses.transliteration: dadāvaṃbāpatiḥ śarvo bhavānyāś ca calasya ca labdhvā cakṣustadā devā indraviṣṇupurogamāḥ
verses.translation: The divine Dundubhis were sounded; the sages eulogised the lord; the chiefs of the Gandharvas sang; the Apsarases danced; the leaders of the Ganas rejoiced; Arnba the daughter of the lord of mountains too rejoiced. The delighted goddess placed at his feet the divine fragrant garland in the presence of the heaven-dwellers. Devas including Brahma, Yak§as, Nagas and Rakgasas shouted "Well done, well done'* and made obeisance to him then and there with their heads touching the ground.
verses.hindi: अध्याय ९०३ भगवान् शिव एवं पार्वतीके विवाहकी मांगलिक कथा  ककअं अककककऊ कफज क काकमअडडकममकम आ सतज कककफफफकककफफफफफफफफफफफफ्फफफफफफफफ फफफ फफ फफ फफफ फफ फफ
verses.wordMeaning: The divine Dundubhis were sounded; the sages eulogised the lord; the chiefs of the Gandharvas sang; the Apsarases danced; the leaders of the Ganas rejoiced; Arnba the daughter of the lord of mountains too rejoiced.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The divine Dundubhis were sounded; the sages eulogised the lord; the chiefs of the Gandharvas sang; the Apsarases danced; the leaders of the Ganas rejoiced; Arnba the daughter of the lord of mountains too rejoiced.…

verses.sanskrit: सब्रह्मकः सशक्राश् च तमपश्यन्महेश्वरम् ब्रह्माद्या नेमिरे तूर्णं भवानी च गिरीश्वरः
verses.transliteration: sabrahmakaḥ saśakrāś ca tamapaśyanmaheśvaram brahmādyā nemire tūrṇaṃ bhavānī ca girīśvaraḥ
verses.translation: The divine Dundubhis were sounded; the sages eulogised the lord; the chiefs of the Gandharvas sang; the Apsarases danced; the leaders of the Ganas rejoiced; Arnba the daughter of the lord of mountains too rejoiced. The delighted goddess placed at his feet the divine fragrant garland in the presence of the heaven-dwellers. Devas including Brahma, Yak§as, Nagas and Rakgasas shouted "Well done, well done'* and made obeisance to him then and there with their heads touching the ground.
verses.hindi: ्थमुद्वाहार्थमिहागतः । गये हैं । इन पार्वतीने परमेष्ठी शिव-की मायासे
verses.wordMeaning: The divine Dundubhis were sounded; the sages eulogised the lord; the chiefs of the Gandharvas sang; the Apsarases danced; the leaders of the Ganas rejoiced; Arnba the daughter of the lord of mountains too rejoiced.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The divine Dundubhis were sounded; the sages eulogised the lord; the chiefs of the Gandharvas sang; the Apsarases danced; the leaders of the Ganas rejoiced; Arnba the daughter of the lord of mountains too rejoiced.…

verses.sanskrit: मुनयश् च महादेवं गणेशाः शिवसंमताः ससर्जुः पुष्पवृष्टिं च खेचराः सिद्धचारणाः
verses.transliteration: munayaś ca mahādevaṃ gaṇeśāḥ śivasaṃmatāḥ sasarjuḥ puṣpavṛṣṭiṃ ca khecarāḥ siddhacāraṇāḥ
verses.translation: The divine Dundubhis were sounded; the sages eulogised the lord; the chiefs of the Gandharvas sang; the Apsarases danced; the leaders of the Ganas rejoiced; Arnba the daughter of the lord of mountains too rejoiced. The delighted goddess placed at his feet the divine fragrant garland in the presence of the heaven-dwellers. Devas including Brahma, Yak§as, Nagas and Rakgasas shouted "Well done, well done'* and made obeisance to him then and there with their heads touching the ground.
verses.hindi: अतोऽसौ जगतां धात्री धाता तव ममापि च॥ ४१  हिमवानूकी पुत्रीके रूपमें जन्म लिया है। अतः ये सभी लोकोंकी, आपकी तथा मेरी भी धात्री (जननी) हैं और श्रौत-स्मार्त प्रवृत्तिक लिये विवाहके उद्देश्यसे यहाँ आये हुए ये रुद्र सबके धाता (जनक) हैं। चूँकि पृथ्वी, जल, अग्नि, आकाश, चन्द्र, सूर्य, आत्मा तथा पवन शिवके ही विग्रहस्वरूप हैं, अतः इन रुद्रदेवकी इन्हीं मूर्तियोंसे ही जगत् उत्पन्न हुआ है। तथापि हिमवानूके तथा मेरे वचनसे शुक्ल-कृष्ण-लोहित वर्णवाली मायारूपा
verses.wordMeaning: The divine Dundubhis were sounded; the sages eulogised the lord; the chiefs of the Gandharvas sang; the Apsarases danced; the leaders of the Ganas rejoiced; Arnba the daughter of the lord of mountains too rejoiced.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The divine Dundubhis were sounded; the sages eulogised the lord; the chiefs of the Gandharvas sang; the Apsarases danced; the leaders of the Ganas rejoiced; Arnba the daughter of the lord of mountains too rejoiced.…

verses.sanskrit: देवदुन्दुभयो नेदुस् तुष्टुवुर्मुनयः प्रभुम् जगुर्गन्धर्वमुख्याश् च ननृतुश्चाप्सरोगणाः
verses.transliteration: devadundubhayo nedus tuṣṭuvurmunayaḥ prabhum jagurgandharvamukhyāś ca nanṛtuścāpsarogaṇāḥ
verses.translation: The divine Dundubhis were sounded; the sages eulogised the lord; the chiefs of the Gandharvas sang; the Apsarases danced; the leaders of the Ganas rejoiced; Arnba the daughter of the lord of mountains too rejoiced. The delighted goddess placed at his feet the divine fragrant garland in the presence of the heaven-dwellers. Devas including Brahma, Yak§as, Nagas and Rakgasas shouted "Well done, well done'* and made obeisance to him then and there with their heads touching the ground.
verses.hindi: इन पार्वतीको उन शिवके निमित्त प्रदान कर देना चाहिए; है विष्णो! आप भी प्रकृतिरूप हैं । पर्वतराजके साथ यह सम्बन्ध आपके लिये भी कल्याणप्रद है। मैं पद्मकल्पमें आपके नाभिकमलसे उत्पन्न हुआ था; अतः
verses.wordMeaning: The divine Dundubhis were sounded; the sages eulogised the lord; the chiefs of the Gandharvas sang; the Apsarases danced; the leaders of the Ganas rejoiced; Arnba the daughter of the lord of mountains too rejoiced.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The divine Dundubhis were sounded; the sages eulogised the lord; the chiefs of the Gandharvas sang; the Apsarases danced; the leaders of the Ganas rejoiced; Arnba the daughter of the lord of mountains too rejoiced.…

verses.sanskrit: मुमुहुर्गणपाः सर्वे मुमोदांबा च पार्वती तस्य देवी तदा हृष्टा समक्षं त्रिदिवौकसाम्
verses.transliteration: mumuhurgaṇapāḥ sarve mumodāṃbā ca pārvatī tasya devī tadā hṛṣṭā samakṣaṃ tridivaukasām
verses.translation: The divine Dundubhis were sounded; the sages eulogised the lord; the chiefs of the Gandharvas sang; the Apsarases danced; the leaders of the Ganas rejoiced; Arnba the daughter of the lord of mountains too rejoiced. The delighted goddess placed at his feet the divine fragrant garland in the presence of the heaven-dwellers. Devas including Brahma, Yak§as, Nagas and Rakgasas shouted "Well done, well done'* and made obeisance to him then and there with their heads touching the ground.
verses.hindi: आप मेरे अंशस्वरूप इन हिमालयके तथा मेरे भी गुरु हैँ'॥ ३७-४४ /२॥ सूतजी बोले--हे ऋषियो! तब उन देवदेव जनार्दनने ब्रह्मासे कहा--'ठीक है।' तब देवतागण, सभी मुनि तथा देवदेव शिव प्रसन्न हो गये। तदनन्तर कमलके समान नेत्रवाले उन विद्वान् पद्मनाभ विष्णुने
verses.wordMeaning: The divine Dundubhis were sounded; the sages eulogised the lord; the chiefs of the Gandharvas sang; the Apsarases danced; the leaders of the Ganas rejoiced; Arnba the daughter of the lord of mountains too rejoiced.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The divine Dundubhis were sounded; the sages eulogised the lord; the chiefs of the Gandharvas sang; the Apsarases danced; the leaders of the Ganas rejoiced; Arnba the daughter of the lord of mountains too rejoiced.…

verses.sanskrit: पादयोः स्थापयामास मालां दिव्यां सुगन्धिनीम् साधु साध्विति सम्प्रोच्य तया तत्रैव चार्चितम्
verses.transliteration: pādayoḥ sthāpayāmāsa mālāṃ divyāṃ sugandhinīm sādhu sādhviti samprocya tayā tatraiva cārcitam
verses.translation: The divine Dundubhis were sounded; the sages eulogised the lord; the chiefs of the Gandharvas sang; the Apsarases danced; the leaders of the Ganas rejoiced; Arnba the daughter of the lord of mountains too rejoiced. The delighted goddess placed at his feet the divine fragrant garland in the presence of the heaven-dwellers. Devas including Brahma, Yak§as, Nagas and Rakgasas shouted "Well done, well done'* and made obeisance to him then and there with their heads touching the ground.
verses.hindi: उठकर उन पार्वती-को प्रणाम करके अपने हाथोंसे शिवके दोनों चरणोंको धोकर अपने, ब्रह्माके तथा हिमालयके सिरपर जल छिड़का। ' है शिव! आपको नित्यसम्बन्धिनी ये पार्वती विवाहविधिकी सिद्धिके
verses.wordMeaning: The divine Dundubhis were sounded; the sages eulogised the lord; the chiefs of the Gandharvas sang; the Apsarases danced; the leaders of the Ganas rejoiced; Arnba the daughter of the lord of mountains too rejoiced.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The divine Dundubhis were sounded; the sages eulogised the lord; the chiefs of the Gandharvas sang; the Apsarases danced; the leaders of the Ganas rejoiced; Arnba the daughter of the lord of mountains too rejoiced.…

verses.sanskrit: सह देव्या नमश्चक्रुः शिरोभिर् भूतलाश्रितैः सर्वे सब्रह्मका देवाः सयक्षोरगराक्षसाः
verses.transliteration: saha devyā namaścakruḥ śirobhir bhūtalāśritaiḥ sarve sabrahmakā devāḥ sayakṣoragarākṣasāḥ
verses.translation: The divine Dundubhis were sounded; the sages eulogised the lord; the chiefs of the Gandharvas sang; the Apsarases danced; the leaders of the Ganas rejoiced; Arnba the daughter of the lord of mountains too rejoiced. The delighted goddess placed at his feet the divine fragrant garland in the presence of the heaven-dwellers. Devas including Brahma, Yak§as, Nagas and Rakgasas shouted "Well done, well done'* and made obeisance to him then and there with their heads touching the ground.
verses.hindi: लिये ही मेनासे उत्पन्न हुई हैं; ये मेरी छोटी बहन हैं ऐसा कहकर विष्णुने उन पार्वतीको देवेश्वरके लिये जलसहित समर्पित करके स्वयं अपनेको भी उन देवके लिये जलसहित समर्पित कर दिया॥ ४५--४८ /२॥ इसके बाद सभी वेदोंके अर्थामें पारंगत श्रेष्ठ मुनियोंने कहा-- विचार करनेपर वस्तुतः ये महादेव शिव ही दाता, गृहीता, द्रव्य तथा फल सब कुछ हैं और इन्हींकी मायासे यह जगत् स्थित है'-ऐसा
verses.wordMeaning: The divine Dundubhis were sounded; the sages eulogised the lord; the chiefs of the Gandharvas sang; the Apsarases danced; the leaders of the Ganas rejoiced; Arnba the daughter of the lord of mountains too rejoiced.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The divine Dundubhis were sounded; the sages eulogised the lord; the chiefs of the Gandharvas sang; the Apsarases danced; the leaders of the Ganas rejoiced; Arnba the daughter of the lord of mountains too rejoiced.…

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीलिङ्गमहापुराणे पूर्वभागे उमास्वयंवरो नाम द्व्यधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः अथ ब्रह्मा महादेवम् अभिवन्द्य कृताञ्जलिः उद्वाहः क्रियतां देव इत्युवाच महेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: iti śrīliṅgamahāpurāṇe pūrvabhāge umāsvayaṃvaro nāma dvyadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ atha brahmā mahādevam abhivandya kṛtāñjaliḥ udvāhaḥ kriyatāṃ deva ityuvāca maheśvaram
verses.translation: Thereafter Brahma saluted Mahadeva with palms join- ed in reverence and said to Mahe€vara "O lord, may the marriage be celebrated."
verses.hindi: कहकर प्रसन्नतासे रोमांचित उन सभीने शिवजीको
verses.wordMeaning: Thereafter Brahma saluted Mahadeva with palms join- ed in reverence and said to Mahe€vara "O lord, may the marriage be celebrated."
verses.commentary: Sense: Thereafter Brahma saluted Mahadeva with palms join- ed in reverence and said to Mahe€vara "O lord, may the marriage be celebrated."

verses.sanskrit: तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा ब्रह्मणः परमेष्ठिनः यथेष्टमिति लोकेशं प्राह भूतपतिः प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā brahmaṇaḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ yatheṣṭamiti lokeśaṃ prāha bhūtapatiḥ prabhuḥ
verses.translation: On hearing these words of Brahma Paramesthin, the lord of the Bhutas said to Brahma "As you please."
verses.hindi: उस समय आकाशचारी सिद्धों तथा चारणोंने पुष्पवृष्टि की, देवताओंकी दुन्दुभियाँ बजने लगीं और अस्य देवस्य रुद्रस्य मूर्तिभिर्विहितं जगत्। क्ष्माबग्निखेन्दुसूर्यात्मपवनात्मा यतो भवः
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing these words of Brahma Paramesthin, the lord of the Bhutas said to Brahma "As you please."
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing these words of Brahma Paramesthin, the lord of the Bhutas said to Brahma "As you please."

verses.sanskrit: उद्वाहार्थं महेशस्य तत्क्षणादेव सुव्रताः ब्रह्मणा कल्पितं दिव्यं पुरं रत्नमयं शुभम्
verses.transliteration: udvāhārthaṃ maheśasya tatkṣaṇādeva suvratāḥ brahmaṇā kalpitaṃ divyaṃ puraṃ ratnamayaṃ śubham
verses.translation: sarvadeva: ST. reads sarvadcva for sarvadoa. niv&ranam— sarvadevalr api drafpim aiakyam ST. so dazzling that it could not be visualized even by the gods.
verses.hindi: बाढमित्यजमाहासौ देवदेवो जनार्दन:
verses.wordMeaning: sarvadeva: ST. reads sarvadcva for sarvadoa. niv&ranam— sarvadevalr api drafpim aiakyam ST. so dazzling that it could not be visualized even by the gods.
verses.commentary: Sense: sarvadeva: ST. reads sarvadcva for sarvadoa. niv&ranam— sarvadevalr api drafpim aiakyam ST. so dazzling that it could not be visualized even by the gods.

verses.sanskrit: अथादितिर्दितिः साक्षाद् दनुः कद्रुः सुकालिका पुलोमा सुरसा चैव सिंहिका विनता तथा
verses.transliteration: athāditirditiḥ sākṣād danuḥ kadruḥ sukālikā pulomā surasā caiva siṃhikā vinatā tathā
verses.translation: O sages of good holy rites, for the marriage of Mahe£a, a divine splendid city full of jewels was created by BrahmS. instantaneously.
verses.hindi: देवाश्च मुनयः सर्वे देवदेवश्च शङ्करः। पादौ प्रक्षाल्य देवस्य कराभ्यां कमलेक्षणः। अभ्युक्षदात्मनो मूर्धन ब्रह्मणश्च गिरेस्तथा
verses.wordMeaning: O sages of good holy rites, for the marriage of Mahe£a, a divine splendid city full of jewels was created by BrahmS. instantaneously.
verses.commentary: Sense: O sages of good holy rites, for the marriage of Mahe£a, a divine splendid city full of jewels was created by BrahmS. instantaneously.

verses.sanskrit: सिद्धिर्माया क्रिया दुर्गा देवी साक्षात्सुधा स्वधा सावित्री वेदमाता च रजनी दक्षिणा द्युतिः
verses.transliteration: siddhirmāyā kriyā durgā devī sākṣātsudhā svadhā sāvitrī vedamātā ca rajanī dakṣiṇā dyutiḥ
verses.translation: The following persons went to the place of marriage: — Aditi, Diti, Danu, Kadru, Sukalika, Puloma, Suram£, Siriihika, Vinata, Siddhi, Maya, Kriya, Durga, Sudha herself, Svadha, Savitri the mother of Devas, Rajani, Daksina, Dyuti, Svaha, Svadha, Mati, Buddhi, Rddhi, Vrddhi, Sarasvati, Raka, Kuhu, Sinfvalf, Anumati, Dharani, Dharani, Ila, Saci, Nara- yani, and other mothers and wives of Devas — all of them went there joyously saying "O this is Sankara's marriage." Nagas, Ganujas, Yaksas, Gandharvas, Kinnaras, Ganas, oceans, mountains, clouds, months, years, Vedas, Mantras, Yajftas, Kriyas, Humkara, Prana va, thousands of Pratiharas (jugglers, porters), the crores of Apsarases, the divine damsels and their female attendants — all these went to the place of marriage. The rivers in the continents and the worlds of Devas assumed the forms of women and proceeded there with delighted minds.
verses.hindi: इत्युक्त्वा सोदकं दत्त्वा देवीं देवेशवराय ताम्
verses.wordMeaning: The following persons went to the place of marriage: — Aditi, Diti, Danu, Kadru, Sukalika, Puloma, Suram£, Siriihika, Vinata, Siddhi, Maya, Kriya, Durga, Sudha herself, Svadha, Savitri the mother of Devas, Rajani, Daksina, Dyuti, Svaha, Svadha, Mati, Buddhi, Rddhi, Vrddhi,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The following persons went to the place of marriage: — Aditi, Diti, Danu, Kadru, Sukalika, Puloma, Suram£, Siriihika, Vinata, Siddhi, Maya, Kriya, Durga, Sudha herself, Svadha, Savitri the mother of Devas, Rajani, Daksina, Dyuti, Svaha, Svadha, Mati, Buddhi, Rddhi, Vrddhi,…

verses.sanskrit: स्वाहा स्वाहामतिर् बुद्धिर् ऋद्धिर् वृद्धिः सरस्वती राका कुहूः सिनीवाली देवी अनुमती तथा
verses.transliteration: svāhā svāhāmatir buddhir ṛddhir vṛddhiḥ sarasvatī rākā kuhūḥ sinīvālī devī anumatī tathā
verses.translation: The highly blessed leaders of the Ganas bowed to by all the worlds went there joyously saying, "O this is Sankara's marriage."
verses.hindi: स्वात्मानमपि देवाय सोदकं प्रददौ हरिः। अथ सर्वे मुनिश्रेष्ठाः सर्ववेदार्थपारगाः एष देवो हरो नूनं मायया हि ततो जगत्
verses.wordMeaning: The highly blessed leaders of the Ganas bowed to by all the worlds went there joyously saying, "O this is Sankara's marriage."
verses.commentary: Sense: The highly blessed leaders of the Ganas bowed to by all the worlds went there joyously saying, "O this is Sankara's marriage."

verses.sanskrit: धरणी धारणी चेला शची नारायणी तथा एताश्चान्याश् च देवानां मातरः पत्नयस् तथा
verses.transliteration: dharaṇī dhāraṇī celā śacī nārāyaṇī tathā etāścānyāś ca devānāṃ mātaraḥ patnayas tathā
verses.translation: Crores of Ganas and leaders of Ganas, having the colour of the conch came there. Kekarakga came with ten crores; Vidyutas came with eight crores.
verses.hindi: देवदुन्दुभयो ने ुर्ननृतुश्चाप्सरोगणाः। वेदाश्च मूर्तिमन्तस्ते प्रणेमुस्तं महेश्वरम्
verses.wordMeaning: Crores of Ganas and leaders of Ganas, having the colour of the conch came there. Kekarakga came with ten crores; Vidyutas came with eight crores.
verses.commentary: Sense: Crores of Ganas and leaders of Ganas, having the colour of the conch came there. Kekarakga came with ten crores; Vidyutas came with eight crores.

verses.sanskrit: उद्वाहः शङ्करस्येति जग्मुः सर्वा मुदान्विताः उरगा गरुडा यक्षा गन्धर्वाः किन्नरा गणाः
verses.transliteration: udvāhaḥ śaṅkarasyeti jagmuḥ sarvā mudānvitāḥ uragā garuḍā yakṣā gandharvāḥ kinnarā gaṇāḥ
verses.translation: Vi£akha came with sixtyfour crores; Parayatrika with nine crores; Sarvan taka with six crores; the glorious Vikrta- nana too came with six crores.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्मणा मुनिभिः सार्धे जणा मानिभिः सार्ध देवदेवमुमापतिम्।  अप्सर नृत्य कले लगीं। सभी वेदोने शी देवोऽपि देवीमालोक्य सलजां हिमशैलजाम् ५ न तृप्यत्यनवद्याङ्डी सा च देवं वृषध्वजम्। वरदोऽस्मीति तं प्राह हरिं सोऽप्याह शङ्करम्
verses.wordMeaning: Vi£akha came with sixtyfour crores; Parayatrika with nine crores; Sarvan taka with six crores; the glorious Vikrta- nana too came with six crores.
verses.commentary: Sense: Vi£akha came with sixtyfour crores; Parayatrika with nine crores; Sarvan taka with six crores; the glorious Vikrta- nana too came with six crores.

verses.sanskrit: सागरा गिरयो मेघा मासाः संवत्सरास् तथा वेदा मन्त्रास् तथा यज्ञाः स्तोमा धर्माश् च सर्वशः
verses.transliteration: sāgarā girayo meghā māsāḥ saṃvatsarās tathā vedā mantrās tathā yajñāḥ stomā dharmāś ca sarvaśaḥ
verses.translation: The leading Gana, Jvalakela came with twelve crores, the glorious Samada with seven crores; Dundubha with eight crores; Kapalisa with five crores; Sandaraka with six crores; Kanaka and Kumbhaka with several crores of followers.
verses.hindi: त्वयि भक्तिः प्रसीदेति ब्रह्माख्यां च ददौ तु सः। ततस्तु पुनरेवाह ब्रह्मा विज्ञापयन् प्रभुम्
verses.wordMeaning: The leading Gana, Jvalakela came with twelve crores, the glorious Samada with seven crores; Dundubha with eight crores; Kapalisa with five crores; Sandaraka with six crores; Kanaka and Kumbhaka with several crores of followers.
verses.commentary: Sense: The leading Gana, Jvalakela came with twelve crores, the glorious Samada with seven crores; Dundubha with eight crores; Kapalisa with five crores; Sandaraka with six crores; Kanaka and Kumbhaka with several crores of followers.

verses.sanskrit: हुङ्कारः प्रणवश्चैव प्रतिहाराः सहस्रशः कोटिरप्सरसो दिव्यास् तासां च परिचारिकाः
verses.transliteration: huṅkāraḥ praṇavaścaiva pratihārāḥ sahasraśaḥ koṭirapsaraso divyās tāsāṃ ca paricārikāḥ
verses.translation: O brahmins, Vi§t&nibha the leading Gana and the most excellent of all came with eight crores; Pippala and Sannada with a thousand each.
verses.hindi: हविर्जुहोमि वह्नौ तु उपाध्यायपदे स्थितः। ददासि मम यद्याज्ञां कर्तव्यो ह्यकृतो विधिः तमाह शङ्करो देवं देवदेवो जगत्पतिः। यद्यदिष्टं सुरश्रेष्ठ तत्कुरुष्व यथेप्सितम्
verses.wordMeaning: O brahmins, Vi§t&nibha the leading Gana and the most excellent of all came with eight crores; Pippala and Sannada with a thousand each.
verses.commentary: Sense: O brahmins, Vi§t&nibha the leading Gana and the most excellent of all came with eight crores; Pippala and Sannada with a thousand each.

verses.sanskrit: याश् च सर्वेषु द्वीपेषु देवलोकेषु निम्नगाः ताश् च स्त्रीविग्रहाः सर्वाः संजग्मुर्हृष्टमानसाः
verses.transliteration: yāś ca sarveṣu dvīpeṣu devalokeṣu nimnagāḥ tāś ca strīvigrahāḥ sarvāḥ saṃjagmurhṛṣṭamānasāḥ
verses.translation: Agnika came with a hundred crores; Agnimukha with a crore. Similarly Adityamurdha and Dhanavaha came with a crore each.
verses.hindi: कर्तास्मि वचनं सर्व देवदेव पितामह। ततः प्रणम्य हष्टात्मा ब्रह्मा लोकपितामहः
verses.wordMeaning: Agnika came with a hundred crores; Agnimukha with a crore. Similarly Adityamurdha and Dhanavaha came with a crore each.
verses.commentary: Sense: Agnika came with a hundred crores; Agnimukha with a crore. Similarly Adityamurdha and Dhanavaha came with a crore each.

verses.sanskrit: गणपाश् च महाभागाः सर्वलोकनमस्कृताः उद्वाहः शङ्करस्येति तत्राजग्मुर्मुदान्विताः
verses.transliteration: gaṇapāś ca mahābhāgāḥ sarvalokanamaskṛtāḥ udvāhaḥ śaṅkarasyeti tatrājagmurmudānvitāḥ
verses.translation: O sages of good Mantras, Sannama and Kumuda came with a hundred crores; Amogha and Kokila with a crore each.
verses.hindi: हस्तं देवस्य देव्याश्च युयोज परमं प्रभुः। ज्वलनश्च स्वयं तत्र कृताञ्जलिरुपस्थितः आनीतान् विष्णुना विप्रान् सम्पूज्य विविधैर्वरैः । त्रिश्च तं ज्वलनं देवं कारयित्वा प्रदक्षिणम्
verses.wordMeaning: O sages of good Mantras, Sannama and Kumuda came with a hundred crores; Amogha and Kokila with a crore each.
verses.commentary: Sense: O sages of good Mantras, Sannama and Kumuda came with a hundred crores; Amogha and Kokila with a crore each.

verses.sanskrit: अभ्ययुः शङ्खवर्णाश् च गणकोट्यो गणेश्वराः दशभिः केकराक्षश् च विद्युतो ऽष्टाभिर् एव च
verses.transliteration: abhyayuḥ śaṅkhavarṇāś ca gaṇakoṭyo gaṇeśvarāḥ daśabhiḥ kekarākṣaś ca vidyuto 'ṣṭābhir eva ca
verses.translation: Another Gaga-leader Kakapada came with six crores; lord Santanaka with six crores; Mahabala, Madhupihga and Pingala with nine crores each.
verses.hindi: मुक्त्वा हस्तसमायोगं सहितैः सर्वहैवतैः ।
verses.wordMeaning: Another Gaga-leader Kakapada came with six crores; lord Santanaka with six crores; Mahabala, Madhupihga and Pingala with nine crores each.
verses.commentary: Sense: Another Gaga-leader Kakapada came with six crores; lord Santanaka with six crores; Mahabala, Madhupihga and Pingala with nine crores each.

verses.sanskrit: चतुःषष्ट्या विशाखाश् च नवभिः पारयात्रिकः षड्भिः सर्वान्तकः श्रीमान् तथैव विकृताननः
verses.transliteration: catuḥṣaṣṭyā viśākhāś ca navabhiḥ pārayātrikaḥ ṣaḍbhiḥ sarvāntakaḥ śrīmān tathaiva vikṛtānanaḥ
verses.translation: Nila, Devela and Purnabhadra came with ninety cro- res; Caturvaktra of great strength with seventy crores.
verses.hindi: ननाम भगवान् ब्रह्मा देवदेवमुमापतिम्। ततः पाद्यं तयोर्दत्वा शम्भोराचमनं तथा मधुपर्क तथा गां च प्रणम्य च पुनः शिवम्। अतिष्ठद्भगवान् ब्रह्मा देवैरिनद्रपुरोगमैः
verses.wordMeaning: Nila, Devela and Purnabhadra came with ninety cro- res; Caturvaktra of great strength with seventy crores.
verses.commentary: Sense: Nila, Devela and Purnabhadra came with ninety cro- res; Caturvaktra of great strength with seventy crores.

verses.sanskrit: ज्वालाकेशो द्वादशभिः कोटिभिर् गणपुङ्गवः सप्तभिः समदः श्रीमान् दुन्दुभो ऽष्टाभिर् एव च
verses.transliteration: jvālākeśo dvādaśabhiḥ koṭibhir gaṇapuṅgavaḥ saptabhiḥ samadaḥ śrīmān dundubho 'ṣṭābhir eva ca
verses.translation: Devas came with hundreds and thousands of crores of followers.
verses.hindi: शिवको प्रणाम करके भगवान् ब्रह्मा, इन्द्र देवताओंके साथ स्थित हो बैठ गये
verses.wordMeaning: Devas came with hundreds and thousands of crores of followers.
verses.commentary: Sense: Devas came with hundreds and thousands of crores of followers.

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चभिश् च कपालीशः षड्भिः संदारकः शुभः कोटिकोटिभिर् एवेह गण्डकः कुंभकस् तथा
verses.transliteration: pañcabhiś ca kapālīśaḥ ṣaḍbhiḥ saṃdārakaḥ śubhaḥ koṭikoṭibhir eveha gaṇḍakaḥ kuṃbhakas tathā
verses.translation: The Bhutas came with a thousand crores; the Prama- thas with three crores; Virabhadra with sixtyfour crores and the Romajas with crores.
verses.hindi: अप्सराएँ नृत्य करने लगीं। सभी वेदोंने शरीर 0  करके ब्रह्मा तथा मुनियोंके साथ उन देवदेव उमा  महेश्वरको प्रणाम किया॥ ५१-५२१२ ॥ क्‍ लज्जासे भरी म पार्वतीको देखकर श्व तृप्त नहीं होते थे और दूषणरहित शरीरवाली ३  पार्वती भी देवदेव वृषभध्वजको देखकर तृप्त हो. होती थीं। तब शिवने विष्णुसे कहा--'मै वरदाता हूँ।  इसपर उन्होंने भी शंकरसे कहा--' आपमें मेरी भक्ति
verses.wordMeaning: The Bhutas came with a thousand crores; the Prama- thas with three crores; Virabhadra with sixtyfour crores and the Romajas with crores.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Bhutas came with a thousand crores; the Prama- thas with three crores; Virabhadra with sixtyfour crores and the Romajas with crores.

verses.sanskrit: विष्टम्भो ऽष्टाभिर् एवेह गणपः सर्वसत्तमः पिप्पलश् च सहस्रेण संनादश् च तथा द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: viṣṭambho 'ṣṭābhir eveha gaṇapaḥ sarvasattamaḥ pippalaś ca sahasreṇa saṃnādaś ca tathā dvijāḥ
verses.translation: Karana came with twenty crores; the auspicious Kevala with ninety crores. So also Paficaksa, Satamanyu and Meghamanyu too came thus.
verses.hindi: बनी रहे; मुझपर प्रसन्न होइये।' तब शिवने उरे ब्रहम प्रदान किया। इसके बाद ब्रह्माने पुनः प्रभुसे पार्था . करते हुए कहा--'मैं उपाध्याय (आचार्य)-के पदप स्थित होकर अग्निमें हवन करता हूँ और यदि आप.
verses.wordMeaning: Karana came with twenty crores; the auspicious Kevala with ninety crores. So also Paficaksa, Satamanyu and Meghamanyu too came thus.
verses.commentary: Sense: Karana came with twenty crores; the auspicious Kevala with ninety crores. So also Paficaksa, Satamanyu and Meghamanyu too came thus.

verses.sanskrit: आवेष्टनस् तथाष्टाभिः सप्तभिश्चन्द्रतापनः महाकेशः सहस्रेण कोटीनां गणपो वृतः
verses.transliteration: āveṣṭanas tathāṣṭābhiḥ saptabhiścandratāpanaḥ mahākeśaḥ sahasreṇa koṭīnāṃ gaṇapo vṛtaḥ
verses.translation: Katfhakuta, Sukela and Vjrsabha came with sixtyfour crores. The eternal lord Virupaksa also came with the same number.
verses.hindi: आज्ञा दें, तो जो विधि अभीतक नहीं की गयी है, उसे. सम्पन्न करूं ॥ ५३--५६ ॥  तब जगतूके स्वामी देवदेव शंकरने उन देव ब्रह्मासे कहा--' है सुरश्रेष्ठ! जो-जो अभीष्ट हो, उसे  आप इच्छानुसार कौजिये। है देवदेव! है पितामह! मैं आपके समस्त वचनका पालन करूँगा'॥ ५७४, ॥ तदनन्तर उन्हें प्रणाम करके प्रसन्नचित्त परम प्रभु लोकपितामह ब्रह्माने शिव तथा देवी पार्वती -के
verses.wordMeaning: Katfhakuta, Sukela and Vjrsabha came with sixtyfour crores. The eternal lord Virupaksa also came with the same number.
verses.commentary: Sense: Katfhakuta, Sukela and Vjrsabha came with sixtyfour crores. The eternal lord Virupaksa also came with the same number.

verses.sanskrit: कुण्डी द्वादशभिर् वीरस् तथा पर्वतकः शुभः कालश् च कालकश्चैव महाकालः शतेन वै
verses.transliteration: kuṇḍī dvādaśabhir vīras tathā parvatakaḥ śubhaḥ kālaś ca kālakaścaiva mahākālaḥ śatena vai
verses.translation: Talaketu, $a<Jasya, Paficasya, Sanatana, Samvar- taka, Caitra, Lakullsa, Svayamprabhu, Lokantaka, Diptasya, lord Daityantaka, Mrtyuhft, Kalaha, Kala, Mrtyufijayakara, Viada, Vi sad a, Vidyuta, lord Kantaka, the glorious lord Bhfhgiriti who was a favourite of the lord of Devas, Asani, Bhasaka and Sahasrapad came with sixtyfour crores. These and other leaders of the Ganas were innumerable and very powerful.
verses.hindi: हाथोंको परस्पर मिला दिया। स्वयं अग्निदेव हाथ  जोड़े हुए वहाँ उपस्थित हुए। साक्षात् मूर्तिमा. होकर उपस्थित वैवाहिक श्रौत महामन्त्रोंके द्वारा यथो विधिसे हवन करनेके अनन्तर विष्णुके द्वारा लाये गये
verses.wordMeaning: Talaketu, $a<Jasya, Paficasya, Sanatana, Samvar- taka, Caitra, Lakullsa, Svayamprabhu, Lokantaka, Diptasya, lord Daityantaka, Mrtyuhft, Kalaha, Kala, Mrtyufijayakara, Viada, Vi sad a, Vidyuta, lord Kantaka, the glorious lord Bhfhgiriti who was a favourite of the lord of Devas,…
verses.commentary: Sense: Talaketu, $a<Jasya, Paficasya, Sanatana, Samvar- taka, Caitra, Lakullsa, Svayamprabhu, Lokantaka, Diptasya, lord Daityantaka, Mrtyuhft, Kalaha, Kala, Mrtyufijayakara, Viada, Vi sad a, Vidyuta, lord Kantaka, the glorious lord Bhfhgiriti who was a favourite of the lord of Devas,…

verses.sanskrit: आग्निकः शतकोट्या वै कोट्याग्निमुख एव च आदित्यमूर्धा कोट्या च तथा चैव धनावहः
verses.transliteration: āgnikaḥ śatakoṭyā vai koṭyāgnimukha eva ca ādityamūrdhā koṭyā ca tathā caiva dhanāvahaḥ
verses.translation: All of them had a thousand hands each; they wore matted hairs and crowns; they were embellished with the cres- cent moon; they were three-eyed and blue-necked.
verses.hindi: लाजा (धानका लावा)-का भी यथाक्रम हवन करके विविध गोदानोंसे विप्रोंकी पूजाकर पुनः तीन बार अग्निदेवकी प्रदक्षिणा कराकर उनके मिले हुए हाथको मुक्त कराकर भगवान् ब्रह्माने प्रसन्न मनसे सभी देवताओं, ऋषियों तथा मनुष्योंके साथ देवदेव उमापतिको प्रणाम
verses.wordMeaning: All of them had a thousand hands each; they wore matted hairs and crowns; they were embellished with the cres- cent moon; they were three-eyed and blue-necked.
verses.commentary: Sense: All of them had a thousand hands each; they wore matted hairs and crowns; they were embellished with the cres- cent moon; they were three-eyed and blue-necked.

verses.sanskrit: संनामश् च शतेनैव कुमुदः कोटिभिस् तथा अमोघः कोकिलश्चैव कोटिकोट्या सुमन्त्रकः
verses.transliteration: saṃnāmaś ca śatenaiva kumudaḥ koṭibhis tathā amoghaḥ kokilaścaiva koṭikoṭyā sumantrakaḥ
verses.translation: They were adorned with necklaces, earrings, shoulder- lets, crowns and other ornaments. They were on a par with Brahma, Indra and Vi§ 9 u. They were equipped with Aim5 and other siddhis.
verses.hindi: तत्पश्चात् उन दोनोंको पाद्य जल देकर  शम्भुको आचमन, मधुपर्क तथा गौ प्रदान करके प
verses.wordMeaning: They were adorned with necklaces, earrings, shoulder- lets, crowns and other ornaments. They were on a par with Brahma, Indra and Vi§ 9 u. They were equipped with Aim5 and other siddhis.
verses.commentary: Sense: They were adorned with necklaces, earrings, shoulder- lets, crowns and other ornaments. They were on a par with Brahma, Indra and Vi§ 9 u. They were equipped with Aim5 and other siddhis.

verses.sanskrit: काकपाटो ऽपरः षष्ट्या षष्ट्या संतानकः प्रभुः महाबलश् च नवभिर् मधुपिङ्गश् च पिङ्गलः
verses.transliteration: kākapāṭo 'paraḥ ṣaṣṭyā ṣaṣṭyā saṃtānakaḥ prabhuḥ mahābalaś ca navabhir madhupiṅgaś ca piṅgalaḥ
verses.translation: The leading Gagas who usually roamed about in the

verses.wordMeaning: The leading Gagas who usually roamed about in the
