verses.sanskrit: नीलो नवत्या देवेशः पूर्णभद्रस्तथैव च कोटीनां चैव सप्तत्या चतुर्वक्त्रो महाबलः
verses.transliteration: nīlo navatyā deveśaḥ pūrṇabhadrastathaiva ca koṭīnāṃ caiva saptatyā caturvaktro mahābalaḥ
verses.translation: Tumburu, Narada, H£h§, HuhQ and Samagas came to that city taking with them their musical instruments and jewels.
verses.hindi: शिव: समाप्य देवोक्तं वह्निमारोप्य चात्मनि। उनको स्तुति को
verses.wordMeaning: Tumburu, Narada, H£h§, HuhQ and Samagas came to that city taking with them their musical instruments and jewels.
verses.commentary: Sense: Tumburu, Narada, H£h§, HuhQ and Samagas came to that city taking with them their musical instruments and jewels.

verses.sanskrit: कोटिकोटिसहस्राणां शतैर् विंशतिभिर् वृताः तत्राजग्मुस् तथा देवास् ते सर्वे शङ्करं भवम्
verses.transliteration: koṭikoṭisahasrāṇāṃ śatair viṃśatibhir vṛtāḥ tatrājagmus tathā devās te sarve śaṅkaraṃ bhavam
verses.translation: The sages and ascetics delighted in their minds and re- peated holy mantras pertaining to the marriage and other divine songs.
verses.hindi: तया समागतो रुद्रः सर्वलोकहिताय वै॥ ६६ 300006 जात कृत्य सम्पन्न करके तथा अग्निको अपनेमें आरोपित
verses.wordMeaning: The sages and ascetics delighted in their minds and re- peated holy mantras pertaining to the marriage and other divine songs.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sages and ascetics delighted in their minds and re- peated holy mantras pertaining to the marriage and other divine songs.

verses.sanskrit: भूतकोटिसहस्रेण प्रमथः कोटिभिस्त्रिभिः वीरभद्रश्चतुःषष्ट्या रोमजाश्चैव कोटिभिः
verses.transliteration: bhūtakoṭisahasreṇa pramathaḥ koṭibhistribhiḥ vīrabhadraścatuḥṣaṣṭyā romajāścaiva koṭibhiḥ
verses.translation: Thus, when people from all places had assembled, Vi$nu himself led the daughter of the lord of the mountains into that city. She was fully bedecked and had smiles on her face. Then Brahma spoke to Vi?nu, Nar&yana the lord of Devas, in that assembly.
verses.hindi: यः पठेच्छुणुयाद्वापि भवोद्वाहं शुचिस्मितः:।  करके सभी लोकोंके हितके लिये उन पार्वतीके साथ श्रावयेद्वा द्विजान् शुद्धान् वेदवेदाङ्गपारगान्॥ ६७ वहाँसे प्रस्थित हुए
verses.wordMeaning: Thus, when people from all places had assembled, Vi$nu himself led the daughter of the lord of the mountains into that city. She was fully bedecked and had smiles on her face. Then Brahma spoke to Vi?nu, Nar&yana the lord of Devas, in that assembly.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus, when people from all places had assembled, Vi$nu himself led the daughter of the lord of the mountains into that city. She was fully bedecked and had smiles on her face. Then Brahma spoke to Vi?nu, Nar&yana the lord of Devas, in that assembly.

verses.sanskrit: करणश्चैव विंशत्या नवत्या केवलः शुभः पञ्चाक्षः शतमन्युश् च मेघमन्युस् तथैव च
verses.transliteration: karaṇaścaiva viṃśatyā navatyā kevalaḥ śubhaḥ pañcākṣaḥ śatamanyuś ca meghamanyus tathaiva ca
verses.translation: O lord, you were born at the outset from the left side of Rudra, along with Bhavani and other deities. I was born from his right side.
verses.hindi: जो व्यक्ति पवित्र होकर प्रसन्नतापूर्वक शिवके विवाह-आख्यानको पढ़ता अथवा सुनता है अथवा वेद- वेदांगमें पारंगत शुद्ध द्विजोंको सुनाता है, वह गणपति-पद प्राप्त करके शिवके साथ आनन्दित होता है। जहाँ भी ब्राह्मणांद्वारा इस विवाह-प्रसंगको कहा जाता है, वहाँपर शिवजी विराजमान रहते हैं, इसमें सन्देह नहीं है। अतः हे द्विजो! विधिवत् उनकी पूजा करके इस आख्यानको अवश्य कहना चाहिए । है उत्तम ब्राह्मणो ! श्रेष्ठ द्विजों तथा
verses.wordMeaning: O lord, you were born at the outset from the left side of Rudra, along with Bhavani and other deities. I was born from his right side.
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord, you were born at the outset from the left side of Rudra, along with Bhavani and other deities. I was born from his right side.

verses.sanskrit: काष्ठकूटश् चतुःषष्ट्या सुकेशो वृषभस् तथा विरूपाक्षश् च भगवान् चतुःषष्ट्या सनातनः
verses.transliteration: kāṣṭhakūṭaś catuḥṣaṣṭyā sukeśo vṛṣabhas tathā virūpākṣaś ca bhagavān catuḥṣaṣṭyā sanātanaḥ
verses.translation: Indeed, Himavan the lord of the mountains was created for the purpose of sacrifice. He is my own form. This daughter of Himavan was born by the grace of Brahma's power.
verses.hindi: ्षत्रियोंके विवाहमें इस अत्युत्तम सम्पूर्ण शिवविवाह- प्रसंगका कीर्तन करना चाहिए ॥ ६७-६९/२॥
verses.wordMeaning: Indeed, Himavan the lord of the mountains was created for the purpose of sacrifice. He is my own form. This daughter of Himavan was born by the grace of Brahma's power.
verses.commentary: Sense: Indeed, Himavan the lord of the mountains was created for the purpose of sacrifice. He is my own form. This daughter of Himavan was born by the grace of Brahma's power.

verses.sanskrit: तालुकेतुः षडास्यश् च पञ्चास्यश् च सनातनः संवर्तकस् तथा चैत्रो लकुलीशः स्वयं प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: tāluketuḥ ṣaḍāsyaś ca pañcāsyaś ca sanātanaḥ saṃvartakas tathā caitro lakulīśaḥ svayaṃ prabhuḥ
verses.translation: The lord has come here for the proper functioning of the rites laid down in the Vedas and the Smj*ti texts as well as for the sake of marriage rites. Hence, the goddess is the mother of the worlds. The lord is my creator as well as yours.
verses.hindi: तब विवाह कर लेनेके उपरान्त महाकान्तिसम्मन्न शिवजी अपने गणों, नन्दी तथा देवी पार्वतीके साथ दिव्य वाराणसीपुरीमें आये इसके बाद हर्षयुक्त मुखमण्डलवाली भवानी अविमुक्त (वाराणसी) -में सुखपूर्वक आसीन वृषभध्वजको प्रणाम करके उस क्षेत्रका माहात्म्य पूछने लगीं
verses.wordMeaning: The lord has come here for the proper functioning of the rites laid down in the Vedas and the Smj*ti texts as well as for the sake of marriage rites. Hence, the goddess is the mother of the worlds. The lord is my creator as well as yours.
verses.commentary: Sense: The lord has come here for the proper functioning of the rites laid down in the Vedas and the Smj*ti texts as well as for the sake of marriage rites. Hence, the goddess is the mother of the worlds. The lord is my creator as well as yours.

verses.sanskrit: लोकान्तकश् च दीप्तास्यस् तथा दैत्यान्तकः प्रभुः मृत्युहृत् कालहा कालो मृत्युञ्जयकरस् तथा
verses.transliteration: lokāntakaś ca dīptāsyas tathā daityāntakaḥ prabhuḥ mṛtyuhṛt kālahā kālo mṛtyuñjayakaras tathā
verses.translation: The universe is created by the cosmic forms of this lord Rudra since the lord has the eight forms of earth, fire, water, ether, wind, moon, sun and the hot?.
verses.hindi: तब अर्धचन्द्रको तिलकरूपमें धारण करनेवाले शिवजी उत्तम क्षेत्रमाहात्म्यका वर्णन करने लगे-- हे सुरेशानि! मेरे द्वार अविमुक्तक्षेत्रका माहात्म्य विस्तारपूर्वक नहीं कहा जा सकता है; यह क्षेत्र ऋषियोंद्वारा पूजित है।
verses.wordMeaning: The universe is created by the cosmic forms of this lord Rudra since the lord has the eight forms of earth, fire, water, ether, wind, moon, sun and the hot?.
verses.commentary: Sense: The universe is created by the cosmic forms of this lord Rudra since the lord has the eight forms of earth, fire, water, ether, wind, moon, sun and the hot?.

verses.sanskrit: विषादो विषदश्चैव विद्युतः कान्तकः प्रभुः देवो भृङ्गी रिटिः श्रीमान् देवदेवप्रियस् तथा
verses.transliteration: viṣādo viṣadaścaiva vidyutaḥ kāntakaḥ prabhuḥ devo bhṛṅgī riṭiḥ śrīmān devadevapriyas tathā
verses.translation: Still, at the instance of the lord of the mountains as well as at my instance this unborn Prakrti of white, black and red colour should be given to Siva. You too are the Prakrti. The alliance with the king of the mountains is conducive to your welfare as well as mine. In the Padma Kalpa, I was born of your umbilical lotus. Hence, you are my father and an ances- tor to this mountain who is a part of mine.
verses.hindi: हे देवि! मैं अविमुक्तक्षेत्रमें होनेवाले पुण्यफलका वर्णन कैसे करूँ, जहाँपर मरनेवाले पापियोंको एक ही जन्ममें मुक्ति हो जाती है। लोगोंद्वारा अन्यत्र किया गया पाप बाराणसीमें नष्ट हो जाता है और वाराणसीमें किया गया पाप पिशाचयोनिरूपी नरककी प्राप्ति करानेवाला होता है। हजारों पाप करके मनुष्योंके लिये पिशाचत्व श्रेष्ठ है, किंतु काशीपुरीके बिना स्वर्गमें हजार बार इन्द्रपद
verses.wordMeaning: Still, at the instance of the lord of the mountains as well as at my instance this unborn Prakrti of white, black and red colour should be given to Siva. You too are the Prakrti. The alliance with the king of the mountains is conducive to your welfare as well as mine.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Still, at the instance of the lord of the mountains as well as at my instance this unborn Prakrti of white, black and red colour should be given to Siva. You too are the Prakrti. The alliance with the king of the mountains is conducive to your welfare as well as mine.…

verses.sanskrit: अशनिर् भासकश् चैव चतुःषष्ट्या सहस्रपात् एते चान्ये च गणपा असंख्याता महाबलाः
verses.transliteration: aśanir bhāsakaś caiva catuḥṣaṣṭyā sahasrapāt ete cānye ca gaṇapā asaṃkhyātā mahābalāḥ
verses.translation: "This daughter of Mena and my younger sister now belongs to you by matrimonial rite." Saying thus, he dedicated the goddess to the lord of Devas along with water. Vistjui too offered himself to the lord along with water. Then the excellent sages who were masters of the Vedic texts said: — "On consideration, it is indeed this lord Siva who is the giver, the receiver of the material offered and the benefit thereof. Of course, through his Maya has emanated the universe from him." Saying this they bowed down to him. The hair on their skins stood on end due to pleasure. The heaven-walkers — Sid- dhas and Caranas — showered flowers on him.
verses.hindi: यत्रायं कीर्त्यते विप्रैस्तावदास्ते तदा भवः
verses.wordMeaning: "This daughter of Mena and my younger sister now belongs to you by matrimonial rite." Saying thus, he dedicated the goddess to the lord of Devas along with water. Vistjui too offered himself to the lord along with water.…
verses.commentary: Sense: "This daughter of Mena and my younger sister now belongs to you by matrimonial rite." Saying thus, he dedicated the goddess to the lord of Devas along with water. Vistjui too offered himself to the lord along with water.…

verses.sanskrit: सर्वे सहस्रहस्ताश् च जटामुकुटधारिणः चन्द्ररेखावतंसाश् च नीलकण्ठास् त्रिलोचनाः
verses.transliteration: sarve sahasrahastāś ca jaṭāmukuṭadhāriṇaḥ candrarekhāvataṃsāś ca nīlakaṇṭhās trilocanāḥ
verses.translation: The divine drums were sounded. The Apsarases danced. The Vedas assumed physical forms and bowed down to the great lord.
verses.hindi: तस्मात्सम्पूज्य विधिवत्कोर्तयेनान्यथा द्विजाः। उद्वाहे च द्विजेन्द्राणां क्षत्रियाणां द्विजोत्तमाः कीर्तनीयमिदं सर्व भवोद्वाहमनुत्तमम्। कृतोद्वाहस्तदा देव्या हैमवत्या वृषध्वज:
verses.wordMeaning: The divine drums were sounded. The Apsarases danced. The Vedas assumed physical forms and bowed down to the great lord.
verses.commentary: Sense: The divine drums were sounded. The Apsarases danced. The Vedas assumed physical forms and bowed down to the great lord.

verses.sanskrit: हारकुण्डलकेयूरमुकुटाद्यैर् अलंकृताः ब्रह्मेन्द्रविष्णुसंकाशा अणिमादिगुणैर्वृताः
verses.transliteration: hārakuṇḍalakeyūramukuṭādyair alaṃkṛtāḥ brahmendraviṣṇusaṃkāśā aṇimādiguṇairvṛtāḥ
verses.translation: Along with Brahma and the sages they bowed down to the lord of Uma and of Devas. The lord glanced at the bashful daughter of the snow-clad mountain. He was never satiated. She too of splendid and unblemished body was not satiated on seeing the bull-bannered lord. He spoke to Visnu — "I am the bestower of boons." He too then spoke to Sankara.
verses.hindi: सगणो नन्दिना सार्ध सर्वदेवगणैर्वृतः। पुरी वाराणसीं दिव्यामाजगाम महाद्युतिः
verses.wordMeaning: Along with Brahma and the sages they bowed down to the lord of Uma and of Devas. The lord glanced at the bashful daughter of the snow-clad mountain. He was never satiated. She too of splendid and unblemished body was not satiated on seeing the bull-bannered lord.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Along with Brahma and the sages they bowed down to the lord of Uma and of Devas. The lord glanced at the bashful daughter of the snow-clad mountain. He was never satiated. She too of splendid and unblemished body was not satiated on seeing the bull-bannered lord.…

verses.sanskrit: सूर्यकोटिप्रतीकाशास् तत्राजग्मुर्गणेश्वराः पातालचारिणश्चैव सर्वलोकनिवासिनः
verses.transliteration: sūryakoṭipratīkāśās tatrājagmurgaṇeśvarāḥ pātālacāriṇaścaiva sarvalokanivāsinaḥ
verses.translation: "Devotion to you. Be pleased." He then gave him (Hari) the title Brahma 946 as well as instructions in Brahman (Eternal truth). Thereupon, Brahma again spoke to the lord: — "I now offer Havis to the holy fire, officiating as a priest at the sacrifice. If you give me permission, I shall proceed with the rituals, as yet not performed, but which are still to be observ- ed. Sankara, the lord of Devas, the lord of the universe said to the lord "O excellent Deva, do as you please, whatever you like.
verses.hindi: वक्तुं मया सुरेशानि ऋषिसङ्घाभिपूजितम्। किं मया वर्ण्यते देवि ह्यविमुक्तफलोदयः पापिनां यत्र मुक्तिः स्यान्मृतानामेकजन्मना। अन्यत्र तु कृतं पापं वाराणस्यां व्यपोहति
verses.wordMeaning: "Devotion to you. Be pleased." He then gave him (Hari) the title Brahma 946 as well as instructions in Brahman (Eternal truth). Thereupon, Brahma again spoke to the lord: — "I now offer Havis to the holy fire, officiating as a priest at the sacrifice. If you give me permission,…
verses.commentary: Sense: "Devotion to you. Be pleased." He then gave him (Hari) the title Brahma 946 as well as instructions in Brahman (Eternal truth). Thereupon, Brahma again spoke to the lord: — "I now offer Havis to the holy fire, officiating as a priest at the sacrifice. If you give me permission,…

verses.sanskrit: तुंबरुर्नारदो हाहा हूहूश्चैव तु सामगाः रत्नान्यादाय वाद्यांश् च तत्राजग्मुस्तदा पुरम्
verses.transliteration: tuṃbarurnārado hāhā hūhūścaiva tu sāmagāḥ ratnānyādāya vādyāṃś ca tatrājagmustadā puram
verses.translation: O Brahma, O lord of Devas, I shall act according to vour instructions."
verses.hindi: वाराणस्यां कृतं पापं पैशाच्यनरकावहम्। कृत्वा पापसहस्त्राणि पिशाचत्वं वरं नृणाम्
verses.wordMeaning: O Brahma, O lord of Devas, I shall act according to vour instructions."
verses.commentary: Sense: O Brahma, O lord of Devas, I shall act according to vour instructions."

verses.sanskrit: ऋषयः कृत्स्नशस्तत्र देवगीतास्तपोधनाः पुण्यान् वैवाहिकान् मन्त्रान् अजपुर् हृष्टमानसाः
verses.transliteration: ṛṣayaḥ kṛtsnaśastatra devagītāstapodhanāḥ puṇyān vaivāhikān mantrān ajapur hṛṣṭamānasāḥ
verses.translation: The sages beginning with Bhrgu showered gingelly seeds and whole rice grains. The sun and the rest of luminaries worshipped and eulogised the bull-bannered lord.
verses.hindi: न तु शक्रसहस्रत्वं स्वगे काशीपुरीं विना। यत्र त्रिविष्टपो देवो यत्र विश्वेश्वरो विभुः ओङ्कारेशः कृत्तिवासा मृतानां न पुनर्भवः। उक्त्वा कषेत्रस्य माहात्म्यं सङ्क्षेपाच्छशिशेखरः
verses.wordMeaning: The sages beginning with Bhrgu showered gingelly seeds and whole rice grains. The sun and the rest of luminaries worshipped and eulogised the bull-bannered lord.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sages beginning with Bhrgu showered gingelly seeds and whole rice grains. The sun and the rest of luminaries worshipped and eulogised the bull-bannered lord.

verses.sanskrit: तत एवं प्रवृत्ते तु सर्वतश् च समागमे गिरिजां ताम् अलंकृत्य स्वयमेव शुचिस्मिताम्
verses.transliteration: tata evaṃ pravṛtte tu sarvataś ca samāgame girijāṃ tām alaṃkṛtya svayameva śucismitām
verses.translation: Siva concluded the sacred Vedic rites, and imposed the fire on to the Atman. He was thus united with her for the wel- fare of the worlds.
verses.hindi: तत्रैव भगवान् जातो गजवक्त्रो विनायकः
verses.wordMeaning: Siva concluded the sacred Vedic rites, and imposed the fire on to the Atman. He was thus united with her for the wel- fare of the worlds.
verses.commentary: Sense: Siva concluded the sacred Vedic rites, and imposed the fire on to the Atman. He was thus united with her for the wel- fare of the worlds.

verses.sanskrit: पुरं प्रवेशयामास स्वयम् आदाय केशवः सदस्याह च देवेशं नारायणमजो हरिम्
verses.transliteration: puraṃ praveśayāmāsa svayam ādāya keśavaḥ sadasyāha ca deveśaṃ nārāyaṇamajo harim
verses.translation: He who reads or listens to this nuptial of Rudra, or he who smilingly narrates this to brahmins who have master- ed the Vedas and the Vedangas, attains the chieftancy of the Gan as and rejoices with Siva. Wherever this narrative is repeated and glorified by the brahmins, the lord occupies that place as long as the story continues. Hence, O brahmins, O excellent brahmins, in the course of the celebration of the mar- riage of leading brahmins and Kfatriyas, the lord should be duly glorified after the worship and not otherwise. Thus excel-
verses.hindi: हैत्यानां विघ्नरूपार्थमविघ्नाय दिवौकसाम्। एतद्वः कथितं सर्व कथासर्वस्वमुत्तमम् प्राप्त करना भी श्रेष्ठ नहीं है। जहाँपर भगवान् रि क्क
verses.wordMeaning: He who reads or listens to this nuptial of Rudra, or he who smilingly narrates this to brahmins who have master- ed the Vedas and the Vedangas, attains the chieftancy of the Gan as and rejoices with Siva. Wherever this narrative is repeated and glorified by the brahmins,…
verses.commentary: Sense: He who reads or listens to this nuptial of Rudra, or he who smilingly narrates this to brahmins who have master- ed the Vedas and the Vedangas, attains the chieftancy of the Gan as and rejoices with Siva. Wherever this narrative is repeated and glorified by the brahmins,…

verses.sanskrit: भवानग्रे समुत्पन्नो भवान्या सह दैवतैः वामाङ्गादस्य रुद्रस्य दक्षिणाङ्गादहं प्रभो
verses.transliteration: bhavānagre samutpanno bhavānyā saha daivataiḥ vāmāṅgādasya rudrasya dakṣiṇāṅgādahaṃ prabho
verses.translation: trih pradak$ip& —circumambulating the sacrificial fire thrice, from left to right so that the right side is turned towards the fire. But in the Hindu nuptial rites, as observed now-a-days, the bride and bridegroom circumambulate the fire, seven times.
verses.hindi: विभु, विश्वेश्वर तथा कृत्तिवास ओंकारेश विराजमान हैं, उस काशीमें मरनेवालोंका होता'॥ ७३--७७ /२॥
verses.wordMeaning: trih pradak$ip& —circumambulating the sacrificial fire thrice, from left to right so that the right side is turned towards the fire. But in the Hindu nuptial rites, as observed now-a-days, the bride and bridegroom circumambulate the fire, seven times.
verses.commentary: Sense: trih pradak$ip& —circumambulating the sacrificial fire thrice, from left to right so that the right side is turned towards the fire. But in the Hindu nuptial rites, as observed now-a-days, the bride and bridegroom circumambulate the fire, seven times.

verses.sanskrit: मन्मूर्तिस्तुहिनाद्रीशो यज्ञार्थं सृष्ट एव हि एषा हैमवती जज्ञे मायया परमेष्ठिनः
verses.transliteration: manmūrtistuhinādrīśo yajñārthaṃ sṛṣṭa eva hi eṣā haimavatī jajñe māyayā parameṣṭhinaḥ
verses.translation: Uma whose face beamed with delight bowed down to the bull-bannered lord who was comfortably seated in Avi- mukta. She asked him about the glory of that holy centre.
verses.hindi: इस प्रकार संक्षेपमें क्षेत्रका माहात्म्य साह गणेश्वरोंको विदा करके चन्द्रशेखरने पार्वतीको  अपना उद्यान दिखाया। भगवान् गजानन विनायक त्यो विघ्न उत्पन्न करनेके लिये तथा देवताओंका बिष्न करनेके लिये वहींपर उत्पन्न हुए थे। है ऋषियो  मैंने आपलोगोंको कथाका सम्पूर्ण उत्तम तथा सुन्दर तत संक्षेपमें बता दिया, जैसा कि मैंने व्यासजीकी कृपते
verses.wordMeaning: Uma whose face beamed with delight bowed down to the bull-bannered lord who was comfortably seated in Avi- mukta. She asked him about the glory of that holy centre.
verses.commentary: Sense: Uma whose face beamed with delight bowed down to the bull-bannered lord who was comfortably seated in Avi- mukta. She asked him about the glory of that holy centre.

verses.sanskrit: श्रौतस्मार्तप्रवृत्त्यर्थम् उद्वाहार्थम् इहागतः अतो ऽसौ जगतां धात्री धाता तव ममापि च
verses.transliteration: śrautasmārtapravṛttyartham udvāhārtham ihāgataḥ ato 'sau jagatāṃ dhātrī dhātā tava mamāpi ca
verses.translation: The lord who bore the crescent moon on his forehead recounted the greatness of the holy centre: — "O god- dess of Devas, the greatness of Avimukta cannot be recounted by me in detail. This holy centre is honoured by the sages. O fair lady, how shall I tell you in detail the merits of Avimukta?
verses.hindi: गजाननका प्राकट्य करानेके लिये देवताओंद्वारा भगवान् शिवको स्तुति
verses.wordMeaning: The lord who bore the crescent moon on his forehead recounted the greatness of the holy centre: — "O god- dess of Devas, the greatness of Avimukta cannot be recounted by me in detail. This holy centre is honoured by the sages. O fair lady,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The lord who bore the crescent moon on his forehead recounted the greatness of the holy centre: — "O god- dess of Devas, the greatness of Avimukta cannot be recounted by me in detail. This holy centre is honoured by the sages. O fair lady,…

verses.sanskrit: अस्य देवस्य रुद्रस्य मूर्तिभिर् विहितं जगत् क्ष्माबग्निखेन्दुसूर्यात्मपवनात्मा यतो भवः
verses.transliteration: asya devasya rudrasya mūrtibhir vihitaṃ jagat kṣmābagnikhendusūryātmapavanātmā yato bhavaḥ
verses.translation: Sinners who die here shall be liberated even in their very birth. A man dispels at Varanasi the sins he has committed elsewhere. The sins committed at Varanasi turn the sinner into a Pilaca and they lead him to hell. 049 It is better for men to court Pi£acahood after committing thousands of sins at Varanasi than to attain the position of Indra a thous- and times in heaven without the pleasure of being in the city of Ka$i. No living animal is reborn if it dies in this place where the lord Vi£ve£vara, the lord of Omkara, the lord clad in elephant's hides, is ever present. After recounting the glory of the holy centre briefly the moon-crested lord dismissed the leaders of Ganas and pointed out a garden to the goddess. It was here that lord Vinayaka, the deity with the face of an elephant, was born, for creating obstacles in the way of Daityas and for dispelling the same in the way of heaven-dwellers. Thus, the entire essence of the story has been narrated to you. It is a splendid story and I have narrated just as it had been heard by me by the grace of Vvasa. 960
verses.hindi: कथं विनायको जातो गजवक्त्रो गणेश्वरः। कथं प्रभावस्तस्यैवं सूत वक्तुमिहाहसि एतस्मिन्नन्तरे देवाः सेन््रोपेन्द्राः समेत्य ते। धर्मविघ्नं तदा कर्तु हैत्यानामभवन् द्विजाः
verses.wordMeaning: Sinners who die here shall be liberated even in their very birth. A man dispels at Varanasi the sins he has committed elsewhere. The sins committed at Varanasi turn the sinner into a Pilaca and they lead him to hell.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Sinners who die here shall be liberated even in their very birth. A man dispels at Varanasi the sins he has committed elsewhere. The sins committed at Varanasi turn the sinner into a Pilaca and they lead him to hell.…

verses.sanskrit: तथापि तस्मै दातव्या वचनाच्च गिरेर्मम एषा ह्य् अजा शुक्लकृष्णा लोहिता प्रकृतिर्भवान्
verses.transliteration: tathāpi tasmai dātavyā vacanācca girermama eṣā hy ajā śuklakṛṣṇā lohitā prakṛtirbhavān
verses.translation: paii&cya— according to ST. this hell is in preference to the re- birth. V&r&nasy&ifc kftam p&pam pai&canarak&vaham, na tu punar janzna- prfipakam ST.
verses.hindi: असुरा यातुधानाश्च राक्षसाः क्रूरकर्मिणः। तामसाश्च तथा चान्ये राजसाश्च तथा भुवि
verses.wordMeaning: paii&cya— according to ST. this hell is in preference to the re- birth. V&r&nasy&ifc kftam p&pam pai&canarak&vaham, na tu punar janzna- prfipakam ST.
verses.commentary: Sense: paii&cya— according to ST. this hell is in preference to the re- birth. V&r&nasy&ifc kftam p&pam pai&canarak&vaham, na tu punar janzna- prfipakam ST.

verses.sanskrit: श्रेयो ऽपि शैलराजेन संबन्धो ऽयं तवापि च तव पाद्मे समुद्भूतः कल्पे नाभ्यंबुजादहम्
verses.transliteration: śreyo 'pi śailarājena saṃbandho 'yaṃ tavāpi ca tava pādme samudbhūtaḥ kalpe nābhyaṃbujādaham
verses.translation: pras&d&t — i.e. by the favour of the sage Veda Vy&sa.
verses.hindi: अविघ्नं यज्ञदानाद्यैः समभ्यर्च्य महेश्वरम्। ब्रह्माणं च हरिं विप्रा लब्धेप्सितवरा यतः पुत्रार्थं चैव नारीणां नराणां कर्मसिद्धये। विघ्नेशं शङ्करं स्रष्टुं गणपं स्तोतुमर्हथ
verses.wordMeaning: pras&d&t — i.e. by the favour of the sage Veda Vy&sa.
verses.commentary: Sense: pras&d&t — i.e. by the favour of the sage Veda Vy&sa.

verses.sanskrit: मदंशस्यास्य शैलस्य ममापि च गुरुर्भवान् बाढम् इत्यजम् आहासौ देवदेवो जनार्दनः
verses.transliteration: madaṃśasyāsya śailasya mamāpi ca gururbhavān bāḍham ityajam āhāsau devadevo janārdanaḥ
verses.translation: pras&d&t — i.e. by the favour of the sage Veda Vy&sa.
verses.hindi: इत्युक्त्वान्योऽन्यमनघं तुष्टुवुः शिवमीश्वरम्। नमः सर्वात्मने तुभ्यं सर्वज्ञाय पिनाकिने
verses.wordMeaning: pras&d&t — i.e. by the favour of the sage Veda Vy&sa.
verses.commentary: Sense: pras&d&t — i.e. by the favour of the sage Veda Vy&sa.

verses.sanskrit: देवाश् च मुनयः सर्वे देवदेवश् च शङ्करः ततश्चोत्थाय विद्वान्सः पद्मनाभः प्रणम्य ताम्
verses.transliteration: devāś ca munayaḥ sarve devadevaś ca śaṅkaraḥ tataścotthāya vidvānsaḥ padmanābhaḥ praṇamya tām
verses.translation: pras&d&t — i.e. by the favour of the sage Veda Vy&sa.
verses.hindi: ऋषिगण बोले-हे सूतजी! गणोंके स्वामी गजानन विनायक कैसे उत्पन्न हुए; उनका प्रभाव कैसा है? इसे आप बतानेकी कृपा कीजिये सूतजी बोले--हे द्विजो! इसी बीच इन्द्र तथा उपेन्द्रसहित देवतागण एकत्र होकर हैत्योंके धर्ममें विश करनेके लिये प्रवृत्त हुए। है विप्रो! वे विचार करे लगे कि असुर, यातुधान, क्रूर कर्मवाले राक्षस तथा
verses.wordMeaning: pras&d&t — i.e. by the favour of the sage Veda Vy&sa.
verses.commentary: Sense: pras&d&t — i.e. by the favour of the sage Veda Vy&sa.

verses.sanskrit: पादौ प्रक्षाल्य देवस्य कराभ्यां कमलेक्षणः अभ्युक्षद् आत्मनो मूर्ध्नि ब्रह्मणश् च गिरेस् तथा
verses.transliteration: pādau prakṣālya devasya karābhyāṃ kamalekṣaṇaḥ abhyukṣad ātmano mūrdhni brahmaṇaś ca gires tathā
verses.translation: pras&d&t — i.e. by the favour of the sage Veda Vy&sa.
verses.hindi: पृथ्वीपर जो अन्य तमोगुणी तथा रजोगुणी लोग है उन्होंने अविध्नतापूर्वक कार्य करनेहेतु यज्ञ-दान आदिक द्वारा महेश्वर, ब्रह्मा तथा विष्णुकी सम्यकू पूजा अभीष्ट वर प्राप्त कर लिया है; अतः है सुर
verses.wordMeaning: pras&d&t — i.e. by the favour of the sage Veda Vy&sa.
verses.commentary: Sense: pras&d&t — i.e. by the favour of the sage Veda Vy&sa.

verses.sanskrit: त्वदीयैषा विवाहार्थं मेनजा ह्यनुजा मम इत्युक्त्वा सोदकं दत्त्वा देवीं देवेश्वराय ताम्
verses.transliteration: tvadīyaiṣā vivāhārthaṃ menajā hyanujā mama ityuktvā sodakaṃ dattvā devīṃ deveśvarāya tām
verses.translation: pras&d&t — i.e. by the favour of the sage Veda Vy&sa.
verses.hindi: सर्वदा हम लोगोंका पराभव हो रहा है। इसलिये डा विष्के लिये, देवताओंके अविष्तके लिये, सिग पुत्रप्राप्तिके लिये तथा पुरुषोंके कर्मकी सिद्धिके आप सभीलोग विघ्नेश गणपतिके सृजनहेतु स्तुति कीजिये॥ २--६॥
verses.wordMeaning: pras&d&t — i.e. by the favour of the sage Veda Vy&sa.
verses.commentary: Sense: pras&d&t — i.e. by the favour of the sage Veda Vy&sa.

verses.sanskrit: स्वात्मानमपि देवाय सोदकं प्रददौ हरिः अथ सर्वे मुनिश्रेष्ठाः सर्ववेदार्थपारगाः
verses.transliteration: svātmānamapi devāya sodakaṃ pradadau hariḥ atha sarve muniśreṣṭhāḥ sarvavedārthapāragāḥ
verses.translation: pras&d&t — i.e. by the favour of the sage Veda Vy&sa.
verses.hindi: आपसमें ऐसा कहकर वे देवता निरी ps
verses.wordMeaning: pras&d&t — i.e. by the favour of the sage Veda Vy&sa.
verses.commentary: Sense: pras&d&t — i.e. by the favour of the sage Veda Vy&sa.

verses.sanskrit: ऊचुर्दाता गृहीता च फलं द्रव्यं विचारतः एष देवो हरो नूनं मायया हि ततो जगत्

verses.translation: pras&d&t — i.e. by the favour of the sage Veda Vy&sa.

verses.wordMeaning: pras&d&t — i.e. by the favour of the sage Veda Vy&sa.
verses.commentary: Sense: pras&d&t — i.e. by the favour of the sage Veda Vy&sa.

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्त्वा तं प्रणेमुश् च प्रीतिकण्टकितत्वचः ससृजुः पुष्पवर्षाणि खेचराः सिद्धचारणाः
verses.transliteration: ityuktvā taṃ praṇemuś ca prītikaṇṭakitatvacaḥ sasṛjuḥ puṣpavarṣāṇi khecarāḥ siddhacāraṇāḥ
verses.translation: pras&d&t — i.e. by the favour of the sage Veda Vy&sa.
verses.hindi: अनघाय विरिञ्चाय र कार्यार्थदायिने।  स्तुति करने लगे--आप सर्वात्मा, सर्वज्ञ तथा अकायायार्थकायाय हरेः कायापहारिणे॥ ८  पिनाकधारीको नमस्कार है। निष्पाप, विशेष रूपसे
verses.wordMeaning: pras&d&t — i.e. by the favour of the sage Veda Vy&sa.
verses.commentary: Sense: pras&d&t — i.e. by the favour of the sage Veda Vy&sa.

verses.sanskrit: देवदुन्दुभयो नेदुर् ननृतुश्चाप्सरोगणाः वेदाश् च मूर्तिमन्तस्ते प्रणेमुस्तं महेश्वरम्
verses.transliteration: devadundubhayo nedur nanṛtuścāpsarogaṇāḥ vedāś ca mūrtimantaste praṇemustaṃ maheśvaram
verses.translation: pras&d&t — i.e. by the favour of the sage Veda Vy&sa.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्मण्डकी रचना करनेवाले, देवी पार्वती -को तपस्याका फल प्रदान करनेवाले, कायारहित, प्रयोजनके लिये शरीर धारण करनेवाले, विष्णुकी कायाका अपहरण करनेवाले, देहके भीतर अमृताधार-मण्डलमें विराजमान रहनेवाले आप शिव-को नमस्कार है। कृत (सत्ययुग) आदि कालभेदोंको उत्पन्न करनेवाले तथा कालवेग आप शिव-को नमस्कार है॥ ७--९॥
verses.wordMeaning: pras&d&t — i.e. by the favour of the sage Veda Vy&sa.
verses.commentary: Sense: pras&d&t — i.e. by the favour of the sage Veda Vy&sa.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मणा मुनिभिः सार्धं देवदेवमुमापतिम् देवो ऽपि देवीमालोक्य सलज्जां हिमशैलजाम्
verses.transliteration: brahmaṇā munibhiḥ sārdhaṃ devadevamumāpatim devo 'pi devīmālokya salajjāṃ himaśailajām
verses.translation: pras&d&t — i.e. by the favour of the sage Veda Vy&sa.
verses.hindi: कालाग्निके समान भयंकर रूपवाले, धर्म आदि आठ पदों (स्थानों) वाले, महाकालीको विशुद्ध (गौर) देह करनेवाले तथा कालिका (चण्डिका)-की उत्पत्ति करनेवाले आप शिव-को नमस्कार है
verses.wordMeaning: pras&d&t — i.e. by the favour of the sage Veda Vy&sa.
verses.commentary: Sense: pras&d&t — i.e. by the favour of the sage Veda Vy&sa.

verses.sanskrit: न तृप्यत्यनवद्याङ्गी सा च देवं वृषध्वजम् वरदो ऽस्मीति तं प्राह हरिं सो ऽप्याह शङ्करम्
verses.transliteration: na tṛpyatyanavadyāṅgī sā ca devaṃ vṛṣadhvajam varado 'smīti taṃ prāha hariṃ so 'pyāha śaṅkaram
verses.translation: pras&d&t — i.e. by the favour of the sage Veda Vy&sa.
verses.hindi: कालकण्ठ, प्रधानस्वरूप, वाहन (कर्मफलको प्राप्ति करानेवाले) तथा सर्वश्रेष्ठ आप शिव-को नमस्कार है। अम्बिकापति तथा हिरण्यपति आप शिव - को नमस्कार है असि-चर्म-अंकुश धारण करनेवाले शिव-को नमस्कार है। पार्वतीपति, सुवर्णे समान शुक्ल (शुद्ध), अर्धनारीश्वररूप होनेके कारण पीत-शुक्ल वर्णवाले तथा देवताओंकी रक्षाके लिये अग्निरूपबाले आप
verses.wordMeaning: pras&d&t — i.e. by the favour of the sage Veda Vy&sa.
verses.commentary: Sense: pras&d&t — i.e. by the favour of the sage Veda Vy&sa.

verses.sanskrit: त्वयि भक्तिः प्रसीदेति ब्रह्माख्यां च ददौ तु सः ततस्तु पुनरेवाह ब्रह्मा विज्ञापयन्प्रभुम्
verses.transliteration: tvayi bhaktiḥ prasīdeti brahmākhyāṃ ca dadau tu saḥ tatastu punarevāha brahmā vijñāpayanprabhum
verses.translation: pras&d&t — i.e. by the favour of the sage Veda Vy&sa.
verses.hindi: शिव-को नमस्कार है
verses.wordMeaning: pras&d&t — i.e. by the favour of the sage Veda Vy&sa.
verses.commentary: Sense: pras&d&t — i.e. by the favour of the sage Veda Vy&sa.

verses.sanskrit: हविर्जुहोमि वह्नौ तु उपाध्यायपदे स्थितः ददासि मम यद्याज्ञां कर्तव्यो ह्यकृतो विधिः
verses.transliteration: havirjuhomi vahnau tu upādhyāyapade sthitaḥ dadāsi mama yadyājñāṃ kartavyo hyakṛto vidhiḥ
verses.translation: pras&d&t — i.e. by the favour of the sage Veda Vy&sa.
verses.hindi: तुरीयातीत, देवयज्ञ आदि पंच महायज्ञोंके कर्ताओंको फल देनेवाले, पंचमुख सर्पको हारके रूपमें धारण करनेवाले तथा पंचाक्षर मन्त्र-मय आप शिव- को नमस्कार है। पाँच प्रकारसे रुद्र आदि पंच कैवल्य देवोंद्वारा पूजित मूर्तिवाले, पंचाक्षर मन्त्ररूप दृष्टिवाले तथा परात्परतर आप शिव-को नमस्कार है
verses.wordMeaning: pras&d&t — i.e. by the favour of the sage Veda Vy&sa.
verses.commentary: Sense: pras&d&t — i.e. by the favour of the sage Veda Vy&sa.

verses.sanskrit: तमाह शङ्करो देवं देवदेवो जगत्पतिः यद्यदिष्टं सुरश्रेष्ठ तत्कुरुष्व यथेप्सितम्
verses.transliteration: tamāha śaṅkaro devaṃ devadevo jagatpatiḥ yadyadiṣṭaṃ suraśreṣṭha tatkuruṣva yathepsitam
verses.translation: pras&d&t — i.e. by the favour of the sage Veda Vy&sa.
verses.hindi: अकार आदि सोलह स्वरमय वञ्रके समान अभेद्य अंगों तथा मुखवाले, अक्षय रूपवाले, क' से
verses.wordMeaning: pras&d&t — i.e. by the favour of the sage Veda Vy&sa.
verses.commentary: Sense: pras&d&t — i.e. by the favour of the sage Veda Vy&sa.

verses.sanskrit: कर्तास्मि वचनं सर्वं देवदेव पितामह ततः प्रणम्य हृष्टात्मा ब्रह्मा लोकपितामहः
verses.transliteration: kartāsmi vacanaṃ sarvaṃ devadeva pitāmaha tataḥ praṇamya hṛṣṭātmā brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ
verses.translation: pras&d&t — i.e. by the favour of the sage Veda Vy&sa.
verses.hindi: कृतादिभेदकालाय कालवेगाय ते नमः कालाग्निरुद्ररूपाय॒ धर्माद्यष्टपदाय च।
verses.wordMeaning: pras&d&t — i.e. by the favour of the sage Veda Vy&sa.
verses.commentary: Sense: pras&d&t — i.e. by the favour of the sage Veda Vy&sa.

verses.sanskrit: हस्तं देवस्य देव्याश् च युयोज परमं प्रभुः ज्वलनश् च स्वयं तत्र कृताञ्जलिरुपस्थितः
verses.transliteration: hastaṃ devasya devyāś ca yuyoja paramaṃ prabhuḥ jvalanaś ca svayaṃ tatra kṛtāñjalirupasthitaḥ
verses.translation: pras&d&t — i.e. by the favour of the sage Veda Vy&sa.
verses.hindi: कालीविशुद्धदेहाय कालिकाकारणाय ते
verses.wordMeaning: pras&d&t — i.e. by the favour of the sage Veda Vy&sa.
verses.commentary: Sense: pras&d&t — i.e. by the favour of the sage Veda Vy&sa.

verses.sanskrit: श्रौतैरेतैर्महामन्त्रैर् मूर्तिमद्भिर् उपस्थितैः यथोक्तविधिना हुत्वा लाजानपि यथाक्रमम्
verses.transliteration: śrautairetairmahāmantrair mūrtimadbhir upasthitaiḥ yathoktavidhinā hutvā lājānapi yathākramam
verses.translation: pras&d&t — i.e. by the favour of the sage Veda Vy&sa.
verses.hindi: कालकण्ठाय मुख्याय वाहनाय वराय ते। अम्बिकापतये तुभ्यं हिरण्यपतये नमः हिरण्यरेतसे चैव नमः शर्वाय शूलिने। कपालदण्डपाशासिचर्माङ्कशधराय च
verses.wordMeaning: pras&d&t — i.e. by the favour of the sage Veda Vy&sa.
verses.commentary: Sense: pras&d&t — i.e. by the favour of the sage Veda Vy&sa.

verses.sanskrit: आनीतान्विष्णुना विप्रान् सम्पूज्य विविधैर्वरैः त्रिश् च तं ज्वलनं देवं कारयित्वा प्रदक्षिणम्
verses.transliteration: ānītānviṣṇunā viprān sampūjya vividhairvaraiḥ triś ca taṃ jvalanaṃ devaṃ kārayitvā pradakṣiṇam
verses.translation: pras&d&t — i.e. by the favour of the sage Veda Vy&sa.
verses.hindi: पतये हैमवत्याश्च हेमशुक्लाय ते नमः। पीतशुक्लाय रक्षार्थ सुराणां कृष्णवर्त्मने
verses.wordMeaning: pras&d&t — i.e. by the favour of the sage Veda Vy&sa.
verses.commentary: Sense: pras&d&t — i.e. by the favour of the sage Veda Vy&sa.

verses.sanskrit: मुक्त्वा हस्तसमायोगं सहितैः सर्वदैवतैः सुरैश् च मानवैः सर्वैः प्रहृष्टेनान्तरात्मना
verses.transliteration: muktvā hastasamāyogaṃ sahitaiḥ sarvadaivataiḥ suraiś ca mānavaiḥ sarvaiḥ prahṛṣṭenāntarātmanā
verses.translation: pras&d&t — i.e. by the favour of the sage Veda Vy&sa.
verses.hindi: पञ्चमाय महापञ्चयज्ञिनां फलदाय च। पञ्चास्यफ़णिहाराय पञ्चाक्षरमयाय ते पञ्चधा पञ्चकैवल्यदेवैरचितमूर्तये।
verses.wordMeaning: pras&d&t — i.e. by the favour of the sage Veda Vy&sa.
verses.commentary: Sense: pras&d&t — i.e. by the favour of the sage Veda Vy&sa.

verses.sanskrit: ननाम भगवान्ब्रह्मा देवदेवमुमापतिम् ततः पाद्यं तयोर् दत्त्वा शंभोराचमनं तथा
verses.transliteration: nanāma bhagavānbrahmā devadevamumāpatim tataḥ pādyaṃ tayor dattvā śaṃbhorācamanaṃ tathā
verses.translation: pras&d&t — i.e. by the favour of the sage Veda Vy&sa.
verses.hindi: कादिपञ्चकहस्ताय चादिहस्ताय ते नमः
verses.wordMeaning: pras&d&t — i.e. by the favour of the sage Veda Vy&sa.
verses.commentary: Sense: pras&d&t — i.e. by the favour of the sage Veda Vy&sa.

verses.sanskrit: मधुपर्कं तथा गां च प्रणम्य च पुनः शिवम् अतिष्ठद्भगवान्ब्रह्मा देवैरिन्द्रपुरोगमैः
verses.transliteration: madhuparkaṃ tathā gāṃ ca praṇamya ca punaḥ śivam atiṣṭhadbhagavānbrahmā devairindrapurogamaiḥ
verses.translation: pras&d&t — i.e. by the favour of the sage Veda Vy&sa.
verses.hindi: २५५५५५५५०० स्स  जातक... फ्रफ्रफफ्रफफफफ्फफफफ्रफफ्रफ्रफ्फ्रफ्क् कफ फ्रफाफफ्रफफफफ्फफ्फ्रफफफफ फ्रफ्रफ्रफफफफफ्रफमफ्रफ्रफकफ पापापापापमाफपाफापाफफफफ फफफफ फफ कि पाँच वर्णरूप मेढ़ (लिंग) वाले, “य' कारमय अ अगस लवरेफहळाङ्काय निरड्राय च ते नमः॥ सात धातुओंको धारण करनेवाले आप रुद्रको नमसा
verses.wordMeaning: pras&d&t — i.e. by the favour of the sage Veda Vy&sa.
verses.commentary: Sense: pras&d&t — i.e. by the favour of the sage Veda Vy&sa.

verses.sanskrit: भृग्वाद्यमुनयः सर्वे चाक्षतैस्तिलतण्डुलैः सूर्यादयः समभ्यर्च्य तुष्टुवुर्वृषभध्वजम्
verses.transliteration: bhṛgvādyamunayaḥ sarve cākṣataistilataṇḍulaiḥ sūryādayaḥ samabhyarcya tuṣṭuvurvṛṣabhadhvajam
verses.translation: pras&d&t — i.e. by the favour of the sage Veda Vy&sa.
verses.hindi: है। श-ष-स वर्णमय आत्मरूपवाले तथा 'क्ष' प्रलयरूप क्रोधवाले शिवको नमस्कार है । ल, व, रेफ़ ह, ळ--पाँच वर्णरूप हदयोंवाले तथा निरंग आप शिव ह) को नमस्कार है
verses.wordMeaning: pras&d&t — i.e. by the favour of the sage Veda Vy&sa.
verses.commentary: Sense: pras&d&t — i.e. by the favour of the sage Veda Vy&sa.

verses.sanskrit: शिवः समाप्य देवोक्तं वह्निमारोप्य चात्मनि तया समागतो रुद्रः सर्वलोकहिताय वै
verses.transliteration: śivaḥ samāpya devoktaṃ vahnimāropya cātmani tayā samāgato rudraḥ sarvalokahitāya vai
verses.translation: pras&d&t — i.e. by the favour of the sage Veda Vy&sa.
verses.hindi: सभी प्राणियोंके हृदयमें अनाहत ध्वनि करनेवाले, भक्तोंके द्वारा भ्रुवोंके मध्य सदा दिखायी देनेवाले, अत्यन्त भानु (सर्वप्रकाशक), सूर्य-चन्द्र-अग्निरूप वाले परमात्म-स्वरूपी, तीनों गुणोंसे ऊपर स्थित तथा तीर्थरूप पादवाले आप शिव-को नमस्कार है
verses.wordMeaning: pras&d&t — i.e. by the favour of the sage Veda Vy&sa.
verses.commentary: Sense: pras&d&t — i.e. by the favour of the sage Veda Vy&sa.

verses.sanskrit: यः पठेच्छृणुयाद्वापि भवोद्वाहं शुचिस्मितः श्रावयेद्वा द्विजाञ्छुद्धान् वेदवेदाङ्गपारगान्
verses.transliteration: yaḥ paṭhecchṛṇuyādvāpi bhavodvāhaṃ śucismitaḥ śrāvayedvā dvijāñchuddhān vedavedāṅgapāragān
verses.translation: pras&d&t — i.e. by the favour of the sage Veda Vy&sa.
verses.hindi: और उस तीर्थफलके भी अधिष्ठाता आप शिव-को नमस्कार है । क्रकू-यजु:-सामवेदस्वरूप तथा ओंकारस्वरूप शिव-को बार-बार नमस्कार है
verses.wordMeaning: pras&d&t — i.e. by the favour of the sage Veda Vy&sa.
verses.commentary: Sense: pras&d&t — i.e. by the favour of the sage Veda Vy&sa.

verses.sanskrit: स लब्ध्वा गाणपत्यं च भवेन सह मोदते यत्रायं कीर्त्यते विप्रैस् तावदास्ते तदा भवः
verses.transliteration: sa labdhvā gāṇapatyaṃ ca bhavena saha modate yatrāyaṃ kīrtyate viprais tāvadāste tadā bhavaḥ
verses.translation: pras&d&t — i.e. by the favour of the sage Veda Vy&sa.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्मा, विष्णु, हर तीन प्रकारके रूपको धारण करके प्रणवानन्तनादमें तुरीयरूपसे स्थित रहनेवाले, पीत-कृष्ण-रक्त वर्णवाले, अपरिमित तेजवाले, ब्रह्माण्डके बाहर क्रमसे पाँच प्रकारसे जल आदि पाँच स्थानों स्थित रहनेवाले और ब्रह्मा-विष्णु-कुमारस्वरूप आप शिव-को बार-बार नमस्कार है
verses.wordMeaning: pras&d&t — i.e. by the favour of the sage Veda Vy&sa.
verses.commentary: Sense: pras&d&t — i.e. by the favour of the sage Veda Vy&sa.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात् सम्पूज्य विधिवत् कीर्तयेन्नान्यथा द्विजाः उद्वाहे च द्विजेन्द्राणां क्षत्रियाणां द्विजोत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: tasmāt sampūjya vidhivat kīrtayennānyathā dvijāḥ udvāhe ca dvijendrāṇāṃ kṣatriyāṇāṃ dvijottamāḥ
verses.translation: pras&d&t — i.e. by the favour of the sage Veda Vy&sa.
verses.hindi: अम्बिकाके परमेश्वर तथा सबके ऊपर विचरण करनेवाले आप शिव-को नमस्कार है। मूल सूक्ष्म स्वरूपवाले तथा स्थूल-सूक्ष्मस्वरूप आप शिव-की नमस्कार है
verses.wordMeaning: pras&d&t — i.e. by the favour of the sage Veda Vy&sa.
verses.commentary: Sense: pras&d&t — i.e. by the favour of the sage Veda Vy&sa.

verses.sanskrit: कीर्तनीयमिदं सर्वं भवोद्वाहमनुत्तमम् कृतोद्वाहस्तदा देव्या हैमवत्या वृषध्वजः
verses.transliteration: kīrtanīyamidaṃ sarvaṃ bhavodvāhamanuttamam kṛtodvāhastadā devyā haimavatyā vṛṣadhvajaḥ
verses.translation: pras&d&t — i.e. by the favour of the sage Veda Vy&sa.
verses.hindi: समस्त संकल्योंसे रहित, सबसे रक्षित (गुप्त), आदि-मध्य-अन्तसे रहित तथा ज्ञानमें स्थित आप शिव-को बार-बार नमस्कार है गणोंसहित यम, अग्नि, वायु, रुद्र, वरुण, सोम, इन्द्र तथा निशाचरोंके द्वारा दिशाओं-विदिशाओमें ति पूजित आप शिव-को नमस्कार है। सभी तथा सभी मार्गोमें सर्वदा पूजित आपको नमस्कार है
verses.wordMeaning: pras&d&t — i.e. by the favour of the sage Veda Vy&sa.
verses.commentary: Sense: pras&d&t — i.e. by the favour of the sage Veda Vy&sa.

verses.sanskrit: सगणो नन्दिना सार्धं सर्वदेवगणैर्वृतः पुरीं वाराणसीं दिव्याम् आजगाम महाद्युतिः
verses.transliteration: sagaṇo nandinā sārdhaṃ sarvadevagaṇairvṛtaḥ purīṃ vārāṇasīṃ divyām ājagāma mahādyutiḥ
verses.translation: pras&d&t — i.e. by the favour of the sage Veda Vy&sa.
verses.hindi: रुद्र, रुद्रनील, कद्र, प्रचेता, महेश्वर, धीर सा आप शिवको नमस्कार है
verses.wordMeaning: pras&d&t — i.e. by the favour of the sage Veda Vy&sa.
verses.commentary: Sense: pras&d&t — i.e. by the favour of the sage Veda Vy&sa.

verses.sanskrit: अविमुक्ते सुखासीनं प्रणम्य वृषभध्वजम् अपृच्छत्क्षेत्रमाहात्म्यं भवानी हर्षितानना
verses.transliteration: avimukte sukhāsīnaṃ praṇamya vṛṣabhadhvajam apṛcchatkṣetramāhātmyaṃ bhavānī harṣitānanā
verses.translation: pras&d&t — i.e. by the favour of the sage Veda Vy&sa.
verses.hindi: हे भगवन्! सुनिये; देवताओं तथा हैत्योके स्वामी सर्वेषामेव भूतानां हृदि निःस्वनकारिणे । भ्रुवोरन्ते सदासद्धिर्दृष्टायात्यन्तभानवे
verses.wordMeaning: pras&d&t — i.e. by the favour of the sage Veda Vy&sa.
verses.commentary: Sense: pras&d&t — i.e. by the favour of the sage Veda Vy&sa.

verses.sanskrit: अथाहार्धेन्दुतिलकः क्षेत्रमाहात्म्यमुत्तमम् अविमुक्तस्य माहात्म्यं विस्तराच्छक्यते नहि
verses.transliteration: athāhārdhendutilakaḥ kṣetramāhātmyamuttamam avimuktasya māhātmyaṃ vistarācchakyate nahi
verses.translation: pras&d&t — i.e. by the favour of the sage Veda Vy&sa.
verses.hindi: ऋग्यजुःसामवेदाय ओङ्काराय नमो नमः
verses.wordMeaning: pras&d&t — i.e. by the favour of the sage Veda Vy&sa.
verses.commentary: Sense: pras&d&t — i.e. by the favour of the sage Veda Vy&sa.

verses.sanskrit: वक्तुं मया सुरेशानि ऋषिसंघाभिपूजितम् किं मया वर्ण्यते देवी ह्य् अविमुक्तफलोदयः
verses.transliteration: vaktuṃ mayā sureśāni ṛṣisaṃghābhipūjitam kiṃ mayā varṇyate devī hy avimuktaphalodayaḥ
verses.translation: pras&d&t — i.e. by the favour of the sage Veda Vy&sa.
verses.hindi: ओङ्कारे त्रिविधं रूपमास्थायोपरिवासिने। पीताय कृष्णवर्णाय रक्तायात्यन्ततेजसे ब्रह्मणे विष्णवे तुभ्यं कुमाराय नमो नमः
verses.wordMeaning: pras&d&t — i.e. by the favour of the sage Veda Vy&sa.
verses.commentary: Sense: pras&d&t — i.e. by the favour of the sage Veda Vy&sa.

verses.sanskrit: पापिनां यत्र मुक्तिः स्यान् मृतानाम् एकजन्मना अन्यत्र तु कृतं पापं वाराणस्यां व्यपोहति
verses.transliteration: pāpināṃ yatra muktiḥ syān mṛtānām ekajanmanā anyatra tu kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ vārāṇasyāṃ vyapohati
verses.translation: pras&d&t — i.e. by the favour of the sage Veda Vy&sa.
verses.hindi: यमाग्निवायुरुद्राम्बुसोमशक्रनिशाचरैः । दिङ्मुखे दिङ्मुखे नित्यं सगणैः पूजिताय ते
verses.wordMeaning: pras&d&t — i.e. by the favour of the sage Veda Vy&sa.
verses.commentary: Sense: pras&d&t — i.e. by the favour of the sage Veda Vy&sa.

verses.sanskrit: वाराणस्यां कृतं पापं पैशाच्यनरकावहम् कृत्वा पापसहस्राणि पिशाचत्वं वरं नृणाम्
verses.transliteration: vārāṇasyāṃ kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ paiśācyanarakāvaham kṛtvā pāpasahasrāṇi piśācatvaṃ varaṃ nṛṇām
verses.translation: pras&d&t — i.e. by the favour of the sage Veda Vy&sa.
verses.hindi: रुद्राय रुद्रनीलाय कह्रुद्राय प्रचेतसे। महेश्वराय धीराय नमः साक्षात् शिवाय ते विघ्ननाशक श्रीगणेशजीके प्राकट्यकी कथा
verses.wordMeaning: pras&d&t — i.e. by the favour of the sage Veda Vy&sa.
verses.commentary: Sense: pras&d&t — i.e. by the favour of the sage Veda Vy&sa.

verses.sanskrit: न तु शक्रसहस्रत्वं स्वर्गे काशीपुरीं विना यत्र त्रिविष्टपो देवो यत्र विश्वेश्वरो विभुः
verses.transliteration: na tu śakrasahasratvaṃ svarge kāśīpurīṃ vinā yatra triviṣṭapo devo yatra viśveśvaro vibhuḥ
verses.translation: pras&d&t — i.e. by the favour of the sage Veda Vy&sa.
verses.hindi: FRR क क कक कक कका आमामा जसका कफ फ फफ फ क फ फ फक फ फफ फ फ फफ फ फ़ ज फफफ फ फफफ फ कक कका क फफ कफ का
verses.wordMeaning: pras&d&t — i.e. by the favour of the sage Veda Vy&sa.
verses.commentary: Sense: pras&d&t — i.e. by the favour of the sage Veda Vy&sa.

verses.sanskrit: ॐकारेशः कृत्तिवासा मृतानां न पुनर्भवः उक्त्वा क्षेत्रस्य माहात्म्यं संक्षेपाच्छशिशेखरः
verses.transliteration: oṃkāreśaḥ kṛttivāsā mṛtānāṃ na punarbhavaḥ uktvā kṣetrasya māhātmyaṃ saṃkṣepācchaśiśekharaḥ
verses.translation: pras&d&t — i.e. by the favour of the sage Veda Vy&sa.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्मा-इन्र आदिने मख, कामदेव, यम, अग्नि तथा दक्षयज्ञके विध्वंसरूपी आपके विचित्र क्रिया-कलापका वर्णन स्तुतिके बहाने किया है; आप क्षमा करें आदि प्रधान देवताओंके द्वारा किये गये इस स्तवको भक्तिपूर्वक पढ़ता है अथवा दूसरोंको सुनाता है, वह
verses.wordMeaning: pras&d&t — i.e. by the favour of the sage Veda Vy&sa.
verses.commentary: Sense: pras&d&t — i.e. by the favour of the sage Veda Vy&sa.

verses.sanskrit: दर्शयामास चोद्यानं परित्यज्य गणेश्वरान् तत्रैव भगवान् जातो गजवक्त्रो विनायकः
verses.transliteration: darśayāmāsa codyānaṃ parityajya gaṇeśvarān tatraiva bhagavān jāto gajavaktro vināyakaḥ
verses.translation: pras&d&t — i.e. by the favour of the sage Veda Vy&sa.
verses.hindi: कीर्तितं ्रावयेद्विद्ठान् स याति परमां गतिम्॥ २९  परम गतिको प्राप्त होता है
verses.wordMeaning: pras&d&t — i.e. by the favour of the sage Veda Vy&sa.
verses.commentary: Sense: pras&d&t — i.e. by the favour of the sage Veda Vy&sa.

verses.sanskrit: दैत्यानां विघ्नरूपार्थम् अविघ्नाय दिवौकसाम् एतद्वः कथितं सर्वं कथासर्वस्वमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: daityānāṃ vighnarūpārtham avighnāya divaukasām etadvaḥ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ kathāsarvasvamuttamam
verses.translation: pras&d&t — i.e. by the favour of the sage Veda Vy&sa.
verses.hindi: विघ्ननाशक श्रीगणेशजीके प्राकट्यकी कथा तदाम्बिकापतिर्भवः पिनाकधृडू महेश्वरः
verses.wordMeaning: pras&d&t — i.e. by the favour of the sage Veda Vy&sa.
verses.commentary: Sense: pras&d&t — i.e. by the favour of the sage Veda Vy&sa.

verses.sanskrit: यथाश्रुतं मया सर्वं प्रसादाद्वः सुशोभनम्
verses.transliteration: yathāśrutaṃ mayā sarvaṃ prasādādvaḥ suśobhanam
verses.translation: pras&d&t — i.e. by the favour of the sage Veda Vy&sa.
verses.hindi: समस्तकर्मसिद्धये सुरापकारकारिभिः
verses.wordMeaning: pras&d&t — i.e. by the favour of the sage Veda Vy&sa.
verses.commentary: Sense: pras&d&t — i.e. by the favour of the sage Veda Vy&sa.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीलिङ्गमहापुराणे पूर्वभागे पार्वतीविवाहवर्णनं नाम त्र्यधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः कथं विनायको जातो गजवक्त्रो गणेश्वरः कथं प्रभावस्तस्यैवं सूत वक्तुमिहार्हसि
verses.transliteration: iti śrīliṅgamahāpurāṇe pūrvabhāge pārvatīvivāhavarṇanaṃ nāma tryadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ kathaṃ vināyako jāto gajavaktro gaṇeśvaraḥ kathaṃ prabhāvastasyaivaṃ sūta vaktumihārhasi
verses.translation: How was the elephant-faced Vinayaka, the leader of the Ganas, born? What is his power? O Suta, it behoves you to narrate this to us.
verses.hindi: ततः प्रसीदताद्भवान् सुविघ्नकर्मकारणम्। सुरापकारकारिणामिहैष एव नो वरः
verses.wordMeaning: How was the elephant-faced Vinayaka, the leader of the Ganas, born? What is his power? O Suta, it behoves you to narrate this to us.
verses.commentary: Sense: How was the elephant-faced Vinayaka, the leader of the Ganas, born? What is his power? O Suta, it behoves you to narrate this to us.

verses.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे देवाः सेन्द्रोपेन्द्राः समेत्य ते धर्मविघ्नं तदा कर्तुं दैत्यानामभवन्द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: etasminnantare devāḥ sendropendrāḥ sametya te dharmavighnaṃ tadā kartuṃ daityānāmabhavandvijāḥ
verses.translation: O brahmins, in the meantime, Devas including Indra and Upendra assembled together in order to create obstacles in the holy rites of Daityas.
verses.hindi: गणेश्वरं सुरेश्वरं वपुर्दधार सः शिवः
verses.wordMeaning: O brahmins, in the meantime, Devas including Indra and Upendra assembled together in order to create obstacles in the holy rites of Daityas.
verses.commentary: Sense: O brahmins, in the meantime, Devas including Indra and Upendra assembled together in order to create obstacles in the holy rites of Daityas.

verses.sanskrit: असुरा यातुधानाश् च राक्षसाः क्रूरकर्मिणः तामसाश् च तथा चान्ये राजसाश् च तथा भुवि
verses.transliteration: asurā yātudhānāś ca rākṣasāḥ krūrakarmiṇaḥ tāmasāś ca tathā cānye rājasāś ca tathā bhuvi
verses.translation: Asuras, Yatudhanas, Rak$asas of ruthless activities and other beings of Tamasa and Rajasa nature on the earth wor- ship the lord without impediment, by means of sacrifices and charitable gifts. The brahmins worship Brahma and Vi$nu and acquire the desired boons. In the same manner they attain everything. It is due to this, O excellent Devas, that we are able to achieve victory always. It behoves you to eulogise him in order to make him create. VighneSa the leader of Ganas for creating obstacles for them and for the destruction of obstacles in the way of the heaven-dwellers, for the sak e of granting sons unto the women and for the achievement of holy rites unto men.
verses.hindi: समस्तलोकसम्भवं भवार्तिहारिणं शुभम् गजाननं तदाम्बिका॥
verses.wordMeaning: Asuras, Yatudhanas, Rak$asas of ruthless activities and other beings of Tamasa and Rajasa nature on the earth wor- ship the lord without impediment, by means of sacrifices and charitable gifts. The brahmins worship Brahma and Vi$nu and acquire the desired boons.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Asuras, Yatudhanas, Rak$asas of ruthless activities and other beings of Tamasa and Rajasa nature on the earth wor- ship the lord without impediment, by means of sacrifices and charitable gifts. The brahmins worship Brahma and Vi$nu and acquire the desired boons.…

verses.sanskrit: अविघ्नं यज्ञदानाद्यैः समभ्यर्च्य महेश्वरम् ब्रह्माणं च हरिं विप्रा लब्धेप्सितवरा यतः
verses.transliteration: avighnaṃ yajñadānādyaiḥ samabhyarcya maheśvaram brahmāṇaṃ ca hariṃ viprā labdhepsitavarā yataḥ
verses.translation: After saying thus to one another they eulogised the sinless lord Siva.
verses.hindi: सूतजी बोले- है ऋषियो! शिवजीको प्रणाम करके जब सुरेश्वर लोग यथास्थान स्थित हो गये, तब अम्बिकापति, पिनाकधारी, भव महेश्वरने उन श्रेष्ठ
verses.wordMeaning: After saying thus to one another they eulogised the sinless lord Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying thus to one another they eulogised the sinless lord Siva.

verses.sanskrit: ततो ऽस्माकं सुरश्रेष्ठाः सदा विजयसंभवः तेषां ततस्तु विघ्नार्थम् अविघ्नाय दिवौकसाम्
verses.transliteration: tato 'smākaṃ suraśreṣṭhāḥ sadā vijayasaṃbhavaḥ teṣāṃ tatastu vighnārtham avighnāya divaukasām
verses.translation: Obeisance to the sinless Virifica, 951 to the deity who bestows on the goddess everything that is of consequence; to one who has no body; to one whose body is of great substance; to one who removes the physical form of Visnu.
verses.hindi: भीगे नेत्रवाले देवताओंने प्रसन्नतासे युक्त होकर आदरपूर्वक शिवको प्रणाम किया इसके बाद महेश्वर भवने सुधामृततुल्य दूष्टिसे देखकर सुरेश्वरोंसे कहा- आपलोगोंका कल्याण हो'
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to the sinless Virifica, 951 to the deity who bestows on the goddess everything that is of consequence; to one who has no body; to one whose body is of great substance; to one who removes the physical form of Visnu.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to the sinless Virifica, 951 to the deity who bestows on the goddess everything that is of consequence; to one who has no body; to one whose body is of great substance; to one who removes the physical form of Visnu.

verses.sanskrit: पुत्रार्थं चैव नारीणां नराणां कर्मसिद्धये विघ्नेशं शङ्करं स्रष्टुं गणपं स्तोतुमर्हथ
verses.transliteration: putrārthaṃ caiva nārīṇāṃ narāṇāṃ karmasiddhaye vighneśaṃ śaṅkaraṃ sraṣṭuṃ gaṇapaṃ stotumarhatha
verses.translation: Obeisance to you stationed in the zone of the nectarine base, in the body; obeisance to the Kala (time) differentiated as Krta, etc., obeisance to the force of Kala; obeisance to you.
verses.hindi: तदनन्तर स्वामी शिवको देखकर निर्भय होकर बृहस्मतिने उन्हें प्रणाम करके कहा-- है ईश! ये देवता आपका दर्शन करके वरप्राप्तिक लिये आपके घर आये हुए हैं। देवताओंका अपकार करनेवाले हैत्यों आदिके
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to you stationed in the zone of the nectarine base, in the body; obeisance to the Kala (time) differentiated as Krta, etc., obeisance to the force of Kala; obeisance to you.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to you stationed in the zone of the nectarine base, in the body; obeisance to the Kala (time) differentiated as Krta, etc., obeisance to the force of Kala; obeisance to you.

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्त्वान्योन्यमनघं तुष्टुवुः शिवमीश्वरम् नमः सर्वात्मने तुभ्यं सर्वज्ञाय पिनाकिने
verses.transliteration: ityuktvānyonyamanaghaṃ tuṣṭuvuḥ śivamīśvaram namaḥ sarvātmane tubhyaṃ sarvajñāya pinākine
verses.translation: Obeisance to one of the form of Kala, Agni and
verses.hindi: द्वारा निर्विध्नतापूर्वक समस्त कर्मोकी सिद्धिके लिये आप सदा प्रार्थित हैं। अतः आप देवताओंके अपकारी हैत्योके विघ्नयुक्त कर्मका कारण बनिये और प्रसन्न होइये; यही हमलोगोंका वर है'॥ ४--६॥ तब यह सुनकर उन पिनाकधारी सुरेश्वर शिवने
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to one of the form of Kala, Agni and
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to one of the form of Kala, Agni and

verses.sanskrit: अनघाय विरिञ्चाय देव्याः कार्यार्थदायिने अकायायार्थकायाय हरेः कायापहारिणे
verses.transliteration: anaghāya viriñcāya devyāḥ kāryārthadāyine akāyāyārthakāyāya hareḥ kāyāpahāriṇe
verses.translation: Virific&ya— vifefega recayati brahm&pSnyutp&dayatlti Virifi- cas taimai ST, the creator of the universe.
verses.hindi: गणेश्वरों तथा ब्रह्मा आदि सुरेश्वरोंने समस्त लोकोंको उत्पन्न करनेवाले तथा संसारका कष्ट दूर करनेवाले शुभ गजाननरूपी महेश्वरको स्तुति की
verses.wordMeaning: Virific&ya— vifefega recayati brahm&pSnyutp&dayatlti Virifi- cas taimai ST, the creator of the universe.
verses.commentary: Sense: Virific&ya— vifefega recayati brahm&pSnyutp&dayatlti Virifi- cas taimai ST, the creator of the universe.

verses.sanskrit: कायान्तस्थामृताधारमण्डलावस्थिताय ते कृतादिभेदकालाय कालवेगाय ते नमः
verses.transliteration: kāyāntasthāmṛtādhāramaṇḍalāvasthitāya te kṛtādibhedakālāya kālavegāya te namaḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to the great blue-necked lord, obeisance to you having the excellent vehicle; obeisance to you the lord of Ambika; obeisance to the lord of Hiranya.
verses.hindi: इसके बाद अम्बिका पार्वती -ने हाथीके समान मुख धारण किये हुए और हाथोंमें त्रिशूल तथा पाश श्रीलिड्रमहापुराण  पूवा
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to the great blue-necked lord, obeisance to you having the excellent vehicle; obeisance to you the lord of Ambika; obeisance to the lord of Hiranya.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to the great blue-necked lord, obeisance to you having the excellent vehicle; obeisance to you the lord of Ambika; obeisance to the lord of Hiranya.

verses.sanskrit: कालाग्निरुद्ररूपाय धर्माद्यष्टपदाय च कालीविशुद्धदेहाय कालिकाकारणाय ते
verses.transliteration: kālāgnirudrarūpāya dharmādyaṣṭapadāya ca kālīviśuddhadehāya kālikākāraṇāya te
verses.translation: Obeisance to you Hiranyaretas; obeisance to the trident-bearing lord identical with all; obeisance to one holding skull, staff, noose, sword, leathern shield and goad.
verses.hindi: ददुः पुष्पवर्षं हि सिद्धा मुनीन्द्रा लिये हुए समस्त लोकोंके उत्पादक कल्याणका
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to you Hiranyaretas; obeisance to the trident-bearing lord identical with all; obeisance to one holding skull, staff, noose, sword, leathern shield and goad.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to you Hiranyaretas; obeisance to the trident-bearing lord identical with all; obeisance to one holding skull, staff, noose, sword, leathern shield and goad.

verses.sanskrit: कालकण्ठाय मुख्याय वाहनाय वराय ते अंबिकापतये तुभ्यं हिरण्यपतये नमः
verses.transliteration: kālakaṇṭhāya mukhyāya vāhanāya varāya te aṃbikāpataye tubhyaṃ hiraṇyapataye namaḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to the husband of the daughter of Himavan; obeisance to you whitish and golden 063 in complexion; obeis- ance to one whose semen is yellow in colour, obeisance to fire for the protection ofDevas.
verses.hindi: स्तथा खेचरा देवसङ्घास्तदानीम्। महेश्वरस्य पुत्रकोऽभिवन्द्य तातमम्बिकाम्
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to the husband of the daughter of Himavan; obeisance to you whitish and golden 063 in complexion; obeis- ance to one whose semen is yellow in colour, obeisance to fire for the protection ofDevas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to the husband of the daughter of Himavan; obeisance to you whitish and golden 063 in complexion; obeis- ance to one whose semen is yellow in colour, obeisance to fire for the protection ofDevas.

verses.sanskrit: हिरण्यरेतसे चैव नमः शर्वाय शूलिने कपालदण्डपाशासिचर्माङ्कुशधराय च
verses.transliteration: hiraṇyaretase caiva namaḥ śarvāya śūline kapāladaṇḍapāśāsicarmāṅkuśadharāya ca
verses.translation: Obeisance to the fifth one; 064 obeisance to the bestower of boons on the Paftcayajfiins; 955 obeisance to you having the five-hooded serpent for necklace; obeisance to you the five- syllabled mantra itself.
verses.hindi: गजाननको जन्म दिया
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to the fifth one; 064 obeisance to the bestower of boons on the Paftcayajfiins; 955 obeisance to you having the five-hooded serpent for necklace; obeisance to you the five- syllabled mantra itself.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to the fifth one; 064 obeisance to the bestower of boons on the Paftcayajfiins; 955 obeisance to you having the five-hooded serpent for necklace; obeisance to you the five- syllabled mantra itself.

verses.sanskrit: पतये हैमवत्याश् च हेमशुक्लाय ते नमः पीतशुक्लाय रक्षार्थं सुराणां कृष्णवर्त्मने
verses.transliteration: pataye haimavatyāś ca hemaśuklāya te namaḥ pītaśuklāya rakṣārthaṃ surāṇāṃ kṛṣṇavartmane
verses.translation: Obeisance to the deity whose form is worshipped in five ways by the fiveKaivalyaDevas; obeisance to you whose vision is on the five syllables; 966 obeisance to you greater than the greatest.
verses.hindi: उस समय सिद्धों, मुनियों, आकाशचारियों तथा होकर एकदन्त महेश्वर गणेशको प्रणाम किया तथा उनको स्तुति की
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to the deity whose form is worshipped in five ways by the fiveKaivalyaDevas; obeisance to you whose vision is on the five syllables; 966 obeisance to you greater than the greatest.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to the deity whose form is worshipped in five ways by the fiveKaivalyaDevas; obeisance to you whose vision is on the five syllables; 966 obeisance to you greater than the greatest.

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चमाय महापञ्चयज्ञिनां फलदाय च पञ्चास्यफणिहाराय पञ्चाक्षरमयाय ते
verses.transliteration: pañcamāya mahāpañcayajñināṃ phaladāya ca pañcāsyaphaṇihārāya pañcākṣaramayāya te
verses.translation: Obeisance to one of inexhaustible form; obeisance to one of adamantine limbs and jaws constituted by the sixteen vowels; 967 obeisance to you whose right and left hands are cons-
verses.hindi: उस समय उन शिवा-शिवसे उत्पन्न, विचित्र वस्त्र-आभूषणोंसे अलंकृत तथा सभी मंगलोंका आलय महेश्वर-पुत्र वह बालक गजानन मूर्तिमान् सुन्दर भैरवकी भाँति स्थित होकर पिता शिव तथा माताकी वन्दना
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to one of inexhaustible form; obeisance to one of adamantine limbs and jaws constituted by the sixteen vowels; 967 obeisance to you whose right and left hands are cons-
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to one of inexhaustible form; obeisance to one of adamantine limbs and jaws constituted by the sixteen vowels; 967 obeisance to you whose right and left hands are cons-

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चधा पञ्चकैवल्यदेवैरर्चितमूर्तये पञ्चाक्षरदृशे तुभ्यं परात्परतराय ते
verses.transliteration: pañcadhā pañcakaivalyadevairarcitamūrtaye pañcākṣaradṛśe tubhyaṃ parātparatarāya te
verses.translation: dharm&dya$t&pad&ya — the lord of the guardians (Indra, etc.) of the eight quarters.
verses.hindi: करके नृत्य करने लगा उत्पन्न हुए पुत्रको देखकर भगवान् सर्वेश्वर भवने गजाननके लिये सभी जातकर्म आदि संस्कारोंकी स्वयं किया
verses.wordMeaning: dharm&dya$t&pad&ya — the lord of the guardians (Indra, etc.) of the eight quarters.
verses.commentary: Sense: dharm&dya$t&pad&ya — the lord of the guardians (Indra, etc.) of the eight quarters.

verses.sanskrit: षोडशस्वरवज्राङ्गवक्त्रायाक्षयरूपिणे कादिपञ्चकहस्ताय चादिहस्ताय ते नमः
verses.transliteration: ṣoḍaśasvaravajrāṅgavaktrāyākṣayarūpiṇe kādipañcakahastāya cādihastāya te namaḥ
verses.translation: pahcam&ya — one who is stationed beyond the four stages of consciousness — turiyktltfiya ST. or one who can be realized by a -system of worship comprising madya (wine), m&msa (flesh), matsya (fish), mudrfi (mystical gesticulation) and maithuna (sexual intercourse). The letter 'm* the best among the letters is variously interpreted by the right and left hand worshippers of £akti.
verses.hindi: इसके बाद जगद्गुरु महादेव भवने स्वयं  अपने परम सुखदायक हाथोंसे उसे उठाकर, आलिंगन तथा उसके सिरको सूँघकर कहा-- है मेरे पुत्र! तुम्हा अवतार हैत्योंके विनाशके लिये और देवताओं तथा ब्रह्मवावी
verses.wordMeaning: pahcam&ya — one who is stationed beyond the four stages of consciousness — turiyktltfiya ST. or one who can be realized by a -system of worship comprising madya (wine), m&msa (flesh), matsya (fish), mudrfi (mystical gesticulation) and maithuna (sexual intercourse).…
verses.commentary: Sense: pahcam&ya — one who is stationed beyond the four stages of consciousness — turiyktltfiya ST. or one who can be realized by a -system of worship comprising madya (wine), m&msa (flesh), matsya (fish), mudrfi (mystical gesticulation) and maithuna (sexual intercourse).…

verses.sanskrit: टादिपादाय रुद्राय तादिपादाय ते नमः पादिमेण्ढ्राय यद्यङ्गधातुसप्तकधारिणे
verses.transliteration: ṭādipādāya rudrāya tādipādāya te namaḥ pādimeṇḍhrāya yadyaṅgadhātusaptakadhāriṇe
verses.translation: paflc&ksara-dfie— one who sees or favours by the five-syllabled mantra 'namai fivfiya*.
verses.hindi: द्विजोंके उपकारके लिये हुआ है। जिसने पृथ्वीतल प दक्षिणाविहीन यज्ञ किया है, तुम स्वर्गपथमें स्थित हुए उसके धर्ममें विघ्न डालो। इस पृथ्वीतलपः जातमात्रं सुतं दृष्ट्या चकार भगवान् भव: । गजाननाय कृत्यांस्तु सर्वान् सर्वेश्वरः स्वयम्
verses.wordMeaning: paflc&ksara-dfie— one who sees or favours by the five-syllabled mantra 'namai fivfiya*.
verses.commentary: Sense: paflc&ksara-dfie— one who sees or favours by the five-syllabled mantra 'namai fivfiya*.

verses.sanskrit: शान्तात्मरूपिणे साक्षात् क्षदन्तक्रोधिने नमः लवरेफहलाङ्गाय निरङ्गाय च ते नमः
verses.transliteration: śāntātmarūpiṇe sākṣāt kṣadantakrodhine namaḥ lavarephahalāṅgāya niraṅgāya ca te namaḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to you Rudra whose right and left legs are constituted by the five letters beginning with C '/ M and the five letters beginning with * 4 /". Obeisance to one whose penis is constituted by the five letters beginning with t( p "; obeisance to one who holds seven limbs and seven constituents, lymph etc. constituted by the letters beginning with "y\ 956
verses.hindi: आदाय च कराभ्यां च सुसुखाभ्यां भवः स्वयम् । आलिङ्गयाघ्राय मूर्धानं महादेवो जगद्गुरुः
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to you Rudra whose right and left legs are constituted by the five letters beginning with C '/ M and the five letters beginning with * 4 /". Obeisance to one whose penis is constituted by the five letters beginning with t( p ";…
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to you Rudra whose right and left legs are constituted by the five letters beginning with C '/ M and the five letters beginning with * 4 /". Obeisance to one whose penis is constituted by the five letters beginning with t( p ";…

verses.sanskrit: सर्वेषाम् एव भूतानां हृदि निःस्वनकारिणे भ्रुवोर् अन्ते सदा सद्भिर् दृष्टायात्यन्तभानवे
verses.transliteration: sarveṣām eva bhūtānāṃ hṛdi niḥsvanakāriṇe bhruvor ante sadā sadbhir dṛṣṭāyātyantabhānave
verses.translation: Obeisance to one whose form is the Atihan ending with < V,; 95ft obeisance to one whose anger is constituted by the letter *h 9 ending with ksa. 960 Obeisance to one whose limbs are constituted by the letters 1, v, r, h, and s; obeisance to you devoid of limbs.
verses.hindi: तवावतारो हैत्यानां विनाशाय ममात्मज। देवानामुपकारार्थं द्विजानां ब्रह्मवादिनाम् यज्ञश्च दक्षिणाहीनः कृतो येन महीतले। तस्य धर्मस्य विघ्नं च कुरु स्वर्गपथे स्थितः
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to one whose form is the Atihan ending with < V,; 95ft obeisance to one whose anger is constituted by the letter *h 9 ending with ksa. 960 Obeisance to one whose limbs are constituted by the letters 1, v, r, h, and s; obeisance to you devoid of limbs.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to one whose form is the Atihan ending with < V,; 95ft obeisance to one whose anger is constituted by the letter *h 9 ending with ksa. 960 Obeisance to one whose limbs are constituted by the letters 1, v, r, h, and s; obeisance to you devoid of limbs.

verses.sanskrit: भानुसोमाग्निनेत्राय परमात्मस्वरूपिणे गुणत्रयोपरिस्थाय तीर्थपादाय ते नमः
verses.transliteration: bhānusomāgninetrāya paramātmasvarūpiṇe guṇatrayoparisthāya tīrthapādāya te namaḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to one who causes sounds in the heart of all living beings; obeisance to one who is always seen by devotees in between the eyebrows; obeisance to the excessive-raved.
verses.hindi: विघ्ननाशक श्रीगणेशजीके प्राकस्यकी कथा
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to one who causes sounds in the heart of all living beings; obeisance to one who is always seen by devotees in between the eyebrows; obeisance to the excessive-raved.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to one who causes sounds in the heart of all living beings; obeisance to one who is always seen by devotees in between the eyebrows; obeisance to the excessive-raved.

verses.sanskrit: तीर्थतत्त्वाय साराय तस्मादपि पराय ते ऋग्यजुःसामवेदाय ॐकाराय नमो नमः
verses.transliteration: tīrthatattvāya sārāya tasmādapi parāya te ṛgyajuḥsāmavedāya oṃkārāya namo namaḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to one whose eyes are constituted by the sun, moon and fire; obeisance to the deity of the form of the supreme soul; obeisance to one who is stationed above the three Gunas, obeisance to one whose feet constitute the holy centre. 961
verses.hindi: अध्यापनं चाध्ययनं व्याख्यानं कर्म एव च। योन्यायतः करोत्यस्मिंस्तस्य प्राणान् सदा हर स्वधर्मरहितानां च प्राणानपहर प्रभो
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to one whose eyes are constituted by the sun, moon and fire; obeisance to the deity of the form of the supreme soul; obeisance to one who is stationed above the three Gunas, obeisance to one whose feet constitute the holy centre. 961
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to one whose eyes are constituted by the sun, moon and fire; obeisance to the deity of the form of the supreme soul; obeisance to one who is stationed above the three Gunas, obeisance to one whose feet constitute the holy centre. 961

verses.sanskrit: ओङ्कारे त्रिविधं रूपम् आस्थायोपरिवासिने पीताय कृष्णवर्णाय रक्तायात्यन्ततेजसे
verses.transliteration: oṅkāre trividhaṃ rūpam āsthāyoparivāsine pītāya kṛṣṇavarṇāya raktāyātyantatejase
verses.translation: Obeisance to one who stays above, after creating three- fold form in the Omkara; 962 obeisance to the yellow one, to one dark in complexion; to the red one; to one of excessive refulgence.
verses.hindi: याः स्त्रियस्त्वां सदा कालं पुरुषाश्च विनायक। यजन्ति तासां तेषां च त्वत्साम्यं दातुमर्हसि
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to one who stays above, after creating three- fold form in the Omkara; 962 obeisance to the yellow one, to one dark in complexion; to the red one; to one of excessive refulgence.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to one who stays above, after creating three- fold form in the Omkara; 962 obeisance to the yellow one, to one dark in complexion; to the red one; to one of excessive refulgence.

verses.sanskrit: स्थानपञ्चकसंस्थाय पञ्चधाण्डबहिः क्रमात् ब्रह्मणे विष्णवे तुभ्यं कुमाराय नमोनमः
verses.transliteration: sthānapañcakasaṃsthāya pañcadhāṇḍabahiḥ kramāt brahmaṇe viṣṇave tubhyaṃ kumārāya namonamaḥ
verses.translation: Obeisance to one who is situated in five abodes 963 in
verses.hindi: मां च नारायणं वापि ब्रह्माणमपि पुत्रक। यजन्ति यज्ञैर्वा विप्रैरग्रे पूज्यो भविष्यसि देवैरपि तथान्यैश्च लब्धव्यं नास्ति कुत्रचित्
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to one who is situated in five abodes 963 in
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to one who is situated in five abodes 963 in

verses.sanskrit: अंबायाः परमेशाय सर्वोपरिचराय ते मूलसूक्ष्मस्वरूपाय स्थूलसूक्ष्माय ते नमः
verses.transliteration: aṃbāyāḥ parameśāya sarvoparicarāya te mūlasūkṣmasvarūpāya sthūlasūkṣmāya te namaḥ
verses.translation: k?adanta— -the letter ending with *k?*, i.e. 'k* f inclusive of the preceding letter ( h'.
verses.hindi: अभ्यर्चयन्ति ये लोका मानवास्तु विनायकम्।
verses.wordMeaning: k?adanta— -the letter ending with *k?*, i.e. 'k* f inclusive of the preceding letter ( h'.
verses.commentary: Sense: k?adanta— -the letter ending with *k?*, i.e. 'k* f inclusive of the preceding letter ( h'.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वसंकल्पशून्याय सर्वस्माद्रक्षिताय ते आदिमध्यान्तशून्याय चित्संस्थाय नमोनमः
verses.transliteration: sarvasaṃkalpaśūnyāya sarvasmādrakṣitāya te ādimadhyāntaśūnyāya citsaṃsthāya namonamaḥ
verses.translation: triyidham rupam — the forms BrahmS, Vifjpu and Rudra.
verses.hindi: तदाप्रभृति लोकेऽस्मिन् पूजयन्ति गणेश्वरम्। हैत्यानां धर्मविघ्नं च चकारासौ गणेश्वरः कर्म करता हो; उसके प्राणोंको तुम सदा हरते रहो। हे नरश्रेष्ठ! है प्रभो! वर्णसे च्युत तथा अपने धर्मसे रहित पुरुषों एवं स्त्रियोंके प्राणोंको हर लो। है विनायक! जो स्त्रियाँ तथा पुरुष सदा कालरूप तुम्हारी पूजा करें, तुम उन्हे
verses.wordMeaning: triyidham rupam — the forms BrahmS, Vifjpu and Rudra.
verses.commentary: Sense: triyidham rupam — the forms BrahmS, Vifjpu and Rudra.

verses.sanskrit: यमाग्निवायुरुद्रांबुसोमशक्रनिशाचरैः दिङ्मुखे दिङ्मुखे नित्यं सगणैः पूजिताय ते
verses.transliteration: yamāgnivāyurudrāṃbusomaśakraniśācaraiḥ diṅmukhe diṅmukhe nityaṃ sagaṇaiḥ pūjitāya te
verses.translation: sth&na-pancaka— i.e. earth, water, fire, wind and ether.
verses.hindi: अपना साम्य प्रदान करो । है बालगणेश्वर ! तुम इस लोक तथा परलोकमें पूजित होकर युवा और वृद्ध भक्तोंकी रक्षा सम्पूर्ण प्रयलसे करो । तुम तीनों लोकोंमें सर्वत्र विघ्नगणेश्वरके रूपमें पूजनीय तथा वन्दनीय होओगे; इसमें संशय नहीं
verses.wordMeaning: sth&na-pancaka— i.e. earth, water, fire, wind and ether.
verses.commentary: Sense: sth&na-pancaka— i.e. earth, water, fire, wind and ether.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वेषु सर्वदा सर्वमार्गे सम्पूजिताय ते रुद्राय रुद्रनीलाय कद्रुद्राय प्रचेतसे महेश्वराय धीराय नमः साक्षाच्छिवाय ते
verses.transliteration: sarveṣu sarvadā sarvamārge sampūjitāya te rudrāya rudranīlāya kadrudrāya pracetase maheśvarāya dhīrāya namaḥ sākṣācchivāya te
verses.translation: Obeisance to the lord of Uma; obeisance to you who move above all; obeisance to you of subtle form at the root; obeisance to you the gross as well as subtle.
verses.hindi: है। है पुत्र! जो विप्र मेरी, विष्णुकी तथा ब्रह्माकी पूजा करते हैं अथवा अग्निष्टोम आदि यज्ञोके द्वारा यजन करते हैं, उन ब्राह्मणोंके द्वारा भी सबसे पहले तुम पूज्य होओगे । तुम्हारी पूजा न करके जो कल्याणके लिये श्रौत- स्मार्त-लौकिक कर्म करेगा, उसका मंगल अमंगलके रूपमें परिवर्तित हो जायेगा। है गजानन! तुम समस्त कार्योंकी सिद्धिके लिये ब्राह्मणों, क्षत्रियो, वैश्यों तथा शुद्रोंके द्वारा शुभ भक्ष्य-भोज्य आदिसे भली-भाँति पूजाके
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to the lord of Uma; obeisance to you who move above all; obeisance to you of subtle form at the root; obeisance to you the gross as well as subtle.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to the lord of Uma; obeisance to you who move above all; obeisance to you of subtle form at the root; obeisance to you the gross as well as subtle.

verses.sanskrit: अथ शृणु भगवन् स्तवच्छलेन कथितमजेन्द्रमुखैः सुरासुरेशैः ।* मखमदनयमाग्निदक्षयज्ञक्षपणविचित्रविचेष्टितं क्षमस्व
verses.transliteration: atha śṛṇu bhagavan stavacchalena kathitamajendramukhaiḥ surāsureśaiḥ /* makhamadanayamāgnidakṣayajñakṣapaṇavicitraviceṣṭitaṃ kṣamasva
verses.translation: Obeisance to you devoid of all conceptions; to you protected from all; to you devoid of beginning, middle and end; to you stationed in Cit. Obeisance to you worshipped perpetually by Yama, Agni, Vayu, Rudra, Varuna, Soma, Indra and Nirjrti and the guardians of different quarters.
verses.hindi: योग्य होओगे। गन्ध, पुष्प, धूप आदिसे तुम्हारी पूजा किये बिना तीनों लोकोंमें कहीं भी देवताओं तथा अन्य लोगोंसे भी कुछ नहीं प्राप्त हो सकता है। जो मानव विनायकको पूजा करेंगे, वे इन्द्र आदिके द्वारा भी पूजनीय होंगे; इसमें
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to you devoid of all conceptions; to you protected from all; to you devoid of beginning, middle and end; to you stationed in Cit. Obeisance to you worshipped perpetually by Yama, Agni, Vayu, Rudra, Varuna, Soma, Indra and Nirjrti and the guardians of different quarters.
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to you devoid of all conceptions; to you protected from all; to you devoid of beginning, middle and end; to you stationed in Cit. Obeisance to you worshipped perpetually by Yama, Agni, Vayu, Rudra, Varuna, Soma, Indra and Nirjrti and the guardians of different quarters.

verses.sanskrit: यः पठेत्तु स्तवं भक्त्या शक्राग्निप्रमुखैः सुरैः कीर्तितं श्रावयेद्विद्वान् स याति परमां गतिम्
verses.transliteration: yaḥ paṭhettu stavaṃ bhaktyā śakrāgnipramukhaiḥ suraiḥ kīrtitaṃ śrāvayedvidvān sa yāti paramāṃ gatim
verses.translation: Obeisance to you who are worshipped in every- thing and in all paths and always. Obeisance to Rudra, Rudranila, Kadrudra Pracetas. Obeisance to the bold Mahe4vara; obeisance to Siva. O lord, O destroyer of sacrifice, of Kama, of Yama, of Agni and of Dak§ayajfia, listen. For- give the deceptive utterances and peculiar activities pursued by the leaders of Devas as well as Asuras and those other leaders Vi$Qu and Indra.
verses.hindi: सन्देह नहीं है । यदि फलकी इच्छा रखनेवाले तुम्हारी पूजा नहीं करते हों, तो वे चाहे ब्रह्मा, विष्णु, स्वयं मैं, इन्द्र अथवा अन्य देवता ही क्यों न हों, उन्हें तुम विघ्नोंसे बाधित करो'॥ १४--२७॥ तब प्रभु गणपतिने विघ्नगणोंको उत्पन्न किया और वे गणोंके साथ शिवजीको नमस्कार करके उनके आगे खड़े हो गये
verses.wordMeaning: Obeisance to you who are worshipped in every- thing and in all paths and always. Obeisance to Rudra, Rudranila, Kadrudra Pracetas. Obeisance to the bold Mahe4vara; obeisance to Siva. O lord, O destroyer of sacrifice, of Kama, of Yama, of Agni and of Dak§ayajfia, listen.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Obeisance to you who are worshipped in every- thing and in all paths and always. Obeisance to Rudra, Rudranila, Kadrudra Pracetas. Obeisance to the bold Mahe4vara; obeisance to Siva. O lord, O destroyer of sacrifice, of Kama, of Yama, of Agni and of Dak§ayajfia, listen.…

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीलिङ्गमहापुराणे पूर्वभागे देवस्तुतिर्नाम चतुरधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः यदा स्थिताः सुरेश्वराः प्रणम्य चैवमीश्वरम् तदांबिकापतिर् भवः पिनाकधृङ् महेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: iti śrīliṅgamahāpurāṇe pūrvabhāge devastutirnāma caturadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ yadā sthitāḥ sureśvarāḥ praṇamya caivamīśvaram tadāṃbikāpatir bhavaḥ pinākadhṛṅ maheśvaraḥ
verses.translation: The lord glanced at them with visions sweet as nectar. The lord said to the leading Devas — "Welfare be to you."
verses.hindi: उसी समयसे लोग इस लोकमें गणपतिको पूजा करने लगे और वे गणेश्वर हैत्योंके धर्ममें विघ्न डालने लगे। है ऋषियो! मैंने आप लोगोंको स्कन्द (कार्तिकेय)-के अग्रजको उत्पत्तिका सम्पूर्ण आख्यान
verses.wordMeaning: The lord glanced at them with visions sweet as nectar. The lord said to the leading Devas — "Welfare be to you."
verses.commentary: Sense: The lord glanced at them with visions sweet as nectar. The lord said to the leading Devas — "Welfare be to you."

verses.sanskrit: ददौ निरीक्षणं क्षणाद् भवः स तान्सुरोत्तमान् प्रणेमुरादराद्धरं सुरा मुदार्द्रलोचनाः
verses.transliteration: dadau nirīkṣaṇaṃ kṣaṇād bhavaḥ sa tānsurottamān praṇemurādarāddharaṃ surā mudārdralocanāḥ
verses.translation: The lord of speech Brhaspati glanced at the lord fear- lessly, bowed to him and said — O Isa, it is with the desire for a boon that Devas have come here. You have always been unobstructedly requested by Asuras and others. You are prayed to by those who are harmful and injurious to Devas, for the achievement of their desire. Hence, bless us with a good cause of impediment to those who bring about injury to Devas. This alone is our request.
verses.hindi: बता दिया। जो इसे पढ़ता है, सुनता है अथवा सुनाता है, वह सुखी हो जाता है गये विनायकोत्पत्तिनाम पञ्चाधिकशततमोऽध्यायः
verses.wordMeaning: The lord of speech Brhaspati glanced at the lord fear- lessly, bowed to him and said — O Isa, it is with the desire for a boon that Devas have come here. You have always been unobstructedly requested by Asuras and others.…
verses.commentary: Sense: The lord of speech Brhaspati glanced at the lord fear- lessly, bowed to him and said — O Isa, it is with the desire for a boon that Devas have come here. You have always been unobstructedly requested by Asuras and others.…

verses.sanskrit: भवः सुधामृतोपमैर् निरीक्षणैर्निरीक्षणात् तदाह भद्रमस्तु वः सुरेश्वरान् महेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: bhavaḥ sudhāmṛtopamair nirīkṣaṇairnirīkṣaṇāt tadāha bhadramastu vaḥ sureśvarān maheśvaraḥ
verses.translation: On hearing that, the Pinaka- bearing lord of Devas, Siva created the body of the leading Deva Gane$vara. M5
verses.hindi: :/विवायकोत्पत्ति' नामक एक सौ पाँचवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing that, the Pinaka- bearing lord of Devas, Siva created the body of the leading Deva Gane$vara. M5
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing that, the Pinaka- bearing lord of Devas, Siva created the body of the leading Deva Gane$vara. M5

verses.sanskrit: वरार्थमीश वीक्ष्यते सुरा गृहं गतास्त्विमे प्रणम्य चाह वाक्पतिः पतिं निरीक्ष्य निर्भयः
verses.transliteration: varārthamīśa vīkṣyate surā gṛhaṃ gatāstvime praṇamya cāha vākpatiḥ patiṃ nirīkṣya nirbhayaḥ
verses.translation: The leading Ganas and the lords of Devas eulogised Mahe£vara, the origin of the world and the splendid dispellcr of the distress of worldly existence. Then Ambika welcomed the elephant- faced lord Gajanana the cause of the origin of the world, the wi elder of the trident and noose. Siddhas and sages showered flowers. The heaven-walkers, the groups of Devas eulogised lord Mahesa the bestower of the cherished desires. The lords of Devas bowed to Ganesa and Mahe&a alertfully.
verses.hindi: फफफफफफफफफफ क्ष क काका 1. फफ दारुकासुरके विनाशके लिये भगवान् शिवद्वारा अपने शरीरसे काली तथा अष्टभैरवोंको प्रकट करना एवं शिवताण्डवनृत्यको कथा
verses.wordMeaning: The leading Ganas and the lords of Devas eulogised Mahe£vara, the origin of the world and the splendid dispellcr of the distress of worldly existence. Then Ambika welcomed the elephant- faced lord Gajanana the cause of the origin of the world,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The leading Ganas and the lords of Devas eulogised Mahe£vara, the origin of the world and the splendid dispellcr of the distress of worldly existence. Then Ambika welcomed the elephant- faced lord Gajanana the cause of the origin of the world,…

verses.sanskrit: सुरेतरादिभिः सदा ह्य् अविघ्नमर्थितो भवान् समस्तकर्मसिद्धये सुरापकारकारिभिः
verses.transliteration: suretarādibhiḥ sadā hy avighnamarthito bhavān samastakarmasiddhaye surāpakārakāribhiḥ
verses.translation: That boy emanating from both of them, the embodied form of gentleness and terrific appearance, the abode of all auspiciousness stood there and danced.
verses.hindi: दारुकोऽसुरसम्भूतस्तपसा लब्धविक्रमः। सूदयामास कालाग्निरिव देवान् द्विजोत्तमान्
verses.wordMeaning: That boy emanating from both of them, the embodied form of gentleness and terrific appearance, the abode of all auspiciousness stood there and danced.
verses.commentary: Sense: That boy emanating from both of them, the embodied form of gentleness and terrific appearance, the abode of all auspiciousness stood there and danced.

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रसीदताद् भवान् सुविघ्नकर्मकारणम् सुरापकारकारिणाम् इहैष एव नो वरः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prasīdatād bhavān suvighnakarmakāraṇam surāpakārakāriṇām ihaiṣa eva no varaḥ
verses.translation: Gajanana was bedecked in wonderful garments and ornaments of various kinds. The gentle son of Mahelvara salut- ed his father and mother. Lord Bhava, the lord of all, himself performed the post-natal rites of his recently born son Gajanana.
verses.hindi: दारुकेण तदा देवास्ताडिताः पीडिता भृशम्। ब्रह्माणं च तथेशानं कुमारं विष्णुमेव च स्त्रीरूपधारिभिः स्तुत्येब्रह्माद्येर्युधि संस्थितैः
verses.wordMeaning: Gajanana was bedecked in wonderful garments and ornaments of various kinds. The gentle son of Mahelvara salut- ed his father and mother. Lord Bhava, the lord of all, himself performed the post-natal rites of his recently born son Gajanana.
