verses.commentary: Sense: Gajanana was bedecked in wonderful garments and ornaments of various kinds. The gentle son of Mahelvara salut- ed his father and mother. Lord Bhava, the lord of all, himself performed the post-natal rites of his recently born son Gajanana.

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तदा निशम्य वै पिनाकधृक् सुरेश्वरः गणेश्वरं सुरेश्वरं वपुर्दधार सः शिवः
verses.transliteration: tatastadā niśamya vai pinākadhṛk sureśvaraḥ gaṇeśvaraṃ sureśvaraṃ vapurdadhāra saḥ śivaḥ
verses.translation: He held him in his arms that offered gentle pleasure and happiness. Mahadeva, the preceptor of the universe, em- braced him and kissed him on his head and said.
verses.hindi: बाधितास्तेन ते सर्वे ब्रह्माणं प्राप्य वै द्विजाः । विज्ञाप्य तस्मै तत्सर्व तेन सार्धमुमापतिम्
verses.wordMeaning: He held him in his arms that offered gentle pleasure and happiness. Mahadeva, the preceptor of the universe, em- braced him and kissed him on his head and said.
verses.commentary: Sense: He held him in his arms that offered gentle pleasure and happiness. Mahadeva, the preceptor of the universe, em- braced him and kissed him on his head and said.

verses.sanskrit: गणेश्वराश् च तुष्टुवुः सुरेश्वरा महेश्वरम् समस्तलोकसंभवं भवार्त्तिहारिणं शुभम्
verses.transliteration: gaṇeśvarāś ca tuṣṭuvuḥ sureśvarā maheśvaram samastalokasaṃbhavaṃ bhavārttihāriṇaṃ śubham
verses.translation: O my son, you are born for the destruction of Daityas and for rendering help unto Devas and brahmins the expound- ers of Vedas.
verses.hindi: ब्रह्मा प्राप्य च देवेशं प्रणम्य बहुधा नतः दारुणो भगवान् दारुः पूर्व तेन विनिर्जिताः। निहत्य दारुकं हैत्यं स्त्रीवध्यं त्रातुमहसि
verses.wordMeaning: O my son, you are born for the destruction of Daityas and for rendering help unto Devas and brahmins the expound- ers of Vedas.
verses.commentary: Sense: O my son, you are born for the destruction of Daityas and for rendering help unto Devas and brahmins the expound- ers of Vedas.

verses.sanskrit: इभाननाश्रितं वरं त्रिशूलपाशधारिणम् समस्तलोकसंभवं गजाननं तदांबिका
verses.transliteration: ibhānanāśritaṃ varaṃ triśūlapāśadhāriṇam samastalokasaṃbhavaṃ gajānanaṃ tadāṃbikā
verses.translation: Be stationed in the heavenly path. Create impediment in the rituals of that person by whom the sacrifice had been performed without the monetary gifts on the surface of the earth.
verses.hindi: विज्ञप्तिं ब्रह्मणः श्रुत्वा भगवान् भगनेत्रहा। देवीमुवाच देवेशो गिरिजां प्रहसन्निव ८
verses.wordMeaning: Be stationed in the heavenly path. Create impediment in the rituals of that person by whom the sacrifice had been performed without the monetary gifts on the surface of the earth.
verses.commentary: Sense: Be stationed in the heavenly path. Create impediment in the rituals of that person by whom the sacrifice had been performed without the monetary gifts on the surface of the earth.

verses.sanskrit: ददुः पुष्पवर्षं हि सिद्धा मुनीन्द्रास् तथा खेचरा देवसंघास्तदानीम् तदा तुष्टुवुश्चैकदन्तं सुरेशाः प्रणेमुर्गणेशं महेशं वितन्द्राः
verses.transliteration: daduḥ puṣpavarṣaṃ hi siddhā munīndrās tathā khecarā devasaṃghāstadānīm tadā tuṣṭuvuścaikadantaṃ sureśāḥ praṇemurgaṇeśaṃ maheśaṃ vitandrāḥ
verses.translation: Lord Siva entered the womb of Umft to be born as Gaodlvafa; vide, the Vedic concept that the wife becomes the mother unto her husband when the latter is bom of her in the form of a son:
verses.hindi: विवेश देहे देवस्य देवेशी जन्मतत्परा एकेनांशेन देवेशं प्रविष्टा देवसत्तमम्। न विवेद तदा ब्रह्मा देवाश्चेन्द्रपुरोगमाः
verses.wordMeaning: Lord Siva entered the womb of Umft to be born as Gaodlvafa; vide, the Vedic concept that the wife becomes the mother unto her husband when the latter is bom of her in the form of a son:
verses.commentary: Sense: Lord Siva entered the womb of Umft to be born as Gaodlvafa; vide, the Vedic concept that the wife becomes the mother unto her husband when the latter is bom of her in the form of a son:

verses.sanskrit: तदा तयोर्विनिर्गतः सुभैरवः स मूर्तिमान् स्थितो ननर्त बालकः समस्तमङ्गलालयः
verses.transliteration: tadā tayorvinirgataḥ subhairavaḥ sa mūrtimān sthito nanarta bālakaḥ samastamaṅgalālayaḥ
verses.translation: Remove the vital breaths of the person who improperly performs the rites of teaching and study of the Vedas, the com- mentaries thereon and the rites mentioned in them.
verses.hindi: ऋषिगण बोले है सूतजी ! हमलोगोंने स्कच
verses.wordMeaning: Remove the vital breaths of the person who improperly performs the rites of teaching and study of the Vedas, the com- mentaries thereon and the rites mentioned in them.
verses.commentary: Sense: Remove the vital breaths of the person who improperly performs the rites of teaching and study of the Vedas, the com- mentaries thereon and the rites mentioned in them.

verses.sanskrit: विचित्रवस्त्रभूषणैर् अलंकृतो गजाननः महेश्वरस्य पुत्रको ऽभिवन्द्य तातम् अम्बिकाम्
verses.transliteration: vicitravastrabhūṣaṇair alaṃkṛto gajānanaḥ maheśvarasya putrako 'bhivandya tātam ambikām
verses.translation: O lord, remove the vital breaths of men and women fallen off from their castes. O leading man, similarly, do unto those who are devoid of their duties.
verses.hindi: अग्रजका प्रादुर्भाव तो सुन लिया; अब आप हमलोगोंको यथार्थरूपसे यह बतायें कि शम्भुके नृत्यका आरम्भ कैसे तथा किसलिये हुआ ? सूतजी बोले--दारुक नामक एक हैत्य असुरोमै उत्पन्न हुआ । तपस्यासे पराक्रम प्राप्त करके कालाग्निके समान वह असुर देवताओं तथा उत्तम द्विजोंको पीडित करने लगा
verses.wordMeaning: O lord, remove the vital breaths of men and women fallen off from their castes. O leading man, similarly, do unto those who are devoid of their duties.
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord, remove the vital breaths of men and women fallen off from their castes. O leading man, similarly, do unto those who are devoid of their duties.

verses.sanskrit: जातमात्रं सुतं दृष्ट्वा चकार भगवान्भवः गजाननाय कृत्यांस्तु सर्वान्सर्वेश्वरः स्वयम्
verses.transliteration: jātamātraṃ sutaṃ dṛṣṭvā cakāra bhagavānbhavaḥ gajānanāya kṛtyāṃstu sarvānsarveśvaraḥ svayam
verses.translation: O Vinayaka, it behoves you to bestow equality with you, on those men and women who worship you on all occasions.
verses.hindi: उस समय वह दारुक ब्रह्मा, ईशान, कुमार, विष्णु यम, इन्द्र आदिके पास पहुँचकर उन देवताओंको सताने लगा, इससे वे देवता बहुत पीड़ित हुए। “यह असुर स्त्रीवध्य है'--ऐसा सोचकर स्त्रीरूपधारी तथा युद्धके
verses.wordMeaning: O Vinayaka, it behoves you to bestow equality with you, on those men and women who worship you on all occasions.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Vinayaka, it behoves you to bestow equality with you, on those men and women who worship you on all occasions.

verses.sanskrit: आदाय च कराभ्यां च सुसुखाभ्यां भवः स्वयम् आलिङ्ग्याघ्राय मूर्धानं महादेवो जगद्गुरुः
verses.transliteration: ādāya ca karābhyāṃ ca susukhābhyāṃ bhavaḥ svayam āliṅgyāghrāya mūrdhānaṃ mahādevo jagadguruḥ
verses.translation: O boy GaneSvara, protect your devotees with all efforts. On being worshipped here and hereafter protect old people and those who are in the prime of their youth.
verses.hindi: लिये स्थित उन स्तुत्य ब्रह्मा आदिके साथ वह असुर युद्ध करने लगा हे द्विजो! तब उसके द्वारा बाधित किये गये वे सभी देवतागण ब्रह्माके पास पहुँचकर उनसे सब कुछ निवेदन करके पुन: उन ब्रह्माके साथ उमापतिके यहाँ जाकर पितामहको आगे करके शिवकी स्तुति
verses.wordMeaning: O boy GaneSvara, protect your devotees with all efforts. On being worshipped here and hereafter protect old people and those who are in the prime of their youth.
verses.commentary: Sense: O boy GaneSvara, protect your devotees with all efforts. On being worshipped here and hereafter protect old people and those who are in the prime of their youth.

verses.sanskrit: तवावतारो दैत्यानां विनाशाय ममात्मज देवानामुपकारार्थं द्विजानां ब्रह्मवादिनाम्
verses.transliteration: tavāvatāro daityānāṃ vināśāya mamātmaja devānāmupakārārthaṃ dvijānāṃ brahmavādinām
verses.translation: O Vighnefvara, O Gane€vara, everywhere in the three worlds, you alone will undoubtedly become worthy of being worshipped and honoured.
verses.hindi: करने लगे। इसके बाद देवेशके निकट जाकर अत्यन्त विनम्र होकर प्रणाम करके ब्रह्माने कहा--'हे भगवन्! दारुक महाभयंकर है; हमलोग उससे पहले ही पराजित हो चुके हैं । स्त्रीके द्वारा वध्य उस हैत्य दारुकका संहार
verses.wordMeaning: O Vighnefvara, O Gane€vara, everywhere in the three worlds, you alone will undoubtedly become worthy of being worshipped and honoured.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Vighnefvara, O Gane€vara, everywhere in the three worlds, you alone will undoubtedly become worthy of being worshipped and honoured.

verses.sanskrit: यज्ञश् च दक्षिणाहीनः कृतो येन महीतले तस्य धर्मस्य विघ्नं च कुरु स्वर्गपथे स्थितः
verses.transliteration: yajñaś ca dakṣiṇāhīnaḥ kṛto yena mahītale tasya dharmasya vighnaṃ ca kuru svargapathe sthitaḥ
verses.translation: O son, even when the brahmins worship me, as Nara- yana or Brahma or when they perform sacrificial rites you will be worshipped at the outset.
verses.hindi: करके आप हमलोगोंकी रक्षा कीजिये'॥ ५--७॥ ब्रह्माजीकी प्रार्थना सुनकर भगके नेत्रोंको १८ करनेवाले भगवान् देवेशने देवी गिरिजासे हँसते ६? कहा- है शुभे! है वरानने! मैं सभी लोकोंके हितके लिये इस स्त्रीवध्य दारुकके वधहेतु आज आपसे प्रार्थना
verses.wordMeaning: O son, even when the brahmins worship me, as Nara- yana or Brahma or when they perform sacrificial rites you will be worshipped at the outset.
verses.commentary: Sense: O son, even when the brahmins worship me, as Nara- yana or Brahma or when they perform sacrificial rites you will be worshipped at the outset.

verses.sanskrit: अध्यापनं चाध्ययनं व्याख्यानं कर्म एव च यो ऽन्यायतः करोत्यस्मिन् तस्य प्राणान्सदा हर
verses.transliteration: adhyāpanaṃ cādhyayanaṃ vyākhyānaṃ karma eva ca yo 'nyāyataḥ karotyasmin tasya prāṇānsadā hara
verses.translation: If anyone performs auspicious rite laid down in the &rutis or Smftis or any worldly ceremony without worshipping you at the outset, it will be turned inauspicious.
verses.hindi: तब उनका वचन सुनकर संसारको उत्पन्न कणेवाली उन देवेश्वरीने जन्मके लिये तत्पर होकर शिवके शरीर प्रवेश किया। वे पार्वती देवताओंमें श्रेष्ठ देवेश्वर
verses.wordMeaning: If anyone performs auspicious rite laid down in the &rutis or Smftis or any worldly ceremony without worshipping you at the outset, it will be turned inauspicious.
verses.commentary: Sense: If anyone performs auspicious rite laid down in the &rutis or Smftis or any worldly ceremony without worshipping you at the outset, it will be turned inauspicious.

verses.sanskrit: वर्णाच्च्युतानां नारीणां नराणां नरपुङ्गव स्वधर्मरहितानां च प्राणानपहर प्रभो
verses.transliteration: varṇāccyutānāṃ nārīṇāṃ narāṇāṃ narapuṅgava svadharmarahitānāṃ ca prāṇānapahara prabho
verses.translation: O Gajanana, you are worthy of being worshipped by brahmins, K$atriyas, VaiSyas and Sudras by the offerings of splendid edibles and food-stuffs for the achievement of all Siddhis.
verses.hindi: अध्याय १०६ भगवान् शिवद्वारा काली तथा अष्टभैरवोंको प्रकट करना ५५७ सोलहवें अंशसे प्रविष्ट हुई; उस समय ब्रह्मा, इन्द्र आदि प्रधान देवता भी इसे नहीं जान पाये। मंगलमयी पार्वतीको पूर्ववत् शम्भुके समीप स्थित देखकर सब कुछ जाननेवाले ब्रह्मा भी उनकी मायासे
verses.wordMeaning: O Gajanana, you are worthy of being worshipped by brahmins, K$atriyas, VaiSyas and Sudras by the offerings of splendid edibles and food-stuffs for the achievement of all Siddhis.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Gajanana, you are worthy of being worshipped by brahmins, K$atriyas, VaiSyas and Sudras by the offerings of splendid edibles and food-stuffs for the achievement of all Siddhis.

verses.sanskrit: याः स्त्रियस्त्वां सदा कालं पुरुषाश् च विनायक यजन्ति तासां तेषां च त्वत्साम्यं दातुमर्हसि
verses.transliteration: yāḥ striyastvāṃ sadā kālaṃ puruṣāś ca vināyaka yajanti tāsāṃ teṣāṃ ca tvatsāmyaṃ dātumarhasi
verses.translation: There is nothing to be achieved by Devas and others anywhere in the three worlds without first worshipping you with scents, fragrant flowers and incense.
verses.hindi: उन देवदेवके शरीरमें प्रविष्ट हुईं उन पार्वतीने उनके कण्ठमें स्थित विषसे अपने शरीरको बनाया
verses.wordMeaning: There is nothing to be achieved by Devas and others anywhere in the three worlds without first worshipping you with scents, fragrant flowers and incense.
verses.commentary: Sense: There is nothing to be achieved by Devas and others anywhere in the three worlds without first worshipping you with scents, fragrant flowers and incense.

verses.sanskrit: त्वं भक्तान् सर्वयत्नेन रक्ष बालगणेश्वर यौवनस्थांश् च वृद्धांश् च इहामुत्र च पूजितः
verses.transliteration: tvaṃ bhaktān sarvayatnena rakṣa bālagaṇeśvara yauvanasthāṃś ca vṛddhāṃś ca ihāmutra ca pūjitaḥ
verses.translation: Those people, those human beings, who worship you are undoubtedly to be worshipped by even Indra and others.
verses.hindi: इसके बाद उन पार्वतीको विषभूता जानकर कामशत्रु शिव-ने अपने तीसरे नेत्रसे कालकण्ठी (कृष्णवर्णके कण्ठवाली) कपर्दिनी कालीको उत्पन्न किया जब विषके कारण कृष्णवर्णके कण्ठवाली काली
verses.wordMeaning: Those people, those human beings, who worship you are undoubtedly to be worshipped by even Indra and others.
verses.commentary: Sense: Those people, those human beings, who worship you are undoubtedly to be worshipped by even Indra and others.

verses.sanskrit: जगत्त्रये ऽत्र सर्वत्र त्वं हि विघ्नगणेश्वरः संपूज्यो वन्दनीयश् च भविष्यसि न संशयः
verses.transliteration: jagattraye 'tra sarvatra tvaṃ hi vighnagaṇeśvaraḥ saṃpūjyo vandanīyaś ca bhaviṣyasi na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: If those who seek benefits do not worship you, you will harass them through impediments, even if it be Brahma, Vi§i?u, Indra and Devas or even I myself.
verses.hindi: हुई। अब असिद्धिके कारण हैत्योंकी पराजय निश्चित है, इससे भवानी तथा परमेश्वर शिव-को प्रसन्नता हुई
verses.wordMeaning: If those who seek benefits do not worship you, you will harass them through impediments, even if it be Brahma, Vi§i?u, Indra and Devas or even I myself.
verses.commentary: Sense: If those who seek benefits do not worship you, you will harass them through impediments, even if it be Brahma, Vi§i?u, Indra and Devas or even I myself.

verses.sanskrit: मां च नारायणं वापि ब्रह्माणम् अपि पुत्रक यजन्ति यज्ञैर्वा विप्रैर् अग्रे पूज्यो भविष्यसि
verses.transliteration: māṃ ca nārāyaṇaṃ vāpi brahmāṇam api putraka yajanti yajñairvā viprair agre pūjyo bhaviṣyasi
verses.translation: Then lord Ganapati created Vighnaganas (attendants of impediment). Along with his Ganas he bowed to the lord and stood in front of him.
verses.hindi: विषसे अलंकृत कृष्णवर्णके कण्ठवाली तथा अग्निके सदृश स्वरूपवाली उस प्रादुर्भूत कालीको देखकर सभी उनके ललाटमें शिवकी भाँति तीसरा नेत्र था, मस्तकपर अति तीव्र चन्द्ररेखा थी, कण्ठमें कालकूट विष था, हाथमें विकराल तीक्ष्ण त्रिशूल था और वे सर्पोके हार-कुण्डल आदि आभूषण धारण किये हुए
verses.wordMeaning: Then lord Ganapati created Vighnaganas (attendants of impediment). Along with his Ganas he bowed to the lord and stood in front of him.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then lord Ganapati created Vighnaganas (attendants of impediment). Along with his Ganas he bowed to the lord and stood in front of him.

verses.sanskrit: त्वाम् अनभ्यर्च्य कल्याणं श्रौतं स्मार्तं च लौकिकम् कुरुते तस्य कल्याणम् अकल्याणं भविष्यति
verses.transliteration: tvām anabhyarcya kalyāṇaṃ śrautaṃ smārtaṃ ca laukikam kurute tasya kalyāṇam akalyāṇaṃ bhaviṣyati
verses.translation: Ever since then, people worship Ganesvara in this world. This Gaevara created obstacles in the ritual* of
verses.hindi: कालीके साथ दिव्य वस्त्र धारण किये हुई तथा सभी आभूषणोंसे विभूषित देवियाँ, सिद्धोंके स्वामी, सिद्धगण तथा पिशाच भी उत्पन्न हुए
verses.wordMeaning: Ever since then, people worship Ganesvara in this world. This Gaevara created obstacles in the ritual* of
verses.commentary: Sense: Ever since then, people worship Ganesvara in this world. This Gaevara created obstacles in the ritual* of

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणैः क्षत्रियैर्वैश्यैः शूद्रैश्चैव गजानन सम्पूज्य सर्वसिद्ध्यर्थं भक्ष्यभोज्यादिभिः शुभैः
verses.transliteration: brāhmaṇaiḥ kṣatriyairvaiśyaiḥ śūdraiścaiva gajānana sampūjya sarvasiddhyarthaṃ bhakṣyabhojyādibhiḥ śubhaiḥ
verses.translation: Ever since then, people worship Ganesvara in this world. This Gaevara created obstacles in the ritual* of
verses.hindi: तब उन पार्वतीकी आज्ञासे परमेश्वरी काली - ने सुराधिपोंको मारनेवाले असुर दारुकका वध कर दिया हे श्रेष्ठ विप्रो! उनके अतिशय वेग तथा क्रोधको अग्निसे यह सम्पूर्ण जगत् व्याकुल हो उठा। तब ईश्वर भव भी मायासे बालरूप धारणकर उन कालीको क्रोधाग्निको पीनेके लिये काशीमें श्‍्मशानमें जाकर
verses.wordMeaning: Ever since then, people worship Ganesvara in this world. This Gaevara created obstacles in the ritual* of
verses.commentary: Sense: Ever since then, people worship Ganesvara in this world. This Gaevara created obstacles in the ritual* of

verses.sanskrit: त्वां गन्धपुष्पधूपाद्यैर् अनभ्यर्च्य जगत्त्रये देवैरपि तथान्यैश् च लब्धव्यं नास्ति कुत्रचित्
verses.transliteration: tvāṃ gandhapuṣpadhūpādyair anabhyarcya jagattraye devairapi tathānyaiś ca labdhavyaṃ nāsti kutracit
verses.translation: Ever since then, people worship Ganesvara in this world. This Gaevara created obstacles in the ritual* of
verses.hindi: सा प्रविष्टा तनुं तस्य देवदेवस्य पार्वती । क्रण्ठस्थेन विषेणास्य तनुं चक्रे तदात्मनः
verses.wordMeaning: Ever since then, people worship Ganesvara in this world. This Gaevara created obstacles in the ritual* of
verses.commentary: Sense: Ever since then, people worship Ganesvara in this world. This Gaevara created obstacles in the ritual* of

verses.sanskrit: अभ्यर्चयन्ति ये लोका मानवास्तु विनायकम् ते चार्चनीयाः शक्राद्यैर् भविष्यन्ति न संशयः
verses.transliteration: abhyarcayanti ye lokā mānavāstu vināyakam te cārcanīyāḥ śakrādyair bhaviṣyanti na saṃśayaḥ
verses.translation: Ever since then, people worship Ganesvara in this world. This Gaevara created obstacles in the ritual* of
verses.hindi: ससर्ज कालीं कामारिः कालकण्ठी कपर्दिनीम् जाता यदा कालिमकालकण्ठी
verses.wordMeaning: Ever since then, people worship Ganesvara in this world. This Gaevara created obstacles in the ritual* of
verses.commentary: Sense: Ever since then, people worship Ganesvara in this world. This Gaevara created obstacles in the ritual* of

verses.sanskrit: अजं हरिं च मां वापि शक्रमन्यान्सुरानपि विघ्नैर् बाधयसि त्वां चेन् नार्चयन्ति फलार्थिनः
verses.transliteration: ajaṃ hariṃ ca māṃ vāpi śakramanyānsurānapi vighnair bādhayasi tvāṃ cen nārcayanti phalārthinaḥ
verses.translation: Ever since then, people worship Ganesvara in this world. This Gaevara created obstacles in the ritual* of
verses.hindi: जाता तदानीं विपुला जयश्रीः। देवेतराणामजयस्त्वसिद्धया
verses.wordMeaning: Ever since then, people worship Ganesvara in this world. This Gaevara created obstacles in the ritual* of
verses.commentary: Sense: Ever since then, people worship Ganesvara in this world. This Gaevara created obstacles in the ritual* of

verses.sanskrit: ससर्ज च तदा विघ्नगणं गणपतिः प्रभुः गणैः सार्धं नमस्कृत्वाप्य् अतिष्ठत्तस्य चाग्रतः
verses.transliteration: sasarja ca tadā vighnagaṇaṃ gaṇapatiḥ prabhuḥ gaṇaiḥ sārdhaṃ namaskṛtvāpy atiṣṭhattasya cāgrataḥ
verses.translation: Ever since then, people worship Ganesvara in this world. This Gaevara created obstacles in the ritual* of
verses.hindi: जातां तदानी सुरसिद्धसङ्घा कालीं गरालङ्कृतकालकण्ठी- मुपेन्द्रपद्योद्भवशक्र मुख्याः
verses.wordMeaning: Ever since then, people worship Ganesvara in this world. This Gaevara created obstacles in the ritual* of
verses.commentary: Sense: Ever since then, people worship Ganesvara in this world. This Gaevara created obstacles in the ritual* of

verses.sanskrit: तदा प्रभृति लोके ऽस्मिन् पूजयन्ति गणेश्वरम् दैत्यानां धर्मविघ्नं च चकारासौ गणेश्वरः
verses.transliteration: tadā prabhṛti loke 'smin pūjayanti gaṇeśvaram daityānāṃ dharmavighnaṃ ca cakārāsau gaṇeśvaraḥ
verses.translation: Ever since then, people worship Ganesvara in this world. This Gaevara created obstacles in the ritual* of
verses.hindi: कण्ठे करालं निशितं त्रिशूलं करे करालं च विभूषणानि
verses.wordMeaning: Ever since then, people worship Ganesvara in this world. This Gaevara created obstacles in the ritual* of
verses.commentary: Sense: Ever since then, people worship Ganesvara in this world. This Gaevara created obstacles in the ritual* of

verses.sanskrit: एतद्वः कथितं सर्वं स्कन्दाग्रजसमुद्भवम् यः पठेच्छृणुयाद्वापि श्रावयेद्वा सुखीभवेत्
verses.transliteration: etadvaḥ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ skandāgrajasamudbhavam yaḥ paṭhecchṛṇuyādvāpi śrāvayedvā sukhībhavet
verses.translation: Ever since then, people worship Ganesvara in this world. This Gaevara created obstacles in the ritual* of
verses.hindi: सार्ध दिव्याम्बरा देव्यः सर्वाभरणभूषिताः । सिद्धेन्द्रसिद्धाएच तथा पिशाचा जज्ञिरे पुनः ० ऊफ फफफ्फफफ फ फ फ फ फ़ फ फ़ फ फ फ़ फ फ़ फ फ़ क फ फी का फफफ फफ फफ फम
verses.wordMeaning: Ever since then, people worship Ganesvara in this world. This Gaevara created obstacles in the ritual* of
verses.commentary: Sense: Ever since then, people worship Ganesvara in this world. This Gaevara created obstacles in the ritual* of

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीलिङ्गमहापुराणे पूर्वभागे विनायकोत्पत्तिर्नाम पञ्चाधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः नृत्यारम्भः कथं शंभोः किमर्थं वा यथातथम् वक्तुमर्हसि चास्माकं श्रुतः स्कन्दाग्रजोद्भवः
verses.transliteration: iti śrīliṅgamahāpurāṇe pūrvabhāge vināyakotpattirnāma pañcādhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ nṛtyārambhaḥ kathaṃ śaṃbhoḥ kimarthaṃ vā yathātatham vaktumarhasi cāsmākaṃ śrutaḥ skandāgrajodbhavaḥ
verses.translation: We have heard about the nativity of the elder brother of Skanda. It behoves you now to tell us precisely wherefore and how Lord Siva begins his Tandava dance.
verses.hindi: स्तनजेन तदा सार्ध कोपमस्याः पपौ पुनः। क्रोधेनानेन वै बालः क्षेत्राणां रक्षकोऽभवत्
verses.wordMeaning: We have heard about the nativity of the elder brother of Skanda. It behoves you now to tell us precisely wherefore and how Lord Siva begins his Tandava dance.
verses.commentary: Sense: We have heard about the nativity of the elder brother of Skanda. It behoves you now to tell us precisely wherefore and how Lord Siva begins his Tandava dance.

verses.sanskrit: दारुको ऽसुरसम्भूतस् तपसा लब्धविक्रमः सूदयामास कालाग्निर् इव देवान्द्विजोत्तमान्
verses.transliteration: dāruko 'surasambhūtas tapasā labdhavikramaḥ sūdayāmāsa kālāgnir iva devāndvijottamān
verses.translation: Daruka born in the family of Asuras attained heroism through his penance. Like the fire at the end of a. yuga he killed Devas as well as brahmins.
verses.hindi: कृतमस्याः प्रसादार्थं देवदेवेन ताण्डवम्। तत्र सब्रह्मका देवाः सेनद्रोपेन्द्राः समन्ततः। प्रणेमुस्तुष्टुवुः कालीं पुनर्देवीं च पार्वतीम्
verses.wordMeaning: Daruka born in the family of Asuras attained heroism through his penance. Like the fire at the end of a. yuga he killed Devas as well as brahmins.
verses.commentary: Sense: Daruka born in the family of Asuras attained heroism through his penance. Like the fire at the end of a. yuga he killed Devas as well as brahmins.

verses.sanskrit: दारुकेण तदा देवास् ताडिताः पीडिता भृशम् ब्रह्माणं च तथेशानं कुमारं विष्णुमेव च
verses.transliteration: dārukeṇa tadā devās tāḍitāḥ pīḍitā bhṛśam brahmāṇaṃ ca tatheśānaṃ kumāraṃ viṣṇumeva ca
verses.translation: Devas were extremely afflicted and hurt by Daruka. They sought refuge in Brahma, ISana, Kumara, Visnu, Yama and Indra. Knowing that the Asura could be killed only by a woman, he was confronted in a battle by Indra 9 " and others in fine guises of women. Still they were overwhelmed by him. O brahmins, they approached Brahma and acquainted him with everything. Accompanied by Brahma they approached the lordofUma. With Brahma at the forefront, they eulogised him. Approaching the lord of Devas and bowing to him in diverse ways Brahma said i — **0 lord, the demon Daruka is a terrible fellow. We have been defeated by him at the outset. It behoves you to protect us by killing Daruka who is destined to be killed by a lady.
verses.hindi: हे द्विजो! उन बालरूप ईशानको देखकर ता. मायासे मोहित उन कालीने उन्हें उठाकर मस्तक इई.  अपना वक्षस्थित स्तन ग्रहण कराया
verses.wordMeaning: Devas were extremely afflicted and hurt by Daruka. They sought refuge in Brahma, ISana, Kumara, Visnu, Yama and Indra. Knowing that the Asura could be killed only by a woman, he was confronted in a battle by Indra 9 " and others in fine guises of women.…
verses.commentary: Sense: Devas were extremely afflicted and hurt by Daruka. They sought refuge in Brahma, ISana, Kumara, Visnu, Yama and Indra. Knowing that the Asura could be killed only by a woman, he was confronted in a battle by Indra 9 " and others in fine guises of women.…

verses.sanskrit: यममिन्द्रमनुप्राप्य स्त्रीवध्य इति चासुरः स्त्रीरूपधारिभिः स्तुत्यैर् ब्रह्माद्यैर्युधि संस्थितैः
verses.transliteration: yamamindramanuprāpya strīvadhya iti cāsuraḥ strīrūpadhāribhiḥ stutyair brahmādyairyudhi saṃsthitaiḥ
verses.translation: On hearing this submission of Brahma the lord who destroyed the eyes of Bhaga, said laughingly to the goddess, the daughter of the mountain-lord.
verses.hindi: तब वे बालरूप शिव दूधके साथ उनका क्रोध धे  पी गये और इस प्रकार वे इस क्रोधसे ्षेत्रोकी रक्ष  करनेवाले हो गये । उन बुद्धिमान् क्षेत्रपाल  भैरव-क्ष  भी आठ मूर्तियाँ हो गयीं। इस प्रकार वे काली स्त  बालकके द्वारा क्रोधमूच्छित (नष्ट संज्ञावाली) कर दौ  गयीं
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing this submission of Brahma the lord who destroyed the eyes of Bhaga, said laughingly to the goddess, the daughter of the mountain-lord.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing this submission of Brahma the lord who destroyed the eyes of Bhaga, said laughingly to the goddess, the daughter of the mountain-lord.

verses.sanskrit: बाधितास्तेन ते सर्वे ब्रह्माणं प्राप्य वै द्विजाः विज्ञाप्य तस्मै तत्सर्वं तेन सार्धमुमापतिम्
verses.transliteration: bādhitāstena te sarve brahmāṇaṃ prāpya vai dvijāḥ vijñāpya tasmai tatsarvaṃ tena sārdhamumāpatim
verses.translation: Afflicted by him, all those gods, O brahmins, went to Brahma. After informing him of everything, they approached the consort of Uma together with him.
verses.hindi: इसके बाद प्रीतियुक्त देवदेव शिवने इन काली- को प्रसन्नताके लिये सन्ध्याकालमें श्रेष्ठ भूतों तथा प्रेतोंके साथ ताण्डव नृत्य किया
verses.wordMeaning: Afflicted by him, all those gods, O brahmins, went to Brahma. After informing him of everything, they approached the consort of Uma together with him.
verses.commentary: Sense: Afflicted by him, all those gods, O brahmins, went to Brahma. After informing him of everything, they approached the consort of Uma together with him.

verses.sanskrit: सम्प्राप्य तुष्टुवुः सर्वे पितामहपुरोगमाः ब्रह्मा प्राप्य च देवेशं प्रणम्य बहुधा नतः
verses.transliteration: samprāpya tuṣṭuvuḥ sarve pitāmahapurogamāḥ brahmā prāpya ca deveśaṃ praṇamya bahudhā nataḥ
verses.translation: O splendid and good-looking lady, I am now requesting you for the welfare of the worlds to slay Daruka who is destined to be killed by a lady.
verses.hindi: शम्भुके नृत्यामृतका कण्ठपर्यन्त पान करके वे परमेश्वरी उस श्मशानमें सुखपूर्वक नाचने लगीं और योगिनियाँ भी उनके साथ नाचने लगीं वहाँपर ब्रह्मा-विष्णु-इन्द्रसहित सभी देवताओंने सभी ओरसे कालीको तथा पुनः देवी पार्वतीको प्रणाम किया और उनकी स्तुति की
verses.wordMeaning: O splendid and good-looking lady, I am now requesting you for the welfare of the worlds to slay Daruka who is destined to be killed by a lady.
verses.commentary: Sense: O splendid and good-looking lady, I am now requesting you for the welfare of the worlds to slay Daruka who is destined to be killed by a lady.

verses.sanskrit: दारुणो भगवान्दारुः पूर्वं तेन विनिर्जिताः निहत्य दारुकं दैत्यं स्त्रीवध्यं त्रातुमर्हसि
verses.transliteration: dāruṇo bhagavāndāruḥ pūrvaṃ tena vinirjitāḥ nihatya dārukaṃ daityaṃ strīvadhyaṃ trātumarhasi
verses.translation: On hearing his words, the goddess 967 entered the body of the lord, she being desirous of taking birth from the lord of Devas.
verses.hindi: हे ऋषियो ! इस प्रकार मैंने संक्षेपमें शूलधारी प्रभुके ताण्डवनृत्यका वर्णन कर दिया; “योगके आनन्दके कारण विभु शिव-का ताण्डव होता है'-एऐसा अन्य लोग कहते हैं
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing his words, the goddess 967 entered the body of the lord, she being desirous of taking birth from the lord of Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing his words, the goddess 967 entered the body of the lord, she being desirous of taking birth from the lord of Devas.

verses.sanskrit: विज्ञप्तिं ब्रह्मणः श्रुत्वा भगवान् भगनेत्रहा देवीमुवाच देवेशो गिरिजां प्रहसन्निव
verses.transliteration: vijñaptiṃ brahmaṇaḥ śrutvā bhagavān bhaganetrahā devīmuvāca deveśo girijāṃ prahasanniva
verses.translation: On seeing the splendid daughter of the lord of the mountains stationed by the side of the lord as before, even the omniscient four-faced lord Brahma was deluded by her Maya.
verses.hindi: शिवभक्त उपमन्युकी कथा तथा उमामहेश्वरद्वारा उसपर अनुग्रह करना एवं कालीमुपालभ्य गते देवे त्रियम्बके।
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing the splendid daughter of the lord of the mountains stationed by the side of the lord as before, even the omniscient four-faced lord Brahma was deluded by her Maya.
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing the splendid daughter of the lord of the mountains stationed by the side of the lord as before, even the omniscient four-faced lord Brahma was deluded by her Maya.

verses.sanskrit: भवतीं प्रार्थयाम्यद्य हिताय जगतां शुभे वधार्थं दारुकस्यास्य स्त्रीवध्यस्य वरानने
verses.transliteration: bhavatīṃ prārthayāmyadya hitāya jagatāṃ śubhe vadhārthaṃ dārukasyāsya strīvadhyasya varānane
verses.translation: Having entered the body of the lord of Devas, Parvati made her own body out of poison in the neck of the lord.
verses.hindi: ऋषिगण बोले- है सूतजी। पूर्वकालमें उपम महेश्वरसे गणाधिप पद प्राप्त करके पुनः कैसे प्राप्त किया; आप इस समय बतानेकी 80 कोजिये
verses.wordMeaning: Having entered the body of the lord of Devas, Parvati made her own body out of poison in the neck of the lord.
verses.commentary: Sense: Having entered the body of the lord of Devas, Parvati made her own body out of poison in the neck of the lord.

verses.sanskrit: अथ सा तस्य वचनं निशम्य जगतो ऽरणिः विवेश देहे देवस्य देवेशी जन्मतत्परा
verses.transliteration: atha sā tasya vacanaṃ niśamya jagato 'raṇiḥ viveśa dehe devasya deveśī janmatatparā
verses.translation: On coming to know of this the enemy of Kama (i. e. Siva) created Kali the blue-necked goddess with matted hair from his third eye.
verses.hindi: सूतजी बोले- है ऋषियो ! इस प्रकार कालीकी उत्पन्न करके त्रिनेत्र शिवके चले जानेपर उपमन्युने उपमन्युः समभ्यर्च्य तपसा लब्धवान् फलम्॥ २  द्वारा उनकी पूजा करके फल प्राप्त किया था
verses.wordMeaning: On coming to know of this the enemy of Kama (i. e. Siva) created Kali the blue-necked goddess with matted hair from his third eye.
verses.commentary: Sense: On coming to know of this the enemy of Kama (i. e. Siva) created Kali the blue-necked goddess with matted hair from his third eye.

verses.sanskrit: एकेनांशेन देवेशं प्रविष्टा देवसत्तमम् न विवेद तदा ब्रह्मा देवाश्चेन्द्रपुरोगमाः
verses.transliteration: ekenāṃśena deveśaṃ praviṣṭā devasattamam na viveda tadā brahmā devāścendrapurogamāḥ
verses.translation: When the black-neckcd goddess was born the glory of victory too originated. Now Bhavani and Paramesvara were sure to inflict defeat over the demon.
verses.hindi: शिवभक्त उपमन्युकी तथा न्युको कथा तथा उमामहेश्वरद्वारा उसपर अनुग्रह करना ५५९
verses.wordMeaning: When the black-neckcd goddess was born the glory of victory too originated. Now Bhavani and Paramesvara were sure to inflict defeat over the demon.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the black-neckcd goddess was born the glory of victory too originated. Now Bhavani and Paramesvara were sure to inflict defeat over the demon.

verses.sanskrit: गिरिजां पूर्ववच्छंभोर् दृष्ट्वा पार्श्वस्थितां शुभाम् मायया मोहितस्तस्याः सर्वज्ञो ऽपि चतुर्मुखः
verses.transliteration: girijāṃ pūrvavacchaṃbhor dṛṣṭvā pārśvasthitāṃ śubhām māyayā mohitastasyāḥ sarvajño 'pi caturmukhaḥ
verses.translation: On seeing Kali who resembled fire and whose black neck was embellished with poison, taking her origin, Devas and Siddhas, the chief of whom were Vi$nu, Brahma and Indra, fled, due to fright;
verses.hindi: ख्यातो मुनिश्च द्विजसत्तमा:। पीत्वा स्थितं यथाकामं दृष्ट्वा प्रोवाच मातरम्।
verses.wordMeaning: On seeing Kali who resembled fire and whose black neck was embellished with poison, taking her origin, Devas and Siddhas, the chief of whom were Vi$nu, Brahma and Indra, fled, due to fright;
verses.commentary: Sense: On seeing Kali who resembled fire and whose black neck was embellished with poison, taking her origin, Devas and Siddhas, the chief of whom were Vi$nu, Brahma and Indra, fled, due to fright;

verses.sanskrit: सा प्रविष्टा तनुं तस्य देवदेवस्य पार्वती कण्ठस्थेन विषेणास्य तनुं चक्रे तदात्मनः
verses.transliteration: sā praviṣṭā tanuṃ tasya devadevasya pārvatī kaṇṭhasthena viṣeṇāsya tanuṃ cakre tadātmanaḥ
verses.translation: Similarly, an eye manifested itself in the forehead, the exalted contour of the crescent moon on the head, the terrible poison in the neck, the sharp and the terrible trident in the arm and the ornaments in their respective places.
verses.hindi: गव्यं क्षीरमतिस्वादु नाल्पमुष्णं नमाम्यहम्।
verses.wordMeaning: Similarly, an eye manifested itself in the forehead, the exalted contour of the crescent moon on the head, the terrible poison in the neck, the sharp and the terrible trident in the arm and the ornaments in their respective places.
verses.commentary: Sense: Similarly, an eye manifested itself in the forehead, the exalted contour of the crescent moon on the head, the terrible poison in the neck, the sharp and the terrible trident in the arm and the ornaments in their respective places.

verses.sanskrit: तां च ज्ञात्वा तथाभूतां तृतीयेनेक्षणेन वै ससर्ज कालीं कामारिः कालकण्ठीं कपर्दिनीम्
verses.transliteration: tāṃ ca jñātvā tathābhūtāṃ tṛtīyenekṣaṇena vai sasarja kālīṃ kāmāriḥ kālakaṇṭhīṃ kapardinīm
verses.translation: Along with the goddess were bom the lords of Siddhas as well as Pisacas who w r ore divine garments and who were bedecked in ornaments.
verses.hindi: उपलालितैवं पुत्रेण पुत्रमालिङ्ग्य सादरम् आलिङ्ग्यादाय दुःखार्ता प्रददौ कृत्रिमं पयः
verses.wordMeaning: Along with the goddess were bom the lords of Siddhas as well as Pisacas who w r ore divine garments and who were bedecked in ornaments.
verses.commentary: Sense: Along with the goddess were bom the lords of Siddhas as well as Pisacas who w r ore divine garments and who were bedecked in ornaments.

verses.sanskrit: जाता यदा कालिमकालकण्ठी जाता तदानीं विपुला जयश्रीः देवेतराणामजयस्त्वसिद्ध्या तुष्टिर्भवान्याः परमेश्वरस्य
verses.transliteration: jātā yadā kālimakālakaṇṭhī jātā tadānīṃ vipulā jayaśrīḥ devetarāṇāmajayastvasiddhyā tuṣṭirbhavānyāḥ parameśvarasya
verses.translation: At the behest of Parvati, the great goddess slew the demon Daruka who used to attack and kill the chiefs among Devas.
verses.hindi: सम्मार्ज्य नेत्रे पुत्रस्य कराभ्यां कमलायते
verses.wordMeaning: At the behest of Parvati, the great goddess slew the demon Daruka who used to attack and kill the chiefs among Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: At the behest of Parvati, the great goddess slew the demon Daruka who used to attack and kill the chiefs among Devas.

verses.sanskrit: जातां तदानीं सुरसिद्धसंघा दृष्ट्वा भयाद् दुद्रुवुर् अग्निकल्पाम् कालीं गरालंकृतकालकण्ठीम् उपेन्द्रपद्मोद्भवशक्रमुख्याः
verses.transliteration: jātāṃ tadānīṃ surasiddhasaṃghā dṛṣṭvā bhayād dudruvur agnikalpām kālīṃ garālaṃkṛtakālakaṇṭhīm upendrapadmodbhavaśakramukhyāḥ
verses.translation: O leading brahmins, by virtue of impetuosity, and the fire of anger, the entire universe became agitated.
verses.hindi: भाग्यहीना न पश्यन्ति भक्तिहीनाश्च ये शिवे राज्यं स्वर्ग च मोक्षं च भोजनं क्षीरसम्भवम्। न लभन्ते प्रियाण्येषां नो तुष्यति सदा भवः
verses.wordMeaning: O leading brahmins, by virtue of impetuosity, and the fire of anger, the entire universe became agitated.
verses.commentary: Sense: O leading brahmins, by virtue of impetuosity, and the fire of anger, the entire universe became agitated.

verses.sanskrit: तथैव जातं नयनं ललाटे सितांशुलेखा च शिरस्युदग्रा कण्ठे करालं निशितं त्रिशूलं करे करालं च विभूषणानि
verses.transliteration: tathaiva jātaṃ nayanaṃ lalāṭe sitāṃśulekhā ca śirasyudagrā kaṇṭhe karālaṃ niśitaṃ triśūlaṃ kare karālaṃ ca vibhūṣaṇāni
verses.translation: jagato'raoib — the source of creation.
verses.hindi: हे श्रेष्ठ द्विजो! “उपमन्यु'-इस नामसे प्रसिद्ध मुनि थे; कुमारके समान तेजस्वी उन्होंने किसी समय स्वेच्छानुसार खेलते हुए अपने मामाके आश्रममें थोड़ा-सा दूध पी लिया, तब ईर्ष्येके कारण उनके
verses.wordMeaning: jagato'raoib — the source of creation.
verses.commentary: Sense: jagato'raoib — the source of creation.

verses.sanskrit: सार्धं दिव्यांबरा देव्याः सर्वाभरणभूषिताः सिद्धेन्द्रसिद्धाश् च तथा पिशाचा जज्ञिरे पुनः
verses.transliteration: sārdhaṃ divyāṃbarā devyāḥ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitāḥ siddhendrasiddhāś ca tathā piśācā jajñire punaḥ
verses.translation: Bhava assumed the form of a boy due to his power of Maya and stationed himself in the cremation ground full of corpses and ghosts. l£vara, then cried in order to quaff the fire of her anger.
verses.hindi: मामाके पुत्रने उत्तम दुग्धका पान किया तब इच्छानुसार दुग्ध पीकर उसे पासमें खड़ा देखकर उपमन्युने अपनी मातासे कहा-हे मातः! हे महाभागे! है तपस्विनि! आप मुझको गायका दुग्ध
verses.wordMeaning: Bhava assumed the form of a boy due to his power of Maya and stationed himself in the cremation ground full of corpses and ghosts. l£vara, then cried in order to quaff the fire of her anger.
verses.commentary: Sense: Bhava assumed the form of a boy due to his power of Maya and stationed himself in the cremation ground full of corpses and ghosts. l£vara, then cried in order to quaff the fire of her anger.

verses.sanskrit: आज्ञया दारुकं तस्याः पार्वत्याः परमेश्वरी दानवं सूदयामास सूदयन्तं सुराधिपान्
verses.transliteration: ājñayā dārukaṃ tasyāḥ pārvatyāḥ parameśvarī dānavaṃ sūdayāmāsa sūdayantaṃ surādhipān
verses.translation: O brahmins, on seeing the boy, who was actually l£ana the goddess was deluded by his Maya. She took him, kissed him on his head and suckled him at her breasts.
verses.hindi: न हो; मैं आपको नमस्कार करता हूँ॥ ५/२ ॥
verses.wordMeaning: O brahmins, on seeing the boy, who was actually l£ana the goddess was deluded by his Maya. She took him, kissed him on his head and suckled him at her breasts.
verses.commentary: Sense: O brahmins, on seeing the boy, who was actually l£ana the goddess was deluded by his Maya. She took him, kissed him on his head and suckled him at her breasts.

verses.sanskrit: संरंभातिप्रसंगाद् वै तस्याः सर्वमिदं जगत् क्रोधाग्निना च विप्रेन्द्राः संबभूव तदातुरम्
verses.transliteration: saṃraṃbhātiprasaṃgād vai tasyāḥ sarvamidaṃ jagat krodhāgninā ca viprendrāḥ saṃbabhūva tadāturam
verses.translation: Along with her breast-milk the boy quaffed up her warth also and he became the protector of the holy centres.
verses.hindi: सूतजी बोले--इस प्रकार पुत्रके द्वारा स्नेह- पूर्वक कही गयी वह बात सुनकर माता आदरके साथ पुत्रका आलिंगन करके दुःखित हो गयी और अपनी निर्धनताका स्मरणकर व्याकुल होकर विलाप करने लगी। है द्विजो! बार-बार दूधका स्मरण करके महातेजस्वी उपमन्यु भी मातासे रोते हुए यही कहते थे- मुझे दो, मुझे दो'

verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, there was a sage known as Upamanyu. He was as refulgent as Karttikeya. 972 Once while playing about in the hermitage of his maternal uncle, he got only a small quantity of milk while his uncle's son drank a good quantity of excellent milk malicioulsy. On seeing him drinking milk as much as he pleased, Upamanyu spoke to his mother. "O mother, O highly blessed mother, O ascetic woman, give me cow's sweet milk, which should be hot and not too little in quantity. I am bowing down to you."
