verses.transliteration: gavyaṃ kṣīram atisvādu nālpamuṣṇaṃ namāmyaham upalālitaivaṃ putreṇa putram āliṅgya sādaram
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, on drinking the artificial milk given by his mother the boy became dejected and said, "O mother, this is not milk".
verses.hindi: जाता है, वही प्राप्त होता है; विष्णु अथवा अन्य तब माताका वचन सुनकर महातेजस्वी बालक उपमन्यु भी तपस्विनी माताको प्रणाम करके बोला-हे महाभागे! शोकका त्याग करो; महादेवजी चाहे कहीं भी हों, मैं शीघ्र अथवा विलम्बसे क्षीरसमुद्रको प्राप्त कर
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent brahmins, on drinking the artificial milk given by his mother the boy became dejected and said, "O mother, this is not milk".
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent brahmins, on drinking the artificial milk given by his mother the boy became dejected and said, "O mother, this is not milk".

verses.sanskrit: दुःखिता विललापार्ता स्मृत्वा नैर्धन्यमात्मनः स्मृत्वा स्मृत्वा पुनः क्षीरम् उपमन्युरपि द्विजाः देहि देहीति तामाह रोदमानो महाद्युतिः
verses.transliteration: duḥkhitā vilalāpārtā smṛtvā nairdhanyamātmanaḥ smṛtvā smṛtvā punaḥ kṣīram upamanyurapi dvijāḥ dehi dehīti tāmāha rodamāno mahādyutiḥ
verses.translation: There is a river full of jewels within the range of heaven and nether worlds. Those who are unfortunate, being devoid of devotion to Siva do not perceive it.
verses.hindi: सूतजी बोले-- है क्रषियो! उसे प्रणामकर वे उपमन्यु तप करनेके लिये प्रवृत्त हुए। तब माताने पुत्रसे कहा-- पूर्णरूपसे अत्यन्त शुभ तपस्या करो।' उससे आज्ञा प्राप्त करके हिमवान् पर्वतपर जाकर
verses.wordMeaning: There is a river full of jewels within the range of heaven and nether worlds. Those who are unfortunate, being devoid of devotion to Siva do not perceive it.
verses.commentary: Sense: There is a river full of jewels within the range of heaven and nether worlds. Those who are unfortunate, being devoid of devotion to Siva do not perceive it.

verses.sanskrit: उञ्छवृत्त्यार्जितान् बीजान् स्वयं पिष्ट्वा च सा तदा बीजपिष्टं तदालोड्य तोयेन कलभाषिणी
verses.transliteration: uñchavṛttyārjitān bījān svayaṃ piṣṭvā ca sā tadā bījapiṣṭaṃ tadāloḍya toyena kalabhāṣiṇī
verses.translation: Such persons do not obtain kingdom, heaven, salva- tion and the diet of milk. They do not achieve pleasing things unless Bhava is satisfied with them.
verses.hindi: वायुका आहार करते हुए एकाग्रचित्त होकर वे अति कठोर तप करने लगे॥ १८-१९१/२॥ उस विप्रकी तपस्यासे सम्पूर्ण जगत् तप्त हो उठा । तब सभी श्रेष्ठ देवताओंने विष्णुको प्रणाम करके वह बात बतायी। इसके बाद उनका वचन सुनकर वे भगवान् पुरुषोत्तम “यह क्या है'--ऐसा सोचकर पुनः
verses.wordMeaning: Such persons do not obtain kingdom, heaven, salva- tion and the diet of milk. They do not achieve pleasing things unless Bhava is satisfied with them.
verses.commentary: Sense: Such persons do not obtain kingdom, heaven, salva- tion and the diet of milk. They do not achieve pleasing things unless Bhava is satisfied with them.

verses.sanskrit: ऐह्येहि मम पुत्रेति सामपूर्वं ततः सुतम् आलिङ्ग्यादाय दुःखार्ता प्रददौ कृत्रिमं पयः
verses.transliteration: aihyehi mama putreti sāmapūrvaṃ tataḥ sutam āliṅgyādāya duḥkhārtā pradadau kṛtrimaṃ payaḥ
verses.translation: Kuxn&ra iva — Skanda-sadfiab ST. as Karttikeya.
verses.hindi: उसका कारण जानकर महेश्वरके दर्शनकी इच्छासे
verses.wordMeaning: Kuxn&ra iva — Skanda-sadfiab ST. as Karttikeya.
verses.commentary: Sense: Kuxn&ra iva — Skanda-sadfiab ST. as Karttikeya.

verses.sanskrit: पीत्वा च कृत्रिमं क्षीरं मात्रा दत्तं द्विजोत्तमाः नैतत्क्षीरमिति प्राह मातरं चातिविह्वलः
verses.transliteration: pītvā ca kṛtrimaṃ kṣīraṃ mātrā dattaṃ dvijottamāḥ naitatkṣīramiti prāha mātaraṃ cātivihvalaḥ
verses.translation: Everything results from the grace of Bhava and not from the grace of other deities. Those who are devoted to other deities are miserable, confused and bewildered.
verses.hindi: शिवको देखकर उन्हें प्रणाम करके विष्णुने हाथ जोड़कर यह कहा--'हे भगवन्! उपमन्यु नामसे प्रसिद्ध किसी ब्राह्मणने दुग्धके लिये अपनी तपस्यासे सबकी जला डाला; आप उसे रोकिये'॥ २३ /२॥ इसके अनन्तर पिनाकधारी देव परमेश्वरने इन्द्रक रूप धारणकर वहाँ जानेका विचार किया। तत्पश्चा सदाशिव देवराज इन्र-का रूप धारणकर रत गजराजपर आरूढ होकर सुरों, असुरों, सिद्धो तथा मर्ह
verses.wordMeaning: Everything results from the grace of Bhava and not from the grace of other deities. Those who are devoted to other deities are miserable, confused and bewildered.
verses.commentary: Sense: Everything results from the grace of Bhava and not from the grace of other deities. Those who are devoted to other deities are miserable, confused and bewildered.

verses.sanskrit: दुःखिता सा तदा प्राह सम्प्रेक्ष्याघ्राय मूर्धनि संमार्ज्य नेत्रे पुत्रस्य कराभ्यां कमलायते
verses.transliteration: duḥkhitā sā tadā prāha samprekṣyāghrāya mūrdhani saṃmārjya netre putrasya karābhyāṃ kamalāyate
verses.translation: Whence can we get milk? We have not worshipped Mahadeva. O son, only that can be achieved, which has been gifted after exalting Siva and not by exalting Viftiu or any other lord.
verses.hindi: नागोंके साथ मुनिके तपोबनमें गये
verses.wordMeaning: Whence can we get milk? We have not worshipped Mahadeva. O son, only that can be achieved, which has been gifted after exalting Siva and not by exalting Viftiu or any other lord.
verses.commentary: Sense: Whence can we get milk? We have not worshipped Mahadeva. O son, only that can be achieved, which has been gifted after exalting Siva and not by exalting Viftiu or any other lord.

verses.sanskrit: तटिनी रत्नपूर्णास्ते स्वर्गपातालगोचराः भाग्यहीना न पश्यन्ति भक्तिहीनाश् च ये शिवे
verses.transliteration: taṭinī ratnapūrṇāste svargapātālagocarāḥ bhāgyahīnā na paśyanti bhaktihīnāś ca ye śive
verses.translation: The mother then said to him, C( Perform the splendid penance perfectly". On being permitted by her he performed a very severe penance.
verses.hindi: शिवभक्त उपमन्युकी कथा तथा उमामहेश्वरद्वारा उसपर अनुग्रह करना RBBB क क भ काक कफ आजम म मी sR = कक फ क कक फ फफ फ फ फ फ फ फ फफ फ फ फ फ फ फफ फ फफ फ फ फ फ फ फफफ फफ फफफ फ फफ का काकर
verses.wordMeaning: The mother then said to him, C( Perform the splendid penance perfectly". On being permitted by her he performed a very severe penance.
verses.commentary: Sense: The mother then said to him, C( Perform the splendid penance perfectly". On being permitted by her he performed a very severe penance.

verses.sanskrit: राज्यं स्वर्गं च मोक्षं च भोजनं क्षीरसंभवम् न लभन्ते प्रियाण्येषां नो तुष्यति सदा भवः
verses.transliteration: rājyaṃ svargaṃ ca mokṣaṃ ca bhojanaṃ kṣīrasaṃbhavam na labhante priyāṇyeṣāṃ no tuṣyati sadā bhavaḥ
verses.translation: He went to the mountain Himavan. With great atten- tion and concentration he took in only wind as food. Due to his penance the universe became agitated.
verses.hindi: करेण चान्येन सितातपत्रम्
verses.wordMeaning: He went to the mountain Himavan. With great atten- tion and concentration he took in only wind as food. Due to his penance the universe became agitated.
verses.commentary: Sense: He went to the mountain Himavan. With great atten- tion and concentration he took in only wind as food. Due to his penance the universe became agitated.

verses.sanskrit: भवप्रसादजं सर्वं नान्यदेवप्रसादजम् अन्यदेवेषु निरता दुःखार्ता विभ्रमन्ति च
verses.transliteration: bhavaprasādajaṃ sarvaṃ nānyadevaprasādajam anyadeveṣu niratā duḥkhārtā vibhramanti ca
verses.translation: The excellent Devas bowed down to Vi$nu and mentioned everything to him. On hearing their words lord Vis$u thought, "What is this?" On deep consideration he re- realized the cause. With a desire to see MaheSvara, he hastened to the Mandara mountain. On seeing the lord, he joined his palms in reverence, bowed down to him and said: — "O lord, a certain brahmin boy known as Upamanyu has, for the sake of milk, burnt everything by means of his penance. Curb him." On hearing their petition, the Pinaka-bearing lord resolved to
verses.hindi: राज भगवान् सोमः शक्ररूपी सदाशिवः। सितातपत्रेण यथा चन्द्रबिम्बेन मन्दरः जगामानुग्रहं कर्तुमुपमन्योस्तदाश्रमम्
verses.wordMeaning: The excellent Devas bowed down to Vi$nu and mentioned everything to him. On hearing their words lord Vis$u thought, "What is this?" On deep consideration he re- realized the cause. With a desire to see MaheSvara, he hastened to the Mandara mountain. On seeing the lord,…
verses.commentary: Sense: The excellent Devas bowed down to Vi$nu and mentioned everything to him. On hearing their words lord Vis$u thought, "What is this?" On deep consideration he re- realized the cause. With a desire to see MaheSvara, he hastened to the Mandara mountain. On seeing the lord,…

verses.sanskrit: क्षीरं तत्र कुतो ऽस्माकं महादेवो न पूजितः पूर्वजन्मनि यद्दत्तं शिवमुद्यम्य वै सुत
verses.transliteration: kṣīraṃ tatra kuto 'smākaṃ mahādevo na pūjitaḥ pūrvajanmani yaddattaṃ śivamudyamya vai suta
verses.translation: Having assumed the form of Indra the king of immor- tal beings, he went to the penance grove of the sage riding on the white elephant. He was accompanied by Devas, Asuras, Siddhas and Nagas.
verses.hindi: तं दृष्ट्वा परमेशानं शक्ररूपधरं शिवम्। प्रणम्य शिरसा प्राह मुनिर्मुनिवराः स्वयम्
verses.wordMeaning: Having assumed the form of Indra the king of immor- tal beings, he went to the penance grove of the sage riding on the white elephant. He was accompanied by Devas, Asuras, Siddhas and Nagas.
verses.commentary: Sense: Having assumed the form of Indra the king of immor- tal beings, he went to the penance grove of the sage riding on the white elephant. He was accompanied by Devas, Asuras, Siddhas and Nagas.

verses.sanskrit: तदेव लभ्यं नान्यत्तु विष्णुमुद्यम्य वा प्रभुम् निशम्य वचनं मातुर् उपमन्युर्महाद्युतिः
verses.transliteration: tadeva labhyaṃ nānyattu viṣṇumudyamya vā prabhum niśamya vacanaṃ mātur upamanyurmahādyutiḥ
verses.translation: Indra was accompanied by $aci and he mounted the elephant. The sun held the fan in his left hand and the white umbrella iifthe other.
verses.hindi: पावितश्चाश्रमश्चायं मम देवेश्वरः स्वयम्। प्राप्तः शक्रो जगन्नाथो भगवान् भानुना प्रभुः एवमुक्तस्तदा तेन शक्रेण मुनिसत्तमः। वरयामि शिवे भक्तिमित्युवाच कृताञ्जलिः
verses.wordMeaning: Indra was accompanied by $aci and he mounted the elephant. The sun held the fan in his left hand and the white umbrella iifthe other.
verses.commentary: Sense: Indra was accompanied by $aci and he mounted the elephant. The sun held the fan in his left hand and the white umbrella iifthe other.

verses.sanskrit: बालो ऽपि मातरं प्राह प्रणिपत्य तपस्विनीम् त्यज शोकं महाभागे महादेवो ऽस्ति चेत्क्वचित्
verses.transliteration: bālo 'pi mātaraṃ prāha praṇipatya tapasvinīm tyaja śokaṃ mahābhāge mahādevo 'sti cetkvacit
verses.translation: With his white umbrella, lord Sadadiva who had assumed the form of Indra and was accompanied by Uma [in the form of Sac!] shone like. the Mandara mountain with the disc of the moon above it.
verses.hindi: उनके साथ ही उस हाथीपर चढ़कर सूर्यदेव अपने बाएँ हाथमें बालव्यजन तथा दाएँ हाथमें श्वेत छत्र लेकर शचीसहित सुरेन्द्रकी सेवा कर रहे थे
verses.wordMeaning: With his white umbrella, lord Sadadiva who had assumed the form of Indra and was accompanied by Uma [in the form of Sac!] shone like. the Mandara mountain with the disc of the moon above it.
verses.commentary: Sense: With his white umbrella, lord Sadadiva who had assumed the form of Indra and was accompanied by Uma [in the form of Sac!] shone like. the Mandara mountain with the disc of the moon above it.

verses.sanskrit: चिराद्वा ह्यचिराद्वापि क्षीरोदं साधयाम्यहम् तां प्रणम्यैवमुक्त्वा स तपः कर्तुं प्रचक्रमे
verses.transliteration: cirādvā hyacirādvāpi kṣīrodaṃ sādhayāmyaham tāṃ praṇamyaivamuktvā sa tapaḥ kartuṃ pracakrame
verses.translation: Having assumed the form of Indra like this, the lord went to the hermitage of Upamanyu in order to bless him.
verses.hindi: उस समय उमासहित शक्ररूपी भगवान् सदाशिव श्वेत छत्रसे उसी तरह सुशोभित हो रहे थे, जैसे चन्द्रबिम्बसे मन्दर पर्वत सुशोभित होता है इस प्रकार इनद्रका स्वरूप धारण करके परमेश्वर उस उपमन्युपर अनुग्रह करनेके लिये उसके आश्रममें गये
verses.wordMeaning: Having assumed the form of Indra like this, the lord went to the hermitage of Upamanyu in order to bless him.
verses.commentary: Sense: Having assumed the form of Indra like this, the lord went to the hermitage of Upamanyu in order to bless him.

verses.sanskrit: तमाह माता सुशुभं कुर्विति सुतरां सुतम् अनुज्ञातस्तया तत्र तपस्तेपे सुदुस्तरम्
verses.transliteration: tamāha mātā suśubhaṃ kurviti sutarāṃ sutam anujñātastayā tatra tapastepe sudustaram
verses.translation: "O highly intelligent sage of good holy rites, O elder brother of Dhaumya, I am delighted with you for your penance. Tell me the boon you wish to choose. I shall give you all desired things."
verses.hindi: हे मुनिवरो! इन्द्ररूपधारी उन परमेशान शिवको
verses.wordMeaning: "O highly intelligent sage of good holy rites, O elder brother of Dhaumya, I am delighted with you for your penance. Tell me the boon you wish to choose. I shall give you all desired things."
verses.commentary: Sense: "O highly intelligent sage of good holy rites, O elder brother of Dhaumya, I am delighted with you for your penance. Tell me the boon you wish to choose. I shall give you all desired things."

verses.sanskrit: हिमवत्पर्वतं प्राप्य वायुभक्षः समाहितः तपसा तस्य विप्रस्य विधूपितमभूज्जगत्
verses.transliteration: himavatparvataṃ prāpya vāyubhakṣaḥ samāhitaḥ tapasā tasya viprasya vidhūpitamabhūjjagat
verses.translation: The excellent sage who was thus urged by Indra, said with palms joined in reverence: — "I choose devotion to Siva."
verses.hindi: देखकर सिर झुकाकर प्रणाम करके मुनि उपमन्यु- जे स्वयं कहा--'मेरा यह आश्रम पवित्र हो गया; क्योंकि साथ यहाँ स्वयं आये हुए हैं'
verses.wordMeaning: The excellent sage who was thus urged by Indra, said with palms joined in reverence: — "I choose devotion to Siva."
verses.commentary: Sense: The excellent sage who was thus urged by Indra, said with palms joined in reverence: — "I choose devotion to Siva."

verses.sanskrit: प्रणम्याहुस्तु तत्सर्वे हरये देवसत्तमाः श्रुत्वा तेषां तदा वाक्यं भगवान्पुरुषोत्तमः
verses.transliteration: praṇamyāhustu tatsarve haraye devasattamāḥ śrutvā teṣāṃ tadā vākyaṃ bhagavānpuruṣottamaḥ
verses.translation: On hearing the words of the sage, Lord Isana himself in the guise of Indra said excitedly as if he was angry.
verses.hindi: ऐसा कहकर हाथ जोड़कर खड़े हुए द्विजको देखकर इन्द्ररूपधारी शिव गम्भीर वाणीमें बोले--' हे सुब्रत! मैं तुम्हारे इस तपसे प्रसन्न हो गया हूँ; वर माँगो। है ऋषि धौम्यके अग्रज! है महामते! मैं
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing the words of the sage, Lord Isana himself in the guise of Indra said excitedly as if he was angry.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the words of the sage, Lord Isana himself in the guise of Indra said excitedly as if he was angry.

verses.sanskrit: किमिदं त्विति संचिन्त्य ज्ञात्वा तत्कारणं च सः जगाम मन्दरं तूर्णं महेश्वरदिदृक्षया
verses.transliteration: kimidaṃ tviti saṃcintya jñātvā tatkāraṇaṃ ca saḥ jagāma mandaraṃ tūrṇaṃ maheśvaradidṛkṣayā
verses.translation: "O celestial sage, you do not know me, the lord of Devas. I am Indra the overlord of the three worlds, bowed to by all Devas.
verses.hindi: तुम्हें समस्त अभीष्ट प्रदान करता हूँ' तब शक्ररूपी शिवके हारा ऐसा कहे जानेपर मुनिश्रेष्ठने हाथ जोड़कर कहा-- मैं शिवमें भक्तिका वर माँगता हँ'
verses.wordMeaning: "O celestial sage, you do not know me, the lord of Devas. I am Indra the overlord of the three worlds, bowed to by all Devas.
verses.commentary: Sense: "O celestial sage, you do not know me, the lord of Devas. I am Indra the overlord of the three worlds, bowed to by all Devas.

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा देवं प्रणम्यैवं प्रोवाचेदं कृताञ्जलिः भगवन् ब्राह्मणः कश्चिद् उपमन्युरितिश्रुतः
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvā devaṃ praṇamyaivaṃ provācedaṃ kṛtāñjaliḥ bhagavan brāhmaṇaḥ kaścid upamanyuritiśrutaḥ
verses.translation: O brahmin sage, be my devotee. Worship me always.
verses.hindi: श्रीलिड्रमहापुराण
verses.wordMeaning: O brahmin sage, be my devotee. Worship me always.
verses.commentary: Sense: O brahmin sage, be my devotee. Worship me always.

verses.sanskrit: क्षीरार्थमदहत्सर्वं तपसा तं निवारय एतस्मिन्नन्तरे देवः पिनाकी परमेश्वरः शक्ररूपं समास्थाय गन्तुं चक्रे मतिं तदा
verses.transliteration: kṣīrārthamadahatsarvaṃ tapasā taṃ nivāraya etasminnantare devaḥ pinākī parameśvaraḥ śakrarūpaṃ samāsthāya gantuṃ cakre matiṃ tadā
verses.translation: On hearing the words of Indra that rent his ears, Upamanyu said thus after repeating the splendid fiVe-syllabled mantra: Om namas Sivaya.
verses.hindi: फुफफफफफफफफफ फफफ फक्क फाम की EEE मां न जानासि देवर्षे देवराजानमीश्वरम्। त्रैलोक्याधिपतिं शक्रं सर्वदेवनमस्कृतम्
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing the words of Indra that rent his ears, Upamanyu said thus after repeating the splendid fiVe-syllabled mantra: Om namas Sivaya.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the words of Indra that rent his ears, Upamanyu said thus after repeating the splendid fiVe-syllabled mantra: Om namas Sivaya.

verses.sanskrit: अथ जगाम मुनेस्तु तपोवनं गजवरेण सितेन सदाशिवः सह सुरासुरसिद्धमहोरगैर् अमरराजतनुं स्वयमास्थितः
verses.transliteration: atha jagāma munestu tapovanaṃ gajavareṇa sitena sadāśivaḥ saha surāsurasiddhamahoragair amararājatanuṃ svayamāsthitaḥ
verses.translation: "I think some base Daitya has come here in the guise
verses.hindi: ददामि सर्व भद्रं ते त्यज रुद्रं च निर्गुणम्
verses.wordMeaning: "I think some base Daitya has come here in the guise
verses.commentary: Sense: "I think some base Daitya has come here in the guise

verses.sanskrit: सहैव चारुह्य तदा द्विपं तं प्रगृह्य वालव्यजनं विवस्वान् ।* वामेन शच्या सहितं सुरेन्द्रं करेण चान्येन सितातपत्रम्
verses.transliteration: sahaiva cāruhya tadā dvipaṃ taṃ pragṛhya vālavyajanaṃ vivasvān /* vāmena śacyā sahitaṃ surendraṃ kareṇa cānyena sitātapatram
verses.translation: Every quality has been mentioned by you while engaged in censuring Bhava. Incidentally, the state of his being devoid of attributes has been extolled.
verses.hindi: कर्तु हैत्याधमः कश्चिद्धर्मविघ्नं च नान्यथा प्रसङ्काहेवदेवस्य निर्गुणत्वं महात्मनः
verses.wordMeaning: Every quality has been mentioned by you while engaged in censuring Bhava. Incidentally, the state of his being devoid of attributes has been extolled.
verses.commentary: Sense: Every quality has been mentioned by you while engaged in censuring Bhava. Incidentally, the state of his being devoid of attributes has been extolled.

verses.sanskrit: रराज भगवान् सोमः शक्ररूपी सदाशिवः सितातपत्रेण यथा चन्द्रबिंबेन मन्दरः
verses.transliteration: rarāja bhagavān somaḥ śakrarūpī sadāśivaḥ sitātapatreṇa yathā candrabiṃbena mandaraḥ
verses.translation: pSvitai cMramafe. We have adopted the N.S. reading.
verses.hindi: भवान्तरकृतं पापं श्रुता निन्दा भवस्य तु
verses.wordMeaning: pSvitai cMramafe. We have adopted the N.S. reading.
verses.commentary: Sense: pSvitai cMramafe. We have adopted the N.S. reading.

verses.sanskrit: आस्थायैवं हि शक्रस्य स्वरूपं परमेश्वरः जगामानुग्रहं कर्तुम् उपमन्योस् तदाश्रमम्
verses.transliteration: āsthāyaivaṃ hi śakrasya svarūpaṃ parameśvaraḥ jagāmānugrahaṃ kartum upamanyos tadāśramam
verses.translation: Of what avail is much talk? I know that I have com- mitted a great sin in my previous birth. For I am compelled to hear the censure of Bhava.
verses.hindi: श्रुत्वा निन्दां भवस्याथ तत्क्षणादेव सन्त्यजेत्। स्वदेहं तं निहत्याशु शिवलोकं स गच्छति यो वाचोत्पाटयेजिह्वां शिवनिन्दारतस्य तु। त्रिः सप्तकुलमुद्धृत्य शिवलोकं स गच्छति
verses.wordMeaning: Of what avail is much talk? I know that I have com- mitted a great sin in my previous birth. For I am compelled to hear the censure of Bhava.
verses.commentary: Sense: Of what avail is much talk? I know that I have com- mitted a great sin in my previous birth. For I am compelled to hear the censure of Bhava.

verses.sanskrit: तं दृष्ट्वा परमेशानं शक्ररूपधरं शिवम् प्रणम्य शिरसा प्राह मुनिर्मुनिवराः स्वयम्
verses.transliteration: taṃ dṛṣṭvā parameśānaṃ śakrarūpadharaṃ śivam praṇamya śirasā prāha munirmunivarāḥ svayam
verses.translation: On hearing the censure of Bhava, one must kill the person who censures, immediately and cast off his body at the very instant. He shall thereby go to the world of Siva.
verses.hindi: निहत्य त्वां शिवास्त्रेण त्यजाम्येतत्कलेवरम्
verses.wordMeaning: On hearing the censure of Bhava, one must kill the person who censures, immediately and cast off his body at the very instant. He shall thereby go to the world of Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: On hearing the censure of Bhava, one must kill the person who censures, immediately and cast off his body at the very instant. He shall thereby go to the world of Siva.

verses.sanskrit: पावितश्चाश्रमश्चायं मम देवेश्वरः स्वयम् प्राप्तः शक्रो जगन्नाथो भगवान्भानुना प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: pāvitaścāśramaścāyaṃ mama deveśvaraḥ svayam prāptaḥ śakro jagannātho bhagavānbhānunā prabhuḥ
verses.translation: He, who plucks out the tongue of the person who is engaged in censuring Siva verbally, uplifts twentyone genera- tions of his family and goes to the world of Siva.* 74
verses.hindi: एवमुक्त्वा तु तं देवमुपमन्युरभीतवत्। शक्रं चक्रे मतिं हन्तुमथर्वास्त्रेण मन्त्रवित् अतिष्ठच्च महातेजाः शुष्केन्धनमिवाव्यय:
verses.wordMeaning: He, who plucks out the tongue of the person who is engaged in censuring Siva verbally, uplifts twentyone genera- tions of his family and goes to the world of Siva.* 74
verses.commentary: Sense: He, who plucks out the tongue of the person who is engaged in censuring Siva verbally, uplifts twentyone genera- tions of his family and goes to the world of Siva.* 74

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्त्वा स्थितं वीक्ष्य कृताञ्जलिपुटं द्विजम् प्राह गंभीरया वाचा शक्ररूपधरो हरः
verses.transliteration: evamuktvā sthitaṃ vīkṣya kṛtāñjalipuṭaṃ dvijam prāha gaṃbhīrayā vācā śakrarūpadharo haraḥ
verses.translation: O base one, let alone my desire for milk. I shall leave off my body after killing you by the missile of Siva.
verses.hindi: एवं व्यवसिते विप्रे भगवान् भगनेत्रहा। वारयामास सौम्येन धारणां तस्य योगिनः
verses.wordMeaning: O base one, let alone my desire for milk. I shall leave off my body after killing you by the missile of Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: O base one, let alone my desire for milk. I shall leave off my body after killing you by the missile of Siva.

verses.sanskrit: तुष्टो ऽस्मि ते वरं ब्रूहि तपसानेन सुव्रत ददामि चेप्सितान् सर्वान् धौम्याग्रज महामते
verses.transliteration: tuṣṭo 'smi te varaṃ brūhi tapasānena suvrata dadāmi cepsitān sarvān dhaumyāgraja mahāmate
verses.translation: Undoubtedly what had been mentioned by my mother was true. The lord has not been worshipped by us in the previous birth."
verses.hindi: तब मुनिका वचन सुनकर इन्द्रका रूप षू  करनेवाले प्रभु ईशान कुपितकी भाँति गता बोले-'हे देव! तीनों लोकोके अधिपति ताह इन्द्रको क्या तुम नहीं जानते हो? है विप्रर्षे! तुमे  भक्त हो जाओ और सर्वदा मेरी ही पूजा करो, मै तु सब कुछ प्रदान करता हूँ, तुम्हारा कल्याण हो; निर्गुण शिवका त्याग कर दो'॥ ३४--३६॥
verses.wordMeaning: Undoubtedly what had been mentioned by my mother was true. The lord has not been worshipped by us in the previous birth."
verses.commentary: Sense: Undoubtedly what had been mentioned by my mother was true. The lord has not been worshipped by us in the previous birth."

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्तस्तदा तेन शक्रेण मुनिसत्तमः वरयामि शिवे भक्तिम् इत्युवाच कृताञ्जलिः
verses.transliteration: evamuktastadā tena śakreṇa munisattamaḥ varayāmi śive bhaktim ityuvāca kṛtāñjaliḥ
verses.translation: After saying this boldly to the lord, Upamanyu the knower of mantras resolved to kill Indra by means of the Atharva missile.
verses.hindi: तब इन्द्रका कर्णविदारक वचन सुनकर उपमन्यु पवित्र पंचाक्षरमन्त्रका जप करते हुए यह कहा-' अब मैं समझता हूँ कि निश्चय ही कोई अधम हैत्य स्वय इनद्रके स्वरूपमें मेरे धर्में विघ्न डालनेके लिये यहाँ
verses.wordMeaning: After saying this boldly to the lord, Upamanyu the knower of mantras resolved to kill Indra by means of the Atharva missile.
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying this boldly to the lord, Upamanyu the knower of mantras resolved to kill Indra by means of the Atharva missile.

verses.sanskrit: ततो निशम्य वचनं मुनेः कुपितवत्प्रभुः प्राह सव्यग्रमीशानः शक्ररूपधरः स्वयम्
verses.transliteration: tato niśamya vacanaṃ muneḥ kupitavatprabhuḥ prāha savyagramīśānaḥ śakrarūpadharaḥ svayam
verses.translation: The sage of great refulgence took a handful of Bhasman from the receptacle. Then, he discharged the Atharva missile against him and roared.
verses.hindi: आया है; इसमें सन्देह नहीं है। शिवनिन्दापरायण आपने ही प्रसंगवश महात्मा देवदेव शिव-की निर्गुणता भी बतायी है। अधिक कहनेसे क्या लाभ; मैंने आज अनुमान किया है कि पूर्वजन्ममें किया हुआ मेरा कोई महापाप अवश्य है, जिसके कारण मैंने शिवकी निन्दा सुनी है। जो शिवकी निन्दा सुनकर उसी क्षण उस शिवनिन्दक-को मारकर अपने शरीरको त्याग देता है, वह शिवलोकको जाता है। जो व्यक्ति वाणीसे
verses.wordMeaning: The sage of great refulgence took a handful of Bhasman from the receptacle. Then, he discharged the Atharva missile against him and roared.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sage of great refulgence took a handful of Bhasman from the receptacle. Then, he discharged the Atharva missile against him and roared.

verses.sanskrit: मां न जानासि देवर्षे देवराजानमीश्वरम् त्रैलोक्याधिपतिं शक्रं सर्वदेवनमस्कृतम्
verses.transliteration: māṃ na jānāsi devarṣe devarājānamīśvaram trailokyādhipatiṃ śakraṃ sarvadevanamaskṛtam
verses.translation: The sage of great brilliance, the unchanging soul meditated on the lord, invoked the Dharana of Agni, and got ready to burn his body like the dry fuel.
verses.hindi: शिवनिन्दा करनेवालेकी जीभ उखाड़ लेता है, वह अपनी इक्कीस पीढियोंका उद्धार करके शिवलोकको
verses.wordMeaning: The sage of great brilliance, the unchanging soul meditated on the lord, invoked the Dharana of Agni, and got ready to burn his body like the dry fuel.
verses.commentary: Sense: The sage of great brilliance, the unchanging soul meditated on the lord, invoked the Dharana of Agni, and got ready to burn his body like the dry fuel.

verses.sanskrit: मद्भक्तो भव विप्रर्षे मामेवार्चय सर्वदा ददामि सर्वं भद्रं ते त्यज रुद्रं च निर्गुणम्
verses.transliteration: madbhakto bhava viprarṣe māmevārcaya sarvadā dadāmi sarvaṃ bhadraṃ te tyaja rudraṃ ca nirguṇam
verses.translation: When the brahmin boy attempted this, the lord, the destroyer of the eyes of Bhaga, prevented him by means of the missile of Soma.
verses.hindi: जाता है। दूधके लिये मेरी जो इच्छा है, वह अब दूर रहे; शिवके अस्त्रसे तुझ सुराधमका वध करके मैं अपने इस शरीरका भी त्याग कर दूँगा। माताने पहले
verses.wordMeaning: When the brahmin boy attempted this, the lord, the destroyer of the eyes of Bhaga, prevented him by means of the missile of Soma.
verses.commentary: Sense: When the brahmin boy attempted this, the lord, the destroyer of the eyes of Bhaga, prevented him by means of the missile of Soma.

verses.sanskrit: ततः शक्रस्य वचनं श्रुत्वा श्रोत्रविदारणम् उपमन्युरिदं प्राह जपन् पञ्चाक्षरं शुभम्
verses.transliteration: tataḥ śakrasya vacanaṃ śrutvā śrotravidāraṇam upamanyuridaṃ prāha japan pañcākṣaraṃ śubham
verses.translation: The Atharva missile of that sage that resembled Kalagni was withdrawn by Candraka (moon) missile at the instance ofNandin.
verses.hindi: जो कहा था, वह सत्य है; इसमें सन्देह नहीं है। हमलोगेनै पूर्वजन्ममें शिवकी पूजा नहीं की थी'
verses.wordMeaning: The Atharva missile of that sage that resembled Kalagni was withdrawn by Candraka (moon) missile at the instance ofNandin.
verses.commentary: Sense: The Atharva missile of that sage that resembled Kalagni was withdrawn by Candraka (moon) missile at the instance ofNandin.

verses.sanskrit: मन्ये शक्रस्य रूपेण नूनम् अत्रागतः स्वयम् कर्तुं दैत्याधमः कश्चिद् धर्मविघ्नं च नान्यथा
verses.transliteration: manye śakrasya rūpeṇa nūnam atrāgataḥ svayam kartuṃ daityādhamaḥ kaścid dharmavighnaṃ ca nānyathā
verses.translation: Then lord Par ame£ vara assumed his own form with the crescent moon at his crest and showed himself to the brahmin.
verses.hindi: ऐसा कहकर निडरकी भाँति होकर मन्त्रव उपमन्युने उन इन्द्रदेवको अथर्वास्त्रसे मार देनेका विचार किया। उस महातेजस्वीने भस्मके आधारसे एक मु
verses.wordMeaning: Then lord Par ame£ vara assumed his own form with the crescent moon at his crest and showed himself to the brahmin.
verses.commentary: Sense: Then lord Par ame£ vara assumed his own form with the crescent moon at his crest and showed himself to the brahmin.

verses.sanskrit: त्वयैव कथितं सर्वं भवनिन्दारतेन वै प्रसंगाद्देवदेवस्य निर्गुणत्वं महात्मनः
verses.transliteration: tvayaiva kathitaṃ sarvaṃ bhavanindāratena vai prasaṃgāddevadevasya nirguṇatvaṃ mahātmanaḥ
verses.translation: All round the boy, the following appeared, viz: — thousands of milk currents, the milk ocean, the ocean of curd, the ocean of ghee, the ocean of fruits, the ocean of various edibles and food-s tuffs and mountains of Apupas.
verses.hindi: भस्म लेकर उसके लिये अथर्वास्त्रका सृजन किया और
verses.wordMeaning: All round the boy, the following appeared, viz: — thousands of milk currents, the milk ocean, the ocean of curd, the ocean of ghee, the ocean of fruits, the ocean of various edibles and food-s tuffs and mountains of Apupas.
verses.commentary: Sense: All round the boy, the following appeared, viz: — thousands of milk currents, the milk ocean, the ocean of curd, the ocean of ghee, the ocean of fruits, the ocean of various edibles and food-s tuffs and mountains of Apupas.

verses.sanskrit: बहुनात्र किमुक्तेन मयाद्यानुमितं महत् भवान्तरकृतं पापं श्रुता निन्दा भवस्य तु
verses.transliteration: bahunātra kimuktena mayādyānumitaṃ mahat bhavāntarakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ śrutā nindā bhavasya tu
verses.translation: The merciful lord looked smilingly at the smiling daughter of the mountain. He then sympathetically looked at
verses.hindi: जोरसे ध्वनि की। तब आग्नेयी धारणाका ध्यान अपने देहको सूखे ईंधनकी तरह जलानेके लिये  उस विप्रके ऐसा निश्चय करनेपर भगके नेत्रकी
verses.wordMeaning: The merciful lord looked smilingly at the smiling daughter of the mountain. He then sympathetically looked at
verses.commentary: Sense: The merciful lord looked smilingly at the smiling daughter of the mountain. He then sympathetically looked at

verses.sanskrit: श्रुत्वा निन्दां भवस्याथ तत्क्षणादेव संत्यजेत् स्वदेहं तं निहत्याशु शिवलोकं स गच्छति
verses.transliteration: śrutvā nindāṃ bhavasyātha tatkṣaṇādeva saṃtyajet svadehaṃ taṃ nihatyāśu śivalokaṃ sa gacchati
verses.translation: Mark the sectarian attitude of this puritya*
verses.hindi: अध्याय १०७ शिवभक्त उपमन्युकी कथा तथा उमामहेश्वरद्वारा उसपर अनुग्रह करना ५६३
verses.wordMeaning: Mark the sectarian attitude of this puritya*
verses.commentary: Sense: Mark the sectarian attitude of this puritya*

verses.sanskrit: यो वाचोत्पाटयेज्जिह्वां शिवनिन्दारतस्य तु त्रिः सप्तकुलमुद्धृत्य शिवलोकं स गच्छति
verses.transliteration: yo vācotpāṭayejjihvāṃ śivanindāratasya tu triḥ saptakulamuddhṛtya śivalokaṃ sa gacchati
verses.translation: See, O dear Upamanyu. Enjoy all pleasure as you desire in the company of your kinsmen. O highly blessed one, This Parvati is your mother.
verses.hindi: HARB काध माक कका फाम ममी ममी नी सभफभपपाफफफफफपफफफाफफफफफफपपफपफफफफफफपफमफफफपफपफणफफ़फफफफफपफफफ अथर्वास्त्रं हक न रक संहतं चन्द्रिकेण तु। करनेवाले भगवान् शिवने सोमधारणायोगसे उस कालाग्निसदुश नियोगान्नन्दिनस्तथा॥ ४९  योगी उपमन्यु -की  आग्नेयी धारणाको रोक दिया तब भगवानास्थाय परमेश्वर; ।  पके आदेशसे चन्द्रिक नामक गण-ने उसके कालाग्नि दर्शयामास विप्राय बालेन्दुकृतशेखरम्॥ ५० सदृश अथर्वास्त्रका संहरण कर लिया
verses.wordMeaning: See, O dear Upamanyu. Enjoy all pleasure as you desire in the company of your kinsmen. O highly blessed one, This Parvati is your mother.
verses.commentary: Sense: See, O dear Upamanyu. Enjoy all pleasure as you desire in the company of your kinsmen. O highly blessed one, This Parvati is your mother.

verses.sanskrit: आस्तां तावन्ममेच्छायाः क्षीरं प्रति सुराधमम् निहत्य त्वां शिवास्त्रेण त्यजाम्येतत्कलेवरम्
verses.transliteration: āstāṃ tāvanmamecchāyāḥ kṣīraṃ prati surādhamam nihatya tvāṃ śivāstreṇa tyajāmyetatkalevaram
verses.translation: You have been adopted as my son now. Hence, this ocean of milk, the ocean of honey, the ocean of curds, the ocean of rice soaked in ghee, the ocean of fruits and lambatives, the ocean of edibles and foodstuffs and also moun- tains of baked pies.
verses.hindi: इसके बाद भगवान् परमेश्‍वरने बालचन्द्रमासे
verses.wordMeaning: You have been adopted as my son now. Hence, this ocean of milk, the ocean of honey, the ocean of curds, the ocean of rice soaked in ghee, the ocean of fruits and lambatives, the ocean of edibles and foodstuffs and also moun- tains of baked pies.
verses.commentary: Sense: You have been adopted as my son now. Hence, this ocean of milk, the ocean of honey, the ocean of curds, the ocean of rice soaked in ghee, the ocean of fruits and lambatives, the ocean of edibles and foodstuffs and also moun- tains of baked pies.

verses.sanskrit: पुरा मात्रा तु कथितं तथ्यमेव न संशयः पूर्वजन्मनि चास्माभिर् अपूजित इति प्रभुः
verses.transliteration: purā mātrā tu kathitaṃ tathyameva na saṃśayaḥ pūrvajanmani cāsmābhir apūjita iti prabhuḥ
verses.translation: O sage, your father is Mahadeva who is the father of the worlds. Undoubtedly your highly blessed mother is the mother of the universe.
verses.hindi: शोभित मस्तकवाले अपने स्वरूपको धारण करके दध्यादेरर्णवं चैव घृतोदार्णवमेव च॥ ५१  विप्रको दिखाया फलार्णवं च बालस्य भक्ष्यभोज्यार्णवं त उस समय बालक उपमन्यु-के चारों और अपूपगिरयश्चैव तथातिष्ठन् भा  हजारों दुग्धधाराएँ, क्षीरसागर, मधुका समुद्र, दधिका
verses.wordMeaning: O sage, your father is Mahadeva who is the father of the worlds. Undoubtedly your highly blessed mother is the mother of the universe.
verses.commentary: Sense: O sage, your father is Mahadeva who is the father of the worlds. Undoubtedly your highly blessed mother is the mother of the universe.

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्त्वा तु तं देवम् उपमन्युरभीतवत् शक्रं चक्रे मतिं हन्तुम् अथर्वास्त्रेण मन्त्रवित्
verses.transliteration: evamuktvā tu taṃ devam upamanyurabhītavat śakraṃ cakre matiṃ hantum atharvāstreṇa mantravit
verses.translation: Immortality is bestowed upon you. So also the per- petual chieftancy of the Ganas. Choose your boons; you shall not hesitate in this matter. I shall give you whatever you ask for.
verses.hindi: हक 0 साग घृतका सागर, फलका सागर, अन्य भक्ष्य- उपमन्युमुवाच सस्मितो भोज्य पदार्थोका सागर तथा अपूपोंके पर्वत उपस्थित
verses.wordMeaning: Immortality is bestowed upon you. So also the per- petual chieftancy of the Ganas. Choose your boons; you shall not hesitate in this matter. I shall give you whatever you ask for.
verses.commentary: Sense: Immortality is bestowed upon you. So also the per- petual chieftancy of the Ganas. Choose your boons; you shall not hesitate in this matter. I shall give you whatever you ask for.

verses.sanskrit: भस्माधारान्महातेजा भस्ममुष्टिं प्रगृह्य च अथर्वास्त्रं ततस्तस्मै ससर्ज च ननाद च
verses.transliteration: bhasmādhārānmahātejā bhasmamuṣṭiṃ pragṛhya ca atharvāstraṃ tatastasmai sasarja ca nanāda ca
verses.translation: After saying thus, Mah&deva lifted him with his hands. Lord Bhava kissed him on the head and handed him to the goddess.
verses.hindi: तदनन्तर दयालु भगवान् शिव-ने मुसकानयुक्त गिरिजाको देखकर तथा बन्धुजनोंसे घिरे हुए उपमन्युको ओर दयापूर्वक देखकर मुसकराकर उससे कहा-- हे मेरे पुत्र! तुम अपने बान्धवोंके साथ इच्छानुसार भोगोंका उपभोग करो। है उपमन्यो! है महाभाग! देखो, ये पार्वती तुम्हारी माता हैं। मैंने आज तुम्हें अपना पुत्र बना लिया है और तुम्हें क्षीरसागर, मधुसागर, दधिसागर, घृत तथा ओदनका सागर, फलोंका सागर, लेह्य पदार्थोंका
verses.wordMeaning: After saying thus, Mah&deva lifted him with his hands. Lord Bhava kissed him on the head and handed him to the goddess.
verses.commentary: Sense: After saying thus, Mah&deva lifted him with his hands. Lord Bhava kissed him on the head and handed him to the goddess.

verses.sanskrit: दग्धुं स्वदेहम् आग्नेयीं ध्यात्वा वै धारणां तदा अतिष्ठच्च महातेजाः शुष्केन्धनमिवाव्ययः
verses.transliteration: dagdhuṃ svadeham āgneyīṃ dhyātvā vai dhāraṇāṃ tadā atiṣṭhacca mahātejāḥ śuṣkendhanamivāvyayaḥ
verses.translation: O excellent brahmins, on seeing her son the delighted goddess, the daughter of the mountain gave him yogaisvarya (the prosperity of the yoga) and the Brahmavidya ( the eso- teric doctrine of Brahman).
verses.hindi: सागर, अपूपोंके पर्वत तथा भक्ष्य-भोज्य पदार्थोका सागर प्रदान किया है। है मुने! सभी लोकोंके पिता महादेव तुम्हारे पिता हैं और जगज्जननी महाभागा पार्वती तुम्हारी माता हैं; इसमें सन्देह नहीं है । मैंने तुम्हें
verses.wordMeaning: O excellent brahmins, on seeing her son the delighted goddess, the daughter of the mountain gave him yogaisvarya (the prosperity of the yoga) and the Brahmavidya ( the eso- teric doctrine of Brahman).
verses.commentary: Sense: O excellent brahmins, on seeing her son the delighted goddess, the daughter of the mountain gave him yogaisvarya (the prosperity of the yoga) and the Brahmavidya ( the eso- teric doctrine of Brahman).

verses.sanskrit: एवं व्यवसिते विप्रे भगवान्भगनेत्रहा वारयामास सौम्येन धारणां तस्य योगिनः
verses.transliteration: evaṃ vyavasite vipre bhagavānbhaganetrahā vārayāmāsa saumyena dhāraṇāṃ tasya yoginaḥ
verses.translation: After attaining the boon from her, and the perpetual bachelorhood he eulogised Mahadeva with words choked with delight.
verses.hindi: अमरत्व तथा शाश्‍वत गाणपत्य प्रदान कर दिया, अब तुम अन्य वरोंको भी माँग लो, मैं तुम्हें दूँगा; इसमें तुम्हें सन्देह नहीं करना चाहिए' ऐसा कहकर महादेव विभु शिवने उसे दोनों हाथोंसे उठाकर उसका सिर सूँघकर पुनः उसे देवी पार्वती -को दे दिया
verses.wordMeaning: After attaining the boon from her, and the perpetual bachelorhood he eulogised Mahadeva with words choked with delight.
verses.commentary: Sense: After attaining the boon from her, and the perpetual bachelorhood he eulogised Mahadeva with words choked with delight.

verses.sanskrit: अथर्वास्त्रं तदा तस्य संहृतं चन्द्रकेण तु कालाग्निसदृशं चेदं नियोगान्नन्दिनस् तथा
verses.transliteration: atharvāstraṃ tadā tasya saṃhṛtaṃ candrakeṇa tu kālāgnisadṛśaṃ cedaṃ niyogānnandinas tathā
verses.translation: With palms joined in reverence he bowed down again and again to the lord. He chose boons with eyes devoid of Rajas Guria. 97D
verses.hindi: हे श्रेष्ठ द्विजो! तब अपने पुत्रको देखकर गिरिराजपुत्री देवी पार्वती-ने प्रसन्न होकर उसे योगैश्वर्यं तथा ब्रह्मविद्या प्रदान को
verses.wordMeaning: With palms joined in reverence he bowed down again and again to the lord. He chose boons with eyes devoid of Rajas Guria. 97D
verses.commentary: Sense: With palms joined in reverence he bowed down again and again to the lord. He chose boons with eyes devoid of Rajas Guria. 97D

verses.sanskrit: स्वरूपमेव भगवान् आस्थाय परमेश्वरः दर्शयामास विप्राय बालेन्दुकृतशेखरम्
verses.transliteration: svarūpameva bhagavān āsthāya parameśvaraḥ darśayāmāsa viprāya bālendukṛtaśekharam
verses.translation: O lord of the chiefs of Devas, bless me with un- swerving devotion unto you. O Mahadeva, may I have faith and perpetual nearness to you. On thus being requested by him the smiling lord Sankara offered the brahmin the cherished desire. Thereafter the lord vanished there itself.
verses.hindi: उसने भी उन पार्वतीसे वर तथा शाश्वत कुमारत्व प्राप्त करके हर्षके कारण गद्गद वाणीसे महादेवकी भगवान् बन्धुजनैः समावृतम्। गिरिजामवलोक्य सस्मितां सघृणं प्रेक्ष तु तं तदा घृणी
verses.wordMeaning: O lord of the chiefs of Devas, bless me with un- swerving devotion unto you. O Mahadeva, may I have faith and perpetual nearness to you. On thus being requested by him the smiling lord Sankara offered the brahmin the cherished desire. Thereafter the lord vanished there itself.
verses.commentary: Sense: O lord of the chiefs of Devas, bless me with un- swerving devotion unto you. O Mahadeva, may I have faith and perpetual nearness to you. On thus being requested by him the smiling lord Sankara offered the brahmin the cherished desire. Thereafter the lord vanished there itself.

verses.sanskrit: क्षीरधारासहस्रं च क्षीरोदार्णवमेव च दध्यादेरर्णवं चैव घृतोदार्णवमेव च
verses.transliteration: kṣīradhārāsahasraṃ ca kṣīrodārṇavameva ca dadhyāderarṇavaṃ caiva ghṛtodārṇavameva ca
verses.translation: virajck?anam — virajc?u eva iksanam yasya tam ST. one who looks after the affairs of only those who are given to benevolent activities.
verses.hindi: भुङ्क्ष्व भोगान् यथाकामं बान्धवैः पश्य वत्स मे। उपमन्यो महाभाग तवाम्बैषा हि पार्वती
verses.wordMeaning: virajck?anam — virajc?u eva iksanam yasya tam ST. one who looks after the affairs of only those who are given to benevolent activities.
verses.commentary: Sense: virajck?anam — virajc?u eva iksanam yasya tam ST. one who looks after the affairs of only those who are given to benevolent activities.

verses.sanskrit: फलार्णवं च बालस्य भक्ष्यभोज्यार्णवं तथा अपूपगिरयश्चैव तथातिष्ठन् समन्ततः
verses.transliteration: phalārṇavaṃ ca bālasya bhakṣyabhojyārṇavaṃ tathā apūpagirayaścaiva tathātiṣṭhan samantataḥ
verses.translation: virajck?anam — virajc?u eva iksanam yasya tam ST. one who looks after the affairs of only those who are given to benevolent activities.

verses.wordMeaning: virajck?anam — virajc?u eva iksanam yasya tam ST. one who looks after the affairs of only those who are given to benevolent activities.
verses.commentary: Sense: virajck?anam — virajc?u eva iksanam yasya tam ST. one who looks after the affairs of only those who are given to benevolent activities.

verses.sanskrit: उपमन्युमुवाच सस्मितो भगवान्बन्धुजनैः समावृतम् गिरिजाम् अवलोक्य सस्मितां सघृणं प्रेक्ष्यतु तं तदा घृणी
verses.transliteration: upamanyumuvāca sasmito bhagavānbandhujanaiḥ samāvṛtam girijām avalokya sasmitāṃ saghṛṇaṃ prekṣyatu taṃ tadā ghṛṇī
verses.translation: virajck?anam — virajc?u eva iksanam yasya tam ST. one who looks after the affairs of only those who are given to benevolent activities.

verses.wordMeaning: virajck?anam — virajc?u eva iksanam yasya tam ST. one who looks after the affairs of only those who are given to benevolent activities.

verses.transliteration: pitā tava mahādevaḥ pitā vai jagatāṃ mune mātā tava mahābhāgā jaganmātā na saṃśayaḥ

verses.commentary: Sense: virajck?anam — virajc?u eva iksanam yasya tam ST. one who looks after the affairs of only those who are given to benevolent activities.

verses.transliteration: devī tanayamālokya dadau tasmai girīndrajā yogaiśvaryaṃ tadā tuṣṭā brahmavidyāṃ dvijottamāḥ
verses.translation: virajck?anam — virajc?u eva iksanam yasya tam ST. one who looks after the affairs of only those who are given to benevolent activities.
verses.hindi: एवमुक्तस्तदा तेन प्रहसन्निव शङ्कुरः। विप्रको वांछित वर प्रदान करके वहांपर अन्तर्धान हो दत्त्वेप्सितं हि विप्राय तत्रैवान्तरधीयत॥ ६४  गये भगवान् श्रीकृष्णका गुरु उपमन्युके आश्रममें जाना और उनसे पाशुपतञ्ञान प्राप्त करना तथा पाशुपतव्रतका माहात्म्य
verses.wordMeaning: virajck?anam — virajc?u eva iksanam yasya tam ST. one who looks after the affairs of only those who are given to benevolent activities.
verses.commentary: Sense: virajck?anam — virajc?u eva iksanam yasya tam ST. one who looks after the affairs of only those who are given to benevolent activities.

verses.sanskrit: सो ऽपि लब्ध्वा वरं तस्याः कुमारत्वं च सर्वदा तुष्टाव च महादेवं हर्षगद्गदया गिरा
verses.transliteration: so 'pi labdhvā varaṃ tasyāḥ kumāratvaṃ ca sarvadā tuṣṭāva ca mahādevaṃ harṣagadgadayā girā
verses.translation: virajck?anam — virajc?u eva iksanam yasya tam ST. one who looks after the affairs of only those who are given to benevolent activities.
verses.hindi: ऋषय ऊचुः ऋषिगण बोले-अक्लिष्ट कर्मवाले वासु
verses.wordMeaning: virajck?anam — virajc?u eva iksanam yasya tam ST. one who looks after the affairs of only those who are given to benevolent activities.
verses.commentary: Sense: virajck?anam — virajc?u eva iksanam yasya tam ST. one who looks after the affairs of only those who are given to benevolent activities.

verses.sanskrit: वरयामास च तदा वरेण्यं विरजेक्षणम् कृताञ्जलिपुटो भूत्वा प्रणिपत्य पुनः पुनः
verses.transliteration: varayāmāsa ca tadā vareṇyaṃ virajekṣaṇam kṛtāñjalipuṭo bhūtvā praṇipatya punaḥ punaḥ
verses.translation: virajck?anam — virajc?u eva iksanam yasya tam ST. one who looks after the affairs of only those who are given to benevolent activities.
verses.hindi: ही) लाए वासुदेवेन कृष्णेनाक्लिष्टकर्मणा। श्रीकृष्णने धौम्यके ज्येष्ठ भ्राता उपमन्यु -का द याग्रजः लब्धं दिव्यं पाशुपतं व्रतम्॥ १  किया था और उनसे दिव्य पाशुपतत्रत ग्रहण किया थी  कथ लब्धं तदा ज्ञानं तस्मात्कृष्णेन धीमता।  है सूतजी! बुद्धिमान् श्रीकृष्णने उनसे यह ज्ञात

verses.commentary: Sense: virajck?anam — virajc?u eva iksanam yasya tam ST. one who looks after the affairs of only those who are given to benevolent activities.

verses.sanskrit: प्रसीद देवदेवेश त्वयि चाव्यभिचारिणी श्रद्धा चैव महादेव सान्निध्यं चैव सर्वदा
verses.transliteration: prasīda devadeveśa tvayi cāvyabhicāriṇī śraddhā caiva mahādeva sānnidhyaṃ caiva sarvadā
verses.translation: virajck?anam — virajc?u eva iksanam yasya tam ST. one who looks after the affairs of only those who are given to benevolent activities.
verses.hindi: वक्तुमहसि तां सूत कथां पातकनाशिनीम्॥ २  प्राप्त किया; उस पापनाशिनी कथाको बतानेकी कष
verses.wordMeaning: virajck?anam — virajc?u eva iksanam yasya tam ST. one who looks after the affairs of only those who are given to benevolent activities.
verses.commentary: Sense: virajck?anam — virajc?u eva iksanam yasya tam ST. one who looks after the affairs of only those who are given to benevolent activities.

verses.transliteration: evamuktastadā tena prahasanniva śaṅkaraḥ dattvepsitaṃ hi viprāya tatraivāntaradhīyata
verses.translation: virajck?anam — virajc?u eva iksanam yasya tam ST. one who looks after the affairs of only those who are given to benevolent activities.
verses.hindi: अध्याय १०८ भगवान् श्रीकृष्णका गुरु उपमन्युके आश्रममें जाना”'पाशुपतब्रतका माहात्म्य अक्कल टा स क काका आमाका अ जि्कजककककफफकककफफफफफफफफफफफफफफपफफफकफफफकफ कफ फी फाफफ फक

verses.commentary: Sense: virajck?anam — virajc?u eva iksanam yasya tam ST. one who looks after the affairs of only those who are given to benevolent activities.

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रीलिङ्गमहापुराणे पूर्वभागे उपमन्युचरितं नाम सप्ताधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः दृष्टो ऽसौ वासुदेवेन कृष्णेनाक्लिष्टकर्मणा धौम्याग्रजस्ततो लब्धं दिव्यं पाशुपतं व्रतम्
verses.transliteration: iti śrīliṅgamahāpurāṇe pūrvabhāge upamanyucaritaṃ nāma saptādhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ dṛṣṭo 'sau vāsudevena kṛṣṇenākliṣṭakarmaṇā dhaumyāgrajastato labdhaṃ divyaṃ pāśupataṃ vratam
verses.translation: O Suta, how was the knowledge acquired from him by the intelligent Ky§$a? It behoves you to recount this story that destroys all sins.
verses.hindi: च्छया ह्यवतीर्णोऽपि वासुदेवः सनातनः। निन्दयन्तेव मानुष्यं देहशुद्धिं चकार सः
verses.wordMeaning: O Suta, how was the knowledge acquired from him by the intelligent Ky§$a? It behoves you to recount this story that destroys all sins.
verses.commentary: Sense: O Suta, how was the knowledge acquired from him by the intelligent Ky§$a? It behoves you to recount this story that destroys all sins.

verses.sanskrit: कथं लब्धं तदा ज्ञानं तस्मात्कृष्णेन धीमता वक्तुमर्हसि तां सूत कथां पातकनाशिनीम्
verses.transliteration: kathaṃ labdhaṃ tadā jñānaṃ tasmātkṛṣṇena dhīmatā vaktumarhasi tāṃ sūta kathāṃ pātakanāśinīm
verses.translation: Although the eternal lord had incarnated of his own accord as the son of Vasudeva, yet he despised human form and so performed purificatory rites for the body.
verses.hindi: आश्रमं चोपमन्योर्वै दृष्टवांस्तत्र तं मुनिम्॥ नमश्चकार तं दृष्ट्वा धौम्याग्रजमहो द्विजाः।
verses.wordMeaning: Although the eternal lord had incarnated of his own accord as the son of Vasudeva, yet he despised human form and so performed purificatory rites for the body.
verses.commentary: Sense: Although the eternal lord had incarnated of his own accord as the son of Vasudeva, yet he despised human form and so performed purificatory rites for the body.

verses.sanskrit: स्वेच्छया ह्यवतीर्णो ऽपि वासुदेवः सनातनः निन्दयन्नेव मानुष्यं देहशुद्धिं चकार सः
verses.transliteration: svecchayā hyavatīrṇo 'pi vāsudevaḥ sanātanaḥ nindayanneva mānuṣyaṃ dehaśuddhiṃ cakāra saḥ
verses.translation: For obtaining sons the lord wanted to perform penance. He went to the hermitage of Upamanyu and saw that sage there.
verses.hindi: तस्यावलोकनादेव मुनेः कृष्णस्य धीमतः। नष्टमेव मलं सर्व कायजं कर्मजं तथा॥
verses.wordMeaning: For obtaining sons the lord wanted to perform penance. He went to the hermitage of Upamanyu and saw that sage there.
verses.commentary: Sense: For obtaining sons the lord wanted to perform penance. He went to the hermitage of Upamanyu and saw that sage there.

verses.sanskrit: पुत्रार्थं भगवांस्तत्र तपस्तप्तुं जगाम च आश्रमं चोपमन्योर्वै दृष्टवांस्तत्र तं मुनिम्
verses.transliteration: putrārthaṃ bhagavāṃstatra tapastaptuṃ jagāma ca āśramaṃ copamanyorvai dṛṣṭavāṃstatra taṃ munim
verses.translation: O brahmins, on seeing Upamanyu, the elder brother of Dhaumya, Krgna circumambulated him three times and bowed to him respectfully.
verses.hindi: तपसा त्वेकवर्षान्ते दृष्ट्वा देवं महेश्वरम्। सूतजी बोले-हे ऋषियो! सनातन वासुदेव अपनी इच्छासे अवतीर्ण हुए थे, फिर भी उन्होंने मानवरूपकी निन्दा करते हुए देहशुद्धि को थी
verses.wordMeaning: O brahmins, on seeing Upamanyu, the elder brother of Dhaumya, Krgna circumambulated him three times and bowed to him respectfully.
verses.commentary: Sense: O brahmins, on seeing Upamanyu, the elder brother of Dhaumya, Krgna circumambulated him three times and bowed to him respectfully.

verses.sanskrit: नमश्चकार तं दृष्ट्वा धौम्याग्रजमहो द्विजाः बहुमानेन वै कृष्णस् त्रिः कृत्वा वै प्रदक्षिणम्
verses.transliteration: namaścakāra taṃ dṛṣṭvā dhaumyāgrajamaho dvijāḥ bahumānena vai kṛṣṇas triḥ kṛtvā vai pradakṣiṇam
verses.translation: By the mere sight of that intelligent sage all the impu- rities of Kf$na originating from the body as well as physical activities perished.
verses.hindi: भगवान् श्रीकृष्ण पुत्रप्राप्तिहेतु तप करनेके लिये उपमन्युके आश्रममें गये और उन्होंने वहाँ उन मुनिका दर्शन किया। है द्विजो! उन धौम्याग्रजको
verses.wordMeaning: By the mere sight of that intelligent sage all the impu- rities of Kf$na originating from the body as well as physical activities perished.
verses.commentary: Sense: By the mere sight of that intelligent sage all the impu- rities of Kf$na originating from the body as well as physical activities perished.

verses.sanskrit: तस्यावलोकनादेव मुनेः कृष्णस्य धीमतः नष्टमेव मलं सर्वं कायजं कर्म्मजं तथा
verses.transliteration: tasyāvalokanādeva muneḥ kṛṣṇasya dhīmataḥ naṣṭameva malaṃ sarvaṃ kāyajaṃ karmmajaṃ tathā
verses.translation: O leading brahmins, repeating the mantras beginning with "Agnih" and "Vayub" in due order, Upamanyu of great lustre dusted him with Bhasman. With a delighted mind the sage gave him the perfect divine knowledge pertaining to Pa&upati. O brahmins, it was due to the favour of the sage that Kfa became initiated honourably in the divine rite of Paiupati.
verses.hindi: प्रदक्षिणा करके श्रीकृष्णने उन्हें नमस्कार किया उन मुनिके अवलोकनमात्रसे बुद्धिमान् श्रीकृष्णका सम्पूर्ण देहजनित तथा कर्मजनित मल नष्ट हो गया
verses.wordMeaning: O leading brahmins, repeating the mantras beginning with "Agnih" and "Vayub" in due order, Upamanyu of great lustre dusted him with Bhasman. With a delighted mind the sage gave him the perfect divine knowledge pertaining to Pa&upati. O brahmins,…
verses.commentary: Sense: O leading brahmins, repeating the mantras beginning with "Agnih" and "Vayub" in due order, Upamanyu of great lustre dusted him with Bhasman. With a delighted mind the sage gave him the perfect divine knowledge pertaining to Pa&upati. O brahmins,…

verses.sanskrit: भस्मनोद्धूलनं कृत्वा उपमन्युर्महाद्युतिः तमग्निरिति विप्रेन्द्रा वायुरित्यादिभिः क्रमात्
verses.transliteration: bhasmanoddhūlanaṃ kṛtvā upamanyurmahādyutiḥ tamagniriti viprendrā vāyurityādibhiḥ kramāt
verses.translation: By means of penance he saw lord Mahelvara at the end of a year. On seeing the lord accompanied by Amba 979 and the Gaas he obtained a son known as Samba who was
verses.hindi: करके प्रसन्नचित्त होकर क्रमसे अग्नि, वायु आदि मन्तरोंके
verses.wordMeaning: By means of penance he saw lord Mahelvara at the end of a year. On seeing the lord accompanied by Amba 979 and the Gaas he obtained a son known as Samba who was
verses.commentary: Sense: By means of penance he saw lord Mahelvara at the end of a year. On seeing the lord accompanied by Amba 979 and the Gaas he obtained a son known as Samba who was

verses.sanskrit: दिव्यं पाशुपतं ज्ञानं प्रददौ प्रीतमानसः मुनेः प्रसादान्मान्यो ऽसौ कृष्णः पाशुपते द्विजाः
verses.transliteration: divyaṃ pāśupataṃ jñānaṃ pradadau prītamānasaḥ muneḥ prasādānmānyo 'sau kṛṣṇaḥ pāśupate dvijāḥ
verses.translation: Ever since then, all the divine sages of unimpeded holy rites and all the devotees of Palupati surrounded Kna and stood by him.
verses.hindi: हे द्विजो! मुनिकी कृपासे वे श्रीकृष्ण पाशुपतत्रतमें मान्य हो गये। अपनी तपस्यासे एक वर्षके अन्तमें पार्वती तथा गणोंसहित अव्यग्र देव महेश्वरका दर्शन करके उन्होंने अपना पुत्र प्राप्त किया। उसी समयसे प्रशस्त व्रतवाले दिव्य मुनिगण तथा पशुपतिके सभी भक्त सदा उन कृष्णको घेरकर स्थित रहने
verses.wordMeaning: Ever since then, all the divine sages of unimpeded holy rites and all the devotees of Palupati surrounded Kna and stood by him.
verses.commentary: Sense: Ever since then, all the divine sages of unimpeded holy rites and all the devotees of Palupati surrounded Kna and stood by him.

verses.sanskrit: तपसा त्वेकवर्षान्ते दृष्ट्वा देवं महेश्वरम् सांबं सगणमव्यग्रं लब्धवान्पुत्रमात्मनः
verses.transliteration: tapasā tvekavarṣānte dṛṣṭvā devaṃ maheśvaram sāṃbaṃ sagaṇamavyagraṃ labdhavānputramātmanaḥ
verses.translation: I shall recount another holy rite that bestows per- petual salvation upon all living beings. The devotee shall make a gold girdle, a shaft-receptacle or support, a gold block spherical in shape and a fan with a handle. Then the man or woman shall make an ink-pot and a pen. He shall gather a knife or scissors and a vessel. The devotee shall dust his body with Bhasman and give these articles to a devotee of Pa£upati. He shall dedicate a golden, silver or copper vessel in accordance with his capacity. He shall then worship the yogins.

verses.sanskrit: तदाप्रभृति तं कृष्णं मुनयः संशितव्रताः दिव्याः पाशुपताः सर्वे तस्थुः संवृत्य सर्वदा
verses.transliteration: tadāprabhṛti taṃ kṛṣṇaṃ munayaḥ saṃśitavratāḥ divyāḥ pāśupatāḥ sarve tasthuḥ saṃvṛtya sarvadā
verses.translation: All these persons shall be liberated from their sins along with the members of their families. They will go to the divine region of Rudra. No doubt need be entertained in this respect.
verses.hindi: नरैः स्त्रियाथ वा कार्य मषीभाजनलेखनीमू क्षुराकर्तरिका चापि अथ पात्रमथापि वा। पाशुपताय दातव्यं भस्मोद्धूलितविग्रहैः
verses.wordMeaning: All these persons shall be liberated from their sins along with the members of their families. They will go to the divine region of Rudra. No doubt need be entertained in this respect.
verses.commentary: Sense: All these persons shall be liberated from their sins along with the members of their families. They will go to the divine region of Rudra. No doubt need be entertained in this respect.

verses.sanskrit: अन्यं च कथयिष्यामि मुक्त्यर्थं प्राणिनां सदा सौवर्णीं मेखलां कृत्वा आधारं दण्डधारणम्
verses.transliteration: anyaṃ ca kathayiṣyāmi muktyarthaṃ prāṇināṃ sadā sauvarṇīṃ mekhalāṃ kṛtvā ādhāraṃ daṇḍadhāraṇam
verses.translation: Hence, by means* of charitable gifts a householder is liberated from the bondage of worldly existence. If one makes charitable gifts to yogins, Siva becomes pleased quickly.
verses.hindi: ते सर्वे पापनिर्मुक्ताः समस्तकुलसंयुताः । यान्ति रुद्रपदं दिव्यं नात्र कार्या विचारणा
verses.wordMeaning: Hence, by means* of charitable gifts a householder is liberated from the bondage of worldly existence. If one makes charitable gifts to yogins, Siva becomes pleased quickly.
verses.commentary: Sense: Hence, by means* of charitable gifts a householder is liberated from the bondage of worldly existence. If one makes charitable gifts to yogins, Siva becomes pleased quickly.

verses.sanskrit: सौवर्णं पिण्डिकं चापि व्यजनं दण्डमेव च नरैः स्त्रियाथ वा कार्यं मषीभाजनलेखनीम्
verses.transliteration: sauvarṇaṃ piṇḍikaṃ cāpi vyajanaṃ daṇḍameva ca naraiḥ striyātha vā kāryaṃ maṣībhājanalekhanīm
verses.translation: If a person desires salvation, he shall make charitable gifts of kingdom, son, riches, horse, a vehicle or all his possession.
verses.hindi: योगिनां सम्प्रदानेन शिवः क्षिप्रं प्रसीदति सर्वस्वं वापि दातव्यं यदीच्छेनमोक्षमुत्तमम्
verses.wordMeaning: If a person desires salvation, he shall make charitable gifts of kingdom, son, riches, horse, a vehicle or all his possession.
verses.commentary: Sense: If a person desires salvation, he shall make charitable gifts of kingdom, son, riches, horse, a vehicle or all his possession.

verses.sanskrit: क्षुराः कर्तरिका चापि अथ पात्रमथापि वा पाशुपताय दातव्यं भस्मोद्धूलितविग्रहैः
verses.transliteration: kṣurāḥ kartarikā cāpi atha pātramathāpi vā pāśupatāya dātavyaṃ bhasmoddhūlitavigrahaiḥ
verses.translation: One shall strenuously attempt to achieve the fixed goal through his physical body that is uncertain and un- fixed. The excellent and eternal Pasupata vrata is the cause of redemption from the ocean of worldly existence.
verses.hindi: यः पठेच्छणुयाद्वापि विष्णुलोकं स गच्छति
verses.wordMeaning: One shall strenuously attempt to achieve the fixed goal through his physical body that is uncertain and un- fixed. The excellent and eternal Pasupata vrata is the cause of redemption from the ocean of worldly existence.
verses.commentary: Sense: One shall strenuously attempt to achieve the fixed goal through his physical body that is uncertain and un- fixed. The excellent and eternal Pasupata vrata is the cause of redemption from the ocean of worldly existence.

verses.sanskrit: सौवर्णं राजतं वापि ताम्रं वाथ निवेदयेत् आत्मवित्तानुसारेण योगिनं पूजयेद्बुधः
verses.transliteration: sauvarṇaṃ rājataṃ vāpi tāmraṃ vātha nivedayet ātmavittānusāreṇa yoginaṃ pūjayedbudhaḥ
verses.translation: Thus everything has been succinctly mentioned to you. He who reads this or listens to this undoubtedly goes to the World of Siva.
verses.hindi: हे ऋषियो! सदा सभी प्राणियोंकी लिये मैं अन्य व्रतको भी बताऊँगा। सुवर्णमयी (परिनालिका) बनाकर उसके आधार, (जलनिवारक बाहरी भाग), पिण्डिक ( लिङ्ग), दीक्षादण्ड--यह सब सोनेका बनाना चाहिए; साथ हौ
verses.wordMeaning: Thus everything has been succinctly mentioned to you. He who reads this or listens to this undoubtedly goes to the World of Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus everything has been succinctly mentioned to you. He who reads this or listens to this undoubtedly goes to the World of Siva.

verses.sanskrit: ते सर्वे पापनिर्मुक्ताः समस्तकुलसंयुताः यान्ति रुद्रपदं दिव्यं नात्र कार्या विचारणा
verses.transliteration: te sarve pāpanirmuktāḥ samastakulasaṃyutāḥ yānti rudrapadaṃ divyaṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā
verses.translation: Thus everything has been succinctly mentioned to you. He who reads this or listens to this undoubtedly goes to the World of Siva.
verses.hindi: स्वर्णमय बनाकर इन सभी सामग्रियोंको भस्मसे उद्धृत शरीरवाले पुरुषोंके द्वारा या स्त्रीके द्वारा किसी पशुपतिः भक्तको दे दिया जाना चाहिए। बुद्धिमान् व्यक्तिको चाहिए कि अपने धन-सामर्थ्यके अनुसार सोने, चाँदी
verses.wordMeaning: Thus everything has been succinctly mentioned to you. He who reads this or listens to this undoubtedly goes to the World of Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus everything has been succinctly mentioned to you. He who reads this or listens to this undoubtedly goes to the World of Siva.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मादनेन दानेन गृहस्थो मुच्यते भवात् योगिनां संप्रदानेन शिवः क्षिप्रं प्रसीदति
verses.transliteration: tasmādanena dānena gṛhastho mucyate bhavāt yogināṃ saṃpradānena śivaḥ kṣipraṃ prasīdati
verses.translation: Thus everything has been succinctly mentioned to you. He who reads this or listens to this undoubtedly goes to the World of Siva.
verses.hindi: अथवा ताँबेकी ही सामग्री समर्पित करै और उस योगीको पूजा करे॥ ११--१४॥ ऐसा दान करनेवाले वे सभीलोग सम्पूर्ण कुलसहित पापमुक्त होकर दिव्य रुद्रपदको जाते हैं; इसमें सन्देह नहीं करना चाहिए। अतः गृहस्थ इस दानके द्वारा संसार चक्र-से छूट जाता है। योगियोंके
verses.wordMeaning: Thus everything has been succinctly mentioned to you. He who reads this or listens to this undoubtedly goes to the World of Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus everything has been succinctly mentioned to you. He who reads this or listens to this undoubtedly goes to the World of Siva.

verses.sanskrit: राज्यं पुत्रं धनं भव्यम् अश्वं यानमथापि वा सर्वस्वं वापि दातव्यं यदीच्छेन्मोक्षमुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: rājyaṃ putraṃ dhanaṃ bhavyam aśvaṃ yānamathāpi vā sarvasvaṃ vāpi dātavyaṃ yadīcchenmokṣamuttamam
verses.translation: Thus everything has been succinctly mentioned to you. He who reads this or listens to this undoubtedly goes to the World of Siva.
verses.hindi: लिये यह दान करनेसे शिव शीघ्र ही प्रसन्न होते हैं। यदि कोई उत्तम मोक्ष चाहता हो, तो उसे भव्य राज्य, पुत्र, धन, अश्व, यान--यहाँतक कि सर्वस्वका दान कर देना चाहिए। इस अनित्य शरीरसे भव्य, नित्य
verses.wordMeaning: Thus everything has been succinctly mentioned to you. He who reads this or listens to this undoubtedly goes to the World of Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus everything has been succinctly mentioned to you. He who reads this or listens to this undoubtedly goes to the World of Siva.

verses.sanskrit: अध्रुवेण शरीरेण ध्रुवं साध्यं प्रयत्नतः भव्यं पाशुपतं नित्यं संसारार्णवतारकम्
verses.transliteration: adhruveṇa śarīreṇa dhruvaṃ sādhyaṃ prayatnataḥ bhavyaṃ pāśupataṃ nityaṃ saṃsārārṇavatārakam
verses.translation: Thus everything has been succinctly mentioned to you. He who reads this or listens to this undoubtedly goes to the World of Siva.
verses.hindi: (शाश्वत) तथा संसार-सागरसे पार करनेवाले पाशुपतव्रतको प्रयत्नपूर्वक अवश्य सिद्ध करा चाहिए॥ १५--१८॥ हे क्रषियो! मैंने संक्षेपमें आपलोगोंको यह सब बता दिया। जो इसे पढ़ता है अथवा सुनता है, वह विष्णुलोकको जाता है; इसमें संशय नहीं है
verses.wordMeaning: Thus everything has been succinctly mentioned to you. He who reads this or listens to this undoubtedly goes to the World of Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus everything has been succinctly mentioned to you. He who reads this or listens to this undoubtedly goes to the World of Siva.

verses.sanskrit: एतद्वः कथितं सर्वं संक्षेपान्न च संशयः यः पठेच्छृणुयाद्वापि विष्णुलोकं स गच्छति
verses.transliteration: etadvaḥ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ saṃkṣepānna ca saṃśayaḥ yaḥ paṭhecchṛṇuyādvāpi viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati
verses.translation: Thus everything has been succinctly mentioned to you. He who reads this or listens to this undoubtedly goes to the World of Siva.
verses.hindi: एक सौ आठवाँ अध्याय पूर्ण हुआ
verses.wordMeaning: Thus everything has been succinctly mentioned to you. He who reads this or listens to this undoubtedly goes to the World of Siva.
verses.commentary: Sense: Thus everything has been succinctly mentioned to you. He who reads this or listens to this undoubtedly goes to the World of Siva.
